6dfd0f179b53bc11fd75eeb04e1748e077591151.translatedText: "Police-Citizen Express Shanghai" Weibo content revealed: Today, the Shanghai police requested the Shanghai Huangpu District People's Procuratorate to arrest Lin, a suspect in the "4.1" case at Fudan University, on suspicion of intentional homicide.

cb997413364ee7bdbb76d8f706b57ae72bc70529.sourceText: 4月11日，市公安局文化保卫分局接复旦大学保卫处报案：该校枫林校区2010级硕士研究生黄某自4月1日引用了寝室内饮水机中的水后出现身体不适，有中毒迹象，正在医院抢救。
cb997413364ee7bdbb76d8f706b57ae72bc70529.translatedText: On April 11, the Cultural Security Bureau of the Municipal Public Security Bureau received a report from the Security Office of Fudan University: Huang, a 2010 graduate student at the Fenglin Campus of the school, had consumed water from the water dispenser in the dormitory since April 1. He was feeling unwell and showing signs of poisoning, and was being treated in the hospital.

cc37fc2bfdfae995a1ffee0175fa758a2841aeb8.sourceText: 上海警方接报后立即组织专案组开展侦查。经现场勘查和调查走访，锁定黄某同寝室同学林某有重大作案嫌疑，当晚依法对林某实施刑事传唤。4月12日，林某被警方依法刑事拘留。
cc37fc2bfdfae995a1ffee0175fa758a2841aeb8.translatedText: After receiving the report, the Shanghai police immediately organized a task force to conduct an investigation. After on-site inspection and investigation visits, they identified Huang's dormitory classmate Lin as suspected of committing a major crime. Suspicious, Lin was criminally summoned in accordance with the law that night.

d4e44b2fe35abeca13827363c8afce1f21696acb.sourceText: 经警方初步查明，林某因生活琐事与黄某不和，心存不满，经事先预谋， 3月31日中午，将其做实验后剩余并存放在实验室内的剧毒化合物带至寝室，注入饮水机水槽。4月1日晨，黄某饮用饮水机中的水后出现中毒症状，后经医院抢救无效于4月16日下午去世。
d4e44b2fe35abeca13827363c8afce1f21696acb.translatedText: After preliminary investigation by the police, Lin was dissatisfied with Huang due to trivial matters in his life. At noon on March 31, the highly toxic compounds left over from the experiment and stored in the laboratory were brought to the dormitory and poured into the water dispenser sink. On the morning of April 1, Huang developed symptoms of poisoning after drinking the water from the water dispenser. He later died in the afternoon of April 16 after the hospital's rescue efforts failed.

d428d2e33d19b6366485d2cdf4408daae77fd62e.sourceText: “亚利桑那好声音”校园歌手大赛初赛落下帏幕 ASU中国学生会, 八月恋歌KTV和太阳鸟亚省华人网共同举办的”Arizona好声音”校园歌手大赛初赛已经于2月17日（周日）落下了帷幕。来自亚利桑那州不同学校四十余位中外参赛选手为大家献上了两场精彩的比赛。并且，借鉴了好声音节目的”盲选”初赛形式也让参赛和观战的所有同学耳目一新。 经过两天激烈的角逐，十二名选手用他们的好声音征服了三位评委，并将于三月一日在ASU上演巅峰对决。 此次活动的前身是ASU的传统年度活动校园歌手大赛。在席卷全球的”好声音”浪潮下，这次的校园歌手大赛适时地进行了创新，打破州内校际限制，希望借助好声音的影响力，扩大这个传统活动的规模。学生会和八月恋歌对这次的活动有一个共同的愿景：希望能够成为中国在美留学生中的一个品牌活动。也正是为了这个目标，这次比赛的策划团队呕心沥血，希望能给大家奉上一场属于音乐的饕餮盛宴。 决赛的形式依旧借鉴了好声音节目的导师分组对抗。目前，十二位选手已经由三位导师分成了三支队伍。这三支队伍要通过对内对抗和队际对抗的方式，角逐最后的冠军和冠军队伍的头衔。由导师张也弛带领的队伍中，有一位选手格外引人注目，来自美国，金发碧眼，却操着一口流利普通话的帅哥棗马麟。刚接触中文两年半的他不仅用一首来自王洛宾作词的《一江水》赢得了评委的青睐，更是有着一手说相声的本事。初赛现场反应最为热烈的说唱歌手靖璟，在姜勋导师带领的队伍中，找到了同为业余音乐人的宫政。他居所的布置陈设俨然一个专业的音乐制作室，不仅为准备比赛，更是给了这次活动很大的音乐技术支持。导师高薇佳领衔的队伍中，更是有着”小汪峰”魏任天、专业研习过歌剧的陈翰文，和去年比赛中给人留下深刻印象的深情歌者林锐斌。这样的阵容，相信谁都不会对比赛的精彩和激烈有一丝的怀疑。即将进入最后一周备战的选手们，都在努力打磨自己的歌唱技巧，只等巅峰之夜，绽放他们所有的光华。 在此，亚利桑那州立大学学生学者联谊会，八月恋歌KTV和”太阳鸟”亚省华人网共同向亚利桑那州各界人士发出邀请，欢迎莅临指导我们此次”Arizona好声音”校园歌手大赛的决赛。让我们共同见证十二位选手、三支队伍充满激情和创造力的表演，见证校园活动走出校际，走向联合化、品牌化的第一步。 三月一日，共襄盛举。 感谢大凤凰城华人侨团联合总会（侨联）欣欣超市 新世界超市 魅力造型 台湾美食 翡翠轩美食的赞助和支持！
d428d2e33d19b6366485d2cdf4408daae77fd62e.translatedText: The preliminary round of the "Voice of Arizona" campus singer competition has come to an end ASU Chinese Student Union, The preliminary round of the "Voice of Arizona" campus singer competition jointly organized by August Love Song KTV and Sunbird Asia Chinese Network came to an end on February 17 (Sunday). More than 40 Chinese and foreign contestants from different schools in Arizona presented two exciting games to everyone. Moreover, the "blind audition" preliminary competition format, which was borrowed from the Good Voice program, was also refreshing to all students participating and watching. After two days of fierce competition, the twelve contestants conquered the three judges with their good voices and will stage a peak showdown at ASU on March 1. The predecessor of this event is ASU's traditional annual campus singer competition. Under the wave of "Good Voice" sweeping the world, this campus singer competition made timely innovations to break the inter-school restrictions within the state, hoping to use the influence of Good Voice to expand the scale of this traditional event. The Student Union and August Love Song have a common vision for this event: they hope to become a brand event among Chinese students studying in the United States. It is for this goal that the planning team of this competition has worked hard, hoping to provide everyone with a feast of music. The format of the finals still draws on the mentor group competition from the "Voice" program. Currently, the twelve players have been divided into three teams by three mentors. These three teams will compete for the final championship and the title of championship team through internal confrontation and inter-team confrontation. Among the team led by mentor Zhang Yezhi, one player stood out, Zao Malin, a handsome guy from the United States who was blond and blue-eyed but spoke fluent Mandarin. Having only been exposed to Chinese for two and a half years, he not only won the judges' favor with his song "One River" written by Wang Luobin, but he also has the ability to speak cross talk. Rapper Jing Jing, who had the most enthusiastic response at the preliminary round, found Gong Zheng, who is also an amateur musician, in the team led by instructor Jiang Xun. The layout of his residence is like a professional music production studio, which not only prepares for the competition, but also provides great musical technical support for this event. The team led by instructor Gao Weijia also includes "Little Wangfeng" Wei Rentian, Chen Hanwen, who has studied opera professionally, and Lin Ruibin, a soulful singer who left a deep impression in last year's competition. With such a lineup, I believe no one will have the slightest doubt about the excitement and intensity of the game. The contestants who are about to enter the final week of preparations are working hard to polish their singing skills and are just waiting for the peak night to shine in all their brilliance. Here, the Arizona State University Students and Scholars Association, August Love Song KTV and "Sunbird" Chinese Network of Arizona jointly extend invitations to people from all walks of life in Arizona. Welcome to come and guide us in the finals of the "Voice of Arizona" campus singer competition. Let us witness the passionate and creative performances of twelve contestants and three teams, and witness the first step in campus activities to go beyond inter-school and move toward unionization and branding. On March 1st, we participated in a grand event. Thank you to the Federation of Chinese Overseas Chinese Organizations in Greater Phoenix City (Overseas Chinese Federation) for their sponsorship and support!

Beijing and Shanghai have ranked among the world's major cities...

df5ad3a6e75ebea579860212513161be63adecbc.sourceText: 普华永道和纽约合作组织今天联合发布《机遇之都2012》研究报告，北京与上海在经济影响力及门户城市两项指标方面，已与伦敦、巴黎、纽约一起跻身世界主要城市五强。在2012年的排名中，北京在经济影响力方面超越了其他参评城市，包括众多历史上重要的全球性城市，从第九位跃居第一位。
df5ad3a6e75ebea579860212513161be63adecbc.translatedText: PricewaterhouseCoopers and the New York Partnership jointly released the "Cities of Opportunity 2012" research report today. Beijing and Shanghai have joined London, Paris and New York among the top five major cities in the world in terms of economic influence and gateway cities. In the 2012 ranking, Beijing surpassed other participating cities in terms of economic influence, including many historically important global cities, jumping from ninth to first.

dc3b1c0384756e98b48a7d3326f406842e28e16c.sourceText: 北京在多项经济变量上均名列前五名，包括：全球500强总部的数目名列第二，仅次于东京；GDP增长率名列第三；按资本投资额计算的外国直接投资名列第三，按新建项目计算名列第五；金融和商业服务工作机会数目名列第四，仅次于米兰、巴黎和伦敦。
dc3b1c0384756e98b48a7d3326f406842e28e16c.translatedText: Beijing ranks in the top five in a number of economic variables, including: second in the number of Fortune 500 headquarters, second only to Tokyo; third in GDP growth; third in foreign direct investment in terms of capital investment and fifth in terms of new projects; fourth in the number of financial and business services jobs, after Milan, Paris and London.

04a849e604d3dfacafebe41d176384ee9d4d26fa.sourceText: 上海在全球的经济影响力排名第五，比去年的第八位有所上升，同时上海在门户城市指标上排名第四。
04a849e604d3dfacafebe41d176384ee9d4d26fa.translatedText: Shanghai ranks fifth in global economic influence, up from eighth last year, and ranks fourth in the gateway city indicator.

60b80e059d5f7bbc7490640e01f7aadb74778b4b.sourceText: 门户城市是一个新的指标类别，以一系列数据变量衡量城市的全球连通性和吸引力，相关数据包括飞机起降架次和旅客总流量，上海在这两个变量上排名第七位；另外还有酒店客房数量，上海在这一变量上领先于其他26个城市。
60b80e059d5f7bbc7490640e01f7aadb74778b4b.translatedText: Gateway City is a new indicator category that measures a city's global connectivity and attractiveness based on a series of data variables. Relevant data include aircraft movements and total passenger flow, Shanghai ranks seventh on these two variables; there is also the number of hotel rooms, Shanghai is ahead of 26 other cities on this variable.

f21024e901dbed6e10e87983e5cc9726e23df8e1.sourceText: 同时，上海继续保持其在吸引国外直接投资领域的优势，无论是项目数量和投资金额方面均蝉联榜首，并在实际国内生产总值（GDP）增长率上排名第四。
f21024e901dbed6e10e87983e5cc9726e23df8e1.translatedText: At the same time, Shanghai continues to maintain its advantage in attracting foreign direct investment, ranking first in terms of number of projects and investment amount, and ranking fourth in terms of real gross domestic product (GDP) growth rate.

9c6fcf0d574ed6117befcb82c70fdb7f12aa53ed.sourceText: 报告称，老牌大都市纽约和伦敦依靠整体优势与其他城市划出一个分水岭。虽然纽约以微弱优势小胜伦敦，但在十大经济指标中没有获得单项领先。多伦多总体排名第三，显示出良好的平衡，但同样无单项胜出。巴黎和斯德哥尔摩位列第四和第五。
9c6fcf0d574ed6117befcb82c70fdb7f12aa53ed.translatedText: The report stated that the established metropolises New York and London rely on their overall advantages to draw a watershed from other cities. Although New York narrowly beat London, it did not take the lead in any of the top ten economic indicators. Toronto finished third overall, showing good balance, but again with no individual wins. Paris and Stockholm ranked fourth and fifth.

d2923a5d528974df9abcff8c5d5280808f479313.sourceText: 分析北京成全球城市巨人仍存改善空间
d2923a5d528974df9abcff8c5d5280808f479313.translatedText: Analysis that Beijing still has room for improvement to become a global urban giant

ec4bccc4998959cd3c490345db0fa5e3c1b5a122.sourceText: 报告称，上海和北京在一系列社会和经济指标上的平衡发展表明这两个城市已经做好准备，由单纯的快速发展向可持续发展转变。
ec4bccc4998959cd3c490345db0fa5e3c1b5a122.translatedText: The report said that the balanced development of Shanghai and Beijing on a series of social and economic indicators shows that the two cities are ready to transform from simple rapid development to sustainable development.

39eba95411101e48a3549f12bbeaa2838eb856af.sourceText: 普华永道中国公共政策与监管事务主管合伙人吴卫军表示：”北京在经济影响力指标上跃居第一，成为全球城市巨人。门户城市指标名列第三，具体变量包括从机场到市中心的方便程度名列第一，酒店客房数目名列第二，旅客总流量排名第六，在亚洲名列第二，以及主持的国际会议数目名列第四等，北京成为了’世界的城市’。”
39eba95411101e48a3549f12bbeaa2838eb856af.translatedText: > Wu Weijun, PwC China Public Policy and Regulatory Affairs Leader, said: "Beijing jumped to first place in the economic influence indicator and became a global city giant. The gateway city indicator ranked third. Specific variables include the convenience from the airport to the city center ranked first, the number of hotel rooms ranked second, and the total passenger flow ranked sixth in Asia. Ranking second and ranking fourth in terms of the number of international conferences it has hosted, Beijing has become a 'city of the world'. "

c429f8b8cbf3c9667e5f71970c705a5ac52e88e4.sourceText: 此外北京的亮点还包括：始终重视可持续发展，在可负担公共交通方面名列第一，使用者成本方面为第三低廉的城市，绿色空间方面名列第七，废物回收方面名列第八。在金融和商业服务业方面，北京的雇佣比例超过30%，也就是说北京的10个工作人口中就有3个服务于金融和商业服务业。该比例与米兰、巴黎、伦敦、旧金山、芝加哥等城市一般高。
c429f8b8cbf3c9667e5f71970c705a5ac52e88e4.translatedText: In addition, Beijing's highlights include: always paying attention to sustainable development, ranking first in affordable public transportation, the third cheapest city in terms of user costs, ranking seventh in terms of green space, and ranking eighth in waste recycling. In terms of financial and business services, Beijing’s employment ratio exceeds 30%, which means that 3 out of 10 working people in Beijing serve the financial and business services industry. This ratio is generally higher than that of cities such as Milan, Paris, London, San Francisco, and Chicago.

773a97e636d0e99c3d4827e081819bd9b46cec46.sourceText: ”当然，我们也要看到北京的不足之处，如：在智力资本和创新、健康、安全以及治安、交通和基础设施这几项指标上北京排名较靠后，例如健康保障系统名列第七，还存在较大改善空间。”吴卫军说。
773a97e636d0e99c3d4827e081819bd9b46cec46.translatedText: "Of course, we must also see Beijing's shortcomings, such as: Beijing ranks relatively low in several indicators such as intellectual capital and innovation, health, safety, public security, transportation and infrastructure. For example, the health security system ranks seventh, and there is still much room for improvement." Wu Weijun said.

1ee8d3975887daf004e4e4b82a7177ea617f9776.sourceText: 回顾去年北京经济影响力排第九
1ee8d3975887daf004e4e4b82a7177ea617f9776.translatedText: Looking back on last year, Beijing ranked ninth in terms of economic influence

3e5b792c7e68b8fc59399961a166a5cedcd42f0b.sourceText: 在《机遇之都2011》报告中，北京的经济影响力在世界主要城市中排名第九位，上海排名第八位。
3e5b792c7e68b8fc59399961a166a5cedcd42f0b.translatedText: In the "City of Opportunity 2011" report, Beijing's economic influence ranked ninth among the world's major cities, and Shanghai ranked eighth.

265e6b0526b040506cf26f0c64ed5894c715d29f.sourceText: 就外国直接投资而言，北京在资本总额和新建项目数方面排名靠前，同时，北京2011年的全球五百强公司总部数量相比2010年前进一位，名列第二，表明北京对于外资的吸引力持续增长。
265e6b0526b040506cf26f0c64ed5894c715d29f.translatedText: In terms of foreign direct investment, Beijing ranks high in terms of total capital and number of new projects. At the same time, the number of headquarters of Fortune 500 companies in Beijing in 2011 was one place higher than in 2010, ranking second, indicating that Beijing's attraction to foreign investment continues to grow.

977fae8e7286151afb119ce9180cd156c5f7c484.sourceText: 通过各项指标可看出，通过近几十年的发展，中国都市在交通与基础建设和经济发展上都有了坚实的进步，北京和上海在这两个指标上已晋升为国际一流。
977fae8e7286151afb119ce9180cd156c5f7c484.translatedText: It can be seen from various indicators that through development in recent decades, Chinese cities have made solid progress in transportation and infrastructure construction and economic development. Beijing and Shanghai have been promoted to the world's first-class in these two indicators.

8887482f1d9d33d146b9d5384cb51f54059da7c5.sourceText: 从2007年开始发布的《机遇之都》的研究基于公开数据，数据来源主要包括三方面：全球多边发展组织，如世界银行和国际货币基金组织；国家统计机构，如英国国家统计局和美国统计局；以及商业数据提供方。
8887482f1d9d33d146b9d5384cb51f54059da7c5.translatedText: The "City of Opportunity" research published since 2007 is based on public data. The data sources mainly include three aspects: global multilateral development organizations, such as the World Bank and the International Monetary Fund; national statistical agencies, such as the British National Bureau of Statistics and the United States Census Bureau; and commercial data providers.

863f353fd10cba66b7cc5249876fd4c06049c973.translatedText: I'm crazy about football - Phoenix amateur team activities (photos) (Coco Report) Women will never understand that men get up in the middle of the night to drink and watch football games while working...

cc7c8de1de0baba9469010a95b65b5a9c01653f9.sourceText: （可可报道） 女人永远也不能理解，男人半夜三更起来喝酒看球赛，工作了一周开一个小时车也要去球场踢一场球，到任何一个地方都要去找到属于自己的球队。在太阳鸟亚省华人网论坛、 Mitbbs 亚利桑那论坛都很容易看到寻找球队的帖子。其实在凤凰城一直活跃着很多个业余队伍，而且前中国国足队长吴群力也在凤凰城。
cc7c8de1de0baba9469010a95b65b5a9c01653f9.translatedText: (Coco Report) Women will never understand that men wake up in the middle of the night to drink and watch football games, drive an hour after working for a week to go to the stadium to play a game, and find their own team wherever they go. It's easy to see posts looking for teams on the Sunbirds Chinese Forum in Alberta and the Mitbbs Arizona Forum. In fact, there are many amateur teams active in Phoenix City, and former Chinese National Football Team Captain Wu Qunli is also in Phoenix City.

3ed882a44bf481dd85f96608f9cd53afea53b999.sourceText: 11 月 26 日星期六下午 3 ： 00pm 吴群力教练带队，来自工程师，理发师，医生，老师，生意人等各个行业的足球爱好者二十多人齐聚一堂在（ Palo Verde Park ）公园内的草坪上开赛。下午只是个娱乐赛，队员分为白蓝两队。队员的年龄也有很大差别，既十几岁的少年，也有 70 多岁的大爷。白队队员少，但是进攻依然非常积极，可是后卫却出现了空挡，蓝队的前锋，将球带入前场无人地带，他快速向球移动以求控制，同时注意到迎面而来的对方球员，摆出大脚解围的夸张架势，对方果然放慢节奏而避让，前锋如愿刹住右腿的假动作，接着将右膝向内一扣一转，正好闪过中后卫可以看见球门，他便毫无犹豫地拔脚怒射，球应声入网！真算是开门红，在前半场蓝队就摄入四球，白队加强了后防，在后半场，蓝队并没有出色的进攻，反被白队攻入一球。最后比赛以 4 比 1 结束，蓝队获胜。
3ed882a44bf481dd85f96608f9cd53afea53b999.translatedText: On Saturday, November 26th at 3:00pm, coach Wu Qunli led the team. More than 20 football enthusiasts from various industries such as engineers, barbers, doctors, teachers, businessmen, etc. gathered together to start the game on the lawn in the (Palo Verde Park) park. It was just an entertainment game in the afternoon, and the players were divided into two teams: white and blue. The age of the team members also varies greatly, ranging from teenagers to men in their 70s. The white team has fewer players, but the offense is still very active, but the defender has a gap. The forward of the blue team takes the ball into the no-man's land in the frontcourt. He quickly moves towards the ball to control it, and at the same time notices the oncoming opponent player and puts out his big foot. In the exaggerated posture of the clearance, the opponent actually slowed down the pace and avoided it. The forward stopped the fake movement of his right leg as expected, and then buckled and turned his right knee inward, just in time to get past the center back and see the goal. He shot without hesitation, and the ball hit the net! It was a good start. In the first half, the blue team scored four goals. The white team strengthened its defense. In the second half, the blue team did not have a good offense and was scored by the white team. The game ended 4-1 in favor of the blue team.

b4899214444f052e79f3d9602ded5fdf7a210954.sourceText: 凤凰城中国足球队参加了非常多的当地比赛，也曾经在 在第一届凤凰城亚洲杯比赛中夺冠。这支足球赛的活动已经有一些年头。 下午五点，球场上不仅有这些平时规矩上班男人，还陆续来了很多家长和孩子，很多家庭已经把孩子带来向国足队长吴群力学习。虽然年纪小，可是跟在专业教练身后，小朋友们球巅得还非常有架势。
b4899214444f052e79f3d9602ded5fdf7a210954.translatedText: The Phoenix Chinese football team has participated in many local competitions and also won the first Phoenix Asian Cup. This football tournament has been around for some years. At five o'clock in the afternoon, there were not only these regular working men on the court, but also many parents and children. Many families had brought their children to learn from the national football team captain Wu Qunli. Although they are young, following the professional coaches, the children are very good at handling the ball.

baaf3e344ab279d96deb5019d29df374f4cb5f46.sourceText: 希望参加足球活动的朋友，就赶紧加入吧，在凤凰城您也依然能够为球而狂！
baaf3e344ab279d96deb5019d29df374f4cb5f46.translatedText: Friends who want to participate in football activities, please join us quickly. You can still be crazy about football in Phoenix!

5213d9e188bff959d4dcb1a15fd8e92ad1decaf8.sourceText: 专家分析凶杀动机：生活受挫滥杀无辜 （亚省时报） 20岁的亚当兰扎12月14日早上在康州中部钮敦镇家中枪杀自己的母亲南希兰扎后荷枪实弹，闯入2英里外的桑迪胡克小学，杀死六名教职员工和20名6-7岁的一年级学生。 人们都在询问为什么亚当兰扎在杀死自己的母亲后无情地杀害更多无辜的人，各大媒体大头条都是”为什么？为什么？” 东北大学著名犯罪心理学教授杰克莱文暨 《大规模屠杀：美国日益严重的威胁》 （Mass Murder: America’s Growing Menace）一书的作者应美国公共电台NPR的邀请，对康州学校枪击案的产生背景进行了分析。 莱文教授表示，如此大规模滥杀无辜的凶手通常非常聪明，而且为行凶做了长期的准备，有的甚至花一年以上的时间精心筹划。 他说，凶手可能是在事业或生活上经历了严酷的打击，或者失去挚爱，长期处于抑郁与不快之中。他们可能性格孤僻，没有朋友，很少和别人交往。在很长时间内，他们把自己的痛苦归咎于外界，责备每个人，却很少反省自己。 亚当兰扎的心理特质与莱文教授的分析极为相近。他被同学描述为非常聪明，非常内向，表现常常与众不同。 亚当的父母于2009年离异，他的哥哥兰恩兰扎表示自2010年以后就很少与弟弟来往。亚当与母亲住在一起，很少与邻居来往，性格孤僻，加上家庭破裂，有可能使亚当产生极端心态。 莱文教授表示，很多人在人生中会经历挫折，也会消沉，甚至会产生杀害无辜以泄愤的极端想法，但只有很少人 去真正精心筹划，把可怕的想法变为残酷的现实。 亚当兰扎的母亲是12月14日大规模屠杀案的第一个受害者，也是整个案件的关键人物。20岁的亚当没有资格买枪，他所使用的枪支都是他母亲名下的。如果是他的母亲教他使用枪支，如果母子相依为命，那么在亚当精心筹划大屠杀时，他的母亲是否知情？她在亚当的个性形成中扮演怎样的角色？这些细节也许要等到将来才会知道。
5213d9e188bff959d4dcb1a15fd8e92ad1decaf8.translatedText: Experts analyze the motive for the murder: Life was frustrated and he killed innocent people indiscriminately (Alberta Times) On the morning of December 14, 20-year-old Adam Lanza shot his mother Nancy Lanza to death at her home in Newtontown, central Connecticut, and then armed herself with a live ammunition. Then he broke into Sandy Hook Elementary School 2 miles away, killing six staff and 20 first-grade students aged 6-7. People are asking why Adam Lanza ruthlessly killed more innocent people after killing his mother, and the headlines in major media are "Why? Why?" Jack Levin, a famous professor of criminal psychology at Northeastern University and the author of "Mass Murder: America's Growing Menace", was invited by the American public radio station NPR to analyze the background of the Connecticut school shooting. Professor Levin said that murderers who kill innocent people on such a large scale are usually very smart and have made long-term preparations for their crimes. Some even spend more than a year carefully planning. He said that the murderer may have experienced a severe blow in career or life, or lost a loved one, and has been depressed and unhappy for a long time. They may be withdrawn, have no friends, and rarely interact with others. For a long time, they blame the outside world for their pain, blaming everyone, but rarely reflect on themselves. Adam Lanza's psychological traits are very similar to Professor Levin's analysis. He was described by his classmates as being very smart, very introverted, and often acting out of the ordinary. Adam's parents divorced in 2009, and his brother Lan Lanza said that he has rarely interacted with his brother since 2010. Adam lives with his mother and rarely interacts with neighbors. He is withdrawn and his family is broken up, which may cause Adam to develop an extreme mentality. Professor Levin said that many people will experience setbacks and depression in life, and even have extreme thoughts of killing innocent people to vent their anger, but only a few people actually plan carefully to turn their terrible thoughts into cruel reality. Adam Lanza's mother was the first victim of the December 14 massacre and a key figure in the entire case. Adam, 20, was not eligible to buy a gun and the guns he used were in his mother's name. If it was his mother who taught him how to use a gun, and if mother and son depended on each other for survival, did her mother know when Adam was carefully planning the massacre? What role did she play in the formation of Adam's personality? These details may not be known until the future.

32e9ec8fdaeb0533b609dfea88077e382c0750ab.translatedText: Although there are many twists and turns, it is difficult to prevent the implementation of the medical reform law. The new health insurance plan is accepting applications today. The debate over the health care law has stalled the budget bill and led to a federal government shutdown, but health care reform...

e4408566ce4ab4154a8ca5519f359b9f78758a03.sourceText: 有关医改法的辩论让预算法案陷于僵局并导致联邦政府关闭，但医改法的新健保网站今天将按时开放，消费者可以按计划开始申请。当然，按计划进行并不意味着一切都会顺利。
e4408566ce4ab4154a8ca5519f359b9f78758a03.translatedText: The debate over the health care reform law has stalled the budget bill and led to a federal government shutdown, but the new health insurance website for the health care reform law will be opened on time today, and consumers can start applying as planned. Of course, going according to plan doesn't mean everything will go smoothly.

e81dfdc8f99d2994987b9278bb7db8256fb3d35d.sourceText: 据国家广播公司（NBC News）报道，医改法的支持者和反对者都说，预计在申请过程中会出现波折。有些问题已经出现：从首都华盛顿网站的电脑宕机到到小企业申请的推迟。这也是联邦政府将申请期定为6个月的原因之一。它显然很不容易。
e81dfdc8f99d2994987b9278bb7db8256fb3d35d.translatedText: According to NBC News, both supporters and opponents of the health care reform law said they expected twists and turns in the application process. Some problems have already arisen: from computer outages at the nation's capital, Washington, D.C., to delays in small business applications. This is one of the reasons why the federal government sets the application period to six months. It's obviously not easy.

5835d3a0b4621b0352d58fb7625fa579d6723352.sourceText: 即使不出故障，申请过程也相当繁琐，不是在喝咖啡的休息时间就能完成的。
5835d3a0b4621b0352d58fb7625fa579d6723352.translatedText: Even if there is no glitch, the application process is quite cumbersome and cannot be completed during a coffee break.

fefd7e9f39ae37caa7f6c2cc0af8b53fc4017310.sourceText: NBC说，那也是特拉华州维明顿克里斯提纳健保系统（Christiana Health Care System）鲍尔（Amy Ball）要同病人交谈的原因。不仅是因为很多病人还不知道他们可以上网购买健保计划，也是因为他们几乎肯定需要帮助。
fefd7e9f39ae37caa7f6c2cc0af8b53fc4017310.translatedText: NBC said that is why Amy Ball of Christiana Health Care System in Wilmington, Delaware, wants to talk to patients. Not only are many patients unaware they can purchase health plans online, but they almost certainly need help.

04aea3f06d0ee6f78b9847c6dbf2a73fa17f8f12.sourceText: 克里斯提纳系统社区教育专家鲍尔说，自己就是进行教育工作。”我知道计划很复杂，但我要告诉他们预期结果。对于某些人来说，这是他们首次得到健保。”
04aea3f06d0ee6f78b9847c6dbf2a73fa17f8f12.translatedText: Bauer, a community education expert in the Christiana System, said that he is engaged in educational work. "I know the plan is complicated, but I want to tell them the expected results. For some people, this is the first time they have received health insurance."

ebeda10e23616092efafa7da847a7c462ceda94e.sourceText: 鲍尔有个表格，将给下属医院所有无保险的病人打电话，敦促他们在今后3个月申请加入。她说，因为有些人的雇主不提供保险，”我想人们知道自己能得到健保时会感到兴奋。”
ebeda10e23616092efafa7da847a7c462ceda94e.translatedText: Ball has a form and will call all uninsured patients in his affiliated hospitals to urge them to apply for enrollment in the next three months. Because some people's employers don't offer coverage, she said, "I think people will be excited to know they can get coverage."

4b6f49a870a4f36c68c11ff0b1ec90af31edd853.sourceText: 由非营利医院组成的克里斯提纳系统正在接受申请并自动提供咨询。而奥巴马政府已经同数百家团体合作，建立?#23548;航员?#32593;络，辅导人们完成大约需要45分钟的申请。
4b6f49a870a4f36c68c11ff0b1ec90af31edd853.translatedText: The Christiana system, made up of nonprofit hospitals, is accepting applications and automatically providing counseling. The Obama administration has partnered with hundreds of groups to create a network of pilots to help people complete the application, which takes about 45 minutes.

6618b38b0635a2f245fae659deb59bed5bf9a722.sourceText: 不仅是新客户需要挑选各种不同的健保计划–从最基本的保险到”白金”全保计划，他们还要提供收入、家庭人员、就业状况及是否为合法居民的身份信息。
6618b38b0635a2f245fae659deb59bed5bf9a722.translatedText: Not only do new customers need to choose from a variety of health insurance plans - from the most basic insurance to the "platinum" comprehensive insurance plan, they also need to provide information about their income, family members, employment status and whether they are legal residents.

8caee81c60f8f398bd57ba9217663f0231e7c21f.sourceText: 新网站联网系统能自动到社安局、国税局、劳工部和国安部的系统核实有关信息。
8caee81c60f8f398bd57ba9217663f0231e7c21f.translatedText: The new website networking system can automatically verify relevant information from the systems of the Social Security Administration, the Internal Revenue Service, the Department of Labor and the Ministry of National Security.

c493838713b304f32590c23c81954ea4d1e2a711.sourceText: 卫生部长西贝柳斯（Kathleen Sebelius）说，人们要做出很多决定：”你是否要高额扣减和低保费？你是否要减少自付部分而缴纳较高的月费？”
c493838713b304f32590c23c81954ea4d1e2a711.translatedText: Health Minister Kathleen Sebelius said people have a lot of decisions to make: "Do you want high deductibles and low premiums? Do you want to reduce your deductible and pay a higher monthly premium?"

b932bec915d7c43863c9f398eb95ead787f596e9.sourceText: 如果能按照计划进行，新系统不仅能计算出保费，还能算出人们能从联邦政府得到的补贴。西贝柳斯说，估计新健保市场90%以上的人都能得到某种补贴。
b932bec915d7c43863c9f398eb95ead787f596e9.translatedText: If it goes according to plan, the new system will not only calculate premiums but also the subsidies people can receive from the federal government. Sibelius said it is estimated that more than 90% of people in the new health insurance market will receive some kind of subsidy.

5c2a469df8987685dc2d36d9d5112ed4ee6d9065.sourceText: 白宫已经指定900多个团体帮助人们完成申请手续，这些团体范围很广，从美国护士协会、地方药店到权益组织。
5c2a469df8987685dc2d36d9d5112ed4ee6d9065.translatedText: The White House has designated more than 900 groups to help people complete the application process, ranging from the American Nurses Association to local pharmacies to advocacy groups.

c4a77a031948a58a92ac34a9f3338ac03ac6d4aa.sourceText: 墨妇走私禁药入境被捕 海关周一在本州南部边境逮捕一名墨西哥籍妇女，据称她拥有强奸犯惯用的违禁药品。 马里珀萨海关执法人员在51岁的乔瑟芬多明格斯的车中搜出310瓶氯胺酮。氯胺酮是一种透明，无臭，无味的液体，在20世纪60年代初作为药管局列为麻醉药禁品。由于氯胺酮也引起失忆，当局说，曾发现多宗性侵犯案受害者在案发前被人喂食此药。 多明格斯将以运毒罪名被起诉。
c4a77a031948a58a92ac34a9f3338ac03ac6d4aa.translatedText: Mexican woman arrested for smuggling banned drugs into the country Customs arrested a Mexican woman at the southern border of the state on Monday, allegedly possessing banned drugs commonly used by rapists. Mariposa Customs Enforcement agents found 310 vials of ketamine in the car of 51-year-old Josephine Dominguez. Ketamine is a clear, odorless, and tasteless liquid that was classified as a prohibited narcotic drug by the Drug Enforcement Administration in the early 1960s. Because ketamine can also cause amnesia, authorities say it has been found in numerous sexual assault cases where victims were fed the drug before the attack. Dominguez will be indicted on drug trafficking charges.

64b38d7168bca9522691abfcfd0b952a3e9b1f32.sourceText: 热烈欢迎华盛顿地区华美老年协会访问鳯凰城华人耆英会 杨济群 华美老年协会将于2011年五月廿六日至廿七日访问鳯凰城华人耆英会，这是一次东西部两大城市老年耆英们聚会的喜庆日子，两个老年会将欢聚一堂，互相交流经验，互相学习，增进了解，加深友情，取长补短，将各自的老年会办得更好，更加有声有色。现将该会会况作一简单介绍： 华美协会(Chinese American Senior Services Association, Inc.)为向该地区华裔老人提供全方位服务，大华府地区各华裔老年团体联合于2005年在马里兰政府注册，成立了华美老年协会。 该会现有会员1,500余人，义工180余人，所有运作金靠义工的热情奉献，并获得多项政府补助金资助。 该会协助政府推展小区服务，联合华人老年团体，帮助提供交友、健身、益智以及鼓励老年人参加义务服务，回馈社会等宗旨下，开办了各种有益老年人的活动，举办各种社团如夕阳红合唱团、奶奶舞蹈队、忘年乐文艺队、消遥游俱乐部等共十六个团队，这些团队各有分工，如老年防病中心定期门诊，为低收入居民提供定期健康检查，各个团队有不同的活动，如太极拳、健身操、团体舞、乒乓球、英语班、计算机班、公民班、烹饪、麻将、旅游等等。每周从周一至周五均安排了不同的团队进行活动，该协会办得多姿多彩，有声有色，使该地区老人有一个清新、活跃的园地安渡晚年。 该会将于五月廿七日上午十时在华人耆英中心与鳯城华人耆英会联欢，届时将有精彩节目表演，欢迎朋友们前来参加这次盛会观看演出。 最后预祝华美协会访问成功。
64b38d7168bca9522691abfcfd0b952a3e9b1f32.translatedText: Warmly welcome the Chinese American Elderly Association in the Washington area to visit the Huangcheng Chinese Seniors Association Yang Jiqun The Chinese American Senior Citizens Association will visit the Huangcheng Chinese Senior Citizens Association from May 26 to May 27, 2011. This is a festive day for the senior citizens of the two major cities in the east and west to gather together. The two senior citizens' associations will gather together to exchange experiences, learn from each other, enhance understanding, deepen friendship, learn from each other's strengths and weaknesses, and make their respective senior citizens' associations better and more impressive. Here is a brief introduction to the association: Chinese American Senior Services Association, Inc. (Chinese American Senior Services Association, Inc.) In order to provide comprehensive services to the Chinese elderly in the area, various Chinese elderly groups in the Greater Washington area jointly registered with the Maryland government in 2005 and established the Chinese American Senior Services Association. The association currently has more than 1,500 members and more than 180 volunteers. All operating funds rely on the enthusiastic dedication of volunteers and have received a number of government subsidies. The association assists the government in promoting community services and unites with Chinese elderly groups to help provide friendship, fitness, education, and encourage the elderly to participate in voluntary services and give back to the society. It has launched various activities beneficial to the elderly and organized various societies such as Sunset Red Chorus, Grandma Dance Team, Year-End Music Art Troupe, and Xiaoyao There are a total of sixteen teams including the travel club. Each of these teams has its own division of labor, such as regular outpatient clinics at the elderly disease prevention center and regular health examinations for low-income residents. Each team has different activities, such as Tai Chi, aerobics, group dance, table tennis, English classes, computer classes, citizenship classes, cooking, mahjong, tourism, etc. Different teams are arranged to carry out activities every week from Monday to Friday. The association organizes colorful and lively activities, allowing the elderly in the area to have a fresh and active place to spend their old age. The association will have a party with the Fucheng Chinese Elders Association at 10 a.m. on May 27 at the Chinese Elders Center. There will be exciting performances. Friends are welcome to attend this event and watch the performances. Finally, I wish the Chinese American Association a successful visit.

d694366d3568b99278d12d73ec78d114171eced8.sourceText: 美中文化艺术交流协会隆重成立 广募文化艺术贤才 随着美中文化艺术交流的日益频繁，中华文化艺术的广泛传播，美中文化艺术交流协会正式注册成立。该协会是由古雅瑜女士，李成先生和陈志钢先生等人和许多朋友支持成立的。该协会是以崇尚美中文化，爱好东西方艺术的各界文化艺术人士为主，各方朋友欢迎加入的无党派，非宗教，非盈利性民间组织。 该协会旨在积极推动和促进美中文化艺术的交流和发展。为各界文化艺术人士建造一­个平台，相互学习，共同提高，增进友谊台。充分利用好资源，为美中文化艺术交流的良好发展，尽一份义务。 协会将有­计划，有目的地举行各种文化艺术活动。其中包括­美术，舞蹈，书法，文学，摄影，武术，体育，医药保健，民俗等方面的活动，以及各种相关的展览会，讲座和学习班。努力将美国的文化艺术介绍给中国民众，也把传统的中华文化艺术带给美国观众。积极安排各种双边文化艺术交流活动。 协会将全力支持和帮助各界文化艺术人士和团体举办以上各类活动，同时也希望各界朋友对该协会给予各种支持和帮助。我­们欢迎所有对推动美中文化艺术交流有兴趣，有责任感的专家，学者和朋友加入我们。让我们共同努力，为美中文化艺术交流的不断发展，贡献一份力量。让文化艺术把我们的生活变得更加美好，更加精彩。 联系人古雅瑜：yayukhoe@yahoo.com 480-726-2181 李成： cfli888@yahoo.com.cn 602-714-1718 陈志钢： chenzhigang2000@yahoo.com 480-705-9166
d694366d3568b99278d12d73ec78d114171eced8.translatedText: The U.S.-China Cultural and Art Exchange Association was grandly established to recruit cultural and artistic talents. With the increasingly frequent cultural and artistic exchanges between the U.S. and China and the widespread dissemination of Chinese culture and art, the U.S.-China Cultural and Art Exchange Association was officially registered and established. The association was established with the support of Ms. Gu Yayu, Mr. Li Cheng, Mr. Chen Zhigang and many friends. The association is a non-partisan, non-religious, non-profit civil organization that is mainly composed of cultural and artistic people from all walks of life who advocate American and Chinese culture and love Eastern and Western art. Friends from all walks of life are welcome to join. The association aims to actively promote and promote the exchange and development of culture and art between the United States and China. Build a platform for cultural and artistic people from all walks of life to learn from each other, improve together, and enhance friendship. Make full use of resources and do our part for the good development of cultural and artistic exchanges between the United States and China. The association will plan and hold various cultural and artistic activities purposefully. These include activities in art, dance, calligraphy, literature, photography, martial arts, sports, medicine and health care, folk customs, etc., as well as various related exhibitions, lectures and classes. We strive to introduce American culture and art to the Chinese people, and also bring traditional Chinese culture and art to American audiences. Actively arrange various bilateral cultural and artistic exchange activities. The association will fully support and help cultural and artistic people and groups from all walks of life to organize the above activities. At the same time, we also hope that friends from all walks of life will give the association all kinds of support and help. We welcome all experts, scholars and friends who are interested and responsible in promoting cultural and artistic exchanges between the United States and China to join us. Let us work together to contribute to the continuous development of cultural and artistic exchanges between the United States and China. Let culture and art make our lives better and more exciting. Contact person Gu Yayu: yayukhoe@yahoo.com 480-726-2181 Li Cheng: cfli888@yahoo.com.cn 602-714-1718 Chen Zhigang: chenzhigang2000@yahoo.com 480-705-9166

ef53389547a47ca5f2036ba990fc7370782166e0.sourceText: 凤凰城九宫：“生存还是毁灭？” 自辛亥革命一百年来，中国各派政治力量，各路所谓的政治精英，大多是经营一党私利的政客和食客。民国如此，共和国亦然。不换汤，也从不换药，百年共和上演的就是一个戏码—权力争斗。这个戏码的最新一出是 >。最时尚的新演员是薄，谷，瓜，王。洋大人黑伍德客串了幽灵的角色。隔岸观戏，忽然想起了莎翁的 >，这两出戏都是权力，阴谋外加性的调料，都充满了恐怖。不同之处是莎翁的悲剧是在戏台上拿捏”悲剧情结”的艺术品；而 >却是中国大舞台上的活人实景。 中国的观众们，还有吾等关注中国时事的真假洋鬼子们，直看的”眼珠落玉盘，下巴坠胸前”。在中国的戏台上，还总有自封的高人引导国人喝彩，代表民众表态。待到戏文行至可以阶段性自圆其说之后，幕急落。高潮之后的平静让人们无所谓适从。其时，下一幕的序曲已经飘然而至。中国的百年现代史，就是如此周而复始的循环。 中国政治气候无常，政治争斗手段阴险，民主政治土壤贫瘠。 变革？改制？这不但需要运作资本，还要付出巨大代价。于是，”稳定”的大旗在中国大地呼啦啦地飘。明眼人都清楚，这是以国泰民安为幡幌，私下的算盘是维护当局的权力和既得利益。 中国在八十年代末期和九十年代初期错过了推进民主化进程的大好时机。当时，经济改革尚未完全铺开，旧的经济体系颓势明显；新的利益集团羽翼未丰。邓小平强人政治的余威尚存。在这种社会转型时期，如果邓小平有三分蒋经国在台湾开放党禁，报禁的魄力和和远见，部分开放大陆的新闻自由和基层选举，现在中国的政治形势当是另一番风景。 时至今日，利益集团控制了中国的要害部门。精英们如果投入怀抱，当坐享其成，步入食利者的行列。看那些民主党派的花瓶们，都曾事业有成，又都是识时务的”俊杰”。于是他们成了中国民盟主席，民建主席，民革主席，农工民主党主席等等，个个都身兼人大副委员长，国家领导人的干活。这些组织的副职也一律是正部级，省地县一级级类推。不识相的如方励之，刘滨雁等，被一网打尽。胡萝卜加大棒这革命的两手实在是高。本来就人少势微的中国精英们大部被收买，一小撮被打杀。如此，精英们鼓吹新闻自由和基层选举的声音微弱，其活动空间几乎为零。 东方不亮西方亮；黑了南方有北方。精英革命不看好就看百姓的。广东省陆丰市东海镇乌坎村的民主选举突然让人眼前一亮。从村委会开始进行民主实践是万里长征第一步。不怕慢，就怕站! 现在的看点是当局的容忍程度有多大。同打篮球一样，每个持球队员的空间都是前突后挪拱出来的，而不是他人给予的。 无论是精英政治，还是草根民主；无论是打杀洋人的”文革”，还是”投洋保命”的2012年；无论利益集团多么贪婪，穷人多么无奈；这些都不会对中国的生存与维系构成实质性威胁。”生存还是毁灭？”这是个大问题，但这不是中国的问题。 2012年4月20日
ef53389547a47ca5f2036ba990fc7370782166e0.translatedText: Phoenix City Nine Palaces: "To be or not?" In the 100 years since the Revolution of 1911, China's various political forces and so-called political elites are mostly politicians and hangers-on who pursue the selfish interests of one party. This is true for the Republic of China, and it is true for the Republic as well. Without changing the soup and never changing the medicine, what has been staged in the century-old Republic is a drama - a struggle for power. The latest in this drama is >. The most stylish new actors are Bo, Gu, Gua and Wang. Foreign man Blackwood guest stars as a ghost. Watching the play from across the bank, I suddenly remembered Shakespeare's ">". Both plays are about power, conspiracy and sex, and both are full of terror. The difference is that Shakespeare's tragedy is a work of art that captures the "tragic complex" on the stage; while > is a real scene of a living person on the Chinese stage. The Chinese audience, as well as the real and fake foreign devils like us who are paying attention to current affairs in China, watched with "eyeballs falling on jade plates and chins falling on chests." On the Chinese stage, there are always self-proclaimed masters who guide the people to cheer and express their opinions on behalf of the people. When the play reaches a point where it can gradually justify itself, the curtain falls sharply. The calm after the climax makes people feel indifferent. At that time, the prelude to the next scene had already arrived. China's century-old modern history is like this cycle. China's political climate is unstable, the methods of political struggle are insidious, and the soil for democratic politics is barren. change? Restructure? This not only requires working capital, but also requires huge costs. As a result, the banner of "stability" flew loudly across the land of China. Anyone with a discerning eye knows that this is under the guise of national peace and security, and the private calculation is to safeguard the authority's power and vested interests. China missed a great opportunity to advance its democratization process in the late 1980s and early 1990s. At that time, economic reform had not yet been fully rolled out, the old economic system was in obvious decline, and new interest groups were still in their infancy. The residual power of Deng Xiaoping’s strongman politics still exists. In this period of social transformation, if Deng Xiaoping had the courage and foresight of Chiang Ching-kuo to lift party bans and newspaper bans in Taiwan, and partially open up press freedom and grassroots elections on the mainland, China's political situation would be a different story now. Today, interest groups control key sectors in China. If the elites embrace it, they should sit back and enjoy the benefits and become rentiers. Look at the vases of the democratic parties. They all have successful careers and are "heroes" who understand current affairs. So they became the chairman of the Chinese Democratic League, the chairman of the China Democratic National Construction Association, the chairman of the Kuomintang Revolutionary Committee, the chairman of the Peasants and Workers Democratic Party, etc., and all of them were vice-chairmen of the National People's Congress and national leaders. The deputy positions of these organizations are also at the ministerial level, and the provincial, prefecture and county levels can be deduced by analogy. Those who were ignorant, such as Fang Lizhi and Liu Binyan, were all caught in one fell swoop. The carrot and the stick are two very powerful tools for revolution. Most of China's elites, who were originally small and weak, were bribed, and a small number were killed. In this way, the elite's voice in advocating for press freedom and grassroots elections is weak, and their space for maneuver is almost zero. If the east is not bright, the west will be bright; if it is dark, the south will be bright, and the north will be. If the elite revolution is not good, it depends on the common people. The democratic election in Wukan Village, Donghai Town, Lufeng City, Guangdong Province suddenly made people's eyes brighter. Carrying out democratic practice starting from the village committee is the first step in the long march. Don’t be afraid of being slow, be afraid of standing still! What’s interesting now is how tolerant the authorities are. Just like playing basketball, the space for each player holding the ball is created by moving forward and backward, rather than being given by others. Whether it is elite politics or grassroots democracy; whether it is the Cultural Revolution that killed foreigners, or 2012 when people "jumped abroad to save their lives"; no matter how greedy the interest groups are or how helpless the poor are; none of these will pose a substantial threat to China's survival and maintenance. "To be or not to be?" This is a big question, but it is not China's problem. April 20, 2012

8a08ac55e21263403fee8a54d13420e49c36aaed.sourceText: 中新网2月1日电 据美国《星岛日报》报道，根据希尔民意调查，美国有接近一半的登记选民也赞成非法移民的子女身份转正，更有73%人赞成那些在军队服役的人成为公民。 报道援引The Hill报道，这两种想法都是源于2010年被国会共和党人扼杀的梦想法案。奥巴马总统上周在他的国情咨文中说，要把从大学毕业或在军队服务的非法移民驱逐并不合理。他说，”给我一条可以让他们有机会赢得公民身份的法律，我会马上签署。”
8a08ac55e21263403fee8a54d13420e49c36aaed.translatedText: China News Service, February 1 (Xinhua) According to the US "Sing Tao Daily" report, according to a Hill poll, nearly half of registered voters in the United States also support the regularization of the status of children of illegal immigrants, and 73% support those serving in the military becoming citizens. The report quoted The Hill as reporting that both ideas originated from the DREAM Act that was killed by congressional Republicans in 2010. In his State of the Union address last week, President Obama said it was not reasonable to deport illegal immigrants who graduated from college or served in the military. He said, "Give me a law that gives them a chance to win citizenship and I will sign it in a heartbeat."

38ab8f5da149d0cbc6d2884ed27ab3cfc1ad24aa.sourceText: 这些问题也已成为共和党总统竞选中的热门话题。金里奇1月27日宣布，他支持修正梦想法案，将令在军队任职的非法入境者的孩子儿童提供的身份转正路径。罗姆内则不支持梦想法案的任何一部分。
38ab8f5da149d0cbc6d2884ed27ab3cfc1ad24aa.translatedText: These issues have also become hot topics in the Republican presidential campaign. Gingrich announced on January 27 that he supports amending the DREAM Act, which would provide children of illegal immigrants serving in the military with a path to regular status. Romney does not support any part of the DREAM Act.

5ef31f7bbdb7b0d5748d00b21200e1434b71e534.sourceText: 于1月26日进行这份希尔民意调查，访问1000名可能投票选民，误差正负 3个百分点。调查显示，可能投票的选民中，48%人表示非法移民带来美国的儿童应在没有受到威胁下提供成为公民的路径，只有34%人反对。民主党人更倾向接受这个想法，有60%支持，23%人反对；而共和党则有46%支持和32%反对。独立选民也同意民主党的看法，有52%人认为应该给予孩子机会，亦有33%人反对。
5ef31f7bbdb7b0d5748d00b21200e1434b71e534.translatedText: This Hill poll was conducted on January 26, interviewing 1,000 likely voters, with an error of plus or minus 3 percentage points. The survey showed that 48% of likely voters said that children brought to the United States by illegal immigrants should be provided with a path to citizenship without being threatened, while only 34% opposed it. Democrats are more likely to accept the idea, with 60% supporting it and 23% opposing it, while Republicans have 46% supporting it and 32% opposing it. Independent voters also agree with the Democratic Party, with 52% saying children should be given a chance, while 33% oppose it.

d416f4ff27733ba7da5d921d769ea56b27bdef55.sourceText: 全国普遍也支持军队服役的人可以身份转正，有72%共和党人、75%民主党人及73%独立选民支持。
d416f4ff27733ba7da5d921d769ea56b27bdef55.translatedText: The country generally supports the idea that people serving in the military can have their status regularized, with 72% of Republicans, 75% of Democrats and 73% of independent voters supporting it.

d81541758330fad78ad7a0a2c580dfde5781b55a.translatedText: Great Wall Traditional Chinese Medicine moved, the mayor came to cut the ribbon in person The Great Wall Hospital of Traditional Chinese Medicine, founded by Dr. Xiao Qingsong and serving as the attending physician, has moved to a new home, and will hold an opening ceremony on January 15, 2014 from 5 to 8 pm on January 15, 2014...

e9013a623b4a47cd21834581f3d85072445b63af.sourceText: 由肖青松医师创办并担任主治医师的长城中医院搬了新家，并于2014年1月15日下午5点至8点举行开业典礼。Scottsdale市长Mayor Jim Lane 亲临开业典礼现场，为医院剪彩祝贺。
e9013a623b4a47cd21834581f3d85072445b63af.translatedText: The Great Wall Hospital of Traditional Chinese Medicine, founded by Dr. Xiao Qingsong and serves as the attending physician, has moved to a new home. Scottsdale Mayor Jim Lane attended the opening ceremony and cut the ribbon to congratulate the hospital.

23c19181222d682fb6bbc66cb2ca1975a3f3ff29.sourceText: 参加此次开业典礼的宾客有：侨界领导Helen Zhang, Garry Ong, Tony Kao; Scottsdale 商务协会领导及成员; Scottsdale警察协会代表Cynthia Hill; Mesa Community College 校长潘先生; 新东方艺术学校校长吕丽华Lihua Lu; 川渝同乡会主席陈志刚Zhigang Chen; 医学界医生陈阳明Yang Ming Chen, 杨彤Anthony Yeung, 周承德Peter Chou肖普泉Puquan Xiao; 及长城中医的病人代表Tom Frenkel, Clifford Osborn等各界朋友。
23c19181222d682fb6bbc66cb2ca1975a3f3ff29.translatedText: Guests attending the opening ceremony include: overseas Chinese leaders Helen Zhang, Garry Ong, Tony Kao; Scottsdale Business Association leaders and members; Scottsdale Police Association representative Cynthia Hill; Mesa Community College principal Mr. Pan; New Oriental Art School principal Lihua Lu; Sichuan and Chongqing Association Chairman Zhigang Chen; medical doctor Yang Ming Chen, Anthony Yeung, Peter Chou, Puquan Xiao; and patient representatives from Great Wall Traditional Chinese Medicine, Tom Frenkel, Clifford Osborn and other friends from all walks of life.

ecf5decc1bc7ff937dc6c0418026098792883330.sourceText: 剪彩仪式上合影，Scottsdale市长Jim Lane 和肖青松医师（第一排左二 左三）
ecf5decc1bc7ff937dc6c0418026098792883330.translatedText: Group photo at the ribbon-cutting ceremony, Scottsdale Mayor Jim Lane and Dr. Xiao Qingsong (first row, second from left, third from left)

30db4e293140a72a267638a034e9462cdd78de50.sourceText: Scottsdale市长Mayor Lane演讲，谈论自己对中医的了解。讲话中，市长说他刚刚结束他的中国海口友好访问，知道美国医院（Mayo Clinic）在那里生意红火，有点意外长城中医在他的门下能让那么多病人受益。在海口的停留恰巧使他接触到了中医文化，他对中医文化很感兴趣。结合自己的海口之旅，市长谈及了自己对中医的理解，表达了对中医的认同，及对长城中医未来发展的祝愿。
30db4e293140a72a267638a034e9462cdd78de50.translatedText: Scottsdale Mayor Lane gave a speech and talked about his understanding of traditional Chinese medicine. In his speech, the mayor said that he had just concluded his goodwill visit to Haikou, China. He knew that the American hospital (Mayo Clinic) was doing booming business there, and he was a little surprised that Great Wall Traditional Chinese Medicine could benefit so many patients under his care. His stay in Haikou happened to bring him into contact with Chinese medicine culture, and he was very interested in it. Based on his own trip to Haikou, the mayor talked about his understanding of traditional Chinese medicine, expressed his recognition of traditional Chinese medicine, and expressed his wishes for the future development of Great Wall Traditional Chinese Medicine.

baee7275139a869ce20ab5f0069d72a911dd2b65.sourceText: 此次活动为亚利桑那州各界人士提供了了解中医文化的平台，促进了医生、病人、侨界、商界之间的交流，为传播中医文化奠定了基础，更为长城中医在未来加强与中国科学研究院的交流与合作，在美国建立研究中心奠定了基础。 剪彩仪式中，市长Mayer Lane, 侨界代表，商界代表，病人代表分别发言，现场所有宾客为中医在美国的发展。。。
baee7275139a869ce20ab5f0069d72a911dd2b65.translatedText: This event provides a platform for people from all walks of life in Arizona to understand the culture of traditional Chinese medicine, promotes exchanges between doctors, patients, overseas Chinese and business circles, and lays a foundation for the dissemination of traditional Chinese medicine culture. It also lays the foundation for Great Wall Traditional Chinese Medicine to strengthen exchanges and cooperation with the Chinese Academy of Sciences in the future and establish a research center in the United States. During the ribbon-cutting ceremony, Mayor Mayer Lane, representatives of the overseas Chinese community, representatives of the business community, and patient representatives spoke respectively. All guests present expressed their views on the development of traditional Chinese medicine in the United States. . .

1be3085a9fbdf4fb93f1582b8e7bb984c72b1988.sourceText: 长城中医院将一如既往地服务于社区，并致力于成立亚利桑那州第一个中医研究中心，传播中医文化。
1be3085a9fbdf4fb93f1582b8e7bb984c72b1988.translatedText: Great Wall Traditional Chinese Medicine Hospital will continue to serve the community and is committed to establishing the first traditional Chinese medicine research center in Arizona and spreading the traditional Chinese medicine culture.

b3625bd42cb1c09e3020daed6358f5dc541fa0b6.sourceText: “脸书忧郁症”在蔓延 医生说，听起来有点过分，但绝对不能忽视，一种名为” Facebook Depression” （脸书忧郁症）的情绪病正在蔓延。 青少年很喜欢社交网站，对大多数人来说” 脸书” 是一个有趣的，轻松的联系方式，了解朋友 的最新动向，第一时间获取最新事件的详情。 但新的研究显示，青少年沈迷在此，可能产生一系列问题。 美国儿科组织警告，当你整天想着与朋友聊天，更新网页，上传照片让你的朋友高兴，把时间都挂着网上而放弃其他，很可能你已经患上一种新的情绪病??’ 脸书忧郁症” 。 ” 当我看到脸书上有人展示他的聚会照片，我感到真棒，可惜我只能呆在家中自怜自艾，这种感觉不好，令人沮丧。” 高中生伊莉萨白姬斯说。但姬斯说她不会立即注册脸书。 ” 当你看到别人在脸书上展示的页面，很容易将自己和别人比较。” 儿童和青少年心理医生恩索夫博士说。 恩索夫医生不认为社交网站导致忧郁症，但是，如果一个孩子本来就有一个脆弱的自尊，这种与人攀比的心理会进一步伤害他。这是因为，一些人认为，社交网站可以作为一个被社会，被群体接受的认知。有些人已经把网络世界当做现实世界。 胃疼，头痛.， 我生病了，不想上学， 能量低， 疲劳， 睡不好，沉迷于社交网站而又受到打击的青少年往往会出现这些状况，除了上网什么都不感兴趣，不愿出去跟朋友面对面交谈、玩耍。 恩索夫博士指出，脸书和其他社交网站其实有积极的一面，通过网络可以帮助孩子们认识到不同的朋友，将孩子们联系在一起，分享他们的快乐和不快乐，只是需要家长引导。暑假漫长，家长平时除了上班之外，还是应该带孩子们出去接近大自然，与真实的人打交道。
b3625bd42cb1c09e3020daed6358f5dc541fa0b6.translatedText: " Facebook depression" is spreading. Doctors say that it sounds a bit excessive, but it must not be ignored. A kind of emotional disease called "Facebook Depression" is spreading. Teenagers like social networking sites very much. For most people, "Facebook" It is a fun and easy way to keep in touch with your friends and get details of the latest events as soon as possible. But new research shows that teenagers are addicted to this, which may cause a series of problems. The American Academy of Pediatrics warns that when you spend all day thinking about chatting with friends, updating web pages, uploading photos to make your friends happy, and spending time online instead of giving up on other things, it is very likely that you have suffered from a new emotional disease - Facebook depression. "When I see someone showing his party photos on Facebook, I feel great, but it's a pity that I can only stay at home and feel sorry for myself. It's a bad feeling and it's depressing." High school student Elizabeth Keese said. But Kees said she wouldn't sign up for Facebook right away. "When you see other people's profiles on Facebook, it's easy to compare yourself to others," said Dr. Ensof, a child and adolescent psychiatrist. Dr. Enthoff doesn't believe social networking sites cause depression, but if a child already has a fragile self-esteem, this comparison mentality can further damage him. This is because some people believe that social networking sites can serve as a cognition that is accepted by society and the group. Some people already regard the online world as the real world. Stomach ache, headache..., I'm sick, don't want to go to school, low energy, fatigue, can't sleep well. Teenagers who are addicted to social networking sites and are hit often have these conditions. They are not interested in anything except surfing the Internet, and are unwilling to go out to talk and play face-to-face with friends. Dr. Ensof pointed out that Facebook and other social networking sites actually have a positive side. The Internet can help children meet different friends, connect children together, and share their happiness and unhappiness. They just need parental guidance. The summer vacation is long. In addition to going to work, parents should still take their children out to get close to nature and interact with real people.

40401877462e4c9432a33b60bbc97ecccd15b985.sourceText: 2011年6月5日零时开始,太阳鸟亚利桑那华人社区网发起了凰城华裔小姐网络投票活动，在短短两天多的时间里，凤凰城华裔小姐选美活动受到全世界各个国家华人的关注。截止到2011年6月7日星期二中午十二时，暂时领先的是6号选手程诗懿以415票，2号高薇佳406票，1号杨忠婷402票。
40401877462e4c9432a33b60bbc97ecccd15b985.translatedText: Starting at 0:00 on June 5, 2011, the Sunbird Arizona Chinese Community Network launched the Miss Chinese Phoenix online voting event. In just over two days, the Miss Chinese Phoenix pageant attracted the attention of Chinese from all over the world. As of 12:00 noon on Tuesday, June 7, 2011, the current leaders are contestant No. 6 Cheng Shiyi with 415 votes, No. 2 Gao Weijia with 406 votes, and No. 1 Yang Zhongting with 402 votes.

725b582cfd23a391acfff203f01aa8e05e1d0a20.sourceText: 网络的点击率成倍增加，第一天的点击率是811人，第二天的点击率就高达1600多人，中国大陆，港澳台的所有省市都在网络上参与投票。然而这次票选的影响远远不仅如此，据网络的最新统计，凤凰城华裔小姐选美的影响已经扩大到了世界范围，加拿大，丹麦，澳大利亚，英国，南非，印度，葡萄牙，新加坡，西班牙，塞尔维亚，意大利，土耳其，俄罗斯，匈牙利，韩国，欧洲，荷兰，哥斯达黎加，日本，智利，德国，挪威等二十多个国家的朋友都在网站上投了选票，选出了自己喜欢的华裔小姐。另外，我们网站的票选赞助单位也正在征集当中，想让更多的人了解您的企业，请尽快与我们联络。
725b582cfd23a391acfff203f01aa8e05e1d0a20.translatedText: The click-through rate on the Internet increased exponentially. The click-through rate on the first day was 811 people, and the click-through rate on the second day was as high as more than 1,600 people. All provinces and cities in mainland China, Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan participated in voting online. However, the influence of this vote goes far beyond that. According to the latest statistics from the Internet, the influence of Miss Chinese Phoenix Pageant has expanded to the world. Friends from Canada, Denmark, Australia, the United Kingdom, South Africa, India, Portugal, Singapore, Spain, Serbia, Italy, Turkey, Russia, Hungary, South Korea, Europe, the Netherlands, Costa Rica, Japan, Chile, Germany, Norway and more than 20 countries have voted on the website to select their favorite Miss Chinese. In addition, we are also recruiting sponsors for voting on our website. If you want more people to know about your company, please contact us as soon as possible.

f0df65af6e02b2b81853859ad2035746bc770c4d.sourceText: 一个团体提出在亚利桑那北部建立新的国家名胜区(national monument)的建议。 他们希望奥巴马总统在大峡谷流域划出1.7万英亩的地区，建立国家名胜区。这一区域地广人稀，以悬崖和峡谷为主，富含草原，森林和沙漠，是猎人狩猎，游人远足的好去处。团体认为在此圈地成园，会对保护野生动物、古树木和水资源起很好作用。他们还希望藉此机会禁止铀矿开采和自由放牧。 亚利桑那养牛协会说，如果这个国家名胜区建成，将会对附近的牧场主造成几代人的伤害。
f0df65af6e02b2b81853859ad2035746bc770c4d.translatedText: A group is proposing a new national monument in northern Arizona. They want President Obama to set aside 17,000 acres in the Grand Canyon watershed to establish a national monument. This area is vast and sparsely populated, dominated by cliffs and canyons, rich in grasslands, forests and deserts. It is a good place for hunters to hunt and tourists to hike. The group believes that enclosing the land into a garden will play a good role in protecting wild animals, ancient trees and water resources. They also want to use the opportunity to ban uranium mining and free grazing. The Arizona Cattlemen's Association says if the national landmark is built, it will cause harm to nearby ranchers for generations.

88fbed4756d6c71e283a54b3a02ceb5de7034583.sourceText: 大凤凰城地区目前房价还算平稳，因房屋供应量少，一月开始价格持续走高。 ASU房地长理论与实践学院负责人说一月份房价稍微有所缓和，可是从二月开始到六月都将持续走高。这个现象没有什么奇怪，只有到新的房源进入市场，才有可能改变。 1月份房屋成交量比去年同期跌了12%。因为今年比去年破产屋，短售屋的数量低了40%。现在市场房屋的数量只有正常的50%，这就造成价格持续上升。目前是卖方市场，五十万以下的房子都能吸引到多个购买合同竞价。为了避免这种竞价，很多买家都选择去购买新房。在过去一年里，新房的销售量上涨了61%。投资者还在继续购房，但是与去年比已经少了很多。1月份，32%的房屋由投资者购买，他们都是现金买家。2012年1月投资者几乎超过40%。 更多有关房地产的信息请咨询金信地产的Tinna(480)287-0180 E-mail:Goldtrustrealty2010@gmail.com
88fbed4756d6c71e283a54b3a02ceb5de7034583.translatedText: Housing prices in the greater Phoenix area are currently relatively stable, but prices have continued to rise since January due to the low supply of housing. The head of ASU's School of Realtor Theory and Practice said housing prices eased slightly in January, but will continue to rise from February to June. There is nothing strange about this phenomenon. It will only change when new properties enter the market. Housing transaction volume fell 12% in January compared with the same period last year. This is because the number of bankrupt homes and short-sale homes this year is 40% lower than last year. The number of houses on the market is now only 50% of normal, which has caused prices to continue to rise. It's a seller's market right now, and houses under $500,000 can attract multiple bids for purchase contracts. To avoid this bidding war, many buyers choose to purchase a new home. Over the past year, new home sales have increased 61%. Investors are continuing to buy homes, but at a much lower level than last year. In January, 32% of homes were purchased by investors, all of whom were cash buyers. In January 2012 investors almost exceeded 40%. For more information about real estate, please contact Tinna of Goldtrust Realty (480) 287-0180 E-mail: Goldtrustrealty2010@gmail.com

9f887b1b281ad69db1a644f2f71d9cda982ff156.sourceText: 高中生可提前两年毕业 （亚省时报） 凤凰城的学生将可以高中生涯缩短为两年。 这个计划称为”准备好就毕业”（Move On When Ready），主要提供给绩优生，在学校通过全新的剑桥国际考试项目后即可报名”准备好就毕业”。 ”这是一个非常激烈的两年计划。他们将采取精选课程授课。”中心高中老师苏珊科里根说。 学生在两年修完精选课程后，通过考试，可获得一个大峡谷文凭，然后可以修读大学课程。 学校领导人认为这一计划可将孩子的注意力吸引到学校，并帮助遏制辍学率。 现在有127个中心高中学生报名进入”准备好就毕业”计划。中心高中是凤凰城地区实施该方案的学校之一。本学年，全州共有14个高中开展这个计划。他们分别是： ASU Preparatory Academy High School (Phoenix)，ASU Preparatory Academy High School – Polytechnic (Mesa)，Gary K. Herberger Young Scholars Academy – ASU West campus (Glendale)，BASIS Schools，BASIS Scottsdale，BASIS Tucson，Dysart Unified School District， Marley Park Middle School (El Mirage)，Nadaburg Unified School District，The Academy at Desert Oasis (Surprise)，Phoenix Union High School District，Central High School，Metro Tech High School.，Yuma Union High School District，Cibola High School，Gila Ridge High School，Kofa High School，San Luis High School，Yuma High School. 以下学校同意2012-2013学年实施该计划：BASIS Schools，BASIS Oro Valley，Dysart Unified School District，Willow Canyon High School (Surprise)，Wickenburg Unified School District，Wickenburg High School。
9f887b1b281ad69db1a644f2f71d9cda982ff156.translatedText: High school students can graduate two years early (Alberta Times) Students in Phoenix will be able to shorten their high school careers to just two years. This program is called "Move On When Ready" and is mainly provided to high-achieving students. After passing the new Cambridge International Examination Program in school, they can sign up for "Move On When Ready". "It's a very intense two-year program. They'll be taking a select class of classes," said Center High School teacher Susan Corrigan. After students complete selected courses in two years and pass the exam, they can receive a Grand Canyon diploma and then take college courses. School leaders believe the program will draw children's attention to school and help curb dropout rates. There are now 127 central high school students enrolled in the Graduation Ready program. Central High School is one of the schools in the Phoenix area implementing the program. This school year, 14 high schools across the state are running the program. They are: ASU Preparatory Academy High School (Phoenix), ASU Preparatory Academy High School – Polytechnic (Mesa), Gary K. Herberger Young Scholars Academy – ASU West campus (Glendale), BASIS Schools, BASIS Scottsdale, BASIS Tucson, Dysart Unified School District, Marley Park Middle School (El Mirage), Nadaburg Unified School District, The Academy at Desert Oasis (Surprise), Phoenix Union High School District, Central High School, Metro Tech High School., Yuma Union High School District, Cibola High School, Gila Ridge High School, Kofa High School, San Luis High School, Yuma High School. The following schools have agreed to implement the program for the 2012-2013 school year: BASIS Schools, BASIS Oro Valley, Dysart Unified School District, Willow Canyon High School (Surprise), Wickenburg Unified School District, Wickenburg High School.

684b03f585c62cebd75f1a61c5be5e56bfb9730e.sourceText: 亚利桑那华人历史协会：张肇鸿 1924年，Flagstaff的一家名为“文华“咖啡馆，因缺乏业务和店主赌博债务…
684b03f585c62cebd75f1a61c5be5e56bfb9730e.translatedText: Arizona Chinese Historical Association: Zhang Zhaohong In 1924, a Flagstaff cafe called the "Mandarin" closed down due to lack of business and the owner's gambling debts...

b87be2d2602937cb805c65ed57675908a02eed72.sourceText: 1924年，Flagstaff的一家名为“文华“咖啡馆，因缺乏业务和店主赌博债务而倒闭。黄世质承担抵押并接管了生意，而原店主Woo Hop Bing就继续担任厨师 ，黄世质偿还他的赌博债务。 这时餐厅的名称更改为”美国厨房“（ The American Kitchen ）。
b87be2d2602937cb805c65ed57675908a02eed72.translatedText: In 1924, a Flagstaff cafe called the "Mandarin" closed down due to lack of business and the owner's gambling debts. Huang Shizhi assumed the mortgage and took over the business, while the original owner Woo Hop Bing continued to serve as the chef while Huang Shizhi paid off his gambling debts. At this time the name of the restaurant was changed to "The American Kitchen".

e7eee74bf5241c347e56cd72af7e4dbd8fe8ba21.sourceText: 黄世质赋予儿子黄炳军（Wong Ben Jun）经营餐厅。在盛大的开幕式上，黄世质邀请了300多位客人和贵宾参加，他们从未见过的如此精致晚宴，让每个人都印象深刻。黄世质是中国守法公民，也是非常成功的房地产经纪人，现在，他又被视为知道如何举办盛大聚会的人。
e7eee74bf5241c347e56cd72af7e4dbd8fe8ba21.translatedText: Huang Shizhi gave his son Wong Ben Jun (Wong Ben Jun) to run the restaurant. At the grand opening ceremony, Huang Shizhi invited more than 300 guests and distinguished guests to attend such an exquisite dinner that they had never seen before, which impressed everyone. Huang Shizhi is a law-abiding citizen of China and a very successful real estate agent, and now he is seen as someone who knows how to throw a great party.

96706744468e4279f3711491b5c80f44d44139a7.sourceText: 餐馆兴旺了几年。一切都进行得很顺利。但是，原店主HooHop Bing对此感到不满。他慢慢地偿还了赌债，但不喜欢为其他任何人打工。他继续赌博并招致了新的债务，最终退出了餐厅并离开了城镇。因为Hoo Hop Bing是一位出色的厨师，黄世质未能找到可靠的人来为顾客提供最好的食物。几年后，随着顾客数量的减少，黄世质关闭了这家餐厅。但为了不气馁，他重新开设了“玫瑰树咖啡馆”（Rose Tree Café），这是一间酒吧和台球厅，他和妻子成功地经营了这家小酒馆数十年。
96706744468e4279f3711491b5c80f44d44139a7.translatedText: The restaurant has been booming for several years. Everything went smoothly. However, the original store owner HooHop Bing was unhappy with this. He slowly paid off his gambling debts, but didn't enjoy working for anyone else. He continued gambling and incurred new debts, eventually quitting the restaurant and leaving town. Because Hoo Hop Bing is an excellent chef, Huang Shizhi failed to find reliable people to provide customers with the best food. After a few years, as the number of customers dwindled, Huang closed the restaurant. But not to be discouraged, he reopened the Rose Tree Café, a bar and billiards hall, which he and his wife successfully ran for decades.

bf8b35e9cc04263eed83f328c34079e8f79634f4.sourceText: 由于洗衣房离圣达菲铁路很近，会受到了流浪汉的困扰。与今天的无家可归者不同，流浪汉实际上是些旅行的工人，他们经常使用火车到处找工作。当他们被抓并赶下车后，许多人来到餐厅门口寻求食物和庇护所。 令人惊讶的是，许多老流浪汉以后成为著名的电影明星和作家，拳击界重量级冠军以及美国民谣歌手。
bf8b35e9cc04263eed83f328c34079e8f79634f4.translatedText: Because the laundry room is very close to the Santa Fe Railway, it will be troubled by homeless people. Unlike today's homeless, tramps were actually traveling workers who often used trains to get around in search of work. After they were caught and kicked out of the car, many came to the restaurant door seeking food and shelter. Surprisingly, many old tramps later became famous movie stars and authors, boxing heavyweight champions, and American folk singers.

20786b27c8dcd014b59c3226fc7c103636cc8ecb.sourceText: 黄世质会对每个人进行纪律训练，包括员工和家庭成员都可以尽其所能。他始终确保洗衣房运转顺畅和有可用的物资并维护机械，并保正他们的顾客得到最好的服务，即使经历了许多人遭受苦难的萧条时期。
20786b27c8dcd014b59c3226fc7c103636cc8ecb.translatedText: >Huang Shizhi will provide discipline training for everyone, including employees and family members to do their best. He always ensured that the laundry was running smoothly and had supplies available and maintained the machinery, and that their customers received the best possible service, even through the Depression when many suffered.

3eb48ca6b22a345e9477a08d096270edb058692a.sourceText: 黄世质对他和他的家人的政策是，社会存在偏见和歧视，要在社区中保持低调，以便融入美国的生活方式。他要求家人和雇员辛勤工作，要有良好的行为举止，最重要的是要遵守法律，通过努力工作成为模范公民，因此他赢得了市民的尊重。
3eb48ca6b22a345e9477a08d096270edb058692a.translatedText: Huang Shizhi's policy towards him and his family is to keep a low profile in the community in order to integrate into the American way of life despite social prejudice and discrimination. He earned the respect of his citizens by requiring his family and employees to work hard, behave well, and most importantly obey the law, becoming a model citizen through hard work.

82f64d3518459bd052d22ee6c0aab19d537d3690.sourceText: 在从旧金山运来的一些中国商品中，他收到了一种由五种不同甜瓜发酵而制成的酒，它具有有益于健康的特性，装在一个类似于炸弹的小圆形陶壶中。这种中国制造的酒在弗拉格斯塔夫很受欢迎。黄世质也曾经用自己的配方酿造一种酒，然后将其存储在一个大粘土缸中。 酒在那里保存了将近70年之后才被销毁。
82f64d3518459bd052d22ee6c0aab19d537d3690.translatedText: Among some Chinese goods shipped from San Francisco, he received a wine made from the fermentation of five different melons, which had healthful properties, in a small round clay pot resembling a bomb. This Chinese-made liquor is popular in Flagstaff. Huang Shizhi also once brewed a wine using his own recipe and then stored it in a large clay vat. The wine was kept there for nearly 70 years before being destroyed.

fb67b6592b48466d388b8289b70d81e47d6a5f7c.sourceText: 中草药是黄世质主要的爱好。他在旧金山唐人街的药草店里闲逛时积累了经验，使他保留了大量的药方，植物和中药有用于治疗几乎所有疾病的成分。如果有人不舒服，在见到黄世质之后，他们几乎再也不会抱怨自己的健康了。
fb67b6592b48466d388b8289b70d81e47d6a5f7c.translatedText: >Chinese herbal medicine is Huang Shizhi's main hobby. The experience he gained while wandering the herb shops of San Francisco's Chinatown allowed him to maintain a large repertoire of herbs and ingredients used in traditional Chinese medicine to treat almost any ailment. If someone is uncomfortable, they will almost never complain about their health after seeing Huang Shizhi.

a18f0eec03d1b4f84379ef0cc2833197529b60e9.sourceText: 但是，黄世质最终病了。他决定使用中草药帮助自己康复。他知道用鸦片来止痛，并前往旧金山，在唐人街的华人医院去接受治疗。医院除了用草药配方外，还使用了针灸和其他在美国医院中未使用的方法帮他治病。
a18f0eec03d1b4f84379ef0cc2833197529b60e9.translatedText: However, Huang Shizhi eventually fell ill. He decided to use Chinese herbal medicine to help him recover. He learned about opium for pain relief and traveled to San Francisco to receive treatment at the Chinese Hospital in Chinatown. In addition to herbal formulas, the hospital also used acupuncture and other methods not used in American hospitals to treat his illness.

bce5b326af36d17082762b31143e884555900fbd.sourceText: 关于黄世质的病，作者黄炳海在书中写道：
bce5b326af36d17082762b31143e884555900fbd.translatedText: Regarding Huang Shizhi's illness, the author Huang Binghai wrote in the book:

dc99a85bf8aaf69d8a3dc6de073cb7b1a145da93.sourceText: “1941年6月的一个晚上，突然之间，洗衣房里电话响起，显然，传来的坏消息是，我父亲快要病死了，他想最后一次见到家人。我的母亲，大哥大嫂和我，马上赶车前去旧金山。
dc99a85bf8aaf69d8a3dc6de073cb7b1a145da93.translatedText: "One night in June 1941, suddenly, the phone rang in the laundry room. Apparently, the bad news was that my father was about to die of illness and he wanted to see his family for the last time. My mother, eldest brother, sister-in-law and I immediately drove to San Francisco.

28c522ae37c94c334bad4233fad2b6e3690d5a5b.sourceText: 但是，当车子在道路中行驶，在向右急转弯要穿过铁轨时，从铁轨的另一端突然冒出来的另一辆车，我们撞到了它的后端。幸运的是，没有人受伤，但是汽车中的物品散落在整个道路上，汽车遭受损坏，已经无法行驶。我们只能返回到巴斯托（Barstow），改乘火车去旧金山，浪费了宝贵的时间。
28c522ae37c94c334bad4233fad2b6e3690d5a5b.translatedText: However, as the car was traveling down the road and making a sharp right turn to cross the tracks, another car appeared from the other end of the tracks and we hit its rear end. Fortunately, no one was injured, but items from the car were scattered across the road and the car was damaged and rendered inoperable. We had to return to Barstow and take the train to San Francisco, wasting precious time.

44107c084959ed6c681a9848f25aa0656a8b2d62.sourceText: 当我们终于到达医院时，父亲苏醒过来。他签署了一些洗衣费支票，然后就去世了。我母亲坚持丧礼用佛教仪式，而不是用通常的基督教。在佛教中，死亡标志着逝者从今世过渡到来生。
44107c084959ed6c681a9848f25aa0656a8b2d62.translatedText: When we finally arrived at the hospital, my father came to. He signed some laundry checks and then died. My mother insisted on Buddhist rituals for the funeral rather than the usual Christian ones. In Buddhism, death marks the deceased's transition from this life to the next.

2070d622714c66bdf72e11ba92d767e8767aceb3.sourceText: 由于爸爸没有留下适当的遗嘱，他的遗产必须进行遗嘱认证，母亲才能控制住。但是，当时的移民法禁止华人移民成为公民，她无法合法拥有该遗产。
2070d622714c66bdf72e11ba92d767e8767aceb3.translatedText: Since Dad did not leave a proper will, his estate must go through probate so that the mother can take control. However, immigration laws at the time prohibited Chinese immigrants from becoming citizens, and she could not legally own the inheritance.

52b86ce2dbd47c9d13895a7e61c0297198eda62c.sourceText: 一位在1922年9月22日之前，与美国公民结婚的中国外籍妇女，因当时在种族上不符合公民的资格，她将无法获得该遗产。法院决定网开一面，于1941年7月22日，允许母亲任命我其中一个大哥哥来担任遗产管理人。我的母亲并试图通过公民资格测试来申请公民身份。考试的主要要求之一是口头背诵美国宪法的序言，我们试图帮助她学习，但是她在说英语单词时遇到了很多麻烦。 ‘为了……我们美国人民’，她从来没有背出超过序言前的十个单词。不久，她放弃了这个主意，并且让我的兄弟Jun担任其遗产管理员。“（待续）
52b86ce2dbd47c9d13895a7e61c0297198eda62c.translatedText: A Chinese foreign woman who married a U.S. citizen before September 22, 1922 will not be able to obtain the inheritance because she was not racially qualified as a citizen at the time. The court decided to be lenient, and on July 22, 1941, my mother was allowed to appoint one of my eldest brothers as the administrator of the estate. My mother and tried to apply for citizenship by passing the citizenship test. One of the main requirements of the exam was to recite orally the Preamble to the United States Constitution, and we tried to help her study, but she had a lot of trouble speaking the English words. 'For...we the people of the United States,' she never recited more than the first ten words of the preface. Soon she gave up on the idea and asked my brother Jun to serve as administrator of her estate. "(to be continued)

f8f4447bfe9701b32b60973f840832d091a005b9.sourceText: (斐匿华人福利会来稿)2月18日，斐匿华人福利会在木须餐馆召开会议，并推选出新一届的领导班子。 在会议上，斐匿华人福利会创始人之一、资深侨领余文劲先生，向大家叙述了有关华人福利会的历史以及成立的经过，并根据过去传统做法，以邓、余、黄姓氏团体和龙冈公所等四个侨团为主，各派两名代表，重新推选出2012年度新职员，其名单如下: 顾问: 余文劲 邓朝驹 黄允文 主席: 张肇鸿 副主席: 余文泽 邓丰沾 秘书: 朱绮华 财政: 黄震捷 基金保管小组: 邓丰沾 余文泽 黄震捷 张华芳 (注: 余长全是本会候补顾问)
f8f4447bfe9701b32b60973f840832d091a005b9.translatedText: (Contributed by the Finnish Chinese Welfare Association) On February 18, the Finnish Chinese Welfare Association held a meeting at Mushu Restaurant and elected a new leadership team. At the meeting, Mr. Yu Wenjin, one of the founders of the Chinese Welfare Association and a senior overseas Chinese leader, told everyone about the history of the Chinese Welfare Association and the process of its establishment. According to past traditional practices, four overseas Chinese groups, including Deng, Yu, Huang, and Longgang Office, sent two representatives each to re-elect new staff for 2012. The list is as follows: Consultant: Yu Wenjin, Deng Chaoju, Huang Yunwen, Chairman: Zhang Zhaohong, Vice Chairman: Yu Wenze, Deng Fengzhan Secretary: Zhu Qihua Finance: Huang Zhenjie Fund custody team: Deng Fengzhan Yu Wenze Huang Zhenjie Zhang Huafang (Note: Yu Changquan is an alternate consultant of the Association)

83b1d7e173755a4a3ef6a20ced28d7f67a343a04.sourceText: 「斐匿华人福利会」简史:1957年，因美国移民局突然发起严查华人进入美国的「假纸」桉件，令到人心惶惶，不可终日。事态使全美华人马上团结起来，成立起全国性的组织「华人福利总会」，以保障全美华人之权益。因此，斐匿华人也相应响应，随即成立起「福利分会」。分会成员以邓、余、黄等姓氏团体和龙冈公所共四个侨团为主干，职员全係推选出任。此后数十年，斐匿福利分会服务侨众，运行顺利。后来因时移势易，全美福利总会最终因停顿至取消，但斐匿华人福利分会坚持了下来，并和拉斯维加斯分会、新墨西哥州分会、祖笋分会联合，成立起「美国西南福利支会」，继续为侨胞服务。1968年，凤凰城华人成立「斐匿侨团联合总会」(侨联)，华人福利会是其中的创会会员之一，并一直延续至今。
83b1d7e173755a4a3ef6a20ced28d7f67a343a04.translatedText: > A brief history of the "Philippine Chinese Welfare Association": In 1957, the US Immigration Service suddenly launched a strict investigation of "fake papers" used by Chinese people to enter the United States, which caused people to be in panic all day long. The situation caused Chinese people across the United States to immediately unite and establish the "Chinese Welfare Federation", a national organization, to protect the rights and interests of Chinese people across the United States. Therefore, the Finnish Chinese responded accordingly and immediately established a "Welfare Branch". The members of the branch are mainly composed of four overseas Chinese groups including Deng, Yu, Huang and Longgang Office, and the staff are elected by all departments. In the following decades, the Phini Welfare Branch served the overseas Chinese and ran smoothly. Later, due to changes in time, the National Welfare Federation eventually came to a standstill and was cancelled. However, the Phoenix Chinese Welfare Branch persisted and joined forces with the Las Vegas branch, the New Mexico branch, and the Zusun branch to establish the "American Southwest Welfare Branch" to continue to serve overseas Chinese. In 1968, the Chinese in Phoenix City established the "Fei Ni Overseas Chinese Federation" (Overseas Chinese Federation), of which the Chinese Welfare Association was one of the founding members and continues to this day.

8cff968a9580c3089e914dc5d2331794f8df18ff.sourceText: (亚省华联供稿) 6月28日，亚省华联（UCAA）召开了第九届”凤凰之夜”迎国庆贺中秋系列庆祝活动第一次筹备会议。 会长李健回顾了8年来一年一度的”凤凰之夜”迎国庆贺中秋庆祝活动。历年的庆祝活动得到了中国驻洛杉矶总领事馆大力支持，领馆负责人专程从洛杉矶赴会，与亚省华人华侨共度”凤凰之夜”；美国各级政界人士也热情参与；大批公司、商业机构、学术机构及其他团体的学者教授、高级管理人员，等在”凤凰之夜”中美论坛上发表演说；各界各族裔民众热情响应。”凤凰之夜”成为亚利桑那州深受广泛盛赞的一年一度的传统，成为汇聚中美各族裔各阶层高层次交流平台，成为亚利桑那州政界、商界、学术界及其民众对中华文化加强了解、增进感情的一个热烈活泼的亮丽舞台。
8cff968a9580c3089e914dc5d2331794f8df18ff.translatedText: (Contributed by Alberta Hualian) On June 28, the Chinese Federation of Alberta (UCAA) held the first preparatory meeting for the 9th "Phoenix Night" series of celebrations to celebrate the National Celebration of the Mid-Autumn Festival. President Li Jian reviewed the annual "Phoenix Night" celebrations for the Mid-Autumn Festival in the past eight years. The celebrations over the years have received strong support from the Chinese Consulate General in Los Angeles. The head of the consulate made a special trip from Los Angeles to spend the "Phoenix Night" with Chinese people in Alberta. Politicians at all levels in the United States also enthusiastically participated; a large number of companies, business institutions, academic institutions and Scholars, professors, and senior managers from other groups gave speeches at the "Phoenix Night" Sino-US Forum; people from all walks of life and ethnic groups responded enthusiastically to the "Phoenix Night", which has become a widely praised annual tradition in Arizona. It has become a high-level exchange platform for all ethnic groups and all walks of life in China and the United States, and has become a platform for Arizona's political, business, academic and people to communicate.

7f6a7bf93c2b67d9ffdf5f5afd74606da2b79f11.sourceText: 今年的”凤凰之夜”国庆中秋团圆晚宴还将与亚省华人反法西斯及纪念抗战胜利七十周年晚宴合并，届时中国驻洛杉矶总领事馆负责人，亚省政届、商界、学界、科技工业等各界及各社团代表将共聚一堂，共饮70周年庆功酒，共享70周年胜利宴。亚省华联并各主协办团体诚挚邀请各界团体及民众，共赴盛宴，共庆70周年辉煌胜利。欢迎各界团体机构及热心民众尽早报名参与，预订有限席位。报名请联系亚省华联会长李健( jian_l1@yahoo.com )。
7f6a7bf93c2b67d9ffdf5f5afd74606da2b79f11.translatedText: This year's "Phoenix Night" National Day Mid-Autumn Festival Reunion Dinner will also be combined with the Alberta Chinese anti-fascist and commemorative dinner to commemorate the 70th anniversary of the victory of the Anti-Japanese War. At that time, the person in charge of the Chinese Consulate General in Los Angeles, the provincial political circles, business circles, academia, and science and technology. Representatives from all walks of life such as industry and various associations will gather together to drink the 70th anniversary celebration wine and share the 70th anniversary victory banquet. The Provincial Hualien and the co-organizers sincerely invite groups and people from all walks of life to celebrate the 70th anniversary of the glorious victory. Organizations and enthusiastic people from all walks of life are welcome to register as soon as possible. To reserve limited seats, please contact Li Jian, the president of the Provincial Hualian. jian_l1@yahoo.com )

08e4b1f60ba41e51b174975e7bf829f6d3cc3226.sourceText: 会议中，亚省华联及社区团体负责人就国庆招待会、艺术表演、国庆中秋团圆晚宴、国庆中秋舞会，等议程进行了热烈的讨论，并推选出各项活动工作组负责人，各项活动将在各工作组的带领下逐步展开。亚省华联并各主协办团体诚挚邀请各界各族献计献策、共襄盛举，共度佳节。
08e4b1f60ba41e51b174975e7bf829f6d3cc3226.translatedText: During the meeting, the heads of the Hualien Association of Alberta and community groups had a heated discussion on the National Day reception, art performances, National Day Mid-Autumn Festival reunion dinner, National Day Mid-Autumn Festival dance, etc., and elected the leaders of various activity working groups, and various activities. It will be gradually launched under the leadership of various working groups. The Hualian Association of Alberta and the co-organizers sincerely invite all walks of life to contribute ideas and participate in the event to celebrate the festival.
