258f5464d4fab1efc547ad6f7077fa25b4dbd45a.sourceText: 参院高官巡访亚洲 曾警告中国勿改现状 美国参院外交委员会主席梅内德斯日前启程开始长达9天的亚洲之行，将先后访问日本、台湾地区、韩国、中国大陆。这是国会新会期开会以来梅内德斯首次访问亚洲。 梅内德斯将于8月13日到15日访问日本，他将会晤日本首相安倍晋三、外务相岸田文雄、防卫相小野寺五典，此前还将会见日本公明党主席山口那津男及日本下院外交委员会主席河井克行。 日方消息人士称，安倍将与梅内德斯讨论美日关系中与中国相关的部分。在8月初美国参院通过的一项决议中，决议声称中国为”改变领土现状”，在钓鱼岛周边及南海”威吓和动用武力”，并称呼美国认为钓鱼岛处于日本控制之下，这一认识”不会因第三方的单方面行动而改变”，并称美国将毫不动摇地根据《日美安保条约》应对”任何武力攻击”。 推动这一议案的正是梅内德斯。 而值得一提的是，在梅内德斯访问的最后一天，安倍内阁中有阁员将要参拜靖国神社。到目前为止，有3人明确表态将入社参拜，有9位表示不会，还有一些成员没有做出表态。 梅内德斯的第二站是台湾地区，外界认为，访台期间，他将就台湾加入国际民航组织（ICAO）、美国对台军售等议题与台湾方面交流。梅内德斯是美国参议院”台湾连线”成员，对台湾各项议题支持不遗余力，日前与联邦众议院外交委员会主席罗艾斯联手在国会推动通过支持台湾以观察员身分参与国际民航组织（ICAO）法案，美国总统奥巴马也已于7月12日签署完成这项法案。 17日到19日访问韩国期间，梅内德斯将会见韩国总统朴槿惠、韩国外长尹炳世等政要。 梅内德斯最后将于19日抵达中国访问，21日结束此次亚洲之行。目前，中方并未公布会晤的人员名单及对话议题。 2009年5月，现任美国国务卿克里，以参议院外交委员会主席的身份访华，并和时任美国众议院议长的佩洛西一同访问了上海、北京和天津等中国城市。那次访华旨在推动美中共同应对气候变化，并还参加了美中清洁能源论坛。时任中国国家副主席习近平和国务院副总理李克强接见了克里。
258f5464d4fab1efc547ad6f7077fa25b4dbd45a.translatedText: Senior Senate officials visited Asia and warned China not to change the status quo. Menendez, chairman of the U.S. Senate Foreign Affairs Committee, recently embarked on a nine-day trip to Asia. He will visit Japan, Taiwan, South Korea, and mainland China. This is Menendez's first visit to Asia since the new session of Congress began. Menendez will visit Japan from August 13 to 15. He will meet with Japanese Prime Minister Shinzo Abe, Foreign Minister Fumio Kishida, and Defense Minister Itsunori Onodera. He will also meet with Japanese Komeito Chairman Natsuo Yamaguchi and Chairman of the Foreign Affairs Committee of the Lower House of Japan Katsuyuki Kawai. Japanese sources said Abe will discuss China-related aspects of U.S.-Japan relations with Menendez. In a resolution passed by the U.S. Senate in early August, the resolution claimed that China had "intimidated and used force" around the Diaoyu Islands and the South China Sea in order to "change the territorial status quo." It also stated that the United States believed that the Diaoyu Islands were under Japanese control and that this understanding "will not be changed by the unilateral actions of a third party." It also stated that the United States will unwaveringly respond to "any armed attack" in accordance with the "Japan-US Security Treaty." It was Menendez who pushed for this motion. It is worth mentioning that on the last day of Menendez's visit, some members of Abe's cabinet will visit the Yasukuni Shrine. So far, 3 people have made it clear that they will join the society to pay homage, 9 people have said they will not, and some members have not made a statement. Menendez's second stop is Taiwan. It is believed that during his visit to Taiwan, he will communicate with Taiwan on issues such as Taiwan's accession to the International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) and U.S. arms sales to Taiwan. Menendez is a member of the U.S. Senate's "Taiwan Connection" and has spared no effort in supporting Taiwan's various issues. He recently joined forces with House Foreign Affairs Committee Chairman Royce to promote the passage of a bill supporting Taiwan's participation in the International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) as an observer in Congress. U.S. President Obama also signed the bill on July 12. During his visit to South Korea from the 17th to the 19th, Menendez will meet with South Korean President Park Geun-hye, South Korean Foreign Minister Yoon Byung-se and other political figures. Menendez will finally arrive in China for a visit on the 19th and will end his Asia trip on the 21st. At present, China has not announced the list of people meeting and the topics of dialogue. In May 2009, the current US Secretary of State Kerry visited China as chairman of the Senate Foreign Affairs Committee, and visited Chinese cities such as Shanghai, Beijing and Tianjin with Pelosi, then Speaker of the US House of Representatives. That visit was aimed at promoting the United States and China to jointly address climate change, and also participated in the U.S.-China Clean Energy Forum. Then Chinese Vice President Xi Jinping and Vice Premier Li Keqiang met with Kerry.

3085339e3e8034e3c39642c29d955a2677458af0.sourceText: 没等到行刑 死刑犯卒于监狱 （亚省时报） 亚利桑那州惩教署9日宣布，2001年被控谋杀妻子和继子女的死囚大卫安东尼死于州立监狱。 安东尼于2002年被判有罪，但在2008年，亚利桑那州最高法院推翻这一判决，法院说，主审法官犯了错，让检方认为安东尼有动机杀他的家人。 安东尼一直坚持自己没有杀人，直至2005年，安东尼的妻子和她14岁的女儿，12岁的儿子的尸体在百艾一个建筑地盘的垃圾桶里被发现。今年8月，陪审团再次认定安东尼三项一级谋杀罪成立，法官在9月判他处死刑。 狱方说，安东尼9日被发现卒于牢房，有明显的自然死因。
3085339e3e8034e3c39642c29d955a2677458af0.translatedText: The death row inmate died in prison before execution (Alberta Times) The Arizona Department of Corrections announced on the 9th that David Anthony, a death row inmate accused of murdering his wife and stepchildren in 2001, died in a state prison. Anthony was found guilty in 2002, but in 2008, the Arizona Supreme Court overturned the conviction, saying the trial judge erred in leading prosecutors to believe Anthony had a motive to kill his family. Anthony always insisted that he did not kill anyone until 2005, when the bodies of Anthony's wife, her 14-year-old daughter, and their 12-year-old son were found in a trash can at a construction site in Baiai. In August this year, the jury again found Anthony guilty of three counts of first-degree murder, and the judge sentenced him to death in September. Prison officials said Anthony was found dead in his cell on the 9th, with obvious natural causes of death.

5da12d2ece7de915e3eb63ae09cc3aeafe84e1f9.sourceText: 石晶系出名门源自天津 ‘石家大院’ 后裔，祖籍隶属’尊美堂’，其父石毓岷就是在’石家大院’出生，今’石家大院’已改为’天津杨柳青博物馆’。

Their ancestral home belongs to "Zunmeitang". His father Shi Yumin was born in the "Shijia Courtyard". Today, the "Shijia Courtyard" has been changed to the "Tianjin Yangliuqing Museum".

a43170c9dd16826d56c29986bd84ca1e0f483fa4.sourceText: 在那里跌倒就在那里站起耒！ 右眼几乎失明的意外伤痛对一个9岁男孩是何等衝击，石晶的父母亲带他到美国耒求医，在复健的治疗上，石晶父亲给他买了一把长弓练眼，那把弓比石晶还高。
a43170c9dd16826d56c29986bd84ca1e0f483fa4.translatedText: Stand up wherever you fall! The accidental injury that left him almost blind in his right eye was such a shock to a 9-year-old boy. Shi Jing's parents took him to the United States to seek medical treatment. For rehabilitation treatment, Shi Jing's father bought him a longbow to practice his eyesight. The bow was taller than Shi Jing's.

028951fd7ec2ac1b6a53556bdc399de9c3c8f594.sourceText: 那时石晶在成长中就接触了射击的领域，以中国的王义夫为偶像，曾不止一次梦想能跟王义夫习枪。
028951fd7ec2ac1b6a53556bdc399de9c3c8f594.translatedText: At that time, Shi Jing was exposed to the field of shooting when she was growing up. She idolized Wang Yifu of China and dreamed of learning guns from Wang Yifu more than once.

1f9f05df8fa898011c22179ef2d4bdd780becc35.sourceText: 石晶随父母定居在亚利桑纳的Gilbert 市，他的童年就在那成长，ASU州立大学毕业后成为州政府职员，在州安全部任电脑工程师，后调州商业部。
1f9f05df8fa898011c22179ef2d4bdd780becc35.translatedText: Shi Jing settled in Gilbert City, Arizona with his parents, where he grew up in his childhood. After graduating from ASU State University, he became a state government employee, working as a computer engineer in the state Department of Security, and later transferred to the state Department of Commerce.

986d02b247205886616ae8ec08708aed815d969b.sourceText: 石晶班馀几呼没有其它嗜好及消遣，全部时间都投入了射击练习，石晶苦练左眼与右手的搭配终于’鸣’鸣惊人，天公也会疼憨仔，梦想也有成真事的一天，石晶7月在移地训练时，到巴西奥运射击场练习时惊喜见到王义夫就站在眼前，美梦成真，当然要向王义夫请教经验，曾经的偶像是今天同场竞赛的对手，虽然石晶是美国国家队选手，但血脉中永远是流著中华儿女的骄傲。
986d02b247205886616ae8ec08708aed815d969b.translatedText: The rest of Shi Jing’s class had no other hobbies or pastimes, so he devoted all his time to shooting practice. Shi Jing worked hard on the combination of his left eye and right hand and finally made an astonishing success. God will also love stupid people, and one day his dream will come true. Shi Jing is moving in July When I was training on the ground, I was surprised to see Wang Yifu standing in front of me when I was practicing at the Brazilian Olympic shooting range. My dream came true. Of course I had to ask Wang Yifu for his experience. His former idol was my opponent in the same competition today. Although Shi Jing is a member of the U.S. national team, the pride of the Chinese people will always flow in his blood.

f89e86684a4b4d3f5a4f1e63f6f5c3dfad3859f5.sourceText: 石晶家庭幸福妻子圆圆贤慧亲切，父石毓岷母杨平都是本地名人，姥姥杨济群更把石晶当心肝宝贝，因石晶是他一手带大，相信石晶把奖牌带回，第一个拿到的人就是姥姥杨济群。

cc23daf18e0ad8ad74b0228b88f30916d1fd452f.sourceText: 选择何种方式卖屋? 当屋主要出售房屋时，通常有两个选择，一个是找房地产经纪人帮屋主打点一切，另一个就是所谓的FSBO(for sale by owner)，由屋主自己来处理一切的销售事宜。 我们身处于互联网发达的世代，屋主们有比以前更多的管道来销售自己的房屋，不必非得透过房地产经纪人不可。如果您要出售房屋，该透过房地产经纪人还是FSBO好呢? 两者皆有利有弊。 For Sale by Owner最明显的优点当然就是可以省下一笔经纪佣金，这也是为什么有很多的屋主宁愿承受较大的风险而选择FSBO。至于FSBO的缺点就是房屋的交易过程、手续通常都需要一点专业知识和经验，大部分的屋主都要上班或打拼自己的事业，要屋主们花时间来学习何为正确的销售手续，陪买家看屋、如何推销自己的房屋、如何交屋过户等，可能很多屋主都不想也没时间来做这样的事，更重要的是如果屋主在售屋的过程中没有遵守相关法律规定或有所疏忽，很可能为自己带来大麻烦。另外值得注意的是，根据统计，买屋者对FSBO的房屋首次出价通常比由经纪人代理的房屋少了5%至10%，因为买屋者知道屋主不用付佣金。若是屋主有时间也愿意学习相关知识及营销技巧，当然可以为自己省下一笔钱。 找房地产经纪人售屋的优点在于省时省力，同时也可确保房屋的销售交易过程是符合专业标准的。房地产经纪人可以帮屋主处理有关售屋的琐事，还可以保护屋主的权益，帮屋主避免交易过程中的疏忽。好的卖方经纪人可以帮屋主带来好买家，让房屋看起来更有吸引力，经纪人还可以透过所属的房屋销售网，将待售的房屋信息放在此销售网络中，所有的房地产经纪人便可以将这些待售屋的信息传达给买屋者。相对的，透过房地产经纪人售屋的缺点就是要付佣金，佣金当然是可以协商的，并没有规定屋主该付多少佣金，传统上是房屋售价的6%。屋主可以依据服务的程度与经纪人的公司约定该付多少佣金。 您如果想用FSBO的方式来自己销售房屋，最重要的关键就是要勤做功课，才不会出错，若是想透过经纪人以避免麻烦，便要找一位具专业知识，服务亲切又诚实负责的经纪人，才可以保护您的权益，为您带来最大的利益。
cc23daf18e0ad8ad74b0228b88f30916d1fd452f.translatedText: Which method should you choose to sell your house? When a homeowner wants to sell his house, he usually has two options. One is to find a real estate agent to help the homeowner take care of everything, and the other is the so-called FSBO (for sale by owner), where the homeowner handles all sales matters himself. We are in an era with developed Internet. Homeowners have more channels than before to sell their homes, and they no longer have to go through a real estate agent. If you are selling your home, should you go through a real estate agent or a FSBO? There are pros and cons to both. The most obvious advantage of For Sale by Owner is of course that you can save a brokerage commission, which is why many homeowners would rather take greater risks and choose FSBO. The disadvantage of FSBO is that the house transaction process and procedures usually require a bit of professional knowledge and experience. Most homeowners have to go to work or work on their own careers. Homeowners need to spend time learning what the correct sales procedures are, accompanying buyers to view houses, how to market their houses, how to transfer the property, etc. Many homeowners may not want to or have time to do such things. More importantly, if the homeowner fails to comply with relevant laws and regulations or is negligent in the process of selling the house, it may cause big trouble for themselves. It’s also worth noting that according to statistics, homebuyers’ first offer on a FSBO home is typically 5% to 10% less than on a home represented by an agent because the homebuyer knows that the homeowner does not have to pay a commission. If the homeowner has the time and is willing to learn relevant knowledge and marketing techniques, he can certainly save himself a lot of money. The advantage of using a real estate agent to sell your house is that it saves time and effort, and it also ensures that the house sales transaction process meets professional standards. Real estate agents can help homeowners handle the trivial matters related to selling their homes, and can also protect their rights and interests and help them avoid negligence during the transaction. A good seller's agent can help homeowners bring good buyers and make the house look more attractive. The agent can also put the information about the houses for sale in the sales network through the house sales network to which it belongs, and all real estate agents can convey the information about the houses for sale to the buyers. In contrast, the disadvantage of selling a house through a real estate agent is that you have to pay a commission. The commission is of course negotiable. There is no regulation on how much commission the homeowner should pay. It is traditionally 6% of the selling price of the house. The homeowner can agree with the broker's company how much commission to pay based on the level of service. If you want to use the FSBO method to sell your house by yourself, the most important key is to do your homework diligently to avoid making mistakes. If you want to use an agent to avoid trouble, you must find an agent who has professional knowledge, friendly service, honesty and responsibility, so that he can protect your rights and interests and bring you the greatest benefit.

225efd60124fc53e6535a551d3fcc8e7658a0dc9.translatedText: Yu Yanying: Birth, old age, illness and death are the battlefield – in memory of Mr. Mak Yingqiang (Alberta Times) On the road of life, it is inevitable to encounter encounters of one kind or another...

299326b3c9e6d3e40bb2a1f2f56a37c0f405b365.sourceText: 在人生的道路上，难免遇到有这样或那样的遭遇，曾在早两个月前，我们耆英会组织老人前往美东旅游，大家怀着十分高兴的心情，渴望着能亲眼见到美国首都华盛顿，做梦更未想过身临其境到白宫参观，这是非常难得的好机会，我们乘坐飞机同行的团友麦英强先生同样怀着这个难得的愿望，终于实现，了郄了自己的心愿。但可惜回来后不几天得了病，身不由己疾病纒身，病情天天不如一天，但他每天能与疾病展开顽强的搏斗，意志坚强，在医院期间有许多的好友，队员去探望和安慰，见到好友和队员时，他那带着热泪盈眶的眼神意味着深厚的友情和爱心，他那顽强斗争的毅力终于战胜病魔的严重威胁，后专移到疗养院休养，亲友感到有希望啦！我们为他而高兴，也希望他能早日康复，再次和我们共同携手享乐老人开心的园地。 天有不测风云，人也有不测风云之患，不料到几天后接到消息，他又返回医院，他很多亲友，我们的队友曾先后几次去探望和慰问他，他已经尽了自己的能力博斗，疲倦了，说不出话来了，一个八十馀岁的老人，他用坚强的意志，付出了极高的代价，病情反覆恶化，威胁着他，战斗力毕竟是有限，经受不起无情的冲击，终于难逃这一劫，真可惜！可惜啊！ 他终于于2011年11月22日上午离开了人间，豋上了”天堂”的消息，他的亲友，我们的队友都感到非常难过，人生是这样，不是生就是死，人生的道路没有第三条可选择，这是自然规律，不可抗拒的，既然如此，我们只能说一句”祝他一路好行”，踏上另外一个世界罢了，安息吧！ 我们活着的每个老年人应有乐观的心态和自己的抱负，有着共同的信念好好地珍惜和爱护每分每秒，争取时光去享受美好的晚年。
299326b3c9e6d3e40bb2a1f2f56a37c0f405b365.translatedText: On the road of life, it is inevitable to encounter encounters of one kind or another. Two months ago, our Senior Citizens Association organized the elderly to travel to the eastern United States. I was in a happy mood and longed to see Washington, the capital of the United States, with my own eyes. I had never dreamed of visiting the White House in person. This was a very rare opportunity. Our group friend Mr. Mai Yingqiang who was flying with us also had this rare wish, and finally realized his wish. But unfortunately, he got sick a few days after he came back. He couldn't help but get sick, and his condition became worse every day. However, he fought tenaciously against the disease every day and had a strong will. During his stay in the hospital, he had many friends and team members to visit and comfort him. When he saw his friends and team members, his eyes filled with tears meant deep friendship and love. His tenacious fighting perseverance finally defeated the serious threat of the disease, and he later moved to a nursing home to recuperate. His relatives and friends felt that there was hope! We are happy for him and hope he can recover soon and join us again to enjoy the happy garden of the elderly. Unexpected things happen in the sky, and people are also prone to unforeseen circumstances. Unexpectedly, I received the news a few days later that he returned to the hospital. Many of his relatives, friends, and our teammates had visited and expressed condolences to him several times. He had fought to the best of his ability and was tired. He was speechless. An old man over eighty years old paid a very high price with his strong will. His condition worsened repeatedly and threatened him. After all, his combat power was limited and he could not withstand the ruthless impact. He finally could not escape this disaster. What a pity! What a pity! He finally left the world on the morning of November 22, 2011, and went to "heaven". His relatives, friends, and our teammates all felt very sad. Life is like this, it is either life or death. There is no third choice in the path of life. This is the law of nature and irresistible. In this case, we can only say "I wish him a good journey" and set foot on another world. Rest in peace! Every elderly person we live should have an optimistic attitude and ambition, and have the common belief to cherish and care for every minute, and strive for time to enjoy a beautiful old age.

cfa436a198f9642297321fd4ffa936c7067f1834.sourceText: 研究：提高领驾照年龄有助减少车祸死亡 （亚省时报） 由本州道路安全部门委托公路安全保险研究所作的研究表明，提高青少年初次领驾照年龄，可以将青少年因车祸死亡人数减少一半。 根据公路安全保险研究所的报告，如果州政府立法通过提高青少年初次领取驾驶执照年龄，必须满足以下要求：一，初次领学车驾照年龄不低于16岁；二，至少有65小时驾驶经历；三，最初领驾照年龄不低于17岁；四，晚上八时起限制青少年驾驶人上路。 按现行交通法，亚省居民，年龄在15.5岁就可以办理学车执照，领取学车执照后半年内，在成年驾驶人监督下完成30小时道路驾驶就可以办理正式驾驶执照。
cfa436a198f9642297321fd4ffa936c7067f1834.translatedText: Study: Raising the driver's license age can help reduce car crash deaths (Alberta Times) A study commissioned by the Insurance Institute for Highway Safety and commissioned by the state's road safety department found that raising the age at which teenagers get their first driver's license could cut the number of teen crash deaths in half. According to a report from the Insurance Institute for Highway Safety, if the state government passes legislation to raise the age for teenagers to obtain a driver's license for the first time, the following requirements must be met: 1. The age for first obtaining a driver's license must be no less than 16 years old; 2. At least 65 hours of driving experience; 3. The age for initially obtaining a driver's license must be no less than 17 years old; 4. Teenage drivers are restricted from taking to the road from 8 p.m. According to the current traffic law, residents of Alberta can apply for a learner's driving license at the age of 15.5. Within six months after receiving the learner's license, they can apply for a formal driving license after completing 30 hours of road driving under the supervision of an adult driver.

85f0fb6f9b590d8a2d28cff59b2a721e691b924f.sourceText: 存在福伯心中的牵挂 张肇鸿 常言道：”有牵挂才会有存在的重量”。人生到了生死的关头…
85f0fb6f9b590d8a2d28cff59b2a721e691b924f.translatedText: The concern that exists in Fu Bo's heart Zhang Zhaohong As the saying goes: "Only when there is concern can there be the weight of existence." Life has reached a critical moment of life and death...

1f7b62df3efc543638c77679f852e62bf385bfc7.sourceText: 存在福伯心中的牵挂 张肇鸿 常言道：”有牵挂才会有存在的重量”。人生到了生死的关头，有些人想到的是遗产的分配，有些人想到的是妻小的安排，还有些人想到的是身后的历史定位。而对于在鬼门关走过一回的”福伯”－土桑（祖笋）老侨领陈英福先生，纒绕和牵挂在心头的郄是”全美华人福利会西南分会”。 十一月中的一天，福伯在家中庭院浇花时，因水湿地滑不慎摔了一跤。八十岁的老人这一跤摔得非同小可，顿时两眼发黑，不省人事，有中风现象，实时被紧急送院进行抢救。可能是福伯为人厚道，有善因善果，也可能是他心中还有牵挂一些事情，用他的话说，是”我要回来”，而”回来”后福伯要做的一件事，就是叫女儿 Cene打电话给《亚省时报》甄社长，并叫侨联主席高志中和我前去见他。 十一月廿一日晨早，我们三人加上亚省时报职员梁小姐一同驱车前往土桑，去医院探望福伯他老人家。在医院内，恰好踫到前台湾宪兵司令杨再村将军也是去探望福伯的，便一同前往。福伯年轻的时候曾经当兵参加抗日救亡活动，是一个革命的热血青年。 甄社长与福伯是多年的老朋友，他代表亚省时报与西南福利分会在花柜里挑选了一盆最好的鲜花，跟随着前来引路的福伯的儿子，我们来到了病房。 福伯半坐在轮椅上，精神看上去尚可，让我们忐忑不安的心情放松了一些。病房中还有同样是坐在轮椅上的福伯的太太福婶，这一对患难鸳鸯数十年来苦乐与共，共育有五女一儿，眼前的二女儿和小儿子已在床榻前侍候多天了，病房内光线充足，鲜花排放，福伯见到我们到来十分高兴，完全不顾自己身上还打着吊针，插着管道和戴着头套，他兴奋地拉着我们的手坐到床沿，接着就打开了话匣子，说话速度有些像”马不停蹄”，女儿Cene几次前来请他”slowly” ，说慢些，他那肯听，一开腔就从上世纪五十代起开讲。1957年，由于美国移民局藉华人有假出生证明之事，对在美华人进行大肆搜查，遂燃起了全体华人反歧视暴动，为争取平等权利，当时全美华人代表集议于美京，施即成立了全美华人福利总会，翌年，凤凰城华人福利分会亦宣告成立。由于华人团结力争，终获美国国会公平立法，由中国原来每年只有一百零五名移民名额修改放宽到二万名（加上台湾二万名，香港五千名）以后华侨来美成千上万，骨肉团聚，开展生机，创出新天，而终发展到今天侨界新局面。西南华人福利支会是1974年成立，成员包括凤凰城、土桑、拉斯韦加斯和新墨西哥州，至今已经有三十五年历史了。 以上的历史，由于经常聆听过福伯的叙述，所以当天他说得不连贯，也很明白他的意思。 接着福伯说道，虽然目前形势比以前强了许多，并有更多的华人团体继续争取自身的权益，但作为福利会的成员，要发扬光荣传统，要和西南各州加强联系，把会务继承下去。 一个八十多岁的老人，心中放不下的竟然是侨社的事情，真是令人感动，我忙向他汇报，我们已和拉斯韦加斯分会联系，过明年第二十七次全美西南华人福利会的联席会议将在一月份在赌城召开，我们凤凰城分会成员会组团去参加，但最重要的是希望福伯早日康复，带领土桑福利会成员出席会，议我们不见不散。 福伯脸上露出笑容，他从1983到2007年先后24年担任西南福利分会秘书长，做好了许多会务，又做了许多好事和善事，自从把秘书长任务交给我后，仍经常来电来信给予教导和提供信息。他是一位和我开口就谈侨社历史和会务，而不谈其他”劳杂子”的侨领，对他的赏识心存感激，我对他说，我不想作这个秘书长，因为我没有你那种认真又认真的精神，但我也很想当你这样的秘书长，因为可以多活上廿四年。 其实一个人能健康地活到八十六岁就不容易，而在八十六岁还经常惦记着侨社会务的侨领就更是难得。”古人不见今时月，今月曾经照古人”。古往今来，前人后辈，滚滚长江浪淘尽英雄人物，好人和好事会被人记传的本来就不会多，但只要我们怀有善心和公益心，在当其时为其社会和人群服务过，就算是明月清辉，也会受到人们的赞美，我们衷心祝福伯早日康复！
1f7b62df3efc543638c77679f852e62bf385bfc7.translatedText: The concern that exists in Fu Bo's heart Zhang Zhaohong As the saying goes: "Only with concern can there be the weight of existence." When life comes to a critical moment, some people think about the distribution of inheritance, some people think about arrangements for wives and children, and some people think about the historical position after death. As for Mr. Chen Yingfu, an old overseas Chinese leader from Tucson, who has been through the gate of hell once, the one who lingers and worries about him is the Southwest Branch of the National Chinese Welfare Association. One day in mid-November, while watering the flowers in the courtyard of his home, Fu Bo accidentally fell due to slippery water. The 80-year-old man suffered a serious fall. His eyes suddenly turned black, he fell unconscious, and had a stroke. He was rushed to the hospital immediately for rescue. It may be that Uncle Fu is a kind man and has good karma and good results, or it may be that he still has some concerns in his heart. In his words, "I want to come back." And one thing that Uncle Fu has to do after "coming back" is to ask his daughter Cene to call President Zhen of the "Alberta Times" and ask Gao Zhizhong, chairman of the Overseas Chinese Federation, and me to go see him. On the morning of November 21, the three of us, together with Ms. Liang, a staff member of the Alberta Times, drove to Tucson to visit Mr. Forbes in the hospital. In the hospital, I happened to see General Yang Zaicun, the former commander of the Taiwan Military Police, also going to visit Uncle Forbes, so they went together. When he was young, Forbes served as a soldier and participated in anti-Japanese and national salvation activities. He was a revolutionary and passionate young man. President Zhen and Fu Bo have been old friends for many years. On behalf of the Alberta Times and the Southwest Welfare Branch, he selected a pot of the best flowers in the flower cabinet. Following Fu Bo's son who came to guide us, we came to the ward. Uncle Fu was half-sitting in a wheelchair and seemed to be in good spirits, which made us feel more relaxed. Also in the ward is Uncle Fu's wife, Aunt Fu, who is also in a wheelchair. This pair of mandarin ducks have shared joys and sorrows for decades and have five daughters and one son. The second daughter and youngest son in front of me have been waiting in front of the bed for many days. There is plenty of light in the ward and flowers are arranged. Uncle Fu saw us arriving. He was very happy, completely ignoring that he was still wearing a diaphragm, a tube, and a headgear. He excitedly took our hands and sat on the edge of the bed, and then started talking. He spoke at a speed that seemed "non-stop". His daughter Cene came to ask him "slowly" several times. , speak slowly, he is willing to listen, and as soon as he starts talking, he starts talking from the 1950s. In 1957, the U.S. Immigration Service conducted extensive searches of Chinese in the United States because they had false birth certificates. This sparked anti-discrimination riots among all Chinese. In order to fight for equal rights, Chinese representatives from all over the United States gathered in Beijing. Shi immediately established the National Chinese Welfare Federation. The following year, the Phoenix Chinese Welfare Branch was also established. Due to the united efforts of the Chinese people, the U.S. Congress finally obtained fair legislation, which revised and relaxed China's annual immigration quota from only 105 to 20,000 (plus 20,000 from Taiwan and 5,000 from Hong Kong). Since then, tens of thousands of overseas Chinese have come to the United States, reunited with their own flesh and blood, developed vitality, created a new world, and finally developed into the new situation of the overseas Chinese community today. The Southwest Chinese Welfare Branch was established in 1974 with members in Phoenix, Tucson, Las Vegas and New Mexico. It has a history of 35 years. Since I had often listened to Forbes' narration of the above history, he spoke incoherently that day, and I understood what he meant very well. Then Fubo said that although the current situation is much stronger than before, and more Chinese groups continue to fight for their own rights and interests, as members of the Welfare Association, we must carry forward the glorious tradition, strengthen ties with the southwestern states, and pass on the affairs of the association. It was really touching that an 80-year-old man couldn't let go of the overseas Chinese community. I quickly reported to him that we had contacted the Las Vegas branch and that the 27th joint meeting of the Southwest Chinese Welfare Association would be held in Las Vegas in January next year. Our Phoenix branch members would organize a group to attend, but the most important thing was to hope that Fu Bo would recover soon and bring the members of the Las Vegas Welfare Association to attend the meeting. We will see you there. A smile appeared on Fubo's face. He served as the secretary-general of the Southwest Welfare Branch for 24 years from 1983 to 2007. He did a lot of conference work and did many good deeds. Since he entrusted me with the task of being the secretary-general, he still often calls and writes to teach and provide information. He was an overseas Chinese leader who talked to me about the history and affairs of the Overseas Chinese Society without talking about other "workers". I was grateful for his appreciation. I told him that I don't want to be this secretary-general because I don't have your serious and conscientious spirit, but I also want to be a secretary-general like you because I can live for another 24 years. In fact, it is not easy for a person to live to the age of eighty-six in good health, and it is even more rare for an overseas Chinese leader to still be thinking about the affairs of the overseas Chinese community at the age of eighty-six. "The ancients did not see the moon today, but the moon used to shine on the ancients." Throughout the ages, the ancestors and the descendants have swept away heroes in the rolling waves of the Yangtze River. Not many good people and good deeds will be remembered by people. But as long as we have a kind heart and a charitable spirit and have served the society and people at that time, even if the moon shines brightly, we will be praised by people. We sincerely wish Uncle a speedy recovery!

fad717c7757696a6a6015fb96197b25cf0dea92e.sourceText: 凤凰城 唐孝先 1969年5月，在犹他州举行的第一条横贯大陆铁路(First Transcontinental Railroad)通车一百週年纪念仪式上，时任美国运输部长的约翰 沃尔佩(John Volpe)无视史实，信口雌黄说：「除了美国人，谁能打通塞拉山脉的隧道？除了美国人，谁能一天舖铁轨十英里？」(Who but Americans could have blasted tunnels through the Sierras? Who but Americans could have built 10 miles of track in one day?) 他隻字未提造铁路的华工及其作的贡献，在场的当年华工后代大为不悦。 第一条横贯大陆铁路，于1863年至1869年由加利福尼亚中央太平洋铁路公司和联合太平洋铁路公司建造，连接艾奥瓦州的康瑟尔布拉夫斯、内布拉斯加州的奥马哈至加利福尼亚州三藩市湾东岸的奥克兰。按原计划，如此浩大的工程要花十四年时间才能完成。由于大量吃苦耐劳、勤劳智慧的华工加入，使工期缩短一半，七年就完成铁路的连接。筑路工人花名册上，一时华工几乎佔百分之九十五。 现年七十三岁的康妮 扬 余(Connie Young Yu)，住在加州湾区城市洛斯 阿尔托斯(Los Altos)，是位历史学家兼作家。她的父母亲，曾经从湾区前往犹他州出席那次第一条横贯大陆铁路通车一百週年的活动。 1869年5月10日，加州铁路大亨利兰 斯坦福(Leland Stanford)，在犹他州的普瑞蒙特瑞尖峰(Promontory Point)与联合太平洋铁路公司东西相向接轨地点，敲下最后一颗金色道钉。横贯大陆铁路完成后，美国西部人口急速增长，经济迅勐发展。 1891年，当上加州参议员及州长的利兰?斯坦福和夫人简 莱瑟罗普 斯坦福(Jane Lathrop Stanford)，创办了斯坦福大学(Stanford University)。而1860年代铁路华工劳动创造的巨额财富，正是斯坦福夫妇筹办斯坦福大学所需资金的主要来源。 十九世纪六十年代来美国的华人移民中，约有12,000人建筑铁路。几十年来，余女士和一般研究早期华人移民的历史爱好者们，不遗馀力地发掘他们来美国后作出的贡献，以及他们的种种遭遇，但成效不大。终于他们的研究得到斯坦福大学的支持。 斯坦福大学的学者们，成立了「北美铁路华工研究项目」(Chinese Railroad Workers in North America Project)。2012年至今，从美国、加拿大到亚洲，有一百多位人类学、考古学等领域裡的专家学者及志愿者，在从事这个项目的研究。他们通力合作，发表文章，出版书籍，製作数字档桉、数位影像，举办会议和其他公开活动。 该项目组副组长希尔顿 奥本辛格(Hilton Obenzinger)说过，如果没有这些华工，斯坦福大学不可能办起来。利兰斯坦福是有钱，然而因为铁路建造成功才使他富可敌国。他之所以有能力创办这所大学，正因为华工建造了这条铁路。 该校美国研究室主任谢莉 菲希尔 菲希金(Shelley Fisher Fishkin)说，我们在中央太平洋铁路公司的工资单记录裡，看到一行中文字，书法极佳，可能出自有会计师背景的读书人手笔。 研究人员相信，华工中不少曾是商人、贸易业者、铁匠。他们经历鸦片战争、太平天国动乱、自然灾害和飢荒，为了寻求机会而来到美国。移民中好多人受过教育，来自中国南方省份广东。 斯坦福大学东亚研究中心主任戈登 张(Gordon Chang)也说，华工们不但身强体壮，他们还怀着开创新生活的雄心壮志。他们来自各行各业，社会不同阶层，具有不同的技能，包括烹调、会计、木工手艺、泥水匠活。 今年6月初，约250位人士到斯坦福大学参加研讨早期来美华工的会议。其中有50位左右铁路华工的后人远道从夏威夷而来。通过家族谱系追溯，口述历史的分享，人们找到研究该项目的新线索。
fad717c7757696a6a6015fb96197b25cf0dea92e.translatedText: Phoenix Tang Xiaoxian In May 1969, at the 100th anniversary ceremony of the First Transcontinental Railroad in Utah, John Volpe, then U.S. Secretary of Transportation, ignored historical facts and said nonsense: "Who but Americans could have blasted tunnels through the Sierras? Who but Americans could have built tunnels in the Sierras? Who but Americans could have blasted tunnels through the Sierras? Who but Americans could have built 10 miles of track in one day?) He did not mention the Chinese workers who built the railway and their contribution. The descendants of the Chinese workers present were very unhappy. The first transcontinental railroad, built from 1863 to 1869 by the California Central Pacific Railroad and the Union Pacific Railroad, connected Council Bluffs, Iowa, and Omaha, Nebraska, to Oakland, California, on the east coast of San Francisco Bay. According to the original plan, such a huge project would take fourteen years to complete. Thanks to the participation of a large number of hardworking, diligent and intelligent Chinese workers, the construction period was shortened by half, and the railway connection was completed in seven years. On the roster of road construction workers, Chinese workers accounted for almost 95%. Connie Young Yu, 73, lives in Los Altos, a Bay Area city in California. She is a historian and writer. Her parents traveled from the Bay Area to Utah to attend the 100th anniversary of the first transcontinental railroad. On May 10, 1869, California railroad tycoon Leland Stanford drove the last golden spike at the point where the Union Pacific Railroad's east-west track connected with Promontory Point in Utah. After the completion of the transcontinental railroad, the population of the western United States increased rapidly and the economy developed rapidly. In 1891, Leland Stanford, who became California's senator and governor, and his wife, Jane Lathrop Stanford, founded Stanford University. The huge wealth created by the labor of Chinese railroad workers in the 1860s was the main source of funds needed by the Stanford couple to organize Stanford University. About 12,000 of the Chinese immigrants who came to the United States in the 1860s built railroads. For decades, Ms. Yu and general history enthusiasts who study early Chinese immigrants have spared no effort to discover their contributions after coming to the United States and their various experiences, but with little success. Finally, their research was supported by Stanford University. Scholars from Stanford University established the "Chinese Railroad Workers in North America Project". Since 2012, more than 100 experts, scholars and volunteers in the fields of anthropology, archaeology and other fields from the United States, Canada to Asia are engaged in research on this project. They work together to publish articles, books, produce digital files and images, and organize conferences and other public events. Hilton Obenzinger, deputy leader of the project team, said that without these Chinese workers, Stanford University would not be possible. Leland Stanford was rich, but it was because of the successful construction of the railroad that he became extremely wealthy. The reason why he was able to found this university was because Chinese laborers built this railway. Shelley Fisher Fishkin, director of the school's American Studies Office, said that in the payroll records of the Central Pacific Railroad, we saw a line of Chinese characters with excellent calligraphy, which may have been written by a scholar with an accountant background. Researchers believe that many Chinese workers were merchants, traders, and blacksmiths. They experienced the Opium War, the Taiping Rebellion, natural disasters and famine, and came to the United States in search of opportunities. The immigrants, many of whom are educated, come from the southern Chinese province of Guangdong. Gordon Chang, director of the Center for East Asian Studies at Stanford University, also said that not only were the Chinese workers physically strong, they also had the ambition to create a new life. They come from all walks of life, different social strata, and have different skills, including cooking, accounting, carpentry, and plastering. In early June this year, about 250 people went to Stanford University to attend a conference on early Chinese workers in the United States. Among them, about 50 descendants of Chinese railway workers came all the way from Hawaii. Through family genealogy tracing and the sharing of oral histories, new clues to research on the project were found.

daad2cf55b3261442f31fddb3a48afdaa9dd5555.translatedText: ” Arizona and Yunnan will become partners in promoting the long-lasting friendship between China and the United States because of the flying tiger anti-Japanese culture. "Deng Chaoju, Chairman of the Organizing Committee of the Chinese Anti-Fascist War in Alberta and Commemoration of the 70th Anniversary of the Victory of the Anti-Japanese War, not only expressed his sincere welcome to the 14 representatives of the Flying Tiger Club of the Yunnan Flying Tiger Museum, but also agreed to hold hands and work together for the exchange plan between the two places.

d276f63528283cdd27017c1fb7cb3ae664d0b43d.sourceText: 由彭越率领14位飞虎会队员，耒美的主要原因是出席云南飞虎博物馆与美国民间航空协会(AVG)自6月25日开始在全美8个城市为纪念反法西斯战争胜利70年共同举办的飞虎抗日文物展。 彭越说，我一定要耒凤凰城，因云南是飞虎队抗日作战基地，凤凰城是飞虎队训练基地，两地在70年前因抗日战争就紧紧绑在一起了。 组委会委员崔增祁致词时，更确定了两地紧密的合作伙伴关係，凤凰城代表团确定明年回访云南。 彭越利用在展览会开始之前一个月时间，带领飞虎会沿着美国第一条高速公路 ”’66号”追寻美国立国初期的昌险奋斗精神，而亚历桑那正是美国西部开发的中继核心，促成飞虎会与本地展开交流的契机。 欢迎大会上嘉宾如云，华人侨社知名领袖佘文劲先生代表致赠感谢状给飞虎会，感谢促成中美两地文化交流的卓越贡献，华总会长李建以半个主人身份致词，希望大家为中美友谊长存交流积极贡献。 当天有二位英雄家属与会，飞虎英雄邓桐臻的遗霜邓夫人及曾参加二战，今天高龄92岁的 Arnold Wu 均受到飞虎会的热诚致意与合照，均将留存在云南飞虎博物馆内。 组委会委员张肇鸿代表大会致赠飞虎会由他亲笔写下本地华人参加抗战的英勇文集，亦将留存在云南飞虎博物馆内，永久纪念。 亚省旗袍会在汤可率领下是当天活动的幕后功臣，除了担任会前准备工作，更在开场时以旗袍正装迎宾，她们选派一位小小飞虎迷，用自己画的飞虎与仙人掌做为礼物送给飞虎会，相当温馨。 有一个秘密; 汤可就是飞虎会会长彭越的岳母大人，两地往后的交流肯定要加温。 当晚场面热烈，气氛高亢出席贵宾有帅至若，陶世诚，吕丽华，赵彩虹，张圣仪，唐孝先，邓贺铮，Benny Yee ，吕美兰，佘霭明，庄淑华，范宪文，陈彩屏，高志中等直到散场大家仍不愿离开而继续交流，是近年少见这么成功的活动。
d276f63528283cdd27017c1fb7cb3ae664d0b43d.translatedText: The 14 members of the Flying Tigers are led by Peng Yue. The main reason for the beauty is to attend the Flying Tiger Anti-Japanese Cultural Relics Exhibition co-organized by the Yunnan Flying Tiger Museum and the American Civil Aviation Association (AVG) in eight cities across the United States since June 25 to commemorate the 70th anniversary of the victory of the Anti-Fascist War. Peng Yue said, I must build Phoenix City, because Yunnan is the Flying Tigers' anti-Japanese combat base, and Phoenix City is the Flying Tigers' training base. The two places were closely tied together because of the Anti-Japanese War 70 years ago. In his speech, Cui Zengqi, a member of the organizing committee, confirmed the close cooperative partnership between the two places, and the Phoenix delegation decided to return to Yunnan next year. Peng Yue used one month before the exhibition to lead the Flying Tiger Club along the first highway "'66" in the United States to trace the spirit of prosperity and struggle in the early days of the United States. Arizona was the relay core for the development of the western United States, which provided an opportunity for the Flying Tiger Club to communicate with the local area. There were many guests at the welcome conference. Mr. She Wenjin, a well-known leader of the Chinese Overseas Chinese Community, presented a certificate of thanks to the Flying Tiger Club on behalf of the Flying Tiger Club for its outstanding contribution to promoting cultural exchanges between China and the United States. Li Jian, President of the Flying Tiger Club, delivered a speech as a half-host, hoping that everyone would actively contribute to the long-lasting friendship and exchanges between China and the United States. Two family members of heroes attended the meeting that day. Mrs. Deng, the deceased of Flying Tiger hero Deng Tongzhen, and Arnold Wu, who is 92 years old today and participated in World War II. Both received warm tributes and took photos with the Flying Tiger Association, and both will be retained in the Yunnan Flying Tiger Museum. Member of the organizing committee Zhang Zhaohong presented to the Flying Tigers Association on behalf of the conference a collection of heroic essays written by him on the local Chinese participating in the Anti-Japanese War, which will also be preserved in the Yunnan Flying Tigers Museum as a permanent commemoration. The Alberta Cheongsam Club, led by Tang Ke, was the hero behind the day's event. In addition to being responsible for the preparatory work, they also welcomed the guests in formal cheongsam at the opening. They selected a little flying tiger fan to give the flying tiger and cactus as a gift to the Flying Tiger Club, which was quite heartwarming. There is a secret; Tang Ke is the mother-in-law of Peng Yue, the president of the Flying Tiger Association. The exchanges between the two places will definitely be heated up in the future. The scene that night was lively and the atmosphere was high. The distinguished guests present included Tao Shicheng, Lui Laiwa, Zhao Caihong, Zhang Shengyi, Tang Xiaoxian, Deng Hezheng, Benny Yee, Lu Meilan, She Aiming, Zhuang Shuhua, Fan Xianwen, Chen Caiping, Gao Zhizhong. Everyone still refused to leave and continued to communicate until the end. It was a rare event like this in recent years.

3ebe26d25359f64a289ccdef9c3ee2d0d447b99a.translatedText: China is a hot spot for realizing dreams. my country's attraction to international talents continues to increase (survey study)

f2fe5d924beee6f4bed515468ac0fdb4724d7c61.sourceText: 人才流动有其自身规律。在经济全球化进程中，发达经济体占据产业链高端，人才等全球优质资源曾经长期向发达经济体聚集。改革开放以来，我国综合国力与世界影响力不断提升，对人才的吸引力越来越强。2008年国际金融危机爆发后，一些发达经济体的发展陷入困境，而我国经济始终保持持续健康发展，越来越多的国际人才选择将中国作为实现自己梦想的热土。
f2fe5d924beee6f4bed515468ac0fdb4724d7c61.translatedText: Talent flow has its own rules. In the process of economic globalization, developed economies occupy the high end of the industrial chain, and high-quality global resources such as talents have been gathering in developed economies for a long time. Since the reform and opening up, my country's comprehensive national strength and global influence have continued to improve, making it more and more attractive to talents. After the outbreak of the international financial crisis in 2008, the development of some developed economies was in trouble, but our country's economy has always maintained sustained and healthy development, and more and more international talents have chosen China as a place to realize their dreams.

54824807021af797dddcd962cc5bed7e33f6e598.sourceText: 为了更好了解中国各区域国际人才竞争力的发展水平，中国与全球化智库和西南财经大学发展研究院从国际人才规模、结构、创新、政策、发展和生活六个方面，对中国区域国际人才竞争力进行整体和分区域评估，编写了《中国区域国际人才竞争力报告(2017)》。这一评估是在充分吸收借鉴国内外人才竞争力研究经验、获取权威数据的前提下进行的。评估结果显示，上海、北京、广东和江苏成为国际人才竞争力总分较高的区域。这4个地区以经济发展、产业创新、国际合作和开放包容等整体优势，组成中国区域国际人才竞争力的第一梯队。第二梯队由其他东部沿海省份及中西部发展较好的省份组成。
54824807021af797dddcd962cc5bed7e33f6e598.translatedText: In order to better understand the development level of international talent competitiveness in various regions in China, the China and Globalization Think Tank and the Development Research Institute of Southwestern University of Finance and Economics conducted an overall and sub-regional assessment of China's regional international talent competitiveness from six aspects: international talent scale, structure, innovation, policy, development and life, and compiled the "China Regional International Talent Competitiveness Report (2017)". This assessment was conducted on the premise of fully absorbing and drawing on domestic and foreign talent competitiveness research experience and obtaining authoritative data. The evaluation results show that Shanghai, Beijing, Guangdong and Jiangsu have become regions with higher overall scores for international talent competitiveness. With their overall advantages in economic development, industrial innovation, international cooperation, openness and inclusiveness, these four regions form the first echelon of China's regional international talent competitiveness. The second tier consists of other eastern coastal provinces and provinces with better development in the central and western regions.

63964ae6403ded3cb08b63194e0a5b6dfc548c26.sourceText: 研究发现，近年来人才流动的方向正在发生趋势性改变。许多原来离开中国到海外谋求发展的人纷纷回国，带回国际化知识、专业技能和人际关系网络。根据教育部数据，2016年我国出国留学人员约54.5万人，留学回国人员约43.3万人，回流率达到79.43%。人才回流所带来的人才红利，成为我国未来发展的优势之一。此外，我国发展对其他国际人才的吸引力也在不断增强。例如，海外华侨华人有6200多万，其中专业人士接近400万人，他们广泛分布在教育、金融、高新技术等行业，很多人已经成为世界一流的科学家、工程师、高级管理人才。近年来，他们中的不少人选择在中国创业安家。
63964ae6403ded3cb08b63194e0a5b6dfc548c26.translatedText: Research has found that the direction of talent flow is undergoing a trend change in recent years. Many people who originally left China to seek development overseas have returned home, bringing with them international knowledge, professional skills and interpersonal networks. According to data from the Ministry of Education, in 2016, about 545,000 people studied abroad in my country, and about 433,000 people returned from studying abroad, with the return rate reaching 79.43%. The talent dividend brought by the return of talents has become one of the advantages of our country's future development. In addition, the attractiveness of my country's development to other international talents is also increasing. For example, there are more than 62 million overseas Chinese, including nearly 4 million professionals. They are widely distributed in education, finance, high-tech and other industries. Many of them have become world-class scientists, engineers, and senior management talents. In recent years, many of them have chosen to start a business and settle down in China.

c2e53719b259cfc41b26ad854cfa0b9d2088c0f2.sourceText: 我国之所以能汇聚众多国际人才，与我国对人才工作的高度重视密切相关。党的十八大以来，以习近平同志为核心的党中央更加重视人才队伍建设。习近平同志指出，我们比历史上任何时期都更需要广开进贤之路、广纳天下英才，要实行更加开放的人才政策，不唯地域引进人才，不求所有开发人才，不拘一格用好人才。为形成具有国际竞争力的人才制度优势，充分开发利用国际人才资源，主动参与国际人才竞争，我国制定了相关政策措施，完善海外人才引进方式，为其出入境、就业居留提供更加便捷高效的服务。比如，2016年，公安部分别推出支持福建自贸试验区建设的10项出入境政策措施和支持广东自贸区建设及创新驱动发展的16项出入境政策措施。随着各地吸引国际人才新政的实施，我国国际人才引进工作不断取得新进展。
c2e53719b259cfc41b26ad854cfa0b9d2088c0f2.translatedText: The reason why our country can bring together so many international talents is closely related to the high importance our country attaches to talent work. Since the 18th National Congress of the Communist Party of China, the Party Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping as the core has paid more attention to the construction of talent teams. Comrade Xi Jinping pointed out that more than at any time in history, we need to open up the road to talents and recruit talents from all over the world. We must implement a more open talent policy. We do not only introduce talents from regions, do not seek to develop talents from all areas, and use talents in an eclectic way. In order to form an internationally competitive talent system advantage, fully develop and utilize international talent resources, and actively participate in international talent competition, my country has formulated relevant policies and measures to improve the introduction of overseas talents and provide more convenient and efficient services for their entry, exit, employment and residence. For example, in 2016, the Ministry of Public Security launched 10 entry-exit policy measures to support the construction of the Fujian Pilot Free Trade Zone and 16 entry-exit policy measures to support the construction and innovation-driven development of the Guangdong Free Trade Zone. With the implementation of new policies to attract international talents in various places, my country's international talent introduction work continues to make new progress.

d7dec6f59b00f13d85bd91ec3f8978dc27bf86bf.sourceText: 当然，为进一步增强对国际人才的吸引力，我国还有许多工作需要不断改进提高。比如，进一步加强引进国际人才的顶层设计，设立专门的国际人才管理机构；加强政策可操作性，持续发挥国家创新区域在引进国际人才方面的引领与示范带动作用，积极探索城市群国际高端人才共享模式；进一步加强城市软实力建设，从自然环境、城市文明和生活配套等方面提升区域国际人才竞争力水平；建立国际人才合作组织，打造国际人才协调服务专业平台；等等。在科学人才思想和有效工作举措推动下，我国对国际人才的吸引力必将全面增强，从而为实现中华民族伟大复兴提供有力人才保障。
d7dec6f59b00f13d85bd91ec3f8978dc27bf86bf.translatedText: Of course, in order to further enhance the attractiveness of international talents, our country still has a lot of work that needs to be continuously improved. For example, further strengthen the top-level design for the introduction of international talents and establish a specialized international talent management agency; strengthen the operability of policies, continue to play the leading and demonstration role of national innovation zones in the introduction of international talents, and actively explore the international high-end talent sharing model in urban agglomerations; further strengthen the construction of urban soft power, improve the competitiveness of regional international talents from the aspects of natural environment, urban civilization and living facilities; establish international talent cooperation organizations and create a professional platform for international talent coordination services; etc. Driven by scientific talent thinking and effective work measures, my country's attraction to international talents will be comprehensively enhanced, thus providing a strong talent guarantee for the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation.

641040cd44027104cc9e465e6bfe1b235bf9755e.sourceText: 游客强大的购买力让旅行社在线路设计上毫不犹豫地加入了购物一项，其中最受欢迎的当属美国洛杉矶棕榈泉卡巴松奥特莱斯、纽约Woodbury奥特莱斯、旧金山联合广场、 法国老佛爷、巴黎春天等云集众多国际一线奢侈品牌的购物场所。 记者从中旅总社、中青旅等京城旅行社了解到，到国外”扫货”已经成为北京游客行程中的一大主要项目，中旅总社出境旅游美洲部经理丛玲表示，美国短线游游 客平均消费能力至少1000美元以上，以老年人为主的东西海岸观光游的人均消费至少也300美元。 中青旅美洲中心经理张惠玲告诉记者，曾有两个家庭去美国旅游，每个家庭都购买了20万美元以上的商品。 记者了解到，英国不少媒体​​热议中国游客新年期间在英国血拼，并将其形容为”北京镑”，也就是中国人消费的英镑。 世界奢侈品协会的数据也显示，国人的奢侈品消费已跃居全球之首。 日前，该协会发布华人春节海外奢侈品消费数据监控报告，数据显示，春节期间，中国人在境外消费累计达72亿美元，创历史最高点，其中消费额最高为欧洲，占46%，其次为 港澳台35%，北美为19%，消费目标为名表、皮具、时装、化妆品香水。 在欧洲，游客最主要消费区域集中在法国、意大利、英国、瑞士，美国集中在纽约、洛杉矶、旧金山、波士顿、夏威夷、芝加哥、华盛顿。 银联卡美国刷卡商家增加了 为了方便华人游客购物，欧美国家的商家纷纷推出方便举措。 据中旅总社丛玲介绍，美国刚开放时能刷银联卡的商家不多，但是时至今日，在大量中国游客纷纷涌入美国后，银联卡的刷卡范围增加了，如机场免税店、 大型购物中心、梅西百货、奥特莱斯等场所均能方便地刷银联卡。 同时，部分免税店还推出优惠卡，折扣商品也能享受9折优惠，而且美国当地的会员超市也对游客开放，价格也相当便宜。 此外，老外店家们还纷纷雇佣能说汉语的店员，英国邦德街的商店就让讲汉语的店员为中国游客服务，法国巴黎春天和老佛爷都有专门针对华人的退税点，里面的工作人员 大多数是华人。
641040cd44027104cc9e465e6bfe1b235bf9755e.translatedText: The strong purchasing power of tourists makes travel agencies not hesitate to add shopping to the itinerary design. Among them, the most popular are undoubtedly the Cabazon Outlets in Palm Springs in Los Angeles, the Woodbury Outlets in New York, and Union Square in San Francisco. Shopping venues such as Galeries Lafayette and Printemps are home to many international first-line luxury brands. The reporter learned from Beijing travel agencies such as China Travel Service and China Youth Travel Service that shopping abroad has become a major item in the itinerary of Beijing tourists. Cong Ling, manager of the outbound tourism Americas department of China Travel Service, said that the average spending power of short-term tourists in the United States is at least US$1,000, and the per capita consumption of sightseeing tours on the east and west coasts, mainly for the elderly, is at least US$300. Zhang Huiling, manager of the Americas Center of China Youth Travel Service, told reporters that two families once traveled to the United States, and each family purchased more than 200,000 US dollars in goods. The reporter learned that many British media are hotly discussing Chinese tourists’ shopping in the UK during the New Year, describing it as the “Beijing pound”, which is the pound consumed by Chinese people. Data from the World Luxury Goods Association also shows that Chinese people’s luxury goods consumption has ranked first in the world. Recently, the association released a data monitoring report on overseas luxury goods consumption during the Chinese Spring Festival. The data showed that during the Spring Festival, Chinese people spent a total of 7.2 billion US dollars overseas, a record high. The highest consumption was in Europe, accounting for 46%, followed by Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan at 35%, and North America at 19%. The consumption targets were luxury watches, leather goods, fashion, cosmetics and perfumes. In Europe, the main consumption areas for tourists are concentrated in France, Italy, the United Kingdom, and Switzerland. In the United States, the main consumption areas are New York, Los Angeles, San Francisco, Boston, Hawaii, Chicago, and Washington. The number of merchants using UnionPay cards in the United States has increased. In order to facilitate shopping for Chinese tourists, merchants in European and American countries have launched convenience measures. According to Cong Ling, headquarter of China Travel Service, there were not many merchants that accepted UnionPay cards when the United States first opened up. But today, after a large number of Chinese tourists flocked to the United States, the scope of UnionPay cards has increased. UnionPay cards can be easily accepted in airport duty-free shops, large shopping malls, Macy's department stores, outlets and other places. At the same time, some duty-free shops have also launched discount cards, and you can also enjoy a 10% discount on discounted products. Local member supermarkets in the United States are also open to tourists, and the prices are quite cheap. In addition, foreign stores have also hired Chinese-speaking clerks. Stores on Bond Street in the United Kingdom have Chinese-speaking clerks serve Chinese tourists. Paris Printemps and Galeries Lafayette in France have tax refund points specifically for Chinese, and most of the staff inside are Chinese.

44844cb0f556afe0f01e92e2a39a97d48d6d8e60.sourceText: 两个不同的慈善团体 亚太健康促进会和慈济 佳叔 我们凤凰城有两个慈善团体，历年来很热心为亚裔社会服务，他们做的慈善虽各有异，但同是出自爱心，值得我们全侨赞。 其一是亚太社区促进会，英文是 ASIAN PACIFIC COMMUNITY IN ACTION 简称 APCA，它的创始人是佳叔多年的好朋友徐德之夫妇的女儿徐凯莱医生。徐德之夫妇两人是中国传统针灸医师，早年曾在加州悬壶济世，退休后迁居来到凤凰城，女儿徐凯莱夫妇是西医，她们是医学世家，医者父母心，所以徐凯莱医师承传父母慈祥，天父施恩，于六, 七年前组织了这个APCA。每年都有一次慈善晚宴，募集慈善基金，用来为亚裔社区医疗和健康常识设施。我们常见到她们在报纸上登广告，佛口菩心劝亚裔侨胞检查身体健康状况，并免费提供：乙性肝炎，高血压，照X光，妇女乳癌和子宫癌等项目的检查。其中尤以乙性肝炎是亚裔人多染和为人最忽略的一种隐形杀手症。如果一个人染上乙性肝炎，表面上没有一点危害，但它一代一代传宗接祖下去，如果不及早治疗，将会变成肝硬化即肝癌。妇女得了乳癌或子宫癌亦很危险，在美国死亡率很高，要时常检验。 亚太社区促进会这个团体，昨四月二十二日晚在SCOTTSDALE DOUBLE TREE 酒店举办第六届慈善筹款，在报上见到这晚会很成功，参加者有四百多人，包括我们侨社龙头老大邓粤宙，余文劲，高志中等。佳叔今年接到请柬时，因早有事安排未暇参加，只寄上捐款以表赞同。 其二是凤凰城慈济联络处。她们做的慈善惠及全人类每一个角落，不分地域，不分族裔，举凡地震，水灾，风灾，洪涝，海啸，车祸造成的祸难，如汶川地震，台湾莫拉克台风，印尼的海啸，南美洪涝，都有她们团队，登山涉水救援。她们本着菩萨心肠，每次都即时发起全体兄弟姐妹有钱出钱，有力出力或出钱出力，有的还是十岁间的小弟弟和小妹妹捧抱善箱，暴着气温110度炎热太阳下，站在人多出入的餐馆，杂货店门前向人们募施，替受苦受难的同胞挣扎这种感人肺腑的善举。佳叔每次出入都不期而然掷下善金。 早年，中国学生在旗杆埠FLAGSTAFF遇到严重车祸，他们急需医疗，食物，语言帮助，慈济团队立即出现使他们异国中得到温暖。 在西人社会我们常见到有民间团体如KWANI，ROTARY，LION WOMEN CLUB给这等慈善机构捐款。希望有日我们侨社团体也效仿他们。
44844cb0f556afe0f01e92e2a39a97d48d6d8e60.translatedText: Two different charity groups, the Asia-Pacific Health Promotion Association and Tzu Chi. Uncle Jia We have two charity groups in Phoenix that have been enthusiastically serving the Asian community over the years. Although their charities are different, they are both motivated by love and deserve praise from all of us. One is the Asia-Pacific Community Promotion Association, which in English is ASIAN PACIFIC COMMUNITY IN ACTION, or APCA for short. Its founder is Dr. Xu Kailai, the daughter of Mr. and Mrs. Xu Dezhi, a good friend of Uncle Jia’s for many years. Xu Dezhi and his wife are traditional Chinese acupuncturists. In their early years, they worked in Xuanhu, California, and moved to Phoenix after retirement. Their daughter, Xu Kailai, and his wife are Western medicine practitioners. They are from a medical family, and doctors are parents. Therefore, Dr. Xu Kailai inherited the kindness of his parents and the kindness of Heavenly Father, and organized the APCA six or seven years ago. There is a charity dinner every year to raise charitable funds for medical and health awareness facilities for the Asian community. We often see them placing advertisements in newspapers, urging Asians to check their health, and providing free examinations for hepatitis B, high blood pressure, X-rays, breast cancer, and uterine cancer. Among them, hepatitis B is a silent killer disease that is commonly infected by Asians and is the most ignored. If a person is infected with hepatitis B, there is no harm at all on the surface, but if it is passed down from generation to generation, if not treated early, it will turn into cirrhosis or liver cancer. It is also very dangerous for women to get breast cancer or uterine cancer. The mortality rate in the United States is very high, so they need to be tested frequently. The Asia-Pacific Community Promotion Association held its sixth charity fund-raising event at the SCOTTSDALE DOUBLE TREE Hotel on the evening of April 22 last night. I read in the newspaper that the party was a success, with more than 400 participants, including the leaders of our overseas Chinese community, Deng Yuezhou, Yu Wenjin, and Gao Zhizhong. When Uncle Jia received the invitation this year, he had no time to attend due to early commitments, so he only sent a donation to express his approval. The second is the Phoenix Tzu Chi Liaison Office. The charity they do benefits every corner of mankind, regardless of region or ethnicity. In disasters caused by earthquakes, floods, wind disasters, floods, tsunamis, and car accidents, such as the Wenchuan earthquake, Typhoon Morakot in Taiwan, tsunamis in Indonesia, and floods in South America, their teams have been involved in mountaineering and wading rescue operations. With a bodhisattva heart, they immediately initiated all brothers and sisters to donate money, help, or contribute money and efforts every time. Some even ten-year-old brothers and sisters held charity boxes and stood in front of crowded restaurants and grocery stores under the 110-degree scorching sun to collect donations from people and fight for the suffering compatriots. This touching act of kindness was heartfelt. Uncle Jia unexpectedly dropped some good money every time he came in and out. In the early years, Chinese students encountered a serious car accident at FLAGSTAFF in Flagstaff. They were in urgent need of medical treatment, food, and language help. The Tzu Chi team immediately appeared to help them feel warm in a foreign country. In Western society, we often see private organizations such as KWANI, ROTARY, and LION WOMEN CLUB donating to such charities. I hope that one day our overseas Chinese community will follow their lead.

9a30e6574847aa2e5a1564c28d230b6087d83ca0.sourceText: 续Scottsdale 市长Mayor Jim Lane 周三剪彩后，长城中医院于周六，2014年1月18日，迎来了又一次盛大的开业典礼暨中国新年舞会。舞会于周六下午4:30开始，在长城中医院的新地址（3225 N. 75th St. Scottsdale, AZ 85251）举行，古筝表演、舞狮表演吸引了来自加州、德州、亚利桑那州的近100人参加此次舞会。来宾包括长城中医院的新老病人、与长城中医院合作的著名医师(Dr. Vance Inouye, Dr. Mark Cwyner等)、 肖青松医生的朋友等。
9a30e6574847aa2e5a1564c28d230b6087d83ca0.translatedText: Controlled by Mayor Jim Lane of Scottsdale After cutting the ribbon on Wednesday, Great Wall Traditional Chinese Medicine Hospital held another grand opening ceremony and Chinese New Year Dance on Saturday, January 18, 2014. The dance started at 4:30 pm on Saturday and was held at the new address of the Great Wall Hospital of Traditional Chinese Medicine (3225 N. 75th St. Scottsdale, AZ 85251). Guzheng performances and lion dance performances attracted nearly 100 people from California, Texas, and Arizona to participate in the dance. Guests included new and old patients of the Great Wall Hospital of Traditional Chinese Medicine, famous doctors who cooperated with the Great Wall Hospital of Traditional Chinese Medicine (Dr. Vance Inouye, Dr. Mark Cwyner, etc.), friends of Dr. Xiao Qingsong, etc.

caea095e0e2bca6c2b4da6d685724a66ed979b9f.sourceText: 舞会汇集了亚省名人：古筝表演家贺绿蒂、川渝同乡会主席陈志刚、肖家三大医生和Alex Yu
caea095e0e2bca6c2b4da6d685724a66ed979b9f.translatedText: The dance brought together celebrities from the province: guzheng performer He Ludi, Chairman of the Sichuan-Chongqing Association Chen Zhigang, the three major doctors of the Xiao family, and Alex Yu

ff7a19155b0eba89ab5e4e3cd4243a916c157b99.sourceText: 此次舞会以古筝和舞狮表演为主题，为公众展示了中国文化的博大精深。舞会上还展示了周三Scottsdale市长Mayor Jim Lane剪彩的报道、长城中医院的再教育项目以及长城中医院未来建设中医研究中心的计划，让更多人了解到长城中医院给社区带来的贡献。
ff7a19155b0eba89ab5e4e3cd4243a916c157b99.translatedText: The dance featured guzheng and lion dance performances, demonstrating the breadth and depth of Chinese culture to the public. The ball also showed reports on Wednesday's ribbon-cutting by Mayor Jim Lane of Scottsdale, the re-education project of Great Wall Hospital of Traditional Chinese Medicine, and the future plans of Great Wall Hospital of Traditional Chinese Medicine to build a Chinese medicine research center, allowing more people to understand the contributions that Great Wall Hospital of Traditional Chinese Medicine has made to the community.

c4d7dfd2042970f174aef0d9ae2f6c10f4978830.sourceText: 古筝由著名古筝表演家贺绿蒂演奏。绿蒂此次现场古筝表演从舞会开始一直持续到舞会结束，宾客们纷纷陶醉于优美的音乐中。绿蒂曾为前德国总理Dr. Richard Van Weizsacker, 前美国总统George H. W. Bush, George W. Bush, Bill Clinton, 尼泊尔国王及王后表演。长城中医院的病人Carol听了绿蒂的演奏说：”要不是亲自听到，我简直不敢相信她可以用有两千多年历史的古筝弹奏中国和西方的古今曲目。”可见，绿蒂的古筝演奏让更多美国人了解了古筝的美妙，加深了他们对中国文化的兴趣。
c4d7dfd2042970f174aef0d9ae2f6c10f4978830.translatedText: The guzheng is played by the famous guzheng performer He Ludi. Lotte's live guzheng performance lasted from the beginning to the end of the dance, and the guests were intoxicated by the beautiful music. Lotte has performed for former German Chancellor Dr. Richard Van Weizsacker, former US Presidents George H. W. Bush, George W. Bush, Bill Clinton, and the King and Queen of Nepal. Carol, a patient at the Great Wall Traditional Chinese Medicine Hospital, listened to Lotte's performance and said, "If I hadn't heard it in person, I couldn't believe that she could play ancient and modern Chinese and Western pieces on a guzheng with a history of more than 2,000 years." It can be seen that Lotte's guzheng performance has made more Americans understand the beauty of the guzheng and deepened their interest in Chinese culture.

d22193b21b94e784b35fbf7e4cba0a19cda5fc65.sourceText: 舞狮表演从下午六点钟开始，由玉月武术会应邀表演。在中国，舞狮、舞龙是每年过年必不可少的节目。而在美国，当我们发邀请函时跟美国人说会有舞狮表演，很多人都不知道是怎么回事。到了舞会现场看到真正的表演后，大家都惊叹不绝。而看到美国人舞狮，更让人觉得中国文化正在被更多的西方人接受，因为此次舞狮队伍的所有成员都是美国人。
d22193b21b94e784b35fbf7e4cba0a19cda5fc65.translatedText: The lion dance performance starts at six o'clock in the afternoon and is performed by Yuyue Martial Arts Club upon invitation. In China, lion dance and dragon dance are essential performances during the Chinese New Year every year. In the United States, when we sent out invitations and told Americans that there would be a lion dance performance, many people didn't know what was going on. After arriving at the dance and seeing the real performance, everyone was amazed. Seeing Americans performing lion dance makes people feel that Chinese culture is being accepted by more Westerners, because all members of the lion dance team are Americans.

c09d06ec2df7d06fcf011fb82bb309892cf2a067.sourceText: 舞会上丰盛的食物，包括寿司、饺子、越南春卷、匹萨、莎拉、各种饮料、红酒等
c09d06ec2df7d06fcf011fb82bb309892cf2a067.translatedText: The sumptuous food at the dance included sushi, dumplings, Vietnamese spring rolls, pizza, salad, various drinks, red wine, etc.

e4845dc0c56bb7dbc14ffe7b92d6fd04a2f16c12.sourceText: 舞会上，肖青松医师也不会忘记与合作医生Dr. Mark Cwynar 讨论一下她们共同的病人Carol的病情，以找出更好的治疗方案。
e4845dc0c56bb7dbc14ffe7b92d6fd04a2f16c12.translatedText: During the dance, Dr. Xiao Qingsong would not forget to discuss the condition of their common patient Carol with Dr. Mark Cwynar, the cooperating doctor, to find a better treatment plan.

38ba8f0fceb610c89174e1005693138b63c70b49.sourceText: 据科工专户外活动组织者的消息，由于９月４日赛多纳（Ｓｅｄｏｎａ）的气温过高，为了保证活动者的安全，原定的登山露营活动取消。请大家到气温凉爽的地方过一个快乐舒适的劳动节，本次活动将改期，具体时间将另行通知。感谢户外活动爱好者们对本活动的大力支持。
38ba8f0fceb610c89174e1005693138b63c70b49.translatedText: According to the organizer of the outdoor activities of the College of Science and Technology, due to the extremely high temperature in Sedona on September 4, in order to ensure the safety of the participants, the originally scheduled mountaineering and camping activities were cancelled. Please go to a cool place to spend a happy and comfortable Labor Day. This event will be rescheduled and the specific time will be notified separately. Thank you to the outdoor enthusiasts for your strong support of this event.

ef954df42ffc1ce26c5bb9f7beb220ae865eaad5.sourceText: 治粤八年南天王——传奇人物陈济棠 （七）尽绵力临危守海南 余玉书 一九四七年蒋介石政权的国民党军队三个兵团号称二十万之众，在嫡系爱将顾祝同、汤恩伯指挥下，与中共华东野战军陈毅麾下年青将领栗裕的九个纵队会战于山东，竟然遭受重创，全部美式装备的整编第七十四师竟然全军覆没，师长张灵甫自杀。蒋介石虽然心高气傲，但一向老谋深算，工于心计的他，已向与中国大陆隔开了海湾海峡的台湾省，及隔了较窄的琼州海峡的海南岛作出了安排。除了派陈诚去代替在二二八事变中在台湾搅到腥风血雨，后来又除陈仪外，又派孙立人前往台湾南部凤山军校去开设第四期军官训练班。 至于海南岛方面一九四七年则再度起用因”两广事变”而下台的陆军一级上将陈济棠为海南特区行政长官兼警备司令，兼海南防卫总司令。到了一九四九年底，则改由西粤名将薛岳接任海南防卫总司令。 陈济棠本是防城人，故追随他的部属多为高雷人氏（高州与雷州），与海南岛仅一水之隔。一九四七年陈济棠临危受命，自然不敢怠慢，于是召集昔日的旧部、至亲，仍以陈家班为班底，作为其海南行政长官任内的本钱。其中包括他的胞弟陈济南，陈济南是正统军校科班出身；黄埔陆军速成学校毕业后，再往日本陆军士官学校留学，毕业于第二十三期骑科；后来又毕业于重庆中央陆军大学将校班，一九四八年科被乃兄召往海南岛，担任海南防卫总司令部警备旅长，后来又担任暂编第十三师师长；陈济棠的第十子陈树柏上尉则被任命为警卫连连长；陈济棠的女婿江茂森则挂少将衔，被任命为海南特区行政长官公署财政处长；陈济棠当年的叛将，反对他脱离南京中央而独立的第七战区司令长官，官拜二级上将的广东籍福将余汉谋，则被任命为海南特区行政公署副长官，成为其助手，陈济棠另一位爱将，有其”武胆”之称的李敬扬中将，则担任海南防卫总司令部副总司令兼参谋长；旧部黄德仪少将则任命为司令部高参。此外协防的除了有限的海空军外，尚有蒋介石嫡系部队刘安琪部少量国军。以有限的兵力，去对付五指山中冯白驹的土共队伍或绰绰有余，但当林彪第四野战军的两个师共军，千帆并举来袭时，就算是神机妙算如名将薛伯龄也回天乏术。陈济棠在第十子陈树柏上尉率领全属新兵的警卫连拚死血战掩护下登机飞往台湾。海南岛的一切，又成过眼烟云，只余下一座以他爱妾命名的”秀英炮台”。
ef954df42ffc1ce26c5bb9f7beb220ae865eaad5.translatedText: The Southern Heavenly King who ruled Guangdong for eight years - the legendary figure Chen Jitang (7) Doing his best to defend Hainan in times of danger Yu Yushu In 1947, the three regiments of the Kuomintang army under Chiang Kai-shek's regime, boasting a strength of 200,000, were fought in Shandong with nine columns of the young general Li Yu under Chen Yi of the East China Field Army of the Communist Party of China under the command of his beloved generals Gu Zhutong and Tang Enbo. They suffered heavy losses. The reorganized 74th Division with all American equipment was completely wiped out, and the division commander Zhang Lingfu committed suicide. Although Chiang Kai-shek is arrogant, he has always been scheming and calculating. He has made arrangements for Taiwan Province, which is separated from mainland China by the Gulf Strait, and Hainan Island, which is separated by the narrower Qiongzhou Strait. In addition to sending Chen Cheng to replace him, who caused a bloody storm in Taiwan during the February 28th Incident, later in addition to Chen Yi, Sun Liren was sent to Fengshan Military Academy in southern Taiwan to open the fourth officer training class. As for Hainan Island, in 1947, Army General Chen Jitang, who had resigned due to the "Guangdong-Guangxi Incident", was again appointed as the chief executive and security commander of the Hainan Special Administrative Region and the commander-in-chief of Hainan's defense. By the end of 1949, Xue Yue, a famous general from Western Guangdong, took over as the Commander-in-Chief of Hainan Defense. Chen Jitang was originally from Fangcheng, so most of his subordinates were from Gaolei (Gaozhou and Leizhou), which was only separated from Hainan Island by a water. In 1947, when Chen Jitang was in danger and was appointed, he naturally did not dare to neglect, so he summoned his old subordinates and close relatives, and still used the Chen family as his team to serve as the capital of his tenure as the chief executive of Hainan. Among them is his younger brother Chen Jinan. Chen Jinan was educated at an orthodox military academy. After graduating from the Huangpu Army Accelerated School, he went to Japan to study abroad and graduated from the 23rd Cavalry Course. He later graduated from the General School of the Central Army University in Chongqing. In 1948, he was called to Hainan Island by Brother Nai and served as the guard brigade commander of the Hainan Defense Headquarters. Later, he served as the temporary commander of the 13th Division; Chen Jitang's tenth son, Captain Chen Shubai, was appointed as the guard company commander; Chen Jitang's son-in-law Jiang Maosen He was given the title of Major General and was appointed as the Director of Finance of the Chief Executive's Office of the Hainan Special Administrative Region; Chen Jitang's rebel general at that time opposed his separation from the Nanjing Central Committee and became the commander-in-chief of the independent Seventh War Zone. Yu Hanmou, a lucky general from Guangdong who was promoted to a second-level general, was appointed as the Hainan Special Administrative Region Chief Executive's Office. The deputy chief of the Administrative Office of the South Zone became his assistant. Another favorite general of Chen Jitang, Lieutenant General Li Jingyang, known as "brave", served as the deputy commander-in-chief and chief of staff of the Hainan Defense Headquarters; the former Major General Huang Deyi was appointed as the senior counselor of the headquarters. In addition to the limited navy and air force, there were also a small number of national troops under Liu Anqi, a direct force of Chiang Kai-shek. With limited troops, it may be more than enough to deal with Feng Baiju's Turkish Communist troops in Wuzhi Mountain. However, when the two Communist divisions of Lin Biao's Fourth Field Army attacked with thousands of sails, even the famous general Xue Boling had no way to save the day. Chen Jitang boarded the plane and flew to Taiwan under the cover of a desperate and bloody battle led by his tenth son, Captain Chen Shubai, who led a guard company composed of all new recruits. Everything in Hainan Island has become a fleeting smoke, and only one "Xiuying Fort" named after his beloved concubine remains.

eda96f088fc6edeb8f355e1562dfc2661cf7c092.sourceText: 凤凰城中文学校于十一月四日下午1:45举办五至十一年级学生的认字比赛。学校举办认字比赛的宗旨是让每一位参加的同学藉由游戏中学习中文和团队合作。今年不同以往，改采文字接龙方式比赛。比赛前用抽签方式将五到十一年级学生平均分为五队【红，黄，蓝，黑，白】，每一队约９人。
eda96f088fc6edeb8f355e1562dfc2661cf7c092.translatedText: Phoenix City Chinese School held a word recognition competition for students from fifth to eleventh grade at 1:45 pm on November 4th. The purpose of the school's literacy competition is to allow every participating student to learn Chinese and teamwork through the game. This year is different from the past, and the competition will be based on text solitaire. Before the game, students from grades 5 to 11 were divided into five teams [red, yellow, blue, black, and white] by drawing lots, with each team having about 9 people.

7eb21f79b6c767a88eda9a859d0a3b9379d7d181.sourceText: 在比赛正式开始之前，首先请主持人─ 卢贞玲老师，讲解比赛规则，好让每一位学生能充分了解比赛规则，并用转盘选出队伍，开始第一轮的文字接龙比赛。首轮由白队先发，白队代表再用转盘选出题目颜色，揭开第一个字，然后用这个字造一个词，或成语。接着下一队代表就必须接着用前一队造词的最后一个字（只要音同即可），接着造一个词。每人给５秒回答时间，无法回答时，可向队友求救，但是会被扣分。完全无法回答，就扣分结束这一回合。然后由下一组重新开始新的回合。
7eb21f79b6c767a88eda9a859d0a3b9379d7d181.translatedText: Before the official start of the competition, first ask the host, Teacher Lu Zhenling, to explain the rules of the competition so that every student can fully understand the rules of the competition, and use the turntable to select the team to start the first round of text solitaire competition. In the first round, the white team starts. The representative of the white team then uses the turntable to select the color of the question, reveals the first word, and then uses this word to create a word or idiom. Then the representatives of the next team must use the last word of the word created by the previous team (as long as the pronunciation is the same), and then create a word. Each person is given 5 seconds to answer. If unable to answer, they can ask for help from their teammates, but points will be deducted. If you are completely unable to answer, you will end the round by deducting points. Then a new round starts again with the next group.

03c5758458be34c2af91b11c5d75d220610981a6.translatedText: Idiom Answering in the Recognition Competition

574165a8ff26955ed414ec9ba4629333724738b3.sourceText: 当各队开始轮流回答，气氛愈来愈紧张，不仅队友抢着帮忙，旁边的观众也忍不住想给些提示。主持人和三位裁判不仅要维持秩序，却也不忍心学生失分太多；每一轮结束，就尽量给分数落后的队伍优先回答成语问题。主办单位将四字成语遮住二字，参赛者必须说出完整的成语，如果能加以解释或造句，另外给分。如此一来，有些原本落后的队伍，反而因此而领先。这使得比赛高潮迭起，胜负难料。
574165a8ff26955ed414ec9ba4629333724738b3.translatedText: When each team began to take turns to answer, the atmosphere became more and more tense. Not only did the teammates rush to help, but the spectators nearby also couldn't help but want to give some hints. The host and the three referees not only have to maintain order, but they also cannot bear the students losing too many points. At the end of each round, they try to give priority to the teams that are behind in answering idiom questions. The organizer covers the four-character idiom with two characters, and the contestants must speak the complete idiom. If they can explain it or make a sentence, they will be given additional points. As a result, some teams that were lagging behind actually took the lead. This makes the game climax after another and the outcome is unpredictable.

8d56a85f6e861bea0a21028a63771c42ddb3b058.sourceText: 在经过一个半小时的比赛，几番轮回之后，最后白队在成语部份的加持之下获得胜利，每一位同学获得一张电影票。第二名的黄队每人得到一张礼品卡，其余的参赛者也都得到一份奖品。虽然比赛一定有输赢，但是这次每位同学的表现都非常杰出，赢得老师和家长的肯定和喝采。
8d56a85f6e861bea0a21028a63771c42ddb3b058.translatedText: After an hour and a half of competition and several rounds of rounds, the white team finally won with the blessing of the idiom part, and each student received a movie ticket. The second-place yellow team each received a gift card, and the remaining contestants also received a prize. Although there must be winners and losers in the competition, every student's performance this time was outstanding, winning recognition and applause from teachers and parents.

b40972fec3bf8cc0a3f65d00cc41b036004ec000.sourceText: 校方也特别感谢五至十一年级的七位老师，和教务共同讨论，拟订比赛方式及规则，并在比赛前利用各式各样的方法，让同学们努力地练习文字接龙和成语。希望藉由这次比赛建立学生的信心，和引燃学习中文的兴趣。 如果您想多认识凤凰城中文学校，或是想加入这个大家庭，请与校长程秀玲联络(480-620-1982) 或参观学校网页(http://clsphoenix.org/)。
b40972fec3bf8cc0a3f65d00cc41b036004ec000.translatedText: The school also expresses special thanks to the seven teachers from grades 5 to 11 who discussed with the academic staff to formulate the competition methods and rules, and used various methods before the competition to allow the students to work hard to practice word solitaire and idioms. We hope that through this competition we can build students’ confidence and ignite their interest in learning Chinese. If you want to know more about Phoenix Chinese School or want to join this big family, please contact the principal Cheng Xiuling (480-620-1982) or visit the school website (http://clsphoenix.org/).

04c790420c4ad311e2d38bdb36f802f3bb1dfc73.sourceText: １.多喝水: 即使你不感觉口渴每日也需多喝水
04c790420c4ad311e2d38bdb36f802f3bb1dfc73.translatedText: 1. Drink more water: Even if you don't feel thirsty, you need to drink more water every day

0104b0cf4aaede4644d5b100ebb40ad9e2cfd935.sourceText: ２.不依赖电风扇为空气的主要来源: 风扇并不能取代待在有空调的场所，它会使身体脱水。
0104b0cf4aaede4644d5b100ebb40ad9e2cfd935.translatedText: > 2. Don't rely on electric fans as the main source of air: Fans cannot replace staying in air-conditioned places, which can dehydrate the body.

8c313ea064e4dbaa1aa6b9f2d6709dc59b2c8b96.sourceText: ３.待在凉爽的室内: 待在有空调的地方， 如果您需要协助支付电费，请和你的电力公司联系是否有特别融通方案。
8c313ea064e4dbaa1aa6b9f2d6709dc59b2c8b96.translatedText: 3. Stay cool indoors: Stay in an air-conditioned area. If you need assistance paying your electric bill, please contact your electric company for special accommodations.

33df9a1f6e1b62dd5711b7a6b21c1c91ebb47400.sourceText: ４.照顾宠物: 确保他们有足够的饮水、遮阳和阴凉的休息处， 因为它们也会脱水。
33df9a1f6e1b62dd5711b7a6b21c1c91ebb47400.translatedText: 4. Take care of pets: Make sure they have enough water, shade and a cool place to rest, as they can also become dehydrated.

3f8e51eee1865a693336b515dcedada009ea70b8.sourceText: ５.以洗澡或淋浴来降温: 淋浴帮助身体凉爽，但是不要在过热后立即淋浴，你的身体可能因降温过快而导致疾病。
3f8e51eee1865a693336b515dcedada009ea70b8.translatedText: 5. Take a bath or shower to cool down: Showering helps the body cool down, but do not shower immediately after overheating. Your body may cool down too quickly and cause illness.

fa2763a1b98a12254c2f6d55abdc45cdf162773c.sourceText: ６.穿着宽松衣物: 让你的皮肤在暑热中呼吸，透气的质料像是棉质最好。
fa2763a1b98a12254c2f6d55abdc45cdf162773c.translatedText: 6. Wear loose clothing: Let your skin breathe in the heat. Breathable materials like cotton are best.

6c4cc5a882bc558d875b4db654fc7930e5aea866.sourceText: ７.尽少使用烤箱和炉灶: 白天使用烤箱和炉灶会增加住家的热气，少用烤箱和炉灶以保持凉爽。
6c4cc5a882bc558d875b4db654fc7930e5aea866.translatedText: 7. Use ovens and stoves as little as possible: Using ovens and stoves during the day will increase the heat in your home. Use ovens and stoves sparingly to keep it cool.

5c8864a2740afc86981d8d3116d78f7ab65903a2.sourceText: ８.减少户外运动: 选在晨间做户外运动，其他时间在空调的室内做运动。
5c8864a2740afc86981d8d3116d78f7ab65903a2.translatedText: 8. Reduce outdoor exercise: Choose to do outdoor exercise in the morning and exercise indoors in air conditioning at other times.

63fdfbbc69d0e1662c92e22523eb5766513c5ff0.sourceText: ９.查访你的邻居和朋友: 打开的窗户可能显示邻居空调可能出问题，查访他们以确保他们维持凉爽。
63fdfbbc69d0e1662c92e22523eb5766513c5ff0.translatedText: 9. Check on your neighbors and friends: Open windows may indicate a possible problem with your neighbor's air conditioner, check on them to make sure they are staying cool.

74411f4dca0018f3511b003ac5cc0e67be603c6e.sourceText: 户口本翻译事项及交通违规罚款和查税 1. 我的户口本没是中文的,没翻译,我是否一定要找到专业翻译社呢,我是否可以自己翻? 答: 大多数准备移民美国的人都有非英语语言的记录和文件。无论是什么文件，如果它们是你移民所需，移民局要求原件和翻译件一起提交。这对于像出生证明，结婚证书和其他重要的记录非常重要。根据8 CFR Sec. 1003.33, 文件翻译︰ 任何由一方在申请中提供的外国语言文件，必须附有英文翻译件，和翻译人员签字的打印出来的证明信。这种证明信必须包括一项声明，翻译人员能够胜任翻译文件工作，而且翻译文件是翻译人员能力范围内的真实准确的语言表达。在一般情况下，获得递交移民局翻译文件最好的方法是，让那些愿意在公证人面前宣誓证明文件翻译的准确性和能流利的使用英文和原文件语言的人来翻译。翻译人员应准备在另外一张纸上翻译，最大限度地模仿原始文件的样式，并保证翻译是准确的。我认为，申请移民的本人不应该自己翻译，相关受益人的亲戚也不要进行文件的翻译，以避免可能的利益冲突。 2.现阶段美国政府没钱, 到处抓交通违规罚款或查税, 做为中餐馆老板,需要注意什么? 个人报税相关资料应保留三年，商家保留四年。但个人或商家若短报所得税达25%以上，国税局可追溯六年。如果国税局认为纳税人税表涉嫌造假，就没有追溯上限 纳税人报税最常出现的错误有：算错数字、申报的房贷利息抵减额与房贷公司提供的数字不同, 了签名。纳税人被查税的理由包括国税局计算机在核对纳税人及第三者公司提供的文件时，发现数字不一致。公司合伙人被查税，通常自己也会被查税，另是随机抽选的结果。 国税局查税通常会寄信通知纳税人，有时也会电话通知再寄信，但不会在电话中要求提供社安号码等个人资料，也不用电子邮件通知。 雇主最容易犯的错，是未能妥善保存员工工作时数纪录，与不清楚正确加班法规，有时是不知道如何算加班费。虽然一周内工作超过40小时，超时工资是正常工资的一倍半，但有些工作的月薪是按件计酬，如车衣业，加班费计算方式不同。据统计，80%商家所买的商业保险保额不足。商家并因规模及行业不同，对保险有不同需求,但最重要是要买劳工伤残保险。
74411f4dca0018f3511b003ac5cc0e67be603c6e.translatedText: Matters concerning the translation of household registration booklet, traffic violation fines and tax inspections 1. My household registration booklet is not in Chinese and has not been translated. Do I have to find a professional translation agency? Can I translate it myself? Answer: Most people who are planning to immigrate to the United States have records and documents in languages ​​other than English. No matter what the documents are, if they are required for your immigration, the Immigration Service requires that the originals and translations be submitted together. This is very important for records like birth certificates, marriage certificates and other important records. Pursuant to 8 CFR Sec. 1003.33, Document Translation: Any foreign language document provided by a party in the application must be accompanied by an English translation and a printed letter signed by the translator. This letter must include a statement that the translator is competent to translate the document and that the translated document is a true and accurate representation of the language within the translator's ability. In general, the best way to obtain a translation of a document submitted to USCIS is to have it translated by someone who is willing to swear under oath before a notary that the document is translated accurately and is fluent in English and the language of the original document. The translator should prepare the translation on a separate piece of paper to mimic the style of the original document as closely as possible and ensure that the translation is accurate. In my opinion, the person applying for immigration should not translate it himself, and relatives of the relevant beneficiaries should not translate the documents to avoid possible conflicts of interest. 2. At this stage, the U.S. government has no money and is everywhere fining traffic violations or conducting tax inspections. As a Chinese restaurant owner, what should you pay attention to? Personal tax return-related information should be retained for three years, and businesses should retain it for four years. However, if an individual or business underreports income tax by more than 25%, the IRS can trace the tax back for six years. If the IRS believes that a taxpayer's tax return is suspected of being falsified, there is no retroactive limit. The most common mistakes taxpayers make when filing taxes include miscalculating numbers, declaring mortgage interest deductions that are different from the numbers provided by the mortgage company, and missing signatures. The reasons why taxpayers are audited include that the IRS computer found that the numbers were inconsistent when checking documents provided by the taxpayer and a third-party company. If a company's partners are subject to tax audit, they will usually be subject to tax audit themselves, and the other is the result of a random selection. When the IRS conducts tax inspections, it usually notifies taxpayers by mail, and sometimes notifies taxpayers by phone and then sends a letter, but it will not ask for personal information such as social security numbers over the phone, nor will it be notified by email. The most common mistakes employers make are failing to properly keep records of employee working hours, not knowing the correct overtime regulations, and sometimes not knowing how to calculate overtime pay. Although if you work more than 40 hours in a week, overtime pay is one and a half times the normal salary. However, for some jobs where the monthly salary is based on piece-rate wages, such as the car clothing industry, overtime pay is calculated differently. According to statistics, 80% of businesses purchase commercial insurance that is insufficiently insured. Businesses have different needs for insurance depending on their size and industry, but the most important thing is to buy workers' disability insurance.

5261cecf79530b3a6df3786143ccb3c1db362ad3.sourceText: 钱德勒两妇人被控虐待母亲 （亚省时报） 近日，钱德勒警方处理了两宗虐待老人事件，无独有偶，两宗案件都是女儿与母亲争执引起的推搡事件。 10月5日晚上，38岁的索菲亚马利索与母亲发生口角，继而将咖啡杯扔向母亲的车，至车窗毁坏。此事被马利索12岁的儿子看到报警，马利索被控殴打及刑事毁坏被捕。 10月7日半夜，39岁的金伯莉霍奇斯在母亲告诉她不能使用堵塞的马桶时与之争执，警方说，霍奇斯的母亲声称她女儿威胁要杀死她，还挥拳将她的头打伤。霍奇斯因涉嫌攻击和扰乱秩序被捕。
5261cecf79530b3a6df3786143ccb3c1db362ad3.translatedText: Two women in Chandler were charged with abusing their mother (Alberta Times) Recently, Chandler police handled two cases of elder abuse. Coincidentally, both cases were pushing incidents caused by a dispute between a daughter and her mother. On the evening of October 5, 38-year-old Sofia Maliso had an argument with her mother, and then threw a coffee cup at her mother's car, causing the car window to be damaged. Maliso's 12-year-old son saw the incident and called the police. Maliso was arrested on charges of assault and criminal damage. In the middle of the night on October 7, 39-year-old Kimberly Hodges got into an argument with her mother when she told her not to use the clogged toilet. Police said Hodges' mother claimed her daughter threatened to kill her and punched her in the head. Hodges was arrested on suspicion of assault and disorderly conduct.
