5ffedc1c256119e356a623be71d257557fa2f591.sourceText: 期待是所有心痛的根源。如若不曾有期待，就不会有那么多甜美的憧憬，如果不曾有期待，也不会有那么多失望的眼泪。 。 。心不动，则不痛。
5ffedc1c256119e356a623be71d257557fa2f591.translatedText: Expectation is the root of all heartache. If there had been no expectations, there would not have been so many sweet longings; if there had been no expectations, there would not have been so many disappointed tears. . . If the mind does not move, there will be no pain.

c096f0c6fb5d14646918ab805417d5e6d98ff7bd.sourceText: 曾经我们都以为自己可以为爱情死，其实爱情死不了人，它只会在最疼的地方扎上一针，然后我们欲哭无泪，我们辗转反侧，我们久病成医，我们百炼成钢。你不是风儿，我也不是沙，再缠绵也到不了天涯，擦干了泪，明天早上，我们都要上班。
c096f0c6fb5d14646918ab805417d5e6d98ff7bd.translatedText: We all thought we could die for love. In fact, love can't kill people. It will only stick a needle in the most painful place, and then we will cry without tears, we toss and turn, we will become a doctor after a long illness, and we will become steel after being tempered. You are not the wind, and I am not the sand. No matter how lingering we are, we will never reach the end of the world. I wiped away my tears. We all have to go to work tomorrow morning.

3c271601201c89cc3e63eda2ec93fdbbc035e1c4.sourceText: 揭开美国煽动南海岛谜 佳叔 美國的經濟在歷史長河中，大約每隔十年就有衰退期。經驗告知，有人三衰六旺，經濟也有衰久必旺，旺久必衰道理。人們在經濟好時，還可把持時機，來個未雨綢繆。但政府在經濟衰退時，面對各行生意冷淡，樓房停止，失業率高時，要怎樣振興經濟，創造工作位，解決民生，增加稅收，這是當政者最頭痛事。 從前，上世紀三，四十年代經濟衰退時，政府為振興經濟撥款出來擴展農，牧業，開發水利交通，建水壩等公路，橋樑工程，增加工作位，將剩餘的農牧品，棄沉大海餵魚，使人們有工作做，振興社會繁榮。 二次大戰後五，六十年代經濟衰退時政府實行放寬貸款政策，使許多家庭可以自購房屋和商家做生意。所以，那時建築業崛起，一枝獨香各行生意得到貸款，如電器，電腦，汽車傾銷全球，加上韓戰，越戰的消耗，這是美國扭轉經濟最盛期。 後來，七八十年代，各國的電器，電腦發達，迎頭趕上美國，汽車王國又給日本搶奪市場，由那時美國的經濟逐漸走下坡，但經過幾場小戰爭，如海地，海灣戰爭，美國當年的經濟衰退勉強維持。 而今，美國經過早年的金融海嘯，經濟一落千丈，奧巴馬的政府雖以大量貸款，幫助民間和企業，企圖振興經濟，但屢試不效。現在國內的建設如水電工程，樓房屋宇，橋樑公路都建到無可再建地方，國外的出口貨，除賣軍火武器和高科技（高科技不敢出售外漏秘密）外，美國實在沒有貨可與他國家競爭。因此，奧巴馬派出一班臣子出外遊說，那些開發中國家買美國武器，如希拉莉克林頓到東南亞煽動南海島權爭，目的在推銷軍火。所以，菲律賓，印度和越南已先后買了一批舊戰船，飛機，火箭，（台灣未定）……..。 奧巴馬的政府很知道，如果在年內攪不好經濟，提高就業率，出年競選連任的機會很微。所以，他現在不敢粘惹上戰爭，更不想與中國敵對，還派有中國血統的駱家輝出使和副總統拜登訪問中國，目的是安撫和中國溝通減少經濟衝突。
3c271601201c89cc3e63eda2ec93fdbbc035e1c4.translatedText: Uncovering the Mystery of the United States' Incitement to the South China Sea Islands Uncle Jia Over the course of history, the U.S. economy has experienced periods of recession approximately every ten years. Experience tells us that some people have three declines and six prosperity, and the economy also has the principle that if it declines for a long time, it will prosper, and if it prospers for a long time, it will decline. When the economy is good, people can seize the opportunity and prepare for a rainy day. However, during the economic recession, when the government is faced with sluggish business in all walks of life, stagnant construction, and high unemployment, how to revitalize the economy, create jobs, solve people's livelihood, and increase tax revenue is the biggest headache for those in power. In the past, when the economy was in recession in the 1930s and 1940s, the government allocated funds to revitalize the economy, expand agriculture and animal husbandry, develop water conservancy and transportation, build dams and other highways and bridge projects, increase work places, and dump the remaining agricultural and animal husbandry products into the sea to feed fish, so that people have work to do and revitalize social prosperity. In the 1950s after World War II and during the economic recession in the 1960s, the government relaxed loan policies, allowing many families to buy their own houses and do business. Therefore, at that time, the construction industry was on the rise, and various businesses received loans, such as electrical appliances, computers, and automobiles, which were sold all over the world. Coupled with the consumption of the Korean War and the Vietnam War, this was the peak period of the United States' economic turnaround. Later, in the 1970s and 1980s, as electrical appliances and computers developed in various countries, they caught up with the United States, and the automobile kingdom robbed Japan of the market. From then on, the U.S. economy gradually declined. However, after several small wars, such as Haiti and the Gulf War, the U.S. economy was barely able to maintain its economic recession that year. Now, after the financial tsunami in the early years of the United States, the economy has plummeted. Although the Obama administration has provided large amounts of loans to help private citizens and businesses in an attempt to revive the economy, repeated attempts have failed. At present, domestic construction such as hydropower projects, buildings, bridges and highways have been built to the point where there is no room for reconstruction. For foreign exports, except for selling arms and high-tech (high-tech is afraid to sell secrets to others), the United States really has no goods to compete with other countries. Therefore, Obama sent a group of ministers to go out to lobby those developing countries to buy American weapons. For example, Hillary Clinton went to Southeast Asia to incite disputes over the South China Sea Islands, with the purpose of selling arms. Therefore, the Philippines, India and Vietnam have successively purchased a batch of old warships, aircraft, rockets, (Taiwan has not yet been determined)... The Obama administration knows very well that if it fails to disrupt the economy and improve the employment rate within this year, its chances of running for re-election next year will be slim. Therefore, he does not dare to get into a war now, let alone be hostile to China. He has also sent the Chinese envoy Locke and Vice President Biden to visit China in order to appease and communicate with China and reduce economic conflicts.

4513f536dd850b82f41cb4063247dc433d1dbfac.sourceText: 四月六日， 周一， 大凤凰城三个同乡会，云南同乡会，贵州同乡会和川渝同乡会，向钱德勒市政府下属负责老年中心和福利的机构捐赠了2000个医用口罩。钱德勒市长科文.哈克先生和机构负责人克丽斯汀.艾丽丝女士亲自到场接受捐赠。出席捐赠仪式的有云南同乡会常务会长徐强先生和刘艳绚女士及其先生儿子，贵州同乡会长温卡佳女士和川渝同乡会常务会长陈志钢先生，知名华人侨领司徒三木和当地华人媒体。非常值得赞扬的是，刘女士的儿子，艾迪亲手用透明塑料片做了好多个防护面罩作为爱心捐赠。在四个标语中， 除三个同乡会名称外，最体现华人心声是“美国团结！美国加油！”。交接仪式充满了团结，友谊和鼓励的气氛。（子刚报道）
4513f536dd850b82f41cb4063247dc433d1dbfac.translatedText: On Monday, April 6, three Greater Phoenix Associations, the Yunnan Association, the Guizhou Association and the Sichuan and Chongqing Association, donated 2,000 medical masks to the Chandler City Government's agency responsible for senior centers and welfare. Chandler Mayor Corwin Harker and organization director Ms. Christine Ellis were present in person to accept the donation. Present at the donation ceremony were Mr. Xu Qiang and Ms. Liu Yanxuan, the executive presidents of the Yunnan Association, and their sons, Ms. Wen Kajia, the president of the Guizhou Association, and Mr. Chen Zhigang, the executive president of the Sichuan and Chongqing Association, well-known overseas Chinese leader Situ Sanmu and local Chinese media. It is very commendable that Ms. Liu’s son, Eddie, personally made several protective masks out of transparent plastic sheets as donations. Among the four slogans, in addition to the names of the three hometown associations, the one that best reflects the aspirations of the Chinese people is "United America! Come on America!". The handover ceremony was filled with an atmosphere of unity, friendship and encouragement. (Reported by Zigang)

70034b833eb6e9250ac363a5512e1a0967c66610.sourceText: 十二月十七日下午二时，世界华人工商妇女企管协会亚利桑那分会在中国文化中心食为天餐厅，举办税务及商业法律专题演讲。 具有廿年会计师专业经验的马昌华及专门商业法方面的律师康明义二位专业人士为凤城的华人带来精彩的演讲.近５０嘉宾到现场倾听，大家纷纷表示受益匪浅。 2012新年的报税季节即将开始，世界华人工商妇女企管协会亚利桑那分会希望为侨胞提供切实的服务，可经过专家的提示如何「节税」早做准备，搜集应付交的报税证明，以免因故 延误报税。 马昌华会计师专精各个行业税务，以及有一定难度的国际税务法，她亦有丰富的经验，尤其是如何节税，十七日的专题演讲，她表示目前2%的受雇佣者的税收减免政策 会延续到今年底，明年是否会继续，相关部门还在商榷中。 另外就是有房屋投资的华人，怎样合理节税，收入较低者会有一个最大额度为2.5万的房屋管理费用的减免，但是如果收入超过15万的客户，是否也可以获得部分费用的减免呢 ？ 马会计师表示可以通过自己管理房屋，并给雇用人员发1099表格等等来抵税。 马会计师还提到，美国的遗产税很重，每个人每年都可以给其他人1.3万美元的礼物，这些礼物都不用扣税，所以夫妻俩每年至少可以给2.6万的礼物给孩子，日积月累能 给把部分资产转给孩子。 具有「商业法」丰富经验的名律师康明义，在商业投资、签约、契约执行的法律业务上非常有经验，例如两个人一起投资，不同的公司形式，利益保障的方式不同。 例如Tenancy in Common 按法律就是加入者按比例来分割利润，股东去世后，遗留的部分可以给亲人继承。 Joint Tenancy with Right of Survivorship就不同，股东去世后，他的股份就由现存的股东稀释，不能传给自己的子女或者家人，很多公司成立的时候都必须考虑好公司的形式，各项规定都必须 白纸黑字的写出来。 世界华人工商妇女企管协会亚利桑那分会的新会员黄慧莉律师也提醒在美国，获得绿卡或者国籍之前，需要先了解美国税法，不要盲目进行。 专家们的演讲，让现场气氛变得特别热烈，大家就自己在生活中遇到的税收或者投资问题向专业人士提问。 由世华工商妇女会会员GGG花店负责人简瑞香，为现场来宾示范圣诞节及新年期间如何为家里布置「插花」及参加宴会时，自己动手做一朵漂亮的「胸花」，既省 钱又高雅的装饰。 现场备有美味的点心及茶水招待，给来宾带来了一个知识丰富美味愉快的下午。
70034b833eb6e9250ac363a5512e1a0967c66610.translatedText: At 2:00 pm on December 17, the Arizona Chapter of the World Chinese Business Women Business Association held a special lecture on taxation and business law at the Chinese Cultural Center Shiweitian Restaurant. Ma Changhua, who has 20 years of professional experience as an accountant, and Kang Mingyi, a lawyer specializing in commercial law, gave wonderful speeches to the Chinese people in Fengcheng. Nearly 50 guests came to the scene to listen, and everyone said they benefited a lot. The tax filing season for the 2012 New Year is about to begin. The Arizona Chapter of the World Chinese Business Women's Business Association hopes to provide practical services to overseas Chinese. They can make early preparations through experts' tips on how to "save taxes" and collect tax filing certificates due to avoid delays in filing taxes for any reason. Accountant Ma Changhua specializes in taxation in various industries and certain difficult international tax laws. She also has rich experience, especially how to save taxes. In a special speech on the 17th, she said that the current tax reduction policy for 2% of employees will continue until the end of this year. Whether it will continue next year, the relevant departments are still under discussion. Another question is how Chinese people who invest in houses can reasonably save taxes. Those with lower incomes will have a maximum exemption of 25,000 yuan in house management fees. But if customers with an income of more than 150,000 yuan can they also get part of the fee exemption? Accountant Ma said that you can deduct taxes by managing your own house and issuing 1099 forms to your employees. Accountant Ma also mentioned that the inheritance tax in the United States is very heavy. Each person can give gifts of 13,000 US dollars to others every year. These gifts are not tax-deductible, so the couple can give at least 26,000 US dollars in gifts to their children every year. Over time, they can transfer part of their assets to their children. Kang Mingyi, a famous lawyer with extensive experience in "commercial law", is very experienced in the legal business of commercial investment, signing, and contract execution. For example, if two people invest together, different company forms have different ways of protecting interests. For example, in Tenancy in Common, according to the law, the profits are divided among the participants in proportion. After the death of the shareholder, the remaining part can be inherited by relatives. Joint Tenancy with Right of Survivorship is different. After a shareholder dies, his shares will be diluted by the existing shareholders and cannot be passed on to his children or family members. When many companies are established, the form of the company must be considered, and all regulations must be written down in black and white. Lawyer Huang Huili, a new member of the Arizona Chapter of the World Chinese Business Women's Business Association, also reminded that in the United States, before obtaining a green card or nationality, you need to understand the U.S. tax laws first and do not proceed blindly. The experts' speeches made the atmosphere particularly lively. Everyone asked the professionals questions about tax or investment issues they encountered in life. Jian Ruixiang, the person in charge of GGG Flower Shop, a member of the Shihua Industrial and Commercial Women's Association, demonstrated to the guests how to decorate "flower arrangements" at home during Christmas and New Year and how to make a beautiful "corsage" by yourself when attending banquets, which is both cost-saving and elegant decoration. Delicious snacks and tea were provided on site, giving the guests a knowledge-rich, delicious and enjoyable afternoon.

9a7989410d29a4c5cff972dc8982dd0d5f2df51e.sourceText: 凤凰城凤鸣：痛失亲人 凤儿的大哥栋儿，比她大18岁，他有一双儿女，大女儿只比她小姑凤儿小4岁，取名贞儿，小儿子比姐姐小三岁，取名诚儿，凤儿很喜欢这一双姪女姪儿，经常和她(他)们一起玩耍游戏。 在诚儿一岁多时，姐弟二人随母亲回娘家的乡村老家，住了一些时间，就在要回济南的那天早上，可怕的悲惨事情发生了。 那时的国家刚刚成立不久，一切都在百废待兴时期，尤其是乡下农村更是穷苦，平时很少有白面馍吃，就在那天一早天还不亮，诚儿的大伯母去碾子上推压麦子，锣成白面，蒸成白面馍，让他(她) 们母女(子) 三人吃了早饭回城。大伯家的孩子起得早，吃了些别的食物，而诚儿小起得晚，空着肚子吃了一个馍，不一会就上吐下泻昏死过去，这时其它小孩也有不良反应，大人们急忙找大夫来诊治，其它小孩得救，唯有凤儿可爱的小姪儿诚儿，由于年龄小又是空腹吃的，没有抢救过来而丧生。等凤儿得知消息时，是大人们处理完事情后，在大人们的谈话中，了觧了一些事情的经过和源由。 诚儿的姥爷、姥姥家，有三个儿子和两个女儿，诚儿的母亲是大女儿，小女儿也嫁到济南市的一家裁缝店，三个儿子在济南市从事不同的职业，所以虽然家在农村却是比较富裕，又行事为人有些张杨和霸气，在村子里得罪不少人，许多人家对他们家产生怨气，而动了杀心，在他们家经常用的碾磨里偷偷地下了毒，本想报复有三个儿子二个女儿的父母，可是，他想毒死的人一个也没死，倒是无故的诚儿成了牺牲品，做了替罪羊。诚儿的爸爸在济南铁路局工作，为此事铁路局几次派人到农村调查，由于当时法制不建全，查无实据无果而终，从此不了了之。 诚儿不幸被害去逝，对诚儿家的亲人打击很大，很久很久诚儿家被悲伤痛苦宠罩着，尤其是诚儿的父母到了痛不欲生的地步。凤儿那时还小，只是在夜深人静时，偷偷的抹眼泪，凤儿那时也只有7、8岁的年记，她不明白为什麽？一个活蹦乱跳的姪儿，去了一趟农村姥姥家，怎麽就一下死了，消失的无影无踪呢？这是凤儿第一次经历痛失亲人，在她幼小心灵深处打下无法抹去的深深烙印，使她才知道人是会死的，没有人可以预测未来。 凤儿长大了，后来认识了主耶稣基督，明白了人是从哪里来，最后到那里去。从上帝创造天地、宇宙万物、又造人以后，是人的祖先亚当、夏娃先背逆神，成了罪人，被上帝赶出伊甸园。但是，”神爱世人，甚至将他的独生子赐给他们，叫一切信他的，不至灭亡，反得永生。”(约翰福音1:16) 。在约翰福音5:24中又告诉我们：”我实实在在地告诉你们，那听我话，又信差我来者的，就有永生，不至于定罪，是已经出死入生了。”从而让人明白一个道理：人一生下来就带有罪性，是耶稣基督的宝血，掩盖、洁净了人的罪，听信他的人，得到永生的盼望。从此人们不再惧怕死亡，而是新生命的开始。圣经在使徒行传一章8节教导说：”但圣灵降临在你们身上，你们就必得着能力，并要在耶路撒冷、犹太全地，和撒玛利亚，直到地极，作我的见証。”所以，有神无比的大爱，怜悯和保守，激励基督徒背负神的使命，将那好的无比的福音传给世人。
9a7989410d29a4c5cff972dc8982dd0d5f2df51e.translatedText: Feng Ming in Phoenix City: The grief of losing a loved one. Feng'er's eldest brother Dong'er is 18 years older than her. He has a pair of children. The eldest daughter is only 4 years younger than her sister-in-law Feng'er and is named Zhen'er. The younger son is three years younger than her sister and is named Cheng'er. Feng'er likes these nieces and nephews very much and often plays games with them. When Cheng'er was more than one year old, the two siblings returned to their parents' rural hometown with their mother and stayed for some time. On the morning of their return to Jinan, a terrible and tragic thing happened. At that time, the country had just been established, and everything was in a period of waste, especially in the rural areas, which were extremely poor. They rarely had white-flour steamed buns to eat. That morning, before dawn, Chenger's aunt went to press the wheat on the mill, beat it into white flour, and steamed it into white-flour steamed buns. The three of them, mother and daughter, had breakfast and returned to the city. The uncle's children got up early and ate some other food, while Cheng'er got up late and ate a steamed bun on an empty stomach. After a while, he suffered from vomiting and diarrhea and passed out. At this time, other children also had adverse reactions. The adults rushed to the doctor for diagnosis and treatment. The other children were saved, but Feng'er's cute little nephew Cheng'er died without resuscitation because he was young and ate on an empty stomach. When Feng'er learned the news, it was after the adults had finished handling the matter, and during their conversations, they learned the story and origin of some things. Cheng'er's grandfather and grandmother's family have three sons and two daughters. Cheng'er's mother is the eldest daughter, and the younger daughter is also married to a tailor shop in Jinan City. The three sons are engaged in different professions in Jinan City, so although the family is in the countryside, they are relatively wealthy, and their behavior is somewhat assertive and domineering. In the village He offended many people, and many families were resentful towards his family, so they had murderous intentions, and secretly added poison to the grinding mill that their family often used. He wanted to take revenge on his parents who had three sons and two daughters, but none of the people he wanted to poison died. Instead, Cheng'er became the victim for no reason and became the scapegoat. Cheng'er's father worked for the Jinan Railway Bureau. For this matter, the Railway Bureau sent people to the countryside several times to investigate. Because the legal system was not established at the time, the investigation ended with no solid evidence and no results, and the matter was never settled. Cheng'er was unfortunately killed and passed away, which was a great blow to the relatives of Cheng'er's family. For a long time, Cheng'er's family was enveloped in sorrow and pain, especially Cheng'er's parents, who were in agony. Feng'er was still young at that time. She only wiped her tears secretly in the dead of night. Feng'er was only 7 or 8 years old at that time. She didn't understand why? A lively nephew went to his grandma's house in the countryside. How could he suddenly die and disappear without a trace? This was Feng'er's first time experiencing the loss of a loved one, which left a deep imprint in her young heart that could not be erased, making her realize that people are mortal and no one can predict the future. Feng'er grew up and later got to know the Lord Jesus Christ, and understood where people come from and where they end up. After God created the heaven and earth, all things in the universe, and man, it was human ancestors Adam and Eve who first rebelled against God, became sinners, and were kicked out of the Garden of Eden by God. However, “God so loved the world that he gave his only begotten Son, that whoever believes in him shall not perish but have everlasting life.” (John 1:16). John 5:24 also tells us: "Truly, truly, I say to you, whoever hears my word and believes him who sent me has eternal life and will not be condemned, but has passed from death to life." This allows people to understand a truth: people are born with a sinful nature. It is the precious blood of Jesus Christ that covers and cleanses people's sins. Those who listen to him have the hope of eternal life. From then on, people no longer feared death, but the beginning of a new life. The Bible teaches in Acts 1:8: "But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit comes upon you, and you will be my witnesses in Jerusalem, and in all Judea and Samaria, and to the ends of the earth." Therefore, God's incomparable love, mercy, and protection inspire Christians to shoulder God's mission and preach the incomparable good gospel to the world.

3431e6b455d2bee89f881039d416e8101de38ac0.sourceText: 凤城荣光会拟订于2015年8月15日在 Hilton Double Tree (Tempe)酒店举行中美盟军纪念抗日战争胜利70週年大会，向抗日战争牺牲的三千万军民同胞表示最诚挚的崇敬与哀悼，也向为自由民主并肩作战的美国盟军表示敬意与感谢。 诚然，必须放下过去的战争仇恨，但不应忘记历史的教训，并追求世界永久的和平。 荣光会诚挚邀请侨界先进，共襄盛举参加筹备会议讨论细节。 筹备会议谨定于2015年5月23日下午1:30pm 在 Hilton Double Tree (2100 S. Priest Dr, Tempe AZ 85282)举行。 本会接中华民国国防部通知，为表彰当年抗日将士保家卫国一吋山河一吋血的抗日精神，特颁纪念章给所有曾参加抗日战争的将士，本地参加抗战家属请提供参战时部队名及番号，曾参与抗战战役的佐証资料，通知本会转国防部备桉后，于纪念大会上颁赠。 大会联络人: 王瑞瑾 电话 520 907 8488 email:rocvj70@gmail.com
3431e6b455d2bee89f881039d416e8101de38ac0.translatedText: The Fengcheng Glory Club was planned to be held at the Hilton Double Tree on August 15, 2015. (Tempe) Hotel held a meeting of the Chinese and American Allied Forces to commemorate the 70th anniversary of the victory of the Anti-Japanese War. It expressed its most sincere respect and condolences to the 30 million soldiers and civilians who sacrificed their lives in the Anti-Japanese War, and also expressed respect and gratitude to the American Allied Forces who fought side by side for freedom and democracy. It is true that we must put aside the hatred of past wars, but we should not forget the lessons of history and pursue permanent world peace. The Rongguang Association sincerely invites advanced overseas Chinese to participate in the preparatory meeting to discuss the details. The preparatory meeting will be held on May 23, 2015 at 1:30pm at Hilton Double Tree (2100 S. Priest Dr, Tempe AZ 85282). The Association was notified by the Ministry of National Defense of the Republic of China that in order to commend the anti-Japanese soldiers for their anti-Japanese spirit of protecting their country and protecting their country, commemorative medals are specially awarded to all soldiers who participated in the Anti-Japanese War. Local family members who participated in the Anti-Japanese War should provide the name and number of the unit when they participated in the war, as well as supporting information of their participation in the Anti-Japanese War. After notifying the Association, it will be forwarded to the Ministry of National Defense for preparation and presented at the commemorative meeting. Conference contact: Wang Ruijin Tel: 520 907 8488 email:rocvj70@gmail.com

522ab8cce38a0c11a9e0d61f9bab1b78ad867f26.sourceText: 为了吸引广大华人青少年积极参加庆祝美国国庆日活动，并鼓励他们进一步提高中文写作水平和艺术绘画能力，也帮助青少年更好的认知美国，增强华人融入美国主流社会的意识和能力，凤凰城华人华侨社团联合总会（侨联）决定在今年国庆前夕，举办迎国庆作文，绘画比赛。具体办法如下：
522ab8cce38a0c11a9e0d61f9bab1b78ad867f26.translatedText: In order to attract the majority of Chinese teenagers to actively participate in the activities to celebrate the Fourth of July, and encourage them to further improve their Chinese writing and artistic painting skills, and also to help teenagers better understand the United States, and enhance the consciousness and ability of Chinese people to integrate into mainstream American society, the Phoenix Federation of Overseas Chinese Associations (Overseas Chinese Association) decided to hold a National Day composition and painting competition on the eve of this year's National Day. The specific methods are as follows:

d04f8e2df146422d97a1240929b37156b23278c6.sourceText: 1） 参赛资格：年龄在17岁以下的华人青少年 2） 参赛题目：围绕庆祝美国国庆自选题目，最好能反映华人视角 3） 作品提交时间：从现在起到五月三十一日止 4） 作品评选：邀请5-7名教育界，文化界人士组成评审委员会评选。 作文评选不分年龄段，评选出优秀作文和获奖作文 绘画作品不分年龄组评选出优秀作品 5） 作文用中文，字数在1200字以内。绘画作品无绘画风格限制，画幅尺寸不小于9X9inch，不大于20X20inch，请注明作者姓名和年龄。 6） 表彰与奖励：优秀作文和获奖作文在七月四日下午四点，举行迎国庆优秀作文报告会，由作者朗诵优秀作品。优秀绘画作品在七月四日庆祝国庆晚会会场前展出，供大家欣赏。并推荐给相关的报刊和杂志上选登。 评选出的优秀作文和绘画作品在国庆晚会上颁发纪念品，获奖作文颁发奖状 和奖学金。
d04f8e2df146422d97a1240929b37156b23278c6.translatedText: 1) Eligibility: Chinese teenagers under the age of 17 2) Entry topic: A self-selected topic surrounding the celebration of the National Day of the United States, preferably reflecting the Chinese perspective 3) Work submission time: from now to May 31st 4) Work selection: Invite 5-7 people from the education and cultural circles to form a review committee for selection. The composition selection will be conducted regardless of age groups, and outstanding compositions and award-winning compositions will be selected. The painting works will be selected regardless of age groups. Excellent works will be selected. 5) The composition should be in Chinese and the number of words should be within 1,200 words. There is no restriction on painting style. The size of the painting should be no less than 9X9inch and no larger than 20X20inch. Please indicate the author’s name and age. 6) Recognition and awards: For outstanding essays and award-winning essays, a National Day Outstanding Essay Report will be held at 4 pm on July 4th, with the author reciting outstanding works. Excellent paintings were displayed in front of the Fourth of July National Day Gala for everyone to enjoy. And recommend it to relevant newspapers and magazines for selection. fa5ebe47cdd25094e331c209ee0c8c536992cddb.translatedText: The Phoenix Chinese Christian Church will be at the Hamilton Aquatic this Saturday (August 9) from 5:30-7:30 pm. Center (3838 S. Arizona Ave, Chandler) hosts its first-ever water social. I hope that through such activities, I can get to know friends who do not come to church. No acquaintances are required to be brought in. There will be reception staff at the entrance. Friends who participate are asked to leave their contact information and indicate that they are invited by GPC Lily Fellowship. Please feel free to invite your friends to participate.

19dfb7ff8d4ddbeaef5a4df67518b07bc382558d.sourceText: 凤凰城 陈姗 又是全美最大的节日复活节, 虽然好像今年提前的春宴场景和去年年底的圣诞演出的歌声还历历在目在耳。成立二十三年的是风雨无阻的少年唱诗班，其成员为四月八日这天登台表演的准备一个半月前就开始。家长们不辞劳苦接送，准备食物，孩子们每次排练，从不缺席，为了衣服队形道具等等表演费尽心思，集思广益，达成共识，所以表演确实有条不紊，整齐亮相，精彩纷呈。不信你看，每到演出总是座无虚席，台下观众抢着留影。很多的摄影爱好者扛着长枪短炮的专业器材抢滩逐个活动。因为所有人都不想错过这样的瞬间。
19dfb7ff8d4ddbeaef5a4df67518b07bc382558d.translatedText: Phoenix Chen Shan Easter is the biggest holiday in the United States, although it seems that the spring banquet scene that was brought forward this year and the singing of the Christmas show at the end of last year are still fresh in my ears. The Rain or Shine Youth Choir has been established for 23 years. The preparations for its members to perform on stage on April 8 began a month and a half ago. Parents worked tirelessly to pick up and drop off, prepare food, and the children were never absent from every rehearsal. They worked hard on clothes, formations, props and other performances, brainstorming and reaching consensus, so the performance was indeed orderly, neat and exciting. If you don’t believe it, every performance is always packed, and the audience rushes to take photos. Many photography enthusiasts, carrying long guns and short cannons with professional equipment, rushed to the beach one after another. Because no one wants to miss this moment.

45127aa852157b4c7114c0f3e9f845b169693d7d.sourceText: 今年教会推出彩色专版十二页十六开的西北通讯，该刊醖酿已久，已出版了两期。有园丁心声，我们的傢，灵程巩音，编者心等栏目。它的出现使教会有了重量级的可视的宣传的论坛。通过记者和编辑室的的镜头和简单的文字我们才知道这半年来组织了很多的大规模各年龄段的活动，如十月二十九日的秋季嘉年华，”是为六年级以下的小孩预备的，初中高中的青少年帮助分发食物，主持游戏项目等，让许多朋友藉此活动接触并踏入社会”。还有餐馆团契感恩节大郊游一日游，远至胡佛水坝，伦敦桥和米德湖，”175人分乘三辆大巴”，俩教会合作为中青年举办。
45127aa852157b4c7114c0f3e9f845b169693d7d.translatedText: This year the church launched the Northwest Newsletter, a color special edition with 12 pages and 16 pages. This magazine has been in the pipeline for a long time and has been published in two issues. There are columns such as Gardener’s Voice, Our Home, Lingcheng Gongyin, and Editor’s Heart. Its emergence gave the church a heavyweight visual publicity forum. Through the lens of reporters and the editorial office and simple words, we learned that many large-scale activities of all ages have been organized in the past six months, such as the Autumn Carnival on October 29, "which is prepared for children under sixth grade. Teenagers in junior high and high schools help distribute food, host game projects, etc., allowing many friends to contact and enter society through this event." There was also a one-day restaurant fellowship Thanksgiving outing to as far away as the Hoover Dam, London Bridge and Lake Mead. "175 people were divided into three buses." The two churches cooperated to organize it for young and middle-aged people.

2cf45c0a841f2c02ce1ff4b9b734879e276e8723.sourceText: 今年四月十九日的广东团契和广州教会的交流是以老年和中年为主的广州之行，圆满结束。正是妇女领导人才辈出的地方和时代，比如该教会的创始人之一馀艳芬是亚省第一位亚裔的女性议员，西北通讯第二期还登了她的专访。另外还有张文两人的流畅的自诉长文和一个残疾女之父写给已过世的女儿的信，这些关于人生经历的文很真实。青少年自去年暑期和秋季到州内外传道外，还有北边小团契可加入。目前共有男子，妇女，大学，年轻人，母亲，成年人，后祈祷团契等，活动时间为：週日上午，週三晚，週四晚，週五晚和周六的单双週活动安排。捐助款物新增衣物等。详情可与中英文牧师，年轻人牧师，少儿部主任，秘书等联係。活动安排见每月初的名单表格。
2cf45c0a841f2c02ce1ff4b9b734879e276e8723.translatedText: The exchange between the Guangdong Fellowship and the Guangzhou Church on April 19 this year was a successful trip to Guangzhou for the elderly and middle-aged people. This is a place and an era where women leaders emerge in large numbers. For example, Yu Yanfen, one of the founders of the church, is the first Asian female member of Parliament in Alberta. The second issue of the Northwest Newsletter even published an exclusive interview with her. There are also fluent self-reported essays by Zhang and Wen and a letter written by the father of a disabled daughter to his deceased daughter. These essays about life experiences are very real. In addition to young people going on missionary missions inside and outside the state last summer and fall, there is also a small northern fellowship that they can join. There are currently men's, women's, university, young people, mothers, adults, post-prayer fellowships, etc. The activity times are: Sunday morning, Wednesday evening, Thursday evening, Friday evening and Saturday odd and even week activities are arranged. Donate money and materials to add new clothes, etc. For details, please contact the Chinese and English pastor, young people pastor, children's ministry director, secretary, etc. Please see the list at the beginning of each month for event schedule.

ed4e9d787bf2a208071990b08ee41fe90bcb40be.translatedText: Chen Zhigang: Please take good care of your piano

5cc25d33202a2939801bccc93683dfaf4220783d.sourceText: 陈志钢：请注意保养好你家的钢琴 陈志钢 凤凰城 我们华人非常注重儿女的音乐教育和修养，许多家庭都拥有钢…
5cc25d33202a2939801bccc93683dfaf4220783d.translatedText: > Chen Zhigang: Please take good care of your piano Chen Zhigang Phoenix City We Chinese attach great importance to the music education and cultivation of our children, and many families own pianos...

f72c2e14b8d79c055069b7ec4d611b37a6bfb126.sourceText: 我们华人非常注重儿女的音乐教育和修养，许多家庭都拥有钢琴。样式从平台钢琴（三角钢琴）到立式钢琴，价格从几千的到几万的，父母之心，感人至深。遗憾的是，大多数父母对钢琴的保养却是一无所知。可怜那，许多钢琴，甚至贵重的钢琴从到家后就从来没有被保养调试过。琴弦松了，零件坏了，被虫蛀了，甚至被水淹了也没人管，也不知道该怎么管。可敬那，我们的乐器之王为了造就我们华人的下一代，勤勤恳恳，任劳任怨，却从来没有得到应有的服侍和’关怀’，直到早早地’废而后已’。
f72c2e14b8d79c055069b7ec4d611b37a6bfb126.translatedText: We Chinese attach great importance to the music education and cultivation of our children, and many families own pianos. The styles range from platform pianos (grand pianos) to upright pianos, and the prices range from a few thousand to tens of thousands. The love of parents is deeply touching. Unfortunately, most parents know nothing about piano maintenance. Unfortunately, many pianos, even expensive pianos, have never been maintained or adjusted since they arrived home. The strings were loose, the parts were broken, it was eaten by insects, it was even flooded, and no one took care of it, and no one knew how to take care of it. Respectfully, our king of musical instruments worked diligently and without complaint in order to educate the next generation of our Chinese people, but he never received the service and care he deserved, until he passed away early.

9f72513012673b42d030a5ba9fa63aefddaf8367.sourceText: 其实，这也不全怪大家。第一，钢琴属高档西洋乐器，我们老中对他的构造原理不太熟悉。第二，错就错在当初人们把Piano翻译成了’钢琴’。钢琴，顾名思义，钢做的，肯定结实耐用。殊不知，所谓的钢，其实就是指那两百多根钢丝弦。其它都是木头，呢子和生铁。确切地说，钢琴应该是属于’键弦’乐器。是由琴键带动琴槌敲击钢弦而发出声音来。因此，从发声原理来说，钢琴有一半属于弦乐器。
9f72513012673b42d030a5ba9fa63aefddaf8367.translatedText: Actually, this is not entirely our fault. First, the piano is a high-end Western musical instrument, and we middle-aged people are not very familiar with its structural principles. Second, the mistake was that people originally translated Piano as 'piano'. Pianos, as the name suggests, are made of steel and are certainly strong and durable. As everyone knows, the so-called steel actually refers to the more than two hundred steel wire strings. The rest is wood, woolen and pig iron. To be precise, the piano should be a 'key string' instrument. The sound is produced by the keys driving the hammers to strike the steel strings. Therefore, from the perspective of sound production principles, half of the piano is a string instrument.

e92cfdc1b756a13663f315c8c8c012ec3aef8dc7.sourceText: 说道弦乐器，大家就比较熟悉了。如二胡，小提琴，琵琶，古筝等乐器都属于弦乐器。看过弦乐器演奏的人都知道，演奏者在演奏前都要调调音。因为所有弦乐器在携带搬运中，演奏中，特别是随着湿度和温度的变化，音准和音律都在不停的变化。其实，钢琴也一样，只不过它的变化不如其它弦乐器那么快。因为它的构造和性能相对来说要稳定得多。其实，职业钢琴演奏家每次演出前，所用的钢琴都是经过调琴师检查调试过的。
e92cfdc1b756a13663f315c8c8c012ec3aef8dc7.translatedText: When it comes to string instruments, everyone is familiar with them. Instruments such as erhu, violin, pipa, guzheng, etc. are all stringed instruments. Anyone who has watched a string instrument play knows that the player must tune it before playing. Because all string instruments are being transported and played, especially with changes in humidity and temperature, the pitch and temperament are constantly changing. In fact, the same goes for the piano, but it doesn't change as quickly as other string instruments. Because its structure and performance are relatively much more stable. In fact, the pianos used by professional pianists are inspected and adjusted by a tuner before each performance.

59b098ad45cd4fc4148b738a238549aa3aed7357.sourceText: 那么普通家庭的钢琴应该多久调试一次呢？简单地说，如果每天都弹奏的钢琴，应该每年至少调试两次。时间最好是在暑期开空调后，和冬季开暖气后。其他钢琴至少每年一次，没人弹的钢琴隔两三年也应该调试一下，以保持钢琴的音准，音律，音色，音质以及内部结构的稳定和张力。千万不要以为没人弹的钢琴不用调，否则，要花两三倍的的时间和工钱才能调试达标，音色音质就需要更长时间才能恢复。
59b098ad45cd4fc4148b738a238549aa3aed7357.translatedText: So how often should a piano in an average family be tuned? Simply put, if your piano is played every day, it should be tuned at least twice a year. The best time is after turning on the air conditioner in the summer and after turning on the heating in the winter. Other pianos should be tuned at least once a year, and pianos that are not played should be tuned every two or three years to maintain the piano's intonation, temperament, timbre, sound quality, and the stability and tension of the internal structure. Don't think that a piano that no one plays does not need to be tuned. Otherwise, it will take two or three times more time and labor to adjust it to the standard, and the tone and sound quality will take longer to recover.

b1c46da2c4729aedce41c38c7ef11dcd1f940c2c.sourceText: 另外提醒大家，1）因为钢琴对湿度温度特别敏感，所以在家放置钢琴的位置最好是远离三口：门口，窗口和空调的出风口。2）如果水淹受潮，一定要把所有的盖子打开，通风晾干，越干越好。3）搬移钢琴时，尽量平稳，避免震动。总之，钢琴属贵重高档乐器，需要仔细保养。如果好好保养，他随时都能发出美妙动听的声音来。
b1c46da2c4729aedce41c38c7ef11dcd1f940c2c.translatedText: Also remind everyone, 1) Because pianos are particularly sensitive to humidity and temperature, it is best to place the piano at home away from three outlets: the door, the window and the air outlet of the air conditioner. 2) If it gets flooded and gets damp, be sure to open all the covers and ventilate it to dry. The drier the better. 3) When moving the piano, try to be as steady as possible to avoid vibration. In short, the piano is a valuable and high-end musical instrument that requires careful maintenance. If taken good care of, it can produce beautiful sounds at any time.

b6eb3eea0a6e3c5a0ba9ad0273cdaa79f3f320dc.sourceText: 人民日报警告：中国经济“三驾马车”全失灵
b6eb3eea0a6e3c5a0ba9ad0273cdaa79f3f320dc.translatedText: People's Daily warns: China's economic "troika" is all out of order

ee2962c480ead92ff60f00199ad1e492a19370e7.sourceText: 人民日报警告：中国经济“三驾马车”全失灵 文汇报 国务院总理温家宝日前指出，要「把稳增长放在更加重要的位置…
ee2962c480ead92ff60f00199ad1e492a19370e7.translatedText: People's Daily warns: China's economic "troika" is all out of order Wen Wei Po Premier Wen Jiabao recently pointed out that it is necessary to "put stabilizing growth in a more important position...

76ec05cca7e69bb8f7e399e5b9f297cb4360d5bc.sourceText: 国务院总理温家宝日前指出，要「把稳增长放在更加重要的位置」，显示中央宏观经济政策有所调整，中国经济形势不容乐观。对此，《人民日报》海外版昨日刊文称，当前拉动经济发展的「三驾马车」都有些失灵，经济惯性下滑过快，考验决策者智慧。不过政府不会为保经济增长而放松对楼市的调控，政府有多种手段可保经济增长，「稳增长」和「控楼市」可同时进行。 《人民日报》援引中国国际经济交流中心信息部副部长徐洪才的观点指出，「出口、投资、消费」这拉动经济的三驾马车近来失灵。徐洪才称，出口方面，因欧债危机愈演愈烈，外需不足，中国出口形势严峻，出口明显萎缩。同时，工资上涨，人民币升值，进口原材料上涨，这亦削减中国出口产品的竞争力。
76ec05cca7e69bb8f7e399e5b9f297cb4360d5bc.translatedText: Premier Wen Jiabao recently pointed out that it is necessary to "put stabilizing growth in a more important position", which shows that the central government's macroeconomic policies have been adjusted and China's economic situation is not optimistic. In this regard, the overseas edition of "People's Daily" published an article yesterday saying that the current "troika" that drives economic development are somewhat dysfunctional, and the economic inertia has declined too fast, testing the wisdom of policymakers. However, the government will not relax controls on the property market in order to maintain economic growth. The government has a variety of means to ensure economic growth. "Stabilizing growth" and "controlling the property market" can be carried out at the same time. "People's Daily" quoted Xu Hongcai, deputy director of the Information Department of the China Center for International Economic Exchanges, as saying that the troika of "exports, investment, and consumption" that drives the economy has recently failed. Xu Hongcai said that in terms of exports, due to the intensification of the European debt crisis and insufficient external demand, China's export situation is severe and exports have shrunk significantly. At the same time, wages are rising, the RMB is appreciating, and imported raw materials are rising, which also reduces the competitiveness of China's export products.

d270ed7ba9e96757967783c333bfcb18a0873968.sourceText: 吁多管齐下保7.5% 投资方面，前几年4万亿元投资已结束，与房地产有关的投资也在萎缩，投资对经济发展的拉动作用明显减弱；消费方面，总体上没什么好转，因收入分配制度改革不可能立竿见影，老百姓还不敢随便花口袋里那点钱。股市、房市下跌，民众的财富效应在减弱，消费意愿也随之减弱。 徐洪才称，为防止经济过快下滑，避免出现「硬着陆」，今年中国的GDP增速不能低于7.5%。为实现经济稳定增长，他建议，应「多管齐下保增长」。首先，在投资上要重点突破，保重点项目，用重点项目把投资撑起来。要补贴低排放、低能耗家电，并拉动相关产业发展。在城乡一体化过程中，要对一些基础设施、医疗、教育、交通等项目进行必要的投资。其次，还是要鼓励出口，调整出口结构，提高出口产品质量，增加中国出口产品的竞争力。 徐洪才进一步指出，信贷政策要定向、定点支持小微企业，要对个体经济适当减税。货币政策方面，央行要保持适度货币供应量，以满足实体经济活动对货币的合理需求。
d270ed7ba9e96757967783c333bfcb18a0873968.translatedText: Calls for a multi-pronged approach to ensure 7.5% investment. In terms of investment, the 4 trillion yuan investment in the past few years has ended, real estate-related investment is also shrinking, and the role of investment in stimulating economic development has been significantly weakened. In terms of consumption, there is generally no improvement, because the reform of the income distribution system cannot be immediate, and people do not dare to spend the money in their pockets casually. The stock market and real estate market have fallen, the wealth effect of the people is weakening, and the willingness to consume has also weakened. Xu Hongcai said that in order to prevent the economy from declining too quickly and avoid a "hard landing", China's GDP growth rate this year cannot be lower than 7.5%. In order to achieve stable economic growth, he suggested that "multi-pronged measures should be taken to maintain growth." First of all, we must make key breakthroughs in investment, protect key projects, and use key projects to support investment. It is necessary to subsidize low-emission and low-energy consumption home appliances and stimulate the development of related industries. In the process of urban-rural integration, necessary investment must be made in some infrastructure, medical care, education, transportation and other projects. Secondly, we still need to encourage exports, adjust the export structure, improve the quality of export products, and increase the competitiveness of China's export products. Xu Hongcai further pointed out that credit policies should support small and micro enterprises in a targeted and targeted manner, and tax reductions should be appropriate for the individual economy. In terms of monetary policy, the central bank must maintain an appropriate money supply to meet the reasonable demand for money from real economic activities.

f168c763f0cec2341de8ea4713e6fbd9815c6d33.sourceText: 2012年是壬辰龙年，也是大凤凰城侨联总会承办美国国庆的第四十四年；以及2012年的凤凰城华裔小姐选美，所以，今年的国庆选美主题就定为《龙飞凤舞庆国庆》。 如何才能做好这场《龙飞凤舞》庆典呢？近日侨联总会选出以张华芳为主席的新一届的领导班子，团队朝气蓬勃，但经验尚有不足，幸而得到华侨前辈扶持，十七个属下团体相助，广大义工帮忙。目前工作已经展开，首要的任务，是要把举办活动的组织架构建立起来，把活动内容和形式定出，把责任落实到人，大家分工合作，一同把工作做好。《龙飞凤舞点将台》是今次活动的资讯平台，将把侨联国庆和选美的相关内容向侨社作出最新的报导。 首先要报导的，是新班子得到了华侨前辈的扶持，资深侨领余文劲先生不但对晚辈鼓励鞭策，而且身体力行，首先出资赞助佳丽参赛。余文劲先生早在1975年已荣任过侨联主席，数十年来不遗余力服务侨众，去年被侨联授予《服务侨社终身成就奖》。 其次，是上一届侨联主席邓朝驹，他对新班子讨教的问题授以经验，提供建议。邓朝驹在前任期间成功地办过两届国庆和选美活动，曾亲自带队去土桑中华文化中心交流；首次去拜会洛杉矶中华会馆；带领佳丽到凤凰卫视取经；到八号电视台做义工；让佳丽到慈济学习和奉献；侨联还成功地举办中国周，华人庆祝亚省建州100年等活动，广受大家好评。 第三，今年新班子人马有来自ABC系、国语系、粤语系各方面的人才，各有专长，有利于团结侨社不同的力量。主席张华芳已担任过两年的侨联副主席，有实际的工作经验和良好的人脉关係，另外，除侨联十七个团体大力协助外，作为〝第二梯队〝的义工团队亦已成立，这班不为名利的义工尤其难能可贵，我们十分欢迎大家加入到义工团队来，贡献才智，树立榜样。 第四，除庆典和选美，侨联还希望有其它团体加入共襄胜举，以便能可进行更多的活动，现计划中的有球类比赛，摄影展或画展等，让国庆日的节目更加丰富多彩。
f168c763f0cec2341de8ea4713e6fbd9815c6d33.translatedText: 2012 is the Year of the Dragon, and it is also the 44th year that the Overseas Chinese Federation of Greater Phoenix City has hosted the National Day of the United States; and the 2012 Miss Chinese Phoenix Beauty Pageant. Therefore, the theme of this year’s National Day pageant is set to "Celebrate the National Day with Dragons and Phoenixes". How can we prepare for this "Dragon and Phoenix" celebration? Recently, the Overseas Chinese Federation has elected a new leadership team with Zhang Huafang as the chairman. The team is full of energy, but still lacks experience. Fortunately, it has the support of senior overseas Chinese, the help of 17 subordinate groups, and the help of volunteers. The work has already begun. The first task is to establish the organizational structure for holding the event, determine the content and format of the event, and assign responsibilities to people. Everyone can divide the work and cooperate to get the job done together. "Dragon and Phoenix Dance" is the information platform of this event. It will provide the latest reports on the Overseas Chinese Federation's National Day and beauty pageant related content to the overseas Chinese community. The first thing I want to report is that the new team has received support from the senior overseas Chinese. Mr. Yu Wenjin, a senior overseas Chinese leader, not only encouraged the juniors, but also set an example and took the lead in sponsoring the contestants. Mr. Yu Wenjin was elected as the Chairman of the Overseas Chinese Federation as early as 1975. He has spared no effort to serve the overseas Chinese for decades. Last year, he was awarded the "Lifetime Achievement Award for Service to the Overseas Chinese Community" by the Overseas Chinese Federation. Secondly, there was Deng Chaoju, the previous chairman of the Overseas Chinese Federation, who imparted experience and provided suggestions on the issues that the new team asked for advice. During his tenure, Deng Chaoju successfully organized two National Day and beauty pageant events. He personally led a team to the Tucson Chinese Cultural Center for exchanges; visited the Los Angeles Chinese Association for the first time; led the beauties to Phoenix TV to learn from the experience; volunteered at TV Station 8; and sent the beauties to Tzu Chi to study and contribute; the Overseas Chinese Federation also successfully organized China Week, Chinese people celebrated the 100th anniversary of the founding of the province of Alberta, and other activities, which were widely praised by everyone. Third, this year’s new team includes talents from the ABC Department, the Mandarin Department, and the Cantonese Department, each with their own expertise, which is conducive to uniting the different forces of the overseas Chinese community. Chairman Zhang Huafang has served as Vice Chairman of the Overseas Chinese Federation for two years and has practical work experience and good connections. In addition, in addition to the strong assistance of the 17 groups of the Overseas Chinese Federation, a volunteer team as the "second echelon" has also been established. This group of volunteers who are not interested in fame and fortune is particularly valuable. We very much welcome everyone to join the volunteer team, contribute their talents and set an example. Fourth, in addition to celebrations and beauty pageants, the Overseas Chinese Federation also hopes that other groups will join in the victory so that more activities can be held. Currently planned are ball games, photography exhibitions or painting exhibitions, etc., to make the National Day programs more colorful.

b93d23774aad014ad45620b526b02d3b2632f5f4.sourceText: 下一期，《龙飞凤舞》点将台继续为大家推介各路英雄人物和活动进展。
b93d23774aad014ad45620b526b02d3b2632f5f4.translatedText: In the next issue, "Dragon and Phoenix Dance" will continue to promote various heroes and activity progress to everyone.

e073f452a02bf59f39901bcbfc8473127e59f8cf.translatedText: Phoenix Chinese School held its first Anti-Japanese War photo exhibition (submission from Phoenix Chinese School) On April 19, Phoenix Chinese School held a photo exhibition on the campus of Mesa Community College...

8ccd3bfd983864c1adb7b05a92fd9e56d382ad1f.sourceText: (凤凰城中文学校来稿)四月十九日，凤凰城中文学校在美莎社区大学校区举办纪念日抗战胜利七十週年的图片展览活动。
8ccd3bfd983864c1adb7b05a92fd9e56d382ad1f.translatedText: (submission from Phoenix Chinese School) On April 19, Phoenix Chinese School held a photo exhibition on the campus of Mesa Community College to commemorate the 70th anniversary of the victory of the Anti-Japanese War.

d338e54d656bb15988b928ba7c5cf192497e17d9.sourceText: 洛杉矶台北经济文化办事处十分重视此次活动，提前三週已把图片寄给了凤凰城中文学校，而整个活动是由学生代联会筹办。在陈晓琪老师的指导下，会长罗允伶以及成员陈怿萱、谢晓岚、郑艾伦和罗启荃等同学，开始准备展览的各项工作，她们张贴图片，分工负责对图片资料方面的介绍。校方也积极筹划活动流程和邀请、接待贵宾等事宜。
d338e54d656bb15988b928ba7c5cf192497e17d9.translatedText: The Los Angeles Taipei Economic and Cultural Office attaches great importance to this event and has sent the pictures to Phoenix Chinese School three weeks in advance. The entire event is organized by the Student Representatives Association. Under the guidance of teacher Chen Xiaoqi, president Luo Yunling and members Chen Yixuan, Xie Xiaolan, Zheng Ailun and Luo Qiquan began to prepare for the exhibition. They posted pictures and were responsible for introducing the picture materials. The school also actively plans event procedures and invites and receives distinguished guests.

663db402e98b27aa15371975b31b57f8050a5319.sourceText: 4月19日下午两点，老师、同学及贵宾们来到了活动现场。来宾包括有资深侨领余文劲，还有高志中、孙如新、黄国熙、邱顺雄、 张慧美、张圣仪、林子宣、张肇鸿、黄馨民、黄义成、余霭明、庄淑华、沉柏、闻玲琳等，以及华裔、非华裔的学生家长们。活动由学校顾问郑弘主持，他热烈欢迎各界嘉宾莅临，阐明了此次活动的意义。学校董事长谢健明致词，他提到这次筹备活动的过程，原本预期只是简单的图片展览，后来延伸到邀请贵宾、致词、剪綵等事项，让他觉得身负重任，一定要把这首次抗战图片展览办成功。然后，主持人邀请贵宾余文劲先生致词。余文劲先生说在日八年抗战期间，他人在大陆，亲身经历了战争的残酷和苦难，印象深刻难忘。他提到求学时环境很差，常常害怕敌机轰炸而停课。当时政府召青年参军，提出「一寸山河一寸血，十万青年十万兵」的口号。战争所带来的人、财物之损失难以估计，是对人类最残酷的事，他要学生们牢记战争带来惨痛的教训，要反对战争，并祝愿世界和平。
663db402e98b27aa15371975b31b57f8050a5319.translatedText: At two o'clock in the afternoon on April 19, teachers, classmates and distinguished guests came to the event. Guests included senior overseas Chinese leader Yu Wenjin, as well as Gao Zhizhong, Sun Ruxin, Huang Guoxi, Qiu Shunxiong, Zhang Huimei, Zhang Shengyi, Lin Zixuan, Zhang Zhaohong, Huang Xinmin, Huang Yicheng, Yu Aiming, Zhuang Shuhua, Shen Bai, Wen Linglin, etc., as well as Chinese and non-Chinese student parents. The event was hosted by school consultant Zheng Hong. He warmly welcomed guests from all walks of life and clarified the significance of the event. Xie Jianming, chairman of the school, delivered a speech. He mentioned that the preparation process for this event was originally expected to be a simple photo exhibition, but later extended to invitations to distinguished guests, speeches, ribbon cutting and other matters. He felt that he had a heavy responsibility and must make this first Anti-Japanese War photo exhibition a success. Then, the host invited the distinguished guest Mr. Yu Wenjin to deliver a speech. Mr. Yu Wenjin said that during the eight-year Anti-Japanese War, he personally experienced the cruelty and suffering of the war in mainland China, which left an unforgettable impression. He mentioned that the environment when he was studying was very poor and he was often afraid of being bombed by enemy planes and had to stop classes. At that time, the government called on young people to join the army and put forward the slogan "One inch of mountains and rivers, one inch of blood, one hundred thousand young people and one hundred thousand soldiers." The human and property losses caused by war are inestimable, and it is the most cruel thing to mankind. He asked students to remember the painful lessons brought by war, oppose war, and wish for world peace.

ee65019da3dec5a6a2f38ea19c437c438f67ad84.translatedText: A group photo of the ribbon-cutting guests

fd90c00f71bae5c5c368b0e22a602ddaf874dbd5.translatedText: Senior overseas Chinese leader Yu Wenjin

b0cb860a35ab0b1f0adbaa74303d8598e0390172.sourceText: 余文劲先生致词完毕后，和来宾们一同进行剪綵，抗战图片展览也正式开始。学生代联会的成员们用流利的中文和英文分别介绍了抗战的五个时期： 抗战前期、战略守势、持久做战、联盟做战和反攻做战时期到日本宣布投降。来宾们全神贯注倾听讲解，并对她们的专注、明快、负责任的态度报以热烈的掌声。
b0cb860a35ab0b1f0adbaa74303d8598e0390172.translatedText: After Mr. Yu Wenjin delivered his speech, he cut the ribbon with the guests, and the Anti-Japanese War photo exhibition officially began. Members of the Student Representative Association introduced the five periods of the Anti-Japanese War in fluent Chinese and English: the early stage of the Anti-Japanese War, the strategic defensive, the protracted war, the alliance war and the counter-offensive war period until Japan announced its surrender. The guests listened attentively to the explanations and gave them warm applause for their focused, lively and responsible attitude.

de02fe50c5c4d4cca7bcfe00ba03f4d9686d4188.sourceText: 图片简介后，大家开始自由阅览图片，并用享用校方准备的茶点，其间还有许多班级的学生由老师带领至会场观看图片。
de02fe50c5c4d4cca7bcfe00ba03f4d9686d4188.translatedText: After the introduction of the pictures, everyone began to browse the pictures freely and enjoyed the refreshments prepared by the school. During this period, students from many classes were led by teachers to the venue to view the pictures.

41cc9c9bb25c1ca786f4a9ceee0087bf435075f0.translatedText: Guests looked at the pictures on display

9246bec3b396ce61a14a7556a2dad0442fc3ab46.sourceText: 校方在此特别感谢洛杉矶台北经文处、凤凰城荣光会所提供的支持与赞助，感谢新东方学校慷慨地借出画架。凤凰城中文学校是本地最悠久的中文学校，至今已有三十四年历史。此次校方深感荣幸，能成为第一个主办抗战图片展览的单位，让海外华人第二代能藉此次机会认识到这段中国近代史上最重要的历史，在纪念抗战胜利七十週年的活动中，记取战争的残酷及抗战胜利的来之不易。这次图片展览规模虽小，但却具有深刻的意义。
9246bec3b396ce61a14a7556a2dad0442fc3ab46.translatedText: The school would like to express special thanks to the Los Angeles Taipei Scripture Office and the Phoenix Glory Club for their support and sponsorship, and to New Oriental School for generously lending the easel. Phoenix Chinese School is the oldest Chinese school in the local area, with a history of 34 years. The school is deeply honored to be the first organization to host a photo exhibition of the Anti-Japanese War, so that the second generation of overseas Chinese can take this opportunity to understand this most important period in China's modern history. In commemorating the 70th anniversary of the victory of the Anti-Japanese War, they can remember the cruelty of the war and the hard-won victory of the Anti-Japanese War. Although this photo exhibition is small in scale, it is of profound significance.

e357a001b3417d34a6f5f5db842500566a17721a.sourceText: 鉴于薄熙来同志涉嫌严重违纪，中央决定，依据《中国共产党章程》和《中国共产党纪律检查机关案件检查工作条例》的有关规定，停止其担任的中央政治局委员、中央委员职务，由中共中央纪律检查委员会对其立案调查。
e357a001b3417d34a6f5f5db842500566a17721a.translatedText: In view of Comrade Bo Xilai's suspected serious violation of discipline, the Central Committee decided, in accordance with the relevant provisions of the "Constitution of the Communist Party of China" and the "Regulations on Case Inspection Work of the Disciplinary Inspection Organs of the Communist Party of China", to suspend his position as a member of the Political Bureau and Central Committee, and to investigate him by the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection of the Communist Party of China.

f8498a708f35c780cc64eb68a4228e4ee4df0f08.sourceText: 公安机关对尼尔伍德死亡案依法进行复查。
f8498a708f35c780cc64eb68a4228e4ee4df0f08.translatedText: The public security organs conducted a review of Neil Wood’s death case in accordance with the law.

5994172f3fb5a47c0064103bab0082a5e57ab4f4.sourceText: 记者从有关部门获悉，2月6日王立军私自进入美国驻成都总领事馆滞留事件发生后，对王立军反映的2011年11月15日英国公民尼尔伍德在重庆被发现死亡一案，公安机关高度重视，专门成立了复查组，本着实事求是的态度，依法进行了复查。
5994172f3fb5a47c0064103bab0082a5e57ab4f4.translatedText: Reporters learned from relevant departments that after the incident of Wang Lijun privately entering the U.S. Consulate General in Chengdu on February 6 and staying there, the public security organs attached great importance to the case of British citizen Neil Wood being found dead in Chongqing on November 15, 2011 reported by Wang Lijun. They set up a review team and conducted a review in accordance with the law in a pragmatic manner.

fa0a24336cf18725b393c03d9e0cfaf67c01ca54.sourceText: 新华网消息，据警方调查，薄谷开来(薄熙来同志妻子)及其子同尼尔伍德过去关系良好，后因经济利益问题产生矛盾。尼尔五德死于他杀，薄谷开来和张晓军(薄家勤务人员)有重大作案嫌疑。薄谷开来、张晓军涉嫌故意杀人犯罪，已移送司法机关。
fa0a24336cf18725b393c03d9e0cfaf67c01ca54.translatedText: According to Xinhuanet news, according to police investigation, Bogu Kailai (comrade Bo Xilai’s wife) and his son had a good relationship with Neil Wood in the past, but later conflicts occurred due to financial interests. Neil Wude died of homicide, and Bogu Kailai and Zhang Xiaojun (Bo family servants) were suspected of committing the crime. Bogu Kailai and Zhang Xiaojun are suspected of intentional homicide and have been transferred to judicial authorities.

61fd405e558b83ebc6bc756a916dea9c6f827646.sourceText: 有关部门负责人表示，我国是社会主义法治国家，法律的尊严和权威不容践踏。不论涉及到谁，只要触犯法律，都将依法处理，决不姑息。
61fd405e558b83ebc6bc756a916dea9c6f827646.translatedText: The person in charge of the relevant department stated that our country is a socialist country governed by the rule of law, and the dignity and authority of the law cannot be trampled upon. No matter who is involved, as long as they violate the law, they will be dealt with according to the law and will never be tolerated.

23960b05a6e982bdccb2b87b712f3c2d3e030dd3.sourceText: 丰富的演讲内容和美味的中国美食就在当天的活动中，活动将持续到晚上6时多，满汉全席宴烹饪大师Tony Wu，美国美食大师 Martin Yan都将现场献艺。

10f0253182bb245053d769204f40df1635a3fd26.sourceText: 1。 我表姐两年前在纽约按摩店做工被抓，在未明真正后果的情况下认了卖淫罪(当时并没有证据控告她这个罪名)，留下案底，现在想申请公民﹐她这样的情况有无办法 翻案，消除犯罪记录？ 怎样才能处理好这样事情入籍呢？ 答: 有犯重罪前科的永久居民一般不可以入籍，通常移民法中例举的重罪有恐怖份子、杀人、强奸、贩毒、战犯等。 如果你表姐所犯之罪不在移民法列举的重罪之列，她也许还有机会入籍。 但是，她要显示其在犯罪后到申请入籍时至少有五年没有再犯罪。 如果是卖淫罪，这还涉及到移民法的另一条规定「道德行为不规「者不可以入籍的问题。你的表姐首先应该把她当年的结案单拿给她的律师看，也许情况并不是 像你所说的那么严重。如果情况属实，我们建议她再等上几年，等满了五年以后再递交入籍申请。如果她要试﹐准备一些文件来证明她已经彻底悔过自新， 是一个好人、好母亲并对社区有贡献的人﹐机会会比较大。
10f0253182bb245053d769204f40df1635a3fd26.translatedText: 1. My cousin was arrested two years ago while working in a massage parlor in New York. She pleaded guilty to prostitution without knowing the true consequences (there was no evidence to charge her with this crime at the time) and left a criminal record. Now she wants to apply for citizenship. Is there any way to reverse the case and expunge her criminal record? How can we handle such a matter and get naturalized? Answer: Permanent residents with a history of committing serious crimes are generally not allowed to naturalize. Commonly cited felonies in immigration laws include terrorism, murder, rape, drug trafficking, war criminals, etc. If the crime your cousin committed is not listed as a felony under immigration law, she may still have a chance to naturalize. However, she must show that she has not committed another crime for at least five years between the time of the crime and the time of application for naturalization. If it is a crime of prostitution, this also involves another provision of the immigration law that "those with irregular moral conduct" cannot be naturalized. Your cousin should first show her lawyer the closing slip of the year. Maybe the situation is not as serious as you said. If the situation is true, we suggest that she waits for a few more years and waits for five years before submitting the naturalization application. If she wants to try, prepare some documents to prove that she has completely repented. If you are a good person, a good mother, and a contributor to the community, you will have a better chance.

8238b53dad9700804975eea18c388a16deb30494.sourceText: 2. 我生于1950年﹐做全职工作有16年之久。 很不幸， 由于公司关闭，我已被解雇。 我从今年3月开始领取失业金。 当我到达62 岁时，我可否申请提早退休？ 又于何时我可以领取全额退休金？ 申请提早退休和于完全退休年龄时才申请有何分别？ 我有一栋房屋和一辆汽车，我是否符合资格申请SSI和食物券？ 目前我失业而且很难找到工作。 我是否必须等到我的完全退休年龄时才可申请退休？ 我目前没有任何医疗保险。 请问何时我可以申请联邦医疗保险(Medicare)？ 答 假如您已累积40个或以上工作季点(最少工作满10年)，您可能可以于年满62岁时申请领取您的社安退休福利，但领取的是永久性减额退休金。 当您申请时，社安局会告诉您应得的金额。 假如那时您仍然可以领取您的失业金，它亦可能被削减。 当您有需要申请时，请电社安​​局1-800-772 1213﹐并要求免费翻译员。 您只可以在完全退休年龄(Full Retirement Age简称FRA)时领取您的全额社安退休金。 一个人的完全退休年龄是根据他／她的出生年份而定。 由于您生于1950年，您的完全退休年龄是66 岁。 假如您提早退休便只可领取减额退休金。 此外，假如您申请提早退休，又继续工作而您的工作收入超过规定的年限额，您的社安退休金可能再被削减直至到达您的完全退休年龄。 然而，假如您在完全退休年龄退休时或之后才工作，任何收入都不会影响您的退休金金额。 假如您是美国公民，当您年满65岁时，您的收入和资产都符合规定的限额，您可以尝试申请SSI(社会安全生活补助金)。 非公民也可能合资格申请但会受到限制。 拥有的房子和车子如果是用来自住及自用，不会算作您资产的一部分。 合资格长者需于「首次参加期」(Initial Enrollment Period) 期内向社安局申请Medicare(联邦医疗保险)避免因延迟参加而受罚。 「首次参加期」是指65岁前3个月至65岁后3个月(一共7个月)。 然而，假如您申请提早退休，当您接近65岁时会自动收到您的Medicare卡，无需亲自去申请。 假如您有40个或以上工作季点，您可以享受免费Part A(医院保险)，但仍需要付Part B(医疗保险)月费。 Part B月费通常从您每月的社安退休金扣除。 于2011年标准PartB 月费为115.40元。 这金额每年都可能会调整。
8238b53dad9700804975eea18c388a16deb30494.translatedText: 2. I was born in 1950 and have been working full-time for 16 years. Unfortunately, I have been laid off due to the company's closure. Can I apply for early retirement when I reach the age of 62? What is the difference between applying for early retirement and applying at full retirement age? I have a house and a car. Am I eligible for SSI and food stamps? Do I have to wait until my full retirement age to apply for Medicare? Answer If you have accumulated 40 or more working quarter points (at least 10 years of service), you may be able to apply for your Social Security retirement benefits, but you will receive a permanently reduced pension. When you apply, the Social Security Administration will tell you the amount you deserve. If you still receive your unemployment benefits at that time, it may also be reduced when you need to apply. 1213, and ask for a free interpreter. You can only receive your full Social Security pension at Full Retirement Age (FRA). A person's full retirement age is based on his/her birth year. Since you were born in 1950, your full retirement age is 66. If you retire early, you can only receive a reduced pension. In addition, if you apply for early retirement and continue to work and your working income exceeds the prescribed annual limit, your Social Security pension may be reduced until you reach your full retirement age. However, if you work at or after your full retirement age, any income will not affect the amount of your pension. If you are a U.S. citizen and your income and assets meet the prescribed limit when you reach the age of 65, you can try to apply for SSI (Social Security Assistance). Non-citizens may also be eligible to apply, but there will be restrictions. If the house and car you own are used for self-occupation and personal use, they will not be counted as part of your assets. Eligible seniors need to apply for Medicare (Federal Medical Insurance) from the Social Security Administration during the "Initial Enrollment Period" to avoid penalties for delaying enrollment. The "first participation period" refers to 3 months before the age of 65 to 3 months after the age of 65 (a total of 7 months). However, if you apply for early retirement, you will automatically receive your Medicare card when you approach age 65 without having to apply in person. If you have 40 or more working quarter points, you can enjoy Part A (hospital insurance) for free, but you still need to pay the monthly fee for Part B (medical insurance). The Part B monthly fee is usually deducted from your monthly Social Security pension. In 2011, the standard PartB monthly fee was 115.40 yuan. This amount may be adjusted annually.

e146c2be7195cd20203c9d5b7c9f934ba6dc5ccb.translatedText: China and the United States are fighting against the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank. (Author of this article: Huang Sheng) The United Kingdom announced that it would join the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank, and Germany, France, and Italy followed suit, which shocked the United States for a while...

37a50d05fe42a28dd35bfa9502d2b2bb5f4013f5.sourceText: （本文作者：黄生）英国宣布加入亚投行，德、法、意大利纷纷仿效，一时让美国大惊失色，美国、日本、新加坡千方百计阻扰，为何？亚投行现在成为了大国角力的焦点。
37a50d05fe42a28dd35bfa9502d2b2bb5f4013f5.translatedText: (Author of this article: Huang Sheng) The United Kingdom announced that it would join the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank, and Germany, France, and Italy followed suit, which shocked the United States. The United States, Japan, and Singapore tried every means to obstruct it. Why? The AIIB has now become the focus of competition among major powers.

6187cd04f7c1701327e0c88ce405a96456edcf09.sourceText: 1、以中国为主导的亚投行，将是中国资本输出的重要金融机构。这背后，如果未来中国的四万亿的外汇储备大幅度减少购买美国国债，而是拿去放贷的话，无疑对美国现有的美元回流机制产生重要的影响，因为中国是美国的第一贸易顺差国，美国之所以敢于保持如此大逆差，就是因为中国会将赚取的顺差继续通过购买美国国债的形式投资美国。
6187cd04f7c1701327e0c88ce405a96456edcf09.translatedText: 1. The China-led AIIB will be an important financial institution for China’s capital export. Behind this, if China's four trillion foreign exchange reserves are significantly reduced in the future to purchase U.S. Treasury bonds and are instead used for lending, it will undoubtedly have an important impact on the United States' existing dollar reflux mechanism, because China is the United States' largest trade surplus country. The reason why the United States dares to maintain such a large deficit is because China will continue to invest the surplus it earns in the United States by purchasing U.S. Treasury bonds.

967a5727c5abace4dc1b6767c3343993761cf014.sourceText: 如果这一根本模式受到亚投行的影响，不是去投资美国，而是去投资亚洲的大型基础项目，那么美国需要重新设计货币路径，会大大影响美国的经济增长和QE的退出，这对美国现有的经济模式是重大打击。
967a5727c5abace4dc1b6767c3343993761cf014.translatedText: If this fundamental model is affected by the AIIB and invests not in the United States but in large-scale infrastructure projects in Asia, then the United States will need to redesign its monetary path, which will greatly affect U.S. economic growth and the withdrawal of QE, which will be a major blow to the existing economic model of the United States.

8e7304a73aaf8df688e86c5437ca043efba34731.sourceText: 2、一旦亚投行开始启动投资亚洲大型的基础建设项目，那么对亚洲其他国家提供的贷款可能不仅仅是美元等外汇，会同时提供人民币贷款，会使得人民币国际化的步伐大大加快，人民币国际化的成功，又会使得这些国家通过人民币进口中国的设备等。这将大大削弱美元、日元在亚洲的地位。这也是美国和日本非常焦急的原因。
8e7304a73aaf8df688e86c5437ca043efba34731.translatedText: 2. Once the AIIB starts investing in large-scale infrastructure projects in Asia, the loans provided to other Asian countries may not only be US dollars and other foreign exchange, but also RMB loans, which will greatly accelerate the pace of RMB internationalization. The success of RMB internationalization will allow these countries to import Chinese equipment through RMB. This will greatly weaken the status of the US dollar and the Japanese yen in Asia. This is why the United States and Japan are very anxious.

248a8791e26b08d242909f251fa6f921baf8218a.sourceText: 3、英国、德国、法国为什么要加入亚投行？无非是利益而已，英国伦敦一直想争取人民币的国际离岸中心；那德国和法国为什么要加入呢？德国和法国都是出口制造大国，一旦加入了亚投行，亚投行投资建设的大型基础建设项目，会优先采购成员国的设备，这可是上十万亿规模以上的大生意，空客飞机、西门子机械，等等，太多了。
248a8791e26b08d242909f251fa6f921baf8218a.translatedText: 3. Why do the United Kingdom, Germany, and France want to join the AIIB? It’s nothing more than interests. London, UK, has always wanted to become an international offshore center for RMB; then why do Germany and France want to join? Germany and France are both major export and manufacturing countries. Once they join the AIIB, the AIIB will give priority to purchasing equipment from member countries for large-scale infrastructure projects invested and constructed by the AIIB. This is a big business with a scale of more than 10 trillion yuan, including Airbus aircraft, Siemens machinery, etc., there are too many.

80e9b1f09172ae642d835d803adc6c6e80929d87.sourceText: 4、英国、德国、法国为什么敢于忤逆美国而加入亚投行？美国马上要加息，美元大量回流，欧洲经济很差，不得不继续量化宽松印钞，美国现在给欧洲带来的是通缩，而美国丝毫不考虑欧洲的现状，连IMF总裁拉加德都警告美国加息可能会导致重大金融灾难，这可是代表欧洲说话的，有用吗？没有，美国该加息还是加息。既然从美国获得不了利益，为什么要拒绝亚投行的巨大的好处呢？在利益面前，政客们都不傻。
80e9b1f09172ae642d835d803adc6c6e80929d87.translatedText: 4. Why do the United Kingdom, Germany, and France dare to disobey the United States and join the AIIB? The U.S. is about to raise interest rates, and the U.S. dollar is returning in large quantities. The European economy is in poor condition and has to continue quantitative easing and money printing. The U.S. is now bringing deflation to Europe, and the U.S. does not consider the current situation in Europe at all. Even IMF President Lagarde warned that U.S. interest rate hikes may lead to a major financial disaster. Is this speaking on behalf of Europe? Is it useful? No, should the United States raise interest rates or raise interest rates? Since there is no benefit to be gained from the United States, why reject the huge benefits of the AIIB? Politicians are not stupid when it comes to interests.

47cb9debbd54614627ba04689c46d61260c2763d.sourceText: 5、美国和日本肯定会阻扰和报复中国。亚投行是代表中国资本输出和人民币国际化的象征，这对于传统的美国和日本把持的世界银行和亚洲开发银行传统势力提出了挑战。同时任何挑战美元的货币都曾经被美国严重的打击过，人民币肯定也不会例外。
47cb9debbd54614627ba04689c46d61260c2763d.translatedText: 5. The United States and Japan will definitely obstruct and retaliate against China. The AIIB is a symbol representing China's capital export and the internationalization of the RMB, which poses a challenge to the traditional powers of the World Bank and Asian Development Bank controlled by the United States and Japan. At the same time, any currency that challenges the US dollar has been severely hit by the United States, and the RMB will certainly be no exception.

bdec15af7b8cf22d1a1650aa64db221d671ed39d.sourceText: 亚投行，肩负着中国和美国、日本在亚洲的角逐，肩负着人民币国际化的重担，但刀光剑影，危机四伏，甚至可能会爆发战争，缅甸战乱，中国在国外的大型建设项目受阻，都是明证，而且这种事情会越来越多。亚投行，走好，人民币，走好！
bdec15af7b8cf22d1a1650aa64db221d671ed39d.translatedText: The Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank shoulders the competition between China, the United States and Japan in Asia, and shoulders the heavy responsibility of the internationalization of the RMB. However, there are dangers and dangers, and war may even break out. The war in Myanmar and the obstruction of China's large-scale construction projects abroad are all evidence of this, and there will be more and more such things. AIIB, go well, RMB, go well!

92423fe203e5c4ef5478df089dba02915845618c.sourceText: 日前看到了”亚利桑那华人华侨联合总会”和”亚利桑那华人华侨总会”在报刊上同期发布的中秋国庆活动的通知。不明底细的读者乍一看一定以为是同一个组织的两场活动，明细的或细心的读者会发现，两个”总会”的名称有略微不同，似乎在上演一场”李鬼战李逵” 的喜剧，颇有较劲的味道。 ”亚利桑那华人华侨联合总会”的广告位于第五版，没有图，四分之一版面，文字通知平平淡淡。两主办单位，一个协办单位，加一些英格力士。 http://sunbirdarizona.com/News-Detail.asp?keyno=1179 （网上类似通知，报上广告仅有黑色文字无图） ”亚利桑那华人华侨总会”的广告位于第3版半版彩色版面红火喜庆，10个主办单位，全体华人协办，中领馆要员参会并有讲座，中国国内涉侨机构来函祝贺，气势明显压过前者。 http://sunbirdarizona.com/News-Detail.asp?keyno=1188 1. ”两董之争”到”两会之争” 大家是否还记得今年春天凤凰城上演的一场亚利桑那华人华侨联合总会分裂的风波。2011年新年伊始，从华联网络通讯看，亚利桑那华人华侨联合总会似乎一夜间突然间分裂成了两派，当然不仅仅是简单的派系之争，而像是势不两立，不可调和的内讧，或者说更像是发生一场”宫廷政变”。一月的一天有人突然宣布一个新的董事会和会长产生，于是乎亚省华联总会一夜间裂变成了两个：两个会长，两个董事会。 看见华人社会出现分裂的局面许多人十分痛心，主动出面调解。经过热心人士数月的调和失败，分裂的当事双方最后走上法庭，最终以”发动政变的一方”败诉退出亚利桑那华人华侨联合总会而结束了这场长达数月的纷争。 华人社区表面上看又回到了往日的平静。然而树欲静而风不止，上次纷争中失败的一方并没有认输，而是重整旗鼓东山再起，新注册了”亚利桑那华人华侨总会”，虽然与原董事会名称只有两字之差，但力图以一种崭新的面貌出现在华人社区面前，并在气势上要压倒前者。 两个”总会”同时现身凤凰城似有点滑稽可笑，却又在情理之中。年初亚利桑那华联总会爆发”宫廷政变”;，笔者在《亚利桑那华人华侨联合总会的危机和转机》一文中写道：”得民心者得天下：亚省华联总会就是个名字，再注册一个亚州华联总会也就是个手续问题，其真正的内涵在于华人社会的支持。只有华人社会的支持才可能得到中领馆的支持和赞助。想必中领馆不会逆水行舟非要支持一个不得人心的组织或个人。总会也只有打着民意的光环才有辉煌，否则，总会是什么，名字而已。” 败诉一方在原华联两董事会正统之争法律诉讼正酣时突然退出，显然，他们终于悟出：亚省华联总会就是个名字而已，再注册一个有何难处。 于是与亚利桑那华人华侨联合总会几乎同名的亚利桑那华人华侨总会不久便应运而生了。此总会非彼总会，无所谓正统不正统，此招高啊。 既然两个”总会”都是社团名称而已，两个总会就有同时存在的合理性。日转星移，几个月前”新董”和”旧董”不共戴天，争权夺利的”两董之争”，演变成兄弟社团间实力竞争的”两会之争”，在民主社会里，这似乎挺符合民主社会竞争法则。 至于中领馆给谁面子，那就要看谁更像”总会”。 平心而论，两个总会都是小团体运作自封的”总会”，缺少名符其实的民意基础，诞生一前一后，可谓难兄难弟尔。自认为正统的华联总会罔顾落实在分裂风波一开始时社区就提出的”正名或正身”的诉求，又回到小圈子民主，失去先机，也就失去真正意义上，名正言顺的总会头衔，错失”危机即是转机” 的历史机遇，使得新总会一出世就与老总会不相伯仲的地步。 新总会似乎悟出了真谛，哪里跌倒哪里爬起来，组织了一个具有更广泛代表性的亚利桑那华侨总会，异军突起，用实力说话。特别是他们明白了”真正的内涵在于华人社会的支持”，接受教训不搞小圈子民主，广结善缘，形成一个更加开放的华侨总会，充分利用自己的人脉，大有后来居上的气势。 华人社区告别在一个小圈子里内斗的格局，形成两会竞争的局面未必不是件好事。通过民主的，政治的，商业的竞争，优胜劣汰，最后成就具有充分代表性，名副其实的”总会”，这恐怕是事物发展的自然规律。
92423fe203e5c4ef5478df089dba02915845618c.translatedText: Recently, I saw the announcement of the Mid-Autumn Festival and National Day activities published by the "Arizona Chinese Federation" and the "Arizona Chinese Federation" in newspapers at the same time. Readers who don't know the details will definitely think that they are two activities of the same organization at first glance. Detailed or careful readers will find that the names of the two "confederations" are slightly different, and it seems that they are staging a comedy of "Li Gui vs. Li Kui", which is quite competitive. The advertisement for "Arizona Chinese Federation" is located on the fifth page. There is no picture, it is a quarter of the page, and the text notice is bland. Two organizers, one co-organizer, plus some Inglis. http://sunbirdarizona.com/News-Detail.asp?keyno=1179 (Similar notices on the Internet, newspaper advertisements only have black text and no pictures) The "Arizona Chinese Association" advertisement is located on the third half-page color page and is booming and festive. 10 organizers, all Chinese co-organizers, important officials from the Chinese consulate attended the conference and gave lectures. Domestic overseas Chinese organizations in China sent letters of congratulations, and the momentum was obviously better than the former. http://sunbirdarizona.com/News-Detail.asp?keyno=1188 1. From the “battle between the two directors” to the “battle between the two conferences” Do you still remember the split of the Arizona Chinese Federation that took place in Phoenix this spring? At the beginning of the new year of 2011, judging from the Hualian network communications, it seemed that the Arizona Chinese Federation suddenly split into two factions overnight. Of course, it was not just a simple factional dispute, but an irreconcilable internal strife, or more like a "palace coup." One day in January, someone suddenly announced the formation of a new board of directors and president, so the Hualien Federation of Asia split into two overnight: two presidents and two boards of directors. Many people were very sad to see the split in the Chinese society and took the initiative to mediate. After months of failed attempts by enthusiasts to reconcile, the divided parties finally went to court, ultimately ending the months-long dispute with the "party that initiated the coup" losing the case and withdrawing from the Arizona Chinese Federation. On the surface, the Chinese community has returned to its former peace. However, the tree is still but the wind is not stopping. The losing party in the last dispute did not admit defeat, but regrouped and made a comeback. The newly registered "Arizona Chinese Association", although there is only a two-letter difference from the original board name, strives to appear in front of the Chinese community with a new look and overwhelm the former in terms of momentum. It seems a bit ridiculous that the two "Associations" appeared in Phoenix City at the same time, but it makes sense. At the beginning of the year, a "palace coup" broke out in the Arizona Overseas Chinese Federation; the author wrote in the article "The Crisis and Turnaround of the Arizona Chinese Federation": "Those who win the hearts of the people win the world: The Arizona Chinese Federation is just a name, and registering another Asian Chinese Federation is just a matter of procedure. Its true content is It lies in the support of the Chinese community. Only with the support of the Chinese community can we get the support and sponsorship of the Chinese Consulate. Presumably, the Chinese Consulate will not support an unpopular organization or individual. Otherwise, it will be nothing but a name." The losing party suddenly withdrew when the legal battle over the legitimacy of the two original Hualian boards of directors was in full swing. Apparently, they finally realized: the Alberta Hualian Association is just a name, so there is no need to register another one. So the Arizona Chinese Federation, which has almost the same name as the Arizona Chinese Federation, came into being soon. This association is not that association. It doesn't matter whether it is orthodox or not. This is a great move. Since the two "general associations" are just the names of societies, it is reasonable for the two general associations to exist at the same time. Days have passed and stars have changed. A few months ago, the "new director" and the "old director" were incompatible with each other and the "war between the two directors" fighting for power has evolved into a "battle between the two associations" in which fraternal organizations compete for strength. In a democratic society, this seems to be in line with the laws of competition in a democratic society. As for whom the Chinese Consulate will give face to, it depends on who is more like the "General Assembly". To be fair, both federations are self-proclaimed federations run by small groups. They lack a real public opinion foundation. They were born one after the other. They are like brothers. The Hualian General Association, which considers itself orthodox, ignored the demands of the community to "rectify its name or identity" at the beginning of the split, and returned to small-circle democracy. It lost the opportunity, and also lost the title of the general association in the true sense. It missed the historical opportunity of "crisis is the turning point", making the new general association on par with the old general association as soon as it was born. The new General Association seems to have realized the true meaning of getting up wherever it fell, and organized a more broadly representative Arizona Overseas Chinese Association, which suddenly emerged as a new force and let its strength speak for itself. In particular, they understood that "the real meaning lies in the support of the Chinese community", accepted the lesson and did not engage in small-circle democracy, and formed good relationships to form a more open Overseas Chinese Association. They made full use of their own connections and had the momentum to catch up from behind. It is not necessarily a good thing for the Chinese community to bid farewell to the pattern of infighting within a small circle and form a situation of competition between the two associations. Through democratic, political, and commercial competition, the survival of the fittest will eventually lead to a fully representative and veritable "General Assembly". This is probably the natural law of the development of things.

a01b25bf3e0da8028375aae18ba3122e1a8da22b.sourceText: 2. 名不正，则言不顺 中国人骨子里有着道统的观念，讲究的是一个名正言顺。然而，”亚利桑那华联总会”本身就是一个小圈子运作自封的总会，是一个天生的畸形儿，尽管成立以来为社区做过不少的工作，也逐步为越来越多的人认可，但是从来没有改变”亚利桑那华联总会”是强加在亚利桑那华人社区头上的事实。直到数月前总会发生内斗，许多人才知道我们被代表了。同样”亚利桑那华人华侨总会”，再一次，从一诞生就自封为总会似乎有点滑稽，给人一种现在人们个个都大言不惭的感觉。无奈间我们只能说今天同时出现的两个总会都面临”正名或者正身”的问题。
a01b25bf3e0da8028375aae18ba3122e1a8da22b.translatedText: 2. If the name is not correct, the words will not be correct. Chinese people have orthodox concepts in their bones, and they pay attention to a correct name and correct words. However, the "Arizona Chinese Federation" itself is a self-proclaimed federation run by a small circle. It is a natural deformity. Although it has done a lot of work for the community since its establishment and has gradually been recognized by more and more people, it has never changed the fact that the "Arizona Chinese Federation" is imposed on the Chinese community in Arizona. Many people didn’t know we were represented until a few months ago when there was always infighting. The same goes for the "Arizona Chinese Overseas Chinese Association". Once again, it seems a bit funny to call itself the association from the moment it was born, giving people the feeling that everyone is talking out loud now. We have no choice but to say that the two associations that appeared at the same time today are both facing the problem of "rectifying their names or rectifying their identities."

3a13610d213259b8c40def5ef4c4715941dd755b.sourceText: 3. 亚省华侨总会需要正名或者正身 旧话重提，数月前当很多华人看到亚省华联总会分裂的消息时都非常气愤，大家之所以气愤是因为”亚利桑那华人华侨联合总会”的头衔强加在我们亚利桑那华人头上，华联分裂以及随之而来的类似文革大字报，匿名谩骂攻击之类的丑陋文化开始在华人舆论圈里死灰复燃，这如同向我们华人社区泼了一盆污水。许多有正义感和荣誉感的人站了出来，试图帮助恢复社区的秩序。 也有一些人认为你们愿意内斗，斗去，但是请你们把名字改了，不要冠以华人总会侮辱我们大家，这叫”正名”。 不改名字也可以，”亚利桑那华人华侨联合总会”从组织结构上就必须改良成具有广泛代表性，联合华人社团，为全亚利桑那华人服务的，机制健全的民主社团，这就是所谓”正身”。 事实证明，如果不能脱胎换骨地改变自己，”亚利桑那华人华侨联合总会”永远只是个名字而已。 为此，笔者曾在不同场合和书面提出建议。华联脱胎换骨的核心就是要十分重视代表性问题，重视”总会”的实质意义。以开放的心态面向所有华人华侨社团，学生会，协会，商会，同学会，同乡会等等，把大家的智慧和能量汇集到华联总会，共同建设团结的，能真正代表华人利益，联合华人社团的，替华人发出强大声音的社区组织。
3a13610d213259b8c40def5ef4c4715941dd755b.translatedText: 3. The Overseas Chinese Federation of Alberta needs to correct its name or identity To reiterate, a few months ago many Chinese people were very angry when they saw the news of the split of the Overseas Chinese Federation of Arizona. The reason why everyone was angry was because the title of "Arizona Chinese Federation" was imposed on us Arizona Chinese. The split of the Chinese Federation and the accompanying ugly culture such as Cultural Revolution big-character posters and anonymous verbal attacks began to resurface in the Chinese public opinion circle. It was like pouring a basin of sewage into our Chinese community. Many people with a sense of justice and honor stepped forward to try to help restore order to the community. There are also some people who think that you are willing to fight among yourself, so go ahead, but please change the name. Don't call it Chinese, which will always insult us all. This is called "correcting the name." Even if the name is not changed, the "Arizona Chinese Federation" must be improved in terms of organizational structure into a democratic association with a sound mechanism that is broadly representative, unites Chinese associations, and serves all Chinese in Arizona. This is the so-called "Zhengsheng". Facts have proved that if we cannot completely change ourselves, the "Arizona Chinese Federation" will always be just a name. To this end, the author has made suggestions on different occasions and in writing. The core of Hualian's rebirth is to attach great importance to the issue of representation and the substantive significance of the "General Conference". With an open mind, we should face all overseas Chinese societies, student unions, associations, chambers of commerce, classmate associations, hometown associations, etc., and bring everyone's wisdom and energy to the Hualian Association to jointly build a united community organization that can truly represent the interests of the Chinese, unite Chinese societies, and make a strong voice for the Chinese.

3a172d2ab6e3f22edf6f2674d5611d9298ea9ef7.sourceText: 4. 华人社会应该在公平竞争的基础上团结起来，发挥我们关键少数的作用 中华民族是世界上最大的民族，一个大的民族一定要有自己的想法，在世界上发挥自己的影响力。虽然我们只占到美国人口的很小一部分，但是我们不能自己把自己边缘化了，团结起来就能在地方政治中起到关键少数的作用，为华人争取更多的利益。 两会和其他华人社团切不可满足于一年办一两次活动，几十个人的小圈子民主的旧模式。两会竞争重新开始，双方应该有更大的格局，更远大的目标，给外人一个耳目一新的气象。通过自身机制的不断完善，带动整个华人社会的团结统一，为华人在美国社会发出更大的声音，向世人传播博大精深的中华文明。
3a172d2ab6e3f22edf6f2674d5611d9298ea9ef7.translatedText: 4. The Chinese community should unite on the basis of fair competition and play the role of our key minority. The Chinese nation is the largest nation in the world. A large nation must have its own ideas and exert its own influence in the world. Although we only account for a small part of the American population, we cannot marginalize ourselves. Together we can play a key minority role in local politics and strive for more benefits for the Chinese. The Two Sessions and other Chinese associations must not be satisfied with the old model of holding one or two events a year and holding a few dozen people in a small circle of democracy. The competition between the two sessions has restarted. Both sides should have a bigger picture and more ambitious goals, giving outsiders a refreshing look. Through the continuous improvement of its own mechanisms, it will promote the unity and unity of the entire Chinese society, give the Chinese a greater voice in American society, and spread the broad and profound Chinese civilization to the world.
