348de912084682634e2897ff1a73616065a856db.sourceText: 经过四个月的努力，保护凤凰城中国文化中心进入一个最后角逐的阶段。True North以为屋顶改建禁止令解除，华人社区就会放弃。老四川将拿出巨额保证金，将保护中国文化中心进行到底。社区的已经有7位朋友，每人拿出一万美金支援法律诉讼，我们的多个诉讼任重道远，希望每一个朋友都不忘初衷，我们要保护华人的海外文化财富，保护中国文化中心。我们华人圈早早就看到中国文化中心两次交易的不寻常的价格，不寻常的程序。然而，经过四个多月的呼吁，美国主流媒体也闻到了不寻常的味道。
348de912084682634e2897ff1a73616065a856db.translatedText: After four months of hard work, the protection of the Chinese Cultural Center in Phoenix has entered a final stage of competition. True North thought the Chinese community would give up if the ban on roof modifications was lifted. Old Sichuan will put up a huge deposit to protect the Chinese Cultural Center to the end. There are already 7 friends in the community, each of whom has donated 10,000 US dollars to support the legal proceedings. Our multiple lawsuits have a long way to go. We hope that every friend will not forget the original intention. We must protect the overseas cultural wealth of the Chinese and protect the Chinese cultural center. We in the Chinese community have long seen the unusual prices and unusual procedures of the two transactions of the China Cultural Center. However, after more than four months of appeals, the mainstream media in the United States also smelled something unusual.

2368b0270627045746fc8175e87cab09117bb506.sourceText: 今天（12月13日）下午是本年度凤凰城市政府的最后一次议会，中美华人代表们将再次到听证会上要求，一个额外的就保护中国城的听证。必须把它再次放到政府的会议议程。感谢那些每次都花好几个小时，努力奔走的朋友。
2368b0270627045746fc8175e87cab09117bb506.translatedText: Today (December 13) afternoon is the last meeting of the Phoenix City Government this year. Chinese and American representatives will once again go to the hearing to demand an additional hearing on the protection of Chinatown. It must be put on the government agenda again. Thank you to those friends who spent hours and hard work every time.

f5d61e0d989082bb32274ba833eea6d9dc49b5ba.sourceText: 12月11日，上午10:00点， 联邦法庭应华人宗教信仰自由基金会上周三的紧急TRO听证要求， 举行了基金会，凤凰城市政府和真北公司一案的紧急听证。 法庭首先讨论了是否需要联邦法庭马上发出TRO的问题。 法官表示， 由于上周五老四川一案已经开始上诉和支付保险金的申请， 目前的TRO已经延至本月18日， 为了不和下级法院的判决发生矛盾， 现在不便另外由联邦法庭讨论和发布新的TRO。 三方律师都同意这个观点。我们也需要更多的资金支持，将这个案子继续下去。
f5d61e0d989082bb32274ba833eea6d9dc49b5ba.translatedText: On December 11, at 10:00 a.m., the federal court held an emergency hearing in the case of the Chinese Foundation for Religious Freedom of Religion, the Foundation, the Phoenix City Government, and True North Corporation in response to the emergency TRO hearing request last Wednesday. The court first discussed the issue of whether a federal court is required to issue a TRO immediately. The judge said that since the appeal and application for payment of insurance benefits in the Lao Sichuan case started last Friday, the current TRO has been postponed to the 18th of this month. In order not to conflict with the lower court's judgment, it is not convenient for the federal court to discuss and issue a new TRO at this time. Lawyers from all three parties agree. We also need more financial support to continue this case.

5971fb997aa896f0d591a37b1437ec39f3fa398a.sourceText: 华人在美国以守法，勤劳，朴实而得名。我们带着中华民族几千年的信仰和文化而来。我们努力工作，按时，按量努力交税，为建设美国做出了很大的贡献。每个华人家庭一年都需要交几千，上万的税收，那么如果今年，请你将这份税收，捐助给保护我们的文化遗产，您是否愿意？所有的捐款活动，都可以抵税，我们现在需要将大家的力量集合起来，有钱的出钱，有力的出力，永不放弃！ 捐款链接：https://www.gofundme.com/saving-phoenix-chinatown

8db3dfbaecfb53995792bee260d3fb07ea7435ef.sourceText: 治粤八年南天王——传奇人物陈济棠（上） 余玉书 (六)失先机满盘皆落索（上） 国民党元老胡汉民个性倔强，律己待人都以严厉著名，孙中山逝世后，如非因为人缘欠佳，早已当上了国府主席，几时才输到汪精卫。因此连蒋介石也不放在眼内，二人不咬弦由来已久，一九三一年蒋任国府主席兼行政院长，胡则任立法院长，蒋胡之间为了以下数事各持己见：（一）胡反对任命因协助解决”中原大战”有功的张学良为陆海空军副总司令；（二）胡反对在”训政时期”召开国民大会，制定约法使蒋成为独揽党军政大权于一身的独裁者。 同年二月二十八日蒋在南京总司令部设下鸿门宴，将胡扣留。第二天胡即被逼辞去本兼各职，并遭押送?#27748;山俱乐部?#36719;禁，这就是著名的”汤山事件”，引起了轩然大波。其实国民党内部四分五裂，并非自今日始，除了蒋的”宁派”、汪的”汉派”、李宗仁的”桂系”，还有”西山会议派”厖等，如今各派要员纷纷南下广州，欲团结一致来对付蒋介石，在广州另立国民政府，与南京的中央国民政府分庭抗礼。 这时被蒋任命为东绥靖主任的陈济棠，财雄势大，拥兵十五万，遂有被推为盟主之势。在大会中选出汪精卫、唐绍仪、唐生智、孙科、许崇智、林森、陈济棠、李烈钧、邹鲁、古应芬、邓泽如等十五人为国府委员。陈济棠、李宗仁、唐生智三人更被推为军事委员会的常委。陈的部队组成第一集团军；李的部队组成第二集团军，并准备联络北方的石友三，及福建陈铭枢的十九路军连手攻蒋。 可是陈济棠当初实在有点不愿意担当这个”反蒋大联盟”的”盟长”，因为他心知肚明，无论在个人的声望及党中的地位，自难与胡汉民、汪精卫等元老级人物相较，甚至连许崇智当第二任粤军总司令时，自己只不过是他手下的一名团长，因此实在犯不着出钱出力，甚至赔上身家性命去为人家抬轿。但后再听幕下的智囊们仔细分析；两广唇齿相依，唇亡则齿寒。上回为了”保境安民”，让路给共军过境，已招老蒋之恨，迟早必找自己算账，与其坐以待毙，不如挺身而出，先下手为强，置诸死地而后生，遂以北上抗日为名，反蒋为实，七月广州国民政府颁讨伐令，两广军队遂开始动员北伐。
8db3dfbaecfb53995792bee260d3fb07ea7435ef.translatedText: The Southern King of Guangdong for eight years - the legendary Chen Jitang (Part 1) Yu Yushu (6) Lost the opportunity and lost everything (Part 1) Hu Hanmin, the veteran of the Kuomintang, had a stubborn personality and was famous for being strict with himself and others. After Sun Yat-sen's death, if it were not for his poor popularity, he had already become the chairman of the country, and he was defeated by Wang Jingwei. Therefore, even Chiang Kai-shek did not pay attention to them. The two had been at odds for a long time. In 1931, Chiang was appointed as the President of the State Council and Executive President, while Hu was appointed as the Legislative Yuan. Chiang and Hu held different opinions on the following matters: (1) Hu opposed the appointment of Zhang Xueliang, who was credited with helping to resolve the "Central Plains War", was appointed deputy commander-in-chief of the Army, Navy and Air Force; (2) Hu opposed convening the National Assembly during the "Tutorial Period" and formulated a convention that made Chiang a dictator who monopolized the party, military and political power. On February 28 of the same year, Chiang held a Hongmen Banquet at the Nanjing General Headquarters and detained Hu. The next day, Hu was forced to resign from all his posts and was escorted to the Mountain Club and banned. This became the famous "Tangshan Incident" and caused an uproar. In fact, the Kuomintang is divided into pieces, not just from today. In addition to Chiang's "Ning faction", Wang's "Han faction", Li Zongren's "Gui faction", and "Xishan Conference faction" Pang and others, important officials from various factions are now going south to Guangzhou, hoping to unite to deal with Chiang Kai-shek, and establish a separate National Government in Guangzhou to compete with the Central National Government in Nanjing. At this time, Chen Jitang, who was appointed by Chiang as the director of Eastern Pacification, was very wealthy and powerful, with an army of 150,000, and was expected to be promoted as the leader of the alliance. Fifteen people including Wang Jingwei, Tang Shaoyi, Tang Shengzhi, Sun Ke, Xu Chongzhi, Lin Sen, Chen Jitang, Li Liejun, Zou Lu, Gu Yingfen and Deng Zeru were elected as members of the National Government at the conference. Chen Jitang, Li Zongren, and Tang Shengzhi were even elected as members of the Standing Committee of the Military Commission. Chen's troops formed the First Army; Li's troops formed the Second Army, and prepared to contact Shi Yousan in the north and Chen Mingshu's 19th Route Army in Fujian to jointly attack Chiang. However, Chen Jitang was really reluctant to serve as the "leader" of this "anti-Chiang alliance" because he knew very well that no matter his personal reputation or status in the party, he could not compare with veteran figures such as Hu Hanmin and Wang Jingwei. Even when Xu Chongzhi was the second commander-in-chief of the Guangdong Army, he was just a regimental commander under him. But later I listened to the careful analysis by the think tanks behind the curtain; Guangdong and Guangxi are closely related to each other, and if their lips die, their teeth will be cold. The last time, in order to "protect the territory and the people", he made way for the Communist troops to cross the border, which had incurred the hatred of Chiang Kai-shek. Sooner or later, he would have to settle the score with himself. Rather than sit back and wait for death, it was better to step forward and strike first, risking death and survive later. So in the name of going north to fight against Japan, in reality, he fought against Chiang. In July, the Guangzhou National Government issued a crusade order, and the Guangdong and Guangxi armies began to mobilize for the Northern Expedition.

da68770eef462f52019aa964ab6c3d31717353b8.sourceText: 第二次世界大战中日本军队在中国南京犯下的大规模屠杀，强奸，纵火，抢劫等战争罪行，在中国人的心里留下永远的痛。从1937年12月13日开始的六个星期，有近30万的中国平民和士兵被日军的枪弹和屠刀夺去了鲜活的生命。约2万多中国妇女被形同野兽般的日本军人所奸淫。宏伟美丽的南京城深陷入大火之中，三分之一的城市被纵火焚烧而化为灰烬。一幕幕触目惊心，诸多事灭绝人伦。30万这个数字，已被定格为日本军国主义在战争中对中国人民造成深切苦难的象征。 日本极右翼分子却无视历史的现实，否认南京大屠杀的存在，他们把正义凛然的东京审判看成是强加给日本的”东京审判史观”。把中方对于这一数字的强调，看成是”中国式的夸张”，是中国对日本施加政治压力的一张历史牌。他们的狂吠，已失去了人性的基准。 富有良知的日本人坦然承认日本军国主义的丑行。著名学者竺原十九司教授写下了《侵略亚洲的日本军人》;洞富雄教授也写下了《南京事件和史料批判》，《驳南京大屠杀是所谓’无稽之谈’》，《南京大屠杀》等专著。藤原彰等也承认在南京大屠杀中遇害的中国人在十数万及二十万人以上。日本军人和随军记者也记叙下当时事件的发生。这许多人的研究和记述，给了那些极右翼分子一记记响亮的耳光。 田中隆吉在《被割断的历史。战败秘话》中回忆：”当时在朝香宫指挥下的’上海派遣军’任情报主任的长勇中佐（后调任第７４联队长，晋升大佐）对我夸口说，是他擅用军司令官的名义下令屠杀俘虏。由于在杭州湾登陆的柳川兵团推进神速，大约有３０万中国兵被切断了后路，他们丢下武器，向我投降。要处理这么多的俘虏，粮食方面是个最大的问题。我立即擅自向所属各部队发出命令，应全部杀掉这些俘虏。我用军司令官的名义，通过无线电传达了这项命令。命令的全文当即烧毁。由于这一命令，大屠杀开始了。”优待俘虏是国际作战的惯例，可日军竟这么毫无人性，的确令人发指。他们大量屠杀手无寸铁的平民百姓更是引起人们的愤恨！ 十六师团炮兵观察班长泽田正久证言”俘虏数目一万左右，遂报告军司令官，司令官命令立即予以抢决”。十六师团长中岛今朝吾也证实”大体上不保留俘虏，全部处理之。”于是出现了第六师团辎重第六联队长在日记中记载的”尸体象漂流着的木头被浪冲了过来，在岸边，重叠地堆积着的尸体一望无际，这些尸体可能有几千，几万，数目大的很。”《朝日新闻》记者今井正刚在他的文章中也写道：”整个码头是一座黑黝黝的尸山，有５０个或许１００个人影在其间来回走动。他们在往江里拖尸体，痛苦呻吟。流淌的鲜血，痉挛的肢体，再加上哑剧般的寂静。对岸隐约可见就象月光下的泥泞一样，整个码头在微微的闪光，那是血。不久，结束了作业的苦力们被迫朝着江岸站成一行。’哒，哒，哒―――’，随着机枪的声音，仰身，倒下，就象跳舞似的， 这一伙人落入江中。结束了—–，约有俩万人，一个军官说。宫崎县一位士兵曾记录：”杀一个支那人，在我们就如杀一只猫或狗一样”。曾根一夫说”’三光’作战，即对敌人不分军民全部的杀光—–”。据1946年2月中国南京军事法庭查证：日军大屠杀28案，19万人；零散屠杀858案，15万人。日军在南京进行了长达六个星期的大屠杀，中国被抢杀和活埋者达30万人。 最为令人发指地是我们听说过足球比赛，田径比赛，可从来没有听说过杀人比赛。而这一幕也就出现在南京大屠杀中。1937年12月13日《东京日日新闻》以”杀人斩的超记录”报道了”日军少尉向井敏明和野田毅在进军南京途中相约’杀人比赛’，商定在占领南京时，先杀满100人者为胜。从句容到汤山，两人分别杀了89人和77人，到南京紫金山下时，两人各称杀了106人和105人，但是不知道谁先杀满100人，所以决定这场比赛不分胜负，重新比赛，看谁先杀满150名中国人——”。以杀人为荣，这已不是军人，简直是衣冠禽兽。当然他们最后也得到了应有的下场。
da68770eef462f52019aa964ab6c3d31717353b8.translatedText: The large-scale massacre, rape, arson, robbery and other war crimes committed by the Japanese army in Nanjing, China during World War II have left eternal pain in the hearts of the Chinese people. In the six weeks starting on December 13, 1937, nearly 300,000 Chinese civilians and soldiers were killed by Japanese bullets and butcher knives. Approximately 20,000 Chinese women were raped by Japanese soldiers who were like beasts. The magnificent and beautiful city of Nanjing was deeply engulfed in fire, and one-third of the city was set on fire and reduced to ashes. The scenes are shocking and many things are inhumane. The number 300,000 has been fixed as a symbol of the deep suffering caused by Japanese militarism to the Chinese people during the war. Japan's far-right elements ignore the reality of history and deny the existence of the Nanjing Massacre. They regard the just and awe-inspiring Tokyo Trial as a "Tokyo Trial view of history" imposed on Japan. Consider China's emphasis on this number as "Chinese-style exaggeration" and a historical card used by China to exert political pressure on Japan. Their barking has lost the basis of humanity. The conscientious Japanese frankly admit the scandal of Japanese militarism. The famous scholar Professor Zhuhara Jujiji wrote "Japanese Soldiers Invading Asia"; Professor Tomio Azuma also wrote "Nanjing Incident and Criticism of Historical Data", "Refutation of the Nanjing Massacre as 'Nonsense'", "Nanjing Massacre" and other monographs. Akira Fujiwara and others also admitted that the number of Chinese killed in the Nanjing Massacre was between 100,000 and 200,000. Japanese soldiers and reporters accompanying the army also described what happened at that time. The research and accounts of many people have given those far-right elements a resounding slap in the face. Tanaka Takayoshi in "History Severed." "Secret Words of Defeat" recalled: "At that time, Lieutenant Colonel Nagayong, who was the intelligence director of the "Shanghai Expeditionary Force" under the command of Asaka Palace (later transferred to the captain of the 74th Regiment and promoted to colonel), boasted to me that he was the one who ordered the massacre of prisoners in the name of the army commander. Due to the rapid advance of the Yanagawa Corps that landed at Hangzhou Bay, about 300,000 Chinese soldiers were cut off. They dropped their weapons and surrendered to me. Important points To deal with so many prisoners, food was the biggest problem. I immediately issued an order to all the troops under my command to kill all the prisoners. In the name of the army commander, I conveyed the order through the radio. The massacre began because of this order, but it was outrageous that the Japanese army was so inhumane. They massacred unarmed civilians in large numbers, which aroused people's resentment! Sawada Masahisa, the artillery observation squad leader of the 16th Division, testified that "the number of prisoners was about 10,000, so he reported it to the army commander, who ordered an immediate execution." The commander of the 16th Division, Nakajima Imago, also confirmed that "generally no prisoners are kept, and all are dealt with." Then it appeared that the captain of the 6th Brigade of the 6th Division recorded in his diary that "the corpses were washed up like drifting logs by the waves and were washed up on the shore. As far as the eye can see, there are piles of corpses piled up on top of each other. These corpses may number in the thousands or tens of thousands, and the number is very large." "Asahi Shimbun" reporter Masago Imai also wrote in his article: "The entire dock is a dark mountain of corpses. , there were 50 or 100 figures walking back and forth. They were dragging corpses into the river, groaning in pain, and the pantomime silence on the other side was like mud under the moonlight. Likewise, the whole dock was flashing slightly, it was blood. Soon, the coolies who had finished their work were forced to stand in a line towards the river bank, "ta, da, da -", leaning up and falling down, as if dancing, with the sound of machine guns. The group fell into the river. It ended with about 20,000 people. A soldier from Miyazaki Prefecture once recorded: "Killing a Chinese is like killing a cat or a dog." "Light -". According to the verification of the Nanjing Military Tribunal in February 1946: 28 massacres by the Japanese army, involving 190,000 people; 858 scattered massacres, involving 150,000 people. The Japanese army carried out a massacre in Nanjing for six weeks, and 300,000 Chinese people were robbed, killed and buried alive. The most outrageous thing is that we have heard of football matches and track and field competitions, but we have never heard of murderous competitions. And this scene also appeared in the Nanjing Massacre. On December 13, 1937, "Tokyo Nichichino Shimbun" reported with "Super Record of Killings" that "Japanese second lieutenants Toshiaki Mukai and Takeshi Noda met for a "murderous competition" on the way to Nanjing, and agreed that the first person to kill 100 people during the occupation of Nanjing would win. From Jurong to Tangshan, the two men killed 89 and 77 people respectively. When they arrived at the foot of the Purple Mountain in Nanjing, they each claimed to have killed 106 and 105 people. However, they did not know who would kill 100 people first, so it was decided that the game would be indiscriminate and rematch to see who could kill 150 Chinese first - ". Taking pride in killing is no longer a soldier, but a beast in uniform. Of course, they finally got the end they deserved.

6e055835a420e9885bde2c239dea2d2e35ba5304.sourceText: 历史的警钟还在长鸣，日本军国主义已在借尸还魂。他们依然想当亚洲乃至世界的老大。并已开始推行自己的军国主义，不仅在”北方四岛”，”独岛”问题上狂吠不已，而且霸占中国的固有领土棗钓鱼岛。尽管五十年前，他们国家自己的地图上也没有这个地方。这些右翼势力就是要以此为契机，张牙舞爪，借”中国威胁论”扩张自己的军力，把自卫队变成侵略军，甚至狂吠”与中国不惜一战”。日本自卫队最高干部部统合幕僚长岩崎茂，近日下达了一项特别指示，要求自卫队海陆空尽快制定一份”应对作战计划”。贼子狼心已跃然纸上。难道我们会让”九一八”事件再次出现，难道我们还想再次听到卢沟桥的抢声，难道我们还要再忍受八年抗战的悲痛。不！决不！今日的中国已不是昔日的”东亚病夫”，她有着坚硬的脊梁。我们爱和平，但也决不再容忍别人的欺辱。我们拭目以待，决不掉以轻心。在”九一八”纪念日即将到来之际，让我们不忘历史，警钟常鸣！
6e055835a420e9885bde2c239dea2d2e35ba5304.translatedText: The alarm bells of history are still ringing, and Japanese militarism is resurrecting itself. They still want to be the boss of Asia and the world. And it has begun to implement its own militarism, not only barking on the "Four Northern Islands" and "Dokdo" issues, but also occupying China's inherent territory, the Diaoyu Islands. Even though this place was not on their country's own map fifty years ago. These right-wing forces will take this as an opportunity to spread their teeth and use the "China threat theory" to expand their military power, turn the Self-Defense Forces into an invasion force, and even bark that they will not hesitate to fight China. Shigeru Iwasaki, chief of staff of the Japan Self-Defense Forces’ highest cadre department, recently issued a special instruction requiring the Self-Defense Forces’ sea, land and air forces to formulate a “response operation plan” as soon as possible. The thief's wolf heart is already on the page. Do we want to let the September 18th incident happen again? Do we want to hear the scramble for Marco Polo Bridge again? Do we have to endure the sorrow of the Anti-Japanese War for another eight years? No! never! Today's China is no longer the "sick man of East Asia" of the past. It has a strong backbone. We love peace, but we will never tolerate bullying from others. We will wait and see and never take it lightly. As the anniversary of September 18th is approaching, let us not forget history and keep the alarm bell ringing!

b10d12456eac3ff495610fbd299efc21363461c5.translatedText: Tempe has become a hot spot for real estate development in Phoenix. A high-end community called "SALT" has begun construction on the shores of Lake Tempe. The project includes 256 apartments, two swimming pools with pavilions, yoga lawn, and spa. The entire project will be completed early next year. Developed by a well-known San Diego developer, this 6-block mixed-use residential project also includes one- to three-bedroom apartments. Tempe has become the hottest location for real estate development in the greater Phoenix area. Earlier, we have introduced that the USA Basketball headquarters will be moved to Tempe, and a 330-square-acre area integrating sports, commerce, and residence is under construction - USA Place. The project cost $436 million. The long-unused corner of Mill Road is set to become a city highlight. USA Place is expected to bring in 350,000 visitors annually. Just north of ASU's Sun Devil Stadium, the $600 million Marina Heights project will house 8,000 State Farm employees. The condominiums "SALT" are just one part of the Lakeside mixed-use project, which will also include two townhouse communities on Sixth Street. By then, 24 new homes will be built, and a further 38 homes will be built east of Weber Road and Scottsdale Road. For more real estate information, please contact Tinna Xie (480)287-0180 Tinna@platinumaz.com

a08094d112825f2a4882e977ed78aa01cda065ed.sourceText: 凤凰城气如虹：洛矶山漫游之一洛矶山印象 我来美十五年，有空闲有条件就经常去旅游，但很少到毗邻美国的国家观光，曾经一次越过亚利桑那边境的墨西哥城市，而另一边的加拿大从未踏入其国土，那里几个 著名的城市，如温哥华、卡加利、多伦多、满地可厖都有亲友居住，由于畏惧天气寒冷，没有计划旅游。 今年中秋过后，我一反常态，与太座参加了洛矶山七日游。 这次成行，与农历八月有关，对于我的家庭来说，每年农历八月是喜气盈门的美好月份，上旬是我女儿的生日，中旬是太座的寿辰，下旬则是我夫妇结婚纪念日 。 际此良辰佳月，儿女们觉得接二连三的设宴庆祝，倒不如出外旅游，浏览世界风景较为有意义，趁住身体还健康，行走方便，旅行游乐，见识世界乐土；探亲访友 ，重逢话旧，乐在其中。 再过数年，老态龙钟，力不从心，欲去也不能。 太座认为是好主意，当再次听到儿子国兴提议去加拿大旅游，就兴致勃勃，终于促成这次洛矶山行程。 我决定选择黄金假期的旅行节目：​​加拿大洛矶山七日游，可以在西雅图进出，也可以在温哥华进出，我就买机票到西雅图，旅游回来逗留三天，探访许久没有见面的老同学、老朋友 。 我原先计划登记十月七日出发的，可以参加耆英会的庆生宴会后才起程，旅行社却通知，由于天气转寒，许多地方冰封不能旅游，十月三日已是最后一团了 。 既然这样，惟有遵从，否则，要等待明年五六月，世界又不知是有什么转变。 这次旅游洛矶山，让我真正见识巍峨高山，雄壮伟大，峰峦起伏，摄人心魄！ 我在越南，去过西宁黑婆山，朱笃禁山，大勒山城，北部沙巴山区，经过南北越相连的长山，也去过中国广东、苏杭部份名山大川，当时在那些地方，惊奇 赞叹不已，但是与洛矶山脉相比，简直是小巫见大巫。 我们的旅行团由西雅图出发，上午在机场接载各地飞来的圑员，有来自台湾、中国大陆、美国各州的华人，其中两对越南夫妇，导游谢先生采用英语和国语讲述，司机华哥 是旅居加拿大的广东人。 旅行车首先载我们到西雅图唐人街用午餐，然后游览市区景点，当晚抵达温哥华，住宿机场海岸旅馆，第二天再增加几个来自台湾的游客，一对印度夫妇，展开洛矶山的漫游。 只见温哥华的城市被高山围绕，也形成湖泊特多，处处山水相逢，令人大开眼界。 在这里兜兜转转到各处观光，真正进入洛矶山脉漫游是第四天，果然不同凡响，别具风格。 哗！ 洛矶山脉（Rocky Mountains）峰峦起伏，高耸入云，顶端皑皑白雪，山壁石块坚挺，一带峭壁巉崖嶙峋突兀，形势奇异，雄伟壮观。 喜欢拍摄的游客，忙个不停，摄的摄，录的录，卡擦声陪衬闪光灯，此起彼落，我认为这样好像是忙碌工作，不算享受，我只喜欢专注地观察欣赏，尽情 探索眼前的美景。 据说，洛矶山的位置在北美洲西部，山脉起伏延长，连绵将近五千公里，一般定义为从加拿大的里阿德河到美国新墨西哥州的格兰德河，南北两端再延伸只能是属于 美洲山地的一部分，不再属于洛矶山脉，加拿大境内最高峰叫罗布峰。 我们旅行团在第五天抵达哥伦比亚大冰原，是最寒冷冰冻的最高冰河，乘巨轮雪车蜿蜒上进二千多公尺高的冰天雪地河川，置身万年冰河境界，我生平第一次尝试踏足 冰雪河床，第一次被冰雪环绕着。 洛矶山脉终年积雪，融化流下成为河流和湖泊的水源，所以湖泊河流特别多，形成不同色泽的美景，也是人们旅游参观的目标。 而之冰雪融化的淡水流量，占美加两国很大部份的供应使用，从洛矶山脉发源的河流很多，全部从不同的方向流入三个大洋：太平洋、大西洋和北冰洋。 我们除了欣赏洛矶山的雄伟磅礡气势，随着旅行车沿着的公路川走，看见两旁都是受国家保护的野生动物公园，有铁丝网围绕在路旁，防止野兽冲出街外，这里狗熊特 多，竖立牌子提醒人们留意。 为了让野生动物互相往来，当地政府还在公路上分段架设天桥，照顾周到，加拿大的野兽真正有福气；想到有些人民生活困苦，贫病交迫，政府不曾适当地料理，民怨日深，对比 之下，人不如兽，真是一大讽刺。 这次洛矶山七日游，给我留下难忘印象，也引起无限感慨！
a08094d112825f2a4882e977ed78aa01cda065ed.translatedText: The Phoenix City is like a rainbow: Rocky Mountain Travels Part 1: Rocky Mountain Impressions. I have been in the United States for fifteen years. I often travel when I have free time and conditions, but rarely visit countries adjacent to the United States. I once crossed the Mexican city on the Arizona border, but Canada on the other side has never set foot in its territory. I have relatives and friends living in several famous cities there, such as Vancouver, Calgary, Toronto, and Montreal. I have no plans to travel because I am afraid of the cold weather. After the Mid-Autumn Festival this year, I went against the norm and took a seven-day trip to the Rocky Mountains with Taizu. This trip is related to the eighth month of the lunar calendar. For my family, August of the lunar calendar is a wonderful month filled with joy. The first ten days of the month are my daughter’s birthday, the middle ten days are Taizu’s birthday, and the last ten days are my couple’s wedding anniversary. On this good day and month, the children feel that instead of having a series of banquets to celebrate, it is more meaningful to travel and browse the world's scenery. While they are still healthy and walking easily, they can travel and have fun, see the paradise of the world; visit relatives and friends, catch up with each other and have fun in it. In a few years, he will be senile, unable to do what he wants, and unable to leave even if he wants to. Taizu thought it was a good idea. When he heard his son Guoxing's proposal to travel to Canada again, he became very interested and finally made the trip to the Rocky Mountains possible. I decided to choose the travel program of the golden holiday: a seven-day tour of the Canadian Rockies, which can be entered and exited in Seattle or Vancouver. I bought a ticket to Seattle and stayed for three days after the trip to visit old classmates and old friends I had not seen for a long time. I originally planned to register for departure on October 7th so that I could attend the birthday party of the Senior Citizens Association before setting off. However, the travel agency informed me that due to the cold weather, many places were frozen and it was impossible to travel. October 3rd was the last day of the trip. In this case, we have no choice but to comply. Otherwise, we will have to wait for May or June next year, and the world will not know how to change. This trip to the Rocky Mountains allowed me to truly see the majestic mountains, their majesty, and the undulating peaks, which are breathtaking! When I was in Vietnam, I visited Hei Po Mountain in Xining, Chau Doc Mountain, Dalat Mountain City, the Sapa Mountains in the north, passed through the Truong Son Mountains connecting North and South Vietnam, and also visited some famous mountains and rivers in Guangdong, Suzhou and Hangzhou in China. At that time, I was amazed and amazed in those places, but compared with the Rocky Mountains, they were nothing compared to the Rocky Mountains. Our tour group departed from Seattle and picked up people from all over the world at the airport in the morning. There were Chinese from Taiwan, mainland China, and various states in the United States, including two Vietnamese couples. The tour guide, Mr. Xie, spoke in English and Mandarin. The driver, Brother Hua, is a Cantonese living in Canada. The tour bus first took us to Seattle's Chinatown for lunch, and then visited the city's attractions. We arrived in Vancouver that night and stayed at the Airport Coast Hotel. The next day, we were joined by a few tourists from Taiwan and an Indian couple, and we began to roam the Rocky Mountains. I saw that the city of Vancouver is surrounded by mountains and has many lakes. Mountains and rivers meet everywhere, which is eye-opening. After wandering around here for sightseeing, it was the fourth day when we really entered the Rocky Mountains and roamed. It was indeed extraordinary and unique. Wow! The Rocky Mountains have undulating peaks, towering into the clouds. The tops are covered with white snow, the mountain walls are solid and rocky, and the cliffs in the area are rugged and abrupt. The situation is strange and majestic. Tourists who like to take pictures are busy non-stop, taking pictures and recording, with the flash lighting flashing, one after another. I think this is like busy work, not enjoyment. I just like to observe and appreciate attentively, and explore the beautiful scenery in front of me. It is said that the Rocky Mountains are located in the western part of North America. The mountains are undulating and extend for nearly 5,000 kilometers. They are generally defined as running from the Riad River in Canada to the Rio Grande River in New Mexico, the United States. The extension to the north and south ends can only be part of the American mountains and no longer belong to the Rocky Mountains. The highest peak in Canada is called Mount Robe. On the fifth day, our tour group arrived at the Columbia Icefield, which is the coldest and highest glacier. We took a giant snowmobile to wind up the ice and snow river more than 2,000 meters high. We were in the realm of thousands of years of glaciers. It was the first time in my life that I tried to set foot on the ice and snow river bed, and was surrounded by ice and snow for the first time. The Rocky Mountains are covered with snow all year round, which melts and flows down to become the water source for rivers and lakes. Therefore, there are many lakes and rivers, forming beautiful scenery of different colors, which is also a tourist destination. The flow of fresh water from melted ice and snow accounts for a large part of the supply in the United States and Canada. There are many rivers originating from the Rocky Mountains, all flowing into three oceans from different directions: the Pacific, Atlantic and Arctic Oceans. In addition to admiring the majesty of the Rocky Mountains, we walked along the highway along the station wagon and saw nationally protected wildlife parks on both sides. There were barbed wire fences surrounding the roads to prevent wild animals from running out of the streets. There were many bears here, and signs were erected to remind people to pay attention. In order to allow wild animals to communicate with each other, the local government has also built overpasses on sections of the highway and taken good care of them. The wild animals in Canada are truly blessed. It is really ironic to think that some people live in poverty and are suffering from poverty and disease. This seven-day trip to the Rocky Mountains left an unforgettable impression on me and aroused endless emotions!

2eddc5c263f55d150c4588e45dd73c8e0188785a.sourceText: 文扬：与英语读者一起解读中国新疆 新疆维吾尔自治区，中国西北部一块面积约为7个英国，或者6个新西兰，或者2个新南威尔士州大小的边疆地区。 因为它地处偏远，经济相对落后，人们在谈论中国时很难直接想到它，以至于很多第一次踏上这块土地的人们，都不由得惊叹中国之大：居然还有这么一大块经常被人遗忘的角落！ 被人们遗忘，主要是因为它长期以来处在中国经济奇迹光环的阴影之下。它远离海岸线，为三座巨大的山脉所分割，气候条件很差，不具备率先进行开发、超前实现起飞的地域优势。 但在另外一种考虑中，即中国的国家安全战略的考虑中，它的受重视程度，却超过了任何其他地区。 打开地图即可看到，新疆有着5600公里长的边境线，与蒙古、俄罗斯、哈萨克斯坦、塔吉克斯坦、吉尔吉斯斯坦、阿富汗、巴基斯坦、印度共八个国家接壤。 而居住在新疆的2千1百多万人口中，共有55个不同民族混居在一起，其中就包括这些邻国的民族。而且有8种宗教共处在一起，其中就包括伊斯兰教、基督教、东正教等这些在中亚各国盛行的宗教。 如何在这样一个幅员辽阔、多民族共处、多宗教并行、边境线绵长、与多个外国接壤的边疆地区实现和平稳定、经济发展和民生改善，这样一个课题，不仅是对于中国政府，即使是放在世界范围内，也是一个具有罕见难度的战略性问题。 虽然从历史讲，中国中央政府对于这片土地的有效管治，一直可以追溯到公元前一百多年的汉武帝时期，但真正在现代国家主权和领土完整这个意义上的国家统治，是从1949年中华人民共和国成立之后开始的。 国共内战结束后，当时进入新疆的中国人民解放军近二十万人就地集体转业，组建新疆军区生产建设兵团，在大沙漠边缘的戈壁荒滩上开垦农田，进行屯垦戍边。 非亲眼所见，外人难以想象这是怎样的一种”开垦”和”建设”。开垦，不是与当地原住民争抢土地，而是在荒无人烟的石头滩上划地为田，从最原始的耕作开始。建设，也没有任何从外地调运的物资和技术支援，而是完全凭军垦战士人拉肩扛，白手起家。 安家落户的所谓”家”，”房子”是在地上挖的地洞，”妻子”是组织上从外地调派来分配给大家的女人，衣服是补丁摞补丁的旧军装，吃的是维持生存最基本的食物。刚刚结束了战争的中国军人，继续以战争的方式转入生产，为后来的建设打下了最初的基础。 这是只有在中国边疆地区才会出现的故事。若对应到英语读者的理解中，就犹如是当年来到新世界的定居者，不是与原住民争抢最好的土地，而是选择无人开垦的偏远荒地；不是依靠从当地获取的财富，而是艰苦奋斗白手起家；在与所有原住民和平共处、相互促进的互利合作中，建设起一片片新的家园、一座座新的城市。 今天的新疆，已经到处都现代化了。当年屯垦戍边的情景，只在博物馆和遗址公园里才能看到了。但新疆生产建设兵团这个中国特色的组织形式仍然持续着，一个城市，也就是一个师，师市合一、政企合一。 用自由民主这两个概念可以解读西方的边疆开拓史，因为征服和掠夺也是自由。但在中国的边疆开拓史上，只有生产建设这两个概念。过去如此，今天也仍然如此。
2eddc5c263f55d150c4588e45dd73c8e0188785a.translatedText: Wen Yang: Interpret China's Xinjiang with English readers The Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region, a border area in northwest China that is about the size of seven United Kingdom, or six New Zealand, or two New South Wales. Because of its remote location and relatively backward economy, it is difficult for people to think of it directly when talking about China. So many people who set foot on this land for the first time can’t help but marvel at how big China is: there is such a large corner that is often forgotten! It has been forgotten mainly because it has long been in the shadow of China's economic miracle. It is far away from the coastline and divided by three huge mountains. It has very poor climate conditions and does not have the geographical advantage to be the first to develop and achieve take-off. But in another consideration, namely, China's national security strategy, it receives more attention than any other region. Open the map and you will see that Xinjiang has a 5,600-kilometer-long border with eight countries: Mongolia, Russia, Kazakhstan, Tajikistan, Kyrgyzstan, Afghanistan, Pakistan, and India. Among the more than 21 million people living in Xinjiang, a total of 55 different ethnic groups live together, including ethnic groups from these neighboring countries. And there are 8 religions coexisting together, including Islam, Christianity, Orthodox Christianity and other religions that are popular in Central Asian countries. How to achieve peace and stability, economic development and improvement of people's livelihood in such a vast border area with multi-ethnic coexistence, multi-religion, long borders and borders with many foreign countries is a strategic issue of rare difficulty not only for the Chinese government, but also for the world. Although historically speaking, the effective management of this land by the Chinese central government can be traced back to the period of Emperor Wu of the Han Dynasty more than 100 years ago, the true national rule in the sense of modern national sovereignty and territorial integrity began after the founding of the People's Republic of China in 1949. After the civil war between the Kuomintang and the Communist Party, nearly 200,000 people from the Chinese People's Liberation Army who entered Xinjiang were collectively transferred to the Xinjiang Military Region and formed the Xinjiang Military Region Production and Construction Corps. They reclaimed farmland on the Gobi desert sands on the edge of the desert and carried out land reclamation and border garrison. Without seeing it with one's own eyes, it is difficult for outsiders to imagine what kind of "reclamation" and "construction" this is. Reclamation is not about competing for land with local aborigines, but about converting land into fields on uninhabited stone beaches, starting with the most primitive farming. The construction did not receive any material or technical support from other places. Instead, it was completely built from scratch by the military reclamation warriors. The so-called "home" where we settle down is a hole dug in the ground. The "wife" is a woman assigned to everyone by the organization from other places. The clothes are old military uniforms with patches on them, and the food is the most basic food for survival. The Chinese soldiers who had just ended the war continued to shift into production in a war-like manner, laying the initial foundation for subsequent construction. This is a story that can only appear in China's border areas. If it corresponds to the understanding of English readers, it is like the settlers who came to the New World. They did not compete with the indigenous people for the best land, but chose remote wastelands that were not cultivated by anyone. Instead of relying on the wealth obtained from the local area, they started from scratch through hard work. They built new homes and new cities in the mutually beneficial cooperation of peaceful coexistence and mutual promotion with all the indigenous people. Today's Xinjiang has been modernized everywhere. The scenes of land reclamation and border garrison in those days can only be seen in museums and heritage parks. However, the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps, an organizational form with Chinese characteristics, still continues. A city, that is, a division, integrates division and city, and integrates government and enterprises. The two concepts of liberal democracy can be used to interpret the history of Western frontier development, because conquest and plunder are also freedoms. But in the history of China's frontier development, there were only two concepts: production and construction. This was true in the past and remains true today.

c968c454587d159b51f42c224281afc759a0a701.sourceText: 快讯 | 真北公司投诉凤凰城中国文化中心网站败诉
c968c454587d159b51f42c224281afc759a0a701.translatedText: News | True North Company lost its lawsuit against the Phoenix Chinese Cultural Center website

f5afe9f995111bd9feda6b1b91987a5c459ea1aa.sourceText: 快讯 | 真北公司投诉凤凰城中国文化中心网站败诉 真北公司在今年八月关闭了网上所有关于凤凰城中粮中国文化中心的…
f5afe9f995111bd9feda6b1b91987a5c459ea1aa.translatedText: News | True North Company lost its lawsuit against the Phoenix Chinese Cultural Center website True North Company closed all online websites and information about the Phoenix COFCO Chinese Cultural Center in August this year...

fe77faacb98a79b1f3318155dcc9fdf239a7e5b9.sourceText: 真北公司在今年八月关闭了网上所有关于凤凰城中粮中国文化中心的网站和消息,妨碍了中心里现有的商家的生意。为了让人们知道文化中心还在运行,商社餐馆还在,同时也是为了挽救文化中心，侨社在今年9月注册了一个网站：https://www.phoenixchineseculturalcenter.com/ 上面是中英文版,收集了所有凤凰城中国文化中心的资料，供所有关心中国文化中心的人参考游览。
fe77faacb98a79b1f3318155dcc9fdf239a7e5b9.translatedText: True North Company closed all online websites and information about the Phoenix COFCO Chinese Cultural Center in August this year, hindering the business of existing merchants in the center. In order to let people know that the cultural center is still running, the businesses and restaurants are still there, and at the same time to save the cultural center, the overseas Chinese community registered a website in September this year: https://www.phoenixchineseculturalcenter.com/ The above is the Chinese and English version, which collects all the information about the Phoenix Chinese Cultural Center for the reference of all those who care about the Chinese Cultural Center.

d065c98c5824246f1efe5410420ccadc70027df1.sourceText: 今年11月,真北公司向美国仲裁委员会对此网站提出抗议,要求法官判决把该网站的所有权转给真北。 法官在看了双方的争辩书以后,判决真北公司的全部三条抗议都不属实。法官判决说:真北公司是在恶意行事，并企图非法扭转的方式来劫持正当的网站 。 法官判定侨社没有错,可以继续拥有和经营此网站。 今天，好多互联网上都报导了此事。 因为这是一个比较新潮的网站所有权案例,很多人非常关心。
d065c98c5824246f1efe5410420ccadc70027df1.translatedText: In November this year, True North filed a protest against this website with the American Arbitration Commission, asking the judge to transfer the ownership of the website to True North. After reading the arguments from both parties, the judge ruled that all three of True North's protests were untrue. The judge ruled: True North acted in bad faith and attempted to hijack legitimate websites in an illegal and reversal manner. The judge determined that the overseas Chinese community was not at fault and could continue to own and operate this website. Today, there are many reports on this matter on the Internet. Because this is a relatively new website ownership case, many people are very concerned about it.

9ba0e7ab00905e7a3d3cb8f5f41a687508476f5d.sourceText: 美国亚利桑那州走私移民法被判无效‏ 11月7日，美国联邦亚利桑那区法庭发出判决称，亚利桑那州的走私移民法同…
9ba0e7ab00905e7a3d3cb8f5f41a687508476f5d.translatedText: Arizona's immigration smuggling law was ruled invalid‏ On November 7, the U.S. Federal District Court of Arizona issued a ruling stating that Arizona's immigration smuggling law is the same as...

8f522b78666bb65f95c25e23579dce12e6362acd.sourceText: 11月7日，美国联邦亚利桑那区法庭发出判决称，亚利桑那州的走私移民法同联邦政府在移民问题上的权威相冲突，因此无效。
8f522b78666bb65f95c25e23579dce12e6362acd.translatedText: On November 7, the U.S. Federal District Court of Arizona issued a ruling that Arizona's immigration smuggling law conflicts with the federal government's authority on immigration issues and is therefore invalid.

3fb0bdaeb32d0373bb180b3b396974e74c4e33aa.sourceText: 《洛杉矶时报》报导说，亚利桑那州2005年通过的走私移民法规定，那些将非法移民走私进该州的人将受到起诉。随后，该法律被纳入2010年通过的亚利桑那州SB 1070法桉，是美国历史上最广泛、最严格的反非法移民法桉之一。 联邦法官博尔顿（Susan Bolton）在判决中称，同联邦法律相比，该州的走私移民法附加了更多以及不同的州级刑罚；该法剥夺了联邦政府在处理走私犯罪上的绝对权威；该法对不违反联邦法律的行为定罪，并且没有包含联邦法律中的”避风港”条款，豁免宗教行为。
3fb0bdaeb32d0373bb180b3b396974e74c4e33aa.translatedText: The Los Angeles Times reported that Arizona’s immigration smuggling law passed in 2005 stipulates that those who smuggle illegal immigrants into the state will be prosecuted. The law was subsequently incorporated into Arizona's SB 1070, passed in 2010, which is one of the broadest and strictest anti-illegal immigration laws in U.S. history. Federal Judge Susan Bolton said in her ruling that the state's immigration smuggling law imposes more and different state-level penalties than federal law; the law deprives the federal government of its absolute authority in dealing with smuggling crimes; the law criminalizes conduct that does not violate federal law and does not include the "safe harbor" provision in federal law that exempts religious behavior.

f2eb20955286f15338d4e33cc5e8e8537c154bd4.sourceText: 此前，美国第9巡回法庭判决另一项亚利桑那州的移民法无效。该法律规定，窝藏、运送和隐蔽非法移民在亚利桑那州属于犯罪。
f2eb20955286f15338d4e33cc5e8e8537c154bd4.translatedText: Previously, the 9th U.S. Circuit Court ruled that another Arizona immigration law was invalid. The law makes it a crime in Arizona to harbor, transport and conceal illegal immigrants.

d21549666e41a39be2b956dcbd6f467ab3825b83.sourceText: 博尔顿还判决SB 1070法桉的核心部分无效。原条款允许亚利桑那州逮捕那些非法进入美国或者未携带合法文件而找工作的人。
d21549666e41a39be2b956dcbd6f467ab3825b83.translatedText: Bolton also ruled that the core part of the SB 1070 law was invalid. The original provision allowed Arizona to arrest people who entered the country illegally or were looking for work without legal documents.

e856cbc49b34eff3b5b81f8337010d214504cd7a.sourceText: 2012年，美国最高法院曾判决SB 1070法桉的部分条款违宪，但允许亚利桑那州授权警察检查那些他们怀疑是非法移民的移民身份。
e856cbc49b34eff3b5b81f8337010d214504cd7a.translatedText: In 2012, the U.S. Supreme Court ruled that some provisions of SB 1070 were unconstitutional, but allowed Arizona to authorize police to check the immigration status of those they suspected to be illegal immigrants.

9abbf5b21b9ffdfb40f190aa7a3d1d2905c9ccf9.sourceText: 2013年，联邦法官曾判决玛莉科巴县警长阿佩约（Joe Arpaio）在交通检查和搜查非法移民时违反了拉丁裔的宪法权利。阿佩约强烈支持亚利桑那州在移民问题上的强硬立场。
9abbf5b21b9ffdfb40f190aa7a3d1d2905c9ccf9.translatedText: In 2013, a federal judge ruled that Maricopa County Sheriff Joe Arpaio violated the constitutional rights of Latinos during traffic checks and searches of illegal immigrants. Arpaio strongly supports Arizona's tough stance on immigration.

d245102ce32c62ab12731d055550ced166fa80ba.sourceText: 您想提升孩子的语言表达能力吗? 您想增强孩子的自信心吗? 您希望孩子拥有更开朗的性格吗? 朗诵表演与演讲是诸多艺术中与儿童的中文学习、语言表达能力结合最紧密的艺术项目。从小通过掌握朗诵表演的技能技巧，不仅能提高语言表达能力，还能克服当众表达的胆怯心理、增强自信心、具备出众的口才能力，为今后的奋斗，创造成功的捷径! 课程介绍：朗诵和演讲就像唱歌、跳舞一样，是一种人们喜闻乐见的艺术才能。本课程的教学目的是让你的孩子学会通过自己的声音和抑扬顿挫、轻重缓急的语气语调，准确、鲜明、生动地表达作者的思想感情和作品的情节情景，给人以艺术美感和心灵震撼。同时也希望通过本课程的学习能够有效地提高你孩子的口头表达能力，有助于你孩子中文学习水平和综合素质的迅速提升。 标准普通话教学：声母、韵母、声调、及语音矫正 朗读教学：朗诵的常用技巧与方法；现代诗歌、散文、古诗词、古文、寓言故事等文体的朗读训练；口头表达训练 AP中文说写训练：熟练掌握AP中文要求的基本字词听说读写要求 课程特色： 小班化教学：每位学生可以接受专门辅导，对于个人的语音、语调、发音等问题可以更加及时的发现并纠正； 独特内部培训：模拟场景让儿童慢慢摆脱胆怯心理，逐步丰富肢体语言； 鼓励社区活动参与：有大量实践机会，可以参加AAA及本地社团组织的朗诵演讲比赛和AAA组织的大型演出。 为9月20号学校的汇报演出排练诗朗诵节目 突破自我，训练胆量，让孩子从胆怯中走出去， 与人交流更加大方，勇于在多人面前展现自己。 授课时间：周日1：00—2：30（根据报名情况分班） 联系电话：480-600-1377 高京京老师 480-213-9187 吕丽华老师 请尽早报名，以便老师为9月份的演出排练诗朗诵节目
d245102ce32c62ab12731d055550ced166fa80ba.translatedText: Do you want to improve your child's language expression ability? Do you want to enhance your child's self-confidence? Do you want your child to have a more cheerful personality? Reciting performances and speeches are art projects that are most closely integrated with children's Chinese learning and language expression abilities among many arts. By mastering the skills of recitation and performance from an early age, you can not only improve your language expression skills, but also overcome the timidity of expressing in public, enhance your self-confidence, and have outstanding eloquence skills, creating a shortcut to success for future struggles! Course introduction: Recitation and speech, like singing and dancing, are artistic talents that people love to hear and see. The teaching purpose of this course is to let your children learn to accurately, clearly and vividly express the author's thoughts and feelings and the plot of the work through their own voice, cadence, and priority of tone, giving people a sense of artistic beauty and spiritual shock. At the same time, we hope that studying this course can effectively improve your child's oral expression ability and help your child's Chinese learning level and overall quality to rapidly improve. Standard Mandarin teaching: initial consonants, finals, tones, and pronunciation correction. Reading teaching: common skills and methods of recitation; reading training of modern poetry, prose, ancient poetry, ancient prose, fables and other genres; oral expression training. AP Chinese speaking and writing training: proficiency in the basic words, listening, speaking, reading and writing requirements required by AP Chinese. Course features: Small class teaching: each student can receive specialized tutoring, and personal pronunciation, intonation, pronunciation and other problems can be discovered and corrected in a more timely manner; Unique in-house training: Simulated scenes help children slowly get rid of timidity and gradually enrich their body language; Encourage participation in community activities: There are a lot of practice opportunities, and you can participate in recitation and speech competitions organized by AAA and local societies and large-scale performances organized by AAA. Rehearse the poem recitation program for the school report performance on September 20th. Break through yourself and train your courage, so that children can get out of timidity, communicate more generously with others, and have the courage to show themselves in front of many people. Teaching time: Sunday 1:00-2:30 (classes are divided according to registration status) Contact number: 480-600-1377 Teacher Gao Jingjing 480-213-9187 Teacher Lu Lihua Please register as early as possible so that the teacher can rehearse the poetry recitation program for the performance in September

9006883f792fc90f4704aa46ab69cfe3e4e53504.translatedText: Zhang Zhaohong: Report on the overseas Chinese in the Phoenix area of ​​the United States 1. Overview of the overseas Chinese community: At the beginning of the 20th century, Phoenix City already had the Deng family, the Yu family, the Huang family, etc. The Chinese ancestors in...

57d1c44517ba8053f10ad9afa1196ab4589c3ec6.sourceText: 一、侨区概况: 在廿世纪之初，鳯凰城已经有了邓氏、余氏、黄氏等。 华人先辈在本地以姓氏组织起来的宗亲团体，开始只是为了达到守望相助、共御外侮之目的。 按官方记录，在1940年，凤凰城总人口已有65,414人，华人人数却只有431人，占总数的0.66%。 本埠华人如此的少，但当年却面临着的种族岐视，要反对这种现象并不能采用直接抗争的方法。 所以在1937年，本埠华人首次自发庆祝美国国庆，表明”吾人此举，乃是本着生于斯，长于斯，居于斯，以表示拥护美国之热诚”。 到了1939年，本地商家成立了”华商总会”，组织起华人在七月四日庆祝美国国庆，表达对美国的认同，以此反对当时的种族岐视。 ” 华商总会”当年还发起过捐助”一碗饭”活动，把筹到的钱汇回祖国救助在日本侵略者铁蹄下的苦难同胞。 1941年太平洋战争爆发后，亚省有七十九位华人子弟应征当兵，其中参加中美空军混合大队第十四航空飞虎队服务的也有四位华人，他们远赴中国，和中国军民一起 直接抗击入侵祖国的日本帝国主义。 二次大战中有五位华裔军人为国捐躯。 而本埠华人继续举办美国国庆活动，支持国家反法西斯主义。 之后，举办庆祝美国国庆活成为本埠华人的传统活动，并一直延续至今。 到了上世纪六十年代末，鳯凰城华人已经有五千人和多个团体。 1968年，由全侨十三个团体成立起”斐匿侨团联合总会” 。 侨联成立以来，继续组织​​全侨举办庆祝国庆和”双十节”活动。 到目前，大凤凰城地区已有十万华人华侨之众，侨联总会发展到今日已经有十七个团体，一直是本地区最大的华人组织。 目前更名为”大凤凰城地区侨团联合总会”，成员已包括鳯凰城及周边多个卫星城市，每年举办上千人庆祝美国国庆活动和其它多个活动。
57d1c44517ba8053f10ad9afa1196ab4589c3ec6.translatedText: 1. Overview of the overseas Chinese community: At the beginning of the 20th century, there were already Deng, Yu, Huang, etc. in Huanghuang City. The kinship groups organized by local surnames by the Chinese ancestors were initially intended to help each other and defend against foreign aggression. According to official records, in 1940, the total population of Phoenix was 65,414, but the number of Chinese was only 431, accounting for 0.66% of the total. There were so few Chinese in this city, but they faced racial discrimination at that time. To oppose this phenomenon, we could not use direct resistance. Therefore, in 1937, the local Chinese people spontaneously celebrated the National Day of the United States for the first time, stating that "we are doing this to express our sincere support for the United States because we were born here, grew up here, and live here." In 1939, local merchants established the "Chinese Business Association" to organize Chinese people to celebrate the Fourth of July as the National Day to express their identification with the United States and to oppose racial discrimination at the time. The "Chinese Chamber of Commerce" also launched a "bowl of rice" donation event that year, and remitted the money raised back to the motherland to help the suffering compatriots under the iron heel of the Japanese invaders. After the outbreak of the Pacific War in 1941, 79 Chinese people from Alberta were recruited to serve in the military. Among them, four Chinese served in the 14th Flying Tigers, a mixed group of the Chinese and American Air Forces. They went to China and directly fought with the Chinese military and civilians against the Japanese imperialism that invaded the motherland. During World War II, five Chinese-American soldiers died for their country. The local Chinese continue to hold National Day activities to support the country's anti-fascism. After that, holding celebrations for the National Day of the United States became a traditional activity for the local Chinese and continues to this day. By the end of the 1960s, there were 5,000 Chinese people and multiple groups in Huanghuang City. In 1968, the "Feni Overseas Chinese Federation" was established by 13 overseas Chinese groups. Since its establishment, the Overseas Chinese Federation has continued to organize activities for all overseas Chinese to celebrate National Day and the "Double Tenth Day". So far, there are 100,000 overseas Chinese in the greater Phoenix area. The Overseas Chinese Federation has grown to include 17 groups today, and it has always been the largest Chinese organization in the region. Currently renamed as "Greater Phoenix Area Overseas Chinese Association", its members include Phoenix and many surrounding satellite cities. Every year, it holds thousands of people to celebrate the National Day and many other activities.

a88bca3e4321929c2a22058c3f7246becfe5b072.sourceText: 二、侨团之情况与发展 四十四年来，鳯凰城侨联总会通过举办庆祝国庆和各种活动，一方面显示出华人团结的力量，力求主流社会认同，另方面积极宣扬中华文化。 鳯凰城侨联总会成立之初，正值”中国热”开始，美国人对五千年的中华文化欣赏和向往，就算是离开祖国数十年的本地华侨及其后裔，也迫切需要寻 回自己的根以及文化上的认同。 如是，侨联举办国庆活动就有了新的内涵。 从1970年开始，连年的庆典中加入了舞龙醒狮的表演，并有民俗婚礼表演，古典服装与旗袍秀，中国功夫，中国电影等文化艺术的节目，改变美国民众对中国人的残旧 印象。 同时，还增添了〝凤​​凰城​​华裔小姐选美〞环节，鼓励下一代华​​裔的参与，让中华文化得到传承，也让国庆活动有了更加亮丽的色彩。 侨联宏扬中华文化的活动通过”中外杂志”、”金山时报”，以及近年的本地报刊和网络等各种传媒的报道，在国内外产生了积极的影响，这种成功，也是侨联举办国庆活动的另 一种意义所在。 连年举办的庆典活动得到了主流社会的关注和支持。 在1979年，亚利桑那州州长布鲁斯‧毕比(Bruce E. Babbit) 已经亲自来到现场，和华人一起庆祝美国国庆。 到了九十年代，鳯凰城市长史洁林沙(Skip Rimsza ) 在贺函中写道：”我要欢迎举办鳯凰城华人社团国庆大会，自从三十年代末期，您们已开始庆祝这个富有历史性的 日子。”在千禧年，州长珍迪(Jane Dee Hall) 发来贺函：”代表整个亚利桑那州，我欣荣地认同今年的活动，我赞誉你们给予亚利桑那州公民的承诺和忠心。你们为了保持 社区那份强烈的精神而鞠躬尽瘁。”每年，州、市政府都有贺辞或有官员参加庆典，侨民亦大力支持和参与。 侨联亦在发展中，由开始的寻求认同到争取自身的权益，努力争取到政府部门拨出经费去兴建”康宁大厦”、”耆英会”，近来还得到政府拨款五百卅万元兴建起” 康乐大厦”。 近年来，由于祖国和两岸形势的发展，侨联亦参与两岸团体所举办的活动，并举办多方面的公益活动。 1989年，美州和全美中华会馆和中华公所曾于在本埠召开过一次声势浩大的年会，鳯凰城侨联总会筹划和组织大会召开相当成功，受到好评。 侨联总会亦于2011年去拜会过罗省中华会馆，向侨社老大哥取经和学习。
a88bca3e4321929c2a22058c3f7246becfe5b072.translatedText: 2. The Situation and Development of the Overseas Chinese Community Over the past 44 years, the Overseas Chinese Federation of Nuohuangcheng has held National Day celebrations and various activities to demonstrate the strength of Chinese unity and strive for mainstream social recognition, and to actively promote Chinese culture. When the Overseas Chinese Federation of Huangcheng City was founded, it coincided with the beginning of the "China fever". Americans appreciated and yearned for five thousand years of Chinese culture. Even local overseas Chinese and their descendants who had left the motherland for decades were in urgent need of rediscovering their roots and cultural identity. In this case, the National Day activities held by the Overseas Chinese Federation will have new connotations. Since 1970, dragon and lion dance performances have been added to the annual celebrations, as well as folk wedding performances, classical costume and cheongsam shows, Chinese kung fu, Chinese movies and other cultural and artistic programs to change the American people's old impression of the Chinese. At the same time, the "Miss Chinese Phoenix Beauty Pageant" was also added to encourage the participation of the next generation of Chinese Americans, so that Chinese culture can be passed down and the National Day event will have a brighter color. The Overseas Chinese Federation's activities to promote Chinese culture have had a positive impact at home and abroad through various media reports such as "Chinese and Foreign Magazine", "Jinshan Times", as well as local newspapers and the Internet in recent years. This success is another significance of the National Day activities held by the Overseas Chinese Federation. The celebrations held year after year have received attention and support from mainstream society. In 1979, Arizona Governor Bruce E. Babbit came to the scene in person to celebrate the National Day with the Chinese. In the 1990s, Phoenix Mayor Skip Rimsza wrote in a congratulatory letter: "I would like to welcome the Phoenix Chinese Community National Day Convention, which you have been celebrating since the late 1930s." In the millennium, Governor Jane Dee Hall sent a congratulatory letter: "On behalf of the entire state of Arizona, I am pleased to endorse this year's event, and I commend you for your commitment and loyalty to the citizens of Arizona. "Every year, state and city governments send congratulatory messages or have officials attend the celebrations, and the diaspora also provides strong support and participation. The Overseas Chinese Federation is also developing, from seeking recognition at the beginning to fighting for its own rights and interests. It has worked hard to obtain funds from government departments to build the "Kang Ning Building" and the "Senior Citizen Association". Recently, it also received a government allocation of 5.3 million yuan to build the "Kang Le Building". In recent years, due to the development of the situation in the motherland and across the Taiwan Strait, the Overseas Chinese Federation has also participated in activities organized by groups on both sides of the Taiwan Strait and organized various public welfare activities. In 1989, the American and American Chinese Associations and Chinese Associations held a massive annual conference in this city. The Phoenix Overseas Chinese Federation General Association planned and organized the conference very successfully and was well received. The Federation of Overseas Chinese also visited the Luo Provincial Chinese Association in 2011 to learn from the big brother of the overseas Chinese community.

0f39e18542e4ef1eda0824e87de7931fbf771d2d.sourceText: 三、会馆运作现况 鳯凰城侨联总会从开始十三个发展到目前十七个团体，能够数十年来保持团结，有着其重要的因素所在。 在历史上，有过不少华人团体因财力纷争或内部不和以至活动停滞甚至瓦解。 鳯凰城侨联总会每年举办庆祝美国国庆，无论侨联主席、职员如何更替，选出来的班底就要担负起办好庆祝美国国庆的重要任务。 侨联集合本身十多个团体的人力物力，大家分工合作，团结互助和顾全大局。 在为时半年的筹备活动中舒筋活络，吐故纳新，不断补充新人新力量，所以多年来不但没有解散反而得到发展。 另外，每年的庆祝活动还得到了华人社区其它社团的协助，吸引到许多义工的帮忙，庆典成为了让大家贡献力量和展示才华的平台，成为一个让凤凰城各界共同参与的大型活动。 华侨先进们早在一九七零年国庆活动中就加入了”选美”环节，让年青一代也乐意参与，选美让筹款数目大有增加。 鳯凰城华裔小姐选美已办过卅一届,氛围也因而充满娱乐性和观赏性，七月份骄阳似火，但连主流社会亦乐于参与。 早在1978年，侨联就首次印有”国庆特刋”，近年来”国庆特刋”更成为侨联每年活动的资料记载，为历史留下纪录。
0f39e18542e4ef1eda0824e87de7931fbf771d2d.translatedText: 3. The current status of the operation of the association. The Overseas Chinese Federation of Nuohuangcheng has grown from 13 groups to 17 groups at present. It has been able to maintain unity for decades, which is an important factor. In history, many Chinese groups have had their activities stagnated or even collapsed due to financial disputes or internal discord. The Overseas Chinese Federation of Phoenix City celebrates the National Day every year. No matter how the chairman and staff of the Overseas Chinese Federation change, the selected team must shoulder the important task of successfully celebrating the National Day. The Overseas Chinese Federation has pooled the manpower and material resources of more than a dozen of its own groups, and everyone divides labor and cooperates to unite and help each other and take the overall situation into consideration. During the half-year preparatory activities, we relaxed our muscles, brought in new ideas, and constantly added new people and new strengths. Therefore, instead of disbanding, we have developed over the years. In addition, the annual celebration also receives assistance from other associations in the Chinese community and attracts the help of many volunteers. The celebration has become a platform for everyone to contribute and showcase their talents, and has become a large-scale event that all walks of life in Phoenix can participate in. The advanced overseas Chinese have already included a "beauty pageant" in the National Day activities in 1970, which made the younger generation willing to participate. The beauty pageant greatly increased the amount of funds raised. The Miss Chinese Beauty Pageant in Phoenix City has been held for the 30th time, and the atmosphere is therefore full of entertainment and viewing. The sun is shining brightly in July, but even the mainstream society is willing to participate. As early as 1978, the Federation of Overseas Chinese printed the "National Day Special" for the first time. In recent years, the "National Day Special" has become a record of the annual activities of the Overseas Chinese Federation, leaving a record for history.

67e2943d53032615a31e05caf5f57010f92e9640.sourceText: 四、结论 今天当我们重新回顾，在早期华人并不多的鳯凰城，华侨先辈成立了侨联总会。 四十多年来坚持不懈地举办庆祝美国国庆活动，这份坚持执着和成功，在全美各大城市的华人社区中亦是十分少有的。 鳯凰城华人会记载这段历史，珍惜这份热情，并愐怀华侨先辈的贡献，在薪火相传中，继续发扬这个优良传统！
67e2943d53032615a31e05caf5f57010f92e9640.translatedText: 4. Conclusion Today when we look back again, in the early days of Huanghuang City where there were not many Chinese, the overseas Chinese ancestors established the Overseas Chinese Federation. For more than 40 years, we have been organizing activities to celebrate the National Day of the United States. This kind of persistence and success is very rare among the Chinese communities in major cities in the United States. The Phoenix City Chinese Association will record this period of history, cherish this enthusiasm, and cherish the contributions of our overseas Chinese ancestors. We will continue to carry forward this fine tradition as the torch is passed down from generation to generation!

c67b6d3203eb13ba59d09d3f693437e30348c8ea.sourceText: 3月2日上午真北公司关掉了同顺居的抽油烟机，华人社区的公关人员Tom Simon 拿了老四川的钥匙上房顶去打开风扇时，居然发现真北公司的律师亲自在房顶上看守油烟机。真北公司想抢这把钥匙没有得逞后，居然打电话给警察局，要警察抓Tom。警察来了以后表示，这里是有两家餐馆的公共广场，任何人都可以自由进出公共区域。他们根据法律不可能抓Tom, 同时还告诉真北，他们已被告知如果没有出示法庭的Eviction Order（驱逐令）, 只要同顺居里面有人，真北不可以锁门，否则就是犯法。 真北一共叫来了三次警察，所有警察都是同样的态度。真北公司下午又叫来了消防局，声称同顺居没有抽烟系统，不能营业，要求消防局出书面证明关掉同顺居。同顺居的经理给律师打通电话，经过交涉，消防局态度明确，他们来的时候同顺居没有犯规，他们不能表示任何意见。消防局建议同顺居在没有抽风系统时，尽快考虑别的方法先继续营业，建议律师尽快下周从法庭拿到相关维权文件。 老四川的赵老板非常支持同顺居，决定这周末开始联手提供餐饮服务，其中包括提供火锅大餐，并尽快安排自助餐，对有点餐的客户，老四川可以帮助同顺居做菜，送到同顺居。 真北公司3月2日还第四次剪断了同顺居的电话线，同时威胁，他们明天会把同顺居的公共抽烟系统管道通道全部拆掉，试图永久性让同顺居停业。今天的行为，真北公司的律师和二把手直接参与，实在不敢相信，在美国这个讲究民主和文明的社会制度下，可以看到这种类似黑手党的恶性行为。
c67b6d3203eb13ba59d09d3f693437e30348c8ea.translatedText: On the morning of March 2, True North Company turned off the range hood of Tongshunju. When Tom Simon, a public relations officer of the Chinese community, took the old Sichuan key and went up to the roof to turn on the fan, he actually found True North's lawyer personally guarding the range hood on the roof. After True North failed to steal the key, they actually called the police station and asked the police to arrest Tom. After the police arrived, they said that this was a public square with two restaurants, and anyone could freely enter and exit the public area. According to the law, it was impossible for them to arrest Tom. They also told Zhenbei that they had been told that if there was no Eviction Order from the court, Zhenbei could not lock the door as long as there was someone in Tongshunju, otherwise it would be a violation of the law. Zhenbei called the police three times in total, and all the police had the same attitude. True North Company called the fire station again in the afternoon, claiming that Tongshunju did not have a smoking system and could not operate, and asked the fire station to provide written certification to close Tongshunju. Tongshunju's manager called the lawyer. After negotiation, the fire department made it clear that Tongshunju had not committed any foul play when they came, and they could not express any opinions. The fire department suggested that Tongshunju should consider other methods to continue business as soon as possible when there is no exhaust system. It also recommended that lawyers obtain relevant rights protection documents from the court as soon as possible next week. Boss Zhao from Old Sichuan is very supportive of Tongshunju and decided to jointly provide catering services this weekend, including providing hot pot meals and arranging buffets as soon as possible. For customers who order meals, Old Sichuan can help Tongshunju cook the dishes and deliver them to Tongshunju. On March 2, True North also cut off Tongshunju’s phone lines for the fourth time. At the same time, they threatened that they would remove all the ducts of Tongshunju’s public smoking system tomorrow in an attempt to permanently shut down Tongshunju. True North's lawyers and second-in-command were directly involved in today's behavior. I really can't believe that in the United States, a social system that values ​​democracy and civilization, we can see such vicious behavior similar to the mafia.

579f46ca810267d4fedb09cffba3faf9e61920f0.sourceText: 同顺居是在中国文化中心租赁的正在营业的中餐馆，他们有继续租赁中国文化中心的5年合同的续约权。目前正在与新业主真北公司就租约问题打官司，为了逼走同顺居，新业主毫无道德底线得使出各种招数。
579f46ca810267d4fedb09cffba3faf9e61920f0.translatedText: Tongshunju is a currently operating Chinese restaurant leased in the Chinese Cultural Center. They have the right to renew the 5-year contract to continue leasing the Chinese Cultural Center. We are currently in a legal battle with the new owner, True North Company, over the lease. In order to force Tongshunju out, the new owner has no moral bottom line and resorts to all kinds of tricks.

50d794acd499d5444f3ab2ef043a474d7b0d5f7c.sourceText: 2月1日上诉法对老四川案的判决使文化中心得到一段时间的保护。但市政府所发的换瓦许可仍是悬在文化中心头上的利剑。证据显示市里在发许可证时没有执行正常的程序和法规。为此老四川最近将凤凰城市政府告上了法庭。同顺居为了保护自己的权益，近日也将TN告上了法庭。 老四川和同顺居半年来生意下降很多，有时甚至贴钱经营。面对这种局面，侨联和多位支持保护文化中心的朋友们共同成立了Citizen Voice，帮助老四川和文化中心的其他商家提供全方位支持。以众人之力，保护华人商家，共同保护文化中心。 最近成立的Citizen Voice 公民之声是一个非盈利组织，请大家踊跃参与，滴水成川，用行动保护文化中心。免税捐款写给Citizen Voice 或者 CUAGP。捐款的支票请寄 Citizen Voice 3116 S Mill Ave. #188 Tempe AZ 85282 如果直接转帐请私聊郑诗琦 或者楊萍 。
50d794acd499d5444f3ab2ef043a474d7b0d5f7c.translatedText: On February 1, the appeal law’s judgment on the old Sichuan case gave the cultural center protection for a period of time. However, the permit issued by the city government to replace the tiles is still a sword hanging over the cultural center. The evidence showed the city failed to implement normal procedures and regulations when issuing permits. For this reason, Old Sichuan recently took the Phoenix City Government to court. In order to protect their rights and interests, Tongshunju also recently took TN to court. The business of Laosichuan and Tongshunju has dropped significantly in the past six months, and sometimes they even operate at a discount. Faced with this situation, the Overseas Chinese Federation and many friends who support the protection of the cultural center jointly established Citizen Voice to help provide all-round support to other businesses in Old Sichuan and the cultural center. Use everyone’s efforts to protect Chinese businesses and jointly protect the cultural center. The recently established Citizen Voice is a non-profit organization. Everyone is invited to actively participate, and every drop of water can become a river, and use actions to protect the cultural center. Make tax-deductible donations to Citizen Voice or CUAGP. Please send a donation check to Citizen Voice 3116 S Mill Ave. #188 Tempe AZ 85282. If you want to transfer directly, please send a private message to Zheng Shiqi or Yang Ping.

5f5c40364b049becab5cc9399496ba691d2e7790.translatedText: Music Island It's hard to hear the sound of the piano. I am a crucian carp that comes here because of its fame. I look around and look for it. I pray in the happy faces of men and women. I climb up to the poet Shu Ting. Later, I asked people along the street and said that she had fled Germany, leaving her beautiful hometown to tourists from all over the world to take pictures. She wanted to climb up to the Sunlight Rock to see Xiamen spread out in the distance before her eyes. She was surprised to meet Zheng Chenggong in the middle of the mountain. The surname of the country used thirty-nine glorious years to provide future generations with a memorial hall full of tragedy and legend. The cable car flies over, and the bird garden is surrounded by birds chirping, cursing, and cursing. They are surrounded by a dragnet. The beach is sunny and sunny, and the scenery is as poetic as picturesque. The sound of drums has been silent for a hundred years, and the waves are even calmer

3ef6d22aaac6c889958dff9bd66a5266ade2c095.sourceText: 註:与厦门一水之隔的鼓浪屿，居民家家有钢琴，是名诗人舒婷的故乡。 日光巖為岛上海拔最高处，小岛游人如鯽，已破坏了桃园幽静，天籟之音难闻。
3ef6d22aaac6c889958dff9bd66a5266ade2c095.translatedText: Note: On Gulangyu Island, which is across the water from Xiamen, residents have pianos in every home. It is the hometown of the famous poet Shu Ting. Sunlight Rock is the highest point on the island. Visitors to the island are like crucian carp, which has destroyed the tranquility of the Taoyuan and made the sounds of nature unpleasant.

5f775a26a33dc8ec27b63189e2fcc5d464b66da6.sourceText: 传承华夏文化 喜迎亚省新春 传承华夏文化 喜迎亚省新春 ——记亚省现代中文学参加2018年亚省艺术学院春节晚会报道 (亚省现代中文学校 讯) 欢声笑语辞旧岁，喜聚一堂贺新春。新年伊始，我校应亚省艺术学院的邀请，参加了当地华人一年一度的春节晚会的演出。 元月6日下午7点整，亚省艺术学院春节晚会在梅萨市艺术中心（Mesa Art Center）拉开了序幕。流光溢彩的炫目舞台，别出心裁的开场演出，让全场掌声雷动！亚省艺术学院的这场嘉年华大联欢，不仅让学院的师生们展示了精湛技艺，还有幸邀请到了中国著名杂技艺术团的联合参演！更让观众们激动的是，亚省现代中文学校的合唱团和校乐队也首次为春晚带来了节目！ 中场休息后，当帷幕缓缓拉开，亚省现代中文学校合唱团及校乐队的全体成员已经神采奕奕地站在了舞台上！让观众眼前一亮的是参加童声合唱和朗诵演出的同学们，尤其是女孩子们，她们身着大红色上衣，两条马尾辫系着大红色绸带，显得分外喜庆吉祥！开场诗朗诵”新年到，放鞭炮，噼噼啪啪真热闹”六个可爱的小同学声音清晰响亮、一口流利的标准普通话，突显了我们中文学校在海外中文教育中保持的一流水准！紧接着二十位小同学和成人合唱团合唱了海内外华人家喻户晓，曾获20世纪华人音乐十大经典之一的歌曲《北风吹》。经过改编的乐曲，在我校乐队的激情演奏下，童声的稚嫩清澈和成人合唱队的喉清韵雅有如渔舟唱晚般应答如流，曲罢余音绕梁，令人久久回味！ 作为亚省华人社区活动的中坚力量，现代中文学校此次参演不仅向整个社区展示了我们中文教学的成果，也帮助学生深入体会中国的文化，同时也和本地其它华人团体一起积极推广亚裔传统文化！ 感谢亚省现代中文学校陶世诚董事长、王玉兰校长的大力支持以及演出组委会的田韶微副校长和高京京老师的精心组织！感谢亚省艺术学院吕丽华院长为排练和演出提供的周到服务！感谢各位家长及义工的热情参与！感谢参加朗诵和合唱团的全体成员！感谢蔡善皋老师及全体乐队成员，还有我们的摄影师！ 送一声祝福、道一声问候！祝愿我们中文学校和华人社区迎来欣欣向荣的又一年！（撰稿高京京；摄影 Steve Tu，Nanyan Chai）
5f775a26a33dc8ec27b63189e2fcc5d464b66da6.translatedText: Inherit the Chinese culture and welcome the New Year to the province. Inherit the Chinese culture and welcome the new year to the province. ——Report on the participation of Alberta Modern Chinese School in the 2018 Alberta School of the Arts Spring Festival Gala (Alberta Modern Chinese School News) Say goodbye to the old year with joy and joy, and happily gather together to celebrate the new year. At the beginning of the new year, our school was invited by the Art Institute of Alberta to participate in the performance of the local Chinese annual Spring Festival Gala. At 7:00 pm on January 6th, the Alberta College of Art Spring Festival Gala kicked off at the Mesa Art Center. The dazzling stage and the unique opening performance made the audience burst into applause! This carnival party held by the Alberta College of Art not only allowed the teachers and students of the college to display their superb skills, but also had the honor to invite the famous Chinese acrobatic art troupe to jointly perform! What made the audience even more excited was that the choir and school band of the Alberta Modern Chinese School also presented programs for the Spring Festival Gala for the first time! After the intermission, when the curtain slowly opened, all members of the choir and school band of the Alberta Modern Chinese School were already standing on the stage in high spirits! What caught the audience's attention were the students who participated in the children's chorus and recitation performances, especially the girls. They were dressed in bright red tops, with two ponytails tied with bright red ribbons, looking extremely festive and auspicious! The opening poem recited "New Year is here, set off firecrackers, the crackling is really lively." The six cute little students had clear and loud voices and fluent standard Mandarin, which highlighted the first-class level that our Chinese school maintains in overseas Chinese education! Then twenty primary school students and the adult choir sang "The North Wind Blows", a song that is a household name among Chinese at home and abroad and one of the top ten classics of Chinese music in the 20th century. The adapted music, under the passionate performance of our school band, the tender and clear children's voices and the clear and elegant throats of the adult chorus responded like a fishing boat singing at night. As the backbone of Chinese community activities in Alberta, Modern Chinese School's participation in this performance not only showcases the results of our Chinese teaching to the entire community, but also helps students deeply understand Chinese culture. At the same time, it also actively promotes traditional Asian culture with other local Chinese groups! Thanks to Chairman Tao Shicheng and Principal Wang Yulan of the Alberta Modern Chinese School for their strong support, as well as Vice Principal Tian Shaowei and Teacher Gao Jingjing of the performance organizing committee for their careful organization! Thanks to Dean Lu Lihua of the Alberta College of the Arts for providing thoughtful services for rehearsals and performances! Thank you to all parents and volunteers for your enthusiastic participation! Thank you to everyone who participated in the reading and choir! Thank you to teacher Cai Shangao and all the band members, as well as our photographer! Send a blessing and a greeting! I wish our Chinese school and Chinese community another prosperous year! (Written by Gao Jingjing; Photographed by Steve Tu, Nanyan Chai)

ab69733009bd9701dd7033c4b715800f002ea5b6.sourceText: 从明年开始，数百万接受社会安全金及其它政府福利的人不再会从邮箱中收到政府发放的支票。 联邦政府现在每个月会寄出7300万张支票，但这种发放纸质支票的做法将逐步被淘汰。政府将要求人们接受电子版的福利，即通过直接银行储蓄或给那些没有银行账户者一张可充值的借记卡。 这种变化将会影响那些接受社会安全金、退伍军人福利、铁路员工退休金及联邦伤残金的人。但退税不在此列。不过国税局鼓励纳税人以电子方式获得退税。 财政部披露，大约有90%的接受联邦福利的人已经以电子方式获得他们的福利。新的福利受益人被要求从去年开始以电子方式获得相关福利，但也有一些人例外。不过这些人需要在2013年3月的时候转成用电子方式接受福利。 财政部的电子资金转移部门负责人亨德森说电子付款比纸质支票更安全有效。在2010年的时候，有超过54万张的福利支票报失或被窃。这种向电子付款转变的过程会给政府每年省下约1亿2000万美元。社会安全局将在下一个十年中省下10亿多美元。 老年人权益团体说，他们理解政府想削减开支并利用新科技的意愿。食品券计划在2004年的时候已经将纸质食品券转成借记卡付款。 但权益团体也担心，这种转变对年迈的退休人员可能带来的不方便，因为这些人可能对电子付款的方式不熟悉。
ab69733009bd9701dd7033c4b715800f002ea5b6.translatedText: Starting next year, millions of people who receive Social Security and other government benefits will no longer receive government checks in their mailboxes. The federal government now sends 73 million checks each month, but this practice of issuing paper checks will be phased out. The government will ask people to take benefits electronically, either through direct bank deposits or by giving those without bank accounts a reloadable debit card. The change will affect those who receive Social Security, veterans' benefits, railroad employee pensions and federal disability benefits. But tax refunds are not included in this. However, the IRS encourages taxpayers to obtain their refunds electronically. The Treasury Department revealed that about 90% of people receiving federal benefits already receive their benefits electronically. New welfare recipients were required to receive their benefits electronically starting last year, but there were some exceptions. However, these people will need to switch to receiving benefits electronically in March 2013. Henderson, who heads the Treasury's electronic funds transfer unit, said electronic payments are more secure and efficient than paper checks. In 2010, more than 540,000 welfare checks were reported lost or stolen. This transition to electronic payments will save the government approximately $120 million annually. The Social Security Administration will save more than $1 billion over the next decade. Seniors advocacy groups say they understand the government's desire to cut spending and take advantage of new technology. The food stamp program switched from paper food stamps to debit card payments in 2004. But advocacy groups are also concerned about the inconvenience the switch could bring to older retirees, who may be unfamiliar with electronic payments.

d2ba099ce8b616c619c4903953c087b1ecf61362.sourceText: 第二届世界华侨华人美术书法展于本月16日在北京开幕。本次画展组委会共收到来自42个国家和地区、2000名作者选送的近4000余幅作品。近日，经由中国美协、中国书协和中国侨联推举的国内外书画专家组成的评选委会，经评委会严格评选，共有292件书画作品脱颖而出，其中91件为书画佳作奖，201件为书画优秀奖。 亚利桑那州知名画家林峰先生所创作的抽象画”裂变”获得了美术佳作奖。
d2ba099ce8b616c619c4903953c087b1ecf61362.translatedText: The Second World Overseas Chinese Art Calligraphy Exhibition opened in Beijing on the 16th of this month. The organizing committee of this exhibition received nearly 4,000 works from 2,000 artists from 42 countries and regions. Recently, after strict selection by a selection committee composed of domestic and foreign calligraphy and painting experts recommended by the China Artists Association, the Chinese Calligraphy Association and the China Federation of Returned Overseas Chinese, a total of 292 calligraphy and painting works stood out, of which 91 were awarded the Excellent Calligraphy and Painting Award, and 201 were awarded the Excellence Award for Calligraphy and Painting. The abstract painting "Fission" created by Mr. Lin Feng, a well-known Arizona painter, won the Fine Art Award.

6f2580df9765609e89e9e111345313db62d1dd91.sourceText: ”裂变”是画家林峰先生近年来创作的系列现代主义丙烯混合材料画之一的作品， 也是美西地区非常畅销的的艺术作品之一。他的作品色彩浓烈而又厚重，层层叠叠，充满了无尽变幻质感和肌理，强烈的光感穿透过变幻的色彩，展现了裂变的韵律。画面中丰富的笔触充满着刚毅的力量。散发着大气与豪放的风采和迷人浪漫的气息，给人独立思索，欣赏和想象的空间。
6f2580df9765609e89e9e111345313db62d1dd91.translatedText: "Fission" is one of a series of modernist acrylic mixed-material paintings created by the painter Mr. Lin Feng in recent years. It is also one of the best-selling art works in the Western United States. His works are rich and thick in color, layer upon layer, and full of endlessly changing textures and textures. The strong sense of light penetrates through the changing colors, showing the rhythm of fission. The rich brushstrokes in the painting are full of resolute power. It exudes a grand and bold style and a charming and romantic atmosphere, giving people space for independent thinking, appreciation and imagination.

18e8cdb64f635745f003c4d006242b8b1709baae.sourceText: 在画展开幕仪式上，中国侨联副主席乔卫表示：”这些画家虽然人在海外，但他们依然非常完整地继承着中华文化的传统，而且他们把中国现在的发展融入在自己的作品之中，这是一个非常鲜明的特点，另外还有一个特点，因为他们（画家）在海外长期生活，他们吸收了当地文化一些特色的东西，但是他们在中国文化和世界文化方面做了努力和尝试，华侨作为中国梦和世界梦沟通的使者，已经在艺术方面开始实现了。”开幕仪式上，主办方还为获奖艺术家、优秀组织单位颁发了荣誉证书。
18e8cdb64f635745f003c4d006242b8b1709baae.translatedText: At the opening ceremony of the exhibition, Qiao Wei, vice chairman of the All-China Federation of Returned Overseas Chinese, said: "Although these painters are overseas, they still inherit the traditions of Chinese culture very completely, and they integrate the current development of China into their works. This is a very distinctive feature, and there is another special feature. Because they (painters) have lived overseas for a long time, they have absorbed some characteristics of local culture, but they have made efforts and attempts in Chinese culture and world culture. As messengers of communication between the Chinese dream and the world dream, overseas Chinese have begun to realize it in art." At the opening ceremony, the organizers also issued certificates of honor to the winning artists and outstanding organizational units.
