China will overtake Europe by the end of this year and become the third largest source of international tourists to Arizona in the United States. Arizona…

380eaa8e547a1564561201f49b56deb8e6c1e0c4.sourceText: 中国今年底将超过欧洲，成为美国亚利桑那州第三大国际游客来源。
380eaa8e547a1564561201f49b56deb8e6c1e0c4.translatedText: China will surpass Europe by the end of this year and become the third largest source of international tourists in Arizona, USA.

3bc0cf470dc8632ff2c933dd6aeb0bc5ebff1283.sourceText: 亚利桑那州旅游办公室说，墨西哥和加拿大是该州游客最多的前两国，不过，去年中国游客数字将近七万七千人，比前年增加百分之20。过去七年中国游客的数字持续上升，今年中国游客将第一次超越欧洲游客总和。
3bc0cf470dc8632ff2c933dd6aeb0bc5ebff1283.translatedText: The Arizona Tourism Office said that Mexico and Canada are the top two countries with the most tourists to the state. However, the number of Chinese tourists last year was nearly 77,000, an increase of 20% from the previous year. The number of Chinese tourists has continued to rise over the past seven years, and this year, for the first time, Chinese tourists will surpass the total number of European tourists.

d60f773cd5c4a4a484ffae24ff19d744e3385eac.sourceText: 强劲的美元导致外国游客减少，特别是欧洲游客。然而，中国却是显著的例外，亚利桑那州已经成为中国游客不断增长的热点。
d60f773cd5c4a4a484ffae24ff19d744e3385eac.translatedText: The strong US dollar has led to fewer foreign tourists, especially those from Europe. However, China is a notable exception, with Arizona becoming a growing hotspot for Chinese tourists.

bb9eab5cea8b48fb0c3eb9887e3d8ab5db2c17ce.sourceText: 办公室代表道林说，中国市场韧性很强，对货币问题反应并不强烈。从经济角度看，中国的发展非常好，中产阶级增长非常快。
bb9eab5cea8b48fb0c3eb9887e3d8ab5db2c17ce.translatedText: Office representative Dowling said that the Chinese market is very resilient and does not react strongly to currency issues. From an economic perspective, China's development is very good, and its middle class is growing very fast.

42e986bef0926a367428b6ee4297e5774d2dca35.sourceText: 办公室的执行主席约翰森认为增长部分归功于?#32654;国品牌?#39033;目，这个项目的资金来源是私人捐款和联邦政府根据签证豁免计划向国际游客征收的费用。
42e986bef0926a367428b6ee4297e5774d2dca35.translatedText: Johnson, the office's executive chairman, attributes the growth in part to the national branding program, which is funded through private donations and fees levied by the federal government on international visitors under the Visa Waiver Program.

172e917b462fc07316bd5189919a95f23677092c.sourceText: 除了联邦的支持外，亚利桑那州过去四年也有驻中国的旅游和贸易代表。约翰森说，州政府知道中国是个重要市场。
172e917b462fc07316bd5189919a95f23677092c.translatedText: In addition to federal support, Arizona has had tourism and trade representatives stationed in China for the past four years. Johnson said the state government knows China is an important market.

4e4c30be5ab96a2164699cffcc280d4890018954.sourceText: 亚利桑那州也被称为大峡谷州。旅游办公室发言人斯科特?#37011;恩指出，中国人是社交媒体的积极追随者，当亲朋好友在社交媒体上张贴自己在大峡谷的照片，看到的人也会想来此地旅游。
4e4c30be5ab96a2164699cffcc280d4890018954.translatedText: Arizona is also known as the Grand Canyon State. Tourism Office spokesman Scott? #37011; En pointed out that the Chinese are active followers of social media. When relatives and friends post photos of themselves at the Grand Canyon on social media, people who see them will also want to travel here.

1e4b4f947bc52af2c603ae690d3ae8692eca7f58.sourceText: 道林说，亚利桑那州北部一直吸引大量中国游客，现在的区别是，中国游客能在全州各地玩的更久、花费更多。
1e4b4f947bc52af2c603ae690d3ae8692eca7f58.translatedText: Dowling said northern Arizona has always attracted a large number of Chinese tourists, but the difference now is that Chinese tourists can stay longer and spend more throughout the state.

bdcb1ce81f050dcc912b190ee14b0d68664d46ac.sourceText: 邓恩还指出招揽中国游客对亚利桑那州的经济效益。他说，中国人像疯了一样购物。不仅帮了卖货物的零售商，也帮了州和地方政府的税收。
bdcb1ce81f050dcc912b190ee14b0d68664d46ac.translatedText: Dunn also pointed to the economic benefits to Arizona of attracting Chinese tourists. He said the Chinese were shopping like crazy. Not only does it help retailers selling goods, but it also helps state and local governments collect taxes.

46763ccf32dfb4193ef4bbf7f0f414f02686ec2a.sourceText: 根据美国商务部的统计，中国游客2015年在美国花费270亿美元。亚利桑那州旅游办公室做的一项研究显示，4300万美国和国际游客2016年在亚利桑那州花费了2110万美元，比前一年增加了一个百分点，如果排除燃料价格下跌的因素，游客在吃喝玩乐和住宿的花费实际上比前一年至少增长百分之三。
46763ccf32dfb4193ef4bbf7f0f414f02686ec2a.translatedText: According to statistics from the U.S. Department of Commerce, Chinese tourists spent $27 billion in the United States in 2015. A study done by the Arizona Office of Tourism shows that 43 million U.S. and international visitors spent $21.1 million in Arizona in 2016, an increase of one percentage point from the previous year. If you exclude the factor of lower fuel prices, tourists' spending on food, entertainment, entertainment and accommodation actually increased by at least three percent from the previous year.

bd8d4350878870c25260f87b8ae52ca28040dab6.sourceText: 亚利桑那州下一个四年宣传计划不会忽视国际游客，因为他们来访的停留时间比国内游客更长。
bd8d4350878870c25260f87b8ae52ca28040dab6.translatedText: Arizona’s next four-year promotion plan will not ignore international visitors because they visit and stay longer than domestic visitors.

14a7b93d29d60eef25fda933a07d434d2d1b7798.sourceText: 亚利桑那州旅游办公室的宣传计划可能有个软肋，今年夏天破纪录的高温，导致凤凰城机场的飞机无法起飞，成为新闻的一个热门。不过约翰森表示，因为天气热而迟飞几分钟，应该比在冰天雪地滞留
14a7b93d29d60eef25fda933a07d434d2d1b7798.translatedText: There may be a weakness in the Arizona tourism office's promotional plan. This summer's record-breaking high temperatures made the Phoenix airport unable to take off, making it a hot news item. However, Johnson said that being delayed for a few minutes due to hot weather should be better than being stranded in ice and snow.

75d41e1ede85a0918fd2e18ef6c7d612cd5a72d3.sourceText: 外媒盘点2017年十大商业丑闻：苹果、三星等在列
75d41e1ede85a0918fd2e18ef6c7d612cd5a72d3.translatedText: Foreign media took stock of the top ten business scandals in 2017: Apple, Samsung, etc. were listed

b88eb1f0f809907e02b1c1c501a58344d7bb90fe.sourceText: 外媒盘点2017年十大商业丑闻：苹果、三星等在列 来源：财富中文网 虽然2017年股东表面上没出什么大…
b88eb1f0f809907e02b1c1c501a58344d7bb90fe.translatedText: Foreign media took stock of the top ten business scandals in 2017: Apple, Samsung, etc. were listed Source: Fortune Chinese Although on the surface nothing big happened to shareholders in 2017...

0ca0844576af1f6228580bb1f92daf3cd414585d.sourceText: 虽然2017年股东表面上没出什么大事，但实际上各种丑剧和公关失败案例层出不穷。
0ca0844576af1f6228580bb1f92daf3cd414585d.translatedText: Although on the surface nothing big happened to shareholders in 2017, in fact there were endless cases of scandals and public relations failures.

c1964479189be83a9232a0280780f65b236607f2.sourceText: 这一年，三星深陷行贿丑闻，韦恩斯坦公司遭性骚扰指控，美联航”拖拽”乘客造成流血事件历历在目，不过其他公司大体上比较平静。
c1964479189be83a9232a0280780f65b236607f2.translatedText: This year, Samsung was embroiled in a bribery scandal, the Weinstein Company was accused of sexual harassment, and United Airlines "drags" passengers causing bloodshed, but other companies have generally been relatively calm.

2882e079605323cd29f6e30f6105257651f50234.sourceText: 以下列举了2017年商业界最大的几起丑闻：
2882e079605323cd29f6e30f6105257651f50234.translatedText: > Here are some of the biggest scandals in the business world in 2017:

e96bdb25a142bf8bdb0f76b98637d08a3b6f4825.sourceText: 美联航拖拽乘客下飞机导致受伤事件
e96bdb25a142bf8bdb0f76b98637d08a3b6f4825.translatedText: United Airlines dragged a passenger off the plane causing injuries

a825f58d3b3af781db8018ec3f190b6aed34a458.sourceText: 2017年3月2日，美国商务部在华盛顿特区举办的2017航空峰会上，美联航首席执行官奥斯卡.穆尼奥斯发表演讲。Kristoffer Tripplaar?Sipa USA via AP
a825f58d3b3af781db8018ec3f190b6aed34a458.translatedText: On March 2, 2017, at the 2017 Aviation Summit hosted by the U.S. Department of Commerce in Washington, D.C., United Airlines CEO Oscar Munoz delivered a speech. Kristoffer Tripplaar?Sipa USA via AP

a082d38f6d30083cd662d692b0c5af228565073d.sourceText: 2017年4月，美联航一架航班出现超额订票，两名安保人员将一位不愿下飞机的乘客强行拖走导致流血受伤，也引发全球对美联航的指责。视频显示，争吵中69岁的杜成德（David Dao）头部撞击到扶手，毛衣被拉至胸口露出肚子，眼镜也歪在一边，最后躺在地上由安保人员拖出过道下了飞机。
a082d38f6d30083cd662d692b0c5af228565073d.translatedText: In April 2017, a United Airlines flight was overbooked. Two security personnel forcibly dragged a passenger who was unwilling to get off the plane, causing bleeding and injuries. This also triggered global criticism of United Airlines. The video shows that during the argument, 69-year-old David Dao hit his head on the armrest, his sweater was pulled up to his chest to expose his stomach, and his glasses were tilted to one side. He finally lay on the ground and was dragged out of the aisle by security personnel and got off the plane.

40c55d55a2552820ce7456a8312eb2462b487115.sourceText: 全球消费者看到这一幕都很震惊，迅速发起抵制行动。之后美联航首席执行官就此事道歉时却一副洗白姿态，只说”该事件令所有美联航员工感到难过”，却低估了视频对观众造成的负面影响，以及乘客对航空产业的巨大不满。更给伤口上撒盐的是，媒体报道显示穆尼奥斯在写给员工的信中骂杜成德是个”破坏分子，而且故意挑衅”。
40c55d55a2552820ce7456a8312eb2462b487115.translatedText: Consumers around the world were shocked when they saw this scene and quickly launched a boycott. Later, when the CEO of United Airlines apologized for the incident, he appeared to be white-washing it. He only said that "this incident saddens all United employees." However, he underestimated the negative impact of the video on viewers and the huge dissatisfaction of passengers with the aviation industry. To add salt to the wound, media reports showed that Muñoz called Du Chengde a "saboteur and deliberately provocative" in a letter to employees.

8d764a1c102611b032928754a44b7ece2da63755.sourceText: 虽然该事件对美联航利润影响不太大，但乘客对航空服务多年积怨借此事件集中爆发。
8d764a1c102611b032928754a44b7ece2da63755.translatedText: Although the incident did not have a significant impact on United Airlines' profits, the incident focused on the resentment that passengers have had for air services for many years.

4affb1b2938a9f2f9d50019093d40bb219f563b4.sourceText: 虽然此后杜成德与美联航庭外和解，但此事引发的对航空业巨大不满并未停止。美国交通部数据显示，事件发生后六个月里，与航空有关的投诉增加了13%。
4affb1b2938a9f2f9d50019093d40bb219f563b4.translatedText: Although Du Chengde and United Airlines settled out of court, the huge dissatisfaction with the aviation industry caused by this matter has not stopped. U.S. Department of Transportation data shows that aviation-related complaints increased by 13% in the six months after the incident.

d69daaeafcdc4a62a2adca7ea15fd71684a765c6.sourceText: 2017年多家公司深陷性骚扰指控丑闻，其中也包括娱乐业巨头21世纪福克斯。
d69daaeafcdc4a62a2adca7ea15fd71684a765c6.translatedText: In 2017, many companies were involved in sexual harassment accusation scandals, including the entertainment giant 21st Century Fox.

77181bcfd7de82a70221ece252ac70594bc153eb.sourceText: 2016年福克斯的麻烦就开始了，前主持人格雷琴.卡尔森指控福克斯新闻首席执行官罗杰.艾尔斯性骚扰。但事情并未就此打住。4月有报道称，明星主播比尔.奥莱利曾付给五位女性数百万美元平息性骚扰指控。此事曝光后，广告主立刻暂停了向”奥莱利实情”节目的投放。当月奥莱利便离开电视台。
77181bcfd7de82a70221ece252ac70594bc153eb.translatedText: > Fox’s troubles began in 2016, when former host Gretchen Carlson accused Fox News CEO Roger Ailes of sexual harassment. But it didn't stop there. In April, it was reported that celebrity anchor Bill O'Reilly had paid five women millions of dollars to settle sexual harassment accusations. After the incident came to light, advertisers immediately suspended advertising for "O'Reilly Facts." O'Reilly left the network that month.

c12f3c37caefa50dc17a706372c104b968b69871.sourceText: 投资者知道此事后都非常生气，因为出现性骚扰丑闻代表这家公司文化有严重问题。之后又有报道称，福克斯知晓奥莱斯身受指控后还考虑1月继续请他工作，给愤怒的公众舆论火上浇油。
c12f3c37caefa50dc17a706372c104b968b69871.translatedText: Investors were very angry when they found out about this, because the sexual harassment scandal represents a serious problem with the company's culture. Later, reports emerged that Fox was considering hiring Oles for a job in January after learning of the charges against him, adding fuel to the angry public opinion.

0436769fbdcd59a59d37f228e3d69d5d0ab7d4a4.sourceText: 因此，福克斯11月同意支付9000万美元平息与奥莱利和艾尔斯丑闻相关的投资者指控，还专门成立了内部委员会负责确保正常的工作环境。
0436769fbdcd59a59d37f228e3d69d5d0ab7d4a4.translatedText: Therefore, Fox agreed in November to pay $90 million to settle investor accusations related to the O'Reilly and Ailes scandals, and also established an internal committee to ensure a normal working environment.

b2f4adfc92174fcfebec12821da34cd409a8f45a.sourceText: 奥莱利拒绝认错，福克斯也没承认做错。
b2f4adfc92174fcfebec12821da34cd409a8f45a.translatedText: O'Reilly refused to admit wrongdoing, and Foxx did not admit wrongdoing.

42c4e19c305d0d9a11abe9785c18f40fcb387083.sourceText: 总统大选后的一年里，议会和互联网巨头们都在重新思考民主议程中自己扮演的角色。
42c4e19c305d0d9a11abe9785c18f40fcb387083.translatedText: In the year since the presidential election, both Congress and the internet giants are rethinking their role in the democratic agenda.

098e74213419cb53667cf6fb33caed667b9047d0.sourceText: 很多人猜测社交媒体上充斥的假新闻可能影响了2016年大选，但看Facebook和谷歌等业内巨头都拒绝承认。
098e74213419cb53667cf6fb33caed667b9047d0.translatedText: Many people speculate that fake news on social media may have affected the 2016 election, but industry giants such as Facebook and Google have refused to admit it.

7c775e14892546d7c20538b8ec36d0eef60ba461.sourceText: 2017年情况发生变化，大部分收入来自互联网广告的Facebook和谷歌都表示，发现与俄罗斯政府相关的账号。Facebook称在平台上发现约3000条与俄罗斯相关的广告购买订单，背后的目的都是分裂美国。谷歌发现与俄罗斯有关的公司在YouTube和Gmail上购买了上万条广告。Twitter也表示，俄罗斯政府支持的媒体”今日俄罗斯”2016年在其平台上购买了27.4万美元的广告。
7c775e14892546d7c20538b8ec36d0eef60ba461.translatedText: That changed in 2017, when Facebook and Google, which generate most of their revenue from internet advertising, said they had discovered accounts linked to the Russian government. Facebook said it found about 3,000 Russian-related ad purchase orders on the platform, with the purpose of splitting the United States. Google found that companies with ties to Russia purchased tens of thousands of ads on YouTube and Gmail. Twitter also said that Russia Today, a Russian government-backed media outlet, purchased $274,000 in advertising on its platform in 2016.

4a64b73c4d1514fe95bac49cdd35021eb2a5a3f7.sourceText: 看起来问题暂时还没法彻底解决。Twitter、Facebook和谷歌仍在调查平台上与俄罗斯有关的活动。议会对该领域的态度日渐强硬，有些人已经开始质疑各巨头吸引用户的方式，各巨头的麻烦远未休止。
4a64b73c4d1514fe95bac49cdd35021eb2a5a3f7.translatedText: It seems that the problem cannot be completely solved yet. Twitter, Facebook and Google are still investigating Russia-related activity on their platforms. Parliament has become increasingly tough on the field, and some have begun to question the way giants attract users. The giants' troubles are far from over.

24a38a53c9e87548667bd37167378a49bf53b855.translatedText: Uber has been in accidents again and again

bcb0e94320c4ca3c197b249e760f10232a01497f.sourceText: 如果说之前Uber遇到的法律纠纷就像开车过减速带的颠簸，那么2017年Uber遇到的事堪称高速路上10辆车大追尾。前有性骚扰指控，后有针对创始人卡兰尼克领导能力的质疑，甚至还有犯罪调查。
bcb0e94320c4ca3c197b249e760f10232a01497f.translatedText: If the previous legal disputes that Uber encountered were like driving over a bumpy speed bump, then what happened to Uber in 2017 was like a 10-car rear-end collision on the highway. There were sexual harassment accusations before, and later there were questions about founder Kalanick’s leadership, and even criminal investigations.

6562a3a8104b8f0d36e36543454d301202fc1a69.sourceText: 2月，前员工苏珊.富勒指控Uber内部性骚扰频繁出现。5月，司法部宣布对Uber开展犯罪调查，因为Uber被指使用名叫”Greyball”的软件在某些地区非法运营时规避地方监管者调查。结果是，6月卡兰尼克离职，给接任者棗时任Expedia首席执行官的达拉.克斯罗萨西留下重整公司的巨大烂摊子。
6562a3a8104b8f0d36e36543454d301202fc1a69.translatedText: In February, former employee Susan Fuller accused Uber of frequent sexual harassment. In May, the Justice Department announced a criminal investigation into Uber over allegations that it used software called "Greyball" to circumvent local regulators when operating illegally in certain areas. As a result, Kalanick left in June, leaving his successor, then-Expedia CEO Dara Kosloshahi, with a huge mess to restructure the company.

b02a8bb3cb709da94471f20ad2f95a6510068054.sourceText: 接下来发生的事导致收拾烂摊子几乎变成”不可能的任务”：就在克斯罗萨西出任后不久，英国伦敦就宣布取缔Uber，11月有消息称Uber数据库遭黑，约5700万用户资料有泄露风险。
b02a8bb3cb709da94471f20ad2f95a6510068054.translatedText: What happened next made cleaning up the mess almost an "impossible task": Shortly after Korosashi took office, London, England, announced a ban on Uber. In November, it was reported that Uber's database was hacked, and about 57 million user data were at risk of being leaked.

005e27b4c02ba02612aaa668c8767ff1f97127a1.sourceText: 跟坐美联航飞机不一样，Uber用户选择其实很多，转头就可以选择豪华出租车。而且由于Uber犯错连连，市场份额也被竞争对手Lyft抢走，之前一年Uber市场份额为84%，2017年降至74%。
005e27b4c02ba02612aaa668c8767ff1f97127a1.translatedText: Unlike flying on United Airlines, Uber users actually have many choices, and they can choose luxury taxis right away. And due to Uber's repeated mistakes, its market share was also taken away by competitor Lyft. Uber's market share was 84% ​​in the previous year, and fell to 74% in 2017.

1357b96110419035ae5bc79738b62d045e139d80.sourceText: Uber估值曾高达680亿美元。但出这么多事后，日本银行软银收购其股份时估值已降至480亿美元。
1357b96110419035ae5bc79738b62d045e139d80.translatedText: Uber’s valuation was once as high as US$68 billion. But after so much happened, the valuation had dropped to US$48 billion when Japanese bank SoftBank acquired its shares.

da882cf2566e03de6a85d54b476569fa3713ace1.sourceText: 哈维.韦恩斯坦遭多起性骚扰指控
da882cf2566e03de6a85d54b476569fa3713ace1.translatedText: Harvey Weinstein has been accused of multiple sexual harassments

f4ff75c5a908409069a591ab5976da8ab59ac15f.sourceText: 要说起韦恩斯坦的故事，好莱坞情节最曲折的电影都演不出来。
f4ff75c5a908409069a591ab5976da8ab59ac15f.translatedText: When it comes to Weinstein’s story, even the most twisted Hollywood movies can’t tell it.

649f62fb1f1e3635550d944189597a4fcd5e3cdb.sourceText: 从10月开始，100多位女演员指控好莱坞大佬韦恩斯坦数十年间存在性骚扰行为。韦恩斯坦道了歉，但这位数次荣获奥斯卡的金牌制作人还是被迫离开韦恩斯坦公司。而且道歉之后公众仍然对韦恩斯坦能数十年行为不当却安然无恙十分愤怒。
649f62fb1f1e3635550d944189597a4fcd5e3cdb.translatedText: Since October, more than 100 actresses have accused Hollywood tycoon Weinstein of decades of sexual harassment. Weinstein apologized, but the Oscar-winning producer was forced to leave the Weinstein Company. And even after the apology, the public was still furious that Weinstein could have behaved unscathed for decades.

d7085de6cca4b28ae1e10de7ed245e271307a528.sourceText: 据称韦恩斯坦为了避免对抗指控，曾聘请以色列情报机构摩萨德前探员跟踪指控者。但后来发现，韦恩斯坦之所以能掌握大权多年，靠的还不只是间谍和各种威胁，他还有很多亿万富翁朋友们保驾，虽然有迹象显示2015年韦恩斯坦曾挪用公司资金供私人使用。后来韦恩斯坦同意向公司偿还700万美元。
d7085de6cca4b28ae1e10de7ed245e271307a528.translatedText: It is alleged that Weinstein hired a former agent from the Israeli intelligence agency Mossad to track his accusers in order to avoid confronting the charges. But it was later discovered that Weinstein had been able to hold power for many years not only through spies and various threats. He also had many billionaire friends to protect him, although there were signs that Weinstein had misappropriated company funds for personal use in 2015. Weinstein later agreed to repay the company $7 million.

3e9fb8533761b4b006071aa6566fa3988a3f3f28.sourceText: 一系列指控最大的影响或许是，之后很多沉默的男男女女说出受到性骚扰的往事。
3e9fb8533761b4b006071aa6566fa3988a3f3f28.translatedText: Perhaps the biggest impact of the series of accusations is that many silent men and women later spoke out about their past experiences of sexual harassment.

00fc838a7a1baaf71f725f4b688f475759e10521.sourceText: 韦恩斯坦明确表示，未参与过任何”非自愿性行为”。
00fc838a7a1baaf71f725f4b688f475759e10521.translatedText: Weinstein made it clear that he had not participated in any "non-consensual sex."

a7926bf38f3da8194880b5c89ea15b854f280270.sourceText: 信用评, 级公司艾可飞赚取利润的方式主要是向金融机构和银行出售私人信息，而且经常是敏感的隐私信息。
a7926bf38f3da8194880b5c89ea15b854f280270.translatedText: The credit rating company Ecosystem makes profits mainly by selling private information, often sensitive private information, to financial institutions and banks.

a1862696fcd9cfc723dc1e1d3ee34d453cac1245.sourceText: 但9月艾可飞称遭遇史上最严重的数据泄露，约涉及1.45亿人，达到美国人口半数。
a1862696fcd9cfc723dc1e1d3ee34d453cac1245.translatedText: But in September, Economy said it had suffered the most serious data breach in history, involving approximately 145 million people, accounting for half of the U.S. population.

795aff147ea8582aef3ce1622460a5494618a15b.sourceText: 有消息称艾可飞3月就知道后来黑客利用的漏洞存在，一片哗然中首席执行官理查德.史密斯宣布下台，首席信息官和首席安全官也宣布离职。更可恶的是，艾可飞获知数据泄漏后又等了两个月才公布消息。
795aff147ea8582aef3ce1622460a5494618a15b.translatedText: It was reported that Ikefy knew about the existence of the vulnerability that was later exploited by hackers in March. In an uproar, CEO Richard Smith announced his resignation, and the chief information officer and chief security officer also announced their resignation. What's even more disgusting is that after learning about the data leak, Aikefei waited two months before announcing the news.

a250733d0804bd66a5de960dacd30be9a95447cd.sourceText: 此外，由于艾可飞高管在数据泄露消息公布前曾卖出价值约18亿美元的股票，司法部也开始调查是否存在内幕交易行为。
a250733d0804bd66a5de960dacd30be9a95447cd.translatedText: In addition, because Ecosystem executives sold about $1.8 billion worth of stock before the data leak was announced, the Department of Justice also began investigating whether there was insider trading.

1109bb448e3752a99d41f1727d98bbf96961efad.sourceText: 2016年，三星被Note 7手机电池爆炸折腾够呛。2017年则更糟，三星内部陷入混乱。
1109bb448e3752a99d41f1727d98bbf96961efad.translatedText: In 2016, Samsung was troubled by the explosion of the Note 7 mobile phone battery. 2017 was even worse, with Samsung in chaos.

105f264763191a878d7295f3cd9c772963e55751.sourceText: 三星集团向来由家族掌管，继承人李在镕即将接班，不料卷进韩国前总统朴槿惠政治丑闻被捕入狱，三星面临接班人空缺的严重问题。
105f264763191a878d7295f3cd9c772963e55751.translatedText: Samsung Group has always been run by the family. The heir Lee Jae-yong is about to take over. Unexpectedly, he was involved in the political scandal of former South Korean President Park Geun-hye and was imprisoned. Samsung is facing a serious problem of successor vacancy.

e1ed55e86a048aae9270cf420257de9a6f4357d3.sourceText: 如今李在镕被指向朴槿惠行贿、挪用公款以及隐瞒海外资产，可能面临五年（也可能长达12年）牢狱之灾。
e1ed55e86a048aae9270cf420257de9a6f4357d3.translatedText: Lee Jae-yong is now accused of bribing Park Geun-hye, embezzling public funds and concealing overseas assets. He may face five years (or up to 12 years) in prison.

0663216daa3e913d097439535d55d1f12a44f63b.sourceText: 10月，三星电子联合首席执行官权五铉也宣布辞职，称当前三星的领导层面临严重危机。
0663216daa3e913d097439535d55d1f12a44f63b.translatedText: In October, Samsung Electronics co-CEO Kwon Oh-hyun also announced his resignation, saying that Samsung's leadership is currently facing a serious crisis.

57e304e76ec159041a41f989a802d22231b8da1c.sourceText: ”眼下我们面临前所未有的全面危机，现在全公司应该振作精神重新开始，要启用年轻领导者，在变化迅速的IT行业更快处理各种新挑战，”权五铉在声明中称。
57e304e76ec159041a41f989a802d22231b8da1c.translatedText: "Right now, we are facing an unprecedented comprehensive crisis. Now the whole company should cheer up and start anew, using young leaders to deal with various new challenges faster in the rapidly changing IT industry," Kwon Oh-hyun said in the statement.

03c0130baf00a45bafcbb13b3efa7ef872c2e750.sourceText: 虽然三星长期发展存疑，但短期来看似乎没什么危机。三季度财报显示三星利润创纪录地达到128亿美元，几乎为之前一年的三倍。
03c0130baf00a45bafcbb13b3efa7ef872c2e750.translatedText: Although Samsung's long-term development is questionable, there seems to be no crisis in the short term. The third quarter financial report showed that Samsung’s profit reached a record US$12.8 billion, almost three times the previous year.

9eb378157be1d8a42f8b2c60fda2ff9911d35120.sourceText: 神户钢铁、三菱材料，以及日本公司治理问题
9eb378157be1d8a42f8b2c60fda2ff9911d35120.translatedText: Kobe Steel, Mitsubishi Materials, and Japanese corporate governance issues

7bdfbcc03f22df3a7c34f1390fc995c951a49095.sourceText: 到2017年三季度，日本GDP实现2001年以来持续增长，创下记录。但经济稳步复苏背后却是一波日本大公司产品质量造假的丑闻，也引发外界对日本制造强国地位的质疑。
7bdfbcc03f22df3a7c34f1390fc995c951a49095.translatedText: By the third quarter of 2017, Japan's GDP had achieved sustained growth since 2001, setting a record. But behind the steady recovery of the economy is a wave of scandals involving product quality fraud by major Japanese companies, which has also raised questions about Japan's status as a manufacturing powerhouse.

71e1b92db14f2ff91fedc41a5df4dc86e0200352.sourceText: 10月，神户钢铁承认2007年以来出售给波音、福特、丰田等公司的部分材料信息造假。三菱材料承认，出售给约274个客户的汽车和飞机零部件数据造假。制造业巨头东丽也承认，2008年以来出售的加固轮胎绳索数据不实。
71e1b92db14f2ff91fedc41a5df4dc86e0200352.translatedText: In October, Kobe Steel admitted that it had falsified information on some materials sold to Boeing, Ford, Toyota and other companies since 2007. Mitsubishi Materials admitted that it had fabricated data on automobile and aircraft parts sold to about 274 customers. Manufacturing giant Toray also admitted that data on reinforced tire ropes sold since 2008 were inaccurate.

680f8cbbae5b7f2426fc51d9d5fb7b049d2882b8.sourceText: 2017年，汽车公司日产和斯巴鲁各召回120万辆和39.5万辆汽车，因为数十年里曾让无资质的检验员负责新车出厂前的整车检查。
680f8cbbae5b7f2426fc51d9d5fb7b049d2882b8.translatedText: In 2017, car companies Nissan and Subaru recalled 1.2 million and 395,000 vehicles each because for decades they had used unqualified inspectors to inspect new cars before they left the factory.

9db165f40770ce4fc07c7a6c64f2a55932047224.sourceText: 虽然该丑闻中并非涉及大规模质量问题，但对日本制造业来说影响很负面。如今中国和韩国制造业凭借低成本在市场上发展迅速，而日本制造一直靠优秀品质竞争高端市场。
9db165f40770ce4fc07c7a6c64f2a55932047224.translatedText: Although the scandal does not involve large-scale quality problems, it has a very negative impact on Japanese manufacturing. Today, Chinese and Korean manufacturing industries are developing rapidly in the market with low costs, while Japanese manufacturing has always relied on excellent quality to compete in the high-end market.

c94733bdc07cf6a55519985df36f0c810d19afe3.sourceText: 不过也有分析师表示，之所以近几个月接连出现质量方面的丑闻，也许是日本企业的质量标准过高了。
c94733bdc07cf6a55519985df36f0c810d19afe3.translatedText: However, some analysts said that the reason why quality scandals have appeared one after another in recent months may be that the quality standards of Japanese companies are too high.

c1a000e9edca11e8070e01021f1d6965e659540d.sourceText: 自从2016年因数千万虚假账户失去消费者信任，富国银行一直承诺透明和推动改革，希望重新争取用户。
c1a000e9edca11e8070e01021f1d6965e659540d.translatedText: > Since losing consumer trust due to tens of millions of fake accounts in 2016, Wells Fargo has promised transparency and promoted reforms in the hope of regaining users.

53698104a19453ed1d073049f77c8926d8f32a22.sourceText: 但2017年富国银行问题变得更严重，因为其承认曾在57万客户不需要的前提下收取汽车保险费用。此举导致约2万客户车辆被收回。富国银行表示将支付8000万美元作为赔偿。后来富国银行个人银行负责人和零售银行部门70位左右高级管理人员也因此被开。
53698104a19453ed1d073049f77c8926d8f32a22.translatedText: But Wells Fargo's problems became more serious in 2017 when it admitted that it had charged 570,000 customers for auto insurance when they didn't need it. The move resulted in about 20,000 customer vehicles being repossessed. Wells Fargo said it would pay $80 million in compensation. Later, the head of Wells Fargo's personal banking department and about 70 senior managers in its retail banking department were also fired.

4790347773ab10319d941d0054ce2675089a04e3.sourceText: 同在2017年，富国银行还承认在客户不知情时开设了140万个虚假账户，此前一年已经承认开设210万个假账户。
4790347773ab10319d941d0054ce2675089a04e3.translatedText: Also in 2017, Wells Fargo also admitted to opening 1.4 million fake accounts without customers' knowledge. The previous year, it had admitted to opening 2.1 million fake accounts.

e82fc04c397f99d9afa8d9a84c504573a604764b.sourceText: 临近年末，科技巨头苹果却遭遇巨大危机，因为报道称苹果为解决电池老化问题故意降低旧版iPhone运行速度。
e82fc04c397f99d9afa8d9a84c504573a604764b.translatedText: Near the end of the year, the technology giant Apple encountered a huge crisis because of reports that Apple deliberately slowed down the running speed of older iPhones to solve the problem of battery aging.

b38dc3e0d0445fb5a107d261c0cd169cab092463.sourceText: 这也印证了一些苹果用户长期以来的阴谋论：即每次发售新版之后，苹果会故意降低旧版手机运行速度以强迫用户升级。如今已有用户因苹果不事先通知便降低设备运行速度告上法庭。
b38dc3e0d0445fb5a107d261c0cd169cab092463.translatedText: This also confirms the long-standing conspiracy theory of some Apple users: that every time a new version is released, Apple will deliberately slow down the running speed of older mobile phones to force users to upgrade. Already, users are suing Apple for slowing down their devices without prior notice.

cd295ef22a06c74b4d0e0a1ed077aaa8e1d5208a.sourceText: 苹果方面的回应首先是为降低旧版iPhone速度道歉，称之为”误解”，随后宣布降价为用户更换电池，之前价格为79美元，现降为29美元。苹果称，更换电池后手机运行速度便会变快。
cd295ef22a06c74b4d0e0a1ed077aaa8e1d5208a.translatedText: Apple's response was first to apologize for slowing down the old iPhone, calling it a "misunderstanding", and then announced a price reduction for users to replace the battery. The previous price was US$79, but now it is reduced to US$29. Apple says the phone will run faster after replacing the battery.

aa7877fa3819fe4e21a6adc6e0d41bdc18da0c4e.sourceText: 美国省钱方法 几点去购物最优惠？
aa7877fa3819fe4e21a6adc6e0d41bdc18da0c4e.translatedText: Ways to save money in the United States: When is the best time to go shopping?

df5cef739c3536f1ef725b9ceb38e54ae1fa9324.sourceText: 美国省钱方法 几点去购物最优惠？ 美国世纪大乾旱，很多人担心国家的粮仓，食品价格上涨 事实上，在美…
df5cef739c3536f1ef725b9ceb38e54ae1fa9324.translatedText: How to save money in the United States: When is the best time to go shopping? The drought of the century in the United States, many people are worried about the country's breadbasket, and food prices are rising. In fact, in the United States...

8be072a00a03b7eea77219cd8ddcf0583dab44d0.sourceText: 美国世纪大乾旱，很多人担心国家的粮仓，食品价格上涨
8be072a00a03b7eea77219cd8ddcf0583dab44d0.translatedText: The drought of the century in the United States, many people are worried about the country's breadbasket, and food prices are rising

e124692f4d96d6a74cece7608ab8748cd6d11530.sourceText: 事实上，在美国，如果知道什么时候购买食物，可能会节省很多钱。以下是一些指导原则：
e124692f4d96d6a74cece7608ab8748cd6d11530.translatedText: In fact, in the United States, if you know when to buy food, you may save a lot of money. Here are some guidelines:

d377f3301283f3c263ca2ed2624546c0c0b88e18.sourceText: 肉类： 每週一至週五的早上，可说是最佳购买肉类的时间，消费者经常看到”特价”的标志，必须在当天中午前出售，甚至可能会发现50%或更多的折扣。
d377f3301283f3c263ca2ed2624546c0c0b88e18.translatedText: Meat: The best time to buy meat is in the morning from Monday to Friday. Consumers often see "special offer" signs that must be sold before noon that day, and may even find discounts of 50% or more.

61192522b9b02701636e20f753a79392061b98a0.sourceText: 时令蔬果： 购买时令的水果和蔬菜，价格通常较低，因为产量较多，杂货店也不希望看到它们最终腐烂。美国农业部在网站列出的时令水果和蔬菜的最佳购买时机。
61192522b9b02701636e20f753a79392061b98a0.translatedText: Seasonal Fruits and Vegetables: Buy fruits and vegetables that are in season, usually at lower prices because there are more of them produced, and grocers don’t want to see them end up rotting. The USDA website lists the best times to buy seasonal fruits and vegetables.

9491152d66a51194bcd1022d7e79ce27cc5637af.sourceText: 鸡蛋： 大多数的购物者可能不知道，当接近逾期之时，杂货店把鸡蛋减价销售。对于某些食品來說，逾期的日期，等同于食品可以安全吃用的最后一天限期。但是，鸡蛋可以在逾期后3至5个星期，仍是放心食用，因为不用担心而可购买减价鸡蛋。
9491152d66a51194bcd1022d7e79ce27cc5637af.translatedText: Eggs: Most shoppers may not know that grocery stores put eggs on sale when they are close to their expiration date. For some foods, the expiration date is equivalent to the last day the food is safe to eat. However, eggs can be eaten 3 to 5 weeks after the expiration date, because you don’t have to worry and can buy eggs at reduced prices.

42274496c02f4d160ca724ab3209cadc55ad440d.sourceText: 已熟食品： 如果你喜欢烤鸡，寿司和其他已熟食物，它们可能是更为昂贵的。但是，在杂货店关闭前一个小时，你可以前往购买，因为许多商店不会把已煮熟食物，留待翌日销售，预计大约有40%或以上的折扣。
42274496c02f4d160ca724ab3209cadc55ad440d.translatedText: >Cooked Food: If you like grilled chicken, sushi and other cooked foods, they may be more expensive. However, you can go shopping an hour before the grocery store closes because many stores will not hold cooked food for sale the next day, and expect discounts of around 40% or more.

21fcd120afb6427cfb69b892f799639cd788bf9b.sourceText: 麵包和烘焙食品： 傍晚和晚上，一些商店会将麵包等降价大约50%，否则，商店也随将麵包等弃置。此外，越来越多的一元店销售的麵包，价钱比较杂货店便宜一半到三分之一。
21fcd120afb6427cfb69b892f799639cd788bf9b.translatedText: Bread and baked goods: In the evening and evening, some stores will reduce the price of bread and other products by about 50%, otherwise the store will discard the bread and other products. In addition, an increasing number of dollar stores sell bread that is half to one-third cheaper than grocery stores.

56d1da14af15b5303147e41f671a73d90b903159.sourceText: 冷冻火鸡： 在感恩节和圣诞节之前，有一些食品杂货商会降低火鸡的价格，以吸引消费者，但是，最好的价格往往是假期结束之后，商家也试图促销未售出的火鸡，免得佔用了大量的空间。
56d1da14af15b5303147e41f671a73d90b903159.translatedText: Frozen turkeys: Before Thanksgiving and Christmas, some grocers will lower the price of turkeys to attract consumers. However, the best prices are often after the holidays are over, and merchants also try to promote unsold turkeys so as not to take up a lot of space.

0a53fbd7b80e5a5bdc6152966c85888666baac83.sourceText: 礼品券： 使用它来购买日常用品，例如番茄酱，卫生纸，人造黄油和穀类。消费者都知道週日出版的报纸，送上大量的优惠券，但是，最精明的疯狂优惠券消费者，均知道每月1日，很多的网站是最狂热的送出优惠券，例如：coupons.com，redplum.com，thriftytiff.com等，均报价新一轮的优惠券。
0a53fbd7b80e5a5bdc6152966c85888666baac83.translatedText: Gift Voucher: Use it to buy everyday items such as ketchup, toilet paper, margarine and cereal. Consumers all know that newspapers published on Sundays send out a large number of coupons, but the most savvy coupon-crazy consumers know that on the 1st of every month, many websites are the most enthusiastic about sending out coupons, such as coupons.com, redplum.com, thriftytiff.com, etc., all offering a new round of coupons.

c7364c4589e77ea1a76adc62f5d8d5cc169bfaa3.sourceText: 超市购买杂物： 週三是最好的一天。因为，每週超市杂货店的减价销售，几乎总是在週三开始。如果你想购买减价货品，又不会担心受欢迎的项目早已销售，週三是最好的选择，消费者也不多。
c7364c4589e77ea1a76adc62f5d8d5cc169bfaa3.translatedText: Supermarket shopping for groceries: Wednesday is the best day. Because weekly supermarket and grocery sales almost always start on Wednesday. If you want to buy something on sale without worrying about popular items already sold out, Wednesday is your best bet when there aren't many shoppers.

fab108b6f4f572071a9a49653c7ca9cdf5036cb4.sourceText: 为了减少冲动购买和省钱，消息者应该做一个列表，只购买清单上的货品，尽量每週一次，甚至不要带孩子。
fab108b6f4f572071a9a49653c7ca9cdf5036cb4.translatedText: In order to reduce impulse buying and save money, the informant should make a list and only buy the items on the list, try to buy them once a week, even without children.

90a382edbbf74ea73567aa6286ea8cb7df85b125.sourceText: 去年百万人获美国绿卡 中国全球排第五
90a382edbbf74ea73567aa6286ea8cb7df85b125.translatedText: Last year, one million people received US green cards, China ranked fifth in the world

9200b3027c4c77e19e1d014f4fc412a5c4cc8c3e.sourceText: 去年百万人获美国绿卡 中国全球排第五 《夏威夷记者》网站称，美国国土安全部发布的最新数据显示，去年约100…
9200b3027c4c77e19e1d014f4fc412a5c4cc8c3e.translatedText: Last year, one million people received US green cards, China ranked fifth in the world, "Hawaii Reporter" website said that the latest data released by the US Department of Homeland Security showed that last year, about 100...

cffe4097f829d2f813e3c7f8579491d7c6e02a80.sourceText: 去年百万人获美国绿卡 中国全球排第五 《夏威夷记者》网站称，美国国土安全部发布的最新数据显示，去年约100万人成为美国公民，逾100万人获得绿卡。这个数据显示，新绿卡持有人的数量和归化公民的数量，在过去几年当中相当稳定，去年归化人数有小小增加。移民政策研究中心研究员Claire Bergeron将入籍增加归因于2012年总统大选。她说：”在总统大选前，有许多团体努力敦促人们入籍。今年看到许多大规模的努力来自于拉丁族裔团体。拉丁裔选民包括许多新公民帮助奥巴马总统连任并增强了他所属的民主党在国会的力量。” 据最新发布的数据，2012年总共757,434人归化成为公民，比前一年的694,193增加。新公民人数前五大来源国依次是：墨西哥、菲律宾、印度、多米尼加和中国。其中31,868中国公民入籍成为美国公民。 2011—2012年间，出生于多米尼加和古巴的移民归化人数增加最多。越南、南韩、巴基斯坦、伊朗、尼日利亚和索马里位列归化者来源国的前20名。欧洲国家中，仅英国及乌克兰排名在前20名。 越来越多的国会议员呼吁考虑让1,150万非法移民”转正”。但是其办法及所需时间的长短是国会两党激烈辩论的焦点。 去年，美国颁发绿卡给1,031,631名外国公民。这使他们可以永久在美国生活和工作，并在五年后能成为美国公民。墨西哥、中国和印度是永久居民的三大来源国。伊拉克、缅甸、孟加拉和埃塞俄比亚的人位于前20名。 大多数绿卡持有人此前已经生活在美国。将近66%的人获得绿卡是因为跟美国公民或另一个绿卡持有人的家庭关系。决定谁获得绿卡的制度是一个复杂的过程，一般而言，美国公民或永久居民的家庭成员、拥有美国企业需要的就业技能的外国人有优先权。 一些移民改革者建议，为非法移民建立一个新的绿卡类别，而其他人反对这个他们认为是对违法者进行”大赦”的做法。 华盛顿的研究团体”城市研究所”的移民专家Erwin DeLeon说，新的数据趋势将在未来10年呈现，因为国会现在正在为移民改革而努力，他说：“如果国会今年或明年通过移民改革，”到2020年你将看到永久居民和新公民人数出现一个大的飙升。” Claire Bergeron表示，有人建议非归化移民等10年才可以成为合法移民，再等5年才可以归化成为美国人。
cffe4097f829d2f813e3c7f8579491d7c6e02a80.translatedText: Last year, one million people received US green cards, China ranked fifth in the world. The "Hawaii Reporter" website stated that the latest data released by the U.S. Department of Homeland Security showed that about 1 million people became U.S. citizens last year and more than 1 million people obtained green cards. This data shows that the number of new green card holders and naturalized citizens has been quite stable in the past few years, with a slight increase in the number of naturalized citizens last year. Claire Bergeron, a researcher at the Center for Immigration Policy Research, attributes the increase in naturalization to the 2012 presidential election. "Ahead of the presidential election, there are many group efforts to urge people to naturalize, and this year we've seen a lot of large-scale efforts from Latino groups. Latino voters, including many new citizens, helped re-elect President Obama and strengthened his Democratic Party in Congress," she said. A total of 757,434 people naturalized as citizens in 2012, up from 694,193 the year before, according to newly released data. The top five countries of origin for the number of new citizens are: Mexico, Philippines, India, Dominica and China. Among them, 31,868 Chinese citizens were naturalized as U.S. citizens. Between 2011 and 2012, immigrants born in Dominica and Cuba saw the largest increases in the number of naturalized immigrants. Vietnam, South Korea, Pakistan, Iran, Nigeria and Somalia rank among the top 20 countries of origin of naturalized persons. Among European countries, only the United Kingdom and Ukraine rank in the top 20. A growing number of members of Congress are calling for consideration of “regularizing” the 11.5 million illegal immigrants. But its approach and the length of time it will take are the focus of fierce bipartisan debate in Congress. Last year, the United States issued green cards to 1,031,631 foreign citizens. This allows them to live and work in the United States permanently and become U.S. citizens after five years. Mexico, China and India are the top three source countries of permanent residents. People from Iraq, Myanmar, Bangladesh and Ethiopia are in the top 20. Most green card holders have already lived in the United States. Nearly 66% of people receive green cards because of family ties to a U.S. citizen or another green card holder. The system for determining who gets a green card is a complex process. Generally speaking, priority is given to family members of U.S. citizens or permanent residents, and to foreigners with employment skills needed by U.S. businesses. Some immigration reformers have suggested creating a new green card category for illegal immigrants, while others oppose what they see as an "amnesty" for lawbreakers. Erwin DeLeon, an immigration expert at the Urban Institute, a Washington-based research group, said new data trends will emerge over the next decade as Congress now works on immigration reform. "If Congress passes immigration reform this year or next year," he said, "by 2020 you will see a big spike in the number of permanent residents and new citizens." "Claire Bergeron said that some people suggest that non-naturalized immigrants wait 10 years before becoming legal immigrants, and wait another 5 years before naturalizing as Americans.

4aabf9f1f9a38f5a2a8a6c0bb6848b0c1b5a8e9b.sourceText: 太阳鸟纪事：取材于凤凰城的小说《凤囚凰》连载（八）
4aabf9f1f9a38f5a2a8a6c0bb6848b0c1b5a8e9b.translatedText: Chronicle of the Sunbird: Serialization of the novel "Phoenix Prisoner" based on Phoenix City (eight)

1811320e2a1f3656a5803f8e468597d85c8da47f.sourceText: 太阳鸟纪事：取材于凤凰城的小说《凤囚凰》连载（八） （编者按）在某个时间，某个空间，我们在这里，美国亚利桑那州…
1811320e2a1f3656a5803f8e468597d85c8da47f.translatedText: Sunbird Chronicle: Serialization (eight) of the novel "Phoenix Prisoner of Phoenix" based on Phoenix City (Editor's note) At a certain time, in a certain space, we are here in Arizona, USA...

55c825ebe4193c902d489a2e7bf6bc5f326647e0.sourceText: 稻子没想到我的英语烂到这个程度，我们用肢体语言向对方卖力地比划，但仍然无济于事。面对一个漂亮的哑巴他束手无策。我这才知道沟通的重要性。我们在宾馆里互相对牛弹琴，几个小时后，稻子拉着我进商场买了一个快译通。稻子发现他又能畅所欲言了，而且听众是他心爱的像小鸟一样的中国女孩，他像孩子一样兴奋不已。
55c825ebe4193c902d489a2e7bf6bc5f326647e0.translatedText: Dao Zi did not expect that my English was so bad. We used body language to gesture hard at each other, but it still didn't help. He was helpless when faced with a beautiful mute. Only then did I realize the importance of communication. We played the piano against each other in the hotel. A few hours later, Daozi took me into the mall and bought a quick translation. Dao Zi found that he could speak freely again, and the audience was his beloved bird-like Chinese girl. He was as excited as a child.

b14ec44e4ec2146914cea4fcad3b78d538931429.sourceText: 稻子通过快译通传给我的第一句话是：我很喜欢你，我希望你能给我机会，让我将来好好地照顾你。看样子这句话让他憋了很久，他涨红着脸低头温柔地看着我的时候，我的心咯噔一下，像有一根羽毛轻轻地在我伤口拂过。他诚恳地把快译通递给我，等着我的答案。
b14ec44e4ec2146914cea4fcad3b78d538931429.translatedText: The first sentence Daozi sent to me through the express was: I like you very much, and I hope you can give me a chance to take good care of you in the future. It seemed that he had been holding back these words for a long time. When he looked down at me tenderly with a blushing face, my heart skipped a beat, as if a feather was gently brushing against my wound. He handed me the quick translation sincerely and waited for my answer.

82a5f9a99a3ccc08a29182963282f49fc6a8c281.sourceText: 我沉思了片刻，然后打了一串字：我也喜欢你，但我需要了解你。
82a5f9a99a3ccc08a29182963282f49fc6a8c281.translatedText: I thought for a moment, and then typed a string of words: I like you too, but I need to get to know you.

5bbaf92483373652821af3589b201f9bcacd2648.sourceText: 稻子点点头，说，我有耐性让你去全面了解我。那么你最想去旅游的地方是哪里？
5bbaf92483373652821af3589b201f9bcacd2648.translatedText: Daozi nodded and said, I have the patience to let you fully understand me. So where would you most like to travel?

b491442d5357a9d73b9cc900043c07d6b17ec94b.sourceText: 丽江。我想告诉他，每次失恋的时候，我都想去那，但我没说，我说，听说那是个好地方，离天堂最近。
b491442d5357a9d73b9cc900043c07d6b17ec94b.translatedText: >Lijiang. I wanted to tell him that every time I fell in love, I wanted to go there, but I didn’t say that. I said, I heard that it was a good place and the closest to heaven.

6690ead6b0e82fd414f18f5e027ea49da99b9095.sourceText: 那就先去那吧，美国夏威夷也是一个离天堂最近的地方，我以后带你去夏威夷游玩。稻子专注地敲打着字母，然后抬手给我看，他说，我有十天的假期，我们可以计划在丽江游玩几天。
6690ead6b0e82fd414f18f5e027ea49da99b9095.translatedText: Then go there first. Hawaii in the United States is also the place closest to paradise. I will take you to Hawaii in the future. Daozi typed the letters intently, then raised his hand to show me. He said, I have ten days of vacation, and we can plan a few days in Lijiang.

996541aa07b399437f20d02f2c18d6df655cc1ea.sourceText: 我微微一笑，点头表示赞许。
996541aa07b399437f20d02f2c18d6df655cc1ea.translatedText: I smiled slightly and nodded in approval.

f5927fa2e2014f6d7b9cba4df1ed3921a6785ced.sourceText: 快译通让我们俩的感情一点点地升温，我们计划三天后去云南。我对这次旅行充满了期待，但内心又有些惶恐不安。一切充满了戏剧性，我发现我越来越接近华子的想法，这对一个没有受过教育的一无所有的乡下丫头来说，用冒险和寻找刺激来形容未免太过于单调浅薄，尽管我也喜欢冒险。我跟姐姐唯一不同的是，我还有足够的时间面对未知未来的挑战，而这种挑战需要付出代价，我想此刻，我已经做好了心理准备。
f5927fa2e2014f6d7b9cba4df1ed3921a6785ced.translatedText: Kuaiyi Tong has warmed up our relationship little by little, and we plan to go to Yunnan in three days. I was looking forward to this trip, but I was also a little nervous. Everything was full of drama, and I found that I was getting closer and closer to Hua Zi's thoughts. For an uneducated country girl with nothing, using adventure and seeking excitement to describe it was too monotonous and shallow, although I also like adventure. The only difference between me and my sister is that I still have enough time to face the challenges of the unknown future, and such challenges require a price. I think at this moment, I am mentally prepared.

d3c93e39dee856451e33339156d8e14493087171.sourceText: 我们真正的关系是从丽江开始的。
d3c93e39dee856451e33339156d8e14493087171.translatedText: Our real relationship started in Lijiang.

674e5eb06361fdc6cb2ca959d7fb6160cbfaa88d.sourceText: 丽江之前，稻子从谷歌里搜索了很多关于丽江的资料，比如当地的地图、丽江和大理的历史古迹、玉龙雪山的海拔和气温、少数民族的风土人情和文化，当然还有旅馆。他将这些资料打印好，然后进行归类，研读几遍后再小心翼翼地放进行李箱里，他叮嘱我带几件保暖衣服，玉龙雪山上气温低，有积雪。等到我们出发时他对那的一草一木已经了如指掌了。我不由得对他肃然起敬，对他开口的第一句许诺也不置可否。
674e5eb06361fdc6cb2ca959d7fb6160cbfaa88d.translatedText: Before Lijiang, Daozi searched a lot of information about Lijiang from Google, such as local maps, historical sites in Lijiang and Dali, the altitude and temperature of Jade Dragon Snow Mountain, the customs and culture of ethnic minorities, and of course hotels. He printed out the information, then classified it, read it several times, and then carefully put it in the suitcase. He told me to bring some warm clothes because the temperature on the Jade Dragon Snow Mountain was low and there was snow. By the time we set off, he knew every detail of the place. I couldn't help but be in awe of him, and I was unconvinced by the first promise he made.

542a022506c2d2f4cd4bb8f704417ae4d73088dc.sourceText: 其实旅游对我来说是一件奢侈的事，我从来不敢奢望能出去游玩，我当初的理想是实实在在地挣钱吃饭睡觉找个好男人有个温暖的家，年轻时好好奋斗，老了抱抱孙。我想大多数人的理想和我差不多 — 过实诚日子。所以去丽江是我信口胡诌来的，把有钱有闲人的浪漫强加在自己头上来” 哄哄” 老外。没想到稻子那么认真，他这样一来倒让我惭愧不已，我觉得我至少可以装成一个有文化有浪漫情调的女孩，像一只蝴蝶一样在花丛中飞来飞去来体验生活的美好。
542a022506c2d2f4cd4bb8f704417ae4d73088dc.translatedText: In fact, traveling is a luxury for me. I never dare to expect to go out for fun. My original ideal was to earn money, eat, sleep, find a good man and have a warm home, work hard when I was young, and have grandchildren when I am old. I think most people’s ideals are similar to mine—to live an honest life. So I went to Lijiang out of nowhere, forcing the romance of rich and idle people on myself to "coax" foreigners. I didn't expect Dao Zi to be so serious, and it made me feel ashamed. I thought I could at least pretend to be a cultured and romantic girl, and fly around among the flowers like a butterfly to experience the beauty of life.

6cd2d7b545cc257c14b0b28378f3835b2761ed4d.sourceText: 我告诫自己这么做。生活真的是美好的，只是我遭遇了几次挫折而已，这些挫折在人的一生中算不了什么，人的一生总要面临许许多多的沟沟坎坎，而生活还是要继续。这样想的时候，我的心情豁然开朗了许多。我在这样一种全身心放松的情况下开始了我的浪漫丽江之旅。
6cd2d7b545cc257c14b0b28378f3835b2761ed4d.translatedText: I told myself to do this. Life is really beautiful, but I have encountered a few setbacks. These setbacks are nothing in a person's life. A person's life always faces many ups and downs, but life still has to go on. When I thought about it this way, my mood suddenly became much brighter. I started my romantic trip to Lijiang in such a relaxed situation.

669ab47fe3f0aec5c6f3b0f6c5ba488b2d4f3f4b.sourceText: 到了丽江我才发现我错了，对我这样一个疲于奔命的人来说，我无法欣赏它的美。在我眼里，那里的房子老一点，服饰特别一点，到处都是小桥流水人家。高高低低的被磨得铮亮的石板路挤满了来来往往的行人，两旁的店铺里挂满了当地特色的小饰品和东巴文的工艺木盘。稻子被这些具有浓郁民族文化气息的小东西吸引，他毫不吝啬自己的赞美之词，他啧啧称赞的时候完全进入了一种忘我的境界，恨不得把整座城都搬回去，而我倒成了他的陪衬。
669ab47fe3f0aec5c6f3b0f6c5ba488b2d4f3f4b.translatedText: When I arrived in Lijiang, I realized that I was wrong. For a person like me who is so exhausted, I couldn't appreciate its beauty. In my eyes, the houses there are older, the clothes are more unique, and there are houses with small bridges and flowing water everywhere. The high and low polished stone roads are crowded with pedestrians, and the shops on both sides are filled with local trinkets and Dongba handicraft wooden plates. Daozi was attracted by these small things with strong national cultural flavor. He was not stingy with his words of praise. When he praised them, he completely entered a state of selflessness. He wished he could move the whole city back, and I became his foil.

540f53dd659e248cb02149e48414127737cc704d.sourceText: 第三天，丽江之行出现了转折，让我遭遇了有生以来第一次浪漫的求婚，这次难忘的经历是从稻子的西装开始的。
540f53dd659e248cb02149e48414127737cc704d.translatedText: On the third day, the trip to Lijiang took a turn, and I encountered my first romantic proposal in my life. This unforgettable experience started with Daozi’s suit.

e1d71f58fd155f78b68acb5800de1c1ce1c23cf9.sourceText: 那天一大清早稻子就起床了，他洗漱完毕后到隔壁的房间叫醒我，我睁开惺忪的睡眼看到他西装革履地站在我面前，脸上挂着一本正经的微笑。我被他这身正统的打扮吓了一大跳，我盯着他的西装足足看了十几秒钟，以为有什么重大会议正等着我，赶紧潦草地收拾了一下就跟他出了门。
e1d71f58fd155f78b68acb5800de1c1ce1c23cf9.translatedText: Daozi got up early that morning. After washing, he went to the next room to wake me up. I opened my sleepy eyes and saw him standing in front of me in a suit and ties, with a serious smile on his face. I was startled by his formal attire. I stared at his suit for more than ten seconds, thinking that some important meeting was waiting for me, so I quickly packed it up and followed him out the door.

90c22b11e8e7e763d6a5ffed857cb7dfcccf0a0b.sourceText: 我们随着人流上了一辆大巴，大巴开动后，我开始仔细打量里面的每一个人，我发现除了稻子外，所有的人都穿着舒服的休闲装，他们悠闲而愉快地交谈着，而稻子，除了西装革履，他还穿着一双精心打理过的皮鞋，锃亮锃亮的皮鞋将我的影子很怪异地倒映在上面，看着极其别扭。他不说话，仍然一脸很奇怪的严肃，眼睛紧张地直视前方，但眼神却不在那里，似乎在盯着遥远某处并不存在的东西，跟前几天的洒脱相比真有天壤之别。我觉得事情越来越蹊跷，心想，我跟他认识才几天时间，他不会因为我是冒充的就把我卖了吧？我越想心里越忐忑不安，后来实在忍不住了，站起来问他，我们是不是去开会？
90c22b11e8e7e763d6a5ffed857cb7dfcccf0a0b.translatedText: We followed the flow of people and boarded a bus. After the bus started, I started to look at everyone inside carefully. I found that except for Daozi, everyone was wearing comfortable casual clothes. They were chatting leisurely and happily. And Daozi, in addition to suits and leather shoes, also wore a pair of well-kept leather shoes. The shiny leather shoes reflected my shadow strangely on them, which looked extremely awkward. He didn't speak, but still had a strangely serious look on his face. His eyes were staring straight ahead nervously, but they were not there. He seemed to be staring at something that didn't exist somewhere far away. It was really different from the free and easy look of the previous few days. I felt that things were getting more and more strange, and I thought, I've only known him for a few days, he wouldn't sell me out just because I'm a fake, right? The more I thought about it, the more uneasy I felt. Finally I couldn't bear it anymore, so I stood up and asked him, are we going to a meeting?

99818cbcab7d2f7816ee63b755aa8f46c2f01134.sourceText: 稻子不解，瞪大眼睛看着我。我这才想起来他不懂汉语。我拼命地用手比划，情急之下忘了快译通。
99818cbcab7d2f7816ee63b755aa8f46c2f01134.translatedText: Dao Zi was puzzled and looked at me with wide eyes. Then I remembered that he didn’t understand Chinese. I gestured desperately with my hands, and in my desperation I forgot to translate it quickly.

a1bcad3bed263cfc02de44296f2945ee40ae16ab.sourceText: 旁边一个和我年龄差不多的女孩帮我翻译后，他也拼命地给我比划，着急地摆手，说， No ， No 。
a1bcad3bed263cfc02de44296f2945ee40ae16ab.translatedText: After a girl next to me who was about the same age helped me translate, he also gestured to me desperately, waved his hands anxiously, and said, No, No.

488ddcf3fbf5044d5761cf42246f3dc4a61af7ec.sourceText: 这下我更不安了，我的脸色一定变了，血液和汗水一起往头上涌，我说，我要下车。稻子不解地看着我，我比划着，手指向窗外，态度更加坚决，我又说，我要下车。
488ddcf3fbf5044d5761cf42246f3dc4a61af7ec.translatedText: Now I was even more uneasy. My face must have changed, blood and sweat were rushing to my head. I said, I want to get off the car. Daozi looked at me in confusion. I gestured and pointed my finger out the window, my attitude became more determined, and I said, I want to get off the car.

3c324cff27d1742e1ad6a80b46471610b393fa8a.sourceText: 稻子这次听懂了，他看了看窗外，车在山坡上快速行驶，路上了无人烟。他用刚刚学会的一句中文问我，为什么？
3c324cff27d1742e1ad6a80b46471610b393fa8a.translatedText: Daozi understood this time. He looked out the window. The car was driving fast on the hillside and there was no one on the road. He asked me using a Chinese sentence he had just learned, why?

a5f75710e03eadaa47247724bec6c2e84f78440f.sourceText: 稻子马上发现我们之间出现了问题，他赶紧把快译通给我。我生气地在上面输出一行字：我们要到哪里去？你一直都没有告诉我，我像傻瓜一样跟你跑，你把我卖了我还不知道。
a5f75710e03eadaa47247724bec6c2e84f78440f.translatedText: Daozi immediately noticed that there was a problem between us, and he quickly gave me the quick translation. I angrily typed a line above: Where are we going? You never told me, I ran with you like a fool, and I didn't know you sold me.

41c54d232aeace963674342cb3a07d711712c850.sourceText: 我的一本正经把稻子逗笑了，他把我拉向座位，握着我的手轻轻放在他胸前，然后摇了几下，意思是要我放心。然后一把搂着我，温柔地摩挲我的头发，他的手轻轻地在我的脸上来回抚摸时，我终于安静下来了。
41c54d232aeace963674342cb3a07d711712c850.translatedText: My seriousness made Daozi laugh. He pulled me towards the seat, held my hand and gently placed it on his chest, and then shook it a few times to reassure me. Then he hugged me and gently stroked my hair. When his hand gently stroked my face back and forth, I finally calmed down.

b46482030705e6df9a04a84959eb7da2aa5f782d.sourceText: 车停在一个山脚下，大大小小的车把这个简陋的停车场挤得水泄不通。人群中有人在激动地呐喊，我顺着那手指的方向望去，一座海拔很高而且积满了白雪的大山挡住了我的视线。旅行团的导游小姐在扩音喇叭里激动地叫喊：同志们注意，传说中的玉龙雪山就在我们眼前了，请看 —– 。陈词慷慨激昂，像在搞演说。我哧溜逃到几米远外，顺着她的手指望去，烟雾缭绕的玉龙雪山像刚刚被这扩音喇叭叫醒了一样，雾开始蒸腾起来，没过多久，极目所眺之处变成了白茫茫的一片。我心想，幸亏稻子聪明了一次，这次要跟着旅行团出来，这一惊一乍的还哪有什么浪漫可言。
b46482030705e6df9a04a84959eb7da2aa5f782d.translatedText: The car was parked at the foot of a mountain. Cars of all sizes crowded the simple parking lot. Someone in the crowd was shouting excitedly. I looked in the direction of the finger. A mountain with a high altitude and full of snow blocked my sight. The tour guide of the tour group shouted excitedly through the loudspeaker: Comrades, pay attention, the legendary Jade Dragon Snow Mountain is right in front of us, please take a look - -. The speech was impassioned, like a speech. I fled a few meters away and followed her hand. The smoky Jade Dragon Snow Mountain seemed to have just been awakened by the loudspeaker. The fog began to evaporate. After a while, the place as far as the eye could see turned into a vast expanse of white. I thought to myself, luckily Daozi was smart and decided to go out with the tour group this time. There was nothing romantic about this sudden surprise.

26f77b13cd8e2d0aae5693fe30b4002e92b81fd1.sourceText: 我们排队上索道，稻子紧紧牵着我的手，他的手心很热，出了少许的汗，黏糊糊的。我抬头看了看他，他的脸憋得通红，他脸颊通红的时候像一位慈祥可爱的圣诞老人。但他的笑容此刻显得不那么慈祥了，脸上的肌肉僵硬得让看到的人胃部痉挛。我突然产生了一种很奇怪而冒险的想法：他用笑容把我带入他的世界，那么会不会也止于这个呢? 他会把我带向哪里?
26f77b13cd8e2d0aae5693fe30b4002e92b81fd1.translatedText: We lined up to get on the ropeway, Dao Zai held my hand tightly. His palms were very hot, sweaty and sticky. I looked up at him, and his face was red from suppressing it. When his cheeks were red, he looked like a kind and lovely Santa Claus. But his smile looked less kind now, and the muscles on his face were so stiff that those who saw him felt stomach cramps. I suddenly had a very strange and adventurous thought: He brought me into his world with his smile, but will it stop there? Where will he take me?

55d3b17d4d7143799840cf6b835235029a7a3695.sourceText: 缆车在不断攀升的过程中，我们面对面地站着，另外一对老龄夫妇坐在那里目不转睛地看着在他们面前一掠而过的风景，他们的目光空洞而遥远，像是睁大眼睛睡着了，我们在那里成了多余的存在。他们给我足够的时间和勇气去仔细打量稻子，稻子不以为意，他像是在等待什么，总是以一个固定姿势目光掠过我的头颅去看山顶。只是越接近目的地，他的脸越贴着我的头颅，直至我无法注视他为止。
55d3b17d4d7143799840cf6b835235029a7a3695.translatedText: As the cable car continued to climb, we stood face to face. Another elderly couple sat there and stared at the scenery passing by in front of them. Their eyes were empty and distant, as if they were asleep with their eyes wide open. We became redundant there. They gave me enough time and courage to look at Rice carefully. Rice didn't take it seriously. He seemed to be waiting for something. He always glanced over my head in a fixed posture to look at the top of the mountain. But the closer he got to his destination, the closer his face pressed against my head, until I couldn't look at him anymore.

28533261743392548b362abc8b936c45be9296dc.sourceText: 我们到达山顶时，浓雾消散了一些，但仍然只能清晰地看到几米之内的地方。山上除了白得晃眼的积雪外，什么也没有，一群生意人的叫嚣打破了雪山的寂静。然而对我来说，我的兴趣远远不在这些，我一直在琢磨稻子一整天来的不寻常举动。
28533261743392548b362abc8b936c45be9296dc.translatedText: When we reached the top of the mountain, the dense fog dissipated a bit, but we could still only see clearly within a few meters. There was nothing but dazzling white snow on the mountain. The shouts of a group of businessmen broke the silence of the snow-capped mountains. However, for me, my interest is far from these. I have been wondering about rice's unusual behavior all day long.

03c21095ffec1d58490f0163c2b260a00a0629b9.sourceText: 稻子紧跟着我，他从随身携带的包里拿出一件加厚的碎花棉袄 ( 这是我早几年从乡下带过来的 ) 披在我身上，他自己也在西装里面加了一件羊绒毛衣，他重新套上西装，一丝不苟地系好领带。他不时忧心忡忡地打量不远处的雾，我想应该是雾，身边几个游客跟他有类似的担心。他也不时地打量我，他打量我的时候我的胃部就明显地痉挛一下。我想快点离开这个寒冷的地方，但稻子却丝毫没有这个意思，我们在观景台拍了几张照片，他好像从中找到了乐趣，那就是给那些无法拍合影的游客拍照。他乐此不疲，面部的肌肉在游客的欢笑中慢慢松弛下来。
03c21095ffec1d58490f0163c2b260a00a0629b9.translatedText: Daozi followed me closely. He took out a thick floral cotton-padded jacket (which I brought from the countryside a few years ago) from his carry-on bag and put it on me. He also added a cashmere sweater to his suit. He put his suit back on and tied his tie meticulously. From time to time, he looked worriedly at the fog not far away. I thought it must be fog. Several tourists around him had similar worries to him. He also looked at me from time to time, and my stomach visibly cramped when he looked at me. I wanted to leave this cold place quickly, but Daozi had no intention of doing so. We took a few photos at the observation deck, and he seemed to find fun in taking photos of tourists who couldn't take group photos. He enjoyed it endlessly, and the muscles on his face slowly relaxed amidst the laughter of the tourists.

3899c4dbb158bde6d259d327b69ffbf035981e1e.sourceText: 山上客来客往，大多只是拍几张照片就走人。金发碧眼的稻子因为热心为人拍照的缘故，他成了山顶上最受瞩目的焦点，他受欢迎的程度超过了这座给人无限美好遐想的雪山。他甚至成为了人们拍照和合影的对象，每次有人找他合影时，他都挺直脖子，做出各种不同的鬼脸和姿势，而笑容总是显得那么真诚而富有善意。我看着他，心想，爽朗的笑声又出现在他脸上了。
3899c4dbb158bde6d259d327b69ffbf035981e1e.translatedText: There are many tourists coming and going on the mountain, most of them just take a few photos and then leave. The blond rice with blue eyes became the center of attention on the top of the mountain because of his enthusiasm for taking photos. His popularity exceeded that of this snow-capped mountain that gave people unlimited beautiful reverie. He has even become the target of people taking photos and group photos. Every time someone takes a photo with him, he straightens his neck and makes various faces and postures, and his smile always looks so sincere and kind. I looked at him and thought, the hearty laughter appeared on his face again.

beda99582d6aff56ca5a2677036e525168acae96.sourceText: 天啊，一米阳光。人群中有人惊叫起来。
beda99582d6aff56ca5a2677036e525168acae96.translatedText: Oh my god, one meter of sunshine. Someone in the crowd screamed.

019ab6158a96a3a24c8d3d04199cc21b206e5381.sourceText: 这句话吸引了所有人的目光，我知道，这里面很多人，包括我在内，完全不懂玉龙雪山一米阳光的传说，人们好奇是因为这声惊叫引起的。的确，雾不知道什么时候散去了，阳光穿透厚厚的云层，在山顶上撒下了薄薄的一层。尽管只是薄薄的一层，但在清凉的雪白积雪的映照下，却也显得格外耀眼而温暖。
019ab6158a96a3a24c8d3d04199cc21b206e5381.translatedText: This sentence attracted everyone's attention. I know that many people here, including me, have no idea about the legend of one meter of sunshine in Jade Dragon Snow Mountain. People's curiosity was caused by this scream. Indeed, I don’t know when the fog dissipated, and the sun penetrated the thick clouds and cast a thin layer on the top of the mountain. Although it is only a thin layer, it looks particularly dazzling and warm under the cool white snow.

31e1cdbcbb7b1fc0a003345d56be74aa69aaa92e.sourceText: 稻子一个跨步踱到我面前，单膝跪地，他变魔术般地从西装口袋里掏出一个精致的枣红色的首饰盒，盒盖事先就已打开，一枚明亮的钻石戒指出现在我面前，这耀眼的光芒在空中划了一道弧线后停在我眼前，我吓了一大跳，我本能的第一个反应是：他想干什么? 我真的不知道他想干什么，这种架势我从没见过，但我知道戒指意味着什么。我很快意识到这种浪漫的求婚真真切切地发生在我身上了，有一霎那我为自己终于穿上了水晶鞋而沾沾自喜，但随之我又不免感叹：这一切未免来得太快了，我刚刚还对他的行为产生了怀疑。
31e1cdbcbb7b1fc0a003345d56be74aa69aaa92e.translatedText: Daazi walked up to me and knelt down on one knee. He magically took out an exquisite maroon jewelry box from his suit pocket. The lid of the box had been opened beforehand, and a bright diamond ring appeared in front of me. This dazzling light drew an arc in the air and stopped in front of my eyes. I was startled. My first instinctive reaction was: What does he want to do? I really don't know what he wants to do. I have never seen this kind of attitude, but I know what the ring means. I soon realized that this kind of romantic proposal had really happened to me. For a moment, I felt smug that I had finally put on the glass slippers, but then I couldn't help but sigh: This all happened too fast, and I had doubts about his behavior just now.

3e28982d9c46c8535e2abf20a57b29ab6b3e278d.sourceText: 嫁给我。稻子在我的惊慌失措中用蹩脚的中文说。
3e28982d9c46c8535e2abf20a57b29ab6b3e278d.translatedText: >Marry me. Rice said in broken Chinese in my panic.

00601b1dae7e0c78b385fc284e5bc0de9a892320.sourceText: 众人开始起哄，有些人因为拍照的事已经和稻子建立了感情，有些人觉得这么浪漫的求婚如果遭到拒绝，那难得一见的一米阳光岂不是白白浪费了。一米阳光意味着什么? 人们相信被这道阳光照耀到的人就能拥有一世不变的爱情。稻子之所以安排得这么精细，估计他也深谙此道。所以他们起哄的时候说得最多的是要我快点伸出手指。
00601b1dae7e0c78b385fc284e5bc0de9a892320.translatedText: Everyone started to make noises. Some people had already established a relationship with Daozi because of the photo shoot. Some people felt that if such a romantic proposal was rejected, then the rare meter of sunshine would be wasted. What does one meter of sunshine mean? People believe that those who are illuminated by this sunshine can have everlasting love. The reason why Daozi arranged it so carefully is probably because he is well versed in it. So when they heckled me, the most common thing they said was asking me to hurry up and put out my finger.

bd4793cc129c9e280b7ebf5a33dadd7598d432d5.sourceText: 我看着稻子，稻子脸上的肌肉紧张地挤到了一块，他在焦急地等待答案，我现在了解他了，一旦得到满意的答复，他脸上的肌肉马上就会欢快地舒展开来，他会笑得像一朵向日葵，在阳光下绽放得格外灿烂。
bd4793cc129c9e280b7ebf5a33dadd7598d432d5.translatedText: I looked at Daozi, and the muscles on Daozi's face were squeezed together nervously. He was waiting anxiously for the answer. I understand him now. Once he gets a satisfactory answer, the muscles on his face will immediately stretch out happily, and he will smile like a sunflower, blooming particularly brightly in the sun.

e065f0c2ebcda6e6668e9787cfcfdc471c28c8de.sourceText: 稻子终于如愿以偿。尽管有一霎那的迟疑，但在这个非常时期，我找不出拒绝的理由。在秋初的一个日月同辉的中午，穿着笔挺西装打着红色领带脚踏油头皮鞋的稻子在石头与石头之间欢快地跳跃，他每次跳跃的时候金黄色的头发都好看地扬起来，那金色的头发在一米阳光的照射下显得格外耀眼，他高兴得像个孩子。
e065f0c2ebcda6e6668e9787cfcfdc471c28c8de.translatedText: Rice finally got his wish. Although there was a moment of hesitation, in this extraordinary period, I could not find a reason to refuse. On a noon in early autumn when the sun and the moon shine together, Daozi, wearing a crisp suit and a red tie and leather shoes, jumps happily between stones. Every time he jumps, his golden hair rises beautifully. The golden hair is particularly dazzling under the one meter of sunlight. He is as happy as a child.

72debec132c84ab4ee1a7086e33b1064f5258452.sourceText: 一切都太突然而富有戏剧性了。
72debec132c84ab4ee1a7086e33b1064f5258452.translatedText: Everything was so sudden and dramatic.

e39414904f938767def8895666ff308982e9e1c4.sourceText: 亞省中國餐館協會成立卅週年慶 （亞省中國餐館協會通訊）二月十八日晚，亞省中國餐館協會假座鳳凰城六福海鮮酒家，舉辦成立卅週年的紀念活動，有三百五十位協會成員及社會賢達、僑界翹楚出席了晚宴。是晚高朋滿座，氣氛熱烈，節目精彩，禮物豐富。 主席鄧朝駒向會員和貴賓們致以熱烈的節日問候，恭祝各位犬年身體健康，生意興隆，家庭幸福! 他感謝餐館會會員卅年來對協會的信任和參與；感謝眾多食品行業和單位的鼎力協助；感謝社會各界和僑團多年的鼓勵和大力的支持，讓亞省中國餐館協會從最初的几間餐館的組合，發展到今天有 350 間餐館會員的組織。 卅年来，中餐館會秉持服務會員，爭取會員權益的宗旨，積極促進中餐館事業的發展，持續地拓展會務，努力與中餐館業相關的政府部門溝通協調，盡力去解決會員所遇到的問題和困難，舉辦過各方面的學習班和會務活動，中餐館會為會員作出了應有的服務。與此同時，亞省中國餐館協會長期以來參加社會和僑界的各種公益活動，出錢出力，服務社會，服務大眾，支持社團，並且作出了積極的貢獻。 鄧朝駒主席在致辭之後，中餐館協會全體董事局成員，向宴會的貴賓們祝酒致賀。 對亞省中國餐館卅年來努力不懈的服務和貢獻，會員和社會及僑界給予了高度的評價。瑪里科巴郡衛生局長率領多位高層管理人員親臨會場，向中餐館協會表達熱烈的祝賀，衛生署總監 Steven Goods 并上台致賀辭。亞利桑那無居者服務中心（ CASS) 的代表；鳳凰城慈濟分會；大鳳凰城僑聯主席 Raymond Tang ；中國週委員會主席 Elain Wong ；鳳凰城中文學校校長 Tony Tang ，亦分別上台致辭，并向中餐館會頒發了奬牌和奬狀。 晚宴由創會會員徐國富和張華芳擔任司儀。在風趣歡樂的氣氛中，有三個勁歌熱舞的節目與眾同樂。有五位餐館會會員弟子獲得了本年度的獎學金。宴會中特別邀請了資深僑領余文勁先生上台致辭，余文勁先生是目睹和支持中餐館會成長的僑界代表，他對餐館會卅年來所取得的成績給予充分的肯定，并祝賀中餐館協會和各间餐館會員，今後繼續與「長豆芽」一樣，「發完再發」！他還興致勃勃地，幫忙抽出 2018 金犬旺年的超級頭獎的號碼，純金狗由 CASS 的主任 Lisa Glow 得到大獎。 卅週年慶的禮品相多豐富，贊助的單位眾多，包括有：志興食品批發公司、李錦記食品公司、太太樂食品公司、雲吞食品公司、 US Food 、 United Food Service 、金隆珠寶 、 Wine 紅酒公司、欣欣超市和 Hibachi Grill & Supreme Buffet 、㤗國皇宫高級美容中心等。晚宴中每檯都有中奬號碼，還有貴重物品穿插抽獎，再加上每位來賓都獲贈送禮物，人手一袋，皆大歡喜！ 為了辦好這次中餐館協會卅週年的紀念活動，餐館會主席鄧朝駒多次召開工作會議，理事和義工們做了大量的准備工作，六福海鮮海家為晚宴提供了美味佳餚。在相互祝福聲中，亞省中國餐館協會除舊迎新，將邁向下一個新的里程。 （張肇鴻報導） 晚宴高朋滿座會員眾多 主席鄧朝駒致詞 中餐館會全體成員向來賓祝酒致謝 司儀徐國富、張華芳 郡衛生局長率高層人員親臨會場，總監 Steven Goods 致賀辭 無居者服務中心（ CASS) 代表致感謝信 鳳凰城慈濟分會 向中餐館協會頒發獎狀 中國週主席 Elaine Wong 致感謝信 副主席梅德和理事賴甲乙向會員優秀子弟頒發奖學金 余文勁先生致辭并作抽獎佳賓 由 CASS 的主任 Lisa Glow得到 超級頭獎 30 周年紀念活動勁歌熱舞选登
e39414904f938767def8895666ff308982e9e1c4.translatedText: The 30th anniversary of the establishment of the Alberta Chinese Restaurant Association (Newsletter of the Alberta Chinese Restaurant Association) On the evening of February 18, the Alberta Chinese Restaurant Association held a commemorative event to commemorate its 30th anniversary at Luk Fook Seafood Restaurant in Phoenix. 350 association members, social luminaries, and overseas Chinese leaders attended the dinner. The evening was full of guests, the atmosphere was warm, the program was exciting, and the gifts were plentiful. Chairman Deng Chaoju extended warm holiday greetings to members and distinguished guests, wishing everyone good health, prosperous business, and happy families in the Year of the Dog! He thanked the members of the Restaurant Association for their trust and participation in the association over the past thirty years; thanked many food industries and units for their generous assistance; thanked all walks of life and the overseas Chinese community for their years of encouragement and strong support, which has enabled the Chinese Restaurant Association of Alberta to develop from a combination of a few restaurants to an organization with 350 restaurant members today. Over the past thirty years, the Chinese Restaurant Association has adhered to the purpose of serving members and fighting for their rights and interests, actively promoted the development of the Chinese restaurant industry, continued to expand the association's affairs, strived to communicate and coordinate with government departments related to the Chinese restaurant industry, and tried its best to solve the problems and difficulties encountered by members. It has organized various study classes and conference activities, and the Chinese Restaurant Association has provided due services to members. At the same time, the Alberta Chinese Restaurant Association has long participated in various public welfare activities in society and the overseas Chinese community, contributed money and efforts, served the society, served the public, supported associations, and made positive contributions. After Chairman Deng Chaoju delivered his speech, all members of the board of directors of the Chinese Restaurant Association toasted to the distinguished guests at the banquet. For the unremitting service and contribution of Chinese restaurants in Alberta over the past 30 years, members, society and the overseas Chinese community have spoken highly of it. The Maricopa County Health Director led many senior managers to the venue to express warm congratulations to the Chinese Restaurant Association. Health Department Director Steven Goods also took the stage to deliver a congratulatory speech. Representatives from the Arizona Homeless Service Center (CASS); Phoenix Tzu Chi Chapter; Raymond Tang, Chairman of the Overseas Chinese Federation of Greater Phoenix; Elain Wong, Chairman of the China Week Committee; and Tony Tang, Principal of Phoenix Chinese School, also took the stage to deliver speeches and presented medals and certificates to the Chinese restaurant association. The dinner was hosted by founding members Xu Guofu and Zhang Huafang. In a fun and joyful atmosphere, there were three lively singing and dancing programs that entertained everyone. Five Restaurant Association member disciples received this year’s scholarships. During the banquet, Mr. Yu Wenjin, a senior overseas Chinese leader, was specially invited to give a speech. Mr. Yu Wenjin is a representative of the overseas Chinese community who has witnessed and supported the growth of the Chinese Restaurant Association. He fully affirmed the achievements of the Restaurant Association in the past thirty years and congratulated the Chinese Restaurant Association and all restaurant members. In the future, they will continue to "grow bean sprouts" and "distribute them after they are distributed"! He also enthusiastically helped draw the numbers for the 2018 Golden Dog Super Jackpot, a solid golden dog won by CASS Director Lisa Glow. The gifts for the 30th anniversary celebration are abundant and sponsored by many units, including: Chi Hing Food Wholesale Company, Lee Kum Kee Food Company, Totole Food Company, Wonton Food Company, US Food, United Food Service, Jinlong Jewelry, Wine Company, Xinxin Supermarket, Hibachi Grill & Supreme Buffet, Imperial Palace Premium Beauty Center, etc. During the dinner, each table had winning numbers, and valuables were interspersed with the lottery. In addition, each guest received a gift, a bag for everyone, everyone was happy! In order to successfully organize the 30th anniversary commemoration event of the Chinese Restaurant Association, the Chairman of the Restaurant Association, Deng Chaoju, held several working meetings. The directors and volunteers made a lot of preparations. Luk Fook Seafood Haijia provided delicious dishes for the dinner. In the mutual blessings, the Chinese Restaurant Association of Alberta will put aside the old and welcome the new, and will move towards the next new milestone. (Reported by Zhang Zhaohong) The dinner was packed with guests and many members. Chairman Deng Chaoju delivered a speech. All members of the Chinese Restaurant Association toasted to the guests. Masters of Ceremony Xu Guofu and Zhang Huafang. The county health director and senior officials visited the venue. Director Steven Goods delivered a congratulatory speech. Representatives of the Center for Homeless Services (CASS) sent a letter of thanks. Phoenix Tzu Chi Chapter issued a certificate to the Chinese Restaurant Association. China Week Chairman Elaine Wong sent a letter of thanks. Vice Chairman Meide and Director Lai Jiayi awarded scholarships to outstanding children of members. Mr. Yu Wenjin delivered a speech and was the lucky draw guest. The director of CASS, Lisa Glow, won the super jackpot. The 30th anniversary commemoration event featured singing and dancing.

47ef737aeead571b43d311f8691a32c62f37f75f.translatedText: > Two Chrysler vehicles have been inspected due to potential safety issues. The U.S. safety regulator has launched an investigation into Chrysler Group L...

32b56e0dfefdebc6cdc3d46b54ee2230c63c406e.sourceText: 两款克莱斯勒车辆因潜在安全问题受检 美国安全监管部门已展开对克莱斯勒集团（Chrysler Group LLC）2012年款吉普大切诺基（Jeep Grand Cherokee）以及2009至2010年款道奇公羊1500（Dodge Ram 1500）的缺陷调查。此类缺陷调查通常是车辆被召回的前奏。 全国高速公路交通安全管理局（NHTSA）表示，他们正在调查约10.68万辆2012年款吉普大切诺基潜在的动力转向软管故障问题。这一问题可能导致引擎盖下起火。 NHTSA也正在调查约23万辆2009至2010年款道奇公羊1500潜在的后差速器故障问题。这一问题可能引起后轮锁定及车辆失控。 NHTSA的缺陷调查办公室说，2012年款大切诺基的动力转向软管可能故障，导致发动舱的动力转向液泄漏，而这种液体”可能因发动舱的热表面而被引燃”。 在对道奇公羊汽车的调查中，NHTSA已收到12起因差速器故障导致后轮锁住的投诉，其中包括一起造成车辆撞入水泥墩的事故。
32b56e0dfefdebc6cdc3d46b54ee2230c63c406e.translatedText: > Two Chrysler vehicles have been inspected due to potential safety issues. The U.S. safety regulator has launched an investigation into the 2012 Jeep Grand of Chrysler Group LLC. Cherokee and 2009 to 2010 Dodge Ram 1500. Such defect investigations are often a precursor to vehicle recalls. The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) said it is investigating a potential power steering hose failure in about 106,800 2012 Jeep Grand Cherokees that could cause fires under the hood. NHTSA is also investigating a potential rear differential failure in about 230,000 2009 to 2010 Dodge Ram 1500s, which could cause the rear wheels to lock and cause loss of vehicle control. NHTSA's defect investigation office said that the power steering hose in the 2012 Grand Cherokee may have failed, causing the power steering fluid to leak in the engine compartment, and the fluid "could be ignited by hot surfaces in the engine compartment." In its investigation of Dodge Ram vehicles, NHTSA has received 12 complaints of rear wheels locking due to differential differential failures, including one incident that caused the vehicle to crash into a concrete pier.

On the afternoon of August 29, the Chinese Consulate General in San Francisco held the "Foreign Affairs of the People's Republic of China...

ba00e491dab9d6601a8fdf5f4faf4418b436b8a9.sourceText: 中国签证九月起采用新策 旧金山总领馆举行说明会 8月29日下午，中国驻旧金山总领馆举行《中华人民共和国外国人入境出境管理条例》宣介会，向湾区的侨团代表、旅游业者，以及媒体记者介绍将于9月1日开始实行的最新出入境管理条例，以及新的签证申请表格。新的条例将让海外华人往返中国及居住国之前更为便利。 中国驻旧金山副总领事毕刚介绍了这次签证调整的重点：外国人普通签证由原来的8类调整为12类，而现行的F签证、L签证将进行拆分，并新增加了颁发给外国高层次人才和中国急需紧缺专门人才的R签证。 对旧金山地区而言，最受华裔社区关注的是本次新设立的Q签证，这种签证主要发给申请入境探亲的海外华人及其家属，有效期及停留期从180天到5年不等，为他们的探亲团聚提供了便利。 随著国际交往的进一步扩展，2012年中国出入境人数达到4.3亿人次。新的签证管理条例，将让更多人往返于中美两国之间探亲、交流、商务、旅游更为快捷便利。
ba00e491dab9d6601a8fdf5f4faf4418b436b8a9.translatedText: Chinese Visa will adopt a new policy in September. The Consulate General in San Francisco will hold a briefing. On the afternoon of August 29, the Chinese Consulate General in San Francisco held a briefing on the "Regulations of the People's Republic of China on the Entry and Exit Management of Foreigners" to introduce the latest entry and exit regulations that will be implemented on September 1, as well as the new visa application form, to representatives of overseas Chinese groups, tourism operators, and media reporters in the Bay Area. The new regulations will make it easier for overseas Chinese to travel between China and their country of residence. Bi Gang, Deputy Consul General of China in San Francisco, introduced the key points of this visa adjustment: ordinary visas for foreigners have been adjusted from the original 8 categories to 12 categories, and the current F visas and L visas will be split, and the R visa issued to foreign high-level talents and China's urgently needed specialized talents will be added. For the San Francisco area, the most concerned thing among the Chinese community is the newly established Q visa. This visa is mainly issued to overseas Chinese and their family members who apply to enter the country to visit relatives. The validity period and stay period range from 180 days to 5 years, which provides convenience for their family visits and reunions. With the further expansion of international exchanges, the number of entries and exits from China reached 430 million in 2012. The new visa management regulations will make it faster and more convenient for more people to travel between China and the United States to visit relatives, communicate, do business, and travel.

The City Council approved the city law and placed it on the Nov. 6 ballot for voters to vote on. If passed, Mayor Chandler would serve the same terms as city council members and the same terms as most mayors in the state.
