592ad8991340ac8109d01ab8d852c24d1e317101.sourceText: 谢春池：郑季有中国古典人物画展（多图） 大约去年八九月间，季有兄告诉我他要出版一本个人画集，还要办一次个人画展。这让我意外地高兴，说：这是一件好事啊！大凡知青兄弟姐妹有一点文艺成果问世，即使是一篇四五百字的短文见于报章，我都由衷的高兴，何况季有兄要出画集、办画展。这是一件多么不容易的事啊！我表示全力支持，还说可以厦门知青文化活动组委会、厦门知青书画沙龙来主办。他说正合其意。 季有兄又说，要请我和华伟兄作序，他说华伟已答应，然而，我未推却，也未答应，那些日子我委实太忙。 不久，季有兄拿着华伟兄的序给我，我读后，真诚地表示，有此序即可。在短时间里，我真没法为之作序，季有兄甚为体谅。但，他请我为其画展写前言，我答应了。 今年一月，知青书画沙龙活动日，季有兄将刚出版的《郑季有画集》（中国书画出版社）带来，送给沙龙的同好们，诸君莫不欣喜祝贺。我对季有兄说，画展的前言我近些日子当完成。 写此类文章或有真知灼见，或有深刻印象，才不会流于敷衍，仅成应酬之事。而上述两者我皆没有。我有的，只是对包括季有兄在内的每一个知青兄弟姐妹的情感。 任何一种文艺作品的发表与展示，都是一种社会化了的行为，虽然，其作品属于作者个人，其行为却与公众联系在一起。那么，作品的发表与展示，将给社会与公众带来什么？或许，作者个人可以不必考虑太多，而评介者的言说，则不可完全个人化。 从这个角度来谈论，季有兄的画作给我们带来什么？ 华伟兄为《郑季有画集》作序之题目是《人净画自净》，以为斯言甚确！华伟兄多从季有兄的佛教题材的作品来阐释，其分析评价皆很到位，能够对读者有所启示。我以为心若无几分净，是不可能画出一点的禅境的，这恐是众所认可的。因而，我更愿意从季有兄的其他题材的作品来谈论所谓”净”。 何谓”净”？无尘则”净”，是否？而人本身是一种”尘”，”尘”者若向往”净”，则必弃”尘”，弃”尘”则必把”自己”弃掉，否则，永远不净！绘画是”尘”的一种表现，以”尘”绘”净”，极难，若得几分”净”，大幸。季有兄用了二十多年的功夫，做到了，实属不易。这在非佛题材的作品里，已有所见。 季有兄非佛题材的作品，我们见到的多为古典题材，抑或高士，抑或豪杰，抑或仕女。如《兰亭修禊图》（多幅），再现当年兰亭文人学士雅集之盛况，颇引人入胜。如《关圣帝君》，把一个关公描绘得威武神勇，特别是飘起的战袍，富有动感。《赤壁赋》和《东坡品茗图》，把苏轼和周遭之山水和谐地融为一体，显示了古诗的意境，足见季有兄的用心。 上述诸图，都较为脱俗，较少”尘”之物，皆和作者自身沉浸于佛意之后，再返制古代世象有关。就个人而言，我喜欢《茶圣》和《茶圣 品茗图》：前者，茶圣与俩茶童被置于悠哉闲适的状态中，很愉悦读者；后者，茶圣与俩茶童对坐或背坐，等待品茗，趣味盎然，两画构图简洁，且无任何背景与衬物，主体非常突出，且蕴含更多的”净”，正应了”山中方七日，世上数百年”的仙境。 不少友人观赏季有兄的仕女图，都称赞有加。这一二十年，国画家画美女的大有人在，然而，厦门则少，季有兄应是较突出的一位。无论画裸或半裸或不裸的仕女图，季有兄都追求一种纯美，虽缺乏独创性，却带来一股清新之风，让人体验了几分的”净”。至此，我们可以说，季有兄的画作给我们带来一种神性与人性相融的真善美。 关于季有兄的佛像，我以为从艺术而言画得最生动的是《十八罗汉图》，人物形象栩栩如生，构图也好，其色调没有作者个人喜欢的那种重彩，反而令人倍感和谐和色美。而另一幅《罗汉图》，画的也是十八罗汉，重彩，却艳而不俗，画面人物皆有意趣，颇为难得。风格不同的两副画作，皆表现了一种大气，殊不容易。 我亦从小学国画，至今还非常业余，此生已不能做得更专业一些，连接近季有兄的水平都恐怕做不到。因而，对季有兄的业余得相当专业，自然钦佩。画山水难，画花鸟难，画人物更难，因而，我们周边画画的，特别是业余画画的，画人物的非常少。加之工笔费时费工费神，这样的画者更少。季有兄就显得更可贵。 我相信，季有兄的画展将给知青书画沙龙带来好的声誉，也将给我们的生活带来一份美好的忆念。 兰亭修禊图 千手千眼观世音菩萨 吉庆图 连年有余 郑绝尘香韵 四季有福图（斗方）
592ad8991340ac8109d01ab8d852c24d1e317101.translatedText: Xie Chunchi: Zheng Jiyou's Classical Chinese Figure Painting Exhibition (multiple pictures) About August or September last year, brother Ji You told me that he was going to publish a personal painting album and hold a personal painting exhibition. This made me unexpectedly happy and said: This is a good thing! Whenever brothers and sisters of educated youth have some literary and artistic achievements, even if a short article of four or five hundred words appears in a newspaper, I am sincerely happy, not to mention that Brother Ji You wants to publish a collection of paintings and hold an exhibition. What a difficult thing it is! I expressed my full support and said that the Xiamen Educated Youth Cultural Activities Organizing Committee and the Xiamen Educated Youth Calligraphy and Painting Salon could host it. He said it was just what he wanted. Brother Ji You also said that he wanted Brother Huawei and I to write a preface. He said that Huawei had agreed. However, I neither declined nor agreed. I was really too busy in those days. Not long after, Brother Ji You gave me the preface by Brother Hua Wei. After reading it, I sincerely expressed that this preface was enough. In the short time, I really can't write a preface for it, and Brother Ji You is very considerate. However, he asked me to write a foreword for his exhibition, and I agreed. In January of this year, on the day of the Calligraphy and Painting Salon for Educated Youth, brother Ji You brought the newly published "Collection of Paintings by Zheng Jiyou" (China Painting and Calligraphy Publishing House) to the salon's colleagues, who were all delighted to congratulate him. I told Brother Ji You that I should finish the preface for the exhibition in the near future. Writing such articles may have true insights or profound impressions, so that they will not be perfunctory and just a matter of entertainment. I have neither of the above. All I have is feelings for every educated youth brother and sister, including brother Ji You. The publication and display of any kind of literary and artistic work is a socialized behavior. Although the work belongs to the author personally, his behavior is connected with the public. So, what will the publication and display of the work bring to society and the public? Perhaps the author does not need to think too much personally, but the reviewer's words cannot be completely personal. Talking from this perspective, what do Ji Youxiong’s paintings bring us? The title of Brother Hua Wei's preface to "Collection of Zheng Jiyou's Paintings" is "People purify themselves by painting", and I think this statement is very true! Brother Hua Wei mostly explains it from Brother Ji You's works on Buddhist themes. His analysis and evaluation are very accurate and can provide some inspiration to readers. I think that if the mind is not somewhat pure, it is impossible to create a Zen state. This is probably recognized by everyone. Therefore, I prefer to talk about the so-called "purity" from Brother Ji You's works on other themes. What does "purity" mean? Dust-free means "pure", right? Human beings themselves are a kind of "dust". If a "dust" person yearns for "purity", he must abandon "dust", and if he abandons "dust", he must abandon "himself", otherwise, he will never be pure! Painting is an expression of "dust". It is extremely difficult to paint "pure" with "dust". If you can get a little "pure", you will be lucky. Brother Ji You spent more than 20 years working hard to achieve this, which was not easy. This has been seen in works with non-Buddhist themes. Ji Youxiong’s non-Buddhist-themed works, what we see are mostly classical themes, either high scholars, heroes, or ladies. For example, "Lanting Repairing the Wise Picture" (multiple paintings) reproduces the grand gathering of literati and scholars in Lanting in those days, which is quite fascinating. For example, "Guan Sheng Dijun" depicts Guan Gong as majestic and brave, especially the floating shirt, which is full of dynamic. "Red Cliff Ode" and "Dongpo Tea Drinking Picture" harmoniously integrate Su Shi and the surrounding mountains and rivers, showing the artistic conception of ancient poetry, which shows Brother Ji You's intentions. The above-mentioned pictures are all more refined and less "dusty", which is related to the fact that the author himself was immersed in the Buddha's mind and then recreated the ancient world. Personally, I like "The Tea Sage" and "The Tea Sage Drinking Tea": in the former, the Tea Sage and the two tea boys are placed in a leisurely state, which is very pleasing to readers; in the latter, the Tea Sage and the two tea boys sit opposite or with their backs, waiting to drink tea, which is full of interest. The composition of the two paintings is simple, without any background or lining. The subject is very prominent and contains more "purity", which corresponds to the fairyland of "seven days in the mountains, hundreds of years in the world". Many friends admired Ji Youxiong's pictures of ladies and praised them highly. In the past twenty years, there have been many Chinese painters who painted beauties, but there were fewer in Xiamen. Brother Ji You should be the more prominent one. Regardless of whether he paints pictures of naked, semi-nude or non-nude ladies, Ji Youxiong pursues a kind of pure beauty. Although he lacks originality, he brings a fresh wind and makes people experience a certain degree of "purity". At this point, we can say that Ji Youxiong's paintings bring us a kind of truth, goodness and beauty that blends divinity and humanity. Regarding Brother Ji You's Buddha statues, I think the most vivid painting from an artistic point of view is the "Eighteen Arhats". The characters are lifelike and the composition is good. The color tone is not the heavy color that the author personally likes, but it makes people feel more harmonious and beautiful. The other painting, "Arhat", also depicts eighteen Arhats. It is rich in color, but gorgeous and not vulgar. The characters in the picture are all interesting, which is quite rare. The two paintings with different styles both express a kind of atmosphere, which is not easy. I have been painting Chinese paintings since elementary school, and I am still very amateur. I can no longer do it more professionally in this life, and I am afraid I cannot even reach the level of Brother Ji You. Therefore, I naturally admire Brother Ji You for his amateurishness and professionalism. It is difficult to paint landscapes, flowers and birds, and even more difficult to paint figures. Therefore, there are very few painters around us, especially amateur painters, who paint figures. In addition, meticulous painting is time-consuming and labor-intensive, so there are even fewer such painters. Brother Ji You is even more valuable. I believe that Brother Ji You’s painting exhibition will bring a good reputation to the Educated Youth Calligraphy and Painting Salon and will also bring a beautiful memory to our lives. 03f2ca01d0dea4caa886611b684b599bbc33aaf6.sourceText: 1948年，时年四十九岁的着名美国小说家欧内斯特 海明威，偕第四任夫人玛丽 海明威，重访意大利，旅居威尼斯。 入秋后的一天，天气寒冷，阴雨绵绵。爱好狩猎的海明威仍兴致勃勃，随同卡路 凯希勒伯爵及其友人，外出巡猎，打野鸽取乐。年方十九的贵族小姐艾德里安娜 伊凡塞奇，是这群人中唯一的女性。 艾德里安娜天生丽质，楚楚动人。她父亲征战沙场，为国捐躯，由母亲一手抚育成长。母亲家教甚严，送她上天主教学校，使之成为虔诚的天主教徒。 艾德里安娜此行之前，从未开过枪。初次打猎，不仅一无所获，脸还被枪膛裡退出的子弹壳，撞了一块瘀伤。 当天下午，在凯希勒庄园裡，艾德里安娜坐在大火炉旁烤乾衣服，海明威向她走近。她转过脸来看他，他看到她脸上被子弹壳擦伤处，还呈红色。 「你好吗，闺女！」海明威用意大利语问候。 「还好，要是我有一把梳子就好了。」她想梳理湿漉漉的头髮。由于脸上疼痛，她欲笑又止。 艾德里安娜苍白狭长的脸，在火炉微弱的光线下，显得鬱鬱不乐。海明威注视她那双澹褐色的眼睛，失神了一会儿。他放下手上的白兰地酒杯，从口袋裡掏出自己的梳子，送给艾德里安娜，说：「闺女，用我的。」她出自真诚的喜悦，露出笑容。 说来也奇怪，像一把梳子这样简单的礼物，竟会把两个如此不同的人栓在一起，后来，艾德里安娜成了海明威又一位红颜知己。海明威要年长得多，熟谙世上事务，然而艾德里安娜天真烂漫、娇嫩孺弱、温柔体贴，这些素质吸引住海明威，那是玛丽所没有的。 海明威多次款待艾德里安娜，在他下榻的豪华酒店格里蒂宫旅馆餐厅，与她共进晚餐；艾德里安娜也常常邀请海明威，到自家庄园作客，在客厅壁炉前彻夜长谈。 海明威下一部长篇小说《过河入林》裡，他借男主人公之身，表现自己对艾德里安娜的爱慕之情。小说演变成一位十九岁的姑娘，与一名五十岁的男子之间的爱情故事。下面是一段对女主人公雷娜塔的描述： 然后她走进房间。她是一位身材高䠷的美女，步子较大，焕发出青春的光彩。她漫不经心，让风吹乱了头髮。她肤色灰白，近乎橄榄色。她的风姿，足以战胜你或任何人的心。她乌黑的头髮，充满光泽，飘垂在双肩上。 ——《过河入林》 1950年，艾德里安娜同母亲多拉、哥哥杰安弗朗哥一起，到古巴造访海明威夫妇。海明威在小佛罗里达餐馆宴请他们，还请他们乘皮拉尔号渔船打渔游玩。 玛丽很喜欢同杰安弗朗哥共处，海明威则很喜欢与艾德里安娜厮守。玛丽并不知道，她丈夫的小说《过河入林》中的女主人公蕾娜塔，就是以艾德里安娜作为原型来写的。 蕾娜塔本义「重生」，出自海明威和第一任夫人哈德莉多年前在意大利各尔梯纳交的朋友雷娜塔 布加蒂。他要他笔下的男主人公康威尔上校的爱慕之情，代表青春活力，在他心中重生。再看一段小说的描写： 她身材高䠷而匀称，年轻又美丽，上校吻了她，感觉到她那柔软的身体依偎在他身上，而他自己的身体，却粗壮结实，饱经风霜。他吻她时，脑中一片空白。 ——《过河入林》 艾德里安娜坦言，她与海明威的恋爱，从未达到顶峰，不过在海明威古巴故居瞭望山庄地下室裡，找到她用意大利文写的情意绵绵、充满魅力的情书，至少有二十六封。 海明威研究学者、海明威学会副会长杰拉尔德 肯尼迪博士，谈到海明威同艾德里安娜的关係时说：「我们可以从玛丽的日记中获知，（海明威与艾德里安娜）之间的关係非常密切，可能就是密友关係。虽然那时海明威身体，承受多种病痛，包括偶尔阳痿，的确很难想像……众所週知，有这样一个模式，他每写一部主要长篇小说时，总有一任夫人，而前次婚姻尚未破裂，他已在物色、追求下一任夫人了。我想，如果说，艾德里安娜在同样情况下，对他有重要影响，那种说法是公正的。她不但给他人生带来感官激动，她的吸引力，也给他带来创作灵感。我想，不管他俩有没有在卧室裡做过那事，其实他对做那事，已情趣缺缺了。」
03f2ca01d0dea4caa886611b684b599bbc33aaf6.translatedText: In 1948, the 49-year-old famous American novelist Ernest Hemingway and his fourth wife Mary Hemingway revisited Italy and lived in Venice. One day after autumn, the weather was cold and rainy. Hemingway, who loved hunting, was still very interested in hunting. He accompanied Count Carl Kechler and his friends on a hunting trip and hunted wild pigeons for fun. The nineteen-year-old noble lady Adriana Ivansage is the only woman in this group of people. Adrienne is naturally beautiful and charming. Her father fought on the battlefield and died for the country, and was raised by her mother. Her mother had a very strict upbringing and sent her to a Catholic school so that she could become a devout Catholic. Adriana had never fired a gun before this trip. The first time I went hunting, I not only found nothing, but my face was bruised by the bullet casing that was ejected from the gun chamber. That afternoon, at Kechler Manor, Adrienne was sitting by the large stove drying her clothes when Hemingway approached her. She turned to look at him, and he saw that the bullet casing scratches on her face were still red. "How are you, my dear?" Hemingway greeted in Italian. "Fortunately, I wish I had a comb." She wanted to comb her wet hair. She stopped laughing because of the pain on her face. Adrienne's pale and long face looked gloomy in the dim light of the stove. Hemingway stared into her pale brown eyes and was lost for a moment. He put down the brandy glass in his hand, took out his comb from his pocket, gave it to Adrienne, and said, "My daughter, use mine." She smiled out of genuine joy. It is strange that a gift as simple as a comb could tie two such different people together. Later, Adrienne became another confidante of Hemingway. Hemingway was much older and well versed in the affairs of the world, but Adrienne's innocence, tenderness, tenderness and thoughtfulness were qualities that attracted Hemingway that Mary did not possess. Hemingway entertained Adriana many times and had dinner with her at the restaurant of the Gritti Palace, a luxury hotel where he stayed. Adriana also often invited Hemingway to visit her manor and talk all night long in front of the fireplace in the living room. In Hemingway's next novel, "Across the River and Into the Woods," he used the male protagonist to express his love for Adrienne. The novel evolves into a love story between a nineteen-year-old girl and a fifty-year-old man. Here is a description of the heroine Renata: Then she walked into the room. She is a tall beauty with a long stride and a youthful glow. She was careless, letting the wind ruffle her hair. Her complexion was ashen, almost olive. Her grace is enough to win your heart or anyone else's. Her dark hair was full of luster and flowed down her shoulders. ——"Across the River and into the Woods" In 1950, Adriana, her mother Dora, and her brother Jean Franco went to Cuba to visit the Hemingway couple. Hemingway entertained them at a Little Florida restaurant and invited them to go fishing on the Pilar fishing boat. Mary enjoyed spending time with Jean Franco, and Hemingway enjoyed spending time with Adrienne. Mary did not know that the heroine Renata in her husband's novel "Across the River and into the Woods" was written based on Adrienne. Renata originally means "rebirth" and comes from Renata Bugatti, a friend Hemingway and his first wife Hadley made in Cortina, Italy many years ago. He wanted the love and admiration of his hero, Colonel Cornwell, to represent youthful vitality and be reborn in his heart. Let’s look at a description from the novel: She was tall and well-proportioned, young and beautiful. The colonel kissed her and felt her soft body clinging to him, while his own body was thick, strong and weathered. When he kissed her, his mind went blank. ——"Across the River and Into the Woods" Adriana admitted that her love affair with Hemingway never reached its peak, but in the basement of Hemingway's former residence in Lookout Mountain in Cuba, she found at least 26 affectionate and charming love letters written in Italian. Gerald, Hemingway scholar and vice president of the Hemingway Society Dr. Kennedy, talking about the relationship between Hemingway and Adrienne, said: "We can know from Mary's diary that the relationship between (Hemingway and Adrienne) was very close, and it may have been a relationship of close friends. Although Hemingway was suffering from many illnesses at that time, including occasional impotence, it is indeed difficult to imagine... It is well known that there is such a pattern. Every time he writes a major novel, there is always one Mrs. Ren, and the previous marriage has not yet broken up, he is already looking for and pursuing his next wife. I think it is fair to say that Adriana has an important influence on him under the same circumstances. She not only brings sensual excitement to his life, but also brings him creative inspiration. I think that whether they have done it in the bedroom, in fact, he has no interest in doing it. "

836c00067cecd1c0d1ad854c0898fc1b38f3a226.sourceText: 参院两党为避免国债危机做最后努力 有信心达成一致 周一，奥巴马总统召集议会领导人齐聚白宫，为避免美国政府债务违约和结束政府关门最后进行努力。 上周六开始， 美国国会参议院多数党领袖里德和少数党领袖麦康奈尔就开启了避免美国政府债务违约和结束政府关门的最后谈判。人们希冀在过去5年都能在两党拉锯中达成关键妥协的参议院领导人这次能”再现神功”。但连续48小时的”彻夜交谈”也未能给两党债务上限拉锯带来一丝积极的迹象。 在周一的会议上，奥巴马将继续坚持拒绝通过延长债务上限重启政府的理念。而里德和康乃尔似乎都对周一的谈判信心满满。 周一早上，缅因州共和党参议员苏珊 科林斯（SusanCollins)召开了另一场两党会议。据科林斯透露说，虽然目前还没有具体的方案成行，但两党的谈判已经取得了显著成效。 而根据美国两党政策中心(Bipartisan Policy Center，BPC）的最新预测，财政部资金耗尽导致美国国债技术性违约的期限将发生在10月22日~11月1日。 根据美国财政部相关财务网站TreasuryDirect的数据，从10月15日~11月15日，美国合计有4350亿美元需要展期的美国到期债券，其中17日有1200亿美元债券到期，24日将有930亿美元国债到期，31日将有890亿美元到期。而11月7日和14日则先后将有540亿美元和790亿美元到期。 而其中10月23日、10月31日和11月1日，则是该时间段需要支付款项的关键日。10月23日应付120亿美元社保福利金；10月31日应付60亿美元公债利息。而11月1日则应付各类款项合计超过550亿美元。
836c00067cecd1c0d1ad854c0898fc1b38f3a226.translatedText: The two parties in the Senate are making final efforts to avoid a national debt crisis and are confident of reaching an agreement. On Monday, President Obama summoned congressional leaders to the White House to make a final effort to avoid a default on the U.S. government's debt and end the government shutdown. Starting last Saturday, U.S. Senate Majority Leader Reid and Minority Leader McConnell began final negotiations to avoid a U.S. government debt default and end the government shutdown. People hope that the Senate leaders who have been able to reach key compromises in the tug-of-war between the two parties in the past five years can "repeat their magic skills" this time. However, 48 consecutive hours of "all-night talks" failed to bring any positive sign to the tug of war over the debt ceiling between the two parties. At Monday's meeting, Obama will continue to insist on rejecting the idea of ​​restarting the government by extending the debt ceiling. Both Reid and Cornell seemed confident about Monday's negotiations. Another bipartisan meeting was held Monday morning with Maine Republican Sen. Susan Collins. According to Collins, although no specific plan has yet been implemented, the negotiations between the two parties have achieved remarkable results. According to the latest forecast from the Bipartisan Policy Center (BPC), the period when the Treasury Department runs out of funds, leading to a technical default on U.S. Treasury bonds, will occur from October 22 to November 1. According to data from TreasuryDirect, a financial website related to the U.S. Department of the Treasury, from October 15th to November 15th, the United States has a total of $435 billion in U.S. maturing bonds that need to be rolled over, of which $120 billion in bonds will mature on the 17th, $93 billion in Treasury bonds will mature on the 24th, and $89 billion will mature on the 31st. On November 7 and 14, US$54 billion and US$79 billion will mature respectively. Among them, October 23, October 31 and November 1 are the key days when payments need to be made during this period. On October 23, US$12 billion in social security benefits were payable; on October 31, US$6 billion in public debt interest was payable. On November 1, the total amount of various types of payments due exceeded US$55 billion.

0849c34999a3e5d98e2e8818ff725336b7f70c58.sourceText: 唐孝先：《春江花月夜》诗与曲 唐代诗人张若虚七言古诗《春江花月夜》，以”春江潮水连海平，海上明月共潮生。”开头，以”不知乘月几人归，落月摇情满江树。”结尾，共三十六句，每四句一换韵，用清丽之笔，再现江南春夜景色，如同月光照耀下的万里长江画卷，同时寄寓着游子思归之情。该诗意境空明，缠绵非惻，词清语丽，韵调优美，写景写情交职成文，被前人誉為”孤篇盖全唐”，闻一多称之為”诗中之诗，顶峰上的顶峰。”诗人也因”孤篇横绝，竟為大家。” 古典琵琶大套文曲《夕阳簫鼓》，又名《潯阳月夜》、《潯阳琵琶》或《潯阳曲》，意境深远，乐音悠长，明清时期就已流传。《夕阳簫鼓》曲名最早见於清代姚燮《今乐考证》，而曲谱最早见於鞠自林所传《閒叙幽音》琵琶谱，以及一八一九年《南北二派秘本琵琶谱真传》等。一般说法，此曲后来取意唐诗名篇《春江花月夜》更名。 我的看法是，一九二五年上海大同乐会的柳尧章、郑覲文，将《夕阳簫鼓》改為丝竹合奏，而唐代诗人白居易名篇《琵琶行》首二句即為”潯阳江头夜送客，枫叶荻花秋索索。”后面又说：”我从去年辞帝京，謫居卧病潯阳城。潯阳地僻无音乐，终岁不闻丝竹声。”诗中三次提到潯阳（今江西九江境内长江段）。 因為《夕阳簫鼓》又名《潯阳月夜》、《潯阳琵琶》或《潯阳曲》，就根据成诗於潯阳畔的《琵琶行》中”春江花朝秋月夜”句，更名為《春江花月夜》，乐曲主奏乐器為琵琶、簫。 《春江花月夜》作為民族器乐曲，全曲分成十段：一，江楼鐘鼓；二，月上东山；三，风迴曲水；四，花影层叠；五，水云深际；六，渔舟唱晚；七，洄澜拍岸；八，橈鸣远瀨；九，欸乃归舟；十，尾声。 后来中国中央广播乐团指挥彭修文，对此曲进行细腻的艺术处理。他运用大乐队拥有的丰富乐器色彩，巧加编配，乐器时增时减，使乐队音响富有高低、浓淡、厚薄的变化，层次分明，使该曲既发扬古典音韵优雅的格调，又充满内在的激情，从而名立中国传统乐曲之首，二〇〇八年北京奥运会开幕式上演奏了此曲。 《春江花月夜》既有中国民族乐器独奏、不同配器组合的演奏，也有改编成钢琴曲、西洋管弦乐曲等表现形式。 《春江花月夜》全诗朗颂，配上《春江花月夜》全曲伴奏，可谓珠联璧合，天衣无缝，让人欣赏原汁原味的诗和曲。 经孟庆华填词、改编，由京剧名角于魁智（老生）、李胜素（青衣）对唱的京腔京调《春江花月夜》，别开生面，独树一帜，让人耳目一新。
0849c34999a3e5d98e2e8818ff725336b7f70c58.translatedText: Tang Xiaoxian: "Spring River with Flowers and Moonlight Night" poem and music The Tang Dynasty poet Zhang Ruoxu's seven-character poem "Spring River with Flowers and Moonlight Night" states: "The tide of the spring river reaches the level of the sea, and the bright moon rises with the tide on the sea." "It starts with "I don't know how many people are returning by the moon, and the falling moon shakes the trees all over the river with love." "At the end, there are thirty-six sentences in total. Every four sentences change the rhyme. With a clear and beautiful pen, the scenery of the spring night in the south of the Yangtze River is reproduced, like a scroll of the Yangtze River illuminated by the moonlight. At the same time, it expresses the wanderer's longing for home. The poem has a clear artistic conception, lingering and non-compassionate, clear words, beautiful rhymes, and a perfect description of the scene and emotion. It was praised by the predecessors as "a single poem that covers the entire Tang Dynasty". Wen Yiduo called it "the poem among poems, the pinnacle of the pinnacle." "The poet also became famous for everyone because of his solitary poem." " The classical pipa opera set "Sunset Flute and Drum", also known as "Xunyang Moon Night", "Xunyang Pipa" or "Xunyang Song", has profound artistic conception and long music. The title of "Sunset Flute and Drum" was first seen in Yao Xie's "Jin" in the Qing Dynasty. "Music Research", and the score was first found in "Xianxu Youyin" pipa score passed down by Ju Zilin, and "The True Biography of Pipa Score of the Northern and Southern Schools" in 1819. It is generally said that this song was later renamed after the famous Tang poem "Spring River Flower Moonlight Night". My opinion is that Liu Yaozhang and Zheng Jinwen of the Shanghai Datong Concert in 1925 changed "Sunset Flute and Drums" to a silk and bamboo ensemble, and the first two lines of the famous poem "Pipa Xing" by the Tang Dynasty poet Bai Juyi are "The Xunyang River sees off guests on the first night, and the maple leaves and flowers bloom in the autumn." "Later, he said: "I resigned from the imperial capital last year and was relegated to Xunyang City where I was sick. There is no music in Xunyang, a remote place, and the sound of silk and bamboo is not heard all year round. "Xunyang (now the Yangtze River section in Jiujiang, Jiangxi) is mentioned three times in the poem. Because "Sunset Flute and Drum" is also known as "Xunyang Moonlight Night", "Xunyang Pipa" or "Xunyang Song", it was renamed "Spring River Flowers Morning Night" based on the sentence "Spring River Flowers Chaoqiu Moon Night" in "Pipa Xing" written on the bank of Xunyang. The main instruments of the music are pipa and xiao. "Spring River with Flowers and Moonlight Night" is a national instrumental music piece. The whole song is divided into ten sections: 1. Bells and drums on the river tower; 2. The moon rises above the east mountain; 3. The wind returns to the water; 4. Flower shadows cascade; 5. The depth of water and clouds; 6. The fishing boat sings late; 7. The waves beat on the shore; 8. The beams ring in the distance; 9. The boat is returning to the boat; 10. The end. Later, Peng Xiuwen, the conductor of the China Central Broadcasting Orchestra, gave this piece a delicate artistic treatment. He used the rich instrument colors of the big band, cleverly arranged them, and added and subtracted the instruments, so that the orchestra's sound was full of changes in pitch, shade, and thickness. "Spring River with Flowers and Moonlight Night" includes Chinese folk musical instrument solos, performances of different orchestration combinations, and is also adapted into piano music, Western orchestral music and other forms of performance. Written and adapted by Meng Qinghua and sung by famous Peking opera actors Yu Kuizhi (Laosheng) and Li Shengsu (Tsing Yi), the Peking opera "Moonlight Night on the Spring River" is unique, unique and refreshing.

c9116304c3300aa72d57afcd8d8da7f7f9be7d6a.sourceText: 阳光圣地美国西南部亚利桑那州被《吉尼斯世界纪录大全》评为全球光照最多的地方，每年有4000小时的光照时间，相当于每天11个小时阳光。在此观赏科罗拉多大峡谷不失为一种极佳享受。
c9116304c3300aa72d57afcd8d8da7f7f9be7d6a.translatedText: Sunshine Land Arizona in the southwestern United States is rated as the place with the most sunshine in the world by the Guinness Book of World Records, with 4,000 hours of sunshine per year, equivalent to 11 hours of sunshine per day. Viewing the Grand Canyon here is an excellent experience.

21cbde333e65266eeeee2d326a43f5160f028925.sourceText: 地球上最干净的地方冰岛永冻冰层和北极光吸引着众多游客，然而这些远不足以形容冰岛的美。冰岛还拥有世界上最纯净的空气和水，天然的森林空气净化器源源不断提供新鲜空气。
21cbde333e65266eeeee2d326a43f5160f028925.translatedText: The cleanest place on earth, Iceland’s permafrost ice and northern lights attract many tourists, but these are far from enough to describe the beauty of Iceland. Iceland also has some of the purest air and water in the world, and natural forest air purifiers provide a constant supply of fresh air.

97f497f965dd54e58ad34fcce167a411dcb8453f.sourceText: 星光璀璨纳米比亚沙漠天气干旱，夜晚群星璀璨，吸引着全球各地的天文爱好者。这儿还专门设有大量的观星场地，游客可以享受360度全景式观星。
97f497f965dd54e58ad34fcce167a411dcb8453f.translatedText: The stars are shining. The weather in the Namibia desert is dry and the stars are shining brightly at night, attracting astronomy enthusiasts from all over the world. There are also a large number of stargazing venues here, where visitors can enjoy 360-degree panoramic stargazing.

571e10096e646d70bc5f84c8fa2fbd74be2c1576.sourceText: 地球上风最少的国家刚果民主共和国据说是全球最少刮风的国家。不仅很少吹风，而且风速极低。
571e10096e646d70bc5f84c8fa2fbd74be2c1576.translatedText: The windiest country on earth, the Democratic Republic of the Congo is said to be the windiest country in the world. Not only is there little wind, but the wind speed is extremely low.

544636be7f0b1541749e8707deb09ed06d4366c4.sourceText: 滑雪胜地由于每年降雪丰富，加拿大BC省的滑雪度假区是滑雪爱好者的最爱。
544636be7f0b1541749e8707deb09ed06d4366c4.translatedText: Ski resorts Due to the abundant snowfall every year, the ski resorts in BC, Canada are the favorites of ski enthusiasts.

be980648cdc8a2ab82157dce99c63bf0310f07dd.sourceText: 地球上最湿润的地方由于地处地中海东海岸，塞浦路斯拥有全球最佳气候，非常湿润，吸引着众多游客。
be980648cdc8a2ab82157dce99c63bf0310f07dd.translatedText: The wettest place on earth. Located on the east coast of the Mediterranean, Cyprus has the best climate in the world and is very humid, attracting many tourists.

b0dcb2577bb18e026d05b89cc25e2d2ed7a2119b.sourceText: 全球雨量最少的国家每年仅0.07厘米的降水量使得智利成为全球最干旱的国家之一。
b0dcb2577bb18e026d05b89cc25e2d2ed7a2119b.translatedText: The country with the least rainfall in the world. The annual precipitation of only 0.07 centimeters makes Chile one of the driest countries in the world.

4f2e5422baab2b74221a9f565bb0766a4d307e5f.sourceText: 最炎热的国家巴西60%之多的国土面积被热带雨林覆盖，是全球雨林面积最大的国家，拥有1700种鸟类，以及其他众多珍稀动植物物种。
4f2e5422baab2b74221a9f565bb0766a4d307e5f.translatedText: The hottest country, Brazil has 60% of its land area covered by tropical rainforest. It is the country with the largest rainforest area in the world and is home to 1,700 species of birds and many other rare animal and plant species.

9449d192a7d013f9d5f25ce78da890fe9c89ee03.sourceText: 中国国民党七月十九日全代会通过洪秀柱参选中华民国第十四任总统，亚利桑那直属分部洪秀柱后援会筹备已久，随即于同一天在凤凰城正式成立，与会党员及来宾计五十六人。 资深党员闵中英，詹浩文及惠斌华担任召集人，荣誉会长谷音，秘书处杨永慧，财务处梁小燕及严瑜，执行委员苏莉莉、梁维国、曹嘉仪、潘文慧、陈超仁、蔡昌、李问浙、傅屏生、 丘仲平及王玮𤧟。 大会主席闵中英首先简介洪秀柱历经党内初选制度，通过联署提名，跨越民调门槛，获得正式提名。 早于党内第一阶段、第一时间，亚利桑那直属分部同志即参与联署支持，经全代会正式提名，本分部即因应成立后援会，由衷支持洪秀柱之承担勇气与护党决心，更认同其治国理念与施政方针。 闵主席续述洪秀柱六月十六日中常会演讲参选理念之要点。 台湾当前民粹横行，阻拦立法施政，毫无理性地反中锁国，以致经济停滞，产业退化，社会仇恨与族群对立日益加深，而学校教育与媒体传播，肆意歪曲误导，民粹盲目跟从，是非不分，毫无理智地反政府，社会日益沉沦，却完全不顾后果。 洪秀柱具体地倡议签署两岸和平协定，积极参与国际组织，充分发展经济，合理调整财税及立法制度，实现公平分配正义。会中，潘文慧及王厚济先后唸完洪秀柱初选讲稿。 直属分部顾问谷音远从洛杉矶赴会。 她说，基于与分部之深厚情谊，以及对洪秀柱之支持，此行乃义不容辞，深具意义。洪秀柱从初选一路走来，风雨波折，但始终勇往直前。以谷音的话直说，”她都站起来，我们没有理由不站起来！”。 洪秀柱不玩黑金，将设立台币百元小额捐款专户，筹募基金，打此一艰辛选战，立即获得捐款响应。 参加马总统过境洛城餐会时，极为感慨台湾民众及媒体偏差，竟全盘抹杀马总统团队之政绩。台湾竞争力、购买力、与就业率虽非名列世界前茅，但仍是绝大多数国家望尘莫及，台湾购买力甚至高于英国与日本，连美国国会议员均一一登台致词肯定。 谷音也提供马总统执政七年与民进党扁政府时期政绩比较表，包含免签证国、租税协定、鱼业协定、劳保年金、与社会治安等类目，两相对照，高下立见。 总之，我们认同洪秀柱的信念，中国国民党是创建亚洲第一个民主共和国之泱泱大党，秉持先烈先贤的党魂党德与中心思想。 我们决不妥协，决不姑息，争一时，更争千秋。我们要大是大非，绝不能失掉格局、原则与志气。 直属分部 ”依道不依势，依志不依力”，大家同心协力，诚如召集人惠斌华最后发言呼吁，儘量返国投票，尽力助选，这是一场只能赢、不能输的关键选战。
9449d192a7d013f9d5f25ce78da890fe9c89ee03.translatedText: The National Congress of the Chinese Kuomintang approved Hong Xiuzhu’s candidacy for the 14th President of the Republic of China. The Arizona branch of the Hong Xiuzhu Support Association had been in preparation for a long time and was officially established in Phoenix on the same day. Fifty-six party members and guests attended the meeting. Senior party members Min Zhongying, Zhan Haowen and Hui Binhua served as conveners, Honorary President Gu Yin, Secretariat Yang Yonghui, Finance Department Liang Xiaoyan and Yan Yu, executive members Su Lili, Liang Weiguo, Cao Jiayi, Pan Wenhui, Chen Chaoren, Cai Chang, Li Wenzhe, Fu Pingsheng, Qiu Zhongping and Wang Wei𤧟. Chairman of the conference Min Zhongying first introduced that Hong Xiuzhu had gone through the party's primary election system, passed the joint signature nomination, crossed the polling threshold, and was officially nominated. As early as the first stage of the party, comrades from the Arizona branch signed a petition to support it. After being formally nominated by the National Congress, the branch immediately established a support group to sincerely support Hong Xiuzhu's courage and determination to protect the party, and also recognized his philosophy of governing the country and his policies. Chairman Min continued to elaborate on the key points of Hong Xiuzhu’s speech at the regular meeting of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China on June 16. Populism is currently rampant in Taiwan, obstructing legislation and governance, and irrationally anti-China, resulting in economic stagnation, industrial degradation, and deepening social hatred and ethnic opposition. School education and media dissemination are wantonly distorting and misleading, and populism blindly follows, does not distinguish between right and wrong, and is irrationally anti-government. The society is sinking day by day, but completely regardless of the consequences. Hong Xiuzhu specifically advocated signing a cross-strait peace agreement, actively participating in international organizations, fully developing the economy, rationally adjusting the fiscal and taxation and legislative systems, and achieving fair distribution and justice. During the meeting, Pan Wenhui and Wang Houji successively read Hong Xiuzhu’s primary election speeches. Gu Yinyuan, consultant of the direct branch, attended the meeting from Los Angeles. She said that based on her deep friendship with the branch and her support for Hong Xiuzhu, this trip was obligatory and meaningful. Hong Xiuzhu's journey from the primary election has been full of ups and downs, but he has always moved forward bravely. To put it bluntly in Gu Yin's words, "She has stood up, there is no reason for us not to stand up!". Hong Xiuzhu will not play with black money. He will set up a special account for small donations of NT$100 to raise funds. He will fight this arduous campaign and receive an immediate response from donations. When I attended a dinner party hosted by President Ma when he passed through Los Angeles, I was deeply moved by the bias of the Taiwanese people and media, which completely wiped out the achievements of President Ma's team. Although Taiwan's competitiveness, purchasing power, and employment rate are not among the best in the world, they are still beyond the reach of most countries. Taiwan's purchasing power is even higher than that of the United Kingdom and Japan. Even members of the U.S. Congress took the stage to give affirmative speeches. Gu Yin also provided a comparison table of President Ma’s performance during his seven years in power and that of the Democratic Progressive Party government, including visa-free countries, tax agreements, fishery agreements, labor insurance and pensions, and social security. In short, we agree with Hong Xiuzhu's belief that the Chinese Kuomintang is the great party that created Asia's first democratic republic and upholds the party soul, party ethics and central ideology of the martyrs and sages. We will never compromise or tolerate. If we fight for a moment, we will fight for the future. We must be clear about right and wrong, and we must never lose our pattern, principles and aspirations. The directly affiliated branch "follows the road, not the situation, and the will, not the strength." Everyone works together. Just as the convener Hui Binhua called on in his final speech, try to return to the country to vote and do your best to help the election. This is a critical election that can only be won and cannot be lost.

Southwest Airlines takes the lead in raising prices...

741cf54e4fc2599454e38c011fc8db49fd23f731.sourceText: 多家航空公司计划今年第五次涨价。 西南航空率先提高票价，不到500英里的单程票价上涨五美元。 西南航空提高票价时，其它航空公司大都跟进， 并且那种涨价会持续下去。 到目前为止，全美最大的航空公司–达美（Delta）、美国航空（US Airways）、联合航空（United）和美利坚航空（American）都已跟随西南航空涨价。 维京美国（Virgin America）也提高了短程航空票价，包括旧金山到圣地亚哥、拉斯维加斯和洛杉矶等同西南航空竞争的航线。 美国各航空公司今年保持盈利，但仍然抱怨营运​​开支上涨，主要是因为燃料费上涨。 它们由于减少航班和减少座位，能够维较高票价。 今年以来，航空公司八次试图提高票价，其中四次成功。 最新一次由西南航空牵头，成为第五次。 西南航空的平均单程票价为141.72美元，平均里程为939英里。 去年航空公司试图22次涨价，其中9次成功。 票价比较网（Farecompare.com）执行长西尼说，今年以来，航空公司试图改变策略。 通常，航空公司涨价都是比较大的范围。 但上个星期，达美航空提高商务旅行者票价，对最后一刻钟买票的乘客收取高票价，也提供更多空间。 但其它公司没有跟进，那一做法失败。
741cf54e4fc2599454e38c011fc8db49fd23f731.translatedText: Many airlines plan to increase prices for the fifth time this year. Southwest Airlines was the first to raise its fares, increasing one-way fares of less than 500 miles by $5. When Southwest raises its fares, most other airlines follow suit, and those price increases tend to continue. So far, the nation's largest airlines - Delta, US Airways, United and American - have followed Southwest in raising prices. Virgin America has also raised fares on short-haul flights, including San Francisco to San Diego, Las Vegas and Los Angeles, where Southwest competes. U.S. airlines have remained profitable this year but still complain about rising operating expenses, mainly due to rising fuel costs. With fewer flights and fewer seats, they are able to maintain higher fares. Airlines have tried to raise fares eight times this year, four of which have been successful. The latest, led by Southwest Airlines, becomes the fifth. Southwest's average one-way fare is $141.72 and the average mileage is 939 miles. Airlines tried to raise prices 22 times last year, nine of which were successful. Farecompare.com CEO Sini said that this year, airlines have tried to change their strategies. Usually, airline price increases are relatively large. But last week, Delta Air Lines raised its fares for business travelers, charging more for last-minute tickets and offering more space. But other companies didn't follow suit, and that approach failed.

78623646dd52f616aee97b4474d845ec38bc0f95.sourceText: (侨联通讯)由凤凰卫视主办的＂中华小姐环球大赛＂已进入第十年。美洲赛区今年选择到亚利桑那州进行，将打造出一台热情、浪漫、神祕的选美赛事。 十年来，参加环球大赛的中华小姐，都会参加一个奇妙的旅程，凤凰卫视将把中华佳丽选美过程拍成迷你系列送给观众。 今年，参加中华小姐环球大赛（美洲赛区）的选手将参观亚利桑那州的着名景点，如鲍威尔湖，羚羊谷，和圣都那(Sedona) 等 。凤凰卫视也将举办亚利桑那州独特的文化活动，安排佳丽们参加希拉河印第安之夜的访谈节目等。8月10日下午2时，中华小姐环球大赛（美洲赛区）总决赛，将在亚利桑那州凤凰城野马赌场酒店举行。入场赠券请洽：六福酒家 欣欣超市 新东方艺校。VIP票请与侨联张肇鸿先生预订，电话(602)788-7808。

Over the past ten years, Miss China who have participated in the global competition will take part in a wonderful journey. This year, contestants participating in the Miss China Universe (American Division) will visit famous attractions in Arizona, such as Lake Powell, Antelope Canyon, and Sedona. Phoenix TV will also organize unique cultural events in Arizona and arrange for beauties to participate in the Gila River Indian Night interview program. At 2 p.m. on August 10, the finals of the Miss China Universe (American Division) will be held at the Wild Horse Casino Hotel in Phoenix, Arizona. For admission tickets, please contact: Luk Fook Restaurant, Xinxin Supermarket, and New Oriental Art School. fbb29deb2fac886972fe920a38f77f6429e34632.sourceText: 1879 年 5 月，由于酷暑，南太平洋铁路公司停止了穿越亚利桑那州的工作，铁轨在凤凰城以南 35 英里处名为 Terminus（Casa Grande）的附近，许多暂时失业的中国工人前往凤凰城寻找工作和夏天的住所。当时凤凰城中国人的数量仍然很少。
fbb29deb2fac886972fe920a38f77f6429e34632.translatedText: In May 1879, due to the intense heat, the Southern Pacific Railroad stopped its work across Arizona. The tracks were located near Terminus (Casa Grande) 35 miles south of Phoenix. Many temporarily unemployed Chinese workers went to Phoenix to find work and summer residence. At that time, the number of Chinese in Phoenix was still very small.

756361c716028ac99ab541b8ef8bba977c2283d9.sourceText: 1880 年 1 月，在铁路建设恢复后，大多数华人重返工作岗位，但已知至少有 164 人留在马里科帕县，在凤凰城及其周边地区形成了相当大的华人社区。那些搬进城里的人开办了杂货店、餐馆和洗衣店，并找到了家庭佣人、厨师、园丁和蔬菜小贩的工作。
756361c716028ac99ab541b8ef8bba977c2283d9.translatedText: In January 1880, after railroad construction resumed, most Chinese returned to work, but at least 164 are known to have remained in Maricopa County, forming a sizable Chinese community in and around Phoenix. Those who moved into the city opened grocery stores, restaurants, and laundries, and found work as domestic servants, cooks, gardeners, and vegetable vendors.

5b03d73d781feb64e22b46b8d6ccd776876d487d.sourceText: 第一个时段唐人街是位于 1st（当时称为 Montezuma）和 Adams 街的华人企业和寄宿公寓群。 唐人街为中国移民提供了一个独立的空间来建立社区和他们的企业发展的地方。
5b03d73d781feb64e22b46b8d6ccd776876d487d.translatedText: First Period Chinatown was a cluster of Chinese businesses and boarding houses located at 1st (then known as Montezuma) and Adams streets. Chinatown provided a separate space for Chinese immigrants to build community and a place where their businesses could develop.

1b12d5bd25d80f213f24c2d3ed2bd103f17399de.sourceText: 当时的亚利桑那人认为华人是不受欢迎的居民，但他们没有如加利福尼亚人对待华人的仇恨，而更多是抱怨胜于威胁。最常见的投诉是针对洗衣业。在1881年，凤凰城议会宣布“洗衣店”为公众骚扰，后来征收了洗衣执照税，许多人被指控无证经营洗衣。《菲尼克斯报》(Phoenix Gazette)经常抱怨华人控制着洗衣房，饭店和蔬菜园的业务，但显然没有白人愿意来竞争这些工作。
1b12d5bd25d80f213f24c2d3ed2bd103f17399de.translatedText: At that time, Arizonans considered the Chinese to be unwelcome residents, but they did not have the same hatred towards the Chinese as the Californians, and complained more than threatened them. The most common complaints are against the laundry industry. In 1881, the Phoenix City Council declared "laundries" a public nuisance, later imposed a laundry license tax, and many people were charged with operating laundries without a license. The Phoenix Gazette often complained that Chinese controlled the laundry, restaurant and vegetable garden operations, but apparently no whites were willing to compete for these jobs.

dfa18d72f255b213994615cc0bc9ed80a973755e.sourceText: 然而，到 1890 年代初，白人商人发起了将唐人街迁出该市不断发展的商业区的运动。当时，中国移民不被允许拥有财产，因此他们没有被驱逐出租赁建筑物的保护。
dfa18d72f255b213994615cc0bc9ed80a973755e.translatedText: However, by the early 1890s, white merchants launched a movement to move Chinatown out of the city's growing commercial district. At the time, Chinese immigrants were not allowed to own property, so they had no protection from eviction from rented buildings.

f77b8a2fc5855f969fecfcc800fc08158eef3dba.sourceText: 1895年，白人商人发起移走“中国殖民地”(Chinese colony) 运动，把唐人街迁离不断发展的商业区。华人被威胁不离开会将唐人街摧毁。
f77b8a2fc5855f969fecfcc800fc08158eef3dba.translatedText: In 1895, white businessmen launched a movement to remove the "Chinese colony" and moved Chinatown away from the growing commercial district. The Chinese were threatened that Chinatown would be destroyed if they did not leave.

83819c562eb0cec045cc41e03d64004d5df6eb98.sourceText: 凤凰城第二次的唐人街，位置是沿著华盛顿、亚当斯、范布伦(Washington,Adams, Van Buren)的三条街，跨越9个街区。但有些商家仍然留在旧唐人街。在大部分建筑物里，如餐馆、杂货店、洗衣店，一楼用作做生意，楼上则是宿舍。
83819c562eb0cec045cc41e03d64004d5df6eb98.translatedText: The second Chinatown in Phoenix is ​​located along the three streets of Washington, Adams, and Van Buren, spanning 9 blocks. But some businesses remain in old Chinatown. In most buildings, such as restaurants, grocery stores, and laundromats, the first floor is used for business and the upper floors are dormitories.

5efc95ad0252ffe5fb0689ae849d847666425243.sourceText: 到了1930年代，在唐人街的几乎每个街区都有一家华人杂货店。华人杂货店已有60多家。如遇到有白人商家竞争，华人宁可把店搬到其他的地方。他们辛勤和长时间工作，商店每天开门超过15个小时，一年到头营业。到1930年代后期，经过几代人的努力，年轻人可以享受中产阶级舒服的生活方式。1945年，由于华裔大量的迁出，凤凰城的第二处唐人街几乎完全消失。[119]
5efc95ad0252ffe5fb0689ae849d847666425243.translatedText: By the 1930s, there was a Chinese grocery store on almost every block in Chinatown. There are more than 60 Chinese grocery stores. If they encounter competition from white merchants, the Chinese would rather move their stores to other places. They work hard and long hours, and the store is open more than 15 hours a day, all year round. By the late 1930s, after several generations of hard work, young people could enjoy a comfortable middle-class lifestyle. In 1945, due to the large-scale emigration of Chinese Americans, the second Chinatown in Phoenix almost completely disappeared. [119]

28c76cad754116354d2846adc37df7f9403f2edf.sourceText: 凤凰城的第一处唐人街的地图，来自桑伯恩地图和出版公司（Phoenix’s First Chinatown, 1889. Sanborn Map and Publishing Co.）, 以及凤凰城的第二处唐人街的地图。
28c76cad754116354d2846adc37df7f9403f2edf.translatedText: Map of Phoenix’s First Chinatown, 1889. Sanborn Map and Publishing Co., and map of Phoenix’s Second Chinatown.

8792afb0b8031f0fba9570b2993e2ffa1d0ff0e1.sourceText: 1990年，根据鳯凰城市政建设规划，要兴建一所可容体育场及会议厅等综合性的庞大建筑群。当时包括上世纪五十年代初在本埠兴建的英端大厦在内，很多楼房因需要而被政府徵用拆除。
8792afb0b8031f0fba9570b2993e2ffa1d0ff0e1.translatedText: In 1990, according to the municipal construction plan of Huanghuang City, a large comprehensive building complex that could accommodate stadiums, conference halls, etc. was to be built. At that time, many buildings, including the Ying Tuan Building built in the city in the early 1950s, were requisitioned and demolished by the government due to needs.

4bb936618c613f382835185dab91b2823d034587.sourceText: 在挖掘地基时，发现了许多物品，遂即断定那是当年华埠居民的遗物或弃物。政府当即发出五万元的预算来，以供考古专家雇佣工人等项的开支。这些发掘出的遗物和弃物充分说明：在至早期，鳯凰城已有了华人，华人是鳯凰城的一部份、社团的一份子。在发掘后加以断定：当年的华埠座落在第一街至第三街之间，南北则以麦地森街(Madison Street )与捷弗森街(Jafferson Street)为界，是鳯凰城第二次唐人街的繁华地带。在1890年初，本城华埠人数已逾二百。
4bb936618c613f382835185dab91b2823d034587.translatedText: During the excavation of the foundation, many items were found, and they were immediately concluded to be relics or discarded items from Chinatown residents at that time. The government immediately issued a budget of NT$50,000 to cover expenses such as hiring archaeological experts and workers. These excavated relics and discarded objects fully demonstrate that in the earliest days, there were Chinese people in Huanghuang City, and the Chinese were part of the city and a part of the community. After excavation, it was determined that Chinatown at that time was located between First Street and Third Street, bounded by Madison Street and Jafferson Street to the north and south. It was the bustling area of ​​Phoenix City's second Chinatown. In early 1890, the city's Chinatown population exceeded 200.

0c1a13e44bca63e5210326261284eda3d8185ceb.sourceText: 发掘出的这一批十九世末的华埠文物，立即引起凤凰城侨界的高度重视。有本地华商会的老侨和华裔提议将文物展出，得到了侨社各界的大力支持，共筹到近两万元，综合市政府及各方面资助达到五万二千多元。
0c1a13e44bca63e5210326261284eda3d8185ceb.translatedText: This batch of Chinatown cultural relics from the late 19th century unearthed immediately attracted great attention from the overseas Chinese community in Phoenix. Some elderly overseas Chinese and ethnic Chinese from the local Chinese Chamber of Commerce proposed to exhibit the cultural relics, which received strong support from all walks of life in the overseas Chinese community. A total of nearly 20,000 yuan was raised, and the combined funding from the municipal government and various parties reached more than 52,000 yuan.

69efb6278ea095628442c0ce926bcf504a64e964.sourceText: 大球埸竣工后，在1992年9月，〝斐匿中国城文物展览〞首次在球场东面的大厅揭幕，展览的出土文物包括有陶瓷、水砚、茶壶、酒樽等两个专柜，还有早期华人回国返美文件，以及上世纪初期的斐匿中文学校相片、课本等等。斐匿中国城文物还在全美各地多个城市进行过展览。
69efb6278ea095628442c0ce926bcf504a64e964.translatedText: After the completion of the stadium, in September 1992, the "Fine Chinatown Cultural Relics Exhibition" was opened for the first time in the east hall of the stadium. The unearthed cultural relics on display include two special counters such as ceramics, inkstones, teapots, and wine bottles, as well as documents of early Chinese returning to the United States, as well as photos and textbooks of the Feinian Chinese School in the early 20th century. Phenomenal Chinatown cultural relics have also been exhibited in many cities across the United States.

e5fdf3921a2621185cfcf6b55e5937f0f524e3e4.sourceText: 当年的文物在展出过后，已经被博物馆收藏。有鉴于此，在2016年4月，笔者和时任大凤凰城华人侨联总会的邓洪钺主席（下图），去了鳯凰城市立博物馆，对亚省华人先民的历史作了一次调查。
e5fdf3921a2621185cfcf6b55e5937f0f524e3e4.translatedText: The cultural relics from that year have been collected by the museum after being exhibited. In view of this, in April 2016, the author and Deng Hongyue (pictured below), then Chairman of the Greater Phoenix Overseas Chinese Federation, went to the Phoenix Municipal Museum to conduct an investigation into the history of the Chinese ancestors of Alberta.

dffd6e033ac4106416650e533a5359215138d009.sourceText: 博物馆馆长Lindsey Vogel-Teeter亲自接待了我们。对于博物馆而言，除上世纪九十年代办过出土文物展览外，近卅年来已没有相关的华人团体来查询过这些历史了。馆长相当敬业，她准备了很多相关的文件，书籍，相片供查阅。之后，还亲自带我们进入到内部的文物馆藏室，让我们参观和拍摄当年出土的华人先民的物件。我们在博物馆内部看到不少当年的出土文物。
dffd6e033ac4106416650e533a5359215138d009.translatedText: Museum Director Lindsey Vogel-Teeter received us personally. As for the museum, except for the exhibition of unearthed cultural relics held in the 1990s, no relevant Chinese groups have inquired about these histories in the past 30 years. The curator is very dedicated and has prepared many relevant documents, books, and photos for review. After that, he personally took us into the internal cultural relics collection room, allowing us to visit and take photos of the objects of the Chinese ancestors that were unearthed that year. We saw many unearthed cultural relics from that year inside the museum.

52a468cf192627580369d0d1e932e33d0bb5ccae.sourceText: 文物放置在一排排的专柜之中，打开后，在贴上标签的塑胶袋中的文物，可近距离清晰地见到，有部分可以戴上手套触摸，也可移放到安置著专门灯光的地方去拍摄，并且有详细的介绍。
52a468cf192627580369d0d1e932e33d0bb5ccae.translatedText: The cultural relics are placed in rows of counters. After opening, the cultural relics in the labeled plastic bags can be clearly seen at close range. Some parts can be touched with gloves, or moved to a place with special lighting for photography, and there are detailed introductions.

a9a3153a8ce9198b49db56db38ef46267a3b1c54.sourceText: 在博物馆中的华埠遗物，还有约两千件尚待配凑、胶合、分类、储存、以及附加说明等工作。遗物大部份为玻璃瓶、酒瓶、饮料瓶、奶瓶、药瓶，其古老者可有二百年历史，磁器有中、英、墨及本州PIMA制品，也有不完整的宋磁又曰青磁 (CELADON) ，小件如钮扣耳饰、古铜钱等。
a9a3153a8ce9198b49db56db38ef46267a3b1c54.translatedText: There are still about 2,000 Chinatown relics in the museum that need to be assembled, glued, classified, stored, and explained. Most of the relics are glass bottles, wine bottles, beverage bottles, milk bottles, and medicine bottles. Some of them are as old as 200 years old. The porcelain includes Chinese, English, Ink, and Honshu PIMA products. There are also incomplete Song Dynasty porcelain, also known as CELADON, and small items such as button earrings, bronze coins, etc.

638dd53723f5f7409ea6dc2ccd336d87ab61821b.sourceText: 张肇鸿和邓洪钺还去了ASU的大学图书馆，查阅和搜集有关鳯凰城华人历史的相关资料。
638dd53723f5f7409ea6dc2ccd336d87ab61821b.translatedText: Zhang Zhaohong and Deng Hongyue also went to the ASU university library to check and collect relevant information about the history of the Chinese in Phoenix City.

88a3ea8f5a432a8d5a8a4d65d6b0da2faf421a0c.sourceText: (凤凰城龙冈公所报导) 2016年5月7日至9日，美洲龙冈总公所主席张国钦伉俪到访凤凰城，指导本年度在凤凰城举办的第21届美洲恳亲大会的筹备工作。
88a3ea8f5a432a8d5a8a4d65d6b0da2faf421a0c.translatedText: (reported by the Phoenix Longgang Office) From May 7 to 9, 2016, Mr. and Mrs. Zhang Guoqin, chairman of the Longgang Americas Office, visited Phoenix to guide the preparations for the 21st Americas Friendship Conference held in Phoenix this year.

fc7237ec44f0855680231c9dd9e211ce796eeeb8.sourceText: 今年10月，凤凰城龙冈将承办美洲龙冈恳亲代表大会，包括美国、加拿大、墨西哥、秘鲁及台湾的代表前来参加。恳亲大会的任务光荣又艰巨，龙冈全体成员正在为办好恳亲大会而努力准备。在工作会议其间，张主席听取了凤凤城龙冈公所的汇报，对目前的筹备工作给予支持和肯定。并对恳亲活动行程计划提出了建议，在一些具体项目上给予实际的支援。张主席伉俪到访其间，还参观了为恳亲活动所预定的旅店、餐馆。凤凰城龙冈全体成员热烈欢迎主席伉俪的到访，盛情招待远道而来的首长，并表示将齐心合力，继续筹办好这次恳亲大会。
fc7237ec44f0855680231c9dd9e211ce796eeeb8.translatedText: In October this year, Phoenix Longgang will host the Longgang America Congress, including representatives from the United States, Canada, Mexico, Peru and Taiwan. The task of the kissing conference is glorious and arduous. All members of Longgang are working hard to prepare for the kissing conference. During the working meeting, Chairman Zhang listened to the report from Fengfengcheng Longgang Office and gave support and affirmation to the current preparatory work. He also made suggestions for the itinerary of the pro-family activities and provided practical support on some specific projects. During their visit, Chairman Zhang and his wife also visited the hotels and restaurants booked for the wedding event. All members of Phoenix City Longgang warmly welcomed the visit of the chairman and his wife, warmly entertained the chiefs who came from afar, and expressed that they would work together to continue to prepare for this intimate meeting.

cc3296cdf891e87489867d2d7df0cb7bbc87ffbf.sourceText: 代序— ”放逐天涯客” 一九九八年十一月内子婉冰出版首部散文与微型小说合集”回流岁月”，至今转瞬十多年；她于二零零六年二月发行的”扰攘红尘拾絮”，却是 澳洲华文诗坛第一部汉俳诗集。 相隔六载后的龙年，其新著微型小说集”放逐天涯客”即将面世，有幸作为此书原稿的第一位读者；又请我代撰序文，踌躇犹豫，唯恐贻笑方家。 因闺命难违，幸有”内举不避亲”之说，唯有硬着头皮勉强为之，试以阅读后感受略陈心得，还望文评家们不吝赐正。 一九九三年婉冰心血来潮开始投稿，翌年就发表了首篇微型小说，在过去长达十八载里，她的”微型小说”作品不到百篇，平均每年四至五篇；其余时间多 撰散文、汉俳和诗作。 算不上是多产的作家，一如她过往喜欢唱、演粤剧般，自视为业余票友而非专业。 偶而兴之所至引吭高歌，全无压力的自唱自娱 。 灵感涌现时便伏案创作，撰写文章、小说更无半分功利思想。 全是随缘随喜 ，作品量少也就不足为怪了。 她操曲的美妙嗓音来自天赋，动人的歌声无师自通；作诗写文撰小说，亦如我一样自学而成。 拥有兰质惠心及智慧，再加上就读高中时、课余曾在当代大儒赵大钝老师门下修习古文(赵老师定居雪梨郊区、已九十余岁)，打下良好中文根基。 因而、其诗、文、小说选字遣词极见典雅、国学功力自然流露无遗。 ”微型小说”分为多类，这部集子所收录篇章，总括看来，多属揉合散文笔锋类。 行文或形容，都可见到优美散文章法，绝非时下那些流行通俗言情作品的泛泛之作。 试引已被「维州华文作家协会」出版的选集、采用她那篇「枫林道上」作为书名，此篇文句如: 「枫树急忙伸展绿掌，向晴空献媚求吻，竟教春风恣意耍弄。」 「其忧郁眼神写着无奈与哀伤，惹得花草被感染盈泪相望。」拟人化的丰富想像力，花草竟能「盈泪相望」？ ”良好市民”中:「长空闪烁的群星，正偷偷张望着，引证人性的虚伪；皓月也在努力，欲射穿其白天所说的谎言。」将群星与皓月看成有灵性之人了。 ” 喜讯”:「轻盈旋动那条黑色呢士薄薄软软长裙，是那么潇洒飘逸。通花雅致的布料，隐约透现肤色内衣，是充满无限诱惑。」对穿着形容将女性诱人 姿色显现，若无细微观察力，不易如此描述。 ”稀客”:「忽然镜中出现秀发披肩，曲线纤美肤色若雪的洋少女，咀角扯露阴凄笑意。影像在身旁隐约飘移、、、」将幽灵鬼影、当成走在 街上的洋美女了。 「凄冷冬夜,寒风飒飒，被强撼树影无奈地参差，仿佛像蠢蠢欲动幢幢魑魅；逼逗得墨尔本的夜空更冻寒，让星月渐减退皓亮。 」 此篇”冬冷碎童心” 首 段描写仿似幽美散文。 「仅汪伯迟缓的胶鞋步履声，正在无奈地敲击着寂寞地板，器皿赶紧用不规律响声，不断的和应。」西方社会老年人悲歌的写照，反映现实的?#28891;泪滴残年?仍 用拟人化形容，以「地板寂寞」反射了汪伯的孤单？ 器皿居然会「和应」？ 像此类巧思在集中篇章颇多。 ”谁识寸草心”将社会时事当题材，逆转结尾始知富家女的身份，令读者惊讶。 微型小说结局运用「逆转式」而不流于公式化，能让读者深感意外而符合事实，非有巧妙灵思难处理。 如何令读者信服「逆转」合情合理，又不到最后一段无法测知，都是考验微型小说作家的本领与技巧。 这本集子多篇创作、婉冰皆应用了「逆转」方法，惊奇的结局往往让读者大感意外，完全达到微型小说迷人境界。 用作书名的那篇「放逐天涯客」，婉冰于一九七八年举家海上逃难、伦落印尼荒岛十七日的恶梦，竟化为与自身苦难无关的小说。 描述千辛万苦投奔怒海后的倩儿最后被奸杀，其父老程疯癫自语:「是妳曾经谋杀的鬼魂找妳偿命吧! 」那位越战时「为虎作伥」的越共女特工倩儿，终于横死新乡，逃不出善恶报应因果律。 由于婉冰有国学根基，平素又爱唱歌词典雅的粤剧；更喜欢阅读「红楼梦」及唐诗宋词；其微型小说打题，已蕴含雅意。 如:「多情只剩春庭月」、「重施迷雾惑心魂」、「烛泪滴残年」、「风动旧梦寒」等等。 读婉冰这册”放逐天涯客”微型小说集，虽非篇篇为精品；但其迷人处，是同时可感受到她婉约笔法，灵巧构思以及清丽雅致的散文佳句。 还是留待读者们慢慢细读吧，行文至此是该打住了；不然会有「老黄卖瓜」之嫌啦!
cc3296cdf891e87489867d2d7df0cb7bbc87ffbf.translatedText: Preface - "Exiling Guests from the End of the World" In November 1998, Nei Zi Wanbing published her first collection of essays and micro-novels, "Returning to the Years", and it has been more than ten years since then. Her "Disturbing the Red Dust", released in February 2006, was the first collection of Chinese haiku poems in the Australian Chinese poetry circle. Six years later, in the Year of the Dragon, his new micro-novel collection "Exiled from the End of the World" is about to be published. I am honored to be the first reader of the original manuscript of this book. He also asked me to write the preface, but he hesitated for fear of making the Fang family laugh. Because it is hard to disobey a girlfriend's orders, fortunately there is a saying that "do not avoid relatives when you are in love", so I can only bite the bullet and do it reluctantly. I will try to give a brief summary of my experience after reading it, and hope that literary critics will not hesitate to correct me. In 1993, Wan Bing began to submit manuscripts on a whim, and published her first micro-novel the following year. Over the past eighteen years, she has written less than 100 "micro-novel" works, averaging four to five per year. During the rest of the time, she wrote mostly prose, Chinese haiku, and poetry. She is not a prolific writer. As she used to like singing and acting in Cantonese opera, she considers herself an amateur rather than a professional. Occasionally, I would sing loudly when I got excited, and I could sing and entertain myself without any pressure. When inspiration strikes, he writes at his desk, writing articles and novels without any utilitarian thoughts. It's all about randomness, so it's no wonder that there are so few works. Her beautiful singing voice comes from natural talent, and her beautiful singing voice is self-taught without a teacher. Her poetry, writing and novels are also self-taught like me. He has a good heart and wisdom, and he studied ancient Chinese under the contemporary scholar Zhao Darui when he was in high school and after school (Teacher Zhao lives in the suburbs of Sydney and is over 90 years old), laying a good foundation in Chinese. Therefore, his choice of words in poems, articles and novels is extremely elegant, and his skills in Chinese studies are naturally revealed. "Micro-novel" is divided into many categories. Generally speaking, the chapters included in this collection belong to the category of combined prose style. The beautiful prose style can be seen in the writing or description, and it is by no means an ordinary work like those popular popular romance works nowadays. An anthology published by the Chinese Writers Association of Victoria uses her article "On the Maple Forest Road" as the title of the book. This article has sentences such as: "The maple trees hurriedly stretched out their green palms and asked for kisses in the clear sky, and actually taught the spring wind to play with it." "Their melancholy eyes wrote helplessness and sadness, causing the flowers and plants to be infected and look at each other with tears." With the rich imagination of personification, how can flowers and plants "look at each other with tears"? In "Good Citizen": "The twinkling stars in the sky are secretly watching, citing the hypocrisy of human nature; the bright moon is also working hard to shoot through the lies it told during the day." The stars and the bright moon are regarded as spiritual people. "Good news": "The thin and soft black woolen dress is so chic and elegant as it spins lightly. The elegant fabric with elegant flowers and skin-colored underwear is full of infinite temptation." The description of clothing reveals a woman's alluring appearance. Without subtle observation, it is difficult to describe it like this. "Rare Visitor": "Suddenly, a foreign girl with shawl hair, slender curves and a snowy complexion appeared in the mirror, with a sinister smile on her lips. The image drifted vaguely around her..." She mistook the ghost figure for a beautiful foreign woman walking on the street. "On a cold winter night, the cold wind howls, and the shadows of the trees are helplessly scattered, as if they are about to move. It makes the Melbourne night sky even colder, making the stars and moon gradually lose their brightness." The first paragraph of this article "Winter Cold Shatters Children's Hearts" is like a beautiful prose. "Only the sound of Uncle Wang's slow rubber shoes is tapping helplessly on the lonely floor, and the utensils are hurriedly responding with irregular sounds." The portrayal of the elegies of the elderly in Western society reflects the reality of the "teardrops" in their dying years. It is still described with personification, and the "loneliness on the floor" reflects Uncle Wang's loneliness? The vessel can actually "response"? There are many ingenious ideas like this in the collected chapters. "Who Knows the Heart of a Grass" takes current social events as its subject matter, and at the end of the twist, the identity of the rich girl is revealed, which surprises the readers. The ending of the micro-novel uses a "reversal" without being formulaic, which can make readers feel deeply surprised and consistent with the facts. It is difficult to solve without ingenuity. How to convince readers that the "reversal" is reasonable and unpredictable until the last paragraph is a test of the micro-novel writer's ability and skills. Wan Bing used the "reversal" method in many articles in this collection. The surprising endings often surprise readers, completely reaching the charming realm of micro-novel. The title of the book, "Exiled from the End of the World," is about Wan Bing's nightmare of her family escaping at sea in 1978 and being stranded on a desert island in Indonesia for seventeen days. It was turned into a novel that has nothing to do with her own suffering. It describes that Qian'er, who went to the sea of ​​​​wrath after all kinds of hardships, was raped and murdered in the end. Her father, Old Cheng, went crazy and said to himself: "It's the ghost you once murdered who is looking for you to pay for your life!" Qian'er, a female Viet Cong agent who "worked for the tiger" during the Vietnam War, finally died in Xinxiang, unable to escape the law of retribution for good and evil. Since Wan Bing has a foundation in Chinese studies, she also likes to sing elegant Cantonese opera. She also likes to read "A Dream of Red Mansions" and Tang poetry and Song lyrics. The titles of her micro-novels already contain elegant meanings. For example: "Only the moon in the spring garden is sentimental", "The mist is cast again to confuse the heart and soul", "The old years are dying with candles and tears", "The old dreams are cold in the wind" and so on. Reading Wan Bing's micro-novel collection "Exiled from the End of the World", although not every chapter is a masterpiece, its charm is that at the same time, you can feel her graceful writing style, deft conception and clear and elegant prose. Let the readers read it slowly and carefully. It is time to stop writing at this point; otherwise, it will be regarded as a "old man selling melons"!

af46582ae9ed29bf1c77a7b0b5e455b0582e1adb.sourceText: 中国寻根之旅夏令营广东营 着重传授中华文化 ”寻根之旅”夏令营海外组团单位之一的全美中华青年联合会在洛杉矶宣布，将组团参与由国务院侨务办公室，广东省侨务办公室主办的2012年中国寻根之旅夏令营-广东营。欢迎全美各地14至23周岁，身体健康的海外华裔青少年报名参加。 据介绍，广东营将于7月13日在广州开营，在近两个星期的时间内，为来自海外的华裔青少年传授包括学习实用汉语会话、中国旅游地理常识、国学常识、禅武功夫或中国民族舞蹈、中国书法、绘画等中华文化为主干的课程。夏令营于7月25日结束。 据广东省侨办介绍，举办”寻根之旅”夏令营活动，是为了让海外华裔青少年更好地学习、传播与传承中华文化，了解和体会中华文化的博大精深。特别是让海外华裔青少年进一步体会亚运后的中国广州市的新面貌，领略岭南文化的精髓，开阔视野，弘扬中华几千年的优秀文化，增强海外华裔新生代的自豪感。通过”寻血脉之根”、学中华语言和才艺、游故土山川与古迹。 广东省侨办将负责营员在参加夏令营期间的住宿、课程、旅游和餐饮等费用。国际旅行机票、签证费和报名费由营员自行支付。 办营时间：2012年7月13日至25日，共13天。办营地点: 广东广州及顺德等地区。活动内容包括：学习实用汉语会话课程、中国旅游地理常识、国学常识、禅武功夫或中国民族舞蹈、中国书法、绘画，名胜古迹参观学习，与广东省学校的学生交流联谊活动等。 全美中华青年联合会表示，欢迎北美地区的华裔青少年报名参加，有关报名事项和咨询，请与全美中华青年联合会 aacyf.org@gmail.com 联络。（AACYF洛杉矶讯）
af46582ae9ed29bf1c77a7b0b5e455b0582e1adb.translatedText: China Roots Journey Summer Camp Guangdong Camp focuses on teaching Chinese culture The National Chinese Youth Federation, one of the overseas organizers of the "Roots Journey" summer camp, announced in Los Angeles that it will organize a group to participate in the 2012 China Roots Journey Summer Camp-Guangdong Camp hosted by the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the State Council and the Guangdong Provincial Overseas Chinese Affairs Office. Healthy overseas Chinese teenagers from all over the United States, aged 14 to 23, are welcome to sign up. According to reports, the Guangdong Camp will open in Guangzhou on July 13. In the past two weeks, it will teach overseas Chinese teenagers courses including learning practical Chinese conversation, knowledge of Chinese tourism geography, knowledge of Chinese studies, Zen martial arts or Chinese folk dance, Chinese calligraphy, painting and other Chinese culture-based courses. Summer camp ends on July 25th. According to the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of Guangdong Province, the purpose of organizing the "Root Journey" summer camp is to allow overseas Chinese teenagers to better learn, spread and inherit Chinese culture, and to understand and appreciate the breadth and depth of Chinese culture. In particular, overseas Chinese teenagers can further understand the new look of Guangzhou, China after the Asian Games, appreciate the essence of Lingnan culture, broaden their horizons, carry forward China's thousands of years of excellent culture, and enhance the pride of the new generation of overseas Chinese. Through "searching for the roots of blood", learning the Chinese language and talents, and visiting the mountains, rivers and historical sites of their hometown. The Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of Guangdong Province will be responsible for campers’ accommodation, courses, travel, meals and other expenses during the summer camp. International travel air tickets, visa fees and registration fees are paid by campers themselves. Operation time: July 13th to 25th, 2012, a total of 13 days. Camp locations: Guangzhou, Shunde and other areas in Guangdong. Activities include: learning practical Chinese conversation courses, knowledge of Chinese tourism geography, knowledge of Chinese traditional culture, Zen martial arts or Chinese folk dance, Chinese calligraphy, painting, visits to historical sites, exchanges and social activities with students from schools in Guangdong Province, etc. The National Chinese Youth Federation stated that Chinese teenagers in North America are welcome to sign up. For registration matters and inquiries, please contact the National Chinese Youth Federation at aacyf.org@gmail.com. (AACYF Los Angeles News)

c1229734847edfe4ecb53fbcd0b6dd6f80b3b5bb.sourceText: 天港机场的新空中列车周一首次试行 （亚省时报） 凤凰城天港国际机场新轻轨列车的首次试运行在周一举行。 整个运行测试在东廉价停车场的新火车站和列车的维修设施之间的轨道上进行。 自动电力动力的PHX天空列车会在第44街，华盛顿街道和东廉价停车场以及4号航站楼之间的地铁轻轨车站运行。 该服务预计在2013年第一季度开始。 PHX天空列车将运行一周7天，一年365天，将是免费的。 菲尼克斯市市长格雷格?#26031;坦顿说，15亿美元的项目完全是由天港机场支付的费用资助。 PHX天空车厢内部看起来像很多地铁轻轨车。 预计每年6万人次的运量，一年节约城市公共汽车燃料近10万美元。 斯坦顿说，”这空中列车，将是一个短短两分钟的车程。从车站到4号航站楼只需两分钟车程，”他说，第1阶段的项目创造就业6000人。 第二阶段预计将增加2000个就业机会。 据凤凰城官方规划，PHX天空列车将2015年初服务于3号航站楼，2号航站楼并带有人行道，机场的租车中心还会运行到2020年。 斯坦顿表示”天港未来的成功是我们的城市未来的成功。他们将齐头并进，”。
c1229734847edfe4ecb53fbcd0b6dd6f80b3b5bb.translatedText: > Sky Harbor Airport’s new SkyTrain makes its first trial run Monday (Alberta Times) The first trial run of Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport’s new light rail train took place on Monday. The entire operational test took place on the track between the new train station and the train's maintenance facilities in the East Budget Car Park. The autonomous, electric-powered PHX SkyTrain will operate at Metro light rail stations between 44th Street, Washington Street and the East Affordable Parking Lot and Terminal 4. The service is expected to begin in the first quarter of 2013. The PHX SkyTrain will operate seven days a week, 365 days a year and will be free. Phoenix Mayor Greg Tanton said the $1.5 billion project is entirely funded by Sky Harbor Airport fees. The interior of the PHX skycar looks like many subway light rail cars. It is estimated that the annual transportation volume will be 60,000, and the city's bus fuel will be saved nearly 100,000 US dollars a year. Stanton said, "This skytrain will be a short two-minute drive. It will only be a two-minute drive from the station to Terminal 4," and he said the Phase 1 project will create jobs for 6,000 people. The second phase is expected to create 2,000 jobs. According to Phoenix's official plan, the PHX sky train will serve Terminal 3 in early 2015, and Terminal 2 will have sidewalks. The airport's car rental center will also operate until 2020. "The future success of Sky Harbor is the future success of our city. They will go hand in hand," Stanton said.
