According to the video replayed at the scene, Park Tae-hwan's feet shook when he started, and his results were eventually cancelled.

dfab21dd859d1481d83352efe210a15a26f09c66.sourceText: 但是国际泳联随后对朴泰桓犯规事实进行了复查，决定恢复其比赛资格，也令当晚的对决更具戏剧性。
dfab21dd859d1481d83352efe210a15a26f09c66.translatedText: However, FINA subsequently reviewed the fact that Park Tae-hwan committed a foul and decided to reinstate his qualifications, which also made the showdown that night even more dramatic.

9edba8a22e22384659fcadd0628edeb1b4abb3f2.sourceText: 比赛于当地时间19时51分打响，位于第四泳道的孙杨延续了上午的好状态，但他一直采用跟随战术，直到最后300米才加速反超，一举击败此前领先的朴泰桓摘得金牌，并打破了奥运会纪录。
9edba8a22e22384659fcadd0628edeb1b4abb3f2.translatedText: The competition started at 19:51 local time. Sun Yang, who was in the fourth lane, continued his good form in the morning, but he kept using follow-up tactics until the last 300 meters before accelerating to overtake. He defeated the previous leader Park Tae-hwan in one fell swoop to win the gold medal and broke the Olympic record.

7e629e5f15ab298544c82a6264ae47ec97389300.sourceText: 夺冠后的孙杨非常激动，他对中新网记者说，”今天听了很多韩国人的报道，心中一直压了一口气，现在终于出来了”。
7e629e5f15ab298544c82a6264ae47ec97389300.translatedText: Sun Yang was very excited after winning the championship. He told a reporter from China News Service, "I listened to many reports from Koreans today, and I have been feeling depressed. Now it is finally out."

a4289f4edeaa941bf9a5bea56364f3d46a06316c.sourceText: ”其实朴泰桓’复活’对我来说没有任何影响，只有同场对决，才能体现出自己的存在。”孙杨说，”我现在很激动，因为父母养育了我，金牌是给他们最好的回报。”
a4289f4edeaa941bf9a5bea56364f3d46a06316c.translatedText: "Actually, Park Tae-hwan's 'resurrection' has no impact on me. Only in the same match can I reflect my existence." Sun Yang said, "I am very excited now because my parents raised me, and the gold medal is the best reward for them."

f61206b0954ce765af687191ad4150b4942afd07.sourceText: 以前曾”保证”夺冠不哭，但孙杨在受访时还是泪流不止，”我也不知道为何这么多泪水，可能是这些年练得太不容易了。”
f61206b0954ce765af687191ad4150b4942afd07.translatedText: Previous He once "promised" not to cry when he won the championship, but Sun Yang still burst into tears when being interviewed. "I don't know why there are so many tears. Maybe it's because practicing has been too difficult these years."

bf72eb5e8b4e589de3e15593b88bc07d76e7d90f.sourceText: 孙杨说，”今天这枚金牌是送给很多对手的，我要证明给他们看，我打败了所有韩国人。”
bf72eb5e8b4e589de3e15593b88bc07d76e7d90f.translatedText: Sun Yang said, "Today this gold medal is given to many opponents. I want to prove to them that I defeated all Koreans."

81f8e5c28f5ec0be8f5e0caa6efe043e2951e4bd.sourceText: 渔猎部提醒：小心郊野狼
81f8e5c28f5ec0be8f5e0caa6efe043e2951e4bd.translatedText: Department of Fish and Game reminds: Beware of coyotes

b5b25cff81a4441326aa240d36a3bfb3bda81451.sourceText: 渔猎部提醒：小心郊野狼 （亚省时报） 每年夏天都有郊野狼到居民区、民宅去寻找食物和水。虽然聪明的郊狼很…
b5b25cff81a4441326aa240d36a3bfb3bda81451.translatedText: Department of Fish and Game reminds: Beware of coyotes (Alberta Times) Every summer, coyotes come to residential areas and homes in search of food and water. Although smart coyotes are very...

b937a3f6cd8da6e788f65cfc0a70d3bfb053d799.sourceText: 渔猎部提醒：小心郊野狼 （亚省时报） 每年夏天都有郊野狼到居民区、民宅去寻找食物和水。虽然聪明的郊狼很少攻击人类，但家中的家猫、小狗、小鸟很可能成为它的美味。 住在河边、湖畔，或者是公园附近的家庭一定要注意，夏天炎热的阳光常使郊狼走出沙漠，来到人烟稠密的市区，看管好你的宠物，喂鸟的饲料不用时放好。遇见郊狼也不必惊慌，平时带个摇铃或者吹得响的小软管在身上，郊狼会对这种喇叭声感到惊恐，会落荒而逃。 郊狼入侵民宅不单单发生在亚利桑那州，除了夏威夷，每个州都有类似事情发生。说白了，也就是个生存问题，动物也有生存的权利，不是吗？
b937a3f6cd8da6e788f65cfc0a70d3bfb053d799.translatedText: Department of Fish and Game reminds: Beware of coyotes (Alberta Times) Every summer, coyotes come to residential areas and homes in search of food and water. Although smart coyotes rarely attack humans, domestic cats, puppies, and birds at home are likely to become its delicacies. Families living by rivers, lakes, or near parks must pay attention. The hot summer sunshine often brings coyotes out of the desert and into densely populated urban areas. Keep an eye on your pets and put away bird feed when not in use. There is no need to panic when you encounter a coyote. You usually carry a rattle or a small hose with you that can blow loudly. The coyote will be frightened by the sound of the trumpet and will run away. Coyotes invading homes are not just an occurrence in Arizona. Similar incidents have occurred in every state except Hawaii. To put it bluntly, it is a matter of survival. Animals also have the right to survive, right?

0bc54bedd823c0c2b2bcd22579304462c2f67470.sourceText: 本田、福特 召回休旅车

fce226f26883159107252d8f662a4a44026174d5.sourceText: 本田、福特 召回休旅车 （亚省时报） 本田公司(Honda)19日宣布在全球各地召回超过32万1000辆小…
fce226f26883159107252d8f662a4a44026174d5.translatedText: Honda and Ford recall SUVs (Alberta Times) Honda announced on the 19th that it would recall more than 321,000 small SUVs around the world...

af36d832a65fcb366695ac5ce6bfe4fcec627311.sourceText: 本田公司(Honda)19日宣布在全球各地召回超过32万1000辆小型休旅车，因为这些车辆的车门可能闩不住。福特汽车公司(Ford)更通告车主立刻停开最新年份的Escape休旅车，以免引擎失火。 本田的召回令涵盖2012年份的31万4000辆CR-V小型休旅车，以及大约7300辆2013年份的雅阁ILX小型豪华车。 本田说，这些车辆驾驶座或乘客座的车门门把，如与电动或手动门锁同时使用，车门门闩可能失灵，也就是车门可能闩不住，或是即使闩住，一旦使用车锁又会打开。公司尚未接到因为这种问题而发生事故或受伤的报告。 召回令涵盖美国的16万6600辆CR-V和6200多辆ILX。车主8月中旬就会接到通知，请他们把车开到经销商那裡检查，必要时进行修理。 福特公司19日也发布不寻常的警告，召回配备排气量1.6公升的四汽缸引擎的2013年份Escape休旅车。其他年份或配备其他引擎的Escape不受影响。 福特敦促车主立刻停开这种车辆，并与经销商连络。经销商会登门取车，并把一辆车交给车主暂用，直到车子修好。 这些车辆的油管可能破裂，使汽油洒出来，造成引擎起火。福特希望在两周内运出必要零件，并把所有受影响的车辆修好。只要有零件，实际修理工作只要一小时。 福特说，它已接到三件起火报告，两件发生在工厂，另一件发生在车主开车之时，不过没有人因此受伤。福特强调把这种车停在车库很安全，因为它们只在行驶时才可能失火。 这项召回令影响美国和加拿大的1万1500辆Escape，其中只有4800辆已售出，其馀还在经销商那裡。
af36d832a65fcb366695ac5ce6bfe4fcec627311.translatedText: Honda announced on the 19th that it would recall more than 321,000 small SUVs around the world because the doors of these vehicles may not latch. Ford Motor Company (Ford) also informed owners to immediately stop driving the latest model of the Escape SUV to prevent engine fires. Honda's recall covers 314,000 CR-V compact SUVs from the 2012 model year and approximately 7,300 Accord ILX small luxury sedans from the 2013 model year. Honda said that if the driver's or passenger's door handle of these vehicles is used at the same time as an electric or manual door lock, the door latch may fail, that is, the door may not latch, or even if it is latched, it will open when the lock is used. The company has had no reports of accidents or injuries due to this problem. The recall covers 166,600 CR-Vs and more than 6,200 ILXs in the United States. Car owners will be notified in mid-August, asking them to take their cars to dealers for inspection and repairs if necessary. Ford also issued an unusual warning on the 19th, recalling the 2013 Escape SUV equipped with a 1.6-liter four-cylinder engine. Escapes from other years or with other engines are not affected. Ford urges owners to stop driving the vehicles immediately and contact their dealers. The dealer will come to pick up the car and give a car to the owner for temporary use until the car is repaired. These vehicles may have fuel lines that rupture, spilling gasoline and causing engine fires. Ford hopes to have the necessary parts shipped and all affected vehicles repaired within two weeks. As long as the parts are available, the actual repair job only takes an hour. Ford said it had received three reports of fires, two at the factory and one while the owner was driving, but no one was injured. Ford stresses that the cars are safe to park in a garage because they can only catch fire while being driven. The recall affects 11,500 Escapes in the United States and Canada, of which only 4,800 have been sold and the rest are still in dealers.

f555596782077ff6ae65a6b386a681191ffc01e4.sourceText: 美移民新法规助公民家属早团圆
f555596782077ff6ae65a6b386a681191ffc01e4.translatedText: New U.S. immigration regulations help reunite families of citizens early

9ec457a2336cd481a944ed01bc35b88792813bc7.sourceText: 美移民新法规助公民家属早团圆 奥巴马政府星期三宣布允许美国公民避免同非法移民直系亲属长期分离的新规则。假如…
9ec457a2336cd481a944ed01bc35b88792813bc7.translatedText: > New U.S. immigration regulations help reunite families of citizens early The Obama administration announced on Wednesday new rules that allow U.S. citizens to avoid long-term separation from immediate family members of illegal immigrants. What if…

ddd85ba7fc6ab931e2cfc21ed6e8b464f219e13d.sourceText: 奥巴马政府星期三宣布允许美国公民避免同非法移民直系亲属长期分离的新规则。假如这些非移亲属申请合法居民身份，从海外可望顺利重返美国。这一措施或许帮助数十万美国公民同家人早日团圆。
ddd85ba7fc6ab931e2cfc21ed6e8b464f219e13d.translatedText: The Obama administration announced Wednesday new rules that would allow U.S. citizens to avoid long-term separation from their immediate family members who are illegal immigrants. If these non-immigrant relatives apply for legal resident status, they can expect to successfully return to the United States from overseas. This measure may help hundreds of thousands of American citizens reunite with their families as soon as possible.

a9260494b8e0eda950b0826e13ea0648d8e873ed.sourceText: 移民新法规助公民家属早团圆，申请绿卡人数可望大增。（网络图）
a9260494b8e0eda950b0826e13ea0648d8e873ed.translatedText: New immigration laws help citizens’ families reunite earlier, and the number of people applying for green cards is expected to increase significantly. (Internet picture)

854341f8057a663582053513b31d301590bfdfa5.sourceText: 据《纽约时报》报道，国土安全部长纳波利塔诺（Janet Napolitano）宣布的新规则将创造豁免措施，避开移民法中深奥的”第22条军规”。美国公民的配偶、子女或父母如果申请绿卡，往往面临分离长达十年的窘境。
854341f8057a663582053513b31d301590bfdfa5.translatedText: According to the New York Times, the new rules announced by Homeland Security Secretary Janet Napolitano will create exemptions to avoid the esoteric "Catch-22" of immigration law. Spouses, children or parents of U.S. citizens often face the dilemma of being separated for up to ten years if they apply for a green card.

b441baff56f7d97ac35dddc62f6b9dba839ef9b7.sourceText: 直到现在，这些移民要离开美国回到原籍国家去拿签证–即使已经得到批准–风险太大，因此无数家庭决定不申请，其结果大量增加在美非法移民数量。
b441baff56f7d97ac35dddc62f6b9dba839ef9b7.translatedText: Until now, the risk for these immigrants to leave the United States and return to their country of origin to obtain a visa - even if it has been approved - has been too great, so countless families have decided not to apply, resulting in a massive increase in the number of illegal immigrants in the United States.

a4ce942efcad92d165484240850f33b2d3944d66.sourceText: 移民当局将于3月3日开始接受豁免申请。政府官员一年前就宣布了那一政策变化，但它们要接受公众评论并作出修改之后才能成为正式规则。
a4ce942efcad92d165484240850f33b2d3944d66.translatedText: Immigration authorities will begin accepting exemption applications on March 3. Administration officials announced the policy changes a year ago, but they are subject to public comment and revisions before they become official rules.

6c924a246b3cff72f7740e85a7c63deb6fc5105a.sourceText: 美国公民为在外国出生的配偶或孩子获得绿卡相当直接，对部分父母也适用。但是如果移民非法进入美国，他们必须回到原籍国家到美国使领馆申请签证。但根据1996年的法规，非法移民一旦离开美国，他们至少3年，多则10年不得重返美国。
6c924a246b3cff72f7740e85a7c63deb6fc5105a.translatedText: Obtaining a green card for a U.S. citizen’s foreign-born spouse or child is fairly straightforward, and may also apply to some parents. But if immigrants enter the United States illegally, they must return to their country of origin to apply for a visa at a U.S. embassy or consulate. But according to the 1996 regulations, once illegal immigrants leave the United States, they are not allowed to return to the United States for at least three years and up to 10 years.

ec5eea8729609ed29de56ae81b1090a656f09287.sourceText: 即使没有受到禁止入境限制的移民也有可能被迫在海外滞留数月，等待领馆完成申请手续。
ec5eea8729609ed29de56ae81b1090a656f09287.translatedText: Even immigrants who are not subject to entry ban restrictions may be forced to stay overseas for several months, waiting for the consulate to complete the application procedures.

326c6e7ce052938c511b01a9004108eff7d1bbb9.sourceText: 根据新规则，美国人的家属可以在美国申请豁免再入境禁令，在离开美国之前拿到签证。官员估计，移民在国外的时间可以缩短成”几个星期的事情”。
326c6e7ce052938c511b01a9004108eff7d1bbb9.translatedText: Under the new rules, family members of Americans can apply for exemption from the re-entry ban in the United States and obtain visas before leaving the United States. Officials estimate that immigrants' time abroad can be reduced to "a matter of weeks."

c13fd0c266b4099a5308461dd6dfd805cd6c5ea4.sourceText: 美国公民和移民局（USCIS）局长马约卡斯（Alejandro Mayorkas）说，新规则的关键好处就是在申请期间，个人不必同美国公民家属分开。
c13fd0c266b4099a5308461dd6dfd805cd6c5ea4.translatedText: U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS) Director Alejandro Mayorkas said a key benefit of the new rules is that individuals do not have to be separated from their U.S. citizen family members during the application process.

c3a6f66b9742337eeb691f376edfbaf38ba97630.sourceText: 对于移民来说，美国官员称，离开美国之前拿到已获批准的豁免文件也将打消他们对能否得到签证的顾虑。
c3a6f66b9742337eeb691f376edfbaf38ba97630.translatedText: For immigrants, U.S. officials say getting approved exemption documents before leaving the United States will also eliminate concerns about whether they can get a visa.

fba420ea87668963d35f59b0ff971de1c5e59d87.sourceText: 美国移民律师协会主席利希特尔（Laura Lichter）说，新规则比起现有法规是个”大跃进。…….对于不愿让亲人面对不确定性、骑墙观望的家庭来说，现在他们不用等待。”
fba420ea87668963d35f59b0ff971de1c5e59d87.translatedText: Laura Lichter, president of the American Immigration Lawyers Association, said the new rules are a "big leap forward" compared to existing regulations. ... For families who don't want their loved ones to face uncertainty and sit on the sidelines, now they don't have to wait."

27f4397df2e288a4eaa5cfd454a4060d1f708fac.sourceText: 利希特尔说，由于豁免申请费高达585美元，许多家庭仍然面临障碍。
27f4397df2e288a4eaa5cfd454a4060d1f708fac.translatedText: Lichter said many families still face obstacles because the waiver application fee is as high as $585.

ce2dff0ad993a582b773c2a8e63e0dfb1084553a.sourceText: 新规则并没有给予非法移民任何合法身份，也没有为已经提出的申请提供捷径。为了获得绿卡，移民仍然需要证明，如果遭递解出境，将引起某个美国公民”极端困难”。利希特尔呼吁国会修改法律，消除禁止再入境规定所造成的困境。
ce2dff0ad993a582b773c2a8e63e0dfb1084553a.translatedText: The new rules do not give illegal immigrants any legal status, nor do they provide shortcuts for applications that have already been made. In order to obtain a green card, immigrants still need to prove that deportation would cause "extreme hardship" to a U.S. citizen. Lichtel called on Congress to amend the law to eliminate the dilemma caused by the no-reentry rule.

380d7c0f5b6497bceaad2b209f828ddbdd7ad794.sourceText: 张肇鸿 大象或骡马刚生出来的小象或小骡马，几乎都可以站立起来的。而人类的婴儿在出生后，一两个月的宝宝在趴着的时…
380d7c0f5b6497bceaad2b209f828ddbdd7ad794.translatedText: Zhang Zhaohong Almost all newborn elephants or mules can stand up. After human babies are born, when they are lying on their stomachs for one or two months...

dbd0df96bd355b4e8c3602b59e5ef7382bc0f358.sourceText: 大象或骡马刚生出来的小象或小骡马，几乎都可以站立起来的。而人类的婴儿在出生后，一两个月的宝宝在趴着的时候，也有可以抬起头的，这时候抬头大概会呈现45度角，只是坚持的时间不会太长。而在五个月大的时候，婴儿大都能够抬起头来。
dbd0df96bd355b4e8c3602b59e5ef7382bc0f358.translatedText: Elephants or mules. Almost all newborn elephants or mules can stand up. After birth, human babies, one or two months old, can also raise their heads when they are lying on their stomachs. At this time, the heads will be raised at about a 45-degree angle, but they will not last too long. By the time they are five months old, most babies can hold their heads up.

86d39f130f69f6ef552c88e4d9b22362c450fbfe.sourceText: 抬头的另一层意思，是指抬头观望世界。孩子经过“七坐八爬九生牙”（现在更早），再到学习站立和行走，开始慢慢地认识这个世界。
86d39f130f69f6ef552c88e4d9b22362c450fbfe.translatedText: Another meaning of raising your head is to look up at the world. Children go through "seven sitting, eight climbing and nine teething" (earlier now), then learn to stand and walk, and slowly begin to understand the world.

0376e11f7ce09ac62ec008039f3f0590ac89f2dc.sourceText: 抬头是接收讯息，在成长过程中，通过双眼观察世间万物和其中的变化，并存留在脑海中，再通过互联互通，举一反三，便可得到新的思维。
0376e11f7ce09ac62ec008039f3f0590ac89f2dc.translatedText: Raising your head is to receive messages. In the process of growing up, you can observe everything in the world and the changes in it through your eyes, and keep it in your mind. Then through interconnection and inferences, you can get new ideas.

57c5e8eda3767212f60887df76f2ae9e99cc4a77.sourceText: 而在低头的时候，就可以作思考和决定下一步的行为。 抬头更进一步的意思，是凝视天空或星空，不是看小鸟的飞翔，云彩的飘逸，星星的发光，而是有了对太空的观察和冥想。这是人类思维的一个进階：四周的物体已经不再新奇，太空的奥妙才是最引人入胜的地方。
57c5e8eda3767212f60887df76f2ae9e99cc4a77.translatedText: When you lower your head, you can think and decide the next action. The further meaning of raising your head is to gaze at the sky or the stars, not to watch the flying birds, the flowing clouds, or the shining stars, but to observe and meditate on space. This is an advancement in human thinking: the objects around us are no longer novel, and the mystery of space is the most fascinating thing.

10706bf473b179fc9e564bdab697ddde9702b535.sourceText: 在薇薇的孩子房间里，挂有太阳系的示意图，让他们从小认识太阳系的结构。父母还给孩子们添置了不少相关的书籍和玩具。
10706bf473b179fc9e564bdab697ddde9702b535.translatedText: In Weiwei's children's room, there is a schematic diagram of the solar system hanging, allowing them to understand the structure of the solar system from an early age. Parents also bought many related books and toys for their children.

c1dd530b9493d775cf7cf38289e7db116e0799de.sourceText: 在NASA工作的舅舅，给外甥们寄来有关航空航天的模型和游戏光碟。
c1dd530b9493d775cf7cf38289e7db116e0799de.translatedText: My uncle, who works at NASA, sent his nephews models and game CDs related to aerospace.

d8943f18b8293ebccb9db7b0bd92ae4aaa47f637.sourceText: 美国是一个太空大国，美国人想象力丰富且有勇于冒险的精神，所以在这方面的创新能力很强。 美国学校对儿童进行太空方面知识的教育和智力开发也很早。有些教学题材，是由不同企业或机构所提供的。
d8943f18b8293ebccb9db7b0bd92ae4aaa47f637.translatedText: The United States is a space power. Americans have rich imagination and adventurous spirit, so they have strong innovation capabilities in this area. American schools also educate children about space knowledge and develop their intelligence very early. Some teaching topics are provided by different companies or institutions.

bdfbc22ebcb5f6cb417a931d9c95efc3917ded75.sourceText: 这是课堂作业。最外一层是月份，中间黑色部分是时刻表，内圆是天空中著名星座的名称。这简单实用的星空图，是由Jodrell Bank赞助的，并由孩子们自己动手来制作。
bdfbc22ebcb5f6cb417a931d9c95efc3917ded75.translatedText: >This is a class assignment. The outermost layer is the month, the middle black part is the timetable, and the inner circle is the name of the famous constellation in the sky. This simple and practical starry sky chart is sponsored by Jodrell Bank and made by children themselves.

cd9b784200436a9c74ff4fe1643668d250b3e7cf.sourceText: 这“星空图”可转动，展示每年在不同的月份和不同的时刻，可以观看天空中星座在不同的位置。 网络流传一种说法：智商越高的人，抬头看天会就会越早。于是就有了那些大科学家们，谁比谁更早抬头的故事。
cd9b784200436a9c74ff4fe1643668d250b3e7cf.translatedText: This "starry sky map" can be rotated to show that in different months and at different times of the year, you can watch the constellations in different positions in the sky. There is a saying circulating on the Internet: The higher the IQ of a person, the sooner he will look up to the sky. So there are stories about those great scientists who rose up earlier than others.

be026da84ceaa3c764120bf09ce2137c53ca105a.sourceText: 这个梗来自YouTube上的“老高与小茉”，有一集关于对天才的论述，老高形容那个人如果是天才，出生五岁会抬头仰望天空。
be026da84ceaa3c764120bf09ce2137c53ca105a.translatedText: This meme comes from "Lao Gao and Xiao Mo" on YouTube. There is an episode about the discussion of genius. Lao Gao describes that if the person is a genius, he will look up at the sky when he is five years old.

542e65525e32a74cbbd4cfa520a6a1f517bf2016.sourceText: 我们的孙儿是平凡的孩子。五岁的时候虽然也会抬头望天，但不至于去到冥想的境界。女儿给他们买了架天文望远镜，启蒙他们去探索宇宙的奥秘。
542e65525e32a74cbbd4cfa520a6a1f517bf2016.translatedText: Our grandchildren are ordinary children. Although I would look up at the sky when I was five years old, I would not reach the state of meditation. The daughter bought them an astronomical telescope and inspired them to explore the mysteries of the universe.

afaf26b20683bfb80effa157eac26119187542e3.sourceText: 薇薇带孩子们去游乐园坐“太空飞船”
afaf26b20683bfb80effa157eac26119187542e3.translatedText: Weiwei took the children to the amusement park to ride on the "spaceship"

fbd5532849f3f0c59c7000fdabca6c154726ab91.sourceText: 在孩子们的寝室的床前，挂有一幅“森林与星空”的相片。可能有某个闪烁星星，正在发出那慈祥的母爱之光，凝视着那熟睡中的孩子们……。
fbd5532849f3f0c59c7000fdabca6c154726ab91.translatedText: There was a photo of "Forest and Starry Sky" hanging in front of the bed in the children's dormitory. There may be some twinkling star that is emitting the light of kind maternal love, staring at the sleeping children...

621b2383e20fae84cd1843bbfa23bd83af38589a.translatedText: Chinese media: New immigrants with low income and no status dare not seek medical treatment. China News Service, March 26 (Xinhua) The United States' "World Journal" recently published an article saying that people who are busy with work, have low income and...

ea7c5fefe57170433e526cea31d9c8e86bba6a5a.sourceText: 中新网3月26日电 美国《世界日报》日前刊文称，忙于工作、收入低以及怕无证身份曝光，许多美国新移民都怕去医院看诊，对于身体的不适只能强忍，带来严重后果。69岁的来女士，因每月仅有不到千元(美元，下同)的收入，患有飞蚊症且配戴不合适的眼镜长达一年，为省钱只能忍受。来先生24日前往日落公园举办的免费健康筛检活动，终获医生治疗并将得到一副新眼镜。
ea7c5fefe57170433e526cea31d9c8e86bba6a5a.translatedText: China News Service, March 26 (Xinhua) The American "World Journal" recently published an article stating that many new immigrants to the United States are afraid of going to the hospital because of their busy work, low income, and fear of exposure of their undocumented status. They can only endure their physical discomfort, which will bring serious consequences. Ms. Lai, 69, has a monthly income of less than 1,000 U.S. dollars. She suffers from floaters and has been wearing ill-fitting glasses for a year. She has to endure it in order to save money. Mr. Lai went to a free health screening event held in Sunset Park on the 24th and was finally treated by a doctor and received a new pair of glasses.

c2ae5cf9e8091c782017b09e650f6f8a5691abee.sourceText: 免费健康筛检由纽约市健康与心理卫生局(DOHMH)、城市健保计划(MetroPlus)和安服心公共健康服务中心(Amphs)共同举办，当日吸引百余人前往。作为看诊人之一的来女士，八年前独自从中国广州依亲赴美，因语言不通，只能从事护理工作。她说，虽然体力可以支持，但精神上受不到尊重，每月也仅能赚百元左右。
c2ae5cf9e8091c782017b09e650f6f8a5691abee.translatedText: The free health screening was jointly organized by the New York City Department of Health and Mental Hygiene (DOHMH), MetroPlus and Amphs, attracting more than a hundred people that day. Ms. Lai, one of the patients, came to the United States alone from Guangzhou, China eight years ago. Due to the language barrier, she could only work in nursing. She said that although she could support her physically, she was not respected mentally and could only earn about 100 yuan a month.

52169dc7372061a418745099e9e2329c9477ec4c.sourceText: 一年前，来女士发现自己眼前出现黑点，虽不影响走路，但视线格外不清楚。起初她并未在意，但越来越严重。由于平日工作繁忙，看诊需要钱，只能拖着病情。当日检查时，她说自己只能看见视力表前两行。医生为她诊断后，除了预约后续治疗，也表示将为她免费重配一副新眼镜。对此，她感到十分高兴，”一副眼镜要100多元，哪里舍得自己买”。
52169dc7372061a418745099e9e2329c9477ec4c.translatedText: A year ago, Ms. Lai discovered that black spots appeared in front of her eyes. Although it did not affect her walking, her vision was extremely unclear. At first she didn't notice it, but it got worse. Due to my busy work schedule and the need for money to see a doctor, I could only put off my illness. During the examination that day, she said she could only see the first two lines on the eye chart. After the doctor diagnosed her, in addition to making an appointment for follow-up treatment, he also said that he would get a new pair of glasses for her free of charge. She was very happy about this, "A pair of glasses costs more than 100 yuan, so how can I afford to buy them myself?"

85232a9973db5a527e51004b4da127a5d25dcae1.sourceText: 陈Allen也在当日前来检查。她说，六年前从上海赴美打拼后，帮他人看管小孩谋生。没有身份的她表示，因担心看诊花费以及被问到移民身份问题，六年来没有做过任何身体检查；近日因感到潮热等不适的身体状况，看到免费健康筛检的信息，特地前来。
85232a9973db5a527e51004b4da127a5d25dcae1.translatedText: Chen Allen also came to inspect on the same day. She said that after moving to the United States from Shanghai six years ago to work hard, she made a living by looking after other people's children. She, who is undocumented, said that she had not had any physical examination in six years because she was worried about the cost of medical treatment and being asked about her immigration status. Recently, she saw the information about free health screening because she felt hot flashes and other uncomfortable physical conditions and came here specially.

e66e8784e569125481a2b8b866a7eed06a764455.sourceText: 城市健保计划亚裔市场活动策划刘先生表示，新移民为谋生，常忽视对健康的关注，直到发现严重病症时才去医院治疗，常为时已晚。纽约市健康与心理卫生局的张Mimi表示，日落公园的肺结核病比率全市最高，但地区的民众对健康检查并不上心，”当天我在街上发传单半小时，仅有两个路人愿意接受”。她呼吁新移民能积极参与健康检查，避免悲剧发生。
e66e8784e569125481a2b8b866a7eed06a764455.translatedText: Mr. Liu, the Asian market event planner of City Health Insurance Plan, said that in order to make a living, new immigrants often ignore health concerns and do not go to the hospital for treatment until serious illnesses are discovered. It is often too late. Mimi Zhang of the New York City Department of Health and Mental Hygiene said that Sunset Park has the highest tuberculosis rate in the city, but people in the area are not interested in health inspections. "I was handing out leaflets on the street for half an hour that day, and only two passers-by were willing to accept them." She called on new immigrants to actively participate in health examinations to avoid tragedies.

bbe0531284ca83e7f209c9953fdad1b540e1ee91.sourceText: 两个多月前孩子邀请我们，全家一起乘黄金公主号邮轮（ Golden Princess ），去阿拉斯加旅游，我们欣然同意一起前往。
bbe0531284ca83e7f209c9953fdad1b540e1ee91.translatedText: More than two months ago, our children invited us to take the Golden Princess cruise ship (Golden Princess) to travel to Alaska. We happily agreed to go together.

28b75fddbad348513f81be6c6a3fefc6cd7e2026.sourceText: 乘邮轮是第一次，所以这两个月还是很期待的，终於等到 6 月 1 日准备好旅游行李， 6 月 2 日一早出发。这次旅游一家三代六口人浩浩蕩蕩，光行李就六大箱，有儿子的朋友送我们去机场。乘坐的是美國西北航空公司的飞机，三个小时到达西雅图。在飞机上看到，越往北飞气候越冷，沿途看到有長年积雪不融化的高山，很是壮观。飞机升到雲层以上，天气很好，看到的是一望无际的兰天白雲，当快到达西雅图时，飞机降落俯冲、穿过厚厚的雲层，有大朶大朶的白雲飘过飞机翅膀，好美的一幅画面。下飞机取出行李走不多远，有一位亚裔老人接我们，他是邮轮公司的服务员，告诉我们怎样走，按照他的引导，把行李摆放在一堆行李中，是邮轮公司的服务人员，统一把行李拉走，送上邮轮我们住的房间门口。我们只需携帶隨身小包，去等邮轮公司的大巴士。等了大约一个多小时，看着各种颜色的大巴士，载走一整车一整车的乘客，正在翘首张望时，终於等到载我们的绿色大巴士。大巴士經过路边许多小木屋，但虽然小，建得确美丽优雅。听说西雅图房价很高，比我们鳳凰城高出一倍，一般的房屋都建得较小一点。当接近港湾时，看到远处有三艘大邮轮，仃靠在港湾码头，大家在猜测哪一艘邮轮是我们要乘坐的黄金公主号。当大巴士开得越来越近时，仃在港湾的整整齐齐三艘大邮轮中，我们找到要乘坐的黄金公主邮轮，大巴士直接把我们一车人，载到了我们要乘坐的黄金公主号邮轮前，我们终於看清了黄金公主号邮轮的真面目。啊！真的是一个庞然大物，这许多游客在这庞然大物面前，显得如此渺小，我们就要乘上黃金公主号邮轮，渡过我们期待已久的阿拉斯加探索之旅。
28b75fddbad348513f81be6c6a3fefc6cd7e2026.translatedText: It was my first time to take a cruise, so I was looking forward to it for the past two months. Finally, I prepared my travel luggage on June 1st and set off early in the morning on June 2nd. This trip included a large family of six people, three generations, and six large boxes of luggage. A friend with a son took us to the airport. I took a Northwest Airlines flight and arrived in Seattle in three hours. I saw from the plane that the climate gets colder as we fly north, and along the way we see mountains covered with snow that never melts, which is very spectacular. The plane rose above the clouds. The weather was very good. What we saw was the endless blue sky and white clouds. When we were about to reach Seattle, the plane landed and swooped through the thick clouds. There were big white clouds floating over the wings of the plane. It was such a beautiful scene. Not far after we got off the plane and took out our luggage, an old Asian man picked us up. He was a cruise company attendant and told us how to get there. Following his guidance, we placed our luggage in a pile of luggage. He was a cruise company service employee who took the luggage away and delivered it to the door of our room on the cruise ship. We just need to carry our small carry-on bag and wait for the cruise company's big bus. After waiting for about an hour, we watched the big buses of various colors carrying away a whole busload of passengers. When we were looking up and down, we finally saw the big green bus that took us. The big bus passed by many small wooden houses on the roadside, but although they were small, they were really beautiful and elegant. I heard that housing prices in Seattle are very high, twice as high as ours in Phoenix, and most houses are built smaller. When approaching the harbor, we saw three large cruise ships in the distance, docked at the harbor pier. Everyone was guessing which cruise ship was the Golden Princess we were going to take. As the big bus drove closer and closer, among the three large cruise ships in the harbor, we found the Golden Princess cruise ship we were going to take. The big bus took us directly to the Golden Princess cruise ship we were going to take. We finally saw the true face of the Golden Princess cruise ship. ah! It is really a behemoth. Many tourists seem so small in front of this behemoth. We will board the Golden Princess cruise ship for our long-awaited exploration trip to Alaska.

496f2e865e73cdc645fb4d7773fc062f40631f19.sourceText: 等待登船的人很多，大家自觉排好，秩序井然地通过安检，拿到房间卡，直接先去 14 层楼自助餐厅吃午饭。自助餐厅很大，精美的食品、水果、甜点、饮料极其丰盛。因为都集中在这一时段上船，要排長队进餐厅。还好，很快就排到我们，隨便拿些食品、水果、甜点，当我们一坐下来，就有侍者前来询问需要什么饮料，孩子们点冰水，我和先生点了綠茶。当热热的香茶一入口，一天的舟车劳累荡然無存。由於早晨起得太早没有食欲，没进早餐，现在吃起精美的美國自助餐，自然是香甜可口，大饱口福。
496f2e865e73cdc645fb4d7773fc062f40631f19.translatedText: There were many people waiting to board the ship. Everyone lined up consciously, passed the security check in an orderly manner, got their room cards, and went directly to the cafeteria on the 14th floor for lunch. The buffet restaurant is very large, with an abundance of exquisite food, fruits, desserts, and drinks. Because most people board the ship during this time, there is a long queue to enter the restaurant. Fortunately, we were quickly queued up to grab some food, fruit, and desserts. As soon as we sat down, a waiter came to ask what drinks we wanted. The children ordered ice water, and my husband and I ordered green tea. As soon as you take the hot fragrant tea into your mouth, the fatigue of the day's journey is gone. Since I woke up too early in the morning and lost my appetite, I skipped breakfast. Now I ate the exquisite American buffet, which was naturally sweet and delicious and a real treat.

25a5a7639a722186c23347593677965560c7c9c1.sourceText: 午饭后，我们夫妇去房间休息，我们住 11 楼 B742 房间。走出电梯间，拐入客房走廊，所有客房门口都放着自己的行李，当然这项服务是预订收费的，对於游客来说，这是用钱买方便。找到我们的房间，我们的两件行李己放在房间门口。用房卡打开门，打开灯，室内干净整洁，到处是明晃晃的大玻璃镜，或坐或站或行都照出自己的身影。稍事休息一下，孙子帶我们去听講座，是邮轮公司给客人講觧注意事项，如遇紧急危险情况，怎样使用救生衣、怎样逃生等。
25a5a7639a722186c23347593677965560c7c9c1.translatedText: After lunch, our couple went to our room to rest. We stayed in Room B742 on the 11th floor. When you walk out of the elevator and turn into the guest room corridor, your luggage is placed at the door of all guest rooms. Of course, this service is charged for booking. For tourists, this is convenience paid for. We found our room and our two pieces of luggage were already placed at the door of the room. Use the room card to open the door and turn on the lights. The room is clean and tidy. There are big bright glass mirrors everywhere, reflecting your own figure wherever you sit, stand or walk. After taking a short break, my grandson took us to a lecture. The cruise company explained to guests the precautions, how to use life jackets, how to escape, etc. in case of emergency danger.

9dcdfac8e384a8cb397b417236b8a060a946ff86.sourceText: 下午 4:00Pm 在不知不知不觉中己开船， Golden Priness 航行於加拿大沿海，沿内湾巡游，沿途奇岩异树，群岛罗列，鸟兽奔驰、飞翔其间，风光無限。在此豪华邮轮上，可尽情享用提供的各式大餐，除了烟、酒要自费外，其它的食物、大餐、自助餐及非酒精饮料都是免费供应。孩子帶我们在邮轮上做了简单的观察， 5:30Pm 去我们预订的 5 楼大餐厅，餐厅的 15 号餐桌是我们家预订的餐桌，有专门的侍者为我们服务。孩子们为我们点了饭菜，一道道慢慢上，饭后各式各样甜点是我的最爱，好看又好吃！先生给我提醒：当心下船后增加太多体重。我不以为然的一笑，心想不会那么危险吧！
9dcdfac8e384a8cb397b417236b8a060a946ff86.translatedText: At 4:00PM in the afternoon, I unknowingly set sail. The Golden Priness sailed along the coast of Canada, cruising along the inner bay. Along the way, there were strange rocks and trees, islands lined up, birds and animals galloping and flying among them, and the scenery was endless. On this luxury cruise ship, you can enjoy all kinds of meals provided. Except for tobacco and alcohol at your own expense, other food, meals, buffets and non-alcoholic drinks are provided free of charge. The child took us to do a brief observation on the cruise ship, and at 5:30Pm we went to the large restaurant on the 5th floor that we had reserved. Table No. 15 in the restaurant was the table reserved by our family, and there was a dedicated waiter to serve us. The children ordered food for us, and the dishes were served slowly. The various desserts after the meal are my favorite, they are beautiful and delicious! My husband reminded me: be careful about gaining too much weight after getting off the boat. I smiled disapprovingly, thinking it wouldn't be that dangerous!

3ab1c7250a54fe8e5e2a68a0e56057958fd1eb89.sourceText: 晚饭后， 8:30Pm 在大剧场有节目，当我们一家进入剧场，看到己是座无虚席，不但没有空位，就是两边的楼梯走道上也站了不少人。我们站了一会，有一对好心的年青人，把座位让给我们。这时我们看到，有一个演員在台上说秀，看了一会也听不懂，只听不时笑声连连，更有人笑得的前仰后合，我们确不明白为什么？多少年没学好英语，这时悔之晚矣！我们夫妻两人，把座位让给儿子和媳妇，回房间休息了。
3ab1c7250a54fe8e5e2a68a0e56057958fd1eb89.translatedText: After dinner, there was a program at the Grand Theater at 8:30Pm. When our family entered the theater, we saw that the seats were packed. Not only were there no empty seats, but there were also many people standing on the stairs and walkways on both sides. We stood for a while, and a pair of kind-hearted young people gave us their seats. At this time, we saw an actor speaking on the stage. After watching it for a while, we couldn't understand it. We only heard laughter from time to time, and some people even laughed so hard that they fell forward and backward. We really didn't understand why? I haven’t learned English well in many years, and it’s too late to regret it now! My husband and I gave up our seats to our son and wife and went back to our room to rest.

56df97ba5b62dcf886a3c0cf371eab6d6bb3bb8b.sourceText: 回到房间，发现服务生已把邮轮的有关资料介绍和第二天的活动资料，放在桌子上，借着字典的邦助，明白第二天的活动内容。經过一天的舟车劳累，这时瞌睡虫来袭，洗了澡，轻轻松松倒头便睡，一觉到天亮，时间是 6:30Am ，是在家准时起床的时间，即将开始一段浪漫、您闲的阿拉斯加海上探索之旅！ ( 未完待续 )
56df97ba5b62dcf886a3c0cf371eab6d6bb3bb8b.translatedText: When I returned to the room, I found that the waiter had put information about the cruise ship and the activities for the next day on the table. With the help of a dictionary, I could understand the activities for the next day. After a tiring day on the boat, sleepyheads came over. I took a shower and fell asleep easily. It was 6:30 AM at dawn, which is the time to get up on time at home. I am about to start a romantic and leisurely exploration trip on the Alaskan sea! (To be continued)

b0714de6aa3a7c4a250c9de34e670f68f5c540d6.sourceText: 留学美国寄宿学校才发现满眼黄皮肤 如同国内学校
b0714de6aa3a7c4a250c9de34e670f68f5c540d6.translatedText: After studying in a boarding school in the United States, I discovered that my eyes are full of yellow skin. Just like in domestic schools

0bee4ce4e5f850ff766ba655a97f6c00b622b349.sourceText: 留学美国寄宿学校才发现满眼黄皮肤 如同国内学校 有一个家长带着十五岁的儿子，在上海面试，面试官是一所美国高…
0bee4ce4e5f850ff766ba655a97f6c00b622b349.translatedText: After studying in a boarding school in the United States, I discovered that my eyes are full of yellow skin. Just like in domestic schools. A parent brought his fifteen-year-old son for an interview in Shanghai. The interviewer was an American high school...

aa3f753f7f0e66ef7bfa9748ed0687162101e3a8.sourceText: 原本托福是很多人来美国上大学和研究生，才需要考的，能考到八十分，就可被很多大学录取了。来美国读高中的门槛被抬得这么高，竞争力如此强，让立志于让孩子们上精英学校的家长们始料不及。中国高中生到美国的越来越多，竞争越来越激烈，似乎比申请大学还难。让孩子在美国有一个良好的开始，是每个家长都希望的，这么一场残酷的无硝烟的战争，却是想上精英学校的孩子们必经的，出国读书要上精英名校，不比高考容易。
aa3f753f7f0e66ef7bfa9748ed0687162101e3a8.translatedText: Originally, the TOEFL was only required for many people who came to the United States to attend college and graduate school. If you can score 80 points, you can be admitted to many universities. The threshold for coming to the United States to attend high school has been raised so high and the competition is so strong, which surprises parents who are determined to send their children to elite schools. More and more Chinese high school students are coming to the United States, and the competition is becoming more and more fierce. It seems to be more difficult than applying to college. Giving their children a good start in the United States is what every parent hopes for. Such a cruel and smokeless war is a must for children who want to go to elite schools. Going to elite schools when studying abroad is no easier than the college entrance examination.

2f9e1cbd8c337e1548e43c7708e84d2db1247560.sourceText: 美国本来是公平的，实施免费的公立教育，从学前班一直到高中毕业，孩子家境不好，没有关系，上学都是免费的，穷学生甚至可以申请免费早餐和午餐，以确保能健康长身体。不过这是对美国当地孩子的，对于外国人，想来美国读书，绝对无法去公立学校上课，想拿留学签证，必须上私立学校。当然，这只是对高中以下的年级来说，如果外国学生想来上大学，公立私立随便上，都能被录取，美国的大学都是要收费的，免费的教育餐只是截止到高中教育。
2f9e1cbd8c337e1548e43c7708e84d2db1247560.translatedText: The United States is originally fair and implements free public education from preschool to high school graduation. It doesn't matter if the children are from poor families. They go to school for free. Poor students can even apply for free breakfast and lunch to ensure that they can grow up healthily. But this is for local children in the United States. For foreigners who want to come to the United States to study, they absolutely cannot go to public schools. If they want to get a study visa, they must go to private schools. Of course, this is only for grades below high school. If foreign students want to go to university, they can be admitted to any public or private university. American universities all charge fees, and free educational meals only extend to high school education.

cab17f93f96854bdc6260fe0f18fe72536379fa2.sourceText: 既然公立学校是免费的，私立学校存在，便是美国人的怕输心理。公立学校参差良莠不齐，虽然在地税高尚区有绝好的公立学校，然而因公立学校来自不拒，只要在那个区居住，哪怕是租屋，都可以上当区的学校，对孩子教育有些想法又有足够经济实力的美国父母，会把孩子送到私立学校去，这便是美国的精英学校了。
cab17f93f96854bdc6260fe0f18fe72536379fa2.translatedText: Since public schools are free, the existence of private schools is due to the American fear of losing. Public schools vary widely. Although there are excellent public schools in areas with high local taxes, public schools welcome people from all over the country. As long as you live in that area, even if you rent an apartment, you can attend the district school. American parents who have some ideas about their children's education and have sufficient financial strength will send their children to private schools. These are America's elite schools.

d41d9e5add38735a4458e8e33265bdb157cab96d.sourceText: 美国的私立学校，大概有三种：走读的教会学校、走读的非教会学校和寄宿学校。由于公立学校免费的缘故，可想而知，私校都是相对优秀的学校，才能立足，争取到学生。寄宿学校由于有宿舍，在开始的时候很受中国留学生青睐，最早来的中国学生一般都会被送到寄宿学校，以至于几年下来，很多寄宿学校的中国学生都已泛滥，校园里满眼都是黄皮肤的亚洲孩子。寄宿学校相对来讲环境封闭，像极国内的所谓国际学校。
d41d9e5add38735a4458e8e33265bdb157cab96d.translatedText: There are roughly three types of private schools in the United States: day church schools, non-church day schools and boarding schools. Since public schools are free, it is conceivable that private schools are relatively excellent schools in order to gain a foothold and win students. Because boarding schools have dormitories, they were very popular among Chinese students at the beginning. The first Chinese students to come were usually sent to boarding schools. In the past few years, many boarding schools have been overpopulated with Chinese students, and the campuses are full of yellow-skinned Asian children. Boarding schools have a relatively closed environment, like so-called international schools in China.

b5e9a08dab517bb019d15b867eab3e8c71a687ff.sourceText: 毕竟寄宿学校宿舍有限，很多外国学生开始选择走读学校，住在美国人家庭，会有纯粹美国生活的经历。只不过，美国寄宿家庭并不是那么容易找，让很多选走读学校的学生面临困境。
b5e9a08dab517bb019d15b867eab3e8c71a687ff.translatedText: After all, boarding school dormitories are limited, so many foreign students are beginning to choose day schools to live in American families and have a purely American life experience. However, it is not so easy to find host families in the United States, which puts many students who choose day schools in a difficult situation.

e71b491c02664a9098ed69724dfe0c2a8249d65e.sourceText: 见到一些走读学校图省事，为了招到中国学生，干脆将学校中国留学生的管理，外包给一家中介，中介也不含糊，就近在学校附近租赁公寓，把十几个中国敛在一起，真正成了中国特色的宿舍。可怜了这些小留学生，天天和中国孩子混，实在是无法静心学习。不知道这些管理公司怎样向家长交代。
e71b491c02664a9098ed69724dfe0c2a8249d65e.translatedText: I have seen some day schools trying to save trouble. In order to recruit Chinese students, they simply outsource the management of the school's Chinese students to an agency. The agency is not unambiguous and rents apartments nearby the school, bringing more than a dozen Chinese students together to truly become a dormitory with Chinese characteristics. I feel sorry for these young international students, who hang out with Chinese children every day and cannot concentrate on studying. I don’t know how these management companies will explain to parents.

10e1db651c9616572ea37323265be0b1364ae7e9.sourceText: 只是很多家长，千里迢迢，并不知晓孩子们在美国经历的种种。很佩服这些小留学生，年纪小小，在人生最叛逆的青春期，就有那么大的勇气，到异国他乡开始新的人生篇章。美国的高中课程对当地孩子来说，也是不易的，更不要说这些英语是非母语的小留学生们。曾经写过一篇文章《留学虎穴》，痛心有些孩子来到美国后，甚至还会面临到野鸡学校的困扰，在异国求学路，变得未知而不定。
10e1db651c9616572ea37323265be0b1364ae7e9.translatedText: It’s just that many parents are thousands of miles away and don’t know what their children have experienced in the United States. I admire these young international students who, at such a young age, have so much courage to start a new chapter in a foreign country during their most rebellious adolescence. High school courses in the United States are not easy for local children, let alone these young international students for whom English is not their native language. I once wrote an article "Studying in a Tiger's Den". I was sad that some children would even face the trouble of going to a pheasant school after coming to the United States. The path to study in a foreign country has become unknown and uncertain.

5e486aba5293de5ba65f1f750da8f8beeb8ecd91.sourceText: 选择一所精英学校在美国读书，是很多中国小留学生和家长的心愿，竞争再激烈，都要试一下，然而，选择是残酷的。不过，进了精英学校，未必能进常春藤名牌大学。朋友的孩子，在美国一所公立高中读书，却爬藤成功，进了哈佛，只因她在并不那么优秀的公立高中里，成了最优秀的精英团队，个人履历写得满满得听起来唬人。
5e486aba5293de5ba65f1f750da8f8beeb8ecd91.translatedText: Choosing an elite school to study in the United States is the wish of many Chinese international students and parents. No matter how fierce the competition is, they have to give it a try. However, the choice is cruel. However, attending an elite school may not necessarily lead to admission to an Ivy League university. A friend's child studied in a public high school in the United States, but she succeeded in climbing the ladder and entered Harvard. Just because she became the best elite team in a not-so-excellent public high school, and her resume was so full that it sounded bluffing.

dc2c683209caf74f1ecc678517663c04ea413e41.sourceText: 塞翁失马，焉知非福，朋友女儿爬藤成功进哈佛的故事，会在另一篇文章《爬藤成功》里详解，希望前文提到的那个担心孩子进不美国高中的家长，看到后会得到些许安慰。
dc2c683209caf74f1ecc678517663c04ea413e41.translatedText: > A blessing in disguise, a blessing in disguise. The story of my friend’s daughter’s success in climbing the vine to get into Harvard will be explained in detail in another article, “Successful in Climbing the vine.” I hope the parent mentioned above who is worried about whether his child will get into an American high school will get some comfort after reading this.

3d0eac5dc73b5adeebded09d578eb66fe3ed73c1.sourceText: 白宫对国会有关人民币汇率法案表示担忧 【侨报网讯】美国白宫5日说，美国政府对国会参议院有关惩罚中国”操纵汇率”的法案表示担忧和关切。 白宫发言人卡尼当天说，这一立法行动引发了对美国国际义务一致性的担忧，”我们正与国会议员们讨论这些问题”。卡尼还表示，如果法案进一步获得推进，这些担忧应该被解决。不过，他没有透露有关白宫担忧的更多细节。 美国参议院3日投票程序性通过了”2011年货币汇率监督改革法案”立项预案。这项法案将操纵汇率与贸易补贴绑定，要求美国政府调查主要贸易伙伴是否存在直接或间接压低本国货币币值，以及为本国出口提供补贴的行为。一旦主要贸易伙伴汇率被认定低估，美国将对其征收惩罚性关税。外界普遍认为，此举主要针对中国，旨在逼迫人民币加速升值。 当天参议院的程序性投票获得通过，意味着这项法案将进入参议院下一步的表决程序。如果参议院全院通过，该法案还要在众议院获得通过才能提交总统签署为法律。不过，目前由共和党主导的美国会众议院领导人对这项法案持保留态度。 中国外交部对美国参议院的这一举动表示坚决反对，称该案以所谓”货币失衡”为借口，将汇率问题进一步升级，采取保护主义措施，严重违背世贸组织规则，严重干扰中美经贸关系。 同时，来自美国商业组织、主流媒体、研究机构等也纷纷对这一法案表示反对，认为这只会产生反作用，对美国没有好处。
3d0eac5dc73b5adeebded09d578eb66fe3ed73c1.translatedText: The White House expresses concern about Congress's bill on the RMB exchange rate [Qiaobao.com] The White House said on the 5th that the U.S. government is concerned about the Senate's bill to punish China for "exchange rate manipulation." White House spokesman Carney said that day that this legislative action raised concerns about the consistency of the United States' international obligations. "We are discussing these issues with members of Congress." Carney also said those concerns should be addressed if the bill moves forward. However, he did not provide further details about the White House's concerns. The U.S. Senate voted procedurally on the 3rd to pass the "Currency Exchange Rate Supervision Reform Act of 2011" project proposal. This bill ties exchange rate manipulation to trade subsidies, requiring the U.S. government to investigate whether major trading partners have directly or indirectly depressed the value of their own currencies and provided subsidies for their exports. Once the exchange rates of major trading partners are determined to be undervalued, the United States will impose punitive tariffs on them. The outside world generally believes that this move is mainly aimed at China and is intended to force the yuan to appreciate faster. The Senate's procedural vote passed that day, which means that the bill will enter the next step of the Senate's voting process. If passed by the full Senate, the bill would have to pass the House of Representatives before being sent to the president to be signed into law. However, leaders of the U.S. House of Representatives, currently dominated by Republicans, have reservations about the bill. The Chinese Ministry of Foreign Affairs expressed firm opposition to this move by the U.S. Senate, saying that the case used the so-called "currency imbalance" as an excuse to further escalate the exchange rate issue and adopt protectionist measures, seriously violating WTO rules and seriously disrupting Sino-U.S. economic and trade relations. At the same time, American business organizations, mainstream media, research institutions, etc. have also expressed opposition to this bill, believing that it will only be counterproductive and not beneficial to the United States.

30fab8813fecc30a54bcee0c7c418bdf28374010.sourceText: 激怒美国大牌 中国职业代购遭封杀（图）
30fab8813fecc30a54bcee0c7c418bdf28374010.translatedText: Angrying big American brands, China's professional purchasing agents are blocked (pictures)

1ed0c4cc62a2f872db52011da5fcfbe296ca2a7a.sourceText: 激怒美国大牌 中国职业代购遭封杀（图） 颇受美国年轻人追捧的服装品牌Abercrom…
1ed0c4cc62a2f872db52011da5fcfbe296ca2a7a.translatedText: Angrying big American brands, Chinese professional purchasing agents are blocked (pictures) Abercrom, a clothing brand popular among young people in the United States...

abdd9747b54e2888029e649b5865b012d629f748.sourceText: 颇受美国年轻人追捧的服装品牌Abercrombie and Fitch（简称A&F），及旗下以南加海滩、冲浪为设计主题的Hollister近年在中国大陆掀起流行旋风。苦于中国境内专卖店少、价格昂 贵，不少粉丝求助美国的代购业者。代购者经历一段疯狂的’淘金热”后，开始抱怨这两家品牌对职业代购者开始严格封杀，不少人已登上黑名单，被封卡、封地 址、甚至封网路IP。 在洛杉矶读大学二年级的Sophia孙表示，来美之前对这两个潮牌早已如数家珍。遇到折扣大的时候，淘来的好康价格低到可以与大陆号称”原单”、”尾单”的仿冒品媲美。国内老同学纷纷表达各种”羡慕嫉妒恨”的心情后，她开始全心投入代购这两个品牌。
abdd9747b54e2888029e649b5865b012d629f748.translatedText: Abercrombie and Abercrombie, a clothing brand popular among young people in the United States... Fitch (referred to as A&F) and its brand Hollister, which is designed with Southern California beaches and surfing as its theme, have set off a popular whirlwind in mainland China in recent years. Suffering from the scarcity of specialty stores and high prices in China, many fans turn to purchasing agents in the United States. After going through a crazy “gold rush” period, purchasing agents began to complain that these two brands began to strictly block professional purchasing agents. Many people have been blacklisted and have had their cards, addresses, and even Internet IPs blocked. Sophia Sun, a second-year college student in Los Angeles, said that she knew these two trendy brands well before coming to the United States. When the discounts were high, the prices of the good products were so low that they were comparable to the counterfeit products in mainland China that were called "original orders" and "last orders." After feeling "envy and jealousy", she began to devote herself to purchasing these two brands

732e4c12a3b0fd32d9c1fcbf54b2403c7755d7bb.sourceText: 行内代购规则很简单，只要买家在官方网站上看上任何商品，像Sophia这样的代购者，便会替他们在网上订购，到货后再寄至中国大陆。
732e4c12a3b0fd32d9c1fcbf54b2403c7755d7bb.translatedText: The rules of purchasing in the industry are very simple. As long as the buyer looks at any product on the official website, a purchasing agent like Sophia will buy it for them. Order online and ship to mainland China after delivery.

4054ae113f2adbe9adfc728eef06e119e9179bc6.sourceText: 去年整年的代购都很顺利，她靠这两个品牌赚的钱已有四位数。但最近情况大逆转，A&F开始严打代购者。她说，Sophia孙这个名字已登上A&F和Hollister”黑名单”。
4054ae113f2adbe9adfc728eef06e119e9179bc6.translatedText: Last year, the purchasing agent went smoothly, and she made four figures from these two brands. However, the situation has reversed recently, and A&F has begun to crack down on purchasing agents, she said. Sun's name has been on the "blacklist" of A&F and Hollister

09d1380a81eaf27d533327b090a8e53314de5332.sourceText: 黑名单上的客户不是因为买衣服小气，而是因为出手太阔绰。趁着年初A&F大减价，她一个多月内接到十 笔订单，每笔总金额都超过200元。她每周下订单不超过两次，且尽量更换不同的收货地址和信用卡。
09d1380a81eaf27d533327b090a8e53314de5332.translatedText: The customers on the blacklist are not because they are stingy when buying clothes, but because they spend too much money. Taking advantage of A&F's big sale at the beginning of the year, she received ten orders in more than a month. The total amount of each order exceeded 200 yuan. She placed no more than two orders a week, and tried to change the delivery address and credit card.

1fa18694ddb2b882872008e75427e3ee04d2d0c8.sourceText: 一个月后，她收到来自A&F的电子邮件，声称会取消后面所有未发货的订单，将来也永远不会接受Sophia孙的任何订单，包括A&F旗下的Hollister等其他品牌。几经交涉后，A&F承认将其列入黑名单，是因为怀疑她大量购入其商品并非自用，而是为二次贩卖（Resale）。
1fa18694ddb2b882872008e75427e3ee04d2d0c8.translatedText: A month later, she received an email from A&F, claiming that she would cancel all subsequent orders. We will never accept any orders from Sophia Sun in the future, including Hollister and other brands owned by A&F. After several negotiations, A&F admitted that they had blacklisted her because they suspected that she purchased a large amount of her products not for her own use, but for secondary use. Resale.

d70731d7f8043b5e4a6e5854fe5074ec4a2df9d7.sourceText: 与Sophia有相同遭遇的在美代购者大量存在。一旦上了黑名单，这位购买者的信用卡、收货地址、电子邮件，及其相关联的所有资料将统统被封杀。
d70731d7f8043b5e4a6e5854fe5074ec4a2df9d7.translatedText: There are a large number of purchasers in the United States who have the same experience as Sophia. Once on the blacklist, the purchaser's credit card, shipping address, email, and all related information will be included.

3e947a05ed844e5ac3b2e64128bb3c66708ae7ca.sourceText: 同样被列入黑名单的Crystal称，自从她上榜以后，她曾用过的家里地址、公司地址也跟着变黑。以致使用同一邮寄地址的无辜室友、同事都再也无法网 购。甚至有网友指出，A&F封的不仅是个人信息，甚至连无形的网路IP地址也封。只要使用同一网路系统，即使改变所有信息重新註册购买也于事无 补。
3e947a05ed844e5ac3b2e64128bb3c66708ae7ca.translatedText: Crystal, who was also blacklisted, said that since she was listed, her home address and company address have also become blacklisted, so that innocent roommates and colleagues who use the same mailing address can no longer access the Internet. Some netizens even pointed out that A&F blocks not only personal information, but also invisible network IP addresses. As long as they use the same network system, it will not help even if they change all the information and re-register for purchases.

6465c25c0a0ac2b10a070b0d6895a21779952e96.sourceText: 惹毛当红品牌A&F，逼其对市场设限，”受害者”都把矛头指向大陆市场的庞大需求。近年来，针对外来的购买力量，不少受大陆消费者青睐的商品 纷纷在美设限。A&F除网路销售严格审查外，Outlet店里也竖起牌子告之，一次购买不得超过20件。美国本土皮包品牌Coach也规定带有标志性Logo的商品不得超过五件。
6465c25c0a0ac2b10a070b0d6895a21779952e96.translatedText: Angered the popular brand A&F and forced it to impose restrictions on the market. In recent years, many products favored by mainland consumers have been targeted by foreign purchasing power. Restrictions have been set in the United States. In addition to strict inspections of online sales, A&F has also put up signs in outlet stores to inform that no more than 20 items can be purchased at a time. The American local leather bag brand Coach also stipulates that no more than five items with iconic logos can be purchased.

aac489c598ee0d4e207d472bce22cf510ebd5890.sourceText: 凤凰城出现巨大磨菇云场面震撼
aac489c598ee0d4e207d472bce22cf510ebd5890.translatedText: A huge mushroom cloud appeared in Phoenix, a shocking scene

b4e9c3e5016873d225c8e5d0204736cabecbca6d.sourceText: 凤凰城出现巨大磨菇云场面震撼 美国亚利桑那州凤凰城日前惊现巨大的磨菇云，引发热烈讨论，原来这是所谓…
b4e9c3e5016873d225c8e5d0204736cabecbca6d.translatedText: A huge mushroom cloud appeared in Phoenix, a shocking scene. A huge mushroom cloud suddenly appeared in Phoenix, Arizona, USA, triggering heated discussions. It turns out that this is the so-called...

96463bae702a6692687d77fdd74f3bca29abbb20.sourceText: 美国亚利桑那州凤凰城日前惊现巨大的磨菇云，引发热烈讨论，原来这是所谓微爆发（microburst）的天文现象，由摄影师弗格森所拍摄。
96463bae702a6692687d77fdd74f3bca29abbb20.translatedText: A huge mushroom cloud suddenly appeared in Phoenix, Arizona, USA, triggering heated discussions. It turns out that this is an astronomical phenomenon called a microburst, which was captured by photographer Ferguson.

68db27321b4b8455f4346e14b28c96cd2f71d3ff.sourceText: 从照片可见，微爆发就如一片巨型的磨菇云凌驾在凤凰城的上空，相当震撼。专家解释，微爆发由一股向下的气流形成，恰好跟龙卷风形成方向相反，并谓微爆发相当危险，飞机若靠近的话，或会导致相撞。
68db27321b4b8455f4346e14b28c96cd2f71d3ff.translatedText: As can be seen from the photo, the microburst is like a giant mushroom cloud hovering over Phoenix, which is quite shocking. Experts explained that microbursts are formed by a downward airflow, which is exactly the opposite direction from the formation of tornadoes. They also said that microbursts are very dangerous and may cause a collision if aircraft get close.

e7ae05c71e76ebd783fc72ba719a8b3a84c3a252.sourceText: 美国之音：中美人才争夺战谁输谁赢
e7ae05c71e76ebd783fc72ba719a8b3a84c3a252.translatedText: Voice of America: Who loses and who wins in the battle for talent between China and the United States

a53074432c1abc4688bfafa6a2d5c61cc55278e8.sourceText: 美国之音：中美人才争夺战谁输谁赢 人民日报旗下的人民网曾转载一篇题为《美媒：中美人才战美落败，近半旅美人才…
a53074432c1abc4688bfafa6a2d5c61cc55278e8.translatedText: Voice of America: Who loses and who wins in the battle for talent between China and the United States People's Daily Online, a subsidiary of the People's Daily, once reprinted an article titled "U.S. media: China and the United States have lost the war for talent, and nearly half of the talents in the United States...

c7f778b5d515ebd57281785004250cc022e62088.sourceText: 这些大大小小人才计划中最有名的是从2008年底开始实施的”千人计划” 。目的是围绕中国战略发展目标，用5－10年时间在重点创新项目、重点学科和重点实验室、企业和金融机构引进一批高层次的海外人才回国创新创业。
c7f778b5d515ebd57281785004250cc022e62088.translatedText: The most famous of these large and small talent plans is the "Thousand Talents Plan" implemented at the end of 2008. The purpose is to focus on China's strategic development goals and use 5-10 years to introduce a group of high-level overseas talents to return to China to innovate and start businesses in key innovation projects, key disciplines and key laboratories, enterprises and financial institutions.

f68b1ba650e84892f7167db5a91d14dccd99b6e9.sourceText: 为了使这个计划更具诱惑力，中国政府承诺给每位引进的人才提供100万元人民币的一次性补助；引进人才享受医疗照顾人员待遇；享受包括住房、探亲、子女教育等补贴；以及用人单位为引进人才的配偶安排工作或发放生活补贴等等。据报导， 千人计划三年间已经吸引了2200多名高新领域的人才回国，其中55％的人才来自美国。
f68b1ba650e84892f7167db5a91d14dccd99b6e9.translatedText: In order to make this plan more attractive, the Chinese government promises to provide each imported talent with a one-time subsidy of 1 million yuan; the imported talents will enjoy medical care personnel treatment; enjoy subsidies including housing, family visits, children's education, etc.; and the employer will arrange jobs or provide living allowances for the spouses of the imported talents, etc. According to reports, the Thousand Talents Plan has attracted more than 2,200 talents in high-tech fields to return to China in three years, 55% of whom are from the United States.

570db27b13b92d6c7982b7ec2d826e98356d4d6f.sourceText: 目前在美国国立卫生研究院(National Institute of Health)担任神经学研究员的杨天明表示，自己决定海归确实受到了这些人才引进计划的吸引，但这些计划并不是他要海归的决定因素。他说：”是有这个影响，我自己就申请了千人计划，只是结果还没有下来，但是我回国最重要的原因还是国内的（科研）经费比较有保障，就算这个申请不下来，在其他方面经费也可以得到足够的支持。”
570db27b13b92d6c7982b7ec2d826e98356d4d6f.translatedText: Yang Tianming, who is currently a neurology researcher at the National Institute of Health, said that his decision to return overseas was indeed attracted by these talent introduction programs, but these programs were not the deciding factor in his decision to return overseas. He said: "Because of this influence, I applied for the Thousand Talents Program myself, but the result has not been received yet. However, the most important reason for me to return to China is that domestic (scientific research) funding is relatively secure. Even if the application is not approved, I can still get sufficient support in other aspects of funding."

004586dd551c3b73a6f7a19e18be1cab133b7dec.sourceText: 杨天明是神经学领域的顶尖人才。他从上海复旦大学毕业后赴美，2003年从贝勒医学院（Baylor College of Medicine)获得神经学博士学位后又在华盛顿大学(University of Washington at Seattle)攻读博士后，2008年开始在美国国立卫生院担任研究员。他说，受经济影响，美国科研投入缩水是他决定回国发展的主要原因。”因为美国现在经济不好，所以目前在美国的科研经费不是特别好，而国内恰好相反，国内最近在科研方面投入的力度很大，今年我回国访问的时候后有人给我提到这样一个机会，给的科研经费很充足，所以我决定回国。因为做Science需要经费的支持才能出成果。”
004586dd551c3b73a6f7a19e18be1cab133b7dec.translatedText: > Yang Tianming is a top talent in the field of neurology. After graduating from Fudan University in Shanghai, he went to the United States. After receiving his PhD in neurology from Baylor College of Medicine in 2003, he studied for a postdoctoral degree at the University of Washington at Seattle. In 2008, he began to work as a researcher at the National Institutes of Health. He said that due to the economic impact, the shrinking investment in scientific research in the United States was the main reason for his decision to return to China for development. "Because the economy in the United States is not good right now, the current scientific research funding in the United States is not particularly good. On the contrary, China has recently invested a lot in scientific research. When I returned to China for a visit this year, someone mentioned such an opportunity to me and the scientific research funding was sufficient, so I decided to return to China. Because doing science requires financial support to produce results."

0e3372f86d145554d07908b6d487e75c1cac1890.sourceText: 的确，中国过去十多年在研发方面的投资水平一直稳步提高。2010年，中国在研发方面的投资占GPD的1.5％。虽然这一比例要远高于大多数发展中国家，但仍然逊色于美国的2.7％。
0e3372f86d145554d07908b6d487e75c1cac1890.translatedText: Indeed, China's investment level in research and development has been steadily increasing in the past ten years. In 2010, China's investment in R&D accounted for 1.5% of GPD. Although this proportion is much higher than that of most developing countries, it is still inferior to the 2.7% of the United States.

44d2832fb7586e964954ea74be30316def06d783.sourceText: 然而，在美华人选择归国的原因各不相同。2004年来美的徐愔现在是负责运营国际金融电文网络的环球银行金融电信协会（SWIFT）的软件工程师。她表示，海归对她最大的吸引在于能和国内的家人朋友团聚。她说： ”如果有好的机会的话，我是一定会考虑回国的，毕竟家人都在那边。因为回国可以和家人在一起，这是我考虑的比较重要的一个因素。”
44d2832fb7586e964954ea74be30316def06d783.translatedText: However, the reasons why Chinese in the United States choose to return home vary. Xu Min, who came to the United States in 2004, is now a software engineer at the Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication (SWIFT), which operates the international financial messaging network. She said that the biggest attraction for her as a returnee is that she can reunite with her family and friends back home. She said: "If there is a good opportunity, I will definitely consider returning to China. After all, my family is there. Because I can be with my family back home, which is an important factor for me to consider."

f85d8d729ebd7547bcb88e02f0a6c4ef72ef4464.sourceText: 中国与全球化研究中心和北京大学光华管理学院7月下旬联合发布了《中国海归创业发展报告（2012）》蓝皮书。这是中国首部重点研究海归群体回国创业的报告。报告说，自千人计划出台以来，中国正在从”人才流失国”逐渐成为 ”人才回流国”。这份报告还说，选择海归的主要因素是个人职业发展、社会文化以及与亲朋好友团聚。由此可见，虽然中国政府出台的各项政策能起到一定推动作用，但它们显然不是促成海归的最重要因素。
f85d8d729ebd7547bcb88e02f0a6c4ef72ef4464.translatedText: The China and Globalization Research Center and Peking University Guanghua School of Management jointly released the "China Returnee Entrepreneurship Development Report (2012)" blue book in late July. This is China's first report focusing on the study of returnee groups returning to China to start businesses. The report said that since the launch of the Thousand Talents Plan, China has gradually transformed from a "brain-draining country" to a "brain-returning country." The report also said that the main factors for choosing overseas returnees are personal career development, social culture and reunion with family and friends. It can be seen that although various policies introduced by the Chinese government can play a certain role in promoting returnees, they are obviously not the most important factor in promoting returnees.

47249679f57d0744957dc9f79f4bb5aa938a8feb.sourceText: 中国加大力度引进海外人才的举动确实引起了美国各界的关注。纽约市长布隆伯格牵头的一个团体”新美国经济联盟”(Partnership for a New American Economy) 5月份公布的一份调查报告把美国的人才流失归咎于美国僵化的移民政策。该报告说，美国的移民体系运作迟缓、僵化，而且未能与美国的劳工市场需求接轨。报告发现，从美国大学毕业后的外国留学生由于受到签证的限制而被迫离开美国。仅最近几年，被迫离开美国的外国留学生人数就达数千人之多。而恰恰是外国留学生往往会学习美国本土学生不青睐的科学、技术、工程和数学领域的专业。
47249679f57d0744957dc9f79f4bb5aa938a8feb.translatedText: China's increased efforts to introduce overseas talents have indeed attracted the attention of all walks of life in the United States. A survey report released in May by the Partnership for a New American Economy, a group led by New York Mayor Bloomberg, blamed the United States' rigid immigration policy for the brain drain. The report said the U.S. immigration system is slow, rigid and fails to align with U.S. labor market needs. The report found that foreign students who graduated from American universities were forced to leave the United States due to visa restrictions. In recent years alone, thousands of foreign students have been forced to leave the United States. It is precisely foreign students who tend to study science, technology, engineering and mathematics fields that are not popular among American students.

dab867eb7cfcd50ee830d52d90e4646667d55871.sourceText: 刚刚公布的《中国海归创业发展报告（2012）》也指出，中国的海归人才中属于外籍公民或持永久居留权者占全部海归的44％。这就说明，这些高端的海归人才并不一定是真正的”海龟”，而是往返于国内和海外的所谓”海鸥”。
dab867eb7cfcd50ee830d52d90e4646667d55871.translatedText: The just-announced "China Returnee Entrepreneurship Development Report (2012)" also pointed out that among China's returnee talents, those who are foreign citizens or hold permanent residency account for 44% of all returnees. This shows that these high-end returnee talents are not necessarily real "turtles", but so-called "seagulls" traveling between China and overseas.

52349f89b7a85ce38998855d7100f32f734eaef7.sourceText: 或许，很多高端人才决定当”海鸥”而不是”海龟”的现象在某种程度上表明海外人才对中国欢迎海外人才政策的持续性以及中国社会的长远发展仍存在些许疑虑。 布鲁金斯学会约翰 桑顿中国中心主任李成表示，一个国家对人才的真正吸引力在于其制度，仅靠一两个好的政策来吸引人才是远远不足的。
52349f89b7a85ce38998855d7100f32f734eaef7.translatedText: Perhaps, the phenomenon of many high-end talents deciding to become "seagulls" instead of "turtles" indicates to some extent that overseas talents still have some doubts about the sustainability of China's policy of welcoming overseas talents and the long-term development of Chinese society. Li Cheng, director of the John Thornton China Center at the Brookings Institution, said that the real attraction of a country to talents lies in its system. It is far from enough to rely on one or two good policies to attract talents.

8faa5ac702615167e6dfa60c8ae128721f75a9a4.sourceText: 李成说： ”政策对人才的吸引力度其实是很弱的。从中国方面来说，中国的政策很好，但是从整个大环境方面，制度方面来说，存在很多问题，这是一个基本的评估。从过去 二、三十年来讲，中国取得了很大的发展，人才回流也确实是趋势。但在近年来，回国也有很多的阻碍，制度和政治方面的问题， 包括中国的学术腐败、假学历、对海归的排挤等等。而且中国自己的市场现在也出现了很多很多问题，虽然很多’海龟’回去了，但是它（中国）需要的最尖端人才还是很难找到，很多人才回去了，但是很多需要的人才得不到很好的发展。”
8faa5ac702615167e6dfa60c8ae128721f75a9a4.translatedText: Li Cheng said: "The attractiveness of policies to talents is actually very weak. From China's perspective, China's policies are very good, but from the perspective of the overall environment and system, there are many problems. This is a basic assessment. In the past two or three decades, China has achieved great development, and the return of talents is indeed a trend. But in recent years, there have been many obstacles to returning to China, including institutional and political problems. Including China's academic corruption, fake academic qualifications, exclusion of returnees, etc. Moreover, China's own market is also experiencing many problems. Although many "turtles" have gone back, it (China) is still difficult to find the most cutting-edge talents it needs. Many talents have gone back, but they are very difficult to find. Talents in high demand cannot be well developed. "

018f6e89aff9cdc9e0a752df02ddcef0352ef05b.sourceText: 实际上，就在中共中央组织部部长李源潮号召海外人才回国报效祖国的同时，中国的达官贵人、官二代和富二代们却纷纷涌向海外。华盛顿邮报一篇文章提到互联网上流传的一个非官方统计数字。这个统计称，中国现任和退休的部长级官员中74.5％的子女持有美国绿卡或者是美国公民，而这一比例在他们的孙子和孙女中则高达91％。
018f6e89aff9cdc9e0a752df02ddcef0352ef05b.translatedText: In fact, just as Li Yuanchao, head of the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, called on overseas talents to return to serve the motherland, China's dignitaries, second-generation officials and second-generation rich people are flocking overseas. A Washington Post article mentioned an unofficial statistic circulating on the Internet. According to this statistics, 74.5% of the children of current and retired ministerial officials in China hold U.S. green cards or are U.S. citizens, and this proportion is as high as 91% among their grandchildren.

2d653bc4b000d676644e5aa1d93a45ade5aa4e37.sourceText: 发布胡润中国财富排行榜的胡润研究院去年进行的一项调查显示，中国有一半的百万富翁表示他们打算移民海外，而北美是他们首选的移民目的地。中国的学子们也继续源源不断进入美国的大学校园。在2010－2011学年，共有15.8万中国学生赴美留学，比上个学年增长23.5％，为历史最高水平。
2d653bc4b000d676644e5aa1d93a45ade5aa4e37.translatedText: A survey last year by the Hurun Research Institute, which publishes the Hurun China Wealth Rankings, showed that half of China's millionaires said they planned to immigrate overseas, and North America was their preferred destination. Chinese students also continue to enter American university campuses. In the 2010-2011 academic year, a total of 158,000 Chinese students studied in the United States, an increase of 23.5% over the previous academic year and the highest level in history.

eb1ca7dd2250a70a62aec58ce22e0c4751e5aa67.sourceText: 美国时代杂志网站不久前刊登了华人作家刘柏川（Eric Liu）的文章。 刘柏川对比了中美两国对人才的吸引力。他说，中国虽然在奋起直追，但中国的工程师更多的是从事日常工作而不是发明，中国对互联网的控制扼杀了创新，行政的不透明和公众信任的缺失浇灭了公民的进取心。相比之下，美国的内在优势表现在其众多的科研型大学、鼓励风险投资的经济体系、对各种族移民的接纳、相对透明的政府和遍及全国的志愿组织网络。
eb1ca7dd2250a70a62aec58ce22e0c4751e5aa67.translatedText: The American Time magazine website recently published an article by Chinese writer Eric Liu. Liu Baichuan compared the attraction of talents between China and the United States. He said that although China is catching up, its engineers are more engaged in daily work rather than inventing. China's control of the Internet has stifled innovation. Administrative opacity and the lack of public trust have dampened citizens' enterprising spirit. In contrast, the inherent advantages of the United States are reflected in its numerous research-oriented universities, an economic system that encourages venture capital, its acceptance of immigrants of all races, a relatively transparent government, and a nationwide network of voluntary organizations.

77d575ac8d2f53b438738cf0326f19645a3a60b2.sourceText: 对中国而言，要想真正成为一块吸引人才的磁石，就势必要对这些内在的体制性问题做出调整和改变。然而，进行这些制度性改革的难度要远远大于出台一两个政策和条文。美中两国的人才之战才刚刚打响，胜负还远未见分晓。
77d575ac8d2f53b438738cf0326f19645a3a60b2.translatedText: For China, in order to truly become a magnet for attracting talents, it is necessary to make adjustments and changes to these inherent systemic problems. However, carrying out these institutional reforms is far more difficult than issuing one or two policies and provisions. The war for talent between the United States and China has just begun, and the outcome is far from clear.

e3c2b6d6819912cb9e33b64292ac29524dc30b14.sourceText: （彭菲供稿）1/17日星期六，受美国亚利桑那州华人经贸文化促进协会Arizona Chinese Economic & Cultural Advancement Association of USA (ACECA)之邀，凤凰城上百名嘉宾欢聚一堂，共度热情洋溢的新年爱心晚宴及舞会。 美国亚利桑那州华人经贸文化促进协会会长黄双双向大家敬拜早年，并向大家介绍了协会的宗旨和近年来取得的成绩。她介绍，美国亚省华人经贸文化促进协会（ACECA) 于二零一三年一月成立。协会是一个非赢利，非政治，非宗教的专业团体。宗旨是在教育, 医疗保健，高科技，绿色能源等商业领域增加经济发展并致力中美经济文化交流。协会在过去的两年里着重社区服务和传播中国文化。协会曾多次在社区举办理财，报税，牙科保健，健康保健，投资，申请大学奖学金等免费讲座。展望未来，ACECA 在未来的两年里将继续努力促进华人企业的发展，传播中国文化，为社区捉供更多公益活动，并努力为贫穷地区，学校和学生提供经济援助。协会将设置奖学金以致鼓励为社区作出杰出贡献的的高中生和大学生。协会将设计会员VIP 优惠卡和爱心优恵卡。协会将出售爱心卡的所得的收入全部捐赠给中国贫穷地区。
e3c2b6d6819912cb9e33b64292ac29524dc30b14.translatedText: (Contributed by Peng Fei) On Saturday, January 17, sponsored by the Arizona Chinese Economic & Cultural Advancement Association of USA (ACECA) invited hundreds of guests from Phoenix City to gather together for a passionate New Year Love Dinner and Dance. Huang Shuangshuang, president of the Arizona Chinese Economic, Trade and Cultural Promotion Association, paid tribute to everyone in his early years and introduced the association's purpose and achievements in recent years. She introduced that the Alberta Chinese Economic, Trade and Cultural Promotion Association (ACECA) was established in January 2013. The Association is a non-profit, non-political, non-religious professional body. The purpose is to increase economic development in the business fields of education, health care, high technology, green energy and other business fields and to contribute to Sino-US economic and cultural exchanges. In the past two years, the association has focused on community service and spreading Chinese culture. The association has held many free lectures on financial management, tax preparation, dental care, health care, investment, applying for college scholarships, etc. in the community. Looking to the future, ACECA will continue to work hard to promote the development of Chinese enterprises, spread Chinese culture, provide more public welfare activities for the community, and strive to provide financial assistance to poor areas, schools and students in the next two years. The association will establish scholarships to encourage high school and college students who have made outstanding contributions to the community. The association will design member VIP discount cards and love gift cards. The association will donate all proceeds from the sale of love cards to poor areas in China.

d3465170b3e409eb70729bbd605350367f63a55e.translatedText: The association conducted an on-site election vote for the new board of directors, and announced the new board members elected on the spot: Jing Tianwei: chairman of the board of directors, Huang Shuangshuang: President of the Association, Chen Ting: Vice President of the Association, Peng Fei: Vice President of the Association, Chen Xieping: Treasurer of the Board of Directors. Love reunion, charity society. The association collected a total of $575 in donations during the dance, all of which will be donated to students from schools in poor areas of China. The association would like to express special thanks to MESA Community College president Mr. Pan Shou'an, the first principal of Asia Hope Chinese School Mr. Tang Xiaoxian and his wife Cai Shangao, Mrs. Yu who is beloved by the community and caring, and the UCAA, Principal Lu of the Art School of Alberta, "Sunbird" Arizona Chinese Network, the dance group led by GPCCC He Chunling, representatives of the modern Chinese schools in Alberta, representatives of the Hope Modern Chinese School, the Chinese Band and Chorus, ASU Student representatives, representatives of the Alberta Times, Asian American News reporter Sun Jianping, representatives of the Alberta Writers Association, representatives of the Alberta Mobile New Media "Alberta Chinese Weijia-Arizona Information Platform" and many other friends enthusiastically supported and participated. The colorful entertainment program at the party won bursts of applause, and the lucky draw interspersed in the program brought laughter.

88b96a92db761e4a5dee5f57bf8cc2be260f16db.sourceText: 杨济群：举头望明月，低头思故乡 中秋，这个充满美丽，浪漫，诗情画意的日子是我一年中最喜爱的节日，湛蓝色的天…
88b96a92db761e4a5dee5f57bf8cc2be260f16db.translatedText: Yang Jiqun: Looking up at the bright moon, looking down at my hometown. Mid-Autumn Festival, a day full of beauty, romance, and poetry, is my favorite festival of the year. The blue sky...

9b527c67d7c22a6dbbcffed4561301609b355f33.sourceText: 杨济群：举头望明月，低头思故乡 中秋，这个充满美丽，浪漫，诗情画意的日子是我一年中最喜爱的节日，湛蓝色的天空托着满满的圆月，思绪一下就飞上了月宫，幻想着嫦娥起舞，吴刚捧酒，玉兔守树的美丽画面，中秋也是人间收获的季节，丰收的日子，秋高气爽，晴空万里，人们的心情也会格外舒畅，我爱中秋。 历来的文人墨客有过多少咏中秋的诗歌词赋，赞颂这优美的节日，每到这一天，我总会沉浸在一种难以言表的思绪中，银色的月光，淡雅的天际，微微的秋风，使人产生”我欲乘风归去”的感觉，回忆从小到老一个又一个的中秋，感到时光的流逝，更使人思念万里外的故乡，人，不管你走到哪里，离家乡有多远，故乡却永远在你的身边，家乡的那所老屋，院子里的那口老井和门前的那株老槐树都永远活在你的心里，仰望幽幽的夜空和圆圆的明月，故乡那生我养我的山山水水如在眼前，真是”举头望明月，低头思故乡，”那心中升起的思乡情绪，浓浓的扯都扯不断。 小时过中秋是儿童时代最欢喜的日子，当月亮娘娘升上天空，满地银光，蒙眬而又纯净，几个小朋友相约去”摸熟”，到了人家的菜地，轻轻地钻进玉米地，折下玉米，毛豆，或其它瓜果，听到主人佯装追赶的吼声，（在这个节日里主人是不会真的追赶来，”摸熟”的孩子的），心里又惊又喜，在月光下奔跑，那种充满童趣的欢乐是成年以后找也找不回来的，但也是一生蕴藏在心底的最最美丽的回忆。 到美国后的每个中秋，一家人相聚在女婿女儿家小巧精致的小花园里，月色份外明亮，一家人吃着月饼瓜果梨桃，品茗谈心，小外孙告诉我”美国的地理位置注定了看月亮时会感到比中国大而圆，加上环境污染比中国少得多，所以月色格外亮丽。”的确，仰望长空，真感到月亮娘娘又大又圆，恰似一颗珍珠漂浮在无边无际的蔚蓝色大海之中，低头再看一家人的笑脸，心头涌上无比的温馨，那是一种奇妙的感觉，这时，祖国，故乡，那远方的亲人和父老乡亲都浮现眼前，这是一个游子对故土的怀念，我想，我的亲人们此时也一定在牵挂着万里外的我和我的一家吧！此时此刻，我在心底默默祝祷，但愿”月常圆，花常好，人长久”。
9b527c67d7c22a6dbbcffed4561301609b355f33.translatedText: Yang Jiqun: Looking up at the bright moon, looking down at my hometown. Mid-Autumn Festival, a day full of beauty, romance, and poetry, is my favorite festival of the year. The blue sky holds a full moon, and my thoughts immediately fly to the Moon Palace, imagining the beautiful scenes of Chang'e dancing, Wu Gang holding wine, and the Jade Rabbit guarding the tree. The Mid-Autumn Festival is also the harvest season in the world. On harvest days, with crisp autumn air and clear skies, people's mood will be particularly comfortable. I love the Mid-Autumn Festival. Literati throughout the history have written many poems and poems about the Mid-Autumn Festival, praising this beautiful festival. Every day on this day, I will always be immersed in an indescribable thought. The silver moonlight, the elegant sky, and the gentle autumn wind make people feel like "I want to ride the wind back." Recalling the Mid-Autumn Festival from childhood to old, I feel the passage of time, and I miss my hometown thousands of miles away. Wherever you go, no matter how far you are from your hometown, your hometown will always be by your side. The old house in your hometown, the old well in the yard and the old locust tree in front of the door will always live in your heart. Looking up at the faint night sky and the round bright moon, the mountains and rivers of your hometown that gave birth to me and raised me are just before your eyes. It is really like "looking up at the moon, looking down at my hometown." The homesickness rising in my heart is so strong that I can't stop talking about it. The Mid-Autumn Festival is the happiest day in childhood. When the Moon Lady rises into the sky, the ground is covered with silver light, hazy and pure. Several children meet to "touch and touch" the vegetables. When they arrive at someone's vegetable field, they gently dig into the corn field and break off the corn, edamame, or other fruits. When the owner pretends to The roar of chasing (the master will not really chase after a child who is "familiar" during this festival), the heart is surprised and happy, running under the moonlight, that kind of childlike joy cannot be found after adulthood, but it is also the most beautiful memory stored in the heart of a lifetime. Every Mid-Autumn Festival after arriving in the United States, the family gathers in the small and exquisite garden of the son-in-law and daughter's home. The moonlight is particularly bright. The family eats moon cakes, fruits, pears, and drinks tea. My grandson told me, "The geographical location of the United States is destined to make the moon feel bigger and rounder than that of China. In addition, the environmental pollution is much less than that of China, so the moonlight is particularly bright." Indeed, looking up at the sky, I really feel that the Moon Queen is there again. Big and round, just like a pearl floating in the boundless blue sea. When I lower my head and look at the smiling faces of my family, I feel an incomparable warmth in my heart. It is a wonderful feeling. At this time, the motherland, hometown, relatives and fellow villagers in the distance all appear in front of my eyes. This is a wanderer's nostalgia for my hometown. I think my relatives must be thinking about me and my family thousands of miles away at this time! At this moment, I pray silently in my heart, hoping that "the moon will always be full, the flowers will always be beautiful, and people will last forever."

8152f02f9f00bc12a1a03fcfd53cf820e7125b9a.sourceText: 中国国民党第十九次全国代表大会，于七月十九日在台北国父纪念馆召开，大会首要议程为通过洪秀柱参选中华民国第十四任总统党内提名。 亚利桑那直属分部党代表王玮𤧟常委返台与会，依照主席抽籤顺序，第三号发言，表达对国家及国民党的忠诚拥护， 洪秀柱参选总统的绝对支持。 在会议上，感受到党内的士气高昂，洪秀柱勇于承担的气魄，以及维护国家尊严、维持两岸和平的坚定立场。 在提名演讲中，洪秀柱重申 ”团结与承担”，引领国家走向和平、开放、均富与道德的大道上; 找回诚实、尊重、包容与慈悲的信仰价值; 拿出愿景、远见、和实践能力，来制定台湾永续发展的政策，立足本土，权衡两岸，接轨国际。 未来两岸政策将以国民党的党纲为基础，以九二共识，一中各表作为两岸和平发展最重要的核心价值。 一个民主政党，不同的声音，多元的意见，正是拟聚新力量的开始。国民党执政就是建立倾听，包容，明辨是非，崇尚道德的法治社会。 要用同理心和责任感，实现跨越世代，贫富、族群的正义与公平，迎向希望的未来。
8152f02f9f00bc12a1a03fcfd53cf820e7125b9a.translatedText: The 19th National Congress of the Chinese Kuomintang was held at the Sun Yat-Sen Memorial Hall in Taipei on July 19. The top agenda of the conference was to approve Hong Xiuzhu's candidacy for the party's nomination as the 14th President of the Republic of China. Arizona branch party representative Wang Wei, member of the Standing Committee, returned to Taiwan to attend the meeting. According to the order of the chairman's drawing of lots, No. 3 spoke, expressing his loyal support for the country and the Kuomintang, and his absolute support for Hong Xiuzhu's candidacy for president. At the meeting, I felt the high morale within the party, Hong Xiuzhu’s courage to take on the responsibility, and his firm stance to safeguard national dignity and maintain cross-strait peace. In his nomination speech, Hong Xiuzhu reiterated "unity and responsibility" to lead the country on the road of peace, openness, equal wealth and morality; to find the faith values ​​of honesty, respect, tolerance and compassion; to use vision, foresight and practical ability to formulate policies for Taiwan's sustainable development, based on locality, weighing cross-strait considerations, and integrating with the international community. Future cross-Strait policies will be based on the Kuomintang's party platform, and the 1992 Consensus and one China, each with separate representations will be the most important core values ​​for the peaceful development of cross-Strait relations. A democratic political party, with different voices and diverse opinions, is the beginning of gathering new strength. The Kuomintang's rule is to establish a society under the rule of law that listens, is tolerant, distinguishes right from wrong, and upholds morality. We must use empathy and responsibility to achieve justice and fairness across generations, rich and poor, and ethnic groups, and embrace a hopeful future.
