4b91b3eef51ca0542b31958bfc2caa69e3049e53.sourceText: 中老年汉语拼音开班啦 欢迎大家来参加 （崔增祁供稿）汉语拼音是用拼音字母拚写普通话语音的方桉，是中国语言文字的专家们总结了以往注音认字的经验，并研究了世界各种拼音文字的特点行成的。汉语拚音採用国际通用的拉丁字母，拚成音节，加上不同的声调即可给所有汉字注音，从而得出准确的发音，它是学讲中国话（普通话）的有效工具。1977年，联合国地名标准化会议决定採用汉语拚音作为拚写中国地名的国际标准；1982年，国际标准化组织决定採用汉语拚音作为拚写汉语的国际标准。目前学校採用的中文课本也都用汉语拼音注音，其应用范围日益广泛，在语文教学、书报刊物出版、编写索引、拚音电报、旗语、灯光訉号、商业广告中普遍被採用，特别是电脑中文化操作中，必须学会使用汉语拼音。 为了帮助中老年朋友补上汉语拼音这一课。华人耆英中心将于近期开设汉语拚音研习班，延聘资深语文教师哈秀环女士任教。从五月三十日起，每星期四上午九点到十点上课，共十五个课时。凡十八嵗以上成年，办理了鳯凰城老人中心活动成员资格者，均可免费参加学习。请莫失良机。 地点：734 W. ELM st. Phoenix AZ 85013
4b91b3eef51ca0542b31958bfc2caa69e3049e53.translatedText: Chinese Pinyin classes for middle-aged and elderly people are open. Everyone is welcome to attend. (Contributed by Cui Zengqi) Hanyu Pinyin is a scheme for spelling the pronunciation of Mandarin using Pinyin letters. It was developed by experts in Chinese language and writing who summarized the previous experience of pinyin recognition and studied the characteristics of various Pinyin characters around the world. Chinese Pinyin uses the internationally accepted Latin alphabet, spells it into syllables, and adds different tones to notate all Chinese characters, so as to obtain accurate pronunciation. It is an effective tool for learning to speak Chinese (Mandarin). In 1977, the United Nations Conference on the Standardization of Geographical Names decided to adopt Hanyu Pinyin as the international standard for spelling Chinese place names; in 1982, the International Organization for Standardization decided to adopt Hanyu Pinyin as the international standard for spelling Chinese place names. Chinese textbooks currently used in schools also use Hanyu Pinyin, and its application range is increasingly wide. It is widely used in Chinese teaching, book and newspaper publishing, indexing, Pinyin telegrams, flags, light signs, and commercial advertisements. Especially in computer cultural operations, you must learn to use Hanyu Pinyin. In order to help middle-aged and elderly friends catch up on the Chinese Pinyin lesson. The Chinese Senior Citizens Center will open a Chinese Pinyin workshop in the near future and has hired a senior Chinese teacher, Ms. Ha Xiuhuan, to teach. Starting from May 30th, classes will be held every Thursday from 9 am to 10 am, for a total of 15 classes. All adults over the age of 18 who have applied for membership in the Huanghuang City Senior Center can participate in the study for free. Please don't miss this opportunity. Location: 734 W. ELM st. Phoenix AZ 85013

09a43254e764f6f603c3dc123af42330b53b1b64.translatedText: Zhen Kaiying: Remembering from taking my daughter to the hospital Yesterday, my youngest daughter Yangyang caught a cold and coughed heartbreakingly all night. I took her to the hospital this morning. From registration to treatment...

fefa89c28f90fc7a4a32ee0fd94fe804414293d4.sourceText: 甄凯婴：从带女儿上医院想起 昨天，小女儿羊羊感冒了，夜里撕心裂肺地咳了一夜，今早带她去医院。从挂号到看完病取完药回家，整整花了近五个小时。 提起上医院，生活在北京的人心里犯愁。北京的医院都是全国人民的医院，好多外地病患慕名而来，加上本地病患，每天都把全北京各个三级医院围个水泄不通。好不容易挂上号了，排队等见医生又是大半天，见着医生听两下心肺，又被打发去查血、查尿，病人还得拖着病体，忍着痛楚，跑上跑下去缴费，去排队检查，等结果，又会医生诊室去等医生开药，然后又是排队缴费，排队取药……很多人说，在北京，得什么都别得病！ 不禁想起6月15日与”第八期海外华文媒体高级研修班”成员一起，参观的上海市闵行区古美社区卫生服务中心（下称古美医院）的情况。 闵行区古美街道位于闵行区中部，街道总面积6.5平方公里，是一个纯居住小区，目前户籍人数4.2万人，入住人数11.3万人，外来流动人口数2万人，60岁以上老年人占总人口18.3%。 古美路社区卫生服务中心是一所集预防、保健、医疗、康复、健康教育、计生技术指导于一体的标准化社区卫生服务中心，下设4个服务点，全面承担起社区居民常见病、多发病、慢性病的防治工作。 据医院发言人罗小蓉医师介绍，医院在职员工有134人，其中110人是专业医学人士。医院有病床110张，医保家庭病床200张。门诊接诊数量惊人，2006年门诊量达227515人次，平均日门诊量823人次。 医院的最大特色是设备电脑化。医院为社区每位常住居民(包括非户籍居民）建立医疗档案，每位居民可凭手中的健康卡和医保卡，在家即可预约挂号。如不懂电脑操作或家中无电脑者，可到就近的街道办事处寻求帮助。有了这套服务，大大节省了病患排队挂号的时间。病人看完病之后，医生也是在电脑上开处方，取药、缴费也是刷卡完成。电脑化的实施，大大减少了病人在医院为挂号、缴费、取药等带来的上下奔波。 古美医院还有一大特色：服务人性化。病人回家后，医生还贴心地打电话随访。对慢性病病人，如高血压、糖尿病等病人，定期随访，有需要者，医生还上门随访。好多国人生病爱挂水（打吊针），在古美医院下属四个服务点就可完成这项服务。古美街道的居民，平时有个头昏脑热的，也不用去叨扰三级医院了。 难怪我们当天在古美医院几乎看不到病人，偌大一个医院干净安祥，还以为医院为了接待我们特意不接诊呢，原来早就被一批批分流了。 现在国人抱怨看病难，担心一级、二级医院医生水平不均，设备不全，都三级医院去，造成三级医院病患人满，有些医生难免出差错，继而引发医患冲突，血案时有发生。 如果，在全国各地多一些像古美医院这样的现代化社区卫生服务中心，民众看病难问题是不是得到很大程度的改善？医患冲突会不会减少了？社会会不会进一步和谐？这一连串问题的答案，我想中国各级政府心中有数。
fefa89c28f90fc7a4a32ee0fd94fe804414293d4.translatedText: Zhen Kaiying: I remember taking my daughter to the hospital. Yesterday, my youngest daughter Yangyang caught a cold and coughed heartbreakingly all night. I took her to the hospital this morning. It took nearly five hours from registration to seeing the doctor and picking up medicine and going home. People living in Beijing feel worried when they think of going to the hospital. Beijing's hospitals are hospitals for the people of the whole country. Many patients from other places come here to visit them. In addition, local patients also crowd all the tertiary hospitals in Beijing every day. After finally getting registered, I waited in line to see the doctor for most of the day. I saw the doctor listening to the heart and lungs twice, and was sent to do a blood test and urine test. The patient had to drag his body, endure the pain, run up and down to pay, go to the line for examination, wait for the results, go to the doctor's office to wait for the doctor to prescribe medicine, and then line up to pay and pick up the medicine... Many people say that in Beijing, there is nothing wrong with getting sick! I can’t help but think of the visit I took to the Gumei Community Health Service Center (hereinafter referred to as Gumei Hospital) in Minhang District, Shanghai on June 15 with members of the “Eighth Overseas Chinese Media Advanced Training Class”. Gumei Street in Minhang District is located in the middle of Minhang District. It has a total street area of ​​6.5 square kilometers. It is a purely residential community. It currently has 42,000 registered residents, 113,000 residents, and a migrant population of 20,000. Elderly people over 60 years old account for 18.3% of the total population. Gumei Road Community Health Service Center is a standardized community health service center that integrates prevention, health care, medical treatment, rehabilitation, health education, and family planning technical guidance. It has 4 service points and is fully responsible for the prevention and treatment of common, frequently-occurring, and chronic diseases among community residents. According to hospital spokesperson Dr. Luo Xiaorong, the hospital has 134 employees, 110 of whom are medical professionals. The hospital has 110 beds and 200 medical insurance family beds. The number of outpatient visits is astonishing. In 2006, the number of outpatient visits reached 227,515, with an average daily outpatient volume of 823. The biggest feature of the hospital is the computerization of equipment. The hospital establishes medical files for every permanent resident in the community (including non-registered residents). Each resident can make an appointment at home with the health card and medical insurance card in his hand. If you do not know how to operate a computer or do not have a computer at home, you can go to the nearest subdistrict office for help. With this set of services, patients’ time in queuing for registration is greatly saved. After the patient sees the doctor, the doctor also writes a prescription on the computer, and the medication and payment are also completed by swiping the card. The implementation of computerization has greatly reduced the time patients have to travel up and down in the hospital for registration, payment, and medicine collection. Gumei Hospital also has a major feature: humanized service. After the patient returned home, the doctor thoughtfully called and followed up. Patients with chronic diseases, such as hypertension and diabetes, are followed up regularly. If necessary, doctors will also visit their homes for follow-up visits. Many Chinese people like to take water injections (injections) when they are sick. This service can be completed at the four service points affiliated to Gumei Hospital. Residents of Gumei Street don't need to bother with tertiary hospitals if they usually have dizziness. No wonder we saw almost no patients in Gumei Hospital that day. The hospital is so big and clean and peaceful. We thought the hospital didn’t accept patients specifically to receive us. It turned out that they had been diverted in batches. Nowadays, Chinese people complain that it is difficult to see a doctor. They are worried that doctors in first- and second-level hospitals are not uniformly qualified and have insufficient equipment. They all go to third-level hospitals, causing the third-level hospitals to be overcrowded with patients. Some doctors will inevitably make mistakes, which will lead to conflicts between doctors and patients, and murders occur from time to time. If there were more modern community health service centers like Gumei Hospital across the country, would the problem of people's difficulty in seeing a doctor be greatly improved? Will doctor-patient conflicts be reduced? Will society become more harmonious? I think Chinese governments at all levels know the answers to this series of questions.

9cc1718f18bdad03beff2c7c422e9359dabf683b.sourceText: 美大航空公司今年五度调涨机票 今年飞机票涨价已达第五次了。最近的涨价由西南航空公司(Southwest)率先开始，该公司500英里以下航线的票价，单程上涨五元。通常西南航空涨票价，其他公司都会跟进，形成涨价潮。 迄今一些最大的航空公司，包括达美(Delta)、全美(US Airways)、联合(United)与美国(American)航空公司都已跟着西南航空涨价；维珍美国(Virgin America)航空公司也在与西南航空竞争国内短程市场，如旧金山到圣地亚哥、拉斯韦加斯到洛杉矶等。 航空公司虽然迄今为止都在盈利，但仍旧抱怨营运费用太高，主要是飞机燃油的成本高。因而许多航空公司都藉减少班次和限制座位来涨票价。 西南航空公司发言人艾希莉 迪伦说：”我们绝不愿对顾客涨票价，也对我们在公司网站上提供的低廉票价感到自豪，但有时涨价是为支付营业成本（包括燃油）所必须的。” 今年以来航空公司已试图涨价八次，四次成功，现在由西南航空领导的涨价是第五次。去年航空公司22次企图涨价，成功九次。 西南航空公司的平均旅客票价是单程141.72元，旅客平均飞行里数是939英里。 Farecompare.com的执行长西尼说，航空公司今年改变策略，通常他们是对所有的航线涨票价，但上周达美航空公司试图对商务旅客常走的航线涨票价，由于其他航空公司未跟进，以致该尝试失败了，但至少航空公司不想一直全面涨票价，暂时改为针对特定旅客涨价的B计划。
9cc1718f18bdad03beff2c7c422e9359dabf683b.translatedText: > American Airlines has raised air ticket prices for the fifth time this year. This is the fifth time this year that air ticket prices have increased. The most recent price increase was initiated by Southwest Airlines, which increased its fares by $5 one-way on routes under 500 miles. Usually when Southwest Airlines raises its fares, other companies will follow suit, creating a wave of price increases. So far, some of the largest airlines, including Delta, US Airways, United and American, have followed Southwest Airlines in raising prices; Virgin America is also competing with Southwest Airlines in domestic short-haul markets, such as San Francisco to San Diego, Las Vegas to Los Angeles, etc. Although airlines have been profitable so far, they still complain about high operating expenses, mainly due to the high cost of aircraft fuel. Therefore, many airlines have increased fares by reducing flights and restricting seats. Southwest Airlines spokesperson Ashley Dillon said: "We are never willing to raise fares on our customers and are proud of the low fares we offer on our website, but sometimes price increases are necessary to cover operating costs, including fuel." Airlines have tried to increase prices eight times this year, four times successfully, and now the price increase led by Southwest Airlines is the fifth. Airlines attempted to raise prices 22 times last year and succeeded nine times. The average passenger fare on Southwest Airlines is 141.72 yuan one way, and the average passenger mileage is 939 miles. Farecompare.com CEO Sini said that airlines have changed their strategies this year. Usually they raise fares on all routes, but last week Delta Air Lines tried to raise fares on routes frequently used by business passengers. Because other airlines did not follow suit, the attempt failed, but at least the airline did not want to keep raising fares across the board, and temporarily changed to Plan B to raise prices for specific passengers.

b8b561f3c79766c50260a217b3175b33cc9b5c4a.sourceText: 6月28日，中国驻洛杉矶总领事刘健及夫人陈小玲女士，教育参赞袁东博士、白东石领事到访亚利桑那凤凰城，亚省华联、大凤凰城华人侨团联合总会、ASU孔子学院、ASU学生学者联谊会、《亚省时报》、希望中文学校、现代中文学校、新东方艺术学校、亚省华人医生协会等几十个华人华侨学界团体近百人出席了在Mekong Palace举行的欢迎晚宴。
b8b561f3c79766c50260a217b3175b33cc9b5c4a.translatedText: On June 28, Chinese Consul General in Los Angeles Liu Jian and his wife Ms. Chen Xiaoling, Education Counselor Dr. Yuan Dong, and Consul Bai Dongshi visited Phoenix, Arizona, and the Hualian Association of Asia and the Greater Phoenix Chinese Association Nearly a hundred people from dozens of Chinese and overseas Chinese academic groups, including the United Federation of Federation, ASU Confucius Institute, ASU Students and Scholars Association, "Alberta Times", Hope Chinese School, Modern Chinese School, New Oriental Art School, and the Alberta Chinese Doctors Association, attended the event in Mekong Welcome dinner held at the Palace.

cfca4cc70a0badb227ec2fccb31f2e3ffbb21a14.sourceText: 刘健总领事在致词中回顾了中美建交35年来双边合作取得的瞩目成就，高度评价了亚利桑那侨学界各团体在增进中美两国人民相互了解，为维护和发展海外华侨的福祉和权益，为传承中华民族的文化，为推进当地各族裔之间的交流和睦，为推动当地社区的经济文化发展所作出的重要的贡献。他希望在未来的发展中，大家继续发挥侨领的作用，特别是亚利桑那和中国之间的发展，以2012年为例，亚利桑那州向中国出口12亿美元，还有很大的合作发展空间。他同样希望大家一如既往地关心支持中国的发展。中国现在提出了两个百年的目标，提出了中国梦，这是我们全体炎黄子孙的共同目标，但是要实现这个目标，还需要艰苦的努力。总领馆希望和大家经常走动，希望大家把总领馆当成自己的家，为中美两国间的双赢互利和平发展继续共同努力。
cfca4cc70a0badb227ec2fccb31f2e3ffbb21a14.translatedText: In his speech, Consul General Liu Jian reviewed the remarkable achievements of bilateral cooperation over the past 35 years since the establishment of diplomatic relations between China and the United States, and spoke highly of the important contributions made by various Arizona overseas Chinese academic groups in enhancing mutual understanding between the people of China and the United States, safeguarding and developing the welfare and rights of overseas Chinese, inheriting the culture of the Chinese nation, promoting exchanges and harmony among local ethnic groups, and promoting the economic and cultural development of local communities. He hopes that in future development, everyone will continue to play the role of overseas Chinese leaders, especially in the development between Arizona and China. Taking 2012 as an example, Arizona exported US$1.2 billion to China, and there is still a lot of room for cooperation and development. He also hopes that everyone will continue to care and support China's development. China has now put forward two centenary goals and proposed the Chinese Dream. This is the common goal of all our descendants, but to achieve this goal, we still need hard work. The Consulate General hopes to visit you frequently. I hope you will treat the Consulate General as your home and continue to work together for win-win, mutual benefit and peaceful development between China and the United States.

96cd9fab3119d5239937bd578416a99dc301339d.sourceText: 亚省各侨学界领袖分别致词欢迎总领事夫妇一行。亚省华联会长王惟咨博士在发言中感谢大使和夫人一行在百忙之中来到凤凰城侨社看望大家，感谢总领事馆一直以来对我们侨社的关心，支持和邦助，希望以后能为中国的发展和文化交流做一些贡献。
96cd9fab3119d5239937bd578416a99dc301339d.translatedText: > Leaders of overseas Chinese academic circles in Alberta delivered speeches to welcome the Consul General and his wife. In his speech, Dr. Wang Weizi, President of the Chinese Federation of Alberta, thanked the ambassador and his wife for taking the time to come to the Phoenix Overseas Chinese Community to visit everyone despite their busy schedules. He also thanked the Consulate General for its continued concern, support and assistance to our overseas Chinese community. He hoped that it could make some contributions to China's development and cultural exchanges in the future.

60adbcc4c77df927e103a5703aa794a2542ad19a.sourceText: 正如刘健总领事所说，亚利桑那州的华人以”特别的温度”热烈欢迎他们，整个晚宴热情洋溢，温馨祥和。宴席期间，亚省华联代表向刘健总领事一行交流了9月即将举办的第八届”凤凰之夜”迎国庆贺中秋系列庆祝活动，与教育参赞袁东博士商讨了进一步推进教育交流的计划，期待刘健总领事一行9月回来，和亚省华人华侨共度一年一度的”凤凰之夜”
60adbcc4c77df927e103a5703aa794a2542ad19a.translatedText: As Consul General Liu Jian said, the Chinese in Arizona warmly welcomed them with "special warmth". The entire dinner was warm, warm and peaceful. During the banquet, representatives of the Hualian Federation of Alberta shared with Consul General Liu Jian and his delegation the 8th "Phoenix Night" National Celebration and Mid-Autumn Festival series celebrations to be held in September. They discussed plans to further promote educational exchanges with Education Counselor Dr. Yuan Dong. They looked forward to the return of Consul General Liu Jian and his delegation in September to meet with Chinese people in Alberta. Overseas Chinese gather together for the annual "Phoenix Night"

ae58911f7c9d5ced8900bcb2dfffb860601b7d83.sourceText: 【环球网综合报道】据英国路透社11月7日报道，美国加利福尼亚州至亚利桑那州地区的夜空出现神秘亮光的消息7日晚在社交媒体不胫而走。五角大楼称，这是海军导弹飞行试验引起的现象。
ae58911f7c9d5ced8900bcb2dfffb860601b7d83.translatedText: [Global Network Comprehensive Report] According to a British Reuters report on November 7, news of mysterious lights appearing in the night sky from California to Arizona spread like wildfire on social media on the evening of the 7th. The Pentagon said the phenomenon was caused by a Navy missile flight test.

f99b304c67ac4a14584f66e6d70396768b2e3248.sourceText: 五角大楼公共事务发言人佩里(Ryan Perry)称，有关方面在海上进行海军战略系统项目”三叉戟II”(D5)导弹飞行试验，该试验是从位于南加州外海太平洋试射场的”肯塔基”号潜艇(USS Kentucky)上进行的。
f99b304c67ac4a14584f66e6d70396768b2e3248.translatedText: Pentagon public affairs spokesman Ryan Perry said that relevant parties conducted a naval strategic system project "Trident II" (D5) missile flight test at sea. The test was conducted from the "USS Kentucky" submarine (USS Kentucky) located at the Pacific Test Range off the coast of Southern California.

ee027b03b52cfa5bb781ca2b2617866fc7ab7098.sourceText: 推特、脸书等社交媒体用户纷纷上传亮光的图片和视频并跟帖评论，有的说可能是流星，有的说可能是不明飞行物(UFO)等。
ee027b03b52cfa5bb781ca2b2617866fc7ab7098.translatedText: Social media users such as Twitter and Facebook have uploaded pictures and videos of bright lights and commented on them. Some said they might be meteors, some said they might be UFOs, etc.

b6fb403e340fd997f7dfb825265e2abe1dee858d.sourceText: 根据上述发言人的讲话，这次试验是计划的、正在进行的系统评估试验的一部分。该发言人指出，由于关于”三叉戟II”(D5)导弹发射试验的信息在发射前属于机密信息，因此通常不发布此类导弹试验的信息
b6fb403e340fd997f7dfb825265e2abe1dee858d.translatedText: According to the above-mentioned spokesperson, this trial is part of a planned and ongoing system evaluation trial. 8d56c7f6137af473c3ef0936fa6719a50dfdba7e.sourceText: 感恩节前自己动手捏泥塑火鸡 ——–”新东方”文化讲坛感恩节特别奉献 照片上这只颜色鲜艳，形象生动的烤火鸡看上去是不是令人垂涎三尺？其实这不是一只真正的火鸡，这是一只用手捏出来的陶土泥塑火鸡，只有两寸长一寸高。感恩节快到了，烤火鸡，做苹果派，这些具有特色的节日活动又要在各个家庭中展开了。 本期的”新东方文化讲坛”将会为大家安排什么具有感恩节特色的活动呢？著名的雕塑家徐威东老师为将为您带来一堂陶土泥塑的公开课，徐老师会在一个小时的时间里手把手地教会您和您的孩子，如何把一块小小的陶土泥捏成一只感恩节的小火鸡。然后拿回家去，在家里的小烤箱里烤上十五分钟，就可以永久保存。 大家都知道，陶土是一种无毒无臭的天然矿物，柔软湿润，可塑性强，亲近可爱。目前陶艺制作在社会上非常流行，人人都喜欢。孩子们喜欢是因为，它能满足孩子们好动、好奇、好胜的需要。成人们喜欢，是因为它是一种休闲放松的方式。那么，感恩节前的那个周末就让我们和孩子们一起来跟着徐老师体会自己动手捏泥塑的快乐吧! 主讲人：徐威东，著名艺术家、画家、雕塑家。 从事视觉艺术30余年， 天赋艺术才能和立体想像力， 接受过8年专业艺术教育，学习过美术、雕塑、设计等。并有10年以上的教学经历。早期从事经典的玉石雕刻，礼品设计制作，后又从事卡通产品的开发。近年来则致力于建筑雕塑，有着大量不同行业和领域的工作经验。 更多详情请登陆徐威东网站 http://3dsculpturestudio.com/ 时间：2012年11月17日 周六 7:00-8:00pm 地点：新东方艺术学校 1100 N Alma school Chandler Az.,85224 电话：602-490-0613
8d56c7f6137af473c3ef0936fa6719a50dfdba7e.translatedText: Make your own clay sculpture turkey before Thanksgiving ——“New Oriental” Culture Forum’s Special Thanksgiving Offering Doesn’t this brightly colored and vivid roast turkey in the photo look mouth-watering? In fact, this is not a real turkey. It is a clay sculpture made by hand. It is only two inches long and one inch high. Thanksgiving is coming soon. Roasting turkeys and making apple pies are some of the unique holiday activities that families have to do again. What activities with Thanksgiving characteristics will be arranged for you in this issue of "New Oriental Culture Forum"? The famous sculptor Mr. Xu Weidong will bring you an open class on clay sculpture. In one hour, Mr. Xu will teach you and your children step by step how to shape a small piece of clay into a small Thanksgiving turkey. Then take it home and bake it in a small oven at home for fifteen minutes, and it can be stored forever. As we all know, clay is a non-toxic and odorless natural mineral that is soft, moist, highly malleable, approachable and lovely. Ceramic making is very popular in society at present and everyone likes it. Children like it because it satisfies their needs of being active, curious and competitive. Adults like it because it is a way to relax. So, on the weekend before Thanksgiving, let us and the children follow Teacher Xu to experience the joy of making clay sculptures by ourselves! Speaker: Xu Weidong, a famous artist, painter, and sculptor. He has been engaged in visual art for more than 30 years. He has natural artistic talent and three-dimensional imagination. He has received 8 years of professional art education and studied art, sculpture, design, etc. And have more than 10 years of teaching experience. In the early days, he was engaged in classic jade carving, gift design and production, and later in the development of cartoon products. In recent years, he has devoted himself to architectural sculpture and has a lot of work experience in different industries and fields. For more details, please visit Xu Weidong's website http://3dsculpturestudio.com/ Time: November 17, 2012 Saturday 7:00-8:00pm Location: New Oriental Art School 1100 N Alma school Chandler Az., 85224 Tel: 602-490-0613

6d48dc432d6ce9b8e815f349fe153d0d7e20caf0.sourceText: 中新网12月25日电 美国《侨报》日前发表评论文章称，转眼间已是2017岁末；2017年1月20日，大选中爆冷胜利的特朗普入主白宫。”特朗普时间”开启的一年里，在这位”非典型”总统治下，美国在立法、经济、社会、外交等方面等发生了一些变化或进展。
6d48dc432d6ce9b8e815f349fe153d0d7e20caf0.translatedText: China News Service, December 25 The American "Overseas Chinese News" recently published a commentary article saying that in the blink of an eye it is the end of 2017; on January 20, 2017, Trump won the White House after an unexpected victory in the general election. In the year since the "Trump Time" began, under the rule of this "atypical" president, the United States has experienced some changes or progress in legislative, economic, social, diplomatic and other aspects.

2ac520bd165cce3c91452e069799947b4061969c.sourceText: 评论称，特朗普在竞选时，曾经在葛底斯堡演讲，和美国人民有一个”百日约定”，列出了就职百日之内要实现的目标。但特朗普在这一年相当多的时间里几乎”诸事不顺”。相当长的时间里只能把”迅速任命大法官”作为能上台面的”执政成果”。
2ac520bd165cce3c91452e069799947b4061969c.translatedText: commented that during the campaign, Trump once delivered a speech at Gettysburg and made a "100-day promise" with the American people, listing goals to be achieved within 100 days of taking office. But Trump has had almost everything go wrong for much of this year. For a long time, the only "quick appointment of justices" can be regarded as a "governing achievement" that can be put on the table.

57b2cac70088f8ed28d3988552554d7d4566ca50.sourceText: ”旅行禁令”经过各种波折终于实行、白宫方面一再强调”加强移民执法””废除”链式移民””等，没有成为国会立法优先事项的迹象。废除奥巴马健保只差”临门一脚”的时候因受到共和党议员的反对而未获通过，虽然现在终于被夹带在税改方案里被取消了强制条款，但从现在起到2019年生效期间还有什么变化很难说。
57b2cac70088f8ed28d3988552554d7d4566ca50.translatedText: The "travel ban" was finally implemented after various twists and turns. The White House has repeatedly emphasized "strengthening immigration enforcement" and "abolition of "chain migration"", etc., but there is no sign of it becoming a legislative priority for Congress. Repealing Obamacare was just a "final step" and failed due to opposition from Republican lawmakers. Although it has finally been included in the tax reform plan and the mandatory provisions have been removed, it is difficult to say what changes will occur between now and when it takes effect in 2019.

0c8fb71b7860690dfb4a727212faa2eb230c1ee9.sourceText: 基础设施的”一万亿计划”被一推再推，那堵美墨边境是否能正式开工也还是未知。好在，从4月白宫发布税改大纲开始，美国历史上减税幅度最大的税改方案终于在圣诞节前送到了特朗普的签字桌上。这个重大胜利的到来成为特朗普执政成就清单浓墨重彩的一笔，也大大提振了特朗普及其支持者的士气。
0c8fb71b7860690dfb4a727212faa2eb230c1ee9.translatedText: The "one trillion plan" for infrastructure has been pushed back again and again, and it is still unknown whether the construction of the US-Mexico border can be officially started. Fortunately, starting from the release of the tax reform outline by the White House in April, the tax reform plan with the largest tax cuts in U.S. history was finally delivered to Trump's signing table before Christmas. The arrival of this major victory became a highlight in Trump's list of achievements during his administration, and also greatly boosted the morale of Trump and his supporters.

e02d53d8f0906234a4233803e145c02a9599dab9.sourceText: 2017对美国经济来说是不错的一年，也是特朗普常用来证明自己”让美国再次伟大”的最重要论据。美国经济实现了连续两个季度3%以上的经济增长，这是2014年以来的第一次。失业率也在继续走低。股市一年来更是主要指标屡创新高。
e02d53d8f0906234a4233803e145c02a9599dab9.translatedText: 2017 was a good year for the U.S. economy, and it was also the most important argument Trump often used to prove his "Make America Great Again." The U.S. economy has achieved economic growth of more than 3% for two consecutive quarters, which is the first time since 2014. The unemployment rate also continues to fall. The stock market has seen major indicators hit new highs repeatedly over the past year.

b053776857002fc6190dba42ce540b48d81ea9fb.sourceText: 但并不是所有人都认为这归功于特朗普。民主党的说法是，这与奥巴马执政的经济红利、经济政策的滞后性分不开。当然，美国经济向好究竟是谁的功劳还有待时间检验，但特朗普上任后削减了能源、教育、就业等各领域的规章制度共860条，替经济”松绑”，这是不争的事实。至于大公司及其海外利润会不会大量”回归”、经济增速能否保持在3%以上等，现在还不能判断。税改能带来多少经济增长，以及能否抵消债务大幅提升带来的负面影响，更是各方面都在观望的。
b053776857002fc6190dba42ce540b48d81ea9fb.translatedText: But not everyone credits Trump with that. The Democratic Party's argument is that this is inseparable from the economic dividends and the lag in economic policies of the Obama administration. Of course, it remains to be seen who is responsible for the improvement of the U.S. economy. However, after taking office, Trump has cut a total of 860 regulations and rules in various fields such as energy, education, and employment, "loosening" the economy. This is an indisputable fact. As for whether large companies and their overseas profits will "return" in large quantities, and whether the economic growth rate can be maintained above 3%, it is still unclear. Everyone is waiting to see how much economic growth the tax reform can bring and whether it can offset the negative impact of a significant increase in debt.

f61badfd12ffe8f719756362e91ad4ae5a28aab3.sourceText: 评论称，应该说，美国社会的”分化”这些年来一直在愈演愈烈，而社会矛盾在政界表现为两党之间深深的裂痕。虽然几个月前两党关系看似有缓和迹象，但现在还是处于对立状态。
f61badfd12ffe8f719756362e91ad4ae5a28aab3.translatedText: commented that it should be said that the "division" of American society has been intensifying over the years, and social contradictions manifest in the political circles as deep rifts between the two parties. Although relations between the two parties seemed to be easing a few months ago, they are now at odds.

6b2d0f6d8728a103561d1a96db2c875635c8766b.sourceText: 从废除奥巴马健保到税务改革，特朗普都没有从民主党得到一张赞成票。现在，阿拉巴马州参议员补选失利给共和党敲响了警钟，2018年中期选举结果还难以预测；选情还将受到通俄门调查和未来一年特朗普执政成果的影响。但可以预测的是，一旦共和党不再同时控制国会两院，特朗普执政将受到更多的掣肘。
6b2d0f6d8728a103561d1a96db2c875635c8766b.translatedText: From repealing Obamacare to tax reform, Trump did not get a single vote from the Democratic Party. Now, the defeat in the Alabama Senate by-election has sounded a wake-up call to the Republican Party. The results of the 2018 midterm elections are still difficult to predict; the election will also be affected by the Russia investigation and the results of the Trump administration in the next year. But what can be predicted is that once the Republican Party no longer controls both houses of Congress, Trump will be more constrained in his administration.

4f3ab321d8e69ba12e104c7fd3e12547cf094807.sourceText: ”特朗普元年”即将过去，总统本人对自己的执政能力评价是”仅次于林肯”，但民调支持率下降也是客观存在的事实。他在一些领域有所推进和斩获，但也还有不少竞选承诺前景茫然，但一个最大的变化是确定的了：这就是整个美国社会与政治走向，对内对外政策都发生了”变轨”，也就是由自由主义向保守主义，从全球优先到美国优先的重大转化。可以预见，在未来，还有更激烈的大戏即将拉开帷幕。
4f3ab321d8e69ba12e104c7fd3e12547cf094807.translatedText: "The First Year of Trump" is about to pass. The president himself evaluates his ability to govern as "second only to Lincoln", but the decline in poll support is also an objective fact. He has made progress and made achievements in some areas, but there are still many campaign promises with uncertain prospects. But one of the biggest changes is certain: this is the overall social and political trend of the United States, and the "change" in domestic and foreign policies, that is, a major transformation from liberalism to conservatism, and from global priority to America first. It is foreseeable that in the future, there will be more intense dramas about to begin.

96767f0ba3e7ff6ba5aa954bb048257d3848171d.sourceText: 梦，是人们对未来美好前景的期许。 最近，中国共產党新选出的领 导人习近平在参观了中国国家博物舘的”復兴之路”的展览后指出，实现中华民族伟大復兴的梦想一定能实现！于是中国梦成了人们议论的热衷话题，引起了社会的极大兴趣和反响。我正好在北京，于是顶着懔烈的寒风，也赶去参观了”复兴之路”。这里展出了中国従辛亥革命至今近百年的历史啚片，展示了中国人民為推翻封建王朝，抵御外国入侵，争取独立民主自由的国家，為实现中国工业化和现代化所作的努力。也展示了中共十八提出的目标：在夲世纪的头二十年，也就是还有八年，大约还有三千天的时间，中国要实现全面䢖成小康社会，人均收入比现在再翻一番；在夲世纪笫五十年，使中国建成為富强民主自由和谐的社会主义强国。目标十分具体，每一个中国人都為之欢欣鼓舞。 中国梦的热议使我想到了美国梦。 美国梦起源于英国对美国殖民时期，发展于十九世纪。当时欧洲的青年人把去美国开创新的亊业并取得了成功称之為美国梦，是一种相信每个人通过不懈的努力奋斗便能在美国这块土地上获得更好的生话的信仰。两百多年来，美国梦一直激励着世界各地青年来到这里创造自己的价值，美国成为全球成功人士的摇篮。美国工业化的进程中，出现了许多靠奋斗起家的工商业巨子。因发明起家的通用电气的爱迪生，贫穷人家出身的石油巨子洛克菲勒，发明汽车生產綫的福特，银行家摩根。在信息时代又涌现出苹果之父乔布斯，微软的比尔.盖兹，雅虎的杨致逺等。他们的成功都是靠自己的聪明才智和勤奋，而不是靠权力和老子。两百多年来，许多中国人也来到这里寻求自己的美国梦。有的参加了淘金梦，有的成功了科学家之梦，有的实现了政治家之梦，成為美国政界的重要成员。当然，也有大量的人做成了小康之梦，即一幢洋房一辆汽车温馨家庭之梦，中產阶级之梦。一些老年人到美国寻求一个宁静安定的生活，享受淸新空气和阳光的健康长寿之梦。人们不禁想到是什么促成美国梦容易成功？我想重要的是美国创造了一个人们做梦的好环境。美国従䢖国开始，就移植了欧洲的进歩思想，把民主自由平等的理想写进了独立宣言和美国宪法，自由平等成为现实制度和生活方式。机会均等，权利平等溶入美国社会的各个领域，人们拥有充分的经济、生活上的自由。 中国梦和美国梦有着许多极大的夲质上的差异。美国梦是个人之梦，是以个人主义為理想和目标的梦。千千万万的个人成功之梦成就了一个强大而富有的国家。而中国梦则是一个国家之梦，一个强国之梦，中国人，包括我们这些华侨為了这个目标曾经為之奋斗了近百年。人们坚信只有强国，人民才能富足。况且中国要实现的是社会主义现代化强国，社会主义是提倡人民共同富有，只是在初级阶段允许一部份人先富起来。两国文化和制度上以及人口的差异也使实现梦想之路有着不同的轨跡，中国梦不可能重走美国梦的老路，何况美国梦己进入了某种困境，正在寻求新的突破。中国梦应该借鑑美国梦的自由平等思想，发展中国特色，用好中国人特有的持续了百年的爱国强国的愿望，為人们做梦创造出更好的环境。行百里者半九十，中国梦前进的道路上荆棘丛生，有的根深蒂固。人们对习近平和李克强等新一代领导寄以期望。第一步的亲民和轻车从简，从严治军的十条禁令受到大家欢迎，改革和反贪的方向符合民众心愿，您们的经历使我相信你们是站在人民这一边的。祝愿”中国梦”顺利实现，一个没有霸权的和世界人民友好相处的中华民族将重新奋起。 梦，是没有止境的。只要地球继续转动，世界末日尚未来临，人们将继续编织更多美丽的梦。不久的未来，人类将共同携手，创建一个美丽的宇宙之梦—-”䦕发星际之梦”。
96767f0ba3e7ff6ba5aa954bb048257d3848171d.translatedText: Dreams are people’s expectations for a bright future. Recently, Xi Jinping, the newly elected leader of the Communist Party of China, pointed out after visiting the "Road to Rejuvenation" exhibition at the National Museum of China that the dream of realizing the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation will surely come true! As a result, the Chinese Dream has become a hot topic of discussion, arousing great interest and response from society. I happened to be in Beijing, so I rushed to visit the "Road to Renaissance" despite the strong cold wind. On display here are historical films dating from the Revolution of 1911 to the present day, showing the Chinese people's efforts to overthrow the feudal dynasty, resist foreign invasion, strive for an independent, democratic and free country, and realize China's industrialization and modernization. It also shows the goals proposed by the Communist Party of China in the 18th century: In the first twenty years of the new century, that is, there are still eight years, and about 3,000 days left, China will build a moderately prosperous society in all respects, with per capita income doubling what it is now; in the fiftieth year of the new century, China will build a prosperous, strong, democratic, free, and harmonious socialist country. The goal is very specific, and every Chinese is excited about it. The buzz about the Chinese Dream reminds me of the American Dream. The American Dream originated during the British colonial period in the United States and developed in the 19th century. At that time, young people in Europe called going to the United States to start a new business and achieve success the American Dream. It was a belief that everyone could obtain a better life in the United States through unremitting efforts. For more than two hundred years, the American Dream has been inspiring young people from all over the world to come here to create their own value, and the United States has become the cradle of successful people around the world. In the process of industrialization in the United States, many industrial and commercial giants emerged who started their careers through hard work. Edison, who started his career with the invention of General Electric, Rockefeller, the oil giant who came from a poor family, Ford, who invented the automobile production line, and banker Morgan. In the information age, Apple's father Steve Jobs, Microsoft's Bill Gates, Yahoo's Jerry Yang, etc. emerged. Their success relies on their own intelligence and diligence, not on power and Lao Tzu. For more than two hundred years, many Chinese have also come here to seek their American dream. Some participated in the gold rush dream, some succeeded in becoming scientists, and some realized the dream of politicians and became important members of American politics. Of course, there are also a large number of people who have realized the dream of being well-off, that is, the dream of a house, a car, a warm family, and the dream of the middle class. Some elderly people come to the United States in search of a quiet and stable life, the dream of enjoying a long and healthy life with fresh air and sunshine. People can't help but think about what makes the American dream easy to succeed? I think the important thing is that America has created a good environment for people to dream. Since its founding, the United States has transplanted European progressive ideas and written the ideals of democracy, freedom and equality into the Declaration of Independence and the U.S. Constitution, making freedom and equality a realistic system and way of life. Equality of opportunity and equal rights are integrated into all areas of American society, and people have full economic and life freedom. There are many great qualitative differences between the Chinese Dream and the American Dream. The American Dream is a personal dream, a dream with individualism as its ideal and goal. Thousands of individual dreams of success have created a strong and wealthy country. The Chinese Dream is the dream of a country, a dream of a powerful country. Chinese people, including us overseas Chinese, have been fighting for this goal for nearly a hundred years. People firmly believe that only when the country is strong can the people be prosperous. Moreover, what China wants to achieve is a modern and powerful socialist country. Socialism advocates the common prosperity of the people, but only allows some people to get rich first in the primary stage. The differences in culture, system and population between the two countries also make the road to realizing the dream have different trajectories. The Chinese dream cannot follow the old path of the American dream, not to mention that the American dream has entered a certain dilemma and is seeking new breakthroughs. The Chinese Dream should learn from the American Dream's ideas of freedom and equality, develop Chinese characteristics, and make good use of the Chinese people's unique patriotic desire to strengthen the country that has lasted for hundreds of years to create a better environment for people to dream. A journey of a hundred miles takes half a mile. The path forward for the Chinese Dream is full of thorns, some of which are deep-rooted. People have high expectations for the new generation of leaders such as Xi Jinping and Li Keqiang. The first step of being closer to the people and simpler, and the ten prohibitions on stricter military management are welcomed by everyone. The direction of reform and anti-corruption is in line with the people's wishes. Your experience makes me believe that you are on the side of the people. I wish the "Chinese Dream" can be realized smoothly, and a Chinese nation without hegemony that can live in harmony with the people of the world will rise again. Dreams have no end. As long as the earth continues to rotate and the end of the world has not yet come, people will continue to weave more beautiful dreams. In the near future, human beings will work together to create a beautiful dream of the universe - "Yifa Interstellar Dream".

40451a947d06ff1e19e691bb571697a04539560c.translatedText: Local high ozone alert for two consecutive days (Alberta Times) Environmental regulators issued high-concentration ozone alerts in the Phoenix area for two consecutive days this week due to scorching hot weather and little wind...

1534bdd85f6c11ea56466132a2b9e3c50f8936e0.sourceText: 因天气灼热和少风，环境监管机构本周连续两天在凤凰城地区发出高浓度臭氧警报。 马里科巴郡空气质量检测官员说，预计本周天气继续炎热无风，凤凰城地区温度保持在华氏100度以上，容易造成臭氧大面积聚集而又散不出去的后果。 专家说，臭氧是一种无形气体，由太阳加热辐射加上其他空气污染聚集而成。 臭氧浓度高可以刺激肺部，导致哮喘病疾病加剧。
1534bdd85f6c11ea56466132a2b9e3c50f8936e0.translatedText: Due to scorching hot weather and little wind, environmental regulators issued high-concentration ozone alerts for two consecutive days in the Phoenix area this week. Maricopa County air quality monitoring officials said the weather is expected to continue to be hot and windless this week, and the temperature in the Phoenix area will remain above 100 degrees Fahrenheit, which will easily cause ozone to accumulate in a large area and not be able to dissipate. Experts say ozone is an invisible gas formed by the accumulation of heating radiation from the sun and other air pollution. High ozone concentrations can irritate the lungs and worsen asthma attacks.

0c4ec739bb45408f7a0ffa2413d465b6baff2673.sourceText: 去年八月，我们大家自发的走向街头， 轰轰烈烈地向社会各界表达了保护凤凰城中国文化中心的决心。
0c4ec739bb45408f7a0ffa2413d465b6baff2673.translatedText: Last August, we all took to the streets spontaneously and vigorously expressed our determination to protect the Phoenix Chinese Cultural Center to all walks of life.

d2492af31a90b9fca805661339eabedd8c2ea836.sourceText: 近一年了，凤凰城各界人士经过艰苦卓绝的不懈努力， 学习运用法律手段来维护和争取华人在文化中心的权益。 随着时间的推移， 真北公司将越来越不得不认真考虑我们提出双赢的解决方式。 胜利的曙光已经不远了。
d2492af31a90b9fca805661339eabedd8c2ea836.translatedText: In the past year, people from all walks of life in Phoenix City have made unremitting efforts and learned to use legal means to protect and fight for the rights and interests of Chinese people in the cultural center. As time goes on, True North will increasingly have to seriously consider the win-win solutions we propose. The dawn of victory is not far away.

6de28caa6bb0e914a2083d9a9335d27fd7263e57.sourceText: 为了纪念我们一年来的抗争， 为了让各界人士更好的了解维权的进展， 我们定于8月19日下午2点， 在老四川餐馆举办一埸保护中国城一周年的纪念活动， 回顾我们走过的路， 现况介紹，以及联谊聚餐等。敬请各位朋友光临， 畅所欲言并支持老四川，有如下几点希望：
6de28caa6bb0e914a2083d9a9335d27fd7263e57.translatedText: In order to commemorate our one-year struggle and to allow people from all walks of life to better understand the progress of rights protection, we are scheduled to hold a commemorative event to commemorate the first anniversary of protecting Chinatown at 2 pm on August 19th at the Old Sichuan Restaurant. We will review the road we have traveled, introduce the current situation, and have a social dinner. All friends are welcome to come, speak freely and support old Sichuan. I have the following hopes:

0dee902b904cd42a4298ac45186a04b9d51f855b.sourceText: 1。如果有保护文化中心的T Shirt 请尽量穿上。
0dee902b904cd42a4298ac45186a04b9d51f855b.translatedText: 1. If you have a protective cultural center T-shirt, please try to wear it.

8d4192b3161345843d26926b458835d08bb2a1c7.sourceText: 2。除非征得同意，在个人发言时请勿录视频录音。
8d4192b3161345843d26926b458835d08bb2a1c7.translatedText: 2. Do not make video recordings of personal statements unless you have permission.

0e681deebe7f410edd85803034e9b1a3d2229c7e.sourceText: 3。欢迎捐款给Citizen Voice用于支持老四川。
0e681deebe7f410edd85803034e9b1a3d2229c7e.translatedText: 3. Welcome to donate to Citizen Voice to support old Sichuan.

76116271493e9786ac28e993a68bbf430377571c.sourceText: 4。请来用午餐或晚餐以支持老四川维权。
76116271493e9786ac28e993a68bbf430377571c.translatedText: 4. Please come for lunch or dinner to support the rights protection of old Sichuan.

b53caabd506f66791e01a00b2c5cbb42eca7dad8.sourceText: 请记住8月19日下午两点，地点老四川，我们不见不散！
b53caabd506f66791e01a00b2c5cbb42eca7dad8.translatedText: Please remember that it will be at two o'clock in the afternoon on August 19th, in Sichuan, we will see you there!

dc7dde06bf1160c5a2d2109d28444f6052a960a0.sourceText: 经济回升 美国10城市拥房率大涨
dc7dde06bf1160c5a2d2109d28444f6052a960a0.translatedText: The economy is picking up, and the home ownership rate in 10 U.S. cities has soared

383c70dd0b1b0a40b70c77c430b0a839a9951e53.sourceText: 经济回升 美国10城市拥房率大涨 在当前学贷债务创历史新高、积攒首付面临挑战及许多地区房价暴涨之际，很多美…
383c70dd0b1b0a40b70c77c430b0a839a9951e53.translatedText: The economy is picking up, and the home ownership rate in 10 U.S. cities has soared At a time when student loan debt is at an all-time high, saving for a down payment is a challenge, and housing prices are skyrocketing in many areas, many Americans...

642eda305c92c2a6f41c56652c33212298fed852.sourceText: 在当前学贷债务创历史新高、积攒首付面临挑战及许多地区房价暴涨之际，很多美国人，特别是年轻人，连拥有自己住房的想法都不敢有。不过，最新报告显示，近期10个城市的拥房率大幅增长，或许可以成为许多渴望拥有自己住房者的新选择。
642eda305c92c2a6f41c56652c33212298fed852.translatedText: At a time when student loan debt is at an all-time high, saving for a down payment is a challenge, and housing prices are skyrocketing in many areas, many Americans, especially young people, don’t even dare to think about owning their own homes. However, the latest report shows that the home ownership rate in 10 cities has increased significantly recently, which may become a new choice for many people who desire to own their own homes.

8df3db2329062fc0f0416f3ea693f8a7104ed6ad.sourceText: 据《今日美国》报导，美国人口调查局去年10月份公布的报告显示，截至2017年第三个季度，约63.9%的美国人拥有自己的住房。而对于35岁以下的人来说，这一数字比较惨淡，只有35.6%。美国人的拥房率顶峰是在2004年，达69.2%，此后一直在下降。而Realtor.com的最新报告显示，美国至少有10个城市拥房率大幅增长。
8df3db2329062fc0f0416f3ea693f8a7104ed6ad.translatedText: According to USA Today, a report released by the U.S. Census Bureau in October last year showed that as of the third quarter of 2017, about 63.9% of Americans owned their own homes. For people under 35, the figure is bleak, at only 35.6%. The American homeownership rate peaked in 2004 at 69.2% and has been declining since then. The latest report from Realtor.com shows that at least 10 cities in the United States have experienced significant growth in home ownership rates.

1ede58eb140b2dabc70316f17e022128d43ee9a4.sourceText: 该网站的数据团队发现，在”铁銹地带”（密歇根州、威斯康辛州、印第安纳州）以及主要大城市外围的一些小城市和一些繁华的南部中心地带，居民拥房率在增长。Realtor.com的特拉帕索（Clare Trapasso）表示，有趣的是这些地方大部分都相对便宜，名单上超过半数的城市房价中位数低于全国水平。目前美国平均房价中位数为274,492美元。如果打算2018年买房，请记住这些城市。
1ede58eb140b2dabc70316f17e022128d43ee9a4.translatedText: The website's data team found that homeownership is growing in the Rust Belt (Michigan, Wisconsin, Indiana), as well as in some smaller cities on the outskirts of major cities and in some bustling southern heartlands. Clare Trapasso of Realtor.com said what's interesting is that most of these places are relatively affordable, with more than half of the cities on the list having median home prices lower than the national rate. The current median average home price in the United States is $274,492. If you plan to buy a house in 2018, keep these cities in mind.

c431aaf0c4e7dad9cc4f62416d2af31e1d1cfe61.sourceText: 威斯康辛州的密尔沃基以酿酒业闻名，经历了数十年的经济挑战后现在开始复苏。目前全市 房屋 拥有率为68.7%，比过去三年增加了11%。房价中位数是224,950美元。
c431aaf0c4e7dad9cc4f62416d2af31e1d1cfe61.translatedText: Milwaukee, Wisconsin, known for its brewing industry, is recovering after decades of economic challenges. The current city-wide home ownership rate is 68.7%, an increase of 11% over the past three years. The median home price is $224,950.

1d109f48b9ea2e066274683392e3084e8a1ad209.sourceText: 作为南部繁荣的金融中心，北卡罗莱纳州夏洛特的房屋拥有率在过去三年增长了10.5%，目前为62.8%。这里的房价中位数是327,050美元，远高于全国平均水平。
1d109f48b9ea2e066274683392e3084e8a1ad209.translatedText: As the booming financial center of the South, the homeownership rate in Charlotte, North Carolina, has grown 10.5% over the past three years and currently stands at 62.8%. The median home price here is $327,050, well above the national average.

f8ebccdaa1a8c46de68f32f53b530071c863aa57.sourceText: 田纳西州的孟菲斯是因猫王而闻名的城市，当地中位房价为195,050美元。过去三年房屋拥有率增长了约9.3%，目前为61%。
f8ebccdaa1a8c46de68f32f53b530071c863aa57.translatedText: Memphis, Tennessee is a city famous for Elvis Presley. The local median house price is $195,050. The homeownership rate has increased by about 9.3% over the past three years and currently stands at 61%.

95aaf0e20a7158da9c5d0260fdd7a36ace130190.sourceText: 因华盛顿特区房价过高，买家发现附近的巴尔的摩是个可支付得起的城市，房屋所有率高达68.4%，过去三年增长了7.3%。房屋中间价徘徊在30万美元左右（比华盛顿特区低30.2%）。
95aaf0e20a7158da9c5d0260fdd7a36ace130190.translatedText: Due to the high housing prices in Washington, DC, buyers have found nearby Baltimore to be an affordable city, with the home ownership rate as high as 68.4%, an increase of 7.3% in the past three years. The median home price hovers around $300,000 (30.2% lower than in Washington, D.C.).

eedf672eb71c8b88a87628ab10cd647f7b8453ac.sourceText: 歌 手比利.乔尔（Billy Joel）以他关于该市经济困难的歌曲使位于宾夕法尼亚州的阿伦敦名声大噪。进入2017年，这个离纽约市和费城不远的城市正经历重生，这在很大程度上归功于亚马逊、沃尔玛和雀巢等公司的入驻。当地房屋所有率最近几年增加了7.3%，至惊人的74.8%，远高于全国平均水平。中位房价约225,000美元。
eedf672eb71c8b88a87628ab10cd647f7b8453ac.translatedText: Singer Billy Joel made Allentown, Pennsylvania, famous with his songs about the city's economic difficulties. Entering 2017, the city, not far from New York City and Philadelphia, is experiencing a rebirth, thanks in large part to the arrival of companies like Amazon, Walmart, and Nestlé. The local homeownership rate has increased by 7.3% in recent years to an astonishing 74.8%, well above the national average. The median home price is approximately $225,000.

fc0e9f055265a5bf72c602124eb4176fd5a488c5.sourceText: 根据Realtor.com的统计，位于宾夕法尼亚州西南部的匹兹堡正在成为硅谷的东海岸版本（除了天价房价）。当地的大学毕业生被谷歌（Google）、优步（Uber）和英特尔（Intel）等技术公司争相抢走，这些公司在当地都设有研发中心。自2014年以来，当地房屋所有率增长了7.2%，达74%，令人吃惊的是，其房价中位数远低于全国平均水平，仅为174,950美元。
fc0e9f055265a5bf72c602124eb4176fd5a488c5.translatedText: According to statistics from Realtor.com, Pittsburgh, located in southwestern Pennsylvania, is becoming the East Coast version of Silicon Valley (except for sky-high housing prices). Local college graduates are being snapped up by technology companies such as Google, Uber and Intel, which all have local R&D centers. The local homeownership rate has increased 7.2% since 2014, to 74%, and surprisingly, its median home price is well below the national average at just $174,950.

15698582f5e6bceeaf47452888327da8b31f3b61.sourceText: 位于新墨西哥州的阿尔伯克基气候温和，拥有负担得起的住房和历史悠久的老城区。该市近年来房屋所有率上涨了5.7%，达66%。房价中间值约为239,950美元。
15698582f5e6bceeaf47452888327da8b31f3b61.translatedText: Albuquerque, New Mexico, has a temperate climate, affordable housing, and a historic Old Town. The city's homeownership rate has increased by 5.7% in recent years to 66%. The median home price is approximately $239,950.

084f47625022d935a8fe5c2df61752a6c626e777.sourceText: 位于田纳西州的纳什维尔，是具有传奇色彩的音乐之城，也成为南方的美食热点城市之一。当地房价自2012年以来上涨了89%。尽管如此，纳什维尔仍然是一个房价相对便宜的地方，房屋拥有率继续保持上涨势头。房屋平均价格为359,050美元，房屋拥有率达68.8%，过去三年增加了4.9%。
084f47625022d935a8fe5c2df61752a6c626e777.translatedText: Located in Nashville, Tennessee, it is a legendary music city and has become one of the food hotspots in the South. Local house prices have increased by 89% since 2012. Still, Nashville remains a relatively affordable place, and homeownership rates continue to rise. The average home price is $359,050, and the homeownership rate is 68.8%, an increase of 4.9% over the past three years.

7a9af7f80c8bf60523a44676ce65aebcd92e35dd.sourceText: 德克萨斯州长期以来一直是美国住房可负担得起的地方之一（没有州所得税），这种可负担性吸引了很多大企业。在达拉斯，很多公司搬入这一地区并扩张，进而导致价格上涨。目前该市房价中位数为339,950美元，房屋所有率为60.7%，比过去三年增长了4.8%。
7a9af7f80c8bf60523a44676ce65aebcd92e35dd.translatedText: Texas has long been one of the most affordable places to live in the United States (with no state income tax), and this affordability has attracted many big businesses. In Dallas, many companies are moving into the area and expanding, causing prices to rise. The current median home price in the city is $339,950, and the homeownership rate is 60.7%, an increase of 4.8% over the past three years.

094143831ca5e640049211ec88a0a9ad95e23739.sourceText: 纽约州雪城的房价中位数是149,950美元，有些独立房价格甚至在8万美元至10万美元之间。房屋所有率是66.5%，自2014年以来上涨了4.6%。
094143831ca5e640049211ec88a0a9ad95e23739.translatedText: The median house price in Syracuse, New York is $149,950, with some houses priced between $80,000 and $100,000. The homeownership rate is 66.5%, up 4.6% since 2014.

b827432a3e4e95a3ef19a7a461dba779edc0a20a.sourceText: 蛇年即尽，马年将至。对于久居海外的华人，过春节的气氛是无法和国内相比的。我们过年没有长假，没有千家万户的爆竹声声，也无法和所有的亲人团团圆圆。我们能做到的就是大家欢聚一堂，共同庆祝我们自己的传统节日—-春节。 ”看春晚”是中国人过春节最重要的活动之一。 新东方艺术学校多年来一直承担着打造亚省春晚的重任。目前，新东方艺术学校联手孔子学院等多家单位共同努力，为大家献上马年春节的文化大餐棗亚省马年春节晚会。 本次晚会是一台集舞蹈，器乐，声乐，武术等综合文艺晚会。所有的舞蹈节目，由新东方艺术学校的师生精心打造。经过数月的编排，演员刻苦训练，老师们加班加点，呈现给观众的一定是最好，最精彩的。 舞蹈节目中有专门为春节晚会准备的，由徐爱妮女士赞助并邀请的香港著名舞蹈家帕莎吾曼尔老师亲自指导的《新疆顶碗舞》。帕莎老师曾经任中国东方歌舞团独舞演员，有多年的演出和教学经验，相信这次学生们得到的真传，能给大家带来艺术上的享受和春节的快乐。 此场晚会您还会欣赏到由亚省中华乐团带给您的声乐和器乐节目。目前，极具中国文化元素的民乐，京剧等节目，正由蔡善皋老师率领演员们进入了最后的冲刺排练，请您拭目以待。 亚利桑那少林文化中心的延倾师傅，为使观众看到真正的少林功夫，特地邀请了来自少林寺的师兄弟加盟表演。延倾师傅精心挑选和训练的学生们也在为春晚的表演跃跃欲试了。 还有令您惊喜的，著名小提琴演奏家曾晶的加盟。来自凤凰城交响乐团的第一小提琴师曾晶，曾与马友友，郎朗，李云迪等世界知名演奏家合作，上演多场音乐会。作为一名出色的小提琴演奏家，她在凤凰城的华人社区中极负盛名。马年的春晚舞台上，曾晶将一展风采。 圣诞节与新年即将来临，华人朋友要给身边的朋友送什么礼物呢？送上几张春晚门票，应该是个特别的选择。既可以让亲人们过一个中国年，也可以让身边的美国朋友感受到我们中华民族的文化魅力。 如今春晚门票已经开始热卖，晚会入场券对号入座，心动不如行动，快快购票。并请大家告诉大家: 晚会时间： 2014年1月19日（星期日）下午4:00点 January 19 (Sunday), 2014, 4:00pm 晚会地点： Chandler Center for the Arts 售票热线： 602-490-8613 售票地点： 新东方艺术学校 1100 N Alma School Rd #18,Chandler AZ 85224 (蓝天餐馆北侧) Chandler Center for the Arts 250 N. Arizona Ave. Chandler, AZ 85225
b827432a3e4e95a3ef19a7a461dba779edc0a20a.translatedText: The Year of the Snake is coming to an end and the Year of the Horse is approaching. For Chinese people who have lived overseas for a long time, the atmosphere during the Spring Festival cannot be compared with that at home. We don’t have a long holiday during the New Year, there’s no sound of firecrackers in thousands of households, and we can’t reunite with all our relatives. What we can do is to get together and celebrate our own traditional festival - the Spring Festival. "Watching the Spring Festival Gala" is one of the most important activities for Chinese people to celebrate the Spring Festival. New Oriental Art School has been shouldering the important task of creating the Alberta Spring Festival Gala for many years. Currently, New Oriental Art School is working together with the Confucius Institute and many other units to present a cultural feast for the Spring Festival of the Year of the Horse to the Yaya Province Year of the Horse Spring Festival Gala. This party is a comprehensive art party integrating dance, instrumental music, vocal music, martial arts, etc. All dance programs are carefully created by teachers and students of New Oriental Art School. After months of choreography, the actors trained hard, and the teachers worked overtime, what is presented to the audience must be the best and most exciting. Among the dance programs, there is the "Xinjiang Bowl Dance" specially prepared for the Spring Festival Gala, sponsored and invited by Ms. Xu Aini and directed by the famous Hong Kong dancer Pasha Wumaner. Teacher Pasha used to be a solo dancer in the China Oriental Song and Dance Troupe and has many years of performance and teaching experience. I believe that the true teachings received by the students this time can bring artistic enjoyment and Spring Festival happiness to everyone. At this party, you will also enjoy vocal and instrumental music programs brought to you by the Alberta Chinese Orchestra. Currently, the actors and actresses, such as folk music and Peking opera, which are full of Chinese cultural elements, are entering the final sprint rehearsals led by teacher Cai Shangao. Please wait and see. Master Yan Qing of the Arizona Shaolin Cultural Center, in order to let the audience see the real Shaolin Kung Fu, specially invited brothers from the Shaolin Temple to join in the performance. The students carefully selected and trained by Master Yanqing are also eager to perform in the Spring Festival Gala. What will also surprise you is the participation of the famous violinist Zeng Jing. Zeng Jing, the first violinist from the Phoenix Symphony Orchestra, has performed in many concerts with world-renowned performers such as Yo-Yo Ma, Lang Lang, and Yundi Li. As an excellent violinist, she is well-known among the Chinese community in Phoenix. Zeng Jing will show off her talents on the stage of the Spring Festival Gala in the Year of the Horse. Christmas and New Year are coming soon, what gifts should Chinese friends give to their friends? Giving away a few tickets to the Spring Festival Gala should be a special choice. Not only can your relatives celebrate a Chinese New Year, but you can also let your American friends around you feel the cultural charm of our Chinese nation. Tickets for the Spring Festival Gala are now on sale. Tickets for the gala are all reserved. It’s better to act than to buy your tickets quickly. And please tell everyone: Party time: January 19 (Sunday), 2014, 4:00pm Party location: Chandler Center for the Arts Ticket hotline: 602-490-8613 Ticket location: New Oriental Art School 1100 N Alma School Rd #18, Chandler AZ 85224 (North side of Blue Sky Restaurant) Chandler Center for the Arts 250 N. 72699eb9783129dae912e3cf172074f34c706034.sourceText: 山火使更多人撤离 干燥多风致山火扩散 （亚省时报） 受到大风和干燥气候的影响，皇冠镇一场山林大火周日令更多民众离开家园。消防队员与该州4场大火中最大一场的战斗已近结束。 近日在亚利桑那州、新墨西哥州和科罗拉多州发生的山林大火已迫使几个小镇的居民撤离家园，西南部超过65平方英里的森林、灌木丛和草地化为灰烬。 这是今年发生的首次大规模山林大火。2011年，本州曾遭遇空前的山火季，发生了近2000次火灾，过火面积超过1500平方英里。 消防队员最担心的是所谓的”角斗士大火”（Gladiator Fire），在周六大风暂停后，周日再次出现干燥多风气候，而且未来几天这种情况还将持续。 ”我们预计今天会出现更激烈的火势，（大火）的助燃剂就是干燥，而且情况危险，”消防部门女发言人菲德勒周日说，”可能会有更多人被疏散。” 因当地一处旧矿而得名的”角斗士大火”已毁坏了4处建筑，迫使Crown King（皇冠）镇大约350名居民在本周早些时候撤出其住宅。由于这场大火，另有3个偏远小社区的居民周五被疏散。 目前，这场被控制了10%的大火的过火面积已至少有20平方英里。 此外，四处着火点中最大的一处”向日葵大火”（Sunflower Fire）已快被扑灭，该处的各种救火资源正陆续调往他处，负责扑救该地大火机构女发言人海因斯说。
72699eb9783129dae912e3cf172074f34c706034.translatedText: Wildfires prompted more people to evacuate. Dry and windy wildfires caused wildfires to spread (Alberta Times). A bushfire in Crown Township forced more people to leave their homes on Sunday due to high winds and dry conditions. Firefighters are nearing the end of their battle with the largest of the state's four blazes. Recent wildfires in Arizona, New Mexico and Colorado have forced residents of several small towns to evacuate their homes and reduced more than 65 square miles of forests, shrubs and grasslands in the Southwest to ashes. This is the first large-scale forest fire this year. In 2011, the state experienced an unprecedented wildfire season, with nearly 2,000 fires burning over 1,500 square miles. Firefighters' biggest concern is the so-called Gladiator Fire, which will return to dry and windy weather on Sunday after a lull in winds on Saturday and will continue to do so in the coming days. "We are expecting more intense fires today, fueled by dryness and dangerous conditions," Fidler, a fire department spokeswoman, said Sunday. "More people may be evacuated." The Gladiator Fire, named after an old local mine, has destroyed four structures and forced about 350 residents of the town of Crown King to evacuate their homes earlier this week. Residents of three other small remote communities were evacuated on Friday because of the fire. Currently, the fire, which is 10% contained, has burned at least 20 square miles. In addition, the Sunflower Fire, the largest of the four fires, has almost been extinguished, and various firefighting resources there are being gradually transferred to other places, said Hines, a spokeswoman for the agency responsible for fighting the fire.

cdd44325d487364ec065c5fb0ae3cb811f6505a3.sourceText: 这位在去年曾正确预测加密货币涨势的分析师说，比特币之外，其他的加密数字货币也可能表现的更好。在2016年12月，彼得森曾预测比特币在2017年将达到2000美元。根据CoinDesk的数据，当时比特币的交易价格低于900美元，随后在2017年5月他的预测成为了现实。
cdd44325d487364ec065c5fb0ae3cb811f6505a3.translatedText: The analyst who correctly predicted the rise of cryptocurrencies last year said that besides Bitcoin, other cryptocurrencies may also perform better. In December 2016, Peterson predicted that Bitcoin would reach $2,000 in 2017. His prediction came true in May 2017, when Bitcoin was trading below $900, according to CoinDesk data.

8fe19bd8c4f6539f5d275c768e31abdb86244681.sourceText: 他在周二再次抛出了大胆的预测，认为在更多得机构投资者和期货合约交易的推动下，比特币2018年可能涨到5万美元至10万美元。数据显示，要达到10万美元的价格，比特币需要从周二13601.43美元的最高价格上涨635%。先前，彼得森曾表示，达到10万美元可能需要10年的时间。
8fe19bd8c4f6539f5d275c768e31abdb86244681.translatedText: He once again made a bold prediction on Tuesday, believing that Bitcoin may rise to US$50,000 to US$100,000 in 2018, driven by more institutional investors and futures contract trading. Data shows that to reach a price of $100,000, Bitcoin would need to rise 635% from Tuesday’s peak price of $13,601.43. Previously, Peterson said it could take 10 years to reach $100,000.

404d8ecc6f61bbdf9383a62501f488217b81ee85.sourceText: 然而，包括比特币、以太坊等在内的数字货币周二出现大幅抛售，因政府打压预期升温。其中，比特币价格一度下挫逾14%，至12000美元下方。据路透报道，韩国企划财政部长官称禁止加密货币交易仍是一项可能选择。此外，一位中国央行官员周二也表示，应该禁止数字货币的集中交易。

763556dfc21d11266e410bb52bd48e0450b3ee16.sourceText: (亚省时报 杨绮薇报道)那是一个阳光明媚的日子，在洛杉矶圣盖博市的外甥驾着他那辆新买的本田，带着我和先生来到慕名已久的洛杉矶湖人队主赛馆棗斯台普斯球馆(STAPLES Center)朝圣。 斯台普斯中心就在洛杉矶市中心，我们的车子离球馆老远就看到三幢大楼上并排竖着的湖人三位历史中锋张伯伦、贾巴尔和奥尼尔的巨幅画像。外甥说，这是苹果电脑公司在斯台普斯中心对面的费加罗大饭店三幢主楼上做的广告。三位中锋动作各异，奥尼尔的位置最高。这虽然是一个商业广告，却最直观地向人们宣扬了湖人最骄傲的中锋传统。 才20分钟的车程，我们就来到了斯台普斯中心球馆。这是NBA两支球队洛杉矶湖人队和洛杉矶快船队位于加利福尼亚州洛杉矶市的主场。球馆顶部悬挂着六面超大电视屏幕，不断播放比赛中每个精彩画面和历史上16次夺得总冠军、30次进入总决赛的光荣历史，还有对现役湖人球星的介绍。 球馆位于洛杉矶贯穿市中心的菲格罗阿大街旁，商业区内高大林立的写字楼，让斯台普斯显得格外另类；而面对南边的低矮楼房，极为现代化的斯台普斯又显得太过高调。总之，斯台普斯在洛杉矶市中心就像一个与周围环境格格不入的外来者，那么孤独，那么另类。 斯台普斯中心有个很不谦虚的定语–世界体育和娱乐中心。不过走进这个巨大的篮球馆，联想到在这里进行的篮球比赛，和好莱坞影星们经常在这里举行的演唱会等活动，这个头衔还不算太牵强。 斯台普斯中心是洛杉矶的一个象征性建筑，也是体育界的一块福地。1999年球馆正式投入使用，湖人队把主场从大西部论坛球馆搬到这里。令人称奇的是，此后竟湖人队竟然连续三个赛季夺得总冠军。此外，WNBA的洛杉矶火花队于2001年将主场搬到这里，随即在2001年和2002年连续两次夺得WNBA的总冠军。这块福地让湖人队的光辉历史添上了浓墨重彩的一页，湖人队从此开创了一个新的时代。 外甥说，正如米兰的圣西罗是足球迷梦中的伊甸园一样，斯台普斯是篮球朝圣者的必到之地。但是圣西罗球场下面，有一个综合AC米兰和国际米兰历史的博物馆，而斯台普斯球馆却没有任何湖人球队历史的博物馆，只有一个纪念品商店。”所有关于湖人的东西都能在那里找到。”外甥这样告诉我们。 我们发现，偌大的斯台普斯球馆几乎是一座空城。外甥说，除了比赛日之外，这里都是空空荡荡的。尽管过两天就有NBA大赛，但斯台普斯的售票窗口却只开了2个，而前来问津的球迷寥寥无几。外甥说，以前每到比赛日之前，这里都排着长队，现在大家要么买了季票，要么就干脆在网上买，到现场买票的人很少了。售票窗口内有一位黑皮肤的工作人员，他告诉我们，前来买票的都是外地人或外国人。 我们在外甥的引导下，慢慢徜徉，细细观赏，偶尔拍照留念。斯台普斯周围很安静，没有游人，没有喧哗，也不见原本随处可见的。 此行让我们有一点点遗憾，看不到俱乐部的历史，看不到狂热的球迷，甚至连在空地打篮球的人都看不到，斯台普斯与我们心中原来那座完美的篮球圣地形象相去甚远。
763556dfc21d11266e410bb52bd48e0450b3ee16.translatedText: (Alberta Times) Reported by Yang Qiwei) It was a sunny day. My nephew in San Gabriel, Los Angeles, drove his newly purchased Honda and took my husband and I on a pilgrimage to the long-famous Staples Center, the home stadium of the Los Angeles Lakers. The Staples Center is located in the center of Los Angeles. As we drove far away from the arena, we saw huge portraits of the three historical centers of the Lakers, Chamberlain, Kareem Abdul-Jabbar and O'Neal, standing side by side on three buildings. The nephew said that this was an advertisement for Apple Computer on the three main buildings of the Le Figaro Hotel opposite the Staples Center. The three centers have different movements, with O'Neal in the highest position. Although this is a commercial, it most intuitively promotes the Lakers' most proud center tradition to people. After only a 20-minute drive, we arrived at the Staples Center Arena. This is the home stadium of two NBA teams, the Los Angeles Lakers and the Los Angeles Clippers, located in Los Angeles, California. Six large TV screens hang on the top of the arena, constantly showing every highlight of the game and the glorious history of winning the championship 16 times and entering the finals 30 times, as well as introducing the current Lakers stars. The arena is located next to Figueroa Street, which runs through the city center of Los Angeles. The tall office buildings in the business district make Staples look particularly unusual. Facing the low-rise buildings to the south, the extremely modern Staples seems too high-profile. In short, Staples was like an outsider who was incompatible with his surroundings in downtown Los Angeles, so lonely and different. Staples Center has a very immodest attributive – World Sports and Entertainment Center. However, when you walk into this huge basketball stadium and think of the basketball games played here and the concerts and other activities that Hollywood movie stars often hold here, this title is not too far-fetched. Staples Center is a symbolic building in Los Angeles and a blessed place in the sports world. In 1999, the arena was officially put into use, and the Lakers moved their home court here from the Great Western Forum Arena. What is amazing is that the Lakers actually won the championship for three consecutive seasons. In addition, the WNBA's Los Angeles Sparks moved their home court here in 2001, and then won two consecutive WNBA championships in 2001 and 2002. This blessed land added a colorful page to the glorious history of the Lakers, and the Lakers created a new era. The nephew said that just as Milan's San Siro is the Garden of Eden in football fans' dreams, Staples is a must-see for basketball pilgrims. But underneath the San Siro Stadium, there is a museum that combines the history of AC Milan and Inter Milan, while the Staples Center does not have any museum with the history of the Lakers team, only a souvenir shop. "Everything about the Lakers can be found there." My nephew told us. We found that the huge Staples Center was almost a ghost town. The nephew said the place was empty except on game days. Although there will be an NBA game in two days, only two ticket windows at Staples are open, and very few fans come to inquire. My nephew said that there used to be long queues here before every game day, but now everyone either bought season tickets or simply bought them online, and very few people came to buy tickets on site. There was a dark-skinned staff member at the ticket window. He told us that the people who came to buy tickets were all outsiders or foreigners. Under the guidance of my nephew, we wandered slowly, watched carefully, and occasionally took photos. It's quiet around Staples, with no tourists, no noise, and none of the usual sights that can be seen everywhere. This trip made us a little regretful. We couldn't see the history of the club, we couldn't see the fanatical fans, and we couldn't even see people playing basketball in the open space. Staples is far from the perfect basketball holy land in our minds.

c333fe395d9ed2c6f9cec88e9cd23eb621d66965.sourceText: 较健康的孩子可能成绩更好 心肺健康或决定分数 一项新的研究发现，美国的初中生中的那些身体健康的人更可能会在阅读和数学能力的标准化测试中获得更高的分数。 据HealthDay News报道，该研究的发现显示，学生的平均分数的上升与健康水平的提高之间具有相关性。 该研究的主要作者佩特里是北德克萨斯大学丹顿分校运动心理学中心的负责人。他说，孩子们的身体越健康，他们的分数也越高。 佩特里说，家长们应该鼓励他们的孩子更积极地运动。身体的健康可带来某些现实的认知和学术上的好处。 该研究的结果会在周五的美国心理学协会的年度大会上报告。该大会在佛罗里达州的奥兰多举行。 这项研究包括了超过1200名的初中生，他们来自德克萨斯州郊区地带的5所学校，其中男孩561人，女孩650人。这些孩子大约57%为白人，有近四分之一的人为西裔，有9%为黑人，约2%为亚裔。 学区给研究人员提供了有关孩子的族裔、年龄、年级及他们是否合格加入免费学校午餐计划的相关资讯。后者是该孩子家庭社会经济状态的一个指标。各个学校还提供研究者这些孩子的考试分数。 对孩子的健康测试是他们在上体育课期间进行的以确定他们的心肺健康指标以及他们的身体质量指数（BMI）。BMI是一个人有多少身体脂肪的指标。这些孩子还需要填写问卷以帮助研究人员确定孩子的自尊心和社会支持等因素。 结果发现，男孩和女孩如果有着较高的心肺健康水平，预计他们在数学和阅读测验中也会有较好的分数。
c333fe395d9ed2c6f9cec88e9cd23eb621d66965.translatedText: Healthier kids may get better grades. A new study finds that among U.S. middle school students, those who are physically fit are more likely to score higher on standardized tests of reading and math ability. According to HealthDay News, the study's findings showed a correlation between rising student average scores and improved health. Petry, the study's lead author, is director of the Center for Sport Psychology at the University of North Texas in Denton. He said the fitter the children were, the higher their scores were. Petry said parents should encourage their children to be more active. Physical fitness can bring certain real-life cognitive and academic benefits. The study's results will be reported Friday at the American Psychological Association's annual convention. The conference is held in Orlando, Florida. The study included more than 1,200 middle school students, 561 boys and 650 girls, from five suburban schools in Texas. About 57% of these children are white, nearly a quarter are Hispanic, 9% are black, and about 2% are Asian. School districts provided researchers with information about children's race, age, grade level and whether they were eligible for the free school lunch program. The latter is an indicator of the socioeconomic status of the child's family. Each school also provided the researchers with the test scores of the children. Children's fitness tests are conducted during their physical education classes to determine their cardiorespiratory fitness indicators as well as their body mass index (BMI). BMI is an indicator of how much body fat a person has. The children were also asked to fill out questionnaires to help researchers determine factors such as the children's self-esteem and social support. The results found that boys and girls with higher levels of cardiorespiratory fitness were predicted to score better on math and reading tests.

357bd79c48b89f8c8fe34574df2ad445923472a2.sourceText: 红豆词出现在红楼梦第二十八回，是宝玉应冯紫英之邀，在一个熟人斗酒聚会上的弹唱的酒令。因其词义委婉多情，立即为后世无数爱着和准备爱的男女所倾倒，大有盖压唐朝王维红豆诗的风头。
357bd79c48b89f8c8fe34574df2ad445923472a2.translatedText: The poem "red beans" appears in the 28th chapter of Dream of Red Mansions. It is Baoyu's invitation to play and sing at an acquaintances' drinking party at a drinking party. Because of its euphemistic and sentimental meaning, it immediately attracted countless men and women who loved and were ready to love in later generations, and it greatly overshadowed the popularity of Hongdou's poems by Wang Wei of the Tang Dynasty.

fc89aaf84ca01dd9a79b86508f53dc2ec11de96d.sourceText: 自然，这词如果当着黛玉之面吟出，或者给大院里的任何一个姐妹，笔者只剩下羡慕和妒忌的分了。宝玉本是多情王，向姐妹献殷勤是里手，感觉来了，来个千古名篇不足为怪。但细细看了一下所谓的斗酒会，也就四五人而已，与宝玉以往的姑娘圈好像很不一样，鱼龙混杂得很。
fc89aaf84ca01dd9a79b86508f53dc2ec11de96d.translatedText: Naturally, if this word was recited in front of Daiyu, or given to any sister in the compound, the author would only be filled with envy and jealousy. be4f55708b624c6533b231eb0f860ba23aeb2396.sourceText: 先看发起人。冯紫英用现时的说法就是”官二代”，其父是当代神武将军冯唐。特殊的地位决定了他天文地理无所不通，三教九流皆为朋友，能拍胸脯帮人干事，也敢打架弄得自己鼻青脸肿，是那种”赶明我给习总说说，拨拉一个师归你管”的高人。

fad043289c00b38a86dbb5ff258fbc510e31cccc.translatedText: Look what kind of people he has brought to the drinking party. Ping'er, the first singer at the drinking party, was a prostitute. I don’t know what kind of ceremony the belt exchange was at the time, but Xiren later discovered that the belt given to Baoyu had been exchanged for that "bastard" and said, "I knew you were doing these things again." 0f9df261f272b6911c841f7a4ffe16958939c461.sourceText: 罗嗦了半天，看官可能明白了，宝玉著名的红豆词就是在这样一个环境里，对牛弹琴弹唱出来的！
0f9df261f272b6911c841f7a4ffe16958939c461.translatedText: After being wordy for a long time, the reader may have understood that Baoyu's famous red bean poem was sung in such an environment by playing the harp to a cow!

d366cc7eed79099ba7bc9ffa1042dc21dfe5a59c.sourceText: 不知道这个典故，但就诗词而言确实是好文采，情思两字不在词中，却无处不在：
d366cc7eed79099ba7bc9ffa1042dc21dfe5a59c.translatedText: I don’t know this allusion, but as far as poetry is concerned, it is indeed a good literary talent. The word "emotion" is not in the poem, but it is everywhere:

db940bc9550357240ce520dc193879a30f6b6e14.sourceText: ”滴不尽相思血泪抛红豆，开不完春柳春花满画楼。睡不稳纱窗风雨黄昏后，忘不了新愁与旧愁。咽不下玉粒金波噎满喉，照不尽菱花镜里形容瘦。展不开的眉头，捱不明的更漏：呀!恰便似遮不住的青山隐隐，流不断的绿水悠悠。”

346adc0983f800a7cd504ecd04b891decf0dc1e2.sourceText: 唱完便随着宝玉外出，紧紧拉手，交换腰带什么的了—

84a988c8fe87aeb924a5c89d3b1aeac514bcefd5.sourceText: 这个曹雪芹，一肚子的文采，借宝玉嘴唱出倒也正常，但也要找个好地不是？！弄得后人猜疑频频：恰便似遮不住的青山隐隐，流不断的绿水悠悠—

3a7b1b10813608dde8b803ec4d0b5766a622e6ec.sourceText: 不过，想想也是，这《红豆词》鲜花也亏仗着这堆牛粪才这样滋润。若在姑娘们斗诗会上，灵牙利嘴的姑娘们一迭声地追问：谁是你的”新愁和旧愁”呵？你”展不开的眉头”究竟是为谁哪？宝玉情何以堪哪。

c656a3e7ff8e75051a908dd98a455dea5f16a9ea.sourceText: 报人老真：旅行随笔（三）－社区不再“唐话世界” 洛杉矶常来常往，报人无意欣赏”天使之城”的风光，只着眼那里的华人文化生活。 记得上世纪五十年代，某中文报纸有则新闻：”唐人街某中餐馆，在当街大门前的广告牌写着：【招工本店做唐餐、需炸炉尾、抓码、巴士杯各乙名，会讲唐话，意者来倾，按月磅水。】 有一华人见此，便去应徴问：”招工吗？要干啥的？” 老板架起眼镜望了一眼，指着广告牌说：”你唔会睇咩？” 应征者答：”我是唐人，会说国语、普通语。不会讲唐话、炸炉尾、抓码、巴士杯，干啥？” 老板就说：”该处系唐人街，唐话世界，唔会讲唐话，唔算系唐人，唔识会做唐餐。” 老板说得有点偏执，但是却说出当时唐人街的实情。其实，唐朝在中国历史上是一个强盛的朝代。海外的华人往往称自己是”唐人” 。移民初期，地处广东沿海的四邑（台山、开平、恩平、新会四县）来的华工最早、最多。早期到达美国西部的华工，多数在旧金山以至洛杉矶落脚。在外域异乡。言语不通，给工作和生活带来很多不便。四邑人通用的台山话，成为当时的一种凝聚力量，使他们逐步聚居起来，守望相助，共谋生计。聚居地叫做”唐人街”，台山话就是”唐话”。 ”唐话世界”的出现，实际上是美国华人社区的雏形。以后，大众为争取在社会上的权益，组织起形形式式的华人社团，流传了下来统称”传统侨社”。 洛杉矶唐人街最早出现，大概在19世纪90年代，位于洛杉矶市中心东北部的24号街区，对华人曾经很有”凝聚力”。上世纪40年代最为兴盛，各种具备广东色彩的商店、茶楼餐馆，吸引了无数的游客。多年来，报人每到洛城，总要到唐人街一行。走在大街上，擦身而过不乏乡里亲友，侧耳倾听不时是熟悉的”唐话”。 这趟抵洛城，没有到唐人街去。亲友们都说，约莫上世纪90年代开始，洛杉矶”老唐人街”在人们心目中”过时”了，近年更显得冷淡。目前，华人社区中心，已经由洛杉矶东部市郊的蒙特利公园市所取代，叫做”新唐人街”(约在洛杉矶市中心以东8公里)。其中有:蒙特利公园市(Monterey Park)，阿罕布拉市(Alhambra)，圣盖博市(San Gabriel)，柔似蜜市(Rosemead)，天普市(Temple City)，亚凯凯迪亚市(Arcadia)，圣马利诺市(San Marino)，南帕萨迪纳市（South Pasadena），哈仙达冈(Hacienda Heights) 、罗兰冈(Rowland Heights)，钻石吧市(Diamond Bar)，核桃市(Walnut), 等等。居住于大洛杉矶地区的华人较少前往”旧唐人街”，大家喜欢前往”新唐人街”的圣盖博谷去，购物、饮食、消费和消遣。 半个月来，报人吃住都在圣盖博市。只见大街的店铺，招牌大多是字体工整秀丽的中文。到处可以看到，陈列着来自漂亮服饰、书画、工艺品、电器家具，经营着上等的各式美食菜肴，等等。置身于商品琳琅满目的市区、流连五光色的的街头，令我想起中国好些大城市的景色。听说这里住着不少来自台湾的新移民．称为”小台北”。在这里，报人与亲友们饮荼、吃饭，购物、办事，讲国语，普通话，说台山话都通行，不再”唐话世界”了。 正是”三句不离本行”，报人看到，随着来自海峡两岸移民的与日俱增，洛杉矶华人社区文化更加丰富多彩。目前，有好几家华人电视台， 华语广播电台，全天24小时播放国语或粤语。中文报刊，除有六、七份日报，其他每月每周发行的社区报和月刋，不下20多家。 这趟到洛城，回顾”唐话世界”的变迁，老报人感慨良多。就眼前自力经营的一份中文报纸而言，扪心自问，是从”唐话世界”温床哺育出来的，摆脱不了”四邑”的地方”框架”。面对飞跃发展的时代，如何适应于多元化的华人社区的需求呢？到那时候会让人说太过时了？确实诚惶诚恐。 A3-驻洛总领馆新闻组长了乐利文领事(左2)与本报作者合影
c656a3e7ff8e75051a908dd98a455dea5f16a9ea.translatedText: Reporter Lao Zhen: Travel Essay (3) - The community is no longer a "Tang-speaking world". I often travel to Los Angeles, and the reporter has no intention of appreciating the scenery of the "City of Angels", only focusing on the Chinese cultural life there. I remember a piece of news in a Chinese newspaper in the 1950s: "A Chinese restaurant in Chinatown had a billboard in front of the street door that read: [We are looking for workers to cook Tang cuisine, and we need to fry the end of the oven, grab a code, and a bus cup. They can speak Tang dialect. Anyone who wants to come will pay for the water by the pound."] When a Chinese saw this, he went to Yingwei and asked: "Are you hiring?" What to do? The boss put up his glasses, took a look, pointed at the billboard and said, "Don't you know how to read it?" "The applicant replied: "I am from Tang Dynasty and can speak Mandarin and Mandarin. If you don’t know how to speak Chinese, fry the bottom of the furnace, catch codes, and win bus cups, what are you doing? The boss said: "This is Chinatown, a world of Tang dialect. If you don't speak Tang dialect, you don't count as a Tang person, and I don't know how to cook Tang cuisine." "The boss was a bit paranoid, but he told the truth about Chinatown at that time. In fact, the Tang Dynasty was a powerful dynasty in Chinese history. Overseas Chinese often call themselves "Tang people" In the early days of immigration, the earliest and largest number of Chinese workers came from Siyi (the four counties of Taishan, Kaiping, Enping, and Xinhui) in Guangdong. Most of the Chinese workers who arrived in the western United States settled in San Francisco and even Los Angeles, where they could not speak the language. , which brought a lot of inconvenience to work and life. The Taishan dialect commonly used by the people in the four towns became a cohesive force at that time, causing them to gradually gather together to help each other and make a living together. The settlement was called "Chinatown", and Taishan dialect was "Tang dialect". The emergence of "Tang Dialect World" was actually the prototype of the Chinese community in the United States. Later, in order to fight for their rights and interests in society, the public organized various Chinese associations, which were passed down and collectively referred to as "traditional overseas Chinese associations." Chinatown in Los Angeles first appeared in the 1890s. Block 24, located in the northeastern part of downtown Los Angeles, was very "cohesive" to the Chinese. It was most prosperous in the 1940s, and various shops and restaurants with Cantonese characteristics attracted countless tourists. For many years, reporters always visited Chinatown when they visited Los Angeles. When walking on the street, they passed by many relatives and friends from the hometown, and they listened to the familiar "Tang dialect" from time to time. When I arrived in Los Angeles, I didn’t go to Chinatown. Friends and relatives said that since about the 1990s, the “Old Chinatown” of Los Angeles has become “outdated” in people’s minds, and it has become even more indifferent in recent years. Currently, the Chinese community center has been replaced by the Monterey Park City in the eastern suburbs of Los Angeles, which is called “New Chinatown” (about 8 kilometers east of downtown Los Angeles). Park), Alhambra, San Gabriel, Rosemead, Temple City, Arcadia, San Marino, South Pasadena, Hacienda Heights, Rowland Heights, Diamond Bar), Walnut, etc. Chinese people living in the greater Los Angeles area rarely go to "Old Chinatown", and everyone likes to go to the "New Chinatown" of the San Gabriel Valley for shopping, eating, consumption and entertainment. For half a month, the reporter has been living and dining in San Gabriel City. Most of the shops on the street have neat and beautiful Chinese characters on their signs. They display beautiful clothing, calligraphy and painting, handicrafts, electrical appliances and furniture, and sell all kinds of high-quality food and dishes, etc. in the city. Wandering around the colorful streets reminds me of the scenery of many big cities in China. I heard that many new immigrants from Taiwan live here. It is called "Little Taipei". Here, people drink tea, eat, shop, and do business. Mandarin, Mandarin, and Taishan dialect are all spoken. It is no longer a "Tang dialect world." It is "never leave one's profession". Journalists see that with the increasing number of immigrants from both sides of the Taiwan Strait, the culture of the Chinese community in Los Angeles has become more colorful. Currently, there are several Chinese TV stations and Chinese radio stations broadcasting in Mandarin or Cantonese 24 hours a day. In addition to six or seven daily newspapers, there are no less than 20 community newspapers and monthly newspapers. When I went to Los Angeles and reviewed the changes in the "Tang dialect world", I felt a lot of emotions. As for an independently run Chinese newspaper, I asked myself that it was nurtured from the hotbed of the "Tang dialect world" and could not get rid of the "Siyi" local "framework". In the face of the era of rapid development, how can it adapt to the needs of the diversified Chinese community? I am really afraid that it will be too outdated. A3-The head of the press team of the Consulate General in Los Angeles, Consul Le Liwen (2nd from left), took a photo with the author of this newspaper

79ba6063fa06b5423bcfe0df94e5360e5e380857.translatedText: > The Sino-US Allied Forces Commemoration of the Victory of the Anti-Japanese War was held on August 15, which is also the anniversary of Japan’s surrender, and was held in Phoenix, Arizona.

c4b7efe486c29e6dce007c38ecc0f4955758f83e.sourceText: 大会由中华民国凤凰城荣光联谊会，美国亚历桑那州退伍军人总会及美国华裔退伍军人50分会共同主办。 中华民国退辅会副主委金筱辉与中华民国驻洛杉矶台北经文处副处长王秉慎应邀共同主持。 大会由洛杉矶中华旗队护旗开场，当军威壮盛的中华旗队高举中美国旗进场，会场500多位中外耒宾全体起立致敬迎旗，多位侨胞热泪夺眶而出，抗日英雄姜建民夫人，泣不成声说，我看见中华民国国旗的尊严及国号被尊重，我非常感动。 近260位美军现役及退役军人出席盛宴，多人均穿军服赴会，一致由衷的对中华旗队的惊艳与表现敬佩。
c4b7efe486c29e6dce007c38ecc0f4955758f83e.translatedText: The conference is co-sponsored by the Phoenix Glory Fellowship of the Republic of China, the Arizona Veterans Association and the 50th Chapter of Chinese American Veterans. Jin Xiaohui, deputy director of the Retirement Association of the Republic of China, and Wang Bingshen, deputy director of the Taipei Cultural Office of the Republic of China in Los Angeles, were invited to co-host. The conference started with the Los Angeles Chinese Flag Troop guarding the flag. When the mighty Chinese Flag Troop entered the venue holding the Chinese and American flags high, more than 500 Chinese and foreign guests stood up to salute the flag. Many overseas Chinese burst into tears. Anti-Japanese hero Mrs. Jiang Jianmin burst into tears and said, I saw the dignity of the flag of the Republic of China and the country's name being respected, and I was very moved. Nearly 260 active and retired U.S. military personnel attended the banquet. Many of them wore military uniforms and expressed their sincere admiration for the amazing performance of the Chinese flag team.

f62038b02ce6c08e13bc9f19fa056bdf4e78e88f.sourceText: 王秉慎副处长致词説：由中美盟军共同主办纪念抗日战争胜利及台湾光复活动，令活动本身增益不少。 马总统曾强调纪念抗战胜利之意义在于防止战争追求和平，战争之错误可以遗忘，但历史真相不能扭曲。 今天许多曾参与二战之中华民国与美国将士齐聚一堂，再次証明中华民国与二战时美国盟友之合作及对当时太平洋战场之贡献。 中华民国退辅会金筱辉副主委代表马英九总统颁赠11位曾在中国战区参加抗日战争老兵及家属荣誉状及纪念奖章。 金筱辉副主委特别指出当年中美盟军在太平洋战区共同为捍卫自由民主而战的意义，当年飞虎队国军飞行员就是在亚历桑那州受训，当晚特别向出席的中华民国空军飞行官致慰问意。 美国西南区纪念抗战胜利70週年筹备会总干事高啓正代表筹备会致词，表示这场非常成功的盛会，是由中美盟军共同合作办成，是筹备会系列活动中最后一场，也是规模最大的一场。 州长Doug Ducey 与中华民国驻洛杉矶台北经文处夏季昌处长及州参议员佘艶芬均颁赠大会奖状。 当晚司仪由美军退伍军人总会长 Rob Welch 及美空军退役上校 Ronald Perkins 共同担任，美海军少将 Navy Rear Admiral James A. Symonds 受邀专题报告。 当晚共有11位中华民国抗日老兵及家属获颁奖状及奖章，美军则有38位参加二战老兵亲自领奖，其中包括三位女兵，及二位美印地安 Navajo(那娃候)族老兵。
f62038b02ce6c08e13bc9f19fa056bdf4e78e88f.translatedText: Deputy Director Wang Bingshen said in his speech: The activities commemorating the victory of the Anti-Japanese War and the liberation of Taiwan were co-sponsored by the Allied Forces of China and the United States, which made the event itself a lot better. President Ma once emphasized that the significance of commemorating the victory of the Anti-Japanese War is to prevent war and pursue peace. The mistakes of the war can be forgotten, but the historical truth cannot be distorted. Today, many soldiers from the Republic of China and the United States who participated in World War II gathered together to once again prove the cooperation between the Republic of China and its American allies during World War II and its contribution to the Pacific Theater at that time. On behalf of President Ma Ying-jeou, Vice Chairman Jin Xiaohui of the Retired Auxiliary Association of the Republic of China presented certificates of honor and commemorative medals to 11 veterans who had participated in the Anti-Japanese War in the Chinese theater and their families. Vice Chairman Jin Xiaohui specifically pointed out the significance of the Chinese and American allies fighting together to defend freedom and democracy in the Pacific Theater. The Chinese Flying Tigers pilots were trained in Arizona. That night, he especially expressed condolences to the flight officers of the Republic of China Air Force who were present. Gao Qizheng, Director-General of the Southwest District Preparatory Meeting to Commemorate the 70th Anniversary of the Victory of the Anti-Japanese War, delivered a speech on behalf of the preparatory meeting, saying that this very successful event was jointly organized by the Chinese and American Allied Forces. It was the last and largest event in the series of preparatory meetings. Governor Doug Ducey, Director of the Taipei Cultural Affairs Office of the Republic of China in Los Angeles, Xia Chang, and State Senator She Chanfen all presented certificates from the conference. The masters of ceremony that night were Rob Welch, President of the US Military Veterans Association, and Ronald Perkins, retired US Air Force Colonel. US Navy Rear Admiral James A. Symonds was invited to make a special speech. A total of 11 veterans of the Anti-Japanese War of the Republic of China and their families received certificates and medals that night, while 38 veterans of the US Army who participated in World War II received the awards in person, including three female soldiers and two veterans of the Navajo tribe of the American Indians.
