fad4de625b6d827eab60e366efd2063fe71f2f60.sourceText: (张肇鸿报导)5月12日晚，凤凰城华人保龄球大赛举行总决赛，经过多轮较量，最终由亚省中餐馆会六福队荣获2014年度团体冠军，上海Grill获得亚军。5月19日，大赛颁奖典礼在红锅餐馆举行。 保龄球是一种持球者把球朝着球道上的十个球瓶用滚动击倒的运动。早在前7200年古埃及的古墓中被考古学家发现有九个球瓶和一个石球，因而被认为那时可能就有类似保龄球的运动。现代的球道长19.15米。保龄球的重量最重到16磅，可凭喜好而选择重量，通常为8到16磅。比赛记分单位是局，每局十个计分格。每个计分格最多有两次投球的机会。若第一次没能把球瓶全部击倒，则可以再投第二次。单局连投出12个全中，为300分。 凤凰城华人保龄球今年共有7支队伍，各队伍逢星期一晚都会去保龄球场训练或比赛，经年不断。去年九月至今年五月，是各队跃马横枪，沙场较量的时候。每队战将数人，车轮战术，轮流滚球击倒球瓶。队员由三只手指夹起保龄球，用腰力、臂力、手力、指力配合把球对准目标抛出，保龄球或旋转向前，或迂迴曲折击倒球瓶，各队你追我赶，互相校量，比赛最后用积分评出名次。 今年六福队荣获得年度团体冠军，队员有Brian McCoy, Rogelio Cedillo, Roberto Lopez 。上海Grill获得亚军。Edward Ong单局连投12个全中，获美国保龄球协会赠送鑽戒乙枚，Tony Diep、Mandy Ong、Larry Eng、Johnny Mo获赠奖杯。
fad4de625b6d827eab60e366efd2063fe71f2f60.translatedText: (Zhang Zhaohong reported) On the evening of May 12th, the Phoenix Chinese Bowling Competition held its finals. After many rounds of competition, the Alberta Chinese Restaurant Association Luk Fu team won the 2014 team championship, and Shanghai Grill won the runner-up. On May 19, the competition award ceremony was held at the Red Pot Restaurant. Bowling is a sport in which the ball holder rolls the ball toward ten pins on the lane. As early as 7200 BC, archaeologists discovered nine pins and a stone ball in an ancient Egyptian tomb, so it is believed that there may have been a sport similar to bowling at that time. The modern fairway is 19.15 meters long. The weight of a bowling ball is up to 16 pounds. You can choose the weight according to your preference, usually 8 to 16 pounds. The scoring unit of the game is a round, with ten scoring grids in each round. There are a maximum of two pitches per scoring box. If you fail to knock down all the pins the first time, you can shoot a second time. Hitting 12 consecutive hits in a single game is 300 points. Phoenix Chinese Bowling has a total of 7 teams this year, and each team goes to the bowling alley every Monday night to train or compete, year after year. From September last year to May this year, the teams competed on the battlefield. Each team has several players, using wheel tactics, and take turns rolling the ball to knock down the pins. Players pick up the bowling ball with three fingers and use waist, arm, hand and finger strength to throw the ball at the target. The bowling ball will either spin forward or knock down the pin in a roundabout way. Each team chases after each other and measures each other. At the end of the game, points will be used to determine the ranking. This year, the Luk Fook team won the annual team championship. The team members include Brian McCoy, Rogelio Cedillo, and Roberto Lopez. Shanghai Grill won the second place. Edward Ong hit all 12 shots in a single game and was presented with a diamond ring by the United States Bowling Association. Tony Diep, Mandy Ong, Larry Eng, and Johnny Mo were presented with trophies.

adcad9dd8d1d261529d8ebded413ad88b5720c4e.sourceText: 我们是一群有心团结侨社，提供同胞们一个联谊性、文化性、以及互助服务的活动中心的义务服务者。有鉴於大凤凰城东区华人年长人口的逐渐增加，却缺乏一个以华人文化為主的活动场所，因此发起这个筹备的活动。以下是目前的主要构想，并希望能够徵询你的意见：
adcad9dd8d1d261529d8ebded413ad88b5720c4e.translatedText: We are a group of overseas Chinese communities that are determined to unite with overseas Chinese communities and provide our compatriots with an activity center that provides social, cultural, and mutual assistance services. In view of the gradual increase in the elderly Chinese population in the East District of Greater Phoenix, but the lack of an activity venue focusing on Chinese culture, this preparatory activity was launched. The following are the current main ideas, and we hope to solicit your opinions:

4dfc716e74e87e316b7558ea9222644e149ace96.sourceText: 目的（主旨）：联络年满五十岁的华人同胞（以及其不分年龄不分国籍之亲友），开展联谊活动，丰富精神文化生活，互助互利。
4dfc716e74e87e316b7558ea9222644e149ace96.translatedText: Purpose (theme): To contact Chinese compatriots over fifty years old (and their relatives and friends regardless of age and nationality), carry out social activities, enrich spiritual and cultural life, and achieve mutual benefit.

5b6da8d7fce4f4fe3dc99cba95ab1314db6cd3bf.sourceText: 康乐文艺活动：象棋围棋、麻将桥牌、乒乓网球、排球蓝球、茶道品茗、书法绘画、烹调厨艺、健康养生、旅游摄影、爬山远足、歌咏舞蹈、曲艺器乐等。
5b6da8d7fce4f4fe3dc99cba95ab1314db6cd3bf.translatedText: Recreational and cultural activities: chess and Go, mahjong and bridge, table tennis, volleyball and basketball, tea ceremony, calligraphy and painting, cooking, health and wellness, travel photography, mountain climbing and hiking, singing and dancing, folk arts and instrumental music, etc.

96d3d130c78b4685cbee3edb7ca94741b69f9a76.sourceText: 凤凰城气如虹：生活随笔-庆祝中秋 壬辰中秋节终于在星期日降临，中秋是个赏月、拜月的节日，最适宜于晚上进行庆祝，我家每年循例在农历八月十五夜，月亮上升的时候，搬设香炉供桌，摆放月饼、芋头 、柚子等水果，炷香拜月，儿女们若无其他要事，都会在家欢度佳节，人月团圆。 我家庆祝中秋习俗不变，在越南如是，在美国也如是，只是，在越南比较热闹，因为左邻右舍共同庆贺，华越民族一起赏月，街头巷尾孩童玩花灯的欢欣景象，洋溢着愉快的 笑声，越南政府更将中秋节定为越南儿童节，饶有意义！ 在美国则简单得多，有中国城的地方还有点气氛，没有的话，就像「聋公破竹──过节不闻声」。 我住在凤凰城西区，​​这个中秋夜，月光明亮，邻舍静悄悄，只有后面一家有人游泳玩乐，传来嘈杂声，我夫妇和女儿循例在后院拜月赏月，国风与媳妇也回来共 庆团圆；大儿子出埠旅行未归，小儿子则选择温馨的二人世界过节。 我除了自家庆祝中秋，也参加一些侨界团体联欢，最早是四星期前的开平同乡会中秋联欢，最近是中秋前两天的耆英会欢宴，中秋前夕越裔共同体的庆祝。 凤凰城华人耆英会的中秋欢宴，距离中秋节只有两天，组织得很成功，我夫妇早已登记参与，各耆老朋友参加人数拥挤，会场内座无虚席，侨联会的领导人物也光临主持，显得 隆重。 庆祝节目陆续亮相，广东歌咏组率先登场，展开大合唱，声调嘹亮；继续推出乐师演奏广东音乐，会员歌唱粤曲，满足大众喜好，拍掌称赞。 跟着国语组合也阵容强盛，演唱不俗，每阕音韵飞扬，响彻会场；跟着模特儿时装姿态表演，轻移莲步，闻歌起舞，婀娜多姿，转身背后，有如十八姑娘，全无老 态！ 联欢餐点也丰富，月饼蛋糕并送，鲜奶水果齐分，人人满意，皆大欢喜。 至于中秋节前夕越裔共同体的庆祝，东区在美莎市新世界超市广场，西区在格栏岱市如来禅寺，同时举行，设有歌唱舞蹈节目娱宾，许多诱导儿童的益智游戏，以及 赠送花灯玩具等，不收门票，自由入座，吸引众多宾客扶老携幼前往观赏，真正无分彼此，充分展开大众同乐的环境。 我选择到东区新世界那边，我夫妇与国兴、国欣一家四口，约同内兄陈财顺、老襟王楚荣与家人，到那里品尝越南美食，欣赏庆祝表演，场面非常热闹，人头涌 涌，碰上不少越南朋友，寒暄话旧，共庆中秋。 大家都重视庆祝中秋，是好现象，毕竟这是华越民族的大节日，在传统的阴历历法里，中秋节仅次于过年的春节，排名第二，应该热烈庆祝。 美中不足是有些应节活动距离正确日子太远，对下一代传承欠缺深刻印象，模糊不清。 综观各团体组织的庆祝聚会，我认为新东方艺术学校最佳，在钱得乐艺术中心举办「金秋中国舞汇演」，于中秋节当日下午进行，真正迎合节日，值得鼓掌！ 中秋节的意义是庆团圆，月饼拜月是主要的仪式，圚圚的月亮，代表一家人的整体齐全，故此又称团圆节；古代很多诗人墨客离乡背井，常在中秋夜对月感怀，千百 年来曾写下无数优美的诗词，流传后世。 中秋节有很多传说，家庭庆祝最好循例讲述，让子孙们对节日有特别概念。 唐代「唐明皇游月殿」是中秋拜月的起源，最早的月亮故事则有「嫦娥奔月」，「后羿射月」，「吴刚伐桂」，「玉兔捣药」等，虽然是神话 传说，正显示习俗文化的特别色彩。 中秋节食月饼提花灯的习俗，始于朱元璋起义推翻元朝的讯号，于中秋节分派月饼，内藏揭竿起义秘密纸条，晚上家家户户点燃花灯作响应，建立明朝。 我们也可讲述现代火箭征月球的知识，增加中秋节的新情调，譬如一九六七年，美国太阳神载人登录月球，轰动全世界，当时越南堤岸远东日报就发表一首打油诗，有些读者 拿来作为庆祝中秋新话题，倒也有趣： 古时登月有嫦娥，如今登月阿波罗， 如果嫦娥真会见，一中一外说什么？
96d3d130c78b4685cbee3edb7ca94741b69f9a76.translatedText: The Phoenix City is full of energy: Life Essays - Celebrating the Mid-Autumn Festival. The Renchen Mid-Autumn Festival finally arrived on Sunday. The Mid-Autumn Festival is a festival for appreciating and worshiping the moon. It is best to celebrate at night. Every year, my family will set up an incense burner on the table when the moon rises on the 15th night of the eighth lunar month, place moon cakes, taro, grapefruit and other fruits, burn incense and worship the moon. If there are no other important things, the children will celebrate the festival at home and reunite the moon and the moon. My family’s custom of celebrating the Mid-Autumn Festival remains unchanged, as it is in Vietnam and the United States. However, it is more lively in Vietnam because neighbors celebrate together, Chinese and Vietnamese people enjoy the moon together, and the joyful scene of children playing with lanterns in the streets is filled with joyful laughter. The Vietnamese government has designated the Mid-Autumn Festival as Vietnamese Children’s Day, which is very meaningful! In the United States, it is much simpler. Where there is a Chinatown, there is still some atmosphere. Without it, it is like "a deaf man breaking a bamboo - not hearing anything during the holidays." I live in the west district of Phoenix City. On this Mid-Autumn Festival night, the moonlight was bright and the neighborhood was quiet. Only the family in the back was swimming and having fun. There was noise. My husband, wife and daughter worshiped and admired the moon in the backyard as usual. Guofeng and his wife also came back to celebrate the reunion. The eldest son did not return from a trip to the city, but the younger son chose to spend the holiday in a warm world of two. In addition to celebrating the Mid-Autumn Festival at home, I also participate in some gatherings of overseas Chinese community groups. The earliest was the Mid-Autumn Festival Gala of the Kaiping Association four weeks ago, the most recent was the banquet of the Senior Citizens Association two days before the Mid-Autumn Festival, and the celebration of the Vietnamese community on the eve of the Mid-Autumn Festival. The Mid-Autumn Festival banquet held by the Phoenix Chinese Senior Citizens Association was only two days away from the Mid-Autumn Festival. It was organized very successfully. My husband and I had already registered to participate. There were a large number of senior friends attending, and the venue was packed. Leaders from the Overseas Chinese Association also came to host it, which made it seem grand. Celebration programs were unveiled one after another, with the Cantonese singing group taking the lead and launching a chorus with loud and clear voices; musicians continued to perform Cantonese music, and members sang Cantonese opera to satisfy the public's preferences and receive applause. The Mandarin group also had a strong lineup and performed well, with each tune soaring and resounding throughout the venue; followed the model's fashion pose performance, lightly moving lotus steps, dancing to the song, graceful and graceful, turning behind her, like an eighteenth-year-old girl, without any signs of aging! The party meals were also rich, with mooncakes and cakes given away, and fresh milk and fruits shared. Everyone was satisfied and happy. As for the celebration of the Vietnamese community on the eve of the Mid-Autumn Festival, the Eastern District is held at the New World Supermarket Plaza in Mesa City, and the Western District is held at the Tathagata Zen Temple in Galendai City. There are singing and dancing programs to entertain guests, many educational games to induce children, and gifts of lanterns and toys. There is no admission fee and free seating. It attracts many guests, old and young, to come and watch. There is no distinction between each other, and the environment of public enjoyment is fully developed. I chose to go to the New World in East District. My husband, my wife, and my family of four, Guo Xing and Guo Xin, made an appointment with my brother-in-law, Chen Caishun, and my husband, Wang Churong, and their families to taste Vietnamese food and enjoy the celebratory performances. The scene was very lively and crowded, and I met many Vietnamese friends, chatting and celebrating the Mid-Autumn Festival together. It is a good sign that everyone attaches great importance to celebrating the Mid-Autumn Festival. After all, it is a major festival for the Chinese and Vietnamese people. In the traditional lunar calendar, the Mid-Autumn Festival ranks second after the Spring Festival and should be celebrated enthusiastically. The only drawback is that some festival activities are too far away from the correct date, and they lack a deep impression on the next generation and are unclear. Looking at the celebration gatherings organized by various groups, I think New Oriental Art School is the best. It held the "Golden Autumn Chinese Dance Performance" at the Chandler Art Center on the afternoon of the Mid-Autumn Festival. It truly catered to the festival and deserves applause! The meaning of the Mid-Autumn Festival is to celebrate reunion, and worshiping the moon with mooncakes is the main ritual. The bright moon represents the completeness of the family, so it is also called the Reunion Festival. In ancient times, many poets and poets left their hometowns and often missed the moon on the night of the Mid-Autumn Festival. Over the thousands of years, they wrote countless beautiful poems that have been passed down to future generations. There are many legends about the Mid-Autumn Festival. It is best to tell them as a family celebration so that children and grandchildren can have a special concept of the festival. In the Tang Dynasty, "Tang Minghuang visited the Moon Palace" was the origin of the Mid-Autumn Festival moon worship. The earliest moon stories include "Chang'e flying to the moon", "Hou Yi shooting the moon", "Wu Gang conquering the Gui", "Jade Rabbit making medicine", etc. Although they are myths and legends, they show the special color of custom culture. The custom of mooncakes and jacquard lanterns for the Mid-Autumn Festival began when Zhu Yuanzhang's uprising overthrew the Yuan Dynasty. Mooncakes were distributed on the Mid-Autumn Festival, containing secret notes about the uprising. At night, every household lit lanterns in response and established the Ming Dynasty. We can also tell the knowledge about modern rockets' expedition to the moon to add new sentiments to the Mid-Autumn Festival. For example, in 1967, the American Sun God manned the moon landing, which shocked the world. At that time, Vietnam's Far East Daily published a limerick. Some readers used it as a new topic to celebrate the Mid-Autumn Festival. It is also interesting: In ancient times, Chang'e landed on the moon, and now Apollo landed on the moon. If Chang'e really met, what would one say in one Chinese and one foreign language?

e9183bf9b5f000b949dd2a677fbcf8173893d8c9.sourceText: 凤凰城侨联总会在早期庆祝美国国庆的活动中，有一个让全侨男女老少都能满足”表演欲”的节目，那就是”时装表演”。侨联当年与本地的美国大公司JC Penny有着良好关係，服装有大公司提供，既现成又方便，侨联也多了一个时尚的表演节目；而JC Penny有免费的华人”模特”在社区打广告，一家便宜两家着，所以何乐而不为。这种无需严格排练又可以不分年纪的自娱自乐”时装骚”，多年来一直侨社庆祝活动中的节目之一，常常是从耆老到幼稚园孩童，还有美国人，穿上各式各样的时装扮”模特”走秀，大家上去”潇洒走一回”，不但”独乐乐”，而且”众乐乐”，皆大欢喜。所以从七十年代到九十年代，时装表演成为”长青树”节目，历久不衰。但是到了九十年代之初，本埠来了一位”王娲”女士，时装秀就起了点变化。 王娲来自香港，曾当选过香港的”微笑小姐”，亦是”露华浓”公司的顾问，她毕业于加州长堤大学教育系，是当年加州美容协会会员。来到亚省后，在Scottsdale City开了一间名为”Boutique Astar”的美容时装店。她很有生意头脑，为了给该店起个中文名号，便想到要登报徵名，优胜者有奬。于是乎鳯凰城一班”墨客騒人” 纷纷投稿，争着为美容时装店起名号，三个月内共徵得七十五个名字。围绕着徵文的取名也很有趣，有人说”王娲”之姓名就很有王者风范，令人联想起”女娲补天”故事，并说女娲在”炼五色石补天”中，曾遗下的了一块石头，日后成为了”红楼梦”中贾宝玉那一块”通灵宝玉”，此店不如就取名为”宝玉”，又或者是宝玉的另一代号怡红公子”，以此作雅号不但珠光宝气，而且与衆多的脂粉姐妹有缘，说不定会引来滔滔生意呢。笔者亦曾建议此店名的雅号最好与”华”字有关，因为华字解作”美丽而有光彩”，且有华丽、华彩、铅华等适合其经营性质，而店之英文名号”Boutique”也含有”高级、奢华”之意，而且它是华资企业，也为华人服务，雅号不妨选用”艺华”，并拟好了一对联： 艺貌芳容 不离浓粧澹抺 华装礼服 适配名士佳人 上联说美容，下联话时装，也还凑合。 但也有人认为，这世上只有一样东西可以令到”魔鬼变美女，美女变仙女”的，用它作店名担保石破天惊，前无古人！这个金字招牌就是”画皮”！并询问王娲是否有胆色去釆用？征名活动最后由佳叔胜出，他起的点名是”艺之华”，并把得奖的$500捐赠给了华人耆英会。 且不说用什麽名号合符王娲的心意，只不过宣传已起作用，王娲此时乘胜追击，继而在华美酒家开办”鳯凰城首届女模特儿”大赛，消息一经传开，前后共有九位佳丽报名参加，经过王娲小姐十天的悉心训练，这班年轻貎美的业馀模特终于穿上Boutique Astar时装店提供的时装和晚礼服粉墨登场。是晚王娲还特地请来了洛杉矶”世界时装协会”主席Sherdon West，本地《时装趋势》杂志社记者出任裁判，举办时有数百人来到华美酒家观看模特比赛，一时间热闹非常。比赛当夜胜出的冠军是17岁的高三学生黄雅丽，她人如其名，有一种冷艳的的美，亚军是简苹，而季军由蔡惠英夺得。1995年，黄雅婷参加了鳯凰城华裔小姐选美，并夺得皇冠，成为惟一一个有模特和选美双料冠军的皇后。 办完模特大赛后，王娲名声大躁，不但自己打响了知名度，招徕生意，而且鳯凰城侨社也多了一位美容时装顾问。所以到了1993年，斐匿侨联要举办庆祝美国国庆暨侨联成立廿五週年活动，时装表演部分就由王娲担任总编导，在王娲导演指挥下，包括侨联副主席余自任，妇女会主席谢妙求，中餐馆会主席余兆威等都得亲自上场，四十多位男女老少充当模特，事前经过了训练和排演，表演也得到空前的成功。自此之后，以前侨联那一种大众化和随心随意时尚衣裳秀，有了较正统的规范。 2005年，东森卫视应邀前来拍摄侨联庆国庆和选美活动，王娲带领摄製队去游历凤城风光，并去了Scottsdale拍摄名胜风景，以及前往城北景区参观当年好箂坞拍摄007谍战片中，小飞机穿越过的拱形山洞，令到大家大开眼界。 王娲曾进军政坛，但夙愿未能达到。以后转作房地产事业，十多年来有着不错的成绩，被选为Scottsdale地产公会董事，成为这个拥有万人会员董事局中的首位华人董事。2009年她担任亚省人口普查专员。十分尽心尽力。 王娲在人生的”秀场”上，时时有着丽影霓裳的演出，令人称羡。而王娲的”登报徵名”和”女模大赛”，亦为凤凰城华人添上了一段佳话。
e9183bf9b5f000b949dd2a677fbcf8173893d8c9.translatedText: In the early activities of the Phoenix Overseas Chinese Federation to celebrate the National Day of the United States, there was a program that allowed all overseas Chinese men, women and children to satisfy their "desire for performance", and that was the "fashion show". At that time, the Overseas Chinese Federation had a good relationship with JC Penny, a large local American company. The clothing was provided by the large company, which was both ready-made and convenient. The Overseas Chinese Federation also had a fashionable performance program; and JC Penny had free Chinese "models" to advertise in the community. It was cheaper for one company than for two, so why not do it. This kind of "fashion show" that does not require strict rehearsal and can be enjoyed by oneself regardless of age has been one of the programs in the celebrations of overseas Chinese communities for many years. People from the elderly to kindergarten children, as well as Americans, often put on various fashionable costumes and "models" to walk on the catwalk. Therefore, from the 1970s to the 1990s, fashion shows became "evergreen" programs and lasted for a long time. But in the early 1990s, Ms. Wang Wa came to the city, and the fashion show changed a bit. Wang Wa is from Hong Kong. She was once elected as "Miss Smile" in Hong Kong and is also a consultant for the "Revlon" company. She graduated from the Education Department of California University at Long Beach and was a member of the California Beauty Association. After coming to Alberta, she opened a beauty and fashion store called "Boutique Astar" in Scottsdale City. She is very business-minded. In order to give the store a Chinese name, she thought of listing it in a newspaper and the winner would receive a prize. As a result, a group of "poet writers" from Huangcheng City submitted articles one after another, vying to name the beauty and fashion store. Within three months, a total of 75 names were collected. The naming surrounding the essay is also very interesting. Some people say that the name "Wang Wa" has a royal demeanor, which is reminiscent of the story of "Nu Wa mending the sky". It is also said that Nu Wa once left a stone when she was "refining five-color stones to mend the sky". In the future, it became the "psychic jade" of Jia Baoyu in "A Dream of Red Mansions". It would be better to name this store "Baoyu", or Baoyu's other code name, "Yihong Gongzi". This nickname is not only jewel-like, but also unique to many The makeup sisters are destined to be together, maybe it will attract a lot of business. The author also suggested that the name of this store should be related to the word "hua", because the Chinese word means "beautiful and lustrous", and the words "gorgeous", "huacai", "huahua", etc. are suitable for the nature of its business. The English name of the store "Boutique" also contains the meaning of "high-end and luxury", and it is a Chinese-owned enterprise and also serves the Chinese. The name may as well be "Yihua" and a couplet was drawn up: The artistic appearance and the beautiful appearance are accompanied by heavy make-up and gorgeous dresses, suitable for celebrities and beauties. The first couplet talks about beauty, and the second couplet talks about fashion, which is okay. But some people think that there is only one thing in the world that can turn "devils into beauties and beauties into fairies". Using it as a store name is unprecedented! This golden sign is "Painted Skin"! They asked Wang Wa if he had the courage to use it? In the end, Jia Shu won the name "Yi Zhi Hua" and donated the winning $500 to the Chinese Senior Citizens Association. Not to mention the name that suited Wang Wa's wishes, but the publicity had worked. Wang Wa took advantage of the victory and launched the "Fenghuang City's First Female Model" contest at Huamei Restaurant. Once the news spread, a total of nine beauties signed up to participate. After ten days of careful training by Miss Wang Wa, these young and beautiful amateur models finally wore Boutique. The fashion and evening gowns provided by Astar Fashion Store were on display in the evening, and Wang Wa specially invited Sherdon, the chairman of the "World Fashion Council" in Los Angeles. West, a reporter from the local Fashion Trend magazine served as the referee. Hundreds of people came to Huamei Restaurant to watch the model competition. The winner on the night of the competition was 17-year-old high school senior Huang Yali. As the name suggests, there is a kind of cold beauty. The runner-up was Jian Ping, and the third runner-up was won by Cai Huiying. In 1995, Huang Yating participated in the Miss Chinese Beauty Pageant in Phoenix City and won the crown, becoming the only queen to win both the model and beauty pageant titles. After holding the model competition, Wang Wa became famous. Not only did she gain popularity and attract business, but the Overseas Chinese Association in Huanghuang City also had a beauty and fashion consultant. So in 1993, the Feinie Overseas Chinese Federation held an event to celebrate the National Day of the United States and the 25th anniversary of the founding of the Overseas Chinese Federation. Wang Wa served as the chief editor and directed the fashion show. Next, including Vice Chairman of the Overseas Chinese Federation Yu Ziren, Chairman of the Women's Association Xie Miaoqiu, and Chairman of the Chinese Restaurant Association Yu Zhaowei, more than 40 men, women, and children acted as models. They were trained and rehearsed in advance, and the performance was an unprecedented success. Since then, the popular and casual fashion show of the Overseas Chinese Federation has become more orthodox. In 2005, Dongsen TV was invited to film the Overseas Chinese National Day and the beauty pageant. Wang Wa led the film team to tour the scenery of Fengcheng, and went to Scottsdale to shoot scenic spots. They also went to the northern scenic spot to visit the arched cave where the small plane flew through in the 007 spy film that was filmed in Ho Chi Wan, which was an eye-opener for everyone. Wang Wa once entered politics, but her long-cherished wish failed. She later switched to real estate and achieved good results for more than ten years. She was elected as a director of the Scottsdale Real Estate Association and became the first Chinese director on the board of directors of the Scottsdale Real Estate Association, which has 10,000 members. In 2009, she served as the census commissioner of the province. In the "show" of life, Wang Wa always performs in beautiful and colorful clothes, which is enviable. Wang Wa's "registration" and "female model competition" have also added a good story to the Chinese people in Phoenix.

b610e563965337eae38078f0745863eb121f8719.sourceText: 金信地产新闻：专家预计亚利桑那经济将在三年内全面复苏 金信地产新闻：专家预计亚利桑那经济将在三年内全面复苏 12月5日由亚利桑那州立大学商学院与摩根大通银行共同主办的第49届年度经济预测午餐会隆重举行。大约1000人在凤凰城会议中心参加了此次会议。 截止到9月，亚利桑那就业增长排在全国第五，凤凰城地区在大城市中排名第四。摩根大通WP凯瑞商学院经济展望中心主任李先生说，亚利桑那州在2013年预计将新增6万个就业岗位，在专业的商业服务，零售，酒店，医疗保健领域。失业率将下降到7.6%。他补充说明，只要国家大环境，不拖亚利桑那的后腿，亚利桑那将有2.5%的就业增长。今年已经有了2%的增长。亚利桑那已经赢回了经济衰退前的三分之一的职位。他相信在三年内经济将回到衰退前。 专家预测2013年个人收入将提高5%。 今年提高了4%。零售也将增长6%，今年增长了5%。人口将上升1.5%。 他相信随着房地长市场的好转，独立屋建造许可将会上升50%。 首席经济学家贝斯安Bovino有不同的意见。他比较关注政府的?#36130;政悬崖?#12290;如果政府不能避免这个问题，美国的失业率将到9%。今年的国内生产总值上升了2.1%， 比原先预测的高，2013年她认为希望达到2.3%。 她的报告依然显示出今后有大的就业市场，同时数据也表现出，家庭有购买大件商品的意愿，例如车和房子。 尽管目前失业率依然还很高，但是贝斯安看到了很好的房地产市场的前景。到今年9月，房地产经济增长了45%。 她参考了一个报告，指出有1.3百万个房屋不再赔本。随着市场的继续走高，市场价格将会高于屋主的投资价格。她预期2013年市民住宅建筑业将增长19%。 某房地产咨询公司总裁波拉克作出了如下的总结。亚利桑那的独立屋和公寓市场恢复的非常迅速。只有商业地产，办公室还有一段路要走。亚利桑那还有40%的房子亏钱，但是大家已经看到了大的复苏。新房屋的销售表现不俗，67%的新房市场相当活跃，房屋基本上在一年内售完。建筑商开始努力满足市场的需求。出租市场最近也变得非常强劲。目前当地有22%的独立屋正在出租。一年前仅有12%。随着人口的增加，更多的房主开始考虑投资出租屋。 波拉克说如果可以避免?#36130;政悬崖?#65292;接下去几年，事情会有改观。 到2015年，只要有正常的人口流动，现在我们遇到的问题都可以解决。更多有关房地产的信息请咨询金信地产的Tinna (480)287-0180 E-mail:Goldtrustrealty2010@gmail.com
b610e563965337eae38078f0745863eb121f8719.translatedText: Jinxin Real Estate News: Experts predict Arizona’s economy will fully recover within three years Jinxin Real Estate News: Experts predict Arizona’s economy will fully recover within three years On December 5, the 49th Annual Economic Forecast Luncheon, co-sponsored by the Arizona State University School of Business and JPMorgan Chase Bank, was held. About 1,000 people attended the meeting at the Phoenix Convention Center. As of September, Arizona ranked fifth nationally for job growth, and the Phoenix area ranked fourth among large cities. Mr. Lee, director of the Center for Economic Outlook at J.P. Morgan Chase's WP Carey Business School, said Arizona is expected to add 60,000 new jobs in 2013 in professional business services, retail, hospitality, and health care. The unemployment rate will fall to 7.6%. He added that as long as the national environment does not hold back Arizona, Arizona will have a 2.5% job growth. There has been a 2% growth this year. Arizona has won back a third of the jobs it had before the recession. He believes the economy will be back to pre-recession within three years. Experts predict that personal income will increase by 5% in 2013. This year it increased by 4%. Retail sales will also grow by 6%, after growing by 5% this year. The population will increase by 1.5%. He believes that as the real estate market improves, single-family building permits will increase by 50%. Chief economist Beth Ann Bovino has a different opinion. He is more concerned about the government's political cliff. If the government cannot avoid this problem, the unemployment rate in the United States will reach 9%. This year's GDP rose by 2.1%, higher than originally forecast, and she said she hoped to reach 2.3% in 2013. Her report still shows that there will be a large job market in the future, and the data also shows that households are willing to buy big-ticket items, such as cars and houses. Although the unemployment rate is still high, Besian sees good prospects for the real estate market. By September this year, the real estate economy had grown by 45%. She referenced a report indicating that 1.3 million homes were no longer a loss maker. As the market continues to move higher, market prices will be higher than what homeowners paid for their investments. She expects the residential construction industry to grow by 19% in 2013. Pollack, president of a real estate consulting company, made the following summary. Arizona's single-family home and condo market is recovering very quickly. Only commercial properties, offices are still some way off. 40% of houses in Arizona are still losing money, but everyone has seen a big recovery. Sales of new homes performed well, with 67% of the new home markets being quite active, with homes basically sold within a year. Builders began to work hard to meet the demands of the market. The rental market has also become very strong recently. Currently, 22% of the local detached houses are for rent. A year ago it was just 12%. As the population increases, more homeowners are considering investing in rental properties. Pollack said that if the political cliff can be avoided, things will change in the next few years. By 2015, as long as there is normal population flow, all the problems we encounter now can be solved. 6b40ac0810523dd5b004ed05da77dee787f1d525.sourceText: 凤凰城气如虹：洛矶山漫游之三－温哥华云埠 我参与加拿大洛矶山七日游，第一日傍晚抵达温哥华(Vancouver)，旅行车停泊在海岸旅​​馆旁边，接载一位来自台湾的旅客，以便同去列治文(Richmond)沪上酒家吃晚饭。 坐在车上等待期间，看见路旁的房子门前有三个中文大字：「静思堂」，映入眼帘，我非常高兴，再从玻璃门窗仔细观看，原来是温哥华慈济分会会所。 太座总是笑我看见中文就喜形于色，她不理解在欧美外国城市 ，中文大字能向着游客闪耀光彩，珍贵无比，值得赞扬。 在加国住宿了第一晚，翌日晨早在旅馆的白斑餐厅( White Spot) 用过早餐后，开始在温哥华境内展开旅游。 导游通知大家，今天增加六名台湾游客和一对印度夫妇，明日增加四名来自非洲的华人，总人数达到三十一位。 导游并说明这两天都是游览附近胜景，住宿原来的旅馆，行李照常放置，不用搬迁，但最重要携带寒衣​​、药物、手机和摄影机等观光必备用具。 旅行车准七时出发，导游在车上讲述温哥华市概况，以及有关两天的行程，包括游览旧城区，史丹利(Stanley Park) 公园，伊利莎白女皇公园，中国城，曾组织冬季奥运会地点 的惠斯勒(Whistler)和温哥华岛。 聆听讲述得知，温哥华是加拿大全国第三大都会，西部最大的城市，水陆交通枢纽主要地区，属于卑诗省范围。 所谓卑诗省，本是英文ＢＣ两字母的译音，全名是不列颠哥伦比亚省( British Columbia) 。 温哥华是华人的重镇，一九九七年香港回归中国前，港人害怕社会主义专制政策，大量移民到此居留，成为北美仅次于旧金山的最大唐人街，甚至有人戏称「香哥华」，广州 话是华人社区通用的语言。 近年台湾与陆客增多，国语交谈逐渐兴盛。 我今回是初到温哥华，坐车观景，看见样样新鲜，枫树林立，枫叶飘摇，绿多黄少，红色更稀。 又见市区远处高山隆起，外面还有一片海洋，路旁湖泊特多，似乎各地「山水有相逢」，山河秀丽，景色怡人。 略逛旧城，我不感兴趣，太座则喜欢进商店购物，购买御寒衣冠。 我较喜欢中国城风味，令人特别留神，充满华人传统文化，店铺的经营，有​​点像昔日越南堤岸相似，显示广东老侨谋生，四海相同。 经过一家狭窄的店铺，竖直的大招牌吸引我的视线：「周永职──燕梳」，名字仿似我的兄弟，燕梳呢？ 导游就要向讲国语人士解释，那是「保险」的粤语译音。 再过不远，我又见一个古老招牌；「中国国民党云高华支部」，原来早期的译名不是温哥华，而是云高华，怪不得有「云埠」或「云城」的简称。 啊！ 云埠，云城，很有诗意，我们就在此云游，欣赏中国城云彩，让我感觉亲切，路经一家饼店，买包番薯亁，买盒鸡仔饼作零食，回味一下传统家乡风味 。 中午云集重庆酒楼用餐，享受云埠唐人美食，领略云城唐人气氛，完全没有身在异乡为异客的感觉。 可惜一切快速过去，景物转眼烟消云散，午饭后我们像云淡风轻般离去！ 温哥华的所有旅游胜景，相当著名，值得亲临赏玩，只是时间所限，旅行团不能尽情享乐，惟有拣选重点地区，体验一下情趣，来自各方的旅客，都忙碌着摄影录像，留作纪念。 史丹利公园的环境相当优美，公园入口处广阔空旷，有旧总督史丹利的铜像，东侧广场面临海洋矗立着七株图腾柱，雕刻着各种人物或熊等兽类动物，彩色缤纷，形式独特，大概是 代表各土著部落的标志。 伊利莎白女皇公园，景色宜人，樱花枫叶绽放自然的美，芬芳飘逸；两对越南夫妇喜欢与我俩一起，同声同气，攀谈共游，齐齐步行上斜坡，看到中心摆设有趣的 雕像，一位摄影师以手示意别阻挡我的镜头，另有三个人像代表游客整装等待拍照，这些栩栩如生雕塑，成为我们猎取镜头的免费模特儿。 午后到达惠斯勒，这里更有名堂，是北美最大的滑雪场所，是二○一○年举办冬季奥运会的地方，留下五环奥运标志纪念，吸引很多游客，成为旅游热门聚点。 这里地方广大，到处都有可欣赏的景象，特别是另外一边的骑车斗士，吸引游客围观，他们都是胆识过人的​​青年，乘坐缆车连同自行车登上山峰，然后踏车迂回曲折的从高峰 飞飈下山脚，惊心动魄！ 旅行团除了亲临各胜景游览，沿途观看山川海湾，蓝天白云，花卉树木，青葱翠绿，也有不少美观奇景，如经过宁峡谷看见吊桥特色，来往史丹利公园，可眺望到一对狮子塑像摆在 铁桥头两边，叫做狮门铁桥，还有其他值得一游之处，不过，欲要详细赏玩，从容不迫，必须自由行才能得偿所愿，旅行团集体措施，安排旅程紧凑，时间匆促，每个 景点不可能逗留太久。 夜幕低垂，旅行团已疲累了，匆匆往中餐馆吃晚饭，就要返回海岸旅馆休憩安眠，再准备明天行程。
6b40ac0810523dd5b004ed05da77dee787f1d525.translatedText: Phoenix City is like a rainbow: Rocky Mountain Tour 3 - Vancouver Cloud Port I participated in a seven-day tour of the Canadian Rockies. I arrived in Vancouver (Vancouver) on the evening of the first day. The station wagon parked next to the Coast Hotel and picked up a tourist from Taiwan so that we could have dinner at Shanghai Restaurant in Richmond. While I was sitting in the car waiting, I saw three Chinese characters in front of the house on the roadside: "Jing Si Hall". I was very happy. Then I looked carefully through the glass door and window. It turned out to be the Vancouver Tzu Chi branch. The Queen always laughs at me because I am so happy when I see Chinese characters. She does not understand that in foreign cities in Europe and the United States, Chinese characters can shine brightly to tourists. They are extremely precious and worthy of praise. After spending the first night in Canada, we had breakfast at the hotel’s White Spot restaurant the next morning and started traveling in Vancouver. The tour guide informed everyone that today there will be six more Taiwanese tourists and an Indian couple, and tomorrow there will be four more Chinese from Africa, bringing the total number to thirty-one. The tour guide also explained that these two days are spent visiting nearby scenic spots, staying in the original hotel, leaving luggage as usual, no need to move, but the most important thing is to bring cold clothes, medicine, mobile phones, cameras and other essential sightseeing equipment. The tour bus set off at seven o'clock on time. The tour guide gave an overview of the city of Vancouver and the two-day itinerary, including visits to the Old Town, Stanley Park, Queen Elizabeth Park, Chinatown, Whistler, where the Winter Olympics were organized, and Vancouver Island. Listening to the narration, we learned that Vancouver is the third largest city in Canada, the largest city in the west, a major water and land transportation hub, and belongs to the province of British Columbia. The so-called British Columbia is originally the transliteration of the English letters BC, and its full name is British Columbia. Vancouver is an important town for Chinese people. Before Hong Kong returned to China in 1997, Hong Kong people were afraid of the socialist authoritarian policies and immigrated in large numbers to live here. It became the largest Chinatown in North America after San Francisco. Some people even nicknamed it "Hong Kong China". Cantonese is the common language of the Chinese community. In recent years, the number of tourists from Taiwan and Mainland China has increased, and Mandarin conversation has gradually become more popular. This is my first time in Vancouver. I took a car to see the scenery. I saw everything fresh. There were many maple trees, with swaying maple leaves. There were more greens than yellows, and the reds were even rarer. I also saw mountains rising in the distance from the city, and there was an ocean outside. There were so many lakes on the roadsides. It seemed like "mountains and rivers meet each other" everywhere. The mountains and rivers were beautiful and the scenery was pleasant. I wasn't interested in a brief tour of the old city, but Taizu liked to go shopping in stores and buy warm clothes. I prefer the Chinatown flavor, which is particularly noteworthy. It is full of traditional Chinese culture. The operation of the shops is a bit like the Vietnam embankment in the past, which shows that the livelihood of old overseas Chinese in Guangdong is the same all over the world. Passing a narrow shop, a large vertical sign caught my eye: "Zhou Yongzhi──Yan Shu", the name resembles that of my brother, where is Yan Shu? The tour guide has to explain to Mandarin speakers that it is the Cantonese transliteration of "insurance". Not far away, I saw another old signboard: "Yungaohua Branch of the Chinese Kuomintang". It turned out that the early translation was not Vancouver, but Yungaohua. No wonder it was abbreviated as "Yunbu" or "Yuncheng". ah! Yuncheng, Yuncheng, is very poetic. We wandered here, admiring the clouds in Chinatown, which made me feel friendly. I passed by a bakery and bought a bag of sweet potato kettle and a box of chicken pancakes for snacks, reminiscing about the traditional flavor of my hometown. At noon, we gathered at a Chongqing restaurant for dinner, enjoying Yunchu’s Tang Dynasty cuisine and appreciating the Yuncheng Tang Dynasty atmosphere. We didn’t feel like a stranger in a foreign land at all. Unfortunately, everything passed quickly and the scenery disappeared in an instant. After lunch, we left like a calm cloud! All tourist attractions in Vancouver are quite famous and worth visiting in person. However, due to time constraints, tour groups cannot enjoy themselves as much as they want. They can only choose key areas to experience the fun. Tourists from all walks of life are busy taking photos and videos as souvenirs. The environment of Stanley Park is quite beautiful. The entrance of the park is vast and open, with a bronze statue of the old Governor Stanley. Facing the ocean, there are seven totem poles standing in the square on the east side. They are carved with various figures or bears and other beasts. They are colorful and unique in form. They are probably symbols representing various indigenous tribes. Queen Elizabeth Park has a pleasant scenery. The cherry blossoms and maple leaves are blooming with natural beauty and fragrance. Two Vietnamese couples like to join us, chatting and traveling together. They walk up the slope together and see interesting statues in the center. A photographer gestures with his hand not to block my lens. There are three other figures representing tourists dressed up and waiting to be photographed. These lifelike sculptures have become free models for us to capture the lens. Arrive in Whistler in the afternoon. It is even more famous. It is the largest ski resort in North America and the place where the 2010 Winter Olympics was held. The five-ring Olympic symbol is left to commemorate it, attracting many tourists and becoming a popular tourist destination. The place is vast and there are sights to admire everywhere, especially the bicycle fighters on the other side, which attract tourists to watch. They are all courageous young people. They take the cable car and bicycles to the top of the mountain, and then cycle from the peak to the foot of the mountain in a circuitous way. It is thrilling! In addition to visiting various scenic spots in person, the tour group also saw mountains, rivers and bays, blue skies and white clouds, flowers and trees, and lush green scenery along the way. There were also many beautiful and wonderful sights, such as the suspension bridge feature when passing through Ning Canyon, and a pair of lion statues on the way to and from Stanley Park. There are other places worth visiting on both sides of the iron bridge, called the Lions Gate Iron Bridge. However, if you want to see it in detail, take your time and travel freely to get what you want. The tour group uses collective measures to arrange the itinerary in a compact and time-sensitive manner. It is impossible to stay at each attraction for too long. As night fell, the tour group was already tired. They hurried to a Chinese restaurant for dinner and then returned to the Coast Hotel to rest and prepare for tomorrow's trip.

fdc558bdf0915bbb1513f060942863ba5700072b.sourceText: (续上期，译文 ) 反华法早在 1876 年就已出台，每当经济衰退挤压美国西部年轻的经济体时，就会通过更多的反华法。 移民法变得越来越严格，以至于家庭成员从中国回来后有时会被扔进海关滞留，即使他们有公民身份证明。 1919 年，邓悦宁（ Wing F. Ong） 作为一名 14 岁的船童来到美国，当时他在三藩市的天使岛被监禁了三个月，当局对他的公民身份进行了双重检查。邓悦宁虽然出生在中国，但他是公民，因为他的父亲是一名工人，出生在美国。
fdc558bdf0915bbb1513f060942863ba5700072b.translatedText: (Continued from previous issue, translation) Anti-Chinese laws were introduced as early as 1876, and more were passed whenever a recession squeezed the young economies of the American West. Immigration laws became increasingly strict, so that family members were sometimes thrown into customs detention after returning from China, even if they had proof of citizenship. In 1919, Wing F. Ong The 14-year-old boat boy arrived in the United States when he was imprisoned for three months on San Francisco's Angel Island, where authorities double-checked his citizenship. Although born in China, Deng Yuening was a citizen because his father, a laborer, was born in the United States.

13710fd5453eb4d6ad8643b310611088869894bb.sourceText: 在加利福尼亚州，成千上万的华人移居到田野、采矿营地和铁路上工作，一系列灾难性的经济问题导致了 1870 年代失业白人暴徒对华人的残酷迫害。一些中国人逃往亚利桑那州等州。
13710fd5453eb4d6ad8643b310611088869894bb.translatedText: In California, thousands of Chinese immigrated to work in the fields, mining camps, and railroads, and a series of disastrous economic problems led to the 1870s. The brutal persecution of Chinese by unemployed white mobs in the 1890s.

1d43de7ece3781355c0e42596f0b7b8f8feca095.sourceText: 到达亚利桑那州后，他们从未经历过针对沿海华人社区的暴力程度，但相反地，他们面临着同样持久的歧视。像邓楷隆这样的华人在 1890 年代来到这里，很容易成为当地媒体的目标，而且在大多数城镇，无论规模大小，都至少有一个反华仇恨团体。
1d43de7ece3781355c0e42596f0b7b8f8feca095.translatedText: Upon arriving in Arizona, they never experienced the level of violence directed against coastal Chinese communities, but instead faced the same persistent discrimination that Chinese like Deng Kailong did in the 1890s. Coming of age, it was easy to target the local media, and in most towns, large or small, there was at least one anti-Chinese hate group

9a7525e51be7f0014ecf6db571cb69f7845d4f09.sourceText: 《亚利桑那共和报》1956 年的一篇报道称，普雷斯科特和墓碑镇，而不是菲尼克斯，是“仇华者的温床”。（《共和报》的文章虽然颇有同情心，但没有指出它的前身亚利桑那州共和党人在华人刚抵达菲尼克斯时，媒体就带头进行了种族诱饵。1890年，当亚利桑那州的华人人口达到两位数时，该报显示，“狡猾的蒙古人应该被限制在尽可能小的区域内。”）
9a7525e51be7f0014ecf6db571cb69f7845d4f09.translatedText: The Arizona Republic 1956. A report in 1999 claimed that Prescott and Tombstone, not Phoenix, were "hotbeds of China-haters." (The Republic's article, while sympathetic, failed to note that its predecessor, the Arizona Republican, had spearheaded the race-baiting in 1890 when the Chinese first arrived in Phoenix. When the Chinese population reached double digits, the newspaper showed that "the cunning Mongolians should be confined to the smallest possible area.")

62baa8beef06521791e79267839a6f5f753c8403.sourceText: “当我还是个孩子的时候，即使在像老里亚托（凤凰城市中心）这样的三流剧院，中国人也必须坐在阳台上，”邓粤寅（ Fred Ong ）回忆道。 “即使是在允许西班牙裔进入主要区域的剧院，我们也必须呆在阳台上（观看）。”直到第二次世界大战结束后，他才可以找到任何具有永久性或有地位的工作，那时他和三个兄弟都已在武装部队服过役。去年（1990），来自亚利桑那州的唯一一位二战中的华裔战俘小亨利（邓粤寅的弟弟邓粤钿 Henry Ong Jr.）因其英勇行为获得了国会的表彰。
62baa8beef06521791e79267839a6f5f753c8403.translatedText: "When I was a child, even in third-rate theaters like the old Rialto (downtown Phoenix), the Chinese had to sit on the balcony," Deng Yueyin ( Fred Ong recalled, “Even in theaters where Hispanics were allowed in the main area, we had to stay in the balcony. " He was unable to find any job of permanent or status until after World War II, by which time he and his three brothers had already served in the armed forces. Last year (1990), Henry Ong Jr., the only Chinese-American prisoner of war in World War II, came from Arizona. Jr. was honored by Congress for his heroic actions.

b10ad2e4e5d334869f65e69f89961ce1d306560d.sourceText: 面对根深蒂固的偏见，邓氏和其他华人宗族建立的家族协会对于平衡他们的生存机会至关重要。通过邓氏协会，邓楷隆夫妇整合资源来资助新企业，为新移民提供社会和情感的支持，并照顾生病或年老的亲戚。“中国人不想去银行。因为他们必须披露所有信息，这可能会给他们带来移民麻烦，”邓粤钿说。
b10ad2e4e5d334869f65e69f89961ce1d306560d.translatedText: In the face of deep-seated prejudice, the family associations established by the Tangs and other Chinese clans were crucial to balancing their chances of survival. Through the Tangs, the Tangs pooled resources to fund new ventures, provide social and emotional support to newcomers, and care for sick or elderly relatives. Because they have to disclose all the information, it could get them into immigration trouble," said Deng Yuetian.

b554354dddb80a035f741e44a6bbc07e9b4f156c.sourceText: 虽然来自多种文化、有着牢固家庭关系的移民为了生存而联合起来，但很少有其他民族能够像华人家族协会那样参考如此复杂或组织良好的传统。这里的协会（宗亲团体），例如余氏家族协会、黄氏家族协会和龙岡家族协会，都是以这些氏族几个世纪以来发展起来的机构为蓝本的。在中国，邓氏的宗亲团体是由亲戚在广东省省会广州等城市建立的，为抵达城市上学的家庭成员提供寄宿处、邮递处、咨询中心和社交大厅。 做生意或参观。（邓粤寅和邓粤钿少年时曾回中国广州读高中和初中，所以中英文俱佳。两兄弟都做过中华商会的主席。编者注。）
b554354dddb80a035f741e44a6bbc07e9b4f156c.translatedText: While immigrants from many cultures with strong family ties band together to survive, few other ethnic groups can draw on such a complex or well-organized tradition as the Chinese Family Association. The association here Hui (clan groups) such as the Yu Clan Association, the Huang Clan Association, and the Longgang Clan Association were modeled on the institutions that these clans had developed over the centuries. In China, Deng's clan groups were established by relatives in cities such as Guangzhou, the capital of Guangdong Province, to provide boarding houses, post offices, counseling centers, and social halls for family members who arrived in the city to attend school. Doing business or visiting. (Deng Yueyin and Deng Yuedian went back to Guangzhou, China to attend high school and junior high school when they were young, so they are both good at Chinese and English. Both brothers have served as chairman of the Chinese Chamber of Commerce. Editor's note.)

be738bcca3a3669f207588dbf27071006f90731c.sourceText: 即使现在，家族对邓氏公所的依赖已经减少到每周一次的麻将比赛，和很少的社交场合，但该公所仍靠成员的奉献而得以维持。 “我父亲总是说你必须了解自己的文化才能成为一个更好的人。” 邓粤寅回忆道。
be738bcca3a3669f207588dbf27071006f90731c.translatedText: Even now, when the family's reliance on Deng's office has been reduced to a weekly mahjong match and few social occasions, the office remains afloat through the dedication of its members. "My father always said you have to understand your own culture to become a better person." Deng Yueyin recalled.

2bc5ece62d0f6e417d9d693c640e66ec246ef70a.sourceText: 凤凰城邓家的墙上挂着一幅写满中国书法的大卷轴。“这是我父亲写的邓氏家族的部分历史，” 邓粤钿说。 “我父亲以书法而闻名。尽管他几乎没有受过正规教育，但他是自学书法的，我们认为书法是一种艺术形式。”另一幅卷轴则传达了邓氏夫妇在家乡的一所学校对他们的良好祝愿，这所学校是他们在美国取得商业成功后捐赠的。就像 Ong Ko Met 的肖像一样，捐赠一所凤凰城的邓氏年轻人永远不会就读的学校的举动，是象征着战略价值，而不是感性价值。
2bc5ece62d0f6e417d9d693c640e66ec246ef70a.translatedText: A large scroll filled with Chinese calligraphy hangs on the wall of Deng's house in Phoenix City. "This is part of the history of the Deng family written by my father," Deng Yuedian said. "My father was famous for his calligraphy. Although he had little formal education, he taught himself calligraphy and we consider calligraphy an art form." Another scroll conveys the Deng couple's good wishes from a school in their hometown that they donated after their commercial success in the United States. Like Ong Ko Met's portrait, the act of donating a school that Phoenix's Tang youth will never attend symbolizes strategic rather than sentimental value.

fa93f2943b62c0d011c51518cfb68f60e883477e.sourceText: 邓粤寅的堂兄邓悦宁(Wing F. Ong) 后来成为凤凰城的一名律师，他也是第一位当选州立法机构议员的美籍华人，他和家乡的其他男孩一起坐在一棵树下开始接受正规教育。他的传记作者、亚利桑那州立大学社会学教授理查德·长泽说，人们期望邓悦宁死记硬背教义，并忠诚地为他的主人服务（或者接受殴打）。
fa93f2943b62c0d011c51518cfb68f60e883477e.translatedText: Deng Yueyin's cousin Wing F. Ong later became a lawyer in Phoenix and the first Chinese American elected to the state legislature. He began his formal education by sitting under a tree with other boys in his hometown. His biographer, Arizona State University sociology professor Richard Nagasawa, said Deng was expected to memorize teachings and serve his master loyally (or take a beating).

91f3cb43a33c8d4f0ecbf79f5fc7b9c3f4447db9.translatedText: Deng Yuening and Huang Meigui couple

0ce7153497a97deda6b429d6c75f8ba13d429c76.sourceText: 邓悦宁来到美国，雄心勃勃地学习英语。他在凤凰城加入了他叔叔邓楷隆的家庭，因为这里的学校会录取他。理查德·长泽在其 1986 年所写的邓悦宁传记《夏日之风》中表示，根据当时加州的法律，如果中国孩子不懂英语，他们甚至可能（并且已经）被排除在种族隔离学校之外。
0ce7153497a97deda6b429d6c75f8ba13d429c76.translatedText: Deng Yuening came to the United States and ambitiously learned English. He joined his uncle Deng Kailong's family in Phoenix because schools here would admit him. In his 1986 biography of Deng, "Summer Wind," Richard Nagasawa said that under California law at the time, Chinese children could even be (and were) excluded from segregated schools if they didn't understand English.

a24aa6c554ca868f50a0cc5480f1b9a445c5ea2e.sourceText: 到达凤凰城后，15 岁的邓悦宁在格兰特小学 (Grant Elementary School) 升入一年级，这是位于市中心以西亚当斯街 (Adams Street) 的一所新学校。 他用四年完成了小学学业，两年后从凤凰城联合高中毕业。
a24aa6c554ca868f50a0cc5480f1b9a445c5ea2e.translatedText: After arriving in Phoenix, 15-year-old Yuening Deng entered first grade at Grant Elementary School, a new school on Adams Street west of downtown. He completed elementary school in four years and graduated from Phoenix Union High School two years later.

dc3de2cb256c21c1fd48bb35f6d3bc73fd8e4bd5.sourceText: 邓悦宁第一次接触政治是在高中时期，当时他为州长托马斯·E·坎贝尔（Thomas E. Campbell）当男仆。坎贝尔夫妇对他印象深刻，后来帮助他完成了亚利桑那大学法学院的学业。 邓粤寅回忆道，他的堂兄邓悦宁“非常专注、雄心勃勃”。
dc3de2cb256c21c1fd48bb35f6d3bc73fd8e4bd5.translatedText: Deng Yuening’s first exposure to politics was in high school, when he worked as a valet for Governor Thomas E. Campbell. The Campbells were so impressed with him that they later helped him through law school at the University of Arizona. Deng Yueyin recalled that his cousin Deng Yuening was "very dedicated and ambitious."

79664712f1635fcd67dadf9dd441fbfb813f2211.sourceText: 邓悦宁的女儿玛德琳邓-坂田(Madeline Ong-Sakata) 说，他父亲性格外向、健谈，是美国习俗和政治的敏锐观察者。“爸爸了解这个系统，”她说。 “很多华裔美国人不知道如何玩这个游戏，但我父亲知道，而且他也玩过。”
79664712f1635fcd67dadf9dd441fbfb813f2211.translatedText: Deng Yuening's daughter, Madeline Ong-Sakata, said her father was outgoing, talkative and a keen observer of American customs and politics. “Dad knows the system,” she said. "A lot of Chinese-Americans don't know how to play this game, but my father knew it, and he played it."

99823d35b79c796f6bd942d0726738f8553698a4.sourceText: 与凤凰城的大多数第二代华人一样，邓悦宁最初跟随他的叔叔和堂兄进入家族企业。但据他的孩子们说，他的职业抱负超出了他这一代大多数人的抱负，并让他的一些亲戚感到震惊。
99823d35b79c796f6bd942d0726738f8553698a4.translatedText: Like most second-generation Chinese in Phoenix, Yuening Deng initially followed his uncle and cousin into the family business. But his career ambitions exceeded those of most of his generation and shocked some of his relatives, according to his children.

10da512dd476eb25a796cc9e69726aba4e2f6402.sourceText: 就在邓悦宁准备进入由叔叔邓楷隆安排的传统婚姻时，邓悦宁告知他想有一天成为一名律师。邓悦宁的女儿玛德琳说，她的父亲与 16 岁的母亲黄玫瑰（Rose Wong ）的婚姻承担了双向的义务，在她从中国赶来参加婚礼之前，他从未见过她。 “她答应支持他成为一名律师的目标，但作为回报，他必须承诺帮助她的兄弟姐妹移民，”玛德琳说。“这就是包办婚姻的运作方式。这是一个协议，双方都从中得到了一些东西。”
10da512dd476eb25a796cc9e69726aba4e2f6402.translatedText: Just as Deng Yuening was preparing to enter a traditional marriage arranged by his uncle Deng Kailong, Deng Yuening told him that he wanted to become a lawyer one day. Deng Yuening's daughter Madeline said her father's marriage to his 16-year-old mother, Rose Wong, was a two-way commitment and that he had never met her before she came from China for the wedding. "She promised to support his goal of becoming a lawyer, but in return he had to promise to help her siblings immigrate," Madeleine said. "That's how arranged marriage works. It's an agreement and both parties get something out of it."

744038d3a5b5c8f4d4d7ae9e1a04a29b44270c4b.sourceText: 他们的杂货店的利润以Penny（美分）计算，他们的第一个孩子在后面的房间里出生了。 尽管如此，玛德琳回忆道，“我父亲兑现了他的承诺，把我的叔叔和阿姨带来了，他们帮助妈妈经营商店，而我父亲则在图森上法学院。”
744038d3a5b5c8f4d4d7ae9e1a04a29b44270c4b.translatedText: Their grocery store's profits are measured in pennies, and their first child is born in the back room. Nonetheless, Madeleine recalled, "My father made good on his promise and brought my uncle and aunt over, and they helped mom run the store while my father went to law school in Tucson."

8e839bd5bc0681771562ee0d820678812e480e23.sourceText: （照片来自凤凰城博物馆和网络）

b1e43ca67734a0a41f31d44768ccc22de18aaccc.sourceText: 《亚利桑那州美国军团托马斯·邓 50 》 (AMERICAN LEGION OF ARIZONA THOMAS TANG POST 50) 一书是由亚省华裔军人 KWONG C.TANG 在 1997 年编写，由亚省华人退伍军人会出版。
b1e43ca67734a0a41f31d44768ccc22de18aaccc.translatedText: >The book "AMERICAN LEGION OF ARIZONA THOMAS TANG POST 50" was written in 1997 by KWONG C.TANG, a Chinese soldier from Alberta, and published by the Chinese Veterans Association of Alberta.

f3d98e3e7f9280f6ccad19018d51dedf69173256.sourceText: K.C.TANG 家中的三兄弟前后入伍当过兵，他在韩战中从事飞行大队的文职工作。这部二百馀页的书籍记载着第一次世界大战，第二次世界大战的资料，以及许多华裔军人的战迹和故事。
f3d98e3e7f9280f6ccad19018d51dedf69173256.translatedText: K.C.TANG The three brothers in the family enlisted in the army and served as soldiers. He worked as a civilian in the flying brigade during the Korean War. This book of more than 200 pages records information about the First World War and the Second World War, as well as the battle deeds and stories of many Chinese soldiers.

c69086b98a84ce6c8e36ba4a2eb8b64c4a747e6d.sourceText: 历年来，亚省华人华裔应徵参军，保家卫国。在第一次世界大战时期，亚省有两位华人应征当兵，一位是 Hong Ham ，另一位是 Dea hong Toy 即关祟琼先生，他在战争中负伤，是首位荣获“紫心勋章”的华裔军人。
c69086b98a84ce6c8e36ba4a2eb8b64c4a747e6d.translatedText: Over the years, Chinese people in Alberta have been drafted into the army to protect their homes and country. During the First World War, two Chinese men in Alberta were drafted into the army, one was Hong Ham and the other was Dea hong Toy, Mr. Guan Chongqiong. He was wounded in the war and was the first Chinese-American soldier to be awarded the "Purple Heart Medal".

428bc29387b210d7445b8ef0f9dcbe144f6ab3ea.sourceText: 第二次世界大战，书中记载有 79 位亚省华人子弟应徵当兵，报効美国，参加海、陆、空军和特种兵种，勇赴前线，浴血奋战，五位华裔军人为国捐躯，其中有三位是空军战士。
428bc29387b210d7445b8ef0f9dcbe144f6ab3ea.translatedText: During the Second World War, the book records that 79 Chinese people from Alberta were drafted into the army to serve the United States. They participated in the navy, army, air force and special forces. They bravely went to the front line and fought bloody battles. Five Chinese soldiers died for the country, three of them were air force soldiers.

c03117703e26022ed8cf77f1b75c66d389f4d05a.sourceText: 1950 年韩战爆发，亚省有 23 位华人子弟参军，有些是二次大战老兵重上战场，在海陆空各兵种都有华人参与。
c03117703e26022ed8cf77f1b75c66d389f4d05a.translatedText: When the Korean War broke out in 1950, 23 Chinese men from Alberta joined the army, some of whom were veterans of World War II and returned to the battlefield. Chinese participated in all branches of the military, including land, sea and air.

a26ea054254a6aa35fd7eb701069fb506abf88e6.sourceText: 在 1961 年至 1975 年越南战争中，亚省有 22 位华人服役，其中有多位从事文职和技术工作。还有一位在终端机服务的女军官。越战中有一位名为 Herbert Wong 的军人战死沙场。
a26ea054254a6aa35fd7eb701069fb506abf88e6.translatedText: In the Vietnam War from 1961 to 1975, 22 Chinese Americans served in Alberta, many of them in civilian and technical jobs. There is also a female officer serving at the terminal. A soldier named Herbert Wong died in the Vietnam War.

aed1be8a151d9fc9e85a5ab68b703d90a742498a.sourceText: 在其后的中东战争，海湾战争，伊拉克战争和阿富汗战争中，都有华裔应徵当兵，为国効劳。
aed1be8a151d9fc9e85a5ab68b703d90a742498a.translatedText: In the subsequent Middle East War, Gulf War, Iraq War and Afghanistan War, Chinese people were recruited as soldiers to serve their country.

004cf03f2794abd2dccad7dc121105ddabc51288.sourceText: 1950 年，由 44 位亚省退伍华人组成了“华裔军人会”。因为邓心平是一次大战老兵，德高望重，为了纪念他的贡献，华裔军人会之后改名为“邓心平退伍军人会”（ Thomas Tang Post 50) 。
004cf03f2794abd2dccad7dc121105ddabc51288.translatedText: In 1950, the "Chinese American Military Association" was formed by 44 retired Chinese from Alberta. Because Deng Xinping was a veteran of World War I and highly respected, in order to commemorate his contribution, the Chinese American Military Association later changed its name to "Deng Xinping Veterans Association" (Thomas Tang Post 50).

79c8221a329d6cb6fc112bdd0a71eb09c3d09318.sourceText: 在《邓心平退伍军人会》一书中，亚省华裔军人的履历，姓名和资料用英文记载，我们尽努力查到了其中部分军人的中文姓名。
79c8221a329d6cb6fc112bdd0a71eb09c3d09318.translatedText: In the book "Deng Xinping Veterans Association", the resumes, names and information of Chinese soldiers in Alberta are recorded in English. We have tried our best to find the Chinese names of some of the soldiers.

b9b4317fb6678383db5486fd6a11043647508d5f.sourceText: 华裔军人有很多优秀人才日后成为了社团的领导，给侨社增加了活力和动力。如一战老兵关关祟琼，热爱侨社，推动侨务，成为《斐匿侨联总会》第一届主席。二战老兵邓桐等也当过侨联总主席。越战退伍军人余自任，他在2005 年被选为侨联总会主席，并当上全美同源会的副总会长。
b9b4317fb6678383db5486fd6a11043647508d5f.translatedText: Many outstanding talents from the Chinese military have become leaders of the associations in the future, adding vitality and motivation to the overseas Chinese associations. For example, Guan Guan Chongqiong, a veteran of World War I, loved overseas Chinese communities, promoted overseas Chinese affairs, and became the first chairman of the "Fei Ni Overseas Chinese Federation". Deng Tong, a veteran of World War II, also served as the general chairman of the Overseas Chinese Federation. Yu Ziren, a Vietnam War veteran, was elected as the president of the Overseas Chinese Federation in 2005 and became the vice president of the All-American Federation.

08711e1b126076d164514ac5cddc68201b4e9dec.sourceText: 每年国庆，当退伍军人扛枪护旗进场时，会场一片庄严肃穆，在美国国旗上，有著亚省华人华裔军人的忠诚与奉献。我们向百多位曾保家卫国，如今已长眠在青草墓地中的退伍军人表示崇高的敬意，并献上一个个心中的花环。
08711e1b126076d164514ac5cddc68201b4e9dec.translatedText: Every National Day, when the veterans enter the venue carrying guns and protecting the flag, the venue is solemn and solemn. On the American flag, there is the loyalty and dedication of the Chinese soldiers in Alberta. We pay high respect to the more than a hundred veterans who have protected their families and the country and are now buried in the green grass cemetery, and lay wreaths in our hearts.

4940df879599b476d0c678445f85c33b12c1937d.sourceText: 送别战友邓桐臻 （ 2007 ） 摄影：张肇鸿
4940df879599b476d0c678445f85c33b12c1937d.translatedText: Farewell to comrade Deng Tongzhen (2007) Photography: Zhang Zhaohong

57564ecebd09618683110fe3e070c9397d473e3b.sourceText: 沙漠明珠 | 美国亚利桑那州华人历史（四十五）第四章：关崇琼家族（7）
57564ecebd09618683110fe3e070c9397d473e3b.translatedText: Pearl of the Desert | Chinese History of Arizona, USA (45) Chapter 4: Guan Chongqiong Family (7)

daac4b4e13956498b81856b7f0400daedb4980ee.sourceText: 亚利桑那华人历史协会：张肇鸿 关崇琼大儿子关卫理(William k.Toy) ，出生于 1921 年。193…
daac4b4e13956498b81856b7f0400daedb4980ee.translatedText: Arizona Chinese Historical Association: Zhang Zhaohong Guan Chongqiong’s eldest son Guan Weili (William k. Toy) was born in 1921. 193…

b21b6fe0ccf19729be63bea587afff47bdf465b7.sourceText: 关崇琼大儿子关卫理(William k.Toy) ，出生于 1921 年。1936年他在凤凰城高中毕业。1938 年加入亚利桑那州国民警卫队，1940年入伍美国陆军。他在俄克拉荷马州和德克萨斯州接受战前训练，并于 1942 年 12 月被任命为步兵少尉。同年被派往巴拿马，通并过北非和波斯湾前往中国、缅甸和印度战区的执行任务，担任步兵武器教官。之后担任中国陆军联络官，职责需要他参与中国军队的重建，因为中国军队准备在缅甸北部和中部打击日军。
b21b6fe0ccf19729be63bea587afff47bdf465b7.translatedText: >Guan Chongqiong’s eldest son Guan Weili (William k. Toy) was born in 1921. He graduated from Phoenix High School in 1936. He joined the Arizona National Guard in 1938 and enlisted in the U.S. Army in 1940. He received prewar training in Oklahoma and Texas and was commissioned a second lieutenant in the infantry in December 1942. In the same year, he was sent to Panama and served as an infantry weapons instructor through North Africa and the Persian Gulf to perform missions in theaters in China, Myanmar and India. He then served as a Chinese Army Liaison Officer, his duties requiring him to participate in the reconstruction of the Chinese Army as it prepared to attack Japanese forces in northern and central Burma.

8accca73b4aa7cc0acf2d36db7906ee3840de14c.sourceText: 二战期间，关卫理被史迪威将军送到英国学习，以便能够协助史迪威将军和麦克阿瑟将军在中国与日本人作战。他在回美国凤凰城作探访家庭时，留有照片和说明：
8accca73b4aa7cc0acf2d36db7906ee3840de14c.translatedText: During World War II, Wei-Li Kwan was sent to England by General Stilwell to study so that he could assist General Stilwell and General MacArthur in fighting the Japanese in China. When he returned to Phoenix to visit his family, he left photos and descriptions:

18ac2df705aa20563bd992566fc84ed58c0e1e66.sourceText: 我,一名上尉,在完成了对中国-缅甸-印度战线的第一次访问后，史迪威将军将我送到英国。于1945年春季在伯克利大学学习中文。我将能够协助史迪威将军和麦克阿瑟将军在中国与日本人作战。该课程历时四个月，完成后我回到了凤凰城，与家人进行了短暂的探访。很快就该告别再次回到CBI的战线了。 这张照片是在欢送会上拍摄的。 我的所有兄弟姐妹都在场，除了两个：大姐Sou（关秀容） ，她已婚并居住在芝加哥无法参加。 还有三弟Grey（关护理），他曾在陈纳德将军领导的第14航空队任职于美国空军中队。
18ac2df705aa20563bd992566fc84ed58c0e1e66.translatedText: I, a captain, was sent to England by General Stilwell after completing my first visit to the China-Burma-India front. Studied Chinese at Berkeley University in the spring of 1945. I would be able to assist Generals Stilwell and MacArthur in their fight against the Japanese in China. The program lasted four months, and upon completion I returned to Phoenix for a short visit with my family. Soon it will be time to say goodbye and return to the CBI front again. This photo was taken at the farewell party. All of my siblings were present except for two: the eldest sister Sou (Kwan Hsiu-yong), who is married and living in Chicago and was unable to attend. There is also a third brother, Gray (Guan Guannuo), who served in the United States Air Force squadron in the 14th Air Force under General Chennault.

e5adfb8a98cf857455436a446a822d3d1dadf8a9.sourceText: 1945 年，关卫理被分配到 CIG（中央情报局的前身）的杜鲁门政府期间担任白宫信使。1950 年，他受命前往韩国和日本，在盟军部队担任翻译和口译。回到美国本土后，在加利福尼亚州普雷西迪奥担任执行官。之后，他重新被部署到台湾军事顾问团担任步兵部队指挥官，随后在冲绳担任新闻官。
e5adfb8a98cf857455436a446a822d3d1dadf8a9.translatedText: In 1945, Kwan was assigned to CIG (the predecessor of the CIA) to serve as a White House messenger during the Truman administration. In 1950, he was commissioned to Korea and Japan, where he served as a translator and interpreter for Allied forces. After returning stateside, he served as an executive officer in Presidio, California. He then redeployed to the Taiwan Military Advisory Corps as an infantry unit commander and later served as a press officer in Okinawa.

1974ab43ece3eaf9fdca4702df8bd52ea85ea5bb.sourceText: 关卫理战功彪炳，获奖勋章包括有二战服役勋章；美国国防服务奖章；美国征战勋章；欧洲、非洲及中东征战奖章；占领军勋章（日本）；韩国服役勋章；联合国服务奖章；国防服役勋章；武装部队预备役勋章等等。关卫理在军中服役长这廿年，直到 1960 年退休时官拜中校，他是本州华人获得最高军阶者。他曾在州政府、市政府和众多退伍军人服务组织任职，包括担任过退伍军人会总指挥官等，在华人社区中，他担任过凤凰城龙岡社团的主席。
1974ab43ece3eaf9fdca4702df8bd52ea85ea5bb.translatedText: >Weili Guan has outstanding military exploits. His medals include the World War II Service Medal; the U.S. Defense Service Medal; the U.S. Campaign Medal; the European, African and Middle Eastern Campaign Medal; the Occupation Force Medal (Japan); the Korean Service Medal; the United Nations Service Medal; the National Defense Service Medal; the Armed Forces Reserve Medal, etc. Kwan served in the military for 20 years until his retirement in 1960 when he was promoted to lieutenant colonel. He was the highest military rank among Chinese in the state. He has served in state government, municipal government and numerous veterans service organizations, including serving as the commander-in-chief of the Veterans Association. In the Chinese community, he served as president of the Phoenix Longgang Association.

ca7c22978754351e738bb24ea6b4c263e618acee.sourceText: 关卫理在2002 年入选亚利桑那退伍军人名人堂，他在2008 年 2 月 24 日去世。
ca7c22978754351e738bb24ea6b4c263e618acee.translatedText: Kwan was inducted into the Arizona Veterans Hall of Fame in 2002. He died on February 24, 2008.

1a157ba7198a65a1020ade3fd3ff2ffe6ced2eec.sourceText: 关崇琼的三儿子关护理（Grey k.Toy），1923 年出生，毕业于北方高中和凤凰学院。1942年服役，加入美国陆军航空兵。成为一名特种兵。1943年1月，关护理进入俄亥俄州著名的赖特-帕特森空军基地，研习飞机仪器 – 导航 -投弹瞄准器和自动飞行控制。 1943年分配到北非战区。
1a157ba7198a65a1020ade3fd3ff2ffe6ced2eec.translatedText: >Guan Chongqiong’s third son, Guan Nursing (Grey k. Toy), was born in 1923 and graduated from Northern High School and Phoenix College. Entered service in 1942 and joined the U.S. Army Air Forces. Become a special forces soldier. In January 1943, Guan entered the famous Wright-Patterson Air Force Base in Ohio to study aircraft instruments-navigation-bomb sights and automatic flight control. Assigned to the North African Theater in 1943.

5080dd74ecc280e6ad197133ba41e86fbd7c8209.sourceText: 1944年至1945年12月，关护理去到中国，服务于中美空军第十四航空队(飞虎队)，成为第20大队轰炸司令部的一名成员，和中国军民一起打击日本帝国侵略者。关护理获得过欧洲-中东战区、大西洋-太平洋战区勋章等5枚奖章。 关护理于 1946 年光荣退役。
5080dd74ecc280e6ad197133ba41e86fbd7c8209.translatedText: From 1944 to December 1945, Guan went to China and served in the 14th Air Force (Flying Tigers) of the Chinese and American Air Forces. He became a member of the 20th Bomb Group and worked with Chinese soldiers and civilians to fight against the Japanese imperial invaders. Guan Nursing has won 5 medals including the European-Middle East Theater Medal and the Atlantic-Pacific Theater Medal. Kwan was honorably discharged in 1946.

451fc5705d5168dc8cecbd4a7550e94ce482c1a0.sourceText: 服役归来后，关护理管理家族的企业，包括杂货店和香格里拉餐厅。在晚年，他还开了一间渔具用品店。
451fc5705d5168dc8cecbd4a7550e94ce482c1a0.translatedText: After returning from the service, Guan took care of the family's businesses, including a grocery store and Shangri-La restaurant. In his later years, he also opened a fishing equipment store.

00b33e657a47ca94555cd619e70875a21ed96e74.sourceText: 和两个英雄的儿子（关家相册）
00b33e657a47ca94555cd619e70875a21ed96e74.translatedText: and two heroic sons (Guan family photo album)

015de7e4454f454c51c9b776fbd6c6a7c56e78ac.sourceText: 在关家族谱中，关崇琼的父亲关国莱娶了两房妻子：关崇琼是周氏所出，而关崇翼是黄氏所出。他们是同父异母的兄弟。关崇翼之子关永业(Quan,Wing Yip)，在二战中服务于美军第101师空降部队，参加了著名的进攻法国诺曼底的战役。当时他们的任务是确保桥梁安全，切断德国军队通信及补给。关永业在101师空降部队中是名一等兵，二次大战胜利后，他获得了包括＂欧洲-非州战役奖章＂等四枚奖章。
015de7e4454f454c51c9b776fbd6c6a7c56e78ac.translatedText: In the Guan family tree, Guan Chongqiong's father Guan Guolai married two wives: Guan Chongqiong was born to the Zhou family, and Guan Chongyi was born to the Huang family. They are half-brothers. Quan Wing Yip, the son of Guan Chongyi, served in the 101st Airborne Division of the US Army during World War II and participated in the famous attack on Normandy, France. Their mission at that time was to ensure the safety of the bridge and cut off the German army's communications and supplies. Guan Yongye was a first-class soldier in the 101st Division Airborne Force. After the victory of World War II, he won four medals including the "European-African Campaign Medal".

06a18533311df54811f66afc4617ce01b80a9e0e.sourceText: 在关家相册一张关永业的戎装照片，上面有行文字：祟琼四父叔惠存。这“父叔”是开平人的称呼，是指父亲的同辈兄弟，也就是“叔父”之意。关永业是凤凰城资深侨领关宗任的父亲。（续待）
06a18533311df54811f66afc4617ce01b80a9e0e.translatedText: In the Guan family photo album, there is a photo of Guan Yongye in military uniform, with the words: Chong Qiong's fourth father and uncle Huicun. This "Uncle Father" is a title from Kaiping people, referring to his father's brothers of the same generation, which also means "uncle". Guan Yongye is the father of Guan Zongren, a senior overseas Chinese leader in Phoenix City. (continued)

f41aa53dcc550137ea740e572c90934a269c59c4.sourceText: 吉伯特居民的幸运午餐 （亚省时报） 近日，吉伯特居民怀蒂奥斯丁女士被抽中，与另外三位来个全国各地的幸运儿一起，和总统奥巴马吃了顿午餐。 稍早前，奥斯丁女士通过obamaforamerica.com网站，向竞选连任的奥巴马总统捐了5美元，竟幸运地被抽中，6月15日，在离白宫不远的林肯饭店，与总统一起吃午饭。 饭桌上，奥斯丁女士透露，她与总统分享了与女儿相处的乐事（奥斯丁有个10岁的女儿，总统也有两个10来岁的千金），旅游趣闻等。总统还告诉她，本周末他将回芝加哥参加一个家族成员的婚礼。 奥斯丁女士是美莎市的东南谷房地产经纪人协会营销主任，她说，总统也很关心本州的房地产现状。 ”这是一个伟大的谈话，”她说，”我永远不会忘记。” 人说：百年修得同船渡,千年修得共枕眠。一顿午餐需要什么修为？5美元而已。
f41aa53dcc550137ea740e572c90934a269c59c4.translatedText: Gilbert resident's lucky lunch (Alberta Times) Recently, Gilbert resident Ms. Whitey Austin was drawn and had lunch with President Obama along with three other lucky people from across the country. Earlier, Ms. Austin donated $5 to President Obama's re-election campaign through the obamaforamerica.com website, and was lucky enough to be selected to have lunch with the President at the Lincoln Hotel not far from the White House on June 15. At the dinner table, Ms. Austin revealed that she shared with the president the joy of getting along with her daughter (Austin has a 10-year-old daughter, and the president also has two 10-year-old daughters), travel anecdotes, etc. The president also told her he would be returning to Chicago this weekend to attend a family wedding. Ms. Austin, director of marketing for the Southeast Valley Association of Realtors in Mesa, said the president is also concerned about the state of real estate in the state. "This was a great conversation," she said, "I will never forget it." People say: A hundred years of cultivation can make us cross the same boat, and a thousand years of cultivation can make us sleep together. What kind of cultivation is needed for a lunch? Only $5.

09c968456aaedd1800039651b4c29659a95a01cc.sourceText: 想存钱？凤凰城是好地方
09c968456aaedd1800039651b4c29659a95a01cc.translatedText: Want to save money? Phoenix is ​​a great place

cabd3372b123e91572b1b93262b6ede4969a8a5a.sourceText: 想存钱？凤凰城是好地方 选择理想的居住城市并非易事，大多数时候，人们必须从一个生活费较低的地区或生活费昂贵但高…
cabd3372b123e91572b1b93262b6ede4969a8a5a.translatedText: Want to save money? Phoenix is ​​a good place. Choosing the ideal city to live in is not easy. Most of the time, people have to choose from an area with a lower cost of living or an area with expensive living costs but high income...

a47f6915b4b1f917c83f99f33c4019a4f1240008.sourceText: 选择理想的居住城市并非易事，大多数时候，人们必须从一个生活费较低的地区或生活费昂贵但高收入地区之中选择一个。但美国也有一些生活费不贵且收入高的城市。
a47f6915b4b1f917c83f99f33c4019a4f1240008.translatedText: Choosing an ideal city to live in is not easy. Most of the time, people have to choose from an area with a low cost of living or an area with expensive living costs but high income. But there are also some cities in the United States where living costs are not expensive and incomes are high.

cfbb03907ec067369e5c6eb01fb805b5f16d1f22.sourceText: 美国知名理财网站GOBankingRates经过调查，发现一些平均年薪较高且生活成本较低的城市。
cfbb03907ec067369e5c6eb01fb805b5f16d1f22.translatedText: GOBankingRates, a well-known American financial website, conducted a survey and found some cities with higher average annual salary and lower cost of living.

0c8222cd34f88aaf36290f7a620f87e052ae8ffc.sourceText: 为了确定这些城市，GOBankingRates使用Zillow、Numbeo和美国人口普查局的数据，对美国270个城市进行分析和排名，在分析中，考虑到每个城市的房屋租金中位数、食品杂货费用、水电费施和交通运输等因素，最终确定该地区每月平均生活费用，然后从每个城市平均年收入中扣除平均花费，这样居民就知道他们在支出后还剩下多少钱。
0c8222cd34f88aaf36290f7a620f87e052ae8ffc.translatedText: To identify these cities, GOBankingRates used data from Zillow, Numbeo, and the U.S. Census Bureau to analyze and rank 270 U.S. cities. In its analysis, it took into account factors such as median home rent, grocery costs, utility bills, and transportation in each city to determine the average monthly cost of living in the area. The average cost was then deducted from each city's average annual income so residents know how much money they have left after spending.

88b9267cf1d1b00fc1bc7452eb936a42aab98a15.sourceText: GOBankingRates根据每个城市每年在扣除基本支出后剩余资金的数额，评选出全美10个收入高但生活费又不贵的城市。凤凰城以平均年收入：73,135美元高居地四名。
88b9267cf1d1b00fc1bc7452eb936a42aab98a15.translatedText: >GOBankingRates selects 10 cities in the United States with high incomes but low cost of living based on the amount of funds remaining in each city after deducting basic expenses each year. Phoenix ranks fourth with an average annual income of $73,135.

a8d26be642c74ff817c661d4bd156f258a6f3d07.sourceText: 以下是美国10个高工资、生活费用可负担得起的城市排名。
a8d26be642c74ff817c661d4bd156f258a6f3d07.translatedText: The following is a ranking of 10 cities in the United States with high wages and affordable living expenses.

d3ab93683215abbdf943eb182bd882ecd1d8c361.sourceText: 1. 俄克拉荷马城（Oklahoma City），俄克拉荷马州

ab92acafaad1baad8c6e5b231e76b4157c673d82.sourceText: 平均年收入：72,385美元 月租金中位数：1,070美元 年度必需生活开支：18,701美元
ab92acafaad1baad8c6e5b231e76b4157c673d82.translatedText: Average annual income: $72,385 Median monthly rent: $1,070 Annual necessary living expenses: $18,701

a40880f84489013acb241c45962e10bffd3133c2.sourceText: 2. 堪萨斯城（Kansas City），密苏里州

d97c9793008e853e08df4be10c2169b381e715de.translatedText: Republican rising star Senator Marco Rubio and other lawmakers introduced an immigration reform bill on Monday. "The New York Times"

8cbdeb186d07ca547a540bf5f145090e90ebbd36.sourceText: 去年大选，亚太裔中投给奥巴马总统的支持选票占了亚太裔选民的73%。全面移民改革法案开始实施，亚太裔当中的非法移民，也有了转正的机会。 亚美正义中心(The Asian American Justice Center)总裁莫美指出，全美共有100万个亚裔非法移民；在梦想法案涉及的学生之中，就有十分之一为亚裔。她说，全面移民改革法案，除将协助1100万非法移民合法化，并将允许外籍高科技硕博士直接拿绿卡，又将缓解目前的积压移民申请案。移民局积压的移民案中，亚裔人士就占了200多万件。五个积压移民申请案最多的国家中，亚洲国家就有四个。她说，新移民法案将缓解目前的积压案件，这也是亚裔应该支持参院移民案的原因。
8cbdeb186d07ca547a540bf5f145090e90ebbd36.translatedText: In last year's general election, Asian-Pacific Americans voted for President Obama, accounting for 73% of the votes cast by Asian-Pacific Americans. With the implementation of the Comprehensive Immigration Reform Act, illegal immigrants among Asian and Pacific Islanders also have the opportunity to become regular immigrants. Mo Mei, president of The Asian American Justice Center, pointed out that there are 1 million illegal Asian immigrants in the United States; among the students affected by the Dream Act, one in ten is Asian. She said that the comprehensive immigration reform bill will not only help legalize 11 million illegal immigrants, but also allow foreign high-tech masters and PhDs to directly obtain green cards, and will also ease the current backlog of immigration applications. Asians account for more than 2 million of the backlog of immigration cases in the Immigration Bureau. Four of the five countries with the largest backlogs of immigration applications are in Asia. She said that the new immigration bill will alleviate the current backlog of cases, which is why Asians should support the Senate immigration case.

b94a3e7c8c2df8beeca98e90d66d8e70df72a9f1.sourceText: 参院拟提留住中印人才移民法案
b94a3e7c8c2df8beeca98e90d66d8e70df72a9f1.translatedText: The Senate intends to propose a bill to retain Chinese and Indian talent immigration

da2b00d54ba427613a74e9f4a9aba5e790001439.sourceText: 国会参议院一批民主、共和两党参议员公布了他们所提出的移民改革提案的细节。参议员舒默（Charles Schumer）称参院两党在移民法修改问题上达成协议是一个重大的突破。
da2b00d54ba427613a74e9f4a9aba5e790001439.translatedText: A group of Democratic and Republican senators in the Senate announced the details of their proposed immigration reform proposals. Senator Charles Schumer called the agreement between the two parties in the Senate on changes to immigration laws a major breakthrough.

a059a88228f0b4a51d279a789d8c4f0660ebd46c.sourceText: 国会两党参议员的移民改革法建议增加高科技人才绿卡，在美国大学取得科学、数学和工程专业硕士以上学位的非法移民，均可得到绿卡，以便协助美国吸引和留住全世界的高科技 人才。
a059a88228f0b4a51d279a789d8c4f0660ebd46c.translatedText: The immigration reform law proposed by senators from both parties in Congress proposes to increase the number of green cards for high-tech talents. Illegal immigrants who have obtained a master's degree or above in science, mathematics and engineering from American universities can obtain green cards to help the United States attract and retain high-tech talents from around the world.

f6239190c5b0d83763066d2316a8db386360451c.sourceText: 移民改革蓝图指出：我们培养世界未来的发明家和企业家，在他们最能为美国经济做出贡献的时刻，最终却要迫使他们离开美国，这在教育上没有任何意义。
f6239190c5b0d83763066d2316a8db386360451c.translatedText: The Immigration Reform Blueprint states: It makes no educational sense for us to train the world's future inventors and entrepreneurs at the moment when they can most contribute to the U.S. economy, but ultimately force them to leave the United States.

82e414d81cd9c3da96c30b05d8154513481fdb70.sourceText: 据纽约客杂志(The New Yorker)报导，留住中国、印度和巴西等国的部分杰出科学家和编程师，使他们成为美国的高科技人才，是具有战略意义的步骤。 经济创新与增长如今愈易依赖人力资本，而不是单靠金融资本。 为科学专业毕业的高科技人才发放绿卡，受到矽谷和美国各地企业的欢迎，可吸引高科技人才充实Google和微软等公司，将大大增进美国的创业精神，移民创办的企业比土生土长的美国人高 出一倍。
82e414d81cd9c3da96c30b05d8154513481fdb70.translatedText: According to The New Yorker magazine, retaining some outstanding scientists and programmers from China, India, Brazil and other countries and turning them into high-tech talents in the United States is a step of strategic significance. Economic innovation and growth are now increasingly dependent on human capital rather than financial capital alone. Issuing green cards to high-tech talents who have graduated from science majors is welcomed by Silicon Valley and companies across the United States. It can attract high-tech talents to enrich companies such as Google and Microsoft. It will greatly enhance the entrepreneurial spirit in the United States. The number of companies founded by immigrants is twice as high as that of native-born Americans.

7f178c4e3cb836486faf7b49496819c8af4eb9f6.sourceText: 但给高科技人才获得绿卡，除将增加美国的技术熟练人才外，还可能导致薪资降低，从而使美国出生的科学专业的毕业生受到影响。
7f178c4e3cb836486faf7b49496819c8af4eb9f6.translatedText: However, granting green cards to high-tech talents will not only increase the number of skilled talents in the United States, but may also lead to lower wages, thus affecting U.S.-born science graduates.

cd6f916eb027b0beaaa7a2b51b2b01f32e00819b.sourceText: 增加高科技人才的绿卡，还将使没有高科技文凭的移民受到影响。 国会众院去年在通过STEM就业法案时，同意增加5万5000个高科技人才绿卡，但同时要相等削减其他移民类别的绿卡。 民主党和白宫虽然将在谈判中继续坚持，新增的高科技绿卡不应影响到其他类别的移民，但为了促使通过移民法，民主党人乐意在这方面做出让步。
cd6f916eb027b0beaaa7a2b51b2b01f32e00819b.translatedText: Increasing green cards for high-tech talents will also affect immigrants without high-tech diplomas. When the House of Representatives passed the STEM Employment Act last year, it agreed to increase the number of green cards for high-tech talents by 55,000, but at the same time cut green cards for other immigration categories equally. Although the Democrats and the White House will continue to insist in negotiations that the new high-tech green cards should not affect other categories of immigrants, Democrats are willing to make concessions in this regard in order to promote the passage of immigration laws.

e9a2067d34fd90088e8e4dbcd1e7248b06f359a8.sourceText: 高科技人才绿卡的实施可能有一定难度，部分只需一年即可读完的硕士计划，将会吸引大批外国学生涌入，使得外国人充斥在学费低廉的大学，导致高科技人才的绿卡 计画被滥用。 而拿到绿卡后，许多移民可能将选择到华尔街工作，而不是去矽谷或底特律。
e9a2067d34fd90088e8e4dbcd1e7248b06f359a8.translatedText: The implementation of green cards for high-tech talents may be difficult. Some master's programs that only take one year to complete will attract a large influx of foreign students, flooding universities with low tuition fees and causing the green card program for high-tech talents to be abused. After getting green cards, many immigrants may choose to work on Wall Street instead of going to Silicon Valley or Detroit.

ad53cd00cfa6fd5da9bd52dca6b3d25f5d5cad67.sourceText: 移民改革仍面临共和党顽强抵抗 移民改革提案仍将面临国会共和党众议员的顽强抵抗。《纽约时报》的文章说，南卡罗莱纳州格林威尔市的托米餐馆（Tommy抯 Country Ham House）是当地边议论政治边享受美食的好去处，这一点自从2007年以来并没有变化。而在2007年当地保守派清楚表明他们对于”大赦”非法移民的态度。
ad53cd00cfa6fd5da9bd52dca6b3d25f5d5cad67.translatedText: Immigration reform still faces stubborn resistance from Republicans. Immigration reform proposals will still face stubborn resistance from Republican members of Congress. The "New York Times" article said that Tommy's Country Ham House in Greenville, South Carolina, is a good place for locals to discuss politics while enjoying good food. This has not changed since 2007. In 2007, local conservatives clearly stated their attitude toward "amnesty" for illegal immigrants.

12c43cd86e6908f954f2b5d221d1563932fa223d.sourceText: 新教学给美术课带来了新效应（组图） 希望中文学校来稿 关心孩子画画的家长你们好， 前几年咱们凤凰城只学儿童画，这两年家长又都送孩子学素描，但不知以上两种方法都距离独立绘画这条路，相差很远。并且还会出现以下两种情况，第一，几年素描下来，后面学什么，可能由于色彩部分没人教了，前面的学习也就被荒废了，时间金钱的支出也被搭进去了。第二，先学几年素描，再学几年色彩，这种双倍的支出会让家长望而生畏！加上繁多的功课，都会使学画这条路中途而废而最终没能学出来。以上都是家长盲目性和不懂绘画造成的！ 自从2012年赵彩虹担任”希望中文学校”校长以来，给予美术班教学很大支持和重视，并在教学改进上给予了重望！从2011年素描，色彩同步教学后，又向美术班提出，你是美术老师又一直在画油画，有没一种再好的学习方法，可让我们”希望中文学校”学子，在最短时间里学习到独立绘画的能力？棗我明白这是在教学上，对老师的一个挑战，也是对”希望中文学校”教德上的一个挑战！ 在美术班信老师的积极配合下，在今年上半年，在色彩素描同步教学基础上，又往前跨进了一大步：”根据素描造型，色彩也造型”这样一个绘画规律，今年又进一步推出：用”直接立体色彩造型”来代替”慢速素描铅笔造型”。由于这种方法符合了绘画规律，结果获得了在6岁7岁孩子们身上的可喜效应！并让孩子在第一时间里就树立了对绘画的自信心，一幅幅以前认为持久战才能学习得到东西，在最短时间里就变得可望可及！ 这种方法是根据19世纪的塞尚，就是最早使用直接立体色彩造型的。凡高也就是，直接用他那近似孩子般对色彩的直觉，尤其是他那强烈的黄色创造出了他最神秘的艺术价值！为什么200年后，我们不能把这种方法也教给我们的孩子们呢？这是一种简捷又提高独立绘画能力的方法！”希望中文学校”美术教学上的这一个重大突破，给学习画画的孩子提供了最大的方便，可以在最时间里，直接把方法学到学走，还可以给家长在支出上节省了一大笔，至少是3年的开支！ ”希望中文学校”的这种做法和思路，实实在在为提高学习能力，和突出教育功德的一件事半功倍的做法！为了孩子的学习和教育，我们希望把这种新的学习方法，向广大孩子们推广，让广大家长都来观注，让广大热爱画画的孩子都来得到这之中的益处！我们?#24076;望中文学校?#20026;此也大开了招生之门，让孩子们早点跨进来，让家长早点节省您的开支。也希望新来的孩子和我们之前的孩子一样，早日学到实际方法，实现你绘画的最终目的。 Eric 9岁 乐乐 11岁 咪咪 12岁 (2) 咪咪 12岁 (3) 咪咪 12岁 逍逍 5岁半 (2) 逍逍 5岁半
12c43cd86e6908f954f2b5d221d1563932fa223d.translatedText: > The new teaching has brought new effects to art classes (photo group). We hope Chinese schools can submit contributions. Hello parents who care about their children's drawing, In the past few years, we in Phoenix only learned children's painting. In the past two years, parents have sent their children to learn sketching. However, I don't know that the above two methods are far from the road of independent painting. And the following two situations will occur. First, after a few years of sketching, what to learn later may be because no one will teach the color part, so the previous learning will be wasted, and the expenditure of time and money will also be used. Second, learning sketching for a few years first, and then learning color for a few more years. This double expense will be daunting to parents! Coupled with a lot of homework, the road to learning painting will be abandoned halfway and ultimately failed to be learned. The above are all caused by parents’ blindness and ignorance of painting! Since Zhao Caihong became the principal of "Hope Chinese School" in 2012, he has given great support and attention to the teaching of art classes, and has given great hope in teaching improvement! After the simultaneous teaching of sketching and color in 2011, I asked the art class, "You are an art teacher and you have been painting oil paintings. Is there a better learning method that can allow our "Hope Chinese School" students to learn the ability to paint independently in the shortest time?" I understand that this is a challenge to teachers in terms of teaching, and it is also a challenge to the teaching ethics of "Hope Chinese School"! With the active cooperation of teacher Xin from the art class, in the first half of this year, based on the synchronous teaching of color sketching, we took a big step forward: the painting rule "according to the sketch shape, the color also shapes the shape" was further introduced this year: using "direct three-dimensional color modeling" to replace the "slow sketch pencil shape". Since this method complies with the rules of painting, the results have been gratifying on children aged 6 and 7 years old! And let the children establish their self-confidence in painting in the first time. What they thought was a protracted struggle to learn becomes achievable in the shortest time! This method is based on Cezanne in the 19th century, who was the first to use direct three-dimensional color modeling. That is to say, Van Gogh directly used his child-like intuition for color, especially his strong yellow, to create his most mysterious artistic value! Why can’t we teach this method to our children 200 years later? This is a simple and easy way to improve independent drawing skills! This major breakthrough in the art teaching of "Hope Chinese School" provides the greatest convenience for children learning to draw. They can learn the method directly in the shortest time. It can also save parents a lot of money, at least for three years! The approach and thinking of "Hope Chinese School" is truly a way to improve learning ability and highlight the merits of education, which is a way to get twice the result with half the effort! For the sake of children's learning and education, we hope to promote this new learning method to the majority of children, let the majority of parents pay attention, and let the majority of children who love painting benefit from it! We?#24076;Hope Chinese School?#20026;This also opens the door to enrollment, allowing children to enter early and parents to save your expenses early. I also hope that the new children, like our previous children, will learn practical methods as soon as possible to achieve the ultimate goal of your painting. Eric is 9 years old, Lele is 11 years old, Mimi is 12 years old (2) Mimi is 12 years old (3) Mimi is 12 years old, Xiaoxiao is 5 and a half years old (2) Xiaoxiao is 5 and a half years old
