7d4a7488899e3beda88bfed3790e6755f8a530b2.sourceText: 洛杉矶古冬：「作家」也者 年前回香港，得到香港作家协会副主席林荫兄一张名片。依足一般名片的格式 ，在职衔一行，即名字上面，林兄印了四个小字：「专栏作家」。最近再回香港，老朋友副主席的宝座依然坐稳，名片却翻了新花样，「专栏作家」变成「专业作家」了。我逗他说：「老兄终于成家，恭喜了！」谁知他竟板起面孔回答说：「给人骂得多了！你也该骂，招牌都扛出来了，还要躲躲闪闪！」原因是为了便于与文友联系，我也印了份名片，以洛城作协会员的名义行头，下面另加「自由作者」四个小字。为此林兄很不客气的质问：「自由作者是什么意思，别的作者就不自由了吗？」 倒不是小的谦逊过人。即便是我们协会的会长周愚先生，都声言自己从未自认 作家哩！是否因为「作家」这顶帽子太大太重，抑或太招摇了，戴起来不好受，所以大家都避之唯恐不及了？ 问题显然出在「家」字上面。而归根结蒂，相信还是文人相轻这个老毛病在作 怪。你也算作家呀？只怕才露出一点点口风，那边已有人撇着嘴皮说：「自高身价，得啦！」甚至公然给你加上引号，指为自我标榜，加以嘲讽。一些本来就欠缺斤两的晚辈如古冬之流，给他们一唬，脚都软了，为示「谦厚」，只好在小卡片上加以诠释，在下仅是作家协会里面一名小作者，本已羞惭不已，求大爷网开一面，高抬贵手啦！ 然话说回来，文友们一眼便看出，名片上既然有了作家协会主席或会员的名分 ，下面的「专业作家」、「自由作者」便是架床叠屋，累赘多余。还是周会长高明，一句「自由投稿业余作者」，巧妙地避过了判官老爷们的棍子，令古冬不由得拍髀叫好！ 那么，作家真是那么尊贵，那么高不可攀么？却又未必。如果你像金庸、倪匡 他们，著作等身，堆积成金，无疑令人敬慕，令人景仰。像林荫他们也不错，作品推踢而出，作文养家而卓然有余，可谓真正的「作家」。可是除了数得出的少数高手之外，海外的作者真能「作」到家肥屋润的，又有几人呢？告诉你，我们出书几乎都是自掏腰包的，在报章发表文章大半是没有稿费拿的！诚然文章有别于纸币，两者不宜相提并论，但说实在话，当一名生财乏术的穷作家，总不见得特别光彩吧！ 照词典的解释，「作家」也者，一名「写作文章」的人而已。说俗一点，即一 名爱玩文字游戏，精于无中生有瞎吹牛皮的人而己！ 大陆的学生有句顺口溜：「男学工，女学医，调皮捣蛋的学文艺。」工与医， 还有商与法，皆是硬绷绷的真才实学，须遵循一定的章法，要一板一眼的去学去做，不可以胡来。而文艺，则可以自行创作，自由发挥，所凭的是才气，要讲的是技巧，或者多少还得带点浪漫与不羁，可说是华而不实了。所以人家叫「师」，而我们称「家」，这当中想必不无道理吧！ 从前有些作家自视甚高，动辄要教训人。现在可不行了，文章写得比你好的人 多的是，别人不要的草包，你还抱着当宝贝，才是笑大人家的肚皮！等着瞧吧，用不着谁批斗谁，家里的电脑电视，迟早会把你们赶尽杀绝！ 在此情此景之下，依然妙笔生花，不断有鸿篇巨制推出的能者，已是自成一家 ，根本不在乎你怎样看待他了。苦的是我们这些小作者，误入歧途，在一篇文章换 不到一包花生米的景况下，还执迷不悟，死撑到底，甘为片言只字呕心沥血，而只能望「家」兴叹。要是大爷们尚有一点恻隐之心的话，就请收起你的棍子，让我们爬过作家大家庭的门槛，以便借助那儿的炉火，煮几个字聊以充饥好不好？ 由作家，或者叫写作人所组成的家，叫作家协会，或者不叫作家协会，名称不同，实际一样，都是驿站一个吧了。前面仍然荆棘满途，同道中人，不论从哪一个门口出来，途中产生不同的组合，都是为了互相照应，互相扶持，而不是互相排挤，互相白眼啊！
7d4a7488899e3beda88bfed3790e6755f8a530b2.translatedText: >Los Angeles Gu Dong: "Writer" I returned to Hong Kong two years ago and got a business card from Brother Lam Yin, the vice chairman of the Hong Kong Writers Association. Following the format of a general business card, Brother Lin printed four small characters on the title line, that is, above the name: "Columnist." I recently returned to Hong Kong. My old friend's position as vice chairman is still secure, but his business card has been transformed into a new one. The "columnist" has become a "professional writer." I teased him and said, "Brother, I finally got married. Congratulations!" Unexpectedly, he replied with a straight face: "I get scolded a lot! You deserve to be scolded too. You have to show off your brand name and still have to dodge it!" The reason was that in order to facilitate contact with literary friends, I also printed a business card and wore it in the name of a member of the Los Angeles Writers Association, with the four small words "freelance author" underneath. For this reason, Brother Lin asked rudely: "What does it mean to be a free author? Aren't other authors free?" It's not that Xiao Xiao is extremely humble. Even Mr. Zhou Yu, the president of our association, claims that he has never considered himself a writer! Is it because the hat of "writer" is too big and heavy, or is it too ostentatious and uncomfortable to wear, so everyone avoids it? The problem obviously lies in the word "home". In the final analysis, I believe that the old problem of literati being indifferent to each other is at work. Are you considered a writer too? I'm afraid if you just show off a little bit, someone over there will already curl their lips and say, "Come on, come on!" They may even openly put quotation marks on you to point out that you are self-proclaimed and to ridicule you. Some juniors like Gu Dong, who were already lacking in talent, were given a bluff and their feet were weak. In order to show "humility", they had to explain it on a small card. I am just a young author in the Writers Association. I am already ashamed. Please be kind and show your respect! But having said that, literary friends can see at a glance that since the title of chairman or member of the Writers Association is on the business card, the words "professional writer" and "freelance writer" below are just a redundant and redundant thing. It was Chairman Zhou who cleverly avoided the judges' sticks by saying "Free submissions for amateur authors", which made Gu Dong couldn't help but clapped his forehead and applauded! So, is a writer really that noble and unattainable? But not necessarily. If you are like Jin Yong and Ni Kuang, with numerous works piled up into gold, you will undoubtedly be admired and admired. Lin Yin and others are also good. Their works are well-received and they can support their families with their writing. They can be called real "writers". But except for a few masters who can be counted, how many overseas authors can really "write" to make a living? Let me tell you, we almost all publish books out of our own pockets, and most of the articles we publish in newspapers are free of royalties! It is true that articles are different from paper money, and the two should not be compared with each other, but to be honest, being a poor writer who has no way to make money is not necessarily particularly glorious! According to the dictionary's explanation, "writer" is just a person who "writes articles". To put it bluntly, he is a person who loves to play word games and is good at making things out of nothing! Mainland students have a saying: "Men study engineering, women study medicine, and the naughty ones study literature and art." Engineering and medicine, as well as business and law, are all hard and real studies that must follow certain rules and regulations. They must learn and do things in a strict manner, and no random things are allowed. As for literature and art, you can create on your own and express yourself freely. It relies on talent and skills, or it must be somewhat romantic and uninhibited, which can be said to be flashy. So people call us "teachers" and we call them "home". There must be some reason for this! In the past, some writers thought very highly of themselves and were always willing to lecture others. It's no longer possible. There are many people who write better articles than you. You still hold the idiots that others don't want as your treasures, and you are laughing at other people's belly! Just wait and see, there is no need to criticize anyone, the computer and TV at home will sooner or later kill you all! Under this situation, wonderful works are still produced, and great works are constantly being released by talented people. They are already in a class of their own, and they don't care what you think of them. The sad thing is that we young writers have gone astray. When we can't exchange an article for a bag of peanuts, we are still stubborn and persist to the end. We are willing to work hard for just a few words, but we can only look forward to "home". If you still have a little compassion, please put away your stick and let us climb over the threshold of the writer's family, so that we can use the fire there to cook a few words to satisfy our hunger, okay? A family composed of writers, or writers, is called a Writers Association, or it may not be called a Writers Association. The name is different, but in fact it is the same. They are all one inn. The road ahead is still full of thorns. No matter which door we come out of, people on the same path will form different combinations along the way, all for the purpose of taking care of each other and supporting each other, instead of excluding each other and looking down at each other!

ee3fb85cf8784b6f7231ef3738cd315f6d212381.sourceText: 亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院讲座：才子与佳人 —-唐传奇《李娃传》的考古诠释 2012年11月4日，亚利桑那州立大学人文学院及亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院有幸邀请到北京大学考古文博学院的齐东方教授来亚利桑那州立大学讲授一场题为”才子与佳人-唐传奇《李娃传》的考古诠释”的讲座。本讲座将于11月4日周日下午一点在亚利桑那州立大学人文学院60教室举行(LL Building Floor Basement Room 60 http://www.asu.edu/map/interactive/?campus=tempe&building=LL )。此次讲座使用中文，对亚利桑那州的民众免费开放，欢迎广大民众届时前来参加这场丰富的文化盛宴。 众所周知，”才子佳人”是中国传统文化中男女婚姻最理想、最美妙的搭配。唐传奇小说《李娃传》描述的人物容貌、服饰、道具、场景、环境、空间等，保留了许多当时生活的素材。这个故事以爱情与世态人情为题材，通过人物 的人生、境遇来表现人性，具有浪漫主义色彩。它在人物塑造上带有强烈的现实性与明确的时代性；在叙事的结构上，呈现网状交织的场景。故事发生在长安城内，所以小说中穿插着人物的容貌、服饰、烘托故事情节的道具、环境等很多素材。考古发现的很多古代绘画、石刻、雕塑、器物、遗迹，可靠地构成了时空综合系统，是古代社会的缩影，将零散的考古发现，与正史文献、笔记小说进行一次重组，或许可以《李娃传》的文字描述形象化，人物行为立体化，故事事件空间化，构建出唐代丰富生动的社会生活，激活历史的记忆。 齐东方教授主要研究汉唐时期考古、历史、文物与美术史。著有《丝绸之路棗通向中亚的历史故道》、《中国通史 隋唐史 隋唐考古》、《唐代金银器研究》、《走进死亡之海》等著作，并主编《花舞大唐春》考古报告。
ee3fb85cf8784b6f7231ef3738cd315f6d212381.translatedText: Lecture by the Confucius Institute at Arizona State University: Talents and Beauties—The Archaeological Interpretation of the Legend of Tang Dynasty's "The Legend of Li Wa" On November 4, 2012, the College of Humanities at Arizona State University and the Confucius Institute at Arizona State University were honored to invite Professor Qi Dongfang from the School of Archeology and Museology at Peking University to give a lecture at Arizona State University entitled "Gifts and Beauties - Archaeological Interpretation of the Tang Legend "Li Wa"". This lecture will be held on Sunday, November 4th at 1:00 pm in Room 60, School of Humanities, Arizona State University (LL Building Floor Basement Room 60 http://www.asu.edu/map/interactive/?campus=tempe&building=LL). This lecture is in Chinese and is free and open to the people of Arizona. The general public is welcome to come and participate in this rich cultural feast. As we all know, "talented scholars and beautiful ladies" are the most ideal and wonderful combination of marriage between men and women in traditional Chinese culture. The characters' appearances, costumes, props, scenes, environments, spaces, etc. described in the Tang Dynasty's legendary novel "The Story of Li Wa" retain many materials from life at that time. This story takes love and human relationships as its themes, and expresses human nature through the characters' lives and circumstances, which is romantic. It has a strong sense of reality and clear contemporary character in character creation; in terms of narrative structure, it presents a network of intertwined scenes. The story takes place in Chang'an City, so the novel is interspersed with many materials such as the characters' appearance, clothing, props, and environment to highlight the plot. Many ancient paintings, stone carvings, sculptures, utensils, and relics discovered by archaeologists reliably form a comprehensive system of time and space, which is a microcosm of ancient society. By reorganizing the scattered archaeological discoveries with official historical documents and notebook novels, it may be possible to visualize the text descriptions in "The Biography of Li Wa", make the characters' behaviors three-dimensional, and make the story events spatial, construct a rich and vivid social life in the Tang Dynasty, and activate the memory of history. Professor Qi Dongfang mainly studies archeology, history, cultural relics and art history during the Han and Tang Dynasties. He is the author of "The Historical Route of the Silk Road to Central Asia", "General History of China, History of the Sui and Tang Dynasties, Archeology of the Sui and Tang Dynasties", "Research on Gold and Silverware of the Tang Dynasty", "Into the Sea of ​​Death", etc., and edited the archaeological report "Flowers Dance in the Spring of the Tang Dynasty".

121e68975fc06c65ecbcdb4e4693ca1ffe0f75a7.sourceText: ​ ( 摄影 艺柳白） 冯小刚执导的电影《芳华》受到了国内外朋友的广泛关注，那是讲述70-80 年代中国文工团成员的生活，在一个物质生活并不富裕的年代，体现普通百姓对艺术的向往，其中有生活的酸甜苦辣，又有艺术路上的艰辛历程，更有艺术的享受和辉煌。9 月23 日晚在美莎艺术中心，第三届亚省中秋舞蹈节圆满落幕。一百多位来自亚省艺术学院和希望中文学校的演员们将一场近三个小时的精彩演出奉献给亚省观众。身在海外的华人，物质生活大都没有太大的压力，唱唱歌，跳跳舞就成为了生活中的重要组成部分。这里的小演员最小的只有3 岁，年纪最大的演员有60 岁。从充满童趣的舞蹈《小花旦》，《阿里郎》到开场舞《欢乐的跳吧》小演员享受的是舞蹈的乐趣。成人演员跟多的是锻炼健康的身体，保持一颗年轻的心。
121e68975fc06c65ecbcdb4e4693ca1ffe0f75a7.translatedText: ​ (Photography by Yi Liubai) The film "Youth" directed by Feng Xiaogang has received widespread attention from friends at home and abroad. It is about 70-80 The lives of members of the Chinese Art Troupe in the 1990s, in an era when material life was not rich, reflected the ordinary people's yearning for art, including the ups and downs of life, the hardships on the road to art, and the enjoyment and glory of art. On the evening of September 23rd at the Mesa Arts Center, the 3rd Alberta Mid-Autumn Dance Festival came to a successful conclusion. More than a hundred actors from the Alberta College of the Arts and Hope Chinese School presented a nearly three-hour performance to the Alberta audience. Most Chinese overseas do not have much pressure on their material lives. Singing and dancing have become an important part of their lives. The youngest actor here is only 3 years old, and the oldest actor is 60 years old. From the childlike dances "Little Hua Dan" and "Arirang" to the opening dance "Dance with Joy", the young actors enjoyed the fun of dancing. Adult actors mostly exercise a healthy body and maintain a young heart.

2b60ed4669be41a94ce33b2339afc602d7b1dc3a.sourceText: 从学习舞蹈的那天开始，所有的演员都离不开基本功训练，亚省艺术学院多个班级把基本功组合带到了舞台上。经过一年的训练，孩子们从站，立，行的姿态都变得更加优雅，她们的柔韧性，爆发力也都是同龄人中的佼佼者。加强班的基本功表演更是迎来了全场阵阵掌声。一批新的独舞演员也脱颖而出，《 且看行云 》《 山南笠影 》《 咏荷 》都将最美的故事和扎实的基本功融为一体，让孩子们向专业的舞者进步。群舞《 傣家女儿傣家雨 》让大家看到了亚利桑那州当地多年学习中国民族舞蹈的孩子对中国民族文化的诠释。
2b60ed4669be41a94ce33b2339afc602d7b1dc3a.translatedText: >From the day they learn dance, all actors cannot do without basic skills training. Many classes at the Art Institute of Alberta have brought basic skills combinations to the stage. After a year of training, the children's postures in standing, standing and walking have become more elegant. Their flexibility and explosive power are also among the best among their peers. The basic skills performance of the intensive class received bursts of applause from the audience. A group of new solo dancers have also come to the fore. "Looking at the Moving Clouds", "Shannan Liying" and "Ode to the Lotus" all integrate the most beautiful stories and solid basic skills, allowing children to progress towards professional dancers. The group dance "Daughter of the Dai Family, Rain of the Dai Family" allowed everyone to see the interpretation of Chinese national culture by local Arizona children who have studied Chinese folk dance for many years.

11e5507b1e29413b9adcf100f68a2ee4efb9bf28.translatedText: "Daughter of the Dai Family, Dai Family Rain"

d204c17df6292522c6455b0249a62c8ba3fb1980.sourceText: 成人舞蹈班更是社区里积极的文艺爱好者的群体。已经不再是年方二八，但现在的每一天都是我们一生中最年轻的一天，为什么不让自己的每一天都载歌载舞快乐起来，健康起来？《采薇》《妈妈的歌》《最炫民族风》《西部放歌》《贝鲁特之夜》都别出心裁，各有特色，演员们虽然没有孩子们的力度和柔韧度，但是生活的阅历，和对音乐，舞蹈的理解，让这些美女帅哥的表演更加富有韵味。 他们将最年轻的自己展现出来，最真实的生活展现出来，艺术总是能把人留在最美丽的年华，他们演绎了亚利桑那华人的” 芳华” 。
d204c17df6292522c6455b0249a62c8ba3fb1980.translatedText: The adult dance class is a group of active literary and art lovers in the community. We are no longer twenty-eight years old, but every day now is the youngest day in our lives. Why not let yourself sing and dance every day to be happy and healthy? "Plucking Wei", "Mother's Song", "The Most Dazzling National Style", "Western Singing" and "Beirut Night" are all unique and have their own characteristics. Although the actors do not have the strength and flexibility of children, their life experience and understanding of music and dance make the performances of these beautiful and handsome men more charming. They showed their youngest selves and their truest lives. Art can always keep people in their most beautiful years. They performed the "youth" of Arizona Chinese.

208032cbf2defed99314ce98af9de18c11d41184.sourceText: 希望中文学校的朗诵《弟子规》给中秋舞蹈节，画上了浓墨重彩，普通话，中国字，书法，扇子，民间舞，他们用语言，文字，舞蹈等多种形式，一起欢庆传统中秋节。我们为我们的语言，文化，艺术骄傲和自豪。2018 第九届亚省春晚我们再相聚
208032cbf2defed99314ce98af9de18c11d41184.translatedText: I hope that the Chinese school's recitation of "Disciple Rules" will add a strong color to the Mid-Autumn Festival. affd7f7c1dadb91ed5de23072b81ce820c640e26.translatedText: Zhang Zhaohong: Tigers and wolves grab money, Chinese people are careful to lose money! Phoenix City Zhang Zhaohong On January 25th, I made an appointment with some old friends to the "New World Restaurant"...

5c3b3d8a87fe393dc1fd5f13686165d5828c3a0b.sourceText: 1月25日，约了几位老友到”新世界酒楼”饮茶。茶市兴旺，席无虚座。饮完茶后，正准备达上归程之际，忽然闻得友人的LUX轿车在停车场内不翼而飞，众人惊讶，连忙四方寻找，但遍查不获。光天化日竟有偷车贼如此猖獗乎？此时亦惊动了新世界酒楼经理前来帮忙，她发现在失车区域中有一灯柱上，贴有一块小到不能再小的广告(图1蓝线区)，前去细看，方知道是警告非专属用户不得在此泊车，否则会被强行拖走。
5c3b3d8a87fe393dc1fd5f13686165d5828c3a0b.translatedText: On January 25th, I made an appointment with some old friends to have tea at the "New World Restaurant". The tea market was booming and there were no empty seats. After drinking tea, as they were about to return home, they suddenly heard that their friend's LUX car had disappeared in the parking lot. Everyone was surprised and hurriedly looked for it, but couldn't find it. Are car thieves so rampant in Tianhuari? At this time, the manager of the New World Restaurant was alerted and came to help. She found an extremely small advertisement posted on a lamppost in the area where the car was lost (the blue line area in Figure 1). When she went to take a closer look, she realized that it was a warning to non-exclusive users not to park here, otherwise they would be forcibly towed away.

33f177c366aaeefa876ca8725bf8215e043b8658.sourceText: 查看老友泊车位置(图1 红线区内最左端，很难看到小警告)，泊车区离新世界商场咫尺之距，客人停车不疑有错，尤其是在周末，商场车满为患，华人到新世界酒楼或购物或饮茶，在此泊车者众，一般人并不知此位置并不隶属世界商场的泊车区，如照停不误，便有被拖走的可能。
33f177c366aaeefa876ca8725bf8215e043b8658.translatedText: View the parking location of old friends (Figure 1). At the far left end of the red line area, it is difficult to see the small warning). The parking area is very close to New World Shopping Mall. It is undoubtedly wrong for guests to park. Especially on weekends, the shopping mall is full of cars. Chinese people go to New World Restaurant to shop or drink tea. There are many people parking here. Most people don't know that this location is not part of the parking area of the World Mall. If you park correctly, you may be towed away.

d2dc333a756f11fcc9d8f9fa4e7d97a6b6b55a2b.sourceText: 我们惟有按警告牌上的号码打上一通电话，但辨公时间已过，只是录音回复而已。此刻大家如老鼠拉龟，无从下手。忽然，见有两轮大拖车到来，有数个身穿拖车公司制服者，在此泊车区内细看每一汽车，似乎在选择＂肥猪＂而拖之。我们急忙前去问询，果然是他们刚才来过拖车，现在又回来继续再拖，而拖车留出的空位，再有不明危机的后到车轮补上，如此拖了又补，补了又拖，周末竟成为拖车公司的发财之日。
d2dc333a756f11fcc9d8f9fa4e7d97a6b6b55a2b.translatedText: We can only call the number on the warning sign, but it is already the business hours. However, it was just a recorded reply. At this moment, everyone was like a mouse trying to pull a tortoise, and they had no idea what to do. Suddenly, a large two-wheeled tow truck arrived. There were several people wearing tow truck company uniforms, looking carefully at every car in the parking area, seeming to choose the "fat pig" to tow. . We hurriedly went to inquire, and sure enough it was that they had towed the truck just now, and now they came back to continue towing, and the vacancies left by the tow truck would be filled by the wheels if there was an unknown crisis. After towing and towing, it became a problem for the tow truck company over the weekend.

011da9df8f3f808d0c53db47d347543a84528211.sourceText: 惟问他们车子拖到何处，如何赎回？并按他们提供之地址，来到了拖车公司。只见拖车公司大门深锁，有一大招牌说明：如工作时间已过，可打另一电话求助。打通电话后，告知我们需等两个小时，并要准备好现钱或信用卡付款才能赎车。只好等待。期间见有两次大拖车拖回车轮进内，此地围牆四周佈满铁丝网。又见有其它失车主租用的士前来赎车，其它未到的，只能等到星期一才可办理手续赎回。
011da9df8f3f808d0c53db47d347543a84528211.translatedText: I asked them where the car was towed and how to redeem it. I went to the tow truck company at the address they provided. There was a sign saying: If the working hours are over, you can call for help. After the call was made, we were told that we would have to wait for two hours and have to prepare cash or credit card payment to redeem the car. During this period, we saw two large tow trucks coming in. The place was surrounded by walls. Barbed wire. I also saw other owners renting taxis to redeem their cars. Others who had not arrived had to wait until Monday to complete the redemption procedures.

1b6e0cb4fcbe49de2e0204572ea3ac6ef0d463dc.sourceText: 好不容易等来了一位大汉，他要过朋友的驾照，车匙，高额收取了$255元后，才将车交回给朋友。一场虚惊，还得用上许多真金白银方可收场。回来心血来潮，找了本老皇曆查查，看看是否真的”今日不宜出门’？
1b6e0cb4fcbe49de2e0204572ea3ac6ef0d463dc.translatedText: Finally, a big man came and asked for it. The driver's license and car keys were paid a hefty $255 before the car was handed back to my friend. A false alarm had to be spent on a lot of real money. On a whim, I checked the old calendar to see if it was really "not a good time to go out today"?

20d8a5a1852d59c3e8d9634dbc46d6ed7dd41c9b.sourceText: 撰文告知华人同胞，日后需小心此类小警告造成的陷井；同时呼吁新世界商场，客人失车如城门失火，影响生意，更有些客人远道从土桑市等地前来购物、饮茶，不小心失车如何返家？祈望商场能在此泊车误区贴上大的告示，不让无良拖车公司长期得益，减少上门客人的无端破财。
20d8a5a1852d59c3e8d9634dbc46d6ed7dd41c9b.translatedText: wrote an article to inform Chinese compatriots that they need to be careful of the traps caused by such small warnings in the future; at the same time, they appealed to New World Shopping Center. Customers' lost cars were like a fire at the city gate, which affected business. Some customers even came from afar to shop and drink tea from Tucson and other places. How do you get home if your car is accidentally lost? I hope the shopping mall can put up a big notice on this parking misunderstanding to prevent unscrupulous towing companies from benefiting in the long run and reduce the unwarranted loss of money to customers.

c5f10ff51ddeb5a5d3ce51121f348d34cada9a2b.sourceText: 在凤城华人侨社非常活跃的中餐馆协会于六月四日举行2012年主席及理事改选。 关兆峰在全票通过下当选新任主席，张华芳，梅树德为副主席，赖甲乙任财务，邓朝驹任审计，徐国富任英文秘书，高志中任中文秘书。 关兆峰提出三项工作目标: ①希望中餐会做一个领头羊团结侨社②加强会员服务工作③内部会议要真诚讨论对事不对人。 选举后全体理事均提出个人工作报告，并通过推动侨社筹建活动中心案。
c5f10ff51ddeb5a5d3ce51121f348d34cada9a2b.translatedText: The Chinese Restaurant Association, which is very active in the Fengcheng Overseas Chinese Community, held the 2012 election of its chairman and directors. Guan Zhaofeng was elected as the new chairman by unanimous vote, Zhang Huafang and Mei Shude were the vice-chairmen, Lai Jiayi was appointed as the treasurer, Deng Chaoju was appointed as the auditor, Xu Guofu was appointed as the English secretary, and Gao Zhizhong was appointed as the Chinese secretary. Guan Zhaofeng proposed three work goals: ① Hope that the Chinese Food Association will be a leader in uniting the overseas Chinese community ② Strengthen member service work ③ Internal meetings should sincerely discuss what is right and who is not. After the election, all directors submitted personal work reports and approved the proposal to promote the construction of an activity center for the overseas Chinese community.

3730786191fdf044ac1d757b51721a1eb4633a84.sourceText: 报道称，美国联邦调查局和纽约警察局的探员18日联合逮捕了26名嫌犯中的21人，还有2人将于19日自首，其他3人暂时未缉拿归案。起诉书称，嫌犯帮助想移民美国的中国公民造假，让他们谎称在国内受迫害，并为他们提供相关材料，教唆他们在与移民官员面试时撒谎。
3730786191fdf044ac1d757b51721a1eb4633a84.translatedText: reported that agents from the FBI and the New York Police Department jointly arrested 21 of the 26 suspects on the 18th. Two more people will surrender on the 19th, and the other three have not yet been arrested. The indictment stated that the suspects helped Chinese citizens who wanted to immigrate to the United States to make false claims about being persecuted in the country, provided them with relevant materials, and instigated them to lie during interviews with immigration officials.

8eff213bdb90ce3bdf0b73a857b241ec3f8ec924.translatedText: Zhang Zhaohong There is an idiom called "puzzling", which originally means that when the rabbit's ears are lifted, the male rabbit will flutter non-stop, the female rabbit will close her eyes, and it is difficult to tell the male and female when running on the ground...

61d5077ada007252c501363122e8471d4790ccd2.sourceText: 有句成语叫做“扑朔迷离”，原是指把兔子耳朵提起，雄兔会扑腾不停，雌兔会眯上眼睛，而在地上跑的时候雌雄难辨。后来形容事物错综复杂，不容易看清真相。
61d5077ada007252c501363122e8471d4790ccd2.translatedText: Later, he described things as complicated and difficult to see the truth clearly.

71e5a8494f288689838c9c8f10cd4215c80650be.sourceText: 这句成语源自《木兰诗》结尾的那一句：“雄兔足扑朔，雌兔眼迷离，双兔傍地走，安能辨我是雌雄？”
71e5a8494f288689838c9c8f10cd4215c80650be.translatedText: This idiom comes from the sentence at the end of "Mulan Poetry": "The male rabbit's feet are twitching, the female rabbit's eyes are blurred, the two rabbits are walking next to each other, how can they tell whether I am male or female?"

281ff622f879c52f9f69a9f17dfa649548dd7af7.sourceText: 《木兰诗》是中国南北朝的一首乐府诗歌。木兰从少习骑，长而益精。值可汗点兵，因其父名在军书中，而老父病不能行。木兰女扮男装，代父从军。溯黄河，度黑山，转战驱驰十二年，数建奇功。
281ff622f879c52f9f69a9f17dfa649548dd7af7.translatedText: "Mulan Poetry" is a Yuefu poem from the Southern and Northern Dynasties of China. Mulan learned to ride from a young age, and she became more refined as time went by. It was time for the Khan to order troops, because his father's name was in the military book, and his old father was ill and could not walk. Mulan disguises herself as a man and joins the army in place of her father. He traveled up the Yellow River, crossed the Black Mountains, and fought for twelve years, accomplishing many extraordinary feats.

a3b697a537bcd5ffe62f1622d10be9dc1067f25b.sourceText: 木兰从军体现了木兰的保家卫国英雄气概，也有孝敬父亲的女儿情怀。
a3b697a537bcd5ffe62f1622d10be9dc1067f25b.translatedText: Mulan's joining the army reflects Mulan's heroic spirit of defending her family and country, and her feelings as a daughter who respects her father.

39d4a60a58e373022a7600d3aeeaf5ba1a91fa70.sourceText: 从军十二年，军中的同袍为何对木兰雌雄莫辨？确实有点令人费解。笔者查到另一些资料，说是木兰从军后从事的是差役（古代传递军事情报和公文的人），独来独往，途中只在驿站休息和换马匹，有房间供单独使用，所以外人难辨木兰“雌雄”的真相。
39d4a60a58e373022a7600d3aeeaf5ba1a91fa70.translatedText: After twelve years in the army, why can’t my fellow soldiers distinguish whether Mulan is male or female? It's a bit puzzling indeed. The author found some other information, saying that after Mulan joined the army, she worked as a messenger (a person who delivered military information and official documents in ancient times). She traveled alone, only resting and changing horses at the inn along the way, and had a room for separate use, so it was difficult for outsiders to tell the truth about Mulan's "male and female".

7a7c7c0ba3bbce18ca4fdc71902419ee4b9c8f7e.sourceText: 兔子的雌雄性别在幼时也是难以辨识的。兔科共有9属42种，为草食类动物，夜间行动，有管状长耳、簇状短尾，两条前肢较短，而后肢较长且强健有力。
7a7c7c0ba3bbce18ca4fdc71902419ee4b9c8f7e.translatedText: The male and female gender of rabbits is also difficult to identify when they are young. There are 42 species in 9 genera of the Leporidae family. They are herbivorous animals that move at night. They have long tubular ears, short tufted tails, two short forelimbs, and long and powerful hind limbs.

679b4f319900e36424c92e0543d305f070e432ad.sourceText: 早在六千万年前，有一种被称为攀援始祖兽的生物，后进化为始祖兔；到大概三千万年以前，始祖兔进化为野兔，而野生的兔子直到三千年以前，才逐渐被驯化为家兔。
679b4f319900e36424c92e0543d305f070e432ad.translatedText: As early as 60 million years ago, there was a creature called the Climbing Archeopteryx, which later evolved into the Archeorabbit; about 30 million years ago, the Archeorabbit evolved into a hare, and it was not until 3,000 years ago that wild rabbits were gradually domesticated into domestic rabbits.

3a4b9ed03549903748344e0cc1a47aa8ccfe2026.sourceText: 野兔至今在全球仍有几十个亚种。它们适应多样环境，食性很广，包括各种杂草、植物的种子和果实，以及树木的枝叶和嫩皮。野兔最爱吃植物的嫩叶，但并不包括胡萝卜。因为胡萝卜是人类种植的作物，野兔在野外能采食到的机会并不多，另外，胡萝卜糖分较高，也不适合家兔的消化系统。
3a4b9ed03549903748344e0cc1a47aa8ccfe2026.translatedText: There are still dozens of subspecies of hares around the world. They are adapted to a variety of environments and have a wide range of food habits, including various weeds, plant seeds and fruits, as well as tree branches, leaves and tender bark. Rabbits love to eat the young leaves of plants, but this does not include carrots. Because carrots are a crop grown by humans, there are not many opportunities for wild rabbits to eat them in the wild. In addition, carrots are high in sugar and are not suitable for the digestive system of domestic rabbits.

63d8ce3386bf466e8c7b6b9cf165c5a9f01a8846.sourceText: 兔子为什么有“三瓣嘴”“红眼睛”“顺风耳”呢？
63d8ce3386bf466e8c7b6b9cf165c5a9f01a8846.translatedText: Why do rabbits have "three-petal mouths", "red eyes" and "windy ears"?

d232936e1ae0544d0103099bafa0811da3f37da0.sourceText: 兔子拥有发达的门齿，帮助其啃食各种草类、草根以及树皮。三瓣嘴最有利于将它们将门齿及时、无障碍地翻出来使用。
d232936e1ae0544d0103099bafa0811da3f37da0.translatedText: Rabbits have well-developed incisors, which help them eat various grasses, grass roots and tree bark. The three-petal mouth is most conducive to turning the incisors out for use in a timely and unobstructed manner.

7ca9e73252bbb3037d9cbc5478fc8c097fe08eb3.sourceText: 而兔子的“红眼睛”并不是普遍性的。通常大部分白色兔子的眼睛是红色的，但还有黑色、蓝色、灰色等多种。红色眼睛的兔子令人喜爱，从进化论角度上来说，兔子眼睛的颜色是根据生活的环境变化而生成的，并且具有遗传性。
7ca9e73252bbb3037d9cbc5478fc8c097fe08eb3.translatedText: The "red eyes" of rabbits are not universal. Usually most white rabbits have red eyes, but there are also black, blue, gray, and more. Rabbits with red eyes are adorable. From an evolutionary perspective, the color of rabbit eyes is generated based on changes in the living environment and is hereditary.

3b0be64b0104d30bf1549ca1c9a33cd13417d701.sourceText: 兔子有“顺风耳”，对声音非常敏感，这对耳朵就像它们自带的“雷达”，耳内的密毛恰如天线一般。只要把两只耳朵高高竖起并稍作转动，数十米外的微小声音都会被兔子灵敏地收入耳中，这样它们就能及时发现危险并逃跑。
3b0be64b0104d30bf1549ca1c9a33cd13417d701.translatedText: Rabbits have "wind ears" and are very sensitive to sound. These ears are like their own "radar", and the dense hair in the ears is like an antenna. As long as the two ears are raised high and turned slightly, the small sounds dozens of meters away will be sensitively received by rabbits, so that they can detect danger in time and escape.

c92d803f67b2514773a20f9aeba842f7a3f3560b.sourceText: 兔子生性谨慎、胆小，只有在休息时才会把耳朵耷拉下来紧贴在颈背上。有人说抓兔子就要抓耳朵，其实抓住它们的耳朵时，兔子会停止挣扎，也许是希望自己的“雷达”不要被破坏了吧。
c92d803f67b2514773a20f9aeba842f7a3f3560b.translatedText: Rabbits are cautious and timid by nature. They will droop their ears and stick them against the nape of their necks only when they are resting. Some people say that to catch rabbits, you have to scratch their ears. In fact, when you grab their ears, rabbits will stop struggling, maybe hoping that their "radar" will not be destroyed.

32f9c73041f9afd9e2f33baa874fe229fb735853.sourceText: 野兔喜欢打洞，但不喜欢长时间地待在洞中，而用借洞来逃生。在被天敌追杀过程中，野兔的奔跑通常不是盲目的，它们在平常活动中摸清了地形，就算不是自己挖的，它们也都提前去“熟悉”过，甚至会时不时再去“熟悉”一下。因此，当被敌害追击时，野兔通常都能迅速准确地逃入附近的地洞中。
32f9c73041f9afd9e2f33baa874fe229fb735853.translatedText: Hare likes to dig holes, but they don’t like to stay in the holes for a long time, so they use borrowed holes to escape. When being chased by natural enemies, hares usually do not run blindly. They have figured out the terrain in their daily activities. Even if they did not dig it themselves, they have been "familiar" with it in advance, and even "familiar" with it again from time to time. Therefore, when being chased by enemies, hares can usually escape into nearby burrows quickly and accurately.

21766e2375e245ac4355b533796d5a0300ad7eb3.sourceText: “狡兔三窟”的成语最早出自于《战国策·齐策四》，现在多用来比喻隐蔽的地方或方法多。在中国传统文化中，“六畜”之外还有“六兽”，兔子就是“六兽”之一，是人们捕猎的主要对象。《诗经》里有三首诗与野兔有关。《瓠叶》中说：“幡幡瓠叶，采之亨之。君子有酒，酌言尝之。有兔斯首，炮之燔之……”描述的就是猎人打到野兔拿来下酒的欢乐景象。
21766e2375e245ac4355b533796d5a0300ad7eb3.translatedText: The idiom "Three burrows of a cunning rabbit" first came from "Warring States Policy·Qi Ce IV", and is now often used to describe hidden places or methods. In traditional Chinese culture, there are "six beasts" in addition to the "six domestic animals". Rabbits are one of the "six beasts" and are the main targets for people to hunt. There are three poems in the Book of Songs related to hares. "Gourd Leaves" says: "Fan banners and gourd leaves are used to gather them. A gentleman has wine, so he tastes it. If there is a rabbit head, he can burn it with a cannon..." It describes the happy scene of hunters hunting hares and using them for drinking.

977ab580a8c3be81080352189de41279db4e15d8.sourceText: 家兔的祖先不是野兔，而是野生的穴兔。穴兔原产于欧洲，部分经由“丝绸之路”去到中国。中国的野生幼兔易患佝偻病，没法繁殖。可以说，全球的家兔均由穴兔驯化而来。
977ab580a8c3be81080352189de41279db4e15d8.translatedText: The ancestors of domestic rabbits are not hares, but wild cave rabbits. The cave rabbit is native to Europe, and some came to China via the "Silk Road". Young wild rabbits in China are prone to rickets and cannot reproduce. It can be said that all domestic rabbits around the world were domesticated from cave rabbits.

16e35c21fe57311a1d4be3bb72decff1ae9b388d.sourceText: 英语中称呼家兔是Rabbit，野兔则是Hare。穴兔刚生下来的幼仔身上是光滑无毛的，因为它们多喜欢待在洞里，野兔刚出生的幼仔却是有毛的，它们多在地表活动，生下来不久就要到处跑动。
16e35c21fe57311a1d4be3bb72decff1ae9b388d.translatedText: In English, domestic rabbits are called Rabbit, and wild rabbits are called Hare. The newborn cubs of cave rabbits are smooth and hairless because they like to stay in holes. However, the newborn cubs of hare are furry. They mostly move around on the surface and will run around soon after they are born.

b14f2add6baa848c346bf29d0665fe03e3001623.sourceText: 兔类有许多濒危品种，因失去栖息地及猎杀，还有持续不断的山火、过度放牧、伐林破坏环境等等因素所至。
b14f2add6baa848c346bf29d0665fe03e3001623.translatedText: There are many endangered species of rabbits, due to habitat loss and hunting, as well as ongoing wildfires, overgrazing, deforestation and other factors that damage the environment.

cdc2031701c5c36c71a98754c4e5d2092026e651.sourceText: 笔者以为，兔子是人类和禽兽弱肉强的对象，是动物界食物链中最低端的动物之一，它没有以牙还牙的能力，只能靠拼命奔跑来逃命，用努力繁殖来防止种类的灭绝。兔子是以献身精神来维持自然界生态平衡的一个物种。
cdc2031701c5c36c71a98754c4e5d2092026e651.translatedText: The author believes that rabbits are weak targets for humans and animals, and are one of the lowest animals in the animal food chain. They do not have the ability to retaliate and can only escape by running as hard as they can, and use their efforts to reproduce to prevent the extinction of the species. Rabbits are a species that are dedicated to maintaining the ecological balance of nature.

6e8290e0b158e3d42cbb30ffcf721188164b26a5.sourceText: 女儿薮薇年幼时，我们买了许多附有录音带的“看图讲故事”书籍，并播放给她听，她自幼最喜欢的就是小白兔。
6e8290e0b158e3d42cbb30ffcf721188164b26a5.translatedText: When our daughter Xia Wei was young, we bought a lot of "Look at Pictures and Tell Stories" books with audio tapes and played them to her. Her favorite since she was a child was the little white rabbit.

4e4736030779219bd877f6b19529a36f88ec4a7d.sourceText: 直至长大后，她也常去兔子房作义工，家中的摆设也多有关于兔类的艺术品。
4e4736030779219bd877f6b19529a36f88ec4a7d.translatedText: When she grew up, she often went to the rabbit house as a volunteer, and many of the furnishings in her home contained art pieces about rabbits.

e6b758ec72c7d67b413508fc575dc8ec17a5717b.sourceText: 薮薇还把带有兔图案的衣裳穿在身上。她了为孩子们培养爱心，热爱小动物，让他们照顾好残障的小兔。
e6b758ec72c7d67b413508fc575dc8ec17a5717b.translatedText: Xu Wei also wore clothes with rabbit patterns on her body. She cultivated love and love for small animals in the children, and asked them to take good care of the disabled rabbits.

5c4fb5eb48c2e7e2decffb29f67c64171fbe834b.sourceText: 唐代诗人王建有一首写小白兔的诗：“新秋白兔大于拳，红耳霜毛趁草眠。天子不教人射击，玉鞭遮到马蹄前。”此诗赞美幼小的兔子“睡态”可掬，令人可爱，劝导人不要随意伤害兔子。
5c4fb5eb48c2e7e2decffb29f67c64171fbe834b.translatedText: Wang Jian, a poet of the Tang Dynasty, wrote a poem about a little white rabbit: "The white rabbit in the new autumn is bigger than a fist, and its red ears and frosty fur sleep in the grass. The emperor does not teach people to shoot, but the jade whip covers the horse's hooves." This poem praises the cuteness of the young rabbit's "sleeping state" and advises people not to hurt rabbits at will.

ce79c309c4b8b8250b411e44020354f7b74a6c97.sourceText: 这个课程专门为辣妈们设计。因为晚上和周末大多妈妈都必须在家陪孩子，先生，反而是老公上班了，孩子上课了，妈妈们才有自己的时间。一个人在家健身，无聊，想找个说话的人都没有。在学校里健身有老师的细心指导，还能跟妈妈们说说家常，心情好，身体好。
ce79c309c4b8b8250b411e44020354f7b74a6c97.translatedText: This course is specially designed for hot moms. Because most mothers have to be at home with their children in the evenings and weekends, sir. Instead, it is the husbands who go to work and the children who go to school, so mothers have their own time. Working out alone at home is boring and there is no one to talk to. d5b42e2b26d7a1c0d1efec325f956a3b29cc5f29.translatedText: Celebrate the "Chinese Cheongsam Overseas Collection" and the "Global (China) Cheongsam Congress" Launching Ceremony

cbc5340490d8fbe17ed4ced820bfa73a7e85af2a.sourceText: 【竹林报道】8月16日，凤凰城众多旗袍爱好者聚会，参加了当地”中国旗袍海外总汇”与”全球（中国）旗袍总会”携手合作的启动仪式，宣告了中国旗袍海外总汇与国际接轨，共同发扬传统国粹精华，弘扬旗袍文化之美 。 当天的与会者，纷纷身着各种长短旗袍，色彩缤纷地亮相。她们婀娜多姿的身影，被旗袍简洁明朗的线条、丰富多姿的款式、质地轻柔的面料，衬托出东方女性特有的优雅、柔美、典雅与妩媚。成为一道让人过目难忘，别致亮丽的风景线。 中国旗袍总会是在中国国家文化部、妇联以及各国驻华使馆、海外华侨机构鼎力支持下，携手社会各界名流、全球华人杰出代表共同建立的文化传播平台。现下设427家分会，其中国内分会324家、国外分会103家，会员人数超过230万人。随着中国旗袍会品牌知名度越来越高，分会数也在逐步增加，会员人数与日俱增。旗袍会会员遍布全球各地，包括南非祖马夫人、日本皇室公主、美国外交部副部长夫人均为旗袍会会员。
cbc5340490d8fbe17ed4ced820bfa73a7e85af2a.translatedText: [Bamboo Forest Report] On August 16, many cheongsam enthusiasts gathered in Phoenix City to participate in the launching ceremony of the cooperation between the local "Chinese Cheongsam Overseas Collection" and the "Global (China) Cheongsam Federation", announcing that the Chinese Cheongsam Overseas Collection is in line with international standards, jointly carrying forward the essence of traditional Chinese quintessence, and promoting the beauty of cheongsam culture. Attendees on that day appeared in colorful cheongsams of various lengths and lengths. Their graceful figures, combined with the cheongsam's simple and clear lines, rich and colorful styles, and soft fabrics, bring out the unique elegance, femininity, elegance and charm of oriental women. It becomes an unforgettable, unique and beautiful landscape. The China Cheongsam Federation is a cultural communication platform jointly established by celebrities from all walks of life and outstanding representatives of the global Chinese community with the strong support of the Chinese Ministry of Culture, the Women's Federation, embassies of various countries in China, and overseas Chinese organizations. It currently has 427 branches, including 324 domestic branches and 103 foreign branches, with more than 2.3 million members. As the brand awareness of the China Cheongsam Association becomes higher and higher, the number of branches is also gradually increasing, and the number of members is increasing day by day. The Qipao Club has members all over the world, including Mrs. Zuma of South Africa, the Japanese royal princess, and the wife of the US Deputy Secretary of Foreign Affairs. They are all members of the Qipao Club.

41f531fbbd8468014d08fd1847ec6a7536445385.sourceText: 我们旗袍会的宗旨是”弘扬中华传统文化，展现旗袍风采，彰显东方女性魅力”。今年，5月16日，中国旗袍总会还打破了着旗袍行走人数最多的世界吉尼斯纪录，全球参加人数达20万，行走在中国大地和全球各个地方，更是以以视觉艺术，秀出华人女性优雅、婉约的风韵，传播了中国服饰文化的内涵与华美。 亚利桑那的”中国旗袍海外总汇”成立于2012年。自创办以来，举办旗袍沙龙，多次参加春节，亚洲节，中文学校舞台剧等演出，尤其是参加慈善表演，得过第10届”亚太之美”（A Taste of Asia）筹款晚宴颁发的一等奖，短短时日，成绩斐然，令人刮目相看。在今年的春节晚会中，一个怀旧的《上海滩》节目更是俘获了大批人心，旗袍韵味十足，展示了旗袍不仅仅是服饰，不仅仅是审美，更是文化。也许不仅仅是文化，更是一种民族的精神与情怀。旗袍穿的也不仅仅是曲线，而是自信，是气场。正如中国旗袍总会主题歌《旗袍赋》所唱的：”你是中华的美丽使者，你是世界的日出印象”。
41f531fbbd8468014d08fd1847ec6a7536445385.translatedText: The purpose of our cheongsam association is to "carry forward Chinese traditional culture, show the style of cheongsam, and highlight the charm of oriental women." This year, on May 16, the China Cheongsam Federation also broke the Guinness World Record for the largest number of people walking in cheongsam. The number of global participants reached 200,000, walking in China and various places around the world. It also used visual art to show off the elegance and graceful charm of Chinese women and spread the connotation and beauty of Chinese clothing culture. Arizona’s “Chinese Cheongsam Overseas Collection” was established in 2012. Since its establishment, it has held cheongsam salons and participated in many performances such as the Spring Festival, Asia Festival, and Chinese school stage plays. In particular, it has participated in charity performances and won the first prize at the 10th "A Taste of Asia" fundraising dinner. In a short period of time, it has achieved remarkable results, which is impressive. In this year's Spring Festival Gala, a nostalgic "Shanghai Beach" program captured the hearts of a large number of people. The cheongsam is full of charm, showing that cheongsam is not just clothing, not just aesthetics, but also culture. Perhaps it is not just culture, but also a national spirit and sentiment. Cheongsam is not only about curves, but about confidence and aura. As the theme song of the China Cheongsam Federation sings in "Ode to Cheongsam": "You are the beautiful messenger of China, and you are the sunrise impression of the world."

c3cd957bdd5ac9671e7999c5450fbd648d058f7f.sourceText: 原是中国旗袍海外总汇的主席，副主席，现又成为全球（中国）旗袍总会的会长与副会长的张华芳，汤可都是爱美，爱旗袍，爱中国传统文化的践行者，表演者与领路人。张华芳曾任大凤凰城侨联主席，现任亚省中餐馆协会主席，是个人人皆知的女强人。但她不满足于仅仅做个女强人，靓丽的她还要做个强”女人”。她多次担纲起当地华人选美，包装美人的培训工作。对中国的服饰也情有独钟，尤其对旗袍及其文化抱有使命感、荣誉感与自豪感。这次加入中国旗袍总会也是她回国去穿针引线来的。
c3cd957bdd5ac9671e7999c5450fbd648d058f7f.translatedText: Zhang Huafang, formerly the chairman and vice-chairman of the Chinese Cheongsam Overseas Federation, and now the president and vice-president of the Global (China) Cheongsam Federation, and Tang Ke are both practitioners, performers and leaders who love beauty, cheongsam and Chinese traditional culture. Zhang Huafang was the former chairman of the Greater Phoenix Overseas Chinese Federation and is currently the chairman of the Chinese Restaurant Association of Alberta. She is a well-known strong woman. But she is not satisfied with just being a strong woman, she also wants to be a beautiful and strong "woman". She has been responsible for the training of local Chinese beauty pageants and packaging beauties many times. I also have a special liking for Chinese clothing, especially cheongsam and its culture, with a sense of mission, honor and pride. This time she joined the Chinese Cheongsam Federation because she returned to China to work hard.

33595f0da5168c4727c12b427a7794bbedd15486.sourceText: 由于她有社会活动家的地位的便利，要不遗余力地推广中国文化，她岂能白白浪费这些资源。为此，她说，”作为一名中国人，我们有义务和责任向更多的人展示我们的文化和美学。我会尽力为大家创造更多机会，寻求更大更国际化的舞台”。她也希望会员们能够继续成为中华美丽的使者，向各族裔展示中国传统服饰之美，让中华文化在海外得以传承。 而副会长汤可被人认为天生是个旗袍控， 掩盖不住的风姿从眉梢眼角流露出来，不动声色，临水照花，是一个能把旗袍穿到骨子里的人。同时，她将把弘扬和推广祖国旗袍文化当做自己终身的事业。中国文化艺术始终伴随着她的生活。2004年，她曾经是中国全球 ”环球小姐”中国西南片区前10名形象设计师，后她又担任过香港、新加坡等地的形象设计师。成立亚利桑那的”中国旗袍海外总汇”前，她就已经原创了很多旗袍舞蹈，一心要在海外树立起旗袍的品牌形象。得奖的，被认可的背后都有她默默付出的无数的心血与汗水。
33595f0da5168c4727c12b427a7794bbedd15486.translatedText: Since she has the convenience of being a social activist, she must spare no effort to promote Chinese culture. How can she waste these resources in vain? To this end, she said, "As a Chinese, we have the obligation and responsibility to show our culture and aesthetics to more people. I will try my best to create more opportunities for everyone and seek a larger and more international stage." She also hopes that members can continue to be ambassadors of the beauty of China, show the beauty of traditional Chinese costumes to all ethnic groups, and allow Chinese culture to be passed down overseas. Vice-president Tang Ke is considered to be a cheongsam lover by nature. His unconcealable grace is revealed from the corners of his eyebrows and eyes. He is calm and looks at the flowers by the water. He is a person who can wear cheongsam to the core. At the same time, she will regard carrying forward and promoting the cheongsam culture of her motherland as her lifelong career. Chinese culture and art have always been with her in her life. In 2004, she was one of the top 10 image designers in Southwest China for Miss Universe in China. She later served as an image designer in Hong Kong, Singapore and other places. Before establishing the "Chinese Cheongsam Overseas Collection" in Arizona, she had already created many original cheongsam dances and was determined to establish the cheongsam brand image overseas. Behind the awards and recognition are the countless hard work and sweat she has silently put in.

bc98e00c07f24c3f4428601210f64fa6babe72be.sourceText: 为打造旗袍这张中国时尚女性的名片，她展现了两个视野：一是对旗袍文化礼仪指导、美姿美仪，带给了大家专业性且艺术性的视野。当天的活动中她就示范教给了大家优雅的坐姿，捡东西时的蹲姿，高贵、含蓄、贤淑的风姿等。二是创新、创意、创造，融入国际的视野。她编导的旗袍舞与探戈相结合，不断地在东方与西方的元素有机融合过程中碰撞，探索，实践，得到主流社会的肯定与赞赏。
bc98e00c07f24c3f4428601210f64fa6babe72be.translatedText: In order to create the cheongsam, the business card of Chinese fashionable women, she showed two visions: First, she gave everyone a professional and artistic vision of cheongsam cultural etiquette guidance and beauty. During the day's activities, she demonstrated and taught everyone elegant sitting posture, squatting posture when picking up things, noble, reserved and virtuous demeanor, etc. The second is innovation, creativity, creation, and integration into an international perspective. The combination of cheongsam dance and tango she choreographed continuously collided, explored, and practiced in the process of organic integration of Eastern and Western elements, and was recognized and appreciated by mainstream society.

94c103c6a7fddc225d646d3c91aac1e8bf67838f.sourceText: 在当今中国风引领世界潮流之时，中国旗袍会借势而发，不断壮大，闪亮登上国际舞台之时， 凤凰城分会的成立，也同样将为中国旗袍文化全球化的发展起到积极的平台引导作用。
94c103c6a7fddc225d646d3c91aac1e8bf67838f.translatedText: When Chinese style leads the world trend, Chinese cheongsam will take advantage of the situation, continue to grow, and shine on the international stage. The establishment of the Phoenix branch will also play a positive role in guiding the global development of Chinese cheongsam culture.

5eebb587704bacaee9c9c511e6a5f6f975303ff8.sourceText: 台湾退除役官兵辅导委员会副主任委员吕嘉凯访问凤凰城 2017年8月25日，近百亚利桑那退伍军人，台湾退伍军人和家人相聚一堂，欢迎台湾退除役官兵辅导委员会副主任委员吕嘉凯，以及海外联络科科长王凯珩一行访问凤凰城。 亚利桑那退伍军人协会以及美国军团协会在凤凰城希尔顿酒店宴请来宾。亚利桑那州参议员余艳芬，历史学家Herb Zinn作为主讲嘉宾，一起分享了退伍老兵家庭的故事，已经他们在战场上 的故事。亚利桑那退伍军人协会主席 Reggie Yates，美国军团协会主席George Ong，前亚裔白宫顾问邓朝驹，国会退伍服务总监 Lee Huff，国会议员Andy Biggs， 钱德勒市议员黄馨民，中华总会主席邱顺雄, 侨务咨询委员高志中都参加了欢迎午宴。 部分嘉宾合影留念 吕委员表示非常开心看到亚利桑那退役军人协会和台湾退役军人，以及家属关系如此的融洽。大家就像一家人一样，也没有想到当地对退伍军人，那些为了国家奉献青春热血的人，如此的敬重。这是他第一次参加凤凰城当地的退伍军人联谊活动，非常欣喜。 台湾退除役官兵辅导委员会副主任委员吕嘉凯 亚利桑那州参议员余艳芬
5eebb587704bacaee9c9c511e6a5f6f975303ff8.translatedText: Lu Jiakai, deputy chairman of Taiwan's Retired Officers and Soldiers Counseling Committee, visited Phoenix On August 25, 2017, nearly a hundred Arizona veterans, Taiwanese veterans and their families gathered together to welcome Lu Jiakai, deputy director of the Taiwan Retired Officers and Soldiers Counseling Committee, and Wang Kaiheng, chief of the Overseas Liaison Section, to visit Phoenix. The Arizona Veterans Association and the American Legion hosted a banquet at the Phoenix Hilton Hotel. Arizona Senator Yu Yanfen and historian Herb Zinn were the guest speakers, sharing the stories of veteran families and their stories on the battlefield. Reggie Yates, President of the Arizona Veterans Association, George Ong, President of the American Legion Association, former Asian White House Advisor Deng Chaoju, Congressional Veterans Services Director Lee Huff, Congressman Andy Biggs, Chandler City Councilman Huang Xinmin, Chinese Federation Chairman Qiu Shunxiong, and Overseas Chinese Affairs Advisory Committee Gao Zhizhong all attended the welcome luncheon. Some guests took a group photo. Commissioner Lu said he was very happy to see such a harmonious relationship between the Arizona Veterans Association and Taiwanese veterans and their families. We are all like a family, and we did not expect that the local community has such respect for veterans, those who have devoted their youth and blood to the country. This was his first time participating in a local veterans' fellowship event in Phoenix, and he was very happy. Lu Jiakai, deputy chairman of Taiwan’s Retired Officers and Soldiers Counseling Committee Arizona Senator Yu Yanfen

0b7ff6000ceef714424608137f5e951f48347e41.translatedText: >Maricopa County office building leak closed Over the weekend, the Maricopa County office building was closed for repairs due to flooding caused by an out-of-control pipe. Fuller, spokesman for the Maricopa County Department of Public Health, said a water pipe leak flooded the birth registration office building on 16th Street North in Phoenix, but fortunately no records were damaged. During the maintenance period of the office building, resident birth certificates, death certificates, paternity tests, satellite location changes and other services will be transferred to 3003 W. Thomas Rd in Phoenix and 4419 E. Main St., Suite 105 in Mesa. Certificate services can also be completed online at: WeArePublicHealth.org.

bb2fdb098cfcb0b5ef45ec4b80407fbad36467a4.sourceText: 作者商慧明老师，华东师范大学毕业，曾为中国“汉语大词典”出版社高级编辑。在海外中文学校任教期间为孩子们写了很多充满爱、童心、灵气、希望、憧憬的诗歌和文章。 请阅读他的长诗“孩子，其实不怪你”，看商老师从怎样的角度劝说有点忧郁的孩子。
bb2fdb098cfcb0b5ef45ec4b80407fbad36467a4.translatedText: The author, teacher Shang Huiming, graduated from East China Normal University and was a senior editor of China's "Chinese Dictionary" publishing house. While teaching in overseas Chinese schools, I wrote many poems and articles for children full of love, childlike innocence, aura, hope, and longing. Please read his long poem "Child, I actually don't blame you" to see how Teacher Shang persuades children who are a little depressed.

27d5a417c7d63e5a1f3a26938529b5c95ba4c482.sourceText: 今天提笔写这封信， 是因为我想同你说话，看着你微笑， 像给予一只小猫， 轻轻地但全是爱怜地拥抱…… 你曾经有绝佳的乐感， 吹起小号像上阵的号角， 敲打着邻居懒叔叔起床做操； 你还有青春的美妙， 将古琴筝弦与灵魂缠绕， 让人难分是古典美女今又潮， 还是今朝靓丽旧时照？ 你曾经是那么可爱，灵气， 让同龄人撇来羡慕的眼神， 让大人们再三将邻家的女孩夸奖拥抱！ 不知发生了什么，也不知道从哪天开始？ 时光隧道一下没有了蓝天， 也没有了阳光照耀。 仿佛世界遗忘了你， 你也忘记了世界， 只有呆滞的目光停留在课桌一角！ 就像一棵默默无闻的小草， 时刻都在害怕森林里奇树怪藤的张牙舞爪？ 仿佛只有在未知的天涯， 才能触摸你昔日的频道？ 我猜想， 也许你遭遇了可怕的学校霸凌， 那些看不得优秀的同窗每天对你冷眼相对， 唇枪舌刀？ 或许，你被某位教书匠看中， 每天过分的热情指导， 将内心烦躁的地雷引爆, 让你讨厌任何喋喋不休的好心说教？ 还有，是否父母每天为鸡毛蒜皮的小事争 吵？ 像蹩脚的歌唱家， 虽然音频高亢，自成腔调， 却给你带了无尽的烦恼？ 你说， 还是闺蜜说得妙，比任何说教都要好： 你不是规则的制定者， 也不是游戏的修改者， 撞了南墙可以回头， 打不赢你还可以跑！ 对呀，为什么我就不能摒弃古筝放弃号， 藏身楼道做狼嚎？ 为什么我就不能钻进森林变小草， 用不着每天对着同学老师校长皮笑肉不笑？ 为什么我就不能对你们考第一侧目以待， 无动于衷？ 为什么我就不能得了老末还洋洋自得，想 着哪天陋室也能成楼？ 是呀，是呀， 明明大人虚伪又可笑， 却对孩子把鞭子扬得高高！ 考个第一从来是家长自己心里美梦的赶超, 孩子不过是个打不垮骂不倒的受气包！ 学校“天天向上”天天叫, 天天有人像春笋一样挺冒， 可知几家欢乐几家愁， 金字塔下累死几多狗！ 最多是老师校长加薪评职会上的光彩夺目， 哪见铺垫的狗儿汗水一丝一毫！ 每天都映入眼帘的宏图初心， 不过是马路围墙的装饰华表， 还不如树上那几只怪鸟， 呱呱鼓噪，连路上的黑大恶少都吓唬不了！ 是的，孩子，其实你没错， 是这个世界太糟糕！ 这个世界有很多山， 山峦起伏，西低东高。 人人都喜欢望远登高，俯瞰自傲， 可少有人留心眼下的山脚土坳—– 战争打了无数次，血流成河，攻城掠堡， 可曾见百姓流离失所， 无处还乡告老？ 宏图绘了无数幅，钢筋霸野，高楼雄起， 可曾听得弄堂胡同黎民半夜梦呓： 何时拆迁阳光本地普照？ 到处可见， 各地名校拆并如反掌， 教匠磨拳志气豪， 孰不知 这里金榜题名，一将功成举家欢， 那边逊山之外无颜熬？ 昨日莘莘学子备受关怀， 如今外卖后备担心差评恶瞧！ 往昔老师再不相见， 濡沫同窗四散寥寥， 叫我如何再欢颜， 叫我何处寻明朝？ 我不忧郁谁烦恼！ 孩子，你真的没错， 环境还是这个环境， 社会还是这个社会， 是从一开始， 我们就偏离了正规之路， 我们就失去了正义之道！ 你的无语，冷眼和自嘲， 应该是你冷静独特的视角， 你的不解，困惑和烦恼， 却是你善良立身之本，应该引以为豪！ 是他们太功利，没有人情， 才让很多精神和灵魂在虚浮的钢筋水泥中 游移飘渺！ 孩子，你要自信，不要在乎别人的胡说八 道！ 这个世界有人制造雾霾， 也有人终生相争，力主环保； 这个社会有人孜孜不倦追逐名禄之利， 也有好人毕生为乡村女娃教育，心血尽耗！ 那里有恶汉以镣铐锁人而猥琐地窃喜， 这里也有豪杰侠女为抵抗强权而肝胆相 照 。 一如这个世界有人觊觎别国领地， 也有人奋起抗争，以不屈捍卫家园为荣耀！ 孩子，这个多元世界本身就有不同色调， 每人都有自己的独特喜好: 他酷爱金锁银链，光彩映面， 你珍藏玉软绿翠为心底珍宝。 没准，没准， 你失去的是世俗念叨，得到的却是整个世 界的关注和拥抱！ 你精灵的笔触， 描绘的是心灵的美妙； 你婉转的歌喉， 传来的就是天堂神曲的委婉俊俏。 这个世界上有人就喜欢饶舌鼓噪， 哪个不顺眼说哪个就是抑郁，精神和神经 大条。 孰不知每个人都有精神疾病， 只不过有人风轻云淡，漂浮在云霄， 有人不幸落在地狱备受煎熬！ 孩子，别担心， 敞开善良的心胸容纳别人， 用自信的基石去抵抗他人的呱噪！ 当人们看不透蒙娜丽莎时，说是神秘的微 笑， 但一旦读懂女神的本意， 无人不顶礼膜拜，恨不伏地扑倒。 也许， 你就是中国的梵高， 昔日的涂鸦没准是明日的瑰宝； 不经意的小曲也许会有但丁神曲的同妙。 当你沦为人家眼中最不幸的人时， 你也许正引领着世上最新的风潮——- 走自己的路，听凭别人念叨去。 孩子，一切都不怪你， 是这个世界太功利，太卑劣，太小气，太 虚荣，太无趣，也太热闹
27d5a417c7d63e5a1f3a26938529b5c95ba4c482.translatedText: I write this letter today because I want to talk to you and watch you smile, like giving a kitten a hug, gently but lovingly... You once had an excellent sense of music, blowing the trumpet like a horn for battle, and beating the neighbor's lazy uncle to get up and do exercises; you also have the beauty of youth, entwining the strings of the guqin and the zither with the soul, making it difficult to tell whether it is a classical beauty who is fashionable today, or a beautiful old photo of today? You were once so cute and smart, making your peers cast envious glances, and making adults praise and hug the girl next door again and again! I don’t know what happened, and I don’t know when it started? The time tunnel suddenly lost the blue sky and the sunshine. It's as if the world has forgotten you, and you have forgotten the world, with only your dull eyes staying on the corner of the desk! Like an unknown grass, always afraid of the strange trees and vines in the forest? It seems that only in the unknown end of the world can I touch your old channel? I guess, maybe you encountered terrible bullying at school, and those classmates who looked down on excellence looked at you coldly and quarreled with you every day? Perhaps, you have been favored by a certain teacher, and his overly enthusiastic guidance every day has detonated the landmine of irritability in your heart, making you hate any nagging well-intentioned preaching? Also, do your parents argue about trivial matters every day? Like a bad singer, although his voice is high-pitched and has his own accent, it brings you endless troubles? You said, what my best friend said is wonderful, better than any preaching: You are not the maker of the rules, nor the modifier of the game. You can turn back if you hit a wall, and you can still run if you can't win! That's right, why can't I abandon the guzheng and hide in the corridor and howl like a wolf? Why can't I go into the forest and become grass? I don't have to smile at my classmates, teachers and principal every day? Why can't I just look at you and be indifferent to your first place in the exam? Why can't I be so complacent after winning Lao Mo, thinking that one day my humble house will become a building? Yes, yes, it is obvious that the adults are hypocritical and ridiculous, but they raise the whip high to the children! Getting the first place in the exam has always been the parent's dream to catch up, while the child is just a doormat who cannot be beaten or scolded! The school shouts "Every day up" every day, and people stand out like bamboo shoots every day. You can tell that some families are happy and some are sad, and how many dogs are dying of exhaustion under the pyramid! At most, it is the brilliance of teachers and principals at the salary increase evaluation meeting, but there is not a trace of dog sweat in the foreshadowing! The grand plan that catches our eyes every day is just a decoration on the road wall, not as good as those strange birds on the tree, croaking and making noisy noise, which can't even scare the black men on the road! Yes, kid, you are actually right, the world is too bad! There are many mountains in this world, with undulating mountains, low in the west and high in the east. Everyone likes to look far and high, overlooking the proud mountains, but few people pay attention to the mountains at the foot of the mountain - wars have been fought countless times, blood has flowed into rivers, and castles have been sieged. Have you ever seen people displaced and having nowhere to return to their hometowns to retire? Countless grand plans have been drawn, with steel bars dominating the countryside and high-rise buildings rising. Have you ever heard the people in the alleys dreaming in the middle of the night: When will the demolition and sunshine shine locally? You can see it everywhere, famous schools from all over the country have been demolished and merged, and the teachers are working hard and ambitious. Who knows that here, a person is named on the gold medal list, and the whole family is happy when he succeeds, but over there, there is no shame outside the mountains? Yesterday, many students were cared for, but now the food delivery backup is worried about bad reviews! Teachers in the past no longer meet each other, and my classmates are scattered everywhere. How can I be happy again? Where can I find the Ming Dynasty? I am not worried, who is worried! My child, you are really right. The environment is still this environment, and the society is still this society. From the beginning, we have deviated from the normal path, and we have lost the way of justice! Your speechlessness, cold eyes and self-deprecation should be your calm and unique perspective. Your confusion, confusion and troubles are the foundation of your kindness and you should be proud of it! It is because they are too utilitarian and impersonal that they allow many spirits and souls to wander in the emptiness of reinforced concrete! Child, you have to be confident and don’t care about other people’s nonsense! There are people in this world who create smog, and there are people who fight all their lives and advocate for environmental protection. There are people in this society who tirelessly pursue fame and fortune, and there are good people who spend their entire lives educating rural girls and spend all their efforts! There are villains there who secretly rejoice in shackling people, and here there are heroes and heroines who bravely resist the powerful. Just as there are people in this world who covet the territory of other countries, there are also people who rise up to fight and take it as an honor to defend their homeland unyieldingly! My child, this diverse world itself has different tones, and everyone has his own unique preferences: He loves gold and silver chains, which reflect the brilliance of his face, and you treasure soft jade and green emeralds as treasures in your heart. Maybe, maybe, what you lose is worldly talk, but what you gain is the attention and embrace of the whole world! Your elfin brushstrokes depict the beauty of the soul; your melodious singing voice conveys the euphemism and beauty of the Divine Comedy of Heaven. There are people in this world who just like to talk and make noises. If they don't like it, they will be depressed, mentally and nervously. Who knows that everyone has mental illness, but some people are calm and floating in the sky, while some people unfortunately fall into hell and suffer! Children, don't worry, open your kind heart to accommodate others, and use the cornerstone of self-confidence to resist the noise of others! When people couldn't see through the Mona Lisa, they said it was a mysterious smile. But once they understood the true meaning of the goddess, no one could help but worship her and fall down on her face. Maybe, you are China's Van Gogh. The graffiti of the past may be the treasure of tomorrow; the casual ditty may have the same charm as Dante's Divine Comedy. When you become the most unfortunate person in the eyes of others, you may be leading the latest trend in the world - go your own way and let others tell you. My child, I don’t blame you for everything. It’s just that this world is too utilitarian, too despicable, too stingy, too vain, too boring, and too lively.

2b83b5bc46149c9f9324f8062e2690042ffb8404.sourceText: 中国炒房团奔袭美国 大呼“什么都太便宜”(图)
2b83b5bc46149c9f9324f8062e2690042ffb8404.translatedText: Chinese real estate speculators rush to the United States, shouting "Everything is too cheap" (Photo)

f9900234ae7d0d592fa8f1d8f9835d64765e8095.sourceText: 中国炒房团奔袭美国 大呼“什么都太便宜”(图) 2011年9月15日，北京秋季房地产展示交易会上，美国洛杉…
f9900234ae7d0d592fa8f1d8f9835d64765e8095.translatedText: Chinese real estate speculators rush to the United States, shouting "Everything is too cheap" (Photo) On September 15, 2011, at the Beijing Autumn Real Estate Exhibition and Trade Fair, Los Angeles, the United States...

319041c0618f7a8c7acdb7f30bd7183265c1db42.sourceText: 2011年9月15日，北京秋季房地产展示交易会上，美国洛杉矶、旧金山、纽约、拉斯维加斯地产展台。
319041c0618f7a8c7acdb7f30bd7183265c1db42.translatedText: On September 15, 2011, at the Beijing Autumn Real Estate Exhibition and Trade Fair, real estate booths in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, and Las Vegas.

1d5ff73203f2fc2c43ea5b44ff5680da69550f06.sourceText: 三十年前，日本人在美国豪掷千金；三十年后，腰缠万贯的中国投资人，正一波波地冲向美国楼市以及所有值得投资的领域。支撑这些中国买家的，是过去十年中国迅速膨胀的资产泡沫所带来的巨量财富。
1d5ff73203f2fc2c43ea5b44ff5680da69550f06.translatedText: Thirty years ago, the Japanese spent a lot of money in the United States; thirty years later, wealthy Chinese investors are rushing into the U.S. property market and all areas worth investing in waves. Supporting these Chinese buyers is the huge wealth generated by China's rapidly expanding asset bubble over the past decade.

6e571cf5e35d9a2bc0573a116d3bf223d83ba271.sourceText: 35岁的印度人Amy发现，她的美国梦正被一群疯狂的中国人搅乱了。
6e571cf5e35d9a2bc0573a116d3bf223d83ba271.translatedText: Amy, a 35-year-old Indian, found that her American dream was being disrupted by a group of crazy Chinese.

611c977a4ace666d801c09d66207622e47043400.sourceText: Amy是硅谷一家IT公司的经理，她跟丈夫想在加州小镇帕洛阿尔托（Palo Alto）买一套房。她已经下了12次单，但几乎每次都被中国家庭买走棗这些中国买家全额现金付款，还至少比房主开价高出二十多万美元。
611c977a4ace666d801c09d66207622e47043400.translatedText: Amy is a manager of an IT company in Silicon Valley. She and her husband want to buy an apartment in the small town of Palo Alto, California. She has placed orders 12 times, but almost every time she was bought by a Chinese family. These Chinese buyers paid in full cash and were at least $200,000 higher than the asking price of the homeowner.

8ec019a89a02b2352af99241bc96e4fcde09d795.sourceText: 要知道，他们所在的帕洛阿尔托房价不菲，一套房子至少在150万美元以上。这里被称为硅谷最好的地区之一，是斯坦福大学所在地，也是Facebook等公司总部所在。
8ec019a89a02b2352af99241bc96e4fcde09d795.translatedText: You know, the housing prices in Palo Alto where they are located are expensive, with a house costing at least US$1.5 million. Known as one of the best areas in Silicon Valley, it is home to Stanford University and the headquarters of companies such as Facebook.

65b7c304f049aed2dc848c610c5dc88e8d8b11ea.sourceText: 这些中国买家身上贴着一些共同的标签：人在中年，有一个十几岁的孩子。父母一般买了房就回国，留孩子在美国上学。
65b7c304f049aed2dc848c610c5dc88e8d8b11ea.translatedText: These Chinese buyers have some common labels: they are middle-aged and have a teenage child. Parents usually buy a house and then return to China, leaving their children to go to school in the United States.

0635902e9d12e0e538ab138a081c70b0a1e00e7c.sourceText: 她的中国朋友这样向她解释，这种情况下，一般父母在中国赚钱比在美国容易得多，且对于赚来的钱没有太多安全感，?#24635;之以后要移民，干脆现在就买房?#12290;
0635902e9d12e0e538ab138a081c70b0a1e00e7c.translatedText: Her Chinese friend explained to her that in this case, it is much easier for parents to make money in China than in the United States, and they do not have much sense of security about the money they earn. If they want to immigrate in the future, why not buy a house now?

15795db497bc2e4d44910992db34c9225d127562.sourceText: Amy仍然觉得不可思议：怎么可能存够那么多现金呢？
15795db497bc2e4d44910992db34c9225d127562.translatedText: Amy still finds it incredible: How can it be possible to save so much cash?

0e33b76ec65e214ec0cca65cf81b271cc67cad36.sourceText: 事实上，越来越多出手阔绰的中国买家正像黄蜂一样涌入美国地产市场及其他投资领域。支撑这些中国买家的，是过去十年中国迅速膨胀的资产泡沫所带来的巨量财富。
0e33b76ec65e214ec0cca65cf81b271cc67cad36.translatedText: In fact, more and more generous Chinese buyers are flooding into the U.S. real estate market and other investment fields like wasps. Supporting these Chinese buyers is the huge wealth generated by China's rapidly expanding asset bubble over the past decade.

39a249178856d3bd5769c55a2e8cae579143b787.sourceText: 全美房地产经纪人协会的数据显示，从2011年起，中国超越墨西哥和英国，迅速成为美国房地产物业的第二大国际买家，仅次于美国邻国加拿大，占国际销售额的11%，接近一年90亿美元。这一数字相当于印度购买力的两倍，而过去数年，两者在美国房地产市场上的表现曾经不相上下。
39a249178856d3bd5769c55a2e8cae579143b787.translatedText: Data from the National Association of Realtors shows that since 2011, China has surpassed Mexico and the United Kingdom and has quickly become the second largest international buyer of U.S. real estate properties, second only to U.S. neighbor Canada, accounting for 11% of international sales and nearly $9 billion a year. That's twice the purchasing power of India, which has been neck-and-neck in the U.S. real estate market over the past few years.

4141bcc805451fd457f3abe92415767732167875.sourceText: 全美房地产经纪人协会主席罗纳德 菲利普斯在接受媒体采访时曾提到，70%的中国买家喜欢住在美国西岸的加州洛杉矶，其次是纽约州的纽约和佛罗里达州的迈阿密。
4141bcc805451fd457f3abe92415767732167875.translatedText: Ronald Phillips, chairman of the National Association of Realtors, mentioned in an interview with the media that 70% of Chinese buyers prefer to live in Los Angeles, California, on the West Coast of the United States, followed by New York, New York, and Miami, Florida.

5c8db9adc7bf58b9b2750f494496965e41cd3e5a.sourceText: 美国商务部提供的数据显示，2011年，中国人卖掉了透过美国银行和证券经纪持有的包括美股、债券等证券产品，合共320亿美元。同时对美国的产业直接投资增加了5.76亿美元。
5c8db9adc7bf58b9b2750f494496965e41cd3e5a.translatedText: Data provided by the U.S. Department of Commerce show that in 2011, the Chinese sold a total of US$32 billion in securities products including U.S. stocks, bonds, etc. held through U.S. banks and securities brokers. At the same time, direct investment in industries in the United States increased by US$576 million.

3e48af9a3b6abecb6ae8ffd180486928849bc9ce.sourceText: 中国买家在纽约、洛杉矶，甚至在过去鲜有中国买家问津的佛罗里达州大手笔扫楼的轶事，频繁见诸美国报端。美国媒体评价称，这让人回想起曾经于二十世纪八十年代席卷美国的日本人购房潮，”后来随着日本经济的崩溃，这股热潮也随之消退了”。
3e48af9a3b6abecb6ae8ffd180486928849bc9ce.translatedText: Anecdotes about Chinese buyers spending large sums of money to sweep up properties in New York, Los Angeles, and even in Florida, a state that few Chinese buyers paid attention to in the past, are frequently reported in American newspapers. American media commented that this was reminiscent of the wave of Japanese home buying that swept the United States in the 1980s. "Later, with the collapse of Japan's economy, this wave also subsided."

79f925633d963c8feb7e606109a9aaa5027d5cd1.translatedText: "In the United States, you can buy a house with money"

5eb98a68d736983f7ce2da023b0a7fefe827771f.sourceText: 50岁的郭冬是个老北京，他自称”红旗下生红旗下长”，一直以为自己会在北京四环内那一套160多平米的公寓里住上一辈子。2002年，老郭才以每平米7800元的价格置办了这套房产。
5eb98a68d736983f7ce2da023b0a7fefe827771f.translatedText: 50-year-old Guo Dong is an old Beijinger. He calls himself "the leader born under a red flag" and always thought that he would live in a 160-square-meter apartment in Beijing's Fourth Ring Road for the rest of his life. In 2002, Lao Guocai purchased this property at a price of 7,800 yuan per square meter.

bc77c387669d9a5dc2e796014166f059a0d48c22.sourceText: 八年后，他卖掉了自己在北京的据点，转而成为美国西海岸的中国房东。
bc77c387669d9a5dc2e796014166f059a0d48c22.translatedText: Eight years later, he sold his stronghold in Beijing and became a Chinese landlord on the West Coast of the United States.

3c7d8755fd21dddec1df2eaf18618b54da92f057.sourceText: 新房产位于一个叫Woodland[最新消息 价格 户型点评]的小镇，距离美国加州首府萨克拉门托20公里，距离旧金山一个多小时车程。别墅230多平米，前后是花园院子。
3c7d8755fd21dddec1df2eaf18618b54da92f057.translatedText: The new property is located in a small town called Woodland [latest news, price, apartment reviews], 20 kilometers away from Sacramento, the capital of California, and more than an hour's drive from San Francisco. The villa is more than 230 square meters, with gardens and yards in front and behind.

10b902700674c26fe75cc544699280afd25da60b.sourceText: 老郭拿下它花了26.5万美元。房子是2004年建成的，在2006年美国房地产泡沫顶峰时曾卖到过58万美元。上一任房主是个不到40岁的美国精英，2008年金融危机以后房价暴跌，跟很多美国人一样，房主选择了”策略性违约”棗他觉得再按买房时的价格还贷”不值”，不想继续还贷，于是房子被银行收回。
10b902700674c26fe75cc544699280afd25da60b.translatedText: Lao Guo spent US$265,000 to acquire it. The house was built in 2004 and sold for $580,000 at the peak of the U.S. housing bubble in 2006. The last homeowner was an American elite under 40 years old. After the financial crisis in 2008, house prices plummeted. Like many Americans, the homeowner chose a "strategic default" because he felt that it was "not worth it" to repay the loan at the price when he bought the house. He did not want to continue to repay the loan, so the house was repossessed by the bank.

47dd9c799b08da8e5bf4e9f895bdab515bd1b9f6.sourceText: 这类房子被称作”法拍房”，很多中国买家前往抄底，捡的便是这类”便宜货”。 在美国，中国买家动辄全额现金支付房款，深得卖主欢心。老郭甚至因此PK掉两个报价比他高的美国买主。
47dd9c799b08da8e5bf4e9f895bdab515bd1b9f6.translatedText: This type of house is called a "foreclosure house". Many Chinese buyers go there to hunt for bargains and pick up such "bargains." In the United States, Chinese buyers often pay full cash for a house, which makes the sellers happy. Lao Guo even lost two American buyers who quoted higher prices than him.

9bcbbd535c9db416469a5e795873c26262e0d1a6.sourceText: 现金来自中国的卖房款。2010年初，他以每平米35000元的价格卖掉自己住了八年的房子，此时的房价已经比当初购房时翻了四倍。
9bcbbd535c9db416469a5e795873c26262e0d1a6.translatedText: The cash comes from the sale of the house in China. In early 2010, he sold the house he had lived in for eight years for 35,000 yuan per square meter. At this time, the house price had quadrupled compared to when he bought it.

12b86398dd73da5477b2de057fda6eb5cb18a2d9.sourceText: 那时正是房价最高涨的时候，”几乎没有卖不出去的房子，房产公司到处在找房源”。约好看房的那一天，老郭家前后接待了一百多人。一天内的到访人数，超过前七年的总和。中介公司的几拨人还有互相掩护当托的，有些买主甚至想直接放几百万的现金立刻成交。
12b86398dd73da5477b2de057fda6eb5cb18a2d9.translatedText: At that time, housing prices were at their highest. “There were almost no houses that could not be sold, and real estate companies were looking for housing everywhere.” On the day when we made an appointment to view the house, Lao Guo's family received more than a hundred people. The number of visitors in one day exceeded the total number of visitors in the previous seven years. Several groups of people in the intermediary company also cover each other, and some buyers even want to directly deposit millions of cash to complete the transaction immediately.

981b22545eabc93e4b3e45e877da43d32026b18c.sourceText: 一套北京四环内的房子卖了近600万元，大约比老郭在”美国农村”那套别墅价格的三倍还多。
981b22545eabc93e4b3e45e877da43d32026b18c.translatedText: A house within the Fourth Ring Road in Beijing was sold for nearly 6 million yuan, which is about three times the price of Lao Guo's villa in "Rural America."

e7d410329a9c48c6c58b86ed88a171e4f9bcc30d.sourceText: 让老郭真正下定决心抛售炙手可热的北京房产的，还是因为孩子。24岁的儿子在美国西海岸一家大学念书，楼市低迷，租房市场却日益看涨。索性置办一套房产，也好为日后孩子移民做准备。
e7d410329a9c48c6c58b86ed88a171e4f9bcc30d.translatedText: What made Lao Guo really determined to sell off the hot real estate in Beijing was because of his children. My 24-year-old son is studying at a university on the West Coast of the United States. The housing market is in a slump, but the rental market is increasingly bullish. Simply buy a property to prepare for your children's future immigration.

5d7df4006ac1eb860d80ffe2e4117895b07168ea.sourceText: 美国的国际买家对地域的偏好各异棗加拿大人喜欢买佛罗里达或者南加州的房子，大多用于冬季度假；墨西哥人偏好在得克萨斯购置房产，因为回国方便。而中国人的住宅群集中扎堆在好的学区和大型实验室附近。
5d7df4006ac1eb860d80ffe2e4117895b07168ea.translatedText: International buyers in the United States have different regional preferences: Canadians like to buy houses in Florida or Southern California, mostly for winter vacations; Mexicans prefer to buy properties in Texas because it is convenient to return home. The Chinese residential clusters are clustered near good school districts and large laboratories.

46cf2b6faf8da2afacd2eeb6f7b1f3b4f32f5e46.sourceText: 台湾人罗懿慧是美国Prudential Douglas Elliman地产公司的高级副总裁，代理纽约长岛的房产已近20年。她对南方周末记者说，在长岛买房子的中国人大多是为了”方便小孩读书”。长岛位于纽约东边，是一座临海狭长型小岛。当地税率较高，算得上纽约的”富人区”。交通也很方便，火车二十分钟能直通曼哈顿。
46cf2b6faf8da2afacd2eeb6f7b1f3b4f32f5e46.translatedText: Taiwanese Luo Yihui is the senior vice president of Prudential Douglas Elliman Real Estate Company in the United States. She has been representing real estate in Long Island, New York for nearly 20 years. She told Southern Weekend reporters that most Chinese people who buy houses on Long Island do so "to make it easier for their children to study." Long Island is located east of New York and is a long and narrow island near the sea. The local tax rate is relatively high and it can be considered a "rich area" in New York. The transportation is also very convenient. The train can go directly to Manhattan in 20 minutes.

7c8514531fd9e85f875ce26c86f3d9d811431db8.sourceText: ”在美国，出钱就可以买房子，没绿卡的话到纽约私立学校注册就有I-20（入学许可）。”罗懿慧说，”几乎每个人来都是为了下一代。”
7c8514531fd9e85f875ce26c86f3d9d811431db8.translatedText: "In the United States, you can buy a house by paying money. If you don't have a green card, you can get an I-20 (admission permit) by registering at a private school in New York." Luo Yihui said, "Almost everyone comes here for the next generation."

e70e2d89ad58aa07e6db72d515d5a6f5f4aac982.sourceText: 2009年9月6日，在北京秋季房展上，美国房地产项目在做推介。
e70e2d89ad58aa07e6db72d515d5a6f5f4aac982.translatedText: On September 6, 2009, at the Beijing Autumn Housing Show, American real estate projects were being promoted.

08cf917eaebdaf58f5a7cdcf739893e8b8cd9db4.sourceText: 罗懿慧的中国客人2012年突然一窝蜂地多了起来，多到让人怀疑这是不是场”逃难潮”。
08cf917eaebdaf58f5a7cdcf739893e8b8cd9db4.translatedText: Luo Yihui’s Chinese customers suddenly increased in 2012, so much that one wonders if this is a “fleeing wave.”

886d1125a523d2aa73c9d827c9ceaaf98b945998.sourceText: 这些中国客户不难辨认：他们或带着孩子，十几个人一群，像观光团一样考察待售的楼房。他们看房很勤奋，”不愿意错过任何一个”，觉得”什么都太便宜”。
886d1125a523d2aa73c9d827c9ceaaf98b945998.translatedText: These Chinese customers are not difficult to identify: they may be with their children, in groups of more than a dozen, inspecting the buildings for sale like a tour group. They are very diligent in looking at properties, "don't want to miss anything" and think "everything is too cheap".

57ecf067ba953b6ef480329b5ca310d8bab57f81.sourceText: 他们容易给人”财大气粗”的印象。看房的时候，有人就直接跑到院子里抽烟，抽完烟蒂就丢在地上。有时候进门一看房间不是中意的，转身就走，顾不上在场房主的感受。
57ecf067ba953b6ef480329b5ca310d8bab57f81.translatedText: They tend to give people the impression of being "rich and wealthy". When looking at the house, some people went directly to the yard to smoke, and after smoking the cigarette butts, they threw them on the ground. Sometimes when you walk in and see the room you don't like it, you turn around and leave, without caring about the feelings of the owner of the room.

79410118b3542d3b7563e3d865257bc36c1b1747.sourceText: ”每个人都说要买5000万的楼。”罗懿慧说，她不得不甄选那些”严肃的投资者”，才带其看房。
79410118b3542d3b7563e3d865257bc36c1b1747.translatedText: "Everyone said they wanted to buy a 50 million house." Luo Yihui said that she had to select those "serious investors" before showing them the house.

3da3e0efbe1a2d90d15c8e833e1a0a514ef6f6ad.sourceText: 这些人中大多数是三四十岁的中青年，”很多人四十多岁资产都上亿”，年轻、富有得让人讶异。台湾人罗懿慧有时候会好奇这些内地客户钱从哪来，他们不外乎这几年因投资房地产身家倍增，或者因为所投资的公司上市，年纪轻轻就已腰缠万贯。
3da3e0efbe1a2d90d15c8e833e1a0a514ef6f6ad.translatedText: Most of these people are young and middle-aged people in their thirties and forties. "Many people in their forties have assets of hundreds of millions." They are surprisingly young and wealthy. Taiwanese Luo Yihui sometimes wonders where the money of these mainland customers comes from. Their wealth has doubled in recent years due to investment in real estate, or because the companies they invested in have gone public, they have become rich at a young age.

9c3ea31c42699f56a7a0bc63a6fb030ee2412a1d.sourceText: ”他们说，过去几年在大陆赚钱很好赚，有什么好的项目，评估下，几个人凑点钱就投，土法炼钢。但是现在越来越困难了。”罗说。
9c3ea31c42699f56a7a0bc63a6fb030ee2412a1d.translatedText: "They said that it was easy to make money in the mainland in the past few years. If there were any good projects, after evaluation, a few people would pool some money and invest in it, making steel by local methods. But now it is getting more and more difficult." Luo said.

7088c7ef2ab0fb8438369227cea972c5e5fd4bb0.sourceText: 罗将这种中国投资客蜂拥而入的导火索归结于美国签证之门大开。从频繁拒签到新开驻京第二签证处，用了十年时间。据美国驻华大使馆数据，2012年近140万中国人申请赴美签证，比2011年增加四成多。
7088c7ef2ab0fb8438369227cea972c5e5fd4bb0.translatedText: Luo attributed the influx of Chinese investors to the wide opening of U.S. visas. It took ten years from frequent visa rejections to the opening of a new second visa office in Beijing. According to data from the U.S. Embassy in China, nearly 1.4 million Chinese applied for visas to the United States in 2012, an increase of more than 40% from 2011.

36709e59c0ae5d4ab7f54b629b9055f0e84f0d9e.sourceText: 在长岛，十年前几乎还看不到中国投资客的影子，五六年前陆陆续续有来自上海和北京的中国买家，这两年，西安、贵阳、成都这些二三线城市的金主开始成群结队地降临。他们出手阔绰，常常豪掷千金。
36709e59c0ae5d4ab7f54b629b9055f0e84f0d9e.translatedText: In Changdao, there were almost no traces of Chinese investors ten years ago. Five or six years ago, there were Chinese buyers from Shanghai and Beijing. In the past two years, investors from second- and third-tier cities such as Xi'an, Guiyang, and Chengdu began to arrive in droves. They spend a lot of money and often spend a lot of money.

a5e49201e397bfdace9a5435192f8fc98e0888eb.sourceText: 长岛的地产市场一直颇安静，过去很多上千万美金的房子很久无法成交，偶尔有一两个买家前来考察便无下文。”曼哈顿这边真的有很多有钱人，但是房地产交易没那么疯狂，美国本地人一般不会花那么多钱去买房子。”罗懿慧说。
a5e49201e397bfdace9a5435192f8fc98e0888eb.translatedText: Long Island's real estate market has always been quite quiet. In the past, many houses worth tens of millions of dollars could not be sold for a long time. Occasionally, one or two buyers came to inspect but nothing happened. "There are really a lot of rich people here in Manhattan, but the real estate transactions are not that crazy, and local Americans generally don't spend that much money to buy a house." Luo Yihui said.

cd068b537291113caeb680ea2e6005b12f813451.sourceText: 现在这些房子的接盘者基本都是中国买家。长岛最近成交的三个上千万的房子，买主都是中国人。尽管价格不菲，但他们仍然觉得”比中国的便宜”。对于他们中的有些人来说，买一栋房子，”就像买一件500美金的衣服”。
cd068b537291113caeb680ea2e6005b12f813451.translatedText: Now the takers of these houses are basically Chinese buyers. The buyers of the three tens of millions of houses recently sold on Long Island were all Chinese. Although they are expensive, they still feel "cheaper than those in China". For some of them, buying a house is "like buying a $500 piece of clothing."

cbb27b90de97b6c3fd84f66acd6c632cd2cd64af.sourceText: 一个半月前，一对中国夫妇来纽约看房。先生差不多五十岁，在北京做生意。太太不到四十岁，带着小孩，扬言要”搞定房子才回国”。而此时，她没有绿卡，甚至没有当地的银行账户，在此之前只有过一次美国观光的经历。两三天后，这对夫妇敲定了长岛一栋130万美金的别墅，定金13万美元。两天之内，钱全部到账。
cbb27b90de97b6c3fd84f66acd6c632cd2cd64af.translatedText: A month and a half ago, a Chinese couple came to New York to view a house. My husband is almost fifty years old and is doing business in Beijing. The wife was less than forty years old and had a child with her. She threatened to "finish the house before returning to China." At this time, she did not have a green card or even a local bank account. She had only visited the United States once before. Two or three days later, the couple settled on a US$1.3 million villa in Long Island with a deposit of US$130,000. Within two days, all the money arrived.

a05db8be8fa317a575615e91dfe2b237266053ab.sourceText: ”你有时候会觉得不可理喻，但是她真的就这么买了房子。”罗懿慧说。
a05db8be8fa317a575615e91dfe2b237266053ab.translatedText: "Sometimes you may find it unreasonable, but she really bought a house like this." Luo Yihui said.

1f6c8b62edbd2d2edc92aae96d5dff9fe8b0eb91.sourceText: 眼下，国家规定的换汇指标是，每人每年5万美元。像老郭买房，需要的金额不多，就多找几个朋友帮忙凑额度。而大额度转钱出海也早已不是难事。”跟打苍蝇一样简单，五亿十亿慢点，几百万几千万转一转就出来了。先落地香港，还不是地下钱庄。”美国一家华人投资公司合伙人告诉南方周末记者。
1f6c8b62edbd2d2edc92aae96d5dff9fe8b0eb91.translatedText: At present, the exchange rate quota set by the state is US$50,000 per person per year. For example, Lao Guo didn't need much money to buy a house, so he asked a few friends to help him raise the amount. It is no longer difficult to transfer large amounts of money overseas. "It's as easy as swatting a fly. Five billion billion will come out slowly, and millions and tens of millions will come out in just a few turns. It will be launched in Hong Kong first, and it will not be an underground bank yet." A partner of a Chinese investment company in the United States told a Southern Weekend reporter.

2c7c133264b3b830863938367d064f8a9ab2f3cc.sourceText: 而一些亚洲关系深厚的银行，比如汇丰、花旗，可以为在美国买房的中国投资客提供贷款。他们明白，越来越多的中国买家正在涌入美国，而相似的游戏规则也被从大陆移植到了大洋彼岸棗要想贷款，可以，请先至少将贷款额的50%存至银行。
2c7c133264b3b830863938367d064f8a9ab2f3cc.translatedText: Some banks with deep connections in Asia, such as HSBC and Citigroup, can provide loans to Chinese investors buying houses in the United States. They understand that more and more Chinese buyers are pouring into the United States, and similar rules of the game have also been transplanted from the mainland to the other side of the ocean. If you want to get a loan, yes, please first deposit at least 50% of the loan amount in the bank.

b011793428ae804e1eeec88d24863e826f071654.sourceText: ”来这边是为了抄底。以前国内可以投资的领域，现在都断了。股票、房地产倒掉了，高利贷完蛋了，理财产品又看不懂，古董基本都是假的，冬虫夏虫、茶都不靠谱，一炒就上去。”上述合伙人说，”更关键的一点是，大家找不到安全感。”
b011793428ae804e1eeec88d24863e826f071654.translatedText: "I came here to hunt for bargains. In the past, all domestic investment fields were closed. Stocks and real estate have been dumped, loan sharking is dead, financial products are incomprehensible, antiques are basically fake, insects, summer insects, and tea are not reliable, and they will be sold as soon as they are speculated." The above-mentioned partner said, "The more important point is that no one can find a sense of security."
