ef8f71b416b830fe2203ed704d52ba746eb97fb5.sourceText: 电子广告牌新法获批 （亚省时报） 州立法机构已经批准了电子广告牌新法案，允许在本州没有天文观测站地方，设立电子广告牌。 虽然布鲁尔州长在本届立法会会期开始时就否决了这项法案，参众两会在周一批准了修改后的法案。 新法涉及天文台行业成千上万的就业岗位，和拥有数以千计的电子告示板的广告客户。新条例重新送至州长办公桌，它允许在凤凰城地区和本州西南部大部分地区点亮电子广告牌，除上述地区外，凡其他所有本州地区竖立视为非法行为。 广告牌行业偏向原来的旧法，在法院在去年11月称，现有的广告牌（法）已存在数十年，严重影响高速公路的美化，遂将旧法裁决为非法。
ef8f71b416b830fe2203ed704d52ba746eb97fb5.translatedText: > New law for electronic billboards has been approved (Alberta Times) The state legislature has approved a new bill for electronic billboards, allowing the establishment of electronic billboards in places where there are no astronomical observatories in the state. Although Governor Brewer vetoed the bill at the beginning of this legislative session, the House and Senate approved a revised version of the bill on Monday. The new law affects thousands of jobs in the observatory industry and advertisers who own thousands of electronic notice boards. The new regulations, which are back on the governor's desk, would allow electronic billboards to be lit in the Phoenix area and much of the southwestern part of the state, making them illegal in all other parts of the state. The billboard industry favored the original old law. In November last year, the court ruled that the existing billboard (law) had existed for decades and seriously affected the beautification of highways, so it ruled the old law illegal.

d1d03d8b9f9a0377f13e8d1611ca10b2faeca82f.sourceText: 凤鸣：黄金公主号邮轮阿拉斯加探索之旅（五） 凤凰城 凤鸣 上船第五天早上6:00邮轮在小城史凯威（Skagway）仃靠。史凯威是位于阿拉斯加东南方内湾航道的最北端。在史凯威仃靠的主要旅游项目，是乘坐世界上最美的铁路。我们本想在船上买乘坐小火车的票，可是我们去晚了，卖票的走了，我们只好下船后去火车站买。实际上在火车站买票还每人省了 $10，在等待火车的时间，我们去看了热闹的百老汇大道。沿途皆是展示着十九世纪时，因淘金热潮兴起的小镇模样。例如：木制人行道，古装马车，女马车夫。可以參观第98小径历史博物馆，其中存放了当年淘金热潮的精致艺术品。沿街布满了卖旅游纪念品的商店，商店里琳琅满目的纪念品，让眼睛迎接不暇、爱不释手，各店的纪念品也是大同小意。 怀特通路及育空路线由斯咖格威 （Skagway）的海平开始，在仅仅二十英里的距离，己攀登达至近三千呎的高峰，而其中百分之三点九都是布满陡峭的斜坡，铁路的急弯造就了怀特通路成为窄轨铁路。兴建这全長一百一十英里的道路，在各方面都是很大的挑战。工程由南北两队工程人员同时进行，在一九零零年七月二十九日，两队工作人员在卡克罗斯 (Carcross) 汇合。为了记念这历史性时刻，铁路主席撒母耳 格拉弗白(Samuel H Graves) 在此设下纪念碑。在整个工程中，共有三万五千人员投入工作。虽然每位工人工作的时间都各有不同，但他们都一起克服了重重困难而达到理想。这总值一千万美元的工程，是由英国的资金，美国的工程师和加拿大承建商共同合作的成果。为了克服困难及充满挑战性的天气和地理环境，工程动用了数以万计的工作人员及四百五十吨的炸药，来建设这「黄金铁路」。 下午3:0pm我们搭乘上世界最美铁路的火车，去白嗌口与育空(加拿大境内) ，沿着当年淘金者所走的路线，去經历当年淘金者所走过的路线的艰险。隨着火车慢慢爬上山峦，透过车窗我们看到一边是悬崖绝壁、一边是万丈深渊。首先看到了当年淘金者的公墓，他们为追求黄金梦，而長眠于此。远处長年积雪不化的层层雪山高耸入雲，有从雪山上融化的溪水，从山涧飞流直下。有层峦叠嶂的密林，也有枯草丛生的荒坡。在积雪不化的路边，半人高的积雪，有整齐的铁敲铲过的痕迹。看到有一废弃的当年最長的悬臂梁桥，被在一九六九年，筑成六百七十五呎長的隧道及一座新的桥梁所代替。途中經过两个钻山隧道，都建在高达一千呎之上。在菲莎(加拿大卑诗省) 越过了美加边境，加拿大的海关亦设在此处。很难想像，当年的淘金者，是怎样在恶性环境下，背着淘金工具和他们的梦想，一步一步艰难地到达育空地区的白马市、卡可罗斯、班奈特（加拿大卑诗省）。更难想像筑路工人，又是如何克服千难万险，筑成了这世界上独具一格、独一无二的最高、最美的铁路，让我们这后来人享受。沿途美丽的秀丽风景，如诗如画，用相机留下美好瞬间。 坐火车下山后，火车直接开到邮轮仃靠的码头，下了火车直接登船，非常方便。晚饭后在大剧场有文艺表演。这次我们早早就赶到，找了最佳位置的座位坐下，等待演出开始。开始后才知道，今天仍然由年青魔术师Alexander magician 表演，他的表演比上次在小剧场的表演更精彩。尤其是大变活人的表演，真让人看不透，一个大美女，双手被绑住，关进箱子加上鎖，过一会怎样就变成他被鎖在箱子里，我们看得是目瞪口呆，这就是魔术师的高明过人之处，让人十分佩服。
d1d03d8b9f9a0377f13e8d1611ca10b2faeca82f.translatedText: Fengming: Golden Princess Cruise Alaska Discovery Journey (V) Phoenix City Fengming The cruise docked at Skagway at 6:00 in the morning on the fifth day. Skagway is the northernmost point of Alaska's southeastern Inland Passage. The main tourist attraction in Skagway is to take the most beautiful railway in the world. We originally wanted to buy tickets for the train on the boat, but we were late and the ticket seller left. We had to buy tickets at the train station after we got off the boat. $10. While waiting for the train, we went to see the lively Broadway Avenue. Along the way, there are displays of the town that emerged due to the gold rush in the 19th century. For example, wooden sidewalks, period carriages, and female carriage drivers. You can visit the 98th Trail Historical Museum, which stores exquisite artworks from the gold rush. The streets are lined with shops selling tourist souvenirs. White Pass and Yukon Route via Skagway The Skagway begins at sea level and reaches a peak of nearly 3,000 feet in a distance of only 20 miles, of which 3.9% is covered with steep slopes. The sharp curves of the railway made the White Pass a narrow-gauge railway. The construction of this 110-mile road was a great challenge. The project was carried out by two teams of engineers from the north and the south. On July 29, 1900, the two teams of workers were in Carcross. Convergence. To commemorate this historic moment, Railway Chairman Samuel H Graves A monument was set up here. Throughout the project, a total of 35,000 people worked. Although each worker worked at different times, they all overcame many difficulties to achieve their goals. This project, worth 10 million US dollars, was the result of a joint effort between British funds, American engineers and Canadian contractors. In order to overcome the difficult and challenging weather and geographical environment, the project used tens of thousands of workers and 450 tons of explosives to build this "Golden Railway". At 3:00pm we took the train on the most beautiful railway in the world, going to Baijiakou and Yukon (in Canada) , follow the route that the gold prospectors took, and experience the hardships of the route that the gold prospectors took. As the train slowly climbed up the mountains, through the train window, we saw the cliffs on one side and the abyss on the other. First, we saw the cemetery where the gold diggers were buried in pursuit of their gold dream. In the distance, the layers of snow-capped mountains towered into the clouds, and streams melted from the snow-capped mountains, flowing from the mountain streams. Straight down. There are mountains of dense forests and barren slopes covered with dry grass. On the roadside where the snow is still half a man high, there are neat traces of shoveling of the longest cantilever beam that was once abandoned. The bridge was replaced by a 675-foot-long tunnel and a new bridge built in 1969, passing through two mountain tunnels, both built at a height of 1,000 feet in Fraser (British Columbia, Canada). After crossing the U.S.-Canada border, Canadian customs is also located here. It is difficult to imagine how the gold diggers back then carried gold mining tools and their dreams on their backs and reached Whitehorse, Cacoros, and Bennett in the Yukon Territory step by step in a vicious environment. British Columbia). It is even more difficult to imagine how the road construction workers overcame all kinds of difficulties and dangers to build the unique, unique, highest and most beautiful railway in the world, so that we, the future generations, can enjoy the beautiful and picturesque scenery along the way and capture the beautiful moments with our cameras. After taking the train down the mountain, the train drove directly to the pier where the cruise ship docked. It was very convenient to get off the train and board the ship. We arrived early this time and found the best seats to sit down. We only found out that the performance was still performed by the young magician Alexander Magician. His performance was even more exciting than the last performance in the small theater. Especially the performance of transforming a living person into a living person. It was really hard to see through. A beautiful woman had her hands tied and was put in a box and locked. After a while, she was locked in the box. We were dumbfounded. This is the magician's brilliance and admiration.

ed324194a88cefdb1f0aabc72f240def426c200b.sourceText: 这份排行榜对美国200个人口最多的地区进行安全驾驶员排名，科罗拉多州柯林斯堡（Fort Collins）是相对较安全的城市，在好事达公司的榜单上名列榜首，当地驾驶员发生行车事故的概率比普通美国司机低28.2%，平均每隔13.9年才发生一次交通事故。相比之下，司机撞车最频繁的地区包括美国多个人口最稠密的大都市区，华盛顿特区在危险驾驶方面再次名列首位。美国首都华盛顿居民发生行车事故的概率比全美平均水平高出109.3%，每隔4.8年就发生一次交通事故。
ed324194a88cefdb1f0aabc72f240def426c200b.translatedText: This ranking ranks the safest drivers in the 200 most populous areas in the United States. Fort Collins, Colorado (Fort Collins) Collins is a relatively safe city, ranking first on Allstate's list. Local drivers are 28.2% less likely to be involved in a traffic accident than the average American driver, with an average of only one accident every 13.9 years. By contrast, the areas where drivers crashed most frequently include several of the nation's most densely populated metropolitan areas, with Washington, D.C. again ranking first for dangerous driving. The probability of a traffic accident for residents of Washington, the capital of the United States, is 109.3% higher than the national average, with a traffic accident occurring every 4.8 years.

b05758ea89f98713f55444768e954e4df39f89ef.sourceText: 我们根据好事达公司的研究报告，在下面的幻灯片中介绍十个驾驶水准最糟糕的美国城市。尽管位居前列的危险城市包括主要的大都市区棗比如巴尔的摩、费城、迈阿密和旧金山棗然而全美最大的几座城市却在危险驾驶榜单上排名较低，让人感到惊讶。以汽车拥堵闻名的洛杉矶仅在榜单上排名第14位，拥有高效公共交通网络的纽约和芝加哥分别在榜单上名列第23位和第45位。
b05758ea89f98713f55444768e954e4df39f89ef.translatedText: In the slideshow below, we present the ten U.S. cities with the worst driving standards, based on research from Allstate. While the top dangerous cities include major metropolitan areas such as Baltimore, Philadelphia, Miami and San Francisco, it's surprising that some of the nation's largest cities rank lower on the dangerous driving list. Los Angeles, known for its car congestion, only ranked 14th on the list, while New York and Chicago, which have efficient public transportation networks, ranked 23rd and 45th respectively.

5b2bf4de3684ab676b77f199e446194b84ad40c5.sourceText: 除了柯林斯堡，其他登上最佳驾驶员榜单的十大城市包括：爱达荷州博伊西（Boise）、北达科他州苏福尔斯（Sioux Falls）、得克萨斯州布朗维尔（Brownville）、威斯康星州麦迪逊（Madison）、内华达州里诺（Reno）、亚拉巴马州亨茨维尔（Huntsville）、加利福尼亚州维塞利亚（Visalia）、亚拉巴马州蒙哥马利（Montgomery）和俄勒冈州尤金市（Eugene）。这些城市中人口最稠密的地区是威斯康星州麦迪逊的大学城，按照美国人口普查局根据2012年数据的估计，当地拥有240,323名居民，在美国最大城市排行榜上名列第82位。
5b2bf4de3684ab676b77f199e446194b84ad40c5.translatedText: In addition to Fort Collins, other top ten cities on the best driver list include: Boise, Idaho, Sioux Falls, North Dakota Falls, Texas; Madison, Wisconsin; Reno, Nevada; Huntsville, Alabama; Visalia, California; Montgomery, Alabama; and Eugene, Oregon. The most densely populated of these cities is the college town of Madison, Wisconsin, which has 240,323 residents, according to U.S. Census Bureau estimates based on 2012 data, ranking it 82nd on the list of the largest cities in the United States.

be9ae06ee6db2bb52f1e64d2f05d3fb50b459aba.sourceText: 在美国最大的城市中棗拥有百万以上居民的城市棗亚利桑那州凤凰城的驾驶环境最安全，当地司机发生交通事故的概率仅比全美平均水平高2.0%。通常来说，凤凰城居民平均每隔9.8年才发生一次事故。其他较为安全的主要大都市区包括圣迭戈、圣安东尼奥、芝加哥和休斯顿。
be9ae06ee6db2bb52f1e64d2f05d3fb50b459aba.translatedText: Among the largest cities in the United States, Phoenix, Arizona, a city with more than one million residents, has the safest driving environment. The probability of local drivers getting into traffic accidents is only 2.0% higher than the national average. Typically, Phoenix residents are involved in an accident only once every 9.8 years. Other major metropolitan areas that are safer include San Diego, San Antonio, Chicago and Houston.

9c307dc4cdcbc1378bf19316a58aaa3ed54875df.sourceText: 显而易见，在大都市区谨慎驾驶可能比人烟稀少地区的行车风险更大，但是每个人都应该迎接自己的挑战，尤其是对那些不熟悉该地区的司机。为了实现这个目标，汽车安全专家建议，那些计划驾驶汽车前往大城市游览的司机需要注意当地人可能认为显而易见的安全驾驶技巧：
9c307dc4cdcbc1378bf19316a58aaa3ed54875df.translatedText: Obviously, driving with caution in metropolitan areas may be more risky than driving in sparsely populated areas, but everyone should rise to their own challenges, especially drivers who are unfamiliar with the area. To achieve this goal, auto safety experts recommend that drivers who plan to take their cars to visit big cities need to pay attention to safe driving tips that locals may think are obvious:

7e5a39a235d8cc0c85c105f2aec8b7a84f98f990.sourceText: 留出足够的时间到达你的目的地。交通拥堵、信号灯时间过长、行人慢吞吞地过马路，以及不可避免的全年修路和绕道，几乎肯定会给司机的行驶时间造成严重影响。预计迫使你停车或放缓行驶速度的因素，沿途也许会出现意想不到的众多行人、紧急车辆、运货车、停放的汽车、出租车和城市公交车。
7e5a39a235d8cc0c85c105f2aec8b7a84f98f990.translatedText: Allow enough time to get to your destination. Traffic congestion, lengthy traffic lights, pedestrians taking their time crossing the road, and the inevitable year-round road construction and detours will almost certainly have a serious impact on a driver's travel time. Expect an unexpected number of pedestrians, emergency vehicles, delivery trucks, parked cars, taxis and city buses along the way, forcing you to stop or slow down.

d6c1b5d8d61116cfaab25025ab96657634c81f12.sourceText: 关注不断变化的交通状况。收听电台的交通报告，或者使用导航系统显示拥堵信息，寻找替代的行驶路线，尽量减少时间延误。
d6c1b5d8d61116cfaab25025ab96657634c81f12.translatedText: Follow changing traffic conditions. Listen to traffic reports on the radio or use your navigation system to display congestion information and find alternative driving routes to minimize delays.

b6c42dc5a17e7892ae4fd9ce81c9e5cb79b6e9dd.sourceText: 提前在地图上规划行驶路线，使用全球定位系统（GPS）找到最有效的方式抵达目的地；如果迷路的话，安全地靠边停车，然后询问方向，如果你感觉情况危险，请打电话给政府当局。
b6c42dc5a17e7892ae4fd9ce81c9e5cb79b6e9dd.translatedText: Plan your driving route on a map in advance and use Global Positioning System (GPS) to find the most efficient way to your destination; if you get lost, pull over safely and ask for directions, or call authorities if you feel the situation is dangerous.

041f892c0ed8072dfc36ecd0a2941fc1ce77c9e8.sourceText: 与此同时，大城市居民驾车前往人迹稀少的地区旅行，应该特别注意遵循以下指导原则：
041f892c0ed8072dfc36ecd0a2941fc1ce77c9e8.translatedText: At the same time, residents of big cities should pay special attention to following the following guidelines when traveling by car to sparsely populated areas:

d335c0ca2ca4f241d4170953a828239b99803cd2.sourceText: 注意最高车速的限制。道路上的车流量可能较少，车速限制较高，但是要控制过于加大油门的冲动，尤其是在你不熟悉的地区驾车行驶。
d335c0ca2ca4f241d4170953a828239b99803cd2.translatedText: Pay attention to the maximum speed limit. There may be less traffic on the road and higher speed limits, but resist the urge to hit the gas too hard, especially when driving in an area you're not familiar with.

881ea519d0f73930ab2f3906168705f0f0220b48.sourceText: 在没有人行横道标志的路段，随时留意可能从对面横穿马路的行人。
881ea519d0f73930ab2f3906168705f0f0220b48.translatedText: On sections of road where there are no crosswalk signs, always be on the lookout for pedestrians who may be crossing the road from the opposite side.

8e161526d42b55d1895894451ba297ab71d16fab.sourceText: 和前方车辆保持安全距离，尤其是大卡车，这些车辆的视线可能受限；确保有足够的空间和机会可以超越卡车，特别是行驶在双车道公路上。
8e161526d42b55d1895894451ba297ab71d16fab.translatedText: Keep a safe distance from vehicles in front of you, especially large trucks, which may have limited visibility; make sure there is enough space and opportunity to overtake trucks, especially on two-lane roads.

21bb944bdd89eec767e3b47264d6251fff9a42cc.sourceText: 凤凰城气如虹：洛矶山漫游之四维多利亚市 温哥华的清晨，天气寒冷，华哥驾驶的旅行车已停泊在静思堂门前，我们这群来自五洲四海的旅客，在旅馆吃完早餐，披挂寒衣，步行过去登车。导游老谢点算足够人数，向大家道声「早晨！」，开始第三天的旅程。 旅行车直驶往维多​​利亚海港渔人码头，等待搭乘渡轮到温哥华岛，所有乘客必须下车，徒步上船，海风迎面吹来，更感寒冷。这艘渡船庞大，我前所未见，船舱下面两层可容纳大量车辆，上面五层为旅客坐位，舱内设备齐全，餐厅茶座无缺。以往我在越南经常乘渡轮过河，由于越南南方为湄公河下游，分支为九龙江出海，河流特多，昔日没有能力建桥，如在西贡过河往守添，在美萩过前江去梹椥，在永隆过后江去芹苴厖处处都要靠渡轮，当年觉得那些渡轮规模很大，但今日乘船所见，对比之下，才知以前的渺小。 导游解释，今天全日都在岛上参观，岛上的维多利亚市是卑诗省首府，很多人就误以为这里叫维多利亚岛，其实是搞错，这里叫温哥华岛，是北美西海岸最大的岛屿，面积与台湾宝岛差不多，人口却只有八十万。原本政府计画兴建桥梁，使交通方便，但遭居民反对，他们不愿意招惹太多人到来，破坏恬静的生活。 登岛旅游，发觉这里地大人稀，树木青绿，花卉多彩，与世无争的境界，房屋楼宇充满欧洲风味。看来这种环境，最适合退休人士居住，不过，如果个性喜欢活动，喜欢热闹的话，这里不能心满意足，沿途左看右看，房屋疏落，经过几个市镇，店铺宁静，看不见花天酒地的娱乐场所。 旅行团首先参观闻名远近的宝翠花园(ButChart Gardens)，这花园地方广阔，风景独特，据说超过一百年历史。花园的正面是个广场，导游为我们购买入门券，并分派印有中文的地图指南，我略略翻阅，只见其译名是「布查特」而不是「宝翠」，花园物资原是一位叫珍妮．布查特私人所拥有，她喜爱种植花卉，毕生不断巧妙结合各类奇花异草，整理布置，建造下沉花园、玫瑰园、地中海园，还把庄​​园命名为「欢迎」，迎接各地客人参观，现在成为举世闻名谐音「不差的」(ButChart)花园。 广场是参观起点，也是终点，邻近有咖啡店、礼品店、种子售卖、询问处和洗手间，游客环绕一周观赏，可随意购买物品或停顿歇息。我太座最喜欢花卉，踏入这庞大庄园，心花怒放，观看花花世界，欣赏百花齐放，花枝招展，花样百出，千花吐艳，万花迎人，真正花多眼乱，拍摄不尽，录影不完，她总爱在花丛徘徊，在花架赏玩，在花朵前恋栈不舍，要不是我催促离开，她必定流连忘返，无法依时归队。 参观宝翠花园的时间最充足，大家都满意，个个开心，赞不绝口。继续下一站的行程是稍事逗留零的起点，这里不过是维多利亚市靠近海岸的一个小公园，建立一个书写「Mile 0」 的横型纪念碑，说明此地是加拿大一号高速公路西边的起点。公园不远处则有个纪念破脚者铜像，刻着泰利霍斯(Terry Fox)及其事迹，导游略述这位加拿大青年，右腿患肿瘤要截肢，后来他独脚长跑筹款以捐助癌症研究，死时廿二岁。 跟着参观维多利亚市府大楼，这楼房的建筑有点像英法国家的款式，也就是所谓欧洲风格，大楼里面宽敞宏伟，气势庄严，门窗的玻璃装置图案美丽，经常在名教堂看见那种艺术设备。市府位置美观，对面望见海域与船只，附近是公园草地的布置，转过去有座雄伟的旅馆，前面种植的树木修剪像盆栽的特色，气候凉快，显示祥和气氛。 午餐又是去中国城，啊！看来加拿大每一个城市都有中国城，真是华人的光彩。我以为温哥华岛离开陆地，中国人不会到来，事实却与我预估不符，原来这个岛一样有唐人街，更是加拿大最古老的唐人街，当年先侨是从旧金山转过来找寻另一个采矿地，后来同样是建筑铁路的劳工，苦不堪言，现在仍隐约留下旧痕迹，成为旅游观光景点，这里保留中国色彩，有华人的店铺与美食，欢迎宾客光临，我们华人，特别洋溢同胞的亲切感。 观光完维多利亚市的胜景，结束一天的旅程，下午告别温哥华岛，乘渡轮回归陆地，在返回旅馆途中，经过红鹤酒家用晚餐，红鹤酒家在温哥华很有口碑，听说加华作协曾在这里举办春节联欢大会，我有点印象，这晚到此品尝美食，感觉很愉快！
21bb944bdd89eec767e3b47264d6251fff9a42cc.translatedText: Phoenix City is like a rainbow: Rocky Mountain Tour Part 4 Victoria City It was a cold morning in Vancouver. The station wagon driven by Hua Ge had been parked in front of the Jing Si Hall. We, a group of travelers from all over the world, had breakfast at the hotel, put on our cold clothes, and walked over to board the bus. The tour guide Lao Xie counted enough people and said "Morning!" to everyone, starting the third day of the journey. The tour bus drove straight to Fisherman's Wharf in Victoria Harbor to wait for the ferry to Vancouver Island. All passengers had to get off the bus and board the boat on foot. The sea breeze blew in their faces, making them feel even colder. This ferry is huge and I have never seen it before. The lower two floors of the cabin can accommodate a large number of vehicles, and the upper five floors are passenger seats. The cabin is fully equipped, including restaurants and tea seats. In the past, I often took ferries to cross rivers in Vietnam. Since the southern part of Vietnam is the lower reaches of the Mekong River and branches to the Mekong River to the sea, there are many rivers. In the past, there was no ability to build bridges. For example, crossing the river in Saigon to Thu Thiem, crossing the Tien Giang in My Tho to go to Anhui, and crossing the Hou River in Vinh Long to go to Can Tho Pang had to rely on ferries. At that time, I thought those ferries were very large, but when I take a boat today, I can see how small they were before in comparison. The tour guide explained that we spent the whole day visiting the island. The city of Victoria on the island is the capital of British Columbia. Many people mistakenly think that this place is called Victoria Island. In fact, this is a mistake. This place is called Vancouver Island. It is the largest island on the west coast of North America. It is about the same size as Taiwan Island, but has a population of only 800,000. The government originally planned to build a bridge to make transportation more convenient, but it was opposed by residents who were unwilling to attract too many people and ruin their peaceful life. When traveling to the island, I found that there are few people here, the trees are green, the flowers are colorful, the world is peaceful, and the buildings are full of European flavor. It seems that this kind of environment is the most suitable for retired people to live. However, if you like activities and liveliness, you will not be satisfied here. Looking left and right along the way, you can see sparse houses. After passing several towns, the shops are quiet and there are no entertainment venues. The tour group first visited the famous ButChart Gardens. This garden is vast and has unique scenery. It is said to be more than a hundred years old. There is a square in front of the garden. The tour guide bought entrance tickets for us and distributed a map guide printed in Chinese. I flipped through it briefly and saw that the translation was "Butchart" instead of "Bao Cui". The garden supplies were originally purchased by a woman named Jenny. Privately owned by Butchart, she loved planting flowers. Throughout her life, she continued to skillfully combine various exotic flowers and plants, organize the layout, and build a sunken garden, a rose garden, and a Mediterranean garden. She also named the manor "Welcome" to welcome guests from all over the world to visit. Now it has become a world-famous garden with a homonym of "ButChart". The square is the starting point and the end point of the tour. There are coffee shops, gift shops, seed sales, information desks and restrooms nearby. Visitors can go around and watch, and they can buy items or take a rest at will. My Queen loves flowers the most. When I stepped into this huge manor, my heart was filled with joy. I watched the world of flowers and admired the blooming flowers. I had the most time to visit Beocui Gardens. Everyone was satisfied, happy and full of praise. The next stop on the itinerary is to stop at the starting point of zero, which is just a small park near the coast in Victoria City. A horizontal monument with "Mile 0" written on it is built to indicate that this is the starting point of the west side of Canada's Highway 1. Not far from the park, there is a bronze statue commemorating the Broken Foot, which is engraved with Terry Fox and his deeds. The tour guide briefly explained that this young Canadian had a tumor in his right leg that required amputation. Later, he ran long distances on one leg to raise money for cancer research. He died at the age of 22. Then we visited the Victoria City Hall building. The architecture of this building is a bit like the style of the British and French countries, which is the so-called European style. The building is spacious and majestic inside, with a solemn momentum. The glass installation patterns on the doors and windows are beautiful. The kind of art equipment you often see in famous churches. The location of the city hall is beautiful. You can see the sea and ships on the opposite side. There is a park and grass layout nearby. Turning around, there is a majestic hotel. The trees planted in front are trimmed like potted plants. The climate is cool and the atmosphere is peaceful. Lunch is going to Chinatown again, ah! It seems that every city in Canada has a Chinatown, which is really the glory of the Chinese people. I thought that the Chinese would not come to Vancouver Island if it left the mainland, but the facts were not in line with my expectation. It turns out that this island also has a Chinatown, and it is the oldest Chinatown in Canada. The ancestors came from San Francisco to find another mining site. Later, they also worked as laborers in the construction of railways. They were miserable. Now, there are still vague traces of the old and it has become a tourist attraction. It retains the Chinese color, has Chinese shops and food, and welcomes guests. We Chinese are especially filled with a sense of intimacy from our compatriots. After sightseeing the scenic spots in Victoria, the day's journey ended. In the afternoon, we said goodbye to Vancouver Island and took the ferry back to the mainland. On the way back to the hotel, we passed by the Red Crane Restaurant for dinner. The Red Crane Restaurant has a good reputation in Vancouver. I heard that the Canadian Chinese Writers Association once held a Spring Festival Gala here. I was somewhat impressed. It was a pleasure to taste the delicious food here!

0eac28888e2a0f6cf585f41d672dcef48c723636.sourceText: 邮局续裁员 邮件延迟将恶化 (亚省时报) 在美国邮政局为节省开支关闭数百个处理中心之前，一些企业抱怨，邮局的服务品质已经下降。数十名地区报纸说，报纸递送延迟或根本就没有送出去，造成他们损失广告和订户。 去年，《时代杂志》公司向邮局投诉，订户反应显著延迟收到他们订阅的杂志《体育画报》、《人物》和《时代》等杂志。 邮政局说，几个因素导致他所谓的轻微延迟：老式分拣机器破旧，需要更多时间维修；传递路线因为邮递量下降而取消；工人学习如何使用新设备分拣目录和杂志。 几个大的投递客户表示，他们已经跟邮政局反应造成延迟的机器的问题。五月份，Northrop Grumman控告邮政局，说它违反了8.74亿美元合同，因为不当延迟和打乱该公司安装100个分拣邮件的机器的工作。 邮政局负责处理和投递的经理本德说，邮政局最近开始使用一种系统来追踪标准邮件按时投递的比例。?#22312;今年的前两个季度，全国标准邮件按时投递比例是93%。?/FONT> 邮件数量的下降，特别是占据收入的很大部分的第一类邮件数量下降，造成邮政业务稳步流失，在今年财政年度的上半年平均每个月损失10亿美元，迫使邮政局建议关闭一半处理中心和裁员数十万。
0eac28888e2a0f6cf585f41d672dcef48c723636.translatedText: Post Office laid off layoffs, and mail delays were going to get worse (Alberta Times) Before the U.S. Postal Service closed hundreds of processing centers to save money, some businesses were complaining that service quality at the post office had deteriorated. Dozens of area newspapers said paper deliveries were delayed or not delivered at all, costing them advertising and subscribers. Last year, Time Magazine complained to the Post Office that subscribers reported significant delays in receiving their subscriptions to magazines such as Sports Illustrated, People and Time. The Postal Service said several factors contributed to what he called minor delays: Older sorting machines were worn out and needed more time to repair; delivery routes were canceled because of declining mail volume; and workers were learning how to use new equipment to sort catalogs and magazines. Several large delivery customers said they have contacted the Postal Service about machine problems that are causing delays. In May, Northrop Grumman sued the Postal Service, saying it violated an $874 million contract by unduly delaying and disrupting the company's efforts to install 100 machines to sort mail. The Postal Service recently began using a system to track what percentage of standard mail is delivered on time, said Bender, the postal service's manager of processing and delivery. ?#22312;In the first two quarters of this year, the national standard mail delivery rate on time was 93%. ?/FONT> Declining mail volume, especially first-class mail, which accounts for a large portion of revenue, has caused a steady drain on postal business, averaging $1 billion a month in the first half of this fiscal year and forcing the Postal Service to recommend closing half its processing centers and laying off hundreds of thousands of employees.

394111d69b8555d0a4b3456d879ae1fbc7c64b01.sourceText: 墨西哥国家安全委员会说，当局在检查一条跨境排水管时，觉察到有一处的混凝土表面异常后，移出部分表面材料，才发现这条隧道。
394111d69b8555d0a4b3456d879ae1fbc7c64b01.translatedText: Mexico's National Security Council said that when authorities inspected a cross-border drainage pipe, they noticed an abnormality in the concrete surface and removed some surface materials before discovering the tunnel.

1324faabbc4c9fb878afb5a0a052ff8ed2e0ec3b.sourceText: 委员会说，隧道长达31.5米，其中将近1.5米在墨西哥境内，其余约30米在美国境内。部分隧道由木梁支撑，其余布满泥土和石块，出口仍未打通，显然还在挖掘当中。
1324faabbc4c9fb878afb5a0a052ff8ed2e0ec3b.translatedText: The committee said the tunnel is 31.5 meters long, of which nearly 1.5 meters are in Mexico and the remaining about 30 meters are in the United States. Part of the tunnel is supported by wooden beams, while the rest is filled with dirt and rocks. The exit has not yet been opened and is obviously still being excavated.

c1571d8889898324f7b50967ad991596e4b8e628.sourceText: 墨西哥和美国当局不时会发现这类非法隧道。这些隧道多数是墨西哥贩毒集团为了把毒品运往美国，而挖掘的。
c1571d8889898324f7b50967ad991596e4b8e628.translatedText: Illegal tunnels of this type are discovered from time to time by Mexican and U.S. authorities. Most of these tunnels were dug by Mexican drug cartels to transport drugs to the United States.

fcbf059d4e357bff55e7c0128d2ff530cc7e37ab.sourceText: ”美西侨报”出了一个”向雷锋同志学习”的栏目，使我想起了学雷锋这个题目。在中国，无论大人小孩，说到雷锋精神，无人不知，无人不晓。1962年，雷锋因公殉职，1963年，大陆掀起了学习雷锋的全国性活动，所有的领导人都為他提词。当时因為阶级斗争的需要，把雷锋的事跡加上阶级斗争的含义，即”爱憎分明，立场坚定”，”对同志像春天般的温暖，对敌人像秋风扫落叶一样”。其实，人们了解和接受到的真正的学雷锋就是為人民做好事。一段时间内，学雷锋成了做好人好事的代名词。但没有多久，学雷锋就被那场振憾了中国歷史的文化大革命的浪潮淹没了。在一些领导人感受着”与天奋斗，其乐无穷，与人奋斗，其乐无穷”的时候，全国人民陷入了人整人，人批人，人斗人的大混乱之中。昨天的革命英雄，今天成了反革命分子；早上还是仁人君子，下午就突然变成了罪恶昭彰的坏分子。不三不四的渣滓跳出来胡作非為，好人过着朝不保夕的日子。人们哪儿再有心思学雷锋，那时，人们常说，雷锋叔叔不见了。更可怕的是，这场革命把人与人的基本关係破坏殆尽，人人学会了自我保护，人与人之间的信任关係难以确立，人变得更加自私了。再加上每次号召学雷锋，只有群眾活动，看不到领导人的行动，中国的学雷锋一直没有成為人们的自觉行动。现在，每年的三月五日，在毛泽东主席给雷锋同志提词的日子，各机关，学校，部队组织一些人上街為大家做好事，提倡雷锋精神。 八十年代，中国改革开放以后，我们走出国门，看到雷锋事跡比比皆是，那时我们就笑侃雷锋叔叔跑到外国去了。有一次，在摩洛哥，我们的汽车在荒野的山坡上发生了故障，那已是傍晚时分，一个摩洛哥人见我们都是小眼睛的外国人，他骑着摩托车到附近去买了些麵包水果和肉罐头，给我们送来了晚餐，晚上还陪我们一起在那裡过夜，直到第二天使馆的人来后才放心地离去。我们要给他钱聊表谢意，他坚决不收，指着天空说是真主叫他这样做的。 来到美国后，生活中经常见到助人為乐的好人好事，他们不叫学雷锋，我却常常自然而然地把这些行為和雷锋的名字结合起来了。在基督教会，在老人公寓，在机场，在医院，在马路上，只要你遇到困难，就会有人来帮助你，生活中时时处处都有雷锋。美国社会到处看到义工的身影，他们不计报酬，自觉自愿地為社会公益提供服务，这是狠平常的事，这些就是雷锋精神的体现。在美国生活久了，我自己也渐渐地溶入到為公眾服务的队伍中了。在我们华人社区有一位年过70的余妈妈，20多年来，默默地关心和照顾从中国来的留学生，帮他们解决生活中的许多困难，她还為侨社的每次活动做了许多后勤服务工作，从不计较名利。我十分尊敬这位雷锋妈妈。当我和她谈及这些时，她的回答也 狠简单，”是耶穌基督改变了我”。 当然，美国的做好人好事和中国的学雷锋还是有本质上差别的，首先他们并没有要求树立共產主义的世界观，并不提倡像雷锋那样”毫不利己，专门利人”。资本主义社会是允许和认可个人主义，追求个人财富和幸福是天经地义的。他们帮助别人，是以自身的存在為前提的，做好事帮助别人不是贡献和牺牲，而是对社会的回馈和分享，在帮助他人的同时，自己也获得心灵上的满足和得到新的收获。 学雷锋，做好人好事无疑是非常好的活动，有利于社会文明道德的提高，有利於和谐社会的建设。但加在雷锋事蹟上的阶级斗争的一些提法：”爱憎分明，立场坚定”应该与时俱进的去掉，我相信雷锋在帮助一位老人过马路的时候，不可能还想一想他是什麼阶级？是应该用”春天”还是”秋天”。我最近看到中国电视台播放的一个宣传片”信仰”，片中提到许多作出了突出贡献的共產党员都是有共產主义的信仰，且不说他们信仰共產主义的真实程度，但说明人们已经认识到共產主义只是一种”信仰”，而不是现实。信仰会给人以勇气和力量，去做出常人做不到的事情，雷锋就是一个具有信仰的人，我前面提到的一些事例也都是有信仰的人。 愿我们的社会有更多的活雷锋！
fcbf059d4e357bff55e7c0128d2ff530cc7e37ab.translatedText: The "American Overseas Chinese News" published a column on "Learning from Comrade Lei Feng", which reminded me of the topic of learning from Lei Feng. In China, no matter adults or children, everyone knows and understands the spirit of Lei Feng. In 1962, Lei Feng died in the line of duty. In 1963, a nationwide campaign to learn from Lei Feng was launched in mainland China, and all leaders commended him. At that time, due to the needs of class struggle, Lei Feng's deeds were added with the meaning of class struggle, that is, "clear love and hate, firm stance", "treating comrades like spring-like warmth, treating enemies like autumn wind sweeping away fallen leaves." In fact, what people understand and accept is that the real way to learn from Lei Feng is to do good things for the people. Over a period of time, imitating Lei Feng became synonymous with doing good deeds. But it didn't take long for those who followed Lei Feng to be overwhelmed by the wave of the Cultural Revolution that shook up Chinese history. When some leaders felt that "there is endless joy in fighting against heaven, and endless joy in fighting against people," the people across the country fell into a great chaos in which people attacked others, criticized others, and fought against others. Yesterday's revolutionary hero has become a counter-revolutionary today; he was a benevolent gentleman in the morning, but suddenly turned into a notorious bad element in the afternoon. The shady scum jump out and do whatever they want, while the good people live a precarious life. How can people bother to imitate Lei Feng? At that time, people often said that Uncle Lei Feng was missing. What is even more frightening is that this revolution has completely destroyed the basic relationships between people. Everyone has learned to protect themselves, making it difficult to establish trusting relationships between people, and people have become more selfish. In addition, every time there is a call to imitate Lei Feng, there are only mass activities and no leaders’ actions. In China, imitating Lei Feng has never become a conscious action among people. Now, every year on March 5th, when Chairman Mao Zedong gives Comrade Lei Feng a speech, various agencies, schools, and military units organize some people to go to the streets to do good deeds for everyone and promote Lei Feng's spirit. In the 1980s, after China's reform and opening up, we went abroad and saw Lei Feng's deeds everywhere. At that time, we laughed and said that Uncle Lei Feng went abroad. Once, in Morocco, our car broke down on a wild hillside. It was already evening. A Moroccan saw that we were all small-eyed foreigners. He rode a motorcycle nearby and bought some bread, fruits and canned meat. He brought us dinner and stayed with us there for the night. He did not feel relieved until someone from the embassy arrived the next day. We wanted to give him money to express our gratitude, but he refused to accept it. He pointed to the sky and said that God told him to do this. After coming to the United States, I often see good people and good deeds who are willing to help others. They are not called imitating Lei Feng, but I often naturally combine these behaviors with Lei Feng's name. In Christian churches, in apartments for the elderly, at airports, in hospitals, on the road, as long as you encounter difficulties, someone will come to help you. There is Lei Feng everywhere in life. Volunteers can be seen everywhere in American society. They voluntarily provide services for social welfare regardless of remuneration. This is a very normal thing. These are the embodiment of Lei Feng's spirit. After living in the United States for a long time, I have gradually integrated myself into the ranks of serving the public. In our Chinese community, there is a mother who is over 70 years old. For more than 20 years, she has quietly cared for and taken care of international students from China and helped them solve many difficulties in life. She also did a lot of logistical services for every activity of the overseas Chinese community, and never cared about fame and fortune. I respect this Lei Feng’s mother very much. When I talked about this with her, her answer was simple, "It was Jesus Christ who changed me." Of course, there is a fundamental difference between the American way of doing good deeds and China's imitation of Lei Feng. First of all, they do not require the establishment of a communist worldview, nor do they advocate "no self-interest, only benefiting others" like Lei Feng. Capitalist society allows and recognizes individualism, and the pursuit of personal wealth and happiness is natural. They help others based on their own existence. Doing good deeds to help others is not contribution and sacrifice, but feedback and sharing to society. While helping others, they also gain spiritual satisfaction and gain new gains. Learning from Lei Feng and doing good deeds is undoubtedly a very good activity, which is conducive to the improvement of social civilization and morality and the construction of a harmonious society. However, some references to class struggle added to Lei Feng's deeds: "clear love and hate, firm stance" should be removed with the times. I believe that when Lei Feng helped an old man cross the road, he couldn't have thought about his class? Should I use "spring" or "autumn"? I recently saw a propaganda video "Faith" played on Chinese TV. The film mentioned that many Communist Party members who have made outstanding contributions have communist beliefs. Not to mention the true extent of their belief in communism, it shows that people have realized that communism is only a "belief" and not a reality. Faith gives people the courage and strength to do things that ordinary people cannot do. Lei Feng is a person with faith. Some of the examples I mentioned earlier are also people with faith. I hope there will be more active Lei Feng in our society!

8c9b0ca45da74c8009bd433b13cbf46150a7a2ec.sourceText: 美男人梦幻城市 美西三城登顶 《亚省时报》 根据《男性健康》杂志评比，对寻求幸福、健康和良好生活品质的美国男人而言，爱达荷州的波伊西（Boise）、北加州的圣荷西（San Jose）和旧金山或许是他们梦寐以求的应许之地。 这三个美西城市在《男性健康》（Men’s Health）志适合男性居住的百大城市评比排名前3，西维吉尼亚州的查尔斯顿（Charleston）、宾州的费城和阿拉巴马州的伯明罕（Birmingham）最不适男人居住。 每年都排前几名的旧金山，以肥胖比例低、吸烟人口少、教育程度高和居民普遍健康令人印象深刻。圣荷西癌症和心脏病死亡率极低，吸烟者比例在100个评比城市中是最低的，且犯罪率低。 伯明罕则因高罹癌率、高暴力犯罪率和健康水准低落敬陪末座。倒数5名城市依序是伯明罕、费城、查尔斯顿、俄亥俄州的托雷多（Toledo）和密苏里州的圣路易（St. Louis）。 亚利桑那州只有两大都市上榜，凤凰城排37，图森排45，纽约排第33，洛杉矶是第47。
8c9b0ca45da74c8009bd433b13cbf46150a7a2ec.translatedText: Beautiful Men’s Dream Cities: Three Cities in the Western United States Reach the Top “Alberta Times” According to Men’s Health magazine, for American men seeking happiness, health and good quality of life, Boise in Idaho, San Jose in Northern California and San Francisco may be the promised land of their dreams. These three Western American cities ranked in the top three in Men’s Health’s list of the top 100 cities for men to live in. Charleston, West Virginia, Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, and Birmingham, Alabama, were the least suitable places for men to live. San Francisco, which ranks among the top cities every year, impresses with its low obesity rate, small smoking population, high educational level and generally healthy residents. San Jose has extremely low cancer and heart disease mortality rates, the lowest smoker rate among the 100 cities rated, and a low crime rate. Birmingham ranks last due to high cancer rates, high violent crime rates and poor health. The bottom five cities are Birmingham, Philadelphia, Charleston, Toledo, Ohio, and St. Louis, Missouri. Only two major cities in Arizona made the list, with Phoenix at 37th, Tucson at 45th, New York at 33rd, and Los Angeles at 47th.

abcab749926a7b80fac1ad7b0aaffde63865385d.translatedText: >Chinese People's Liberation Army Historical Landmark Building

878305f97dad3441fcc8a14f2a708c01a1a76fd8.sourceText: 1929年建成的太阳商业公司，在1985年被列在国家史迹名录，成为受保护的历史地标的楼宇。但是，这座建筑却经历了险被强拆的命运，最终，经过历史保护主义者和华人努力的抗争，这座著名的建筑才得到保留。
878305f97dad3441fcc8a14f2a708c01a1a76fd8.translatedText: The Sun Commercial Company, built in 1929, was listed on the National Register of Historic Places in 1985 and became a protected historical landmark building. However, this building experienced the fate of being demolished. In the end, after the hard struggle of historical preservationists and the Chinese, this famous building was preserved.

0b28938cf9aed8b7ff20a7e2eef8565eaf95659b.sourceText: 事因太阳商业大厦后来经过转让，最终被菲尼克斯NBN太阳篮球队和合伙人所拥有。对于这座在黄金地段原华人建筑，财大气粗的业主公布了一项要拆除仓库屋顶的计划：在一楼上方建造耗资二亿美元的豪华酒店和公寓大厦。
0b28938cf9aed8b7ff20a7e2eef8565eaf95659b.translatedText: The Sun Commercial Building was later transferred and eventually owned by the Phoenix NBN Suns Basketball Team and its partners. For this former Chinese building in a prime location, the wealthy owner has unveiled a plan to demolish the warehouse roof: build a $200 million luxury hotel and apartment tower above the first floor.

53912aa5003c2e5b16440f44a1e5a4df542b5a68.sourceText: 但这计划受到历史保护主义者的反对，在华人社会更掀起了轩然大波。邓安业的后裔强烈不满，据理力争。当年担任亚省州众议员的黄仕均带领广大华人力保这座历史建筑。但NBA太阳队和开发商依然一意孤行，而市议会亦同意进行拆建，于是双方为此提出了訢讼。
53912aa5003c2e5b16440f44a1e5a4df542b5a68.translatedText: However, this plan was opposed by historical preservationists and caused an uproar in the Chinese society. Deng Anye's descendants were strongly dissatisfied and argued vigorously. Huang Shijun, who served as the Alberta state representative at the time, led the Chinese people to protect this historical building. However, the NBA Suns and the developer still insisted on going their own way, and the city council also agreed to proceed with demolition and construction, so both parties filed a lawsuit.

8e4de5fbeade6b4bb4b521acdd1300f1943682d5.sourceText: 最后强权不敌公理，在2007年的秋天，法院裁定强拆这座历史建筑的决定不当，从而使拆建计划胎死腹中，这座建筑最终得到了永久性的保护。这是华人联合起来取得维护自身权益的一次成功的法律行动。
8e4de5fbeade6b4bb4b521acdd1300f1943682d5.translatedText: In the end, power failed to defeat justice. In the autumn of 2007, the court ruled that the decision to demolish this historical building was inappropriate, thus aborting the demolition plan and the building was finally permanently protected. This is a successful legal action by the Chinese people to unite to protect their own rights and interests.

9b0f77ad08db05b02fd64f30fd10a6e24e1e0372.sourceText: 邓安业和太太共育有10个儿女。在这大家庭中，排行第六的是儿子邓心平。邓心平在亚省历史上的军事和法律方面，都有过积极的贡献，为这个家族增添了荣耀。
9b0f77ad08db05b02fd64f30fd10a6e24e1e0372.translatedText: >Deng Anye and his wife have 10 children in total. In this big family, the sixth son is Deng Xinping. Deng Xinping had made positive contributions in both military and legal aspects in the history of Alberta, adding glory to this family.

c43f12e7360164767c2573560b43b6d925f18c15.sourceText: 九巡迴大法院法官邓心平

1feead1213dd32af01dc431e080aedee1bce29bd.sourceText: 邓心平(Thomas Tang)，1922年1月11日出生于凤凰城。二次大战爆发后，20岁的邓心平应征入伍。在加州蒙特利和北卡罗来纳州接受训练，之后派往奥克拉荷马锡尔堡的军官学校学习，成为后备军官。
1feead1213dd32af01dc431e080aedee1bce29bd.translatedText: Deng Xinping (Thomas Tang) was born in Phoenix on January 11, 1922. After the outbreak of World War II, 20-year-old Deng Xinping enlisted in the army. He received training in Monterey, California and North Carolina, and was later sent to the Officer School at Fort Sill, Oklahoma, to become a reserve officer.

084ff4626dd2a45c16875fc0ced25a313115506b.sourceText: 1944年8月，邓心平在军官学校毕业，授少尉军衔，派往野战炮兵炮台执行教学，后在加州大学柏克莱分校学习中文。
084ff4626dd2a45c16875fc0ced25a313115506b.translatedText: In August 1944, Deng Xinping graduated from the military academy, was awarded the rank of second lieutenant, and was sent to the field artillery battery to perform teaching. Later, he studied Chinese at the University of California, Berkeley.

56487efdb4d4794820c79ce8de47ad007920768b.sourceText: 邓心平20岁时成为了陆军中尉。他被派往亚太战场，在中国昆明任战斗联络军官，并在中缅边界、云南、广西等地帮助中国军队完善军事设备，并从日军收回相关设施。
56487efdb4d4794820c79ce8de47ad007920768b.translatedText: Deng Xinping became an army lieutenant when he was 20 years old. He was sent to the Asia-Pacific battlefield and served as a combat liaison officer in Kunming, China. He helped the Chinese army improve military equipment on the China-Myanmar border, Yunnan, Guangxi and other places, and recovered related facilities from the Japanese army.

e11b837db583235a8658992bbd11c72fee38e524.sourceText: 1945年9月邓心平调去驻华军事指挥部司令部，1946年8月退伍。1951年韩战期间，邓心平被召回服役，随同盟军的笔译和口译服务团，派往东京和韩国釜山服务，升为上尉。之后，他回到美国在亚利桑那大学学习并获得法律学位。成为当时亚利桑那州仅有的三位华裔律师之一。
e11b837db583235a8658992bbd11c72fee38e524.translatedText: In September 1945, Deng Xinping was transferred to the headquarters of the Military Command in China and retired from the army in August 1946. During the Korean War in 1951, Deng Xinping was recalled to serve. He was sent to Tokyo and Busan, South Korea to serve in Tokyo and Busan, South Korea, with the Translation and Interpretation Service Corps of the Allied Forces, and was promoted to captain. He then returned to the United States to study at the University of Arizona and receive a law degree. Became one of only three Chinese-American lawyers in Arizona at the time.

9aee75becb385d89de6577459e6dfdd8740a4bcb.sourceText: 1952年，邓心平担任亚利桑那州马利可巴郡副检察官。1956年担任亚利桑那州副检察长。1962年任凤凰城市副市长。1962年的8年，担任亚利桑那州上等法院法官。1977年被选为亚利桑那州律师协会主席。
9aee75becb385d89de6577459e6dfdd8740a4bcb.translatedText: In 1952, Deng Xinping served as deputy prosecutor of Maricopa County, Arizona. Served as Arizona Deputy Attorney General in 1956. In 1962, he was appointed deputy mayor of Phoenix City. From 1962 to 1968, he served as a judge of the Superior Court of Arizona. In 1977, he was elected president of the Arizona State Bar Association.

e431916a180e5e354ed21ba23bc7cf20bd6dbb6d.sourceText: 1977年8月26日，邓心平被总统卡特委任为美国上诉法院第九巡迴法院法官，地位仅次于最高法院法官，管美西十州法务。他当了16年巡迴大法官，人们对他的评价是：冷静，绅士风度，他倡导个人权利和少数民族在法律界的发展。他为美国印第安人法律、劳工权利、和其他问题提过400条的意见。
e431916a180e5e354ed21ba23bc7cf20bd6dbb6d.translatedText: On August 26, 1977, Deng Xinping was appointed by President Carter as a judge of the Ninth Circuit Court of Appeals of the United States. His status was second only to the justices of the Supreme Court, and he was in charge of the legal affairs of ten states in the western United States. He served as a circuit judge for 16 years. People commented on him as: calm and gentlemanly. He advocated individual rights and the development of ethnic minorities in the legal profession. He wrote 400 opinions on American Indian law, labor rights, and other issues.

86b4846c3adc8120e01ae886d8197199d3ea8bef.sourceText: 邓心平是第一位华裔联邦大法官，他秉公执法，伸张正义，维护华人在社会上的合法权益。他对平权意义和对种族岐视问题有其深刻的理解，1978年美国独立日，邓心平在给侨联总会的贺信中，以华人舞狮的例子来阐述自由平等社会的来之不易，信中充满对美国精神的理解，文字表达又是如此的平凡：
86b4846c3adc8120e01ae886d8197199d3ea8bef.translatedText: Deng Xinping is the first Chinese-American federal justice. He enforces the law impartially, upholds justice, and safeguards the legitimate rights and interests of the Chinese in society. He has a profound understanding of the meaning of equal rights and racial discrimination. In his congratulatory letter to the Federation of Overseas Chinese in 1978, Deng Xinping used the example of the Chinese lion dance to illustrate the hard-won success of a free and equal society. The letter was full of understanding of the American spirit, and the words expressed Da You is so ordinary:

d9385f2d3e2c1d93d99aa8e56ef8be82339ea6cb.sourceText: 〝鳯凰城侨联许多年来在华人社区保持庆祝美国国庆，这一活动日趋完美和扩大，经历了漫长的路。在庆祝美国国庆二百週年之际，鳯凰城庆典中出现了中国的舞狮表演，这是我们的先辈们在制定宪法时不可能想到的。一个非常有意义的想法是，自由的精神和民主的理念，不仅存在于跳广塲舞的美国白人中，也存在于喜爱墨西哥音乐和中国舞狮的不同族群中。实现美国梦的程式是200年前制订的，它还不是完美无缺的，需要不断的寻求探索，我们每个人都要为使他日臻完善作出贡献。同时，发扬和喜爱你们的传统和习俗, 华人在亚利桑那的历史已包容在我们美国的传统中，并已成为其组成部份。”
d9385f2d3e2c1d93d99aa8e56ef8be82339ea6cb.translatedText: "The Overseas Chinese Federation of Huangcheng has been celebrating the National Day of the United States in the Chinese community for many years. This event has become more perfect and expanded and has gone through a long road. On the occasion of celebrating the bicentennial of the National Day of the United States, Huanghuang City There was a Chinese lion dance performance in the city celebration, which our ancestors could not have imagined when they wrote the Constitution. A very meaningful idea is that the spirit of freedom and the concept of democracy exist not only among white Americans who dance Cantonese dance, but also among those who love Mexican music. The program for realizing the American dream was formulated 200 years ago. It is not perfect and needs continuous exploration. At the same time, each of us must contribute to making it perfect. At the same time, we must carry forward and love your traditions and customs. The history of the Chinese in Arizona has been included in our American tradition and has become an integral part of it. "

8838f8fd27d027fa91180eab80d49deacf9130fd.sourceText: 1992年，他在华美专业协会活动中作了演讲。他说，美国的法律是明文反对种族岐视的，但在实际生活中，历史遗留下来的有意或无意的歧视随时会发生，亚裔到美国有较长的历史，却是最受岐视的族种之一。我们亚裔要解决问题，应该联合起来，加强团结，使社会知道这种力量不容忽视。同时，要靠自身努力，在科学文化上求取上进，在政治经济上要取得一定地位。
8838f8fd27d027fa91180eab80d49deacf9130fd.translatedText: In 1992, he gave a speech at the Chinese American Professional Association event. He said that American laws clearly oppose racial discrimination, but in real life, intentional or unintentional discrimination left over from history can occur at any time. Asians have a long history in the United States, but they are one of the most discriminated races. If we Asians want to solve the problem, we should unite and strengthen unity to let society know that this power cannot be ignored. At the same time, we must rely on our own efforts to make progress in science and culture, and achieve a certain status in politics and economy.

fdb130c0a03078cb71853391f2971ec06965fd56.sourceText: 邓心平除了在美国政界和法律界享有盛誉外，还担任过美国退伍军人协会指挥官。1950年，由44位退伍华人组成了“亚利桑那华裔军人会”，邓心平是创会人之一。他被选入亚利桑那退伍军人＂名人堂＂。为纪念他的政绩，以他的名字所命名的＂亚省邓心平退伍军人会＂。The American Legion ofArizona Thomas Tang Post 50＂，中文简称为＂邓心平退伍军人会＂。邓心平于1995年去世，享年73岁。
fdb130c0a03078cb71853391f2971ec06965fd56.translatedText: In addition to being well-known in the American political and legal circles, Deng Xinping also served as the commander of the American Legion. In 1950, 44 retired Chinese formed the "Arizona Chinese Military Association", and Deng Xinping was one of the founders. He was elected to the Arizona Veterans Hall of Fame. To commemorate his political achievements, the "Alberta Deng Xinping Veterans Association" was named after him. The American Legion of Arizona Thomas Tang Post 50", abbreviated in Chinese as "Deng Xinping Veterans Association". Deng Xinping died in 1995 at the age of 73.

c680a5fd99dfe0fcca8bfe6d5b7308172464604d.sourceText: 美海外追税引发不满 放弃国籍绿卡人数创新高 编者按：自从美国开始对公民或永久居民的海外收入课税以来，放弃美国公民或永久居民身份人数直线上升，根据国税局(IRS)的纪录，仅去年就有将近1800人抛弃美国国籍或绿卡，创下国税局自1998年开始公布这项数据以来的纪录。放弃身份的人认为，现在要保有美国国籍或绿卡，代价太高。 美国税负沉重迫使国人放弃国籍的情形，在卡通漫画英雄”超人”去年宣布放弃美国籍后，引发注意。路透报导，去年放弃国籍的人数不仅创下新高，其人数为2008年的八倍，更是2007年到2009年三年放弃国籍人数的总和。 美国是全世界对公民境外所得课税的少数国家之一。今年估计有630万住在国外的美国公民须要在6月底前申报境外所得税。附属于国税局的全国纳税人权益维护人(National Taxpayer Advocate’s Office)办公室去年12月公布一项报告，举出国外报税的困难包括文件繁琐、缺乏网上报税工具和语言障碍。对于想要合法避免境外报税的纳税人，唯一的选择是放弃国籍。国税局数据显示，去年放弃国籍者有1788人，但该数字可能低估。国税局定期在联邦公报(Federal Register)公布放弃国籍者的姓名，有些已经放弃国籍者表示，他们在公报上没有看到自己的名字。 过去25年来，有许多百万及亿万富翁放美国籍，其中包括嘉年华游轮公司(Carnival Cruise)已故创办人阿里森(Ted Arison)，以及前福特汽车公司董事丁曼(Michael Dingman)。 但现在连不是很有钱的人也要放弃国籍，这些人认为，放弃国籍不只是涉及税负沉重，还涉及反对美国官僚制度和隐私。 4月7日宣誓放弃美国国籍的敦恩表示，如果保持美国籍他必须报税和申报他所有银行账号，包括和他妻子合开的共同账号。他说：”透露妻子和合伙人共同账号太过份。我妻子的银行账号和国税局没有关系。”敦恩的妻子为加拿大人。
c680a5fd99dfe0fcca8bfe6d5b7308172464604d.translatedText: The U.S.'s overseas tax recovery has caused dissatisfaction, and the number of people who have given up their citizenship and green cards has reached a record high. Editor's note: Since the United States began to tax the overseas income of citizens or permanent residents, the number of people who have given up their U.S. citizenship or permanent resident status has skyrocketed. According to records from the Internal Revenue Service (IRS), nearly 1,800 people abandoned their U.S. citizenship or green cards last year alone, setting a record since the IRS began publishing this data in 1998. Those who have renounced their status believe that it is now too expensive to retain U.S. citizenship or a green card. The heavy tax burden in the United States is forcing Americans to renounce their nationality, which attracted attention last year after the cartoon hero "Superman" announced that he had renounced his American citizenship. Reuters reported that the number of people who renounced their nationality last year not only hit a new high, eight times that of 2008, but also the number of people who renounced their nationality in the three years from 2007 to 2009 combined. The United States is one of the few countries in the world that taxes its citizens’ foreign income. This year an estimated 6.3 million U.S. citizens living abroad will need to file foreign income taxes by the end of June. The National Taxpayer Advocate’s Office, affiliated with the Internal Revenue Service, released a report in December citing difficulties in filing taxes abroad, including cumbersome documentation, a lack of online filing tools and language barriers. For taxpayers who want to legally avoid filing taxes abroad, the only option is to renounce citizenship. IRS data shows that 1,788 people renounced their citizenship last year, but that number is likely an underestimate. The IRS regularly publishes the names of people who have renounced their citizenship in the Federal Register, and some people who have renounced their citizenship say they did not see their names in the Register. Over the past 25 years, many millionaires and billionaires have emigrated to the United States, including late Carnival Cruise founder Ted Arison and former Ford Motor Co. director Michael Dingman. But now even people who are not very wealthy are giving up their citizenship, and these people believe that giving up citizenship involves not only heavy tax burdens, but also opposition to American bureaucracy and privacy. Dunn, who swore off his U.S. citizenship on April 7, said that if he maintains his U.S. citizenship, he must file taxes and declare all his bank accounts, including the joint account opened with his wife. He said: "Revealing the joint account number of my wife and her partner is too much. My wife's bank account has nothing to do with the IRS." Dunn's wife is Canadian.

a5423f428047bb010d77cd57076b5d41a2705ff6.sourceText: 人民币创今年以来单日最大涨幅 受美元指数连续五日下跌刺激，五月份第一个交易日，人民币对美元汇率中间价再创汇改来新高。5月2日，人民币对美元汇率中间价报6.2082，大涨126个基点，创下了今年来的单日最大涨幅。 据新华社报道，这是人民币对美元汇率中间价连续第三个交易日跳涨，令市场对未来人民币升值预期加强。业内人士指出，美元指数连续下跌，是昨日人民币大涨的直接原因，从中长期来看，为防止资金大幅流出，人民币将继续维持升势。 金融问题专家赵庆明对记者表示，美元指数走强之时，人民币则相应稳定，而当美元指数走贬的时候，人民币升幅则更大，这个规律目前仍未改变，昨日的中间价大涨，主要是受国内市场休假期间，国际外汇市场上美元连续下跌的影响。 数据显示，从4月25日开始，美元指数连续5日下跌，从当日最高的82.94点，最低下探到5月1日的81.33点，短短5个交易日，跌幅约1.9%。 ”今年经济基本面较去年好转，这是支持人民币升值的基本面因素。”赵庆明指出。统计数据显示，刚刚过去的四月份，人民币对美元汇率中间价再接再厉，单月上涨了481个基点，涨幅为0.77%，创下了今年来的单月最大涨幅。 虽然也有人担心，持续的大幅升值对出口不利，但不可否认的是，四月人民币的连续加速升值，已令市场对人民币的升值预期逐渐加强。从海外无本金远期（NDF）市场来看，1年期NDF所隐含的贬值预期越来越小，基本接近均衡水平。 对于未来，业内人士指出，从中间价来看，预计未来人民币对美元会有微幅升值或持平，5月份继续走强的概率较大。 交行金研中心指出，在经济温和恢复的大背景下，中国将继续保持对国际资本的吸引力。同时，美国一季度GDP数据不及预期，在一定程度上会拖累美元指数，加之国内居民和企业的结汇意愿依然强烈，人民币仍将面临升值压力。 ”但从人民币国际化、获取国际资源和避免资本大规模流出等方面考虑，大幅贬值也不可取。”交行金研中心指出，随着经济增速小幅回升，在全球流动性泛滥的背景下，未来我国仍可能面临一定程度的资本流入压力，在此背景下，预计2013年人民币汇率会继续保持双向波动、小幅升值的运行格局。
a5423f428047bb010d77cd57076b5d41a2705ff6.translatedText: The RMB achieved the largest single-day increase this year. Spurred by the U.S. dollar index falling for five consecutive days, the central parity rate of the RMB against the U.S. dollar hit a new high on the first trading day of May. On May 2, the central parity rate of the RMB against the U.S. dollar was reported at 6.2082, a sharp increase of 126 basis points, the largest single-day increase this year. According to Xinhua News Agency, this is the third consecutive trading day that the central parity rate of the RMB against the US dollar has jumped, strengthening market expectations for future RMB appreciation. Industry insiders pointed out that the continuous decline of the US dollar index was the direct cause of yesterday's sharp rise in the RMB. In the medium to long term, in order to prevent large outflows of funds, the RMB will continue to maintain its upward trend. Financial expert Zhao Qingming told reporters that when the U.S. dollar index strengthens, the RMB is correspondingly stable, and when the U.S. dollar index depreciates, the RMB rises even more. This rule has not changed yet. Yesterday's central parity rose sharply, mainly due to the continuous decline of the U.S. dollar in the international foreign exchange market during the domestic market holiday. Data show that starting from April 25, the U.S. dollar index fell for five consecutive days, from the highest point of 82.94 points that day to the lowest point of 81.33 points on May 1. In just five trading days, the dollar index fell by about 1.9%. "The economic fundamentals this year are better than last year, which is the fundamental factor supporting the appreciation of the RMB." Zhao Qingming pointed out. Statistics show that in the past April, the central parity rate of the RMB against the US dollar continued to improve, rising by 481 basis points in a single month, or 0.77%, setting the largest single-month increase this year. Although some people are worried that the continued sharp appreciation will be detrimental to exports, it is undeniable that the continuous accelerated appreciation of the RMB in April has gradually strengthened the market's expectations for the appreciation of the RMB. Judging from the overseas non-principal forward (NDF) market, the depreciation expectation implied by the 1-year NDF is getting smaller and smaller, basically approaching the equilibrium level. Regarding the future, industry insiders pointed out that from the perspective of the central parity rate, the RMB is expected to appreciate slightly or stay flat against the US dollar in the future, and there is a high probability that the RMB will continue to strengthen in May. The Financial Research Center of the Bank of Communications pointed out that under the background of moderate economic recovery, China will continue to remain attractive to international capital. At the same time, the U.S. GDP data in the first quarter was lower than expected, which will drag down the U.S. dollar index to a certain extent. In addition, domestic residents and companies still have a strong willingness to settle foreign exchange, and the RMB will still face appreciation pressure. "However, from the aspects of RMB internationalization, access to international resources and avoiding large-scale capital outflows, substantial depreciation is not advisable." The Financial Research Center of the Bank of Communications pointed out that with the slight rebound in economic growth and against the background of flooding global liquidity, my country may still face a certain degree of capital inflow pressure in the future. Against this background, it is expected that the RMB exchange rate will continue to maintain a pattern of two-way fluctuations and slight appreciation in 2013.

c36491a0ac2f440012557af24222a51324fe3338.translatedText: > Brewer dissents from federal appeals court cuts Lawyers representing Arizona's governor recently filed a review petition with the U.S. Supreme Court, asking the Supreme Court to overturn lower...

ae0a2e1bb5e46f30d5ff92d1625c83e40af045d8.sourceText: 代表亚利桑那州长的律师最近向美国最高法院提出复核申请，要求最高法院推翻下级法院关于禁止州政府不能停止发放福利给州政府员工合法同性伴侣福利的裁决。
ae0a2e1bb5e46f30d5ff92d1625c83e40af045d8.translatedText: Lawyers representing Arizona's governor recently filed a review petition with the U.S. Supreme Court, asking the Supreme Court to overturn a lower court's ruling that prohibits the state from stopping benefits for state employees who are legally married to same-sex couples.

c6d2f176b0272bf9143669f275a13ffc3f1f17d2.sourceText: 联邦上诉法院对亚利桑那州的裁决，是本州预算法的一部分。 2008 年，布鲁尔的前任，时任本州州长的民主党人珍妮特纳波利塔诺（现任美国国土安全部部长）作出裁减州内同性伴侣福利的决定。
c6d2f176b0272bf9143669f275a13ffc3f1f17d2.translatedText: The federal appeals court ruling in Arizona is part of the state's budget law. In 2008, Brewer's predecessor, then-governor Janet Napolitano, a Democrat who is now the U.S. Department of Homeland Security secretary, made the decision to cut benefits for same-sex couples in the state.

28032812db42471e8da467e36592b428a18799bc.sourceText: 一位联邦法官裁定，州府可以裁减异性夫妇的福利，因为在亚利桑那州，只有异性夫妇结婚合法。但法官基于亚利桑那州同性夫妇不合法的法律，裁定州府裁减同性伴侣福利不合法。
28032812db42471e8da467e36592b428a18799bc.translatedText: A federal judge has ruled that the state can cut benefits for opposite-sex couples because only opposite-sex couples are legal to marry in Arizona. But a judge ruled that the state's cuts to benefits for same-sex couples were illegal based on Arizona's law that illegal same-sex couples.

2b4327e3d1c404002bd38a59dfb459e586654694.sourceText: 布鲁尔说，此案是本州的人权问题。她说，本州有权决定自己资金优先事项，不劳联邦操心。

732a5a0c792ad5b86fc518002997354686ed2e14.sourceText: 为何在美华人有三分之一属英语能力有限者 （亚省时报） 据不完全统计，在美华人的总数已经接近400万，但是，据华盛顿”移民政策研究所”近日根据人口普查局以及美国社会调查（ACS）的结果公布英语能力有限人口报告。在2010年2500万五岁以上的英语能力有限人口中，说西班牙语的有1652万人，说华语的次之，有154.8万人，占6.1%。说华语的人口在加州、纽约州、新泽西州、华盛顿州、南卡州、犹他州及亚拉巴马州都占第二位。就是说在美国近400万华人中，有近155万华人属于英语能力有限者。 华人新移民中英语能力有限者的比率较过去提高，首先在于近十年来华人移民人数的大幅增加。半个世纪之前，在美国以外出生的人按原籍排名，头五名都来自欧洲，而现在的移民中，头五名都来自拉美和亚洲，分别是墨西哥、中国、菲律宾、印度、古巴。中国（包括台湾和香港）的移民，位居第二。 其次，移民美国的华人，越来越多地选择居住在华人聚集区，如纽约和加州等地，华人越来越多地聚集在一定的居住区，该区的各种服务设施，机构也就越来越多且越来越完善，这就使得很多华人，不需要会很多英语，甚至不会英语都可以生存。这种现象过去在老唐人街就存在着，现在随着华人人数的增加和华人区的扩大，变得更为常见。尽管美国政府一直努力使外来移民同化于美国社会，但事实证明，移民越是高度集中的地方，同化就越慢，越不彻底，其中的表现之一就是许多华人新移民 没有或者只有很有限的英语能力。 对外界社会的封闭心态也使得很多华人不注重英语能力的提高，不少华人就一直生活在华人圈子里，社会交际圈狭窄，逐渐成为社会边缘化群体，更难融入主流社会。不懂英语使很多华人根本不知道美国社会发生的事情，对许多法律和规定也不甚了了，影响生活质量，例如因为自觉无法和警察沟通，遭遇抢劫和其他事故，也往往选择不报案，因而在客观上助长了不法之徒将华人视为如何软弱可欺的族群。等等 此外，华人是否愿意刻苦学习英语，和同化的意愿也有很大关系，曾有学者利昂布维尔根据统计资料列出各种族移民归化率，排第一是菲律宾人，有76.2%，第二名是韩国人。第三名是华人，归化率是68.5%。 就是说，每100 个华人移民中，只有68.5人归化为美国公民，余下的31.5人，可能有各种原因不愿意或者尚未归化。很显然，如果希望归化为美国公民，进而融入美国社会，相当的英语能力是必要的。如果意愿不强烈，或其他种种原因，例如年龄，文化水平，进入美国的时间长短等等，都会影响或限制华人的学习英语的愿望，其结果，就表现为英语能力有限。
732a5a0c792ad5b86fc518002997354686ed2e14.translatedText: Why do one-third of Chinese in the United States have limited English proficiency (Alberta Times) According to incomplete statistics, the total number of Chinese in the United States is close to 4 million. However, the "Immigration Policy Institute" in Washington recently released a report on the population with limited English proficiency based on the results of the Census Bureau and the American Social Survey (ACS). Among the 25 million people over the age of five with limited English proficiency in 2010, 16.52 million people spoke Spanish, followed by 1.548 million people who spoke Chinese, accounting for 6.1%. The Chinese-speaking population ranks second in California, New York, New Jersey, Washington, South Carolina, Utah and Alabama. That is to say, among the nearly 4 million Chinese in the United States, nearly 1.55 million Chinese have limited English proficiency. The proportion of new Chinese immigrants with limited English proficiency is higher than in the past. First of all, the number of Chinese immigrants has increased significantly in the past decade. Half a century ago, the top five people born outside the United States in terms of origin were from Europe. But now among immigrants, the top five are from Latin America and Asia, namely Mexico, China, the Philippines, India, and Cuba. Immigrants from China (including Taiwan and Hong Kong) ranked second. Secondly, Chinese immigrants to the United States are increasingly choosing to live in Chinese-gathering areas, such as New York and California. More and more Chinese are gathering in certain residential areas, and the various service facilities and institutions in the area are becoming more and more complete. This allows many Chinese to survive without knowing much or even no English. This phenomenon existed in old Chinatowns in the past, but now it has become more common with the increase in the number of Chinese and the expansion of Chinese districts. Although the U.S. government has been working hard to assimilate immigrants into American society, facts have proven that the more immigrants are concentrated in places, the slower and less complete the assimilation is. One of the manifestations of this is that many new Chinese immigrants have no or very limited English skills. The closed mentality towards the outside world also makes many Chinese people not pay attention to improving their English skills. Many Chinese people have always lived in Chinese circles, with narrow social communication circles, and have gradually become a marginalized group in society, making it more difficult to integrate into mainstream society. Not knowing English means that many Chinese people have no idea what is happening in American society, and are unclear about many laws and regulations, which affects the quality of life. For example, because they feel unable to communicate with the police, they often choose not to report the case when encountering robberies and other accidents. This objectively encourages criminals to regard the Chinese as a weak and bullied ethnic group. Etc. In addition, whether Chinese people are willing to study English hard has a lot to do with their willingness to assimilate. Scholar Leon Bouvier once listed the naturalization rates of immigrants of various races based on statistical data. The first place is Filipinos with 76.2%, and the second place is Koreans. The third place is Chinese, with a naturalization rate of 68.5%. That is to say, for every 100 Chinese immigrants, only 68.5 are naturalized as U.S. citizens, and the remaining 31.5 may be unwilling or have not yet naturalized for various reasons. Obviously, if you hope to become a naturalized U.S. citizen and then integrate into American society, considerable English proficiency is necessary. If the willingness is not strong, or various other reasons, such as age, education level, length of time in the United States, etc., will affect or limit the Chinese's desire to learn English, the result will be limited English ability.

485b2de3f6e92da2bfa72bca317f780ad50c4956.sourceText: 甄凯婴：黄河之滨 天鹅之城（二） 黄河之滨 天鹅之城?#38543;”世界华文媒体合作联盟考察采访团”访三门峡散记 甄凯婴 二、绿水青山天鹅之城 随着三门峡水利工程的动工，1957年3月，中央在原陕州设立三门峡市。1961年，由于中苏关系变化和国家经济困难，三门峡市由地级市降为县级市。1986年重新升为地级市，现辖湖滨区、义马市、渑池县、陕县、灵宝市、卢氏县、经济技术开发区和产业集聚区，总面积10496平方公里，人口227.48万。 经过数十年的经营，如今三门峡是一座”四面环山三面水，半城烟村半城田”的园林城市，境内有亚武山国家级森林公园、甘山国家级森林公园、玉皇山国家级森林公园，市内街道两旁各种植两排塔松和法国梧桐，处处绿树成荫。 大坝节流灌溉改变了三门峡原有的自然环境，使三门峡大 坝上 游库区形成大面积的黄河湿地。环境怡人的湿地，给三门峡市引来了很多鸟类，这其中，以白天鹅最为闻名。 据说2005年以前，每年入冬以后到次年初春的这段季节，三门峡黄河湿地上总会迎来白天鹅。但那时来的很少，三只五只，不成规模。在三门峡市对湿地进行开发保护后，白天鹅才成群结队而来，形成今天这样的规模。通过人为地增大水面，增种植物，三门峡天鹅湖国家城市湿地公园的湿地性质不但没被破坏，还被加强了。2005年以来，来三门峡过冬的天鹅逐年增多，近两年竟有上万只。2010年4月，三门峡被中国野生动物保护协会命名为”大天鹅之乡”。 我们考察团到达的时节正值初夏，本是天鹅飞回西伯利亚躲避酷热的时节，湿地里不应该有天鹅。可是，在公园的湖面上，三三两两的天鹅在水中或立或卧，对游人没有害怕之感。当地人说，公园美好的环境，让天鹅变”懒”了，想把三门峡当作永远的家了。成群结队而来的白天鹅，也让三门峡这座有”天鹅城”之称的城市更加名副其实。 三门峡大坝 三门峡天鹅 三、第十八届中国（三门峡）国际黄河旅游节 历届三门峡市政府在宣传三门峡，推广黄河文化旅游方面不遗余力，所举办的中国（三门峡）国际黄河旅游节活动迄今已有十八届。在世界华文媒体合作联盟的组织下，笔者与15个国家和地区的33家华文媒体记者走进三门峡，出席了本届旅游节”龙行天下黄河魂”大型文艺演出、中国大黄河旅游国际研讨发布会、”驴友”交流大会万人帐篷节、横渡”母亲河”等重大活动，并对三门峡代表性景点进行了参观采访。 本届旅游节共有15项活动，其中开幕式暨”龙行天下黄河魂”大型文艺演出、中国大黄河旅游国际研讨发布会、2012中国三门峡横渡母亲河、三门峡经贸合作洽谈及签字仪式为四大主体活动。其他配套活动还有2012亚洲财富论坛、经济合作项目对接洽谈及商务考察、”天下黄河”沿黄九省（区）大型集邮暨三门峡旅游风光全国摄影联展、首届户外用品博览会暨全国驴友交流大会、首届三门峡汽车文化旅游博览会、第五届科技文化艺术节、函谷关”品茶论道”、”黄河之旅绿色甘山”全国山地自行车邀请赛、第五届全国双胞胎漂流大赛、热气球”穿越黄河丹峡”，以及”魅力三门峡”系列群众广场文体活动。 5月20日在天鹅湖国家城市湿地公园举行的”2012年中国三门峡（第三届）横渡母亲河”活动，让我们领略到千人竞渡黄河、万人观看的壮观一幕。活动当天，来自全国29个省（区、市）以及港澳台地区的90多支代表队、2568名游泳爱好者，从该市天鹅湖国家城市湿地公园的三河广场河岸下水，横渡直线距离约1300米的黄河，游至对岸山西省平陆县太阳渡登陆。虽然烈日当空，丝毫不减两岸居民观看的热情。 考察团在三门峡匆匆采访了两天，对三门峡这个城市有了初步的体会。虽然没有观赏到大坝泄洪的壮观景象，但看到波涛汹涌的黄河，被大坝面驯服成一片清澈透亮的，波光粼粼的大湖。这里的街道整洁，高楼林立；政府官员才思敏捷，创新务实；这里的民风淳朴，热情好客，让人流连忘返。 参加黄河竞渡的广东南海队
485b2de3f6e92da2bfa72bca317f780ad50c4956.translatedText: Zhen Kaiying: City of Swans on the Bank of the Yellow River (2) City of Swans on the Bank of the Yellow River?#38543; "World Chinese Media Cooperation Alliance Investigation Team"'s visit to Sanmenxia Zhen Kaiying 2. City of Swans with Green Waters and Green Mountains With the start of the Sanmenxia Water Conservancy Project, in March 1957, the central government established Sanmenxia City in the former Shaanxi Prefecture. In 1961, due to changes in Sino-Soviet relations and national economic difficulties, Sanmenxia City was downgraded from a prefecture-level city to a county-level city. It was re-upgraded to a prefecture-level city in 1986 and currently governs Hubin District, Yima City, Mianchi County, Shaanxi County, Lingbao City, Lushi County, economic and technological development zones and industrial clusters, with a total area of ​​10,496 square kilometers and a population of 2.2748 million. After decades of operation, Sanmenxia is now a garden city "surrounded by mountains and water on three sides, half city smoked villages and half city farmland". There are Yawu Mountain National Forest Park, Ganshan National Forest Park, and Yuhuang Mountain National Forest Park within the city. Two rows of Tasmania pines and French plane trees are planted on both sides of the city streets, and trees are everywhere. The dam's throttling irrigation has changed the original natural environment of Sanmenxia, ​​forming a large area of ​​Yellow River wetland in the reservoir area upstream of the Sanmenxia Dam. The pleasant wetland environment attracts many birds to Sanmenxia City, among which the white swan is the most famous. It is said that before 2005, during the period from winter to early spring of the following year, white swans would always be welcomed on the Yellow River Wetland in Sanmenxia. But at that time there were only a few, three to five, not a large number. After Sanmenxia City developed and protected the wetland, the white swans came in droves, forming the scale it is today. By artificially increasing the water surface and planting more plants, the wetland nature of Sanmenxia Swan Lake National Urban Wetland Park has not only been not destroyed, but has also been enhanced. Since 2005, the number of swans coming to Sanmenxia to spend the winter has increased year by year, with tens of thousands in the past two years. In April 2010, Sanmenxia was named the "Hometown of Whooper Swans" by the China Wildlife Conservation Association. It was early summer when our inspection team arrived. This is the time when swans fly back to Siberia to escape the scorching heat. There should not be swans in the wetlands. However, on the lake in the park, swans in twos and threes are standing or lying in the water, showing no fear of tourists. Locals say that the beautiful environment of the park makes the swans become "lazy" and want to make Sanmenxia their permanent home. The white swans that come in droves make Sanmenxia, ​​a city known as the "Swan City", more worthy of its name. Sanmenxia Dam Sanmenxia Swan 3. The 18th China (Sanmenxia) International Yellow River Tourism Festival The Sanmenxia Municipal Government has spared no effort in publicizing Sanmenxia and promoting Yellow River cultural tourism. The China (Sanmenxia) International Yellow River Tourism Festival has been held for 18 times so far. Under the organization of the World Chinese Media Cooperation Alliance, the author and 33 Chinese-language media reporters from 15 countries and regions went to Sanmenxia and attended major events such as the "Dragon Walking the World Yellow River Soul" large-scale theatrical performance at this tourism festival, China's Greater Yellow River Tourism International Seminar and Conference, the "Travel Friends" Exchange Conference Ten Thousand Tent Festival, and Crossing the "Mother River". They also visited and interviewed the representative attractions of Sanmenxia. This tourism festival has a total of 15 activities, including the opening ceremony and large-scale theatrical performance of "Dragon Walking the World Yellow River Soul", China's Greater Yellow River Tourism International Seminar and Conference, China's Sanmenxia Crossing the Mother River in 2012, and Sanmenxia Economic and Trade Cooperation Negotiation and Signing Ceremony as the four main activities. Other supporting activities include the 2012 Asian Fortune Forum, economic cooperation project matchmaking and business inspections, the "World Yellow River" large-scale stamp collection in nine provinces (districts) along the Yellow River and the national photography exhibition of Sanmenxia tourism scenery, the first Outdoor Products Expo and the National Travel Friends Exchange Conference, the first Sanmenxia Automobile Culture Cultural Tourism Expo, the 5th Science, Technology, Culture and Art Festival, Hangu Pass "Tea Tasting Discussion", "Yellow River Journey Green Ganshan" National Mountain Bike Invitational Competition, the 5th National Twin Rafting Competition, hot air balloon "Crossing the Yellow River Dan Gorge", and the "Charming Sanmenxia" series of mass square cultural and sports activities. The "2012 China Sanmenxia (Third) Mother River Crossing" event held at the Swan Lake National Urban Wetland Park on May 20 allowed us to experience the spectacular scene of thousands of people competing to cross the Yellow River and tens of thousands of people watching. On the day of the event, more than 90 teams and 2,568 swimmers from 29 provinces (autonomous regions and municipalities) across the country as well as Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan entered the water from the bank of Sanhe Square in the city's Swan Lake National Urban Wetland Park, crossed the Yellow River with a straight line distance of about 1,300 meters, and swam to the opposite bank of Taiyangdu Landing in Pinglu County, Shanxi Province. Although the sun was blazing, it did not dampen the enthusiasm of residents on both sides of the Taiwan Strait to watch. The inspection team spent two days in Sanmenxia and had a preliminary understanding of the city. Although we did not see the spectacular sight of the dam releasing water, we did see the turbulent Yellow River being tamed by the dam surface into a clear, translucent, sparkling lake. The streets here are neat and tidy, and there are many tall buildings; the government officials are quick-thinking, innovative and pragmatic; the people here are simple, warm and hospitable, making people forget to leave. The Guangdong Nanhai Team participating in the Yellow River Race

c4db3ef90243930c67916f659ff9f920b57099cf.sourceText: 雷暴使东南谷数百家庭停电 （亚省时报） 周二晚的雷暴不仅带来了沙尘，还使东南谷数以百计居民饱受停电之苦。 盐河计划电力公司发言人说，傍晚6时30分左右停电，正是沙尘暴接近的时间，直接影响皇后溪地区，有500棗1000户居民被停电。受灾地区主要在Crismon Road 至 Jodi Drive， 和Pecos Road至Ocotillo Road之间。 庆幸的是，SRP维修队在停电后两小时左右将线路修复通电。
c4db3ef90243930c67916f659ff9f920b57099cf.translatedText: Thunderstorm leaves hundreds of homes in Southeast Valley without power (Alberta Times) A ​​thunderstorm Tuesday night not only brought dust, but also left hundreds of residents in the Southeast Valley suffering from power outages. A spokesman for the Salt River Project Power Company said that the power outage occurred around 6:30 in the evening, which was the time when the sandstorm was approaching. It directly affected the Queen Creek area, and 500 and 1,000 residents were without power. The affected areas were mainly between Crismon Road to Jodi Drive and Pecos Road to Ocotillo Road. Fortunately, the SRP maintenance team restored the line and powered it on about two hours after the power outage.

b9ac97db71e09b674b57679de18d037719b91ac6.sourceText: 对抗儿童肥胖症 中小学校午餐更新 （亚省时报） 为了对抗日益严重的儿童肥胖症，根据7月1日起生效的美国联邦规定，今后全美孩童的学校午餐，谷类食品至少一半以上必须为全谷类。 今年1月，国会立法通过”儿童健康、免饥饿法案”，内容包括改善全美学童的营养午餐，减少油脂与盐分的摄取，增加蔬菜与水果的比例，希望让孩子们吃得更健康，远离肥胖症。 ”儿童健康、免饥饿法案”从1日起生效，暑假过后各级学校陆续开学，学童将会发现学校午餐内容与以往略有不同。 举例来说，谷类食品至少一半以上必须为全谷类，到2014年7月1日，所有的谷类食品都必须为全谷类。 根据这项新规定，学校午餐的含盐量在未来10年内，必须减少一半。同时，以往可以吃到的果汁冰棒，今后将改为新鲜水果，披萨饼皮将采用全麦面粉制作，油炸马铃薯块也将由地瓜条取代。
b9ac97db71e09b674b57679de18d037719b91ac6.translatedText: Fighting Childhood Obesity Primary and Secondary School Lunch Updates (Alberta Times) In order to combat the growing epidemic of childhood obesity, according to U.S. federal regulations that took effect on July 1, at least half of the cereals in school lunches for children across the United States must be whole grains. In January this year, Congress passed legislation called the "Healthy Children, Hunger-Free Act," which includes improving nutritious lunches for children across the United States, reducing fat and salt intake, and increasing the proportion of vegetables and fruits, hoping to make children eat healthier and stay away from obesity. The "Healthy Children, Hunger-Free Act" will take effect on the 1st. After the summer vacation, schools at all levels will begin to reopen. School children will find that the content of school lunches is slightly different from before. For example, at least half of cereals must be whole grains, and by July 1, 2014, all cereals must be whole grains. Under the new regulations, the salt content of school lunches must be reduced by half within the next 10 years. At the same time, the fruit popsicles that can be eaten in the past will be replaced by fresh fruits in the future, the pizza crust will be made of whole wheat flour, and the fried potato cubes will also be replaced by sweet potato sticks.

cc28fece1d9c16aef16dd9fbd61df19711a10cf8.sourceText: 美国执行死刑数降至二十年来最低 (亚省时报) 一个跟踪统计死刑数据的组织表示，美国9个州今年执行过死刑，是20年来最少的。总部设在华盛顿的死刑信息中心星期二在年度报告中公布了这个数据。 这个组织说，2012年，超过三分之二的执行死刑案集中在4个州，得克萨斯州执行了15起死刑，亚利桑那州6起，另外还有俄克拉荷马州和密西西比州。该组织说，美国今年共有43位犯人被执行死刑，与2011年相同。 自1976年美国恢复死刑后，处以极刑一直是争议很大的议题。该组织说，美国50个州中超过半数的州目前没有死刑处罚，或者在过去5年内没有执行过死刑 。
cc28fece1d9c16aef16dd9fbd61df19711a10cf8.translatedText: The number of executions in the United States has dropped to the lowest level in 20 years (Alberta Times) An organization that tracks death penalty data said that 9 states in the United States have carried out executions this year, the fewest in 20 years. The Washington-based Death Penalty Information Center released the data Tuesday in its annual report. The organization said that in 2012, more than two-thirds of executions were concentrated in four states, with 15 executions in Texas, six in Arizona, Oklahoma and Mississippi. The organization said that a total of 43 prisoners were executed in the United States this year, the same as in 2011. Since the United States reinstated the death penalty in 1976, capital punishment has been a controversial issue. The organization said that more than half of the 50 states in the United States currently do not have the death penalty or have not carried out an execution in the past five years.

53e1dc332dab81007491650681c20de7c7603150.sourceText: 这个”十万强计划”除了鼓励美国的高中生、大学生前往中国留学和实习以外，还将输送美国的教师前往中国进行交流培训等。该计划由奥巴马总统于09年提出，国务卿喜莱莉于去年5月在北京将这个计划签署为双边协议。
53e1dc332dab81007491650681c20de7c7603150.translatedText: In addition to encouraging American high school students and college students to study and intern in China, this "100,000 Strong Plan" will also send American teachers to China for exchange and training. This plan was proposed by President Obama in 2009, and Secretary of State Hillary Clinton signed the plan into a bilateral agreement in Beijing last May.

54149c5ef091158e3037fcb8817784b5c0be163b.sourceText: 这个”十万强计划”虽然是政府发起的，但资金来源主要是企业、民间机构以及慈善家，而非联邦预算。喜莱莉在去年宣布福特基金会将为这个计划提供赞助，该基金会将为”十万强基金”提供一百万元资金，鼓励美国学生前往中国留学。除了美国的一些企业捐助之外，中国企业也在这个项目上投入了资金，著名的”万向集团”就已经为这个”十万人留学中国计划”捐助了约485万元。
54149c5ef091158e3037fcb8817784b5c0be163b.translatedText: Although this "100,000 Strong Plan" is initiated by the government, its funding sources mainly come from enterprises, private institutions and philanthropists, rather than the federal budget. Hillary announced last year that the Ford Foundation would sponsor the program, which would provide $1 million in funding for the "100,000 Strong Fund" to encourage American students to study in China. In addition to donations from some American companies, Chinese companies have also invested in this project. The famous "Wanxiang Group" has donated approximately 4.85 million yuan to this "100,000 Study Abroad in China Plan".

d3a12299002c06432fc6801441e82e50e079b116.translatedText: Today (January 24), Chinese Ambassador to the United States Zhang Yesui also attended the event.

224e0ad0cc7b614683fbf4e72e7e6577942d708c.sourceText: ”太阳鸟”亚利桑那华人网倾情策划
224e0ad0cc7b614683fbf4e72e7e6577942d708c.translatedText: "Sunbird" is carefully planned by the Arizona Chinese Network

f4e514298d3966e910c7abc8357d586db8ee7289.sourceText: 一直以来，新东方艺术学校始终以”传承中华文明，开创美好未来”为办学宗旨。今天，为了丰富亚利桑那州华人的文化生活，使亚省华人有一个长久的信息交流的平台，我们将再次以此为宗旨，在本校内开设”新东方文化讲坛”。
f4e514298d3966e910c7abc8357d586db8ee7289.translatedText: All along, New Oriental Art School has always been "inheriting the Chinese "Civilization and creating a better future" is the school's purpose. Today, in order to enrich the cultural life of Chinese in Arizona and provide a long-term information exchange platform for Chinese in Arizona, we will once again use this as our purpose and open the "New Oriental Cultural Forum" in our school .

1dd6560e0060f3062b636c42c49fa34803451fe9.sourceText: 本讲坛将以文化讲座的形式进行，初步定于每周一期，即每周六晚七点开始。每期讲座的内容将会提前在新东方网站及”太阳鸟”亚利桑那华人网上提前发布。届时，我们将邀请本省各界知名学者、文化界名人来担任主讲人。讲座的内容将会涉及政治、经济、文化的方方面面。此外，如果我们的华人朋友中，有谁在工作、学习和生活中的某个方面有所心得，愿意拿出来和朋友们分享，我们的讲坛也将为你提供这样的机会。
1dd6560e0060f3062b636c42c49fa34803451fe9.translatedText: This forum will be held in the form of a cultural lecture, initially scheduled to start at 7pm every Saturday. The content of each lecture will be released in advance on the New Oriental website and the "Sunbird" Arizona Chinese website. At that time, we will invite well-known scholars and cultural celebrities in the province to serve as speakers. The content of the lecture will cover all aspects of politics, economy, and culture. In addition, if any of our Chinese friends are working or studying If you have any experience in a certain aspect of life and are willing to share it with your friends, our forum will also provide you with such an opportunity.

1dc5d38e8c47ec5221456fcd47edebe24e49a192.sourceText: 本讲坛的第一次讲座将定于八月中下旬，由著名的美术家徐威东老师主讲，徐老师将会以如何从孩提时代提高审美情趣和怎样从生活中发现美为主题，和朋友们分享他的心得。
1dc5d38e8c47ec5221456fcd47edebe24e49a192.translatedText: The first lecture of this forum will be held in mid-to-late August, by a famous speaker. The artist Mr. Xu Weidong will give a lecture. Mr. Xu will share his experience with friends on the theme of how to improve aesthetic taste from childhood and how to discover beauty in life.

7520a291089c4e2f95b92c4d42b76ebd6dd1e072.sourceText: 亲爱的朋友，如果你周末有时间，如果你愿意交朋友，如果你想提升自身的文化修养，或者如果你仅仅是只想放松一下紧张了一周的大脑，那么请你邀上三五知己朋友，来新东方艺术学校的文化讲坛听讲座吧。在讲座之后，我们还为愿意留下来闲聊的朋友提供茶座，大家可以一起喝喝茶，聊聊天，说说自己的或者别人的故事。
7520a291089c4e2f95b92c4d42b76ebd6dd1e072.translatedText: Dear friends, if If you have time on weekends, if you are willing to make friends, if you want to improve your cultural accomplishment, or if you just want to relax your mind after a stressful week, then please invite some close friends to attend the lecture at the cultural forum of New Oriental Art School. After the lecture, we will also provide tea for friends who are willing to stay and chat. Everyone can drink tea together and tell their own or other people's stories.
