f2d1d9ce5343c0688f12f00cd2bdf08b52b9dc63.sourceText: (世纪新能源网) 美国公共事业UniSource Energy Services（UES）扩大其亚利桑那州威尔科克斯的太阳能光伏和风力发电项目，其可再生能源发电量将翻一番。
f2d1d9ce5343c0688f12f00cd2bdf08b52b9dc63.translatedText: (Century New Energy Network) US public utility UniSource Energy Services (UES) is expanding its solar photovoltaic and wind project in Wilcox, Arizona, which will double its renewable energy generation capacity.

185e3c7b7e3063db6985f2761ff284c3c1801856.sourceText: 此37MW＂赤兔马＂（Red Horse）项目将于本月竣工，将为超过7,500个家庭提供足够的太阳能发电。
185e3c7b7e3063db6985f2761ff284c3c1801856.translatedText: >The 37MW "Red Horse" project will be completed this month and will provide enough solar power for more than 7,500 households.

20a9777021f12328d628b4b5c7b266ed6de56129.sourceText: 此项目是UES到目前为止最大的单个可再生能源资源项目，其拥有或租赁的可再生能源系统总容量达到66MW。
20a9777021f12328d628b4b5c7b266ed6de56129.translatedText: This project is UES's largest single renewable energy resource project so far, with the total capacity of its owned or leased renewable energy systems reaching 66MW.

cd3810ebd6152aba45fd022ae16574d5cfb703c9.sourceText: 此＂赤兔马＂项目的所有权及运营权归属于休斯顿的Torch Renewable Energy公司，其将电力出售给UES。
cd3810ebd6152aba45fd022ae16574d5cfb703c9.translatedText: The ownership and operation rights of the "Red Tuma" project belong to Houston-based Torch Renewable Energy, which sells the power to UES.

9ef25a4b82b378f7b01d2ee4917bcda1bdafb250.sourceText: 自2015年8月，该项目在早期阶段已经向UES的姊妹公司图森电力公司（TEP）的客户提供风能和太阳能发电。
9ef25a4b82b378f7b01d2ee4917bcda1bdafb250.translatedText: Since August 2015, the project has been providing wind and solar power to customers of UES's sister company Tucson Electric Power (TEP) in its early stages.

7d5b672a8ee696e8ab0d149becbd3a21b1f9888e.sourceText: 整个＂赤兔马＂项目为UES和TEP生产101MW太阳能和风能发电，可满足超过21,000户家庭的用电。此项目包括100,000块太阳能电池板，占地面积200 英亩。
7d5b672a8ee696e8ab0d149becbd3a21b1f9888e.translatedText: The entire "Red Tuma" project produces 101MW of solar and wind power for UES and TEP, which can meet the electricity needs of more than 21,000 households. The project includes 100,000 solar panels and covers an area of ​​200 acres.

2eaac51fc25d5a69376658c921e056776feb8cf4.sourceText: 随着此项目的完工，UES大约有12%的能源将来自于可再生能源。
2eaac51fc25d5a69376658c921e056776feb8cf4.translatedText: With the completion of this project, approximately 12% of UES's energy will come from renewable energy.

182aa6960b072d63d63c19745ecdd6f9db83da82.translatedText: American Shen Ning's random talk about a figure in the Republic of China: Chen Duxiu. When I was a child, I often knocked down this and that in Beijing. There were really not many good people in modern China. The newspaper announced that the leaders were opening...

283fdad7dea795a5db7c9d3e141439752ca37976.sourceText: 我小时候﹐北京城里经常打倒这个那个﹐现代中国实在好人不多。报纸宣布﹐领袖开骂﹐老师批判﹐学生们跟着喊口号﹐陈独秀是其中一个打倒的。回到家里不一样﹐不许讲陈独秀先生坏话。母亲说﹕他是外祖父的救命恩人。
283fdad7dea795a5db7c9d3e141439752ca37976.translatedText: When I was a child, I often beat down this and that in Beijing. There are really not many good people in modern China. The newspaper announced that the leaders were scolding, the teachers were criticizing, and the students were shouting slogans. Chen Duxiu was one of them who was knocked down. It's different when you get home. You're not allowed to speak ill of Mr. Chen Duxiu. My mother said: He was my grandfather’s savior.

dc3b1c90d221eca35a6f763f1456e99301731a12.sourceText: 五四运动前后﹐外祖父才十五岁﹐在北京大学预科读书。当时陈独秀先生已是文科学长﹐外祖父并不认识他﹐更不知道他是中国传播共产思想的第一人。二十年代初﹐外祖父到上海﹐在商务印书馆做编辑﹐跟中共早期党员恽代英交了朋友﹐开始参加社会政治活动﹐那时候便一定听说陈独秀的大名了﹐但外祖父没有对后人们提起过。
dc3b1c90d221eca35a6f763f1456e99301731a12.translatedText: Around the time of the May 4th Movement, my grandfather was only fifteen years old and studying in the preparatory department of Peking University. At that time, Mr. Chen Duxiu was already the dean of liberal arts. My grandfather did not know him, let alone the first person to spread communist ideas in China. In the early 1920s, my grandfather went to Shanghai and worked as an editor at the Commercial Press. He made friends with Yun Daiying, an early member of the Communist Party of China, and began to participate in social and political activities. At that time, he must have heard of Chen Duxiu's name, but his grandfather never mentioned it to future generations.

66cb95a531e7abc8234bb08727555d909b31b9bb.sourceText: 北伐战争爆发﹐外祖父到武汉参加大革命﹐任北伐军校的政治教官。武汉军校校长是蒋介石﹐但具体校务由恽代英主持。当时叶挺率领的部队﹐驻扎武汉。毛泽东领导的农民运动讲习所﹐也在武汉。所以当时武汉基本是中共控制的天下﹐请参阅本书”北伐战争”一文。那期间外祖父不满武汉工会农会的许多做法﹐并且曾经几次阻止农会书记为胁迫民众服从﹐任意残杀无辜农民。外祖父的作为﹐自然引起武汉农运领袖的不满﹐便派人把外祖父逮捕。当时母亲不到六岁﹐下面还有两个弟弟。
66cb95a531e7abc8234bb08727555d909b31b9bb.translatedText: When the Northern Expedition broke out, my grandfather went to Wuhan to participate in the Great Revolution and served as a political instructor at the Northern Expedition Military Academy. The principal of Wuhan Military Academy was Chiang Kai-shek, but the specific school affairs were presided over by Yun Daiying. At that time, the troops led by Ye Ting were stationed in Wuhan. The Peasant Movement Training Center led by Mao Zedong is also in Wuhan. Therefore, Wuhan was basically controlled by the CCP at that time. Please refer to the article "Northern Expedition" in this book. During that period, my grandfather was dissatisfied with many practices of the Wuhan Trade Union and Peasant Association, and several times prevented the secretary of the Peasant Association from killing innocent peasants in order to coerce people into obeying. My grandfather's actions naturally aroused the dissatisfaction of the leaders of the Wuhan Peasant Movement, so they sent people to arrest my grandfather. My mother was less than six years old at the time, and she had two younger brothers.

4566486f39e106a9722e98aeb1b2d8629648d6e1.sourceText: 本来全家以为外祖父此去一定无归﹐不料过了两日﹐外祖父被放出来。原来是中共内部两派正在激烈斗争﹐以陈独秀先生为首的一派﹐认为当时农民运动过火﹐需要纠正。武汉军校政治部主任施存统先生是中共党内高级干部﹐同意陈独秀先生的主张﹐所以当施先生获知武汉农运领袖下令逮捕外祖父后﹐马上报经陈独秀先生批准﹐将外祖父释放﹐留下一条性命。从此外祖父家人﹐永远敬陈独秀先生为救命恩人。
4566486f39e106a9722e98aeb1b2d8629648d6e1.translatedText: Originally, the whole family thought that my grandfather would never return, but unexpectedly, two days later, my grandfather was released. It turned out that there was a fierce struggle between two factions within the CCP. The faction headed by Mr. Chen Duxiu believed that the peasant movement at that time had gone too far and needed to be corrected. Mr. Shi Cuntong, director of the Political Department of Wuhan Military Academy, is a senior cadre within the Chinese Communist Party and agreed with Mr. Chen Duxiu’s proposition. Therefore, when Mr. Shi learned that the leader of the Wuhan Peasant Movement ordered the arrest of his grandfather, he immediately reported to Mr. Chen Duxiu for approval and released his grandfather, leaving his life intact. From then on, my grandfather’s family will always respect Mr. Chen Duxiu as their lifesaver.

7ca8521b0f7956357e8997deafbddc5a6ffa008b.sourceText: 汪精卫先生在武汉分共以后﹐中共被迫南下﹐保存实力。外祖父趁机逃离军校﹐躲藏起来﹐从此与中共分道扬镖。后来他在上海遇见施存统先生﹐才知道陈独秀先生因为反对农民运动的残暴﹐在中共党内遭到清洗﹐施先生自己也受到整肃﹐已经金盆洗手﹐弃政从教。三十年代初﹐外祖父到北京大学法学院做教授﹐又与施先生同事﹐施先生也在北京大学做教授。
7ca8521b0f7956357e8997deafbddc5a6ffa008b.translatedText: After Mr. Wang Jingwei split the Communist Party in Wuhan, the CCP was forced to go south to preserve its strength. My grandfather took the opportunity to escape from the military academy and went into hiding. From then on, he parted ways with the CCP. Later, when he met Mr. Shi Cuntong in Shanghai, he learned that Mr. Chen Duxiu had been purged within the Communist Party of China because of his opposition to the brutality of the peasant movement. Mr. Shi himself had also been purged. He had washed his hands and abandoned politics to pursue a career in education. In the early 1930s, my grandfather went to Peking University Law School to work as a professor, and worked with Mr. Shi, who was also a professor at Peking University.

f1045847258439a2ab8b73e443e2e3ae55154b16.sourceText: 第二年爆出中共建党元勋陈独秀先生被捕的消息﹐当时传说﹐陈独秀先生遭中共整肃之后﹐一直在上海隐名埋姓﹐躲避国民党政府的追捕。后来是他自己党内的反对派﹐为了彻底消灭他的影响力﹐私下把陈独秀先生捉起来﹐秘密送给国民政府治安机关去坐牢的。此说确否﹐无法证实﹐当时是盛传无疑。外祖父根据他在北伐战争中的所见所闻﹐相信那些农运领袖一定做得出这等卑劣而残忍的事情。
f1045847258439a2ab8b73e443e2e3ae55154b16.translatedText: The following year, news broke of the arrest of Mr. Chen Duxiu, the founding father of the Communist Party of China. At that time, it was said that Mr. Chen Duxiu had been hiding in Shanghai to avoid being pursued by the Kuomintang government after being purged by the CCP. Later, the opposition within his own party, in order to completely eliminate his influence, privately arrested Mr. Chen Duxiu and secretly sent him to the security organs of the Nationalist Government for imprisonment. Whether this theory is true or not cannot be confirmed. It was undoubtedly a rumor at the time. Based on what he saw and heard during the Northern Expedition, my grandfather believed that the leaders of the peasant movement must be able to do such despicable and cruel things.

1353a61495eb497200de8a596d72e29ea2d53a57.sourceText: 北京各大学曾因为陈独秀先生被捕的事﹐很热闹过一番。胡适先生跟陈独秀先生一起办过《新青年》杂志﹐在北京大学三院大礼堂﹐开演讲会赞扬文学革命时期的陈独秀﹐听众不下三千人。中共为了冲淡和对抗胡适之先生的演讲﹐同一时期也在朝阳大学开演讲会﹐由马哲民主讲﹐批判陈独秀。那个批判陈独秀的马哲民﹐自称是武汉北伐时期的农民部长﹐曾经坚决反对过陈独秀的机会主义。但是外祖父曾在武汉跟马哲民认识﹐两个人都在北伐军校做教官﹐外祖父是中校军衔﹐而马哲民是少校。此外马哲民当时也在沈雁冰主持的《民国日报》做编辑﹐哪里做过什么农民部长﹐他那时的级别还远远够不上去反对总书记陈独秀先生。此等政客﹐怎么竟敢如此当众扯谎﹐任意编造历史﹐真是骇人听闻。不过中国老话说﹕人不要脸﹐鬼都害怕。硬耍流氓﹐不顾脸面和死活﹐也就没人惹得起﹐只好让他三分﹐所以流氓无赖倒是经常能够获得胜利。
1353a61495eb497200de8a596d72e29ea2d53a57.translatedText: There was a lot of excitement in various universities in Beijing because of the arrest of Mr. Chen Duxiu. Mr. Hu Shi and Mr. Chen Duxiu co-organized the magazine "New Youth". In the auditorium of the Third Hospital of Peking University, they held a lecture to praise Chen Duxiu during the literary revolution, with an audience of no less than 3,000 people. In order to dilute and counter Mr. Hu Shizhi's speech, the CCP also held a lecture at Chaoyang University at the same time, with Ma Zhemin giving a lecture to criticize Chen Duxiu. Ma Zhemin, who criticized Chen Duxiu, claimed to be the peasant minister during the Northern Expedition in Wuhan, and had firmly opposed Chen Duxiu's opportunism. But my grandfather had met Ma Zhemin in Wuhan. Both of them were instructors at the Northern Expeditionary Military Academy. My grandfather had the rank of lieutenant colonel, and Ma Zhemin was a major. In addition, Ma Zhemin was also an editor at the Republic of China Daily, chaired by Shen Yanbing, and had served as a peasant minister. His rank at that time was far from high enough to oppose General Secretary Chen Duxiu. How dare these politicians lie in public and fabricate history at will? It's really appalling. But there is an old Chinese saying: People are shameless, but ghosts are afraid. If you act like a gangster, regardless of face or life and death, no one can afford to offend him, so you have to give him three points, so the gangster can often win.

f4bf50289128439f7bf4a17e4f8875b6cb55861c.sourceText: 北平大学法学院左派学生﹐也发起一个演讲会﹐邀请许德珩﹐刘侃元﹐施存统﹐和其他几个中共干部﹐讲评陈独秀先生。许德珩﹐刘侃元﹐施存统三人﹐在武汉北伐革命期间﹐外祖父都曾结识﹐施存统先生甚至曾是外祖父的救命恩人。演讲前一日﹐施先生来外祖父家﹐说到明天讲陈独秀先生。外祖父劝他取消此约﹐不要去讲﹐告诉施先生﹕前几​​天有人来约外祖父讲陈独秀先生﹐他便当面谢绝。外祖父认为﹐当时只有胡适之先生可以讲陈独秀先生﹐其他人都没有什么资格。虽然施先生曾与陈独秀先生关系很深﹐但在当时情况下演讲﹐必然受到左派的打击﹐犯不着。
f4bf50289128439f7bf4a17e4f8875b6cb55861c.translatedText: Leftist students at Peking University Law School also organized a lecture and invited Xu Deheng, Liu Kanyuan, Shi Cuntong, and several other CCP cadres to comment on Mr. Chen Duxiu. Xu Deheng, Liu Kanyuan, and Shi Cuntong were all acquainted with my grandfather during the Northern Expedition in Wuhan. Mr. Shi Cuntong was even my grandfather's savior. The day before the speech, Mr. Shi came to his grandfather's house and said that he would give a lecture about Mr. Chen Duxiu tomorrow. Grandfather advised him to cancel the appointment and not to talk about it. He told Mr. Shi that a few days ago someone came to ask grandpa to talk about Mr. Chen Duxiu, but he declined in person. My grandfather believed that only Mr. Hu Shizhi could talk about Mr. Chen Duxiu at that time, and no one else was qualified. Although Mr. Shi had a close relationship with Mr. Chen Duxiu, his speech under the circumstances at that time was bound to be attacked by the left and was not a crime.

68944fab1b7d9a20b299f941c0c5a11fde7e98c0.sourceText: 第二天演讲会后﹐施先生又跑来找外祖父﹐面无人色﹐说是那次演讲会﹐聚集了近三千学生。警察大批出动﹐预防意外发生。许德珩﹐刘侃元临时不来﹐只施存统一人上台。他先讲陈独秀先生在文学革命中的重要地位﹐大多学生鼓掌﹐而小撮左派学生跺脚嘘声。施先生继续讲武汉北伐时期的陈独秀先生﹐那批左派学生大起骚动﹐施先生怕了﹐只得勉强批评几句陈独秀先生的机会主义﹐于是大部学生便大喊倒好﹐赶他下台。
68944fab1b7d9a20b299f941c0c5a11fde7e98c0.translatedText: After the lecture the next day, Mr. Shi came to see his grandfather again. His face was pale and he said that nearly three thousand students had gathered at that lecture. Police were deployed in large numbers to prevent accidents. Xu Deheng and Liu Kanyuan were temporarily absent, and only Shi Cun came on stage. He first talked about Mr. Chen Duxiu's important position in the literary revolution. Most students applauded, while a small group of leftist students stamped their feet and booed. Mr. Shi continued to talk about Mr. Chen Duxiu during the Northern Expedition in Wuhan. The leftist students caused a huge commotion. Mr. Shi was afraid and could only criticize Mr. Chen Duxiu's opportunism. Most of the students shouted that it would be better to drive him out of office.

6d089384e25eaedc66b13242f614dc2179573c91.sourceText: 陈独秀先生在国民党监狱关了五年﹐始终不改唯物主义信仰﹐坚贞不屈。直到抗战爆发﹐国民政府为团结各方民众参加抗战﹐施行大赦﹐才把陈独秀先生释放出来。那时战情危急﹐上海先失守﹐继而南京陷落﹐国民政府内迁武汉。外祖父在武汉创办艺文研究会﹐陈独秀先生也同时到武汉﹐二人得以相聚。
6d089384e25eaedc66b13242f614dc2179573c91.translatedText: Mr. Chen Duxiu was imprisoned in the Kuomintang prison for five years, and he never changed his materialist beliefs and was unyielding. It was not until the outbreak of the Anti-Japanese War that the Nationalist Government issued an amnesty in order to unite the people of all parties to participate in the Anti-Japanese War and released Mr. Chen Duxiu. At that time, the war situation was critical. Shanghai fell first, then Nanjing fell, and the Nationalist government moved inward to Wuhan. My grandfather founded the Art and Literature Research Association in Wuhan, and Mr. Chen Duxiu also came to Wuhan at the same time, and the two got together.

8ab203bc6d6e8e0f357005d6f02efe3b5fbb3f64.sourceText: 出狱之后﹐陈独秀先生得不到中共任何关怀﹐贫病交加﹐难以为继。出于对陈独​​秀先生的尊敬﹐也为报答陈独秀先生当年的救命之恩﹐外祖父聘陈独秀先生为艺文研究会刊物写稿﹐并以稿费为名﹐资助他的生活所需。
8ab203bc6d6e8e0f357005d6f02efe3b5fbb3f64.translatedText: After he was released from prison, Mr. Chen Duxiu received no care from the CCP and suffered from poverty and illness, making it difficult to survive. Out of respect for Mr. Chen Duxiu, and in order to repay Mr. Chen Duxiu’s life-saving grace, my grandfather hired Mr. Chen Duxiu to write articles for the Art and Literature Research Association’s publications, and used the royalties to fund his living needs.

3d8d4005234788dbd0dc357e7b0a74a1d3ec7a25.sourceText: 于是艺文研究会的周刊﹐发表出来陈独秀先生文章。当时八路军驻武汉办事处代表周恩来看到﹐马上发表公开讲话﹐指斥陈独秀先生五年来一直接受日本津贴﹐每月三百元。外祖父闻言﹐赶紧出面﹐当众澄清﹐驳斥周恩来造谣﹐说明是艺文研究会约陈独秀先生撰稿﹐按常规发稿费。艺文研究会是国民党的文化机构﹐并非日本特务机关﹐所以陈独秀先生接受艺文研究会稿费﹐绝非接受日本津贴。这样双方公开论战﹐一时之间﹐成为热点﹐武汉各报为之轰动。据母亲讲﹐她那时十四五岁﹐记得家门口经常聚集大群记者﹐外祖父回家出门﹐总要被人阻拦﹐有时会站在马路上﹐跟新华社的记者发生激烈争辨。
3d8d4005234788dbd0dc357e7b0a74a1d3ec7a25.translatedText: So the weekly magazine of the Art and Literature Research Association published an article by Mr. Chen Duxiu. At that time, Zhou Enlai, the representative of the Eighth Route Army Office in Wuhan, saw this and immediately made a public speech, criticizing Mr. Chen Duxiu for receiving a Japanese subsidy of 300 yuan per month for five years. Upon hearing this, my grandfather quickly came forward and clarified in public, refuting Zhou Enlai's rumors, explaining that Mr. Chen Duxiu was invited by the Art and Literature Research Association to write the article, and he was paid the regular publishing fee. The Art and Literature Research Association is a cultural institution of the Kuomintang and not a Japanese secret service. Therefore, Mr. Chen Duxiu accepts royalties from the Art and Literature Research Association and is definitely not accepting Japanese subsidies. This open debate between the two sides suddenly became a hot topic, and newspapers in Wuhan became a sensation. According to her mother, she was fourteen or fifteen years old at the time. She remembers that large groups of reporters often gathered in front of her home. My grandfather was always blocked when he went home and went out. Sometimes he would stand on the road and get into heated arguments with reporters from Xinhua News Agency.

14cb29e524a43c0bc4b2b7ba2743e71019a63d0d.sourceText: 一天晚上外祖父回家﹐夜黑风高﹐刚到门口﹐旁边闪出一人﹐高大健壮﹐灰色军装﹐两手插在口袋里﹐内有鼓鼓的硬物。外祖父问﹕找我有事吗﹖壮汉说﹕我要问问陈独秀的事。外祖父一听﹐再看看那口袋里的硬物﹐心想﹕此番休矣。那汉子说﹕他原是江西中共红军军官﹐被国军俘虏后﹐在开封监狱关了七年。最近获释﹐到武汉来寻找八路军。看到报纸消息﹐才知陈独秀先生曾经被捕。他根据报纸上的报道﹐特别来找外祖父﹐询问此事究竟。外祖父便简单地把陈独秀先生如何入狱﹐又如何释放﹐以及如何在武汉谋生的情况讲了一遍。壮汉听完﹐沉​​思良久﹐长叹一声﹐扬长而去。
14cb29e524a43c0bc4b2b7ba2743e71019a63d0d.translatedText: One night when my grandfather came home, it was dark and windy. As soon as he arrived at the door, a tall and strong man in a gray military uniform appeared next to him. He put his hands in his pockets and had a bulging hard object inside. Grandfather asked: Do you want to see me for anything? The strong man said: I want to ask about Chen Duxiu. When my grandfather heard this, he looked at the hard object in his pocket and thought: This time is over. The man said: He was originally an officer of the Red Army of the Communist Party of China in Jiangxi Province. After being captured by the Chinese army, he was imprisoned in Kaifeng Prison for seven years. Recently released, he went to Wuhan to look for the Eighth Route Army. After reading the news in the newspaper, I learned that Mr. Chen Duxiu had been arrested. Based on the newspaper reports, he specifically came to see his grandfather to inquire about the matter. My grandfather briefly told how Mr. Chen Duxiu was imprisoned, how he was released, and how he made a living in Wuhan. After hearing this, the strong man pondered for a long time, sighed, and walked away.

da0f2bfbd84d0c6191766ac06df4638f3a110c8d.sourceText: 那段期间﹐外祖父每周去看望陈独秀先生一两次﹐除送钱送粮之外﹐也谈天说地。外祖父曾经问过陈独秀先生﹐他是否有意另外组建一个共产党。陈独秀先生回答﹕一个社会不能有两个共产党同时存在﹐一个好﹐一个坏。如今的共产党杀人放火﹐无恶不做。他另组一个真实的共产主义党﹐也是不会组成的。外祖父又问他﹐是否愿意回到原来的共产党。陈独秀先生答﹕有人为了他回党﹐奔走多次。延安方面也要求他悔过投降﹐然后回党。可是陈独秀先生再三声明﹐决不回党。
da0f2bfbd84d0c6191766ac06df4638f3a110c8d.translatedText: During that period, my grandfather visited Mr. Chen Duxiu once or twice a week. In addition to sending money and food, he also talked about everything. My grandfather once asked Mr. Chen Duxiu if he intended to form another Communist Party. Mr. Chen Duxiu replied: A society cannot have two communist parties coexisting, one good and one bad. Today’s Communist Party commits murder, arson, and all kinds of evil. He will not be able to form another real communist party. My grandfather asked him again if he was willing to return to the original Communist Party. Mr. Chen Duxiu replied: Some people have made many attempts to return him to the Party. Yan'an also asked him to repent, surrender, and then return to the party. However, Mr. Chen Duxiu has repeatedly stated that he will never return to the party.

067aa54ed597de590d514b59f18b3f89e32d30be.sourceText: 有一次外祖父去看望陈独秀先生﹐在门口见到李公朴从房间里匆忙走出。外祖父进了屋子之后﹐谈及此状﹐原来方才陈独秀先生与李公朴聊天﹐对李公朴说﹕你们跟着莫斯科﹐反对国粹主义者。将来有一天﹐史大林与希特勒合作起来﹐对付英法﹐你们怎么办﹖李公朴说﹕那是可能的事。陈独秀先生又对李公朴说﹕你们最抗日﹐甚至最最抗日﹐可是如果将来有一天﹐苏俄与日本法西斯合作﹐对付英美﹐你们又怎么办﹖
067aa54ed597de590d514b59f18b3f89e32d30be.translatedText: Once my grandfather went to visit Mr. Chen Duxiu and saw Li Gongpu hurriedly walking out of the room at the door.外祖父进了屋子之后﹐谈及此状﹐原来方才陈独秀先生与李公朴聊天﹐对李公朴说﹕你们跟着莫斯科﹐反对国粹主义者。 One day in the future, Stalin and Hitler will cooperate to deal with Britain and France. What will you do? Li Gongpu said: That is possible.陈独秀先生又对李公朴说﹕你们最抗日﹐甚至最最抗日﹐可是如果将来有一天﹐苏俄与日本法西斯合作﹐对付英美﹐你们又怎么办﹖

0c7835dbbacd198d81bb3f5af619195a1b91059f.sourceText: 陈独秀先生对外祖父说﹕我说到这里﹐公朴红着脸﹐站起来就走了。外祖父问﹕李公朴的脸还会红么﹖说完此话﹐和陈独秀先生相对大笑。那李公朴的脸本是棕色﹐就算会脸红也看不出来。但笑归笑﹐可悲的是﹐陈独秀先生果然远见卓识﹐苏联共产党的后来作为﹐都被他不幸一一而言中。母亲给我们讲这些故事后﹐常会补充说﹐那些往事外祖父都有日记﹐所以是确实的。我来美国后﹐读到外祖父的一些随笔文章﹐如此的许多对话都用了引号﹐想必是陈独秀先生的原话。
0c7835dbbacd198d81bb3f5af619195a1b91059f.translatedText: Mr. Chen Duxiu said to his grandfather: When I said this, Gong Pu blushed, stood up and left. Grandfather asked: Will Li Gongpu’s face still be red? After saying this, he and Mr. Chen Duxiu laughed at each other. Li Gongpu's face is originally brown, and even if he blushes, he won't be able to tell. But it's a laugh. The sad thing is that Mr. Chen Duxiu was indeed farsighted, and he unfortunately failed to predict all the subsequent actions of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union. After my mother told us these stories, she would often add that my grandfather had a diary of those past events, so they were true. After I came to the United States, I read some essays written by my grandfather. Many of these conversations were in quotation marks. They must have been Mr. Chen Duxiu’s original words.

77fec5e7df4a57eed87f8c9930363205586cc02b.sourceText: 中国首次成功预警破坏性地震
77fec5e7df4a57eed87f8c9930363205586cc02b.translatedText: China successfully warned of a destructive earthquake for the first time

aec21e74d6c392314141924747f2e5b701792fd0.sourceText: 中国首次成功预警破坏性地震 当地时间19日10时46分，云南省昭通市巧家县、四川省凉山彝族自治州宁南县交界…
aec21e74d6c392314141924747f2e5b701792fd0.translatedText: China successfully warned of a destructive earthquake for the first time At 10:46 local time on the 19th, at the junction of Qiaojia County, Zhaotong City, Yunnan Province, and Ningnan County, Liangshan Yi Autonomous Prefecture, Sichuan Province...

9791aba44408089920e1f40a3d7a027eb6513f25.sourceText: 当日上午10时47分5秒，该地震预警系统通过地震预警信息接收终端发出了地震预警倒计时警报，并显示地震预警信息”云南巧家10时46分59秒发生5.0级地震……”。该地震预警信息也通过手机、计算机、专用接收终端、微博等进行了同步发布。为巧家县部分地区、昭通市等周边区域提供了几秒到几十秒不等的预警时间。
9791aba44408089920e1f40a3d7a027eb6513f25.translatedText: At 10:47:55 on the same day, the earthquake early warning system issued an earthquake early warning countdown alarm through the earthquake early warning information receiving terminal, and displayed the earthquake early warning information "A 5.0-magnitude earthquake occurred in Qiaojia, Yunnan Province at 10:46:59...". The earthquake early warning information was also released simultaneously through mobile phones, computers, special receiving terminals, Weibo, etc. Warning times ranging from a few seconds to tens of seconds are provided for parts of Qiaojia County, Zhaotong City and other surrounding areas.

ad973c008ecc7dd7e5d20a157c5c6710e74655da.sourceText: 数分钟后，记者经中国地震台网公布的信息确认，当日10时46分云南省昭通市巧家县、四川省凉山彝族自治州宁南县交界（北纬27.1度，东经103.0度）发生4.9级地震。据相关部门了解，截至目前，该地震已造成4人受轻微伤，房屋倒塌9户56间、受损298户815间。
ad973c008ecc7dd7e5d20a157c5c6710e74655da.translatedText: A few minutes later, the reporter confirmed through information released by the China Seismological Network that a magnitude 4.9 earthquake occurred at the junction of Qiaojia County, Zhaotong City, Yunnan Province, and Ningnan County, Liangshan Yi Autonomous Prefecture, Sichuan Province (27.1 degrees north latitude, 103.0 degrees east longitude) at 10:46 that day. According to relevant departments, so far, the earthquake has caused 4 minor injuries, 9 households with 56 houses collapsed, and 298 households with 815 houses damaged.

48766181d3c3a7e1430e96d6d8be2a29b2e68eed.sourceText: 据了解，小于2.5级的地震通常为小地震；2.5至4.7级地震为有感地震；破坏性地震为大于4.7级的地震，并造成一定的人员伤亡和建筑物破坏，或造成重大的人员伤亡和建筑物破坏的地震灾害。
48766181d3c3a7e1430e96d6d8be2a29b2e68eed.translatedText: It is understood that earthquakes with a magnitude less than 2.5 are usually small earthquakes; earthquakes with a magnitude of 2.5 to 4.7 are felt earthquakes; destructive earthquakes are earthquakes with a magnitude greater than 4.7 and cause certain casualties and building damage, or earthquake disasters that cause major casualties and building damage.

737f0d99449be228112e3b696a0db34d3bdb5c5a.sourceText: ”经过这次地震，证明这个系统对较大级别地震也是可以的。”成都高新减灾研究所所长王暾表示，该地震预警系统在经历了众多较小级别地震检验后，通过此次地震证实，该地震预警系统对于5级左右破坏性地震也能进行很好预警。
737f0d99449be228112e3b696a0db34d3bdb5c5a.translatedText: "After this earthquake, it was proved that this system can also handle larger earthquakes." Wang Dun, director of the Chengdu High-tech Disaster Reduction Institute, said that after the earthquake early warning system has experienced many smaller earthquakes, this earthquake confirmed that the earthquake early warning system can also provide good early warning for destructive earthquakes around magnitude 5.

d46c8a915542c7eb4e553c96895b67daab4ff1bd.sourceText: 中国旅游业发展有多快？这份世界级榜单给出了答案
d46c8a915542c7eb4e553c96895b67daab4ff1bd.translatedText: How fast is China's tourism industry developing? This world-class list gives the answer

47ef558e13a5a7da253cb343698f6c969701687c.sourceText: 中国旅游业发展有多快？这份世界级榜单给出了答案 原标题：中国旅游业发展有多快？这份世界级榜单给出了答案 …
47ef558e13a5a7da253cb343698f6c969701687c.translatedText: How fast is China’s tourism industry developing? This world-class list gives the answer. Original title: How fast is China’s tourism industry developing? This world-class list gives the answer...

fcc82ae5f5cc5cac55e18f4142ce1ed4d5cbcbdc.sourceText: 原标题：中国旅游业发展有多快？这份世界级榜单给出了答案
fcc82ae5f5cc5cac55e18f4142ce1ed4d5cbcbdc.translatedText: Original title: How fast is China’s tourism industry developing? This world-class list gives the answer

f72f71bab0419f26dad7ff3e0f7a1b89738b20f4.sourceText: 海外网10月25日电 中国旅游业什么水平？全球各大媒体纷纷给出了答案。全球10大发展最快旅游城市，中国竟包揽前5名。另外，中国出境游大力驱动亚太地区旅游业发展，入境游的显著增幅也折射出中国的经济发展成就，前景令人赞叹。
f72f71bab0419f26dad7ff3e0f7a1b89738b20f4.translatedText: Overseas Network, October 25th: What is the level of China's tourism industry? Major media outlets around the world have given answers. Among the top 10 fastest-growing tourism cities in the world, China actually takes the top five. In addition, China's outbound tourism has vigorously driven the development of tourism in the Asia-Pacific region, and the significant growth in inbound tourism also reflects China's economic development achievements, and the prospects are impressive.

420902d39f8ed89665c25e2963f66387072ae58c.sourceText: 全球发展最快旅游城市中国包揽前5名
420902d39f8ed89665c25e2963f66387072ae58c.translatedText: >China, the world's fastest growing tourism city, takes the top 5 places

0e523b3b2c2710467cb6c29097d6373dda1e8a34.sourceText: 世界旅游及旅行理事会（WTTC）最新发布的数据显示，全球发展最快的10个旅游城市全部在亚洲，而中国包揽了前5名。其中，重庆位列榜首，广州、上海、北京和成都紧随其后。
0e523b3b2c2710467cb6c29097d6373dda1e8a34.translatedText: The latest data released by the World Travel and Tourism Council (WTTC) shows that the world's 10 fastest growing tourism cities are all in Asia, and China takes the top 5 places. Among them, Chongqing tops the list, followed by Guangzhou, Shanghai, Beijing and Chengdu.

edd90df3b013ebebc2e37278dee0b9a256e39297.sourceText: 该协会最新发布的”城市旅游与旅行影响”报告显示，未来10年内，亚洲城市将站在全球旅游业增长的最前端，特别是中国的城市。这一研究报告覆盖全球65个城市，其中三分之二的城市在亚太地区。
edd90df3b013ebebc2e37278dee0b9a256e39297.translatedText: The association's latest "Urban Tourism and Travel Impact" report shows that in the next 10 years, Asian cities will be at the forefront of global tourism growth, especially Chinese cities. This research report covers 65 cities around the world, two-thirds of which are in the Asia-Pacific region.

502955222d87fbbf1dc6907e8e1f98ff7215f52d.sourceText: 中国西南部重庆市名列该榜单的首位，其旅游业收入平均每年增长14%。紧随其后的是广州，每年增长13.1%。上海和北京分别以12.8%和12%的年均增幅名列第三和第四位；成都名列第五，每年增长11.2%。排名第六至十位的城市依次为：马尼拉（10.9%）、德里（10.8%）、深圳（10.7%）、吉隆坡（10.1%）和雅加达（10%）。
502955222d87fbbf1dc6907e8e1f98ff7215f52d.translatedText: Chongqing, a city in southwestern China, tops the list, with tourism revenue growing at an average 14% per year. Following closely behind is Guangzhou, with annual growth of 13.1%. Shanghai and Beijing ranked third and fourth with average annual growth rates of 12.8% and 12% respectively; Chengdu ranked fifth with an annual growth rate of 11.2%. The cities ranking sixth to tenth are: Manila (10.9%), Delhi (10.8%), Shenzhen (10.7%), Kuala Lumpur (10.1%) and Jakarta (10%).

0b7803c31d1fe677d05386fe04e8e0bbf9516ab3.sourceText: 报告中称，中国巨大的国内市场是其旅游城市快速发展的强劲后盾。世界旅游及旅行理事会首席执行官格瓦拉（Gloria Guevara）也赞道，”高达两位数的增长率，真是令人惊叹。”她还表示，中国游客促进了全球许多旅游城市的发展，但同时，中国国内旅游业的发展潜力更为巨大。
0b7803c31d1fe677d05386fe04e8e0bbf9516ab3.translatedText: The report stated that China’s huge domestic market is a strong backing for the rapid development of its tourist cities. Gloria Guevara, CEO of the World Travel and Tourism Council, also praised, "The double-digit growth rate is really amazing." She also said that Chinese tourists have promoted the development of many tourist cities around the world, but at the same time, the development potential of China's domestic tourism industry is even greater.

a0954d1b9c0e059a1a53dbbb8cec18972d2da9e1.sourceText: 出境游：驱动亚太地区旅游业发展
a0954d1b9c0e059a1a53dbbb8cec18972d2da9e1.translatedText: Outbound tourism: driving the development of tourism in the Asia-Pacific region

0e8ba0b4f80662b44886dd1fb334ed3ea046dcb2.sourceText: 泰国《曼谷邮报》高度评价了中国出境游于世界旅游业而言的意义，该报称，中国是亚太地区旅游业发展的最大驱动力。
0e8ba0b4f80662b44886dd1fb334ed3ea046dcb2.translatedText: Thailand's "Bangkok Post" spoke highly of the significance of China's outbound tourism in the world tourism industry. The newspaper stated that China is the biggest driving force for the development of tourism in the Asia-Pacific region.

55ecfa84798343f30a58bea9c2507d5c9f3037bc.sourceText: 报道称，根据中国国家旅游局发布的旅游统计数据，2017年上半年，中国公民出境旅游人数达6203万人次。中国游客的到来给全球旅游地的旅游业带来了机遇，另外，也促使亚洲各国对本地旅游设施进行更好的建设。旅游地不但努力吸引更多数量的游客，同时又注重所提供旅游服务的质量。
55ecfa84798343f30a58bea9c2507d5c9f3037bc.translatedText: reported that according to tourism statistics released by the China National Tourism Administration, in the first half of 2017, the number of Chinese citizens traveling abroad reached 62.03 million. The arrival of Chinese tourists has brought opportunities to the tourism industry in global tourist destinations. In addition, it has also prompted Asian countries to better build local tourism facilities. Tourist destinations not only strive to attract more tourists, but also pay attention to the quality of the tourism services they provide.

9b0540865b299f68f3188127ce91189f26f0d7a0.sourceText: 世界旅游组织（UNWTO）4月也发布报告称，2016年，全球各大出境市场的开支情况反映出全球出境游需求的不断增长。其中，中国市场以12%的出境开支增幅名列前茅，引领国际出境游的潮流。UNWTO秘书长Taleb Rifai称，这对全球各大目的地而言都是好事，旅游能带动一国经济增长、就业发展及其他发展机遇。
9b0540865b299f68f3188127ce91189f26f0d7a0.translatedText: The World Tourism Organization (UNWTO) also released a report in April stating that in 2016, expenditures in major global outbound markets reflected the growing demand for global outbound travel. Among them, the Chinese market ranks first with a 12% increase in outbound spending, leading the trend of international outbound travel. UNWTO Secretary-General Taleb Rifai said that this is a good thing for major destinations around the world. Tourism can drive a country’s economic growth, employment development and other development opportunities.

218a5546ddb10ad34bfd8ad3b0be6269bc53fc23.sourceText: 入境游：折射中国经济发展成就
218a5546ddb10ad34bfd8ad3b0be6269bc53fc23.translatedText: Inbound tourism: Reflecting China's economic development achievements

6b5ba1e1f130c3e0d4e11f2ad0c03d0f660b1427.sourceText: 中国出境游正改变亚太旅游格局，同时，中国入境游客数量及其消费增长也正在发生微妙变化，从中可以窥见中国经济转型升级的成就，以及国家吸引力的提升。
6b5ba1e1f130c3e0d4e11f2ad0c03d0f660b1427.translatedText: China's outbound tourism is changing the Asia-Pacific tourism landscape. At the same time, the number of Chinese inbound tourists and their consumption growth are also undergoing subtle changes, which can provide a glimpse of the achievements of China's economic transformation and upgrading, as well as the improvement of the country's attractiveness.

f0ffe60b346ac643e67ef85f4ae942cdf9c0342d.sourceText: 中国旅游研究院报告提供的数据显示，2016年中国出境旅游市场达到1.22亿人次，出境旅游花费1098亿美元，分别同比增长4.3%和5.07%，旅游市场总量与消费增长都呈现出趋缓的态势。同期，中国入境旅游市场规模与消费均持续增长，特别是外国客源市场增幅显著。2016年中国接待入境游客13844.38万人次，同比增长3.5%，规模总量达到历史新高。其中，外国人入境旅游市场的规模和增速分别为2815.12万人次和8.3%，创国际金融危机以来的历史新高。
f0ffe60b346ac643e67ef85f4ae942cdf9c0342d.translatedText: Data provided by the China Tourism Academy report show that in 2016, China's outbound tourism market reached 122 million people, and outbound tourism expenditures were US$109.8 billion, a year-on-year increase of 4.3% and 5.07% respectively. Both the total tourism market volume and consumption growth have shown a slowing trend. During the same period, China's inbound tourism market continued to grow in size and consumption, especially in foreign tourist source markets. In 2016, China received 138.4438 million inbound tourists, a year-on-year increase of 3.5%, and the total number reached a record high. Among them, the scale and growth rate of the foreign inbound tourism market were 28.1512 million and 8.3% respectively, setting a record high since the international financial crisis.

dc78dbd143549a7ea9b7c2d3fe8ddb7d3786c860.sourceText: 两厢对比，不难发现，中国入境游与出境游规模和消费的增速呈现出逆向趋势，多年来国人热衷出境游，到境外买买买的局面正在发生微妙变化。诚然，签证便利化、国际航班加密、免退税业务落地、系列旅游年活动开展等积极因素的拉动，对境外人士入境旅游提供了便捷，但不可否认，中国政治经济环境的稳定是对入境游最有力的保障和吸引。
dc78dbd143549a7ea9b7c2d3fe8ddb7d3786c860.translatedText: Comparing the two sides, it is not difficult to find that the growth rate of China's inbound and outbound tourism scale and consumption has shown a reverse trend. For many years, Chinese people have been keen on outbound travel and the situation of shopping abroad is undergoing subtle changes. It is true that positive factors such as visa facilitation, increased number of international flights, implementation of tax-free and refundable services, and a series of tourism year activities have made inbound tourism more convenient for foreigners. However, it is undeniable that the stability of China's political and economic environment is the most powerful guarantee and attraction for inbound tourism.

09baec3c3d3ba66038d398ad9ef508f57ffa210c.sourceText: 中国社会政治局面的稳定自不待言，在全球经济放缓的背景下，中国经济仍然一枝独秀也是有目共睹。而中国吸引外资的数据进一步表明中国政经环境吸引力持续提升。另一方面，国内各方面环境的持续改善和旅游产业综合发展，在吸引境外人士入境营商和旅游的同时，也同样会对国内游产生影响。
09baec3c3d3ba66038d398ad9ef508f57ffa210c.translatedText: It goes without saying that China's social and political situation is stable. It is obvious to all that China's economy remains outstanding despite the global economic slowdown. The data on China’s attraction of foreign investment further shows that the attractiveness of China’s political and economic environment continues to improve. On the other hand, the continuous improvement of the domestic environment in all aspects and the comprehensive development of the tourism industry will not only attract foreigners to enter the country for business and tourism, but will also have an impact on domestic tourism.

3403c5ec55fc4b8abe5ff0a531086f9e8e196806.sourceText: 福布斯中国富豪榜上的女富豪（组图）
3403c5ec55fc4b8abe5ff0a531086f9e8e196806.translatedText: The richest women on the Forbes China Rich List (photo)

86dcee58352680ff1096a771abb3d799da69dc45.sourceText: 福布斯中国富豪榜上的女富豪（组图） 吴亚军继续领跑女性富豪，…
86dcee58352680ff1096a771abb3d799da69dc45.translatedText: The richest women on the Forbes China Rich List (photo) Wu Yajun continues to lead the female billionaires,...

78d8bac18efa24496e085e822f0897e3c292c24f.sourceText: 吴亚军继续领跑女性富豪，以390.6亿元高居榜首
78d8bac18efa24496e085e822f0897e3c292c24f.translatedText: Wu Yajun continues to lead the female billionaires, topping the list with 39.06 billion yuan

8c5a18616e206818ba126af42d6d54fddba42361.sourceText: 全球著名财经类杂志《福布斯》今日发布了2012年福布斯中国富豪榜单。在今年的上榜富豪中，有23位女性富豪，比去年少了3位，其中，吴亚军继续领跑女性富豪，以390.6亿元高居榜首，紧随其后的是碧桂园的杨惠妍和富华国际集团的陈丽华，她们分别以277.2亿元和176.4亿元暂居二三名的位置。
8c5a18616e206818ba126af42d6d54fddba42361.translatedText: The world-famous financial magazine "Forbes" today released the 2012 Forbes China Rich List. Among the richest people on this year's list, there are 23 women, three less than last year. Among them, Wu Yajun continues to lead the female rich list, topping the list with 39.06 billion yuan, followed by Yang Huiyan of Country Garden and Chen Lihua of Fuhua International Group, who temporarily occupy the second and third positions with 27.72 billion yuan and 17.64 billion yuan respectively.

103eb67cd5fb3aa8cc01f4af494d0f64039f8d26.sourceText: 据福布斯统计，今年的上榜富豪中，有23位女性富豪，比去年少了3位，她们的财富总额也从去年的2,325.5亿元下降到2089.4亿元，占400富豪财富总额的7.85%。其中，身价超过100亿元的女性有7位，与过去两年情况相同，且还是去年的同一批人。这23人中有6名女性富豪的财富来源与房地产相关，其中有5位名列前10，且占据前4名。
103eb67cd5fb3aa8cc01f4af494d0f64039f8d26.translatedText: According to Forbes statistics, there are 23 female billionaires on this year's list, 3 fewer than last year. Their total wealth has also dropped from 232.55 billion yuan last year to 208.94 billion yuan, accounting for 7.85% of the total wealth of the 400 richest people. Among them, there are 7 women with a net worth of more than 10 billion yuan. The situation is the same as in the past two years, and they are still the same group of people last year. Among these 23 people, the source of wealth of 6 female rich people is related to real estate, 5 of them are among the top 10, and they occupy the top 4 places.

a7a21c948ccb27233a94cd83be592770dd3871a6.sourceText: 吴亚军继续领跑女性富豪，以390.6亿元高居榜首，且在整体榜单中，由去年的第7名上升到今年的第5名。紧随其后的是碧桂园的杨惠妍和富华国际集团的陈丽华，她们分别以277.2亿元和176.4亿元暂居二三名的位置，有趣的是，她们还形成”首尾呼应”，31岁的杨惠妍是2012福布斯中国400富豪中最年轻的女性富豪，而陈丽华以71岁高龄成为榜单中最年长的女性。
a7a21c948ccb27233a94cd83be592770dd3871a6.translatedText: > Wu Yajun continues to lead the list of female richest people, topping the list with 39.06 billion yuan. In the overall list, she rose from 7th last year to 5th this year. Followed closely by Yang Huiyan of Country Garden and Chen Lihua of Fu Wah International Group, they temporarily ranked second and third with 27.72 billion yuan and 17.64 billion yuan respectively. Interestingly, they also formed a "head-to-tail echo". The 31-year-old Yang Huiyan was the youngest female billionaire among the 2012 Forbes China 400 richest people, while Chen Lihua became the oldest woman on the list at the age of 71.

ed1f97ea750d3f20361dc413214d25fb5e4be587.sourceText: 杨惠妍(右） 杨惠妍今年仍然是福布斯榜上最富有的富二代。但是她依然秉持自碧桂园上市以来的低调作风，在公司内更为专注于未来战略及碧桂园品牌方面的工作，并未对目前碧桂园的内部事务作过多干涉。碧桂园的员工描述杨惠妍是”相貌端庄，气质颇佳。”而杨国强则强调，杨惠妍的心地很好，这是他愿意将自己的巨额财富留给她的原因。
ed1f97ea750d3f20361dc413214d25fb5e4be587.translatedText: > Yang Huiyan (right) Yang Huiyan is still the richest second generation on the Forbes list this year. However, she still adheres to the low-key style since Country Garden's listing. She is more focused on future strategies and Country Garden brand work within the company, and has not interfered too much in the current internal affairs of Country Garden. Country Garden employees described Yang Huiyan as "dignified in appearance and good temperament." Yang Guoqiang emphasized that Yang Huiyan has a good heart, which is why he is willing to leave his huge wealth to her.

69a0a0b350cddd2f3c5e175e5cb1136f6822e5c0.sourceText: 陈丽华则一度是福布斯富豪榜上的中国女首富，她出身贫困，高中辍学后，开始做家具修理生意，开办了家具厂，1982年移居香港后，从事国际贸易、地产投资，积累了可观的资本。80年代末她回到内地投资房地产。尽管陈丽华已经将富华国际集团交给儿子赵勇打理，自己则专注于收藏紫檀木，但由于开发金宝街时拆毁名人故居，陈丽华每次媒体曝光总会陷于争议之中。
69a0a0b350cddd2f3c5e175e5cb1136f6822e5c0.translatedText: Chen Lihua was once the richest woman in China on the Forbes rich list. She was born in poverty. After dropping out of high school, she started a furniture repair business and opened a furniture factory. After moving to Hong Kong in 1982, she engaged in international trade and real estate investment, and accumulated considerable capital. In the late 1980s, she returned to the mainland to invest in real estate. Although Chen Laiwa has handed over the Fu Wah International Group to her son Zhao Yong to take care of it, and she focuses on collecting rosewood, due to the demolition of celebrities' former residences when developing Jinbao Street, Chen Laiwa always falls into controversy every time she is exposed in the media.

d8bd595f19abd673b86163afe89c86553565eab5.sourceText: (华人福利会稿) 四月二十三日，凤凰城华人福利会在康乐大厦为侨胞办理省钱购买寿地活动。本次活动的各种寿地价格均比绿木墓园公司寿地原价降低1,000至1,500元，加上其它配套备件的优惠，为前来购买寿地的华人同胞省下一笔可观的费用。 从上午十一时至下午三时，资深侨领余文劲先生联同华人福利会义工们，绿木墓园公司总经理David Walker ，经理Kristine DInius，辅导员Karla Gottry，一直在康乐大厦现场为侨胞服务。在义工们的帮助下，购买者先进行登记，并按次序办事。各位侨胞挑选好墓地的位置，并在义工们的协助下，与墓园办事人员之间进行中英语沟通和办理工作，让侨胞的寿地买得安心，买得放心。 一九九二年，资深侨领余文劲先生联同华人福利会，与绿木墓园公司商洽，建立了亚省唯一的华人墓园，并以优惠价为侨民团购墓地，这些年已经为侨胞节省了数十万元。 华人福利会自2011年福利会改选班底以来，关心着华人同胞们的切身利益，在每年团购寿地中为侨胞省钱。去年一次就为侨胞节省了62,500元。绿木墓园公司十分感谢华人福利会的大力协助。 参加本次活动的义工有：资深侨领余文劲、福利会主席张肇鸿，方惠贤、尹凤影、关昆容、余锦天和司徒存
d8bd595f19abd673b86163afe89c86553565eab5.translatedText: (Chinese Welfare Association draft) On April 23, the Phoenix Chinese Welfare Association helped overseas Chinese save money to purchase longevity land at Kangle Building. The prices of various Shoudi in this event are 1,000 to 1,500 yuan lower than the original price of Shoudi from Greenwood Cemetery Company. In addition, discounts on other supporting spare parts can save a considerable amount of money for Chinese compatriots who come to buy Shoudi. From 11 a.m. to 3 p.m., senior overseas Chinese leader Mr. Yu Wenjin, together with Chinese Welfare Association volunteers, Greenwood Cemetery Company general manager David Walker, manager Kristine DInius, and counselor Karla Gottry, have been serving the overseas Chinese on site at the Kangle Building. With the help of volunteers, buyers first register and follow the order. The overseas Chinese selected the location of the cemetery, and with the help of volunteers, they communicated and handled the work in Chinese and English with the cemetery staff, so that the overseas Chinese could feel at ease when buying their birthday place. In 1992, Mr. Yu Wenjin, a senior overseas Chinese leader, teamed up with the Chinese Welfare Association and negotiated with the Greenwood Cemetery Company to establish the only Chinese cemetery in Alberta and group purchased the cemetery for overseas Chinese at a preferential price. Over the years, it has saved overseas Chinese hundreds of thousands of dollars. Since the Welfare Association re-elected its team in 2011, the Chinese Welfare Association has cared about the vital interests of the Chinese compatriots and saved overseas Chinese money in the annual group purchase of birthdays. Last year, we saved overseas Chinese 62,500 yuan in one go. Greenwood Cemetery Company is very grateful to the Chinese Welfare Association for its great assistance. Volunteers participating in this event include: senior overseas Chinese leader Yu Wenjin, Welfare Association Chairman Zhang Zhaohong, Fang Huixian, Yin Fengying, Guan Kunrong, Yu Jintian and Situ Cun

79189078d309f197191636c35867503f6f489c8a.sourceText: 凤凰城凤鸣：飞鸟与葡萄 两年前，我家后院栽种了一棵葡萄树，先生兴致勃勃地搭了一个漂亮又牢固结实的葡萄架，一心等秋后收获葡萄。令人失望的是，头一年有一小串葡萄，但没有结果。第二年也長了一串葡萄，也没结成果，心中的希望有些渺茫。今年春天，突然发現，葡萄枝上掛著一串串像小米一样黄色的小花苞，又过一段时间，黄色花苞都炸开，变成了一串串小黃花，長这么一把年纪，没見过葡萄开花是什么样，这次记录見証了全过程，拍下照片做纪念，只等秋后葡萄丰收。有朋友来访，我家先生都骄傲地向朋友展示，自家后院的棵棵果树。半月前有朋友一家来访，说起了各自家后院的果树。朋友家也有一棵葡萄树，也结了不少葡萄，可是葡萄引来了许多飞鸟，把剛一发红的葡萄都啄吃了，他家的女主人，为防鸟儿啄吃，用塑料袋套起来。他们家葡萄的遭遇，提醒了我们。第二天早晨，打开后院大门，鸟儿的欢快叫声不绝於耳，慌忙走到葡萄架四周一看，我那串串可爱的葡萄，尤其垂在最下边的葡萄，有好几串遭到小飞鸟的偷袭，小小的红葡萄只留下一层薄皮，甜美的葡萄汁成了飞鸟的早餐。 为了保证自家葡萄的平安生長，先生和我共同商议办法。防止小鸟啄食葡萄的唯一办法，就是用尼龙网把整个葡萄架复盖起来，这可是个大工程。方法决定后，说干就干马上行动。找出去年为枣树架网的旧尼龙网，从上到四周都复盖起来，有间隙的地方用线联起来，保証小鸟钻不进网内。感觉万无一失后，回到房内通过玻璃窗观察一切动静。不一会有几只小鸟从不同方向朝网撞去，撞到网后扑扑楞楞飞起来，打个转后又向网撞去，又被尼龙网挡住，几个来回都不能飞进网内，站在墙头向葡萄架张望，并叽叽喳喳地叫个不仃停。突然看到一只小鸟，不知从何处钻进网内，在网内撞来撞去就是飞不出去，也顾不上啄吃葡萄，我马上去后院看个究竟，就在这时看见小鸟从南边的网隙中飞了出去，我们爬上梯子仔细检查，发現有一处地方没有缝合好，让小鸟钻了空子，等把这南边的缝合处仔细又缝合一遍，这样处理以后，小鸟们几次试图闯进尼龙网而不能成功，从此，小鸟们好像会传递信息，再也没有小鸟光顾葡萄架，一个早晨的人与鸟较量，以人胜鸟而告终。我们家的葡萄保住了！ 有一首歌是这样唱得： 野地的花，穿着美麗的衣裳， 天空的鸟儿从来不为生活忙， 慈爱的天父天天都看顾， 祂更爱世上人，为他们预备永生的路。 一切需要，天父都知道 若心中烦恼，让祂为你除掉， 慈爱的天父天天都看顾， 祂是全能的主，信靠祂的人真是有福。 无論是人还是其它一切动、植物，都是创造宇宙万物的上帝所创造，大有权柄、荣耀、万能的上帝为世人预备好了一切，無价而宝贵的十字架救恩，也为世人预备好。〝你若口里认耶稣为主，心里信 神叫他从死里复活，就必得救。因为人心里相信，就可以称义，口里承认，就可以得救。經上说『凡信他的人，必不至於羞愧。』〞（罗马书10:9～11）您現在知道，耶稣基督曾为您死，让您信靠他得永生，您愿意現在请他进入您心，作您个人的救主吗？
79189078d309f197191636c35867503f6f489c8a.translatedText: Phoenix City Fengming: Birds and Grapes Two years ago, a grape vine was planted in my backyard. My husband enthusiastically built a beautiful, strong and strong grape trellis, waiting for the harvest of grapes in the fall. Disappointingly, there was a small bunch of grapes the first year but no fruit. A bunch of grapes also grew in the second year, but they did not bear fruit, so my hope was somewhat slim. This spring, I suddenly discovered that there were bunches of small yellow flower buds like millet hanging on the grape branches. After a while, the yellow flower buds exploded and turned into bunches of small yellow flowers. I have never seen what grapes bloom like in such a long time. This time I recorded and witnessed the whole process and took photos as a souvenir, just waiting for the grape harvest in autumn. When friends come to visit, my husband proudly shows them the fruit trees in his backyard. Half a month ago, a friend's family came to visit and they talked about the fruit trees in their backyards. A friend's house also had a grape tree that produced a lot of grapes, but the grapes attracted many birds and ate all the grapes that had just turned red. The hostess of his house covered it with a plastic bag to prevent the birds from eating it. What happened to their grapes reminds us. The next morning, when I opened the backyard door, I could hear the cheerful chirping of birds. I hurriedly walked around the grape trellis and took a look. I saw that several of my lovely bunches of grapes, especially the grapes hanging at the bottom, had been attacked by small flying birds. Only a thin layer of skin was left on the small red grapes, and the sweet grape juice became the birds' breakfast. In order to ensure the safe growth of our own grapes, my husband and I discussed ways together. The only way to prevent birds from pecking the grapes is to cover the entire grape trellis with nylon netting, which is a big project. After deciding on the method, just do it and take action immediately. Find out the old nylon net that was used to net the jujube trees last year, cover it from top to bottom, and connect the gaps with threads to ensure that birds cannot get into the net. After feeling that everything is safe, go back to the room and observe everything going on through the glass window. After a while, several birds hit the net from different directions. After hitting the net, they fluttered and flew up. They turned around and then hit the net again. They were blocked by the nylon net. After several back and forth, they could not fly into the net. They stood on the wall and looked at the grape trellis, and kept chirping. Suddenly I saw a little bird, which got into the net from nowhere. It was bumping around in the net but couldn't fly out, and couldn't care about pecking the grapes. I immediately went to the backyard to take a look. At this moment, I saw the little bird fly out from the gap in the net on the south side. We climbed up the ladder to check carefully and found that there was a place that was not sewn properly. , let the birds take advantage of the loophole, and then carefully sewed the southern seam again. After doing this, the birds tried to break into the nylon net several times but failed. From then on, the birds seemed to be able to pass on the message, and no birds visited the grape trellis again. One morning's contest between humans and birds ended with humans defeating birds. Our grapes are saved! There is a song that goes like this: The flowers in the field are dressed in beautiful clothes. The birds in the sky are never busy with life. The loving Heavenly Father takes care of them every day. He loves the people in the world even more and prepares the way to eternal life for them. Heavenly Father knows all your needs. If you have troubles in your heart, let Him remove them for you. Our loving Heavenly Father takes care of you every day. He is the Almighty Lord. Those who trust Him are truly blessed. Both humans and all other animals and plants were created by God, who created the universe. The powerful, glorious, and almighty God has prepared everything for the world. The priceless and precious salvation of the cross has also been prepared for the world. "If you confess with your mouth that Jesus is Lord and believe in your heart that God raised him from the dead, you will be saved. For if you believe with your heart you will be justified, and if you confess with your mouth you will be saved. The Bible says, 'Whoever believes in him will not be ashamed.'" (Romans 10:9-11) You now know that Jesus Christ died for you so that you can trust him for eternal life. Are you willing to invite him into your heart now to be your personal savior?

China has surpassed India for two consecutive years and has become the largest source country of international students in the United States. Have been engaged in...

2f3ff9b8a4613ff1c3edb5dcf298388f9f043550.sourceText: 误区一：找什么工作就选什么专业 据史丹利介绍，美国的教育体系和中国有区别。本科阶段，美国教育体系的目的是”修身”，让学生懂得如何去学习，如何协作、与人相处等等；针对工作的学习是研究生阶段的任务。 这与中国留学生的心理预期不同。北京市高一学生小叶正在备战”美国高考”，她出国留学是为了将来回国能找个好工作。对于本科专业的选择，小叶刚开始想学音乐，后来觉得不容易就业，又想转向物理。 小叶的想法代表了一部分准备出国的高中生。他们认为，在选择美国大学的本科专业时，将来想从事什么工作，就应该选什么专业。 史丹利告诉记者，这与美国本科阶段教育的初衷是背离的。’我们不想在本科阶段培养一些只知道怎么按按钮、让机器运作起来的大学生。”史丹利建议，本科阶段专业的选择应该考虑两点，自己擅长做什么和喜欢做什么。对于擅长做的事情，学习起来不会很难，容易建立自信；而对于喜欢做的事情，会有学习的动力。
2f3ff9b8a4613ff1c3edb5dcf298388f9f043550.translatedText: >Myth 1: Choose whatever major you want to find a job. According to Stanley, the education system in the United States is different from that in China. At the undergraduate level, the purpose of the American education system is to "cultivate self-cultivation" so that students know how to learn, how to collaborate, get along with others, etc.; work-oriented learning is a task at the graduate level. This is different from the psychological expectations of Chinese international students. Xiaoye, a first-year high school student in Beijing, is preparing for the "American College Entrance Examination". She is studying abroad so that she can find a good job when she returns to China in the future. Regarding the choice of undergraduate major, Xiaoye initially wanted to study music, but later found it difficult to find a job and wanted to switch to physics. Xiaoye's thoughts represent some high school students who are preparing to go abroad. They believe that when choosing an undergraduate major in an American university, you should choose whatever major you want to work in in the future. Stanley told reporters that this is contrary to the original intention of undergraduate education in the United States. ’ We don’t want to produce undergraduates who just know how to push buttons and make machines work. "Stanley suggested that you should consider two points when choosing a major at the undergraduate level, what you are good at and what you like to do. For things you are good at, it will not be difficult to learn and it is easy to build confidence; and for things you like to do, you will have the motivation to learn.

2033db03e4be4216837b9b94903a486c94651361.sourceText: 误区二：到美国再学英语 很多家长和学生认为，就是因为英文不好，才想去留学。在中国只要掌握英语的应试能力就可以了，到美国再深造。 ”英语能力弱，直接决定着课堂接受能力差。”史丹利说，”这可能导致留学生从一开始就失去学习的信心。”
2033db03e4be4216837b9b94903a486c94651361.translatedText: Misunderstanding 2: Learn English in the United States. Many parents and students think that it is because English is not good that they want to study abroad. In China, you only need to master the test-taking skills in English and further study in the United States. "Weak English ability directly determines poor receptive ability in the classroom. "This may cause international students to lose confidence in learning from the beginning," Stanley said. "

8580634b8c6c48eaa76f49fbcc00d1c5942f2119.sourceText: 误区三：先生活后读书 一些留学生初到美国之后，忙于跟大家聚会，享受快乐。史丹利提醒，美国大学的课程是非常密集和紧张的，一步落下，步步落后。有的留学生可能在一开始落下了步子，就再也没有机会追上课程进度了。因此，对于课程的学习一定要启动快，切勿先生活后读书。
8580634b8c6c48eaa76f49fbcc00d1c5942f2119.translatedText: Misunderstanding 3: Live first and then study. After arriving in the United States for the first time, some international students are busy gathering with everyone and having fun. Stanley reminded that the courses in American universities are very intensive and intense. If you fall behind every step, you will fall behind step by step. Some international students may fall behind at the beginning and never have the chance to catch up with the progress of the course. Therefore, you must start learning the course quickly, and do not live first and then study.

e8ac1a86e641fc5b6a73ce5467f8a0d3a4ca66ff.translatedText: The Pew Hispanic Center pointed out that as many as 1.7 million people are eligible for the federal government's new temporary program. Qualified illegal immigrants can apply for work permits, Social Security cards and driver's licenses.

9d71c415deaf527d8215f521b0ddba45bf45adba.sourceText: 欧巴马政府开放儿时抵美的移民申请延后驱逐出境，部分符合资格的年轻非法移民至少2年内不会被驱逐出境。官员估计，亚利桑那州有8万非法移民符合申请资格。

97d01881d7207872acd48ddfb16de480aaf70ed5.sourceText: （本网讯）4月11日在红宝石酒家迎来了200多位法律界的嘉宾，他们身着盛装参加亚利桑那第十七届亚裔法律协会奖学金颁奖与筹款晚宴。协会主席康明义，亚省首位华裔女法官邓周雅定，华裔律师戴学正，黄秀丽，伍兆文等都来到现场为亚裔法律学子们祝贺。
97d01881d7207872acd48ddfb16de480aaf70ed5.translatedText: (News from this website) More than 200 guests from the legal profession were welcomed at the Ruby Restaurant on April 11. They dressed up to attend the 17th Arizona Asian Law Association Scholarship Awards and Fundraising Dinner. Association Chairman Kang Mingyi, Alberta's first Chinese female judge Deng Zhouyading, Chinese lawyers Dai Xuezheng, Huang Xiuli, Wu Zhaowen, etc. all came to the scene to congratulate the Asian law students.

9278eb3600be3a7cd76535127771a4b8f5a79ee6.sourceText: 晚上7时晚宴正式开始，主席康明义首先欢迎各位法律界人士的光临。他用辩证的逻辑给大家介绍了亚裔法律协会在行业中的角色。他说我们在亚利桑那，很多人把华裔，印度裔当做少数民族，这么说没有错，但是转换一个全球的视野，华裔，印度裔就要大的族裔。多数和少数只是一个相对的概念，而亚裔法律协会并不是一个少数族裔的组织，它是一个以一个宽容的理念，接受民族多元化的组织。不管你是不是亚裔只要接受多元化的民族概念，都能让我们在一起共同工作，共同开拓市场。
9278eb3600be3a7cd76535127771a4b8f5a79ee6.translatedText: The dinner officially started at 7pm. Chairman Kang Mingyi first welcomed all the legal professionals. He used dialectical logic to introduce the role of the Asian Legal Association in the industry. He said that in Arizona, many people regard Chinese and Indians as ethnic minorities. This is not wrong, but from a global perspective, Chinese and Indians are the largest ethnic groups. Majority and minority are just relative concepts, and the Asian Law Association is not an organization of ethnic minorities. It is an organization that accepts ethnic diversity with a tolerant concept. Regardless of whether you are Asian or not, as long as you accept the concept of diverse ethnic groups, we can work together and develop markets together.

4c18e491a194d3c01bd4cb184b92e4e7dfb62b96.sourceText: 每年亚裔法律协会都会延续一个作风，请到很特别的主讲嘉宾，去年是华裔神探李昌钰先生的精彩演讲。今年请到了朝鲜的问题专家麦克金先生（Mike Kim）。金先生经常是CNN，BBC讨论朝鲜问题的座上宾。他的书《逃出朝鲜》，讲述了2003年他放弃美国的经济支柱，离开中国，住在朝鲜边境，帮助很多朝鲜人逃离朝鲜到中国避难的经历。他为朝鲜难民提供很多人道主义的救援。金先生特别强调对朝鲜女性的逃离和保护工作。其中当然也有亲眼看到的妇女被贩卖的经历。他希望更多的国际组织能加入到人道主义救援工作中去。金先生书中反应了救助的过程，同时也最最真实的体现了朝鲜局势。他带来三本书进行现场拍卖，拍卖所得作为亚裔法律协会的助学金。现场来宾慷慨解囊，每本书都以超过120美元的价格成功售出。
4c18e491a194d3c01bd4cb184b92e4e7dfb62b96.translatedText: Every year, the Asian Legal Association continues its tradition of inviting a very special guest speaker. Last year, it was Mr. Li Changyu, a Chinese-American detective who gave a wonderful speech. This year we invited Mr. Mike Kim, an expert on North Korea. Mr. Kim is a frequent guest on CNN and the BBC discussing North Korea. His book "Escape from North Korea" tells the story of his experience in giving up his economic support in the United States in 2003, leaving China, living on the border of North Korea, and helping many North Koreans escape North Korea and seek refuge in China. He provided many humanitarian aids to North Korean refugees. Mr. Kim placed special emphasis on the escape and protection of North Korean women. Of course, there are also personal experiences of women being trafficked. He hopes that more international organizations can join in humanitarian relief work. Mr. Jin’s book reflects the rescue process and also reflects the situation in North Korea in the most realistic way. He brought three books for a live auction, and the proceeds were used as bursaries for the Asian Law Association. Guests donated generously, and each book was successfully sold for more than $120.

108e999b538a98ea922b9a0d9ef5e84f21bfa512.sourceText: 奥巴马移民新政是福是祸? 《时代》周刊撰文称，奥巴马的移民新政是不是真的可以为非法移民带来曙光?文章称，暂缓递解法自然是令非法移民喜出望外。对于他们来说，这意味着迈开了未来成为美国公民的第一步。那些从小就来到美国的非法移民终于有机会追寻大多数美国人认为理所当然的目标，如申请一份正式工作，自由旅行，并获得驾驶执照。而工作收入可以帮助他们读完大学。拥有高等学位。那些因为不能合法工作，只能从事低端非正式工作的人，将可以寻找更好的工作。 不过，总统的新政仍有很多不确定性因素。首先，美国公民及移民局表示：如果申请人没有被定重罪或重大轻罪，并且对（国家安全）不构成威胁，则申请会被考虑。但目前还不清楚官员所说的”重大”和 ”威胁”是指那些。所以曾经触犯过法律的人不敢确定申请是否会给他们带来麻烦。因为移民局会分享申请人的信息。人权团体敦促那些有疑问的申请人咨询律师，但不是每个人都能支付得起律师费用。 另外，政府的这一政策为期2年，并没有说是否还会延续。这种不确定性令非法移民有几种猜测：一，共和党总统候选人罗姆尼，被认为对非法移民并不友好，如在选举中获胜，可能决定不再延长该计划。二，即使奥巴马连任，政府可能会作出同样的决定。最后，华盛顿可以提前结束该计划。如果是这样的话，那些申请者很容易成为被驱逐出境的目标，因为政府有他们的指纹和个人信息。 怀着诸多期待和疑虑，洛杉矶人道移民权利联盟接到许多询问电话，常见问题诸如：如果申请被拒，是否会被遣返？什么情况下，申请不被接受？有的年轻非法移民的家长被美国遣返后再次潜入美国。他们担心申请会让家人面临被遣返的威胁。 不过，尽管存在风险，许多年轻人决定申请。他们相信政府不会在两年后结束这项计划，把已经对美国经济有所贡献的人遣返出境。 另外，已经有州出现了对申请暂缓递解移民的敌对情绪。哥伦比亚广播公司称，星期三，亚利桑那州州长签署行政命令，指示州各部门不能向通过暂缓递解方式获得工作许可的工作移民颁发驾照。州长布鲁尔说：”联邦政策并没有承认这些移民的合法地位，我将遵照当前移民法精神不给予这些人公共福利。” 根据奥巴马颁布的新的行政命令，幼年（16岁或者更年轻）来美，在美国居住五年以上，但没有合法身分的在学、高中毕业及光荣退役人士可以申请暂缓递解。被判有重罪的人士没有资格申请暂缓递解。 布鲁尔的发言人在接受采访使称：”布鲁尔的命令意在缓解暂缓递解令带来的混乱局面，国土安全部一再表示，这些人没有合法的地位，””他们可以留着美国，不被驱逐和起诉，但法律不承认他们的合法性。” 亚利桑那州《梦想法案》联盟称，布鲁尔的命令旨在欺凌手无寸铁的年轻人。联盟主席杜塞尔称：”他们感到难过的是布鲁尔依旧保持过去的立场，违背《梦想法案》精神，与年轻人作对。”
108e999b538a98ea922b9a0d9ef5e84f21bfa512.translatedText: Is Obama's New Immigration Deal a blessing or a curse? "Time" magazine wrote an article saying, can Obama's new immigration policy really bring hope to illegal immigrants? The article said that the temporary suspension of deportation law will naturally make illegal immigrants overjoyed. For them, this means taking the first step toward becoming U.S. citizens. Undocumented immigrants who came to the United States as children finally have a chance to pursue goals that most Americans take for granted, such as applying for a regular job, traveling freely, and getting a driver's license. And the income from work can help them through college. Have an advanced degree. Those who are stuck in low-end informal jobs because they cannot work legally will be able to look for better jobs. However, there are still many uncertainties about the president's new deal. First, USCIS said: Applications will be considered if the applicant has not been convicted of a felony or significant misdemeanor and does not pose a threat (to national security). But it's unclear what officials mean by "significant" and "threat." So people who have had trouble with the law are unsure whether applying will get them into trouble. Because the immigration office will share the applicant’s information. Human rights groups urge applicants with questions to consult a lawyer, but not everyone can afford one. In addition, the government's policy lasts for two years and has not said whether it will continue. This uncertainty has led to several speculations by illegal immigrants: First, Republican presidential candidate Mitt Romney, who is considered unfriendly to illegal immigrants, may decide not to extend the program if he wins the election. Second, even if Obama is re-elected, the government may make the same decision. Finally, Washington could end the program early. If so, those applicants would be easy targets for deportation because the government has their fingerprints and personal information. With many expectations and doubts, the Humane Immigrant Rights Alliance of Los Angeles received many inquiries. Common questions include: If the application is rejected, will I be deported? Under what circumstances will an application not be accepted? Some young illegal immigrants whose parents were deported from the United States sneaked into the United States again. They fear applying would put their families at risk of deportation. But despite the risks, many young people decide to apply. They believe the government will not end the program after two years and deport people who have contributed to the U.S. economy. In addition, some states have become hostile to immigrants applying for a stay of deportation. CBS said that on Wednesday, the governor of Arizona signed an executive order instructing state departments not to issue driver's licenses to working immigrants who have obtained work permits through the suspension of deportation. Governor Brewer said: "Federal policy does not recognize the legal status of these immigrants, and I will follow the spirit of current immigration laws and not grant public benefits to these people." According to Obama's new executive order, people who came to the United States as children (16 years old or younger) and have lived in the United States for more than five years, but without legal status, are in school, high school graduates, and honorably discharged persons can apply for withholding of deportation. People who have been convicted of a felony are not eligible to apply for deferred action. Brewer's spokesperson said in an interview: "Brewer's order is intended to alleviate the chaos caused by the suspension of deportation orders. The Department of Homeland Security has repeatedly stated that these people have no legal status. "They can stay in the United States without being deported and prosecuted, but the law does not recognize their legality." The Arizona "Dream Act" coalition said that Brewer's order is intended to bully defenseless young people. Alliance President Dussel said: "They are sad that Brewer still maintains his past stance, violates the spirit of the Dream Act, and goes against young people."

76e719f561ad11748dcd172247640d3d0d92cb28.translatedText: US media: Chinese homeowners are far less wealthy than they think.

becd9832de43d622cb26cd6d91e5c35552da413e.translatedText: US media: Chinese homeowners are far less wealthy than they think. According to "Reference News", American media believe that there are many empty houses in Chinese cities, where people live in...

8ef349e69003fe840fecaff2c0f1363ee2282385.sourceText: 美国《福布斯》双周刊网站10月28日文章题：在中国，没有一座城市没有可怕的大片空房。
8ef349e69003fe840fecaff2c0f1363ee2282385.translatedText: The title of the October 28 article on the US "Forbes" biweekly website: In China, there is no city without terrible tracts of empty houses.

9ed694fe004ec7288c7e141be52a53eead7b6e7e.sourceText: 在中国，现实和经济分析似乎相差得太远。但是，鉴于中国政府内部在经济数据与投资推广之间存在的混乱，在”经济是否在增长”这样简单的问题上出现分化可能也是不可避免的。
9ed694fe004ec7288c7e141be52a53eead7b6e7e.translatedText: In China, reality and economic analysis seem too far apart. But given the confusion within the Chinese government between economic data and investment promotion, divisions over something as simple as whether the economy is growing may be inevitable.

4426fa20afc3d087d2ca6827484be50233d48c33.sourceText: 《华尔街日报》在最近一篇报道中写道：”目前在北京和上海这样的大城市，存在住房供应短缺的状况，这就导致房地产价格迅速上涨。”而路透社则写下了这样的句子：”中国需要更多住房。”对我们当中的一些人来说，这几乎是不可理解的。我们的所见所闻与此截然不同。
4426fa20afc3d087d2ca6827484be50233d48c33.translatedText: The Wall Street Journal wrote in a recent report: "There is currently a shortage of housing supply in big cities like Beijing and Shanghai, which has caused real estate prices to rise rapidly." And Reuters wrote this sentence: "China needs more housing." For some of us, this is almost incomprehensible. What we saw and heard was nothing like that.

8c602f002ba18b235e0d2dec90615a9152de9cae.sourceText: 过去两年我不停地在中国各地旅行，我可以说从未见过一座城市、城镇或村庄没有大片空房。一位曾两次行走约1500公里的同事说，他没有一次看不到成片的空房。在北边，与西伯利亚接壤的满洲里决定成为旅游胜地，建造了成千上万座空荡荡的别墅。在南方，一位同事在云南山区拍摄的视频中，连续15分钟都是空空如也的高楼。在北京的南四环和上海的浦东和徐汇区，也有成片成片堪比鬼城的小区。
8c602f002ba18b235e0d2dec90615a9152de9cae.translatedText: I have been traveling non-stop throughout China for the past two years and I can say that I have never seen a city, town or village without large tracts of empty houses. A colleague who has traveled about 1,500 kilometers twice said that there was never a time when he saw empty houses. To the north, Manzhouli, on the border with Siberia, decided to become a tourist destination and thousands of empty villas were built. In the south, a video taken by a colleague in the mountains of Yunnan showed empty high-rise buildings for 15 consecutive minutes. In Beijing's South Fourth Ring Road and Shanghai's Pudong and Xuhui districts, there are also clusters of communities that are comparable to ghost towns.

c9b2028215cc24db88298660411199f1894784be.sourceText: 根据中国政府2010年的报告，当时中国的住房自有率接近90%。世界平均水平为63%，美国为65%。报告还指出15%的中国人拥有不止一处房产。
c9b2028215cc24db88298660411199f1894784be.translatedText: According to a 2010 Chinese government report, China's home ownership rate was close to 90% at that time. The world average is 63% and the United States is 65%. The report also pointed out that 15% of Chinese people own more than one property.

658b079ec997cc045c389a1d10ffb2f51d0ead35.sourceText: 总的来说，城市越小，拥有多套住房的比例就越高。在河北省一个中等城市，当地一开发商说，那里的住房自有率高达200%。辽宁锦州一个开发商说，该市至少一半人口拥有多套住房。许多城市的白领，尤其是银行、金融和房地产行业的白领通常有四五套住房。
658b079ec997cc045c389a1d10ffb2f51d0ead35.translatedText: In general, the smaller the city, the higher the proportion of multiple housing units. In a medium-sized city in Hebei Province, a local developer said the home ownership rate there is as high as 200%. A developer in Jinzhou, Liaoning, said at least half of the city's population owns multiple housing units. White-collar workers in many cities, especially those in banking, finance and real estate industries, usually own four or five houses.

3d39f391c64b467f2a2a3846bbbb7132bcb86bff.sourceText: 现在，住房供应严重过剩。而房价也在趋同，大致在每平方米5000元至1万元之间，具体取决于房子的豪华程度，但与什么城市及当地的平均收入无关。河北一个贫穷的小城市房价达到每平方米1万元，跟沈阳和哈尔滨等相对富有的城市房价差不多。
3d39f391c64b467f2a2a3846bbbb7132bcb86bff.translatedText: Right now, there is a serious oversupply of housing. House prices are also converging, ranging from RMB 5,000 to RMB 10,000 per square meter, depending on the luxury of the house, but it has nothing to do with the city or the local average income. Housing prices in a small, poor city in Hebei reach 10,000 yuan per square meter, which is similar to housing prices in relatively wealthy cities such as Shenyang and Harbin.

f15cab7f9ed59f66ad6979410903ff15fca676b8.sourceText: 这并不意味着在中国，住房已经成为新型可交易商品，就像手表和珠宝一样。人们买了房子往往空着，因为出租会使住房贬值。
f15cab7f9ed59f66ad6979410903ff15fca676b8.translatedText: This does not mean that housing has become a new tradable commodity in China, like watches and jewelry. People buy homes and often leave them empty because renting out devalues ​​the home.

7c982b26e39b694116c5a3b8cd4acf930e434ba5.sourceText: 问题在于，房主们大多不知道他们坐拥的房产根本不值房子的报价。所以他们远远不像自己认为的那么富有。
7c982b26e39b694116c5a3b8cd4acf930e434ba5.translatedText: The problem is that most homeowners have no idea that the property they are sitting on is simply not worth the asking price. So they are nowhere near as wealthy as they think they are.

df65b9636fd518de11d51c33e63fa04a195adcb2.sourceText: 州长道格杜西昨日（3月19日）下令所有建筑物的旗帜降到一半，直到3月22日日落，以纪念3月16日亚特兰大市区8名受害者的枪击事件。
df65b9636fd518de11d51c33e63fa04a195adcb2.translatedText: Governor Doug Ducey yesterday (March 19) ordered flags on all buildings to be lowered to half-staff until sunset on March 22 to commemorate the shootings of eight victims in downtown Atlanta on March 16.

0a169ade3c60578a7a2cf7549886e0f66c9da597.sourceText: 杜西州长说：“本周，有8人死于一场毫无意义和令人发指的暴力行为。他认为这次袭击是可憎的，亚利桑那州和亚特兰大会站在同一条战线上。他说：“我们向亚特兰大社区和受害者的亲人致以祈祷和最深切的慰问。我已经下令降半旗，以纪念八名无辜的生命。”
0a169ade3c60578a7a2cf7549886e0f66c9da597.translatedText: Governor Ducey said: "This week, eight people died in a senseless and heinous act of violence. He believes that the attack was abhorrent, and Arizona and Atlanta stand together." He said: "We send our prayers and deepest condolences to the Atlanta community and the victims' loved ones." I have ordered flags to be flown at half-staff to honor the eight innocent lives lost. "

d0c7c9e9c7278722160a1d3e7595afc1327c8227.sourceText: 州长的降半旗命令与拜登总统的声明相协调。
d0c7c9e9c7278722160a1d3e7595afc1327c8227.translatedText: The Governor’s order to lower flags to half-staff is coordinated with President Biden’s statement.

54e0c0b928499ca8427229ecd983526020dc1198.sourceText: 台湾赠送大陆的梅花鹿”繁星””点点”和长鬃山羊”喜羊羊””乐羊羊”顺利度过隔离检疫期后，２８日正式和游客见面。
54e0c0b928499ca8427229ecd983526020dc1198.translatedText: Taiwan presented mainland China's sika deer "Fanxing" and "Diandian" and long-maned goats "Pleasant Goat" and "Le Sheep". After successfully passing the quarantine period, they officially met with tourists on the 28th.

54bcfaac9dd0805b422eb93b28fee775eedc148d.sourceText: 记者２８日上午在位于威海刘公岛国家森林公园的梅花鹿馆和长鬃山羊馆看到，雄性梅花鹿”繁星”昂首阔步，徜徉在室外场馆，”点点”则在后面亦步亦趋，十分恩爱。长鬃山羊”喜羊羊”和”乐羊羊”则比较”害羞”，大部分时间躲在假山和树阴后，远远打量着游人。
54bcfaac9dd0805b422eb93b28fee775eedc148d.translatedText: On the morning of the 28th, reporters saw the male sika deer "Stars" strutting around in the outdoor venues at the Sika Deer Hall and Long-maned Goat Hall located in Liugong Island National Forest Park in Weihai, while "Diandian" followed suit behind, very affectionate. The long-maned goats "Pleasant Goat" and "Le Sheep Goat" are relatively "shy" and spend most of their time hiding behind rockeries and shade trees, watching tourists from a distance.

1651110d69ee53fe9fbb6b583e17c4807e9e1e84.sourceText: 据刘公岛管委会主任袁学恩介绍，经过一个月的隔离检验检疫和十几天的户外适应，目前两对”宝贝”已经基本适应了在威海的新家，各种生活状态达到在台湾时的水平。
1651110d69ee53fe9fbb6b583e17c4807e9e1e84.translatedText: According to Yuan Xuen, director of the Liugong Island Administrative Committee, after one month of isolation, inspection and quarantine and more than ten days of outdoor adaptation, the two pairs of "babies" have basically adapted to their new home in Weihai, and their living conditions have reached the same level as in Taiwan.

ecce74f016ec7d97d179f7f96d41071cc024832e.sourceText: 台湾同胞赠送大陆同胞的两只梅花鹿和两只长鬃山羊于４月１６日从台北抵达位于威海刘公岛的新家。
ecce74f016ec7d97d179f7f96d41071cc024832e.translatedText: Two sika deer and two long-maned goats presented by Taiwan compatriots to mainland compatriots arrived at their new home on Liugong Island, Weihai from Taipei on April 16.

f77c323533ff4a17f82befb59bb1b2416161fa42.sourceText: 2015年3月21日上午，贵州民族大学传媒学院院长颜春龙拜访亚省华人媒体，并与”太阳鸟”亚利桑那华人网的负责人谢成彦，就新媒体的发展方向和盈利模式进行了探讨。
f77c323533ff4a17f82befb59bb1b2416161fa42.translatedText: On the morning of March 21, 2015, Yan Chunlong, dean of the School of Communication at Guizhou University for Nationalities, visited the Chinese media in Arizona and discussed with Xie Chengyan, the head of the "Sunbird" Arizona Chinese Network, the development direction and profit model of new media.

c6a93c51395ad04ca9941ef1e4d84aa1ad2717cb.sourceText: 颜院长肯定了”太阳鸟”亚利桑那华人网的定位，抓住亚利桑那当地特色，打造当地新媒体品牌。他强调传递独特的新闻内容是非常重要的。传统的广告收入，已经不再是新媒体的主要收入。为客户牵线搭桥，帮助他们创收，打造客户的品牌影响力，将使新媒体的盈利点大大增加，很有发展前景。颜院长在纽约做访问学者，在一个多月的时间里，他从美国的北部到南部沿路驱车，拜访了各地的华文媒体，收集了大量美国华人媒体第一手资料。
c6a93c51395ad04ca9941ef1e4d84aa1ad2717cb.translatedText: Dean Yan affirmed the positioning of "Sunbird" Arizona Chinese Network, grasping the local characteristics of Arizona and building a local new media brand. He emphasized the importance of delivering unique news content. Traditional advertising revenue is no longer the main revenue source of new media. Connecting customers, helping them generate income, and building their brand influence will greatly increase the profit points of new media and have great development prospects. Dean Yan was a visiting scholar in New York. For more than a month, he drove from the north to the south of the United States, visited Chinese media in various places, and collected a large amount of first-hand information on Chinese media in the United States.

d7812ff381935a95d2c04e39cf593a4ceffa7be7.sourceText: 颜院长就高校如何与海外媒体合作，建立实践基地，提高华文媒体世界影响力等方面提出了自己的独到见解。
d7812ff381935a95d2c04e39cf593a4ceffa7be7.translatedText: > Dean Yan put forward his unique insights on how universities can cooperate with overseas media, establish practice bases, and improve the influence of Chinese media in the world.

d5f863f9f6d0c1d459705c430de142a6c4585c5c.sourceText: ”今奇貓”在当今画坛被广为肯定：当代著名画家范曾：”神猫异趣，于今称奇！”。著名画家韩美林则在赠送今奇先生的一幅同题材作品的落款中自谦”今奇老师法正厖美林不敢弄斧”。国画大师李可染： ”小猫眼里有大世界”。趙樸初简言定位：”精纯到前无古人”。启功谈今奇艺术：”奇、奇。名符其实”。文坛巨星冰心的评语是：猫咪造型的概括力，”超然物外”。老舍夫人胡絜青毎次谈到今奇猫：”绝啦！”日本人十分重视收藏”今奇猫”，日本驻中国大使中江要介说：”今奇猫”：”有一种吸引人的魔力，百看不生厌”。日本《朝日新闻》称之为”寓意深刻，光彩照人”。总之，”今奇猫”画出了猫的灵魂，输入了人的精神。”今奇猫”多次获奖，在国际上颇负盛誉， 曾被《人民日报》、《世界日报》、《亚利桑那共和报》和多家电视台，以及欧洲一些国家和日本新闻媒体争先报道。他的学生遍及欧亚十八国。
d5f863f9f6d0c1d459705c430de142a6c4585c5c.translatedText: "Today's Wonderful Cat" is widely recognized in today's painting circles: The famous contemporary painter Fan Zeng said: "The magical cat is strangely interesting, and is now called a wonder!". The famous painter Han Meilin modestly signed a work of the same theme as a gift to Mr. Jinqi, saying "Jinqi's teacher Fazheng Pang Meilin did not dare to use an axe." Li Keran, a master of traditional Chinese painting: "There is a big world in the eyes of a kitten." Zhao Puchu briefly stated his positioning: "It is so pure that no one has ever done it before." Qi Gong talks about today's strange art: "Strange, strange. It lives up to its name." Literary superstar Bing Xin commented: The summarizing power of the cat shape is "transcendental". Lao She’s wife, Hu Jieqing, always talked about Jinqi Mao: “It’s amazing!” The Japanese attach great importance to collecting “Kinqi Cat”. Japanese Ambassador to China Kaname Nakae said: “Kinqi Cat” has an attractive magic power that never gets tired of it. Japan's "Asahi Shimbun" called it "profound and dazzling". In short, "Jinqi Cat" depicts the soul of the cat and imports the human spirit. "Jinqi Cat" has won many awards and is well-known internationally. It has been reported by "People's Daily", "World Journal", "Arizona Republic" and many TV stations, as well as some European countries and Japanese news media. His students spread across eighteen countries in Europe and Asia.

Members of the Phoenix Chinese School Student Representative Association held a small gratitude celebration for the teachers of the Chinese school to thank the teachers for their teaching and hard work.

f69104ed3ff2773b2792d43c29a6efe2cbe57412.translatedText: The chairman of the Student Representative Association thanked the teachers for their hard work

9f18be56d892c4ab8b5b3f9cb90044113008fe0e.sourceText: 在教师节的前三週，学生代联会成员们先到各个班级，请学生们说几句对老师感谢的话语，并用手机录影下来。之后学生代联会会长罗允伶把所有的录影编辑成完整的影片，准备在週日教师节当成一份惊喜礼物播放给老师们观赏。
9f18be56d892c4ab8b5b3f9cb90044113008fe0e.translatedText: Three weeks before Teachers' Day, members of the Student Representative Association first went to each class, asked the students to say a few words of gratitude to the teachers, and recorded them on their mobile phones. Later, Luo Yunling, the president of the Student Representatives Association, edited all the videos into a complete video, ready to be played as a surprise gift for the teachers on Teachers' Day on Sunday.

1241bb7fa44d9fe2bd0fb80f612d190d94297e00.sourceText: 老师们正在观看学生们制作的短片
1241bb7fa44d9fe2bd0fb80f612d190d94297e00.translatedText: Teachers are watching the short film made by students

3ee5177b8b5c654b6f9e7f27886d2103bedefa43.sourceText: 9月28日当天，校方请老师在上完课后移驾办公室。之后会场就开始播放製作好的学生感谢影片，现场并且准备美味蛋糕和星巴克咖啡供老师们享用。学生代联会会长还当场颁赠一份贴心小礼物- 星巴克咖啡礼卡，给每位在场的老师们。老师、学生和家长们聚在一起，聊天并享用甜点，大家都渡过了一个美好的下午时光。
3ee5177b8b5c654b6f9e7f27886d2103bedefa43.translatedText: On September 28, the school asked teachers to move to the office after class. Afterwards, the venue began to play the student thank-you video, and delicious cakes and Starbucks coffee were prepared for the teachers to enjoy. The president of the Student Representative Association also presented a thoughtful gift - a Starbucks coffee gift card to every teacher present. Teachers, students and parents gathered together to chat and enjoy desserts, and everyone had a wonderful afternoon.

15e60590ead7f8e3d139972a3958f3f746f6c78b.sourceText: 凤凰城中文学校学生代联会是凤凰城中文学校裡一个很特别的学生组织，成员包括会长、副会长、文书、秘书以及财务等职位，是由中文学校学生投票选出。每年学生代联会都会举办很多活动，例如义卖、募款、秋季烤肉设立游戏摊位、岁末募捐罐头到慈济等等的活动。学生除了来学校上中文课程，还可以学习当义工帮助别人，是个非常有义意的组织。
15e60590ead7f8e3d139972a3958f3f746f6c78b.translatedText: Phoenix Chinese School Student Representative Association is a very special student organization in Phoenix Chinese School. Its members include president, vice president, clerk, secretary and financial position. They are elected by votes of Chinese school students. Every year, the Student Generation Association holds many activities, such as charity sales, fund-raising, setting up game booths at autumn barbecues, end-of-year donations of cans to Tzu Chi, etc. In addition to taking Chinese courses at school, students can also learn to be volunteers to help others. It is a very meaningful organization.

There have been significantly fewer homes losing money in the greater Phoenix area. This is not unexpected at all, because there are a large number of bankrupt houses, and housing...

965b5df7726e5df150088e092a26e2e300cc6f0d.sourceText: 大凤凰城市区还有多少房子亏本？ 大凤凰城地区亏本的房子已经大大减少。这一点都不出乎预料，因为破产屋大量减少，房屋中值价格比去年上升了将近40%。 根据Zillow第三季度的报告，45.5%的房屋还是亏本，比第二季度的51.6%少了很多。 许多房地产分析员认为，Zillow的数字还是偏高，接近352，444的房主还是亏本。凤凰城亏损最多的地区是邮编为85043的地区。近74%的人贷款金额超过了房屋的价值。全美范围，30%的业主还是亏本。更多有关房地产的信息请咨询金信地产的Tinna (480)287-0180 E-mail:Goldtrustrealty2010@gmail.com
965b5df7726e5df150088e092a26e2e300cc6f0d.translatedText: How many houses are still losing money in the greater Phoenix area? There have been significantly fewer homes losing money in the greater Phoenix area. This is not unexpected at all, as there has been a significant decrease in bankruptcies and the median home price has increased by nearly 40% compared to last year. According to Zillow's third-quarter report, 45.5% of homes still lost money, down from 51.6% in the second quarter. Many real estate analysts believe Zillow's numbers are still on the high side, with nearly 352,444 homeowners still losing money. The area with the largest losses in Phoenix is ​​the 85043 ZIP code. Nearly 74% of people borrowed more than their home was worth. Nationwide, 30% of property owners are still losing money. For more information about real estate, please contact Tinna of Goldtrust Realty (480)287-0180 E-mail:Goldtrustrealty2010@gmail.com
