d2a8f67c84f3b474d21269adee69aff3cbaafcef.sourceText: [希望中文学校3/8/2015稿]春天来了，冰雪融化,道路开通，学校终于开学了。3月6日中国边远地区四川省色达县旭日乡中心小学好不热闹，今天这是他们开学的第一天,学校把学生集中在一起举行春季开学典礼。发放课本同时，还发放希望中文学校送去的爱心物资。其实这批物资在去年12月20号圣诞前就已经送到色达县了，原计划是作为圣诞礼物送给学生的,但是因为天气、道路等种种原因，学校在12月中已经放假了，就在开学前两天，3月4日丹达校长才在依旧寒冷的初春风雪中赶去县城里将最后一批愛心物资拉回学校，并刻意在开学的时候发送，告诉同学们，来自遥远的美国希望中文学校在新年开学之际为旭日小学送祝福，献爱心，以此鼓励学生新的一年里好好学习，天天向上。
d2a8f67c84f3b474d21269adee69aff3cbaafcef.translatedText: [Draft of Hope Chinese School 3/8/2015] Spring is here, the ice and snow have melted, the roads are open, and the school has finally started. On March 6, the Xuri Township Central Primary School in Seda County, Sichuan Province, a remote area of ​​China, was very busy. Today was their first day of school. The school gathered students together to hold a spring opening ceremony. At the same time as textbooks were distributed, charity supplies sent by Hope Chinese schools were also distributed. In fact, this batch of supplies was delivered to Seda County before Christmas on December 20 last year. It was originally planned to be given to students as Christmas gifts. However, due to various reasons such as weather and roads, the school was already on holiday in mid-December. Just two days before the start of school, Principal Danda arrived in the still cold weather on March 4. In the wind and snow in early spring, I rushed to the county town to bring the last batch of charity supplies back to the school, and deliberately sent them out at the beginning of school, telling the students that the Chinese school from the distant United States would send blessings and love to Rising Sun Primary School at the beginning of the new year, so as to encourage students to study hard in the new year and make progress every day.

20caecd3ad82844b79bf0f78fccabd80f6f7c2ef.sourceText: 在发送爱心礼物会上,每个学生手中都收到一张来自希望中文学校学生会制作的爱心卡,卡片里满载着希望中文学校对小朋友的节日问候和新年的祝福，还有希望学校师生捎来的冬衣,绒帽,钢笔,练习本等学习用品,收到礼物的小朋友都非常开心，脸上绽放出灿烂的微笑。丹达校长给我们发来了发放现场相片及代表学校和学生的感谢话语。看到相片,希望的师生心里不由得有种满足感，幸福感，自豪感，真是奉献爱心，收获快乐！我们的爱心活动不仅得到希望中文学校家长老师学生大力支持而且在准备物资和运送物资的过程中得到了国内许多认识和不认识朋友的支持, 意外收获了国内爱心接力, 爱心传递。
20caecd3ad82844b79bf0f78fccabd80f6f7c2ef.translatedText: At the love gift sending party, each student received a love card made by the Student Union of Hope Chinese School. The card was filled with holiday greetings and New Year blessings from Hope Chinese School to the children, as well as winter clothes, velvet hats, pens, exercise books and other school supplies sent by teachers and students of Hope School. The children who received the gifts were very happy, with bright smiles on their faces. Principal Danda sent us photos of the distribution site and words of thanks on behalf of the school and students. Seeing the photos, the teachers and students of Hope couldn't help but feel a sense of satisfaction, happiness, and pride. They really gave love and gained happiness! Our charity activities not only received strong support from parents, teachers and students of Hope Chinese School, but also received support from many domestic friends, both familiar and unknown, in the process of preparing and delivering supplies. We unexpectedly gained a domestic relay of love and the spread of love.

66599a5221a76de19fcc26f7ceb2bc232055fe43.sourceText: 这个由希望中文学校学生会发起的爱心行动,意将雪中送炭,扶贫帮困,助人为乐的中华传统美德和美国感恩节文化结合在一起，倡导同学们有一颗感恩之心，关爱之心，从去年十,十一月积极在校内展开了义卖及捐款筹款等系列活动, 十二月准备物资和运送物资, 到现在三月的物资发放,倾注了希望团队许多热情和心血,这次的爱心行动终于圆满告一段落。但这并不意味着爱心行动的结束，这只是一个开始!这么有意义的活动希望中文学校学生会计划每年继续下去,继续爱心接力,使国内贫困地区更多有需要的孩子得到帮助!
66599a5221a76de19fcc26f7ceb2bc232055fe43.translatedText: This love action initiated by the Hope Chinese School Student Union is intended to combine the traditional Chinese virtues of providing help in times of need, helping the poor, and helping others with the American Thanksgiving culture, and advocates students to have a grateful and caring heart. Since October and November last year, a series of activities such as charity sales, donations and fundraising have been actively carried out in the school. In December, supplies were prepared and delivered. The distribution of supplies in March has put a lot of enthusiasm and hard work into the Hope team, and this love action has finally come to a successful conclusion. But this does not mean the end of the charity action, it is just the beginning! I hope that such a meaningful activity will be continued every year and the charity relay will continue to help more children in need in poor areas of the country!

8de71d287e20467a06403a1c7d75a8572bc5f0fe.sourceText: 有一群孩子，住在离天最近的地方，冰天雪地中，衣衫单薄，简陋的屋子里，残缺的课本,这样的照片或许让您潸然泪下，或许让您心灵振撼，或许让您不堪忍受,可这些丝毫不能阻挡他们对山外的世界充满向往,依旧渴望用知识为自己的梦想插上希望的翅膀，将来他们或会成为医生、艺术家、绘画师、老师、工匠，他们会用他们自己的力量改变家乡的面貌！我们一点点的关爱和帮助，可以让他们在求知的路上走得更远些,飞得更高些！
8de71d287e20467a06403a1c7d75a8572bc5f0fe.translatedText: There is a group of children living closest to the sky, in the ice and snow, with thin clothes and simple houses. , incomplete textbooks, such photos may make you cry, may shock your soul, or may make you unbearable, but these cannot stop them from yearning for the world outside the mountains, and they are still eager to use knowledge to give their dreams wings of hope. In the future, they may become doctors, artists, painters, teachers, craftsmen, and they will use their own power to change the face of their hometown! A little bit of our care and help can help them go further and fly higher in their pursuit of knowledge!

9018701c1f8c15407124d1636ffadc8dd5a12cf1.sourceText: 希望越千山，爱心传万里。给予爱心，给予希望,下次的爱心行动期待你的参与!
9018701c1f8c15407124d1636ffadc8dd5a12cf1.translatedText: Hope goes over thousands of mountains and love spreads thousands of miles. Give love, give hope, and look forward to your participation in the next love action!

b65e1da418521dbb758e9c512aec25822bd1ca2a.translatedText: [Qiaobao.com, November 15th comprehensive report] Tourists visiting Maine in the United States may be confused by some road signs.

ad8e0da6b55b8fe8ae2c4e0b9f8e515983bf7ca4.sourceText: 例如，巴黎（Paris）位于秘鲁南边30英里；几分钟车程以外是挪威。到墨西哥、丹麦和莫斯科（Moscow）都只需不到一小时车路。
ad8e0da6b55b8fe8ae2c4e0b9f8e515983bf7ca4.translatedText: For example, Paris is 30 miles south of Peru; Norway is a few minutes away. It only takes less than an hour to reach Mexico, Denmark and Moscow.

2728ed2c2393d9a3690ea94b5c622dbd0bd2f7bb.sourceText: 缅因州为什么会有这些地名?
2728ed2c2393d9a3690ea94b5c622dbd0bd2f7bb.translatedText: Why do Maine have these place names?

f24df280fb4d4cb554b695decf048678684bb194.sourceText: 连线美国告诉我们，原来，它们反映了大约200年前来这里的定居者对当时世界一些地方正在发生的争取自由或反抗外来入侵斗争的情结。例如:
f24df280fb4d4cb554b695decf048678684bb194.translatedText: Wired America tells us that it turns out that they reflect the sentiments of the settlers who came here about 200 years ago towards the struggles for freedom or resistance to foreign invasion that were taking place in some parts of the world at that time. For example:

87ae093d1487ce63dabdf59bc89aba3805d198d4.sourceText: 缅因州小镇墨西哥（Mexico）的居民1818年为支持墨西哥人民反抗西班牙的统治争取独立而将这里起名为墨西哥。
87ae093d1487ce63dabdf59bc89aba3805d198d4.translatedText: The residents of the small town of Mexico in Maine named the place Mexico in 1818 to support the Mexican people's struggle for independence from Spanish rule.

3dd2d4320fb640ed350cfd833410708869b15d5e.sourceText: 这场战争为墨西哥独立战争，发生于1810-1821年，是墨西哥人民与西班牙殖民当局之间爆发的一系列武装冲突，开始于1810年9月6日。它以理想主义的农民对殖民地领主的反抗为开端，却以自由派与保守派达成同盟而告终。
3dd2d4320fb640ed350cfd833410708869b15d5e.translatedText: This war is the Mexican War of Independence, which took place from 1810 to 1821. It was a series of armed conflicts that broke out between the Mexican people and the Spanish colonial authorities. It started on September 6, 1810. It began with idealistic peasants revolting against colonial lords, but ended with an alliance between liberals and conservatives.

d46269dbed2cd2a0a6ebad6c7c973b0fdfc8c4bd.sourceText: 缅因州的丹麦（Denmark）是1807年在丹麦海军遭到英国攻击后，当地居民为向丹麦人民表示同情而采用的名字。
d46269dbed2cd2a0a6ebad6c7c973b0fdfc8c4bd.translatedText: >Denmark in Maine was a name adopted by local residents to express sympathy for the Danish people after the Danish navy was attacked by the British in 1807.

6537d25fb4ea5239163ec52ddade017e0f42b6cb.sourceText: 缅因州的秘鲁（Peru）得名于当时恰逢1821年秘鲁宣布摆脱西班牙统治而独立。
6537d25fb4ea5239163ec52ddade017e0f42b6cb.translatedText: Peru in Maine was named after Peru declared its independence from Spanish rule in 1821.

4daac97ba2235037648e1d32a376913a7ecf4590.sourceText: 位于美国新英格兰地区（New England）最东北角与加拿大接壤的缅因州，还有一些以遥远的海外城市中发生的有历史意义的政治事件而命名的地方。
4daac97ba2235037648e1d32a376913a7ecf4590.translatedText: Maine is located in the northeastern corner of New England in the United States and borders Canada. There are also some places named after historical political events that took place in distant overseas cities.

2c221fdf329a284e546afe72282fe918830d1d23.sourceText: 1812年，对当时刚刚打败拿破仑军队的俄罗斯充满敬意的缅因定居者，将他们新建的城镇取名为莫斯科（Moscow）。
2c221fdf329a284e546afe72282fe918830d1d23.translatedText: In 1812, Maine settlers who were full of respect for Russia, which had just defeated Napoleon's army, named their newly built town Moscow.

c8a8b485a3f165ebc20daae1af6dd1cf8559592b.sourceText: 1793年得名的缅因州巴黎（Paris），表达了人们对法国在美国独立战争（American Revolution）中提供的支持的感激之情。（美国还有其他18个名叫巴黎的地方，也是出于同样的原因。）
c8a8b485a3f165ebc20daae1af6dd1cf8559592b.translatedText: Paris, Maine, was named in 1793 to express people's gratitude for France's support in the American Revolution. (There are 18 other places in the United States named Paris, for the same reason.)

98163158fc2be466607d6a975568053f42bd5892.sourceText: 来自百科百科的信息称，美国独立战争，或称美国革命战争（1775年-1783年），是大英帝国和其北美十三州殖民地的革命者，以及几个欧洲强国之间的一场战争。
98163158fc2be466607d6a975568053f42bd5892.translatedText: Information from Encyclopedia states that the American Revolutionary War, or the American Revolutionary War (1775-1783), was a war between revolutionaries from the British Empire and its thirteen North American colonies, and several European powers.

0a37e17a9206ac2f2a659329766756be32216e12.sourceText: 这场战争主要是始于为了对抗英国的经济政策，但后来却因为法国、西班牙及荷兰加入战争对抗英国，而使战争的范围远远超过了英属北美之外。同时，许多印地安人为双方打仗。
0a37e17a9206ac2f2a659329766756be32216e12.translatedText: This war mainly started to fight against the British economic policy, but later because France, Spain and the Netherlands joined the war against the British, the scope of the war expanded far beyond British North America. Meanwhile, many Indians fought for both sides.

630e65afdd93d9b8e34ddc4a1fe4981b401dee13.sourceText: 这个令人费解的路标是缅因州最吸引人拍照的景象之一。
630e65afdd93d9b8e34ddc4a1fe4981b401dee13.translatedText: This puzzling road sign is one of the most photogenic sights in Maine.

c2eef2da9003a08b7466cb2d133a456eb21f1780.sourceText: 其他一些采用国家名称的城镇棗如瑞典、挪威、波兰、中国棗有其他一些历史缘由。
c2eef2da9003a08b7466cb2d133a456eb21f1780.translatedText: Other cities and towns that use country names such as Sweden, Norway, Poland, and China have other historical reasons.

ba614a83b32e39cd2cb9d5628daa42314a9efad2.sourceText: 比如中国（China）是当时流行的一首歌曲的歌名。
ba614a83b32e39cd2cb9d5628daa42314a9efad2.translatedText: For example, China was the title of a popular song at the time.

185eb440995fe4f51442794b04c744141012314a.sourceText: 维基百科介绍称，中国镇位于缅因州的肯纳贝克县（Kennebec County），据2010年美国人口普查的数据，这里居住了4328人。
185eb440995fe4f51442794b04c744141012314a.translatedText: Wikipedia states that China Town is located in Kennebec County, Maine. According to the 2010 U.S. Census, 4,328 people live here.

97a3ae51c3f62abb5c9ca19f2d9d6129d73708fa.sourceText: 该镇总面积为56.86平方英里，其中陆地面积为49.88平方英里，水域面积为6.98平方英里。该镇有一个湖叫中国湖，面积3939英亩。
97a3ae51c3f62abb5c9ca19f2d9d6129d73708fa.translatedText: The town has a total area of ​​56.86 square miles, of which 49.88 square miles are land and 6.98 square miles are water. The town has a lake called China Lake, covering an area of ​​3,939 acres.

5ee86a0be2208639b665cf6c510ba44adff13288.sourceText: 中国镇的历史可以追溯到1774年。虽然名字叫中国，但这里基本上没有中国人。根据美国人口统计，这里的住户97.1%是白人，亚裔仅占0.4%。
5ee86a0be2208639b665cf6c510ba44adff13288.translatedText: Chinatown’s history dates back to 1774. Although the name is China, there are basically no Chinese here. According to the U.S. Census Bureau, 97.1% of residents here are white, with Asians accounting for only 0.4%.

076caa819bda72a4a6555ff0c94ae2e8aea83770.sourceText: 但为什么会起这样一个名字呢？

4525461c308f439a1f36994b52e102bf0872e283.sourceText: 维基百科介绍称，该镇的名称是一个叫Japheth Washburn的人决定的。本来他想给这个镇取名布鲁姆维尔（Bloomville），遭到布隆菲尔德（Bloomfield）镇居民的反对，认为这样的话两个镇的名字过于相似了，会引起混乱。考虑之后，Washburn决定就叫中国吧。因为他最喜欢的赞美诗有一首的名字就是这个。这首被广泛传唱的赞美诗是由马萨诸塞州诺斯菲尔德的斯旺（Timothy Swan）在1790年写的，并于1801年发表。
4525461c308f439a1f36994b52e102bf0872e283.translatedText: Wikipedia states that the name of the town was decided by a man named Japheth Washburn. He originally wanted to name the town Bloomville, but was opposed by the residents of Bloomfield, who believed that the names of the two towns would be too similar and would cause confusion. After thinking about it, Washburn decided to just call it China. Because one of his favorite hymns is called that. This widely sung hymn was written in 1790 by Timothy Swan of Northfield, Massachusetts, and published in 1801.

c601c8d9164b42b22e604afcd0ab45da50b5aad7.sourceText: 再比如，瑞典（Sweden）是当时在那里安家的瑞典移民选择的名字。
c601c8d9164b42b22e604afcd0ab45da50b5aad7.translatedText: For another example, Sweden was the name chosen by the Swedish immigrants who settled there at that time.

e4ec0c1251cb526946eb0d0540af9395ce726c76.sourceText: 用其他国家名称和外国城市名字命名的地方，在美国并不只限于在缅因一个州，但它们在缅因州如此密集，堪称与众不同。
e4ec0c1251cb526946eb0d0540af9395ce726c76.translatedText: Places named after the names of other countries and foreign cities are not limited to one state in the United States, but Maine is so densely populated that it is unique.

a038dfe368b2cc320aa8d4e862a7bfcc47d8eb1d.sourceText: 蔷薇花开：中国离航母时代还有多远？ 中国离航母时代还有多远？ 中国第一艘航母平台在经过近一个月的休整之后，于8月27日下午16时15分，在拖船的簇拥下，告别送行的拖船，驶出辽宁省大连市的停泊码头，驶向大海，开始第十次海试。 本次航母平台海试将迎接台风”布拉万”的洗礼。海军副司令员徐洪猛表示，一年来的九次海试中，航母平台的各项技术操作非常顺利，均已达到预期效果。每完成一次海试，中国向航母时代又迈进了一步。 原海军某部部长郑明少将指出，航空母舰是维护国家海洋权益、保护海上交通运输安全、遏制周边蚕食我国岛屿领土的有力保障。现在，全世界9个国家已有20艘现役航母，其中美国占11艘。有的国家还在研发新型航母，有的已有准航母。中国只是即将拥有第一艘中型航母。郑明少将说，我们既不会，也没条件向美国航母挑战；更没必要与同为文明古国的印度搞航母竞赛；我们将向曾经帮助我国发展海军的国家，比如俄罗斯、乌克兰，继续学习和交流，尽管这些帮助是有条件、有代价的。由此可见，中国航母是不会对亚太周边国家构成威胁的，它的出现和改进在世界发展中是正常的事件，是众望所归、大势所趋的举动。 根据目前公开的资料显示，战后的美国航母发展是从福莱斯特级大型航空母舰开始的。开工最早的”福莱斯特”号始建于于1952年，两年半后，即1954年底试航，又过了不到1年，即1955年10月开始服役。1956年，美国开始建造”小鹰号”航母，历时3年半。从下水试航到服役用了1年时间。其后的几艘”小鹰级”航母的建设速度逐渐减慢，直到降至两年半，从试航到服役通常都只用1年多的时间。但建造”尼米兹号”这艘目前世界上吨位最大的一级核动力航空母舰，从试航到服役一共用了3年的时间，其后建造的9艘航母，除了”亚拉伯罕?#26519;肯”号用了1年9个月的时间，其他都用了2-3年的时间。不过，也有极端的例子。西班牙的首艘航母棗”阿斯图里亚斯王子”号，1982年5月22日下水，6年后的1988年5月30日才编入海军服役，其过程如此之长，是因为需要对指挥和控制系统不断进行改进，并增加一座司令舰桥以满足担当指挥舰的需要。 而我国第一艘航空母舰并不比尼米兹级大型核动力航空母舰吨位大，其满载排水量比?#31119;莱斯特?#21495;还少1万余吨。从舰载机的数量上看，”尼米兹号”配86架舰载机、可攻击飞机和截击敌方的巡航导弹、两台核反应堆、8台8000千瓦汽轮发电机、SPS-48E三维对空搜索雷达等先进装备。但我国第一艘航母仅为中型常规动力航空母舰，非核动力航母，其技术难度当小于尼米兹级。 中国一直向往航母时代，迫切需要进入航母时代，航空母舰是维护国家海洋权益、保护海上交通运输安全、遏制周边蚕食我国岛屿领土的有力保障。尤其在当今周边海域风起云涌、世界多极化发展的战略格局下，中国航母编队要挺身而出，驶向深海，维护国家主权、执行和平使命。而在这之前，西方多国早已在航母时代中游刃有余。尽管随着中国第一艘航母平台海试步入常规化，中国航母之路已展现一线曙光，但依然任重而道远。 世界政治经济的秩序决不能靠战争和冷战来继续，一国称霸、主宰世界的格局在亚太及其它任何地区都将随着多极化、多元化而逐渐改变，中国首爆原子弹和随后的?#20004;弹一星?#65292;曾经影响世界战略的大格局。但是，中国首艘航母却被某些国家不怀善意的媒体和人士贬低为”纸老虎”，究竟中国第一艘航母能不能像”两弹一星”那样，对世界战略格局发挥一定的影响，还要假以时日才能验证。 虽然随着我国航母平台海试步入常规化，中国的航母之路已展现一线曙光，但航母从第一次海试到正式服役再到形成战斗力，是一个很漫长的过程。航母研究专家李杰大校曾表示，航母从试航到服役，一般需要3年的时间，而形成战斗力，又需5?年的时间。可见，中国离航母时代还有一个旷日持久的过程，不容乐观，依然任重而道远呢。
a038dfe368b2cc320aa8d4e862a7bfcc47d8eb1d.translatedText: Roses in bloom: How far is China from the aircraft carrier era? How far is China from the aircraft carrier era? After nearly a month of rest, China's first aircraft carrier platform, surrounded by tugboats, bid farewell to the tugboats at 16:15 in the afternoon on August 27, sailed out of the dock in Dalian City, Liaoning Province, and headed for the sea to begin its tenth sea trial. This sea trial of the aircraft carrier platform will welcome the baptism of Typhoon "Bulavan". Xu Hongmeng, deputy commander of the Navy, said that during the nine sea trials in the past year, various technical operations of the aircraft carrier platform were very smooth and all achieved the expected results. Every time a sea trial is completed, China takes another step towards the aircraft carrier era. Rear Admiral Zheng Ming, former minister of the Navy, pointed out that aircraft carriers are a powerful guarantee for safeguarding national maritime rights and interests, protecting maritime transportation safety, and curbing surrounding areas from encroaching on our island territory. Currently, nine countries around the world have 20 aircraft carriers in active service, of which the United States accounts for 11. Some countries are still developing new aircraft carriers, and some already have quasi-aircraft carriers. China is just about to have its first medium-sized aircraft carrier. Rear Admiral Zheng Ming said that we will neither challenge nor have the conditions to challenge the US aircraft carrier; there is no need to engage in an aircraft carrier race with India, which is also an ancient civilization; we will continue to learn and exchange with countries that have helped our country develop its navy, such as Russia and Ukraine, although this help comes with conditions and costs. It can be seen that China's aircraft carrier will not pose a threat to neighboring countries in the Asia-Pacific. Its emergence and improvement are normal events in the development of the world, a move that is expected by the public and the general trend. According to current public information, the postwar development of U.S. aircraft carriers began with the Forrest-class large aircraft carriers. The earliest construction of the "Forrest" was started in 1952. Two and a half years later, at the end of 1954, it went on trial and less than a year later, it entered service in October 1955. In 1956, the United States began construction of the "Kitty Hawk" aircraft carrier, which lasted three and a half years. It took one year from launch to commissioning. The construction speed of the subsequent "Kitty Hawk-class" aircraft carriers gradually slowed down until it dropped to two and a half years. It usually only takes more than a year from trial to commissioning. However, the construction of the "Nimitz", the first-class nuclear-powered aircraft carrier with the largest tonnage in the world, took a total of three years from trial to commissioning. The nine subsequent aircraft carriers built, except for the "Abraham Ken", which took one year and nine months, all took two to three years. However, there are extreme examples. Spain's first aircraft carrier, the "Prince of Asturias", was launched on May 22, 1982, and was entered into naval service six years later on May 30, 1988. The process took so long because the command and control system needed to be continuously improved and a command bridge added to meet the needs of the command ship. However, my country's first aircraft carrier is no larger than the Nimitz-class large nuclear-powered aircraft carrier, and its full-load displacement is more than 10,000 tons less than the Leicester. Judging from the number of carrier-based aircraft, the "Nimitz" is equipped with 86 carrier-based aircraft, cruise missiles that can attack aircraft and intercept enemy enemies, two nuclear reactors, eight 8,000-kilowatt turbine generators, SPS-48E three-dimensional air search radar and other advanced equipment. However, my country's first aircraft carrier is only a medium-sized conventionally powered aircraft carrier, not a nuclear-powered aircraft carrier, and its technical difficulty should be less than that of the Nimitz class. China has always longed for the era of aircraft carriers and urgently needs to enter the era of aircraft carriers. Aircraft carriers are a powerful guarantee for safeguarding national maritime rights and interests, protecting maritime transportation safety, and curbing surrounding encroachment on our island territory. Especially in today's strategic landscape of turbulent surrounding waters and multi-polar development of the world, China's aircraft carrier fleet must step forward and sail into the deep sea to safeguard national sovereignty and carry out peaceful missions. Before this, many Western countries had already been comfortable in the aircraft carrier era. Although China's first aircraft carrier platform sea trials have become routine, China's aircraft carrier road has shown a glimmer of hope, but there is still a long way to go. The world's political and economic order must not be sustained by war and the Cold War. The pattern of one country dominating the world will gradually change with multipolarity and diversification in the Asia-Pacific and other regions. China's first atomic bomb and subsequent "one-satellite bomb" once affected the overall pattern of world strategy. However, China's first aircraft carrier has been belittled as a "paper tiger" by unfavorable media and people in some countries. Whether China's first aircraft carrier can exert a certain influence on the world's strategic pattern like "two bombs and one satellite" will only take time to verify. Although my country's aircraft carrier platform has become a regular sea trial, China's aircraft carrier road has shown a glimmer of hope, but the aircraft carrier from the first sea trial to formal service and then to the formation of combat effectiveness is a very long process. Colonel Li Jie, an expert on aircraft carrier research, once said that it generally takes three years for an aircraft carrier to go from trial to service, and another five years to form combat effectiveness. It can be seen that China still has a long and protracted process before it reaches the aircraft carrier era. It is not optimistic and there is still a long way to go.

496004d76afedc0c5fccf48f02491eacd9ebf0ce.sourceText: ​【本报讯】(亚省现代中文学校教学部特约报道) 2020 新春伊始，新型冠状病毒肺炎的疫情成为全球焦点，也牵动着每一个海外华人的心。在亚利桑那州出现首例患者后，亚省现代中文学校作为华人社区的重要组成部分，本着关爱我校师生、义工和对整个社区负责的态度，主动减少华人社区人员接触的机会，做出了立即停止教室授课的慎重决定。与此同时，学校考虑到单纯停课数周对管理团队来说相对简单省事，但对学生的持续中文学习会造成不可估量的损失，于是积极商讨相应的后续措施。最终，本着对我校学生及家长负责的态度，亚省现代中文学校决定暂时启用网络授课方式：2 月8 号开始，有条件的班级开始试行网络教学；力争在2 月15 日实现大部分课程网络教学，直至恢复ASU教室授课，以保障学生“停课不停学”。
496004d76afedc0c5fccf48f02491eacd9ebf0ce.translatedText: ​[News from this newspaper] (Special report from the Teaching Department of Modern Chinese School of Alberta) 2020 At the beginning of the new year, the novel coronavirus pneumonia epidemic has become the global focus, and it has also affected the hearts of every overseas Chinese. After the first patient appeared in Arizona, as an important part of the Chinese community, the Alberta Modern Chinese School took the initiative to reduce the opportunities for people in the Chinese community to come into contact with each other and made a prudent decision to immediately stop classroom teaching in line with the attitude of caring for our teachers, students, volunteers, and being responsible for the entire community. At the same time, the school considered that simply suspending classes for a few weeks would be relatively simple and trouble-free for the management team, but would cause immeasurable losses to students' continued Chinese learning, so it actively discussed corresponding follow-up measures. Finally, in line with a responsible attitude towards the students and parents of our school, the Alberta Modern Chinese School decided to temporarily enable online teaching: starting from February 8, qualified classes will begin trial online teaching; and strive to implement online teaching for most courses on February 15 until ASU classroom teaching is resumed to ensure that students "continue to learn when classes are suspended."

b9729f197edd647c4696510727c3e84ab3696998.sourceText: 经过校委会积极商讨提案，在董事会批准和全力支持下，全校教师、义工积极投入了为网络授课的准备工作中。首先，校委会成员通过几次密集的电话会议，确定了使用Zoom网课平台；并由教学部中文组、数学组、才艺组的几位组长连续奋战几夜，为教师、学生和家长制作了网课使用指南，率先发给各位老师审阅和学习。2 月1日星期六的早晨，所有中文、数学老师及部分才艺课老师利用学校停课1 周的时间，分批参加了近两小时的网络课堂培训。课后又通过答疑环节，提出更多便利学生和家长的建议，如提出制作中英双语版本网课使用指南等。在使用指南经过完善并发出后，各班老师将联系学生和家长在2 月8 号前先试课，以确保下周六网课顺利开展。做出临时转为从未尝试过的网络授课的决定对一个全部由义工运作的学校来说，毫无疑问意味着是一个艰巨的挑战。这需要义工教师甘于奉献，自觉增加义工服务时间，快速学习并熟练使用网络平台，调整课件等等。同时也需要家长的大力协助与支持，帮助孩子登录到网络平台并做好一定的监督工作。这对一部分并不熟练掌握电脑技术的教师和家长来说是有不少困难需要克服的。但出乎大家意料的是，绝大多数老师和家长们的反应是相当积极的。校委会董事会多名成员也主动申请提供网课或技术指导工作。为了能最大限度地满足学生的学习需求，为了不被暂时的困难阻断学生的学习热情，为了携手并肩应对这突如其来的特殊考验，每一个“现代人”都更多地体现出了理解和包容，团结与互助。我们感叹于校委会及董事会的果断和魄力，感叹于教师义工们的无私奉献，也感叹于家长和学生的理解与支持!为每一个“现代人”点赞!
b9729f197edd647c4696510727c3e84ab3696998.translatedText: After the school committee actively discussed the proposal, and with the approval and full support of the board of directors, all the teachers and volunteers of the school actively participated in the preparation for online teaching. First of all, the school committee members decided to use the Zoom online class platform through several intensive phone conferences. Several team leaders from the Chinese, Mathematics, and Talent Groups of the Teaching Department worked hard for several nights to produce an online class usage guide for teachers, students, and parents, which was first sent to teachers for review and study. On the morning of Saturday, February 1, all Chinese and math teachers and some talent class teachers took advantage of the one-week school closure to participate in nearly two hours of online classroom training in batches. After class, through a question and answer session, more suggestions were put forward to facilitate students and parents, such as the production of a Chinese-English bilingual version of the online course usage guide. After the user guide is refined and issued, teachers in each class will contact students and parents to try out the class before February 8 to ensure the smooth start of online classes next Saturday. Making the decision to temporarily switch to online teaching, which has never been attempted before, undoubtedly represents a difficult challenge for a school run entirely by volunteers. This requires volunteer teachers to be willing to contribute, consciously increase their volunteer service time, quickly learn and skillfully use online platforms, adjust courseware, etc. At the same time, it also requires strong assistance and support from parents to help their children log in to the online platform and do certain supervision. For some teachers and parents who are not proficient in computer technology, there are many difficulties to overcome. But to everyone's surprise, the response from the vast majority of teachers and parents was quite positive. Many members of the school committee and board of directors also took the initiative to apply to provide online courses or technical guidance. In order to meet students' learning needs to the greatest extent, in order not to be blocked by temporary difficulties, students' enthusiasm for learning, and in order to work hand in hand to cope with this sudden special test, every "modern person" has shown more understanding and tolerance, solidarity and mutual assistance. We marvel at the decisiveness and courage of the school committee and board of directors, the selfless dedication of teacher volunteers, and the understanding and support of parents and students! Thumbs up for every "modern person"!

0963bb28f772c082e95d851d2881f2c35cc59f42.sourceText: 在中国，找医生看病一件很麻烦的事。去医院看病的人如潮水一般，每天清晨开门前一小时，医院掛号处就排上了长长的队伍。90年代以后，医院实行了名医掛号的办法，教授级医师的掛号费由人民币五块涨到十块，甚至三十块，五十块，有的医院专家看病掛号费高达二，三百块，中国人相信名医，总希望找最好的医生看病，只要治好病多花点钱也值得，于是排队找专家看病的队排得更长了，往往是提前一天就开始排队。因為排队难，有关係的就要托人走后门，年纪大的人就花钱僱人代排队，有的打工仔（妹）找到了一份新的职业。另外，中国的看病是以医生為中心，病人在医生的诊室外等候，按规定叫到你的名字就进去看病。因為病人多，一位医生每半天要看三，四十个病人。大家着急，常常是医生的周围站着一堆人挤来挤去，天天都有争吵发生。看一次病相当于赶一次大集，有时小病会累成大病，没病也会累出点病来。新建的中日友好医院专门為局级以上干部，教授级以上科技人员和外国人开闢了特设门诊部，局部有了点好转，但这只是少数人。更麻烦的是如果你得了大病，需要住院或手术，走后门，送红包是不可或缺的”程序”。这个不规范的”程序”给病人最大的困惑是，受礼的人不要你送，你却不敢不送；送红包又不知道该送给谁，送多少才好，怎样送法对方才能欣然接受等等，人们有时不得不请”送礼专家”代办。当然，还有一个最大的难题就是治疗的费用问题，所有医院都是先收支票再看病。 在美国看病，我觉得和中国有很大的不同。看医生要提前约好Appointment，按时看病，即使稍等一会儿，也在一个很舒适的环境中，看着电视，喝点咖啡。看病是以病人為中心，每个病人在一间诊室内等候医生来看病，病人的健康状况作為个人隐私受到法律的保护。每位医生每半天只看七，八个病人，比较轻鬆，和病人谈笑自如。他们更多地偏重于靠实验报告进行诊断，因此美国人的血不值钱，动不动就用抽血，X光，超声波，CT，MRI直至抽脊髓检查等手段，有时真觉得他们过於小心，后来了解到这是他们的行规，既是对病人负责，也是对医生自身的保护,也体现了医学科学的进步和现代水平。当然，在美国看病最大的好处是看病不必為送红包或请客送礼而烦恼，美国不兴那一套，要送都没处送。好极了！好极了！许多朋友跟我讲，就凭这一点，我就喜欢住在美国。还有医护人员对病人的态度百分之九十五以上都是笑脸相迎，表现出对病人的关怀和体贴，使人感到很温暖；在中国，这个百分比大约在百分之五十吧！我还记常常发生為看病生气的事，因為你要求他看病，敢怒而不敢言，这种滋味真难受。 美国的911 和Emergency 真正体现了以人為本和救死扶伤的精神。无论你在美国的任何地方，出现了生命危急，只要call 911，五分鐘之内，急救车一定赶到。医护人员立即开始检查和紧急处置，根据病人的需要送急诊室。美国政府有规定，911 和Emergency都是救人第一，不论肤色，人种，是否有合法身份，有没有收入和医疗保险，看病救人要紧。我有几位朋友曾因骨折，泻肚，高烧去了急诊，没有任何要求，先把病看好，然后再寄账单给你，如果确实经济有困难，也可以商量解决。我自己刚到美国不久，也有一次急诊的经歷。那是发生在医生对我进行心臟运动试验时，医生认為我有生命危险，必须马上做搭桥手术，一边通知我的儿子，一边就由医院的社会工作人员為我办理申请急诊费用的文件。我在监护室呆了一天作準备，第二天就做了价值10万美元的心臟搭桥手术。就这样，我又多活了10多年。 看病，对於每个人来说是一件大事，特别是绿卡移民来美国，五年内经济上由担保人负责，年青人可以通过工作单位得到基本的保险，对老年人说，看病往往成為新移民的大问题。但是，你只要有绿卡，就可以申请到急诊卡，平时的门诊，一些大的医疗集团和大的医院都有专门对低收入的居民进行帮助的项目，参加这种项目以后，每年花一百美元左右就可以了。 美国在实现人的生命最為宝贵这一普世价值方面，真正体现了社会的文明和进步。
0963bb28f772c082e95d851d2881f2c35cc59f42.translatedText: In China, it is very troublesome to find a doctor. There is a flood of people going to the hospital to see a doctor. There is a long queue at the hospital registration office an hour before it opens every morning. After the 1990s, hospitals implemented the method of registering with famous doctors. The registration fee for professor-level doctors increased from RMB 5 to RMB 10, or even RMB 30 or RMB 50. In some hospitals, the registration fee for experts to see a doctor was as high as RMB 2 or 300. Chinese people believe in famous doctors and always hope to find the best doctor to see a doctor. As long as the disease is cured, it is worth spending more money, so the queues to see experts are getting longer, and they often start queuing up a day in advance. Because queuing is difficult, those who have connections have to ask someone to go through the back door. Older people pay people to wait in line for them. Some wage earners (girls) have found a new career. In addition, medical treatment in China is doctor-centered. Patients wait outside the doctor's clinic. According to regulations, they go in to see a doctor when their name is called. Because there are so many patients, a doctor has to see 30 to 40 patients every half day. Everyone was anxious, and there were often crowds of people standing around the doctor, squeezing around, and quarrels occurred every day. Going to see a doctor once is equivalent to going to a big meeting. Sometimes a minor illness will become a serious illness, and even if you are not sick, you will become sick due to exhaustion. The newly built China-Japan Friendship Hospital has opened a special outpatient department for cadres at the bureau level and above, scientific and technical personnel at professor level and above, and foreigners. Some people have seen some improvement, but these are only a small number of people. What's even more troublesome is that if you get a serious illness and need hospitalization or surgery, going through the back door and sending red envelopes is an indispensable "procedure". The biggest confusion caused by this irregular "procedure" to patients is that the person receiving the gift does not want you to give it, but you dare not not give it; when giving red envelopes, you don't know who to give it to, how much to give, how to give it so that the other party can accept it happily, etc. Sometimes people have to ask "gift giving experts" to do it for them. Of course, the biggest problem is the cost of treatment. All hospitals collect checks first and then treat patients. I feel that seeing a doctor in the United States is very different from that in China. When seeing a doctor, you need to make an appointment in advance and see the doctor on time. Even if you wait for a while, you can still watch TV and drink some coffee in a very comfortable environment. Medical treatment is patient-centered. Each patient waits in a clinic for a doctor to see a doctor. The patient's health status is protected by law as personal privacy. Each doctor only sees seven or eight patients every half day. He is relatively relaxed and can talk and laugh freely with the patients. They tend to rely more on laboratory reports for diagnosis, so Americans’ blood is not valuable, and they often use blood drawing, X-ray, ultrasound, CT, MRI, and even spinal cord examination and other methods. Sometimes I really feel that they are too cautious. Later I learned that this is their business rule. It is not only responsible for the patient, but also the protection of the doctor himself. It also reflects the progress and modern level of medical science. Of course, the biggest advantage of seeing a doctor in the United States is that you don’t have to worry about giving red envelopes or treating guests to gifts. The United States doesn’t do that, and there’s nowhere to give it. Great! Great! Many friends have told me that just because of this, I like living in the United States. In addition, more than 95% of the attitude of medical staff towards patients is to greet patients with a smile, showing care and consideration for the patient, which makes people feel very warm; in China, this percentage is about 50%! I still remember that I often got angry over medical treatment. Because you asked him to see a doctor, you dared to get angry but dare not speak out. This feeling is really uncomfortable. America's 911 and Emergency truly embody the spirit of putting people first and saving lives. No matter where you are in the United States, if your life is in danger, just call 911 and an ambulance will arrive within five minutes. Medical staff immediately begin examination and emergency treatment, and send the patient to the emergency room according to the patient's needs. The U.S. government has regulations that the first priority for 911 and Emergency is to save people. Regardless of skin color, race, legal status, income and medical insurance, it is important to see a doctor and save people. Several of my friends have gone to the emergency room for fractures, diarrhea, and high fever. There are no requirements. They will take good care of the disease first and then send you the bill. If you really have financial difficulties, we can also negotiate a solution. Not long after I arrived in the United States, I also had an emergency room experience. That happened when the doctor was conducting a cardiac exercise test on me. The doctor believed that my life was in danger and that I needed to undergo bypass surgery immediately. While notifying my son, the hospital's social worker processed the documents for me to apply for emergency medical expenses. I spent a day in the intensive care unit getting ready, and the next day I had $100,000 worth of heart bypass surgery. In this way, I lived for more than 10 years. Seeing a doctor is a big deal for everyone, especially those who immigrate to the United States with a green card. The guarantor will be responsible for the financial support within five years. Young people can get basic insurance through their workplace. For the elderly, seeing a doctor often becomes a big problem for new immigrants. However, as long as you have a green card, you can apply for an emergency card. In normal outpatient clinics, some large medical groups and hospitals have programs specifically to help low-income residents. After participating in such programs, it only costs about one hundred dollars a year. In realizing the universal value that human life is the most precious, the United States truly embodies social civilization and progress.

ff22d76ff500ecac7f4ead8363b34960baf07167.sourceText: （新东方艺术学校供稿 秋香报道）在刚刚过去的”金秋”中国舞蹈节晚会中，配乐诗朗诵这个节目受到了观众好评。整场晚会中这个唯一的语言类节目，点缀在满场的舞蹈中，显得清新雅致，令人耳目一新。 两对少男少女，在一曲动听的古筝名曲《渔舟唱晚》中朗诵了《水调歌头 明月几时有》。这首宋词由著名词人苏轼填写，是中国古典诗词中关于中秋最著名的篇章。孩子们的朗诵抑扬顿挫、饱含激情。ASU的一位音乐教授评价说，”诗词与音乐丝丝入扣，朗诵在音乐的高潮中结束，堪称完美。”有的家长也感慨地说，”这是一个非常出色的节目，打破了只有歌舞的传统，也让家长们认识到，我们的孩子原来也能字正腔圆地咏诵唐诗宋词。”
ff22d76ff500ecac7f4ead8363b34960baf07167.translatedText: (Contributed by New Oriental Art School) Reported by Qiuxiang) In the just past "Golden Autumn" Chinese Dance Festival Gala, the program of poetry recitation to music was well received by the audience. This is the only language program in the whole party, interspersed with the dances all over the place, looking fresh, elegant and refreshing. Two pairs of boys and girls recited "When will the bright moon come out" in a beautiful guzheng song "Fishing Boat Sings Evening". This Song poem was written by the famous poet Su Shi and is the most famous chapter about the Mid-Autumn Festival in Chinese classical poetry. The children's recitation was cadenced and full of passion. A music professor from ASU commented, "Poetry and music are perfectly connected, and the recitation ends with the climax of the music, which is perfect." Some parents also said with emotion, "This is a very good program, breaking the tradition of only singing and dancing, and also allows parents to realize that our children can also recite Tang poetry and Song lyrics fluently."

a0c5740555661c36c3a56648d82cec06b31fd408.sourceText: 马利科巴郡增设天气短信警报服务 周一晚天气突变，成千上万的手机用户收到马利科巴郡的天气警报短信，提醒机主有洪涝威胁。 国家气象局发言人沃特斯说：”我们提供一个新的服务项目，把国家气象局有关沙尘暴警报、洪水警报等，发给机主。” 国家气象局的危急短信服务计划有天气警报、黄色警报和总统警报，甚至包括恐怖袭击警报等，理论上所有的手机都能收到，但现时是否能收到，要取决你的运营商和手机模型。大部分黑莓和苹果手机暂时无法接收此类短信。沃特斯说，国家气象局正在与各大运营商谈判，尽快解决这个问题。 周一晚，在佩森南部的向日葵野火地区有山洪出现，短信却无法传递到此，因为短信服务暂时也只能惠及马利科巴郡手机机主。 如果机主不想接收警报短信，可在运营商网站找到如何退出的指示。
a0c5740555661c36c3a56648d82cec06b31fd408.translatedText: Maricopa County added a weather text message alert service. The weather suddenly changed on Monday night, and thousands of mobile phone users received weather warning text messages from Maricopa County, reminding phone owners of the threat of flooding. Waters, a spokesman for the National Weather Service, said: "We are providing a new service to send the National Weather Service's sandstorm warnings, flood warnings, etc. to the owners." The National Weather Service's critical text message service plan includes weather warnings, yellow alerts, presidential alerts, and even terrorist attack warnings. In theory, all mobile phones can receive it, but whether it can be received currently depends on your operator and mobile phone model. Most BlackBerry and Apple phones are temporarily unable to receive such text messages. Waters said the National Weather Service is in talks with major operators to resolve the issue as quickly as possible. There were flash floods in the Sunflower Wildfire area south of Payson on Monday night, but text messages could not be delivered there because the text message service could only benefit mobile phone owners in Maricopa County for the time being. If the owner does not want to receive alert text messages, instructions on how to opt out can be found on the operator's website.

42a37740dc607c07797d6c14be135f66bb471f14.sourceText: 奥巴马宣布击毙拉登 宣称正义得到伸张 人民网 美国总统奥巴马1日晚间宣布，”基地”组织头号领导人本·拉登当天在巴基斯坦境内被美军击毙。白宫透露，美军特种部队根据可靠情报，发动了本次”杀拉登行动”，并顺利找到他的遗体。奥巴马在宣布拉登死讯时特别宣称，”正义得到伸张”。 获悉拉登死讯后，很多美国人在白宫附近欢呼胜利。美国认定，拉登是”911”恐怖袭击事件元凶，美军对此人的追捕行动已持续了近10年，并为提供其下落者设立了2500万美元的悬赏。除了拉登外，”基地”组织第二号任务扎瓦赫里的悬赏也是2500万美元。 奥巴马说，美军经过数月侦察，确定拉登在巴基斯坦城市阿伯塔巴德市内一座建筑内生活。针对这一情况，奥巴马下令美军发动攻击，在经过短暂交火后，拉登被打死。自从2001年后，拉登一直下落不明，有人宣称其已经死亡，但他却发布过30多段录音和录像讲话。 美国认为，拉登是”基地”组织的”精神支柱”，并主要充当”战略家”，不直接参与策划恐怖袭击活动。再加上今天”基地”组织早已化整为零，分散到其他国家活动，因此”击毙拉登”只是具有象征意义的胜利，对消除全球范围内的恐怖活动影响不大。 现在还不清楚潜伏在美欧各地的”基地”组织成员是否会开展报复性袭击活动。拉登是曾是沙特阿拉伯公民，后来被剥夺了国籍。美军发动阿富汗战争后，拉登通过长期隐居的办法来躲避美军追捕。
42a37740dc607c07797d6c14be135f66bb471f14.translatedText: Obama announced the killing of Bin Laden and declared that justice had been done. People's Daily Online US President Obama announced on the evening of the 1st that bin Laden, the top leader of the "Al Qaeda" organization, was killed by the US military in Pakistan that day. The White House revealed that the US military special forces launched this "Operation to Kill Bin Laden" based on reliable intelligence and successfully found his body. When announcing bin Laden's death, Obama specifically declared, "Justice has been served." After learning of Bin Laden's death, many Americans cheered victory near the White House. The United States has determined that Bin Laden was the culprit of the September 11 terrorist attacks. The US military has been hunting this man for nearly 10 years and has set up a reward of US$25 million for anyone who can provide information on his whereabouts. In addition to Bin Laden, the reward for al-Qaeda's second mission, Al-Zawahiri, is also $25 million. Obama said that after months of reconnaissance by the US military, it was determined that bin Laden was living in a building in the Pakistani city of Abbottabad. In response to this situation, Obama ordered the US military to launch an attack. After a brief exchange of fire, bin Laden was killed. Bin Laden's whereabouts have been unknown since 2001. Some people claimed that he was dead, but he has released more than 30 audio and video speeches. The United States believes that Bin Laden is the "spiritual pillar" of the "Al Qaeda" organization and mainly acts as a "strategist" and is not directly involved in planning terrorist attacks. In addition, today's "Al Qaeda" organization has long been broken into pieces and dispersed to other countries. Therefore, "killing Bin Laden" is only a symbolic victory and has little impact on eliminating terrorist activities on a global scale. It is still unclear whether al-Qaeda members lurking throughout the United States and Europe will carry out retaliatory attacks. Bin Laden was a Saudi Arabian citizen who was later stripped of his citizenship. After the U.S. military launched the war in Afghanistan, Bin Laden stayed in seclusion for a long time to avoid being hunted by the U.S. military.

e962638c5bc322f9d4d707e3ffc36052b613cb8e.sourceText: 本周亚利桑那迎来今年第一次高温预警 Phoenix –身在亚利桑那的各位小伙伴们，准备好迎接2…
e962638c5bc322f9d4d707e3ffc36052b613cb8e.translatedText: This week Arizona ushered in the first high temperature warning of the year Phoenix – Dear friends in Arizona, get ready for 2…

5a04133245f5c59aa47888acc904a0b303f1017d.sourceText: Phoenix – 身在亚利桑那的各位小伙伴们，准备好迎接 2016 迄今为止最强烈的高温天气吧！这也是我们今年接收到的第一次高温预警。
5a04133245f5c59aa47888acc904a0b303f1017d.translatedText: Phoenix – Dear friends in Arizona, prepare for the most intense high temperature weather in 2016 so far! This is also the first high temperature warning we have received this year.

c66960ab2a5a9c16cc0262765e807c948a68862f.sourceText: 据悉，谷区的气温今天能够低至 100 华氏度，到本周四，亚利桑那州的气温将爬升至 107 华氏度。
c66960ab2a5a9c16cc0262765e807c948a68862f.translatedText: Temperatures in the Valley are expected to dip as low as 100 degrees Fahrenheit today and will climb to 107 degrees Fahrenheit in Arizona by Thursday.

c2500cfbaeb94a596d783b4f8973cbba6868a6d9.sourceText: 此外，当我们逐渐热起来的时候，我们的空气质量也变得很糟糕。一项有关臭氧层严重污染的忠告将于本周四生效。所以，如果你有呼吸问题，你可能要限制你在室外逗留的时间。
c2500cfbaeb94a596d783b4f8973cbba6868a6d9.translatedText: Also, as we warm up, our air quality becomes terrible. An advisory on severe pollution of the ozone layer will come into effect on Thursday. So, if you have breathing problems, you may want to limit the time you spend outside.

bccae6da6e045a38f4b8e310e771b6131626897e.sourceText: 本周最热的一天将出现在周五，谷区的气温会在今年第一次上升至 110 华氏度。
bccae6da6e045a38f4b8e310e771b6131626897e.translatedText: The hottest day of the week will be Friday, with temperatures in the Valley rising to 110 degrees for the first time this year.

93a4295d37c81023ffead6d10e33b77e62d3048d.sourceText: 一个严重高温的预警将在谷区生效，亚利桑那州南部的大部分地区，科罗拉多河谷沿岸的地区，从本周五到周日都会受到影响。
93a4295d37c81023ffead6d10e33b77e62d3048d.translatedText: A severe heat advisory is in effect for the Valley, affecting much of southern Arizona and along the Colorado River Valley from Friday through Sunday.

f8bb879a13504f77b08d0f1219d2584ac6946b1c.sourceText: 谷区的温度也将于下周的早些时候上升至 110 到 115 华氏度的高温。
f8bb879a13504f77b08d0f1219d2584ac6946b1c.translatedText: > Temperatures in the Valley will also rise to highs of 110 to 115 degrees Fahrenheit early next week.

6fb3f40b1180bf2b7c45aa49e7b0981211b1bb1f.sourceText: 亚利桑那州有关高温天气的记录有望在本周五，周六日以及下周一打破。每天都有可能比之前的高温记录高 1 到 2 度。
6fb3f40b1180bf2b7c45aa49e7b0981211b1bb1f.translatedText: > Arizona's record high temperatures are expected to be broken this Friday, Saturday, Sunday and next Monday. Each day has the potential to be 1 to 2 degrees warmer than the previous high temperature record.

3b968004fe1e0f28db7e77af7e8e652318fe1a5b.sourceText: 本周六看起来将会是亚利桑那州最热的一天，届时菲尼克斯将会达到 116 华氏度。如果预测准确， 今年亚利桑那州达到 115 华氏度或者以上高温的时间将是最早的。
3b968004fe1e0f28db7e77af7e8e652318fe1a5b.translatedText: This Saturday looks set to be the hottest day in Arizona, with temperatures reaching 116 degrees in Phoenix. If forecasts are accurate, Arizona will be among the earliest this year to experience high temperatures of 115 degrees or above.

4ac84167b11b400615152e3a9ebf530d63f12fbc.sourceText: 这种炎热的天气有可能是危险的，甚至是致命的。所以，请你确保自己补充足够的水分，每天早上坚持适当地户外活动。避免在早上 10 点到晚上 7 点间在户外逗留过长的时间，因为这是一天中最热的时间段。
4ac84167b11b400615152e3a9ebf530d63f12fbc.translatedText: This hot weather can be dangerous and even fatal. So, please make sure you are hydrated enough and engage in appropriate outdoor activities every morning. Avoid spending too much time outdoors between 10am and 7pm as this is the hottest time of the day.

7e65efe316b6a8a975f8c19c6011aabd471be20c.sourceText: 最高法院暗示 鼓励各州强化反移民法 全国各地的立法者和反非法移民活动人士都在摩拳擦掌，因为最高法院似乎倾向支持SB1070的某些部分，这可能带来新一波严厉的反非法移民法律。约十多个州表示，如果亚州法律的关键部分受到最高法院的支持，他们有兴趣提出类似的法案。联邦司法部控告亚利桑那州法律与联邦移民政策有冲突的案件预计将于六月份做出判决。 ”美国人合法移民”团体的主席格亨表示，”我们相信我们可以通过这项法律。” ”美国人移民改革联盟”主席斯登也表示很受鼓舞。因为上周三口头辩论中数名法官暗示他们建议让亚州实行该法律最富争议的部分?#35201;求警察检查那些他们怀疑是非法居留的人的移民身份。另外一个条款允许警察在没有逮捕令的情况下逮捕受被疑是非法移民的民众。 ”法官们发出清晰的信号，州府在这个领域有很大的空间采取行动。”斯登说：”未来几个月他们将花费大量精力检视所有的可能性。” 如果六月份的判决支持亚州法案1070，包括阿拉巴马、乔治亚、印第安纳、南卡和犹他等州都将推进类似的措施，他们都已经通过相关法律但是被搁置，等待高等法院的判决。 ”如果亚利桑那做的很好，我们也将做的很好。”阿拉巴马州参议员比森说。他提出一项比亚利桑那州更严厉的法律。除了要求警察在截停交通违规车辆的时候确定当事人公民身份之外，它还要求政府部门在处理汽车牌照，小孩入学和就业的时候确认合法居留身份。 在很多州诸如密西西比和宾州的立法者说，如果最高法院开绿灯的话，他们将渴望学习亚利桑那和阿拉巴马州的模式。 众议院州政府委员会主席，宾州共和党国会议员麦特卡夫说：”你看看一个个的民调，不论是企业主，雇主，小企业主还是行政人员，大多数美国人支持1070这样的法律。”麦特卡夫已经推出一项法案，其中包含了SB1070法律条款，并等待最高法院的有利判决出台之后再将其在委员会上提出。 在密西西比州，一项强硬的反非法移民法案今年早些时候在国会获得通过，但是被参议院否决。它的支持者计划明年再次闯关，并希望最高法院的判决将给予他们指南。跟密西西比一样，南达科他州的议员也否决了一项基亚利桑那法律的措施，但是法案的提出者，共和党州议员斯蒂尔表示将再次闯关。在罗德岛州，州议员帕卢波说，他很高兴看到最高法院明显支持允许州府实行移民法。 在几个多数党不占绝对多数的州比如爱荷华、科罗拉多、蒙大拿和肯塔基，立法者说任何强硬派移民法案的命运将取决于十一月的州选举。
7e65efe316b6a8a975f8c19c6011aabd471be20c.translatedText: The Supreme Court hinted at encouraging states to strengthen anti-immigration laws. Lawmakers and anti-illegal immigration activists across the country are gearing up as the Supreme Court appears inclined to uphold parts of SB 1070, which could usher in a new wave of tough anti-illegal immigration laws. About a dozen states have expressed interest in introducing similar bills if key parts of the substate law are upheld by the Supreme Court. A decision in the federal Justice Department's case accusing Arizona of conflicts between state law and federal immigration policy is expected in June. Gehen, chairman of the "Americans for Legal Immigration" group, said, "We believe we can pass this law." Stern, chairman of the "Americans for Immigration Reform", also said he was encouraged. That's because several justices hinted during oral arguments last Wednesday that they would recommend letting the state implement the most controversial part of the law - requiring police to check the immigration status of people they suspect are in the country illegally. Another provision allows police to arrest people suspected of being illegal immigrants without a warrant. "The justices sent a clear signal that states have a lot of room to act in this area," Stern said. "They will spend a lot of energy in the next few months examining all possibilities." If the June ruling supports Sub-Asia Bill 1070, states including Alabama, Georgia, Indiana, South Carolina and Utah will all move forward with similar measures. They have all passed relevant laws but have put them on hold, waiting for the high court's decision. "If Arizona does well, we will do well," said Alabama Sen. Beason. He proposed a law that would be tougher than Arizona's. In addition to requiring police to confirm a person's citizenship when stopping a vehicle for traffic violations, it also requires government agencies to confirm legal residence status when processing car license plates, children's enrollment in school and employment. Lawmakers in many states, such as Mississippi and Pennsylvania, say they would be eager to follow the model in Arizona and Alabama if the Supreme Court gives the green light. Republican Congressman Metcalfe of Pennsylvania, chairman of the House State Government Committee, said: "If you look at the polls, whether it is business owners, employers, small business owners or administrators, the majority of Americans support laws like 1070." Metcalf has introduced a bill that contains the legal provisions of SB1070 and is waiting for a favorable Supreme Court decision before introducing it in committee. In Mississippi, a tough anti-illegal immigration bill passed Congress earlier this year but was blocked by the Senate. Its backers plan to try again next year and hope the Supreme Court decision will give them guidance. Like Mississippi, South Dakota lawmakers rejected a measure based on the Arizona law, but the bill's sponsor, Republican state Rep. Steele, said he would push through again. In Rhode Island, state Rep. Palupo said he was pleased to see the Supreme Court's clear support for allowing state capitals to impose immigration laws. In several states where the majority party does not hold a supermajority, such as Iowa, Colorado, Montana and Kentucky, lawmakers say the fate of any hard-line immigration bill will depend on November state elections.

49f0f1db92d350537ba7352d01d1e2ad79b82c35.sourceText: 《移民改革法案》可望三四月提出？ 白宫发言人卡尼在9日的新闻发布会上再度强调，全面移民改革是奥巴马第二任期内的优先议题，他还暗示移民改革有可能列入欧巴马的就职演说或国情咨文演说。 回应有关人士担心奥巴马会先处理枪枝问题，又会把移民改革推迟进行，卡尼表示，奥巴马将于第二任期及早进行移民改革。 卡尼说，奥巴马将在国情咨文谈他的施政计划，暗示总统也会具体谈到移民改革计划。 据悉，相关国会议员将于奥巴马就职演说后，国情咨文演说前，公布《全面移民改革法案》的原则，法案可望于3，4月提出，最早将于夏天表决。 与债限问题，控枪法案等比起来，移民改革法案反而成为两党共同致力，而可能过关的案子。 《全面移民改革法案》最重要的部分是非法移民大赦，全国1100万非法移民可望翻身。目前的争议关键，在于这些人能否成为公民。该法案也将包含《梦想法案》。 法案还将硬性规定全面使用核实雇员身分的联邦电子身分验证系统(E-VERIFY)。 这将是1986年移民大赦以来，影响最广泛的移民法案。 此次总统大选，73%的亚太裔选民和70%的西语裔选民，都投票给欧巴马总统，共和党人也在国会选举失利。这些都为共和党人敲了警钟。 由此可见，国会通过全面移民改革法案的可能性大增，因为共和党人再也输不起西语裔选票。
49f0f1db92d350537ba7352d01d1e2ad79b82c35.translatedText: Is the Immigration Reform Bill expected to be introduced in March or April? White House spokesman Carney once again emphasized at a press conference on the 9th that comprehensive immigration reform is a priority issue during Obama's second term. He also hinted that immigration reform may be included in Obama's inaugural address or State of the Union address. In response to concerns from some people that Obama would deal with the gun issue first and delay immigration reform, Carney said that Obama would carry out immigration reform as early as possible in his second term. Carney said Obama will talk about his policy plans in the State of the Union address, hinting that the president will also talk specifically about immigration reform plans. It is reported that relevant members of Congress will announce the principles of the "Comprehensive Immigration Reform Act" after Obama's inauguration speech and before the State of the Union address. The bill is expected to be proposed in March or April, and will be voted on as early as the summer. Compared with debt limit issues, gun control bills, etc., the immigration reform bill has become a case that the two parties can work together to pass. The most important part of the "Comprehensive Immigration Reform Act" is the amnesty for illegal immigrants. The 11 million illegal immigrants across the country are expected to be exonerated. The key to the current controversy is whether these people can become citizens. The bill will also include the DREAM Act. The bill will also mandate the full use of the federal Electronic Identity Verification System (E-VERIFY) to verify employee identities. This will be the most sweeping immigration bill since the 1986 immigration amnesty. In this presidential election, 73% of Asian-Pacific voters and 70% of Hispanic voters voted for President Obama, and Republicans also lost in congressional elections. These are a wake-up call for Republicans. It can be seen that the possibility of Congress passing a comprehensive immigration reform bill has greatly increased, because Republicans can no longer afford to lose Hispanic votes.

c54ddcb986bf11d3bd67dab7bd6ca13c636290e3.sourceText: 七、不系安全帶 。乘坐私家車、校車及配有安全帶的大客車時均須系上安全帶。不滿8歲或身高不到4英尺9英寸（144厘米）的兒童乘車須使用兒童安全座椅。
c54ddcb986bf11d3bd67dab7bd6ca13c636290e3.translatedText: 7. Do not wear seat belts. Seat belts must be worn when riding in private cars, school buses and buses equipped with seat belts. Children under 8 years old or less than 4 feet 9 inches (144 centimeters) tall must use a child safety seat.

e32dcbc952a9f7072c77c3b68d7891a550a62794.sourceText: 八、不為特種車讓行。 法律規定，道路行駛車輛在遇到警車、消防車、救護車鳴笛或校車閃爍紅燈等情形時，應盡快避讓并停車，等待此類車輛先行。
e32dcbc952a9f7072c77c3b68d7891a550a62794.translatedText: 8. Do not give way to special vehicles. The law stipulates that when road vehicles encounter situations such as police cars, fire trucks, ambulance sirens or school buses flashing red lights, they should avoid and stop as soon as possible and wait for such vehicles to go ahead.

0d9bb4bbbe741044dbf0d9f7408ba7043581bd55.sourceText: 九、忽視行人優先。 遇到行人穿越馬路，不論路口是否有交通信号燈，不論道路是否标識人行橫道線或過街行人是否違章，行進車輛均須提前在安全距離停車讓行。加州允許自行車上公路，行進車輛須與其至少保持3英尺（約1米）距離。盡管法律規定車輛必須為行人讓行，但仍存在違章過街未被駕駛員及時發現而被撞擊的風險。行人要随時留意周圍安全，尤其要避免邊走邊低頭看手機等分散注意力的行為。
0d9bb4bbbe741044dbf0d9f7408ba7043581bd55.translatedText: 9. Ignoring pedestrian priority. When encountering pedestrians crossing the road, regardless of whether there is a traffic light at the intersection, whether the road is marked with a crosswalk or whether the pedestrian crossing the street is violating the regulations, the moving vehicle must stop at a safe distance in advance to give way. California allows bicycles on the road, but moving vehicles must keep at least 3 feet (about 1 meter) away from them. Although the law stipulates that vehicles must give way to pedestrians, there is still a risk of being hit if the driver violates the rules when crossing the street without being noticed in time. Pedestrians should pay attention to their surroundings at all times, and especially avoid distracting behaviors such as looking down at their mobile phones while walking.

4fc5a92e3b8ffcc162531b4054c147b07bcb2fba.sourceText: 十、未買保險。 駕車人員必須購買汽車責任險，以在事故發生後賠償對方的損失。加州最低責任險(單人事故最多賠償1.5萬美元，最高保額3萬美元）往往不夠償付損失，建議購買賠付5萬或10萬美元的責任險。還可購買賠償本人車損的綜合保險和未投保駕駛人險（Uninsured Motorist，可在對方無保險或保險不足時賠償本人的損失）。
4fc5a92e3b8ffcc162531b4054c147b07bcb2fba.translatedText: > 10. Not buying insurance. Motorists must purchase automobile liability insurance to compensate the other party for their losses after an accident. California's minimum liability insurance (maximum compensation for a single accident is US$15,000, maximum coverage is US$30,000) is often not enough to cover losses, so it is recommended to purchase liability insurance that pays US$50,000 or US$100,000. You can also purchase comprehensive insurance to compensate for your own car damage and Uninsured Motorist insurance (which can compensate you for your losses when the other party has no insurance or insufficient insurance).

17a6fa7f76e1926a9a8c811c4ed7fad28ad114d5.sourceText: 十一、無視警方出庭通知。 警察開出的單據是出庭通知（Notice to Appear），簽署并不表示認罰。如果駕車人拒絕簽字或争辯，可能會以妨礙司法罪名而被逮捕。不管是否收到法院的通知，你本人或委托人應提前到法院查詢并及時出庭，否則可能會以藐視法庭罪而被通緝。
17a6fa7f76e1926a9a8c811c4ed7fad28ad114d5.translatedText: 11. Ignore the police notice to appear in court. The document issued by the police is a Notice to Appear, and signing does not mean that you accept the penalty. If a motorist refuses to sign or argue, he or she may be arrested for obstruction of justice. Regardless of whether you have received a notice from the court, you or your client should check with the court in advance and appear in court promptly, otherwise you may be wanted for contempt of court.

574562d9d777a051c985ed3c355ef5f6fe98c499.sourceText: 十二、車禍逃逸。 如果發生道路交通事故，無論責任在誰，駕車者均須與對方交換駕駛人員信息（駕照）、車輛信息、保險等相關資料，并記下目擊證人姓名及聯系方式等，也可用手機等攝錄事發現場。在與路邊停放車輛發生交通事故又無法找到車主時，須在被撞的汽車上留下自己的聯絡方式等資料。如事故中發生人員傷亡，應立即撥打911報警，等候救護人員到場。
574562d9d777a051c985ed3c355ef5f6fe98c499.translatedText: > 12. Escape from car accident. If a road traffic accident occurs, no matter who is responsible, the driver must exchange driver information (driver's license), vehicle information, insurance and other relevant information with the other party, and write down the names and contact information of witnesses. You can also use your mobile phone to record the scene of the accident. When a traffic accident occurs with a vehicle parked on the roadside and the owner cannot be found, you must leave your contact information and other information on the hit car. If there are casualties in the accident, call 911 immediately and wait for ambulance personnel to arrive.

82b08c1a5d6f3d7c6c86e8aed5414499ed0fd112.sourceText: 十三、使用手機。 禁止在駕車時手持或使用手機等通訊設備。如需使用要通過免提或車載藍牙等設備，但兩耳不得同時佩戴耳機。
82b08c1a5d6f3d7c6c86e8aed5414499ed0fd112.translatedText: > 13. Use mobile phones. It is prohibited to hold or use mobile phones and other communication devices while driving. If you need to use it, you must use a hands-free or car Bluetooth device, but you must not wear headphones on both ears at the same time.

b58dced0e09dd2c8e3cda8864d9c21344872d680.sourceText: 十四、車内存放貴重物品。 在車内，特别是顯眼處擺放行李箱、手提包等物品易招致不法分子破窗偷盜，且此類财物被盜案件破案率極低，通常難以挽回損失。
b58dced0e09dd2c8e3cda8864d9c21344872d680.translatedText: > 14. Store valuables in the car. Placing suitcases, handbags and other items in a car, especially in conspicuous places, can easily lead to criminals breaking windows and stealing them. In addition, the detection rate of such property theft cases is very low, and it is usually difficult to recover the losses.

f9dc8f7c43b9dcd75200fe0e842d3ac74a904461.sourceText: 駐洛杉矶總領館在此提醒領區内中國公民， 遵守交規 、 謹慎駕車是法律規定的義務，直接關系到 他人 和 您 本人 的安 全 。 強烈建議中國公民來美駕車前，事先閱讀并掌握目的地各州的駕車規定：

313d0c50c2e94c6a7377d5cf1daae1c4d4338ef3.sourceText: （转载于新华网）美国亚利桑那州24日发生一起车祸，4名中国游客身亡。中国游客在海外遇难后，中国驻洛杉矶总领馆从事领事保护的工作人员进入紧张工作状态。
313d0c50c2e94c6a7377d5cf1daae1c4d4338ef3.translatedText: (Reprinted on Xinhuanet) A car accident occurred in Arizona, the United States, on the 24th, and four Chinese tourists died. After a Chinese tourist died overseas, the consular protection staff of the Chinese Consulate General in Los Angeles entered a tense working state.

e2fc442d3b18f808378c2dae3d47cf431308654d.sourceText: 事发后，洛杉矶总领馆工作人员第一时间与亚利桑那州警方取得联系，从官方证实4名来自广东省的中国公民在该州西北部金曼市附近因车祸身亡。
e2fc442d3b18f808378c2dae3d47cf431308654d.translatedText: After the incident, the staff of the Consulate General in Los Angeles contacted the Arizona police immediately and received official confirmation that four Chinese citizens from Guangdong Province died in a car accident near Kingman in the northwest of the state.

94cb720669800302e6d346f734a0c99fae3237e6.sourceText: 总领馆立即通过广东省外事办及公安部门核查死者身份，及时获得死者家属信息。总领馆在与家属取得联系通报事发情况的同时着手协助家属办理护照和赴美手续，帮助焦急的家属能及时到美国处理后事。
94cb720669800302e6d346f734a0c99fae3237e6.translatedText: The Consulate General immediately verified the identity of the deceased through the Guangdong Provincial Foreign Affairs Office and the Public Security Department, and obtained the information of the deceased’s family in a timely manner. The Consulate General contacted the family members to inform them of the incident, and at the same time assisted the family members in applying for passports and procedures for traveling to the United States, helping the anxious family members to go to the United States in time to handle funeral arrangements.

cf1ef752d8276740d91b7fa5325d091e59dffe55.sourceText: 洛杉矶总领馆领侨组领事周咏梅表示，领馆在事发后一手积极为家属提供来美便利，一手与亚利桑那州警方保持密切沟通，领馆在遇难者家属抵达后将陪同家属赴亚利桑那州协助处理后事。
cf1ef752d8276740d91b7fa5325d091e59dffe55.translatedText: Zhou Yongmei, Consul of the Consular Section of the Consulate General in Los Angeles, said that after the incident, the consulate actively provided convenience for the family members to come to the United States and maintained close communication with the Arizona police. After the families of the victims arrived, the consulate will accompany the family members to Arizona to help handle the funeral arrangements.

60c9bddce0a947a21ceb87a36047fb09b85c4326.sourceText: 开支削减 部分被关移民或被释放 据《纽约每日新闻》报道，新泽西州勃艮县（Bergen County）位于哈肯萨克（Hackensack）的监狱系统可能释放被ICE拘留的移民。 为节省资金，那家联邦机构星期一开始释放被拘押在全美监狱和拘留中心的部分移民。 ICE发言人克里斯顿森（Gillian Christensen）说，随着联邦预算削减3月1日就要到来，ICE指示各地办公室审议被拘留的人员，要保证被拘留人数同资金水平一致。 克里斯顿森没有给出多少移民会处于”监视性释放”的数字。权益人士和移民律师估计会出现”大规模释放”，其中新泽西、亚利桑那、路易斯安那、得克萨斯和佛罗里达的拘留设施都将释放数十人。 长岛移民律师约翰逊（Bryan Johnson）说，一名客户告诉他，新泽西勃艮县监狱告诉狱警释放12名移民。
60c9bddce0a947a21ceb87a36047fb09b85c4326.translatedText: Spending cuts, some detained immigrants may be released. According to the "New York Daily News", the prison system of Bergen County, New Jersey (Bergen County) in Hackensack (Hackensack) may release immigrants detained by ICE. To save money, the federal agency on Monday began releasing some immigrants held in prisons and detention centers across the United States. ICE spokesperson Gillian Christensen said that with federal budget cuts approaching on March 1, ICE is directing offices to review detainees to ensure that the number of detainees is consistent with funding levels. Christensen did not give a figure for how many immigrants would be placed on "supervised release." Rights activists and immigration attorneys anticipate "mass releases," with dozens of people released from detention facilities in New Jersey, Arizona, Louisiana, Texas and Florida. Long Island immigration lawyer Bryan Johnson said a client told him that the Burgundy County Jail in New Jersey told guards to release 12 immigrants.

203cbedfc0f29cf588dbbfdf7759ec5e755ca109.sourceText: 第三家航空公司入驻美莎门户机场 （亚省时报）美莎市官员说，第三家航空公司已确定入驻门户机场。 凤凰棗美莎门户机场位于美莎市郊区，是由已退役的威廉斯空军基地改建而成的民用机场，目的是为日益饱和的凤凰城空港机场解压。目前有精神航空和忠诚航空两个公司入驻，其中忠诚航空经营国内33条航线，精神航空有11条航线。

Phoenix Zaomeisha Gateway Airport is located in the suburbs of Mesa City. It is a civilian airport converted from the retired Williams Air Force Base with the purpose of relieving the pressure of the increasingly saturated Phoenix Airport. Currently, there are two companies, Spirit Airlines and Allegiant Airlines, operating 33 domestic routes and Spirit Airlines operating 11 routes.

(Contributed by the Organizing Committee to Celebrate the 20th Anniversary of Hong Kong's Return) 2017 is the year of Hong Kong...

d4d42e54df6403f5d3dd42068debbcca27c25930.sourceText: （庆祝香港回归二十周年筹委会供稿）2017年是香港回归二十周年，美国当地时间6月17日晚，由亚利桑那州华人华侨总会（ACA亚省华总）、亚利桑那州华人华侨联合总会（ACUA）联合大凤凰城地区侨界共同举办的庆祝香港回归二十周年座谈会在凤凰城隆重举行。中国驻洛杉矶总领事馆侨务组组长王学政领事、陈晓毅领事，亚利桑那州各侨团代表、港澳台侨胞代表、美国友人等六十余人出席了座谈会。
d4d42e54df6403f5d3dd42068debbcca27c25930.translatedText: (Contributed by the Organizing Committee to Celebrate the 20th Anniversary of Hong Kong's Return) 2017 is the 20th anniversary of Hong Kong's Return, local time in the United States in June On the evening of the 17th, a symposium to celebrate the 20th anniversary of Hong Kong's return to China was held in Phoenix, co-organized by the Arizona Chinese Association (ACA), the Arizona Chinese Association (ACUA) and the overseas Chinese community in the greater Phoenix area. More than 60 people attended the symposium, including Consul Wang Xuezheng and Consul Chen Xiaoyi, leaders of the Overseas Chinese Affairs Section of the Chinese Consulate General in Los Angeles, representatives of overseas Chinese delegations in Arizona, representatives of overseas Chinese from Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan, and American friends.

2a45cbc1c3f551e538df8f843383df7290f9c18c.sourceText: 座谈会由亚利桑那州华人总会会长袁亚华、理事长杨文田、荣誉会长徐强、亚利桑那州华人华侨联合总会会长吴宁、理事长吴亮祖、旅美科学家工程师专业人士协会凤凰城分会（科工专）会长李江、理事长李雨共同召集，华人总会会长袁亚华、凤凰城大学管理学院课程部院长孙颖共同主持座谈会。
2a45cbc1c3f551e538df8f843383df7290f9c18c.translatedText: The symposium was hosted by Arizona Chinese Federation President Yuan Yahua, Chairman Yang Wentian, Honorary President Xu Qiang, Arizona Chinese Federation President Wu Ning, Chairman Wu Liangzu , Li Jiang, President of the Phoenix Branch (Science and Engineering Professionals) of the Association of Scientists and Engineers in the United States (Science and Engineering), and Li Yu, the Chairman, co-convened the symposium. Yuan Yahua, President of the Chinese Federation, and Sun Ying, Dean of the Curriculum Department of the School of Management of the University of Phoenix, co-chaired the symposium.

597f2a0dc1bb77409264ec6b7b2dc24677b4e828.sourceText: 王学政领事在致辞中回顾中国通过外交谈判成功解决香港问题实现香港回归的历史，强调中央政府将坚定不移贯彻”一国两制”方针和基本法，不动摇、 不变形、 不走样，坚定不移支持香港依法推进民主发展，坚定不移维护香港长期繁荣稳定，并严格按照宪法和基本法框架使香港政制发展、法治进步、社会变革，他充分肯定了亚利桑那州侨胞在参加中美文化交流、促进香港地区和美国当地的交流与往来，在反对港独、支持一国两制、港人治港、高度自治、促进祖国统一等方面都发挥了积极作用，此时此刻举办庆祝香港回归二十周年座谈会具有历史性纪念意义。
597f2a0dc1bb77409264ec6b7b2dc24677b4e828.translatedText: In his speech, Consul Wang Xuezheng reviewed the history of China's successful settlement of the Hong Kong issue through diplomatic negotiations and the return of Hong Kong, stressing that the central government will unswervingly implement the "one country, two systems" policy and the Basic Law, and will not waver, deform, or He will not be out of shape, unswervingly support Hong Kong in promoting democratic development in accordance with the law, unswervingly safeguard Hong Kong's long-term prosperity and stability, and strictly follow the framework of the Constitution and Basic Law to develop Hong Kong's political system, progress in the rule of law, and achieve social change. He fully affirmed the overseas Chinese in Arizona in participating in Sino-US cultural exchanges , promote exchanges and exchanges between Hong Kong and the United States, and have played an active role in opposing Hong Kong independence, supporting one country, two systems, Hong Kong people governing Hong Kong, a high degree of autonomy, and promoting the reunification of the motherland. It is of historic commemorative significance to hold a symposium to celebrate the 20th anniversary of Hong Kong's return at this moment.

e8ec2ab301e4bae1e82090185edad2f78e2d0b7d.sourceText: 座谈会召集人杨文田代表筹委会在致辞中阐述中央政府在香港实施”一国两制”的成功实践对祖国完成统一大业的特殊重大意义，香港回归二十年来，在政治、经济、民生等方面取得了瞩目成就，今年六月香港蝉联全球最具竞争力经济体榜首，中央与香港在”一国两制”框架下共同致力于香港的繁荣稳定，中央始终是香港的最强后盾，重视香港在国家发展全局中的重要地位和作用，在维护国家核心利益的重要问题上坚定不移与祖国保持一致。
e8ec2ab301e4bae1e82090185edad2f78e2d0b7d.translatedText: The convener of the symposium, Yang Wentian, on behalf of the Preparatory Committee, elaborated in his speech on behalf of the Preparatory Committee that the central government's successful implementation of "one country, two systems" in Hong Kong has special significance for the motherland to complete the great cause of reunification. In the past 20 years since Hong Kong's return to the motherland, Hong Kong has witnessed political and economic changes. Hong Kong has made remarkable achievements in areas such as health and people's livelihood. In June this year, Hong Kong continued to rank first among the world's most competitive economies. The central government and Hong Kong are jointly committed to Hong Kong's prosperity and stability under the "one country, two systems" framework. The central government has always been Hong Kong's strongest backer, attaches great importance to Hong Kong's important position and role in the overall development of the country, and remains unswervingly consistent with the motherland on important issues of safeguarding the country's core interests.

ded29cb83d6c10de320b97086d227d160067aa44.sourceText: 侨届元老余文劲发表热情洋溢的讲话，赞叹中国近代的发展成就，大力支持侨社活动；钱德勒市议员黄馨民希望更多在美华人参加竞选，服务华人社区，为中美友好关系牵线搭桥；侨联顾问邓朝驹20年前在香港作为嘉宾参加回归典礼，见证香港回归的历史时刻；徐强在致辞中表示，香港回归充分体现中国国力的日益强大，彰显中国人民的胸襟和胆略、勇气和智慧；侨联总会英文秘书余文焯、凤凰城开平市姐妹城市委员会主席梅树德先后作了精彩的发言；李江讲述八十年代起海外学子建设香港、报效祖国的感人事迹；吴亮祖列举香港百年历史的重要事件，分析”一带一路”、自由贸易区等重大战略机遇，使得香港日益成为跨国公司拓展内地与亚洲业务的首选；州立大学陈怀宇教授在发言中肯定香港在文物拍卖和文化艺术交流方面对祖国做出的重要贡献；前图森中文学校校长陈荣基在发言中希望华人鼓励孩子学习中文和中国历史，努力培养孩子成为刚健有为、自强不息的新一代华人；著名作家戴定国分享凤凰城侨社在1997年庆祝香港回归的纪念活动报道，并朗读了他的文章《愿东方之珠更加辉煌灿烂》；州立大学中国学生学者联谊会会长主席李赫讲述内地学生报考香港大学和香港学生报考内地院校的故事。
ded29cb83d6c10de320b97086d227d160067aa44.translatedText: > Yu Wenjin, a veteran of the overseas Chinese community, delivered a passionate speech, praising China's development achievements in modern times and strongly supporting the activities of overseas Chinese communities; Chandler City Councilor Huang Xinmin hopes that more Chinese in the United States will participate in the election, serve the Chinese community, and bridge the friendly relations between China and the United States; Deng Chaoju, consultant of the Federation of Overseas Chinese, attended the handover ceremony as a guest in Hong Kong 20 years ago and witnessed the return of Hong Kong. Historical moment; Xu Qiang said in his speech that the return of Hong Kong fully reflects the growing strength of China's national power and demonstrates the broad-mindedness and courage, courage and wisdom of the Chinese people; Yu Wenzhuo, English secretary of the Federation of Overseas Chinese, and Mei Shude, chairman of the Phoenix Kaiping Sister City Committee, made wonderful speeches; Li Jiang told the touching stories of overseas students building Hong Kong and serving the motherland since the 1980s; Wu Liangzu listed Hong Kong's century-old history Important historical events and analysis of major strategic opportunities such as the "Belt and Road Initiative" and the Free Trade Zone have made Hong Kong increasingly the first choice for multinational companies to expand business in the mainland and Asia; Professor Chen Huaiyu of State University affirmed Hong Kong's important contributions to the motherland in terms of cultural relic auctions and cultural and artistic exchanges in his speech; Chen Rongji, the former principal of Tucson Chinese School, hoped in his speech that Chinese people would encourage their children to learn Chinese and China History, striving to cultivate children to become a vigorous and self-improving new generation of Chinese; the famous writer Dai Dingguo shared the report of the Phoenix Overseas Chinese Community's commemorative activities celebrating the return of Hong Kong in 1997, and read his article "May the Pearl of the Orient Be More Glorious"; Li He, the president of the Chinese Students and Scholars Association of State University, told the stories of mainland students applying to Hong Kong universities and Hong Kong students applying to mainland institutions.

2f022c665d4859a8782b366c4eea14d1e76b9463.sourceText: 二十载风风雨雨，紫荆花开分外艳，东方之珠放异彩，在两个小时的座谈会中，参会代表们共同回顾香港的辉煌历史、展望美好的未来，用事实讲述香港回归祖国、实施”一国两制”的成功实践，盛赞香港回归20周年取得的瞩目成就，海外侨胞有信心、有理由相信香港将在祖国母亲的怀抱里再次腾飞，祝愿香港更加繁荣稳定、再创辉煌，祝愿中国更加富强昌盛！
2f022c665d4859a8782b366c4eea14d1e76b9463.translatedText: After twenty years of ups and downs, the bauhinia blossoms are exceptionally beautiful, and the Pearl of the Orient shines brightly. During the two-hour symposium, participating representatives reviewed Hong Kong's glorious history, looked forward to a bright future, and used facts to tell the story of Hong Kong's return to the motherland and the implementation of "one country, two systems" The successful practice of Hong Kong has praised the remarkable achievements made on the 20th anniversary of Hong Kong's return to the motherland. Overseas Chinese have confidence and reason to believe that Hong Kong will take off again in the embrace of the motherland. They wish Hong Kong will be more prosperous and stable and create greater glory, and wish China a more prosperous and prosperous society!

592ef50952b0350cf360a7a5f721a6e58c60eecf.sourceText: 亚利桑那州华人华侨庆祝香港回归祖国二十周年座谈会得到侨社各界人士的大力支持，筹委会通过媒体表示衷心的感谢！因为座谈会的座位安排有限，还有部分人士无法参会，筹委会在此表示歉意！ 参加此次座谈会的还有凤凰城市政府华人长者服务中心主任裴霞云、凤凰城友城委员会公关部的部长Adam Yee；爱国友人Jennifer Esther Leung 、Justin Joshua Chee；亚省川渝联谊会会长程晓丽、云南同乡会理事长李明良、亚省枪会会长崔鑫；亚省华总副会长胡珍、前科工专会长杨夏、UA大学中国学生学者联谊会前会长仇玺源、亚利桑那州立大学中国学生学者联谊会副会长郭祥超、科工专龙舟队队长黄俊哲；侨社爱国人士林泉先生、新东方学院校长于华、亚省历史协会副会长、著名作家唐孝先、亚省历史协会秘书长余明信、亚省历史协会理事阮蔼明、理事黄丽容；美国国际合作交流协会顾问马向明、亚省青年商会副会长崔煜龙、旅美科学家工程师专业人士协会凤凰城分会代表晨阳；整形外科医生杜国玲、亚省高科技协会主席邱恬、一周报社长胡珊、凤凰城华美半导体协会会长张映平、亚美报记者Rebecca 李；亚省山东同乡会会长王萧莉、亚省山东同乡会代表曲涛、亚省越华会会长黄海、亚省越华会副会长周永新；亚省华总常务理事张扶滔、北美枫香凤凰话剧社负责人肖宇、摄影家艺柳白、著名作家汪静玉、美西侨报社长方惠贤、福建联谊会代表陈雪英；”太阳鸟”亚利桑那华人网网站负责人谢成彦、侨社爱囯人士乔金姊、武德钟、李爱珍、魏露莹；美国国际合作交流协会顾问曾志达、姜雪晖律师、亚利桑那州立大学教授姜南、亚省华总常务理事倪庆霄等（鸣谢名单按参会报名先后顺序）。筹委会向为此次座谈会提供赞助的余文劲、杨文田、吴宁表示感谢！

d4fc79db6789743811434bc5061b23ae62f17329.sourceText: 西南航空遭威胁 航班急降凤城 （亚省时报） 当局正调查西南航空航班遭受威胁的事故。 周二晚，西南航空公司收到三个恐吓消息，威胁在三架737飞机放置威胁物品。其中1184从加州橙县的约翰韦恩机场飞往奥克拉荷马的托沙，西南航空将其紧急降落凤凰城的空港机场，接受FBI联合反恐特遣部队和凤凰城警察署的现场排查。 根据西南航空发言人阿什利狄龙说，1184航班有乘客125人，包括5名机组成员，起飞不久接获机上可能有威胁物品消息，即与航管局和FBI联络，7点30分在凤凰城空港机场降落，凤凰城警方关闭了机场附近道路，只留紧急车辆出入。反恐探员上机检查，当局没有公布是否在机上发现任何威胁物品。 相似的恐吓还有两宗，都在加州，除了1184航班外，航班811原本从橙县飞往凤凰城，在起飞前接获威胁后便取消飞行。另一班机威胁已排除，乘客重新登机飞往目的地。 到9日凌晨，两架飞机都被确定安全，但停留在原地，乘客被安排新的班机离开。
d4fc79db6789743811434bc5061b23ae62f17329.translatedText: Southwest Airlines flight was threatened and flight made emergency landing in Fengcheng (Alberta Times) The authorities are investigating the threat to Southwest Airlines flight. On Tuesday night, Southwest Airlines received three threatening messages threatening to place threatening items on three 737 aircraft. Among them, 1,184 were flying from John Wayne Airport in Orange County, California to Tosha, Oklahoma. Southwest Airlines made an emergency landing at Phoenix Airport and underwent on-site investigation by the FBI Joint Terrorism Task Force and the Phoenix Police Department. According to Southwest Airlines spokesperson Ashley Dillon, Flight 1184 had 125 passengers, including five crew members. Shortly after takeoff, they received news that there might be threatening items on board. They contacted the aviation authority and the FBI and landed at the Phoenix Airport at 7:30. Phoenix police closed the roads near the airport, leaving only emergency vehicles in and out. Anti-terrorism agents inspected the aircraft, but authorities did not announce whether any threatening items were found on board. There were two other similar threats, both in California. In addition to Flight 1184, Flight 811 was originally flying from Orange County to Phoenix. The flight was canceled after receiving threats before departure. The threat to the other flight was eliminated and passengers reboarded to their destination. By the early morning of the 9th, both planes were determined to be safe, but they stayed in place and passengers were arranged to take new flights to leave.

632fee2b3381143ea6db7b15974c6586b882da04.sourceText: 亚利桑那州立法通过免征收黄金白银所得税。这意味着在该州，贵金属已成为与美元并驾齐驱的合法货币。
632fee2b3381143ea6db7b15974c6586b882da04.translatedText: Arizona legislation passed to exempt gold and silver from income tax. This means that in the state, the precious metal has become a legal currency alongside the U.S. dollar.

6118c6ef88a1004dd45b564330c3f7a196702b4a.sourceText: 周三，亚利桑那州参议院以16-13的票数，批准取消本州贵金属的所有征税。该法案会交到州长Doug Duccey，由他签署使之生效。
6118c6ef88a1004dd45b564330c3f7a196702b4a.translatedText: On Wednesday, the Arizona Senate voted 16-13 to approve the elimination of all taxes on precious metals in the state. The bill will go to Governor Doug Duccey for his signature.

e0368ca14cdb5cf5feafe32501d60c91e5468047.sourceText: 众议院法案2014是由众议员Mark Finchem（R-Tucson）提出。法案旨在使亚利桑那州纳税人可以在他们的联邦税收计算亚利桑那州经调总收入（AGI）中去掉贵金属相关的盈亏。
e0368ca14cdb5cf5feafe32501d60c91e5468047.translatedText: House Bill 2014 was introduced by Rep. Mark Finchem (R-Tucson). The bill seeks to allow Arizona taxpayers to exclude precious metals-related gains and losses from their federal tax calculations of Arizona Adjusted Gross Income (AGI).

1c76ba8915032d2cc8da92cc407883d91c6f9064.sourceText: Sound Money防御联盟、前美国总统候选人Ron Paul以及自由运动帮助确保HB2014能通过。他们觉得该方案可以打破美联储对货币供给的垄断。
1c76ba8915032d2cc8da92cc407883d91c6f9064.translatedText: The Sound Money Defense Alliance, former US presidential candidate Ron Paul, and the liberal movement helped ensure the passage of HB2014. They felt the plan could break the Fed's monopoly on the money supply.

d6bcca246b430181dc5570158e3af9e664735657.sourceText: Sound Money防御联盟的副主任Jp Cortez认为，因为美联储的货币政策导致通胀，纳税人需持有黄金来对抗纸币的贬值。当他们把黄金兑换成美元，他们是赚的。然而，考虑到实际的购买平价，他们未必真的是赚了。他们所赚取的只是名义上的盈利，因为美元在缓慢地、持续地贬值中。
d6bcca246b430181dc5570158e3af9e664735657.translatedText: Jp Cortez, deputy director of the Sound Money Defense Alliance, believes that because the Federal Reserve's monetary policy causes inflation, taxpayers need to hold gold to combat the depreciation of banknotes. When they exchange gold for dollars, they make money. However, considering the actual purchase parity, they may not actually make a profit. What they are making is nominal profit because the dollar is slowly and continuously depreciating.

642923790b89bb344ae5e761f47ea711acd7ac04.sourceText: Sound Money防御联盟主任Stefan Bleason称亚利桑那州正在引导大家保卫自己的钱袋子，让公民在遇到美联储滥用政策导致通胀与金融危机时能够保护自己的财富。 Ron Paul表示：
642923790b89bb344ae5e761f47ea711acd7ac04.translatedText: > Stefan Bleason, director of the Sound Money Defense Alliance, said Arizona is guiding everyone to defend their pocketbooks so that citizens can protect their wealth when the Federal Reserve's abusive policies lead to inflation and financial crises. Ron Paul said:

9a74c994c28fc27df2411b55807cd8bbd12c76f6.sourceText: HB2014是一份重要且及时的立法文件。美联储并未能通过史上最低利率来让经济从上次危机中复苏，这是美元不久就要崩溃的信号。因而通过一份旨在保护公民使用替代货币的法案实在必行，公民可以用替代货币对抗即将分文不值的纸币。
9a74c994c28fc27df2411b55807cd8bbd12c76f6.translatedText: >HB2014 is an important and timely legislative document. The Fed's failure to revive the economy from the last crisis with historically low interest rates is a sign that the dollar will soon collapse. It is therefore imperative to pass a bill aimed at protecting citizens’ use of alternative currencies against banknotes that are about to become worthless.

3b064115fe710ffb057a2b0464112abb0601443f.sourceText: 此前黄金头条有提及，3月中旬，由共和党把持的爱达荷州众议院以压倒优势，批准取消贵金属资本利得税和所得税，如果再得到参议院批准，未来当地黄金白银将获得几乎与美元同等货币地位。
3b064115fe710ffb057a2b0464112abb0601443f.translatedText: As previously mentioned in gold headlines, in mid-March, the Republican-controlled Idaho House of Representatives overwhelmingly approved the elimination of capital gains tax and income tax on precious metals. If approved by the Senate, local gold and silver will gain almost the same currency status as the U.S. dollar in the future.

891800de4af59e1d52d29ce9bca62f6767bd15eb.sourceText: 根据美国现行联邦法律，出售实物黄金最终要承担资本利得税，即以美元计算对黄金增值部分征税。在一些共和党人看来，这并非?#36164;本利得?#65292;而是由于美联储人为滥发货币，导致的货币贬值。
891800de4af59e1d52d29ce9bca62f6767bd15eb.translatedText: According to current U.S. federal law, the sale of physical gold is ultimately subject to capital gains tax, which is a tax on the appreciation of gold calculated in U.S. dollars. In the view of some Republicans, this is not?#36164;capital gain?#65292;but a devaluation of the currency caused by the Federal Reserve's artificial indiscriminate issuance of currency.

3cd4b44c309a70c5c808b4f27584e96037593030.sourceText: 包括犹他州以及俄克拉荷马州在内的其他州也在消除贵金属所得税问题上采取行动。另外一些州会返还贵金属的销售税或者是设立贵金属的托管来帮助公民保存与交易贵金属。
3cd4b44c309a70c5c808b4f27584e96037593030.translatedText: Other states, including Utah and Oklahoma, are also taking action to eliminate income taxes on precious metals. Other states will rebate the sales tax on precious metals or set up precious metal escrow to help citizens store and trade precious metals.
