7e9e2c6e6df486456f1b332b48568543cae759eb.sourceText: 舞蹈教授陈薇做客传艺 艺术总监邱晓榕回国取经——亚省艺术学院 （亚省艺术学院供稿） ”用心与舞蹈相连”这是亚省艺术学院的客座老师陈薇教授的舞蹈哲学。”轻轻撩起水波，感受天上漂浮的白云，亲吻醇厚的大地?.”这都是陈薇老师在教课时候用到的语句，她总是用最美的语言，描绘舞蹈中的故事，让每个演员用心去体会，再用舞蹈动作表现内心的感受。所有观众看到的，不仅是动作，更是一个用心演绎的艺术作品。 10月13日陈薇教授刚刚结束中国的行程，就应约来到”亚省艺术学院”给不同年纪的孩子们带来了一系列特别的培训。作为海外”桃李杯”的评委，陈老师说亚省艺术学院学生从小朋友到成人，基本功都非常扎实，老师的专业水平很高。这次她来就在学生的艺术表现上提出了更高的要求。舞蹈中的呼吸，每个动作的节奏，每个情绪的调动都是陈老师抓的重点，让学生们快乐地，美丽地去展现舞蹈。几堂课下来，学生在舞蹈理解上有很大的进步。上小课的学生额外加课，北校成人班，校外的舞蹈团体都纷纷报名参加陈薇老师的培训，陈薇老师的课程满满当当，这也是”亚省艺术学院”引进校外优秀老师客座的新尝试，未来我们还将不断地将其他州，甚至中国的高水平的老师请学校来客座教学。 另外，代表亚省艺术学院参加国务院侨办举办的文化中国，海外文化社团，中华才艺培训班的艺术总监邱晓榕老师也发来了视频和照片。本次培训，在中国十九大进行之时，来自全球十三国家的代表，受祖国之邀相聚一堂，作为”一带一路”的文化经济建设重要组成部分，受到了全世界广泛关注。中央电视台，陕西电视台全球直播报道开班仪式。民族民间舞，中国古典舞，腰鼓秧歌培训课程，让民族的声音走向世界。用文化敲开世界与中国的大门，让中华文化之声传扬世界。邱晓榕老师在培训班中，以专业的舞蹈技艺，脱颖而出。同时也与其他海外同人一起交流了舞蹈教学的经验，并展示了”亚省艺术学院”海外教学成果。 走出去，请进来，未来”亚省艺术学院”不仅会在教师培训上实行这个理念，更会组织更多交流演出，参加专业比赛。让老师和孩子们开阔眼界，专业更上一层楼。 陈薇老师（第三排左一）教学图片 邱晓榕（陕西西安）
7e9e2c6e6df486456f1b332b48568543cae759eb.translatedText: Dance professor Chen Wei is a guest to teach the art Artistic Director Qiu Xiaorong returned to China to learn from the experience—Alberta College of the Arts (Contributed by the Alberta College of the Arts) "Connecting the heart with dance" is the dance philosophy of Professor Chen Wei, a visiting teacher at the Art Institute of Alberta. "Gently stir up the water waves, feel the white clouds floating in the sky, and kiss the mellow earth?" These are the phrases that Teacher Chen Wei uses when teaching. She always uses the most beautiful language to describe the story in dance, allowing each actor to experience it with their heart, and then use dance movements to express their inner feelings. What all the audience sees is not only movements, but also an art work performed with heart. On October 13th, Professor Chen Wei just finished her trip to China and was invited to come to the "Alberta Art Institute" to give a series of special training to children of different ages. As a judge of the overseas "Taoli Cup", Teacher Chen said that the students of the Art Institute of Alberta have very solid basic skills from children to adults, and the teacher's professional level is very high. This time she came to put forward higher requirements for the students' artistic performance. The breathing in the dance, the rhythm of every movement, and the mobilization of every emotion are all from Chen. The teacher focuses on allowing students to perform dance happily and beautifully. After a few classes, students have made great progress in dance understanding. Students in small classes have taken extra classes, and dance groups from outside the school have signed up for teacher Chen Wei's training. Teacher Chen Wei's courses are full. This is also a new attempt by the "Alberta Art Institute" to introduce outstanding teachers from outside the school. In the future, we will continue to invite high-level teachers from other states and even China to teach as guests. In addition, art director Qiu Xiaorong, who represented the Art Institute of Alberta in the Cultural China, Overseas Cultural Association, and Chinese Talent Training Course organized by the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the State Council, also sent videos and photos. During the 19th National Congress of China, representatives from 13 countries around the world gathered together at the invitation of the motherland. As an important part of the cultural and economic construction of the "One Belt and One Road", it has received widespread attention from the world. CCTV, Shaanxi The opening ceremony was broadcast live on TV stations. Ethnic folk dance, Chinese classical dance, and waist drum yangko training courses bring the voice of the nation to the world. Use culture to open the door to the world and let the voice of Chinese culture spread to the world. Teacher Qiu Xiaorong stood out with her professional dance skills in the training class. At the same time, she also exchanged dance teaching experience with other overseas colleagues and demonstrated the overseas teaching results of the "Alberta Art Institute". Go out and come in. In the future, the "Alberta Art Institute" will not only implement this concept in teacher training, but also organize more exchange performances and participate in professional competitions to broaden the horizons of teachers and children and take their profession to a higher level. Teacher Chen Wei (third row, first from left) teaching photo Qiu Xiaorong (Xi'an, Shaanxi).

1a8737985313dc0b775f17595fd80e6000e5a753.sourceText: 中华民国(台湾)侨务委员会「洛杉矶华侨文教服务中心」副主任廖建勋，半个月内两度到访凤凰城，如果加上驻美代表高硕泰大使及驻洛杉矶办事处处长夏季昌等外交官，应邀出席美国职棒大联盟亚利桑那响尾蛇队主场，担任今年球季首週对洛杉矶队赛事开球佳宾，以及见证亚省参众议会通过友台决议桉，从事记者多年的经验，可明显感受到中华民国台湾政府，对于亚利桑那州的重视程度正在逐渐加温，这应该是旅居此间侨民之福。 二度莅临凤凰城访问，廖建勋副主任仍然受到热情欢迎，也感受到这裡的华人及侨民社区非常的活跃。他强烈认为这裡的政府对我们华人很支持，对中华民国台湾也很友好。他说「州参众议会通过友台决议，显示华人社区和台湾侨民们，长期努力耕耘才有如此的成果，大家对国民外交真的很有贡献。」 廖建勋副主任首次外派洛杉矶两个月，三月底第一次到凤凰城时，分别参加「斐匿黄氏宗亲会」祭祖、春宴；拜会「台湾同乡会」会长；主持侨务荣誉职人员座谈，并与传统侨社「侨联总会」属下各侨团首长餐敍，大家都对侨委会这位年轻副主任，为服务此间侨胞，台语、中文、英文及广东话都朗朗上口，两天马不停蹄，留下深刻印象，也建立了交情。 四月八、九日是廖建勋副主任第二次来访。他这次参加「美洲合胜堂凤凰城支堂」胜强别墅成立揭幕典礼暨春节联欢庆会，包括三藩市总堂、罗省、波伦、舍路、美利允、典化各支堂庆贺代表、侨团领袖与长老，都不远千里前来参加，支堂内外及春宴会场中华民国国旗飘扬，都让与会者觉得非常感动。 凤凰城侨务谘询委员高志中表示，廖副主任这麽短的期间两度来访，促成了侨社卅多年来少见的团结，侨民们不分政党，能一起团聚欢迎侨委会的官员，实在难得。对于合胜堂开幕剪彩、宴会，无论三藩市书记长陈龙赞及主席邝振国春，「美洲合胜总堂」黄炳衡总理、余文劲侨务谘询委员等人致词，都表示「合胜总堂」百多年来一直支持中华民国，推崇民主、自由理念，这真是侨委会多年来服务全侨很好的肯定。 短短半个月两度访问凤凰城，马不停蹄参加侨社活动，廖建勋副主任用行动证实侨务委员会很重视侨胞。对于有人在这裡指责中华民国(台湾)政府，廖副主任表示，我们有自己的主权当然要捍卫，希望大家各自努力，多用心为侨胞造福
1a8737985313dc0b775f17595fd80e6000e5a753.translatedText: Liao Jianxun, deputy director of the "Los Angeles Overseas Chinese Cultural and Educational Service Center" of the Overseas Chinese Affairs Commission of the Republic of China (Taiwan), visited Phoenix twice in half a month. If you include Ambassador Gao Shuotai, the representative in the United States, and Xia Chang, director of the Los Angeles Office, etc. The diplomat was invited to attend the home court of the Arizona Diamondbacks of the Major League Baseball League and served as the kickoff guest for the first week of this year's baseball season against Los Angeles. He also witnessed the Alberta Senate passing the Taiwan Friendship Resolution. With many years of experience as a reporter, it is obvious that the Taiwanese government of the Republic of China is paying more and more attention to Arizona. This should be a blessing for the expats living here. During his second visit to Phoenix, Deputy Director Liao Jianxun still received a warm welcome and felt that the Chinese and overseas Chinese communities here are very active. He strongly believes that the government here is very supportive of us Chinese and very friendly to Taiwan, the Republic of China. He said, "The passage of the friendship-Taiwan resolution by the state Senate shows that the Chinese community and Taiwanese expatriates have worked hard for a long time to achieve such results. Everyone has really contributed to national diplomacy." Deputy Director Liao Jianxun was first dispatched to Los Angeles for two months. When he first arrived in Phoenix at the end of March, he participated in the ancestor worship and spring banquet of the "Fei Nie Huang Clan Association"; met with the president of the "Taiwan Association"; hosted a discussion with honorary personnel of overseas Chinese affairs, and had discussions with traditional overseas Chinese societies The heads of the overseas Chinese groups under the "Overseas Chinese Federation" discussed the meal. Everyone was deeply impressed by the young deputy director of the Overseas Chinese Committee. In order to serve the overseas Chinese here, he spoke Taiwanese, Chinese, English and Cantonese fluently. He worked non-stop for two days, which left a deep impression and established a friendship. April 8th and 9th was Deputy Director Liao Jianxun’s second visit. This time, he attended the opening ceremony of the Shengqiang Villa and the Spring Festival Gala of the "Phoenix City Branch of American Hesheng Church". Representatives from the San Francisco Main Church, Luozhou, Bolan, Shelu, Meiliyun, and Dianhua branches, as well as leaders and elders of the overseas Chinese community, came from thousands of miles to attend. The flag of the Republic of China was flying inside and outside the branch and at the Spring Festival banquet venue, which made the participants feel very touched. Phoenix City Overseas Chinese Affairs Advisory Committee member Gao Zhizhong said that Deputy Director Liao's two visits in such a short period of time contributed to the unity that has been rare in the overseas Chinese community for more than 30 years. It is really rare for overseas Chinese, regardless of political party, to reunite together to welcome officials of the Overseas Chinese Affairs Council. Regarding the opening ribbon-cutting and banquet of Hop Sing Hall, San Francisco Secretary General Chen Longzan and Chairman Kuang Zhenguochun, as well as "Hop Sing Hall" Prime Minister Huang Bingheng, Yu Wenjin, Overseas Chinese Affairs Advisory Committee and others delivered speeches. They all said that "Hop Sing Hall" has supported the Republic of China for more than 100 years and promoted the concepts of democracy and freedom. This is really an affirmation of the Overseas Chinese Affairs Council's good service to all overseas Chinese over the years. In just half a month, he visited Phoenix City twice and participated in overseas Chinese community activities non-stop. Deputy Director Liao Jianxun confirmed with actions that the Overseas Chinese Affairs Commission attaches great importance to overseas Chinese. Regarding some people’s accusations against the Government of the Republic of China (Taiwan) here, Deputy Director Liao said that of course we have our own sovereignty and must defend it. I hope everyone will work hard and be more dedicated to benefiting the overseas Chinese

8d04d0db4c181aa779d8e4d45db738e474ddb574.sourceText: 廖建勋主任与凤凰城侨联总会和侨团领袖餐敍后合照
8d04d0db4c181aa779d8e4d45db738e474ddb574.translatedText: Director Liao Jianxun took a photo with the Phoenix Overseas Chinese Federation and the leaders of the overseas Chinese group after the meal

3c67910377decb0c26824776816a5ea925b3c915.sourceText: 【侨报网编译庞克6月27日报道】毫无疑问，中国的教育体系存在问题，片面强调死记硬背，不利于对学生道德的教育和课外活动能力的培养，中国也清楚地意识到这一点。中国的父母很担心，他们开始认清现实，即考试中的高分并不能转化成实际中的严谨思考能力，为改变现状，中国的父母开始寻求教育替代之路，选择其他的教育途径，这就是为什么中国学生纷纷涌向海外大学攻读学士、硕士和博士学位的原因。
3c67910377decb0c26824776816a5ea925b3c915.translatedText: [Punke report compiled by Qiaobao.com on June 27] There is no doubt that China’s education system has problems. The one-sided emphasis on rote learning is not conducive to students’ moral education and the cultivation of extracurricular activities. China is also clearly aware of this. Chinese parents are worried. They have begun to recognize the reality that high scores in exams cannot translate into rigorous thinking skills in practice. In order to change the status quo, Chinese parents have begun to seek alternative paths to education and choose other educational paths. This is why Chinese students are flocking to overseas universities to study for bachelor's, master's and doctoral degrees.

d74164e9d5364efafdeff058b014b498bf873cca.sourceText: 福布斯网站（forbes.com）报道，根据美国国际教育协会（Institute of International Education）以及美国国务院教育与文化事务局（Bureau of Educational and Cultural Affairs）的数据，2010 – 2011学年，中国学生在美国的大学入学率上升23%，至157558人，超过印度的103895人和韩国的73351人，中国也成为在美学校中最大的国际学生来源国。
d74164e9d5364efafdeff058b014b498bf873cca.translatedText: Forbes.com reports, based on data from the Institute of International Education and the Bureau of Educational and Cultural Affairs of the U.S. Department of State, 2010 – In the 2011 academic year, the enrollment rate of Chinese students in American universities increased by 23% to 157,558, surpassing India's 103,895 and South Korea's 73,351. China has also become the largest source of international students in American schools.

8c1baf1090743a3f85e9edfcfad8a2d24966544a.sourceText: 除了大学，高中也成为中国学生追逐的对象。美国则乐得其所，接受涌入的中国学生，不仅多样化了学生的构成，还为学校的创收作出了贡献。数据显示，中国家长也愿意花费巨额投资孩子的教育。
8c1baf1090743a3f85e9edfcfad8a2d24966544a.translatedText: In addition to universities, high schools have also become the targets of Chinese students. The United States is happy to accept the influx of Chinese students, which not only diversifies the composition of students, but also contributes to the revenue generation of schools. Data shows that Chinese parents are also willing to spend huge sums of money to invest in their children’s education.

11b6eaebbf210f5c775218663f3f2d9983366bfb.sourceText: 但是，与中国学生选择留学美国一样，毕业后这些学生都不约而同选择回归国内，而且很多学生最初也不是特别愿意离开中国，他们希望能够和家人离得更近，并且不愿错过中国的职业机会。
11b6eaebbf210f5c775218663f3f2d9983366bfb.translatedText: However, just like Chinese students who choose to study in the United States, these students all choose to return to China after graduation, and many students are not particularly willing to leave China at first. They hope to be closer to their families and do not want to miss career opportunities in China.

330d4ece19a0196a3b97325a5608fb7744fc1c8c.sourceText: 这就造成了一种矛盾，中国学生想要接受美国的教育，但又倾向待在国内。美国大学看准了这一良机，将美国教育搬到中国。杜克和纽约大学更是在上海建立校区，提供全日制教育，开创了”落地教育”的新模式。事实证明，这是一次成功的尝试。越来越多的美国大学选择与中国院校合作，中美学校合作趋势显现无疑。
330d4ece19a0196a3b97325a5608fb7744fc1c8c.translatedText: This creates a contradiction. Chinese students want to receive an American education, but they prefer to stay at home. American universities saw this opportunity and moved American education to China. Duke and New York University have even established campuses in Shanghai to provide full-time education, creating a new model of "on-the-ground education". This proved to be a successful endeavor. More and more American universities are choosing to cooperate with Chinese institutions, and the trend of cooperation between Chinese and American schools is undoubtedly evident.

6974e1f34c72374318ebdf04f4f4b850cbcc1a2d.sourceText: 福布斯专家称，美国大学大都知道提供什么样的教学课程，授予何种学位，如何定价，并保持学校和品牌的一致性。但是，还有一些特殊的地方，需要引起美国教育机构的格外注意：
6974e1f34c72374318ebdf04f4f4b850cbcc1a2d.translatedText: Forbes experts said that most American universities know what teaching courses to offer, what degrees to award, how to price, and to maintain the consistency of the school and brand. However, there are some special points that require special attention from American educational institutions:

cc860a635155eba286ee65dc06b4aaf461b50656.sourceText: 第一、 无论开展何种国际性的首创，都必须得到利害关系人的支持，尤其是学校中的一些荣誉教授，而且越早越好。另外，学校的员工也应该参与进来，这样可以避免潜在的冲突，特别是教学任务方面。
cc860a635155eba286ee65dc06b4aaf461b50656.translatedText: First, no matter what kind of international initiative is carried out, it must get the support of stakeholders, especially some honorary professors in the school, and the sooner the better. In addition, school staff should be involved so that potential conflicts can be avoided, especially regarding teaching assignments.

3c64a69278a4dc53e035719860d05952649d97a9.sourceText: 第二、 选择合适的人员去中国授课至关重要。美国的大学教授多不愿长期调到中国。学校需要协调各方关系，安排合适的人员。使得去中国授课的教师既能满足教学任务，又能保持授课质量，还能维护学校品牌。
3c64a69278a4dc53e035719860d05952649d97a9.translatedText: Second, it is crucial to choose the right people to teach in China. Many American university professors are reluctant to transfer to China for a long time. The school needs to coordinate the relationship between all parties and arrange appropriate personnel. This enables teachers who go to China to teach not only to meet their teaching tasks, but also to maintain teaching quality and maintain the school brand.

ce65c2b198e1abd1ce4ebd8627795ff78eb3809b.sourceText: 第三、 处理好与中国当地政府的关系。中国的”十二五”计划中，教育是很重要的环节。这意味着，美国大学与中国的合作会与以往大不相同，不仅要协调各方关系，推进教学前进，同时还要达到美国国内的期望值。
ce65c2b198e1abd1ce4ebd8627795ff78eb3809b.translatedText: Third, handle the relationship with local Chinese governments. In China's "Twelfth Five-Year Plan", education is a very important link. This means that the cooperation between American universities and China will be very different from the past. It must not only coordinate the relationship between the parties and promote teaching progress, but also meet domestic expectations in the United States.

79e0c56c87f04ab5b2e96ce3eb3318a1855bf154.sourceText: 总而言之，中国给美国大学的国际化发展提供了前所未有的机会，无论是开辟新的学术战场还是创造收入来源。但美国学校需要格外小心，这背后的巨大挑战也同时存在。
79e0c56c87f04ab5b2e96ce3eb3318a1855bf154.translatedText: In short, China provides unprecedented opportunities for the international development of American universities, whether it is opening up new academic battlefields or creating sources of income. But American schools need to be extra careful, and huge challenges also exist behind this.

f5ab4b475b997a1508d2fbd568b73312434bb8d3.sourceText: 中国第一所获得教育部批准的中美合作大学棗上海纽约大学将于2013年开始招生，其中近半数学生将通过美国纽约大学招生系统录取后入学上海纽约大学，另外51%的学生来自中国大陆，他们将通过?#19977;位一体?#30340;综合评价，即高考成绩、高中学业水平考试和综合素质评价情况，进入上海纽约大学学习。
f5ab4b475b997a1508d2fbd568b73312434bb8d3.translatedText: New York University Shanghai, China's first Sino-US cooperative university approved by the Ministry of Education, will begin enrollment in 2013, and nearly half of the students will enroll through New York University in the United States. After admission to the system, the other 51% of students are from mainland China. They will enter NYU Shanghai through a comprehensive evaluation, that is, college entrance examination scores, high school academic proficiency tests and comprehensive quality evaluation.

a62a20aab179ebe3e4578a07f10a5716730631f1.sourceText: 据介绍，未来的上海纽约大学是纽约大学全球系统中的最新门户校园，将致力于建设一流的综合性研究型大学，努力成为中国高等教育国际合作示范改革的试验田。
a62a20aab179ebe3e4578a07f10a5716730631f1.translatedText: According to reports, the future NYU Shanghai will be the latest gateway campus in the NYU global system. It will be committed to building a first-class comprehensive research university and strive to become a test field for the demonstration reform of international cooperation in higher education in China.

a353583dfa7b62e076201638762d7b3ee7beeece.sourceText: 亚省华联供稿 秋香报道
a353583dfa7b62e076201638762d7b3ee7beeece.translatedText: >Contributed by Alberta Hualian Qiu Xiang reports

aacac3d94909a18e3e32f0c14efb996643e2c1da.sourceText: 每年的金秋九、十月份，是亚利桑那州华人社区最热闹的季节。华人社区各界庆祝国庆和中秋的活动都将在这时举行。在诸多的庆祝活动中，国庆-中秋《凤凰之夜》系列活动尤其值得期待与参与。
aacac3d94909a18e3e32f0c14efb996643e2c1da.translatedText: The golden autumn months of September and October are the busiest seasons for the Chinese community in Arizona. Activities from all walks of life in the Chinese community to celebrate National Day and Mid-Autumn Festival will be held at this time. Among the many celebration activities, the National Day-Mid-Autumn Festival "Phoenix Night" series of activities is particularly worth looking forward to and participating in.

be495b1061bbcd21110ed3250f2e896a73e24937.sourceText: ”凤凰之夜”由亚省华联（UCAA）与ASU孔子学院共同主办，面向公众，免费开放。由于其活动内容丰富、时代特色鲜明、参与人群众多而得到了社区最广泛的支持与参与。整个活动由亚利桑那州当地众多重要的华人社团参与协办，其中包括大凤凰城华人侨团联合总会、亚利桑那州立大学中国学生学者联谊会、亚省现代中文学校、亚省希望中文学校，以及《亚省时报》报社等华人社团。这将是一场亚利桑那州各界华人欢聚的盛会。
be495b1061bbcd21110ed3250f2e896a73e24937.translatedText: "Phoenix Night" is co-sponsored by the Chinese Federation of Alberta (UCAA) and the ASU Confucius Institute. It is open to the public and free of charge. Due to its rich activity content, distinctive characteristics of the times, and large number of participants, it has received the most extensive support and participation from the community. The entire event was co-sponsored by many important local Chinese associations in Arizona, including the Greater Phoenix Chinese Overseas Chinese Association, Arizona State University Chinese Students and Scholars Association, Alberta Modern Chinese School, Alberta Hope Chinese School, and Chinese associations such as the "Alberta Times" newspaper. This will be a grand gathering of Chinese from all walks of life in Arizona.

dd9cce7d8db126181ad6e8f76e43b747232faf8a.sourceText: ”凤凰之夜”到今年已经是第七届，与往年传统相同，今年，亚省华联将继续与ASU孔子学院共同主办主题为”中美合作面面观”中美文化论坛。届时，美国国会议员、Honeywell公司亚太地区总裁和与我们背景相同的Intel华人明星将应邀到会做主题演讲。演讲者会与听众分享他们对中国市场的认识、与中国做生意的经验，等等。
dd9cce7d8db126181ad6e8f76e43b747232faf8a.translatedText: "Phoenix Night" this year is already the seventh. As with previous years' tradition, this year, the Alberta Hualien will continue to co-host the Sino-US Cultural Forum with the theme of "Aspects of Sino-US Cooperation" with the ASU Confucius Institute. At that time, members of the U.S. Congress, the president of Honeywell's Asia-Pacific region, and Intel Chinese stars with the same background as us will be invited to give keynote speeches. Speakers will share with the audience their understanding of the Chinese market, experience in doing business with China, etc.

b103013bbaeefcfa8010807f61a6f4046638ad59.sourceText: 国庆招待会将在中美文化论坛之后举行，中华人民共和国驻洛杉矶总领事馆会派代表出席并致贺辞。以”我眼中的中国”为主题的青少年海报比赛和摄影比赛也是每年《凤凰之夜》的保留节目，现场将会举行获奖作品的颁奖典礼，而获奖作品将会早早地陈列在会场一端进行展出。招待会上，朋友们还会欣赏到本地艺术家们精彩的文艺表演。
b103013bbaeefcfa8010807f61a6f4046638ad59.translatedText: The National Day reception will be held after the Sino-US Cultural Forum. Representatives from the Consulate General of the People's Republic of China in Los Angeles will attend and deliver a congratulatory message. The youth poster competition and photography competition with the theme of "China in My Eyes" are also part of the annual "Phoenix Night". An award ceremony for the winning works will be held on site, and the winning works will be displayed at one end of the venue early. At the reception, friends will also enjoy wonderful cultural performances by local artists.

fa2ff2409b32194c251ea9bb6932418cc87e85e3.sourceText: 尤其值得一提的是，亚省华联将会为朋友们提供简单的晚餐，安排在招待会之后，舞会之前。晚餐会有水果、蔬菜沙拉、肉类鱼类三明治、休闲小食品、饮料，等等。朋友们可以边吃边聊，是叙旧交谈、结识新知、拓展人际关系的好时机。
fa2ff2409b32194c251ea9bb6932418cc87e85e3.translatedText: It is particularly worth mentioning that the Alberta Hualian will provide a simple dinner for friends, which will be arranged after the reception and before the dance. Dinner will include fruits, vegetable salads, meat and fish sandwiches, snacks, drinks, etc. Friends can chat while eating, which is a good time to reminisce about old times, make new acquaintances, and expand interpersonal relationships.

239b1e7042b9de870c132bb6c75a0d4454c2504f.sourceText: 中秋联谊舞会将会在晚餐后举行，与晚餐一样，这也是一个大家交朋识友的好时机。每年的舞会都会有大量喜爱交谊舞的朋友前来参加。
239b1e7042b9de870c132bb6c75a0d4454c2504f.translatedText: The Mid-Autumn Festival Dance will be held after the dinner. Like the dinner, this is also a good time for everyone to make friends. The annual dance is attended by a large number of friends who love ballroom dancing.

b01a465688001a39788b44d65e3de24639e781a1.sourceText: 今年的国庆-中秋”凤凰之夜”将于9月22日星期日举行，具体活动安排如下:
b01a465688001a39788b44d65e3de24639e781a1.translatedText: This year’s National Day-Mid-Autumn Festival “Phoenix Night” will be held on Sunday, September 22nd. The specific event schedule is as follows:

0345c391846246faa7e64b19f5a28dfd86523e3e.translatedText: The sub-zero low temperature that has been rare in many years has arrived in Phoenix!

d56b5b01e9bb302ab13f9cb5f26c1fd0152fa089.sourceText: 多年难遇的零下低温到凤凰城啦！ 凤凰城的市民不得不面对零下的温度，这样的低温将持续到周三。周五上午气温将回…
d56b5b01e9bb302ab13f9cb5f26c1fd0152fa089.translatedText: The sub-zero low temperature that has been rare in many years has arrived in Phoenix! People in Phoenix have to deal with subzero temperatures that will last until Wednesday. The temperature will return on Friday morning...

fb692d175b7993c72d5769f4690f1b8937f39bdb.sourceText: 凤凰城的市民不得不面对零下的温度，这样的低温将持续到周三。周五上午气温将回升。 今天上午市民已经感受到寒流的力量，最高温度才50度左右，周三午后最高气温60度。早上很多市民都是看到家里的草坪上霜。
fb692d175b7993c72d5769f4690f1b8937f39bdb.translatedText: Citizens of Phoenix have to face subzero temperatures, and such low temperatures will continue until Wednesday. Temperatures will warm up Friday morning. Citizens have already felt the power of the cold wave this morning, with the highest temperature only around 50 degrees, and the highest temperature on Wednesday afternoon was 60 degrees. Many citizens saw frost on their lawns in the morning.

da7ca7d30d8ae9394e21bc65258c9e4c06adf9e2.sourceText: 周二上午，寒流袭击了纳瓦霍印第安聚集地，”the Window Rock School District”学区取消了当天的课程，因为温度太低。 国家气象局说，到周三寒流还将在北亚利桑那。Window Rock的气温还会比周二的21度更低，最低可达零下5度。 各个城市也在为那些无家可归者准备衣物以及安置他们到救助站。市民也相互分享起取暖，为家庭花草作物保温的小窍门。 就在这几天，好好在凤凰城感受冬季吧！
da7ca7d30d8ae9394e21bc65258c9e4c06adf9e2.translatedText: A cold snap hit the Navajo Indian enclave on Tuesday morning, and the Window Rock School District canceled classes for the day because the temperature was too low. The National Weather Service said the cold snap will remain in Northern Arizona through Wednesday. Temperatures in Window Rock will be cooler than Tuesday's 21 degrees, with temperatures as low as minus 5 degrees. Cities are also preparing clothing for homeless people and placing them in aid stations. Citizens also shared with each other tips on heating and keeping household flowers, plants and crops warm. In these few days, let’s experience winter in Phoenix!

d48ad1aab23f9237586efba567d4dcf484d92ecc.sourceText: 第一次参加全美中文学校协会全国大会，未曾期盼能享受到这么好的讲座。现在二十几天过去了，经过了热闹的圣诞节，轻松的滑雪假期，再加上新年的冲击，朋友婚礼的盛大，当我提笔写稿时竟还留存着当时中文讲座带来的感动与震撼！
d48ad1aab23f9237586efba567d4dcf484d92ecc.translatedText: attended the National Association of Chinese Schools National Convention for the first time and never expected to enjoy such a good lecture. Now more than twenty days have passed, after a lively Christmas, a relaxing ski vacation, coupled with the impact of the New Year, and the grand wedding of a friend, when I started writing the article, I still retained the touch and shock brought by the Chinese lecture at that time!

2b74b5fbd6290acb8208c7d5741321be82ba7234.sourceText: 屈指一算，移居美国已有八年之久，每个周末都要带着宝贝女儿去中文学校学中文，巴不得孩子们中文听说读写面面俱到，似乎就读于中国。只是万万没有想到英文的冲击力巨大，几乎夺走了孩子们学习中文的兴趣！父母们无不紧张，他们多么希望自己的小孩能够用中文与自己的乡亲父老交流啊！
2b74b5fbd6290acb8208c7d5741321be82ba7234.translatedText: By the way, I have moved to the United States for eight years. Every weekend I take my baby daughter to a Chinese school to learn Chinese. I wish my children could master Chinese listening, speaking, reading and writing, as if they were studying in China. I just never expected that English would have such a huge impact that it would almost take away children’s interest in learning Chinese! Parents are all nervous. How they hope their children can communicate with their fellow villagers and elders in Chinese!

c66d9544d28aeaaeec0cf16cab0589bb1e5e8760.translatedText: "Memorize the book thickly when memorizing lessons, and talk thinly about books during lectures. Pay attention to the learning situation, and do a good job in pre-class planning and classroom generation."

4946107abe0523aa169fadea8f05428fbfd2a02c.sourceText: 中新网3月6日电 据外媒报道，解决几十万美国”追梦者”移民去留问题的最后期限已在5日过去，但美国国会和白宫都没有采取任何行动。 美国总统特朗普去年9月宣布结束奥巴马政府时期保护”追梦者”不被驱逐的《幼年来美暂缓递解行动》（DACA） 。 特朗普随后给国会一段时间找到更好的解决办法。如无法解决，他将”重新考虑这个问题”。特朗普给出的最后期限是3月5日。 白宫发言人萨拉桑德斯5日表示，”国会未能采取行动，这绝对是糟糕的。”她称这一局面是”可悲的”。 但是民主党人指责说，特朗普和共和党领导层未能在参议院通过移民议案， 不过，70多万名年轻的”追梦者”暂时并没有被遣返的危险。 一家联邦法庭下令禁止白宫终止DACA，白宫绕过联邦上诉法院，直接请求最高法院干预，但最高法院上个月宣布拒绝干预，而是要求联邦上诉法院尽快审理。 预计，最高法院不太可能在近期内重审此案，而国会似乎也并不急于通过任何”追梦者”法案。 这给那些受保护身份到期的”追梦者”有时间重新申请，把保护再延长两年。 特朗普已表示，他愿意考虑向”追梦者”提供成为公民的路径，但作为交换，必须终止某些合法移民项目，并出资在美墨边界筑墙。 据悉，这些”追梦者”是幼年时被父母非法带入美国的年轻人。民调显示，80%多的受访者认为，应当允许”追梦者”留在美国。这些”追梦者”对自己前途难测表示极其沮丧和焦虑。
4946107abe0523aa169fadea8f05428fbfd2a02c.translatedText: China News Service, March 6 According to foreign media reports, the deadline to resolve the immigration issue of hundreds of thousands of American "Dream Chasers" has passed on the 5th, but neither the U.S. Congress nor the White House has taken any action. In September last year, U.S. President Trump announced the end of the Deferred Action for Childhood Arrivals (DACA), which protected "Dreamers" from deportation during the Obama administration. Trump then gave Congress some time to find a better solution. If it cannot be resolved, he will "reconsider the issue." Trump's deadline is March 5. White House spokesperson Sarah Sanders said on the 5th, "It is absolutely terrible that Congress has failed to take action." She called the situation "tragic." However, Democrats accused Trump and Republican leadership of failing to pass an immigration bill in the Senate. However, more than 700,000 young "Dreamers" are not in danger of being deported for the time being. A federal court ordered the White House to prohibit the White House from terminating DACA. The White House bypassed the federal appeals court and directly asked the Supreme Court to intervene. However, the Supreme Court announced last month that it refused to intervene and instead asked the federal appeals court to hear the decision as soon as possible. The Supreme Court is unlikely to revisit the case in the near future, and Congress appears to be in no rush to pass any Dreamer legislation. This gives Dreamers whose protected status has expired time to reapply to extend their protection for another two years. Trump has said he is willing to consider offering Dreamers a path to citizenship, but in exchange must end certain legal immigration programs and fund a wall on the U.S.-Mexico border. It is reported that these "Dreamers" are young people who were illegally brought to the United States by their parents when they were young. Polls show that more than 80% of respondents believe that "Dreamers" should be allowed to stay in the United States. These "dream chasers" expressed extreme frustration and anxiety about their uncertain future.

e7007ffb5d04972aadea64ad491b670e87849d14.sourceText: 森林大火使空气质量恶化 本州岛森林大火延烧已两星期，当局出动 4 千多名消防人员灭火，终于有所进展，两座山城稍早前被强制撤离的七千多居民获准返家，不过，森林大火引发的浓烟造成空气质量恶化，使得有关当局相当担忧。 这起亚 利桑那州有史以来第二大的森林火灾引发的浓密黑烟不仅弥漫本州岛东部，而且越界笼罩新墨西哥州中部，造成许多民众眼睛刺痛、喉咙有灼烧感。卫生当局紧急呼吁民众要注意呼吸道健康。 在本州岛东部，大火浓烟所产生的微粒是联邦安全标准的 20 倍，不过，比起上周五的 40 倍已经改善许多。当局表示，情况虽有好转，但是仍然相当恶劣。 有些较大微粒若是吸入体内，可以透过咳嗽把它咳出来，但一些细小微粒，宽度大概只有头发的 28 分之一，若进入肺部，就很难排出体外，会严重危及健康。 新墨西哥州卫生部门也警告民众，空气质量恶化，最好不要从事户外活动。 参与救火的消防员表示，进入火场后，浓烟使得他们咳不停，几乎很难呼吸到新鲜空气，使得救火困难重重。 大火还朝通往德州西部的 2 条主输电线路，节节进逼，所幸目前并没有造成立即威胁; 不过 10 号晚上，靠近新墨西哥州州界附近，已经开始出现零星野火，新墨西哥州当局如临大敌，紧急加派 150 名消防员和数辆消防车，到场戒备。 由于野火持续延烧，散发出的大量浓烟，严重影响空气质量，卫生单位也呼吁民众多加注意，以防呼吸道出现不适。野火燎原，北的犹他州则因为今年春天异常寒冷，使得山间积雪破纪录。积雪丰厚，对滑雪场业者是个大利多，但一旦开始消融，不只山脚下的居民，恐怕 ​​ 美国西部各州，都会惨遭洪灾侵袭，后果不堪设想。 这起森林大火从五月 29 号延烧至今，已烧毁数十栋房屋建筑及一千多平方公里的林地，同时也烧掉当局两千七百多万美元，将近一万多居民撤离家园。 亚利桑那州史上最大火灾发生在 2002 年，当时烧毁一千九百平方公里的林地，将近五百栋房屋建筑也都付之一炬。
e7007ffb5d04972aadea64ad491b670e87849d14.translatedText: Forest fires have worsened air quality. The forest fires on Honshu Island have been burning for two weeks. The authorities have dispatched more than 4,000 firefighters to extinguish the fires. Finally, some progress has been made. More than 7,000 residents of two mountain towns who were forced to evacuate earlier were allowed to return home. However, the thick smoke caused by the forest fires has worsened the air quality, making relevant authorities very worried. Thick black smoke caused by the second-largest forest fire in Arizona's history not only filled the eastern part of the state, but also crossed the border and enveloped central New Mexico, causing many people's eyes to sting and their throats to burn. Health authorities urgently appeal to the public to pay attention to respiratory health. In eastern Honshu, smoke from the fires produced particulates 20 times higher than federal safety standards, but that was an improvement from 40 times last Friday. Authorities said that although the situation has improved, it is still very bad. If some larger particles are inhaled into the body, they can be coughed out. However, some small particles, which are only about 1/28th the width of a hair, will be difficult to be expelled from the body if they enter the lungs and will seriously endanger health. The New Mexico Health Department also warned the public that it is best not to engage in outdoor activities due to deteriorating air quality. Firefighters involved in fighting the fire said that after entering the fire scene, the thick smoke made them cough non-stop and it was almost difficult to breathe fresh air, making it difficult to fight the fire. The fire is also advancing towards the two main transmission lines leading to west Texas. Fortunately, it does not pose an immediate threat; however, on the night of the 10th, sporadic wildfires have begun to appear near the New Mexico state line. The New Mexico authorities were on the verge of a major enemy and urgently dispatched 150 firefighters and several fire trucks to the scene. As wildfires continue to burn and emit large amounts of thick smoke, which seriously affects air quality, health authorities also call on the public to pay more attention to prevent respiratory discomfort. Wildfires are raging, and in northern Utah, an unusually cold spring this year resulted in record-breaking snow accumulation in the mountains. The abundant snow cover is a big plus for ski resort operators, but once it begins to melt, not only the residents at the foot of the mountain, but also the western states of the United States will be hit by floods, with disastrous consequences. The forest fire has spread since May 29 and has burned dozens of houses and buildings and more than 1,000 square kilometers of forest land. It has also cost the authorities more than 27 million US dollars and nearly 10,000 residents have evacuated their homes. The largest fire in Arizona's history occurred in 2002, burning 1,900 square kilometers of forestland and destroying nearly 500 homes and buildings.

0ed93f0fe55a6407993634f7273f327f8bb64860.sourceText: 中国国民党亚利桑那直属分部新旧任常委交接顺利完成 中国国民党亚利桑那直属分部于七月二十二日，召开新旧任常委交接会议，由资深同志闵中英司仪主持，惠斌华担任主席，陈超仁监交，在与会同志见证下，圆满完成交接事宜。 主席惠斌华致词，本直属分部成立于二零一一年六月四日，六年以来，王玮婷常委带领同志，出钱出力，兢兢业业，除例行党务工作以外，并举办多次重大活动。今日本直属分部受到中央肯定，立足鳯凰城，乃是王常委与全体同志努力之结果。 过去六年，亚利桑那直属分部接待组织发展委员会主任苏俊宾及海外部主任夏大明视察、成立大选后援会、筹组助选团返台助选、远赴洛彬机参加金溥聪及洪秀柱访美晚宴，以及募集特别党费暨政治献金等等。 主席勉励新任常务丘仲平，当尽心尽力，遵行党中央政策暨组织规章，因应分部所需，落实分部党务，以不负同志之託付。同志亦当各展其才，尽其所能加以协助,本直属分部才能延续发展，更进一步。 陈超仁牧师监交，再次感谢王常委六年来之服务奉献，同志之同心努力，始有今日之亚利桑那直属分部。并期勉丘常委承担责任，协合同志，群策群力完成所负使命。陈牧师并为常委暨分部恳切祷告。 王常委于会中表彰特别党费暨政治献金捐款同志，分发中央党部製作複刻版中华革命党党员証，以资纪念，以及正式收据暨本分部捐献同志名册，以昭众信。本分部捐献共计美金一万零四百元。 随后，王常委列册移交中国国民党党旗、党员名册以及分部借用之中华民国国旗、美国国旗及亚利桑那直属分部横匾等。新任丘常委照单签收，随即走马上任，并将筹组工作团队，着手党务运作，我分部全体同志共勉之。 (国民党亚利桑那直属分部供稿)
0ed93f0fe55a6407993634f7273f327f8bb64860.translatedText: The handover of the new and old standing committee members of the Arizona branch of the Chinese Kuomintang was successfully completed The Arizona branch of the Chinese Kuomintang held a handover meeting between the old and new standing committee members on July 22. Senior comrade Min Zhongying presided over the meeting, Hui Binhua served as the chairman, and Chen Chaoren supervised the handover. Witnessed by the comrades present, the handover was successfully completed. Chairman Hui Binhua delivered a speech. This directly affiliated branch was established on June 4, 2011. Over the past six years, Standing Committee Member Wang Weiting has led comrades to contribute money and effort and work conscientiously. In addition to routine party work, many major activities have been held. Today, the branch directly under the Japanese branch has been recognized by the central government and established in Huangcheng. This is the result of the efforts of Standing Committee Member Wang and all comrades. In the past six years, the Arizona Branch has hosted inspections by Su Junbin, Director of the Organization Development Committee, and Xia Daming, Director of the Overseas Department, established a post-election support group, organized an election team to return to Taiwan to support the election, went to Luobingji to attend the dinner of Kim Puchong and Hong Xiuzhu's visit to the United States, and raised special party dues and political donations, etc. The chairman encouraged the new executive Qiu Zhongping to do his best, abide by the Party Central Committee's policies and organizational regulations, respond to the needs of the branch, implement branch party affairs, and live up to the trust of his comrades. Comrades should also display their talents and do their best to assist, so that this directly affiliated branch can continue to develop and go further. Pastor Chen Chaoren supervised the transfer and once again thanked Standing Committee Member Wang for his service and dedication over the past six years. The concerted efforts of the comrades have led to the direct Arizona branch today. He also expected members of the Standing Committee of Mianqiu to assume responsibilities, coordinate with comrades, and work together to complete their missions. Pastor Chen also prayed sincerely for the Standing Committee and the branch. During the meeting, Standing Committee Member Wang commended the comrades who made special party dues and political donations, and distributed replica Chinese Revolutionary Party membership certificates produced by the Central Party Committee as a commemoration, as well as official receipts and a list of donated comrades of the branch to show public trust. This branch donated a total of US$10,400. Subsequently, Standing Committee Member Wang listed and handed over the Chinese Kuomintang flag, party member roster, as well as the branch's borrowed flag of the Republic of China, the American flag and the banner of the Arizona branch. The new member of the Qiu Standing Committee signed the order and took office immediately. He will organize a working team to start party affairs. All the comrades of our branch encourage him. (Contributed by the Arizona branch of the Kuomintang)

82ce6b0d2db574ab65be3e84bdd09d3850516d62.sourceText: 凤凰城 气如虹 「星期六常有节目」，这是我移民来美生活发现的一个特点，因为平日忙碌工作，总是将节目安排在週末进行，这个六月十七日星期六下午四时，我又去美莎市新世界酒家贵宾厅，参加亚利桑那州华人华侨庆祝香港回归二十周年座谈会。 我是日前接获亚省越华联谊会黄海会长的通知，希望能代表越华会共同出席，支持社团的活动，我当天有空，就答应了。从传递过来的邀请通知书裡，知道是本州侨学界所组织，联络人名单有七位，我孤陋寡闻，只认识三位，自己不是侨界人物，没有机会认识那么多学者、科技人员和留学生。 果然，当日下午抵达座谈会场，陌生面貌较多，幸好，看到美西侨报社长方慧贤已坐在那裡，总算有个熟稔老友；忙碌迎宾的徐强和吴亮祖，也举手招呼；黄海在圆桌上回头向我招手，说是预留位置给我，和梅树德并坐；望向前桌，见到着名作家唐孝先，连忙过去打招呼，他喜孜孜地介绍另一位作家戴定国给我认识，荣幸之至。环顾室内，看见其他几个熟识者：耆英会友李爱珍，耆英中心主任裴霞云，女作家汪静玉，太阳鸟网站负责人谢成彦。此其时，杨文田理事长，陪同中国驻洛杉矶的两位侨务领事王学政、陈晓毅入席，也见侨界元老余文劲和资深侨领邓朝驹，联袂进来，又见钱得乐市议员黄馨民到了，贵宾们都坐在首席位置。 时间已届，娇声清脆的孙颖宣佈座谈会开始，袁亚华主持介绍出席嘉宾，很多人物都有名衔，来头不少，没有职称的皆冠以爱国人士，很有创意。我留意室内八张圆桌，大约共坐七十人，虽然经过逐一介绍，我听完有如水过鸭背，点滴不留，无法铭记谁与谁。 没关係，我主要是聆听各界人士的高见，多听多闻，总有裨益。静静听取各人对香港回归廿年，发表了连串意见，综合集结，大致上认同香港回归的骄傲，对一九九七年香港回归，证明中国实力趋于强盛，英国才愿意拱手奉还已佔领的国土，让国人吐气扬眉。有重提当年庆回归盛况，见证历史；也有回顾亚省组织庆回归的兴奋场面，薄海腾欢。更有称讚中国领导人精明，实践「一国两制」港人治港的政策优越，成就瞩目。只有一位大学生讲述内地学生投考香港大学，经过接触，似乎不能融入香港社会，指出族群间存有分歧，期望将来会改善厖 聆听座谈会上发表的意见，正面讚扬香港回归居多，展望将来更繁荣昌盛，前途无限。然而，我总觉得论述未达全面，不够深度，似乎欠缺些什么，一时又想不起来。直到散会用餐时，我坐在香港精品店东主马向明旁边，閒聊起香港人，才蓦然醒觉，啊呀！这座谈会就是欠缺香港人发言，实在美中不足。香港回归祖国，祖国当然欢欣，但香港人的感想又如何？廿年后的今日又怎样？现时香港市民不是扰扰攘攘，极力争取什么民主吗？应该让他们亲自讲述，瞭解其心态，有多方面的意见反映，百花齐放，综合起来，才显得客观和正确。 还记得，在一九九七年之前，很多香港朋友，提起回归大事，不是感到自豪，而是感到害怕，那时对中国共产制度仍存有戒心，经济条件好的同胞纷纷搞移民，不少电影明星申请前往加拿大温哥华定居，歌神许冠杰为了安抚港人，还特别创作了〈话之你九七〉歌曲，「香港适应力强未吓窒」，「或者到咗九七，繁荣盛世，道道有金执」，当年我也懂得哼唱。 总之，香港回归二十年，的确是意义重大的日子，值得纪念；将来如再有组织座谈会，应该邀请多些香港学者参与发表意见，才显得公正，合情合理。
82ce6b0d2db574ab65be3e84bdd09d3850516d62.translatedText: Phoenix City Qi Ruhong "There are always programs on Saturdays." This is a feature I discovered when I immigrated to the United States. Because of my busy work schedule, programs are always scheduled for weekends. At 4:00 pm on Saturday, June 17, I went to the VIP room of the New World Restaurant in Mesa City to attend a symposium held by Arizona Chinese in celebration of the 20th anniversary of Hong Kong's return to the motherland. I recently received a notice from President Huang Hai of the Vietnamese-Chinese Association of Alberta, hoping to attend on behalf of the Vietnamese-Chinese Association to support the activities of the association. I was free that day, so I agreed. From the invitation letter that was passed on, I learned that it was organized by the overseas Chinese academic community in this state and that there were seven contact persons on the list. I was ignorant and only knew three of them. I was not a figure in the overseas Chinese community and had no chance to get to know so many scholars, scientific and technological personnel and international students. Sure enough, when we arrived at the symposium in the afternoon, there were many unfamiliar faces. Fortunately, we saw Fang Huixian, the president of the Spanish-American Overseas Chinese Newspaper, sitting there, and we finally had an old friend; Xu Qiang and Wu Liangzu, who were busy welcoming guests, also raised their hands to say hello; Huang Hai was in the circle He turned around at the table and waved to me, saying that he had reserved a seat for me to sit with Mei Shude. Looking at the front table, he saw the famous writer Tang Xiaoxian, and hurried over to say hello. He happily introduced another writer, Dai Dingguo, to me. It was a great honor. Looking around the room, I saw several other familiar people: Li Aizhen, a member of the Senior Citizens Association, Pei Xiayun, director of the Senior Citizens Center, Wang Jingyu, a female writer, and Xie Chengyan, the person in charge of the Sunbird website. At this time, Chairman Yang Wentian accompanied Wang Xuezheng and Chen Xiaoyi, the two overseas Chinese consuls of China in Los Angeles, to the table. Yu Wenjin, a veteran of the overseas Chinese community, and Deng Chaoju, a senior overseas Chinese leader, came in hand in hand. Qiandele City Councilor Huang Xinmin arrived, and the distinguished guests were all sitting in the first place. The time has expired. Sun Ying announced the start of the symposium with a clear voice. Yuan Yahua presided over the introduction of the guests. Many people had titles and backgrounds. Those without professional titles were all labeled as patriots, which was very creative. I noticed that there were eight round tables in the room, with a total of about seventy people sitting there. Although they were introduced one by one, I felt like water flowing over a duck's back after listening to them. Not a single detail was retained, and I couldn't remember who was with whom. It doesn't matter, I mainly listen to the opinions of people from all walks of life. Listening more is always helpful. I listened quietly to everyone's opinions on the 20th anniversary of Hong Kong's return. After comprehensive gathering, I generally agreed with the pride of Hong Kong's return. The return of Hong Kong in 1997 proved that China's strength was becoming stronger, and Britain was willing to hand over the territory it had occupied, making the Chinese people feel proud. Some recalled the grand celebration of the handover and witnessed history; others recalled the exciting scenes of the provincial organization celebrating the return, making Bo Hai happy. He also praised China's leaders for their shrewdness, implementing the "one country, two systems" policy of Hong Kong people governing Hong Kong, and its superior policies and remarkable achievements. Only one college student said that mainland students applied to the University of Hong Kong. After being contacted, they seemed unable to integrate into Hong Kong society. He pointed out that there were differences between ethnic groups and hoped that they would improve in the future. Listening to the opinions expressed at the symposium, most of them praised Hong Kong's return and looked forward to a more prosperous and promising future. However, I always feel that the discussion is not comprehensive and in-depth. It seems that something is missing, and I can't remember it for a while. It was not until the meeting was over that I sat next to Ma Xiangming, the owner of a Hong Kong boutique, and chatted about Hong Kong people, and then I suddenly woke up, ah! This symposium lacks the voices of Hong Kong people, which is really a fly in the ointment. The motherland is of course happy that Hong Kong has returned to the motherland, but what do the people of Hong Kong feel? What about today, twenty years later? Aren’t Hong Kong citizens currently clamoring and striving for some kind of democracy? They should be allowed to speak in person, understand their mentality, and reflect their opinions from many aspects. Only when a hundred flowers bloom can it appear objective and correct. I still remember that before 1997, many Hong Kong friends felt not proud but scared when mentioning the reunification event. At that time, they were still wary of China's communist system. Compatriots with better economic conditions were immigrating one after another. Many movie stars applied to settle in Vancouver, Canada. In order to appease Hong Kong people, the singer Xu Guanjie specially composed the song "You Are 1977", "Hong Kong's adaptability is not frightened", "Maybe in 1997, prosperity and wealth are everywhere." I also knew how to hum at that time. In short, the 20th anniversary of Hong Kong's return is indeed a significant day and worth commemorating. If there is another symposium organized in the future, more Hong Kong scholars should be invited to participate and express their opinions, so that it will be fair, reasonable and reasonable.

7f8ae71f39021af78550090f6ffc0cf023d77406.sourceText: 周永新（亚利桑那州凤凰城 业馀作者） 香港虽然弹丸之地，但它的经济与文化，向来发展得奇佳，光芒四射。许多海外华人常说：「全靠有香港的电视剧集和卡拉ＯＫ录影带所吸引，我们的下一代才能听能说母语。」 香港真是颗东方之珠，在九七回归中国之前，我们华人都为它的前途担心，怕它失去原来的光彩。不过，经过一年多所走的路程，虽困难重重，但我认为其前景仍然乐观。起码，在一般文化活动以及纪念六四事件中，依旧保持港人的自由民主作风，有此气魄，理应前途似锦。 至于目前的窘态，有些是与国际形势息息相关。亚洲金融风暴是最大的打击，连遥远的美国也受影响，何况区区一个香港？有些是天灾横祸，如禽流感肆虐，完全属于意外的；谈到新机场开始营运一团糟，当然是管理失误，但这么庞大工程，出错在所难免，只要及时补救，还是情有可谅。 由于前两者搅乱港人心态，对新机场更加抱怨，最后把一肚子闷气发洩到董特首身上。其实，即使香港未回归，老董未上台，金融风暴和禽流感一样会发生，果真如此又怨谁人？东方之珠只是一时晦暗，将来还是永耀光芒的。 一九九八年九月六日星期日，发表于世界日报的「民意论坛」
7f8ae71f39021af78550090f6ffc0cf023d77406.translatedText: Zhou Yongxin (amateur author from Phoenix, Arizona) Although Hong Kong is a small place, its economy and culture have always developed extremely well and are radiant. Many overseas Chinese often say: "It is only because of the attraction of Hong Kong TV series and karaoke videos that our next generation can hear and speak the mother tongue." Hong Kong is really the Pearl of the Orient. Before the return to China in 1997, we Chinese were worried about its future, fearing that it would lose its original glory. However, after more than a year of journey, despite the difficulties, I think its prospects are still optimistic. At least, in general cultural activities and in commemoration of the June 4th incident, Hong Kong people still maintain the liberal and democratic style. With this courage, the future should be bright. As for the current dilemma, some of it is closely related to the international situation. The Asian financial crisis is the biggest blow, affecting even the distant United States, let alone Hong Kong? Some are natural disasters, such as the raging bird flu, which are completely accidental. When it comes to the chaos at the beginning of the new airport's operation, it is certainly a management error. However, mistakes are inevitable for such a huge project. As long as they are rectified in time, it is understandable. Because the first two disrupted the mentality of Hong Kong people, they complained even more about the new airport, and finally vented their frustration on Chief Executive Dong. In fact, even if Hong Kong has not returned to the motherland and the old chairman has not come to power, the financial crisis will happen just like bird flu. If so, who can we blame? The Pearl of the Orient is only dim for a while, but it will still shine brightly in the future. Published in World Journal's "Public Opinion Forum" on Sunday, September 6, 1998

d009ca42d3b1d4a6c12087680f2565f0aad58cd5.sourceText: ” 久扬专桉 ” 马总统第五次来访洛杉矶 中华民国总统马英九「久扬专桉」16日过境洛杉矶，马总统这次美国过境波士顿于哈佛大学演讲与洛杉矶参访扬克斯航空博物馆，是中华民国总统受到美国政府最高的礼遇，马总统这次「久扬专桉」可能是总统卸任前的「毕业旅行」。 马总统在专机上发表谈话: ”在外交工作是中华民国生存发展的重要一环，本次将拜访多明尼加、海地及尼加拉瓜三个友邦，旅途虽然辛苦，但我相信这会是一场有意义且值得的访问，期盼能为中华民国「活路外交」写下新的一页”。 16日下午马总统抵达下塌洛杉矶环球影城希尔顿酒店时，本地侨胞三百多名夹道欢迎马总统第五度来访洛杉矶，晚间举行侨宴, 和侨民代表欢聚一堂，分享马总统为中华民国的安全，经济努力再回亚洲四小龙之首的成果。 17日马总统一行包括随行官员国安会秘书长高华柱、外交部长林永乐、经济部长邓振中、侨务委会委员长陈士魁、立法委员吕学樟、詹凯臣、王育敏、李贵敏等人就马不停蹄展开行程。在参加美国西岸政要早餐会，随后马总统一行车队在美国警察保安前导下, 特别前往约50哩外的奇诺市的洋基航空博物馆（Yanks Air Museum）参访, 并参观建国百年时中华民国赠送给洋基航空博物馆的F-5E「中正」战机，本地侨胞二百多名夹道欢迎马总统首次来到圣贝纳迪诺县，马总统并与曾在二战期间效力于飞虎队的老飞官贾维特见面，感谢当年保卫中华民国。中午回酒店后，参加美国商会企业家的午餐会，下午四时，再一次由二百多名侨胞高呼”马总统加油”, 侨民依依不捨高喊”谢谢马总统”欢送马总统一行的离开酒店，随即马总统在和侨社代表中华会馆主席伍尚齐握手致谢后，马总统和送行侨民们挥手致谢, 就登车返台。 「久扬专桉」一行人增加5位烧烫伤专家随同协助八仙尘爆受害者，专家包括约翰霍普金斯大学整形外科教授兼烧烫伤中心主任密尔纳（Stephen M. Milner）、约翰霍普金斯大学紧急医药学院助理教授凯特蕾（Christina Lynne Catlett）、约翰霍普金斯大学整形外科总医师勒伍（Denver Matthew. Lough）、约翰霍普金斯大学烧烫伤中心复建科主任魏尔（Linda Coll Ware）、烧烫伤专科护士林奇（Theresa Ann Lynch）等、随同总统专机返台。 鳯城侨领计有尹衍桓，高志中，李玲麟，王瑞瑾，邱顺雄，张圣仪，张慧美，邱文琪等八位应邀出席7月16日总统晚宴，尹衍桓被大会特别安排主桌，与薄瑞光相邻，席间多有互动。
d009ca42d3b1d4a6c12087680f2565f0aad58cd5.translatedText: " Jiu Yang Special" "President Ma's fifth visit to Los Angeles President Ma Ying-jeou of the Republic of China passed through Los Angeles on the 16th. President Ma's trip to Boston to give a speech at Harvard University and Los Angeles to visit the Yonkers Air Museum is the highest courtesy the President of the Republic of China has received from the U.S. government. President Ma's "long-lasting tour" may be the president's "graduation trip" before leaving office. President Ma delivered a speech on the special plane: "Diplomacy is an important part of the survival and development of the Republic of China. This time we will visit three friendly countries, the Dominican Republic, Haiti and Nicaragua. Although the journey is difficult, I believe this will be a meaningful and worthwhile visit. I look forward to writing a new page in the "survival diplomacy" of the Republic of China." When President Ma arrived at the Hilton Hotel in Universal City, Los Angeles, on the afternoon of the 16th, more than 300 local overseas Chinese lined the streets to welcome President Ma for his fifth visit to Los Angeles. In the evening, an overseas Chinese banquet was held, and representatives of the overseas Chinese gathered together to share the results of President Ma’s efforts to ensure the security and economy of the Republic of China and return it to the top of the Four Asian Tigers. On the 17th, President Ma and his entourage, including accompanying officials National Security Council Secretary-General Gao Huazhu, Foreign Minister Lin Yongle, Economic Minister Deng Zhenzhong, Chairman of the Overseas Chinese Affairs Commission Chen Shikui, legislators Lu Xuezhang, Zhan Kaichen, Wang Yumin, Li Guimin and others started their trip non-stop. After attending a breakfast meeting of U.S. West Coast dignitaries, President Ma and his convoy, led by U.S. police security, made a special trip to the Yankee Air Museum in Chino, about 50 miles away. Museum) and visited the F-5E "Chiang Kai-shek" fighter jet presented to the Yankee Aviation Museum by the Republic of China during the 100th anniversary of the founding of the Republic of China. More than 200 local overseas Chinese lined the streets to welcome President Ma to San Bernardino County for the first time. President Ma also met with Javitt, a veteran pilot who served in the Flying Tigers during World War II, and thanked him for defending the Republic of China. After returning to the hotel at noon, he attended a luncheon for entrepreneurs of the American Chamber of Commerce. At four o'clock in the afternoon, more than 200 overseas Chinese once again shouted "Come on, President Ma". The overseas Chinese reluctantly shouted "Thank you, President Ma" to see President Ma and his party off the hotel. Immediately after President Ma shook hands with Wu Shangqi, chairman of the Chinese Association of Overseas Chinese Association, and thanked him, President Ma and the overseas Chinese waved to thank them before boarding the car to return to Taiwan. The "Jiu Yang Experts" team has added five burn and scald experts to assist the victims of the Eight Immortals Dust explosion. The experts include Stephen M. Milner, professor of plastic surgery at Johns Hopkins University and director of the Burn and Scald Center, Christina Lynne Catlett, assistant professor at the Johns Hopkins School of Emergency Medicine, Denver Matthew. Ware, Burns and Scald Specialist Nurse Theresa Ann Lynch and others returned to Taiwan with the President's special plane. Eight overseas Chinese leaders from Fucheng, including Yin Yanhuan, Gao Zhizhong, Li Linglin, Wang Ruijin, Qiu Shunxiong, Zhang Shengyi, Zhang Huimei, and Qiu Wenqi, were invited to attend the presidential dinner on July 16. Yin Yanhuan was specially arranged to head the table by the conference, adjacent to Bo Ruiguang, and there was a lot of interaction during the dinner.

0e808e1b1bdc45a650182f192d081d38cbeec515.sourceText: (亚太社区促进会供稿)你知道 在美国每十三点七分钟就有一人自杀吗？ 疾病防制中心的最新统计数字顕示: 二零一零年美国自杀死亡人数为三万八千三百六十四人, 此上升数字再次将自杀死亡列为全美第十大死因, 和二零零九年比较, 增加了百分之三点九, 相当于每十万人当中有十二点四人次自杀。自杀人数自二千年起年年増髙,这是过去十五年来最髙的, 年长的亚太裔妇女比白人或黑人有较髙的自杀率, 最髙自杀率是八十五岁以上的亚裔男性, 自杀也是十五岁至二十四岁年龄群的第三大死因。 亚太社区促进会有幸和Magellan Health Services 合作,在二零一二年十二月二日星期日下午三时三十分共同推出一齣 由 Dr. James Campbell及其友人担纲有关防范自杀的舞台剧–”沉默的哭泣”, 剧情叙述生活裹承受许多压力事件而意图自杀的三个角色。 此剧的目的是提醒一般大众对于预防亲人及朋友自杀的认知, 此剧是由自杀预防研究中心委託製作, 且经过不同观众观赏, 被视为是一个相当有益的教育媒介。 ” 沉默的哭泣”给予大众机会参与当前许多人经历的正常压力, 它也揭露和自杀相关的一些因素、线索、原因及预防之道。 我们希望此剧会激励观众帮助週遭社区的人们处理无助感, 也希望能防范我们所爱的人𣎴必要的死亡。 此剧将在Playhouse on the Park (1850 N. Central Ave., Phoenix AZ 85004) 演出, 由Magellan Health Services 赞助, 您无须购票入场, 但是恳请您擕带两罐食品或是美金五元以便捐助给本地的食物银行, 座位有限, 请现在就预约, 电话: (602) 265-4598 或送电子邮件至yen@apcaaz.org。
0e808e1b1bdc45a650182f192d081d38cbeec515.translatedText: (Contributed by the Asia Pacific Community Promotion Association) Did you know that one person commits suicide every 13.7 minutes in the United States? The latest statistics from the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention show that the number of suicide deaths in the United States in 2010 was 38,364. This increase once again ranked suicide as the tenth leading cause of death in the United States. Compared with 2009, it increased by 3.9%, equivalent to 12.4 suicides per 100,000 people. The number of suicides has increased every year since 2000. This is the highest rate in the past fifteen years. Older Asian and Pacific Islander women have higher suicide rates than whites or blacks. The highest suicide rate is among Asian men over the age of 85. Suicide is also the third leading cause of death in the age group of 15 to 24 years old. The Asia Pacific Community Promotion Association is honored to collaborate with Magellan Health Services to jointly present a stage play on suicide prevention - "Silent Cry", starring Dr. James Campbell and his friends, on Sunday, December 2, 2012 at 3:30 pm. The plot tells the story of three characters who have suffered many stressful events in their lives and attempted suicide. The purpose of this play is to raise the general public's awareness of suicide prevention among relatives and friends. This play was commissioned by the Suicide Prevention Research Center and has been viewed by different audiences and is regarded as a very useful educational medium. "Silent Cry" gives the public the opportunity to participate in the normal stress that many people are experiencing today. It also exposes some of the factors, clues, causes and prevention methods related to suicide. We hope this show will inspire viewers to help people in the communities around them deal with feelings of helplessness, and hopefully prevent the necessary deaths of our loved ones. This play will be performed at the Playhouse on the Park (1850 N. Central Ave., Phoenix AZ 85004) and is sponsored by Magellan Health Services. You do not need to buy a ticket to enter, but you are kindly asked to bring two cans of food or US$5 to donate to the local food bank. Seats are limited. Please make a reservation now. Call: (602) 265-4598 or email yen@apcaaz.org.

6c04fba94ea7c4eede8990ac3ada7cb0eca75bca.sourceText: 亚利桑那州立大学学生在泰国失踪，可能已溺水而亡 （亚省时报） 一名21岁州立大学学生，Joshua Shane 在学校组织的泰国旅游活动时，在普吉岛深夜游泳时失踪。当时水流 强劲，和他同游的学生勉强游到岸边，而他Joshua却消失了。有关方面在努力后已放弃搜救，并假设他已死亡。 Joshua Shane到泰国是参加为期四周的国外学习课程。他是一名大三学生。家人说他对于国际社会公正以及 全球持续发展充满兴趣。 亚利桑那新闻发布官Julie Newberg说：州立大学对此深感悲痛并对Joshua的家人和朋友致以诚挚的慰问。
6c04fba94ea7c4eede8990ac3ada7cb0eca75bca.translatedText: Arizona State University student missing in Thailand, may have drowned (Alberta Times) A 21-year-old state university student, Joshua Shane He disappeared while swimming in Phuket late at night during a trip to Thailand organized by the school. The current was strong at that time, and the students who swam with him barely swam to the shore, but Joshua disappeared. The search and rescue efforts were abandoned and he was presumed dead. Joshua Shane went to Thailand to participate in a four-week study abroad course. He is a junior. Family members said he was interested in international social justice and sustainable global development. "The State University is deeply saddened by this incident and extends our sincere condolences to Joshua's family and friends," said Arizona Press Release Officer Julie Newberg.

f0d8ef57349da3fcabb4c62844df33fe05ad5277.sourceText: 六月十七日，北京，人民大会堂， ”987，我们的红楼梦”- 纪念八七版电视剧《红楼梦》开播三十周年庆典音乐会。 盛事庆典，隆重热烈，颇是吻合了人民大会堂的庄重和大气。 放眼望去，能容纳一万五千人的人民大会堂的三层观众席， 座无虚席。人们怀着对八七版红楼梦的喜爱，从祖国各地、 乃至大洋彼岸，汇集北京人民大会堂， 共同观赏这场特别的音乐盛典。 华声合唱团不愧是红楼梦和陈力的铁杆”红粉”。 咱华声女高两大天王陈昭和玛莎，俺们三人相约北京， 一起为陈力的红楼梦音乐会捧场，超级给力！ 整场音乐会可谓众星云集，演出阵容超级强大， 舞台设计的豪华气派中，倾注了款款温馨深情， 无不带给人们满满的红楼回忆。 然而，相信观众中，一定有一大批特别的观众： 他们痴迷于曹雪芹的名著《红楼梦》， 他们热爱王扶林的电视连续剧《红楼梦》，然而，他们对王立平以?/SPAN> 一朝入梦，终生不醒?#30340;四年，呕心沥血打造的《红楼梦》 音乐以及把它演绎成经典的陈力更是情有独钟。 当美丽端庄的陈力，以一袭宝石蓝长裙出现在舞台中央，以一曲《 枉凝眉》拉开音乐会序幕，全场观众报以经久不息的热烈掌声， 以此表达无数喜爱陈力的观众对旅居海外多年的陈力和她的红楼梦音 乐的由衷的喜爱和感怀。而整场音乐会，更是以陈力最经典的《 葬花吟》压轴，将音乐会推向最高潮。 看着舞台中央、聚光灯下盛装优雅的陈力，心中无限感慨。 感受着舞台上陈力的光彩夺目，感动着她梦幻般的天籁之音， 更感念着陈力发自内心的真诚善良和她的优雅淡定。 这位以最优美动情、最感人肺腑的音乐之声， 演绎了几代人心中红楼梦经典音乐的中国著名女高音歌唱家， 也和她所成就的红楼梦音乐一样，成为一个时代的经典，历经岁月， 历久弥新！ 三十年来，王立平和陈力的红楼梦音乐，伴随了几代人的岁月成长，” 从来不需要想起，永远也不会忘记”。正是陈力， 是她的红楼梦音乐， 让我们第一次深深体会到经典那不可抗拒的魅力和魔力。 飞越重洋，快闪京城，短短四天的中美往返，只为我们喜爱的陈力， 只为亲历盛事，感受经典！ 一个感动又有趣的小插曲：陈力在音乐会开场时曾动情地说：” 最感动的就是，有的朋友是利用周末， 专程从美国回来参加这次音乐会，两天后又要赶回美国工作?’ 暖心)。当晚会刚刚结束，就见一个”扛长枪”的记者匆匆走过来， 问：” 你们就是陈力刚才说的专程从美国回国参加红楼梦音乐会的朋友吧？” 。是啊，我相信， 我们会成为这场红楼梦音乐会万名观众中最特别的观众和钢杆力迷。 这是一次名副其实的追梦之旅！ 平生第一次，也必将成为唯一。 衷心祝贺音乐会取得圆满成功！ 衷心祝贺陈力的天籁之音圆梦北京！ 🌹祝福陈力🌹
f0d8ef57349da3fcabb4c62844df33fe05ad5277.translatedText: June 17, Beijing, Great Hall of the People, "987, Our Dream of Red Mansions" - A concert to commemorate the 30th anniversary of the 1987 TV series "A Dream of Red Mansions". The grand event celebration is grand and enthusiastic, which is in line with the solemnity and atmosphere of the Great Hall of the People. Looking around, the three-story auditorium of the Great Hall of the People, which can accommodate 15,000 people, is packed with seats. With their love for the 1987 version of Dream of Red Mansions, people from all over the country and even across the ocean gathered in the Great Hall of the People in Beijing to watch this special music ceremony. The Huasheng Choir is indeed a die-hard "fan" of Dream of Red Mansions and Chen Li. Chen Zhao and Martha, the two great girls of Chinese high school, the three of us met in Beijing to support Chen Li's Dream of Red Mansions concert together. It was super awesome! The entire concert was a star-studded event, with a super strong lineup. The luxurious stage design was filled with warmth and affection, all of which brought people full of memories of the Red Mansions. However, I believe that there must be a large number of special viewers in the audience: they are obsessed with Cao Xueqin's masterpiece "A Dream of Red Mansions", and they love Wang Fulin's TV series "A Dream of Red Mansions". However, they have a special liking for the music of "A Dream of Red Mansions" that Wang Liping worked hard to create for four years and Chen Li, who interpreted it into a classic. When the beautiful and dignified Chen Li appeared in the center of the stage in a sapphire blue dress and kicked off the concert with the song "Wang Ning Mei", the audience gave a long and warm applause to express the sincere love and affection of countless Chen Li fans who have lived overseas for many years and her music "Dream of Red Mansions". The entire concert ended with Chen Li's most classic song "The Burial of Flowers", pushing the concert to its climax. Looking at the elegantly dressed Chen Li in the center of the stage, under the spotlight, I felt infinite emotion in my heart. I felt Chen Li's brilliance on the stage, moved by her dreamy and natural voice, and even more grateful for Chen Li's sincerity and kindness from the heart and her elegance and calmness. This famous Chinese soprano singer, who has performed the classic music of Dream of Red Mansions in the hearts of generations with the most beautiful, emotional and touching music, has also become a classic of an era like the music of Dream of Red Mansions that she has created, lasting timeless over the years! Over the past thirty years, the music of Wang Liping and Chen Li's Dream of Red Mansions has accompanied the growth of several generations. "It never needs to be thought of and will never be forgotten." It was Chen Li and her music of Dream of Red Mansions that made us deeply appreciate the irresistible charm and magic of classics for the first time. Flying across the ocean, popping into Beijing, traveling back and forth between China and the United States in just four days, just for our favorite Chen Li, just to experience the grand event and experience the classics! A touching and interesting episode: Chen Li once said emotionally at the opening of the concert: "The most touching thing is that some friends used the weekend to come back from the United States to attend this concert, and then rushed back to the United States to work two days later?" (Heartwarming). Just after the concert ended that night, a reporter "carrying a spear" hurried over and asked: "Are you the friends Chen Li just mentioned who came back from the United States to attend the Dream of Red Mansions concert?" ". Yes, I believe that we will become the most special audience and steel pole fans among the tens of thousands of spectators at this Dream of Red Mansions concert. This is a veritable dream-chasing journey! The first time in my life, and it will definitely become the only one. I sincerely congratulate the concert on its complete success! My sincere congratulations to Chen Li for his heavenly sound to realize his dream in Beijing! 🌹Blessings to Chen Li🌹

21e84bb0e7f7b8d9cd571e5b42b7cbf92f3be933.sourceText: （希望中文学校供稿）2013年1月5日，是新年的第一个周末，希望中文学校对所有教师进行了一次开学前的教师培训会议。会议假座位于Chandler的Yummy Grill Buffy，培训教师的同时，还请大家共享了一次美食。 培训会议在热烈的新年氛围中开始，大家品尝着各种美味的食物，交流着假期里的各种趣事，好不热闹。待大家品尝美食后，董事长黄双双、行政校长赵彩虹首先代表学校，祝各位老师节日愉快，随后展望了新的一学期学校的各项事务发展。希望中文学校将一如既往，向学生传授中文知识和中华文化，并开拓创新的展开各种教学活动或竞赛。
21e84bb0e7f7b8d9cd571e5b42b7cbf92f3be933.translatedText: (Contributed by Hope Chinese School) January 5, 2013, was the first weekend of the New Year. The conference venue was located at Yummy Grill Buffy in Chandler. While training teachers, everyone was also invited to share a delicious meal. The training meeting started in a warm New Year atmosphere. Everyone tasted a variety of delicious food and exchanged various interesting things during the holidays. It was very lively. After everyone tasted the delicious food, Chairman Huang Shuangshuang and Executive Principal Zhao Caihong first represented the school and wished all teachers a happy holiday, and then looked forward to the development of various school affairs in the new semester. It is hoped that Chinese schools will continue to teach students Chinese knowledge and Chinese culture, and carry out various teaching activities or competitions in innovative ways.

592d19565b6c5bc3510906bb4fae76086a14985b.sourceText: 教学校长谢小红向大家介绍了几位下学期即将加入到希望中文学校教学活动中的新教师，使得希望中文学校的师资力量始终保持资深教师和新鲜能量的互补状态。谢校长也介绍和强调了新的教师章程，规范了教师的各种教学制度，希望能够以更高的教学质量和更规范的教学行为来更好的教育学生，也为学生做出良好的榜样。教师们也就共同维护好学校的卫生环境、增加学生志愿者机会以及学生的安全等各个方面提出了很好的建议。
592d19565b6c5bc3510906bb4fae76086a14985b.translatedText: >Teaching Principal Xie Xiaohong introduced several new teachers who will join the teaching activities of Hope Chinese School next semester, so that the teaching staff of Hope Chinese School always maintains a complementary state of senior teachers and fresh energy. Principal Xie also introduced and emphasized the new teacher charter, which standardizes various teaching systems for teachers, hoping to better educate students with higher teaching quality and more standardized teaching behaviors, and also set a good example for students. The teachers also put forward good suggestions on various aspects such as jointly maintaining the school's hygienic environment, increasing student volunteer opportunities, and student safety.

ee58ab95c66e0499502ddb6992e86eed31d64cf6.sourceText: 最后资深中文教师杨京生老师对任职的公立高中中文资格考试的情况做了一个图文并茂的介绍。虽然是目前公立高中的一个中文资格考试，但是通过对这个考试的形式、内容、以及考题范围的了解，对我们中文学校老师平时的教学也有很大的启发和帮助，老师们了解了不少可以参考的教学工具和资源，受益匪浅。在热烈的提问和讨论中，本次教师培训会圆满结束。
ee58ab95c66e0499502ddb6992e86eed31d64cf6.translatedText: Finally, senior Chinese teacher Yang Jingsheng gave an illustrated introduction to the Chinese Qualification Examination of the public high school where he works. Although it is currently a Chinese qualifying test for public high schools, understanding the form, content, and scope of the test questions has greatly inspired and helped our Chinese school teachers in their daily teaching. The teachers have learned a lot about the teaching tools and resources that can be used for reference, and have benefited a lot. With lively questions and discussions, this teacher training session ended successfully.

15ed3f2292f8cd69f9e7c0877ab99841f9bd5a55.sourceText: 该法强制要求全体民众从2014年开始买医疗保险，否则就会被罚款。在实施过程中，医改法还将面临很多不确定性。如果有人不买医疗保险，谁来执法，怎么罚款？医改法扩大了保险范围，将增加3000多万人，势必增加医保系统的负担。在联邦财政已经非常困难的情况下，医保体系难以为继势必更加明显。
15ed3f2292f8cd69f9e7c0877ab99841f9bd5a55.translatedText: This law forces all people to buy medical insurance starting in 2014, otherwise they will be fined. During the implementation process, the health care reform law will also face many uncertainties. If someone does not buy medical insurance, who will enforce the law and how will they be fined? The health care reform law has expanded insurance coverage and will add more than 30 million people, which will inevitably increase the burden on the medical insurance system. As the federal finances are already very difficult, the unsustainability of the medical insurance system will inevitably become more obvious.

53b7b2b9bf56f1adb2ef12d7d250a7441561eac5.sourceText: 据美国联邦卫生部估算，约有270万的亚裔和华人会因为医改法得到免费身体检查。另外，医改法还有若干条款对华人和亚裔有好处的，比如子女到26岁都可以跟着父母医疗保险计划受益，以前最多只能到21岁。这对很多华人和亚裔有好处，估计会有10万人受惠。
53b7b2b9bf56f1adb2ef12d7d250a7441561eac5.translatedText: According to estimates from the U.S. Federal Department of Health, approximately 2.7 million Asians and Chinese will receive free physical examinations due to the health care reform law. In addition, the health care reform law also has several provisions that are beneficial to Chinese and Asian people. For example, children can benefit from their parents' medical insurance plan until they are 26 years old. In the past, they could only benefit from their parents' medical insurance plan until they were 21 years old. This will benefit many Chinese and Asians, and it is estimated that 100,000 people will benefit.

ceba654c821641d016e2b0b4c8e870425084ccd0.sourceText: 医改法还规定，有病在身者，保险公司不可以拒保，原来保险公司对一些高血压、糖尿病或癌症患者可以拒保。华人和亚裔做小老板或做生意的人比较多，这些人只能自己给自己买保险，但现在保费很贵。新法规定，要开一个交换市场，把散户集中在一起，集体跟保险公司竞价，这样就可以把保费降下来，对小业主来说有好处。
ceba654c821641d016e2b0b4c8e870425084ccd0.translatedText: The medical reform law also stipulates that insurance companies cannot refuse insurance to people who are sick. Originally, insurance companies could refuse insurance to some patients with high blood pressure, diabetes or cancer. There are many Chinese and Asian people who are small bosses or businesses. These people can only buy insurance for themselves, but the premiums are very expensive now. The new law stipulates that an exchange market should be opened to bring retail investors together and collectively bid with insurance companies, so that premiums can be reduced, which is good for small owners.

ddfd9a0cdc23ae93b6710529815e353d28e4cf11.translatedText: (Phoenix City Comprehensive News on the 25th) 17 climbers in Arizona, the United States, were trapped due to flash floods. The local rescue department rescued most of the trapped people on Sunday (23rd), and the last two were rescued by rescue helicopters on Monday (24th).

1ecf66a56cb6b93aab590a4ef1707705578e0c8c.sourceText: 事发于坦凯一个瀑布，片段可见，洪流中央的大树几乎被淹没，受困的登山者则在树顶紧抓树枝，以防被洪水冲走。直升机上的救援人员游绳而下，并在登山者抓紧其腿部后，将他带回安全的岸边。
1ecf66a56cb6b93aab590a4ef1707705578e0c8c.translatedText: The incident occurred at a waterfall in Tankai. The clip shows that the big tree in the middle of the torrent was almost submerged, and the stranded climbers clung to the branches at the top of the tree to prevent being washed away by the flood. Rescuers on the helicopter swam down the rope and brought the climber back to safety after he grabbed his legs.

8c49ce786b5ee7e6716bca9ed3442cffae9484d3.sourceText: 当局在接到登山者受困报告后，于当天救出大部分人，但至晚上仍未完成整个救援行动，最终只得将最后两名登山者留在现场，并空投物资予他们，翌日再将他们救出。
8c49ce786b5ee7e6716bca9ed3442cffae9484d3.translatedText: After receiving reports of trapped climbers, the authorities rescued most of them that day. However, the entire rescue operation was not completed by night. In the end, they had to leave the last two climbers at the scene, airdropped supplies to them, and rescued them the next day.

4500c31403b0a1d38f7c42c069c286558df1d2bb.sourceText: 南加一天几十震 专家称与大地震无直接关系 （亚省时报） 据美国地质调查局监测数据显示，截至8月26日下午，南加州布劳利地区连续发生七十多次地震，其中包括三次5级以上的地震和多次4级以上的地震。 地处美国与墨西哥边界的加州南部的布劳利地区 当日监测到的最强地震为5.5级。自上午10时02分开始，该地区连续发生数十次地震，最强烈的一次为5.5级，发生在当地时间13时57分。由于这次地震地下几公里至10几公里的范围，属于浅层地震，使附近的圣地亚哥橙县和亚利桑那州大部分地区均有震感。 加州理工学院地震研究所储日升博士表示，美国与墨西哥边境所处的地区为地震多发区，每年都有较大有感地震发生。此次连续多次地震应为前震、主震和余震的组合，属于正常现象。储日升博士认为，这些地震与人们所言的加州将发生的7级以上大地震没有直接关系。
4500c31403b0a1d38f7c42c069c286558df1d2bb.translatedText: Dozens of earthquakes in Southern California are not directly related to major earthquakes, experts say (Alberta Times) According to monitoring data from the United States Geological Survey, as of the afternoon of August 26, more than 70 earthquakes occurred in the Brawley area of Southern California, including three earthquakes of magnitude 5 or above and multiple earthquakes of magnitude 4 or above. The strongest earthquake detected that day in the Brawley area of ​​southern California, located on the border between the United States and Mexico, was 5.5 magnitude. Since 10:02 a.m., dozens of earthquakes have occurred in the area. The strongest one, with a magnitude of 5.5, occurred at 13:57 local time. Because the earthquake ranged from several kilometers to more than 10 kilometers underground, it was a shallow earthquake and could be felt in nearby San Diego, Orange County and most parts of Arizona. Dr. Chu Risheng from the California Institute of Technology’s Institute of Seismology said that the area on the border between the United States and Mexico is an earthquake-prone area, with large felt earthquakes occurring every year. The continuous earthquakes should be a combination of foreshocks, mainshocks and aftershocks, which is a normal phenomenon. Dr. Chu Risheng believes that these earthquakes are not directly related to the major earthquake of magnitude 7 or above that people say will occur in California.

2c1cd8ce4a002f943b322d2655b5a280d6c65cac.sourceText: 法律问答 1。我听说以后只要有硕士学位的人就可以11。我听说以后只要有硕士学位的人就可以直接拿绿卡﹐是否真有此事﹖ 答﹕ 2012 年11月30日，美国众议院以245票对139票简单多数通过了2012 STEM 就业法案。这标志着该项法案将会移交到参议院进行表决。2012 STEM就业法案旨在撤销现行的?#25277;签绿卡?#65292;并将其每年5万5千个绿卡名额转给在美国高等院校获得科学、技术、工程、数学专业（STEM）的外籍博士及硕士毕业生。 绿卡名额由符合条件的博士毕业生优先使用，如有剩余则转给硕士毕业生。 该项法案在今年9月20日提交众议院进行快速表决，因未能得到超过三分之二的赞同票而遭到否决。共和党在此基础上增加了一项条款，允许美国永久居民的配偶及未成年子女在他们提出绿卡申请一年之后来到美国等待绿卡，但只有在他们真正获得绿卡之后才可以在美国工作和享受福利。美国每年会发放约8万张亲属移民绿卡。该法案虽然在众议院得到通过，但是在由民主党占多数的参议院就前途未卜。11月29日，白宫发布了一份行政政策声明，明确反对2012 STEM就业法案。民主党在吸引高科技专业人才增强美国竞争优势方面和共和党并无分歧，但是他们主张进行更为?#20840;面的?#31227;民体制改革，吸引STEM人才应当作为这种?#20840;面改革?#30340;一部分。除非两党愿意妥协，达成一致，否则已经在众议院通过的2012 STEM就业法案估计也不大可能在参议院通过，最终也将无疾而终。 2。我是否可以将我所有资产将近4百万美金转给我的小孩而不用交赠与税﹖ 答﹕在2012年每个人享有512万元赠与免税额，到了2013年1月1日将有所改变。 所以，如果好好规画将来留给孩子的财产，利用一生一次512万的赠与免税额，夫妇两人就可享有1024万元的免税额。 2012年对于「1%」或百万以上的富翁可谓得天独厚，机不可失。随着遗产税(Estate Tax)豁免(Exemption)从今年512万元剧降为明年的100万元进入倒数，据国会预算处的估计，征交遗产税的富人将从2012年的4000人急升为2013年的5万5000人，因此高达5万的潜在遗产税交纳家庭在做最后的冲刺，使自己在年底前降级为「次百万」富翁，以求豁免
2c1cd8ce4a002f943b322d2655b5a280d6c65cac.translatedText: Legal Questions and Answers 1. I heard that in the future, only those with a master's degree can apply11. I heard that in the future, people with a master's degree can directly get a green card. Is this true? Answer: On November 30, 2012, the U.S. House of Representatives passed the STEM Jobs Act of 2012 by a simple majority of 245 votes to 139 votes. This signals that the bill will move to the Senate for a vote. The STEM Employment Act of 2012 aims to revoke the current green card system and transfer its annual green card quota of 55,000 to foreign doctoral and master's degree graduates who have obtained science, technology, engineering, and mathematics (STEM) majors from U.S. colleges and universities. Green card quotas will be given priority to qualified doctoral graduates, and if any are left, they will be transferred to master's degree graduates. The bill was submitted to the House of Representatives for a quick vote on September 20 this year, but was rejected because it failed to obtain more than two-thirds of the votes in favor. On this basis, the Republicans added a provision that allows the spouses and minor children of U.S. permanent residents to come to the United States to wait for a green card one year after they apply for a green card, but they can only work and enjoy benefits in the United States after they actually obtain a green card. The United States issues approximately 80,000 family-based immigration green cards every year. Although the bill passed the House of Representatives, its future in the Senate, where Democrats hold a majority, is uncertain. On November 29, the White House issued an executive policy statement explicitly opposing the 2012 STEM Jobs Act. The Democratic Party has no disagreement with the Republican Party in attracting high-tech professionals to enhance the United States' competitive advantage, but they advocate a more comprehensive reform of the democratic system. Attracting STEM talents should be part of this comprehensive reform. Unless the two parties are willing to compromise and reach an agreement, the 2012 STEM Employment Act, which has passed the House of Representatives, is unlikely to pass in the Senate and will eventually die. 2. Can I transfer all of my assets, nearly $4 million, to my children without paying gift taxes? Answer: In 2012, each person enjoyed a gift tax exemption of NT$5.12 million, which will change on January 1, 2013. Therefore, if you carefully plan the property you will leave to your children in the future and take advantage of the lifetime gift tax exemption of NT$5.12 million, the couple can enjoy a tax exemption of NT$10.24 million. 2012 is a unique year for the "1%" or millionaires, and this opportunity cannot be missed. As the estate tax exemption plummets from $5.12 million this year to $1 million next year, the Congressional Budget Office estimates that the number of rich people subject to estate tax will surge from 4,000 in 2012 to 55,000 in 2013. Therefore, families with potential estate tax payments of up to $50,000 are making a final push to downgrade themselves to "sub-millionaires" before the end of the year in order to seek exemption.

7163c4c40e59c596148b0454de1823ff23f81df6.translatedText: Super Typhoon “Ramason” severely damaged Haikou City and Hainan Island, please help! Under the news coverage of the Malaysia Airlines International Flight Crash and the Gaza Corridor crisis last week, there was very little news about Scottsdale’s sister city, Haikou City and Hainan Island being seriously affected by Super Typhoon “Ramason”. After we learned about the severe damage in Haikou, we immediately decided to launch a fundraising operation. The Red Cross made a mistake in providing quilts to the victims in midsummer, and the government's emergency relief was belated. The people of Haikou and Hainan were left with devastation after the violent storm, and they still had to rely on themselves. The following URL links are domestic and foreign reports on the disaster: 1. http://english.cntv.cn/2014/07/20/VIDE1405862639838477.shtml 2. http://hudongba.mobi/article/nto2?h_share_uid=&from=timeline&isappinstalled=0 3. http://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?__biz=MzA4Mzc5ODgzMA==&mid=200768252&idx=1&sn=3a29d5226806f355082054a9e38b50ab&scene=2&from=timeline&isappinstalled=0#rd 4. http://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?__biz=MzA5NjgwMjMzMw==&mid=200479960&idx=1&sn=3ba2340d7e4e81f78a1d436377a4253e&scene=2&from=timeline&isappinstalled=0#rd Scottsdale Mayor Jim Lane We have provided condolences and support as soon as possible. The Scottsdale Sister Cities Association hopes to provide the most direct help as soon as possible. After asking our friends in Haikou, we decided to give the amount raised for disaster relief directly to Haikou People's Hospital. Although the hospital was hit by the typhoon and the disaster was serious, it still continued to provide medical needs for the helpless and injured victims. Please give full play to the spirit of "when others are hungry, they are hungry, and when others are drowning, they are drowning" and provide substantial help. 6649c12b1b65ec6c035cd5ece8f50d0d0a6686dc.sourceText: 一波未平一波又起，因贪污公款，使用学生当仆人又被指控20年杀害前夫的纽约圣约翰大学（St. John’s University）前副校长兼亚洲研究中心院长章曙彤（Cecilia Chang）周二在皇后区家中上吊自杀。
6649c12b1b65ec6c035cd5ece8f50d0d0a6686dc.translatedText: One after another, Cecilia Chang, the former vice president and dean of the Asian Studies Center at St. John’s University in New York, who was accused of embezzling public funds, using students as servants, and killing her ex-husband 20 years ago, hanged herself at her home in Queens on Tuesday.

b42d4afe180b76819e350d2aa40349110bcd3f37.sourceText: 凤凰城计划增设轻轨车站 （亚省时报） 周三，凤凰城市议会批准一个12万美元的建设计划，用以增设两个轻轨车站。 两个车站初步方案设在16街和48街。有意见认为，目前轻轨站多分布在商业区，旧城区（16街）的低收入居民更需要公共交通。 凤凰城轻轨已经运行十年，每天乘客超过五万，有超负荷迹象。营运方目前有五个扩展工程，其中美莎的工程已经动工，凤凰城的轻轨扩展工程也于下月开始，其他工程也将陆续动工。
b42d4afe180b76819e350d2aa40349110bcd3f37.translatedText: Phoenix plans to add light rail stations (Alberta Times) On Wednesday, Phoenix City Council approved a $120,000 construction plan to add two light rail stations. The preliminary plan for the two stations is to be located at 16th Street and 48th Street. Some people believe that at present, light rail stations are mostly located in business districts, and low-income residents in the old city (16th Street) need public transportation more. The Phoenix light rail has been running for ten years, with more than 50,000 passengers a day, and there are signs of overload. The operator currently has five expansion projects, of which the Mesa project has already started. The Phoenix light rail expansion project will also start next month, and other projects will also start one after another.
