f91db966ca32d9b34af6f1211ca5d74c17bb16b1.translatedText: The National Day flag-raising ceremony for the overseas Chinese community in Phoenix was successfully held – officials from the Consulate General in Los Angeles solemnly attended ("Sunbird" Qiuxiang...

6d6c2c943a70387e40e380abcdc02356ed143fe3.sourceText: 星条旗与五星红旗迎风飘扬 卞立新副总领事在讲话中首先代表洛杉矶总领事馆向凤凰城地区华人华侨和各界朋友至以诚挚的问候和节日 的祝贺，向升旗仪式的主办者和参与者表示衷心的敬意和感谢。然后她充分肯定了亚省华人为大力宏扬中华文化，支持祖国经济建设，促进两岸和平发展等方面所做的贡献。最后，卞立新副总领事号召大家携起手来，为中华民族的伟大复兴努力奋斗。现场观众 不禁被她的诚挚和热情所鼓舞，纷纷鼓掌，用响亮的掌声表达了大家对领事们的敬意和感谢！
6d6c2c943a70387e40e380abcdc02356ed143fe3.translatedText: The Star-Spangled Banner and the Five-Star Red Flag fluttered in the wind In his speech, Deputy Consul General Bian Lixin first expressed his sincere greetings and holidays to the overseas Chinese and friends from all walks of life in the Phoenix area on behalf of the Consulate General in Los Angeles. Congratulations to the organizers and participants of the flag-raising ceremony. Then she fully affirmed the contributions of the Chinese people in Alberta to vigorously promote Chinese culture, support the economic construction of the motherland, and promote the peaceful development of the two sides. Finally, Deputy Consul General Bian Lixin called on everyone to join hands and work hard for the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation. The audience could not help but be inspired by her sincerity and enthusiasm, and applauded loudly to express their respect and gratitude to the consuls!

d009ccbe86eaae68415c300ad7c77ba18536d38b.translatedText: Economy | Four Sam's Club stores, including Scottsdale & Chandler, have closed. The person in charge of Sam's Club announced on Thursday morning...

e687f771f8921befd17de1d8c775322247ae95c3.sourceText: 山姆会员店负责人周四上午宣布位于Casa Grande, San Tan Plaza in Chandler, Scottsdale 和 Prescott Valley的四家山姆会员店宣布停业。他们将营业到1月25日。这次停业行动波及全美。全美一共有63家店面停业或者合并。其中50家是马上停业，大约10家还会经营几个星期。
e687f771f8921befd17de1d8c775322247ae95c3.translatedText: The person in charge of Sam's Club announced on Thursday morning that the four Sam's Club stores located at Casa Grande, San Tan Plaza in Chandler, Scottsdale and Prescott Valley have announced the closure of business. They will be open until January 25th. The shutdown spread across the United States. A total of 63 stores in the United States have closed or merged. Of these, 50 are closing immediately, and about 10 will remain open for a few weeks.

377715841d72bf125e10516eb71472b5ad9cd790.sourceText: 于此同事，随着企业税改行动，沃尔玛还宣布员工的最低工资从9美元提高到11美元每小时。当然被裁减的员工还会获得60天的补偿。
377715841d72bf125e10516eb71472b5ad9cd790.translatedText: At the same time, along with the corporate tax reform action, Walmart also announced that the minimum wage for employees will be increased from $9 to $11 per hour. Of course, laid-off employees will also receive 60 days of compensation.

3c1e785cd5ec21178b6ce16bd9b1d2894e0c5de4.sourceText: 其他山姆会员店还会正常影响，需要退换商品的客人，依然可以到其他会员店进行。
3c1e785cd5ec21178b6ce16bd9b1d2894e0c5de4.translatedText: Other Sam's Club stores will still be affected normally. Customers who need to return or exchange goods can still go to other member stores to do so.

b8e3572373e6f350d4d99e18ec1a8bcc8415ef3f.translatedText: Huiming: Know the meaning by looking at the words

cc5e4b642652ef958fbe5226172ee2a571dfc639.sourceText: 慧明：望词知义 图桑 慧明 人们常用”望文生义”这样的成语说那些喜欢从表面现象得出…
cc5e4b642652ef958fbe5226172ee2a571dfc639.translatedText: Huiming: Know the meaning by looking at the words Tucson Huiming People often use the idiom "Looking for the meaning from the words" to describe those who like to draw conclusions from superficial phenomena...

e839ec27fe08d0b667fa326ec87f77091022ae79.sourceText: 人们常用”望文生义”这样的成语说那些喜欢从表面现象得出结论的人，批评他孤陋寡闻等等。其实，这种批评不一定对。只要你有足够的经验和判断力，望一篇文也可以发很多正确的感想和决策的。虽然现如今是大数据时代，你如果敏锐，完全可以以小窥大，觉察世间规律，不必陷入繁琐数据分析之中。
e839ec27fe08d0b667fa326ec87f77091022ae79.translatedText: People often use the idiom "Looking for the meaning from the words" to describe those who like to draw conclusions from the superficial phenomena, criticizing them for being ignorant and so on. In fact, this criticism is not necessarily correct. As long as you have enough experience and judgment, you can post many correct thoughts and decisions in one article. Although today is the era of big data, if you are keen, you can see the big picture from the small and be aware of the laws of the world without getting stuck in tedious data analysis.

4e29002fcb642a2558d0af3d660c80600993ccc1.sourceText: 但本文感兴趣的是”望词知义”。知道一个词的大概表面意思，深入探讨，便可知道这个词产生的背景以及相关的事宜，进而推测词的未来和影响，实在是个很有趣味的事。
4e29002fcb642a2558d0af3d660c80600993ccc1.translatedText: But what this article is interested in is "knowing the meaning by looking at the words". It is really interesting to know the general surface meaning of a word and then delve deeper to know the background of the word and related matters, and then speculate on the future and influence of the word.

1ab0b9f040b4006af1aff567b1ade2bac8ec14c7.sourceText: 本人上世纪九十年代在上海语言文字的出版社工作，成天和旧词新字打交道。上海那时虽不像现在网络新语层出不穷，但出版社为了自己未来的出路，还是前瞻性地成立了一个现代汉语收词组，专门收纳报上书中（那时电脑还没流行）流行的语言，或者大家约定俗成的口头语言，为以后编篡词典所用。
1ab0b9f040b4006af1aff567b1ade2bac8ec14c7.translatedText: I worked in a Shanghai language publishing house in the 1990s, and I dealt with old words and new words all day long. Although Shanghai was not as full of Internet new words as it is now, the publishing house still proactively established a modern Chinese phrase collection group for its own future, specifically to collect popular languages ​​​​in newspapers (computers were not yet popular at that time), or common spoken languages ​​​​for future use in compiling dictionaries.

924e73ef1f29c6a8e00066b67b79124c7e030237.sourceText: 比如上海人称虾米为”开洋”，无论弄堂大妈还是祖籍为浙江的老宁波都这样你来我去，但为什么虾米在海里还叫虾子虾米，一离海水反而叫”开洋”，没叫上岸，见光什么的，没人说得清。专家们翻遍了词典台湾的大陆的甚至康熙的，都找不到答案。因为没有确切权威的说法，最后出版社食堂的阿姨的说法”这个虾米在水里是躬着的，出水晒干后就张开肚皮了，所以反而向海洋了”就无奈地被大家接受了。但书证是没有的，只是口头文化而已。所以无论虾米还是开洋，以后还是如此，没有未来。
924e73ef1f29c6a8e00066b67b79124c7e030237.translatedText: For example, people in Shanghai call shrimps "kaiyang", whether it's the aunt in the alley or the old Ningbo whose ancestral home is Zhejiang, you come and go. But why shrimps are still called shrimps when they are in the sea, but when they are out of the sea, they are called "kaiyang". They are not called ashore, and no one can explain it when they see the light. Experts searched through dictionaries from Taiwan, Mainland China and even Kangxi, but could not find the answer. Since there was no definite and authoritative statement, the statement from the aunt in the publishing house’s cafeteria was reluctantly accepted by everyone: “This shrimp is bowed in the water, and after it is dried out of the water, it opens its belly, so it faces the ocean instead.” But there is no documentary evidence, it is just oral culture. So no matter Xiami or Kaiyang, it will still be the same in the future, there is no future.

22246437b178a67a49a3bf9d608f6e45479de2b0.sourceText: 还有就是”捣浆糊”一词。”捣浆糊”最初流行在上海是有很多说法的。有人说这是从过去流氓地痞在自己的地盘里犯了事，逃离本地，到外面去避避风头，是”逃江湖”意思，后来根据音便有了”捣浆糊”的说法。其实在上世纪末流行时此词已经完全没了江湖的意思。
22246437b178a67a49a3bf9d608f6e45479de2b0.translatedText: There is also the word "mashing". There are many explanations for why "mashing paste" was first popular in Shanghai. Some people say that this comes from the past when hooligans committed crimes in their own territory and fled the local area to avoid the limelight. It means "escaping from the world". Later, according to the sound, there was a saying of "making a mess". In fact, when it became popular at the end of the last century, this word had completely lost its meaning of Jianghu.

bd7ea84f9ac3cd200a2a54d6447124047213e6e0.sourceText: 在捣浆糊还未流行的时候，上海已经有”混枪水””混腔势”的说法，指那些没有真才实学，又向往上层美好前景的人喜欢用花里胡俏的言行打扮自己，吓唬别人。但如何会变成”捣浆糊”呢？
bd7ea84f9ac3cd200a2a54d6447124047213e6e0.translatedText: Before being popular, there was already a saying in Shanghai of "bastards" and "bastards", which refers to those who have no real talent and knowledge and yearn for the bright prospects of the upper class. They like to dress themselves up with fancy words and deeds to scare others. But how does it become a "mush"?

8698b1a5bbb95c2690d95357403db4255a97fefb.sourceText: 根据语言流行的规律，一个新词要被现代社会接受，首先要借助强势和多样的媒体，日复一日地强调，大众都被洗了脑，新词就出现了。比如”星星之火，可以燎原”经过毛泽东的演绎，再为中国大陆百姓所传诵，便成了家喻户晓的现代成语。可是有多少人知道，此名句首先是出现在现在已经没有话语权的，中国传统经典《尚书.盘庚》中的呢？
8698b1a5bbb95c2690d95357403db4255a97fefb.translatedText: According to the laws of language popularity, for a new word to be accepted by modern society, it must first use strong and diverse media to emphasize it day after day. The public will be brainwashed, and the new word will appear. For example, "A single spark can start a prairie fire" was interpreted by Mao Zedong and recited by the people in mainland China, and has become a well-known modern idiom. But how many people know that this famous sentence first appeared in the traditional Chinese classic "Shang Shu Pan Geng" that no longer has the right to speak?

92f2e3a3ee49bac117749999a35709c2b943192b.sourceText: 所以，捣浆糊的产生一定和大人物出现有关。上个世纪八十年代，正是外来权威空降上海的时候，官场上虽然唯唯诺诺，给足了生姜的面子，因为生姜还是给上海带来些新气象的。你想过去当官的都是军人的干活，做起报告来都是读秘书的稿子，现在突然出现一张说着苏北腔上海话的，说着说着还时不时地蹦几句英文的书记，自然让人感到新鲜。但老是在官场上又弹又跳时，市井弄堂百姓就不以为然了。
92f2e3a3ee49bac117749999a35709c2b943192b.translatedText: Therefore, the emergence of the paste must be related to the appearance of big shots. In the 1980s, when foreign authorities came to Shanghai, although the officials were submissive, they gave Ginger enough face, because Ginger still brought some new atmosphere to Shanghai. You may think that in the past, officials only had to work as soldiers, and when making reports, they read the secretary's manuscripts. Now, suddenly, a secretary speaking in Shanghainese dialect with a Northern Jiangsu accent and speaking a few words in English from time to time suddenly appeared, which naturally made people feel fresh. But when he always bounces around in the officialdom, the people in the streets and alleys don't take it seriously.

1bea4d52749cd50e16819a2b9f7a2cc4d080328e.sourceText: 上海人从来不惧权威。英国人印度人在租界耀武扬威，上海人照样喊你”红头阿三”，日本在上海打仗不可一世，上海人一样在你眼皮下喊你小日本。所以，后来人们发现新来的也没有什么新花头，把自己说得很革命，很前卫，很有韬略，甚至还很传统的，很有责任，喜欢说别人”Too Simple”的人其实肚里也没什么。不是身后那些朱大帅徐大将鼎力相助，上海哪有以后的蓝图。但向舆论和上面吹起来，总是自己的功劳，没有我老姜决策于帷幄之中，哪有将军决胜于千里之外之说，很是沾沾自喜自吹自擂。
1bea4d52749cd50e16819a2b9f7a2cc4d080328e.translatedText: Shanghai people are never afraid of authority. When the British and Indians showed off their power in the concession, the Shanghainese people still called you "Red-headed Asan". The Japanese fought arrogantly in Shanghai, and the Shanghainese people still called you "Little Japan" under your noses. Therefore, later people discovered that the newcomers did not have any new tricks. They described themselves as very revolutionary, very avant-garde, very strategic, and even very traditional and very responsible. People who like to call others "Too Simple" actually have nothing in mind. Without the help of Marshal Zhu and General Xu behind him, Shanghai would not have a blueprint for the future. But when you brag to the public opinion and above, it is always your own merit. Without me, Lao Jiang, making decisions behind the curtain, there would be no theory that a general could win a decisive victory thousands of miles away. I am very complacent and boastful.

25c9e79dca6d7fe19039dc3838822497c91afa03.sourceText: 上海老百姓很难长久买一个戏子的账，无论茅善玉还是周立波，更不要说姜戏子了。但大面上还要过得去，人家空降上海毕竟还是南方乡亲嘛。所以回答朋友询问老姜如何怎样，一百个上海人，九十九个都会嘿嘿一笑:”淘浆糊”呀。后来经国语一演绎，就变成了”捣浆糊”了。也是这个”捣浆糊”实在太形象了，以后凡不干实事，又喜欢吹的人，无论政治商场达人还是市井百姓，都被冠以”捣浆糊”了。不同的是，这个浆糊的流行是自下而上的，不是”星星之火可以燎原”是自上而下的。
25c9e79dca6d7fe19039dc3838822497c91afa03.translatedText: It is difficult for ordinary people in Shanghai to trust an actor for a long time, no matter Mao Shanyu or Zhou Libo, let alone actor Jiang. But on the whole, it's still passable. After all, I'm still a southerner who landed in Shanghai. So in response to a friend's question about Lao Jiang, ninety-nine out of a hundred Shanghainese would laugh and say, "Looking for paste." Later, when it was interpreted in Mandarin, it turned into "making paste". It is also true that "making mistakes" is too vivid. From now on, anyone who does not do practical things and likes to brag, whether they are political experts or ordinary people, will be labeled as "making mistakes". The difference is that the popularity of this paste is from the bottom up, not from the top down like "a single spark can start a prairie fire".

62cc646a8af41c17ff432d325132edb272d33cf9.sourceText: 上海还流行过”抓手”一词，后来创造”抓手”的变中央国务大员了，抓手也在党报抓了几年，满中国都是”以xx为抓手”,搞好什么，发展什么的说法。其实”抓手”本意也就是”把手”的意思，雅点的说也就是”契机”和”机会”，可为什么这么含蓄的词变成如此赤裸裸的需求表达了呢？
62cc646a8af41c17ff432d325132edb272d33cf9.translatedText: The word "grasp" was also popular in Shanghai. Later, the person who coined "grasp" became a state minister of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China. The "grasp" was also used in the party newspapers for several years. There is a saying all over China that "use xx as the grip" to do something well and develop something. In fact, the original meaning of "handle" is "handle". To put it more elegantly, it means "opportunity" and "opportunity". But why did such an implicit word become such a naked expression of demand?

f7c13c79e5c161f838dc47c773f341ac1ca6947d.sourceText: 这和当初发生的两件大事有关。
f7c13c79e5c161f838dc47c773f341ac1ca6947d.translatedText: This is related to two major events that happened at the beginning.

4344e75b7b6a43ba12edb817ce906497d0ce1ac6.sourceText: 一是邓公在毛时代结束后，看到国家经济一片萧瑟，觉得光骂四人帮也不行，便创造了很多简单发展理论，比如猫论和摸石头的理论都为当时人们所熟知。但真正对民间和官场影响的还是”让一部分人先富起来”理论。这个理论看似平淡，但就是一个抓手，百姓抓住就是股票百万，官儿抓住就是资源人脉。
4344e75b7b6a43ba12edb817ce906497d0ce1ac6.translatedText: First, after the end of the Maoist era, Deng Gong saw that the country's economy was in a bleak state, and felt that just scolding the Gang of Four was not enough, so he created many simple development theories, such as the cat theory and the theory of touching stones, which were well known to people at the time. But what really affects the people and official circles is the theory of "let some people get rich first". This theory may seem plain, but it is a starting point. If the common people catch it, they can get millions of shares, and if the officials catch it, they can get resources and connections.

87b185ecfafed9a8b2a0230d15211805d19c9ebc.sourceText: 二是那年学生上街，书记下野，懵懵懂懂的新姜不知所措地被邓公选为总舵把子，让很多人看了眼红。市井秘传莫非这姜抓住了什么把手，这等飞黄腾达？
87b185ecfafed9a8b2a0230d15211805d19c9ebc.translatedText: Secondly, that year students took to the streets and the secretary went out of office. Xinjiang, who was ignorant and ignorant, was elected as the chief helmsman by Deng Gong, which made many people jealous. According to the secrets of the market, could it be that this Jiang had grasped some handle to achieve such a rapid rise?

b7b7744276ad2daf52a2cea51bfe65c151221364.sourceText: 老姜一北上，觊觎上海头把交椅的黄菊花陈芝麻比谁都明白，机遇对自己对上海的重要，于是与时俱进地提出了”抓手”的理论。那时上海和浦东的报纸文件以及官员们的嘴里哪天没出现”抓手”倒让人们奇怪了，莫非哪位又边缘化了？
b7b7744276ad2daf52a2cea51bfe65c151221364.translatedText: As soon as Lao Jiang went north, Huang Juhua and Chen Zhima, who coveted the top spot in Shanghai, understood better than anyone else the importance of opportunities to themselves and Shanghai, so they put forward the theory of "grasping hands" in keeping with the times. At that time, people were surprised when there were no "grasping hands" in newspapers and documents in Shanghai and Pudong and in the mouths of officials. Could it be that someone was marginalized again?

ea87c3b4f9430dbe6adf0960ded479737e8c229b.sourceText: 若是按照词典收词依据来说，”抓手”的书证已经足够了，可以作为新词出现了。但没想到的是这个词产生得快，也消失得快。在菊花黄谢之后，很少人再提”抓手”了。大概人们都避嫌了吧。
ea87c3b4f9430dbe6adf0960ded479737e8c229b.translatedText: If we look at the basis for collecting words in the dictionary, the documentary evidence of "grasp" is enough and it can appear as a new word. But what I didn’t expect was that this word was born and disappeared quickly. After the chrysanthemums fade, few people mention the "grasp" anymore. Maybe people have avoided suspicion.

987e7dd3cd842133a794dfb6033f17d48f9248ab.sourceText: 其实，这词消失也是可以想得到的。那班喜欢喊抓手的人干得更加急吼吼，到处以钱为抓手或者准则，耗尽了社会资源，也耗尽了自己的信用。笔者那时为了出版一本宣传逆境孩子成功的书《张开你的翅膀》，希望社会各界名流签名题词发扬广大。求到了一慈善基金会会长–那首先提抓手的书记太太，是否给我们的孩子提个词什么的？那会长想必是受”抓手”理论浸淫已久，让秘书带出话来:”三万元一题词！”当时三万元对小编来说，无异于今天三十万或更多，钱拿不出，题词自然没有，还带回来满肚的被歧视的怨恨。现在想来，后悔怨恨的甚至忏悔的应该是这些”抓手”们，丢掉了中国几千年的传统，抓了满手的权和钱，结果自己倒被人抓起来了。
987e7dd3cd842133a794dfb6033f17d48f9248ab.translatedText: In fact, it is conceivable that this word disappears. Those people who like to shout for help work more hurriedly, using money as the catcher or criterion everywhere, depleting social resources and their own credibility. At that time, the author wanted to publish a book "Spread Your Wings" to promote the success of children in adversity, and hoped that celebrities from all walks of life would sign and inscribe the book to spread it widely. I asked the president of a charity foundation - the wife of the secretary who raised the hand first, if she could give our child a message or something? The president must have been immersed in the "grabbing hand" theory for a long time, so he asked his secretary to say: "Thirty thousand yuan for an inscription!" To the editor, thirty thousand yuan at that time was equivalent to three hundred thousand or more today. If he couldn't get the money, he couldn't get the inscription, and he brought back a lot of resentment for being discriminated against. Now that I think about it, the ones who are regretful, resentful and even repentant should be these "grabbers" who threw away thousands of years of Chinese tradition and grabbed a lot of power and money, only to be arrested themselves.

67e9931b207ab97a29f0c3bb85a8e22202018a32.sourceText: 幸亏，当时出版社的收词组没收”抓手”那玩意为词。
67e9931b207ab97a29f0c3bb85a8e22202018a32.translatedText: Fortunately, the publishing house’s collection of phrases at that time confiscated the “grasping hand” thing as a phrase.

1c41a9629e2f2e45178020ef75a020cfc5dab810.sourceText: 青少年吸大麻人口超越抽烟 美国疾病管制暨预防中心（CDC）今天提出报告指出，23%高中生表示自己近来有吸大…
1c41a9629e2f2e45178020ef75a020cfc5dab810.translatedText: The number of teenagers smoking marijuana exceeds that of smoking. The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) issued a report today stating that 23% of high school students said they had smoked marijuana recently...

5c27552963e0f1bca8de5c19d5a942b5faa8d9dc.sourceText: 青少年吸大麻人口超越抽烟 美国疾病管制暨预防中心（CDC）今天提出报告指出，23%高中生表示自己近来有吸大麻，18%表示有抽烟。这项报告针对多种危险行为对青少年做调查。 数十年来，美国青少年吸烟人口不断下滑；不过吸大麻人口起伏不定，近来更有上升趋势。吸大麻与抽烟的青少年，数目有时不相上下，然而去年吸食大麻的人首度超越抽烟人口。 密西根大学先前所做调查同时发现，吸大麻的青少年来得比抽烟的人多。来自密西根的专家表示，现今的青少年显然认为大麻的危险性比香烟低。
5c27552963e0f1bca8de5c19d5a942b5faa8d9dc.translatedText: The number of teenagers smoking marijuana exceeded smoking. The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) reported today that 23% of high school students said they had smoked marijuana recently, and 18% said they smoked cigarettes. The report surveyed teenagers on a variety of risky behaviors. The number of U.S. teen smokers has been declining for decades; however, the number of marijuana smokers has fluctuated and has been on the rise recently. The number of teenagers who smoke marijuana and smoke cigarettes is sometimes about the same, but last year for the first time, the number of marijuana smokers exceeded the number of smokers. A previous survey conducted by the University of Michigan also found that more teenagers smoke marijuana than smoke cigarettes. Experts from Michigan say today's teens clearly view marijuana as less dangerous than cigarettes.

a7929eca0eb5cbb4742fb131a4851362ede256b7.sourceText: 慧明：赶早赶巧还要赶的好 一家美国著名汽车公司在商场里进行促销抽奖，被顾客反讥糊弄消费者。那公司痛改前非，决心给顾客点实惠，让几百上千人深夜十一点到公司广场再抽奖，说是有惊喜给大家。到最后一刻我才想起有这么回事，结果最后一个去抽奖，偏偏就让我中了头奖，拿了个巨型背投电脑。那时还没有液晶平板，所以得意了很久，真是赶巧了。 过去就没有这样的好运。那年还在上海上班，在路上走着。前面出现了一堆废报纸，兄弟飞起一脚，将纸堆踢得远远，准备再上前几步，权当个足球玩耍。正是说时迟那时快，从我身后窜上一辆”黄鱼车”（上海对三轮运货车的称呼），那蹬车的哥们纵身跃下，扑向那纸包，喃喃细语，幸福地双泪长流。原来那是他几天下来积攒的脚力钱又被找回来了。别人的辛苦铜钱理当归别人，我不眼热，不是你的，赶巧了到你脚下还是要被自己踢掉的。 所以赶巧了有时也没有好结果。以往事再为证。那时的上海还没有地铁，交通很不方便。从家到单位上班乘公交大约要三个小时（现在只要半个钟点），而骑自行车只要四五十分钟。所以那时年轻力壮的我经常骑车上下班，由此阅尽了城市风情。 但有的风情是阅不得的，阅了要付代价的。单位来了个女士，论学历可以进编辑室工作，可偏偏被分在资料室，很少有人能见到她的真面目。而且那女士是个病西施，三天两头不能上班，反倒要人送稿子和资料上门，兄弟骑车上下班便成了顺道邮差，知道了那女士的住址。 出版社可以是阳春白雪的殿堂，也可以是下里巴人的八卦世界，所以后来就慢慢知道了，那女人是社长大学时的同学，已经离婚等等。那个时代兄弟窃以为干部们还算纯洁，不像现在每人都掖着藏着二奶三姨。不过是咱们社长念旧情，帮助一下同窗罢了，我经常反击着那些八卦阿姨们。 关在编辑室的古文字堆里是难以一下体会到外面日新月异的风气的。但当你赶的巧了，见到了时代潮流现代进行时，你便会立马觉悟到，领导，真的只有领导才是与时俱进的。那天为了赶稿子，早上六点就从家里出发，经过那女士家的时候不过六点半。你说巧也不巧，那天车堵，我的自行车就被堵在那女士的门口。就在我心烦地张望前途时，那门轻轻地打开了，一个衣帽不整的男人正在拉扯着围巾出现在门前，那个男人竟是我们可敬的社长，那总在晚上打电话给老婆：今天晚上工作忙，出版局多年评选的优秀党员！ 我实在想不出什么理由可以说明，社长清晨从别家女人的门里，由内而外地出来是为了解决工作上的问题。 事后，一个同事说，兄弟你可以装着没看见么。能装么？那睡眼惺忪的脸正对着我诧异的眼，直线距离不过两尺。我担心的是那时肯定说了点什么，见到领导能不打招呼么？但我实在想不起来说了些什么，不会是说”早”吧？假如说了早，真该掌嘴！早什么早，这么早就到别的女人家里最怕别人说早！说”吃了吗”？国人见面都这样问。更不妥，昨晚刚偷腥，今早就被人说吃，多不给面子。再说领导也不好回答哪，说没吃，明明吃了人家豆腐；说吃了，不是不打自招么？那领导明白着呢，他手下那般文字工匠们厉害得很，别看一个个眼镜片像啤酒瓶底样，谁知那后面会考证出什么结果。偏偏我这个不会说话的嘴给领导出了难题。 结果弄得一整天，我倒小心翼翼不敢见领导的面，仿佛是那晚上我吃了谁家的豆腐那般。结果实在憋不住了，找到编辑部的老法师，寻求心理支持。老法师就是一位老编辑，天文地理无所不知，人情世故无所不通，也愿意帮朋友排忧解难。他的特点是可以热心帮忙，但脸上从来没有半点表情。但那次我看到那啤酒瓶般厚的眼镜片后闪了一下诡异的笑意，但那丝诡异很快又被常态淹没了。 老弟，你完了，法师开口就言重。我怎么完了！？兄弟当年还年轻，业务也可以，凭什么就完了？ ”那个”也完了。法师依然不动声色，不做解释。”那个”想当然就是领导。 结果，那几年果真积攥了不少领导给的小鞋，大概完了就是指的这事。后来出版社的大书编完，兄弟请求调离他处，领导没阻拦。大家都心知肚明，尽管豆腐是拎不起来的，但故事是可以重新提起的。 所以哪，都说早起的鸟儿有食吃也不一定对，赶早赶巧都不重要，要赶的好才行。像我便是一例，赶早了却赶糟了。 补充一句，那领导后来真完了，将我们辛苦几十年的心血版权卖给台湾，30万美金进了自己的腰包，结果案发了。那钱现在看来也不多，但那时足以让他完了。
a7929eca0eb5cbb4742fb131a4851362ede256b7.translatedText: Huiming: It’s better to rush early than to catch up. A famous American automobile company held a promotional lottery in a shopping mall, but was ridiculed by customers to fool consumers. The company changed its ways and decided to give customers some benefits. It asked hundreds or even thousands of people to come to the company square at 11 o'clock in the night to draw a lottery, saying that it had a surprise for everyone. It wasn't until the last moment that I remembered what had happened, and I was the last one to go to the lottery, and I happened to win the first prize, and got a giant rear-projection computer. There were no LCD panels at that time, so I was proud of it for a long time. It was just a coincidence. There has been no such good luck in the past. That year I was still working in Shanghai and walking on the road. A pile of scrap newspapers appeared in front of him. The brother flew up and kicked the pile of paper far away, preparing to take a few steps forward and play like a football. Just in time, a "yellow croaker" (the name for three-wheeled transport trucks in Shanghai) jumped up from behind me. The buddy on the bicycle jumped down, threw himself at the paper bag, murmured, and shed tears of happiness. It turned out that it was the money he had saved over the past few days that had been found again. Others' hard-earned coins should belong to others. I'm not jealous. It's not yours. If it happens to fall at your feet, I will still be kicked out by myself. So sometimes it just happens and it doesn't end well. The past will prove it again. There was no subway in Shanghai at that time, and transportation was very inconvenient. It takes about three hours by bus from home to work (now only half an hour), and only 40 to 50 minutes by bicycle. So at that time, when I was young and strong, I often cycled to and from get off work, and I learned all about the city. But some styles cannot be read, and you have to pay a price for reading them. A woman came to the unit. She could work in the editorial room based on her academic qualifications, but she was assigned to the data room, and few people could see her true face. Moreover, the lady was sick and could not go to work every day for three days. Instead, she had to have manuscripts and materials delivered to her door. The brother who rode his bicycle to and from get off work became a drop-in postman and knew the lady's address. A publishing house can be a palace of high spirits, or it can be a world of gossip for lower-class people, so later on I gradually found out that the woman was the president's classmate in college and had been divorced. At that time, the brothers secretly thought that the cadres were relatively pure, unlike now where everyone is hiding their mistresses and aunts. It's just that our president is reminiscing about old friendship and helping his classmates. I often fight back against those gossipy aunties. It is difficult to immediately appreciate the ever-changing atmosphere outside in the pile of ancient texts in the editing room. But when you catch it by chance and see the trend of the times progressing, you will immediately realize that leaders, really only leaders, can keep pace with the times. In order to catch up on the manuscript that day, I started from home at six o'clock in the morning, and it was only half past six when I passed the lady's house. You could say it was a coincidence, but there was a traffic jam that day, and my bicycle was blocked at that lady’s door. Just when I was anxiously looking at the future, the door opened gently, and a disheveled man appeared in front of the door, tugging on his scarf. That man turned out to be our respectable president, who always called his wife at night: I am busy with work tonight, and I am an outstanding party member selected by the Publishing Bureau for many years! I really can't think of any reason why the president came out of another woman's door early in the morning to solve a work problem. Afterwards, a colleague said, brother, can you pretend not to see it? Can you pretend? The sleepy face was facing my surprised eyes, only two feet apart in a straight line. What I'm worried about is that I must have said something at that time. Can I not say hello when I see the leader? But I really can't remember what I said. Could it be "morning"? If you said it too early, you should be slapped! Why should I be early? I am most afraid of being told that I am early when I arrive at another woman’s house so early! Say "Have you eaten?" Chinese people always ask this when they meet. It's even more inappropriate. I just stole it last night, and I'm being accused of eating it this morning. I'm not giving you face at all. Besides, it’s not easy for leaders to answer questions. If they say they haven’t eaten, they’ve clearly eaten someone else’s tofu. If they say they’ve eaten, aren’t they just asking for trouble? The leader understands that the writing craftsmen under him are very good. Even if the lenses look like the bottom of a beer bottle, who knows what the results will be later. However, my dumb mouth created a problem for the leader. As a result, I was so cautious that I didn't dare to see the leader for the whole day, as if I had eaten someone else's tofu that night. As a result, I couldn't hold it in anymore, so I went to the old mage in the editorial department for psychological support. The old master is an old editor who knows everything about astronomy and geography, and is knowledgeable about people and the world. He is also willing to help his friends solve their problems. His characteristic is that he is eager to help, but he never has the slightest expression on his face. But that time I flashed a weird smile when I saw those glasses as thick as beer bottles, but the weirdness was quickly submerged by normality. Brother, you are finished. The mage always speaks harshly. How am I finished! ? My brother was still young back then and his business was good, so why should he be finished? "That" is finished too. The mage remained calm and did not explain. "That" is taken for granted as the leader. As a result, in those few years, I really accumulated a lot of small shoes given by the leaders, and this is probably what I was referring to. Later, after the publishing house finished editing the big book, my brother asked to be transferred to another place, but the leader did not stop him. Everyone knows that although the tofu cannot be lifted, the story can be told again. So, it is said that the early bird catches the food, but it is not necessarily correct. It is not important to catch the opportunity early, but to catch it well. It's like me. I rushed too early but ended up too late. Let me add that the leader was really screwed up later. He sold the copyright that we had worked hard on for decades to Taiwan and pocketed 300,000 US dollars. As a result, the crime was discovered. That money may not seem like much now, but it was enough to finish him off at that time.

9d7d32e73e238f11f4d06559106eb9846c9ce908.sourceText: 众志成城 抗击疫情 | 此爱翻山海，山海皆可平
9d7d32e73e238f11f4d06559106eb9846c9ce908.translatedText: United as one to fight the epidemic | This love can conquer mountains and seas, and all mountains and seas can be leveled

826fe2757d4b7bd5b26be3ffea04c9a6577fe0c5.translatedText: (Donation Publicity Group) In just a few weeks, nearly three hundred families donated $47,895 from individuals, and the company matched the donation of about $11,700. The Chinese Restaurant Association...

866ced41fad68812ea01fb4152cbe0cd16dcbe59.sourceText: （捐赠宣传组）短短数周，将近三百个家庭，个人捐款$47895，公司配捐约$11700，中餐馆协会及餐馆业主捐款$17900，其他捐款$1000，累计捐款额达到$78495……这就是AZ的速度，AZ华人的速度，每一位心怀大爱的个人及团体的速度。时间回到2020年3月17日，刚刚打完抗疫上半场驰援祖国的大仗，亚利桑那州的华人们就意识到一场新的战役正在展开。AZ多家医疗机构告急：口罩库存量不足，防护服短缺，很多医院向社区求助，甚至表示可以接受手工缝制的布制口罩。和一个半月前的武汉一样，逆行而上的白衣天使们正面临着无防护上阵的危机，将与病毒正面交战。
866ced41fad68812ea01fb4152cbe0cd16dcbe59.translatedText: (Donation Publicity Group) in just a few weeks, will Nearly three hundred families donated $47,895 from individuals, about $11,700 from the company, $17,900 from the Chinese Restaurant Association and restaurant owners, and $1,000 from other donations. The cumulative donation amount reached $78,495... This is the speed of AZ, the speed of AZ Chinese, and the speed of every individual and group with great love. Back on March 17, 2020, just after the first half of the fight against the epidemic to help the motherland, the Chinese people in Arizona realized that a new battle was unfolding. Many medical institutions in AZ are in emergency: there is insufficient stock of masks and a shortage of protective clothing. Many hospitals have asked the community for help and even said they can accept hand-sewn cloth masks. Just like Wuhan a month and a half ago, the angels in white who are going retrograde are facing the crisis of going into battle without protection and will fight the virus head-on.

706f1e71a17545c91a8a62755910ec6ec893a0d2.sourceText: 危急时刻，AZ Chinese Americans COVID-19 Relief在三百多位志愿者的努力下应运而生。疫情如火，一方面募款工作在如火如荼地开展着，另一方面，各个小组的工作也在有条不紊地进行着。1采购组，肩负寻找货源，检验产品资质，协商价格，签订购买合同等一系列最关键的任务，是整个活动的重中之重；2物流组，打通货运清关等环节，为防护用品顺利到达铺平道路；3医院对接组，和凤凰城及图森的各大医院机构协商捐赠对接事宜，确保大家的爱心捐赠送达最需要的地方；4财务组，整合账目，收发款项，是此次捐赠活动最有力的后勤保障；5中英文宣传组，“我们在奉献的同时，还要让整个美国社会看到华人的努力，听到华人的声音”，对一个团队来说，精神是一种比山更强烈比海更澎湃的力量；6法务组，法治社会，一切要有章可循，让捐赠活动走得更稳，走得更远。
706f1e71a17545c91a8a62755910ec6ec893a0d2.translatedText: At this critical moment, AZ Chinese Americans COVID-19 Relief came into being due to the efforts of more than 300 volunteers. The epidemic is raging. On the one hand, fundraising work is in full swing. On the other hand, the work of various groups is also proceeding in an orderly manner. 1. The purchasing group is responsible for a series of the most critical tasks such as finding sources of goods, inspecting product qualifications, negotiating prices, and signing purchase contracts. It is the top priority of the entire activity; 2. The logistics group is responsible for clearing freight and customs clearance and other links to pave the way for the smooth arrival of protective equipment; 3. The hospital docking group negotiates donation docking matters with major hospitals in Phoenix and Tucson to ensure that everyone's donations are delivered to the places where they are most needed; 4. Finance The team, which integrates accounts and sends and receives funds, is the most powerful logistical support for this donation event; 5 Chinese and English publicity team, "While we are making contributions, we also need to let the entire American society see the efforts of the Chinese and hear the voices of the Chinese." For a team, the spirit is a force stronger than mountains and more surging than the sea; 6 Legal team, in a society governed by law, everything must be followed in order to make the donation more stable and go further.

f5febb97c809885fac3c21f9cd96421898f547f4.sourceText: 4月7日，第一批5000个口罩飘洋过海，历经万里行程，终于来到Mountain Park Heath Center的工作人员手上；4月8日，Chandler Reginal Medical Center和Gilbert Mercy也从组织者的手中接过了沉甸甸的18000个口罩。第一批其余的七万多个口罩也在陆续到达，并将被送抵凤凰城和图森的其他医疗机构，去完成捍卫医护人员的神圣使命。
f5febb97c809885fac3c21f9cd96421898f547f4.translatedText: On April 7, the first batch of 5,000 masks traveled across the ocean and finally arrived at the hands of the staff at Mountain Park Heath Center after thousands of miles of travel. On April 8, Chandler Reginal Medical Center and Gilbert Mercy also received a heavy 18,000 masks from the organizers. The remaining more than 70,000 masks in the first batch are also arriving one after another and will be sent to other medical institutions in Phoenix and Tucson to complete the sacred mission of protecting medical staff.

92a7ccb3a18249bb7d517df71a36495ce496bd64.sourceText: 疫情还在持续，许许多多的爱心小故事也在身边不断发生着。中国的情况已经在逐步好转，美国的春天也必将会到来。一边是故乡，有父母兄弟，是我心之所向；一边是家园，有妻子儿女，是我魂之所牵。我愿处处安好，我愿家家美满。谁说山穷水尽疑无路，我坚信此爱翻山海，山海皆可平！
92a7ccb3a18249bb7d517df71a36495ce496bd64.translatedText: The epidemic is still going on, and many little stories of love are also happening around us. The situation in China is gradually improving, and spring in the United States is bound to come. On one side is my hometown, with my parents and brothers, which is where my heart is; on the other side is my home, with my wife and children, which is where my soul is. I want everything to be well, and I want every family to be happy. Who said that there is no way out when the mountains and rivers are exhausted? I firmly believe that this love can transcend mountains and seas, and all mountains and seas can be leveled!

9a0302dd24adfdbe96eea253477c0f527446b1b4.translatedText: The British and American media are paying attention to China's liberalization of the "two-child policy", and domestic scholars have commented that the "impact is limited"

6ce81c71c2be4ace9ee55fd275a001c2de7713b4.translatedText: The "Decision of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China on Comprehensively Deepening...

26debc9fb4f135ae795d05f0b3495e846dccbe88.sourceText: 英国广播公司(BBC)报道称，中国决策机构在本周的关键会议落下帷幕，被称为中国下一阶段改革蓝图的《决定》文件已经披露。会上决定了包括废除劳教制度和”单独二胎”政策在全国推广等突破性措施。
26debc9fb4f135ae795d05f0b3495e846dccbe88.translatedText: " reviewed and approved by the Third Plenary Session of the 18th CPC Central Committee. The British Broadcasting Corporation (BBC) reported that the key meeting of China's decision-making body came to an end this week, and the "Decision" document known as China's blueprint for the next stage of reform has been disclosed. Breakthrough measures were decided at the meeting, including the abolition of the re-education through labor system and the nationwide promotion of the "two-child policy".

baba8a679cbcf70fa6d28cbc97b9fdf2681cf2c6.sourceText: BBC详细介绍了中国上世纪70年代开始推行计划生育政策，多数情况下是一家一子女，但少数民族一户可育多于一名子女。
baba8a679cbcf70fa6d28cbc97b9fdf2681cf2c6.translatedText: >The BBC introduced in detail that China began to implement the family planning policy in the 1970s. In most cases, one child is per family, but ethnic minorities can have more than one child per family.

6e07ede0edc5371a5858b55ac58c3bb404f96b5e.sourceText: 英国天空电视台指出，中国此次有关二胎生育政策的决定，将是一个重大的政策调整。中国此次还将废除推行了数十年的劳动教养制度。
6e07ede0edc5371a5858b55ac58c3bb404f96b5e.translatedText: British Sky TV pointed out that China’s decision on the second-child policy will be a major policy adjustment. China will also abolish the reeducation through labor system that has been implemented for decades.

90eaea9c3604b3c91cfbb77f4820fd49d7ece48b.sourceText: 美国《纽约时报》的评论文章称，中国政府关于放松计划生育政策和废止劳教制度的政策变动，是事关中国民生的两项重要的改革。
90eaea9c3604b3c91cfbb77f4820fd49d7ece48b.translatedText: A commentary in the New York Times stated that the Chinese government’s policy changes on relaxing the family planning policy and abolishing the labor reeducation system are two important reforms related to China’s people’s livelihood.

6b0853dec66c20d08693bf624adf1c5ac86a0c80.sourceText: 《纽约时报》文章指出，中国多年来实施城市居民一家育一子的政策，但现在，政策在逐年放宽。之前只有当一个家庭中，父母双方都是各自家中的独生子，他们才能生育2名子女，但现在，只要父母中一方是家中的独生子，他们也可以生两个孩子。
6b0853dec66c20d08693bf624adf1c5ac86a0c80.translatedText: The New York Times article pointed out that China has implemented a policy of raising one child per family for urban residents for many years, but now, the policy is being relaxed year by year. Previously, a family could only have two children if both parents were the only child in their respective families, but now, as long as one parent is the only child, they can also have two children.

2a3cb664d146685e343731f8d7c02a4b9dd00685.sourceText: 中国社科院人口统计学学者王广洲（音译）在接受《纽约时报》采访时表示，这是自1970年以来，z中央政府对计划生育政策的首次放开，意义重大，但如何操作的具体办法还有待于进一步的研究。
2a3cb664d146685e343731f8d7c02a4b9dd00685.translatedText: Wang Guangzhou (transliteration), a demographer at the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences, said in an interview with the New York Times that this is the first time the central government has liberalized the family planning policy since 1970. It is of great significance, but the specific methods of how to operate it still need further research.

db15b3ffb4a57ccbb145c865173fbd108ce19ef1.sourceText: 国内专家普遍看好放开”单独”二胎政策。他们认为，这一政策对宏观经济和社会发展都起到了有利作用。生育水平低导致人口年龄失衡，社会更趋于老龄化，劳动力供给不足，随之而来的是养老问题更加突出。而生育水平的提高，对这些社会问题都将有所缓解。
db15b3ffb4a57ccbb145c865173fbd108ce19ef1.translatedText: Domestic experts are generally optimistic about liberalizing the "individual" second-child policy. They believe that this policy has played a beneficial role in macroeconomic and social development. Low fertility levels have led to an imbalance in the age of the population, making society more aging, and insufficient labor supply. As a result, the problem of elderly care has become more prominent. The improvement of fertility level will alleviate these social problems.

0e2c0dd4aa5fa03c145ee65cdd9fac24a946cf3f.sourceText: ”单独”二胎生育政策启动实施，对中国人口增长会产生怎样的影响？”政策刚刚出台，生育水平短期内会有一定回升，但随着时间的推移，政策效应会慢慢淡化和削弱。”上海市社科院人口与发展研究所副所长周海旺表示，这种提高与回升同样受地域影响，相比农村，对城市的影响会更大一些。但对于上海等经济较为发达、生育率原本很低的城市来说，影响非常有限，相比之下，二线城市影响更大。
0e2c0dd4aa5fa03c145ee65cdd9fac24a946cf3f.translatedText: The launch of the "individual" two-child policy will have what impact on China's population growth? "The policy has just been introduced, and the fertility level will rebound to a certain extent in the short term, but as time goes by, the policy effect will slowly fade and weaken." Zhou Haiwang, deputy director of the Institute of Population and Development of the Shanghai Academy of Social Sciences, said that this improvement and rebound are also affected by geography, and will have a greater impact on cities than in rural areas. However, for cities such as Shanghai with relatively developed economies and originally low fertility rates, the impact is very limited. In contrast, the impact is greater in second-tier cities.

dc9b85c57bee496b65601b0e0b2aae179e13647b.translatedText: The American Overseas Chinese Newspaper reported

5a0f4c7ec014ecffc9ab9d700ab3b0c3fc686277.sourceText: 2011年，远远高出中国大陆GDP增长数据的，是同比大幅增长的留学人员数量棗34万人成行，20%的增幅，让中国成为世界最大的留学人员派遣国。留学群体基数的日益壮大，也让”留学低龄化”越发成为潮流。九月，更多的未成年”小留学生”即将远渡重洋，奔赴”留学首选国”美国，踏上自己少小离家的求学之旅。 留学机构”暗战”中关村，”察颜阅色”是关键 欲问留学产业有多热，请上”村”里走一遭棗在北京，以传统电子产业蜚声海外的”中国硅谷”中关村似乎正在经历一场宏大的产业转型。在国内最大的外语培训机构棗新东方教育集团地处的海淀中街上举目望去，就有形形色色、大小不一的留学机构近20家。 下午1点，午后灼热的阳光下，各家”阵营”的销售人员依据路人相貌锁定潜在客户，殷勤递上传单；拉着三轮车出来的小贩卖力推销涵盖TOEFL、IELTS、SAT在内，所有出国考试必备科目的盗版教辅书籍棗村里夏末秋初这一处风景，也成为各路商家围绕中国大陆这一风生水起的留学市场，展开明争暗斗的一个剪影。 一位街面销售人员告诉记者，根据年初制定的新战略，除年轻人外，公司在目标客户的圈定上，会更多考虑那些有着优厚经济实力，同时又有高端教育需求的成熟家庭，因此沿街推销会更多关注那些携带孩子出来的群体。”当然(孩子)也不能太小，只要不是牵着手的，看起来初中大小的就挺合适，我们会针对家庭条件的不同，给客户提供量身定制、个性化的出国留学一条龙服务。” 对于这种愿者上钩、”钓鱼”式推销能够收到的有效反馈，这位销售人员的回答远超记者预料，”差不多十个里面有三、四个吧，尽管竞争还是激烈的，但是现在真的比往年好做了”。 记者查阅启德教育集团”国际教育研究院”发布的《2011年中国学生留学意向调查报告》发现，随着中国家庭收入的增加，越来越多的家长选择让自己未成年的孩子成为小留学生，留学低龄化开始成为主流。而针对全国14个城市、17500多名学生及家长的调查统计数据显示，国内学生最感兴趣的留学热点国家前五位分别为：美国、英国、澳大利亚、加拿大、新加坡。前三名中，美国占比33%、英国17%、澳大利亚14%。从国家选择上来说，美国留学更加炙手可热。 记者致电新东方旗下的前途出国咨询有限公司，一位陈姓留学顾问介绍，目前大陆各所公办优质初、高中开设的国际课程班，极大转变了以往国际教育领域被私立学校垄断的局面，业已成为大陆学生出国留学的重要渠道。 ”这些针对尚未成年的初中生开设国际课程的高中，在定位上我们都称之为国际高中。目前北京开办国际班的学校多，形式多，但在课程设置上基本都由中方课程、语言课程和外方课程三部分组成，课程与留学目的紧密衔接。若目的地是美国，像SAT、AP这些肯定要有涉及。像人大附中、北京四中这些公立校现在都还成了AP考试考点。我们(留学机构)都很关注这一市场。”陈顾问表示。 在留学热潮带动下，仅在北京地区，就有10%的中考毕业生选择高中里的国际班，业内普遍预计，今后很长的一段时间里，这一比例还将呈现稳步上升趋势。同时，国际班的办学热潮，正在从北、上、广等热点一线城市向全国蔓延。
5a0f4c7ec014ecffc9ab9d700ab3b0c3fc686277.translatedText: In 2011, what was far higher than mainland China's GDP growth data was the substantial year-on-year increase in the number of overseas students, 340,000, a 20% increase, making China the world's largest sending country of overseas students. The growing base of students studying abroad has also made "study abroad at a younger age" increasingly becoming a trend. In September, more underage "little international students" will soon travel across the ocean to the United States, the "first choice country for studying abroad", to embark on their own study journey away from home. Study abroad institutions are "secretly fighting" against Zhongguancun, and "looking at the appearance" is the key. If you want to know how popular the study abroad industry is, please go to the "village" for a tour. In Beijing, Zhongguancun, the "China's Silicon Valley" famous overseas for its traditional electronics industry, seems to be undergoing a grand industrial transformation. Looking around on Haidian Middle Street, where Zao New Oriental Education Group, the largest foreign language training institution in the country, is located, there are nearly 20 study abroad institutions of various sizes. At 1 o'clock in the afternoon, under the scorching afternoon sun, sales staff from various "camps" targeted potential customers based on the appearance of passers-by and diligently handed out flyers; vendors pulling out tricycles tried to sell pirated teaching aids covering TOEFL, IELTS, and SAT, all necessary subjects for overseas exams. The scenery in Zaocun in late summer and early autumn has also become a silhouette of the overt and covert competition among various merchants around the booming study abroad market in mainland China. A street salesperson told reporters that according to the new strategy formulated at the beginning of the year, in addition to young people, the company will give more consideration to mature families with strong financial strength and high-end education needs when defining target customers. Therefore, street sales will pay more attention to those groups with children. "Of course (the children) cannot be too young. As long as they are not holding hands, it seems that junior high school-sized children are quite suitable. We will provide customers with tailor-made and personalized one-stop services for studying abroad based on different family conditions." Regarding the effective feedback received from those who are willing to take the bait and "fishing" sales, the salesperson's answer far exceeded the reporter's expectations, "About three or four out of ten. Although the competition is still fierce, it is really better now than in previous years." The reporter consulted the "2011 Survey Report on Chinese Students' Intention to Study Abroad" released by Kai Tak Education Group's "International Education Research Institute" and found that as the income of Chinese families increases, more and more parents choose to let their underage children become international students, and studying abroad at a younger age has begun to become mainstream. The survey statistics of more than 17,500 students and parents in 14 cities across the country show that the top five hot countries for studying abroad that domestic students are most interested in are: the United States, the United Kingdom, Australia, Canada, and Singapore. Among the top three, the United States accounts for 33%, the United Kingdom 17%, and Australia 14%. In terms of country selection, studying in the United States is even more popular. The reporter called Qiantu Abroad Consulting Co., Ltd., a subsidiary of New Oriental, and a study abroad consultant surnamed Chen introduced that the international courses currently offered by high-quality public junior and senior high schools in mainland China have greatly changed the previous monopoly of private schools in the international education field and have become an important channel for mainland students to study abroad. "These high schools that offer international courses for underage junior high school students are called international high schools in terms of positioning. Currently, there are many schools in Beijing offering international courses in many forms, but the curriculum basically consists of three parts: Chinese courses, language courses and foreign courses. The courses are closely connected with the purpose of studying abroad. If the destination is the United States, things like SAT and AP must be involved. Public schools such as the High School Affiliated to Renmin University and Beijing No. 4 Middle School are now also AP exam test centers," said Consultant Chen. Driven by the craze for studying abroad, in Beijing alone, 10% of high school entrance examination graduates choose international classes in high schools. The industry generally predicts that this proportion will continue to rise steadily for a long time to come. At the same time, the craze for offering international classes is spreading across the country from popular first-tier cities such as Beijing, Shanghai and Guangzhou.

e1c95c3a3a06fadb0ac9de94c57843af7e938a74.sourceText: 小留学生及其家庭棗成长的期盼和烦恼 美国何以成为留学首选国？2011年留学调查显示，教育质量和文化氛围已成为中国学生选择留学目的国的两大首要考量因素，各占近30%的比例。而在院校选择方面，专业排名和就业前景两者成为优先考虑的因素。 在新东方大厦一楼咨询大厅，一位在门口接孩子回家的先生这样说：”你瞧现在的高中生，一日三餐就差喂到嘴里了，每天除了考试什么都不关心，将来怎么走向社会？而且在国内上好大学的竞争太激烈，孩子若考不上特别耽误前程。去美国读书尽管会吃苦，但肯定能真正经历成长。” 在大陆，越来越多的家长认为，国内教育资源有限，优秀学生太多，还不如”曲线救国”，到国际高中学习国际课程。 ”只要是来这里的，基本上家庭消费能力和留学意愿都比较强，所以学费多少并不是他们关心的重点，通常他们最关注的是教育教学情况，像开设的课程，办学经验，师资情况这些的。”另据咨询大厅的留学顾问介绍，选择国际高中的家长和学生，百分之百将走上出国留学的道路。 ”出国要趁早”，但是早出国真的能收获成长？近年来屡见不鲜的关于小留学生生活糜烂、奢侈消费、聚众赌博、甚至违法犯罪的负面报道不时传回中国，也不得不让家长担忧起低龄留学的风险。 与高考成绩不理想，进而选择出国的高中生群体不同，再小一点的孩子往往被家庭因素所左右。由于这类小留学生的决定权更多掌握在家长手中，因此在选择国家、学校时，家长的意志显得尤为突出，”被留学”的情况也不是不可能发生。在不是自己意愿驱使的留学生涯中，产生逆反心理的可能性也非常大。 作为一名过来人，上海律师戴先生用自己的曲折经历告诉记者，为了尚未成年的孩子，家庭所做出的努力往往超出想象。 戴先生的孩子戴竹今年12岁，尚是贪玩的年纪，却早已被家里规划好了人生道路，稚嫩的面孔一脸严肃棗在大陆读完六年级，参加SSAT考试，接着被洛杉矶地区一所私立学校录取，家里甚至连将来的高中都替他考虑好了。 ”说到底，还是不放心，想时刻都能看的到、管的着他。”因为赴美”陪读”有严格的要求，为了满足”F2陪读签证”中”夫妻任何一方的身份合法；夫妻双方有足够的资金证明能够承担在美国期间的所有费用”的要求，十多年之前，”高瞻远瞩”的戴先生就开始为此拼搏棗选择、从事带有国际背景的公司和职业，以及努力赚钱，”我当时就两个念头，首先孩子一定要去美国读书，第二为了他我必须挣足1000万。” 目前，戴先生已经辞去在国内的工作，即将在9月初启程赴美，开始一个家庭的陪读生活，据他所说，像他这种情况的家庭其实不在少数，下一步基本上也只有移民这一条路可以走。 戴先生的情况也许是个案，但在他之外，那些远离父母视线，缺乏自制力的小留学生们如何在缺失管教的开放环境中健康成长？少小离家与”成长的烦恼”共生，让人难以心安。
e1c95c3a3a06fadb0ac9de94c57843af7e938a74.translatedText: The expectations and worries of young international students and their families growing up. Why has the United States become the first choice country for studying abroad? The 2011 study abroad survey showed that education quality and cultural atmosphere have become the two primary considerations for Chinese students in choosing a destination country to study abroad, each accounting for nearly 30%. When it comes to college selection, professional rankings and employment prospects have become priority factors. In the consultation hall on the first floor of the New Oriental Building, a gentleman who picked up his children at the door said this: "Look at today's high school students, who have to put three meals a day into their mouths. They don't care about anything except exams every day. How will they enter the society in the future? Moreover, the competition for getting into a good university in China is too fierce. If children fail to pass the exam, their future will be particularly delayed. Although it will be hard to study in the United States, you will definitely experience real growth." In mainland China, more and more parents believe that domestic education resources are limited and there are too many outstanding students, so it is better to "save the country" by studying international courses in international high schools. "As long as they come here, their family spending power and willingness to study abroad are basically relatively strong, so the tuition fee is not their focus. Usually, what they are most concerned about is the education and teaching situation, such as the courses offered, school running experience, teachers' situation, etc." According to the study abroad consultant in the consulting hall, 100% of parents and students who choose international high schools will embark on the road of studying abroad. "You should go abroad as early as possible", but can you really gain growth by going abroad early? In recent years, negative reports about young international students' corrupt lives, extravagant consumption, gatherings for gambling, and even illegal crimes have been spread back to China from time to time, which has also made parents worry about the risks of studying abroad at a young age. Unlike the group of high school students who do not perform well in the college entrance examination and choose to go abroad, younger children are often influenced by family factors. Since the decision-making power of these young international students is more in the hands of their parents, the will of their parents is particularly prominent when choosing a country and school, and it is not impossible for them to be "student abroad". In a study abroad career that is not driven by one's own wishes, the possibility of developing a rebellious mentality is also very high. As a person who has experienced this, Mr. Dai, a Shanghai lawyer, told reporters with his own tortuous experience that for the sake of underage children, the efforts made by families are often beyond imagination. Mr. Dai's child, Dai Zhu, is 12 years old. He is still playful, but his life path has already been planned by his family. His young face is serious. He finished sixth grade in China, took the SSAT exam, and was admitted to a private school in the Los Angeles area. The family has even considered his future high school for him. "In the end, I still don't worry. I want to be able to see and control him at all times." Because there are strict requirements for "accompanying students" in the United States. In order to meet the "F2 accompanying student visa", "the status of either spouse is legal; both spouses have sufficient funds to prove that they can bear all the expenses during the period in the United States." "More than ten years ago, the "forward-looking" Mr. Dai began to work hard for this purpose, choosing companies and careers with international backgrounds, and working hard to make money. "I had two thoughts at the time. First, my child must go to the United States to study, and second, I must earn 10 million for him." At present, Mr. Dai has resigned from his job in China and is about to leave for the United States in early September to start living with a family. According to him, there are actually many families in his situation, and the next step is basically to immigrate. Mr. Dai's situation may be an isolated case, but besides him, how can those young international students who are far away from their parents' sight and lack self-control grow up healthily in an open environment lacking discipline? Leaving home at a young age coexists with "growing pains", which makes it difficult to feel at ease.

dd7e2c18477cd348438db963f9aab26940c74718.sourceText: 游学”第三极”赢利点凸显棗留学市场新动向 ”低龄留学”时代大幕已经开启，大陆家庭日益增长的高端教育需求与留学服务公司，以及美国学校三者之间的利益关系开始空前紧密结合起来。 美国政府和私立学校当然不会对每年近24%的赴美留学增长率视而不见，在大陆，从奥巴马积极推动中美关系，留学签证放宽，OPT实习机会大开到人民币升值，有越来越多”利好”消息放出。 作为教育国际化发展、演变的重要体现，2012年，青少年海外游学项目关注度和需求度极大提升，成为继出国留学、入读国际高中后的高端教育市场”第三极”棗拥有众多海外教育资源的留学服务机构纷纷打出”预演留学、减少留学障碍”等口号，凭借自身独有的海外院校资源与关系，成为这些游学项目的重要推手。 在名校访问和英语学习等传统项目基础上，中国留学服务公司拓展出更为丰富的新项目。记者在某教育机构官网上看见，针对低龄孩子的游学美国计划，机构推出”素质提高营””语言浸泡营””留学语言营””职业特训营”等不同主题的游学团，以迎合更多学生和家长的个性化需求。 留学的本质是一个锻炼学生独立生活能力的过程，不可能事事顺利，但通过”预演”性质的游学，能让年幼的孩子提前了解日后留学生活中可能遇到学习、语言、社交等难题，体验远离家人独立生活的过程，都将帮助他们判断自己是否适合留学。另外，不是所有人日后都有机会留学，通过这些体验式项目，用相对低的费用入读哈佛或耶鲁，学生将获得一段在世界顶级名校体验及学习的宝贵经历，这对他们设定人生目标及规划都将带来启发作用。
dd7e2c18477cd348438db963f9aab26940c74718.translatedText: The "Third Pole" Profit Point of Study Tours Highlights New Trends in the Study Abroad Market The era of "younger students studying abroad" has begun. The growing demand for high-end education from mainland families, study abroad service companies, and American schools have become more closely integrated than ever before. Of course, the U.S. government and private schools will not turn a blind eye to the nearly 24% annual growth rate of studying in the U.S. In mainland China, from Obama's active promotion of Sino-U.S. relations, the relaxation of study visas, the widening of OPT internship opportunities to the appreciation of the RMB, more and more "good" news has been released. As an important manifestation of the development and evolution of education internationalization, in 2012, the attention and demand for overseas study tour programs for teenagers increased significantly, becoming the "third pole" of the high-end education market after studying abroad and enrolling in international high schools. Study abroad service agencies with numerous overseas education resources have launched slogans such as "preview study abroad and reduce barriers to study abroad" and have become important promoters of these study tour programs by virtue of their unique overseas school resources and relationships. On the basis of traditional projects such as visits to famous schools and English learning, China Study Abroad Service Corporation has developed a richer range of new projects. The reporter saw on the official website of an educational institution that for young children’s study tour in the United States, the institution has launched study tour groups with different themes such as “Quality Improvement Camp”, “Language Immersion Camp”, “Study Abroad Language Camp” and “Special Vocational Training Camp” to cater to the individual needs of more students and parents. The essence of studying abroad is a process of training students' ability to live independently. Everything cannot go smoothly. However, through a "preview" study tour, young children can understand in advance the difficulties they may encounter in studying abroad, such as learning, language, and social interaction. The experience of living independently away from their families will help them judge whether they are suitable for studying abroad. In addition, not everyone will have the opportunity to study abroad in the future. Through these experiential programs, students can attend Harvard or Yale at a relatively low cost. Students will gain a valuable experience of experiencing and studying at the world's top universities, which will inspire them to set life goals and plans.

0326bc7e72e68e98a6e117204eb539921d037d82.sourceText: 据台湾媒体报道，熊黛林上月默认收了男友郭富城(城城)3克拉钻戒，还传相恋6年的两人，本月祕密注册结婚，不料案情急转直下，城城14、17日在台港出席活动时皆发表”拒婚宣言”，将一直怀有结婚梦的熊黛林从天堂打进地狱，港媒爆料，早在城城公开拒婚前，两人感情已到瓶颈，熊13日和友人打电话时激动倾吐：”我好辛苦，好不开心！”
0326bc7e72e68e98a6e117204eb539921d037d82.translatedText: According to Taiwanese media reports, Xiong Dailin accepted a 3-carat diamond ring from her boyfriend Aaron Kwok (Chengcheng) by default last month. It was also rumored that the two have been in love for 6 years. She secretly registered to get married this month. Unexpectedly, the case took a turn for the worse. Cheng Cheng issued a "Declaration of Refusal to Marriage" when attending events in Taiwan and Hong Kong on the 14th and 17th, sending Xiong Dailin, who had always dreamed of getting married, from heaven to hell. Hong Kong media broke the news that Cheng Cheng publicly refused to marry as early as Previously, the relationship between the two had reached a bottleneck. When Xiong called a friend on the 13th, he excitedly confided: "I'm so hard and unhappy!"

d02fbc2e0946ffb0981315d5c4acf76c43e4ffcf.sourceText: 郭富城日前赴台宣传”舞临盛宴”演唱会时否认婚讯，还撂重话”我是工作狂，家庭观念一直不存在”，强调”现在是黄金时间，不是用来结婚生子的”，后来在港也宣布没成家念头，两次拒婚把将满32岁的熊黛林情绪打入谷底。
d02fbc2e0946ffb0981315d5c4acf76c43e4ffcf.translatedText: Aaron Kwok recently went to Taiwan to promote the "Dancing Feast" concert and denied the news of marriage. , he also said harshly, "I am a workaholic, and the concept of family has never existed" and emphasized that "now is the golden time, not for getting married and having children." Later, he announced in Hong Kong that he had no intention of starting a family. His two rejections of marriage pushed Xiong Dailin, who was about to turn 32, into a rock bottom.

97ab4256da9bdc9eece8d582bcc38fe2d7ecf1cf.sourceText: 据查，熊黛林13日与助理到酒店吃平价自助餐，看来心情极差，后来接了通电话愈说愈激动，邻桌的记者听到她说”我好辛苦，好不开心”，模样伤心，令人心疼。
97ab4256da9bdc9eece8d582bcc38fe2d7ecf1cf.translatedText: According to the investigation, Xiong Dailin went to the hotel with her assistant to eat at a cheap buffet on the 13th. She seemed to be in a very bad mood. Later, she answered the phone and became more and more excited as she talked. The reporter at the next table heard her say, "I'm so hard and unhappy." She looked sad and heartbroken.

a49e777549de7c779cb647f3181a84c18d0da7b5.sourceText: 图森枪杀案凶手认罪 法官择日判刑 联邦地方法院法官拉里伯恩斯周五发布消息，将图森枪杀案凶手判刑日期提到11月8日。 贾里德罗夫纳于2011年1月在图森一家超市外袭击当时的国会众议员吉福兹女士，这场枪击案最终造成六人死亡，十二人受伤的惨剧，震惊全美。罗夫纳被捕后曾被送往医院作精神病鉴定和治疗。 在八月初的审讯中，罗夫纳对包括谋杀在内的19项罪名认罪，预计他会在狱中渡过余生，没有假释资格。
a49e777549de7c779cb647f3181a84c18d0da7b5.translatedText: The Tucson shooting murderer pleaded guilty and the judge set a sentencing date Federal District Court Judge Larry Burns released a message on Friday and raised the sentencing date for the Tucson shooting murderer to November 8. Jared Rovner attacked then-Congresswoman Giffords outside a Tucson supermarket in January 2011. The shooting ultimately killed six people and injured 12 others, shocking the United States. After his arrest, Rovner was sent to the hospital for psychiatric evaluation and treatment. During a trial in early August, Rovner pleaded guilty to 19 counts, including murder, and is expected to spend the rest of his life in prison without parole eligibility.

38c4e45e7b6ab0fc0eb38e1ed6c7c696d542366d.sourceText: 2015年亚省华联迎国庆贺中秋第九届”凤凰之夜”于9月12日在C-Fu Gourmet隆重举行。”凤凰之夜”是由亚利桑那州华人华侨联合会（亚省华联UCAA）主办，大凤凰城华人侨团联合总会、亚省现代中文学校、亚省希望中文学校、ASU中国学生学者联谊会、亚省反法西斯暨纪念抗战胜利七十周年筹委会协办，近二十侨社广泛参与的团圆盛会。
38c4e45e7b6ab0fc0eb38e1ed6c7c696d542366d.translatedText: The ninth "Phoenix Night" of the 2015 Alberta Hualian National Celebration Mid-Autumn Festival was held grandly at C-Fu Gourmet on September 12th. "Phoenix Night" is hosted by the Chinese Overseas Chinese Association of Arizona (UCAA), and co-organized by the Chinese Overseas Chinese Association of Greater Phoenix, Alberta Modern Chinese School, Alberta Hope Chinese School, ASU Chinese Students and Scholars Association, and the Alberta Anti-Fascist and Commemoration of the 70th Anniversary of the Victory of the Anti-Japanese War Organizing Committee. Nearly 20 overseas Chinese associations have widely participated in the reunion event.

91199e95c31562e2dd83108f661ef3e84857c423.sourceText: 移民改革似现重大突破 参院八人帮达共识 如何为目前已经在美国居住的1100万非法移民提供合法身份一直是移民综合改革最有争议的部分。如今，被称作”八人帮”的8名国会参议院为起草移民改革法案努力了几个星期后已经私下达成协议，允许非法移民有条件地逐步取得合法身份。分析人士认为，这是移民改革的一个重大突破。 据《洛杉矶时报》报道，了解闭门谈判的幕僚称，新法案要求非法移民先到国土安全部登记，为他们在美国居住时期报税并支付仍待确定数字的罚款。当然，他们必须在执法部门维持无犯罪的干净记录。 得到临时合法身份之后，这些移民可以合法工作，但不能获得食品券、家庭现金救济、医疗补助和失业保险金等联邦福利。 参议院8人小组目前的草案内容与奥巴马总统要为非法移民提供入籍途径的移民改革呼吁相一致。最近，国会共和党议员也试图解决同样的问题，因为在去年11月的大选中共和党候选人对移民问题的强硬立场使自己受到了伤害。 尽管新草案距离真正的立法还有很长的距离，移民权益人士对于可能出现的突破仍然表示谨慎的乐观。美国进步中心移民专家凯利（Angela Kelley）说：”9个月前，如果谁说4名共和党和4名民主党人一起制订要让1100万非法移民合法化的方案，人们都会认为是胡说。现在，这就像魔方一样，更多方面颜色一致。那很有意义。” 现在还没有敲定的是非法移民要等多久才能申请永久居民身份、以及要等多久才能最终成为公民。参议员的幕僚说，得到绿卡也许要等10年以上。 政治上敏感的问题还包括：每年为高技术专家及其他客工发放多少签证，如何跟踪游客何时离开美国，如何为扩大边境巡逻人员、建立边界墙和其它安全措施提供资金。 这8名参议员希望在3月22日复活节休会之前向参议院司法委员会提交完成的法案。但是，幕僚说，其余需要更多技术顾问及开支估计，要到4月初才能拿出。 参议院8人小组包括共和党人南卡罗来纳州的格雷厄姆（Lindsey Graham）、佛罗里达州的卢比奥（Marco Rubio）、亚利桑那州的麦凯恩（John McCain）和弗雷克（Jeff Flake），以及民主党人纽约州的舒默（Charles E. Schumer）、伊利诺伊州的德宾（Richard J. Durbin）、新泽西州的梅嫩德斯（Robert Menendez）和科罗拉多州的班纳特（Michael Bennet）。 新法案长达数百页。麦凯恩接受媒体采访时说：”我们正在努力制订。但是，我不能肯定能否全部完成。……有些问题争议很大。”
91199e95c31562e2dd83108f661ef3e84857c423.translatedText: Immigration reform seems to have achieved a major breakthrough, and the eight-member Senate reached a consensus. How to provide legal status for the 11 million illegal immigrants currently living in the United States has always been the most controversial part of the comprehensive immigration reform. Now, after working for weeks to draft an immigration reform bill, eight members of the Senate, known as the "Gang of Eight," have reached a private agreement to allow illegal immigrants to gradually obtain legal status with conditions. Analysts believe this is a major breakthrough in immigration reform. The Los Angeles Times reported that the new bill would require illegal immigrants to register with the Department of Homeland Security, file taxes for the period they lived in the United States and pay a still-to-be-determined amount of fines, according to people familiar with the closed-door negotiations. Of course, they must maintain a clean record with law enforcement. After receiving temporary legal status, these immigrants can work legally but cannot receive federal benefits such as food stamps, cash assistance for families, Medicaid and unemployment insurance benefits. The eight-member Senate panel's current draft is consistent with President Obama's call for immigration reform to provide a path to citizenship for illegal immigrants. More recently, Republican members of Congress have tried to address the same issue, having been hurt by Republican candidates' hardline stance on immigration in last November's election. Although the new draft is still a long way from actual legislation, immigration advocates remain cautiously optimistic about a possible breakthrough. Angela Kelley, an immigration expert at the Center for American Progress, said: "Nine months ago, if anyone had said that four Republicans and four Democrats would come together to formulate a plan to legalize 11 million illegal immigrants, people would have thought it was nonsense. Now, it's like a Rubik's Cube, with more aspects of the same color. That makes sense." What has not yet been finalized is how long illegal immigrants will have to wait to apply for permanent resident status, and how long they will have to wait to eventually become citizens. The senator's staff said it may take more than 10 years to get a green card. Politically sensitive issues also include: how many visas to issue each year to high-tech experts and other guest workers, how to track when tourists leave the United States, and how to fund expanded Border Patrol personnel, a border wall and other security measures. The eight senators hope to submit the completed bill to the Senate Judiciary Committee before the Easter recess on March 22. But the rest, aides said, requires more technical consultants and spending estimates, which won't be available until early April. The eight-member Senate panel includes Republicans Lindsey Graham of South Carolina, Marco Rubio of Florida, John McCain and Jeff Flake of Arizona, and Democrats Charles E. Schumer of New York, Richard J. Durbin of Illinois, Robert Menendez of New Jersey and Michael Bennet of Colorado. The new bill is hundreds of pages long. McCain said in an interview with the media: "We are working hard to formulate it. However, I am not sure whether it can be completed completely. ... Some issues are very controversial."

8dea6ee21a89f752c2ad50a8500e3f790a71a7d6.sourceText: 普雷斯科现裸体男 偷车被警察击毙 （亚省时报） 雅瓦培郡警方发言人伊夫林德说，上周五在普雷斯科特偷车的裸体男子，被警员枪击后送往医院，至周日不治身亡。警员同时还将他的宠物狗一起射杀。 警方在上周五上午接获猞猁湖附近的露营地报警电话，说一名怀疑嗑药并失控的裸体男子偷走一辆红色吉普车。后来警方在出事地点附近找到这辆吉普时，车已被撞毁。 警员很快找到肇事裸男并对其包围，遭到其反击。警员开枪自卫，首先打死他的狗，在使用电击枪无法将其制服后，开枪击伤裸男。裸男很快被送往雅瓦培区域医疗中心，延至上周日终告不治。 伊夫林德说，肇事的裸体男子名叫卡尔文福尔雷，27岁。出事前几天曾因吸食”浴盐”遭逮捕，警方觉得其态度合作，将他释放。警方没有说本次事件是因吸食”浴盐”有关。
8dea6ee21a89f752c2ad50a8500e3f790a71a7d6.translatedText: > A naked man appears in Presco, steals a car and is shot dead by police (Alberta Times) A naked man who stole a car in Prescott last Friday was shot by a police officer and taken to a hospital, where he died on Sunday, Yavapai County police spokesman Eve Lind said. The police also shot and killed his pet dog. Police received a call from a campground near Lynx Lake last Friday morning, reporting that a naked man suspected of being drugged and out of control had stolen a red Jeep. When police later found the Jeep near the accident site, it had been crashed. The police quickly found the naked man responsible and surrounded him, but he fought back. The police officer fired in self-defense, first killing his dog and then shooting and wounding the naked man after using a stun gun to subdue it. The naked man was rushed to Yavapai Regional Medical Center, where he died on Sunday. Evelind said that the naked man responsible for the accident was named Calvin Forey, 27 years old. A few days before the accident, he was arrested for taking "bath salts". The police found his attitude cooperative and released him. The police did not say that the incident was related to the use of "bath salts."

e2aa7052854929ad8f10dbbc0809527b5120e53b.sourceText: 美国大选:为什么星期二投票 （亚省时报） 美国2012年总统大选11月6号星期二举行。美国人为什么在星期二投票? 不管是四年一次的总统大选，还是两年一次的国会选举，美国的全国性选举总是在11月的第一个星期一之后的星期二进行。 要弄清楚这个问题我们要回到1845年以前的美国社会。当时是农业社会，人们出门坐马车。那时候各州的选举日五花八门，各州之间的投票日相差很长时间。美国国会参议院历史办公室主任里奇博士说，这样就出现了很多问题。 里奇博士说： ”因为当时是农业社会，人们要化很长时间到投票站。投票时间可以长达好几个星期，到19世纪初还是这样。有的人到一个县投完票，然后赶着马车到另一个县去投票，这样就出现了很多选举的舞弊现象。” 1845年，国会通过法律设定全国投票日。这个法律通过后的第一次总统大选是在1848年。 ​​ 但是全国统一选举为什么在11月举行？又为什么要在星期二举行呢? 对当时的农业社会来说，11月秋收刚刚结束，天气还不算太冷，正好有闲暇去投票。选举日定在星期二是因为当时人们必须赶马车到县政府所在地投票。星期天人们都要去教堂， 如果星期一出发，星期二才能到达投票地点。 即便如此，我们可能还有疑问。按照这些考虑，选择11月的第一个星期二不就可以了？为什么是第一个星期一以后的第一个星期二呢？ 这样是为了选举日不会落在11月1号。因为11月1号是万圣节(All Saints Day)，这是一个天主教的重要节日。 不过现在的美国既不是农业社会，我们也有了便利的交通工具，不用赶着马车去投票，可不可以改为周末投票呢?里奇博士说:”其实我们很难找到一个人人都满意的投票日。人们已经习惯了星期二投票了，所以我觉得这种情况还会持续。” 现在美国很多州在几个星期前就可以提前投票，但是星期二投票日这个传统还是有着很重要的意义，竞选到这时候已经进行了很长时间，投票日这一天选举结果会揭晓，就像是一出戏最后要落幕，令人期待。
e2aa7052854929ad8f10dbbc0809527b5120e53b.translatedText: US Election: Why Americans vote on Tuesday (Alberta Times) The 2012 US presidential election will be held on Tuesday, November 6th. Why do Americans vote on Tuesday? Whether it is a presidential election every four years or a congressional election every two years, national elections in the United States are always held on the Tuesday after the first Monday in November. To understand this problem we have to go back to American society before 1845. It was an agricultural society at that time, and people went out by horse-drawn carriage. At that time, there were a variety of election days in each state, and voting days varied greatly between states. Dr. Rich, director of the U.S. Senate History Office, said that many problems have arisen. Dr. Rich said: "Because it was an agricultural society at that time, people had to go to the polling station for a long time. The voting time could last for several weeks, and it was still like this at the beginning of the 19th century. Some people went to one county to vote, and then drove the carriage to another county to vote. This led to a lot of election fraud." In 1845, Congress passed a law to set a national voting day. The first presidential election after this law was passed was in 1848. ​​ But why are the national unified elections held in November? And why was it held on Tuesday? For the agricultural society at that time, the autumn harvest had just ended in November, and the weather was not too cold, so there was just enough time to vote. Election Day was set on Tuesday because people had to drive horse-drawn carriages to the county seat to vote. People have to go to church on Sunday. If they set out on Monday, they can only arrive at the voting location on Tuesday. Even so, we may have questions. Based on these considerations, wouldn’t it be enough to choose the first Tuesday in November? Why is it the first Tuesday after the first Monday? This is so that Election Day does not fall on November 1st. Because November 1st is All Saints Day, which is an important Catholic holiday. However, the United States is not an agricultural society now, and we also have convenient transportation. We don’t have to drive horse-drawn carriages to vote. Can we switch to weekend voting? Dr. Rich said: "In fact, it is difficult for us to find a voting day that everyone is satisfied with. People are used to voting on Tuesday, so I think this situation will continue." Now many states in the United States have allowed early voting a few weeks ago, but the tradition of Tuesday voting day still has a very important significance. The campaign has been going on for a long time by this time. The election results will be announced on voting day, which is like the end of a drama, which is exciting.

6826a248b9326200d70eee2fc73e752ce015e8b9.sourceText: 凤凰城凤鸣： 向为我们创造清潔优雅生活环境的环卫工人致敬 上周因为旅游签证的事去了一趟洛杉矶，洛杉矶的城市环境卫生，可用臓、乱、差三字形容不为过。汽车走过有时还会飄来阵阵异味，可能我们没有到富人区和豪华的建筑区，所以就我所到之处，留下了如此糟糕的印象。我们凤凰城却是树木花草相映，无论春夏秋冬，都是树木茂盛，花开鲜艳，草地绿油油一片片，虽然是号称建在沙模中的城市，称得上是沙模中的绿上洲。这些优雅清潔的生活环境，是辛勤工作的环卫工人，用他们的灵巧双手和辛苦的劳动换来的，到处都留下他们巧夺天工的别具特色的雕塑和辛勤工作的汗水，我们衷心的向这许许多多的环卫工人，献上我们的城挚感谢和祝福！ 我们生活在大凤凰城优雅清潔的环境中，平时并无多大感触，因为习惯成自然，仿佛觉得凤凰城就是这样。如果你稍微注意一下，你就知道它来之不易。当我每天晨练时，一出门經常会发现有许多环卫工人，已經工作了很久。他们已經把花草树木上修剪下来的枯枝烂叶，一堆一堆的放在麻袋片上，等有车来再一包包送上汽车拉走，用鼓风机把草屑吹走，人行道上被吹的干干净净，而他们的身上却落满了灰尘。無論天气多热，气温多高，他们一般都是身穿黄绿色的長袖外衣，头上戴着帶有后蔽灰尘被肩的帽子，三、五一组各司其职的做着自己的工作。有人开着割草机负责割草，有人拿着工具剪切树枝、花卉，使每一棵树、每一株花卉，都修剪的整整齐齐、漂漂亮亮，造形独特，各自向行人展现着它的妩媚多姿，整个凤凰城就像绿树成荫、百花齐放的花園。有几次我还看到在汽车上，配备一台粉碎机，把大的树枝放進去，机器轟隆隆转动，被粉碎机粉碎的树枝成绿色粉沫，从粉碎机中吐出来，这些绿色粉沫可以用来做牛、羊的饲料，这全是無害的绿色饲料。每过一段时间，野草刚刚冒芽，环卫工人们就身背喷雾器，隨走隨喷，让每一棵野草死在萌芽中。 無論是寒冬酷暑，就是这些环境卫士，为凤凰城的优雅清潔的环境，而天天辛勤工作著。他们大部份是墨西哥工人，虽然工作又脏、又苦、又累，但他们都工作著、快乐著。有时会碰見他们工作中间休息，他们会围坐一起，吃着各自准备的午饭，一边吃饭、一边大声欢笑着，自帶的音响放着欢快的音乐，他们是乐在其中。我们应该尊重他们的劳动，自觉保持环境卫生，不隨地吐痰、不乱仍拉圾，让凤凰城永远都像绿树成荫、百花竞放的大花园。
6826a248b9326200d70eee2fc73e752ce015e8b9.translatedText: Phoenix City Fengming: Pay tribute to the sanitation workers who create a clean and elegant living environment for us. Last week I went to Los Angeles for a tourist visa. The urban environmental sanitation of Los Angeles can be described as dirty, chaotic, and poor. Occasionally there would be a smell when the car passed by. Maybe we didn't go to the wealthy areas and luxurious construction areas, so wherever I went, I left such a bad impression. In Phoenix, trees and flowers complement each other. No matter in spring, summer, autumn or winter, the trees are lush, the flowers are blooming, and the grass is green. Although it is said to be a city built in a sand mold, it can be called an oasis in the sand mold. These elegant and clean living environments are the result of hard-working sanitation workers using their dexterous hands and hard work. Their ingenious and unique sculptures and hard work are left everywhere. We sincerely offer our sincere gratitude and blessings to these many sanitation workers! We live in the elegant and clean environment of Greater Phoenix City, and we usually don’t feel much about it, because we become accustomed to it, and it seems that Phoenix City is like this. If you pay a little attention, you will know that it does not come easily. When I do my morning exercises every day, I often find many sanitation workers as soon as I go out. They have been working for a long time. They had put the dead branches and leaves trimmed from the flowers, plants and trees in piles on the sacks. When the car came, they would put the bags in the car and take them away. They used a blower to blow away the grass clippings. The sidewalk was blown clean, but their bodies were covered with dust. No matter how hot the weather is or how high the temperature is, they usually wear yellow-green long-sleeved coats and hats with dust covers on their heads. Groups of three and five perform their own tasks. Some people drive lawn mowers to cut the grass, while others use tools to cut branches and flowers, so that every tree and flower is neatly trimmed, beautiful and unique in shape, each showing its charm to passers-by. The entire Phoenix City is like a garden lined with green trees and blooming flowers. Several times I saw a car equipped with a crusher. Large branches were put in, and the machine rumbled. The branches crushed by the crusher turned into green powder, which was spit out from the crusher. This green powder can be used to make feed for cattle and sheep. It is all harmless green feed. Every once in a while, when weeds have just sprouted, sanitation workers carry sprayers and spray them wherever they go, killing every weed in its buds. No matter it is cold, winter or hot, these environmental guards work hard every day to maintain an elegant and clean environment in Phoenix. Most of them are Mexican workers. Although their work is dirty, hard, and tiring, they are all working and happy. Sometimes I would see them taking a break during work. They would sit around and eat the lunch they had prepared. They would laugh loudly while eating, and their own speakers would play cheerful music. They enjoyed it. We should respect their work, consciously maintain environmental hygiene, and refrain from spitting and littering, so that Phoenix will always be like a big garden lined with green trees and blooming flowers.

ef3743cb8507d6f2d74d17dfc2fca12192d274b0.sourceText: 2016年12月29日上午十一点，中国国民党亚利桑那直属分部党员召开临时委员会议。 党员们忧心忡忡，义愤填膺。 现在是本党最困难的时刻，面对执政的民进党党挟国会人数之优势，假藉转型之名，用”不当党产条例”追杀国民党，企图以此来消灭国民党，将国父孙中山一百馀年前建立的国民党毁于一旦。 党员们检讨了国民党经过先前两次选举的挫败，以及面临党产追杀 、各项党内改革事项、组织精简、人员精实方桉等产生的矛盾，认为国民党面临着非常严厉的挑战，应该在团结中寻求改变。正如洪主席所言：”团结改革真的不是口号，经过这次纷扰，要以最诚恳态度加强 沟通，也非常严格约束干部同仁，多听各方面意见、凝聚共识，对党是有好处。” 中国国民党预计本年五月二十日举行党主席暨第二十届党代表选举，中国国民党亚利桑那直属分部全力支持党的决定。 党员们对洪秀柱主席在代表国民党所发表有关民主、反独、两岸、经济、核能、税改以及未来展望的政见和主张，予以百分百的认同并全力支持！ 为了响应党中央于十月廿二日发起”特别党费”与 ”仟圆捐募”两项活动，一为解决国民党当前财务危机，二为募集长期基金，救亡图存，捍卫中华民国宪政。第一次捐款活动将于会后造册转汇海外部。
ef3743cb8507d6f2d74d17dfc2fca12192d274b0.translatedText: At 11 a.m. on December 29, 2016, members of the Arizona branch of the Chinese Kuomintang held an interim committee meeting. Party members were worried and filled with indignation. Now is the most difficult moment for our party. Facing the ruling Democratic Progressive Party, it is taking advantage of the number of people in Congress and using the "improper party property regulations" to pursue the Kuomintang in the name of transformation in an attempt to eliminate the Kuomintang and destroy the Kuomintang founded by the founding father Sun Yat-sen more than a hundred years ago. Party members reviewed the KMT's setbacks in the previous two elections, as well as the conflicts arising from the pursuit of party assets, various intra-party reform matters, organizational streamlining, and personnel lean programs. They believed that the KMT faced very severe challenges and should seek changes in unity. As Chairman Hong said: "Unity and reform are really not a slogan. After this turmoil, we must strengthen communication in the most sincere manner, and strictly discipline our cadre colleagues. It is good for the party to listen to opinions from all sides and build consensus." The Chinese Kuomintang is expected to hold the party chairman and 20th party representative election on May 20 this year. The Arizona branch of the Chinese Kuomintang fully supports the party's decision. Party members fully recognize and fully support Chairman Hong Xiuzhu’s political opinions and propositions on democracy, anti-independence, cross-strait, economy, nuclear energy, tax reform and future prospects expressed on behalf of the Kuomintang! In response to the two activities of "Special Party Dues" and "Thousand Yuan Donation" launched by the Party Central Committee on October 22, one is to solve the current financial crisis of the Kuomintang, and the other is to raise long-term funds to save the nation and defend the constitutional government of the Republic of China. The first donation will be recorded and transferred to the overseas department after the meeting.
