8a6172122a4c43ea4f9d7b28c18724f9e6baca4e.sourceText: 图桑 慧明 现在一说起男女之间有了感觉，就说来电了，看到那直勾勾的目光非要到对方黑色的蓝色的或绿色的眸子间挖出点什么来的时候，过来人常常掩嘴暗笑：对上眼了。 可是读一读中国的古代文学名著，比方红楼梦，就会发现我们这种表达方式虽然很直率，却也粗俗有加。同样一个男女方相思又不得正果的故事，曹雪芹曹大师一个标题”枉凝眉”就让所有的后人都自叹不如。 ”枉凝眉”不是一个词牌，也不是一个诗歌的固定格式，最初出现在《红楼梦》第五回中。想必是曹雪芹在介绍了荣宁家族和主要人物后，准备全面谱写红楼故事，以宝玉梦为由头，拟想了十二首曲子，《枉凝眉》是其中的一曲。这十二首曲子内容不一，格式各异，与其说是曹大师显示自己的诗歌功底，不如说他用诗歌曲调的形式在透露红楼的大概框架更准确。如果能有心记住这十二首曲子，再随着情节细细品味红楼，就会发现曹大师的功夫真是了得非凡。 还是回到对眼这事吧。《枉凝眉》说出了世间有缘无分爱情的真谛，无怪此曲一出，引无数文人竞折腰，纷纷从自己和身边的情事出发，考证红楼里是哪几个对上了眼，眉来眼去，却没个结果。 对情种而言，和谁都是很容易对上眼的。但对大众读者来说，宝玉和黛玉才真正配的上《枉凝眉》的描述。”一个是阆苑仙葩，一个是美玉无瑕”自不待说了，特别电视陈晓旭扮演的林黛玉形象出现之后，宝黛之恋几乎唤起了，也安慰了世上无数对相思暗恋，却不得正果的情种们。 其实，宝黛第一次相遇就对上了眼。林姑娘初次见宝玉是清高里带一点自卑的，人家是富家子弟，又成天在女孩堆里混着，所以林姑娘脑中的宝玉”不知是怎样个惫懒人呢”！但一见到宝玉，却心生惊讶暗想”好生奇怪，倒像在那里见过的，何等眼熟！”这一个奇怪和眼熟便是林妹妹心动的开始。 宝玉从来是有女孩缘的，他说”这个妹妹我曾见过的””看着面善，心里倒像是远别重逢的一般”是一种讨好女孩子的小伎俩，但看官可曾记得他听到黛玉酸酸地说那块玉时，就发狠地撤下那块玉，砸在地上那节？若不是一见钟情，岂有此等过激之举！ 所以林姑娘和宝玉确实是对上眼了。但世上对上眼的事多去了，要从年轻美貌看到白发苍苍，从惊艳看到顺眼不是每对有缘的男女能做到的，何况还是少男少女的恋情呢。 由恋而生爱情，套句俗话说，要靠男女双方共同添柴才能越烧越旺。宝玉基本上属于那种见一个爱一个的情种。你在红楼中可以看到他对女性世界以外的许多人的讨厌甚至憎恨，但却找不到他对任何女孩不满的片章只语，用现在的话说便是有太多的脂粉气。他的脂粉气的爱情哲学就是让他倾其所能，”空劳牵挂”所有的女孩。当一个不一般身世和装扮的女孩出现的时候，宝玉凝眉倾爱是必然的。 对于一般的女孩来，这娘娘腔的混事魔王至少要比薛蟠那样的真魔王好上一万倍。但对黛玉来说就不满足了。林姑娘毕竟读过一点正书，精神世界特别丰富，丰富到整天要别人附和自己。说得过一点，林黛玉有点自闭症，经常反复重复着一个几个念想，说话围绕着心中的那个主题，却老说不到点上。所以曹雪芹说她虽有奇缘，但”如何心事终虚话”?爱情是私密的东西，你老是在外围感叹流泪，要别人理解自己的身世呀，感情呀。别人说一点话，你就遐想加泪水，”枉自嗟呀”（白白地感叹）。在那个时代，婚姻本无自由，，宝玉当许配给宝钗，你又不争取，当然只好枉凝眉了。 宝玉和黛玉最后一次凝眉是以傻笑收局的（九十六回）。虽然都是笑，但宝玉之笑是真傻笑，他以为不日娶的真是眼前的林妹妹了。而林黛玉之笑强装的，她已经知道宝玉将娶宝钗，她知道将失去理解自己的人，她甚至还会鄙视宝玉也不过是俗人而已，她也许还会预感到自己不久人世，但此时只能用相对傻笑来诠释枉凝眉了！ 所以红楼这场凝眉剧终究只能以”一个是水中月，一个是镜中花。想眼中能有多少泪珠儿，怎禁得秋流到冬，春流到夏!”闭幕。其实，曹雪芹那个”枉”字早早出现在那十二首曲中，说明这位大师就从未想过让这对冤家得个正果！可叹这残酷的神来之笔换来了后世多少怜香惜玉的泪水！ 也多亏有枉凝眉之说。若写成宝黛俩成婚生子，从此粉黛不抹，诗词不填，见天锅碗瓢盆，恐怕红楼梦早成灰烬一堆，哪还有后人的念想呢。
8a6172122a4c43ea4f9d7b28c18724f9e6baca4e.translatedText: Tusang Huiming Nowadays, when people talk about feelings between men and women, they say they have received a call. When they see the direct gaze that insists on digging something out between the black, blue or green eyes of the other person, the person who comes here often hides his mouth and smiles secretly: they have met each other. But if you read ancient Chinese literary classics, such as A Dream of Red Mansions, you will find that although our way of expression is very straightforward, it is also vulgar. It's the same story about a man and a woman who love each other but can't get it right. Master Cao Xueqin and Cao Cao's title "Wonderful Ningmei" made all future generations feel inferior. "Wang Ningmei" is not a word brand, nor is it a fixed format of poetry. It first appeared in the fifth chapter of "A Dream of Red Mansions". Presumably, after Cao Xueqin introduced the Rongning family and the main characters, he was ready to compose the story of the Red Mansions in an all-round way. He used Baoyu's dream as the starting point and imagined twelve songs, of which "Wan Ning Mei" is one of them. These twelve pieces of music have different contents and formats. Rather than Master Cao showing off his poetry skills, it is more accurate to say that he used the form of poetic melody to reveal the general framework of Red Mansions. If you can memorize these twelve pieces of music and then carefully appreciate the plot of The Red Mansion, you will find that Master Cao's kung fu is truly extraordinary. Let’s get back to the matter of looking at each other. "Wan Ning Mei" tells the true meaning of love that is destined but not separated in the world. It is no wonder that as soon as this song came out, it attracted countless literati to start from themselves and the love affairs around them to find out who had fallen in love with each other in the red building. For lovers, it is easy to fall in love with anyone. But for the public readers, Baoyu and Daiyu are truly worthy of the description in "Wang Ning Mei". It goes without saying that "one is the immortal flower of Langyuan, and the other is the flawless jade." Especially after the appearance of Lin Daiyu played by Chen Xiaoxu on TV, the love between Bao and Dai was almost aroused, and it also comforted countless people in the world who had longed for lovesickness but had no success. In fact, Bao Dai fell in love with each other the first time they met. When Miss Lin first met Baoyu, she was aloof and a little inferior. He was from a rich family and hung out with girls all day long. Therefore, in Miss Lin's mind, Baoyu was "somewhat kind of lazy person"! But when she saw Baoyu, she was surprised and thought to herself, "It's so strange, it looks like something I've seen there before. It looks so familiar!" This strangeness and familiarity was the beginning of Sister Lin's heartbeat. Baoyu has always been attracted to girls. He said, "I have seen this sister before." "Looking kind-hearted, but feeling like we are reunited after a long separation." This is a little trick to please girls. But did the judge remember that when he heard Daiyu say sourly about the piece of jade, he violently removed the piece of jade and smashed it on the ground? If it wasn't love at first sight, how could there be such an extreme move! So Miss Lin and Baoyu really have their eyes on each other. But there are so many things that meet the eye in the world. From young and beautiful to gray-haired, from stunning to pleasing to the eye, not every couple who are destined to meet can do it, let alone the love between a boy and a girl. Love is born from love. As the saying goes, it depends on both men and women to add firewood together to make it more and more prosperous. Baoyu basically belongs to the kind of person who falls in love with someone when they meet him. You can see in The Red Mansion that he dislikes and even hates many people outside the female world, but you can't find a single word about his dissatisfaction with any girl. In today's terms, there is too much makeup. His rosy love philosophy is to let him devote all his energy to all the girls "in vain". When a girl with unusual life experience and appearance appears, it is inevitable that Baoyu will fall in love with her. For ordinary girls, this sissy devil is at least ten thousand times better than a real devil like Xue Pan. But Daiyu was not satisfied. After all, Miss Lin has read some serious books and has a very rich spiritual world. She is so rich that she wants others to agree with her all day long. To be fair, Lin Daiyu is a bit autistic. She often repeats a few thoughts over and over again, and her words revolve around the theme in her heart, but she always misses the point. So Cao Xueqin said that although she had a romantic relationship, "how can you end up with lies"? Love is a private thing. You always sigh and shed tears from the outside, asking others to understand your life experience and feelings. When others say something, you will reverie and cry, "It's all in vain" (sigh in vain). In that era, there was no freedom in marriage. Baoyu was supposed to be betrothed to Baochai, and if you didn't fight for it, of course you would have no choice but to frown in vain. The last time Baoyu and Daiyu frowned ended with a silly smile (96 chapters). Although they were all smiles, Baoyu's smile was a real giggle. He thought that the person he would marry soon was really the sister Lin in front of him. Lin Daiyu pretended to smile because she already knew that Baoyu would marry Baochai, she knew that she would lose someone who understood her, and she even despised Baoyu for being just a commoner. She might also have a premonition that she would not die soon, but at this time she could only use a relatively silly smile to explain her in vain! Therefore, the eyebrow-raising drama in Red Mansion can only end with "One is the moon in the water, and the other is the flower in the mirror. How many tears can there be in the eyes, how can they prevent autumn from flowing to winter, and spring to summer!" In fact, Cao Xueqin's word "in vain" appeared early in those twelve songs, which shows that the master never thought of letting these enemies achieve justice! It's a pity that this cruel stroke of genius has brought many tears of pity and pity in future generations! Thanks to the theory of Ningmei in vain. If it were written that Bao and Dai got married and had children, and from then on the pink and white would not be wiped off, the poems would not be filled in, and the pots and pans would be seen in the sky, I am afraid that the Dream of Red Mansions would have been turned into a pile of ashes, and there would be no thoughts for future generations.

498fef19b27dc1f43256942ae315608c46c7c0c8.sourceText: 凤凰城气如虹：宝岛顺道游之五：胜景遍高雄 在屏东县林边乡水利村渡过一宵，我夫妇早晨起来出外漫步，呼吸新鲜空气，头脑格外清醒。 一位在附近起早干活的大娘，见我们面孔陌生，四处张望，询问是否要寻找哪家人，我笑笑摆手，并指指玉萍的房屋，说是远地来探访她的叔婶，大娘 绽开笑脸，表示欢迎。 看来，屏东的民风淳朴，充满人情味。 今日星期二，是正常工作日，大人要工作，孩子要读书。 玉萍为了陪伴我夫妇，特地申请休假两天，安排了儿女上学，就载太座去外面购买早餐回来吃，然后开始今天的节目。 依照玉萍小叔蔡君的计划，他清晨打点饲养鱼虾妥当后，就有空闲时间驾车载我夫妇去高雄游览，玉萍当然伴随，蔡的越南新娘也借此大好机会同行，因为我们 都可使用越语交谈。 由屏东去高雄，就像昨日来时的路程一样，要经过大鹏湾景观桥，蔡君昨日说过今天会让我们在大鹏湾风景区游览，今日却改变主意，认为高雄各景观较佳， 值得参观，只在这里稍事逗留，略为欣赏，往沙滩漫步，眺望海阔天空。 其实这个风景区有其特色，范围也广阔，独特的泻湖天然景色，沿湖边规划的高尔夫球场，红树林生态公园，人工沙滩，舰艇音乐博物馆，室内海洋育乐馆，旅游休憩中心等等， 若详细浏览也花时间。 蔡君可算是司机兼导游，我们当然听从他的意见，很快就离开屏东大鹏湾风景区，汽车驶向高雄，远远那边，看见那座八十五层大楼，东帝士国际广场 ，建筑形状酷似「高」字，可当作高雄的地标，在台北还没有一○一的时候，这是台湾最高的摩天大楼。 二○○六年，何少卿表妹曾带领我登上此楼观景，曾在爱河沿岸巡礼，深宵逛六合夜市厖胜景遍高雄，留给我良好印象。 这回重临，蔡君说时间短促，把握机会参观几个著名景点就好，不宜登高楼；确实有道理，何况此楼我已到过，而纽约帝国大厦、吉隆坡双子塔、台北一○ 一，都有我的足迹，现在不必再花时间登楼俯瞰城市面貌了。 于是，蔡君带我们去高雄的几处名胜古迹游览，欣赏美丽景观，中午去吃自助餐，是选择玉萍最喜欢的那一家。 堂姪女介绍说，这餐馆菜肴丰富，款式多样，价钱不贵，要让三叔三婶大快朵颐，领略高雄的美食。 言谈中，蔡君老是嫌我逗留屏东的日子太短，不能参加他于周末补办的婚宴，诚属遗憾；就是去观光游览，胜景遍高雄，也无法仔细欣赏，来去匆匆，未免可惜 。 我惟有说声抱歉，实在不想再麻烦向航空公司更改回越日期。 这一天在高雄，蔡君前后选择游览几个景点，首先是海洋公园，在阳光的照耀下，看见海洋旁边的草地，散布各类海中生物造型，全是用破烂陶瓷碎片堆砌，有鱼虾蟹 螺等等形状，颇具艺术性，能吸引游客，为摄影的好背景。 另一处是参观「领事馆官邸概念馆」，在一个山岗上，蔡君说过去原是英国领事居住旧址，风景优美，成为观光热门景点。 还有旗后炮台，位置也在较高的斜坡，满清时代所建造，采取西方炮台设计，配合中国式门墙，形成中西风格的堡垒特色。 当时中英鸦片战争，清廷为了加强防卫，督造「威震天南」的旗后炮台，与「雄镇北门」的港口炮台分据两方，以中低炮火射程威力，扼守打狗港 。 最后一个游览地点是左营莲花潭风景区，左营，就是前几天冯顺好建议我坐火车在这站下车，等待堂姪女来迎接回屏东，如果当时听从了，这样的话，昨日 下午能够最先游览这景点了。 莲池潭在高雄左营区，南靠龟山，北邻半屏山，湖面广阔，过去是乡民赖以灌溉农田的主要水源，如今成为知名的旅游胜地，沿湖四周都是寺庙与古迹，新旧 建筑相结合，形成一片观光胜地，吸引众多游客。 我太座最喜欢欣赏美景，拿著录影机不停地拍摄和录取镜头，莲潭池风景区的确耀眼，各庙宇的独特艺术建筑，如北极亭的玄天上帝，手持七星宝剑的威严，龙虎 塔的巨龙猛虎 等等厖配衬着周遭的绿地设施，让游客乐而忘返。 高雄多美景，但我的时间有限，只能略为参观一二，就要返回屏东。 依照原定计划，明日转往嘉义，后日返中坜，然后告别台湾。
498fef19b27dc1f43256942ae315608c46c7c0c8.translatedText: Phoenix City is like a rainbow: Treasure Island side trip No. 5: Kaohsiung’s scenic spots. After spending the night in the Shui Conservancy Village of Linbian Township, Pingtung County, my husband and I got up in the morning and went for a walk to breathe in the fresh air and feel extra clear-headed. An aunt who got up early to work nearby saw us with unfamiliar faces, looked around and asked if she was looking for any family. I smiled and waved, pointing to Yuping's house, saying that she was visiting her uncle and aunt from afar. The aunt smiled and expressed welcome. It seems that the folk customs in Pingtung are simple and full of human touch. Today is Tuesday, a normal working day. Adults have to work and children have to study. In order to accompany me and my wife, Yuping specially applied for two days of leave, arranged for her children to go to school, and then took her mother out to buy breakfast and come back to eat, and then started today's program. According to the plan of Yuping's uncle Cai Jun, after he had prepared and raised fish and shrimps in the early morning, he had free time to drive me and my wife to Kaohsiung for a sightseeing. Of course Yuping accompanied us, and Cai's Vietnamese bride also took this opportunity to accompany us, because we could all converse in Vietnamese. Going from Pingtung to Kaohsiung is just like the journey we took yesterday, passing through the Dapeng Bay Scenic Bridge. Cai Jun said yesterday that we would visit the Dapeng Bay Scenic Area today, but today he changed his mind and thought that the scenery in Kaohsiung is better and worth visiting. He only stayed here for a while to enjoy it, strolled on the beach, and looked at the vast sea and sky. In fact, this scenic spot has its own characteristics and is vast in scope, including the unique natural scenery of the lagoon, golf courses planned along the lake, mangrove ecological park, artificial beach, ship music museum, indoor marine amusement center, tourism and leisure center, etc. It will take time to browse in detail. Cai Junke is the driver and tour guide. Of course we listened to his advice and soon left Pingtung Dapeng Bay Scenic Area. The car drove towards Kaohsiung. In the distance, we saw the 85-story building, the East Texas International Plaza. The shape of the building resembles the word "high" and can be regarded as the landmark of Kaohsiung. When there was no 101 in Taipei, this was the tallest skyscraper in Taiwan. In 2006, my cousin He Shaoqing took me up to this building to view the scenery. She once went on a pilgrimage along the Love River and visited the Liuhe Night Market late at night. Kaohsiung's panoramic view left a good impression on me. This time, Cai Jun said that time was short and it was best to seize the opportunity to visit a few famous attractions instead of climbing high-rise buildings. It made sense, not to mention that I had already been to this building, and I had visited the Empire State Building in New York, the Petronas Twin Towers in Kuala Lumpur, and Taipei 101. Now there was no need to spend time climbing up the stairs to overlook the city. So, Cai Jun took us to visit several places of interest in Kaohsiung to enjoy the beautiful scenery. We went to a buffet at noon and chose Yuping’s favorite restaurant. My cousin said that this restaurant has rich dishes, various styles, and is not expensive. It will make my uncle and aunt enjoy their meal and appreciate Kaohsiung’s delicious food. During the conversation, Cai Jun always thought that my stay in Pingtung was too short and I couldn't attend the wedding banquet he hosted on the weekend. It was a pity. Even if I went sightseeing in Kaohsiung, I couldn't appreciate the scenic spots in Kaohsiung. It was a pity that I came and went in a hurry. I can only say sorry, but I really don’t want to go through the trouble of asking the airline to change my return date to Vietnam. On this day in Kaohsiung, Cai Jun chose to visit several scenic spots. The first was the Ocean Park. Under the sunshine, he saw the grass next to the ocean, scattered with various shapes of sea creatures. They were all made of broken ceramic fragments, with shapes such as fish, shrimps, crabs, snails, etc. They were quite artistic, attracted tourists, and provided a good background for photography. Another place is to visit the "Consulate Official Residence Concept Pavilion". It is located on a hill. Cai Jun said that it used to be the former residence of the British consul. It has beautiful scenery and has become a popular tourist attraction. There is also the flag-back fort, which is also located on a higher slope. It was built during the Manchu and Qing Dynasties. It adopts a Western fort design and is matched with Chinese-style gates and walls to form a Chinese-Western style fortress. During the Sino-British Opium War, in order to strengthen defense, the Qing government supervised the construction of the "Megatron Tiannan" flag rear fort and the "Xiongzhen North Gate" port fort on both sides. They used medium and low artillery fire ranges to guard Dagou Port. The last place to visit is Zuoying Lotus Pond Scenic Area, Zuoying. A few days ago, Feng Shunhao suggested that I take the train and get off at this station and wait for my cousin’s daughter to welcome me back to Pingtung. If I had listened, I would have been able to visit this scenic spot first yesterday afternoon. Lotus Pond is located in Zuoying District, Kaohsiung, with Guishan Mountain to the south and Banping Mountain to the north. The lake is vast and it used to be the main water source that villagers relied on to irrigate farmland. Now it has become a well-known tourist attraction. The lake is surrounded by temples and monuments, and the combination of old and new buildings forms a tourist attraction that attracts many tourists. My favorite thing is to enjoy the beautiful scenery. I hold a video camera and keep filming and recording footage. The Lotus Pond Scenic Area is indeed dazzling. The unique artistic architecture of each temple, such as the Xuantian God in the North Pole Pavilion, the majesty holding a seven-star sword, the dragon and tiger in the Dragon and Tiger Tower, etc. complement the surrounding green space facilities, making tourists forget to leave. Kaohsiung has many beautiful scenery, but my time is limited, so I can only visit briefly before returning to Pingtung. According to the original plan, we will transfer to Chiayi tomorrow, return to Zhongli the day after, and then say goodbye to Taiwan.

778d0e54eb296c7e2198b69aa6f3d7d8012d1916.translatedText: Fengming: Birthday blessings, a grateful and happy birthday banquet December 8, 2012 is a good day in the sun. Today I am going to attend Aunt Xu’s 80th birthday party...

5bd062e91d4a54b612dd46a99a91cca76ba091cf.sourceText: 2012年12月8日這天，阳光明睸是一个好日子，今天要参加徐伯母八十大寿的庆生宴会。每年的12月份的某一天，徐伯母的女兒徐凯莱，女婿查理，都要为徐伯母举行生日庆生宴，今年也不列外、并具有特殊的意义—-八十大寿庆生宴。早在半月前，我们就接到凯莱的盛情邀请，为感谢教会和周围的朋友，多年来对徐伯母和她們全家的邦助和支持，要在”兰天”举行感恩的答谢宴会。为了健康的原因，原本我们夫妇晚饭是不吃饭店、更不吃Buffet(自助餐) ，但是凯莱的盛情邀请是一个例外。我们高兴的接受邀请，答应一定准时参加。
5bd062e91d4a54b612dd46a99a91cca76ba091cf.translatedText: December 8, 2012 is a good day in the sun. Today I am going to attend the birthday party of Aunt Xu’s 80th birthday. Every year on a certain day in December, Aunt Xu's daughter Xu Kailai and son-in-law Charlie hold a birthday party for Aunt Xu. This year is no exception and has special significance - the 80th birthday party. As early as half a month ago, we received a warm invitation from Gloria to hold a gratitude banquet in "Lantian" to thank the church and surrounding friends for their help and support to Aunt Xu and their family over the years. For health reasons, we, as a couple, originally did not eat in restaurants or buffets for dinner, but Gloria's warm invitation was an exception. We happily accepted the invitation and promised to attend on time.

0d4287b9b598bdfefdc2d900eecd285885b36814.sourceText: 这天中午在教会听完牧师讲道后，马上驱车前往教会对面的”藍天中国餐馆”(CHINA KING RESTAURANT）。進入饭店看到”藍天”餐馆，看到是裝修后换然一新，已坐满了顾客。凯莱夫妇和徐伯母已在包间等侯，很快大家都陸陸续续到达，互致问候后逐一落座。参加的来宾还真不少，有熟悉的朋友，还有些不熟悉的朋友，足足坐满三大桌。一開始，凯莱代表全家向各位来宾献上感恩，感谢各位長輩及朋友、同仁，多年来对她母亲的关心和照顾，对她工作上的支持和对她們的家庭的邦助，今天正好是徐伯母的八十岁寿辰，所以今天的聚会是感恩的生日聚会，希望各位長輩和同仁朋友，都健康快乐！寿星徐伯母也发表感言：感谢朋友們多年来对我的关愛和邦助，也感谢查理对我的关心和愛护，自从先生回了天家以后，怕我一人孤单，就接我在他家居住，就像儿子一样照顾我的一切生活起居，感谢神赐我这样好的女儿和女婿。
0d4287b9b598bdfefdc2d900eecd285885b36814.translatedText: After listening to the pastor's sermon at the church at noon that day, I immediately drove to the "CHINA KING RESTAURANT" opposite the church. When I entered the hotel, I saw the "Blue Sky" restaurant. It had been renovated and it was already full of customers. Mr. and Mrs. Gloria and Aunt Xu were already waiting in the private room. Soon everyone arrived one after another, exchanged greetings and sat down one by one. There were quite a few guests attending, including familiar friends and some unfamiliar friends, filling three tables. At the beginning, on behalf of the whole family, Kai Lai expressed his gratitude to all the guests, thanking all the elders, friends and colleagues for their concern and care for her mother over the years, their support in her work and their help to their family. Today happens to be Aunt Xu’s 80th birthday, so today’s party is a birthday party with thanksgiving. I hope all the elders and colleagues are healthy and happy! Aunt Xu, the birthday girl, also gave a speech: I would like to thank my friends for their care and help over the years, and also thank Charlie for his care and love for me. Since my husband returned to his home in heaven, he was afraid that I would be alone, so he took me to live in his home and took care of all my daily life like a son. I thank God for giving me such a good daughter and son-in-law.

e484a6313da860c00b848f5e14416675e55c12d3.sourceText: 开宴前由王伯伯做谢饭禱告！今天的晚宴非常丰盛，先上一道蟹肉鱼肚羹，后续上一道道精美菜肴，鸡、鴨、魚、虾，蟹一應俱全，晚宴上大家吃得香甜美，谈得也开心，不吃饭店的我們，被吃到个个肚儿园。今天有幸我們和寿星徐伯母一桌，特别订制的庆生大蛋糕就摆上了我們的餐桌上。啊！好大好精美漂亮的蛋糕，服务员邦忙插上向征八十大寿的腊烛八只蜡烛，点燃腊独后，请徐伯母许个美好的愿望，我在心中默默许愿：祝愿徐伯母年年岁岁平安快乐！服务员为大家切好蛋糕，征求各位意見：要水果的、还是芋头的！想不到，一个蛋糕可以做出两种口味，虽然已经吃到十二分饱，挡不住那香甜蛋糕的诱惑，那真是吃到三天不吃饭也不觉得饿的程度。茶足饭饱后全体来宾合影留念！时间己经不早了，大家起 身依依不舍话别，互道珍重，互相祝福，祝福明年会更美好！
e484a6313da860c00b848f5e14416675e55c12d3.translatedText: Before the banquet, Uncle Wang will say a prayer of thanks for the meal! Today's dinner was very sumptuous, starting with a dish of crabmeat and fish maw soup, followed by exquisite dishes, including chicken, duck, fish, shrimp, and crab. Everyone ate deliciously and talked happily at the dinner. Those of us who didn't go to the restaurant were all eaten to our stomachs. Today we are lucky enough to sit at the same table as the birthday girl, Aunt Xu, and a specially ordered birthday cake was placed on our table. ah! It was such a big, exquisite and beautiful cake. The waiter Bang hurriedly inserted eight candles for Zheng Zheng’s 80th birthday. After lighting the cake, he asked Aunt Xu to make a good wish. I made a wish silently in my heart: I wish Aunt Xu peace and happiness every year! The waiter cut the cake for everyone and asked for your opinions: should you like fruit or taro? Unexpectedly, one cake can have two flavors. Even though I was very full, I couldn't resist the temptation of the sweet cake. It was so good that I didn't feel hungry even if I didn't eat for three days. After having enough tea and dinner, all the guests took a group photo! It was already getting late, so everyone stood up and said goodbye reluctantly, cherishing each other, blessing each other, and wishing that next year would be better!

1d5a01a48753329e217042865bde913d5972d577.sourceText: 在回家的途中，和先生谈起今天的感恩生日祝福晚宴，心生无限感慨！凯莱夫妇对母亲的孝敬和愛心，的确感人肺腑，值得我們學习和效法。徐凯莱姊妹是徐伯母的唯一女儿，在徐伯伯病重期间，陪母亲一起，一直无微不至的照顾病中的徐伯伯。徐伯伯 安 息主 怀 之 后，她又挑起了照顾和陪伴母亲的重担。把母亲接到自己家中一同居住，使母亲不会感到孤独和寂寞，有女儿、女婿、两个小外孙女陪伴，徐伯母的晚年生活，充满了幸福和喜乐。
1d5a01a48753329e217042865bde913d5972d577.translatedText: On the way home, I talked to my husband about today’s Thanksgiving birthday blessing dinner, and I was filled with emotion! The filial piety and love shown by Mr. and Mrs. Kelley to their mother are truly touching and worthy of our study and imitation. Sister Xu Kailai is Aunt Xu's only daughter. When Uncle Xu was seriously ill, she accompanied her mother and took care of Uncle Xu in every possible way. After Uncle Xu passed away, she took up the heavy responsibility of taking care of and accompanying her mother. Taking her mother into her own home to live together so that her mother would not feel isolated and lonely. With her daughter, son-in-law, and two little granddaughters by her side, Aunt Xu's later life was full of happiness and joy.

6b7c5cc4d7b9b28ae6ca89424f4c83e30307ea77.sourceText: 现在的社会，有多少儿女能做到像凯莱夫妇一样，孝敬父母,处处为父母着想，把孝敬父母做为自己不可堆卸的责任，始终不 离不弃。圣经在”出埃及记”22:12(十诫中的第五诫)中教导我們：”当孝敬父母，使你的日子，在耶和华你 神所赐你的地上，得以长久。”阿们！愿普天下的儿女都能像凯莱夫妇 一样，孝敬父母，也祝福徐母在女儿女婿 的孝敬与疼爱中，安度晚年，在天父的慈爱和恩典中幸福著、快乐著！愿天下的父母都在慈爱的天父的大爱和怜悯中，幸福著、快乐著！ 阿们！
6b7c5cc4d7b9b28ae6ca89424f4c83e30307ea77.translatedText: In today's society, how many children can be like the Glorias, who honor their parents, think about their parents at all times, regard honoring their parents as their indispensable responsibility, and never give up. The Bible teaches us in Exodus 22:12 (the fifth of the Ten Commandments): "Honor your father and your mother, so that your days may be long in the land the Lord your God is giving you." Amen! May all children in the world honor their parents like Mr. and Mrs. Gloria, and may Xu’s mother spend her remaining years peacefully in the filial piety and love of her daughter and son-in-law, and be happy and joyful in the love and grace of Heavenly Father! May all parents in the world be happy and happy in the great love and mercy of our loving Heavenly Father! Amen!

be28b1125653c7acbfdecfe65c57de82e01ba986.translatedText: Cui Zengqi: Look at China and Look at the United States (V)————Justice and Reason There is an ideal fair world...

7e2b425fb78f4ea9d989408ed959c08234512989.sourceText: 有一个理想的公平世界也是人类追求的普世价值。中国人常说：”凡事要讲个理”、”有理走遍天下”。但是在阶级社会存在的今天，很难做到这一点。人们只期望在不公平事件发生的时候，能有地方讲理，有人能主持公道。京剧中的”竇娥冤”、”苏三起解”和电影”秋菊打官司”都是讲普通百姓蒙冤求公道的故事。在歷史上，有一句话”衙门朝南开，有理无钱莫进来”。老百姓要告状，要先经滚钉板才能见县太爷，可见寻求公道之难。现在的中国，各政府部门都设有上访办公室，以听取群眾反映，但大家都知道，他们的权力有限，最多起个安抚作用，形同摆设。法律体系还狠不完善，人们经常遇到有理没处讲，有苦没处诉的境地。这种感受我想每个从中国来的老百姓都有亲身感受。 美国的社会，我相信也存在著许多不公道的地方，但是我接触了几件事使我感到还真有点说理的地方，写出来和大家分享。 我来美国不久，為实现美国梦的一部分?—想拥有一部属于自己的汽车。一天，我看到一份报纸报导週六在车行有Early Bird Sale。我就大清早赶去，买了一部TOYTO二手车，当时我对车一窍不通，只是看外表漂亮就行。买回来第二天，就在马路上拋锚了，一些学雷锋的老美帮我打通了卖车的车行，把车拉回去修理，10天内修了两次，共一千四百多元。车行告诉我这个费用要我出，因為在我买车的发票上写明了”AS IS”这意味著车一旦买走，他就不管了。我也说不过他，只有不情愿地付了钱，把车开了回来，但心裡老觉得不是滋味。几天后，和朋友谈起此事，有人告诉我，卖车行上面有一个协会，可以向他们反映一下。我抱着试试看的心理把事情的经过告诉他们，不料不到一个月就收到了答复。他们的决定是这些修理费用应由车行负责，并把这一决定同时通知我和卖车行，一周后，我就收到了1400美金的退款支票。我心裡对美国社会自然地產生了一份好感。 还有一次，我因发高烧去看了急诊，正好那个月我参加了人口普查工作，有一千多元的收入。AHCCCS 办公室通知我，由於我有了收入，这次急诊费用四千多元应由我自己负担。怎麼办？朋友告诉我，政府有免费為老百姓服务的律师，可以去找找看。于是我真的找到了法律諮询部门，他们耐心地听了我的申诉，為我起草了一份文件，告诉我去州政府的一个公平委员会。果然，州政府接受了我的申诉，并约定时间要AHCCCS的工作人员去听证。这裡虽不是法庭，但也是我坐在一边，AHCCCS坐在一边，仲裁人坐在前面。他说AHCCCS是按我的月收入乘12得出我的年收入為20000元，所以要我付急诊费用，计算没有错；但我是一次性收入不到2000元，要我交4000多元医疗费也不合理，结论是要把全部的花费都带上和AHCCCS的工作人员重新计算一下。最后还是全部免除了我的费用。 有了这些经验，我对美国社会的公平感有了信心。之后，我学会了上法院讲理，用法律保护自己。有一次，我的汽车没有通过尾气检测，我送到一个墨西哥人开的修车店，他只简单清理一下，就要我付175美金，说保证通过检测。既然如此，我就付了钱。但二次送去尾气检测依然超标，我感觉是受了欺骗。我要他退钱，他坚持不退。于是我交了38美元的诉讼费上告到法院，经法庭开庭判决我胜诉。但也指出，在没有讲定修理价格之前就开始修理，双方都有一定责任。他退还了大部分款项。不论怎样，有了讲理的地方，心裡痛快。当然，法院是讲理的地方，道理不足就要败诉。我有一次去移民局办事，把车停在有自动计费桿的马路旁，因等候时间长，而且车停错了方向，出来时车上贴了一张罚单，我想申请免罚单又一次走上了法庭。上法庭之前我的美国朋友还专门教我要求FORGIVE ME 这个词。法官让警察说明情况后，毫不犹豫地对我笑着说，原本你犯了两个错，应罚你32元，现在警察只罚了你16元，快去交了吧！不料这次上法庭还上了记录，在我通过了全部公民考试后，移民官通知我，我还需要背景调查，原来因為我有了法庭记录，幸亏不是犯罪。 每个人都期望有一个公道的社会环境，我觉得美国这地方比起没法讲理的地方，生活起来心情舒畅得多。
7e2b425fb78f4ea9d989408ed959c08234512989.translatedText: Having an ideal fair world is also a universal value pursued by mankind. Chinese people often say: "Everything must be reasonable" and "reasonable can be found all over the world". But in today's class society, it is difficult to do this. People only hope that when unfair events occur, there will be a place to reason and someone to uphold justice. The Peking operas "Dou E's Injustice" and "Su San Qi Jie" and the movie "Qiu Ju's Lawsuit" all tell stories about ordinary people who have been wronged and seek justice. In history, there is a saying: "The Yamen opens to the south, so don't come in if you have reason or no money." When ordinary people wanted to file a complaint, they had to go through a nail-rolling board before they could see the county magistrate, which shows how difficult it is to seek justice. In today's China, various government departments have petition offices to listen to people's feedback, but everyone knows that their power is limited and they can only play a pacifying role and are nothing more than decorations. The legal system is still far from perfect, and people often find themselves in situations where they have no way to speak out and have no way to complain. I think every ordinary person from China has experienced this feeling personally. I believe that there are many unfair places in American society, but I have come across a few things that make me feel that they are somewhat reasonable, so I will write them down to share with you. I came to the United States not long ago. As part of realizing the American dream, I wanted to own a car of my own. One day, I saw a newspaper report that there was an Early Bird Sale at the car dealership on Saturday. I rushed there early in the morning and bought a second-hand TOYTO car. I didn’t know anything about cars at the time, and I just wanted to buy a second-hand TOYTO car because of its beautiful appearance. The day after I bought it, it broke down on the road. Some old Americans who imitated Lei Feng helped me get through to the dealership that sold the car, and took the car back for repairs. It was repaired twice within 10 days, for a total of more than 1,400 yuan. The car dealer told me that I have to pay this fee because the invoice for buying the car stated "AS IS", which means that once the car is purchased, he will not care about it. I couldn't persuade him, so I reluctantly paid the money and drove the car back, but I always felt uncomfortable in my heart. A few days later, I talked about this matter with a friend, and someone told me that there was an association above the car dealership and I could report it to them. With the mentality of giving it a try, I told them what happened, but unexpectedly, I received a reply within a month. They decided that the repair costs should be borne by the car dealer, and notified me and the car dealer of this decision. A week later, I received a refund check for US$1,400. I naturally developed a good impression of American society. Another time, I went to the emergency room because of a high fever. That month I participated in the census and earned more than a thousand yuan. The AHCCCS office informed me that since I have income, the emergency room bill of more than 4,000 yuan should be borne by me. what to do? A friend told me that the government has lawyers who serve the people free of charge, so you can look for them. So I actually found the legal advisory department, and they patiently listened to my complaint, drafted a document for me, and told me to go to an equity committee in the state government. Sure enough, the state government accepted my appeal and set a time for AHCCCS staff to attend a hearing. Although this is not a court, I am sitting on one side, AHCCCS is sitting on the other side, and the arbitrator is sitting in front. He said that AHCCCS calculated my annual income as 20,000 yuan based on my monthly income multiplied by 12, so I was asked to pay for emergency treatment. The calculation was correct. However, my one-time income was less than 2,000 yuan, so it was unreasonable to ask me to pay more than 4,000 yuan in medical expenses. The conclusion was that I should bring all the expenses with the AHCCCS staff to recalculate. In the end, all my fees were waived. With these experiences, I gained confidence in the fairness of American society. After that, I learned to go to court to reason and use the law to protect myself. One time, my car failed an emissions test, so I sent it to a Mexican-owned car repair shop. He simply cleaned it and asked me to pay $175, saying it was guaranteed to pass the test. In that case, I paid. But the second time I sent it for exhaust gas testing, it still exceeded the standard. I felt that I had been deceived. I asked him to refund the money, but he refused. So I paid a legal fee of US$38 and went to court, and the court ruled that I won the case. But it also pointed out that both parties have certain responsibilities if repairs are started before the repair price is agreed upon. He returned most of the money. No matter what, I feel happy when I have a place to be reasonable. Of course, the court is a place of reasoning, and if there is insufficient reason, the case will be lost. I once went to the Immigration Bureau for business and parked my car next to a road with an automatic toll bar. Because the waiting time was long and the car was parked in the wrong direction, a ticket was posted on my car when I came out. I wanted to apply for exemption from the ticket and went to court again. Before going to court, my American friend specifically taught me to ask for the word FORGIVE ME. After the judge asked the police to explain the situation, he smiled at me without hesitation and said, "Originally, you made two mistakes and you should be fined 32 yuan. Now the police only fined you 16 yuan. Go and pay it!" Unexpectedly, this time I went to court and it was recorded. After I passed all the citizenship tests, the immigration officer informed me that I still needed a background check. It turned out that because I had a court record, fortunately it was not a crime. Everyone hopes for a fair social environment. I think living in the United States is much more comfortable than in a place where people are unreasonable.

ce7a0b499992b92f709e5501e7f25c60e2b3feb0.sourceText: 二十年前来亚利桑那州立大学英文系进修、学习英语教学的中国两岸三地访问学者、留学生，一定知道毕生致力英语作为第二语言教学(Teaching English as a Second Language, TESL)的教授奈伊博士(Dr. James W. Ney)。不幸的是奈伊教授已于今年5月30日在斯科茨代尔安然逝世，享年84岁。 奈伊教授1932年7月28日出生于非洲肯尼亚，他在那裡生活到7岁。后来他们家移居加拿大纳奈莫，他在户外成长，擅长驾游艇、打鱼、爬山，这样的爱好伴随他终身。 他于1954年结婚，不久移居美国。他先就读惠顿学院(Wheaton College)，获神学硕士。后来在密西根大学(University of Michigan)读书，获英语语言文学教育博士。他长期从事TESL教学，经验丰富，学术研究硕果累累。 奈伊博士以荣誉教授身份，从亚利桑那州立大学英文系退休。他是国际上英语作为第二语言教学的权威专家，曾经到过好多国家讲学。 奈伊教授热爱生活，幽默风趣，家庭幸福美满。
ce7a0b499992b92f709e5501e7f25c60e2b3feb0.translatedText: The visiting scholars and international students from China and Taiwan who came to the English Department of Arizona State University twenty years ago to further their studies and learn English teaching must know that they have devoted their lives to teaching English as a second language (Teaching English as a Second Language) Dr. James W. Ney, professor of Second Language, TESL. Unfortunately, Professor Nye passed away peacefully in Scottsdale on May 30 this year at the age of 84. Professor Nye was born in Kenya, Africa on July 28, 1932, where he lived until he was 7 years old. Later, his family moved to Nanaimo, Canada. He grew up outdoors and was good at yachting, fishing, and mountain climbing. Such hobbies stayed with him throughout his life. He married in 1954 and soon moved to the United States. He first attended Wheaton College and received a master's degree in theology. Later, he studied at the University of Michigan and received a doctorate in English language and literature education. He has been engaged in TESL teaching for a long time and has rich experience and fruitful academic research results. Dr. Nye retired from the Department of English at Arizona State University as Professor Emeritus. He is an authoritative expert on English as a second language teaching in the world and has given lectures in many countries. Professor Nye loves life, is humorous, and has a happy family.

4711262771f3360aadac3bf5d779f874bb5b1c8c.sourceText: 亚利桑那州今年”双十”晚会确定于10月6日于豪华大气的 Chandler Center for Arts 隆重举行。 今年台湾侨委会国庆表演团阵容超强，节目内容更是精彩亮丽可以说又是近年来最受侨胞讚赏与欢迎的一年。 叶爱菱担纲演出，凤飞飞(刘明珠模彷)，邓丽君(张瀞云模彷)，江蕙(陈思安模彷)演唱所有成名歌曲，激情舞台气势一波推动一波，观衆高昂的情绪必将 High 到沸点。 旅日红星林晓培诠释客家经典名曲，台视歌唱大赛最新出炉帅哥小子黄家新将与大家合唱”你是我的眼”！ 喜欢邓丽君，凤飞飞及江蕙的歌迷朋友，可以在国庆酒会上看到她们的身影，表演团全体巨星将在会场与你分享台湾美食，共同庆祝这让你永难忘怀的一夜。 今年演出节目叫好叫座，大会选择有1500席位剧院，尽量满足所有热情朋友的需求，透过所属社团的安排必能让你閤家同乐，共渡国庆。
4711262771f3360aadac3bf5d779f874bb5b1c8c.translatedText: This year's "Double Ten" party in Arizona is confirmed to be held grandly on October 6th at the luxurious Chandler Center for Arts. This year's National Day Performance Troupe of the Taiwan Overseas Chinese Affairs Council has a strong lineup, and the program content is even more exciting. It can be said that it is the most appreciated and popular year among overseas Chinese in recent years. Ye Ailing takes the lead in the performance, Feng Feifei (imitation of Liu Mingzhu), Teresa Teng (imitation of Zhang Chengyun), and Jiang Hui (imitation of Chen Sian) sing all the famous songs. The passionate stage momentum is promoted one after another, and the audience's high emotions will surely reach the boiling point. Japanese star Lin Xiaopei interprets Hakka classics, and the latest handsome boy Huang Jiaxin from the Taiwan TV singing competition will sing "You Are My Eyes" with everyone! Fans who like Teresa Teng, Feng Feifei and Jiang Hui can see them at the National Day reception. All the superstars of the performing group will share Taiwanese delicacies with you at the venue to celebrate this night that you will never forget. This year's performance has been well received and the conference has chosen a theater with 1,500 seats to meet the needs of all enthusiastic friends. Through the arrangements of your affiliated societies, you will be able to have fun with your family and celebrate the National Day together.

f959ffe57cb6bec22a4e042d68ef2d1930fc187a.sourceText: 气如虹:聆听发言须谨慎 凤凰城 气如虹 我们日常谈话裡，发言和聆听是两方面的场合，有时发言者是一个意思，聆听者却是另一个意思，会产生误会和误解，因而我们听见任何发言，不要单凭直觉去诠释，要运用大脑思维，分析是否合理。还有一点比较重要，聆听者要有耐心，等待发言者表达完整的意思，才给予回答；或者未曾明瞭原意时，不妨提问清楚，这样可避免无谓的误解。很多时候，发言的人语气缓慢，还没有完成整句说话，聆听者已领悟差错，急速反驳，造成损伤情谊的憾事。 我小时候在玻璃厂做童工，有位技工师傅教导我，工作要认真，必须谨慎听从师傅们的指示，如果聆听时有不明白的地方，立即提问，不要闷在心裡煳裡煳涂的干，那很容易「撞板」出错，还述说一个铁匠学徒铸成大错的不幸事故给我听。 半世纪前，越南铸造刀、斧、凿等铁类器皿，都是手工艺，将残旧铁板锯开小块，放进煤炭熔炉猛烈烧软，然后技工用长钳夹住，放在铁砧上，由两名技工相对站着，拿起铁锤子举高砸打下去，依照刀或斧的形状夯打，嘀嘀哒哒，你夯我夯，轮流操作，很有节奏。那天雇用了一个新学徒，铁匠师傅教导他打铁趁热，如何高举锤子使劲猛击，为了让他有秩序的干，师傅加以指导说明：「你要留意，高举锤子，我一点头你就砸下去。」学徒唯唯诺诺，谨记在心注视着，看见师傅一点头，立即一锤子打下去！天呀！他竟煳裡煳涂的打在师傅头上，当堂头破血流！ 有位男子，逛街时遇见一位很久没见面的女郎，向她打招呼，女郎满睑狐疑地对身旁的姊妹低声说：「好像不认识这个人。」他听见了，慢吞吞地说：「妳是真抑假？装作不认识我厖我以前就是妳老公厖」他未及说完，女郎已一巴掌掴过来，骂句「神经病」就走开了，其实他想说「以前就是妳老公的同学」，却无端受辱。 另外一场合是口吃的人，广东人称为「漏口」，那是口腔障碍，不能将一个词句顺溜说出，要重複说出上一半几次才能连接后一半，聆听的人很容易疏忽而误解 ，必须耐心聆听完整个句子，才明白真正意义，然后作出合理的反应。 以前在越南堤岸，侨胞以广东人佔多数，早上街头摆卖很多广东式靓汤粉麵，潮语称为粿条的那种，民众喜爱的早餐。广东人帮衬，习惯呼叫煮粉，而「煮」又有个古语是「熝」，仍有长者喜叫熝粉。当年有个口吃的人去吃早餐，不顺畅的吩咐摊贩：「唔?#21780;?#21780;该，熝?#29085;?#29085;?#30871;粉俾我。」广东话熝与六同音，那天适逢生意兴旺，摊贩忙碌料理，没留意多少顾客，只铭记听闻「熝六碗粉」，他迅速地一连煮好六碗粉，伙计用托盘端出去的时候，哎呀！搞错了，仅有一位食客嘛，那完全是聆听欠谨慎的结果。 这场合，有点像早期香港有位口吃的人那样，去北京旅游，途中口渴，走到饮料摊位，打算购买一樽装汽水，询问价钱若干，摊贩一边拿着开盖器一边说：「ＸＸ元，开不开？」此君觉得价钱实在太贵，乃指着摊贩回答：「你开?#24320;?#24320;厖 」摊贩是灵活服务顾客高手，听到「开开」就迅速开启樽盖，一连开了两樽，却听到口吃者说出的下半句：「你开厖开玩笑呐，价钱这麽贵！」说完便转身离去，摊贩为之气结。 这种种事情的发生，都是聆听者不小心，没有耐心听清楚整句的表达，或者未理解说话的内容，自己仓卒作出决定；吸取经验，每当聆听别人的讲述，千万不要先入为主地急速判断，放缓慢点，以清醒的头脑去思考，然后作出决定也未迟。 大明正德皇时期，广东有位政治人物梁储，官至内阁首辅，发生一段写诗贺寿的轶事，可作为谨慎聆听的参考资料。传说梁储有一回前往参加柴姓世侄家庭的寿宴，遭受其富裕亲人的鄙视，他看在眼内，心照不宣，显得若无其事；跟着那亲属与知县想让他出丑，建议他在白绢上题诗，他循例推辞未遂，便答允下来，研磨香墨，下笔疾书，首句是「丫环不是亚娘身，」一看这不雅诗句，众人不乐，那位富亲更在咒骂胡说八道，岂料第二句是「月裡嫦娥降世尘；」那意义又完全不同了。继续第三句是：「生下五男皆做贼，」富亲更无法忍受了，破口大骂这是诬蔑诋毁柴家兄弟的声誉，知县在座居然还敢放肆，扬言必须拿出真凭实据；这时候，梁储慢条斯理的写下最后一句：「偷取蟠桃敬母亲。」立即扭转情势，贬抑化为赞扬，满堂喝采！ 这个历史故事，无疑也是指出，聆听发言须谨慎，要顾及全面，等待到最后话语结束，将意思表达清楚，全面瞭解，然后採取正确回应。否则，变成断章取义，一知半解或完全误解，甚至好事弄成坏事，那就确实难堪。
f959ffe57cb6bec22a4e042d68ef2d1930fc187a.translatedText: Qi Ruhong: Be careful when listening to speeches Phoenix Qi Ruhong In our daily conversations, speaking and listening are two aspects of the situation. Sometimes the speaker means one thing, but the listener means another, which will cause misunderstandings and misunderstandings. Therefore, when we hear any speech, we should not interpret it based on intuition alone, but use our brains to think and analyze whether it is reasonable. Another important point is that the listener should be patient and wait for the speaker to express the complete meaning before giving an answer; or when the original intention is not clear, you may wish to ask questions clearly, so as to avoid unnecessary misunderstandings. Many times, the speaker speaks slowly and before he has finished the whole sentence, the listener has already understood the mistake and refutes quickly, which is a pity that damages the friendship. When I was a child, I worked as a child laborer in a glass factory. A master craftsman taught me that I must work seriously and follow the instructions of the masters carefully. If there is something I don’t understand when listening, ask questions immediately and don’t work in a muddle. It is easy to make mistakes. He also told me an unfortunate incident in which a blacksmith’s apprentice made a big mistake. Half a century ago, Vietnam cast iron utensils such as knives, axes, and chisels. It was all done by handicraft. The old iron plates were cut into small pieces and put into the coal furnace to be heated until they were soft. Then the technicians used long tongs to clamp them and put them on the anvil. A new apprentice was hired that day. The master blacksmith taught him how to hit the iron hard while the iron was hot. In order to make him do it in an orderly manner, the master gave instructions: "You have to pay attention. Hold the hammer high. I will nod and you will hit it." Oh my God! He was so confused that he hit the master on the head, causing a bloody mess! A man met a girl he hadn't seen for a long time while shopping and greeted her. The girl suspiciously whispered to the sister next to her: "I don't seem to know this person." He heard it and said slowly: "You are really shy. Are you pretending not to know me? I used to be your husband." Before he could finish his sentence, the girl slapped him, cursed him with "psycho" and walked away. In fact, he wanted to say "I used to be your husband's classmate", but he was humiliated for no reason. Another situation is a person who stutters, which the Cantonese people call "leaky mouth". This is an oral disorder that prevents the person from speaking a sentence smoothly. The first half of a sentence must be repeated several times to connect the second half. The listener can easily neglect and misunderstand. It is necessary to listen patiently to the entire sentence to understand the true meaning and then make a reasonable response. In the past, in Vietnam, the majority of overseas Chinese were Cantonese. In the morning, there were many delicious Cantonese-style noodle soups sold on the streets. The kind called Kway Teow in Chaozhou dialect was a favorite breakfast among the people. Cantonese people are accustomed to calling "boiled noodles", and there is an old saying for "boiled" which is "熝". There are still elders who like to call them "熝粉". Back then, there was a man who stuttered when he went to have breakfast, and he asked the vendor in an awkward manner: "Well, you should give it to me." In Cantonese, the word "熝" means "熝" (熝), which is the same as "liu" (liu). It was a busy day and the vendor was busy cooking. He didn't pay attention to many customers. He only remembered hearing about "熝六bowls". He quickly cooked six bowls of noodles in a row. When the waiter brought them out on a tray, oops! It was a mistake, there was only one diner, and that was entirely the result of a lack of careful listening. This situation is a bit like a person who stuttered in Hong Kong in the early days. He traveled to Beijing and was thirsty on the way. He walked to a beverage stall and planned to buy a bottle of soda. He asked how much it cost. The vendor held the cap opener and said, "XX yuan, can't you open it?" The person felt that the price was too expensive, so he pointed to the vendor and replied, "You open it?" The vendor was a master at serving customers flexibly. When he heard "open", he quickly opened the bottle cap and opened two bottles in a row. However, he heard the second half of the stutterer's sentence: "You are kidding me, the price is so expensive!" After saying that, he turned around and left. The vendor was furious. This kind of thing happens because the listener is not careful, has no patience to hear the whole sentence clearly, or does not understand the content of the speech, and makes a hasty decision on his own; learn from experience, whenever listening to other people's stories, do not make preconceptions and make quick judgments. Slow down, think with a clear mind, and then make a decision. During the period of Emperor Zhengde of the Ming Dynasty, there was an anecdote about Liang Chu, a politician in Guangdong who rose from official to chief minister of the cabinet and wrote a poem to celebrate his birthday, which can be used as a reference for careful listening. Legend has it that Liang Chu once went to attend a birthday party for his nephew's family surnamed Chai, and was despised by his wealthy relatives. He saw this in his eyes and tacitly understood it, appearing as if nothing had happened. The relatives and the magistrate wanted to make him look bad and suggested that he write a poem on white silk, but he refused as usual. , he agreed and came down, grinding ink and writing quickly. The first sentence was "The girl is not a girl." When they saw this indecent poem, everyone was unhappy. The rich relative even cursed and talked nonsense. Unexpectedly, the second sentence was "Chang'e came to the world in the moon." The meaning was completely different. The third sentence continued: "After giving birth to five boys, all will be thieves." The rich relative couldn't bear it anymore and yelled that this was a slander to slander the reputation of the Chai family brothers. The magistrate here actually dared to be so bold and threatened that real evidence must be produced. At this time, Liang Chu slowly wrote the last sentence: "Stealing flat peaches to honor the mother." The situation was immediately reversed, and the disparagement was turned into praise, and the whole hall cheered! This historical story undoubtedly also points out that one must be careful when listening to a speech, take the whole thing into consideration, wait until the end of the last words, express the meaning clearly, fully understand it, and then take the correct response. Otherwise, it will be taken out of context, half-understood or completely misunderstood, or even a good thing will turn into a bad thing, which will be really embarrassing.

0b946aaa655c9b517a080bd1df74119a85aae828.sourceText: 新东方艺术学校成为美国政府幼儿早教培训单位之一 ”新东方文化讲坛”幼儿早教讲座圆满举行 新东方艺术学校成为美国政府幼儿早教培训单位之一 2012年9月8日晚上，新东方文化讲坛(新东方艺术学校与陈普”绿洲文教”合办)与”太阳鸟”’亚利桑那华人网在新东方艺术学校进行了一场生动的关于儿童早期教育的讲座，由美国当代著名的儿童早教专家Dr. Jill Stamm和她的助手Rachel Lam主讲。共有包括华人、韩国人及美国人在内的四十多人参加了讲座。他们中既有父母和准父母，也有现职和已退休的幼教工作者。 讲座现场 Dr. Jill Stamm从亚利桑那教育部拿到了一笔基金，用于一个叫做” First Things First”的政府项目。该项目主要用于培训父母和幼儿工作者如何对0-5岁的婴幼儿进行教育。在过去的几年里，亚利桑那州的主要医院、图书馆、学校和幼儿园的婴幼儿工作者和父母65,000多人得到了该项目的培训。新东方艺术学校将成为本省华人地区第一个与州政府合作进行”First Things First”项目的单位，仍然由Dr. Jill Stamm主持，对亚省华人地区的父母 、准父母和幼教工作者进行培训。在昨天的活动中，已经有十五个家庭的父母和四位幼教工作者当场报名参加。该培训将进行十周，每周一次。培训结束后将获得由州政府颁发的幼教工作者培训证书。 婴儿与成人的脑量对比 在一个半小时的讲座时间里，Dr.Stamm和Rachel Lan 用大量的详实的科学数据以图片和录影的方式向听众解释了０—-５岁儿童的早期教育的重要性。两位老师告诉大家，人类的大脑到3 岁的时候已经达到了成人脑量的90%，一个人的智商除先天因素外，更主要的是后天的培养。要想使孩子更加聪明在婴儿期父母和看护人就要对孩子做五件事：交谈、阅读、哼唱、玩耍和爱抚。两位老师将会在接下来的系列讲座中就这五个方面展开深入的讲解。 幼儿早教培训继续接受报名，该项目受美国政府财政支持，免费向公众开放。 报名咨询电话：602-490-8613；480-319-1098 Dr. Jill Stamm是的新方向研究所的创始人之，这个研究所主要是研究婴儿的大脑发育（指数）。她也是亚利桑那州儿童协会的成员之一，亚利桑那州立大学临床医学副教授。她是BRIGHT FROM START一书的作者，书中描述了如何以简单科学的方式培养孩子从出生到３岁的思维发展。她经常在The Arizona Republic杂志中发表关于儿童发展的文章。在电视台、广播和网站中也被多次采访。同时她还在州长的顾问委员会中担任职务，主管科学，技术，工程和数学方面的工作。 Dr. Jill Stamm是BRAIN BOXES的发明人，这是一个非常独特的已经获得了专利的系列工具，帮助幼儿教师和工作人员在工作的时候 ，如何与幼儿进行的互动，以此来促进和鼓励孩子的大脑的健康发育。 Dr. Jill Stamm有两个成年女儿。Kristin是一名神经学家。Jenny由于早产，在身体发育方面有残疾，但基于母亲对她特殊的理解与关爱，她仍然在茁壮成长。
0b946aaa655c9b517a080bd1df74119a85aae828.translatedText: New Oriental Art School became one of the U.S. government early childhood education training units. The "New Oriental Culture Forum" early childhood education lecture was successfully held. New Oriental Art School became one of the U.S. government early childhood education training units. On the evening of September 8, 2012, the New Oriental Culture Forum (co-organized by New Oriental Art School and Chen Pu's "Oasis Culture and Education") and "Sunbird" Arizona Chinese Network conducted a lively lecture on early childhood education at the New Oriental Art School. The lecture was given by the famous contemporary American early childhood education expert Dr. Jill Stamm and her assistant Rachel Lam. A total of more than 40 people including Chinese, Koreans and Americans attended the lecture. They include parents and expectant parents, as well as current and retired early childhood education workers. Lecture scene Dr. Jill Stamm received a grant from the Arizona Department of Education for a government project called "First Things First." This project is mainly used to train parents and early childhood workers how to educate infants and young children aged 0-5. Over the past few years, more than 65,000 infant and child care workers and parents at major Arizona hospitals, libraries, schools and preschools have been trained through the program. New Oriental Art School will become the first unit in the Chinese area of ​​the province to cooperate with the state government in the "First Things First" project. It will still be chaired by Dr. Jill Stamm and will train parents, expectant parents and early childhood education workers in the Chinese area of ​​Alberta. In yesterday’s event, parents from fifteen families and four early childhood education workers had signed up to participate on the spot. The training will take place once a week for ten weeks. After the training, you will receive a preschool education worker training certificate issued by the state government. Comparison of brain size between infants and adults. During the one-and-a-half-hour lecture, Dr. Stamm and Rachel Lan used a large amount of detailed scientific data to explain to the audience the importance of early education for children aged 0--5 years old in the form of pictures and videos. The two teachers told everyone that the human brain has reached 90% of the adult brain volume by the age of 3. In addition to innate factors, a person's IQ is mainly a result of acquired cultivation. To make children smarter, parents and caregivers need to do five things with their children during infancy: talk, read, hum, play, and caress. The two teachers will give in-depth explanations on these five aspects in the next series of lectures. Early childhood education training continues to accept registration. This project is financially supported by the US government and is free and open to the public. Registration consultation hotline: 602-490-8613; 480-319-1098 Dr. Jill Stamm is the founder of the New Directions Institute, which mainly studies infant brain development (index). She is also a member of the Arizona Children's Society and an associate professor of clinical medicine at Arizona State University. She is the author of BRIGHT FROM START, which describes how to cultivate children's thinking development from birth to 3 years old in a simple and scientific way. She frequently writes about child development in The Arizona Republic magazine. He has also been interviewed many times on television, radio and websites. She also serves on the Governor's Advisory Council on Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics. Dr. Jill Stamm is the inventor of BRAIN BOXES, a unique and patented series of tools that help early childhood teachers and staff interact with young children at work to promote and encourage healthy brain development. Dr. Jill Stamm has two adult daughters. Kristin is a neuroscientist. Due to her premature birth, Jenny has physical developmental disabilities, but she is still thriving based on her mother's special understanding and care for her.

7e1e80a7d03646c316162132ac21968e5896de50.sourceText: 生活随笔 观感心情 凤凰城 气如虹 我的几篇旅行游记完结了，本星期可以恢复【生活随笔】的专栏作品。实际上，出外旅游也是我的日常生活一部分，只不过为了详细划分清楚，就把游记文章另作编排，避免混淆。 令我感到快慰的，无论游记文章或者生活随笔，都获得凤凰城读者朋友喜爱与共鸣，多次诚意赞许，那是最大的鼓励，精神的支柱，正是这股无形力量，使我不敢停顿创作，不愿辜负读者对我的厚爱。 这半年内，我在亚省时报发表旅游文章较多，曾经两度旅游，记录行踪。六七月间是〈宝岛顺道旅游〉，七篇，十月是〈落基山漫游〉，也是七篇。 上次是飞去越南经过宝岛，顺道逗留七日旅游，同时探亲访友，很多来自台湾朋友阅读后，都说我描述得很好，有的说「很久没有回去，阅读了你的游记，真想回去看看现况了。」有的说「以前在台湾很少旅游，阅读了你的文章，让我也想去旅游一趟。」 这次十月，是农历八月，庆祝太座生辰与我俩结婚纪念，专程往加拿大落基山漫游，游记刊登，一样获得读者好评。有位朋友说：「我怕冷，不过看了你的生动描述，倒想去见识见识，明年六七月吧，我也去落基山一游。」另外一位大娘说：「我曾经去旅游过，好像很平凡，没什么特别，不像你那么玩得开心！」 哦！我记起过去有人对我说过同样的话。那是越南的一九八六年，南方人民对北方很陌生，南方一向生活在自由民主的资本社会，被解放了十年，仍不适应无产阶级专政，所以政府革新思维，鼓励民众前去北方旅游，藉以互相沟通，旅费非常便宜，国家作财政补贴，但游客寥寥无几。那年七月，一班华人朋友决定放下戒心，响应第五郡文化宫的呼吁，尝试观光与了解环境，邀我夫妇同行，登记河内十日游，但当时玻璃工厂兴旺，太座留下帮忙管理业务，我携带长子国平前往，平生第一次搭乘美国波音飞机，第一次飞往越南北方，第一次踏上共产党的首都河内，回程又是第一次搭乘苏联援助的图标飞机。 在此说明一下，我童年时代的越南是法国属地，阮氏皇朝，保大皇在位，首都皇宫在中圻顺化；一九五四年法国在奠边府战败，下旗归国，日内瓦条约将南北越分割，北方由胡志明领导的共产党管辖，当时国际共产被形容为落下铁幕，实际情形外界所知不多。南方称为自由世界，由美国支持的吴廷琰回来执政，废除帝制，成立越南共和国，选举总统，以西贡为首都。从此南北双方展开主义斗争，形成震惊世界的越战。一九七五年，越共解放南方后，只有北方人民南下的增多，南方北上十分稀少，十年后国家鼓吹旅游，西贡人民仍犹豫不决，忐忑不安，愿意去旅游者甚少，对首都河内更是不熟识。 正因如此，我们第五郡文化宫旅行团，抵达北方很受欢迎，尤其瞻仰胡志明陵，受到贵宾式的接待。旅游回来，我以〈山河秀丽北游记〉栏目， 一连写了十篇作品，在解放日报的《国土与人民》版刊登，获得读者关注，引起人们前往旅行的兴趣。不过，有位朋友旅游回来对我说：「看你描写得那么吸引，为什么我去旅行，觉得很平凡，毫无特色，似乎有受骗的样子。」 对了，这就是症结所在，在于观感，在于心情。我们去旅游，必须投入，集中精神，才能领略个中乐趣。不要以为出外观光就快乐，最重要是心情，随团旅游也好，同亲友自由行也好，甚至独自去浏览景点也好，须要丢开烦恼，放宽胸怀，全神贯注，投入心灵，客观面对，乐在其中，这样观赏才有韵味，才会乐而忘返。否则，心不在焉，美景当前，视若无睹，或主观执着，诸多挑剔，怎会感到乐趣呢！ 事实证明，景物的美与丑，好与坏，不在于景物的本身，而是参观者的感觉。我时常提到越南人流传的一句好诗：「人闷景物有何欢？」 ( ng ườ i bu ồ n c ả nh vui đ 鈛 bao gi ờ? ) 诗句含义指出，景物是没有表情，没有喜与悲，如果个人心情闷闷不乐，观看任何景物都不会欢欣。相反，个人如满怀高兴，就觉得眼前的景物特别有趣。 这就是观感问题，心情问题。我们去旅游，主要在观光景物，认识新境界，乐观与悲观的心情大有差别。我抱持开朗胸怀，往好处着想，所以旅途愉快。别人如若事事不顺眼，先入为主，存在偏见，怎能开心观赏呢！正如《红楼梦》的林黛玉，对落花有无限哀怨，「侬今葬花人笑痴，他年葬侬知是谁？」但薛宝钗的看法完全相反，她充满信心：「好风凭借力，送我上青云！」观感心情，非常重要，我们不可忽视。
7e1e80a7d03646c316162132ac21968e5896de50.translatedText: Life Essays, Perceptions and Moods, Phoenix City, Qi Ruhong. Several of my travel notes have been completed, and I can resume the [Life Essays] column this week. In fact, traveling is also a part of my daily life. However, in order to make the details clear, I have arranged the travel articles separately to avoid confusion. What makes me feel gratified is that regardless of travel articles or life essays, they have been loved and resonated with Phoenix readers and have been sincerely praised many times. This is the greatest encouragement and spiritual pillar. It is this invisible force that makes me dare not stop writing and do not want to live up to the love of readers. In the past six months, I have published many travel articles in the Alberta Times. I have traveled twice and recorded my travels. In June and July, there are seven chapters called "Tour of the Treasure Island," and in October there are seven chapters called "A Wandering in the Rockies." Last time I flew to Vietnam and passed through Taiwan Island, where I stayed for seven days to travel and visit relatives and friends. After reading it, many friends from Taiwan said that my description was very good. Some said, "I haven't been back for a long time. After reading your travel notes, I really want to go back and see the current situation." Some said, "I rarely traveled in Taiwan before. Reading your article made me want to travel." This time, October is the eighth month of the lunar calendar. To celebrate the birthday of The Queen and our wedding anniversary, we made a special trip to the Canadian Rockies to roam. The travel notes were published and received favorable reviews from readers. A friend said: "I'm afraid of the cold, but after reading your vivid description, I really want to experience it. I'll go to the Rocky Mountains in June or July next year." Another lady said: "I have traveled before, but it seemed very ordinary, nothing special, and I didn't have as much fun as you did!" Oh! I remembered someone saying the same thing to me in the past. It was 1986 in Vietnam, and the people in the south were unfamiliar with the north. The south had always lived in a liberal democratic capital society. After being liberated for ten years, it was still not accustomed to the dictatorship of the proletariat. Therefore, the government innovatively encouraged people to travel to the north to communicate with each other. Travel expenses were very cheap and the state provided financial subsidies, but there were only a few tourists. In July of that year, a group of Chinese friends decided to let down their guard and respond to the call of the Fifth District Cultural Palace to try sightseeing and understanding the environment. They invited me and my wife to accompany them and registered for a ten-day tour of Hanoi. However, the glass factory was booming at that time, so Tai Zuo stayed to help manage the business. I took my eldest son Guoping there with me. It was the first time in my life that I took an American Boeing plane, flew to North Vietnam for the first time, set foot on Hanoi, the capital of the Communist Party, and took the Soviet-aided icon plane for the first time on the return trip. Let me explain here that the Vietnam of my childhood was a French territory, under the Nguyen dynasty, Emperor Bao Dai was on the throne, and the capital palace was in Central Hue. In 1954, France was defeated at Dien Bien Phu and returned to the country under the flag. The Geneva Treaty divided North and South Vietnam, and the north was under the jurisdiction of the Communist Party led by Ho Chi Minh. At that time, international communism was described as falling behind the Iron Curtain, and the actual situation was not well known to the outside world. The South was called the Free World. Ngo Dinh Diem, supported by the United States, came back to rule, abolished the monarchy, established the Republic of Vietnam, elected a president, and made Saigon its capital. From then on, the North and the South launched a communist struggle, resulting in the Vietnam War that shocked the world. In 1975, after the Vietnamese Communist Party liberated the south, only the number of people from the north going south increased, while the number of people from the south going north was very rare. Ten years later, the country promoted tourism, but the people of Saigon were still hesitant and uneasy. Very few people were willing to travel, and they were even less familiar with the capital Hanoi. Because of this, our fifth district cultural palace tour group was very popular when we arrived in the north, especially when we visited the Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum and were received like VIPs. After returning from the trip, I wrote ten articles in a row under the column "Travel Notes on Beautiful Mountains and Rivers in the North", which were published in the "Land and People" section of Liberation Daily. This attracted readers' attention and aroused people's interest in traveling. However, a friend came back from traveling and said to me: "Your descriptions are so attractive. Why do I feel so ordinary and featureless when I travel, as if I have been deceived." By the way, this is the crux of the matter, it lies in perception and mood. When we travel, we must be immersed and concentrated in order to appreciate the fun. Don’t think that you will be happy when you go sightseeing. The most important thing is your mood. Whether traveling in a group, traveling alone with relatives and friends, or even visiting scenic spots alone, you need to put aside your worries, relax your mind, concentrate on it, put your soul into it, face it objectively, and enjoy it. Only in this way can the viewing have charm and you will never forget to return. Otherwise, if you are absent-minded and turn a blind eye to the beautiful scenery in front of you, or you are subjective and persistent, and you are too picky, how can you feel fun! Facts have proved that the beauty or ugliness of a scene, good or bad, does not lie in the scene itself, but in the feelings of the visitors. I often mention a good poem circulated by Vietnamese: "What joy can a person enjoy when he is bored with scenery?" (ng ườ i bu ồ n c ả nh vui đ 鈛 bao gi ờ?) The meaning of the poem points out that scenery has no expression, no joy or sorrow. If a person is depressed, he will not be happy watching any scenery. On the contrary, if an individual is full of joy, he will find the scenery in front of him particularly interesting. This is a matter of perception and mood. When we travel, we mainly focus on sightseeing and understanding new realms. There is a big difference between optimism and pessimism. I keep an open mind and think for the best, so I have a pleasant trip. If others don't like everything, have preconceptions, and have prejudices, how can they enjoy watching it happily? Just like Lin Daiyu in "A Dream of Red Mansions", she has infinite sorrow for falling flowers, "If you bury flowers today, you will laugh like crazy. Who will he bury next year?" But Xue Baochai's view is completely opposite. She is full of confidence: "The good wind will send me to the blue clouds with its power!" The perception of mood is very important and we cannot ignore it.

d2a9ee70e5e7e302f071cdfb3b1d25c25f04902a.sourceText: 两岸逾４００位中小企业代表２７日齐聚台北，共同探讨如何抓住两岸经济合作框架协议（ＥＣＦＡ）以及大陆”十二五”规划启动带来的新机遇。
d2a9ee70e5e7e302f071cdfb3b1d25c25f04902a.translatedText: More than 400 representatives of small and medium-sized enterprises from both sides of the Taiwan Strait gathered in Taipei on the 27th to discuss how to seize the new opportunities brought by the Cross-Strait Economic Cooperation Framework Agreement (ECFA) and the launch of the mainland's "Twelfth Five-Year Plan".

2faabe68b4f63fbcf2ae208f1a004b2952c87cf9.sourceText: 为期两天的”海峡两岸中小企业论坛”由台湾中小企业协会、大陆中小企业协会以及台北世界贸易中心共同主办。来自大陆１７个省市区的１５０名中小企业代表与会。
2faabe68b4f63fbcf2ae208f1a004b2952c87cf9.translatedText: The two-day "Cross-Strait Small and Medium Enterprises Forum" is co-sponsored by the Taiwan Small and Medium Enterprises Association, the Mainland Small and Medium Enterprises Association and the Taipei World Trade Center. 150 representatives of small and medium-sized enterprises from 17 provinces and municipalities in mainland China attended the meeting.

aaf3ab3a37ca190da9dbf6234bb804431a36b3b6.sourceText: 大陆中小企业协会会长李子彬表示，今年是ＥＣＦＡ实施第一年，也是大陆”十二五”规划开局之年。ＥＣＦＡ的积极效应已逐步显现，两岸货物贸易明显增长，服务贸易进一步开放，两岸人员、资金和技术的流动加快，两岸在自主创新和创造自主品牌方面的合作以及产业合作都得到强化。
aaf3ab3a37ca190da9dbf6234bb804431a36b3b6.translatedText: Li Zibin, president of the Mainland Small and Medium Enterprises Association, said that this year is the first year of ECFA implementation and also the beginning of Mainland China’s “Twelfth Five-Year Plan”. The positive effects of ECFA have gradually emerged. Cross-Strait trade in goods has increased significantly, service trade has been further opened, cross-Strait personnel, capital and technology flows have accelerated, and cross-Strait cooperation in independent innovation and the creation of independent brands, as well as industrial cooperation, have been strengthened.

22e1d5abc400f45662c5e291172fecd5222699de.sourceText: 他认为，两岸签署ＥＣＦＡ之后，中小企业的交流合作进入新阶段，未来发展的空间广阔。大陆市场大，资金储备日益增加，人力资源丰富，而台湾企业创新能力强，管理经验和开拓国际市场的经验丰富，如果双方优势合作，竞争力会很快增强。他希望通过本次论坛，两岸可以交换中小企业发展经验，推进两岸经贸合作和产业发展转型，也推动中小企业服务机构和社会团体的对接与合作。
22e1d5abc400f45662c5e291172fecd5222699de.translatedText: He believes that after the signing of the ECFA between the two sides, the exchanges and cooperation between small and medium-sized enterprises have entered a new stage, and there is broad room for future development. The mainland has a large market, increasing capital reserves, and abundant human resources, while Taiwanese companies have strong innovation capabilities, rich management experience and experience in exploring international markets. If the two sides cooperate with each other, their competitiveness will soon increase. He hopes that through this forum, the two sides can exchange experience in the development of small and medium-sized enterprises, promote cross-strait economic and trade cooperation and industrial development transformation, and also promote the docking and cooperation of small and medium-sized enterprise service agencies and social groups.

0fc1666316bf4638818d1650cd7975749d34b865.sourceText: 台湾中小企业协会理事长林秉彬在论坛上表示，台湾中小企业过去主要开拓欧美市场，而目前大陆正致力于扩大内需，发展消费性产品，将是台湾中小企业的新机会。此外，台湾中小企业发展较早，有很多经验和教训可供大陆同行参考。
0fc1666316bf4638818d1650cd7975749d34b865.translatedText: Lin Bingbin, chairman of the Taiwan Small and Medium Enterprises Association, said at the forum that Taiwan's small and medium-sized enterprises used to mainly explore the European and American markets, but now the mainland is committed to expanding domestic demand and developing consumer products, which will be new opportunities for Taiwan's small and medium-sized enterprises. In addition, Taiwan's small and medium-sized enterprises developed earlier and have a lot of experience and lessons for their mainland counterparts to refer to.

6e81120def4aa2d8be59fab6682d468d5e7bbd5b.sourceText: 林秉彬表示，希望论坛可以成为两岸中小企业合作交流的常态性平台，帮助大家了解两岸市场的发展趋势和变化，增进互信，建立两岸中小企业紧密联系的网络。
6e81120def4aa2d8be59fab6682d468d5e7bbd5b.translatedText: Lin Bingbin expressed the hope that the forum can become a regular platform for cooperation and exchange between small and medium-sized enterprises on both sides of the Taiwan Strait, helping everyone understand the development trends and changes in the cross-strait market, enhance mutual trust, and establish a close network of small and medium-sized enterprises on both sides of the Taiwan Strait.

3d1dd1b25728f04a051f3dab3246edde1340807c.sourceText: 海基会董事长江丙坤在论坛上表示，两岸中小企业合作是两岸经贸合作的重要部分。ＥＣＦＡ为中小企业提供了新机遇。在货物贸易方面，已经实施的早收清单仅占货物贸易的一小部分，目前两岸关于货物贸易的后续谈判刚刚开始，如果谈判取得成果，两岸中小企业的贸易机会将进一步增加，并进而提高竞争力。未来两岸还可以扩大开放服务业，扩大中小企业互相进入市场的机会。
3d1dd1b25728f04a051f3dab3246edde1340807c.translatedText: Jiang Bingkun, chairman of the Straits Exchange Foundation, said at the forum that cross-strait cooperation between small and medium-sized enterprises is an important part of cross-strait economic and trade cooperation. ECFA provides new opportunities for small and medium-sized enterprises. In terms of trade in goods, the early harvest list that has been implemented only accounts for a small part of the trade in goods. The follow-up negotiations between the two sides on the trade in goods have just begun. If the negotiations achieve results, the trade opportunities for small and medium-sized enterprises on both sides of the Taiwan Strait will be further increased, and thus the competitiveness will be improved. In the future, both sides of the Taiwan Strait can also expand the opening up of the service industry and expand opportunities for small and medium-sized enterprises to enter each other's markets.

5b32306aecb040a69a8da8d8d8c794a9d29ea0dd.sourceText: 本次论坛除研讨活动之外，还将分成金融、绿色能源、机械和物流等１０个产业，组织企业面对面交流对接，帮助他们找到合作伙伴。
5b32306aecb040a69a8da8d8d8c794a9d29ea0dd.translatedText: In addition to seminar activities, this forum will also be divided into 10 industries such as finance, green energy, machinery and logistics, and organize face-to-face exchanges between enterprises to help them find partners.

180b29802233835eb861a13e0e93649d33926037.sourceText: 图桑 慧明 紫菱洲是贾迎春在红楼大院的住所，因被宝钗在诗会将菱洲作为迎春的笔名，所以紫菱洲就和迎春有分不开的关系和情结了。 先絮叨一下贾迎春的出身背景。迎春的父亲是贾赦，和贾政（宝玉的父亲）是亲兄弟，如果不提她母亲是妾的原因，她至少和宝玉是堂兄妹的关系，加上从小和宝玉、姑娘们在一起耳鬓厮磨的，虽然关系不及元春（宝玉的亲姐姐）和探春（宝玉的同父异母的妹妹）但和宝玉的感情还是不浅的。 但这个贾府二小姐的脾性和大小姐元春三小姐探春有着天壤之别。她年纪不大，但好像已经洞穿了所有的世事，东西被偷了不生气，被针戳了不叫痛，写个诗歌像白开水，姑娘们经常猜谜也从来没见她猜出过，听说她会下棋，但也没见她赢过谁。那个叫兴儿的小厮还敢把贾府的这二小姐喊做”二木头”，却也没见过她为自己倒霉和没才气而自卑自怜。可见迎春与世无争的性格了。 迎春这种脾气的形成和她那令人自豪不起来的父亲贾赦有关。这个父亲岂止是让人不自豪了，简直是让人羞愧了。虽然贾赦是贾母的长子，但他一生既不追名为官，也不从商求利，一把年龄了还贼眼斜视，光往年轻的丫鬟身上打量，除了重色以外，别无他技。这种人放在哪个社会都让人不待见的。有这样的父亲迎春在红楼大院里怎能抬得起头来！ 这个父亲甚至为了自己的欠款将女儿迎春嫁给一个行伍出生的军官，导致迎春外嫁一年后就被折磨而死。 没才能和地位低从来是被人歧视的口实，在红楼大院里这是谁都心知肚明的潜规则。但作为情种的宝玉却从来不这样认为。他的名言”女儿是水做的骨肉，男子是泥做的骨肉”让无数女性读者感到亲切无比。宝玉是无愧于女人们对他的尊敬的，因为他心中”这’女儿’两个字极尊贵极清净的，比那瑞兽珍禽、奇花异草更觉希罕尊贵呢”，在他的世界里”清爽”的是女儿；男子便是一概”浊臭逼人”的。所以女孩对他来说从来没有地位高低之分，他才不管你是正出庶出姑娘丫鬟呢。所以，在迎春逝去后，宝玉来到紫菱洲院，目睹旧物，感慨不已，写下了紫菱洲歌悼念迎春”池塘一夜秋风冷，吹散芰荷红玉影。蓼花菱叶不胜愁，重露繁霜压纤梗。不闻永昼敲棋声，燕泥点点污棋枰。古人惜别怜朋友，况我今当手足情!”一视同仁庶出的，而且才能平平的堂姐妹。 这首歌肯定的是迎春这个红楼大院悲剧小人物的地位，但提升的却是宝玉个人的魅力。一个一生都不走运的女孩，又这样凄惨地离去，是很容易被人忘却的，但宝玉没有忘记她，读者也因此增加了一份对宝玉特别的尊重。 紫菱洲歌在”红楼梦”第七十九回出现的时候，大院里繁荣欢乐的莺歌燕舞已经结束，姑娘们嫁的嫁，亡的亡，家族败相已现。曹雪芹让宝玉借悼迎春写下这首歌，实际上在警示世人，无论奢华还是贫穷，无论红朝黑都，一切都会过去，只有友情和亲情才会在心底永存。
180b29802233835eb861a13e0e93649d33926037.translatedText: Tucson Huiming Zilingzhou is Jia Yingchun's residence in the Red Mansion Courtyard. Because Baochai used Lingzhou as Yingchun's pen name in the Poetry Society, Zilingzhou has an inseparable relationship and complex with Yingchun. Let’s first talk about Jia Yingchun’s background. Yingchun's father is Jia She, and she is a biological brother to Jia Zheng (Baoyu's father). If we don't mention the reason why her mother is a concubine, she is at least cousin to Baoyu. In addition, she has been rubbing shoulders with Baoyu and the girls since she was a child. Although her relationship is not as good as Yuanchun (Baoyu's biological sister) and Tanchun (Baoyu's half-sister), she still has a deep relationship with Baoyu. But the temperament of the second lady of the Jia family is very different from that of the eldest lady Yuanchun and the third lady Tanchun. She is not very old, but she seems to have seen through all the worldly affairs. She doesn't get angry when things are stolen, she doesn't feel pain when she is pricked by a needle, and writing a poem is like plain water. Girls often do riddles but she has never guessed them. I heard that she can play chess, but I have never seen her win against anyone. The young boy named Xing'er dared to call the second young lady of the Jia family "Er Mu", but he never saw her feel inferior and pity for her unlucky and lack of talent. This shows Yingchun’s indifferent character. The formation of Yingchun's temper is related to her father Jia She, who is not proud of herself. This father not only makes people not proud, but also makes people ashamed. Although Jia She was the eldest son of Jia Mu, he neither pursued a career in officialdom nor did he seek profit from business. Even when he was old, he would look askance at young maids and had no other skills except focusing on their looks. This kind of person is frowned upon in any society. With such a father, how can he hold his head high in the Red Mansion Courtyard during the Spring Festival! This father even married his daughter Yingchun to an officer who was born in the army to pay off his debt. As a result, Yingchun was tortured to death a year after her marriage. Lack of talent and low status have always been excuses for being discriminated against. In the Red Mansion Courtyard, this is an unspoken rule that everyone knows very well. But as a lover, Baoyu never thinks so. His famous saying, "Daughters are flesh and blood made of water, men are flesh and blood made of mud" has made countless female readers feel very familiar. Baoyu is worthy of women's respect for him, because in his heart, "the word 'daughter' is extremely noble and pure, even more noble than the auspicious animals, rare birds, exotic flowers and plants." In his world, it is daughters who are "refreshing"; men are all "stinky". Therefore, girls have never had a high or low status for him. He doesn't care whether you are a concubine or a maid. Therefore, after Yingchun passed away, Baoyu came to Zilingzhou Courtyard, saw the old things, and was filled with emotion. He wrote the song of Zilingzhou in memory of Yingchun. The autumn wind in the pond was cold one night, and the red jade shadows of lotus flowers were blown away. Victory is sad, heavy dew is heavy on the slender stems. I can't hear the sound of playing chess in the eternal day, and the chessboard is stained with mud. The ancients said farewell to friends, but now I treat them as brothers!" I treat cousins who are common people and have average talents. This song affirms the status of Yingchun, a tragic little figure in the Red Mansion Courtyard, but it enhances Baoyu's personal charm. It is easy for people to forget a girl who was unlucky in her life and passed away so miserably, but Baoyu did not forget her, and the readers also gained special respect for Baoyu. When Zilingzhou Song appeared in the 79th chapter of "Dream of Red Mansions", the prosperous and joyful Yinggeyanwu in the courtyard had ended, girls were getting married and dying, and the family was in ruins. Cao Xueqin asked Baoyu to write this song to mourn and welcome the spring. In fact, it is a warning to the world that no matter luxury or poverty, no matter prosperous or dark, everything will pass, and only friendship and family love will last forever in the heart.

ecf71fc435d59810d317fc8c2d0152ae324ebbff.translatedText: —— Remember the modern Chinese school in Alberta Report on participating in the 2018 Chinese Orchestra Spring Festival Gala

2275e2161fe39da5f83dd09c51d234a9a038624a.sourceText: (亚省现代中文学校 讯) 欢声笑语辞旧岁，喜聚一堂贺新春。农历新年伊始，我校应凤凰城中华乐团的邀请，参加了当地华人一年一度的春节晚会的演出。
2275e2161fe39da5f83dd09c51d234a9a038624a.translatedText: (Alberta Modern Chinese School News) Say goodbye to the old year with joy and joy, and happily gather together to celebrate the new year. At the beginning of the Lunar New Year, our school was invited by the Phoenix Chinese Orchestra to perform at the local Chinese annual Spring Festival Gala.

a796a9a949f66746e3e1a45983ee32792d298b65.sourceText: 大年初二下午7点整，凤凰城中华乐团春节晚会在坦佩市艺术中心（ Tempe Center for the Arts ）拉开了序幕。让观众们激动的是，亚省现代中文学校的童声合唱团和校乐队为春晚带来了开场第一个节目！流光溢彩的炫目舞台，别出心裁的开场演出，让全场掌声雷动！参加童声合唱和朗诵演出的同学们，尤其是女孩子们，她们身着大红色上衣，两条马尾辫系着大红色绸带，显得分外喜庆吉祥！开场诗朗诵” 新年到，放鞭炮，噼噼啪啪真热闹” ，六个可爱的小同学声音清晰响亮、一口流利的标准普通话，突显了我们中文学校在海外中文教育中保持的一流水准！紧接着十几位小同学和成人合唱团合唱了海内外华人家喻户晓，曾获20世纪华人音乐十大经典之一的歌曲《北风吹》。经过改编的乐曲，在我校乐队的激情演奏下，童声的稚嫩清澈和成人合唱队的喉清韵雅有如渔舟唱晚般应答如流，曲罢余音绕梁，令人久久回味！
a796a9a949f66746e3e1a45983ee32792d298b65.translatedText: At 7:00 pm on the second day of the Lunar New Year, the Phoenix Chinese Orchestra’s Spring Festival Gala kicked off at the Tempe Center for the Arts. What excited the audience was that the children's choir and school band of the Alberta Modern Chinese School presented the first program of the Spring Festival Gala! The dazzling stage and the unique opening performance made the audience burst into applause! The students who participated in the children's chorus and recitation performances, especially the girls, were dressed in bright red tops with two ponytails tied with bright red ribbons, looking extremely festive and auspicious! The opening poem recited "New Year is here, set off firecrackers, the crackling is really lively." The six cute little students' voices were clear and loud, and they spoke fluent standard Mandarin, which highlighted the first-class standard our Chinese school maintains in overseas Chinese education! Then more than a dozen primary school students and an adult choir sang the song "The North Wind Blows", which is a household name among Chinese at home and abroad and one of the top ten classics of Chinese music in the 20th century. The adapted music, under the passionate performance of our school band, the tender and clear children's voices and the clear and elegant throats of the adult chorus responded like a fishing boat singing at night.

d175d8d97c8501e90a54f519760c86507a2610c9.sourceText: 作为亚省华人社区活动的中坚力量，现代中文学校和华人社区主流团体，特别是中华乐团等艺术团体组织长期保持共建互助的友好关系。此次参演不仅向整个社区展示了我们中文教学的成果，也帮助学生深入体会中国的新 年 文化，同时也和本地其它华人团体一起积极推广亚裔传统文化！
d175d8d97c8501e90a54f519760c86507a2610c9.translatedText: As the backbone of Chinese community activities in Alberta, Modern Chinese Schools and mainstream groups in the Chinese community, especially art groups such as the Chinese Orchestra, have long maintained a friendly relationship of co-construction and mutual assistance. Participating in this performance not only showcases the results of our Chinese teaching to the entire community, but also helps students deeply understand the Chinese New Year culture. At the same time, it also actively promotes traditional Asian culture with other local Chinese groups!

2a2834f82aa5af86a778d94b4bc11327b057a89e.sourceText: 感谢亚省现代中文学校陶世诚董事长、王玉兰校长的大力支持以及演出组委会的田韶微副校长和高京京、吕丽华老师的精心组织！感谢中华乐团苗玉良团长的盛情邀请。感谢各位家长及义工的热情参与！感谢参加朗诵和合唱团的全体成员！感谢蔡善皋老师及全体乐队成员，还有我们的摄影师！
2a2834f82aa5af86a778d94b4bc11327b057a89e.translatedText: >Thanks to Chairman Tao Shicheng and Principal Wang Yulan of the Alberta Modern Chinese School for their strong support, as well as Vice Principal Tian Shaowei and teachers Gao Jingjing and Lu Lihua of the performance organizing committee for their careful organization! Thanks to Director Miao Yuliang of the Chinese Orchestra for the kind invitation. Thank you to all parents and volunteers for your enthusiastic participation! Thank you to everyone who participated in the reading and choir! Thank you to teacher Cai Shangao and all the band members, as well as our photographer!

b11761713526819e2dfc3d056bbb1e3acb6a9974.sourceText: 2013-3-5 Chandler, AZ）Sonoran Desert 春天的脚步近了，孩子们期盼的快乐春假就要在美丽的三月拉开帷幕。从2013年3月11日到3月22日为期两周的时间里，新东方艺术学校（www. eaaAZ.com）为孩子们精心准备了快乐、有益的春假艺术课堂。一方面让重视孩子教育的爸爸妈妈放心：春假里孩子们远离电视和电游，在新东方丰富的艺术课堂中度过春假，并且每天应用标准中文，春假教育不缩水！也让孩子们开心：新东方的春假艺术课堂有音乐、舞蹈、武术、手工……当然还会结识很多好朋友！
b11761713526819e2dfc3d056bbb1e3acb6a9974.translatedText: 2013-3-5 Chandler, AZ) Sonoran Desert Spring is approaching, and the happy spring break that children look forward to will begin in the beautiful March. During the two-week period from March 11 to March 22, 2013, New Oriental Art School (www. eaaAZ.com) carefully prepared a happy and beneficial spring break art class for the children. On the one hand, it reassures parents who value their children’s education: During the spring break, children stay away from TV and video games, spend the spring break in New Oriental’s rich art classes, and use standard Chinese every day, so the spring break education will not be reduced! It also makes the children happy: New Oriental’s spring break art classes include music, dance, martial arts, crafts... and of course you will make many good friends!

e2d5b02766aadf5656a3e2c3cc4841d02e758d5e.sourceText: 新东方春假课程的设置方面，应大家的要求，今年将继续突出每日的中文课堂。老师根据学生中文程度，在每天的春假课堂中加强中文。课堂上多说、多练；并有每课适量的书写作业。在中文之外的艺术课程中，学校老师也应用标准的中文授课；积极鼓励和引导孩子们的中文表达。
e2d5b02766aadf5656a3e2c3cc4841d02e758d5e.translatedText: In terms of setting up New Oriental’s spring break courses, in response to everyone’s requests, this year we will continue to highlight daily Chinese classes. Teachers strengthen Chinese in daily spring break classes based on students' Chinese proficiency. Talk more and practice more in class; and have an appropriate amount of writing homework in each lesson. In art courses other than Chinese, school teachers also use standard Chinese teaching; actively encourage and guide children's Chinese expression.

2be2ea6f3bdda7f5db640e07f5e384eee596d0b2.sourceText: 新东方的艺术课堂的另一个主旨是让孩子们动起来学习，而不只是坐在那儿学习。由新东方专业舞蹈教员教授的健身形体课让学生们在节奏中动起来，加强体能，提高协调能力和对自身体态的自信心。
2be2ea6f3bdda7f5db640e07f5e384eee596d0b2.translatedText: Another theme of New Oriental's art classes is to allow children to move and learn instead of just sitting there and learning. The fitness class taught by New Oriental's professional dance teachers allows students to move to the rhythm, strengthen their physical fitness, improve their coordination skills and confidence in their own body posture.

3c0f2e6abb0fb8f15ed1582d58dbab42a326be51.sourceText: 另外一个”动起来学”的春假课程是武术基础课。武术课由亚利桑那少林文化中心的专业老师来授。没有学过武术的同学们可以体验、并打下坚实的武术基础；资深的学员可以在专业老师的指导下继续磨练个人的武术技艺。
3c0f2e6abb0fb8f15ed1582d58dbab42a326be51.translatedText: Another "Move to Learn" spring break course is the basic martial arts course. Martial arts classes are taught by professional teachers from the Arizona Shaolin Cultural Center. Students who have never studied martial arts can experience and lay a solid foundation in martial arts; experienced students can continue to hone their personal martial arts skills under the guidance of professional teachers.

8babb6296668f27883e5c92c0ddc6b17b1899b05.sourceText: 其他的艺术课程还包括：美术课，音乐基础，手工制作等课程。
8babb6296668f27883e5c92c0ddc6b17b1899b05.translatedText: >Other art courses include: art classes, music basics, handicrafts and other courses.

a47b8cf2cd9db92e429813b2f95898d3910d6079.sourceText: 答: 很多资讯都可以在互联网上免费取得，像是: www.CrimeReports.com 、www.FamilyWatchDog.us 这两个网站，只要输入您想查询的房屋地址，便会以地图的方式显示出附近的 犯罪活动地点、性罪犯的照片、罪行及住家地址等资料，至于地区的经济、人口状况，则可以在www.BestPlaces.net 这个网站中找到资讯。

6a031e9ef66eec04ce6ffb59f8faf8da4bef4dae.sourceText: 答: 这是一种权利转让的契​​约，用于让与人对房屋产权、利益、所有权的转让，但不包括任何让与者依法有效的利益或所有权。
