40fd8d50c96ef7893c0a25be2b3224a9b8974724.sourceText: (凤凰城龙冈通讯)承蒙罗省龙冈亲义公所诚挚的邀请，三月廿日，凤凰城龙冈亲义公所主席张肇鸿，率团十三人前往洛杉矶，参加罗省龙冈公所的盛大春宴。 春宴在着名的唐人街金龙大酒家举行，筵开近七十席。是晚星光熠熠，高朋满座，不少亲朋好友温馨见面。凤鳯城龙冈全体成员得到加州美联邦众议员赵美心的亲切慰问，并一起拍摄留念。美洲龙冈亲义总公所主席张国钦，前任主席关健中，总公所监督、龙冈季刊社长关宗鲁，美国龙冈亲义总公所主席关子燕，罗省龙冈亲义公所主席关质聪等等(多不胜数) ，对凤凰城龙冈今年筹办美洲恳亲大会给予大力鼓励和支持。张肇鸿把保存数十年来美洲、美国、罗省等龙冈活动的历史相片出示与众同乐，宾主相谈甚欢。 凤凰城龙冈与罗省龙冈渊源久远，现任世界龙冈总会会长关宗任的外公张喜沾，原来也是罗省龙冈会馆的创会人之一。关宗任 代表凤凰城龙冈祝贺团上台致辞。他感谢罗省兄弟公所的热诚邀请和盛情招待，并向大家介绍了凤凰城筹办恳亲大会的准备工作，热情欢迎各兄弟公所踊䠰参加今年十月，在凤凰城召开的美洲龙冈第廿一届恳亲大会。 罗省龙冈春宴办得非常成功，皆因关主席领导有方，全体成员一致努力的结果。尤其开场那四座代表刘、关、张、赵姓的彩狮，龙腾虎跃，生气勃勃，寓意着龙冈会务昌隆，更上层楼！这次春宴准备周全，场面隆重，招呼入微，菜式精美，节目精采，也为我们筹办恳亲大会提供了宝贵的经验。 翌日，凤凰城龙冈一行拜会了罗省龙冈公所，向四先祖上香，向兄弟公所取经，并与各位叔伯婶母聚会交谈，受到了亲切的接待。这次赴罗省的成员包括有：关宗任、张肇鸿、刘沃彪、 刘邓婉仪、刘全知、刘陈爱卿、刘邓情芬、刘丽华、张华芳、张慧美、邱顺雄及其家人等。
40fd8d50c96ef7893c0a25be2b3224a9b8974724.translatedText: (Phoenix City Longgang News) Thanks to the sincere invitation of the Longgang Qinyi Office of Luo Province, on March 20th, Zhang Zhaohong, chairman of the Longgang Qinyi Office of Phoenix City, led a delegation of 13 people to Los Angeles to attend the grand spring banquet of the Longgang Office of Luo Province. The spring banquet was held at the famous Golden Dragon Restaurant in Chinatown, with nearly seventy guests. It was a star-studded evening, the house was full of guests, and many relatives and friends met warmly. All members of Fengcheng Longgang received cordial condolences from California US Congressman Zhao Meixin and took photos together. Zhang Guoqin, chairman of Longgang Friendship and Friendship Association of America, former chairman Guan Jianzhong, Guan Zonglu, director of the general office and president of Longgang Quarterly, Guan Ziyan, chairman of Longgang Friendship and Friendship Association of America, Guan Zhicong, chairman of Longgang Friendship and Friendship Association of Luo Province, etc. (too numerous to mention), have given strong encouragement and support to Phoenix Longgang in organizing the Americas Friendship Conference this year. Zhang Zhaohong showed the historical photos of Longgang activities in the United States, the United States, Luo Province and other places over the past decades to entertain the audience, and the guests and hosts had a great time chatting. Phoenix City Longgang has a long history with Longgang, Luo Province. Zhang Xizhan, the grandfather of Guan Zongren, the current president of the World Longgang Association, was originally one of the founders of the Longgang Association of Luo Province. Guan Zongren delivered a speech on behalf of the Phoenix Longgang congratulatory group. He thanked the Luo Brothers Office for their sincere invitation and warm hospitality, and introduced to everyone the preparations for Phoenix City’s preparations for the marriage conference. He warmly welcomed all brothers’ offices to participate in the 21st Dragon Boat Festival of the Americas, which will be held in Phoenix this October. The Longgang Spring Banquet in Luo Province was very successful, all due to Chairman Guan's effective leadership and the concerted efforts of all members. Especially the four colorful lions at the beginning, representing the surnames Liu, Guan, Zhang and Zhao, are full of vigor and vitality, which means that the Longgang Conference is prosperous and going to the next level! This spring banquet was well prepared, grand, with attentive greetings, exquisite dishes, and exciting programs. It also provided us with valuable experience in preparing for the wedding. The next day, Phoenix City Longgang and his party visited the Longgang Office of Luo Province, offered incense to the four ancestors, learned from the brother offices, and gathered and talked with uncles and aunts, and received a cordial reception. The members who went to Luo Province this time include: Guan Zongren, Zhang Zhaohong, Liu Wobiao, Liu Dengwanyi, Liu Quanzhi, Liu Chen Aiqing, Liu Dengqingfen, Liu Lihua, Zhang Huafang, Zhang Huimei, Qiu Shunxiong and their families.

81dc75e7598df570350bbb1856a848db78710564.sourceText: 贫贱夫妻百事哀？研究：缺钱会削弱婚姻 （亚省时报） 一项新的研究提示，低收入男女结婚可能性较小而且比有钱的夫妇更容易离婚，导致这种情况的有金钱问题、酗酒和毒品使用等社会和经济方面的因素。加州大学洛杉矶分校的研究人员还发现，较低收入的人与那些高收入者对婚姻制度有着类似的看法，而且他们在婚姻的浪漫标准方面也类似。 据报告作者披露，这些发现提示，强化低收入人群婚姻关系的努力应该超越对婚姻价值的宣扬，其重点应该聚焦于低收入人群所面临的问题。该研究报告将发表在最近一期的《婚姻与家庭杂志》上。 文章的共同作者特雷尔在新闻发布会上说，在过去的15年中，解决低收入配偶中婚姻比例的下降及离婚率的增长的各种努力受到了一些有关低收入者较少结婚及他们有着较高的婚姻失败率的假设的导引。我们的研究目的就是为了将虚构与现实区分开来。 特雷尔与同事卡尼对电话调查的回应进行了分析。这些调查的资料来自佛罗里达州、加利福尼亚州、纽约州和德克萨斯州的6000多人，他们的平均年龄为45岁。 与较高收入者相比，低收入者有着类似的婚姻观，他们不容易同意离婚，而且更可能看重婚姻中的经济方面，其中包括丈夫和妻子是否有好的工作。
81dc75e7598df570350bbb1856a848db78710564.translatedText: Poor couples are miserable? Study: Lack of money weakens marriages (Alberta Times) Low-income men and women are less likely to get married and more likely to divorce than wealthy couples, a new study suggests, citing social and financial factors such as money problems, alcohol and drug use. The UCLA researchers also found that people with lower incomes had similar views about the institution of marriage as those with higher incomes, and they also held similar romantic standards for marriage. According to the report's authors, these findings suggest that efforts to strengthen marriages among low-income people should go beyond promoting the value of marriage and focus on the problems faced by low-income people. The study will be published in a recent issue of the Journal of Marriage and Family. Terrell, co-author of the article, said in a news release that over the past 15 years, various efforts to address the decline in the proportion of marriages among low-income couples and the increase in divorce rates have been guided by assumptions that low-income people marry less often and that they have higher rates of marriage failure. The purpose of our research is to separate fiction from reality. Terrell and his colleague Carney analyzed responses to the telephone survey. The surveys were based on more than 6,000 people in Florida, California, New York and Texas, with an average age of 45. Compared with higher-income earners, lower-income earners have similar views on marriage. They are less likely to agree to divorce and are more likely to value the financial aspects of marriage, including whether the husband and wife have good jobs.

3b1cd2929a58d26c7d2aa9aed5d34f9faf891276.sourceText: ”华语在海外受到热捧，作为炎黄子孙，推广华文教育义不容辞。”10日，来自马来西亚的亚洲国际教科研集团总裁叶潍鸣向记者表示。
3b1cd2929a58d26c7d2aa9aed5d34f9faf891276.translatedText: "The Chinese language is very popular overseas. As a descendant of the Chinese people, it is our duty to promote Chinese education." On the 10th, Ye Weiming, president of Asia International Education and Research Group from Malaysia, told reporters.

04997a903e6d7b31560a3a2cdd524c6458bda6e4.sourceText: 当天，由中国华文教育基金会主办、湖北省外事侨务办公室承办的”2017海外红烛故乡行棗湖北荆楚文化之旅”在武汉启动。
04997a903e6d7b31560a3a2cdd524c6458bda6e4.translatedText: On the same day, the "2017 Overseas Red Candle Hometown Tour Hubei Jingchu Cultural Tour" sponsored by the China Chinese Education Foundation and hosted by the Hubei Provincial Foreign Affairs and Overseas Chinese Affairs Office was launched in Wuhan.

0fff39f5f2e9a38abec6d52f16cf0dececd3d813.sourceText: 现年48岁的叶潍鸣是马来西亚第五代华裔。他告诉记者，父辈从小教育他，炎黄子孙不能忘祖，要尽己所能传承中华文化。1995年，他筹办了亚洲语言学院。
0fff39f5f2e9a38abec6d52f16cf0dececd3d813.translatedText: Yip Weiming, 48, is the fifth generation Chinese in Malaysia. He told reporters that his parents taught him since childhood that descendants of the Yan and Huang Dynasties should not forget their ancestors and should do their best to pass on Chinese culture. In 1995, he organized the Asian Language Institute.

3c97d3eef7e84611f41ce359153f32dde959ae75.sourceText: 虽然遭遇过文化差异、资金、师资、教材等困境，但是他始终坚守在华文教育阵营。20多年过去了，亚洲语言学院发展成为亚洲国际教科研集团。
3c97d3eef7e84611f41ce359153f32dde959ae75.translatedText: Although he has encountered difficulties such as cultural differences, funding, teachers, and teaching materials, he has always stuck to the Chinese education camp. More than 20 years have passed, and the Asian Language Institute has developed into the Asian International Education and Research Group.

18b9e0c9147cbb97b1a2aa0943b0be320fb04bbf.sourceText: 据叶潍鸣介绍，至今其集团拥有32家子公司，200多个华文教师，4000多名学生；在泰国开办有华文语言培训学院，在印度尼西亚开办有200余所汉语学院；3年前，其集团与马来西亚官方合作，每年保送300余名非华裔学生到中国学习汉语。
18b9e0c9147cbb97b1a2aa0943b0be320fb04bbf.translatedText: According to Ye Weiming, his group currently has 32 subsidiaries, more than 200 Chinese teachers, and more than 4,000 students; it has a Chinese language training college in Thailand and more than 200 Chinese language colleges in Indonesia; three years ago, its group cooperated with the Malaysian government to send more than 300 non-Chinese students to China to learn Chinese every year.

0c18acf612e9cf5327173c6464d83f0884f450f4.sourceText: 在66岁的赖美清看来，语言通和文化通，对于民心相通至关重要，而语言通要从娃娃抓起。多年来，她担任汉语教师，游走于各学校讲学。
0c18acf612e9cf5327173c6464d83f0884f450f4.translatedText: In the view of 66-year-old Lai Meiqing, language proficiency and cultural proficiency are crucial to people-to-people communication, and language proficiency should start from childhood. For many years, she has served as a Chinese teacher and travels to various schools to give lectures.

fb29ede04c858e456169620fb33d42878072f75a.sourceText: 2010年，她与一位华人朋友合伙创办了泰国启智幼儿园，教授中文、泰文等。她表示，”汉语热”中华文化热”持续升温，作为华人她感到非常自豪。泰国现有的师资数量、能力已难以满足需求，希望中国多派些训练有素的教师、提供统一的课本，助推泰国华文教育发展。
fb29ede04c858e456169620fb33d42878072f75a.translatedText: In 2010, she co-founded Thailand Qizhi Kindergarten with a Chinese friend, teaching Chinese, Thai, etc. She said that the "Chinese language craze" and "Chinese culture craze" continue to heat up, and she is very proud to be Chinese. The current number and ability of teachers in Thailand can no longer meet the demand. She hopes that China will send more well-trained teachers and provide unified textbooks to promote the development of Chinese education in Thailand.

441e554e89a8185d69335999961ccd71be33d67c.sourceText: ”华侨华人的后代不会讲华语，该是一件多么可怕的事情。”日本横滨中华学院理事长梁庆安是一名老华侨，从事华文教育已近30年。
441e554e89a8185d69335999961ccd71be33d67c.translatedText: " What a terrible thing it is for the descendants of overseas Chinese who cannot speak Chinese. "Liang Qing'an, chairman of the Chinese Academy of Yokohama, Japan, is an old overseas Chinese who has been engaged in Chinese education for nearly 30 years.

4ed697437013f97e773add0cb69ff842e330995e.sourceText: 如今72岁的他依然坚守在华文教育一线。”希望以己之力，增强后代对中华文化认同感和祖(籍)国的归属感。”梁庆安表示。
4ed697437013f97e773add0cb69ff842e330995e.translatedText: Now at the age of 72, he still sticks to the front line of Chinese education." He hopes to use his own efforts to enhance future generations' sense of Chinese cultural identity and sense of belonging to their ancestral country. " Liang Qing'an said.

2b43f9657e2c4e6ae05290778b66ea53cad5a6a9.sourceText: 为期10天的荆楚文化之旅，共有来自马来西亚、日本、泰国、西班牙等国家的15名华文教师参加。在鄂期间，他们将赴武汉、宜昌、荆州等地考察。

91b55b926968b3f665f4f0146b3d40145d9c3c00.sourceText: 中国华文教育基金会项目二部主任李晓梅表示，海外华文教师为华文教育事业做出了突出贡献，希望通过”海外红烛故乡行”激发其传承中华文化的热忱。(完)
91b55b926968b3f665f4f0146b3d40145d9c3c00.translatedText: Li Xiaomei, director of the second project department of the China Chinese Education Foundation, said that overseas Chinese teachers have made outstanding contributions to the cause of Chinese education and hope to inspire their enthusiasm for inheriting Chinese culture through the "Overseas Red Candle Hometown Tour" (End).

cf5f68c2f662c5883ff099cc4fa2fa1a14c3aac0.sourceText: 我所在的神经内科，是全国首屈一指的重点科室，当年大学毕业分来这里觉得专家个个都是牛人，崇拜得五体投地。慢慢地在临床上轮转，当住院医师，我的确得到了相当严格和高端的神经内科医师培训，患者都是全国各地慕名来求最终诊断的，专家们的诊断水平跟国际相差无几，甚至超过国外（中国人多，病种多，所以在这里见识也多）。但是这仅仅是诊断，神经内科能明确诊断的病大概三分之一，在这三分之一里能治疗的估计是三分之一，神经科往往可以运用各种先进的诊断技术来确诊病因，但由于疑难杂症多，往往只能获得一个笼统的治疗方向，而难以建立个体化治疗，所以有着所谓”重诊断轻治疗”行业传统，治疗捉襟见肘。我时常胡思乱想，号称科学先进的现代医学就是这样治病救人的吗？
cf5f68c2f662c5883ff099cc4fa2fa1a14c3aac0.translatedText: The Department of Neurology where I work is one of the leading key departments in the country. When I came here as a college graduate, I felt that all the experts were great and I admired them so much. Slowly rotating through clinical practice and becoming a resident physician, I did receive quite rigorous and high-end training as a neurologist. Patients came from all over the country to seek final diagnosis. The diagnostic level of the experts was almost the same as that of other countries, and even exceeded that of foreign countries (China has a large number of people and many types of diseases, so there is a lot of experience here). But this is only a diagnosis. About one-third of the diseases that can be clearly diagnosed by neurology are estimated to be one-third that can be treated. Neurology can often use various advanced diagnostic technologies to diagnose the cause. However, due to the many difficult and complicated diseases, it is often only possible to obtain a general treatment direction, and it is difficult to establish individualized treatment. Therefore, there is a so-called "emphasis on diagnosis and light treatment" industry tradition, and treatment is stretched. I often think wildly, is this how modern medicine, which claims to be scientific and advanced, can treat illnesses and save lives?

81ca0df96e79472d1935a860461a16797847586d.sourceText: 进了NICU（神经重症监护室）只三天，我就特别沮丧，每天就是在讨论用多少营养液，用什么抗生素，怎么对症治疗，延长这些昏迷患者的生存期限。我开始怀疑医生的价值：医生到底是干什么的，难道就是这样无休止地维持病人根本没有意义和质量的生命吗？
81ca0df96e79472d1935a860461a16797847586d.translatedText: Only three days after entering the NICU (Neuro Intensive Care Unit), I became extremely frustrated. Every day I was discussing how much nutrient solution to use, what antibiotics to use, and how to treat symptoms to extend the survival period of these comatose patients. I began to doubt the value of doctors: What on earth do doctors do? Is it to endlessly maintain patients’ lives that have no meaning or quality at all?

b072e1cc7c21286e7ed914b351bbcb84d461ac45.sourceText: 我永远记得当一年住院医轮转内科遇到的那个肺癌患者，她刚刚30岁，患晚期肺癌，胸廓变形了，头上有两处颅骨转移，包着白纱布。她整整三个月没有平躺着睡过一觉，只能抱着枕头端坐，间或眯眼打盹。她那位可敬的爱人没日没夜地守着她。我值班的那天，她爱人来找我，说她疼得厉害。我忙去看她，情况已经是相当惨烈：她的血压全靠药物维持（医学上就是临终状态了），每日几乎不进食，整个人都浮肿了，呈现出一种透明的白净，可以透过薄薄的皮肤看见她孱弱的血管仍在顽强地搏动。我听了她的肺，全是痰鸣音，她却没有一点力气咳出来，只能靠护士吸痰，但每吸一次都极度痛苦。肿瘤让她疼痛得神志不清，普通的止痛药无济于事，只能打度冷丁，至此我才相信书上记载的癌性疼痛有多厉害。
b072e1cc7c21286e7ed914b351bbcb84d461ac45.translatedText: I will always remember the lung cancer patient I met during my one-year residency rotation in the internal medicine department. She was just 30 years old, suffering from advanced lung cancer, her chest was deformed, and there were two skull metastases on her head, which were wrapped in white gauze. She hadn't slept on her back for three whole months. She could only sit upright with her pillow in her arms, and occasionally squinted her eyes and dozed off. Her worthy lover watched over her day and night. The day I was on duty, her lover came to me and said she was in severe pain. I rushed to see her, and the situation was already quite tragic: her blood pressure was maintained entirely by medication (medically speaking, she was in a terminal state), she barely ate every day, and her whole body was swollen, showing a transparent white color, and her weak blood vessels could be seen through the thin skin, still pulsing tenaciously. I listened to her lungs, which were full of phlegm, but she had no strength to cough it out. She had to rely on the nurse to suction the phlegm, but every time she suctioned, it was extremely painful. The tumor made her so painful that she was delirious. Ordinary painkillers did not help, so she could only take meperidine. Only then did I believe how severe the cancer pain recorded in the book was.

393c0e8de611fe2ca7b5eb8f33df6306fc6514ea.sourceText: 我给了她一支，不是很管用，仍疼得迷迷糊糊。我也不敢再给，不知如何是好。她爱人从冰箱里拿了支冰棍给她，脸上表情极其复杂。在这个寒冷的深夜，暖洋洋的病房里，一口一口地喂她吃冰棍，她像个孩子一样，慢慢地吮吸着，奉如甘饴。于她而言，每一次进食，每一次看见第二天的太阳，都是一种奇迹。
393c0e8de611fe2ca7b5eb8f33df6306fc6514ea.translatedText: I gave her one, but it didn’t work very well and she was still in pain. I don’t dare to give it anymore, I don’t know what to do. Her lover took a popsicle from the refrigerator to her, with an extremely complicated expression on his face. In this cold late night, in the warm ward, she was fed popsicles one by one, and she sucked them slowly like a child, enjoying them as sweet treats. For her, every time she eats and every time she sees the sun the next day, it is a miracle.

fe9f482537ef9bfe00568b2aeb90087a97a83d4e.sourceText: 我每天都会知道她还在消耗维持着，直到那个早已料到却不愿到的中午，抢救现场气氛竟是一种无奈的从容，她爱人不停地给亲友打电话：”我媳妇快不行了，你们打车来吧厖”泣不成声，那种极度压抑悲伤的声音让我简直要窒息了。
fe9f482537ef9bfe00568b2aeb90087a97a83d4e.translatedText: Every day I would know that she was still consuming and sustaining. Until the noon that I had expected but didn’t want to arrive, the atmosphere at the rescue scene was one of helpless calmness. Her lover kept calling relatives and friends: "My wife is dying, you guys can take a taxi." She burst into tears. The extremely depressed and sad voice made me almost suffocated.

43c7a5295724b8738a8026e84fedf5c233c4e959.sourceText: 她已经完全昏迷了，脸肿得厉害，呈现出一种灰白色的”死气”，轻轻地喘息。她终于可以平躺在久违了三个月的床上了，她就在这张她趴了三个月，却从未躺过的床上永远睡去了。年资高的大夫在从容地临终抢救，大家都明白这于她及家人都是一种解脱，但我没法看完整个过程。也许是年资太低，工作还短，心里还留着一条缝棗一条医生不该有的缝，我的整个心都憋得很疼。这是件令人沮丧的事，我拿这件事尽我所能与他人轻描淡写聊了半天，掩饰我这种不符职业情感的心理，而结果却是愈加郁闷。
43c7a5295724b8738a8026e84fedf5c233c4e959.translatedText: > She was completely unconscious, her face was severely swollen, showing a gray-white "dead air", and she was breathing lightly. She could finally lie down on the bed that she had not seen for three months. She slept forever on this bed that she had been lying on for three months but had never laid on. The senior doctor was calmly resuscitating her at the end of her life. Everyone knew that this was a relief for her and her family, but I couldn't watch the whole process. Maybe it's because my seniority is too low and my job is still short. There is still a gap in my heart that a doctor shouldn't have. My whole heart feels very painful. This is a frustrating thing. I tried my best to talk about it with others for a long time to cover up my unprofessional psychology, but the result was even more depressed.

401f4bfd233e18f3413e54fbd14a95316031a881.sourceText: 我还主管过一个患者，她是个 72岁的老人，患脑肿瘤，高颅压、慢性脑疝形成。我们神经内科只能用药降颅压，但是时间长了很快会肾衰的，根本问题（肿瘤）不解决，不可能好转。所以，我们确诊肿瘤之后让家属尽快转科，但是从来不出现的儿子儿媳一听说要出院，就马上来跟我们交涉，似乎把老太太扔在病房，就是进了保险箱了，他们也就尽到了孝心。
401f4bfd233e18f3413e54fbd14a95316031a881.translatedText: I also managed a patient. She was a 72-year-old woman who suffered from brain tumors, high intracranial pressure, and chronic cerebral herniation. Our department of neurology can only use drugs to lower intracranial pressure, but over time, kidney failure will soon occur. Unless the underlying problem (tumor) is solved, it is impossible to get better. Therefore, after we diagnosed the tumor, we asked the family members to transfer to the hospital as soon as possible. However, as soon as the son and daughter-in-law, who had never shown up, heard that he was going to be discharged, they immediately came to negotiate with us. It seemed that they had fulfilled their filial piety by leaving the old lady in the ward and putting her in the safe.

49f49a809a145bd88324151ed9601962d022c7d9.sourceText: 老爷子被这两对小夫妻弄得没了主意，也想赖在神经内科。其实转往神经外科，尽快手术，老太太还是有救的，至少不是目前的等死状态。最后我把嘴皮子说破，终于同意了转科，这样又拖延了一周左右。我当时都恨不得大嘴巴抽那几个矫情的子女，这是为老太太好吗？
49f49a809a145bd88324151ed9601962d022c7d9.translatedText: The old man was confused by these two young couples and wanted to stay in the neurology department. In fact, if she is transferred to neurosurgery and operated on as soon as possible, the old lady can still be saved, at least she is not in the current state of waiting to die. Finally, I spoke out and finally agreed to transfer to another department, which delayed it for another week or so. At that time, I wanted to slap those pretentious children. Is this good for the old lady?

08e513d651c503a61ce594d256f1c7cb27e5b650.sourceText: 不过，现在我渐渐想明白了，普通人对死亡是很恐惧的。他们未必能真正理解死的含义，那是生命最后的尊严，每个人都应该得到死时的尊重和人文关怀，而不是因为生者害怕死别，害怕背上不孝的骂名，就硬要医生盲目延长临终的过程。有希望救的，就应该尽百分百的努力去做，但是无意义的抢救，该舍弃还是应该舍弃。
08e513d651c503a61ce594d256f1c7cb27e5b650.translatedText: However, now I gradually understand that ordinary people are very afraid of death. They may not truly understand the meaning of death, which is the final dignity of life. Everyone should be treated with respect and humanistic care when they die, instead of forcing doctors to blindly prolong the dying process just because the living are afraid of farewell and fear of being stigmatized as unfilial. If there is hope of rescuing, one should make one hundred percent effort, but meaningless rescuing should be given up.

2d8cab04550dfa3abd2e6b37a8879479afa1af33.sourceText: 我工作了十年，见过各种死亡场面，感慨良多。很多病人在急诊室去世时，身上被插着各种管子：输液器、胃管、导尿管、氧气管，甚至是气管插管。最后那一刻，真的是惨不忍睹，既增加了临终者的痛苦，也增加了世人对死亡的恐惧感。亲属盲目追求延长患者毫无质量的生存时间，有时候其实只是为了世俗的所谓”尽孝”。
2d8cab04550dfa3abd2e6b37a8879479afa1af33.translatedText: I have been working for ten years and have seen various death scenes and have a lot of emotions. Many patients die in the emergency room with various tubes inserted into their bodies: IV sets, gastric tubes, urinary catheters, oxygen tubes, and even endotracheal tubes. The last moment was truly horrific, which not only increased the pain of the dying person, but also increased the world's fear of death. Relatives blindly pursue prolonging the patient's quality-free survival time, sometimes just for the sake of the so-called "filial piety" in the world.

639803c18ab992b5904594f6a57cabfe78f91191.sourceText: 我想起我第一次抢救病人时忍不住湿润的红红的眼圈；想起我见过的最孝顺的儿子签署放弃有创抢救他爹后，在地上”梆梆梆”磕的响头；想起患者离去后，家属惨烈干嚎后在门口冷静摊派丧葬费用；想起无耻”医闹”老爹死后不及时入殓，开始盘点医护失误准备官司，面对生死真是众生百态，人性毕现。
639803c18ab992b5904594f6a57cabfe78f91191.translatedText: I think of the red eyes that couldn’t help but moisten when I rescued a patient for the first time; I think of the most filial son I’ve ever seen making a “bang bang bang” sound on the ground after he signed to give up invasive efforts to rescue his father. I remembered that after the patient passed away, the family members cried out miserably and calmly divided up the funeral expenses at the door; I thought of the shameless "medical trouble" of my father who was not buried in time after his death, and began to take stock of the medical mistakes and prepare for a lawsuit. Faced with life and death, all living beings are in various forms, and human nature is fully revealed.

1dd40030245b2c04cf74b5e4921b87174d327c3c.sourceText: 我有一位英年早逝的大师兄，他气度非凡，大高个子，声如洪钟，是我见过的最博学的神经内科医生，他理解力、记忆力都超强，专业知识（神经解剖、神经病理、神经生理）和社科知识都超强（历史、政治、文化、艺术）。
1dd40030245b2c04cf74b5e4921b87174d327c3c.translatedText: I have a senior brother who died young. He was an extraordinary man, tall and tall, with a voice as loud as a bell. He was the most knowledgeable neurologist I have ever seen. He had super understanding and memory, and had super professional knowledge (neuroanatomy, neuropathology, neurophysiology) and social science knowledge (history, politics, culture, art).

242293836e55298877a481a6232ccf926f02a07c.sourceText: 我简直没见过比他更神的神经科医生。他看病，我们这些小字辈的在旁观摩，觉得简直就是一种享受。从查体到诊断、到治疗，从健康指导到心理疏导，让病人觉得宽慰，让我们觉得到位。他给大家讲课，旁征博引，口吐莲花，思路清楚，特别实用。他没出过一天国门，但是用英文作讲演时，那种地道和流畅，让很多海龟也汗颜。
242293836e55298877a481a6232ccf926f02a07c.translatedText: I simply have never seen a more amazing neurologist than him. When he was seeing a doctor, we juniors were watching, which was a real pleasure. From physical examination to diagnosis to treatment, from health guidance to psychological counseling, patients feel relieved and we feel that we are in place. He gave lectures to everyone, quoted eloquently, spoke lotus words, had clear ideas, and was particularly practical. He has never been out of the country for a day, but when he gives a speech in English, his authenticity and fluency put many turtles to shame.

106c100ee34152ff8a2cea53a6d5fd8669761403.sourceText: 45岁时，他查出肝癌，做了肝移植。他一度还复出，松散地出门诊，经常跟我这个闲云野鹤的人聊，他说他是提前进入耳顺阶段，准备进入随心所欲不逾矩的阶段。我们探讨过工作的目的，他说最低级，工作是为了生存；高一些，工作是为了获得成就感、获得快乐；最高境界，工作什么都不为，就是工作。
106c100ee34152ff8a2cea53a6d5fd8669761403.translatedText: At the age of 45, he was diagnosed with liver cancer and underwent a liver transplant. He even came back for a time and went out to the clinic on a loose basis. He often talked to me, a person who is idle and wild, and he said that he had entered the stage of hearing loss in advance and was ready to enter the stage of doing whatever he wanted without breaking the rules. We discussed the purpose of work, and he said that at the lowest level, work is for survival; at the higher level, work is for a sense of accomplishment and happiness; at the highest level, work is for nothing, just work.

563a18c6b54d5c9dd35c4b35ae519549434ae8a4.sourceText: 他做完肝移植手术一年后，癌细胞再度扩散。他还发消息跟我说，不要担心，他这一型扩散后最高生存期是7个月，他要试试挑战纪录。至今他的这些短信我都舍不得删去。 他的葬礼在八宝山，看到他静静地躺在鲜花中，我悲不能已。他应该没吃什么苦头，他爱人也是医生，放弃了一切有创抢救。师兄总算是可以安静地走了。我后来想通了，默默地跟他说：师兄，你先走一步，大家都会再见面的。
563a18c6b54d5c9dd35c4b35ae519549434ae8a4.translatedText: One year after his liver transplant, the cancer spread again. He also sent me a message telling me not to worry. The maximum survival time after the spread of his type is 7 months. He wanted to try to challenge the record. To this day, I can’t bear to delete these text messages from him. His funeral was in Babaoshan. Seeing him lying quietly among the flowers made me extremely sad. He probably didn't suffer much. His wife was also a doctor and gave up all invasive treatments. Senior brother can finally leave quietly. I figured it out later and said to him silently: Brother, take the first step and we will meet again.

fb5c7eaeda0c44e1c6884a24ed273678182dcfc0.sourceText: 人没有选择出生的权利，但是应该有选择死亡的权利。生如夏花般绚烂，死如秋叶般静美，是我愿。
fb5c7eaeda0c44e1c6884a24ed273678182dcfc0.translatedText: People do not have the right to choose birth, but they should have the right to choose death. Life is as gorgeous as summer flowers, and death is as quiet and beautiful as autumn leaves. This is my wish.

c6c1d37c246397fa9565c499e017651216450933.sourceText: 作者是北京宣武医院主治医师，新浪微博帐号是@莲子清如许。
c6c1d37c246397fa9565c499e017651216450933.translatedText: The author is an attending physician at Beijing Xuanwu Hospital, and his Sina Weibo account is @lianziqingruxu.

9f5b3aaaa768f967f52686b388d31060c7ac4265.sourceText: 非移暂缓递解今生效 联邦提醒勿造假 （亚省时报） 美国移民法规近数十年来的最大变革将于15日起生效。即日起，幼时来美、在美国居住五年以上的15至31岁，但没有合法身分的在学、高中毕业及光荣退役人士，15日起可向美国公民及移民服务局(USCIS)申请暂缓驱逐(Deferred Action for Childhood Arrivals)两年。 这项申请并无时间限制，两年后可申请延长。但暂缓驱逐并非身分合法化，申请人不得离境出国、也不能成为美国公民，只是可以走出惧怕被遣返的阴影，在美国境内工作报税。大约有170万青年非法移民可因此受惠。 这项新规自欧巴马总统突然宣布后，移民局紧锣密鼓在两月后推出实施细则。全美各地移民小区已经开始普设咨询讲座，辅导青年非法移民填写申请表格。 美国公民及移民服务局14日下午公布了专供此类所谓”追梦者”申请的新I-821D表 ( http://www.uscis.gov/USCIS/files /form/i-821d.pdf)，及申请指南( http://www.uscis.gov/USCIS/files/form/i- 821dinstr.pdf )。 USCIS局长梅奥卡斯（Alejandro Mayorkas）14日在记者会中指出，申请人须同时寄出I-821D新表格，以及申请授权工作的I-765表、I-765WS表(也可上移民局官网http://www.uscis.gov下载)，外加所有所需证明文件及申请费465美元。 另外，希望以电子邮件或简讯获知申请讯息者，须再送G-1145表(E-Notificationof Application/Petitioner Acceptance，http://www.uscis.gov/files/form/g-1145.pdf)。 梅奥卡斯说，工作人员已经做好处理潮水般涌来的申请，但这并不代表非移们一定可以得到完全合法的居住权。该局是行使裁量权，对每一个申请都是个案处理。遭否决的都无法再上诉。他并表示，申请没有时间限制，未满15岁的，可以等满15岁时再提出申 请。他说，申请人只要来美时未满16岁，可以是自行来美，当初不必随同父母入境。新办法为鼓励学习，即使目前没有在学，只要申请时在学即符合资格。 国家安全官员称，在潮水般的申请中，有部分申请是造假的，但工作人员一定会将这些造假者揪出。造假问题会威胁到国家安全，并给造假者留下严重的犯罪案底。分析人士指出，这些造假问题将会对奥巴马即将到来的11月总统大选产生极其不良影响。在此之前，应经有共和党人谴责奥巴马绕开国会为非法移民”开后门”提供”庇护”。 批评者称欧巴马此举纯粹是选举买票的选举动作，形同一次未经国会同意的特赦行为，鼓励非法变合法。同时，在美国失业率高达8.3%之际，突然再释出100多万的年轻劳工进入就业市场，等于在此艰难时刻，变相剥夺合法人民的工作机会。 同时也增加政府经办此案的支出，因为都是逐案批准，耗费人力。但国内安全部表示，申请人所缴申请费应可应付支出。 而且即使共和党罗穆尼当选上台后，善待非法移民的欧巴马政策新规仍将继续实施。反对非法移民的华府智库”移民政策中心”主任克果瑞安(Mark Krikorian )表示，罗穆尼上台也不敢取消此一新规，至少对已经申请到暂缓驱逐的人而言是不用担心了。
9f5b3aaaa768f967f52686b388d31060c7ac4265.translatedText: >Deferred Action for Non-immigrant Deportation takes effect today. Federal reminder not to make false claims (Alberta Times) The biggest change in U.S. immigration regulations in recent decades will take effect on the 15th. Effective immediately, people aged 15 to 31 who came to the United States as children and have lived in the United States for more than five years, but who are in school, high school graduates, and honorably discharged without legal status, can apply to the United States Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS) for a two-year Deferred Action for Childhood Arrivals starting from the 15th. There is no time limit for this application and it can be extended after two years. However, the suspension of deportation is not legalization of status. Applicants are not allowed to leave the country or become a U.S. citizen. They can only get over the fear of being deported and work and file taxes in the United States. Approximately 1.7 million young illegal immigrants could benefit from this. Since President Obama suddenly announced this new rule, the Immigration Bureau has been working hard to launch the implementation details two months later. Immigrant communities across the United States have begun to hold counseling sessions to help young illegal immigrants fill out application forms. On the afternoon of the 14th, the United States Citizenship and Immigration Services announced the new I-821D form ( http://www.uscis.gov/USCIS/files /form/i-821d.pdf ) and application guide ( http://www.uscis.gov/USCIS/files/form/i-821dinstr.pdf ) specifically for such so-called "Dream Chaser" applications. USCIS Director Alejandro Mayorkas pointed out at a press conference on the 14th that applicants must also send the new I-821D form, as well as the I-765 form and I-765WS form applying for authorized work (which can also be downloaded from the official website of the USCIS http://www.uscis.gov), plus all required supporting documents and an application fee of US$465. In addition, those who wish to receive application information via email or text message must submit Form G-1145 (E-Notification of Application/Petitioner Acceptance, http://www.uscis.gov/files/form/g-1145.pdf). Mayorkas said that staff are ready to handle the influx of applications, but this does not mean that non-immigrants will definitely get full legal residency. The Bureau exercises its discretion and handles each application on a case-by-case basis. Those who are rejected can no longer appeal. He also said that there is no time limit for application. Those under 15 years old can wait until they turn 15 before applying. He said that as long as the applicant is under 16 years old when coming to the United States, he can come to the United States on his own and does not need to accompany his parents when entering the United States. The new approach is to encourage learning. Even if you are not currently studying, you will be eligible as long as you are studying when you apply. National security officials say some of the influx of applications are fake, but officials will be able to identify the falsifiers. Counterfeiting threatens national security and leaves counterfeiters with serious criminal records. Analysts pointed out that these fraud issues will have an extremely negative impact on Obama's upcoming presidential election in November. Prior to this, some Republicans should have accused Obama of bypassing Congress to "open a back door" and provide "asylum" for illegal immigrants. Critics say Obama's move is purely an electoral move to buy votes, tantamount to an amnesty without the consent of Congress, and encourages the illegal to become legal. At the same time, when the unemployment rate in the United States is as high as 8.3%, the sudden release of more than 1 million young workers into the job market is tantamount to depriving legal people of job opportunities in this difficult time. At the same time, it also increases the government's expenditure on handling the case, because approval is done on a case-by-case basis, which is labor-intensive. However, the Ministry of Homeland Security said the application fee paid by the applicant should be enough to cover expenses. And even after Republican Romney is elected to power, Obama's new policies that are friendly to illegal immigrants will continue to be implemented. Mark Krikorian, director of the Immigration Policy Center, a Washington think tank that opposes illegal immigration, said Romney would not dare to cancel this new rule even after taking office. At least those who have already applied for a stay of deportation will not have to worry.

3d95eb1a3841080e7591b9ed5ed3e2a61c725f80.sourceText: 心水： 望远镜 两座楼阁相距几百公尺，都是三十多层的新住宅单位，夜来丙边窗户放射的灯光相映辉；随着深宵迫近，各个亮丽的框框才先后熄掉电流，让黑色吞噬了 楼内的人影。 李天搬进来后，他喜欢凭窗凝望，墨尔本城中心璀烂的灯火像一幅立体画般悬在左边视线里。 仰首天空宛如被割切的豆腐块，冷月孤星偶然出现，又羞愧的急急奔逃进黑幕。 对面窗内移动的模糊人影勾起他无限的想像，这些困囚在陋室中的各色人等究竟晚间的活动是什么？ 他试图拼凑每幅动感的窗景，去构想自以为是的答案。 对正十八 层的那家。 窗门极少关闭，卧室濶大，平素早早关灯，周末仿佛都开派对，往往到深夜，就只剩一些男女间欢爱的动作，他往往将视线移向左边，又忍不住调回来瞄 一眼，距离远，说不定也只是他的幻想。 太太外向，喜欢推推麻将和跳舞；他好像独处，性格内向，晚上听了古典乐，再神游窗外，日子平淡安适。 夫妻有如朋友，互不干扰，卿卿我我的浓情已随着平凡生活渐渐消失无踪；有时竟相对无言，仿佛火车厢偶然相遇的男女，只要停站也就各奔前程。 『送给你，七折价钱，你可以无聊时拿到天台上观星星。 』她捧着一盒礼物放在他面前，李天感激的说了声谢谢。 打开才知道是整套望远镜，心中一喜，笑竟泛上脸颊，对面窗里迷茫的男女今后就可以求证清楚了。 他左有这种意念，但实在不敢造次，知夫莫若妻，心灵相通，倒非古有诌呢！ 『阿媚！ 今晚周末别去打麻将。 我们厖』 『三缺一，约好了。 』对着大镜穿上黑色底衣裤，她不忘回身向他又说声谢谢，为了报答她送的礼物，他竟一次购了半打她最喜欢的丝质体内衣裤悄悄放在她 枕下。 望着她轻盈的旋着身出门，他有份被冷落的自嘲着苦笑。 音乐的章节空空茫茫，像风声流过，他有点坐卧不宁的焦急。 灯一一开启后，他骤然想起还没启用的望远镜，遂立即冲入书房拿出来，在窗边较好对焦，有种犯罪感的剌击而至，他不敢望向那道窗户。 夜深沉，妻依然未归；对楼只乘下那窗通明的诱惑，男女相拥热吻，李天调正焦距，画面拉近，男背挡住了女人身影，无形陶醉里脚步移向大床 ；女人上衣被脱落，套裙除掉，黑底裤黑乳罩扑上镜片袭击李天的眼睛。 她动手拉上窗帘的刹那，阿媚的五官显现，他一惊放手，望远镜濠出窗外跌下，李天匆匆赶到那边楼阁，充上十八层。 他茫然的望着通道两边八家门户，脸色铁青、、、、、。
3d95eb1a3841080e7591b9ed5ed3e2a61c725f80.translatedText: Favorites: Telescope The two pavilions are several hundred meters apart. They are both new residential units with more than 30 floors. The lights from the windows on both sides complement each other at night. As the night approaches, the bright frames turn off the electricity one after another, allowing the blackness to swallow up the figures inside the buildings. After Li Tian moved in, he liked to stare out of the window. The bright lights in the center of Melbourne hung like a three-dimensional painting in his left field of vision. Looking up at the sky, it looks like a cut piece of tofu. The lonely star of Leng Yue appears by chance, and then rushes into the darkness in shame. The blurry figures moving in the opposite window aroused his endless imagination. What are the activities of these various people trapped in the shabby room at night? He tried to piece together each dynamic window scene to conceive a self-righteous answer. Opposite the house on the 18th floor. The windows and doors are rarely closed, the bedroom is large, the lights are turned off early on weekdays, and there seems to be parties on weekends. Often until late at night, there are only some loving movements between men and women. He often moves his eyes to the left, but can't help but turn back to take a look. It is far away, maybe it is just his fantasy. My wife is outgoing and likes to play mahjong and dance; he seems to be alone and introverted. He listens to classical music at night and then wanders out of the window. His life is peaceful and comfortable. Husband and wife are like friends, they do not interfere with each other, and the affection between each other has gradually disappeared with ordinary life; sometimes they are relatively silent, like a man and a woman who meet by chance in a train car and go their separate ways as soon as they stop. "Giving it to you, it's 30% off the price. You can take it to the rooftop to watch the stars when you're bored. ” She held a box of gifts and placed it in front of him. Li Tian said thank you gratefully. When I opened it, I realized that it was a complete set of telescopes. I felt happy and smiled on my cheeks. The confused man and woman in the opposite window would be able to find out clearly from now on. He had this idea, but he really didn't dare to make a mistake. He knew his husband better than his wife, and had a spiritual connection. This was not an ancient rule! "Amei!" Don't go play mahjong tonight on the weekend. We are so big" "Three of us are missing one, so we have made an appointment. " Putting on her black underwear in front of the big mirror, she didn't forget to turn around and say thank you to him again. In order to repay her for the gift, he actually bought half a dozen of her favorite silk underwear at one time and quietly placed them under her pillow. Watching her spin lightly and go out, he smiled wryly at himself, feeling left out. The music chapters were empty, like the sound of wind passing by, and he felt restless and anxious. After turning on the lights one by one, he suddenly remembered the telescope that had not been used yet, so he immediately rushed into the study to take it out, and focused it better by the window. He felt a sense of guilt, and he did not dare to look at the window. The night was deep, but his wife still hadn't returned; he only took advantage of the temptation of the bright window on the opposite floor, and the man and woman hugged each other and kissed each other passionately. Li Tian adjusted the focus, and the picture zoomed in. The man's back blocked the woman's figure, and he moved towards the big bed in invisible intoxication; the woman's top was taken off, her skirt was removed, and her black bottoms and black bra fell onto the lens and struck Li Tian's eyes. The moment she moved to close the curtains, A Mei's facial features appeared. He was startled and let go. The telescope fell out of the window. Li Tian hurried to the pavilion over there and climbed to the eighteenth floor. He stared blankly at the eight doors on both sides of the passage, his face ashen...

4447962039a80cc22f510745fd7769e496614cf4.sourceText: 彭博给纽约犯轻罪非法移民放行 纽约市长彭博18日签署了两个移民法案，限制纽约市警察局不分轻重把被捕移民移交给移民局。 彭博在签署法案时表示，纽约市很重视移民的贡献，新通过的法案意在将纽约打造成全世界对移民最友好的城市。 彭博还说，新法案是对移民局”安全社区计划”（Secure Communities Program）的直接回应。 自从2012年5月起，移民局在纽约州启动”安全社区计划”，规定纽约市警察必须与移民局合作。当一个人被警察逮捕，警察可以从移民局档案看到此人的移民身份，警察要把被捕人士的指纹转发给移民局，如果当事人是外籍人士，移民局有权要求警察将其暂时扣留，然后把人接走，关进移民拘押所，等候递解出境。 这个计划遭移民权益团体反对，因为有些非法移民只因为违反交通规则或轻微触犯法律而被捕，之后被移民局驱逐出境。 而纽约市政府新法律规定，对一些犯轻罪的人，警方不得将其指纹转交给移民局，包括无驾照驾驶和卖淫，后者经常是人口走私的受害人。 只在以下情况，犯案移民的指纹才被转发给移民局：过去10年里犯过重罪或轻罪，遭刑事通缉，帮派分子，恐怖分子，有驱逐令在身，被指控重罪或某些轻罪包括属性侵，持有枪支，酗酒驾车，违法保护令。
4447962039a80cc22f510745fd7769e496614cf4.translatedText: Bloomberg gave New York a green light for illegal immigrants who committed misdemeanor crimes. New York Mayor Bloomberg signed two immigration bills on the 18th, restricting the New York City Police Department from handing over arrested immigrants to the Immigration Bureau regardless of their severity. When signing the bill, Bloomberg said that New York City attaches great importance to the contributions of immigrants, and the newly passed bill is intended to make New York the most immigrant-friendly city in the world. Bloomberg also said that the new bill is a direct response to the USCIS’s “Secure Communities Program”. Since May 2012, the Immigration Bureau has launched the "Safe Communities Plan" in New York State, stipulating that New York City police must cooperate with the Immigration Bureau. When a person is arrested by the police, the police can see the person's immigration status from the Immigration Bureau file. The police must forward the arrested person's fingerprints to the Immigration Bureau. If the person is a foreigner, the Immigration Bureau has the right to ask the police to temporarily detain the person, then pick him up and put him in an immigration detention center to await deportation. The plan is opposed by immigration rights groups because some illegal immigrants are arrested for traffic violations or minor violations of the law and then deported by immigration authorities. The New York City government's new law stipulates that police are not allowed to transfer the fingerprints of people who have committed some misdemeanors, including driving without a driver's license and prostitution, who are often victims of human smuggling. Fingerprints are forwarded to USCIS only if the immigrant has committed a felony or misdemeanor in the past 10 years, is wanted on a criminal warrant, is a gang member, a terrorist, has a deportation order, has been charged with a felony or certain misdemeanors including sexual assault, possession of a firearm, drunk driving, or violated a protection order.

5f9372b0badcbba048ed053a6ba56d4e4437da52.sourceText: ‘有娘的孩子有人疼’ 三位新任市议员中，当晩就属黄馨民最风光，不仅感受到远在故乡的侨委会委员长指派代表出席与致赠花篮的光荣，驻洛杉矶台北经文处夏季昌处长也致赠花篮道贺，深情厚礼是给黄馨民，但所有台侨分享到这份亲切的温馨。
5f9372b0badcbba048ed053a6ba56d4e4437da52.translatedText: 'A mother's child will be loved' Among the three newly-appointed city councilors, Huang Xinmin was the most popular that night. Not only did he feel the honor of being sent by the Chairman of the Overseas Chinese Affairs Committee in his hometown to attend and present a flower basket, the director of the Taipei Cultural Affairs Office in Los Angeles, Xia Chang, also presented a flower basket to express his congratulations. 987bea689dee98b29bbdd0854efcd636db9d46d1.translatedText: Senior overseas Chinese leaders of traditional overseas Chinese communities, Deng Chaoju, Fang Huixian and representatives of Asian and Chinese descent were also present that night, which also showed that Huang Xinmin has deep connections and won everyone's support and love.

d61ee818f90e0888b4e30851af142b5f546ab80b.sourceText: 如果我现在说讨厌乔布斯，像厌恶希特勒和谁谁谁，相信世界上所有的人会同时停止手指的拨弄，抬起头仇恨地看着我，那齐刷刷的手指让我一下就能体会了什么叫千夫所指。但我确实有厌在心。 大凡世界上有权有钱有地位的人把物质的都得到了，便想在精神上控制人了。那希特勒为了一民族的私欲，杀人无数，犯他国无戒，还让欧洲所有的人都像他的国民那样，见他就斜出手臂，惶恐且严肃呼喊他的名字。但他没想到自以为得意的个人崇拜到柏林被美苏联军攻克后，那林一样的举手致敬都变成了无精打采的投降。 亚洲人也喜欢搞这样的崇拜控制。一个君王在上，无数臣民匍匐在地，不敢发点大气。后来人虽然站起来了，但还要手挥伟人语录，口称万寿无疆才能坐下吃饭。不过，待到一部分和大部分人都富起来的时候，所有的清规戒律都让歌舞升平的酒宴冲垮了，除了朝鲜那个胖子还在坚持慈父领袖的威严外。 看来靠权势来左右人精神的时代已似落花流水了。 但企图用技术继续控制人精神的人却风生水起，层出不穷。那乔布斯就是其中一个。从上个世纪起，那苹果的电脑系统就喜欢标新立异，麻烦得微软老是要放下身段转换再转换，才能求得和谐。但到Iphone的时代，苹果就再也不用看别人的脸色行事了，他知道现在就是在自己脸上抹一条线，别人也会仿着刻一道痕的。他现在有的是市场和拥趸，因为现在放眼世界望去，无论飞机火车，还是汽车，无论是闲着还是忙着，站着做着还是蹲着，人人手头都握一个缺口苹果，或泛喜悦情，或做痛苦状，不一而形。 要说这小乔没给世人带来方便也不是实话。现在拿着个手机就像拿了个通灵宝玉，天文地理无所不知，家长里短无所不晓，哪怕相隔千山万水。但从此人们只会对着手机发微信了，连那一百多字的微博都不愿发了。人人关注的是八卦和遥遥领先之预言，那些经典大论及名著恐怕连名字都被人忘却了。连那些医生科技工作者也在悲哀，以后再也不要搞专业和研究了，只要拿起手机古勾或百度一下，那些五花八门的学问就会从天而降！ 倍遭乔布斯荼毒的莫过于孩子和年青人的心灵了。家长们本着让孩子不要输在起跑线上的信念，给了孩子智能苹果，孩子却一指直捣游戏龙门，灭杀虚幻生灵无数，还自以为英雄。荒废了学业不论，还丧失了爱心、人情和本性。那年轻人也悲，原先求爱追友，还有点诗情画意的文采相助，现在只剩下对着手机说，我爱你，在干啥啦，只会干巴巴的苦求和苦恋了。 可惜，人们认识到了危机，却不愿意舍弃危机，仍然每隔三分钟就拨弄一下手机。 以后的世界究竟怎样，谁都不敢预测。但现在人们看到的是乔布斯脸朝天躺在地下，却让世上成千上万的人低着头，捻着手指，欣赏着他。他实现了乔不死的梦，用技术让所有的人都对死后的他依然顶礼膜拜。 但还有很多的人不喜欢向这缺口苹果低头。那中国四川的家长为了还给孩子青春的学习时代，帮儿子的同班同学每人发一个普通手机，以抵抗乔布斯的游戏 。从矿石收音机、无线发报机走到现在电脑是时代的进步，但走到放弃文化放弃思索的地步，那就聪明被聪明误了。 我也希望人们特别是年轻人还能抬起头来，看看周围的青山绿水，给别人一个温暖的眼神和真诚的拥抱。但今天有谁像当年陈胜吴广振臂一呼天下苦秦久矣，兄弟一定揭竿而起，废了乔不死和他的手机! 为救救孩子，父母是什么事都愿做的。
d61ee818f90e0888b4e30851af142b5f546ab80b.translatedText: If I say now that I hate Jobs, just like I hate Hitler and so-and-so, I believe that all the people in the world will stop fingering at the same time, raise their heads and look at me with hatred. Those fingers that are brushing together let me understand what it means to be pointed at by thousands of people. But I do feel tired. Generally speaking, people with power, money, and status in the world have obtained all material things, and then they want to control people spiritually. For the selfish desires of a nation, Hitler killed countless people and violated the rules of other countries. He also made everyone in Europe do like his citizens, who stretched out their arms when they saw him, and shouted his name in fear and solemnity. But he didn't expect that his proud personal worship would turn into a listless surrender after Berlin was captured by the US and Soviet troops. Asians also like to engage in this kind of worship control. There is a king on top, and countless subjects are prostrate on the ground, not daring to show off. Later, although people stood up, they still had to wave quotes from great men and proclaim longevity before they could sit down to eat. However, when some and most people became rich, all the rules and regulations were washed away by the banquets of singing and dancing, except for the fat man in North Korea who still insisted on the majesty of a fatherly leader. It seems that the era of relying on power to control people's minds has come to an end. However, people who try to use technology to continue to control people's minds are becoming more and more popular. Then Steve Jobs is one of them. Since the last century, Apple's computer systems have liked to be unconventional, making it so troublesome that Microsoft has always had to put aside its efforts to switch and switch again in order to achieve harmony. But in the era of the iPhone, Apple no longer has to look at other people's faces to act. He knows that if he puts a line on his face, others will imitate and carve a mark. He now has a market and fans, because if you look around the world now, no matter whether you are on a plane, train, or car, whether you are idle or busy, standing or squatting, everyone is holding a chipped apple in their hand, either in joy or in pain. It is not true to say that Xiao Qiao has not brought convenience to the world. Holding a mobile phone now is like holding a psychic gem. It knows everything about astronomy and geography, and the parents know everything, even if they are thousands of miles apart. But from now on, people only send WeChat messages to their mobile phones, and they don’t even want to post Weibo posts of more than 100 words. Everyone pays attention to gossip and far-reaching predictions, and those classic treatises and masterpieces may even have been forgotten by people. Even those medical and scientific workers are sad. They will no longer engage in professional studies and research. As long as they pick up Gugou or Baidu on their mobile phones, all kinds of knowledge will fall from the sky! No one was more poisoned by Steve Jobs than the minds of children and young people. Parents gave their children smart apples in the belief that they would not lose at the starting line, but the children went straight to the game, killing countless illusory creatures, and thought they were heroes. They have neglected their studies and lost their love, humanity and nature. The young man was also sad. He used to seek love and pursue friends, and he also used some poetic and artistic talents to help. Now he can only say, I love you to his mobile phone. What is he doing? He can only beg and be in love. It's a pity that people are aware of the crisis but are unwilling to give up the crisis. They still fiddle with their mobile phones every three minutes. No one can predict what the world will be like in the future. But what people see now is Jobs lying on the ground with his face in the sky, but thousands of people around the world are bowing their heads, twirling their fingers, and admiring him. He realized Joe's dream of immortality and used technology to make everyone still worship him after death. But there are still many people who don’t like to bow to this notched apple. In order to give their children a youthful learning period, parents in Sichuan, China, gave each of their son's classmates an ordinary mobile phone to resist Steve Jobs's game. From mineral radios and wireless transmitters to the current computer is the progress of the times, but to the point where we give up culture and give up thinking, then wisdom is mistaken for wisdom. I also hope that people, especially young people, can still raise their heads, look at the green mountains and green waters around them, and give others a warm look and a sincere hug. But if anyone today is like Chen Sheng and Wu Guang who raised their arms and called out the suffering of the Qin Dynasty for a long time, the brothers will definitely rise up and destroy Qiao Busheng and his mobile phone! In order to save their children, parents are willing to do anything.

fd0f64748e5780f2997f00f5b4a39009fd2a600b.sourceText: 沙尘暴洪水接踵而来 这个夏季不平静 上周二晚的一场暴雨，另凤凰城西北的国旗镇和无忧镇陷入混乱。 据说，暴风骤雨带来道路被洪水淹没，大量小树木被连根拔起，无忧镇17号高速公路附近，数辆汽车熄火，消防员从三辆小汽车和一辆卡车中救出九人，包括一名婴儿。所幸无人受伤，无需送往医院医治。 据悉，阵风在国歌镇高达每小时66英里，造成近1500户住宅停电一小时。 亚利桑那州每年的6月15日至9月30日为夏季暴风季节，往年多以雷电夹杂小雨为主，近年来，雷电、暴雨、沙尘暴一样不少。气象专家说，这种极端气象在美国只有本州才有，其他地方，也只是非洲的撒哈拉沙漠和中东部分地方才出现，是干燥和大量沙子聚集而成，跟近年本地干旱有莫大关联。 气象专家呼吁市民，对突然而来的极端天气无需惊慌，沙尘、暴风雨多在傍晚出现，老人、儿童及呼吸道病患应尽量减少此时段出门。
fd0f64748e5780f2997f00f5b4a39009fd2a600b.translatedText: Sandstorms and floods are coming one after another. This summer is not peaceful. A heavy rain last Tuesday night plunged Flag Town and Wuyou Town northwest of Phoenix into chaos. It is said that the storm caused roads to be flooded and a large number of small trees to be uprooted. Several cars stalled near Highway 17 in Wusou Town. Firefighters rescued nine people, including an infant, from three cars and a truck. Fortunately, no one was injured and did not need to be taken to the hospital for treatment. It is reported that wind gusts reached up to 66 miles per hour in the town of Anthem, causing nearly 1,500 residences to lose power for an hour. Arizona's summer storm season lasts from June 15 to September 30 every year. In previous years, thunder and lightning were mostly mixed with light rain. In recent years, there have been a lot of thunder and lightning, heavy rain, and sandstorms. Meteorological experts said that this kind of extreme weather occurs only in this state in the United States. It only occurs in other places, such as the Sahara Desert in Africa and parts of the Middle East. It is caused by dryness and the accumulation of large amounts of sand, and is closely related to the local drought in recent years. Meteorological experts urge citizens not to panic about sudden extreme weather. Dust and storms often occur in the evening. The elderly, children and people with respiratory diseases should try to avoid going out during this time.

038fafd7f0b51817d3893b4b5ef8baf9e238ac12.sourceText: 海外华裔青少年中文教学体会分享-马立平博士主讲 马立平博士毕业于斯坦福大学教育学院，从事海外华裔青少年中文教育探索二十年。她通过教学实践编写出的”马立平”教学材料，受到学生和家长的喜爱我们。学校在2008年开始尝试增加”马立平”教材进行教学。如何将该教材的优势发挥其最大的作用，达到最好的教学效果，一直是学校领导和老师探索的目标。经过学校的努力，我们有幸请到了马立平博士亲自来我校进行培训、演讲。她将利用3月21日这一天，不仅为我们的中文老师做一个培训，而且还将与我们凤凰城地区的华人家长进行交流，帮助家长能够更好地辅助学生学好中文。同日，我们还请到了本地教育专家陈普博士为大家讲解中文AP考试的要点。 现将马立平博士和陈普博士的日程安排公布如下： 日期 时间 地点 参加群体 内容 3月21日 9:00am — 11:00am MCC BP-5 所有中文老师 马立平博士将与老师们分享自己多年的中文教学经验，并解答老师们的疑问。 3月21日 1:00pm–3:00pm MCC BP-5 所有家长 马立平博士阐述她的教学理念，答家长疑问。 陈普博士讲解AP中文要点。 由于阶梯教室座位有限，家长只能凭票进入会场，请有兴趣的家长于2月28日和3月7日这两天到”希望中文学校”办公室领取入场券。这次讲座将面向凤凰城地区所有华人家庭，学校仅提供100张入场券，先到先得，赠完为止。
038fafd7f0b51817d3893b4b5ef8baf9e238ac12.translatedText: Sharing experience in teaching Chinese to overseas Chinese teenagers - Dr. Ma Liping has lectured. Dr. Ma Liping graduated from the School of Education, Stanford University and has been engaged in the exploration of Chinese education for overseas Chinese teenagers for 20 years. The "Ma Liping" teaching materials she compiled through teaching practice are loved by students and parents. In 2008, the school began to try to add "Ma Liping" teaching materials for teaching. How to maximize the advantages of this textbook and achieve the best teaching effect has always been the goal of school leaders and teachers. Through the efforts of the school, we were fortunate enough to have Dr. Ma Liping come to our school to give training and lectures in person. She will use March 21st not only to provide training for our Chinese teachers, but also to communicate with Chinese parents in the Phoenix area to help parents better assist students to learn Chinese well. On the same day, we also invited local education expert Dr. Chen Pu to explain the key points of the Chinese AP exam. The schedule of Dr. Ma Liping and Dr. Chen Pu is now announced as follows: Date Time Venue Participating Group Content March 21 9:00am — 11:00am MCC BP-5 All Chinese teachers Dr. Ma Liping will share his many years of Chinese teaching experience with the teachers and answer their questions. March 21st 1:00pm–3:00pm MCC BP-5 All Parents Dr. Ma Liping explains her teaching philosophy and answers parents’ questions. Dr. Chen Pu explains the key points of AP Chinese. Due to limited seats in the lecture theater, parents can only enter the venue with tickets. Interested parents are asked to go to the "Hope Chinese School" office on February 28 and March 7 to collect their tickets. This lecture will be open to all Chinese families in the Phoenix area. The school only provides 100 tickets, first come, first served, while supplies last.

9a7f609155d75027acbc08e81ed5d5c14c686a4a.sourceText: 立法者涨工资 盼选民开绿灯 （亚省时报） 亚利桑那州选民可能在今秋大选中，就本州议员是否涨工资投票。 选民最后一次就议员年薪投票在1998年，当时批准议员的年薪为15000美元。本次将就是否批准议员们的年薪涨到24000美元。 亚利桑那州每年的议会会期通常只有四个月，反对者认为，议员们在短短四个月内赚了平常人的一年工资，相对来说已经很高。而且，议员们还有其他工作和收入，议会工作只是兼职。 亚省选民已经为议员年薪投票了五次，每次都被否决。本次提案的命运如何？11月大选揭晓。
9a7f609155d75027acbc08e81ed5d5c14c686a4a.translatedText: Legislators raise salaries, hoping for voters’ green light (Alberta Times) Arizona voters may vote on whether to raise the salaries of state legislators in this fall’s general election. Voters last voted on an annual salary for lawmakers in 1998, when they approved an annual salary of $15,000. This time, it will be decided whether to approve an increase in the annual salary of MPs to US$24,000. Arizona's annual legislative session is usually only four months. Opponents believe that in just four months, legislators earn a year's salary of ordinary people, which is relatively high. Moreover, MPs have other jobs and incomes, and parliamentary work is only part-time. Alberta voters have voted five times for MPs' annual salaries, and they have been rejected each time. What is the fate of this proposal? The November election is announced.

61fcf535cdcdf7f99a920e83bb21e7d0d9489072.sourceText: 最佳大学 哈佛、普大并列第一 「美国新闻与世界报导」杂志12日公布今年全美最佳大学排行榜，排名与去年相去不远，哈佛大学一如预料地再度荣登榜首，不过，该校这次是与普林斯顿大学并列第一。 今年的排行榜中，耶鲁大学、哥伦比亚大学和芝加哥大学分居第三、四、五名。麻州麻省理工学院今年位居第六，加州史丹福大学排名第七，北卡州杜克大学与宾州大学则并列第八。 前十名唯一的小变动是，去年与麻省理工学院(MIT)并列第五的加州理工学院(California Institute of Technology)，今年排名下滑，与达特茅斯学院(Dartmouth College)同列第十。 公立学校排名最高的是列名21的柏克莱加州大学，洛杉矶加州大学(UCLA)及南加大紧随在后，接着是维吉尼亚大学、位于安娜堡(Ann Arbor)的密西根大学和教堂山北卡罗来纳大学。
61fcf535cdcdf7f99a920e83bb21e7d0d9489072.translatedText: Best University: Harvard and Princeton University are tied for first place. "U.S. News & World Report" magazine released this year's ranking of the best universities in the United States on the 12th. The rankings are not far from last year. Harvard University once again topped the list as expected, but this time it tied for first place with Princeton University. In this year's rankings, Yale University, Columbia University and the University of Chicago rank third, fourth and fifth respectively. The Massachusetts Institute of Technology in Massachusetts ranked sixth this year, Stanford University in California ranked seventh, and Duke University in North Carolina and the University of Pennsylvania tied for eighth. The only small change in the top ten is that the California Institute of Technology (California Institute of Technology), which was tied for fifth place with MIT last year, has slipped this year and is tied with Dartmouth College (Dartmouth College) for tenth place. The highest-ranked public school is the University of California, Berkeley, ranked 21st, followed by the University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA) and the University of Southern California, followed by the University of Virginia, the University of Michigan in Ann Arbor and the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill.

8272c169370d08bf5e7e83016dd465362e12e89d.sourceText: ９月１４日这个很普通的日子，即将在华人社区变得不再普通，因为上百个亚利桑那的小演员在这一天，将中国舞蹈展示在家人，社区和美国朋友面前。他们中有的孩子只学了几个月，有的坚持了近十年。最小的演员只有三岁多，年纪最大的也有五十多岁。这个舞蹈节，把”中国舞蹈”当做一种最不一样的语言，与观众对话。
8272c169370d08bf5e7e83016dd465362e12e89d.translatedText: September 14th, this very ordinary day, is about to become no longer ordinary in the Chinese community, because on this day, hundreds of young Arizona performers will show Chinese dance in front of their families, communities and American friends. Some of them only studied for a few months, while some persisted for nearly ten years. The youngest actor is only over three years old, and the oldest is over fifty. This dance festival treats "Chinese dance" as the most different language to dialogue with the audience.

74f48f7789213b8d71e014be4782e6ba78e9a5eb.sourceText: 在接近演出临近的日子，新东方艺术学校的老师和孩子们都已是箭在弦上。舞蹈总监邱晓榕老师介绍，本次舞蹈节一共有２０个节目，参加演出的演员一百多人。舞蹈包括汉族，蒙古族，朝鲜族，彝族以及亚洲其他国家的民族舞蹈。２０１３年春晚结束后，他们就着手筹备这次舞蹈节，一路走来相当不易。
74f48f7789213b8d71e014be4782e6ba78e9a5eb.translatedText: As the performance approaches, the teachers and children of the New Oriental Art School are getting ready. Dance director Qiu Xiaorong said that there are a total of 20 programs in this dance festival, with more than 100 actors participating in the performances. Dances include ethnic dances of the Han, Mongolian, Korean, Yi and other Asian countries. After the 2013 Spring Festival Gala, they started preparing for this dance festival, and it was not an easy journey.

0cda4be0a93175e0effa4c19155a8a282dadde23.sourceText: ”台上一分钟，台下十年功”本次舞蹈节专门有一个基本功汇报演出，小演员们将平时练习的基本功，技巧以舞蹈方式向观众展示：劈腿，下腰，大跳以及各种柔韧度，力度的表现。从这个节目中，观众可以看到一个美丽舞蹈后面付出的艰辛。邱老师说很多小演员特别喜欢这个节目。其中有的小演员先天柔韧度不是很好，当老师要求展示后腿动作时（腿从后搬至头顶），她们总是主动要求完成，并表示一定会练好。邱老师说她非常开心看到孩子们这么努力，看着他们常常会因为一个技巧，练习成百上千次，直到自己顺利完成。这不仅是身体素质的训练，更是个性上的锻炼，让孩子产生一种韧性，直视自己的弱点，并努力改进。这也是舞蹈的魅力之一，总是会让人有征服感，同时又有表现欲。
0cda4be0a93175e0effa4c19155a8a282dadde23.translatedText: "One minute on stage, ten years off stage" This dance festival has a special basic skills report performance. The young actors will show the audience the basic skills and skills they usually practice in the form of dance: splits, lower waist, big jump and various flexibility and strength performances. From this show, the audience can see the hard work behind a beautiful dance. Teacher Qiu said that many young actors particularly like this show. Some of the young actors are not born with very good flexibility. When the teacher asks them to demonstrate the movement of their hind legs (moving their legs from behind to the top of their head), they always ask to complete it and say that they will definitely practice it well. Teacher Qiu said that she was very happy to see the children working so hard. She often practiced a skill hundreds or thousands of times until they successfully completed it. This is not only physical fitness training, but also personality training, allowing children to develop a sense of resilience, look directly at their own weaknesses, and work hard to improve. This is also one of the charms of dance. It always makes people feel conquered and at the same time expressive.

de4598946e891f6e4eec333df50d108f1ccac5b5.sourceText: 《花开时节》就是一个描述春暖花开，百花争艳的表现力非常强的舞蹈。它是由传统中国手绢舞改进的汉族舞蹈。舞者身上的鲜花饰品，让舞台变得徇丽多彩。瞬间，这些裙子上的鲜花就在舞蹈者的手上跳跃起来，它们时而奔放地向阳开放，时而立体地旋转在观众的眼前，平面和立面的结合，把姹紫嫣红的春天，表现得淋漓尽致。这个十二人的群舞，是本次舞蹈节的压轴好戏。《花开时节》从２,３月份开始基本动作练习。没练习几次，就遇上了欢乐的春假，大部分孩子都出门旅行。原本十几人的舞蹈，顿时就只剩下了五六个人。好不容易等到回学校，各个小演员基本动作的学习程度变得参差不齐，邱老师只能一遍又一遍地反复给学生补课。刚把人凑齐，队形也大致有个样子，接踵而来又是暑假。一个暑假过后，孩子还能不能记住那些动作，又成了重大考验。原先小演员都是用手绢来代替道具，８月初真正的道具从中国定制回来后，发现比手绢难转很多。原本练习很不错的动作，因为新道具的加入，让很多孩子很不习惯，不得不加大孩子的练习量。《花开时节》这个新节目很受大家欢迎，正式演出时会给观众们带来怎样地震撼呢？
de4598946e891f6e4eec333df50d108f1ccac5b5.translatedText: "Blooming Season" is a very expressive dance that describes the warmth of spring and the blooming of flowers. It is a Han dance improved from the traditional Chinese handkerchief dance. The flower accessories on the dancers made the stage beautiful and colorful. In an instant, the flowers on these skirts jumped on the hands of the dancers. Sometimes they opened unrestrainedly towards the sun, and sometimes they rotated three-dimensionally in front of the audience. The combination of plane and elevation vividly expressed the colorful spring. This group dance of twelve people is the finale of this dance festival. "Blooming Season" starts with basic movement exercises in February and March. After only a few practices, we encountered the joyful spring break, and most of the children went on trips. There were originally a dozen people dancing, but suddenly there were only five or six people left. After finally returning to school, the level of learning of the basic movements of each young actor became uneven. Teacher Qiu could only teach the students over and over again. We had just gathered the people together, and the formation had a rough shape. Then it was summer vacation again. After a summer vacation, whether the children can still remember those actions has become a major test. Originally, the young actors used handkerchiefs as props. After the real props were customized from China in early August, they found that they were much more difficult to use than handkerchiefs. The movements that were originally very good to practice, because of the addition of new props, many children are not used to it and have to increase the amount of practice. The new program "Blooming Season" is very popular with everyone. How will it shock the audience when it is officially performed?

82dc44357fb40bdafe4444783352a6480bc12ede.sourceText: 目前，小演员们进入了扣动作和表情的最后阶段，服装，道具，灯光一切就绪，亚省舞蹈节的大幕马上就要开启，带上您的朋友一起去享受这场有中国味儿的文艺大餐！９月１４日下午４时，我们不见不散。
82dc44357fb40bdafe4444783352a6480bc12ede.translatedText: At present, the young actors have entered the final stage of their movements and expressions. The costumes, props and lighting are all ready. The curtain of the Alberta Dance Festival is about to open. Bring your friends to enjoy this cultural feast with a Chinese flavor! We will see you at 4 pm on September 14th.

31f4ea77adc4f0e780f17bbf32e8e4381744b0f2.sourceText: 中国如毁灭美国；美国也将毁灭中国! 作者：CNN 记者 美国海外电视台 ”中国如毁灭美国，美国也将毁灭中国”这是CNN记者扎卡里亚近日评论中的看法。 中国国家总理温家宝2010年9月到访美国期间，曾接受CNN记者扎卡里亚（Fareed Zakaria）的专访。后者近日再次撰文，抨击中国媒体对于美国信用等级下调一事的评述，称中国并未给予美国恩惠，相反，中国实际上需要美国。 扎卡里亚表示，中国在过去几周时间中，对于美国信用等级下调作出的反应令他感到惊讶。中国官媒大声宣称，美国需要治疗其在债务问题上的疾病。香港一家媒体的头条则公开用”美国梦结束”这样的标题，称华盛顿欠每一个中国公民5,700元人民币，折合900美元。 还有中国分析人士认为，华盛顿对于其债务问题的解决，仅仅是令这颗定时炸弹的导火线延长了一寸而已。扎卡里亚称，这类的评论震撼了中国民众的神经。 当上海股市出现下跌之后，中国的博客写手们涌向社交平台，质疑为何美国遭受降级，而中国成为最大的受害者？还有人称，用中国纳税人的钱购买美国债券，是一个巨大的错误，中国必须持有的是那些可以负责任的资产。 文章称，在美国，也可以听到很多人担心中国政府或许会停止购买美国国债的忧虑。扎卡里亚称，他认为这些担心被过度渲染了。因为现在美中两国的经济局势就如同冷战时期的核威慑学说，即”如果你毁灭我，我也将毁灭你”。 扎卡里亚举例称，中国目前确实是美国最大的债务持有者，拥有约1.2万亿美元的国债，要比日本、英国和巴西持有的都多。但是很少有人了解的一个事实是，大部分美国债务还是被社会保障信托、养老资本以及联邦贮备系统中的美国人所拥有。 不过，中国作为边际买主依然是非常重要的，有人想象中国将会低价抛售美国的1.2万亿国债，但是这只是一个巨大的猜想。如果中国真的开始抛售的话，将会产生一系列的灾难性连锁反应。 如果中国这样做的话，将会对美元引发恐慌性的抛售，这必定将伤害美国经济，而美国则是中国第一大的出口市场。况且这对于希望将工人安排于遍布中国的外资工厂中工作的北京政府来说，也并不是一个好消息。 扎卡里亚称，中国倾向于一个出口导向型的增长战略，这要求其保持商品价格低廉，而这则意味着必须保持货币低估，这也是为何中国购买美元的原因。 中国是否能够停止或者减缓购买美国债务呢？是的，当然可以。但是即使是这样，中国能够做出的选择也比人们的预期要少。随着中国出口的不断增长，其必须增加其外汇储备。这些钱将如何存放呢？难道中国想要投资日本债务，或者令日元成为其储备货币吗？任何能够了解中日深刻仇恨的人都知道，这将是不可能的。 欧元主导的资产或许是有可能的，但是难道中国真的希望将资金投入欧元区，这样一个货币未来比任何时候都看似动荡的市场？中国或许能够购买英镑或者瑞士法郎，但是绝不可能大批量购买。 事实上，如果中国停止购买美国国债，人民币的价值将会上涨，中国的出口将变得更贵，中国的就业率将会下滑。因此，就在中国的媒体都在大肆抨击美国政府政策的时候，北京政府会怎样做呢？预计它会继续购买美国债券。 中国已经进入到一个购买美国债券的圆圈，无论任何评级机构如何做出评判，没有任何其他的债券市场能够像美国市场一样大，或者一样安全。因此，扎卡里亚称，忽略所有说中国正在给予美国一个巨大恩惠的理论，因为中国实际上无处可去。从这一角度说，美国很可能是正在给予中国恩惠。
31f4ea77adc4f0e780f17bbf32e8e4381744b0f2.translatedText: If China destroys the United States, the United States will also destroy China! Author: CNN reporter American Overseas Television "If China destroys the United States, the United States will also destroy China." This is the view of CNN reporter Zakaria in a recent comment. During his visit to the United States in September 2010, Chinese Premier Wen Jiabao accepted an exclusive interview with CNN reporter Fareed Zakaria. The latter recently wrote another article criticizing the Chinese media's comments on the downgrade of the United States' credit rating, saying that China has not given the United States favors. On the contrary, China actually needs the United States. Zakaria said he was surprised by China's response to the downgrade of the U.S. credit rating in the past few weeks. Chinese state media loudly declared that the United States needed to cure its debt ailment. A Hong Kong media headline publicly used the headline "The American Dream is Over," claiming that Washington owes every Chinese citizen 5,700 yuan, equivalent to US$900. Some Chinese analysts believe that Washington's solution to its debt problem has only extended the fuse of this time bomb by an inch. Zakaria said that such comments shocked the nerves of the Chinese people. After the Shanghai stock market fell, Chinese bloggers flocked to social platforms to question why the United States suffered a downgrade and China became the biggest victim. Others say that using Chinese taxpayers' money to buy U.S. bonds is a huge mistake. China must hold assets that can be held responsibly. The article stated that in the United States, many people can also be heard worried that the Chinese government may stop buying U.S. Treasury bonds. Zakaria said he believed those concerns were overblown. Because the current economic situation between the United States and China is like the nuclear deterrence doctrine during the Cold War, that is, "If you destroy me, I will destroy you." For example, Zakaria said that China is indeed the largest debt holder in the United States, with about 1.2 trillion US dollars in national debt, which is more than Japan, the United Kingdom and Brazil. But what few people understand is that most of the U.S. debt is still owned by Americans in Social Security trusts, pension capital, and the Federal Reserve System. However, China is still very important as a marginal buyer. Some people imagine that China will sell off the 1.2 trillion U.S. Treasury bonds at a low price, but this is just a huge conjecture. If China really starts to sell off, there will be a series of catastrophic chain reactions. If China does this, it will trigger panic selling of the U.S. dollar, which will definitely hurt the U.S. economy, and the U.S. is China's largest export market. Moreover, this is not good news for the Beijing government, which hopes to place workers in foreign-owned factories across China. Zakaria said China prefers an export-oriented growth strategy, which requires it to keep commodity prices low, which means it must keep its currency undervalued, which is why China buys U.S. dollars. Can China stop or slow down its purchases of U.S. debt? Yes, of course. But even so, China has fewer choices than people expect. As China's exports continue to grow, it must increase its foreign exchange reserves. How will the money be stored? Does China want to invest in Japanese debt or make the yen its reserve currency? Anyone who can understand the deep hatred between China and Japan knows that this will be impossible. Euro-dominated assets may be possible, but does China really want to put money into the eurozone, a market where the future of the currency looks more volatile than ever? China may be able to buy pounds or Swiss francs, but never in large quantities. In fact, if China stopped buying U.S. Treasuries, the value of the yuan would rise, China's exports would become more expensive, and China's employment rate would decline. So, just as the Chinese media is criticizing the U.S. government's policies, what will the Beijing government do? It is expected to continue buying U.S. bonds. China has entered a circle of buying U.S. bonds, and no matter what any ratings agency decides, no other bond market is as big or as safe as the U.S. market. Therefore, Zakaria said, ignore all theories that China is giving the United States a huge favor, because China actually has nowhere to go. From this perspective, the United States is probably giving China a favor.

a3ae5f7e2f991e3d46475ccd05c9d258ada0b9d3.sourceText: 上周五，美国联邦法院陪审团对苹果公司(Apple)和三星公司(Samsung)之间的专利诉讼案做出裁决。预计这项裁决将会改变竞争激烈的手机行业的面貌。
a3ae5f7e2f991e3d46475ccd05c9d258ada0b9d3.translatedText: On Friday, a U.S. federal court jury issued a verdict in the patent lawsuit between Apple and Samsung. The ruling is expected to change the face of the highly competitive mobile phone industry.

09dc430e75cec15fc615b188ff00b9b9b23ddafa.sourceText: 这场被外界密切关注的审判在圣何塞进行，三星几乎彻底败诉，并且被判支付超过10亿美元的赔偿金。对三星而言，其中的意义不言而喻。公司将来设计产品时必须谨慎，避免被控抄袭苹果。
09dc430e75cec15fc615b188ff00b9b9b23ddafa.translatedText: This closely watched trial was held in San Jose. Samsung almost completely lost the case and was ordered to pay more than $1 billion in damages. For Samsung, the significance is self-evident. The company must be careful when designing future products to avoid being accused of copying Apple.

bf3181fbdf77e9359c9d83dd3071a1b8a1fe8633.sourceText: 其他生产商也可能变得更加谨慎。谷歌公司(Google)制造了三星手机的核心软件操作系统Android，通过其硬件制造伙伴，谷歌显然也会感受到其中的影响。不过，行业专家称，正准备用新软件进入手机市场的微软公司(Microsoft)所受的影响将比较少。
bf3181fbdf77e9359c9d83dd3071a1b8a1fe8633.translatedText: Other manufacturers may also become more cautious. Google, which makes Android, the core software operating system for Samsung phones, will obviously feel the impact through its hardware manufacturing partners. However, industry experts say Microsoft, which is preparing to enter the mobile phone market with new software, will be less affected.

e7962eed123bca9d97b878abf0365c8d393fe1f8.sourceText: 苹果一直是智能手机市场的领头羊。它定义了智能手机的外观以及用户与手机的互动方式。如今流行的大部分智能手机都是玻璃和金属构成的直板手机，通过触摸屏控制，屏幕上布满了图标。消费者对这种形式比较熟悉，所以，不同生产商的手机都倾向于采用类似的外观和操作方式。
e7962eed123bca9d97b878abf0365c8d393fe1f8.translatedText: Apple has always been the leader in the smartphone market. It defines what a smartphone looks like and how users interact with it. Most of today's popular smartphones are candy bars made of glass and metal, controlled by a touch screen and filled with icons. Consumers are familiar with this format, so mobile phones from different manufacturers tend to have similar appearances and operations.

7dc5ece4dfe580756792d3586f785bee7d74bab0.sourceText: 首先将被改变的，可能就是这些相似性。Dickstein Shapiro律师事务所西海岸知识产权事务部主管小罗伯特W迪克森(Robert W. Dickerson Jr.)称，”未来各家公司将必须考虑，它们希望自家的产品与竞争者的产品在形状、大小、触感、观感方面有多大程度的相似，彼此的图标是雷同还是有差别。” Dickstein Shapiro是一家专利法事务所，没有参与三星-苹果案。
7dc5ece4dfe580756792d3586f785bee7d74bab0.translatedText: >The first thing that will be changed may be these similarities. “In the future, companies are going to have to consider how similar they want their products to be to their competitors’ products in terms of shape, size, feel, look and feel, whether their icons are the same or different,” said Robert W. Dickerson Jr., director of the West Coast intellectual property practice at Dickstein Shapiro, a patent law firm that is not involved in the Samsung-Apple case.

1c85d36e325a844ede76ed3ed9213a55f8123823.sourceText: 微软及其主要硬件伙伴诺基亚公司(Nokia)起码会轻松一点。加州大学伯克利分校(University of California Berkeley)法律与技术中心(Center for Law and Technology)的执行主管罗伯特巴尔(Robert Barr)称，诺基亚Windows手机的用户界面棗用户看到和触摸的图标和其他功能棗看起来与iPhone有着明显的区别。作为长期的手机生产商，诺基亚也拥有多项专利保护自己。微软和诺基亚正试图在智能手机市场东山再起，对它们而言，设计上的区分度不仅能在这场席卷全行业的专利战中取得明显优势，还能获得营销优势。
1c85d36e325a844ede76ed3ed9213a55f8123823.translatedText: Microsoft and its main hardware partner Nokia will at least have it easier. Robert Barr, executive director of the Center for Law and Technology at the University of California Berkeley, said the user interface of Nokia's Windows phones—the icons and other features that users see and touch—look distinctly different from those on the iPhone. As a long-time mobile phone manufacturer, Nokia also has a number of patents to protect itself. Microsoft and Nokia are trying to make a comeback in the smartphone market, and for them, design differentiation can not only give them a clear advantage in the patent war that is sweeping the industry, but also gain a marketing advantage.

49fae63417ed29d2a2922929d3cbd8bfbc551562.sourceText: 不过，对谷歌和所有使用Android软件的手机生产商而言，事情则会变得更加艰难。Android手机是当今市场上最常见的智能手机。三星是世界上最大的手机生产商，其市场份额还在迅速增长。三星和其他生产商制造的各种Android手机加起来的销量能轻易打败苹果的iPhone。
49fae63417ed29d2a2922929d3cbd8bfbc551562.translatedText: However, things will become more difficult for Google and all mobile phone manufacturers using Android software. Android phones are the most common smartphones on the market today. Samsung is the world's largest mobile phone maker and its market share is growing rapidly. A variety of Android phones made by Samsung and other manufacturers can easily outsell Apple's iPhone.

af97834ebfcf9e00639197023592bcea7029ed3f.sourceText: 加州大学伯克利分校法学院的法学与技术教授罗伯特稰蒙吉斯(Robert P. Merges)称，尽管本案没有牵涉谷歌，但是苹果显然一直针对的是Android。如果其他采用Android的手机生产商忌惮苹果发起对它们的诉讼并且胜诉的话，它们会不会放弃Android？梅吉斯称，”还有许多使用Android的公司，将来可能会面临诉讼，而且，如果赔偿金的判决维持不变，Android系统每个参与者的成本都将提高。”
af97834ebfcf9e00639197023592bcea7029ed3f.translatedText: Robert P. Merges, a professor of law and technology at the University of California, Berkeley School of Law, said that although this case does not involve Google, Apple has obviously been targeting Android. If other mobile phone manufacturers using Android are afraid that Apple will initiate a lawsuit against them and win the lawsuit, will they give up Android? Megis said, "There are many companies using Android that may face lawsuits in the future, and if the compensation award remains unchanged, the cost for everyone involved in the Android system will increase."

78aac63a21ca6382f4cb1c79bfb4ef6ed1946a2c.sourceText: 如果手机生产商转而使用较不普及的系统，比如Windows，亦或是预计将于明年问世的黑莓操作系统，这将使苹果取得市场先机。梅吉斯称，”这对谷歌来说不是好消息。苹果真正的目标是Android生态系统、Android的世界、所有与Android有关的东西。这才是它真正的靶子。”
78aac63a21ca6382f4cb1c79bfb4ef6ed1946a2c.translatedText: If mobile phone manufacturers switch to less popular systems, such as Windows, or the BlackBerry operating system expected to be released next year, this will give Apple a market advantage. Megis said, "This is not good news for Google. Apple's real goal is the Android ecosystem, the Android world, and everything related to Android. This is its real target."

e7fc1c732b5d68ff5af4ea0d0d4fb0ca4aa948d0.translatedText: Oscar winners go on tour, the last stop in Phoenix (Alberta Times) The Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences made a new decision this year, sending eight 8.5-pound Oscar-winning figures to tour the top ten cities in the United States to promote the Oscars, which has seen its ratings lag behind before. Starting from February 4, Oscar winners, accompanied by famous movie stars Angie Greenup and Ben Gleib, started from New York, passed through Philadelphia, Washington, DC, Baltimore, Chicago, St. Louis, Kansas City, Houston, Dallas, arrived in Phoenix on February 21, and returned to Los Angeles before the award ceremony on February 24. Although most movie fans in Phoenix cannot attend the Oscar ceremony live, they can still take photos with the Oscar winners.

f083e56443c27c6fd489063e5c82fc8d03672bcb.sourceText: 中新网12月12日电 据外媒12日报道，美国总统特朗普(Donald Trump)指，曼哈顿港务局巴士总站造成数人伤亡的爆炸突显”改革移民制度的需要”。
f083e56443c27c6fd489063e5c82fc8d03672bcb.translatedText: China News Service, December 12 According to foreign media reports on the 12th, US President Trump (Donald Trump) Trump said the explosion that killed several people at the Port Authority bus terminal in Manhattan highlighted "the need to reform the immigration system."

1f39be257aea2e19be8d0dc0deea759bcb15fffe.sourceText: 白宫在袭击发生后发表声明，批评现时移民制度让发动袭击的嫌犯乌拉(Akayed Ullah)透过在美亲属移民到当地。
1f39be257aea2e19be8d0dc0deea759bcb15fffe.translatedText: The White House issued a statement after the attack, criticizing the current immigration system for allowing Akayed Ullah, the suspect who carried out the attack, to immigrate to the country through relatives in the United States.

952a911c8053d125ce5f96f7c5deceaa3d0c8000.sourceText: 纽约警方指乌拉受极端组织”伊斯兰国”影响，但与该组织没有直接联系。警方也指，根据乌拉的计划，这本是一宗自杀式袭击，但最后没有成功。
952a911c8053d125ce5f96f7c5deceaa3d0c8000.translatedText: The New York police stated that Ullah was influenced by the extremist organization "Islamic State", but had no direct connection with the organization. The police also said that according to Ullah's plan, this was a suicide attack, but it failed in the end.

77c1b1aa2c6b85d7d1b8ef527e76a6c8868028a1.sourceText: 除乌拉外，袭击至今造成至少三人受伤，包括一名警员。
77c1b1aa2c6b85d7d1b8ef527e76a6c8868028a1.translatedText: In addition to Ullah, the attack has injured at least three people so far, including a police officer.

e6bd5e24fd1d5cb51a05a234053f34f034889eb5.sourceText: 美国传媒报道，乌拉现年27岁，2011年从孟加拉跟父母一起以移民签证搬到美国。
e6bd5e24fd1d5cb51a05a234053f34f034889eb5.translatedText: US media reported that Ulla, now 27 years old, moved to the United States from Bangladesh with her parents on an immigrant visa in 2011.

20c1b4b40438d0abbe628544c0f80386e9fe257c.sourceText: 白宫发言人桑德斯(Sarah Sanders)透露，乌拉持有F43类签证。那表示他是一名F41类签证持有人的儿子，这种签证通常发给一名美国公民年满21岁的兄弟姐妹。
20c1b4b40438d0abbe628544c0f80386e9fe257c.translatedText: White House spokesperson Sarah Sanders revealed that Ullah holds an F43 visa. That means he is the son of an F41 visa holder, which is usually issued to a 21-year-old sibling of a U.S. citizen.

73eb07d578b33b4b968caea86e0bb9bce4d1eee5.sourceText: 特朗普曾称要结束像乌拉这种透过亲属关系取得签证的”连带移民”桑德斯指，如当局早就实行特朗普的计划，乌拉当年就不能移民到美国。
73eb07d578b33b4b968caea86e0bb9bce4d1eee5.translatedText: Trump once said that he would end "joint immigration" like Ullah who obtained a visa through family ties. Sanders said that if the authorities had implemented Trump's plan, Ullah would not have been able to immigrate to the United States that year.

704a57fc1ba4c76a6377d69139f2d9ee993bc731.sourceText: 特朗普早前宣布禁止数个国家的国民入境美国，引起争议。孟加拉并不在禁令之列。
704a57fc1ba4c76a6377d69139f2d9ee993bc731.translatedText: Trump announced earlier that he would ban nationals from several countries from entering the United States, causing controversy. Bangladesh is not included in the ban.

3176afe80258ddaf97a60d17da8312beabfda374.sourceText: 纽约警方指，乌拉持有美国永久居民身份，被扣留期间有作口供，但警方拒绝透露他说了甚么。
3176afe80258ddaf97a60d17da8312beabfda374.translatedText: New York police stated that Ullah holds U.S. permanent resident status and gave a confession during his detention, but the police refused to disclose what he said.

14afec046e9e78fce80bc78d9a17bc1a794b923e.sourceText: 罗姆尼选副手 麦凯恩经验谈 （亚省时报） 本州共和党籍联邦参议员麦凯恩6天提供一些参选经验给笃定赢得党内初选的罗姆尼：挑自己信任的人担任副手。 麦凯恩四年前出马角逐总统，选择培林担任副手，最后败给民主党籍的欧巴马。当时担任阿拉斯加州长的培林知名度不高，且全国舞台经验有限，但却成功激起共和党保守基层的热情，只是最后仍不敌民主党的狂潮。 美国广播公司（ABC）政论节目”本周”（This Week）专访麦凯恩，问及副手人选上，他会给前麻萨诸塞州长罗姆尼什么建议。 麦凯恩说：”我觉得副手必须是他可以信赖的人。最重要的是，如果罗姆尼发生了什么事，这个副手是否有能力接替他的位置？” ”这是我2008年挑选副手的主要考量，我相信罗姆尼的考量会和我一样。”
14afec046e9e78fce80bc78d9a17bc1a794b923e.translatedText: Romney chooses deputy, McCain talks about his experience (Alberta Times) The state's Republican U.S. Senator McCain provided some experience in running for six days to Romney, who is determined to win the party's primary: Pick someone you trust as his deputy. McCain ran for president four years ago and chose Palin as his deputy, but ultimately lost to Democratic candidate Obama. Palin, who was the governor of Alaska at the time, was not well-known and had limited experience on the national stage, but he successfully aroused the enthusiasm of the conservative base of the Republican Party, but was ultimately defeated by the enthusiasm of the Democratic Party. The ABC political commentary program "This Week" conducted an exclusive interview with McCain and asked him what advice he would give to former Massachusetts Governor Mitt Romney after he was selected as his deputy. McCain said: "I think the deputy has to be someone he can trust. The most important thing is, if something happens to Romney, is this deputy capable of taking over his position?" "This was my main consideration in selecting my deputy in 2008, and I believe Romney's considerations will be the same as mine."
