14dc8103cbbb86d479d7e686e785fc73d45f8872.sourceText: 财政悬崖 对本州影响 （亚省时报） 自11月7日大选过后，国会里民主、共和两党就激烈争论如何降低联邦赤字。这段时间内，以色列和巴勒斯坦交过火，又达成停战协议。刚果叛军夺下、然后又同意撤出商业大城果玛，中国十八大开过换了届，淘宝双十一疯狂甩卖后又准备双十二继续，但美国两大党还在互掐中。 民主党认为共和党不想认真缩减支出，只想保留富人的减税措施；共和党也觉得民主党不想认真减支，只想提高富人税率。照此下去，朝野有希望在圣诞节前达成避开「财政悬崖」的协议，这个机率可能比中威力球奖头彩还低。 一旦两党没有达成协议，财政悬崖产生，将对亚利桑那州有什么影响？从2013年1月1日起，本州岛将损失： *1400万美元联邦教育资金援助，给父母为现役军人，或居住在印第安部落学生，或其它一些与联邦政府认可低收入、低税收学区学生。 *950万美元给贫困儿童的学前教育计划。结果：失去300工作和1500名儿童失去服务。 *440万儿童保健和发展拨款，提供补贴低收入家庭支付儿童保健。约1400名儿童失去补贴。 *280万美元药物滥用的预防和治疗计划，为本州岛提供酒精和药物瘾的治疗和康复。约7600人受影响。 *170万美元劳动力投资法案，帮助失业补助计划和失业工人再培训。有1000人受影响。 *120万高级营养计划。服务对象：为贫困老人在家或社区中心提供食物。*100万美元给低收入家庭提供能源援助计划。结果：部分低收入家庭未能获取空调冷气或暖气补贴。 不过，两党吵归吵，最终会在截止日期找到妥协方案，拨款肯定有增有减，两党皆大欢喜，惨的从来只是平民百姓。
14dc8103cbbb86d479d7e686e785fc73d45f8872.translatedText: The impact of the fiscal cliff on the state (Alberta Times) Since the election on November 7, the Democratic and Republican parties in Congress have fiercely debated how to reduce the federal deficit. During this period, Israel and Palestine exchanged fire and reached an armistice agreement. The Congolese rebels captured and then agreed to withdraw from the commercial city of Goma, China’s 18th National Congress has been held and a new term has passed, and Taobao is preparing to continue the Double 12 sale after the crazy sales on Double 11, but the two major parties in the United States are still at each other’s throats. The Democrats believe that the Republicans do not want to seriously reduce spending and only want to retain tax cuts for the rich; the Republicans also feel that the Democrats do not want to seriously reduce spending and only want to increase tax rates for the wealthy. If this continues, the government and opposition parties hope to reach an agreement to avoid the "fiscal cliff" before Christmas. This chance may be lower than winning the Powerball jackpot. Once the two parties do not reach an agreement and the fiscal cliff occurs, what impact will it have on Arizona? Starting January 1, 2013, the island will lose: *$14 million in federal education funding assistance for students whose parents are active duty military personnel, or live in Indian tribes, or other students in federally recognized low-income, low-tax school districts. *$9.5 million for preschool education programs for needy children. The result: 300 jobs lost and 1,500 children out of services. *$4.4 million in child care and development grants to provide subsidies for low-income families to pay for child care. About 1,400 children lost their subsidies. *$2.8 million substance abuse prevention and treatment program to provide alcohol and drug addiction treatment and recovery on the island. About 7,600 people are affected. *$1.7 million workforce investment bill to help with unemployment compensation programs and retraining displaced workers. 1,000 people are affected. *1.2 million premium nutrition plan. Target recipients: Provide food to poor elderly people at home or in community centers. *$1 million to provide energy assistance programs to low-income households. Result: Some low-income families were unable to obtain air conditioning or heating subsidies. However, the two parties will quarrel and quarrel, and they will eventually find a compromise solution before the deadline. The funding will definitely increase or decrease. Both parties will be happy, but it will always be the common people who suffer.

4cf2baffd331df63384bb4758390abbc7f6b0dce.sourceText: 立法两会领导人同意州长的建议，在预算法桉通过之前，暂停所有提桉的签署，从堕胎法桉到公务员退休费。 珍布鲁尔对预算谈判的进展感到不满，她告诉议员们，在她提出的预算桉未获两会通过之前，她不会考虑任何建议，不会签署任何法桉。她的发言人表示，违反禁令将导致否决。 几天来，参众两会领导人没有将法桉最终投票结果交给州长。但现在，立法者必须在他们的会期内对本届所有提桉进行表决，州长签署成法律的步骤唯有搁置。 2009年本州最高法院裁决，提桉通过后必须及时送至州长签署。立法两会现在要做的是按法将提桉讨论、投票，至于州长那里，两会议员无法控制。 本届两会批准的法桉，包括堕胎法，儿童座椅加高，本州公务员退休金等。 州长说，签署这些法桉都不成问题，就算本届议会会期结束，也不影响她在会后90天内签署。现在最要解决的是她提出的财政预算桉。 参议会周二已经紧急通过公务员退休费法桉，就等州长签署。该法的内容主要是雇员和员工必须各付退休金的50%。现行退休金法在2011年被更改，雇主只需付47%，员工自付53%。法官裁定此法违反了受亚利桑那州宪法保护的合同。法桉还拨款4千万美元，为州机构和学区偿还因旧法而多收雇员退休金。此前，众议会已经批准这项立法。
4cf2baffd331df63384bb4758390abbc7f6b0dce.translatedText: The leaders of the two legislative chambers agreed with the governor's suggestion that before the budget bill is passed, the signing of all bills, from the abortion bill to civil servant retirement pay, is suspended. Jean Brewer is dissatisfied with the progress of budget negotiations and told lawmakers that she will not consider any suggestions or sign any legislation until her proposed budget is passed by the two sessions. Her spokesman said violating the ban would result in a veto. For days, House and Senate leaders did not hand over the final vote on the bill to the governor. But now, lawmakers must vote on all proposals this term during their session, putting the governor on hold to sign them into law. In 2009, the state's Supreme Court ruled that after the proposal is passed, it must be sent to the governor for signature in a timely manner. What the two legislative sessions need to do now is discuss and vote on the proposal in accordance with the law. As for the governor, members of the two sessions have no control over it. The laws approved by the current two sessions include abortion laws, child seat heightening, state civil servant pensions, etc. The governor said that signing these laws will not be a problem. Even if the current parliamentary session ends, it will not affect her signing within 90 days after the session. The most important thing to solve now is the fiscal budget she proposed. The Senate on Tuesday urgently passed the Civil Service Retirement Benefit Act, which is awaiting the governor's signature. The main content of this law is that employees and employees must each pay 50% of their pension. Current pension laws were changed in 2011 so that employers only pay 47% and employees pay 53%. The judge ruled that the law violated contracts protected by the Arizona Constitution. The legislation also allocates $40 million to reimburse state agencies and school districts for overcharges in employee retirement benefits due to the old law. The House of Representatives had previously approved the legislation.

6e417c439d486eb09fb1da0cb137c857d9ffb030.sourceText: 团结一心其利断金——保护凤凰城“中国文化中心“游行 8月13日下午三点凤凰城两百五十多市民，冒着华氏一百多度的高温，在凤凰城中国文化中心举行游行反对新主人TRUE NORTH COMPANIS去除中国文化中心所有中国元素，改建成公司办公大楼。也就是说亚利桑那州唯一一个中国古典江南园林建筑以及凤凰城多元文化的标志性建筑”中国文化中心”以及”和园”危在旦夕。 8月13日游行现场（一） 8月13日游行现场（二） 游行中九十高龄的资深侨领余文劲 杨萍 （左三） 邓朝驹（左四） 来参加游行的市民，小的只有一岁多，老的是九十高龄的资深侨领余文劲。大家都让余老先生到阴凉处坐坐，余先生说：”那怎么能行？这么多人在烈日下，我不一定能坚持很久，但是我一定要尽力跟大家站在一起！.” 他站在街对面，手举游行的标语，坚决反对拆除和修改”中国文化中心”。侨领邓朝驹，张传东都向媒体阐述了市民游行的目的和担忧。组织者杨萍，艺柳白，张旭东，方方等都对游行安全做了全面安排。游行队伍喊着口号”保护中国文化中心” ”保护我们的花园” ”反对毁掉亚利桑那州的历史” ”反对毁掉凤凰城多元文化”。在我们的游行队伍中，有不同的肤色，不同的种族 的人，但都是为了一个目的走到一起，保护”中国文化中心”,保护凤凰城的文化遗产，保护亚利桑那的文化遗产，保护全美国人民文化财产。 8月13日游行现场年纪最小的小朋友 小游行志愿者 张苏南 全家来支持游行 8月12日晚，名为Danny Millegan美国朋友，在中国文化中心独守了一整夜，警察找他谈话，劝他回家，他坚决不同意，他要用自己的实际行动呼吁更多的美国朋友一起来保护中国文化中心，他成为了游行队伍中的明星。钱德勒市华人议员黄馨民，凤凰城市议员Michael Nowakowaski也参加了游行，Michael表示会促成一次与新房东见面的会议，他称中国文化中心就是”沙漠中的一缕中国”。在游行中，每位市民都邀请游行者联署”保中国文化中心”的请愿书，坚决要求”原地，原址，原样”保护中国文化中心，目前这份联署人数已经突破三千。 8月13日游行现场（三） 8月13日游行现场（四） 8月13日游行现场（五） 8月13日游行现场（六） 本次游行规模在华人社区空前，准备时间只有短短一天。所有参加游行的市民自制标语，自己复印图片，宣传材料。网名”上中下”朋友自制降温喷水瓶，分发给大家解暑降温。当地书法家陈普老师挥毫泼墨自制超大标语，志愿者大宋给大家送水，欣欣超市老板赖甲乙亲自拿着冰镇饮料免费分发给大家。老四川餐馆和同顺居餐馆也都为大家提供休息场地和免费饮料。游行的筹备会和会后总结都是由老四川提供的场地。 游行圆满落帷，保护”中国文化中心”的新闻占据了亚利桑那各大媒体，CBS5，Fox 10 News，12news三大电视台，Arizona Republic报纸都详细报道本次游行。让大家深刻体会到”团结一心，其利断金”, 然而我们保护”中国文化中心”的征程才刚刚开始，任重而道远！
6e417c439d486eb09fb1da0cb137c857d9ffb030.translatedText: United as one, we can cut off gold - Parade to protect the "Chinese Cultural Center" in Phoenix At three o'clock in the afternoon on August 13, more than 250 Phoenix residents braved the heat of more than 100 degrees Fahrenheit to hold a demonstration at the Phoenix Chinese Cultural Center to oppose the new owner, TRUE NORTH COMPANIS, who removed all Chinese elements from the Chinese Cultural Center and converted it into a company office building. In other words, the only classical Chinese Jiangnan garden architecture in Arizona and the multicultural landmark buildings of Phoenix, the "Chinese Cultural Center" and the "Harmony Garden" are in danger. The scene of the parade on August 13 (1) The scene of the parade on August 13 (2) The 90-year-old senior overseas Chinese leader Yu Wenjin in the parade Yang Ping (third from left) Deng Chaoju (fourth from left) The citizens who came to participate in the parade were only over one year old, and the oldest one was 90-year-old senior overseas Chinese leader Yu Wenjin. Everyone asked Mr. Yu to sit in the shade. Mr. Yu said: "How can that be done? With so many people under the scorching sun, I may not be able to hold on for a long time, but I must try my best to stand with everyone!" He stood across the street, holding a marching slogan, and firmly opposed the demolition and modification of the "Chinese Cultural Center." Overseas Chinese leaders Deng Chaoju and Zhang Chuandong both explained to the media the purpose and concerns of the citizens' march. Organizers Yang Ping, Yi Liubai, Zhang Xudong, Fang Fang, etc. all made comprehensive arrangements for the safety of the parade. The marchers shouted slogans: "Protect the Chinese Cultural Center," "Protect our gardens," "Oppose the destruction of Arizona's history," and "Oppose the destruction of Phoenix's multiculturalism." In our parade, there are people of different colors and races, but they all come together for one purpose, to protect the "Chinese Cultural Center", to protect the cultural heritage of Phoenix, to protect the cultural heritage of Arizona, and to protect the cultural property of the people of the United States. The youngest child at the parade on August 13, young parade volunteer Zhang Sunan, and his whole family came to support the parade. On the evening of August 12, an American friend named Danny Millegan stayed alone at the Chinese Cultural Center all night. The police talked to him and persuaded him to go home. He firmly disagreed. He wanted to use his actual actions to call on more American friends to protect the Chinese Cultural Center. He became a star in the parade. Chandler City Councilor Huang Xinmin and Phoenix City Councilor Michael Nowakowaski also participated in the parade. Michael said that he would facilitate a meeting with the new landlord. He called the Chinese Cultural Center "a ray of China in the desert." During the march, every citizen invited the marchers to sign a petition to "protect the Chinese Cultural Center," resolutely demanding that the Chinese Cultural Center be protected "in the same place, as it is, as it is." The number of signatures has now exceeded 3,000. Parade on August 13 (Wednesday) Parade on August 13 (Four) Parade on August 13 (V) Parade on August 13 (Six) The scale of this parade is unprecedented in the Chinese community, and the preparation time is only one day. All citizens participating in the parade made their own slogans, copied pictures and promotional materials themselves. A friend with the online name "Shang Zhongxia" made his own cooling spray bottles and distributed them to everyone to relieve themselves from the heat. Local calligrapher Mr. Chen Pu made his own super large slogans with a splash of ink, volunteer Da Song delivered water to everyone, and Xinxin Supermarket owner Lai Jiayi personally handed out iced drinks to everyone for free. Old Sichuan Restaurant and Tongshunju Restaurant also provide rest areas and free drinks for everyone. The preparatory meeting and post-meeting summary of the parade were both held at venues provided by Old Sichuan. The parade came to a successful conclusion, and news about protecting the "Chinese Cultural Center" occupied all major media in Arizona. CBS5, Fox 10 News, 12news, and the Arizona Republic newspaper all reported the parade in detail. Let everyone deeply understand that "united as one, we can cut through gold". However, our journey to protect the "Chinese Cultural Center" has just begun, and there is a long way to go!

07da081d32cf9c1b483933498bcab3d206616cdf.sourceText: 【环球网报道 记者王欢】日本《产经新闻》8月29日报道称，美国国务院新闻发言人维多利亚?#32445;兰28日在例行记者会上谈及钓鱼岛问题时，将钓鱼岛称为”尖阁诸岛”，即日本当局对钓鱼岛及其周边附属岛屿的称谓。
07da081d32cf9c1b483933498bcab3d206616cdf.translatedText: [Global Network Report Reporter Wang Huan] Japan's "Sankei Shimbun" reported on August 29 that when the U.S. State Department spokesperson Victoria Lan talked about the Diaoyu Islands issue at a regular press conference on the 28th, she called the Diaoyu Islands the "Senkaku Islands," which is the name used by the Japanese authorities for the Diaoyu Islands and their surrounding affiliated islands.

968f01899b5b4f6614afa6a6fbfeeca180251cc5.sourceText: 据称，纽兰在记者会上将钓鱼岛表述为”SENKAKUS”，这一发音正是日语 ”尖阁”发音的英文复数形式。
968f01899b5b4f6614afa6a6fbfeeca180251cc5.translatedText: It is said that Newland described the Diaoyu Islands as "SENKAKUS" at the press conference. This pronunciation is the English plural form of the Japanese pronunciation of "Senkaku".

1b69e73ba1dab0bf88e2dc6cb88e2871c036cc28.sourceText: 《产经新闻》臆测称，由此可见，美政府已经将日本对钓鱼岛的称谓定为其”正式名称”。美方或已认定钓鱼岛及其周边附岛屿是”日本领土”。
1b69e73ba1dab0bf88e2dc6cb88e2871c036cc28.translatedText: "Sankei Shimbun" speculated that this shows that the US government has designated Japan's name for the Diaoyu Islands as its "official name." The United States may have determined that the Diaoyu Islands and surrounding islands are "Japanese territory."

40322e32ca80ac05b83fbdbad8a0cefdc27f67c1.sourceText: 纽兰在28日的记者会上重申钓鱼岛是《美日安保条约》的适用对象，但她同时强调，在钓鱼岛问题上，美政府不会采取特定立场。
40322e32ca80ac05b83fbdbad8a0cefdc27f67c1.translatedText: Nuland reiterated at a press conference on the 28th that the Diaoyu Islands are applicable to the US-Japan Security Treaty, but she also emphasized that the US government will not adopt a specific position on the Diaoyu Islands issue.

9f4835c057cd0627e527135a3d1c3fedfb2f47e1.sourceText: 围绕钓鱼岛问题，中国外交部发言人曾多次重申，钓鱼岛及其附属岛屿自古以来就是中国的固有领土，中国对此拥有无可争辩的主权。根据《中华人民共和国海岛保护法》，中国国家海洋局于2012年3月公布了钓鱼岛的标准名称为?#38035;鱼岛?#65292;汉语拼音为”Di鄌 Y?Dǎo”，英文名称为”Diaoyu Island”。
9f4835c057cd0627e527135a3d1c3fedfb2f47e1.translatedText: Regarding the Diaoyu Islands issue, the spokesperson of the Chinese Ministry of Foreign Affairs has repeatedly reiterated that the Diaoyu Islands and its affiliated islands have been China’s inherent territory since ancient times, and China has indisputable sovereignty over them. According to the "Island Protection Law of the People's Republic of China", the State Oceanic Administration of China announced the standard name of Diaoyu Island in March 2012 as "Diaoyu Island" in Chinese pinyin as "Di鄌 Y? Dǎo" and its English name as "Diaoyu Island".

1466c23106dbef0e9d3a1d896d74a9521fd08a17.translatedText: Why should our country improve the "green card" system?

fb662b7f26b2866126f673e154199f5ff75949e6.sourceText: 当今世界综合国力的竞争，归根结底是对人才特别是高层次人才的竞争。近年来，随着我国经济社会持续快速发展，对高层次人才的需求日趋迫切，到我国创业发展的外籍高层次人才数量迅速增加。特别是２００８年以后，以”千人计划”为龙头的海外高层次人才引进工作整体快速推进，中央层面引进了２７００余名海外高层次人才，３年多来引进的海外正教授数量，是前３０年的几十倍，在海内外引起了强烈反响。据统计，各省区市地市以上城市自２００９年以来引进了两万多名海外高层次人才。海外高层次人才已逐渐成为提高我国自主创新能力的领跑者和生力军，成为我国人才队伍的重要组成部分和现代化建设的特需人才资源。
fb662b7f26b2866126f673e154199f5ff75949e6.translatedText: The competition for comprehensive national strength in today's world is ultimately a competition for talents, especially high-level talents. In recent years, with the sustained and rapid development of my country's economy and society, the demand for high-level talents has become increasingly urgent, and the number of high-level foreign talents who have come to my country to start businesses and develop has increased rapidly. Especially after 2008, the work of introducing high-level overseas talents led by the "Thousand Talents Plan" has been advancing rapidly. More than 2,700 high-level overseas talents have been introduced at the central level. The number of overseas full professors introduced in more than three years has been dozens of times that of the previous 30 years, which has aroused strong repercussions at home and abroad. According to statistics, cities in various provinces, autonomous regions and municipalities and above have introduced more than 20,000 high-level overseas talents since 2009. Overseas high-level talents have gradually become the frontrunners and new force in improving my country's independent innovation capabilities. They have become an important part of my country's talent team and a special talent resource for modernization.

a0d472a036caacc39bc5ae1f2e7d14eaa7ccd16e.sourceText: ”绿卡”制度是欧美发达国家在全球范围内开展人才竞争，吸引和留住高层次人才的一项重要制度。例如，美国每年发放１００多万张”绿卡”，其中高层次人才职业移民”绿卡”达１４万张。我国?#32511;卡?#21046;度自２００４年８月由公安部、外交部开始实施，目前已为近５０００名外国人办理了永久 居留 手续，其中有相当一部分是海外高层次人才及其家属，?#32511;卡?#21046;度已成为我国吸引海外高层次人才的一项重要制度。随着近年来我国海外高层次人才引进工作迅速发展，我国”绿卡”门槛过高、程序复杂、适用范围小、相关待遇不够明确等问题日益突出，亟待加以解决。
a0d472a036caacc39bc5ae1f2e7d14eaa7ccd16e.translatedText: The "green card" system is an important system for European and American developed countries to compete for talents on a global scale and attract and retain high-level talents. For example, the United States issues more than 1 million "green cards" every year, including 140,000 "green cards" for high-level professional immigrants. Our country's card program was implemented by the Ministry of Public Security and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs in August 2004. Currently, nearly 5,000 foreigners have gone through permanent residence procedures, a considerable number of whom are high-level overseas talents and their families. The program has become an important system for attracting high-level overseas talents in my country. With the rapid development of my country's overseas high-level talent introduction in recent years, my country's "green card" threshold is too high, the procedures are complex, the scope of application is small, and the relevant benefits are not clear enough. These problems have become increasingly prominent and need to be solved urgently.

68ea7e85e54f90882084d26e6f3af5c21ff06f6e.sourceText: 中组部、人力资源社会保障部、公安部等２５部门历时两年多，经过调研、讨论、起草等几个阶段，在听取多方面意见，反复修改完善的基础上，联合签发了《办法》，为进一步吸引外籍高层次人才来华工作，解决他们工作生活中的后顾之忧，充分发挥他们的作用营造良好的政策环境。《办法》的出台，对于我国积极应对国际人才竞争，加强高层次人才队伍建设，推进产业结构升级都具有十分重要的意义。
68ea7e85e54f90882084d26e6f3af5c21ff06f6e.translatedText: After more than two years of research, discussion, drafting and other stages, 25 departments including the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the CPC, the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security, and the Ministry of Public Security jointly issued the "Measures" on the basis of listening to opinions from many parties and repeatedly revising and improving them to further attract high-level foreign talents to work in China, solve their worries in work and life, and create a good policy environment to give full play to their role. The promulgation of the "Measures" is of great significance for our country to actively respond to international talent competition, strengthen the construction of high-level talent teams, and promote the upgrading of industrial structure.

fff25b8be951f736123fb2b792344f6088317a54.sourceText: 持”绿卡”人员出入境有何便利？
fff25b8be951f736123fb2b792344f6088317a54.translatedText: What are the conveniences for entry and exit of "green card" holders?

ac572b9c22eb987d8cf8632910983ef11735ddea.sourceText: 《办法》规定，”在中国居留期限不受限制，可以凭有效护照和《外国人永久居留证》出入中国国境，无需另外办理签证等手续；其配偶及直系亲属，可按有关规定申请办理相应签证、居留证件或《外国人永久居留证》”。《办法》还规定，”进出境自用物品按照海关对定居旅客的有关规定办理手续”。因此，取得中国”绿卡”后定居国内的外国人应为”定居旅客”。与中国籍的”居民旅客”相比，”定居旅客”更便于将本人或家庭在境内居留期间需要的日常生活用品携运入境。
ac572b9c22eb987d8cf8632910983ef11735ddea.translatedText: The "Measures" stipulate that "there is no limit on the period of residence in China. You can enter and exit China with a valid passport and "Permanent Residence Permit for Foreigners" without additional visa and other procedures; your spouse and immediate family members can apply for corresponding visas, residence documents or "Permanent Residence Permit for Foreigners" in accordance with relevant regulations." The "Measures" also stipulates that "the entry and exit procedures for personal use items shall be handled in accordance with the relevant customs regulations for settled passengers." Therefore, foreigners who settle in China after obtaining China’s “green card” should be regarded as “settled tourists”. Compared with "resident tourists" of Chinese nationality, "settled tourists" are more convenient to bring into the country the daily necessities needed by themselves or their families during their stay in the country.

206942939b169e47adec70d2a1704168c51b922a.sourceText: 持”绿卡”人员在华工作有何便利？
206942939b169e47adec70d2a1704168c51b922a.translatedText: What are the conveniences for "green card" holders to work in China?

b1a916b8a31ef9ee0696d8005383f76979d6131d.sourceText: 《办法》第四到第七条明确持”绿卡”人员在华工作可享有的各项待遇。其中第四条明确，”在中国就业，免办《外国人就业证》；符合条件的，可优先办理《外国专家证》《回国（来华）专家证》以及各地人才居住证”；第五条规定，”可以合法获得的人民币在中国境内进行外商直接投资”，此举可减少投资的税收和兑换成本；第六条规定，”在中国投资项目、设立外商投资企业的，发展改革、商务、工商、外汇等部门按照外资管理有关规定简化核准及审批程序，提高效率”；第七条规定，”可按规定参加专业技术职务任职资格评审和专业技术人员资格考试”。
b1a916b8a31ef9ee0696d8005383f76979d6131d.translatedText: Articles 4 to 7 of the "Measures" clarify the various benefits that "green card" holders can enjoy when working in China. Article 4 clarifies that "employment in China is exempt from the need for a "Foreigner Employment Permit"; those who meet the conditions can be given priority to apply for a "Foreign Expert Certificate", "Returning (Coming to China) Expert Certificate" and Residence Permit for Talents from Various Regions"; Article 5 stipulates that "RMB that can be obtained legally can be used for foreign direct investment in China", which can reduce the tax and investment costs Exchange costs; Article 6 stipulates, "For those who invest in projects or establish foreign-invested enterprises in China, the development and reform, commerce, industry and commerce, foreign exchange and other departments shall simplify the verification and approval procedures in accordance with the relevant regulations on foreign investment management to improve efficiency"; Article 7 stipulates, "You may participate in the review of qualifications for professional and technical positions and the qualification examination for professional and technical personnel in accordance with regulations."

a41cb6c23a2485f999bdbbbf1c82b038e0d05052.sourceText: 持”绿卡”人员在生活方面有何待遇？
a41cb6c23a2485f999bdbbbf1c82b038e0d05052.translatedText: >What are the living conditions for Green Card holders?

c870717244347ea16408c1e6290bcc9652491767.sourceText: 在子女就学方面，《办法》规定，”随迁子女义务教育阶段入学，符合条件的，可享受相关政策，由其居住地教育行政部门按照就近入学的原则办理入、转学手续，不收取国家规定以外的费用”。这是首次在国家层面明确了持”绿卡”人员的子女可在居住地接受义务教育，享受本地居民待遇。鉴于我国高等教育阶段针对外国学生的入学要求更适用于外籍人才子女，因此仍按现行政策执行。
c870717244347ea16408c1e6290bcc9652491767.translatedText: Regarding children's schooling, the "Measures" stipulates that "if children who follow migrant children enroll in compulsory education and meet the conditions, they can enjoy relevant policies. The education administrative department of their place of residence will handle the admission and transfer procedures in accordance with the principle of enrolling in the nearest school, and no fees other than those prescribed by the state will be charged." This is the first time that it has been clarified at the national level that children of "green card" holders can receive compulsory education in their place of residence and enjoy the treatment of local residents. Since the admission requirements for foreign students at the higher education stage in my country are more applicable to the children of foreign talents, the current policy is still implemented.

91915fdfb630a9e8586a73c7c2d9c2fc7a451686.sourceText: 对于参加社保，《办法》明确，可以”绿卡”作为有效身份凭证办理社会保险参保手续。同时，体现”国民待遇”原则，明确在境内居住而未就业的”绿卡”持有者，符合相关要求的，也可以参加我国城镇居民基本医疗和城镇居民社会养老保险，享受社会保险待遇。
91915fdfb630a9e8586a73c7c2d9c2fc7a451686.translatedText: Regarding participation in social security, the "Measures" clearly state that a "green card" can be used as a valid identity document to handle social insurance participation procedures. At the same time, it embodies the principle of "national treatment" and clarifies that "green card" holders who live in the country but are not employed and meet relevant requirements can also participate in my country's basic medical care for urban residents and social pension insurance for urban residents and enjoy social insurance benefits.

e4eff81d8225403e2636f62ea48c871aa469fbbd.sourceText: 《办法》规定，”可按照《住房公积金管理条例》等规定，在工作地缴存和使用住房公积金，离开该地区时，可按规定办理住房公积金的提取或转移手续”，即持”绿卡”人员在住房公积金方面与中国公民享有同等待遇。
e4eff81d8225403e2636f62ea48c871aa469fbbd.translatedText: The "Measures" stipulate that "housing provident funds can be deposited and used at the place of work in accordance with the "Housing Provident Fund Management Regulations" and other regulations. When leaving the area, the housing provident fund can be withdrawn or transferred according to regulations." That is, "green card" holders enjoy the same treatment as Chinese citizens in terms of housing provident funds.

7afdf4f9360cb50e9e97fc5a0c0dd967821fb59b.sourceText: 《办法》还规定，持”绿卡”外国人在缴纳所得税、办理金融业务、进行国内商旅消费、申请机动车驾驶证等方面都享受中国公民同等待遇。
7afdf4f9360cb50e9e97fc5a0c0dd967821fb59b.translatedText: The "Measures" also stipulate that foreigners holding "green cards" enjoy the same treatment as Chinese citizens in paying income tax, handling financial services, conducting domestic business travel, and applying for motor vehicle driving licenses.

Park). The Phoenix Ancestors and Soldiers Memorial Cemetery once buried a group of the earliest Chinese who came to Arizona. 75dbb3663200e42de00d193d074f9ec4cd2fbc21.translatedText: Qi Ruhong: Moving to a new home to celebrate one year old Phoenix City Qi Ruhong The atmosphere of the Lunar New Year is strong, and it has not dissipated for nearly a month in Greater Phoenix, Arizona. Various overseas Chinese communities...

a97d47c164d56661c51bb93257319717446a185f.sourceText: 农曆新春的气氛浓郁，在亚利桑那大凤凰城将近一个月还没有散去，各侨社的春宴陆续有来，广东俗语有云：「有心唔怕迟，三月拜年时。」正符合此间侨社的写照。围绕着华越人士的圈子裡，一直洋溢兴奋景象；展现在每个人的仪态上，总是堆满欢笑容颜，恭贺新禧的声音络绎不绝，显然春醒笑靥生，春回大地，万象更新，到处喜气洋洋！
a97d47c164d56661c51bb93257319717446a185f.translatedText: The atmosphere of the Chinese New Year has been strong, and it has not dissipated for nearly a month in Greater Phoenix, Arizona. Spring banquets from various overseas Chinese communities have come one after another. There is a Cantonese proverb: "If you have a good intention, you are not afraid of being late, and you will pay New Year's greetings in March." This is in line with the portrayal of the overseas Chinese communities here. The circle surrounding the Huayue people is always filled with excitement; everyone's demeanor is always full of smiles, and there is an endless stream of congratulatory voices for the New Year. It is obvious that spring is waking up with smiles, spring is returning to the earth, everything is renewed, and everyone is full of joy!

eae2046d6a58480d1315bb6b1a6e133f95358dea.sourceText: 整个大环境无比愉悦，加上家庭间天伦之乐，让许多亲友开心过年，简直阳春璀璨，新岁亨通。这个戊戌狗年旺旺，我也陶醉于春节带来的欢欣，太座更感心境快慰，享受祖母与外祖母辈份的趣味，弄孙寻乐。
eae2046d6a58480d1315bb6b1a6e133f95358dea.translatedText: The whole environment is extremely pleasant, and the family happiness makes many relatives and friends celebrate the New Year happily. It is a bright spring and a prosperous new year. In this prosperous Year of the Dog, I am also intoxicated by the joy brought by the Spring Festival. Taizu feels even more relieved, enjoying the fun of the grandmothers and grandchildren, and having fun with the grandchildren.

2e0015f39f3bbfc315ebdf728aead8a2c1fdd628.sourceText: 年纪老迈，最大的快乐莫过于看到儿女生活稳定，小孙平安成长。最值得一提的，在迎接戊戌春节的时候，女儿国欣告知，在丁酉除夕当日，签署了购买新居手续，过年后随即择吉乔迁入住，同时为女儿慧嫺举办週岁生日庆典。啊啊！这真是个好消息，适逢盛会的安排，可谓双喜齐来；在新春吉庆日子裡，增添欢乐气氛，喜气盈门，让亲友同分享，温馨满人间！
2e0015f39f3bbfc315ebdf728aead8a2c1fdd628.translatedText: As I grow older, the greatest joy is to see my children live a stable life and my grandchildren grow up safely. The most noteworthy thing to mention is that when welcoming the Spring Festival of 1898, her daughter Guoxin informed that on Dingyou’s New Year’s Eve, she signed the procedures for purchasing a new home, and immediately chose an auspicious move to move in after the New Year. At the same time, she held a birthday celebration for her daughter Hui Xian. Ah! This is really good news. The arrangement coincides with the grand event, which can be said to be a double happiness. In the auspicious days of the New Year, it adds a joyful atmosphere, fills the door with joy, allows relatives and friends to share it, and fills the world with warmth!

d8ee96fe68a96c4577a2c6e2af1f28bbf0fc5b44.sourceText: 慧嫺外孙女于丁酉年二月十四日出生，阳曆是三月十一日，以农曆计算还有三个星期才满週岁，但今年阳曆三月十一日刚好是星期日，遂决定以此日庆祝，那就最适宜邀请亲戚莅临联欢。而庆祝的前夕，是农曆正月廿三日星期六，黄太亲家查看曆法，附注是适宜乔迁新居吉日，乃嘱咐儿子光汉遵照指示搬迁入住。这样一来
d8ee96fe68a96c4577a2c6e2af1f28bbf0fc5b44.translatedText: Hui Xian's granddaughter was born on February 14, Ding You year, which is March 11 according to the Gregorian calendar. According to the lunar calendar, she still has three weeks to turn one year old. However, March 11 this year happens to be a Sunday, so she decided to celebrate on this day. It would be the best time to invite relatives to the party. The eve of the celebration was Saturday, the 23rd day of the first month of the lunar calendar. Mrs. Huang's family checked the calendar and noted that it was an auspicious day for moving to a new home. They asked their son Guanghan to follow the instructions and move in. In this way,

6f97ae2d39bef60bc4ab65a5af41cff56fba2e1f.sourceText: ，乔迁新居与週岁庆典，连续两日内进行，原本平静的新春期间，顿时变成琐事繁杂，忙得不可开交。我和太座担心所有事物来不及处理，星期六前往协助搬迁零星家具，清理新居杂物；星期日又前往摆设檯椅，放置食物，准备迎宾宴客，又是忙个没完没了。
6f97ae2d39bef60bc4ab65a5af41cff56fba2e1f.translatedText: , the move to a new house and the first-year celebration were held in two consecutive days. The originally peaceful New Year period suddenly turned into a complicated and busy time. My wife and I were worried that we would not be able to deal with everything in time, so we went to help move the scattered furniture and clean up the clutter in the new house on Saturday. On Sunday, we went to set up tables and chairs, place food, and prepare to welcome guests. We were busy again.

ad80b988b74cca4b813abf8d4e83354199d5960a.sourceText: 人逢喜事精神爽！虽然忙碌得四肢劳累，腰酸背痛，心情还是很欢欣，很兴奋。看见女儿国欣和女婿光汉购置了宽敞的新居，乘着狗年旺旺的春节势头，乔迁入住，诚属天大喜事。而看见外孙女慧嫺快乐成长，坐在学行车内四处奔跑，咧开小嘴天真地笑，为她庆祝週岁生日，自更快慰满怀。回顾初出娘胎的婴孩照片，抱在手裡好像个玩具娃娃，如今转瞬一年，能够耍弄逗趣，恰似宝贝掌珠，真正值得庆祝。亲友莅临这个欢宴聚会，除了祝福週岁天真可爱的婴孩，还要参观宽阔广大的房屋，人人谈笑风生，满堂愉悦。
ad80b988b74cca4b813abf8d4e83354199d5960a.translatedText: People feel refreshed when happy events happen! Although my limbs were tired from the busy work and my back was sore, I was still very happy and excited. It is a great joy to see my daughter Guo Xin and son-in-law Guang Han buying a spacious new home and taking advantage of the momentum of the Spring Festival in the Year of the Dog to move in. And seeing my granddaughter Hui Xian growing up happily, running around in the school car, grinning innocently, celebrating her first birthday, I feel so happy. Looking back at the photos of the baby when he was just born, he looked like a toy doll in his hands. Now, one year later, he is able to play with and play with, just like a baby in the palm of his hand. This is truly worthy of celebration. Relatives and friends come to this festive gathering. In addition to blessing the innocent and lovely one-year-old baby, they also visit the spacious house. Everyone is talking and laughing, and the whole house is full of joy.

58e44c115d0dce24b04539c38d9a6cea3c5c3693.sourceText: 女儿乔迁新居，外孙女庆祝週岁，并没有在酒店大摆筵席，只是订购越南美食，比萨薄饼，烤鸭烧肉贵妃鸡厖以自助餐方式，在新居内简单进行。女儿觉得这些日子很多朋友不停应酬侨界的春宴活动，不愿打搅过多朋友，不想太舖张，只邀请双方家长的亲戚以及几位往来密切的好友，纵使如此，宾客也超越六十之众，整座新居热闹哄哄，尤其压轴庆祝慧嫺週岁生日的一刻，点燃烛光在蛋糕上，齐唱生日快乐的歌曲，围观拍照的叫唤此起彼落，让晚宴进入最兴奋的高潮，留下人生最美好的形象，我这个外祖父，竟然乐到笑甩掉了牙齿，呵呵呵呵厖失礼！失礼！
58e44c115d0dce24b04539c38d9a6cea3c5c3693.translatedText: My daughter moved into a new house and my granddaughter celebrated her first birthday. They did not hold a big banquet in the hotel. They just ordered Vietnamese food, pizza, and roast duck, roasted pork, chicken, and a simple buffet in the new house. My daughter felt that many of her friends were attending the spring banquets of the overseas Chinese community these days, so she did not want to disturb too many friends or be too extravagant, so she only invited relatives of both parents and a few close friends. Even so, the number of guests exceeded sixty, and the whole new residence was bustling, especially for the grand finale. On the occasion of wishing Hui Xian her first birthday, she lit candles on the cake and sang the song "Happy Birthday" together, while people watching and calling for photos came one after another. The dinner reached its most exciting climax and left the most beautiful image in life. My grandfather was so happy that he lost his teeth with laughter. Hahahaha, that's rude! Discourteous!

e111772f9fc7a8964de072c63badac6135d80e1a.sourceText: 6 月 19 日至 22 日，亚省时报 副社长甄凯婴与 来自五大洲 20 个国家和地区近 40 家知名华文媒体的总编、社长和编辑、记者， 完成了在上海复旦大学新闻学院的研讨后，前往四川 省阿坝州参加 ” 文化中国 海外知名华文媒体聚焦四川藏区新生活” 活动。
e111772f9fc7a8964de072c63badac6135d80e1a.translatedText: From June 19 to 22, Zhen Kaiying, deputy president of the Alberta Times, and nearly 40 editors-in-chief, presidents, editors, and reporters from 20 countries and regions on five continents, completed seminars at the School of Journalism at Fudan University in Shanghai, and went to Aba Prefecture, Sichuan Province to participate in the "Cultural China. Well-known overseas Chinese media focus on new life in Tibetan areas of Sichuan" event.

e5c852a868258d1f0203bba2ffe5119d732be357.sourceText: 此次名为” 文化中国 海外知名华文媒体聚焦四川藏区新生活” 的采访活动，由中国国务院侨办宣传司和四川省政府侨办、新闻办主办，采访团在 4 天时间内，赴四川阿坝州红原县、若尔盖县，采访牧民定居点、大骨疾病综合防治移民搬迁点、精品旅游村、国家牧草种植基地，并参观九曲黄河第一湾、达扎寺书院、花湖景区等，报道藏区经济社会发展、文化保护情况、地震灾后重建以及成兰铁路建设状况。
e5c852a868258d1f0203bba2ffe5119d732be357.translatedText: The interview event titled "Cultural China. Well-known overseas Chinese media focus on new life in Tibetan areas of Sichuan" was hosted by the Propaganda Department of the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the State Council of China and the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office and Information Office of the Sichuan Provincial Government. The interview team was held on 4 Within three days, we went to Hongyuan County and Ruoergai County, Aba Prefecture, Sichuan, to interview herder settlements, resettlement sites for comprehensive prevention and treatment of bone disease, boutique tourist villages, and national pasture planting bases. We also visited the first bay of the Jiuqu Yellow River, Dazha Monastery Academy, Huahu Scenic Area, etc., and reported on the economic and social development, cultural protection, post-earthquake reconstruction in Tibetan areas, and the construction status of the Chengdu-Lanzhou Railway.

c088959ff6026323503ce555646d011f5c41ae7e.sourceText: 四川省人大常委会副主任郭永祥会见华文媒体代表
c088959ff6026323503ce555646d011f5c41ae7e.translatedText: Deputy Director of the Standing Committee of the Sichuan Provincial People's Congress Guo Yongxiang met with Chinese media representatives

d07b5d86350cf36677f3fc2774dd9f82da7967b0.sourceText: 四川省人大常委会副主任郭永祥在会见华文媒体代表时，简要介绍了四川基本情况、汶川地震抗震救灾情况、经济发展情况以及藏区牧民定居行动计划暨帐篷新生活行动。他希望华文媒体代表深入藏区基层，了解藏区的真实情况，亲身感受藏区的发展变化。
d07b5d86350cf36677f3fc2774dd9f82da7967b0.translatedText: When meeting with representatives of the Chinese media, Guo Yongxiang, Deputy Director of the Standing Committee of the Sichuan Provincial People's Congress, briefly introduced the basic situation of Sichuan, the Wenchuan earthquake relief situation, economic development, and the Tibetan herdsmen settlement action plan and tent new life action. He hoped that Chinese media representatives would go deep into the grassroots in Tibetan areas to understand the real situation in Tibetan areas and experience the development and changes in Tibetan areas first-hand.

04d60f413236fcf12560b0fe557f7ea10cadbfdb.sourceText: 郭永祥介绍说，四川省藏区包括甘孜、阿坝、凉山 3 个州 32 个藏区县，面积近 25 万平方公里，占全省总面积的一半以上，拥有人口 187 万人， 其中藏族人口 124 万人，藏族人口仅次于西藏自治区，是中国第二大藏区。近年来，四川省大力发展藏区经济，改善藏区民众生产生活水平，先后启动实施了” 牧民定居行动计划暨帐篷新生活行动” 、” 藏区?+3?/FONT> 免费中等职业教育计划” 和” 四川藏区卫生事业发展计划” 等，使藏民生活有了翻天覆地的改变 。
04d60f413236fcf12560b0fe557f7ea10cadbfdb.translatedText: Guo Yongxiang said that the Tibetan areas in Sichuan Province include 32 Tibetan areas and counties in the three prefectures of Garze, Ngaba and Liangshan, covering an area of ​​nearly 250,000 square kilometers, accounting for more than half of the total area of ​​the province, and with a population of 1.87 million, including 1.24 million Tibetan people. The Tibetan population is second only to the Tibet Autonomous Region, making it the second largest Tibetan area in China. In recent years, Sichuan Province has vigorously developed the economy of Tibetan areas and improved the production and living standards of people in Tibetan areas. It has successively launched and implemented the "Herders Settlement Action Plan and New Life in Tents Action Plan", the "Tibetan Areas Free Secondary Vocational Education Plan" and the "Sichuan Tibetan Areas Health Care Development Plan", etc., which have brought about earth-shaking changes in the lives of Tibetan people.

a55165f54dd430d64559234ffea118a3b47838c3.sourceText: 在完成这次对藏区经济文化发展的实地考察后，甄凯婴表示，将感受转化成文字，尽快与读者分享藏区民俗和牧民新生活的现况。
a55165f54dd430d64559234ffea118a3b47838c3.translatedText: After completing this on-the-spot investigation of the economic and cultural development of Tibetan areas, Zhen Kaiying said that he would translate his feelings into words and share with readers the current status of Tibetan folk customs and the new life of herdsmen as soon as possible.

c75a01c1a4d9b060731cd10e32e65b7da35eab82.sourceText: 陈琴：“三八妇女节有感” 凤凰城 陈琴 北美女人作家协会在今天 ” 华联 ” 主办的三八妇女节团拜会上演唱了大家熟悉的老歌 ” 年轻的朋友来相会 ” 。八十年代年轻的我们如今已步入了中、老年。上周末当我们聚在一起练唱这首歌时，大家议论到歌曲中 ” 为祖国，为四化，流过多少汗，回首往事心中可有愧？ ” 有一姐妹说：我们在海外为祖国做贡献了吗? 北美女人作家协会创始人风霞姐妺说: ” 我们在国外教中文就是为传扬中国文化作贡献啊！” 风霞曾带领北美妇女出版过两本有关中国妇女来美国生活的亲身经历和体会的书，她和她的先生还创办了孟子中文学校，正为传扬中国文化作贡献。 这个话题在我心中已萦绕多年。我一直在想在国外为中国做点什么。今天在微信上看到国内朋友发的 ARJ21 飞机飞过北京机场上空的照片，我倍感亲切: 我曾经在美国霍尼韦尔公司参与了为第一架中国支线客机控制系统设计和实施工作，也是唯一一个华裔女工程师在霍尼韦尔参加了它最早期的设计，并帮助中国商飞和霍尼韦尔的合作和沟通。特别是一〇、一一年间我受到大飞机事业的感召，回国为中国商飞服务了两年。去年年㡳这架支线客机终于通过了适航取证，其中也有我的一份贡献。而现在我又在从事中国第一架干线客机的飞行控制系统的设计和实施，我会为中国的航空事业高速发展而努力。 其实，我们这些华裔妇女都在不同的岗位上为中国直接或间接地做着贡献，我们问心无愧！
c75a01c1a4d9b060731cd10e32e65b7da35eab82.translatedText: Chen Qin: “Feelings on Women’s Day” Phoenix Chen Qin North American Association of Women Writers today at “Hualian” The well-known old song "Young Friends Come to Meet" was sung at the Women's Day group reception hosted by the group. We who were young in the 1980s have now entered middle-aged and old age. When we got together to practice singing this song last weekend, everyone discussed the song, "For the motherland and the four modernizations, how much sweat have you shed, do you feel guilty looking back on the past?" One sister said: Have we contributed to the motherland overseas? Sister Fengxia, founder of the North American Women Writers Association, said: "We teach Chinese abroad to contribute to the spread of Chinese culture!" Fengxia has led North American women to publish two books about the personal experiences and experiences of Chinese women living in the United States. She and her husband also founded the Mencius Chinese School and are making contributions to the spread of Chinese culture. This topic has been on my mind for many years. I have been thinking about doing something for China abroad. Today I saw on WeChat a photo of an ARJ21 aircraft flying over the Beijing Airport posted by a domestic friend, and I felt very cordial: I once participated in the design and implementation of the control system for the first Chinese regional airliner at Honeywell in the United States. I was also the only Chinese female engineer to participate in its earliest design at Honeywell, and helped the cooperation and communication between COMAC and Honeywell. Especially in 10 and 11, I was inspired by the large aircraft industry and returned to China to serve COMAC for two years. Last year, this regional airliner finally passed the airworthiness certification, and I also made a contribution to it. Now I am engaged in the design and implementation of the flight control system of China's first mainline passenger aircraft. I will work hard for the rapid development of China's aviation industry. In fact, we Chinese women have contributed directly or indirectly to China in different positions, and we have a clear conscience!

On the 28th, U.S. Ambassador to China Gary Locke visited the new US Consulate General in Guangzhou for the first time and inspected the new building of the U.S. Consulate General in Guangzhou...

06e98b6f2d5a81a4b3407beff67b97d43cd6a096.sourceText: 中国公民赴美签证有望放宽至五年多次 28日，美国驻华大使骆家辉首次莅临美国驻穗总领事馆新馆视察，并向广州图书馆赠送80本前美驻穗总领事理查?#23041;廉斯的回忆录。 南都记者谭庆驹摄 ”下一步我们的工作就是给中国公民提供多年多次的签证，现在的签证是一年多次，我们希望给中国商人、学生和游客5年多次的有效入境签证”，美国驻华大使骆家辉28日首次莅临美国驻穗总领事馆新馆视察。他表示，减少签证等候时间、改善签证流程是他2011年上任以来的重要目标之一。 ”我2011年8月就任(美国)驻华大使，我工作的一个重要目标就是把签证等候时间降下来”，骆家辉说，”我就任大使后的一个半月内，签证等候时间已降到了5天”。他称，”现在的签证是一年多次，我们希望对中国商人、学生和游客给予5年多次的有效入境签证”。 启德教育广州公司美国服务顾问主管黎沛杰介绍，目前中国内地留学生办理赴美学生签证，采用一年多次往返政策。一旦美驻华使领馆对中国内地学生也实行五年多次往返的政策，中国留学生赴美签证手续将简化。赴美留学生将可办一次签证、在5年内实现多次往返，则无需再为过往签证失效后短期停留中国但需重新签证而发愁了。 骆家辉还表示，按照现在的赴美签证流程，当申请人签证获批后，一般是去最近的中信银行领取签证。未来，美国大使馆考虑直接把签证寄到申请人家中。 美国驻穗总领事馆的领区包括广东、广西、福建和海南四省份，是美国在境外所有领事馆中非移民签证服务处理量最大的一个。 花絮 ”回”广州是为了吃地道芝麻糊 28日，骆家辉还在美国驻穗新领馆出席对广州市图书馆的赠书仪式。所赠书籍是80本美中恢复正常邦交后首任美国驻广州总领事理查?#23041;廉斯的回忆录。”广州图书馆非常漂亮，下次我要找时间进去看看”，骆家辉在活动现场还不忘盛赞美领馆新馆的”邻居”。 当日是骆家辉第二次访问广州，也是首次莅临美领馆新馆舍。他说，他的祖父和父亲都出生在广东，他母亲则来自香港，每次回广东他都会感到很高兴，”我一直非常想来广州，因为在广州可吃到地道的芝麻糊，而北京吃到的只有pow der(面粉)”。
06e98b6f2d5a81a4b3407beff67b97d43cd6a096.translatedText: The visa for Chinese citizens to visit the United States is expected to be relaxed to multiple times of five years On the 28th, U.S. Ambassador to China Gary Locke visited the new U.S. Consulate General in Guangzhou for the first time and presented 80 copies of the memoirs of former U.S. Consul General in Guangzhou Richard Williams to the Guangzhou Library. Photo by Nandu reporter Tan Qingju “Our next step is to provide multi-year, multiple-entry visas for Chinese citizens. The current visas are multiple-entry visas per year. We hope to provide Chinese businessmen, students and tourists with valid multiple-entry visas for five years.” US Ambassador to China Gary Locke visited the new US Consulate General in Guangdong for the first time on the 28th. He said that reducing visa waiting times and improving the visa process has been one of his important goals since taking office in 2011. "I took office as the (U.S.) ambassador to China in August 2011. One of my important goals in my work is to reduce the visa waiting time," Locke said. "Within one and a half months after I took office as the ambassador, the visa waiting time has been reduced to 5 days." He said, "The current visa is for multiple entries per year. We hope to grant valid multiple entry visas for five years to Chinese businessmen, students and tourists." Li Peijie, head of U.S. service consulting at Kai Tak Education Guangzhou Company, said that currently, mainland Chinese students applying for student visas to the United States adopt a multiple-entry-a-year policy. Once the U.S. embassy and consulates in China also implement the five-year multiple-entry policy for mainland Chinese students, the visa procedures for Chinese students studying in the United States will be simplified. International students going to the United States will be able to apply for a visa once and make multiple trips within 5 years, so they no longer need to worry about getting a new visa for a short-term stay in China after the previous visa expires. Locke also said that according to the current visa process for the United States, when the applicant's visa is approved, he usually goes to the nearest CITIC Bank to collect the visa. In the future, the U.S. Embassy is considering sending visas directly to applicants’ homes. The U.S. Consulate General in Guangzhou covers the four provinces of Guangdong, Guangxi, Fujian and Hainan. It handles the largest number of non-immigrant visa services among all U.S. consulates abroad. Highlights: The purpose of "returning" to Guangzhou was to eat authentic sesame paste. On the 28th, Locke also attended the book donation ceremony to the Guangzhou Library at the US Consulate in Guangzhou. The donated books are 80 memoirs of Richard Williams, the first U.S. Consul General in Guangzhou after the United States and China resumed normal diplomatic relations. "The Guangzhou Library is very beautiful. I will find time to go in and take a look next time." Locke did not forget to praise the "neighbors" of the new consulate at the event. That day was Locke's second visit to Guangzhou and his first visit to the new US Consulate building. He said that his grandfather and father were both born in Guangdong, and his mother was from Hong Kong. He would be very happy every time he returned to Guangdong, "I have always wanted to come to Guangzhou because you can eat authentic sesame paste in Guangzhou, but all you can eat in Beijing is powder (flour)."

3e212f8484cd0a5113e2819d9bd0dc881ad5b966.sourceText: （凤凰城中文学校 来稿） 五月五日凤凰城中文学校在梅莎社区大学举行了2013 年的毕业典礼。在毕业生入场陆续就坐之后，程秀玲校长带着感慨及依依不捨的心情为毕业生致词。今年一共有九位毕业生：活泼大方的徐安莉，幽默风趣的张仲棣，蕙质兰心的傅世婷，才学兼备的吴易霖，乐观进取的郭柏邑，秀外慧中的张仲嘉，品学兼优的岳康文，能歌善舞的黄凯和五育兼备的文及恩。最难能可贵地是徐安莉，吴易霖和岳康文同学从三岁到中文学校学前班就读，一路坚持到现在。其他的毕业生也都有十多年学习中文的历史，说起中文也是非常流利。
3e212f8484cd0a5113e2819d9bd0dc881ad5b966.translatedText: (Contributed by Phoenix Chinese School) On May 5th, Phoenix Chinese School held its 2013 graduation ceremony at Mesa Community College. After the graduates entered and took their seats, Principal Cheng Xiuling delivered a speech to the graduates with emotion and reluctance. There are nine graduates this year: Xu Anli, who is lively and generous, Zhang Zhongdi, who is humorous, Fu Shiting, who is good at singing and dancing, Wu Yilin, who is both talented and knowledgeable, Guo Boyi, who is optimistic and enterprising, Zhang Zhongjia, who is beautiful and smart, Yue Kangwen, who is good at both morals and academics, Huang Kai, who is good at singing and dancing, and Wen Ji'en, who is good at five educations. The most commendable ones are Xu Anli, Wu Yilin and Yue Kangwen who attended the preschool class of the Chinese school from the age of three and have persisted all the way until now. Other graduates have also studied Chinese for more than ten years and speak Chinese very fluently.

0d3e3b6a78c8f8481069792e8ac33d833fe6e9cb.sourceText: 毕业生和毕业生家长老师们合影
0d3e3b6a78c8f8481069792e8ac33d833fe6e9cb.translatedText: A group photo of graduates and their parents and teachers

fb886573063ae6f00b600de4b4eb137a11973d7e.translatedText: Mr. Deng Chaoju delivered a speech

d862a5b1b525e7428d4d74b2d3731d91273ff83e.sourceText: 本校很荣幸邀请到前美国白宫亚太裔员会委员邓朝驹先生来参加毕业典礼，并分享他的宝贵的人生经验。邓先生不仅在商业界展露头角，更积极参与侨界活动，不仅是美国华人福利会西南区负责人，也是亚利桑那州商业改进局常务董事。他鼓励在场的毕业生在毕业后持续学习中文，相信这一项技能，会是他们日后求职就业的利器。
d862a5b1b525e7428d4d74b2d3731d91273ff83e.translatedText: Our school is honored to invite Mr. Deng Chaoju, former member of the White House Asian and Pacific Islander Council, to attend the graduation ceremony and share his valuable life experience. Mr. Deng not only shows his prominence in the business community, but also actively participates in activities in the overseas Chinese community. He is not only the director of the Southwest Region of the American Chinese Welfare Association, but also the managing director of the Arizona Better Business Bureau. He encouraged the graduates present to continue learning Chinese after graduation, believing that this skill would be a useful tool for them to find jobs in the future.

d03315590bfd66b914ae0000221963701de515bf.sourceText: 毕业生合照 接着由毕业班导师卢贞玲老师介绍毕业生。学富五车的卢老师，用每一位毕业生的照片为他们製作个人成长的投影片，并让每一位毕业生朗读一段诗词，和发表毕业感言。卢老师藉由不同的诗词，讲解诗中的涵意，从晏殊《蝶恋花》”昨夜西风凋碧树。独上高楼，望尽天涯路。”和常常用来形容男女感情的柳永 ”衣带渐宽终不悔，为伊消得人憔悴。”和辛弃疾 ”众裡寻他千百度。蓦然回首，那人却在，灯火阑珊处。”以及众所周知的 苏轼 ；李白〈将进酒〉等等，最后在崔颢 ”昔人已乘黄鹤去，此地空馀黄鹤楼。 黄鹤一去不复返，白云千载空悠悠。”结束了这一段诗词分享。 在这九位毕业生所发表的感言中，竟不约而同表示他们刚开始都不愿意来上中文学校，而今回想起来，反而感谢父母的坚持，和老师们谆谆教诲，让他们持续了多年中文学习，也认识这些好朋友。毕业生发表感言之后，他们一起合唱表演”隐形的翅膀”。 希望藉由这首歌鼓励他们勇敢坚强，面对困难，追逐梦想，”隐形的翅膀”会带你遨翔天际达到目标。接着学校颁发毕业证书与礼物，最后在校生合唱”祝福”－”伤离别，离别虽然在眼前。说再见，再见不会太遥远。 若有缘，有缘就能期待明天，你和我重逢在灿烂的季节 。”将毕业典礼带入尾声。最后在”放心去飞”歌声中祝福毕业生展翅高飞，鹏程万里！ 2013年凤凰城中文学校秋季班将于8月11日注册开学，如果您想多认识凤凰城中文学校，或是想加入这个大家庭，请与校长程秀玲联络(480-620-1982) 或参观学校网页(http://www.clsphoenix.org/)。
d03315590bfd66b914ae0000221963701de515bf.translatedText: Group photo of the graduates. Then the graduating class tutor, Ms. Lu Zhenling, introduced the graduates. Teacher Lu, who has a wealth of knowledge, used the photos of each graduate to make a slideshow of their personal growth, and asked each graduate to read a poem and deliver a graduation speech. Teacher Lu used different poems to explain the meaning of the poems, starting from Yan Shu's "Butterflies in Love with Flowers" "Last night the west wind withered the green trees. Going up to the tall building alone, I can see all the way to the end of the world." and Liu Yong, which is often used to describe the relationship between men and women. "The crowd searched for him thousands of times. Suddenly looking back, he was there, in the dimly lit place." and the well-known Su Shi; Li Bai's "About to Enter the Wine" and so on. Finally, Cui Hao ended this poem sharing by saying, "The people of the past have gone on the Yellow Crane, and the Yellow Crane Tower is empty here. The Yellow Crane is gone and never returns, and the white clouds are empty for thousands of years." In the speeches given by these nine graduates, they unanimously said that they were not willing to attend a Chinese school at the beginning. But now that they think about it, they are grateful to their parents for their persistence and the teachers’ earnest teachings, which allowed them to continue studying Chinese for many years and make these good friends. After the graduates gave speeches, they sang "Invisible Wings" together. I hope that this song will encourage them to be brave and strong, face difficulties, and chase their dreams. The "invisible wings" will take you to soar into the sky and achieve your goals. Then the school issued graduation certificates and gifts, and finally the students sang "Blessings" - "It hurts to say goodbye, although the parting is in front of you. Say goodbye, goodbye will not be too far away. If you are destined, you can look forward to tomorrow, you and I will meet again in the glorious season." The graduation ceremony came to an end. Finally, in the song "Fly with confidence", I wish the graduates to fly high and achieve great success! Registration for the 2013 Phoenix Chinese School fall class will start on August 11. If you want to know more about Phoenix Chinese School or want to join this big family, please contact the principal Cheng Xiuling (480-620-1982) or visit the school website (http://www.clsphoenix.org/).

9621f0c5fc8975b290c642487b5b255b8827424e.translatedText: > Liu Yong's clothes are getting wider and wider, but he never regrets it, because of Yi's disappearance, people are haggard.

af67f29a93a5857a67f01aa1bed432dfe88d8473.sourceText: 王维〈辛夷坞〉 木末芙蓉花，山中发红萼。 涧户寂无人，纷纷开且落。
af67f29a93a5857a67f01aa1bed432dfe88d8473.translatedText: Wang Wei's "Xinyiwu" The hibiscus flowers are at the end of the wood, and the calyx is red in the mountains. There is no one in the stream. They open and close one after another.

6ae136a14ea2e5442b339033620a904de7fa52b0.sourceText: 苏轼 人有悲欢离合， 月有阴晴圆缺， 此事古难全。但愿人长久， 千里共婵娟。
6ae136a14ea2e5442b339033620a904de7fa52b0.translatedText: Su Shi People have joys and sorrows, and the moon waxes and wanes. This is a difficult thing in ancient times. I hope that people will live long and share the beauty of the moon thousands of miles apart.

c330c8b67baa9febf11bb7615303c505f49c2696.sourceText: 李白〈将进酒〉 人生得意须尽欢， 莫使金樽空对月。 天生我材必有用， 千金散尽还复来
c330c8b67baa9febf11bb7615303c505f49c2696.translatedText: Li Bai <About to Drink> If you are proud of life, you must enjoy it to the fullest. Do not let the golden bottle stand empty against the moon. My talents are destined to be useful, and I will come back after all the gold I have spent.

0d81e07ec0714a2ac2335b438eec8d73f536520e.sourceText: 李商隐《嫦娥》 云母屏风烛影深， 长河渐落晓星沉。嫦娥应悔偷灵药， 碧海青天夜夜心。
0d81e07ec0714a2ac2335b438eec8d73f536520e.translatedText: Li Shangyin's "Chang'e" The candle shadow on the mica screen is deep, The long river is gradually setting and the dawn stars are sinking. Chang'e should regret stealing the elixir, and her heart will be filled with blue sea and blue sky every night.

9991eb31095e27d61289902ca694aa589974adfb.sourceText: 金庸《水龙吟》 敝屣荣华，浮云生死，此身何惧！教单于折箭， 六军辟易，奋英雄怒！
9991eb31095e27d61289902ca694aa589974adfb.translatedText: Jin Yong's "The Song of the Water Dragon" The glory of my body is like the floating clouds of life and death, why should I be afraid of this body! Teach the Chanyu how to break arrows, the six armies are ready to change, and the heroic heroes are angry!

984af06cb66f470d059bf5dfdfaf4832e85c543e.sourceText: 崔颢 昔人已乘黄鹤去， 此地空馀黄鹤楼。 黄鹤一去不复返， 白云千载空悠悠。
984af06cb66f470d059bf5dfdfaf4832e85c543e.translatedText: Cui Hao People in the past have gone by Yellow Crane, but the Yellow Crane Tower is empty here. The yellow crane is gone and never returns, and the white clouds remain empty for thousands of years.

9c455c553ff85d86b58975e2cb263364bbc4cbb5.sourceText: 隐秘的美国医疗””红包””:各种游说集团和利益链
9c455c553ff85d86b58975e2cb263364bbc4cbb5.translatedText: The hidden "red envelope" of American medical care: various lobbying groups and interest chains

ad20137893212cde89b3b681dcdcd9a0644e2569.sourceText: 隐秘的美国医疗””红包””:各种游说集团和利益链 不久前，美…
ad20137893212cde89b3b681dcdcd9a0644e2569.translatedText: The hidden "red envelope" of American medical care: various lobbying groups and interest chains Not long ago, the United States...

035f8cea2df24ac7e72dbea514ac0844ef63398e.sourceText: 不久前，美国加利福尼亚大学的研究人员在美国《自然》杂志上刊登文章称：糖有”毒”且成瘾，过量摄入糖类如同慢性自杀，建议像控制烟草一样控制糖。美国疾病控制中心的一份报告称，到2030年，42%的美国人都会超过肥胖线。接下去的20年内仅仅因肥胖导致的医疗费用就会达到五千多亿美元。糖在”催胖”美国人方面功劳不小。
035f8cea2df24ac7e72dbea514ac0844ef63398e.translatedText: Not long ago, researchers from the University of California published an article in the American "Nature" magazine saying that sugar is "poisonous" and addictive. Excessive intake of sugar is like chronic suicide. It is recommended to control sugar like tobacco. A report from the Centers for Disease Control states that by 2030, 42% of Americans will be obese. Over the next 20 years, the medical costs caused by obesity alone will reach more than $500 billion. Sugar has played a big role in making Americans fat.

36c097739e5de054f9a2d8f79eb67324bbab9077.sourceText: 由于糖农的强大游说攻势，光American Crystal Sugar一家每年的游说费用就以百万美元计，导致美国市场常年对进口糖实行严格配额控制。其结果是美国糖价(5285,-90.00,-1.67%)远远高于市场价格，芝加哥那些做儿童食品的都跑加拿大或墨西哥去了。糖价贵了，没力气跑加拿大或墨西哥的食品企业就开始找便宜的替代品。他们找到了另一个强大的游说集团：中西部种玉米(2392,8.00,0.34%)的大农场主。每五年国会讨论农业补贴法案期间，也是成千上百的组织前去游说的时候。加州伯克利教授Michael Pollan估计，在过去的十五年里，玉米农场收到了730亿美元的政府补贴。结果是美国有很多玉米，便宜的玉米被做成了玉米糖浆，为了使尽量少的玉米糖浆达到同样的甜度，玉米糖浆又被层层处理成浓缩玉米糖浆（HFCS）。美国几乎所有的包装食品都含有HFCS，一勺甜麦片入口，HFCS直冲肝脏。
36c097739e5de054f9a2d8f79eb67324bbab9077.translatedText: Due to the strong lobbying campaign of sugar farmers, American Crystal Sugar alone spends millions of dollars in lobbying expenses every year, resulting in the U.S. market imposing strict quota controls on imported sugar all year round. As a result, the price of sugar in the United States (5285, -90.00, -1.67%) is much higher than the market price. Those who make children's food in Chicago have gone to Canada or Mexico. The price of sugar has become expensive, and food companies that cannot afford to go to Canada or Mexico have begun to look for cheaper alternatives. They found another powerful lobbying group: large corn farmers in the Midwest. Every five years when Congress discusses the farm subsidy bill, it is also the time when thousands of organizations go out to lobby. Michael Pollan, a professor in Berkeley, California, estimates that corn farms have received $73 billion in government subsidies over the past fifteen years. The result is that there is a lot of corn in the United States, and the cheap corn is made into corn syrup. In order to achieve the same sweetness with as little corn syrup as possible, the corn syrup is processed into layers of concentrated corn syrup (HFCS). Almost all packaged foods in the United States contain HFCS. A spoonful of sweet cereal goes straight to your liver.

6e67007834f69655d37e789ffff1e4746fcef9ae.sourceText: 你说HFCS有健康隐患，导致糖尿病？这里还有一个游说大户，玉米加工协会花费三千万美金打广告做项目，证明糖就是糖，HFCS不能受歧视。今年它又耗资几千万企图将食品成分表上的HFCS改名成简单的玉米糖浆，不幸被否决了。但是谁敢说HFCS不是食物，咱们国会的游说队伍里见！我和我邻居吃了那么多HFCS，糖尿病患者比例逐年上升，医疗费用居高不下怎么办？
6e67007834f69655d37e789ffff1e4746fcef9ae.translatedText: You said HFCS has health risks and causes diabetes? There is also a major lobbyist here, the Corn Processing Association, which has spent $30 million on advertising and projects to prove that sugar is sugar and HFCS cannot be discriminated against. This year it spent tens of millions in an attempt to change the name of HFCS on food ingredient lists to simple corn syrup, but unfortunately it was rejected. But who dares to say that HFCS is not food? See you in the lobbying team of Congress! My neighbor and I have eaten so much HFCS. What should we do if the proportion of diabetics increases year by year and medical expenses remain high?

5966173e5aa59a1e3adbe57558319d58a5e950f9.sourceText: 在美国看病，价格高、手续复杂已不是新闻。一点小手术动辄上万美元，在每张医院账单背后，都是各方利益的争夺。据国会办公室和独立游说监督机构Center for Responsive Politics的资料，2008年至今，医疗业用于游说的费用超过了50亿美元，其中十大游说机构每年的花费就有一亿多。最有争议的恐怕当属全美医生协会（AMA）。很多人指责AMA通过严格控制行医执照来提高医疗行业的准入门槛，保证医生的高收入（亦即病人的高账单）。前几年各大超市陆续推出价廉物美的店内小诊所的时候，AMA就是有力的反对者。
5966173e5aa59a1e3adbe57558319d58a5e950f9.translatedText: It is no longer news that medical treatment in the United States is expensive and complicated. A minor surgery can easily cost tens of thousands of dollars. Behind every hospital bill, there is a competition for the interests of all parties. According to information from congressional offices and the Center for Responsive Politics, an independent lobbying watchdog, the medical industry has spent more than $5 billion on lobbying since 2008, with the top ten lobbying organizations spending more than $100 million each year. The most controversial one is probably the American Medical Association (AMA). Many people accuse the AMA of raising the barriers to entry in the medical industry by strictly controlling medical licenses and ensuring high incomes for doctors (that is, high bills for patients). In the past few years, when major supermarkets successively launched cheap and high-quality in-store clinics, AMA was a strong opponent.

b115335953a543d4305562859c196fc8b4f6ea9b.sourceText: 直接游说只是争夺的一部分。据National Journal透露，在奥巴马推出全民医疗方案那短短一年多时间里，全美医疗保险计划（美国保险业的游说组织）把一亿多美元通过美国商会转移到各种反对新法案的活动中。利益争夺也在各个州内上演。马萨诸塞州是医疗改革的先锋，所以各方游说也异常活跃。
b115335953a543d4305562859c196fc8b4f6ea9b.translatedText: Direct lobbying is only part of the battle. According to National Journal, in just over a year since Obama launched the universal health care plan, the National Health Insurance Plan (a lobbying organization for the U.S. insurance industry) transferred more than $100 million through the U.S. Chamber of Commerce to various activities opposing the new bill. Competition for interests is also taking place in various states. Massachusetts is a pioneer in health care reform, so lobbying from all parties is also extremely active.

9dc86028145ffe9cadf49239769ccd7b5c8bf8a3.sourceText: 明明白白的规则，就这样在各方势力的拉锯战中制定下来了。这些百万、千万甚至上亿的数字中，以及由于利益争夺而导致的一路飙升的医疗费用中，这些我们不知不觉的?#32654;国规则下的医疗红包?#65292;同中国人塞给医生的红包区别在哪里呢？
9dc86028145ffe9cadf49239769ccd7b5c8bf8a3.translatedText: The clear rules were formulated in the tug-of-war between the various forces. Among these numbers of millions, tens of millions or even hundreds of millions, as well as the soaring medical expenses due to competition for interests, what is the difference between these medical red envelopes that we unknowingly receive under Chinese rules and the red envelopes that Chinese people give to doctors?

dc941ffef8418537abe7b909789dffb70f3c794f.sourceText: 新移民“外来医”也可在美国执业
dc941ffef8418537abe7b909789dffb70f3c794f.translatedText: New immigrant "foreign doctors" can also practice in the United States

8df7835828fed9aded41129ff883aed0593ca132.sourceText: 新移民“外来医”也可在美国执业 ”外来医”也可在美国执业，就读海外医学院，费用比美国…
8df7835828fed9aded41129ff883aed0593ca132.translatedText: New immigrant "foreign doctors" can also practice in the United States. "Foreign doctors" can also practice in the United States and attend overseas medical schools, which are more expensive than the United States...

ac4ce108bdea3144c37ec361d555e9fd7cc75b07.sourceText: 去年在洛杉矶完成临床技能考试的中国大陆移民徐先生说，当天考场将近一半是毕业于母国医学院的中、韩、印、巴等国的”外来医”。徐先生指出，?#22269;内医师工作压力大、时间长、收入不高?#65292;?#38500;非名校医学院毕业，否则要进大城市、好医院很难?#65292;而且被美国承认的中国医学院数量不少，都是促使大陆医学院毕业生纷纷来美做”外来医”的因素。
ac4ce108bdea3144c37ec361d555e9fd7cc75b07.translatedText: Mr. Xu, an immigrant from mainland China who completed the clinical skills examination in Los Angeles last year, said that nearly half of the examination room that day were "foreign doctors" from China, South Korea, India, Pakistan and other countries who graduated from medical schools in their home countries. Mr. Xu pointed out that physicians have high work pressure, long hours, and low incomes. Unless they graduate from prestigious medical schools, it would be difficult for them to enter big cities and good hospitals. Moreover, there are many Chinese medical schools recognized by the United States, which are all factors that encourage graduates from mainland medical schools to come to the United States to work as "foreign doctors."

c98dbc6340530865ee5b77603702253f300a12bb.sourceText: 毕业于大陆东北地区一家非重点医学院的刘同学去年春季成功获得纽约上州的一个住院医机会。刘同学表示，目前在上海、北京、广州以及香港、台湾都有USMLE考点，可先在当地完成USMLE Step1以及Step2临床知识两部分考试，然后来美完成临床技能考试，再申请住院医、工作签证。
c98dbc6340530865ee5b77603702253f300a12bb.translatedText: Liu, who graduated from a non-key medical school in northeastern China, successfully obtained a residency opportunity in upstate New York last spring. Liu said that there are currently USMLE test centers in Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Hong Kong, and Taiwan. You can first complete the USMLE Step1 and Step2 clinical knowledge exams locally, and then come to the United States to complete the clinical skills exam, and then apply for residency and work visas.

9b47402b5000e71533563962fc08c9de85e88e70.sourceText: 还有部分已有母国博士学位的”外来医”通过申请博士后来美。毕业于北京大学生物系、目前就读洛杉矶加大生物学博士的康同学表示，学界里的确存在此种做法，相熟的北大医学部口腔专业毕业的两位学姐，来美后成功从博士、博士后转为牙医，去年圈子里又有一位华人博士后也转行牙医。
9b47402b5000e71533563962fc08c9de85e88e70.translatedText: There are also some "foreign doctors" who have doctorates in their home countries and come to the United States by applying for doctorates. Kang, who graduated from the Department of Biology at Peking University and is currently studying for a Ph.D. in Biology at the University of California, Los Angeles, said that this practice does exist in the academic world. Two acquaintances who graduated from the Department of Dentistry at Peking University School of Medicine successfully transitioned from Ph.D. and postdoc to dentistry after coming to the United States. Last year, another Chinese postdoc in the circle also switched to dentistry.

4c9466bea0aa6222858e661475c29c57b3a55bd3.sourceText: 仁爱医疗集团副总裁林元清指出，外国医学院毕业生要在美国执业，在语言、找住院医机会等方面，确实比本地同行困难许多，而且很大一部分竞争来自毕业于美国医学院、中英双语流利的华裔同行。
4c9466bea0aa6222858e661475c29c57b3a55bd3.translatedText: Lin Yuanqing, vice president of Renai Medical Group, pointed out that it is indeed much more difficult for foreign medical school graduates to practice in the United States than their local counterparts in terms of language and finding residency opportunities, and a large part of the competition comes from Chinese colleagues who graduated from American medical schools and are fluent in Chinese and English.

59a7fbb03f8ef65130ab15823f39a8312d79dfa8.sourceText: 但”外来医”也不是没有机会，林元清建议”多积累义工、见习经验，有助于提高申请住院医的成功机会，有时部分住院医做满就离开了，这时就有补缺的机会”，也可通过申请偏远的住院医项目，降低竞争激烈程度。
59a7fbb03f8ef65130ab15823f39a8312d79dfa8.translatedText: However, "foreign doctors" are not without opportunities. Lin Yuanqing suggested that "accumulating more volunteer and internship experience will help improve the chance of success in applying for residency. Sometimes some residents leave after completing their term, and then there will be opportunities to fill the vacancies." You can also apply for remote residency programs to reduce the intensity of competition.

2d6beda8f941b922970c2a819211f78b1e0ceb1c.sourceText: 省钱省时的快捷方式人人爱走，美国人也不例外。林元清透露，如今也有部分美国人纷纷到海外取攻读医学学位，再返回美国执业。
2d6beda8f941b922970c2a819211f78b1e0ceb1c.translatedText: Everyone loves shortcuts to save money and time, and Americans are no exception. Lin Yuanqing revealed that some Americans are now studying abroad for medical degrees and then returning to the United States to practice medicine.

e9eedc1737f55bd1e07bc38c84f872cc2b8af35b.sourceText: 一位华裔”外来医”透露，目前在亚洲国家有不少医学院开设了英文学位课程，主要面向计划毕业后到美国、加拿大做?#22806;来医?#30340;学生，其中有不少就是在本国没申请上医学院的美国人，但这部分”外来医”的整体学术水平、知识素质，都要低于美国本土医学院毕业生，以及在母国通过考试选拔进入医学院、再来美考照执业的新移民”外来医”
e9eedc1737f55bd1e07bc38c84f872cc2b8af35b.translatedText: A Chinese "foreign doctor" revealed that many medical schools in Asian countries currently offer English degree courses, mainly for students who plan to do medicine in the United States and Canada after graduation. Many of them are Americans who have not applied for medical school in their home countries. However, the overall academic level and knowledge quality of these "foreign doctors" are lower than those of domestic medical school graduates in the United States, as well as new immigrant "foreign doctors" who have passed examinations in their home countries to enter medical schools and then come to the United States to take the license to practice.

It started in China at the beginning of the year and by mid-to-late March, it had spread widely in Europe and the United States, causing people all over the world to suffer. Fried...

56441b557a8348246ee2bf477845d6dde3ad8012.sourceText: 2020年，由新冠病毒引发的疫情来势凶猛，年初在中国，至三月中下旬，已在欧美地区广为扩散，让世界各地民众饱受煎熬！
56441b557a8348246ee2bf477845d6dde3ad8012.translatedText: In 2020, the epidemic caused by the new coronavirus has been fierce. It started in China at the beginning of the year and by mid-to-late March, it had spread widely in Europe and the United States, causing people all over the world to suffer!

3350773d801988e7802ab5fe41cb5876f77dd8dc.sourceText: 鉴于疫情的䦉疟，二月份，亚省中国餐馆协会和本地多个华人华侨团体一样，发起了为祖国受灾的同胞的捐款活动，其义行得到了协会广大会员和社会各界的积极响应。在中餐馆协会和义工团队的努力下，首批医疗物资以民间对民间的形式，已发货去湖北襄阳急救中心，表达了海外华人对祖国同胞的关心和支持。
3350773d801988e7802ab5fe41cb5876f77dd8dc.translatedText: In view of the epidemic situation, in February, the Chinese Restaurant Association of Alberta, like many local Chinese and overseas Chinese groups, launched a donation activity for the compatriots affected by the disaster in the motherland. The charity event received positive response from the majority of members of the association and all walks of life. Thanks to the efforts of the Chinese Restaurant Association and the volunteer team, the first batch of medical supplies has been shipped to the Xiangyang Emergency Center in Hubei Province on a people-to-people basis, expressing the concern and support of overseas Chinese for our compatriots in the motherland.

0d4b716d77df4bbe6e48941b1044def20fd37ed2.sourceText: 但是，由于近日疫情急转直下，新冠病毒相当凶猛，至三月中旬，疫情已在美国迅速蔓延，让各行各业蒙受极大的损失！亚利桑那州也不能例外，目前所有的餐馆业从三月二十日起，为配合州政府的颁佈的新禁令，不再设置堂食，以防控新冠病毒的扩散。由于只能依靠外卖维持生意，也不知何时才能解封，至使广大的中餐协会成员忧心忡忡，生意也一落千丈。有鉴于此，亚省中国餐馆协会在此非常时期，经过审时度势的讨论，作出如下的决定：
0d4b716d77df4bbe6e48941b1044def20fd37ed2.translatedText: However, due to the rapid deterioration of the epidemic situation in recent days, the new coronavirus is quite ferocious. By mid-March, the epidemic had spread rapidly in the United States, causing all walks of life to suffer huge losses! Arizona is no exception. Currently, all restaurants will no longer set up dine-in restaurants starting from March 20 to comply with the new ban issued by the state government to prevent and control the spread of the new coronavirus. Since they can only rely on takeout to maintain their business, and they don't know when the lockdown will be lifted, the majority of Chinese restaurant association members are worried, and their business has plummeted. In view of this, during this extraordinary period, the Alberta Chinese Restaurant Association, after reviewing the situation and discussing the situation, made the following decision:

cfd7b404e6cbfc3fd188b101d174b577b0c19464.sourceText: 一、已运送去援助湖北襄阳防疫物资的费用，全部由亚省中国餐馆协会来承担。 二、由于中国疫情好转，而本地疫情加重，所筹到的款项不再对海外作出捐赠，而转为自身救助，现决定退还所有由会员和社会团体及善者仁翁捐出的每一笔善款，以作疫情损失之下的帮补之用，大家共度时艰。退款支票将于近期寄出。
cfd7b404e6cbfc3fd188b101d174b577b0c19464.translatedText: 1. The cost of the epidemic prevention materials shipped to Xiangyang, Hubei Province will be borne entirely by the Alberta Chinese Restaurant Association. 2. Due to the improvement of the epidemic situation in China and the worsening of the local epidemic situation, the funds raised will no longer be donated overseas, but will be used for self-rescue. We have now decided to return every donation made by members, social groups and philanthropists to help compensate for the losses caused by the epidemic, so that everyone can tide over the difficulties. Refund checks will be mailed shortly.

4f22003dc1762a7d2b82b47c91b1da2db2adf86b.sourceText: 三、亚省中国餐馆协会在此向捐款人士作出公开的说明，并衷心地感谢广大会员和侨胞的大力支持！请各位多多保重，大家一起共度难关！
4f22003dc1762a7d2b82b47c91b1da2db2adf86b.translatedText: 3. The Chinese Restaurant Association of Alberta would like to make a public explanation to the donors and sincerely thank its members and overseas Chinese for their strong support! Please take care of yourself and let’s get through this together!

b063c3bc92d88129753a6cadf8fcae7e97801600.sourceText: 沙漠明珠 | 美国亚利桑那州华人历史（四十一）第四章：关崇琼家族（3）
b063c3bc92d88129753a6cadf8fcae7e97801600.translatedText: Pearl of the Desert | Chinese History of Arizona, USA (41) Chapter 4: Guan Chongqiong Family (3)

cc3e62c01234e2780e0355308b94190105edd557.sourceText: 亚利桑那历史协会：张肇鸿 百年前的 “回美证” 关崇琼万里迢迢地从中国来到了美国，这个充满勇气的少年因为有志向…
cc3e62c01234e2780e0355308b94190105edd557.translatedText: Arizona Historical Association: Zhang Zhaohong The "Return Permit" a hundred years ago Guan Chongqiong came to the United States from China all the way, this courageous young man because of his ambition...

520f5eda04b2207ff007f41a1bf9602e9910834c.sourceText: 关崇琼万里迢迢地从中国来到了美国，这个充满勇气的少年因为有志向和期望，很快就适应了在美国新的生活。
520f5eda04b2207ff007f41a1bf9602e9910834c.translatedText: Guan Chongqiong came to the United States all the way from China. This courageous young man quickly adapted to his new life in the United States because of his ambition and expectations.

ab0c2f00691a735441a297fb6d88f2d7943f1ba3.sourceText: 1900年，凤凰城的唐人街正处在一个复兴阶段，美国其他城市的排华对地处偏辟的凤凰城影响并不太大。亚利桑那此时虽然属于美国，但仍未建州。来自加州的铁路刚建成不久，很多修筑铁路的华工留了下来，其他城市的华人也迁入，促进了本地唐人街的发展。
ab0c2f00691a735441a297fb6d88f2d7943f1ba3.translatedText: In 1900, Phoenix's Chinatown was in a stage of renaissance. The exclusion of Chinese in other American cities did not have much impact on the remote Phoenix. Although Arizona was part of the United States at this time, it was not yet a state. Not long after the railroad from California was built, many Chinese workers who built the railroad stayed, and Chinese from other cities also moved in, promoting the development of local Chinatowns.

2a0fd9973602008e676183e4b6a1601cc4df0c1f.sourceText: 当时，凤凰城中心三间最大的餐馆都是由华人经营，最出名的一间是由余康中(Sing Yee, Sr.)经营的《花旗餐馆》(American Kitchen)。餐馆位于市区繁华的中央街 (Central)，是当其时少数的中式餐馆。东主余康中学贯中英，经营有方，与政府的关係良好，不少初到埠的华人被收留工作或得其帮助。
2a0fd9973602008e676183e4b6a1601cc4df0c1f.translatedText: At that time, the three largest restaurants in central Phoenix were all run by Chinese. The most famous one was the American Kitchen run by Sing Yee, Sr. The restaurant was located on the bustling Central Street in the city and was one of the few Chinese restaurants at the time. The proprietor, Yu Kang Middle School, is well versed in both Chinese and English, is well-run, and has a good relationship with the government. Many Chinese who have just arrived in the city have been taken in to work or receive help.

e1459e58a1fb1c7a565c74661a9f96e57bfdaba8.sourceText: 关崇琼来到美国后，到《花旗餐馆》打工，开始做的是洗盘碗的杂工，人工每天5美分。由于刻苦耐劳和勤俭，他的职位慢慢地的升迁，在美国站稳了脚跟。
e1459e58a1fb1c7a565c74661a9f96e57bfdaba8.translatedText: After Guan Chongqiong came to the United States, he worked at Citi Restaurant. He started as a dishwasher and paid 5 cents per day for labor. Due to hard work and thrift, his position slowly rose and he established a firm foothold in the United States.

e59ba71c206f166d409074a3457bf7da11dc89c6.sourceText: 在开平的关家一直惦记著这个大洋彼岸的儿子。因为已到成家立室之时，父母决定帮关崇琼提一门婚事。看中的是李家的女子，名女好。女家也同意把女儿嫁给关崇琼，于是关家就开始筹办婚事，并通知关崇琼回家结婚。当时，无人知道这段婚姻的结果，日后要分开多长的时间。
e59ba71c206f166d409074a3457bf7da11dc89c6.translatedText: The Guan family in Kaiping have always been thinking about their son across the ocean. Because it was time to start a family, her parents decided to help Guan Chongqiong propose a marriage. What he is interested in is a girl from the Li family, a famous girl. The bride's family also agreed to marry their daughter to Guan Chongqiong, so the Guan family began to prepare for the wedding and notified Guan Chongqiong to go home and get married. At that time, no one knew the outcome of this marriage or how long they would be separated in the future.

6e0f9c342716a20ec62e4d49d96be5e682badc20.sourceText: 1912年，关崇琼19岁。他从信中得知老家已帮他约好了一门亲事，离家3年多了，便决定回国探望父母和结婚成家。为了婚后能重返美国，继续实现自己的梦想，在返国前他申请了现在被称为“回美证”的一纸文书。
6e0f9c342716a20ec62e4d49d96be5e682badc20.translatedText: In 1912, Guan Chongqiong was 19 years old. He learned from the letter that his hometown had arranged a marriage for him. After being away from home for more than three years, he decided to return to China to visit his parents and get married and start a family. In order to return to the United States after marriage and continue to realize his dream, he applied for a piece of paper now known as a "reentry permit" before returning to the country.

ca113aaab8dd7d40be09471b1b2a55c01e344758.sourceText: 当时，在美国三藩市海关申请和核发的文件是 “ 430号表格，第弍号禀”。（“禀”的意思是下级向上级的报告），文件是中英双语的，中文的内容如下：
ca113aaab8dd7d40be09471b1b2a55c01e344758.translatedText: At that time, the document applied for and issued by the Customs in San Francisco was "Form No. 430, Submission No. 9". ("Zhen" means a report from a subordinate to a superior). The document is bilingual in Chinese and English. The content in Chinese is as follows:

f6f766c1a32d57dc46a2b6ac9ddde4cf1993a387.sourceText: “此禀专为土生欲离美国由外而返立实凭证之所用。”
f6f766c1a32d57dc46a2b6ac9ddde4cf1993a387.translatedText: "This report is specially used to establish a solid certificate for natives who want to leave the United States and return from abroad."

87df6f3c1115e038eb99b6c42e0835c4af23d15f.sourceText: “管理处人入口委员知之，我现欲暂离美国出游外邦，今由华人出入之港（San Francisco)埠而去，将来亦即由该埠而回。兹依三十九款之例，在美国出世所有之凭据呈上查验，亦亲与证人到委员之公办房询问口供，照例签名禀上，并附相三幅。”
87df6f3c1115e038eb99b6c42e0835c4af23d15f.translatedText: "The entrance committee of the Management Office is aware that I want to temporarily leave the United States and travel to foreign countries. This is the port of entry and exit for Chinese people (San). Francisco), and will return from that port in the future. In accordance with the provisions of Paragraph 39, all the certificates of birth in the United States will be submitted for inspection. Witnesses will also be interviewed in person at the commissioner's office. They will be signed and submitted as usual, and three photos will be attached. "

c941115a470f63b1a27fc745c6ee96c4c9e67f11.sourceText: “此禀未落船之先要亲到管理外人入口委员公办房换回一号禀方可落船。”
c941115a470f63b1a27fc745c6ee96c4c9e67f11.translatedText: "Before disembarking, you must go to the public office of the Alien Entrance Committee to exchange for the No. 1 license before disembarking."

11dd18a0ecf2273cdaefd699cc8047e2ca9e015f.sourceText: 海关文件中提到：出国者只能是美国藉民，且要有证人口供证实和核实，并且从该埠出国就从该埠回来。
11dd18a0ecf2273cdaefd699cc8047e2ca9e015f.translatedText: The customs document mentioned: Those who go abroad can only be U.S. citizens, and must have a witness statement to confirm and verify, and they must return from that port when they leave the country.

54751076ec6e7621ebd5c89576d2566f2251728a.sourceText: 关祟琼当初以“纸儿子”的身份来美国时，也是从三藩市上埠，有美国“出世所有之凭据”的资料验证。另外，这张文件只是“弍号禀”，要换“一号禀”方可落船。
54751076ec6e7621ebd5c89576d2566f2251728a.translatedText: When Guan Chongqiong came to the United States as a "paper son", he also came to the port from San Francisco, and he had the information to verify the "certificate of birth ownership" in the United States. In addition, this document is only the "No. 4 report", and you need to change it to the "No. 1 report" before you can get off the ship.

418f339916cb679c4f09f221675274c5fdfbecf7.sourceText: 这个“一号禀”，作者估计是回中国落船时的入境文件。当回美国时，亦要把“一号禀”换回“弍号禀”才能进入美国。这样才能严防出入境者的身份假冒和互换。
418f339916cb679c4f09f221675274c5fdfbecf7.translatedText: This "No. 1 report", the author estimates, is the entry document when returning to China and disembarking. When you return to the United States, you must exchange your "No. 1 Certificate" for a "No. 3 Certificate" before you can enter the United States. In this way, we can strictly prevent the identity counterfeiting and exchange of immigrants.

78a67589fa1a80c3b839d943bc8265212c6661e7.sourceText: 在棑华法案的年代，华工在返华之后绝大多数的再无法重回美国。所以，这份百年前亚省华人的返回美国的海关文件，对于了解当时的华人历史实属珍贵。
78a67589fa1a80c3b839d943bc8265212c6661e7.translatedText: In the era of the China Anti-China Act, the vast majority of Chinese workers could not return to the United States after returning to China. Therefore, this customs document from the Chinese in Alberta returning to the United States a hundred years ago is really valuable for understanding the history of the Chinese at that time.

3aac2e840a2923859570956289cd25fa1f7e1de3.sourceText: 1912年6月20日，关崇琼在开平老家和李女好结婚成为夫妇。根据法例，在美国出生的华人在中国结婚，其家属没有资格进入美国。关崇琼并不能把妻子申请来美国。（待续）
3aac2e840a2923859570956289cd25fa1f7e1de3.translatedText: On June 20, 1912, Guan Chongqiong married Li Nuhao in her hometown in Kaiping. According to the law, if a Chinese born in the United States marries in China, their family members are not eligible to enter the United States. Guan Chongqiong cannot apply for his wife to come to the United States. (to be continued)

f557a7be5c792289b3a0344debf483efb018a820.sourceText: 斯格思岱裸体男脱衫有前科 （亚省时报） 斯格思岱裸体男，上周五在制造撞车、劫车、撞人连环大案后，被送往医院羁留病房。警方在稍后的调查中发现，这不是约翰布里格姆第一次脱衣闹事。 警方在翻查记录时发现，去年感恩节期间，有人报警称遭到邻居干扰，警员到场，发现布里格姆吸食大麻和其他毒品的证据，并大吵大闹。警员将其带至拘留所，布里格姆开始变本加厉，在牢房里又踢又喊，最终脱掉所有衣服。他弟弟翌日将其带走，想不到不够一年，布里格姆又故伎重演。 评：近来，全美各地疯传裸体男闹事，甚为吓人。难道脱衫会传染？脱衫上瘾？说到底还是与毒有关。
f557a7be5c792289b3a0344debf483efb018a820.translatedText: The naked man in Scottsdale who took off his shirt has a criminal record (Alberta Times) The naked man from Scottsdale was sent to the hospital detention ward last Friday after causing a series of car crashes, carjackings, and pedestrian collisions. Police later discovered during the investigation that this was not the first time John Brigham had taken off his clothes and caused trouble. When police reviewed records, they found that during Thanksgiving last year, someone called the police to report being disturbed by a neighbor. Officers arrived and found evidence that Brigham had smoked marijuana and other drugs and was making a fuss. Officers took him to a detention center, where Brigham began to intensify his behavior, kicking and screaming in the cell and eventually taking off all his clothes. His brother took him away the next day. Unexpectedly, less than a year later, Brigham was back to his old tricks. Comment: Recently, there have been rumors of naked men causing trouble across the United States, which is very scary. Is it contagious if you take off your shirt? Addicted to taking off your shirt? In the final analysis, it is still related to poison.
