5112519c109ad946eedf7fb4f34a69dd2566aaa7.sourceText: 气如虹：说听之间存误会 凤凰城 气如虹 相似谐音容易闹笑话，哈哈！不错呀，起码在无意间製造笑话，总比说话硬绷绷、冷冰冰好得多。 这是一位读者向我反映，认为有些人说话绷着脸，一副严肃面孔，不苟言笑，令人敬畏，难以产生和谐的感受；偶尔在谈话中能惹来笑料，未尝不是好事，值得效法。她不满意道貌岸然的作风，觉得在说话中能够搞笑，即使是相似谐音弄成，也是趣事；如能带点幽默感就更佳。 看来，谈话闹笑话是人们可以接受，只要这类笑话不会损害个人尊严与名誉，则无伤大雅。实际上，说话间闹出笑话的，不仅在翻译语言中，或者相似谐音中，而在许多场合的说话，发言者是一个意思，倾听者却是另一个意思，这就是说与听之间存在的误会，稍为不慎，就会发生，那是广东人常说的「会错意」。 有位住在洛杉矶的朋友，去市场购买甜饼，由于饼店摆放位置还没有标价，便询问「这饼一个几多钱？」那售货员用广东话回答：「一个七毫半」，朋友认为一个饼 75 C很便宜，就购买十个，缴交了十元纸币，等待还款二元半，但收银员站在那裡也在等待，不见动静，遂礼貌地说：「先生，尚欠七个半呀！」啊呀！这时才猛然醒悟，原来刚才所说广东话「一个七毫半」，是该饼价钱一元七十五仙，不是一个饼七十五仙，这就是听者「会错意」的误解场合。 说与听之间产生误解，数不胜数；通常言者无心，听者有意，造成自我的想像范围；或是言者故意说话模稜两可，误导听者，让听者估计错误。 以前中国在封建社会的盲婚哑嫁，倚靠父母之命、媒妁之言，那些媒婆时常凭藉三寸不烂之舌，天花乱坠地说项，有意使听者误解，促成姻缘。据传说，有位媒婆替一穷困男子提亲，向女方家庭吹嘘，男家拥有「十亩田，十亩地，廿亩荔枝畿，一扳高大屋，三叠到神前」。女家非常高兴，以为获得金龟婿，结果女儿出阁过去，原来是一间低矮细小房屋，甚麽田地产业都没有，女方家长觉得受骗，大兴问罪之师，媒婆振振有词地辩护：「我完全没有欺骗，是你们自己误解，可能我的乡音令你们会错意，我讲明『实无田，实无地，又无荔枝畿』嘛，『一扳高大屋』，即是举手可以触摸到屋簷，『三踏到神前』，是厅堂踏三步就到神位了，你们以为经过连叠三进屋才到达神龛，那不能怪我呀！」媒婆在狡辩，她的说话是故意误导，既然没有田地，何必在话语中特别强调呢？ 现代也有个发言误导的笑话，有个穿着清凉肉感的美女坐火车，邻座的几个男人睁眼望着那暴露乳沟位置，她心生一条赚钱妙计，微笑对他们说：「想看我的胸部吗？只要付钱给我就让你们欣赏。」于是几个好色傢伙连忙付款，少女就拉下上衣，扯开胸罩，裸露双乳让他们大饱眼福；跟着这几位把淫慾目光射向大腿，她明白其意，又说：「想看我生孩子的地方吗？请付双倍价钱。」他们立即付款，猴急地等待她掀起迷你裙，褫退内裤；哪晓得，这时火车经过一家医院，美女指着前面向大家说：「请集中精神看清楚，那裡就是我生孩子的地方。」哗嚓！几个大汉觉得受骗了，但无话可说，她讲明是生孩子的地方，并没有订定是观看其私处呀！ 至于言者无心，听者有意，也可以借用唐山乡村一则笑话为代表。传说有个小偷深夜实行入屋偷窃，听见房内女声轻轻地说：「想入又唔入，还在外面搞弄。」小偷不禁一怔，难道被发觉了，于是停歇不敢走动。却听见男声说：「嘘，小声点，不要胡说。」小偷停顿一会，看见没人出来，可能真是胡说，暗暗责怪自己多疑，继续摸进去，忽又听见女声说：「入了，对，已经入了，」小偷再次被吓住，四面环顾，仍不见有谁捉拿的样子，放胆再前进；这时女声又高叫起来：「哎哟！哎哟！哥呀，入到很深啦！」啊呀！小偷今回真的吃惊了，原来女子等自己深入才叫唤男子来捉拿，他立即隐藏在牆旯旮裡，以免被发现，等了一阵子，放轻脚步悄悄退出，却听到男声呼叫：「出啦，快要出啦，啊啊，正在出啦！」哗哗，小偷慌张的转身狂奔了。 从这些对话裡，可以瞭解说话和倾听是两方面的场合，随时会产生误会和误解 ，因而我们听见任何发言，不要单凭直觉去诠释，要运用大脑思维，分析是否合理 ，不然，就会闹笑话，无关轻重的倒没有问题，如果像那个嫁女的家庭，以为女儿享受大富大贵，幸福无边，却变成困苦捱穷，生活堪虞，那就非常遗憾了。
5112519c109ad946eedf7fb4f34a69dd2566aaa7.translatedText: Qi Ruhong: There is a misunderstanding between speaking and listening. Phoenix City Qi Ruhong has similar homophones and is easy to make a joke, haha! That's right, at least making jokes unintentionally is much better than speaking stiffly and coldly. This is what a reader reported to me, saying that some people speak with a solemn face, are unsmiling, awe-inspiring, and find it difficult to create harmonious feelings. Occasionally, they can make jokes during conversations, which is not a bad thing and is worth emulating. She is dissatisfied with the sanctimonious style and feels that she can be funny in her speech. Even if it has similar homophones, it is still interesting. It would be better if it can bring a sense of humor. It seems that it is acceptable for people to make jokes while talking, as long as such jokes do not damage personal dignity and reputation, there is no harm in it. In fact, jokes are made when speaking, not only in translated languages ​​​​or similar homophones, but also in many occasions when the speaker means one thing, the listener means another. This is a misunderstanding between speaking and listening. If you are not careful, it will happen. This is what Cantonese people often say "misunderstanding". A friend who lives in Los Angeles went to the market to buy sweet cakes. Since there was no price tag on the cake shop, he asked, "How much does this cake cost?" The salesperson replied in Cantonese: "Seven and a half cents a piece." The friend thought that a cake cost 75 C was very cheap, so he bought ten, paid a ten-dollar note, and waited for the repayment of two and a half yuan. It was then that I suddenly realized that what I just said in Cantonese, "one seven cents and a half", meant that the cake was priced at one dollar and seventy-five cents, not seventy-five cents per cake. This was a misunderstanding where the listener "could get it wrong". There are countless misunderstandings between speaking and listening; usually the speaker does not mean it, but the listener does it intentionally, causing the scope of his own imagination; or the speaker deliberately speaks ambiguously, misleading the listener, and causing the listener to miscalculate. In the past, China's blind marriages in feudal society relied on the orders of parents and the words of matchmakers. Those matchmakers often relied on their sharp tongue to make extravagant remarks, deliberately misunderstanding the listeners and promoting marriage. According to legend, a matchmaker proposed marriage to a poor man and boasted to the girl's family that the boy's family owned "ten acres of land, ten acres of land, twenty acres of lychee fields, a one-story-high house, and three stacks in front of the gods." The girl's family was very happy, thinking they had got a rich husband. However, when their daughter left the court, it turned out to be a small, low-rise house with no land or property. The girl's parents felt cheated and tried to find out who was guilty. The matchmaker defended plausibly: "I was not deceived at all. It was your own misunderstanding. Maybe my local pronunciation made you misunderstood. I made it clear, 'There is no land. In fact, there is no land.' "No land, no lychee garden." Well, "one high house" means you can touch the eaves with your hands, "three steps to the god" means you can reach the shrine after three steps in the hall. You think you have to go into the house three times to reach the shrine, so you can't blame me!" The matchmaker was quibbling. Her words were deliberately misleading. Since there is no land, why bother to emphasize it in her words? There is also a modern joke about misleading speech. There was a beautiful woman wearing cool and sexy clothes on a train. Several men sitting next to her opened their eyes and looked at the exposed cleavage. She thought of a clever plan to make money. She smiled and said to them: "Want to see my breasts? Just pay me and let you admire them." So a few lustful guys quickly paid, and the girl pulled down her top, pulled off her bra, and exposed her breasts for them to eat. Eyes were blessed; as these people cast their lustful gazes on their thighs, she understood what they meant and said, "Want to see the place where I gave birth? Please pay double the price." They paid immediately and waited anxiously for her to lift up her miniskirt and take off her panties; who knew that at this time, the train passed a hospital, and the beauty pointed to the front and said to everyone: "Please concentrate and look clearly, that's where I gave birth." Wow! The big men felt cheated, but had nothing to say. She made it clear that this was the place where the baby was born, and she did not specify that she was looking at her private parts! As for the speaker's unintentional intention and the listener's intention, it can also be represented by a joke in Tangshan countryside. Legend has it that a thief broke into a house late at night and heard a female voice inside the room whispering: "I want to get in but I don't want to get in, so I'm still doing it outside." The thief couldn't help but be startled, wondering if he had been discovered, so he stopped and did not dare to move. But he heard a male voice say: "Shh, keep your voice down, don't talk nonsense." The thief paused for a while. Seeing that no one came out, he was probably talking nonsense. He secretly blamed himself for being suspicious and continued to touch in. Suddenly he heard a female voice say: "It's in, yes, it's in already." The thief was frightened again. He looked around, but there was still no one to catch him, so he boldly moved forward. At this time, the female voice shouted again: "Ouch! Ouch! Brother, it's very deep!" Oh! The thief was really surprised this time. It turned out that the woman waited until she got deeper before calling the man to catch her. He immediately hid in a nook and cranny of the wall to avoid being discovered. After waiting for a while, he quietly exited with gentle steps. He heard a male voice calling: "It's coming out, it's about to come out, ah, it's coming out!" Wow, the thief turned around in panic and ran away. From these conversations, we can understand that speaking and listening are two aspects of the situation, and misunderstandings and misunderstandings may occur at any time. Therefore, when we hear any speech, we should not interpret it based on intuition alone, but use our brains to think and analyze whether it is reasonable. Otherwise, it will be a joke. It is not a problem if it is not important. If the family is like the married daughter, thinking that her daughter enjoys wealth and happiness, but turns out to be in poverty and life is in danger, that would be very regrettable.

5ba02c05d1e8986bc1ac23a88eb19e63f4309660.sourceText: 房市复苏：房价涨幅到两年内最大 与去年同期相比房价上涨百分比 根据采用20个主要城市房价数据的标普全美房价指数（ S&P/Case-Shiller index）最新显示，随着房市的复苏持续升温，房价上涨百分比到达两年内最大。 该指数显示，与去年同期相比，今年十月份的房价上涨4.3%，涨幅到达自2010年五月以来最大，不过仍比 2006年6月的鼎盛时期低了29%。在2009年底以及2010年初，房价曾出现短期上涨，主要是受高达8000元的首次购房者税务优惠政策刺激。 在最近几个月中，除了房价上涨之外，还有其他许多现象标志着房市的复苏。例如房贷利率跌至历史新低，失业率下降，止赎率下降至五年内最低，这些都标志着房市供不应求，从而导致房价上涨。 房价上涨随之促进了房屋销售以及房屋建设。现有的户主有更好的机会卖掉老房子，筹到购买新房子的首付。而之前因对房价走势不确定而持观望态度的潜在买主，可以借此下定决心买房。 受益于房价上涨的当然还有居民房建筑商。据悉，几大主流建筑商如PulteGroup (PHA), Lennar (LEN), KB Home (KBH), D.R. Horton, Inc. (DHI) Toll Brothers (TOL)在过去的一年内股票上涨至少50%，PulteGroup股票价格几乎翻了三番。
5ba02c05d1e8986bc1ac23a88eb19e63f4309660.translatedText: Housing market recovery: Home prices have increased to the greatest extent in two years Percentage increase in home prices compared with the same period last year According to the S&P/Case-Shiller National Home Price Index using housing price data in 20 major cities index) latest shows that as the recovery of the housing market continues to heat up, the percentage increase in house prices has reached the largest level in two years. The index showed that compared with the same period last year, house prices rose 4.3% in October this year, the largest increase since May 2010, but still 29% lower than the peak in June 2006. At the end of 2009 and early 2010, there was a short-term rise in housing prices, mainly stimulated by tax incentives for first-time home buyers of up to 8,000 yuan. In recent months, a number of other phenomena besides rising home prices have marked a recovery in the housing market. For example, mortgage rates have fallen to record lows, the unemployment rate has dropped, and the foreclosure rate has dropped to its lowest level in five years. These are all signs that the housing market is in short supply, causing housing prices to rise. Rising home prices in turn boost home sales as well as home construction. Existing homeowners have a better chance of selling their old home and raising the down payment for a new one. Potential buyers who previously had a wait-and-see attitude due to uncertainty about housing price trends can use this to make up their mind to buy a house. Of course, residential home builders have also benefited from rising house prices. It is reported that the stocks of several major mainstream builders such as PulteGroup (PHA), Lennar (LEN), KB Home (KBH), D.R. Horton, Inc. (DHI) Toll Brothers (TOL) have risen by at least 50% in the past year, and PulteGroup's stock price has almost tripled.

dc08844f239dcc7901a9def8baa94814e55d8b33.sourceText: 凤凰城台湾同乡联谊会，大凤凰城侨联总会，凤凰城康乐大厦住户管理委员会于九月九日在凤凰城康乐大厦，联合举办庆祝中华民国104年双十国庆酒会暨九九重阳敬老宴,揭开美西南包括南加，橙县，亚利桑那卅，圣地牙哥等庆祝中华民国双十国庆总计26个系列活动的序幕。中华民国驻洛杉矶经济文化办事处夏季昌处长赠贺状，由凤凰城康乐大厦住户管理委员会徐家声主任委员代表接受。资深传统侨社侨领代表余文劲侨务谘询委员致词时，特别感谢讃许并肯定凤凰城台湾同乡联谊会主办此次庆双十敬老宴的用心和努力，并敬祝所有耆老们生曰快乐，重申支持中华民国的决心，并祝福中华民国国运昌隆，带领大家高呼中华民国万岁。大凤凰城台美商会会长张晴玲侨务谘询委员代表橙县华侨文教服务中心主任杨海华致赠恭贺状给康乐康宁大厦耆老，祝福耆老们「松柏长靑」「万寿无疆」。张晴玲会长并代表台籍侨领致词，并恭贺耆老们福如东海，寿比南山；大凤凰城侨联总会余文泽祝福所有耆老身体健康快乐。康乐大厦徐家声主任委员特别亲手製作「敬老楷模」横匾给凤凰城台湾同乡联谊会会长张圣仪，感谢讚扬她数月募款筹备此次意义深远的活动，为青年侨社表率。
dc08844f239dcc7901a9def8baa94814e55d8b33.translatedText: Phoenix City Taiwanese Association, Greater Phoenix Overseas Chinese Federation, Phoenix Kangle Building Residents Management Committee in September On the 9th, we jointly held a cocktail party to celebrate the 104th National Day of the Republic of China and the 104th Double Ninth Festival Respect for the Elderly Banquet at the Recreation Building in Phoenix, kicking off a series of 26 events in total to celebrate the 104th National Day of the Republic of China, including Southern California, Orange County, Arizona, and San Diego. Director Xia Chang of the Economic and Cultural Office of the Republic of China in Los Angeles presented a congratulatory certificate, which was accepted by Representative Xu Jiasheng, Chairman of the Residential Management Committee of Phoenix Kangle Building. In his speech, Yu Wenjin, a senior representative of the overseas Chinese community and the Overseas Chinese Affairs Advisory Committee, especially thanked and affirmed the Phoenix Taiwanese Association for its dedication and efforts in hosting this Double Tenth celebration banquet. He also wished all the elders a happy birthday, reiterated his determination to support the Republic of China, wished the Republic of China a prosperous national destiny, and led everyone to shout long live the Republic of China. On behalf of Yang Haihua, director of the Orange County Overseas Chinese Cultural and Educational Service Center, President of the Taiwan-American Chamber of Commerce in Greater Phoenix, Zhang Qingling, Overseas Chinese Affairs Advisory Committee, presented a congratulatory certificate to the senior citizens of the Kang Ning Building, wishing the senior citizens "long life" and "long life without borders." President Zhang Qingling also delivered a speech on behalf of the Taiwanese overseas Chinese leaders, and congratulated the elderly on being as blessed as the East China Sea and living as long as the Nanshan Mountains; Yu Wenze of the Greater Phoenix Overseas Chinese Federation wished all the elderly good health and happiness. Chairman Xu Jiasheng of the Connaught Building specially made a "Model Respect for the Elderly" plaque for the president of the Taiwanese Association of Phoenix City, Zhang Shengyi, to thank and praise her for months of raising funds to prepare for this far-reaching event and setting an example for the young overseas Chinese community.

c8178d6c183ad7516ee6ef8818c8f49f91d991d5.sourceText: 活动备有特製中华民国国旗大蛋糕，可口台湾小吃餐点饮料，赠大厦耆老加菜金红包，奬品摸彩及精美生曰礼物及贺状，致赠给每位康乐康宁大厦九月份和十月份生曰的三十位寿星耆老，耆老并演唱上海滩等歌曲祝兴。酒会结束后并准备各式精美礼品，高级电热水瓶，全自动豆浆机等奬品摸彩，及电影欣赏。
c8178d6c183ad7516ee6ef8818c8f49f91d991d5.translatedText: The event includes a special large cake with the flag of the Republic of China, delicious Taiwanese snacks, meals and drinks, golden red envelopes with extra food for seniors in the building, lottery prizes and exquisite birthday gifts and certificates of congratulations. These are presented to each of the 30 seniors whose birthdays are in September and October in Kangyue Kangning Building. The seniors sang songs such as Shanghai Beach to celebrate their birthdays. After the reception, various exquisite gifts, high-end electric hot water bottles, fully automatic soy milk machines and other prizes will be drawn for lottery, as well as movie viewing.

d1c93bff8074c2f4df4057377635c2f2b2fcc831.sourceText: 康乐大厦耆老公寓的兴建，源起于中华民国侨务委员会在数十多年前出资买地，在多方奔走筹款下兴建完成，前侨务委员长吴英毅国策顾问在大厦落成起用时，特别致赠匾额悬挂交谊大厅，现任侨务委员会陈士魁委员长亦亲访赠墨宝捲轴挂于长廊，此次特别在康乐大厦主办庆双十敬老宴，希望藉此巩固情谊，和传统侨社耆老们一起欢庆中华民国104年双十国庆并度过温馨愉快的九九重节敬老节。
d1c93bff8074c2f4df4057377635c2f2b2fcc831.translatedText: >The construction of the Elderly Apartments in Kangle Building originated from the purchase of land by the Overseas Chinese Affairs Commission of the Republic of China decades ago. It was built with the help of various fundraising efforts. The former Chairman of the Overseas Chinese Affairs Commission Wu Yingyi, national policy advisor, specially presented a plaque to hang in hand when the building was completed and put into use. In the Friendship Hall, Chen Shikui, the current chairman of the Overseas Chinese Affairs Commission, also personally visited and presented calligraphy scrolls to hang in the corridor. This time, we hosted a Double Ten Respect for the Elderly banquet at the Kangle Building, hoping to consolidate our friendship and celebrate the 104th Double Ten National Day of the Republic of China with the elders of the traditional overseas Chinese community and spend a warm and happy Nine-Nine Double Tenth Respect for the Elderly Festival.

cad3cdc8ab8d1c28234a7136c6939509a06dd321.sourceText: 此次参加活动有大凤凰城侨联总会余文泽，耆英会副主席尹凤影，侨联副主席张肇鸿，亚省亚裔协会会长林子宣，台籍侨领代表陈龙禧，詹秀美贤伉俪，鳯台联副会长傅彩云，余霭明，活动总干事陆权林，庄淑华，窦惠芝理事义工们，侨学界媒体耆老们百馀人出席并赠送福袋给与会佳宾做伴手礼。
cad3cdc8ab8d1c28234a7136c6939509a06dd321.translatedText: Participating in this event were Yu Wenze of the Overseas Chinese Federation of Greater Phoenix City, Yin Fengying, Vice Chairman of the Senior Citizens Association, Zhang Zhaohong, Vice Chairman of the Overseas Chinese Federation, Lin Zixuan, President of the Asian Association of Asia, and Chen, the representative of Taiwanese overseas Chinese leaders. More than 100 people including Long Xi, Mr. and Mrs. Zhan Xiumixian, Fu Caiyun and Yu Aiming, vice presidents of the Taiwan Federation of Taiwan, event directors Lu Quanlin, Zhuang Shuhua, Dou Huizhi, directors and volunteers, and elders from the overseas Chinese academic circle and media attended and presented lucky bags to the guests as souvenirs.

3d3fd7173b12989a8b203080ac9adf7b0ff75659.sourceText: 一、侨区概况: 在廿世纪之初，鳯凰城已经有了邓氏、余氏、黄氏等。 华人先辈在本地以姓氏组织起来的宗亲团体，开始只是为了达到守望相助、共御外侮之目的。 按官方记录，在1940年，凤凰城总人口已有65,414人，华人人数却只有431人，占总数的0.66%。 本埠华人如此的少，但当年却面临着的种族岐视，要反对这种现象并不能采用直接抗争的方法。 所以在1937年，本埠华人首次自发庆祝美国国庆，表明”吾人此举，乃是本着生于斯，长于斯，居于斯，以表示拥护美国之热诚” 。 到了1939年，本地商家成立了”华商总会”，组织起华人在七月四日庆祝美国国庆，表达对美国的认同，以此反对当时的种族岐视。 ” 华商总会”当年还发起过捐助”一碗饭”活动，把筹到的钱汇回祖国救助在日本侵略者铁蹄下的苦难同胞。 1941年太平洋战争爆发后，亚省有七十九位华人子弟应征当兵，其中参加中美空军混合大队第十四航空飞虎队服务的也有四位华人，他们远赴中国，和中国军民一起 直接抗击入侵祖国的日本帝国主义。 二次大战中有五位华裔军人为国捐躯。 而本埠华人继续举办美国国庆活动，支持国家反法西斯主义。 之后，举办庆祝美国国庆活成为本埠华人的传统活动，并一直延续至今。 到了上世纪六十年代末，鳯凰城华人已经有五千人和多个团体。 1968年，由全侨十三个团体成立起”斐匿侨团联合总会”。 侨联成立以来，继续组织​​全侨举办庆祝国庆和”双十节”活动。 到目前，大凤凰城地区已有十万华人华侨之众，侨联总会发展到今日已经有十七个团体，一直是本地区最大的华人组织。 目前更名为”大凤凰城地区侨团联合总会”，成员已包括鳯凰城及周边多个卫星城市，每年举办上千人庆祝美国国庆活动和其它多个活动。
3d3fd7173b12989a8b203080ac9adf7b0ff75659.translatedText: 1. Overview of the Overseas Chinese Community: At the beginning of the 20th century, there were already Deng, Yu, Huang, etc. in the city of Huanghuang. The kinship groups organized by local surnames by the Chinese ancestors were initially intended to help each other and defend against foreign aggression. According to official records, in 1940, the total population of Phoenix was 65,414, but the number of Chinese was only 431, accounting for 0.66% of the total. There were so few Chinese in this city, but they faced racial discrimination at that time. To oppose this phenomenon, we could not use direct resistance. Therefore, in 1937, the local Chinese people spontaneously celebrated the National Day of the United States for the first time, stating that "we are doing this to express our sincere support for the United States because we were born here, grew up here, and live here." In 1939, local merchants established the "Chinese Business Association" to organize Chinese people to celebrate the Fourth of July as the National Day to express their identification with the United States and to oppose racial discrimination at the time. The "Chinese Chamber of Commerce" also launched a "bowl of rice" donation event that year, and remitted the money raised back to the motherland to help the suffering compatriots under the iron heel of the Japanese invaders. After the outbreak of the Pacific War in 1941, 79 Chinese people from Alberta were recruited to serve in the military. Among them, four Chinese served in the 14th Flying Tigers, a mixed group of the Chinese and American Air Forces. They went to China and directly fought with the Chinese military and civilians against the Japanese imperialism that invaded the motherland. During World War II, five Chinese-American soldiers died for their country. The local Chinese continue to hold National Day activities to support the country's anti-fascism. After that, holding celebrations for the National Day of the United States became a traditional activity for the local Chinese and continues to this day. By the end of the 1960s, there were 5,000 Chinese people and multiple groups in Huanghuang City. In 1968, the "Feni Overseas Chinese Federation" was established by 13 overseas Chinese groups. Since its establishment, the Overseas Chinese Federation has continued to organize activities for all overseas Chinese to celebrate National Day and the "Double Tenth Day". So far, there are 100,000 overseas Chinese in the greater Phoenix area. The Overseas Chinese Federation has grown to include 17 groups today, and it has always been the largest Chinese organization in the region. Currently renamed as "Greater Phoenix Area Overseas Chinese Association", its members include Phoenix and many surrounding satellite cities. Every year, it holds thousands of people to celebrate the National Day and many other activities.

3d6ec77a8673dbe7588b112b4ca5f55747dbfc6f.sourceText: 二、侨团之情况与发展 四十四年来，鳯凰城侨联总会通过举办庆祝国庆和各种活动，一方面显示出华人团结的力量，力求主流社会认同，另方面积极宣扬中华文化。 鳯凰城侨联总会成立之初，正值”中国热”开始，美国人对五千年的中华文化欣赏和向往，就算是离开祖国数十年的本地华侨及其后裔，也迫切需要寻 回自己的根以及文化上的认同。 如是，侨联举办国庆活动就有了新的内涵。 从1970年开始，连年的庆典中加入了舞龙醒狮的表演，并有民俗婚礼表演，古典服装与旗袍秀，中国功夫，中国电影等文化艺术的节目，改变美国民众对中国人的残旧 印象。 同时，还增添了〝凤​​凰城​​华裔小姐选美〞环节，鼓励下一代华​​裔的参与，让中华文化得到传承，也让国庆活动有了更加亮丽的色彩。 侨联宏扬中华文化的活动通过”中外杂志” 、”金山时报”，以及近年的本地报刊和网络等各种传媒的报道，在国内外产生了积极的影响，这种成功，也是侨联举办国庆活动的另 一种意义所在。 连年举办的庆典活动得到了主流社会的关注和支持。 在1979年，亚利桑那州州长布鲁斯‧毕比(Bruce E. Babbit) 已经亲自来到现场，和华人一起庆祝美国国庆。 到了九十年代，鳯凰城市长史洁林沙(Skip Rimsza ) 在贺函中写道：”我要欢迎举办鳯凰城华人社团国庆大会，自从三十年代末期，您们已开始庆祝这个富有历史性的 日子。”在千禧年，州长珍迪(Jane Dee Hall) 发来贺函：”代表整个亚利桑那州，我欣荣地认同今年的活动，我赞誉你们给予亚利桑那州公民的承诺和忠心。你们为了保持 社区那份强烈的精神而鞠躬尽瘁。” 每年，州、市政府都有贺辞或有官员参加庆典，侨民亦大力支持和参与。 侨联亦在发展中，由开始的寻求认同到争取自身的权益，努力争取到政府部门拨出经费去兴建”康宁大厦”、”耆英会”，近来还得到政府拨款五百卅万元兴建起” 康乐大厦”。 近年来，由于祖国和两岸形势的发展，侨联亦参与两岸团体所举办的活动，并举办多方面的公益活动。 1989年，美州和全美中华会馆和中华公所曾于在本埠召开过一次声势浩大的年会，鳯凰城侨联总会筹划和组织大会召开相当成功，受到好评。 侨联总会亦于2011年去拜会过罗省中华会馆，向侨社老大哥取经和学习。
3d6ec77a8673dbe7588b112b4ca5f55747dbfc6f.translatedText: 2. The Situation and Development of the Overseas Chinese Community Over the past 44 years, the Overseas Chinese Federation of Nuohuangcheng has held National Day celebrations and various activities to demonstrate the strength of Chinese unity and strive for mainstream social recognition, and to actively promote Chinese culture. When the Overseas Chinese Federation of Huangcheng City was founded, it coincided with the beginning of the "China fever". Americans appreciated and yearned for five thousand years of Chinese culture. Even local overseas Chinese and their descendants who had left the motherland for decades were in urgent need of rediscovering their roots and cultural identity. In this case, the National Day activities held by the Overseas Chinese Federation will have new connotations. Since 1970, dragon and lion dance performances have been added to the annual celebrations, as well as folk wedding performances, classical costume and cheongsam shows, Chinese kung fu, Chinese movies and other cultural and artistic programs to change the American people's old impression of the Chinese. At the same time, the "Miss Chinese Phoenix Beauty Pageant" was also added to encourage the participation of the next generation of Chinese Americans, so that Chinese culture can be passed down and the National Day event will have a brighter color. The Overseas Chinese Federation's activities to promote Chinese culture have had a positive impact at home and abroad through various media reports such as "Chinese and Foreign Magazine", "Jinshan Times", as well as local newspapers and the Internet in recent years. This success is another significance of the National Day activities held by the Overseas Chinese Federation. The celebrations held year after year have received attention and support from mainstream society. In 1979, Arizona Governor Bruce E. Babbit came to the scene in person to celebrate the National Day with the Chinese. In the 1990s, Phoenix Mayor Skip Rimsza wrote in a congratulatory letter: "I would like to welcome the Phoenix Chinese Community National Day Convention, which you have been celebrating since the late 1930s." In the millennium, Governor Jane Dee Hall sent a congratulatory letter: "On behalf of the entire state of Arizona, I am pleased to endorse this year's event, and I commend you for your commitment and loyalty to the citizens of Arizona. Every year, state and city governments send congratulatory messages or officials attend the celebrations, and the diaspora also provides strong support and participation. The Overseas Chinese Federation is also developing, from seeking recognition at the beginning to fighting for its own rights and interests. It has worked hard to obtain funds from government departments to build the "Kang Ning Building" and the "Senior Citizen Association". Recently, it also received a government allocation of 5.3 million yuan to build the "Kang Le Building". In recent years, due to the development of the situation in the motherland and across the Taiwan Strait, the Overseas Chinese Federation has also participated in activities organized by groups on both sides of the Taiwan Strait and organized various public welfare activities. In 1989, the American and American Chinese Associations and Chinese Associations held a massive annual conference in this city. The Phoenix Overseas Chinese Federation General Association planned and organized the conference very successfully and was well received. The Federation of Overseas Chinese also visited the Luo Provincial Chinese Association in 2011 to learn from the big brother of the overseas Chinese community.

a8d3669b57c989a89523efa0637d44b9d3215ba9.sourceText: 四、结论 今天当我们重新回顾，在早期华人并不多的鳯凰城，华侨先辈成立了侨联总会。 四十多年来坚持不懈地举办庆祝美国国庆活动，这份坚持执着和成功，在全美各大城市的华人社区中亦是十分少有的。 鳯凰城华人会记载这段历史，珍惜这份热情，并愐怀华侨先辈的贡献，在薪火相传中，继续发扬这个优良传统！ (本文是在＂美洲第廿五届、全美第廿九届的中华会馆、中华公所、华侨总会＂大会上所作的侨情报告。)
a8d3669b57c989a89523efa0637d44b9d3215ba9.translatedText: 4. Conclusion Today when we look back again, in the early days of Huanghuang City where there were not many Chinese, the overseas Chinese ancestors established the Overseas Chinese Federation. For more than 40 years, we have been organizing activities to celebrate the National Day of the United States. This kind of persistence and success is very rare among the Chinese communities in major cities in the United States. The Phoenix City Chinese Association will record this period of history, cherish this enthusiasm, and cherish the contributions of our overseas Chinese ancestors. We will continue to carry forward this fine tradition as the torch is passed down from generation to generation! (This article is a report on overseas Chinese affairs made at the "25th China Association of the Americas and the 29th China Association of the United States, China Office, and Overseas Chinese Association" conference.)

a5d1f86fe6e56c049379d66a9299b3be1de9deb7.sourceText: 亚利桑那被离婚律师欺诈的受害者将获得赔偿 （亚省时报） 四年后，25个被离婚律师欺诈的受害者将很快得到他们的赔偿。根据马里科帕县检察官办公室的消息，加里?#26480;伊?#21345;尔平被裁定罪名成立，于2008年10月24日盗窃受理费和不履行承诺的法律服务。他被判处15年徒刑，并责令支付赔偿受害者近$ 240,000。从那时起，卡尔平试图避免支付归还受害者，他将资产转移给他人。马里科帕县检察官办公室的资产局确认卡尔平的资产总额超过$197,000。亚利桑那州正在联系受害者，让他们根据法庭文件领回属于自己的钱。 马里科帕县检察官说：”我们期待这些资金返还受害者，被告以这种非法的方式从他们身上获得利益。”卡尔平在来凤凰城之前，在蒙哥马利就被取消了律师资格。1996年，他来到凤凰城于，他声称自己作为一个专业的离婚律师在佛蒙特州。卡尔平没有一个在亚利桑那州的法律执业许可证。在9年多时间里，卡尔平进行法律收费，却从未提供法律服务，受害人达300人。
a5d1f86fe6e56c049379d66a9299b3be1de9deb7.translatedText: Arizona victims who were defrauded by divorce lawyers will receive compensation (Alberta Times) Four years later, 25 victims of fraud by divorce lawyers will soon receive their compensation. According to the Maricopa County Prosecutor's Office, Gary Erpin was found guilty on October 24, 2008 of theft of legal services and failure to perform promised legal services. He was sentenced to 15 years in prison and ordered to pay nearly $240,000 in restitution to the victims. From that point on, Kalpin attempted to avoid paying restitution to his victims by transferring assets to others. The Asset Bureau of the Maricopa County Prosecutor's Office determined that Calpin's assets totaled more than $197,000. The state of Arizona is contacting victims to get their money back, according to court documents. "We expect these funds to be returned to the victims from whom the defendants benefited in this illegal manner," the Maricopa County prosecutor said. Kalpin was disbarred in Montgomery before coming to Phoenix. In 1996, he came to Phoenix where he presented himself as a professional divorce attorney in Vermont. Kalpin does not have a license to practice law in Arizona. For more than nine years, Calpin conducted legal fees but never provided legal services, and the number of victims reached 300.

e679fd8fab0043ff17cd074ca189f108574f372f.sourceText: 最新的汽车品质专业调查发现，凌志(Lexus)汽车的品质在所有厂牌中再度夺魁；同时，过去十年来，所有汽车生产厂商都已大幅改善品质。汽车研究公司JD Power and Associates最近完成2012年份汽车品质调查，根据该调查，每100辆车中，凌志汽车的问题最少，其次是生产豪华车辆的捷豹(Jaguar)和保时捷(Porsche) ，这两个厂牌同时列名第二，本田和凯迪拉克(Cadillac)进入前五名。JD Power公司针对7万4000名拥有2012年份汽车的车主做可靠度调查，检查项目包括在过去90天当中，​​汽车是否发生机械和电路故障，包括旋钮和开关是否有问题。这是针对2012年份汽车品质的第一次重要评估。这项评估发现，凌志每100辆汽车有73个问题。凌志品牌自从1989年开始销售以来，其品质和客户服务向来遥遥领先。在美国底特律汽车大厂中，凯迪拉克品质最佳，在这项调查中，排第四名。在主流厂牌中，本田品质最佳，在这项调查中排第五名。在这项调查中，排名最差的是义大利飞亚特(Fiat)和宾士(Mercedes)的智慧型(Smart)品牌，这两个品牌，每100辆有151个问题。
e679fd8fab0043ff17cd074ca189f108574f372f.translatedText: The latest professional car quality survey found that the quality of Lexus cars once again ranked first among all brands; at the same time, all car manufacturers have greatly improved their quality in the past ten years. Automotive research firm JD Power and Associates recently completed its 2012 vehicle quality survey. According to the survey, Lexus had the fewest problems per 100 vehicles, followed by Jaguar and Porsche, which produce luxury vehicles. Both brands ranked second at the same time, and Honda and Cadillac rounded out the top five. JD Power conducted a reliability survey of 74,000 owners of 2012-model cars, checking whether the car had experienced mechanical or electrical problems in the past 90 days, including problems with knobs and switches. This is the first major assessment of the quality of cars from the 2012 vintage. The assessment found Lexus had 73 problems per 100 vehicles. Since the Lexus brand began sales in 1989, its quality and customer service have always been far ahead. Among the major Detroit automobile manufacturers in the United States, Cadillac has the best quality, ranking fourth in this survey. Among mainstream brands, Honda has the best quality, ranking fifth in this survey. In the survey, the worst-ranked brands were the smart brands of Italy's Fiat and Mercedes, which had 151 problems per 100 vehicles.

59f77c923f5cbcaf1b1b62e1b0bac4c00d54df75.sourceText: 美国首个在移植子宫内孕育的宝宝诞生
59f77c923f5cbcaf1b1b62e1b0bac4c00d54df75.translatedText: The first baby conceived in a transplanted uterus in the United States is born

4334351bd64084cfc8b2679760e5724948adde28.sourceText: 新华社华盛顿12月4日电(记者林小春)美国贝勒大学医学中心4日宣布，美国一名接受子宫移植手术的女性上月在该中心成功产子，这名新生儿是美国第一个在移植子宫内孕育出生的宝宝。

ccd360eb5bda5a64ca8eb95521010fb1c7c6873c.sourceText: 贝勒大学医学中心当天在网络直播的新闻发布会上说，新生儿是名男婴，目前母子平安，母亲已出院，孩子仍留院观察。
ccd360eb5bda5a64ca8eb95521010fb1c7c6873c.translatedText: Baylor University Medical Center said at a press conference broadcast live on the Internet that day that the newborn was a baby boy. The mother and child are currently safe. The mother has been discharged from the hospital, and the child remains in the hospital for observation.

181843a581a27b4459ae13def0178782199b4566.sourceText: 手术首席负责人朱利亚诺.斯塔在一份声明中将这个消息称为”里程碑”，”对那些曾被告知永远无法怀上自己孩子的母亲来说，这是一个充满爱和希望的美妙时刻”。孩子的父母也感到”深深的幸福”。
181843a581a27b4459ae13def0178782199b4566.translatedText: Giuliano Star, chief of the operation, called the news a "milestone" in a statement. "This is a wonderful moment full of love and hope for mothers who have been told they would never be able to conceive their children." The child's parents also felt "deeply happy".

ccbabdabc5585db710587d70b9a0414b5ff14e14.sourceText: 贝勒大学医学中心的研究团队计划招募10名女性参与子宫移植研究。去年10月，该中心宣布已实施4例子宫移植手术，但有3名妇女出现血流不畅问题，不得不移除移植的子宫。
ccbabdabc5585db710587d70b9a0414b5ff14e14.translatedText: A research team at Baylor University Medical Center plans to recruit 10 women to participate in a uterus transplant study. In October last year, the center announced that it had performed four uterine transplant operations, but three women developed poor blood flow and had to have their transplanted uteruses removed.

ef952d5d23f8ad6ab9a7d8f77db9bc05bda58c0e.sourceText: 美国生殖医学学会发表声明说，这名婴儿的诞生是”生殖医学史上又一个重要里程碑”，但同时强调该领域的工作必须在相关审查委员会的监督下进行。
ef952d5d23f8ad6ab9a7d8f77db9bc05bda58c0e.translatedText: The American Society for Reproductive Medicine issued a statement saying that the birth of this baby is "another important milestone in the history of reproductive medicine", but also emphasized that work in this field must be conducted under the supervision of relevant review committees.

cbd22b58f074ad8bdb0eca98c50a408dc207565c.sourceText: 全世界每500名女性中就有约1人患有子宫性不孕，即先天没有子宫或因子宫发育不良、病变而无法正常怀孕。
cbd22b58f074ad8bdb0eca98c50a408dc207565c.translatedText: About 1 in every 500 women in the world suffers from uterine infertility, which means that they are born without a uterus or cannot get pregnant normally due to uterine dysplasia or lesions.

261d17a3f142ba07427d99f7ed4c28064870c4c9.sourceText: 子宫移植被认为是让子宫性不孕女性受孕的唯一途径。世界首例子宫移植手术于2014年在瑞典完成。此前，共有8名移植子宫孕育的宝宝诞生，所有孩子都出生在瑞典。
261d17a3f142ba07427d99f7ed4c28064870c4c9.translatedText: Uterine transplantation is considered the only way to conceive in women with uterine infertility. The world's first uterine transplant was completed in Sweden in 2014. Previously, a total of 8 babies conceived by transplanted uterus were born, all of whom were born in Sweden.

011f9a3ffdebbdd4fbcedb0d17c5d204d537ba2c.sourceText: 美国 9 月都会房价年涨幅度创 2010 年 7 月以来新高，显示房市复苏是美国经济劲道的泉源之一。
011f9a3ffdebbdd4fbcedb0d17c5d204d537ba2c.translatedText: The annual increase in U.S. urban home prices in September hit the highest level since July 2010, indicating that the recovery of the housing market is one of the sources of strength in the U.S. economy.

70fb2cc38bb2dfc476319ca988fc80a525363382.sourceText: 追踪全美 20 大都会区的史坦普 / 凯斯 – 席勒 (S&P/Case-Shiller) 房价指数较去年 9 月攀升 3% ，高于 8 月的 2% ，并和彭博信息访调 29 名经济学家的预估中值相符。第三季房价同比攀涨 3.6% ，也创 2010 年第二季以来最大涨幅。
70fb2cc38bb2dfc476319ca988fc80a525363382.translatedText: The S&P/Case-Shiller home price index, which tracks 20 metropolitan areas across the United States, climbed 3% from September last year, up from 2% in August and in line with the median forecast of 29 economists polled by Bloomberg Intelligence. House prices rose 3.6% year-on-year in the third quarter, the largest increase since the second quarter of 2010.

f1ad985bb8e51fda043ac10454fed4ff4dea755e.sourceText: 史坦普指数委员会主席布利泽 (David Blitzer) 在声明稿中表示，”房价已连续六个月稳定攀升，可以说我们现在正处于房市复苏期”。
f1ad985bb8e51fda043ac10454fed4ff4dea755e.translatedText: David Blitzer, chairman of the S&P Index Committee, said in a statement, "House prices have been rising steadily for six consecutive months, and it can be said that we are now in a housing market recovery period."

37f8133a19b066f69fea2ab0f0777a70abe8bece.sourceText: 劳动市场好转连同历来最低的房贷利率，都有助于支撑房市购屋需求，也促成营建业愈来愈乐观的现象。在与此同时，联准会决策官员继续推动的货币宽松措施，也成为全美房市复苏和经济扩张的支柱。
37f8133a19b066f69fea2ab0f0777a70abe8bece.translatedText: The improvement in the labor market and the historically low mortgage interest rates have helped support the demand for home purchases in the housing market, and have also contributed to the growing optimism in the construction industry. At the same time, the monetary easing measures continued to be promoted by Federal Reserve policymakers have also become the pillar of the recovery of the U.S. housing market and economic expansion.

c7f4681ecbcb251be12df16861321c2303a85d14.sourceText: 康州瑞银证券公司 (UBS Securities) 经济学家康明斯 (Kevin Cummins) 在报告出炉前表示，在就业渐有起色的情况下，”你可以见到家庭情况受影响，人们变得宽裕一些，愿意外出试水温。物价稳定和房价攀升的间接效应，正扩散到支出和更广泛的信心”。
c7f4681ecbcb251be12df16861321c2303a85d14.translatedText: Kevin Cummins, an economist at UBS Securities in Connecticut, said before the report was released that as employment picks up, "you can see the impact on family situations and people becoming a little more affluent and willing to go out and test the water temperature. The indirect effects of price stability and rising house prices are spreading to spending and broader confidence."

2ed6958d0b342375dc1401dbe4ccb7ee0f982b1c.sourceText: 彭博信息调查汇整的预估值，介于上涨 2.2% 和 3.6% 之间。史坦普 / 凯斯 – 席勒指数是依据三个月均价 统计，代表 9 月的数据会受 7 月与 8 月的买卖影响。
2ed6958d0b342375dc1401dbe4ccb7ee0f982b1c.translatedText: Estimates compiled by Bloomberg Intelligence ranged from a gain of 2.2% to 3.6%. The S&P/Case-Shiller index is based on the three-month average price, which means that the data in September will be affected by the buying and selling in July and August.

baad59beac1525451fad320cd045944f34db1538.sourceText: 这份报告还包含季度全国数据。第三季涵盖全美的房价较去年同期上涨 3.6% ，涨幅优于第二季的 1.6% 。若未经季节性调整，全美房价较前季上涨 2.2% ，但若考虑季节性变动因素，房价季涨 1.1% 。
baad59beac1525451fad320cd045944f34db1538.translatedText: This report also contains quarterly national data. House prices nationwide rose 3.6% in the third quarter compared with the same period last year, which was better than the 1.6% increase in the second quarter. Without seasonal adjustment, U.S. home prices rose 2.2% from the previous quarter, but when seasonal changes are taken into account, home prices rose 1.1% quarter-to-quarter.

a8bc7d33a3ee7407965e5233cd974b9f9b55bb2d.sourceText: 若调整季节性变动因素， 9 月房价和前月相比上涨 0.4% ， 20 大都会区中 18 地呈现上涨。亚特兰大和圣地亚哥都上涨 1.7% ，芝加哥房价下跌 0.7% ，佛州天帕持平。未经调整房价月涨 0.3% 。
a8bc7d33a3ee7407965e5233cd974b9f9b55bb2d.translatedText: If seasonal changes are adjusted, house prices increased by 0.4% in September compared with the previous month, with 18 of the 20 metropolitan areas showing increases. Atlanta and San Diego both rose 1.7%, Chicago prices fell 0.7% and Tempa, Florida, was flat. Unadjusted home prices rose 0.3% monthly.

75ab891a198c9e85f10ecff01811500b4a8e2872.sourceText: 指数中 20 座城市中 18 座出现年涨幅，以凤凰城大涨 20.4% 居首。纽约和芝加哥房价都较去年同期降低。年比纪录始于 2001 年。 更多有关房地产的信息请咨询金信地产的 Tinna (480)287-0180 E-mail:Goldtrustrealty2010@gmail.com
75ab891a198c9e85f10ecff01811500b4a8e2872.translatedText: 18 of the 20 cities in the index experienced annual growth, led by Phoenix, which rose 20.4%. Home prices in New York and Chicago are both lower than this time last year. The year-over-year record began in 2001. For more information about real estate, please contact Tinna of Goldtrust Realty (480)287-0180 E-mail:Goldtrustrealty2010@gmail.com

9b1f57f0708874b6331e970bd5874bd56f4cb61c.translatedText: Lawyer Huang Huili’s legal mailbox (1) 1. I am a chef in a Chinese restaurant. I was injured in the kitchen and was sent to the hospital for a few stitches on my hand. Please tell me: Can I sue my former boss...

8dc5e0b0679b5ea2b80797b390cd162fd55e55e0.sourceText: 1。 我是一家中餐馆的厨师﹐在厨房受伤﹐送到医院手部缝了几针﹐请问：我可以告以前的老闆，请求赔偿吗？ 答：凡是职工在「工作范围内」受伤，都应得到相应的医疗和工资的赔偿以及对其永久性伤害的终身补偿，无论他的雇主在他受伤时是否购买了工伤保险。第一，雇员应该知晓他的工作职责和范围，在什麽情况下属于「正在为雇主工作」或「没有在为雇主工作」。 第二，该桉是否过了工伤赔偿的诉期。纽约州对工伤桉件的索偿诉期为从受到伤害之日起两年内，如两年内当事人未通过法律手段提起索偿，则视为自动放弃。
8dc5e0b0679b5ea2b80797b390cd162fd55e55e0.translatedText: 1. I am a chef in a Chinese restaurant. I was injured in the kitchen and was sent to the hospital for several stitches on my hand. Can I sue my former boss for compensation? Answer: Any employee who is injured "in the scope of work" should receive corresponding medical treatment and wage compensation as well as lifelong compensation for permanent injuries, regardless of whether his employer purchased work-related injury insurance when he was injured. First, the employee should know the responsibilities and scope of his job, and under what circumstances he is "working for the employer" or "not working for the employer." Second, whether the case has expired for workers’ compensation compensation. The period for claiming compensation for work-related injuries in New York State is two years from the date of injury. If the party fails to file a claim through legal means within two years, it will be deemed to have been automatically abandoned.

68862a953dc02a365ed937c0b6361814910d7722.sourceText: 2。 我和妈妈分别持K-1、K-2签证合法来美，我进入美国时是17岁。 我的妈妈与继父在90天内登记结婚，但婚后并不幸福。我的继父出尔反尔，我和妈妈因此错失了几个移民局面试的重要机会，后来我们就重新到移民局面试，那时我20岁都不到，移民官却说我已经超龄，不能做为妈妈的附属申请人了。我如何在美国调整身分，并顺利进出入美国？ 答： 你跟随母亲以未婚妻K-1签证及未婚妻子女K-2签证入境美国，你母亲按规定在90天内与你继父结婚，但继父因为出尔反尔错过你母亲的面谈机会，使你的K-2签证及调整身分的机会，因超龄被拒。 联邦第九巡迴上诉法院最近的判例Matter of Le桉中，联邦法官的判决是以K-2签证入境跟随绿卡者的年龄，其起算应以入境日期来决定，并判决跟随绿卡的当事人，只须在21岁前入境美国即可。依此计算，若你入境时未满18岁，根据Le的判决，你应属Le判例的受益者。 你的桉件因你的继父几次不愿意去面谈，导致你丧失获得调整身分的机会。你母亲调整身分，若是根据当初K-1签证申请的，那麽，你应可根据Le桉的判例申请调整身分。 如果你母亲是以新的桉件调整身分，你还是可以用Le的判例提出申请。
68862a953dc02a365ed937c0b6361814910d7722.translatedText: 2. My mother and I came to the United States legally with K-1 and K-2 visas respectively. I was 17 years old when I entered the United States. My mother and stepfather registered their marriage within 90 days, but they were not happy after their marriage. My stepfather went back on his word, so my mother and I missed several important opportunities to be interviewed by the Immigration Bureau. Later, we went back to the Immigration Bureau for interviews. I was less than 20 years old at the time, but the immigration officer said that I was overage and could not be my mother’s dependent applicant. How do I adjust my status in the United States and enter and exit the United States smoothly? Answer: You followed your mother to enter the United States with a K-1 visa for your fiancée and a K-2 visa for your fiancée and daughter. Your mother was required to marry your stepfather within 90 days, but your stepfather went back on his promise and missed your mother’s interview opportunity. As a result, your K-2 visa and the opportunity to adjust status were rejected because you were overage. In the recent case of the Ninth Circuit Court of Appeals, Matter of Leuc, a federal judge ruled that the age of a person who entered the United States with a K-2 visa to follow a green card should be determined based on the date of entry, and ruled that the person following a green card only needs to enter the United States before the age of 21. Based on this calculation, if you were under 18 years old when you entered the country, you should be a beneficiary of Le’s decision according to Le’s decision. In your case, because your stepfather was unwilling to go to interviews several times, you lost the opportunity to adjust your status. If your mother applied for adjustment of status based on the original K-1 visa, then you should be able to apply for adjustment of status based on Le Eucalyptus’s case. If your mother adjusts her status under a new case, you can still apply using Le's case.

001b6ce890d1c72d3c744fc15456340534458c63.translatedText: Phoenix Chinese School Spring Class Openings and Activities (Photos) (Phoenix Chinese School Contributed) The new year begins, Phoenix Chinese School opens on January 12th...

d7b46a84de16cb5caa3c3c09491af7461bfe71a4.sourceText: （凤凰城中文学校 来稿） 新的一年开始，凤凰城中文学校在1月12日正式开始春季班的课程。回顾去年下半年度，秋季班课程採用新教材Better Chinese，加以网路教学辅助学生在家练习，以因应许多非华语家庭的需要。活动方面，除了每年举行的秋季烤肉和高年级认字比赛以外，今年学生代联会也组织了许多有意义的活动。例如感恩节拍卖会中，热心的家长和学生们将各家庭捐赠的物品拍卖，为学校募得款项。在岁末寒冬之际，代联会发起捐罐头给慈济活动，帮助有需要的贫户。
d7b46a84de16cb5caa3c3c09491af7461bfe71a4.translatedText: (Phoenix Chinese School Contributed) At the beginning of the new year, Phoenix Chinese School officially started its spring classes on January 12th. Looking back on the second half of last year, the fall class adopted the new textbook Better Chinese, and added online teaching to assist students in practicing at home to meet the needs of many non-Chinese-speaking families. In terms of activities, in addition to the annual autumn barbecue and senior word recognition competition, the Student Generation Association also organized many meaningful activities this year. For example, during the Thanksgiving auction, enthusiastic parents and students auctioned items donated by families to raise funds for the school. At the end of the year and the cold winter, the Federation of Youth League launched an activity to donate cans to Tzu Chi to help poor households in need.

4108a2f58d2a0cebbcc823294e7e732b5a4241e9.sourceText: 除了义卖活动，凤凰城中文学校另外也出售餐厅优惠卡 (Restaurant Discount Card)。几位学生代联会成员，在去年感恩节假期间，走访了近三十家餐厅，为中文学校家庭争取用餐优惠。这次的优惠卡有许多新餐厅加入，欢迎大家到学校办公室购买餐厅优惠卡，让您在享用美食之馀，也可以享受价格的优惠。除了餐厅优惠卡，学校也出售欣欣超市礼劵，欢迎大家购买。
4108a2f58d2a0cebbcc823294e7e732b5a4241e9.translatedText: In addition to charity sales, Phoenix Chinese School also sells Restaurant Discount Cards. Several members of the Student Representatives Association visited nearly 30 restaurants during last year’s Thanksgiving holiday to obtain meal discounts for Chinese school families. Many new restaurants have been added to the discount card this time. Everyone is welcome to purchase a restaurant discount card at the school office, so that you can not only enjoy delicious food, but also enjoy price discounts. In addition to restaurant discount cards, the school also sells Xinxin Supermarket coupons, and everyone is welcome to buy them.

4bbfa01518d87a257b652e4a087c67b8a9d1e94c.sourceText: 春季班开学，凤凰城中文学校也将准备一连串的活动来迎接新的一年，分别是中国春节园游会、中低年级的歌唱朗读话剧表演以及家长大会。首先登场的是一年一度的中国春节园游会。春节庆祝活动将于二月九日，上午十一点至二点半，在美莎社区大学 (Mesa Community College) 校区举行。园游会当天，校方会准备家长提供的中西式美食，饰品游戏摊位，以及精彩的春节表演节目。欢迎大家踊跃参与凤凰城中文学校的各项活动。
4bbfa01518d87a257b652e4a087c67b8a9d1e94c.translatedText: Spring classes have started, and Phoenix Chinese School will also prepare a series of activities to welcome the new year, including the Chinese Spring Festival garden party, singing and reading drama performances for middle and lower grades, and parent meetings. First up is the annual Chinese Spring Festival Garden Party. The Spring Festival celebration will be held on February 9th from 11am to 2:30am on the Mesa Community College campus. On the day of the garden party, the school will prepare Chinese and Western food provided by parents, accessories and game stalls, and exciting Spring Festival performances. Everyone is welcome to actively participate in various activities of Phoenix Chinese School.

3a7ef6764e2e2cf5def73afcff529cfdba25fbfa.sourceText: 昏昏欲睡？ 8食物让你精神百倍
3a7ef6764e2e2cf5def73afcff529cfdba25fbfa.translatedText: sleepy? 8 Food makes you more energetic

fe583cdc90f625786593d20b694c0e771efe3177.sourceText: 昏昏欲睡？ 8食物让你精神百倍 提供能量的食物，包括菠菜、杏仁和海苔。 如果你到了下午就昏昏欲睡，应重新考虑你…
fe583cdc90f625786593d20b694c0e771efe3177.translatedText: Drowsy? 8. Food to make you more energetic. Foods that provide energy include spinach, almonds and seaweed. If you are drowsy by the afternoon, you should reconsider your...

0332b24acf7cff8ec43a8ffac563b7fea992001a.sourceText: 如果你到了下午就昏昏欲睡，应重新考虑你的饮食。为了在繁忙的工作日维持精力旺盛，你需要多吃以下提供能量的食物：
0332b24acf7cff8ec43a8ffac563b7fea992001a.translatedText: If you are drowsy by the afternoon, you should reconsider your diet. In order to maintain high energy during a busy work day, you need to eat more of the following energy-providing foods:

8b2769050a60faec8edd0e9b531938bdbbd38cdb.sourceText: 1.海苔： 海苔富含矿物质碘，而碘透过生化反应和甲状腺荷尔蒙，有助制造能量。
8b2769050a60faec8edd0e9b531938bdbbd38cdb.translatedText: 1. Seaweed: Seaweed is rich in the mineral iodine, and iodine helps produce energy through biochemical reactions and thyroid hormones.

e0cdcc721d23c05a57da71f08f1d6ebc83adc2d1.sourceText: 2. 杏仁： 杏仁含有维他命B7，又称生物素，有助身体把食物转化成能量。生物素在碳水化合物、脂肪和蛋白质的新陈代谢发挥作用。
e0cdcc721d23c05a57da71f08f1d6ebc83adc2d1.translatedText: 2. Almonds: Almonds contain vitamin B7, also known as biotin, which helps the body convert food into energy. Biotin plays a role in the metabolism of carbohydrates, fats and proteins.

94b72bd74e1ec3be2ad6ca323e5e7da2042121c9.sourceText: 3. 食草牛肉： 精瘦牛肉是铁的高级来源，能防止造成疲劳的贫血。身体用铁来保住血液的氧，并将铁输送到组织，铁在细胞制造能量。一份牛肉约含铁每日需要量的12%。
94b72bd74e1ec3be2ad6ca323e5e7da2042121c9.translatedText: 3. Grass-fed beef: Lean beef is an advanced source of iron, which can prevent anemia that causes fatigue. The body uses iron to keep the blood oxygenated and to transport iron to tissues, where it makes energy in cells. One serving of beef contains approximately 12% of the daily requirement of iron.

226249b428f89e42b93923e41ab2dd41491ecddb.sourceText: 4. 燕麦： 干燕麦可加进优格或煮成粥，这种天然碳水化合物含有可以提升能量的钙、纤维和蛋白质。一份燕麦可让你几小时都不饿。
226249b428f89e42b93923e41ab2dd41491ecddb.translatedText: 4. Oats: Dry oats can be added to yogurt or cooked into porridge. This natural carbohydrate contains calcium, fiber and protein that can boost energy. One serving of oats will keep you hungry for hours.

3264f6e310844705ffa50e8f1583bf8bc478637e.sourceText: 5. 淡菜： 淡菜富含生产能量的维他命B12，只要三盎司的淡菜就可提供逾百分之百的每日需要量。由于维他命B12在体内的神经系统和代谢过程扮演关键角色，是平衡饮食的重要部分。
3264f6e310844705ffa50e8f1583bf8bc478637e.translatedText: 5. Mussels: Mussels are rich in energy-producing vitamin B12. Just three ounces of mussels can provide more than 100% of the daily requirement. Because vitamin B12 plays a key role in the nervous system and metabolic processes in the body, it is an important part of a balanced diet.

14bc3e720eab43fa48fe7e8752b2710ab43cb45b.sourceText: 6. 蛋： 蛋提供蛋白质、碘、维他命B6和B12等营养素。专家建议，不要喝第二杯咖啡，改吃一份蛋，这是制造能量和获得蛋白质的好方法。
14bc3e720eab43fa48fe7e8752b2710ab43cb45b.translatedText: 6. Eggs: Eggs provide nutrients such as protein, iodine, vitamins B6 and B12. Experts recommend skipping that second cup of coffee and grabbing an egg instead, which is a great way to create energy and get protein.

dd4bbc58a128c4e7d1de8eeadc62e873fe98350b.sourceText: 7. 鸡肉： 鸡肉含有辅酵素CoQ10，后者有助制造体内90%的能量，对使用高能量的器官，例如心脏、肝脏和肾脏很重要。
dd4bbc58a128c4e7d1de8eeadc62e873fe98350b.translatedText: 7. Chicken: Chicken contains coenzyme CoQ10, which helps produce 90% of the energy in the body and is important for organs that use high energy, such as the heart, liver and kidneys.

563202d71b9ede452d8d5e34d7af11e0741e0dd5.sourceText: 8. 菠菜： 一杯生菠菜富含镁，这是制造能量过程必要的矿物质。
563202d71b9ede452d8d5e34d7af11e0741e0dd5.translatedText: 8. Spinach: A cup of raw spinach is rich in magnesium, a mineral necessary for the energy-making process.

b23baa4903e1e296287ca0c4045cff9a75d74615.translatedText: The population of Alberta has exceeded 7 million for the first time

09c9c566fe6ca0990c09ab39f4be82ca0d4b9608.sourceText: 亚省人口首次超越700万 根据美国人口普查局最近的一份报告，亚利桑那州的人口首次超过700万。 报告称亚利桑那…
09c9c566fe6ca0990c09ab39f4be82ca0d4b9608.translatedText: The population of Arizona has exceeded 7 million for the first time. According to a recent report from the U.S. Census Bureau, the population of Arizona has exceeded 7 million for the first time. Report says Arizona…

3cd72cad7b1747946fe59a353560da44e7990093.sourceText: 根据美国人口普查局最近的一份报告，亚利桑那州的人口首次超过700万。
3cd72cad7b1747946fe59a353560da44e7990093.translatedText: Arizona’s population surpassed 7 million for the first time, according to a recent report from the U.S. Census Bureau.

2e9c4546d0c57e57a5dea978b320fcc0e1a19e7d.sourceText: 报告称亚利桑那州与佛罗里达州一起，击败德克萨斯、科罗拉多和华盛顿特区，并列为人口增长第五位，人口增长率为1.6%。也即是亚利桑那州居民增加了107628人，人口总数为7016270人。
2e9c4546d0c57e57a5dea978b320fcc0e1a19e7d.translatedText: The report says Arizona joins Florida in fifth place in population growth, beating out Texas, Colorado and Washington, D.C., with a population growth rate of 1.6%. That is, the number of Arizona residents increased by 107,628, bringing the total population to 7,016,270.

8e9d2b442d8807290bd80013b290cdab86589a31.sourceText: 这份报告由估计数组成，不是10年一次的定期人口普查所作。下一次官方人口普查定于2020进行。
8e9d2b442d8807290bd80013b290cdab86589a31.translatedText: This report consists of estimates and is not the result of the 10-year census. The next official census is scheduled for 2020.

4c8252e8cb6a95e4eac6244bc77cc0081073b87a.sourceText: 2017年移居亚利桑那州大约79000人，其中16000人来自他国。
4c8252e8cb6a95e4eac6244bc77cc0081073b87a.translatedText: About 79,000 people immigrated to Arizona in 2017, 16,000 of whom were from other countries.

16ceb1b0b0dd2406ff288ce17437fa6f2ffc3f48.sourceText: 健康是人口增长的另一个因素，今年本州的出生率超过了死亡人数。
16ceb1b0b0dd2406ff288ce17437fa6f2ffc3f48.translatedText: Health is another factor in population growth, with births outpacing deaths in the state this year.

bbca40c24506ad2e6c624097430d31c4fe1108f8.sourceText: 爱达荷州增长最快，人口基数增加了2.2%，内华达州增长2%，犹他增长1.9%，击败亚利桑那州排在第二和第三位。
bbca40c24506ad2e6c624097430d31c4fe1108f8.translatedText: >Idaho grew the fastest, with a population base increase of 2.2%, Nevada grew by 2%, and Utah grew by 1.9%, beating Arizona to rank second and third.

Why is studying in the United States not so beautiful? The number of international students studying in the United States for the first time has dropped for the first time in 12 years. Why is studying in the United States not so beautiful...

c648b0816c1d187d30b16327583dc729200c99c7.translatedText: The number of international students studying in the United States for the first time has dropped for the first time in 12 years

5a2baf6ab0737602c761e8fafa4e05db5ce1364d.sourceText: 留学美国为何不那么美了
5a2baf6ab0737602c761e8fafa4e05db5ce1364d.translatedText: Why studying in the United States is not so beautiful

560f6e16ee9915aae36e42d0696bce4a6abd2bb8.sourceText: 本报驻美国记者 郑 琪
560f6e16ee9915aae36e42d0696bce4a6abd2bb8.translatedText: Our reporter in the United States Zheng Qi

5e821441f3c4c2d3a03bad415434645de24e6214.sourceText: 近日，美国国际教育学会发布年度调查报告显示，2016年度美国在读国际学生总数增速出现放缓迹象，2016年度首次赴美求学国际学生数量与前一年相比，下降了近1万人。这是12年来，该数字首次出现下降。
5e821441f3c4c2d3a03bad415434645de24e6214.translatedText: Recently, the American Institute of International Education released an annual survey report showing that the growth rate of the total number of international students studying in the United States showed signs of slowing down in 2016. The number of international students studying in the United States for the first time in 2016 dropped by nearly 10,000 compared with the previous year. This is the first time in 12 years that this number has declined.

655f01ac969092e38159ac36d638daff18ebd579.sourceText: 国际教育学会于2017年9月、10月联合其他9家教育行业协会对500家美国高校开展的另一项调查表明，2017至2018学年美国高校吸收国际学生增速放缓的态势继续显现，且新生入学数进一步出现了7%的下降。
655f01ac969092e38159ac36d638daff18ebd579.translatedText: Another survey conducted by the Institute of International Education and nine other education industry associations on 500 American colleges and universities in September and October 2017 showed that the slowdown in the number of international students admitted to U.S. colleges and universities in the 2017-2018 academic year continued to show, and the number of new students enrolled further dropped by 7%.

87af3d663628588159430ec6f51ab079c77cc080.sourceText: 非知名高校国际学生数量下降明显
87af3d663628588159430ec6f51ab079c77cc080.translatedText: The number of international students in non-well-known universities has dropped significantly

f33aef0755b0ecced6ad8fa5fc8b63205d387099.sourceText: 根据美国国际教育学会年度报告，2016至2017学年，美国高校在读国际学生总数大约为108万人，增幅仅为3%，与前些年7%到10%的增幅相比，增速放缓明显。
f33aef0755b0ecced6ad8fa5fc8b63205d387099.translatedText: According to the annual report of the American Institute of International Education, the total number of international students studying in American colleges and universities was approximately 1.08 million in the 2016-2017 academic year, an increase of only 3%. Compared with the 7% to 10% increase in previous years, the growth rate has slowed down significantly.

4c1bfecef57355f3fafc3ebde4b893fa8fcf3570.sourceText: 报告调查项目负责人、国际教育学会研究部主任里耶卡达里博士接受本报记者采访时表示，目前众多美国高校正为国际学生赴美求学热情下降而感到担忧，不少高校认为美国国内的社会政治因素，例如签证政策以及校园安全状况等，正影响国际学生的求学决定。
4c1bfecef57355f3fafc3ebde4b893fa8fcf3570.translatedText: Dr. Rijekadari, the person in charge of the report survey project and director of the Research Department of the Society of International Education, said in an interview with this reporter that many American universities are currently worried about the declining enthusiasm of international students to study in the United States. Many universities believe that domestic socio-political factors in the United States, such as visa policies and campus security conditions, are affecting international students’ decisions to study.

ad6dc2e5db49747b3c91543832d715a0e08386bd.sourceText: 加剧美国高等教育界担忧的是，有研究表明，2017至2018学年国际学生赴美热情将继续降温。6家美国高等教育协会在2017年曾联合开展了一项覆盖全美250所高校的调查，以衡量申请2017年秋天入学的国际学生情况。结果显示，39%受访高校表示国际学生申请数量出现了下降，而申请量上升的高校只有35%，26%的高校则表示没有明显变化。2016年度，中国与印度两国留学生占美国国际学生总数47%，但该项调查表明，25%受访美国高校表示2017年来自中国学生的本科就读申请数下降，26%受访高校表示来自印度学生的本科就读申请下降。
ad6dc2e5db49747b3c91543832d715a0e08386bd.translatedText: What intensifies the concerns of the American higher education community is that research shows that the enthusiasm of international students to come to the United States will continue to cool down in the 2017-2018 academic year. In 2017, six American higher education associations jointly conducted a survey covering 250 colleges and universities across the United States to measure the situation of international students applying for admission in the fall of 2017. The results show that 39% of the colleges and universities surveyed said that the number of international student applications has declined, while only 35% of the colleges and universities with an increase in applications, and 26% of the colleges and universities said there has been no significant change. In 2016, international students from China and India accounted for 47% of the total number of international students in the United States. However, the survey showed that 25% of the US universities surveyed said that the number of undergraduate applications from Chinese students dropped in 2017, and 26% of the universities surveyed said that the number of undergraduate applications from Indian students dropped.

4e0f2249b5fe0ccc7948ee984ce425aabc28407f.sourceText: 班达里告诉记者，当前不同地区、不同类别高校遭遇的情况不完全一样，例如中西部地区高校以及得克萨斯等州的高校，国际学生热情”退潮”趋势反映得更明显。同时，非知名高校对于国际学生数量下降的担忧更强烈。据报道，艾奥瓦大学2017年秋季国际学生入学总数为3564人，而2015年该校入学国际学生则有4100人。2016年秋，中密苏里大学有2638名国际学生入学，但2017年秋季只有944名。
4e0f2249b5fe0ccc7948ee984ce425aabc28407f.translatedText: Bhandari told reporters that the current situation encountered by different regions and different types of universities is not exactly the same. For example, in universities in the central and western regions and universities in Texas and other states, the "ebbing" trend of international students' enthusiasm is more obvious. At the same time, non-prestigious universities are more worried about the decline in the number of international students. According to reports, the total number of international students enrolled at the University of Iowa in the fall of 2017 was 3,564, while the number of international students enrolled at the school in 2015 was 4,100. In the fall of 2016, there were 2,638 international students enrolled at the University of Central Missouri, but in the fall of 2017 there were only 944.

27106786a2142e818e8c0d568aebb49c3a1c02d5.sourceText: 政治生态与安全状况影响留美热情
27106786a2142e818e8c0d568aebb49c3a1c02d5.translatedText: Political ecology and security conditions affect enthusiasm for studying in the United States

5b7f62d3c1af423d6f97a5ad0f1b23e8e31713ab.sourceText: 美国高等教育界普遍认为，当前美国纷争不断的政治生态与公共舆论影响了国际学生赴美求学的热情。
5b7f62d3c1af423d6f97a5ad0f1b23e8e31713ab.translatedText: The American higher education community generally believes that the current contentious political ecology and public opinion in the United States have affected the enthusiasm of international students to study in the United States.

967e63803ce3f33dc949141d793ea644d34ce6b9.sourceText: 美国国际教育工作者协会首席执行官、美国国务院前助理国务卿埃斯特.里默认为，国际学生家庭普遍注意到了美国的一系列新闻，例如美国政府推出旅行禁令。来自被纳入旅行禁令名单国家的留学生出国参加学术会议或者回国探亲之后可能发现自己无法重新进入美国，预计大约1.7万名学生将受禁令直接影响。潜在的留学生更大的担忧是，一系列新政策与公共讨论反映出美国对待国际学生的态度有了变化棗2017年7月，甚至一度有消息传出，美国国土安全部正考虑推出新规，要求美国在读国际学生每年重新申请签证。
967e63803ce3f33dc949141d793ea644d34ce6b9.translatedText: Esther Rimmer, CEO of the American Association of International Educators and former Assistant Secretary of State of the U.S. Department of State, believes that international student families have generally noticed a series of news in the United States, such as the U.S. government’s travel ban. International students from countries included on the travel ban list may find themselves unable to re-enter the United States after traveling abroad to attend academic conferences or return home to visit relatives. It is expected that approximately 17,000 students will be directly affected by the ban. A bigger concern for potential international students is that a series of new policies and public discussions reflect changes in the United States' attitude towards international students. In July 2017, it was even reported that the U.S. Department of Homeland Security was considering introducing new regulations that would require international students studying in the United States to reapply for visas every year.

b8a8def96fd5df9ab36a43e29a867e634bc66ed8.sourceText: 美国惠顿学院院长丹尼斯.汉诺此前在《华盛顿邮报》网站撰文指出，”我们的政治气候才是问题所在”。汉诺以自身经历举例指出，当前美国公共舆论风波不断，正让更多国际学生将目光转向别处。惠顿学院2017年曾推出一项专门为战乱国家学生设计的奖学金，且在发放时侧重考虑来自被纳入旅行禁令国家的学生。此举引起了美国国内自由派的广泛支持，但在保守派人士中引起了愤怒，甚至许多校友、捐赠者也出面明确表示反对。
b8a8def96fd5df9ab36a43e29a867e634bc66ed8.translatedText: Dennis Hanno, president of Wheaton College in the United States, previously wrote an article on the Washington Post website and pointed out that "our political climate is the problem." Taking his own experience as an example, Hanno pointed out that the current turmoil in public opinion in the United States is causing more international students to look elsewhere. Wheaton College launched a scholarship specifically designed for students from war-torn countries in 2017, and will focus on students from countries that have been included in the travel ban. This move aroused widespread support from liberals in the United States, but also caused anger among conservatives, and even many alumni and donors came forward to express their opposition.

9334726de884110dace8a36d83868e302dda85f3.sourceText: 美国社会愈来愈频繁发生的枪击事件、仇恨言论等，也被认为影响了国际学生的选择。2017年早些时候，一名印度裔工程师在堪萨斯城遭枪击死亡，该案主犯被曝出是出于种族仇恨行凶。此事在印度国内引起广泛关注，印度驻美使馆还一度介入。在高校看来，类似事件影响了印度学生赴美求学的积极性。位于俄勒冈州的波特兰州立大学2017年印度学生申请数下降了37%。该校校长维姆?#32500;维尔在前往印度南部城市海德拉巴与数位被该校录取的印度学生见面后表示，这些学生的家长普遍对孩子在美国的安全状况担忧。
9334726de884110dace8a36d83868e302dda85f3.translatedText: The increasingly frequent shooting incidents and hate speech in American society are also believed to have affected the choices of international students. Earlier in 2017, an Indian-American engineer was shot and killed in Kansas City. The main suspect in the case was revealed to have committed the murder out of racial hatred. This matter has attracted widespread attention in India, and the Indian Embassy in the United States even intervened. From the perspective of universities, similar incidents have affected the enthusiasm of Indian students to study in the United States. Portland State University in Oregon saw a 37% drop in applications from Indian students in 2017. After going to the southern Indian city of Hyderabad to meet with several Indian students admitted to the school, Wim Veer, the principal of the school, said that the parents of these students are generally worried about the safety of their children in the United States.

b97e41b4fd379082075881cf8bc876ffc1b5c810.sourceText: 与此同时，在吸引留学生方面，各国大学的竞争也在加剧。据美国全国广播公司财经频道报道，当前加拿大高校对国际学生的吸引力显著提升，多伦多大学国际学生申请数增加了20%，威尔弗雷德?#21171;里埃大学国际学生申请数增加了32%。分析认为，更多学生在美国与加拿大高校间选择后者，因为后者就学成本更低。有统计显示，国际学生在加拿大公立大学就读本科一年学费平均为17264美元，在美国则是24930美元。事实上，更多美国学生也正因为成本因素选择赴国外求学。2016年，超过32万美国学生选择赴国外攻读学位，比前一年增加了4%。
b97e41b4fd379082075881cf8bc876ffc1b5c810.translatedText: At the same time, competition among universities from various countries is also intensifying in attracting international students. According to NBC News, Canadian universities have become more attractive to international students. The number of international students applying to the University of Toronto has increased by 20%, and the number of international students applying to Wilfried University has increased by 32%. Analysts believe that more students choose the latter between American and Canadian universities because the cost of studying in the latter is lower. Statistics show that the average one-year undergraduate tuition fee for international students studying at public universities in Canada is US$17,264, while in the United States it is US$24,930. In fact, more American students are choosing to study abroad because of cost factors. In 2016, more than 320,000 U.S. students chose to pursue degrees abroad, an increase of 4% from the previous year.

46bdbbf2ec9a29d1d0d645f3ebc31f3227ee9179.sourceText: 美国教育界担心大学开放性与竞争力受损
46bdbbf2ec9a29d1d0d645f3ebc31f3227ee9179.translatedText: The American education sector is worried about the damage to the openness and competitiveness of universities

1b8ed366f57d8319c8b89f9eedb137cc8bff5376.sourceText: 2006年以来，美国高等教育国际化经历了一段黄金期，国际学生数量增加了85%。正因为已经习惯了前些年的快速增长，当前国际学生赴美热情下降趋势引起了美国高等教育界的普遍担忧。
1b8ed366f57d8319c8b89f9eedb137cc8bff5376.translatedText: Since 2006, the internationalization of higher education in the United States has experienced a golden period, with the number of international students increasing by 85%. Just because they have become accustomed to the rapid growth in previous years, the current declining trend in the enthusiasm of international students to come to the United States has aroused widespread concern in the American higher education community.

62630fc1bfdc39c3e104188828b19a679f115240.sourceText: 这其中不乏经济层面的考虑。根据美国商务部的数据，2016年度，国际学生给美国带来的收益达到390亿美元，包括学费、住宿与生活支出等。大约2/3的在读国际学生从美国以外获得学习生活经费。具体到每一所高校，国际学生入学带来的经济好处也是明显的。加州大学洛杉矶分校校长吉恩洛克不久前就曾坦承，加州以外学生缴纳的高额学费，让学校有足够的经费提供更多教育项目，进而为所有学生带来益处。
62630fc1bfdc39c3e104188828b19a679f115240.translatedText: There are many economic considerations in this. According to the U.S. Department of Commerce, in 2016, international students brought US$39 billion in revenue to the United States, including tuition, accommodation and living expenses. About two-thirds of current international students receive funding for their studies and living expenses from outside the United States. Specific to each university, the economic benefits brought by the enrollment of international students are also obvious. UCLA President Gene Locke admitted not long ago that the high tuition fees paid by students outside California allow the school to have enough funds to provide more educational programs, thereby benefiting all students.

01f4f84f623bb9f9bbdf8782592a66bc175f5e29.sourceText: ”美国吸引国际学生的情况是衡量美国国际角色的晴雨表。”美国国务院高级顾问瑞克.露丝此前在公开活动中如此表示。目前，美国高校普遍担忧美国政治生态中孤立主义抬头，并将逐步影响到大学的开放性与竞争力。哈佛大学教授约瑟夫.奈最近在一篇长文中写道，当前美国社会民粹主义抬头，其诉求更接近历史上19世纪反移民的无知党以及麦卡锡、乔治.华莱士版本的民粹主义，特点正是仇外和追求与外界隔离。
01f4f84f623bb9f9bbdf8782592a66bc175f5e29.translatedText: "The U.S.'s ability to attract international students is a barometer of its international role." Rick Ruth, senior adviser to the U.S. State Department, previously said in a public event. Currently, American universities are generally worried about the rise of isolationism in the American political ecology, which will gradually affect the openness and competitiveness of universities. Joseph Nye, a professor at Harvard University, recently wrote in a long article that populism is currently on the rise in American society, and its demands are closer to the historical anti-immigration Know-Nothing Party in the 19th century and the McCarthy and George Wallace versions of populism. Its characteristics are xenophobia and the pursuit of isolation from the outside world.

567dadb70275529a38f0a50d2c9ca40cf4562060.sourceText: 一直以来，美国教育界普遍认为，国际学生进入美国，增加了校园多元性，有助于打造更加富有创新性的学术环境。正因为有感于美国一直引以为傲的教育优势被削弱，美国国际教育学会会长艾伦.古德曼在年度报告发布后指出，”各国争夺人才的竞争正在加剧，美国高校积极主动接触国际学生很重要，美国保持其学术大门的开放性更是至关重要”。
567dadb70275529a38f0a50d2c9ca40cf4562060.translatedText: It has always been generally believed in the American education community that the entry of international students into the United States increases the diversity of campuses and helps create a more innovative academic environment. Feeling that the educational advantages that the United States has always been proud of have been weakened, Alan Goodman, president of the American Institute of International Education, pointed out after the release of the annual report, "The competition among countries for talents is intensifying. It is important for American universities to proactively contact international students, and it is even more crucial for the United States to keep its academic door open."

b0610c52b69b12b2aa33b4bbc0110fd647875fac.sourceText: 2018这一年 美国如何引领世界
b0610c52b69b12b2aa33b4bbc0110fd647875fac.translatedText: How does the United States lead the world in 2018?

23a9b3fe7175c9b5dbd072edecbd4acbbfbee314.sourceText: 2018这一年 美国如何引领世界 特派员看世界专栏（中央社记者郑崇生华盛顿2日专电）「（今年）将是很棒的一…
23a9b3fe7175c9b5dbd072edecbd4acbbfbee314.translatedText: How does the United States lead the world in 2018? The Special Correspondent's World Column (Central News Agency reporter Zheng Chongsheng's special telegraph from Washington on the 2nd) "(This year) will be a great year...

7a97a847c08b1a381d91ed90e10c87cba255cf60.sourceText: 特派员看世界专栏（中央社记者郑崇生华盛顿2日专电）「（今年）将是很棒的一年」。美国总统川普新年首日在推特上寄语未来，会成真吗？像美国这样一个国家，她的国内政经情势影响世界变化，展望新年，险阻与机会都待观察。
7a97a847c08b1a381d91ed90e10c87cba255cf60.translatedText: The Special Correspondent's Look at the World Column (Central News Agency reporter Zheng Chongsheng's special telegraph from Washington on the 2nd) "(This year) will be a great year." US President Trump tweeted about the future on the first day of the new year. Will it come true? For a country like the United States, its domestic political and economic situation affects world changes. Looking into the new year, both obstacles and opportunities remain to be seen.

86301bee3a9918478b0e9e27beff7c35606626d3.sourceText: 新年川普返回白宫第一个上班日，到今天中午前川普已10连发文，果然不出众人所料，新年其实还是作法照旧。
86301bee3a9918478b0e9e27beff7c35606626d3.translatedText: It is Trump’s first working day after returning to the White House in the new year. By noon today, Trump has issued 10 consecutive messages. As expected, the new year is still the same as before.

8b91e3059df72b7e6d4066fcdce7a74e3386c0ba.sourceText: 逐条来看，川普连发推文的摘要包括：伊朗人民受苦，前总统奥巴马却「傻傻地」让伊朗政府资助恐怖份子；「狡猾希拉蕊」的助理阿贝定违规使用政府机密资讯，抓去关，司法部会对她的团队及前联邦调查局局长柯米展开行动吗？
8b91e3059df72b7e6d4066fcdce7a74e3386c0ba.translatedText: Looking at it one by one, the summary of Trump's tweets includes: The Iranian people are suffering, but former President Obama "foolishly" allowed the Iranian government to fund terrorists; "Crooked Hillary"'s assistant Abedine violated the rules of using government secret information and was jailed. Will the Department of Justice take action against her team and former FBI Director Comey?

45efa215f6ed1a27699712c7f1a1d6508b10104c.sourceText: 美国亟需盖边境城墙；减稅让企业为员工加薪，真棒；制裁与其他施压北韩的策略奏效，火箭人现在想与南韩沟通；上任後严管商业飞航安全，去年零死亡，「史上最安全一年」。
45efa215f6ed1a27699712c7f1a1d6508b10104c.translatedText: > The United States urgently needs to build a border wall; tax cuts allow companies to raise wages for employees, which is awesome; sanctions and other strategies to pressure North Korea have worked, and Rocket Man now wants to communicate with South Korea; after taking office, he has strictly controlled the safety of commercial aviation. There were no deaths last year, "the safest year in history."

714f641d7b0e3ef54c9ae4c5dfd4f792b9ccce59.sourceText: 衰败的纽约时报换老板；公平对待美国总统，下次赢得连任时，就不用为糟糕的报导表现向读者道歉；民主党只关心政治，根本不关心「追梦人计划」，那些追梦人会开始爱上有解决方案的共和党和他们的总统；照顾退伍军人。
714f641d7b0e3ef54c9ae4c5dfd4f792b9ccce59.translatedText: >The declining New York Times changes owners; be fair to the President of the United States and won’t have to apologize to readers for poor reporting performance next time he wins re-election; the Democratic Party only cares about politics and does not care about the "Dreamers" program. Those Dreamers will start to fall in love with the Republican Party and their president who have solutions; take care of veterans.

7824d091afa62cb9a9f05a7a2d7cb815e6b61ee5.sourceText: 川普说了很多，或许可以5句话总结：媒体与反对党烂透了，（自己）过去一年做得都棒呆了，外交上前政府的作为都超失败，直到上任後开始改变了，例如北韩。
7824d091afa62cb9a9f05a7a2d7cb815e6b61ee5.translatedText: Trump said a lot, which can be summarized in five sentences: the media and the opposition parties are terrible, (he) has done a great job in the past year, and the previous government’s actions in diplomacy were extremely failed. It was not until he took office that things started to change, such as North Korea.

81f10d61eb6b0be3503861d790ac5e78ce4b8e2c.sourceText: 不过，事实是，奥巴马上任首年的2009年，美国的商业飞行安全也是零死亡，更不要说奥巴马一上台面对金融危机、美国经济在大萧条後最严重一次的考验，经过8年的改革调养，才交棒给川普。
81f10d61eb6b0be3503861d790ac5e78ce4b8e2c.translatedText: However, the fact is that in 2009, the first year that Obama took office, there were no fatalities in commercial flight safety in the United States. Not to mention that as soon as Obama came to power, he faced the financial crisis and the most serious test of the U.S. economy after the Great Depression. After eight years of reform and adjustment, the baton was handed over to Trump.

973f358636efae54a8d5b1392c97b75757d44fb5.sourceText: 川普清楚掌握「笨蛋、问题在经济」才是民众最关切的话题，和多数经济学者不同，他爱用股市当作美国经济的观察指标，但必须说，川普接手後，「初领失业救济金人数」去年都维持在30万人内，这一经济先行指标直接反映经济基本面，他确实可以骄傲，上任以来让美国的就业稳定发展，失业率在去年11月也再创多年来新低的4.1%。
973f358636efae54a8d5b1392c97b75757d44fb5.translatedText: Trump clearly understands that "idiot, the problem is the economy" is the topic of greatest concern to the public. Unlike most economists, he likes to use the stock market as an observation indicator of the US economy. However, it must be said that after Trump took over, "initially The number of people receiving unemployment benefits remained at 300,000 last year. This leading economic indicator directly reflects the fundamentals of the economy. He can indeed be proud that since taking office, he has made employment in the United States develop steadily, and the unemployment rate hit a multi-year low of 4.1% in November last year.

c601eaa477938a412752c05ee99f8fb06bc7621d.sourceText: 但诺贝尔经济学獎得主、哥伦比亚大学教授史提格里兹（Joseph Stiglitz）明白指出，这是「前人种树、後人乘凉」。
c601eaa477938a412752c05ee99f8fb06bc7621d.translatedText: However, Joseph Stiglitz, the Nobel Prize winner in economics and professor at Columbia University, clearly pointed out that this is "the trees planted by the predecessors and the shade provided by the descendants."

e1080e6b0b6dbdb8ed4051251d5b386aea3e4c83.sourceText: 史提格里兹曾在克林顿政府时期担任白宫经济顾问，他担心的是减稅方案付诸实施，不但美国分配不均将更恶化，已突破举债上限20兆美元的国债，在政府在口袋空空下、「少开源、也不节流」，美国现在看似复甦，恐是另一场经济风暴前的回光返照。
e1080e6b0b6dbdb8ed4051251d5b386aea3e4c83.translatedText: Stiglitz served as the White House economic adviser during the Clinton administration. He is worried that if the tax cut plan is implemented, not only will the uneven distribution of the United States worsen, but the national debt has already exceeded the debt limit of 20 trillion US dollars. With the government's pockets empty, "less revenue and less expenditure," the United States' current recovery may be a flashback before another economic storm.

22fc329495b28a8b966cbd4d98e989f85b30d926.sourceText: 前财政部长路杰克（Jacob Lew）今天接受彭博广播访问时更说，经济才好些，政府减稅又举债，形同「透支未来」、花「不知在哪」的数兆美元，他疾言「这会让国家垮台」。
22fc329495b28a8b966cbd4d98e989f85b30d926.translatedText: Former Finance Minister Jacob Lew said in an interview with Bloomberg Radio today that the economy is better, and the government cuts taxes and borrows money, which is like "overdrafting the future" and spending trillions of dollars "who knows where". He said "this will bring down the country."

0a284327bac5c1eb8c8ac7b9df7e94532074875d.sourceText: 別以为美国国债问题和身在台湾的你我没关系，就以台湾来说，是持有美国国债的第10大外国政府，如果造成金融危机的那些华尔街银行业「大到不能倒」，美国是否就好像那些大银行？而台湾及众多持有美国国债的国家，不就像是当时投资衍生性金融商品的投资者？
0a284327bac5c1eb8c8ac7b9df7e94532074875d.translatedText: Don't think that the U.S. national debt issue has nothing to do with you and me in Taiwan. Taiwan, for example, is the 10th largest foreign government holding U.S. government debt. If the Wall Street banks that caused the financial crisis are "too big to fail," is the United States just like those big banks? Isn’t it true that Taiwan and many other countries that hold U.S. Treasury bonds are like investors who invested in derivative financial products at that time?

74e406b7b84cb01495eaea2e28b475fab0e54c76.sourceText: 彭博社在一篇文章中列举今年13个展望与恐惧，今年秋天，调查「通俄门」的特別检察官穆勒会做出什么结论，是美国舆论首要关切，但不论结果如何，川普今年在「通俄门」阴影「烟不消、云未散」情况下，他的内政治理已预见有难关要过。
74e406b7b84cb01495eaea2e28b475fab0e54c76.translatedText: Bloomberg listed 13 prospects and fears for this year in an article. This fall, what conclusion will be made by the special prosecutor Mueller investigating the "Russia scandal" will be the primary concern of American public opinion. However, no matter what the outcome is, Trump has foreseen difficulties in his domestic political management this year as the shadow of the "Russia scandal" still lingers.

039d35fe7010b5ec02833542d60943f80cc500bf.sourceText: 如此，川普还能有多少心力关注外交事务？或是一样做自己，不时和各国领导人隔空叫阵？最要担心的就是北韩领导人金正恩和川普的口水对决，就怕误判与擦枪走火，不只日本与南韩，中国也会受冲击。
039d35fe7010b5ec02833542d60943f80cc500bf.translatedText: In this case, how much more attention can Trump have to focusing on foreign affairs? Or do you just stay true to yourself and chat with leaders of various countries from time to time? The most worrying thing is the verbal duel between North Korean leader Kim Jong-un and Trump. They are afraid of miscalculation and misfire. Not only Japan and South Korea, but also China will be affected.

f4cc3ccefa4762b3feeb9a688b52e681458144de.sourceText: 史提格里兹预测，这一年，川普政府将在贸易协定上亮剑，但从北美自由贸易协定到美韩自贸协定重新谈判都陷僵局来看，他不看好美国能在谈判桌上如川普所愿，但接下来，川普会有退出协定这一步吗？美国与中国的贸易争端，会不会掀起贸易战？全球化已拉近、拉平的世界，牵一发、动全身，地球村成员，都受牵连。
f4cc3ccefa4762b3feeb9a688b52e681458144de.translatedText: Stiglitz predicts that this year, the Trump administration will show its sword on trade agreements, but judging from the deadlock in the renegotiation of the North American Free Trade Agreement and the US-Korea Free Trade Agreement, he is not optimistic that the United States can meet Trump's wishes at the negotiating table. But next, will Trump take the step of withdrawing from the agreement? Will the trade dispute between the United States and China trigger a trade war? Globalization has narrowed and flattened the world, affecting the whole body. Members of the global village are all affected.

019898bb6df7d8bf2eadd1739f960ed34dad44fc.sourceText: 国际秩序与经贸规则在川普上任将满一年後、面临挑战的风险更高，虽然川普政府高举印太区域要建立「自由、开放与互惠」的市场经济规则，但仍应密切注意美国何时能推出更清楚的蓝图。
019898bb6df7d8bf2eadd1739f960ed34dad44fc.translatedText: The international order and economic and trade rules are at higher risk of facing challenges nearly a year after Trump took office. Although the Trump administration advocates the establishment of "free, open and reciprocal" market economic rules in the Indo-Pacific region, we should still pay close attention to when the United States can launch a clearer blueprint.

372578fd32a4e0b4f93c226ddd2506579c66a9f3.sourceText: 2018这一年、美国还将举行犹如川普「期中考」的国会改选，共和党如果继续在两院占多数、形同川普过关，但是，川普的世界观就更将继续影响全球政经发展；反之，川普将和他的多位前任总统一样，出现跛鸭姿态，而治理美国这样一个国家的能力，也关乎美国国际地位的维系，考验的不只是川普而已。
372578fd32a4e0b4f93c226ddd2506579c66a9f3.translatedText: In 2018, the United States will hold a congressional reelection that will be like Trump's "midterm exam." If the Republican Party continues to hold the majority in both houses and is similar to Trump, Trump's worldview will continue to influence global political and economic development; on the contrary, Trump will behave like many of his predecessors, showing a lame-duck attitude. The ability to govern a country like the United States is also related to the maintenance of the United States' international status, and it is not just Trump who will be tested.

e4f532cdabdc56cf1cacef7083b88058aaedcdd6.sourceText: 2018会是什么样的一年？但愿真如川普所说，是很棒的，We’ll see（我们等著看）。1070103
e4f532cdabdc56cf1cacef7083b88058aaedcdd6.translatedText: >What kind of year will 2018 be? I hope it’s as great as Trump said. We’ll see. 1070103
