4a34c8f47f0550d7a63a32e012b775d859ec9807.sourceText: NASA：元旦将有超级月亮 月底有月全食 2018年的第一天，美国将迎来这一年的第一个超级月亮，错过了没关系，…
4a34c8f47f0550d7a63a32e012b775d859ec9807.translatedText: NASA: There will be a super moon on New Year’s Day and a total lunar eclipse at the end of the month On the first day of 2018, the United States will usher in the first super moon of the year. It doesn’t matter if you miss it,...

9f8567ca26818bc115bef2198cc71ad8b94b0bf1.sourceText: 明年（2018年）的第一天，美国将迎来这一年的第一个超级月亮，错过了没关系，因为紧接着明年1月的最后一天又有一个超级月亮。
9f8567ca26818bc115bef2198cc71ad8b94b0bf1.translatedText: On the first day of next year (2018), the United States will usher in the first super moon of the year. It doesn’t matter if you miss it, because there will be another super moon on the last day of January next year.

9966e10e92a3cf7f432dc1d4966524c3bdb9ac4b.sourceText: 根据美国国家航空航天局（NASA）网站，2018年第一个超级月亮（Super Moon）出现在1月1日，在美东地区的人们，当天晚上9点24分会看到大又大又亮的满月。
9966e10e92a3cf7f432dc1d4966524c3bdb9ac4b.translatedText: According to the National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA) website, the first super moon (Super Moon) in 2018 will appear on January 1. People in the eastern United States will see a big, bright and full moon at 9:24 pm that day.

1e57e01a446b38cbba1df4d85d19439ca6ea4361.sourceText: 超级月亮发生在月球距离地球最近的时候，大约每隔13个月会出现一次。它的大小会比平时满月大14%，亮度则高出30%。前一次超级月亮是在2017年12月3日。
1e57e01a446b38cbba1df4d85d19439ca6ea4361.translatedText: Super moons occur when the moon is closest to the earth and occur approximately every 13 months. It will be 14% larger and 30% brighter than the normal full moon. The previous supermoon was on December 3, 2017.

d3e8f333c2b951386e0b1dfeb57c80df5051917d.sourceText: 如果错过1月1日的超级月亮，不用担心，因为明年第二个超级满月出现在1月31日。
d3e8f333c2b951386e0b1dfeb57c80df5051917d.translatedText: If you miss the super moon on January 1, don’t worry, because the second super full moon next year will appear on January 31.

1a32e6286fbd5db4e3ff64a2885f50fb68465875.sourceText: 2017年12月4日，在法国南部Marseille市拍到的超级月亮。(ANNE-CHRISTINE POUJOULAT/AFP/Getty Images)
1a32e6286fbd5db4e3ff64a2885f50fb68465875.translatedText: >The super moon photographed in Marseille, southern France, on December 4, 2017. (ANNE-CHRISTINE POUJOULAT/AFP/Getty Images)

17c613c0b69e64a3371fc9e898697c67a78f909d.sourceText: NASA表示，大约每隔两年半会发生一个月内出现两个超级月亮，有些人会将第二个满月称为”蓝月亮”（Blue Moon）。它只是一个天文术语，当晚人们看到的月亮颜色和平常看到的相仿，不会看到蓝色的月亮。
17c613c0b69e64a3371fc9e898697c67a78f909d.translatedText: NASA said that two super moons will appear within one month approximately every two and a half years. Some people will call the second full moon a "Blue Moon". It is just an astronomical term. The color of the moon that people see that night is similar to what they usually see. They will not see a blue moon.

ccfb29a2f39706b2c5480bf40d500775bab96422.sourceText: 2017年12月3日，美国华府上空的超级月亮。(NASA/Bill Ingalls via Getty Images)
ccfb29a2f39706b2c5480bf40d500775bab96422.translatedText: On December 3, 2017, the super moon over Washington, USA. (NASA/Bill Ingalls via Getty Images)

1907bdcc728353deb06b6b33d45861962057f9b6.sourceText: 更特别的是，明年1月31日的蓝月亮正巧遇上月全食，地球、太阳，月亮排在一起，地球会遮挡太阳直射在月亮上的光线。这次月全食，在北美、太平洋及东亚地区的人们，都可以看到。
1907bdcc728353deb06b6b33d45861962057f9b6.translatedText: What’s even more special is that the blue moon on January 31 next year will coincide with a total lunar eclipse. The earth, sun, and moon are aligned, and the earth will block the sun’s direct light on the moon. This total lunar eclipse can be seen by people in North America, the Pacific and East Asia.

666906e5f24ab1e07b9c950ef0d1540474bf629a.sourceText: NASA说，当天的满月不会那么明亮，但它将”呈现一种令人毛骨悚然的、比平日的满月更暗淡的光芒，可能是偏红的色调”。
666906e5f24ab1e07b9c950ef0d1540474bf629a.translatedText: NASA said the full moon won't be that bright that day, but it will "show an eerie, dimmer glow than a normal full moon, possibly with a reddish tint."

1ef75c0c0ae65eb0b85f13ddf7541c26a6067e15.sourceText: CNN新闻引述Timeanddate.com网站的资料说，欣赏超级月亮的最佳时机是月亮升起的瞬间，即月亮从地平线上升起的时候。该网站还提供了一个计算器，方便网友查询居住地观赏超级月亮的最佳时间。如果无法观看，也可以在这两个网站 The Virtual Telescope Project 及 Slooh.com 观看。
1ef75c0c0ae65eb0b85f13ddf7541c26a6067e15.translatedText: CNN News quoted information from the Timeanddate.com website as saying that the best time to enjoy the super moon is the moment the moon rises, that is, when the moon rises from the horizon. The website also provides a calculator to help netizens check the best time to watch the super moon where they live. If you can't watch it, you can watch it on these two websites: The Virtual Telescope Project and Slooh.com.

1e7726593a13b4c3e2f238adb6e967083407b20b.sourceText: CDC：亚省等36州发现流感大范围传播
1e7726593a13b4c3e2f238adb6e967083407b20b.translatedText: CDC: 36 states including Alberta have discovered widespread influenza transmission

5a01c91ebefefd71d43d35b06b940f9c874e3914.sourceText: CDC：亚省等36州发现流感大范围传播 今年的流感季节开始得较早，美国疾病控制与预防中心提醒公众开始注射流感疫…
5a01c91ebefefd71d43d35b06b940f9c874e3914.translatedText: >CDC: 36 states including Alberta have discovered widespread influenza transmission. This year’s flu season started earlier, and the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention reminded the public to start getting flu shots...

e0f38bca6004d5e9cf9e8d8baffc042f22dcce9c.sourceText: 今年的流感季节开始得较早，美国疾病控制和预防中心提醒公众开始注射流感疫苗。
e0f38bca6004d5e9cf9e8d8baffc042f22dcce9c.translatedText: This year’s flu season started early, and the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention reminded the public to start getting flu shots.

e75dcd74729cfa7cff279dcf1690f4246212aa7a.sourceText: 今年冬天，寒冷天气席卷美国大部分地区，而流感疫苗的接种率也偏低。美国疾病控制和预防中心（CDC）周五（12月29日）公布的数据显示，上周共收到36个州的流感大范围传播报告，其中有21个州出现较大数量的病案。
e75dcd74729cfa7cff279dcf1690f4246212aa7a.translatedText: As cold weather sweeps across much of the United States this winter, flu vaccine uptake is also low. Data released by the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) on Friday (December 29) showed that a total of 36 states received reports of widespread influenza spread last week, of which 21 states had a large number of cases.

5266d05bccec73600496abac137800eefc2caf18.sourceText: 在亚利桑那州，至12月中止，已确认2,976例流感病患，比去年同期增长了758%。其中一名女婴和一名20岁女子因流感去世。
5266d05bccec73600496abac137800eefc2caf18.translatedText: In Arizona, as of December, 2,976 cases of influenza have been confirmed, an increase of 758% over the same period last year. Among them, a baby girl and a 20-year-old woman died of influenza.

513ec00e925dcbf9d8a58347a9e192ea46d4986e.sourceText: 美国的流感季节通常从10月开始，持续到5月，而流感高峰期通常发生在2月左右。
513ec00e925dcbf9d8a58347a9e192ea46d4986e.translatedText: The flu season in the United States usually starts in October and lasts until May, and the peak flu season usually occurs around February.

11cfc03f4fe2c35ff7b7450bf17cfe92511ccd1f.sourceText: 常见的流感症状包括发烧、全身酸痛、打寒战、疲劳并伴随咳嗽和喉咙痛，这些症状通常会在几天内消失，但对于老人、幼儿、孕妇和有呼吸系统问题的人来说，可能特别危险，因为它可以发展成为肺炎。
11cfc03f4fe2c35ff7b7450bf17cfe92511ccd1f.translatedText: Common flu symptoms include fever, body aches, chills, and fatigue accompanied by a cough and sore throat. These symptoms usually go away within a few days, but can be particularly dangerous for the elderly, young children, pregnant women, and people with respiratory problems, as it can develop into pneumonia.

356f436b8e7dba92b8544012ceba1079e9242516.sourceText: 目前，已经有不同的州报导流感死亡案例。根据《旧金山纪事报》报导，加州至少有10人（65岁以下）死亡。特拉华州当地卫生官员表示，一名47岁的男性和一名83岁的老妇死亡。在北卡罗莱纳州，有12人死亡，其中包括1名儿童。在南卡罗莱纳州，有7人（65岁及以上）死亡。
356f436b8e7dba92b8544012ceba1079e9242516.translatedText: Currently, flu deaths have been reported in different states. According to the San Francisco Chronicle, at least 10 people (under 65 years old) died in California. Local health officials in Delaware said a 47-year-old man and an 83-year-old woman died. In North Carolina, 12 people died, including one child. In South Carolina, seven people (65 and older) have died.

447ba9e0c762211e25b5e86db1083ee8248be74b.sourceText: 美国疾病控制与预防中心最新的流感病毒检测发现，最常见流感病毒类型为甲型流感（H3）。流感疫苗的有效率一直是公众关心的话题。
447ba9e0c762211e25b5e86db1083ee8248be74b.translatedText: The latest influenza virus testing by the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention found that the most common type of influenza virus is influenza A (H3). The effectiveness of influenza vaccines has always been a topic of public concern.

d3d5d989435955d7a9a6074091211dae723bbe71.sourceText: 田纳西大学医学中心（University of Tennessee Medical Center）的传染病预防主管拉特克（Jennifer Radtke）表示，很快CDC会看到今年的流感病毒是否正好与疫苗匹配。
d3d5d989435955d7a9a6074091211dae723bbe71.translatedText: Jennifer Radtke, director of infectious disease prevention at the University of Tennessee Medical Center, said that soon the CDC will see whether this year's flu virus is a good match for the vaccine.

57d6257e38913abbfc0f22b3e8015d1fcb18bd28.sourceText: 她说：”流感疫苗的有效率通常是10%至33%之间，如果疫苗与流感病毒不匹配，就会有更多病例出现。”
57d6257e38913abbfc0f22b3e8015d1fcb18bd28.translatedText: She said: "The effectiveness of the flu vaccine is usually between 10% and 33%. If the vaccine does not match the influenza virus, more cases will occur."

0266867275c7852d6bbd895e4e0fb45e8f509f59.sourceText: 而CDC最近的一项研究也表明，疫苗的有效性每年都有所不同，但是当流行病毒与疫苗病毒匹配时，流感疫苗通常可以使总体的疾病风险降低40%至60%。
0266867275c7852d6bbd895e4e0fb45e8f509f59.translatedText: A recent CDC study also showed that the effectiveness of the vaccine varies from year to year, but when the circulating virus matches the vaccine virus, the flu vaccine can usually reduce the overall risk of disease by 40% to 60%.

911eadb2330d8e83997018375706d9786bd94daa.sourceText: 鉴于此，美国卫生官员表示，虽然流感疫苗不能保证完全奏效，但现在开始接种流感疫苗仍是打击病毒的一种方法。
911eadb2330d8e83997018375706d9786bd94daa.translatedText: In view of this, U.S. health officials say that although the flu vaccine is not guaranteed to be completely effective, starting to get the flu vaccine now is still a way to combat the virus.

54c5e31d176cfab5f6a29c099161ae83db76890d.sourceText: 个人健保计划包含流感疫苗全额给付，美国药剂师协会（American Pharmacists Association）已发布公告说，现在各州的药剂师可以进行流感疫苗接种。
54c5e31d176cfab5f6a29c099161ae83db76890d.translatedText: Individual health insurance plans include full coverage of the flu vaccine, and the American Pharmacists Association has issued an announcement that pharmacists in various states can now administer flu vaccinations.

db5811e074f3018fdfb294ae7491101e66b75c47.sourceText: 连锁药房沃尔格林（Walgreens）的药剂师林德（Jason Lind）说：”人们走进药房，特别是24小​​时药房，随时来、通常15分钟就可以（接种完毕）。”
db5811e074f3018fdfb294ae7491101e66b75c47.translatedText: Jason Lind, a pharmacist at the Walgreens pharmacy chain, said: "People walk into pharmacies, especially 24-hour pharmacies, and they can come at any time, and it usually takes 15 minutes (to get vaccinated)."

8ba5a8e61097b5a1450201eb1ca03f7957d690e9.sourceText: 38免签国滞美人口逾2% 丧失待遇
8ba5a8e61097b5a1450201eb1ca03f7957d690e9.translatedText: More than 2% of the population of 38 visa-free countries staying in the United States have lost their benefits

49eee6a7a4d894bcda31c451629d374d5cf28465.sourceText: 38免签国滞美人口逾2% 丧失待遇 （华盛顿十五日电）川普政府今天对38个参与「美国免签证计画」（VWP）…
49eee6a7a4d894bcda31c451629d374d5cf28465.translatedText: > More than 2% of the population of 38 visa-free countries staying in the United States have lost their benefits (Washington, 15th) The Trump administration today implemented new regulations for 38 countries participating in the "U.S. Visa Waiver Program" (VWP)...

f94a6f5cc180a723f51c04a7d94f21276b395397.sourceText: （华盛顿十五日电）川普政府今天对38个参与「美国免签证计画」（VWP）的国家实施新规定。官员表示，新规定包括要求相关国家使用美国的反恐资料，审查过境旅客；同时，公民逾期滞留美国比例相对较高的免签国，必须对大众实施宣导，强调逾期滞留的后果。其中一项现行处分是逾期者日后可能无法再以免签赴美。
f94a6f5cc180a723f51c04a7d94f21276b395397.translatedText: (Washington, 15th) The Trump administration today implemented new regulations for 38 countries participating in the "U.S. Visa Waiver Program" (VWP). Officials said the new regulations include requiring relevant countries to use U.S. anti-terrorism information to screen transit passengers; at the same time, visa-free countries with a relatively high proportion of citizens overstaying in the U.S. must educate the public and emphasize the consequences of overstaying. One of the current penalties is that overstayers may no longer be able to travel to the United States without a visa in the future.

c003fa5d8795eafe1af0395d6832aeaa0781ca48.sourceText: 路透报导，美国的免签计画允许大多数欧洲国家旅客，可免签赴美多达90天；38个参与美国免签计画国家地区的公民想免签入境美国，必须先取得所谓旅行授权，台湾也是38个参与美国免签计画的国家地区之一。根据统计，每年免签证来美的游客超过2000万。
c003fa5d8795eafe1af0395d6832aeaa0781ca48.translatedText: Reuters reported that the U.S. Visa Waiver Program allows travelers from most European countries to travel to the United States without a visa for up to 90 days; citizens of 38 countries and regions participating in the U.S. Visa Waiver Program must first obtain a so-called travel authorization if they want to enter the United States without a visa. Taiwan is also one of the 38 countries and regions participating in the U.S. Visa Waiver Program. According to statistics, more than 20 million tourists come to the United States without visas every year.

a478a67b4521d78ad467013d5ff6cf1a9fb21e0b.sourceText: 川普政府对参加与美国互惠免签证计画的38个国家推出新规定，要求这些免签国加强与美国的合作，对恐怖主义进行严格筛检，包括与美国提供的恐怖名单对照，检查在本国和38国之间旅行的人，并要告诫本国公民不要利用免签待遇，长期滞美不归。
a478a67b4521d78ad467013d5ff6cf1a9fb21e0b.translatedText: The Trump administration has introduced new regulations for the 38 countries that participate in the reciprocal visa-free program with the United States, requiring these visa-free countries to strengthen cooperation with the United States and conduct strict screening for terrorism, including comparing it with the terror list provided by the United States, and checking people traveling between their own countries and the 38 countries. It also warns its citizens not to take advantage of the visa-free benefits and stay in the United States for a long time.

730b80b600029cb56d7671dcd372766c5ef6cded.sourceText: 参加互免签证计画的都是美国的盟友，包括澳洲、法国、南韩、英国、台湾等。国土安全部长柯丝汀.尼尔森说，新规定可使互免签证计画得到加强，参加国在筛检恐怖主义上必须符合新的高标准，包括严审各自国家的机场工作人员，和在检查本国公民上与美国配合。
730b80b600029cb56d7671dcd372766c5ef6cded.translatedText: Participants in the mutual visa exemption program are all allies of the United States, including Australia, France, South Korea, the United Kingdom, Taiwan, etc. Homeland Security Secretary Kirsten Nielsen said that the new rules can strengthen the mutual visa exemption program. Participating countries must meet new high standards in screening for terrorism, including strictly scrutinizing their respective countries’ airport personnel and cooperating with the United States in screening their own citizens.

e92ecee36d5e74f4ef725e1b9cbf3d380344bda9.sourceText: 按照新规定，如果免签证国家的逾期滞留不归比率超过2%，就要在国内展开宣传运动，以教育本国公民遵守旅行规定。去年的资料显示，匈牙利、葡萄牙、希腊和圣马力诺四国的逾期滞留不归公民超过2%，其中的袖珍国圣马力诺尽管只有14人滞留不归，但也超过2%，因此需要按照美国的要求进行宣导，否则将丧失免签互惠待遇。
e92ecee36d5e74f4ef725e1b9cbf3d380344bda9.translatedText: According to the new regulations, if the overstay rate in a visa-free country exceeds 2%, a domestic publicity campaign will be launched to educate its citizens to comply with travel regulations. Last year's data showed that Hungary, Portugal, Greece and San Marino had more than 2% of their overstayed citizens. Among them, the pocket country of San Marino had only 14 overstayers, but it still exceeded 2%. Therefore, it needs to be promoted in accordance with the requirements of the United States, otherwise it will lose its visa-free reciprocal benefits.

c4fcbe7941206da3c5c600ad9f058d2165e8c00c.sourceText: 国安部的资料显示，全球各国在美逾期滞留不归的比重平均为2.17%，而互免签证国家只有0.68%，而且大多数最终都会离境。
c4fcbe7941206da3c5c600ad9f058d2165e8c00c.translatedText: According to data from the Ministry of Homeland Security, the average proportion of overstayers in the United States from countries around the world is 2.17%, while only 0.68% of visa-exemption countries, and most of them will eventually leave the country.

2a89dd4704e75d20b119bc2114502f492124c5b8.sourceText: 热点 | 加入2018亚省春晚 为挽救中国文化中心助威
2a89dd4704e75d20b119bc2114502f492124c5b8.translatedText: Hotspots | Join the 2018 Alberta Spring Festival Gala to cheer for saving the Chinese Cultural Center

4b77410d06e4dc887a21688da5b0e13af9bc0fb5.sourceText: 热点 | 加入2018亚省春晚 为挽救中国文化中心助威 2018年马上就要到了，与往年的新年不同的是，一件关系…
4b77410d06e4dc887a21688da5b0e13af9bc0fb5.translatedText: Hotspots | Join the 2018 Alberta Spring Festival Gala to cheer for the saving of the Chinese Cultural Center 2018 is coming soon. What is different from the New Year in previous years is that one thing is related to...

59ba4127023ecf56347d37e477fb303b96225285.sourceText: 2018年马上就要到了，与往年的新年不同的是，一件关系凤凰城华人，或者是凤凰城普通市民的事件，把我们联系在一起，就是挽救中国文化中心。经过四个多月的努力，中国文化中心还安然无恙，在此我们感谢那些为保护中心出钱出力的朋友。今天，要想让中国文化中心留下来，还任重而道远，多个官司，都在紧张的进行的，到现在，双方都有些疲惫，但是，我们有普通民众的支持。2018年亚省春晚和挽救中国文化中心组委会携手，将庆祝新年活动，赋予了更加深刻的意义，请加入我们的春晚，您购买的票，将有部分直接捐助给挽救中国文化中心，请邀请更多的美国朋友，让他们知道”中国文化中心”是凤凰城独特的财富，美国独特的财富。
59ba4127023ecf56347d37e477fb303b96225285.translatedText: 2018 is coming soon. What is different from the New Year in previous years is that one thing that is related to the Chinese people in Phoenix, or the ordinary citizens of Phoenix, connects us, which is to save the Chinese Cultural Center. After more than four months of hard work, the Chinese Cultural Center is still safe and sound. We would like to thank those friends who have contributed money and efforts to protect the center. Today, there is still a long way to go in order for the Chinese Cultural Center to stay. Multiple lawsuits are being fought intensively. Up to now, both parties are a little tired, but we have the support of ordinary people. The 2018 Alberta Spring Festival Gala and the Save China Cultural Center Organizing Committee have joined hands to give the New Year celebrations a more profound meaning. Please join us for the Spring Festival Gala. Part of the tickets you purchase will be directly donated to Save the China Cultural Center. Please invite more American friends and let them know that the "China Cultural Center" is a unique wealth of Phoenix and a unique wealth of the United States.

bfda5c630c2076840b77391d3b6f2790020cefc0.sourceText: 在晚会的现场我们还会准备筹款箱，大家自由捐款。可以现金或支票

a1de3b2472a19da9d15fac1b279adcf7c84b5191.sourceText: 税改后 川普拟推行美30年来最大移民改革
a1de3b2472a19da9d15fac1b279adcf7c84b5191.translatedText: After tax reform, Trump plans to implement the largest immigration reform in the United States in 30 years

589025050a70b414b468d6eb53d1ff8c5682ec82.sourceText: 税改后 川普拟推行美30年来最大移民改革 白宫正在开展一场宣传活动，对美国30年来执行的亲属移民体制进行评估，…
589025050a70b414b468d6eb53d1ff8c5682ec82.translatedText: After tax reform, Trump plans to implement the largest immigration reform in the United States in 30 years. The White House is launching a publicity campaign to evaluate the family-based immigration system implemented in the United States over the past 30 years...

79f240f06035181b07821e19d9128913fc2dbdd2.sourceText: 美国30年来最大的减税（税改）法案即将尘埃落定。与此同时，白宫正在开展一场宣传活动，对美国30年来执行的亲属移民体制进行评估，准备在明年大力推广择优移民制度。
79f240f06035181b07821e19d9128913fc2dbdd2.translatedText: The largest tax cut (tax reform) bill in the United States in 30 years is about to be finalized. At the same time, the White House is launching a publicity campaign to evaluate the family-based immigration system implemented in the United States over the past 30 years and prepare to vigorously promote the merit-based immigration system next year.

dc78b881b388d74f561106fc48a923f8d416ca8c.sourceText: 美联社报导，美国政府正在收集数据，以支持目前的移民体系不仅不符合美国工人的利益，而且可能对美国和美国人造成危险。
dc78b881b388d74f561106fc48a923f8d416ca8c.translatedText: The Associated Press reported that the U.S. government is collecting data to support the idea that the current immigration system is not only inconsistent with the interests of American workers, but may also be dangerous to the United States and Americans.

6dbfc0e2d02f2aab07ccf18fac28dd6da807095b.sourceText: 白宫发言人霍根.吉德利（Hogan Gidley）表示：”我们相信数据驱动政策，这些数据将有助于推动国会对移民综合改革的投票。”
6dbfc0e2d02f2aab07ccf18fac28dd6da807095b.translatedText: White House spokesman Hogan Gidley said: "We believe in data-driven policy, and these data will help drive votes in Congress on comprehensive immigration reform."

5c38a803a8a59021bbc044b266f9905b55e34246.sourceText: 白宫官员上周向美联社介绍了他们的战略，并表示数据表明（移民系统）需要立即改变。但美国目前的政治环境会对移民改革造成困难，在2018年中期选举之前，国会共和党人中，也有人不愿意参与重大移民辩论。
5c38a803a8a59021bbc044b266f9905b55e34246.translatedText: White House officials described their strategy to The Associated Press last week and said the data showed that (the immigration system) needs immediate changes. However, the current political environment in the United States will make immigration reform difficult. Before the 2018 midterm elections, some congressional Republicans are unwilling to participate in major immigration debates.

25817cdf07e01a555129134924e4da2ec96109ee.sourceText: 报导说，川普总统1月30日的国情咨文演讲中，移民改革可能是重点之一。白宫也计划由总统发表其它声明、由内阁官员出面介绍或到保守派媒体推动这一议题。
25817cdf07e01a555129134924e4da2ec96109ee.translatedText: reported that immigration reform may be one of the key points in President Trump’s State of the Union address on January 30. The White House also plans to promote the issue through other statements by the president, introductions by cabinet officials or in conservative media outlets.

226f9bd37afdc1b3019bac513b65d7a5197ec6d2.sourceText: 美国国土安全部门数据显示，2005年至2016年，美国吸纳的1300万移民中，将近930万移民是通过亲属移民来到美国。在过去的10年中，只有十五分之一的移民是因为拥有良好技能，拿到绿卡入境美国。
226f9bd37afdc1b3019bac513b65d7a5197ec6d2.translatedText: Data from the U.S. Department of Homeland Security show that from 2005 to 2016, of the 13 million immigrants the United States absorbed, nearly 9.3 million immigrants came to the United States through relative immigrants. In the past 10 years, only one in fifteen immigrants obtained a green card and entered the United States because of their good skills.

a89f46042148c4b1286df0ea947088b9c882e546.sourceText: 其它计划发布的报告包括：美国监狱移民人数的报告，对移民法庭积压的评估和处理庇护案件的延误报告，以及政府关于移民与恐怖主义之间联系的文件等。
a89f46042148c4b1286df0ea947088b9c882e546.translatedText: Other planned reports include a report on the number of immigrants in U.S. jails, an assessment of immigration court backlogs and delays in processing asylum cases, and a government document on the link between immigration and terrorism.

e0dc03f71fbfd5d0fa4c92fdcd141c7fbecc6294.sourceText: 吉德利说：”了解真实数字的人越多，他们就会越来越明白，这对美国工人是不利的，这对美国的安全是不利的。坦率地说，当这些数字全部出来时，我们相信这将会是国会几乎不可能忽视（问题）。”
e0dc03f71fbfd5d0fa4c92fdcd141c7fbecc6294.translatedText: Gidley said: "The more people who know the real numbers, the more they will understand that this is bad for American workers, this is bad for American security. Frankly, when these numbers come out in full, we believe this is going to be almost impossible for Congress to ignore (the problem)."

c7089108efb2d6bd5604d12f53b8c5ce10e4c2e4.sourceText: 批评者则质疑政府对过去的数据的选择性使用有误导之嫌。
c7089108efb2d6bd5604d12f53b8c5ce10e4c2e4.translatedText: Critics have questioned the government's selective use of past data as misleading.

6c6324d1a278fe2e7768babd12fa13738ed64674.sourceText: 将代表30年来 美国移民体系最根本变化
6c6324d1a278fe2e7768babd12fa13738ed64674.translatedText: will represent the most fundamental change in the U.S. immigration system in the past 30 years

51847ec0fbc7453cb94a8bcaab12f47fffbefd85.sourceText: 美国现政府建议改革以家庭为基础的移民（亲属移民），将代表30年来美国移民体系最根本的变化。这将导致终止”链式移民”，即允许一个移民将一系列家庭成员带到美国的移民政策。美国当局计划以一种有利于教育和就业潜力的积分制度（择优）取而代之，择优移民制度也是英国等其它国家日益接受的措施。
51847ec0fbc7453cb94a8bcaab12f47fffbefd85.translatedText: The current U.S. government’s proposal to reform family-based immigration (relative-based immigration) will represent the most fundamental change in the U.S. immigration system in the past 30 years. This would lead to an end to "chain migration," an immigration policy that allows one immigrant to bring a series of family members to the United States. US authorities plan to replace it with a points-based system (merit-based) that favors education and employment potential, a measure increasingly accepted by other countries such as the UK.

4ff6567ef002f044c638a083f1228e3e4429366b.sourceText: 官员们说，白宫希望国会在2018年初开始处理这个问题，不过还没有就立法战略与国会领导人进行广泛讨论。
4ff6567ef002f044c638a083f1228e3e4429366b.translatedText: Officials say the White House hopes Congress will begin taking up the issue in early 2018, though it has not yet held extensive discussions with congressional leaders on legislative strategy.

4bd5de632626ff5681df1c5a03b1b80fa7467cf5.sourceText: 12月11日，纽约曼哈顿发生一起自制炸弹恐袭事件，涉案嫌犯是通过亲属移民来美的孟加拉国人士。川普及其幕僚再次呼吁收紧美国移民，终止”链式移民”。他在一份声明中表示，美国”松散的移民体系，让许多危险的、没有经过充分审查的人进入我们的国家”。
4bd5de632626ff5681df1c5a03b1b80fa7467cf5.translatedText: On December 11, a homemade bomb terrorist attack occurred in Manhattan, New York. The suspect involved was a Bangladeshi who immigrated to the United States through relatives. Trump and his aides once again called for tightening immigration in the United States and ending "chain migration." He said in a statement that the United States' "lax immigration system allows many dangerous and inadequately vetted people to enter our country."

fb72b817ddf36a0294a06e8d5f4d6175a473b81f.sourceText: 万圣节恐怖袭击事件嫌犯Sayfullo Saipov是通过美国国务院的绿卡抽签移民计划（又称多元移民绿卡抽签，Diversity Immigration Visa Lottery，简称DV）进入美国的。
fb72b817ddf36a0294a06e8d5f4d6175a473b81f.translatedText: Halloween terrorist attack suspect Sayfullo Saipov entered the United States through the U.S. Department of State’s Green Card Lottery Immigration Program (also known as the Diversity Immigration Visa Lottery, referred to as DV).

690ff500c9c0da956acd11b15d2a6725ea8ab2b0.sourceText: 司法部长塞申斯在一份声明中说：”在不到两个月的时间里，在纽约市发生了两起恐怖袭击事件，这些恐怖袭击事件是由于我们失败的移民政策（绿卡抽签移民计划和链式移民）导致，而这些移民政策并不符合国家利益。”
690ff500c9c0da956acd11b15d2a6725ea8ab2b0.translatedText: Attorney General Sessions said in a statement: "In less than two months, two terrorist attacks occurred in New York City. These terrorist attacks were caused by our failed immigration policies (green card lottery program and chain migration) that were not in the national interest."

af7f8fe037d89d96fd090a4b5e5a605f32129fe2.sourceText: 今年8月2日，川普和共和党参议员普度（David Perdue）及科顿（Tom Cotton）共同宣布未来移民改革方向，采”择优”（merit-based system）制，大幅减少亲属移民数量，停止发放绿卡给美国居民配偶及未成年子女以外的亲属；未来10年大砍绿卡发放的数量，由每年的100万个削减到50万个；取消绿卡抽签；难民申请绿卡的年度配额削减为5万等。
af7f8fe037d89d96fd090a4b5e5a605f32129fe2.translatedText: On August 2 this year, Trump and Republican Senators David Perdue and Tom Cotton jointly announced the direction of future immigration reform, adopting a "merit-based system", significantly reducing the number of family-based immigrants, and stopping the issuance of green cards to relatives other than spouses and minor children of U.S. residents; in the next 10 years, the number of green cards issued will be reduced from 1 million to 500,000 per year; the green card lottery will be cancelled; the annual quota for refugee applications for green cards will be reduced to 50,000.

0939ad0ff231116ffeaddd233b9f152becdd6f86.sourceText: 美将表决最终版税改法案 系30年来最大税改行动
0939ad0ff231116ffeaddd233b9f152becdd6f86.translatedText: The United States will vote on the final royalty reform bill, which is the largest tax reform action in 30 years

e819e15ff53890e4c93f6135263cdf139bc37282.sourceText: 美将表决最终版税改法案 系30年来最大税改行动 中新网12月17日电 据外媒报道，近日，美国共和党公布了税…
e819e15ff53890e4c93f6135263cdf139bc37282.translatedText: The United States will vote on the final royalty reform bill, which is the largest tax reform action in 30 years. China News Service, December 17 (Xinhua) According to foreign media reports, recently, the U.S. Republican Party announced a tax...

2537097f88d26a3dc129de4f341f883976760389.sourceText: 中新网12月17日电 据外媒报道，近日，美国共和党公布了税务改革法案的最终敲定版本，企业税和个人所得税的下调幅度比之前版本中的小。
2537097f88d26a3dc129de4f341f883976760389.translatedText: China News Service, December 17 (Xinhua) According to foreign media reports, the U.S. Republican Party recently announced the final version of the tax reform bill, which reduces corporate tax and personal income tax to a smaller extent than in the previous version.

30d48ec9a98687c9fc2971c288845a9314281fed.sourceText: 据报道，该税改法案定下周初交给美国会参众两院表决，如果顺利通过，那将是美国30年来最大的一次税改行动，也是特朗普今年1月上台以来第一个获得通过的法案。
30d48ec9a98687c9fc2971c288845a9314281fed.translatedText: According to reports, the tax reform bill is scheduled to be voted on by the House and Senate early next week. If passed successfully, it will be the largest tax reform action in the United States in 30 years and the first bill passed since Trump took office in January this year.

30f0a9f330a6ddbfd0f4149ce40cf53ac9acf249.sourceText: 根据这份最终版本的税改法案，公司税将从现有的35%下调到21%。美国企业界多年来不断展开游说，希望政府削减税率。
30f0a9f330a6ddbfd0f4149ce40cf53ac9acf249.translatedText: According to this final version of the tax reform bill, the corporate tax will be reduced from the existing 35% to 21%. The U.S. business community has been lobbying for years, hoping that the government will cut tax rates.

a5894f49f8806a243d1b0639619d5c0c4f4dc663.sourceText: 至于个人所得税保留七个等级，但每个等级的最高税率都下调，针对富裕人士的最高等级税率减少2.6个百分点至37%。所有税改措施将从2018年估税年开始实施。
a5894f49f8806a243d1b0639619d5c0c4f4dc663.translatedText: As for the personal income tax, the seven levels will be retained, but the top tax rate for each level will be lowered. The top tax rate for wealthy individuals will be reduced by 2.6 percentage points to 37%. All tax reform measures will be implemented from the year of assessment 2018.

0543ecc43a5a81a514ee54c595db9cc85161cde1.sourceText: 美国参众两院的共和党议员此前对减税法案的最终版本达成一致。总统特朗普在白宫表示，税务局建议，国会如能在圣诞节前表决通过并将法案送交给他签署，新税法就能从明年2月开始实施。
0543ecc43a5a81a514ee54c595db9cc85161cde1.translatedText: Republican members of the U.S. House and Senate previously agreed on the final version of the tax cut bill. President Trump said at the White House that the IRS recommended that if Congress can vote and send the bill to him for signature before Christmas, the new tax law can be implemented starting in February next year.

17f88089e7207a5305c4c8bfcde573a937bb8e70.sourceText: 美国众议院定于下周对税改法案进行表决，由于众议院中共和党众议员较多，要通过应该不成问题。众议院通过之后，法案就交给参议院表决。法案在两院都获得通过，最后再交给特朗普签署成为法令。
17f88089e7207a5305c4c8bfcde573a937bb8e70.translatedText: The U.S. House of Representatives is scheduled to vote on the tax reform bill next week. Since there are many Republican members of the House of Representatives, passing it should not be a problem. After the House passes the bill, it goes to the Senate for a vote. The bill passed both houses of Congress before being handed over to Trump to sign into law.

2f4dbb4e550c1bc1da449d760feb458159957f2a.sourceText: 报道指出，该法案是否能通过对特朗普意义很大，因为他上台至今还没能在国会推过任何法案。原本表明不支持税改计划的两名共和党参议员鲁比奥与考克尔改变主意，同意投支持票，这提高了国会通过此法案的机会。
2f4dbb4e550c1bc1da449d760feb458159957f2a.translatedText: Reports pointed out that whether the bill can be passed is of great significance to Trump, because he has not been able to push any bill through Congress since he took office. Two Republican senators, Rubio and Corker, who had originally stated that they did not support the tax reform plan, changed their minds and agreed to vote in favor, which improved the chances of Congress passing the bill.

e7ce535e0cb160e66758a759194e2672ce3998c4.sourceText: 鲁比奥称，法案修改后增加了对养育孩童的补贴，因此他决定支持税改。考克尔原本担心税改会使财政赤字增加，法案内容修改后，他表示最终版本虽然仍”不尽理想”，但他不想耽误协助美国商界的良机，因此决定改变初衷。
e7ce535e0cb160e66758a759194e2672ce3998c4.translatedText: > Rubio said that the bill was revised to increase subsidies for raising children, so he decided to support tax reform. Corker was originally worried that the tax reform would increase the fiscal deficit. After the bill was revised, he said that although the final version was still "not ideal," he did not want to waste a good opportunity to help the American business community, so he decided to change his original intention.

cc3a7e6b4743e982b2f54bca13e685aff01ca312.sourceText: 不过，共和党在参议院100议席中有52名参议员，只占微差优势，民主党有48名参议员；共和党至今仍有三名参议员未承诺支持，因此这个法案的前景仍存在变数。
cc3a7e6b4743e982b2f54bca13e685aff01ca312.translatedText: However, the Republican Party has 52 senators in the 100-seat Senate, with only a slight advantage, while the Democratic Party has 48 senators. There are still three Republican senators who have not pledged their support, so the prospects of this bill are still uncertain.

1638ff02f700b4aaf88de9ac5131669a9e03a657.sourceText: 此次税改计划若落实，未来将进一步加重美国的债务负担。美国国债已高达20万亿美元(约27万亿新元)，估计税改后10年将增多1.5万亿美元。
1638ff02f700b4aaf88de9ac5131669a9e03a657.translatedText: If this tax reform plan is implemented, it will further increase the debt burden of the United States in the future. The U.S. national debt has reached US$20 trillion (approximately S$27 trillion), and it is estimated that it will increase by US$1.5 trillion in 10 years after tax reform.

17871dcce592ce1452de57308aa23f7ea945e429.sourceText: 另一方面，美国民主党人一直严厉抨击税改法案只让有钱人受惠。曾在去年角逐民主党总统候选人但最后败给前国务卿希拉莉的参议员桑德斯，就指税改法案凸显了美国的”道德败坏与经济龌龊”。
17871dcce592ce1452de57308aa23f7ea945e429.translatedText: On the other hand, American Democrats have been severely criticizing the tax reform bill as only benefiting the rich. Senator Sanders, who ran for the Democratic presidential nomination last year but lost to former Secretary of State Hillary Clinton, said the tax reform bill highlighted the "moral corruption and economic filth" of the United States.

909f1e0d04494ebf08198a74696e7b859d78a550.sourceText: 桑德斯说：”这是一份派给共和党竞选活动有钱捐献者的礼物，对我们国家的工人阶层家庭而言则是个侮辱。”
909f1e0d04494ebf08198a74696e7b859d78a550.translatedText: Sanders said: "This is a gift to wealthy donors to the Republican campaign and an insult to working-class families in our country."

f0543bcfc504d6ddeec40109193b5e43ee2aef82.sourceText: 然而，美国共和党人指出，因为美国经济扩张的速度不够快，有必要削减税率来刺激经济。
f0543bcfc504d6ddeec40109193b5e43ee2aef82.translatedText: However, U.S. Republicans pointed out that because the U.S. economy is not expanding fast enough, tax cuts are necessary to stimulate the economy.

c1ec4ecede0f2b270669501c21cb1b4382563f55.sourceText: 美国众议院共和党领袖麦卡锡说：”美国人民如今已触手可及这个计划，它会带来较高工资、较少税额、较简单的制度，和一个更强大的美国经济。”
c1ec4ecede0f2b270669501c21cb1b4382563f55.translatedText: U.S. House of Representatives Republican Leader McCarthy said: "The American people now have this plan within their reach. It will bring higher wages, lower taxes, simpler systems, and a stronger American economy."

b7c2285d5cddf242cf251d06c76aed6812485d04.sourceText: 财经观察：美国通过30年来最大规模减税法案影响几何？
b7c2285d5cddf242cf251d06c76aed6812485d04.translatedText: Financial Observer: What will be the impact of the largest tax cut bill passed by the United States in 30 years?

c384a09ae11d0d90a3b03ee87636644f0be4a0fb.sourceText: 财经观察：美国通过30年来最大规模减税法案影响几何？ 新华社华盛顿12月20日电财经观察：美国通过30年来…
c384a09ae11d0d90a3b03ee87636644f0be4a0fb.translatedText: Financial Observation: What will be the impact of the largest tax cut bill passed by the United States in 30 years? Xinhua News Agency, Washington, December 20th. Financial Observation: The United States passed the largest tax cut bill in 30 years...

4d273512fef38ab5fb999ce1540ee769a1673901.sourceText: 新华社华盛顿12月20日电财经观察：美国通过30年来最大规模减税法案影响几何？

adb3f72aadf930acc77e6c7e229ff907b7c4ce8e.sourceText: 新华社记者江宇娟 高攀 金旼旼
adb3f72aadf930acc77e6c7e229ff907b7c4ce8e.translatedText: Xinhua News Agency reporter Jiang Yujuan, Gao Pan, Jin Minmin

2a17b810489200c2f031d91bd68af4de38facff8.sourceText: 美国国会参众两院20日通过30年来美国最大规模减税法案。分析人士认为，减税对美国经济增长的刺激作用有限，而且部分涉及跨国企业的条款可能违反双边税收协定和国际贸易准则。
2a17b810489200c2f031d91bd68af4de38facff8.translatedText: The U.S. House of Representatives and the Senate passed the largest tax cut bill in the United States in 30 years on the 20th. Analysts believe that tax cuts have limited stimulating effect on U.S. economic growth, and some provisions involving multinational enterprises may violate bilateral tax agreements and international trade norms.

5a6065e6b92fcfd086b8ba58a88d830c7cf8e4ab.translatedText: Corporate tax reform is the focus

224c4c69a7ea1b8beb92c559fd5d2e17e17b38ec.sourceText: 企业所得税改革是本次减税法案的核心，也得到美国商界的普遍支持。根据税改法案，美国联邦企业所得税税率将从现在的35%降至21%；对美国企业留存海外的利润一次性征税，其中现金利润的税率为15.5%； 推行”属地制”征税原则 ，即未来美国企业的海外利润将只需在利润产生的国家交税，而无需向美国政府交税。为鼓励企业长期投资，企业所得税税改内容是永久的。
224c4c69a7ea1b8beb92c559fd5d2e17e17b38ec.translatedText: Corporate income tax reform is the core of this tax reduction bill, and has received widespread support from the American business community. According to the tax reform bill, the U.S. federal corporate income tax rate will be reduced from the current 35% to 21%; a one-time tax will be imposed on the profits retained by U.S. companies overseas, of which the tax rate on cash profits is 15.5%; the principle of "territorial system" taxation will be implemented, that is, in the future, U.S. companies' overseas profits will only have to pay tax in the country where the profits are generated, without having to pay taxes to the U.S. government. In order to encourage long-term investment by enterprises, the content of the corporate income tax reform is permanent.

6c7a6a86ce54b61407e494e37a9dd02320202164.sourceText: 美国商会总裁托马斯.多诺霍当天发表声明说，美国商界一直呼吁降低企业税率，实施全面直接的资本投资抵扣和属地制征税原则，这些措施将让美国企业更具竞争力。
6c7a6a86ce54b61407e494e37a9dd02320202164.translatedText: U.S. Chamber of Commerce President Thomas Donoghue issued a statement on the same day, saying that the U.S. business community has been calling for lowering the corporate tax rate and implementing comprehensive direct capital investment deductions and territorial taxation principles. These measures will make U.S. companies more competitive.

6f293c5a96c0756341e2bceb77287c05fd18d72a.sourceText: 在个人所得税方面，维持目前联邦个人所得税率7档不变，但大部分税率有所下降，其中最高税率从目前的39.6%降至37%。此外，个人所得税标准抵扣额将翻倍，但对地方和州税等税收抵扣设定上限。个人所得税变动的有效期仅到2025年底。
6f293c5a96c0756341e2bceb77287c05fd18d72a.translatedText: In terms of personal income tax, the current federal personal income tax rate in the seventh bracket remains unchanged, but most tax rates have dropped, with the highest tax rate falling from the current 39.6% to 37%. In addition, the standard deduction for personal income taxes would be doubled, but deductions for taxes such as local and state taxes would be capped. The personal income tax changes are only valid until the end of 2025.

298e0f05e0f8d32514aa1248126dd66d81a254e3.sourceText: 美国参众两院税收联合委员会的初步预测显示，2019年，家庭年收入在2万至10万美元之间的中产阶级，即半数的美国纳税人，将享受610亿美元的减税规模。不过税收优惠到期后，这些家庭缴税规模将增加。
298e0f05e0f8d32514aa1248126dd66d81a254e3.translatedText: Preliminary forecasts from the U.S. House-Senate Joint Committee on Taxation show that in 2019, the middle class with annual household income between $20,000 and $100,000, or half of U.S. taxpayers, will enjoy a tax cut of $61 billion. However, after the tax incentives expire, the tax payments of these families will increase.

55fffc862ffcdb57a7f1b4fed62ac66498dd125d.sourceText: 华盛顿智库税务政策中心的研究显示，本次减税的大部分收益都将由高收入家庭获得，有可能进一步加剧美国贫富分化。
55fffc862ffcdb57a7f1b4fed62ac66498dd125d.translatedText: Research from the Tax Policy Center, a Washington think tank, shows that most of the benefits of this tax cut will be obtained by high-income families, which is likely to further exacerbate the divide between rich and poor in the United States.

fb3358aff6a3df60c147b5398718d631a3299b14.translatedText: The economic stimulus effect may be limited

976c679549e1335ad6ad8663c3ef202bb57483c7.sourceText: 目前，主流经济学界普遍认为减税对经济增长的提升作用较为温和。参众两院税收联合委员会预测，未来十年内，减税法案将平均每年推动经济增速提高不到0.08个百分点。宾夕法尼亚大学沃顿商学院的预测显示，未来十年，减税将提高经济增速0.06至0.12个百分点。
976c679549e1335ad6ad8663c3ef202bb57483c7.translatedText: At present, the mainstream economic circles generally believe that the impact of tax cuts on economic growth is relatively mild. The Joint Committee on Taxation of the House of Representatives and the Senate predicts that over the next ten years, the tax cut bill will increase economic growth by less than 0.08 percentage points per year on average. Forecasts from the Wharton School of the University of Pennsylvania show that tax cuts will increase economic growth by 0.06 to 0.12 percentage points over the next decade.

fbd5126ccc7c4f6d5c5c8f437ac0d03a9579c43c.sourceText: 美联储主席耶伦近期也表示，美联储官员与大多数经济学家对减税政策的分析一致，认为减税可能会小幅提升未来几年美国经济增长。美联储近期公布的经济预测显示，预计今明两年美国经济增速均为2.5%，分别高于9月份预测的2.4%和2.1%。但到2019年和2020年，美国经济增速将分别回落至2.1%和2%。
fbd5126ccc7c4f6d5c5c8f437ac0d03a9579c43c.translatedText: Federal Reserve Chairman Yellen also recently stated that Fed officials are consistent with most economists’ analysis of tax cuts and believe that tax cuts may slightly increase U.S. economic growth in the next few years. The economic forecast recently released by the Federal Reserve shows that the U.S. economic growth rate is expected to be 2.5% this year and next, which is higher than the 2.4% and 2.1% forecast in September respectively. But by 2019 and 2020, the U.S. economic growth will fall back to 2.1% and 2% respectively.

fc3b74f604f2fc13ecbffea8fc2eb78bdd487b2d.sourceText: 分析人士指出，减税法案非但不能实现对美国经济的强刺激，还有可能进一步恶化联邦政府的债务水平。参众两院税收联合委员会的初步预测显示，未来十年，该法案将让美国联邦政府财政赤字增加1.46万亿美元。美国跨党派研究机构取制定负责的联邦预算委员会计，到2027年，美国联邦政府债务占国内生产总值的比重将从2017年的77%上升至98%。
fc3b74f604f2fc13ecbffea8fc2eb78bdd487b2d.translatedText: Analysts pointed out that the tax cut bill will not only fail to achieve a strong stimulus to the U.S. economy, but may further worsen the federal government's debt level. Preliminary projections from the House and Senate Joint Committee on Taxation show that the bill will increase the U.S. federal government's fiscal deficit by $1.46 trillion over the next decade. According to estimates from the U.S. bipartisan research institute and the responsible Federal Budget Committee, the U.S. federal government debt will account for 98% of gross domestic product by 2027, up from 77% in 2017.

683a30d44ca4d5c6f33988f778e9ac7fc6a3382a.sourceText: 美国前财长劳伦斯.萨默斯则指出减税法案进一步推高美国财政赤字，政府在基础设施、人力资源以及科技领域的投资必将受限，无助于提高美国潜在经济增长。
683a30d44ca4d5c6f33988f778e9ac7fc6a3382a.translatedText: Former U.S. Treasury Secretary Lawrence Summers pointed out that the tax cut bill will further push up the U.S. fiscal deficit, and the government’s investment in infrastructure, human resources, and technology will be limited, which will not help increase the potential economic growth of the United States.

362f8ae814025d0dd7ff85a862352c6040ff3af2.sourceText: 全球税基争夺或将开启
362f8ae814025d0dd7ff85a862352c6040ff3af2.translatedText: Global competition for tax base may begin

b0f93180347fdc88e65f78f960b10132120cf4fe.sourceText: 针对跨国企业的税收改革，这份法案除了推行”属地制”征税原则和对美国企业海外利润一次性征税外，还推出了税基侵蚀与反滥用税，即如果跨国企业与海外分支机构或总部的交易降低了这些企业在美国的纳税义务，美国政府将对此类交易征税。这种新税种将限制跨国企业通过此类内部交易来避税，还将阻止他们将产业或知识产权、专利等无形资产转移到其他国家。
b0f93180347fdc88e65f78f960b10132120cf4fe.translatedText: Regarding the tax reform of multinational enterprises, in addition to promoting the "territorial system" taxation principle and a one-time tax on overseas profits of US enterprises, this bill also introduces tax base erosion and anti-abuse taxes. That is, if transactions between multinational enterprises and overseas branches or headquarters reduce the tax liability of these enterprises in the United States, the US government will tax such transactions. This new tax will restrict multinational companies from avoiding taxes through such internal transactions, and will also prevent them from transferring industries or intangible assets such as intellectual property and patents to other countries.

51eb11123bdd7893edaaeaa0e1b937f982a0d036.sourceText: 这一条款已经招致美国贸易伙伴的反对。日前，法国、德国、意大利、西班牙和英国等欧洲五国财长联合致信美国财政部长姆努钦，称美国减税法案的部分内容可能违反目前双边税收协定和世界贸易规则。
51eb11123bdd7893edaaeaa0e1b937f982a0d036.translatedText: This provision has already drawn opposition from U.S. trading partners. A few days ago, the finance ministers of five European countries, including France, Germany, Italy, Spain and the United Kingdom, jointly sent a letter to U.S. Treasury Secretary Mnuchin, saying that part of the U.S. tax cut bill may violate current bilateral tax agreements and world trade rules.

1513e6c01bd0029b7266d06eae40c4736d0d6330.sourceText: 华盛顿智库彼得森国际经济研究所高级研究员加里.克莱德.赫夫鲍尔说，税基侵蚀税将破坏当前的全球产业链，有可能引发美国贸易和投资伙伴的抗议和报复，甚至可能引发在世贸组织的诉讼。
1513e6c01bd0029b7266d06eae40c4736d0d6330.translatedText: Gary Clyde Hufbauer, a senior fellow at the Peterson Institute for International Economics, a Washington think tank, said that base erosion taxes will disrupt the current global industrial chain and may trigger protests and retaliation from U.S. trade and investment partners, and may even trigger litigation at the WTO.

267921f7b03d80d1bee82e9c1a9b5cb5955bce85.sourceText: 在全球化的背景下，国际税收的协调变得日益严峻。萨默斯表示，美国不应加入全球竞争性减税，而应成为全球税务协调的关键力量。
267921f7b03d80d1bee82e9c1a9b5cb5955bce85.translatedText: In the context of globalization, international tax coordination has become increasingly severe. Summers said the United States should not join in global competitive tax cuts, but should become a key force in global tax coordination.

6f12454857408f2c33a301d61787940858df9a43.sourceText: 还是以前好！调查显示美国人自认过得不如50年前
6f12454857408f2c33a301d61787940858df9a43.translatedText: It’s still as good as before! Surveys show that Americans think their lives are not as good as they were 50 years ago

a3d5ab6a8d8b98bf61d5a26d639413847047cac1.sourceText: 还是以前好！调查显示美国人自认过得不如50年前 昨天会更好？美国人自认过得不如50年前 美国皮尤研究中…
a3d5ab6a8d8b98bf61d5a26d639413847047cac1.translatedText: ! Survey shows Americans think they are worse off than they were 50 years ago. Will yesterday be better? Americans think they are worse off than they were 50 years ago. According to Pew Research in the United States...

c2374182997820796bb23e887663f2e2a5cfcf9b.sourceText: 昨天会更好？美国人自认过得不如50年前
c2374182997820796bb23e887663f2e2a5cfcf9b.translatedText: Would yesterday have been better? Americans feel their lives are not as good as they were 50 years ago

4fd39193204b853a2ac34a33db6ecdabdb9427b9.sourceText: 美国皮尤研究中心最新调查结果显示，美国人感到自己的生活不如50年前。
4fd39193204b853a2ac34a33db6ecdabdb9427b9.translatedText: The latest survey results from the Pew Research Center in the United States show that Americans feel their lives are not as good as they were 50 years ago.

eb009b20b6b932c404d05af8232d336fb8df7fed.sourceText: 美国市场观察网站17日报道，皮尤研究中心今年春季对全球30多个国家将近4.3万人展开上述调查。其中，越南、印度、韩国、德国、土耳其、荷兰、瑞典、波兰、西班牙等国家的大部分国民都认为自己的生活比50年前好。
eb009b20b6b932c404d05af8232d336fb8df7fed.translatedText: The American Market Watch website reported on the 17th that the Pew Research Center conducted the above-mentioned survey on nearly 43,000 people in more than 30 countries around the world this spring. Among them, most citizens in Vietnam, India, South Korea, Germany, Turkey, the Netherlands, Sweden, Poland, Spain and other countries believe that their lives are better than they were 50 years ago.

e14a2cd5e7840228d0b5ea279253246de79e8fc4.sourceText: 然而，美国人并不这么认为。

4288dd4cd0260fe04f6c501a2d82039f2d4adeac.sourceText: 与美国人有同感的包括塞内加尔、尼日利亚、肯尼亚、加纳、巴西、法国、匈牙利、黎巴嫩和秘鲁等国的受调查者。
4288dd4cd0260fe04f6c501a2d82039f2d4adeac.translatedText: Those surveyed who shared the same sentiments as Americans included those in Senegal, Nigeria, Kenya, Ghana, Brazil, France, Hungary, Lebanon and Peru.

8775b5568267d8d0da1439a919bc43d5f96d2ee9.sourceText: 皮尤研究中心分析，在欧洲，对比那些不支持右翼政党政见的民众，民粹主义者可能更加醉心于过去。
8775b5568267d8d0da1439a919bc43d5f96d2ee9.translatedText: Pew Research Center analyzes that in Europe, populists may be more obsessed with the past than those who do not support the political views of right-wing parties.

92a90926afda98bc9f2842209c2a2ad9cbd7ea92.sourceText: 皮尤研究中心认为，在美国，富有阶层似乎把中产甩到后面。
92a90926afda98bc9f2842209c2a2ad9cbd7ea92.translatedText: The Pew Research Center believes that in the United States, the wealthy seem to be leaving the middle class behind.

74ff92d652a4eacbeceba893b4fe9d8a83c69fe6.sourceText: 美国城市研究所去年6月发布的报告说，2014年美国中产收入占比26%。经通胀因素调整后，这一比例在1979年为46%。
74ff92d652a4eacbeceba893b4fe9d8a83c69fe6.translatedText: A report released by the American Urban Institute in June last year stated that the middle-class income in the United States accounted for 26% in 2014. Adjusted for inflation, this ratio was 46% in 1979.

4de84d66dff2ad5cd968f371a67672c36227f092.sourceText: 美国联邦储备委员会今年9月发布的调查结果显示，虽然美国经济复苏开始惠及偏低收入阶层，但贫富差距继续扩大。
4de84d66dff2ad5cd968f371a67672c36227f092.translatedText: Survey results released by the U.S. Federal Reserve Board in September this year showed that although the U.S. economic recovery has begun to benefit the lower-income groups, the gap between the rich and the poor continues to widen.

4499da1f3fb907ff8a8cd70807c73587f8e8e617.sourceText: 报告发现，最富阶层家庭持有的收入和财富比例达1989年以来最高水平。2016年，最富1%家庭收入占比增加至23.8%，这一数字在2013年为20.3%。收入底端90%家庭的收入占比下降至49.7%，为这项调查有史以来最低水平。
4499da1f3fb907ff8a8cd70807c73587f8e8e617.translatedText: The report found that the proportion of income and wealth held by the richest households reached the highest level since 1989. In 2016, the income share of the richest 1% of households increased to 23.8%, compared with 20.3% in 2013. The income share of households in the bottom 90% dropped to 49.7%, the lowest level ever recorded in this survey.

98f1f24db3923b083621c180ae0ffc0bea2b45e6.sourceText: 美国总统唐纳德.特朗普正大力推进税改。经济学家和分析人士普遍认为，这次税改可能进一步扩大贫富差距，恶化美国政府财政状况。
98f1f24db3923b083621c180ae0ffc0bea2b45e6.translatedText: US President Donald Trump is vigorously promoting tax reform. Economists and analysts generally believe that this tax reform may further widen the gap between rich and poor and worsen the financial situation of the US government.

aabbf80b99571ccd51216cf069dd29b487ccf392.sourceText: 热点 | 2018第九届””亚省春晚””亮点早知道 通过奇妙、…
aabbf80b99571ccd51216cf069dd29b487ccf392.translatedText: Hot spots | The highlights of the 9th "Alberta Spring Festival Gala" in 2018 should be known in advance Through wonderful and...

03ef1282cea279a44fc66e0fd2ea110518c01f2c.sourceText: 通过奇妙、高难的表演，将 力量 与美感、意境与情怀完美结合， 2 018 第九届亚省春晚，突破传统春晚的歌舞主题， 将杂技与舞蹈结合，带给您一个全新的试听感受。 多个世界级获奖杂技表演团队都带来了他们的绝活。集现代声光电科技为一体的激光舞，将会是杂技节目中的又一亮点。
03ef1282cea279a44fc66e0fd2ea110518c01f2c.translatedText: Through wonderful and difficult performances, the power and beauty, artistic conception and feelings are perfectly combined. In 2018, the 9th Alberta Spring Festival Gala broke through the traditional singing and dancing theme of the Spring Festival Gala. Data shows arrest rates are at their lowest level in 45 years.

3fa0f0ecf64d51e176f8fcc751cfd9c3144618c0.sourceText: 美国移民海关执法局(ICE)副局长托马斯.霍曼(Thomas Homan)5日对媒体表示，美国总统特朗普在行政命令中明确指出任何人不可以非法进入美国。”如果有人非法入境，执法人员将对其进行抓捕”，他说。
3fa0f0ecf64d51e176f8fcc751cfd9c3144618c0.translatedText: U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) Deputy Director Thomas Homan told the media on the 5th that U.S. President Trump clearly stated in the executive order that no one can enter the United States illegally. "If someone enters the country illegally, law enforcement officers will arrest them," he said.

bf1e965b7555dcee43d95599d34db36279cde585.sourceText: 报道指出，美国移民海关执法局通常先拘留非法入境人员，随后将其驱逐出境。这种操作被称作”内部清除”(”interior removals”)。媒体指出，边境逮捕率下降意味着更多人被驱逐出境。2017财年，被”内部清除”的人员达81603人。与2016年同期相比，该人数增长了37%。
bf1e965b7555dcee43d95599d34db36279cde585.translatedText: Reports pointed out that U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement usually detains illegal immigrants and then deports them. This operation is called "interior removals". The media pointed out that the decline in border apprehensions means more people are being deported. In fiscal year 2017, 81,603 people were “internally purged”. Compared with the same period in 2016, this number increased by 37%.

318a738d108796f29b78f92d2c9a3be88fb17494.sourceText: 美国国家公共电台指出，美国边境逮捕率急剧下降的原因尚不清楚。特朗普政府尚未获得修建美墨边境墙的资金。同时，边境警员人数在不断下降。目前少于19500人。
318a738d108796f29b78f92d2c9a3be88fb17494.translatedText: >National Public Radio pointed out that the reason for the sharp decline in U.S. border arrest rates is unclear. The Trump administration has yet to secure funding for a U.S.-Mexico border wall. At the same time, the number of border police officers is declining. There are currently less than 19,500 people.

5f890c68ddefcf8e88e064c15e0f4d07e6f33df2.sourceText: 不过，美国总统特朗普执政后，2017年2月，其主要幕僚、前美国国土安全部部长约翰?#20975;利取消了奥巴马政府执政期间关于限制驱逐非法人员的政策。该媒体认为，特朗普在移民政策上的强硬态度可能阻止了一些人试图非法进入美国。
5f890c68ddefcf8e88e064c15e0f4d07e6f33df2.translatedText: However, after U.S. President Trump took office, in February 2017, his main aide and former U.S. Secretary of Homeland Security John Leigh canceled the policy of restricting the deportation of illegal persons during the Obama administration. The media believes that Trump’s tough stance on immigration policy may have deterred some people from trying to enter the United States illegally.

11d4f8d8d1e79d3117ef93d60db55024398ab55d.sourceText: 美国海关边境保护局副局长罗纳德.维泰罗(Ronald Vitiello)指出，自2017年5月以来，美国边境警察逮捕的非法移民呈现新特征：一是以家庭和无人陪伴的儿童为主；二是约六成被捕人员并非来自墨西哥，而是来自美洲中部地区；三是更多人员选择通过得克萨斯州南部入境，而放弃过去惯用的”走廊”亚利桑那州边境。
11d4f8d8d1e79d3117ef93d60db55024398ab55d.translatedText: U.S. Customs and Border Protection Deputy Director Ronald Vitiello pointed out that since May 2017, the illegal immigrants arrested by the U.S. Border Police have shown new characteristics: first, they are mainly families and unaccompanied children; second, about 60% of the arrested people are not from Mexico, but from Central America; third, more people choose to enter through southern Texas, abandoning the usual "corridor" of the Arizona border.

ec98fd82a934514409981100d80d0111b1efce79.sourceText: 关于外界对该机构过度使用武力逮捕非法人员的指责，罗纳德表示，该机构人员增加使用”不太致命”的设备进行执法。如2017财年使用胡椒喷雾979次，比2016年有所增加。(完)
ec98fd82a934514409981100d80d0111b1efce79.translatedText: Regarding external accusations that the agency uses excessive force to arrest illegal personnel, Ronald said that agency personnel have increased the use of "less lethal" equipment for law enforcement. For example, pepper spray was used 979 times in fiscal year 2017, an increase from 2016. (over)

0ea5e8ca40bd825246d9d650547ae07ad37a7d49.translatedText: Ministry of Finance: Tax reform will bring about US$1.8 trillion in additional revenue in the next 10 years [Overseas Chinese News reporter Xu Yifan reported from Washington on December 11] December 11...

0b4c15d9e05476cdd53b023e2f45983e573955ae.sourceText: 【侨报记者徐一凡12月11日华盛顿报道】12月11日，美国财政部发布对参议院税改方案的分析报告。报告称，税改在未来10年将给美国带来1.8万亿美元的额外财政收入。美国GDP增长可能达到2.9%，税改方案不仅能弥补减税所造成的财政收入损失还能带来额外收益。财政部长努钦（Steven Mnuchin）强调，税改将给美国政府带来可观的长期收入。
0b4c15d9e05476cdd53b023e2f45983e573955ae.translatedText: [Overseas Chinese News reporter Xu Yifan reported from Washington on December 11] On December 11, the U.S. Treasury Department released an analysis report on the Senate tax reform plan. The report states that tax reform will bring US$1.8 trillion in additional fiscal revenue to the United States over the next 10 years. U.S. GDP growth may reach 2.9%. The tax reform plan can not only make up for the loss of fiscal revenue caused by tax cuts but also bring additional benefits. Treasury Secretary Steven Mnuchin emphasized that tax reform will bring considerable long-term revenue to the U.S. government.

f2034f6c7424aaeddae7e14cfaa900b2fe813ebc.sourceText: 财政部今天发布的报告是对税收政策办公室（OTP）关于结合政府经济增长举措的税收预期的总结分析。根据预期增长，参议院的税改方案将在10年内带来1.8万亿美元额外财政收入。努钦表示，这一分析显示了政府经济议程对收入的影响；政府致力于以税收改革和更广泛的经济政策刺激增长，这会给政府带来可观的长期收入。
f2034f6c7424aaeddae7e14cfaa900b2fe813ebc.translatedText: The report released by the Treasury Department today is a summary analysis of the Office of Tax Policy (OTP) tax revenue expectations combined with the government's economic growth initiatives. Based on expected growth, the Senate tax reform package will bring in $1.8 trillion in additional fiscal revenue over 10 years. Mnuchin said this analysis shows the impact of the government's economic agenda on revenue; the government is committed to stimulating growth with tax reform and broader economic policies, which will bring significant long-term revenue to the government.

99d45ff38913d9652c783c0358832096a995b598.sourceText: 财政部的税收政策办公室对参议院的税改方案进行了建模，并进行与国会联合税务委员会（JCT）类似的静态分析；根据现行法律税改会减少1.5万亿美元收入，根据现行政策税改会减少1万亿美元收入。这两个数字之所以会有区别是因为现行法律中有一些即将过期的内容，但根据现行政策很可能会让这些法律更新从而持续有效。
99d45ff38913d9652c783c0358832096a995b598.translatedText: The Treasury Department’s Tax Policy Office modeled the Senate’s tax reform package and conducted a static analysis similar to that of the Congressional Joint Committee on Taxation (JCT); tax reform would reduce revenue by $1.5 trillion under current law and $1 trillion under current policy. The difference between these two numbers is because there are elements of the current law that are about to expire, but current policy is likely to bring these laws up to date so they remain in effect.

35f5c411af16d6ea34381360aebe9f81f747f875.sourceText: OTP模拟了更高增长对收入的影响。根据2018财年预算案的估计，10年间政府财政收入平均年增长率为2.9%；OTP将这个数字与之前预估的2.2%增长率基线做比较。财政部认为，这0.7%的增速提高，一半将来自于公司税的变化；另一半预期来自于转缴税制（pass-through taxation）和个人税的改变，以及2018年预算案中提到的管理改革、基础设施发展、福利改革等。
35f5c411af16d6ea34381360aebe9f81f747f875.translatedText: >OTP simulates the impact of higher growth on revenue. According to estimates in the fiscal year 2018 budget, the average annual growth rate of government revenue over the 10 years is 2.9%; OTP compares this figure with the previously estimated baseline growth rate of 2.2%. The Ministry of Finance believes that half of this 0.7% increase in growth will come from changes in corporate tax; the other half is expected to come from changes in pass-through taxation and personal tax, as well as management reforms, infrastructure development, welfare reforms, etc. mentioned in the 2018 Budget.

46b82f704fc825761f7d80035c6d0d3fcb531631.sourceText: 财政部表示，这0.7%的额外增长率将在10年间带来1.8万亿美元的额外财政收入，减去根据现行法律税改带来的1.5万亿美元收入减少，还将有3000万美元的收入增加。这里的收入增加将主要来自于后面5年；因为多出的支出在前几年创造增长，造成税收延迟。
46b82f704fc825761f7d80035c6d0d3fcb531631.translatedText: The Treasury Department stated that this 0.7% additional growth rate will bring in additional fiscal revenue of $1.8 trillion over 10 years. Subtracting the $1.5 trillion revenue reduction caused by tax reform under current laws, there will be an increase of $30 million in revenue. The increase in revenue here will come mainly from the next five years; because the extra spending creates growth in the first few years, taxes are delayed.

f9ebc5c1e9be9e881d198b0be003bc80fd9103ff.sourceText: 财政部承认，不同经济学家给出的增长预测数字并不相同。根据OTP预测，如果每年额外的GDP增长达到0.35%，那么额外财政税收将是大约1万亿美元。同时，JCT和OTP认为，众议院税改计划所带来的收益与参议院不会有太大区别。
f9ebc5c1e9be9e881d198b0be003bc80fd9103ff.translatedText: The Ministry of Finance admitted that the growth forecasts given by different economists are different. According to OTP forecasts, if additional GDP growth reaches 0.35% per year, additional fiscal revenue will be approximately US$1 trillion. At the same time, JCT and OTP believe that the benefits brought by the House tax reform plan will not be much different from those in the Senate.

67983e44d99e0af70db721219553ca4906a1545e.sourceText: 美国已通知联合国，美国将不再参与《全球移民协议》(Global Compact on Migration)。
67983e44d99e0af70db721219553ca4906a1545e.translatedText: The United States has informed the United Nations that it will no longer participate in the Global Compact on Migration.

7d0e3cc454ca4937dd32f0a392450f8adfac872f.sourceText: 2016年，联合国193个成员国一致通过一项不具约束力的政治宣言，即纽约难民和移民宣言。该宣言承诺支持难民权益，帮助他们重新定居，并确保他们有接受教育和工作的机会。
7d0e3cc454ca4937dd32f0a392450f8adfac872f.translatedText: In 2016, 193 member states of the United Nations unanimously adopted a non-binding political declaration, the New York Declaration on Refugees and Migrants. The declaration pledges to support refugee rights, help them resettle and ensure they have access to education and work opportunities.

12c9aa52700e9e08062bd4282cd7c405fe2be871.sourceText: 美国驻联合国代表团星期六在一份申明中说，宣言中”多项条款与美国的移民和难民政策以及川普政府的移民政策原则不一致。”
12c9aa52700e9e08062bd4282cd7c405fe2be871.translatedText: The U.S. Mission to the United Nations said in a statement on Saturday that "many provisions in the declaration are inconsistent with U.S. immigration and refugee policies and the immigration policy principles of the Trump administration."

bba9bf6c6e8ae1055d8e3aae75aecad49aea407e.sourceText: 在美国宣布退出《全球移民协议》之际，全球移民会议将于星期一在墨西哥的巴亚尔塔港市开幕。此次会议的目的是协商制定人道策略，去帮助全世界6000多万因各种原因而被迫流离失所的人。
bba9bf6c6e8ae1055d8e3aae75aecad49aea407e.translatedText: As the United States announced its withdrawal from the Global Migration Agreement, the Global Migration Conference will open in Puerto Vallarta, Mexico, on Monday. The purpose of this meeting is to negotiate and formulate humanitarian strategies to help the more than 60 million people around the world who are forcibly displaced for various reasons.

3bcbf8c488019fff9432d0323c938d1bcf533954.sourceText: 美国《外交政策》杂志的文章说，川普总统决定美国不参与有关难民问题的讨论凸显32岁的白宫高级政策顾问斯蒂芬.米勒(Stephen Miller)在有关问题上的持久影响力。米勒推动川普政府大规模限制移民的政策。
3bcbf8c488019fff9432d0323c938d1bcf533954.translatedText: An article in the US "Foreign Policy" magazine said that President Trump's decision not to participate in discussions on refugee issues highlights the lasting influence of 32-year-old White House senior policy adviser Stephen Miller on relevant issues. Miller pushed for the Trump administration's policies to massively restrict immigration.

923ffad151d7807ee696585351244efc52ddca3c.sourceText: 《外交政策》的文章说，白宫办公厅主任凯利和美国司法部长塞申斯都强烈支持美国退出《全球移民协议》。文章说，美国常驻联合国大使妮基.黑利反对美国退出。她认为，如果参加在墨西哥举行的大会，美国将能够发挥对全球移民政策的影响力。但她最终没有说服总统。
923ffad151d7807ee696585351244efc52ddca3c.translatedText: The "Foreign Policy" article stated that White House Chief of Staff Kelly and U.S. Attorney General Sessions both strongly support the United States' withdrawal from the Global Migration Agreement. The article said that Nikki Haley, the U.S. ambassador to the United Nations, opposed the U.S. withdrawal. She believes that by participating in the convention in Mexico, the United States will be able to exert influence on global immigration policy. But she ultimately failed to convince the president.

926bafde2c3f7099c1fd5a0302c0d0cae3a8cecc.sourceText: 黑利星期六发表声明说，”美国对我们的移民传统以及我们在支持全球移民和难民的长期精神领导力感到自豪厖但是我们在移民政策上的决定必须始终由并且仅由美国人决定。”
926bafde2c3f7099c1fd5a0302c0d0cae3a8cecc.translatedText: Haley issued a statement on Saturday, saying, "The United States is proud of our immigrant heritage and our long-standing spiritual leadership in supporting immigrants and refugees around the world, but our decisions on immigration policy must always be determined by and only Americans."

0dd7c42d180325e758f3c618880085ae5dd08ffa.sourceText: 她说：”我们将决定如何以最好的方式控制我们的国界，决定谁能够进入我们的国家。纽约宣言的全球方案与美国的主权不符。”
0dd7c42d180325e758f3c618880085ae5dd08ffa.translatedText: She said: "We will determine how best to control our borders and determine who can enter our country. The global approach of the New York Declaration is inconsistent with American sovereignty."

8534e72ec302503f2be2aad03f7cc3fa8029896e.sourceText: 通过奇妙、高难的表演，将 力量 与美感、意境与情怀完美结合， 2 018 第九届亚省春晚，突破传统春晚的歌舞主题， 将杂技与舞蹈结合，带给您一个全新的试听感受。 多个世界级获奖杂技表演团队都带来了他们的绝活。著名杂技《 云中漫步》《力量》， 您将亲眼看到帅气的小伙子们挑战人类的极限。美丽的柔术技巧表演者又将传统的顶碗，与身体的柔韧技巧，以及舞蹈结合在一起。 主办方亚省艺术学院和中美文化教育基金会花巨资带来的灯光效果， 更将本次晚会的规格推到了历史的新高度。

Multiple world-class award-winning acrobatic performance teams bring their unique skills. With the famous acrobatics "Walking in the Clouds" and "Power", you will see with your own eyes handsome young men challenging the limits of human beings. The performers of beautiful contortion techniques combine traditional head bowling with body flexibility techniques and dance. The organizers, the Art Institute of Alberta and the China-US Cultural Education Foundation, spent huge sums of money to bring about the lighting effects, which pushed the standards of this party to a new height in history.

85807639698a69f3a674cbf124752cc434dd27e2.sourceText: Rudy Yee是凤凰城华人社区的支柱，也是一位深受爱戴的丈夫、父亲和祖父，于2024年2月25日晚在家中睡梦中安详去世，享年83岁。Rudy Yee出生于1940年4月19日，是移民之子，与兄弟们一起在位于凤凰城市中心的家庭商店Sam Kim Market长大。1955年，Yee家族搬迁并在第11大道和Glendale路开设了Glenex市场。
85807639698a69f3a674cbf124752cc434dd27e2.translatedText: Rudy Yee, a pillar of Phoenix's Chinese community and a beloved husband, father and grandfather, passed away peacefully in his sleep at home on the evening of February 25, 2024. He was 83 years old. Rudy Yee was born on April 19, 1940, the son of immigrants, and grew up with his brothers at the family store Sam Kim Market in downtown Phoenix. In 1955, the Yee family moved and opened Glenex Market at 11th Avenue and Glendale Road.

c32a4ce067a208831de6ddf9b913326c74fdf5c9.sourceText: Rudy应征加入美国陆军，并于1962年至1964年在冲绳自豪地担任防空技术员。1966年，他娶了他一生的挚爱玛丽·安，与她共度了充满爱和奉献的一生。经历了人生的高潮和低谷，Rudy继承了家族的遗产，创造了更好的生活，先是当了工程师，然后当了【湖南餐馆】老板。他是一位慈爱的丈夫，是三个儿子（凯文、杰森和斯蒂芬）的父亲，也是11个孙子孙女的祖父。Rudy把家庭看得比一切都重要。
c32a4ce067a208831de6ddf9b913326c74fdf5c9.translatedText: Rudy enlisted in the U.S. Army and proudly served as an anti-aircraft technician in Okinawa from 1962 to 1964. In 1966, he married the love of his life, Mary Ann, with whom he lived a life of love and devotion. After experiencing the highs and lows of life, Rudy inherited his family's legacy and created a better life, first as an engineer and then as a [Hunan restaurant] owner. He is a loving husband, father of three sons (Kevin, Jason and Stephen) and grandfather of 11 grandchildren. Rudy values ​​family above all else.

a97c3b3f04c40596cb3affeab2f3fced69ccae7e.sourceText: Rudy也是凤凰城华人社区不可或缺的一员，1974年与州参议员Wing F. Ong在凤凰城共同创立了华裔公民联盟。Rudy的社区服务还包括凤凰TOY家庭协会、凤凰华人年度七月四日庆祝活动、大凤凰华人联合会、美国退伍军人协会Thomas Tang Post 50和中国老年人中心。Rudy是凤凰城第一浸信会的终身成员，他还支持西北浸信会，他的儿子斯蒂芬在那里担任牧师。
a97c3b3f04c40596cb3affeab2f3fced69ccae7e.translatedText: Rudy is also an integral member of the Chinese community in Phoenix. In 1974, he co-founded the Chinese Citizens League in Phoenix with State Senator Wing F. Ong. Rudy's community service also includes the Phoenix TOY Family Association, Phoenix Chinese Annual Fourth of July Celebration, Chinese Federation of Greater Phoenix, American Legion Thomas Tang Post 50 and the Chinese Senior Center. Rudy was a lifelong member of First Baptist Church in Phoenix, and he also supported Northwest Baptist Church, where his son Stephen served as pastor.

b1b758e0a867bace499d9a888c7540fe58ac6f84.sourceText: Rudy的遗产是无私和对他人坚定不移的奉献。他从帮助他人和让每个人都有宾至如归的感觉中找到了快乐。他的一生证明了他的服务，无论是对他的国家、社区、朋友，还是最重要的家人。 Rudy的葬礼将于2024年3月30日星期六在凤凰城的绿木墓园举行。告别仪式将于上午9点在宁静教堂开始，随后于上午11点举行追悼会，朋友、家人和社区成员将聚集在一起，纪念余长存先生的非凡遗产，并分享珍贵的回忆。
b1b758e0a867bace499d9a888c7540fe58ac6f84.translatedText: Rudy's legacy is one of selflessness and unwavering devotion to others. He found joy in helping others and making everyone feel welcome. His life was a testament to his service, whether to his country, his community, his friends, and most importantly, his family. Rudy's funeral will be held on Saturday, March 30, 2024, at Greenwood Cemetery in Phoenix. A farewell service will begin at 9 a.m. at Serenity Church, followed by a memorial service at 11 a.m., where friends, family and community members will gather to commemorate Mr. Yu Changcun’s extraordinary legacy and share cherished memories.

On January 31st, the 2026 Alberta Spring Festival Gala will make its grand debut at the Chandler Center for the Arts, gathering with friends from all walks of life in the greater Phoenix area to celebrate the New Year and welcome the Year of the Horse.

79c9146caf47cfca5057c4b154151835954dadda.sourceText: 本届春晚将以一台兼具传统底蕴与现代气息的视听盛宴，为您开启全新一年的好运之旅。曾上过中央电视台春晚的，中国大师级神秘嘉宾将现场为大家带来惊艳表演，在拉斯维加斯魔术大赛中获大奖的Mr.Lim都是你值得期待的新春大礼！舞台上有翩若惊鸿的中国古典舞、热情奔放的民族舞，余音绕梁的中华国粹京剧，还有器乐合奏、合唱等精彩节目，更有底蕴深厚的中国传统节目首次登上凤城舞台……灯光璀璨，鼓乐铿锵，精彩纷呈、高潮迭起，是您与家人朋友 乘风启程、共迎马年 的不二之选。
79c9146caf47cfca5057c4b154151835954dadda.translatedText: This Spring Festival Gala will provide you with an audio-visual feast that combines traditional heritage and modern flavor to start a new year of good luck for you. The Chinese master-class mysterious guest who has appeared on the CCTV Spring Festival Gala will give you a stunning performance on the spot. Mr. Lim, who won the grand prize in the Las Vegas Magic Competition, is a New Year gift you can look forward to! On the stage, there are stunning Chinese classical dances, passionate folk dances, the lingering sounds of Chinese quintessence Peking Opera, as well as instrumental ensembles, choruses and other wonderful programs, and more traditional Chinese programs with profound heritage are on the Fengcheng stage for the first time... The lights are bright, the drums are sonorous, the excitement is exciting, and the climax is endless. It is the best choice for you and your family and friends to set off in the wind and welcome the Year of the Horse together.

ff518dbe6f696903bc5b0116b91f3ab1fd2358d4.sourceText: 【亚利桑那州斯科茨代尔讯】3月6日晚，由国际交流组织 Global Ties Arizona 举办的第三届农历新年庆典在 Western Spirit: Scottsdale’s Museum of the West 隆重举行。来自不同国家和文化背景的嘉宾齐聚一堂，共同庆祝这一具有东方传统特色的节日。
ff518dbe6f696903bc5b0116b91f3ab1fd2358d4.translatedText: [Scottsdale, Arizona] On the evening of March 6, the third Lunar New Year celebration organized by the international exchange organization Global Ties Arizona was held at Western Spirit: Scottsdale’s Museum of the West Held solemnly. Guests from different countries and cultural backgrounds gathered together to celebrate this festival with oriental traditional characteristics.

e2f5e46c4a54c2321bb4db247d8234951aac0ff8.sourceText: 活动现场洋溢着浓厚的中国农历新年氛围。晚会以中国舞蹈《好日子》热闹开场，随后精彩节目轮番上演。舞狮表演气势热烈，赢得观众阵阵掌声；华人画家 范融先生 现场挥毫作画，以马为主题展示中国水墨艺术；具有两千多年历史的中国传统乐器 古筝独奏 悠扬动听。此外，越南舞蹈与歌曲表演也为晚会增添了多元文化色彩。华裔侨领 Barry 担任整场活动主持人，使晚会气氛热烈而融洽。
e2f5e46c4a54c2321bb4db247d8234951aac0ff8.translatedText: The event site was filled with a strong Chinese New Year atmosphere. The party started lively with the Chinese dance "Good Day", followed by exciting performances in turn. The lion dance performance was enthusiastic and won rounds of applause from the audience; the Chinese painter Mr. Fan Rong painted on the spot, using horses as the theme to show Chinese ink art; the guzheng, a traditional Chinese musical instrument with a history of more than 2,000 years, played a melodious solo. In addition, Vietnamese dance and song performances also added a multicultural touch to the party. Barry, a Chinese-American leader, served as the host of the entire event, making the party atmosphere warm and harmonious.

aeb5a3d7dafea67df306678c6e31ab41317d3c3b.translatedText: Chinese overseas Chinese leader Barry Wong

8ee1e0e22d62195a85a760b11b296ae5e050c2bf.sourceText: 华人画家 范融先生 现场挥毫作画
8ee1e0e22d62195a85a760b11b296ae5e050c2bf.translatedText: Chinese painter Mr. Fan Rong painted on the spot

fe27e0c683d6d797d45d3496476937a1172cdfe5.sourceText: 在节目之外，来宾还可以体验中国书法，将自己的名字写成中文作为纪念。主办方还准备了家庭式晚宴和甜点，让嘉宾在轻松愉快的氛围中交流互动。
fe27e0c683d6d797d45d3496476937a1172cdfe5.translatedText: In addition to the program, guests can also experience Chinese calligraphy and write their names in Chinese as a souvenir. The organizers also prepared a family-style dinner and desserts to allow guests to interact in a relaxed and pleasant atmosphere.

53e76e1c4f9bb4c067743529884f69f6d881e4f5.sourceText: Global Ties Arizona 是亚利桑那州致力于推动国际交流与民间外交的非营利组织，通过国际访问项目、文化交流和社区活动促进亚利桑那与世界各国之间的理解与合作。该机构拥有近60年的历史，长期接待来自世界各地的国际代表团，并组织各类跨文化活动，帮助当地社区更好地了解全球文化与事务。
53e76e1c4f9bb4c067743529884f69f6d881e4f5.translatedText: >Global Ties Arizona is a non-profit organization in Arizona dedicated to promoting international exchanges and people-to-people diplomacy, promoting understanding and cooperation between Arizona and other countries around the world through international visit projects, cultural exchanges and community activities. The institution has a history of nearly 60 years. It has long received international delegations from all over the world and organized various cross-cultural activities to help local communities better understand global culture and affairs.

72efbdd11bbf3ac50102ea1dc53e6e141350b1d7.sourceText: 此次农历新年庆典不仅展示了中国传统文化，也体现了凤凰城地区多元文化交融的活力，成为促进不同文化交流与友谊的一场精彩盛会。
72efbdd11bbf3ac50102ea1dc53e6e141350b1d7.translatedText: This Lunar New Year celebration not only showcases Chinese traditional culture, but also reflects the vitality of multicultural integration in the Phoenix area, becoming a wonderful event that promotes exchanges and friendship between different cultures.

Finance Deng Yun, Auditor Xie Chengyan, English Secretary Jia Besco, and Chinese Secretary Zhen Kaiying. The previous chairman Deng Chaoju was promoted to consultant.

56ad17dd75bfbdb7cb7d570d8a59c7f6c4cd3086.sourceText: 徐国富主席发表上任感言谓，在邓朝驹主席的带领下，UCA AZ过去两年从无到有，逐渐让社区认识到我们。感谢曾经服务过和正在服务中的董事们，今后将继续与大家一起，争取更多的公民权益。
56ad17dd75bfbdb7cb7d570d8a59c7f6c4cd3086.translatedText: > Chairman Xu Guofu delivered his acceptance speech and said that under the leadership of Chairman Deng Chaoju, UCA AZ has grown from scratch in the past two years and has gradually made the community recognize us. Thanks to the directors who have served and are currently serving, we will continue to work with everyone to fight for more citizen rights in the future.

77586ffa22843319f60744d2c8946929c163ccd4.sourceText: UCA AZ每年举办一次大型活动，去年的“关注青少年心理健康”取得很好的关注力。今年的主题是“老人照护”，内容包括长期照护、老人院分级、遗嘱设立等等。这次活动与凤凰城华人耆英会合作，订于5月17日（星期五）在华人耆英会会所举行。活动具体安排正在确认中，一旦确认将立刻公布。
77586ffa22843319f60744d2c8946929c163ccd4.translatedText: >UCA AZ holds a large-scale event every year, and last year’s “Focus on Youth Mental Health” gained great attention. This year's theme is "Elderly Care", which includes long-term care, classification of nursing homes, establishment of wills, etc. This event is in cooperation with the Phoenix Chinese Senior Citizens Association and is scheduled to be held on May 17 (Friday) at the Chinese Senior Citizens Association clubhouse. The specific arrangements for the event are being confirmed and will be announced immediately once confirmed.

6c4f1b6d10ae5b168c61f867f59ad02a505fdfb5.sourceText: 此外，2024年美国华人大会将以“拥抱新时代民权运动”为主题，于6月27至30日在华盛顿特区举行。今年的大会将有五个轨道：1）全国青年大会；2）全国心理健康峰会；3）亚太裔政治行动峰会；4)社区建设和公民参与；5）创业和职业发展。
6c4f1b6d10ae5b168c61f867f59ad02a505fdfb5.translatedText: In addition, the 2024 Chinese American Conference will be held in Washington, DC from June 27th to 30th with the theme of "Embracing the Civil Rights Movement in the New Era". This year’s conference will have five tracks: 1) National Youth Conference; 2) National Mental Health Summit; 3) Asian Pacific American Political Action Summit; 4) Community Building and Civic Engagement; and 5) Entrepreneurship and Career Development.

ba1c833832093369837ef1adcb035446eed87aee.sourceText: 亚利桑那州前后有过五本华人电话本，最早的一本名为《亚省斐匿、祖笋华侨通讯。“斐匿”是指凤凰城，“祖笋”是台山话，即为“图森”市。这本“华侨通讯录”是上世纪六十年代出版，笔者曾看过是红字图案的封面，但并没有见过其中的内容。
ba1c833832093369837ef1adcb035446eed87aee.translatedText: There have been five Chinese phone books in Arizona. The earliest one is called "Alberta Feini and Zusun Overseas Chinese Newsletter." "Feni" refers to the city of Phoenix, and "Zusun" means "Tucson" in Taishan dialect. This "Overseas Chinese Phone Book" was published in the 1960s. , the author has seen the cover with red letters, but has not seen the content.

cd836ce7eec16f01b642a35fd37c57c15f9cf6a9.sourceText: 第二本“华侨通讯”是上面绿色封面的那一本，出版时间是1971年。这本“华人通讯”由邓粤寅所编印，有130页。范围包括亚省各地城镇华人的通讯资料，当时共印了2000本，免费向商家和住家发行。这本华人通讯封面广告是“斐匿瓜菜公司”，电话252-4881，直到2022年，当我加上区号(602)拨号后，居然还可以打通。半个世纪过去，公司仍在，电话号未变，老板仍是邓尚武先生，当时我去采访他时，还有不少华人定购他公司出产的新鲜面条。
cd836ce7eec16f01b642a35fd37c57c15f9cf6a9.translatedText: The second "Overseas Chinese Newsletter" is the one with the green cover. This "Chinese Newsletter" was compiled and printed by Deng Yueyin and has 130 pages. A total of 2,000 copies of communication materials for Chinese people in cities and towns across the province were printed and distributed free of charge to businesses and households. The cover advertisement on this Chinese newsletter was "Fini Guacai Company" and the phone number was 252-4881. Until 2022, when I added the area code (602) to dial, I could still get through. , the company is still there, the phone number has not changed, and the boss is still Mr. Deng Shangwu. When I went to interview him, there were still many Chinese ordering the fresh noodles produced by his company.

2ff4db7194ff2489c8cb0ce14c717c1fa2338813.sourceText: 这本通讯录的封底是一页绿色的广告，这是一间由华人经营，名为“Tang‘s Imports”的百货公司，“经营各国出入口业务”，“这里百货排列买什么有什么”。他们有三间百货公司分佈在凤凰城和坦佩市，是当时著名的华人企业，另外，“Tang’s”企业还经瓜菜店铺和中餐馆以及墨西哥餐馆等等，其锋头一时无兩。
2ff4db7194ff2489c8cb0ce14c717c1fa2338813.translatedText: The back cover of this address book is a green page of advertisements. This is a restaurant run by Chinese people called "Tang’s." Imports” department store, “operates import and export business from various countries”, “you can buy whatever you want in department stores here”. They had three department stores located in Phoenix and Tempe, and were well-known Chinese enterprises at the time. In addition, “Tang’s” also operated vegetable shops, Chinese restaurants, Mexican restaurants, etc., and its popularity was unparalleled.

7c6e2db95057bbce2d11d60d055de1335aade60c.sourceText: “China Doll”在当年还是一间“华美小馆”，之后才搬到对面的新地址，并用六十万美元装修，成为七十年代美国西南最大面积的两层茶楼。
7c6e2db95057bbce2d11d60d055de1335aade60c.translatedText: "China Doll" was still a "Chinese and American Tavern" at that time. It was later moved to a new address across the street and renovated with US$600,000. It became the largest two-story teahouse in the southwest of the United States in the 1970s.

33b40bb8eb4463738a0b689a1943f0b3c2f6acfd.sourceText: 这本“华人通讯”给我们留下亚省华人当年的大量资讯，例如，有全美首位州众议员邓悦宁（Wing F. Ong)，为他的餐厅”WING’S所打”的广告。邓悦宁是上世纪五十年代全美国七位华人律师之一，他在凤凰城开有律师事务所，还开华人餐馆，开始是以“前铺后居”的家庭形式经营，而这一间开业是在当年城市的繁华路段，他可以在经营中接触到更多的人脉。
33b40bb8eb4463738a0b689a1943f0b3c2f6acfd.translatedText: This "Chinese Newsletter" left us with a lot of information about the Chinese in Alberta at that time. For example, the first state representative in the United States, Wing F. Ong), advertising for his restaurant "WING'S". Deng Yuening was one of the seven Chinese lawyers in the United States in the 1950s. He opened a law firm in Phoenix and also opened a Chinese restaurant, starting with a "front shop and a living room". It was run as a family, and this one was opened in a prosperous section of the city. He could get in touch with more contacts in the business.

33daddcc3fae867bc295c80852c4337b1c44c52d.sourceText: 值得一提的还有“崇琼楼”，（Toy’S Shangri-La) 这是一间1951年开业的餐厅，由本地著名的侨领，参加过一战且立有战功的关崇琼先生所建立，这是当年华人所经营最大的餐馆，掌管厨政的是关崇琼的第二个儿子关护理，他在二战中曾回到过中国，参加打击日军並立过战功的人物。关崇琼夫妇育有十一个儿女，十个养育成人。众多的儿女是那个时代的就好的人力资源，“崇琼楼”在家族经营了廿多年后，把铺位出租给其他华人经营。下面是这间餐厅在华人通讯录中的一个广告。直到今天，这间餐厅仍由华人经营，之前是间布斐中餐馆，但现在已经改为“东京寿司”日本料理店 ，餐厅门面也有了很大的改观。虽然如此，这仍是到目前为止，亚省唯一的一间属于华人物业，并由华人经营了七十多年的餐馆。
33daddcc3fae867bc295c80852c4337b1c44c52d.translatedText: It is worth mentioning that "Chongqiong Building" (Toy’S) is also worth mentioning. Shangri-La) This is a restaurant opened in 1951. It was established by Mr. Guan Chongqiong, a well-known local overseas Chinese leader who participated in World War I and made military exploits. It was the largest restaurant run by Chinese at that time. The person in charge of the kitchen was Guan Chongqiong’s second son Guan Nurong. He returned to China during World War II and participated in the fight against the Japanese army and made military exploits. Guan Chongqiong and his wife had eleven children. Ten children were raised. The numerous children were the best human resources of that era. After the family had been running the restaurant for more than 20 years, the shop was rented out to other Chinese. The following is an advertisement for this restaurant in the Chinese address book. To this day, this restaurant is still operated by Chinese people. It was formerly a Buffy Chinese restaurant, but it has now been changed to a "Tokyo Sushi" Japanese restaurant. , the restaurant's appearance has also undergone great changes. However, this is still the only restaurant in Alberta that is owned by a Chinese and has been operated by a Chinese for more than 70 years.

b328fb517a30baf5db0dda25a67c2166e61604a6.sourceText: 张华芳主席恭祝大家龙年福庆满门！ 前任主席关嬿仪對2023年度的工作作了总結，大家对她在过去一年来为龙岡团体所作出的努力和成绩表示感谢和赞许。 2024年凤凰城龙岡公所新一届的职员表如下： 主席：张华芳 副主席：刘全知 关兆锋 赵新卓 财政：Jun Lau 英文书記：张慧美 中文书記：刘丽华 核數：赵荣辉 会務：Margie Liu 通讯：张肇鸿 顾問：刘汝璋 刘沃彪 关嬿仪 张万波 职员：刘陈爱卿 张冯建华 赵嘉倫 主席张华芳此次是再度当选。2013年，时任主席的张华芳率团参加美洲龙岡总会在美国休斯顿举行的第20届恳亲大会，她勇于承担重任，与凤凰城全体成员接办下一届的恳亲大會。
