In 2013, then-chairman Zhang Huafang led a delegation to participate in the 20th Annual Friendship Conference held by the Dragon Gang Association of America in Houston, USA. She had the courage to shoulder the heavy responsibility and took over the next Annual Conference with all members of Phoenix City.

2c63ba509868d331736002487eec02b8124a9715.sourceText: 龙岡组织缘起于三国时代“桃园结义”和“古城聚会”的历史。一千八百年来，刘、关、张、趙四姓宗亲尊从先主遗训：“勉之，勉之！勿以恶小而为之，勿以善小而不为。惟贤惟德，能服於人。（出自《三国志·蜀传》）。” 一百多年前，四姓宗亲在广东开平建成“龙岡古廟”，供奉四姓先贤和诸葛孔明像。之后，龙岡精神随着中国移民流传海外，世界各地的四姓宗亲纷纷建立“龙岡”组织，团结合作，守望相助。 二十世纪未，移民到美国的四姓宗亲建立“美国龙岡亲义总公所”，并于1928年召开了第一次全国性代表大会，支持孙中山先生的革命活动。1963年，世界龙岡亲义总公所在香港正式成立。至今世界各地龙岡组织超过一百四十多个，海外宗親超過三百多万人。 近代的美国龙岡贤能辈出，如担任过美国劳工部和交通部部长的赵小兰，联邦众议员赵美心，联邦众议员刘云平等。在各行各业出类拔萃的龙岡优秀人才更是多不胜数！ 凤凰城龙岡亲义公所成立于1973年，至今已超过五十年的历史。 2016年，第21屆美洲龙岡恳亲大会在凤凰城成功召开！泛美洲的华人团体大型会议，在亚利桑那州也只有侨联总会和凤凰城龙岡团体举办过。
2c63ba509868d331736002487eec02b8124a9715.translatedText: The Longgang Organization originated from the history of "Taoyuan Stakeholdership" and "Ancient City Gathering" during the Three Kingdoms era. For 1,800 years, the clansmen of the four surnames Liu, Guan, Zhang and Zhao have followed the instructions of their ancestors: "Encourage them, encourage them! Do not do evil because it is small, and do not do good because it is small. Only the virtuous and virtuous can obey others. (From "Three Kingdoms·Shu Biography")." More than a hundred years ago, the four surnames built the "Longgang Ancient Temple" in Kaiping, Guangdong, to worship the sages of the four surnames and Zhuge Kongming. Later, the Longgang spirit spread overseas with Chinese immigrants, and clansmen of the four surnames around the world established "Longgang" organizations to unite, cooperate, and help each other. At the end of the 20th century, four surnames who immigrated to the United States established the "American Longgang General Office of Friendship and Friendship" and held the first national congress in 1928 to support Dr. Sun Yat-sen's revolutionary activities. In 1963, the World Longgang Chenyi General Office was officially established in Hong Kong. So far, there are more than 140 Longgang organizations around the world, with more than 3 million overseas clan members. In modern times, there have been many talented people in Longgang, such as Elaine Chao, who served as Secretary of the Department of Labor and Department of Transportation, Congresswoman Zhao Meixin, and Congressman Liu Yunping. There are countless outstanding talents in Longgang who are outstanding in all walks of life! Phoenix Longgang Qinyi Office was established in 1973 and has a history of more than 50 years. In 2016, the 21st American Longgang Kiss Conference was successfully held in Phoenix! Only the Overseas Chinese Federation and the Phoenix Longgang Group have held large-scale meetings of Chinese groups across America in Arizona.

e11bfe621edb497518f5eb2b2638cf1109d4e037.sourceText: 张华芳服务侨社多年。她出任过大凤凰城侨联总会主席、亚省中餐馆协会主席，也是华人福利会、亚省华人历史协会的理事，她对凤凰城中文学校、华人耆英会等文化公益事业出钱出力，贡献良多，好评如潮。 春回大地迎新岁，似曾相识燕归来。迈入新的一年，寄望凤凰城龙岡团体在张华芳主席的带领下，焕发龙马精神，取得新的成绩，为华人社区增添芳华风采！ （张肇鸿报道）
e11bfe621edb497518f5eb2b2638cf1109d4e037.translatedText: Zhang Huafang has served the overseas Chinese community for many years. She has served as the chairman of the Greater Phoenix Overseas Chinese Federation, the chairman of the Chinese Restaurant Association of Alberta, and is also a director of the Chinese Welfare Association and the Chinese Historical Association of Alberta. She has made great contributions to cultural and public welfare undertakings such as the Phoenix Chinese School and the Chinese Seniors Association, and has received rave reviews. Spring returns to the earth to welcome the new year, and it seems that the familiar swallows are returning. Entering the new year, I hope that under the leadership of Chairman Zhang Huafang, the Phoenix Longgang Group will glow with the spirit of Longma, achieve new results, and add youthful charm to the Chinese community! 464a4b4d2a5caa417ed01d460f30f9776147a73a.sourceText: 斐匿余風采堂及其物业 张肇鸿 摄影 根据史科，被余氏公奉为太祖的余靖忠襄公，是宋朝广东韶关人，登进士第，后至工部尚书， 与欧阳修等齐名。当时有诗赞贤臣余靖：“必有谋臣裨帝右，更加风采动朝端。” 这是《余风采堂 》“风采”一词之来由。又因韶关有一河流名曰“武溪”，余靖用此为号，并出过文集，故“武溪”又成 为了余风采堂的另一个别称。 余风采堂起缘之国内而发展于海外。一百多年前，美国的余氏宗亲就在美国地区成立了“余风 采堂”，在众多的侨社团体中是个大的宗亲组织。斐匿余风采堂成立于一九六一年，并于一九八八 年置下堂所，自此祭祖香火不断，宗亲联谊年年举行。 1900年代，余康中家族经营《花旗餐馆》，是当时由少数华人所经营的餐馆。余康中学贯中英 ，经营有方，与当时的政商关係良好，不少初到埠的余氏宗亲被收留工作或得其帮助，落脚生根 ，是斐匿余氏家族的开埠功臣。 1940年代，有余赏和与余永享开了一间在当时可称之为“超市” 的“星光孖结”，“孖结”是广东四邑 话“Market” 的译音。也有余明德开的二间货仓。余明德是当时侨社的活跃人物，是创立早期余风 采堂的重要功臣。他们长期服务余氏宗亲，没有宗族兴邦的精神，难以为继。 在二战期间，余氏军人Sing Y. Yee在保家卫国中战死沙场。1945年9月2日，日本投降签字仪 式在美军战列舰密苏里号甲板上举行，日本帝国共11人登上密苏里号，向中、美、英、苏等9国 代表面前签属《降伏文书》。美国海军官兵目睹穷凶极恶日本帝国低头伏降。美国海军各兵种共 有380万人，能在密苏里号服役的官兵为万分之一，凤凰城余氏军人炮手Tom Bon Yee是其中的 一位，他见証了这历史上庄严的一刻，为亚省华人的历史增添了光彩。 1950年代，凤凰城社区开办中文学校，从广东岭南大学毕业移民来美的余梓春，担任起中文学 校校长。当时斐匿华裔子女普遍受不懂国学，为了使下一代承传中华文化，不忘祖国乡情，余梓 春先生贡献良多。 1988年，斐匿余风采堂决定购置堂所，虽然没有如邓氏先辈那样买有土地，为日后建设会所提 供资助。但当时的余氏宗亲热情高涨，为建新会所积极筹钱，在一星期内即集资到十五万元，以 后又因扩建堂所再把筹款额推高至二十三万元。因筹款已够置业，所以总堂所拨给的二万元也一 分钱未领取，让给其它更有需要的会馆。如今的余风采堂年年有物业出租收入，会务兴隆。
464a4b4d2a5caa417ed01d460f30f9776147a73a.translatedText: > Yee Fong Toy Family Association and its properties Photography by Zhang Zhaohong According to historical records, Duke Yu Jingzhong, who was regarded as the Taizu by the Yu family, was a native of Shaoguan, Guangdong in the Song Dynasty. He became a Jinshi and later became the Minister of the Ministry of Industry, and was as famous as Ouyang Xiu and others. At that time, there was a poem praising the virtuous minister Yu Jing: "There must be advisers who will serve the emperor at his right and move the court with more grace." This is the origin of the word "style" in "Yu Fengcaitang". And because there is a river in Shaoguan named "Wuxi", Yu Jing used this as his nickname and published an anthology of essays, so "Wuxi" became another nickname for Yu Fengcaitang. Yu Fengcaitang originated in China and developed overseas. More than a hundred years ago, the Yu clan in the United States established the "Yufeng Caitang" in the United States, which is a large clan organization among many overseas Chinese communities. Fei Niyu Fengcai Hall was established in 1961 and the lower hall was built in 1988. Since then, ancestor worship has continued and family reunions have been held every year. In the 1900s, Yu Kangzhong's family operated "Citi Restaurant", which was a restaurant operated by a small number of Chinese at that time. Yukang Middle School was proficient in Chinese and English, well-run, and had good political and business relations at the time. Many Yu family members who had just arrived in the port were taken in to work or helped to settle down and settle down. They were the heroes of the Fei Ni Yu family in opening the port. In the 1940s, You Yu Shanghe and Yu Yongxiang opened "Xingguang Margin", which could be called a "supermarket" at the time. "Margin" is the transliteration of "Market" in the Siyi dialect of Guangdong. There are also two warehouses opened by Yu Mingde. Yu Mingde was an active figure in the overseas Chinese community at that time and an important contributor to the establishment of the early Yu Fengcaitang. They have served the Yu clan for a long time, and without the spirit of clan rejuvenation, it is difficult to survive. During World War II, Sing Y. Yee, a soldier of the Ye family, died on the battlefield while defending his country. On September 2, 1945, Japan's surrender signing ceremony was held on the deck of the USS Missouri. A total of 11 people from the Japanese Empire boarded the Missouri and signed the "Instrument of Surrender" in front of representatives of nine countries, including China, the United States, Britain, and the Soviet Union. The U.S. Navy officers and soldiers witnessed the atrocities of the Japanese Empire bowing their heads and surrendering. There are 3.8 million people in all branches of the U.S. Navy, and only one in 10,000 officers and men can serve on the USS Missouri. Phoenix Yu's gunner Tom Bon Yee is one of them. He witnessed this solemn moment in history and added glory to the history of the Chinese in Alberta. In the 1950s, a Chinese school was opened in the Phoenix community. Yu Zichun, who immigrated to the United States after graduating from Lingnan University in Guangdong, became the principal of the Chinese school. At that time, Chinese children in the Philippines generally did not understand traditional Chinese culture. In order to ensure that the next generation would inherit Chinese culture and not forget the nostalgia of the motherland, Mr. Yu Zichun made a lot of contributions. In 1988, Fei Niyu Fengcai Hall decided to purchase a church hall, although it did not buy land like the Deng ancestors did to provide funding for the future construction of the hall. However, the Yu family members were very enthusiastic at that time and actively raised money for the construction of a new clubhouse. Within a week, they raised 150,000 yuan. Later, due to the expansion of the church hall, the amount of funds raised was pushed up to 230,000 yuan. Since the funds raised were enough to buy a house, not a penny of the NT$20,000 allocated by the main church was received, and was given to other clubs in greater need. Nowadays, Yu Fengcaitang generates property rental income every year and its business is booming.

e4e0a1e64a903a4ed15462c5038b69b1150e3081.sourceText: 在余风采堂动土奠基时，以余氏第二代 “土纸仔” 余文泽和余锐滚等为首的一帮男女后生捲起衫 袖，磨拳擦掌全盘策划，自己动手砌地台油油漆，装修礼堂和厨房设备，在短时间内新的堂所已 经落成。新建的“余风采堂” 美观实用，余风采堂每年祭祖香火鼎盛，男女老少踊跃参加，由族人 自动捐出的六隻烧猪在祭祖后全部“太公分猪肉” 人人有份，盛况连年。
e4e0a1e64a903a4ed15462c5038b69b1150e3081.translatedText: When the foundation stone was laid for Yu Feng Caitang, a group of young men and women, headed by Yu Wenze and Yu Ruigun, the second generation of the Yu family, rolled up their sleeves and started planning. They started laying the floor, painting, and decorating the auditorium and kitchen equipment. The new hall was completed in a short period of time. The newly built "Yufengcaitang" is beautiful and practical. Every year, the ancestor worship in Yufengcaitang is very popular. Men, women, old and young actively participate in it. The six roast pigs donated by the tribe members are all "Taigong pork" after the ancestor worship. Everyone has a share, and the event continues year after year.

d89d5eefe3a24aa8ed36e7deb86bb455e5b6a84a.sourceText: 时至今日，斐匿余风采堂的堂务巳由中、青一代接管打理，堂务会议都是英文进行，新的一代 尊敬老侨，发展会务，热心社会。当今许多宗亲组织都有人员减少，后继无人的忧虑，而斐匿余 风采堂却令人看到了薪火相传，蓬勃发展的景象。余氏家族重视培养下一代，余风采堂连年发放 奬学金，无论是学英文或学中文的学生都尽力栽培，余氏宗族的努力已经春华秋实。 当今余氏最著名的人物是余艳芬（Kimberly Yee），她自2018年起担任亚利桑那州财政部部长 ，也是美国历史上首位赢得州政府重要公职的华裔女性。 在全美的余氏宗亲堂所中，斐匿余风采堂也是个模范堂所，在对祖国故乡建设方面，斐匿余氏 宗亲桑梓深情，为重修故乡宗祠，美国余风采堂总行集资超过一百万，斐匿余氏宗亲就捐出了廿 六万。余氏家族人材辈出，余文裕，余文劲荣膺过世界余氏宗亲总会要职，并有多位余氏族人担 任过凤凰城侨联总会主席。已故的余文劲先生更是人人敬佩的资深侨领。 余氏家族和人才对主流社会和凤凰城华人社区都有积极的贡献。
d89d5eefe3a24aa8ed36e7deb86bb455e5b6a84a.translatedText: Today, the church affairs of Fei Niyu Fengcai Hall have been taken over by the middle and younger generations. Hall meetings are all held in English. The new generation respects the old overseas Chinese, develops conference affairs, and is enthusiastic about society. Nowadays, many clan organizations are worried about having fewer members and no successors, but Fei Niyu Fengcai Hall allows people to see the scene of vigorous development in which the firepower is passed down from generation to generation. The Yu family attaches great importance to cultivating the next generation. Yu Fengcaitang has issued scholarships year after year to train students whether they are studying English or Chinese. The efforts of the Yu family have come to fruition. The most famous figure in the Ye family today is Kimberly Yee, who has served as Arizona Secretary of the Treasury since 2018 and is also the first Chinese-American woman in American history to win an important public office in the state government. Among the ancestral halls of the Yu family in the United States, Fei Niyu Fengcai Hall is also a model hall. In terms of the construction of the motherland, the Fei Niyu family has a deep affection for their hometown. In order to rebuild the ancestral hall in their hometown, the head office of Yu Fengcai Hall in the United States raised more than one million, and the Fei Niyu clan donated 260,000. The Yu family is full of talented people. Yu Wenyu and Yu Wenjin have been honored with important positions in the World Yu Clan Association, and many members of the Yu family have served as presidents of the Phoenix Overseas Chinese Federation. The late Mr. Yu Wenjin was a senior overseas Chinese leader that everyone admired. The Yu family and talent have made positive contributions to mainstream society and the Phoenix Chinese community.

45b2930da9174a03c80eb20840e4579185ea063c.translatedText: Arizona Chinese Historical Association Zhang Zhaohong’s 30-ton “Chinese Coolie” statue In the Auburn area, in addition to digging for gold...

8226ac35d9164af55b4383fdb288e7b7cb97450a.sourceText: 亚利桑那州华人历史协会 张肇鴻
8226ac35d9164af55b4383fdb288e7b7cb97450a.translatedText: Arizona Chinese Historical Association Zhang Zhaohong

843f261489a12688295e0727df66e57121b1920d.sourceText: 在奥本(Auburn)地区，华人除了淘金，另一大贡献是修筑铁路。修建太平洋铁路最艰难的一段就在波莱赛（Placer)境内，为了打通内华达山脉，有5 千多华工参加修建，被炸死的就达 200 多人。整个铁路建设期间，有1200名以上的华工死去，在华工建设的路段，平均每2英里的枕木下埋葬了3名华工。所以有历史学者说，“每一根枕木下就有一名华工的尸体!”
843f261489a12688295e0727df66e57121b1920d.translatedText: In the Auburn area, in addition to gold mining, another major contribution of the Chinese was the construction of railways. The most difficult section of the Pacific Railway was built in Placer. In order to open up the Sierra Nevada Mountains, more than 5,000 Chinese workers participated in the construction, and more than 200 people were killed in the bombing. During the entire railway construction period, more than 1,200 Chinese workers died. On average, 3 Chinese workers were buried under sleepers every 2 miles on the section of road built by Chinese workers. That’s why some historians said, “Under every sleeper there is the body of a Chinese laborer!”

3481f0790e6478ea29fd5239cd6ff9deb5069da0.sourceText: 在铁路博物馆中，我看到一张相片，这是一个早期来美国的中国移民的家庭合照。这个家族后人罗素.N.罗，有如下的说明：（译文）我的曾祖父洪利华和他的兄弟吉华参加建造横贯大陆的铁路，这是我与美国历史最直接的联系。我站在山顶的大隧道中间，在黑暗中抚摸着花岗岩墙壁，他们在这里辛勤工作了 15 个月。吉华叔叔在一次爆炸中失去了一只眼睛。我能感受到150年前中国男人的存在。我为这些来自广东的年轻人为自己和美国所取得的成就感到骄傲！
3481f0790e6478ea29fd5239cd6ff9deb5069da0.translatedText: In the Railway Museum, I saw a photo of a family of early Chinese immigrants to the United States. Russell N. Rowe, a descendant of this family, has the following explanation: (Translation) My great-grandfather Honglihua and his brother Jihua participated in the construction of the transcontinental railroad. This is my most direct connection with American history. I stood in the dark, caressing the granite walls in the middle of the great tunnel at the top of the mountain where they had toiled for 15 months. Uncle Jihua lost an eye in an explosion. I can feel the presence of Chinese men 150 years ago. I am so proud of what these young people from Guangdong have achieved for themselves and the United States!

c45111e2b422c16d282a3e8fc72b43865f85ee59.sourceText: 1869年5月10日，美国中央太平洋铁路公司的总裁利兰·斯坦福，在犹他州海角峰用银锤将最后一根“金道钉”钉入铁轨，标志着美国第一条横贯大陆的铁路完工。这条铁路线全长1776英里，将旧金山湾的太平洋海岸与已有的东部铁路网联结起来。铁路的建成使美国经济发生了革命性的变化，尤其是西部的产业，并证明了美国华人的历史贡献。
c45111e2b422c16d282a3e8fc72b43865f85ee59.translatedText: On May 10, 1869, Leland Stanford, the president of the Central Pacific Railroad Company, drove the last "golden spike" into the track with a silver hammer at Cape Peak, Utah, marking the completion of the first transcontinental railroad in the United States. The 1,776-mile rail line connects the Pacific Coast of San Francisco Bay to the existing eastern rail network. The completion of the railroad revolutionized the American economy, especially industries in the West, and proved the historical contribution of Chinese Americans.

703838e5b6f059355b921b56bf400c4b8590a836.sourceText: 在横贯大陆的铁路完工的典礼上，却看不到一个华工的身影！
703838e5b6f059355b921b56bf400c4b8590a836.translatedText: At the completion ceremony of the transcontinental railway, not a single Chinese laborer was seen!

3b44854f84dfc2877163ebffa793d0e746ba69bb.sourceText: 让美国经济腾飞的铁路华工
3b44854f84dfc2877163ebffa793d0e746ba69bb.translatedText: The Chinese railroad workers who made the U.S. economy take off

062f6b01f43622daf5641d7bc224ff37a7bd91cd.translatedText: The image of the "Chinese railroad workers" made of spikes

0e01b18a5ad553e697846df2d0ec203757b76024.translatedText: "Tianjingsha. Chinese railroad workers in the United States"

a230b3d79db999cf70a4a620f7792af4af98a5f5.translatedText: the male ghost refused to return home!

793c203c136987fea3995e9494ea0c5151bb25cf.sourceText: 在这次淘金筑路寻根的旅途中，笔者曾多次写下诗稿，不管写得好与不好，都是触景生情而产生出来的心灵碰撞火花，诗作能够得到大家的共鸣与点赞，是对我最好的支持和勉励。
793c203c136987fea3995e9494ea0c5151bb25cf.translatedText: During this journey of digging for gold, building roads and finding roots, the author has written poems many times. No matter whether they are good or not, they are sparks of spiritual collision caused by touching the scene. The fact that the poems can be resonated and praised by everyone is the best support and encouragement for me.

9db9e62b42c1184f73b4d7ec471370756f22fd98.sourceText: 那晚到达旅馆时，我们正在前台大厅等待分配房间，忽然听到团友“老威”在大声地朗读笔者写的《一堵残墙》：
9db9e62b42c1184f73b4d7ec471370756f22fd98.translatedText: When we arrived at the hotel that night, we were waiting to be assigned a room in the front lobby. Suddenly we heard our groupmate "Lao Wei" reading aloud "A Broken Wall" written by the author:

f82475c9aa25a3a9c47ee07ab9f6c3a270209d78.sourceText: “这是一堵墙；这是百年前的一堵残墙；这是淘金华人留下唯一的“南墙”! 1850 年，千百华工，带着几个婆娘，克服千辛万苦，只为了一个梦想……”
f82475c9aa25a3a9c47ee07ab9f6c3a270209d78.translatedText: "This is a wall; this is a Broken Wall from a hundred years ago; this is the only "Southern Wall" left by the gold-mining Chinese! 1850 For years, thousands of Chinese workers, together with several wives, overcame countless hardships, just for one dream..."

dcf04ee5a6a0c0e90ff88a36a54846aa4547afd7.sourceText: 老威是北京人，朗读时字正腔圆，抑扬顿挫分明，低音时沉韵感性，高音时铿锵有力，分外的悦耳和感人，这是一位训练有素朗颂达人！
dcf04ee5a6a0c0e90ff88a36a54846aa4547afd7.translatedText: Lao Wei is a native of Beijing. When he reads aloud, his words are clear and mellow, with clear cadences. The bass is deep and sensual, and the treble is sonorous and powerful. It is exceptionally pleasant and touching. He is a well-trained resonant master!

385e7daad843d659c560c8ca2b2c6c8aee52c40a.sourceText: 那天晚上，我作了一个梦，梦见老威正在为《中国移民》电视剧的“一堵残墙”作诗朗颂：
385e7daad843d659c560c8ca2b2c6c8aee52c40a.translatedText: That night, I had a dream. I dreamed that Lao Wei was composing a poem for "A Broken Wall" in the TV series "Chinese Immigration":

a707f8a490f04a662ae67d9e70cdca734cc8ae53.sourceText: “今天，我们来了，伸出了手，撫摸百年历史；拍一个照，留下无数思量。如何紧跟先辈的脚步？如何重建我们的城墙！……”
a707f8a490f04a662ae67d9e70cdca734cc8ae53.translatedText: "Today, I They came, stretched out their hands, touched the century-old history; took a photo, leaving countless thoughts. How to follow in the footsteps of our ancestors? How to rebuild our city wall! ..."

18de8a6b1b6e4463746548d19fa325909e6493dc.sourceText: 玉石之声悠扬，绕梁三日！
18de8a6b1b6e4463746548d19fa325909e6493dc.translatedText: The sound of jade lingers for three days!

906102342f57d7d5e1c83b11ef39bed1de8604b8.sourceText: 老威和张素久大姐合照
906102342f57d7d5e1c83b11ef39bed1de8604b8.translatedText: >Lao Wei and sister Zhang Sujiu took a photo

edec26273d5ee2c8d7706e0ab4d72115429322de.translatedText: Arizona Chinese Historical Association Zhang Zhaohong

ded8c41c0169a52239edb4f0a0d757860934e68d.sourceText: 旅游第三日，我们起程去“乐居镇”（Locke)参观。
ded8c41c0169a52239edb4f0a0d757860934e68d.translatedText: On the third day of the trip, we set off to visit "Locke".

2ffe2f9663b83cce05ed660cebe78a8d1b9cf6d8.sourceText: 19世纪60年代，为了把沼泽地变成农田，联邦政府要在乐居镇附近修建堤坝。成千上万的华人劳工完成了横贯大陆的铁路建设之后，继续被雇用修筑堤坝。华工每天挣不到一美元，硬是用铁锹和独轮车，修建了这座一千多英里的堤坝。
2ffe2f9663b83cce05ed660cebe78a8d1b9cf6d8.translatedText: In the 1860s, in order to turn swampland into farmland, the federal government wanted to build a dike near Leju Town. After thousands of Chinese laborers completed construction of the transcontinental railroad, they continued to be employed building levees. Chinese workers, who earned less than a dollar a day, had to use shovels and wheelbarrows to build the more than a thousand-mile dike.

5fc3a2303bbc6e9382134c8ee0cdaf3141b2adc2.sourceText: 1915年，有部分华人居所被大火吞没，农场主人允许居民建立他们自己的城镇。在被租用的地上，华人社区建起了邮局，电影院、酒楼、食物市场、干货店、理发店、及多项经营、乐居随着岁月兴旺起来，永久居民曾有六百，常来常往的人客愈千人。
5fc3a2303bbc6e9382134c8ee0cdaf3141b2adc2.translatedText: In 1915, some Chinese residences were engulfed by fire, and the farm owners allowed the residents to establish their own towns. On the rented land, the Chinese community built a post office, a cinema, a restaurant, a food market, a dry goods store, a barber shop, and a variety of businesses. Leju prospered over the years, with 600 permanent residents and more than a thousand regular visitors.

5c6b1d4f56ec68591388531ec362e9e2e370c9f2.sourceText: 1971年，乐居镇被列为“国民历史地区”，1999年成为“国家历史性地区里程碑”。美国政府内政部用中文为乐居镇立碑：
5c6b1d4f56ec68591388531ec362e9e2e370c9f2.translatedText: In 1971, Leju Town was listed as a "National Historic Area" and in 1999 it became a "National Historic Area Milestone". The Department of the Interior of the U.S. government erected a monument in Chinese for Leju Town:

41e0926484807d74321fae52db2544c51cd0bf49.sourceText: “这个地方拥有国民特色的意义，纪念着美国国家历史。
41e0926484807d74321fae52db2544c51cd0bf49.translatedText: "This place has the significance of national characteristics and commemorates the history of the United States.

1f522a9adefaecd2e77099c28dcabb78a998df70.sourceText: 乐居镇成为美国最庞大及最全面的华人农村美式社区实例，没有其他仍尚在可相比的地区能清晰展示出华人农村的美国生活”。
1f522a9adefaecd2e77099c28dcabb78a998df70.translatedText: Leju Town has become the largest and most comprehensive example of Chinese rural American communities in the United States. There is no other comparable area that can clearly show the American life of Chinese rural areas."

1afb31f23fbd85c3c38137c8f00ba6c0517de1dd.sourceText: 张素久会长在乐居镇留影
1afb31f23fbd85c3c38137c8f00ba6c0517de1dd.translatedText: President Zhang Sujiu took photos in Leju Town

8ffb28c4e8023281b51772b95c51d82721b4c670.sourceText: 乐居镇设立有孔子先贤和孙中山先生的铜像，大家前往拍照留念。
8ffb28c4e8023281b51772b95c51d82721b4c670.translatedText: There were bronze statues of Confucius and Dr. Sun Yat-sen in Leju Town. Everyone went to take photos.

f5c674c26233e73bdbc61f76f18cd84317da456f.translatedText: Zhang Zhaohong, He Huijun, Chen Canpei

b990c5eb4096abdda11fd34f4a103f4c9e25954a.sourceText: 乐居镇街景 摄影 李苏
b990c5eb4096abdda11fd34f4a103f4c9e25954a.translatedText: Leju Town Street View Photography Li Su

edef3eda5470d3a68fbed1de7bb96b3bba5d74fd.sourceText: 参观完乐居镇，旅游大巴到达科洛马，这是加州首个发现黄金的地方。我们参观了此地的“黄金发现博物馆”。
edef3eda5470d3a68fbed1de7bb96b3bba5d74fd.translatedText: After visiting Leju Town, the tour bus arrived at Coloma, the first place where gold was discovered in California. We visited the “Gold Discovery Museum” here.

e1db10a75c234659e2855d1ef604b67ca120bdaa.sourceText: 1848年二月，两名中国男子及一名女子乘坐美国鹰号 (American Eagle) 海轮，从广州横渡太平洋抵达加州的三藩市，成为最早登陆并留居在“金山”的华裔移民。随后两年，一波波的华人接踵而至，在此地留下了他们的历史足迹。
e1db10a75c234659e2855d1ef604b67ca120bdaa.translatedText: In February 1848, two Chinese men and a woman took the American Eagle and crossed the Pacific Ocean from Guangzhou to San Francisco, California. They became the first Chinese immigrants to land and stay in "Golden Mountain". In the following two years, waves of Chinese arrived one after another, leaving their historical footprints here.

72adebdba1bb4fde553e9e033ea1cf0e5c63809c.sourceText: 到1860年，加州有华工2万4千人，从1848至1883年，加州黄金产值达12亿美元，占美国黄金总产值的三分之二，其中相当一部分是华人矿工所采。为美国创造了巨额财富，积累了丰厚的资本。
72adebdba1bb4fde553e9e033ea1cf0e5c63809c.translatedText: By 1860, there were 24,000 Chinese workers in California. From 1848 to 1883, California's gold production value reached US$1.2 billion, accounting for two-thirds of the total gold production value in the United States, a considerable part of which was mined by Chinese miners. He created huge wealth and accumulated abundant capital for the United States.

e3202c9a3673b53d0ff4343d351ddf77a2c12d17.sourceText: 下午，我们去到奥本镇（Auburn)。这是1849年淘金大潮的第一站。在博物馆中，我们看到了许多华人先辈在淘金时代的资料和所用过的物品。
e3202c9a3673b53d0ff4343d351ddf77a2c12d17.translatedText: In the afternoon, we went to Auburn. This was the first stop of the 1849 gold rush. In the museum, we saw many materials and items used by our Chinese ancestors during the gold rush era.

7824e679afeb87d6007cadf9b772c4a5c294b151.sourceText: 在这篇文章之后，也说说本旅游团的人物和故事。
7824e679afeb87d6007cadf9b772c4a5c294b151.translatedText: After this article, also talk about the characters and stories of this tour group.

47f6aaf3c0348a213b27543b15d8c16bf3271f4e.sourceText: 最初收到旅行须知时，上面写有“为备不时之需，可带上电热水壶和方便面“。但这次旅游档次高，除了中途赶时間吃快餐外，晚餐大多在餐馆饮酒加菜，张大姐带来两箱靓葡萄酒，大老闆又轮付帐单，旅游团变亲友团。方便面等没有派上用场，于是随团游历了“八千里路云和月。”
47f6aaf3c0348a213b27543b15d8c16bf3271f4e.translatedText: When I first received the travel instructions, it said, "You can bring an electric kettle and instant noodles for emergencies." But this time the tour was of a high standard. In addition to eating fast food in a hurry, most of the dinner was at a restaurant with drinks and food. Sister Zhang brought two boxes of beautiful wine, and the big boss took turns paying the bill. The tour group became a group of relatives and friends. Instant noodles etc. were of no use, so we traveled with the group on the "Eight Thousand Miles Road to Clouds and Moons."

51bc78ce67401e230bc2c7a8d4f75e90ac2db239.sourceText: 旅途有缘结识了华美基金总裁及美国投资与移民协会执行会长何会均会长。他是两家纳斯达克上市公司的CEO，致力于中美两国企业合作，帮助中外优质企业在美国华尔街上市。
51bc78ce67401e230bc2c7a8d4f75e90ac2db239.translatedText: During the trip, I got acquainted with President He Huijun, President of Huamei Fund and Executive President of the American Investment and Immigration Association. He is the CEO of two Nasdaq-listed companies. He is committed to cooperation between Chinese and American enterprises and helps high-quality Chinese and foreign companies to be listed on Wall Street in the United States.

5e540808e126942ef235a2a3ffde31840b0db679.sourceText: 何总厚德载物、热情豪爽，善当伯乐识人才，广交朋友成伟业。他在纽约交易所隔壁特朗普大厦中租用办公室，能调度海量的资金投资优质企业，说他日理万机一点不过分。而且，他还是一位有社会责任感的成功企业家。
5e540808e126942ef235a2a3ffde31840b0db679.translatedText: Mr. Ho is virtuous, enthusiastic and forthright, good at identifying talents, making friends and achieving great success. He rents an office in Trump Tower next to the New York Stock Exchange and is able to mobilize huge amounts of funds to invest in high-quality companies. It is not an exaggeration to say that he has everything on his plate. Moreover, he is also a successful entrepreneur with a sense of social responsibility.

bd851b6c0c2216f8d61f1564b102846a21266bf3.sourceText: 偶遇生日派对，何总送礼金让小伙伴笑得灿烂。
bd851b6c0c2216f8d61f1564b102846a21266bf3.translatedText: At a birthday party by chance, Mr. He gave gifts to make the friends smile brightly.

41cf98c91afa5d1e4261b9825982ba9086d20270.sourceText: 何会长在旅途中酒庄请酒，晚餐加菜。有一次适逢假日，一座庙宇不开门，只有个工人在清理草坪。见惯世面的何总不失时机地送上小费，不久引来了拿锁匙的工作人员，何总又送上“鬼推磨”小费，于是庙宇门终于八字打开，团友鱼贯而入，尽兴参观。
41cf98c91afa5d1e4261b9825982ba9086d20270.translatedText: During the trip, President He invited wine at the winery and extra dishes for dinner. Once, during a holiday, a temple was closed and there was only a worker cleaning the lawn. Mr. He, who was accustomed to the world, lost no time in giving a tip, and soon the staff who took the key were attracted. Mr. He also gave a "ghost-turning" tip, so the temple door finally opened, and the group members filed in and enjoyed the visit.

ac2d977863eef1d07e42c71babb7e6adfd0f5b9d.sourceText: 何会均（中）在横幅上签名留念
ac2d977863eef1d07e42c71babb7e6adfd0f5b9d.translatedText: He Huijun (middle) signed the banner as a souvenir

3b59ebbc0da7b8e1913e84187c591abbd4d7ab6d.sourceText: 旅游过后，何总请我到他的办公室参观，因此了解到他跟国际投资基金合作，是坐拥多家纳斯达克主板上市公司法人股东。
3b59ebbc0da7b8e1913e84187c591abbd4d7ab6d.translatedText: After the trip, Mr. He invited me to visit his office, so I learned that he cooperates with international investment funds and is a legal shareholder of several NASDAQ main board listed companies.

03ce2d6e715e66961364f1f85af1ab8226f55b35.sourceText: 在洛杉矶一座高层建筑中的会客厅里，摆设着黄花梨镶嵌金菊花的沙发，高级红木家具，各种紫沙茶壶，墙上有拍卖得来的欧洲名画，还专门另辟一室供奉与众不同的青铜质地的仙女佛。
03ce2d6e715e66961364f1f85af1ab8226f55b35.translatedText: In the living room of a high-rise building in Los Angeles, there are huanghuali sofas inlaid with golden chrysanthemums, high-end mahogany furniture, various purple sand teapots, famous European paintings from auctions on the walls, and a separate room dedicated to the unique bronze fairy Buddha.

22bdb209043351e33ab036d2f1702aa6103cac8b.sourceText: 办公室挂有一帧两米长的水墨彩画，画中的雄鸡屹立在一磐石上，但没有作经典式的吭奋扬声之状，而是在一鸣惊人之后，回眸眺望远处的双飞彩鳥。雄鸡周边簇拥着一串串又红又紫葡萄，收获的季节令人心情愉悦，似乎闻到了美酒的醇香。画上有楷书题跋：“大吉福到”。
22bdb209043351e33ab036d2f1702aa6103cac8b.translatedText: There is a two-meter-long ink painting hanging in the office. The rooster in the painting is standing on a rock, but it does not make a classic loud sound. Instead, after making a blockbuster, it looks back at the colorful birds flying in the distance. The rooster is surrounded by bunches of red and purple grapes. The harvest season makes people feel happy, as if they smell the mellow aroma of fine wine. There is an inscription and postscript in regular script on the painting: "Great good fortune has arrived."

7708af5532eee64b3a1b105924cf95fdb7a1d79f.sourceText: 午餐适逢何总任命一位CEO到华尔街上任，席间有茅台酒及美味佳肴款待。他还提及将会到亚利桑那州走一趟，视察环境和寻获商机。
7708af5532eee64b3a1b105924cf95fdb7a1d79f.translatedText: The lunch coincided with Mr. He appointing a CEO to take up the post on Wall Street. During the dinner, there was Maotai wine and delicious food. He also mentioned that he would take a trip to Arizona to inspect the environment and look for business opportunities.

f047b2497fadec2c8f14e1172b70c2a8ac3d3ed6.sourceText: “亚利桑那”，你可读作“拉你桑拿”，也可称为“拉你爽拿”。经验老到且目光远大的投资家，定能够在这一片索诺兰沙漠的热土上，看到前景，淘得金沙。
f047b2497fadec2c8f14e1172b70c2a8ac3d3ed6.translatedText: "Arizona", you can pronounce it as "pull you in the sauna" or "pull you in the sauna". Investors with experience and far-sightedness will surely be able to see the prospects and strike gold in this hot land of the Sonoran Desert.

4bc415ae211618e2e613442b48c0c56907319ea6.sourceText: 沙漠明珠 | 美西华人淘金筑路寻根之旅 5
4bc415ae211618e2e613442b48c0c56907319ea6.translatedText: Pearl of the Desert | A journey of Chinese people searching for gold and finding their roots in West America 5

285c59f5d42c8c6e886ce2386bbeed1c4d66d4b1.sourceText: 亚利桑那州华人历史协会 张肇鸿 在科洛马（Coloma)，有1848 年最早发现黄金的马歇尔和苏特儿农场的水…
285c59f5d42c8c6e886ce2386bbeed1c4d66d4b1.translatedText: Arizona Chinese Historical Association Zhang Zhaohong In Coloma, there is water from the farms of Marshall and Suter, who first discovered gold in 1848...

3ae2695656ae65045cfd7c5d5cc4e4176ee881da.sourceText: 在科洛马（Coloma)，有1848 年最早发现黄金的马歇尔和苏特儿农场的水车，有一家 1848 年开张至今的史密斯铁匠铺， 丛林中还有一栋石头砌成的屋子，这是 19 世纪 50 年代中国杂货铺的遗址，这个杂货铺当年供应淘金工地 2 千多华工的日用品。
3ae2695656ae65045cfd7c5d5cc4e4176ee881da.translatedText: In Coloma, there is a waterwheel from the farm of Marshall and Suter, who were the first to discover gold in 1848. There is a Smith's Blacksmith Shop, which opened in 1848, and a stone house in the jungle are the remains of a Chinese grocery store in the 1850s. This grocery store supplied daily necessities to more than 2,000 Chinese workers at the gold mining site.

8838c186f49bfd4b2d70cb14a018e4a3082754c0.sourceText: 发现黄金后的七个月，《纽约先锋报》才首先刊登了这一消息；十一个月后，时任美国总统鲍克才正式向全世界消息:“在西部那块土地上发现了大量的黄金，简直令人难以置信”。
8838c186f49bfd4b2d70cb14a018e4a3082754c0.translatedText: Seven months after the discovery of gold, the New York Herald first published the news; eleven months later, then US President Bowker officially informed the world: "A large amount of gold was discovered in that land in the west. It is simply unbelievable."

5e8ef25a1f24f275218b596f13cfec76c5ded501.translatedText: The place where gold was first discovered

e6273f7e0479dd85d639068a3905b949f8ca9294.sourceText: 全世界都被搅动。到 1848 年底，各地成千上万淘金者涌入加州。中国沿海居民也决然出走海外，成为淘金潮的一支主力军。
e6273f7e0479dd85d639068a3905b949f8ca9294.translatedText: The whole world was stirred. By the end of 1848, thousands of gold prospectors from all over were flooding into California. Chinese coastal residents also decided to leave overseas and became a main force in the gold rush.

83658d29d426b59a9124c2e0e3c12c4416470152.translatedText: The Chinese in the gold rush era

8de02861526295b7afae7a9c58e9084391bc7a43.translatedText: The Eternal Stream is very popular, and

c331356575a1e75ddc5dc1f7935a72ce4f081516.translatedText: thousands of Chinese workers are digging with their hands.

320f263ffc14528d0e1f795951320e547c38e083.translatedText: A century of gold mining history,

2e6e5f8094e220ea4c9eed0b19ab70a77b20a0d1.translatedText: Starting a business with ten fingers depends on hard work!

29bd3991d5d3f5a55ede5917c494fc6693eedd74.sourceText: 我们继续前往参观“加州铁路博物馆”，这是全美最大的铁路博物馆之一。
29bd3991d5d3f5a55ede5917c494fc6693eedd74.translatedText: We continue to visit the "California Railroad Museum", which is one of the largest railroad museums in the United States.

459db5197e6a3f791edabbae68076b6feced02b5.sourceText: 隧道原型和早期火车 摄影 李苏
459db5197e6a3f791edabbae68076b6feced02b5.translatedText: Tunnel prototypes and early trains Photography by Li Su

e7a3e66f603d2e51695bc551e69e2ec5eff3a10e.sourceText: 铁路博物馆场地大、各种机车多
e7a3e66f603d2e51695bc551e69e2ec5eff3a10e.translatedText: The railway museum is large and has many locomotives of all kinds

60a2d0c553b57e8e908c5c10dcdf370f170b46af.sourceText: 当年的火车路轨和车轮
60a2d0c553b57e8e908c5c10dcdf370f170b46af.translatedText: The train tracks and wheels of that year

5e70ce87ef3c93b19beb56e96aa02ff6128b0862.sourceText: 本次旅游的策划及组织者是美中文化协会基金会主席林旭。今年7月份，他们已经为这次历史寻根之旅进行热身和踩点。
5e70ce87ef3c93b19beb56e96aa02ff6128b0862.translatedText: The planner and organizer of this tour is Lin Xu, chairman of the US-China Cultural Association Foundation. In July this year, they have already warmed up and set foot on this historical root-seeking journey.

681dfb11409047e3d41ede0b9e22fa0fc6006338.sourceText: 林旭是清华、南加大的学霸，有过众多的头衔，但他总是把帽子当做鞋子穿，于是在服务华人的道路上，就留下了一个个深深的脚印。
681dfb11409047e3d41ede0b9e22fa0fc6006338.translatedText: Lin Xu is a top student at Tsinghua University and the University of Southern California. He has many titles, but he always wears his hat as his shoes, thus leaving deep footprints on the road of serving the Chinese.

7bab683c76e0f8a3f529d27238136f11b060e4a8.sourceText: 自1995年以来，林旭一直服务于美国洛杉矶华人侨社，他曾出任美中文化协会会长，长期以来组织和参加各种社会活动和文化演出，连续16年担任美国华人春节联欢晚会总策划和总制作(2005–2020)。
7bab683c76e0f8a3f529d27238136f11b060e4a8.translatedText: Since 1995, Lin Xu has been serving the Chinese Overseas Chinese Community in Los Angeles, USA. He has served as the president of the US-China Cultural Association. He has long organized and participated in various social activities and cultural performances, and served as the chief planner and chief producer of the American Chinese Spring Festival Gala for 16 consecutive years (2005–2020).

76cf857fe8963541ec3b29075e1511bcadca89be.sourceText: 他还操盘美中文化交流，美国华人华侨事务，美国反腐运行机制、非盈利组织的管理与运作、美国社会的多元文化、美国外交政策与美中关系、美国大学教育与管理、突发事件应急管理等。他在州立大学校授课，並多次应邀前往中国各地进行讲课和演讲。
76cf857fe8963541ec3b29075e1511bcadca89be.translatedText: He also handles cultural exchanges between the United States and China, affairs of overseas Chinese in the United States, the anti-corruption operating mechanism in the United States, the management and operation of non-profit organizations, multiculturalism in American society, U.S. foreign policy and U.S.-China relations, American university education and management, emergency management, etc. He teaches at state universities and has been invited to various parts of China to give lectures and lectures.

26183a7ca82c02acce854d1f432d1fee776b74b9.sourceText: 他也是美国城市广播电视台、魅力中国卫视、美国1300AM广播电台、美国华人资讯网、美国华人网等媒体的访谈嘉宾和政治评论员。
26183a7ca82c02acce854d1f432d1fee776b74b9.translatedText: He is also an interview guest and political commentator for American City Radio and Television, Charming China Satellite TV, American 1300AM Radio Station, American Chinese Information Network, American Chinese Network and other media.

cdc0905b89b8869ef24dd39b06cd5e37f598a0ae.sourceText: 美中文化协会基金会主席林旭
cdc0905b89b8869ef24dd39b06cd5e37f598a0ae.translatedText: Chairman of the US-China Cultural Association Foundation Lin Xu

f4150ffb39313c66f7985e55093293a51f76bd73.sourceText: 其实凤凰城华人对林旭会长並不陌生。早在2009年，他就组织了“海陆空三军仪仗队”专程来到凤凰城，为庆祝“中华人民共和国成立六十周年”举办升旗和阅兵典礼。仪仗队英姿勃发，场面震撼，给本地的华人留下了深刻的印象。
f4150ffb39313c66f7985e55093293a51f76bd73.translatedText: In fact, the Chinese in Phoenix are no strangers to President Lin Xu. As early as 2009, he organized the "Guard of Honor of the Navy, Army and Air Force" to make a special trip to Phoenix to hold a flag-raising and military parade ceremony to celebrate the "60th anniversary of the founding of the People's Republic of China". The honor guard was heroic and the scene was shocking, which left a deep impression on the local Chinese people.

ea755029d95f9faa27188a4f73634e3bb6b255f9.sourceText: 一起来为社区发声：抗议the landings at Ocotillo项目入驻钱德勒市
ea755029d95f9faa27188a4f73634e3bb6b255f9.translatedText: Let’s speak out for the community: Protest the landings at Ocotillo project coming to Chandler

f126d2782388e811db0db3e2ac68396ce68ee3d2.sourceText: 各位居民/邻居/朋友们， 最近一个亚利桑那州外的开发商联合Maricopa郡政府要在钱德勒南边的中心地带（Ar…
f126d2782388e811db0db3e2ac68396ce68ee3d2.translatedText: Dear residents/neighbors/friends, Recently, an out-of-Arizona developer joined forces with the Maricopa County Government to build a project in the heart of south Chandler (Ar...

356a0f6c358db6da0d603e5a86b368c72378ff90.sourceText: 最近一个亚利桑那州外的开发商联合Maricopa郡政府要在钱德勒南边的中心地带（Arizona Ave/Ocotillo 附近）建造500多户的能容纳2000余人的廉租公寓。然而根据城市规划，这块地是用来发展商业的。现在硬性更改成高密度住宅区，这是城市建设原本没有的规划，这将对当地的治安，交通，物资，能源，造成巨大压力。更令人担忧的是，该建筑商，有着极差的评分，他们在其他州建的小区以”脏乱差”闻名。而我们本地就很多信誉极佳的建筑商，为什么要千里迢迢到外州邀请来如此质量的承建商？这块地就在本市著名高中Hamilton high school 旁边，周边的环境将直接的影响了这些还未正式步入社会的孩子们。这也是亚利桑那州亚裔和华裔居民最集中的地区。为什么选这个建筑商，为什么选这块地？当地居民对政府的用意非常疑惑。很多居民表示不欢迎这样的项目，也不允许这样的项目毁掉大家努力建设的美好社区。为了钱德勒的安宁，为了我们的孩子，请您加入联合抵制这个项目。下面这个链接是一份给市政府的请愿书，花费大家1分钟的时间签个名，每个家庭超过18岁的市民都可以分别签字。届时会反馈大家的签名和反对意见给市政府，寻求他们的帮助！让我们齐心协力，守护我们的家园。谢谢您的支持！请愿书链接
356a0f6c358db6da0d603e5a86b368c72378ff90.translatedText: A recent outside-Arizona developer teamed up with the Maricopa County Government to build a project in the heart of south Chandler (Arizona Ave/Ocotillo). nearby) to build more than 500 low-rent apartments that can accommodate more than 2,000 people. However, according to the city plan, this land is used for commercial development. Now it is hard to change it into a high-density residential area. This is an original plan for urban construction, which will cause huge pressure on local security, transportation, materials, and energy. What’s even more worrying is that this builder has extremely poor ratings. The communities they build in other states are known to be “dirty and messy”. But we have many local builders with excellent reputations. Why would we go all the way to invite such a high-quality contractor to this site in Hamilton, a famous high school in this city? high school Next to it, the surrounding environment will directly affect these children who have not officially entered society. This is also the area with the highest concentration of Asian and Chinese residents in Arizona. Why did they choose this builder and why did they choose this land? Many residents expressed that they do not welcome such a project and will not allow it to destroy the beautiful community that everyone has worked hard to build. Ning, for the sake of our children, please join the boycott of this project. The link below is a petition to the city government. It will take everyone 1 minute to sign it. Everyone in the family who is over 18 years old can sign it separately. We will then send your signatures and objections to the city government to ask for their help! Thank you for your support!

d9fdfae7da430534c5818a14134af093e2c3bd9a.translatedText: Tickets for the 2023 Alberta Spring Festival Gala & New Year’s Reception are on sale

af12cd8249c0261eb9ff1227f416b4c1bb24f780.sourceText: 为喜迎2023农历新年，由亚省艺术学院（Arizona Art Academy）,钱德勒市政府，美国华人联合会…
af12cd8249c0261eb9ff1227f416b4c1bb24f780.translatedText: In order to welcome the 2023 Lunar New Year, the Arizona Art Academy, the Chandler City Government, and the United Chinese Americans in America...

07c3931ba1a591d7c06bfb68bd15d7a8ef112166.sourceText: 为喜迎2023农历新年，由亚省艺术学院（Arizona Art Academy）,钱德勒市政府，美国华人联合会亚利桑那分会（UCA AZ）联合举办的亚省春晚和新年酒会将与1月15日晚上在Chandler Center for the Arts 隆重登场。
07c3931ba1a591d7c06bfb68bd15d7a8ef112166.translatedText: To welcome the 2023 Lunar New Year, the Arizona Art Academy (Arizona Art Academy), the Chandler City Government, the Arizona Chapter of the United Chinese Americans in America (UCA) AZ) will make its grand debut at the Chandler Center for the Arts on the evening of January 15th.

8f3637017ba65cdcf54334ee1237f0789b362fcd.sourceText: 新春伊始，辞旧迎新，对于每个华人来说都特别有意义，远在海外的我们守望相助，拼搏进取，也将继续秉持团结协作精神，促进多元文化的共同发展与繁荣。本场演出将由不同族裔艺术团体担纲，体现我们共建多元化、公平性和包容性（Diversity, Equity, Inclusion，简称DEI）未来的美好愿景。本届春晚还是一届感谢钱德勒市教育系统工作人员的公益活动，凡是在钱德勒教育系统工作的人员能在市政府领到免费的入场券，座位有限，先来先得！
8f3637017ba65cdcf54334ee1237f0789b362fcd.translatedText: At the beginning of the new year, it is particularly meaningful for every Chinese to bid farewell to the old and welcome the new. We, overseas, help each other and strive for progress. We will continue to uphold the spirit of unity and cooperation to promote the common development and prosperity of multiculturalism. This performance will be performed by art groups of different ethnic groups, reflecting our vision of building a future of diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI). This Spring Festival Gala is also a charity event to thank the staff of the Chandler City Education System. Anyone who works in the Chandler Education System can receive free admission tickets at the city government. Seats are limited, first come, first served!

c84a05815e6e48d1cf18db9e29753902800b08e8.sourceText: 届时中美朋友将共襄盛举，欢度中国传统春节。
c84a05815e6e48d1cf18db9e29753902800b08e8.translatedText: At that time, friends from China and the United States will participate in the grand event and celebrate the traditional Chinese Spring Festival.

eaae0a0337faa8259b58d33e8029a44f0101aa65.sourceText: 购票地点：Chandler Center for the Arts & Arizona Art Academy
eaae0a0337faa8259b58d33e8029a44f0101aa65.translatedText: Ticket purchase location: Chandler Center for the Arts & Arizona Art Academy

85080b3cb65c6327ab5856058ff98aff012f0957.translatedText: For event details, please contact Arizonaartacademy@gmail.com & 4802870180

31322de5c58b2e5f271637251ebf759ba6b1978d.sourceText: 不愿提起 、未敢忘记、 铭记历史、珍惜当下
31322de5c58b2e5f271637251ebf759ba6b1978d.translatedText: Do not want to mention, dare not forget, remember the history, cherish the present

d6fb3a8027751075b20a9adc7be2fbebf5a70599.sourceText: 凤凰城 陶臻 【本报讯】纪念凤凰城五周年的文章 《护城风云 永不忘怀》发表后，一石激起千层浪！打开了封存五年…
d6fb3a8027751075b20a9adc7be2fbebf5a70599.translatedText: Tao Zhen, Phoenix City [News from this newspaper] After the publication of the article "The Storm of Protecting the City, Never Forget" to commemorate the fifth anniversary of Phoenix City, it stirred up waves with one stone! Opened after being sealed for five years...

2866ec116a1049e3ad1c1a6fac9ad7ebc22d9f7a.sourceText: 【本报讯】纪念凤凰城五周年的文章 《护城风云 永不忘怀》发表后，一石激起千层浪！打开了封存五年的护城历史，把我们又带回了近千人的护城行动中，引起了强烈的震撼、共鸣，激发了许多长久憋在心里的真话。
2866ec116a1049e3ad1c1a6fac9ad7ebc22d9f7a.translatedText: [News from this newspaper] After the publication of the article "The Storm of Protecting the City, Never Forget" to commemorate the fifth anniversary of Phoenix City, it stirred up a thousand waves with one stone! It opened up the history of city defense that had been sealed for five years, and brought us back to the city defense actions of nearly a thousand people. It aroused strong shock and resonance, and inspired many truths that have been held in our hearts for a long time.

5b942951f9d213b9cf219c3b30af156bf609b1a8.sourceText: 其实，那场维权斗争早已铭刻在心灵深处，嘴里虽不说，心里早就有。因为那是震惊美国的历时最长，规模做大，涉及的面最广的华人维权斗争，它不会随着时光的流逝而淡忘，其影响力将会与时俱进，随着社会的发展和人们的民主、正义和维权觉悟和意识的提高，越来越显示出其伟大的历史和现实意义！我们凤凰城华人华侨做了一件创造历史的伟大事件！
5b942951f9d213b9cf219c3b30af156bf609b1a8.translatedText: In fact, the struggle for rights protection has long been engraved in the depths of the soul. Although it is not said in the mouth, it is already in the heart. Because it was the Chinese rights struggle that shocked the United States with the longest duration, the largest scale, and the widest coverage. It will not be forgotten with the passage of time. Its influence will keep pace with the times. With the development of society and the improvement of people's awareness and awareness of democracy, justice, and rights protection, it will increasingly show its great historical and practical significance! We, the overseas Chinese in Phoenix, have done a great event that created history!

c0fe2c04fcad6c14d58d8e496a365d132fe6cd4e.sourceText: 下面摘录微信中的一些感人话语（省去个人的名字和表情图像，顺序随意）:
c0fe2c04fcad6c14d58d8e496a365d132fe6cd4e.translatedText: The following are excerpts from some touching words in WeChat (omitting personal names and emoticons, the order is arbitrary):

b7164312cc72fcc374ae7987710189e6853d85d2.sourceText: 记得那天是我的生日呢。晚上在老四川朗诵了那首诗歌，许多朋友表演了节目。下午我们在议会抗议游行，结束后赶到老四川的。
b7164312cc72fcc374ae7987710189e6853d85d2.translatedText: I remember that day is my birthday. In the evening, the poem was recited in Old Sichuan, and many friends performed. In the afternoon we held a protest march on the parliament and rushed to Old Sichuan after it was over.

5244ca20d569c3150347566be7c0506a38c8945e.sourceText: 我们的护城战士有大爱无疆之心。关怀社会。是我学习的楷模！
5244ca20d569c3150347566be7c0506a38c8945e.translatedText: Our city guards have a heart of boundless love. Caring for the community. He is a role model for me to learn from!

f20a73f1aec07aa66298674a918c7d22fe7e4cac.sourceText: 非常感谢各位，保护凤凰城中国文化中心的经过，应该载入史册。
f20a73f1aec07aa66298674a918c7d22fe7e4cac.translatedText: Thank you very much. The process of protecting the Chinese Cultural Center in Phoenix should be recorded in history.

d0b7f8219d9c0442be1041f3fae3c0ce4dd18831.sourceText: 《美华史记》有在美国注册的网站，有微信网站，还有中英文双语出版的书，《美华史记》第一卷已在 Amazon 上架。我会把大作《护城风云永不忘怀》转发给他们。谢谢了。
d0b7f8219d9c0442be1041f3fae3c0ce4dd18831.translatedText: "American-Chinese Historical Records" has a website registered in the United States, a WeChat website, and a book published in both Chinese and English. The first volume of "American-Chinese Historical Records" has been put on Amazon. I will forward the masterpiece "The Storm of Protecting the City Will Never Be Forgotten" to them. Thank you.

143a0ab4b867ba8e7b159ebfc822fdefe8eaa596.sourceText: 凤凰城 “ 中国文化中心 “ 一直珍藏在心的深处, 相信这也是孩子们一生中最难忘的记忆, 无论他们走到哪, 文化常在。
143a0ab4b867ba8e7b159ebfc822fdefe8eaa596.translatedText: Phoenix City’s “Chinese Cultural Center” has always been treasured deep in my heart. I believe this is also the most unforgettable memory in the children’s lives. No matter where they go, culture will always be there.

a6b41b0ec338e4a2f74455aa291c1f7ad3d2b31f.sourceText: 护城以来，我们报社全力以赴，大造舆论，从社长到记者、编辑都一直奋战在新闻战线的第一线，发表大量的护城文章！
a6b41b0ec338e4a2f74455aa291c1f7ad3d2b31f.translatedText: Since the city was defended, our newspaper has gone all out to create public opinion. From the president to reporters and editors, they have been fighting on the front line of the news front and published a large number of articles to protect the city!

9139a3801d2b6d1c2b00972bc7e47506b93e5d5e.sourceText: 谢谢转发，忆往昔，不堪回首啊！我常常经过以前的文化中心，每次看到面目全非的旧址，心中都是无奈和愤怒。
9139a3801d2b6d1c2b00972bc7e47506b93e5d5e.translatedText: Thank you for forwarding, remembering the past, I can’t bear to look back! I often pass by the former cultural center, and every time I see the unrecognizable old site, I feel helpless and angry.

4d528a5de37da3ecb5c6bf5ac7941d4acadf0562.sourceText: 建城当初, 一大帮老侨，如余文劲老先生、老甑社长，不顾酷热，挨家挨户打电话募捐，挨家挨户上门收捐款。 92 岁高龄的余文劲老先生，他在高温下，自己开车到游行现场支持大家， …… 这份情怀不能遗忘，要永远记住！
4d528a5de37da3ecb5c6bf5ac7941d4acadf0562.translatedText: When the city was first founded, a large group of old overseas Chinese, such as Mr. Yu Wenjin and President Lao Zeng, regardless of the scorching heat, went door-to-door to collect donations and called them door-to-door. Mr. Yu Wenjin, 92 years old, drove himself to the parade to support everyone despite the high temperature... This feeling cannot be forgotten and should be remembered forever!

8e80145603ec0c982d52a5a40b05920f78a2b989.sourceText: 一年一度跟着护城周年纪念文章郑重缅怀过去
8e80145603ec0c982d52a5a40b05920f78a2b989.translatedText: Once a year, I solemnly remember the past with the article on the anniversary of the city defense

cddab6d58f375951ad26a796e5da3f9ea42e0987.sourceText: 謝謝你的分享，這事是我心中最遺憾的事！至今沒有勇氣去看那建築設計的如何了，嘆！
cddab6d58f375951ad26a796e5da3f9ea42e0987.translatedText: Thank you for sharing, this is the most regretful thing in my heart! I still don’t have the courage to look at the architectural design, sigh!

f526e09d6ed87c19e339a7a4c31a300dd51ad64d.sourceText: 感谢您的分享！尤其记得大家的无私奉献！都努力了那么久，遗憾还是没能保住。真的太可惜了！
f526e09d6ed87c19e339a7a4c31a300dd51ad64d.translatedText: Thank you for sharing! Especially remember everyone’s selfless dedication! After working hard for so long, it’s a pity that I still can’t save it. What a pity!

8659d6a97d8c8f17bba2703776f764bc80053666.sourceText: 拜读并保存了为保护凤凰城之中国城五周年的历史记录篇。当年凤城华人团结联手奋力护城的点点滴滴仍历历在目。
8659d6a97d8c8f17bba2703776f764bc80053666.translatedText: Read and save the historical record of the fifth anniversary of the protection of Chinatown in Phoenix. The Chinese people in Fengcheng united and worked hard to protect the city at that time are still vivid in my mind.

99bfd1a587639bebcfb5f164e6985a60d379d660.sourceText: 我们热爱的中国城虽然被拆除了，但是却永远屹立在我们的心中！永远不会忘记！
99bfd1a587639bebcfb5f164e6985a60d379d660.translatedText: Although the Chinatown we loved has been demolished, it will always stand in our hearts! Never forget!

e263b1dbfeab6f117bf57b740aa59eaa4c5d64c5.sourceText: 深深感谢前辈们，为保护中国城付出了这么多，令人感动！你们的正直、正义和对中华文化的爱护和热爱，这种高尚情怀值得我们学习！深深地敬佩！
e263b1dbfeab6f117bf57b740aa59eaa4c5d64c5.translatedText: I deeply appreciate the seniors who have sacrificed so much to protect Chinatown, which is touching! Your integrity, justice and love for Chinese culture are worth learning from us! Deeply admire!

0c4cd5e319a945d365370226f93bcd743a23bd75.sourceText: 作为记者，有幸见证和跟踪报道中国文化城的活动，深感荣幸和责任。
0c4cd5e319a945d365370226f93bcd743a23bd75.translatedText: As a reporter, I have the honor to witness and follow up on the activities of China Cultural City. I feel deeply honored and responsible.

2b84df534cabacbac8b42e130cd6b65a9f863ab0.sourceText: 历史协会在这次护城运动中，曾把保留了廿年的中国城视频上传，并把大量相关的文章和相片配合当时的时势发表，今后也会继续这样做。
2b84df534cabacbac8b42e130cd6b65a9f863ab0.translatedText: During this city defense movement, the Historical Association uploaded a video of Chinatown that had been preserved for 20 years, and published a large number of related articles and photos in line with the current situation at that time, and will continue to do so in the future.

f70b859a7cf34f18f87714aa19f15d4cb6623929.sourceText: 翻开亚利桑那州华人的维权历史，保护中国文化城的维权斗争，无论从规模，历时的时间，还是维权的深度，应该是最重大的华人维权事件，应该大书特书。 “ 古为今用 “ ，离当今越近，越应当引起关注，更受到华人维权人士的关心、研究，出书立卷，因为总结历史就是为了今天的维权斗争。谢谢历史学会的关注！
f70b859a7cf34f18f87714aa19f15d4cb6623929.translatedText: Looking back at the history of Chinese rights protection in Arizona, the rights protection struggle to protect China Cultural City should be the most significant Chinese rights protection event in terms of scale, duration, and depth of rights protection, and should be written down in a special book. "The past serves the present", the closer it is to today, the more it should attract attention, and it will be more concerned, studied and published by Chinese rights defenders, because summarizing history is for today's rights protection struggle. Thank you to the Historical Society for your interest!

7bfc7db8a887038e27e0f6abf2aec95246e8ad10.sourceText: 真佩服！尤其文章中洋溢着的浩然正气，激荡人心。也是作者胸怀的写照。
7bfc7db8a887038e27e0f6abf2aec95246e8ad10.translatedText: >I really admire it! In particular, the awe-inspiring righteousness permeated in the article stirred people's hearts. It is also a reflection of the author's mind.

1df8f53f8afddc86236c52f7799359c37c346143.translatedText: Thank you for the historical moment.

f04eb5519304ecdc022025731d8adf174a47d9fd.sourceText: 是啊，多么感人的肺腑之言，多么自然亲切的真实情感，多么引人深思的富有哲理的金文名句！
f04eb5519304ecdc022025731d8adf174a47d9fd.translatedText: Yes, what a touching heartfelt words, what a natural and kind true emotion, what a thought-provoking and philosophical golden inscription!

738af4d0c51b96825e7ddbb7b5ffa6a8dcb00943.sourceText: 最近微信中有买彩票的热议，如果中了奖，首先建文化城。这是我们护城战士不约而同的共同答案，是我们护城人的最大心愿！古话说的好：“衙门大门朝南开，有理没钱莫进来”。发奋图强吧，朋友，发展我们华人的事业，挣多多的钱，有钱就好办事了！您说对吗？
738af4d0c51b96825e7ddbb7b5ffa6a8dcb00943.translatedText: Recently there has been a heated discussion on WeChat about buying lottery tickets. If you win the prize, build a cultural city first. This is the common answer of our city guards, and it is our greatest wish! As the old saying goes: "The gate of the Yamen opens to the south. If you have reason but no money, don't come in." Let's work hard, friends, develop our Chinese careers and earn a lot of money. It will be easier to do things if we have money! Are you right?

f2688d6ee52002e2bf7bf8f1abc465bfa15e0df6.sourceText: 护城风云 永不忘怀
f2688d6ee52002e2bf7bf8f1abc465bfa15e0df6.translatedText: Protect the city and never forget it

0fee9ce71783fae3accb3e04bfe6caa855112ee3.translatedText: There is a city in the Phoenix Mountains,

e00c01895059d1cb66c2d623f8bbf876e40f36da.translatedText: offers love and affection to protect her,

1b9cd6fbe69ac303632659ee642d8496b8592274.translatedText: just because the ancestors live in the city,

59a8fe0bf911e68750076687448e8f58dd15490f.sourceText: 神圣神灵我爱她！那知妖魔鬼风吹，
59a8fe0bf911e68750076687448e8f58dd15490f.translatedText: the holy spirit, I love her! Who would have thought that when the wind blows, the treasure in

85a909fe16d996a5063faa17541cdda7c83c4084.translatedText: 's resentment and resentment rises to the sky, and

7bc9d227752b95bb37d0e9db4255c6c005e07e07.sourceText: 护城风云痛心里！多少次的追寻，
7bc9d227752b95bb37d0e9db4255c6c005e07e07.translatedText: 's heart aches in the storm of protecting the city! How many times have I pursued,

c2a3ee699994b1c46bf84b93f462547b274bb32c.translatedText: how many times have I inquired,

9901e047b7452e98cbc66aa799a0a3edc38503ec.translatedText: > have I thought so many times,

d830ced3e4c647ded74f823d3677646e7a7e2243.sourceText: 多少次的梦盼。美丽的中国城总在心中萦绕，
d830ced3e4c647ded74f823d3677646e7a7e2243.translatedText: > have I dreamed of it so many times. The beautiful Chinatown always lingers in my heart,

cdc53502c3091a22be8b73712c331a2037302f7a.sourceText: 美丽的中国文化中心总是深情的牵挂，
cdc53502c3091a22be8b73712c331a2037302f7a.translatedText: The beautiful China Cultural Center is always deeply concerned,

258481e6f44eefba0dc06baa9cb09a9d9900f95d.sourceText: 一雕塑一古词是民族的情结，
258481e6f44eefba0dc06baa9cb09a9d9900f95d.translatedText: A sculpture and an ancient word are the national complex,

fc54680a433ffe1ad60bc6e16fc3b0355785b7ec.sourceText: 搂堂亭阁琉璃瓦是乡愁的依托，硝烟弥漫是真正的战场，
fc54680a433ffe1ad60bc6e16fc3b0355785b7ec.translatedText: The glazed tiles of the pavilions and pavilions are the hometown. The support of sorrow and the smoke of gunfire are the real battlefield.

5069b00a9887851e3419d1d6d0fc2954e279c404.sourceText: 不屈不饶的是战斗的精神，
5069b00a9887851e3419d1d6d0fc2954e279c404.translatedText: The unyielding spirit is the spirit of fighting.

0901936d9ec5e36c5f4df35350857cd37795cd78.sourceText: 捐款捐物是纯洁的心灵，
0901936d9ec5e36c5f4df35350857cd37795cd78.translatedText: Donating money and materials is the purity of the heart.

0b1fd98056c9ba49d79cc92313a6948a9f2d2336.sourceText: 全心地投入是游子的拳拳情怀！那是那年最大的事情，
0b1fd98056c9ba49d79cc92313a6948a9f2d2336.translatedText: Devoting yourself wholeheartedly is the feeling of a wanderer! That was the biggest thing that year,

726bd5e6bec2a07f823cd14a58229bd930561c80.translatedText: that was the most investment that year,

ff8fa6021d11dd0c521d0087f123fa913179730f.translatedText: that was the deepest heartache that year,

df76f4173cc26f6e5158e8145361db0d7fdc7070.sourceText: 那是那年最好的期盼！黑云压城城欲摧，
df76f4173cc26f6e5158e8145361db0d7fdc7070.translatedText: that was the best expectation that year! Dark clouds are threatening to destroy the city,

9286323dd1675a0c8c71a51b3f93c097db0ade9c.translatedText: the precious city is destroyed and the heart is broken.

034c4ed6bab6e9a3985d2e17a401667be2be7c4a.translatedText: It's not that the wanderer has an unfilial heart,

da8de583523d09b8dcfa73f96c26983af12a29db.sourceText: 只是世道混浊力不到。年深外境犹吾境，
da8de583523d09b8dcfa73f96c26983af12a29db.translatedText: it's just that the world is turbid and he can't help it. Years later, the foreign land is still like my own.

bc766579c155f1b42771f254ed758268007189fc.translatedText: For a long time, the foreign land is my hometown.

57740c488d59256c1ba2f7c4cabf540e0330e8a5.translatedText: I miss the foreign land so much that it feels like my hometown.

3463283dfee6679f17329d508925de3387bd9eb7.sourceText: 神明祖先进咱家。多少次走过那心爱的地，
3463283dfee6679f17329d508925de3387bd9eb7.translatedText: The gods and ancestors come into our home. How many times have I walked through that beloved place?

55107b39f34c94ba6ba70ebcad690dd7cac7c588.translatedText: I want to see it but I can’t open my eyes.

f9ba5b0b8307e32652b69be6a81e52cae7cc6201.translatedText: It’s so miserable that the characters have changed.

77905ea82bb0b78e0e9f88ab096790bbbb9ee5b0.sourceText: 只有孤云浮动天如故。五年心酸五年的泪，
77905ea82bb0b78e0e9f88ab096790bbbb9ee5b0.translatedText: Only the lonely clouds are floating in the sky. Five years of heartache, five years of tears,

ddd1a5e3109308571ac30899d26ff3e03f11f892.translatedText: five years of looking back on five years of love,

079be5ad8cc9744f7f88f25b88f5994e204112c5.translatedText: rebuilding the treasure city with brilliance!

84a6eb4b37eae41c7f2fc6f19edefd484eadf5ac.translatedText: There is a god in the heart and a god in the throne,

572c267e06fbbc3e735bedf865fcb065a83b54d2.translatedText: bless the descendants with long-lasting happiness and honor,

63d3e8ec6b52b698dc2fad28935817e5f15aa565.sourceText: 2004年，沙漠玉华人妇女会完成了第二集《莲蓬》。这集《莲蓬》的封面由荷叶、莲花和莲蓬组成。荷叶制造养分，莲花香远益清，莲蓬果实累累。在“莲蓬“名称的旁边圈有一个“玉”字。
63d3e8ec6b52b698dc2fad28935817e5f15aa565.translatedText: In 2004, the Desert Jade Chinese Women's Association completed the second episode of "Lotus Powder". The cover of this episode "Lotus pods" consists of lotus leaves, lotus flowers and lotus pods. Lotus leaves produce nutrients, lotus flowers are fragrant and clear, and lotus pods are full of fruits. There is a word "jade" circled next to the name "Lotus Peng".

0dafd5e9791e9fa99fd76ee70aed45ec8a959a40.sourceText: 比起之前的初来报到，此时更能体会到华人女性的坚毅不拨，她们通过自身的努力得到了成果，她们的家庭得到发展，社会地位有了提高，她们的眼光和胸怀更宽广，所以“莲蓬”的内容便扩充到了更多的层面。
0dafd5e9791e9fa99fd76ee70aed45ec8a959a40.translatedText: Compared with the previous registration, I can now appreciate the perseverance of Chinese women more. They have achieved results through their own efforts, their families have developed, their social status has improved, their vision and mind are broader, so the content of "Lotus Powder" has been expanded to more levels.

bbe4634c726e81295b764b5fc9ff90cdf8c55036.sourceText: 这本书的主题包括了社区团体，种族和民族，社会与文化等等，努力推广中国家庭习俗和传统文化，《莲蓬》把华人故事传播到主流社会，也增加华裔对自身历史的了解。
bbe4634c726e81295b764b5fc9ff90cdf8c55036.translatedText: The themes of this book include community groups, race and ethnicity, society and culture, etc., and strive to promote Chinese family customs and traditional culture. "Lotus Powder" spreads Chinese stories to mainstream society, and also increases Chinese people's understanding of their own history.

1176c98a78c4c67625f369771d659aa9a3a8ebcd.sourceText: “Desert Jade Woman’s Club” 早期由亚利桑那州凤凰城亚裔女性组成的社会群体。1960 年该俱乐部成为亚利桑那州妇女俱乐部联合会（AFJWC ）和妇女俱乐部总联合会 (GFWC) 的一部分。 1970 年 ，俱乐部取消新会员 35 岁的年龄限制，并向所有年龄段开放会员资格，增加了不少的成员。
1176c98a78c4c67625f369771d659aa9a3a8ebcd.translatedText: “Desert Jade Woman’s Club” An early social group composed of Asian women in Phoenix, Arizona. In 1960 the club became part of the Arizona Federation of Women's Clubs (AFJWC) and the General Federation of Women's Clubs (GFWC). In 1970, the club removed the 35-year-old age limit for new members and opened membership to all ages, adding many members.

316f5650c8e065f600c36cb89df0f8e2b9f48659.sourceText: 1974年，沙漠翡翠女子俱乐部的华裔加入凤凰城侨联总会，团体的中文名称改为“沙漠玉华人妇女会“，但她们仍属于GFWC總部的一部分。此时俱乐部更注重华裔下一代的成长，也更愿意回馈社会和贡献华人社区。
316f5650c8e065f600c36cb89df0f8e2b9f48659.translatedText: In 1974, the Chinese members of the Desert Jade Women's Club joined the Phoenix Overseas Chinese Federation. The Chinese name of the group was changed to "Desert Jade Chinese Women's Association", but they were still part of the GFWC headquarters. At this time, the club pays more attention to the growth of the next generation of Chinese Americans, and is more willing to give back to society and contribute to the Chinese community.

547b8daafc76087b0ad384a0d05a8b2a3b0d4d02.sourceText: 1976年，《莲蓬》创刊， 2004年完成第二集，将美籍华人文化历史和信息汇编成册出版，传授给年轻一代。其出售所得已用于教育奖学金。
547b8daafc76087b0ad384a0d05a8b2a3b0d4d02.translatedText: In 1976, "Lotus Patch" was first published, and the second volume was completed in 2004. It compiled and published Chinese-American culture, history and information in a book, and taught it to the younger generation. Proceeds from its sale have been used for educational scholarships.

f35c23b2f8bfad6bcd2f6966839810b664459c29.sourceText: 1978年3月，沙漠玉华人妇女会参加了由城市主办的 “您好，凤凰城”，在市中心广场举行活动。这个全市范围的项目侧重于以种族为导向的表演艺术项目。
f35c23b2f8bfad6bcd2f6966839810b664459c29.translatedText: In March 1978, the Desert Jade Chinese Women's Association participated in the "Hello, Phoenix" event hosted by the city and held an event in the city center square. This citywide program focuses on racially oriented performing arts programming.

c6fac17a23ebd4cb2b761fb36a1d1c7db3da7168.sourceText: 沙漠玉华人妇女会的许多慈善和公民项目，包括向当地各个消防部门、退伍军人团体、社区、服务和家庭组织捐赠时间、金钱和精力。
c6fac17a23ebd4cb2b761fb36a1d1c7db3da7168.translatedText: Desert Jade Chinese Women's Association's many charitable and civic projects include donating time, money and energy to various local fire departments, veterans groups, community, service and family organizations.

c2ff918b49aebdde6f33faecb285695e457c9cd8.sourceText: 1992年起，沙漠玉华人妇女会每年颁发奖学金给优秀的华裔学生，到1995年人数增至6名，每位的奖学金高达500元。 1995年与1996年，她们把募集到的资金46,000元捐助给凤凰城艺术博物馆的亚洲画廊，也捐款到圣文森特德保罗的免费医疗和牙科诊所。1998年，沙漠玉华人妇女会捐助了五千元，用于华人耆英中心的扩建工程。
c2ff918b49aebdde6f33faecb285695e457c9cd8.translatedText: Since 1992, the Desert Jade Chinese Women's Association has awarded scholarships to outstanding Chinese students every year. By 1995, the number increased to 6, with each scholarship worth up to 500 yuan. In 1995 and 1996, they donated $46,000 of the funds raised to the Asian Gallery of the Phoenix Art Museum and to the free medical and dental clinic at St. Vincent de Paul. In 1998, the Desert Jade Chinese Women's Association donated 5,000 yuan for the expansion project of the Chinese Senior Citizens Center.

29b51b9cacb9c47a12053dd23e1cd3cd225f5616.sourceText: 沙漠玉华人妇女会对凤凰城艺术博物馆捐赠超过$34,000，成为一个非常着名的赞助者，在当年所有的媒体和广告都打印Desert Jade Woman’s Club的名字，她们在2000-2002年间获得了GFWC总部的奖项。
29b51b9cacb9c47a12053dd23e1cd3cd225f5616.translatedText: The Desert Jade Chinese Women’s Club donated more than $34,000 to the Phoenix Art Museum and became a very famous sponsor. In that year, all media and advertisements printed the name of the Desert Jade Woman’s Club. They received awards from the GFWC headquarters from 2000 to 2002.

f0cbb942d010dd2b4e2701034df826521dcd0fa8.sourceText: 2003年期间，她们捐资超过一万元及超过300本图书捐赠给Brunson Lee小学。2004年，建立亚洲Gallery艺术之友捐赠基金，又在5年的时间内向凤凰城艺术博物馆捐款超过25,000美元。
f0cbb942d010dd2b4e2701034df826521dcd0fa8.translatedText: During 2003, they donated more than NT$10,000 and more than 300 books to Brunson Lee Primary School. In 2004, the Friends of Asia Gallery Art Endowment Fund was established and donated more than US$25,000 to the Phoenix Art Museum within 5 years.

af9db0f32b750f3427e108ce6076d409c56cf10e.sourceText: 2005年，沙漠玉华人妇女会捐款千元，向家暴受害者在民事法庭提供免费法律援助。另外，援助八个8年级学生就读高中。 2006年，有罪犯入侵成员的家并造成人身伤害。沙漠玉华人妇女会向捕获犯罪的沉默证人基金提供了捐赠。
af9db0f32b750f3427e108ce6076d409c56cf10e.translatedText: In 2005, the Desert Jade Chinese Women's Association donated 1,000 yuan to provide free legal aid to victims of domestic violence in civil courts. In addition, eight 8th grade students are assisted to attend high school. In 2006, criminals invaded members' homes and caused physical harm. The Desert Jade Chinese Women's Association made a donation to the Silent Witness Fund to Catch Crimes.

3138fadc9f02eed2512f436158be11572e6dcbc6.sourceText: 多年来，沙漠玉华人妇女会支持保存历史文物和老建筑，如拯救菲尼克斯太阳队的商业大厦，旧唐人街遗物等。还对中国文化夏令营、总统的电基金进行了捐赠。
3138fadc9f02eed2512f436158be11572e6dcbc6.translatedText: Over the years, the Desert Jade Chinese Women's Association has supported the preservation of historical relics and old buildings, such as saving the Phoenix Suns commercial building, relics of old Chinatown, etc. Donations were also made to the Chinese Cultural Summer Camp and the President’s Electricity Fund.

7f5530c5934723aeea3844a648ab9ed708b4aaa9.sourceText: 每年，俱乐部成员都会制作和设计一本相册，其中包括照片、信件和当年活动的信息，因此也保留了历史。
7f5530c5934723aeea3844a648ab9ed708b4aaa9.translatedText: Every year, club members create and design a photo album that includes photos, letters and information about the year's events, thus also preserving history.

8ef75f66259fe5ddc0ecaccba42e3bf12a7b06bf.sourceText: Desert Jade Woman’s Club成立至今已经超过60年，做了不少的好事和善事，在主流社会和华人社区中树立了妇女的优秀形象。2010年，她们留下了一张成立50周年的大合照。沙漠翡翠，历世流芳。
8ef75f66259fe5ddc0ecaccba42e3bf12a7b06bf.translatedText: Desert Jade Woman’s Club has been established for more than 60 years. It has done a lot of good deeds and established an excellent image of women in mainstream society and the Chinese community. In 2010, they left a group photo for the 50th anniversary of their establishment. Desert emerald has been famous for generations.

51ceb326428d9d738165253d622c9bb7d1c09848.sourceText: 盛夏七月，2021-2022年度国际桃李杯舞蹈大赛全球总决赛完美收官。亚省艺术学院四支独舞与一支群舞在决赛中凯旋而归，分别获得了评委特别奖、十佳铂金奖及铂金奖。此外，组委会还授予了本校邱晓榕老师桃李满园奖，感谢其为传播舞蹈文化做出的贡献。
51ceb326428d9d738165253d622c9bb7d1c09848.translatedText: In mid-summer July, the global finals of the 2021-2022 International Taoli Cup Dance Competition came to a perfect conclusion. Four solo dances and one group dance from the Art Institute of Alberta returned triumphantly in the finals and won the Special Judges Award, the Top Ten Platinum Award and the Platinum Award respectively. In addition, the organizing committee also awarded teacher Qiu Xiaorong of our school the Taoli Manyuan Award for his contribution to the spread of dance culture.

14bed9c7edeb897568be4d22c4aec01b610d3bcb.sourceText: 本年度国桃杯采用线上线下比赛同步模式进行，来自北美洲、亚洲和欧洲的选手们共同参与了本次舞蹈盛会。能够经过冬季、春季、夏季的层层选拔晋级年度决赛的，都是很有水准的舞蹈，激烈竞争之下，亚省艺术学院的群舞《且吟春雨》、Sabrina Zhao 的《梦想霓裳》Sevrina Bunch的《大漠红柳》获得了铂金奖。Jenna Ko以当代舞《唯一》获得了十佳铂金奖、评委特别奖，同时获得儿童高阶组第一名及当代舞舞种第一名。她的古典舞《红玉丹心》获得了铂金奖及儿童进阶组第一名。两支舞蹈在总决赛中共获得六个奖项。舞者们这累累硕果的背后，是暑期集训时挥洒的汗水，是苦练基本功时的坚韧，也是热爱舞蹈并甘之如饴的拼搏精神的体现。
14bed9c7edeb897568be4d22c4aec01b610d3bcb.translatedText: This year's National Peach Cup adopts a simultaneous online and offline competition mode. Players from North America, Asia and Europe participated in this dance event. Those who can advance to the annual finals through the selection process in winter, spring and summer are all dances of a very high standard. Under fierce competition, the group dance "Singing the Spring Rain" by the Alberta College of Art, Sabrina Zhao's "Dream Clothes" and Sevrina Bunch's "Desert Red Willow" won the platinum award. Jenna Ko won the Top Ten Platinum Award and the Judges' Special Award for her contemporary dance "Only". She also won first place in the children's advanced category and first place in the contemporary dance category. Her classical dance "Ruby Heart" won the Platinum Award and first place in the children's advanced category. The two dances won a total of six awards in the finals. Behind the numerous achievements of the dancers is the sweat they shed during summer training, the tenacity when practicing basic skills, and the embodiment of the fighting spirit of loving dance and enjoying it.

1f2efd249ba1d99c2c239df9695ec9205e5bf563.sourceText: 国桃总召集人潘琪儿老师如是评价此活动——“看似轻歌曼舞的一个文娱活动，却意义非凡。它体现了海内外华人的精神面貌及舞蹈人对自己的热爱的事所付出的不懈努力。”
1f2efd249ba1d99c2c239df9695ec9205e5bf563.translatedText: > Mr. Pan Qier, the general convener of Guotao, commented on this event - "It seems to be an entertainment activity with light singing and dancing, but it is of extraordinary significance. It reflects the domestic The spirit of foreign Chinese and the unremitting efforts of dancers towards their passion.”

3a72063edca85ff0d7d76684f51ed22d57e50e8d.sourceText: 西海岸加州传来桃李杯捷报，东海岸的佛州传来了我校舞者Audrey Zhang的好消息。她在奥兰多举办的Starpower 全国比赛中，荣获初级组小组第一和15-19岁初级组总分第二，并获得$1000奖学金。在Showstopper 全国比赛中，她挑战高级组，获得小组第一和15-19高级组总分第五，并获得了double platinum 1st place。她不但在舞台上绽放了自己的光芒，更是将中华舞蹈的魅力展现给了各族裔的观众。让我们祝贺获奖舞者，并为这些文化使者们喝彩！
3a72063edca85ff0d7d76684f51ed22d57e50e8d.translatedText: The success of the Taoli Cup came from California on the west coast, and the news of our school’s dancer Audrey came from Florida on the east coast. Good news for Zhang. She won first place in the junior category and second overall in the 15-19-year-old junior category at the Starpower National Competition in Orlando, and received a $1,000 scholarship. In the Showstopper national competition, she challenged the senior group and won the first place in the group and the fifth overall score in the 15-19 senior group, and won the double platinum 1st place. Not only did she shine on the stage, she also showed the charm of Chinese dance to audiences of all ethnic groups. Let us congratulate the winning dancers and applaud these cultural ambassadors!

2a08fe3b21fed1c9a2793a4c886f222f91ef0f0a.sourceText: 亚利桑那州财政部长余艳芬（Yimberly Yee）周一宣布，她将竞选2022年的州长，在第二任期结束后，跳入共和党初选，接替道格·杜西（Doug Ducey）。
2a08fe3b21fed1c9a2793a4c886f222f91ef0f0a.translatedText: Arizona Treasurer Yimberly Yee announced on Monday that she will run for governor in 2022, jumping into the Republican primary to succeed Doug Ducey after her second term ends.

2ab6d99d47a67217320fc0fa3420e13a255c46f9.sourceText: Yee是首位参加比赛的著名共和党人，她试图发挥自己的保守派资历，在周一上午发布的一段短视频中着重介绍边境问题并支持前总统唐纳德·特朗普。另一位共和党候选人周一晚参加了比赛。
2ab6d99d47a67217320fc0fa3420e13a255c46f9.translatedText: Yee, the first prominent Republican to enter the race, sought to leverage her conservative credentials by highlighting border issues and endorsing former President Donald Trump in a short video posted Monday morning. Another Republican candidate entered the race Monday night.

a4bd63b2b5366d675b640883e4cd06774aa4c35c.sourceText: Yee表示：“我正在竞选州长，将亚利桑那州放在首位，以确保我们的孩子与家人在这里所享有的相同的机会和自由，这首先要确保我们的南部边界安全。”
a4bd63b2b5366d675b640883e4cd06774aa4c35c.translatedText: Yee said: "I am running for governor to put Arizona first to ensure that our children have the same opportunities and freedoms that their families enjoy here, and that starts with securing our southern border."

d1617a47527bafa854b9fc6c54b74274a8ca7da0.sourceText: 公告明确表明，她打算对特朗普的支持成为她向共和党主要选民呼吁的关键部分。她在2016年共和党全国代表大会上发表讲话，并于2020年曾担任特朗普亚太裔美国人国家联席主席以及特朗普总统顾问委员会成员
d1617a47527bafa854b9fc6c54b74274a8ca7da0.translatedText: The announcement made clear that she intends her support of Trump to be a key part of her appeal to Republican primary voters. She spoke at the 2016 Republican National Convention and in 2020 served as Trump Asian Pacific American National Co-Chair and as a member of President Trump’s Advisory Council

7532a4600ac1875e198575922b8ee7deb72823c1.sourceText: 亚利桑那州州财政部长余艳芬（Kimberly Yee）在2020年8月24日在凤凰城举行的MAGA聚会志愿者活动的RNC观察晚会上发表讲话。
7532a4600ac1875e198575922b8ee7deb72823c1.translatedText: Arizona State Treasurer Kimberly Yee speaks at the RNC Watch Gala at the MAGA Gathering Volunteer Event in Phoenix on August 24, 2020.

da82d4af18d2d22f032ea2a0aa9a73bd6cb74851.sourceText: 在2018年，是第一个赢得亚利桑那州州政府重要职位的亚裔美国人。她曾担任州参议员，代表西山谷20区，并于2017年至2019年担任多数党领袖。
da82d4af18d2d22f032ea2a0aa9a73bd6cb74851.translatedText: In 2018, was the first Asian American to win an important position in Arizona state government. She served as a state senator representing West Valley District 20 and served as majority leader from 2017 to 2019.

4da11b1aa47fa31ee72d6a7739c3286e7695af40.sourceText: 在2018年财务大赛的辩论中，Yee说她反对提高税收，但她说她希望该州对税收进行审查并寻找改善程序的方法。
4da11b1aa47fa31ee72d6a7739c3286e7695af40.translatedText: During the 2018 Finance Contest debate, Yee said she opposed raising taxes, but said she wanted the state to review them and look for ways to improve the process.

45b429cf7e6b019eac8759ccf20d5533777e0f13.sourceText: 她在辩论中说：“我认为，从整体上了解我们州税制的概况非常重要，” “即使他们如何报税。作为小型企业主，让我们变得更容易。”
45b429cf7e6b019eac8759ccf20d5533777e0f13.translatedText: "I think it's really important to understand the big picture of our state's tax system as a whole," she said during the debate. "Even how they file their taxes. Makes it easier for us as small business owners."

2ecae9037f5d809adfcb0c8e9be38667edab551d.sourceText: Yee之前曾在州立立法机关和司库工作。
2ecae9037f5d809adfcb0c8e9be38667edab551d.translatedText: Yee previously worked in the state Legislature and as treasurer.

07a7d6104e176848f5404b24bbd0950b67ca05dd.sourceText: 在涉足亚利桑那州政治之前，她曾担任加利福尼亚州州长阿诺德·施瓦辛格（Arnold Schwarzenegger）的内阁副秘书和加利福尼亚州州长皮特·威尔逊（Pete Wilson）的政策分析师。现在，她与丈夫在西谷经营牙科诊所。Yee在亚利桑那州出生和长大，拥有Pepperdine大学和亚利桑那州立大学的学位。余艳芬有两个孩子。
07a7d6104e176848f5404b24bbd0950b67ca05dd.translatedText: Before getting involved in Arizona politics, she served as deputy cabinet secretary to California Governor Arnold Schwarzenegger and policy analyst to California Governor Pete Wilson. She now runs a dental practice with her husband in the West Valley. Yee was born and raised in Arizona and holds degrees from Pepperdine University and Arizona State University. Yu Yanfen has two children.

89a486649d39ab1be5ee28850a7ebf60acff3f06.sourceText: U.S.News4月27日公布了2021年最佳高中排行榜，对全美17,800多所公立高中进行了排名，衡量了学校为来自不同社会和经济背景的学生提供服务的情况。
89a486649d39ab1be5ee28850a7ebf60acff3f06.translatedText: U.S. News announced the 2021 Best High Schools rankings on April 27, ranking more than 17,800 public high schools in the United States and measuring how well schools serve students from different social and economic backgrounds.

255a2289657f6fad2f93b1c0f099debbef687625.sourceText: 弗吉尼亚州的Thomas Jefferson High School for Science and Technology在全国最佳高中排名中位列第一，也位列magnet school之列。亚利桑那州的BASIS Chandler在特许学校排行榜上名列前茅，新泽西州的High Technology高中是排名第一的STEM学校。全美排名前十的学校代表了10个不同的州，这表明美国各地都有高质量的公立高中。
255a2289657f6fad2f93b1c0f099debbef687625.translatedText: Thomas Jefferson High School for Science and Technology in Virginia ranks first among the best high schools in the country and is also among the magnet schools. Arizona's BASIS Chandler tops the charter school rankings, and New Jersey's High Technology High School is the No. 1 STEM school. The top 10 schools nationwide represent 10 different states, demonstrating that there are high-quality public high schools across the United States.

a13b9e742c5d1cefc219e9328e856f6229f32c07.sourceText: 在所有排名靠前的学校中，35.3%在农村或偏远地区，24.6%在城市。在排名前5%的学校中，7.2%在农村或偏远地区，42.3%在城市。
a13b9e742c5d1cefc219e9328e856f6229f32c07.translatedText: Of all top-ranked schools, 35.3% are in rural or remote areas and 24.6% are in cities. Among the top 5% of schools, 7.2% are in rural or remote areas and 42.3% are in cities.

20079d1eafbc440b74a9583e116ae138cc332cd2.sourceText: 该评选方法着重于六个因素：大学准备，阅读和数学能力，阅读和数学表现，表现欠佳学生比率，大学课程宽度和毕业率。大学入学准备度具体衡量的是高等教育和国际学士学位考试的参与度和表现。本版中使用的数据来自2018-2019学年，因此未受到COVID-19大流行的影响。
20079d1eafbc440b74a9583e116ae138cc332cd2.translatedText: The selection methodology focuses on six factors: college readiness, reading and math proficiency, reading and math performance, rate of underperforming students, college course breadth and graduation rate. College readiness specifically measures participation in and performance on higher education and International Baccalaureate exams. The data used in this edition are from the 2018-2019 school year and therefore have not been affected by the COVID-19 pandemic.

7480e00dff80eb6320319bee4625339c82517885.sourceText: 而在此次排名取得骄人成绩的BASIS学校是由亚利桑那本土教育家Michael和Olga Block夫妇于1998年在图森创立，其目标是教育学生具有国际竞争力的水平。发展至今共有29所，其中22所位于亚利桑那州，一所位于路易斯安那州，三所位于德克萨斯州，一所位于华盛顿特区，一所位于纽约。
7480e00dff80eb6320319bee4625339c82517885.translatedText: The BASIS school that achieved impressive results in this ranking was founded in Tucson in 1998 by native Arizona educators Michael and Olga Block. Its goal is to educate students to an internationally competitive level. There are currently 29 schools in total, 22 of which are located in Arizona, one in Louisiana, three in Texas, one in Washington, D.C., and one in New York.

cb4e2f782b341f4a04362c9654de404aa1a2378e.sourceText: 2003年开办的BASIS Scottsdale曾连续多年雄霸全美最佳高中第一名，近年因主办方改变评选方面而落后，今年全国总排名38，特许学校排名第5。今年全国排名最前的是BASIS Chandler，全国总排名第8，全国特许学校排名第1。
cb4e2f782b341f4a04362c9654de404aa1a2378e.translatedText: BASIS Scottsdale, opened in 2003, has been ranked first among the best high schools in the United States for many years. In recent years, it has fallen behind due to changes in the selection process by the organizers. This year, it ranks 38th in the country overall and 5th among charter schools. At the top of the national rankings this year is BASIS Chandler, ranked No. 8 nationally overall and No. 1 charter school nationally.

5965b2c4846175d4069d7389ceafb63f5b171bf7.sourceText: 2021“亚省春晚”网络版将于2月6日晚7点在Zoom和Youtube同时向全世界直播。 它是由亚省艺术学院主办，美中文化教育基金会，亚省华人华侨联合会，现代中文学校，希望中文学校，中华乐团，Tarwater Elementary School，Coronado Elementary School，亚省时报，亚美报，凤凰导报， 太阳鸟亚利桑那华人网共同协办的春节文艺盛宴，并长期受到富国银行，Arizona’s Vision ，杨桐医生，王楠医生，利利超级市场，徐国富保险服务的赞助。他们共同为华人文化在海外的传播起到了重要作用。
5965b2c4846175d4069d7389ceafb63f5b171bf7.translatedText: >The 2021 "Alberta Spring Festival Gala" online version will be broadcast live to the world on Zoom and Youtube at 7 pm on February 6. It is a Spring Festival literary feast co-organized by the Art Institute of Alberta, the US-China Cultural Education Foundation, the Overseas Chinese Federation of Alberta, Modern Chinese School, Hope Chinese School, Chinese Orchestra, Tarwater Elementary School, Coronado Elementary School, the Alberta Times, Asian American News, Phoenix Herald, Sunbird Arizona Chinese Network, and has been sponsored by Wells Fargo Bank, Arizona’s Vision, Dr. Yang Tong, Dr. Wang Nan, Lili Supermarket, and Xu Guofu Insurance Services for a long time. Together, they played an important role in the spread of Chinese culture overseas.

cf1bc4db52813dbfbf3f45ed0931a53fe9ec7356.sourceText: 本次春晚由近两百个华人家庭参与表演，就开场舞一个舞蹈近上百的中美小朋友共同表演，瞬间点燃现场的热情。表演者是来自亚省艺术学院，以及Tarwater Elementary School，Coronado Elementary School两所公立小学。
cf1bc4db52813dbfbf3f45ed0931a53fe9ec7356.translatedText: This Spring Festival Gala was performed by nearly two hundred Chinese families. The opening dance was performed by nearly a hundred Chinese and American children, which instantly ignited the enthusiasm of the scene. The performers are from the Alberta College of the Arts and two public elementary schools, Tarwater Elementary School and Coronado Elementary School.

a711dccfe82cd52d2950522d5cc0266ecfb28a8c.sourceText: 手影：Playful 逗趣 焦建东（右）

40189dd7ee7f7c108f6f6356bcd66431888a3c37.sourceText: 中国国家杂技团演员焦建东将2008年春晚的手影戏《逗趣》带到的《亚省春晚》的舞台上。灵动的小鸟，在焦老师的手里，是那么的活灵活现，千变万化的手影，让你看到光影之中的动人故事！
40189dd7ee7f7c108f6f6356bcd66431888a3c37.translatedText: Jiao Jiandong, an actor from the China National Acrobatic Troupe, brought the hand shadow play "Playful" from the 2008 Spring Festival Gala to the stage of the "Alberta Spring Festival Gala". The smart bird is so vivid in the hands of Teacher Jiao, and the ever-changing hand shadows allow you to see the moving stories in the light and shadow!
