1316ccb46b45926221dc8626ece6fd8590b702dc.translatedText: More than a hundred volunteers started vaccinating service personnel fighting on the front line of the epidemic in December 2020. These volunteers work 10-hour shifts (from 7 a.m. to 5 p.m.). Arizona Asian Alliance (AZAA) donated delicious Chinese meals to 160 volunteers on January 3.

e5359eb47cb32abfffe0033ff5c77dbd9881e912.sourceText: AZAA 会长Frank 张旭东，副会长张传东，理事邓凌，楊萍以及农民画家参加了送餐活动。
e5359eb47cb32abfffe0033ff5c77dbd9881e912.translatedText: AZAA President Frank Zhang Xudong, Vice President Zhang Chuandong, Directors Deng Ling, Yang Ping and farmer painters participated in the meal delivery event.

e3a7dedcd2fbbcefe16fd891b5b5927733c351dd.sourceText: 非常感谢新世界大洒楼给AZAA打折并在早上10点做好了160份精致午餐盒及160个春卷。10大箱午餐一行四辆车浩浩荡荡开往疫苗分发地 Chandler Gilbert Community College。
e3a7dedcd2fbbcefe16fd891b5b5927733c351dd.translatedText: Thank you very much to New World Dashalou for giving AZAA a discount and preparing 160 exquisite lunch boxes and 160 spring rolls at 10 a.m. A group of four vehicles with 10 large boxes of lunch drove to Chandler Gilbert Community College, the vaccine distribution site.

54ae0b6afe742270bc24e0f42e6984d3d6864027.sourceText: 参加捐赠的朋友有点被入口处陆军把守惊到了。还有警车挡路。还好联系的人特意先和警察打招呼，所以放我们四个车进去，当然前面是警察开道。好像进入了战地医院的感觉。打疫苗的人都是开车进去。这里每天给三千六百多人打疫苗。Maricopa 卫生部也在这里监督疫苗分发。和我们联系的Dignity Health工作人员Michelle早上5点就开始准备工作。要干到晩上八点才能收摊回去。她们真的太辛苦了。感谢这些志愿者们的爱心，也感谢为在疫情第一线的医护人员、警察和消防员们。
54ae0b6afe742270bc24e0f42e6984d3d6864027.translatedText: Friends who participated in the donation were a little surprised by the army guard at the entrance. There are also police cars blocking the road. Fortunately, the person I contacted specifically said hello to the police first, so he let the four of us in, with the police clearing the way. It feels like entering a field hospital. People who get vaccinated drive in. More than 3,600 people are vaccinated here every day. The Maricopa Health Department is also here to oversee vaccine distribution. Michelle, the Dignity Health staff member who contacted us, started preparations at 5 a.m. I have to work until eight o'clock in the evening before I can close the stall and go back. They work really hard. Thank you to these volunteers for their love, as well as to the medical staff, police and firefighters who are on the front line of the epidemic.

43a02c15affc7df5af63f26946bbafab6bcaa8ee.sourceText: 这是Dignity Health给AZAA 的感谢信.

8ac52800e76b3cc18eb637738d9d042c6bed18dc.sourceText: 亚省华联第13届凤凰之夜17日云上见
8ac52800e76b3cc18eb637738d9d042c6bed18dc.translatedText: >The 13th Phoenix Night of Hualian Province of Alberta will be seen on the cloud on the 17th

35e67acdb19a75e15c6e79b6f6b07031923c6677.sourceText: 【本报讯】人在凤城精神爽，月到中秋分外明。为了准备一年一度《凤凰之夜》文艺晚会，亚省各界侨团齐心协力， 精诚合作, 并成立了亚省凤凰之夜筹备委员会。本次凤凰之夜筹备活动由亚省华联牵头，组成十人小组共同筹办，筹委会主要包括亚省现代中文学校，亚省艺术学院，亚省希望中文学校，图桑华人协会和孟子中文学校。
35e67acdb19a75e15c6e79b6f6b07031923c6677.translatedText: [News from this newspaper] People are in high spirits in Fengcheng, and the moon is exceptionally bright during the Mid-Autumn Festival. In order to prepare for the annual "Phoenix Night" gala, overseas Chinese groups from all walks of life in the province worked together and cooperated sincerely, and established the Alberta Phoenix Night Preparatory Committee. The preparatory event for Phoenix Night was led by the Alberta Hualian and organized by a ten-member team. The organizing committee mainly includes the Alberta Modern Chinese School, the Art Institute of Alberta, the Alberta Hope Chinese School, the Tucson Chinese Association and the Mencius Chinese School.

42a9733a7e0f60783ac10421d6467f900920e3ad.sourceText: 亚省华联第13届凤凰之夜将于10月17号晚上7点开演，各演出人员正在紧锣密鼓排练中。月是思念，更是期盼，凤凰城华人志愿者群策群力，加上社区积极支持，将把亚省华联的美好和祝福分享给国内外的亲人朋友。
42a9733a7e0f60783ac10421d6467f900920e3ad.translatedText: >The 13th Phoenix Night of the Hualian Province of Alberta will start at 7 pm on October 17th, and the performers are rehearsing intensively. The month is filled with longing and even more expectation. With the combined efforts of the Chinese volunteers in Phoenix and the active support of the community, they will share the beauty and blessings of the Hualien of Alberta with relatives and friends at home and abroad.

d8ca581c65e862b7539d7a44f50f966bbb516c3d.sourceText: 10月17日，节目主持人将把活动组织者们夜以继日精心制作的节目一一呈现，一共有16个精彩节目，涵盖了歌曲舞蹈，诗词写作，相声和中华武术等各方面，非常多样化，高手在民间！
d8ca581c65e862b7539d7a44f50f966bbb516c3d.translatedText: On October 17th, the program host will present the programs carefully produced by the event organizers day and night. There are 16 wonderful programs in total, covering various aspects such as singing and dancing, poetry writing, cross talk and Chinese martial arts. They are very diverse and the masters are among the people!

64c6e9b1b8a6f0db56cabc72fd2968d45dc24313.sourceText: 基于疫情，本届凤凰之夜演出将以网上直播方式向观众呈现，用Youtube和Zoom两个平台，只要有网络，世界各个角落都可以观看。其中Zoom 直播链接：https://us02web.zoom.us/j/82433526300，Meeting ID: 824 3352 6300，Password:20201017。
64c6e9b1b8a6f0db56cabc72fd2968d45dc24313.translatedText: Due to the epidemic, this Phoenix Night performance will be presented to the audience through an online live broadcast. Using two platforms, Youtube and Zoom, as long as there is an Internet connection, it can be watched from every corner of the world. Among them, the Zoom live broadcast link: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/82433526300, Meeting ID: 824 3352 6300, Password: 20201017.

10bca9d2e2dd046a53aaf94c3c0a365652e9b275.sourceText: 凤凰之夜由亚省华联主办，协办单位包括：亚省现代中文学校、亚省艺术学院、亚省希望中文学校、图桑华人协会、凤城华人基督教会中文学校、孟子中文学校、青苹果中文艺术学校、Tarwater 小学、亚利桑那少林寺文化中心、大凤凰城侨联总会、AZ凤凰座和ASU饭饭学生组织(以上排名不分先后)。
10bca9d2e2dd046a53aaf94c3c0a365652e9b275.translatedText: >Phoenix Night is hosted by the Hualian Federation of Alberta. The co-organizers include: Alberta Modern Chinese School, Alberta College of the Arts, Alberta Hope Chinese School, Tucson Chinese Association, Fengcheng Chinese Christian Church Chinese School, Mencius Chinese School, Green Apple Chinese Art School, Tarwater Elementary School, Arizona Shaolin Temple Cultural Center, Greater Phoenix Overseas Chinese Federation, AZ Phoenix Block and ASU Fanfan Student Organization (the above are listed in no particular order).

a83dfb540584d9360af3316e53a655932c5dd0ad.sourceText: 最近COVID19病毒疫情肆虐，每个人都受之影响。特别是每天感染人数居高不下， 使每个人都迫切感受到病毒之威胁。其实我们亚利桑那州还有另一个独特的真菌杀手， 那就是山谷热。最近有三位华人受其感染其中两位不幸离世，更使我们迫切认识到山谷热其实离我们并不太远。
a83dfb540584d9360af3316e53a655932c5dd0ad.translatedText: The recent COVID19 virus epidemic is raging, and everyone is affected by it. We actually have another unique fungal killer in Arizona, and that's Valley Fever. Recently, three Chinese people were infected and two of them died unfortunately, which makes us urgently realize that valley fever is not too far away from us.

73fdd410ab77b594ad2bd14ef6f829701c186ccd.sourceText: 为了有效地自我保护，这次我们有幸请到American Valley Fever Association的杨萍女士给大家科普山谷热必要的基础知识， 从识别，预防，到求治的各种注意事项， 以避免不必要的悲剧发生。期间还会有被感染过的朋友现身说法。时间为一个半小时。
73fdd410ab77b594ad2bd14ef6f829701c186ccd.translatedText: In order to effectively protect ourselves, this time we are honored to invite Ms. Yang Ping from the American Valley Fever Association to give everyone the necessary basic knowledge about valley fever, from identification, prevention, to various precautions for seeking treatment, so as to avoid unnecessary tragedies. c130935e32f9e9368e628cfb486646857e3f648e.sourceText: 从4月26日到30日亚利桑那州出现了高温警告，气温接近40摄氏度，居民们期待着确诊数据的大量减少。可是从绝对数据看，这几日的数字没有减少，反而增加，大家对气温升高能杀死病毒的说法感到失望。记者也对最近的数据做了详细的观察和分析，有几个因素需要考虑: 1从四月的最后一周开始的总测试数量有所增加，而 检测人数和确诊人数的比例是有所下降的 。上周之前确诊比例在9%以上，现在降到9%以下，昨日是8.7%，今日是8.7%，在今后的数据中，我们会将检测率做必要的数据刊出。另外，根据本周的交通情况看，很民众也开始放松警惕，没有严格执行居家令。这也是造成确认数据没有明显下降的另一原因之一。 今日 新型冠状病毒感染激 增403例，新增死亡18 ，总人数8364！亚利桑那州 居家禁令延期到5月15日 ！坚持，巩固多个月的努力！据亚利桑那州卫生服务部昨日发布的数字，由新的冠状病毒引起的亚利桑那州COVID-19病例 7962 人，新增314例， 已知死亡330人， 新增死亡10.
c130935e32f9e9368e628cfb486646857e3f648e.translatedText: From April 26 to 30, a high temperature warning appeared in Arizona, with temperatures approaching 40 degrees Celsius. Residents are looking forward to a significant reduction in confirmed cases. However, judging from the absolute data, the numbers have not decreased in the past few days, but have increased. Everyone is disappointed with the claim that rising temperatures can kill the virus. The reporter also made a detailed observation and analysis of the recent data. There are several factors to consider: 1. The total number of tests has increased since the last week of April, while the ratio of the number of tests to the number of confirmed cases has declined. The proportion of confirmed cases was above 9% before last week, but now it has dropped below 9%. Yesterday it was 8.7%, and today it is 8.7%. In future data, we will publish the necessary data on the detection rate. In addition, judging from the traffic conditions this week, many people have begun to relax their vigilance and have not strictly implemented the stay-at-home order. This is another reason why there is no significant decline in confirmed data. Today, the number of new coronavirus infections surged by 403, with 18 new deaths, and the total number of people was 8,364! Arizona's stay-at-home order extended to May 15th! Persevere and consolidate many months of hard work! e890e5a8a259d3fd0c28aa316aa222bfaa599829.translatedText: >Phoenix Children's Hospital doctors confirmed the positive result. He diagnosed one patient last Friday but has not examined any other cases. He was asymptomatic at work on Friday and followed infection control. The hospital also notified other family members and staff who had been exposed. He developed symptoms on Friday night and tested positive. The doctor is currently recovering in isolation at home. The hospital said no other doctors or staff had noticed symptoms. They will continue to serve patients on the front lines. The total number of tests reported by the state health department is incomplete, just the number from private labs. Two patients were confirmed in the Gila River india community on Tuesday, 15 were confirmed at Arizona State University (ASU), and 3 were confirmed at the University of Arizona (UA)

Those aged 40-59 accounted for 33%, and those over 60 accounted for 29%. 35 patients (14%) were hospitalized in Maricopa County. 3 deaths.

bf5fedc3599ec815c985d760905a5d89c09bdb00.translatedText: Mohave County announced Tuesday its first confirmed case in the Lake Havasu City area. The state code does not currently reflect the situation.

c2ade6f96a0f8237083ddd46eac945d257af79b9.sourceText: 该公告还意味着，如果疾病控制和预防中心确认此案为阳性，则该县可能必须遵循道夫·杜西州长的命令，要求其在餐馆以及关闭的酒吧，体育馆和剧院提供有限服务。
c2ade6f96a0f8237083ddd46eac945d257af79b9.translatedText: The announcement also means that if the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention confirms the case as positive, the county may have to follow Governor Ducey's order to provide limited service at restaurants as well as closed bars, gyms and theaters.

ccbf9a92b8fd9467d8e9d4b2155d0ad7cd79f1b0.sourceText: 该人说，该人是成年人，没有住院并且正在康复中。莫哈维县公共卫生局表示，无法更确切地说明此人的性别或年龄。
ccbf9a92b8fd9467d8e9d4b2155d0ad7cd79f1b0.translatedText: The person is an adult, is not hospitalized and is recovering, the person said. Mohave County Public Health said it could not be more specific about the person's gender or age.

870fe93a7cf1e1094ff316357722d33e8cf6a860.sourceText: 将与该人的密切接触者进行访谈，该县建议每个人对症状和隔离进行14天的监控。
870fe93a7cf1e1094ff316357722d33e8cf6a860.translatedText: Close contacts of the individual will be interviewed, and the county recommends everyone monitor for symptoms and quarantine for 14 days.

979b62ab3ef908568e02698976707f9cf6688959.sourceText: “随着全国和整个亚利桑那州每天都有新的病例增加，在莫哈韦县看到我们的第一例病例就不足为奇了，”县卫生部门负责人丹妮丝·伯利说。
979b62ab3ef908568e02698976707f9cf6688959.translatedText: "With new cases rising daily across the country and throughout Arizona, it is not surprising to see our first case in Mohave County," said Denise Burley, county health department director.

That includes 43 in Arizona. There are 30 in Navajo County, seven in Apache County, six in Coconino County, Arizona, four in McKinley County, and two in San Juan County, New Mexico.

5742918e8764e6e088fb1df1d641ffa3c42e1db8.sourceText: Navajo族首领乔纳森·内兹（Jonathan Nez）发布的“待在家里”命令仍然有效。这要求纳瓦霍族的居民呆在家里，并消除不必要的旅行。
5742918e8764e6e088fb1df1d641ffa3c42e1db8.translatedText: The "stay at home" order issued by Navajo Chief Jonathan Nez remains in effect. This requires residents of the Navajo Nation to stay home and eliminate non-essential travel.

367e85d0b7c5c10bcd34caf19ef3844fabe8fe5b.sourceText: 现在，纳瓦霍人保留区的居民还可以注册纳瓦霍人紧急管理部门发出的紧急警报。新闻稿称，周一发出警报，敦促纳瓦霍所有居民留在家中。要注册紧急警报，请给“ Navajo Nation”发短信至888777或在www.nnalert.com上在线注册。
367e85d0b7c5c10bcd34caf19ef3844fabe8fe5b.translatedText: Residents on the Navajo Reservation can now also sign up for emergency alerts from Navajo Emergency Management. An alert was issued Monday urging all Navajo residents to stay home, the news release said. To sign up for emergency alerts, text "Navajo Nation" to 888777 or register online at www.nnalert.com.

a347b257b3d1b3f32c1056bc588cbfa0c318051f.translatedText: The number of Arizona COVID-19 cases caused by the new coronavirus has now exceeded 1,700, with 41 known deaths, according to new data released by the Arizona Department of Health Services on Friday.

81f46aa32afda05c7b69ac374d02f856afc4f9af.sourceText: 莫哈维Mohave已确认另外两例冠状病毒病例。第一个确诊涉及一名在哈瓦苏湖市地区the Lake Havasu City隔离在家中康复的成年人。卫生官员说，此人在流行病学上与先前的病例有关。第二个是金曼Kingman附近的成年人，他也处于隔离和在家中康复的状态。
81f46aa32afda05c7b69ac374d02f856afc4f9af.translatedText: Two more cases of coronavirus have been confirmed in Mohave. The first confirmed case involves an adult recovering at home in isolation in the Lake Havasu City area. Health officials say the person is epidemiologically related to a previous case. The second is an adult from nearby Kingman who is also in isolation and recovering at home.

fba764ecd9434ace8e20ced1f4d56d9f4ccbfac0.translatedText: An individual who works at Fort Huachuca and is a resident of Cochise has the first positive case of COVID-19 in the area and has become the fifth confirmed case in the county, a spokesperson confirmed.

5096f8781d0e083430a7d27a4df7eef3f50829b8.translatedText: Yavapai has 41 confirmed cases of COVID-19, an increase of seven from the previous day.

f555f1eec1d98c8c0ec2fc17d76da9fb0f98e3e4.sourceText: 根据最新的州数据，在亚利桑那州已识别的病例总数为1776。自周四以来，该州已报告确诊病例1598例，死亡32例，确诊病例增加了171例，即11％。

c67da14c7ba3a387e5a2cf143c14d0572b98062e.translatedText: As of Tuesday morning, Pima County has recorded six COVID-19 related deaths. There are eight in Maricopa County and three in Coconino County, according to their respective websites. Navajo County announced one death from COVID-19 on Sunday.

dacb9c3caa90662beb62819ee5a5452713345e6f.translatedText: The Navajo Nation announced Monday that it has 148 cases and five confirmed deaths.

d7515e58bb335750067751cac2d0673d296a19f2.translatedText: The Navajo Nation Department of Health has issued a new public health emergency order that implements and extends the stay-at-home order.

5507d0d6e46069541ad99e7483a8063eb17091ae.sourceText: 纳瓦霍族乔纳森·内兹说：“在全国各地的社区中看到警察局长弗朗西斯科下的纳瓦霍警察局，以确保人们遵守新的居家令。我们需要保护我们的人民。”
5507d0d6e46069541ad99e7483a8063eb17091ae.translatedText: Navajo Nation Jonathan Nez said, "The Navajo Police Department under Chief Francisco is being seen in communities across the country to make sure people are complying with the new stay-at-home order. We need to protect our people."

a302291b7de4d4c649a3004183e3e9b2bf04743d.sourceText: 居家令从晚上8点开始。到凌晨5点并于周一晚上生效。没有提供违反居家令有关的处罚的详细信息。居家令不包括上下班的重要雇员，但他们必须有文件。

1caf0ad1fbe420d1738f4dee3ab10d9254745933.sourceText: 两位推断阳性还在等待CDC的最后确认。新增加的确诊病例为40多岁的女性，正在医院接受治疗。经调查该病例为亚利桑那州首例人传人患者。目前州健康办公室正在确认该女性接触过的人群。
1caf0ad1fbe420d1738f4dee3ab10d9254745933.translatedText: The two presumed positive cases are still waiting for final confirmation from the CDC. The newly confirmed case is a woman in her 40s who is receiving treatment in the hospital. The case was investigated as the first case of human-to-human transmission in Arizona. The state health office is currently identifying people the woman came into contact with.

8409fcd2012ae5a39fd740afe467aea3927e2df6.sourceText: 亚利桑那州第二位确诊病例为20多岁的男性，他正在家隔离，运送他进行检查的4位消防队员和2位护理人员昨天被要求隔离。其中一位消防队员隔离后，已经被排除感染，回到工作岗位，其余的消防队员和护理人员仍在隔离，尚未出现任何不适症状。
8409fcd2012ae5a39fd740afe467aea3927e2df6.translatedText: The second confirmed case in Arizona is a man in his 20s. He is isolating at home. The four firefighters and two paramedics who transported him for examination were asked to quarantine yesterday. One of the firefighters has been ruled out of infection and returned to work after being quarantined. The remaining firefighters and paramedics are still in quarantine and have not yet shown any symptoms.

e6729b477b9940baaa48f1b04b992efa111fe4de.translatedText: There are currently 20 confirmed cases in Arizona, more than half of which are imported cases. The CDC has provided information on some of the infected persons. Let’s take a comprehensive review below.

ca55bc1b9b1217e1d5860a5a2f89daf00dec3e3e.sourceText: 亚利桑那首例是1/26确诊从武汉旅行回来的ASU国际留学生。他未住校，并很好的做了自我隔离，2/21日宣布彻底康复 第2例发病地区为Maricop，病例从巴黎旅行回来，并参加朋友生日派对，传染给另一个27岁的男性朋友。受感染的还有两位女性，一个30多岁，一个70多岁，两位80多岁的男性老人 3/6 Pinal一家5口 社区感染。这一家第一个感染的是女主人，在Maricopa的医疗部门工作，她们一家都是社区感染。 3/9 Pima 郊区确诊一例从疫区旅行回来 3/11 Maricopa一位90多岁的老人感染，也是首位住院治疗的病人，他的传染源目前还不清楚 3/13 Graham 的小学教员从Virginia旅行归来传染 3/13 Pima报告第2个确诊病例，但是无法找到与第一位联系，两天后第3例出现，周一第4例出现
ca55bc1b9b1217e1d5860a5a2f89daf00dec3e3e.translatedText: The first case in Arizona was an ASU international student diagnosed on 1/26 who returned from traveling to Wuhan. He did not live on campus and did a good job in self-isolation. He was declared completely recovered on February 21. The second case was in Maricop. The case returned from a trip to Paris and attended a friend's birthday party and infected another 27-year-old male friend. Also infected are two women, one in their 30s, one in their 70s, and two men in their 80s. 3/6 Pinal's family of 5 were infected in the community. The first person in this family to be infected was the hostess, who worked in the medical department of Maricopa. The whole family was infected in the community. 3/9 A case was confirmed in the suburbs of Pima and returned from a trip to an epidemic area. 3/11 A 90-year-old man in Maricopa was infected and was the first patient to be hospitalized. The source of his infection is still unclear. 3/13 An elementary school teacher in Graham returned from a trip to Virginia and became infected. 3/13 Pima reported the second confirmed case, but no contact with the first one could be found. The third case appeared two days later, and the fourth case appeared on Monday

65c7c92dac65f18b73f1fc4cdb56b8bbec068c19.sourceText: 尊敬的ASU社区： 如您从以前的来信中所知，大学领导一直密切关注围绕新型冠状病毒（COVID-19）爆发和传播…
65c7c92dac65f18b73f1fc4cdb56b8bbec068c19.translatedText: Dear ASU community: As you know from previous correspondence, university leadership has been closely monitoring the events and public health recommendations surrounding the outbreak and spread of the novel coronavirus (COVID-19)…

4bab0d0424afa3f3f440f2689ef3191e61a37cd7.sourceText: 如您从以前的来信中所知，大学领导一直密切关注围绕新型冠状病毒（COVID-19）爆发和传播的事件和公共卫生建议。本大学一直在忙于规划和准备过渡到在线教学环境的可能性，以帮助管理COVID-19的潜在传播。
4bab0d0424afa3f3f440f2689ef3191e61a37cd7.translatedText: As you know from previous correspondence, university leadership has been closely monitoring the events and public health recommendations surrounding the outbreak and spread of the novel coronavirus (COVID-19). The University has been busy planning and preparing for the possibility of transitioning to an online teaching environment to help manage the potential spread of COVID-19.

a51a9c21f919a53b27b9a440ade84d1779aab8f4.sourceText: 尽管目前ASU尚无确诊的COVID-19病例，但我们知道，在春假期间，ASU社区的许多成员本周一直在本国和世界各地旅行，这样可能会传播COVID-19 。为了预防起见，我们已决定将面授课程转换为在线指导。
a51a9c21f919a53b27b9a440ade84d1779aab8f4.translatedText: While there are currently no confirmed cases of COVID-19 at ASU, we know that many members of the ASU community have been traveling around the country and around the world this week during spring break, potentially spreading COVID-19. As a precautionary measure, we have decided to convert face-to-face classes to online instruction.

aaa0a9b38112b5d10cab4d616d2c85f064be7f05.sourceText: 从3月16日星期一开始，将有以下变动：
aaa0a9b38112b5d10cab4d616d2c85f064be7f05.translatedText: Starting from Monday, March 16, there will be the following changes:

7371211e7d3b5e12832164c75ab5eb152b1da387.sourceText: 1、所有面授课程都将转换为在线教学。课程将以这种模式继续进行两周，届时大学将评估COVID-19的状况。其他信息将在不久后，会提供针对教师和学生的有关如何过渡到在线教学的具体指导。
7371211e7d3b5e12832164c75ab5eb152b1da387.translatedText: 1. All face-to-face courses will be converted to online teaching. Classes will continue in this mode for two weeks, at which time the university will assess the COVID-19 situation. Additional information will be provided soon, with specific guidance for teachers and students on how to transition to online instruction.

f88e57c6a1fca87ec75f763b3c72f0a01e436f41.sourceText: 2、 大学仍然开放。大学住房，计算机实验室，食品服务，健康诊所，咨询服务，研究实验室以及大学的所有其他方面仍然开放。
f88e57c6a1fca87ec75f763b3c72f0a01e436f41.translatedText: 2. Universities are still open. University housing, computer labs, food services, health clinics, counseling services, research laboratories, and all other aspects of the university remain open.

67d51c7b9b81a496e057dd745f58dd54a1a25d89.sourceText: 除非另行宣布，否则所有公共活动将继续进行。
67d51c7b9b81a496e057dd745f58dd54a1a25d89.translatedText: Unless otherwise announced, all public events will continue.

a3529d524e88b4324b83013713ba58bcc6ba27dd.sourceText: 我们出于谨慎考虑而采取这些步骤。公共卫生官员尚未将此作为公共机构的要求。但是，鉴于我们所知道的一切以及根据疾病控制与预防中心的信息可以预期的结果，我们认为这是当前最谨慎的行动方案。
a3529d524e88b4324b83013713ba58bcc6ba27dd.translatedText: We are taking these steps out of an abundance of caution. Public health officials have not yet made this a requirement for public agencies. However, given everything we know and what can be expected based on information from the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, we believe this is the most prudent course of action at this time.

64615583374897a7f5bdae17a8d72f2333ffd356.sourceText: ASU的COVID-19网页将继续是我们与大学运营相关的信息和更新的主要来源。我们将通过尽可能多的渠道交流事态的发展和变化，并且我们在大学中拥有一支由个人组成的团队，随时可以帮助教职员工和学生过渡到在线教学。
64615583374897a7f5bdae17a8d72f2333ffd356.translatedText: ASU’s COVID-19 webpage will continue to be our primary source of information and updates related to university operations. We will communicate developments and changes through as many channels as possible, and we have a team of individuals across the University ready to help staff and students transition to online teaching.

ca619c239f76dc1b35d1cedf88b1d792f34b0b49.sourceText: COVID-19的传播可能需要改变我们互动的方式，但并不能改变我们的工作。 ASU将继续运营，并将继续为我们服务的学生提供最优质的教育，ASU员工将继续履行职责。
ca619c239f76dc1b35d1cedf88b1d792f34b0b49.translatedText: >The spread of COVID-19 may require changes in the way we interact, but it does not change the way we work. ASU will continue to operate and will continue to provide the highest quality education to the students we serve, and ASU employees will continue to perform their duties.

51694b252fbf6b41d5077e7e75a48afbde4c307f.sourceText: 这不仅对我们在ASU的社区，而且对于大都会凤凰城，亚利桑那州和本国的广大社区都是一个新的挑战。我们将继续与当地、州和联邦公共卫生官员密切监视COVID-19的情况。
51694b252fbf6b41d5077e7e75a48afbde4c307f.translatedText: This is a new challenge not only for our community at ASU, but also for the wider community in metro Phoenix, Arizona and the country. We continue to closely monitor the COVID-19 situation with local, state and federal public health officials.

e0cb9446b250c3f3544428cfbe9c65bf6de5bf8e.sourceText: 同时，请继续您的工作和学习。这样做不仅可以照顾好自己和周围的人，同时也能继续遵守公共卫生官员建议的预防措施，但不要放弃对教育和每天所做的重要工作的承诺。再者，不久之后将会发布更多信息以及有关教职员工和学生的具体指导。
e0cb9446b250c3f3544428cfbe9c65bf6de5bf8e.translatedText: In the meantime, please continue with your work and studies. Do this to not only take care of yourself and those around you while continuing to follow the precautions recommended by public health officials, but without abandoning your commitment to education and the important work you do every day. Again, more information and specific guidance for staff and students will be released shortly.

cf358598a7b54322fef06dc1cbad0ab2b9e68600.sourceText: 昨天新增1例确诊患者为来访的英特尔Intel公司雇员，因为公差，该员工于3月2日和3月3日到访了钱德勒位于Rural和Ray路的办公地点，根据英特尔内部信息显示是CH5和CH6楼。英特尔公司依据亚利桑那公共卫生部门的要求，对该雇员所到过的地方已经进行了消毒，清洁。亲密接触人员私下通知进行隔离。公司内部通知，如果工作可以远程操作，请与部门经理协商，允许在家工作。公司已经开始消毒清洁其他办公场所，保证员工上班的环境，对来访人员做更详细的调查。希望大家从我做起，勤洗手，保证工作环境的卫生。
cf358598a7b54322fef06dc1cbad0ab2b9e68600.translatedText: Yesterday, one of the newly confirmed patients was a visiting Intel employee. Due to official business, the employee visited Chandler's offices on Rural and Ray roads on March 2 and March 3. According to Intel's internal information, it was on the CH5 and CH6 floors. In accordance with the requirements of the Arizona Department of Public Health, Intel has disinfected and cleaned the areas where the employee visited. Close contacts are privately notified to quarantine. The company has informed internally that if work can be performed remotely, please consult with the department manager to allow working from home. The company has begun disinfecting and cleaning other office spaces to ensure the environment for employees to work, and conduct more detailed investigations of visitors. I hope everyone will start from me and wash their hands frequently to ensure a hygienic working environment.

ed9985118cf55d5538da6dc1e1d43606eee7b162.sourceText: 3月9日根据亚利桑那的公共健康部门的最新数据，亚利桑那州没有新增病例。但是5例确诊病例中，有一个来自Pinal county的学区。亚利桑那州一共检测的人员为56例，44人排除感染，7人等待结果。
ed9985118cf55d5538da6dc1e1d43606eee7b162.translatedText: On March 9, according to the latest data from the Arizona Department of Public Health, there were no new cases in Arizona. But among the five confirmed cases, one is from the Pinal County school district. A total of 56 people have been tested in Arizona, 44 people have been ruled out as infected, and 7 people are waiting for results.

4bbb3a940520d4ab6d42109c6591f1dab2bb64f5.sourceText: 周日新增两个病例来自Pinal county的同一个家庭，其中一个病人是Queen Creek的学生，就读于American Leadership Academy， Ironwood K-12. 亚利桑那健康服务中心表示患者已经康复，患者有症状的时候，没有到学校，所以在学校传播的可能性低。现在是春假，学校管理层有充分的时间来完成公共健康部门建议的消毒，清洁工作，在春假结束后，学校能够回到正常秩序。家长和员工会收到学校发的信，通知大家如何预防新冠状病毒。
4bbb3a940520d4ab6d42109c6591f1dab2bb64f5.translatedText: Two new cases on Sunday came from the same family in Pinal county. One of the patients is a Queen Creek student who attends American Leadership Academy, Ironwood K-12. The Arizona Health Services Center said the patient has recovered. When the patient had symptoms, he did not go to school, so the possibility of transmission in school is low. It is spring break, and school management has ample time to complete the disinfection and cleaning work recommended by the public health department so that the school can return to normal order after spring break. Parents and staff will receive letters from the school informing them about how to prevent COVID-19.

67e07a13de000f82d64b767e6bffd7c6c256602c.sourceText: Pinal County位于凤凰城和图桑中间，是发展比较快的市郊地区。
67e07a13de000f82d64b767e6bffd7c6c256602c.translatedText: Pinal County is located between Phoenix and Tucson and is a rapidly developing suburban area.

2d08a167dc0fee6b1b8b8bd7762a549ee9239897.sourceText: 在《凤凰城华人耆英会成立四十周年纪念特刊》中，有关于“海外华人妇女会”的资料。
2d08a167dc0fee6b1b8b8bd7762a549ee9239897.translatedText: In the "Special Issue Commemorating the 40th Anniversary of the Phoenix Chinese Seniors Association", there is information about the "Overseas Chinese Women's Association".

29d33d2e036e73de8868d0aa78d95543b397f0b2.sourceText: 方慧贤叙述：1983年，耆英会开办了一 间以广东话为主的学校：“中华文艺社“，让华裔子弟有机会学习中华文化。 当时带著孩子来上学的母亲们，都是由在美亲属申请来定居的广东移民，年纪平均约三十岁左右，孩子都为适龄学生，父母极盼望孩童有机会学习中文，所以不辞劳苦，每星期天都带孩子来上课。
29d33d2e036e73de8868d0aa78d95543b397f0b2.translatedText: > Fang Huixian narrates: In 1983, the Senior Citizens Association opened a school focusing on Cantonese: the "Chinese Literature and Art Society", allowing Chinese children to have the opportunity to learn Chinese culture. The mothers who brought their children to school at that time were all immigrants from Guangdong who had applied to settle in the United States through relatives in the United States. Their average age was about thirty years old, and their children were all school-age students. Their parents were eager for their children to have the opportunity to learn Chinese, so they worked tirelessly to bring their children to class every Sunday.

f9f9f187f2d242b37db586b102ff1fd9de4cd950.sourceText: 在等待孩子下课时，母亲们很自然地互相交流，交换移民来美后生活的艰辛和经历，互相细诉，“海外华人妇女会”便是此时诞生。 当时学校有七位义务老师，包括黄淑莲、裴霞云、方慧贤等等，以学生的中文程度高低分班。课馀也有各项文娱活动，如中国民族舞蹈班，舞狮队……。我是音乐教育出身喜欢唱歌、编制民族舞蹈。学生们曾受邀到社区各地演出，家长们缝制舞衣，学生们穿上奇装异服上台表演。在缺乏代表中华文化节目的时期，学生的表演非常吃香，学生与家长们都兴奋地参与。
f9f9f187f2d242b37db586b102ff1fd9de4cd950.translatedText: While waiting for their children to finish class, mothers naturally communicated with each other, exchanging the hardships and experiences of life after immigrating to the United States, and telling each other in detail. This is when the "Overseas Chinese Women's Association" was born. At that time, the school had seven volunteer teachers, including Huang Shulian, Pei Xiayun, Fang Huixian, etc., who divided the students into classes based on their Chinese proficiency. There are also various recreational activities after school, such as Chinese folk dance classes, lion dance teams... I am a music educator and enjoy singing and choreographing folk dances. Students have been invited to perform in various parts of the community, parents sewed dance costumes, and students put on fancy costumes to perform on stage. During a period when there was a lack of programs representing Chinese culture, the students' performances were very popular, and students and parents participated excitedly.

c164d511b8fee18e87438513f7f817e540fbd552.sourceText: 记得有一年，耆英会举办了一次农曆新年室外活动，租赁市政府的流动舞台与音响设备，很多政要莅临参加庆祝，设有食品摊位，为中美人士用毛笔写中文名字等等。会员与学生在舞台上表演不同节目，娱已娱人办得非常出色乐不可支。此次春节活动，该是华人主办室外活动首开先河，日后 其他团体陆续借镜仿傚举办，耆英会每每以此为荣。
c164d511b8fee18e87438513f7f817e540fbd552.translatedText: I remember that one year, the Senior Citizens Association held an outdoor Lunar New Year event, renting the city government's mobile stage and sound equipment. Many dignitaries came to celebrate, set up food stalls, and used calligraphy brushes to write Chinese names for Chinese and American people, etc. Members and students performed different programs on the stage, which was very exciting and entertaining. This Spring Festival event was the first of its kind for Chinese to host an outdoor event. In the future, other groups will follow suit and hold it, and the Senior Citizens Association is always proud of it.

2217e872652e92eeec4e4a3272d54a7b84f71536.sourceText: 海外华人妇女会投入对侨社服务，致力公益。每年以义卖方式举办筹款，卖春卷，卖粽子，卖年糕，卖月饼…等等，很获侨胞支持。筹得的款项，不能移作别用，全数用在公益事业上。该会长期关心斐匿华人耆英会，每逢佳节，或赠礼品，或送食物，相敬老人家。同时主持中文学校，负起全盘校务，海外侨教，造福华侨子侄。凡此种种，为公益事业努力以赴，正符合该会成立时标明“敬老携幼”的宗旨。
2217e872652e92eeec4e4a3272d54a7b84f71536.translatedText: Overseas Chinese Women's Association devotes itself to serving overseas Chinese communities and dedicating itself to public welfare. Every year, a charity sale is held to raise funds, selling spring rolls, rice dumplings, rice cakes, moon cakes, etc., which is very popular among overseas Chinese. The funds raised cannot be used for other purposes, and all funds are used for public welfare. The association has long been concerned about the Feini Chinese Elderly Association. During every festive season, it pays tribute to the elderly by giving gifts or food. At the same time, he presided over the Chinese school, took charge of all school affairs, taught overseas Chinese, and benefited the overseas Chinese children and nephews. All these efforts and efforts for public welfare are in line with the purpose of "respecting the elderly and supporting the young" stated when the association was established.

5556bf6df9dad30c24405924559d23b89481c362.sourceText: 方慧贤是斐匿中文学校始创人，并担任过八年的校长。她开辨过华人成人英文夜学班，办学期间，有时六间课室全满，帮助到为数众多的新移民。妇女会中很多成员都在中文学校当过教师，妇女会连年来为学校活动筹办经费食物，为学品兼优的学生颁发奖品和奖学金。为了筹集经费，她们除了义卖中国传统美食外，还通过向不同族裔团体和学校传播中华文化，包括有中华文化讲座，美食讲座，民族舞蹈，太极拳，醒狮表演等来筹款。
5556bf6df9dad30c24405924559d23b89481c362.translatedText: Fang Huixian is the founder of Feini Chinese School and has served as the principal for eight years. She ran an English evening class for Chinese adults. During the school's run, all six classrooms were sometimes full, and she helped a large number of new immigrants. Many members of the Women's Association have worked as teachers in Chinese schools. The Women's Association has raised funds and food for school activities over the years, and awarded prizes and scholarships to students with excellent academic performance. In order to raise funds, in addition to charity sales of traditional Chinese delicacies, they also spread Chinese culture to different ethnic groups and schools, including Chinese culture lectures, food lectures, ethnic dances, Tai Chi, lion dance performances, etc.

8a0839995b9cc88405e44f4bcd5ec4561bd9603e.sourceText: 创办斐匿中文学校的经费，是侨联总会筹集得来的，当年各侨团、侨界人仕纷纷大解善囊，共得款项七万一千九百多元，其中捐款最多的团体就是海外华人妇女会。因为主办了学校，华人耆英会最终合格申请到非牟利机构的免税牌照。
8a0839995b9cc88405e44f4bcd5ec4561bd9603e.translatedText: The funds to establish Feini Chinese School were raised by the Overseas Chinese Federation. Overseas Chinese groups and people from the overseas Chinese community donated generously, and a total of more than 71,900 yuan was obtained. Among them, the group that donated the most was the Overseas Chinese Women's Association. Because it hosted the school, the Chinese Senior Citizens Association was finally qualified to apply for a tax-free license as a non-profit organization.

b751527a7947bd6e245eef9a53561898cfaabedb.sourceText: 海外华人妇女会成功的原因，与担任过六届侨联主席、九届妇女会主席的方慧贤不无关係。方慧贤在1976年加入侨社活动，1979年任沙漠玉青年会主席，1983年创办 “海外华人妇女会”，在许多活动都有着她们的身影。在《沙漠明珠》第一集中，记有资深侨领余文劲对她们的评价：
b751527a7947bd6e245eef9a53561898cfaabedb.translatedText: The reason for the success of the Overseas Chinese Women's Association has something to do with Fang Huixian, who served as the chairman of the Overseas Chinese Federation for six terms and the nine-term Women's Association. Fang Huixian joined the overseas Chinese community in 1976, served as the chairman of the Desert Jade Youth Association in 1979, and founded the "Overseas Chinese Women's Association" in 1983. They have participated in many activities. In the first episode of "Pearl of the Desert", Yu Wenjin, a senior overseas Chinese leader, commented on them:

63a28a833e1c33f69a9a7ff10dab28bda840a38a.sourceText: 这个团体成员精明，年青端庄，青春活泼，朝气蓬勃，而且多才艺，能歌善舞，在侨社举办的活动中，做得有声有色，深得广大侨胞的好评。尤其是这班海外姑娘，当她们穿起粉红色的制服时，整齐划一，秀丽美观，花枝招展，尤觉锦上添花。表演唱歌，舞蹈，谐剧等，节目丰富，异常精彩，不时为侨社带来一股欢乐愉快的气氛，该会每次演出，群众交口称誉。这些赞美，係反映侨众对该会的良好评价，当时在本市芸芸侨团的活动中，的确显得该会的“独领风骚”。海外华人妇女会曾为我们的侨社文化生活增添不少亮丽色彩，是社区泼辣又可爱的“开心果”。
63a28a833e1c33f69a9a7ff10dab28bda840a38a.translatedText: The members of this group are smart, young and dignified, youthful and lively, full of vigor, and multi-talented. They are good at singing and dancing. They have done a great job in the activities held by the overseas Chinese community and have won praise from the majority of overseas Chinese. Especially this group of overseas girls, when they wear pink uniforms, they are uniform, beautiful and beautiful, and they feel like the icing on the cake. Performances of singing, dancing, comedy, etc. are rich and exciting, bringing a happy atmosphere to the overseas Chinese community from time to time. Every time the association performs, it is praised by the masses. These praises reflected the good evaluation of the association by the overseas Chinese. Among the activities of the overseas Chinese groups in the city at that time, the association indeed appeared to be "leading the way". The Overseas Chinese Women's Association has added a lot of bright colors to the cultural life of our overseas Chinese community, and is a lively and lovely "pistachio" in the community.

b825226efd1ef2ae358d55915f38bb6e8d96f762.sourceText: 数年前，海外华人妇女会决定解散其组织。她们并没有留下自身团体的书籍，而方慧贤的这篇文章，也就成为了该会的历史记载。
b825226efd1ef2ae358d55915f38bb6e8d96f762.translatedText: A few years ago, the Overseas Chinese Women's Association decided to dissolve its organization. They did not leave any books of their own group, and Fang Huixian’s article became the historical record of the association.

d68be8f2603539dd28a75d4a1921bf3530bbc364.sourceText: 亚利桑那华人历史协会保留有十多卷海外华人妇女会活动的录像带，她们热心公益活动和活色生香的形象，将长留在凤凰城华人的记忆之中，也为华人妇女树立了一个好榜样。
d68be8f2603539dd28a75d4a1921bf3530bbc364.translatedText: The Arizona Chinese Historical Association has preserved more than ten videos of the activities of the Overseas Chinese Women's Association. Their enthusiastic public welfare activities and lively image will remain in the memory of the Chinese in Phoenix, and they have also set a good example for Chinese women.

91bd0be98e072699bfb482c1c714b645aef5f8f1.sourceText: 这是群不仅人美，还特别努力的学生，一周上两到三堂课，比孩子们还努力，无论是一大早还是晚上八九点排练，大家从不轻易缺席！她们有的是工程师，有的是房地产经纪，有的是美妈，多年台下的训练，让她们获得了优雅的气质，让人羡慕的型体，更是让她们的人生焕发了不一样的光彩。短短两个月的时间内，学习了《绾纱》这个新节目，将东方女性温柔典雅的气质融入舞蹈中，把全场的观众都美化了！细腻如丝，优雅如画，成为本次比赛的闪亮之星，总排名十佳的首位！
91bd0be98e072699bfb482c1c714b645aef5f8f1.translatedText: This is a group of students who are not only beautiful but also very hard-working. They have two to three classes a week and work harder than the children. No matter whether they are rehearsing early in the morning or at 8 or 9 in the evening, everyone is never absent easily! Some of them are engineers, some are real estate agents, and some are beautiful mothers. Years of training in the audience have given them an elegant temperament and an enviable figure, which has given their lives a different brilliance. In just two months, I learned the new program "Yaosha", integrating the gentle and elegant temperament of oriental women into the dance, beautifying the entire audience! Delicate as silk, elegant as picturesque, it has become the shining star of this competition, ranking first among the top ten!

LuluBi is an experienced solo dancer at the Art Institute of Alberta. She has good folk dance skills and is becoming more and more familiar with her dance expressions. She has repeatedly won good results in major Chinese and American dance competitions.

533262ef2af1d7d6d2aeca38fff20e6096942d99.translatedText: Three children rehearsed this program specifically for the competition. The "Flying" dance embodies the characteristics of Chinese and Western art. The dance has a strong sense of picture and a ten-meter-long ribbon, which is a great test for the children's dance skills. These three children not only achieved very good results in the trio dance, but also won the 1st Platinum Award in the solo dance, and all ranked first in the overall ranking.

d9f6d60db9deb2495f96a675df4097bdce92984b.sourceText: Jenna Ko是亚省艺术学院所有参赛选手中年龄最小，学习舞蹈时间最短的孩子，而且是极少数首次参赛就进中级组比赛的选手之一。大部分中级组的选手都是每周至少上3-5小时课程，学习舞蹈多年。Jenna Ko起点高，成绩也很突出，她的两个舞蹈都获得白金奖，成为了一个舞蹈新星。
d9f6d60db9deb2495f96a675df4097bdce92984b.translatedText: Jenna Ko is the youngest among all the contestants at the Alberta Academy of Arts and has the shortest time to learn dance. She is also one of the very few contestants who entered the intermediate category for the first time. Most of the contestants in the intermediate group take at least 3-5 hours of classes every week and have studied dance for many years. Jenna Ko has a high starting point and outstanding results. Both of her dances won platinum awards and she became a new dance star.

b6348d960a9ea12052b58c340333b01a141c7975.sourceText: 2020年初，亚省艺术学院在Rainbrow，Showstopper多个舞蹈大赛中均获佳绩。这得益于亚省艺术学院多年来学校管理团队，师生，家长的共同努力。优秀和稳定的师资团队是学校的金字招牌。在吕丽华校长的领导下，学校行政老师 Jessica King 为学生们参赛和演出做了大量细致的工作。年轻活泼的李慈惠老师开启小朋友的舞蹈之路，培养她们对舞蹈的兴趣，资深的邱晓榕老师是全亚利桑那州舞蹈示范的标杆，受到老师和家长们的喜爱。2019年新加入的陈薇教授，更是在舞蹈编排和特训方面给孩子提出了更高的要求，她们把学校的教学质量推向了一个新高度，向全美的舞蹈界朋友展示了中国民族舞蹈的独特魅力，再次热烈祝贺亚省艺术学院，以及所有的获奖者！
b6348d960a9ea12052b58c340333b01a141c7975.translatedText: At the beginning of 2020, the Alberta College of Art won good results in multiple dance competitions such as Rainbrow and Showstopper. This is due to the joint efforts of the school management team, teachers, students, and parents of the Alberta College of Art over the years. The excellent and stable teaching staff is the school’s golden signature. Under the leadership of Principal Lu Lihua, school administrative teacher Jessica King did a lot of meticulous work for students to compete and perform. Young and lively teacher Li Cihui starts children's dance journey and cultivates their interest in dance. Senior teacher Qiu Xiaorong is the benchmark for dance demonstrations in Arizona and is loved by teachers and parents. Professor Chen Wei, who was newly joined in 2019, has put forward higher requirements for children in terms of dance choreography and special training. They have pushed the school's teaching quality to a new height and demonstrated the unique charm of Chinese folk dance to friends in the dance industry across the United States. Once again, warm congratulations to the Art Institute of Alberta and all the winners!

bf485ad09611d836d63e61fa6bce6c4d39c34ce9.sourceText: 1月16日晚9:30分，在彩虹全美舞蹈大赛现场，来自亚省艺术学院的Kylie Hartana，以精湛的舞技，折服全场，为2020亚利桑那分赛区画上了圆满的句号。观众，裁判都起立为她喝彩，并为她戴上了15-19岁组别，民族舞最高分的皇冠。就在前一天，来自亚省艺术学院年仅10岁的Jenna Ko, 追随师姐的步伐，第一次参加舞蹈比赛，囊括了比赛中的几乎所有奖项！
bf485ad09611d836d63e61fa6bce6c4d39c34ce9.translatedText: At 9:30 pm on January 16th, at the Rainbow All-American Dance Competition, Kylie Hartana from the Art Institute of Alberta impressed the audience with her superb dance skills, bringing a successful conclusion to the 2020 Arizona Division. The audience and the judges all stood up and applauded her, and crowned her with the highest score in folk dance in the 15-19 age group. Just the day before, 10-year-old Jenna Ko from the Alberta College of Art followed in the footsteps of her senior sisters and participated in the dance competition for the first time, winning almost all the awards in the competition!

808965524e9a380eb4f15400243a63021c8f2c99.sourceText: Kylie Hartana以《扇舞》获得了15-19岁组别，民族舞最高分皇冠！双白金奖，overall High Point，最佳年度舞者称号以及$500奖学金。Kylie的《扇舞》在亚省春晚上就受到热烈欢迎。这是一个中国功夫和舞蹈的组合。刚中带柔，动作难度大，既要掌握功夫中的技法，又要揉入舞蹈技巧，将力学和美学结合到了一个新的高度。亚省艺术学院的老师们，也是根据Kylie Hartana身体条件，专门为她选定的节目，短短一分半钟的节目让人赏心悦目，意犹未尽。
808965524e9a380eb4f15400243a63021c8f2c99.translatedText: Kylie Hartana won the 15-19 year old category with "Fan Dance", the crown with the highest score in folk dance! Double Platinum Award, overall High Point, Dancer of the Year title and $500 scholarship. Kylie's "Fan Dance" was warmly welcomed at the Alberta Spring Festival Gala. This is a combination of Chinese Kung Fu and dance. It is both hard and soft, and the movements are difficult. It requires mastering the techniques of kung fu and incorporating dance skills, which combines mechanics and aesthetics to a new level. The teachers at the Art Institute of Alberta also specially selected the program for Kylie Hartana based on her physical condition. The short one-and-a-half-minute program is pleasing to the eye and left unfinished.

67239c737110a8ec257d6736e8cc18d1c52f4930.sourceText: Jenna Ko（娜娜）以舞蹈《天蓝蓝》获得了8-11岁组别的双白金奖，overall high ponit，最佳年度舞者称号以及$500奖学金。娜娜的现代舞，也在比赛中获得白金奖!
67239c737110a8ec257d6736e8cc18d1c52f4930.translatedText: Jenna Ko (Nana) won the double platinum award in the 8-11 years old category, overall high ponit, best dancer of the year title and $500 scholarship for her dance "Sky Blue". Nana's modern dance also won a platinum award in the competition!

caaa512d0ec28193068868f403983d6261e316cf.sourceText: 两年前，娜娜开始进入亚省艺术学院学习舞蹈，她是亚省艺术学院年龄最小的独舞演员，更是最努力的学生之一。无论是上课还是放假，娜娜总是风雨无阻，坚持来上课，除了正常的舞蹈课，技巧课，只要有时间，她都额外上小课。无数个日日夜夜，小伙伴们都在玩耍，只有她在练功房，压腿，下腰，练习舞蹈技巧。短短两年的时间，辛勤的汗水，带来了丰硕的收获，她也成为亚省艺术学院进步最快的学员之一。从舞蹈初级班开始，亚省艺术学院的老师们，从舞蹈技巧，动作美感和规范性上都严格要求，这也是比赛中，孩子们获奖的基础。
caaa512d0ec28193068868f403983d6261e316cf.translatedText: Two years ago, Nana began to study dance at the Alberta College of the Arts. She is the youngest solo dancer at the Alberta College of the Arts and one of the hardest-working students. No matter it is class or vacation, Nana always insists on coming to class regardless of rain or shine. In addition to normal dance classes and technique classes, she also takes extra small classes whenever she has time. Countless days and nights, while her friends were playing, she was the only one in the practice room, pressing her legs, lowering her waist, and practicing her dance skills. In just two years, her hard work has brought fruitful results, and she has become one of the fastest-growing students at the Art Institute of Alberta. Starting from the junior dance class, the teachers from the Art College of Alberta have strict requirements on dance skills, movement beauty and standardization. This is also the basis for children to win awards in the competition.

28bbb50acb48cabd0e258da6f1df2bee206a30af.sourceText: 再次祝贺两位学员获得的好成绩，需要特别指出的是Overall High Point是一个含金量非常高的奖项，它打破所有舞蹈分类，按得分做的总排名，每个年龄段的前十名才能获此殊荣。
28bbb50acb48cabd0e258da6f1df2bee206a30af.translatedText: Congratulations again to the two students for their good results. It needs to be particularly pointed out that the Overall High Point is a very valuable award. It breaks all dance categories and is based on the overall ranking of scores. Only the top ten in each age group can win this award.

b6312187358226afc9192973c9da14426a0851e5.sourceText: 亚省亚太妇女公益团 (以下简称Giving Circle) 于本年已发放壹万元与以支援亚太妇女为⽬的之亚省慈善团体。受惠团 体包括有Arizona South Asians for Safe Families (ASASF) 及 Asian Pacific Community in Action (APCIA)。资助 ⾦各为伍仟元。 ASASF 是为协助亚太妇女提防家暴及性虐并加强她们对这⽅ ⾯的意识故是次资助⾦亦会被⽤作相关的用途。APCIA 则为帮助侨居亚省的 亚太裔⼈仕提供健康护理。资助⾦将拨作发展「长者护理员先导训练计划」之 ⽤。经此计划成功受训的学员料可提供短暂䕶理与有病或有需要⼜不⼤懂英语 的亚太裔长者以纾缓其家⼈长期照顾的劳累。 Giving Circle 主席Grace Lau 称Circle 的成立是为召集资源为侨居亚省有需要 的亚太裔妇女提供多⽅⾯如健康、教育、安全及经济的⽀援。Giving Circle 由 2014 年创办⾄今已发放三万元与有关的慈善团体。成员除创办⼈Grace Lau 外尚有Casssandra Mason-Motz, Eileen Yeung, Amy Gittler, Mary Heiss, Annie Hsu, Kelly Hsu, Leezie Kim, Christine Kovach, Anndi Kwanwmura, Mamiko Odegard, Doris Ong, Elizabeth Roe, Ruth Tan Lim, Astria Wong 及 Debra Larson. 各会员每年捐出壹仟元与Giving Circle 基金。有兴趣参与⼈仕 可电邮Grace Lau. Email:GYLau@aol.com
b6312187358226afc9192973c9da14426a0851e5.translatedText: The Asia-Pacific Women’s Charity Group of the Province of Asia and the Pacific (hereinafter referred to as the Giving Circle) This year, $10,000 has been distributed to charities in Alberta that support Asian and Pacific women. Beneficiary groups include Arizona South Asians for Safe Families (ASASF) and Asian Pacific Community in Action (APCIA). The funding amount is RMB 5,000 each. ASASF aims to help Asian-Pacific women prevent domestic violence and sexual abuse and enhance their awareness of this, so the funding will also be used for related purposes. APCIA provides health care to help Asian and Pacific Islanders living in Alberta. The subsidy will be allocated for the development of the "Pilot Training Scheme for Elderly Care Workers". Trainees who are successfully trained in this program are expected to provide short-term care to Asian and Pacific Islander elders who are sick or in need and do not understand English well, so as to relieve their families from the fatigue of long-term care. Giving Circle President Grace Lau said the Circle was established to mobilize resources to provide multi-faceted support in health, education, safety and economics to Asian and Pacific Islander women in need in Alberta. Since its establishment in 2014, Giving Circle has distributed $30,000 to related charities. In addition to founder Grace Lau, members include Casssandra Mason-Motz, Eileen Yeung, Amy Gittler, Mary Heiss, Annie Hsu, Kelly Hsu, Leezie Kim, Christine Kovach, Anndi Kwanwmura, Mamiko Odegard, Doris Ong, Elizabeth Roe, Ruth Tan Lim, Astria Wong and Debra Larson. Each member donates $1,000 to the Giving Circle fund every year. Anyone interested in participating can email Grace Lau. Email:GYLau@aol.com

fdeb69de8692f694beecd385526b7bbbfc2557db.sourceText: 【本报讯】 12月5日，下午5：30分中华商会在凤凰城市中心RottN?nbsp; Grapes餐厅举办2018年节日聚会。近三十位朋友参加了聚会，其中7位非会员加入了中华商会的聚会队伍，让更多的新鲜血液加入到这个亚利桑那州历史最悠久的社团之一。会长伍兆文律师主持了整个活动。
fdeb69de8692f694beecd385526b7bbbfc2557db.translatedText: [News from this newspaper] On December 5th, at 5:30 pm, the Chinese Chamber of Commerce held its 2018 holiday party at the RottN?nbsp;Grapes restaurant in downtown Phoenix. Nearly thirty friends attended the party, of which 7 non-members joined the party team of the Chinese Chamber of Commerce, allowing more fresh blood to join this one of the oldest societies in Arizona. Lawyer Wu Zhaowen, the president, presided over the entire event.

1d2b2a232622c4d979c6d2a7dbb6b89d00b408e4.sourceText: 节日聚会是中华商会一种日常的活动形式，这样的聚会为华裔中小业主提供互相交流学习的机会，分享资源，建立联系。当晚，主办方为来宾准备了丰盛的美食，还让大家把名片放在一起，举办了小小抽奖环节。通过游戏，也让朋友们相互认识。参加活动的朋友来自各行各业，有律师，教授，工程师，会计，医生，房地产经济，社区服务人员，媒体等等。大家一边分享美食，一边轻松攀谈。有的朋友说今年的假日季，比往年的生意好，原本的生意淡季，已经不淡了，并举例自己在节日季遇到的几个大客户，看来凤凰城的经济一片欣欣向荣。一位会计朋友说华裔对房地产投资很感兴趣，最近她在准备一个讲座，向大家介绍新税法对房地产的影响。现场的来宾都很有兴趣，希望也能在凤凰城听到这个讲座。前去圣地亚哥申请到科研资金的精神科博士则给大家讲了，去加州工作后的一些新奇的经历，也比较了加州和亚利桑那州在科研领域的不同之处。而多年为社区服务的中国周负责人则为大家介绍了2019年的活动，?#31607;子大赛?#65292;?#33590;艺表演?#37117;将会是亮点，充满中国特色的活动，每年在中国周上都大受欢迎。亚省春晚也将于1月12日在美莎艺术中心举办，活动的负责人也给大家带去了晚会宣传资料，春晚已经成为当地华人的一个品牌，受到了中美朋友的欢迎，现在门票正在热卖中。
1d2b2a232622c4d979c6d2a7dbb6b89d00b408e4.translatedText: Holiday gatherings are a daily activity of the Chinese Chamber of Commerce. Such gatherings provide opportunities for Chinese small and medium-sized owners to communicate and learn from each other, share resources, and establish connections. That night, the organizer prepared sumptuous food for the guests, and also asked everyone to put their business cards together and held a small lottery. Through games, friends can also get to know each other. Friends participating in the event came from all walks of life, including lawyers, professors, engineers, accountants, doctors, real estate managers, community service personnel, media and so on. Everyone shared delicious food and chatted easily. Some friends said that business during this year's holiday season was better than in previous years, and that the original off-season business was no longer slow. They gave examples of several big customers they met during the holiday season. It seems that Phoenix's economy is booming. An accountant friend said that Chinese Americans are very interested in real estate investment. Recently, she was preparing a lecture to introduce the impact of the new tax law on real estate. The guests at the scene were very interested and hoped to hear this lecture in Phoenix. A doctor of psychiatry who went to San Diego to apply for scientific research funds told everyone about some novel experiences he had after going to work in California, and also compared the differences between California and Arizona in the field of scientific research. The person in charge of China Week, who has served the community for many years, introduced the activities in 2019. The sub-contest will be the highlight. It is an activity full of Chinese characteristics and is very popular at China Week every year. The Alberta Spring Festival Gala will also be held at the Mesa Art Center on January 12. The person in charge of the event also brought promotional materials for the gala to everyone. The Spring Festival Gala has become a brand among local Chinese and has been welcomed by friends from China and the United States. Tickets are now on sale.

c0d30bf30daeacbdabcfa60354efbead444c0da5.sourceText: 从晚上5：30到9点，新老朋友相谈甚欢，意犹未尽，在聚会中，会长伍兆文还透露了一点小秘密，到2019年4月，他的第二届任期就要结束，李江将当选下一任中华商会会长。中华商会组建于1939年，明年将迎来80周年的纪念，2019年80周年新春聚会将于4月初举行。届时欢迎侨界新老朋友共襄盛举。
c0d30bf30daeacbdabcfa60354efbead444c0da5.translatedText: From 5:30 to 9 o'clock in the evening, old and new friends had a great time chatting with each other. During the gathering, President Wu Zhaowen also revealed a little secret. By April 2019, his second term will end, and Li Jiang will be elected as the next president of the Chinese Chamber of Commerce. The Chinese Chamber of Commerce was established in 1939 and will celebrate its 80th anniversary next year. The 2019 80th anniversary New Year party will be held in early April. New and old friends from the overseas Chinese community are welcome to attend the grand event.

a7185e9a46ebf44530590b8c109279a44e984eaa.translatedText: >In the New Year of 2020, Arizona's traditional Chinese opera "Alberta Spring Festival Gala" is full of New Year's blessings and will have a grand opening at 7:00pm on January 25 (the first day of the new year) at the Meisha Art Center. Arizona's literary and artistic elites have participated in this grand event. After 10 years of work, more and more American artists have joined us. The 2020 Arizona Spring Festival Gala has become a big gathering for friends from China and the United States to celebrate the New Year and revel together. This year's show will dazzle you, so get ready!

68f3da41efe256477609dd9aca6f5dac16588440.sourceText: ”亚省春晚”请到了2019年度在拉斯维加斯Vivafest马戏比赛中获得2019年最佳新兴丝绸艺术家奖的Annie Mielke。一根长十米的绸子，就成为了Annie在空中自由飞翔的舞台，她精湛的技艺，开创了丝绸杂技艺术的多项先河。春晚Annie 还带来她的小团队，他们每个人都深怀绝技，用身体挑战力量和平衡的极限，点燃2020春晚的舞台。
68f3da41efe256477609dd9aca6f5dac16588440.translatedText: "Alberta Spring Festival Gala" invited Annie Mielke, who won the 2019 Best Emerging Silk Artist Award at the Vivafest Circus Competition in Las Vegas in 2019. A ten-meter-long piece of silk became a stage for Annie to fly freely in the air. Her exquisite skills created many precedents in the art of silk acrobatics. Annie also brought her small team to the Spring Festival Gala. Each of them has a special skill and uses their body to challenge the limits of strength and balance, igniting the stage of the 2020 Spring Festival Gala.

27b0ce9d51a071803e0ddbe6deb819e43311dc46.sourceText: 由亚省艺术学院同学们表演的《刀马旦》，在中秋舞蹈节，亚洲节受到了观众们热烈欢迎，她们的一招一式，都展现了孩子们扎实的基本功，身段，气势，都活脱脱一个个巾帼英雄！

258a8c1d4f7b6d0481284904a582860e34aef0a9.sourceText: 气如虹： 妙在其中的语句 凤凰城 气如虹 有人问我，说话要讲求技巧，那写作岂不是更加要技巧？答案自然是肯定的，写作文章，遣词用字，行文造句，必须要讲究优美技巧来表达，起承转合，段落分明，一丝不苟。只不过，作文可以精雕细琢，再三推敲，尤其长篇论述，有如手工艺术，慢工出细活，务求产品精致。 说话呢，时间条件不容许缓慢，必须在分秒之间冲口而出；在交际场合，无论首先发言或回答问话，都不能迟疑不决，不能支吾其词。因此，说话技巧优胜过写作技巧，有的人笔下洋洋洒洒描述千言，在对答时刻却张口结舌，哑口无言。 分析写作技巧，以创作短小精悍的文体，最能显示作者的特殊技巧。如一般小品散文，或几个字的对联，或五七言的诗句，或深奥的谜语之类，有的非常杰出，表现精采，让读者领会蕴藏着的不凡含义，真个妙在其中。 就以经常谈到「屡战屡败」的熟谙语句，反映出短小精悍的特色，一经修饰，发挥相反意义。清朝曾国藩指挥湘军与太平军作战，连连失利，在给朝廷报告的奏章中，就使用这词汇，其部下李元度认为不妥，这语气表示我军差劲，会遭受谴责，应改为「屡败屡战」，那就凸出斗志高昂，意义完全不同，实在妙不可言。 在文字表达的技巧中，往昔的文人雅仕，通常以对联创作表露无遗；在短短的几个字或十几个字内，能够包含出对联者所陈述的意见，而应对下联的，也是透过一两句短语反映自己的观点。 我年少在越南堤岸，常听长者们津津乐道广东伦文叙的故事，称赞他和柳先开碰撞的对联。传说伦文叙上京遇见柳先开，柳看不起南方子弟，就出个上联要求应对，那是「东鸟西飞，遍地凤凰难立足。」语调明显充满霸气，贬低广东才子，伦文叙知道在羞辱自己，遂毫不留情地回应：「南麟北跃，满山禽兽尽低头！」（另有的说是「南龙北跃，一江鱼鳖尽低头。」）这里上联下联都含有弦外之音，语句均含有奥妙意境，不可思议，展现运用者的机智程度。 当年广东侨胞很赞赏伦文叙的急才，时常是茶馀饭後的讲古资料，伦文叙为胡员外题百鸟朝凰图的诗句，讲述得较多。因为该诗开始两句，平平无奇：「天生一只又一只，三四五六七八只」，不但毫无特色，还有点不伦不类，即使後续两句很不错，说明「凤凰何少鸟何多，啄尽人间千万石。」也挽回不了颓势，员外感觉沮丧，埋怨糟蹋这幅苏东坡名画，他要求解释那些含义模糊的数字语句；哪晓得一经解释，员外拍案叫绝，大呼妙在其中。原来首句「一只又一只」等於两只，三四相乘是十二只，五六相乘是三十只，七八相乘是五十六只，总数加起来刚好一百只，正确吟咏「百鸟朝凰」的图画。 中国历代文学，奥妙的佳作实在很多，述说不尽，我们只能在自己所知的范围里闲聊，或者选择性地举出较著名的谈论一下。譬如东汉时的蔡邕，流亡期间途经曹娥碑，听说碑文创作得很好，虽夜仍摸碑阅读，读罢称赞不已，题下八字於碑後：「黄绢幼妇，外孙齑臼」，当时没有谁明白其意，直到杨修才解开疑点，指出黄绢是色丝，幼妇是少女，外孙是女之子，齑臼是受辛器皿，整句是「绝妙好辤。」辤是古辞字。看哪！妙不可言啊！ 不仅在古代，近代也有不少巧言妙语，就以谜语来说，有的创作非常奥妙，上世纪八十年代初，台湾中华民国中央广播电台的红棉节目，有一回在猜谜项目里，说出个「巨木」谜题，猜一句成语，我苦思一番找到答案是「水到渠成」，我就认为创作得相当精巧，也算妙在其中了。
258a8c1d4f7b6d0481284904a582860e34aef0a9.translatedText: Qi Ruhong: The wonderful sentences in it Phoenix City Qi Ruhong Someone asked me that speaking requires skills, so doesn't writing require even more skills? The answer is of course yes. When writing an article, you must pay attention to beautiful words, words, and sentences, and you must pay attention to beautiful expressions, successions, transitions, clear paragraphs, and meticulousness. However, composition can be carefully crafted and reviewed repeatedly, especially long-form essays. It is like manual art, where slow work is done carefully to ensure a refined product. When speaking, time conditions do not allow for slowness, and must be blurted out in seconds; in social situations, whether you speak first or answer questions, you must not hesitate or equivocate. Therefore, speaking skills are better than writing skills. Some people describe a thousand words eloquently, but they are speechless when answering questions. Analyze writing techniques to create short, concise prose that best displays the author's special skills. For example, ordinary short prose, or couplets of a few words, or poems of five or seven words, or profound riddles, some of them are very outstanding and brilliantly performed, allowing readers to understand the extraordinary meaning contained in them, which is really wonderful. The familiar phrase that often talks about "successful defeats" reflects the short and concise characteristics. Once modified, it has the opposite meaning. In the Qing Dynasty, Zeng Guofan commanded the Hunan Army to fight against the Taiping Army and suffered successive defeats. He used this term in his report to the court. His subordinate Li Yuandu thought it was inappropriate. This tone meant that our army was poor and would be condemned. It should be changed to "repeated defeats and repeated battles", which would highlight the high fighting spirit and have a completely different meaning. It is really wonderful. Among the techniques of written expression, literati in the past usually expressed their opinions through the creation of couplets; in just a few words or a dozen words, the opinions stated by the couplet can be contained, and in response to the second couplet, one or two phrases can be used to reflect one's own opinions. When I was young in Vietnam, I often heard the elders talking about the story of Lun Wenxu in Guangdong and praising the couplet between him and Liu Xiankai. Legend has it that Lun Wenxu met Liu Xiankai when he went to Beijing. Liu looked down on the students from the south, so he wrote a couplet to respond, "Birds flying in the east and west, Phoenixes everywhere can't stand." The tone was obviously domineering, belittling Guangdong talents, Lun Wenxu knew that he was humiliating himself, so he showed no mercy He responded: "The southern lin leaps to the north, and all the beasts in the mountain bow their heads!" (Others say, "The southern dragon leaps to the north, and all the fish and turtles in the river bow their heads.") Here, both the upper and lower lines contain subtext, and the sentences contain mysterious artistic conceptions, which are incredible and show the wit of the user. At that time, the overseas Chinese in Guangdong greatly appreciated Lun Wenxu's eagerness and talent, and they often gave lectures on ancient materials after dinner. Lun Wenxu wrote more about Hu Yuan's poem about the picture of a hundred birds facing the phoenix. Because the first two sentences of the poem are unremarkable: "One is born one after another, three, four, five, six, seven or eight." It is not only featureless but also a bit nondescript. Even though the following two sentences are very good, it shows that "there are so few phoenixes and so many birds. They peck all the people." Tens of millions of stones between them." could not restore the decline. The member was frustrated and complained about the waste of this famous painting by Su Dongpo. He asked for an explanation of those ambiguous numerical statements; but once the explanation was given, the member was amazed and exclaimed that it was wonderful. It turns out that the first sentence "one after another" equals two, the multiplication of three and four is twelve, the multiplication of five and six is ​​thirty, the multiplication of seven and eight is fifty-six, and the total adds up to exactly one hundred, correctly reciting the picture of "a hundred birds facing the phoenix". There are so many wonderful and mysterious works in Chinese literature in the past dynasties that it is impossible to describe them all. We can only talk about them within the scope of our knowledge, or selectively mention the more famous ones. For example, Cai Yong in the Eastern Han Dynasty passed by Cao'e's stele during his exile. He heard that the inscription on the stele was very good. He touched the stele and read it even at night. After reading it, he praised it so much that he wrote eight characters on the back of the stele: "Young woman in yellow silk, grandson Junjiu". At that time, no one understood its meaning. It was not until Yang Xiu solved the doubts that the yellow silk was colored silk, the young woman was a girl, the grandson was the daughter's son, and the mortar was a vessel for suffering. The whole sentence was "excellent and good." "褤" is an ancient word. Look! How wonderful! Not only in ancient times, but also in modern times, there are many witty sayings. As for riddles, some creations are very mysterious. In the early 1980s, the Red Cotton Program of the Central Broadcasting Station of the Republic of China in Taiwan once asked a "giant tree" riddle and guessed an idiom in the riddle project. I thought hard and found that the answer was "it comes naturally". I thought the creation was quite ingenious, and it was also wonderful.

3a57bba86b7a1aa995b285f467e7713499321296.translatedText: Modern Chinese School of Alberta actively participated in the 10th Chinese Teacher Training of the ASU Confucius Institute. First of all, Fannie Tam, Executive Director of the Confucius Institute Madam to...

0f45991770aae43c6d2e6afdf691f2d824cef8dc.sourceText: 新学期第一个周日一月十三号一大早，亚利桑那州立大学中心报告厅聚集了来自孔子学院，美国多个公立学校的孔子课堂，各中文学校的 100 多名校长，教学主管，中文 项目负责人和老师们。他们齐聚一堂在这里参加亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院第十届POST-ACTFL CONFERNCE WORKSHOP 中文教师培训。在陶世诚董事长和杨轶伦校长的大力支持下，亚省现代中文学校的全体中文老师们参加了会议并由参加 2018 年全美外国语 教学年会(ACTFL)的两位老师做了精彩的演讲和教学经验交流。
0f45991770aae43c6d2e6afdf691f2d824cef8dc.translatedText: Early in the morning on January 13th, the first Sunday of the new semester, more than 100 principals, teaching supervisors, Chinese project leaders and teachers from the Confucius Institute, Confucius Classrooms in multiple public schools in the United States, and Chinese schools gathered in the lecture hall of the Arizona State University Center. They gathered here to participate in the 10th POST-ACTFL CONFERNCE WORKSHOP Chinese Teacher Training of the Confucius Institute at Arizona State University. With the strong support of Chairman Tao Shicheng and Principal Yang Yilun, all Chinese teachers from Alberta Modern Chinese Schools attended the meeting, and two teachers who participated in the 2018 National Conference on Teaching Foreign Languages ​​(ACTFL) gave wonderful speeches and exchanged teaching experiences.

d3c0a9c2b3621eb98b309b5485523c480b510028.sourceText: 首先孔子学院执行院长 Fannie Tam 女士致开幕词欢迎各位老师的到来。接着设立 了孔子课堂两个公立学校校长介绍了他们中文教学的经验，和教学理念方法等。参加年 会的孔院谢文静老师,和洞溪学区的吴芳老师分别就教学方法进行了简明扼要的阐述。
d3c0a9c2b3621eb98b309b5485523c480b510028.translatedText: First of all, Ms. Fannie Tam, Executive Director of the Confucius Institute, delivered an opening speech to welcome all the teachers. Then the principals of two public schools who set up Confucius Classrooms introduced their Chinese teaching experience, teaching concepts and methods. Teacher Xie Wenjing from the Confucius Institute and teacher Wu Fang from Dongxi School District who attended the annual meeting gave concise explanations on teaching methods respectively.

8f03fd4766d3083060fcc7a84765b8ba96bc8451.sourceText: 和以往不同的是孔子学院本次培训安排了许多生动活泼有趣的项目。来自中国的气 功大师徐武教授在大家都听了两个多小时的讲座后带领大家站立起来，教大家做了一套健身养生的气功动作，徐老师一招一式的耐心教练，所有的老师们认真努力的学习，使 得久坐之后的疲劳一扫而光。看到好多老师纷纷脱掉外衣，认认真真的跟老师完成了一个又一个的动作，现场的气氛非常热烈，感谢孔子学院为老师们提供的健身锻炼机会。
8f03fd4766d3083060fcc7a84765b8ba96bc8451.translatedText: Different from the past, the Confucius Institute arranged many lively and interesting projects for this training. Professor Xu Wu, a qigong master from China, led everyone to stand up after listening to the lecture for more than two hours, and taught everyone a set of qigong movements for fitness and health. Teacher Xu patiently coached each move, and all the teachers studied hard, so that the fatigue after sitting for a long time was gone. I saw many teachers taking off their coats one after another and conscientiously completing one action after another with the teacher. The atmosphere at the scene was very warm. I thanked the Confucius Institute for providing the teachers with fitness exercise opportunities.

cb810dc76771e7d6bede3f88ff3d5b13d9b4fa7e.sourceText: 为体现汉语教学和中国文化的传播相结合的办学特色，孔子学院还专门邀请了民间 书法家周先生现场为老师们书写福字和春联，通过抽奖的方式送给老师，老师们拿着大 红的福字合影留念，一派喜气洋洋的新年气氛。
cb810dc76771e7d6bede3f88ff3d5b13d9b4fa7e.translatedText: In order to reflect the school-running characteristics of combining Chinese teaching and the dissemination of Chinese culture, the Confucius Institute also specially invited Mr. Zhou, a folk calligrapher, to write the Chinese characters "福" and Spring Festival couplets for the teachers on the spot, and gave them to the teachers through a lottery. The teachers took photos with the big red characters "福", creating a joyful New Year atmosphere.

d2379ddf0970529f2fceebb67233530794f7e249.sourceText: 亚省现代中文学校的安然老师和曾颖华老师代表我校在会上做了培训演讲。安然老 师演讲的题目是:Apply the Skills to Interpret the Readings安老师通过 Character Level, Word Level, Sentence Level 字，词，句的分级教学和 训练，来帮助学生学习和加深记忆，在演讲中，安老师列举了汉字的部件，部首，声旁 等等教学中用于帮助学生理解和记忆的方法和形式，老师们听了他的演讲，深感安老师 的教学尽职尽责，兢兢业业。
d2379ddf0970529f2fceebb67233530794f7e249.translatedText: Teachers An Ran and Zeng Yinghua from the Alberta Modern Chinese School gave training speeches at the meeting on behalf of our school. The title of Teacher An Ran’s speech is: Apply the Skills to Interpret the Readings. Teacher An helps students learn and deepen their memory through graded teaching and training of Character Level, Word Level, Sentence Level characters, words and sentences. In the speech, Teacher An listed the parts, radicals, consonants and other methods and forms of Chinese characters used in teaching to help students understand and remember. After listening to his speech, the teachers were deeply impressed by Teacher An. His teaching is conscientious and conscientious.

3057b9f1e0ba452ee0f4ad46a171932e30b352de.sourceText: 现代中文学校的曾颖华老师通过《语言与文化的相遇》的演讲题目，结合生动有趣 的图画，阐述了中国文化元素在汉语教学中的应用。曾老师通过许多素材讲解了中国文 化的 悠久历史和习俗谚语的出处。列举了中国美食，中国传统节日，中国服饰等例子， 非常形象和生动的运用到中文的教学中。
3057b9f1e0ba452ee0f4ad46a171932e30b352de.translatedText: Teacher Zeng Yinghua from Modern Chinese School explained the application of Chinese cultural elements in Chinese teaching through the topic of "The Encounter between Language and Culture" and combined with vivid and interesting pictures. Teacher Zeng explained the long history of Chinese culture and the origin of customs and proverbs through many materials. Examples of Chinese food, Chinese traditional festivals, Chinese costumes, etc. are listed, which are very vivid and vividly used in Chinese teaching.

06bd6771b1a61008863ebb6e523155fb528fa42d.sourceText: 本次的研讨会，首次增加了除教师分享参加年会的心得和教学交流以外的《汉语”奥斯卡”微视频大赛》的颁奖典礼。来自一百多部参赛作品的 25 个奖项，在会上揭晓。 每位获奖选手走上红地毯，兴高采烈的从颁奖老师手中接过奖杯并发表了热情洋溢的获 奖感言。饶有趣味的是现场的老师们通过手机投票的方式选出了最佳视频奖。据主持人 介绍:中文视频大赛已经连续举办了 5 届，参数人数逐年增加，参赛的视频水平也越来 越能体现参赛学生特别是非华裔学生的汉语水平，本次最佳作品奖，最佳原创奖，最佳 改编奖，最佳音乐剪辑奖最佳编剧奖和优胜奖等充分体现出学生们的学习热情和创造力。
06bd6771b1a61008863ebb6e523155fb528fa42d.translatedText: This seminar, for the first time, added the award ceremony of the "Chinese "Oscar" Micro Video Competition, in addition to teachers sharing their experiences from participating in the annual meeting and teaching exchanges. Twenty-five awards from more than a hundred entries were announced at the meeting. Each award-winning contestant walked onto the red carpet, happily received the trophy from the award-giving teacher and delivered an enthusiastic acceptance speech. What is interesting is that the teachers on site selected the best video award through mobile phone voting. According to the host, the Chinese video competition has been held for 5 consecutive years, with the number of parameters increasing year by year, and the level of participating videos increasingly reflecting the Chinese proficiency of participating students, especially non-Chinese students. The Best Work Award, Best Original Award, Best Adaptation Award, Best Music Editing Award, Best Screenplay Award, and Winner Award fully reflect the students' enthusiasm for learning and creativity.

f67146832b3988c2edbfc8f7eb787f1665d2e6d5.sourceText: 与会的老师们在热情洋溢的欢乐祥和气氛中合影留念。通过教学的经验交流，老师 们受益匪浅，在以后的教学中更能取长补短，不断提高教学水平和教学质量。感谢孔子 学院给大家提供学习和交流的平台，祝愿博大精深的中国文化走向世界，愿大家共同努 力使传播中国文化的前景更加美好。
f67146832b3988c2edbfc8f7eb787f1665d2e6d5.translatedText: The participating teachers took group photos in a warm, joyful and peaceful atmosphere. Through the exchange of teaching experience, teachers have benefited a lot and can learn from each other's strengths in future teaching to continuously improve their teaching level and quality. Thank you to the Confucius Institute for providing you with a platform for learning and exchange. I wish that the broad and profound Chinese culture will go to the world. I hope that everyone will work together to make the prospect of spreading Chinese culture even better.

1b864d9e0c188b597947da9593263c43fffe0442.sourceText: 世界上只有两种抽油烟机：一种是方太抽油烟机，一种是其他抽油烟机。
1b864d9e0c188b597947da9593263c43fffe0442.translatedText: There are only two types of range hoods in the world: one is the FOTILE range hood, and the other is other range hoods.

f0ef634592c81f75bfa255a6b3b229fa226692a9.sourceText: 中国高端厨电市场占有率第一的方太，进入美国市场两年多来，已经走进了千家万户。
f0ef634592c81f75bfa255a6b3b229fa226692a9.translatedText: Fotile, which has the largest market share in high-end kitchen appliances in China, has entered the US market for more than two years and has entered thousands of households.

11573aa0e56cb5919b99e8ae39eb87e87c3356cc.sourceText: 你的朋友多次谈方太网红油烟机 JQG7501 ，你的邻居已经从亚马逊下单，但是其他他们更想在本地经销商实际体验和感受，传说中 95% 的油烟分离率和近吸强排不跑烟的方太吸油烟神器。
11573aa0e56cb5919b99e8ae39eb87e87c3356cc.translatedText: Your friends have talked about FOTILE’s red range hood JQG7501 many times, and your neighbors have already placed orders from Amazon, but others would rather experience it at a local dealer. The legendary 95% range hood separation rate and FOTILE’s magic smoke-absorbing device that can draw close-in and force exhaust smoke without escaping.

b270c75364cc6ff66d4dec37521cfe491dcb50bf.sourceText: 作为高端厨电领导者, 方太自 1996 年创立以来即专注于成套化、嵌入式高端厨电领域，目前已形成吸油烟机、嵌入式燃气灶、嵌入式消毒柜、嵌入式电蒸箱、嵌入式微波炉、嵌入式电烤箱、燃气热水器、水槽洗碗机八大产品线。 方太拥有行业前沿的实验室、构建了行业技术力量雄厚的研究院，国家发明专利数量行业内位居翘楚地位。凭借雄厚的研发实力，方太主导制定了吸油烟机行业的国家标准及国际标准，更以出色的工业设计实力，斩获了行业多项 iF 及 reddot 大奖。 方太开创了现代儒家管理模式，并积极投身传统文化推广、慈善、环保等公益事业，努力践行企业社会公民责任。 以?SPAN style=’FONT-FAMILY: DengXian; PADDING-BOTTOM: 0px; PADDING-TOP: 0px; PADDING-LEFT: 0px; MARGIN: 0px; PADDING-RIGHT: 0px’>人品、企品、产品，三品合一?SPAN style=’FONT-FAMILY: DengXian; PADDING-BOTTOM: 0px; PADDING-TOP: 0px; PADDING-LEFT: 0px; MARGIN: 0px; PADDING-RIGHT: 0px’>为核心价值观、以?SPAN style=’FONT-FAMILY: DengXian; PADDING-BOTTOM: 0px; PADDING-TOP: 0px; PADDING-LEFT: 0px; MARGIN: 0px; PADDING-RIGHT: 0px’>让家的感觉更好?SPAN style=’FONT-FAMILY: DengXian; PADDING-BOTTOM: 0px; PADDING-TOP: 0px; PADDING-LEFT: 0px; MARGIN: 0px; PADDING-RIGHT: 0px’>为使命的方太，正朝着?SPAN style=’FONT-FAMILY: DengXian; PADDING-BOTTOM: 0px; PADDING-TOP: 0px; PADDING-LEFT: 0px; MARGIN: 0px; PADDING-RIGHT: 0px’>成为一家伟大的企业?SPAN style=’FONT-FAMILY: DengXian; PADDING-BOTTOM: 0px; PADDING-TOP: 0px; PADDING-LEFT: 0px; MARGIN: 0px; PADDING-RIGHT: 0px’>的愿景全面迈进。
b270c75364cc6ff66d4dec37521cfe491dcb50bf.translatedText: As a leader in high-end kitchen appliances, FOTILE has been in business since 1996 Since its establishment in 2010, it has focused on the field of complete sets of embedded high-end kitchen appliances. Currently, it has formed eight product lines: range hoods, embedded gas stoves, embedded disinfection cabinets, embedded electric steamers, embedded microwave ovens, embedded electric ovens, gas water heaters, and sink dishwashers. FOTILE has cutting-edge laboratories in the industry, established a research institute with strong technical strength in the industry, and ranks among the top in the industry in terms of the number of national invention patents. With its strong R&D capabilities, FOTILE has led the formulation of national and international standards for the range hood industry, and has won multiple iF and reddot awards in the industry with its outstanding industrial design capabilities. Fotile has created a modern Confucian management model, and actively participates in public welfare undertakings such as traditional culture promotion, charity, and environmental protection, and strives to fulfill its corporate social citizenship responsibilities. With?SPAN style=’FONT-FAMILY: DengXian; PADDING-BOTTOM: 0px; PADDING-TOP: 0px; PADDING-LEFT: 0px; MARGIN: 0px; PADDING-RIGHT: 0px’>character, enterprise and products, three products in one?SPAN style=’FONT-FAMILY: DengXian; PADDING-BOTTOM: 0px; PADDING-TOP: 0px; PADDING-LEFT: 0px; MARGIN: 0px; PADDING-RIGHT: 0px’> as the core values, with?SPAN style=’FONT-FAMILY: DengXian; PADDING-RIGHT: 0px’>Making your home feel better?SPAN style=’FONT-FAMILY: DengXian; PADDING-BOTTOM: 0px; PADDING-TOP: 0px; PADDING-LEFT: 0px; MARGIN: 0px; DengXian; PADDING-BOTTOM: 0px; PADDING-TOP: 0px; PADDING-LEFT: 0px; MARGIN: 0px; PADDING-RIGHT: 0px’>Become a great company?SPAN style=’FONT-FAMILY: DengXian; 0px; MARGIN: 0px; PADDING-RIGHT: 0px’>’s vision has taken full stride.
