ffb859b43418a6a4932e35428f21a18c693ff549.translatedText: >Alberta Chinese support Sichuan group to participate in the presidential re-election rally Keep American Great! On October 19th, US President Trump arrived in Arizona...

ff7de49734bd53f7c0a510c0ec90c2d000cd47f5.sourceText: 10月19日美国总统特朗普到达亚利桑那州美莎市举行他的续任选 举集会。亚利桑那州华裔挺川群的群主张传东以及十多个支持者， 当日下午3点半就到集会现场。 大家穿着挺川的体恤带着挺川的帽子， 以及挽救中国文化中心的文化衫，表达对总统特朗普的支持。 还有一些挺川华人，早早就加入志愿者队伍， 为组织本次活动尽力尽职。
ff7de49734bd53f7c0a510c0ec90c2d000cd47f5.translatedText: On October 19th, US President Trump arrived in Mesa, Arizona to hold his re-election rally. A member of the Arizona Chinese Support Sichuan Group, Zhang Chuandong and more than a dozen supporters, arrived at the rally at 3:30 pm that day. Everyone wore pro-Sichuan T-shirts, pro-Sichuan hats, and Save the China Cultural Center T-shirts to express their support for President Trump. There are also some Sichuan Chinese who joined the volunteer team early and did their best to organize this event.

5b31c0f321dbc58657e83d2a68b2b3ddb4d164d7.sourceText: 华人挺川群的朋友们与其他族裔支持者相互问候，分享两年来， 特朗普总统为普通老百姓挣得的利益。美欧日启动零关税，加拿大， 墨西哥达成北美新贸易协定。与此同时，美国制造业回归， 失业率达到历史新低，减税政策落到实处。 特朗普企业家的实干精神处处体现， 一步一步落实他在选举中的承诺。
5b31c0f321dbc58657e83d2a68b2b3ddb4d164d7.translatedText: Friends of the Chinese Sichuan group greeted each other and supporters of other ethnic groups and shared the benefits that President Trump has earned for ordinary people in the past two years. The United States, Europe and Japan launched zero tariffs, and Canada and Mexico reached a new North American trade agreement. At the same time, the U.S. manufacturing industry has returned, the unemployment rate has reached a record low, and tax cuts have been implemented. Trump’s entrepreneurial spirit is reflected in every aspect, and he implements his election promises step by step.

a72dd0b6e2e2aef66b9f9111c0911f04cb825919.sourceText: 挺川群群主张传东作为美国少数族裔的代表接受了墨西哥电视台的采 访。首先表示我们是华裔美国人，美国是一个移民国家， 我们和所有其他移民一样热爱这个国家， 我们将国家利益放在所有利益之上， 我们希望美国的经济能更上一层楼， 这也是特朗普总统用自己两年来的工作业绩证明了这一点。 同时华裔也希望所有的族裔都有一个平等，友好的关系。 凤凰城中国文化中心， 少数族裔的业主和其他族裔的业主一样拥有相同的权益， 他们的权益同样受到保护和尊重。我们期待特朗普续任， 带来美国经济的再次腾飞。 现场的挺川朋友都为群主的精彩回答欢呼。
a72dd0b6e2e2aef66b9f9111c0911f04cb825919.translatedText: Tingchuan Qunqun advocated that Chuandong accepted an interview with Mexican television as a representative of ethnic minorities in the United States. First of all, we are Chinese Americans. The United States is a country of immigrants. We love this country as much as all other immigrants. We put national interests above all interests. We hope that the U.S. economy can reach a higher level. This is what President Trump has proven with his work performance in the past two years. At the same time, Chinese Americans also hope that all ethnic groups can have an equal and friendly relationship. At the Phoenix Chinese Cultural Center, owners of ethnic minorities have the same rights as owners of other ethnic groups, and their rights are equally protected and respected. We look forward to Trump’s re-election, which will bring about another boom in the U.S. economy. All Tingchuan friends present cheered for the group leader’s wonderful answer.

e4ac3a660e4e28d370ef7afcc19b8aafc89eee82.sourceText: 晚上7点，两架直升飞机在美莎机场上空盘旋，现场全面沸腾， 活动现场内外高喊”USA，USA。。。。。”口号， 有些支持者甚至热泪盈眶，两年多来， 我们的生活的确因为新总统的努力而发生了可喜的变化。 在全场的欢呼声中，特朗普依然是神采奕奕地走向演讲台， 欢呼声连绵起伏，特朗普向大家介绍了两年的政绩， 希望大家依然能把选票投给他，”Keep America great”，并表示亚利桑那州的边界安全依然是重点， 边界墙一定会建。 在演讲中特朗普大力推荐了亚利桑那州的国会女议员候选人Mart ha McSally。希望选民们把票投给她。 亚利桑那州的市民们看到了一个70多岁的总统， 为了国家利益四处奔波，为了让美国再次强大。
e4ac3a660e4e28d370ef7afcc19b8aafc89eee82.translatedText: At 7 o'clock in the evening, two helicopters hovered over the Mesa Airport, and the scene was full of excitement. People inside and outside the event site chanted the slogan "USA, USA...". Some supporters even burst into tears. Over the past two years, our lives have indeed undergone gratifying changes due to the efforts of the new president. Amidst the cheers from the audience, Trump still walked to the podium in high spirits, and the cheers continued. Trump introduced his two years of political achievements to everyone, hoping that everyone would still vote for him, "Keep America great," and said that Arizona's border security is still a priority, and the border wall will definitely be built. In his speech, Trump strongly recommended Arizona Congresswoman candidate Martha McSally. I hope voters will vote for her. The citizens of Arizona saw a president in his 70s running around for the benefit of the country and making the United States strong again.

768651bb839761a7da051ec8ef5ed666d509eb92.sourceText: 到现场支持特朗普的部分华裔
768651bb839761a7da051ec8ef5ed666d509eb92.translatedText: Some Chinese people who supported Trump at the event

1843171142d55744e9d567aea4a56385b2a468f8.sourceText: 从2016特朗普竞选开始，华人参政议政的愿望越来越强烈。 亚利桑那州华人挺川群成为全美第一个用飞机打出支持特朗普广告的 群体。再此之后， 挺川群的骨干成员们成立AZAA亚利桑那州亚裔联盟， 动员华人朋友参政议政，联合全美华裔反对亚裔细分， 并为有相同政见的政客募款，收集选票。 他们出钱出力用实际行动捍卫华人权益， 可以说是华人社区一股清流。在此特别呼吁华人朋友， 拿起你的选票，表达自己的意愿，发出我们的声音。
1843171142d55744e9d567aea4a56385b2a468f8.translatedText: Since the Trump campaign in 2016, the desire of Chinese people to participate in politics has become stronger and stronger. The Chinese pro-Sichuan group in Arizona became the first group in the United States to fly advertisements supporting Trump. After that, key members of the Tingchuan group established the AZAA Arizona Asian Alliance to mobilize Chinese friends to participate in politics, unite Chinese Americans across the United States to oppose Asian subdivision, and raise funds and votes for politicians with the same political views. They spend money and effort to defend the rights and interests of the Chinese with practical actions, which can be said to be a breath of fresh air in the Chinese community. I would like to specifically call on our Chinese friends to pick up your votes, express your wishes, and make our voices heard.

7ab5a00466ba0f00f840b7ce414cf8388f458faf.sourceText: 9月22日中国民族民间舞考级测试在亚省艺术学院举办
7ab5a00466ba0f00f840b7ce414cf8388f458faf.translatedText: On September 22, the Chinese Ethnic Folk Dance Grading Test was held at the Art College of Alberta

941b1e75d82d7b583cda92e21867e96c32614fff.sourceText: 教育学中考试是对教学质量的检验这一重要教育要素。教学质量的优劣是孩子，更是家长们最关心的。教学计划、方法、手段…
941b1e75d82d7b583cda92e21867e96c32614fff.translatedText: The Educational Secondary School Examination is an important educational element that tests the quality of teaching. The quality of teaching is what children and parents are most concerned about. Teaching plans, methods, means...

a257d719c1fcfd8f5540d4b328df6949f383e014.sourceText: 教育学中考试是对教学质量的检验这一重要教育要素。教学质量的优劣是孩子，更是家长们最关心的。教学计划、方法、手段、步骤以及教师自身素质和能力是影响教学质量的重要因素，这些因素对教材的实施也至关重要，即使是一套优秀的教材，在上述因素不完善的行课中，教师也难以达到教材的要求。而这些因素的完善只有通过教师的学习才能够完成，因此，中国民族民间舞考试中心严格要求教师培训持证教学。亚省艺术学院的邱晓榕老师，李慈慧老师，顺利通过舞蹈考级师资考试，获得资格证书。二位老师分别开设了考级一至十级的考级班，参加考级班的同学通过几个月的刻苦训练，准备于今年9月22日接受来自中国民族民间舞考级中心的考试。 考试时间：22号（周日）下午4点开始
a257d719c1fcfd8f5540d4b328df6949f383e014.translatedText: > The examination in education is an important educational element that tests the quality of teaching. The quality of teaching is what children and parents are most concerned about. Teaching plans, methods, means, steps, as well as teachers’ own qualities and abilities are important factors that affect the quality of teaching. These factors are also crucial to the implementation of teaching materials. Even if it is an excellent set of teaching materials, it will be difficult for teachers to meet the requirements of the teaching materials in a class where the above factors are imperfect. The improvement of these factors can only be completed through teacher's study. Therefore, the China Ethnic Folk Dance Examination Center strictly requires teachers to train and hold certified teaching. Teachers Qiu Xiaorong and Li Cihui from the Art Institute of Alberta successfully passed the dance teacher examination and obtained qualification certificates. The two teachers respectively opened grading classes for grades 1 to 10. After several months of hard training, the students participating in the class are preparing to take the exam from the Chinese Ethnic Folk Dance Grading Center on September 22 this year. Examination time: Starting at 4 pm on the 22nd (Sunday)

3f56770b3268f7e0284656de2d65fc89976ef3a0.sourceText: 考试当天，上午9–12点（5班到8班）（成人班）将由考官专家开设大师课，所有同学都可以参加。
3f56770b3268f7e0284656de2d65fc89976ef3a0.translatedText: On the day of the exam, from 9 to 12 am (Classes 5 to 8) (Adult Class), a master class will be held by examiner experts, and all students can participate.

dfcc48d8b6a7705c2ba7b4fdabe9831eee069ef9.sourceText: 大师课费用：3小时/$90。授课（老师介绍单独发）希望同学们抓住这个难得的机会，提升自己。
dfcc48d8b6a7705c2ba7b4fdabe9831eee069ef9.translatedText: Master class fee: 3 hours/$90. The lecture (the teacher’s introduction will be sent separately) hopes that students will seize this rare opportunity to improve themselves.

c3bff76f5d298be91f2c4bcb041fe89d93c797b6.sourceText: 参加考试也是一个自我实现、公平竞争的锻炼，应该让孩子们以一种放松的心态去参与考试，增强未来的生存能力。凡从小学舞蹈的孩子，长大后都有一个共同的特点——良好的形体，脱俗的气质，高雅的举止，充满活力、充满自信的人生。
c3bff76f5d298be91f2c4bcb041fe89d93c797b6.translatedText: Taking the exam is also an exercise for self-realization and fair competition. Children should be allowed to participate in the exam with a relaxed attitude to enhance their future survival ability. All children who have danced since elementary school have a common characteristic when they grow up - good shape, refined temperament, elegant manners, and a life full of energy and confidence.

37017346b325c13f8c70bf8e4fef1015835f3bc8.sourceText: 岁末年初，踏着2020年鼠年新春的脚步，亚省现代中文学校迎来了春季学年的开学日。本月18日上午，在亚利桑那州立大学的坦佩主校区，欢声笑语荡漾在冬日温暖的校园里，数百名师生、家长和义工们齐聚一堂，共同迎接现代中文学校春季学年的第一天！
37017346b325c13f8c70bf8e4fef1015835f3bc8.translatedText: At the end of the year and the beginning of the new year, following the footsteps of the New Year of the Year of the Rat in 2020, the Alberta Modern Chinese School ushered in the opening day of the spring school year. On the morning of the 18th of this month, at the main campus of Arizona State University in Tempe, laughter and laughter rippled in the warm winter campus. Hundreds of teachers, students, parents and volunteers gathered together to welcome the first day of the spring academic year of Modern Chinese School!

2e780e504c06873827bd4e896e1118755871f0ee.sourceText: 上午8时，在董事长陶世诚和校长杨轶伦的带领下，由董事会、校委会、部分老师、义工及学生会组成的工作小组，有条不紊地进行开学日的准备工作。于此之前，校委会已多次沟通与协调，有效落实课程设置、教师配备、教室调配及开学日工作流程等具体工作，提高新生注册程序的工作效率，同时，保证开学首日的教学质量！
2e780e504c06873827bd4e896e1118755871f0ee.translatedText: At 8 a.m., under the leadership of chairman Tao Shicheng and principal Yang Yilun, a working group composed of the board of directors, school committee, some teachers, volunteers and student unions carried out preparations for the opening day in an orderly manner. Prior to this, the school committee has communicated and coordinated many times to effectively implement specific tasks such as curriculum setting, teacher staffing, classroom deployment, and work procedures for the first day of school, to improve the efficiency of the new student registration process, and at the same time, ensure the quality of teaching on the first day of school!

1d8b201fa62c1a1f1a9ab7b08d899a8c5d3c201b.sourceText: 不到半小时，选课咨询的电脑注册系统就已经准备就绪，工作人员全部到位，等待前来咨询课程和需要现场注册的家长们；另一边，负责教材选购的工作人员根据学科和年级把教材分门别类，方便家长们阅览选择与现场购买。负责接待的工作人员们有条不紊地组织与疏导陆续到来的家长和学生们。大家精神抖擞地忙碌着，以最大的热情和最真诚的笑容接待每一位前来咨询的家长。
1d8b201fa62c1a1f1a9ab7b08d899a8c5d3c201b.translatedText: In less than half an hour, the computer registration system for course selection consultation was ready, and all staff were in place, waiting for parents who came to consult about courses and need to register on-site; on the other hand, the staff responsible for the purchase of teaching materials divided the teaching materials into categories according to subjects and grades, making it easier for parents to browse, select and purchase on-site. The reception staff organized and guided the arriving parents and students in an orderly manner. Everyone was busy and energetic, receiving every parent who came for consultation with the greatest enthusiasm and the most sincere smile.

c52f907dc9af7db8a953dda70d0fd26db752cab0.sourceText: 与此同时，各科老师们也都提前到岗，以最饱满的精神面貌欢迎每一位学生。以精益求精的治学态度，为孩子们带来春季学年精彩的第一堂课！
c52f907dc9af7db8a953dda70d0fd26db752cab0.translatedText: At the same time, teachers from all subjects also arrived early to welcome every student with the fullest spirit. With an academic attitude of striving for excellence, we will provide children with a wonderful first class of the spring school year!

4ac8100c6de76fccb360cbc17e1145612b2fcfab.sourceText: 目前，亚省中文学校共开设中文、数学、AP辅导、SAT辅导等多门基础课程，并积极拓展课外活动课程。除继续开设民族舞蹈、拉丁舞、合唱、美术、象棋、武术、摄影、化妆及公共演讲课程以外，春季学年特别邀请到专业老师开设散打及瑜伽课程，同时增设了ESL课程。董事会和校委会成员希望尽最大努力，调配最优质资源来满足所有学生的学习需要。 2019年已成为过去，我们回首，满是骄傲与自豪，因为2019真实记录了所有“现代人”努力进取的风茂；2020年如约而至，我们憧憬，满是期待与欣喜，因为开启一个新学年，我们又拥有了一个崭新的开始。在2020年新的征途上，所有“现代人”将继续开拓创新，勇往直前，迎接属于2020新的挑战，创造属于2020新的精彩！2020，我们继续“相约现代”！
4ac8100c6de76fccb360cbc17e1145612b2fcfab.translatedText: Currently, Chinese schools in Alberta offer many basic courses such as Chinese, mathematics, AP tutoring, SAT tutoring, etc., and actively expand extracurricular activities. In addition to continuing to offer courses in folk dance, Latin dance, chorus, art, chess, martial arts, photography, makeup and public speaking, professional teachers are specially invited to offer Sanda and yoga courses in the spring academic year, and ESL courses are also added. Members of the Board of Trustees and School Committee want to do their best to deploy the best resources to meet the learning needs of all students. 2019 has become the past, and we look back with pride and pride, because 2019 truly recorded the hard work and progress of all "modern people"; 2020 has arrived as promised, and we are looking forward to it, full of expectations and joy, because with the start of a new school year, we have a new beginning. On the new journey in 2020, all "modern people" will continue to innovate, move forward courageously, meet the new challenges of 2020, and create new excitement in 2020! In 2020, we will continue to "meet the modern world"!

424542d78cc60903b6632ffc7bd2c9649e60cbd8.sourceText: 随着 2019 年新春的到来，亚省现代中文学校的师生和家长们满怀豪情地迎来了 2019 年的春季新学期。本月 12 日周六上午，数百名师生，家长和义工们从凤凰城的四面八方来到了位于坦佩市区亚利桑那州立大学主校区里美丽的亚省现代中文学校。欢声笑语荡漾在校园里，新学期的第一天开始了。
424542d78cc60903b6632ffc7bd2c9649e60cbd8.translatedText: With the arrival of the New Year of 2019, teachers, students and parents of Alberta Modern Chinese School welcomed it with pride. The new spring semester of 2019. On the morning of Saturday, the 12th of this month, hundreds of teachers, students, parents and volunteers from all over Phoenix came to the beautiful Alberta Modern Chinese School on the main campus of Arizona State University in downtown Tempe. Laughter and laughter rippled through the campus as the first day of the new semester began.

b00bd9afd005a4ab069b980201db6a33c3e212d4.sourceText: 在校长杨轶伦和董事长陶世诚先生的带领下，开学第一天的各项工作开展得紧张而有序。位于学校二楼的办公室内，从上午 9 点钟开始就站满了前来选购教材和注册选课的家长和学生。学校董事会和校委会的成员几乎全部到场。他们和学校义工们一起帮助家长们注册课程，选购教材，解答家长们提出的各种问题，并且提供各种咨询服务。
b00bd9afd005a4ab069b980201db6a33c3e212d4.translatedText: Under the leadership of principal Yang Yilun and chairman Mr. Tao Shicheng, all the work on the first day of school was carried out nervously and orderly. The office on the second floor of the school has been filled with parents and students who came to buy textbooks and register for courses since 9 a.m. Nearly all members of the School Board and School Committee were present. Together with school volunteers, they help parents register for courses, purchase textbooks, answer various questions raised by parents, and provide various consulting services.

0643fdec8efcb90ab173825f9cdc3b9cbb6b1649.sourceText: 学校的老师们也都按时到岗，准时为孩子们开始讲授寒假后的第一节课。
0643fdec8efcb90ab173825f9cdc3b9cbb6b1649.translatedText: The teachers at the school also arrived on time and started teaching the children on time the first lesson after the winter vacation.

14fad57283b43f3516625bd9e10d7bdf588b075c.sourceText: 学校成人太极班的老师和学员们也是热情高涨，开学第一天就按时报到，集中进行了 2019 年春季的第一次太极拳活动。
14fad57283b43f3516625bd9e10d7bdf588b075c.translatedText: The teachers and students of the school’s adult Tai Chi class were also very enthusiastic. They reported on time on the first day of school and concentrated on the first Tai Chi activity in the spring of 2019.

0cfc4fc911d0e405e436c6bd9dcbea985bb5a199.sourceText: 现代中文学校的学生乐队在学校开学的当晚参加了凤凰城华人社团文艺团体举办的 2019 年春节联欢晚会的演出。现代中文学校的学生们身着红色的?#29616;代?#34920;演服装，在?#20170;夜无眠?#30340;乐曲声中，认真表演了精彩的中文朗诵节目，获得了观众的热烈掌声！
0cfc4fc911d0e405e436c6bd9dcbea985bb5a199.translatedText: The student band of Modern Chinese School participated in the performance of the 2019 Spring Festival Gala held by the Phoenix Chinese Community Arts Group on the night when the school started. The students of the Modern Chinese School, dressed in red performance costumes, performed a wonderful Chinese recitation program amidst the music of Sleepless Night, and received warm applause from the audience!

2ebe142d858204f422e04d0a2156b1de0f38f9f6.sourceText: 亚省现代中文学校将在新的学期里继续致力于传播中华文化，探索中文教学的研究，积极参加各项社区活动。
2ebe142d858204f422e04d0a2156b1de0f38f9f6.translatedText: >Alberta Modern Chinese School will continue to be committed to spreading Chinese culture, exploring research on Chinese teaching, and actively participating in various community activities in the new semester.

e54ae811dce42cf97a273c58e45d119b3c8f6180.sourceText: 热烈祝贺我校杨轶伦校长当选全美中文学校协会秘书长，亚省现代中文学校愿意继续为本社区的华文教育做出更大贡献！
e54ae811dce42cf97a273c58e45d119b3c8f6180.translatedText: Warm congratulations to Principal Yang Yilun of our school for being elected Secretary-General of the National Association of Chinese Schools. Modern Chinese School of Alberta is willing to continue to make greater contributions to Chinese education in this community!

5f0d623c8cab3480846989c5b05d8c145b1badb9.sourceText: Celebrating the 69th anniversary of People’s Republic of China My name is Kimberly Yee 余艷芬. I’m the Arizona Senate Majority Leader and I am honored to be invited to this evening’s event celebrating the 69th anniversary of People’s Republic of China. In 2010, I became the first Asian woman elected to the Arizona State Legislature in our state’s history. As the only Chinese American currently serving in the Arizona Legislature, it is important to represent our community and its interests. Chinese Americans are an integral part of our country’s great success as they have set forth tremendous efforts and have made significant contributions to the U.S. in various fields as science, engineering, business, education and the arts. The number of Asian-American-owned businesses in Arizona is growing rapidly, and these businesses produce revenues that outweigh other minority groups, according to a recent report by the Asian American Chamber of Commerce of Arizona. Asian-American-owned businesses produced $6.1 billion in revenue in 2012, even though Asian-Americans make up just 4 percent of the state’s population. The Asian population in Arizona nearly doubled between 2000 and 2010, the largest growth of any minority group. There are now more than 240,000 Asians in Arizona. Revenue by Asian-American-owned businesses in Arizona grew 35 percent between 2007 and 2012. Between 2007 and 2012, the number of Asian-owned businesses in Arizona also jumped 35 percent to 22,088 from 16,303, according to 2015 Census Bureau data. Continued partnerships for trade and business is important to our great state. It is a testament that the President and CEO of the Arizona Chamber of Commerce and Industry is here tonight to share in this celebration and show his support for continuing strong relations in business and industry between our two countries. There are so many business owners here tonight and I want to thank you for all that you have contributed to our economy in trade and business. You have helped to build he prosperity that Arizona enjoys today. Best wishes as we continue to enjoy peace, pursue democracy and attain economic prosperity!

6f3961f93fab6e4f18a4588f7c83edca6b6588b1.sourceText: 2018 年8 月，北京舞蹈学院高教师资团队前往美国洛杉矶开设了师资培训与考试。亚省艺术学院李慈慧老师经过三天30 支舞蹈，每天7 小时的学习，在考试中成功通过了1到3级的考核。亚省艺术学院也成为了亚利桑那州唯一的中国民族民间舞考级机构。
6f3961f93fab6e4f18a4588f7c83edca6b6588b1.translatedText: In August 2018, the higher education teaching staff of Beijing Dance Academy went to Los Angeles, the United States to offer teacher training and examinations. After three days of 30 dances and 7 hours of study every day, teacher Li Cihui from the Art Institute of Alberta successfully passed the assessment from Level 1 to Level 3. The Alberta College of the Arts has also become the only Chinese folk dance grading institution in Arizona.

1a1858e5c004296afcb6185677c7ca52f5f64bb8.translatedText: >Why do we need to take the exam?

2f68f0f5f86cd37b89d29dbb4b7b29a37a16825e.sourceText: 相信这是很多家长学生想问的问题。
2f68f0f5f86cd37b89d29dbb4b7b29a37a16825e.translatedText: I believe this is a question that many parents and students want to ask.

9ca967980ef1b0d4ff27592aa69d9d1e33069501.sourceText: 首先规范民族民间舞的教学内容。考级教材是由北京舞蹈学院资深专家结合几十年教学经验编辑而成。教学内容不仅丰富，而且根据不同年龄的孩子，不同程度，将各种民族民间舞的要素，集合在120个舞蹈组合里面。教材循序渐进，有连贯性，完整性，让全世界学习中国民族民间舞的孩子，规范，系统地学习。
9ca967980ef1b0d4ff27592aa69d9d1e33069501.translatedText: First of all, standardize the teaching content of ethnic folk dance. The examination materials are compiled by senior experts from Beijing Dance Academy based on decades of teaching experience. The teaching content is not only rich, but also integrates elements of various ethnic and folk dances into 120 dance combinations according to children of different ages and levels. The teaching materials are step-by-step, coherent and complete, allowing children around the world to learn Chinese folk dances in a standardized and systematic manner.

a0d5c8a3122650888a1ca995446f9439371ff9a9.sourceText: 其次，规范师资队伍。在海外教中国民族民间舞的机构越来越多，教师水品也参差不齐。中国民族民间舞考级需教师通过考核，未经考核和获取教师资格证不得授课。
a0d5c8a3122650888a1ca995446f9439371ff9a9.translatedText: Secondly, standardize the teaching staff. There are more and more institutions teaching Chinese folk dance overseas, and the quality of teachers is also uneven. Teachers must pass the assessment for Chinese ethnic and folk dance. Teachers are not allowed to teach without passing the assessment and obtaining a teacher qualification certificate.

943e4ae102e0ec8651bed6dfce01c5b5620c1d92.sourceText: 再次，规范评价体系。孩子和家长花了很多时间，精力，金钱让孩子学习中国民族民间舞，学得如何？是不是专业？到达了一个什么水准？不是授课老师来评价。孩子的努力，会受到更加公平和专业的鉴定。来自北京舞蹈学院的资深专家现场考核，并针对孩子的优缺点做点评。当然孩子也会不断有新目标，让努力得到认可。等级考试的最高级，将是专业水准要求。亚省艺术学院也获得了高级培训资格。将陆续开设中，高级课程。
943e4ae102e0ec8651bed6dfce01c5b5620c1d92.translatedText: Again, standardize the evaluation system. Children and parents have spent a lot of time, energy, and money on letting their children learn Chinese folk dance. How did they learn? Is it professional? What level has it reached? It is not the instructor who makes the evaluation. Children's efforts will be evaluated more fairly and professionally. Senior experts from Beijing Dance Academy conduct on-site assessments and comment on the children’s strengths and weaknesses. Of course, children will continue to have new goals so that their efforts will be recognized. The highest level of the grade examination will be the professional level requirement. The Art Institute of Alberta has also received advanced training qualifications. Intermediate and advanced courses will be offered gradually.

6b0198866fad9b0c2ee13f2c051366858f6dd697.sourceText: 最后，家长希望孩子在学习中国民族民间舞来继承我们中华民族的文化和传统，这是非常好的想法，只有我们自己对民族文化的认可和发扬光大，中华民族才能在世界民族之林获得一席之地。让孩子们建立自信，民族艺术会让他们变得更加独特和美丽，回到那句话?#27665;族的，就是世界的?#12290;
6b0198866fad9b0c2ee13f2c051366858f6dd697.translatedText: Finally, parents hope that their children can inherit the culture and traditions of our Chinese nation by learning Chinese folk dances. This is a very good idea. Only by recognizing and carrying forward our national culture can the Chinese nation gain a place among the nations of the world. Let children build up their self-confidence, and national arts will make them more unique and beautiful. Going back to that sentence?#27665;The nation belongs to the world?#12290;

d0789dc0d7b6189f26240b2508446b1b99ed77bf.sourceText: 中国民族民间舞考级教材是北京舞蹈学院著名舞蹈教育家潘志涛教授主编，以?#24841;悦教育和素质教育科学统一?#20026;出发点，强调身体多方位训练，强调多元化与趣味性相结合，使每一位参与者在快乐的舞蹈学习中不仅训练了形体，培养了气质，同时建立乐观自信的态度。
d0789dc0d7b6189f26240b2508446b1b99ed77bf.translatedText: The Chinese folk dance examination textbook is from Beijing Dance Academy Editor-in-chief, Professor Pan Zhitao, a famous dance educator, takes the scientific unification of joyful education and quality education as the starting point, emphasizing multi-faceted training of the body, emphasizing the combination of diversity and fun, so that every participant not only trains the body, cultivates temperament, but also builds an optimistic and confident attitude in happy dance learning.

23630068692b5213466def67492b267b4fefa086.sourceText: 教材每级十支舞蹈组合，从幼儿时期延伸到青少年，按成长的特点进行舞目编排，并由北京舞蹈学院中国民族民间舞系来进行教材音乐编审。
23630068692b5213466def67492b267b4fefa086.translatedText: The teaching materials include ten dance combinations for each level, extending from early childhood to adolescence. The dances are arranged according to the characteristics of growth, and the music of the teaching materials is edited by the Chinese Ethnic and Folk Dance Department of Beijing Dance Academy.

9ef034a5d203d1c90006d8f3e9866681cabc7f89.sourceText: 教材内容不仅包括汉、藏、蒙、维、朝五大民族的舞蹈还有哈尼族、达斡尔族、傈僳族、白族等多个少数民族舞蹈，共50多个舞种，让学生在学习舞蹈的同时了解中国民族文化。
9ef034a5d203d1c90006d8f3e9866681cabc7f89.translatedText: The teaching materials include not only the dances of the five major ethnic groups of Han, Tibetan, Mongolian, Uighur and Korean, but also the dances of Hani, Daur, Lisu, Bai and other ethnic minorities, with a total of more than 50 dance types, allowing students to learn about Chinese national culture while learning dance.

7788ff0150069ee2827014fee4e0ca0c34ba3584.translatedText: > May the children dance with joy.

87b5d3091a30cbd5e0322f26f5ac58b178c832e3.sourceText: 6月15日，亚利桑那州立大学中国留学生江玥车祸，被杀案，在凤凰城高等法院进行判决 ，法官接受了嫌犯Holly Davis以二级谋杀被定罪，获刑25年。这也是今年2月被告与检方达成的认罪协议，从开始的一级谋杀改为二级谋杀的最高刑期。
87b5d3091a30cbd5e0322f26f5ac58b178c832e3.translatedText: On June 15, the case of Jiang Yue, a Chinese student at Arizona State University, was killed in a car accident. The verdict was heard in the Phoenix Superior Court. The judge accepted that the suspect Holly Davis was convicted of second-degree murder and sentenced to 25 years in prison. This was also the plea agreement reached by the defendant and prosecutors in February this year, changing the initial sentence of first-degree murder to the maximum sentence of second-degree murder.

9b903898a6a7b287acded55f7532811c359f85f2.sourceText: 2016年1月16日，江玥开车在路上被嫌犯追尾，嫌犯下车近距离对车内开数枪，江玥因伤势过重抢救无效身亡。
9b903898a6a7b287acded55f7532811c359f85f2.translatedText: On January 16, 2016, Jiang Yue was rear-ended by a suspect while driving on the road. The suspect got out of the car and fired several shots into the car at close range. Jiang Yue died due to excessive injuries and rescue efforts failed.

e1f8fdcaac2743992ce3cc531caeb2894d087554.sourceText: 亚省2018年度JuniorDuck Stamp 鸭邮绘画庆典6月8日上午在Phoenix 动物园举行，来自Highminton High School 的九年级学生 Amanda Wong 获得本州最高奖揃est of Show’。她画的是夕阳余辉下一群Northen pintail抖动着美丽的翅膀，正飞回夜晚的栖息地，详情请访问https://www.fws.gov/birds/education/junior-duck-stamp-conservation-program/junior-duck-stamp-in-your-state-Arizona.php

Ninth grader Amanda Wong wins the state’s top award, Best of Show’. What she painted is a group of Northern pintails fluttering their beautiful wings under the afterglow of the setting sun, flying back to their night habitat. For details, please visit https://www.fws.gov/birds/education/junior-duck-stamp-conservation-program/junior-duck-stamp-in-your-state-Arizona.php

96b452e7cc6532fdc52155abb7f54bda825bbc5d.sourceText: Amanda 从小热爱绘画，近年来利用周末时间，在林峰画家的指导，进行全面的绘画础训练，使她在绘画造型，色彩应用，艺术创作等方面有了长足的进步。半年来，Amanda参加的Scholastic art and writing awards 获得了银奖；?018 Young Artists Authorscompetition’获得了第一名，并代表Chandler city 参加Washington D.C.国际联盟城市的最后竞赛；在亚省patriotic 绘画比赛中荣获第二名。
96b452e7cc6532fdc52155abb7f54bda825bbc5d.translatedText: >Amanda She has loved painting since she was a child. In recent years, she has used her weekend time to receive comprehensive basic painting training under the guidance of painter Lin Feng, which has enabled her to make great progress in painting modeling, color application, and artistic creation. In the past six months, Amanda has participated in the Scholastic art and writing awards and won the silver medal; won first place in the 2018 Young Artists Authors Competition, and represented Chandler city in the final competition of the Washington D.C. International League City; and won second place in the Alberta Patriot Painting Competition.

7f44bfbd8f14a035b3cd58f1fdcd45be034a9c1d.sourceText: 鸭邮是美国官方机构组织的，为环境保护筹集资金而设立的一项绘画赛事，鸭画则是要求非常逼真的写实。林峰画家认为：对于中小学生来说，长时间对照鸭子的图片准确复制，孩子对绘画的艺术审美，理解以及艺术创新都会产生偏差，更会摧残和扼杀孩子的绘画个性和艺术天赋。因此林峰画家不鼓励学生参赛，对有兴趣参赛的学生也要求只能在每年的2月份开始，三月初完成并交稿，限定时间完成。画鸭培养了学生工匠绘画的耐心和技能，但所带来的弊端更多。
7f44bfbd8f14a035b3cd58f1fdcd45be034a9c1d.translatedText: Duck Post is a painting competition organized by the United States official organization to raise funds for environmental protection. Duck painting requires very realistic realism. Painter Lin Feng believes that for primary and secondary school students, if they compare the accurate copying of duck pictures for a long time, the children's artistic aesthetics, understanding and artistic innovation of painting will be biased, and it will destroy and stifle the children's painting personality and artistic talent. Therefore, Lin Feng Painter does not encourage students to participate. Students who are interested in participating are also required to start in February and complete and submit the manuscript in early March each year, within a limited time. Painting ducks cultivates the patience and skills of student craftsmen in painting, but it also brings more disadvantages.

30da1ad483834fd512e004ee12f7b3f392e55507.sourceText: 和往年一样，今年各年龄组的获奖者主要都来自华裔的家庭，说明许多华裔孩子非常重视，并刻苦努力。

2c1cf316ae698aa98e76b3636eabf4729ef5350e.sourceText: 为了热烈庆祝中华人民共和国成立69周年,亚省各界华人华侨將联合举办庆祝国庆活动。 兹定于2018年9月15日(星期六)晚上6:00时,在新世界海鲜酒楼举办国庆晚宴。晚宴由亚省华 人华侨联合会、大凤凰城地区侨团联合总会和亚利桑那州华人华侨联合总会(排名不分先后)聯 合举办。届时将举行隆重的升旗仪式和文艺演出,并誠邀中国驻洛杉矶总领事馆派员莅临凤凰城 出席庆祝活动。歡迎各界人士踴躍參加。(餐費每位30元) 亚省各界华人华侨庆祝中华人民共和国国庆活动筹备委员会供稿
2c1cf316ae698aa98e76b3636eabf4729ef5350e.translatedText: In order to warmly celebrate the 69th anniversary of the founding of the People's Republic of China, Chinese and overseas Chinese from all walks of life in Alberta will jointly hold National Day celebration activities. A National Day dinner will be held at New World Seafood Restaurant at 6:00 pm on September 15, 2018 (Saturday). The dinner was jointly organized by the Alberta Chinese and Overseas Chinese Federation, the Greater Phoenix Area Overseas Chinese Federation and the Arizona Chinese and Overseas Chinese Federation (in no particular order). A grand flag-raising ceremony and artistic performances will be held, and officials from the Chinese Consulate General in Los Angeles are sincerely invited to Phoenix to attend the celebrations. People from all walks of life are welcome to participate. (Meal cost 30 yuan per person) Contributed by the Preparatory Committee for Chinese and Overseas Chinese from all walks of life in Alberta to celebrate the National Day of the People's Republic of China

a9f43f6427ea4ffa7ff70c386f781f1271f801f8.sourceText: (亚利桑那现代中文学校供稿) 为了帮助海外华文学校改善办学条件、优化办学环境、提升 教学水平，逐步建立起”培训、考核、认证”三位一体的华文教师培训机制。日前，由国 侨办主办、全美中文学校协会协办、协会凤凰城联络中心、亚省那现代中文学校和亚省希 望中文学校承办的”海外华文教育名师巡讲团”行莅临凤凰城。
a9f43f6427ea4ffa7ff70c386f781f1271f801f8.translatedText: (contributed by Arizona Modern Chinese School) In order to help overseas Chinese schools improve school conditions, optimize the school environment, and enhance To improve the teaching level, a three-in-one Chinese teacher training mechanism of "training, assessment, and certification" has been gradually established. Recently, the "Overseas Chinese Education Famous Teacher Tour", sponsored by the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the State Council, co-organized by the National Association of Chinese Schools, and hosted by the association's Phoenix Contact Center, Alberta Modern Chinese School and Alberta Hope Chinese School, visited Phoenix.

cdec721d7f50788fad46ab7c267b292d860f7091.sourceText: 2018 年 8 月 4 日，正值亚省现代中文学校新学年即将开学之际，凤凰城广大中文教 师就迎来了华文教育名师巡讲团的专家们。我校领导高度重视此次讲座，校长 Allan Yang 数月前就开始联合亚省希望中文学校和本地其他中文学校领导积极动员中文学校的教师参 加，反复宣讲本次培训机会难得，希望全体中文教师和中文教育的爱好者积极参加。董事 长陶世诚等学校主要领导也积极配合全美中文学校协会开展和此次活动有关的组织工作。
cdec721d7f50788fad46ab7c267b292d860f7091.translatedText: On August 4, 2018, just as the new school year of modern Chinese schools in Alberta was about to begin, the majority of Chinese teachers in Phoenix welcomed experts from the famous Chinese education teacher tour group. The leaders of our school attach great importance to this lecture. A few months ago, Principal Allan Yang began to work with the leaders of Hope Chinese School in Alberta and other local Chinese schools to actively mobilize teachers from Chinese schools to participate. He repeatedly preached that this training opportunity was rare and hoped that all Chinese teachers and Chinese education enthusiasts would actively participate. Chairman Tao Shicheng and other major school leaders also actively cooperated with the National Association of Chinese Schools to carry out organizational work related to this event.

c64dac5df9562abb8e823701ff442e10b2c3da47.sourceText: 上午九点，培训讲座在亚省那现代中文学校所在的亚利桑那州立大学主校区 Discovery Hall 准时开始。近百名本地中文教师和慕名远道而来的中文教育爱好者济济一堂。 首先，由全美中文学校协会前会长、凤凰城地区联络中心主任帅致若向老师们隆重介绍了 本次名师巡讲团成员：巡讲团团长江苏省侨办华文教育发展中心杨严主任，南京大学艺术 学院康尔教授，苏州大学教育学院心理系丁芳教授，连云港市解放路小学校长、特级教师 华雪珍老师。这些老师都是国内的学府精英、在华文教育教学上经验丰富的名师。帅会长 并代表大家感谢国侨办送”教上门”，多年来为海外华文教育做出了杰出的贡献。
c64dac5df9562abb8e823701ff442e10b2c3da47.translatedText: At nine o'clock in the morning, the training lecture started on time at Discovery Hall on the main campus of Arizona State University where the Alberta Modern Chinese School is located. Nearly a hundred local Chinese teachers and Chinese education enthusiasts who came from afar gathered together. First of all, Shuai Zhiruo, former president of the National Association of Chinese Schools and Director of the Phoenix Area Liaison Center, solemnly introduced the members of this famous teacher tour group to the teachers: the tour group leader, Director Yang Yan of the Chinese Education Development Center of the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of Jiangsu Province, Professor Kang Er from the School of Art of Nanjing University, Professor Ding Fang from the Department of Psychology, School of Education, Suzhou University, and Teacher Hua Xuezhen, the principal and special teacher of Jiefang Road Primary School in Lianyungang City. These teachers are all domestic academic elites and famous teachers with rich experience in Chinese education and teaching. President Shuai also thanked the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the State Council on behalf of everyone for sending “door-to-door teachers” and making outstanding contributions to overseas Chinese education over the years.

4c7757ca14f2b3a298109bbad2462524327a37c5.sourceText: 接着是这次主要承办学校亚省现代中文学校校长 Allan Yang 致辞。杨校长首先感谢名 师巡讲团的专家们不远万里来到美国推广华文教育，感谢国侨办采取多形式、多渠道培训 海外华文教师，使得海外华校能在传播中国文化的道路上走的更顺畅。杨校长衷心感谢其 他参与组织工作的本地华文教育的领导，亚省希望中文学校校长田琳、董事长李健，图桑 祖筍中文学校校长曹佩琴，凤城华人基督教会中文学校校长彭新立，凤凰城中文学校校长 程秀玲，并再次感谢每位出席活动的中文教师积极参与这次培训！最后，杨校长宣布培训 正式开始！
4c7757ca14f2b3a298109bbad2462524327a37c5.translatedText: Then the speech was delivered by Allan Yang, principal of the Alberta Modern Chinese School, the main host school. Principal Yang first thanked the experts from the Famous Teacher Tour Team for traveling thousands of miles to the United States to promote Chinese education, and thanked the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the State Council for its multi-form and multi-channel training of overseas Chinese teachers, which has enabled overseas Chinese schools to spread Chinese culture more smoothly. Principal Yang sincerely thanked other local Chinese education leaders who participated in the organization, including Tian Lin, principal of Hope Chinese School in Alberta, and Li Jian, chairman of the board of directors, Cao Peiqin, principal of Zusun Chinese School in Tucson, Peng Xinli, principal of Fengcheng Chinese Christian Church Chinese School, Cheng Xiuling, principal of Phoenix Chinese School, and once again thanked every Chinese teacher who attended the event for actively participating in this training! Finally, Principal Yang announced that the training had officially begun!

d04d99fa909e577b09d39ed04c7fa0ad3b6fb3e6.sourceText: 首先主讲的丁芳教授带给大家的演讲题目是”儿童语言学习的心理特点与兴趣培 养”。丁教授是苏州大学教育学院心理系教授，硕士生导师，主要专注与儿童心理理论等 方面的研究，至今已发表过 80 余篇相关学术论文。她主要强调在讲课过程中要结合儿童 语言学习的心理特点，从儿童的认知发展年龄、语言习得过程等方面入手，并提出了相应 的教学建议。比如，好这个字，丁教授在讲解当中，给了一个非常有趣的图片，左边是一 个妈妈，右边这个妈妈用手托着孩子，又形象又容易理解，这样的教学非常符合低年级学 生的年龄特质。她还向老师们介绍了皮亚杰、伊根等心理学大师的理论，深入浅出地讲解 了如何结合多元智能的活动设计与利用中国文化的元素的教学法，使老师们真正感受到― 教学是一门艺术，谁将它演绎的好，谁就能感化学生的心灵！
d04d99fa909e577b09d39ed04c7fa0ad3b6fb3e6.translatedText: >Professor Ding Fang, who gave the first lecture, gave everyone a speech entitled "Psychological Characteristics and Interest Cultivation of Children's Language Learning". Professor Ding is a professor in the Psychology Department of the School of Education of Soochow University and a master's tutor. He mainly focuses on research on child psychological theory and has published more than 80 related academic papers so far. She mainly emphasized that the psychological characteristics of children's language learning should be combined in the teaching process, starting from the cognitive development age of children, language acquisition process, etc., and put forward corresponding teaching suggestions. For example, during the explanation of the word "good", Professor Ding gave a very interesting picture. On the left is a mother, and on the right the mother is holding her child with her hands. It is vivid and easy to understand. This kind of teaching is very suitable for the age characteristics of lower grade students. She also introduced the theories of psychology masters such as Piaget and Egan to the teachers, and explained in a simple and easy-to-understand way how to combine the activity design of multiple intelligences with the teaching methods that use elements of Chinese culture, so that the teachers can truly feel that teaching is an art, and whoever interprets it well can influence the hearts of students!

5f925f347efc9ebf028a251e6c2d9a548cac5819.sourceText: 第二位华雪珍老师主讲的题目是”童乐汉语”。华雪珍老师是连云港市解放路小学 校长、”华雪珍小学语文名师工作室”主持人，曾荣获无数省、市、乃至全国课堂教学大 赛奖项。从事多年的小学语文教学工作，华老师立足儿童视角，从识字、阅读、写作、展 示等层面，循序渐进地讲解了如何培养语言学习能力，如何发掘儿童学习潜能，让全体在 座老师体会到老师不仅是传道授业者，同时更是引导者。特别值得一提的是，华老师向大 家展示了趣味别致的手工课件设计—–做端午香囊。整个课件设计让学生既领略了中国传 统节日的诗歌和文化习俗，又学习制作了端午香囊，更重要的是感受了中国诗词和文化的 魅力。
5f925f347efc9ebf028a251e6c2d9a548cac5819.translatedText: The second teacher Hua Xuezhen lectured on the topic "Children's Chinese". Teacher Hua Xuezhen is the principal of Jiefang Road Primary School in Lianyungang City and the host of the "Hua Xuezhen Primary School Chinese Teacher Studio". She has won numerous provincial, municipal, and even national classroom teaching competition awards. Having been engaged in primary school Chinese teaching for many years, Teacher Hua based her perspective on children and explained step by step how to cultivate language learning abilities and how to explore children's learning potential from the perspectives of literacy, reading, writing, and presentation. This allowed all teachers present to realize that teachers are not only evangelists, but also guides. What is particularly worth mentioning is that Teacher Hua showed everyone an interesting and unique handmade courseware design - making Dragon Boat Festival sachets. The entire courseware design allows students to not only appreciate the poetry and cultural customs of traditional Chinese festivals, but also learn to make Dragon Boat Festival sachets, and more importantly, feel the charm of Chinese poetry and culture.

0471aa526448bbf674fc9b842dcd650595560c4a.sourceText: 海内外知名的康尔教授主讲的题目是”漫谈中华传统文化”。康教授是中国美学专 家，现任南京大学艺术学院教授、博士生导师。他还是央视《百家讲坛》栏目主持人之一。 康教授撰写的剧本，曾两次获得中国电视剧”飞天奖”。康教授幽默风趣的讲座分析了中 国传统文化的主要构成，论述了中国传统哲学以及儒、道、释三家思想的精髓。他从宇宙 观、生存关、审美观、艺术观、创作批评观等五个方面论述中华美学文化精神的特征，并 列举了大量的实例、名人、民歌、艺术家及中国早期优秀电影等，让老师们更进一步了解 了中国特色美学的独特魅力与中华美学精神以及中华美学的范畴。康教授用旁征博引的演 讲引领着老师们穿越数千年的历史，寻根溯源领略了中华文化的恢宏气势和博大精深。
0471aa526448bbf674fc9b842dcd650595560c4a.translatedText: Professor Kang'er, a well-known professor at home and abroad, gave a lecture titled "Discussing Chinese Traditional Culture." Professor Kang is an expert in Chinese aesthetics and currently serves as a professor and doctoral supervisor at the School of Arts, Nanjing University. He is also one of the hosts of CCTV's "Hundred Forum" column. The script written by Professor Kang has won the Chinese TV Drama "Feitian Award" twice. Professor Kang's humorous lecture analyzed the main components of traditional Chinese culture and discussed the essence of traditional Chinese philosophy and Confucianism, Taoism and Buddhism. He discussed the characteristics of Chinese aesthetics and cultural spirit from five aspects: cosmology, survival, aesthetics, art, and creative criticism, and listed a large number of examples, celebrities, folk songs, artists, and early Chinese outstanding films, allowing teachers to further understand the unique charm of aesthetics with Chinese characteristics, the spirit of Chinese aesthetics, and the scope of Chinese aesthetics. Professor Kang used his eloquent speech to lead the teachers through thousands of years of history, tracing their roots and appreciating the grandeur, breadth and depth of Chinese culture.

a77066f39b4e1ee9ea9b865429da4f31f6b998d5.sourceText: 这次培训取得了圆满成功，由于组委会的积极筹备，参加巡讲团凤凰城站培训的老 师远超许多姐妹城市的参训人数。我们要特别感谢亚省现代中文学校和亚省希望中文学校 校委会、董事会的精心组织和无私奉献以及全体中文老师的大力支持。引用专家团一位老 师的话；热情周到而不失厚道，感觉如沐春风！也再次感谢国侨办及全美中文学校协会！ 感谢名师巡讲团的专家！感谢所有与会的中文老师和朋友们！
a77066f39b4e1ee9ea9b865429da4f31f6b998d5.translatedText: This training was a complete success. Due to the active preparations of the organizing committee, the number of teachers participating in the training at the Phoenix Station of the tour team far exceeded the number of participants in many sister cities. We would like to especially thank the school committees and boards of the Alberta Modern Chinese School and the Alberta Hope Chinese School for their careful organization and selfless dedication, as well as the strong support of all Chinese teachers. To quote a teacher from the expert group: He is warm and considerate yet kind, and feels like a spring breeze! Thanks again to the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the State Council and the National Association of Chinese Schools! Thanks to the experts from the famous teacher tour group! Thank you to all Chinese teachers and friends who attended the conference!

4ceb1f7f63fa35f622c0f2f937dbf6499d3012b7.sourceText: PROMINENT AZ SPINE SURGEON DR. ANTHONY YEUNG OF DISC ANNOUNCES HIS SUPPORT OF THE FIGHT TO SAVE PCCC Phoenix, Arizona: The most prominent spine surgeon in the southwest has joined the fight to save the Phoenix Chinese Cultural Center.?nbsp; Dr. Anthony Yeung, Senior Associate at Desert Institute for Spine Care (DISC), announced his support to the preservation effort today after meeting with several representatives who are battling to save the Center. His support is crucial to our effort to preserve the Center,?said Thomas Simon, Spokesman for Chinese United Association of Greater Phoenix (CUAGP), an umbrella non-profit that represents over 29 Asian-American non-profits in the Phoenix area. Dr. Yeung is a leader in the community, and his success in the medical field is well documented. Adding his support is a strong signal to every successful Asian-American that it憇 time to get off the sidelines and fight for equal rights and fair treatment,?said Simon. Dr. Yeung will speak at a special conference and dinner this Friday, April 20, 2018, to be held at the Beijing Garden Restaurant, located in the Chinese Cultural Center. The seating will begin at 7PM, and Dr. Yeung will address an audience of successful Asian-Americans in a Key-Note Speech at 8:30PM. The title of Dr. Yeung’s address: Chinese Americans in Arizona and Their Responsility to Save the Chinese Cultural Center. According to Dr. Yeung, he decided to support the effort after discovering that ”This is a property rights issue. We’re talking about the property rights of a Chinese American,’said the surgeon, ‘and that’s something we can all understand.’ Speaking directly about the Investment Banker David Tedesco and his desire to destroy the Center, Dr. Yeung did not mince words: ‘What Tedesco is trying to do is a direct affront to every minority property owner in the state, and particularly to all Asian Americans. He must be stopped,’he added. Chinese Americans in Arizona The Doctor is expected to attend the eviction trial for Beijing Garden Restaurant on Monday at 9 AM, to be held at the the Maricopa County Courthouse, East Court Building, 101 West Jefferson, Courtroom 813, Phoenix, AZ 85003.

229a8d35e7ced78f97d6ed98f28e5e0b5f25f33a.sourceText: Uber自驾车闯祸 美亚利桑那州暂停测试 （中央社旧金山26日综合外电报导）美国亚利桑那州州长杜席今天踩刹车，宣布优步（Uber）自动驾驶车测试计划喊卡。亚利桑那州日前发生自驾车撞死人悲剧，杜席看了行车记录器影像后，表示感到「不安与担忧」。 亚利桑那州州长杜席（Doug Ducey）致函Uber执行长柯霍斯洛夏西（Dara Khosrowshahi），声称他指示交通部门官员，暂时别让Uber在公路测试或驾驶自驾车。 杜席在信件中说：「我觉得录影画面令人感到不安与担忧，Uber能否持续在亚利桑那州测试自驾车，现在产生了许多疑虑。」 一辆Uber自驾车18日撞死一名行人，Uber旋即暂停美国自驾车计划。 Uber发言人告诉法新社：「上周发生那场悲剧后，我们主动暂停所有城市的自驾车营运计划。」他说：「我们持续尽可能地协助调查人员，我们今后将保持与州长办公室的对话管道畅通。」 这宗全球首起自驾车撞死行人案例的行车记录器影像拍到，Uber自驾车操作者似乎分心了，而且车祸前几秒表情惊恐，倒抽了几口气。 从影像中可见驾驶低头看著某个东西将近5秒钟，之后终于凝视前方，接著车子在坦佩（Tempe）撞到一名女子。 警方公布了这段画面，以及牵著脚踏车的行人在昏暗公路上遭撞击前几秒的行车记录器影像。这辆车子当时是处于自驾模式。 警察局长莫伊尔（Sylvia Moir）上周告诉「旧金山纪事报」（San Francisco Chronicle），尽管当局仍在持续调查，「初步来看Uber可能没错」，主因这名行人没有走在斑马线上。 莫伊尔告诉旧金山纪事报：「由于她是从阴暗处直接走到公路上，无论在任何模式下，这种撞击显然很难避免。」 Uber发生自驾车撞人意外后，各界质疑当局允许企业将公路当成自驾车科技测试地点，是否等于让民众置于险境。 与此同时，自驾车提倡者主张，只要避免人类驾驶失误，他们有可能把道路变得更安全。 亚利桑那州与加州向来特别大力支持自驾车，希望当地的自驾技术研发公司能创造就业与建厂，发展这个备受看好的新产业。（译者：张晓雯/核稿：卢映孜）
229a8d35e7ced78f97d6ed98f28e5e0b5f25f33a.translatedText: Uber's self-driving car crashes, Arizona suspends testing (Central News Agency, San Francisco, comprehensive foreign news report on the 26th) Governor Du Xi of the US state of Arizona hit the brakes today and announced that Uber’s self-driving car test plan has been suspended. A tragedy occurred when a self-driving car hit and killed someone in Arizona. After watching the driving recorder video, Du Xi expressed that he felt "uneasy and worried." Arizona Governor Doug Ducey sent a letter to Uber CEO Dara Khosrowshahi stating that he was instructing transportation officials not to allow Uber to test or drive self-driving cars on public roads for the time being. Du Xi said in the letter: "I think the video is disturbing and worrying. There are now many doubts about whether Uber can continue to test self-driving cars in Arizona." An Uber self-driving car hit and killed a pedestrian on the 18th, and Uber immediately suspended its US self-driving program. An Uber spokesman told AFP: "After last week's tragedy, we proactively suspended self-driving operations in all cities." He said: "We continue to assist investigators as much as possible, and we will keep the dialogue channel with the governor's office open in the future." The video shows the driver looking down at something for nearly five seconds before finally staring forward before the car hits a woman in Tempe. Police released the footage, as well as dash cam footage of the seconds before the pedestrian was hit on a dimly lit road. The car was in self-driving mode at the time. Police Chief Sylvia Moir told the San Francisco Chronicle last week that while authorities are continuing to investigate, "preliminarily it seems Uber may be right" because the pedestrian was not walking on a zebra crossing. Moyle told the San Francisco Chronicle: "Because she walked directly from the shadows to the road, no matter what mode she was in, this kind of impact was obviously difficult to avoid." After Uber's self-driving car crashed into someone, people from all walks of life questioned whether the authorities were putting people at risk by allowing companies to use roads as test sites for self-driving technology. At the same time, self-driving advocates argue that they have the potential to make roads safer by eliminating human mistakes. Arizona and California have always been particularly strong supporters of self-driving cars. They hope that local self-driving technology research and development companies can create jobs and build factories to develop this promising new industry. (Translator: Zhang Xiaowen/Verification: Lu Yingzi)

c2465b8efa3658590a5e2951c7fcae026044237f.translatedText: The rejection rate of H-1B visas in the United States has soared. About a quarter of them were rejected in 2017

041094967a642fdcf897f9645ef00d1cba9686b4.translatedText: The rejection rate of H-1B visas in the United States soared. About a quarter of them were rejected in 2017. Data map: Trump. China Overseas Chinese Network, March 29. According to the United States' "World...

20a7fba5b1551d53b431ed98c65c379743010620.sourceText: 中国侨网3月29日电 据美国《世界日报》报道，根据美国联邦公民及移民服务局(USCIS)数据，一年前，每五件申请案不到一件遭驳回；但去年1月至8月期间，平均每四件申请案就有超过一件被驳回；律师预测，这样严峻的形势可能只是开始，日后只会越来越难。
20a7fba5b1551d53b431ed98c65c379743010620.translatedText: China Overseas Chinese Network, March 29. According to the U.S. "World Journal", according to U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS) data, a year ago, less than one out of every five applications was rejected; but between January and August last year, an average of more than one out of every four applications was rejected; lawyers predict that this severe situation may be just the beginning, and it will only become more and more difficult in the future.

b6fbdd7791a676d7db334ba2c0e0780874d89310.sourceText: 在南加州一家上市公司工作超过三年的吴小姐，2017年申请H-1B更新；她在2014年首次申请时很顺利，没有遇到任何困难，心想这次更新肯定不会有状况；未料她在经历补件和超过大半年等待后，仍收到移民局拒绝信，没有任何心理准备的她，必须在几周内做好工作交接并离职。
b6fbdd7791a676d7db334ba2c0e0780874d89310.translatedText: Ms. Wu, who has worked for a listed company in Southern California for more than three years, applied for H-1B renewal in 2017. Her first application in 2014 went smoothly without any difficulties, and she thought there would be no problems with the renewal this time. Unexpectedly, she still received a rejection letter from the Immigration Bureau after waiting for more than half a year to complete the application. Without any psychological preparation, she had to make a job handover and leave her job within a few weeks.

78abc5fecc11fa9ac70b744da719f02a83eb1c04.sourceText: 吴小姐说，三年来，她工作表现很好，不仅当了部门内的”小官”，还获得加薪，公司还为她办绿卡。她的美国梦看似逐渐实现，没想到移民局居然在一个更新案件上拒绝她，让她非常震惊，”不仅丢了工作和收入，最头疼的是离职后，公司不得不终止绿卡申请，让她前几年付出的所有心血都白费。”
78abc5fecc11fa9ac70b744da719f02a83eb1c04.translatedText: Ms. Wu said that in the past three years, she has performed very well at work. Not only did she become a "minor official" in the department, she also received a salary increase, and the company also applied for a green card for her. Her American dream seemed to be gradually coming true, but she was shocked when the Immigration Bureau actually rejected her in a renewal case. "Not only did she lose her job and income, but the most troublesome thing was that after leaving her job, the company had to terminate the green card application, making all her hard work in the past few years in vain."

6cd437587670eaaea38e39f56fa66cc2d91f74ee.sourceText: 律师表示，向移民局申诉，费时费力，且胜算很小，不如2018年4月再重新申请H-1B。
6cd437587670eaaea38e39f56fa66cc2d91f74ee.translatedText: The lawyer said that appealing to the Immigration Bureau is time-consuming and laborious, and the chance of winning is very small. It is better to reapply for H-1B in April 2018.

eb1330a9eace63eea646d9b3b4995564f183f347.sourceText: 吴小姐为了留在美国，只有在离职后，花了几千元注册重返学校，确保以学生身份合法留在美国。然而4月还将面临超过20万人争抢85000个名额的H-1B抽签的惨烈竞争，即使幸运中签，也难保证移民局不再给她出难题。
eb1330a9eace63eea646d9b3b4995564f183f347.translatedText: In order to stay in the United States, Ms. Wu spent thousands of dollars to register and return to school after leaving her job to ensure that she could legally stay in the United States as a student. However, in April, she will face fierce competition with more than 200,000 people competing for the 85,000 H-1B lottery. Even if she is lucky enough to win the lottery, it is difficult to guarantee that the Immigration Bureau will no longer cause problems for her.

2a4dff3fab48af4e36ea614e977e72562f030997.sourceText: 今年的H-1B工作签证递件日将至，虽然整体名额并未减少，但在特朗普总统签署”买美国货，雇美国人”的行政命令后，H-1B的补件通知(Request for Evidence)数量去年达高峰，较2016和2015年分别多出40%、65%，大大增加取得H-1B的难度。
2a4dff3fab48af4e36ea614e977e72562f030997.translatedText: This year's H-1B work visa application date is approaching. Although the overall quota has not been reduced, after President Trump signed the "Buy American, Hire American" executive order, the number of H-1B Request for Evidence reached a peak last year, which was 40% and 65% more than in 2016 and 2015 respectively, greatly increasing the difficulty of obtaining H-1B.

cf57563722a776cafbff2073b1fc0bc1d64be39d.sourceText: 虽然今年H-1B的一般名额仍有65000人，特朗普在去年4月和7月颁布了两道行政令和行政备忘录，要求国土安全部(DHS)加强对移民类签证和福利的严格审核，明显影响申请者等待时间。
cf57563722a776cafbff2073b1fc0bc1d64be39d.translatedText: Although the general quota for H-1B this year is still 65,000, Trump issued two executive orders and administrative memorandums in April and July last year, requiring the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) to strengthen strict review of immigrant visas and benefits, which significantly affected the waiting time of applicants.

57fc5e480bdbb617ff1859d352ad5c77cddb4e67.sourceText: 移民律师黄子虔表示，特朗普上任时，很多人以为移民局打击的目标只是非法移民，现在看来连职业移民、跨国公司经理人(L-1)、投资移民等，都遭遇困难。
57fc5e480bdbb617ff1859d352ad5c77cddb4e67.translatedText: Immigration lawyer Huang Ziqian said that when Trump took office, many people thought that the target of the Immigration Service was only illegal immigrants. Now it seems that even professional immigrants, multinational company managers (L-1), investment immigrants, etc. are encountering difficulties.

0f5156b46a168c0381e09f7f189ad0c400fec375.sourceText: 他说，过去移民局要求H-1B补件本身并不新鲜，移民律师很清楚哪里有问题与如何补救，”只要用心去准备，再次提交材料，通过审核不是难题。”
0f5156b46a168c0381e09f7f189ad0c400fec375.translatedText: He said that in the past, the Immigration Bureau's request for H-1B supplementary documents was not new. Immigration lawyers knew very well where there were problems and how to remedy them. "As long as you prepare carefully and submit the materials again, it is not a problem to pass the review."

33e02d3bdafc688268c638cd2446bc296f4915a8.sourceText: 但现在黄子虔和不少移民律师都看到一个”奇怪的趋势”，即补件时并没有被要求提交很多材料，但后来移民局却以之前完全没有提到的材料或问题来拒绝，”我们根本不知道移民官在想什么，有时都被拒绝得莫名其妙。”
33e02d3bdafc688268c638cd2446bc296f4915a8.translatedText: But now Huang Ziqian and many immigration lawyers have seen a "strange trend", that is, they were not required to submit many materials when supplementing the documents, but later the Immigration Bureau did not mention it at all before. "We have no idea what the immigration officer is thinking, and sometimes we are rejected inexplicably."

3de9e10a42430f95af8cd731e244c611839aee5f.sourceText: 他说，如果补件的时候不提某个问题，申请人就没有机会解释说明，之后却又因此问题被移民局拒绝，这样的程序对申请人很不公平，”糟糕的是问题现在普遍存在。”
3de9e10a42430f95af8cd731e244c611839aee5f.translatedText: He said that if a certain issue is not mentioned when supplementing the document, the applicant will not have the opportunity to explain, and then he will be rejected by the Immigration Bureau because of the issue. Such a procedure is very unfair to the applicant. "The worst thing is that the problem is now widespread."

e6b05ef2f7c4330a1cea1d12e9f7e09435fd4f99.sourceText: 移民局局长西斯纳(L. Francis Cissna)在一份声明中表示，要求申请者提供更多文件，能够确保批准H-1B的准确性，”确保每一个申请者都符合当局标准和个人的首要条件”。
e6b05ef2f7c4330a1cea1d12e9f7e09435fd4f99.translatedText: Immigration Bureau Director Cissna (L. Francis Cissna said in a statement that requiring applicants to provide more documentation will ensure the accuracy of H-1B approval and "ensure that each applicant meets the agency's standards and individual priorities."

cb2a686135487e166ca41af53da9af001f0074db.sourceText: 不过，对于补件通知数量去年大增的说法，西斯纳则反驳说，应该从发放通知的比率来看较准确；数据显示在2017财年的比率约为20%，与前两年相差不多；但数据还显示，发通知比率在2018财年的前几个月增加两倍，达到40%。
cb2a686135487e166ca41af53da9af001f0074db.translatedText: However, Cissna countered that the number of supplementary notices increased significantly last year, saying that it should be more accurate to look at the rate of issuing notices; data show that the rate in fiscal year 2017 was about 20%, which was similar to the previous two years; but the data also showed that the rate of issuing notices tripled in the first few months of fiscal year 2018, reaching 40%.

2989320e11f636a0dedfcb381f5219f1d0d568d2.sourceText: 但据了解，2017年11月H-1B被拒率为17.6%，是2016年同期7.7%的一倍多。(张敏毅 颜嘉莹)
2989320e11f636a0dedfcb381f5219f1d0d568d2.translatedText: However, it is understood that the H-1B rejection rate in November 2017 was 17.6%, more than double the 7.7% in the same period in 2016. (Zhang Minyi Yan Jiaying)

427d2ed25e13480f8c94e007b89343267f67f636.sourceText: 早晨醒来做好””3个1分钟””，可以预防脑梗的发生
427d2ed25e13480f8c94e007b89343267f67f636.translatedText: Wake up in the morning and do "three 1-minute"s" to prevent the occurrence of cerebral infarction

79cf164839d7af137afa14d78c005687e017b290.sourceText: 早晨醒来做好””3个1分钟””，可以预防脑梗的发生 起床的一瞬…
79cf164839d7af137afa14d78c005687e017b290.translatedText: Wake up in the morning and do "three 1-minutes"" to prevent the occurrence of cerebral infarction. The moment you get up...

a3d90608511569791ac96cbc8a8b9ff05dde86ef.sourceText: 起床的一瞬间如果不注意，是件很危险的事情，尤其是对于有高血压、血管疾病的人来说更是危险。在数多病例当中，有25%左右的人脑梗发作或是猝死都在这起床的一瞬间发生，常常使人措手不及。
a3d90608511569791ac96cbc8a8b9ff05dde86ef.translatedText: If you don't pay attention the moment you get up, it is very dangerous, especially for people with high blood pressure and vascular diseases. In many cases, about 25% of people suffer from cerebral infarction or sudden death at the moment of getting up, which often catches people off guard.

7acb350a4ef34eed1823b23bfaab5d8912fb0e96.sourceText: 这是因为人在夜晚漫长的睡眠中，呼吸和心率会减缓，血压和体温下降，代谢也变慢。人在睡醒的时候血液还相对黏稠，脑部急性缺氧缺血，如果此时立马从躺卧到坐立，甚至突然下床活动，会刺激到血管，很容易就引发脑梗的发生。
7acb350a4ef34eed1823b23bfaab5d8912fb0e96.translatedText: This is because during a long sleep at night, breathing and heart rate slow down, blood pressure and body temperature drop, and metabolism also slows down. When a person wakes up, the blood is still relatively viscous, and the brain is acutely hypoxic and ischemic. If you immediately change from lying to sitting, or even get out of bed suddenly, the blood vessels will be stimulated, which can easily lead to cerebral infarction.

57bc7d590313086e48c6bc62894030da1cf5932f.sourceText: 早晨醒来要如何预防脑梗，关键就在一个”慢”字。早晨醒来做好”3个1分钟”，可以预防脑梗的发生。
57bc7d590313086e48c6bc62894030da1cf5932f.translatedText: How to prevent cerebral infarction when you wake up in the morning, the key lies in the word "slow". Wake up in the morning and do "three 1-minute exercises" to prevent the occurrence of cerebral infarction.

132c520bc1874cea73e7eab0b8da2756bf179ab6.translatedText: 1. Lie in bed for 1 minute after waking up

4729eea3f5543ae143f01a585a7fa7b4aad0b3f1.sourceText: 躺着时，血液循环比较慢，黏稠度也较高，醒来先不着急立马起身，应该先在床上躺一会儿，伸伸懒腰，使血液慢慢流动正常再起身。
4729eea3f5543ae143f01a585a7fa7b4aad0b3f1.translatedText: When lying down, blood circulation is slower and the viscosity is higher. When you wake up, do not get up immediately. You should lie on the bed for a while, stretch, and let the blood flow slowly and normally before getting up.

223deb7b3c409f5d334d9be08f19a3bbf58f1282.translatedText: 2. Sit up and lean on the head of the bed for 1 minute

833c18ecf982500f585436145175b853a0a8f290.sourceText: 起身靠坐在床头这个姿势可以使心脏和血管发出提示，告诉它们一天的正常工作即将开始，给它们一个适应过程。
833c18ecf982500f585436145175b853a0a8f290.translatedText: Stand up and sit on the head of the bed. This posture can prompt the heart and blood vessels to tell them that the normal work of the day is about to begin, giving them an adaptation process.

994fd3d6ff801aca84e12baccb03a5595844b09a.translatedText: 3. Wait for another 1 minute with your legs drooping

b0aabb8c3542c31a907646afa6144b744088e013.sourceText: 起床后不要立即站起，可以多坐在床边一会儿，觉得反应正常再下床，这也是再一次适应的过程，能使心跳加快，改善脑供血状况。
b0aabb8c3542c31a907646afa6144b744088e013.translatedText: Don't stand up immediately after getting up. You can sit on the edge of the bed for a while, and then get out of bed if you feel the reaction is normal. This is also a process of adaptation again, which can speed up the heartbeat and improve the blood supply to the brain.

000269133ac849f615f78574850b773bf323e70e.sourceText: 这方法简单易行，只花短短的3分钟，就能起到药物起不到的预防作用。当然了，除了早起要注意预防之外，白天和晚上睡前也不要忘了做好预防脑梗的工作。
000269133ac849f615f78574850b773bf323e70e.translatedText: This method is simple and easy to implement. It only takes 3 minutes to achieve a preventive effect that drugs cannot. Of course, in addition to paying attention to prevention when you get up early, don't forget to do a good job in preventing cerebral infarction during the day and before going to bed at night.

511acbad6754cb35f4b9742ce0f1fd1d5954cca2.sourceText: 白天如何预防脑梗，关键就在一个”吃”字。白天常吃2样东西，可以预防脑梗发生。
511acbad6754cb35f4b9742ce0f1fd1d5954cca2.translatedText: How to prevent cerebral infarction during the day, the key lies in the word "eat". Eating two things regularly during the day can prevent cerebral infarction.

f60f3acc110996f773aa6cbb358d19cfc413c86c.sourceText: 预防脑梗，食疗也是不错的方法，日常可以多吃一些能清血栓，养护血管的食物，比如姬松茸、大豆、芦笋、枸杞等。它们都是药食同源的食物，所含的有效成分，对于预防和改善脑梗很有好处。下面给大家介绍两种调养的吃法：
f60f3acc110996f773aa6cbb358d19cfc413c86c.translatedText: Diet therapy is also a good way to prevent cerebral infarction. You can eat more foods that can clear blood clots and protect blood vessels, such as Agaricus blazei, soybeans, asparagus, wolfberry, etc. They are all foods with the same origin as medicine and food, and the active ingredients they contain are very beneficial to preventing and improving cerebral infarction. Here are two ways to take care of yourself:

12131cff37660a2a334db155a5c5e27edb10e272.sourceText: 1、姬松茸芦笋饮品：取芦笋20克，姬松茸20克，大豆10克，枸杞10克，把4种食物洗净后煎煮30分钟，每天饮用2次汤水。
12131cff37660a2a334db155a5c5e27edb10e272.translatedText: 1. Agaricus asparagus drink: Take 20 grams of asparagus, 20 grams of Agaricus blazei, 10 grams of soybeans, and 10 grams of wolfberry. Wash the four kinds of food and boil them for 30 minutes. Drink the soup twice a day.

15b4088f4336ae969a62a0c1e941667cdd8bbc22.sourceText: 2、姬松茸复合菌发酵液：将姬松茸、芦笋、枸杞、大豆的有效成分进行提纯萃取，再和益生菌进行厌氧发酵即可。药理研究发现，药食同源的食物经过发酵之后，效果会比熬煮泡水等方式更明显，有条件的可以选择这类发酵液。
15b4088f4336ae969a62a0c1e941667cdd8bbc22.translatedText: 2. Agaricus blazei complex fermentation broth: Purify and extract the active ingredients of Agaricus blazei, asparagus, wolfberry, and soybean, and then conduct anaerobic fermentation with probiotics. Pharmacological research has found that after fermentation of food with the same origin as medicine and food, the effect will be more obvious than boiling and soaking in water. If conditions permit, you can choose this type of fermentation liquid.

1e283340f7d4661e0762a50cf41b3f0f578e8f60.sourceText: 睡前如何预防脑梗，关键在一个”动”字。睡前多做1个动作，可以预防脑梗发生。
1e283340f7d4661e0762a50cf41b3f0f578e8f60.translatedText: How to prevent cerebral infarction before going to bed, the key lies in the word "move". Doing one more action before going to bed can prevent cerebral infarction.

bf8149da58b93766c0853a0c1c87aabd36091238.sourceText: 可以利用睡前的时间，踮踮脚，既简单又不需要借助任何器材，就可以达到预防脑梗的目的。
bf8149da58b93766c0853a0c1c87aabd36091238.translatedText: You can use the time before going to bed to stand on tiptoe. It is simple and does not require any equipment to prevent cerebral infarction.

41f318656d78d8daa04ba90b419be84e13835cef.sourceText: 方法：首先要穿平稳的平底鞋，将脚跟抬起，用脚去支撑身体，踮脚大约2秒后放下脚跟，站稳后再次将脚跟抬起，如此重复，每次做5分钟左右即可。
41f318656d78d8daa04ba90b419be84e13835cef.translatedText: Method: First, wear stable flat shoes, lift your heels, use your feet to support your body, stand on tiptoe for about 2 seconds and then lower your heels. After standing firm, lift your heels again. Repeat this for about 5 minutes each time.

28526d6c715d2298a17d94ff1043cc09b4ad109c.translatedText: Exclusive | Federal Senator candidate Kelli Ward met with the Chinese community At 1 pm on March 24, 2018, at the Chandler Police Department...

a0dbb38226c5d450f7b330c78e6570e2167b573c.sourceText: 2018年3月24日下午1点，在钱德勒警察局社区会议室， 近五十多华人朋友与联邦参议员候选人Kelli Ward进行了一场愉快的交谈。
a0dbb38226c5d450f7b330c78e6570e2167b573c.translatedText: At 1 pm on March 24, 2018, at the Chandler Police Department community conference room, nearly fifty Chinese friends met with Federal Senator candidate Kelli Ward had a great conversation.

0237d473fa309e2858fe325f5f853e82100019c9.translatedText: A group photo of the participants

97537d8e73791b9892f935ed840c414418b9c27f.sourceText: 下午亚裔社区AZAA的副会长张传东组织了本次见面会，他指出， 美国华人大部分人还是不愿涉足政治，大都是事不关己高高挂起。 然而政治却分分钟影响着我们的正常生活。新的电线从什么地方走， 学区怎么划分，税怎么交，怎么使用， 政客们制定的每一项政策都影响着我们的生活。临时抱佛脚， 佛还不搭理，这样的苦已经吃够了。可喜的是， 目前越来越多凤凰城华人都都意识到这一点， 当天五十多朋友来到现场与联邦参议员候选人 Kelli Ward医生面对面。
97537d8e73791b9892f935ed840c414418b9c27f.translatedText: In the afternoon, Zhang Chuandong, the vice president of the Asian community AZAA, organized this meeting. He pointed out that most Chinese Americans are still reluctant to get involved in politics, and most of them care about matters that have nothing to do with themselves. However, politics affects our normal life every minute. Where do new wires go, how school districts are divided, how taxes are paid, and how they are used. Every policy formulated by politicians affects our lives. I have suffered enough by cramming myself for the moment and not paying attention to him. Fortunately, more and more Chinese people in Phoenix are aware of this. On that day, more than 50 friends came to the scene to meet federal senator candidate Dr. Kelli Ward face to face.

0072f72611d9deea94f459333c779e7af826f868.sourceText: Kelli Ward是一位多次亲自参与华人活动的联邦参议员候选人。 也是一名医生，是共和党保守派的代表。 首先她支持保护凤凰城中国文化中心， 希望继续保持多元文化的共同发展，同时也反对亚裔细分， 希望所有的民族都平等。除此之外， 她主张废除Obamacare。 Obamacare不仅增加了中产阶级的医疗负担， 而且医疗服务却没有得到有效保障。第二她支持降低，简化税收， 让税收政策更加公平。第三她也是总统特朗普的建墙计划的拥护者， 增强边境安全，阻止非法移民进入美国。 她觉得物理上的边界是有必要的，让那些非法移民更难越过边境。 第四恢复美国的军事力量，同时倡导和平。 她主张为老弱妇孺声张正义，主张裁剪政府开支，监管和官僚作风。
0072f72611d9deea94f459333c779e7af826f868.translatedText: Kelli Ward is a federal senator candidate who has personally participated in Chinese activities many times. He is also a doctor and a representative of the conservative wing of the Republican Party. First of all, she supports the protection of the Phoenix Chinese Cultural Center and hopes to continue to maintain the common development of multiculturalism. At the same time, she opposes the subdivision of Asians and hopes that all ethnic groups will be equal. Among other things, she advocates repealing Obamacare. Obamacare not only increases the medical burden on the middle class, but also does not effectively protect medical services. Second, she supports lowering and simplifying taxes to make tax policies more fair. Third, she is also a supporter of President Trump's wall-building plan to enhance border security and prevent illegal immigrants from entering the United States. She believes a physical border is necessary to make it more difficult for illegal immigrants to cross. Fourth, restore American military power while advocating for peace. She advocates justice for the elderly, weak, women and children, and advocates cutting government spending, regulation and bureaucracy.

d338c1cc66f1849032a065527428366e52a9b92f.sourceText: Kelli Ward 与大家交流自己的政见
d338c1cc66f1849032a065527428366e52a9b92f.translatedText: Kelli Ward exchanges her political opinions with everyone

28f5c8c6aa0b2b10d7b6aa685599d4ea82cf110a.sourceText: Kelli来到华人社区，想听听华人朋友的诉求， 她的大部分政见跟我们华人有很多共同点。活动当日， 钱德勒议员黄馨民，以及社区关心政治的朋友都齐聚一堂。 再次我们呼吁更多的朋友关注和参与政治，只有参与， 华人在美国才能拥有一席之地。
28f5c8c6aa0b2b10d7b6aa685599d4ea82cf110a.translatedText: Kelli came to the Chinese community and wanted to hear the demands of Chinese friends. Most of her political opinions have a lot in common with us Chinese. On the day of the event, Chandler Councilor Huang Xinmin and friends from the community who were concerned about politics gathered together. Once again, we call on more friends to pay attention to and participate in politics. Only by participating can the Chinese have a place in the United States.

6bf255b6b98eaf3799ae1d7cf5f1376b42b56ef5.sourceText: 中新网3月30日电 据美国《世界日报》报道，美国电动汽车生产商特斯拉自愿在全球召回约12.3万辆Model S轿车，因发现特定螺栓在寒冷气候下腐蚀可能导致动力方向盘失灵。
6bf255b6b98eaf3799ae1d7cf5f1376b42b56ef5.translatedText: China News Service, March 30 According to the US "World Journal" report, the US electric car manufacturer Tesla voluntarily recalled about 123,000 Model S sedans worldwide because it was found that certain bolts corroded in cold climates and may cause the power steering wheel to malfunction.

0b0809765d7aeb58957d7c733af6fe3793e03d9e.sourceText: 特斯拉29日表示，召回范围是2016年4月前生产的Model S轿车。据信这是特斯拉历史上规模最大的召回事件。特斯拉称，美国可能受影响的汽车中不到0.02%有这一问题。
0b0809765d7aeb58957d7c733af6fe3793e03d9e.translatedText: Tesla stated on the 29th that the scope of the recall is Model S sedans produced before April 2016. This is believed to be the largest recall in Tesla history. Tesla said that less than 0.02% of potentially affected vehicles in the United States have this problem.

1a18fcb0f4ec4d53413d7d5ac5c81cbcfd291887.sourceText: 截至去年底，特斯拉共卖出28万辆电动车。特斯拉向客户发送的电子邮件表示：”我们的电动车总共已行驶逾10亿英里，目前不曾因这个零件引发伤亡或事故。”
1a18fcb0f4ec4d53413d7d5ac5c81cbcfd291887.translatedText: By the end of last year, Tesla had sold a total of 280,000 electric vehicles. An email sent by Tesla to customers stated: "Our electric vehicles have driven more than 1 billion miles in total, and there have been no casualties or accidents caused by this part."

fdae5ad7e472751d2e7b7c36cfe36f11c5ff52fe.sourceText: 特斯拉执行长马斯克正面临Model 3量产进度落后的挑战，也需筹措现金。特斯拉原本设定Model 3的产量在第1季提高至每周2500辆，否则将冲击现金流以及量产平价电动车的进度。
fdae5ad7e472751d2e7b7c36cfe36f11c5ff52fe.translatedText: Tesla CEO Musk is facing the challenge of falling behind the schedule of Model 3 mass production and also needs to raise cash. Tesla originally planned to increase Model 3 production to 2,500 units per week in the first quarter, otherwise it would impact cash flow and the progress of mass production of affordable electric vehicles.

98497e933db33d6d707204b16c88a6778b3bcd0e.sourceText: 但信评机构穆迪认为特斯拉可能无法达成这项目标，把特斯拉的债信评级由原本的垃圾级B2降至B3。
98497e933db33d6d707204b16c88a6778b3bcd0e.translatedText: However, the credit rating agency Moody's believes that Tesla may not be able to achieve this goal and lowered Tesla's credit rating from the original junk level B2 to B3.

e341e29f917784aaea7f237ddf6934769f07af18.sourceText: 特斯拉上周已鼓励工厂员工提生产能，证明”仇视者”的看法错误。总工程师Doug Field向员工表示，看空和批评特斯拉的人，正不断质疑公司实现执行长马斯克量产平价电动车愿景的能力，如果每天可生产超过300辆Model 3，将是个”不可思议的胜利”。
e341e29f917784aaea7f237ddf6934769f07af18.translatedText: Tesla last week encouraged factory employees to increase production capacity, proving the "haters" wrong. Chief engineer Doug Field told employees that Tesla bears and critics are constantly questioning the company's ability to realize CEO Musk's vision of mass-producing affordable electric vehicles. If it can produce more than 300 Model 3 vehicles per day, it will be an "incredible victory."

37da90e733d3019acadafd462f1d7bb140d4660e.translatedText: [Comprehensive report by Qiaobao.com on March 13] Compared with other developed countries, the cost of medical insurance in the United States is twice that of other countries. A new study shows that the average life expectancy of Americans is the lowest among these countries.

519873638f4925847ddafbe4345ccafdf35ff5ab.sourceText: 马里兰州盖瑟斯堡的米妮.哈桑医生正在诊所为病人做检查（照片：美联社）
519873638f4925847ddafbe4345ccafdf35ff5ab.translatedText: Dr. Minnie Hassan of Gaithersburg, Maryland, is examining a patient at the clinic (Photo: Associated Press)

9b344c387248c0e6db52e0beba0eb4072aa55e8f.sourceText: 美国民众每年花费9403美元在医疗保险上。而德国人这项花费只有5000美元出头。
9b344c387248c0e6db52e0beba0eb4072aa55e8f.translatedText: Americans spend $9,403 on health insurance every year. The Germans only spent a little over $5,000.

4aeef0297f05c15937321ab2f35dd06a5f58f36e.sourceText: 据美国中文网报道，哈佛大学的一项研究对美国民众医疗保险花费进行解读。哈佛大学全球健康专业教授阿什.贾（Ashish Jha）表示，众所周知美国医疗保险花费高于其他国家，但造成这个结果的原因却遭到误解。
4aeef0297f05c15937321ab2f35dd06a5f58f36e.translatedText: According to reports from the American Chinese website, a study by Harvard University interpreted the medical insurance expenses of the American people. Ashish Jha, a professor of global health at Harvard University, said that it is well known that the cost of health insurance in the United States is higher than that of other countries, but the reasons for this result have been misunderstood.

7bdfab1573da716fcb17d5395ed76f7b7c0763d6.sourceText: 阿什认为，这个结果并不是由于过多的拜访医生、住院治疗所造成的。
7bdfab1573da716fcb17d5395ed76f7b7c0763d6.translatedText: Ash believes that this result is not caused by too many doctor visits and hospitalization.

86f29cfb519299d135d4b954e8b6655309e2922f.sourceText: 在这项研究中，阿什和他的同事们收集了2013年至2016年加拿大、德国、澳大利亚、日本、瑞典、丹麦、英国、瑞士和荷兰等10个高收入国家的数据。他们发现，美国医疗保险收费较高的原因是由于美国的医生和护士薪水较高，美国医生薪水约为218173美元，而其他国家则只有86607美元到154126美元。
86f29cfb519299d135d4b954e8b6655309e2922f.translatedText: In this study, Ashe and his colleagues collected data from 2013 to 2016 in 10 high-income countries including Canada, Germany, Australia, Japan, Sweden, Denmark, the United Kingdom, Switzerland and the Netherlands. They found that the reason for the higher medical insurance charges in the United States is due to the higher salaries of doctors and nurses in the United States. The salary of doctors in the United States is about $218,173, while in other countries it is only $86,607 to $154,126.

ed2296a8ffd84e3c982bfb5590643a3175666beb.sourceText: 此外，美国在制药方面花费更多，美国制药投入为人均1443美元，其他国家则在466美元到939美元之间。 尽管美国的医疗支出增加，但公民的健康状况更差。美国民众的预期寿命是78.8岁，是这11个国家中最低的。其他国家的平均寿命在80到83.9岁之间。
ed2296a8ffd84e3c982bfb5590643a3175666beb.translatedText: In addition, the United States spends more on pharmaceuticals. The United States’ pharmaceutical investment per capita is US$1,443, while other countries spend between US$466 and US$939. Even as health care spending increases in the United States, citizens are experiencing worse health outcomes. The life expectancy of the American people is 78.8 years, the lowest among these 11 countries. The average life expectancy in other countries ranges from 80 to 83.9 years.

e2d726a64df9010304b5cc32df919a519af149f7.sourceText: 此外，阿什发现美国医疗服务的整体利用率与其他国家相似，这并不是造成医疗保险费用上涨的原因。阿什认为美国医疗保险支出增加的两个主要因素是医疗保健服务价格上涨和行政费用。
e2d726a64df9010304b5cc32df919a519af149f7.translatedText: In addition, Ash found that overall U.S. health care utilization rates are similar to those in other countries, which is not responsible for rising health insurance costs. Ashe believes the two main factors contributing to the increase in U.S. health insurance spending are rising prices for health care services and administrative costs.

17f287d3767ab27de114cc616060c618dd4efbe0.sourceText: 还有更糟糕的，今后3年，全美19个州的医保费用可能上涨50%以上，而17个州可能看到医保费用上涨90%以上。
17f287d3767ab27de114cc616060c618dd4efbe0.translatedText: What's even worse is that in the next three years, medical insurance costs in 19 states across the United States may rise by more than 50%, and 17 states may see medical insurance costs rise by more than 90%.
