303dc811cee3153ca077837b90a1773a0efb40de.translatedText: Looking at "customer first" from the shopping experience in the United States Picture/text: North America Xiaopu [...

653c37148ba6c2d98e36fcea72c7349941f52980.sourceText: 图/文： 北美小璞 【作者简介】北美小璞，资深媒体人，美国北卡罗来纳大学媒体访问学者；美国印第安纳大学传媒硕士。 导 读 ：老美买东西总是习惯性的留好发票，因为在美国买东西换货、退货是太正常不过的事情了。实际上在美国、加拿大等欧美国家并没有法律保障顾客必须有”Right of Refund(退货权利)”，而是各个商家服务业为了让顾客有更好的”客户体验”而共同履行的行业”潜规则”。我以前在国内管理一个公司品牌部的时候，经常分享这个观点”尽最大的努力让客户满意，从而留住他们，因为开发新客户的成本是维护老客户成本的6倍。。。”。相对于我们服务业更多地停留在”顾客至上”口号上，美国的服务业这么说也是这么做的。
653c37148ba6c2d98e36fcea72c7349941f52980.translatedText: Picture/text: North America Xiaopu [About the author] North America Xiaopu, a senior media person, a visiting scholar in media at the University of North Carolina, USA; Master of Communication from Indiana University, USA. Introduction: Americans always keep invoices when buying things, because it is normal to exchange and return goods when buying things in the United States. In fact, in the United States, Canada and other European and American countries, there is no legal guarantee that customers must have the "Right of Refund". Instead, it is an industry "hidden rule" that various merchant service industries jointly implement in order to provide customers with a better "customer experience." When I used to manage a company's brand department in China, I often shared this view: "Try your best to satisfy customers so as to retain them, because the cost of developing new customers is 6 times the cost of maintaining old customers...". Compared with our service industry, which remains more focused on the slogan of "customer first", the American service industry also does this.

b6378cecdeed186c660d1d5985f3b3eb445ef267.sourceText: 【正文】从冰箱里翻出昨天在Harries Teeter(美国东部一家连锁超市)买的水果拼盘，已经吃了一半，打开盒子发现水果有点异味儿。我在昨天吃的时候肯定没有任何问题，不清楚水果是因为隔夜的原因，还是因为原来的质量不好导致变质的。 晚上我和美国房东Peter在客厅里面聊天，无意中和Peter聊到了此事。他听到后说，”你先别把水果倒掉，明天你拿着去超市，他们会给你一个满意的答复”。我说一共才6刀多的东西，而且我已经吃了一半，吃的时候也没发现问题，这事就算了吧。Peter说，毕竟才一天就坏了，这至少说明水果不新鲜，坚持让我拿去超市理论。
b6378cecdeed186c660d1d5985f3b3eb445ef267.translatedText: [Text] I took out the fruit platter I bought from Harries Teeter (a supermarket chain in the eastern United States) yesterday from the refrigerator. I had already eaten half of it. When I opened the box, I found that the fruit had a bit of a peculiar smell. There was definitely no problem when I ate it yesterday. I don’t know whether the fruit spoiled because it was left overnight or because the original quality was poor. In the evening, I was chatting with my American landlord Peter in the living room, and I accidentally talked about this matter with Peter. After hearing this, he said, "Don't throw away the fruit yet. If you take it to the supermarket tomorrow, they will give you a satisfactory answer." I said it was only a little over 6 dollars in total, and I had already eaten half of it, and I didn’t notice anything wrong when I ate it, so let’s just forget about it. Peter said that after all, it had gone bad in just one day, which at least meant that the fruit was not fresh, and insisted that I take it to the supermarket to argue.

acd1072e8bd7af48cf1b40e3cbe55812a661d28b.sourceText: 我们国人一般买小额的东西没有留发票的习惯，而且退货的时候，如果没发票或者东西有点变动就不给退了。我告诉Pete r，我没留发票，而且为了几块钱去超市Argue太麻烦，我不去找了。Peter说，没有发票也没关系，因为这是事实，如果我不愿意去，他自己去。 老美的维权意识很强，并不是在乎钱的多少。 第二天，Peter带着剩下的水果自己去了超市。不一会他从超市回来，拿给我13刀美元说，对方的Manager今天出面了，诚挚请Peter向我带去他们的歉意，并给我双倍水果拼盘的价钱作为补偿，希望这次购买不会对我产生什么不快，如果我觉得处理方案不满意，我可以再去找她们商量。 有点小惊喜之余我问Peter，我一是没发票，二是东西几乎都吃光了，三是水果刚吃的时候的确没有问题，但是他们的处理方式着实让我感到有点意外和满意。Peter说，”这是维护你的权益，如果你去Argue,他们以后会更注意保持水果的新鲜度。同时，你对处理的方式感到满意和高兴，这样你以后还会去那里买东西，这正是他们想要的！”They want to have their company face and not lose clients(他们很注意公司的形象而且不想失去顾客)? Peter 还告诉我，虽然商家多是凭发票退、换货，但是美国还有一些商家如Costco,即使没有发票，他们也可以通过自己的电脑系统找出当初购物的原始记录，给顾客退、换货。
acd1072e8bd7af48cf1b40e3cbe55812a661d28b.translatedText: We Chinese generally don’t have the habit of leaving an invoice when buying small items. Moreover, when returning goods, if there is no invoice or the item has been slightly changed, we will not refund it. I told Pete r that I didn’t keep an invoice, and it was too troublesome to go to the supermarket Argue for a few dollars, so I wouldn’t go looking for it. Peter said that it didn't matter if there was no invoice, because it was a fact, and if I didn't want to go, he would go by himself. Americans have a strong sense of rights protection and don't care about the amount of money. The next day, Peter took the remaining fruit to the supermarket by himself. After a while he came back from the supermarket and gave me 13 US dollars and said that the manager of the other party came forward today and sincerely asked Peter to bring me their apology and give me double the price of the fruit platter as compensation. I hope this purchase will not cause any discomfort to me. If I feel dissatisfied with the solution, I can go to them to discuss it again. I was a little surprised and asked Peter. Firstly, I didn't have an invoice, secondly, I had almost eaten all the food, and thirdly, there was indeed no problem with the fruit when I first ate it, but the way they handled it really made me feel a bit surprised and satisfied. Peter said, "This is to protect your rights. If you go to Argue, they will pay more attention to keeping the freshness of the fruit in the future. At the same time, you are satisfied and happy with the way it was handled, so that you will go there to buy things in the future, which is what they want!" They want to have their company face and not lose clients (they are very careful about the company's image and do not want to lose customers)? Peter He also told me that although most merchants use invoices to return or exchange goods, there are still some merchants in the United States, such as Costco, who can use their computer systems to find out the original purchase records and return or exchange goods to customers even if they do not have an invoice.

7e2adc7d25848f258fa9fbd376ed77d3abf29bc1.sourceText: 我回想起一个月前在美国另外一家店买东西时的场景，当时我看到一种喜欢的Cookie打特价，这款平时很少打折，所以我准备多买几盒放家里备用。可是柜台上只剩下一盒了。 当我付账时，无意中告诉了收银员我的失望。这个售货员二话没说，给我打出了一个Receipt ( 收据 )，是4盒Cookie的Coupon ( 优惠劵 )。 他告诉我，一个月内我还可以凭这个Receipt，用现在的优惠价买到4盒Cookie。这个收据就是我们平时在英语中常说的”Take a rain check” ( This means you can buy the item later for the sale price, even when the sale is over. 如果你想买某个打折的商品没货了，他们可以给开个Rain check的收据，等什么时候有货的时候，可以凭据按照打折的价钱购买 )。 Rain Check也是美国商场客户至上体验的另外一个好的例子。
7e2adc7d25848f258fa9fbd376ed77d3abf29bc1.translatedText: I recalled the scene when I was shopping in another store in the United States a month ago. At that time, I saw a special price on a type of cookie that I liked. This type of cookie is rarely discounted, so I planned to buy a few more boxes to keep at home. But there was only one box left on the counter. When I paid the bill, I accidentally told the cashier my disappointment. Without saying a word, the salesperson typed a receipt for me, which was a coupon for 4 boxes of cookies. He told me that within a month I could use this receipt to buy 4 boxes of cookies at the current discounted price. This receipt is what we often call "Take a rain check" in English (This means you can buy the item later for the sale price, even when the sale is over. If a discounted item you want to buy is out of stock, they can issue a rain check receipt, and when it is in stock, you can purchase it at the discounted price). Rain Check is another good example of customer-first experience in American malls.

d5bbbff0541a685f229c7d1439df03e409ce19e7.sourceText: 同时在美国超市买东西，如果你付的钱和货架上的价签不一样(价签因为摆放错误或者更新不及时，超市里经常会出现货架上的价签和结账时候的价钱不一样)你可以免费得到这个商品 ( If a sale item scans wrong, you will get it for free )。 在美国还有很多这样的购物经历，在国内购物经常出现的”失望”场景，在这里往往会得到意外”惊喜”。
d5bbbff0541a685f229c7d1439df03e409ce19e7.translatedText: At the same time when buying something in an American supermarket, if the price you pay is different from the price tag on the shelf (because the price tag is placed incorrectly or is not updated in time, the price tag on the shelf is often different from the price at checkout), you can get this product for free (If a sale item scans wrong, you will get it for free). There are many such shopping experiences in the United States. The "disappointment" scenes that often occur when shopping in China often lead to unexpected "surprises" here.

2917e78615d9afcf4b662cb58f9234881f914310.sourceText: 相对于我在美国购物不断获得的”意外惊喜”，我们国内的服务业在处理顾客购物纠纷上，还有很多不到位和欠缺，能让顾客收获这些意外”惊喜”的经历少之又少。在国内的很多商家看来，百年老店和商家品牌的形象远远不如马上进账现钱更实惠。 实际上在美国没有法律保障顾客必须有”Right of Refund(退货权利)”，而是各个商家服务业为了做到”顾客至上”、让顾客有更好的”客户体验”而制定的行业”潜规则”。在整个服务行业有个基本理论，开发新客户的成本是维护老客户成本的6倍，相对于我们更多的停留在口号上，美国服务业这么说也是这么做的。
2917e78615d9afcf4b662cb58f9234881f914310.translatedText: Compared with the "unexpected surprises" I continue to get when shopping in the United States, our domestic service industry still has many deficiencies and deficiencies in handling customer shopping disputes. There are very few experiences that allow customers to reap these unexpected "surprises." In the eyes of many domestic merchants, the image of a century-old store and merchant brand is far less affordable than receiving cash immediately. In fact, there is no law in the United States that guarantees that customers must have the "Right of Refund (right of return)." Instead, it is an industry "hidden rule" formulated by each merchant service industry in order to achieve "customer first" and allow customers to have a better "customer experience." There is a basic theory in the entire service industry that the cost of developing new customers is 6 times the cost of maintaining old customers. Compared with us who stay more on slogans, the American service industry also does this.

e0547f7fdfd16ff94bed979d6b51ed507528938e.sourceText: 美国交通监管部门派团队 调查Uber无人车致死行人案
e0547f7fdfd16ff94bed979d6b51ed507528938e.translatedText: The U.S. transportation regulatory department sent a team to investigate the case of Uber's self-driving car killing a pedestrian

c8bf7fa5d7f51d6006ed7db005fd6ea71eb93156.translatedText: The U.S. transportation regulatory department sent a team to investigate the case of Uber's self-driving car killing a pedestrian. Special topic: The first case of a driverless car hitting and killing a person! Uber is under investigation...

930ffb8a81f16984ff15c670733250bb498c1831.translatedText: Special topic: The first case of a driverless car hitting and killing a person! Uber under investigation

d79cecd23dfc723c1467a1ef2bf0774b443ea526.sourceText: 相关消息： 首例无人驾驶车撞人致死案！Uber暂停项目接受调查
d79cecd23dfc723c1467a1ef2bf0774b443ea526.translatedText: Related news: The first case of a driverless car hitting a person and causing death! Uber suspends project under investigation

7262465a5ac43e884588284427b0b53b181f16b4.sourceText: 新浪科技讯 北京时间3月20日上午消息，美国国家公路交通安全管理局（NHTSA）和美国国家运输安全委员会（NTSB）周一宣布，他们已向亚利桑那州坦佩市派出团队，以调查Uber无人驾驶汽车撞死行人事故。
7262465a5ac43e884588284427b0b53b181f16b4.translatedText: Sina Technology News On the morning of March 20, Beijing time, the U.S. National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) and the U.S. National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) announced on Monday that they had dispatched a team to Tempe, Arizona, to investigate an accident involving an Uber self-driving car that killed a pedestrian.

66ee7435d54e0fef398cbf09da75a7e7d11b84c1.sourceText: NHTSA在声明中表示，他们目前正”和Uber、沃尔沃以及联邦、州和当地相关部门就这一事故进行接触”，并将采取适当措施。NTSB在Twitter中声明称，他们也会派出一个团队调查该事故。
66ee7435d54e0fef398cbf09da75a7e7d11b84c1.translatedText: NHTSA said in a statement that they are currently "in contact with Uber, Volvo and relevant federal, state and local authorities regarding this incident" and will take appropriate measures. The NTSB stated on Twitter that they would also send a team to investigate the accident.

f593bb4cb04d196ab014f5761960bf9d69f280cf.sourceText: 一辆由Uber研发的无人驾驶汽车意外撞上了一名过马路的行人。据外媒引述警方的消息报道称，这名女性行人已经死亡，车祸原因不明。这是全球首例自驾车撞死人事故。Uber暂时中止一切测试活动。(轶群)
f593bb4cb04d196ab014f5761960bf9d69f280cf.translatedText: A driverless car developed by Uber accidentally hit a pedestrian crossing the road. According to foreign media reports citing police sources, the female pedestrian was dead and the cause of the accident was unknown. This is the world's first fatal accident involving a self-driving car. Uber has temporarily suspended all testing activities. (Yiqun)

2a8a7f02bdbecd8c94c42bccabfebfff87491487.sourceText: 最新 | 法院警告 True North Companies律师野蛮驱赶文化中心中国企业的行为是犯罪
2a8a7f02bdbecd8c94c42bccabfebfff87491487.translatedText: Latest | Court warns True North Companies lawyer's behavior of brutally driving away Chinese companies from the Cultural Center is a crime

54848c896881ef667e7123e53d625255af46f55f.sourceText: 最新 | 法院警告 True North Companies律师野蛮驱赶文化中心中国企业的行为是犯罪 3月13…
54848c896881ef667e7123e53d625255af46f55f.translatedText: Latest | Court warns True North Companies lawyer's behavior of brutally driving away Chinese companies from the Cultural Center is a crime March 13th…

e1fb8f3c15450078ad70f544a8fe9dfdac7e4a53.sourceText: 3月13日在马立库帕郡法庭，经过四个小时的辩论，在凤凰城中国文化中心租赁经营的中餐馆同顺居，经历了十几天的断电，断水，断电话，断网络，封抽油烟管道等， True North Companies（真背）公司 近乎无赖的，逼迫停止正常营业的行径后，法院终于还同顺居一个公道。 法官在法庭上命令”真背”公司恢复供电，电话，网络的服务，禁止其无礼驱赶同顺居。 True North Companies（真背）公司买了中国文化中心后真是挺背的。
e1fb8f3c15450078ad70f544a8fe9dfdac7e4a53.translatedText: On March 13th, in the Maricupa County Court, after four hours of debate, Tongshunju, a Chinese restaurant leased and operated by the Chinese Cultural Center in Phoenix, went through more than ten days of power outages, water cuts, phone calls, internet disconnections, and range hood sealing. After True North Companies was almost rogue and forced to stop normal business, the court finally gave Tongshunju justice. The judge ordered the "Zhenbei" company in court to restore power, telephone and Internet services, and prohibited it from rudely evicting co-shunju. True North Companies really did a great job after buying the Chinese Cultural Center.

1f6ca774d4ae66c07eabc11e84dd570fa1a02ecf.sourceText: 法官跟”真背”公司的律师说，他不能相信他所听到的”真背”公司对同顺居一个餐馆所做的行径，如果这都是真的，他们不是可恶，而是犯罪。而且法官还针对”真背”公司的律师说，如果他们的行为是你的建议，那就真是过了线。言下之一，律师的资格都会受到影响。这次的紧急听证，只是一个开始。同顺居可以在那里正常营业，并由法令保证水电气正常运行，如果”真背”司再有什么小动作，必将迎来法庭的严惩。 4月16日，陪审团听证还将继续，真背公司和同顺居老板将再次对薄公堂，届时希望华人朋友尽可能多参加，到现场支持。
1f6ca774d4ae66c07eabc11e84dd570fa1a02ecf.translatedText: The judge told the lawyer of "Zhenbei" company that he could not believe what he heard about what "Zhenbei" company did to Tong Shunju in a restaurant. If this was true, they were not abominable, but criminal. Moreover, the judge also said to the lawyers of the "Zhenbei" company that if their actions were your suggestions, then they really crossed the line. Implicitly, the lawyer's qualifications will be affected. This emergency hearing is just the beginning. Tongshunju can operate normally there, and the normal operation of water and electricity is guaranteed by law. If the company "really betrays" the company again, it will be severely punished by the court. On April 16, the jury hearing will continue. The boss of Zhenbei Company and Tongshunju will face Bo in court again. At that time, we hope that as many Chinese friends as possible will participate and come to the scene to support.

18a57b3cbde6dd9fedb63135dbf9fd8cbc011c8c.sourceText: True North Companies（真背）公司旗下拥有Realty Executives， Passport Hearth, and Pump It Up. 公司由David Tedesco 运营。号称是有近千员工的大企业，甚至是参与儿童教育与娱乐，房地产等企业的公司，对于一个中餐馆都干出什么勾当？我们来看看，挽救凤凰城中国文化中心组委会带来的真实的记录。
18a57b3cbde6dd9fedb63135dbf9fd8cbc011c8c.translatedText: True North Companies owns Realty Executives, Passport Hearth, and Pump It Up. The company is run by David Tedesco. It is said to be a large enterprise with nearly a thousand employees, or even a company involved in children's education and entertainment, real estate and other enterprises. What kind of activities does it do to a Chinese restaurant? Let’s take a look at the real record brought by the organizing committee to save the Chinese Cultural Center in Phoenix.

3a0ec9dcf47c4d14b819464e854420602c7fce68.sourceText: 历史记录下了真北公司的流氓行径：
3a0ec9dcf47c4d14b819464e854420602c7fce68.translatedText: History has recorded the hooliganism of True North Company:

77781e5bf3b72fa1b5e0908c15eb184c165d001d.sourceText: 3 月 2 号，关闭排风扇，切断电话线，叫消防队来水浇歺馆， 叫警察来逮捕我们的发言人 ，用调虎离山计， 妄图闯入歺馆锁门 ；
77781e5bf3b72fa1b5e0908c15eb184c165d001d.translatedText: On March 2, we turned off the exhaust fan, cut off the phone lines, called the fire brigade to water the restaurant, called the police to arrest our spokesperson, and used the trick to break into the restaurant and lock the door;

ecbef316542c17d6806783851bf7e2196afd4248.sourceText: 3 月 6 号去电力公司，把同顺居的户名换成真北；
ecbef316542c17d6806783851bf7e2196afd4248.translatedText: March 6 We went to the electric power company and changed Tongshunju’s account name to Zhenbei;

bfa2dbd8221e102e7c768a6b82774b3067ad6c1f.sourceText: 3 月 9 号，不准同顺居卸货，其安保负责人 又一次 妄图闯入歺馆， 强行阻止我方打开排风扇；
bfa2dbd8221e102e7c768a6b82774b3067ad6c1f.translatedText: On March 9, Tongshunju was not allowed to unload the goods, and the security manager once again tried to break into the hotel and forcibly prevented us from turning on the exhaust fan;

0e43fbb2246e9abcb3efa0fc3afe215b9110f038.sourceText: 3 月 12 号，通知电公司断电。
0e43fbb2246e9abcb3efa0fc3afe215b9110f038.translatedText: On March 12th, we notified the power company to cut off the power.

d788f681f4782e19140bf594d79ecc4857e056b6.sourceText: 3月13号，上午7点断电，并锁上了电表。
d788f681f4782e19140bf594d79ecc4857e056b6.translatedText: On March 13, the power was cut off at 7 a.m. and the meter was locked.

fe9d58c20f6fcaa62fdcd2f01052e2215d99682c.sourceText: 面对真北公司的种种倒行逆施。 同顺居歺馆在广大侨胞的大力支援下，团结战斗，针锋相对， 粉碎了真北的一个又一个阴谋，取得了阶段性的胜利，请看 3 月 2 号 保卫同顺居战斗的纪实。
fe9d58c20f6fcaa62fdcd2f01052e2215d99682c.translatedText: Facing the various perverse actions of True North Company. With the strong support of the vast number of overseas Chinese, Tongshunju Hall united in fighting and faced tit-for-tat, smashing True North’s plots one after another and achieving staged victories. Please see the record of the battle to defend Tongshunju on March 2.

f94515ba2cc730b20e9bba2a295e2f0fcaeea0ed.sourceText: 一场没有开枪放炮的，但却是硝烟滾滾的战斗 3 月 2 日在同顺居 餐馆打响了！
f94515ba2cc730b20e9bba2a295e2f0fcaeea0ed.translatedText: A battle without shooting, but full of smoke, started at Tongshunju Restaurant on March 2!

7da0d119de796573868f68d352fbe6468ce72e74.sourceText: 大家知道，同顺居的续约的案件已经进入法律程序， 谁是谁非静候法院判决就是了。然而真北 668 公司的几位头面人物 却一反常态，赤膊上阵。他们迫不及待地摘掉同顺居餐馆的广告牌， 四次掐断电话线，关闭排风扇， 还两次叫警察用莫名其妙的罪名要求警察逮捕我们的发言人Tom， 还叫来消防队，以无排风扇经营之罪，要求关闭同顺居歺館。 他们妄图用调虎离山计，造成餐馆内无人，强行锁门。 真的是丧心病狂，贱喊捉贼！他们对警察还谎称有驱逐令， 却又拿不出文件，其尴尬之态不言而喻。尽管他们脑羞成怒， 个个气得面红耳赤，也于事无补，只能自食其果了！他们藐视法律， 藐视法庭的傲慢嘴脸暴露无遗。正如他们极其狂妄地咆哮道：” 我们是国际公司，有的是钱，我们要用钱砸死你们”！ 他们这种有预谋的，歇斯底里的种种倒行逆施， 理所当然地遭到了警方拒绝， 他们煞费心机祘尽的种种机关都被我们勇敢的气势、 严正的立场和高度的智慧予以迊头疼击。 事后细细地思量他们自编自导、黔驴技穷的这场闹剧， 感到了他们的失态和反常。看来， 我们的斗争锋芒击中了他们的要害。 联系到他们要求加快上诉的审理进度， 显现出他们已经承受不起多次限制令给他们带来的重创。 在此正告真北公司，想要用欺压、威胁、 强行拆除等手段打压我之少数族裔，是永远也不会得逞的！
7da0d119de796573868f68d352fbe6468ce72e74.translatedText: As we all know, the contract renewal case of Tongshunju has entered the legal process, and who is who is waiting for the court's decision. However, several leading figures of True North 668 Company went against the norm and went shirtless. They couldn't wait to take down the billboard of Tongshunju Restaurant, cut off the phone lines four times, turned off the exhaust fan, and called the police twice to arrest our spokesperson Tom on inexplicable charges. They also called the fire brigade and demanded that Tongshunju Restaurant be closed for operating without an exhaust fan. They tried to lure the tiger away from the mountain, leaving no one in the restaurant and forcing the door to be locked. He is really heartbroken and shouting to catch the thief! They also lied to the police about having a deportation order, but could not produce the documents. Their embarrassment was self-evident. Even though they were so embarrassed that they were all red-faced and red-faced with anger, it was of no use and they had to reap the consequences! Their contempt for the law and their contempt for the courts have been fully exposed. Just as they roared extremely arrogantly: "We are an international company with a lot of money, and we will use our money to kill you!" Their premeditated and hysterical perverse actions were naturally rejected by the police, and all their elaborate mechanisms were thwarted by our courageous momentum, stern stance and high level of wisdom. Afterwards, I thought carefully about this farce that they wrote, directed, and had no skills at all, and I felt their gaffe and abnormality. It seems that the edge of our struggle has hit their vital point. They were contacted to request that the appeal be expedited, which showed that they could no longer bear the heavy blow brought to them by multiple restraining orders. I would like to warn True North Company that they will never succeed if they try to suppress our ethnic minorities by bullying, threatening, forcibly demolishing and other means!

0a607b0df36b437f6e2e037f2a4bb8f54155a162.sourceText: 然而，我们这边却风景独好，气势高涨！ 就在这离奇事件发生后的第一时间里， 我们及时详细地向各个微信群报告了事件的真相。 引起了广大网友的密切关注；就在这第一时间里， 当地的华人独家电视台就开展了工作；就在这第一时间里， 许多朋友迅速赶到现场，毫不犹豫地站到了斗争的最前线； 就在这第一时间里，我们的战友就向全社会报道了这个事件的真相； 就在这第一时间里，我们向当地媒体通报了情况； 就在这第一时间里，不少人报名通宵保护同顺居餐馆！是啊， 在这第一时间里，我们的所作所为令人感动不已！我真地看到了， 我们保护中国文化城的坚定决心和坚强意志；我们团结同心， 其利断金的强大力量； 我们无私奉献的高贵品德和大无畏的斗争精神！我真地感受到了， 我们能保住文化城的根本所在！ 我情不自禁地为守夜战士些了几句顺口溜：”风雨欲来何须愁， 危难之中显风流。身而舍己豪气在，金瓦闪闪凤凰来”。
0a607b0df36b437f6e2e037f2a4bb8f54155a162.translatedText: However, the scenery here is unique and the momentum is high! Immediately after this bizarre incident occurred, we reported the truth of the incident to various WeChat groups in a timely and detailed manner. It aroused the close attention of the majority of netizens; in this first moment, the local Chinese exclusive TV station started work; in this first moment, many friends rushed to the scene quickly and stood at the forefront of the struggle without hesitation; in this first moment, our comrades reported the truth of this incident to the whole society; in this first moment, we informed the local media of the situation; in this first moment, many people signed up to protect the Tongshunju restaurant all night long! Yes, in this first moment, what we did was very touching! I really saw our firm determination and strong will to protect China Cultural City; our unity as one, the powerful force that can cut through gold; our noble character of selfless dedication and fearless fighting spirit! I really feel that we can preserve the foundation of the Cultural City! I couldn't help but write a few jingles for the night watchers: "There is no need to worry when the storm is coming. In times of crisis, one can show one's grace. The heroic spirit of sacrificing oneself is there, and the golden tiles are shining like a phoenix."

4282f8695866e6eaf40e66a919f36d4e316d7868.sourceText: 当天，晚上十点左右，我们向5位警察报告事件的情景还历历在目。 一边是我们近30人的护城战士紧紧地围在了一起向警察报告， 一边是真北 668 公司的3位头面人物在距离我们20余米的黑暗处 窃窃私语。我们强大的阵容， 旺盛的人气与暗出鬼鬼祟祟的孤零零的3人形成了鲜明的对照， 这就是正义战胜邪恶的真实写照！
4282f8695866e6eaf40e66a919f36d4e316d7868.translatedText: That day, around ten o'clock in the evening, we still vividly remember the scene when we reported the incident to five police officers. On one side, nearly 30 of us city guards gathered tightly together to report to the police. On the other side, the three leading figures of True North 668 Company were whispering in a dark place more than 20 meters away from us. Our strong lineup and strong popularity form a sharp contrast with the sneaky and lonely three people. This is a true portrayal of justice defeating evil!

936b0413ac559b0eaa8f911050230ada009246e1.sourceText: 特别值得提出的是，面对真北 668 公司的打压， 我们有参政经历的华人以亲身的经历提出了告状胜算的可能。 三个臭皮匠顶个诸葛亮，一个告状的方案就酝酿成形了。说时迟， 那时快，四方联系法院，通宵写状子，我们的无名英雄们 一如既往地 奉献着！我们向他们致敬！在这场斗争中，我们看到了 有参政经历的 华人在关键时刻的作用，我们真的需要有更多的华人走上政治午台。 联想到这次凤凰城文化城的保护战的战火是侨领侨团点然， 而添油加柴的却是我们草根民众，不免有些遗憾。 要是都能像当初之时，许多侨领侨团始终站在第一线， 那将是一个多么鼓舞人心的局面！期待我们的侨领侨团不忘初心， 一如既往！
936b0413ac559b0eaa8f911050230ada009246e1.translatedText: What is particularly worth mentioning is that in the face of the suppression by True North 668 Company, we Chinese people with experience in politics raised the possibility of winning the lawsuit through personal experience. The three cobblers supported Zhuge Liang, and a plan to sue was hatched. It was too late to say, but it was soon, all parties contacted the court and stayed up all night to write the complaint. Our unsung heroes are dedicated as always! We salute them! In this struggle, we have seen the role of Chinese people with experience in political participation at critical moments. We really need more Chinese people to take to the political stage. I feel a little regretful when I think that the fight to protect the Phoenix Cultural City was started by overseas Chinese leaders, but it was us grassroots people who added fuel to the fire. What an inspiring situation it would be if many overseas Chinese leaders and delegations could always stand on the front line like before! We hope that our overseas Chinese leaders will not forget their original aspirations and continue to do so!

17888350a86cb3ea9fb55f6c6d3ca1d485905bce.sourceText: 由于大家的共同努力，正义战胜了邪恶， 保卫同顺居餐馆的战斗取得了阶段性的胜利了， 向所有参加同顺居餐馆保卫战的战友们致敬！
17888350a86cb3ea9fb55f6c6d3ca1d485905bce.translatedText: Thanks to everyone's joint efforts, justice defeated evil, and the battle to defend Tongshunju Restaurant has achieved a staged victory. I pay tribute to all the comrades who participated in the battle to defend Tongshunju Restaurant!

5fd3021c102811dec91a28fc486777f66a96f2f2.sourceText: 3月5日， 当地法庭已经就真北公司和中粮物业管理公司对同顺居的卑鄙行径颁 发了限制令，保护同顺居的老板和员工的安全。同时， 市消防队的警官在收到真北公司和中粮物业管理公司的第二次谎报火 警，企图用高压水枪来伤害同顺居的正常营业时， 也警告了他们不可再滥用消防资源来伤害同顺居， 造成市政开支的损失 。
5fd3021c102811dec91a28fc486777f66a96f2f2.translatedText: On March 5, the local court issued a restraining order against Zhenbei Company and COFCO Property Management Company for their despicable behavior towards Tongshunju to protect the safety of Tongshunju’s boss and employees. At the same time, when police officers from the city fire brigade received a second false fire report from Zhenbei Company and COFCO Property Management Company in an attempt to use high-pressure water cannons to harm Tongshunju’s normal business, they also warned them not to abuse firefighting resources to harm Tongshunju and cause losses to municipal expenses.

a0e8a7bc2a1e58a79fd128807d19071d9cbd884c.sourceText: 然而真北公司贼心不死，继续其流氓行为 ，竟敢非法除掉 同顺居餐馆 的户名，切断电源。当时正是中午时分，餐馆正在营业， 有的顾客正在就餐，有的顾客正在洗手间，大师傅正在切菜， 危险和事故迫在眉前！
a0e8a7bc2a1e58a79fd128807d19071d9cbd884c.translatedText: However, Zhenbei Company persisted in its rogue behavior and even dared to illegally remove the account name of Tongshunju Restaurant and cut off the power supply. It was noon, the restaurant was open, some customers were dining, some were in the bathroom, and the master chef was cutting vegetables. Danger and accidents were imminent!

5b761eebac66b3bba684419ded7c3222b0dbfb85.sourceText: 就在这个时刻，同顺居餐馆被断电的险情传遍了微信群！第一时间， 发电机送到了，支援的朋友赶到了；第一时间，与电公司联系上了， 与电公司工人师傅联系上了，与 county attorney.Bill Montgomery 办公室联系上了，与媒体联系上了, 第一时间，微信群炸开了锅，满眼都是网友的关注、声援、 声讨和建议。3个多小时后，电力恢复了！ 同顺居餐馆员工和广大侨胞齐心协力又一次赢得了胜利！
5b761eebac66b3bba684419ded7c3222b0dbfb85.translatedText: At this moment, the danger of power outage at Tongshunju Restaurant spread throughout the WeChat group! Immediately, the generator was delivered, and support friends arrived. Immediately, I contacted the electric company, the master worker of the electric company, the office of county attorney Bill Montgomery, and the media. Immediately, the WeChat group exploded, filled with attention, support, condemnation, and suggestions from netizens. After more than 3 hours, the power was restored! The staff of Tongshunju Restaurant and the vast number of overseas Chinese worked together to win again!

95f2db4a7dbf8ef11250a627c100c90914b9eb24.sourceText: 保卫同顺居餐馆的战斗还远远没有结束，曲折、 残酷的斗争还在后头。我们呼吁 大 凤凰城 地区 5万同胞， 密切关注事态的发展，伸出您援助的手，出钱出力， 帮帮我们正在蒙受苦难的同胞！凤凰城中国文化中心得以保护至今， 就是有一群中华儿女一直不离不弃， 一直战斗在保护中国文化中心的 风 口浪尖！保护、传承中华文化人人有责， 我们欢迎您加入我们的行列。
95f2db4a7dbf8ef11250a627c100c90914b9eb24.translatedText: The battle to defend Tongshunju Restaurant is far from over, and a tortuous and cruel struggle is still to come. We appeal to the 50,000 compatriots in the greater Phoenix area to pay close attention to the development of the situation, extend your helping hand, contribute money and efforts, and help our compatriots who are suffering! The Chinese Cultural Center in Phoenix has been protected to this day because of a group of Chinese people who have never abandoned it and have been fighting to protect the Chinese Cultural Center! Everyone has the responsibility to protect and inherit Chinese culture, and we welcome you to join us.

bd003bcd3e8a4861baa171945c778cbdad7611f3.sourceText: 谢谢了，我们的骨肉同胞，我们的同根同祖的兄弟姐妹！（感谢胡昌铭的记录）
bd003bcd3e8a4861baa171945c778cbdad7611f3.translatedText: Thank you, our flesh and blood compatriots, our brothers and sisters with the same roots and ancestors! (Thanks to Hu Changming for the record)

36686cc256b571f7e70cd1ffca6699d39a5ea035.sourceText: 3月16日电 美国《世界日报》文章称，美国联邦卫生官员15日着手推动一项史无前例的重大反烟举措：将设定规范、大幅降低香烟中的尼古丁含量，藉此帮助吸烟者戒烟、预防年轻人抽烟成瘾。
36686cc256b571f7e70cd1ffca6699d39a5ea035.translatedText: March 16th The US "World Journal" article stated that US federal health officials launched an unprecedented major anti-smoking initiative on the 15th: they will set standards and significantly reduce the nicotine content in cigarettes to help smokers quit smoking and prevent young people from becoming addicted to smoking.

d107923d595f4786ba8da1c8c506980ce869314b.sourceText: 联邦食品暨药物管理局(FDA)去年夏天提出有关草案，15日公布限制尼古丁新细节及潜在影响。政府过去对烟草中的尼古丁含量并未设限，现在FDA可依法规范尼古丁含量，最多减少八成。
d107923d595f4786ba8da1c8c506980ce869314b.translatedText: The Federal Food and Drug Administration (FDA) proposed a relevant draft last summer and announced new details and potential impacts of nicotine restrictions on the 15th. In the past, the government did not set limits on the nicotine content in tobacco. Now the FDA can regulate the nicotine content in accordance with the law and reduce it by up to 80%.

38867ce9e5a6c5941b7421c1ccdb31803b3a212f.sourceText: FDA估计，目前美国成年人吸烟人口占15%，在2060年以前，可下降至1.4%。在新限制实施一年内，可望有500万人戒烟。
38867ce9e5a6c5941b7421c1ccdb31803b3a212f.translatedText: The FDA estimates that currently 15% of the adult population in the United States smokes, which may drop to 1.4% before 2060. Within a year of the new restrictions, 5 million people are expected to quit smoking.

d5c7c2d4da6874cd9f88b665b51ece5bb2bef280.sourceText: FDA烟草中心负责人塞勒(Mitch Zeller)表示，”限制尼古丁”可以帮助未来几代的孩子，不致因尝试抽烟而走向成瘾致命之途。
d5c7c2d4da6874cd9f88b665b51ece5bb2bef280.translatedText: Mitch Zeller, director of the FDA Tobacco Center, said that "limiting nicotine" can help future generations of children avoid trying smoking and leading to fatal addiction.

ee9f8c9501341aba04b6f21fe9219bd87d02e686.sourceText: FDA提案重点在于：尼古丁容易上瘾，但不会致命。然而，抽烟时吸入的燃烧烟草和其他物质会导致癌症、心脏病和支气管炎。数十年来的反烟措施让抽烟率降至新低，但每年仍有逾48万人因吸烟致死。
ee9f8c9501341aba04b6f21fe9219bd87d02e686.translatedText: The focus of the FDA proposal is that nicotine is addictive but not fatal. However, the burning tobacco and other substances inhaled while smoking can cause cancer, heart disease, and bronchitis. Decades of anti-smoking measures have driven smoking rates to new lows, but more than 480,000 people still die from smoking every year.

9a55f80cfccaf4db962ee5d6c007d8ead939d4d7.sourceText: 低尼古丁香烟并非新概念，包括菲利普莫里斯在内的几家公司曾在1980和1990年代试图在美国销售低尼古丁香烟，结果不太成功。
9a55f80cfccaf4db962ee5d6c007d8ead939d4d7.translatedText: Low-nicotine cigarettes are not a new concept. Several companies, including Philip Morris, tried to sell low-nicotine cigarettes in the United States in the 1980s and 1990s, with less than successful results.

3916d6a40348131d3a7d5e63ae21af18bf22d080.sourceText: FDA2009年获得授权规管香烟和其他烟草产品成分，但FDA不断面临大型烟草公司的法律挑战和阻碍。
3916d6a40348131d3a7d5e63ae21af18bf22d080.translatedText: >The FDA was authorized to regulate the ingredients of cigarettes and other tobacco products in 2009, but the FDA continues to face legal challenges and obstacles from large tobacco companies.

9b288a42ca7a1b59a1cdb82185341de31dfa3f83.sourceText: 烟草业分析师认为，由于涉复杂风险，FDA可能至少需要四年，才能落实任何变更。
9b288a42ca7a1b59a1cdb82185341de31dfa3f83.translatedText: Tobacco industry analysts believe that it may take the FDA at least four years to implement any changes due to the complex risks involved.

54705ef72bd7094edc073bdd981d7d2a2de2cf58.sourceText: FDA已于2016年取得电子烟授权，但制造商提交产品审查的截止日期已延后到2022年。目前尚不清楚电子烟能否帮助成瘾者戒烟。
54705ef72bd7094edc073bdd981d7d2a2de2cf58.translatedText: The FDA obtained e-cigarette authorization in 2016, but the deadline for manufacturers to submit product reviews has been extended to 2022. It's unclear whether e-cigarettes can help addicts quit smoking.

6bf69413200b7c36e5c1936265fd568615446719.translatedText: Poll: Nearly 60% of Americans say Trump is a racist (Central News Agency, Washington, 1st comprehensive foreign news report) More than half of Americans, most of whom are African-American and Hispanic...

9e36c93b01d9c9c04f3209efd67669be34c24d31.sourceText: （中央社华盛顿1日综合外电报导）超过一半美国人、其中大部分为非裔和西语裔民众认为，美国总统川普是种族主义者。逾半数认为他的政策让西语裔民众和穆斯林处境更糟，将近一半认为让非裔美国人日子更难过。
9e36c93b01d9c9c04f3209efd67669be34c24d31.translatedText: (Central News Agency, Washington, 1st comprehensive foreign news report) More than half of Americans, most of whom are African-American and Hispanic people, believe that US President Trump is a racist. More than half think his policies have made life worse for Hispanics and Muslims, and nearly half think it has made life harder for African Americans.

42c88bd7ecdb49b3ed5362686eb8f96fe033a23d.sourceText: 根据美联社-NORC公共事务研究中心（Associated Press-NORC Center for Public Affairs Research）所做新民调，57%美国人认为川普（Donald Trump）政策对穆斯林不利；56%的人认为对西语裔不利。47%民众、其中3/4为非裔则认为，川普政策对非裔美国人不利。
42c88bd7ecdb49b3ed5362686eb8f96fe033a23d.translatedText: According to a new poll conducted by the Associated Press-NORC Center for Public Affairs Research, 57% of Americans believe that Trump’s policies are harmful to Muslims; 56% believe that they are harmful to Hispanics. 47% of the people, 3/4 of whom are African Americans, believe that Trump’s policies are harmful to African Americans.

656b60c227953eb42a501584680294e1788ab597.sourceText: 美联社报导，57%美国成年人认为川普是种族主义者，包括超过8/10非裔、3/4西语裔和近一半白人认为如此。85%民主党人认为川普是种族主义者，但共和党仅21%人同意。
656b60c227953eb42a501584680294e1788ab597.translatedText: The Associated Press reported that 57% of American adults believe Trump is a racist, including more than 8/10 African Americans, 3/4 Hispanics and nearly half of white people. 85% of Democrats believe Trump is racist, but only 21% of Republicans agree.

4a7229d5b93ba7f4f0c9424c252209a837e9c7cf.sourceText: 民调结果显示，川普担任总统期间，美国在种族议题上明显分歧。川普不但承诺在美墨边界筑墙，防止移民非法进入美国，还以鸟不生蛋（shithole）形容非洲国家。
4a7229d5b93ba7f4f0c9424c252209a837e9c7cf.translatedText: Poll results show that during Trump’s term as president, the United States was clearly divided on racial issues. Trump not only promised to build a wall on the US-Mexico border to prevent immigrants from illegally entering the United States, but also described African countries as "shitholes".

77a8e7f419964db352826d788e1c96255f7b849e.sourceText: 针对这项民调结果，白宫没有立即做出回应。不过，川普今年年初被问到外界认为他是种族主义者时，他回应：「不，不是。我不是种族主义者。」他也告诉记者：「我可以告诉你们，我是你们访问过最没有种族主义的人。」（译者：叶俐纬/核稿：卢映孜）1070302
77a8e7f419964db352826d788e1c96255f7b849e.translatedText: The White House did not immediately respond to the poll results. However, when Trump was asked at the beginning of this year that others thought he was a racist, he responded: "No, no. I am not a racist." He also told reporters: "I can tell you, I am the least racist person you have ever interviewed." (Translator: Ye Liwei/Verification: Lu Yingzi) 1070302

541501a81373659d9f0ee7e8641eb2bd5ee20023.translatedText: Aetna Group, headquartered in Hartford, Connecticut, is the third largest insurance company in the United States. (Photo source: Associated Press)

8f68b072a726eea9eecebe01c885c898df7a1746.sourceText: 【侨报综合讯】加州政府为配合实施奥巴马医保法而设立的医保交易市场”加州全保”（Covered California）周四发表分析报告说， 2019年，全美通过政府医保市场购买医疗保险的民众可能看到保费上涨22%到32%。专家指出，去年国会在税改法案中废除奥巴马医保法强制民众购买医保的条款，将促使个人医保费用在2019年上涨7%到15%，另外医疗费用上升的趋势将把医保费用推高7%。
8f68b072a726eea9eecebe01c885c898df7a1746.translatedText: [Qiaobao Comprehensive News] Covered California, the health insurance exchange market established by the California government to cooperate with the implementation of the Obamacare law, issued an analysis report on Thursday saying that in 2019, people across the United States who purchase health insurance through the government health insurance market may see premiums increase by 22% to 32%. Experts point out that the repeal of the provisions of the Obamacare law in the tax reform bill last year that forced people to purchase medical insurance will cause individual medical insurance costs to rise by 7% to 15% in 2019. In addition, the rising trend of medical costs will push medical insurance costs up by 7%.

a7f426ced78f06cd135466b89c3adb7162ba681f.sourceText: 据旧金山记事报网站报道，”加州全保”市场为该州没有从雇主那里获得医保的120万居民提供医保选购服务。它没有列出加州医保费用上涨的具体数字。不过，在它发表该报告之前，城市研究所上个月发表的分析报告估计，2019年，加州的医保费用将上涨18%。
a7f426ced78f06cd135466b89c3adb7162ba681f.translatedText: According to the San Francisco Chronicle website, the "California Covered" market provides health insurance shopping services for the 1.2 million residents of the state who do not receive health insurance from their employers. It did not list specific figures for the increase in California's health care costs. However, before it released the report, an analysis released last month by the Urban Institute estimated that health care costs in California will rise 18% in 2019.

e57d8ce0a36f3a8f1196639d5ce516085c21b12b.sourceText: ”加州全保”的主任彼得.李（Peter Lee）说：”消费者将在9月和10月看到他们明年1月医保费用上涨的通知。”
e57d8ce0a36f3a8f1196639d5ce516085c21b12b.translatedText: Peter Lee, director of Covered California, said: "Consumers will see notifications of increases in their health insurance costs in January next year in September and October."

07bef6ce8fe5153d415902c22ed49b93872135eb.sourceText: 最新分析报告预计，医保费用将在随后两年继续上涨。到2021 年， 与目前的医保费用相比，加州将成为全美医保费用上涨35%左右的15个州之一。由于进入加州个人医保市场的居民慢性病比例属于最低，而健康人口比例最高，该州医保费用的涨幅还属于较低的范围。
07bef6ce8fe5153d415902c22ed49b93872135eb.translatedText: The latest analysis report predicts that health insurance costs will continue to rise in the next two years. By 2021, California will be one of 15 states in the United States where health insurance costs will rise by about 35% compared to current health care costs. Since California has the lowest proportion of residents with chronic diseases and the highest proportion of healthy people entering the individual health insurance market, the increase in health insurance costs in the state is still within a relatively low range.

c466e910dcc667ab36e366eee411c930e07edc8e.sourceText: 今后3年，全美19个州的医保费用可能上涨50%以上，而17个州可能看到医保费用上涨90%以上。
c466e910dcc667ab36e366eee411c930e07edc8e.translatedText: In the next three years, medical insurance costs may rise by more than 50% in 19 states across the United States, and 17 states may see medical insurance costs rise by more than 90%.

a87ecfd0fd46505401f69d9fd8bbd2737a025fe4.sourceText: 医保费用这样大幅上涨，主要适用于全美大约1000万得到政府保费补贴的居民和600万没有得到补贴者。前面一批人也许能得到部分保护，因为他们医保费用的上涨可能被所获补贴增加抵消掉，而后一批人则会受到沉重打击。
a87ecfd0fd46505401f69d9fd8bbd2737a025fe4.translatedText: Such a sharp increase in medical insurance costs mainly applies to the approximately 10 million residents in the United States who receive government premium subsidies and the 6 million who do not receive subsidies. The first group of people may be partially protected because the increase in their medical insurance costs may be offset by the increase in subsidies they receive, while the latter group of people will be hit hard.

db9a2670c1dce863637e30b1aaf9e78256697d29.sourceText: 自从2014年”加州全保”市场开始运营以来，医保费用在前两年各上涨了4%，但在2017 年和2018年却分别上涨了13%和12.5%。
db9a2670c1dce863637e30b1aaf9e78256697d29.translatedText: Since the "California Covered" market began operating in 2014, medical insurance costs increased by 4% in each of the first two years, but increased by 13% and 12.5% ​​in 2017 and 2018 respectively.

160a7352741061f3c68261a3c627836381f8cd84.sourceText: 预计医保费用上涨的部分原因是受医疗开支上升驱动，而国会和白宫自2017年以来给保险市场注入不确定因素，无疑是为那种趋势火上浇油。奥巴马执政时期出台的《可负担医疗法》（Affordable Care Act，俗称奥巴马医保法）规定个人必须购买医保，否则会被罚款。该条款将在2019年失效，因为去年12月国会通过的税改法案废除了它。
160a7352741061f3c68261a3c627836381f8cd84.translatedText: Health insurance premiums are expected to rise in part due to rising medical spending, and the uncertainty Congress and the White House have injected into the insurance market since 2017 has undoubtedly added fuel to that trend. The Affordable Care Act (commonly known as Obamacare) introduced during the Obama administration stipulates that individuals must purchase health insurance, otherwise they will be fined. That provision will expire in 2019 because the tax reform bill passed by Congress in December repealed it.

495e2b5bd12d0cb5461e97b871826d3d225b770e.sourceText: ”加州全保”市场精算师、分析报告作者贝特科（John Bertko） 指出，到2019年，废除个人必须购买医保强制条款将导致医保费用上涨7%到15%，而医疗费不断增加的趋势会促使每年的医保费用上涨7%。
495e2b5bd12d0cb5461e97b871826d3d225b770e.translatedText: "California Covered" market actuary and author of the analysis report, John Bertko, pointed out that by 2019, the abolition of the mandatory clause that individuals must purchase medical insurance will cause medical insurance costs to increase by 7% to 15%, and the trend of increasing medical expenses will cause annual medical insurance costs to rise by 7%.

f5e93af2c9af616cce9f2c8d183988c11041fe20.sourceText: 川普政府近日对价格便宜、覆盖面较小的医保计划放松了监管。专家预计，这将把个人医保市场变成两大部分：健康人群转向价格较低、覆盖面较小的医保计划，而有病人群只好付较高的医保费用，因为他们需要覆盖面较大的医保计划。
f5e93af2c9af616cce9f2c8d183988c11041fe20.translatedText: >The Trump administration has recently relaxed regulations on cheaper health insurance plans with less coverage. Experts predict that this will divide the individual health insurance market into two parts: healthy people will switch to lower-priced health insurance plans with less coverage, while sick people will have to pay higher health insurance premiums because they need health insurance plans with greater coverage.

9bdaa07cd20edfc23924d6116af7bf87aa184c16.sourceText: 强制民众购买医保条款是奥巴马医保法的基石，其原理是大家都买医保，年轻、健康人群所交的保费就可以被用来补贴年老、多病的人群，从而使后者可以少花钱、多看病。该条款被废除后，很多年轻、健康的人可能不再参保，保险公司的收入势必会减少，因此不得不提高保费，以维持正常运转。
9bdaa07cd20edfc23924d6116af7bf87aa184c16.translatedText: The clause that forces people to buy medical insurance is the cornerstone of the Obamacare law. The principle is that if everyone buys medical insurance, the premiums paid by young and healthy people can be used to subsidize the elderly and sick people, so that the latter can spend less and see more doctors. After this provision is repealed, many young and healthy people may no longer be insured, and insurance companies will inevitably see less revenue, so they will have to increase premiums to maintain normal operations.

cbd363e70529c2063661706f9463c7f32a4c1e53.translatedText: The woman with diarrhea was diagnosed with uremia, which was related to the negligence during pregnancy 10 years ago. Original title: A woman from Hangzhou had diarrhea, and was diagnosed with uremia! She was pregnant like she was 10 years ago...

658caaf2000264c8ee02bff8a068807c2c4ed2a6.sourceText: 原标题：杭州女子拉肚子，结果查出尿毒症！竟和10年前怀孕时的一个疏忽有关
658caaf2000264c8ee02bff8a068807c2c4ed2a6.translatedText: Original title: Hangzhou woman had diarrhea and was found to have uremia! It was actually related to an oversight during pregnancy 10 years ago

2e5f231b0d7009b00000508ea07a33c5c5de2ecf.sourceText: 城西的赵女士今年32岁，24岁结婚，生有一个可爱的儿子，本该是很幸福的一家人。可一场拉肚子，她怎么也没想到竟是尿毒症。
2e5f231b0d7009b00000508ea07a33c5c5de2ecf.translatedText: > Ms. Zhao from the west of the city is 32 years old. She got married at the age of 24 and gave birth to a lovely son. They should have been a very happy family. But when she had diarrhea, she never thought it was uremia.

87dc15b29556c40c24a5a1e90b7cb78e69b0a8a8.sourceText: 在某商城上班的赵女士，工作也不是很忙，平时比较注重身体保养。十年前，因为怀孕，她得了妊娠性高血压，一直服药至今。
87dc15b29556c40c24a5a1e90b7cb78e69b0a8a8.translatedText: Ms. Zhao, who works in a shopping mall, is not very busy at work and usually pays more attention to physical care. Ten years ago, she suffered from gestational hypertension due to pregnancy and has been taking medication to this day.

c0e38fab1e9efd285f89e25143bc9ad55a3e28c0.sourceText: 但不久前的一天，她突然开始肚子痛，拉水样便，一天拉了7-8次，而且还恶心呕吐4-5次，她以为自己吃了什么不干净的东西，就跑到了杭州市西溪医院就诊。
c0e38fab1e9efd285f89e25143bc9ad55a3e28c0.translatedText: But one day not long ago, she suddenly started to have stomach pains and had watery stools. She had urination 7-8 times a day and had nausea and vomiting 4-5 times. She thought she had eaten something unclean, so she went to Hangzhou Xixi Hospital for treatment.

0b535560a8ca42668b35da4a674cfbdc111e56d1.sourceText: 接诊的崔龚臻医生通过检查，发现赵女士不是简单的肠道疾病，她的血钾超标，这是很不正常的一个指标。
0b535560a8ca42668b35da4a674cfbdc111e56d1.translatedText: > Dr. Cui Gongzhen, who treated her, found through examination that Ms. Zhao did not have a simple intestinal disease. Her blood potassium exceeded the standard, which is a very abnormal indicator.

50c49817303c8e0ed9474c8db2571f221c8a6baa.sourceText: 因为血钾通过肾脏代谢，如果血钾高，很有可能是因为肾脏有问题。于是，崔医生查了赵女士的肝肾功能。一查才发现，赵女士肌酐1327μmol/L（正常女性：44-97μmol/L），尿素32.4 mmol/L（正常情况：3.2-7.0mmol/L），详细询问病史后初步诊断为慢性肾病5期，也就是常说的慢性肾衰，必须马上血透治疗。
50c49817303c8e0ed9474c8db2571f221c8a6baa.translatedText: Because blood potassium is metabolized by the kidneys, if blood potassium is high, it is most likely because of kidney problems. So Dr. Cui checked Ms. Zhao’s liver and kidney function. After an investigation, it was discovered that Ms. Zhao's creatinine was 1327 μmol/L (normal female: 44-97 μmol/L), and urea was 32.4 mmol/L (normal: 3.2-7.0 mmol/L). After detailed medical history, she was initially diagnosed with stage 5 chronic kidney disease, which is often referred to as chronic renal failure, and he must be treated with hemodialysis immediately.

3eb4e4dfb4cd17465122c777b3f6b6c5c00a4bdd.sourceText: 于是，赵女士被送入病房，立即进行血透治疗，病情开始慢慢好转。
3eb4e4dfb4cd17465122c777b3f6b6c5c00a4bdd.translatedText: As a result, Ms. Zhao was sent to the ward and immediately underwent hemodialysis treatment, and her condition began to slowly improve.

303439eb4bf44d16ccda1dd0a5118a6a9f948f2d.sourceText: 该院普内科主任医师李惠莉告诉记者，慢性肾衰竭是指各种肾脏病导致肾脏功能渐进性不可逆性减退，直至功能丧失所出现的一系列症状和代谢紊乱所组成的临床综合征。慢性肾衰的终末期即为人们常说的尿毒症。
303439eb4bf44d16ccda1dd0a5118a6a9f948f2d.translatedText: Li Huili, chief physician of the general internal medicine department of the hospital, told reporters that chronic renal failure refers to a clinical syndrome consisting of a series of symptoms and metabolic disorders caused by various kidney diseases that lead to progressive and irreversible decline in kidney function until the function is lost. The end stage of chronic renal failure is often referred to as uremia.

9566dd2980a4126debf160106945a390f9148c81.sourceText: 李主任仔细分析患者的病情后，排除了遗传、免疫系统疾病等因素，最终考虑与当时怀孕有关。赵女士10年前产检就发现尿蛋白高，同时伴有高血压，当时赵女士只对高血压重视，而忽略了尿蛋白异常。很可惜，10年下来，急性的肾功能不全已经慢慢发展成为慢性肾衰。
9566dd2980a4126debf160106945a390f9148c81.translatedText: After careful analysis of the patient's condition, Director Li ruled out factors such as genetics and immune system diseases, and finally considered it to be related to the pregnancy at that time. Ms. Zhao's prenatal checkup 10 years ago revealed high urinary protein and high blood pressure. At that time, Ms. Zhao only paid attention to high blood pressure and ignored abnormal urinary protein. Unfortunately, over the past 10 years, acute renal insufficiency has slowly developed into chronic renal failure.

c08eee1c22c5d6bec37c694ba776c2177559a7bf.sourceText: 尿毒症正在走向年轻化，所以年轻的朋友们，不要再以自己年轻作为健康资本。李主任提醒大家，如果出现脸色发黄或发白、足踝部和眼睑浮肿、胃口不好、味觉障碍、恶心呕吐、容易疲倦、乏力、尿量减少等症状，必须引起重视，尽快到医院做相关检查。几乎所有的肾脏病都可以通过尿常规的异常表现出来，因此要及时尿检。
c08eee1c22c5d6bec37c694ba776c2177559a7bf.translatedText: Uremia is becoming younger, so young friends, stop using your youth as a health asset. Director Li reminds everyone that if you have symptoms such as yellowing or white complexion, swollen ankles and eyelids, poor appetite, dysgeusia, nausea and vomiting, easy fatigue, fatigue, decreased urine output, etc., you must pay attention and go to the hospital for relevant examinations as soon as possible. Almost all kidney diseases can be manifested by abnormalities in urine routine, so urine testing is required in time.

005785d9b820436cf5402b7403e2def5b47be2aa.sourceText: 李主任说，保护肾脏，除了定期检查外，应不憋尿、多喝水，饮食清淡、减少食盐摄入，避免滥用药物、长期大量服用止痛剂，不吸烟、少喝酒。
005785d9b820436cf5402b7403e2def5b47be2aa.translatedText: Director Li said that to protect the kidneys, in addition to regular inspections, you should not hold back your urine, drink more water, eat a light diet, reduce salt intake, avoid drug abuse, long-term use of large amounts of analgesics, not smoke, and drink less.

0917753c01ba13685e23e7a2f602822414a12c15.sourceText: 2018 年世界肾脏病日马上就到了，今年主题是”关注肾脏病，关爱女性健康”，杭州市西溪医院将于3月8日下午14：00?6：00，在血透中心（1号楼4楼）为透析病人免费检测透析通路的血管B超，同时在体检中心休息区（1号楼4楼）开展《呵护透析通路》的健康讲座。
0917753c01ba13685e23e7a2f602822414a12c15.translatedText: 2018 World Kidney Day is coming soon. This year's theme is "Pay attention to kidney disease and care for women's health." Hangzhou Xixi Hospital will provide free vascular B-ultrasound testing for dialysis patients in the hemodialysis center (4th floor of Building 1) from 14:00 to 6:00 on March 8. At the same time, a health lecture on "Care for Dialysis Access" will be held in the rest area of the physical examination center (4th floor of Building 1).

73a074d22ce2fb9f898ead16fafcf20d73a640c6.translatedText: Famous physicist Stephen Hawking passed away at the age of 76 Famous physicist Stephen Hawking Sina Technology News At noon on March 14, according to multiple...

2b751e779823a476b4e0625ccd959ec9ad64d222.sourceText: 新浪科技讯 3月14日中午消息，据多家英国媒体报道，著名物理学家史蒂芬.霍金今日去世，享年76岁。
2b751e779823a476b4e0625ccd959ec9ad64d222.translatedText: Sina Technology News at noon on March 14, according to multiple British media reports, the famous physicist Stephen Hawking died today at the age of 76.

1fdcd8ac9a2b1b3af711b4f19828f956cb49c067.sourceText: 史蒂芬.威廉.霍金（Stephen William Hawking），1942年1月8日出生于英国牛津，英国剑桥大学著名物理学家，现代最伟大的物理学家之一、20世纪享有国际盛誉的伟人之一，著有《时间简史》等书。1979至2009年任卢卡斯数学教授，主要研究领域是宇宙论和黑洞，证明了广义相对论的奇性定理和黑洞面积定理，提出了黑洞蒸发理论和无边界的霍金宇宙模型，在统一20世纪物理学的两大基础理论棗爱因斯坦创立的相对论和普朗克创立的量子力学方面走出了重要一步。
1fdcd8ac9a2b1b3af711b4f19828f956cb49c067.translatedText: Stephen William Hawking, born on January 8, 1942 in Oxford, England, is a famous physicist at the University of Cambridge in England. He is one of the greatest physicists in modern times and one of the internationally renowned great men of the 20th century. He is the author of "A Brief History of Time" and other books. He served as Lucas Professor of Mathematics from 1979 to 2009. His main research areas were cosmology and black holes. He proved the singularity theorem and the black hole area theorem of general relativity, proposed the black hole evaporation theory and the boundaryless Hawking universe model, and took an important step in unifying the two basic theories of physics in the 20th century: the theory of relativity founded by Einstein and the quantum mechanics founded by Planck.

411ad989c39c9ced22c61dd11f3018b4928d735a.sourceText: 以下为霍金发言人声明全文：
411ad989c39c9ced22c61dd11f3018b4928d735a.translatedText: The following is the full text of the statement from Hawking's spokesperson:

7322ce09323409326e1b7e4229f9813176c70ddd.sourceText: 我们遗憾的宣布，史蒂芬.霍金（Stephen Hawking）教授已经辞世，享年76岁。
7322ce09323409326e1b7e4229f9813176c70ddd.translatedText: We regret to announce that Professor Stephen Hawking has passed away at the age of 76.

ff4dad799c178596929e6dca97d49791643ed9b4.sourceText: 霍金教授今晨在位于剑桥的家中平静地离开了这个世界。
ff4dad799c178596929e6dca97d49791643ed9b4.translatedText: Professor Hawking passed away peacefully this morning at his home in Cambridge.

ba848fe0f32ce50068ae97eb758f919c864daef8.sourceText: 他的家人希望外界能够给予他们时间和隐私来悼念霍金教授的离开，但是他们想要感谢每一位在霍金教授的一生中，一直以来站他身边并且支持他的人。
ba848fe0f32ce50068ae97eb758f919c864daef8.translatedText: His family hopes that the outside world can give them time and privacy to mourn Professor Hawking's passing, but they would like to thank everyone who has stood by and supported Professor Hawking throughout his life.

35c291a889669a01fc6e3e918924187dd88aba05.sourceText: 他的子女露西、罗伯特和蒂姆发出了如下声明：
35c291a889669a01fc6e3e918924187dd88aba05.translatedText: His children Lucy, Robert and Tim issued the following statement:

9758d7406402d5f76a359a9d0e12cb14d4fe793e.sourceText: ”我们深爱的父亲已于今日辞世，我们为此感到极度伤心。他是一名伟大的科学家，一个卓越的人，他的工作成功将会在未来许多年继续存在下去。他的勇气和坚持以及他的天才与幽默鼓舞了来自世界各地的人。他曾经说过： ”如果不能为你所爱的人提供一个家，宇宙就没有什么意义了。”我们将会永远怀念他。”
9758d7406402d5f76a359a9d0e12cb14d4fe793e.translatedText: "We are extremely saddened that our beloved father has passed away today. He was a great scientist and a remarkable man, and the success of his work will live on for many years to come. His courage and persistence, as well as his genius and humor, inspired people from all over the world. He once said: "There's not much point in the universe if it doesn't provide a home for the people you love. "We will miss him forever."

bfc17b56da4d78c54e985a4bd2aa5ae0a327a75c.sourceText: 剑桥大学开冈维尔凯斯学院开放了吊唁信，供所有希望悼念霍金教授一生工作成果的人阅读。
bfc17b56da4d78c54e985a4bd2aa5ae0a327a75c.translatedText: >Caiganville Caius College, University of Cambridge, has opened letters of condolence for anyone who wishes to pay tribute to Professor Hawking's life's work.

4bfb7ecba3924a860487a01799af8e3f2ad44b3f.translatedText: Breaking 125-year history, Coca-Cola will launch alcoholic beverages (Central News Agency, Tokyo, 7th comprehensive foreign news report) The American soft drink industry giant Coca-Cola is planning to...

ab8ec15e38b0bface3e8d00011761619ba5c89dd.sourceText: （中央社东京7日综合外电报导）美国软性饮料业巨擘可口可乐公司正计划打破自身125年历史，準备首度推出含酒精的饮料产品。他们想搭上在日本渐受欢迎的Chu-Hai气泡酒热潮，在当地贩售类似罐装气泡甜酒。
ab8ec15e38b0bface3e8d00011761619ba5c89dd.translatedText: (Central News Agency, Tokyo, 7th comprehensive foreign news report) The American soft drink industry giant Coca-Cola is planning to break its 125-year history and prepare to launch alcoholic beverage products for the first time. They want to ride on the Chu-Hai sparkling wine craze that is gaining popularity in Japan and sell similar canned sparkling liqueur locally.

c45fd9898085a96507896dc538847e651250b261.sourceText: 英国广播公司（BBC）报导，Chu-Hai气泡酒的酒精含量通常介于3%-8%。可口可乐日本分公司总裁贾杜诺（Jorge Garduno）表示，这项行动是「针对我们市场一小块特定族群的小型试验」。
c45fd9898085a96507896dc538847e651250b261.translatedText: The British Broadcasting Corporation (BBC) reported that the alcohol content of Chu-Hai sparkling wine is usually between 3% and 8%. Jorge Garduno, president of Coca-Cola Japan, said the move was "a small trial targeting a small, specific segment of our market."

781fcf4aadb4ff9d0bafa55b6b266425d8122ab2.sourceText: 贾杜诺还说：「我们从未在含酒量低的饮料市场进行试验。这将证明我们如何在核心业务之外领域持续开发机会。」然而他暗示，这款饮料很可能不会在日本以外地区销售。
781fcf4aadb4ff9d0bafa55b6b266425d8122ab2.translatedText: Giardino also said: "We have never experimented in the low-alcohol beverage market. This will demonstrate how we can continue to develop opportunities in areas outside of our core business." However, he hinted that the drink will likely not be sold outside Japan.

85eeb63622b8c689f4cf6025f875526f7ee7f8ea.sourceText: Chu-Hai是日本烧酎高球（highball）调酒的缩写。这款产品被宣传为啤酒的替代品，并且格外受女性消费者喜爱。
85eeb63622b8c689f4cf6025f875526f7ee7f8ea.translatedText: Chu-Hai is the abbreviation of Japanese highball bartending. The product is promoted as an alternative to beer and is particularly popular with female consumers.

bb9852678bf4e9d4992207167ccd95ef78cb0610.sourceText: 日本3大饮料公司麒麟控股公司（Kirin Holdings Co.）、三得利控股公司（Suntory Holdings Ltd.）和朝日集团控股公司（Asahi Group Holdings Ltd.）全都推出不同款的Chu-Hai气泡酒，并持续研发新口味。
bb9852678bf4e9d4992207167ccd95ef78cb0610.translatedText: Japan's three major beverage companies, Kirin Holdings Co., Suntory Holdings Ltd. and Asahi Group Holdings Ltd., have all launched different versions of Chu-Hai sparkling wine and continue to develop new flavors.

9b6981423d2cbbf33fb07d1abfddb07de6c581a6.sourceText: 其中最受欢迎的Chu-Hai气泡酒是葡萄柚和柠檬等柑橘口味，也有葡萄、苹果和蜜桃等其他水果口味。
9b6981423d2cbbf33fb07d1abfddb07de6c581a6.translatedText: The most popular Chu-Hai sparkling wines are citrus flavors such as grapefruit and lemon, as well as other fruit flavors such as grape, apple and peach.

7d47f1f6dd7d3772083151c1b95f750db684548b.sourceText: 另一方面，随著年轻消费族群的健康意识抬头，可口可乐公司不断开发气泡饮料以外的产品，包括已推出瓶装水和茶品。（译者：张正芊/核稿：张佑之）
7d47f1f6dd7d3772083151c1b95f750db684548b.translatedText: On the other hand, as young consumers become more health-conscious, Coca-Cola continues to develop products other than sparkling beverages, including the launch of bottled water and tea. (Translator: Zhang Zhengqian/Verification: Zhang Youzhi)

f229c3ad3a6e8df1b8d2467b4927a343416d4f21.sourceText: 大鳳凰城台美商會2018 春宴迎金狗慶元宵 大鳳凰城台美商會於三月三曰星期六晚上六點在鳳城海鮮酒家舉行2018年新春晚宴,和大鳳凰城主流政商名流及台僑一起迎接金狗年歡渡元宵佳節。 晚會由祥獅獻瑞熱鬧開場，大鳯凰城台美商會會長張聖儀率先代表商會全體理監事向與會嘉賓介紹商會歴史活動簡介，致力促進國民外交，培育青商和商機媒合不遺餘力，並敬祝大家狗年行大運，好運旺旺來大發。美國聯邦國會眾議員Congressman Paul Gosar 擔任本次春宴的主講人，和參會嘉賓分享此次川普稅改對中小型企業的影響並祝賀大家新年快樂。亞利桑那州卅長Dough Doucey特頒Proclamation 明定為農曆春節曰由卅長多元平等辦公室執行長Barry Wong 代表頒發給大鳯凰城台美商會，由創會會長䔥時英，前會長張晴玲陳明鏡及會長張聖儀接下賀狀。錢德樂副市市長Nora Ellen 在致詞時特別讚揚本商會大力促進族裔交流和商機謀合所做的貢獻並恭賀大家新春愉快。 此次出席的主流政要還有有美國聯邦國會眾議員Congressman Andy Biggs辦公室代表Lee Huff，錢德樂市市長候選人暨前副市長Kevin Hartke夫婦, 錢德樂姊姊市主席暨亞利桑納卅交通運輸部副主席Jack Sellers, 錢德樂市議員Mark Stewart,Terry Roe 錢德樂市多元族裔廳長Leah Powell, 錢德樂市經貿廳長Micah Miranda, Chandler Tullmore and 錢德樂台南姊妹市主席及理事們，大鳳凰城台美商會理事徐愛妮Juan Carrillo，葉琍琍王棟齊，李裕泉王麗玉，竇蕙芝王棟賢伉儷，黄一帆，簡媁婷，杜淑儝，黄鍚珩，嚴招弟，李佩倫，特别委員王麗詔，陳祈君Rob Truman，青商部會長Brian 蕭，商會理事暨僑務顧問黃玉蓮鄭弘，亜省台灣同鄉會創會會長文衍庭，亜省台灣同鄉會會長吳文瑞，前會長林國祥，鳳凰城中文學校校長程秀琳，鳳凰城慈濟負責人郭濟林師兄，亞省台美人婦女會創會會長郭慈玉，鳳凰城台灣同鄉聯誼會副會長傅彩雲，高志中僑務諮詢委員，台灣漢翔航空北美洲副總裁戴源遠，台灣京晨科技北美洲總經理魏守逸，中華航空公司北美洲業務經理李宜真，錢德樂商會，韓僑商會，越僑商會，亞裔商會，亜省華商會長伍兆文, 亜省婦女地產協會全卅總會長張聖儀，亜省科工副會長胡珍醫師，亜省共和黨亜裔聯盟主席Kevin Deng，2018鳳凰城華埠公主台灣親善大使李翎瑀等政商亜盈實業公司業務經理曽昌遠等政商名流近二百餘人出席晚宴盛況空前。 晚宴中特別由創會會長蕭時英，頒發商會終身成就獎給甫退休的前會長張晴玲僑務諮詢委員，並代表商會所有理監事會員，向張晴玲名譽會長致上最高敬意，感謝張晴玲在商會19年來的歴史上，曾擔任三届會長十多餘年来致力會務，無私奉献才能發展至今，張晴玲永久名譽會長也發表感言，全體與會佳賓一致起立鼔掌，實至名歸。 此次晚宴青商部負責安排各式舞蹈歌唱表演節目由享頌樂團, ASU台灣同學會，台灣親善大使李翎瑀擔任演出精彩絕倫，在大鳳凰城台美商會理監事大合唱爱拼才會赢中圓滿結束。商會精心策劃摸彩活動，共募得八十份超過萬元等值各式精美高級禮品，電器，二份4人組免費高爾夫球劵及機票等。包括由洛杉機經文處夏季昌處長所捐贈高級禮劵，洛杉磯文教中心主任翁桂堂偕同副主任傅以蒨及廖建勛所贈的高級禮品，洛杉磯經文處經濟組長王廷驊捐贈的台灣精品威剛科技LED檯燈等，讓大鳳凰城台商台僑感受到長官們满满的關懷和温暖。 在此也特別感謝金龍金鋪老板娘Tammy Wong所捐贈24K 金狗，欣欣超市Super L Market 賴甲乙老闆，聚點KTV 老闆Thomas Tam, 火爆鴨老闆David Chiang，Southeast Dentistry 譚威正牙醫師，Spirit Fitness, 大發地產，張晴玲，徐爱妮黄玉蓮，竇蕙芝，簡瑋𤧟所贊助各式禮卷禮品。 晚會高潮由ASU 台灣留學生謝孟璇幸運抽中由中華航空公司提供由洛杉磯往返台北的免費機票一張，及商會會員王麗詔抽中由中華航空公司提供洛杉磯往返台北的豪經艙升等券一張，在一片驚嘆連連下落幕，賓主盡歡。
f229c3ad3a6e8df1b8d2467b4927a343416d4f21.translatedText: Taiwan-American Chamber of Commerce in Greater Phoenix 2018 Spring Banquet to Celebrate the Lantern Festival with the Golden Dog. The Taiwan-American Chamber of Commerce in Greater Phoenix held its 2018 New Year Dinner at Fengcheng Seafood Restaurant at 6 pm on Saturday, March 3, to welcome the Year of the Golden Dog and celebrate the Lantern Festival with mainstream political and business celebrities in Greater Phoenix and Taiwanese overseas Chinese. The evening party started with a lively presentation of auspicious lions. Zhang Shengyi, President of the Taiwan-American Chamber of Commerce in Daluohuang City, took the lead in introducing the history and activities of the Chamber of Commerce to the guests on behalf of all the directors and supervisors of the Chamber of Commerce. He is committed to promoting national diplomacy, cultivating young businessmen and matching business opportunities. He also wishes everyone good luck in the Year of the Dog and good luck. U.S. Congressman Paul Gosar served as the keynote speaker at this spring banquet. He shared with the guests the impact of Trump’s tax reform on small and medium-sized enterprises and wished everyone a happy New Year. Arizona Governor Dough Doucey specially awarded the Proclamation to the Taiwan American Chamber of Commerce in Taipei City on behalf of Barry Wong, CEO of the Office of Diversity and Equality, which is designated as the Lunar New Year. The founding president Shi Ying, former president Zhang Qingling, Chen Mingjing and president Zhang Shengyi accepted the congratulatory certificate. In her speech, Chandler Deputy Mayor Nora Ellen particularly praised the Chamber of Commerce for its contribution in promoting ethnic exchanges and business opportunities and wished everyone a happy New Year. Mainstream dignitaries present this time include Lee Huff, representative of the office of U.S. Congressman Andy Biggs, Chandler mayoral candidate and former deputy mayor Kevin Hartke and his wife, e01c1996d55f8407f383c6ce5ab6f6ba85acf56d.sourceText: 美国人购物冲动 每年多花5400元
e01c1996d55f8407f383c6ce5ab6f6ba85acf56d.translatedText: Americans spend 5,400 yuan more on impulse shopping every year

46169f139d2e99e8824effa8584c809a9b3008c1.sourceText: 美国人购物冲动 每年多花5400元 消费者常因冲动而购物，平均每人每年达5400美元。 （综合报导）折价及…
46169f139d2e99e8824effa8584c809a9b3008c1.translatedText: Americans spend 5,400 yuan more on impulse shopping every year. Consumers often make purchases based on impulse, and the average person spends 5,400 U.S. dollars per year. (Comprehensive report) Discounts and...

dec79fb18ba58f044dca46d68c51a9fdf3f9dc49.sourceText: （综合报导）折价及促销讯息网站Slickdeals.net公布最新调查统计显示，美国消费者因为「冲动购物」而花费的金额，平均每人每年最高可达5400美元。
dec79fb18ba58f044dca46d68c51a9fdf3f9dc49.translatedText: (Comprehensive report) Discount and promotion information website Slickdeals.net released the latest survey statistics showing that the average amount of money spent by American consumers due to "impulse shopping" can reach up to US$5,400 per person per year.

b7023f280de2f922678ad34ca9d379ec8840747b.sourceText: 在这项调查当中，研究人员针对2000名抽样选出的消费者进行问卷调查，统计显示平均每名消费者每周会有三次不在规画之内的「临时起意」消费，一月下来开销约450美元，一年就花了5400美元。
b7023f280de2f922678ad34ca9d379ec8840747b.translatedText: In this survey, researchers conducted a questionnaire survey on 2,000 sampled consumers. Statistics show that on average, each consumer makes three unplanned "impulsive" purchases every week, spending about US$450 in a month and US$5,400 in a year.

e6a134930f47926dedcf945c51a4ca32f1bdb68f.sourceText: 若从消费项目区分，「食物」是最多美国消费者冲动之下买的商品，约有70.5%受访民众坦承，确实会忍不住随手购买吃的。
e6a134930f47926dedcf945c51a4ca32f1bdb68f.translatedText: If divided by consumption items, "food" is the most impulsively bought item among American consumers. About 70.5% of the people surveyed admitted that they can't help but buy food casually.

0f0aed0113679f6f28ca84097653cf951c63ab0b.sourceText: 另外，约有85%受访消费者则说，如果看到打折或有优惠促销推出，就会引发他们的冲动消费行为。
0f0aed0113679f6f28ca84097653cf951c63ab0b.translatedText: In addition, about 85% of consumers surveyed said that if they see discounts or promotions, it will trigger their impulse consumption behavior.

e735348e068552aeba79bde9fd57c1378f0aed0a.sourceText: Slickdeals.net执行长迈尔斯(Josh Meyers)分析，许多消费者会出现「机会出现临时起意的消费习惯」，趁着减价期间大肆购买便是这样的心态反映。
e735348e068552aeba79bde9fd57c1378f0aed0a.translatedText: Josh Meyers, CEO of Slickdeals.net, analyzed that many consumers will have "spurious consumption habits when the opportunity arises." Taking advantage of the sale period to buy aggressively is a reflection of this mentality.

528782d5e19cd74ecd02ee09a5e619fbf3480541.sourceText: 然而，逛街买东西虽然会让某些消费者感到快乐，但如果开销超支，后果可能是痛苦的。
528782d5e19cd74ecd02ee09a5e619fbf3480541.translatedText: However, although shopping for goods can make some consumers feel happy, if they overspend, the consequences can be painful.

5ebbde6a7c789f7a927b08e21db2a70b5fd618fa.sourceText: 美国联邦储备银行今年1月公布的报告指出，美国家庭所背负的信用卡卡债累积已达1兆美元，平均每名美国消费者持有三张信用卡，未缴清的卡帐余额则有6375美元，这个数字比一年之前增加了3%。
5ebbde6a7c789f7a927b08e21db2a70b5fd618fa.translatedText: A report released by the Federal Reserve Bank of the United States in January this year pointed out that the accumulated credit card debt of American households has reached US$1 trillion. The average American consumer holds three credit cards and has an unpaid card balance of US$6,375. This number has increased by 3% from a year ago.

d58cbb1793cf51301e62df1625794fd3b7b0ec60.sourceText: 如何改正随心所欲乱买东西的毛病？迈尔斯建议，消费者出手消费之前，不妨先认真想想，自己究竟是否真的需要这件商品，而且不要急着购买，等个一天让自己好好思考，看看花钱购买这样商品是不是真的合情合理。如果真的需要，可打听是否为最低价格。
d58cbb1793cf51301e62df1625794fd3b7b0ec60.translatedText: How to correct the problem of buying things at will? Myers suggested that before consumers make a purchase, they might as well think carefully about whether they really need the product, and don't rush to buy it. Wait a day to let yourself think carefully and see if it is really reasonable to spend money on such a product. If you really need it, ask if it's the lowest price.

654437af56ef63e86c212ba8f6531ad7c2752899.translatedText: Brief introduction of the 28th "China Week" event held by the Alberta Modern Chinese School

77a53db271387fef2688d7e7760d5c42fa8a55cf.sourceText: 亚省现代中文学校参加第28届””中国周””活动简讯 (亚省现代…
77a53db271387fef2688d7e7760d5c42fa8a55cf.translatedText: Brief briefing of the 28th "China Week" held by the Alberta Modern Chinese School (Alberta Modern...

c76f6ea864c07107303877c203340b13ed36a45a.sourceText: (亚省现代中文学校供稿) 为期三天的第28届”中国周”活动于2018年2月18日在凤凰城圆 满落幕。亚省现代中文学校参与其中, 并于周日下午负责组织”儿童乐园”和”中文学校 园地”的活动。当天，游人络绎不绝，他们一方面学习手工制作灯笼，剪纸，起中国名字 ；另一方面，询问亚省现代中文学校的中国文化课程的设置情况。在此，感谢所有义工的 奉献。他们是：王玉兰，田韶微，Allan Yang/高京京全家，赵敏，陶世诚，纳思佳，徐 强，Wendy Xu，Janice Light，Aiai Price，艺柳白，方方，段晓彬，Kathy Price，等 。还有前来助阵的亚省现代中文学校的老义工：Bernard Ho/Diana Ho夫妇，何梦涛/杨洁 夫妇。 多年来，亚省现代中文学校始终将学生和家长的需求放在首位。老师们在教授中文 课的同时，把中国文化传授其中，讲述凤凰城中国文化中心的历史和她在我们这些海外华 人、华裔心目中的定位。当天活动结束后，亚省现代中文学校将当日下午一元一元收集到 的捐款$97全部捐献给了文化中心，以表对保护凤凰城中国文化中心的关切和支持！ 亚省现代中文学校除开设中文、数学、文化课外，还为学生和家长朋友们增设合唱 、舞蹈、太极、Yoga、绘画、乐队，等。亚省现代中文学校也是亚省唯一一所同时拥有乐 队、合唱队、和舞蹈队的中文学校。亚省现代中文学校热诚欢迎您的加盟！更多详情请浏 览亚省现代中文学校网站：www.ccsarizona.org. (摄影：艺柳白、方方)
c76f6ea864c07107303877c203340b13ed36a45a.translatedText: (Contributed by the Alberta Modern Chinese School)) The three-day 28th "China Week" event was held in Phoenix on February 18, 2018. It ended with a happy ending. The Alberta Modern Chinese School participated and was responsible for organizing the "Children's Paradise" and "Chinese School Garden" activities on Sunday afternoon. On the one hand, there was an endless stream of visitors. On the one hand, they learned about hand-making lanterns, paper-cutting, and making Chinese names; on the other hand, they asked about the Chinese culture courses of the Alberta Modern Chinese School. Here, I would like to thank all the volunteers for their dedication. They are: Wang Yulan, Tian Shaowei, and Allan Yang/Gao Jingjing’s family, Zhao Min, Tao Shicheng, Na Sijia, Xu Qiang, Wendy Xu, Janice Light, Aiai Price, Yi Liubai, Fang Fang, Duan Xiaobin, Kathy Price, etc. There are also old volunteers from the Alberta Modern Chinese School: Bernard Ho/Diana Ho, He Mengtao/Yang Jie. For many years, the teachers at the Alberta Modern Chinese School have always put the needs of students and parents first. At the same time, he taught Chinese culture and told the history of the Phoenix Chinese Cultural Center and its position in the minds of overseas Chinese and Chinese. After the event, the Alberta Modern Chinese School donated all the donations of $1 per dollar that day to the cultural center to show its concern and support for the protection of the Phoenix Chinese Cultural Center! In addition to offering Chinese, mathematics, and cultural classes, the Alberta Modern Chinese School also added a chorus for students and parents. , dance, Tai Chi, Yoga, painting, band, etc. The Alberta Modern Chinese School is also the only Chinese school in the province that also has a band, chorus, and dance team. For more details, please visit the Alberta Modern Chinese School website: www.ccsarizona.org. (Photography: Yi Liubai, Fang Fang)

f2956b77ec60368c95d709c7a6cd39407e68451e.translatedText: Who makes the most money in 2017? The per capita disposable income in Beijing and Shanghai is approaching 60,000 yuan. Original title: Who made the most money in 2017? The per capita disposable income in Beijing and Shanghai is close to 6...

286e106bb8ed7464624f98ad5ecc0ac29f208430.sourceText: 原标题：2017年谁挣钱最多？京沪人均可支配收入逼近6万元
286e106bb8ed7464624f98ad5ecc0ac29f208430.translatedText: Original title: Who made the most money in 2017? The per capita disposable income in Beijing and Shanghai is approaching 60,000 yuan

6baa3953ccf7be7b8820d4958c8157b172d66e11.sourceText: 中新网客户端北京2月24日电(记者李金磊)国家统计局近日公布了31个省份2017年居民人均可支配收入。数据显示，10省份人均可支配收入超过全国水平。上海、北京2017年居民人均可支配收入逼近6万元大关，上海以58987.96元位居全国首位。
6baa3953ccf7be7b8820d4958c8157b172d66e11.translatedText: > China News Service Client, Beijing, February 24 (Reporter Li Jinlei) The National Bureau of Statistics recently announced the per capita disposable income of residents in 31 provinces in 2017. Data show that per capita disposable income in 10 provinces exceeds the national level. The per capita disposable income of residents in Shanghai and Beijing in 2017 was close to the 60,000 yuan mark, with Shanghai ranking first in the country with 58,987.96 yuan.

190ef7ef4175315fbc6fbf3a7c80c2bb62bc8444.sourceText: 人民币。 中新网记者李金磊摄
190ef7ef4175315fbc6fbf3a7c80c2bb62bc8444.translatedText: >RMB. Photo by China News Service reporter Li Jinlei

242daa44682270bf9d73ea404ecccbafd71366da.sourceText: 10省份人均可支配收入超全国水平
242daa44682270bf9d73ea404ecccbafd71366da.translatedText: The per capita disposable income of 10 provinces exceeds the national level

6e4dfec2a720bfacdfca218e2cbb95ea81ed09a3.sourceText: 国家统计局的数据显示，2017年居民人均可支配收入25974元，比上年名义增长9.0%；扣除价格因素实际增长7.3%。
6e4dfec2a720bfacdfca218e2cbb95ea81ed09a3.translatedText: Data from the National Bureau of Statistics show that in 2017, the per capita disposable income of residents was 25,974 yuan, a nominal increase of 9.0% over the previous year; after deducting price factors, the real increase was 7.3%.

20623e8d6305684c63be6e21b4431738843ed35d.sourceText: 居民可支配收入，指居民可用于最终消费支出和储蓄的总和，即居民可用于自由支配的收入，既包括现金收入，也包括实物收入。按照收入的来源，可支配收入包括工资性收入、经营净收入、财产净收入和转移净收入。
20623e8d6305684c63be6e21b4431738843ed35d.translatedText: Residents' disposable income refers to the sum of residents' final consumption expenditures and savings, that is, the income that residents can use for discretionary disposal, including both cash income and in-kind income. According to the source of income, disposable income includes salary income, net operating income, net property income and net transfer income.

fcc20c7ea04f6beb77f808aff0f69b7942bc21e2.sourceText: 中新网记者梳理发现，上海、北京、浙江、天津、江苏、广东、福建、辽宁、山东、内蒙古2017年居民人均可支配收入超过了全国平均水平。
fcc20c7ea04f6beb77f808aff0f69b7942bc21e2.translatedText: > China News Network reporters found that the per capita disposable income of residents in Shanghai, Beijing, Zhejiang, Tianjin, Jiangsu, Guangdong, Fujian, Liaoning, Shandong, and Inner Mongolia in 2017 exceeded the national average.

fe52f7666d4f9566f0c6b43d36ff002c4adf1595.sourceText: 2017年各地居民人均可支配收入。来源：国家统计局网站
fe52f7666d4f9566f0c6b43d36ff002c4adf1595.translatedText: >Per capita disposable income of residents in various regions in 2017. Source: National Bureau of Statistics website

f9827f28f4c82e461306d2a77c66f8cefed94e72.sourceText: 京沪人均可支配收入逼近6万元大关
f9827f28f4c82e461306d2a77c66f8cefed94e72.translatedText: The per capita disposable income of Beijing and Shanghai is approaching the 60,000 yuan mark

078a9123919291ba19adbdcd70add5d09a00b3d7.sourceText: 在31个省区市中，上海、北京、浙江2017年居民人均可支配收入位居前三名。其中，上海、北京居民人均可支配收入分别达到58987.96元、57229.83元，逼近6万元大关。
078a9123919291ba19adbdcd70add5d09a00b3d7.translatedText: Among the 31 provinces, autonomous regions and municipalities, Shanghai, Beijing, and Zhejiang ranked among the top three in terms of per capita disposable income of residents in 2017. Among them, the per capita disposable income of Shanghai and Beijing residents reached 58,987.96 yuan and 57,229.83 yuan respectively, approaching the 60,000 yuan mark.

adc56ed658f7048d4de32d92c575d12d68f6ff06.sourceText: 上海、北京是2017年全国仅有的居民人均可支配收入在”5万元俱乐部”的地区；浙江居民人均可支配收入达到42045.69元，属于”4万元俱乐部”的唯一成员。
adc56ed658f7048d4de32d92c575d12d68f6ff06.translatedText: Shanghai and Beijing are the only regions in the country where the per capita disposable income of residents is in the "50,000 yuan club" in 2017; the per capita disposable income of Zhejiang residents reached 42,045.69 yuan, making it the only member of the "40,000 yuan club".

c323dc9e7d7c72a9cb6fb21a46f4239dbdbed139.sourceText: 收入水平高，消费水平也高。国家统计局数据显示，上海2017年居民人均消费支出为39791.85元，北京为37425.34元，位居全国前两位。
c323dc9e7d7c72a9cb6fb21a46f4239dbdbed139.translatedText: The income level is high and the consumption level is also high. According to data from the National Bureau of Statistics, Shanghai's per capita consumption expenditure in 2017 was 39,791.85 yuan, and Beijing's was 37,425.34 yuan, ranking the top two in the country.

eabfc82cd8397f72de383bb6dfba41046d0e1335.sourceText: 居民在超市里购物。 中新网记者李金磊摄
eabfc82cd8397f72de383bb6dfba41046d0e1335.translatedText: Residents shop in supermarkets. Photo by China News Service reporter Li Jinlei

d67a126fbbd7708856f966c23862f19eb95e2bd8.sourceText: 多地居民收入增速跑赢GDP增速
d67a126fbbd7708856f966c23862f19eb95e2bd8.translatedText: Resident income growth in many places outpaced GDP growth

fc62e06ceadf94ad8b225aa8f400b40b5d8cef2a.sourceText: 从全国来看，2017年居民收入增长快于经济增长。数据显示，2017年全国居民人均可支配收入比上年实际增长7.3%，实际增速比GDP和人均GDP增长分别快0.4和1.0个百分点。
fc62e06ceadf94ad8b225aa8f400b40b5d8cef2a.translatedText: Nationally, in 2017, residents' income growth was faster than economic growth. Data show that in 2017, the per capita disposable income of national residents actually increased by 7.3% compared with the previous year, and the actual growth rate was 0.4 and 1.0 percentage points faster than the growth of GDP and per capita GDP respectively.

702fb233716e7441060ec8ef3a16c6fc3cf31746.sourceText: 在地方层面，多地2017年居民收入增速跑赢了当地的GDP增速。如，北京2017年居民人均可支配收入实际增长6.9%，高于同期GDP增速0.2个百分点。江苏2017年居民人均可支配收入实际增长7.4%，高出GDP增速0.2个百分点。
702fb233716e7441060ec8ef3a16c6fc3cf31746.translatedText: At the local level, the growth rate of residents’ income in many places outperformed the local GDP growth rate in 2017. For example, the per capita disposable income of Beijing residents in 2017 actually increased by 6.9%, which was 0.2 percentage points higher than the GDP growth rate in the same period. Jiangsu's per capita disposable income actually increased by 7.4% in 2017, 0.2 percentage points higher than the GDP growth rate.

e3b06e62b71577783ba097ea55478d4ae6d3fac9.sourceText: 中国劳动学会副会长苏海南对中新网记者表示，居民收入增速跑赢GDP增速，首先是因为经济稳定增长，企业效益好转，居民收入有了增长的基础。同时，努力让居民收入增长跟经济增长保持同步，一系列居民增收、深化收入分配制度改革政策也起到了积极的推动作用。(完)
e3b06e62b71577783ba097ea55478d4ae6d3fac9.translatedText: Su Hainan, vice president of the China Labor Society, told a reporter from China News Service that the growth rate of residents' income outpaced the growth rate of GDP, first of all, because the economy has grown steadily, business performance has improved, and residents' income has a basis for growth. At the same time, efforts have been made to keep the growth of residents' income in line with economic growth, and a series of policies to increase residents' income and deepen the reform of the income distribution system have also played a positive role in promoting. (over)

be154ad70ec84adca60668a21275c1e214226b47.sourceText: 不再欢迎移民？ USCIS官网拿掉「美国是移民国家」
be154ad70ec84adca60668a21275c1e214226b47.translatedText: Immigrants no longer welcome? The USCIS official website has removed "The United States is a country of immigrants"

777f6686560fd50ebf762c0d69fba59ed46b9ada.sourceText: 不再欢迎移民？ USCIS官网拿掉「美国是移民国家」 提供外国人申请移民和移民申请入籍服务的美国公民及移民…
777f6686560fd50ebf762c0d69fba59ed46b9ada.translatedText: and no longer welcomes immigrants? The USCIS official website has removed the phrase "The United States is a country of immigrants." U.S. citizens and immigrants, who provide services for foreigners to apply for immigration and immigrants to apply for naturalization...

e3eb72a75f55f656099c761b62b727653064b2d6.sourceText: 提供外国人申请移民和移民申请入籍服务的美国公民及移民服务局(USCIS)，如今的宗旨出现重大变化；USCIS在最近更新的网页”关于我们”一栏中，拿掉了”美国是移民国家”的表述，USCIS局长契斯纳(Lee Cissna)回覆媒体电邮质询时表示，修改宗旨代表USCIS要履行新使命。
e3eb72a75f55f656099c761b62b727653064b2d6.translatedText: The United States Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS), which provides services for foreigners to apply for immigration and immigrants to apply for naturalization, has undergone major changes in its mission. USCIS has removed the statement "The United States is a country of immigrants" from the "About Us" column of its recently updated webpage. USCIS Director Lee Chesner (Lee) Cissna responded to the media’s email inquiry and stated that the revised purpose represents USCIS’s new mission.

f4265365e82941107add6b5f83c3afdeb47522c3.sourceText: 新宗旨不再提”美国是移民国家”(nation of immigrants)，而是强调在保护美国人和国家的安全，以及尊重美国价值观的同时，USCIS要管理美国的合法移民体系、捍卫国家的完整，以及确保在处理移民和公民申请上的高效与公正。
f4265365e82941107add6b5f83c3afdeb47522c3.translatedText: The new purpose no longer mentions that "the United States is a nation of immigrants", but emphasizes that while protecting the security of Americans and the country, and respecting American values, USCIS must manage the legal immigration system of the United States, defend the integrity of the country, and ensure efficiency and fairness in processing immigration and citizenship applications.

e6a04bdc5f7db9a7f9ea0df6bab3203637f5f07e.sourceText: USCIS是国土安全部的所属部门，以前的宗旨是：”USCIS保证美国是移民国家的一贯承诺、为各类申请人提供準确有效的讯息、批准移民和公民申请、增进移民对入籍归化的了解，以及保证美国移民体系的完整。”
e6a04bdc5f7db9a7f9ea0df6bab3203637f5f07e.translatedText: USCIS is a department of the Department of Homeland Security. Its previous mission was: "USCIS ensures the United States' continued commitment as a nation of immigrants, provides accurate and effective information to all types of applicants, approves immigration and citizenship applications, enhances immigrants' understanding of naturalization, and ensures the integrity of the U.S. immigration system." "

08c86208ac2af94643dbfbb698afd32962e52442.sourceText: 一名USCIS官员表示，新宗旨反映出USCIS指导原则的改变，重点为公正、合法、高效、保护美国人的安全和捍卫国家安全，明确界定了USCIS在国家移民体系中的作用，和USCIS员工对美国民众的承诺。
08c86208ac2af94643dbfbb698afd32962e52442.translatedText: A USCIS official said that the new purpose reflects changes in USCIS's guiding principles, which focus on fairness, legality, efficiency, protecting the safety of Americans and defending national security. It clearly defines the role of USCIS in the national immigration system and the commitment of USCIS employees to the American people.

77b86c24d81af06590074e7db5b3ba443f77fbc3.sourceText: 契斯纳说，新宗旨去掉了”客户”(customers)一词，是避免产生误解。他说，USCIS对美国和申请人都很重要，但工作复杂，不能让外界认为USCIS的工作属于商业行为，而使用”客户”一词会导致人们误解，认为申请人是服务对象，而不是美国人。
77b86c24d81af06590074e7db5b3ba443f77fbc3.translatedText: Chessner said the new purpose removed the word "customers" to avoid misunderstandings. He said that USCIS is important to both the United States and applicants, but the work is complex and the outside world cannot think that USCIS's work is a commercial practice. Using the word "client" will lead to misunderstandings that applicants are the service recipients, not Americans.

aac02d35e2814d0ec3c460df0814ae260326f5b2.sourceText: 契斯纳说，所有申请人都应得到尊重和礼遇，不再使用”客户”提法，意味著申请人不是客户，而是外国人。
aac02d35e2814d0ec3c460df0814ae260326f5b2.translatedText: Chesner said that all applicants should be treated with respect and courtesy and no longer use the term "customer", which means that the applicant is not a customer, but a foreigner.
