54559211a5afd78ddde363e9023b09f6887a6250.sourceText: 僵持不下，美国移民改革难推进
54559211a5afd78ddde363e9023b09f6887a6250.translatedText: Deadlock makes it difficult to advance U.S. immigration reform

296941165c9a2e9b3968cd678cf5d498e25ff8f0.sourceText: 日前，美国国会参议院接连否决了4项移民改革议案，参议院移民改革的公开辩论再次无果而终。随着完全实施”童年抵美者暂缓遣返”计划的日期临近，该项目下的年轻人(”追梦人”)去留再次引发舆论关注。参议院在此问题上的争斗表明，要顺利完成移民改革并不容易。
296941165c9a2e9b3968cd678cf5d498e25ff8f0.translatedText: A few days ago, the U.S. Senate rejected four immigration reform bills in succession, and the public debate on immigration reform in the Senate once again ended without any results. As the date for the full implementation of the Deferred Action for Childhood Arrivals program approaches, the fate of young people ("Dreamers") under the program has once again attracted public attention. The Senate battle on the issue shows that successfully completing immigration reform will not be easy.

645d4cc3c125b90850f9095510745fbe79738fd2.sourceText: 此次移民改革有两项主要内容。一是”追梦人”的去留。美国媒体估计，在”童年抵美者暂缓遣返”项目下，有约70万年轻人可免于遣返，另有约110万人符合免于遣返的资格，但没有申请该项目。去年9月，美国总统特朗普废除该项目，暂缓半年执行，并要求国会在此期间达成替代协议，今年3月5日将是最后期限。如果届时国会仍不能达成解决方案，”追梦人”有可能被遣返。
645d4cc3c125b90850f9095510745fbe79738fd2.translatedText: This immigration reform has two main contents. The first is the fate of "Dream Chasers". U.S. media estimate that under the Deferred Action for Childhood Arrivals program, about 700,000 young people are exempt from deportation, and about 1.1 million people are eligible for exemption from deportation but have not applied for the program. In September last year, US President Trump abolished the project, suspended its implementation for half a year, and asked Congress to reach a replacement agreement during this period. March 5 this year will be the deadline. If Congress still cannot reach a solution by then, the "Dreamers" may be deported.

6de99240a6eec91b42df9433d5a94709ab480e50.sourceText: 二是修建美墨边境墙。特朗普已经多次表示，如果移民改革方案不包括修建边境墙的部分，就拒绝签署。特朗普凭借”反移民”的强硬形象当选，并不断在该问题上发声，却使问题更加棘手。
6de99240a6eec91b42df9433d5a94709ab480e50.translatedText: The second is to build the US-Mexico border wall. Trump has repeatedly stated that he will refuse to sign the immigration reform package if it does not include building a border wall. Trump was elected with a tough "anti-immigration" image and has continued to speak out on this issue, which has made the problem even more difficult.

f4673d1469b80cda4e9666d29ca7240208670b0a.sourceText: 白宫此前曾同参议院民主党领袖查克默商定，以支持”童年抵美者暂缓遣返”替代方案换取民主党支持修建边境墙，但舒默之后发表声明，撤回对修建边境墙的支持。移民改革议案被否决后，舒默指责白宫参与两党议员的移民改革谈判。参议院共和党领袖麦康奈尔说，参议院制定的法案必须是”可行的”，即众议院能够通过，特朗普也能签署。
f4673d1469b80cda4e9666d29ca7240208670b0a.translatedText: The White House had previously agreed with Senate Democratic leader Chuck Schumer to support the Deferred Action for Childhood Arrivals alternative in exchange for Democratic support for the construction of the border wall. However, Schumer later issued a statement withdrawing his support for the construction of the border wall. After the immigration reform bill was defeated, Schumer accused the White House of participating in the immigration reform negotiations between lawmakers from both parties. Senate Republican leader McConnell said that the bill enacted by the Senate must be "feasible", that is, the House of Representatives can pass it and Trump can sign it.

d7ade8bc00b98347819c6ab4dea52aa16de7f015.sourceText: 1月20日，美国联邦政府因移民改革未果关门。一个多月来，国会在此问题上没有取得有意义的进展。由于时间紧迫，再加上联邦政府两次关门的”教训”，不少参议员对移民改革议案表达了积极态度，但仍未达成妥协。当地媒体指出，这反映出美国国会极度分裂。
d7ade8bc00b98347819c6ab4dea52aa16de7f015.translatedText: On January 20, the U.S. federal government shut down due to failed immigration reform. Congress has made no meaningful progress on the issue in more than a month. Due to time constraints and the "lessons" from the two federal government shutdowns, many senators have expressed positive attitudes towards the immigration reform bill, but no compromise has yet been reached. Local media pointed out that this reflects the extreme divisions in the U.S. Congress.

dd3d3ab44b4eece2c2bec208cbdb05d239dc1ecb.sourceText: 美国自由派和保守派在移民改革问题上分歧严重，自由派认为应该回应大多数民众的呼声，允许”追梦人”继续留在美国。而保守派则认为，”童年抵美者暂缓遣返”计划仅是前任总统奥巴马向非法移民作出的承诺。
dd3d3ab44b4eece2c2bec208cbdb05d239dc1ecb.translatedText: American liberals and conservatives have serious differences on the issue of immigration reform. Liberals believe that we should respond to the voice of the majority of the people and allow "Dreamers" to continue to stay in the United States. Conservatives believe that the Deferred Action for Childhood Arrivals program is just a promise made by former President Obama to illegal immigrants.

cb7d65ebff857f64d2bbf1dd36dadb645430917e.sourceText: 移民问题在美国是一个敏感话题，更是一个关乎选票的政治问题。近年来，两党政府一直都试图推动综合性的移民改革，但是成效有限。2013年，奥巴马政府力推综合移民改革，为约1100万非法移民提供归化途径，但没能赢得国会众议院支持。
cb7d65ebff857f64d2bbf1dd36dadb645430917e.translatedText: Immigration is a sensitive topic in the United States, and it is also a political issue related to votes. In recent years, governments of both parties have been trying to promote comprehensive immigration reform, but with limited success. In 2013, the Obama administration pushed for comprehensive immigration reform to provide a path to naturalization for about 11 million illegal immigrants, but it failed to win support from the House of Representatives.

7c2e2a0e1f8a164afdabcafb19abbc97afecf033.sourceText: 在国会就移民问题进行激烈争斗的同时，美国联邦政府的移民政策变得更加强硬。去年初，特朗普签署行政命令，要求加强执法，并将执法重点从有犯罪记录者扩大至所有非法移民。美国入境和海关执法局2017年共逮捕14.3万人次非法移民，成为近3年来的新高。
7c2e2a0e1f8a164afdabcafb19abbc97afecf033.translatedText: While Congress is engaged in fierce battles over immigration, the U.S. federal government’s immigration policies have become tougher. Early last year, Trump signed an executive order requiring stronger law enforcement and expanding the focus of law enforcement from those with criminal records to all illegal immigrants. U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement arrested a total of 143,000 illegal immigrants in 2017, a new high in the past three years.

537d391feb90a3d1508a4a82621feb9cac1f1d50.sourceText: 在近日的一次闭门会议中，最高法院讨论了司法部有关”童年抵美者暂缓遣返”上诉的可能。此前，有联邦法官判决应该暂缓执行废除该项目的决定，司法部跨过联邦巡回上诉法院等程序，直接向最高法院申诉。美国媒体分析称，符合条件的移民申请”童年抵美者暂缓遣返”项目通常需要两个月时间，即使最高法院判决该项目继续实施，也会带来难题。(记者 张朋辉)
537d391feb90a3d1508a4a82621feb9cac1f1d50.translatedText: In a recent closed-door meeting, the Supreme Court discussed the possibility of the Department of Justice’s appeal of the Deferred Action for Childhood Arrivals. Previously, a federal judge ruled that the decision to abolish the project should be suspended. The Department of Justice bypassed the Federal Circuit Court of Appeals and other procedures and appealed directly to the Supreme Court. U.S. media analysis said that it usually takes two months for eligible immigrants to apply for the Deferred Action for Childhood Arrivals program, and even if the Supreme Court rules that the program continues to be implemented, it will cause problems. (Reporter Zhang Penghui)

db892cd05d9ba643ec32cc7802378dea7cf6e4d4.translatedText: Activities | Promote Chinese culture and welcome the New Year in Alberta – Report on the 2018 New Year Gala (News from the Alberta Modern Chinese School) Say goodbye to the old days with laughter...

09a88b365ff4cfdb674f83c5b87b6653150400e4.sourceText: (亚省现代中文学校讯) 欢声笑语辞旧岁，喜聚一堂贺新春。农历新年伊始，我校应凤凰城中华乐团的邀请，参加了当地华人一年一度的春节晚会的演出。
09a88b365ff4cfdb674f83c5b87b6653150400e4.translatedText: (News from the Modern Chinese School in Alberta) Say goodbye to the old year with joy and laughter, and happily gather together to celebrate the new year. At the beginning of the Lunar New Year, our school was invited by the Phoenix Chinese Orchestra to perform at the local Chinese annual Spring Festival Gala.

dfbaf97563666f2f33f47d529694dd6e61d1be65.sourceText: 作为亚省华人社区活动的中坚力量，现代中文学校和华人社区主流团体，特别是中华乐团等艺术团体组织长期保持共建互助的友好关系。此次参演不仅向整个社区展示了我们中文教学的成果，也帮助学生深入体会中国的” 年” 文化，同时也和本地其它华人团体一起积极推广亚裔传统文化！
dfbaf97563666f2f33f47d529694dd6e61d1be65.translatedText: As the backbone of Chinese community activities in Alberta, Modern Chinese Schools and mainstream groups in the Chinese community, especially art groups such as the Chinese Orchestra, have long maintained a friendly relationship of co-construction and mutual assistance. Participating in this performance not only showcases the results of our Chinese teaching to the entire community, but also helps students deeply understand China's "Nian" culture. At the same time, it also actively promotes traditional Asian culture with other local Chinese groups!

203190d571de432fac5e3641684824230f2cb216.sourceText: 美政府推短期廉价医保计划 保费仅奥巴马医保1/3
203190d571de432fac5e3641684824230f2cb216.translatedText: The U.S. government launches a short-term low-cost medical insurance plan with a premium that is only 1/3 of Obamacare

1ace30591d73fdd942bc604dbff814aab65d1b2d.sourceText: 美政府推短期廉价医保计划 保费仅奥巴马医保1/3 资料视频：特朗普新税法实施 必将终结奥巴马医保法 来源：…
1ace30591d73fdd942bc604dbff814aab65d1b2d.translatedText: The U.S. government launches a short-term low-cost health insurance plan with a premium that is only 1/3 of Obamacare. Information video: The implementation of Trump’s new tax law will definitely end Obamacare. Source:…

e92c767a7a2f1ab3b0b394902ab108237131b4cf.sourceText: 资料视频：特朗普新税法实施 必将终结奥巴马医保法 来源：上海东方高清
e92c767a7a2f1ab3b0b394902ab108237131b4cf.translatedText: Information video: The implementation of Trump’s new tax law will definitely end Obamacare. Source: Shanghai Oriental HD

9727b10c38aa2348070abf3afcab8215bd7ecbaf.sourceText: 中新网2月22日电 据美国《世界日报》报道，日前，美国卫生与福利部推出一项新的短期保险计划，准备在消费者中推广，以作为奥巴马医保全面保险计划之外的一种廉价选择，每月的保费约是全面保险计划的三分之一。
9727b10c38aa2348070abf3afcab8215bd7ecbaf.translatedText: China News Service, February 22. According to the US "World Journal" report, the US Department of Health and Welfare has recently launched a new short-term insurance plan and is preparing to promote it among consumers as a cheap alternative to the Obamacare comprehensive insurance plan. The monthly premium is about one-third of the comprehensive insurance plan.

260094a2c89761dcff204e92c4448cb8e1081bbe.sourceText: 新计划允许消费者购买最多12个月的短期保险，但保险福利较少，不涵盖部分主要保险，因此保费相应降低。
260094a2c89761dcff204e92c4448cb8e1081bbe.translatedText: The new plan allows consumers to purchase short-term insurance for up to 12 months, but the insurance benefits are fewer and some major insurances are not covered, so the premiums are reduced accordingly.

600b323e30ea4ffd246106f11408d4809a53d938.sourceText: 政府表示，短期保险计划将开放60天征求公众意见，以便尽早完善，争取在年底前上市。
600b323e30ea4ffd246106f11408d4809a53d938.translatedText: The government stated that the short-term insurance plan will be open for public comment for 60 days in order to improve it as soon as possible and strive to launch it before the end of the year.

d5b08ed3103ea3745143f60aa115ea4e2d21926b.sourceText: 不过，根据奥巴马医保规定，短期保险计划在2018年仍不算正式保险，意味着参加者在法律上仍被视为没有保险，报税时可能面临罚款。但到了2019年，奥巴马医保的强制纳保规定被废除就将生效。
d5b08ed3103ea3745143f60aa115ea4e2d21926b.translatedText: However, according to Obamacare regulations, short-term insurance plans are still not considered formal insurance in 2018, which means that participants are still legally considered to be uninsured and may face penalties when filing taxes. But in 2019, the repeal of Obamacare’s mandatory coverage will take effect.

826cc4a8b695b6168880d8374fb517d6d5315034.sourceText: 报道称，该计划还有免责声明，即预先说明达不到奥巴马医保的保险条件、没有十大类福利和保险范围有限，如果被保险公司发现是带病投保，将对参加者收取更高费用。
826cc4a8b695b6168880d8374fb517d6d5315034.translatedText: reported that the plan also has a disclaimer, which states in advance that it does not meet the insurance conditions of Obamacare, does not have the ten major categories of benefits, and has limited insurance coverage. If the insurance company finds that the plan is insured while sick, participants will be charged higher fees.

473cc9ffdcfcfed92b0d43ee1651aa6587b66dbe.sourceText: 但卫生部表示，短期保险计划作为一种选择，在需要个人健保计划但又不符合奥巴马医保补贴政策的中产阶级会有市场，部分中产阶级的保费每月1000多美元，还要付数千美元的自付额，他们当中没有保险的比率在升高。
473cc9ffdcfcfed92b0d43ee1651aa6587b66dbe.translatedText: However, the Ministry of Health stated that short-term insurance plans, as an option, will have a market among the middle class who need individual health insurance plans but do not meet the Obamacare subsidy policy. For some middle class, the monthly premium is more than 1,000 US dollars, and they have to pay thousands of dollars in deductibles. The rate of uninsured among them is increasing.

efaa5a50a76ffb2e74dabc3684a4d1dcd2e6addd.sourceText: 美国卫生部长指出，消费者如果得不到健保补贴，在健保市场买保险确实难以承受。卫生部估计，短期保险计划的每月保费，约是全面保险计划的三分之一。
efaa5a50a76ffb2e74dabc3684a4d1dcd2e6addd.translatedText: The U.S. Secretary of Health pointed out that if consumers do not receive health insurance subsidies, it is indeed unaffordable to buy insurance in the health insurance market. The Ministry of Health estimates that the monthly premium for a short-term insurance plan is about one-third that of a comprehensive insurance plan.

af6e97669740ea006a47e83e390fdb9d89c0cbbf.sourceText: 民主党人批评短期保险计划是”垃圾保险”，主流保险游说集团担忧，该计划是在健康群体和病患群体中制造分裂，使带病投保者的费用更高。
af6e97669740ea006a47e83e390fdb9d89c0cbbf.translatedText: Democrats criticized short-term insurance plans as "junk insurance," and mainstream insurance lobbying groups worried that the plans would create divisions between healthy and sick groups, making it more expensive for sick policyholders.

5c9713b15ee15a6d4bb41039383f7e63221d253d.sourceText: 特朗普政府表示，短期保险计划不是要伤害奥巴马医保，而是有助于领不到医保补贴的人，预计新计划实施后，退出奥巴马医保计划的人只有10万到20万，而且对许多没有保险的人会有吸引力，全美约2800万人没有保险。
5c9713b15ee15a6d4bb41039383f7e63221d253d.translatedText: The Trump administration stated that the short-term insurance plan is not to harm Obamacare, but to help people who cannot receive health insurance subsidies. It is expected that after the implementation of the new plan, only 100,000 to 200,000 people will withdraw from the Obamacare plan, and it will be attractive to many people without insurance. About 28 million people in the United States are without insurance.

a88a1f617a8514f58bc5c2f94e60bc7def46cff6.sourceText: 美国联邦医疗计划(Medicare)和医疗补助计划(Medicaid)服务中心主任表示，许多健康的人没有参加健保计划，现在他们有了参加健保的机会。
a88a1f617a8514f58bc5c2f94e60bc7def46cff6.translatedText: The director of the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services said that many healthy people who do not participate in health insurance plans now have the opportunity to participate in health insurance.

d14ab4847e52a6e625a78a8b646a957a1f26e153.sourceText: 主要保险公司”联合健保”(United Healthcare)已推出短期保险计划，但其他保险公司认为，短期保险计划只是一种补充，主要供消费者在换工作、搬到其他州或尚未领取Medicare的退休者考虑。
d14ab4847e52a6e625a78a8b646a957a1f26e153.translatedText: Major insurance company "United Healthcare" has launched short-term insurance plans, but other insurance companies believe that short-term insurance plans are just a supplement, mainly for consumers to consider when changing jobs, moving to other states or retirees who have not yet received Medicare.

ee079a00b4f2bcea3649ca7afae12ca4afb58367.sourceText: 维权组织认为，消费者如果选择短期保险计划，为了保证能获支付，一定要仔细阅读计划的说明。
ee079a00b4f2bcea3649ca7afae12ca4afb58367.translatedText: Rights protection organizations believe that if consumers choose a short-term insurance plan, they must read the plan instructions carefully in order to ensure that they will be paid.

fe51e7a155f8bc126419b9973bb4189c0fdeeb3e.sourceText: 感恩节后，美国进入假日购物旺季，其中以”黑色星期五”（24日）和”网络星期一”（27日）两天的折扣优惠最大。”网络星期一”（Cyber​​ Monday）往往被视为”黑色星期五”的小兄弟，但事实上，自前年年底开始，网络星期一就比黑色星期五有着更好的销售表现。
fe51e7a155f8bc126419b9973bb4189c0fdeeb3e.translatedText: After Thanksgiving, the United States enters the peak holiday shopping season, with the biggest discounts on "Black Friday" (24th) and "Cyber ​​Monday" (27th). "Cyber ​​Monday" is often regarded as the little brother of "Black Friday", but in fact, since the end of the previous year, Cyber ​​Monday has had better sales performance than Black Friday.

8a45543ba9ec8d120ecef91dfb4b930d237462ad.sourceText: 那么，是什么使得网络星期一如此特别呢？以下是美国CBS新闻列出的有关网络星期一与黑色星期五的七个不同之处。
8a45543ba9ec8d120ecef91dfb4b930d237462ad.translatedText: So, what makes Cyber ​​Monday so special? Here are seven differences between Cyber ​​Monday and Black Friday, listed by CBS News.

2d408464e72a915e3b294e6081b316d6a9e712bc.sourceText: 网络星期一有着更愉快的起源
2d408464e72a915e3b294e6081b316d6a9e712bc.translatedText: Cyber ​​Monday has a more cheerful origin

5d4e04896830c88a90a97bbab64c365128588ed6.sourceText: 有关”黑色星期五”这个词的起源，目前仍没有一个确切的说法。流传说法是费城警方在二十世纪五十年代创造了这么一个带有否定涵义的词。周四感恩节之后，由于周六费城举行年度陆军/海军美式足球比赛，成群结队的人在星期五那天向市区聚集，各商店就利用这各机会提供商品大优惠，吸引人们登门购物，而警察们所面对的，则是长时间的、繁忙的值勤工作。直到20世纪八十年代，黑色星期五才开始赢得更广泛的、更好的声誉。
5d4e04896830c88a90a97bbab64c365128588ed6.translatedText: There is still no definite statement about the origin of the term "Black Friday". Legend has it that the Philadelphia police coined the word with negative connotations in the 1950s. After Thanksgiving on Thursday, with Philadelphia hosting the annual Army/Navy football game on Saturday, crowds of people gathered downtown on Friday. Stores took advantage of the opportunity to offer great deals on merchandise to attract people to shop, while police officers faced long, busy shifts. It wasn't until the 1980s that Black Friday began to gain a wider and better reputation.

67a1e234eb1f803cd60242224f803dc39644f22e.sourceText: 但网络星期一的起源比较清晰，而且是十几年前才出现的。这个词在2005年由全美零售联盟（National Retail Federation）提出，用于描述感恩节之后的星期一。当时人们在回到工作岗位后继续在网上购物。
67a1e234eb1f803cd60242224f803dc39644f22e.translatedText: But the origin of Cyber ​​Monday is relatively clear, and it only appeared more than ten years ago. The term was coined by the National Retail Federation in 2005 to describe the Monday after Thanksgiving. At that time people continued to shop online after returning to work.

4b86f0f428c72f7f4dbf598e770201cf769e96bf.sourceText: 网络星期一有更少的广告

36fef5868942c64ed593a573609a0eaed3597657.sourceText: 感恩节期间，很多人在出门购物前已经知道黑色星期五有哪些最好的优惠了。这是因为零售商们早在十月初就发布了黑色星期五的广告。然而，我们看到网络星期一的广告相对较少，可能是因为零售商已经洞悉购物者会选中哪些商品交易。
36fef5868942c64ed593a573609a0eaed3597657.translatedText: During Thanksgiving, many people already know what the best Black Friday deals are before they go out shopping. That's because retailers release Black Friday ads as early as early October. However, we saw relatively few Cyber ​​Monday ads, likely because retailers already have insights into which deals shoppers will be picking up.

85d3bd383a79e5f458d2e9fae57bebff6ddd07c2.sourceText: 告别店内的开门大抢购

ca0b22229c2f12ce11bbaba09057d4c2d91466b0.sourceText: 零售商的开门大抢购（Doorbusters）的广告数量日益减少。由于网络星期一是网上购物的日子。许多人认为，没有理由去挤当地的百思买（Bestbuy）商店的大门。
ca0b22229c2f12ce11bbaba09057d4c2d91466b0.translatedText: Retailers are seeing fewer ads for doorbusters. Since Cyber ​​Monday is the day for online shopping. Many people believe there is no reason to crowd the doors of their local Bestbuy store.

129dbb60b98050b1b29a6370d0d7b2c4e09692fe.sourceText: 总的来说，”开门大抢购”在消亡之中。一直以来，店内消费者对低库存商品即刻脱销的现象感到沮丧，因为这些商品在几秒钟内就卖光了。而零售商也开始聆听购物者的反馈。
129dbb60b98050b1b29a6370d0d7b2c4e09692fe.translatedText: In general, the "open door rush" is dying. In-store shoppers have long been frustrated by the phenomenon of low-stock items being sold out in seconds. And retailers are starting to listen to shopper feedback.

e561b39580f7e75ce0eb3101aab17fe90c9405f6.sourceText: 如今，常见的是，零售商在网上推出所谓的黑色星期五”开门大抢购”。
e561b39580f7e75ce0eb3101aab17fe90c9405f6.translatedText: Nowadays, it is common for retailers to launch so-called Black Friday "door-opening sales" online.

d16b1e51cfc7f8b704ed299f7fb1126dd911ad18.sourceText: 大多数销售在不到24小时内完成
d16b1e51cfc7f8b704ed299f7fb1126dd911ad18.translatedText: Most sales occur in less than 24 hours

e0ae4b39a8156d3ad8b364e602567b8d0710e5d3.sourceText: ”网络星期一”最具特色的特征之一可能就是其交易的短暂性，特别是与感恩节和黑色星期五相比。网络星期一的交易大部分都在当日结束。
e0ae4b39a8156d3ad8b364e602567b8d0710e5d3.translatedText: Perhaps one of the most distinctive features of Cyber ​​Monday is the ephemeral nature of its deals, especially compared to Thanksgiving and Black Friday. Most of the Cyber ​​Monday deals end that day.

e3d1305cb15d0dcc9476ed528848f3ca2f9d74f2.sourceText: 网络星期一还有更多的”瞬时”优惠，比如亚马逊的闪电折扣。无论是用笔记本电脑、手机还是用平板设备购物，消费者通常总是盯着屏幕不放，因为商家优惠期很短，买家争夺激烈。
e3d1305cb15d0dcc9476ed528848f3ca2f9d74f2.translatedText: Cyber ​​Monday also has more "instant" deals, such as Amazon's lightning discounts. Whether shopping on a laptop, mobile phone or tablet device, consumers are often glued to their screens as merchants offer deals for short periods of time and competition for buyers is fierce.

1a567e0968a3f759afa9ec810482c8872955b052.sourceText: 网络星期一的在线销售最火爆
1a567e0968a3f759afa9ec810482c8872955b052.translatedText: Online sales are the hottest on Cyber ​​Monday

12164a9e24cdfa13fa068ebdf1cff06894948f01.sourceText: 网络星期一是一年中最大的网络购物日，去年创下了34.5亿美元的销售额，比上年同期增长了12%以上。其中，移动购物（即利用移动设备购物）发挥了不少作用。移动购物占零售网站访问量的47%，占销售量的31%。
12164a9e24cdfa13fa068ebdf1cff06894948f01.translatedText: Cyber ​​Monday is the largest online shopping day of the year, with sales of US$3.45 billion last year, an increase of more than 12% over the same period last year. Among them, mobile shopping (that is, shopping using mobile devices) has played a lot of roles. Mobile shopping accounts for 47% of visits to retail websites and 31% of sales.

ab347ed024506c92df64a295575cd6082557e3a4.sourceText: 不一样的商店将会发光发亮

58bd737029fc01f20369182dc5d268236d9ead02.sourceText: 黑色星期五通常由百思买（Best Buy）、科尔(Kohl”s)、塔吉特（Target）等零售商唱主角，而在网络星期一，人们将看到的是，一些不太出名的商家更吸引消费者。像Crocs和Levi这样的商店曾提供了真正的折扣优惠。所以如果你发现一些意想不到的便宜商品时，请不要感到惊讶。
58bd737029fc01f20369182dc5d268236d9ead02.translatedText: Black Friday is usually dominated by Best Buy Retailers such as Buy, Kohl's, Target, and others are starring, and on Cyber Monday, what people will see is that some of the lesser-known merchants are more attractive to consumers. Stores like Crocs and Levi's have provided real discounts. So don't be surprised if you find some unexpected bargains.

9fefeeabc55bf5da39185dfecd525a6913171712.sourceText: 时尚达人更爱网络星期一

c31a65a1e09d3e26f6c0b2c8720a5d1a3dce38c5.sourceText: 就像奥运会赛季一样，每个购物节都有不同的购物活动。在感恩节和黑色星期五期间，更适合买电子产品，网络星期一则体现在其它商品上。衣服和鞋子的特价不错，零售商在很多情况下还会将未卖出的黑色星期五优惠商品推出，破釜沉舟再搏一次。
c31a65a1e09d3e26f6c0b2c8720a5d1a3dce38c5.translatedText: Just like the Olympic season, each shopping festival has different shopping events. While Thanksgiving and Black Friday are better days for electronics, Cyber ​​Monday is reflected in other items. There are great deals on clothes and shoes, and in many cases, retailers are offering unsold Black Friday deals to try again.

4868c148b6da0f916f540b77fb62a0bb8ed15001.sourceText: 网络星期一的美容产品经常被忽视，但其实很棒。或者还可购买新的厨房用品。值得一提的是，在网络星期一，还可预订到意想不到的酒店大优惠。
4868c148b6da0f916f540b77fb62a0bb8ed15001.translatedText: Cyber ​​Monday beauty products are often overlooked, but they're actually great. Or buy new kitchen items. It is worth mentioning that on Cyber ​​Monday, you can also book unexpected hotel deals.

264a38da1a4505da4c5792ca362a3c8e70536d4a.sourceText: 亚马逊、沃尔玛公布折扣信息
264a38da1a4505da4c5792ca362a3c8e70536d4a.translatedText: Amazon and Walmart announce discount information

b0e734059ccf0565d51261577bfc4af8fa781fcd.sourceText: 亚马逊将有大量的折扣商品，包括一些电子设备，如Echos (回声) 、Fire平板设备和Kindles，这些折扣额度与黑色星期五的折扣差不多。
b0e734059ccf0565d51261577bfc4af8fa781fcd.translatedText: Amazon will have a large number of discounted products, including some electronic devices, such as Echos (Echo), Fire tablet devices and Kindles. These discounts are similar to the discounts on Black Friday.

fce67069c13f1332a42302fb7a96439a0cefcbb0.sourceText: 最新的Echos (回声)将是79.99美元（省20美元） Fire HD 10平板电脑售价99.99美元（省50美元） Kindle Paperwhite将是89.99美元（省30美元）
fce67069c13f1332a42302fb7a96439a0cefcbb0.translatedText: Latest Echos will be $79.99 (save $20) Fire HD 10 tablet is $99.99 (save $50) Kindle Paperwhite will be $89.99 (save $30)

afb913e1c183951e82cf0f3469ce1bdaeb75f381.sourceText: 亚马逊承诺”高级品牌49英寸4K智能电视”仅售329.99美元，目前未知品牌的55英寸4K电视机售价224.99美元。在线零售业巨头也将对索尼和LG的几款4K电视机打折。
afb913e1c183951e82cf0f3469ce1bdaeb75f381.translatedText: > Amazon promises a "premium brand 49-inch 4K smart TV" for only $329.99, and a 55-inch 4K TV from an unknown brand is currently priced at $224.99. The online retail giant will also discount several 4K TVs from Sony and LG.

70bed698baf98af8b4da468ff7f35c458f50ddb0.sourceText: 亚马逊还承诺在各种视频游戏上节省”高达60%”，包括最近发布的”使命召唤：二战”、”中土世界：战争的阴影”和”守望先锋”等。
70bed698baf98af8b4da468ff7f35c458f50ddb0.translatedText: Amazon also promises savings of "up to 60%" on a variety of video games, including the recently released "Call of Duty: WWII," "Middle-earth: Shadow of War" and "Overwatch."

0b8eb033487b8978eab44d01eec52a51ea5150c6.sourceText: 沃尔玛将在周一再次提供类似于黑色星期五的折扣信息，自东部时间午夜正式开始，主要包括：
0b8eb033487b8978eab44d01eec52a51ea5150c6.translatedText: Walmart will once again offer Black Friday-like discounts on Monday, officially starting at midnight ET, including:

9ff5ce0b15f755e3c2b3dd133ffe9a4786dc0c0c.sourceText: 三星58英寸4K电视598美元（省200美元） Bose QuietComfort 25降噪耳机179美元（节省100美元） 500GB的Xbox One S为189美元（省60美元） 1TB的PlayStation 4 Slim为199美元（省50美元）。
9ff5ce0b15f755e3c2b3dd133ffe9a4786dc0c0c.translatedText: Samsung 58-inch 4K TV for $598 (save $200) Bose QuietComfort 25 noise-canceling headphones for $179 (save $100) Xbox One S 500GB for $189 (save $60) The 1TB PlayStation 4 Slim is $199 (save $50).

686624a9c5a95d065511cbf365219278a7e77f24.sourceText: Target的网络星期一销售自”星期一一大早”开始，将包括全场15%的折扣。零售商还为各种电子产品提供折扣，将推出479.99美元的50英寸三星4K电视机；购买Beats X蓝牙耳机或Beats EP有线耳机，送20美元的塔吉特礼品卡。
686624a9c5a95d065511cbf365219278a7e77f24.translatedText: Target's Cyber ​​Monday sales begin "early Monday morning" and will include a 15% discount sitewide. The retailer is also offering discounts on a variety of electronics, including a 50-inch Samsung 4K TV for $479.99 and a $20 Target gift card with the purchase of Beats X Bluetooth headphones or Beats EP wired headphones.

25d9b3c97aaf35e82fd3b047d9f3644a88e5965a.sourceText: 零售商周五看到了假期购物季节的强劲表现，他们希望网络星期一继续保持强劲销售势头。据跟踪该行业的Adobe公司表示，美东时间周五上午10点，零售商在网上的黑色星期五的消费支出达6.4亿美元，比去年同期增长18%以上。
25d9b3c97aaf35e82fd3b047d9f3644a88e5965a.translatedText: >Retailers saw a strong start to the holiday shopping season on Friday, and they are hoping that strong sales momentum will continue on Cyber ​​Monday. According to Adobe, which tracks the industry, as of 10 a.m. ET on Friday, retailers' online Black Friday consumer spending reached $640 million, an increase of more than 18% from the same period last year.

970b8aa27f788c01902c47c9a0c5d7739c538622.sourceText: 在移动设备上的销售是一个特别突出的变化，有着61%的网站访问量和46%的收入。
970b8aa27f788c01902c47c9a0c5d7739c538622.translatedText: Sales on mobile devices are a particularly prominent change, accounting for 61% of site visits and 46% of revenue.

9314144207c5fc61f3cca1dc7d4949d2228340c5.sourceText: 亚马逊（Amazon）、百思买（Best Buy）和沃尔玛（Walmart）的股价周五全线上涨，周五亚马逊股价周二上涨超过2%。
9314144207c5fc61f3cca1dc7d4949d2228340c5.translatedText: Shares of Amazon, Best Buy and Walmart all rose on Friday, with Amazon shares rising more than 2% on Tuesday.

ff86361c0fb0483c52f2c8f70ad9317e558fd6d4.sourceText: Adobe公司营销和客户洞见部门副总裁米基．麦利寇（Mickey Mericle）在一份声明中表示，这个假期的重点是，利用手机等移动设备购物。”零售商知道购物者当前人在何处，他们正在为其提供更好的体验。””而寻找折扣的顾客在使用智能手机快速完成交易方面做得越来越好。”
ff86361c0fb0483c52f2c8f70ad9317e558fd6d4.translatedText: > Mickey. Mickey Mericle said in a statement that the focus this holiday season is shopping on mobile devices such as mobile phones. "Retailers know where shoppers are currently and they are providing them with a better experience." "And customers looking for discounts are getting better at using their smartphones to quickly complete transactions."

321505b6ed054a6651710ca1a62300ea489bfdd1.sourceText: 亚省夜市悄然兴起 美食休闲共享欢乐 （陈丽君报道）金秋时节，由美国环球文化机构（Universal Cultural Organization）于2017年11月17日至19日在亚利桑那州皮奥里亚市（Peoria）举办的”夜市”圆满落幕，这是该机构继2014年、2015年在本地成功举办中国元宵花灯节后奉献的又一盛事。短短三天时间内，吸引了成千上万的游客光顾，各地美食在这里汇聚，多元文化在这里碰撞。 场地周围布满了40多家摊位和商铺，夜幕降临，灯火辉煌的夜市就在熙熙攘攘的行人间热闹起来。从下午5时到晚上11时一直忙碌着，各式各样的美味佳肴让你目不暇接，垂涎欲滴。你不仅可以体验到古老的西部传统风味和独具特色的原住民美食，当然还有充满异国风味的经典美食。如中国、意大利、墨西哥、法国、日本、泰国、印度等。 有炸春卷、扬州炒饭、糖醋里脊、香酥炸虾、汉堡、三明治、烤猪扒、煎香肠、鸡肉卷、BBQ、意大利面、泰式米饭、法式烤牛排、咖哩饭、寿司、天妇罗、串烧、各种饼及面包等，价格合理，有些小吃也叫不上名字，感觉美味可口。很多摊位前都排着长龙，展台前面是美食展示，后面就是各家名厨的表演场，一些游客驻足而观。每家都尽力展示自己的拿手绝活及招牌菜，吆喝着，不遗余力地给游客介绍。各种酒水、饮品和甜点也很受欢迎。主办方特意为夜市制作了一种低度调味酒”Star Light”，口感清爽，盛在一个外形像电灯泡的玻璃器皿里，五颜六色，有颜值很诱人，受到饮酒者喜爱。 人们或站着或坐者，一边品尝美食，一边聊天；也可以尽情欣赏来自不同国家和民族的多元文化展示和娱乐节目。专门搭建的大舞台，上演一幕幕精彩节目，有热舞劲歌、民族旋律、器乐演奏等，民族与现代融合，尽显时代潮流，音乐声、歌声、舞声此起披伏，不时传来阵阵掌声和喝彩声。 一些摊位分别展示趣味游戏，儿童乐园，保健养生，手工制作及工艺饰品等，也吸引了不少人的眼球。活动自然少不了中国元素，凤凰城耆英会的老人们饶有兴致地教当地人玩麻将，并热情地给对中国字感兴趣的参观者起中文名字。很多市民、情侣在许愿树下，写下心中最美好的祝福。 夜市，是各种小吃的集合地，在夜市上寻觅美食，不仅是为了尝遍各种风味，更是闲暇之余的放松和消遣。既满足人们对美食的热情和渴望，更传达蕴含在美食背后的文化魅力。无疑在饮食创新、情感交流、文化共享、友谊和谐等方面都发挥着重要作用，不断推动饮食文化健康可持续发展。 美国环球文化机构是2013年成立的一家非盈利组织，旨在弘扬中华文化，促进多元文化发展，丰富人们的生活。据主办方介绍此次活动历时一年多时间筹划，经过市场考察，周密计划和精心准备，取得了令人可喜的效果，首先感谢义工们的辛勤付出，部分收入将用于支持社会公益和慈善事业；也感谢参与夜市的商家，对他们来说这也是一个展示和创收的良好机会。通过举办这样的活动也积累了一些经验，希望未来在广告宣传、场地选择、项目优化及饮食的多样性等方面做得更具体，吸引更多的高端商家参与，到更多的城市举办，形成集饮食、娱乐、购物、文化一体的具有一定规模的夜市模式。 （ 陈丽君摄影，部分照片主办方提供）
321505b6ed054a6651710ca1a62300ea489bfdd1.translatedText: Night markets are quietly emerging in Alberta, providing food, leisure and sharing fun (reported by Chen Lijun) In the golden autumn season, the "Night Market" organized by the Universal Cultural Organization in the United States from November 17 to 19, 2017, came to a successful conclusion in Peoria, Arizona. This is another grand event contributed by the organization after the successful local Chinese Lantern Festival in 2014 and 2015. In just three days, it attracted thousands of tourists, where delicacies from all over the world gathered and diverse cultures collided. There are more than 40 stalls and shops around the venue. As night falls, the brightly lit night market becomes lively among the bustling pedestrians. It is always busy from 5 pm to 11 pm, and the variety of delicious food will make you dizzy and salivate. Not only can you experience the traditional flavors of the Old West and unique Aboriginal cuisine, but of course there are also classic cuisines full of exotic flavors. Such as China, Italy, Mexico, France, Japan, Thailand, India, etc. There are fried spring rolls, Yangzhou fried rice, sweet and sour pork loin, crispy fried shrimp, burgers, sandwiches, grilled pork chops, fried sausages, chicken rolls, BBQ, pasta, Thai rice, French grilled steak, curry rice, sushi, tempura, skewers, various cakes and breads, etc. The prices are reasonable, and some snacks are not even named, but they feel delicious. There were long queues in front of many stalls. In front of the stalls was a food display, and behind them was a performance venue by famous chefs. Some tourists stopped to watch. Each family tries its best to show off its specialties and signature dishes, shouting and sparing no effort to introduce them to tourists. A variety of alcohol, beverages and desserts are also popular. The organizer specially produced a low-alcohol flavored wine "Star Light" for the night market. It has a refreshing taste and is served in a glass vessel shaped like a light bulb. It is colorful, attractive and popular among drinkers. People are standing or sitting, enjoying delicious food and chatting; they can also enjoy multicultural displays and entertainment programs from different countries and ethnic groups. The specially built large stage staged wonderful performances, including hot dance songs, ethnic melodies, instrumental music performances, etc. The ethnic and modern fusion showed the trend of the times. The sound of music, singing and dancing came and went, and bursts of applause and cheers came from time to time. Some stalls displayed fun games, children's playgrounds, health and wellness, handmade and craft accessories, etc., which also attracted many people's attention. Naturally, Chinese elements are indispensable for the event. Elderly people from the Phoenix Senior Citizens Association taught the locals how to play mahjong with great interest, and enthusiastically gave Chinese names to visitors who were interested in Chinese characters. Many citizens and couples wrote their best wishes under the wishing tree. The night market is a gathering place for various snacks. Looking for delicious food at the night market is not only to taste various flavors, but also to relax and have fun in your spare time. It not only satisfies people's passion and desire for food, but also conveys the cultural charm behind the food. Undoubtedly, it plays an important role in food innovation, emotional exchange, cultural sharing, friendship and harmony, etc., and continuously promotes the healthy and sustainable development of food culture. The American Global Cultural Institute is a non-profit organization established in 2013 to promote Chinese culture, promote the development of multiculturalism, and enrich people's lives. According to the organizer, this event took more than a year to plan. After market inspection, careful planning and careful preparation, it achieved gratifying results. First of all, thank you to the volunteers for their hard work, part of the income will be used to support social welfare and charity; also thank you to the merchants who participated in the night market, for them this is also a good opportunity to showcase and generate income. We have also accumulated some experience by holding such events. We hope to be more specific in advertising, venue selection, project optimization and food diversity in the future, attract more high-end merchants to participate, hold it in more cities, and form a night market model of a certain scale that integrates food, entertainment, shopping and culture. (Photography by Chen Lijun, some photos provided by the organizer)

47fceac10f1fa55b945421eae3a00bb6d4d58963.sourceText: 中新网12月4日电 据美国侨报网综合报道，对在美国的留学生来说，因酒驾而引发的严重后果，将会为他们的学习生涯带来无法挽回的遗憾。
47fceac10f1fa55b945421eae3a00bb6d4d58963.translatedText: China News Service, December 4. According to a comprehensive report by the American Overseas Chinese News Network, for international students in the United States, the serious consequences caused by drunk driving will bring irreparable regrets to their study career.

8939f75bfc6a7ff57f7bac117fb7333bf966beff.sourceText: 酒驾被捕后导致学生签证被取消
8939f75bfc6a7ff57f7bac117fb7333bf966beff.translatedText: A student visa was canceled after being arrested for drunk driving

122f06ef494971318b1fe1f713395c2d7a054a53.sourceText: 2016年3月11日(本文均为当地时间)晚间，一名在纽约州就读的中国留学生刘同学因酒驾被捕，随后法庭要求他出庭见法官，不过出庭被推迟。然而刘同学却在一个月后收到了美国驻沈阳领事馆发来的通知，通知上写着他的F1签证被吊销了。
122f06ef494971318b1fe1f713395c2d7a054a53.translatedText: On the evening of March 11, 2016 (this article is all local time), Liu, a Chinese student studying in New York State, was arrested for drunk driving. He was then required by the court to appear before a judge, but his appearance was postponed. However, Liu received a notice from the U.S. Consulate in Shenyang a month later, stating that his F1 visa had been revoked.

65b4ba7d7b9daf8ced385528c08b255279091ba7.sourceText: 华裔代理律师表示，尽管这名同学还是有机会再次取得F1签证并合法留美读书，不过他应首先处理酒驾的案件。因为在美国，酒驾被捕后所带来的相关后果不容忽视。
65b4ba7d7b9daf8ced385528c08b255279091ba7.translatedText: A Chinese attorney said that although this classmate still has the opportunity to obtain an F1 visa again and legally study in the United States, he should first handle the drunk driving case. Because in the United States, the consequences of being arrested for drunk driving cannot be ignored.

04c4acd496fb3b73457d717db9fd6213f0b332af.sourceText: 学生签证过期后酒驾出车祸 被捕转往移民监狱
04c4acd496fb3b73457d717db9fd6213f0b332af.translatedText: After her student visa expired, she was involved in a car accident while drunk driving and was arrested and transferred to the immigration prison

63fbee1e8c159cd7cb1f6785a8ff9fd87fd78dff.sourceText: 2016年5月22日，一名中国女留学生与朋友在法拉盛聚餐，饭桌上她喝了不少酒。酒席散后她驾车回家，途中撞上了一辆车，并将对方车辆撞损。在受害人报警下，前来的警方当场为该女留学生做酒精测试，数值显示严重超标，遂将她带回警局。之后再做进一步检查时，警方又发现她的学生签证早已过期，属非法停留。于是警方在处理完其酒驾行为后，很快将她转往了移民监狱。
63fbee1e8c159cd7cb1f6785a8ff9fd87fd78dff.translatedText: On May 22, 2016, a Chinese female international student had a dinner with her friends in Flushing. She drank a lot of wine at the dinner table. After the banquet, she drove home and hit a car on the way, damaging the other vehicle. After the victim called the police, the police who came did an alcohol test on the female international student on the spot. The value showed that it was seriously over the limit, so they took her back to the police station. After further inspection, the police discovered that her student visa had already expired and she was staying illegally. So after the police dealt with her drunk driving behavior, she was quickly transferred to the immigration prison.

0144087d2d980b83e59b556f27a472cc236ace30.sourceText: 据悉，该女留学生当初是持学生签证赴美上学，后来在签证过期下也没再续签或更新。
0144087d2d980b83e59b556f27a472cc236ace30.translatedText: It is reported that the female international student originally went to the United States to study on a student visa, but later did not renew or renew her visa after it expired.

80b5146a1d505f988cd112b25b65882ebbcf3bb6.sourceText: 醉驾致6人死亡 或被判终身监禁
80b5146a1d505f988cd112b25b65882ebbcf3bb6.translatedText: Drunk driving caused the death of 6 people or was sentenced to life imprisonment

d79a11e50f476365dfe316926a13d9add7fd37b2.sourceText: 2015年7月24日，周姓中国留学生醉驾上路，结果与一辆丰田汽车相撞，两车再一同撞上其它车辆，导致丰田车上一名西班牙裔女子当场死亡，6人受伤。周姓同学本人头部受伤。
d79a11e50f476365dfe316926a13d9add7fd37b2.translatedText: On July 24, 2015, a Chinese student named Zhou drove drunk on the road and collided with a Toyota car. The two cars then hit other vehicles together, resulting in the death of a Hispanic woman in the Toyota car on the spot and 6 injuries. A classmate named Zhou suffered a head injury.

a134b077019157cf4b2b2152b853494459fe8a51.sourceText: 警局确认事故发生时周姓同学系醉酒驾驶，因此以酒驾严重过失造成他人死亡罪对其进行起诉，保释金为50万美元，面临最少15年有期徒刑，甚至终身监禁。
a134b077019157cf4b2b2152b853494459fe8a51.translatedText: The police confirmed that the student surnamed Zhou was driving drunk when the accident occurred. Therefore, he was charged with serious negligence in drunk driving causing death. The bail was set at 500,000 US dollars, and he faced a minimum of 15 years in prison and even life imprisonment.

becd6dd3aa5843bce4e4d706191151e26c9e7b3b.sourceText: 在美国酒驾的严重后果
becd6dd3aa5843bce4e4d706191151e26c9e7b3b.translatedText: The serious consequences of drunk driving in the United States

7deb7ef87e1ffa866a41ef25f25ff2146218c79f.sourceText: 美国各州关于酒驾的处罚虽然不一样，但只要被警察发现，马上就会被逮捕并戴上手铐送入拘留所。酒驾者被送到拘留所后，就等待交保。等交了一大笔保释金后，还要支付一笔昂贵的拖车费、存车费和罚金。
7deb7ef87e1ffa866a41ef25f25ff2146218c79f.translatedText: Although the penalties for drunk driving vary from state to state in the United States, as long as you are discovered by the police, you will be arrested immediately and handcuffed and sent to a detention center. After the drunk driver is sent to the detention center, he waits to post bail. After paying a large bail, you will also have to pay an expensive towing fee, vehicle storage fee and fines.

a24877724a0159d34e43fbca6cd8044b6a5175be.sourceText: 还要聘请律师打官司，算下来看得见的费用大约要1.3万美元左右。如果情节严重，车辆被扣6个月或1年，还得另外花费交通费。
a24877724a0159d34e43fbca6cd8044b6a5175be.translatedText: You also need to hire a lawyer to litigate, and the estimated cost will be around US$13,000. If the circumstances are serious, the vehicle will be impounded for 6 months or 1 year, and additional transportation fees will have to be paid.

8132ee64a8e4dd83a75a748e387a6d8dfaf81690.sourceText: 此外，以加州的法律规定为例，相关部门对年轻人的酒驾行为实行”零容忍”政策。如果违反规定喝酒，就算血液中的酒精浓度低于0.08%，也将面临吊销驾照一年、罚款、扣留车辆、监禁等处罚。
8132ee64a8e4dd83a75a748e387a6d8dfaf81690.translatedText: In addition, taking California's legal provisions as an example, relevant departments implement a "zero tolerance" policy for young people's drunk driving behavior. If you drink in violation of the regulations, even if your blood alcohol concentration is less than 0.08%, you will face penalties such as a one-year suspension of your driver's license, fines, vehicle impoundment, and imprisonment.

3cd4c2d26f391ab0ebca8ef1f65cdaf9f9038e6b.sourceText: 酒驾记录还将留在个人档案中，并影响到生活中的方方面面。因为酒驾在美国被视为严重危害公共安全的行为，所以拥有酒驾记录的人也将被视为自控能力差的人。
3cd4c2d26f391ab0ebca8ef1f65cdaf9f9038e6b.translatedText: Drunk driving records will remain in personal files and affect all aspects of life. Because drunk driving is considered a serious endangerment to public safety in the United States, people with a drunk driving record will also be regarded as people with poor self-control.

44fc77bd4ff9d5c04d34d6b2cb567026950be979.sourceText: 此外，美国移民局规定，被判酒驾后5年内不能申请入籍。若是持旅游签证在美国驾车被查出酒驾，将会影响下一次入境。今年，美国安全部部长John Kelly表示，酒驾一次就可能遭到遣返出境。这不仅令非法移民害怕，也让持绿卡者不敢忽视。
44fc77bd4ff9d5c04d34d6b2cb567026950be979.translatedText: In addition, the US Immigration Service stipulates that you cannot apply for naturalization within 5 years after being convicted of drunk driving. If you are caught driving under the influence of alcohol while driving in the United States on a tourist visa, it will affect your next entry. This year, U.S. Security and Safety Secretary John Kelly said that a single drunk driver could lead to deportation. This not only scares illegal immigrants, but also makes green card holders dare not ignore it.

75e2e5ad819682c0fdc0cdfc851ce80fb7f96f01.sourceText: 律师指出，通常仅一次酒驾不太容易遭到遣返，最多算轻罪，通常涉及重罪才会遭到递解出境，但不要认为重罪离自己很远，多次累积酒驾，或同时伴有其他触法行为，例如无照驾驶、鲁莽驾驶甚至撞人等，都可能以重罪遭到起诉，从而导致递解出境的命运。
75e2e5ad819682c0fdc0cdfc851ce80fb7f96f01.translatedText: Lawyers pointed out that usually only one drink-driving offense is unlikely to be deported. It is considered a misdemeanor at most, and deportation is usually required when a felony is involved. However, do not think that a felony is far away from you. Repeated drunk driving, or accompanied by other violations of the law, such as driving without a license, reckless driving or even hitting someone, may be prosecuted as a felony, leading to the fate of deportation.

9d43a9cad6ca9f9b08f41a4e6b43d5ad1e44c8b7.sourceText: 由种种事例可见，在美国酒驾被捕将会带来严重的后果。所以留学生千万不能抱有侥幸心理知法犯法，最终付出巨大的代价！
9d43a9cad6ca9f9b08f41a4e6b43d5ad1e44c8b7.translatedText: It can be seen from various cases that being arrested for drunk driving in the United States will bring serious consequences. Therefore, international students must not take chances and break the law, as they will eventually pay a huge price!

a89a93af9dcfd49598cfa20d1f658efa6f7f7ce3.sourceText: 相关专题： 特朗普大胜！美参院通过30年来最大税改法案

8e59cf17377d9d5711f0d43dda921ef1ae78681a.translatedText: Trump tax reform was passed by the Senate, which may increase the deficit by 1.4 trillion US dollars in 10 years

3cfcb0f7f4aef5233330f400f50c4081f90bd9bf.translatedText: The U.S. Senate passed the tax reform bill Congress revised the tax law for the first time in 31 years

51c2737b268b5ab8d7e8bfd7487b8f54bd80c64c.translatedText: The U.S. tax reform bill may benefit the wealthy

3f0ba74cafd43afad1b0e026fff8baf30ba10e3f.sourceText: 万凯梓：美国税改加息利好美指 黄金接连暴跌空头来袭
3f0ba74cafd43afad1b0e026fff8baf30ba10e3f.translatedText: Wan Kaizi: U.S. tax reform and interest rate hikes are good for the U.S. index, gold has plummeted one after another and short sellers are attacking

04d0259bd9a18c357e60de29eee1a32744523e30.sourceText: 共和党税改成功闯关参议院 美元多头春天要来了？
04d0259bd9a18c357e60de29eee1a32744523e30.translatedText: The Republican tax reform successfully passed the Senate. Is the spring for dollar bulls coming?

e85b5831d375e97faae7a4f933c09d456c56b6a0.sourceText: 申万宏源评参议院通过税改议案：年底前落地概率提升
e85b5831d375e97faae7a4f933c09d456c56b6a0.translatedText: Shen Wanhongyuan commented on the tax reform bill passed by the Senate: the probability of implementation before the end of the year is increased

9c041b421924ead0e765e2d63f2b057cbd120c29.sourceText: 1、北京时间12月2日下午3点左右，特朗普的税改方案获得了美国参议院的通过。这是特朗普执政将近一年来，获得的第一个重大胜利。
9c041b421924ead0e765e2d63f2b057cbd120c29.translatedText: 1. At around 3 pm on December 2, Beijing time, Trump’s tax reform plan was approved by the U.S. Senate. This is Trump's first major victory in nearly a year in office.

0b81dec768c2d3e7e7b66fb9b104f6e26af3261e.sourceText: 2、此次税改方案在参议院获得了51票赞成和49票反对。特朗普所在的共和党在参议院拥有52个席位，而48名民主党参议院全部投了反对票。这意味着有一名共和党员投了反对票。
0b81dec768c2d3e7e7b66fb9b104f6e26af3261e.translatedText: 2. The tax reform plan received 51 votes in favor and 49 votes against in the Senate. Trump's Republican Party holds 52 seats in the Senate, and all 48 Democratic senators voted against it. That means one Republican voted against it.

b5d95af406c07796226e7ff52c7e49e9e31b6583.sourceText: 3、11月16日，美国众议院已经以227票对205票通过了税改法案。所以，今天特朗普在参议院获得胜利是决定性的。 接下来，是解决众议院通过的版本和参议院版本的差异问题（比如减税的开始时间）。如果不出意外，特朗普有可能在元旦之前签署减税法案。
b5d95af406c07796226e7ff52c7e49e9e31b6583.translatedText: 3. On November 16, the U.S. House of Representatives passed the tax reform bill by a vote of 227 to 205. Therefore, Trump’s victory in the Senate today is decisive. Next, there is the matter of resolving differences between the House-passed version and the Senate version (such as when tax cuts begin). If nothing else happens, Trump is likely to sign the tax cut bill before New Year's Day.

b3093dbd3ad3c2cc2e5747b1ac758993736435d1.sourceText: 4、根据特朗普的减税方案，未来10年将减免税收大约1.4万亿美元，对美国经济将产生显著的刺激作用。特朗普希望，通过减税做大经济蛋糕，最终解决赤字过大的问题，这能否实现尚有待观察。
b3093dbd3ad3c2cc2e5747b1ac758993736435d1.translatedText: 4. According to Trump’s tax reduction plan, approximately US$1.4 trillion in taxes will be reduced in the next 10 years, which will have a significant stimulating effect on the US economy. Trump hopes to expand the economic pie through tax cuts and ultimately solve the problem of excessive deficits. Whether this can be achieved remains to be seen.

832d5a258c1684e586841304387d1a884abf6abf.sourceText: 上图：美国总统特朗普发表推文，感谢参议院多数党领袖麦康奈尔及参议院临时议长哈奇在税改法案投票期间的工作，并表示期待在圣诞节前签署最终版法案。
832d5a258c1684e586841304387d1a884abf6abf.translatedText: Above: U.S. President Trump tweeted, thanking Senate Majority Leader McConnell and Senate President Pro Tempore Hatch for their work during the vote on the tax reform bill, and expressed that he looked forward to signing the final version of the bill before Christmas.

44883c0c1640a0a81f65622753194d2e29b94ec2.sourceText: 5、这是美国31年来最大规模的税制改革，公司所得税将从35%下调至20%， 税改还鼓励美国公司把海外利润带回美国；在为中产阶级减负方面，个税标准扣除额几乎翻倍。个税从七档减至四档，分别为12%、25%、35%和39.6%。
44883c0c1640a0a81f65622753194d2e29b94ec2.translatedText: 5. This is the largest tax reform in the United States in 31 years. The corporate income tax will be reduced from 35% to 20%. The tax reform also encourages American companies to bring overseas profits back to the United States; in terms of reducing the burden on the middle class, the standard deduction for personal income tax has almost doubled. The personal income tax has been reduced from seven levels to four levels, which are 12%, 25%, 35% and 39.6% respectively.

7ec208a4713322bab9600443d45d8b4c19ea9c44.sourceText: 6、特朗普的减税方案若能及时实施，将对经济产生刺激作用。估计2018年美联储加息的次数将增加到四次。
7ec208a4713322bab9600443d45d8b4c19ea9c44.translatedText: 6. If Trump’s tax cut plan can be implemented in time, it will have a stimulating effect on the economy. The Fed is expected to raise interest rates four times in 2018.

70907119c14147f243eb7431692e7815199009be.sourceText: 7、减税将带来全球性的影响， 主要经济体为了应对美国的竞争，会普遍降低企业所得税、个人所得税，中国也不例外 。此前中国财政部长肖捷已经多次提到过”税制的国际竞争力”的问题。
70907119c14147f243eb7431692e7815199009be.translatedText: 7. Tax cuts will have a global impact. In order to cope with competition from the United States, major economies will generally reduce corporate income tax and personal income tax, and China is no exception. Chinese Finance Minister Xiao Jie has previously mentioned the issue of "the international competitiveness of the tax system" many times.

a2c9e06f927541781c0daf23897401ca01a96ce5.sourceText: 8、减税的实施，将增加美联储加息的次数，这也将影响各国银行的决策。 比如中国央行在明年下半年”被动加息”可能性将增加，而加息对中国楼市、股市将构成利空。
a2c9e06f927541781c0daf23897401ca01a96ce5.translatedText: 8. The implementation of tax cuts will increase the number of interest rate hikes by the Federal Reserve, which will also affect the decision-making of banks in various countries. For example, the possibility that China's central bank will "passively raise interest rates" in the second half of next year will increase, and raising interest rates will be negative for China's property and stock markets.

e55b4bc890bf2843d1d40cd7812960b34287fe67.sourceText: 9、值得注意的是，特朗普还准备废除遗产税。美国的这个举措，可能对全球遗产税产生深远的影响。为了保持竞争力，主要国家未来将纷纷废除遗产税，或者降低税率。 中国推出遗产税的可能性，将大大降低。
e55b4bc890bf2843d1d40cd7812960b34287fe67.translatedText: 9. It is worth noting that Trump is also preparing to abolish the estate tax. This move by the United States may have a profound impact on global inheritance taxes. In order to remain competitive, major countries will abolish inheritance taxes or reduce tax rates in the future. The possibility of China introducing an inheritance tax will be greatly reduced.

7acbb017d4cb4d4d59fa3ee2ed55bbf202b2e607.sourceText: 10、总之，特朗普减税方案的通过，对于中国的实体经济构成利好，对于楼市、股市构成轻微的利空，这将让中国”控制货币总量”的政策获得延续。
7acbb017d4cb4d4d59fa3ee2ed55bbf202b2e607.translatedText: 10. In short, the passage of Trump’s tax cut plan will be good for China’s real economy and slightly negative for the property and stock markets. This will continue China’s policy of “controlling the total currency.”

d1259d17fdef46d27c25738ec34bf01dc5dfe1d0.sourceText: 音乐教育全美国委员会主办的（MTNA）每年一度的声乐才艺大赛，亚利桑那州的分赛刚刚落下帷幕。在众多优秀的演奏者中，华裔小提琴演奏者Belle Wang，脱颖而出暂获最高奖，将代表亚利桑那州于2018年1月5日-8日到拉斯维加斯参加西南赛区的比赛，在西南分赛区获胜者将于明年三月在佛罗里达参加每年一度的总决赛。在此，我们预祝Belle Wang越战越勇，在后面的比赛中取得好成绩，为亚利桑那州争光。
d1259d17fdef46d27c25738ec34bf01dc5dfe1d0.translatedText: The Arizona state competition of the annual vocal talent competition sponsored by the Music Education Council of America (MTNA) has just concluded. Among many outstanding performers, Chinese-American violinist Belle Wang stood out and won the highest award. She will represent Arizona to participate in the Southwest Division competition in Las Vegas from January 5th to 8th, 2018. The winner of the Southwest Division will participate in the annual finals in Florida next March. Here, we wish Belle Wang to become more courageous as she fights, achieve good results in the following games, and win glory for Arizona.

d170f032d37e21eb4810d6d3bbd56793a950b3cf.sourceText: 最新公布的标准普尔卡斯席勒指数显示，标志美国房市价格的综合指数已经回升至房市崩溃前2007年冬季水平。
d170f032d37e21eb4810d6d3bbd56793a950b3cf.translatedText: The latest S&P Cass-Shiller Index shows that the composite index, which marks the price of the US housing market, has rebounded to the level in the winter of 2007 before the housing market collapsed.

a32f13fd272b1d7038e777f2733167c05310a92a.sourceText: 根据最新发布的卡斯席勒指数，9月份的房价指数涨幅是三年多以来的最高水平，过去12个月的数据显示，全国房价指数年上涨6.2％，为2014年6月以来最高的年度涨幅。同时，10城市综合指数的年度增幅为5.7％，20城市综合指数的年度增幅为6.2％。
a32f13fd272b1d7038e777f2733167c05310a92a.translatedText: According to the latest Cass-Shiller Index, the house price index rose in September to the highest level in more than three years. Data over the past 12 months showed that the national house price index increased by 6.2% annually, the highest annual increase since June 2014. At the same time, the annual growth rate of the 10-city composite index was 5.7%, and the annual growth rate of the 20-city composite index was 6.2%.

9d464e0180133b0567e686b28cebcce1b07e35e3.sourceText: 西雅图，拉斯维加斯和圣地亚哥是20个城市中房价增幅最高的城市。在9月份，西雅图以12.9％的价格年增长领先，随后是拉斯维加斯年增长9.0％，圣地亚哥年增长8.2％。
9d464e0180133b0567e686b28cebcce1b07e35e3.translatedText: Seattle, Las Vegas and San Diego had the highest home price growth among the 20 cities. In September, Seattle led the way with annual price growth of 12.9%, followed by Las Vegas at 9.0% and San Diego at 8.2%.

2c51e7ded13b78de6d177dbfaeb11afc7fbfe433.sourceText: ”全国住房价格继续上涨，相应标普普尔劳杰克的卡斯席勒全国指数以自2014年6月以来最快的年率上涨。”标普道琼斯指数委员会主席董事大卫.布利策（David Blitzer）表示：”指数跟踪的所有20个城市的房价与去年同期相比都较高。16个城市年价格增长在加速。强势依然在西部城市，增长最小的分别是亚特兰大、纽约、迈阿密、芝加哥和华盛顿。”
2c51e7ded13b78de6d177dbfaeb11afc7fbfe433.translatedText: "Housing prices across the country continue to rise, with S&P Rawjack's Cass-Shiller National Index rising at its fastest annual rate since June 2014." David Blitzer, Chairman of the Committee on S&P Dow Jones Indices Blitzer said: "House prices in all 20 cities tracked by the index are higher compared with the same period last year. Annual price growth is accelerating in 16 cities. The strength is still in the Western cities, with the smallest growth in Atlanta, New York, Miami, Chicago and Washington."

fcfd2fdb27a0cf2b0ab89208e340b56fdfc07f97.sourceText: 布利策表示，大多数经济指标显示房价可能进一步上涨，包括房贷利息、房屋库存、失业率、通货膨胀率等等，不过相应带来可负担性问题，”上涨的价格意味着有些人将被挤出市场。”
fcfd2fdb27a0cf2b0ab89208e340b56fdfc07f97.translatedText: Blitzer said, Most economic indicators show that housing prices may rise further, including mortgage interest, housing inventory, unemployment rate, inflation rate, etc., but this will bring about affordability issues. "Rising prices mean that some people will be squeezed out of the market."

125381828c08287cc9a651276cfc6229f3b4002e.sourceText: 标普普尔劳杰克的卡斯席勒全国住宅价格指数（S&P CoreLogic Case-Shiller）覆盖美国所有九个人口普查区域，是美国住房价格的主要衡量标准。
125381828c08287cc9a651276cfc6229f3b4002e.translatedText: S&P Laojack's Cass-Shiller National Home Price Index (S&P CoreLogic Case-Shiller) covers all nine U.S. census tracts and is the primary measure of U.S. housing prices.

614ecdbe14f0eccad913f24974ebd0c02dac99ee.translatedText: A giant dragon made of nearly 10,000 porcelain plates, the Temple of Heaven, London Bridge, the lost Mayan dynasty, the Eiffel Tower, giant dinosaurs, graceful underwater creatures, and all kinds of rare world landscapes will be held in the form of a festive lantern display at the state fairgrounds 1826 W McDowell Rd Phoenix, Alberta, on the evening of November 16th. AZ 85007 Meet everyone.

46a496112ecf1a05de493da235e920fc9ab22e0c.sourceText: 本次灯盏的设计都是来自中国自贡，自贡灯会以中国传统文化为主轴，汇集多国古今元素，体现当地多族裔文化特色。北京天坛、龙舟画舫和唐人街，巴黎埃菲尔铁塔与水上威尼斯、旧金山金门大桥与非洲大草原，以及墨西哥金字塔和玛雅文化等75组巨型彩灯，分别呈现世界10余个著名景观，不同族裔的观众几乎都能在灯会上找到自己的家园，一日游遍”地球村”。
46a496112ecf1a05de493da235e920fc9ab22e0c.translatedText: The designs of this lantern are all from Zigong, China. The Zigong Lantern Festival takes Chinese traditional culture as the main axis, bringing together ancient and modern elements from many countries to reflect the local multi-ethnic cultural characteristics. There are 75 groups of giant lanterns, including the Temple of Heaven, the Dragon Boat Festival and Chinatown in Beijing, the Eiffel Tower and Venice on the Water in Paris, the Golden Gate Bridge and the African Savannah in San Francisco, and the pyramids and Mayan culture in Mexico. Each of them presents more than 10 famous landscapes in the world. Audiences of different ethnic groups can almost find their own homes at the lantern festival and travel throughout the "global village" in one day.

db48d97c9b294cc128db44ff24f6cc97e2513ea6.sourceText: 主办方还花巨资将3D超大视频从中国搬到美国，让当地朋友看到中国的最精尖的技术。超大3D屏幕将是亚利桑那州史上首秀。
db48d97c9b294cc128db44ff24f6cc97e2513ea6.translatedText: The organizer also spent huge sums of money to move the 3D super large video from China to the United States, allowing local friends to see China's most sophisticated technology. The large 3D screen will be the first in Arizona history.

c7ab646c4a229c26ffb46614c2da1c5155fdaf9f.sourceText: 只有高大上的设备绝对不能算一个高水品的艺术作品。一定要有才华横溢的人才，本次灯盏还结合中国美食，中国杂技，获得国家大奖的杂技团，倾情献艺，风火轮，空中漫步这些最新的杂技，一定让你感受到人类的超能力。他们还将加盟在美莎艺术中心举办的2018 第九届亚省春晚。来自中国四川的名厨们，将会给当地人带来最地道的中国川菜，让你不出国门，尝到中国经典美食。 圣诞节的灯饰是美国的传统，中国的艺术家们利用最新的声光电技术，将美国的传统节日做到一个全新的高度。这必将成为2017全美最震撼，最难忘的灯盏。2017年11月16日到2018年1月2日，凤凰城将成为不夜城，成为全美最闪耀的城市。
c7ab646c4a229c26ffb46614c2da1c5155fdaf9f.translatedText: Only high-end equipment can never be considered a high-quality work of art. There must be talented people. This lantern also combines Chinese food, Chinese acrobatics, national award-winning acrobatic troupes, passionate performances, hot wheels, air walks and other latest acrobatics, which will definitely make you feel the super power of human beings. They will also join the 2018 9th Alberta Spring Festival Gala held at the Mesa Arts Center. Famous chefs from Sichuan, China, will bring the most authentic Chinese Sichuan cuisine to the locals, allowing you to taste Chinese classic delicacies without going abroad. Christmas lights are an American tradition. Chinese artists use the latest sound and light technology to bring the traditional American festival to a whole new level. This will surely become the most shocking and unforgettable lantern in the United States in 2017. From November 16, 2017 to January 2, 2018, Phoenix will become the city that never sleeps and become the most shining city in the United States.

d961e34b1f27910134f0ec1d8fc265ff8ade384e.translatedText: Hope Chinese School 2017 Autumn Sports Meet (Written by: Xu Xuetao Photography: Huang Bing) I really like Liu Yuxi’s phrase “Autumn has come since ancient times...

5640c0d2219cd0fcfbc4bd607496841cb9f83afa.sourceText: (撰稿：徐雪涛 摄影： 黄冰) 非常喜欢刘禹锡的那句”自古逢秋悲寂寥，我言秋日胜春朝”， 特别是在亚利桑那这个热带沙漠性气候地区，秋天可谓是一年之中最美的季节了。夏日的骄阳已 然冷却，冬季的北风尚未来临，在这样秋高气爽，清新怡人的日子里，亚省希望中文学校又迎来 了一年一度的秋季运动会。 有别于传统的运动会，希望中文学校的运动会并不以输赢为目的，而是充分强调”运动，快 乐，交流”。快看，Tumbleweed Park 的大草坪上，各种妙趣横生的游戏项目都在如火如荼地进 行着。套圈是同学们最喜爱的活动之一，特别是奖品还是他们最中意的各种饮料，孩子们都卯足 了劲要一试身手；家长们也和孩子们通过游戏赢取瓶装水。只见男女老少齐上阵，有全神贯注投 圈的，有七嘴八舌交流经验的，没中的遗憾扼腕，得奖的欢天喜地。 公园的另一角，拔河比赛和接力跑也热火朝天地展开了。拔河成人组的较量中，妈妈队士气 如虹，巾帼不让须眉；爸爸队谦谦君子，尽展绅士风度；最终妈妈队以微弱优势取得胜利。学生 组的比赛更是激烈，孩子们都摩拳擦掌，一股初生牛犊不怕虎的劲头。接力跑的场地上，同学们 迈着矫健的步伐，迎着秋日的微风尽情奔跑，肆意挥洒青春的热情和朝气。 提到快乐二字，又怎能少了美食的加持。本次运动会，不仅各位家长带来了拿手好菜，学校 贴心地预定了美味外卖，学生会成员的家长们也支起摊子给大家烤羊肉串，磨鲜豆浆，做棉花 糖。更值得一提的是，希望第一届厨艺大赛也隆重开场：颜值与味道并重的银耳莲子羹，七彩水 果挞，南瓜聚宝盆，劲辣够味的夫妻肺片，新疆大盘鸡，麻辣凉粉， 香酥味美的萝卜丝酥饼，花 朵面包，黄金猪排，台式盐酥鸡，港式烧肉，还有一出场就惊艳众人的群英荟萃拌米皮。各位烹 饪高手尽展实力，老师学生家长大饱口福，交口称赞。 在欢乐的气氛中，始终有一些忙碌的身影，为运动会的顺利进行，默默无闻地工作着。学生 会的大哥哥大姐姐不仅给小朋友们提供免费的 face painting，还积极组织义卖，为学生会和学校的 工作筹集资金；各位游戏负责老师和学生志愿者，在太阳下奔忙，给大家带去欢笑；各位义工们 早早地开始了采买布置，为运动会提供了可靠的后勤保障。正是由于大家的努力，又一届秋季运 动会圆满成功，让我们一同期待来年，期待更多的欢乐与希望！
5640c0d2219cd0fcfbc4bd607496841cb9f83afa.translatedText: (Written by: Xu Xuetao Photography: Huang Bing) I really like Liu Yuxi’s words, “Since ancient times, autumn has always been a sad and lonely time, but I say that autumn is better than spring.” Especially in Arizona, a tropical desert climate area, autumn is the most beautiful season of the year. The summer sun has cooled down, and the winter north wind has not yet arrived. In such crisp, fresh and pleasant days, the Alberta Hope Chinese School once again ushered in the annual autumn sports meeting. Different from traditional sports games, the sports games of Hope Chinese School do not focus on winning or losing, but fully emphasize "sports, happiness, and communication." Look, all kinds of interesting games are in full swing on the big lawn of Tumbleweed Park. Ring tying is one of the students' favorite activities, especially the prizes are their favorite drinks, and the children are all excited. Parents and children also participated in the game to win bottled water. Some of them were engrossed in the game, some were talking about their experiences, some were regretful about not winning, and some were overjoyed to win. In another corner of the park, the tug-of-war competition and relay race were also in full swing. In the tug-of-war competition for the adult group, the morale of the mother team was greatly improved. Like a rainbow, the women did not show their grace; the father team was a gentleman, showing their gentlemanly demeanor; in the end, the mother team won with a slight advantage. The competition in the student group was even more fierce, and the children were eager to compete, with the energy of a newborn calf. On the relay running field, the students took vigorous steps and ran in the autumn breeze, showing off their youthful enthusiasm and vitality. When it comes to the word happiness, how can we not miss the blessing of delicious food. Not only did the parents bring delicious dishes, the school thoughtfully ordered delicious takeaways, and the parents of the student union members also set up stalls to grill lamb skewers, grind fresh soy milk, and make marshmallows. What’s more worth mentioning is that the first cooking competition will also have a grand opening: Tremella lotus seed soup and colorful water. Fruit tarts, pumpkin cornucopia, spicy and flavorful couple's lung slices, Xinjiang large plate chicken, spicy jelly, crispy and delicious shredded radish cake, flower bread, golden pork chops, Taiwanese salt crispy chicken, Hong Kong style roast pork, and the famous mixed rice noodle that amazed everyone when they appeared. The cooking masters showed off their skills, and teachers, students and parents were full of praise. In the joyful atmosphere, there are always some busy figures working silently for the smooth progress of the sports meeting. The big brothers and sisters of the student union not only provide free face painting to the children, but also actively organize charity sales to raise funds for the work of the student union and the school; the game teachers and student volunteers are busy under the sun, bringing laughter to everyone; all volunteers The purchase and arrangement started early, providing reliable logistical support for the Games. It is due to everyone's efforts that another Autumn Games was a complete success. Let us look forward to the coming year and more joy and hope!

2a1ece3c306a58d980c7c6443bab0e1927cb7a99.sourceText: 昨天是人民空军成立68周年纪念日。纪念日前夕，11月10日上午，空军在航空博物馆举行向英雄纪念墙敬献花篮仪式。空军前司令员马晓天、空军司令员丁来杭、空军政治委员于忠福和在京空军党委常委等出席了纪念活动。
2a1ece3c306a58d980c7c6443bab0e1927cb7a99.translatedText: Yesterday was the 68th anniversary of the founding of the People's Air Force. On the morning of November 10, the eve of the Memorial Day, the Air Force held a flower basket laying ceremony at the Heroes Memorial Wall at the Aviation Museum. Former Air Force Commander Ma Xiaotian, Air Force Commander Ding Laihang, Air Force Political Commissar Yu Zhongfu and members of the Standing Committee of the Air Force Party Committee in Beijing attended the commemorative event.

9c1f10303d7269e3a489b1e9dd5134704fc9a894.sourceText: 空军发言人在仪式上表示，中国空军正向全疆域作战的现代化战略性军种迈进。他还透露，歼-20、运-20已开展编队训练，空军”英雄营”开创了世界上首次使用地空导弹击落敌机的先例。
9c1f10303d7269e3a489b1e9dd5134704fc9a894.translatedText: An Air Force spokesperson said at the ceremony that the Chinese Air Force is moving towards a modern strategic service that operates in all territories. He also revealed that the J-20 and Yun-20 have carried out formation training, and the Air Force's "Hero Battalion" set a precedent for the world's first use of surface-to-air missiles to shoot down enemy aircraft.

b40b68de350e701ec7b48d5df111682bee66f6bc.sourceText: 向空军英模、烈士敬献花篮
b40b68de350e701ec7b48d5df111682bee66f6bc.translatedText: Presenting flower baskets to Air Force heroes and martyrs

8b691e3f785ccf82ff099aa01dc22ff3f477ae14.sourceText: 10日上午10时整，仪式正式开始，军乐队奏响《义勇军进行曲》，全场高唱中华人民共和国国歌。国歌唱毕，全场肃立，向空军英雄模范敬礼，向空军烈士默哀。
8b691e3f785ccf82ff099aa01dc22ff3f477ae14.translatedText: At 10 a.m. on the 10th, the ceremony officially began. The military band played the "March of the Volunteers" and the audience sang the national anthem of the People's Republic of China. After the national song, the audience stood in silence, saluted the heroic models of the Air Force, and observed a moment of silence for the martyrs of the Air Force.

428b0a66c5c9352afcbee194f64f7f5f800fea1e.sourceText: 默哀毕，军乐队奏响《献花曲》，礼兵抬起花篮走向英雄纪念墙，整齐摆放在蓝天魂雕塑前。空军领导与参加仪式的全体人员一起瞻仰空军英雄纪念墙，表达对英雄模范和英烈们的崇高敬意和深切怀念。
428b0a66c5c9352afcbee194f64f7f5f800fea1e.translatedText: After the silence, the military band played "Flower Presentation Song", and the soldiers carried the flower baskets towards the Heroes Memorial Wall and placed them neatly in front of the Blue Sky Soul Sculpture. Air Force leaders and all personnel participating in the ceremony paid homage to the Air Force Heroes Memorial Wall to express their high respect and deep memory for the heroic models and heroes.

b15a30c34ce11b4fc771730933e78502c744eb78.sourceText: 据悉，从2010年开始的每年11月11日前后，空军都举行向空军英雄纪念墙敬献花篮仪式。
b15a30c34ce11b4fc771730933e78502c744eb78.translatedText: It is reported that since 2010, every year around November 11, the Air Force has held a flower basket laying ceremony at the Air Force Heroes Memorial Wall.

defa566497402ec83fbdc7d18577246854d988ba.sourceText: 开创地空导弹击落敌机先例
defa566497402ec83fbdc7d18577246854d988ba.translatedText: Creating a precedent for a surface-to-air missile shooting down an enemy aircraft

5e5c3c4389f4ca104ae49b021a522de059487021.sourceText: 中国空军新闻发言人申进科大校在纪念活动上表示，经过68年建设发展，空军已成为一支由多兵机种组成的战略性军种。特别是近5年，围绕”空天一体、攻防兼备”战略目标建设实战空军、转型空军、战略空军，转型发展进入快车道，备战打仗能力发生历史性变化。
5e5c3c4389f4ca104ae49b021a522de059487021.translatedText: Colonel Shen Jinke, spokesperson of the Chinese Air Force, said at the commemorative event that after 68 years of construction and development, the Air Force has become a strategic service composed of multiple types of aircraft. Especially in the past five years, we have built an actual combat air force, a transformational air force, and a strategic air force around the strategic goal of "integrated air and space, both offensive and defensive". Transformation and development have entered the fast lane, and our war preparation and fighting capabilities have undergone historic changes.

93cb88106628930797fb659e6af07fdf2966ff96.sourceText: 他表示，中国空军活动范围由陆地向远海远洋延伸，兵力运用从单一平台向构建体系发展。近年来，空军进行钓鱼岛空中维权、东海防空识别区管控、南海常态化战巡等行动，坚定不移维护国家主权、保卫国家安全、保障和平发展。
93cb88106628930797fb659e6af07fdf2966ff96.translatedText: He said that the scope of activities of the Chinese Air Force extends from land to distant seas, and the use of force has developed from a single platform to a system. In recent years, the Air Force has carried out air rights protection over the Diaoyu Islands, control of the East China Sea Air Defense Identification Zone, and regular combat patrols in the South China Sea to unswervingly safeguard national sovereignty, safeguard national security, and ensure peaceful development.

c02b97f815969cdcb2144b61e3d72cb06b5d80d6.sourceText: 申进科透露了中国空军的一项壮举：空军”英雄营”开创了世界上首次使用地空导弹击落敌机的先例，中国自主研发的红旗-9地空导弹装备部队后，全面形成作战能力。他说，着眼新的空天威胁和作战样式变化，空军正加快推进防空反导能力建设，地面防空兵形成了远中近程、高中低空相结合的作战体系，信息化条件下防空反导能力全面提升。
c02b97f815969cdcb2144b61e3d72cb06b5d80d6.translatedText: Shen Jinke revealed a feat of the Chinese Air Force: the Air Force's "Hero Battalion" set a precedent for the world's first use of surface-to-air missiles to shoot down enemy aircraft. After China's independently developed Hongqi-9 surface-to-air missiles were equipped with the troops, they fully formed combat capabilities. He said that in view of new air and space threats and changes in combat styles, the Air Force is accelerating the construction of air defense and anti-missile capabilities. The ground air defense forces have formed a combat system that combines long, medium and short-range, high, medium and low altitudes, and the air defense and anti-missile capabilities have been comprehensively improved under information technology.

5fa1bbb65df77b7678c8bea7deb96b46f9417249.translatedText: J-20 and Yun-20 have carried out formation training

a9378349b4c3a87d8cd77a4a88c6656fe40e94aa.sourceText: 申进科介绍，中国空军实战化军事训练从研究队友向研究对手转变，从研究考场向研究战场转变，涌现出一批”金头盔””金飞镖”飞行员和”金盾牌”地空导弹营。
a9378349b4c3a87d8cd77a4a88c6656fe40e94aa.translatedText: Shen Jinke introduced that the Chinese Air Force's actual combat training has changed from studying teammates to studying opponents, from studying examination rooms to studying battlefields, and a group of "Golden Helmet" and "Golden Dart" pilots and "Golden Shield" surface-to-air missile battalions have emerged.

a8da6335318a33c6caa8558d3e33078b2d101ddc.sourceText: 他透露，5年来空军高新武器装备成体系发展。目前，歼-20、运-20已开展编队训练，多名飞行员具备通飞歼-20、歼-16、歼-10C等多种新型战机的能力。
a8da6335318a33c6caa8558d3e33078b2d101ddc.translatedText: He revealed that the Air Force’s high-tech weapons and equipment have been systematically developed over the past five years. At present, the J-20 and Yun-20 have carried out formation training, and many pilots have the ability to fly J-20, J-16, J-10C and other new fighter aircraft.

f77bdb9dc3da4e74cb70a2bce785a728d5cbc46a.sourceText: 歼-20是我国第四代隐形战斗机，进一步提升了空军综合作战能力，今年列装部队。运-20是我国新一代战略大型运输机，使空军战略投送能力迈出关键性一步，2016年列装部队。
f77bdb9dc3da4e74cb70a2bce785a728d5cbc46a.translatedText: The J-20 is my country's fourth-generation stealth fighter, which further enhances the comprehensive combat capabilities of the Air Force and will be commissioned into the army this year. The Y-20 is my country's new generation of strategic large-scale transport aircraft, which has taken a critical step in the Air Force's strategic delivery capabilities. It was commissioned into the army in 2016.

de5725f706debd9f5030f15f25d1755e96c56cae.sourceText: 在培养人才方面，空军在全国各地建设了空军青少年航空学校，与清华大学、北京大学、北京航空航天大学等学校联合培养新型飞行人才，首批28名”清华班”歼击机飞行学员已加入空军战斗行列。
de5725f706debd9f5030f15f25d1755e96c56cae.translatedText: In terms of cultivating talents, the Air Force has built Air Force Youth Aviation Schools across the country, and jointly cultivates new flying talents with Tsinghua University, Peking University, Beijing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics and other schools. The first batch of 28 "Tsinghua Class" fighter pilot students has joined the Air Force's combat ranks.

25b9b4dad387a04bd6c4b01c52d23b03c8765a02.sourceText: 在自身发展的同时，中国空军与世界各国空军在联演联训、作战训练、飞行安全与装备技术等领域开展了广泛交流合作。
25b9b4dad387a04bd6c4b01c52d23b03c8765a02.translatedText: While developing itself, the Chinese Air Force has carried out extensive exchanges and cooperation with air forces around the world in areas such as joint exercises and training, combat training, flight safety and equipment technology.

8d8bdb6e0414df9720df3a838be343701fc7b0f3.sourceText: 申进科表示，当前，空军正不断锤炼空天战略打击能力、空天防御能力和空中战略投送能力，努力建设强大的现代化空军。
8d8bdb6e0414df9720df3a838be343701fc7b0f3.translatedText: Shen Jinke said that currently, the Air Force is constantly improving its air and space strategic strike capabilities, air and space defense capabilities and air strategic delivery capabilities, and is striving to build a strong and modern air force.

e81ecb584ea651d8dfe4a4700b74970eb1079403.translatedText: China News Service, October 30 (Xinhua) Taiwan's "United Daily News" recently published an article saying, is it better to eat vegetables raw or cooked? Are there nutritional differences between raw or cooked foods? Raw food enthusiasts argue that cooking removes important vitamins and destroys beneficial enzymes. But cooking some vegetables can break down their tough cell walls, making nutrients more easily absorbed by the body.

cd44c3b865ebea03acf20e208df9b7f5b6f1fb4a.sourceText: 资料图：一名工人将洗好的胡萝卜切去多余部分。秦斌 摄 图片来源：CFP视觉中国
cd44c3b865ebea03acf20e208df9b7f5b6f1fb4a.translatedText: Data picture: A worker cuts off the excess parts from washed carrots. Photo by Qin Bin Image source: CFP Vision China

716471eec05c672de25b06aa1359c3d62fb0f7c6.sourceText: 多数人知道多食胡萝卜对眼睛有利，因胡萝卜富含β-胡萝卜素，在体内会转化为维生素A，对视力、免疫、皮肤等都至为重要。研究人员发现，吃烹煮过的胡萝卜，更能增加人体吸收β-胡萝卜素的含量。
716471eec05c672de25b06aa1359c3d62fb0f7c6.translatedText: Most people know that eating more carrots is good for the eyes, because carrots are rich in beta-carotene, which is converted into vitamin A in the body, which is very important for vision, immunity, skin, etc. Researchers have found that eating cooked carrots can increase the body's absorption of beta-carotene.

c253e3923b1b6e2412140cfb62f5509b1b67ebb0.sourceText: 当大力水手吞下一罐菠菜，是什么让他的肌肉隆起？如果你觉得是铁，可能没错，但也可能是叶酸棗一种多出现在深色蔬菜中的维生素B，对细胞生长和生殖健康有重要意义。
c253e3923b1b6e2412140cfb62f5509b1b67ebb0.translatedText: When Popeye swallowed a can of spinach, what made his muscles bulge? If you think it's iron, you may be right, but it may also be folic acid, a B vitamin that appears mostly in dark vegetables and is important for cell growth and reproductive health.

0e6353f658d1e92751282ba9069f6eaf1dbd4c2e.sourceText: 虽然菠菜不会因为烹调而增加叶酸的含量，但一项研究发现，蒸过的菠菜能保持叶酸含量不变。那为什么建议吃煮过的菠菜呢？营养师说，因为煮过的菠菜会缩水成一点点，让人可以吃下更多，摄取足够的叶酸。
0e6353f658d1e92751282ba9069f6eaf1dbd4c2e.translatedText: While cooking spinach does not increase its folate content, one study found that steamed spinach maintained its folate content. So why is it recommended to eat cooked spinach? Nutritionists say that because cooked spinach shrinks to a little bit, people can eat more and get enough folic acid.

2870710498bade113bd6274e85e105745a58efe1.sourceText: 西红柿有强大的抗氧化成分─茄红素。如果你常吃西红柿泥、西红柿酱，那么恭喜你已摄取不少茄红素。但如果你只吃新鲜西红柿，那么恐怕只吃进4%茄红素。因西红柿有很厚的细胞壁，身体难以吸收利用，只有在煮熟后，茄红素会充分释放出来。
2870710498bade113bd6274e85e105745a58efe1.translatedText: Tomatoes have a powerful antioxidant component - lycopene. If you often eat tomato puree and tomato sauce, congratulations, you have absorbed a lot of lycopene. But if you only eat fresh tomatoes, then you may only eat 4% lycopene. Because tomatoes have thick cell walls, it is difficult for the body to absorb and utilize them. Lycopene will be fully released only after they are cooked.

4cae02a1b1fb471e4e6a5fc86a444c5be3c30a9f.sourceText: 芦笋在抗癌维生素如A、C、E和叶酸的含量都非常高，但它厚实的细胞壁，让人体难以吸收这些营养素。而烹调能分解其纤维细胞，以便人体吸收更多的维生素。
4cae02a1b1fb471e4e6a5fc86a444c5be3c30a9f.translatedText: Asparagus is very high in anti-cancer vitamins such as A, C, E and folic acid, but its thick cell wall makes it difficult for the body to absorb these nutrients. Cooking can break down its fiber cells so that the body can absorb more vitamins.

1b0fcfa735bb2bf62eecc517e4074ded39a9b91c.sourceText: 橙色的南瓜和胡萝卜一样，富含β-胡萝卜素等抗氧化剂，一旦加热更容易被吸收。
1b0fcfa735bb2bf62eecc517e4074ded39a9b91c.translatedText: >Orange pumpkin, like carrots, is rich in antioxidants such as beta-carotene, which are easier to absorb once heated.
