af953c1a65748e41a9f3e31232acd63054de2b46.sourceText: 德州南部一乡村教会信徒5日近中午做礼拜时遭滥射屠杀，至少26人丧命、24人受伤.此事件据信是美国有史以来最惨烈的教会枪击案.中枪身亡的枪手确认为26岁白人男子戴文.派屈克.凯利(Devin Patrick Kelley)，他担任过主日学课程老师，曾被美国空军开除军籍。警方仍在追查行凶动机，但据信枪手与恐怖组织并无关系。
af953c1a65748e41a9f3e31232acd63054de2b46.translatedText: Believers in a rural church in southern Texas were indiscriminately shot and massacred during worship at noon on the 5th. At least 26 people were killed and 24 injured. This incident is believed to be the most brutal church shooting in the history of the United States. The gunman who was shot and killed was identified as 26-year-old white man Devin Patrick Kelly. Kelley, who served as a Sunday school teacher and was discharged from the U.S. Air Force. Police are still looking for a motive for the attack, but it is believed the gunman has no ties to a terrorist organization.

b77e01600754395a0c5c04a66a13f960f39dd29e.sourceText: 正在日本东京访问的川普总统获悉後表示，德州教会滥射事件是”邪恶行径”，他说已与德州州长艾伯特(Greg Abbott)通过话，并表明该州会获得川普政府的”全力支援”。川普先前推文对家属表示慰问。法新社报导，州长艾伯波特表示，共26人身亡。目前无法立即得知枪手动机。血案发生在德州圣安东尼奥东南方约50公里的小镇苏特兰泉(Sutherland Springs)。
b77e01600754395a0c5c04a66a13f960f39dd29e.translatedText: President Trump, who is visiting Tokyo, Japan, said after learning that the mass shooting incident at a Texas church was an "evil act." He said he had spoken with Texas Governor Greg Abbott and stated that the state would receive "full support" from the Trump administration. Trump previously tweeted his condolences to the family. Agence France-Presse reported that Governor Albert Porter said a total of 26 people died. The shooter's motive was not immediately known. The murder occurred in Sutherland Springs, a small town about 50 kilometers southeast of San Antonio, Texas.

d7f2b7fd30102cfa472848a9aaadbdec27e44623.sourceText: 法新社报导，州长艾伯波特表示，共26人身亡。目前无法立即得知枪手动机。血案发生在德州圣安东尼奥东南方约50公里的小镇苏特兰泉。
d7f2b7fd30102cfa472848a9aaadbdec27e44623.translatedText: Agence France-Presse reported that Governor Albert Porter said that a total of 26 people died. The shooter's motive was not immediately known. The murder occurred in Suitland Springs, a small town about 50 kilometers southeast of San Antonio, Texas.

5037f2cef0a56a0ebc93423b180cbfea564b2e00.sourceText: 当地执法人员透露，枪手凯利一身黑衣，配备野战装备、子弹皮带和一把冲锋枪，走进苏特兰泉第一浸信会教会，随即开火；直到教会裡一名英勇男子趁枪手装弹时，奋勇上前拦阻，凯利才停止攻击。据报导，教会附近一位居民拦阻凯利，将枪枝自凯利手上打落，随後驾车追逐他。
5037f2cef0a56a0ebc93423b180cbfea564b2e00.translatedText: Local law enforcement officials revealed that the gunman Kelly, dressed in black, equipped with field equipment, a bullet belt and a submachine gun, walked into the First Baptist Church of Suitland Springs and opened fire; it was not until a brave man in the church stepped forward to stop the gunman while he was reloading that Kelly stopped attacking. According to reports, a resident near the church blocked Kelly, knocked the gun from his hand, and then chased him in his car.

fa875ec1b0b0efa352dc89762a5f83906292e493.sourceText: 枪手驾车逃逸 中枪亡
fa875ec1b0b0efa352dc89762a5f83906292e493.translatedText: The gunman fled in a car and was shot

1460ac8bd5ed9e4f3d60c9f9ec88bfae6d188e1d.sourceText: 瓜达洛普郡警长办公室发言人墨菲指出，住在圣安东尼奥郊区新布朗菲尔斯(New Braunfels)的凯利，驾驶自己的休旅车逃逸，逃到州界附近撞车，在该郡徒步逃逸时中枪死亡。但凯利是自戕身亡，还是被当地居民击毙，仍不清楚。
1460ac8bd5ed9e4f3d60c9f9ec88bfae6d188e1d.translatedText: Guadalupe County Sheriff's Office spokesman Murphy pointed out that Kelly, who lived in New Braunfels, a suburb of San Antonio, fled in his SUV and crashed near the state line. He was shot and died while escaping on foot in the county. However, it is still unclear whether Kelly committed suicide or was shot by a local resident.

2892e86afa8104548fae9a4a1231c97ce8b8f32d.sourceText: 圣安东尼奥警方5日晚上，带著警犬和拆弹小组突击凯利住所。据报导，凯利最近曾在脸书上传一张类似AR-15攻击步枪的照片。由社媒网站的资料显示，他2009年自新布朗菲尔斯高中毕业後加入空军，2014年被开除军籍，并曾上军事法庭受审。
2892e86afa8104548fae9a4a1231c97ce8b8f32d.translatedText: On the evening of the 5th, the San Antonio police raided Kelly's residence with police dogs and a bomb squad. According to reports, Kelly recently uploaded a photo on Facebook that resembled an AR-15 assault rifle. According to information on social media websites, he joined the Air Force in 2009 after graduating from New Braunfels High School. He was expelled from the military in 2014 and was tried in a military court.

c89beec556d2e7e304be943a224228d98e6049ca.sourceText: 警方目前正调查，他是否可能加入当地一个民兵组织。威尔逊郡行政官加梅斯告诉CNN，包括枪手在内至少27人死亡，死亡人数恐再增加。该教会牧师的14岁女儿也是死者之一，该牧师当天正好出城。现场首批驰援人员来自当地其他教会，他们是接获家人朋友传来发生枪击的简讯而赶往救援。
c89beec556d2e7e304be943a224228d98e6049ca.translatedText: The police are currently investigating whether he may have joined a local militia group. Wilson County Administrator Gamez told CNN that at least 27 people died, including the gunman, and the death toll may increase. The 14-year-old daughter of the church pastor was also one of the deceased. The pastor happened to be out of town that day. The first responders at the scene came from other local churches. They rushed to the rescue after receiving text messages from family and friends that a shooting had occurred.

69a1ee51015ebe92ee64f48316bcc49f6cfe6f01.sourceText: 德州公共安全厅地区主任马丁说，凯利被发现于当日上午11时20分现身于一家Valero加油站，他身著黑衣，穿戴野战装备和一条子弹皮带，”他穿越马路到教堂会，走出车子，开始向教会射击，然後走向教会右方，继续开火，接著进入教会，再度开火”。
69a1ee51015ebe92ee64f48316bcc49f6cfe6f01.translatedText: Texas Department of Public Safety Regional Director Martin said that Kelly was found at a Valero gas station at 11:20 a.m. that day. He was dressed in black, field equipment and a bullet belt. "He crossed the street to the church, got out of the car, started shooting at the church, then walked to the right of the church, continued to fire, then entered the church and opened fire again."

49efc0017158a1b1f5a9c229a68e0d229fcaebfb.translatedText: Multiple guns and explosives were found in the car

4d1f1c9015edf0ce6b019e21980ae061e0d7659f.sourceText: 当他离开教会堂时，一位不知姓名的当地居民拦阻他。马丁说：”一位当地居民抓住他的枪，与嫌犯扭打，嫌犯落下冲锋枪，逃离教堂，一位当地居民当时曾追逐嫌犯。”马丁说，执法人员追踪到在州界附近撞车後徒步逃逸的嫌犯，警方寻获他时，他已死亡，警方在他车上发现多把枪械及疑似爆炸物。
4d1f1c9015edf0ce6b019e21980ae061e0d7659f.translatedText: When he left the church, an unknown local resident stopped him. Martin said: "A local resident grabbed his gun and struggled with the suspect. The suspect dropped his submachine gun and fled the church. A local resident chased the suspect at the time." Martin said that law enforcement officers tracked the suspect who crashed his car near the state line and fled on foot. When the police found him, he was dead. The police found multiple firearms and suspected explosives in his car.

1551a5cf472c0e4182f7b65e1033e1e117f8707e.sourceText: 马丁说，教会内发现23名死者，另两人陈尸教会外，另一人送医後伤重不治。伤者伤势有轻伤，也有的极为严重，他们年纪从五岁到72岁。目前仍不清楚凯利滥射时教会内有多少人，但马丁说，有人逃出，毫发未损。
1551a5cf472c0e4182f7b65e1033e1e117f8707e.translatedText: Martin said that 23 people were found dead inside the church, two others were found dead outside the church, and another person died of his injuries after being sent to the hospital. The injured ranged from minor injuries to extremely serious injuries, and their ages ranged from five to 72 years old. It's still unclear how many people were inside the church when Kelly fired indiscriminately, but Martin said some people escaped unharmed.

1f3c4ce87da22750c014985740e7115f2f2559f2.sourceText: 严格执法 美国拟终止30万人临时保护身份
1f3c4ce87da22750c014985740e7115f2f2559f2.translatedText: Strict law enforcement The United States plans to terminate the temporary protected status of 300,000 people

f8a5c6affec713dc262baba7e5979028f60a2af2.sourceText: 严格执法 美国拟终止30万人临时保护身份 在幼年被成年人非法带入美国的年轻人9月30日在洛杉矶的一个法律资讯机…
f8a5c6affec713dc262baba7e5979028f60a2af2.translatedText: Strict law enforcement The United States plans to terminate the temporary protected status of 300,000 people. Young people who were illegally brought to the United States by adults when they were young were at a legal information machine in Los Angeles on September 30...

b245e871118aea2785b9c5c78e3b7f326495c333.sourceText: 在幼年被成年人非法带入美国的年轻人9月30日在洛杉矶的一个法律资讯机构，等待获得律师资源。(FREDERIC J. BROWN/AFP/Getty Images)
b245e871118aea2785b9c5c78e3b7f326495c333.translatedText: Young people who were illegally brought to the United States by adults when they were young were at a legal information machine in Los Angeles on September 30, waiting to obtain lawyer resources. (FREDERIC J. BROWN/AFP/Getty Images)

696b55ea0ca45f014fdcd00980b20281d1a12296.sourceText: 据美国国务院官员透露，30多万来自中美洲和海地的公民在美国的临时保护身份（TPS）或很快将终止。美国国土安全部预计最早于周一（6日）宣布这项决定。
696b55ea0ca45f014fdcd00980b20281d1a12296.translatedText: According to U.S. State Department officials, the Temporary Protected Status (TPS) of more than 300,000 citizens from Central America and Haiti in the United States may soon be terminated. The U.S. Department of Homeland Security is expected to announce this decision as early as Monday (6th).

329a2b72a66e7807474373dac130e6cfcbcfa406.sourceText: 《华盛顿邮报》报导，周二（10月30日）美国国务卿蒂勒森（Rex Tillerson）发函给国土安全部代理部长杜克（Elaine Duke），告诉她向中美洲及海地公民提供临时保护的需要已经不存在，因为那里的环境和条件已经改变。
329a2b72a66e7807474373dac130e6cfcbcfa406.translatedText: The Washington Post reported that US Secretary of State Rex Tillerson sent a letter to Acting Secretary of Homeland Security Elaine Duke on Tuesday (October 30), telling her that the need to provide temporary protection to citizens in Central America and Haiti no longer exists because the environment and conditions there have changed.

5affc4861a67cb08b151413f4b7139bfa93d84a1.sourceText: 目前在获得TPS身份的人中，有些已经在美国工作和生活了20多年。根据左翼机构、美国进步中心近期公布的调研数据显示，获得临时保守身份的中美洲及海地人在美国出生的子女，已经达到275,000人。
5affc4861a67cb08b151413f4b7139bfa93d84a1.translatedText: Currently, some of those who have obtained TPS status have been working and living in the United States for more than 20 years. According to recent research data released by the left-wing organization and the Center for American Progress, the number of children born in the United States of Central Americans and Haitians who have obtained temporary conservative status has reached 275,000.

9232eddba635f02c4b951b23e92c277cbb82b07e.sourceText: 根据美国法律要求，蒂勒森这份信函的内容没有被公开，但其中的内容已经被几位熟悉此事的官员证实。
9232eddba635f02c4b951b23e92c277cbb82b07e.translatedText: In accordance with U.S. legal requirements, the contents of Tillerson's letter have not been made public, but its contents have been confirmed by several officials familiar with the matter.

00655b5e1d5da3cf90422f01c5816925b682d4e2.sourceText: 周一，国土安全部将宣布，是否对约5.7万洪都拉斯人和2,500名尼加拉瓜人的临时保护身份给予延期。这些人目前的临时保护身份将于明年1月初到期。尽管这些人中大部分是通过非法途径进入美国，由于1998年米奇飓风袭击中美洲，使这些人免遭被遣返的命运。之后，他们的临时保护身份因原籍国的自然灾害和不安定因素而被一再延长。
00655b5e1d5da3cf90422f01c5816925b682d4e2.translatedText: On Monday, the Department of Homeland Security will announce whether to extend Temporary Protected Status for approximately 57,000 Hondurans and 2,500 Nicaraguans. Their current temporary protected status is set to expire in early January next year. Although most of these people entered the United States illegally, Hurricane Mitch hit Central America in 1998 and prevented these people from being deported. Later, their temporary protected status was repeatedly extended due to natural disasters and instability in their countries of origin.

b0eb233a18ddda37ba3ca108d7c9512d4f15b093.sourceText: ”临时保守身份”于1990年获国会通过，原籍国遭受自然灾害或武装冲突的外国人，可以暂时居住在美国，以获得更安全的保障。
b0eb233a18ddda37ba3ca108d7c9512d4f15b093.translatedText: "Temporary Conservative Status" was passed by Congress in 1990. Foreigners whose countries of origin have suffered natural disasters or armed conflicts can temporarily reside in the United States to obtain safer protection.

07b22717d51eb522709143de0bfb06efdc79ebef.sourceText: 川普 政府官员认为，这项计划的实质是给予外籍人临时保护，而非永久性保护，因此不该成为人们藉以转为长期在美居住的手段。由于最初向这些外籍人士提供临时保护的条件已经不存在，这种做法早应该停止。
07b22717d51eb522709143de0bfb06efdc79ebef.translatedText: Trump administration officials believe that the essence of this plan is to grant temporary protection to foreigners, not permanent protection, and therefore should not be used as a means for people to live in the United States long-term. Since the conditions that originally provided temporary protection to these foreign nationals no longer exist, this practice should have been discontinued long ago.

c6183deea543e4b03c2c34fdc60b54bea17b24a2.sourceText: 蒂勒森的做法体现了川普政府收紧移民政策的主张，包括要求减少移民人数和严格执行移民法，以改变前政府不完全执行移民法规的做法。
c6183deea543e4b03c2c34fdc60b54bea17b24a2.translatedText: > Tillerson's approach reflects the Trump administration's advocacy for tightening immigration policies, including calling for reducing the number of immigrants and strictly enforcing immigration laws, in order to change the previous government's incomplete implementation of immigration regulations.

4a1543b1bce0fe9ebfa935e4aa96adcf28d60595.sourceText: 一名不愿透露姓名的美国官员说：”应该说这届政府是在严格解读法律，而前政府却没有做到。”
4a1543b1bce0fe9ebfa935e4aa96adcf28d60595.translatedText: An unnamed US official said: "It should be said that this government is strictly interpreting the law, but the previous government did not do so."

860e85359433d01165ffdf7408ad9f3c406e15d0.sourceText: 这位官员也承认，对于涉及的这些外籍人士，他们的原籍国有许多仍存在贫困、腐败及暴乱的问题，但为应对这些问题，需要寻找其它途径。
860e85359433d01165ffdf7408ad9f3c406e15d0.translatedText: The official also admitted that for the foreigners involved, many of their countries of origin still have problems with poverty, corruption and violence, but to deal with these problems, other ways need to be found.

6ab47ed851e9fdd07239ed18ff5eaf9089221cd7.sourceText: 在这些人当中，许多人已经在美国置业、生子。如果他们的临时保护身份被取消，意味着他们将会被遣返。对此，这位官员表示：”这是一个很难做出的决定。”
6ab47ed851e9fdd07239ed18ff5eaf9089221cd7.translatedText: Among these people, many have already bought homes and had children in the United States. If their temporary protected status is revoked, they will be deported. In response, the official said: "This is a difficult decision to make."

193af847d05a134cbc69f3b1fba5b73d51de24d3.sourceText: 官员说：”这需要（美国政府）与国会及这些国家进行合作。我们会努力寻找新的解决方案，并不是缺乏同情心。然而针对”临时保护身份法”我们很清楚应该怎样做。”
193af847d05a134cbc69f3b1fba5b73d51de24d3.translatedText: The official said: "This requires (the U.S. government) to work with Congress and these countries. We will work hard to find new solutions, and it is not a lack of compassion. However, for" Temporary Protected Status "We know exactly what we should do."

e94ed6ff7eba94d19cf2ea6c3599774d7a932db1.sourceText: 也有美国官员表示，数以万计的中美洲人和海地人回到家乡后，将使当地国受益，因为这些公民将带着在美国获得的职业技能、民主的价值观和个人存款返回来。
e94ed6ff7eba94d19cf2ea6c3599774d7a932db1.translatedText: Some U.S. officials also said that tens of thousands of Central Americans and Haitians will benefit the local countries after returning to their hometowns, because these citizens will return with the professional skills, democratic values ​​and personal savings acquired in the United States.

8a16e77f1eb814923ad8c9a94497054a238a5d29.sourceText: 对于是否会对这些人延长临时保守身份，以及何时公布此决定，国土安全部尚未给予证实。
8a16e77f1eb814923ad8c9a94497054a238a5d29.translatedText: The Department of Homeland Security has not yet confirmed whether Temporary Conservative Status will be extended for these individuals and when this decision will be announced.

a0a86c45c95bbf5f19ec45ca276d40285784042e.sourceText: 在这些人中，大部分来自洪都拉斯，人数约20万，其中至少有3万人居住在华盛顿特区。国土安全部最迟将在明年1月初公布决定，是否为他们延长临时保守身份。
a0a86c45c95bbf5f19ec45ca276d40285784042e.translatedText: Most of these people are from Honduras, numbering about 200,000, and at least 30,000 of them live in Washington, DC. The Department of Homeland Security will announce a decision on whether to extend temporary conservative status for them by early January next year at the latest.

7010d54374c1a671e1225f504baa9f58d6369ebf.sourceText: 国土安全部还要在感恩节前做出决定，是否向5万名海地人延长这种身份。目前这些人大部分集中在佛州，他们在2010年海地遭遇地震后来到美国。这次地震造成20万人死亡。
7010d54374c1a671e1225f504baa9f58d6369ebf.translatedText: The Department of Homeland Security still has until Thanksgiving to decide whether to extend this status to 50,000 Haitians. Most of these people are currently concentrated in Florida. They came to the United States after the earthquake in Haiti in 2010. The earthquake killed 200,000 people.

153da5042bd9b7b1baec45ce86599042a1467cff.sourceText: 如果国土安全部终止这些人的临时保护身份，将给予他们6个月的宽限期，为最终离开美国做准备。
153da5042bd9b7b1baec45ce86599042a1467cff.translatedText: If the Department of Homeland Security terminates the temporary protected status of these individuals, they will be given a six-month grace period to prepare for their eventual departure from the United States.

2e2e51d92d2789b2d75a8fa425695f87e2770324.sourceText: 赞成严格执行移民法的人表示，能否继续给予海地人临时保护身份将测试川普政府，是否愿意严格按照美国移民法的文本来执法。
2e2e51d92d2789b2d75a8fa425695f87e2770324.translatedText: Those who favor strict enforcement of immigration laws say whether they can continue to grant temporary protected status to Haitians will test whether the Trump administration is willing to strictly follow the text of U.S. immigration laws.

d9e1fb9d5ba5b8dc54f8e2a57317f2509af7d007.sourceText: 一些移民法专家也表示，这些海地人如果被终止在美国的保护身份，还可以去加拿大，特别是说法语的魁北克省，申请难民身份，从而避免被逮捕或遣返。
d9e1fb9d5ba5b8dc54f8e2a57317f2509af7d007.translatedText: Some immigration law experts also said that if these Haitians are terminated from protected status in the United States, they can still go to Canada, especially the French-speaking province of Quebec, to apply for refugee status to avoid being arrested or deported.

c19294a93c0195f40daacd8bf48a3c145d4d5d93.sourceText: 关注 | 赌城血案枪手之父曾是FBI通缉要犯 一生恶贯满盈
c19294a93c0195f40daacd8bf48a3c145d4d5d93.translatedText: Attention | The father of the gunman who committed a massacre in the casino was once a wanted criminal by the FBI, and he has been full of evil in his life

6a1fe20cf34cb6f0f7b8befd7e769a160796753e.sourceText: 关注 | 赌城血案枪手之父曾是FBI通缉要犯 一生恶贯满盈 综合媒体报道独家编译：拉斯维加斯血案枪手的兄弟Er…
6a1fe20cf34cb6f0f7b8befd7e769a160796753e.translatedText: Attention | The father of a gunman who committed a murderous crime in the casino was once a wanted man by the FBI, and he has been full of evil in his life Exclusive compilation of comprehensive media reports: Er, the brother of the gunman in the Las Vegas massacre...

76b64c98f5b08f2b308c9a521882723df895caa3.sourceText: 综合媒体报道独家编译： 拉斯维加斯血案枪手的兄弟Eric透露称，他们的父亲就是曾在1969至1977年间被FBI列上十大头号通缉名单的，恶贯满盈的Benjamin Hoskins Paddock，人称Bingo Bruce。
76b64c98f5b08f2b308c9a521882723df895caa3.translatedText: Exclusive compilation of comprehensive media reports: Eric, the brother of the Las Vegas mass murderer, revealed that their father was Benjamin Hoskins Paddock, known as Bingo Bruce, who was on the FBI's ten most wanted lists from 1969 to 1977.

305e5aee2f5a3d53b283c7d9fba7050a917ec9b2.sourceText: 这名悍匪1926年生于美国威斯康星州。 曾使用”Big Daddy”和”Old Baldy”等一系列别名在亚利桑那州抢劫多家银行后，又从得克萨斯州逃狱到俄勒冈州，试图在那里隐姓埋名经营一家宾果游戏厅（bingo parlor ）。
305e5aee2f5a3d53b283c7d9fba7050a917ec9b2.translatedText: This gangster was born in Wisconsin, USA, in 1926. After using a series of aliases such as "Big Daddy" and "Old Baldy" to rob multiple banks in Arizona, he escaped from prison in Texas and went to Oregon, where he tried to run a bingo parlor incognito.

915b0645e1ff45c6273586620b6865215d112a2b.sourceText: 1960年，Bingo Bruce抢劫了亚利桑那州凤凰城的多家Valley National Bank支行。被控劫走近2.5万美元的他，在当年7月于拉斯维加斯被FBI逮捕。在FBI包围他时，他曾试图驾车冲撞FBI探员逃跑，导致FBI探员开枪，将其逼停。同年他被判处20年徒刑.
915b0645e1ff45c6273586620b6865215d112a2b.translatedText: In 1960, Bingo Bruce robbed multiple Valley National Bank branches in Phoenix, Arizona. He was accused of robbing nearly $25,000 and was arrested by the FBI in Las Vegas in July of that year. When the FBI surrounded him, he tried to drive into the FBI agents and escape, causing the FBI agents to fire and force him to stop. In the same year, he was sentenced to 20 years in prison.

cd0670b8b998d097d37ad25f3d748d30668f7c69.sourceText: 在FBI逮捕了涉嫌抢劫银行的Benjamin Hoskins Paddock后，前往他位于亚利桑那Tucson的家中搜索时，他的妻子带着Stephen，也就是本次拉斯维加斯血案制造者出门游泳，以免他知道自己父亲的双面人生后遭受心灵冲击。
cd0670b8b998d097d37ad25f3d748d30668f7c69.translatedText: After the FBI arrested Benjamin Hoskins Paddock on suspicion of bank robbery, when they went to search his home in Tucson, Arizona, his wife took Stephen, the perpetrator of the Las Vegas murder, out for a swim to prevent him from suffering the psychological shock of knowing his father's double life.

ba398349af0efbf946cb9aa8953f0a52e7bc111e.sourceText: 然而，1969年的平安夜，他从得州的联邦监狱成功逃狱。FBI在当时发出的追捕令中称他是被症断为心理变态的（psychopathic），有自杀倾向的（suicidal tendencies）危险武装逃犯。
ba398349af0efbf946cb9aa8953f0a52e7bc111e.translatedText: However, on Christmas Eve 1969, he successfully escaped from a federal prison in Texas. The FBI said in a arrest warrant issued at the time that he was a dangerous armed fugitive diagnosed with psychopathic and suicidal tendencies.

aef948afe0ec031e93445eba2b56bb3d76b5e1c7.sourceText: 在逃狱6个月后，Bingo Bruce又在旧金山抢劫了银行。此后，他长时间以Bruce Werner Ericksen的化名生活在俄勒冈的尤金地区一带，并避免与警察解除，暴露身份。其绰号Bingo Bruce就是来自这段经历。
aef948afe0ec031e93445eba2b56bb3d76b5e1c7.translatedText: Six months after escaping from prison, Bingo Bruce robbed a bank in San Francisco again. Since then, he has lived in the Eugene, Oregon, area for a long time under the pseudonym Bruce Werner Ericksen, and has avoided contacting the police and exposing his identity. His nickname Bingo Bruce came from this experience.

0b28fab3680532e55b4b9e13ecd57a5cf5a30f66.sourceText: 1978年9月，FBI终于在俄勒冈再次逮捕了Bingo Bruce。然而，1979年4月，他获得假释。
0b28fab3680532e55b4b9e13ecd57a5cf5a30f66.translatedText: In September 1978, the FBI finally arrested Bingo Bruce again in Oregon. However, in April 1979, he was paroled.

6fb9cfde1abc3b2b4e59e58e0222b1412fe30d95.sourceText: 1987年，俄勒冈州总检察长对他提出了7项敲诈勒索罪指控，以及一项调整汽车里程表读书的指控。最后，他强调自己身患癌症，并以支付62万3千美元罚金摆平案件。
6fb9cfde1abc3b2b4e59e58e0222b1412fe30d95.translatedText: In 1987, the Oregon Attorney General charged him with seven counts of racketeering and one count of adjusting car odometer readings. In the end, he emphasized that he had cancer and settled the case by paying a fine of $623,000.

0bace19026344bdb2f276ee77c9679a2df40f52a.sourceText: 后来，Benjamin Hoskins Paddock回到得州居住，并于1998年在得州逝世。
0bace19026344bdb2f276ee77c9679a2df40f52a.translatedText: Later, Benjamin Hoskins Paddock returned to Texas to live and died in Texas in 1998.

ecd69673084154a6d3febbcfe03326f910776159.sourceText: （北京9日综合电）一连8天的中国十一黄金周假期终于结束，中国国家旅游局数据中心公布最新数字，中国在十一及中秋假日期间，共接待国内游客7亿500万人次，旅游人次再创新高，旅游收入约5836亿元人民币（约3726亿令吉）。
ecd69673084154a6d3febbcfe03326f910776159.translatedText: (Beijing Comprehensive News on the 9th) The eight-day National Day Golden Week holiday in China has finally come to an end. The China National Tourism Administration Data Center released the latest figures. During the National Day and Mid-Autumn Festival holidays, China received a total of 705 million domestic tourists. The number of tourists hit a new high, and tourism revenue was approximately 583.6 billion yuan (approximately RM372.6 billion).

bb5a0092fa6f43e6e52756c6a939f87acfb18603.sourceText: 出境游客超过600万人次，但值得注意的是，被中国封锁的台湾及因萨德反导系统而关系闹僵的韩国，不入热门境外短线游前10名。
bb5a0092fa6f43e6e52756c6a939f87acfb18603.translatedText: There are more than 6 million outbound tourists, but it is worth noting that Taiwan, which is blocked by China, and South Korea, which has a stalemate due to the THAAD anti-missile system, are not among the top 10 popular overseas short-term tours.

e72b9ddf9f50b90ba821b8736e67a915f0c19cc4.sourceText: 国家旅游局数据中心统计，中国在8天假期共接待国内游客7亿500万人次，比去年接待的5亿9300万人次，多出约1亿1200万人，增幅11.9%，旅游收入约5836亿元人民币。随着高铁及高速公路网的完善，出行越来越方便，自驾游取代旅行团成旅行主流，快旅慢游成为新的旅游方式。
e72b9ddf9f50b90ba821b8736e67a915f0c19cc4.translatedText: According to statistics from the National Tourism Administration Data Center, China received a total of 705 million domestic tourists during the eight-day holiday, about 112 million more than the 593 million it received last year, an increase of 11.9%, and tourism revenue was about 583.6 billion yuan. With the improvement of high-speed rail and highway networks, travel has become more and more convenient. Self-driving tours have replaced tour groups as the mainstream of travel, and fast travel and slow travel have become a new way of travel.

6dcd1e796897ff488c52a3080f51458b2a7c9fe5.sourceText: 北京迎来返程最高峰，旅客在北京西站火车站出站后，准备乘地铁离开站区，候乘队伍蜿蜒超过300米。
6dcd1e796897ff488c52a3080f51458b2a7c9fe5.translatedText: Beijing is experiencing its peak return journey. After exiting the Beijing West Railway Station, passengers are preparing to take the subway to leave the station area. The waiting queue is more than 300 meters long.

95a52d5dbcbe0e9784c5796b004645270bf965b7.translatedText: >Travel to 88 countries Thailand, Japan and India are the most popular

7174c669ae2bd3cebde421803d65ae23a45dfa7b.sourceText: 出境游方面，旅行团游客比例持续下降，自助游客比例上升，中国国家旅游局出境团队游系统及网络大数据显示，十一及中秋假期出境游客数超过600万人次，其中旅行团游客64万1900人次，游客从近300个城市出发，前往全球88个国家及地区、1155个境外城市。
7174c669ae2bd3cebde421803d65ae23a45dfa7b.translatedText: In terms of outbound tourism, the proportion of tourists in tour groups continues to decline, while the proportion of self-guided tourists increases. The China National Tourism Administration's outbound group tour system and network big data show that the number of outbound tourists during the National Day and Mid-Autumn Festival holidays exceeded 6 million, including 641,900 group tourists. Tourists departed from nearly 300 cities and went to 88 countries and regions and 1,155 overseas cities around the world.

e1d6e6caf5854c9a1e00345c2f8f69d837de844c.sourceText: 途牛旅游网上周日发表报告指，十一黄金周期间，泰国、日本及印尼成最受中国客欢迎的短线游目的地前3位，遭封锁的台湾与韩国不在前十。长线游前3名为美国、加拿大、澳洲。购物方面，泰国、斯里兰卡、南非及香港，成为游客最愿意花钱购物的旅游目的地。
e1d6e6caf5854c9a1e00345c2f8f69d837de844c.translatedText: Tuniu Travel released a report on Sunday saying that during the National Day Golden Week, Thailand, Japan and Indonesia became the top three most popular short-term travel destinations for Chinese tourists, while Taiwan and South Korea, which are blocked, were not in the top ten. The top three long-term travel destinations are the United States, Canada, and Australia. In terms of shopping, Thailand, Sri Lanka, South Africa and Hong Kong have become the destinations where tourists are most willing to spend money on shopping.

6d27c58d9b05b37a722349dba3092b4e299e69e3.sourceText: 据商务部监测，10月1日至8日，全国零售及餐饮企业实现销售额约1兆5000亿元，日均销售额比去年十一黄金周增长10.3%。
6d27c58d9b05b37a722349dba3092b4e299e69e3.translatedText: According to monitoring by the Ministry of Commerce, from October 1st to 8th, retail and catering companies nationwide achieved sales of approximately 1.5 trillion yuan, with average daily sales increasing by 10.3% compared with last year’s National Day Golden Week.

70be5c822a81074245365dfa24c53d4c1e63a1e6.translatedText: Travel without your mobile phone 4G traffic soared during the long holiday

ec26a7fb21db212b8afbcfcb5ee0013ab780ffc9.sourceText: 中国民众生活已离不开手机，连观光时也?#26426;不离手?#12290;据中国移动浙江公司数据显示，今年十一长假期间，浙江全省的4G流量比去年增加1.17倍，西湖景区4G流量更较日常增长2.07倍。而民众在景点或行车途中，做得最多的竟是用手机上网看影片。
ec26a7fb21db212b8afbcfcb5ee0013ab780ffc9.translatedText: Chinese people cannot live without their mobile phones, even when sightseeing. According to data from China Mobile Zhejiang Company, during the National Day holiday this year, the 4G traffic in Zhejiang Province increased 1.17 times compared with last year, and the 4G traffic in the West Lake Scenic Area increased 2.07 times compared with daily levels. What people do most when visiting scenic spots or while driving is actually watching videos online on their mobile phones.

a415137649e46e04a5c491fcba12f6563ac2109b.sourceText: 中国移动职员表示，为做好十一期间的通讯保障，公司已提前两个月启动应急保障方案，加大西湖景区、火车站、商业中心等热点的基站容量，令峰值容量最高提升5倍，单用户的下载速率更超过180Mbps。
a415137649e46e04a5c491fcba12f6563ac2109b.translatedText: China Mobile staff said that in order to ensure communication guarantee during the National Day period, the company has launched an emergency support plan two months in advance to increase the capacity of base stations in hot spots such as the West Lake Scenic Area, train stations, and commercial centers, increasing the peak capacity by up to 5 times, and the download rate for a single user has exceeded 180Mbps.

02e2c0fa1da7d5649598cf0bbe22ee0492705317.sourceText: 陕西西安游客孙琳表示，在杭州旅游，衣食住行大多用手机支付，4天内只花了逾100元人民币现金。江苏游客吴凯则指，坐车时用手机看新闻、刷朋友圈，到景区就忙着上传照片，空闲就用手机看影片或玩游戏。
02e2c0fa1da7d5649598cf0bbe22ee0492705317.translatedText: Sun Lin, a tourist from Xi'an, Shaanxi Province, said that when traveling in Hangzhou, she mostly used mobile phones to pay for food, clothing, housing and transportation, and she only spent more than 100 yuan in cash in four days. Wu Kai, a tourist from Jiangsu Province, said that he used his mobile phone to read news and check Moments when he was in the car. When he went to scenic spots, he was busy uploading photos. When he had free time, he used his mobile phone to watch videos or play games.

f9cccd364f7344ac89d7c2957a3e324bb0fe2727.translatedText: On August 16, Phoenix Mayor Greg Stanton made it clear that he and his staff strongly support keeping the Phoenix Chinese Cultural Center in situ, in its original location, and that he will contact the new owner of the Chinese Cultural Center to try to achieve a win-win situation.

5061c918d0eca647701f75b58141535096f700e1.sourceText: 会谈现场 坐在市长对面的资深侨领余文劲意味深长地说：您是凤凰城的市长，可我是中国人的市长，您懂了吗！市长马上回答：我懂了！
5061c918d0eca647701f75b58141535096f700e1.translatedText: Meeting scene Yu Wenjin, a senior overseas Chinese leader sitting opposite the mayor, said meaningfully: You are the mayor of Phoenix, but I am the mayor of the Chinese people. Do you understand? The mayor immediately replied: I understand!

8085eda0bdc0efcd6a2414afed57a8715e948c02.translatedText: Phoenix City Mayor Greg Stanton used the lunch time to communicate with Mr. Yu Wenjin, a senior overseas Chinese leader of the Save the Chinese Cultural Center Organizing Committee, and nine other representatives on the protection of the Chinese Cultural Center. The representative of

762fc4de653cc176c632266d9f16a5483d441706.sourceText: 代表用一个专业的PPT介绍了凤凰城中国文化中心在全美中国城中的独特地位，作为全美第五大城市，我们非常幸运拥有这样一份馈赠。超过半个世纪的加工打磨的原材料，远渡重洋，来到这里，数百位能工巧匠，利用上千年历史的技术，将这样一个艺术品镶嵌在凤凰城的土地上。每个景观的设计，以及安放位置都有故事，也都有讲究。这里已成为世界各地游客来凤凰城旅行的景点之一。来访凤凰城的朋友，在飞机上看到这个标志性建筑。数十张历史照片，展示了当地孩子，刚刚结婚的年轻人，迟暮的老人对中国文化中心的喜爱。它是凤凰城青少年学习中文，中国文化教育的基地。是年轻人结婚摄影的景地，更是老人散步，健身的好去处。
762fc4de653cc176c632266d9f16a5483d441706.translatedText: used a professional PPT to introduce the unique position of the Phoenix Chinese Cultural Center among Chinatowns in the United States. As the fifth largest city in the United States, we are very lucky to have such a gift. The raw materials that have been processed and polished for more than half a century have traveled across the ocean to come here. Hundreds of skilled craftsmen have used thousands of years of technology to inlay such a work of art on the land of Phoenix. The design and placement of each landscape have stories and details. It has become one of the attractions for tourists from all over the world to visit Phoenix. Friends visiting Phoenix saw this iconic building on the plane. Dozens of historical photos show the love of local children, newly married young people, and twilight old people for the Chinese Cultural Center. It is a base for Phoenix youth to learn Chinese and Chinese cultural education. It is a popular place for young people to take wedding photos, and it is also a good place for old people to take a walk and exercise.

9d0d84bf81098884fee0a1c2a5afd25f983b81c3.sourceText: 更让市长动容的是短短时间内，超过5000多人的联署信和许许多多发至肺腑的保留中国文化中心的留言。市长马上意识到这个建筑牵动着千千万万凤凰城市民的心。他更看到8月13日冒着酷暑，两百五十多市民代表的请愿决心。我们告诉市长，上次请愿我们花了不到24小时进行准备，这是凤凰城的中国历史文化遗产，是我们的根，所有热爱中国文化的朋友会像保护生命一样保护中国文化中心。现在已经不是五千人支持我们，越来越多的签名是通过手把手的传递，是每个家庭，每个爸爸妈妈在单位让朋友，同事手签联名信，孩子带到学校让老师和同学们一起联名支持！无数志愿者，晚上输入签名到凌晨…..大家才看到我们的签名数字在不断攀升。在凤凰城历史上，我们从来没有这么大声的表达过我们的诉求，我们也从来没有这么认真过！
9d0d84bf81098884fee0a1c2a5afd25f983b81c3.translatedText: What moved the mayor even more was that in a short period of time, more than 5,000 people signed a letter and many heartfelt messages about preserving the Chinese Cultural Center. The mayor immediately realized that this building touched the hearts of thousands of Phoenix citizens. He also saw the determination of more than 250 citizen representatives to petition despite the scorching heat on August 13. We told the mayor that we spent less than 24 hours preparing the last petition. This is the Chinese historical and cultural heritage of Phoenix and our roots. All friends who love Chinese culture will protect the Chinese Cultural Center as much as they protect life. Now there are no more 5,000 people supporting us. More and more signatures are passed on hand by hand. Every family, every father and mother ask friends and colleagues to sign a joint letter at work, and the children bring it to school for teachers and classmates to sign a joint letter to support! Countless volunteers entered the signatures at night until early in the morning... Only then did everyone see that the number of our signatures continued to rise. In the history of Phoenix, we have never expressed our demands so loudly, and we have never been so serious!

d1cdebfa682603c8ae2ba9c0f2e73715ba451a66.sourceText: 中国文化中心的新主人已经开始刷掉了大柱子上的中国红！今天我们要为我们的孩子，我们的子子孙孙呐喊！原地，原址，原样保持凤凰城中国文化中心！8月20日，下午4：45分，凤凰城保护中国文化中心集结号全面吹响！更大规模的请愿活动，将在中国文化中心举行，继续对业主施加压力,让媒体知道我们坚持保护文化中心的决心，带上家人，朋友，所有热爱凤凰城的朋友，我们不见不散！
d1cdebfa682603c8ae2ba9c0f2e73715ba451a66.translatedText: The new owner of the Chinese Cultural Center has begun to brush off the Chinese red on the big pillars! Today we want to shout for our children, our children and grandchildren! Keep the Phoenix Chinese Cultural Center in the same place, in the same place, as it is! On August 20, at 4:45 pm, the rally call to protect the Chinese Cultural Center in Phoenix was sounded! A larger petition will be held at the Chinese Cultural Center to continue to put pressure on the owners and let the media know our determination to protect the cultural center. Bring your family, friends, and all the friends who love Phoenix, and we will see you there!

e24ab45c02215cad3129a6a12bcea5c22b627270.sourceText: 由全美中文学校协会凤凰城联络中心主办，亚省现代中文学校，希望中文学校承办的2017亚利桑那中文教师培训于8月12日在ASU ART Building隆重举行。
e24ab45c02215cad3129a6a12bcea5c22b627270.translatedText: The 2017 Arizona Chinese Teacher Training, hosted by the Phoenix Contact Center of the National Association of Chinese Schools and hosted by the Alberta Modern Chinese School and Hope Chinese School, was grandly held on August 12 at the ASU ART Building.

06e97c91931c71791daff89fd8e8b1b7ab342201.sourceText: 来自亚省现代中文学校，希望中文学校，凤凰城中文学校，祖筍中文学校，大凤凰地区基督教会中文学校等多所中文学校的教师集聚一堂，会场隆重热烈，洋溢着奋战在教学一线的老师们的高涨的学习热情，体现出一派海外华文教育生生不息，蒸蒸日上的大好前景。
06e97c91931c71791daff89fd8e8b1b7ab342201.translatedText: >Teachers from many Chinese schools such as Alberta Modern Chinese School, Hope Chinese School, Phoenix Chinese School, Zusun Chinese School, Greater Phoenix Area Christian Chinese School, etc. gathered together. The venue was solemn and warm, filled with the high learning enthusiasm of teachers who are working on the front line of teaching, reflecting the great prospects of overseas Chinese education that continues to flourish and thrive.

e226f7fb247c29ab313dac456bacd6210fd953d4.sourceText: 演讲开始前，由前全美中文学校协会会长，现任全美中文学校协会基金会会长的帅致若女士介绍了各中文学校的校长，董事长：现代中文学校校长王玉兰，希望中文学校校长田琳，董事长李健，凤凰城基督教会中文学校校长彭新立，祖筍中文学校校长曹佩琴，凤凰城中文学校校长程秀玲等。
e226f7fb247c29ab313dac456bacd6210fd953d4.translatedText: Before the speech began, Ms. Shuai Zhiruo, former president of the National Association of Chinese Schools and current president of the National Association of Chinese Schools Foundation, introduced the principals of each Chinese school. Chairman: Wang Yulan, principal of Modern Chinese School, Tian Lin, principal of Hope Chinese School, chairman Li Jian, Peng Xinli, principal of Phoenix Christian Church Chinese School, Cao Peiqin, principal of Zusun Chinese School, Cheng Xiuling, principal of Phoenix Chinese School, etc.

bbfe73b8a7bfabe113808a732526dbbddfae3e20.sourceText: 帅致若老师特别表彰了现代中文学校和希望中文学校为本次教师培训所做的大量组织准备工作。两校的领导们为本次活动投入了大量的精力，事无巨细，凝心聚力，保证了今天活动的顺利进行。老师们为这些辛苦工作的校领导义工们热烈鼓掌，感谢他们给大家一个难得的学习机会和周到的服务。
bbfe73b8a7bfabe113808a732526dbbddfae3e20.translatedText: Teacher Shuai Zhiruo especially commended Modern Chinese School and Hope Chinese School for their extensive organizational preparations for this teacher training. The leaders of the two schools devoted a lot of energy to this event, worked hard and worked together to ensure the smooth progress of today's event. The teachers warmly applauded these hard-working school leadership volunteers and thanked them for giving everyone a rare learning opportunity and thoughtful service.

f1e090beb1276f13bc3de46247307d79731f6308.sourceText: 本次教师培训以往不同的是首次由本地的中文老师主讲，非常接地气的根据当地老师的需求，教学的具体问题和我们本地的学生状况有的放矢的给各个中文学校的老师生动有效，受益匪浅的学习交流机会。
f1e090beb1276f13bc3de46247307d79731f6308.translatedText: This teacher training is different from the past in that it is delivered by a local Chinese teacher for the first time. It is very down-to-earth and based on the needs of local teachers, specific teaching issues and the situation of our local students, giving teachers of various Chinese schools a lively, effective and beneficial learning and exchange opportunity.

06330820ac1825a55aaf0b9b41b4b0e54e47c03a.sourceText: 第一位主讲老师是曾多年在现代和希望等中文学校任教，现任ASU中文领航项目讲师的朱婕（Jie Zhu）老师.
06330820ac1825a55aaf0b9b41b4b0e54e47c03a.translatedText: The first lecturer is Mr. Jie Zhu, who has taught in Chinese schools such as Modern and Hope for many years and is currently a lecturer in the ASU Chinese Navigation Program.

3f353db03521a2e13c509ad37ac0c8c1e2529409.sourceText: 专业的教师资质和资深的教师生涯朱老师抓住了一个非常扣人心弦的演讲题目，《教什么，怎么教》，这是我们每一位华文老师始终思考和不断探讨的一个问题。
3f353db03521a2e13c509ad37ac0c8c1e2529409.translatedText: Professional teacher qualifications and experienced teaching career. Mr. Zhu captured a very exciting speech topic, "What to teach and how to teach", which is a question that every Chinese teacher of ours has always thought about and constantly discussed.

68ec8b2624093e635e69ac72b2fe3131a69d3a65.sourceText: 朱老师首先告诉老师们要了解学生的来源，家庭的中文背景，学生的接受程度。老师备课需要缜密的思考和充分的准备，运用学生感兴趣的方式进行教学。多年的教学经验使朱老师能够用老师们熟悉的教材中的课文举例（比如很多老师都教过的”机器人f”一课），使老师们更亲切更具体的领会和学习朱老师的教学方法。介绍了很多生动有趣的教学方法，课堂管理，多媒体运用等等。她的演讲绘声绘色，妙语连珠，引人入胜，会场不时爆发热烈的掌声。
68ec8b2624093e635e69ac72b2fe3131a69d3a65.translatedText: > Teacher Zhu first told the teachers to understand the students’ origins, their family’s Chinese background, and their acceptance level. Teachers need to prepare lessons carefully and fully prepared, and teach in a way that interests students. Years of teaching experience enable Teacher Zhu to use text examples from textbooks that teachers are familiar with (such as the "Robot F" lesson that many teachers have taught), allowing teachers to understand and learn Teacher Zhu's teaching methods more intimately and concretely. Many lively and interesting teaching methods, classroom management, multimedia applications, etc. are introduced. Her speech was vivid, witty and fascinating, and the venue burst into warm applause from time to time.

ccf453e3381dea3f16272de8700b0197b5d9fb2b.sourceText: 第二位演讲老师是何舟洲（zhou zhou He）老师，何老师同时任教于basis和希望中文学校。职业教师的何老师敬业精神是我们榜样，她把对教育事业的热爱全身心投入到了教学工作中，大量的探索和实践使她这次为我们讲述了目前高科技社会老师最想了解和掌握的现代化教学手段，题目是：《中文课堂中的技术运用》。何老师用一幅生动的21世纪课堂的设置图讲述了技术运用在中文课堂的必要性，详细的讲述和演示了Quizlet, seesaw, edpuzzle, Classdojo. Plicker,等等技术的课堂运用和效果，并现场播放了运用这些技术手段的何老师自己制作的教学材料，大家耳目一新，豁然开朗，原来学生们最感兴趣的无处不在的手机等可以用来帮助他们学习中文，大大激发了孩子们的学习热情和积极性。何老师还当场推荐了她自己实践应用的一些网站给老师们。我们看到科学的发展，现代化的工具对中文教育有巨大的力量推动和提高我们的中文教育事业。
ccf453e3381dea3f16272de8700b0197b5d9fb2b.translatedText: The second speech teacher is Mr. Zhou zhou He. Mr. He also teaches at Basis and Hope Chinese School. Teacher He, a professional teacher, is our role model for her professionalism. She has devoted her love for education to teaching work. A lot of exploration and practice have enabled her to tell us about the modern teaching methods that teachers in the current high-tech society most want to understand and master. The title is: "Technology Application in Chinese Classroom". Teacher He used a vivid 21st century classroom setting diagram to describe the necessity of using technology in Chinese classes, describing and demonstrating Quizlet, seesaw, edpuzzle, and Classdojo in detail. The classroom application and effects of Plicker, and other technologies, and the teaching materials produced by Teacher He who used these technologies were played live. Everyone was refreshed and suddenly realized that the ubiquitous mobile phones that students are most interested in can be used to help them learn Chinese, which greatly stimulated the children's enthusiasm and enthusiasm for learning. Teacher He also recommended some websites that she has used in practice to the teachers on the spot. We see that the development of science and modern tools have great power to promote and improve our Chinese education.

a0acb234c9c5cb6273c235315d75b0afffdbad66.sourceText: 最后一位上台演讲的是现代中文学校的唐南筠（Nanyun Tang）老师。唐老师多年执教中文AP班。作为高年级的中文老师，唐老师结合自己多年的教学经验讲述了《语言和文化的结合教学》。
a0acb234c9c5cb6273c235315d75b0afffdbad66.translatedText: The last person to give a speech was Nanyun Tang, a teacher from Modern Chinese School. Teacher Tang has taught Chinese AP classes for many years. As a senior Chinese teacher, Teacher Tang combined his many years of teaching experience to talk about "Integrated Teaching of Language and Culture".

68269c4d9cea8ae520015a88d1bbbdf0d3eb2cdb.sourceText: 首先唐老师提出什么是文化的抽象和具体定义，然后从方言，汉字的演变等不同角度，讲述教学中怎样使学生更多的了解历史悠久，博大精深的中华文化。唐老师演示了为辅助教学自己制作的具有代表性的中国文化教学图片，生动，直观，有趣。例如：中国的饮食文化和为结合课文所展示的抗日战争等历史图片等。在针对高年级学生的教学中不断从中华文化的发展，历史演变，逐渐拥有灿烂文化的中国带着丰富多彩的文化元素屹立在世界的东方这样的民族文化教育。为学生们的AP考试打下坚实的基础，使学生树立了学好中文，考出AP优异成绩的坚定信心。
68269c4d9cea8ae520015a88d1bbbdf0d3eb2cdb.translatedText: First, Teacher Tang proposed the abstract and specific definitions of culture, and then from different perspectives such as dialects and the evolution of Chinese characters, he described how to help students learn more about the long-standing, extensive and profound Chinese culture in teaching. Teacher Tang demonstrated the representative Chinese culture teaching pictures that he made to assist teaching, which were vivid, intuitive and interesting. For example: Chinese food culture and historical pictures such as the Anti-Japanese War displayed to combine with the text. In the teaching for senior students, we continue to learn from the development and historical evolution of Chinese culture, and gradually have a splendid culture. China stands in the east of the world with rich and colorful cultural elements and national cultural education. It lays a solid foundation for students to take the AP exam, allowing students to establish firm confidence in learning Chinese well and getting excellent results in the AP exam.

35a1f3ac5c43d068a59d2ca677eae3c8ea56b243.sourceText: 三位老师的演讲都深深震撼了在场的每位老师，作为播种知识，播种希望的老师，作为传播中华文化的使者，老师们深知责任的重大，使命的崇高，老师们不断学习，不断的探索，只有一个共同的目的，教好中文，不辜负自己的使命和学生的信任，为中华文化的传承，发扬光大贡献力量。
35a1f3ac5c43d068a59d2ca677eae3c8ea56b243.translatedText: The speeches of the three teachers deeply shocked every teacher present. As teachers who sow knowledge and hope, and as messengers to spread Chinese culture, the teachers are well aware of the great responsibility and the lofty mission. The teachers continue to learn and explore, with only one common purpose, to teach Chinese well, live up to their mission and the trust of students, and contribute to the inheritance and promotion of Chinese culture.

a7050eae20e50904e44862cf3f972a74439b771c.sourceText: 几个小时的会议很快过去了，晚上7点了，租用会场的时间已到，老师们只能依依不舍的一路讨论着离去，这样的讲座太受益了，感谢主办方和承办的学校给大家的学习机会，期待着下次。
a7050eae20e50904e44862cf3f972a74439b771c.translatedText: Several hours of the meeting passed quickly. It was 7 o'clock in the evening. The time to rent the venue had come. The teachers could only reluctantly discuss and leave. This kind of lecture was so beneficial. I would like to thank the organizer and the host school for giving everyone the learning opportunity. I look forward to the next time.

aa49fc933d4ec64b9142a6d12c5cb89da6baf7c5.sourceText: （图片来自微信朋友圈） 挽救凤凰城中国文化中心组委会发来最新消息，True North要求换瓦的改建申请没有通过！10月4日议会大厅内外数百市民上街游行向议员表达心声，功不可没！市民要求原地，原址，原样保护中国文化中心，请市政府遵循二十年前自己的承诺。
aa49fc933d4ec64b9142a6d12c5cb89da6baf7c5.translatedText: (Picture from WeChat Moments) Save the latest news from the Phoenix Chinese Cultural Center Organizing Committee, True North’s application for tile replacement was not approved! On October 4, hundreds of citizens inside and outside the parliament hall took to the streets to express their voices to the MPs. Their contribution is indispensable! Citizens demand that the Chinese Cultural Center be protected in its original location, as it is, and the city government should abide by its promise made twenty years ago.

210d28ae7687f8c50417cf380a84e70d03d1d46a.sourceText: 10月4日凤凰城市议员列席会议上，华人代表张传东质问市议员9月12日将大凤凰城华人侨团联合总会（侨联）的请求放在一边，给了一个什么都不能保护的调查意见。是一个什么政治力量在市政府内部周旋，差一点将中国文化中心毁于一旦。另一位代表杨萍更是有理有据的将城市发展规划部门在保护中国文化中心拖延，偏袒的行为一一举证。将二十年前错误的规划图纸，拿给我们的代表，被发现错误后，拿出高达一英尺的材料，让我们的代表自己查找。轻易就发放护栏的许可证。True North 护栏违建直接影响到市民生活，以及中国文化中心现有商户的经营，被民众以及经营者多次投诉，城市发展规划部门才要求True North 改建围栏。城市发展规划部门不仔细研究中心建设时期的规划图和政府承诺，在面对True North 要求改建房顶的许可面前，还唯唯诺诺，犹豫不决。听了两位代表举出的各个实力，现场的一个美国朋友当场起身，质问市长，你们到底收了True North 多少钱，要拆除中国文化中心凰城这么好的建筑，全场掌声雷鸣。
210d28ae7687f8c50417cf380a84e70d03d1d46a.translatedText: At a meeting attended by Phoenix city councilors on October 4, Chinese representative Zhang Chuandong questioned the city councilor for putting aside the request of the Greater Phoenix Chinese Overseas Chinese League (Overseas Chinese Federation) on September 12 and giving an investigation opinion that could not protect anything. Some political force was circling within the city government and almost destroyed the Chinese Cultural Center. Another representative, Yang Ping, even justified the urban development planning department’s delay and partiality in protecting the Chinese Cultural Center. We gave our representatives erroneous planning drawings from twenty years ago. When the errors were discovered, we took out a foot of material and asked our representatives to look for it themselves. Permits for guardrails are easily issued. The illegal construction of guardrails in True North directly affected the lives of citizens and the operations of existing merchants in the Chinese Cultural Center. After many complaints from the public and operators, the urban development planning department required True North to rebuild the fences. The urban development planning department did not carefully study the planning drawings and government commitments during the construction period of the center, and was still hesitant when faced with True North's request for permission to remodel the roof. After listening to the various strengths cited by the two representatives, an American friend at the scene stood up on the spot and asked the mayor, how much did you charge True North to demolish such a good building as the Chinese Cultural Center in Phoenix? The audience burst into applause.

2d4873877701bbbffb783c127b435df1441417eb.sourceText: 13岁小朋友陈宜博告诉大家中国文化中心对于一个美国出身的孩子有多么重要，多元文化的保护对亚利桑那州和凤凰城有多么重要。到目前为止，已经有壹万陆仟多人在网络上联署签名，要求原地，原址，原样保护中国文化中心，这是凤凰城市民的心声。
2d4873877701bbbffb783c127b435df1441417eb.translatedText: 13-year-old Chen Yibo told everyone how important the Chinese Cultural Center is to a child born in the United States, and how important the protection of multiculturalism is to Arizona and Phoenix. So far, more than 16,000 people have signed on the Internet, demanding that the Chinese Cultural Center be protected in its original location. This is the voice of the citizens of Phoenix City.

09a5d2cebe97dd13b0540c7066aab431d41bab60.sourceText: 市议会里保护中国文化中心的要求如火如荼。市政大厅外，小到几个月的小婴儿，老到近90岁的老人冒着100度的高温，走上街头。前后近千人高喊政府议员请听民众心声，遵守你们的承诺，保护中国文化中心，保护亚利桑那的历史手举抗议标牌,路过议会大厅的车辆常常打开车窗，竖起大拇指，和游行队伍互相呼应。保护文化中心的T恤在现场热卖，众多储备，所剩无几。华人车行还给大家送来了清凉的水。英文口号在议会大厅响起将近两个小时，忽然人群中传出了一个中文的口号：”保护中国城”精英会的老年朋友们分别用中文，广东话高喊：”保护中国城”响起热烈的回应，让议员，普通百姓都听到市民的心愿。
09a5d2cebe97dd13b0540c7066aab431d41bab60.translatedText: The demand to protect the Chinese Cultural Center is in full swing in the city council. Outside the city hall, people as young as a few months old and as old as nearly 90 years old braved the 100-degree heat and took to the streets. Nearly a thousand people chanted, "Members of the government, please listen to the people, abide by your commitments, protect the Chinese Cultural Center, and protect Arizona's history." They held protest signs. Vehicles passing by the Congress hall often opened their windows and gave thumbs up, echoing the marchers. The T-shirts of the Preservation Cultural Center were sold at the scene, and there were many reserves but very few were left. The Chinese car dealership also brought cool water to everyone. English slogans rang in the parliament hall for nearly two hours. Suddenly, a Chinese slogan came out from the crowd: "Protect Chinatown." Elderly friends of the elite association shouted in Chinese and Cantonese respectively: "Protect Chinatown." There was an enthusiastic response, allowing members and ordinary people to hear the wishes of the citizens.

5791b508d3e113cdb36e570596da024c0876c80b.translatedText: Some of the marchers took a group photo

f23d139c4f3cc5aa585103e9b9656a082e084eac.sourceText: 据最新消息欣欣超市也把中国文化中心新主人True North 以及他的公关公司告上法庭。这是继大凤凰城华人侨团提出保护中国文化中心之后，摊上的第三起官司，前面两个分别是中国文化中心主人，餐馆老四川状告新的业主。第二个官司是亚省华人信仰维权基金会。面对经济文化政治宗教信仰各方面带来的压力，在昨天游行之前，中国文化中心新主人True North 已经放话出售中国文化中心，并发新闻稿，提出购买要求。第一要有两千万的资金储备，第二要有一百万的不返还押金放到title公司，第三交易要在11月1日之前完成。目前对于侨联出的书面购买合同，直接拒绝了。据两个多月来与新业主的接触，他们在新闻稿件中的种种承诺大都没有兑现，或者是直接撒谎。据True North介绍将要进驻中国文化中心的两个公司将会是Pump It Up (480) 940-7867和 Realty Executives (602) 957-0444，希望大家发邮件，打电话告诉他们，不要成为帮凶，与毁坏历史而文化者为伍，生意是不会兴荣的，更不会获得市民的认可。
f23d139c4f3cc5aa585103e9b9656a082e084eac.translatedText: According to the latest news, Xinxin Supermarket has also taken the new owner of the Chinese Cultural Center, True North, and his public relations company to court. This is the third lawsuit filed after the Greater Phoenix Chinese Overseas Chinese Association proposed to protect the Chinese Cultural Center. The first two were the owners of the Chinese Cultural Center and the restaurant Lao Sichuan sued the new owners. The second lawsuit is against the Alberta Chinese Faith Rights Defense Foundation. Faced with pressure from all aspects of economic, cultural, political and religious beliefs, before yesterday's parade, the new owner of the Chinese Cultural Center, True North, had announced that the Chinese Cultural Center was for sale and issued a press release requesting the purchase. First, there must be a capital reserve of 20 million, secondly, a non-refundable deposit of 1 million must be placed in the title company, and thirdly, the transaction must be completed before November 1. At present, the written purchase contract issued by the Overseas Chinese Federation has been directly rejected. According to more than two months of contact with the new owners, most of the promises they made in press releases have not been fulfilled, or they have outright lied. According to True North, the two companies that will be stationed in the Chinese Cultural Center will be Pump It Up (480) 940-7867 and Realty Executives (602) 957-0444. I hope everyone will send emails and call them to tell them not to be an accomplice and to associate with those who destroy history and culture. Business will not prosper, let alone gain recognition from the public.

87640ae45ee4ffaa10074098af0263c7852974ae.sourceText: 亚利桑那现代中文学校2017—2018教师会 现代中文学校 吕丽华 报道 当毕业典礼的帷幕刚刚落下，中文学校的同学们满载收获准备暑假放松愉快的休整一下的时候，我们的老师们还在为下学年准备着。5月21日，周日，亚省现代中文学校召开了教师会。 会议开始由前任董事长Jim Xi发表热情洋溢的讲话，他感谢老师们辛苦的工作，感谢大家对董事会工作的支持，感谢校董事会和校委会的通力合作。最后隆重介绍新董事长陶世诚。接着新董事长陶世诚满怀信心的说：多年前曾任学校校长，董事长，但那时只有200多学生，现在的学校绝不可同日而语，现在的规模和工作量只能说明肩上的担子更重了。陶世诚董事长表示，感谢学校的信任，接过接力棒，带领董事会做好学校的管理工作，全力配合校委会，使学校越办越好，更上一层楼。 在一片热烈的掌声中，王玉兰校长高兴的宣布，今年是学校有史以来校委会原班人马继续连任，校长和几位副校长在新学年继续为学校服务，奉献。老师们为他们的精神所感动，备受激励。王玉兰校长就学校的各项管理制度，学校的宏伟计划等做了详细的阐述和说明，学校选用的教材今后做了较大改革，班级的设置也做了相应的调整，学校来年组织的重要活动和提高教师队伍素质的培训，明确和规范了教师的教学管理和奖惩制度，以更加完善的制度来保证教学等各项工作的顺利进行, 以更加饱满的激情，更加务实的作风，推进学校内涵发展，提高办学品味，打造学校办学特色。 经学校反复研究，听取各方面意见，下学年学校改革了班级设置和教材的选用，教学副校长田韶微宣布和讲述了具体的方案：课程设置重点把中国文化融进教材当中，中文幼儿班，一年级，二年级选用王双双教材；同时开设拼音班，一年级和二年级暨南班；三年级，四年级，五年级, 六年级 和七年级继续开设马立平和暨南两个教材。高年级的课程设置和教材的选用充分考虑到了学生的AP考试，早些为AP班打下基础。 教材的改革必然给老师的备课增加了更大的工作量，教学副校长田韶微兴奋的告诉大家，他们跟每位需要重新备课的老师都谈了话，没有一位老师抱怨和拒绝承担繁重的新任务。校领导倍受感动，高度赞扬老师们不辞辛苦，兢兢业业，用自己的辛勤耕耘播种桃李，奋战在教学一线，为中文教育做出了巨大贡献。 田韶微副校长还布置了亲子阅读，和校内外的知识竞赛及其它的教学活动。 随后老师们分组讨论，学习，交流。老师们做好了充分的准备迎接新学年的到来。大家知道新一年孕育着新的希望，我们会满怀信心迎接挑战，满腔热情投入工作，进一步增强责任感和使命感，为学校的蓬勃发展而努力，为学生学习中文做出贡献。
87640ae45ee4ffaa10074098af0263c7852974ae.translatedText: Arizona Modern Chinese School 2017-2018 Teachers' Association Modern Chinese School Lu Lihua reported When the curtain of the graduation ceremony has just come down, and the students of the Chinese school have gained a lot and are preparing to take a relaxing and happy break during the summer vacation, our teachers are still preparing for the next school year. On Sunday, May 21st, the Alberta Modern Chinese School held a teachers’ meeting. The meeting began with former chairman Jim Xi delivering a passionate speech. He thanked the teachers for their hard work, everyone's support for the work of the board of directors, and the school board and school committee for their full cooperation. Finally, the new chairman Tao Shicheng was introduced. Then the new chairman Tao Shicheng said with confidence: He was the principal and chairman of the school many years ago, but there were only more than 200 students at that time. The current school is definitely not the same. The current scale and workload can only show that the burden on the shoulders is heavier. Chairman Tao Shicheng expressed his gratitude to the school for its trust, taking over the baton, leading the board of directors to do a good job in the management of the school, and fully cooperating with the school committee to make the school better and better and reach a higher level. Amidst warm applause, Principal Wang Yulan happily announced that this year is the first time in the history of the school that the original members of the school committee have been re-elected. The principal and several vice-principals will continue to serve and contribute to the school in the new school year. The teachers were moved and inspired by their spirit. Principal Wang Yulan elaborated and explained the school's various management systems and the school's grand plan. The teaching materials selected by the school have undergone major reforms in the future, and the class settings have also been adjusted accordingly. The important activities organized by the school in the coming year and the training to improve the quality of the teaching team have clarified and standardized the teaching management and reward and punishment systems of teachers, with a more complete system to ensure the smooth progress of teaching and other work. With fuller passion and a more pragmatic style, we will promote the connotation development of the school, improve the taste of running schools, and create the characteristics of running schools. After repeated studies and listening to opinions from all sides, the school has reformed the class setting and the selection of teaching materials for the next school year. Vice Principal of Teaching Tian Shaowei announced and described the specific plan: the curriculum focuses on integrating Chinese culture into the teaching materials. The Chinese kindergarten class, first grade, and second grade will use Wang Shuangshuang's teaching material; pinyin classes will be opened at the same time, first and second grade Jinan classes; third, fourth, fifth, sixth and seventh grades will continue to use Ma Liping and Jinan teaching materials. The curriculum and teaching materials for the upper grades fully take into account students' AP exams and lay the foundation for AP classes early. The reform of teaching materials will inevitably increase the workload of teachers in preparing lessons. Vice Principal of Teaching Tian Shaowei excitedly told everyone that they have talked with every teacher who needs to prepare lessons again, and no teacher has complained or refused to take on the heavy new tasks. The school leaders were deeply moved and highly praised the teachers for their hard work and dedication, sowing the seeds with their hard work, fighting on the front line of teaching, and making great contributions to Chinese education. Vice Principal Tian Shaowei also arranged parent-child reading, knowledge competitions inside and outside the school and other teaching activities. Then the teachers divided into groups to discuss, learn and communicate. Teachers are fully prepared for the new school year. Everyone knows that the new year breeds new hope. We will meet the challenges with confidence, devote ourselves to work with enthusiasm, further enhance our sense of responsibility and mission, work hard for the vigorous development of the school, and contribute to students' Chinese learning.

7aa692d2eda605bd7705cca558cedee5e53416c0.sourceText: 凤凰城 张肇鸿 The earliest statements made by Arizona’s Chinese-American found. 这是目前能找到的亚省华人先民最早带有相片的一份文件, 时间是1894年5月3日。由俄勒冈州波特兰市税收员亨利 布拉赫曼，向住在亚利桑那州菲尼斯(凤凰城) 居民邝升（Sing Kewong）开具的日后可以返回美国的权利证书–编号＃127865，此文件的功能也就是相当于现在的「回美证」。这张名为「声明」的英文原文如下：
7aa692d2eda605bd7705cca558cedee5e53416c0.translatedText: Phoenix Zhang Zhaohong The earliest statements made by Arizona’s Chinese-American found. This is the earliest document with photos of the Chinese ancestors of Alberta that can be found so far. The time is May 3, 1894. A certificate of entitlement to return to the United States in the future issued by Henry Brachman, the tax collector of Portland, Oregon, to Sing Kewong, a resident of Phoenix, Arizona - No. 127865. The function of this document is equivalent to the current "Reentry Permit". The original English text of this document titled "Declaration" is as follows:

46c0e3c0110f034a5e3417b4e747509018d17d32.sourceText: 文件的中文翻译内容如下: 声明 根据美利坚合众国和中华帝国之间1894年3月17日缔结，1894年12月7日签署，并于1894年12月8日由美利坚合众国总统批准颁发的条约， 注册中国劳工回中国并有意返回美国是符合商务和劳工部1906年2月5日颁布的规定的。 邝升（（Sing Kewong 的中文译音），附像片）希望离开美国回中国并打算返回美国。应邝升要求并根据相应中美条约，俄勒冈州波特兰市税收员亨利 布拉赫曼，于1894年5月3日，向菲尼斯(Phoenix)开具 了要求返回美国的权利证书– 编号＃127865，并附他的照片一式两份，和他在美国的个人， 家庭，财产及别人欠他债务的完整描述。如下： 姓名：邝升（Sing Kewong） 年龄：39 （现年） 身高：5 英尺5?英寸 眼睛颜色：棕色 肤色：白 当地住所：英国厨房，北第一街，菲尼斯，亚利桑那州 职业：厨师 （在名叫英国厨房的餐馆档） 区别标记：左耳前的痣 欠他债款人及金额： 查理邦迪（Charlie Bound)，亚利桑那州凤凰城$ 360.00 余圣（译音），亚利桑那州凤凰城$ 585.00 程隆（译音） 亚利桑那州凤凰城$ 399.00
46c0e3c0110f034a5e3417b4e747509018d17d32.translatedText: The Chinese translation of the document is as follows: Declaration Pursuant to the treaty concluded on March 17, 1894, signed on December 7, 1894, and ratified and issued by the President of the United States of America on December 8, 1894, between the United States of America and the Empire of China, Registering Chinese workers to return to China with the intention of returning to the United States is in compliance with the regulations promulgated by the Department of Commerce and Labor on February 5, 1906. Sing Kewong (Chinese transliteration of Sing Kewong, attached video) hopes to leave the United States and return to China and plans to return to the United States. At the request of Kuang Sheng and in accordance with the corresponding Sino-US treaty, Henry Brachman, the tax collector of Portland, Oregon, issued a certificate of right to Phoenix to return to the United States – No. 127865 – on May 3, 1894, along with two copies of his photo and a complete description of his personal, family, property and debts owed to him in the United States. As follows: Name: Sing Kewong Age: 39 (currently) Height: 5 feet 5 inches Eye color: Brown Skin tone: White Local residence: British Kitchen, North First Street, Phoenix, AZ Occupation: Chef (at a restaurant called British Kitchen) Distinguishing Mark: Mole in front of left ear Who and how much he is owed: Charlie Bound, Phoenix, AZ $360.00 Yu Sheng (transliteration), Phoenix, Arizona $585.00 Cheng Long (transliteration) Phoenix, Arizona $399.00

f1e2b39f028eea50d1a0812c4ce2e9f6dbce2b9f.sourceText: 众所周知，美国政府在1882年已签署了「排华法桉」(Chinese Exclusion Act of 1882)，为何直到1894年，还有华人能拿到返回美国的文件呢？邝升日后是否又真的回到凤凰城?我们下期再续。 (本文感谢凤凰城侨联主席邓洪钺的协助, 及亚利桑那州州立图书馆研究员何乐平先生的翻译)
f1e2b39f028eea50d1a0812c4ce2e9f6dbce2b9f.translatedText: As we all know, the US government signed the "Chinese Exclusion Act of 1882" (Chinese Exclusion Act of 1882). Why were there still Chinese people who could obtain documents to return to the United States until 1894? Will Kuang Sheng really return to Phoenix City in the future? We will continue in the next issue. (This article thanks Deng Hongyue, chairman of the Phoenix Overseas Chinese Federation, for his assistance, and Mr. He Leping, a researcher at the Arizona State Library, for his translation)

402dc68745fa70582c34e935ac64cd38b7364f73.sourceText: 最近亚利桑那大学（UA）有八名中国留学生相继被没收在当地购买的枪支，有的被判非法购买狩猎执照的轻罪。最近这些年，因为国际学生不了解持枪的法律，而莫名触犯美国法律。
402dc68745fa70582c34e935ac64cd38b7364f73.translatedText: Recently, eight Chinese students at the University of Arizona (UA) have had their locally purchased guns confiscated, and some have been convicted of misdemeanors for illegally purchasing hunting licenses. In recent years, international students have inexplicably violated U.S. laws because they do not understand gun laws.

f56b2dab6d06051228679c60922327825d8a9c76.sourceText: 在有关亚利桑那大学8名中国学生强制没收强制的报道中指出，非美国居民是不允许拥有枪支。留学生就是非美国居民中的一类人。但是美国的狩猎执照销售机构监管不是很严，很多学生都能顺利买到居民狩猎执照，自然也就可以买到枪支，这让孩子不知不觉的违反了亚利桑那的法律。
f56b2dab6d06051228679c60922327825d8a9c76.translatedText: In reports about the forcible confiscation of eight Chinese students at the University of Arizona, it was pointed out that non-US residents are not allowed to own guns. International students are a category of non-residents of the United States. However, the supervision of hunting license sales agencies in the United States is not very strict. Many students can successfully buy resident hunting licenses, and naturally they can also buy guns. This makes children unknowingly violate Arizona laws.

e80d66c86593ba7bb1ed60fe87d58f4dc934bc00.sourceText: 2016年1月亚利桑那州立大学中国留学生江玥在车辆中被美国人用枪击毙。这一事件引起很多中国留学生自我防护意识的警惕。非美国居民一般是不允许购买强制的，那么是不是意味着非美国居民就会成为一个没有防范武器的弱势群体。美国还有一个非美国居民狩猎执照，他比一般的居民狩猎执照贵很多，在执照的有效期内，非美国居民是可以合法拥有枪支的。另外有想法拥有枪支的朋友，在购买强制之前一定要学习持有枪支的法律。否则就是给自己带来更多不安全隐患，即使你完全没有恶意。
e80d66c86593ba7bb1ed60fe87d58f4dc934bc00.translatedText: In January 2016, Jiang Yue, a Chinese student at Arizona State University, was shot to death by an American in a vehicle. This incident has aroused the vigilance of many Chinese students' awareness of self-protection. Non-U.S. residents are generally not allowed to purchase compulsory products. Does this mean that non-U.S. residents will become a vulnerable group without protective weapons? The United States also has a hunting license for non-U.S. residents, which is much more expensive than a general resident hunting license. During the validity period of the license, non-U.S. residents can legally own firearms. In addition, friends who want to own guns must learn the laws on gun ownership before purchasing a gun. Otherwise, you will bring more insecurity risks to yourself, even if you have no malicious intentions at all.

f4cfe5901b240ff3c77b162d24f13ee6fbd50645.sourceText: 到目前为止，在亚利桑那州最严重的有关的国际学生持枪案件，是亚利桑那州立大学一名中国留学生将两只AR-15s带入校园，因而被逮捕而且驱逐出境。他将无法再进入美国。
f4cfe5901b240ff3c77b162d24f13ee6fbd50645.translatedText: So far, the most serious case involving international student gun possession in Arizona was a Chinese student at Arizona State University who brought two AR-15s onto campus and was arrested and deported. He will no longer be able to enter the United States.

52247c42cf1505ebbff9c1d52823d36a7980d499.sourceText: The earliest statements made by Arizona’s Chinese-American found. 从资料来看，凤凰城华人先民邝升能在1894年的排华年代能拿到?#22238;美证?#26159;有条件的。 1、他是在美合法居留的华人。 2、他有工作，在菲尼克斯北第一街 (North First Phoenix)的英国厨房工作，或会说些英文和看英文菜单。 3、他有纳税，有报税纪录。我查到，在18世纪时，亚利桑那州仍然是西班牙的殖民地。19世纪初随着墨西哥脱离西班牙独立后，成为墨西哥的一部份。在1848年美墨战争中墨西哥战败后，通过瓜达卢佩-伊达尔戈条约该地割让给予美国。但直到1912年2月14日，亚利桑那州才正式加入美国，凤凰城成为亚利桑那州的首府。邝升当年是如何纳税给美国联邦政府和纳税给州政府的，还没有资料。 4、文件中提到邝升”在美国的个人， 家庭，财产”等文字，可能出于保护私隐，并未具体列出其财产的具体数目。 5、邝升是个勤力的人，不但可以养活自己(或还有家庭)，应有些积蓄。在亚利桑那州凤凰城，有三个人欠他的钱，欠债的人有两个华人：余圣（译音）欠$ 585.00，程隆（译音）欠$ 399.00，还有一个是西人查理邦迪（Charlie Bound) 欠$ 360.00。这些银码加起来有$1,344元，这金额在当时不是个小数目，除了买船票回中国，还可以”衣锦还乡”探亲了。 6、邝升希望离开美国回中国并打算返回美国，要求并根据相应中美条约，申请要求返回美国的权利证书，而且得到了批准。由俄勒冈州波特兰市税收员亨利布拉赫曼，开具 了证书，并附他的照片一式两份。 这里有个问题：为什麽要”由俄勒冈州波特兰市税收员亨利布拉赫曼”开具 了要求返回美国的权利证书呢？俄勒冈州在美国西北部，离亚利桑那州的凤凰城很远，当年亜利桑那州虽然已是美国属地，但还未建州，或未有相关部门处理此类文件。波特兰市是俄勒冈州最大的城市，我查到在19世纪大多数时间里，波特兰市是美国西北太平洋地区最大的港口，或因如此，当年这类的文件也可以由此地纳税部门开出。 另外，邝升申请回美权利证书或还有其他的目的吗？ 欠邝升债务的三个人，数目在当年按华工的收入是很大的，有些可能是欠的他的工资也不一定。邝升手中应有其欠款的证据，才可能藉此回国拿「回美证」机会，把这些欠债通过官方认定，债人才不能扺赖。在当时的法律，欠债的华人不还清债务是不能申请回中国的，而西人的欠钱也可能藉此追讨回来。 至于邝升有没有回中国？或回中国后是否返回美国凤凰城？目前还不知道。但从这张有着很多皱摺 ”回美证” 来看，是邝升用过多次了，或回美国时由官方收回保存下来的，又或是由后人收集存放到Pueblo Grande博物馆的。如邝升真的是从中国返回到凤凰城，去世又在本地，就还有可能找到更多的线索。我查过亚利桑那州凤凰城中心地区的”先民和军人纪念墓园” (Pioneer & Military Memorial Park) ，在墓地先民姓名中，并没有邝升（Sing Kewong）的名字。现正通过本地另一个最早和最大的”绿木墓园”去查询，如能查到相关的消息，可能会得到有关邝升本人和他后人的讯息，那么，邝升这份文件将为我们凤凰城华人先民历史，尤其是邝氏家族在凤凰城的历史，带来更多的讯息。 (全文完)
52247c42cf1505ebbff9c1d52823d36a7980d499.translatedText: The earliest statements made by Arizona’s Chinese-American found. Judging from the data, Kuang Shengneng, the Chinese ancestor of Phoenix City, was able to obtain a US ID card in 1894 during the anti-Chinese era with certain conditions. 1. He is a Chinese legally residing in the United States. 2. He has a job, works in a British kitchen on North First Street in Phoenix, and may speak some English and read English menus. 3. He has paid taxes and has tax return records. I found out that in the 18th century, Arizona was still a Spanish colony. After Mexico gained independence from Spain in the early 19th century, it became part of Mexico. After Mexico's defeat in the Mexican-American War in 1848, the territory was ceded to the United States through the Treaty of Guadalupe Hidalgo. But it was not until February 14, 1912, that Arizona officially joined the United States, and Phoenix became the capital of Arizona. There is no information on how Kuang Sheng paid taxes to the U.S. federal government and state governments. 4. The document mentions Kuang Sheng’s “personal, family, and property in the United States.” The specific amount of his property may not be listed in detail to protect his privacy. 5. Kuang Sheng is a hard-working person. Not only can he support himself (or his family), he should also have some savings. In Phoenix, Arizona, three people owed him money. The debtors were two Chinese: Yu Sheng (transliteration) owed $585.00, Cheng Long (transliteration) owed $399.00, and a Westerner, Charlie Bound, owed $360.00. These debit codes added up to $1,344, which was not a small amount at the time. In addition to buying a boat ticket to return to China, I could also "return to my hometown" to visit relatives. 6. Kuang Sheng hoped to leave the United States and return to China and planned to return to the United States. He requested and applied for a certificate of rights to return to the United States in accordance with the corresponding Sino-US treaty, and it was approved. Certificate issued in duplicate by Henry Brachman, Tax Collector of the City of Portland, Oregon, with his photograph attached. Here’s a question: Why was a Certificate of Right to Return to the United States “issued by Henry Brachman, Tax Collector of the City of Portland, Oregon”? Oregon is in the northwest of the United States, far away from Phoenix, Arizona. Although Arizona was already a U.S. territory at that time, it had not yet established a state, or there were no relevant departments to handle such documents. Portland is the largest city in Oregon. I found that for most of the 19th century, Portland was the largest port in the Pacific Northwest of the United States. Perhaps because of this, such documents could also be issued by the local tax department. In addition, is there any other purpose for Kuang Sheng to apply for a certificate of right to return to the United States? The three people who owed Kuang Sheng debts were very large based on the income of Chinese workers at that time, and some of them may have owed him wages. Kuang Sheng should have evidence of his debts in his hands, so that he can take this opportunity to return to China to get a "Reentry Permit" and have these debts officially recognized so that the debtors cannot rely on them. Under the law at the time, Chinese who owed debts could not apply to return to China unless they paid off their debts, and Westerners could also recover their owed money through this method. As for whether Kuang Sheng returned to China? Or will you return to Phoenix in the United States after returning to China? Don't know yet. But judging from this "reentry permit" with many wrinkles, it can be seen that it was used many times by Kuang Sheng, or it was collected and preserved by the authorities when he returned to the United States, or it was collected and stored in the Pueblo Grande Museum by descendants. If Kuang Sheng really returned to Phoenix from China and died locally, it is possible to find more clues. I checked the "Pioneer & Military Memorial Park" in the center of Phoenix, Arizona. Among the names of the ancestors in the cemetery, the name of Sing Kewong was not found. We are currently searching through another local earliest and largest "Greenwood Cemetery". If relevant information can be found, we may get information about Kuang Sheng himself and his descendants. Then, Kuang Sheng's document will bring more information to the history of our Chinese ancestors in Phoenix, especially the history of the Kuang family in Phoenix. (Full text ends)

a6ab564c5ba6e1b2f7ac3bc8229c12444b3c79d2.sourceText: 1880年代前，凤凰城只有马车线路。铁路的建设成为凤凰城经济起飞的第一个契机，凤凰城也成为通达东西的商品集散地。1893年凤凰城建设了有轨电车系统，取代了先前的马车线路。
a6ab564c5ba6e1b2f7ac3bc8229c12444b3c79d2.translatedText: Before the 1880s, Phoenix only had horse-drawn carriage lines. The construction of the railway became the first opportunity for Phoenix City's economic take-off, and Phoenix City also became a commodity distribution center connecting the east and west. In 1893, Phoenix built a streetcar system, replacing the previous horse-drawn carriage lines.

9e6ada90163f08f6144ffd8f4b7d23f2d864e275.sourceText: 根据5.29志愿者群的最新消息， 5月29日亚利桑那州立大学的两个中国留学生不幸遭遇车祸，其中一名受伤同学经过手术，已经在顺利康复中，目前已经可以说话和走路。另一名同学今天下午三点与律师见面，正在积极配合律师处理相关事宜。ASU中国学生学者联合会第一时间组建了志愿者微信群，很多还留在学校的同学，以及当地的侨民都伸出了援助之手。受伤同学的看护，井然有序的进行中。钱德勒华人议员黄馨民，凤凰城科学家工程师专业协会会长李江也到现场看望。
9e6ada90163f08f6144ffd8f4b7d23f2d864e275.translatedText: According to the latest news from the 5.29 volunteer group, On May 29, two Chinese students at Arizona State University were unfortunately involved in a car accident. One of the injured students has undergone surgery and is recovering smoothly. He can now speak and walk. Another classmate met with the lawyer at 3 o'clock this afternoon and is actively cooperating with the lawyer to handle related matters. The ASU Chinese Students and Scholars Association immediately established a volunteer WeChat group, and many students who were still at the school and local expatriates extended a helping hand. The care of the injured classmates is proceeding in an orderly manner. Chandler Chinese Congressman Huang Xinmin and Li Jiang, president of the Phoenix Professional Association of Scientists and Engineers, also visited the scene.

a37db64794f95192694a283f52f38cdd97c6d10c.sourceText: 5月29日下午，亚利桑那州立大学的阎同学和薛同学在乘坐Lyft公司的车时，不幸在University Dr 和Price Rd交界遭遇车祸。 两位同学相继被送往Banner Desert Medical Center救治。薛同学伤势较轻，阎同学伤势较重，当日就进行了手术。手术一些顺利。30号早晨五点医院为阎同学做了CT检查，情况良好，阎同学本人已经意识清醒。31日就可以下床自理。
a37db64794f95192694a283f52f38cdd97c6d10c.translatedText: On the afternoon of May 29, students Yan and Xue from Arizona State University were unfortunately involved in a car accident at the intersection of University Dr and Price Rd while taking a Lyft car. The two classmates were sent to Banner Desert Medical Center for treatment. Classmate Xue's injury was minor, and Classmate Yan's injury was serious. Surgery was performed on the same day. The surgery went somewhat smoothly. At five o'clock in the morning on the 30th, the hospital performed a CT examination on Yan. The condition was good and Yan was conscious. You can get out of bed and take care of yourself on the 31st.

17473e7ac0af6b7f50a7b0eaf5c5ef3fea1476fb.translatedText: Waymo's self-driving cars are finally on the road, and Phoenix residents can call for free According to news on April 26, Waymo, a self-driving company owned by Google...

3d6dc660a3295bb977de95670f92c6f9c64af55a.sourceText: 4月26日消息，Google旗下的自动驾驶公司Waymo昨天宣布将让普通乘客试乘其自动驾驶汽车，美国亚利桑那州凤凰城的居民可以免费申请试乘。
3d6dc660a3295bb977de95670f92c6f9c64af55a.translatedText: News on April 26, Waymo, a self-driving company owned by Google, announced yesterday that it will allow ordinary passengers to test drive its self-driving cars. Residents of Phoenix, Arizona, USA can apply for a free test drive.

5032497f0cfb2997474bdecd5b95fd9619743ddc.sourceText: Waymo表示，这一试乘计划的名额有数百个，而且该公司提供的不仅仅是单次的自动驾驶体验，这批早期试乘的乘客及其家人还能将Waymo的自动驾驶SUV和MPV免费当作他们的主要或次要交通工具。当然，每次乘坐Waymo自动驾驶汽车时，车上都会配备一位人类司机防止事故。
5032497f0cfb2997474bdecd5b95fd9619743ddc.translatedText: Waymo said that there are hundreds of places for this trial ride program, and the company provides more than just a single self-driving experience. These early trial passengers and their families can also use Waymo's self-driving SUVs and MPVs as their primary or secondary transportation for free. Of course, every time you take a ride in a Waymo self-driving car, there will be a human driver on board to prevent accidents.

68927761514a1f54982123055ef49bf01e69f8be.sourceText: Waymo此举的目的是为了在现实生活中收集普通乘客对于自动驾驶汽车的体验信息。?#25105;们会从这项计划中知道人们会乘坐自动驾驶汽车前往哪些地方，他们如何与汽车进行交流，以及他们想在车内得到哪些信息，擶aymo首席执行官John Krafcik在Medium的一篇博客文章中写道。
68927761514a1f54982123055ef49bf01e69f8be.translatedText: Waymo’s purpose is to collect information about ordinary passengers’ experiences with self-driving cars in real life. ?#25105;We will learn from this program where people will go in self-driving cars, how they will communicate with the car, and what information they want in the car, 涶aymo CEO John Krafcik wrote in a blog post on Medium.

e1601bf5653bc040dc9fdabb2f306f7201109536.sourceText: 这是2009年Google开始研发自动驾驶汽车以来，Waymo首次向外界如此高调地公开其最新进度。2015年Waymo曾让一位非该公司员工单独在其自动驾驶汽车里行驶了一段路程，但在此后一年多的时间里该公司都没有让其自动驾驶汽车公开亮相。
e1601bf5653bc040dc9fdabb2f306f7201109536.translatedText: This is the first time that Waymo has disclosed its latest progress to the outside world in such a high-profile manner since Google began developing self-driving cars in 2009. In 2015, Waymo let a non-employee drive alone for a distance in its self-driving car, but the company did not make its self-driving car public debut for more than a year.

f5717ace6afcf4fac40613a816ff09ba647f27a6.sourceText: ”我们早期的试乘者会在将自动驾驶介绍给全世界的过程中扮演重要的作用，包括私人汽车、公共交通、专车和物流都会受其影响，”John Krafcik说。
f5717ace6afcf4fac40613a816ff09ba647f27a6.translatedText: "Our early test riders will play an important role in introducing autonomous driving to the world, including private cars, public transportation, private cars and logistics," said John Krafcik.

6788f81b770f0aca34a5c1cf393c8dc6bee2c467.sourceText: Waymo目前接受该项目的公开申请，对于这几百个名额将会被哪些人获得Waymo没有提出具体的要求，而是概括为”不同背景但有交通需求的人”。另外，申请人必须年满18岁，目前这一计划仅限于凤凰城的Chandler，Gilbert，Mesa和Tempe四个县区的居民申请，后期会开放给更多的地区。
6788f81b770f0aca34a5c1cf393c8dc6bee2c467.translatedText: Waymo is currently accepting public applications for the project. Waymo does not have specific requirements for who will receive these hundreds of places, but it is summarized as "people from different backgrounds but with transportation needs." In addition, applicants must be over 18 years old. Currently, this program is limited to residents of Chandler, Gilbert, Mesa and Tempe counties in Phoenix. It will be opened to more areas in the future.

9c5b5f2f05af769d47d221ad5c4b9b03903513e9.sourceText: 虽然凤凰城所在的亚利桑那州不要求自动驾驶汽车像在加州那样必须先取得牌照才能在公开道路上测试自动驾驶汽车，但Waymo的这一步仍然走得相当激进，目前Waymo也没有透露乘客是否需要自己为他们乘坐自动驾驶汽车时的安全负责。
9c5b5f2f05af769d47d221ad5c4b9b03903513e9.translatedText: Although Arizona, where Phoenix is ​​located, does not require self-driving cars to obtain a license before testing self-driving cars on public roads like in California, Waymo's step is still quite radical. Currently, Waymo has not disclosed whether passengers need to be responsible for their own safety when riding in self-driving cars.

0f83e559cc6fa9175e404e731b384c390a78c03b.sourceText: 据Waymo发言人称，通过申请的试乘者将可以下载一个Waymo的App，并通过这个App预约附近的自动驾驶汽车，使用车辆不收取费用，但他们将被要求回答关于乘车体验相关的问题。
0f83e559cc6fa9175e404e731b384c390a78c03b.translatedText: According to a Waymo spokesperson, test riders who apply will be able to download a Waymo App and reserve a nearby self-driving car through the App. There is no charge for using the vehicle, but they will be asked to answer questions about the ride experience.

f09843f9394487058b1b844f241ca178b0db0fe3.sourceText: Uber去年也在匹兹堡市邀请过一些当地居民试乘其自动驾驶专车，现在还将范围扩展到了凤凰城和旧金山市。两家自动驾驶公司都在亚利桑那州展开公开测试，这表明亚利桑那对新技术的接纳程度相当高。在Waymo宣布这一试乘计划之后，亚利桑那州运输部对科技媒体The Verge表示：
f09843f9394487058b1b844f241ca178b0db0fe3.translatedText: Uber also invited some local residents to test drive its self-driving cars in Pittsburgh last year, and now it has expanded its scope to Phoenix and San Francisco. Both self-driving companies are conducting public testing in Arizona, which shows that Arizona is very receptive to new technologies. After Waymo announced this test ride program, the Arizona Department of Transportation responded to technology media The The Verge said:

a9c54e40fa72d6be5b3e285a4b5ac726ec5b0a9b.sourceText: ”交通运输的本质正在进行着激烈的变革。在未来的几年里棗或许比我们想象的更短棗交通工具或许会用上我们现在认为非常未来主义的技术厖亚利桑那已经准备好了与Waymo/Google这类公司站在一起来为自动驾驶技术的发展创造更好的环境，但同时公众安全也会被放在首位。亚利桑那州运输部非常期待Waymo的此次公开测试以及它为提升道路交通带来的好处。”
a9c54e40fa72d6be5b3e285a4b5ac726ec5b0a9b.translatedText: "The nature of transportation is undergoing drastic changes. In the next few years, transportation may be shorter than we think, and transportation may use technology that we now consider very futuristic. Arizona is ready to stand with companies like Waymo/Google to create a better environment for the development of autonomous driving technology, but at the same time public safety will be the first priority. The Arizona Department of Transportation is very much looking forward to this public test of Waymo and the benefits it will bring to improve road transportation."

3c26196ea3bbd812a1aefe92d660fce204156b2f.sourceText: Waymo此举的目的是为了在现实生活中收集普通乘客对于自动驾驶汽车的体验信息。”我们会从这项计划中知道人们会乘坐自动驾驶汽车前往哪些地方，他们如何与汽车进行交流，以及他们想在车内得到哪些信息，”Waymo首席执行官John Krafcik在Medium的一篇博客文章中写道。
3c26196ea3bbd812a1aefe92d660fce204156b2f.translatedText: The purpose of Waymo's move is to collect information about ordinary passengers' experiences with self-driving cars in real life. "We will learn from this program where people will go in self-driving cars, how they will communicate with the car, and what information they want in the car," Waymo CEO John Krafcik wrote in a blog post on Medium.

00735227931b5ecb444eff9f41d6092d92e0fe6a.sourceText: Waymo目前接受该项目的公开申请，对于这几百个名额将会被哪些人获得Waymo没有提出具体的要求，而是概括为”不同背景但有交通需求的人”另外，申请人必须年满18岁，目前这一计划仅限于凤凰城的Chandler，Gilbert，Mesa和Tempe四个县区的居民申请，后期会开放给更多的地区。
00735227931b5ecb444eff9f41d6092d92e0fe6a.translatedText: Waymo is currently accepting public applications for the project. Waymo has not put forward specific requirements for who will receive these hundreds of places, but it is summarized as "people with different backgrounds but with transportation needs." In addition, applicants must be over 18 years old. Currently, this program is limited to residents of Chandler, Gilbert, Mesa and Tempe counties in Phoenix. It will be opened to more areas in the future.

bed51cf039a9725d87bf8db1a737d7dc81f2ae6d.sourceText: 骑士队拥有三名全明星球员，乐福、欧文以及联盟第一人勒布朗-詹姆斯（如今NBA联盟第一人头衔似乎开始摇摆了），顶尖的外线炮手JR斯密斯、香波特、德隆、科沃尔以及老将弗莱，内线TT汤普森虽达不到联盟顶级水平，但是毕竟经历过NBA总冠军的洗礼，算是经历过世面的，并且去年在总决赛中起着顶梁柱的作用。在这些盘面之下，骑士怎么也得拿下两局吧！？
bed51cf039a9725d87bf8db1a737d7dc81f2ae6d.translatedText: The Cavaliers have three All-Star players, Love, Irving and the league's first player LeBron James (the title of the NBA's first player seems to be shaking now), top outside gunners JR Smith, Shumpert, Deron, Korver and veteran Frye.
