540f3407c20b798eafd584c4d7f86abdcc545ef1.translatedText: Shanghai Grill restaurant won the championship in the 2017 Restaurant Club Bowling Competition. The Phoenix Chinese Bowling Association’s 2017 regular team competition…

12bd1e68beaad8356d1603370a23b3128a7665ed.sourceText: 凤凰城华人保龄球协会2017年度常规队赛经过九个多月的激烈比赛后,最终由Tony Diep的Shanghai Grill 餐馆勇夺总冠军. 今年的颁奖晚宴于5月29晚在Hibachi Buffet举行, 颁发奖盃,奖牌给各优胜者及赞助商, 更加得到由欣欣超市, 环球布斐, 六福酒家, Hibachi Buffet等送出的大量抽奖礼券,欢乐满堂,尽庆而返. 会长巫宜钊引述—凤凰城华人保龄球协会成立及从未间断比赛已有65年, 为亚省历史最悠久的保龄球会, 难得可贵. 当年前辈多经营什货店或餐馆, 工馀后已夜深, 在缺乏平常娱乐下而组织此会, 除可一边打球, 讨论业务心得, 联络感情, 閒话家常, 更可锻练身体. 一直以来, 球员遍及各行各业. 查亚省中餐馆协会自十多年前以会员及员工组成了2支球队参加该会的比赛,并夺得过三次总冠军, 三次进入总决赛,成绩卓然, 亦是不断提练新球员的成果. 今年更有Edward Ong (餐馆会队)和John Chan (环球布斐队)分别打出299 和298分(300分为满分)的好成绩, 难能可贵. 据悉该会一如以往,为会员及员工提供娱乐福利,会在六月至八月的暑期间, 开办保龄球练习和训练班, 欢迎有兴趣的球员或初学球员参加. 时间是每星期一晚上9:30在AMF保龄球场馆 (1919 W. Bethany Home Rd. Phoenix) 举行. 并会有专人负责陪训. 详情请电: 巫宜钊 623-341-5032
12bd1e68beaad8356d1603370a23b3128a7665ed.translatedText: Phoenix Chinese Bowling Association’s 2017 regular team competition. After more than nine months of fierce competition, Tony Diep’s Shanghai Grill restaurant finally won the championship. This year's awards banquet was held at Hibachi Buffet on the evening of May 29. Trophies and medals were awarded to the winners and sponsors. They also received a large number of raffle coupons from Xinxin Supermarket, Global Buffet, Luk Fook Restaurant, Hibachi Buffet, etc. The dinner was filled with joy and the celebration was over. President Wu Yizhao quoted - The Phoenix Chinese Bowling Association has been established and has been competing for 65 years, making it the oldest bowling club in Alberta. It is rare and valuable. At that time, most of our predecessors ran grocery stores or restaurants. They organized this meeting late at night after work and lacked ordinary entertainment. In addition to playing ball, discussing business ideas, connecting with each other, chatting about daily life, they could also exercise. Players have always come from all walks of life. The Jaya Chinese Restaurant Association has formed two teams with members and employees to participate in the association's competition more than ten years ago, and has won three championships. Entering the finals three times, the results are outstanding, which is also the result of continuous training of new players. This year, Edward Ong (Restaurant Club Team) and John Chan (Global Buffay Team) scored 299 and 298 points respectively (300 is a perfect score), which is commendable. It is reported that the association will continue to provide entertainment benefits for members and employees, and will hold bowling practice and training classes during the summer period from June to August. Interested players or novice players are welcome to participate. The time is every Monday at 9:30 pm at the AMF Bowling Alley (1919 W. Bethany Home Rd. Phoenix). There will be a dedicated person responsible for accompanying the training. For details, please call: Wu Yizhao 623-341-5032

dc1c9246d43c087359f365d1db2a86566649b45d.translatedText: In addition to 60 mph winds, there is hail less than an inch in some areas.

fc5d6d0bd0148208e375e352d12f9894290ca9f3.sourceText: Surpirse地区的警察说：风吹过整个城市的多棵树，阻挡了这些地区的道路。
fc5d6d0bd0148208e375e352d12f9894290ca9f3.translatedText: Police in the Surpirse area said winds had blown several trees across the city, blocking roads in those areas.

5a6101915a48caaff5c793ddb05adbd6c772d3d9.sourceText: 星期六晚上横扫谷地的恶劣天气造成数十次停电，导致数千客户在黑暗中。但是晚上9点半左右，部分停电已经恢复。Surprise地区中大约有800位客户继续没电。在凤凰城中部，下午6点后，1700多名客户没电。大部分在城市的西部。亚利桑那州公共服务部门表示，市内最大的中断时间是在太阳城，近二千四百名客户在周六，五点半前失去电力。APS表示，停电是由于该地区主要电力线路的中断造成的，关闭了Camelot Circle到Sun City Boulevard以及111th Avenue到103rd Avenue的电力。截至周六9:30pm，大部分电力恢复，仅310人仍然没有电。
5a6101915a48caaff5c793ddb05adbd6c772d3d9.translatedText: Severe weather sweeping across the Valley Saturday night caused dozens of power outages, leaving thousands of customers in the dark. But around 9:30 p.m., some of the power outages were restored. About 800 customers in the Surprise area continue to be without power. In central Phoenix, more than 1,700 customers were without power after 6 p.m. Most are in the west of the city. The Arizona Department of Public Service said the largest outage in the city was in Sun City, where nearly 2,400 customers lost power just before 5:30 Saturday. APS said the outage was caused by disruptions to major power lines in the area, shutting down power from Camelot Circle to Sun City Boulevard and 111th Avenue to 103rd Avenue. As of 9:30pm Saturday, most power had been restored, with only 310 people still without power.

a9fad4a0a8380935167317f2d85e3cd388505483.sourceText: 周日沙尘暴和暴雨仍然在继续。国家气象发出洪水警报，周一凌晨1：30am，将有突发洪水（另外在Payson附近，周六突发洪水，已经造成9人死亡），周一凌晨两点再次沙尘暴袭击。所有行驶车辆靠边停行，保证人生安全。

There will be sudden flooding at 1:30 a.m. on Monday (another sudden flood near Payson on Saturday has killed 9 people), and a sandstorm hit again at 2 a.m. on Monday. All moving vehicles should pull over to ensure safety.

62c056ff5ad2b99447ea0570ca422f617e01e2aa.sourceText: 本周，北美热浪来袭。美国亚利桑那州凤凰城明天极端炎热的天气预测已经导致美国航空公司取消了43架从天港国际机场起飞的航班。从下午3点到晚上6点
62c056ff5ad2b99447ea0570ca422f617e01e2aa.translatedText: This week, a heat wave hits North America. Extremely hot weather forecast for tomorrow in Phoenix, Arizona, has caused American Airlines to cancel 43 flights from Sky Harbor International Airport. From 3 p.m. to 6 p.m.

f81df90166d4a52e0e954ef56f4e3b258e356a84.sourceText: 根据美国航空公司的声明，美鹰航空（American Eagle）区域航班使用的是庞巴迪CRJ飞机，最高工作温度为118华氏度（约48摄氏度）。而凤凰城周二预测的温度为120华氏度（约49摄氏度），下午3点到6点之间起飞的航班将会受到影响。受影响的乘客可以联系美国航空公司重新预定或退款。
f81df90166d4a52e0e954ef56f4e3b258e356a84.translatedText: According to a statement from American Airlines, American Eagle regional flights use Bombardier CRJ aircraft with a maximum operating temperature of 118 degrees Fahrenheit (about 48 degrees Celsius). The temperature forecast for Phoenix on Tuesday is 120 degrees Fahrenheit (about 49 degrees Celsius), which will affect flights departing between 3 p.m. and 6 p.m. Affected passengers can contact American Airlines to rebook or receive a refund.

dc84dff9076f281f16a80dd23b64ced664fb1e9f.sourceText: 高温的天气会影响飞机的飞行能力。热空气比冷空气密度低，温度越高，飞机需要升高的速度越快。若是跑道不够长，飞机就不能达到需要的速度。
dc84dff9076f281f16a80dd23b64ced664fb1e9f.translatedText: High temperature weather will affect the flight ability of the aircraft. Hot air is less dense than cold air, and the higher the temperature, the faster the aircraft needs to rise. If the runway is not long enough, the aircraft cannot reach the required speed.

78380d961797731acfb541d00ae455cb7baba4ee.sourceText: 但是，较大的喷气式飞机，如空客和波音的飞机，预计不会受到本周热浪的影响。
78380d961797731acfb541d00ae455cb7baba4ee.translatedText: However, larger jets, such as those from Airbus and Boeing, are not expected to be affected by this week's heat wave.

6f967c8c31b00ef58c8cf237dda2bb66c104e826.sourceText: 亚省华联董事会对亚省亚裔细分决议案（AZ SCR 1012）的立场声明 1. 我们亚省华联与广大华人、华侨一样非常关注本州参议员余艳芬女士在亚省议会提出的亚裔细分决议案。 2. 我们反对这个亚裔细分决议案，因为它违背了美国公平、正义的建国精神，与美国忠诚誓言中所提及的自由、平等、联合的宗旨背道而驰。同时，我们也警惕这类信息可能被用于其它政治目的。 3. 各种族都有其独特的情况。采取立法的形式对约占人口5％的人群细分到十几个以上，而同时对近95％的人口只粗略的划分三到四类，这种作法从根本上来讲是错误的和不合逻辑的。 4. 我们理解并支持诸如APCA这样的机构为亚裔人群服务的宗旨，及他们为此目标的不懈努力。然而，我们不认为通过在政府发布的各类表格上强制填写亚裔人群的种族背景会对亚裔人群的疾病防治产生真正有益的作用。 UCAA Board Statement on AZ SCR 1012 1. We share the concern of many in our community who recently raised their voice regarding SCR1012 being introduced in Arizona by state senator Kimberley Yee ( http://www.azleg.gov/legtext/53leg/1r/bills/scr1012p.pdf ). 2. We oppose AZ SCR 1012 because it is incompatible with the American spirit of equality, fairness, and indivisibility.. United we stand, divided we fall. Meanwhile, we are vigilant about its potential political ramification. 3. People are universally diversified and individually unique. Through legislature in singling out roughly 5% of the population and reclassifying that small group into multiple subgroups while ignoring the differences among the 95% of the population are fundamentally flaw and illogical. 4. We fully understand and support the mission of entities such as APCA in their efforts to better serve Asian and Pacific Islander population, by identifying their special needs in order to modify their disease prevention and management, and to adjust resource allocations. However, we do not believe that simple country-origin registration mandated by government based agencies will have any meaningful and constructive impact on this issue.
6f967c8c31b00ef58c8cf237dda2bb66c104e826.translatedText: Position statement of the Board of Directors of the Chinese Federation of Alberta on the Asian subdivision resolution in Alberta (AZ SCR 1012) 1. We, the Hualian Federation of Alberta, like the majority of Chinese and overseas Chinese, are very concerned about the Asian subdivision resolution proposed by our state Senator Ms. Yu Yanfen in the Alberta Legislature. 2. We oppose this Asian subdivision resolution because it violates the founding spirit of fairness and justice in the United States and runs counter to the purposes of freedom, equality, and union mentioned in the American Loyalty Pledge. At the same time, we are also wary that such information may be used for other political purposes. 3. Each race has its own unique circumstances. It is fundamentally wrong and illogical to use legislation to subdivide about 5% of the population into more than a dozen groups, while at the same time roughly classifying nearly 95% of the population into only three or four categories. 4. We understand and support the purpose of organizations such as APCA to serve the Asian population and their unremitting efforts towards this goal. However, we do not believe that mandating the ethnic background of Asian people on various forms issued by the government will have a truly beneficial effect on the prevention and treatment of diseases among Asian people. cea698779c6463a7f383773bf8f7a8fd5f5b02d6.sourceText: Spring Festival Spectacular for Chinese New Year On the evening of January 28 th, New Year抯 Day according to the ancient Chinese lunisolar calendar (for Year 4715), the local Chinese-American community and its many friends were treated to a program of culture and entertainment without equal. This occasion at the Mesa Center for the Arts was, for the 8 th time, coordinated by the Chinese New Year抯 Show Committee, with the expertise of the Arizona Art Academy, LLC. Additionally vital contributions both in performing talent and in the myriad tasks involved were provided by Hope Chinese School, Contemporary Chinese School of Arizona, United Chinese Association of Arizona, and the Phoenix Chinese Senior Citizens Association. Overall, nearly 200 performers displayed mesmerizing entertainment; individuals and groups involved included (beyond those aforementioned) Phoenix Chinese Arts Ensemble, Chandler Children’s Choir, Tarwater Elementary School, and Coronado Elementary School. The evening featured choirs, solo dance, group dance, vocal solo, and ethnic dance (of the Dai Minority in southwestern China) plus the perennial favorite and internationally known Chinese specialty: acrobatics. And, given our new homeland in the West, there was also a Piano Quartet in G Minor (KV 478.1) by Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart. Audience appreciation was especially notable for 揝pirit of the Peacock,?a group dance, and for 揌oly Cleansing,?a solo dance by our local star Ms. Tina Peng, currently a student at the Barrett, the Honors College of Arizona State University as well as the incumbent Miss Phoenix Chinese 2016. The special expense of such a high quality entertainment was defrayed by many individual donations, but especially by Wells Fargo Bank as a long-time sponsor for our community, as well as by advertisers and contributors old and new (such as Hester, Heitel & Associates, Lee Lee Supermarkets, Arizona抯 Vision, and Neurology & Sleep Medicine Associates). The high distinction of this celebration was conveyed by greetings and representatives present. Arizona Governor Doug Ducey congratulated the occasion through State Representative Eddie Farnsworth (District 12) for the Gilbert-Mesa area. The Consulate General of the People抯 Republic of China in Los Angeles honored the occasion with Consul Xuezheng Wang, Chief of the Overseas Chinese Affairs Section attending. Lihua Lu, the Producer, in keeping with the immemorial Chinese tradition of respect for elders, especially coordinated with President Teresa Yung of the Phoenix Chinese Senior Citizens Association to highlight both their performance participation and their attendance with complementary ticketing. An especial highlight was the presentation by the Xiaorong Qiu, the Artistic Director, of the Platinum (highest) Award in the world finals of the Overseas Taoli Dance Competition to Ms. Tina Peng. For the first time, both of the aforementioned weekend Chinese language schools conducted a Chinese painting exhibition while increasing exposure to our ancestral culture and especially New Year traditions, such as lucky red envelopes. Naturally for such an extraordinary event, community leaders and elders were very present to lend their support and encouragement in addition to those named above, notably, Chandler City Councilman Sam Huang, John M. Yee, Tony Kao, Helen Zhang, and Suoqin Zeng. The entire Chinese American community and our wider society in this metropolitan area will certainly look forward to another iteration as truly the most wonderful way to usher in any new year hereafter. M. Cheak Yee / Yu Wen-chuo 余文焯

bae044f368d2d2324052f15021eca25b63b14d9f.sourceText: 教育部长狄弗斯(Betsy DeVos)恭喜得奖人及其导师，她表示，?#20170;天的总统学者是明日的领袖，我相信他们在步入下一个学习阶段，将继续成为闪亮典范?#12290;共有5100名应届毕业高中生因学术成就取得第一关入围资格，161位总统学者奖得主和他们选的一名师长，将于6月18日前往白宫领奖。
bae044f368d2d2324052f15021eca25b63b14d9f.translatedText: Education Secretary Betsy DeVos congratulated the winners and their mentors. She said, "Today's Presidential Scholars are tomorrow's leaders. I believe they will continue to be shining examples as they enter the next stage of study." A total of 5,100 graduating high school students have obtained the first-level qualifications for their academic achievements. 161 Presidential Scholar Award winners and a teacher selected by them will go to the White House on June 18 to receive the award.

01561734fd5afa2ff18b08c1c1aca8761aef0541.translatedText: Uber's self-driving car crashed in Tempe, and its testing project was suspended. According to news on March 26, Beijing time, an Uber self-driving car crashed in Tempe, Arizona, the United States...

926a90fd2c5eb4fd57abd1fd42f2e99c2caffa67.sourceText: 北京时间3月26日消息，Uber自动驾驶汽车在美国亚利桑那州Tempe发生撞车事故，之后公司自动驾驶测试项目暂时中止。
926a90fd2c5eb4fd57abd1fd42f2e99c2caffa67.translatedText: According to news on March 26, Beijing time, an Uber self-driving car crashed in Tempe, Arizona, and the company's self-driving test project was temporarily suspended.

8905980725526daa77c00b403aaf2f0abf44ae94.sourceText: 最近一张照片出现在Twitter网站，图中一辆Uber沃尔沃自动驾驶SUV与另一辆汽车靠在一起，这辆汽车的车身出现压痕，窗户破碎。Uber新闻发言人证实汽车发生撞车事故，确认了图片的真实性，并说公司已经中止亚利桑那无人驾驶测试，调查结束之前匹兹堡的测试也会暂停。
8905980725526daa77c00b403aaf2f0abf44ae94.translatedText: A recent photo appeared on Twitter. In the picture, an Uber Volvo self-driving SUV is close to another car. The car's body has dents and its windows are broken. An Uber spokesperson confirmed that the car had crashed, confirmed the authenticity of the images, and said the company had suspended self-driving testing in Arizona and that testing in Pittsburgh would also be suspended until the investigation is completed.

a975826ccaf94bbd81b0568f2d7bf04a6c89efb9.sourceText: Tempe警察信息官乔西?#33945;特内罗歌（Josie Montenegro）在接受采访时表示，Uber汽车无须为事故负责，没有人受伤。警方报告称，另一辆汽车未能为Uber汽车让路，所以导致无人驾驶汽车撞到该车的一侧。
a975826ccaf94bbd81b0568f2d7bf04a6c89efb9.translatedText: Tempe police information officer Josie Montenegro said in an interview that the Uber car was not responsible for the accident and that no one was injured. Police reported that another car failed to give way to the Uber car, causing the self-driving car to hit the side of the car.

c1d3292549d4d8ed46da6be20ea4e55dc001ef63.sourceText: 蒙特内罗歌谈到Uber汽车时表示：?#24403;时方向盘后有人，不确定撞车时汽车是否已经由人接管。?/P>
c1d3292549d4d8ed46da6be20ea4e55dc001ef63.translatedText: Montenegro said about the Uber car: There was someone behind the wheel at the time, and he was not sure whether the car had been taken over by someone at the time of the crash. ?/P>

dbd3f3d017ad07db974f0893c39e1f521375fa70.sourceText: Uber新闻发言人表示：?#25105;们正在调查事故，可以确认当时后排没有乘客。?/P>
dbd3f3d017ad07db974f0893c39e1f521375fa70.translatedText: An Uber spokesperson said: We are investigating the accident and can confirm that there were no passengers in the back seat at the time. ?/P>

07e28511798bc840fee03ce34a2b327104ef6804.sourceText: 去年Uber开始在匹兹堡测试无人驾驶汽车，很快又在亚利桑那测试，在此之前加州机动车辆管理局曾禁止Uber在旧金山测试无人驾驶汽车。Uber测试的目的主要是为了展示技术进步，亚利桑那州州长道格?#26460;西（Doug Ducey）在开始运营时乘坐了汽车，上个月，Uber无人驾驶汽车开始在Tempe接送乘客。
07e28511798bc840fee03ce34a2b327104ef6804.translatedText: Last year Uber began testing self-driving cars in Pittsburgh and soon in Arizona. Before that, the California Department of Motor Vehicles banned Uber from testing self-driving cars in San Francisco. The purpose of the Uber test is mainly to demonstrate technological advancements. Arizona Governor Doug Ducey took a ride in the car when the operation began. Last month, Uber's self-driving cars began picking up and dropping off passengers in Tempe.

c7cd1a3f8c1d8bc28bb3b2582298cdc45d5f1bd6.sourceText: 不过Uber无人驾驶汽车引起了争论，Alphabet无人驾驶部门Waymo也在亚利桑那测试无人驾驶汽车，年初时它起诉Uber，宣称Uber窃取了激光雷达设计资料，Uber回应称起诉毫无根据。
c7cd1a3f8c1d8bc28bb3b2582298cdc45d5f1bd6.translatedText: However, Uber’s self-driving cars have caused controversy. Alphabet’s self-driving unit, Waymo, is also testing self-driving cars in Arizona. At the beginning of the year, it sued Uber, claiming that Uber had stolen lidar design data. Uber responded that the lawsuit was baseless.

487aaa78f7baf5655e5343776353c799848eba16.sourceText: 从照片看撞车事故比较严重。Waymo无人驾驶汽车已经在公共道路上行驶200多万英里，汽车发生的事故大部分都很轻微，许多时候是在车流繁忙的地区无人驾驶汽车后部被其它汽车撞上。（星海）
487aaa78f7baf5655e5343776353c799848eba16.translatedText: From the photos, it looks like the crash was serious. Waymo's self-driving cars have driven more than 2 million miles on public roads. Most of the accidents involving their cars have been minor, many of which involve the rear of their self-driving cars being hit by other cars in busy areas. (Xinghai)

7c8a31465c91e8099dc903e0a51d45ddd4365f59.translatedText: More than 175,000 Arizona residents who received blood tests from the laboratory company will receive full refunds, according to a settlement between Theranos Inc. Compensation will reach $4.65 million

731c3f729d4bd114d61b13d1f1efe44af64cd1dd.sourceText: Theranos创始人Elizabeth Holmes 图片来源：BRENDAN MCDERMID/REUTERS
731c3f729d4bd114d61b13d1f1efe44af64cd1dd.translatedText: Theranos founder Elizabeth Holmes Photo source: BRENDAN MCDERMID/REUTERS

5ec8db4e2fae0c808f0183671791732187d6970e.sourceText: 根据Theranos Inc.与亚利桑那州检察长之间达成的和解协议，逾17.5万名接受了这家实验室公司血液检测的亚利桑那州居民将获得全额退款。
5ec8db4e2fae0c808f0183671791732187d6970e.translatedText: More than 175,000 Arizona residents who received blood tests from the laboratory company will receive full refunds under a settlement agreement between Theranos Inc. and the Arizona Attorney General.

8a6e69332d4e2b3b3a432f8e26db063dfd6cf99d.sourceText: 上述协议要求Theranos向一个州立偿付基金支付465万美元，从而解决了这家陷入困境的硅谷公司的又一项法律挑战。Theranos同时将支付20万美元民事罚款和2.5万美元州法律费用。该公司未承认存在不当行为。
8a6e69332d4e2b3b3a432f8e26db063dfd6cf99d.translatedText: The agreement requires Theranos to pay $4.65 million into a state sinking fund, resolving yet another legal challenge by the troubled Silicon Valley company. Theranos will also pay a $200,000 civil penalty and $25,000 in state legal fees. The company has not admitted wrongdoing.

bd3ced5f37f54e7f50a602f3a2873df04c60fd40.sourceText: 上述协议是两天来围绕Theranos血液检测技术或实验室操作存在缺陷的指控而达成的第二起和解协议。该公司周一已与联邦健康监管部门达成监管和法律和解协议，创始人Elizabeth Holmes及该公司同意暂停从事医学实验业务两年。
bd3ced5f37f54e7f50a602f3a2873df04c60fd40.translatedText: The above-mentioned agreement is the second settlement reached in two days surrounding allegations that Theranos' blood testing technology or laboratory operations were defective. The company reached a regulatory and legal settlement with federal health regulators on Monday, with founder Elizabeth Holmes and the company agreeing to suspend medical experimentation for two years.

c3f6018ae3cfb52302e32e2d0cd1c4aa6ae6041d.sourceText: Theranos同时还面临一系列法律挑战，其中包括有关其是否误导投资者的刑事和民事调查。Theranos之前的零售合作伙伴、药店巨头Walgreens Co.及其他一些投资者也向该公司提出了诉讼。
c3f6018ae3cfb52302e32e2d0cd1c4aa6ae6041d.translatedText: Theranos also faces a series of legal challenges, including criminal and civil investigations into whether it misled investors. Theranos' former retail partner, drugstore giant Walgreens Co. and other investors also filed lawsuits against the company.

16a29b8f7c7781e41f2c9a97b0bb70df00597da1.sourceText: 5 月 27 日， 希望中文学校专门组织了一场面向高中生的如何准备和申请大学讲座 。 两位优秀华裔高中毕业生陈卓婷 (Allison Chen) 和王振东 (Zhengdong Wang) 将分享自己高中阶段如何备战和申请大学的经验， 欢迎学 生及家长积极参加，了解大学申请的流程。
16a29b8f7c7781e41f2c9a97b0bb70df00597da1.translatedText: On May 27, Hope Chinese School organized a lecture for high school students on how to prepare and apply for college. Two outstanding Chinese high school graduates, Allison Chen and Zhengdong Wang, will share their experiences in preparing for and applying to college in high school. 12a881a951ad58856e3002b6960cbce74e4a1d3e.translatedText: >The Chinese translation of the document reads as follows:

5d33be15a1370eca786a0e84bb17f87e26ec1344.sourceText: 根据美利坚合众国和中华帝国之间1894年3月17日缔结，1894年12月7日签署，并于1894年12月8日由美利坚合众国总统批准颁发的条约， 注册中国劳工回中国并有意返回美国是符合商务和劳工部1906年2月5日颁布的规定的。
5d33be15a1370eca786a0e84bb17f87e26ec1344.translatedText: Pursuant to the treaty concluded on March 17, 1894, signed on December 7, 1894, and ratified and promulgated by the President of the United States of America on December 8, 1894, between the United States of America and the Empire of China, Registering Chinese workers to return to China with the intention of returning to the United States is in compliance with the regulations promulgated by the Department of Commerce and Labor on February 5, 1906.

bff41a46b3e34d01550678e5d012b7af8dd8db36.sourceText: 邝升（（Sing Kewong 的中文译音），附像片）希望离开美国回中国并打算返回美国。应邝升要求并根据相应中美条约，俄勒冈州波特兰市税收员亨利 布拉赫曼，于1894年5月3日，向菲尼斯(Phoenix)开具 了要求返回美国的权利证书– 编号＃127865，并附他的照片一式两份，和他在美国的个人， 家庭，财产及别人欠他债务的完整描述。如下：

cc74ab960818e1fbf50a09070de63436b520a562.sourceText: ”过年啦！过年啦!”随着孩子们的拜年声，轰轰烈烈的锣鼓声，彩带飞翼的礼炮声，第八届亚省春晚2017年1月28日大年初一在美莎艺术中心盛大开幕。在新春之际，中国驻洛杉矶总领事馆侨务组组长王学政领事代表总领馆出席了春晚和亚省华人一起迎接新年。亚利桑那州州长DougDucey委托Gilbert市州众议员Eddie Farnsworth代表州长出席亚省春晚，隆重宣布1月28日为亚利桑那州”亚裔农历新年日”。资深侨领余文劲，亚省时报社长甄硕钦，亚省华人华侨联合会主席李健，钱德勒市议员黄馨民，侨领张华芳，耆英会主席尹凤影，侨领高志中等都出席了本次春晚，上千观众一起欢度”中国年”。
cc74ab960818e1fbf50a09070de63436b520a562.translatedText: "It's New Year! It's New Year!" With the children's New Year's greetings, the vigorous sound of gongs and drums, and the salute of ribbons and flying wings, the 8th Alberta Spring Festival Gala opened grandly on January 28, 2017, the first day of the Lunar New Year, at the Meisha Art Center. On the occasion of the New Year, Consul Wang Xuezheng, head of the Overseas Chinese Affairs Section of the Chinese Consulate General in Los Angeles, attended the Spring Festival Gala on behalf of the Consulate General to welcome the New Year with Chinese people in Alberta. Arizona Governor Doug Ducey entrusted Gilbert City State Representative Eddie Farnsworth to attend the Alberta Spring Festival Gala on behalf of the governor and solemnly declared January 28 as Arizona’s “Asian Lunar New Year Day”. Senior overseas Chinese leader Yu Wenjin, President of the Alberta Times Zhen Shuoqin, Chairman of the Overseas Chinese Federation of Alberta Li Jian, Chandler City Councilor Huang Xinmin, overseas Chinese leader Zhang Huafang, Chairman of the Senior Citizens Association Yin Fengying, and overseas Chinese leader Gao Zhizhong all attended the Spring Festival Gala, and thousands of viewers celebrated the "Year of China" together.

d40d16c799774d086a079f9c7bfd99b875884c0c.translatedText: Chinese Culture Sings a Great Drama

e4a7e4ae0cc539c9cc9d6ffc04066fe9bc9bc12a.sourceText: ”安塞腰鼓”以磅礴的气势，精湛的表现力令人陶醉，被称为天下第一鼓。为了本次春晚让观众们体会到最地道的中华节日文化，亚省艺术学院千里迢迢，辗转几个城市，把从中国运来的大鼓带到了舞台上，从5岁的小朋友，到60多岁大叔，一起同台，挥起鼓棒，唱起来，跳起来，敲响新春序曲。
e4a7e4ae0cc539c9cc9d6ffc04066fe9bc9bc12a.translatedText: "Ansai Waist Drum" is intoxicating with its majestic momentum and exquisite expressiveness, and is known as the best drum in the world. In order for this Spring Festival Gala to allow the audience to experience the most authentic Chinese festival culture, the Art Institute of Alberta traveled thousands of miles to several cities to bring the big drums shipped from China to the stage. From 5-year-old children to 60-year-old uncles, they all shared the stage, waved the drum sticks, sang, danced, and played the New Year prelude.

6dd7a9799db5f3034f676892015f51b744b2d352.sourceText: 藏族舞蹈《圣浴》展示了第二代华裔移民对中华文化的理解。亚利桑那艺术学院的杰出演员彭天悦在舞蹈中表现了一个美丽的藏族姑娘与神灵的对话。没有到过西藏的她，是通过舞蹈来认识中国的。她说”我有中国人的外貌，那没有什么特别，作为亚裔成绩全优也没有什么特别，但是我懂中国文化，它才使我特别”。她跳藏族舞后，开始知道什么是藏传佛教，藏族人祭拜的方式，宗教与他们生活的关系。她精湛的舞蹈技艺，将藏族姑娘的爽朗活泼表现的淋漓尽致。这个舞蹈也在刚刚结束的海外”桃李杯”国际舞蹈大赛获得了最高奖白金奖。晚会的艺术总监邱晓榕，为了鼓励更多华裔年轻人了解中华文化艺术，为彭天悦颁发了杰出演员奖。
6dd7a9799db5f3034f676892015f51b744b2d352.translatedText: The Tibetan dance "Holy Bath" demonstrated the second generation Chinese immigrants' understanding of Chinese culture. Peng Tianyue, an outstanding actor from the Arizona College of the Arts, performed a beautiful Tibetan girl's dialogue with the gods in her dance. Having never been to Tibet, she got to know China through dance. She said, "I have a Chinese appearance, and that's nothing special. Being Asian and getting straight A's is nothing special, but I understand Chinese culture, and that makes me special." After dancing Tibetan dance, she began to know what Tibetan Buddhism is, the way Tibetan people worship, and the relationship between religion and their lives. Her superb dancing skills vividly express the liveliness and liveliness of Tibetan girls. This dance also won the highest award, the Platinum Award, in the just-concluded overseas "Taoli Cup" International Dance Competition. Qiu Xiaorong, the artistic director of the party, presented Peng Tianyue with the Outstanding Actor Award in order to encourage more young Chinese people to understand Chinese culture and art.

992186d329ba075edbdcd403983f08f7f69cff2b.sourceText: 亚省现代中文学校和希望中文学校将中国小朋友的绘画作品全都带到了晚会现场。晚会的前厅被装饰成了画廊。2017年是金鸡报春。小朋友们就以此位题，画起了色彩斑斓的大公鸡。中国新年到，小朋友心中的春节都有什么呢？小朋友画了辟邪驱魔，兴隆祥瑞灵物舞狮，还有的小朋友记得”年年有余”画了金鱼，”春节”是我们最重要的节日，当然少不了美丽的鲜花。两个中文学校的参与，让我们的中国年过得更有文化色彩，从歌舞到绘画，未来我们还将浓墨重彩的中国字，一起在春晚展出，致力于将”亚省春晚”打造成中华文化的名片。
992186d329ba075edbdcd403983f08f7f69cff2b.translatedText: Alberta Modern Chinese School and Hope Chinese School brought all the paintings of Chinese children to the party. The party's front room was decorated as a gallery. 2017 is the golden rooster heralding spring. The children drew colorful roosters based on this theme. Chinese New Year is here, what do children think about during the Spring Festival? The children drew paintings to ward off evil spirits, and lion dances to promote prosperity and auspiciousness. Some children remembered that "more than every year" was celebrated and painted goldfish. "Spring Festival" is our most important festival, and of course beautiful flowers are indispensable. The participation of two Chinese schools makes our Chinese New Year more culturally colorful, from singing and dancing to painting. In the future, we will also display Chinese characters with rich colors in the Spring Festival Gala, and are committed to making the "Alberta Spring Festival Gala" a business card of Chinese culture.

ac457a377ed42e12b20c07ed3544467a4a4d94d8.sourceText: 部分现代中文学校和希望中文学校绘画作品
ac457a377ed42e12b20c07ed3544467a4a4d94d8.translatedText: Some paintings from Modern Chinese School and Hope Chinese School

2d7f80a314482f6fecd3e2c1f691da31d0de7223.sourceText: 说了这么多，别以为”亚省春晚”就是亚省华裔的自娱自乐，经过这么多年的演出和推广，”亚省春晚”的品质越来越得到美国朋友的认可。蓝眼睛，金头发的小朋友拿起了手绢，绸带扭起了秧歌。他们也兴高采烈地扭到了我们春晚的舞台上，更让”亚省春晚”锦上添花。今年Tarwater小学和Coronado小学都从亚省艺术学院聘请了老师，开设了中华艺术课，舞龙灯，转手绢受到了学生们的热烈欢迎。
2d7f80a314482f6fecd3e2c1f691da31d0de7223.translatedText: Having said all this, don’t think that the “Alberta Spring Festival Gala” is just for Chinese people in Alberta to entertain themselves. After so many years of performances and promotions, the quality of the “Alberta Spring Festival Gala” has been increasingly recognized by American friends. The child with blue eyes and blond hair picked up the handkerchief and twisted the ribbon to perform the Yangko dance. They also happily performed on the stage of our Spring Festival Gala, which made the "Alberta Spring Festival Gala" even better. This year, both Tarwater Elementary School and Coronado Elementary School hired teachers from the Art Institute of Alberta to offer Chinese art classes, dragon lantern dancing, and handkerchief changing, which were warmly welcomed by the students.

53cb8222d29d61ef948a10279acbbe22fc2e05b5.sourceText: 艺术作品彰显当地华人的艺术水准
53cb8222d29d61ef948a10279acbbe22fc2e05b5.translatedText: The artistic works highlight the artistic standards of the local Chinese

a5feb418caff690ed6c122db1743c9a0ed991db1.sourceText: 舞蹈《雀之灵》《当代节奏》都非常受观众的喜爱。雀之灵的表演者多达28人，她们中很多人年龄虽小，但是学习中国民族舞已经好多年，把孔雀空灵优美的曲线展现在舞台上，曼妙优雅的傣族音乐，将所有的观众带到了西双版纳那个美妙的地方。领舞陈思，纤细优雅的舞姿更让观众看得如痴如醉。大型现代舞《当代节奏》是本次春晚的一匹黑马，她们中有专业的舞蹈老师，学习多年舞蹈的舞者，还有从来没有上过舞台的普通的工程师和办公室美女。这个舞蹈让他们放下手中的电脑，手机，开始运动，开始学习我们中国的现代舞蹈。用舞蹈来表现当下的生活。每年春晚的大合唱，更是当地文艺爱好者的大联欢，中华乐团负责人蔡善皋将亚利桑那各种年龄的声乐爱好者组织在一起，娱乐的当地华人的生活，又让大家在艺术修养上有大大的提高。
a5feb418caff690ed6c122db1743c9a0ed991db1.translatedText: The dances "Sparrow Spirit" and "Contemporary Rhythm" are very popular with the audience. There are as many as 28 performers in Bird Spirit. Many of them are young, but they have been studying Chinese folk dance for many years. They show the ethereal and graceful curves of the peacock on the stage, and the graceful and elegant Dai music brings all the audience to the wonderful place of Xishuangbanna. The lead dancer, Chen Si, mesmerized the audience with her slender and elegant dance moves. The large-scale modern dance "Contemporary Rhythm" is a dark horse of this Spring Festival Gala. Among them are professional dance teachers, dancers who have studied dance for many years, as well as ordinary engineers and office beauties who have never been on stage. This dance allows them to put down their computers and mobile phones, start exercising, and start learning our Chinese modern dance. Use dance to express current life. The annual Spring Festival Gala chorus is a grand gathering for local art lovers. Cai Shangao, the head of the Chinese Orchestra, organizes vocal music lovers of all ages in Arizona to entertain the lives of local Chinese and greatly improve everyone's artistic accomplishment.

9781b1ce2cf7031aa0a658938b746ce67c6cbe4f.sourceText: 老少同拜年 慈善永流传
9781b1ce2cf7031aa0a658938b746ce67c6cbe4f.translatedText: >New Year greetings from all ages Charity spreads forever

e6f17cce365e063214d7e8f53d0661d04c271d5f.sourceText: 今年亚省春晚组委会，邀请了20位华裔老人到现场一起同庆新春。春晚的总策划吕丽华，将这份心意无偿捐助给耆英会。”亚省春晚”是社区的非盈利活动，每年在我们欢度春节的时候，都希望有更多需要帮助的人能分享我们的快乐。最近三年，”亚省春晚”已经捐助了鼓励骨髓移植登记的”守护天使基金”，关注中国残障儿童的’蝴蝶基金’关注亚利桑那亚裔健康的”裔社区促进会”，相信未来，更多的华裔会知道我们的新传统，将更多的爱心奉献给社区，是我们春节的重要组成部分。更多的企业也跟我们在一起，亚省视力医院（Arizona抯Vison）, 富国银行（Wellsfargo）王楠医生，利利华人超市都成为了”亚省春晚”的长期赞助商。
e6f17cce365e063214d7e8f53d0661d04c271d5f.translatedText: This year’s Alberta Spring Festival Gala Organizing Committee invited 20 Chinese elderly people to celebrate the New Year together. Lu Lihua, the chief planner of the Spring Festival Gala, donated her heart to the Senior Citizens Association free of charge. "Alberta Spring Festival Gala" is a non-profit event in the community. Every year when we celebrate the Spring Festival, we hope that more people in need can share our happiness. In the past three years, the "Alberta Spring Festival Gala" has donated to the "Guardian Angel Fund" that encourages bone marrow transplant registration, the "Butterfly Fund" that focuses on disabled children in China, and the "American Community Promotion Association" that focuses on the health of Arizona Asians. I believe that in the future, more Chinese Americans will know our new traditions and dedicate more love to the community, which is an important part of our Spring Festival. More companies are joining us. Arizona's Vision Hospital, Wellsfargo, Dr. Wang Nan, and Lily Chinese Supermarket have all become long-term sponsors of the "Alberta Spring Festival Gala".

0cabe0ba4e249e511a3c803622922263b4ad3b52.sourceText: 又是一年春来到，百花齐放，百家争鸣。今天近1500亚省友人们一起欢庆我们的节日，唱中国歌，跳中国舞，看中国画，中华文化是我们每一位华裔的骄傲，他让美国社区看到璀璨的5000年中华文明，我们每个人就是中华文化的符号，留住民族的，就能唱响世界的！相约明年春晚，我们不见不散！
0cabe0ba4e249e511a3c803622922263b4ad3b52.translatedText: Another spring has arrived, with a hundred flowers blooming and a hundred schools of thought contending. Today, nearly 1,500 Alberta friends celebrated our festival together, singing Chinese songs, dancing Chinese dances, and watching Chinese paintings. Chinese culture is the pride of every Chinese-American. It allows the American community to see the splendid 5,000-year-old Chinese civilization. Each of us is a symbol of Chinese culture. Those who retain the nation can sing to the world! Let’s meet at the Spring Festival Gala next year. See you there!

057502b1a485dcf1aebdc7c3de4ac3375f615a38.translatedText: The dragon and the tiger leap forward to signify a good harvest, and the majestic lion brings good luck. Tzu Chi’s lions kicked off the New Year blessings

706866b4209ea8deb165d498ed3ca6385127cd65.sourceText: 发放福慧红包是每次活动中最让大德们期待的时刻。每一个红包都满载着上人无量的感恩与祝福。上人希望天下苍生，广行环保弘人文。虽然上人不能亲临现场祝福，由慈济的师兄师姊代发红包。
706866b4209ea8deb165d498ed3ca6385127cd65.translatedText: Distributing red envelopes of blessing and wisdom is the most anticipated moment of every event for the great virtues. Every red envelope is filled with the Master’s immeasurable gratitude and blessings. The Master hopes that all people in the world will promote environmental protection and promote humanities. Although the Master could not be present to give blessings in person, the brothers and sisters of Tzu Chi distributed the red envelopes on his behalf.

871cd269f344e8b5c6b4da6e8e187a89f2aad9ea.translatedText: Children from the Children’s Advancement Class competed in sign language ‘Children of the Earth’

aae1584c92c7207fe140a33c89270fb2375887f4.sourceText: 最后，百名会众点亮心灯，举燈齐眉，虔心祈願，淨化人心，天下無災無難，羊年是个平安吉祥的福慧年。
aae1584c92c7207fe140a33c89270fb2375887f4.translatedText: Finally, a hundred members of the congregation lit their heart lanterns, raised the lanterns to their eyebrows, and prayed sincerely to purify people’s hearts, so that there would be no disasters in the world, and the Year of the Sheep would be a peaceful and auspicious year of blessing and wisdom.

Huiming The sound of firecrackers outside the window, singing and dancing on the stage. Unexpectedly, things have changed, and the school has become full of spring spirit. The principal issued...

de84401982c051b2224edca5b6bea05e468070f9.sourceText: 祖荀中文学校2017 年春节游园活动纪实 慧明 窗外爆竹声， 舞台歌舞嬉。 不意风水转， 学校聚春气。 校长发红包， 师生露喜气。 虽是晚到了，（$1） 胜领百万银。 精神抖擞起， 雀跃游园去。 这边旗袍秀， 女孩最欢喜。 左顾还右盼， 照相更美丽。 那边象棋盘， 鏖战显英姿： 姐弟同出招， 父子共帅旗。 远山雪未逝， 战士汗已滴。 更有拔河赛， 欢声震天际： 赢了笑颜开， 输了不服气： 细心察对手， 怎么你们多一骑？ 还有抢椅子， 有点神经质： 都等音乐起， 又怕歌声止; 坐下又起来， 起来就没位子。 还是跳格好， 全凭好运气： 赢了笑嘻嘻， 输了不要紧， 看着别人蛋糕一样笑眯眯。 看看却简单， 做做都不易： 夹住巧克力， 扯铃踢毽子， 哪个不是巧用力； 就是投篮球， 也要水滴石穿练毅力； 无论猜灯谜， 更要熟读天下书与诗。 再看书法坛， 为师龙凤舞， 学生描红字。 希冀某一天， 图桑也出一个王羲之。 隔壁涂鸦地， 也是好景致： 红花配绿叶， 蜡笔显童稚。 不料有高手， 游剪若神似 咔嚓一刀去， 红纸变灯笼。 不知再一刀， 老母鸡可会变鸭子？ 忽听厅外喧， 却见乒乓戏。 初生牛犊不怕虎， 欲与老夫嘻。 不料还是老姜辣， 小牛只得讪讪归。 又见父子兵， 枪挑双打骑。（ji） 转换似飞轮， 急急如风驰。 终是胜者赢， 皆大都欢喜。 感谢三女孩， 撑起学生小天地； 感恩校董会， 送来春节新风气。 祝愿加祝愿， 明天更甜蜜。 期盼复期盼， 明年再相会。
de84401982c051b2224edca5b6bea05e468070f9.translatedText: Record of the 2017 Spring Festival garden activities of Zuxun Chinese School Huiming The sound of firecrackers outside the window, singing and dancing on the stage. Unexpectedly, things have changed, and the school has become full of spring spirit. The principal handed out red envelopes, and the teachers and students looked happy. Although he arrived late, ($1) won a million silver dollars. I am full of energy and excited to visit the garden. Girls enjoy the cheongsam show here the most. Looking left and right, taking pictures is more beautiful. Over there is a chessboard, a fierce battle showing off heroic figures: sister and brother making moves together, father and son commanding the flag together. The snow in the distant mountains has not yet passed away, but the soldiers are already sweating. There is also a tug-of-war match, with cheers filling the sky: If you win, you will be smiling, but if you lose, you will not be convinced: Look at your opponent carefully, why do you want to ride more? There is also musical chairs, and I am a bit nervous: I wait for the music to start, but I am afraid that the singing will stop; I sit down and get up, but when I get up, there is no seat. It's better to jump, it all depends on good luck: you smile when you win, it doesn't matter if you lose, you smile like looking at other people's cakes. It looks simple, but it is not easy to do: clamping chocolates, pulling bells and kicking shuttlecocks, none of them are skillful; even shooting basketball requires perseverance through drops of water; whether it is guessing lantern riddles, it is also necessary to be familiar with books and poems from all over the world. Looking at the calligraphy forum again, the dragon and phoenix are dancing for the teacher, and the students are tracing the red letters. I hope that one day, Tucson will also have a Wang Xizhi. The graffiti field next door is also a beautiful scene: red flowers and green leaves, and the crayons look childish. Unexpectedly, there is a master, and the scissors are like gods. With a click of the knife, the red paper turns into a lantern. I wonder if the old hen will turn into a duck with one more blow? Suddenly I heard the noise outside the hall and saw a table tennis play. A newborn calf is not afraid of tigers, but wants to be with the old man. Unexpectedly, it was still old ginger, and the calf had to return home. I saw father and son soldiers again, fighting against cavalry in pairs with spears. (ji) Transition is like a flywheel, and rush is like the wind. In the end, the winner wins, and everyone is happy. Thanks to the three girls for supporting the small world of students; thanks to the school board for bringing in the new spirit of the Spring Festival. Wishes and wishes, tomorrow will be sweeter. Looking forward to seeing you again next year.

0da5b197411395639b6cb91e5cdc85261b6b863c.sourceText: 2017 年 1 月 5 日，亚利桑那州立大学 2017 年春季迎新大会在学生中心（纪念礼堂）楼 202 报告厅隆重举行。凤凰城科工专协会会长，海通建筑公司总裁，李江博士作为华人代表应邀出席并发表了精彩演讲。
0da5b197411395639b6cb91e5cdc85261b6b863c.translatedText: January 5, 2017, Arizona State University 2017 Spring Orientation Assembly was in the Student Center (Memorial Auditorium) Building 202 Lecture Hall was held grandly. Dr. Li Jiang, President of the Phoenix Association of Science and Technology Professionals and President of Haitong Construction Company, was invited to attend as a Chinese representative and delivered a wonderful speech.

678b3d7ff51625da91c13a2484352c5841480ed7.sourceText: 通过演讲，李江博士与新生们分享了自己在美国奋斗三十载的人生经历，还介绍了凤凰城的风土人情及华人现状，并从亲身经历出发安抚国际新生们的思乡情绪，同时还鼓励同学们在大学阶段不仅要保证学业，还要多接触社会，最后邀请同学们参加凤凰城一年一度的华人迎接农历新年活动。
678b3d7ff51625da91c13a2484352c5841480ed7.translatedText: Through his speech, Dr. Li Jiang shared his 30-year life experience in the United States with the freshmen. He also introduced the customs of Phoenix and the current situation of the Chinese. Based on his personal experience, he comforted the homesickness of the international freshmen. He also encouraged the students to not only ensure their studies in college, but also get more contact with the society. Finally, he invited the students to participate in the annual Chinese New Year event in Phoenix.

01a08d149aac5819595dcbdc36d9529116ef4fea.sourceText: 会后，李江博士在台下与同学们亲切交流。除了中国学生，还有不乏印度、欧美的学生向李博士请教，李博士耐心地为同学们一一作答。
01a08d149aac5819595dcbdc36d9529116ef4fea.translatedText: After the meeting, Dr. Li Jiang had a cordial exchange with the students in the audience. In addition to Chinese students, there were also many students from India, Europe and the United States who asked Dr. Li for advice. Dr. Li patiently answered the students one by one.

2d1d250f039bce2362eb4078f37af558ef751a2b.translatedText: The Confucius Institute at ASU joins hands with the Chinese Consulate General in Los Angeles to host the “Arizona-China Culture Day” On the morning of September 24, 2016, local time, in order to promote...

e6f7e5273432096dd4c4b18e858b89986d670508.sourceText: 当地时间2016年9月24日上午，为了促进中美文化交流和庆贺中秋佳节，美国亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院携手中国驻洛杉矶总领事馆在亚利桑那州立大学坦佩校区的OldMain Carson Ballroom大楼内联合举办了2016年”亚利桑那－中国 文化日”文艺汇演。来自国内的中国歌剧舞剧院民族管弦乐团,亚利桑那州立大学学生和孔子学院旗下孔子课堂的学生们一起为大家献上了一场精彩的文化盛宴。
e6f7e5273432096dd4c4b18e858b89986d670508.translatedText: On the morning of September 24, 2016, local time, in order to promote cultural exchanges between China and the United States and celebrate the Mid-Autumn Festival, the Confucius Institute at Arizona State University and the Chinese Consulate General in Los Angeles jointly held the 2016 "Arizona-China Culture Day" theatrical performance in the Old Main Carson Ballroom on the Tempe campus of Arizona State University. The National Orchestra of China Opera and Dance Theater from China, students from Arizona State University and students from the Confucius Classroom under the Confucius Institute presented a wonderful cultural feast to everyone.

b4f0afd3ee292642cb6191acade42807abe67388.sourceText: 中国驻洛杉矶总领事馆刘健总领事（左五）及夫人陈小铃女士（左四）、亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院院长Robert Joe Cutter博士（左七）、副院长Fannie Tam女士（第二排右一）、亚利桑那州参议员Kimberly Yee女士（第一排左六）、Tempe市议员Kolby Granville先生、亚利桑那州立大学文理学院人文系院长暨知识发展副校长GeorgeJustice博士、Global Launch常务董事Julia Rosen以及中国歌剧舞剧院民族管弦乐团团长Wei Yin Jiu先生。
b4f0afd3ee292642cb6191acade42807abe67388.translatedText: Consul General of the Chinese Consulate General in Los Angeles Liu Jian (fifth from left) and his wife Ms. Chen Xiaoling (fourth from left), Director of the Confucius Institute at Arizona State University Dr. Robert Joe Cutter (seventh from left), Vice President Ms. Fannie Tam (second row, first from right), Arizona State Senator Ms. Kimberly Yee (first row, sixth from left), Tempe City Councilor Kolby Mr. Granville, Dr. George Justice, Dean of the Department of Humanities and Vice President for Knowledge Development in the College of Arts and Sciences at Arizona State University, Julia Rosen, Managing Director of Global Launch, and Mr. Wei Yin Jiu, Director of the Chinese Opera and Dance Theater National Orchestra.

e6547eb80471453c34757948bf0af9e5219ba3e1.sourceText: 中国驻洛杉矶总领事馆刘健总领事、亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院院长RobertJoe Cutter博士、副院长Fannie Tam女士,美国亚利桑那州参议员Kimberly Yee女士、Gilbert市长John Lewis先生、坦佩市议员Kolby Granville、亚利桑那州立大学文理学院人文系院长暨知识发展副校长GeorgeJustice博士,Global Launch常务董事 Julia Rosen以及亚利桑那州侨界代表们近200人出席。
e6547eb80471453c34757948bf0af9e5219ba3e1.translatedText: Consul General Liu Jian of the Chinese Consulate General in Los Angeles, Dr. Robert Joe Cutter, Director of the Confucius Institute at Arizona State University, Ms. Fannie Tam, Vice President, Ms. Kimberly Yee, U.S. Senator of Arizona, Mr. John Lewis, Mayor of Gilbert, Kolby Granville, Tempe City Councilor, Dr. George Justice, Dean of the Department of Humanities and Vice President for Knowledge Development in the College of Arts and Sciences at Arizona State University, and Julia, Managing Director of Global Launch Rosen and nearly 200 representatives from the Arizona overseas community attended.

9c0bfeaa07a40b2595d082d1c8d624449f604deb.sourceText: 本次汇演主办方：（左至右）Fannie Tam副院长，刘健总领事，Robert Joe Cutter院长、和人文系主任George Justice博士。
9c0bfeaa07a40b2595d082d1c8d624449f604deb.translatedText: The organizers of this performance: (left to right) Vice Dean Fannie Tam, Consul General Liu Jian, Dean Robert Joe Cutter, and Dr. George Justice, Dean of the Department of Humanities.

147a4c391873611a7c42261c202ff07fde55ae15.sourceText: 亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院院长RobertJoe Cutter博士和中国驻洛杉矶总领事馆刘健总领事为本场演出致了开幕词。Cutter院长用中英双语为大家介绍了今天的到场的嘉宾和亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院近年来在中文教育工作的进展和成果。刘健总领事首先感谢了亚利桑那州各界对本次活动和中美文化交流的大力支持，并肯定了亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院在推广汉语教学、推动中美文化交流等方面所做的贡献。在致辞中，刘健总领事回顾了近年来中国在经济上令世人瞩目的进步，并对中美双边贸易和投资的前景充满希望。他表示中美之间的经贸往来能够把两国人民联系在一起，并实现互利双赢。
147a4c391873611a7c42261c202ff07fde55ae15.translatedText: > Dr. Robert Joe Cutter, Director of the Confucius Institute at Arizona State University, and Liu Jian, Consul General of the Chinese Consulate General in Los Angeles, delivered opening remarks for the performance. Dean Cutter introduced today’s guests in Chinese and English and the progress and achievements of the Confucius Institute at Arizona State University in Chinese education in recent years. Consul General Liu Jian first thanked all walks of life in Arizona for their strong support for this event and cultural exchanges between China and the United States, and affirmed the contribution of the Confucius Institute at Arizona State University in promoting Chinese teaching and promoting cultural exchanges between China and the United States. In his speech, Consul General Liu Jian reviewed China's remarkable economic progress in recent years and was full of hope for the prospects of Sino-US bilateral trade and investment. He said that economic and trade exchanges between China and the United States can connect the two peoples and achieve mutual benefit and win-win results.

a713e3f1a3a3edde84b971f30c601ebe1a33c55f.sourceText: 亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院院长Robert Joe Cutter博士、文理学院人文系主任暨知识企业发展办公室副主席George Justice博士和Gilbert市长John Lewis先生亲切交谈。
a713e3f1a3a3edde84b971f30c601ebe1a33c55f.translatedText: Dr. Robert Joe Cutter, Director of the Confucius Institute at Arizona State University, Dr. George Justice, Dean of the Humanities Department of the College of Arts and Sciences and Vice Chairman of the Office of Knowledge Enterprise Development, and Mr. John Lewis, Mayor of Gilbert, had a cordial conversation.

b63f6649ab703ca447610ae64ada0dc0b631928c.sourceText: 亚利桑那州华裔参议员KimberlyYee女士也为本次文艺汇演做了精彩的致辞。正值中秋佳节，Yee参议员为大家讲述了自己对于中秋节的回忆并告诉大家她最喜欢吃黑豆沙月饼。此外，作为亚利桑那州唯一的亚裔参议员，她还和大家分享了她的家庭从中国移民到美国，并如何通过辛勤地劳动实现了他们的美国梦的经历。
b63f6649ab703ca447610ae64ada0dc0b631928c.translatedText: Ms. Kimberly Yee, Chinese-American Senator of Arizona, also gave a wonderful speech for this cultural performance. As it is the Mid-Autumn Festival, Senator Yee told everyone about her memories of the Mid-Autumn Festival and told everyone that her favorite is black bean paste mooncakes. In addition, as the only Asian senator in Arizona, she also shared her family’s experience of immigrating to the United States from China and realizing their American dream through hard work.

afcbbc8789cc67ebadc5d8f8d5d60b5b75ed483d.sourceText: 激烈雄壮的古曲《霸王卸甲》拉开了演出的序幕。担任本次汇演的主持人中国驻洛杉矶总领事馆文化领王瑾和Jonny Dangerfield是毕业于亚利桑那州立大学中文领航项目并曾经在”汉语桥”美国西南赛区中比赛中摘得桂冠。本次汇演节目丰富多彩精妙绝伦，来自中国和美国双方的节目完美地统一起来，营造出和谐美满的气氛。
afcbbc8789cc67ebadc5d8f8d5d60b5b75ed483d.translatedText: The fierce and majestic ancient song "Overlord Disarms" kicked off the performance. The hosts of this performance are Wang Jin and Jonny Dangerfield, cultural officers of the Chinese Consulate General in Los Angeles, who graduated from the Chinese Language Navigation Program at Arizona State University and won the championship in the "Chinese Bridge" Southwest Division Competition in the United States. The program of this performance was rich, colorful and exquisite. The programs from China and the United States were perfectly unified, creating a harmonious and happy atmosphere.

caf2fb37ddf1878de35cc45771efb23b718b19ff.sourceText: 其中，来自中国歌剧舞剧院民族管弦乐团的艺术家们纷纷拿出自己的绝活，无论是描绘火车开进侗乡时人们的喜悦和对向往幸福美满生活的芦笙独奏《火车进侗乡》，还是中西合璧、粗狂风趣的古筝与大提琴《渔舟唱晚》，又或是刚劲有力，充满激情的京胡与乐队《夜深沉》，艺术家们的精彩演出向中美观众展示出了中国5000年深厚的文化艺术底蕴。观众们如痴如醉地聆听着这些来自异域陌生却又夺人心魄的传统音乐，久久不能回神。
caf2fb37ddf1878de35cc45771efb23b718b19ff.translatedText: Among them, artists from the National Orchestra of China Opera and Dance Drama Theater have come up with their own unique skills, whether they are depicting people's joy and yearning for happiness when the train enters Dong Township. Whether it is the reed solo "The Train Enters the Dong Country", which is a happy life, or the Chinese and Western, rough and funny guzheng and cello "Fishing Boat Sings Evening", or the powerful and passionate Jinghu and band "Deep Night", the wonderful performances of the artists showed China's 5,000-year-old profound cultural and artistic heritage to Chinese and American audiences. The audience listened to these strange but soul-stirring traditional music from a foreign land with fascination, and could not get back to their senses for a long time.

9a6f42a1a6ceb049b9fb20ccffe985d025c71e1d.sourceText: 来自亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院旗下塔沃特小学孔子课堂的学生们合唱《静夜思》和《世界小小小》
9a6f42a1a6ceb049b9fb20ccffe985d025c71e1d.translatedText: >Students from the Confucius Classroom at Tawater Elementary School under the Confucius Institute at Arizona State University sang "Quiet Night Thoughts" and "It's a Small World"

4a3d413b7becfda28bae79de48815d39b4823a70.sourceText: 亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院中文领航项目毕业生 Emrie Tomaiko 独唱《新贵妃醉酒》。
4a3d413b7becfda28bae79de48815d39b4823a70.translatedText: Emrie Tomaiko, a graduate of the Chinese Language Navigation Program of the Confucius Institute at Arizona State University, sang "The Drunken Princess" solo.

596b0edfc9bedaadc8051e4b1ab8537448d643b2.sourceText: 来自亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院旗下塔沃特小学孔子课堂的学生们则为大家带来了两首精彩的合唱《静夜思》和《世界小小小》。只见小朋友们身穿传统中国服饰，台风稳健且字正腔圆地唱出每一句的歌词，得到观众们的一致好评。而当来自亚利桑那州立大学的EmrieTomaiko身着一套红色旗袍，开口唱出《新贵妃醉酒》的第一句时，全场的观众不是震惊到合不上嘴，便是高声叫好。Tomaiko在南京大学留学一年的时候深深爱上了京剧，并开始学唱京剧。她那穿透有力的歌声精彩地诠释了贵妃醉酒时的媚态，而她那微微的笑靥更是将现场气氛推至高潮。
596b0edfc9bedaadc8051e4b1ab8537448d643b2.translatedText: Students from the Confucius Classroom at Tawater Elementary School under the Confucius Institute at Arizona State University performed two wonderful choruses, "Silent Night Thoughts" and "It's a Small World." The children were dressed in traditional Chinese costumes and sang every lyric steadily and accurately, which was well received by the audience. And when Emrie Tomaiko from Arizona State University wore a red cheongsam and sang the first line of "The New Drunken Princess", the audience was either so shocked that they couldn't close their mouths, or they cheered loudly. Tomaiko fell deeply in love with Peking Opera when she studied abroad at Nanjing University for a year and began to learn to sing Peking Opera. Her penetrating and powerful singing voice brilliantly interpreted the drunken concubine's charming appearance, and her slight smile pushed the atmosphere of the scene to a climax.

8c141386f5a99a77018d7d472f9bf29d0ebb7a45.sourceText: 本场演出在一曲热烈欢腾的《花好月圆》中拉下了帷幕。观众们却仍旧沉浸在美妙的乐曲声中，意犹未尽。他们一致表示今天的汇演非常精彩，并希望今后能够有更多的机会参与孔子学院主办的中美文化交流互动活动。在本次汇演活动上，还举办了60 张”2016中国故事”优秀摄影作品展等活动。
8c141386f5a99a77018d7d472f9bf29d0ebb7a45.translatedText: The performance came to an end with the warm and joyful song "Happy Flowers and Full Moon". The audience was still immersed in the wonderful music and still had more to say. They unanimously expressed that today’s performance was very exciting and hoped to have more opportunities to participate in Sino-US cultural exchange and interactive activities hosted by the Confucius Institute in the future. At this performance, an exhibition of 60 excellent "2016 Chinese Stories" photography works was also held.

94ca121ad0a481c5c3cf03f7c98e8ad1fc66cdf9.sourceText: 凤凰城 张肇鸿 今年是中国侨联成立六十周年，庆祝活动在北京人民大会堂举行。亚利桑那州共有四位华人受邀请参加大会，其中杨文田作为中国侨联代表并提前一天出发外，其余三位由洛杉矶总领馆推荐，他们分别是亚省华联会长李健、凤凰城侨联主席邓洪钺和华人福利会会长张肇鸿。因李健和邓洪钺及亚省华总会长袁亚华要主持亚省华人庆祝国庆活动，所以我本人在9月24日下午完成自己的任务外，来不及参加欢迎刘健总领事晚宴和国庆典礼及文艺晚会，便匆匆地踏上了旅程。 9月 26日下午是开幕典礼，因时间匆促机票紧张，加上转机和候机，所以从凤凰城到北京几近用了三十个小时，因时差关系，到北京已是26日凌晨六时，天空还下着雨。出了海关，从首都机场到北京中国大饭店，又碰到上班的尖峰时刻，从五环路到三环内全程不到卅公里，拥塞现象就如挥之不去的堵神如影随从，又走了两个小时。到旅店后便一头倒在浴缸中沉沉睡去。直到下午三点，才着正装前往北京人民大会堂去参加庆祝大会。 来自世界一百六十多个国家和地区的二千人参加了这次庆祝活动，而其中有七百多位代表被安排与国家领导人拍照。我们这批由各国领事馆推荐来的代表很有面子，第一排是国家领导人和老侨领的座位，我们被安排在第三行的中间位置，所以可以清楚地见到国家领导人亲切的面孔。开幕式有中共中央政治局常委、全国政协主席俞正声，中共中央政治局委员、中宣部长刘奇葆、中共中央政治局委员、国家副主席李源潮、全国人大副委员长沉跃跃，国务委员杨洁篪、全国政协副主席李海峰等国家领导人出席，俞正声主席作了重要讲话。中共中央委员、中国侨联主席林军致词、归侨代表及人民团体代表发言。俞正声主席向大会的召开表示热烈祝贺，向与会代表和广大归侨、海外侨胞，向老一代侨联干部和各级侨联工作者表示崇高敬意和亲切问候。他说，广大归侨侨眷和海外侨胞是促进我国现代化建设、实现中华民族伟大复兴的重要力量，长期以来秉承爱国爱乡的优良传统，热情支持中国革命、建设、改革事业，积极推动两岸关系和平发展，为祖国发展、统一和民族复兴作出了重要贡献。 第二天有专题报告，以前曾有过两次来北京开会的经验，深知这些学者和领导都是国之智者，演讲让人大开境界，能听到常人闻之未闻的理论。他们从政治、经济、外交、军事各方面分析目前国家的状况。阐述”中国梦”的”两个一百年”目标：到2021年中国共产党成立100周年以及和2049年中华人民共和国成立100周年时，逐步并最终顺利实现中华民族的伟大复兴。 大师们还提到，人民有安全感才有信用感，人民有信仰国家才有力量，甚至可以用变法去接受人民的意愿，发展中问题用更快发展的方法去解决等等。国泰才能民安，所以在国际关系中，中国坚持走和平发展的道路，不扛旗，不扩张，真心实意和其它国家作朋友，互利双赢。但中国也不会牲牺国家利益，分歧可以但要管控。但这些最终要靠国家实力才可实现，所以发展是硬道理。美国前些年仍认为中国的GDP要到2050年才能赶上美国，但中国国情不同，有国家意志，有人民拥护，所以国家安定，经济增长平稳，GDP很快就上升到全球第二。但我们也应该清楚地认识到，中国仍有二亿较贫穷的平民，GDP按人均计算全球排名也只有第八十位，所以民族复兴第一，要挖穷根，不能打断发展。中国侨联已成立六十周年，六十甲子又重头，中国侨联仍任重道远，应对国家和民族，为实现两个百年的伟大目标而作出新的贡献。 北京金秋能见到蓝天白云，国庆前夕，天安门广场一片瑰丽，用手机拍了些相片留念。27日中午要去”中国华侨历史博物馆”参观，博物馆收藏着三本我所撰写的关于亚省华人历史的书籍。27日下午，我们还将第二次前往北京人民大会堂，参加庆祝中华人民共和国成立67周年的国宴。
94ca121ad0a481c5c3cf03f7c98e8ad1fc66cdf9.translatedText: Phoenix Zhang Zhaohong This year marks the 60th anniversary of the founding of the All-China Federation of Returned Overseas Chinese, and the celebration was held at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing. A total of four Chinese in Arizona were invited to attend the conference. Among them, Yang Wentian was a representative of the Chinese Overseas Chinese Federation and left one day in advance. The other three were recommended by the Consulate General in Los Angeles. They were Li Jian, president of the Overseas Chinese Federation of Arizona, Deng Hongyue, president of the Phoenix Overseas Chinese Federation, and Zhang Zhaohong, president of the Chinese Welfare Association. Because Li Jian, Deng Hongyue and Yuan Yahua, president of the Chinese Association of Alberta, were to host the National Day celebrations for Chinese people in Alberta, I had to complete my own tasks on the afternoon of September 24. I did not have time to attend the welcome dinner for Consul General Liu Jian and the National Day ceremony and cultural evening, so I hurriedly embarked on the journey. The opening ceremony was held on the afternoon of September 26. Due to the rush of time and tight air tickets, as well as transfers and waiting, it took almost thirty hours to get from Phoenix to Beijing. Due to the time difference, it was already 6 a.m. on the 26th when we arrived in Beijing, and it was still raining. After leaving the customs, we went from the Capital Airport to the China World Hotel in Beijing, and encountered the rush hour for work. The whole journey from the Fifth Ring Road to the Third Ring Road was less than 30 kilometers, and the congestion phenomenon followed us like a lingering traffic jam, and we walked for another two hours. After arriving at the hotel, he fell into the bathtub and fell asleep. It wasn't until three o'clock in the afternoon that I went to the Great Hall of the People in Beijing to attend the celebration meeting in formal attire. Two thousand people from more than 160 countries and regions around the world participated in this celebration, and more than 700 of them were arranged to take photos with national leaders. We, the representatives recommended by the consulates of various countries, are very honorable. The first row is for national leaders and veteran overseas Chinese leaders. We are arranged in the middle of the third row, so we can clearly see the friendly faces of national leaders. The opening ceremony was attended by national leaders such as Yu Zhengsheng, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Chairman of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, Liu Qibao, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Minister of Propaganda of the CPC Central Committee, Li Yuanchao, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Vice Chairman of the State, Shen Yueyue, Vice Chairman of the National People's Congress, State Councilor Yang Jiechi, Li Haifeng, Vice Chairman of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, and Chairman Yu Zhengsheng delivered an important speech. Lin Jun, member of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and chairman of the All-China Federation of Returned Overseas Chinese, delivered a speech, and representatives of returned overseas Chinese and people's organizations spoke. Chairman Yu Zhengsheng expressed warm congratulations on the convening of the conference, and expressed his high respect and cordial greetings to the participating representatives and the vast number of returned overseas Chinese and overseas Chinese, as well as to the older generation of cadres of the Overseas Chinese Federation and workers of the Overseas Chinese Federation at all levels. He said that the vast number of returned overseas Chinese, their family members and overseas Chinese are important forces in promoting my country's modernization and realizing the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation. They have long upheld the fine tradition of patriotism and hometown, enthusiastically supported China's revolution, construction, and reform undertakings, actively promoted the peaceful development of cross-Strait relations, and made important contributions to the development, reunification and national rejuvenation of the motherland. There will be a special report on the second day. I have had the experience of coming to Beijing twice for meetings before, and I know that these scholars and leaders are the wise men of the country. Their speeches can open people's minds and allow them to hear theories that ordinary people have never heard of. They analyze the current situation of the country from political, economic, diplomatic, and military aspects. Elaborate on the "two centenary" goals of the "Chinese Dream": by the 100th anniversary of the founding of the Communist Party of China in 2021 and the 100th anniversary of the founding of the People's Republic of China in 2049, the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation will be gradually and ultimately successfully achieved. The masters also mentioned that only when the people have a sense of security can they have a sense of credibility, only when the people have faith can the country be strong, and reform can even be used to accept the wishes of the people, and problems in development can be solved by faster development, etc. Only when the country is peaceful can the people be safe. Therefore, in international relations, China adheres to the path of peaceful development, does not carry the flag or expands, and sincerely makes friends with other countries for mutual benefit and win-win results. But China will not sacrifice its national interests. Differences are acceptable but must be managed. But these can ultimately only be achieved by relying on national strength, so development is the last word. A few years ago, the United States still believed that China's GDP would not catch up with the United States until 2050. However, China's national conditions are different. It has the will of the country and the support of the people. Therefore, the country is stable, the economic growth is stable, and the GDP soon rose to the second place in the world. But we should also clearly realize that China still has 200 million poor civilians, and its GDP per capita ranks only 80th in the world. Therefore, national rejuvenation comes first, and we must dig out the roots of poverty without interrupting development. The Chinese Federation of Returned Overseas Chinese has celebrated its 60th anniversary, and the 60th anniversary has begun again. The Chinese Federation of Returned Overseas Chinese still has a long way to go, facing the country and the nation, and making new contributions to achieve the two centenary goals. Beijing can see blue sky and white clouds in the golden autumn. On the eve of the National Day, Tiananmen Square was magnificent. I took some photos with my mobile phone as a souvenir. At noon on the 27th, I am going to visit the "Overseas Chinese History Museum". The museum collects three books about the history of the Chinese in Alberta that I have written. On the afternoon of the 27th, we will also go to the Great Hall of the People in Beijing for the second time to attend the state banquet celebrating the 67th anniversary of the founding of the People's Republic of China.

5f1605311487ae20c7eaf7269110c2f0a43ff108.sourceText: 据美国《世界日报》报道，美国泳坛”飞鱼”菲尔普斯(Michael Phelps)，在里约奥运会落幕后，画下职业生涯完美句点。接踵而来又有两大喜事，一是10月要和未婚妻妮可-约翰逊(Nicole Johnson)完婚，二是将赴亚利桑那大学(ASU)执教游泳队。为了筹备婚礼，菲尔普斯和约翰逊日前来到洛杉矶某华资珠宝店购买钻石婚戒。
5f1605311487ae20c7eaf7269110c2f0a43ff108.translatedText: According to the US "World Journal" report, the "flying fish" of American swimming Michael Phelps (Michael Phelps) has drawn a perfect end to his career after the Rio Olympics. Two more happy events are coming one after another. One is that he will get married to his fiancée Nicole Johnson in October, and the other is that he will go to the University of Arizona (ASU) to coach the swimming team. In order to prepare for their wedding, Phelps and Johnson recently went to a Chinese-owned jewelry store in Los Angeles to buy diamond wedding rings.

e87f203d63f1a359ff876b9b7f6f858f1902a698.sourceText: 菲尔普斯参加过五届奥运会，豪取28枚奖牌包括23枚金牌，写下了奥运史上的神话。里约奥运会后，菲尔普斯的私生活依然广受关注。菲尔普斯的教练鲍曼(Bob Bowman)近日向媒体透露，菲尔普斯已正式退役，今后不再参加游泳比赛。但是，他的游泳运动生涯并没有结束，菲尔普斯将到亚利桑那大学担任游泳队教练，为美国培养游泳健将。
e87f203d63f1a359ff876b9b7f6f858f1902a698.translatedText: Phelps participated in five Olympic Games and won 28 medals including 23 gold medals, writing a legend in the history of the Olympics. After the Rio Olympics, Phelps's private life still attracted widespread attention. Phelps' coach Bob Bowman recently revealed to the media that Phelps has officially retired and will no longer participate in swimming competitions. However, his swimming career is not over. Phelps will serve as a swimming team coach at the University of Arizona to train swimming athletes for the United States.

1cbaa494a25acf15d25ecfaef8d3f1d35cd63f73.sourceText: 鲍曼是菲尔普斯的私人教练和多年恩师，目前执教亚利桑那大学游泳队。在里约奥运会之前，菲尔普斯专程来到亚利桑那大学游泳馆强化训练，他对该校一流的游泳场馆训练设施非常满意。在里约奥运会结束后，他接受邀请来到亚利桑那大学执教。鲍曼表示，他们师徒俩人再度联手，训练大学生游泳运动员。
1cbaa494a25acf15d25ecfaef8d3f1d35cd63f73.translatedText: Bowman is Phelps' personal coach and mentor for many years and currently coaches the University of Arizona swimming team. Before the Rio Olympics, Phelps made a special trip to the University of Arizona's swimming pool for intensive training. He was very satisfied with the school's first-class swimming pool training facilities. After the Rio Olympics, he accepted an invitation to coach at the University of Arizona. Bowman said that the master and apprentice teamed up again to train college swimmers.

07d8dd92db9d30bdadcaba9ec1bb24dcaa800acf.sourceText: 今年10月，菲尔普斯将和未婚妻约翰逊举行婚礼。约翰逊是2007年加州选美亚军和2010年”加州小姐”选美大赛冠军。2015年2月她和菲尔普斯订婚，来到洛杉矶市某华资珠宝商店购买了一枚订婚戒指。今年9月，他俩又抱着四个月大的儿子，再次来到该家华资珠宝店购买结婚钻戒。因为多年来，该珠宝店华裔老板一直赞助加州小姐选美大赛，所以有缘和约翰逊相识，并且成为好朋友。老板夫妇也将约翰逊视为女儿，感情一向很好。因此，约翰逊和菲尔普斯的订婚戒和结婚戒，都特意来到这家珠宝店选购，留下一段佳话。
07d8dd92db9d30bdadcaba9ec1bb24dcaa800acf.translatedText: In October this year, Phelps will hold a wedding with his fiancée Johnson. Johnson was the 2007 California beauty pageant runner-up and the 2010 "Miss California" beauty pageant champion. In February 2015, she and Phelps got engaged and went to a Chinese-owned jewelry store in Los Angeles to buy an engagement ring. In September this year, they held their four-month-old son and went to the Chinese-owned jewelry store again to buy a diamond wedding ring. Because the Chinese owner of the jewelry store has sponsored the Miss California beauty pageant for many years, he met Johnson and became good friends. The boss and his wife also regard Johnson as their daughter, and their relationship has always been very good. Therefore, Johnson and Phelps specially came to this jewelry store to buy their engagement rings and wedding rings, leaving a good story.

64dd73a7763aede0e30bc3ab3c272d4144cc9d36.translatedText: Huiming: The story of Tucson's referendum against cameras Tucson Huiming Tucson is a very small town in the United States. Because it is close to the Mexican border, the crowd...

e3d3e1bd17a73855a978388ce67338dbacc9aa73.sourceText: Tucson 是美国一个很小的市镇，因为靠近墨西哥边境，人群流动较频繁，人口常在 50 万和 100 万之间。尽管这里有亚利桑那大学，有世界一流的天文技术，可是在美国人视野中， Tucson 没有著名的篮球队橄榄球队，是个不起眼的沙漠城市。最多哪个作家想起了这里，便把杀人犯逃犯逃到亚利桑那的情节编入故事，人们才知道亚利桑那和 Tucson 一点事。
e3d3e1bd17a73855a978388ce67338dbacc9aa73.translatedText: Tucson is a very small town in the United States. Because it is close to the Mexican border, people move frequently, and the population is often between 500,000 and 1 million. Although there is the University of Arizona and world-class astronomical technology here, in the eyes of Americans, Tucson does not have a famous basketball or football team and is an inconspicuous desert city. At most, some writer remembered this and incorporated the plot of a fugitive murderer into Arizona, so people knew nothing about Arizona and Tucson.

4f2e2179c210dd37ed3593e0733ee6f7e904695b.sourceText: 但 2015 年， Tucson 发生的一件事却让美国人刮目相看。
4f2e2179c210dd37ed3593e0733ee6f7e904695b.translatedText: But in 2015, something happened in Tucson that made Americans sit up and take notice.

26a42353bd46b500706cc2a186bbccccd620b0f0.sourceText: 原先 Tucson 和美国所有的城市一样，政府授权警察用车载摄像机监控超速驾车。不知哪个好事者觉得还不过瘾，主张在关键路口都装上摄像头，全面监控超速车。政府部门很是欢喜，因为这样会凭空给政府增加据说是每年 5000 万的罚款。那些相关的可着劲地提高摄影摄像像素，拍一张清晰的罪犯图；不相关部门也乐得屁颠屁颠的，搞专用雷达马上设计程序，提醒车主哪有摄像头；拍须溜马的马上找到警察部门，表明自己愿意为警察送照相罚单等等。更有能人设计专门的涂料涂在车牌上，寻常能看见车牌，一拍照反光便一片白光。
26a42353bd46b500706cc2a186bbccccd620b0f0.translatedText: It turns out that Tucson, like all cities in the United States, has been authorized by the government to use in-car cameras to monitor speeding drivers. I don’t know which good-hearted person thinks this is not enough, and advocates installing cameras at key intersections to fully monitor speeding vehicles. The government departments are very happy, because this will add fines to the government out of thin air, which is said to be 50 million per year. Those who are involved can work hard to increase the pixels of the photography and take a clear picture of the criminal; departments that are not related are also very happy and develop special radars to immediately design programs to remind car owners where there are cameras; those who take pictures of horseback riders immediately find the police department and express their willingness to send photo tickets to the police, etc. There are even more talented people who design special paint and apply it on the license plate. You can usually see the license plate, but when you take a photo, the reflection turns white.

69d2f723c3978640108a197a1bb91daa908346c0.sourceText: 总之，以安全为宗旨的设计为政府增加了收入，多方面增加了就业， Tucson 一时欢天喜地。
69d2f723c3978640108a197a1bb91daa908346c0.translatedText: In short, the safety-oriented design has increased revenue for the government and increased employment in many aspects. Tucson was very happy for a while.

a5e16895165cb1850957f372bbd54d9785e0fd62.sourceText: 但不高兴的是那些开车的劳苦大众，因为这讨厌的摄像头不但使很多人凭空增加了罚款，而且还人为地增加了很多车祸事故。抱怨的声浪在民间一浪高过一浪。很多摄像头被恼怒的开车者在晚上涂上黑漆，最极端的是一蒙面抢手用枪打碎摄像头镜头。
a5e16895165cb1850957f372bbd54d9785e0fd62.translatedText: But those who are unhappy are the working people who drive, because this annoying camera not only increases fines for many people out of thin air, but also artificially increases many car accidents. The voices of complaints among the people are getting louder and louder than ever. Many cameras were painted black at night by angry motorists, and in the most extreme case, a masked gunman smashed the camera lens with a gun.

0f0977b55c6fe66395d6222178fb4736f10a3254.sourceText: 当地许多美国人要求政府部门取消摄像。在美国交税容易和必须，但要想从政府手里要回搞错的钱，难上加难。何况这次摄像头后面还有当地法律支持，所以政府部门很是傲慢，那回答民众质疑的态度，有点像这次大选那位自以为女准总统，朕已经大权在握，量你小屁民也没有什么作为，便居高临下的发布，只要你们反对摄像头的提案获得 15000 名的支持，政府便自动取消这个赚钱的机器。
0f0977b55c6fe66395d6222178fb4736f10a3254.translatedText: Many local Americans asked the government to cancel the filming. It is easy and necessary to pay taxes in the United States, but it is even more difficult to get the wrong money back from the government. What's more, there is local legal support behind the cameras this time, so the government departments are very arrogant. Their attitude in answering people's questions is a bit like the self-proclaimed female quasi-president in this election. I already have the power, and I can't do anything about you little shit people, so I condescendingly announced that as long as your proposal against the cameras gets the support of 15,000 people, the government will automatically cancel this money-making machine.

d24deb5488d0cd17a993979bbf24a9997c8db7d2.sourceText: 政府这次可真看错了 Tucson 的民众，他们以为这个满是老墨打工寻生活的世界没人会关心法律的更改事件。但他们恰恰忽视了这点，被摄像机拍到的除了个别有意闯红灯的，都是那些平常守规矩的驾驶者在灯前犹犹豫豫的。笔者有幸参加了一次被拍者的肇事学习班，参加者除了青年学生外，还有很多公司的经理学校的老师，以及平常很守规矩的律师。一位老太太大概七十也是我们的同学，不同的是她像鲁迅笔下的祥林嫂，见人就向人唠叨，说自己有五十年的驾龄，从来没吃过罚单等等。
d24deb5488d0cd17a993979bbf24a9997c8db7d2.translatedText: The government really misjudged the people of Tucson this time. They thought that in a world full of old people working to make a living, no one would care about changes in the law. But they just ignored this point. Except for a few people who deliberately ran the red light, the drivers who were caught by the camera were all drivers who usually obeyed the rules and hesitated in front of the light. The author was fortunate enough to attend a study class for the person who was photographed causing the accident. In addition to young students, the participants also included teachers from many companies’ management schools, as well as lawyers who usually abide by the rules. An old lady who was about seventy was also a classmate of ours. The difference was that she was like Lu Xun's Sister Xianglin. She always nagged everyone when she saw her, saying that she had fifty years of driving experience and had never had to pay a ticket.

3edf35c6f1f0c8923720d4f29e52f9d0ea16b021.sourceText: 当政府部门提出了这个反对指标后，满大街突然出现了号召大家参加投票的广告。不知怎的，笔者一下便觉得是那个不露声色的律师发动的，后面还有那个走路颤颤巍巍的老太。
3edf35c6f1f0c8923720d4f29e52f9d0ea16b021.translatedText: After the government department proposed this objection indicator, advertisements calling on everyone to vote suddenly appeared all over the streets. Somehow, the author immediately felt that it was the silent lawyer who started it, followed by the old lady who was walking tremblingly.

1af6e8ef6687f8ec89862ecef16602454aea1bf1.sourceText: 结果，政府部门两个星期收到了 50000 张投票。宣布结果的第二天 Tucson 所有的摄像镜头立马被蒙上黑塑料袋，那躲在暗处的拍照车也被取消了。记得那天所有见到的人都喜气洋洋的，仿佛捡到金元宝似的。
1af6e8ef6687f8ec89862ecef16602454aea1bf1.translatedText: As a result, the government department received 50,000 votes in two weeks. The day after the results were announced, all Tucson's camera lenses were immediately covered with black plastic bags, and the camera van hiding in the dark was also cancelled. I remember that everyone I saw that day was beaming with joy, as if they had picked up a gold ingot.

e526cd843297ecd5e9d5ae4043b2c9492231f069.sourceText: 突然想到现在的大选。现在希拉里就有点像那个政府发言人，见人就说自己是国务卿，什么好事和自己都有关。自己确实也是高学历，高智商，看不起那个简直是流氓的土豪川普，更加忽视他的见解。但世事难料，没准大选也会出现 Tucson 的事件呢。
e526cd843297ecd5e9d5ae4043b2c9492231f069.translatedText: Suddenly thought of the current election. Now Hillary is a bit like that government spokesperson. She always says that she is the Secretary of State and that all good things are related to her. I am indeed highly educated and highly intelligent. I look down on the tycoon Trump, who is simply a gangster, and even ignore his opinions. But things are unpredictable, and the Tucson incident may also occur in the general election.

5be0fe4851e27b264304c8855ee1d1b2e97937f3.sourceText: 美洲龙冈亲义总公所10月21日在亚历桑纳州凤凰城举办第21届恳亲代表大会，中华民国驻洛杉矶台北经济文化办事处处长夏季昌、组长刘立欣、橙县华侨文教服务中心主任杨海华等出席开幕典礼，另有来自美洲各地龙冈亲义公所代表逾300人齐聚凤凰城，包含洛杉矶、三藩市、屋崙、芝加哥、休士顿、纽约、纽英伦、多伦多、温哥华、墨西哥、秘鲁等公所代表与宗眷出席，世界龙冈亲义总会主席赵恩广也特别从台湾带领代表团前来参加，现场热闹非凡。
5be0fe4851e27b264304c8855ee1d1b2e97937f3.translatedText: The Longkang Friendship and Friendship Office of America held the 21st People’s Congress in Phoenix, Arizona on October 21st. Xia Chang, director of the Taipei Economic and Cultural Office of the Republic of China in Los Angeles, team leader Liu Lixin, Yang Haihua, director of the Orange County Overseas Chinese Cultural and Educational Service Center, etc. Attending the opening ceremony, more than 300 representatives from Longgang Friendship Offices from all over the Americas gathered in Phoenix, including representatives and family members of offices in Los Angeles, San Francisco, Oakland, Chicago, Houston, New York, New England, Toronto, Vancouver, Mexico, and Peru. Zhao Enguang, chairman of the World Longgang Friendship Association, also led a delegation from Taiwan to attend, and the scene was very lively.

29ec72c4ccc0b0bede807a3d482afe6060a351e3.sourceText: 当天以谒祖仪式揭开序幕，表达对刘关张赵四姓祖先桃园结义，古城聚会慎终追远的传承。开幕典礼则在舞狮精采表演下展开，夏季昌处长致词时肯定龙冈忠义仁勇的精神与团结合作，在全美洲华埠传统侨社具有影响力，深得世人景仰与乐道，并于大会中颁赠总统蔡英文「敦本扬声」的题词，及代表宣读侨务委员会委员长吴新兴贺电，由总公所主席张国钦、恳亲大会筹委会荣誉主席关宗任、恳亲大会筹委会共同主席张肇鸿、关锡樵、刘沃彪代表接受。
29ec72c4ccc0b0bede807a3d482afe6060a351e3.translatedText: The day kicked off with a ceremony to pay homage to the ancestors, expressing the sworn friendship with the ancestors of the four surnames Liu, Guan, Zhang and Zhao in Taoyuan, and gathering in the ancient city to pursue the past with caution. The opening ceremony started with a wonderful lion dance performance. In his speech, Director Xiaxia Chang affirmed Longgang's spirit of loyalty, bravery, unity and cooperation, which is influential in traditional overseas Chinese communities in Chinatowns across America and has won the admiration and praise of the world. During the conference, President Tsai Ing-wen was awarded the " The inscription "Dunben Raise the Voice", and the representative read out the congratulatory message from Wu Xingxing, Chairman of the Overseas Chinese Affairs Commission, which was accepted by representatives from the General Office Chairman Zhang Guoqin, Honorary Chairman of the Preparatory Committee Guan Zongren, and Co-Chairmen of the Preparatory Committee Zhang Zhaohong, Guan Xiqiao, and Liu Wobiao.

e8425af88d4dd3a33fbc0a50ff8eb98014c2e260.sourceText: 当晚恳亲大会筹委会举行与会代表公宴，席开40桌，美洲龙冈亲义总公所顾问张芳华主持了晚宴，资深侨领余文劲，邓朝驹等出席了活动。主办单位亦准备丰富文艺表演节目，与美洲各分所代表同乐，场面热络、气氛温馨。龙冈亲义总公所恳亲大会每三年举行一次，到现在已经63年的历史，这是首次在亚利桑那凤凰城举办。凤凰城的热情周到的接待受到了公所世亲们的极大肯定。
e8425af88d4dd3a33fbc0a50ff8eb98014c2e260.translatedText: That night, the organizing committee of the Qinqin Conference held a public banquet for the representatives attending the conference. There were 40 tables. Zhang Fanghua, consultant of the American Longgang Qinyi General Office, hosted the dinner. Senior overseas Chinese leaders Yu Wenjin and Deng Chaoju attended the event. The organizer also prepared a variety of cultural performances to entertain representatives from branches in the Americas. The scene was lively and the atmosphere was warm. The Ryukang Chess-Yi General Office’s Chess-making Conference is held every three years. It has a history of 63 years. This is the first time it is held in Phoenix, Arizona. Phoenix City's warm and thoughtful reception was greatly recognized by the family members of the office.

975c6ea526e7328117e3c9ad041ff411b6bb0a08.translatedText: Trump won the US presidential election - 2016, the year of political awakening for Chinese Americans. The picture is from 2016...

ed4d96f63ab005036e1440468a07b54e0ebf1b05.sourceText: 图片上是2016年美国上空飘起的第一面支持川普的华人广告，它来自美国亚利桑那州凤凰城。这是由华裔美国人张传东组织的”亚利桑那Trump助选”群打出的第一条代表华人团体的政治广告。他们在短短不到一天的时间里，募集到三千多美金，完成了这个广告的制作，得到全美众多华人的支持和响应，此后相继美国38个州上空飘起了华人”挺川”广告，其中甚至有深蓝州。
ed4d96f63ab005036e1440468a07b54e0ebf1b05.translatedText: The picture is the first Chinese ad supporting Trump that floated over the United States in 2016. It comes from Phoenix, Arizona, USA. This is the first political advertisement on behalf of a Chinese group put out by the "Arizona Trump Campaign" group organized by Chinese-American Zhang Chuandong. In less than a day, they raised more than 3,000 U.S. dollars to complete the production of this advertisement. They received support and response from many Chinese across the United States. Since then, Chinese "Stand Sichuan" advertisements have floated over 38 states in the United States, including even deep blue states.

db9618dfa9db4b98fdd4fa84ceb7fc9d31801f1c.sourceText: 四十位亚利桑那Trump助选群成员相聚一堂
db9618dfa9db4b98fdd4fa84ceb7fc9d31801f1c.translatedText: > Forty members of the Arizona Trump campaign group gathered together

c7623a49e6b51135086ec01155b8bb0c4617d891.sourceText: 11月10日晚”亚利桑那Trump助选”群在钱德勒合顺园餐厅举行了川普竞选胜利的庆功宴，其中的四十位助选朋友终于相聚在一起，庆祝”川普成为美国第45任总统”，于此同时也是有共同政见朋友的大聚会。
c7623a49e6b51135086ec01155b8bb0c4617d891.translatedText: On the evening of November 10th, the "Arizona Trump campaign" group held a celebration banquet for Trump's campaign victory at the Chandler Union Restaurant. Forty of the campaign friends finally gathered together to celebrate "Trump becoming the 45th President of the United States." It was also a large gathering of friends with common political views.

8840081cc5a987c7887aedb734352fa98edbd59c.sourceText: 张传东首先感谢了这么长助选时间里，大家的努力。有钱的出钱，有力的出力，从来没有想到华人如此热情高涨地参与到政治活动中，华裔政治捐款历史上首次如此踊跃。在华裔挺川飞行广告出现后，高速路上的大广告牌，挺川大广告横幅，各种广告形式层出不穷。支持者更是亲力亲为，发扬华裔坚毅，努力的精神，凤凰城华裔走街串巷插挺川广告牌，到老年人公寓为更多老年朋友提供投票的资讯，解释投票流程，提供所有能够方便大家参与政治的服务。
8840081cc5a987c7887aedb734352fa98edbd59c.translatedText: Zhang Chuandong first thanked everyone for their efforts during such a long time of campaigning. The rich contribute money and the powerful contribute. I never expected that Chinese people would participate in political activities with such enthusiasm. For the first time in history, Chinese political donations have been so enthusiastic. After the appearance of Chinese-American Tingchuan flying advertisements, large billboards on highways, large Tingchuan advertising banners, and various forms of advertising emerged in endlessly. Supporters are even more hands-on to carry forward the perseverance and hard-working spirit of Chinese Americans. Chinese Americans in Phoenix go around the streets to plant billboards supporting Sichuan, and go to senior citizens’ apartments to provide voting information to more elderly friends, explain the voting process, and provide all services that can facilitate everyone’s participation in politics.
