de460120e191f0c41c7c0a5c46995e5c47bf9a1a.sourceText: 是的，这一群人，以及通过微信（社交媒体）联系起来的全美上下其他有类似政治诉求的人，前无古人的站在了一起，发出了他们的声音。在美的其他族裔，靓瞎了眼。那个善于经营小生意，公司里工作最不要命，天天让孩子好好读书，从来只当房东，不当房客，从来不发表任何意见的，历史上政治选举从来没有被注意到的族裔，2016年怎么啦?
de460120e191f0c41c7c0a5c46995e5c47bf9a1a.translatedText: Yes, this group of people, as well as other people with similar political demands across the United States who were connected through WeChat (social media), stood together like never before and made their voices heard. Other ethnic groups in the United States are blinded by their beauty. What happened to that ethnic group who is good at running a small business, works the most desperate job in the company, lets his children study hard every day, never acts as a landlord, not a tenant, never expresses any opinions, and has never been noticed in political elections in history?

9175adbc0112c8e5891f31f514ee246a43d647c9.sourceText: 华人的家庭意识是出了名的，现在美国就是我们的家，我们会像爱小家一样，爱这个国家，国家兴亡，匹夫有责。今天选举结束了，我们庆祝助选胜利，一定该画上圆满句号了吧？不！华裔不是盲目的助选者，2016华裔美国人在美参政活动才刚刚开始。我们支持的候选人上台了，接下去我们需要做的就是监督他完成自己的政治纲领。即使是我们选上来的总统，一旦有损国家利益，一旦治国无方，华裔也将用他们手中的选票，手中的资金，开始表达政治意愿，说”Yes?’and ”NO”。如群主所说，2016是美国华裔的政治觉醒年，我们的政治之旅才刚刚启程，我们没有太多的经验，但是以华裔的经济实力，受教育程度，与其他族裔相比，犯愚蠢错误的概率会少一点。
9175adbc0112c8e5891f31f514ee246a43d647c9.translatedText: The Chinese are famous for their sense of family. The United States is our home now, and we will love this country as much as we love our little family. Every man is responsible for the rise and fall of a country. The election is over today, and we celebrate the victory in the campaign. It must be a successful conclusion, right? No! Chinese Americans are not blind supporters of the election. In 2016, Chinese Americans’ political participation in the United States has just begun. The candidate we support has taken office, and what we need to do next is to supervise him to complete his political platform. Even if the president we elect harms the interests of the country and governs the country poorly, Chinese Americans will use their votes and funds to start expressing political will and say "Yes?' and "NO". As the group leader said, 2016 is the year of political awakening for Chinese Americans. Our political journey has just begun. We do not have much experience, but with the economic strength and education level of Chinese Americans, the probability of making stupid mistakes will be less than that of other ethnic groups.

f2b82ec5cd6a0bb309d1a2f728f2530d2a7c8e12.sourceText: 在庆功晚宴上，大家提到总统选举已经告于段落，现在要面对选举后的结果。幸运的希拉里克林顿女士，很少被问及万一选举失败会怎样面对这个问题，希粉也大多没有思想准备接受失败，但是它发生了成为了现实。选举结束的第二天，美国部分城市竟然发生打砸抢事件，因为川普成为下一任美国总统，一些人还针对起华人冷嘲热讽。这是大选过后我们必须正确面对的问题。穆斯林没有制造恐怖事件，美国自己人可忙起来了，这多少可以证明造事者，没有给希拉里长脸，反而将了希拉里一军！难道现在不应该是曾经大家心目中有大国风范的政坛领袖希拉里跟她的粉丝对话的时候吗？面对失败，向川普表示祝贺，很难发自真心可以理解，可是面对一直支持希拉里的普通民众，成为扰乱社会治安的一员，给国家，给普通百姓的生活带来危害，不仅伤了了别人，也伤了自己，不应该发自内心为他们的安全说几句话吗？所有媒体除了渲染混乱的秩序，就再次失声了吗？
f2b82ec5cd6a0bb309d1a2f728f2530d2a7c8e12.translatedText: At the celebration dinner, everyone mentioned that the presidential election has come to an end and now we have to face the post-election results. Fortunately, Ms. Hillary Clinton was rarely asked how she would face this issue if she lost the election. Most of her fans were not mentally prepared to accept failure, but it happened and became a reality. On the day after the election, incidents of vandalism, smashing, and looting occurred in some cities in the United States. Because Trump became the next president of the United States, some people even ridiculed the Chinese. This is a question we must face correctly after the election. Muslims did not cause terrorist incidents, but the Americans themselves were busy. This somewhat proves that the perpetrators did not give Hillary a face, but instead defeated Hillary! Isn't it time for Hillary, a political leader who was once considered a great power, to talk to her fans? In the face of failure, it is difficult to express congratulations to Trump sincerely and understandably. However, in the face of ordinary people who have always supported Hillary and become a member of the group that disrupts social order and brings harm to the country and ordinary people's lives, not only hurting others, but also hurting themselves, shouldn't we say a few words for their safety from the bottom of our hearts? In addition to exaggerating chaotic order, have all the media lost their voice again?

c8ddad4f009b629c666b0bb5e1b7fd6879d4917b.sourceText: 再来谈谈那些朝华裔发难的人。我们应该就此沉默了吗？我们做错了吗？当然不，当华裔因为支持川普被人指责和谩骂的时候，应该送之甜美的微笑。因为骂你的人才是弱者，因为你强了，你的力量威胁到他们，他们才会骂你，当你放弃自己的权利，一切都随人所愿的时候，的确没有人会骂我们。当华人把参政这个事情做好了，未来也许会做得更好的时候，就要做好思想准备被人骂，被人责备。我们是要美国更加强大，我们的心愿和所有的族裔都是一样的，要在这里建设一个富足幸福的生活。
c8ddad4f009b629c666b0bb5e1b7fd6879d4917b.translatedText: Let’s talk about those who attack Chinese Americans. Should we just keep silent? Did we do something wrong? Of course not. When Chinese Americans are criticized and reviled for supporting Trump, they should give them a sweet smile. Because those who scold you are weak. Because you are strong and your power threatens them, they will scold you. When you give up your rights and do everything as others want, no one will scold us. When Chinese people do a good job in participating in politics and may do better in the future, they must be mentally prepared to be scolded and blamed. We want America to be stronger, and our wish is the same as that of all ethnic groups, to build a prosperous and happy life here.

2d6cece87f0c44f20d0461f5af801c9644d7b78f.sourceText: 今天亚利桑那华裔Trump助选群相聚一堂，不仅为庆功，更是一个启航式，从此我们要有自己的声音！
2d6cece87f0c44f20d0461f5af801c9644d7b78f.translatedText: Today, the Arizona Chinese Trump campaign group gathered together not only to celebrate, but also to set sail. From now on, we must have our own voice!

785f91bce41a3099ee6179a191dd6d0f16029c82.translatedText: Vasari Energy will build a 68MW solar photovoltaic project in Arizona Solar energy supply located in Irvine, California, USA...

3ca9e4a66c6d19eec4e37737b6c3f8f0918f5571.sourceText: 位于美国加利福尼亚州欧文市的太阳能供应商Vasari Energy，签署一项合同，在亚利桑那州Maricopa县购买450英亩土地，用于开发68兆瓦太阳能发电光伏项目。
3ca9e4a66c6d19eec4e37737b6c3f8f0918f5571.translatedText: Vasari Energy, a solar energy supplier located in Irvine, California, USA, signed a contract to purchase 450 acres of land in Maricopa County, Arizona, for the development of a 68MW solar power photovoltaic project.

873260c2f3adcb8b811f365e5d9894ea087d5e7e.sourceText: 该项目将通过Vasari Energy的全资合作伙伴Sonoran Solar Development Partners进行开发。
873260c2f3adcb8b811f365e5d9894ea087d5e7e.translatedText: The project will be developed through Sonoran Solar Development Partners, a wholly-owned partner of Vasari Energy.

dfe83b4caa3198d8f033a646f64225ad0d51079f.sourceText: 一旦获得允许设计完成，公司估计项目售价约为1360万美元。预计将于2019年10月开工建设，将于2020年10月开始运营并输送电力。
dfe83b4caa3198d8f033a646f64225ad0d51079f.translatedText: Once the design is approved and completed, the company estimates the project price to be approximately US$13.6 million. Construction is expected to start in October 2019, and operations and power transmission will begin in October 2020.

b748597822d70626473ccd7ea32db5b3f49a6972.sourceText: Vasari Energy副总裁Sam Lipman表示:”此项目会让Vasari Energy向2017年5亿美元的太阳能目标更迈进一步。”
b748597822d70626473ccd7ea32db5b3f49a6972.translatedText: Vasari Energy Vice President Sam Lipman said: "This project will bring Vasari Energy one step closer to its 2017 solar energy goal of $500 million."

9ce98e4745dc334a567d9cc0808052bdb1cd57f7.sourceText: Vasari将负责此项目开发，要么在设计完成获得许可之后将项目出售给具有财务能力的买方，要么构建并运营此项目，创造经济投资和可再生能源项目。
9ce98e4745dc334a567d9cc0808052bdb1cd57f7.translatedText: Vasari will be responsible for the development of this project and either sell the project to a financially capable buyer after the design is completed and obtain permits, or build and operate this project to create economic investment and renewable energy projects.

0f0c31ec61fe01147f9e8760392f200deb3f4b5e.sourceText: Vasari目前在加利福尼亚州、亚利桑那州、内华达州和德克萨斯州的太阳能项目功率潜力为200MW。通过各种投资，该公司计划到2020年底实现700兆瓦运营能力。（文/Tina译）
0f0c31ec61fe01147f9e8760392f200deb3f4b5e.translatedText: Vasari currently has 200MW of solar project power potential in California, Arizona, Nevada and Texas. Through various investments, the company plans to achieve 700 MW operating capacity by the end of 2020. (Text/Translated by Tina)

f5ab997837d162f7ef5afa034a29dccbd719e899.sourceText: 亚省现代中文学校2016-2017学年开学纪实 (亚省现代中文学校供稿) 亚省现代中文学校2016年秋季开…
f5ab997837d162f7ef5afa034a29dccbd719e899.translatedText: Records of the opening of the Alberta Modern Chinese School in the 2016-2017 school year (provided by the Alberta Modern Chinese School) The opening of the Alberta Modern Chinese School in the fall of 2016...

1da7ff4c607a3efe5f1fefe8ea8c4e213bd45259.sourceText: (亚省现代中文学校供稿) 亚省现代中文学校2016年秋季开学了！学校的学生、老师、家长和义工们刚刚在5月上旬喜气洋洋地举办了20周年校庆活动，8月13日又精神饱满地迎来了暑假后新学年的第一天。从早上8点开始，学校的各项工作就紧张有序地进行着，各班的老师们准时开始了暑假后的第一节课，义工们在学校办公室热情地协助学生家长们为孩子们注册、缴费、挑选教材，新一届的校委会和董事会成员热情地为家长们解答各种各样的问题。
1da7ff4c607a3efe5f1fefe8ea8c4e213bd45259.translatedText: (provided by the Alberta Modern Chinese School) The Alberta Modern Chinese School has started in the fall of 2016! The students, teachers, parents and volunteers of the school just held the 20th anniversary celebration in early May with great joy, and on August 13th they ushered in the first day of the new school year after the summer vacation with high spirits. Starting from 8 o'clock in the morning, all the school's work was carried out in an intense and orderly manner. Teachers in each class started the first class after the summer vacation on time. Volunteers enthusiastically assisted parents in the school office to register, pay fees, and select teaching materials for their children. The new school committee and board members enthusiastically answered various questions for parents.

7b6fbb74dee6ce4368034837f9bbf1d6657b3188.sourceText: 现代中文学校自1996年8月建校以来，已从当年的三十多位学生， 三、四位老师的小小规模，发展到今天五百多位学生注册的盛况。到目前为止，学校已经连续四年保持了”华文教育示范学校”的光荣称号。现代中文学校的成绩赢得了社区各界的广泛赞誉和好评。中国驻洛杉矶总领事馆，全美中文学校协会，ASU孔子学院以及凤凰城各个兄弟中文学校，凤凰城本地媒体等都充分肯定和高度赞扬了现代中文学校在过去20年里为致力于凤凰城中文教学，传播中华文化，积极参与本地社区活动方面所取得的的巨大成就。亚利桑那州坦佩市长在现代中文学校成立20周年之际，特为学校发来了公告：”鉴于亚省现代中文学校自建校以来长期致力于本地区中文教育和文化交流及社区建设所作出的积极贡献，我，坦佩市长麦克. 米切尔宣布2016年5月7日为亚省现代中文学校日”。
7b6fbb74dee6ce4368034837f9bbf1d6657b3188.translatedText: Since its establishment in August 1996, Modern Chinese School has grown from a small scale of more than 30 students and three or four teachers to today's grand occasion of more than 500 registered students. So far, the school has maintained the honorable title of "Chinese Education Model School" for four consecutive years. The achievements of Modern Chinese School have won widespread praise and praise from all walks of life in the community. The Consulate General of China in Los Angeles, the National Association of Chinese Schools, the Confucius Institute at ASU, various brother Chinese schools in Phoenix, and the local media in Phoenix have fully affirmed and highly praised the great achievements of Modern Chinese School in the past 20 years in terms of being committed to teaching Chinese in Phoenix, spreading Chinese culture, and actively participating in local community activities. On the occasion of the 20th anniversary of the establishment of the Modern Chinese School, the mayor of Tempe, Arizona, issued a special announcement for the school: "In view of the positive contributions made by the Alberta Modern Chinese School to Chinese education, cultural exchanges and community construction in the region since its establishment, I, the Mayor of Tempe, Mike Mitchell, declare May 7, 2016 as the Alberta Modern Chinese School Day."

b81800810bf2d9e3803ae494fa6d265e6c0daa02.sourceText: 学校20年来取得的巨大成就得益于现代中文学校独具特色的办学模式，多样化的文化传播方式以及多功能并且极具特色的社区服务。
b81800810bf2d9e3803ae494fa6d265e6c0daa02.translatedText: The school's great achievements in the past 20 years are due to the unique school-running model of modern Chinese schools, diversified cultural communication methods, and multi-functional and distinctive community services.

167e00f113876ab5251227097a253d499401af52.sourceText: 独具特色的办学模式主要体现在教师的招聘培训和教材的选择使用，教师和教材是海外中文教学成功的关键。现代中文学校在教师招聘培训和中文教材的选择方面不断推陈出新，认真总结经验教训，形成了自己独特的中文教学模式。
167e00f113876ab5251227097a253d499401af52.translatedText: The unique school-running model is mainly reflected in the recruitment and training of teachers and the selection and use of teaching materials. Teachers and teaching materials are the key to the success of overseas Chinese teaching. Modern Chinese schools continue to innovate in teacher recruitment and training and the selection of Chinese teaching materials, carefully sum up experiences and lessons, and form their own unique Chinese teaching model.

ffb471c329156196f134dfc2495f7d6b529e995e.sourceText: 现代中文学校师资力量雄厚，学校的大部分中文老师都有大学本科以上的学历，很多老师持有亚利桑那州中小学教育合格证书。学校非常注重教师的培训和教学方法的交流，多次邀请北美地区海外中文教学经验丰富的学者和老师来学校开办各类中文教学方面的讲座，同时也积极鼓励本校教师参与北美地区中文教学的交流。2016年7月31日，学校董事长奚文军先生，校长王玉兰女士，中文教学组长高京京女士代表现代中文学校出席了全美中文学校协会在亚利桑那州由七所中文学校负责人组成的中文教学交流讨论会议。学校将和各兄弟学校一起，积极组织和参与8月17日在凤凰城举办的”海外华文教育专家巡讲团”充分组织和动员学校教师参加培训，积极参与巡讲团的各种中文教学创新讲座，鼓励中文老师努力采取寓教于乐的方式进行中文教学，注重培养学生学习汉语的乐趣和主动性。
ffb471c329156196f134dfc2495f7d6b529e995e.translatedText: Modern Chinese School has a strong teaching staff. Most of the school’s Chinese teachers have a bachelor’s degree or above. Many teachers hold Arizona primary and secondary education certificates. The school attaches great importance to teacher training and the exchange of teaching methods. It has repeatedly invited scholars and teachers with rich experience in Chinese teaching in North America to come to the school to give various lectures on Chinese teaching. It also actively encourages our teachers to participate in the exchange of Chinese teaching in North America. On July 31, 2016, school chairman Mr. Xi Wenjun, principal Ms. Wang Yulan, and Chinese teaching team leader Ms. Gao Jingjing represented Modern Chinese School at the National Chinese Schools Association’s Chinese teaching exchange discussion meeting in Arizona composed of heads of seven Chinese schools. The school will, together with its brother schools, actively organize and participate in the "Overseas Chinese Education Experts Lecture Group" held in Phoenix on August 17, fully organize and mobilize school teachers to participate in the training, actively participate in various Chinese teaching innovation lectures of the tour group, encourage Chinese teachers to work hard to teach Chinese in an entertaining way, and focus on cultivating students' fun and initiative in learning Chinese.

4437990742f9d1e25d9b7e99d7ad2c2e38bcf5da.sourceText: 亚省 现代中文学校董事长 奚文军先生(左)，财务副校长 凌洪(中) ，校长 王玉兰女士(右)
4437990742f9d1e25d9b7e99d7ad2c2e38bcf5da.translatedText: >Alberta Modern Chinese School Chairman Mr. Xi Wenjun (left), Vice Principal of Finance Ling Hong (middle), Principal Ms. Wang Yulan (right)

871d1bd223c567fa18e443db15e0911c7f6000ea.sourceText: 在中文教材选择方面，现代中文学校不断创新，总结历年的教学经验，在采用马立平和暨南大学的中文教材的同时，从本学期开始又增加了王双双的中文教材。王双双校长具有多年的海内外一线中文教学的实践经验，她零距离观察并且认真总结了中西方中文教学的方法，总结出一套自己独特的行之有效的中文教学方式，在反复试用修改基础上，编写出一套独具特色的双双中文教材。这套教材的核心是把汉字的学习放入中华文化学习的流程之中，力求增强华语教学的趣味性，增加学生的求知欲。现代中文学校中文教材的多样化，可以让家长和学生根据自己的兴趣和特点，灵活选择不同的教材，以满足不同学生的学习需求。
871d1bd223c567fa18e443db15e0911c7f6000ea.translatedText: In terms of the selection of Chinese teaching materials, Modern Chinese School continues to innovate and sum up the teaching experience over the years. While using Chinese teaching materials from Ma Liping and Jinan University, it has also added Chinese teaching materials from Wang Shuangshuang starting from this semester. Principal Wang Shuangshuang has many years of practical experience in front-line Chinese teaching at home and abroad. She has observed and carefully summarized Chinese teaching methods in China and the West, and summed up a set of her own unique and effective Chinese teaching methods. Based on repeated trials and modifications, she compiled a unique set of Shuangshuang Chinese teaching materials. The core of this set of textbooks is to incorporate the learning of Chinese characters into the process of learning Chinese culture, striving to make Chinese language teaching more interesting and increase students' thirst for knowledge. The diversification of Chinese teaching materials in modern Chinese schools allows parents and students to flexibly choose different teaching materials according to their own interests and characteristics to meet the learning needs of different students.

4778b205c257780cce85761b66d2ddcf55f6ef52.sourceText: 在注重教师和教材的同时，学校还提倡并鼓励老师们主动积极地与家长联系与沟通，与家长密切配合，倾听家长们的反馈意见，使学校的中文教学方式以及教学质量及时得以完善和提高。学校本着提供全方位教育服务的宗旨，除了开设各类中文课程外，还开设了从小学，初中乃至高中各个年级的数学课程。从本学期开始，学校又增设了AMC”全美数学竞赛”课程，帮助对数学竞赛有兴趣的学生准备参与全美的数学竞赛。这些课程的设置极大地满足了本地华人社区注重数理教育的特殊需求。目前，现代中文学校开设的数学课已经成为学生们在常规学校数学基础教育的重要补充。
4778b205c257780cce85761b66d2ddcf55f6ef52.translatedText: While focusing on teachers and teaching materials, the school also advocates and encourages teachers to proactively contact and communicate with parents, work closely with parents, and listen to parents’ feedback, so that the school’s Chinese teaching methods and teaching quality can be improved and improved in a timely manner. In line with the purpose of providing all-round educational services, in addition to offering various Chinese courses, the school also offers mathematics courses for all grades from elementary school, junior high school to high school. Starting from this semester, the school has added the AMC "National Mathematics Competition" course to help students who are interested in mathematics competitions prepare to participate in national mathematics competitions. The setting of these courses greatly meets the special needs of the local Chinese community focusing on mathematics and science education. At present, the mathematics courses offered by modern Chinese schools have become an important supplement to students’ basic mathematics education in regular schools.

40d90076faf7d83418da19e79ff96603381aa3b4.sourceText: 学校充分考虑并且最大限度地满足本社区学生的学习需要是现代中文学校独具特色办学模式的又一体现。中华文化的博大精深，吸引着众多没有任何华语环境家庭的孩子们。社区内很多非华裔或者混合族裔家庭的孩子们有很强的学习华语的欲望，这些家庭的家长们渴望自己的孩子学习华语，了解中华文化。学校充分考虑到了这个特殊群体的需求，从本学期开始，学校充实了双语教学的教师队伍，新增了双语教学班的数量。双语班的老师用英语教汉语，对老师教学质量和水平提出了更高的要求。学校充分发挥中文学校的教师优势，及时配备了合格的双语教师，充分满足了非华裔家庭或者混合家庭学习中文的特殊需求。
40d90076faf7d83418da19e79ff96603381aa3b4.translatedText: The school fully considers and meets the learning needs of students in this community to the greatest extent, which is another manifestation of the unique school-running model of modern Chinese schools. The breadth and depth of Chinese culture attracts many children from families without any Chinese-speaking environment. Many children from non-Chinese or mixed-ethnic families in the community have a strong desire to learn Chinese. Parents of these families are eager for their children to learn Chinese and understand Chinese culture. The school has fully considered the needs of this special group. Starting from this semester, the school has enriched the team of bilingual teaching teachers and increased the number of bilingual teaching classes. Teachers in bilingual classes teach Chinese in English, which puts forward higher requirements for teachers’ teaching quality and level. The school gives full play to the advantages of teachers in Chinese schools and promptly deploys qualified bilingual teachers to fully meet the special needs of non-Chinese families or mixed families learning Chinese.

7fc808deaaa26f2becb8d847914233847d109ec9.sourceText: 多样化的中华文化传播方式，多功能的社区服务方式，使现代中文学校成为传承中华文化，积极服务社区的典范。
7fc808deaaa26f2becb8d847914233847d109ec9.translatedText: Diversified Chinese cultural communication methods and multi-functional community service methods make modern Chinese schools a model for inheriting Chinese culture and actively serving the community.

c3901038863e86a5810a50cd5d9ddd6bc13adeec.sourceText: 除了目前开设的27个华语班和17个数学班外，学校还开设了其它各类选修课程，包括幼儿说说唱唱，幼儿绘画，中华武术，国际象棋，以及各类科目的AP课程。这个多元化的课程设计都最大限度地满足了学生们各个层次的学习要求。学校还积极组建了学生乐队，鼓励学生参加校内外的各项才艺表演。武术班的小朋友在20周年校庆活动中把传统的中华武术文化展示给了观众，获得了热烈的掌声。学校的学生乐队参加了去年亚省纪念二战及抗日战争胜利70周年黄河大合唱和今年2月份凤凰城春晚的演出。在这两场大型社区活动中，我们的学生乐队表现突出，把精彩的节目呈现给了社区观众，出色地完成了演出任务。由学生家长们组成的舞蹈队在学校20周年校庆活动中表演了精彩的新疆维吾尔族舞蹈，表演效果极佳。现代中文学校的这种多元化的文化传播方式得到社会各界的广泛赞誉。
c3901038863e86a5810a50cd5d9ddd6bc13adeec.translatedText: In addition to the 27 Chinese classes and 17 math classes currently offered, the school also offers various other elective courses, including early childhood rap and singing, early childhood painting, Chinese martial arts, chess, and AP courses in various subjects. This diversified course design meets the learning requirements of students at all levels to the greatest extent. The school has also actively formed a student band to encourage students to participate in various talent performances inside and outside the school. The children in the martial arts class showed traditional Chinese martial arts culture to the audience at the 20th anniversary event and received warm applause. The school’s student band participated in last year’s Yellow River Cantata in Alberta to commemorate the 70th anniversary of the victory of World War II and the Anti-Japanese War and in the Phoenix Spring Festival Gala in February this year. In these two large-scale community activities, our student band performed outstandingly, presented wonderful programs to the community audience, and completed the performance tasks excellently. A dance team composed of parents of students performed a wonderful Xinjiang Uyghur dance at the school's 20th anniversary celebration, with excellent results. This diversified cultural communication method of modern Chinese schools has been widely praised by all walks of life.

580bb01141b9bd38964b16f684c500af2ff28a3e.sourceText: 现代中文学校是几百名学生家长们的聚集地。这些送孩子上学的家长中除了孩子的父母亲外，还包括很多爷爷奶奶，外公外婆。中文学校就这样自然而然地成为了华人活动与交流的中心。
580bb01141b9bd38964b16f684c500af2ff28a3e.translatedText: Modern Chinese School is a gathering place for hundreds of students and their parents. In addition to the children's parents, these parents who send their children to school also include many grandparents. In this way, Chinese schools have naturally become centers of Chinese activities and exchanges.

02fda34a2049cdf5e3ced2ef93f9cc150c80babf.sourceText: 学校历届校委会和董事会充分了解学生家长聚集的现实，采取了一整套行之有效的办法来满足每周几百名家长在中文学校各种活动与交流的要求。学生家长不仅数量庞大，而且背景和爱好各异，这就要求举办的活动能够适合各种不同的文化背景与个人爱好。目前在学校注册的各类成人活动班可谓是玲琅满目，应有尽有：太极拳培训班，成人声乐教育与培训班，瑜伽，中国武术，各类舞蹈，绘画艺术培训班，各类医学专题讲座，摄影艺术等。这些为学生家长们提供的活动大多具有中国文化特色，充分满足了学生家长们学习传承中华文化的的需要。
02fda34a2049cdf5e3ced2ef93f9cc150c80babf.translatedText: The school’s previous school committees and boards of directors fully understand the reality of gatherings of students and parents, and have adopted a set of effective methods to meet the requirements of hundreds of parents for various activities and exchanges at the Chinese school every week. Not only are there a large number of student parents, but they also have different backgrounds and hobbies, which requires that the activities organized can be suitable for various cultural backgrounds and personal hobbies. There are a wide variety of adult activity classes currently registered in the school, including Tai Chi training classes, adult vocal education and training classes, yoga, Chinese martial arts, various dance and painting art training classes, various medical lectures, photography art, etc. Most of these activities provided for students and parents have Chinese cultural characteristics, which fully meet the needs of students and parents to learn and inherit Chinese culture.

f6d93972a175e4b7fd9a4faa5e8a5e7044d2c74f.sourceText: 学校举办的这些活动又成为社区活动的一部分。学校家长合唱团是本地华人社区的积极参与者，近几年来参与了本地春晚和去年黄河大合唱的演出，在本地华人社区的文化交流活动中发挥着越来越重要的作用。今年2月份春晚之际，学校首次与希望中文学校合作举办春节联欢会，两校合办的春节联欢会把华人社区大规模纪念传统中国年活动推向了高潮。
f6d93972a175e4b7fd9a4faa5e8a5e7044d2c74f.translatedText: These activities organized by the school have become part of the community activities. The school's Parents' Choir is an active participant in the local Chinese community. In recent years, it has participated in the local Spring Festival Gala and last year's Yellow River Cantata, playing an increasingly important role in cultural exchange activities in the local Chinese community. On the occasion of the Spring Festival Gala in February this year, the school cooperated with Hope Chinese School for the first time to hold a Spring Festival party. The Spring Festival party jointly organized by the two schools pushed the Chinese community's large-scale commemoration of the traditional Chinese Year to its climax.

0c2ee7de3fc4efd4f6f5fec4074f83cba266113f.sourceText: 亚省现代中文学校走过了自己卓有成效的20年，迎来了自己从事中文教学，传播中华文化，积极参与华人社区活动的第21个年头。新一届学校董事会及校委会将不断探索新的华文教学方法，认真总结自己过去20年的办学经验，把现代中文学校办成凤凰城乃至海外中文教学的模范，中华文化传播的中心，以及华人社团活动的核心力量。(撰稿：苗玉良 摄影：赵涛，Mindy Pan，Jin Wu，若鹏，陈斌)
0c2ee7de3fc4efd4f6f5fec4074f83cba266113f.translatedText: >Alberta Modern Chinese School has gone through 20 fruitful years and ushered in its 21st year of teaching Chinese, spreading Chinese culture, and actively participating in Chinese community activities. The new school board of directors and school committee will continue to explore new Chinese teaching methods, carefully summarize their school-running experience in the past 20 years, and build a modern Chinese school into a model of Chinese teaching in Phoenix and even overseas, a center for the spread of Chinese culture, and a core force for Chinese community activities. (Written by: Miao Yuliang Photography: Zhao Tao, Mindy Pan, Jin Wu, Ruopeng, Chen Bin)

9e105d99b9ab285cd1293d1e708e61cbf6b25a60.sourceText: ASU国际学生学者中心招聘专职联络员的通知 （亚省华联UCAA供稿） 快讯： 亚省华联（UCAA）会长李健受亚利桑那州立大学国际学生学者中心副主任Hoyle先生之托，转发招聘专职联络员的广告。这个联络员要求精通中、英文双语及熟知中美两国文化并受副主任Hoyle先生直接领导。 且体要求请点击下面链接： https://sjobs.brassring.com/tgwebhost/jobdetails.aspx?jobId=2552794&PartnerId=25620&SiteId=5494&type=mail&JobReqLang=1&recordstart=1&JobSiteId=5494&JobSiteInfo=2552794_5494&gqid=1304 请有意申请这个工作机会的人按照上面的链接上网查询具体申请办法。该工作申请截止日期为2016年9月24日。
9e105d99b9ab285cd1293d1e708e61cbf6b25a60.translatedText: > Notice on the recruitment of a full-time liaison officer for the ASU International Students and Scholars Center (Contributed by the UCAA) News: Li Jian, President of the Chinese Association of Chinese Associations of Alberta (UCAA), was entrusted by Mr. Hoyle, deputy director of the International Students and Scholars Center at Arizona State University, to forward the advertisement for a full-time liaison officer. This liaison officer is required to be bilingual in Chinese and English, familiar with Chinese and American cultures, and be directly led by Deputy Director Mr. Hoyle. Please click the link below for physical requirements: https://sjobs.brassring.com/tgwebhost/jobdetails.aspx?jobId=2552794&PartnerId=25620&SiteId=5494&type=mail&JobReqLang=1&recordstart=1&JobSiteId=5494&JobSiteInfo=2552794_5494&gqid=1304 Those who are interested in applying for this job opportunity, please follow the link above to check online for specific application procedures. The job application deadline is September 24, 2016.

024b0c42515caba3af87dfb7593942159b69b520.sourceText: 17号亚省中秋舞蹈节门票售空 多元化舞蹈争奇斗艳 亚利桑那以中国民族舞特色而知名的亚省艺术学院将于9月17日在美莎艺术中心为当地朋友献上一场精彩丰呈的中秋艺术盛宴。9月10日晚上所有节目都完成了彩排。这将是一台形式多样，舞蹈种类繁多的精彩演出。 安塞腰鼓，佤族舞，蒙古舞，藏族舞，汉族舞，古典舞，现代舞，啦啦操，肚皮舞，旗袍舞，不同形式的舞蹈，交相辉映，争奇斗艳。既有古典舞的娟秀，也有蒙古舞的粗犷，豪迈。在这个舞蹈节里，观众不仅能通过舞蹈认识中国各民族的文化，更能通过舞蹈基本功的展示，前桥，后桥，下腰，劈叉，旋转，翻腾，一招一式看到美丽的舞蹈后面，小演员们付出了多少艰辛，打下扎实基础，才能将一个艺术作品呈现在观众面前。亚省艺术学院还力邀当地实力派唱将，声乐专业的崔春将歌曲《但愿人长久》，送给海外华人，共庆中秋佳节。 在正式演出前一个周，亚省中秋舞蹈节所有门票一售而空。亚省艺术学院的演出已经收到当地中美朋友的广泛认可。感谢大家多年来的鼎力支持。很多没有买到票的朋友，我们相约2017年1月28日亚省春晚，一定会给给你来更加震撼的表演。 安塞腰鼓 吉祥曜
024b0c42515caba3af87dfb7593942159b69b520.translatedText: Tickets for the Alberta Mid-Autumn Dance Festival on the 17th are sold out, and diverse dances compete for beauty The Art Institute of Arizona, which is famous for its Chinese folk dance, will present a wonderful Mid-Autumn Festival art feast to local friends at the Mesa Art Center on September 17. Rehearsals for all programs were completed on the evening of September 10th. This will be a wonderful performance with various forms and dance types. Ansai waist drum, Wa dance, Mongolian dance, Tibetan dance, Han dance, classical dance, modern dance, cheerleading, belly dance, cheongsam dance, different forms of dance complement each other and compete with each other. There is both the beauty of classical dance and the roughness and heroism of Mongolian dance. In this dance festival, the audience can not only understand the culture of various ethnic groups in China through dance, but also through the demonstration of basic dance skills, such as front bridge, back bridge, lower back, splits, rotations, somersaults, and every move. Behind the beautiful dance, the young actors have worked hard and laid a solid foundation to present an artistic work in front of the audience. The Art Institute of Alberta also invited local talented singer Cui Chun, who majored in vocal music, to send the song "May You Live Longer" to overseas Chinese to celebrate the Mid-Autumn Festival. One week before the official performance, all tickets for the Alberta Mid-Autumn Dance Festival were sold out. The performance of the Alberta College of the Arts has been widely recognized by local Chinese and American friends. Thank you all for your support over the years. For those of you who have not bought tickets, we will meet you at the Alberta Spring Festival Gala on January 28, 2017, and we will definitely give you a more shocking performance. Ansai waist drum Jixiang Yao

259622fca87a1ee5e629c8873dd767d2973c4df6.translatedText: September 17th, Alberta Mid-Autumn Festival: Dance to express lovesickness

a6bb5ee63fd7955cc8278ae634df82bcf1635464.sourceText: 9月17日亚省中秋舞蹈节：以“舞”寄相思 观赏祭拜，寄托情怀，全家团圆，一起…
a6bb5ee63fd7955cc8278ae634df82bcf1635464.translatedText: September 17th, Alberta Mid-Autumn Dance Festival: Use "dance" to express lovesickness. Watch and worship, express feelings, reunite the whole family, together...

84b022bfa73eabd2b06f186c9c725cea000920d1.sourceText: 观赏祭拜，寄托情怀，全家团圆，一起歌舞，共享美食，形成一个传统的活动。今年 9月17日晚6：30， 当地华人在美莎艺术中心以一场民族歌舞，来庆祝我们的传统节日。
84b022bfa73eabd2b06f186c9c725cea000920d1.translatedText: Watch and worship, express feelings, reunite the whole family, sing and dance together, and share food, forming a traditional activity. This year, at 6:30 pm on September 17th, the local Chinese people celebrated our traditional festival with a folk song and dance at the Meisha Art Center.

8db4394f14b9f8670b87ab02ba1f777c4cba8aa4.sourceText: 凤凰城有一百多当地华人在亚省艺术学院学习中国民族舞，现代舞，舞蹈技巧等等。本次舞蹈节很多演员已经过多年的专业训练，将以”舞”寄相思，用最中国的艺术，表达海外华人对祖国，对亲人的情感。
8db4394f14b9f8670b87ab02ba1f777c4cba8aa4.translatedText: There are more than one hundred local Chinese in Phoenix studying Chinese folk dance, modern dance, dance techniques, etc. at the Alberta College of the Arts. Many performers in this dance festival have received professional training for many years and will use "dance" to express their lovesickness and use the most Chinese art to express the feelings of overseas Chinese towards their motherland and their relatives.

4d0ebdadd685341b655c59a6c759f2e59085f8a2.sourceText: 身边的那片田野啊，手边的枣花香，高粱熟来红满天，九儿我送你去远方厖?舞蹈《九儿》，将家乡那片熟悉的土地，再次展现在观众的面前。远离家乡的九儿，一个翻腕，一个抬手，步步美化你的心 ”海上升明月，天涯共此时”她将身在异乡的情感表现的丝丝入扣，凄美，动人，扣人心悬，那就是思乡的感觉吧。
4d0ebdadd685341b655c59a6c759f2e59085f8a2.translatedText: The fields around me, the fragrance of jujube flowers at hand, the ripe sorghum fills the sky with red, Jiuer, I will send you to the distant place. The dance "Jiuer" once again shows the familiar land of my hometown in front of the audience. Jiu'er, who is far away from home, turns her wrists and raises her hands to beautify your heart step by step. "The moon rises in the sea, and we are at the end of the world at this moment." She expresses the emotions of being in a foreign land in a detailed way. It is poignant, touching, and heart-wrenching. It is the feeling of homesickness.

efd10777c0677801583376df9eaffb8d8ec0fc4b.sourceText: 舞蹈《梅花泪》，是中国民族身韵训练的集锦，每个挥袖，每个回眸，都体现东方美女的韵味。《惊鸿舞》首个母女同台演出的节目，身穿宫廷华服 的大小佳丽，集宠爱于一身，娇柔可爱，仪态万千。
efd10777c0677801583376df9eaffb8d8ec0fc4b.translatedText: The dance "Plum Blossom Tears" is a collection of Chinese national body charm training. Every wave of sleeves and every look back reflects the charm of oriental beauty. "The Dance" is the first program where a mother and daughter perform on the same stage. The beauties, big and small, dressed in palace costumes, are pampered, delicate and cute, and full of grace.

99be4b3459f018c1c7b7dd53dbcae9199b73e152.sourceText: 俗话说”台上一分钟，台下十年功”从三岁到十几岁的小演员，将会有非常精彩的舞蹈技巧展示，让大家看看那些美如诗，细如画的舞蹈，都是通过怎样严格的训练，才能表现得淋漓尽致。这是将是一场亚利桑那华人高水平的舞蹈大竞技。
99be4b3459f018c1c7b7dd53dbcae9199b73e152.translatedText: As the saying goes, "One minute on stage, ten years off stage." The young actors from three years old to teenagers will have a very exciting display of dance skills, allowing everyone to see how those beautiful and picturesque dances can be performed through rigorous training. This will be a high-level dance competition for Arizona Chinese.

fb7b173583980b930c17929ffa33f593e6c8d978.translatedText: Facebook drone made successful maiden flight in Arizona

e39db675054d84f608e72478f800f259413b5009.sourceText: Facebook无人机在亚利桑那首航成功 Facebook 今日宣布，其网络投送无人机 Aquila…
e39db675054d84f608e72478f800f259413b5009.translatedText: Facebook drone made successful maiden flight in Arizona Facebook announced today that its network delivery drone Aquila...

6a55b5a2413f3211cdf3ef5f9bd935939473c9df.sourceText: Facebook 今日宣布，其网络投送无人机 Aquila 已经于 6 月 28 日在亚利桑那州的一个军用机场成功首航。虽然此前 Facebook 工程师测试一款五分之一尺寸的 Aquila 已有数月时间，但这次是全尺寸 Aquila 的第一次成功试飞。Aquila 首航在低空飞行了 96 分钟，飞行时间超过了 Facebook 此前预期的三倍。Facebook 创始人兼 CEO 扎克伯格也亲自到场见证了这一时刻。
6a55b5a2413f3211cdf3ef5f9bd935939473c9df.translatedText: Facebook announced today that its network delivery drone Aquila had successfully made its maiden flight at a military airport in Arizona on June 28. While Facebook engineers have been testing a fifth-size Aquila for months, this is the first successful test flight of a full-size Aquila. Aquila's maiden flight lasted 96 minutes at low altitude, more than three times Facebook's previous expectations. Facebook founder and CEO Zuckerberg was also present to witness the moment.

9082ba5d0f3e0d5e099648a639f65a703ad8e76a.sourceText: Aquila 是由太阳能面板供电的，理论上一次可以飞行至多 3 个月时间，速度达到每小时 120 公里；虽然翼展接近波音 737 飞机，但重量仅有 453 公斤；开启巡航模式，耗电仅为5000瓦，功耗仅仅相当于三个头发吹风机或者一台微波炉。按照设计规划，这架无人机可以在 18000 米的高空飞行，通过激光和毫米波技术，为那些传统网络设备无法抵达的偏远地区推送互联网，网络覆盖半径为 96 公里。
9082ba5d0f3e0d5e099648a639f65a703ad8e76a.translatedText: Aquila is powered by solar panels and can theoretically fly for up to 3 months at a time at a speed of 120 kilometers per hour. Although its wingspan is close to that of a Boeing 737 aircraft, it weighs only 453 kilograms. When in cruise mode, it consumes only 5,000 watts of power, which is equivalent to three hair dryers or a microwave oven. According to the design plan, this drone can fly at an altitude of 18,000 meters, using laser and millimeter wave technology to push the Internet to remote areas that cannot be reached by traditional network equipment, with a network coverage radius of 96 kilometers.

b53d4853e0ca917a2206587a6c01a99c2dcd7df1.sourceText: 未来 Facebook 还将继续测试和推进 Aquila 的性能。目前太阳能无人机的续航记录是两个星期，Aquila 要达到 Facebook 长达 3 个月续航的预期还要进行诸多后续研发。相对而言，谷歌的气球网络可以在高空平流层漂浮 6 个月。不过，要使用 Facebook 推送的网络，地面依然需要设置天线，将无人机推送的信号转化为 Wi-Fi 或 4G 网络。这意味着，如果当地不愿意设置天线接受信号，那么也无法接入互联网。同样的，谷歌的气球项目也必须得到当地政府的批准。
b53d4853e0ca917a2206587a6c01a99c2dcd7df1.translatedText: Facebook will continue to test and advance the performance of Aquila in the future. The current battery life record for solar-powered drones is two weeks, and Aquila still needs to undergo a lot of follow-up research and development to reach Facebook’s expectation of a battery life of up to three months. By comparison, Google's network of balloons can float high in the stratosphere for six months. However, to use the network pushed by Facebook, antennas still need to be set up on the ground to convert the signal pushed by the drone into a Wi-Fi or 4G network. This means that if the local area is unwilling to set up antennas to receive signals, it will not be able to access the Internet. Likewise, Google's balloon project must get approval from local governments.

ec966ef62fc8dd99cccd08d09607b6c942e0486f.translatedText: Alphabet will develop self-driving car technology in Arizona Google parent company Alphabet said on Thursday that after launching a self-driving car cooperation with Fiat-…

3a64bf4c6f33e1ec978d3e2a4df489f8f6d3a704.sourceText: 谷歌母公司Alphabet周四表示，在与菲亚特-克莱斯勒展开无人驾驶汽车合作后，该公司还将与更多汽车厂商在亚利桑那州的菲尼克斯进行类似的合作。Alphabet与菲亚特-克莱斯勒的交易是今年5月宣布的，两家公司计划于2017年在100辆左右的Pacifica混动旅行车上安装无人驾驶技术。首批车辆将在今年晚些时候上路，从而将谷歌的无人驾驶汽车路测规模扩大一倍。
3a64bf4c6f33e1ec978d3e2a4df489f8f6d3a704.translatedText: Google parent Alphabet said on Thursday that after launching a self-driving car cooperation with Fiat Chrysler, the company will also conduct similar cooperation with more automakers in Phoenix, Arizona. The deal between Alphabet and Fiat Chrysler was announced in May, and the two companies plan to install self-driving technology on about 100 Pacifica hybrid station wagons in 2017. The first vehicles will hit the road later this year, doubling the scope of Google's self-driving car testing.

e965fe4e5cf17c4e2712309a7575aaf4da6ef83c.sourceText: Alphabet目前的路测车队包括24辆改装的雷克萨斯SUV和34辆专为Alphabet打造的原型汽车。
e965fe4e5cf17c4e2712309a7575aaf4da6ef83c.translatedText: >Alphabet’s current road test fleet includes 24 modified Lexus SUVs and 34 prototype cars specially built for Alphabet.

a9d705e977d193efdd0f82695d72c98548cbcc47.sourceText: 谷歌及其母公司Alphabet的CF鲁斯?#29632;拉特(Ruth Porat)周四在电话会议上表示，菲亚特-克莱斯勒的交易是Alphabet首次直接与汽车厂商合作，但并非最后一次。?#25105;们很高兴与菲亚特-克莱斯勒展开合作，这将把我们的车辆数量扩大一倍多。?#22905;说，?#25105;们还希望能在这一领域与很多伙伴展开合作。?/FONT>
a9d705e977d193efdd0f82695d72c98548cbcc47.translatedText: Ruth Porat, CF of Google and its parent company Alphabet, said on a conference call Thursday that the Fiat-Chrysler deal is Alphabet's first time working directly with an automaker, but it won't be the last. ?#25105;We are pleased to partner with Fiat Chrysler, which will more than double our vehicle fleet. ?#22905; said, ?#25105; We also hope to cooperate with many partners in this field. ?/FONT>

3d77a17036b07bf589b7d631639e5c6d64b03991.sourceText: 珀拉特并未披露更多信息。
3d77a17036b07bf589b7d631639e5c6d64b03991.translatedText: Platt did not disclose any more information.

7ed2e664e942ed30584f19db56c7e14ab737ce00.sourceText: 无人驾驶汽车是Alphabet的大型?#30331;月?#35745;划之一棗这些计划都会投资新的技术领域，虽然可能需要许多年时间才能实现商业化，但却会给行业带来重大变革。 珀拉特提到无人驾驶汽车时说：?#25105;们正在解决巨大需求。?BR>
7ed2e664e942ed30584f19db56c7e14ab737ce00.translatedText: Self-driving cars are one of Alphabet's big plans. These plans will invest in new areas of technology. Although it may take many years to achieve commercialization, they will bring significant changes to the industry. "We are solving a huge need," Perrat said of self-driving cars. ?BR>

448f78b312f2898e87f58cac2d75a8ed8d8e439d.sourceText: Alphabet上季度在类似项目上亏损8.59亿美元，其中很多都与谷歌光纤高速上网项目有关。不过，Alphabet旗下谷歌的70亿美元利润可以轻松覆盖这些亏损。
448f78b312f2898e87f58cac2d75a8ed8d8e439d.translatedText: Alphabet lost $859 million on similar projects last quarter, many of which were related to Google's fiber optic high-speed Internet project. However, Alphabet's Google's $7 billion in profits can easily cover these losses.

291f637174cdd17d734588ad2324050dc522d453.sourceText: Alphabet目前正在美国四大城市测试无人驾驶汽车，除了亚利桑那州的菲尼克斯，还包括加州山景城、华盛顿州科克兰和得州奥斯汀。
291f637174cdd17d734588ad2324050dc522d453.translatedText: Alphabet is currently testing self-driving cars in four major cities in the United States, including Phoenix, Arizona, Mountain View, California, Kirkland, Washington, and Austin, Texas.

d01e72b4ae19568b5b69bd8cc091d784e81ed089.sourceText: 自从2009年开始这一项目以来，这些汽车的行驶里程已经超过了170万英里(280万公里)。
d01e72b4ae19568b5b69bd8cc091d784e81ed089.translatedText: Since the program began in 2009, the vehicles have logged more than 1.7 million miles (2.8 million kilometers).

1503ec09c59e4b9311b1511e20c9efc2836f4683.sourceText: 亚省首位华裔女参议员 Kimberly Yee 在共和党全国代表大会上发表演讲
1503ec09c59e4b9311b1511e20c9efc2836f4683.translatedText: Kimberly Yee, Alberta's first Chinese-American female senator, gave a speech at the Republican National Convention

aab2f436f60835b70c723533c5bfbf2ed9ec468c.sourceText: 亚省首位华裔女参议员 Kimberly Yee 在共和党全国代表大会上发表演讲 本周一在克利夫兰的共和党全…
aab2f436f60835b70c723533c5bfbf2ed9ec468c.translatedText: Alberta's first Chinese-American female senator, Kimberly Yee, gave a speech at the Republican National Convention This Monday at the Republican National Convention in Cleveland...

6f73a50c2051ee00793f2a69e0e056906386f0f4.sourceText: 本周一在克利夫兰的共和党全国代表大会上，就在她准备上台做演讲的时候 Kimberly Yee的手机开始嗡嗡作响。
6f73a50c2051ee00793f2a69e0e056906386f0f4.translatedText: At the Republican National Convention in Cleveland this Monday, just as she was about to take the stage to give a speech, Kimberly Yee's cell phone started buzzing.

2c9e03662bd42780f807106292597df079756bcc.sourceText: 这位来自亚利桑那州共和党参议员的丈夫给她发送了一张她的两个儿子的照片，手机上的简讯写着：＂我知道你做这件事是为了他们。＂
2c9e03662bd42780f807106292597df079756bcc.translatedText: The husband, a Republican senator from Arizona, sent her a photo of her two sons, and a text message on his phone read: "I know you did this for them."

a1f32ba0c17236ad9ff1e43f09f1604d7fac2a6d.sourceText: 对于Yee来说，这几乎是一个不可想象的时刻。她生长于亚利桑那州，Yee的父母经常教育她只要用心去做，她就能实现自己的愿望。然而，他们也许做梦也没有想到他们的女儿有一天会在这个国家共和党的聚会上发表演讲。
a1f32ba0c17236ad9ff1e43f09f1604d7fac2a6d.translatedText: For Yee, this was an almost unimaginable moment. She grew up in Arizona. Yee's parents often taught her that as long as she puts her mind to it, she can realize her wishes. Yet they perhaps never dreamed that their daughter would one day speak at a gathering of the nation's Republican Party.

a810e47acfda4f010bb4c4012f3de44ca93153f0.sourceText: Yee的演讲内容在第一天整个会议上party一样的气氛中显得十分简洁。然而现场拥有相同经历的共和党代表对她的演讲表示了赞许。
a810e47acfda4f010bb4c4012f3de44ca93153f0.translatedText: The content of Yee's speech was very concise in the party-like atmosphere of the entire conference on the first day. However, Republican representatives who had the same experience at the scene praised her speech.

92d18cfdee0f39fd26a70ea602a403e21bdeabde.sourceText: 她讲述了她的家庭从中国移民到美国的经历。她的曾曾祖父在20世纪的转折点时移民美国，为了寻求更好的生活。那时他经营一家洗衣店的生意。在店里他需要手洗衣服。
92d18cfdee0f39fd26a70ea602a403e21bdeabde.translatedText: She talked about her family’s experience immigrating to the United States from China. Her great-great-grandfather immigrated to the United States at the turning point of the 20th century in search of a better life. At that time he ran a laundry business. In the store he needs to wash clothes by hand.

f0ca5f6543958fed8f72314d514e89f26b8e1fa1.sourceText: ＂曾曾祖父的儿子和他的孙子，两代人都在经营着他们洗衣房的家族生意。他的子孙就是我的父母。他们告诉我，在这个伟大的国家里，我能够实现一切我想要的东西。＂Kimberly Yee说道。
f0ca5f6543958fed8f72314d514e89f26b8e1fa1.translatedText: "My great-great-grandfather's son and his grandson, two generations have been running the family business of their laundry room. His descendants are my parents. They told me that in this great country, I can achieve everything I want." Kimberly Yee said.

0d2734a00f52dba2ed1f83df5c64edd6af464ca1.sourceText: Yee 是当选亚利桑那立议会的第一位美国华裔女性。她也为自己赢得了作为公众监督人选的声誉。一直坚持揭露州内政府机构管理不善的问题。
0d2734a00f52dba2ed1f83df5c64edd6af464ca1.translatedText: Yee is the first Chinese American woman elected to the Arizona Legislature. She has also built a reputation for herself as a candidate for public scrutiny. It has been persistent in exposing the mismanagement of government agencies in the state.

8f10e696aa0999aee6f6e62956343629610fd251.sourceText: Yee告诉参加代表大会的嘉宾，作为州参议员，她将自己父母教给自己的价值观运用于实践：＂勤奋，节约，坚持控制政府规模，并且保护新事物。＂
8f10e696aa0999aee6f6e62956343629610fd251.translatedText: Yee told convention guests that as a state senator, she put into practice the values ​​her parents taught her: "hard work, frugality, insisting on controlling the size of government, and protecting new things."

c0716629b07104f7d7bd5fe9aefec4135ca931b8.sourceText: 现在她表示，她将会把这些价值观告诉给自己的孩子。
c0716629b07104f7d7bd5fe9aefec4135ca931b8.translatedText: Now she said she will teach these values ​​to her children.

b034dabe0c31c0f4db4e255f3c111ebc57cc7795.sourceText: ＂现在是时候重温帮助这个国家变得强大的那些共和党的保守观念了。＂来自菲尼克斯西北地区的Yee表示。＂在未来的四年里，我们不能重复过去八年中一直忍受的事情。所以出于这个原因，我支持Donald J. Trump当选总统。＂
b034dabe0c31c0f4db4e255f3c111ebc57cc7795.translatedText: "Now is the time to revisit the conservative ideas of the Republican Party that helped make this country strong." Yee, who is from northwest Phoenix, said. "In the next four years, we cannot repeat what we have endured for the past eight years. So for that reason, I support Donald J. Trump for president."

f72dc4352636f6a4d58e788dd5db1fbf26ab102a.sourceText: 会议现场的一些粉丝– 一些亚裔美国人 — 在她演讲结束后要求与她一起合影。
f72dc4352636f6a4d58e788dd5db1fbf26ab102a.translatedText: Some fans at the conference - some Asian Americans - asked to take a photo with her after her speech.

99a8e6d9ed0142585d1b05b37a5d94b345342c7e.sourceText: 另一个来自德州 Arlington 的代表 Peichi Shinn 在听完Yee的演讲后表示想去和她握手。
99a8e6d9ed0142585d1b05b37a5d94b345342c7e.translatedText: Peichi Shinn, another representative from Arlington, Texas, expressed his desire to shake hands with Yee after listening to her speech.

f8e1d93685a0b58f2f057d330a2cf18660af3c2a.sourceText: ＂她非常具有感召力，＂Shinn 说道，?#30475;到她让我感到我自己被代表了。我刚刚一直在说：＇加油！Yee！＇＂
f8e1d93685a0b58f2f057d330a2cf18660af3c2a.translatedText: "She was very charismatic," Shinn said, and she made me feel represented. I just kept saying: 'Come on! Yee! ''

6620350390a7a17dc77e28cfb8f6e693f16e9612.sourceText: 做智慧型父母，陪伴孩子成长 父母在与子女互动过程中，经常采取何种教养方式，是自主支持还是心理控制？不同的教养方式对子女的学业成就、人格发展及幸福感具有怎样的影响？父母如何遵循儿童青少年心理发展的规律与特点，在子女成长的不同阶段，引导、陪伴他们从容应对可能出现的各种心理危机及适应障碍、成为促进子女健康成长的智慧型父母？
6620350390a7a17dc77e28cfb8f6e693f16e9612.translatedText: Become a smart parent and accompany your children to grow. What kind of parenting methods do parents often adopt when interacting with their children? Is it autonomy support or psychological control? What impact do different parenting styles have on children’s academic achievement, personality development and happiness? How can parents follow the laws and characteristics of the psychological development of children and adolescents, guide and accompany their children to calmly cope with various psychological crises and adaptation disorders at different stages of their children's growth, and become smart parents who promote the healthy growth of their children?

eb9615eda31beb9c6b471b43831c63abf763fd25.sourceText: 晚明小品 中国古代散文是一条渊源流长的历史长河，亘古至今，浩渺无际。发展至晚明，遂开辟出另一条新径，史称小品。小品文是晚明新思想文化背景下的产物，走出了?#25991;以载道?#30340;传统，自由抒写个性自我，表现赤子之心和禅悦之风，并与日益奢侈的消费习尚相结合，形成了求新求乐的生活艺术趋向。本次讲座包括以下几个方面：一、晚明小品中的性灵表现；二、生活艺术化–晚明小品中的陶情与养生；三、乐游之风–晚明小品中的自然山水；四、怡悦情性–晚明小品中的艺术鉴赏；五、人生感悟–晚明清言小品。每个方面都在简单讲述基本状况（理论、概念、思想）之后，选择代表性文本进行分析，以期使听众能够有直接感受。本次讲座的目的是使听者感受古代散文的另一种美，并体悟到古代文化贴近人生与社会，能够与当代社会文化的相通之处。
eb9615eda31beb9c6b471b43831c63abf763fd25.translatedText: Late Ming Dynasty sketches Ancient Chinese prose is a long historical river with a long history, from ancient times to the present, and is boundless. It developed into the late Ming Dynasty and opened up another new path, known as Xiaopin in history. Essays are a product of the new ideological and cultural background of the late Ming Dynasty. They break away from the tradition of "carrying truth" and freely express individuality and self, express innocence and Zen joy, and combine with increasingly luxurious consumption habits to form a trend of life art that seeks novelty and pleasure. This lecture covers the following aspects: 1. Spiritual expression in the late Ming Dynasty sketches; 2. Art of life - Taoism and health preservation in the late Ming Dynasty sketches; 3. The style of joyful travel - the natural landscape in the late Ming Dynasty sketches; 4. Joyful sentiment - art appreciation in the late Ming Dynasty sketches; 5. Life insights - Qingyan sketches in the late Ming Dynasty. In each aspect, after briefly describing the basic situation (theories, concepts, ideas), representative texts are selected for analysis, so that the audience can have a direct experience. The purpose of this lecture is to make the listeners feel another kind of beauty of ancient prose, and realize that ancient culture is close to life and society, and can be connected with contemporary social culture.

9f86eae351c9518f73a3ed110ca536f00f127408.translatedText: The Arizona wildfires still threaten nearby communities (ABC News) The wildfires that have swept through the southwestern United States in recent days have had an impact on Arizona. According to the United States...

da463e910026651dd3b8acb5aa6b97ccb1455b74.sourceText: (ABC News)近日来席卷美国西南部的山火对亚利桑那州造成影响。据美国当地消防员称，他们正在努力控制一处山火蔓延至亚利桑那东部的一个乡村小镇地区。
da463e910026651dd3b8acb5aa6b97ccb1455b74.translatedText: (ABC News) The wildfires that have swept through the southwestern United States in recent days have affected Arizona. Firefighters in the United States said they were working to control a wildfire that spread to a rural town in eastern Arizona.

f7450b69b5d796fa727f44b636a3c3bea0d241ec.sourceText: 据相关官员本周三提供的消息，多亏了植被稀疏，威胁着Cedar Creek社区的山火火焰在过去24小时内并没有造成大面积的移动。
f7450b69b5d796fa727f44b636a3c3bea0d241ec.translatedText: The wildfire flames threatening the Cedar Creek community have not caused widespread movement in the past 24 hours, thanks to sparse vegetation, officials said Wednesday.

de8363cb6b48315102fba665650bd73bfdbb3457.sourceText: 山火已经烧毁了大约67平方英里的地区，起火点在Cedar Creek北部大约二又二分之一英里的地方。现在部分火势已经被控制住了。
de8363cb6b48315102fba665650bd73bfdbb3457.translatedText: The wildfire has burned approximately 67 square miles and started approximately two and one-half miles north of Cedar Creek. Part of the fire is now under control.

a890f8b3ffd8a3d48cc4081547396e88b44fc22e.sourceText: 消防队员正在集中精力对付火线扩张的问题和开展灭火作业。
a890f8b3ffd8a3d48cc4081547396e88b44fc22e.translatedText: Firefighters are focusing on dealing with the problem of fire line expansion and carrying out fire extinguishing operations.

5d4942a781dd355003ee0f414e7b60978ae6bb34.sourceText: 当地居民已经被告知做好从暴露的低地、松树顶和湖边等邻近火区的地方撤离的准备。政府官员Doug Ducey周二发表了紧急声明，增加州内财政预算以向火灾做斗争。
5d4942a781dd355003ee0f414e7b60978ae6bb34.translatedText: Local residents have been told to prepare to evacuate from exposed lowlands, Pine Tops and lakefront areas adjacent to the fire area. Gov. Doug Ducey issued an emergency declaration Tuesday to increase the state's budget to combat the fires.

0d08672347a19f84d183b310969ef47ec6606b3f.sourceText: 据悉本次山火于6月15日开始，具体成因还在调查之中。
0d08672347a19f84d183b310969ef47ec6606b3f.translatedText: It is reported that the wildfire started on June 15, and the specific cause is still under investigation.

28f75a2c1d030bf3870126ae55f1134a55745bfe.sourceText: 通过微信公众号订餐在国内早就已经屡见不鲜。但是在美国还只有洛杉矶和纽约的几家饭店刚刚开始使用。
28f75a2c1d030bf3870126ae55f1134a55745bfe.translatedText: Ordering food through WeChat official accounts has long been common in China. But in the United States, only a few restaurants in Los Angeles and New York have just started using it.

f91fe94ad8abdba32ba7b948520fa2e6b1b28dbf.sourceText: 坐落于Tempe的龙焱烧烤不断引领潮流和时尚，已经将这种新的科技运用到他们的订餐系统中。消费者只需要关注他们的公众号，就可以进入他们的订餐系统，直接通过手机屏幕下单。
f91fe94ad8abdba32ba7b948520fa2e6b1b28dbf.translatedText: Longyan BBQ located in Tempe continues to lead the trend and fashion, and has applied this new technology to their ordering system. Consumers only need to follow their official account to enter their ordering system and place orders directly through their mobile phone screens.

cc677224332f74c96e54dbd3d151bc4159c03219.sourceText: 这种新的订餐体验，可以将客户平均的订餐时间从原来的6分钟缩短到1分钟。并且完全的避免了点餐的过程当中与服务人员沟通方面造成的错误。据很多客户反映，由于手机点餐的时候旁边没有服务人员等候，他们也没有了必须迅速点餐的压力。点餐过程更加随意轻松。
cc677224332f74c96e54dbd3d151bc4159c03219.translatedText: This new ordering experience can shorten the average ordering time for customers from the original 6 minutes to 1 minute. And it completely avoids errors caused by communication with service staff during the ordering process. According to many customers, since there are no service staff waiting next to them when ordering via mobile phone, they no longer have the pressure to order quickly. The ordering process is more casual and relaxed.

f266bb734fd32912601a295da086d0a029d64cf7.sourceText: 除此之外，这款手机点餐系统还设置了，购物积分，会员奖励等一系列的促销和回馈老客户的功能。使得这款系统更加具有?#20154;情味?#12290;
f266bb734fd32912601a295da086d0a029d64cf7.translatedText: In addition, this mobile ordering system also has a series of promotion and feedback functions for old customers such as shopping points and membership rewards. It makes this system more interesting.

02b0cf939e9e8455fe86f84e62af981809458549.sourceText: 目前龙炎烧烤正在展开?#20998;享奖励?#27963;动。
02b0cf939e9e8455fe86f84e62af981809458549.translatedText: Currently, Longyan BBQ is launching a reward-enjoying activity.

e1241b623ecde56e74b6c6e0733dfbe5109ac79f.sourceText: 本活动是指商户设置奖励，粉丝转发朋友圈带来新的粉丝即可获得奖励。
e1241b623ecde56e74b6c6e0733dfbe5109ac79f.translatedText: This activity means that merchants set rewards, and fans can get rewards by forwarding them to their circle of friends and bringing new fans.

8343d6ea3e45a0c980b43e89fde992dbfb6e55f2.sourceText: 1. 已经关注了商户公众号的粉丝转发商户订购页面到朋友圈，粉丝的朋友关注公众号并进入订购页面分享信息的粉丝即获得奖励。
8343d6ea3e45a0c980b43e89fde992dbfb6e55f2.translatedText: 1. Fans who have followed the merchant's official account forward the merchant's ordering page to their circle of friends. Fans whose friends follow the official account and enter the ordering page to share information will receive rewards.

b751cc22974a812af6e4c31fea4a1f5599403983.sourceText: 2. 每增加一个粉丝只获得一次奖励，反复取消关注只视为一次。
b751cc22974a812af6e4c31fea4a1f5599403983.translatedText: 2. Each additional fan will only be rewarded once, and repeated unfollowing will only be considered once.

eb7a0992b43f45c6b2b0cd80affd0fab1e77ddb0.sourceText: 3. 每次奖励的金额为1美金的代金券。使用有效期为30天。

612abe194177b6bda8508fdfef59b8264114a411.sourceText: 亚利桑那州两位共和党代表宁愿辞职也不投票给Trump 菲尼克斯（美联社）–至少两位亚利桑那州共…
612abe194177b6bda8508fdfef59b8264114a411.translatedText: Two Arizona Republican representatives would rather resign than vote for Trump PHOENIX (AP) – At least two Arizona Republican representatives…

9c9694a6d6af5f0cc150d624fdd3fcb43af75e11.sourceText: 菲尼克斯（美联社）–至少两位亚利桑那州共和党代表要求辞职，因为他们不愿意在下个月于克利夫兰举行的共和党全国代表大会上为Donald Trump投票。
9c9694a6d6af5f0cc150d624fdd3fcb43af75e11.translatedText: > PHOENIX (AP) – At least two Arizona Republican representatives have asked to resign because they are unwilling to vote for Donald Trump at next month’s Republican National Convention in Cleveland.

367dc75f5d4280154f34d4b99e55f33bfe689d68.sourceText: 截止目前，58位州代表中的9位已经辞职。前任亚利桑那州长候选人Frank Riggs和一位穆斯林改革倡导者Zuhdi Jasser均表示如果代表大会有一定的竞争性，那么他们将会前往。
367dc75f5d4280154f34d4b99e55f33bfe689d68.translatedText: So far, 9 of the 58 state representatives have resigned. Former Arizona gubernatorial candidate Frank Riggs and a Muslim reform advocate Zuhdi Jasser both said they would go to the convention if it were competitive.

0712c64ba6548361c2632120a0a2e1cc1d8c84ec.sourceText: 前加州众议员Riggs提到他辞职的主要原因是想将精力放在帮助自己妻子争取和平的正义行动上。然而他也承认对Trump作为指定的共和党总统候选人持有’非常严肃的保留意见’。
0712c64ba6548361c2632120a0a2e1cc1d8c84ec.translatedText: Former California Representative Riggs mentioned that the main reason for his resignation was to focus on justice actions to help his wife fight for peace. However, he also admitted to having "very serious reservations" about Trump as the designated Republican presidential candidate.

52e3e9701ed43e3dde19a038c176fb7fcd9d5c6c.sourceText: Riggs 说他’意识到自己不能凭良心到克利夫兰去投票支持（Trump的）提名。’
52e3e9701ed43e3dde19a038c176fb7fcd9d5c6c.translatedText: Riggs said he’s aware he can’t in good conscience go to Cleveland to vote for the nomination. '

204275e2b1c209c460485cbda08a0f82d29bd7ec.sourceText: ’我猜想如果这有政治后果，我会面对这些挫折。’Riggs告诉 （Arizona Capital Times）。
204275e2b1c209c460485cbda08a0f82d29bd7ec.translatedText: ' I guess if there were political consequences to this, I would face these setbacks. ’ Riggs told (Arizona Capital Times).

34e2c5b6630f929c14ae0e14afeb0ea86bca2073.sourceText: 在他递交给党内官员的辞职信中，Jasser称Trump是’每天尴尬的保守主义’。这位来自凤凰城的医生说，尽管自己在一些问题上有不同意见，但是他支持共和党的候选人。
34e2c5b6630f929c14ae0e14afeb0ea86bca2073.translatedText: In his resignation letter to party officials, Jasser called Trump "a daily embarrassing conservatism." The Phoenix doctor said he supports the Republican nominee despite his disagreements on some issues.

fa0110f0fc7a3f2d4c949cc6d1d8e4b72ea2eb9c.sourceText: 然而作为一名穆斯林，Jasser不同意Trump关于禁止穆斯林移民的议案。他坚信美国政府应该临时性的停止穆斯林移民进入，直到整个国家找到一个更好的办法来清除极端分子，而不是妖魔化穆斯林。
fa0110f0fc7a3f2d4c949cc6d1d8e4b72ea2eb9c.translatedText: However, as a Muslim, Jasser disagrees with Trump’s bill to ban Muslim immigration. He firmly believes that the U.S. government should temporarily halt Muslim immigration until the country can find a better way to eliminate extremists than demonize Muslims.

e46501142d68c36581a6cf27ebd834f72666aa88.sourceText: ’一位能够站在世界最大平台上的总统候选人如果没有能力处理穆斯林身份认同问题的威胁，并将伊斯兰政教合一的思想视为威胁，以及无力解决穆斯林和伊斯兰教如何面对现代性的问题，那么他就不能负担起这个责任。’Jasser说。
e46501142d68c36581a6cf27ebd834f72666aa88.translatedText: ’ A presidential candidate who can stand on the world’s largest platform cannot shoulder this responsibility if he is unable to deal with the threat of Muslim identity and the idea of ​​​​theocracy as a threat, and unable to solve the problem of how Muslims and Islam face modernity. ’ Jasser said.

90dc10cf111d2688430ee4a5f12d033896c77ca5.translatedText: Brief summary of the leadership team meeting of the Chinese Alliance of Alberta (UCAA) (Contributed by UCAA) The leadership team of the Leadership Team of the Chinese Alliance of Alberta (UCAA) held a meeting at noon on June 26...

f5a82288c3bc99653885a980cd3124f12174e6ff.sourceText: （亚省华联UCAA供稿） 亚省华联（UCAA）领导团队于六月二十六日中午在皇冠大酒店举行了特别工作午餐会。华联会长李健首先介绍了在北京参加”第八届世界华人华侨社团联谊大会”的收获。介绍了国家总理李克强，国务委员杨洁篪和国侨办主任裘援平的重要讲话。李会长特别深入介绍了国侨办主任裘援平女士在第八届世界华侨华人社团联谊大会上的主题报告”携手绘就和谐景 同心共筑民族梦”。裘主任指出本次大会的主题是：中国梦 侨胞梦-团结协作 造福侨社。围绕这个主题裘主任从三方面展开：一、海外侨社蓬勃发展，内生动力不断增强；二、侨社建设深入推进，惠侨工程稳步实施；三、携手同心造福侨社，同圆共享复兴梦。 李会长在谈到对大会和随后的陕西行的印象时，感受最深的是从中央到地方的各级政府部门的领导和工作人员都非常专业，睿智，有才华和平易近人。最后，针对海外和谐侨社建设与参会的华联领导团队进行了热烈讨论。对裘主任的忠恳建议深表认同，特别是要树立四种意识、做到四个注意：一是树立落地生根意识，注重融入当地社会；二是树立荣辱与共意识，注重维护族群形象；三是树立遵守法律意识，注重文明经商；四是树立知恩图报意识，注重回馈社会公益。 在华联组织发展上，李会长提议增设科技文化交流部，并推荐由鲁钟博士负责，与会人员一致同意。接下来，大家讨论了近期的热点话题。
f5a82288c3bc99653885a980cd3124f12174e6ff.translatedText: (Contributed by UCAA of Alberta) The UCAA leadership team held a special working luncheon at the Crown Hotel at noon on June 26th. Li Jian, President of Hualian, first introduced what he gained from participating in the "Eighth World Chinese Overseas Chinese Associations Conference" in Beijing. Important speeches by Prime Minister Li Keqiang, State Councilor Yang Jiechi and Director of the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the State Council Qiu Yuanping were introduced. President Li made a special in-depth introduction to the theme report delivered by Ms. Qiu Yuanping, director of the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the State Council, at the 8th World Overseas Chinese Association Conference, "Working together to create a harmonious landscape and build a national dream together." Director Qiu pointed out that the theme of this conference is: Chinese Dream, Overseas Chinese Dream - Unity and Cooperation to Benefit the Overseas Chinese Community. Director Qiu focused on this theme from three aspects: 1. Overseas Chinese communities are booming and the endogenous power is constantly increasing; 2. The construction of overseas Chinese communities is further advanced and projects benefiting overseas Chinese are steadily implemented; 3. Working together to benefit overseas Chinese communities and sharing the dream of rejuvenation. When President Li talked about his impressions of the conference and the subsequent trip to Shaanxi, what impressed him most was that the leaders and staff of government departments at all levels from central to local levels were very professional, wise, talented and approachable. Finally, there was a lively discussion on the construction of overseas harmonious overseas Chinese communities and the participating Hualian leadership team. I deeply agree with Director Qiu’s sincere suggestions, especially to establish four kinds of awareness and pay attention to four things: first, establish the awareness of taking root and pay attention to integrating into the local society; second, establish the awareness of honor and disgrace and pay attention to maintaining the image of the ethnic group; third, establish the awareness of obeying the law and pay attention to civilized business; fourth, establish the awareness of repaying kindness and paying attention to giving back to social welfare. Regarding the development of the Hualian organization, President Li proposed to add a science and technology and cultural exchange department and recommended Dr. Lu Zhong to be in charge, and the participants unanimously agreed. Next, everyone discussed recent hot topics.

4ebbf4893630e3c0051b207255293c834e3a7978.translatedText: Alberta Hope Chinese School held a meet-and-greet with Chandler-Gibbot Community College (CGCC) (Contributed by Alberta Hope Chinese School) Alberta Hope Chinese School…

cd12876a5fb5570df9fea9e6b9bfff9e611dc13d.sourceText: （亚省希望中文学校供稿） 亚省希望中文学校董事长李健，校长田琳，副校长曹彩虹，董事刘雅静于七月六日下午前往钱德勒?#21513;博特社区大学CGCC 与Bradley Kendrex 副校长先生，Sylvia Orr副校长女士及相关部门负责人举行了开学前的首次见面会。Kendrex 副校长首先介绍了过去几个月来与希望董事长李健先生推动签署合作备忘录的背景情况和在双方人员的积极不懈的努力下终于成功签字。随后与会人员在友好的气氛中畅谈了双方合作的前景及学生注册，教室分配，教学器材，停车场，校园安全等具体事项。Kendrex 副校长特别指出希望中文学校的所有教室将被安排在相邻的IRN 和CHO的两个建筑内。会后Kendrex副校长与校舍负责人亲自带领希望一行人参观了两所建筑内的教室及另外一个建筑内的舞蹈教室。
cd12876a5fb5570df9fea9e6b9bfff9e611dc13d.translatedText: (Contributed by Alberta Hope Chinese School) Alberta Hope Chinese School Chairman Li Jian, Principal Tian Lin, Vice Principal Cao Caihong, and Director Liu Yajing went to Chandler Bot Community College CGCC on the afternoon of July 6 to hold the first meeting before the start of the school year with Vice Principal Mr. Bradley Kendrex, Ms. Vice Principal Ms. Sylvia Orr and the heads of relevant departments. Vice President Kendrex first introduced the background of promoting the signing of the cooperation memorandum with Mr. Li Jian, Chairman of Hope, in the past few months and the successful signing thanks to the active and unremitting efforts of both parties. Subsequently, the participants discussed the prospects of cooperation between the two parties and specific matters such as student registration, classroom allocation, teaching equipment, parking lots, and campus safety in a friendly atmosphere. Vice Principal Kendrex specifically stated that he hopes that all classrooms in the Chinese school will be arranged in the two adjacent buildings of IRN and CHO. After the meeting, Vice Principal Kendrex and the person in charge of the school personally led Hope and his delegation to visit the classrooms in two buildings and the dance studio in another building.

60bee27de2cde3f5ae7a2f30af26b641e3d6d6ed.sourceText: CGCC的优美的校园环境和干净整齐的教室和先进的教学设施都给希望中文学校的负责人流下了深刻的印象，对CGCC工作人员的友好合作态度和敬业精神也深表感谢。希望中文学校将于2016年秋季迁入CGCC校园的消息自从发布以来受到了本地区华人社区的极大关注， 住在南部和东部的华人家庭都说新校址对大家来说实在是太方便了。新的学期希望中文学校将会增加一些成人课程和音乐方面的课程。希望中文学校决定将与CGCC同歩于八月二十日正式开学。上课时间还是每周六下午十二点至五点。下一步希望中文学校校委会将投入紧张的课程安排中，以保证开学前网上注册能够开通，方便家长为孩子们注册课程。
60bee27de2cde3f5ae7a2f30af26b641e3d6d6ed.translatedText: >CGCC’s beautiful campus environment, clean and tidy classrooms and advanced teaching facilities have left a deep impression on the person in charge of Hope Chinese School. They are also deeply grateful to the friendly and cooperative attitude and professionalism of the CGCC staff. The news that Hope Chinese School will move to the CGCC campus in the fall of 2016 has received great attention from the Chinese community in the region since it was released. Chinese families living in the south and east have said that the new school location is really convenient for everyone. In the new semester, we hope that the Chinese school will add some adult courses and music courses. Hope Chinese School will decide to officially open school on August 20 at the same time as CGCC. Class times are still every Saturday from 12pm to 5pm. The next step is to hope that the Chinese school committee will put in intensive course arrangements to ensure that online registration can be opened before the start of school, making it easier for parents to register their children for courses.

45d781d08623a794a1a7e203c7642db931343695.sourceText: 详细的课程和注册信息请大家查阅学校网站： www.azhopechineseschool.org
45d781d08623a794a1a7e203c7642db931343695.translatedText: For detailed course and registration information, please check the school website: www.azhopechineseschool.org

d2764e46608497152bcf85eba9699a034735538b.sourceText: （abc 15) Phoenix －截止到本周四晚，菲尼克斯大都会地区会一直遭受严重的高温预警影响。
d2764e46608497152bcf85eba9699a034735538b.translatedText: (abc 15) Phoenix - As of Thursday night, the Phoenix metropolitan area will remain under a severe heat warning.

8bb03492578a76a0035be3aa60334c71ef82275b.sourceText: 本周四， Phoenix 地区仍然面临一个 UV 警告。这意味着每天上午 10 点半到下午 2 点半，在室外接受太阳暴晒的时间应该少于 10 分钟，因为这个时间段是太阳最毒辣的时间。请控制您在室外所逗留的时间。如果您需要在太阳底下暴晒，一定要反复涂抹防晒霜。
8bb03492578a76a0035be3aa60334c71ef82275b.translatedText: There is still a UV warning for the Phoenix area this Thursday. This means you should spend less than 10 minutes outside in the sun every day between 10:30 a.m. and 2:30 p.m., as this is when the sun is at its most intense. Please limit the time you spend outside. If you need to be in the sun, be sure to reapply sunscreen.

cd6d31296a8160dcf0a2cfb974a1fbeac303d568.sourceText: 包括本周末和即将来临的下一个星期在内，谷区的天气都将十分干燥。然而我们也应该看到在一天的高温之中，在我们东北和北部地势较高的地区，也会有风暴即将到来。
cd6d31296a8160dcf0a2cfb974a1fbeac303d568.translatedText: The weather in the Valley will be very dry this weekend and into next week. However, we should also see storms approaching during the day's high temperatures in the higher areas to our northeast and north.

ad0f30d7a91ef7028e082394af6fca2f01013940.sourceText: 在未来的七天里，高温将保持在 109-112 华氏度的区间内，我们在夜间也不会感受到多少缓解。早间的低温也只能维持在 85 到 89 华氏度的区间。
ad0f30d7a91ef7028e082394af6fca2f01013940.translatedText: High temperatures will remain in the 109-112 degree range for the next seven days and we won't see much relief at night either. Morning low temperatures will only stay in the 85 to 89 degree range.

3bccb793c41ffe9d44b96c1fe04976422ac622c2.sourceText: 尽量多的在室内逗留一个安全的策略。由高温引起的疾病会导致严重的健康问题。记得要及时检查老年人和您的宠物，确保他们有足够的水分，并且在空调房间里确保安全。
3bccb793c41ffe9d44b96c1fe04976422ac622c2.translatedText: Stay indoors as much as possible as a safe strategy. Illnesses caused by high temperatures can lead to serious health problems. Remember to check on seniors and your pets to make sure they are well hydrated and safe in an air-conditioned room.

4be95357bf33c322dc6447b815abea723d6287e4.sourceText: 根据气象观测显示，下周我们将会看到空气中引起季风的水气增加，着这将增加高地出现风暴的机会。到下周二和周三，我们在谷区甚至能够看到一些暴风雨，尽管现在这样的机会只有10%。
4be95357bf33c322dc6447b815abea723d6287e4.translatedText: According to meteorological observations, next week we will see an increase in the moisture in the air that causes the monsoon, which will increase the chance of storms in the highlands. We could even see some storms in the Valley by next Tuesday and Wednesday, although the chance of that right now is only 10%.

93f0cd728bbd1e5aa2c52018a27ba7ddc65b53bc.translatedText: A Complete Guide to the Tempe Town Lake Fireworks Festival on American Independence Day July 4th The Independence Day of the United States is coming soon! Speaking of American Independence Day, the first thing to mention is...

614f694a03b864b44404cc2ce55df5f0ea280b24.sourceText: 7月4日 美国独立日马上就要到啦！提起美国独立日，首先来科普一下，它是为纪念在1776年7月4日于大陆会议中宣布独立宣言所成立的节日，这一天是美国宣布从大英帝国宣告独立的日子，故独立日也是美国的国庆日。
614f694a03b864b44404cc2ce55df5f0ea280b24.translatedText: July 4th The American Independence Day is coming soon! When it comes to American Independence Day, let’s first do some popular science. It is a holiday established to commemorate the Declaration of Independence announced by the Continental Congress on July 4, 1776. This day is the day when the United States declared independence from the British Empire, so Independence Day is also the National Day of the United States.

669309d4a3f89339a8428276958efb15b307a8a4.sourceText: 每年的美国独立日，烟火表演是不能错过的传统项目，今年也不例外。今年菲尼克斯的TempeTown Lake 也会迎来一年一度的烟花节。计划着在独立日当天和自己的家人和朋友去看烟火表演却没有什么头绪？别着急，亚利桑那华人网特别为您奉上美国独立日Tempe Town Lake 烟花节完全攻略。今年的美国国庆日，让咱们准备准备，一起到河边看烟花，可好？
669309d4a3f89339a8428276958efb15b307a8a4.translatedText: Every year on the Independence Day of the United States, the fireworks show is a traditional event that cannot be missed, and this year is no exception. TempeTown Lake in Phoenix will also have its annual fireworks festival this year. Planning to watch the fireworks show with your family and friends on Independence Day but have no idea? Don’t worry, Arizona Chinese Network will provide you with a complete guide to the Tempe Town Lake Fireworks Festival on Independence Day. This year’s Fourth of July, let’s get ready and go to the river to watch the fireworks together, shall we?

Other items such as blankets, portable chairs, small cameras (no more than 48 " and umbrellas can also be brought into the event. However, in order to ensure everyone's safety, some dangerous items such as fireworks, knives and weapons are strictly prohibited from being brought into the event. In addition, food and pets (except working dogs) are also included in the list of prohibited items.

4dc73e3b95bd88316abe1584ad199a39c3b2ea2c.sourceText: ＡＳＵ学生轻轨被打后续：市政律师函全文翻译 ＡＳＵ在读中国学生石晓琳案的最新进展，市政律师函的全文翻译如下： 尊敬的LeFave理事， 我们仅代表亚利桑那州当地华人和亚裔社区以及亚利桑那州立大学中国和亚裔学生社团，向您提交这封信件，以说明这个带有明显种族仇恨动机的无端暴力袭击行为案件。 2016年5月20日，本案的两位受害人，石晓琳女士和何家弘（音）先生在看完Phoenix Mercury女篮的比赛后，乘坐Valley Metro轻轨回家。在轻轨上因为使用普通话交谈而引起被告人气势汹汹地带有种族歧视意味的咒骂：?#23114;（子），回（他妈的）中国去！?#31867;似这样种族歧视的言论持续了大约20分钟。当两名受害人准备下车时，被告人袭击了石晓琳女士的脸部并将其击倒在地。根据当事人石晓琳女士事后的回忆：当时我一度失去了意识，当我恢复意识时我发现自己倒在地上，满脸是血。 本案的另一位受害人何家弘（音）先生也受到了言语上的攻击，在本次事件中也受到了肢体上的攻击，所幸伤势不重。然而石晓琳女士除了面部的鼻骨被打伤，还伴有一些其他的伤势。这些伤势的肿胀不仅影响他的视线，还有可能需要手术治疗。直到今天，石晓琳女士的眼部仍有4mm 的模糊，骨折仍未愈合，这也使得她正在遭受持续脑震荡而引起的眩晕和恶心折磨。 尊敬的法官您应该还记得，四个月之前，同样是一名来自ASU的中国留学生，19岁的江玥在一次道路事故中被枪杀致死。所有这些事件的受害者都是亚利桑那州立大学的在读学生，其中的两名学生还是在读博士。菲尼克斯大都会地区的华人/亚裔社区以及许多亚利桑那州立大学的在读学生和校友都有理由对这两个几乎在同一时间段发生的犯罪行为感到震惊和惊慌。 我们坚信任何有关种族歧视和种族偏见的犯罪行为都应该在法律的框架下受到充分的起诉和严厉的惩罚。我们不同意市政律师认罪协定中将一个三级或者四级的重罪减刑为六级的轻罪。我们也不同意市政律师提出的减轻判决来使得情况进一步恶化的决定。我们要求法官考虑驳回现有的认罪协定来做一个重新审查，以最大限度的执行一个犯罪判决，而不是坚持在一个假定的或者最小的判决水平上。本案的所有事实、州法院建议的判决以及受害人的声明均表明因为种族仇恨所带来的偏见犯罪应该让法庭考虑对被指控的被告采取一种更加严格的惩罚措施。 如果被告人的确正在受到一些精神疾病的困扰，我们希望她能够得到及时的医治。然而，这并不能减轻她的犯罪行为所带来的影响。她的犯罪行为不能减轻对受害人的身体和心灵带来的伤害。她的仇视行为不能减轻对于亚利桑那州当地华人和亚裔社区所带来的伤害。由于近期一系列仇视行为和暴力事件的发生，亚利桑那华人社区，尤其是在ASU就读的中国学生现在出门时会有恐惧心理。这些暴力事件已经成为有关亚利桑那州对待华人和亚裔如何不友善的国际新闻例证。尊敬的法官您现在就有机会利用有限的法庭权利来表明这样的暴力行为在亚利桑那州是不被容许的。 由于石晓琳女士刚刚开始其在ASU的学习，她仅仅拥有有限的医疗保险，我们也请求法官您在本次案件的赔偿判决中对石晓琳女士采取责任完全开放的归还策略。我们希望法官能够慎重的考虑我们的请求，我们希望看到正义在亚利桑那州能够得到伸张。 您真诚的， Arizona亚裔社团 主席 – 或个人
4dc73e3b95bd88316abe1584ad199a39c3b2ea2c.translatedText: Follow-up of ASU students’ light rail being hit: Full text translation of municipal lawyer’s letter The latest developments in the case of ASU student Shi Xiaolin, the full text of municipal lawyer’s letter is as follows: Dear LeFave Director, We submit this letter to you solely on behalf of the local Chinese and Asian communities in Arizona and the Chinese and Asian Student Association at Arizona State University to describe this case of an unprovoked violent attack motivated by clear racial hatred. On May 20, 2016, the two victims in this case, Ms. Shi Xiaolin and Mr. He Jiahong, took the Valley Metro light rail home after watching the Phoenix Mercury women's basketball game. Because he was talking in Mandarin on the light rail, the defendant cursed aggressively and racially: ?#23114; (子), go back to (fucking) China! ?#31867;The racist remarks continued for about 20 minutes. When the two victims were about to get out of the car, the defendant struck Ms. Shi Xiaolin in the face and knocked her to the ground. According to the recollection of Ms. Shi Xiaolin afterwards: I lost consciousness for a time. When I regained consciousness, I found myself lying on the ground with blood all over my face. Another victim in this case, Mr. He Jiahong, was also verbally attacked and physically attacked in this incident. Fortunately, his injuries were not serious. However, in addition to the facial nasal bone being injured, Ms. Shi Xiaolin also suffered other injuries. The swelling from these injuries not only affects his vision, but may also require surgery. To this day, Ms. Shi Xiaolin still has a 4mm blur in her eyes and her fractures have not healed, which also makes her suffer from dizziness and nausea caused by sustained concussions. Dear judge, you should remember that four months ago, 19-year-old Jiang Yue, also a Chinese student from ASU, was shot to death in a road accident. The victims in all of these incidents were current students at Arizona State University, two of whom were also Ph.D. The Chinese/Asian community in the Phoenix metropolitan area, as well as many current ASU students and alumni, are justifiably shocked and alarmed by these two crimes that occurred at approximately the same time. We firmly believe that any crimes related to racial discrimination and racial bias should be fully prosecuted and severely punished within the framework of the law. We disagree with the municipal attorney's plea agreement that reduces a third- or fourth-degree felony to a sixth-degree misdemeanor. We also disagree with the city attorney's decision to make the situation worse by mitigating the sentence. We ask the judge to consider dismissing the existing plea agreement and conducting a review to maximize the execution of a criminal sentence, rather than insisting on a presumptive or minimum sentence level. All the facts of this case, the state court's recommended sentence, and the victim's statements indicate that a bias crime motivated by racial hatred should warrant the court's consideration of a more stringent penalty for the alleged defendant. If the defendant is indeed suffering from some mental illness, we hope that she can receive timely treatment. However, this does not lessen the impact of her criminal conduct. Her criminal conduct does not mitigate the harm done to the victim's body and mind. Her hateful behavior cannot lessen the harm done to local Chinese and Asian communities in Arizona. Due to the recent series of hateful acts and violent incidents, the Chinese community in Arizona, especially Chinese students studying at ASU, now feel fear when going out. The violence has become an example of international news about how unkind Arizona is toward Chinese and Asian Americans. Dear Judge, you now have the opportunity to use your limited court rights to demonstrate that such violence will not be tolerated in Arizona. Since Ms. Shi Xiaolin has just started her studies at ASU and she only has limited medical insurance, we also ask the judge to adopt a completely open-liability restitution strategy for Ms. Shi Xiaolin in the compensation judgment in this case. We hope that the judge will consider our request carefully, and we hope to see justice served in Arizona. Sincerely, Arizona Asian Community President – ​​or Individual
