93ff2f212faa44ed095df35ef85d15f99592c22c.translatedText: You can meditate as long as you open your eyes - Introduction to Meditation (2) Phoenix Degar Meditation Center Only by not following your heart can you be the master of your mind. To be a spiritual teacher...

17f1c8569f3b0fd6798cade93fcaff24ad364364.sourceText: 不随于心，方为心师。能为心师，则得安乐。
17f1c8569f3b0fd6798cade93fcaff24ad364364.translatedText: Only when you don’t follow your heart can you be a spiritual teacher. If you can be a spiritual teacher, you will find peace and happiness.

43573cacd090dcc0af9e9122beacdac9b6b010a9.sourceText: 既然我们可以通过禅修来训练自心，从而回到平静喜乐的本然状态，那么如何禅修呢？这里将介绍一种简单易行的只要睁着眼睛就能做的禅修：色相禅修。色相的禅修是指以视觉为助缘来安住自心的禅修方法，是有所缘禅修法中的一种。
43573cacd090dcc0af9e9122beacdac9b6b010a9.translatedText: Since we can train our minds through meditation and return to the natural state of peace and joy, how do we practice meditation? Here we will introduce a simple and easy meditation that can be done with your eyes open: form meditation. The meditation of form refers to a meditation method that uses vision as an aid to calm the mind. It is one of the conditioned meditation methods.

dd11e31d7be89f90af44f342abdadd0c63bafba5.sourceText: 在色相的禅修中，我们借助眼睛看到的物体来安住自己的心。也就是主动地让眼睛和心一起”看”某个对境物。可以选择任何物体做对境，物体的颜色、形状、好坏、品质等都不重要，不要去评判。只是单纯地让心和眼睛都看着一个物体就可以了。眼睛看时要自然，不要太过用力。一般来说，眼睛看物体并不难，但是让心也一直同时看着物体就不太容易了。几秒钟后，你的心可能会跑到其他各种念头上，没关系，当你发现后就直接再让心回到所需要观看的物体上即可。不需批评自己走神，不需用力逼迫自己专心，心的游走是自然现象，只需放松地把心回到物体上就好了。
dd11e31d7be89f90af44f342abdadd0c63bafba5.translatedText: In the meditation of color, we use the objects we see with our eyes to calm our mind. That is to actively let the eyes and the heart "see" an object together. You can choose any object as the object. The color, shape, quality, quality, etc. of the object are not important. Don't judge it. Just simply let your mind and eyes look at an object. Look naturally with your eyes and don't use too much force. Generally speaking, it is not difficult for the eyes to look at objects, but it is not easy for the mind to keep looking at objects at the same time. After a few seconds, your mind may wander to various other thoughts. It doesn't matter. When you find out, just return your mind to the object you need to look at. There is no need to criticize yourself for wandering, and there is no need to force yourself to concentrate. The wandering of the mind is a natural phenomenon. Just relax and return your mind to the object.

82d9c92b4cbc962c9c0c7ad31da24b87ea57e74e.sourceText: 我们可以尝试着简单练习一下：首先选择一个自己放松的姿势，让自己的嵴柱及脖子挺直，然后放下所有其他事情让心自然放松，最后选择眼前一个物体作为做这个色相禅修的对境。让自己看着眼前的这个物体，比如一个杯子，同时心也觉知这个杯子。然后不要打扰自己的心，就这样保持眼睛和心都看着这个杯子。很短一段时间后，我们可能就已经对杯子视而不见了，眼睛还盯着这个杯子，但是心却可能想着明天吃什么，或者昨天的电影可真好看等等。当你意识到自己的心跑掉时，只需要把这个心拉回到这个杯子上。这样做几分钟后，可以停止观看，让心自然放松一会儿，然后再继续练习几分钟色相禅修。色相禅修练习每天随时随地都可以做，短时间多次数的练习，非常适合于现代社会里忙碌的人们。
82d9c92b4cbc962c9c0c7ad31da24b87ea57e74e.translatedText: We can try a simple practice: first choose a relaxing posture, straighten your spine and neck, then put down all other things and let your mind relax naturally, and finally choose an object in front of you as the object of this color meditation. Let yourself look at the object in front of you, such as a cup, and at the same time your mind is aware of the cup. Then don't disturb your mind, just keep your eyes and heart looking at the cup. After a short period of time, we may have turned a blind eye to the cup, and our eyes are still staring at the cup, but our minds may be thinking about what we will eat tomorrow, or how good the movie yesterday was, etc. When you realize that your mind has wandered away, just pull your mind back to this cup. After doing this for a few minutes, you can stop looking and let your mind relax naturally for a while, and then continue practicing color meditation for a few more minutes. Hue meditation practice can be done anytime and anywhere every day. It can be practiced multiple times in a short time and is very suitable for busy people in modern society.

16d2f3a5a1390c21fe41894b7472e52dddec873c.sourceText: 色相禅修和我们平时看东西的区别在哪里？在于我们主动地意愿。主动地决定要做禅修，按照禅修的方法主动地让眼和心同时专注在色相上。通过这样主动地运作，心就有意识地锻炼了”自己”。而平时我们看东西时，心是被外境牵着走的，失去了自主性，不是禅修。
16d2f3a5a1390c21fe41894b7472e52dddec873c.translatedText: What is the difference between meditation on hue and how we usually see things? It lies in our active will. Actively decide to meditate, and follow the meditation method to actively focus your eyes and mind on the form at the same time. By operating actively in this way, the mind consciously exercises "itself." But when we usually look at things, our minds are led by the external environment and we lose our autonomy. This is not meditation.

62b318c51eae5145640a78c1bc5fe5cd20d130e1.sourceText: 禅修需要长期耐心地不断地练习才能看到效果。对禅修效果的期待与恐惧是禅修路上的两大障碍。 以上就是一个简单的色相禅修的练习方法。还有很多不同的有所缘和无所缘的禅修方法，目的都是用来稳定，熟悉，和掌控自己的心。因为篇幅有限，这里不能详细的介绍禅修方法。关于禅修的更多方法和信息请访问: www.tergarphoenix.org 文中图片：画家汪钰元作品
62b318c51eae5145640a78c1bc5fe5cd20d130e1.translatedText: Meditation requires long-term, patient and continuous practice to see results. Expectation and fear of the effectiveness of meditation are two major obstacles on the road to meditation. The above is a simple practice method of color meditation. There are many different conditioned and unconditioned meditation methods, all with the purpose of stabilizing, becoming familiar with, and controlling one's mind. Due to limited space, we cannot introduce meditation methods in detail here. For more methods and information about meditation, please visit: www.tergarphoenix.org Pictures in the article: Works by painter Wang Yuyuan

41335207d9ee4bc48223b8e145d5d0c6a8bd9761.translatedText: A forest fire broke out in Arizona, the United States, on the 8th, engulfing 700 acres of fields in the Yarnell Mountains. At least 250 people were forced to relocate, and several buildings were burned.

f4748260cf6f3616a65c0f0cb932463ebd8d3ab7.sourceText: 据美国全国广播公司报导， 这场森林大火于当地时间8日下午3时15分燃起，直到当天晚上8时45分焚烧近600到700亩田地。一座建筑，一个棚子和数个手机信号接收塔被焚毁。当地将近250 至300民众被迫迁移。 8日晚上亚奈尔山区有1,000多住家停电。
f4748260cf6f3616a65c0f0cb932463ebd8d3ab7.translatedText: According to NBC, the forest fire started at 3:15 pm local time on the 8th and burned nearly 600 to 700 acres of fields until 8:45 pm that day. A building, a shed and several cell phone towers were burned. Nearly 250 to 300 local people were forced to relocate. On the evening of the 8th, more than 1,000 homes in the Yarnell Mountains were without power.

a070069a1ff781a4afdb92e8e5396b00a89ca11f.sourceText: 当地土地管理局（BLM）发言人表示，这是亚利桑那州最严重的一场大火， 当地消防队和土地管理局派出救火飞机，地面消防员和消防车前去灭火，并优先将当地残疾人迁移。
a070069a1ff781a4afdb92e8e5396b00a89ca11f.translatedText: A spokesman for the local Bureau of Land Management (BLM) said that this was the most serious fire in Arizona. The local fire brigade and the Bureau of Land Management sent firefighting aircraft, ground firefighters and fire trucks to put out the fire, and prioritized the relocation of local disabled people.

098784720f10246093c87ccefb5eb6b220f0bf9c.sourceText: 目前当地土地管理局尚在调查火灾原因，发言人表示，8日该地区没有出现闪电。由于亚利桑那州今年5月份基本上没有下雨，最近两天该地最高温度都是69华氏度， 8日下午气温更高，并出现了大风，她认为这种气候非常容易引发山火。
098784720f10246093c87ccefb5eb6b220f0bf9c.translatedText: The local Land Management Bureau is still investigating the cause of the fire. A spokesman said that there was no lightning in the area on the 8th. Since there was basically no rain in Arizona in May this year, the highest temperature there in the past two days was 69 degrees Fahrenheit. On the afternoon of the 8th, the temperature was even higher and there were strong winds. She believed that this kind of climate was very easy to trigger wildfires.

e2cdfdb962e3ea18b3ac7a4e081ae0d10826ddbd.sourceText: 报道表示，2013年6月28日，一场雷阵雨的闪电引发的亚奈尔山火曾经导致19名消防员死亡，而那次亚奈尔山火着火地点与这次山火的著火点非常接近。
e2cdfdb962e3ea18b3ac7a4e081ae0d10826ddbd.translatedText: Reports indicate that on June 28, 2013, the Yarnell Fire caused by a thunderstorm and lightning killed 19 firefighters. The Yarnell Fire started very close to the ignition point of this wildfire.

089a9d9ca0dad6dcf9ab9ac32afc3b91aef9848c.translatedText: The officer who was paired with Glasser said Santos-Banos got out of the car and opened fire. The police officer on duty fired back and killed him.

21f524a8d56a15f21e5acd677f062177527fecb2.translatedText: Introduction to Zen Meditation (1) | Learn to be the master of the mind. Only by not following the mind can you be the master of the mind. If you can be a spiritual teacher, you will find peace and happiness. When you are angry, is there any way you can make yourself...

eaa32140c5338fda7f9c34cbeb0407ff707aaa4f.sourceText: 请问在生气的当下，你有没有办法让自己转怒而安？在烦恼的当下，你有没有办法让自己放下忧愁？有人会说，那怎麽可能？不！这是可能的。因为不论是生气或是烦恼等各种情绪都是我们的心受外境影响的觉受。当我们学会认识心并能够掌控心之后，就能够让心不受或少受外境的影响并可以随时转换心的状态，建立起不依外境的真正快乐，而成为心的主人。
eaa32140c5338fda7f9c34cbeb0407ff707aaa4f.translatedText: When you are angry, is there any way you can make yourself calm down? In the moment of trouble, can you find a way to let go of your worries? Some people will say, how is that possible? No! It's possible. Because various emotions, whether it is anger or worry, are the feelings of our hearts that are affected by the external environment. When we learn to understand the heart and be able to control it, we can make the heart less or less affected by external circumstances and can change the state of the heart at any time, establish true happiness that does not depend on external circumstances, and become the master of the heart.

651e6b52d755327cb76763f5bcc5a2b17e045978.sourceText: 禅修就是帮助我们成为心的主人的非常有效的方法。它直接让我们同心打交道，认识它的习气，训练它稳定的安住，认出心中情绪念头的起落，学会掌握调心的技巧和方法，从而使心听我们的指挥，在恐慌，沮丧，生气，嫉妒，执着，自卑，内疚等情绪升起的时候，我们有能力让心回到平静喜乐的本然状态。那麽随时随处快乐就不再是奢望了。
651e6b52d755327cb76763f5bcc5a2b17e045978.translatedText: Meditation is a very effective method to help us become the masters of our hearts. It directly allows us to deal with the mind, recognize its habits, train it to stay stably, recognize the ups and downs of emotions and thoughts in the heart, and learn to master the techniques and methods of regulating the mind, so that the mind can obey our command. When emotions such as panic, frustration, anger, jealousy, persistence, inferiority, guilt, etc. arise, we have the ability to return the mind to its natural state of peace and joy. Then being happy anytime and anywhere is no longer a luxury.

187d4d998760b4b710b04eabc93bd36d6c1e1a19.sourceText: 禅修起源于东方的古老智慧，目前在西方越来越受到学术医学教育界的重视，很多企业也纷纷把禅修纳入僱员的福利，比如穀歌。西方研究结果已经证明禅修可以减轻忧鬱症状，缓解压力和焦虑，提高专注力和大脑处理信息的速度并改善记忆力。禅修还可以提高身体免疫力，降低血压等等。
187d4d998760b4b710b04eabc93bd36d6c1e1a19.translatedText: Meditation originated from the ancient wisdom of the East. It is now receiving more and more attention from academic medical education circles in the West. Many companies have also included meditation in employee benefits, such as Google. Western research results have proven that meditation can reduce symptoms of depression, relieve stress and anxiety, increase concentration and the speed at which the brain processes information, and improve memory. Meditation can also improve the body's immunity, lower blood pressure, etc.

f4305f773efc4e68298e917813f651444f1b462a.sourceText: 禅修并不难或者可以说很简单。我们在坐着，走着，开车，做饭，购物，甚至聊天时都可以禅修。关键是要找到正确的方法和指导并加以持久的练习。我们将在下一期介绍简单的禅修方法。
f4305f773efc4e68298e917813f651444f1b462a.translatedText: Meditation is not difficult or can be said to be very simple. We can meditate while sitting, walking, driving, cooking, shopping, or even talking. The key is to find the right methods and guidance and practice them consistently. We will introduce simple meditation methods in the next issue.

3b78877ab73bb036cb1c05248d9ba14992eb4a00.sourceText: 张肇鸿：亞省歷史上的傑出華人2 記鳳凰城僑聯首届主席、鳳凰城龍岡公所首任主席關崇瓊 (2) 張肇鴻 關崇瓊有個幸福的家庭，他們夫妻和睦相愛，養育有 11 名兒女，在他們的言傳身教之下兒女成才，為社會、對僑社都有積極的貢獻。 關崇瓊的大兒子關衛理 (William K. Toy) 、二兒子關护理（ Grey Toy ）服兵役時的照片。 關衛理 (William k. Toy) ， 1940 年入伍陸軍。在俄克拉荷馬州和德克薩斯州接受戰前訓練， 1942 年派往巴拿馬、 後通過北非和波斯灣前往中國。 1943 至 1944 年回到印度訓練中國軍隊。之後，返回緬甸北部的作戰司令部， 並在緬甸北部和中部打擊日軍。關衛理戰功彪炳、 得過包括有?FONT face=’Microsoft JhengHei’> 亞太區征戰勳章 ‘ 、?#20108;戰大戰勝利勳章＂ 等五枚勳章。關衛理在軍中服役長這廿年，官拜上校，是本州華人获得最高的軍階者。他在本州學校教導高中學生軍訓，也擔任過退伍軍人會等僑領職務。 關護理（ Grey Toy ）， 1942 年服役，加入美國陸軍航空兵。作為特種兵，他是一位投彈瞄準器和飛行控制專家。 1943 年 1 月，關护理進入俄亥俄州著名的賴特 – 帕特森空軍基地，研習飛機儀器 – 導航 – 投彈瞄準器和自動飛行控制。 1943 年分配北非戰區。 1944 年至 1945 年 12 月回到祖國，服務於中美空軍第十四航空隊 ( 飛虎隊 ) ，成為第 20 大隊轟炸司令部的成員，和中國軍民一起打擊日本侵略者。獲得過包括歐洲 – 中東戰區、大西洋 – 太平洋戰區勛章等 5 枚獎章。 在两个兒子中間，是一位英雄的母親。兄弟倆為國効力，受過二次大戰戰火的洗禮，得過不少勳章 。 抗戰初期，中國形勢十分嚴峻。所有從不同國家購買的舊戰機無法與日本軍機抗衡，飛行員損失慘重。珍珠港事件後，美國對日宣戰，中美成為同盟國。美國對中國飛行員進行培訓，而培訓地點就在我們亞利桑那州。在採訪期間，關崇瓊的女兒向我們展示出不少資料，其中有一張是＂中國空軍留美第二批畢業學生集影＂，時間是民國卅一年 (1942 年 )5 月 15 日。那年代正是中華民族抗擊日本侵略者最艱苦的時刻，而這批來美培訓的飛行員，回國後加入＂飛虎隊＂，成為殲滅日軍戰機和地面設施的空軍主力。 關麗壁 (YIOLET TOY) 告訴我們，由於父親是當地的名人，並以實際行動支持抗日救國，所以當年從祖國遠道而來的空軍隊員，在訓練之余常到她們家中度過假日，關家成為這些戰士們的歡聚的地方。關家對這些飛行戰士們關懷備致，關崇瓊夫婦親自款待他們，加上關家有幾位如花似玉的女兒，使到場面更顯得溫馨親切。 有些戰士還把一些與抗戰相關的照片送給她們，讓人們看到當年的宋美玲訪美的歷史鏡頭，這些相片未公開過。 1945 年 8 月 15 日，日本無條件投降，舉世歡騰，鳳凰城軍民亦舉行盛大遊行。作為軍人家屬的關崇瓊家庭，歡呼二戰勝利的結束。這張相片，是他們全家參加遊行時所拍，蓬車上布滿紅白藍彩帶，父親關崇瓊親自駕駛，母親坐在前排位置，而女兒就分別坐在座車的前後，她們打扮得花枝招展，喜氣洋洋，手中揮動著中美兩國的國旗。這些相片為鳳凰城華人當年的抗日愛國歷史提供了寶貴的資料。 關崇瓊的侄子關榮業， 關崇瓊的侄孫 關宗仕 ， 關崇瓊孫女 Patti Toy 是華商小姐。 關崇瓊(前左二)是鳳鳳城龍岡的創會會長 如今，關家大家族已發展到有二、三百人，他們遍佈美國和全世界，在各行各業都是人才輩出。在他們的族譜中，我看到一些熟識的名字，其中有關崇瓊的侄子關榮業，他在二戰中是美軍空降師是一名傘兵，參加過諾曼底戰役，榮獲過四枚獎章。關榮業是本埠世界龍岡總會會長關宗任的父親。另外， 關崇瓊的侄孫 關宗仕也是一名美國海軍，曾獲得過四枚獎章。關宗仕還是位體育高手，在臺球方面身手非凡，曾經在1972年連續兩年獲得過美國海軍西岸臺球總決賽冠軍，這項殊榮讓人對華裔軍人刮目相看。 關崇瓊的孫女 Patti Toy 是龍岡的第一朵?/FONT>金花?/FONT>，她在一九七四年榮獲了鳳凰城華商小姐。我去過三次去關氏家庭，記錄和拍照不少珍貴的歷史資料，她們還送給我一個 60 年前＂崇瓊樓＂的碟子作為留念，讓我喜出望外！ 採訪中，我提到今年十月，美洲龍岡第二十一屆懇親會将會在鳳凰城舉辦，我們誠摯地邀請關家貴賓出席大會。作為鳳鳳城龍岡創會會長關崇瓊的後裔，她們和關宗任會長的關係很密切，所以在家庭會議上通過了贊助一萬元给懇親大會。這種親義加親情，令到鳳鳳城龍岡公所全體成員十分感動，并在此向關氏家族表達最崇高的敬意和由衷的感謝! 初次尋訪到關崇瓊女兒關秀玉 (SHIRLEY TOY) ，她已八十歲，仍在為無家者義賣籌款。
3b78877ab73bb036cb1c05248d9ba14992eb4a00.translatedText: Zhang Zhaohong: Outstanding Chinese in the history of Alberta 2 Notes Guan Chongqiong, the first chairman of the Phoenix Overseas Chinese Federation and the first chairman of the Phoenix Longgang Office (2) Zhang Zhaohong Guan Chongqiong has a happy family. They love each other harmoniously and raise 11 children. Under their words and deeds, their children have become talented and have made positive contributions to society and the overseas Chinese community. Photos of Kwan Chongqiong's eldest son William K. Toy and second son Gray Toy during their military service. William k. Toy, enlisted in the Army in 1940. Received pre-war training in Oklahoma and Texas, sent to Panama in 1942, and then to China via North Africa and the Persian Gulf. Returned to India to train Chinese troops from 1943 to 1944. Afterwards, he returned to the combat headquarters in northern Burma and fought against Japanese forces in northern and central Burma. Kwan Wei-li has outstanding military exploits and has won five medals, including the Asia-Pacific Campaign Medal and the Great War Victory Medal. Kwan has been serving in the military for 20 years and was promoted to colonel. He is the highest-ranked Chinese person in the state. He teaches military training for high school students in schools in the state and has also served as an overseas leader in the Veterans Association. Nursing Guan ( Gray Toy, enlisted in the U.S. Army Air Forces in 1942. As a special forces soldier, he was a bombsight and flight control specialist. In January 1943, Guan entered the famous Wright-Patterson Air Force Base in Ohio to study aircraft instrumentation-navigation-bombsights and automatic flight control. Assigned to the North African Theater in 1943. Returned to the motherland in September, served in the 14th Air Force (Flying Tigers) of the Chinese and American Air Forces, and became a member of the 20th Bomb Group. Together with the Chinese military and civilians, she won 5 medals, including the European-Middle East Theater Medal and the Atlantic-Pacific Theater Medal. She was the mother of two sons. The two brothers served the country and were baptized by the flames of World War II and received many medals. In the early days of the Anti-Japanese War, China's situation was very serious. All the old fighter planes purchased from different countries were unable to compete with Japanese military aircraft, and the pilots suffered heavy losses. After the Pearl Harbor incident, the United States declared war on Japan, and China and the United States became allies. The United States trained Chinese pilots, and the training location was in Arizona. During the interview, Guan Chongqiong's daughter showed us a lot of information, one of which was the "Photograph of the Second Batch of Chinese Air Force Graduates in the United States" in the 31st year of the Republic of China (1942)5 On March 15th, that era was the most difficult time for the Chinese nation to fight against the Japanese invaders. These pilots who came to the United States for training joined the "Flying Tigers" after returning to China and became the main force of the air force that destroyed Japanese fighter planes and ground facilities. Tell us that because my father was a local celebrity and took practical actions to support the anti-Japanese and national salvation, the air force members who came all the way from the motherland often spent their holidays at their home after training. The Guan family became a gathering place for these soldiers. The Guan family cared deeply for these flying warriors. Guan Chongqiong and his wife entertained them personally, and the Guan family had several beautiful daughters, which made the scene even more warm and cordial. Some soldiers also gave them some photos related to the Anti-Japanese War, allowing people to see the historical footage of Song Meiling’s visit to the United States on August 15, 1945. These photos have not been made public. On the same day, Japan unconditionally surrendered, and the whole world rejoiced. The soldiers and civilians in Phoenix also held a grand parade. As a family member of the military, Guan Chongqiong's family cheered the end of World War II. This photo was taken when their family participated in the parade. The caravan was covered with red, white and blue ribbons, and his father Guan Chongqiong. Joan was driving the car, her mother was sitting in the front seat, and her daughter was sitting in the front and back of the car. They were all dressed up, beaming with joy, and waving the national flags of China and the United States. These photos provided valuable information on the anti-Japanese and patriotic history of the Chinese in Phoenix. Guan Chongqiong's nephew Guan Rongye, Guan Chongqiong's grandnephew Guan Zongshi, Guan Chongqiong's granddaughter Patti Toy is a Chinese business lady. Guan Chongqiong (front, second from left) is the founding president of Fengfeng City Longgang. Today, the Guan family has grown to 200 or 300 people, and they are spread all over the United States and all over the world. They are talented people in all walks of life. In their genealogy, I saw some familiar names, including Chongqiong’s nephew Guan Rongye, who was a paratrooper in the US Airborne Division in World War II and participated in the Battle of Normandy. Guan Rongye is the father of Guan Zongren, the president of the local World Longgang Association. Guan Zongshi is also a U.S. Navy man who has won four medals. Guan Zongshi is also a sports expert and has extraordinary skills in billiards. He once won the U.S. Navy West Coast Billiards Finals for two consecutive years in 1972. This honor is impressive to Patti Toy, the granddaughter of Chinese-American soldiers. She was the first golden flower in Longgang. She won the title of Miss Chinese Businesswoman in Phoenix City in 1974. I went to the Guan family three times to record and take photos of many precious historical materials. They also gave me a plate from the "Chongqiong Tower" 60 years ago as a souvenir, which made me overjoyed! During the interview, I mentioned that in October this year, the 21st Longgang American Association will be held in Phoenix. We sincerely invite the distinguished guests of the Guan family to attend the meeting. As the descendants of Guan Chongqiong, the founding president of Fengfengcheng Longgang Association, they and Guan Zongren are the president. The relationship is very close, so the family meeting approved the sponsorship of 10,000 yuan for the wedding ceremony. This kind of fraternity and family affection moved all the members of the Longgang Office in Fengfeng City and expressed their highest respect and heartfelt gratitude to the Guan family! The first time I visited Guan Chongqiong’s daughter, Guan Xiuyu (SHIRLEY TOY), she was eighty years old and still raising money for the charity sale for the homeless.

227b8be61371080e68790945aec2ec4a719dec72.sourceText: 亚裔是美国社会中一个聪明，勤劳，富足的族裔。在我们中,有一些精英脱颖而出,在美国主流社会大放异彩。也许你只在电视，报纸上见过他们，即使你见到他们也不知道他们在为亚裔社区提供怎样的服务。由亚裔公司与企业领导者协会主办的2016领导力大会将与7月8日到10日，在凤凰城举办。在这个会议中，就让我们一起与这些亚裔精英面对面。看看那些走进美国主流社会的亚裔精英们走过的轨迹，分享他们成功的经验，甚至有机会让他们成为你或者你孩子的精神导师。他们中有凤凰城第一位首席华裔女审判长邓周雅定（ Roxanne Song Ong）。拥有多项金融付款专利的CNN首位华裔男主播Richard Lui，还有来自日本，越南，韩国等其他亚洲国家的精英。他们就下面一些论题参与演讲讨论。 突破：怎样执行领导力 21世纪的领导者：在第三个千禧年的生存和发展 美国亚裔现在面临的问题 管理角色：在你的员工中带出最好的 全球成功之路：利用关系通往亚洲和更大的范围 ERG是最佳实践 个人品牌+如何使用社交媒体来启动你的业务 2016年亚裔美国人思考参与+办公室政治与我的生活同在
227b8be61371080e68790945aec2ec4a719dec72.translatedText: Asians are a smart, hard-working, and wealthy ethnic group in American society. Among us, there are some elites who stand out and shine in mainstream American society. Maybe you've only seen them on TV or in newspapers. Even if you see them, you don't know what kind of services they are providing to the Asian community. The 2016 Leadership Conference, hosted by the Asian Corporate and Business Leaders Association, will be held in Phoenix from July 8 to 10. In this meeting, let us meet face to face with these Asian elites. Take a look at the trajectories of those Asian elites who have entered mainstream American society, share their successful experiences, and even have the opportunity to have them become spiritual mentors for you or your children. Among them is Roxanne Song Ong, the first Chinese-American female chief judge in Phoenix. Richard Lui, CNN's first Chinese male anchor who holds multiple financial payment patents, as well as elites from Japan, Vietnam, South Korea and other Asian countries. They participated in speech discussions on some of the following topics. Breakthrough: How to Execute Leadership The 21st Century Leader: Surviving and Thriving in the Third Millennium Issues Facing Asian Americans Today Management Roles: Bringing Out the Best in Your People Paths to Global Success: Leveraging Relationships to Asia and Beyond ERGs are Best Practices Personal Branding + How to Use Social Media to Launch Your Business 2016 Asian American Thinking Participation + Office Politics and My Life

08f87631b1754966deebbfcb8cc7b674118eb7a9.translatedText: The two-and-a-half-hour graduation ceremony has always attracted all the teachers, students and parents of the school. 7c0b0c35b40ccacb0fc86ef8460a211eb0777883.sourceText: （郜子雁编译 ）针对即将到来的Memorial Day，一个特别纪念活动将于2016年5月24日早7：00在菲尼克斯University of Phoenix校园中举行，以纪念那些为这个国家做出无私奉献的人们。
7c0b0c35b40ccacb0fc86ef8460a211eb0777883.translatedText: (compiled by Gao Ziyan) for the upcoming Memorial Day, a special commemorative event will be held at 7:00 a.m. on May 24, 2016 on the campus of the University of Phoenix to commemorate those who have made selfless contributions to this country.

2a5b7bc812063166a7bd71f028ccf7213d4aa04e.sourceText: 本周一，也就是5月23日，是Memorial Day。当天早上，University of Phoenix校园的草坪上插上了上千支美国国旗。据Fox 10新闻报道，今年活动的主题是 Salute to Sacrifice。这些国旗被组成了活动主题的字母，从空中俯瞰会拥有清晰的视觉效果。活动的组织者希望借助这样的一种方式来纪念那些为这个国家做出牺牲的人们。
2a5b7bc812063166a7bd71f028ccf7213d4aa04e.translatedText: This Monday, May 23, is Memorial Day. That morning, thousands of American flags were planted on the lawn of the University of Phoenix campus. According to Fox 10 News, the theme of this year's event is Salute to Sacrifice. These flags are formed into letters of the theme of the event, which will have a clear visual effect when viewed from the air. Organizers of the event hope to use such a way to commemorate those who have made sacrifices for this country.

01c09376e59e3f33318996b671ab36b4ddb81fb2.sourceText: 活动将于本周一开始，本周五结束。该活动向全体公众开放。有兴趣的民众可以亲自前往参加。具体地址位于 I 10 高速公路沿线University of Phoenix 校园内。
01c09376e59e3f33318996b671ab36b4ddb81fb2.translatedText: The event will start this Monday and end this Friday. The event is open to the entire public. Interested people can attend in person. The specific address is on the University of Phoenix campus along the I 10 Freeway.

ef9aa314b00910e1935c132067f43d71a052c07d.sourceText: 亞省中國餐館協會選出2016年領導班子 (亞省中餐館通訊) 亞省中國餐館協會5月19日舉行會議，選出新一屆領導班子。由鄧朝駒擔任主席，楊振綱、梅樹德任副主席。大家對前任主席張華芳兩年來工作成效給予肯定，並報以熱烈的掌聲。新任主席鄧朝駒表示，感謝各位董事的信任，今後將努力工作，讓亞省中國餐館協會的會務更上一層樓。董事們一致表示日後積極支持鄧主席的工作。 CRAA 2016年董事局成员，前排左起：陸少明，楊振綱，鄧朝駒 （主席），梅樹德，張華芳。 後排左起：關兆峰，任建宏，高志中，徐國富，賴甲乙，巫宜釗，張肇鴻。
ef9aa314b00910e1935c132067f43d71a052c07d.translatedText: > The Chinese Restaurant Association of Alberta has elected its leadership team for 2016 (Chinese Restaurant Newsletter of Alberta) The Alberta Chinese Restaurant Association held a meeting on May 19 to elect a new leadership team. Deng Chaoju serves as the chairman, and Yang Zhengang and Mei Shude serve as vice-chairmen. Everyone affirmed the achievements of former chairman Zhang Huafang in the past two years and gave warm applause. The new chairman Deng Chaoju expressed his gratitude to all directors for their trust and will work hard in the future to bring the affairs of the Alberta Chinese Restaurant Association to a higher level. The directors unanimously expressed their active support for Chairman Deng's work in the future. CRAA board members in 2016, front row from left: Lu Shaoming, Yang Zhengang, Deng Chaoju (chairman), Mei Shude, Zhang Huafang. Back row from left: Guan Zhaofeng, Ren Jianhong, Gao Zhizhong, Xu Guofu, Lai Jiayi, Wu Yizhao, Zhang Zhaohong.

At the Spring Banquet, the Chamber of Commerce prepared scholarships for the children of two small business owners, namely Janice Chan and Ashley Ong.

Air tickets to and from China and Phoenix, USA, jewelry and gift certificates brought New Year greetings to the guests. a4dada40cda08a0e1f9ce055d1199c19c86bc6d8.translatedText: Second Vice Chairman: Zhang Deng Shuxian

10ebfa60631c383db08d47b9460ae9fdd10511b9.sourceText: 新任主席邓洪龯来自香港，三十年前毕业于南加州大学化学系。从事多年专业工作后又投入歺饮服务业。他多年来热心参与社区活动，曾任亚省中歺馆协会、中国週等董事会成员，亚美专业协会主席和侨联第一副主席。他当选后表示要在任期内尽全力做出最好成绩。
10ebfa60631c383db08d47b9460ae9fdd10511b9.translatedText: > The new chairman Deng Honghan is from Hong Kong and graduated from the Department of Chemistry of the University of Southern California thirty years ago. After many years of professional work, he joined the catering service industry. He has been enthusiastically participating in community activities for many years. He has served as a board member of the Alberta Chinese Museum Association, China Week, etc., as well as the chairman of the Asian American Professional Association and the first vice president of the Overseas Chinese Federation. After being elected, he said he would do his best to achieve the best results during his term.

1561d9f082840ef6f0ed0ecdee9bdee2e0fbd3cc.sourceText: 新的董事会将按照增强侨社团结，更好为侨胞服务的宗㫖积极开展活动。邦助华人华侨融入美国主流社会。积极宣掦中华文化，推进中美文化交流和经济往来。根据近年来亚省华人留学生和移民增多的趋势，加强关注对青年学子和老年人的支持和帮助。人们期待侨联在新的一年里有新的创新和作为。
1561d9f082840ef6f0ed0ecdee9bdee2e0fbd3cc.translatedText: The new board of directors will actively carry out activities in accordance with the purpose of strengthening the unity of the overseas Chinese community and better serving the overseas Chinese. The state helps overseas Chinese integrate into mainstream American society. Actively promote Chinese culture and promote cultural exchanges and economic exchanges between China and the United States. According to the trend of increasing Chinese international students and immigrants in Alberta in recent years, we will pay more attention to support and help for young students and the elderly. People look forward to new innovations and achievements from the Overseas Chinese Federation in the new year.

d522450eaffb766ef02d2e0f345b730bf377ab50.translatedText: Zhu Junying, chairman of the US-China Exchange Promotion Association, and Song Yang, the person in charge of the event, took the stage to deliver a speech. ab25a31260dbd96e93ed5faf82b9d0b50b3fa6b1.sourceText: ”全球梦幻彩灯嘉年华”已经在四大洲30多个国家和地区进行了展出，2015年在休斯敦的灯展受到美国朋友的热烈欢迎。自贡LED彩灯技术在世界领先，去年在休斯敦使用了100组设计新颖的灯组，组成了7大彩灯主景区，为游客打造一个色彩斑斓、内容丰富的东方灯展嘉年华，开设有”冬季梦幻”、”世界五大洲”、”侏罗纪”等七大园区。
ab25a31260dbd96e93ed5faf82b9d0b50b3fa6b1.translatedText: "Global Fantasy Lantern Carnival" has been exhibited in more than 30 countries and regions on four continents. The 2015 light show in Houston was popular among American friends. Warmly welcome. Zigong leads the world in LED lantern technology. Last year, it used 100 sets of innovatively designed lanterns in Houston to form seven major lantern scenic spots, creating a colorful and rich oriental lantern show carnival for tourists, including "Winter Dreams", "Five Continents of the World" and "Jurassic".

6eafc7d96fca8c677f955f9a7440f0f2fd4b50ac.translatedText: Screenshot of a US media report.

9fcb8196f2973ca7a2902b9463193a7c068b2cc3.sourceText: 北京时间4月2日消息，奥运会历史上金牌数高居首位的菲尔普斯目前正在美国亚利桑那州的坦佩进行紧张的训练，备战美国的里约奥运选拔赛。近日，据美国知名游泳网站《Swim Swam》爆料，在之前确认未婚妻怀孕的菲尔普斯收获了一个好消息，未婚妻妮可-约翰逊怀了四胞胎，他将成为四个孩子的爸爸！
9fcb8196f2973ca7a2902b9463193a7c068b2cc3.translatedText: Screenshot of a US media report. Beijing time on April 2. News. Phelps, who has the highest number of gold medals in the history of the Olympic Games, is currently undergoing intense training in Tempe, Arizona, USA, to prepare for the US Rio Olympic Trials. Recently, according to the well-known American swimming website "Swim Swam", Phelps, who had previously confirmed that his fiancée was pregnant, received good news. His fiancée Nicole Johnson is pregnant with quadruplets, and he will become the father of four children!

2eff5892d24d0a504a828c984df4a70e2ff53887.sourceText: 去年十一月，菲尔普斯在自己的个人社交账号上宣布了自己要升级当爹的喜讯。菲尔普斯当时在社交软件中写道：”我们在8周之前发现了一个振奋人心的消息厖我们的宝宝了已经12周大了！”同时还上传了一张和未婚妻手拿儿童泳裤的照片。
2eff5892d24d0a504a828c984df4a70e2ff53887.translatedText: Last November, Phelps announced the good news on his personal social account that he was going to become a father. Phelps wrote on social media at the time: "We found out the exciting news 8 weeks ago that our baby is already 12 weeks old!" He also uploaded a photo of him and his fiancée holding children's swimming trunks.

3dc2fb3e06563bb932d24ebf267b418ab0d3d4ed.sourceText: 据该媒体爆料，近日菲尔普斯和自己的未婚妻确认了?#22235;胞胎?#30340;消息。而菲尔普斯还在采访中激动表示自己的孩子们可以组建一个游泳接力队，并称他们中间有人可能将会在2036年奥运会中获得九枚金牌。 但由于今日（美国当地时间4月1日）正处于愚人节，且菲鱼相关社交平台上均无相关信息，所以该新闻可能是该网站的愚人节玩笑。
3dc2fb3e06563bb932d24ebf267b418ab0d3d4ed.translatedText: According to the media, Phelps and his fiancée recently confirmed the news of having a baby. Phelps also excitedly said in the interview that his children could form a swimming relay team, and said that some of them might win nine gold medals in the 2036 Olympics. However, since today (April 1, local time in the United States) is April Fool’s Day, and there is no relevant information on Feiyu’s relevant social platforms, the news may be an April Fool’s Day joke on the website.

bfb91ba3a7f46dd54e7838bb55e66bbf020ebf19.sourceText: 几天前，菲尔普斯与未婚妻妮可-约翰逊在美国加利福尼亚州的西湖村为即将出生的孩子举办了新生儿派对。参加派对的菲尔普斯异常兴奋，一身靛蓝的牛仔装扮，第一次穿着牛仔靴的他对所有到来的好友表达了自己的感谢之情。
bfb91ba3a7f46dd54e7838bb55e66bbf020ebf19.translatedText: A few days ago, Phelps and his fiancée Nicole Johnson held a newborn party for their upcoming child in Westlake Village, California, USA. Phelps was extremely excited to attend the party. Dressed in an indigo cowboy outfit and wearing cowboy boots for the first time, he expressed his gratitude to all the friends who came.

a94a207898b88580da455de99c4255a5b47e94ac.sourceText: 菲尔普斯的孩子将于夏天前诞生，这势必会给飞鱼继续向前的动力。对于菲尔普斯来说，他早已无需和别人比较来证明自己，但亮相里约赛场的他更希望给孩子们戴上属于自己的金牌吧。
a94a207898b88580da455de99c4255a5b47e94ac.translatedText: Phelps's child will be born before summer, which will definitely give Feiyu motivation to move forward. For Phelps, he no longer needs to compare with others to prove himself, but when he appears in Rio, he hopes to give his children his own gold medal.

b354d41e9615835a275c6cc07f5abb59d20b9581.sourceText: 希望中文学校特邀洪淑媛医生给大家做中医常识普及讲座。她在美国从事十多年的中医临床工作，其本人以极大的热忱专研并倡导以现代已知的生物医学机理来诠释中医理论，以通俗易懂的语言推广中医，希冀大家及医学专业人士了解中医多靶点，多层次，整体的，信息调节的内涵，合理利用中医的价值。 中医应用了人体生物信息反馈的机制，基于生物细胞维持衡态的生存实质，其临床价值撑得起维护人类生命及健康的半边天。
b354d41e9615835a275c6cc07f5abb59d20b9581.translatedText: I hope that the Chinese school will specially invite Dr. Hong Shuyuan to give everyone a lecture on common knowledge of traditional Chinese medicine. She has been engaged in clinical work of traditional Chinese medicine for more than ten years in the United States. She has devoted great enthusiasm to researching and advocating the interpretation of traditional Chinese medicine theory with modern known biomedical mechanisms, and promotes traditional Chinese medicine in easy-to-understand language. She hopes that everyone and medical professionals will understand the multi-target, multi-level, holistic, and information-regulated connotation of traditional Chinese medicine and the value of rational use of traditional Chinese medicine. Traditional Chinese medicine applies the biological information feedback mechanism of the human body and is based on the survival essence of biological cells maintaining a balanced state. Its clinical value can support half of the sky in protecting human life and health.

03c8d4253b818c9594fc1cf18d0e9ea817775b42.translatedText: A Boeing 767 aircraft escaped from the escape slide in the air and crashed in front of a residence in Phoenix, USA. A Boeing 767 passenger of Atlas Air of the United States...

5a2e9de6e27631ad1ce5bde0c64b8f684b3e1d19.sourceText: 美国亚特拉斯航空公司（Atlas Air）一架波音767客机日前飞越亚利桑那州凤凰城上空时，机上其中一道逃生滑梯突然脱落，坠落在一间住宅房屋的前园。一名女住客经历险境，幸好没有被击中，但已饱受虚惊。事件中无人受伤。
5a2e9de6e27631ad1ce5bde0c64b8f684b3e1d19.translatedText: Atlas Air of the United States When a Boeing 767 Air) was flying over Phoenix, Arizona a few days ago, one of the escape slides on the plane suddenly detached and fell into the front garden of a residential house. A female resident experienced a dangerous situation. Fortunately, she was not hit, but she suffered a false alarm. No one was injured in the incident.

0a148bd5928ab8a49739d60151bf9e6359b1552f.sourceText: 事发于当地时间周三下午，一架波音767客机在飞过亚利桑那州凤凰城上空时，安装在客机机翼上的逃生滑梯突然从853公尺（约2800呎）半空坠下，坠落在凤凰城郊区梅萨市一间屋的前园。客机其后紧急降落在附近一个机场。
0a148bd5928ab8a49739d60151bf9e6359b1552f.translatedText: The incident occurred on Wednesday afternoon local time. When a Boeing 767 passenger plane was flying over Phoenix, Arizona, the escape slide installed on the wing of the passenger plane suddenly fell from 853 meters (about 2,800 feet) in the air and landed in the front garden of a house in Mesa, a suburb of Phoenix. The passenger plane subsequently made an emergency landing at a nearby airport.

6bb1cda1139916c713a1b70926337c85eca51e4f.sourceText: 31岁的屋主塞尔夫形容事件太突然，令人感到十分震惊。塞尔夫表示，事发当时突然传来隆然巨响，房屋都发生震动。当自己一打开大门，便看到一大块银色的东西躺在地上，并嗅到类似硫磺的气味，而种在家门外的一棵树被撞毁。
6bb1cda1139916c713a1b70926337c85eca51e4f.translatedText: Self, a 31-year-old homeowner, described the incident as sudden and shocking. Self said there was a sudden loud bang at the time of the incident and the house was shaken. When he opened the door, he saw a large silver thing lying on the ground and smelled a sulfur-like smell, and a tree planted outside the home was destroyed.

3f86679cfae639098ad910c514ce307d7325f1f6.sourceText: 美国联邦航空管理局（FAA）周五证实事件，并介入调查。发言人格雷戈尔说表示，事件中只有逃生滑梯坠下，机门仍然十分牢固。而事发后，客机在附近的机场安全降落，没有酿成更严重的事故。肇事客机当时没有接载乘客，只有一批机组人员。
3f86679cfae639098ad910c514ce307d7325f1f6.translatedText: The U.S. Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) confirmed the incident on Friday and launched an investigation. Spokesman Gregor said that only the escape slide fell during the incident and the door was still very secure. After the incident, the passenger plane landed safely at a nearby airport and no more serious accident occurred. The aircraft involved in the accident was not carrying passengers, only a crew.

47f14a822f18f20ca4ca29df47907aa728e45220.sourceText: IO公司将在凤凰城再部署600个数据中心模块 美国数据中心专家IO正计划在其位于亚利桑那州凤凰城的园区扩建一个…
47f14a822f18f20ca4ca29df47907aa728e45220.translatedText: IO Company will deploy another 600 data center modules in Phoenix. The American data center expert IO is planning to expand a large three-story data center at its campus in Phoenix, Arizona...

9fc1c540c8b3a77972366bc9dddf674426abbfa8.sourceText: 美国数据中心专家IO正计划在其位于亚利桑那州凤凰城的园区扩建一个大型三层数据中心， IO总部也坐落在该园区中。
9fc1c540c8b3a77972366bc9dddf674426abbfa8.translatedText: The American data center expert IO is planning to expand a large three-story data center at its campus in Phoenix, Arizona, where the IO headquarters is also located.

534b7d7c5c06defaeb68dd3866b7cfb8454a9f2e.sourceText: 数据中心部署第三期将提供超过100MVA的供电容量，并逐渐部署从其子公司Baselayer订购的数据中心模块。
534b7d7c5c06defaeb68dd3866b7cfb8454a9f2e.translatedText: The third phase of the data center deployment will provide more than 100MVA power supply capacity and gradually deploy data center modules ordered from its subsidiary Baselayer.

6882afad3e67f1635ad86ec39c8c3b42222e1b6a.sourceText: 建设工作将从2016年底开始，IO希望能在2017年迎来该数据中心的第一位客户。
6882afad3e67f1635ad86ec39c8c3b42222e1b6a.translatedText: Construction work will begin at the end of 2016, and IO hopes to welcome the first customer of the data center in 2017.

81700c2bb11af5de5b8537848ea8d0c2007c3365.sourceText: IO 公司成立于在2007年，是数据中心模块化设计的行业先驱。直到2015年，公司仍运营着2条不同的业务线-一条提供外包托管和云服务，另外一条向其竞争者销售数据中心模块。
81700c2bb11af5de5b8537848ea8d0c2007c3365.translatedText: IO company was established in 2007 and is an industry pioneer in data center modular design. As of 2015, the company operated two distinct lines of business - one providing outsourced hosting and cloud services, and the other selling data center modules to its competitors.

eca1cf706e08cafbaf159f4d7b14de56a08b0456.sourceText: 去年初，IO公司一分为二，BaseLayer开始接管数据中心模块化业务，而IO继续管理位于亚利桑那州、俄亥俄州、新泽西州、新加坡和伦敦的数据中心。
eca1cf706e08cafbaf159f4d7b14de56a08b0456.translatedText: Early last year, IO split into two. BaseLayer began to take over the data center modular business, while IO continued to manage data centers in Arizona, Ohio, New Jersey, Singapore and London.

0b124e0e8ab4a949a60e14e8c9a8c8561e3d94c0.sourceText: 正如预期所设，IO在新泽西州爱迪生市运营着世界上最大的模块化数据中心。
0b124e0e8ab4a949a60e14e8c9a8c8561e3d94c0.translatedText: As expected, IO operates the world's largest modular data center in Edison, New Jersey.

187457fe0f8f583fdbec033d759cd31abd364a25.sourceText: 与此同时，凤凰城园区已成为西海岸最大的多租户外包托管数据中心之一，拥有超过120MW的核心电力。
187457fe0f8f583fdbec033d759cd31abd364a25.translatedText: Meanwhile, the Phoenix campus has become one of the largest multi-tenant outsourced colocation data centers on the West Coast, with more than 120MW of core power.

c25e3a5946a9070e3c9f1b415bf4b31fafa2824e.sourceText: 2月初，IO在现有设施南面购买了约9英亩的土地，并计划在今年年底前开工建设。IO公司预想建造一个顶端容纳BaseLayer核心模块的一栋建筑，并表示这是业内首例。
c25e3a5946a9070e3c9f1b415bf4b31fafa2824e.translatedText: In early February, IO purchased approximately 9 acres of land south of the existing facility and plans to start construction before the end of this year. IO envisions building a building with BaseLayer core modules on top, and says this is the first of its kind in the industry.

fed540a5af2724d26b2d10a086a6c0fe014110b5.sourceText: 当建设完全完成时，该扩建的建筑将能容纳超过600个独立的数据中心模块。
fed540a5af2724d26b2d10a086a6c0fe014110b5.translatedText: When construction is fully completed, the expanded building will be able to accommodate more than 600 independent data center modules.

d1f8c47a0590482e78aa81a3d4455ea541749c52.sourceText: ”位于凤凰城的IO数据中心园区相当成功棗我们以惊人的速度迅速扩大规模，以应对客户需求，”IO总裁Tony Wanger称。
d1f8c47a0590482e78aa81a3d4455ea541749c52.translatedText: "The IO data center campus in Phoenix has been extremely successful and we have scaled up incredibly quickly to respond to customer demand," said IO President Tony Wanger.

3ae0772cc26f6e00b424965f1af2bea4bf6666f2.sourceText: ”我们为全球最苛刻的客户建造和运营最高效、可持续的数据中心。我们最新的数据中心将定义最先进基础设施的标准，支持外包托管和云服务。这也证明，我们公司致力于投资家乡社区的建设。”
3ae0772cc26f6e00b424965f1af2bea4bf6666f2.translatedText: "We build and operate the most efficient, sustainable data centers for the world's most demanding customers. Our newest data center will set the standard for state-of-the-art infrastructure, supporting outsourced hosting and cloud services. It is also a testament to our company's commitment to investing in the communities where it belongs."

15f28cd685a83e71d1c896afec39dd8f285820c1.sourceText: 大凤凰城台美商会会长张圣仪代表商会致词时表示，感谢联邦参议员迈肯John McCain过去几十年来一直支持中华民国，是我们在国会山庄长期以来的最佳盟友，台湾在世界经济体系占有举足轻重的一席之地，唯有支持台湾加入太平洋战略经济伙伴关係协议（TPP)才能提升全球竞争力。身为中小型企业主，我们每曰在工作岗位上兢兢业业，为美国经济打拼，更呼吁所有台商会员朋友们在今年十一月大选用选票来发声，用选票来支持我们的盟友；并感谢所有参与活动的理事义工和出席嘉宾，活动得以圆满成功。
15f28cd685a83e71d1c896afec39dd8f285820c1.translatedText: President of the Taiwan-American Chamber of Commerce in Greater Phoenix, Zhang Shengyi, delivered a speech on behalf of the chamber of commerce and expressed his gratitude to Senator John McCain. McCain has supported the Republic of China for decades and has been our best ally on Capitol Hill for a long time. Taiwan occupies a pivotal place in the world economic system. Only by supporting Taiwan's participation in the Pacific Strategic Economic Partnership (TPP) can we enhance global competitiveness. As small and medium-sized business owners, we work hard every day at work to contribute to the U.S. economy. We also call on all Taiwanese business members to use their votes to support our allies in the general election in November this year. We would also like to thank all the directors, volunteers and guests who participated in the event. The event was a complete success.

7746b66ea066206db942d7b9e7b3be0e5479b81f.sourceText: 第一次认识Greg Stanton是2011年的中国周，那时候他正准备竞选凤凰城市长职位。再次与他做专访时，他已经刚刚再次连任全美第五大城市凤凰城的市长。
7746b66ea066206db942d7b9e7b3be0e5479b81f.translatedText: The first time I met Greg Stanton was during China Week in 2011, when he was preparing to run for the mayor of Phoenix City. When I had an exclusive interview with him again, he had just been re-elected as the mayor of Phoenix, the fifth largest city in the United States.

642e82f28ffd8331e580d6b94f92a284f52a4d5f.sourceText: ”《甲骨文：中国的时光之旅》英文名：Oracle Bones: A Journey Between China’s Past And Present 《归途列车》英文名： Last Train Home. 《长江》 Longer Yangtze River”凤凰城市长 Greg Stanton列出了一系列他阅读的有关现代中国的书籍和纪录片。他对中华文化的痴迷可见一斑。 2016年是凤凰城-成都姐妹城市缔结三十周年。市长Stanton说凤凰城-成都有非常紧密的姐妹城市关系，之所以我们建立这种友谊，就是希望两个城市的市民相互了解，当我们都成为了朋友，很多的合作都变得更加便利。比如说凤凰城和成都安排学生到姐妹城市做短期的访问，交换老师互访。他说三十年前，我们只知道中国是一个非常独特的国家，我们不了解。在众多凤凰城的姐妹城市中，和成都的姐妹城市关系尤重要。中国是全球第二大经济体。作为两个高速发展的城市，除了了经济上加强合作，更应该在世界领导者的领域站出来，为保护环境做更多切实的合作。Stanton表示在接下去的一两年中，凤凰城市长很希望和成都市长共同签署防止全球变暖的协议。他让姐妹市代表Allan Yang，在企业如何进行资源共享，优势互补从而推动科研成果产业化的良性循环圆桌对话会议中讨论了Uhaul公司在凤凰城可持续发展战略，并发信给成都市市长，希望两个城市之间能够起草防止全球变暖的协议，鼓励城市进行可持续性产业发展。30年的姐妹城市关系，让两个城市，甚至国家在多个层面上有更多的合作。例如凤凰城的移民投资项目Marriott酒店，就吸引很多来自中国的投资者。在未来，到凤凰城投资的手续将更加简单快捷。 在两次中国访问的过程中， Greg Stanton说 ”北京是现代和传统相结合的非常独特的世界金融中心。 我非常喜欢那里，你能买到最时尚的顶级汽车，同时也可以看到很多人骑着自行车从身边走过。最现代的建筑以及上千年的古老建筑都结合在这个城市。”凤凰城是一个新兴工业城市，能为海外投资者提供非常好的投资环境，希望更多的中国朋友来我们这里看看。成都市是中国西南非常有特色的城市，有熊猫，美食，还有很多非常传统的中国文化，他非常期待成都之行。
642e82f28ffd8331e580d6b94f92a284f52a4d5f.translatedText: "Oracle Bones: A Journey Between China’s Past And Present" English title: Last Train Home. "Longer Yangtze River" Phoenix Mayor Greg Stanton listed a series of books and documentaries he has read about modern China. His obsession with Chinese culture is evident. 2016 marks the 30th anniversary of the establishment of the Phoenix-Chengdu sister city. Mayor Stanton said that Phoenix-Chengdu has a very close sister city relationship. The reason why we established this friendship is that we hope that the citizens of the two cities will understand each other. When we all become friends, many cooperations will become more convenient. For example, Phoenix City and Chengdu arrange for students to go to sister cities for short-term visits and exchange teachers for mutual visits. He said that thirty years ago, we only knew that China was a very unique country and we did not understand it. Among the many sister cities of Phoenix, the relationship with Chengdu is particularly important. China is the world's second largest economy. As two rapidly developing cities, in addition to strengthening economic cooperation, they should also stand out as world leaders and do more practical cooperation to protect the environment. Stanton said that in the next year or two, the mayor of Phoenix hopes to sign an agreement with the mayor of Chengdu to prevent global warming. He asked Allan Yang, representative of the sister city, to discuss Uhaul's sustainable development strategy in Phoenix during a roundtable dialogue on how companies can share resources and complement each other's strengths to promote the industrialization of scientific research results. He also sent a letter to the mayor of Chengdu, hoping that the two cities could draft an agreement to prevent global warming and encourage the city to develop sustainable industries. The 30-year sister city relationship has allowed the two cities and even countries to have more cooperation on multiple levels. For example, the Marriott Hotel, an immigration investment project in Phoenix, has attracted many investors from China. In the future, the procedures for investing in Phoenix will be simpler and faster. During two visits to China, Greg Stanton said, "Beijing is a very unique world financial center that combines modernity and tradition. I like it very much. You can buy the most fashionable top-end cars, and you can also see many people riding bicycles passing by. The most modern buildings and thousands of years of ancient buildings are combined in this city." Phoenix is ​​an emerging industrial city that can provide a very good investment environment for overseas investors. I hope more Chinese friends will come to visit us. Chengdu is a very unique city in southwest China. It has pandas, delicious food, and a lot of very traditional Chinese culture. He is looking forward to his trip to Chengdu.

d38df539c417566977e6a171ca07900369269b25.sourceText: 江玥同学不幸遇难的事情牵动着国内以及海外千千万万华人的心。这两天 Tempe 警方在各方目击证人，学生会以及洛杉矶领事馆领事的共同协助下使案情有了很大的进展。此次枪击事件的各方面信息也已经清晰明了。为了给予广大 ASU 在校留学生以及国外内关注此事的华人们同胞们一个交代， ASU 中国学生学者联谊会将联合 Tempe 警方和 ASU 校警于明天 1 月 20 日周三下午在学校 MUArizona Ballroom 召开官方新闻发布会。
d38df539c417566977e6a171ca07900369269b25.translatedText: >The unfortunate death of classmate Jiang Yue has touched the hearts of thousands of Chinese at home and abroad. In the past two days, the Tempe police have made great progress in the case with the help of witnesses from all parties, the student union and the consul from the Los Angeles Consulate. All aspects of the shooting have become clear. In order to give an explanation to the majority of ASU international students and Chinese compatriots abroad who are concerned about this matter, the ASU Chinese Students and Scholars Association will join forces with the Tempe police and ASU campus police to hold an official press conference in the school's MUArizona Ballroom tomorrow afternoon, January 20.

e229dc300192ac1650b15d92a0db01765209d8c4.sourceText: 发布会主要内容为澄清案件发生过程，解答各位同学或社会人士对于此事的疑问。希望广大 ASU 同学以及菲尼克斯华侨同胞们积极出席此次新闻发布会。让社会各界看到我们海外留学生以及华侨同胞团结一致的心，以及对不幸过世的江玥同学的哀悼。
e229dc300192ac1650b15d92a0db01765209d8c4.translatedText: The main content of the press conference is to clarify the process of the case and answer questions about the matter from students or members of the public. We hope that all ASU students and overseas Chinese compatriots in Phoenix will actively attend this press conference. Let all walks of life see the solidarity of our overseas students and overseas Chinese compatriots, and the condolences for Jiang Yue who unfortunately passed away.

2bb73fd66b542626600850b35416af31c75e8ce1.translatedText: The picture above shows the crime location

98d342fac85636beaee6c80c19e91eef71dc74ff.sourceText: 枪击事件发生在昨天，1月16日周六下午3点左右。ASU大二在读女生江玥驾驶一辆白色奔驰汽车于其男友两人从Mekong购物回家。行驶到McClintock Drive并准备左转。进入左转车道后，一辆由一位白人妇女驾驶的大众汽车从左转道右边的直行道强行左转，并撞击到了停在左转道上的江玥驾驶的白色奔驰车。受到撞击后，江玥的男友下车查看车辆受损情况，却发现撞击他们车辆的白人女子在车中手持枪械。于是他赶快回到车中，告知女友快快离开。谁知，在这话语间，该白人女子上前从窗外对驾驶座上的江玥连开数枪。中枪后江玥企图驾车逃离现场。但是在片刻后便失去了知觉，导致车辆失控撞向了另一辆坐了一家人的雪佛兰轿车。车中包括一对夫妇，其中妻子怀有生孕，车中还有三名小孩。枪手开枪后驾车逃离了现场。
98d342fac85636beaee6c80c19e91eef71dc74ff.translatedText: The shooting happened yesterday, Saturday, January 16th at about 3 pm. Jiang Yue, a sophomore at ASU, drove a white Mercedes-Benz car with her boyfriend home from Mekong shopping. Go to McClintock Drive and prepare to turn left. After entering the left turn lane, a Volkswagen driven by a white woman forced a left turn from the straight lane on the right side of the left turn lane and hit a white Mercedes-Benz driven by Jiang Yue that was parked in the left turn lane. After being hit, Jiang Yue's boyfriend got out of the car to check the damage to the vehicle, but found that the white woman who hit their vehicle was holding a gun in the car. So he quickly returned to the car and told his girlfriend to leave quickly. Unexpectedly, during these words, the white woman stepped forward and fired several shots at Jiang Yue in the driver's seat from the window. After being shot, Jiang Yue tried to drive away from the scene. But he lost consciousness a moment later, causing the vehicle to lose control and crash into another Chevrolet sedan carrying a family. The car included a couple, the wife was pregnant, and there were three children in the car. The gunman opened fire and fled the scene.

55b0c8390127ee3e2d24f16fcb6054935fe13254.sourceText: 随后救护车赶到现场，将江玥和他的男友，还有雪佛兰车中的一家人送至医院。不幸的是，江玥因失血过多不幸身亡。
55b0c8390127ee3e2d24f16fcb6054935fe13254.translatedText: The ambulance then rushed to the scene and sent Jiang Yue, his boyfriend, and the family in the Chevrolet car to the hospital. Unfortunately, Jiang Yue died of excessive blood loss.

27838103b2cb58fd76a2a50e8af307ff854fbee6.sourceText: 于昨晚6时许，警方抓捕了这位32岁的白人枪手Holly Davis。据警方初步判断，该女子有嗑药的嫌疑。具体细节需要等待血液化验结果出来方可确认。
27838103b2cb58fd76a2a50e8af307ff854fbee6.translatedText: At about 6 o'clock last night, the police arrested the 32-year-old white gunman Holly Davis. According to the preliminary judgment of the police, the woman was suspected of taking drugs. Specific details need to wait for the blood test results to be confirmed.

0869c21ff283ef50c3e9d58898f6caea5111ea6d.sourceText: 据悉，江玥为ASU大二金融专业学生。来自中国重庆。
0869c21ff283ef50c3e9d58898f6caea5111ea6d.translatedText: It is reported that Jiang Yue is a sophomore finance student at ASU. From Chongqing, China.

c816e933f7296f28130d16373c737d00a9bf0efc.sourceText: ASU中国学生学者联谊会已经与受害女生父母取得联系，并协助Tempe警方处理相关事宜。在此，ASU-CSSA提醒各位海外留学生，出门在外请一定注意人身安全。尽量避免单独出行，特别是女生要避免在晚上单独出行。遇到任何困难或者危险，在确保人身安全的情况下，尽快寻求帮助。
c816e933f7296f28130d16373c737d00a9bf0efc.translatedText: ASU Chinese Students and Scholars Association has contacted the parents of the victim girl and assisted the Tempe police in handling related matters. Here, ASU-CSSA reminds all overseas students to pay attention to personal safety when going out. Try to avoid traveling alone, especially girls, who should avoid traveling alone at night. If you encounter any difficulty or danger, seek help as soon as possible while ensuring your personal safety.

17bebe50f695bbd037ce8cff579c894217f5db56.translatedText: Li Hongzhang and Chop Suey - Commemorating the 120th anniversary of Chinese food entering the mainstream of the United States

44c6a07be14335a5b4510edffefd69a1d7ddabd5.sourceText: 李鸿章与杂碎—纪念中国美食进入美国主流120周年 我们所说的唐餐，即中国美食，是何时在美国落…
44c6a07be14335a5b4510edffefd69a1d7ddabd5.translatedText: Li Hongzhang and Chop Suey - Commemorating the 120th anniversary of Chinese food entering the mainstream of the United States. When did the Tang cuisine we call, that is, Chinese cuisine, come to be in the United States...

b814eb1dbe7aef4cdd4d0c07a7d69c86c9744c28.sourceText: 我们所说的唐餐，即中国美食，是何时在美国落地和发展的呢？翻查历史后得知，中国餐馆在美国开设已有150年的历史了，而将中国餐业发扬光大，能在西餐刀叉声中雄据一席之地的，郄是那120年前访美的清廷洋务大臣李鸿章。 十九世纪中叶，来到美国的中国人就已经开始经商，到了1850年，已有文字资料记载: 在当时华人集中的三藩市，有华人经营的杂货铺33间，药材铺15间，屠宰铺5间，理髮铺5间，另还有一批裁缝、客栈、饼铺、木厂、戏院、报馆等，但当时的中餐馆只有5间。在1872年，华埠中国人的职业最多的是製雪茄烟者，达三千人，皮鞋厂二千人，食品罐头一千人，毛织厂五百人等。在美国华人集中的纽约华埠，同样是操洗衣业者过半，其次为雪茄生意，但餐馆业者仍属少数。由此可知，当时的中餐业并不蓬勃，服务范围仅以唐人街为主，食客大多数也是本地的华人，中餐业这时还谈不上进入到美国主流。 到了1896年，情况有了变化。当时清廷的洋务大臣李鸿章到访美国，抵达纽约后受到美国政府的隆重接待。在饮食方面，”李总督带来庞大的厨师团” ，《纽约时报》1896年8月29日的报道是这样写的：”代表团里有十几个厨师，首席厨师是个高个子、年纪不详、毫无表情的男子。身穿深色长袍，一举一动就像是总督的下级正式官员。大概是因为主人身居要职吧，这位厨师长也一本正经地不和饭店的人说话厖然后上楼，等候着他主人的吩咐。” 美国人的”李鸿章杂碎 创世纪篇”也有记载：”李鸿章到了纽约后，试图创造良好的中美关系，8月29日晚上，他宴请美国客人。席间李鸿章上了道由芹菜、豆芽、肉和美味中国酱组成的菜，以满足中国主人和美国客人的双重口味。”(《美国故事》杂志) ，而这种”杂七杂八”的中国美食，就是日后名声鹊起的中菜”杂碎”，英名的正式译名是”Chop Suey”。 美国主流社会文学中最早说到”李鸿章杂碎”这个词，是在美国作家刘易斯的作品里。在这位诺贝尔和平奖得主的1914年小说里这样写道：”对，到七花王国李鸿章杂碎店和美国点心店去，那里有5美元一位的茶座。”
b814eb1dbe7aef4cdd4d0c07a7d69c86c9744c28.translatedText: When did the Tang cuisine we call, that is, Chinese cuisine, come to be and develop in the United States? After checking the history, I learned that Chinese restaurants have been opened in the United States for 150 years. The person who promoted the Chinese restaurant industry and was able to dominate the sound of Western food knives and forks was Li Hongzhang, the Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Qing Dynasty who visited the United States 120 years ago. In the mid-19th century, the Chinese who came to the United States had already begun to do business. By 1850, there were written records: In San Francisco, where the Chinese were concentrated at that time, there were 33 Chinese-operated grocery stores, 15 medicinal shops, 5 butcher shops, 5 barber shops, as well as a number of tailors, inns, cake shops, wood factories, theaters, newspapers, etc., but there were only 5 Chinese restaurants at that time. In 1872, the most common occupations among the Chinese in Chinatown were cigar makers, with 3,000 people, leather shoe factories with 2,000 people, food canners with 1,000 people, and woolen factories with 500 people. In New York's Chinatown, where Chinese Americans are concentrated, more than half of the businesses are engaged in laundry, followed by the cigar business, but restaurant operators are still in the minority. It can be seen from this that the Chinese restaurant industry was not booming at that time. The service area was mainly in Chinatown, and most of the diners were local Chinese. The Chinese restaurant industry could not yet enter the mainstream of the United States. By 1896, the situation had changed. At that time, Li Hongzhang, the Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Qing Dynasty, visited the United States. After arriving in New York, he was grandly received by the U.S. government. In terms of food, "Governor Lee brought a large team of chefs." The New York Times reported on August 29, 1896, wrote: "There are more than a dozen chefs in the delegation. The chief chef is a tall, expressionless man of unknown age. Wearing a dark robe, he behaves like a subordinate official of the governor. Probably because the owner holds a senior position, the head chef also solemnly did not talk to the people in the hotel and then went upstairs, waiting for his owner's instructions." The American "Creation of Li Hongzhang's Chop Suey" also records: "After Li Hongzhang arrived in New York, he tried to create good Sino-US relations. On the evening of August 29, he entertained American guests. During the dinner, Li Hongzhang served a dish consisting of celery, bean sprouts, meat and delicious Chinese sauce to satisfy the dual tastes of the Chinese host and American guests." ("American Story" magazine) , and this kind of "miscellaneous" Chinese food is the Chinese dish "chop suey" that has become famous in the future. The official translation of the British name is "Chop Suey". The term "Li Hongzhang offal" was first mentioned in mainstream American social literature in the works of American writer Lewis. In the Nobel Peace Prize winner's 1914 novel, he wrote: "Yes, go to Li Hongzhang's Chop Suey Shop and the American Dim Sum Shop in the Kingdom of Seven Flowers, where there is a tea table for $5 a person."

db71dad1a4c24a76c7ec32b23c6b7a9b5e174297.sourceText: 有关李鸿章与杂碎的故事，当年的华埠也流传有不同的版本，其中之一是：李鸿章抵达纽约后，去了一间名为《万里云》的餐馆去吃中餐。不过所吃到的菜式，的确也叫不出什麽名堂，有西人问之，李鸿章便笼统以＂杂碎＂回答。后经新闻记者报道，＂杂碎＂之名竟鹊起风行。到了1898年，就有了《中原楼》以＂杂碎＂作品牌招揽顾客，继而有《香港楼》和《华美餐室》等餐馆跟进。中国美食因李鸿章访美而名声大噪，名不经传的杂碎成为了中国菜的品牌， 到了1903年，梁启超从加拿大来到纽约唐人埠，曾写有下面的文字：＂纽约华人约二万，…业洗衣者居多，杂碎馆次之…杂碎馆自李鸿章游美后始产生，前此西人不履足唐人埠，自李鸿章一到游历，此后来者如鲫。西人好奇，欲知中国人生活之程度，末能如至亚洲，则必到纽约唐人埠一观焉。＂。＂李鸿章在美，思食中国饮食，到唐人街之酒食进馔数次，西人问其名，以杂碎对曰。自杂碎之名大躁，傥纽约一隅，杂碎馆三四百家，遍于全市。全美国华人衣食于是者凡三千余人，每岁此业所收入，可达数百万元，蔚为大国矣。＂ 由此见可见，中国美食是以”李鸿章杂碎”为开路先锋，从纽约、三藩市等华埠扩展至全美各地，并进入到美国主流社会，最终打造出中国美食的大国地位。资料还显示，1896年李鸿章环游诸国，出访俄国、德国、比利时、法国、英国、美国，所到之处皆受当地元首接待，他在美接受纽约时报采访时，还抨击了美国的排华法桉。 凤凰城在1900年已有华人经营中国餐馆。据亚省历史学教授布拉得福-洛金汉所着的《斐匿：一个西南部都市的历史》一书中指出: ”在一九一零年，本地中国人仍经营了一些生意相当好的洗衣店、杂货店、蔬菜摊，而全斐匿城最大的三家餐馆都控制在中国人手里”。从本地华侨前辈提供的资料及相片中，也得知在上世纪初叶已有余氏余康中经营的《花旗餐馆》，是当时少数的中式餐馆之一。1928年，在凤凰城市区繁华的地段开业的《上海楼》杂碎馆，到目前己有80多年的历史，亚省主流社会和无数的美国人，也是从《上海楼》品尝到杂碎，继而热爱上中国菜的。在其后遍地开花的华人餐馆中，杂碎更是必备的中国美食。只是到了近年，因中国餐业走向多元化和宏扬地方美食品牌，杂碎开始日见式微，甚至很难在菜单中看到昔日的这种健康又美味的中菜。纵使这样，我们在美华人郄不可忘记，120年前的”李鸿章杂碎”，曾令中餐业在美国扬名及受益过万千个华人家庭。 据近期资料统计，目前全美国中餐馆已超过5万家， 比麦当劳多两倍以，中餐业在美国年销售额已愈200亿，美国人每天要消费250多万份中餐，成为美国人的家常饭菜。现在的中国美食早己享誉世界，例如在犹太人的习俗里，过完圣诞节就一定吃中国餐呢！ 2016年，亚省中国餐馆协会将隆重举办纪念中国美食进入美国主流社会120周年，这种提议和纪念活动在全美也属首次，具有其开创性的意义，其倡议得到了餐馆同业的热烈响应和积极参与。亚省中国餐馆协会并诚邀亚省主流和凤凰城华人侨界共襄盛举，共同庆祝纪念活动。让我们重温杂碎历史，回味杂碎美味，宏扬中华美食文化！ (作者现任亚省中国餐馆协会顾问)
db71dad1a4c24a76c7ec32b23c6b7a9b5e174297.translatedText: Regarding the story of Li Hongzhang and the chop suey, there were different versions circulated in Chinatown at that time. One of them is: After Li Hongzhang arrived in New York, he went to a restaurant called "Wanli Yun" to eat Chinese food. However, the dishes he ate were indeed nothing special. When Westerners asked, Li Hongzhang simply answered "chop suey". After being reported by journalists, the name "offal" became very popular. By 1898, there was the "Chung Yuan House" to attract customers with the "Chop Suey" brand, and then there were restaurants such as "Hong Kong House" and "Huamei Restaurant" to follow. Chinese food became famous because of Li Hongzhang’s visit to the United States. The little-known chop suey became a brand of Chinese food. In 1903, Liang Qichao came to Chinatown, New York from Canada. He wrote the following: "There are about 20,000 Chinese in New York. Most of them are laundry workers, followed by the chop suey shop... The chop suey shop started after Li Hongzhang's trip to the United States. "In the past, Westerners did not visit Tangren Port. Since Li Hongzhang's arrival, Westerners have been as curious as ever. If they want to know the extent of Chinese life, they must go to New York's Tangren Port to see it." "When Li Hongzhang was in the United States, he wanted to eat Chinese food. He went to Chinatown for several meals. When Westerners asked him his name, he responded with the name of offal. Since the name of offal has become popular, there are three to four hundred offal restaurants in this corner of New York. There are more than 3,000 Chinese people in the United States who have good food and clothing. The income from this business every year can reach millions of dollars, and they have become a big country." It can be seen from this that Chinese food pioneered the path of "Li Hongzhang Chop Suey" and expanded from Chinatowns such as New York and San Francisco to all parts of the United States and entered mainstream American society, eventually establishing the status of Chinese food as a major country. The data also shows that in 1896, Li Hongzhang traveled around the world, visiting Russia, Germany, Belgium, France, the United Kingdom, and the United States. He was received by local heads of state wherever he went. In an interview with the New York Times in the United States, he also criticized the United States' Chinese Exclusion Act. Phoenix already had Chinese restaurants operating in 1900. According to the book "Phenomenon: The History of a Southwest City" written by Bradford Rockingham, a professor of history in Alberta, "In 1910, the local Chinese still ran some quite good laundries, grocery stores, and vegetable stalls, and the three largest restaurants in Phenomenal City were all controlled by Chinese people." From the information and photos provided by local overseas Chinese seniors, we also learned that in the early 20th century, there was the "Citi Restaurant" operated by Yu Kangzhong of the Yu family. It was one of the few Chinese restaurants at that time. In 1928, the "Shanghai House" chop suey restaurant opened in a prosperous area of ​​downtown Phoenix. It has a history of more than 80 years. Mainstream society in Alberta and countless Americans also tasted chop suey from the "Shanghai House" and then fell in love with Chinese food. In the subsequent proliferation of Chinese restaurants, chop suey has become a must-have Chinese delicacy. However, in recent years, due to the diversification of the Chinese catering industry and the promotion of local food brands, chop suey has begun to decline, and it is even difficult to see this healthy and delicious Chinese dish in the past on the menu. Even so, we Chinese in the United States must not forget that "Li Hongzhang Chop Suey" 120 years ago made the Chinese restaurant industry famous in the United States and benefited thousands of Chinese families. According to recent statistics, there are currently more than 50,000 Chinese restaurants in the United States, more than twice as many as McDonald's. The Chinese food industry's annual sales in the United States have exceeded 20 billion. Americans consume more than 2.5 million pieces of Chinese food every day, making it a home-cooked meal for Americans. Nowadays, Chinese food has long been famous all over the world. For example, according to Jewish custom, Chinese food is always eaten after Christmas! In 2016, the Alberta Chinese Restaurant Association will hold a grand ceremony to commemorate the 120th anniversary of the entry of Chinese cuisine into mainstream society in the United States. This kind of initiative and commemorative event is the first in the United States and has its groundbreaking significance. Its initiative has received enthusiastic response and active participation from the restaurant industry. The Chinese Restaurant Association of Alberta sincerely invites the mainstream of the province and the Chinese community in Phoenix to participate in the event and celebrate the commemoration together. Let’s relive the history of chop suey, savor the deliciousness of chop suey, and promote Chinese food culture! (The author is currently a consultant to the Alberta Chinese Restaurant Association)

213b9c5dc3c3331d6fa3c869892be22d957a665a.sourceText: 2014年5月，为准备在全美中文学校协会第10次全国代表大会上的演出，本城五所中文学校负责人和我一起开会讨论节目的基本定调和要求。会上决定节目要体现学生们学习中华语言文化的成果。希望中文学校的董事长周青和校长田琳当时不约而同在脑中想到的就是改编排练”木兰出征”舞蹈剧，并加强语言表现部分；这一点是节目的编导蒋琳老师最近告诉我的。
213b9c5dc3c3331d6fa3c869892be22d957a665a.translatedText: In May 2014, in order to prepare for the performance at the 10th National Congress of the American Chinese Schools Association, the heads of five Chinese schools in this city met with me to discuss the basic tone and requirements of the program. At the meeting, it was decided that the program should reflect the students’ achievements in learning Chinese language and culture. Zhou Qing, the chairman of Hope Chinese School, and Tian Lin, the principal, all had in mind the idea of ​​adapting and rehearsing the "Mulan Goes Out" dance drama and enhancing the language performance; this is what the program's choreographer Jiang Lin recently told me.

f1af9d926a1fee0e40c0cfadcd2b3d25ed76558c.sourceText: 2016年亚省春晚演出的票正在热卖中，有需要的朋友赶紧抢购！这是送给亲人朋友的春节大礼。去年在接近演出的时候，已经是一票难求。本次春晚又有大腕来了。中国青年古筝独奏家夏菁，将在春晚为带来精彩的演绎。夏菁是第七届”世界明日之星”音乐大赛古筝金质奖获得者，第七届中国音乐”金钟奖”得主，获得研究生国家奖学金等殊荣。
f1af9d926a1fee0e40c0cfadcd2b3d25ed76558c.translatedText: Tickets for the 2016 Alberta Spring Festival Gala performances are now on sale, friends in need hurry up and buy them! This is a great Spring Festival gift for relatives and friends. Last year, as we approached the show, it was already hard to get a ticket. Another big name is coming to this Spring Festival Gala. Xia Jing, a young Chinese guzheng soloist, will give a wonderful performance at the Spring Festival Gala. Xia Jing is the winner of the Guzheng Gold Medal in the 7th "World Rising Stars" Music Competition, the winner of the 7th Chinese Music "Golden Bell Award", and has received national scholarships for graduate students and other honors.

9f7d63d37cbfb39eb89616c2fc0ce134c2e365b8.sourceText: 毕业于中国音乐学院的她，与亚利桑那有很多的渊源。2015年她参加了亚利桑那大学的中秋音乐会。她演奏的《阳关三叠》，”渭城朝雨浥轻尘，客舍青青柳色新”，素月悬空的幕布下，整个音乐厅静谧得只听得音乐的流动。2015年她再次与钱德勒交响乐团合作《彝族舞曲》，中西合璧，让中国民间音乐在美国大放异彩。本次”亚省春晚”夏菁又会给我们带来怎样美妙的旋律呢？我们暂时保密，本次春晚节目一定让您爱到，不想离开剧场。 除了大腕的友情演出，近150人的儿童合唱团，会将不同肤色的朋友聚集在一起，庆祝中国的节日和文化。2015年春晚他们演唱的《大海呀，故乡》让很多中国朋友都潸然泪下。今年孩子们会带来一首英文歌和一首中文歌曲。中文歌是经典的中国民乐，很富挑战性。更多精彩还在继续。 亚省春晚时间：2月13日星期六晚7:00 地点： 美莎艺术中心（Mesa Art Center） 春晚售票热线： （480）788-9584 地址：610 N Alma School Rd Ste 16 Chandler AZ 85224
9f7d63d37cbfb39eb89616c2fc0ce134c2e365b8.translatedText: graduated from the China Conservatory of Music and has many connections with Arizona. In 2015, she participated in the Mid-Autumn Festival Concert at the University of Arizona. She played "Three Layers of Yangguan", "The morning rain in Weicheng is lightly dusted, and the guest house is green and willow is new." Under the curtain of Su Yue hanging in the air, the entire concert hall was so quiet that only the flow of music could be heard. In 2015, she collaborated with the Chandler Symphony Orchestra again in "Yi Dance", combining Chinese and Western styles, making Chinese folk music shine in the United States. What kind of beautiful melody will Xia Jing bring us in this "Alberta Spring Festival Gala"? We will keep it secret for the time being. You will definitely love this Spring Festival Gala program and not want to leave the theater. In addition to friendly performances by big names, a children's choir of nearly 150 people will bring together friends of different skin colors to celebrate Chinese festivals and culture. Their performance of "Ocean, Hometown" during the 2015 Spring Festival Gala made many Chinese friends shed tears. This year the children will bring an English song and a Chinese song. Chinese songs are classic Chinese folk music and very challenging. More exciting things to come. Alberta Spring Festival Gala Time: Saturday, February 13th at 7:00 pm Location: Mesa Art Center Spring Festival Gala Ticket Hotline: (480) 788-9584 Address: 610 N Alma School Rd Ste 16 Chandler AZ 85224

Just after Turkey Day, we embarked on a three-day and two-night self-driving trip to visit four national parks in Utah. Although there are no traces left in heaven and earth, we have been there before. After returning home, leave a note for fellow travelers who share the same ambition.

367971225204b5878e390b5ab35af7a616a609e4.sourceText: 鍚安国家公园(Zion Nationa lPark) 鍚安国家公园是我们到犹他州的第一个旅游胜地。驾车从凤凤城到鍚安公园是370英哩，需时6小时。从17号高速公路到Flagstaff，再行驶US-89到达page。page 是亚利桑那州与犹他州边界相交的一个小镇，其中有羚羊谷、马蹄湾和鲍威尔湖等多个着名景点，因之前到过，所以加满汽油就继续赶路。旅游车沿着UT-9 W踏入犹它境地，马不停蹄地驶往鍚安公园。 事先印出地图并带上GPS，手机虽然也有GPS功能，但要使用太多Data，所以并不推荐使用。搜集到资料显示，犹他州这三天多云，气温在华氏6-30度之间(摄时零度以下)，风速7英哩，但湿度是90%，也即是说只要气温再稍低，山区即有降雪之可能。果然，进入犹他境地，开始尚晴空万里，但进入山区就有米粒般约雪花迎面扑来，千点万点地飞舞着撞向车前玻璃，让人有如在观看3D立体电影。 下午3点来了到锡安公园。鍚安国家公园收费不像羚羊谷以人头计算，而是按每台小车30美元收费。进到园区内，还有环游车兔费运送观光客到各个景点，但有些地方需要徒步或脚踏车方能到达。从卫星图上看，锡安公园有很多连环之字形的小路，那是让爬山者征服用的，对于我们这些匆匆过客，难免是令人遗憾之诱惑。所幸的是老天爷还赏面，下午天色竟然雪后转睛，并时会阳光灿烂。夕阳无限好，最好是黄昏，拍摄到的奇山怪石景色是美不胜收。但时光不再荏苒，事前查得太阳下山时间是下午五时十分，且气温会骤降，我们还需开车近两小时赶到预订的旅馆，以便明早去观赏下一个国家公园布莱斯峡谷的风光。 在途已是雪花纷飞，路上结冰，小心开车冒雪摸黑前去，到达布莱斯小镇已是晚上8时。旅店是三星级的BEST WESTERN，也是小镇上好的一间，内中有镇上惟一最大的美式自助餐馆，比起周边的寥寂，边这里是灯火明亮。饱餐之后出来，天空仍落着雪，所有的汽车已被皑皑白雪覆盖。选此旅馆是因为靠近布莱斯峡谷，以便明天一早去欣赏比亚利桑那大峡谷更壮丽的景色，那就是由大自然用鬼斧神功凋刻出来的＂西方冰雪兵马俑＂。
367971225204b5878e390b5ab35af7a616a609e4.translatedText: >Zion Nationa lPark Zion Nationa National Park is our first tourist destination in Utah. The drive from Fengfeng City to Xing'an Park is 370 miles and takes 6 hours. From Highway 17 to Flagstaff, take US-89 to page. Page is a small town where the border between Arizona and Utah intersects. It has many famous attractions such as Antelope Canyon, Horseshoe Bend and Lake Powell. Since I have been there before, I filled up my gas and continued on my way. The tour bus entered Utahland along UT-9 W and drove non-stop to Xi'an Park. Print out the map in advance and bring a GPS. Although your mobile phone also has a GPS function, it uses too much data, so it is not recommended. The information collected shows that Utah has been cloudy these three days, with temperatures ranging from 6 to 30 degrees Fahrenheit (subzero when the photo was taken), wind speeds of 7 miles, but humidity of 90%. This means that as long as the temperature is slightly lower, there is a possibility of snowfall in the mountainous areas. Sure enough, when we entered Utah, the sky was clear at first, but when we entered the mountainous area, snowflakes as big as rice grains rushed towards us, flying in thousands and hitting the front glass of the car, making people feel like watching a 3D movie. Came to Zion Park at 3pm. The fees in Xi'an National Park are not based on head count like Antelope Canyon, but are charged at US$30 per car. Entering the park, there are free tour buses to transport tourists to various attractions, but some places need to be reached on foot or by bicycle. From the satellite image, Zion Park has many zigzag paths for climbers to conquer. For those of us who are passing by in a hurry, it is inevitably a regrettable temptation. Fortunately, God is still kind, and the sky turns snowy in the afternoon, and sometimes the sun shines brightly. The sunset is infinitely beautiful, preferably at dusk, and the scenery of strange mountains and rocks captured is breathtakingly beautiful. But time no longer flies by. We checked in advance that the sun sets at 5:10 pm, and the temperature will drop sharply. We still need to drive nearly two hours to get to the hotel we booked, so that we can go see the scenery of Bryce Canyon, the next national park, tomorrow morning. It was already snowing heavily on the way and the road was icy. We drove carefully in the snow and darkness. It was already 8pm when we arrived at Bryce Town. The hotel is a three-star BEST WESTERN, one of the best in the town. It has the only and largest American buffet restaurant in the town. Compared with the loneliness around it, the lights here are bright. When we came out after a full meal, there was still snow falling in the sky, and all the cars were covered in white snow. I chose this hotel because it is close to Bryce Canyon, so that I can enjoy the more magnificent scenery than the Arizona Grand Canyon tomorrow morning, which is the "Western Ice and Snow Terracotta Warriors" carved by nature with miraculous skills.

00be664049027263db19163979f355ed4589dffd.sourceText: 亚利桑那州立大学开设全美首个GIS本科专业
00be664049027263db19163979f355ed4589dffd.translatedText: Arizona State University has launched the first GIS undergraduate major in the United States

99989d3895e03c124b927434c0d8f4ea06c17dc5.sourceText: 亚利桑那州立大学开设全美首个GIS本科专业 面对测绘技术领域逐渐发展成熟，美国亚利桑那州立大学将增设一个前…
99989d3895e03c124b927434c0d8f4ea06c17dc5.translatedText: Arizona State University has launched the first GIS undergraduate major in the United States. Facing the gradual maturation of the field of surveying and mapping technology, Arizona State University will add a front...

8c991d320774c57bb7f020331f3a18bf9d604ef7.sourceText: 面对测绘技术领域逐渐发展成熟，美国亚利桑那州立大学将增设一个前沿的、全新的地理学学位棗地理信息科学(GIS)专业，这个专业将帮助学生们提升求职时的能力。
8c991d320774c57bb7f020331f3a18bf9d604ef7.translatedText: Facing the gradual development of the field of surveying and mapping technology, Arizona State University will add a cutting-edge, brand-new geography degree - Geographic Information Science (GIS) major. This major will help students improve their abilities when applying for jobs.

111584d8a1bd318ab5bc249ca252d01494612da1.sourceText: 该专业希望培养的学生既拥有解决地理学问题的理论知识和空间思维，又具备软件研发的实际技能。换句话说，学习这个专业的学生毕业后将有可能在测绘、导航以及位置服务这些前沿领域的大公司工作。
111584d8a1bd318ab5bc249ca252d01494612da1.translatedText: This major hopes to cultivate students who have not only the theoretical knowledge and spatial thinking to solve geographical problems, but also the practical skills of software development. In other words, students who study this major will likely work in large companies in cutting-edge fields such as surveying, navigation, and location services after graduation.

debc93f89743b5bcc7f474e105a4f8ef8677f791.sourceText: ”这是在美国设置的第一个地理信息科学本科专业，”亚利桑那州立大学地理科学和城市规划学院主任Elizabeth Wentz说。”这个专业需要计算机科学和地理学两个学科的坚实基础，因此，在教学计划中，既要保证他们能够学到理论知识，又要确保他们具备实际操作能力，这样他们才能从零开发一个新的测绘工具软件。”
debc93f89743b5bcc7f474e105a4f8ef8677f791.translatedText: "This is the first undergraduate geographic information science major in the United States," said Elizabeth Wentz, director of ASU's School of Geographic Sciences and Urban Planning. "This major requires a solid foundation in the two disciplines of computer science and geography. Therefore, in the teaching plan, it is necessary to ensure that they can learn theoretical knowledge and have practical operational capabilities, so that they can develop a new surveying and mapping tool software from scratch."

08ad0967bf0b7510e6f960c8ac0aabb25a69b641.sourceText: GIS有两个含义：地理信息系统棗将地图和信息相结合的软件工具；地理信息科学棗研究如何扩展GIS软件的能力。GIS跨越科学、技术、工程和数学(STEM)等多个领域，根据美国劳工统计局的数据预测， GIS专业的需求增长速度是其他行业的两倍。同样，未来十年，80%的工作岗位都需要专业技能，就像GIS专业所具备的一样。
08ad0967bf0b7510e6f960c8ac0aabb25a69b641.translatedText: > GIS has two meanings: Geographic Information System - a software tool that combines maps and information; Geographic Information Science - studies how to expand the capabilities of GIS software. GIS spans many fields such as science, technology, engineering, and mathematics (STEM). According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, the demand for GIS majors is growing at twice the rate of other industries. Similarly, in the next ten years, 80% of jobs will require professional skills, just like those in the GIS major.

b1c1c8e300fae7a74fe36c06dd4345a98959ae22.sourceText: GIS专业毕业的学生将会进入诸如Google，Esri这样的企业，以及GPS导航软件研发企业，并有可能获得较高的薪酬(58,000美元至126,000美元)。此外，从地方到国家的政府部门，也都需要GIS专业培养的人才，因为他们同时拥有计算机科学和地理学的知识背景及技能。
b1c1c8e300fae7a74fe36c06dd4345a98959ae22.translatedText: >Students graduating from GIS majors will enter companies such as Google and Esri, as well as GPS navigation software R&D companies, and may receive higher salaries (US$58,000 to US$126,000). In addition, government departments from local to national levels also need talents trained in GIS majors, because they have the knowledge background and skills of both computer science and geography.

c4b1b7c2132e42beca412e70dad9e8e71b50e5b9.sourceText: ”这个专业很好的结合了计算机科学、地理分析和解决实际问题的方法，”地理学教授Sergio Rey说，他也是GIS专业的老师。”这个专业的教学会给学生带来更新形式的空间思维和计算技巧，从而带给他们教学以外的收获。”
c4b1b7c2132e42beca412e70dad9e8e71b50e5b9.translatedText: "This major is a good combination of computer science, geographical analysis and practical problem-solving methods," said Geography Professor Sergio Rey, who is also a teacher in the GIS major. "Teaching in this major will bring students newer forms of spatial thinking and computing skills, thereby bringing them gains beyond teaching."

aefa9025e793175deb8ce0c8450e07c954397c0a.sourceText: 通过从教学中掌握的技能，学生提出新的方法，并开发出新的测绘、分析和导航软件。例如，学生可能会提出一个寻找犯罪热点的全新方法，也可能会利用这种新方法开发出一个可以分析犯罪行为的全新软件。
aefa9025e793175deb8ce0c8450e07c954397c0a.translatedText: Through the skills acquired from teaching, students propose new methods and develop new mapping, analysis and navigation software. For example, students might come up with a new way to find crime hotspots, or they might use this new method to develop new software that can analyze criminal behavior.

d2548be2d11d8fa3151803bfdf182c6561d8be31.sourceText: 这个专业的毕业生可以在软件开发公司任职，他们可以开发网络或者移动地图应用，或者对现有的高端桌面地图软件进行改善。他们可以针对客户的个性化需求研发定制软件，无论他的对象是研究动物迁徙的环境专家，还是负责本地商业活动的协会，或者是需要对军事侦察工具做出改善的客户。
d2548be2d11d8fa3151803bfdf182c6561d8be31.translatedText: Graduates of this major can work in software development companies. They can develop web or mobile map applications, or improve existing high-end desktop map software. They can develop custom software tailored to the individual needs of their clients, whether they are environmental experts studying animal migration, associations responsible for local business activities, or clients who need improvements to military reconnaissance tools.

448765a2c5b9e4b777273b69c2cfccf2eca0bd10.sourceText: ”美国的很多学校都是教学生如何使用专业的地理信息系统软件，但亚利桑那州立大学是少数几个让学生学习如何开发GIS软件的学校之一。”Wentz解释说。”同时，我们学校有一些很著名的空间科学家，他们也在很大程度上参与了GIS教学计划。”
448765a2c5b9e4b777273b69c2cfccf2eca0bd10.translatedText: "Many schools in the United States teach students how to use professional geographic information system software, but Arizona State University is one of the few schools that allows students to learn how to develop GIS software." Wentz explained. "At the same time, our school has some well-known space scientists, and they are also involved in the GIS teaching program to a large extent."

c2ec3850bb0878c13645505e76e9ff88db411791.sourceText: ”亚利桑那州立大学提供给你多种机会棗在这里，只要是你梦想的你就可以去做。”其中一位第一批就报名了的学生Nathaniel Gaytan这样评价地理信息科学专业。
c2ec3850bb0878c13645505e76e9ff88db411791.translatedText: "Arizona State University provides you with a variety of opportunities here. As long as it is your dream, you can do it." Nathaniel Gaytan, one of the first batch of students to register, commented on the geographic information science major.

a94c9320ec74423272b66387a13835e0a0ac975b.sourceText: GIS专业将设置在地理科学与城市规划学院，根据《高等教育年鉴》，该学院在全美地理学排名中位列第七。
a94c9320ec74423272b66387a13835e0a0ac975b.translatedText: >The GIS major will be set up in the College of Geographical Sciences and Urban Planning. According to the "Almanac of Higher Education", the college ranks seventh in the geography rankings in the United States.

a84caf293c50537a0f7944f5e434a7e7a93d776c.sourceText: 这个新专业的学生将有机会和学校40多名老师一起工作，无论是数据挖掘还是人文领域，这些老师都具备专业的知识，并在地理学和城市规划领域进行相关的研究和教学。
a84caf293c50537a0f7944f5e434a7e7a93d776c.translatedText: Students in this new major will have the opportunity to work with more than 40 teachers in the school. Whether it is data mining or humanities, these teachers have professional knowledge and conduct relevant research and teaching in the fields of geography and urban planning.

e386e85325bd0b20e4aa0f440e08b7653cc140ab.sourceText: 亚利桑那州立大学的教授有三位是美国科学院院士，一位是美国国家科学基金会青年科学家奖获奖者，两位古根海姆学者及国家研究委员会地理科学委员会成员。他们在GIS算法及软件开发的突出工作得到了国际上的认可，例如开源软件GeoDA和PySAL。
e386e85325bd0b20e4aa0f440e08b7653cc140ab.translatedText: Three professors at Arizona State University are members of the National Academy of Sciences, one is a winner of the National Science Foundation's Young Scientist Award, two Guggenheim Fellows and members of the National Research Council's Board of Geographic Sciences. Their outstanding work in GIS algorithm and software development has been internationally recognized, such as the open source software GeoDA and PySAL.
