df36cb1e12f5e53d820436f2b3625d077095a1ac.translatedText: Zhang Zhaohong: Utah Travel Guide (3) Phoenix Zhang Zhaohong After leaving Bryce Canyon, we drove to Utah’s most famous scenic spot –…

463cc23f3f1d2a614d179002d1cd5695693e2b87.sourceText: 离开布莱斯峡谷，我们驾车前往犹他最蓍名的景区–拱门国家公园（Arches National Park）。众所周知，无论在犹他州的汽车车牌、邮票、杂志或者明信片上，都有＂精致拱门＂（Delicate Arch）的图桉，此地的岩石拱门享誉世界。我们沿着70号国道和191号公路行驶了270英哩，这是一条风光旖旎的道路，十分赏心悦目，一路行程让人惊喜不断。3个半小时后，我们到达了目的地。 拱门国家公园有着天然岩石拱门超过2000座。在亿万年前，这里是汪洋一片，海底盐床和碎片被挤压形成岩石。之后地壳隆起变为陆地，下方的盐岩不敌上方的岩石压力而破碎，在不断风化后塌陷，逐渐成为今天的拱门。比起布莱斯的风化岩柱，这里风光别具一格，无数未形成的、已形成的拱桥比比皆是，成为世界上最大的自然沙岩拱门集中地之一。拱门最小的只有3呎宽，最大的则长达306呎。这些拱门分布在公园内来回数十哩的山路上，旅行者徒步行走累计也有几十哩，即使只观赏主要拱门的也得好几天，无法在一次行程中看完。 拱门国家公园有世界着名的拱门。如最长的景观拱门（Landscape Arch），它位于北部一个称作魔鬼的花园的地方，但今次未够时间去观赏，据闻它有些部位己很窄，还能存在多久是个疑问。我们在夕阳下观看到典型的单孔拱门、双孔拱门（North Window and South Window）、以及一大连一小的炮塔拱门（Turret Arch）这都是十分着名的拱门。我们继续向精緻拱门进发。砂岩所组成的拱门被风雨侵蚀下会倒塌，但精緻拱门却承受长期的风蚀而没有倒下，所以闻名天下。我们来到山下，地标上注明需行走5公里，而且山势抖斜，山路崎岖，要靠先行者用石头堆起的标记行走才能到达，来回需三小时。天将黑，我们只能远望，却无缘去到山顶。要欣赏精緻拱门的姿彩，最好在黎明前上山，待红日昇起那一刻，千万道霞光把它染成橙红才是最理想的。但这次是探访之旅，希望以后在夏天再来观赏它的风采。拱门公园是个神幻魔地，除了拱门，还有为数众多的奇山怪石，平衡石等独特的景观，所有的石头上有着颜色对比非常强烈的纹理。拱门公园没有旅游车，我们自驾游常把车泊在路边，然走向各景区，也拍到不少精美风景相片，有一张远景，其中有多 个怪石人头像，十分惊人！
463cc23f3f1d2a614d179002d1cd5695693e2b87.translatedText: Leaving Bryce Canyon, we drove to Utah’s most famous scenic spot – Arches National Park. As we all know, Utah's car license plates, stamps, magazines or postcards all have images of "Delicate Arch". The rock arches here are world-renowned. We drove 270 miles along National Highway 70 and Highway 191. This is a beautiful road, very pleasing to the eye, and the journey is full of surprises. After 3 and a half hours, we arrived at our destination. Arches National Park has more than 2,000 natural rock arches. Hundreds of millions of years ago, there was a vast ocean, and the seafloor salt beds and debris were squeezed to form rocks. Later, the earth's crust rose up and turned into land. The salt rock below was unable to withstand the pressure of the rock above and broke. After continuous weathering, it collapsed and gradually became the arch today. Compared with the weathered rock pillars of Bryce, the scenery here is unique. Countless unformed and formed arch bridges abound, making it one of the largest concentrations of natural sandstone arches in the world. The smallest arch is only 3 feet wide, and the largest is 306 feet long. These arches are distributed on dozens of miles of mountain roads in the park. Travelers have walked dozens of miles in total. Even if you only see the main arches, it will take several days and you cannot see them all in one trip. Arches National Park is home to the world-famous Arches. For example, the longest Landscape Arch is located in a place called the Devil's Garden in the north. However, we did not have enough time to visit it this time. It is said that some parts of it are very narrow, and it is doubtful how long it will last. We watched the typical single-hole arch, double-hole arch (North Window and South Window), and a large and small turret arch (Turret Arch) under the sunset. These are very famous arches. We continued towards Delicate Arch. Arches made of sandstone will collapse due to wind and rain erosion, but the exquisite arches have withstood long-term wind erosion without falling, so they are famous all over the world. We came to the foot of the mountain. The landmark indicated that we needed to walk 5 kilometers. The mountain was sloping and the mountain road was rugged. We had to rely on the markers piled up by pioneers to reach it. It took three hours to go back and forth. It was getting dark, and we could only look far away, but we had no chance to go to the top of the mountain. To appreciate the beauty of the exquisite arch, it is best to go up the mountain before dawn. The ideal moment is when the red sun rises and thousands of rays of light dye it orange-red. But this is a visit trip, and I hope to come back to see it in the summer. Arch Park is a magical place. In addition to the arches, there are also numerous unique landscapes such as strange mountains and rocks, and balanced stones. All the stones have textures with very strong color contrasts. There are no tourist buses in Arches Park. When we travel by car, we often park the car on the side of the road and walk to various scenic spots. We also take many beautiful scenery photos. There is a distant view with several strange stone figures in it, which is very amazing!

6882109c0a1dbdb83c3357e665b955d13ef3fc7d.sourceText: 直到天黑，我们才离开拱门公园，驾车到达附近一个名为摩押 (Moab) 的小镇。因每年旅游拱门公园人数近百万，所以这个小镇己颇具规模，有不少星级旅店和餐馆。我们在一间名为＂四川榕＂的中国餐馆进餐后，就去到预定的旅馆。这一间星级旅馆十分新净，环境清幽，室外有游泳池，中央设有热水吧，大冷夜居然还有美国孩童在嬉水，旁边则有个大大的火盘，有旅客烤火，真是冰火两重天。在网上选择这间旅馆，是因为好评如潮，早点精美丰富，我们这两天下来也已疲倦，需好好休息，明天还要去一个世界闻名的胜地。
6882109c0a1dbdb83c3357e665b955d13ef3fc7d.translatedText: We didn’t leave Arches Park until dark and drove to a nearby town called Moab. Since nearly one million people visit Arches Park every year, the town has become quite large, with many star-rated hotels and restaurants. After eating at a Chinese restaurant called "Sichuan Banyan", we went to the hotel we booked. This star-rated hotel is very new and clean, with a quiet environment. There is an outdoor swimming pool and a hot water bar in the center. On a cold night, there are American children playing in the water. There is a large fire plate next to it, and tourists are warming up. It is really a world of ice and fire. We chose this hotel online because of the rave reviews. The breakfast was exquisite and rich. We were tired after the past two days and needed a good rest. We have to go to a world-famous resort tomorrow.

7d738b6b578de4e1b427cd17502eb07b69c32c75.sourceText: 布莱斯国家公园前的小镇，星级旅店不多，价格差异也大，网上找到这间WESTERN ，订房时方知其总部设在泰国曼谷，价格比其它同名旅馆优惠很多，但也有注意的事项，这3星旅店预订的房间三天之内就不能退，而其它旅店前一天仍可取消。另外，此地旅馆大都不含早餐，所以要看清细则。 订房时最好用运通卡(America Express)，尤其是在境外消费，总部会即时来电邮核实，以减少诈骗。还要注意是天气预报，那怕是美国如此发达的国家，在乍暖还寒的天时也经常出错。 如这次出游前查得这三天都是多云，结果是大雪又大晴。查得资料，此地降雪量11月份为22吋，12月是55吋，来年2月更高达76吋。所以提醒各位，出发前最好去电所订房的旅店，查询当地实际天气状况。 因下雪时大都能见度差，来回上千英里的旅途，总不能去了一遭什麽也见不到，回来后就说一句”北国风光，千里冰封，万里雪飘”? 第二天早晨，旅店外已是一片银装素裹，车顶多有积雪，车窗门结冰。根据过往经验，入住前已把汽车雨拨拉离前方玻璃窗，以防被冰雪冻结在一起。早上拧来了几桶冷水泼向车身，这是除去冰雪最快之方法。还需预早打开车中的暖气，让机件和车内预热。 早上9时多，我们便开车前往布莱斯峡谷国家公园。进园后方知，除了被称之为天下奇观的”布莱斯露天剧场”开放外，其它园内路线已因冰雪关闭。但大雪之后大晴，让我们这次旅游不虚此行。 布莱斯峡谷国家公园虽然有”峡谷”一词，但其并非真正的峡谷，而是在高原中，由风、河水与冰侵蚀和湖床的沉积而形成的奇特景观，被誉为天然的石俑殿堂和巨大的自然露天剧场，其独特的地理结构称为岩柱（hoodoos）。发现此峡谷的是派尤特人，这些土着以打猎与採集野果为生。在传说中，峡谷内的岩柱是由非常狡猾的郊狼变身而成，在这险恶之地，会让牛隻经常无故失踪。1875年，摩门教信徒埃本尼泽 布莱斯（Ebenezer Bryce）移居此地，并把这一带命名为”布莱斯峡谷”。 布莱斯峡谷比邻近的锡安公园与大峡谷公园处于更高海拔。拥有十分不同的自然生态与气候，使我们感到巨大差异。经千万年流水侵蚀和泥石流的研磨后，所有的岩石都显得千奇百怪，渗透着一种诡异的气氛。而日积月累形成的沉积岩，因金属元素含量不同，展示出不同颜色的瑰丽景致，其岩柱色彩缤纷奇幻夺目。有些独特的岩柱可高达二百英尺，彷佛是直入云霄的天柱，有的像各式各样童话中的人物和动物，还有巧夺天工的石穴、拱桥，以及巨大的天然露天剧场。 今天来到布莱斯峡谷国家公园，远望那石柱群的雄伟气势令人屏息，这是一处具有另类风情的大自然之艺术 极品，第一眼就极具震撼力。在我眼中，这些石柱就如万千将士在雪山冰原上屹立，阵容强大，错落有致。在朝阳照跃之下，棕红色的士兵显得精神焕发，在蓝天绿林相衬之下又是那么风采自然。还有千军万马分佈在高山雪原的各阵地和战壕之中，构成一道道从山顶到深谷的防线！而在后方，亦有一批批后备军人戍装待发！这些漫山遍野的军队，其阵容比西安的秦俑兵马更为强大和壮观！ 峡谷中有抖削的＂城墙＂，而在城墙之后，又有看似鳞次栉比的＂高楼与宫殿＂，这些楼房在阳光背影之下呈红褐色，平添雪地画面的层次与色彩。另外，雪地中真的见到了＂战马出征＂的神气形象，尤其最前的兵士，一人架御四马，这也全仗白雪对红岩的点缀，让?#20912;雪兵马俑?#26174;得更加活龙活现，呼之欲出！还拍到一个特写的镜头，并命名为＂送别＂：相片左下方有爷孙四人，另一妇人抱着怀中孩子，还有众乡亲为出征士兵送别，右方有将军打扮者望向经过的士兵，像在嘱附些什么，而这位士兵早已穿上了白色的甲冑，告别亲朋后走向战场。这是我拍到最应景和最饶有趣味的照片，配合场景说明，在浏览网上布莱斯峡谷公园大相薄后，也真还没有如此维妙维俏写照！又有一照片，是一帮童话般的小矮人，被白雪描绘上各种耳眼口鼻，十分臭美，如不是雪后来到，还真看不到这些石之精灵的化妆舞会呢！ 故事说完了，回到现实。 世界各地有不少旅行者无畏天地严寒, 冰雪路滑，不远万里来到布莱斯峡谷国家公园观光。又或者身旁这位未看过兵马俑的少年，眼中的布又将是什么样的境界呢？离别之际，就让我们和布莱斯峡谷留个影，提前过一个白色圣诞吧！
7d738b6b578de4e1b427cd17502eb07b69c32c75.translatedText: In the small town in front of Bryce National Park, there are not many star-rated hotels, and the prices vary greatly. I found this WESTERN online, and when I made the reservation, I found out that it is headquartered in Bangkok, Thailand. The price is much cheaper than other hotels with the same name. However, there are also things to note. Rooms booked in this 3-star hotel cannot be returned within three days, while other hotels can still cancel the day before. In addition, most hotels here do not include breakfast, so pay attention to the fine print. It is best to use an America Express card when making a reservation, especially when purchasing overseas. The headquarters will send you an email to verify immediately to reduce fraud. Also note that weather forecasts, even for a country as developed as the United States, often make mistakes when the weather turns from warm to cold. For example, before this trip, I checked that it would be cloudy for three days, but it turned out to be heavy snow and sunny. According to the information, the snowfall here was 22 inches in November, 55 inches in December, and as high as 76 inches in February of the following year. Therefore, I would like to remind everyone that before departure, it is best to call the hotel where you booked to check the actual local weather conditions. Because visibility is often poor when it snows, you can't go on a journey of thousands of miles and not see anything. When you come back, you can say "the scenery of the North, thousands of miles of ice, thousands of miles of snow"? The next morning, the outside of the hotel was covered with snow, there was snow on the roof of the car, and the windows and doors were frozen. Based on past experience, the car wipers have been pulled away from the front glass window before moving in to prevent them from being frozen together by ice and snow. In the morning, I wring several buckets of cold water and pour them on the car body. This is the fastest way to remove ice and snow. It is also necessary to turn on the heating in the car in advance to allow the mechanical parts and the interior of the car to warm up. At around 9 a.m., we drove to Bryce Canyon National Park. After entering the park, I learned that except for the "Bryce Amphitheater", which is known as the wonder of the world, it was open, and other routes in the park had been closed due to ice and snow. But it was sunny after the heavy snow, making our trip worthwhile. Although Bryce Canyon National Park has the word "canyon", it is not a real canyon, but a unique landscape on the plateau formed by wind, river and ice erosion and lake bed sedimentation. It is known as a natural stone temple and a huge natural amphitheatre. Its unique geographical structure is called a hoodoos. The canyon was discovered by the Paiute people, who lived by hunting and gathering wild fruits. According to legend, the rock pillars in the canyon were transformed from very cunning coyotes. In this dangerous place, cattle often disappear for no reason. In 1875, Mormon believer Ebenezer Bryce immigrated here and named this area "Bryce Canyon." Bryce Canyon is located at a higher elevation than neighboring Zion and Grand Canyon parks. Having very different natural ecologies and climates makes us feel huge differences. After millions of years of erosion by water and grinding by mudslides, all the rocks look strange and permeate with a strange atmosphere. The sedimentary rocks formed over time show magnificent scenery of different colors due to different metal element contents. The rock pillars are colorful and dazzling. Some unique rock pillars can be as high as 200 feet, as if they are pillars reaching into the sky; some are like characters and animals in various fairy tales; there are also ingenious stone caves, arch bridges, and huge natural amphitheatres. Today we came to Bryce Canyon National Park, and the majesty of the stone pillars from a distance was breathtaking. This is a piece of nature's art with an alternative style, and it is very shocking at first sight. In my eyes, these stone pillars are like thousands of soldiers standing on the snow-capped mountains and ice fields, with a strong and well-proportioned lineup. Under the rising sun, the brown-red soldiers looked energetic, and they looked so elegant and natural against the blue sky and green forests. There are thousands of troops and horses distributed in various positions and trenches in the alpine snowfields, forming lines of defense from the top of the mountain to the deep valleys! And in the rear, there are also batches of reserve soldiers ready to go! The lineup of these armies all over the mountains and plains is more powerful and spectacular than the Qin Terracotta Army in Xi'an! There is a shaky "city wall" in the canyon, and behind the city wall, there are seemingly rows of "high-rise buildings and palaces". These buildings are reddish-brown under the shadow of the sun, adding to the layers and colors of the snowy scene. In addition, we really saw the majestic image of "horses going out to battle" in the snow, especially the soldiers at the front, one man holding four horses. This is all due to the white snow embellishment of the red rocks, making the Snow Terracotta Warriors and Horses more vivid and ready to be seen! A close-up shot was also taken and named "Farewell": in the lower left of the photo, there are four grandfathers and grandsons, another woman holding a child in her arms, and villagers bidding farewell to the soldiers on the expedition. On the right, there is a man dressed as a general looking at the passing soldiers as if to give instructions, and this soldier has already put on white armor, bid farewell to his relatives and friends, and walks to the battlefield. This is the most appropriate and interesting photo I have ever taken. With the description of the scene, after browsing the Bryce Canyon Park photos on the Internet, I have never seen such a lifelike portrayal! There is another photo of a group of fairy-tale dwarfs, painted with various ears, eyes, mouths and noses by Bai Xue. They are very beautiful. If it hadn’t been for the arrival of Snow Queen, I really wouldn’t have been able to see the masquerade of these stone elves! The story is over, back to reality. Many travelers from all over the world are not afraid of the severe cold and slippery ice and snow, and travel thousands of miles to visit Bryce Canyon National Park. Or what kind of state will the cloth look like in the eyes of the young man next to him who has never seen the Terracotta Warriors and Horses? When we say goodbye, let’s take a photo with Bryce Canyon and have a white Christmas in advance!

536eb04622b9eef410a0718ac802a3ff4855925d.sourceText: (亚省中餐馆会通讯) 11月15日亚省中餐馆协会召开年度会议，总结本年度成绩与经验，指出问题及解决方桉，提出2016年度任务和活动内容。 主席张华芳主持会议，董事局成员积极发言，并围绕在新的一年中，如何更好地为会员服务，提出了各种建议和意见。明年是中国餐馆登陆美国150周年纪念，全美中餐馆将有重大纪念活动。 作为美国西南最大的中餐组织，亚省中餐馆协会将联同官方主流和亚省侨界共同筹办一系列庆祝活动。 会议还就百事可乐优惠计划，美国银行信用卡优惠计划，联合购货计划，青年会员文体活动计划，中、英文网络及2016年春宴等议题进行了讨论，邓朝驹董事进行了董事任务分配及任务落实进程的时间表。
536eb04622b9eef410a0718ac802a3ff4855925d.translatedText: (Alberta Chinese Restaurant Association Newsletter) On November 15th, the Alberta Chinese Restaurant Association held its annual meeting to summarize the achievements and experiences of the year, point out problems and solutions, and propose tasks and activities for 2016. Chairman Zhang Huafang presided over the meeting. Board members spoke actively and put forward various suggestions and opinions on how to better serve members in the new year. Next year marks the 150th anniversary of the arrival of Chinese restaurants in the United States, and there will be major commemorative events in Chinese restaurants across the United States. As the largest Chinese restaurant organization in the southwest of the United States, the Alberta Chinese Restaurant Association will work with the official mainstream and the overseas Chinese community in Alberta to jointly organize a series of celebration activities. The meeting also discussed topics such as the Pepsi Cola discount plan, the Bank of America credit card discount plan, the joint shopping plan, the youth member cultural and sports activity plan, the Chinese and English network and the 2016 Spring Banquet. Director Deng Chaoju made a timetable for the director's task allocation and task implementation process.

7af6cce633f9d621a1568f1e955264e91c8aa8bc.sourceText: 大凤凰城台美商会在岁末年终之际,于十一月二十六日感恩节当日举行感恩餐会，会长张晴玲感谢所有理事会员一年来的支持与辛劳，也特别感谢黄玉莲理事开放家裡让大家一起度过温馨愉快的感恩佳节。
7af6cce633f9d621a1568f1e955264e91c8aa8bc.translatedText: The Taiwan-American Chamber of Commerce in Greater Phoenix City held a thanksgiving dinner on November 26, Thanksgiving Day, at the end of the year. President Zhang Qingling thanked all the board members for their support and hard work over the past year, and especially thanked Director Huang Yulian for opening her home for everyone to spend a warm and happy Thanksgiving holiday.

d9c8d72c8f5eaf46729134aded3f19c37835f87a.sourceText: 会长张晴玲在餐会中提议，响应北美洲世台基金会寒冬送暖衣给敍利亜儿童难民的活动，理事会员们一致同意并捐赠美金一千元共襄盛举，把爱心温暖送给需要帮助的小朋友，更让此次感恩节餐会意义非凡。餐会由主人黄玉莲提供丰盛传统美式火鷄蜜汁火腿，各式甜品佳餚，会员准备美味台式料理，和会长张晴玲提供珍藏红酒无限畅饮，宾主尽欢。
d9c8d72c8f5eaf46729134aded3f19c37835f87a.translatedText: President Zhang Qingling proposed during the dinner that in response to the North American World Taiwan Foundation's activity of sending warm clothes to Syrian child refugees in the cold winter, the board members unanimously agreed and donated US$1,000 to participate in the event, sending love and warmth to children in need, which made this Thanksgiving dinner of special significance. The host, Huang Yulian, provided a sumptuous traditional American turkey and honey-glazed ham, as well as various desserts and delicacies. Members prepared delicious Taiwanese dishes, and the president, Zhang Qingling, provided unlimited drinking of red wine. The guests and guests enjoyed the banquet.

b6a33c8e60224ad9ec7b7327cb7a84b9ceaea451.sourceText: 大凤凰城台美商会今年在会长张晴玲带领下，六月去北欧进行商务考察，并体验当地风土民情，八月和美国联邦国会议员Matt Salmon, 钱德勒市政府共同举办支持台湾加入跨太平洋战略经济伙伴关係协议（TPP)座谈会暨台湾优良产品展，九月支持钱德勒少棒队去台南参赛，拜会台南市长赖清德，进行一系列经贸体育交流，并协助会员回台採购开店器材设备，出席九九重阳敬老庆双十及参加世总台商总㑹年会，十一月协助洛杉矶经文处举办行动领务，服务台侨等多项活动。
b6a33c8e60224ad9ec7b7327cb7a84b9ceaea451.translatedText: This year, the Taiwan-American Chamber of Commerce in Greater Phoenix, led by President Zhang Qingling, went to Northern Europe for a business inspection in June and experienced the local customs and customs. In August, they met with U.S. Congressman Matt Salmon, The Chandler City Government co-organized a symposium to support Taiwan's entry into the Trans-Pacific Partnership Agreement (TPP) and an exhibition of Taiwan's quality products. In September, it supported the Chandler Little League team to compete in Tainan, visited Tainan Mayor Lai Qingde, conducted a series of economic, trade and sports exchanges, and assisted members to return to Taiwan to purchase equipment for opening stores. It attended the Double Tenth Double Ninth Festival and participated in the annual meeting of the World Federation of Taiwanese Businessmen. In November, it assisted the Los Angeles Cultural Affairs Office in organizing many activities to serve Taiwanese overseas Chinese.

ce2420b1885bc5dc1e6b0142f77e9ba300ca63e7.sourceText: 今天我们如何在美国做父母 与廖冰博士面对面 我们在一个急速变化的时代从中国移民到美国。曾经在中国为人子女的我们，如今在美国为人父母。然而，异国他乡，斗转星移，我们自己所曾经历的亲子关系，不再会自然地在我们和自己的孩子之间重现，而孩子们面临的，是我们所陌生的成长环境。我们必须摸索、学习、思考、甚至练习怎样做孩子们心中的好父母。 亚利桑那州的希望中文学校学生会及校委会，现代中文学校，祖筍中文学校将在12月5日、6日举办三场”今天在美国我们如何做父母”的交谈会。请到的嘉宾是廖冰博士。 廖冰博士1984年毕业于北京大学，后来在休斯顿大学获得PHD，在Rutgers大学获得MBA，是美银美林大数据分析和模拟高级研究员。她曾担任The Lawrenceville School 私立高中数学教师，有浓烈的教育情怀。创建英华语言学校、英华国际学校、”英华在北京”语言与领导能力暑期学院、英华普林斯顿语言与领导能力暑期学院等非营利教育机构；担任新泽西州父母子女教育俱乐部总顾问十二年，并作过亲子关系等各种主题的讲座、家教论坛和交谈会百十余场，受到家长热烈欢迎，得到了如潮的好评。 2002年北京的新闻媒体以”与美国华裔母亲面对面”为题采访过廖冰博士。她认为”我们这代人不应因为母亲曾经为我们如何地付出，我们就要为自己的子女如何付出。母亲的利益和子女的利益，两者都重要，但是，两者又不能同时全要，我的挑战来自分水岭的划分。新时代要求我们的知识要不断更新，我喜欢接受新东西，喜欢探索，因为教育子女的方式，绝不再是”我们曾经如何如何过厖”’ 除了喂养孩子，给他们保障物质需要以外，我们该怎样倾听孩子内心的需要，以便给他们及时而有力的支持？怎样能够和孩子互相敞开心怀，互相陪伴着越过成长过程中的一个个关卡？怎样能做到既是孩子尊重的家长，又是他们信赖的好朋友？面对各种涌动起伏的潮流与暗流，我们怎样和孩子一起保持清醒的头脑，坚定自己的立场？廖冰博士善于总结和探索，用自己十多年养育一双智商与情商同步发展的儿女的经历和在教育问题上常年探索的收获，创造出了自己的教育理念和方法。在交谈会上，她将以专家和母亲的双重身份与大家一起讨论如何建立现代的亲子关系，培养心智健康的孩子。 **交谈会免费。请大家自愿捐助，奉献爱心。**
ce2420b1885bc5dc1e6b0142f77e9ba300ca63e7.translatedText: How We Are Parenting in America Today Meet Dr. Bing Liao We immigrated to the United States from China in an era of rapid change. We were once children in China and now we are parents in the United States. However, in a foreign country, time has passed, and the parent-child relationship we ourselves have experienced will no longer naturally reappear between us and our children, and the children face a growing environment that is unfamiliar to us. We must explore, learn, think, and even practice how to be good parents to our children. The Student Union and School Committee of Hope Chinese School, Modern Chinese School, and Zusun Chinese School in Arizona will hold three talks on "How We Become Parents in the United States Today" on December 5th and 6th. The invited guest is Dr. Liao Bing. Dr. Liao Bing graduated from Peking University in 1984, and later obtained a PHD from the University of Houston and an MBA from Rutgers University. He is a senior researcher in big data analysis and simulation at Bank of America Merrill Lynch. She once served as a mathematics teacher at The Lawrenceville School, a private high school, and has a strong passion for education. He founded non-profit educational institutions such as Anglo-Chinese Language School, Anglo-Chinese International School, "English-Chinese in Beijing" Language and Leadership Summer Institute, and Anglo-Chinese Princeton Language and Leadership Summer Institute. He has served as the general consultant of the New Jersey Parent-Child Education Club for twelve years and has given more than 100 lectures, tutoring forums and talks on various topics such as parent-child relationships. He has been warmly welcomed by parents and received rave reviews. In 2002, Beijing news media interviewed Dr. Liao Bing under the title "Face to Face with Chinese American Mothers." She believes that "our generation should not have to pay for our children just because our mothers have done for us. The interests of the mother and the interests of the children are both important, but they cannot be both at the same time. My challenge comes from the division of watersheds. The new era requires our knowledge to be constantly updated. I like to accept new things and explore, because the way to educate children is no longer "how we lived in the past."' In addition to feeding our children and providing them with material needs, how can we listen to their children’s inner needs in order to provide them with timely and powerful support? How can we open our hearts to each other and accompany each other through every hurdle in their growth? How can we be a parent that our children respect and a good friend that they trust in the face of various ups and downs? Keep a clear mind and stand firm? Dr. Liao Bing is good at summarizing and exploring. She has used her experience of raising a pair of children with simultaneous development of IQ and EQ for more than ten years and the harvest of years of exploration on educational issues to create her own educational concepts and methods. In her dual role as an expert and mother, she will discuss with everyone how to establish a modern parent-child relationship and cultivate mentally healthy children. **The conversation is free. Please make a voluntary donation and show your love. **

949dbe70e3acc8b8dbc93487665cacc3c16751c2.translatedText: On October 28, the Arizona Chinese Chamber of Commerce and Arizona State University's Carey School of Business jointly held a discussion on what it means to do business in China during China's economic downturn.

a2f56943617fcd4de2c30503f7c86b0a9c85ca23.sourceText: 中华商会会长 伍兆文讲话
a2f56943617fcd4de2c30503f7c86b0a9c85ca23.translatedText: > Chairman of the Chinese Chamber of Commerce Wu Zhaowen delivered a speech

5285963e3dff452c77542a4bb8f9c6e8f5ec7e9c.sourceText: 晚上６时，座谈会正式开始。近百位来自ASU凯瑞商学院，以及中华商会的朋友参与座谈。中华商会会长伍兆文律师介绍了中华商会的历史，中华商会是亚利桑那最早的华人商会，近８０年历史。关注中美商业交流，每年都与与凯瑞商学院合作举办商业座谈。本次活动由亚利桑那全球倡议总监William Brashears博士主持。本次主讲三位嘉宾分别是亚利桑那州立大学政治科学系主任Sheldon Simon教授，多年在华经商的DS 国际集团创始人George Tsai。以及在美国学习工作，由前往中国工作的Angela Zhao。
5285963e3dff452c77542a4bb8f9c6e8f5ec7e9c.translatedText: At 6 p.m., the symposium officially started. Nearly a hundred friends from ASU Carey Business School and the Chinese Chamber of Commerce participated in the discussion. Lawyer Wu Zhaowen, president of the Chinese Chamber of Commerce, introduced the history of the Chinese Chamber of Commerce. The Chinese Chamber of Commerce is the earliest Chinese chamber of commerce in Arizona with a history of nearly 80 years. Paying attention to Sino-US business exchanges, we hold business seminars in cooperation with Carey Business School every year. The event was moderated by Dr. William Brashears, Director of Arizona Global Initiatives. The three speakers this time are Professor Sheldon Simon, Director of the Department of Political Science at Arizona State University, and George Tsai, the founder of DS International Group who has been doing business in China for many years. and Angela Zhao, who studied and worked in the United States and went to work in China.

956abe69cb2f90493a7132bbbac568f8bb235028.sourceText: 亚利桑那州立大学Sheldon Simon教授是做亚洲政治研究的。他建议中国搞好与自己周边邻国关系很重要，这样能保证经济政治的稳定发展。
956abe69cb2f90493a7132bbbac568f8bb235028.translatedText: Professor Sheldon Simon of Arizona State University does research on Asian politics. He suggested that it is important for China to maintain good relations with its neighboring countries so as to ensure stable economic and political development.

75312a12f155bffc125d3c9ceb3942d86aa027e5.sourceText: 有多年在中国开办工厂的George Tsai介绍，最近几年中国很多公司倒闭，劳动力紧缺成为最大的问题。大量的生产性企业转移到了中国之外。并对海外留学生提了建议，如果想回国发展，不要把薪水和待遇跟美国比，这样会落差很大，最重要的是你选择到的职位能够学到什么。
75312a12f155bffc125d3c9ceb3942d86aa027e5.translatedText: George Tsai, who has run factories in China for many years, said that many companies in China have closed down in recent years, and the labor shortage has become the biggest problem. A large number of productive enterprises have moved outside China. He also gave some suggestions to overseas students. If they want to return to China for development, don’t compare their salary and benefits with those in the United States. There will be a big gap. The most important thing is what you can learn from the position you choose.

ebc3bbae62529d7ac5faffa3be8d3b9aa0e45fb9.sourceText: 在美国上学工作，后来又回到中国工作的Angela Zhao讲述了很多自己刚回到中国工作的小故事。他曾经在阿里巴巴工作，现在从事海外教育。从孩子教育方面，她表示在中国看到了更多的机会。因为中国人对孩子的教育都非常重视，未来在中国推广网络教育，让更多经济不发达地区的孩子，看到外面的世界，接触外面的信息最为重要。
ebc3bbae62529d7ac5faffa3be8d3b9aa0e45fb9.translatedText: Angela Zhao, who studied and worked in the United States and later returned to China to work, told many short stories about her first return to work in China. He used to work at Alibaba and is now engaged in overseas education. In terms of children's education, she said she sees more opportunities in China. Because Chinese people attach great importance to their children's education, it is most important to promote online education in China in the future to allow more children in underdeveloped areas to see the outside world and be exposed to outside information.

e42b1488f909e34e93ccbcc609d790e024b5b90b.sourceText: 讲座在在场嘉宾提出的问题中结束，现场气氛相当热烈。下次商会活动将会更加精彩，将为更多当地企业主提供交流的平台。
e42b1488f909e34e93ccbcc609d790e024b5b90b.translatedText: The lecture ended with questions raised by the guests present, and the atmosphere was quite warm. The next chamber of commerce event will be more exciting and will provide a platform for more local business owners to communicate.

916309267645e7228c1a82b63db30b6283d81f9e.translatedText: A grandfather in Arizona threw his 5-year-old granddaughter into the desert and "shoot when he sees bad guys."

1ee7c818a9fee8f3db53f2b37cf8a1cad425f82d.sourceText: 美国亚利桑那州53位男子瑞特（Paul Armand Rater），在当地时间1日晚间带着5岁孙女外出开车兜风，因为车辆受困，最后竟然将孙女独留沙漠中，还给她一把枪，告知「看到坏人就开枪！」自己被发现时则在餐厅内吃汉堡喝饮料，最后被逮捕送往监狱。
1ee7c818a9fee8f3db53f2b37cf8a1cad425f82d.translatedText: Paul Armand, a 53-year-old man from Arizona, USA Rater, took his 5-year-old granddaughter out for a drive on the evening of the 1st local time. Because the car was stuck, he finally left his granddaughter alone in the desert and gave her a gun, telling her to "shoot the bad guys when you see them!" When he was found, he was eating hamburgers and drinking drinks in a restaurant.

601c8fdbcb3e37fc718c09210ee54a18ddf79be0.sourceText: 根据多家外电报导，这起离谱的祖父丢包孙女事件，发生在当地时间11月1日的晚间，住在凤凰城西方约48公里处巴克艾（Buckeye）小镇的瑞特，开着小货车载5岁孙女外出，4小时候家人无法联繫上，于是向警方通报失踪，大批人力前往搜寻，还出动直升机帮忙。
601c8fdbcb3e37fc718c09210ee54a18ddf79be0.translatedText: According to multiple foreign reports, this outrageous incident of a grandfather throwing his granddaughter away. , happened on the evening of November 1, local time, when Rhett, who lives in the small town of Buckeye, about 48 kilometers west of Phoenix, drove his 5-year-old granddaughter out in a minivan. For four hours, her family could not contact her, so they reported her missing to the police. A large number of people went to search, and a helicopter was dispatched to help.

a175a5d0e9ef2ae212a76e9e3de2696792372fd1.sourceText: 最后女童母亲与一名下班来帮忙的警员，在荒野中发现女童，身上还携带一把手枪。细问下，才发现因为车辆在沙漠中抛锚，祖父独自外出求援，给了女童一把枪，还告诉她「看到坏人就开枪！」当地警长无法认同此做法，直言「我不知道一5岁的孩子要怎麽分辨好人坏人，但她就是这样被告知的。」
a175a5d0e9ef2ae212a76e9e3de2696792372fd1.translatedText: Finally, the girl's mother and a police officer who came off work to help, The girl was found in the wilderness, carrying a pistol. After further questioning, she found out that her grandfather went out alone to seek help because the vehicle broke down in the desert. He gave the girl a gun and told her to "shoot the bad guys when you see them!" The local police chief couldn't agree with this approach and said bluntly, "I don't know how a 5-year-old child can tell the difference between good and bad guys, but that's what she was told."

30723cc0b072e708410e6b9eeb1adaabeec1811e.sourceText: 瑞特被发现时，正在一家餐厅内吃汉堡喝饮料，他被捕后向警方供称，当时车子受困，因为孙女抱怨走不动，所以才把她带到一棵树下留在那，并给她枪防身，瑞特则自己向外求援。此举已经侵害到儿童人权，瑞特也被依照2项虐童罪名，与置儿童于危险的罪嫌，暂时关在凤凰城市中心的第四大道监狱（Fourth Avenue Jail）中。
30723cc0b072e708410e6b9eeb1adaabeec1811e.translatedText: > Rhett was released Currently, he was eating hamburgers and drinking drinks in a restaurant. After being arrested, he confessed to the police that the car was stuck at the time. Because his granddaughter complained that she could not walk, he took her to a tree and left her there. He gave her a gun for self-defense. This move violated the human rights of children. Rhett was also temporarily detained at the Fourth Avenue Jail in downtown Phoenix on two counts of child abuse and putting children in danger. Avenue Jail).

3e4deaf47dbb3aa2f0ce812a689ad7371e3dc6f7.sourceText: 据CITYLAB报道，利用美国人口普查局2014年美国社区调查和自己的房价中位数和每月租金中位数的数据，Trulia研究发现，在全国范围内，年龄在25-34岁年轻人买房比租房要省23%的花费。
3e4deaf47dbb3aa2f0ce812a689ad7371e3dc6f7.translatedText: According to CITYLAB, using the U.S. Census Bureau's 2014 American Community Survey and its own data on median house prices and median monthly rents, Trulia research found that nationwide, young people aged 25-34 save 23% more on buying a house than renting.

3ddd6151e8664d1489313662c06276e5a69dfe8b.sourceText: 在全国最大的100个房地产市场中，在其中的98个里买房会比租房便宜，尽管各个大都市地区的房价差异巨大。
3ddd6151e8664d1489313662c06276e5a69dfe8b.translatedText: Buying a home is cheaper than renting in 98 of the nation's 100 largest real estate markets, although home prices vary widely across metropolitan areas.

82c67c583f7f5a4ea34f8af60490bd2bbfd53f57.sourceText: 每年的11 月12月感恩节，圣诞节都是美国人最盛大的家庭节日，很少有人愿意在这个时候搬家，是”数据”的淡季，却是很多移民自购房屋和投资房产的黄金季节。
82c67c583f7f5a4ea34f8af60490bd2bbfd53f57.translatedText: Thanksgiving and Christmas are the biggest family holidays for Americans every year. Few people are willing to move at this time. It is the off-season for "data", but it is also the golden season for many immigrants to buy their own homes and invest in real estate.

They live and rest here...

993feb6907d22accd063417bacffd30d9d7584d9.sourceText: （侨联供稿）凤凰城华人是最早来到亚利桑那州的族群之一。他们生活和安息这个地方。经墓园管理者和一些华人学者多年的努力考証，确认在”先民和军人纪念墓园”中，墓葬着一批最早的华人，保存着亚省最早的中文墓碑。 为纪念华人先辈们作出的卓越贡献，慰籍老一辈华侨的在天忘灵，凤凰城华人福利会在墓园内建立了《华人先辈纪念碑》。大凤凰城地区侨联发起于2015年11月21日（星期六）上午10时在历史墓园进行首次集体公祭，欢迎各团体和个人共同前往拜祭。
993feb6907d22accd063417bacffd30d9d7584d9.translatedText: (Contributed by the Overseas Chinese Federation) The Phoenix Chinese were one of the first ethnic groups to come to Arizona. This is the place where they live and rest. After many years of research by the cemetery managers and some Chinese scholars, it was confirmed that the "Ancestors and Soldiers Memorial Cemetery" contains the tombs of a group of the earliest Chinese and preserves the earliest Chinese tombstones in Alberta. In order to commemorate the outstanding contributions made by the Chinese ancestors and comfort the spirits of the older generation of overseas Chinese in Tianwang, the Phoenix Chinese Welfare Association established the "Chinese Ancestors Monument" in the cemetery. The Greater Phoenix Area Overseas Chinese Federation initiated the first collective public memorial at the historical cemetery at 10 a.m. on November 21, 2015 (Saturday). All groups and individuals are welcome to come together to pay their respects.

cfdc233889a0aaf8e67cebb30aded9aa69979179.sourceText: ”先民和军人纪念墓园”是由联邦认定的历史文化建筑遗址。位于州政府办公区内，地址 在1315 W. Jefferson St, Phoenix, AZ 85007
cfdc233889a0aaf8e67cebb30aded9aa69979179.translatedText: "Ancestors and Military Memorial Cemetery" is a federally recognized historical and cultural architectural site. Located within the state government district at 1315 W. Jefferson St, Phoenix, AZ 85007

0ed29be0c8f820f2b038b1bb5ccadd772bebfbcd.translatedText: 2015 Hope Chinese School Sports Day (written by Zhu Xuewei, photographed by Ling Chao) On November 1st, the Alberta Hope Chinese School held a chandler tumbleweed...

84fdd12af0bd6c26073785873992d2c681873264.sourceText: （朱雪薇撰文，凌超摄影）11月1日，亚省希望中文学校在chandler tumbleweed park举行了一年一度的运动会。虽然已经是深秋时节，但是运动会当天，却是风和日丽暖意融融。家长和孩子们的脸上都洋溢着愉快的笑容，准备在运动会上大显身手。 学校为孩子们租了他们最爱的jumping house和棉花糖机，还为大家准备了饮料、pizza和BBQ，China CityBuffet 和 Jogoya Sushi Seafood Buffet为这次活动捐赠了精美的菜肴。各家能干的家长们还带来了各自的拿手好菜，有五彩丝、卤牛肉、凉粉等各种凉拌菜，还有咖喱牛肉，烤鸡翅，三文鱼丸等热菜，主食方面有五彩炒饭、面条饺子、花卷馒头、面包蛋糕等等，品种齐全味道可口，让大家眼花缭乱食指大动。大家一边品尝美味，一边不时的有人询问，这是谁家的包子，为什么皮可以这么薄？这是谁家的牛肉，为什么这么鲜嫩可口？美食会瞬间变成一场厨艺交流会。 享受完美食之后，运动会正式开始。今年的运动会以”家庭同乐”为主题，学校希望家长和孩子在紧张的工作学习之余能好好享受难得的亲子时光。为此，学校的中文老师们提前好几周就开始商量策划一系列有趣的亲子游戏。包括二人三足、小脚踩大脚、夹乒乓球往返跑、蒙眼喂食等。家长和孩子们一起合作，努力闯关，每完成一个游戏或任务，孩子们都高兴的大叫大跳，迫不及待的去领取奖券，然后用奖券换取自己喜欢的小奖品。最后一项是中文学校的传统项目?#25300;河。先是成人拔河比赛，不光爸爸们摩拳擦掌，连妈妈们也巾帼不让须眉，纷纷上阵。爸爸妈妈们一个个憋足了劲儿，孩子们在旁边加油助威，场面好不热闹。爸爸妈妈比完之后，孩子们上场对抗，爸爸妈妈们在旁边摇旗呐喊，劲头一点不输自己比赛的时候。 学生会也积极响应，策划组织了打糖果、走圈抽奖、扔水球、画脸等游戏和活动，也受到了学生们的热烈好评，一个个玩的不亦乐乎。说到中文学校的学生会，本学期以来，他们一直在坚持义卖，将收入所得捐给国内贫困山区的孩子们。这次运动会上，他们号召大家把家里闲置的玩具、书本、衣物等带来现场，组织了一场yard sale，继续为贫困山区的孩子募集资金。家长老师们不但积极响应，捐出了很多物品，更热情的帮着吆喝推销，成为本次运动会的一大亮点。 运动会在孩子们的笑声闹声中结束了，老师和家长们虽然都很辛苦，但是看着孩子们的笑脸，看着为贫困山区孩子募集到的资金，还有孩子和父母之间增进的亲子之情，大家觉得一切都是值得的。运动会，我们明年再见！
84fdd12af0bd6c26073785873992d2c681873264.translatedText: (written by Zhu Xuewei, photographed by Ling Chao) On November 1st, the Alberta Hope Chinese School held a chandler tumbleweed event The annual sports meeting was held in the park. Although it was already late autumn, the day of the sports meeting was sunny and warm. The faces of parents and children were filled with happy smiles, ready to show off their skills at the sports meeting. The school rented their favorite jumping house and cotton candy machine for the children, and also prepared drinks, pizza and BBQ for everyone. China CityBuffet and Jogoya Sushi Seafood Buffet donated exquisite dishes for this event. The capable parents of each family also brought their own specialty dishes, including various cold dishes such as colorful shredded silk, braised beef, and jelly, as well as hot dishes such as curry beef, grilled chicken wings, and salmon balls. The staple food included colorful fried rice, noodle dumplings, Hanamaki steamed buns, bread cakes, etc. The variety was complete and delicious, making everyone dazzled and moved their index fingers. While everyone was enjoying the delicious food, people asked from time to time, whose buns these are, and why the skin can be so thin? Whose beef is this? Why is it so tender and delicious? The gourmet meeting instantly turns into a cooking exchange meeting. After enjoying the delicious food, the sports meeting officially begins. This year's sports meeting is themed "Family Fun". The school hopes that parents and children can enjoy the rare parent-child time apart from intense work and study. To this end, the school’s Chinese teachers began to discuss and plan a series of interesting parent-child games weeks in advance. Including two people with three legs, small feet stepping on big feet, running back and forth with table tennis balls, blindfolded feeding, etc. Parents and children work together and work hard to pass the levels. Every time a game or task is completed, the children shout and jump with joy. They can't wait to receive the lottery tickets, and then use the lottery tickets to exchange for their favorite small prizes. The last item is the traditional project of Chinese school?#25300;River. First there was the adult tug-of-war competition. Not only the fathers were gearing up, but even the mothers were not outdone and took part in the battle one after another. The parents were all working hard, and the children were cheering beside them. The scene was very lively. After the parents competed, the children went on the field to compete. The parents waved flags and cheered beside them, and their energy was no less than when they were competing. The student union also responded positively, planning and organizing games and activities such as candy beating, circle drawing, water balloon throwing, face painting, etc., which were also warmly praised by the students, and they all had a great time playing. Speaking of the student union of the Chinese school, since this semester, they have been insisting on charity sales and donating the income to children in impoverished mountainous areas in China. At this sports meeting, they called on everyone to bring their idle toys, books, clothes, etc. at home, and organized a yard sale to continue to raise funds for children in impoverished mountainous areas. Parents and teachers not only responded positively and donated many items, but also enthusiastically helped promote the event, which became a highlight of this sports meeting. The sports meeting ended with the laughter and noise of the children. Although the teachers and parents worked very hard, looking at the smiling faces of the children, the funds raised for the children in impoverished mountainous areas, and the enhanced parent-child relationship between the children and their parents, everyone felt that everything was worth it. Sports day, see you next year!

3388a8500c740a9f5c8ce05e49f7fafee6e84f50.sourceText: 9月27日，是祖筍中文学校建校65周年纪念日。祖筍华人文化中心前厅悬挂着红色的宫灯，陈列着回顾中文学校历史和展示当今风貌的图片，还有学生的习作。大厅的主席台上挂着一对红灯笼，三十个大圆桌在大厅里排开，还有红色吉祥的中国结和五彩的中国龙。气氛热烈、祥和。学校在这里举行隆重的庆祝活动。洛杉矶总领馆教育组领事陈卫恒、图森市市长Jonathan Rothschild、图森议会议员SHIRLEY Scott、皮马县皮马学院院长Lee Lambert、图森华人协会主席廖莹、祖筍中文学校董事长陈伯强、亚历桑那大学孔子学院院长陈昭、凤凰城希望中文学校董事长李健和前校长赵彩虹、特邀嘉宾教育学家陈普博士和历史学家杨立博士、祖筍中文学校校长陈荣基、以Bonnie Lam，赵萍为代表的六位学校的老校长、以Kit Lam，梁正锵为代表的十多位老董事、以姜其海，尹世殿为代表的许多老教师和近三百名师生和家长齐聚一堂，共襄盛典。
3388a8500c740a9f5c8ce05e49f7fafee6e84f50.translatedText: September 27 is the 65th anniversary of the founding of Zusun Chinese School. Red palace lanterns are hung in the front hall of the Zusun Chinese Cultural Center, and pictures reviewing the history of the Chinese school and showing its current style are displayed, as well as students' exercises. A pair of red lanterns hang on the rostrum of the hall, and thirty large round tables are lined up in the hall. There are also red auspicious Chinese knots and colorful Chinese dragons. The atmosphere was warm and peaceful. The school holds a grand celebration here. Chen Weiheng, Consul of the Education Section of the Consulate General in Los Angeles, Tucson Mayor Jonathan Rothschild, Tucson Assembly Member SHIRLEY Scott, and Pima County Pima College President Lee Lambert, Tucson Chinese Association Chairman Liao Ying, Zusun Chinese School Chairman Chen Boqiang, Director of the Confucius Institute at the University of Arizona Chen Zhao, Phoenix Hope Chinese School Chairman Li Jian and former principal Zhao Caihong, special guests educationist Dr. Chen Pu and historian Dr. Yang Li, Zusun Chinese School Principal Chen Rongji, six old school principals represented by Bonnie Lam, Zhao Ping, Kit Lam, more than ten old directors represented by Liang Zhengqiang, many old teachers represented by Jiang Qihai and Yin Shidian, and nearly 300 teachers, students and parents gathered together to participate in the grand ceremony.

41d808ce74dc27c93f23f1b1fafb76aac43fd23b.sourceText: 六十五载栉风沐雨，前赴后继。祖筍中文学校始建立于1950年，在一代又一代华人的共同努力下，用中华民族灿烂的语言文化留住了民族的根，从华人补习班成长为南亚利桑那州中文教育的重要基地。近20年来，祖筍中文学校取得了令人瞩目的成绩，得到了图森当地民众的称赞。近10年来，越来越多的非华裔家庭把自己的子女送到学校学习中文，也有越来越多中文学校的老师进入全日制学校任教，活跃在各处中文课程的讲台上。现在，祖筍中文学校已经成为亚利桑那州中文教育和中华文化传播的一面旗帜。学校开设的课程有针对华裔的中文班（分设使用暨南大学编著的《中文》教材的班级和使用马立平编著的《中文》教材的班级）和针对非华裔的中文班。也有中国书法、中国画、中国武术、中国舞蹈、YOYO、乒乓球、羽毛球、棋类、中文会话等文化类课程。现有在校学生149人，常年组织的活动有书法比赛、作文比赛、朗诵比赛、识字测试。从2005年至今祖筍中文学校已经有上百篇学生的作文在世界范围的作文比赛中获奖。
41d808ce74dc27c93f23f1b1fafb76aac43fd23b.translatedText: Sixty-five years of hard work and continuous improvement. Zusun Chinese School was founded in 1950. With the joint efforts of generations of Chinese, it has retained the roots of the nation with the splendid language and culture of the Chinese nation. It has grown from a Chinese cram school to an important base of Chinese education in Southern Arizona. In the past 20 years, Zusun Chinese School has achieved remarkable results and has been praised by the local people in Tucson. In the past 10 years, more and more non-Chinese families have sent their children to school to learn Chinese, and more and more Chinese school teachers have entered full-time schools to teach and are active on the stage of Chinese courses everywhere. Now, Zusun Chinese School has become a banner for Chinese education and the spread of Chinese culture in Arizona. The courses offered by the school include Chinese classes for Chinese-Americans (classes using the "Chinese" textbook compiled by Jinan University and classes using the "Chinese" textbook compiled by Ma Liping) and Chinese classes for non-Chinese-Americans. There are also cultural courses such as Chinese calligraphy, Chinese painting, Chinese martial arts, Chinese dance, YOYO, table tennis, badminton, chess, and Chinese conversation. There are currently 149 students at the school, and activities organized throughout the year include calligraphy competitions, composition competitions, recitation competitions, and literacy tests. Since 2005, Zusun Chinese School has had hundreds of student essays win awards in worldwide essay competitions.

57b04a02c7164a6baa4fe7ed1adfe3e6ef94303f.sourceText: 六十五载披荆斩棘，革旧鼎新。上午九点举行的”中文学校教学理念和教学方法研讨会”拉开了庆祝活动的序幕。图森两所中文学校的现任教师、祖筍中文学校的前几任校长、从凤凰城远道而来的历史学家杨立、教育学家陈普参加了研讨会。在祖筍华人协会主席廖瑩女士陪同下洛杉矶总领馆教育领事陈卫恒到会与老师们见面，并讲了话。他从祖国带来的茉莉花茶勾起了大家的思乡情结。他谈到现在美国人对学习中文很感兴趣，有很高的学习积极性。并指出这是在新形势下中文学校面临着新的任务，希望中文学校在这方面有所作为。廖瑩女士也讲了话，她充分肯定了老师们在中文学校无私的奉 献和卓越的工作，代表祖筍华人协会对老师们表示感谢！
57b04a02c7164a6baa4fe7ed1adfe3e6ef94303f.translatedText: Sixty-five years of overcoming obstacles and reforming the old. The “Seminar on Teaching Concepts and Teaching Methods in Chinese Schools” held at 9 a.m. kicked off the celebration. Current teachers from two Chinese schools in Tucson, former principals of Zusun Chinese School, historian Yang Li and educationist Chen Pu who came all the way from Phoenix attended the seminar. Accompanied by Ms. Liao Ying, Chairman of the Zusun Chinese Association, Chen Weiheng, Education Consul of the Consulate General in Los Angeles, attended the meeting to meet with the teachers and spoke. The jasmine tea he brought from his motherland aroused everyone's homesickness. He said that Americans are now very interested in learning Chinese and have high motivation to learn. He also pointed out that Chinese schools are facing new tasks under the new situation and hoped that Chinese schools would make a difference in this regard. Ms. Liao Ying also spoke. She fully affirmed the selfless dedication and outstanding work of the teachers in the Chinese school, and expressed her gratitude to the teachers on behalf of the Zusun Chinese Association!

b62557765e793712d365668147cf26755e089351.sourceText: 陈卫恒领事与参加研讨会的老师交谈
b62557765e793712d365668147cf26755e089351.translatedText: Consul Chen Weiheng talks with teachers participating in the seminar

cf706a0c8d89ff090662491d96c5c296f6c0de26.sourceText: 杨立、陈普两位博士和祖筍中文学校的几位校长在研讨会发言。杨立以翔实的历史资料向大家展现了美国华人办中文学校历史。以珍贵的图片和具体的数据回顾了祖筍中文学校的历史，突出体现了图森华人克服困难、锲而不舍在中文教育上建立的历史功绩。陈普博士为此次研讨会准备了大量的材料，但是根据研讨会的气氛和到会老师的具体情况，他决定脱离原来准备的讲稿，专注于讨论中文学校培养人的问题。他形象地提出的中文学校”把学生教不会就对了。”的教学理念，令人耳目一新。原定三个小时的研讨会延长了一个多小时，直到下午的庆祝大会就要开始了才意犹未尽地结束了研讨会。（研讨会已另有报道）
cf706a0c8d89ff090662491d96c5c296f6c0de26.translatedText: Doctors Yang Li and Chen Pu and several principals of Zusun Chinese School spoke at the seminar. Yang Li used detailed historical information to show everyone the history of Chinese schools run by Chinese Americans. The history of Zusun Chinese School was reviewed with precious pictures and specific data, highlighting the historical achievements of the Tucson Chinese who overcame difficulties and persevered in establishing Chinese education. Dr. Chen Pu prepared a large amount of materials for this seminar, but based on the atmosphere of the seminar and the specific situation of the teachers attending the seminar, he decided to break away from the originally prepared lecture notes and focus on discussing the issue of cultivating people in Chinese schools. The teaching philosophy that he vividly put forward in Chinese schools is "just don't teach the students enough." This is refreshing. The originally scheduled three-hour seminar was extended by more than an hour, and it was not until the afternoon celebration meeting was about to begin that the seminar ended without satisfaction. (The seminar has been reported separately)

c6a024dacbdc9ab7cf5601acd6532607f420db48.sourceText: 六十五载乘风破浪，日新月异。当天下午，盛大的65周年庆祝会座无虚席。下午两点在狮子舞的锣鼓声中庆祝大会开始，孩子们热闹的开场狮子舞引来现场阵阵喝彩。校董会主席陈伯强先生主持大会。华人协会主席廖瑩女士讲话，她充分肯定了中文学校的前辈开创中文学校的历史功绩，高度赞扬了图森一代又一代老师和学校的管理者为中文学校做出的贡献。洛杉矶总领馆教育领事陈卫恒先生致辞，他带来了洛杉矶总领馆特别的祝贺，并代表国侨办为获得”华星书屋”称号的祖筍中文学校授牌，为2014年获得”华教杰出人士”称号的梁正锵先生颁奖。祖筍中文学校50年代末期的学生，前华人协会主席李琼瑶女士展示了她当年在中文学校学习的照片，回顾了当年学习的情景。并且以老校友的身份为通过AP中国语言和文化考试的四位学生发奖。
c6a024dacbdc9ab7cf5601acd6532607f420db48.translatedText: Sixty-five years of riding the wind and waves, making progress with each passing day. That afternoon, the grand 65th anniversary celebration was packed with people. At two o'clock in the afternoon, the celebration started with the sound of lion dance gongs and drums. The children's lively opening lion dance attracted bursts of applause from the audience. Mr. Chen Boqiang, Chairman of the School Board, presided over the meeting. Ms. Liao Ying, President of the Chinese Association, spoke. She fully affirmed the historical achievements of the predecessors of the Chinese school in establishing the Chinese school, and highly praised the contributions made by generations of teachers and school administrators in Tucson to the Chinese school. Mr. Chen Weiheng, Education Consul of the Los Angeles Consulate General, delivered a speech. He brought special congratulations from the Los Angeles Consulate General, and on behalf of the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the State Council, he awarded the license to Zusun Chinese School, which won the title of "Huaxing Bookstore", and presented the award to Mr. Liang Zhengqiang, who won the title of "Outstanding Chinese Education Person" in 2014. Ms. Li Qiongyao, a student of Zusun Chinese School in the late 1950s and former president of the Chinese Association, showed photos of her studies at the Chinese school and reviewed the scenes of her studies at that time. And as old alumni, awards were given to four students who passed the AP Chinese Language and Culture exam.

da7dc2b5676ae1695297cfd8d960c5d75d15aa35.sourceText: 祖筍中文学校的成长和发展离不开为此付出的志愿者。从建校初期的校董、老师、”周末男孩”，到现在台前幕后的义工为祖筍中文学校的发展做出了不可磨灭的贡献。前校长雷宏在致辞中充分肯定了这些志愿者的贡献，并代表学校向这些志愿者的优秀代表，2010年以来为我校学生评审作文的八位幕后义工颁发了杰出义工奖。他们是杨立、帅致若、商慧明、陈普、赵萍、谢成彦、邓琳、张秋红。
da7dc2b5676ae1695297cfd8d960c5d75d15aa35.translatedText: The growth and development of Zusun Chinese School is inseparable from the volunteers who have contributed to it. From the school directors, teachers, and “weekend boys” in the early days of the school to the current volunteers in front of and behind the scenes, they have made indelible contributions to the development of Zusun Chinese School. Former principal Lei Hong fully affirmed the contributions of these volunteers in his speech, and on behalf of the school, awarded the Outstanding Volunteer Award to the outstanding representatives of these volunteers, the eight behind-the-scenes volunteers who have reviewed the compositions of our school students since 2010. They are Yang Li, Shuai Zhiruo, Shang Huiming, Chen Pu, Zhao Ping, Xie Chengyan, Deng Lin, and Zhang Qiuhong.

a7d3dfc2b486914e7fd7169a406bd78cd9159d02.sourceText: 获得杰出义工奖的杨立、商慧明、赵萍、陈普、邓琳
a7d3dfc2b486914e7fd7169a406bd78cd9159d02.translatedText: >Yang Li, Shang Huiming, Zhao Ping, Chen Pu, and Deng Lin who won the Outstanding Volunteer Award

c680e373757fdb97100725ce7f7e6d412c1fc470.sourceText: 祖筍中文学校65周年的庆祝活动还收到了全美中文学校协会、亚利桑那大学孔子学院、凤凰城希望中文学校、凤凰城现代中文学校、图桑国语教会中文学校发来的贺信和贺电。凤凰城的希望中文学校董事长李健和前校长赵彩虹专程从凤凰城赶来参加庆祝活动。尽管图森的两所中文学校在同一时间上课，图桑国语教会中文学校还是派出了代表全程参加了庆祝活动。亚利桑那大学孔子学院院长陈昭博士专门挤出时间参加庆祝活动，并作为祝贺单位的代表在会上致辞。她热情地称赞祖筍中文学校在社区中所起的积极作用，并向中文学校赠送了特制的贺卡。接着她把话锋一转，身份由嘉宾变成了学生家长。她说自己的两个女儿以前都在祖筍中文学校学习中文，并取得了好成绩，她非常感谢为培育学生，传承中华文化而辛勤工作的老师们。
c680e373757fdb97100725ce7f7e6d412c1fc470.translatedText: The celebration of the 65th anniversary of Zusun Chinese School also received congratulatory letters and telegrams from the National Association of Chinese Schools, the Confucius Institute at the University of Arizona, Phoenix Hope Chinese School, Phoenix Modern Chinese School, and Tucson Chinese Language Church Chinese School. Li Jian, chairman of the Hope Chinese School in Phoenix, and Zhao Caihong, the former principal, made a special trip from Phoenix to attend the celebration. Although the two Chinese schools in Tucson held classes at the same time, Tucson Mandarin Chinese School sent representatives to participate in the celebration. Dr. Chen Zhao, Director of the Confucius Institute at the University of Arizona, made time to attend the celebration and delivered a speech at the meeting as a representative of the congratulatory unit. She enthusiastically praised Zusun Chinese School for its positive role in the community and presented a specially made greeting card to the Chinese school. Then she changed the subject and changed her identity from a guest to a student parent. She said that her two daughters used to study Chinese at Zusun Chinese School and achieved good results. She was very grateful to the teachers who worked hard to cultivate students and inherit Chinese culture.

bf7ca740322b2ce20fc2dd72a073706778c22cf9.sourceText: 亚利桑那大学孔子学院院长陈昭博士给中文学校送来了特制的贺卡。
bf7ca740322b2ce20fc2dd72a073706778c22cf9.translatedText: Dr. Chen Zhao, Director of the Confucius Institute at the University of Arizona, sent a specially made greeting card to the Chinese school.

3879e248f9fef35740ea1463123b024d13366c32.sourceText: 从上世纪六十年代到本世纪初，在祖筍中文学校工作了三十九年的老董事长林澄波先生深情地回顾了祖筍中文学校的发展历史。他端着一个盒子走上讲台，根本不理会主持人给他的已经超时的暗示，一口气讲了二十多分钟。他的盒子里有介绍祖筍中文学校的创始人谭澄波的书，有六十年代出版的祖筍中文学校特刊，有学校的文档，有不同时期新闻报纸对学校的报道，还有十分珍贵的老照片。在展示这些宝贝的过程中，林先生述说着宝贝背后的故事，拉着学校的家常，带着大家走进了祖筍中文学校的时光隧道。从这个时光隧道出来，人们感觉到的是图森的华人为留住自己中华文化的根，一代又一代执着的追求和为之付出的努力。
3879e248f9fef35740ea1463123b024d13366c32.translatedText: From the 1960s to the beginning of this century, Mr. Lin Chengbo, the old chairman who worked at Zusun Chinese School for 39 years, fondly reviewed the development history of Zusun Chinese School. He walked up to the podium carrying a box, ignored the host's hint that the time had expired, and spoke for more than 20 minutes in one breath. In his box were books introducing Tan Chengbo, the founder of Zusun Chinese School, a special issue of Zusun Chinese School published in the 1960s, school documents, newspaper reports on the school from different periods, and very precious old photos. In the process of displaying these treasures, Mr. Lin told the stories behind the treasures and took everyone into the time tunnel of Zusun Chinese School along with the school’s daily routine. Coming out of this time tunnel, what people feel is the persistent pursuit and efforts made by the Chinese in Tucson from generation to generation to retain the roots of their Chinese culture.

d598240e974432b6ec4814270269bec7a882dde7.sourceText: 在祖筍中文学校工作了三十九年的老董事长林澄波先生深情地回顾祖筍中文学校的发展历史。
d598240e974432b6ec4814270269bec7a882dde7.translatedText: Mr. Lin Chengbo, the old chairman who has worked at Zusun Chinese School for thirty-nine years, looked back fondly on the development history of Zusun Chinese School.

d076d6083522fcf5702d1e0f7d439a4257a79ede.sourceText: 庆祝会上师生们精心准备的节目穿插其中，孩子们精彩的表演不时赢得台下热烈掌声。三个舞蹈班的孩子用一个个饱含浓郁中国韵味的舞蹈，向来宾汇报多年的教学成果。YOYO班的同学用滑稽精彩的抖空竹（YOYO）展现出孩子们活泼、开朗、欢快的精神风貌。小学二年级和四年级的同学表演的两个小话剧再现了课堂教学活动的情景，展现了学校的教学现状。已经毕业的学生武玲玲同学朗诵了她在中文学校上学时创作的诗歌《图森，我生长的地方》。诗歌表现了她对图森的热爱，倾述了她对中文学校的眷恋。她用甜美的声音，展开了一幅幅同学们日常生活的画卷。她用这优美的声音中流露出的情感，表达了对中文学校的依依不舍。她饱含深情的声音走进了每一个人的心里。在听众们送给她的雷鸣般的掌声中，我们有理由相信，祖筍中文学校一定会实现陈荣基校长提出的中文学校的总体目标：”我们要通过学校和家庭的共同努力，让学生在学习中文语言知识的同时，学习和了解中华文化，最终形成终生受用的中文能力。”
d076d6083522fcf5702d1e0f7d439a4257a79ede.translatedText: The celebration was interspersed with carefully prepared programs by teachers and students, and the children's wonderful performances occasionally won warm applause from the audience. The children in the three dance classes used dances full of strong Chinese charm to report their years of teaching results to the guests. The students in the YOYO class used the funny and exciting diabolo dance (YOYO) to show the lively, cheerful and joyful spirit of the children. Two short plays performed by students in the second and fourth grades of primary school reproduced the scenes of classroom teaching activities and showed the current teaching situation in the school. Wu Lingling, a graduated student, recited the poem "Tucson, Where I grew up" that she wrote when she was in Chinese school. The poem expresses her love for Tucson and describes her attachment to the Chinese school. With her sweet voice, she unfolded pictures of the daily lives of her classmates. She used the emotion in her beautiful voice to express her reluctance to leave the Chinese school. Her soulful voice entered everyone's heart. In the thunderous applause given to her by the audience, we have reason to believe that Zusun Chinese School will definitely achieve the overall goal of the Chinese school put forward by Principal Chen Rongji: "We must make the joint efforts of schools and families to allow students to learn and understand Chinese culture while learning Chinese language knowledge, and ultimately form Chinese abilities that can be used throughout their lives."

b6069bbc77b6f621f9c76aa1b4647e2e2380852d.sourceText: 六十五载育后裔，传承创新筑未来。承上启下、鉴古知今、面向未来。相信在祖国日益强大的背景下，在各方人士的大力扶持下，祖筍中文学校将迈向更高台阶，为图森华文教育和中华文化传播做出卓越贡献。
b6069bbc77b6f621f9c76aa1b4647e2e2380852d.translatedText: Sixty-five years of cultivating descendants, inheriting innovation and building the future. Connect the past and the future, learn from the past to understand the present, and face the future. I believe that under the background of the increasingly powerful motherland and with the strong support of all parties, Zusun Chinese School will move to a higher level and make outstanding contributions to Tucson Chinese education and the spread of Chinese culture.

c7606d0335a9e86356f1007f81e1a46508cb364e.sourceText: ２０１５年１０月６日，四百嘉宾在凤凰城六福酒家共襄盛举，庆祝中华民国１０４年生日。双十国庆筹备会主席邱顺雄以及侨务咨询委员余文劲，驻洛杉矶台北经济文化办事处副处长王秉慎，资深侨领邓朝驹，亚利桑那州州议长David Gowan，亚利桑那共和党主席罗伯特. 格雷厄姆等美国政要都参加了本次庆典。
c7606d0335a9e86356f1007f81e1a46508cb364e.translatedText: On October 6, 2015, 400 guests attended a grand event at Luk Fook Restaurant in Phoenix to celebrate the 104th birthday of the Republic of China. National Day Preparatory Committee Chairman Qiu Shunxiong, Overseas Chinese Affairs Advisory Committee Yu Wenjin, Deputy Director of the Taipei Economic and Cultural Office in Los Angeles Wang Bingshen, senior overseas Chinese leader Deng Chaoju, Arizona State Speaker David Gowan, Arizona Republican Party Chairman Robert Graham and other American dignitaries attended the celebration.

b04b2c34879faf56c5e74724758e2ed2c3cf73bd.sourceText: （左至右）王秉慎 余文劲 邱顺雄 邱顺雄主席致辞感谢筹备本次生日庆典的功臣。王秉慎向长期支持侨务工作，并对国庆活动作出努力的资深侨领余文劲颁发特别贡献奖。与此同时，黄氏宗亲会的黄定江，美西侨报社长方慧贤，凤凰城中文学校董事长谢健明获得殊荣。
b04b2c34879faf56c5e74724758e2ed2c3cf73bd.translatedText: (left to right) Wang Bingshen, Yu Wenjin, Qiu Shunxiong Chairman Qiu Shunxiong gave a speech to thank the heroes who prepared this birthday celebration. Wang Bingshen presented the Special Contribution Award to Yu Wenjin, a senior overseas Chinese leader who has long supported overseas Chinese affairs and made efforts in National Day activities. At the same time, Huang Dingjiang of the Huang Clan Association, Fang Huixian, president of the American Overseas Chinese Newspaper, and Xie Jianming, chairman of the Phoenix Chinese School, received the honor.

81d9160b0d400db65da5f9a455676d2ce037b25a.sourceText: 获得特别贡献奖嘉宾 亚利桑那州双十国庆筹备会经过多年努力与传承，不仅在华人侨社赢得好评，更深深取得美国主流的认同与参与，播种耕耘如今开花结果，甚至可以说是豊收。亚省共和党主席罗伯特. 格雷厄姆上台致辞，讲述了自己多次与台湾合作的愉快经历，希望亚利桑那与台湾能再接再厉，取得更多经济政治上的交流。 今年”双十”宴会有丰富的抽奖和精彩的表演。耆英会带来了精彩戏曲和演唱还有时装表演，最有特色的是美国印第安原住民带来的呼啦圈表演，美食，大奖，还有表演都迎来了阵阵掌声。双十活动在歌曲《梅花》声中，落下帷幕。我们一起期待１０５双十活动再次相见。
81d9160b0d400db65da5f9a455676d2ce037b25a.translatedText: Guests who received the Special Contribution Award. After years of hard work and inheritance, the Arizona Double Ten National Day Preparatory Conference has not only won praise from the Chinese overseas community, but also gained deep recognition and participation from the mainstream of the United States. The sowing and cultivation are now bearing fruit, and it can even be said to be a harvest. Robert Graham, chairman of the Republican Party of Alberta, took the stage to deliver a speech, recounting his many pleasant experiences of cooperation with Taiwan and hoping that Arizona and Taiwan could continue their efforts to achieve more economic and political exchanges. This year's "Double Ten" banquet has rich draws and exciting performances. The Senior Citizens Association brought wonderful operas, singing and fashion shows. The most distinctive one was the hula hoop performance by the American Indians. Food, prizes and performances all received bursts of applause. The Double Ten event came to an end with the song "Plum Blossom". We look forward to seeing you again at the 105th Double Ten event.

e8bacca66d33e02e76ac1fe78d5e81cc54d261cd.sourceText: 六十五年前，当我们在座的大多数人还没有来到这个世界的时候，一位名叫谭的华人先驱者在美国亚利桑那图桑市办起了中文学校。且不说他在事业上如何成功辉煌，也不说他个人如何有先见之明，为后来的华人传承中华文化打下基础，就回到那个时代看一下谭先生的勇气也是卓越非凡。可知 1950 年，正值韩战时期，美中因北韩交恶，成千上万的两国年轻人为无端的政治信念魂飘异地，两国民间关系紧张可以想见。但就有这样的伟人，在如此敏感时期，在一个完全不同的文化氛围里举起了中文学校的大旗! 不知道这所中文学校是否可以称为当时美国最早的中文学校，但至少这是亚利桑那州华人的骄傲。现在想来，任何溢美赞扬和歌舞升平的庆典，都不能代替我们内心对先人的顶礼膜拜！
e8bacca66d33e02e76ac1fe78d5e81cc54d261cd.translatedText: Sixty-five years ago, when most of us here have not yet come to this world, a Chinese pioneer named Tan opened a Chinese school in Tucson, Arizona, USA. Not to mention how successful and brilliant he was in his career, nor how personally he had the foresight to lay the foundation for future generations of Chinese to inherit Chinese culture. Just go back to that era and take a look at Mr. Tan's courage. It can be seen that in 1950, during the Korean War, the United States and China were at odds with each other because of North Korea. Thousands of young people from both countries were distracted by their unfounded political beliefs. It is conceivable that the civil relations between the two countries were tense. But there was such a great man who raised the banner of a Chinese school in such a sensitive period and in a completely different cultural atmosphere! I don’t know if this Chinese school can be called the earliest Chinese school in the United States at that time, but at least it was the pride of the Chinese in Arizona. Now that I think about it, any celebration of praise and singing and dancing cannot replace our inner worship of our ancestors!

3639f0e9caacb53e07557bfe80ce7327a3426f2a.sourceText: 让我们更加感恩的是，在中文学校每年东奔西跑寻找校舍寻的时候，图桑的梁正锵先生无偿地捐出了自己七英亩的土地，并得到诸多华人前辈的共同襄举，才有了今天这样辉煌壮观的华人会馆和图桑中文学校的校舍，才有了我们的华人孩子能每周日能回到自己的母语学校学习中文的欢天喜地。处于一种舒适宽敞的常态学校环境时，我们往往会昔日的同事和过去的学生曾在教堂和其他地方简陋的桌椅上艰难地学习。也许这种状态在海外或者美国其他地方至今还存在，但至少中文学校海外的同行看到图桑现在这样的校舍会感叹不已，为什么我们这里没有梁先生这样的壮举！
3639f0e9caacb53e07557bfe80ce7327a3426f2a.translatedText: What makes us even more grateful is that when Chinese schools were running around looking for school buildings every year, Mr. Liang Zhengqiang from Tucson donated seven acres of his land free of charge. With the help of many Chinese seniors, we have the magnificent Chinese Association and the Tucson Chinese School building today, and we have the joy of our Chinese children being able to go back to their mother tongue school every Sunday to learn Chinese. When we are in the comfort and spaciousness of a normal school environment, we tend to remember our former colleagues and past students who struggled to study on simple tables and chairs in churches and other places. Maybe this situation still exists overseas or in other places in the United States, but at least overseas colleagues of Chinese schools will sigh when they see the current school building in Tucson, why do we not have such a feat like Mr. Liang here!

65d78f9eda15ca9d684d334b3cce7ba4fa0eb925.sourceText: 祖筍中文学校门前安放着两座巨大的汉白玉的石狮子雕像，这是中华人民共和国驻洛杉矶总领馆赠送的。不知道海外其他中文学校有没有这样的荣幸，但图桑的华人都记得，那是当时的总领事钟建华先生于 2005 年 10 月赠送给图桑华人会馆和中文学校的。而且，大使张云先生盛赞，这是全美最好的中文学校校舍。当然也可能就是当时世界上最好的中文学校，祖筍中文学校前校长马晶先生不无自豪地回忆着。所以在这样近于豪华的校舍中教学，身为师长和学生一样，由衷地感到自己的幸福和责任。
65d78f9eda15ca9d684d334b3cce7ba4fa0eb925.translatedText: There are two huge white marble stone lion statues placed in front of Zusun Chinese School, which were presented by the Consulate General of the People's Republic of China in Los Angeles. I don’t know if other Chinese schools overseas have such an honor, but the Chinese in Tucson all remember that it was presented to the Tucson Chinese Association and Chinese School in October 2005 by Mr. Zhong Jianhua, the then Consul General. Moreover, Ambassador Mr. Zhang Yun highly praised this as the best Chinese school building in the United States. Of course, it might have been the best Chinese school in the world at that time, Mr. Ma Jing, the former principal of Zusun Chinese School, recalled with pride. Therefore, teaching in such a luxurious school building, as a teacher and a student, I sincerely feel my happiness and responsibility.

366e9041a32e2a8be6f2dcb2dd7b01a15f47f594.sourceText: 不过，在这个值得纪念的日子里，智者和哲人想的更多地是海外中文学校的未来和前途。来自凤凰城演讲的陈普博士依然踌躇满志或者忧心忡忡地发出了赤子的感慨，在美国 AP 中文课逐渐进入公立高中的课程时，中文学校面临的将不仅仅是生源的缺失，而且是优秀教师的流失，以单纯教中文文字的中文学校将面临关闭的危险。这似乎是危言耸听，甚至是不合时宜，特别在中国文化借助孔老先生名声蔓行世界大地的时刻。但残酷的是，在歌舞升平的庆贺中，人们很容易忽视美国一些地区的中文学校正在面临着关门和倒闭。
366e9041a32e2a8be6f2dcb2dd7b01a15f47f594.translatedText: However, on this memorable day, wise men and philosophers are thinking more about the future and prospects of overseas Chinese schools. Dr. Chen Pu, who came from Phoenix to give a speech, was still full of ambition or worried. When AP Chinese classes gradually enter the curriculum of public high schools in the United States, Chinese schools will not only face a lack of students, but also a loss of excellent teachers. Chinese schools that only teach Chinese characters will be in danger of closing. This seems alarmist and even inappropriate, especially at a time when Chinese culture is spreading across the world with the help of Mr. Kong’s reputation. But the cruel thing is that in the celebration of peace and prosperity, people easily ignore that Chinese schools in some areas of the United States are facing closure and bankruptcy.

e9ae34dd60601ed7714fbfeab0ca78eba66e405e.sourceText: 原祖筍中文学校校长雷宏教授提出了海外中文学校挽留师资人才的新思路。他认为现在来美读书的中国学生越来越多，中文学校也应该成为他们了解海外华人和当地融合，并且了解当地文化的一个窗口。这样的好处还可以时时地为中文学校的教师提供源源不断的后备人才，也可以让久居海外的华人教师不断接受母国语言的地气。一旦这个人才互动设想运转起来，中文学校的师资储备将会得到较大的改善。
e9ae34dd60601ed7714fbfeab0ca78eba66e405e.translatedText: Professor Lei Hong, the former principal of Zusun Chinese School, proposed new ideas for retaining teaching talents in overseas Chinese schools. He believes that more and more Chinese students are coming to the United States to study, and Chinese schools should also become a window for them to understand overseas Chinese and local integration, and to understand local culture. Such benefits can also provide a steady stream of reserve talents for teachers in Chinese schools, and also allow Chinese teachers who have lived overseas for a long time to continuously accept the flavor of their mother country's language. Once this talent interaction idea is put into operation, the teacher reserve of Chinese schools will be greatly improved.

d522f4f7b42069e85b681fd0214c0a88fb85de58.sourceText: 陈普博士关于教材的想法也极具特色。他认为，与其在暨南立平和传统和现在理念上纠结，不如以唐诗宋词为教材，教出一代熟谙中国传统文化经典的海外华人青年学生来。看起来这个目标离海外中文教学有点距离，但一切都是事在人为，只要编出一套以唐诗宋词为基础的，适合初中高海外学生学习的基本教材来，修养素质和文字的教育是完全可以统一的。你我他，上下来去的基本文字同样可以在由唐宋诗词的文字和历史知识中展现。话题由中国的电视节目《中国好诗词》继续延伸，陈普博士与前祖筍中文学校校长赵萍都由此感慨不已，假如我们的学生也有这样的谈吐和素质，或退一步说，我们的家长和学生都喜欢这样的节目，而不是热衷只靠吼的好声音之类的节目，海外中文学校的学生文化和素质教育的提高就可望又可及，指日可待了。
d522f4f7b42069e85b681fd0214c0a88fb85de58.translatedText: Dr. Chen Pu’s ideas on teaching materials are also very unique. He believes that instead of struggling with the traditional and current concepts of Jinan's peace, it is better to use Tang poetry and Song poetry as teaching materials to teach a generation of overseas Chinese young students who are familiar with the classics of Chinese traditional culture. It seems that this goal is a bit far away from overseas Chinese teaching, but everything depends on human effort. As long as a set of basic teaching materials based on Tang poetry and Song lyrics is compiled and suitable for junior high school and high school overseas students to learn, the education of literacy and literacy can be completely unified. You, me and him, the basic words of up and down can also be shown in the text and historical knowledge of Tang and Song poetry. The topic continued from the Chinese TV program "Chinese Good Poetry". Dr. Chen Pu and the former principal of Zusun Chinese School Zhao Ping were deeply moved by this. If our students also have such conversation and quality, or to say the least, our parents and students like this kind of program instead of being keen on programs such as "The Voice", the improvement of the culture and quality education of students in overseas Chinese schools will be within reach and just around the corner.

88d879b1f7c6a94409943e89cb1a9cd1b598178a.sourceText: 祖筍中文学校 65 周年纪念给我们的思索是多方面和深远的。只要既有主意，又坚持执行力，祖筍中文学校可以从 65 年前走到现在，她也一定能从现在走向更精彩的未来。
88d879b1f7c6a94409943e89cb1a9cd1b598178a.translatedText: The 65th anniversary of Zusun Chinese School has given us many aspects and far-reaching thoughts. As long as she has an idea and persists in execution, Zusun Chinese School can go from 65 years ago to the present, and she will definitely be able to go from the present to a more exciting future.

dc6a0c51a9489f43839f8ed22c6c5217d319efc8.sourceText: ASU孔子学院：“犹太难民在上海，1933—1941” 亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院将联合…
dc6a0c51a9489f43839f8ed22c6c5217d319efc8.translatedText: ASU Confucius Institute: "Jewish Refugees in Shanghai, 1933-1941" The Confucius Institute at Arizona State University will jointly...

a51ff75fb9be642a30ea67f6a6d755437ae207af.sourceText: 亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院将联合主办主题旅行展览：
a51ff75fb9be642a30ea67f6a6d755437ae207af.translatedText: The Confucius Institute at Arizona State University will jointly host a themed traveling exhibition:

cc1c48bcf6ee3639607ad81492cb52597d8e5690.sourceText: 亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院、亚利桑那州立大学犹太研究中心和亚利桑那犹太历史社团 将联合举办一场主题为”犹太难民在上海, 1933-1941”的旅行展览。本次展览位于Cultler-Plotkin Jewish Heritage Center，展览时间为10月18日至12月15日。亚利桑那州犹太历史社团的成员，学生以及现役军人免费入场。
cc1c48bcf6ee3639607ad81492cb52597d8e5690.translatedText: The Confucius Institute at Arizona State University, the Center for Jewish Studies at Arizona State University, and the Arizona Jewish Historical Society will jointly host a traveling exhibition with the theme "Jewish Refugees in Shanghai, 1933-1941." This exhibition is located at the Cultler-Plotkin Jewish Heritage Center and will be on view from October 18 to December 15. Admission is free to members of the Arizona Jewish Historical Society, students and active duty military.

0707c36657a3f51f6c6e16b8a055458f2921d4e3.sourceText: ”犹太难民在上海，1933?941”记录了纳粹大屠杀时期发生在上海的一段独特故事。 超过18000名犹太避难者通过各种渠道获得了准许离开欧洲的文件，并辗转到了上海这个当时几乎唯一的开放城市。他们在上海读书、工作、结婚、生子，生活虽然贫穷，却保全了生命。在这段独特的时期，他们和普通中国百姓互相沟通交流，谱写了一段段感人的友谊乐章。
0707c36657a3f51f6c6e16b8a055458f2921d4e3.translatedText: "Jewish Refugees in Shanghai, 1933-941" records a unique story that happened in Shanghai during the Nazi Holocaust. More than 18,000 Jewish refugees obtained documents allowing them to leave Europe through various channels, and moved to Shanghai, almost the only open city at the time. They study, work, get married, and have children in Shanghai. Although they live in poverty, they have saved their lives. During this unique period, they communicated with ordinary Chinese people and composed touching chapters of friendship.

8f4d5c1976406489ada4592bb5c450ff5c0e265d.sourceText: 本次展览将于10月18日下午5点在Cutler-Plotkin Jewish Heritage Center举行隆重的开幕餐会，观众不但可以享用传统的犹太美食和中国食物，届时还将有来自威斯康辛大学的Weijia Li教授将为大家带来开幕讲座”在妥拉和道德经之间：上海犹太人流亡写作中欧洲－犹太－中国的文化邂逅”
8f4d5c1976406489ada4592bb5c450ff5c0e265d.translatedText: This exhibition will have a grand opening banquet at the Cutler-Plotkin Jewish Heritage Center at 5 pm on October 18. Not only can the audience enjoy traditional Jewish food and Chinese food, there will also be Weijia from the University of Wisconsin. Professor Li will give you the opening lecture "Between the Torah and the Tao Te Ching: European-Jewish-Chinese cultural encounters in Shanghai Jewish exile writing"

3ece6f9b72880ae8b946f6a8399d931ae124988c.sourceText: 本次展览汇集了上海犹太难民纪念馆提供的当时的照片、证件、工艺品，并且还特别邀请到了那段历史的几位亲历者参与本次展览的各项活动。在展览期间陆续会有专家文化讲座、电影展播、读书会等各类活动。同时，其它相关展品也将会在亚利桑那州立大学Tempe校区的Hayden图书馆展出。
3ece6f9b72880ae8b946f6a8399d931ae124988c.translatedText: This exhibition brings together photos, documents, and artifacts from the time provided by the Shanghai Jewish Refugee Memorial Museum, and also specially invited several people who experienced that period of history to participate in various activities of this exhibition. During the exhibition, there will be various activities such as expert cultural lectures, film screenings, and reading clubs. At the same time, other related exhibits will also be on display at the Hayden Library on the Tempe campus of Arizona State University.

f0aec8f5feefc9c69bddbfabbddd448439bf2387.sourceText: 关于本次展览各项活动的具体时间和地点，请参见活动海报，或者登录亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院网站 http://confuciusinstitute.asu.edu/portal/JewishShanghaiExhibit 。
f0aec8f5feefc9c69bddbfabbddd448439bf2387.translatedText: For the specific time and location of various activities in this exhibition, please see the event poster, or log on to the website of the Confucius Institute at Arizona State University at http://confuciusinstitute.asu.edu/portal/JewishShanghaiExhibit.

ccef6243c21921b7d4fd6e6fd7d359232b5839d4.sourceText: 美北亚利桑那大学再爆枪击案致1死3伤 18岁枪手被捕
ccef6243c21921b7d4fd6e6fd7d359232b5839d4.translatedText: Another shooting at Northern Arizona University in the United States left one dead and three injured, and an 18-year-old gunman was arrested

12e741f2f9a32d3cc61a956b75981f31b0427678.sourceText: 美北亚利桑那大学再爆枪击案致1死3伤 18岁枪手被捕 就在美国俄勒冈州一所社区大学发生10死9伤枪击案后…
12e741f2f9a32d3cc61a956b75981f31b0427678.translatedText: Another shooting at Northern Arizona University left one dead and three injured, and an 18-year-old gunman was arrested Just a week after a shooting that killed 10 people and injured 9 people at a community college in Oregon, USA...

7512a7f12a0049f70a4e17393bfb7f0ccce2d0d6.sourceText: 就在美国俄勒冈州一所社区大学发生10死9伤枪击案后一周，亚利桑那州北亚利桑那大学（NAU）9日凌晨又发生致命枪击案，造成1死3伤，18岁的枪手已被警方逮捕。
7512a7f12a0049f70a4e17393bfb7f0ccce2d0d6.translatedText: Just a week after a shooting case that killed 10 people and injured 9 people at a community college in Oregon, another fatal shooting occurred at Northern Arizona University (NAU) in Arizona in the early morning of the 9th, leaving 1 dead and 3 injured. The 18-year-old gunman has been arrested by the police.

5bc0bbb3674b92f24455d1d327d4aa5992e55a62.sourceText: 北亚利桑那大学公共关系主任辛蒂?#24067;朗(Cindy Brown)证实，枪击于9日凌晨发生在弗拉格斯塔夫校区山景厅宿舍外的停车场。警方于1时20分左右接到报警电话。
5bc0bbb3674b92f24455d1d327d4aa5992e55a62.translatedText: Cindy Brown, director of public relations at Northern Arizona University, confirmed that the shooting occurred in the parking lot outside the Mountain View Hall dormitory on the Flagstaff campus in the early morning of the 9th. The police received a call at around 1:20.

ba2ec2adc4a16d6c6b8edc80fe47bfebe3ffd3f3.sourceText: 校园警察局警长福勒(G.T. FOWLER)确认，18岁新生史蒂芬?#29756;斯(Steven Jones)在两群男学生发生对峙后开枪，共造成1人死亡，3人受伤，?#20960;分钟之内一切都平静下来?#65292;警方已将琼斯拘捕。
ba2ec2adc4a16d6c6b8edc80fe47bfebe3ffd3f3.translatedText: Campus Police Chief G.T. FOWLER confirmed that 18-year-old freshman Steven Jones opened fire after a confrontation between two groups of male students, killing one person and injuring three others. Within minutes, everything calmed down. The police had arrested Jones.

73fb17e9a42927d31228436d09047ea50dbfa1a7.sourceText: 伤者均被送往弗拉格斯塔夫医疗中心接受救治。福勒还不能确定幸存者的状况，但表示每个人都有枪伤。
73fb17e9a42927d31228436d09047ea50dbfa1a7.translatedText: The injured were taken to Flagstaff Medical Center for treatment. Fowler could not yet determine the conditions of the survivors but said each had gunshot wounds.

da2dffcf80e8c94eec2456bf0e0d1aa1ffc0b640.sourceText: 学校官方网站称，这是一起”孤立的、史无前例的”事件，校区状况稳定且没有被封锁，9日的课程正常进行。
da2dffcf80e8c94eec2456bf0e0d1aa1ffc0b640.translatedText: The school's official website stated that this was an "isolated and unprecedented" incident. The campus was in stable condition and was not blocked. Courses on the 9th were conducted normally.

5a1fc9e781ba481080c1f8fcb368d7e6c113ef24.sourceText: 学生玛利亚 冈萨雷斯(Maria Gonzalez)说，她起初听到动静以为是鞭炮，”当时我正为一个测验而学习中，我看见窗外两个人在跑，那时我才意识到不是烟花而是枪声。我在学习的地方都不能感觉到安全了。”
5a1fc9e781ba481080c1f8fcb368d7e6c113ef24.translatedText: Student Maria Gonzalez said that she thought it was firecrackers when she heard the noise at first, "I was studying for a test at the time, and I saw two people running outside the window. That's when I realized it was not fireworks but gunshots. I couldn't feel safe where I was studying."

b50fdd4d95352f01b469dc876691e95b814d3905.sourceText: 另一名已经就寝的大三学生梅根?#38463;道尔(Megan Aardahl)说，她被学校发送的警示枪击的短信唤醒，学生们有些惊慌，”这里是个巨大的社区，因此每个人都想确认彼此的安全。”
b50fdd4d95352f01b469dc876691e95b814d3905.translatedText: Megan Doyle, another junior who had gone to bed. Aardahl said she was awakened by a text message sent by the school warning of the shooting, and the students were a little panicked. "This is a huge community, so everyone wants to make sure each other is safe."

e9455c1e69e978b60f310a94adba88f894c999ab.sourceText: 大学警方正密切配合弗拉格斯塔夫警察部门，对此案展开进一步调查。
e9455c1e69e978b60f310a94adba88f894c999ab.translatedText: University police are working closely with the Flagstaff Police Department to further investigate the case.

336257cd88bd2f0428bdaab794571951097ac7c1.sourceText: 北亚利桑那大学在该州北部城市弗拉格斯塔夫扮演者重要的角色，这所4年制公立大学有超过25000名本科生。
336257cd88bd2f0428bdaab794571951097ac7c1.translatedText: Northern Arizona University plays an important role in Flagstaff, a city in the northern part of the state. This 4-year public university has more than 25,000 undergraduate students.

adedc391d47c096f1dbb9916d15004f43dbf5439.translatedText: The shooting occurred on the same day that US President Obama visited Oregon to meet with the families of the victims and the injured in the community college shooting. On October 1, 26-year-old Chris Harper Mercer, wearing a bulletproof suit and carrying six guns, entered Umpqua Community College and opened fire on school personnel, killing eight students and one teacher and injuring nine others. He then exchanged gunfire with police who rushed to the scene and eventually shot himself.

bc8e3a852aed63189853a5be43f6e7469e30a519.sourceText: Scottsdale长城中医诊所，我们给​的比你想象的更多! 转眼又到一年金秋，亚利桑那迎来了这晴空万里、金风送爽的季节。然而，秋季也是流感、各类过敏和不适的高发时段，请各位同胞注意添加衣物，保持良好的生活习惯。 位于Scottsdale，离Tempe校区仅十几分钟路程的的长城中医（Great Wall Chinese Medicine），作为亚利桑医术精湛、规模领先、服务至上的中医诊所，从2006年创立至今一直竭诚为患者服务。 长城中医诊所治疗头痛肩背不适、失眠压力、减肥增肌、青春痘、游戏综合症、经期前综合症、月经不调等常见疾病有显著效果。此外，诊所可提供血液检查、影像检查诊断报告，当你因任何身体不适耽误学业，工作，长城中医诊所可为你提供相应证明，争取到学校、单位的理解。 长城中医的执业中医师、执照针灸师萧医师、韩医师有25年丰富的医疗经验，擅长疑难杂病的诊治和身体的调养护理。 专业推拿理疗师刘医生和胡医生擅长传统中医推拿理疗、足底按摩等等。 此外，长城中医还提供：足浴、拔罐、刮痧、超声波、电针、艾灸等综合全面的传统中医治疗和服务。 如果你有任何身体不适、或者身体保健需求，请随时与我们联系，长城中医讲全心全意为你的健康护航。 Great Wall Chinese Medicine 长城中医诊所
bc8e3a852aed63189853a5be43f6e7469e30a519.translatedText: Scottsdale Great Wall Traditional Chinese Medicine Clinic, we give more than you imagine! 3d35ae59766bc61b8ebcbe44a723e627645f9ee5.sourceText: As an artist, Ai Weiwei is no stranger to controversy and art as an act of subversive creation. As both an artist and social activist, Ai Weiwei has been openly critical of the Chinese government’s stance on democracy and their long record of human-rights violations. As a result of his criticisms and investigation of the government抯 corruption and cover-ups, he was held for 81 days at an undisclosed location in 2011. Following four years of house arrest, Chinese authorities returned his passport, enabling him to flee China for Germany, with his wife and son, where he continued his artistic practice.

Critically acclaimed national and international exhibitions are shown alongside the Museum抯 permanent collection of more than 18,000 works of American, Asian, European, Latin American, Western American, modern and contemporary art, and fashion design. The Museum also presents festivals, a comprehensive film program, live performances and educational programs designed to enlighten, entertain and stimulate visitors of all ages.
