e46ab704b32aa5641d17edaa0db76de29fbab5bf.sourceText: 《飞虎战魂》新书于9月18日出版 Chronicles of Heroic Arizona Chinese-American Servicemen of World War II 在第二次世界大战期间，美国亚利桑那州有七十多名华裔弟子应徵参军。他们勇赴中国战场，亚太战场和欧洲战场。其中有五名军人牺牲，有六位华裔军人回到祖国抗日前线，多位参加了＂美国陆军第十四航空队＂，成为＂飞虎队＂的队员。亚省华裔军人的战迹遍佈世界，他们屡建战功，事迹永远激励后人！籍此＂纪念反法西斯战争暨中国抗战胜利70周年＂之际，作者以汇集出书的形式向他们表达最衷心的感谢和崇高的敬意！ 亚省华裔军人参加过许多重大的战役。《飞虎战魂》内容是以＂飞虎队＂为主线，把英雄战事及当年的时代背景结合起来描述，以感受华裔军人的英雄气概。书中还纪录了在那个不能忘却的年代，美国的华侨以及凰凰城的华人先辈们同仇敌忾，成立了抗日救亡组织，为祖国的抗战胜利作出过积极的贡献！ 《飞虎战魂》是经过多年的资料搜集、校阅、汇编而成。在此期间，作者採访过多位曾参加过二次世界大战的华裔军人，参阅了大量有关二次大战的材料，其中得到了飞虎队队员、欧洲战场老兵及其它华侨前辈的大力支持。他们提供了珍贵的资料，其中包括有书籍、相片、报纸、杂志等等，部分还是抗战时期的刊物。就此角度而言，《飞虎战魂》也是一本关于二次大战资料的通缩读本，值得阅读和收藏。 《飞虎战魂》由张肇鸿编着，陈普为书名提字，郑弘提供封底艺术照片，孙涧萍设计制作。书稿已被中国云南昆明＂飞虎会＂收为馆藏，＂中国华侨历史博物馆＂已发给珍藏品之荣誉証书。特别选择在9月18日出版发行，是为了牢记历史，不忘国耻；珍惜和平，面向未来。对于广大侨胞和众多团体的大力支持和鼓励，作者在此致以最衷心的鸣谢！ 张肇鸿 敬书 2015年9月18日 ( 新书为限量版， 订购电邮：homerzhang@hotmail.com )
e46ab704b32aa5641d17edaa0db76de29fbab5bf.translatedText: The new book "Flying Tiger Fighting Spirit" was published on September 18th Chronicles of Heroic Arizona Chinese-American Servicemen of World War II During World War II, more than seventy Chinese disciples from Arizona in the United States enlisted to join the army. They bravely went to the Chinese battlefield, the Asia-Pacific battlefield and the European battlefield. Five of the soldiers died, six Chinese soldiers returned to the anti-Japanese front line of their motherland, and many joined the "Fourteenth Air Force of the United States Army" and became members of the "Flying Tigers". The battle deeds of Chinese-American soldiers in Alberta can be seen all over the world. They have repeatedly made military exploits and their deeds will always inspire future generations! On this occasion of "commemorating the 70th anniversary of the victory of the Anti-Fascist War and China's Anti-Japanese War", the author expresses his most heartfelt gratitude and high respect to them in the form of a collection of books! Chinese soldiers in Alberta have participated in many major battles. The content of "Flying Tiger Fighting Spirit" is based on the "Flying Tigers" as the main line, combining the description of heroic wars with the historical background of that year to feel the heroic spirit of Chinese-American soldiers. The book also records that in that unforgettable era, the overseas Chinese in the United States and the Chinese ancestors in Huanghuang City shared the same hatred of the enemy, established anti-Japanese and national salvation organizations, and made positive contributions to the victory of the motherland's Anti-Japanese War! "Flying Tiger Fighting Spirit" is compiled after years of data collection, review and compilation. During this period, the author interviewed many Chinese soldiers who participated in World War II and read a large amount of materials about World War II. He received strong support from members of the Flying Tigers, veterans of the European battlefields and other overseas Chinese seniors. They provided precious information, including books, photos, newspapers, magazines, etc., some of which were publications from the Anti-Japanese War period. From this perspective, "Flying Tiger Fighting Spirit" is also a deflationary book about World War II materials, which is worth reading and collecting. "Flying Tiger Fighting Spirit" is edited by Zhang Zhaohong, Chen Pu suggested the title of the book, Zheng Hong provided the back cover art photo, and Sun Jianping designed and produced it. The manuscript has been collected by the "Flying Tiger Club" in Kunming, Yunnan, China, and the "China Overseas Chinese History Museum" has issued a certificate of honor as a collection. It was specially chosen to be published and distributed on September 18 in order to remember history and not forget the national humiliation; cherish peace and face the future. The author would like to express his most heartfelt thanks to the overseas Chinese and many groups for their strong support and encouragement! Respected book by Zhang Zhaohong September 18, 2015 (The new book is a limited edition, order email: homerzhang@hotmail.com)

c3928b9c637313a9b8e23b251c6e23993fbd919c.sourceText: 在历届学校董事会和校委会的领导下，在广大教师和学生，家长以及众多志愿者的不懈努力下，现代中文学校已经走过了卓有成效的19个年头，成功地迈入充满希望的第20个年头。如今，现代中文学校已经成为凤凰城中文教学，中华文化传播，华人社区活动的中心。学校目前已经形成了自己独特的办学模式，多样化的文化传播方式以及多功能并且极具特色的社区活动形式。
c3928b9c637313a9b8e23b251c6e23993fbd919c.translatedText: Under the leadership of successive school boards and school committees, and with the unremitting efforts of teachers and students, parents and many volunteers, Modern Chinese School has gone through a fruitful 19 years and successfully entered a promising 20th year. Today, Modern Chinese School has become the center of Chinese teaching, Chinese culture dissemination, and Chinese community activities in Phoenix. The school has now formed its own unique school-running model, diversified cultural communication methods, and multi-functional and distinctive community activities.

c3b7fcf372554bb839ec5abc5ca3231a7169c720.sourceText: 现代中文学校师资力量雄厚，课程设计齐全，教学方式多样化，充分满足了凤凰城华人华侨学龄儿童学习中文的特殊需求。学校的大部分中文老师都有大学本科以上的学历，很多老师持有亚利桑那州中小学教育资格证书。
c3b7fcf372554bb839ec5abc5ca3231a7169c720.translatedText: Modern Chinese School has strong teaching staff, complete curriculum design and diversified teaching methods, which fully meets the special needs of overseas Chinese school-age children in Phoenix to learn Chinese. Most of the Chinese teachers in the school have a bachelor's degree or above, and many teachers hold Arizona primary and secondary education qualification certificates.

10eb6af8c8671c0532185a085470900f0a404490.sourceText: 为了探索和尝试不同风格的中文教学,现代中文学校分别采用了马立平和暨南大学的中文教材，并且提供双语课，力求让家长和学生可以灵活选择不同的教材和课程，以满足不同学生的学习需求。学校本着提供全方位教育服务的宗旨，除了开设各类中文课程外，还开设了小学，初中以及高中各个年级的数学课程。这些课程的设置极大地满足了本地华人社区注重数理教育的特殊需求，目前已经成为学生们在常规学校数学基础教育之外的重要补充。其他各类选修课程，从华语儿歌到各类科目的AP课程，都最大限度地满足了学生们各个层次的学习要求。
10eb6af8c8671c0532185a085470900f0a404490.translatedText: In order to explore and try different styles of Chinese teaching, Modern Chinese School has adopted Chinese teaching materials from Ma Liping and Jinan University respectively, and provides bilingual classes, striving to allow parents and students to flexibly choose different teaching materials and courses to meet the learning needs of different students. In line with the purpose of providing all-round educational services, the school not only offers various Chinese courses, but also offers mathematics courses for various grades in elementary school, junior high school and high school. The setting of these courses has greatly met the special needs of the local Chinese community in mathematics and science education, and has now become an important supplement to students' basic mathematics education in regular schools. Various other elective courses, from Chinese children's songs to AP courses in various subjects, all meet the learning requirements of students at all levels to the greatest extent.

bc14184d6275916707feb62f2a6c74eee5320e9e.sourceText: 现代中文学校非常注重中文教学经验的交流与合作。学校积极鼓励本校教师参与北美地区中文教学的交，积极组织各种教师培训和中文教学创新方面的讲座，鼓励中文老师努力采取寓教于乐的方式进行中文教学，注重培养学生学习汉语的兴趣和主动性。学校提倡并鼓励老师们主动积极地与家长联系，沟通，以及密切配合，使学校的中文教学方式以及教学效果得以不断完善和提高。
bc14184d6275916707feb62f2a6c74eee5320e9e.translatedText: Modern Chinese School attaches great importance to the exchange and cooperation of Chinese teaching experience. The school actively encourages its teachers to participate in exchanges of Chinese teaching in North America, actively organizes various teacher training and lectures on Chinese teaching innovation, encourages Chinese teachers to strive to teach Chinese in an entertaining way, and focuses on cultivating students' interest and initiative in learning Chinese. The school advocates and encourages teachers to proactively contact, communicate and cooperate closely with parents so that the school's Chinese teaching methods and teaching effects can be continuously improved and improved.

9c622926cc90566a868043529863d737b660a727.sourceText: 传播中华文化，服务社区需求，是现代中文学校的另一个突出特点。学校每年都会举办规模宏大的活动庆祝中国的传统节日春节，猜灯谜，舞长龙，发红包这些活动，极大地激发了孩子们学习和了解中国文化的兴趣。现代中文学校也是凤凰城每年中国周的最热心的参加者之一，展出的毛笔字，手工艺品等每年都吸引了大批的社区居民，为推动社区多元化，推广中国文化艺术作出了有目共睹的贡献。
9c622926cc90566a868043529863d737b660a727.translatedText: Spreading Chinese culture and serving community needs is another outstanding feature of modern Chinese schools. The school holds large-scale activities every year to celebrate the Spring Festival, a traditional Chinese festival. Activities such as guessing lantern riddles, dancing the dragon, and handing out red envelopes greatly stimulate the children's interest in learning and understanding Chinese culture. Modern Chinese School is also one of the most enthusiastic participants in the annual China Week in Phoenix. The exhibited calligraphy, handicrafts, etc. attract a large number of community residents every year, making a visible contribution to promoting community diversity and promoting Chinese culture and art.

387c1d18ab2cfc72a202940916f99abfa68a03b1.sourceText: 现代中文学校目前注册学生人数将近600人，每周六都有来自350个家庭的家长们接送孩子上中文学校，是亚省规模最大的中文学校。
387c1d18ab2cfc72a202940916f99abfa68a03b1.translatedText: Modern Chinese School currently has nearly 600 registered students. Parents from 350 families take their children to the Chinese school every Saturday. It is the largest Chinese school in Alberta.

21e5387ff8581d821b419135968478c0a886f686.sourceText: 为了适应每周几百名家长在中文学校集中的现实，历届学校校委会和董事会都主动采取了积极有效的措施，举办能够适合各种不同背景，并且数量庞大的家长队伍的各种活动。各类成人太极拳培训班，成人声乐教育培训班，瑜伽，中国武术，各类幼儿舞蹈，绘画艺术培训班等反映中国文化特色的活动就在这样一个大的背景下产生了。这些活动在一定程度上满足了各位学生家长们的需求，丰富了家长们的业余生活，成为凤凰城本地华人社区活动的一个重要组成部分。因此，现代中文学校也同时成为了传播中华文化的中心，社区华人华侨交流的平台。
21e5387ff8581d821b419135968478c0a886f686.translatedText: In order to adapt to the reality that hundreds of parents gather in Chinese schools every week, successive school committees and boards of directors have taken the initiative to take active and effective measures to organize various activities that are suitable for a large number of parents with different backgrounds. Various adult Tai Chi training classes, adult vocal music education training classes, yoga, Chinese martial arts, various types of children's dance, painting art training classes and other activities that reflect Chinese cultural characteristics came into being under such a large background. These activities meet the needs of students and parents to a certain extent, enrich their spare time life, and have become an important part of the local Chinese community activities in Phoenix. Therefore, modern Chinese schools have also become centers for spreading Chinese culture and platforms for exchanges between Chinese and overseas Chinese in the community.

51253a8b2dc9cb8351c5657677344fb9b3cd429c.sourceText: 亚省现代中文学校迎来了自己从事中文教学，传播中华文化，积极参与华人社区活动的第20个年头。新当选的学校董事会及校委会将继续坚持以往行之有效的教学模式和办学理念，认真总结过去19年的办学经验，勇于探索与创新，继续把学校办成凤凰城中文教学创新，传播中华文化以及社区活动的中心。
51253a8b2dc9cb8351c5657677344fb9b3cd429c.translatedText: >Alberta Modern Chinese School has ushered in its 20th year of teaching Chinese, spreading Chinese culture, and actively participating in Chinese community activities. The newly elected school board and school committee will continue to adhere to the effective teaching model and school running philosophy in the past, carefully summarize the school running experience in the past 19 years, be brave in exploration and innovation, and continue to build the school into a center for Chinese teaching innovation, dissemination of Chinese culture and community activities in Phoenix.

1d60d1e8609329d373c077af660f727177bce712.translatedText: The north, south, east and west rose up together, and the people's power to resist the invaders was boundless. 15

d06b5ab51616c795b6c5987a24c874622a9c87db.sourceText: 荣登麟阁靖寰宇，志耀精忠安海澜。16
d06b5ab51616c795b6c5987a24c874622a9c87db.translatedText: > Honored in Linge Jinghuanyu, Zhiyao Jingzhong An Hailan. 16

d8a98c3a15a3debeb8858e228d53839ff7143b79.sourceText: 江桥首战高邮毕，降虏芷江落日残。
d8a98c3a15a3debeb8858e228d53839ff7143b79.translatedText: >The first battle at Jiangqiao ended with Gaoyou, and they surrendered to Zhijiang as the sun set.

a2fa823b479312d11aefafb1d225f083d5de466a.sourceText: 得道能得天下助，同盟完胜大收官。17
a2fa823b479312d11aefafb1d225f083d5de466a.translatedText: If you succeed, you can get help from the world, and the alliance will end with a complete victory. 17

4f219f75d8e0b2c7eef52c1d25fc81ef3eeb7bef.sourceText: 凤凰涅槃浴烈火，万里腾欢庆凯旋。
4f219f75d8e0b2c7eef52c1d25fc81ef3eeb7bef.translatedText: >The phoenix is ​​resurrected and bathed in fire, and thousands of miles soar to celebrate its triumph.

793c95a21d893c9ff9bbdab762ee30d567bb7170.sourceText: 碧血丹心昭日月，浩然正气壮河山。
793c95a21d893c9ff9bbdab762ee30d567bb7170.translatedText: >The clear blood and red heart illuminate the sun and the moon, and the awe-inspiring and upright rivers and mountains are strong.

b6247ab089609b970fe79d210b9b2067f3c9cbb7.sourceText: 百年雪耻迢迢路，龙见东方震世寰。18
b6247ab089609b970fe79d210b9b2067f3c9cbb7.translatedText: After a hundred years of avenge, the dragon saw the east and shook the world. 18

10c9f0c8ad7d074d1f728ff9e64e5f5a19d556c6.sourceText: 一统殊功仗后起，千秋圆梦着先鞭。
10c9f0c8ad7d074d1f728ff9e64e5f5a19d556c6.translatedText: >The battle for unification will come later, and the eternal dream will come true first.

790d16ed2222cde6d09af72d3b1fbfbf652e092d.sourceText: 幷肩共展鲲鹏志，绘我中华锦绣篇！
790d16ed2222cde6d09af72d3b1fbfbf652e092d.translatedText: Let’s work together to show Kunpeng’s aspirations and paint the splendid chapter of China!

1c83b8a3046210ebb9567ef058b59a0ba68d1850.sourceText: 1．甲午战败，马关条约割台湾于日本。
1c83b8a3046210ebb9567ef058b59a0ba68d1850.translatedText: 1. After the defeat of the Sino-Japanese War, the Treaty of Shimonoseki ceded Taiwan to Japan.

7a70dd5eea722e7c00ae9d2a5a3ac53f0f2ef689.sourceText: 2．”宁赠友邦，不予家奴”、”先安内后攘外”等政策虽冠冕堂皇，实皆对内镇压，对外屈辱。其结果是内忧不断，外患频仍，人民遭殃，国势日疲。
7a70dd5eea722e7c00ae9d2a5a3ac53f0f2ef689.translatedText: 2． Although policies such as "prefer to give gifts to friends rather than domestic slaves" and "first stabilize the country at home and then fight against the outside world" are high-sounding, they are actually suppression at home and humiliation at the outside. The result is constant internal and external troubles, frequent disasters for the people, and growing fatigue of the country.

4c7af5de22ab462b029072c8fe4317e483037da0.sourceText: 3．1931年九月18日寇製造柳条沟事变，进而攻占东三省。面对三万日本关东军，张学良的三十万东北军”奉命”不战而退，拱手将东三省让于日寇。此中国军人之奇耻大辱也。然而，东北军中亦有英雄，如谢珂，黄显声，李杜，马占山等。
4c7af5de22ab462b029072c8fe4317e483037da0.translatedText: 3. On September 18, 1931, the Japanese invaders caused the Liutiaogou Incident and then captured the three eastern provinces. Facing the 30,000 Japanese Kwantung Army, Zhang Xueliang's 300,000 Northeastern Army was "ordered" to retreat without a fight and surrender the three eastern provinces to the Japanese invaders. This is a great shame and humiliation for Chinese soldiers. However, there are also heroes in the Northeast Army, such as Xie Ke, Huang Xiansheng, Li Du, Ma Zhanshan, etc.

794a456dd06d269c8aee9945824d9aa15b80ec84.sourceText: 4．1935年七月，蒋介石命何应钦与日酋梅津美四郎签订塘沽协定，实行所谓”华北五省自治”，出卖华北主权并禁止人民进行抗日活动。
794a456dd06d269c8aee9945824d9aa15b80ec84.translatedText: 4. In July 1935, Chiang Kai-shek ordered He Yingqin to sign the Tanggu Agreement with the Japanese chief Umezu Mishiro, implementing the so-called "autonomy of the five provinces of North China", selling the sovereignty of North China and prohibiting the people from carrying out anti-Japanese activities.

b0615fe7c3d7c8a37082cec36b93f4cca1fe913d.sourceText: 5．1937年冬日寇攻占南京，随后进行了长达数周的肆无忌惮的烧杀抢掠。中国死难者约三十万。
b0615fe7c3d7c8a37082cec36b93f4cca1fe913d.translatedText: 5. In the winter of 1937, the bandits captured Nanjing, and then carried out unscrupulous burning, killing and looting for several weeks. About 300,000 people died in China.

5749bc6f5921e9859a3aa3b7d8760aa79dee5a48.sourceText: 6．日寇使用细菌生化武器，实行”焼光、杀光、抢光”，疯狂对我抗日根据地军民进行扫荡。其罪行罄竹难书。
5749bc6f5921e9859a3aa3b7d8760aa79dee5a48.translatedText: 6． The Japanese invaders used bacterial and biological weapons and carried out "burn them all, kill them all, and rob them all" to frantically raid the soldiers and civilians in our anti-Japanese base areas. His crimes are too numerous to describe.

bebc273b7e40e74e6607f16d9b7d89dababa5153.sourceText: 7．德意日法西斯结成罪恶的轴心国，发动世界大战，企图称霸、瓜分世界。给各国人民带来深重的苦难。据战后统计，死亡总人数约七千万。
bebc273b7e40e74e6607f16d9b7d89dababa5153.translatedText: 7． The German, Italian, and Japanese fascists formed the evil Axis Powers and launched a world war in an attempt to dominate and carve up the world. It has brought severe suffering to people of all countries. According to post-war statistics, the total number of deaths was approximately 70 million.

6b82731ca654260226081e373032fafd070f65e0.sourceText: 8．万人坑在中国有许多处，皆爲日寇所为，是其兽行的罪证。
6b82731ca654260226081e373032fafd070f65e0.translatedText: 8． There are many mass graves in China, all of which were committed by the Japanese invaders and are evidence of their brutal behavior.

763cf5f0f78b050339dd86e74e2549a21ee3ecf6.sourceText: 9． 1936年十二月，张学良、杨虎城于西安兵谏蒋介石，用武力促其停止内战，枪口对外。通过谈判，国共合作抗敌。
763cf5f0f78b050339dd86e74e2549a21ee3ecf6.translatedText: 9． In December 1936, Zhang Xueliang and Yang Hucheng went to Xi'an to challenge Chiang Kai-shek, using force to urge him to stop the civil war. Through negotiations, the Kuomintang and the Communist Party cooperated to fight the enemy.

4983749c2aa5cb4dccb5f5139b8662b044378bb0.sourceText: 10． 延安宝塔山是坚决抗战到底的象徵。《黄河颂》、《大刀进行曲》、《游击队之歌》、《毕业歌》等抗日歌曲及其它文艺形式是鼓舞人民抵抗侵略、争得民族解放的号角。这些抗战歌曲至今仍然焕发着勃勃生机。
4983749c2aa5cb4dccb5f5139b8662b044378bb0.translatedText: 10． Pagoda Mountain in Yan'an is a symbol of resolute resistance to the end. Anti-Japanese songs such as "Ode to the Yellow River", "March of the Broadsword", "Guerrilla Song", "Graduation Song" and other literary and artistic forms are clarion calls to inspire the people to resist aggression and strive for national liberation. These anti-war songs are still full of vitality.

2ac86a4514878e193baf92377f94008717ba3af7.sourceText: 11． 长白山、黑龙江。东三省的救国军、红军、抗联、义勇军等在极其艰苦的条件下首举义旗坚决抗敌，矢志不渝，长达十四年，真可谓惊天地、泣鬼神！抗联第一军军长杨靖宇壮烈殉国后，日寇剖其腹，发现竟无一粒粮食。最早的义勇军军歌是由孙铭武烈士等创作的《辽东血盟救国军军歌》（1931年10月）。田汉、聂耳创作的《义勇军进行曲》诞生于抗战的艰难关头1935年，由苏联作曲家阿龙?#38463;甫夏洛莫夫配器，是抗战电影《风云儿女》的主题歌。美国黑人歌唱家保罗?#32599;伯逊曾翻唱，以此来声援中国人民的革命斗争。这首歌在抗日战争时期已经很流行， 戴安澜将军曾将此歌定为他统领的200师军歌。中华人民共和国成立后将之定为国歌。
2ac86a4514878e193baf92377f94008717ba3af7.translatedText: 11． Changbai Mountain, Heilongjiang. The National Salvation Army, the Red Army, the Anti-Japanese Alliance, and the Volunteer Army in the three eastern provinces raised the flag of rebellion for the first time and resolutely resisted the enemy under extremely difficult conditions. They were determined to resist the enemy for 14 years. It was truly shocking! After Yang Jingyu, commander of the First Anti-Japanese Army, died for his country, the Japanese invaders cut him open and found that there was not a grain of food. The earliest military song of the Volunteer Army was the "Military Song of the Liaodong Blood Alliance National Salvation Army" (October 1931) composed by martyr Sun Mingwu and others. "March of the Volunteers" composed by Tian Han and Nie Er was born in 1935 at the difficult juncture of the Anti-Japanese War. It was orchestrated by Soviet composer Aaron Shalomov and was the theme song of the Anti-Japanese War movie "Children of the Storm". African American singer Paul Burson once sang a cover to express support for the revolutionary struggle of the Chinese people. This song was already very popular during the Anti-Japanese War. General Dai Anlan once designated this song as the military song of the 200th Division he commanded. After the founding of the People's Republic of China, it was designated as the national anthem.

30c6293b84657c2e0aaad4968c79476032bbb970.sourceText: 12． 抗战初期，中国独撑危局，抵抗侵略者。而西方国家则作壁上观。卢沟桥抗战、上海（淞沪）抗战等战役皆因敌强我弱，统帅指挥不当而失利，也是”片面抗战”导致的结果。淞沪抗战虽失利，但前线将士英勇抗敌，以血肉筑干城，彻底粉粹了日寇妄图迅速灭亡中国的狂妄野心。宋哲元、蒋光鼐、蔡廷锴、谢晋元等将士英名不朽。抗日军兴，”地无分南北，人无分老幼，皆有抗战守土之责”。从东北到滇缅的广阔战场上，抗联、远征军、八路军等坚决抗战的中国各路军队和地方武装奋勇杀敌，功在国家。戴安澜、左权等将士典范长存。
30c6293b84657c2e0aaad4968c79476032bbb970.translatedText: 12． In the early days of the Anti-Japanese War, China stood alone in the crisis and resisted the invaders. Western countries, on the other hand, sit on the sidelines. The Marco Polo Bridge Anti-Japanese War, the Shanghai (Songhu) Anti-Japanese War and other battles all failed because the enemy was strong and we were weak, and the commander's command was improper. They were also the result of "one-sided anti-war". Although the Songhu Anti-Japanese War was defeated, the frontline soldiers fought bravely against the enemy and built Qiancheng with their own flesh and blood, which completely shattered the Japanese aggressors' arrogant ambition to quickly destroy China. Song Zheyuan, Jiang Guangnai, Cai Tingkai, Xie Jinyuan and other soldiers are immortal. With the rise of the anti-Japanese army, "the land is divided into north and south, and people, old and young, all have the responsibility to resist and defend the land." On the vast battlefield from Northeast China to Yunnan and Burma, various Chinese armies and local armed forces who resolutely resisted the war, such as the Anti-Japanese Alliance, the Expeditionary Force, and the Eighth Route Army, fought bravely against the enemy and contributed to the country. Examples of soldiers such as Dai Anlan and Zuo Quan will last forever.

85aab942de3a82ec75fe90b5e53a60920cb379e2.sourceText: 13． 毛泽东的《持久战》（1938年）反驳了”战必亡”论和”速胜”论，揭示了战争发展的规律，制定了抗战的方略、形式和阶段，为抗战的最后胜利指明了航向。在正面战场上，中国军队屡败屡战，艰苦卓绝，终于顶住了日军的进攻并能相机取得局部胜利(如李宗仁指挥的台儿庄大捷)。在敌后战场，八路军、新四军、和游击队以弱胜强，越战越强。到1945年，抗战初的三万余红军已发展成百万雄师，并从日寇手中夺回拥有逾一亿人口的大片国土，抗日根据地和游击区绵连成片。十四年抗战的过程基本按《持久战》指出的方向和形式进行。
85aab942de3a82ec75fe90b5e53a60920cb379e2.translatedText: 13． Mao Zedong's "Protracted War" (1938) refuted the theories of "war will lead to destruction" and "quick victory", revealed the law of war development, formulated the strategy, form and stages of the Anti-Japanese War, and charted the course for the final victory of the Anti-Japanese War. On the frontal battlefield, the Chinese army suffered repeated defeats and fought hard, and finally withstood the Japanese attack and was able to achieve partial victory (such as the great victory of Taierzhuang commanded by Li Zongren). On the battlefield behind enemy lines, the Eighth Route Army, New Fourth Army, and guerrillas defeated the strong with the weak, and became stronger as the war progressed. By 1945, the more than 30,000 Red Army troops at the beginning of the Anti-Japanese War had grown into a million-strong army, and had recaptured a large area of ​​land with a population of more than 100 million from the Japanese invaders. Anti-Japanese base areas and guerrilla zones were contiguous. The process of the fourteen-year war of resistance basically followed the direction and form pointed out in "Protracted War".

915cc0f617e77eb8971fdc5f46394c37bbaef5ba.sourceText: 14． 海外华人华侨与祖国同呼吸共命运。海外抗战捐款约占军费的1/3，”保卫中国同盟”宋庆龄领导的”碗饭”运动就是捐款救亡的一个范例。更有千千万万的华侨和台湾同胞直接参加抗战，包括参加服务团，机工团，飞虎队，军队和游击队。还有许多来自世界各国的仁人志士投身中国抗战（如白求恩、中西村、罗伯特?#32918;特、格里戈里 阿里莫维奇 库里申科、柯棣华等），许多人血洒疆场。
915cc0f617e77eb8971fdc5f46394c37bbaef5ba.translatedText: 14. Overseas Chinese and the motherland share the same fate. Overseas anti-war donations accounted for about 1/3 of military expenditures. The "bowl of rice" campaign led by Soong Ching Ling of the "Alliance to Defend China" is an example of donating money to save the nation. Thousands of overseas Chinese and Taiwanese compatriots directly participated in the Anti-Japanese War, including service corps, mechanical engineering corps, Flying Tigers, army and guerrillas. There were also many people with lofty ideals from all over the world who joined China's Anti-Japanese War (such as Bethune, Nakasaimura, Robert Special, Grigory Alimovich Kurishenko, Kotnis, etc.), and many people shed blood on the battlefield.

042f34ccd54f46518908533141c4a86a0f574215.sourceText: 15． ”兵民乃胜利之本”。正面战场和敌后战场奠定了取得最终胜利的基本军事态势。建立最广泛的抗日统一战线，实行全民抗战形成了陷敌于灭顶之灾的人民战争的汪洋大海。
042f34ccd54f46518908533141c4a86a0f574215.translatedText: 15． "The soldiers and the people are the foundation of victory." The frontal battlefield and the battlefield behind enemy lines established the basic military posture for final victory. The establishment of the broadest anti-Japanese united front and the implementation of the nationwide resistance war formed a vast ocean of people's war that plunged the enemy into disaster.

34e20db242c3a97080f994b0ac4c6efd51ba0f4e.sourceText: 16． 国家民政部公布的第一批300着名抗日烈士和群体名录是有名的和无名的烈士们的杰出代表。这份名录还包括了来自苏、美、加、日等国的抗战烈士。童长荣、陈荣久、赵登禹、佟麟阁、洪麟阁、朱家麟、杨靖宇、杨靖远、陈宇寰、赵尚志、高志航、闻允志、马耀南、邓永耀、苏精诚、张自忠、罗忠毅、易安华、阎海文、刘海涛、廖海涛、洪镇海、戴安澜等千千万万的英雄烈士永垂不朽!英雄的精神永远鼓舞着中华儿女团结向前进。而以国民党副总裁汪精卫和伪满皇帝溥仪为首的叛国投敌、为虎作伥的政客、将领以及一百余万伪军则永远被钉在历史的耻辱柱上！
34e20db242c3a97080f994b0ac4c6efd51ba0f4e.translatedText: 16． The first batch of 300 famous anti-Japanese martyrs and groups published by the Ministry of Civil Affairs is an outstanding representative of famous and unknown martyrs. This list also includes anti-war martyrs from the Soviet Union, the United States, Canada, Japan and other countries. Tong Changrong, Chen Rongjiu, Zhao Dengyu, Tong Linge, Hong Linge, Zhu Jialin, Yang Jingyu, Yang Jingyuan, Chen Yuhuan, Zhao Shangzhi, Gao Zhihang, Wen Yunzhi, Ma Yaonan, Deng Yongyao, Su Jingcheng, Zhang Zizhong , Luo Zhongyi, Yi Anhua, Yan Haiwen, Liu Haitao, Liao Haitao, Hong Zhenhai, Dai Anlan and other thousands of heroes and martyrs will be immortal! The heroic spirit will always inspire the Chinese people to unite and move forward. However, the politicians, generals and more than one million puppet troops who rebelled against the country and surrendered to the enemy, led by the Vice President of the Kuomintang Wang Jingwei and the Puppet Manchukuo Emperor Puyi, as well as the more than one million puppet troops who helped the enemy, will forever be nailed to the pillar of shame in history!

96e0fc0c6cc09859139add0d07d5b4d4046afa4d.sourceText: 17． 抗战的第一枪是在黑龙江省的嫩江江桥打响（1931年十月），当时的省防军指挥官是抗日英雄谢珂和马占山。抗战的最后一战是新四军陶勇、姬鹏飞部攻取高邮（1945年十二月）。芷江是日军代表今井武夫向中国政府代表萧毅肃递交无条件投降降书的地方（1945年八月21日）。中国抗战是世界反法西斯战争的主战场之一，得到了世界人民的支持。苏美英中结成了反法西斯同盟，终于打败了德意日。现代中国的崛起正是萌于辛亥革命和十四年艰苦卓绝的抗日战争。
96e0fc0c6cc09859139add0d07d5b4d4046afa4d.translatedText: 17． The first shot of the Anti-Japanese War was fired at the Nen River Bridge in Heilongjiang Province (October 1931). The provincial defense army commanders at that time were anti-Japanese heroes Xie Ke and Ma Zhanshan. The last battle of the Anti-Japanese War was when Tao Yong and Ji Pengfei of the New Fourth Army captured Gaoyou (December 1945). Zhijiang is the place where Takeo Imai, the representative of the Japanese army, submitted an unconditional surrender letter to Xiao Yisu, the representative of the Chinese government (August 21, 1945). China's Anti-Japanese War was one of the main battlefields in the world's anti-fascist war and received support from people around the world. The Soviet Union, the United States, Britain and China formed an anti-fascist alliance and finally defeated Germany, Italy and Japan. The rise of modern China originated from the Revolution of 1911 and the fourteen-year arduous War of Resistance Against Japan.

4878219a42fa52d8ff3672a67ca1f322783170dd.sourceText: 18． 易经乾卦九二曰：见龙在田，利见大人。抗战胜利是中华崛起的”龙抬头”。
4878219a42fa52d8ff3672a67ca1f322783170dd.translatedText: 18. Qian Gua 92 of the Book of Changes says: Seeing a dragon in the field is a good way to meet a great person. The victory of the Anti-Japanese War was the "dragon raising its head" for China's rise.

bfd0428a7448feaebbbb89cc5c5c67414b8e7d11.sourceText: 【反法西斯胜利70周年亚省特刊】慧明：中日不可能建立睦邻关系

0268080c31bcd86b1dd6398b53c904b090228b90.sourceText: 【凤凰笔会】慧明 说到这个题目，无论中国已故总理周恩来还是日本前首相田中角荣，都会从他们现在的归宿地赶来，对笔者抨击有加。因为近代的中日睦邻口号是他们一唱一和搞起来的。也无可厚非，在那时那场对两国百姓都有巨大伤害的中日战争已经结束了将近20年，两国民间的往来，特别是经济上的往来已经增多，民间从情感上似乎出现了一种厌战和睦邻的情绪。用简单的话说，那时谁都不愿意出门看见一个整天虎着脸的隔壁邻居。就这样，两国总理和首相互送秋波，到1972年便出现了战后的建交了。
0268080c31bcd86b1dd6398b53c904b090228b90.translatedText: [Phoenix Pen Club] Huiming When it comes to this topic, both the late Chinese Prime Minister Zhou Enlai and the former Japanese Prime Minister Tanaka Kakuei will come from their current places of destination to criticize the author. Because the slogan of Sino-Japanese good-neighborliness in modern times was created by them. It is understandable that at that time, the Sino-Japanese war, which had caused great harm to the people of both countries, had ended for nearly 20 years. People-to-people exchanges between the two countries, especially economic exchanges, had increased, and there seemed to be a feeling of war weariness and good neighborliness among the people. To put it simply, no one wanted to go out and see a neighbor next door who had a tiger face all day long. In this way, the prime ministers and prime ministers of the two countries exchanged glances, and by 1972, post-war diplomatic relations were established.

d3b4456622d601784c2ad135a8bbb303cf15abc4.sourceText: 就当时而论，这也许是个创举，特别是中国，忘记前嫌，放弃赔款，大度地与昔日的敌人握手言欢。但从历史的角度而言，这不过是岁月股市的一次高位激情，交替反复震荡乃至跳水才是中日关系的常态。为什么会有这等悲哀论断呢？且听山野居士一一道来。
d3b4456622d601784c2ad135a8bbb303cf15abc4.translatedText: At the time, this may have been a pioneering move, especially for China, which forgot its past grievances, gave up reparations, and magnanimously shook hands with its former enemies. But from a historical perspective, this is just a high-level passion in the stock market over the years. It is the normal state of Sino-Japanese relations to alternately fluctuate and even dive. Why is there such a sad conclusion? Let's listen to the lay people from the mountains and fields coming one by one.

04187685cf4ca626c77b33bc57e89b9fba59d7c2.sourceText: 大凡有利益所图，而无尊严相待的人之间，虽然也会以朋友相称，但不过是利益联盟成员，是没有友情可言的。国与国之间也是如此。二战期间，日本无端地从东北和上海分别入侵中国，为了标榜自己师出有名，搞出一个”大东亚共荣圈”的提法，要所有被他侵略奴役的国家和民族接受这种欺骗，还大言不惭地谎称只有日本是中国和东亚国家的朋友，美国人是想殖民中国等等。很明显，这是一个以自己国家经济利益为中心的共荣圈，没有实力还手的人和国家会有幸福感吗？
04187685cf4ca626c77b33bc57e89b9fba59d7c2.translatedText: Generally speaking, people who have interests in mind and treat each other without dignity may treat each other as friends, but they are just members of an interest alliance and there is no friendship at all. The same is true between countries. During World War II, Japan invaded China from Northeast China and Shanghai for no reason. In order to show off its reputation as a master, it came up with the concept of a "Greater East Asia Co-Prosperity Sphere" and asked all countries and nations that were invaded and enslaved by Japan to accept this deception. It also blatantly lied that only Japan was a friend of China and East Asian countries, and that the Americans wanted to colonize China, etc. Obviously, this is a co-prosperity circle centered on the economic interests of one's own country. Will people and countries who have no strength to fight back feel happy?

a632fa2dc10e643c8979219074876d3a3491d003.sourceText: 其实，美国人倒从来没有殖民他国的意思，庚子赔款的钱还帮助中国建了京师大学堂。倒是日本，在岛国住久了，为狭隘的地盘和匮缺的资源所累，便异想天开地想扩张，从邻国下手了。从1905起，日本就以护路为由派关东军入住东北，实现他蚕食中国的美梦。到九一八事变后，满清遗老投靠日本后，日本的前陆军大臣南次郎上书天皇，声称将东北建成满洲国，可以移民，可以获得资源，可以向北进攻苏联等。战后这些文件都公布了才让人们明白即便建立满洲国，建立所谓大东亚共荣区，也只是日本野心的一部分，他们的终极目标是灭绝中国，建立日不落帝国。和这种侵略者做朋友，做得成吗？做奴隶吧。
a632fa2dc10e643c8979219074876d3a3491d003.translatedText: In fact, Americans have never meant to colonize other countries. The money from the Boxer Indemnity also helped China build the Capital University. On the other hand, Japan, having lived in the island country for a long time, was burdened by its narrow territory and scarce resources, so it wanted to expand in a whimsical way, starting with neighboring countries. Since 1905, Japan has sent the Kwantung Army to the Northeast on the pretext of protecting roads to realize its dream of encroaching on China. After the September 18th Incident, after the Manchurian elders defected to Japan, Japan's former Army Minister Nanjiro wrote to the emperor, claiming that the Northeast would be built into Manchukuo, where immigrants could be immigrated, resources could be obtained, and the Soviet Union could be attacked northward. After the war, when these documents were released, people understood that even the establishment of Manchukuo and the so-called Greater East Asia Co-Prosperity Area were only part of Japan's ambitions. Their ultimate goal was to annihilate China and establish an empire on which the sun never sets. Is it possible to be friends with such an invader? Be a slave.

3e9fc84a96100dced06c246807d4ab018b0e55e4.sourceText: 日本人从来认为自己是东亚高等民族，只有欧美人才能和自己平起平坐。历史上为了维护自己类似白人的面孔和尊严，日本人可以做瞬间转换的变脸人，向白人摇尾乞怜，怒斥中国人是黄祸。日本有一部电影《人证》说的是一个女议员为了自己现在的地位和面子，杀死了自己年轻时和美军黑人所生的孩子。电影写实地还原了当时的一段历史，但折射的却是整个日本民族自以为高贵的本性。和这种民族交朋友是不可能有实质的进展的。
3e9fc84a96100dced06c246807d4ab018b0e55e4.translatedText: The Japanese have always believed that they are a superior nation in East Asia, and only Europeans and Americans can be on an equal footing with them. Historically, in order to maintain their appearance and dignity similar to that of white people, the Japanese could turn into face-changers in an instant, beg for mercy from white people, and angrily denounce the Chinese as a yellow peril. There is a Japanese movie "Witness" about a female congresswoman who killed the child she had with a black American soldier when she was young for the sake of her current status and face. The movie realistically restores a period of history at that time, but it reflects the noble nature of the entire Japanese nation. It is impossible to make real progress in making friends with this kind of people.

b47098665507b4e0d40fa4c5f40bf170a1cfae3e.sourceText: 朋友的交往、睦邻的国家靠的是互相的尊重和关爱，而不是居高临下的俯瞰或勾心斗角的经济心计。比如现在中国和巴基斯坦的关系就是如此。上个世纪八十年代，日本为援助中国上海的宝山钢铁厂建设给了大量的低息贷款和技术，让国人满意不已。其实，这只是利益所趋的经济往来而已，没有实质的朋友交往。所幸到后来，传出日本在输出他们的过时技术，见中国发展势头强大逐渐就减少贷款数量让国人清醒了不少。
b47098665507b4e0d40fa4c5f40bf170a1cfae3e.translatedText: >Friendly exchanges and good-neighborly countries rely on mutual respect and care, rather than condescending overlooking or economic intrigues. For example, this is the current relationship between China and Pakistan. In the 1980s, Japan provided a large amount of low-interest loans and technology to assist the construction of the Baoshan Iron and Steel Plant in Shanghai, China, which satisfied the Chinese people. In fact, this is just an economic transaction driven by interests, and there is no actual friendship. Fortunately, later, it was reported that Japan was exporting their outdated technology. Seeing China's strong development momentum, it gradually reduced the number of loans, which made the Chinese people sober up.

95e86925254804467538ee97d880f189bb5b4a75.sourceText: 但中国历史上就是有许多不清醒的人，沾沾自喜别人派”遣唐使”之类的人向自己学习什么的，而不清楚日本人为什么而学的目的。结果呢，让有目的的日本学习者在甲午海战中摧毁了中国的北洋舰队。中国古代的经济和军力和管理在当时都属世界领先地位，让别人学去了来打败自己，这算什么睦邻关系？
95e86925254804467538ee97d880f189bb5b4a75.translatedText: But there are many unconscious people in Chinese history who are complacent about others sending people like "envoys to the Tang Dynasty" to learn from them, but they don't know why the Japanese are learning. As a result, purposeful Japanese learners destroyed China's Beiyang Fleet in the Sino-Japanese War of Sino-Japanese War. Ancient China's economy, military power and management were among the world's leaders at that time. What kind of good-neighborly relationship is this if others learn from it to defeat itself?

43a446225bbac81ab855c1569f97736a06cc8abc.sourceText: 就说近代，2000年，日本派了近五千人的访问团号称学习访问中国，这些人都是经济和企业的精英，未来已经预感到中国可能有巨大变化，预先到中国了解情况，为的是在未来十年利用中国市场为日本发展留下后路。且不说日本用低价买下大量的中国煤炭填海，积累资源，就看一下日本的各种品牌的汽车在中国各省市都有自己的分厂，就可以清楚地感觉到，不是中国的汽车业有了发展，而是日本的汽车工业战略在中国大展了宏图。有识之士担忧这样没有了中国自主的汽车了。岂止是没有，日本用汽车实现了战争手段没达到的野心，在汽车工业上摧垮了中国。这种朋友真是不交也罢。
43a446225bbac81ab855c1569f97736a06cc8abc.translatedText: In modern times, in 2000, Japan sent a delegation of nearly 5,000 people on a so-called study visit to China. These people were all economic and business elites. They had foreseen that China might undergo huge changes in the future and went to China to understand the situation in advance in order to use the Chinese market to leave a way for Japan to develop in the next ten years. Not to mention that Japan bought a large amount of Chinese coal at low prices to reclaim land and accumulate resources. If you look at the various Japanese brands of cars that have their own branch factories in various provinces and cities in China, you can clearly feel that it is not China's automobile industry that has developed, but Japan's automobile industry strategy that has made great progress in China. People with insight are worried that there will be no more Chinese independent cars. Not only that, Japan used cars to realize its ambitions that had not been achieved through war methods, and destroyed China in the automobile industry. It’s okay not to make friends like this.

b6d1f33ba21bf361fa035614eb42a0418df707fa.sourceText: 问题是中国还偏要交这样的朋友，2008年，中国也派了六百人的党政官员代表团访问日本，有没有日后将中国的产品推向日本，大家可以想见。现任总理李克强被中国动车厂称为超级推销员，就因为他不忘向外国推销自己国家的优秀产品，而当时的中日青年友好之船之旅却什么目的都没达到，反而给中国青年留下一堆麻烦思维垃圾，要么崇日，从过去的三洋、索尼、日立，到现在的原装汽车，要么心里极度不平衡，为了钓鱼岛砸中国的日系车。过去被日本军事上和肉体的残杀，现在被日本精神上的蹂躏，中国还要和这种国家睦邻干嘛！
b6d1f33ba21bf361fa035614eb42a0418df707fa.translatedText: The problem is that China still wants to make such friends. In 2008, China also sent a delegation of 600 party and government officials to visit Japan. You can imagine whether they will push Chinese products to Japan in the future. The current Prime Minister Li Keqiang is called a super salesman by the China Railway Rolling Stock Factory because he never forgets to promote his country's excellent products to foreign countries. However, the Sino-Japanese Youth Friendship Boat trip at that time did not achieve any goal. Instead, it left a pile of troublesome thinking garbage for Chinese youth. Either they worship Japan, from Sanyo, Sony, and Hitachi in the past to the current original cars, or they are extremely unbalanced and want to destroy Chinese Japanese cars for the sake of the Diaoyu Islands. In the past, Japan was militarily and physically massacred, and now it is being ravaged spiritually by Japan. Why would China want to be a good neighbor to such a country?

b2c0f4d5694fc4731918a5c47f745f7d83b346fd.sourceText: 说到钓鱼岛了。明明是中国的领土，由于中国当政者的软弱和不明确的表态使日本人在这个问题上抢了个先手。这里已经没有丝毫共同协商的睦邻关系了。要想睦邻，就永远地放弃钓鱼岛，但如果要维护自己的国土和主权，就不用考虑那么多的睦邻关系，拿下再说。做个设想，如果当年美军一直驻扎钓鱼岛，小日本会吭气吗？
b2c0f4d5694fc4731918a5c47f745f7d83b346fd.translatedText: Speaking of Diaoyu Islands. It is obviously Chinese territory, but the weakness and unclear stance of the Chinese authorities gave the Japanese a head start on this issue. There is no longer a shred of mutually negotiated good neighborly relations here. If you want to be a good neighbor, you should give up the Diaoyu Islands forever. But if you want to safeguard your own land and sovereignty, you don't need to think so much about good neighborly relations. Let's win it first. Just imagine, if the US military had been stationed on the Diaoyu Islands back then, would Japan have been silent?

e69d7da49b24c6382c0aaf0644176cc4f12b5e7f.sourceText: 所以，对待日本，别做任何睦邻的奢想，丢掉幻想，准备战斗吧。
e69d7da49b24c6382c0aaf0644176cc4f12b5e7f.translatedText: So, when dealing with Japan, don’t have any extravagant thoughts about being a good neighbor. Throw away your illusions and prepare to fight.

3cfe3da89c91791b42f5e3ebdf8bac7188e757c0.sourceText: 一辆卡车副驾驶挡风玻璃周三在高速路上被子弹击中，亚利桑那当局担心这是一起连环枪击事件。 在过去的两个星期当局正在调查9起车辆在１０号高速上被枪击的事件。公共安全局还未确认是否是枪杀，目前，还没有人受伤。其中一个子弹击碎车的挡风玻璃，破碎的玻璃刮伤一个13岁女孩。其他的子弹都打在车辆的前灯或者车辆的两侧。 亚利桑那州州长道格?#36842;塞说：?#20122;利桑那州的安全是我们的首要任务，我们正在致力于逮捕那些对这些罪行负责的人。?BR> 周二，警方宣布，他们正在调查最近发生的五次枪击，其中包括一个被击中的车，是正准备去上班的警察，以及另一个在10号公路上去加油站的白色卡车。他们的挡风玻璃都被子弹击中。 公共安全主任表示这是一起?#22269;内恐怖主义犯罪?肇事者正在向某些人发出示威。公共安全主任在新闻发布会上说：十天九起事件，这是一个真正持续威胁到亚利桑那州驾驶安全的问题。FBI正在协助调查。 警方紧急呼吁民众来协助调查，提供犯罪嫌疑人信息。警方还在高速路旁广告牌上紧急发出提供跟枪击事件悬赏信息。提供有价值信息者，将得到两万美金的奖励。 目前警方不会进一步透露调查的信息，他们也还不知道这九起枪击案是否直接相关，是否是从其他行使车辆射出，或者是高速公路旁射出的。虽然现在还没有人员伤亡，但是这个事件继续持续下去，伤亡只是时间问题。
3cfe3da89c91791b42f5e3ebdf8bac7188e757c0.translatedText: A truck's passenger windshield was struck by a bullet on the highway Wednesday in what Arizona authorities fear was a double shooting. Authorities are investigating nine incidents in which vehicles were shot at on Highway 10 in the past two weeks. The Department of Public Safety has not confirmed whether it was a shooting, and no one has been injured at this time. One of the bullets shattered the car's windshield, and the broken glass scratched a 13-year-old girl. Other bullets hit the vehicle's headlights or sides. "The safety of Arizona is our top priority and we are working to apprehend those responsible for these crimes," said Arizona Governor Doug Se. ?BR> On Tuesday, police announced they were investigating five recent shootings, including one that was struck by a police officer on his way to work and another in a white truck on Route 10 on its way to a gas station. Their windshields were hit by bullets. The Director of Public Safety said this was a domestic terrorism crime and the perpetrators were targeting certain individuals. "Nine incidents in 10 days, this is a real and ongoing threat to driving safety in Arizona," the public safety director said at a news conference. The FBI is assisting in the investigation. The police urgently appealed to the public to assist in the investigation and provide information on the suspects. The police also issued an urgent offer of reward information on billboards on the side of the highway. Anyone who provides valuable information will receive a reward of US$20,000. At this time, police will not disclose further information about the investigation, and they do not yet know whether the nine shootings are directly related, whether they were fired from other vehicles, or from the side of the highway. Although there are no casualties yet, if this incident continues, casualties will only be a matter of time.

2a71aba05e0d2da901caba87d6cda04bb1a0a1da.sourceText: 枪击事件开始于8月29日，在10号高速公路和19 到59 ave 之间，一个半小时内有两辆车被击中。第三辆车在29日的更晚一些被击中,位置在10号高速的16st. 第四辆车是8月31日在相同区域。周二一名去上班的警察在10号高速的35ave和43ave，被击中挡风玻璃。另一次枪击发生在一分钟后。
2a71aba05e0d2da901caba87d6cda04bb1a0a1da.translatedText: The shooting began on August 29, with two vehicles being hit within an hour and a half on Highway 10 between 19 and 59 Ave. A third vehicle was hit later on the 29th, at 16th Street on Highway 10. A fourth vehicle was in the same area on August 31st. A police officer going to work was hit in the windshield on Highway 10 at 35 Ave and 43 Ave on Tuesday. Another shooting occurred a minute later.

3bbb6c7ce94c02bdb0b2023d3598a639ca4b2712.sourceText: （纪念抗战筹委会通讯组来稿， 陈丽君摄影）亚省华人华侨纪念反法西斯及抗战勝利七十周年筹委会継七月七日召开纪念抗日座談会和八月十五日举办中美盟軍共同纪念二次大战勝利庆祝活动之后，八月三十日于假野马赌城剧塲，举行了亚省华人纪念抗战胜利70周年首塲文娛演出。由曾经历过抗日战争峰火和承受过苦难的老人们组成的凤凰城华人耆英会合晿团為纪念活动拉开了序幕。專程被邀请從舊金山远道而来的著名粤剧艺术家和歌唱演員给观众奉献了一台精彩的文艺节目。众多侨领出席了活动，图桑的僑胞们也專程趕来参加了活动，共有700余人参加并观看了演出。大家齐聚一堂，用歌声纪念那段苦难历史，铭记先烈的伟大贡献，传承和弘扬伟大的抗战精神。
3bbb6c7ce94c02bdb0b2023d3598a639ca4b2712.translatedText: (contributed by the Correspondence Group of the Preparatory Committee for the Commemoration of the Anti-Japanese War, Photography by Chen Lijun) The Preparatory Committee of the Chinese in Alberta to Commemorate the 70th Anniversary of the Anti-Fascist and Anti-Japanese War Victory held a symposium to commemorate the Anti-Japanese War on July 7 and held a joint celebration of the victory of the Second World War by the Chinese and American Allies on August 15. On August 30, the first cultural entertainment performance of the Chinese in Alberta to commemorate the 70th anniversary of the Victory of the Anti-Japanese War was held at the Wild Horse Casino Theater. The Phoenix Chinese Elders Reunion Group, composed of elderly people who had experienced the peak of the Anti-Japanese War and suffered hardships, kicked off the commemorative event. Famous Cantonese opera artists and singers who were invited all the way from San Francisco presented a wonderful cultural program to the audience. Many overseas Chinese leaders attended the event, and overseas Chinese from Tucson also made a special trip to attend the event. A total of more than 700 people participated and watched the performance. Everyone gathered together to commemorate that painful history with songs, remember the great contributions of the martyrs, and inherit and carry forward the great anti-Japanese spirit.

80faa100067c1ba49f4827054968e8503318562b.sourceText: 首先出场是凤凰城耆英会的国语合唱团，老人们统一着装，精神焕发，给大家演唱了经典的爱国歌曲《我爱我的祖国》，表达柬北人民流浪思乡的《松花江上) 和反映全國人民决死抗战精神的”保衛黄河” 。耆英会的粤语合唱团演唱了《勇敢的中国人》《万里长城永不倒》《上海滩》，老人们昂扬斗志的演唱，令人心潮澎湃，充分体現了中国人民抵抗外國侵略和振兴中华的壮志豪情。
80faa100067c1ba49f4827054968e8503318562b.translatedText: The first appearance was the Mandarin choir of the Phoenix Senior Citizens Association. The elderly people were uniformly dressed and full of energy. They sang the classic patriotic song "I Love My Motherland", "On the Songhua River" which expressed the homesickness of the people in northern Cambodia, and "Defend the Yellow River" which reflected the desperate spirit of the people across the country. The Cantonese choir of the Senior Citizens Association sang "The Brave Chinese", "The Great Wall Will Never Fall Down" and "Shanghai Beach". The high-spirited singing of the elderly was heart-stirring and fully reflected the Chinese people's ambition to resist foreign aggression and revitalize China.

18d3bea7daeb7ef30d5c7c7ded36661c134a91c8.sourceText: 亚省资深侨领余文劲在大会上致词，首先感谢大家光临今天的活动和对纪念抗战胜利活动的支持，他讲到：抗日战争是中国抵抗日本侵略的一场民族性的全面战争。1937年7月7日，日军在北平附近挑起卢沟桥事变，中日战争全面爆发。日本军国主义在中国犯下了滔天罪行，中国人民奋起反抗，八年时间里，我同胞死伤多达3500万以上，财产损失更是无法估计。自己亲身经历八年抗战，惨不忍睹，刻骨铭心。我们要牢记历史，缅怀英烈，珍惜来之不易的和平，开创美好未来；同时告诫我们的下一代，勿忘国耻，不允许战争悲剧重演，传承不屈不饶的民族精神。
18d3bea7daeb7ef30d5c7c7ded36661c134a91c8.translatedText: Yu Wenjin, a senior overseas Chinese leader in Alberta, delivered a speech at the conference. First of all, he thanked everyone for coming to today's event and supporting the activities to commemorate the victory of the Anti-Japanese War. He said: The Anti-Japanese War was a national comprehensive war for China to resist Japanese aggression. On July 7, 1937, the Japanese army provoked the Marco Polo Bridge Incident near Peking, and the Sino-Japanese war broke out in an all-round way. Japanese militarism committed heinous crimes in China, and the Chinese people rose up to resist. In eight years, more than 35 million of our compatriots were killed or injured, and the property losses were incalculable. I personally experienced the eight years of the Anti-Japanese War, which was horrific and unforgettable. We must keep history in mind, honor the heroes, cherish the hard-won peace, and create a better future; at the same time, we warn our next generation not to forget the national humiliation, not to allow the tragedy of war to recur, and to inherit the indomitable national spirit.

6a60f67cc4394984defdad7ca162c0cf6c235cb0.sourceText: 亚省纪念抗战胜利70周年筹委会主席，前白宫亚太裔委员邓朝驹强调，中华民族70年前那段惊天地、泣鬼神、异常悲壮的抗战历史，决不容许忘记。抗日战争的伟大胜利，先辈们已经给我们树立了良好的榜样，他们用流血牺牲完成了中华民族的一次伟大的历史性转折。纪念历史，就是要正视历史，维护和平的外部环境，实现祖国的伟大民族复兴。
6a60f67cc4394984defdad7ca162c0cf6c235cb0.translatedText: Deng Chaoju, chairman of the provincial organizing committee to commemorate the 70th anniversary of the victory of the Anti-Japanese War and former White House Asian and Pacific Islander Councilor, emphasized that the Chinese nation’s shocking and tragic anti-Japanese war history 70 years ago must never be forgotten. In the great victory of the Anti-Japanese War, our ancestors have set a good example for us. They completed a great historic turning point for the Chinese nation with their bloodshed and sacrifice. Commemorating history means facing history squarely, maintaining a peaceful external environment, and realizing the great national rejuvenation of the motherland.

8ed25f48ef98f677a0ccbfeb29c5d2120dc7c14e.sourceText: 凤凰城侨联副主席崔增祁谈到抗日战争是中华民族历史上一场最伟大的卫国战争，是民族精神的伟大胜利，国家兴亡，匹夫有责。这场战争让我们深刻地认识到一条真理，国弱必受人欺。只有国家的统一，人民的团结，社会的稳定，经济的发展，国力的增强，中国人才会有尊严，中华民族才能𣎴再被人侵略和受人凌辱，才能为世界和平与共同发展做出贡献。祝愿两岸同胞共同携手建设更强大的祖国。他感谢王瑞瑾女士为演出活动所付出的辛勤劳动。并对华人耆英会的老朋友们对纪念抗战表現出极大热惰表示特别的感谢。合唱隊员们人人出资捐助纪念抗战活动，还不辞辛劳地大家练习，精彩地演唱了抗日爱国歌曲。
8ed25f48ef98f677a0ccbfeb29c5d2120dc7c14e.translatedText: >Cui Zengqi, vice chairman of the Phoenix Overseas Chinese Federation, said that the Anti-Japanese War was the greatest patriotic war in the history of the Chinese nation and a great victory for the national spirit. Every man is responsible for the rise and fall of the country. This war made us deeply realize the truth that a weak country will be bullied by others. Only with the unification of the country, the unity of the people, social stability, economic development, and the enhancement of national strength can Chinese people have dignity, can the Chinese nation be invaded and humiliated again, and can it contribute to world peace and common development. I wish compatriots on both sides of the Taiwan Straits will work together to build a stronger motherland. He thanked Ms. Wang Ruijin for her hard work in the performance. I would also like to express my special thanks to the old friends of the Chinese Senior Citizens Association for their great enthusiasm in commemorating the Anti-Japanese War. The chorus members each contributed money to commemorate the Anti-Japanese War activities, worked tirelessly to practice, and sang anti-Japanese patriotic songs wonderfully.

939e9266d8a34035301ffe370d15671b58c00060.sourceText: 来自旧金山华侨文教服务团的演员：谭念帖，欧柳霞，徐曼芝，杨顗衡，於西陵，刘丽平分别合唱、独唱了多首抗战時期家喻户晓的经典國語歌曲、粤语歌曲和美國歌曲。粤剧名家欧柳霞、谭念帖以戲装表演的唐明皇与杨贵妃的爱情故事，扮相俊俏，唱腔纯正，优美动听，充分体现了粤剧”热情如火，缠绵悱恻”的特点，使愛好粤剧的朋友飽享了一㘯文化盛歺，受到台下观众的极大赞赏。
939e9266d8a34035301ffe370d15671b58c00060.translatedText: Actors from the San Francisco Overseas Chinese Cultural and Educational Service Troupe: Tan Niantie, Ou Liuxia, Xu Manzhi, Yang Yiheng, Yu Xiling, and Liu Liping respectively performed choruses and solos of many classic Mandarin, Cantonese and American songs that were well-known during the Anti-Japanese War. Cantonese opera masters Ou Liuxia and Tan Niantie performed in costume the love story of Tang Minghuang and Yang Guifei. They were handsome in appearance, pure in singing, and melodious. They fully reflected the characteristics of Cantonese opera of "passionate, lingering and pathos". Friends who love Cantonese opera enjoyed a cultural feast and were greatly appreciated by the audience.

305119a31c0c0bac455be293bd03739686b064a8.sourceText: 演出结束后，侨领余文劲、邓朝驹及亚省侨界代表上台给旧金山华侨文教服务团颁发荣誉证书和献花，感谢他（她）们的精彩演出。观众纷纷上前与演员合影留念。整个演出活动历史2个多小时，在一片欢乐祥和的气氛中落下帷幕。
305119a31c0c0bac455be293bd03739686b064a8.translatedText: After the performance, overseas Chinese leaders Yu Wenjin, Deng Chaoju and representatives of the overseas Chinese community in Alberta took the stage to present honorary certificates and flowers to the San Francisco Overseas Chinese Cultural and Educational Service Group, thanking them for their wonderful performance. The audience came forward to take photos with the actors. The entire performance lasted for more than 2 hours and came to an end in a joyful and peaceful atmosphere.

505522900a252eae6019371837b8e4b371f9dfad.sourceText: 图片来自美联社（AP） 一辆卡车副驾驶挡风玻璃周三在高速路上被子弹击中，亚利桑那当局担心这是一起连环枪击事件。 在过去的两个星期当局正在调查9起车辆在１０号高速上被枪击的事件。公共安全局还未确认是否是枪杀，目前，还没有人受伤。其中一个子弹击碎车的挡风玻璃，破碎的玻璃刮伤一个13岁女孩。其他的子弹都打在车辆的前灯或者车辆的两侧。 亚利桑那州州长道格 迪塞说：”亚利桑那州的安全是我们的首要任务，我们正在致力于逮捕那些对这些罪行负责的人。” 周二，警方宣布，他们正在调查最近发生的五次枪击，其中包括一个被击中的车，是正准备去上班的警察，以及另一个在10号公路上去加油站的白色卡车。他们的挡风玻璃都被子弹击中。 公共安全主任表示这是一起?’内恐怖主义犯罪” 肇事者正在向某些人发出示威。公共安全主任在新闻发布会上说：十天九起事件，这是一个真正持续威胁到亚利桑那州驾驶安全的问题。FBI正在协助调查。 警方紧急呼吁民众来协助调查，提供犯罪嫌疑人信息。警方还在高速路旁广告牌上紧急发出提供跟枪击事件悬赏信息。提供有价值信息者，将得到两万美金的奖励。 目前警方不会进一步透露调查的信息，他们也还不知道这九起枪击案是否直接相关，是否是从其他行使车辆射出，或者是高速公路旁射出的。虽然现在还没有人员伤亡，但是这个事件继续持续下去，伤亡只是时间问题。
505522900a252eae6019371837b8e4b371f9dfad.translatedText: Pictures from the Associated Press (AP) The windshield of the passenger side of a truck was hit by a bullet on the highway on Wednesday, and Arizona authorities feared it was a serial shooting incident. Authorities are investigating nine incidents in which vehicles were shot at on Highway 10 in the past two weeks. The Department of Public Safety has not confirmed whether it was a shooting, and no one has been injured at this time. One of the bullets shattered the car's windshield, and the broken glass scratched a 13-year-old girl. Other bullets hit the vehicle's headlights or sides. "Safety in Arizona is our top priority, and we are working to arrest those responsible for these crimes," said Arizona Governor Doug DeSe. On Tuesday, police announced they were investigating five recent shootings, including one that was struck by a police officer on his way to work and another in a white truck on Route 10 heading to a gas station. Their windshields were hit by bullets. The public safety director said this was a "domestic terrorism crime" and the perpetrator was demonstrating to some people. The public safety director said at a press conference: Nine incidents in ten days, this is a real and continuing threat to driving safety in Arizona. The FBI is assisting in the investigation. The police urgently appealed to the public to assist in the investigation and provide information on the suspects. The police also urgently issued a reward information on the highway billboard to provide information on the shooting incident. Anyone who provides valuable information will receive a reward of $20,000. The police will not disclose further information about the investigation at this time. They also do not know whether the nine shootings are directly related, whether they were shot from other driving vehicles or shot from the side of the highway. Although there are no casualties yet, it is only a matter of time before the incident continues.

a660448cac8e008d090498547bd56fd442719b2d.sourceText: 枪击事件开始于8月29日，在10号高速公路和19 到59 ave 之间，一个半小时内有两辆车被击中。第三辆车是是在29日的更晚一些,位置在10号高速的16st. 第四辆车是8月31日在相同区域。周二一名去上班的警察在10号高速的35ave和43ave，被击中挡风玻璃。另一次枪击发生在一分钟后。
a660448cac8e008d090498547bd56fd442719b2d.translatedText: The shooting began on August 29 at Highway 10 and 19 to 59 Ave. Two vehicles were hit within an hour and a half. The third vehicle was shot much later on the 29th at Highway 16. A fourth vehicle was shot in the windshield on Tuesday, August 31, when a police officer going to work at Highway 10 at 35 Ave and 43 Ave.

57ee16c1475051f2d4e7fde5c014a7b0348e98ee.sourceText: (亚省华联UCAA供稿) 第九届”凤凰之夜”庆祝中华人民共和国成立66周年国庆招待会、”凤凰之夜”晚宴暨欢庆中秋佳节团圆舞会系列活动将于2015年9月12日星期六在C-Fu Gourmet隆重举行。为了筹办这次活动，亚省华联会长李健于8月2日召开了第二次筹备会议。 李健会长首先对大家为华人社区活动的无私奉献表示衷心的感谢，并预祝系列庆祝活动取得圆满成功。同时，他向大家介绍了庆中秋迎国庆系列活动的整体规划和最新进展情况。按照会议议程，各项活动负责人向与会人员汇报了各项工作的准备情况。费健、王惟咨向与会人员说明了国庆招待会的具体事项，并介绍了由当地艺术家表演节目的落实情况。大赵、戎勤奋向大家说明了”凤凰之夜”晚宴场地和食品安排的最新进展。筹委会特别感谢朱岩在炎热的夏日往返饭店数次为确定晚宴菜单所付出的辛劳。董斌向大家汇报了中秋联谊舞会的准备情况，并号召大家积极邀请亲朋好友，参加于9月12日晚在C-Fu Gourmet举行的大型中秋联谊舞会；华尔兹、探戈、伦巴等各类舞曲应有尽有，只等您一展舞姿，共享其乐。亚省现代中文学校新任校长 Jim Xi 以及亚省希望中文学校的负责人表示将大力支持此次”凤凰之夜”系列庆祝活动。目前，贵宾邀请的落实情况和国庆招待会的准备工作也在进行之中。具体系列庆祝活动安排如下: 1) 5：00 – 6：00 PM：签到，C-Fu Gourmet front lobby (Dobson/Warner西南角) 2) 6：00 – 8：00 PM：国庆招待会/文艺表演/晚宴，C-Fu Gourmet dining hall 3) 8：00 – 10：00 PM：中秋联谊舞会，C-Fu Gourmet dining hall 此次”凤凰之夜”大型系列庆祝活动，由亚省华人华侨联合会(UCAA)主办，并由大凤凰城华人侨团联合总会、亚省现代中文学校、亚省希望中文学校、亚利桑那州立大学中国学生学者联谊会、以及亚省华人反法西斯暨纪念抗战胜利七十周年筹委会共同协办。 欢迎大家着正装出席于9月12日星期六举行的庆祝中华人民共和国成立66周年国庆招待会、”凤凰之夜”晚宴暨欢庆中秋佳节团圆舞会。谢谢大家的参与和支持！欢迎各界团体机构及热心民众尽早报名晚宴，预订有限席位，晚宴费用每位$30。报名请联系亚省华联会长李健 (jian_l1@yahoo.com)。最新消息和详情请浏览亚省华联网站：www.chineseaz.org。
57ee16c1475051f2d4e7fde5c014a7b0348e98ee.translatedText: (Contributed by UCAA, Alberta) The 9th "Phoenix Night" celebration of the 66th anniversary of the founding of the People's Republic of China National Day reception, "Phoenix Night" dinner and reunion dance series to celebrate the Mid-Autumn Festival will be held grandly at C-Fu Gourmet on Saturday, September 12, 2015. In order to prepare for this event, Li Jian, president of the Hualian Federation of Alberta, held the second preparatory meeting on August 2. President Li Jian first expressed his heartfelt thanks to everyone for their selfless dedication to Chinese community activities and wished the series of celebrations a complete success. At the same time, he introduced to everyone the overall planning and latest progress of the series of activities to celebrate the Mid-Autumn Festival and the National Day. According to the meeting agenda, the person in charge of each activity reported the preparation status of various tasks to the participants. Fei Jian and Wang Weizi explained the specific matters of the National Day reception to the participants and introduced the implementation of the performances by local artists. Da Zhao and Rong Qinjin explained to everyone the latest progress of the "Phoenix Night" dinner venue and food arrangements. The organizing committee would like to express special thanks to Zhu Yan for his hard work during the hot summer days when he traveled to and from the hotel several times to finalize the dinner menu. Dong Bin reported to everyone the preparations for the Mid-Autumn Festival Dance, and called on everyone to actively invite relatives and friends to participate in the large-scale Mid-Autumn Festival Dance held at C-Fu Gourmet on the evening of September 12th. There are all kinds of dance music such as waltz, tango, rumba, etc., just waiting for you to show off your dancing skills and share the fun. The new principal of the Alberta Modern Chinese School, Jim Xi, and the director of the Alberta Hope Chinese School expressed their strong support for this "Phoenix Night" series of celebrations. Currently, the implementation of VIP invitations and preparations for the National Day reception are also in progress. The specific series of celebration activities are arranged as follows: 1) 5:00 – 6:00 PM: Sign-in, C-Fu Gourmet front lobby (southwest corner of Dobson/Warner) 2) 6:00 – 8:00 PM: National Day reception/artistic performance/dinner, C-Fu Gourmet dining hall 3) 8:00 – 10:00 PM: Mid-Autumn Festival Dance, C-Fu Gourmet dining hall This large-scale series of "Phoenix Night" celebrations is hosted by the Chinese Overseas Chinese Association of Alberta (UCAA), and co-organized by the Federation of Chinese Overseas Chinese Associations in Greater Phoenix, Alberta Modern Chinese School, Alberta Hope Chinese School, Arizona State University Chinese Students and Scholars Association, and the Alberta Chinese Anti-Fascist and Commemoration of the 70th Anniversary of the Victory of the Anti-Japanese War Organizing Committee. Everyone is welcome to wear formal attire to attend the National Day reception to celebrate the 66th anniversary of the founding of the People's Republic of China, the "Phoenix Night" dinner and the Mid-Autumn Festival reunion dance to be held on Saturday, September 12th. Thank you all for your participation and support! Organizations and enthusiastic people from all walks of life are welcome to register for the dinner as early as possible and reserve limited seats. The dinner fee is $30 per person. To register, please contact Li Jian (jian_l1@yahoo.com), President of the Chinese Federation of Alberta. For the latest news and details, please visit the Alberta Hualien website: www.chineseaz.org.

e4ef12726949b7615f2ac28a287a829c4faa67c9.sourceText: 日本时间1945年8月15日中午12点，昭和天皇在录音讲话中首次向日本民众发表《终战诏书》： ……今征伐已历四载，虽我将兵骁勇善战，百官有司励精图治，一亿众庶奉公体国，然时局每况愈下，失势之徵已现。及今，夷军弹石之残虐，频杀无辜，惨害生灵，实难逆料。如若征伐相续，则我生民不存于世，被髮左衽之期重现；如此，则朕何以保全亿兆赤子、何面目复见列祖列宗乎？此朕所以敕令廷臣接受联军之诰者也。……
e4ef12726949b7615f2ac28a287a829c4faa67c9.translatedText: At 12 noon on August 15, 1945, Japan time, Emperor Showa issued the "End of War Edict" to the Japanese people for the first time in a recorded speech: ...The conquest has lasted four years. Although my generals are brave and good at fighting, all the officials are working hard to govern, and one hundred million people are serving the government, the situation is getting worse and worse, and the conquest has lost power. Nowadays, the brutality of the barbarian army's bullets and stones, frequently killing innocent people and causing great harm to living beings, is really unforeseen. If the conquests continue, my people will no longer exist in the world, and the period of being sent to the left will return. In this case, how can I save hundreds of millions of innocent children, and how can I see my ancestors again? This is why I ordered the court officials to accept the imperial edict from the coalition forces. …

4df6119eeb9c2838b35389264b1c6138532595f0.sourceText: 1945年8月15日，日本宣布无条件投降。1945年9月2日，日本投降签字仪式在停泊日本东京湾的美军战列舰密苏里号甲板上举行。在道格拉斯 麦克阿瑟将军的监督下，日本帝国代表团共11人登上密苏里号，并在中、美、英、苏等9国代表面前，签属《降伏文书》，正式宣告日本无条件投。第二次世界大战自此结束。密苏里号上的美国海军官兵们纷纷站在平台上，爬上炮台上，坐在围栏上，亲历目睹往日穷凶极恶日本大帝国低头伏降。美国海军各兵种共有380万人，能在密苏里号服役的官兵只为万分之一，亚省华裔军人炮手Tom Bon Yee是其中的一位，他见証了这历史上庄严的一刻，为亚省华人历史增添了光彩。 坚持抗战八年、付出重大民族牺牲的中华民国政府，派出六名代表出席日本投降签字仪式，由徐永昌上将领队。 徐永昌（1887－1959），晋绥军主要将领，曾任绥远、河北、山西省政府主席，时任中华民国政府军事委员会军令部长，二级陆军上将， 还有海军中将杨宣诚，他是在《开罗宣言》上签名的中国代表之一，陆军中将朱世明，陆军少将王之， 李树正上校和王丕承上校。 在签署仪式中，甲板上站满了参战盟国的代表，麦克阿瑟上将四处张望后，问话副官：”陈纳德在哪里？”由于政治上的分歧，抗日战争即将胜利之际，陈纳德被迫辞职回国。不久后日本宣布投降，陈纳德没能见证这最后的胜利时刻，他十分难受地说道：＂八年来我唯一的雄心就是打败日本，我很希望亲眼看到日本的失败＂。1958年7月18日，美国国会通过晋升陈纳德为空军中将的法桉。7月27日，陈纳德因病在华盛顿去世，终年67岁。 1945年8月17日，作为傀儡政权的满洲国彻底瓦解。9月9日，部署于中国近百万名日军部队于南京向中国战区最高统帅蒋中正宣布投降。9月9日上午九时，中国陆军总司令何应钦在南京陆军总部大礼堂主持受降典礼，日本中国派遣军总司令官冈村宁次大将在日本投降书上签字。冈村宁次的佩刀由何应钦将军接收。9月12日，佈署于东南亚（不含越南北纬16度以北）的日本军队统一在新加坡举办投降仪式，由路易斯 巴顿代表东南亚战区最高司令接受投降，过去被日本被管辖的朝鲜、越南和台湾等地也宣告解除管辖。越南胡志明更发表了《越南独立宣言》，但是阮朝政府以支持共产主义为由，决定对越南民主共和国展开镇压。10月25日，在台日军于台北公会堂向中国战区最高统帅蒋中正委派的陈仪将军投降。 密苏里号于1992年3月31日退役，1998年5月4日，海军部将这艘历史名舰转交给美国战列舰纪念协会。战舰从华盛顿州转移到珍珠港，距离1000码处，是”利桑那号”纪念馆。这一前一后的两艘战舰，标志着二次大战的起始和结束。1999年1月，”密苏里”号向公众正式开放。 二战结束后，亚利桑那州华裔军人仍有官兵派驻到德国和日本执行任务。其中技术兵Francis wong被派往德国法兰克福；参谋上士Joe Quan在第1骑兵第8骑兵团驻守日本；准尉Benjamin Joe所在第95步兵师留守日本；参谋军士Quin Fung派驻日本神户。第65作战工程营的Jimmy C. Tang则派往日本大坂。亚省华裔军人参与了整个第二次世界大战，用青春、热血和生命，谱写出勇敢胜利的篇章。
4df6119eeb9c2838b35389264b1c6138532595f0.translatedText: On August 15, 1945, Japan announced its unconditional surrender. On September 2, 1945, Japan's surrender signing ceremony was held on the deck of the USS Missouri, a US battleship anchored in Tokyo Bay, Japan. Under the supervision of General Douglas MacArthur, a total of 11 members of the Japanese Imperial delegation boarded the Missouri and signed the "Instrument of Surrender" in front of representatives of nine countries including China, the United States, Britain, and the Soviet Union, officially declaring Japan's unconditional surrender. The Second World War ended. The American naval officers and soldiers on board the Missouri stood on the platform, climbed onto the fort, and sat on the railing, witnessing with their own eyes the former heinous Japanese Empire bowing its head. There are 3.8 million people in all branches of the U.S. Navy, and only one in 10,000 officers and men can serve on the USS Missouri. One of them is Tom Bon Yee, a Chinese-American soldier from Alberta. He witnessed this solemn moment in history and added glory to the history of Chinese-Americans in Alberta. The government of the Republic of China, which persisted in the war of resistance for eight years and made great national sacrifices, sent six representatives to attend the Japanese surrender signing ceremony, led by General Xu Yongchang. Xu Yongchang (1887-1959), a major general of the Shanxi-Sui Army, served as Chairman of the Provincial Governments of Suiyuan, Hebei, and Shanxi, and was the Minister of Military Order of the Military Commission of the Government of the Republic of China at that time. He was also a second-class Army General. He also had Navy Lieutenant General Yang Xuancheng, one of the Chinese representatives who signed the Cairo Declaration, Army Lieutenant General Zhu Shiming, Army Major General Wang Zhi, Colonel Li Shuzheng, and Colonel Wang Picheng. During the signing ceremony, the deck was filled with representatives of allied countries participating in the war. After General MacArthur looked around, he asked his adjutant: "Where is Chennault?" Due to political differences, Chennault was forced to resign and return home when the Anti-Japanese War was about to win. Soon after, Japan announced its surrender. Chennault was unable to witness this final moment of victory. He said with great sadness: "My only ambition for the past eight years has been to defeat Japan. I really want to see Japan's defeat with my own eyes." On July 18, 1958, the U.S. Congress passed a bill promoting Chennault to Air Force Lieutenant General. Chennault died of illness in Washington on July 27 at the age of 67. On August 17, 1945, Manchukuo, as a puppet regime, completely collapsed. On September 9, nearly one million Japanese troops deployed in China surrendered to Chiang Kai-shek, the supreme commander of the Chinese theater of war, in Nanjing. At 9 a.m. on September 9, Commander-in-Chief of the Chinese Army He Yingqin presided over the surrender ceremony in the auditorium of the Army Headquarters in Nanjing. General Yoshiji Okamura, Commander-in-Chief of Japan’s China Expeditionary Forces, signed Japan’s instrument of surrender. Okamura Neji's sword was received by General He Yingqin. On September 12, the Japanese troops deployed in Southeast Asia (excluding Vietnam north of the 16th parallel) held a surrender ceremony in Singapore. Louis Patton accepted the surrender on behalf of the Supreme Commander of the Southeast Asian Theater. North Korea, Vietnam, and Taiwan, which were previously under Japanese jurisdiction, were also announced to have been lifted from jurisdiction. Ho Chi Minh of Vietnam even issued the "Declaration of Independence of Vietnam", but the Nguyen government decided to suppress the Democratic Republic of Vietnam on the grounds of supporting communism. On October 25, the Japanese troops in Taiwan surrendered to General Chen Yi, appointed by the supreme commander of the Chinese theater, Chiang Kai-shek, at the Taipei Public Hall. The Missouri was decommissioned on March 31, 1992, and on May 4, 1998, the Department of the Navy transferred the historic ship to the American Battleship Memorial Association. The battleship moved from Washington State to Pearl Harbor. 1,000 yards away is the USS Arizona Memorial. These two battleships, one behind the other, marked the beginning and end of World War II. In January 1999, the "Missouri" was officially opened to the public. After the end of World War II, Arizona Chinese soldiers still had officers and soldiers stationed on missions in Germany and Japan. Among them, technical soldier Francis wong was sent to Frankfurt, Germany; staff sergeant Joe Quan was stationed in Japan in the 1st Cavalry, 8th Cavalry Regiment; warrant officer Benjamin Joe was stationed in Japan with the 95th Infantry Division; and staff sergeant Quin Fung was stationed in Kobe, Japan. Jimmy C. Tang of the 65th Combat Engineer Battalion is assigned to Osaka, Japan. Chinese soldiers from Alberta participated in the entire Second World War and wrote a chapter of brave victory with their youth, blood and life.

9e4f17972b061e11a8737183fa3fd01306821018.sourceText: 淘识音同学是一位学习成绩优秀兴趣爱好广泛的女生，去年她的一家从 Dallas 搬到北 Scottsdale 。在这之前，她已在专业的美术教师指导下经坚持绘画学习多年，有了良好的素描基础和初级的色彩绘画能力，为了更有效地提高自己，家长们为她多方打听和寻找合适的美术教师，以便能够尽快提升艺术欣赏和绘画创作能力。终于在去年 10 月份联系上了林峰画家。
9e4f17972b061e11a8737183fa3fd01306821018.translatedText: Tao Shiyin is a girl with excellent academic performance and a wide range of interests. Last year, her family moved from Dallas to North Scottsdale. Before that, she had been studying painting for many years under the guidance of professional art teachers. She had a good sketch foundation and basic color painting skills. In order to improve herself more effectively, her parents asked her to find a suitable art teacher so that she could improve her art appreciation and painting creation skills as soon as possible. Finally, I contacted Painter Lin Feng in October last year.

8ec007a9586cbd11352a7669093d5d81afbfa58e.sourceText: 从去年 12 月开始至今年 2 月份，林峰画家根据她的基础和个人的兴趣，专门为她设计了几种不同风格的绘画学习和艺术创作的课程。淘识音的父母亲也不辛劳苦，单程驱车一个多小时从北 Scottsdale 到南边 Chandler ，把她送到林峰画室研习。去年末，淘识音同学在周末还挤出时间她还参加了科学竞赛，以及 SAT 考试，并取得近 2300 的好成绩。经过短短的 3 个月，每周一次的紧张研习，她圆满完成了数幅不同材质和风格的美术创作。
8ec007a9586cbd11352a7669093d5d81afbfa58e.translatedText: From December last year to February this year, Painter Lin Feng specially designed several different styles of painting learning and art creation courses for her based on her foundation and personal interests. Tao Shiyin's parents were not hard-working, and they drove more than an hour one way from Scottsdale in the north to Chandler in the south to send her to Raymond Lam's studio to study. At the end of last year, Tao Shiyin still found time on the weekends to participate in science competitions and the SAT exam, and achieved a score of nearly 2,300. After just 3 months of intensive study once a week, she successfully completed several art creations of different materials and styles.

88e93ac916a34692b1685255a0a43a8a82da7672.sourceText: ” 永恒的怀念”是淘识音同学为 Patriotic 比赛创作的一幅人物细节刻画深入感人的作品。画面中，一位母亲（军人）带在着自己的女儿来到越将士纪念碑前，为烈士们献上纪念的花篮。母亲在无数为国捐躯的烈士中寻找她的父亲（女儿的爷爷），含着泪水给女儿讲诉着英雄们故事，女儿凝望着爷爷的名字，幼小纤细手深情地抚摸着英烈们的碑身。。。
88e93ac916a34692b1685255a0a43a8a82da7672.translatedText: "Eternal Memory" is a work created by Tao Shiyin for the Patriotic competition, which depicts characters in profound and touching details. In the picture, a mother (soldier) took her daughter to the Vietnam Soldiers Monument and presented a commemorative flower basket to the martyrs. The mother searched for her father (her daughter’s grandfather) among the countless martyrs who sacrificed their lives for the country, and told her daughter the stories of the heroes with tears in her eyes. The daughter stared at her grandfather’s name, and her young and slender hands touched the monument of the heroes affectionately. . .

e4c4a1a8874c8017751597d607a2a9b83da71c56.sourceText: 在颁奖会上，评委们纷纷表达，这幅作品强烈地勾画起对大家对越战的回忆，对死难和失踪同胞的深深怀念，画面中的色彩和构图既营造出悲伤和哀思气氛，同时也充满了坚强和刚毅的精神。评委们并非常遗憾地告诉淘识音同学，由于母亲右手臂上的徽章刻画有错误，使她失去了获得更高的奖的资格。
e4c4a1a8874c8017751597d607a2a9b83da71c56.translatedText: At the award ceremony, the judges expressed that this work strongly evoked everyone’s memories of the Vietnam War and the deep remembrance of the dead and missing compatriots. The color and composition of the picture not only created an atmosphere of sadness and mourning, but also was full of strength and perseverance. The judges told Tao Shiyin with great regret that because the badge on her mother's right arm was incorrectly drawn, she was disqualified from receiving a higher award.

a3b0ca65a8c3859a57d8b9babc9e1622bce9ceb0.sourceText: 凤凰城 张肇鸿 亚省华裔海军 Dong M. Hom 是舰艇导航通信兵，舰艇负责向中途岛、硫磺岛战役的舰队进行燃料补给。另一位华裔海军Tom Bon Yee 则派到密苏里号战舰上服役。密苏里号战舰是美国最后一艘建造完成的战列舰，满载排水量达到58000吨。船长270.4公尺，船身宽度33公尺，刚好能穿越巴拿马运河。战舰上有3门火力威勐的16英吋口径的主炮，是美国有史以来在战舰上最大的火炮，其射程可达到37公里。密苏里号战舰在1944年下水，参与硫磺岛战役及冲绳战役， 1945年1月13日到达西太平洋前线，成为快速航母特溷编队的旗舰。特溷编队共计17艘航母空母舰、8艘战列舰、16艘巡洋舰、77艘驱逐舰，被称为历史上最强大的舰队。特溷编队16日出动大批舰载机轰炸了东京地区的机场、飞机制造厂。1月19日战列舰群参加了对硫磺岛的战役，其间密苏里号战舰曾遭神风特攻队自杀飞机击中。硫磺岛战役是美军和日军在二战中惨烈的一场战争，为何要攻打硫磺岛？这得从硫磺岛的地理位子说起。 中途岛海战结束后，美军准备攻占太平洋上由日军佔据的硫磺岛，以用作为空军基地，去轰炸日本本土。由于硫磺岛的战略地位重要，所以日军也早就筑起坚固的工事，以作殊死的顽强抵抗。1944年7月，日军向硫磺岛集中兵力达到23,000人。轻重武器方面包括有361门火炮，以及数量庞大的轻型迫击炮，海军炮，高射炮，反坦克炮，火箭炮，火箭弹及轻重机枪等，坦克则安置到战略要点，半埋在土中，以防止空袭。日军还建成非常坚固的地下工事，四通八达，大的暗堡甚至可以容下300到400人。建成地下通道连接所有的地下工事， 食品储备足够坚持两个半月。日军栗林忠道中将对美军抢滩采取不抵抗战术。直到美军先头部队进入陆地500米再发起反击，利用隐蔽工事近距离地杀伤美军有生力量。 1944年10月，美军已投入兵力达7万人。 12月8日起，派出B-24轰炸机连续74天对硫磺岛进行轰炸，但没有对其地下工事造成严重伤害。美轰炸机集中对其机场进行轰炸，日军就调集600人对机场抢险修复，2,000人去填弹坑，仅用了12小时就修复了机场。1945年2月15日，包括密苏里号的美军6艘战列舰加5艘巡洋舰，炮击了硫磺岛上的阵地。同时派出12艘登陆艇佯动，日军炮击导致9艘失去移动能力，3艘重伤。这暴露了日军重炮的位置，战列舰发射重磅炮弹摧毁了这些重炮。 2月19日，美军开始进攻，100架轰炸机先进行轰炸。炮舰火力跟上。 日军防守顽强寸土必争，美军用火焰喷射器和手榴弹进攻地堡。 20日美军占领千鸟机场。折钵山守备队长厚地兼彦大佐战死。 21日，日军32架飞机对美军展开敢死攻击。击伤美军航母萨拉托加，击沉护航航母一艘。美军当日死伤失踪5300人。26日，美军第5海军陆战师第28团第2营终于登上折钵山插上星条旗。12点15分又换了一面更大的旗帜，随军记者乔 罗森塔尔（Joe Rosenthal），拍下了着名的《美军士兵在硫磺岛竖起国旗》的照片。 在硫磺岛战役中，美军见到地堡入口即灌入海水或倒入汽油点火，或用手榴弹、火焰喷射器攻击。由于无法获得任何支援，日军在硫磺岛进行了殊死的抵抗后，许多日本兵在地堡内利用手榴弹相互自杀。全个战役日军21,800人战死，只有不到1%的200人被俘，其馀全部阵亡。美军则伤亡26,000人，其中战死6,821人。战役直到3月26日，硫磺岛才完全被美军控制。美军将该岛建设为供战斗机起飞的机场，B-29超级轰炸机在护航战斗机的保护下可以在中低空轰炸日本本土，对日本东京、名古屋和大坂进行战略轰炸。至二次大战争结束为止，共有2251架受伤的B29轰炸机在硫磺岛降落。美军以牺牲6,800人，伤2万2千人的代价拯救了约2万5千名B29机组成员的性命，此外，美军在硫磺岛战役中的巨大伤亡也间接促成了美国最终向日本投掷原子弹的决定。
a3b0ca65a8c3859a57d8b9babc9e1622bce9ceb0.translatedText: Phoenix Zhang Zhaohong Dong M. Hom of the Chinese-American Navy of the Province of Alberta is a ship navigation and communications officer. The ship is responsible for replenishing fuel to the fleet in the battles of Midway and Iwo Jima. Another Chinese sailor, Tom Bon Yee, was sent to serve on the battleship Missouri. The USS Missouri is the last battleship built in the United States, with a full load displacement of 58,000 tons. With a length of 270.4 meters and a hull width of 33 meters, it can just pass through the Panama Canal. The battleship has three powerful 16-inch-caliber main guns. It is the largest artillery gun ever installed on a battleship in the United States, and its range can reach 37 kilometers. The battleship USS Missouri was launched in 1944 and participated in the Battle of Iwo Jima and the Battle of Okinawa. It arrived at the Western Pacific frontline on January 13, 1945, and became the flagship of the fast aircraft carrier Teji formation. The special fleet has a total of 17 aircraft carriers, 8 battleships, 16 cruisers, and 77 destroyers. It is known as the most powerful fleet in history. On the 16th, the special formation dispatched a large number of carrier-based aircraft to bomb airports and aircraft manufacturing plants in the Tokyo area. On January 19, the battleship group participated in the battle against Iwo Jima, during which the battleship Missouri was hit by a kamikaze suicide plane. The Battle of Iwo Jima was a tragic battle between the U.S. and Japanese troops in World War II. Why did they attack Iwo Jima? This starts with the geographical location of Iwo Jima. After the Battle of Midway, the U.S. military prepared to capture the Japanese-occupied Iwo Jima in the Pacific and use it as an air base to bomb the Japanese mainland. Due to the important strategic position of Iwo Jima, the Japanese army had already built strong fortifications to mount a desperate and tenacious resistance. In July 1944, the Japanese army concentrated 23,000 troops on Iwo Jima. In terms of light and heavy weapons, there are 361 artillery pieces, as well as a large number of light mortars, naval guns, anti-aircraft guns, anti-tank guns, rocket launchers, rockets and light and heavy machine guns. Tanks are placed at strategic points and half-buried in the soil to prevent air attacks. The Japanese army also built very strong underground fortifications, extending in all directions, and the large bunker could even accommodate 300 to 400 people. Underground passages were built to connect all underground fortifications, and the food reserves were enough to last for two and a half months. Japanese Lieutenant General Tadamichi Kuribayashi adopted non-resistance tactics for the US troops to seize the beach. It was not until the leading US military troops entered 500 meters into the land that they launched a counterattack, using hidden fortifications to kill and injure the US military's effective forces at close range. In October 1944, the U.S. military had deployed 70,000 troops. Starting from December 8, B-24 bombers were dispatched to bomb Iwo Jima for 74 consecutive days, but no serious damage was caused to its underground fortifications. U.S. bombers concentrated on bombing the airport, and the Japanese army mobilized 600 people to repair the airport and 2,000 people to fill the bomb craters. It took only 12 hours to repair the airport. On February 15, 1945, six U.S. battleships and five cruisers, including the Missouri, bombarded the positions on Iwo Jima. At the same time, 12 landing craft were sent to feint, but the Japanese shelling caused 9 to lose their ability to move and 3 to be seriously injured. This exposed the location of the Japanese heavy guns, which were destroyed by the battleship's heavy shells. On February 19, the U.S. military began its offensive, with 100 bombers carrying out the bombing first. Gunboat fire kept up. The Japanese defense was tenacious and they fought for every inch of ground. The US military used flamethrowers and grenades to attack the bunker. On the 20th, the US military occupied Chidori Airport. Suribachi garrison captain Atsuji Kanehiko died in battle. On the 21st, 32 Japanese aircraft launched a deadly attack on the US military. Damage the US aircraft carrier Saratoga and sink an escort aircraft carrier. The U.S. military suffered 5,300 casualties and missing persons that day. On the 26th, the 2nd Battalion of the 28th Regiment of the 5th Marine Division of the US Army finally climbed Mount Suribachi to plant the Stars and Stripes. At 12:15, a larger flag was changed, and military reporter Joe Rosenthal took the famous photo of "U.S. Soldiers Raising the Flag on Iwo Jima." During the Battle of Iwo Jima, the U.S. military poured seawater or gasoline into the bunker's entrance to set it on fire, or attacked with grenades and flamethrowers. Unable to obtain any support, after the Japanese army put up a desperate resistance on Iwo Jima, many Japanese soldiers committed suicide with each other using grenades in the bunker. In the entire battle, 21,800 Japanese troops were killed, less than 1% of the 200 were captured, and the rest were all killed. The US military suffered 26,000 casualties, including 6,821 killed in action. The battle lasted until March 26, when Iwo Jima was completely controlled by the U.S. military. The US military built the island as an airport for fighter jets to take off. Under the protection of escort fighter jets, B-29 super bombers can bomb the Japanese mainland at medium and low altitudes and carry out strategic bombing of Tokyo, Nagoya and Osaka, Japan. By the end of World War II, a total of 2,251 injured B29 bombers landed on Iwo Jima. The U.S. military saved the lives of about 25,000 B29 crew members at the cost of 6,800 sacrifices and 22,000 injuries. In addition, the U.S. military's huge casualties in the Battle of Iwo Jima also indirectly contributed to the U.S.'s final decision to drop atomic bombs on Japan.
