e0802183ca72d391765d3427562e716c43857764.sourceText: 2015年度凤凰城中文教学研讨会，将于本月二十五、六举行，授课地点为凤凰城华人基督教会，即日起接受报名。主办单位凤凰城中文学校表示，此次研讨会将邀请远从台湾来的江惜美老师，以及胡龙华老师莅临指导。两位老师具有多年的教学经验与心得，将准备许多精彩的题目，包括语法教学、课堂管理、教桉习写与教具製作、真实语料在教学上的使用、如何进行口语教学，和绘本教学等等，和凤凰城的中文老师们分享。
e0802183ca72d391765d3427562e716c43857764.translatedText: > The 2015 Phoenix Chinese Teaching Seminar will be held on the 25th and Saturday of this month, and the teaching location will be the Phoenix Chinese Christian Church. Registration is open now. The organizer, Phoenix Chinese School, said that this seminar will invite teachers Jiang Ximei and Hu Longhua from Taiwan to give guidance. The two teachers have many years of teaching experience and experience. They will prepare many exciting topics, including grammar teaching, classroom management, teaching writing and teaching aid production, the use of real language materials in teaching, how to teach spoken English, and picture book teaching, etc., to share with Chinese teachers in Phoenix.

87bc52064e620fb333ce3f92c35a64851e714d7e.sourceText: 这次研讨会讲员江惜美老师，现为台湾铭传大学华语教学系教授兼系主任。江惜美老师学历为东吴大学中国文学研究所博士，专长项目有华语文教学、汉字教学、作文教学及苏轼诗词。江惜美老师出版过许多关于如何教孩童语文与作文的书籍，另外对于华语文学习上的教桉习写与教具製作方面，也有非常丰富的经验。胡龙华老师学历为哥伦比亚大学英语教学硕士，曾在美国普林斯顿、布朗、杜克等名校担任讲师和暑期班主教老师，现任美国布朗大学 (Brown University) 高级讲师，于语音、语法教学以及初、中、高级大学中文课程有多年的研究。
87bc52064e620fb333ce3f92c35a64851e714d7e.translatedText: The speaker of this seminar, Ms. Jiang Ximei, is currently the professor and director of the Department of Chinese Language Teaching at Taiwan Ming Chuan University. Teacher Jiang Ximei holds a PhD degree from the Institute of Chinese Literature at Soochow University. Her expertise includes Chinese language teaching, Chinese character teaching, composition teaching and Su Shi’s poetry. Teacher Jiang Ximei has published many books on how to teach children Chinese and composition. In addition, she also has rich experience in teaching writing and making teaching aids for Chinese language learning. Teacher Hu Longhua holds a master's degree in English teaching from Columbia University. He has served as a lecturer and summer class teacher at prestigious universities such as Princeton, Brown, and Duke in the United States. He is currently a senior lecturer at Brown University in the United States. He has many years of research in pronunciation, grammar teaching, and Chinese courses for elementary, intermediate, and advanced universities.

9a46a001cc62d91f964ec14e422e52c9acae6026.sourceText: 中新社休斯敦5月13日电 美国亚利桑那州警方证实，图森市南部一处住宅12日发生致命枪击案，屋内5名男女全部中枪身亡，当局初步怀疑这是一起谋杀-自杀案件。
9a46a001cc62d91f964ec14e422e52c9acae6026.translatedText: China News Service, Houston, May 13 (Xinhua) Police in Arizona, USA, confirmed that a fatal shooting occurred at a residence in southern Tucson on the 12th. All five men and women in the house were shot to death. The authorities initially suspected that this was a murder-suicide.

b2d5589c9a56b3d97c5165c912a2344d8af34860.sourceText: 据美联社13日报道，图森市警方发言人杜根(Pete Dugan)表示，12日下午6点左右，警官接到一名男子报警电话后前往图森市南部一处单层房屋检查，发现了5具尸体。
b2d5589c9a56b3d97c5165c912a2344d8af34860.translatedText: According to the Associated Press report on the 13th, Tucson police spokesman Pete Dugan said that at around 6 pm on the 12th, officers received a call from a man and went to check a single-story house in southern Tucson and found five bodies.

40014c05c040366fc8dd5fb820b9f6ac120b8fdb.sourceText: ”案情细节还有待梳理，但所有死者均有明显的枪击创伤迹象。”他说，当局没有积极寻找犯罪嫌疑人，因为初步调查显示这是一起谋杀-自杀案件。
40014c05c040366fc8dd5fb820b9f6ac120b8fdb.translatedText: "The details of the case have yet to be sorted out, but all the deceased had obvious signs of gunshot trauma." He said the authorities were not actively looking for suspects because preliminary investigations showed it was a murder-suicide.

d6556826de4bfbfd1900c4c8013e3334cdd74f7b.sourceText: 杜根指出，一名男子告诉了警方这起流血事件，他前往该处房屋与某人见面，”向屋内窥视时发现一个人似乎身中数枪死亡”。
d6556826de4bfbfd1900c4c8013e3334cdd74f7b.translatedText: Dugan said a man who told police about the bloodshed went to the house to meet someone and "peeped into the house and saw a man who appeared to have been shot multiple times."

97e57f3a56b1ce9a188cb4d8c706fc3ab79c06b4.sourceText: 调查人员没有透露更多细节和信息，包括受害者姓名和年龄。
97e57f3a56b1ce9a188cb4d8c706fc3ab79c06b4.translatedText: Investigators did not release further details or information, including the victim's name and age.

72cbab7a3e86dced986f7920c15baa3e12d2f8be.sourceText: 图森警察局局长维拉塞纳(Roberto Villasenor)表示，所有5名男女均于12日某个时刻遭到枪击，其中没有年幼的孩子。尸体在房子的不同区域被发现。
72cbab7a3e86dced986f7920c15baa3e12d2f8be.translatedText: Tucson Police Chief Roberto Villasenor said that all five men and women were shot at some point on the 12th, and there were no young children among them. The bodies were found in different areas of the house.

0d8d9f3901255a31976b6733895751f45f671d90.sourceText: 案发地点靠近图森国际机场，距离戴维斯-蒙森空军基地大约2英里。当局正展开进一步调查。
0d8d9f3901255a31976b6733895751f45f671d90.translatedText: The incident took place near Tucson International Airport and about 2 miles from Davis-Monthan Air Force Base. The authorities are conducting further investigations.

a8418372e740d972156788b6514f5ea82be6b975.translatedText: will write a new historical record for the exchanges between Arizona and Tainan City, and it will be the most exciting and vivid page.

c17ac44f7a7ed6f4a9f1b8731ac8df1d02ee410a.sourceText: 钱德勒市长亲自推荐活动 Chandler 明星少棒队于5月18日在市政会议大厅正式成军，将于9月30日赴台参加2015年台南巨人杯少棒锦标赛。 这是亚利桑纳州少棒队第一次到台湾参加比赛，但两地小朋友已经有了深厚的交情。
c17ac44f7a7ed6f4a9f1b8731ac8df1d02ee410a.translatedText: Mayor Chandler personally recommended the event. The Chandler Star Little League team was officially formed at the City Hall on May 18th and will go to Taiwan to participate in the 2015 Tainan Giants Cup Little League Championship on September 30th. This is the first time that the Arizona Little League team has participated in a competition in Taiwan, but the children from both places already have a deep friendship.

63100585a4c9ba4d3a668027c4f4e926438f6610.translatedText: In August last year, Tainan Mayor Lai Qingde visited Arizona and took the Tainan Little League team to train for two weeks. At that time, Chandler and Scottsdale were responsible for the training and competition.

493f58c0f979114aec1cd05f6f6ba0fe2c0c7d77.translatedText: Chairman of the Fundraising Committee Zhang Shengyi introduced the activities

5297273d5e7094a3f09b93cd7f9fa9d7bc228dcc.sourceText: 当本週亚利桑纳正在筹组成立大军之际，台南小将同时在台北尘战群雄，争夺台湾总冠军，希望在8月能代表台湾打到小马联盟世界少棒大赛，而这批连战皆捷的台南小将在球场传耒喜讯，他们想到亚利桑纳的朋友，感谢去年培训时所给予的付出与努力，在越洋电话中表示，5月23，24两场决战有必胜的决心。 台侨社团领袖张圣仪，张晴玲，黄玉莲，郑弘，林子宣，余霭明，庄淑华等在18日 Chandler 明星少棒队成军之日均在场做了见証，而他们也是这支劲旅幕后真正的推手。 打开亚利桑纳州与台南交流大门之人是前任州长 Jan Brewer ，她在2013年首先率团访问台南市，接着台南市长赖清德于去年回访，并确定亚历桑纳是台南市合作伙伴。 赖清德要打造台南市成为” 台湾的威廉波特”，”亚洲的棒球训练中心”，”世界少棒的比赛圣地”，亚利桑纳将与台南携手合作。 今年9月参加台南市巨人杯少棒赛的队伍除了 Chandler 市，尚有 Scottsdale 市，Tucson 市及 Peoria 市等也在积极筹备组军，希望共襄盛举，赴台参赛。
5297273d5e7094a3f09b93cd7f9fa9d7bc228dcc.translatedText: While Arizona is preparing to form an army this week, Tainan young players are competing in Taipei to compete for the Taiwan championship, hoping to win the championship in 8 Yue was able to represent Taiwan in the Little Pony League World Series, and these young Tainan players who had won consecutive games spread the good news at the stadium. They thought of their friends in Arizona and thanked them for their dedication and efforts in training last year. They expressed on the overseas phone that they were determined to win the two finals on May 23 and 24. Taiwanese community leaders Zhang Shengyi, Zhang Qingling, Huang Yulian, Zheng Hong, Lin Zixuan, Yu Aiming, Zhuang Shuhua, etc. were all present to witness the formation of the Chandler Star Little League team on the 18th, and they were also the real driving forces behind this powerful team. The person who opened the door for exchanges between Arizona and Tainan was former Governor Jan Brewer. She first led a delegation to visit Tainan City in 2013, and then Tainan Mayor Lai Ching-de paid a return visit last year and confirmed that Arizona is a partner of Tainan City. Lai Ching-te wants to build Tainan City into "Taiwan's Williamsport", "Asia's Baseball Training Center", "The World's Little League Holy Land", and Arizona will work together with Tainan. In addition to Chandler City, the teams participating in the Tainan City Giants Cup Little League Tournament in September this year include Scottsdale City, Tucson City and Peoria City, etc. are also actively preparing to form teams, hoping to participate in the grand event and compete in Taiwan.

bde024d6ea66c1f2e09c26ca1d1270476bc7a1a4.sourceText: 凤凰城 张肇鸿 纪念反法西斯战争胜利70周年组文 飞虎战魂 (4) 零式战斗机，日语称（”零戦” – れいせん）, 是日本帝国海军在第二次世界大战主力舰载战斗机，堪称日本在二战时最知名的战斗机。”零戦”其服役时正是皇纪纪元2600年而得名。零战是日本产量最大的战斗机，由三菱重工业设计，总计生产了10,449架， 1940年7月开始服役, 从中国战场到整个太平洋战区都可以见到零式战机。零式转弯半径小，速度快，航程远, 太平洋战争初期，零式性能压倒美军战斗机，特别是其机动性和续航力更是无人能及。当时美国的F2A”水牛”、P-40”战鹰”等战斗机面对零式可以说是一筹莫展。那时缺乏对零式战机分析，虽然陈纳德已把有关零式战斗机的性能情报交给美国，但却未受到重视。另外，由于采用错误的战术导致接连惨败，因此零式战机成为不败的神话，盟军对之高度敬畏，根据美军官方文件，战争初期的零战与美军战机的交换比为1：6 。 在那段日子中盟军唯一的亮点就是飞虎队。1941年12月20日，日军空袭昆明时，飞虎队首次参战。飞虎队的P-40B都绘有吓人的鲨鱼嘴，借以打击日军飞行员的士气。虽然P-40B机动性不如零战A6M2，但俯冲速度要快很多。利用这项优势，飞虎队采用高速俯冲，打了就跑的战术，避免与零战纠缠。在1942年飞虎队并入第14航空队前，他们已经摧毁了286架日本飞机（包括空中与地面的），自己仅损失13名飞行员。另外，飞虎队的第三中队在保卫缅甸仰光。在1941年12月23日至25日的日机轰炸中，飞虎队第三中队”击落约90架轰炸机”。由于飞虎队空战中取得了自日本零式战机肆虐中国战场以来的首次空战胜利，随后在缅甸战场上盟军失利时又算是一个创下较多击落日机战果，因而在太平洋战争初期，受到美国与中国的大力宣传。 战争初期在亚太地区的香港、新加坡、菲律宾甚至印度洋，零式统治了整个天空。但到了1942年6月，盟军终于打破零式称霸天空所向无敌的日子。在中途岛战役，载满燃油的零式在即将起飞前被击毁于航母飞行甲板上，这是一个转折点。6月3日，一架零式从龙骧号起飞对荷兰港进行袭击，返航途中因燃料发生泄漏，无法返回母舰，迫降在一个荒岛阿库坦的苔原上，机身翻倒，折断了飞行员的脖子。5周后，一支美国搜索队发现了的零式。美军立即将飞机运回美国，修复并进行试飞。终于找出了零式的缺点，报告迅速传送到太平洋战场，帮助沮丧的美国飞行员改进战术，另外， 美军在新式战机时针对零式的缺点来设计，挽救了成百上千的盟军飞行员生命，最终击败称霸太平洋上空6个月之久的零式飞机。（下图是美军缴获的第一架零式战斗机。）
bde024d6ea66c1f2e09c26ca1d1270476bc7a1a4.translatedText: Phoenix City Zhang Zhaohong commemorated the 70th anniversary of the Anti-Fascist War Victory Spirit (4) The Zero fighter, known in Japanese as "Zero 戦" - れいせん, was the main carrier-based fighter of the Imperial Japanese Navy in World War II. It was Japan's most famous fighter during World War II. "Ling Jian" was named after it was put into service in the year 2600 of the Imperial Era. The Zero is Japan's most produced fighter aircraft. It was designed by Mitsubishi Heavy Industries and a total of 10,449 aircraft were produced. It entered service in July 1940. The Zero fighter can be seen from the Chinese battlefield to the entire Pacific theater. The Zero has a small turning radius, fast speed, and long range. In the early days of the Pacific War, the Zero's performance overwhelmed the US military fighter jets, especially its maneuverability and endurance. At that time, American F2A "Buffalo", P-40 "War Eagle" and other fighter jets could be said to be helpless in the face of the Zero. At that time, there was a lack of analysis of the Zero fighter. Although Chennault had given performance information about the Zero fighter to the United States, it was not taken seriously. In addition, due to the adoption of wrong tactics that led to successive defeats, the Zero fighter became a myth of invincibility, and the Allies were highly awe of it. According to official U.S. military documents, the exchange ratio of Zero fighters to U.S. fighter jets in the early stages of the war was 1:6. The only bright spot for the Allies during those days was the Flying Tigers. On December 20, 1941, when the Japanese air raided Kunming, the Flying Tigers participated in the war for the first time. The Flying Tigers' P-40Bs were all painted with scary shark mouths to demoralize Japanese pilots. Although the P-40B is not as maneuverable as the Zero Fighter A6M2, its dive speed is much faster. Taking advantage of this advantage, the Flying Tigers adopted high-speed dives and hit-and-run tactics to avoid entanglement with Zero. Before the Flying Tigers were merged into the 14th Air Force in 1942, they had destroyed 286 Japanese aircraft (both in the air and on the ground) and lost only 13 pilots. Elsewhere, the Flying Tigers' 3rd Squadron is defending Rangoon, Burma. During the Japanese bombings from December 23 to 25, 1941, the third squadron of the Flying Tigers "shot down about 90 bombers." Since the Flying Tigers achieved their first air combat victory since the Japanese Zero fighter planes wreaked havoc on the Chinese battlefield, and subsequently achieved a record number of downed Japanese aircraft when the Allied forces lost in the Burmese battlefield, they received vigorous publicity from the United States and China in the early days of the Pacific War. In the early days of the war, the Zero dominated the skies in Hong Kong, Singapore, the Philippines and even the Indian Ocean in the Asia-Pacific region. But in June 1942, the Allies finally broke the days when the Zero dominated the sky and was invincible. At the Battle of Midway, a Zero loaded with fuel was destroyed on the aircraft carrier's flight deck just before takeoff. This was a turning point. On June 3, a Zero took off from the Ryujo to attack Dutch Harbor. Due to a fuel leak on the way back, it was unable to return to the mothership. It made an emergency landing on the tundra of Akutan, a deserted island. The fuselage overturned and broke the pilot's neck. Five weeks later, an American search team discovered the Zero. The U.S. military immediately transported the aircraft back to the United States, repaired it, and conducted test flights. The Zero's shortcomings were finally discovered, and the report was quickly sent to the Pacific battlefield to help frustrated American pilots improve their tactics. In addition, the U.S. military designed new fighter aircraft based on the Zero's shortcomings, saving the lives of hundreds of Allied pilots, and finally defeated the Zero aircraft that had dominated the Pacific skies for 6 months. (The picture below shows the first Zero fighter captured by the US military.)

1249155c397101ef891515129220d323e62858b1.sourceText: 1943年美国推出的F-6F”恶妇”战斗机，使零式的性能优势丧失殆尽。零式在数量上也处于劣势，因此在特鲁克和马里亚纳海空战中，零式几乎成为被猎杀的对象。1944年6月，零式A6M5在马里亚纳海战首次参战，19日，108架零式给攻击斯普鲁恩斯的特遣舰队的鱼雷机和轰炸机护航，但是，在F6F地狱猫的阻击和美舰队防空火力的打击下，日本损失了近300架飞机，日本海军大伤元气，此后再无力组织有效的空中攻势。这就是着名的”马里亚纳猎火鸡大赛”。从此，零式失去了昔日不可一世的威风，到了战争末期，零式战机沦为”神风特攻队”自杀攻击飞机。 亚省华裔军人詹姆斯 余（James Sing），是前任联邦大法官邓心平的舅舅。他在二次大战中死于日本帝国零式飞机的神风自杀式攻击。詹姆斯?#37011;在1942年6月服役，加入美国空军航空陆战队。詹姆斯开始去徳克蕯斯州的北美航空学校，进行B25轰炸机的技术训练，4个月后，他和飞行机组员去加州接受进一步的培训。 1943年4月，他们的第345轰炸中队接到命令，出发前往南太平洋。1944年11月9日，在菲律宾的莱特岛上，詹姆斯和其它的345位地面梯队的战士在一起，停靠在托马斯 纳尔逊自由号军舰上2周时间，等待卸下船上的uy货物。1944年11月18日，日本帝国的神风突击队驾驶着零式飞机前来袭击，飞机在舱门投下炸弹，被炸断30吨的主臂砸落在一旁。其后，这架装满燃料的飞机撞在甲板上爆炸，船上到处溅蔓着汽油，并立即爆炸起火。船上的345位士兵中有89位被炸死和被焚烧而死，另有100多人受伤。詹姆斯 邓就是在这次零式飞机的神风自杀式攻击中，被汽油焚烧而夺去了年青的生命。 ”神风特别攻击队”，是在二大战末期，日本为了挽救其战败的局面，利用武士道精神，以”一人、一机、一弹换一舰” 来对美国舰艇编队、登陆部队及固定的集群目标而实施的自杀式袭击。战争中有3912名敢死队员丧命，总共击沉各类舰船81艘，击伤195艘，所用战机多为零式 。最出名自杀式武器是樱花弹和回天鱼雷。战后，日本还妄想用神风特攻击队员的遗书去申报世界记忆遗产名录，被联合国教科文组织所否决。
1249155c397101ef891515129220d323e62858b1.translatedText: The F-6F "Bad Woman" fighter jet launched by the United States in 1943 completely lost the Zero's performance advantages. The Zero was also at a numerical disadvantage, so in the air-to-air battles over the Truk and Mariana seas, the Zero almost became the target of being hunted. In June 1944, the Zero A6M5 participated in the Battle of Mariana for the first time. On the 19th, 108 Zeros escorted the torpedo planes and bombers of the task force attacking Spruance. However, due to the obstruction of the F6F Hellcat and the attack of the U.S. fleet's anti-aircraft firepower, Japan lost nearly 300 aircraft. The Japanese Navy was severely weakened and was unable to organize an effective air offensive thereafter. This is the famous "Mariana Turkey Hunt". Since then, the Zero lost its former unparalleled prestige. By the end of the war, the Zero fighter was reduced to a "kamikaze" suicide attack aircraft. James Sing, a Chinese soldier from Alberta, is the uncle of former federal justice Deng Xinping. He was killed in a kamikaze suicide attack by a Japanese Imperial Zero aircraft during World War II. James?#37011; was commissioned into the United States Air Force Air Corps in June 1942. James began to go to the North American Aviation School in Texas for technical training on the B25 bomber. Four months later, he and the flight crew went to California for further training. In April 1943, their 345th Bomb Squadron received orders to set out for the South Pacific. On November 9, 1944, on Leyte Island in the Philippines, James and 345 other ground echelon soldiers docked on the Thomas Nelson Liberty warship for 2 weeks, waiting to unload the ship's uy cargo. On November 18, 1944, the Kamikaze commandos of the Japanese Empire drove a Zero aircraft to attack. The aircraft dropped a bomb on the door, and its 30-ton main arm was blown off and fell to the side. Afterwards, the plane filled with fuel hit the deck and exploded. Gasoline was splashed everywhere on the ship, and it immediately exploded and caught fire. 89 of the 345 soldiers on board were bombed and burned to death, and more than 100 others were injured. It was during this kamikaze suicide attack by the Zero aircraft that James Deng was burned by gasoline and lost his young life. "Kamikaze Special Attack Team" was a suicide attack carried out by Japan at the end of World War II to save its defeated situation, using the Bushido spirit and using "one man, one machine, one bomb for one ship" to attack American ship formations, landing forces and fixed cluster targets. During the war, 3,912 kamikaze fighters lost their lives, a total of 81 ships of various types were sunk, and 195 were damaged. Most of the fighter planes used were Type Zeros. The most famous suicide weapons are Sakura bombs and Kaiten torpedoes. After the war, Japan also attempted to use the suicide notes of kamikaze attackers to apply for the Memory of the World Heritage list, but it was rejected by UNESCO.

f0c52785fc39efd828a1f5109893567fc8365425.sourceText: 在昨天刚刚结束的纪念美国阵亡军人的绘画比赛中，来自小苏画室（Xiao Su Studio）的16岁王慧琳（Jane Wang）同学，使用彩色铅笔以精湛的画技以及优美的构思所绘制的《父女情深》，在激烈的竞争中脱颖而出，荣获亚省第一名，并获得一千五百美金的高额奖励。王慧琳同学酷爱绘画，利用周末时间在小苏画室已经学习三年。她的早期作品也曾在其游泳队的募捐拍卖会上被竞相收购。
f0c52785fc39efd828a1f5109893567fc8365425.translatedText: In the painting competition to commemorate the fallen American soldiers that just ended yesterday, from Xiao Su Studio Jane Wang, a 16-year-old student from Studio, used colored pencils to draw "Father and Daughter Love" with superb painting skills and beautiful ideas. She stood out in the fierce competition and won first place in the province and received a high reward of US$1,500. Classmate Wang Huilin loves painting and has been studying at Xiao Su Studio for three years on weekends. Her early works were also competitively acquired at fund-raising auctions for her swimming team.

1d3d244f7531db45d09ef9c4bba937948497f58b.sourceText: 另外由凤城侨联举办的2015国庆绘画比赛也刚刚揭晓，来自小苏画室的学生囊括了所有21个奖项的19项。今年侨联的画赛别具一格，每位参赛者必须在统一的指定时间及地点现场绘制参赛作品，此新规则蛮具挑战性，但意外的是学生们都很喜欢这种具有挑战性的比赛形式，踊跃报名参赛。侨联的颁奖仪式将在七月四号美国独立日的庆典大会上颁发。

This new rule is quite challenging, but surprisingly, the students like this challenging competition format and actively sign up to participate. The award ceremony of the Overseas Chinese Federation will be presented at the American Independence Day celebration on July 4th.

cb7fb9875c5a44d436f0c067175f67c0538a1171.sourceText: 二次大战中，亚利桑那州有70多位华裔青年当兵，其中大部分被派亚太战区，但有一位空军士兵到过欧洲战场，在大型轰炸机上服役，执行过轰炸任务达到三十次，参加过诺曼底战役，多次轰炸德国的军事设施，战机曾两度被炮火击中过，最后一次他负伤跳伞，被俘后受尽折磨，但又奇迹般地生还，并直至今天仍健在，他就是现年九十三岁高龄的邓粤钿先生。也是我採访亚省飞虎英雄邓桐臻后，採访到另一位经历过二战大战的老兵。 邓粤钿(Henry Ong) ，1942年当兵，开始被派往密苏里州、佛罗里达州等地学习军事通讯技术。随后，他被分配到亚利桑那州图森的戴维斯-蒙森空军基地，担任B-24轰炸机上的无线电通讯兵。他在新墨西哥州的阿拉莫戈多空军基地作最后的训练后，被派往英国，分配到第487轰炸大队的837轰炸中队，驻扎于伦敦南部。B-24是当时的重型轰炸机，机上有多达9位的空军人员联合操作。他们常在夜间执行任务，通常要持续飞行8〜10小时深入敌方轰炸。一次，B-24被德国防空炮火击中，失去了一个发动机。由于飞回自己的基地距离相当远，他们原打算飞往就近的瑞士。二战期间瑞士是中立国家，任何盟军士兵登陆瑞士不会交给德国人，但也不得不呆在那里待到战争结束为止。他们决定不飞瑞士，冒险花了更多的时间飞回英格兰，以便重返战埸。邓粤钿参加过着名的诺曼底战役。后来，他们派往B-17大型轰炸机去参与战斗。 1944年8月6日，邓粤钿执行第30次任务，去轰炸德国柏林的发动机工厂，这次任务完成后，他们就可返回美国进行整编。但当时炸弹投中目标后，飞机不幸被防空炮火击中，飞机急坠，机组人员奉命跳伞，但所有士兵被德军俘。邓粤钿身上有多处伤，战友爱德华. 赖歇尔受伤最严重，但因为是犹太血统，德国拒绝为他治疗，结果第二天就死了。邓粤钿被送往东部一个俘虏营，两厢车中挤满战俘，他们几乎没有任何食物和水，受尽拆磨。 1945年2月，为逃避苏军的攻势，德国人决定步行迁移整个战俘营，邓粤钿与超过一万人的战俘开始了”死亡之旅”，步行了一千英里，从德国东走到西部。因战况不利德军，整个俘虏营又从西部再折返回东部。他们足足步行了一百多天，时值冬天，沿途有不少战俘死于冻饿与疾病，他虽大难不死，却受尽磨难。 1945年5月4日，邓粤钿被英军救出，才重获自由。 战后美国政府授予邓粤钿多枚勳章，包括战争先锋勳章、二次大战胜利奖章等。邓粤钿退役后，服务社会，担任过全美退役军人战俘亚省总指挥。2005年入选亚省退伍军人名人堂（全州只有三名华人）。为表彰邓粤钿在二次大战的贡献，2007年，凤凰城市长菲尔 高登(Phil Gordon) ，把1月16日这天特定为＂邓粤钿日＂。 在二次大战中，邓粤钿家中的四兄弟是同时应征参军，保家卫国。在下面这张着名的＂一门四杰＂的相片中，就是他们的英雄写照。这四兄弟分别是邓粤昂、邓粤寅、邓粤钿和邓粤铨。 直到今天，除他们的大哥邓粤昂去世外，其余三兄弟仍健在。就在凤凰城，甚至全美国，在纪念反法西斯胜利70周年的这一刻，还有这样三位老兵活着，这简直就是一个稀世奇蹟！他们兄弟见証了二次大战风烟战火，还有那无悔青春的一段段可歌可泣的英雄往事。让我们向他们致以最崇高的敬意！（本文经过邓粤钿先生同意）
cb7fb9875c5a44d436f0c067175f67c0538a1171.translatedText: During World War II, more than 70 Chinese young people in Arizona served as soldiers. Most of them were sent to the Asia-Pacific theater. However, one Air Force soldier went to the European battlefield and served on a large bomber. He has conducted thirty bombing missions, participated in the Battle of Normandy, bombed German military installations many times, and his fighter planes were hit by artillery fire twice. The last time he parachuted out after being injured, and suffered torture after being captured, but miraculously survived and is still alive today. He is Mr. Deng Yuetian, who is now ninety-three years old. It was also after I interviewed Deng Tongzhen, the Flying Tiger hero of Alberta, that I interviewed another veteran who had experienced the Second World War. Henry Ong joined the army in 1942 and was sent to Missouri, Florida and other places to learn military communications technology. He was then assigned to Davis-Monthan Air Force Base in Tucson, Arizona, where he served as a radio operator on a B-24 bomber. After his final training at Alamogordo Air Force Base in New Mexico, he was sent to the United Kingdom and assigned to the 837th Bomb Squadron of the 487th Bomb Group, stationed south of London. The B-24 was a heavy bomber of the day and was operated jointly by up to nine Air Force personnel. They often perform missions at night, usually flying for 8 to 10 hours to penetrate deep into the enemy's territory for bombardment. Once, the B-24 was hit by German anti-aircraft fire and lost an engine. Since it was quite a distance to fly back to their base, they originally planned to fly to nearby Switzerland. Switzerland was a neutral country during World War II. Any Allied soldiers who landed in Switzerland would not be handed over to the Germans, but they would have to stay there until the end of the war. They decided not to fly to Switzerland and took the risk of spending more time flying back to England in order to return to the battlefield. Deng Yuedian participated in the famous Battle of Normandy. Later, they sent B-17 large bombers to participate in the battle. On August 6, 1944, Deng Yuedian carried out his 30th mission to bomb the engine factory in Berlin, Germany. After this mission was completed, they could return to the United States for reorganization. However, after the bomb hit the target, the plane was unfortunately hit by anti-aircraft fire. The plane crashed and the crew was ordered to parachute, but all the soldiers were captured by the Germans. Deng Yuedian had many injuries on his body, and his comrade Edward Reicher was the most seriously injured. However, because he was of Jewish descent, Germany refused to treat him, and he died the next day. Deng Yuedian was sent to a prison camp in the east. The hatchback was packed with prisoners of war. They had almost no food and water and were tortured. In February 1945, in order to escape the Soviet offensive, the Germans decided to move the entire prison camp on foot. Deng Yuedian and more than 10,000 prisoners of war began a "death journey" and walked a thousand miles from east to west Germany. Because the war situation was unfavorable to the German army, the entire prisoner camp turned back from the west to the east. They walked for more than a hundred days, and it was winter. Many prisoners of war died of cold, hunger and disease along the way. Although he survived, he suffered a lot. On May 4, 1945, Deng Yuetian was rescued by the British army and regained his freedom. After the war, the U.S. government awarded Deng Yuedian many medals, including the War Vanguard Medal, the World War II Victory Medal, etc. After Deng Yuetian retired, he served the society and served as the commander-in-chief of the American Veterans Prisoners of War in Alberta. Inducted into the Alberta Veterans Hall of Fame in 2005 (there are only three Chinese in the state). In recognition of Deng Yuedian's contribution to World War II, in 2007, Phoenix Mayor Phil Gordon designated January 16 as "Deng Yuedian Day." During World War II, the four brothers of Deng Yuedian's family were drafted into the army at the same time to protect their family and country. In the following photo of the famous "Four Elites", it is a portrait of their heroes. The four brothers are Deng Yue Ang, Deng Yue Yin, Deng Yue Tian and Deng Yue Quan. To this day, except for the death of their eldest brother Deng Guangdong, the other three brothers are still alive. In Phoenix, and even across the United States, at this moment commemorating the 70th anniversary of the anti-fascist victory, there are still three veterans alive. This is simply a rare miracle! The brothers witnessed the smoke and flames of World War II, as well as the tragic and heroic past of their youth without regrets. Let us pay our highest respect to them! (This article was approved by Mr. Deng Yuedian)

342902a98743f498cb0db4caad4071267437b47c.sourceText: 亚省艺术学校集体排舞Line Dance开课了 Line Dance 于本周六（ 6 月 13 日）下午 3:00 在亚省艺术学校开课。 授课老师：闻玲琳 学校地址： 610 N Alma School Rd # 16 Chandler AZ 85224 排舞属于全球化舞蹈类别的一个分支，英文叫 Line Dance 。 Line 就是排和线的意思， Dance 是舞蹈。翻译过来就是排成排跳的舞蹈。它起源于美国 70 年代的 Western Country Dance （西部乡村舞蹈）。排舞既可以集体共舞，又可以个人独享，形式多样，丰富多彩。 排舞在中 国又被称为广场舞。它简单易学，不需要任何舞蹈经验和基础，也无需舞蹈伴侣。排舞的步伐花式有华尔兹，恰恰，爵士，曼波，探戈，桑巴。。。 每一只排舞都有其独特的舞蹈编排，有的是轻快欢乐，有的是优雅而浪漫；有的是怀旧老歌，有的是最新时尚流行歌曲；有的是中国音乐，有的是英文歌曲。。。 排舞可以舒缓身心压力、增强心肺功能、塑造优美形体、增强身体协调、结交更多朋友、彰显团队精神。 健体价值 排舞具有体育锻炼的价值，经常进行排舞练习，心血管和呼吸系统都能得到良好的锻炼，改善心肺功能，加速新陈代谢过程，促进消化，消除大脑疲劳和精神紧张，从而达到增强体质，增进健康，延缓衰退，提高人体的活动能力等良好的健身作用。 健心价值 从心理学的角度来分析，人的注意力是心理活动对一定对象的指向和集中，也就是说注意是受指向制约的，在翩翩起舞的过程中，其注意力必然都集中在欣赏优雅的舞曲音乐，并沿着节奏将内心情感抒发在舞姿上，由于注意的转移，就能使身体其他部分的机能得到调整和充分休息，所以参加排舞这项运动能消除紧张的情绪和缓解压力，练习者在优美动听的音乐、美妙的舞姿中，消除疲劳、陶冶心灵，感受到愉快的情绪，从而达到最佳的心理状态。 健脑价值 记忆，就是过去的经验在人脑中的反映。它包括识记、保持、再现和回忆四个基本过程。其形式有形象记忆、概念记忆、逻辑记忆、情绪记忆、 运动记忆 等。在排舞的练习过程中不仅要运用形象记忆、概念记忆，而且还要运用情绪记忆和运动记忆，而随着年龄的不断增长，记忆力会以很慢的速度减退，这是自然规律，也是正常现象。通过排舞练习以及对大脑神经的不断刺激，来减缓记忆力减退的生理现象，达到良好的健脑效果。 欢迎感兴趣的朋友踊跃报名参加，（本周六免费试课）联系电话480-213-9187
342902a98743f498cb0db4caad4071267437b47c.translatedText: Line Dance, a group line dance class at the Alberta Art School has started at 3:00 pm on Saturday (June 13th) at the Alberta Art School. Teacher: Wen Linglin School address: 610 N Alma School Rd # 16 Chandler AZ 85224 Line dance is a branch of the global dance category, called Line Dance in English. Line means row and line, and Dance means dance. Translated, it means a dance performed in a row. It originated from Western Country Dance in the United States in the 1970s. Line dance can be danced in a group or individually. It has various forms and is rich and colorful. Line dance is also called square dance in China. It is easy to learn and does not require any dance experience or foundation, nor does it require a dance partner. Line dance styles include waltz, cha cha, jazz, mambo, tango, and samba. . . Each line dance has its own unique choreography, some are light and joyful, some are elegant and romantic; some are nostalgic old songs, some are the latest fashionable pop songs; some are Chinese music, and some are English songs. . . Line dancing can relieve physical and mental stress, enhance cardiopulmonary function, shape a beautiful body, enhance body coordination, make more friends, and demonstrate team spirit. Value of fitness: Line dance has the value of physical exercise. Regular practice of line dance can give good exercise to the cardiovascular and respiratory systems, improve cardiopulmonary function, accelerate metabolic process, promote digestion, eliminate brain fatigue and mental stress, thereby achieving good fitness effects such as strengthening physical fitness, improving health, delaying decline, and improving the human body's ability to move. Healthy value From a psychological perspective, human attention is the direction and concentration of psychological activities on a certain object. That is to say, attention is restricted by direction. In the process of dancing, one's attention must be focused on appreciating elegant dance music and expressing inner emotions in the dance along with the rhythm. Due to the focus of attention, By transferring, the functions of other parts of the body can be adjusted and fully rested. Therefore, participating in line dancing can eliminate tension and relieve stress. Practitioners can eliminate fatigue, cultivate the soul, and feel happy emotions in the beautiful music and wonderful dance postures, thereby achieving the best mental state. Brain-building Value Memory is the reflection of past experiences in the human brain. It includes four basic processes: memorization, retention, reproduction and recall. Its forms include image memory, conceptual memory, logical memory, emotional memory, motor memory, etc. During the practice of line dance, not only image memory and conceptual memory must be used, but also emotional memory and motor memory. As age continues to grow, memory will decline at a very slow rate. This is a natural law and a normal phenomenon. Through line dance practice and continuous stimulation of brain nerves, the physiological phenomenon of memory loss can be slowed down and a good brain-building effect can be achieved. Interested friends are welcome to sign up. (Free trial class this Saturday) Contact number 480-213-9187

f45e997195a3b239febcbd73a2c038f5c840fd7f.sourceText: 下午1点，毕业典礼准时拉开帷幕。首先希望中文学校校长田琳女士上台致辞。她向大家介绍了本次活动到场的嘉宾，他们包括余文劲，邓朝驹，张肇鸿，阮霭明，朱岩，吕丽华，田邵薇，Fannie Tam和于华。田校长总结了学校一年的教学成果，对社会各界人士对我校的支持表示了感谢。Mesa Community College校长潘寿安作为嘉宾代表上台致辞。他回顾了Mesa Community College和希望中文学校携手为海外华裔儿童中华文化教育共同走过的风雨岁月，并展望未来二所学校更好的中文教学发展。随后，舞台中央的投影屏幕缓缓下降，屏幕上播放了一段纪念学校成立20周年的短片。这个短片里，有20年来历任校长、董事长对学校的祝福，有一幅幅记录学校各种活动以及变迁的珍贵照片，让我们看到了学校从最初几十个学生一路走来，发展到今天400多人的规模。在这个短片里，我们注意到除了历届校长董事长之外的另一个特殊群体――他们就是多年来一直为学校默默付出的义工们。今天我们的老义工们为大家带来他们给学校二十年校庆的贺礼和自己改编的，表达他们心声的歌曲《义工之歌》。他们把”我们是共产主义接班人。。。”的歌词改成了”我们是中文学校老义工。。。”熟悉的曲调，感人的歌词，让台下观众不禁一起吟唱起来。他们的心声赢得了台下阵阵掌声。学校今年特别为六年级、十一/十二年级的学生颁发了小学部和中学部的毕业证书，并对学习成绩优异的学生颁发了奖学金，这是对这些在中文学校坚持学习了10多年的孩子们的肯定和鼓励。最后学校新任董事长李健先生上台致辞，他表达了带领学校董事会、校委会继承前人传统，继续努力发扬学校的决心。
f45e997195a3b239febcbd73a2c038f5c840fd7f.translatedText: At 1 p.m., the graduation ceremony kicked off on time. First of all, I hope that the principal of the Chinese school, Ms. Tian Lin, will come to the stage to deliver a speech. She introduced the guests present at this event, including Yu Wenjin, Deng Chaoju, Zhang Zhaohong, Ruan Aiming, Zhu Yan, Lui Lihua, Tian Shaowei, Fannie Tam and Yu Hua. Principal Tian summarized the school’s teaching achievements over the past year and expressed his gratitude to people from all walks of life for their support of our school. Pan Shou'an, the principal of Mesa Community College, took the stage as a guest representative and delivered a speech. He reviewed the ups and downs that Mesa Community College and Hope Chinese School have gone through together to provide Chinese cultural education for overseas Chinese children, and looked forward to better Chinese teaching development in the two schools in the future. Afterwards, the projection screen in the center of the stage slowly lowered, and a short film commemorating the 20th anniversary of the school was played on the screen. In this short film, there are the blessings of the school from the presidents and chairman of the board over the past 20 years, as well as precious photos recording various activities and changes of the school. It allows us to see the school's development from a few dozen students in the beginning to more than 400 students today. In this short video, we noticed another special group besides the previous principals and chairman of the board - they are the volunteers who have been silently contributing to the school for many years. Today our old volunteers bring you the gifts they gave to the school for its 20th anniversary and the song "Volunteer Song" they adapted themselves to express their feelings. They changed the lyrics of "We are the successors of communism..." to "We are old volunteers of the Chinese school..." The familiar tune and touching lyrics made the audience sing along. Their voices won bursts of applause from the audience. This year, the school specially awarded primary and secondary school graduation certificates to students in grades 6, 11/12, and awarded scholarships to students with outstanding academic performance. This is an affirmation and encouragement to these children who have been studying in the Chinese school for more than 10 years. Finally, Mr. Li Jian, the new chairman of the school, took the stage to deliver a speech. He expressed his determination to lead the school board and school committee to inherit the traditions of their predecessors and continue to work hard to develop the school.

d5f6858226d4479475fc6e9a0dc3f96d9d23528d.sourceText: 致辞完毕，大家期待已久的文艺演出终于开始了。今年，从演出的筹划阶段开始，组委会就决定改变往年毕业典礼以班级为单位出节目的惯例，因为这样出来的节目往往数量多，时间冗长，但节目质量却不高。既然是20周年的特别演出，就要有高质量的节目，浓缩所有的精华呈现给大家。今年中文班以年龄组为单位出中文节目，虽然只有5个节目，但却各个都寓意深刻，紧密联系孩子们在中文学校的学习生活。低年级组在曹彩虹、张淑萍、吴盛佳、吴凰华、朱雪薇、杨京生六位老师的悉心指导下，为大家带来了童趣盎然的表演《十二生肖》，表演融合了歌唱、朗诵、讲故事，以及和学校第一任老校长唐孝先老爷爷的问答互动环节。同学们通过排练这个节目，都清楚的了解了中华独有的十二生肖文化，知道了十二生肖到底是哪十二个动物，知道了他们正确的排列顺序，各自的形态特点，还知道了为什么十二生肖里没有猫，为什么老鼠排第一等等的有趣问题。
d5f6858226d4479475fc6e9a0dc3f96d9d23528d.translatedText: After the speech, the long-awaited artistic performance finally began. This year, starting from the planning stage of the performance, the organizing committee decided to change the practice of presenting programs in class units in previous graduation ceremonies, because the programs produced in this way are often large in number and lengthy, but the quality of the programs is not high. Since it is a special performance for the 20th anniversary, there must be a high-quality program that condenses all the essence and presents it to everyone. This year, the Chinese class has Chinese programs based on age groups. Although there are only 5 programs, each one has a profound meaning and is closely related to the children's study and life in the Chinese school. Under the careful guidance of six teachers, Cao Caihong, Zhang Shuping, Wu Shengjia, Wu Huanghua, Zhu Xuewei, and Yang Jingsheng, the lower grade group presented a childlike performance "Twelve Zodiac Signs". The performance combined singing, recitation, storytelling, and a question and answer session with the school's first old principal, Grandpa Tang Xiaoxian. Through rehearsing this program, the students have a clear understanding of China's unique zodiac culture, which animals are in the zodiac, their correct order, their respective morphological characteristics, and interesting questions such as why there is no cat in the zodiac, why the mouse ranks first, and so on.

3ab1e4e014c05172c633c9036971af76639b904f.sourceText: 三、四年级的同学在陈玉和、史敬嵬老师的指导下为大家带来了天津快板《学汉语》。要知道，在海外的华裔儿童能说好普通话已经很不容易了，这次的快板，居然让孩子们说的是天津话！还真别小瞧那帮孩子，一个个把快板打得噼里啪啦响，天津话说的那是有腔有调，加上陈玉和老师亲自撰写的风趣幽默的快板词儿，把台下观众逗得欢笑不止，更有不少来自天津的家长忍不住对孩子们的天津话竖起大拇指。何舟洲、王萧丽、李晓恒老师指导中文六、七、八年级的同学为大家带来了小话剧《夏令营》。讲述了一群美国华裔孩子在参加夏令营的时候因为中文发音不标准让别人误解了不同含义而闹出的很多笑话，以此与台下的同学共勉，一定要努力学好中文，这样暑假去中国旅游的时候才能如鱼得水闹笑话。
3ab1e4e014c05172c633c9036971af76639b904f.translatedText: The third and fourth grade students, under the guidance of teachers Chen Yuhe and Shi Jingwei, brought everyone the Tianjin Allegro "Learning Chinese". You know, it is not easy for Chinese children overseas to speak Mandarin well. This time, the Allegro actually made the children speak Tianjin dialect! Don’t underestimate those children. They played the Allegro with a crackling sound one by one. The Tianjin dialect was full of tune, and the humorous Allegro lyrics written by Chen Yuhe himself made the audience laugh. Many parents from Tianjin couldn’t help but give thumbs up to the children’s Tianjin dialect. Teachers He Zhouzhou, Wang Xiaoli, and Li Xiaoheng guided the Chinese students in grades 6, 7, and 8 to perform a short drama "Summer Camp" for everyone. It tells the story of a group of Chinese-American children who made many jokes while attending a summer camp because the pronunciation of Chinese was not standard and others misunderstood different meanings. It encourages the students in the audience to work hard to learn Chinese well so that they can make jokes like a fish in water when traveling to China during the summer vacation.

f9c880cc043d37410770228ad03d5597e29cf14f.sourceText: 中文九、十、十一/十二年级是学校里年纪最大学习时间最长的学生，加上十一/十二年级即将毕业离校，所以他们格外卖力的为这次演出准备了二个节目。散文诗《爱心行动》根据学校学生会今年号召全校师生为中国四川贫困地区的学生捐款购买学习用品、御寒衣帽的真实活动，由学生自己撰写，并朗诵。”让爱飞翔，让我们连接起世界的爱心，从地球的这一边到另一边。希望越千山，爱心传万里”。听着孩子们充满爱的声音，掌声在礼堂久久回荡。历史剧《草船借箭》无论从表演，台词，还是服装道具都可称得上是专业水准了。”诸葛亮”捋着大胡子，摇着羽毛扇，真是栩栩如生惟妙惟肖。所有的纸板战船、大胡子、古装帽子、服装等道具基本都是老师帮着孩子们一起亲手做出来的。所以他们的指导老师沈颢瑾、吴思远、李素惠也是格外辛苦。为了营造借箭时江面上的大雾场景，李老师还在舞台边卖力的人工造雾，一切的努力都是为了让孩子们在中文学校的学习生涯能够画上一个圆满的句号，为他们留下最珍贵的回忆。
f9c880cc043d37410770228ad03d5597e29cf14f.translatedText: Chinese Grades 9, 10, 11/12 are the oldest students in the school and have studied the longest. In addition, Grade 11/12 are about to graduate and leave school, so they worked extra hard to prepare two programs for this performance. The prose poem "Action of Love" is based on the real activity of the school's student union calling on all teachers and students this year to donate money to buy school supplies and warm clothes for students in poor areas of Sichuan, China. It was written and recited by the students themselves. "Let love fly, let us connect the love of the world, from one side of the earth to the other. I hope that over thousands of mountains, love will spread thousands of miles." Listening to the children's loving voices, applause echoed in the auditorium for a long time. The historical drama "Borrowing Arrows from a Straw Boat" can be regarded as professional in terms of performance, lines, and costumes and props. "Zhuge Liang" is stroking his beard and shaking his feather fan, which is really lifelike and lifelike. All the cardboard warships, beards, costume hats, costumes and other props are basically made by the teacher with the help of the children. Therefore, their instructors Shen Haojin, Wu Siyuan, and Li Suhui also worked extremely hard. In order to create the scene of heavy fog on the river during the borrowing of arrows, Teacher Li also worked hard to create artificial fog beside the stage. All efforts were made to bring the children's learning career in the Chinese school to a successful conclusion and leave them with the most precious memories.

7ff0aa085ccd2584f3388ece3ed7ab2172dbc863.sourceText: 虽然中文学校以学习中文为主，但是也注重发展学生的才艺能力，所以才艺班的节目也不容小觑。开场舞台剧《木兰出征》一出场就把全场观众给震住了。说起来，希望中文学校的《木兰出征》在本地社区已经小有名气，可是在我们娘家人面前还是首次表演。在去年全美中文协会大会晚宴上的首次亮相，这个节目就技惊四座被大加赞赏，之后又陆续参加了本地的春节晚会，元宵晚会等等大型演出，屡次获得好评。这个节目最初是蒋琳老师的舞蹈班排练的一个主题舞蹈，展现中国家喻户晓的花木兰替父从军的感人故事。为了更契合全美中文协会大会的主题，注入更多中华文化的元素，学校从朗诵比赛中脱颖而出的佼佼者中精挑细选，组成一支朗诵队伍，在史敬嵬老师的带领下，孩子们解读了这个故事的文化背景，背诵了著名的《木兰辞》。朗诵与舞蹈巧妙结合，融会贯通出一个更气势磅礴具文化含义，视觉听觉双重享受的高质量节目。 由汤可老师指导的历史歌舞剧《中国印象》贯穿历史长河几千年，从唐宋文明到近代的爱国青年，从古典舞蹈，到民族服装展示，还有小朋友当场书法表演，把中华文化的精粹都浓缩在短短几分钟的节目里，果然是让人记忆深刻的中国印象。蒋琳老师指导的舞蹈《宝贝，加油！》塑造的是一群热烈活泼的啦啦队少女。众所周知，啦啦队在美国的大中学校是深受少女喜欢的一项活动，这个舞蹈让年龄较低还无法真实接触啦啦队的小女生们也过了一把啦啦队宝贝的瘾，孩子们都别提多带劲儿了。
7ff0aa085ccd2584f3388ece3ed7ab2172dbc863.translatedText: Although Chinese schools focus on learning Chinese, they also focus on developing students’ talent abilities, so the programs of talent classes should not be underestimated. The opening stage play "Mulan's Journey" shocked the audience as soon as it appeared. Speaking of which, "Mulan Goes Out" produced by Hope Chinese School is already well-known in the local community, but it was the first time it was performed in front of our family. When it debuted at the National Chinese Language Association conference dinner last year, the show was so amazing that it was praised by everyone. After that, it has participated in local Spring Festival gala, Lantern Festival gala and other large-scale performances, and has repeatedly received praise. This program was originally a theme dance rehearsed by teacher Jiang Lin's dance class, showing the touching story of Hua Mulan, a well-known Chinese woman, who joined the army in place of her father. In order to better fit the theme of the National Chinese Association Conference and inject more elements of Chinese culture, the school carefully selected the outstanding candidates from the recitation competition to form a recitation team. Under the leadership of teacher Shi Jingwei, the children interpreted the cultural background of the story and recited the famous "Mulan Ci". The ingenious combination of recitation and dance creates a more majestic and high-quality program with cultural significance and dual visual and auditory enjoyment. The historical song and dance drama "Chinese Impression" directed by Tang Ke spans thousands of years of history, from the civilization of the Tang and Song Dynasties to the patriotic youth of modern times, from classical dance to national costume displays, and on-site calligraphy performances by children. It condenses the essence of Chinese culture into a program of just a few minutes. It is indeed a memorable impression of China. The dance "Baby, come on!" directed by teacher Jiang Lin. 》creates a group of enthusiastic and lively cheerleading girls. As we all know, cheerleading is a very popular activity among young girls in American universities and middle schools. This dance allows little girls who are too young to have real contact with cheerleading to become addicted to cheerleading. The children are even more energetic.

fc215e8ec2c92d16dfefb678a3d0ef0b68a85088.sourceText: 何春玲老师带领她的成人中国民族舞蹈班和中国现代舞班为大家分别带来中国民族舞《荷塘月色》和藏族舞蹈《心声》。前者曼妙婀娜，后者激荡人心，让观众感叹中国舞蹈艺术的精彩纷呈。武术班的同学们在指导老师李静慧的带领下，给我们展示了中国武术的博大精深，孩子们个个神采飞扬活力四射。最后文艺演出在希望中文学校学生和中华乐团共同合唱的《春晓》、《大海啊故乡》的歌声中降下帷幕。全体演出人员上台合影、谢幕，大家都沉浸在演出成功的喜悦中，久久不愿离去。在本次演出中，希望中文学校的四位小主持人的表现也是可圈可点，为节目增色不少。他们是即将毕业的杨汉文，陈卓婷，还有才读五年级的丁睿凡和毛妤娇。
fc215e8ec2c92d16dfefb678a3d0ef0b68a85088.translatedText: Teacher He Chunling led her adult Chinese folk dance class and Chinese modern dance class to bring you the Chinese folk dance "Moonlight over the Lotus Pond" and the Tibetan dance "Voice of the Heart" respectively. The former is graceful and graceful, while the latter is exciting and makes the audience marvel at the splendor of Chinese dance art. Under the leadership of instructor Li Jinghui, the students in the martial arts class showed us the breadth and depth of Chinese martial arts. The children were all full of energy. Finally, the artistic performance came to an end with the singing of "Spring Dawn" and "Ocean, My Hometown" sung by the Hope Chinese School students and the Chinese Orchestra. All the performers came on stage for a group photo and the curtain call. Everyone was immersed in the joy of a successful performance and did not want to leave for a long time. In this performance, the performance of the four young hosts from Hope Chinese School was also remarkable and added a lot to the show. They are Yang Hanwen and Chen Zhuoting, who are about to graduate, as well as Ding Ruifan and Mao Yujiao, who are only in fifth grade.

447b23e9f47a98ac24e031de3514ece714f18bad.sourceText: 在此我们衷心的对所有老师、家长、董事会成员、校委会成员以及所有的义工们道一声，您们辛苦了，正是各位的辛勤耕耘和无私付出，才有了希望的今天，更有了亚省华裔儿童希望的明天。让我们短暂休憩，期待八月的再次启航。新学期开学日期以及课程详情可登录学校网站
447b23e9f47a98ac24e031de3514ece714f18bad.translatedText: Here we sincerely say a thank you to all the teachers, parents, board members, school committee members and all volunteers. You have worked hard. It is your hard work and selfless dedication that gives you hope today, and a tomorrow that Chinese children in Alberta hope for. Let’s take a short break and look forward to setting sail again in August. The start date of the new semester and course details can be found on the school website

2b08aa30397737bfea8e96b3f33f4570f7938948.translatedText: He Fengchen: 9-day tour of New Zealand's North and South Islands in 2014 (Seven) Phoenix He Fengchen November 13th Te Anau - Milf Sound...

357c9692974a52be3ea8d7542a23c072d9325ff3.sourceText: 11月13日 第阿瑙Te Anau－米佛峡湾Milford Sound－皇后镇Queenstown 今天因要赶中午11:15的米佛峡湾游轮，因此导游要求我们早上5:45就要起床，6:25 装车。可偏偏这个旅馆没有叫早的服务，我眼一睁开已是6:10, 赶快起床，匆匆收拾好行李，还好正赶上装车。我们所住的旅馆是Fiord land Hotel, 餐厅很不错。早餐后我们的车就赶往米佛峡湾。今天天气很不错，阳光灿烂，是整个旅途以来最好的。途中经过镜湖，这个湖是以看雪山倒影而著称的。因要赶时间，导游规定我们只能逗留15分钟。我们一路沿着湖边的栈道走，一路找角度拍摄雪山倒印在湖中的美景，虽然景色很美，也不敢多逗留一分钟，最后按时回到车上。而后车开始驶往丛山峻岭中，到达开鑿在岩石之中的著名的荷马隧道。荷马隧道位于海拔954米的高山上，是一个1.2公里长单车道的表面是裸石的隧道，在1954年开通时是当时最长的此类型的隧道。由于是单车道，在同一时间只有一个方向的车可以行驶。我们到达隧道口时洞口有指示对方的车还有几分钟到达。我们这个方向的车就等候在洞口。几分钟后，对边的车队缓缓开出隧道，等我们这边放行的指示灯亮后，我们的车才得以通过隧道。出了隧道后等车子在山道上绕过弯再回头看，这隧道竟建筑在如此险峻的山腰上，刹是壮观。
357c9692974a52be3ea8d7542a23c072d9325ff3.translatedText: November 13th Te Anau - Milford Sound - Queenstown Today we have to catch the Milford Sound cruise at 11:15 noon, so the tour guide asked us to get up at 5:45 in the morning and load the car at 6:25. Unfortunately, this hotel did not have a wake-up call service. It was already 6:10 when I opened my eyes. I got up quickly and packed my luggage in a hurry. Fortunately, I was in time to load the car. The hotel we stayed in was Fiord land Hotel, and the restaurant was very good. After breakfast we drove to Milford Sound. The weather today is very good, the sun is shining, it is the best since the whole trip. On the way, we passed Mirror Lake, which is famous for seeing the reflection of snow-capped mountains. Because we were in a hurry, the tour guide stipulated that we could only stay for 15 minutes. We walked along the plank road by the lake, looking for angles to take pictures of the beautiful scenery of the snow-capped mountains reflected in the lake. Although the scenery was beautiful, we did not dare to stay for one more minute, and finally returned to the car on time. Then the car started to drive into the mountains and reached the famous Homer Tunnel dug into the rock. The Homer Tunnel is located on a mountain 954 meters above sea level. It is a 1.2-kilometer-long single-lane tunnel with a bare stone surface. When it opened in 1954, it was the longest tunnel of this type at the time. Since it is a single lane, only cars in one direction can travel at the same time. When we arrived at the entrance of the tunnel, there was a sign at the entrance that the other party's car would arrive in a few minutes. The car in our direction is waiting at the entrance of the cave. A few minutes later, the convoy on the other side slowly drove out of the tunnel. Only when the light on our side came on did our car pass through the tunnel. After exiting the tunnel, I waited until the car rounded the bend on the mountain road and looked back. This tunnel was actually built on such a steep mountainside. It was truly spectacular.

338e1bc9d3088ac9311e0179fdc181c030079fea.sourceText: 雪山在镜湖中的倒影 到达峡湾后正赶上将要出发的游轮，马上登船。峡湾是由冰川切割而形成的15公里的入海口，两边险峻的峡谷和雪山均高于1200米以上，非常壮观。米佛峡湾国家公园是新西兰最热门的旅游胜地之一，被英国著名作家，诺贝尔奖获得者Rudyard Kipling称之为世界第八大奇迹。我们一到船上正赶上开饭，领了午餐的牛肉pita和cookie但顾不上吃就跑到上边的甲板去看风景。刚到甲板就被迎面扑来的美景给震撼了，真是名不虚传，叹为观止–深邃的水面上群峰起伏，错落有致，正对面的那座Mitre Peak 突穆而起，高出水面1692米，据说是世界上最高的峡湾独峰。随着船的启动和改变方向，眼前的景色也不停的变
338e1bc9d3088ac9311e0179fdc181c030079fea.translatedText: The reflection of the snow-capped mountains in the Mirror Lake. After arriving at the fjord, we caught up with the cruise ship that was about to leave and boarded the ship immediately. The fjord is a 15-kilometer estuary cut by glaciers. The steep canyons and snow-capped mountains on both sides are more than 1,200 meters high, which is very spectacular. Milford Sound National Park is one of New Zealand's most popular tourist destinations and was called the eighth wonder of the world by the famous British writer and Nobel Prize winner Rudyard Kipling. As soon as we arrived on the boat, we were in time for dinner. We received the beef pita and cookies for lunch, but we didn't bother to eat and ran to the upper deck to look at the scenery. As soon as I arrived on the deck, I was shocked by the beautiful scenery that came to me. It was truly a well-deserved and breathtaking view - the peaks on the deep water surface were undulating and well-proportioned. The Miter Peak directly opposite rose abruptly, 1692 meters above the water. It is said to be the highest single peak in the fjord in the world. As the ship starts and changes direction, the scenery in front of you keeps changing

16a329898fd8aa20844ba2e0ebeda780d4c16def.sourceText: 建筑在峻岭之中的荷马隧道(白色的是入口) 换着角度，变得格外迷人。我不停地按着相机的快门，船每转一个角度就像是一幅新的画，直至船开入正常的航道我们才松了一口气跑回舱内去吃午餐。途中我们几乎一直在甲板上，沿途有看不完的美景：时而苍翠的峡谷，高耸的雪山，时而潺潺的瀑布，还有帆船，海狮?一直等船开到入海口，水面变得宽广起来，船才转弯往回开。在回去的路上船长还特意在经过一处瀑布时将船驶近瀑布，使大家感受一下经受瀑布的洗礼是一个怎样的 感觉。一个半小时后，游船返回码头。不夸张的说，这一次的游船是在这整个南岛旅游过程中印象最深刻，最美的一次经历。
16a329898fd8aa20844ba2e0ebeda780d4c16def.translatedText: The Homer Tunnel (the white one is the entrance) built in the steep mountains changes its angle and becomes particularly charming. I kept pressing the shutter of the camera, and every angle the ship turned was like a new painting. It was not until the ship entered the normal channel that we breathed a sigh of relief and ran back to the cabin to have lunch. We were on the deck almost all the way, and there were endless beautiful views along the way: sometimes green canyons, towering snow-capped mountains, sometimes gurgling waterfalls, sailboats, and sea lions. We waited until the ship reached the estuary and the water became wider before the ship turned and headed back. On the way back, the captain also specially sailed the boat close to a waterfall when passing it, so that everyone could feel what it was like to be baptized by a waterfall. An hour and a half later, the boat returned to the dock. It is no exaggeration to say that this cruise was the most impressive and beautiful experience during the entire trip to the South Island.

002847b2bfcb1300b07c99ea90d3c37521019249.sourceText: 米佛峡湾中的游轮 同车的六位旅友还参加了直升机俯瞰峡湾及冰川的活动，并在冰川上降落留了影。离开米佛峡湾后我们的车开回皇后镇，我们今天就会在皇后镇过夜。到达后一部分旅友去山顶的餐厅吃饭，并在皇后镇的最高处欣赏皇后镇的迷人夜景。其他人就在镇上逛一下，吃吃晚饭。我再次来到湖边的码头，已近黄昏，白天迷人的湖水和码头上停靠着的游轮都已沉浸在暮色中，唯有湖对面高高的 Remarkable雪峰仍在夕阳的照耀下反射着金色的光芒，真是美妙绝伦，叹为观止。
002847b2bfcb1300b07c99ea90d3c37521019249.translatedText: Cruise ship in Milford Sound. The six travelers in the same car also participated in a helicopter overlooking the fjord and glacier, and landed on the glacier to take photos. After leaving Milford Sound, our car will drive back to Queenstown, where we will spend the night today. After arriving, some travelers went to a restaurant on the top of the mountain to eat and enjoy the charming night view of Queenstown from the highest point of Queenstown. The others just walked around town and had dinner. I came to the pier by the lake again. It was almost dusk. The charming lake water during the day and the cruise ships docked on the pier were immersed in twilight. Only the tall Remarkable snow peaks on the other side of the lake were still reflecting the golden light under the setting sun. It was truly wonderful and breathtaking.

3a451a64a76e0ad974ba81dafb153dc4d05e6557.translatedText: Fur products in the Remarkable Xuefeng

716e3a69088d950a7b9979ac46bdc1b2551fe71a.sourceText: 自行车环球世界旅行者陈冠明 周一下午顺利抵达Flagstaff
716e3a69088d950a7b9979ac46bdc1b2551fe71a.translatedText: Cycling world traveler Chen Guanming successfully arrived in Flagstaff on Monday afternoon

2a0aec254c9410902cae2db05269dba10276d44e.sourceText: 自行车环球世界旅行者陈冠明 周一下午顺利抵达Flagstaff 经过７天的骑行，骑自车环球旅行者陈冠明于5…
2a0aec254c9410902cae2db05269dba10276d44e.translatedText: Cycling world traveler Chen Guanming successfully arrived in Flagstaff on Monday afternoon. After seven days of riding, cycling world traveler Chen Guanming arrived in Flagstaff on May 5...

9ad69736b65c868f9153e211b04a68b9a576e706.sourceText: 经过７天的骑行，骑自车环球旅行者陈冠明于5月4日下午3点左右顺利抵达Flagstaff. 陈冠明热情地接受了本网记者的采访。
9ad69736b65c868f9153e211b04a68b9a576e706.translatedText: After 7 days of riding, cycling world traveler Chen Guanming successfully arrived in Flagstaff at about 3 pm on May 4th. Chen Guanming enthusiastically accepted the interview from our reporter.

fcc15a83284e920d0721a1600b941cad56414458.sourceText: 亚利桑那第一印象？没见过长成十几米高的仙人掌。第一次见，也是一道特别的风景。
fcc15a83284e920d0721a1600b941cad56414458.translatedText: >First impression of Arizona? I have never seen a cactus that grows more than ten meters high. Seeing it for the first time is also a special scenery.

ea1a1c352d036ad6434446010c4ef15287785c93.sourceText: 沙漠中骑行之感受？让他想起了在国内戈壁滩上的骑行，人烟稀少。
ea1a1c352d036ad6434446010c4ef15287785c93.translatedText: How does it feel to ride in the desert? It reminded him of riding in the Gobi Desert back home, sparsely populated.

f4918041c48410bb37d5984615ca20552b4c5331.sourceText: 凤凰城到Flagstaff一路上有什么特别的经历吗？被一个外国朋友热情邀请回家做客。到了家才发现原来是老朋友。那个朋友拿出以前在加拿大和他合影的照片。
f4918041c48410bb37d5984615ca20552b4c5331.translatedText: Did you have any special experiences along the way from Phoenix to Flagstaff? I was warmly invited home by a foreign friend. When we got home, we discovered that we were old friends. The friend took out photos he had taken with him in Canada.

2ddbf30a0a0a2eb902cbcf2b5b8f5dde41cf8f67.sourceText: 最开心的事情？遇到了宋磊还有其他这些支持他的朋友们。
2ddbf30a0a0a2eb902cbcf2b5b8f5dde41cf8f67.translatedText: >The happiest thing? Met Song Lei and other friends who supported him.

eac3f38add5e30451fd7062bd89673c6e0bf679d.sourceText: 最困难的路段？有一段路海拔上升了两三千米，无法骑行，他用身体拽着三轮车向flagstaff徒步行走，每走８－１０米就休息一下，一直坚持下来。
eac3f38add5e30451fd7062bd89673c6e0bf679d.translatedText: The most difficult section? There was a section of the road where the altitude rose by two to three thousand meters, making it impossible to ride. He used his body to pull the tricycle and walked toward the flagstaff. He took a break every 8-10 meters and kept going.

c6c075922756cdf7ad5d4de469e1b89502e86ae3.sourceText: 路上车子是否有出现过问题？爆胎７－８次
c6c075922756cdf7ad5d4de469e1b89502e86ae3.translatedText: Have you ever had any problems with your car on the road? Tire puncture 7-8 times

49a472cacb2c8a4a16795c059f097dc0c7697eed.sourceText: 是否有考虑过放弃旅程？ 从来没有，一直要骑行到生命尽头
49a472cacb2c8a4a16795c059f097dc0c7697eed.translatedText: Have you considered giving up the journey? Never, I will ride until the end of my life

447d2ea7a4cca962f9b613d89f3ed4ec0917b4fa.sourceText: 在flagstaff短暂的停留后，陈冠明又已经上路，现在骑行在66号高速上，祝愿陈冠明一路顺利 平安。
447d2ea7a4cca962f9b613d89f3ed4ec0917b4fa.translatedText: After a short stay at flagstaff, Chen Guanming is on the road again, and is now riding on Highway 66. I wish Chen Guanming a smooth and safe journey.

32619d77540ad48923181013e913ba9d784b3ea2.sourceText: 陈冠明抵达凤凰城中国城

2949e3fe628cb16e318664da58c0e8b784dd5d31.sourceText: 【反法西斯胜利70周年亚省特刊】文若：纪念徐德之将军
2949e3fe628cb16e318664da58c0e8b784dd5d31.translatedText: [Alberta Special Issue on the 70th Anniversary of the Anti-Fascist Victory] Wen Ruo: In Memory of General Xu Dezhi

d90f248da2104a1dbcb62d33eb79f7df3be5131c.sourceText: 【反法西斯胜利70周年亚省特刊】文若：纪念徐德之将军 前言：今年是世界反法西斯暨中国抗战胜利七十周年，许多地方…
d90f248da2104a1dbcb62d33eb79f7df3be5131c.translatedText: [Alberta Special Issue on the 70th Anniversary of the Anti-Fascist Victory] Wen Ruo: In Memory of General Xu Dezhi Foreword: This year marks the 70th anniversary of the world’s anti-fascist and China’s victory in the War of Resistance. Many places...

1e72f71eceb01bb31710f64af2676c31239d0239.sourceText: 前言：今年是世界反法西斯暨中国抗战胜利七十周年，许多地方纷纷举办各种纪念活动，很多人也写出各类纪念文章。我们凤凰城，曾经有一位抗日爱国将军徐德之先生居住在这里，直到 2006 年去世；徐将军生前写过许多回忆当年在抗日军校”中国空军幼年学校”的文章；他的爱女徐凯莱医生，是亚利桑那地区影响很大的慈善医疗组织”亚太社区促进会”的创始人和首任会长；徐医生秉承其父母爱心助人的优良家风，多年来与众多热心义工在亚太社区从事慈善医疗事业。以下是我于 2006 年写的文章，作为对尊敬的徐将军的怀念，并以此纪念世界反法西斯暨中国抗战胜利七十周年。
1e72f71eceb01bb31710f64af2676c31239d0239.translatedText: Foreword: This year marks the 70th anniversary of the world’s anti-fascism and the victory of China’s War of Resistance. Various commemorative activities have been held in many places, and many people have written various commemorative articles. Our Phoenix city once had an anti-Japanese patriotic general, Mr. Xu Dezhi, who lived here until his death in 2006. During his lifetime, General Xu wrote many articles recalling his time at the "China Air Force Infantry School" at the anti-Japanese military academy. His beloved daughter, Dr. Xu Kailai, is the founder and first president of the "Asia-Pacific Community Promotion Association", a charitable medical organization with great influence in Arizona. Dr. Xu, adhering to his parents' good family tradition of loving and helping others, has been engaged in charity medical care in the Asia-Pacific community with many enthusiastic volunteers for many years. The following is an article I wrote in 2006 as a memory of the respected General Xu and to commemorate the 70th anniversary of the world’s anti-fascist and China’s victory in the Anti-Japanese War.

7fdd98a89d423d6beed4d81ad518f699ecc94d6d.translatedText: Patriotism, love in kindergarten, Christian love

2600c1690475396210e57acce3bb4de8d30c201c.sourceText: 1996 年我丈夫到 ASU 任教我们搬来凤凰城，直到 2006 年，我们才知道在凤凰城有几位我丈夫外公的学生，其中的一位徐德之将军还常常在报刊发表文章。后来，我们一家与徐德之伯伯一家在凤凰城相见，得益于我们的邻居好友陈秉智黄冠华夫妇在一次交谈给我们带来的惊喜。
2600c1690475396210e57acce3bb4de8d30c201c.translatedText: In 1996, my husband came to teach at ASU and we moved to Phoenix. It was not until 2006 that we learned that there were several students of my husband’s grandfather in Phoenix. One of them, General Xu Dezhi, often published articles in newspapers and periodicals. Later, our family met Uncle Xu Dezhi and his family in Phoenix City, thanks to the surprise brought to us by a conversation between our neighbors and friends Chen Bingzhi and Huang Guanhua.

6b855c04ee2025292af2a491507d0ab0c88296a9.sourceText: 陈秉智黄冠华夫妇来自台湾，他们是徐伯伯一家的好朋友。 2006 年 1 月下旬的一天，冠华到我家小坐，见到一本关于”汪强将军诞辰 100 周年”的回忆录，交谈中把徐伯伯的经历与我丈夫的外祖父汪强将军联系起来了。于是冠华很快将此消息转告了徐伯伯。徐伯伯说，汪强是我们的教育长，”中国空军幼年学校”校长按例名义上由蒋中正兼任，实际上由教育长汪强将军常驻学校主导校务。徐伯伯还说，他多年来就想见见汪教育长的家人，他是幼校一期学生，在大后方的空幼校学习了八年；汪教育长待他们像自己的儿子一样，而且汪教育长的二女儿汪爱丽（即我的婆母）与他们年龄相仿；汪二小姐每逢周末从华美女中返回位于四川蒲阳的”幼校”家中，常常能见到面；徐伯伯还风趣地说，当年我们军校学生全是情窦初开的”小和尚”，对美丽的二小姐只敢悄悄在心里倾慕而已。
6b855c04ee2025292af2a491507d0ab0c88296a9.translatedText: > Chen Bingzhi and Huang Guanhua are from Taiwan. They are good friends of Uncle Xu’s family. One day in late January 2006, Guanhua came to sit at my house and saw a memoir about "The 100th Anniversary of the Birth of General Wang Qiang." During the conversation, he connected Uncle Xu's experience with my husband's grandfather, General Wang Qiang. So Guanhua quickly conveyed the news to Uncle Xu. Uncle Xu said that Wang Qiang is our chief of education. As usual, the principal of the "China Air Force Infant School" is nominally concurrently served by Chiang Kai-shek. In fact, the chief of education, General Wang Qiang, is resident in the school and leads the school affairs. Uncle Xu also said that he has wanted to meet the family of Director Wang for many years. He is a first-year kindergarten student and has studied at Kong Kindergarten in the rear area for eight years. Director Wang treats them like his own sons, and Director Wang’s second daughter Wang Aili (my mother-in-law) is about the same age as them. Imitation; Second Miss Wang returned to her home in Puyang, Sichuan every weekend from the beautiful girls, and we often met each other. Uncle Xu also said wittily that at that time, all our military school students were "little monks" who had just begun to fall in love, and they only dared to secretly admire the beautiful Second Miss in their hearts.

ad207e070e63469d65280529e83cb631a970d410.sourceText: 可惜当时我先生因享受 ASU 大学 学术度假已经去了日本，几天后我也将赴日本。于是徐伯伯托冠华约定我们于三月底返美时见面。我们在日本期间，冠华在电话中转告，徐伯伯非常盼望与我们见面，而且凭记忆画了一幅空军幼年学校所在地四川灌县蒲阳河畔沟子山的油画准备送给我们，还安排了等我们回美请我们以及冠华一家餐叙。可是就在我们回美的前一周， 3 月 19 日徐伯伯突然中风住院了。我们回美短暂待了几天，冠华将我们一家三人在徐伯伯赠送的油画前的合影，送给了徐伯伯。
ad207e070e63469d65280529e83cb631a970d410.translatedText: Unfortunately, my husband had already gone to Japan during his academic vacation at ASU University, and I would also go to Japan in a few days. So Uncle Xu asked Guanhua to make an appointment for us to meet when we return to the United States at the end of March. While we were in Japan, Guanhua told us on the phone that Uncle Xu was very much looking forward to meeting us. He also drew an oil painting from memory of Gouzi Mountain on the banks of the Puyang River in Guan County, Sichuan Province, where the Air Force Junior School is located, and prepared to give it to us. He also arranged to treat us and Guanhua's family to a meal when we returned to the United States. But just a week before we returned to the United States, Uncle Xu suddenly suffered a stroke and was hospitalized on March 19. We returned to the United States for a few days, and Guanhua gave Uncle Xu a photo of the three of us in front of the oil painting presented by Uncle Xu.

0a596ad858eccd959dfe8b6f84d977d8ede49f31.sourceText: 后来我们在日本期间，听说徐伯伯恢复得非常好，我们真是感叹他生命力的顽强。他还表示，有精力时将把与汪教育长的后代在凤凰城相认的故事写出来。以徐伯伯丰硕著作的功力和笔耕不已的毅力，我们等待着拜读徐伯伯的生动文章。
0a596ad858eccd959dfe8b6f84d977d8ede49f31.translatedText: Later, when we were in Japan, we heard that Uncle Xu was recovering very well. We were really impressed by his tenacity. He also said that when he has the energy, he will write the story of how he met Mr. Wang’s descendants in Phoenix. With Uncle Xu’s prolific writing skills and endless perseverance in writing, we look forward to reading Uncle Xu’s vivid articles.

d485ec094a5cbbc2fefae1821395d326d6049984.sourceText: 2006 年夏回美后，我们一直等待徐伯伯尽早恢复能够见面。 9 月 16 日，徐伯伯的一些至亲好友为他庆祝八十一岁大寿，也邀请了我们。徐伯伯一见到我们，马上站起来，握着我丈夫的手，说了很多关于空军幼年学校，关于汪教育长的话题，当时的情景很感人。徐伯伯的敏捷，健谈，乐观令我们非常敬佩。我们带上了汪强将军的照片、书籍资料、空幼校校友聚会的录像等，因担心徐伯伯太激动会影响心脏，我们和他的家人约好下次见面再全部拿给他看。分别时，我们和冠华夫妇与徐伯伯留影，大家度过了一个极其美好的夜晚。
d485ec094a5cbbc2fefae1821395d326d6049984.translatedText: After returning to the United States in the summer of 2006, we have been waiting for Uncle Xu to recover as soon as possible and be able to see each other. On September 16, some of Uncle Xu's close friends and relatives celebrated his eighty-first birthday and invited us. As soon as Uncle Xu saw us, he stood up immediately, held my husband's hand, and talked a lot about Air Force Infant School and Superintendent Wang. The scene at that time was very touching. We admire Uncle Xu very much for his agility, talkativeness and optimism. We brought General Wang Qiang’s photos, books and materials, videos of Kongyou School alumni gatherings, etc. Because we were worried that Uncle Xu’s too much excitement would affect his heart, we made an appointment with his family to show them all to him the next time we meet. When we parted, we took photos with Mr. and Mrs. Guanhua and Uncle Xu. We all had a wonderful night.

9b17e93da31acd57160949482e780be0041e80d2.sourceText: 9 月 24 日，徐伯伯突然病情变化住院， 10 月 2 日，受到众人尊重的徐伯伯辞世。使我们万万难以相信的是，我们在徐伯伯生日聚会上的见面，竟是第一次也是最后的一次见面，怎不令人痛悔万分！
9b17e93da31acd57160949482e780be0041e80d2.translatedText: On September 24, Uncle Xu's condition suddenly changed and he was hospitalized. On October 2, Uncle Xu, who was respected by everyone, passed away. What makes us absolutely unbelievable is that our meeting at Uncle Xu’s birthday party was actually the first and last time we met. How can we not be extremely regretful!

72bfd272314e2b0f37a3840bcba414230e7cdc37.sourceText: 哀讯传到南京，徐伯伯当年一期的同学、空军幼年学校校友会的负责人刘祥骐伯伯，还有我的婆母汪爱丽教授做为汪教育长的后人立即发来唁文，痛悼友人的辞世。后来，两位长辈口述回忆，嘱我整理成文，表达他们的思念之情。
72bfd272314e2b0f37a3840bcba414230e7cdc37.translatedText: The news of grief reached Nanjing. Uncle Xu’s classmate in the first batch and the head of the Air Force Infant School Alumni Association, Uncle Liu Xiangqi, and my mother-in-law, Professor Wang Aili, as the descendants of Superintendent Wang, immediately sent condolences to mourn the death of their friend. Later, the two elders recounted their memories orally and asked me to compile them into a document to express their longing.

096e78e0ed7396b4b69f2016a8515af480e0f870.sourceText: 1939 年，正当日本帝国主义把侵略铁蹄伸入中国腹地，日寇的飞机对我国大后方狂轰滥炸，无数平民百姓死于非命。当时国家航委会任命保定军校第三期出身、曾在美国留过学的汪强将军在四川筹建一所以培养抗日空军后备军为目标的学校”中国空军幼年学校”。
096e78e0ed7396b4b69f2016a8515af480e0f870.translatedText: In 1939, just as the Japanese imperialists extended their iron hooves of aggression into the hinterland of China, Japanese aircraft bombed our country's rear areas indiscriminately, killing countless civilians. At that time, the National Aviation Commission appointed General Wang Qiang, who was born in the third batch of Baoding Military Academy and had studied in the United States, to prepare a school in Sichuan with the goal of cultivating anti-Japanese air force reserve forces, the "China Air Force Infant School".

a12d9db488f9b44ea8b5b8103e3a1a7394842c2b.sourceText: 当时许多省的爱国少年，纷纷报考，经 过 身体测试 和 笔试，最后是百人千人挑一。徐德之伯伯在 12 岁时只身一人远离父母来到了这所学校，成为空军幼年学校第一期学生。接受了既有军事化训练又有德、智、体、美、劳、高素质的培养；既强调整体纪律观念又重视个性充分发展；既传授中国优秀的古老传统思想又融入了西方文明的先进教育理念。徐伯伯在这样的教育环境中，抱着将来要成长为一名飞行员，驾驶铁翼把日本强盗赶出国门、收复失地的决心而努力学习着。空军幼年学校的同学为他撰写的小传曰：徐君德之善诙谐，语言幽默而富风趣，为人谨慎诚实，同学莫不乐与为友。君身材适度，为一翩翩美少年，嗜文艺，极爱交际，而不好运动，处事敏捷，机智过人，尤好探求新奇，君细目，其视也如瞑，故同学咸戏呼之曰”咪咪”。徐伯伯与他的同学们在青少年时代就怀有一颗坚定的”爱国心”，要洗刷国耻，所以都练就了坚强的意志和高超的技艺。几十年来，海峡两岸和遍布各大洲的空军幼年学校的同学中，不仅许多人成为空军骨干，还有许多人以其在幼校的功底，进入其它专业学习，在科技，教育，实业，艺术等领域有所建树者不乏其人。有的成了杰出的飞机设计师，还有的成为业绩显著的大学教授，而徐伯伯后来就成为了一名能行医、会油画、擅写作的空军儒将军。
a12d9db488f9b44ea8b5b8103e3a1a7394842c2b.translatedText: At that time, patriotic young people from many provinces applied for the exam one after another. After passing the physical test and written test, one person from hundreds of thousands of people was finally selected. Uncle Xu Dezhi came to this school alone away from his parents when he was 12 years old and became a student in the first batch of the Air Force Infant School. They have received both military training and high-quality education in moral, intellectual, physical, aesthetic, labor and quality; they have emphasized both overall discipline and full personality development; they have not only imparted China's excellent ancient traditional thoughts but also incorporated advanced educational concepts from Western civilization. In such an educational environment, Uncle Xu studied hard with the determination to grow into a pilot in the future, drive the iron wings to drive Japanese bandits out of the country and regain lost territory. A biography written about him by his classmates at the Air Force Infantry School said: Xu Junde was good and humorous, his language was humorous and interesting, he was cautious and honest, and all his classmates were happy to be friends with him. You are of moderate stature, a handsome young man, fond of literature and art, very sociable, but not good at sports, quick in dealing with things, witty, and especially fond of exploring novelties. When you look at details, you can see as if you are at peace, so your classmates jokingly call him "Mimi". Uncle Xu and his classmates had a firm "patriotic heart" when they were teenagers and wanted to wash away the national humiliation, so they all developed a strong will and superb skills. Over the past few decades, among the students of Air Force Kindergarten Schools on both sides of the Taiwan Strait and across all continents, not only many have become the backbone of the Air Force, but many have used their skills in kindergartens to study in other majors, and there are many who have made achievements in the fields of science and technology, education, industry, art and other fields. Some became outstanding aircraft designers, and others became university professors with outstanding achievements. Uncle Xu later became an Air Force Confucian general who was able to practice medicine, oil painting, and writing.

935e58303f69a19fce8677f8bc251cba660184a5.sourceText: 徐伯伯从十二岁起在蒲阳河畔的空军幼年学校度过了对人生历程中最有影响的八年，因此他有着浓厚的”蒲阳情”，他不但积极为《蒲阳通讯》撰稿，还常与同学相聚。他身居美国，远离蒲阳，还能凭记忆绘制了一幅蒲阳河畔沟子山的油画。这幅油画充分表露了徐伯伯对蒲阳的深切怀念及心中浓厚的蒲阳之情。在空军幼年学校的数年生活，学生们从小朝夕相处产生的这种”蒲阳情”是一种特殊的感情，虽非兄弟却胜似兄弟。正如空幼校校友们所说，这是一种”缔结于抗日烽火的特殊年代，植根于蒲阳山水的特定环境，由共同对侵略者刻骨铭心的仇恨所浇铸”而成的感情。由于岁月的洗磨，当年的两千一百位蒲阳少年，现在大约只剩下一千位古稀老人了。但他们都一样珍重地保护着心中越陈越醇的蒲阳情，都对抗日烽烟中有过的峥嵘岁月充满骄傲，他们有时自豪地用训练有素的歌喉忆唱着自己”论年则幼，用志不歧”的人生初旅，唱着无愧于祖国、无负于时代的童心淬砺历程。这种深埋在心中的蒲阳情，经过近 20 多年来，北京、北美、台湾三地《蒲阳通讯》的交流，经过无数次的各种形式的聚会，这种”蒲阳情”更为发展、更加深厚。这种感情从全世界来看，在所有的军事学校、普通学校之中也是不容易见到的。
935e58303f69a19fce8677f8bc251cba660184a5.translatedText: From the age of twelve, Uncle Xu spent the most influential eight years in his life at the Air Force Junior School on the banks of the Puyang River. Therefore, he has a strong "Puyang love". He not only actively wrote articles for "Puyang News", but also often got together with his classmates. Living in the United States, far away from Puyang, he was able to draw an oil painting of Gouzi Mountain by the Puyang River from memory. This oil painting fully expresses Uncle Xu's deep memory for Pu Yang and the strong affection for Pu Yang in his heart. After several years of living in the Air Force Junior School, the "Puyang love" that the students have developed from getting along with each other day and night is a special kind of relationship. Although they are not brothers, they are better than brothers. As the alumni of Kongyou School said, this is a feeling that was “formed in the special era of the Anti-Japanese War, rooted in the specific environment of Puyang’s landscape, and cast by the unforgettable hatred of the invaders.” Due to the passage of time, there are now only about a thousand elderly people left out of the 2,100 young people in Puyang. But they all cherish the Puyang love in their hearts that gets better and better as time goes by, and they are all full of pride in the prosperous years they spent in the war against Japan. Sometimes they proudly use their well-trained singing voices to recall their first journey in life, "how young they are despite their age, but to have the same ambition." This feeling of Puyang buried deep in my heart has become more developed and deeper after more than 20 years of exchanges between "Puyang Newsletters" in Beijing, North America, and Taiwan, and countless gatherings of various forms. This kind of feeling is not easy to see in all military schools and ordinary schools from all over the world.

98d9ed42db0ada3f786fced3048d905dce39cfbd.sourceText: 徐伯伯来美后成为一名基督徒，他热心为教会的许多活动服务，一贯乐于助人，经常款待来美受训的空军人员。更重要的是，徐伯伯的智慧，宽容，坚毅，豁达，使所有接触过他的人都获得了一种精神上的感召力，他在教会和侨界获得了赞许、敬佩和尊重。从徐伯伯撰写的文章中，常能感受到他的感恩之心及传福音的热情，徐伯伯有着深深的”基督之爱”。
98d9ed42db0ada3f786fced3048d905dce39cfbd.translatedText: Uncle Xu became a Christian after coming to the United States. He enthusiastically served many church activities, was always willing to help others, and often entertained air force personnel who came to the United States for training. More importantly, Uncle Xu's wisdom, tolerance, perseverance and open-mindedness gave everyone who came into contact with him a spiritual inspiration. He gained praise, admiration and respect from the church and the overseas Chinese community. From the articles written by Uncle Xu, we can often feel his gratitude and enthusiasm for evangelism. Uncle Xu has a deep "Christian love".

f75ac27cf66903e3122d5fff4867896b64e5c0b6.sourceText: 现在，徐伯伯已经离开了尘世。我与徐伯伯仅见过一面，我们再也见不到他曾想动笔写出因见到汪教育长的后人而引出的漫长岁月中的记忆珍藏，这真是令我们万分痛惜。今天，我只能以我的文笔，代我们的几位长辈表达对徐伯伯的深切思念之情。愿徐伯伯与他爱戴的、同为基督徒的”中国空军幼年学校”教育长汪强将军在天堂里相会。 ( 写于 2006 年 10 月）
f75ac27cf66903e3122d5fff4867896b64e5c0b6.translatedText: Now, Uncle Xu has passed away. I only met Uncle Xu once, and we will never see him again. We wanted to write down the memories of the long years that were triggered by meeting the descendants of Superintendent Wang. This is really a pity for us. Today, I can only use my writing style to express my deep thoughts for Uncle Xu on behalf of several of our elders. May Uncle Xu and his beloved General Wang Qiang, the education director of the "China Air Force Infant School" who is also a Christian, meet in heaven. (Written in October 2006)

cfe791b2f90c527649b0e8ae2895e855721ddedd.sourceText: 由甄子丹、王宝强、杨采妮、白冰主演，《十月围城》导演陈德森执导，耗资近2亿港币的悬疑功夫大片《一个人的武林》将于4月24日起在北美影院上映。这部影片集结几代港片台前幕后英雄，创新改革功夫片类型，融合警匪悬疑元素的同时为观众展现各流派精彩过瘾的打斗。该片在伦敦电影节首映后即掀起好评热潮，被国际媒体赞为”给港产经典功夫片和全球功夫影迷的一封真挚热烈的情书”。
cfe791b2f90c527649b0e8ae2895e855721ddedd.translatedText: Starring Donnie Yen, Wang Baoqiang, Yang Caini, and Bai Bing, and directed by "October Siege" director Chen Desen, the suspenseful kung fu blockbuster "One Man's Martial Arts" costing nearly HK$200 million will be released in North American theaters starting from April 24. This film brings together generations of Hong Kong film heroes both on stage and behind the scenes, innovating and reforming the kung fu film genre, integrating police and gangster suspense elements while presenting the audience with exciting and enjoyable fights from various genres. The film set off a wave of critical acclaim after its premiere at the London Film Festival, and was praised by international media as "a sincere and passionate love letter to classic Hong Kong kung fu films and global kung fu fans."

363ef12f7ce1d188726bd8267de1f8143acb6281.sourceText: 影片题目”一个人的武林”比喻现代社会中武林不复存在，但每个练武之人心中仍有属于自己的流派，武学追求和成败标准。故事讲述曾为武林公认第一的夏侯武（甄子丹饰）因比赛误杀对手自首入狱，却从新闻中得知弃武过上普通人生活的各派高手接连被神秘人用自家绝技杀害。为阻止惨剧继续，他主动请求协助重案组总督察（杨采妮 饰）调查此案，岂料幕后凶手封于修（王宝强 饰）的执着动摇了夏侯武的武术观，更激发出他不为人知的野心。
363ef12f7ce1d188726bd8267de1f8143acb6281.translatedText: The title of the film "One Man's Martial Arts" is a metaphor for the fact that martial arts no longer exists in modern society, but every martial arts practitioner still has his own school, martial arts pursuit and success or failure standards in his heart. The story tells the story of Xia Houwu (played by Donnie Yen), who was once recognized as the number one in the martial arts world and surrendered to jail for accidentally killing his opponent in a competition. However, he learned from the news that masters from various sects who abandoned martial arts and lived ordinary lives were successively killed by mysterious people using their own unique skills. In order to prevent the tragedy from continuing, he actively requested to assist the Chief Inspector of the Crime Unit (played by Yang Caini) in investigating the case. Unexpectedly, the persistence of the murderer Feng Yuxiu (played by Wang Baoqiang) behind the scenes shook Xiahou Wu's view of martial arts and inspired his unknown ambitions.

e92280da60c5b985ea2a03107909eb5f41c9339f.sourceText: 生于武学世家，为习武从波士顿辗转到北京从师的主演甄子丹凭《叶问》系列成为接班李小龙、成龙、李连杰的国际巨星，因此对功夫片有强烈使命感，希望传承这一华语电影最具世界影响力的宝贵片种与好莱坞动作片抗衡。为支持没老板肯尝试的好剧本，甄子丹还曾自掏腰包投拍功夫片，不料遭遇经济危机赔到账户中只剩100块港币，不得不靠出演一系列烂片还债。为追求镜头前的动作完美无缺，他常年不用替身，全身布满新伤旧痛，手指神经坏死已无知觉仍坚持表演。此次与陈德森合作，甄子丹除了为观众奉上拳拳到肉的打斗，还包揽武术动作设计，配合导演创作展示南拳、北腿、擒拿、兵器四个派别高手与杀手决斗的几场激战，获香港金像奖最佳动作设计奖提名。
e92280da60c5b985ea2a03107909eb5f41c9339f.translatedText: Born into a martial arts family, the star Donnie Yen moved from Boston to Beijing to study martial arts and became an international star succeeding Bruce Lee, Jackie Chan and Jet Li through the "Ip Man" series. Therefore, he has a strong sense of mission for kung fu movies and hopes to inherit this valuable genre of Chinese-language movies with the most global influence to compete with Hollywood action movies. In order to support a good script that no boss was willing to try, Donnie Yen also spent his own money to make a kung fu movie. Unexpectedly, he encountered an economic crisis and only had 100 Hong Kong dollars left in his account. He had to star in a series of bad movies to pay off his debts. In order to pursue perfect movements in front of the camera, he did not use a stand-in all year round. His whole body was covered with new injuries and old pains, and he still continued to perform despite having nerve necrosis in his fingers and losing all feeling. In this cooperation with Chen Desen, Donnie Yen not only provided the audience with fist-to-pound fights, but also took over the martial arts action design. He cooperated with the director to create several fierce battles in which masters of the four factions of southern boxing, northern kick, grappling, and weapons dueled with killers. He was nominated for the Best Action Design Award at the Hong Kong Film Awards.

b65bea0c4a59c335958c150cbc620f9d5e25470e.sourceText: 亲历几代功夫片起伏的导演陈德森对该类型近年烂片频出的困境有独特思考，并将改革付诸实际行动。回首功夫由北传南至广东、香港，从擂台到大荧幕乃至世界电影舞台的繁荣，陈德森认为是那些不用替身、特效，亲身上阵打真功夫的一代影人为港产功夫片赢得了全球影迷和美誉。近年来动作电影产量减少，曾经的幕后英雄被伤痛困扰，生活更是每况愈下。为给他们争取晚年福利，陈德森拍戏之余常四处游说筹款资助退役武行。此次拍片除了为观众展示精彩的武术动作、历史传统、背景文化，他还邀请几十位功夫片前辈前来客串，细心的影迷会在片中发现《大侠霍元甲》武指徐小明、《功夫》武指袁祥仁、《独臂刀》主演姜大卫、《射雕英雄传》主演杨盼盼、《无间道》导演刘伟强甚至嘉禾创始人邹文怀等人的身影一闪而过。他希望这一设计除了致敬经典，也能让观众懂得功夫片是由几代香港影人集体的心血和牺牲凝聚而成。
b65bea0c4a59c335958c150cbc620f9d5e25470e.translatedText: Director Chen Desen, who has personally experienced the ups and downs of several generations of kung fu movies, has unique thoughts on the plight of the genre that has seen frequent bad movies in recent years, and has put reforms into practical actions. Looking back on the spread of kung fu from the north to the south to Guangdong and Hong Kong, and its prosperity from the ring to the big screen and even the world's movie stage, Chen Desen believes that it is the generation of filmmakers who practice real kung fu without substitutes or special effects that have won global fans and reputation for Hong Kong kung fu films. In recent years, the output of action movies has decreased. The former behind-the-scenes heroes have been plagued by injuries and their lives have gone from bad to worse. In order to provide them with benefits in their later years, Chen Desen often lobbied around to raise funds to support retired martial arts after filming. In addition to showcasing wonderful martial arts movements, historical traditions, and background culture for the audience, he also invited dozens of kung fu film seniors to make guest appearances. Careful fans will notice the flashes of martial arts commander Xu Xiaoming from "Fearless Fearless", Yuan Xiangren from "Kung Fu", David Jiang, the star of "One-Armed Sword", Yang Panpan, the star of "The Legend of the Condor Heroes", Liu Weiqiang, the director of "Infernal Affairs", and even Zou Wenhuai, the founder of Jiahe Harvest. He hopes that this design will not only pay tribute to classics, but also allow the audience to understand that kung fu movies are the result of the collective efforts and sacrifices of generations of Hong Kong filmmakers.

66a9ca8990514986f7569860c49b47ae3e7944ae.sourceText: 片中大反派的主演王宝强虽以憨厚老实的喜剧形象深入人心，其实从小就在少林寺接受严格的武术训练，更因李连杰主演的经典功夫片《少林寺》燃起电影梦。陈德森导演看他身形瘦小声音细弱还曾对其质疑，直到他露出真功夫才被震撼，赶忙签下连拍几部的合约。两位女主角中扮演女督察的杨采妮利落干练，扮演甄子丹师妹的白冰则大秀剑法，令人惊艳。
66a9ca8990514986f7569860c49b47ae3e7944ae.translatedText: Although Wang Baoqiang, the main villain in the film, is deeply rooted in the hearts of the people with his honest and honest comedy image, he has actually received strict martial arts training in the Shaolin Temple since he was a child. His dream of becoming a movie star was sparked by the classic kung fu movie "Shaolin Temple" starring Jet Li. Director Chen Desen once questioned him when he saw his thin stature and weak voice. It was not until he showed his true skills that he was shocked and hurriedly signed a contract to shoot several movies in a row. Among the two heroines, Yang Caini, who plays the female inspector, is neat and capable, while Bai Bing, who plays Donnie Yen's junior sister, shows off her sword skills, which is amazing.
