08ba63b1c69044c7fe228e8da272a775fe5a436c.sourceText: 凤凰城 鳯鸣 2015年5月3日下午1：30pm在教会大堂，中文学校的师生和学生家长们欢聚一堂，为庆祝学生们一年的勤奋学习所取得的丰硕成果，举行了庄严、欢乐的毕业与结业典礼。学生们在准备期末考试的同时，在各班班主任老师的带领下，还精心准备了精彩节目。典礼开始前，由教会青少年敬拜小组带领敬拜，他（她）们都是今年的高中毕业生，在踏入大学校门前，为他（她）们的学弟学妹们，再尽一份心、一份力，鼓励学生们继续努力，争取优秀的成绩。接下来，由刘书华牧师作会前祷告，在神的恩典中，预祝典礼成功！ 典礼主持人由Ap班的学生轮流担任，在唱游班/学前班小朋友的咏鹅，找朋友声中拉开帷幕，听着稚嫩的童声，和着不规则的舞姿，十分赏心悦目又可爱。接下来有刘书华牧师颁发成绩特优奖，共三十二位同学荣获此大奖，看着得奖的同学活蹦欢快地、一个接一个地从刘书华牧师手中接过奖杯，笑容灿烂地站在台上，家长们纷纷跑到台前，为得奖的同学们录像的录像、拍照的拍照，给同学们留下这美好而荣耀的瞬间，时间嘎然而止，美丽的画面，成为每个获奖者的幸福回忆。
08ba63b1c69044c7fe228e8da272a775fe5a436c.translatedText: >Phoenix City Minming At 1:30 pm on May 3, 2015, in the church lobby, teachers, students and parents of the Chinese school gathered together to celebrate the fruitful results of the students’ hard work for a year and held a solemn and joyful graduation and completion ceremony. While preparing for the final exam, the students also carefully prepared exciting programs under the leadership of their homeroom teachers. Before the ceremony began, worship was led by the church's youth worship team. They are all high school graduates this year. Before entering the university, they would like to do their best for their fellow students and encourage them to continue working hard and strive for excellent results. Next, Pastor Liu Shuhua gave a pre-meeting prayer, wishing the ceremony a success in God’s grace! The host of the ceremony was taken turns by the students from the Ap class. The ceremony kicked off with the singing of the children from the swimming class/preschool class, singing "Goose" and "Looking for Friends". Listening to the immature children's voices and irregular dance movements, it was very pleasing to the eye and cute. Next, Pastor Liu Shuhua presented the Outstanding Achievement Award. A total of 32 students won this award. Watching the award-winning students lively and cheerfully taking the trophies from Pastor Liu Shuhua one by one, standing on the stage with bright smiles, parents rushed to the stage to videotape and take photos of the award-winning students, leaving this beautiful and glorious moment for the students. Time stopped suddenly, and the beautiful picture became a happy memory for each winner.

a4cc0b451139b8415c4866b6c6d4bd4b1b043089.sourceText: 颁奖告一段落，欢快的歌声响起，”老师祝福你，天空七彩虹，十枝花” ，是简体幼儿班献给老师的歌；简体四班的朗读表演 —司马光；儿童舞蹈班的舞蹈—-花仙子；简体二班的儿歌”幸福的脸，小小世界” ；简体三班的儿歌”十二生肖歌”， 简体一班的诗歌朗诵，有6首之多，对这些出生在美国的孩子来说，能表演这些诗歌与儿歌，实在不是一件容易的事。他（她）们不光表演诗歌和儿歌，青少年舞蹈班的舞蹈表演：”山村小姑娘”，”茉莉花” ，也是有模有样，在优美悦耳的音乐伴奏下，翩翩起舞、如花似锦、婀娜多姿，一个个如美女天使来人间。使我们这些观看者，也如醉如痴，如同在梦中，会埸上不断响起此起彼伏的热烈掌声，为同学们的表演献上祝福！
a4cc0b451139b8415c4866b6c6d4bd4b1b043089.translatedText: The awards came to an end, and the cheerful song sounded, "Teacher bless you, the sky is colorful and ten flowers", which is a song dedicated to the teacher by the Simplified Chinese kindergarten class; the reading performance of Simplified Chinese Class 4 - Sima Guang; the dance of the children's dance class - Flower Fairy; the children's song "Happy Face, Little World" by the Simplified Chinese Class 2; the children's song "Twelve Zodiac Songs" by the Simplified Chinese Class 3, Simplified Chinese Class 1 recited as many as 6 poems. For these children born in the United States, it was not easy to perform these poems and children's songs. They not only performed poems and children's songs, but the dance performances of the youth dance class: "Mountain Girl" and "Jasmine" were also stylish. Accompanied by beautiful and sweet music, they danced gracefully, like flowers, and were graceful, like beautiful angels coming to the world. We viewers were also mesmerized, as if we were in a dream. Warm applause kept ringing out in the venue, blessing the students for their performances!

d7c127277d141af86e2dd2a1a129939273ed4f5f.sourceText: 第三阶段由李鸿志董事颁发识字/朗诵比赛奖，又一批获奖的同学高高兴兴接过奖杯，整整齐齐地站在舞台上，又是一阵录像和拍照的时间，这是同学们一年努力的成绩，笑在脸上、美在心里，更是像花开在老师和家长的心里。最后一个节目是简体六班的配乐诗朗诵：”春江花月夜” ，一群少男少女在琶琶的拌奏下，朗诵着张若虚的诗”春江花月夜” ，清脆悦悦耳的琵琶声从女同学的指尖流出，伴着阴阳顿挫的感人诗句，真是秀了一顿赏心悦目的大餐，使人得到身心灵的净化，他（她）们的完美表演，赢得到了众人热烈掌声，这掌声里包含着赞美，包含着鼓励，更包含着爱！
d7c127277d141af86e2dd2a1a129939273ed4f5f.translatedText: In the third stage, Director Li Hongzhi presented the literacy/reciting competition awards. Another group of award-winning students happily received the trophies and stood neatly on the stage. It was another time for video and photo taking. This is the result of the students' hard work for a year. They are smiling on their faces, beautiful in their hearts, and like flowers blooming in the hearts of teachers and parents. The last program was a poem recitation with music by Simplified Chinese Class 6: "Spring River with Flowers and Moonlight Night". A group of boys and girls recited Zhang Ruoxu's poem "Spring River with Flowers and Moonlight Night" to the music of pipa. , the crisp and melodious sound of pipa flowed from the fingertips of the female classmates, accompanied by the touching verses of yin and yang, it was a feast for the eyes and ears, which purified people's body, mind and soul. Their perfect performance won warm applause from everyone. This applause contained praise, encouragement and even love!

97fd26c5c19d72c48f970c62bd4a934b0dc14675.sourceText: 最后，沉美京校长向本届五名毕业生颁发毕业证书，这五名同学经过数年刻苦努力的学习，终于迎来毕业的神圣时刻，衷心祝福他们！ 毕业与结业典礼在全场欢声笑语中结束！学生们高高兴兴、三五成群地飞快涌向奖品屋领奖，对自己一年的辛勤学习，有个美好的奖赏。 凤凰城华人基督教会中文学校成立于1983年，至今已有32年的历史，是一个非营利组织学校。目前学校设有唱游班, 中文学前班, 简体幼儿班, 注音班, 正体班4个、简体班8个、双语班4个、会话班1个、中文AP班1个、课后活动班中有2个舞蹈班，2个绘画班， 3个数学班和1个武术班共30个班级250多位学生。办校宗旨是教导学生学习中文及中国传统文化以外，并融和基督博爱真理来培养学生健全品格。该校老师、同工，皆本着荣神益人、传扬中华文化为心志。聘任的老师和助教，均是具有爱心、服务热忱、肯牺牲奉献，志同道合的伙伴。办学的目标是：老师队伍专业化、教学系统化、环境社区化、教材趣味化、家长参与化。本年度校长沉美京校长，在中文学校执教14年，曾三年度任中文学校校长。今年在沉美京校长的领导下，大力开展各项工作，取得不寻常的业绩。盼望凤凰城基督教会中文学校越办越好，欢迎对传扬中华文化有责任感的有志之士，到中文学校与全体同工同心协力办好学校！ 下学年的开学日是8/16/2015下午1:30pm 注册日是8/9/2015下午1:30pm～3:30.pm 欢迎登陆学校网站： http://www.gpccs.org 浏览学校更多资讯。
97fd26c5c19d72c48f970c62bd4a934b0dc14675.translatedText: Finally, Principal Shen Meijing awarded graduation certificates to five graduates of this year. After several years of hard study, these five students finally ushered in the sacred moment of graduation. I sincerely wish them all the best! The graduation and graduation ceremony ended with laughter from the audience! The students happily rushed to the prize room in small groups to receive their awards, which was a wonderful reward for their hard work for a year. Phoenix Chinese Christian Church Chinese School was established in 1983 and has a history of 32 years. It is a non-profit organization school. Currently, the school has singing classes, Chinese preschool, simplified Chinese kindergarten class, phonetic class, 4 traditional Chinese classes, 8 simplified Chinese classes, 4 bilingual classes, 1 conversation class, 1 Chinese AP class, after-school activity classes including 2 dance classes, 2 painting classes, 3 math classes and 1 martial arts class, with a total of 30 classes with more than 250 students. The purpose of the school is to teach students to learn Chinese and traditional Chinese culture, and to integrate the truth of Christian love to cultivate students' sound character. The teachers and co-workers of the school all have the ambition to glorify God, benefit people, and spread Chinese culture. The teachers and teaching assistants hired are all like-minded partners with love, enthusiasm for service, willingness to sacrifice and dedication. The goals of running the school are: professionalization of the teacher team, systematic teaching, community-based environment, interesting teaching materials, and parent participation. This year's principal, Principal Shen Meijing, has taught in Chinese schools for 14 years and served as principal of Chinese schools for three years. This year, under the leadership of Principal Shen Meijing, we vigorously carried out various tasks and achieved unusual results. I hope that Phoenix Christian Church Chinese School will get better and better. We welcome people with lofty ideals who have a sense of responsibility for spreading Chinese culture to come to the Chinese school and work together with all the co-workers to run the school well! The opening day of the next school year is 8/16/2015 at 1:30pm. The registration day is 8/9/2015 from 1:30pm to 3:30pm. Welcome to visit the school website: http://www.gpccs.org to browse more information about the school.

fb26a4e8cf09c809de4b0e1b9f25dc4839645ab0.translatedText: 2015 Phoenix Chinese School Graduation Ceremony (contributed by Phoenix Chinese School) Phoenix Chinese School held its graduation ceremony on May 3rd at the Mesa Community College campus...

9bdb0d8e3d976aa61f6c98fe30067d289721945b.sourceText: (凤凰城中文学校 来稿) 凤凰城中文学校于五月三日在美莎社区大学校区举行毕业典礼，今年有四位毕业生，分别是陈亦瑄，谢皓恩，罗允伶和佐藤黛龄。校方今年还特别邀请了侨界知名华人代表邱顺雄先生担任贵宾。邱顺雄先生偕同其夫人一同前来，并且还带礼物赠送给毕业生。美莎社区大学校代表Patricia Esparza也到现场祝贺毕业生。邱顺雄先生在致词中表示，能在美国的中文学校毕业是非常难能可贵的。他祝福并希望毕业生能继续中文的学习，日后多多推广中华文化。
9bdb0d8e3d976aa61f6c98fe30067d289721945b.translatedText: (contributed by Phoenix Chinese School) Phoenix Chinese School held its graduation ceremony on May 3 at the Mesa Community College campus. There are four graduates this year, namely Chen Yixuan, Xie Haoen, Luo Yunling and Sato Dailing. The school also specially invited Mr. Qiu Shunxiong, a well-known Chinese representative in the overseas Chinese community, as a distinguished guest this year. Mr. Qiu Shunxiong came with his wife and brought gifts to the graduates. Patricia Esparza, a representative from Mesa Community College, also came to the scene to congratulate the graduates. Mr. Qiu Shunxiong said in his speech that it is very rare to graduate from a Chinese school in the United States. He wished and hoped that the graduates could continue to study Chinese and promote Chinese culture in the future.

3e938096f9126d3bd5d341d317eb48f753fc05d4.sourceText: 贵宾致词后，毕业班指导老师李素惠接着出场介绍毕业生。李素惠老师先请在座毕业生起立敬礼，谢谢在场所有老师辛苦地教导，也同时感谢父母每週日不间断地接送同学们来上中文课。在场观众也为这些同学不放弃学中文的努力而热烈鼓掌。
3e938096f9126d3bd5d341d317eb48f753fc05d4.translatedText: After the distinguished guest’s speech, Li Suhui, the instructor of the graduating class, then came on stage to introduce the graduates. Teacher Li Suhui first asked the graduates present to stand up and salute. She thanked all the teachers present for their hard work in teaching, and also thanked their parents for picking up and dropping off the students to Chinese classes every Sunday. The audience present also warmly applauded these students for not giving up their efforts in learning Chinese.

d02f97d11e752a65ecff00d9f68480a351d47683.sourceText: 李素惠老师教过这群毕业生很多次，所以介绍每位同学时，都能如数家珍似地说出每一位的喜好和专长。李素惠老师每介绍完一位毕业生，他们就上台唸出毕业感言。几乎每一位毕业生都表示，刚开始都是很不情愿地来上中文课，但渐渐地才了解具备中文语文能力是一项优势。毕业生们都很感激学校老师和父母能多年来不辞辛劳地鼓励支持他们，才能让他们支撑到现在从中文学校毕业。
d02f97d11e752a65ecff00d9f68480a351d47683.translatedText: >Teacher Li Suhui has taught this group of graduates many times, so when introducing each student, she can talk about each one's preferences and expertise as if they are precious. After Teacher Li Suhui introduced a graduate, they went on stage to read their graduation speech. Almost every graduate said that they were reluctant to take Chinese classes at first, but gradually they realized that having Chinese language skills was an advantage. The graduates are very grateful to the school teachers and parents for their tireless encouragement and support over the years, which has enabled them to graduate from the Chinese school.

518d23671dee25c8570b923f1de0dcde286b91af.sourceText: 毕业生一一唸完毕业感言后，贵宾邱顺雄先生伉俪颁给每位毕业生证书和礼物，并和学生们以及家长合照。毕业典礼尾声，学校老师们列队欢送毕业生，大家一同鼓掌，并祝福这些毕业生们前途光明，鹏程万里。
518d23671dee25c8570b923f1de0dcde286b91af.translatedText: After the graduates read their graduation speeches one by one, the distinguished guests Mr. and Mrs. Qiu Shunxiong awarded each graduate a certificate and gift, and took photos with the students and their parents. At the end of the graduation ceremony, the school teachers lined up to see off the graduates. Everyone applauded and wished these graduates a bright future and a bright future.

e36ca7afaf8a9392101f05283fbde6a139ead19f.sourceText: 今年共有70多支来自全美各地的队伍，近二千名选手参加第十二届龙舟大赛，龙舟赛已经成为当地主流社会的重要文化活动，促进了各族裔的文化交流和发展。龙舟比赛分男女溷合组、公司组、学生组、残障组、乳癌康复病人组等。3月28日，亚省中餐协会–百事可乐队穿着清一色的青衣，一日赶四埸。龙舟在碧波荡漾的湖水中竞渡，岸上千百人呐喊加油，人声鼎沸高潮迭起，中餐协会–百事可乐队最终荣获龙舟大赛公司组的季军。4月26日，中餐协会的伙伴们穿上龙舟比赛运动服，挂上奖牌，兴高采烈地合照留念。
e36ca7afaf8a9392101f05283fbde6a139ead19f.translatedText: This year, there are more than 70 teams from all over the United States, with nearly 2,000 players participating in the 12th Dragon Boat Races. Dragon Boat Races have become an important cultural activity in the local mainstream society, promoting cultural exchanges and development of various ethnic groups. The dragon boat race is divided into male and female mixed groups, company groups, student groups, disabled groups, and breast cancer rehabilitation patient groups. On March 28, the Alberta Chinese Restaurant Association-Pepsi Band dressed in Tsing Yi and played four venues in one day. The dragon boat raced in the rippling blue water of the lake. Thousands of people on the shore shouted for cheers, and the crowds were uproarious. The Chinese Restaurant Association-Pepsi Band finally won the third place in the company group of the dragon boat competition. On April 26, the partners of the Chinese Restaurant Association put on dragon boat racing sportswear, hung up their medals, and happily took photos together.

Arizona Ave.，Chandler，Arizona。宓俊生前好友、同学、同事都纷纷前往吊唁。
31db00a8267c01904f85f66d2cd51143617467f7.translatedText: > Mi Jun, a smart, handsome and optimistic student. In August 2012, he entered ASU to study for the Master of Computer Science at the Ira A. Fulton Schools of Engineering. After a pathological fracture in June 2013, he was diagnosed with advanced osteosarcoma (bone cancer). After nearly 2 years of strong struggle against the disease, he left us forever at 9:08 pm on April 2, 2015, U.S. time, at the age of 26. The farewell ceremony for Mi Jun's body was held at 11 a.m. on April 6, 2015 (Monday) at Legacy Funeral Home. Location: 1374 N. Arizona Ave., Chandler, Arizona. Mi Jun's friends, classmates, and colleagues all came to express their condolences.

1fbd3dacefc0a585c9d9403bc4c28a936cfc2778.sourceText: 2015年4月4日，第十四届”汉语桥”世界大学生中文比赛美国西南赛区预选赛在亚利桑那大学举行。来自亚利桑那州立大学的三名学生一路过五关斩六将，凭着超强的实力分别荣获多个组别的冠亚军。其中，Ryan McCloskey在中文高级组里拔得头筹，并将代表美国西南赛区出征在中国举行”汉语桥”复赛。Anthony Costantini获得中级组的冠军，Jacob Black获得中级组的亚军。中国驻洛杉矶总领事馆教育组领事陈卫恒出席并担任了比赛评委。
1fbd3dacefc0a585c9d9403bc4c28a936cfc2778.translatedText: On April 4, 2015, the 14th "Chinese Bridge" Chinese Proficiency Competition for Foreign College Students in the United States Southwest Division Qualifiers was held at the University of Arizona. Three students from Arizona State University passed five levels and won six, and won the championship and runner-up in multiple categories with their super strength. Among them, Ryan McCloskey won the senior Chinese group and will represent the American Southwest Division in the "Chinese Bridge" rematch in China. Jacob Anthony Costantini won the championship in the intermediate group. Black won the runner-up in the intermediate category. Chen Weiheng, Consul of the Education Section of the Chinese Consulate General in Los Angeles, attended and served as a judge for the competition.

ad8b19052f54b0485523df02c0aeb89835184d15.sourceText: 本次比赛汇聚了来自美国亚利桑那州、南加州、得克萨斯州和夏威夷州各个大学的选手，共同争夺一张通往中国总决赛的入场券。当天的预选赛为选手们设置了三道关卡，分别是主题演讲、回答问题和才艺表演。选手们用中文讲述自己与中国的情缘，用准确无误的回答展现了对中国多方面的了解，用歌曲、舞蹈、诗朗诵、武术等才艺表演表达了对中国文化的热爱。
ad8b19052f54b0485523df02c0aeb89835184d15.translatedText: This competition brought together contestants from various universities in Arizona, Southern California, Texas and Hawaii to compete for a ticket to the China finals. The contestants set up three levels, namely keynote speeches, answering questions and talent performances. The contestants talked about their relationship with China in Chinese, demonstrated their multi-faceted understanding of China with accurate answers, and expressed their love for Chinese culture with songs, dances, poetry recitations, martial arts and other talent performances.

78766a428a4fb5be23de7cb7e69da37a373360e1.sourceText: 获得高级组冠军的Ryan McCloskey甫一上场即让所有评委和观众眼前一亮，无论是他的朗目疏眉，还是落落大方的姿态，以及流利清晰的中文都给大家留下了深刻的印象。在才艺表演中，他自弹自唱的《平凡之路》惊艳全场。这位来自坦佩的大学三年级学生目前在亚利桑那州立大学主修计算机科学，辅修中文。在他题为”我的中国梦”的演讲里，他讲述了自己在中国生活的故事。随着父亲工作调动而来到北京的他，最初生活在顺义郊区并在国际学校读高中。在那里，他几乎没有机会接触任何中国文化和中文，也就谈不上对中国抱有感情或者了解。然后自从他搬到北京市区后，他开始学习中文、吃中国菜、结交中国朋友、知道了中国的大众文化、礼仪、思想还有特有的观念。从而开始逐渐理解中国有着一种与美国截然不同的文化，并入乡随俗地接受并喜爱上了这样的文化。回到美国之后，他深深地想念起了北京，他的”中国梦”时刻萦绕在他的心头。他深情地说到：”人总是不会意识到他所拥有地珍贵，直到市区或者离开，才会特别想念。我想念北京，想回到北京。我要继续努力学校中文和计算机科学专业。衷心期待有朝一日能回到中国。我想在中国创业，设计大家喜欢的的应用程序。”关于比赛本身，Ryan表示这是一个让他实现自己梦想的绝好契机：”我觉得仅仅是站在比赛的，似乎我的中国梦就已经在一个触手可及的地方。现在回想起当时的比赛情景，胸中那股对北京的思念之情就显得更加强烈 。”
78766a428a4fb5be23de7cb7e69da37a373360e1.translatedText: Ryan won the championship in the senior category. McCloskey impressed all the judges and the audience as soon as he came on stage. His bright eyes, elegant posture, and fluent and clear Chinese all left a deep impression on everyone. During the talent show, he performed and sang "The Ordinary Road" and amazed the audience. The senior student is currently majoring in computer science and minoring in Chinese at Arizona State University. In his speech titled "My Chinese Dream," he told the story of his life in China. When his father was transferred to Beijing, he initially lived in the suburbs of Shunyi and attended high school in an international school. Without the opportunity to come into contact with any Chinese culture and Chinese language, it is impossible to say that he has any feelings or understanding of China. Then after he moved to the urban area of Beijing, he began to learn Chinese, eat Chinese food, make Chinese friends, and learn about Chinese popular culture, etiquette, thoughts, and unique concepts, and gradually began to understand that China has a unique relationship with China. The completely different culture of the United States, he accepted and loved this culture as the locals did. After returning to the United States, he missed Beijing deeply, and his "Chinese Dream" always lingered in his heart. He said affectionately: "People never realize the preciousness of what they have until they go to the city or leave." I miss Beijing and want to go back to Beijing. I want to continue working hard in school majoring in Chinese and Computer Science. I sincerely look forward to returning to China one day. I want to start a business in China and design applications that everyone likes. Regarding the competition itself, Ryan said that this is a great opportunity for him to realize his dream: "I feel like just standing in the competition, it seems that my Chinese dream is already within reach." Now that I think back to the game at that time, the longing for Beijing in my heart becomes even stronger. "

7cf2202f8b5cad202be8ce3e84885524da9a813f.sourceText: 获得中级组冠军的Anthony Costantini目前是学习东亚历史的大学二年级学生。他从来没去过中国，所以对中国充满了深深的好奇之心。在学习了两年的中文后，体验中国，”不仅仅是想游览长城，参观兵马俑，更是想过一种”地道”的中国生活”变成了他的中国梦。他从饮食、音乐、文学和哲学等各个方面，和大家侃侃而谈自己想过的地道的中国生活。他说道：”众所周知，中国有很丰富的饮食文化，从北到南，从西到东，只是你想不到的，没有你吃不到的。每一个地区，甚至是每一个小乡镇都会有自己独特的味道。 所以我的中国梦首先就是：走遍中国，吃遍中国，亲身感受”舌尖上的中国”！一个地道的中国生活还离不开音乐的陪伴。 音乐无国界，在音乐声中，可以尽情感受当地人们的喜怒哀乐，各地民情。中国的文学和哲学有着悠久历史，从《论语》，《道德经》，到《三国志》与《红楼梦》，你可以和不同历史时期的中国人对话。如果有机会去中国的话， 我会跟中国朋友一起去吃饭，听音乐，还会阅读中文书籍。用我的口，眼，耳去感受古老而又现代的中国。”回首比赛，他认为亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院的老师给予他极大的帮助和充分的鼓励，让他有信心挑战，重新审视自己。他说到：”对于一年前的我来说，参加汉语桥大赛简直就像天方夜谭。可是通过老师们对我的帮助和直到，我能够记住自己的中文演讲，回答和中国有关的文化问题，并且还能唱中文歌。是他们的帮助让我坚定了自己的中国梦，并能够不断为之奋斗。”
7cf2202f8b5cad202be8ce3e84885524da9a813f.translatedText: Anthony Costantini, who won the intermediate category championship, is currently a sophomore studying East Asian history. He has never been to China, so he is full of deep curiosity about China. After studying Chinese for two years, experiencing China, "not only wanting to visit the Great Wall and the Terracotta Warriors, but also wanting to live an "authentic" Chinese life" became his Chinese dream. He talked about the authentic Chinese life he wanted to live in from various aspects such as food, music, literature and philosophy. He said: "As we all know, China has a very rich food culture. From north to south, from west to east, there is nothing you can't imagine, and there is nothing you can't eat. Every region, even every small town, has its own unique taste. So my Chinese dream is first of all: to travel all over China, eat all over China, and experience "China on the Bite of the Tongue" for myself! An authentic Chinese life cannot be separated from the company of music. Music has no borders. In the sound of music, you can enjoy the joys, sorrows, joys and emotions of local people. Chinese literature and philosophy have a long history, from "The Analects of Confucius" and "Tao Te Ching" to "Three Kingdoms" and "Dream of Red Mansions". If you have the opportunity to go to China, you can. I will go out to eat with Chinese friends, listen to music, and read Chinese books. I will use my mouth, eyes, and ears to experience ancient and modern China." Looking back on the competition, he believes that the teachers at the Confucius Institute at Arizona State University gave him great help and sufficient encouragement, giving him the confidence to challenge and re-examine himself. He said: "For me a year ago, participating in the Chinese Bridge Competition was just a fantasy. But with the help and guidance of my teachers, I was able to memorize my Chinese speeches, answer cultural questions related to China, and sing Chinese songs. It was their help that allowed me to strengthen my Chinese dream and continue to strive for it."

ff48208f5b38a05ab7e48c963a6ff5eb10775bb1.sourceText: 获得中级组二等奖的Jacob Black和大家分享了他的中国梦形成的过程，一段在新加坡的经历让他第一次感受到了中文的精妙，从而激发他对中国语言的渴望。两年前，他去新加坡教课。在第一节课上，由于课程的内容比较复杂,所以他就想用一段话鼓励学生努力学习，不要轻言放弃。可是任由他绞尽脑汁,费尽口舌,用尽他当时所会的所有中文词汇, 但是台下的学生依然是听得一头雾水。这时，有一个学生突然站起来告诉他：老师，你想说的是不是”万事起头难”。恍然大悟的Jacob这才发现自己刚才的千言万语用五个字就可以概括得又简洁又精准。而在亚利桑那州立大学学习哲学的他也同时感悟到自己的人生里充满了”万事起头难”，比如说学习中文。在被中文的博大精深所深深震撼之后，他开始渴望深入了解中国语言于文化。正如他所说的那样：”我知道学习的过程是漫长而又艰辛的，不过世上无难事，只怕有心人。我希望有一天可以去中国，学习中文和中国文化，以实现我想更了解这个国家的人民和他们梦想的愿望。”在得知自己获得二等奖后，Jacob感慨万千：”我当初一边努力学习汉语，尽心准备汉语桥比赛，一边还在积极筹备自己的婚礼。人生由无数学习的片段构成，充满了各种的体验。每个人都会回首经历过的困难，但是当我们回首我们怎样度过那段时光,总是会从中受益匪浅。我相信自己这次在汉语桥比赛的经验会对我今后学习中文并致力于了解中国人内心世界非常有帮助。”
ff48208f5b38a05ab7e48c963a6ff5eb10775bb1.translatedText: Jacob won the second prize in the intermediate group Black shared with everyone the process of the formation of his Chinese dream. An experience in Singapore made him feel the subtleties of Chinese for the first time, thus stimulating his desire for the Chinese language. Two years ago, he went to Singapore to teach. In the first class, since the course content was relatively complex, he wanted to use a paragraph to encourage students to study hard and not give up easily. But no matter how hard he racked his brains, exhausted his tongue, and used all the Chinese vocabulary he knew at the time, the students in the audience were still confused. At this time, a student suddenly stood up and told him: Teacher, what do you want to say is "Everything is difficult at the beginning." Jacob suddenly realized that what he just said could be summarized concisely and accurately in five words. While studying philosophy at Arizona State University, he also realized that his life was full of "everything is difficult at the beginning", such as learning Chinese. After being deeply shocked by the breadth and depth of the Chinese language, he began to desire a deeper understanding of Chinese language and culture. As he said: "I know that the learning process is long and arduous, but nothing is difficult in the world, as long as there is a willful person. I hope that one day I can go to China and learn Chinese and Chinese culture to realize my dream of better understanding the people of this country and their dreams." After learning that he had won the second prize, Jacob was filled with emotion: "I was studying Chinese hard and preparing for the Chinese Bridge competition, while also actively preparing for my wedding. Life is composed of countless learning episodes, full of various aspects. Everyone will look back on the difficulties they experienced, but when we look back on how we spent that time, we will always benefit a lot from it. I believe that my experience in the Chinese Bridge competition will be very helpful for me to learn Chinese in the future and strive to understand the inner world of the Chinese people. "

4ab7c02f61c3f8fc89d769b9fc9880723e0917c9.sourceText: 亚利桑那州立大学在本届的”汉语桥”美国西南赛区预选赛中硕果累累，大大激励了凤凰城地区学子们学习中文的热情和决心。这个夏天，Ryan McCloskey还将作为代表前往中国参加下一轮的复赛。亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院衷心祝愿他能够顺利晋级，力争上游，从而早日实现他的中国梦！
4ab7c02f61c3f8fc89d769b9fc9880723e0917c9.translatedText: Arizona State University has achieved great results in this year's "Chinese Bridge" American Southwest Division Qualifiers, which greatly inspired the enthusiasm and determination of students in the Phoenix area to learn Chinese. This summer, Ryan McCloskey will also travel to China as a representative to participate in the next round of rematches. The Confucius Institute at Arizona State University sincerely wishes him a smooth promotion and strives to the top, so that he can realize his Chinese dream as soon as possible!

314f4d30b4ef51a1e51b3d25e680e9f2722e29ac.sourceText: 11月10日 奥克兰Auckland-基督城Churistchurch-Hokitika 一清早赵敬平送我们去机场，由Auckland飞往Christchurch-我们南岛6日游出发的地方。抵达了Christchurch机场后我们会见了我们的导游兼司机Lawson。 他原是香港人，但国语说得不错。原来这个团是由当地世外桃源旅行社组团的，我们这一车共有31位旅客，来自四面八方，有不少从国内来的，但最多的还是从澳大利亚墨尔本来的。Lawson 先带我们到了市区在市区兜了一下参观市容，然后把我们放到了一个由地震而遭受到破坏的正在修缮中的英格兰风格的古老花 园。这个花园原本属于一个贵族，现已由政府接管向公众开放。花园漂亮，幽静。导游在此期间又去机场接了第二批客人，然后带我们前往一家中餐馆用餐。饭后Lawson开车带我们在市中心兜了一下参观市容。Christchurch在两年前曾遭受到一次破坏性极大的地震，市中心很多建筑物都遭到了不同程度的破坏，把原本一座非常美丽的旅游城市变成了一座”死城”。我们现在看到的市中心满目苍夷，到处都是正在修缮的用木头支撑着防治倒塌的楼房，市中心原来的旅馆都不能住人。但车子开过的很多地区都是大片幽静的公园，当地的大学都坐落在公园里。Lawson自豪的对我们说Christchurch是世界上公认的具有面积最大的公园的城市。我们在市内的植物园和隔壁的博物馆逗留了一个半小时，3:15 我们离开了Christchurch前往西海岸的住宿地玉石小镇Hokitika。穿过风景秀丽的Arthur抯 Pass国家公园，傍晚时分我们抵达Hokitika的Beachfront Hotel。 天公不作美，下车时下起了大雨。好在旅馆条件还行，晚餐也不错，吃了烧猪，炸鱼，烤鸡腿和面条等，是特地为我们准备的中式口味的饭菜。
314f4d30b4ef51a1e51b3d25e680e9f2722e29ac.translatedText: November 10 Auckland-Christchurch-Hokitika Early in the morning, Zhao Jingping took us to the airport, flying from Auckland to Christchurch - the starting point of our 6-day South Island tour. After arriving at Christchurch Airport we met our tour guide and driver Lawson. He is originally from Hong Kong, but speaks Mandarin well. It turned out that this group was organized by the local Xanadu Travel Agency. There were 31 passengers in our car, coming from all over the world, many from China, but the largest number were from Melbourne, Australia. Lawson first took us to the city for a tour of the city, and then dropped us into an old English-style garden that was being restored and was damaged by the earthquake. The garden originally belonged to a nobleman, but has now been taken over by the government and open to the public. The garden is beautiful and quiet. During this period, the tour guide went to the airport to pick up the second group of guests, and then took us to a Chinese restaurant for dinner. After the meal, Lawson drove us around the city center to see the city. Christchurch suffered a devastating earthquake two years ago. Many buildings in the city center were damaged to varying degrees, turning what was originally a very beautiful tourist city into a "dead city." The city center we see now is full of desolation, with buildings being repaired and supported by wood to prevent collapse everywhere. The original hotels in the city center cannot be occupied. But many of the areas the car drove through were large and quiet parks, and local universities were located in the parks. Lawson proudly told us that Christchurch is recognized as the city with the largest park in the world. We stayed in the city's botanical garden and the museum next door for an hour and a half. At 3:15 we left Christchurch and headed to the jade town of Hokitika, our accommodation on the west coast. Passing through the scenic Arthur's Pass National Park, we arrived at the Beachfront Hotel in Hokitika in the evening. The weather was not kind and it started to rain heavily when we got off the bus. Fortunately, the hotel was in good condition, and the dinner was also good. We had roasted pork, fried fish, grilled chicken legs, noodles, etc. These were Chinese-style meals specially prepared for us.

1bf4b37b72786969762bbbb4e4ce5652cdceb6ee.sourceText: 2014年11月9日 奥克兰市内游 (Auckland) 早晨仲凯的同学王小健来接我们去游Auckland。 从城市的东部开往城市的中心，途经帆星点点的海湾，到达一处高地。从这里透过海湾，Auckland的地标建筑Skycity高耸的尖塔及周围的建筑物一览无遗地呈现在面前，在蓝天大海的衬托下显得格外的美丽。面向海的高地上有供游客休息的长条椅，坐在上面欣赏美景真令人心旷神怡。接着小健又把我们带到另一处高地棗Eden Park，那是一个火山口的遗址，凹陷的山头虽已长满了青草，但仍看得出那是火山喷发过的痕迹。从这里可以从另外一个角度来看城市的轮廓。我们接 着又去了MJ Savage Memorial Park这个公园紧靠着著名的Mission Bay 海滩，公园中间有个纪念碑，四周的栏杆外种满了鲜花。因是周末，来游览的居民也不少。从山上下来后我们就去Mission Bay吃午饭。在beach 游玩的人很多，好不容易才找到一个packing位。沿着海滩的街是一个接一个的餐馆，我们挑了一家就一边吃一边欣赏海景和快乐的人群。餐毕小健又带我们去了另一个纪念公园，沿着山路盘旋而上，最后到达顶峰。中间有一个高高的古朴的纪念碑，周围的围墙好似古代的城堡，从上往下看，能看到一大群羊儿在山坡上安静地吃着草，往远处能看到整个城市的轮廓。从山上下来后我们随小健到了他的家。房子布置得十分舒适和现代，他的一双儿女很阳光很可爱。晚上由小健做东去市中心SkyCity的旋转餐厅吃饭，到了那里才知道预约已满，只能在同一幢楼的另一家餐馆吃buffet。虽然有些遗憾，不能在最高处俯瞰整个城市的美景，但buffet确实不错。
1bf4b37b72786969762bbbb4e4ce5652cdceb6ee.translatedText: November 9, 2014 Auckland City Tour (Auckland) In the morning, Zhong Kai’s classmate Wang Xiaojian came to pick us up to visit Auckland. Driving from the east of the city to the center of the city, passing through the bay dotted with sails, we arrived at a high ground. From here, through the bay, the towering spiers of Auckland's landmark building Skycity and the surrounding buildings are in front of us, which is particularly beautiful against the blue sky and sea. There are benches for tourists to rest on the high ground facing the sea. It is really refreshing to sit on it and enjoy the beautiful scenery. Then Xiaojian took us to another highland, Eden. Park, which is the ruins of a volcano. Although the sunken hilltop is covered with grass, you can still see the traces of the volcanic eruption. From here, we went to MJ Savage Memorial Park, which is close to the famous Mission Bay beach. There is a monument in the middle of the park and the surrounding railings are filled with flowers. Since it is a weekend, there are many residents visiting. After coming down from the mountain, we went to Mission Bay for lunch. There were a lot of people visiting, so it was hard to find a packing spot. There were restaurants one after another along the beach. We chose one and enjoyed the sea view and the happy crowd. After dinner, Bi Xiaojian took us to another memorial park, spiraling up the mountain road, and finally reached the top. There is a tall and simple monument in the middle, and the surrounding walls look like ancient castles. Looking down, we can see a large group of sheep grazing quietly on the hillside. You can see the outline of the entire city in the distance. After coming down from the mountain, we followed Xiaojian to his home. The house was very comfortable and modern, and his two children were very sunny and cute. In the evening, Xiaojian went to the revolving restaurant in the city center for dinner. When we got there, we found out that the reservation was full and we could only eat buffet at another restaurant in the same building. Although it was a bit regretful that we could not overlook the beautiful view of the whole city from the top, the buffet was really good.

94ee0019af55fe3c273fdd34ebaa1a24c0e33e15.sourceText: 11月11日 Hokitika?#31119;斯冰河镇Fox Glacier?#29926;娜卡湖镇Wanaka 早餐后7:45 装车离开旅馆，在镇上的一家玉石店参观和shopping。新西兰生产一种绿色的软玉，他们把玉加工成当地毛利人所祈福的图案，做成项链等首饰，不同于中国玉的华贵，却有一种大自然的粗犷，别有风味。 出了小镇我们沿着西海岸去看著名的福斯冰川Fox Glacier。由于新西兰的特殊位置和地貌，冰川能在如此低的纬度形成，是世上的一大奇观。一路上田园风光，大片大片的草场延绵不绝，大群的羊，牛，马，鹿布满了草场，远处是连绵的雪山，好一派自然风光。可惜天公不作美，时而阴天，时而下雨，偶而露出太阳。途经Westland国家公园，到达冰川的所在地。天气好的时候可以乘直升机在空中欣赏整个冰川，煞是壮观。直升机也会降落在冰川上，让你与冰川有近距离接触。可惜天气不好，直升机停开，我们只能站在远处遥望冰川。可是天气很阴，冰川藏在云雾中始终看不清楚。由于时间关系，不能再等，我们只好怏怏的回到车上。正准备出发时突然有人指着那边说?#20986;来了！出来了！?#36710;上所有的人一股脑儿跑下车朝着冰川的方向看?#21487;不是吗，天开了一点点眼，让蓝隐隐的冰川露了出来，总算让我们看了一眼，也不枉此行了。
94ee0019af55fe3c273fdd34ebaa1a24c0e33e15.translatedText: November 11th Hokitika?#31119; Fox Gla, Sibinghe Town Glacier?#29926; Naka Lake Town Wanaka After breakfast, load the car and leave the hotel at 7:45, and visit and shop at a jade shop in the town. New Zealand produces a kind of green nephrite. They process the jade into patterns that the local Maori people pray for, and make it into necklaces and other jewelry. It is different from the luxury of Chinese jade, but it has the roughness of nature and a unique flavor. After leaving the town, we walked along the west coast to see the famous Fox Glacier. Due to New Zealand's special location and landform, glaciers can form at such low latitudes, which is a wonder in the world. Along the way, there is pastoral scenery, with large stretches of pasture, large herds of sheep, cattle, horses, and deer filling the pasture, and the continuous snow-capped mountains in the distance, which is a beautiful natural scenery. It's a pity that God is not kind, sometimes it is cloudy, sometimes it rains, and occasionally the sun shines. Pass through Westland National Park and reach the location of the glacier. When the weather is good, you can take a helicopter to admire the entire glacier from the air, which is truly spectacular. Helicopters will also land on the glacier, allowing you to get up close and personal with the glacier. Unfortunately, the weather was bad and the helicopter stopped, so we could only stand in the distance and look at the glacier. But the weather was very cloudy, and the glacier was hidden in the clouds and fog and could not be seen clearly. Due to time constraints, we could not wait any longer, so we had to go back to the car sadly. When I was about to set off, someone suddenly pointed over there and said, "Here we come!" Out! ?#36710;Everyone on the bus ran out of the car and looked in the direction of the glacier?#21487;Wasn’t it? The sky opened a little, and the faint blue glacier was exposed. Finally, we took a look, and our trip was not in vain.

4d367b11b1e1545333e69ae45e4852a4b0275043.sourceText: 何逢辰：2014新西兰南北岛9日游(五)
4d367b11b1e1545333e69ae45e4852a4b0275043.translatedText: He Fengchen: 9-day tour of the North and South Islands of New Zealand in 2014 (Friday)

9a400e24d39a9bcec0c26dc88e698a1adfde6d97.translatedText: He Fengchen: 9-day tour of the North and South Islands of New Zealand in 2014 (Friday) November 11th Hokitika-Fox Glacier Town-W…

8f1171fc4da6d67f7b69c0bb7e9f2c8b5c16715a.sourceText: 11月11日 Hokitika-福斯冰河镇Fox Glacier-瓦娜卡湖镇Wanaka
8f1171fc4da6d67f7b69c0bb7e9f2c8b5c16715a.translatedText: November 11th Hokitika-Fox Glacier Town Glacier - Lake Wanaka Town Wanaka

cd9d531f9daff38eddb75d6f535be223b23da625.sourceText: 早餐后7:45 装车离开旅馆，在镇上的一家玉石店参观和shopping。新西兰生产一种绿色的软玉，他们把玉加工成当地毛利人所祈福的图案，做成项链等首饰，不同于中国玉的华贵，却有一种大自然的粗犷，别有风味。
cd9d531f9daff38eddb75d6f535be223b23da625.translatedText: After breakfast, load the car and leave the hotel at 7:45, and visit and shop at a jade shop in the town. New Zealand produces a kind of green nephrite. They process the jade into patterns that the local Maori people pray for, and make it into necklaces and other jewelry. It is different from the luxury of Chinese jade, but it has the roughness of nature and a unique flavor.

e49806e02288733b9491f349eb4ee940eea9a6bc.sourceText: 出了小镇我们沿着西海岸去看著名的福斯冰川Fox Glacier。由于新西兰的特殊位置和地貌，冰川能在如此低的纬度形成，是世上的一大奇观。一路上田园风光，大片大片的草场延绵不绝，大群的羊，牛，马，鹿布满了草场，远处是连绵的雪山，好一派自然风光。可惜天公不作美，时而阴天，时而下雨，偶而露出太阳。途经Westland国家公园，到达冰川的所在地。天气好的时候可以乘直升机在空中欣赏整个冰川，煞是壮观。直升机也会降落在冰川上，让你与冰川有近距离接触。可惜天气不好，直升机停开，我们只能站在远处遥望冰川。可是天气很阴，冰川藏在云雾中始终看不清楚。由于时间关系，不能再等，我们只好怏怏的回到车上。正准备出发时突然有人指着那边说’?#20986;来了！出来了 ！?车上所有的人一股脑儿跑下车朝着冰川的方向看-可不是吗，天开了一点点眼，让蓝隐隐的冰川露了出来，总算让我们看了一眼，也不枉此行了。
e49806e02288733b9491f349eb4ee940eea9a6bc.translatedText: After leaving the town, we walked along the west coast to see the famous Fox Glacier. Due to New Zealand's special location and landform, glaciers can form at such low latitudes, which is a wonder in the world. Along the way, there is pastoral scenery, with large stretches of pasture, large herds of sheep, cattle, horses, and deer filling the pasture, and the continuous snow-capped mountains in the distance, which is a beautiful natural scenery. It's a pity that God is not kind, sometimes it is cloudy, sometimes it rains, and occasionally the sun shines. Pass through Westland National Park and reach the location of the glacier. When the weather is good, you can take a helicopter to admire the entire glacier from the air, which is truly spectacular. Helicopters will also land on the glacier, allowing you to get up close and personal with the glacier. Unfortunately, the weather was bad and the helicopter stopped, so we could only stand in the distance and look at the glacier. But the weather was very cloudy, and the glacier was hidden in the clouds and fog and could not be seen clearly. Due to time constraints, we could not wait any longer, so we had to go back to the car sadly. When we were about to set off, someone suddenly pointed over there and said, '?#20986;Here we come! Out! ?All the people in the car ran out of the car and looked in the direction of the glacier - right? The sky opened up a little and the faint blue glacier was exposed. Finally, we took a look, and our trip was not in vain.

34cbb8acc939c9b98cb0f8801789d2fd29b58e9d.sourceText: 中午在途中经过的一家颇有品味的西餐馆用餐，吃了沙拉和Fish & Chips, 味道不错。这家餐馆不仅餐做得不错，环境更是很独特。餐馆的后院是一个很大的草场，一直通向远处起伏的山峦，在草场上养了一大群各种颜色和品种的牛，顾客们可透过对着草场的落地玻璃窗一边用餐一边欣赏着新西兰特有的原生态的田园风光。餐毕很多旅友都跑到后面去和牛群亲密接触，拍照留念。
34cbb8acc939c9b98cb0f8801789d2fd29b58e9d.translatedText: At noon, we ate at a tasteful Western restaurant we passed on the way. We had salad and Fish & Chips, which tasted good. This restaurant not only does great food, but also has a unique environment. The restaurant's backyard is a large pasture that leads to the rolling hills in the distance. A large herd of cattle of various colors and breeds are raised on the pasture. Customers can enjoy New Zealand's unique and original pastoral scenery while dining through the floor-to-ceiling glass windows facing the pasture. After the meal, many travelers ran to the back to have close contact with the cattle and take photos.

1eeda77aeee207b309c19b660f5b94cce5728d3a.sourceText: 傍晚我们抵达新西兰的第四大湖Wanaka, 在湖边小镇的Wanaka Hotel 住宿。从房间的后门出去是一大片青青的草地，可以看到远处白雪覆盖的山峦，风景十分优美。安顿好后导游带着我们步行穿过小镇，去了不远的一家餐馆就餐。晚餐是Pizza, 还有炸鱼，薯条和蘑菇蛋汤，店主好像是中国人。怕有些人吃不惯，Lawson 又亲自下厨给我们做了炒饭。饭毕我们赶快抓紧时间，趁太阳还未下山去旅馆对面的湖边欣赏美景。这是一个湖畔公园，夕阳下的雪山格外美丽，太阳的余辉照耀在雪山顶折射出奇妙的色彩，宁静的湖面有雪山的倒影，也有小船静静的靠在湖边厖一派诗情画意。暮色降临，我的注意力被一群刚上岸的野鸭子给吸引了。只见鸭妈妈带领着一群黄褐色交替的小鸭足有十几只多，摇摇摆摆地上了岸，向草地深处走去，断后的是一只有着漂亮羽毛的公鸭，无疑是鸭爸爸-应该是归巢的时间了吧，看着这其乐融融的一家，看着眼前仙境般的湖光山色，只有深深地赞叹：大自然真美！
1eeda77aeee207b309c19b660f5b94cce5728d3a.translatedText: In the evening we arrived at Wanaka, the fourth largest lake in New Zealand, and stayed at the Wanaka Hotel in the lakeside town. Going out from the back door of the room is a large green grassland, and you can see the snow-covered mountains in the distance. The scenery is very beautiful. After settling in, the tour guide took us on foot through the town and to a restaurant not far away for dinner. Dinner is pizza, fish, chips and mushroom egg soup. The owner seems to be Chinese. Afraid that some people might not be used to it, Lawson personally cooked fried rice for us. After dinner, we quickly took the time to go to the lake opposite the hotel to enjoy the beautiful scenery before the sun went down. This is a lakeside park. The snow-capped mountains are particularly beautiful under the setting sun. The afterglow of the sun reflects wonderful colors on the snow-capped mountains. The tranquil lake has reflections of the snow-capped mountains, and there are also small boats quietly leaning on the lake, creating a poetic and picturesque atmosphere. As dusk fell, my attention was attracted by a group of wild ducks that had just landed. I saw the mother duck leading a group of alternating yellow and brown ducklings, more than a dozen of them, swaying ashore and walking towards the depths of the grass. Behind them was a male duck with beautiful feathers, undoubtedly the father duck - it must be time to return to the nest. Looking at this happy family and the fairyland-like lakes and mountains in front of me, I can only deeply admire: Nature is so beautiful!

82a0dde1edead7de7cb7074240536496541574f9.sourceText: 【反法西斯胜利70周年亚省特刊】丁丁：风起了
