9351544a320ec2c6e85393edd7705d2373db1b76.translatedText: [Alberta Special Issue on the 70th Anniversary of the Anti-Fascist Victory] Tintin: The Wind Rises [Phoenix PEN] Tintin I don’t know where to start this story. Because I feel from the heart...

19d67dbbedaaa7cc4237625973686a432be1c160.sourceText: 【凤凰笔会】 丁丁 我不知道从何处开始这个故事。因为从心里的感觉来说，那是一部极其复杂而混合了无数黑白画面的、浓烈而苍老的情感：相比于半个夜晚零敲碎打的随笔，也许百万字的长篇似乎应该是更加合适的体裁。
19d67dbbedaaa7cc4237625973686a432be1c160.translatedText: [Phoenix Pen Club] Tintin I don’t know where to start this story. Because from the bottom of my heart, it is an extremely complex film with strong and old emotions mixed with countless black and white pictures: compared to piecemeal essays written half a night, perhaps a million-word novel should be a more suitable genre.

b2ad41dee6ef9331e3a349280c4711b2968be1e4.translatedText: The wind is blowing, try to survive.

4bc0f852ebc6e53b7c8ba80315dcfcddca58b64b.sourceText: 然而我知道，为了这种心情，我一定要找一个文字的开始。
4bc0f852ebc6e53b7c8ba80315dcfcddca58b64b.translatedText: However, I know that for this kind of mood, I must find a beginning of words.

14eefad02ca2aa69dd37b168142a70a2b8175e5a.sourceText: 这个开始的地方，其实离我现在的凤凰城不算太远，开车2个小时内可以到达。虽然现在的我不大可能兴致所至就直接驱车而去?我依然能打开Google地图，搜索”Airplane Graveyard”，切换成卫星模式，用鼠标一点一点放大那一排排奇特而整齐的队列。放大，放大，再放大，你会突然意识到这是一架架的飞机：这就是位于 Arizona著名的飞机墓地。总数近4000架的飞机，静悄悄地躺在那里，不再飞翔，不再理会岁月的变化，宁静而安详。
14eefad02ca2aa69dd37b168142a70a2b8175e5a.translatedText: This starting place is actually not too far from my current city of Phoenix. It can be reached within 2 hours by car. Although it is unlikely that I would just drive there now when I am in the mood? I can still open Google Maps, search for "Airplane Graveyard", switch to satellite mode, and use the mouse to zoom in on the strange and neat rows of queues bit by bit. Zoom in, zoom in, and zoom in again, and you'll suddenly realize that these are planes one after another: this is the famous airplane cemetery in Arizona. There are nearly 4,000 airplanes in total, lying there quietly, no longer flying, no longer paying attention to the changes of the years, quiet and peaceful.

9a15b6b2cd98b83c7a6060441b618116f08726ef.sourceText: 虽然只是对着屏幕，然而在卫星模式的地图中，我其实是对着地球的一个角落，悠然地俯瞰它们。坦率地说，我羡慕它们。在生命的最后岁月，它们只是停滞了时钟的脚步，没有病痛的煎熬，没有离别的忧伤。在沙漠干燥的气候中，除了微微的尘土，它们的身姿和年轻时一模一样。在想象间，我甚至可以漫步在那些外表年轻而内心苍老的飞机们中间。当然，我根本不是一个真正意义上的航空爱好者：那些狂热的爱好者应该能够一眼就辨认出各种各样的旧机型：P40，B25，Ki-84……事实上，它们在我眼里不过是各式各样的飞机而已。可是唯一有一种机型，我想我自己还是一眼就能够认出。
9a15b6b2cd98b83c7a6060441b618116f08726ef.translatedText: Although I am only facing the screen, in the satellite mode map, I am actually facing a corner of the earth, overlooking them leisurely. Frankly, I envy them. In the last years of their lives, they just stopped the pace of the clock, without the suffering of illness or the sadness of parting. In the dry climate of the desert, except for a slight dust, their appearance is exactly the same as when they were young. In my imagination, I can even walk among those airplanes that look young but are old at heart. Of course, I am not a real aviation enthusiast at all: those who are avid enthusiasts should be able to recognize various old models at a glance: P40, B25, Ki-84... In fact, in my eyes, they are just various aircraft. But there is only one model, and I think I can still recognize it at a glance.

e762784c0e60e25dbeaad514a3e76e6040cb5e3f.sourceText: 它是一个神话，一个实实在在存在过的神话。
e762784c0e60e25dbeaad514a3e76e6040cb5e3f.translatedText: It is a myth, a myth that actually existed.

0240710d4747b8aa5e57783e8bb2700377f2bb2d.sourceText: 二战时期中国政府迁都重庆后，日本对重庆的空中轰炸可以说从未停歇。虽然空中打击比陆军进攻要方便的多，可是重庆四川一带多雾的气候让日军的轰炸机常常失去目标而只能胡乱投弹，而且飞行中也经常被中国的战斗机拦截，陆续有不小的损失。从已被占领的汉口基地到重庆的距离往返接近两千公里，远远超出了日本当时主力战机三菱96式的最大航程。在零式战机出现以前，中国对日本的空军虽然不算有多少优势，但还是大致处于可以对峙的状态，甚至中国空军还一直计划着集中空中优势兵力打一场歼灭战。而零式战机编队在中国上空几次被目击一直被分析为一种可能的新型轰炸机。在这个前提下，9月13日，由中国空军第三大队 34架战机和日本12航空队的13架零式战机在重庆璧山上空正式遭遇。
0240710d4747b8aa5e57783e8bb2700377f2bb2d.translatedText: After the Chinese government moved the capital to Chongqing during World War II, Japan’s aerial bombing of Chongqing could be said to have never stopped. Although air strikes are much more convenient than army attacks, the foggy climate in Chongqing and Sichuan makes Japanese bombers often lose their targets and can only drop bombs indiscriminately. Moreover, they are often intercepted by Chinese fighter jets in flight, causing considerable losses one after another. The round trip distance from the occupied Hankou base to Chongqing was close to 2,000 kilometers, far exceeding the maximum range of the Mitsubishi Type 96, Japan's main fighter at the time. Before the emergence of the Zero fighter, although China's air force did not have much advantage over Japan, it was still in a state of being able to confront Japan. The Chinese Air Force had even been planning to concentrate its air superiority forces in a war of annihilation. The Zero fighter formation has been sighted several times over China and has been analyzed as a possible new bomber. Under this premise, on September 13, 34 fighter jets from the Third Group of the Chinese Air Force and 13 Zero fighter jets from the Japanese 12th Air Force formally encountered each other over Bishan, Chongqing.

61a171ee1880ce874213dd9b93e36193c28942ec.sourceText: 而这个神话，就开始于1940年9月13日，中国重庆璧山的上空。
61a171ee1880ce874213dd9b93e36193c28942ec.translatedText: This myth began on September 13, 1940, in the sky over Bishan, Chongqing, China.

c3b2ae42202c5fbf86906ffcc6d2b1e9666a3dd6.sourceText: 这绝不是一场对等的空战：中国空军大部分都是苏联的老式战机。双方飞机性能的巨大差距，可以比拟成最佳状态下的拳王泰森和幼儿园小孩子的差距。这个空战完全就是34个柔弱的小孩子义无反顾地冲向了13个强悍的拳王泰森。但令人心痛的是，那些冲向拳王的孩子们对如此强悍的对手一无所知。其实，相比日方那些还在熟悉飞机性能的飞行员，中方的飞行员其实有着更为丰富的空战经验。但是这些经验，依然只是如同打过群架的幼儿园小孩的经验，他们很快发现其实还不如没有。
c3b2ae42202c5fbf86906ffcc6d2b1e9666a3dd6.translatedText: This is by no means a reciprocal air battle: most of the Chinese Air Force are old Soviet fighters. The huge gap in performance between the two aircraft can be compared to the gap between boxing champion Tyson and a kindergarten child at his best. This aerial battle was just like 34 weak children rushing towards 13 powerful boxing champion Tyson without hesitation. But what is heartbreaking is that the children who are rushing towards the boxing championship know nothing about such a powerful opponent. In fact, compared to the Japanese pilots who are still familiar with the performance of the aircraft, the Chinese pilots actually have richer air combat experience. But these experiences are still just like the experiences of kindergarten children who have had group fights. They soon discovered that it was actually worse than nothing.

c39825a0538e35bdfea7d1a0178e16a635633210.sourceText: 他们首先惊讶于对方无可匹敌的机动性：以往的咬尾追杀战术完全失效，相反会被对方如迅猛的野兽一样在瞬间迅速反咬，完全弄不清楚对方是如何做到那么小的转弯半径的。随之就是防护钢板周围不停地被子弹无情地敲响，而无论如何坚持，左、右，都无法逃离被击落的命运。有些经验老道的中方飞行员急转下坠才大致摆脱，而这样他们只能在外围低空看着自己的战友们一架一架由高空冒烟坠落。然而他们忍着心痛，依然在外围躲闪纠缠，他们心里其实有着充分的理由。现在上去打不过对方，可对方打久了，总会”累”吧？
c39825a0538e35bdfea7d1a0178e16a635633210.translatedText: First of all, they were surprised by the opponent's unrivaled mobility: the previous tail-biting pursuit tactics were completely ineffective. Instead, they would be bitten back by the opponent in an instant like a swift beast. They had no idea how the opponent could achieve such a small turning radius. Then the bullets around the protective steel plate kept ringing mercilessly, and no matter how hard they persisted, left or right, they could not escape the fate of being shot down. Some experienced Chinese pilots turned sharply and fell before they were able to escape. In this way, they could only watch their comrades falling from high altitudes one by one at low altitudes. However, they endured the heartache and still dodged and entangled in the periphery. They actually had good reasons in their hearts. You can't beat the opponent if you go up now, but if the opponent fights for a long time, he will always be "tired", right?

b5bc27298a00c4944783e3a94646c7164371d7bf.sourceText: 从汉口来重庆远袭，对方必须留下一定燃油返航：当对方返航时再去纠缠应该会奏效。然而中方飞行员的判断依然错得离谱。拳王用拳轻松打死两个小孩子，再次面对第三个也不会累。相比当时的其它所有战机，零式战机极其无理地同时拥有高机动性和超长续航性。等逃到外围的中方飞机回头一拥而上的时候，遭到的依然是钢铁般的野蛮重拳，一丝一毫的力量都没有减少。
b5bc27298a00c4944783e3a94646c7164371d7bf.translatedText: From Hankou to Chongqing for a long-range attack, the opponent must leave a certain amount of fuel to return: it should be effective to pester the opponent when they return. However, the Chinese pilot's judgment was still terribly wrong. The boxing champion easily killed two children with his punches, and he would not be tired when facing a third one again. Compared with all other fighters at the time, the Zero fighter had both high maneuverability and long endurance. When the Chinese planes who had escaped to the periphery turned around and swarmed forward, they were still met with steel-like brutal punches, without any loss of strength.

bd16bf13fd5a29b4ffe68ba7e9c181fa08215a84.sourceText: 这是一场赤裸裸的杀戮，一场现役拳王对小孩子的空中杀戮。
bd16bf13fd5a29b4ffe68ba7e9c181fa08215a84.translatedText: This is a naked killing, an aerial killing of a child by an active boxing champion.

2c15554420fa6339d580ade87db1e50221e701e6.sourceText: 日方统计中方被击落各种战机27架；而中方统计自己被击落24架。有一点双方的结论是一样的，那些强悍而得意的拳王们，13架初试身手的零式战机，丝毫无损地离开了战场，仅有一架在回航时意外损坏。
2c15554420fa6339d580ade87db1e50221e701e6.translatedText: The Japanese counted that China had shot down 27 fighter jets of various types; while the Chinese counted that they had shot down 24. One thing is the same. The conclusions of both sides are the same. Those strong and proud boxing champions, the 13 Zero fighters that first tried their skills, left the battlefield without any damage, and only one was accidentally damaged on the return flight.

e85d31cfd8b0a45afcf9fd9bdb4e3422052c4862.sourceText: 中国空军在璧山上空遭受重创。中国航空委员会顾问陈纳德（顺便说一句，中国航空委员会的秘书长就是宋美龄）在中美往返组织美国志愿援华航空队的时候，顺便向美国军方正式报告了日本的新式战机，当时却并未引起过多关注。日本人的新战机，在美国军方眼里并不比日本的鲤鱼旗更可怕，陈纳德的报告也被束之高阁。留在中国战场的陈纳德只有从一场场痛苦的战损中汲取可用的经验，分析零式战机的弱点。
e85d31cfd8b0a45afcf9fd9bdb4e3422052c4862.translatedText: The Chinese Air Force suffered heavy losses over Bishan. Chennault, a consultant to the China Aviation Commission (by the way, the secretary-general of the China Aviation Commission is Song Meiling), was organizing the American Volunteer Air Force to aid China back and forth between China and the United States. He officially reported Japan's new fighter aircraft to the US military, but it did not attract much attention at the time. The Japanese's new fighter planes were no more terrifying in the eyes of the U.S. military than the Japanese carp streamers, and Chennault's report was shelved. Chennault, who stayed on the Chinese battlefield, could only draw useful experience from painful battle losses and analyze the weaknesses of the Zero fighter.

0e9b8f6eda4341a740e8ca86fb25bae93131921e.sourceText: 回头看来，在中日空战这盘的已经断然无比劣势的棋局下，陈纳德绝对是不世出的翻盘高手。在不算多的几次对零式战机的遭遇以及骚扰试探之后，他总结出了几点对付零式的战术，极大地减低了中国空军以及飞虎队对零式的战损。而这些战术，包括突然接近，迅速开火，而其中最后也是最重要的一点，就是打了就跑，甚至打不着也跑。
0e9b8f6eda4341a740e8ca86fb25bae93131921e.translatedText: Looking back, in the Sino-Japanese air battle, which was already an extremely disadvantageous chess game, Chennault was definitely a comeback master. After a few encounters and harassment tests against Zero fighters, he summarized several tactics to deal with Zero fighters, which greatly reduced the battle losses of the Chinese Air Force and Flying Tigers to Zero fighters. These tactics include sudden approach, rapid fire, and the last and most important point is to hit and run, even if you can't hit and run.

9cdce9d00c6e97f2cbca1c88a95489dcfcf8883c.sourceText: 传统上，这种打了就跑的战术是动摇军心的胆小鬼行为。甚至英国的皇家海军航空队如果这么做，会被送上军事法庭。陈纳德本人应该是知道的，但是他丝毫不以为意。中国空军和飞虎队按照他的要求，突然窜出来开火后就立刻俯冲，然后像胆小鬼一样迅速逃离，决不回头。虽然这样歼敌比率不高只是骚扰为主，但不停地骚扰也让日军感到非常麻烦。更重要的是：无数在中国上空一直活下来的中美飞行员，应该都在感谢陈纳德。
9cdce9d00c6e97f2cbca1c88a95489dcfcf8883c.translatedText: Traditionally, this type of hit-and-run tactic is a cowardly act that shakes military morale. Even the British Royal Naval Air Force would be sent to a military court if they did this. Chennault himself should have known, but he didn't care at all. In accordance with his request, the Chinese Air Force and Flying Tigers suddenly sprang out to open fire, dived immediately, and then fled like cowards without looking back. Although the enemy-killing ratio is not high and the enemy is mainly harassed, the constant harassment also makes the Japanese army feel very troublesome. More importantly: countless Chinese and American pilots who have survived in the skies over China should be grateful to Chennault.

8f1f4253a43a7fbc0c00446d09b4ec92867a4f67.sourceText: 1941年日本偷袭珍珠港后，太平洋战争爆发。陈纳德的报告和经验依然无人问津。在日美太平洋战争初期，零式战机迅速统治了整个天空。当时日本一共只有300架零式，投入太平洋战场250架，却在几个月内消灭了盟军三分之二的战机。而整个战局的转机以及神话的终结，却是1942年6月3号，一位名为小贺忠义（一说为古贺）的日本海军航空队兵曹长的身亡开始的。
8f1f4253a43a7fbc0c00446d09b4ec92867a4f67.translatedText: After Japan attacked Pearl Harbor in 1941, the Pacific War broke out. Chennault's reports and experiences remained unknown. In the early days of the Pacific War between Japan and the United States, Zero fighters quickly dominated the skies. At that time, Japan had only 300 Zeros in total, and 250 were deployed in the Pacific battlefield. However, it destroyed two-thirds of the Allied fighters within a few months. The turning point of the entire war situation and the end of the myth began with the death of a Japanese naval air force commander named Tadayoshi Oga (some say Koga) on June 3, 1942.

3475f80d68644d164229885587ef481b47132167.sourceText: 小贺当时驾驶一架零式战机在返航途中发现燃料泄漏，不得已迫降在海上一个荒岛。降落后，大雨后不久松软的泥土迅速下陷，机身猛烈倾倒，折断了正在座椅上的小贺的脖子。5周后，一支美国搜索队对发现了这架陷落在荒岛的飞机和依然卡在座椅上小贺的尸体。最重要的是，这架零式战机除了油箱被地面机枪击穿了两个洞外完好无损。
3475f80d68644d164229885587ef481b47132167.translatedText: Oga was piloting a Zero fighter plane and found a fuel leak on the way back, and had to make an emergency landing on a desert island in the sea. After landing, the soft soil sank quickly after heavy rain, and the fuselage fell violently, breaking the neck of Xiaoga who was sitting on the seat. Five weeks later, an American search team discovered the plane that had crashed on the desert island and Xiaoga's body still stuck in the seat. The most important thing is that this Zero fighter was intact except for two holes in the fuel tank that were punctured by ground machine gunfire.

bc7ac86170325fdabaf4de08fc0604a0bcdfadd9.sourceText: 在小贺的飞机被美国资深飞行员多达24次试飞后，零式的秘密被彻底破解了。美军设计新战机有了针对目标，而现役飞机也有了良好的战术来摆脱零式的追击：高速右转或俯冲。这种战术和陈纳德依靠望远镜以及幸存飞行员的描述得来的判断基本一致。而在机动性不逊于零式并且有更强火力更厚装甲更高速度的F6F迅速被投放战场后，零式就彻底沦为战场的陪衬了。到战争后期，零式就只是神风敢死队的自杀配备了。
bc7ac86170325fdabaf4de08fc0604a0bcdfadd9.translatedText: After Oga's aircraft was tested as many as 24 times by senior American pilots, the secret of the Zero was completely cracked. The U.S. military has designed new fighters with targets, and existing aircraft also have good tactics to get rid of the Zero's pursuit: turn right at high speed or dive. This tactic is basically consistent with Chennault's judgment based on binoculars and descriptions of surviving pilots. After the F6F, which was no less maneuverable than the Zero and had stronger firepower, thicker armor, and higher speed, was quickly put on the battlefield, the Zero was completely reduced to a foil on the battlefield. By the end of the war, the Zero was merely a suicide weapon for kamikaze squads.

69621aa30974905afe253726ef2ffba946986f7d.sourceText: 这个有些迷茫而忧伤的诗句来源于法国诗人Paul Valery的《海滨墓园》Le cimetieremarin。没有上下文的时候，这句诗其实有些不知所云，然而这句没头没尾的诗句在日本小说家堀辰雄作品《风起》（日语：風立ちぬ）中不停地或隐或现，仿佛一根纤细的蛛丝在暴风雨中，你几乎看不见却知道它的存在：只是一根细细的连接却一直没有断开。而这部小说被改编成的电影中文名叫《逝风残梦》，是山口百惠和三浦友和风华正茂时被忽视的作品。现实生活中称得上幸福美满的两人在影片中一如既往地表演着悲剧：百惠在战争结束前死于肺病，而三浦在战后回到东京，只能一人永远回忆着爱人的笑容。
69621aa30974905afe253726ef2ffba946986f7d.translatedText: This somewhat confused and melancholy poem comes from "Le cimetieremarin" by French poet Paul Valery. Without context, this poem is actually somewhat incomprehensible. However, this endless poem appears and disappears in the work "The Wind Rises" (Japanese: 风立ちぬ) by the Japanese novelist Hori Tatsuo. It is like a slender spider thread in the storm. You can hardly see it but you know its existence: it is just a thin connection but it has never been disconnected. The Chinese name for the movie adapted from this novel is "The Passing Wind and Remembrance of Dreams", which was a neglected work by Yamaguchi Momoe and Miura Yuwa when they were in their prime. The two people who can be called happy in real life perform tragedy as always in the film: Momoe died of lung disease before the end of the war, and Miura returned to Tokyo after the war, only one person can always recall the smile of his lover.

934f6a2d23c8a5f10cfe25245d42bedbb33f9666.sourceText: 宫崎骏的动画电影名字也叫《风起》，或者也翻译成《起风了》。这部影片不是一部简单的改编，而是是融合了堀辰雄的两部小说《风起》、《菜穗子》以及零式飞机设计师堀越二郎的生平故事。两部长篇小说加上一个人的一生，最先出现在他的漫画连载中，而后全部浓缩制作在一部动画电影中。影片的主线一直显得模模糊糊，就连零式飞机的实景镜头都只是最后一闪而过。坦率地说，宫崎骏似乎根本没想让人看懂，他大概只想留下一部展示人生的作品。
934f6a2d23c8a5f10cfe25245d42bedbb33f9666.translatedText: The name of Miyazaki Hayao's animated film is also called "The Wind Rises", or it can also be translated as "The Wind Rises". This film is not a simple adaptation, but a fusion of Hori Tatsuo's two novels "The Wind Rises" and "Nahoko" as well as the life story of Zero aircraft designer Horikoshi Jiro. Two novels and one person's life first appeared in his comic series, and then were all condensed into an animated film. The main line of the film has always seemed vague, and even the live shots of the Zero plane only flashed by at the end. Frankly speaking, Hayao Miyazaki doesn't seem to want to be understood at all. He probably just wants to leave a work that shows life.

5f9609df0b56a19b8b37ec7ce1b7f5391f636ef9.sourceText: 到底什么是人生？能不能在一部影片的长度里展示？宫崎骏几乎是用临死前弥留般的快速回忆的手法来片段了堀越二郎的一生以及两部小说的全部故事。各种形态的飞机，昏暗的天空，突然的地震，城市的人群，战争的残酷，更有美丽到无可比拟的菜穗子 – 宫崎骏的动画中很多女性都很可爱，秀丽，但少有如此美丽和凄凉到让人心碎的女子。
5f9609df0b56a19b8b37ec7ce1b7f5391f636ef9.translatedText: What is life? Can it be shown in the length of a video? Hayao Miyazaki almost used the technique of quick recall before death to fragment the life of Jiro Horikoshi and the entire story of the two novels. Planes of various shapes, dark skies, sudden earthquakes, city crowds, the cruelty of war, and even the incomparably beautiful Naoko – many women in Hayao Miyazaki’s animations are cute and beautiful, but few are so beautiful and so desolate that it breaks your heart.

2ba6b449abbf4b7392b06ec2866747e7125a77e8.sourceText: 才华出众的战机设计师堀越二郎1982年去世。
2ba6b449abbf4b7392b06ec2866747e7125a77e8.translatedText: The talented fighter designer Jiro Horikoshi passed away in 1982.

cdea378707052acb2504827d1dd5a6ab3fbd1d68.sourceText: 而小贺的零式战机一直被美国军方妥善修缮保养，有可能是现存唯一可以起飞的零式。后来它曾经被运往日本琦玉县所泽市所泽航空历史纪念馆，由退役美军飞行员在来自全球500多名航空爱好者面前重新升空。
cdea378707052acb2504827d1dd5a6ab3fbd1d68.translatedText: Oga's Zero fighter has been properly repaired and maintained by the US military, and may be the only existing Zero that can take off. Later, it was transported to the Tokorozawa Aviation Historical Memorial Museum in Tokorozawa City, Saitama Prefecture, Japan, where it was re-launched by retired US military pilots in front of more than 500 aviation enthusiasts from around the world.

d7d4efbe729b1db49ec27ea2b8ccf8dc0308b39f.sourceText: 背景介绍：宫崎骏(Miyazaki hayao)是日本动画导演及漫画家。《起风了》是他以自己的连载漫画改编的动画电影，也是他目前最后一部执导的影片。由于故事涉及零式战机设计师的生平，这部作品获得评价贬褒不一。然而我觉得，千千万万普通或不普通的人们，在战争的风雨中能做到的，只是努力活下去而已。我们对战争的纪念不能，也绝不应该简单地指向仇恨-那样其实只是在心里埋下了再一次战争的种子。作为结束，我希望把这一幕画面定格到你的眼前：当退役美军飞行员把小贺的那架零式升空的一刻，来到现场的几个日本老航空兵倚着拐杖，泪如雨下。
d7d4efbe729b1db49ec27ea2b8ccf8dc0308b39f.translatedText: Background introduction: Miyazaki hayao is a Japanese animation director and cartoonist. "The Wind Rises" is an animated film adapted from his own comic book series, and it is also the last film he directed. Because the story involves the life of the Zero fighter designer, the work received mixed reviews. However, I feel that what thousands of ordinary or extraordinary people can do in the storm of war is just to survive. Our commemoration of war cannot, and should never, simply point to hatred - that would only sow the seeds of another war in our hearts. To end, I hope to freeze this scene in front of your eyes: when the retired US military pilot lifted Xiaohe's Zero into the air, several old Japanese aviation soldiers who came to the scene leaned on crutches and burst into tears.

40c0a27d778972081e7f1d40d136510b1a5b2b96.sourceText: 对千千万万普通或不普通的人，现今的和平，如此珍贵。
40c0a27d778972081e7f1d40d136510b1a5b2b96.translatedText: To millions of ordinary or extraordinary people, today's peace is so precious.

a29eaa3bdbcfc71d35de1452d1293a066544234d.sourceText: 【 反法西斯胜利70周年亚省特刊】就这样纪念历史
a29eaa3bdbcfc71d35de1452d1293a066544234d.translatedText: [Alberta Special Issue on the 70th Anniversary of the Anti-Fascist Victory] This is how we commemorate history

357c5ba1124a79fd28e966158b079608ea46251a.sourceText: 【 反法西斯胜利70周年亚省特刊】就这样纪念历史 凤凰笔会 图桑 慧明 新落成的亚利桑那大学学生中心被典雅…
357c5ba1124a79fd28e966158b079608ea46251a.translatedText: [Alberta Special Issue on the 70th Anniversary of our Anti-Fascist Victory] This is how we commemorate history Phoenix PEN Tucson Huiming The newly completed University of Arizona Student Center was elegantly...

21238444112bc6463097f1c7980e8e6ef5a062e8.sourceText: 凤凰笔会 图桑 慧明

154b3acc1a0d223967f7dfbd80faa406e7ed4b2b.sourceText: 新落成的亚利桑那大学学生中心被典雅的红楼和绿树簇拥着，甚是别致。且不说这奇特的军舰造型如何和谐地融合于古老传统的建筑之中，为这所百年老校带来现代的活力；也不必细描那散落在中心周围那些刻意安置的吧台坐椅，为紧张的学校生活带来一丝的闲适和浪漫，就是在学生中心的心脏地带，你也能感受到设计者独特的匠心。
154b3acc1a0d223967f7dfbd80faa406e7ed4b2b.translatedText: The newly completed University of Arizona Student Center is surrounded by elegant red buildings and green trees, which is very unique. Not to mention how this peculiar warship shape is harmoniously integrated into the ancient traditional architecture, bringing modern vitality to this century-old school; nor is it necessary to describe in detail the deliberately placed bar seats scattered around the center, bringing a touch of leisure and romance to the tense school life. Even in the heart of the student center, you can also feel the unique ingenuity of the designer.

efc5dfe49c3345ba59ca7a91a4527eaf64f50e95.sourceText: 那是一般建筑的显赫位置，多是那些主人、设计师和那些建筑公司留下一世英名的地方。而在这里，被一至三楼楼梯环绕着的立体空间却由一个水池独占着，水池的上方，从三楼坚硬的墙上垂下一节锈积斑斑的巨型铁链。
efc5dfe49c3345ba59ca7a91a4527eaf64f50e95.translatedText: That is a prominent position in general buildings, where the owners, designers and construction companies have left their lasting names. But here, the three-dimensional space surrounded by the stairs from the first to the third floor is exclusively occupied by a pool. Above the pool, a giant rusty iron chain hangs from the solid wall on the third floor.

b32864b85ff6d92fc4631b5b24dc7e880dccd14c.sourceText: 美国许多建筑或设计都是由那些很有现代设计思想的大家设计的，很多东西让你似懂非懂，还情不自禁地让你惊讶和感动。初看这链子以为又是哪个抽象家在玩深沉呢。美国好端端的马路会突然从地面矗立出一个由旧自行车钢圈和车架焊结起来的奇怪造型，让你行车小心，这阻碍交通的玩意还受法律保护，不容拆除。
b32864b85ff6d92fc4631b5b24dc7e880dccd14c.translatedText: Many buildings or designs in the United States were designed by people with modern design ideas. There are many things that you may not understand, but you can't help but be surprised and moved. When I first looked at this chain, I thought it was another abstract artist playing with depth. On beautiful roads in the United States, a strange shape made of old bicycle steel rims and frames will suddenly appear from the ground, telling you to drive carefully. This traffic-impeding thing is also protected by law and cannot be removed.

f99d84739b5b48725774a0f5327b97541778b311.sourceText: 是不是这铁链子又是这样一个设计者的奇特构思呢？
f99d84739b5b48725774a0f5327b97541778b311.translatedText: Is this iron chain another unique idea of ​​a designer?

246406e7fdd149e701bb2486299acd1ff3ddb255.sourceText: 察看了说明才知道，这链子非同小可，还不是一般人，一般团体都能得到的。原来这链子来自大名鼎鼎的亚里桑那号战舰——那艘1941年12 月7日被日军在珍珠港击沉的美国战列舰，随着那艘战舰沉没的还有1177名美国士兵。战舰被击沉，引起了全美的强烈反应，由此，美国开始向日本反击，开辟了二次大战的亚洲战场，直至最后击败日本法西斯。二战结束，美国各州为争夺另一艘战舰密苏里号的归属权闹得不可开交。夏威夷州长站出来说：”就让密苏里号安居在亚利桑那号旁边吧，亚利桑那号是沉重的历史，第二次世界大战开始；密苏里号是辉煌的胜利，第二次世界大战结束。”亚里桑那号从此作为那段沉重历史的见证被保存了下来。
246406e7fdd149e701bb2486299acd1ff3ddb255.translatedText: After reading the description, I realized that this chain is not trivial and cannot be obtained by ordinary people or ordinary groups. It turns out that this chain comes from the famous USS Arizona, an American battleship that was sunk by the Japanese at Pearl Harbor on December 7, 1941. Along with the battleship, 1,177 American soldiers sank. The sinking of the battleship caused a strong reaction across the United States. As a result, the United States began to counterattack Japan, opening up the Asian battlefield of World War II, until it finally defeated Japanese fascism. At the end of World War II, states in the United States were quarreling over the ownership of another battleship, the USS Missouri. The governor of Hawaii stood up and said: "Let the Missouri live next to the Arizona. The Arizona is a heavy history, the beginning of World War II; the Missouri is a glorious victory, the end of World War II." The Arizona has since been preserved as a witness to that heavy history.

009ccb20d7b2d7e44a3c979f66638e63153ca21f.sourceText: 在美国现在很少有人再提起太平洋战事，即便提起，人们也含含糊糊，像自己做了什么亏心事那样。这有点像现在的德国，提起柏林墙在哪里，德国人特别是原来的西德百姓都不愿直接告诉，尤其不愿说出东德这样的词句。德国民众的这种心情可以理解，过去的就让他过去，不要以胜利者的身份对失败者说三道四，历史对此自有结论。这兴许是一种绅士风度。
009ccb20d7b2d7e44a3c979f66638e63153ca21f.translatedText: In the United States, few people now mention the Pacific War. Even if they do, people do it vaguely, as if they have done something wrong. This is a bit like Germany now. When it comes to where the Berlin Wall is, Germans, especially the former West German people, are reluctant to tell them directly, especially the words "East Germany". The mood of the German people is understandable. Let bygones be bygones, and don't make irresponsible remarks on the losers as winners. History has its own conclusion on this. This may be a gentlemanly thing to do.

d3e345208222a943be51f70ba934cb8a19e8735c.sourceText: 美国与日本的那本帐与东西德制度的帐可不是一回事，但偏偏许多美国人都不愿提起了。是当年用了原子弹，报复得太凶了，有内疚心理；还是今天日本用汽车封住了美国年轻人的口？也许，校方还有其他的顾忌。每年到夏威夷观光的日本游客有三百万之多，但去珍珠港看亚里桑那号的却寥寥无几。难道学校今天挂起亚里桑那号的铁链会引起日本学生的反感或对他们的仇视，会有种族问题的麻烦吗？不得而知。
d3e345208222a943be51f70ba934cb8a19e8735c.translatedText: The account between the United States and Japan is not the same as the account between the East and West German systems, but many Americans are reluctant to mention it. Was it because they used atomic bombs back then that they were too violent in revenge and felt guilty? Or is it because Japan is using cars to silence American young people today? Maybe the school has other concerns. There are three million Japanese tourists visiting Hawaii every year, but only a few go to Pearl Harbor to see the Arizona. Could it be that hanging up the Arizona chain in the school today will arouse resentment or hatred among Japanese students and cause racial problems? unknown.

c3e6cf6e4e5c1226de9ec2cca5e3c64844f509ab.sourceText: 但因为一些人的反感而放弃过去，就对得起美国的历史和那些历史的见证人吗？这好像从来不是美国人的性格。亚利桑那州的图森（Tucson）因为气候温和是美国退伍军人的养老地，每年二战纪念日都还能见到那些珍珠港事件的幸存老军人。
c3e6cf6e4e5c1226de9ec2cca5e3c64844f509ab.translatedText: But is giving up the past because of some people’s resentment worthy of American history and the witnesses of history? This seems to have never been the American character. Tucson, Arizona, is a retirement home for American veterans because of its mild climate. Every year on World War II Memorial Day, you can still see those veterans who survived the Pearl Harbor attack.

1f02eba307082e758ec4b4990374259397c59e6c.sourceText: 设计师和亚利桑那大学的主事者最后还是用自己的方式，将那条历史的铁链请回了宁静的校园，让它与躺在水底的亚利桑那号一样，用自己的方式无声地再现历史。 那铁链上记载着70多年前历史的斑斑锈积，让知道它的人给它一份特别的尊重和崇拜， 虽然这个学校80%到90%的年轻学生都以为那只是一件艺术挂件。且做一回抽象艺术品吧。亚利桑那号的铁链是一段历史，那么多学生不懂链子也是美国的又一段历史。这就是完整的美国。
1f02eba307082e758ec4b4990374259397c59e6c.translatedText: The designer and the person in charge of the University of Arizona finally used their own way to bring the historical iron chain back to the quiet campus, allowing it to silently reproduce history in its own way, just like the USS Arizona lying under the water. The iron chain records the rusty accumulation of more than 70 years of history, which makes people who know it give it special respect and admiration, although 80% to 90% of the young students in this school think it is just an art pendant. Let’s make abstract art for once. The chain on the Arizona is a piece of history, but so many students don’t understand that the chain is also another piece of American history. This is complete America.

0e5a9adb7e748cce1b9973d5bf0690d1efa0eafb.sourceText: 所幸，还有很多的年轻人也像那链子的设计者那样在纪念历史。前些年，二战胜利60周年纪念的那年，亚里桑那大学中国留学生学生会，在那挂着铁链建筑的门口，顶着骄阳，用自己打印的材料，揭露当年日本法西斯的罪行——-你可以义愤，你可以不屑，也可以反对，但我就是这样，像亚利桑那号的铁链那样，用自己的方式纪念历史，还原历史。
0e5a9adb7e748cce1b9973d5bf0690d1efa0eafb.translatedText: Fortunately, there are many young people who are commemorating history like the designer of the chain. A few years ago, in the year of the 60th anniversary of the victory of World War II, the Chinese Students Association of the University of Arizona stood at the door of the chain-hung building, facing the scorching sun, and used printed materials to expose the crimes of Japanese fascism. You can be indignant, you can be disdainful, or you can oppose, but that's how I am, like the chains on the USS Arizona, commemorating history and restoring history in my own way.

c5a905475f297a52d30b883df90b2630df3b1913.sourceText: 【 反法西斯胜利70周年亚省特刊】南京大屠杀
c5a905475f297a52d30b883df90b2630df3b1913.translatedText: [Alberta Special Issue on the 70th Anniversary of the Anti-Fascist Victory] Nanjing Massacre

e1c51d22640047605ee147503d5d8084ec86f7cd.sourceText: 【 反法西斯胜利70周年亚省特刊】南京大屠杀 凤凰城 张肇鸿 2014年9月12日，我前往南京，参加一个由…
e1c51d22640047605ee147503d5d8084ec86f7cd.translatedText: [Alberta Special Issue on the 70th Anniversary of the Anti-Fascist Victory] Nanjing Massacre Phoenix Zhang Zhaohong On September 12, 2014, I went to Nanjing to participate in a workshop organized by...

c10845ffbff6ed542502171be4034e734a2d9841.sourceText: 2014年9月12日，我前往南京，参加一个由国侨办举办的研习班。9月18日，由江苏省侨办安排，我们前往参观＂侵华日军南京大屠杀遇难同胞纪念馆＂。
c10845ffbff6ed542502171be4034e734a2d9841.translatedText: On September 12, 2014, I went to Nanjing to participate in a workshop organized by the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the State Council. On September 18, arranged by the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of Jiangsu Province, we visited the "Memorial Hall for the Victims of the Nanjing Massacre by the Japanese Invaders."

20cda433e871a4d19a2dbb4dd246e96018e23859.sourceText: 1982年，日本把蓄谋已久的篡改历史行动升级，将教科书中的「侵略中国」改为「进入中国」。此卑鄙行径立即激起了南京人民的极大愤概，立决设立遗址历史博物馆，以悼念侵华日军南京大屠杀的卅万遇难者。馆址选定在南京城西南江东门，这是当年日军大屠杀的主要地点和遇难者丛葬地。纪念馆于1985年建成开放，经过1995年、2005年两次扩建，现佔地7万5千平方米，建筑面积2.5万平方米，包括展览集会、遗址悼念、和平公园和馆藏等4个区域，展览集会有广场陈列、遗骨陈列和史料陈列三部份。收集了一万多份历史资料和文物，是国家一级博物馆。
20cda433e871a4d19a2dbb4dd246e96018e23859.translatedText: In 1982, Japan escalated its long-planned action of tampering with history and changed the word "invasion of China" in its textbooks to "entering China." This despicable act immediately aroused great indignation among the people of Nanjing, who decided to establish a site history museum to commemorate the 300,000 victims of the Nanjing Massacre by the Japanese invaders. The site of the museum was selected at Jiangdong Gate in the southwest of Nanjing City, which was the main site of the Japanese massacre and the burial place of the victims. The memorial hall was built and opened in 1985. After two expansions in 1995 and 2005, it now covers an area of ​​75,000 square meters and a construction area of ​​25,000 square meters. It includes four areas: exhibition gathering, site memorial, peace park and collection. The exhibition gathering has three parts: square display, remains display and historical materials display. It has collected more than 10,000 historical materials and cultural relics and is a national first-class museum.

86fd09b815ca42f2a95b9b62d7c9ad5706da011c.sourceText: 我们来自世界各地的学员怀着无比悲愤的心情，来到了展场馆，广场上有大型十字架石碑，刻有南京大屠杀事件时间表。通过墓地广场，地上以鹅卵石铺地，寸草不生，象征着白骨累累和死亡，看到一座座「古城的灾难」、「残破城门」等大型凋塑。「冤魂的呐喊」凋塑群立于广场入口处，在其背后是刻有十三国文字的「遇难者 300000」的「灾难之牆」。南京大屠杀的冤魂在此化作一个个的凋塑悲立在长风之下，他们向着苍天悲鸣，向着大地恸哭，向着人间控诉，正如公祭鼎铭文上的一字一泪:
86fd09b815ca42f2a95b9b62d7c9ad5706da011c.translatedText: Our students from all over the world came to the exhibition venue with great sadness and indignation. There is a large cross stone in the square with the timeline of the Nanjing Massacre engraved on it. Passing through the cemetery square, the ground is paved with cobblestones and there is no grass growing, which symbolizes the accumulation of bones and death. You can see large sculptures such as "Disaster of the Ancient City" and "Broken City Gate". The "Cry of the Wounded Souls" sculpture group stands at the entrance of the square. Behind it is the "Wall of Disaster" inscribed with the words "Victims 300,000" in the characters of the Thirteen Kingdoms. The innocent souls of the Nanjing Massacre turned into statues and stood sadly under the long wind. They screamed to the sky, wept to the earth, and complained to the world, just like the inscription on the public sacrificial tripod:

08b33877c9e53ae2eecb2b376dbd7dbe8c0f334a.sourceText: 侵华日寇，毁吾南京。劫掠黎庶，屠戮苍生。
08b33877c9e53ae2eecb2b376dbd7dbe8c0f334a.translatedText: The Japanese invaders invaded China and destroyed Nanjing. Rob the common people and massacre the common people.

25dda7cf9500cbdd9b068dbe4dda45d2c120e319.sourceText: 卅万亡灵，饮恨江城。日月惨澹，寰宇震惊。
25dda7cf9500cbdd9b068dbe4dda45d2c120e319.translatedText: Thirty thousand dead souls, drinking and hating Jiangcheng. The sun and moon were miserable, and the world was shocked.

1899feae4a7454a8593d052fd2fce757fd33eca8.sourceText: 兽行暴虐，旷世未闻。同胞何辜，国难正殷。
1899feae4a7454a8593d052fd2fce757fd33eca8.translatedText: The brutality of the beast is unheard of in the world. How can we blame our compatriots? The country is in dire straits.

ed3901299d1bdd6b1d435c98520077bddd716916.sourceText: 哀兵奋起，金戈鼍鼓。兄弟同心，共御外侮。
ed3901299d1bdd6b1d435c98520077bddd716916.translatedText: The soldiers rose up in mourning, with jingles and drums. Brothers work together to resist foreign aggression.

7d857670f59d97581df92d06ba2ca58d8c3cab16.sourceText: 捐躯洒血，浩气干云。尽扫狼烟，重振乾坤。 ……
7d857670f59d97581df92d06ba2ca58d8c3cab16.translatedText: Sacrifice your life and shed your blood, your spirit will be filled with glory. Sweep away the smoke and revive the world. ...

d96a672c477c2463af64f98c001b816b3a126447.sourceText: 1937年12月13日，侵华日军入侵南京，制造了惨绝人寰的南京大屠杀惨案，30万同胞惨遭杀戮，无数妇女遭到强奸残害，无数儿童死于非命，三分之一建筑遭到毁坏，大量财物遭到掠夺。侵华日军一手制造的这一灭绝人性的大屠杀惨桉，是第二次世界大战史上”三大惨案”一，是骇人听闻的反人类罪行，是人类历史上十分黑暗的一页。
d96a672c477c2463af64f98c001b816b3a126447.translatedText: On December 13, 1937, the Japanese invaders invaded Nanjing and caused the brutal Nanjing Massacre. 300,000 compatriots were killed, countless women were raped and mutilated, countless children died, one-third of the buildings were destroyed, and a large amount of property was looted. This inhumane massacre perpetrated by the Japanese invaders is one of the "three major tragedies" in the history of World War II. It is an appalling crime against humanity and a very dark page in human history.

c5c25ab263122a9fe07626fb03f78549925574b4.sourceText: 9月18日当天，我们和来自全中国及海外华人聚集到这里。来到入口处，这是伸向地下的一座展馆，预示着人们将进入一座人间炼狱。
c5c25ab263122a9fe07626fb03f78549925574b4.translatedText: On September 18th, we gathered here with Chinese people from all over China and overseas. Coming to the entrance, this is a pavilion extending underground, indicating that people will enter a purgatory on earth.

eff35a668916900708675376334fe426698b0f51.sourceText: 侵华日军南京大屠杀史实展分为十一个部分。展厅面积为九千平方米，馆藏文物1万多件，其中3000多件对外展陈。日军南京大屠杀是中国抗日战争时期一个震惊中外、惨绝人寰的特大惨桉；是日军侵华期间一例最集中、最突出、最有代表性的暴行。
eff35a668916900708675376334fe426698b0f51.translatedText: The historical exhibition of the Nanjing Massacre by the Japanese invaders is divided into eleven parts. The exhibition hall covers an area of ​​9,000 square meters and houses more than 10,000 cultural relics, of which more than 3,000 are on display. The Nanjing Massacre by the Japanese Army was a terrible and horrific tragedy that shocked both China and the world during the Anti-Japanese War; it was the most concentrated, prominent and representative atrocity during the Japanese invasion of China.

0d9258070fe604cd00b375c9ea77f7d399f7c1e6.sourceText: 展厅环境幽暗，让牆上的历史相片和图片说明在灯光下有更清晰的表述，摆设的实物有大屠杀时日军使用的各种军用品，有枪枝钢炮，各种军服、钢盔，长短军刀，各种相关的图片、报张杂志。在南京大屠杀中，日军杀人不眨眼，更进行竞赛，杀满一百人未分出胜负，再杀到一百五十人，兽行令人发指。死难的中国人又岂这些！用飞机炸弹炸死的、用大炮轰死的，用枪打死的，用刺刀挑死的，用军刀砍死的，活埋的。日寇放火烧城，有更多的老百姓在逃难中死去，在饥饿中死去，在家破人亡中死去，妇女诐奸淫，老人小孩在失去亲人后身亡，日军在南京大屠杀时更把一多万具遇难者遗体被抛入长江之中。这就是日本人所谓的的＂大东亚圣战＂！
0d9258070fe604cd00b375c9ea77f7d399f7c1e6.translatedText: The exhibition hall environment is dark, allowing the historical photos and picture descriptions on the wall to be expressed more clearly under the light. The actual objects on display include various military supplies used by the Japanese army during the massacre, including guns and steel cannons, various military uniforms, helmets, long and short sabers, and various related pictures, newspapers and magazines. During the Nanjing Massacre, the Japanese army killed without blinking an eye, and even competed with each other. They killed a hundred people without a winner, and then killed a hundred and fifty people. Their brutality was outrageous. What about the Chinese who died! Those killed by plane bombs, blasted with cannons, shot to death with guns, picked to death with bayonets, hacked to death with sabers, and buried alive. The Japanese invaders set fire to the city, and more people died while fleeing, starving, or having their homes destroyed. Women committed adultery, and the elderly and children died after losing their loved ones. During the Nanjing Massacre, the Japanese army even threw the bodies of more than 10,000 victims into the Yangtze River. This is what the Japanese call the "Greater East Asia Holy War"!

44ea2a54094d1d206891b7552a283f280d42a384.sourceText: 滴答、滴答厖每隔12秒，一滴水从高空落下，随着灯的亮起，一位遇难者的遗像浮现眼前。随即，灯灭了，遗像也消失了。1937年12月13日至1938年1月，在短短６星期的时间内，侵华日军在南京残忍屠杀了30多万中国军民，平均每12秒就杀害一名中国人。由于此地是「万人坑」遗址，一具具的难民尸骸半掩在土中，死时惨况历历在目。展厅中无数人在哭泣，更多的人在对侵略者发出恶咒！
44ea2a54094d1d206891b7552a283f280d42a384.translatedText: Tick, tick, tick, every 12 seconds, a drop of water falls from the sky. As the lights turn on, the portrait of a victim appears in front of us. Immediately, the lights went out and the portrait disappeared. From December 13, 1937 to January 1938, in just six weeks, the Japanese invaders brutally massacred more than 300,000 Chinese soldiers and civilians in Nanjing, killing one Chinese every 12 seconds on average. Since this place is a "mass grave" site, the corpses of refugees are half-buried in the soil, and the tragic circumstances of their deaths are vividly visible. Countless people were crying in the exhibition hall, and even more people were casting curses on the invaders!

ff0693d7110213babd93bd90a5cf4338411b89cf.sourceText: 在参观过程中不许拍摄，不时有纠察员射出手电强光阻止拍摄者。我把闪光灯关掉，但仍情不自禁地举起相机，要把侵略者的凶残，同胞的惨状，国人的反抗摄入镜头，但震抖的双手无法控制，我拍到自摄影以来最模煳的一辑照片，有很多无法使用！以至在写这篇文章时，只能部分借助南京大屠杀图册的资料。
ff0693d7110213babd93bd90a5cf4338411b89cf.translatedText: Photography is not allowed during the visit. From time to time, pickets shoot flashlights to stop photographers. I turned off the flash, but still couldn't help but raise the camera, trying to capture the brutality of the invaders, the misery of my compatriots, and the resistance of the Chinese people into the lens. But my trembling hands couldn't control it. I took the most blurry series of photos since taking pictures, and many of them were unusable! As a result, when writing this article, I could only partially rely on the information from the Nanjing Massacre atlas.

00ed85a79e9c1fc1d0ff1af24b7b43d0e5b3318f.sourceText: 展厅没有讲解员，但有语音设备供使用。还有影视厅5个，16毫米摄影机在播放各类型的文献影视资料。令人感动的是，在南京大屠杀那些腥风血雨的日子里，我们的同胞守望相助、相互支持，众多国际友人也冒着风险，以各种方式保护南京民众，并记录下日本侵略者的残暴行径。他们中有德国人、丹麦人、美国人等，对他们的人道精神和无畏义举，中国人民永远不会忘记。
00ed85a79e9c1fc1d0ff1af24b7b43d0e5b3318f.translatedText: There are no guides in the exhibition hall, but there are voice devices for use. There are also 5 film and television halls, with 16mm cameras playing various types of documentary film and television materials. What is touching is that during the bloody days of the Nanjing Massacre, our compatriots helped and supported each other, and many international friends also took risks to protect the people of Nanjing in various ways and record the brutal acts of the Japanese invaders. Among them are Germans, Danes, Americans, etc. Their humanitarian spirit and fearless deeds will never be forgotten by the Chinese people.

dddedf41ee749e10e9cb4e44986fafe523c2a130.sourceText: 为抗击日本帝国主义的侵略，挽救中华民族的危亡，中国人民进行了14年的浴血抗战，1945年8月15日，日本被迫宣布无条件投降。同年9月9日,在南京举行中国战区投降典礼,抗日战争取得了历史性的伟大胜利。战后，远东国际军事法庭和南京审判战犯军事法庭，对南京大屠杀桉进行专桉审理，确认南京大屠杀是第二次世界大战史上一桩典型桉件；是国家贫弱人民遭殃的一段刻骨铭心的国耻和苦难记忆；是中华民族裸露的并值得子孙后代永久牢记遭受外敌侵略和奴役的一道历史伤痕。远东国际军事法庭和中国审判战犯军事法庭，对南京大屠杀惨桉进行调查并从法律上作出定性和定论，一批手上沾满中国人民鲜血的日本战犯受到了法律和正义的审判与严惩，被永远钉在了历史的耻辱柱上。
dddedf41ee749e10e9cb4e44986fafe523c2a130.translatedText: In order to fight against the aggression of Japanese imperialism and save the Chinese nation from danger, the Chinese people fought a bloody war of resistance for 14 years. On August 15, 1945, Japan was forced to announce its unconditional surrender. On September 9 of the same year, the surrender ceremony of the Chinese Theater was held in Nanjing, marking a great historic victory in the War of Resistance Against Japan. After the war, the International Military Tribunal for the Far East and the Military Tribunal for the Trial of War Criminals in Nanjing held special trials on the Nanjing Massacre, confirming that the Nanjing Massacre was a typical incident in the history of World War II; it was an unforgettable memory of national humiliation and suffering that the country's poor and weak people suffered; it was a historical scar exposed by the Chinese nation that should be permanently remembered by future generations as a result of foreign aggression and enslavement. The International Military Tribunal for the Far East and the China Military Tribunal for the Trial of War Criminals investigated the tragedy of the Nanjing Massacre and made legal characterizations and conclusions. A group of Japanese war criminals whose hands were stained with the blood of the Chinese people were tried and severely punished by law and justice, and were forever nailed to the pillar of shame in history.

606d6488c8cf9eccc18fdadaedd09a7937c2c086.sourceText: 在纪念馆中，我看到国、共两党共同抗战的史料。下图左是毛泽东领导的「游击战」。右图有三面旗帜，分别代表美国、英国和中华民国，我拍下这个镜头，并抄下旗帜下的那段声明：「三国之宗旨在剥夺日本自一九一四年第一次世界大战开始以后在太平洋所夺得或占领之一切岛屿，在使日本所窃取于中国之领二，例如满洲、台湾、澎湖列岛等，归还中国。 」 摘自《开罗宣言》1943 年12月1日
606d6488c8cf9eccc18fdadaedd09a7937c2c086.translatedText: In the memorial hall, I saw historical materials about the joint resistance of the Kuomintang and the Communist Party. The left picture below shows the "guerrilla warfare" led by Mao Zedong. There are three flags in the picture on the right, representing the United States, the United Kingdom and the Republic of China respectively. I took this shot and copied the statement under the flag: "The purpose of the Three Kingdoms is to deprive Japan of all the islands it has captured or occupied in the Pacific since the beginning of World War I in 1914, and to return to China the territories Japan stole from China, such as Manchuria, Taiwan, and the Penghu Islands." Excerpted from the Cairo Declaration 1943 December 1, 2019

c461b9b5282dee2a21f2b0ebfc24a1f4f2a12b15.translatedText: A small scolding helps a lot:

9b99efeb2b25f27eb776bd8e461030817c4dd5e7.sourceText: *日本是人类历史的一个民族，也给世界带来了贡献，也给世界带来了创伤，这是军国主义的错误，日本人民应该记住，日本政府更应该记住。
9b99efeb2b25f27eb776bd8e461030817c4dd5e7.translatedText: * Japan is a nation in human history. It has made contributions to the world and also brought trauma to the world. This is a mistake of militarism. The Japanese people should remember it, and the Japanese government should remember it even more.

e232bb23c780868cb39748bf5a6475cdb1ac7d91.sourceText: *把罪行归咎于自身民族软弱的：
e232bb23c780868cb39748bf5a6475cdb1ac7d91.translatedText: * Those who blame their crimes on the weakness of their own nation:

dbc8d9370d38e55c9cccc256c126232463a5b0b9.sourceText: 中国近代的苦难，是民族落后的结果，只要民族团结奋斗！定能走上民族复兴之路！
dbc8d9370d38e55c9cccc256c126232463a5b0b9.translatedText: China's modern sufferings are the result of national backwardness. As long as the nation unites and struggles! We will surely embark on the road to national rejuvenation!

588eea0db2d8d905df38f40231b40f291dca3d40.sourceText: *历史是一面镜子，我们每一个人都要尊重历史、牢记历史，每一个炎黄子孙都应众志成城，建设我们强大的祖国，决不能让历史的悲剧重演。
588eea0db2d8d905df38f40231b40f291dca3d40.translatedText: * History is a mirror. Each of us must respect history and remember history. Every descendant of Yan and Huang must unite as one to build our strong motherland and never allow historical tragedies to repeat themselves.

ec3a154fc28f8f64ba558fbc4d064d4eff5eb8cf.sourceText: *我们的民族太过善良，我们的民族太过健忘，我们的教育太过实用，以至于被屠杀的历史转瞬即忘，试问有几人知道国家公祭日？又有几人知道国家公祭网？军国主义者已在磨刀霍霍了，又有谁来唤醒国人？
ec3a154fc28f8f64ba558fbc4d064d4eff5eb8cf.translatedText: * Our nation is too kind, our nation is too forgetful, and our education is too practical, so that the history of massacre is forgotten in an instant. How many people know about the National Memorial Day? How many people know about the National Memorial Network? The militarists are already sharpening their knives. Who will wake up the Chinese people?

6be178d2df8402b8ce67c8f070a56098bdfb4e62.sourceText: *现在的学校都没有了清明到烈士陵园扫墓接受爱国义教育的活动，我们上学时，每年学校都会组织去烈士陵园扫墓，听当年烈士的事迹。从孩子抓起，让他们从小就有爱国的思想，我们现在安定的生活来之不易，我觉得学校应该在清明节组织学生在这个网站上公祭，而不是热衷于事故频发的春游秋游。
6be178d2df8402b8ce67c8f070a56098bdfb4e62.translatedText: * Nowadays, schools no longer have the activity of going to the martyrs’ cemetery to sweep the tombs during the Qingming Festival to receive patriotic education. When we were in school, every year the school would organize a trip to the martyrs’ cemetery to sweep the tombs and listen to the deeds of the martyrs. Start with the children and let them have patriotic thoughts from an early age. Our stable life is hard-won. I think the school should organize students to perform public sacrifices on this site during the Qingming Festival, instead of being keen on accident-prone spring outings and autumn outings.

d837caf171801e81791cc23d80726242044e6c83.sourceText: 但更多留言是疾恶如仇：
d837caf171801e81791cc23d80726242044e6c83.translatedText: But more of the messages were as hateful as hatred:

5f2f88213b5d407eeea3dd7e23f3314b7939b35c.sourceText: *对死难国人表示深切悼念，对抗日志士表示崇高敬意，对日本侵略者表示强烈愤慨，对目前小日本表示深切厌恶。现在打日本，我首先报名！
5f2f88213b5d407eeea3dd7e23f3314b7939b35c.translatedText: * Expressed deep condolences for the dead compatriots, high respect for the anti-Japanese comrades, strong indignation against the Japanese invaders, and deep disgust for the current small Japan. Now when we go to Japan, I will sign up first!

50fb8ae69bcd6320b44663b564fa514be4365b47.sourceText: * 日本鬼子至今没有低头认输的思想，而且还有卷土重来的意思，我觉得，现在正是把军国主义的思想扼杀在萌芽之中的时候，全面向日本开战，把这个一直靠侵略得到的国富民强的国家彻底的灭之。
50fb8ae69bcd6320b44663b564fa514be4365b47.translatedText: * The Japanese devils still have no intention of bowing their heads and admitting defeat, and they still have the intention of making a comeback. I feel that now is the time to nip the idea of ​​militarism in the bud, launch a full-scale war against Japan, and completely destroy this country that has been rich and powerful through aggression.

1b405730c157768afd35ead454b6ea0f0b891196.sourceText: * 历史不会因时代变迁而改变，事实也不会因巧舌抵赖而消失。南京大屠杀惨桉铁证如山、不容篡改。任何人要否认南京大屠杀惨桉这一事实，历史不会答应，30万无辜死难者的亡灵不会答应，13亿中国人民不会答应，世界上一切爱好和平与正义的人民都不会答应。
1b405730c157768afd35ead454b6ea0f0b891196.translatedText: * History will not change due to the changing times, and facts will not disappear due to clever denials. The tragic evidence of the Nanjing Massacre is irrefutable and cannot be tampered with. If anyone wants to deny the tragic fact of the Nanjing Massacre, history will not agree, the souls of the 300,000 innocent victims will not agree, the 1.3 billion Chinese people will not agree, and all peace- and justice-loving people in the world will not agree.

3116acf071ed7442c88abaadd92f04a81480731a.sourceText: * 那是一场惨绝人寰的大屠杀惨桉。30万人，30万人呐！那都是我们的父母、兄弟、姐妹呀，他们本可以在自己的家园里平静地生活，却无端遭此厄运。
3116acf071ed7442c88abaadd92f04a81480731a.translatedText: * It was a tragic massacre. 300,000 people, 300,000 people! Those are our parents, brothers, and sisters. They could have lived peacefully in their own homes, but they suffered this fate for no reason.

c0913db75eda13d3890cdadfc5bfaa5e413e3d38.sourceText: *所以必需要求日本侵略者作战争赔偿 ， 中国人要觉醒过来，中国人民要提出，日本人对南京大屠杀进行战争赔偿，也要求对中国的侵略进行战争赔偿。中国从现在开始，就是要讲究实际一点了，要求日本人去算算，到底欠我们中国多少血债，欠我们中国人多少条命！
c0913db75eda13d3890cdadfc5bfaa5e413e3d38.translatedText: * Therefore, we must demand war compensation from the Japanese invaders. The Chinese people must wake up and the Chinese people must propose that the Japanese pay war compensation for the Nanjing Massacre and also demand war compensation for China's aggression. From now on, China must be more practical and ask the Japanese to calculate how much blood debt they owe China and how many lives they owe us Chinese!

c1bc45a5da8ae5944f254b9268338d24665f0fa5.sourceText: 抗战老兵凝视”古城的灾难”
c1bc45a5da8ae5944f254b9268338d24665f0fa5.translatedText: Anti-Japanese War Veterans Stare at "The Disaster in the Ancient City"

785001b27ddec935838c88c6c67fe16ff8081b9a.sourceText: 出自对历史的尊重，在此我亦抄录一段对岸的”国军历史文物馆＂”有关”抗战胜利”的一段叙述： ”日本恃强凌弱，处心积虑侵略我国。甲午一战，迫使清廷割让台湾与澎湖列岛。民国20年「九一八事变」，强占我国东北，「七七事变」之后，先行「南京大屠杀」，继之「重庆大轰炸」，罪恶可谓罄竹难书。而日本战败投降，我领袖蒋中正委员长，却秉承中华民族至高至贵的德性，不但在开罗会议时，力主维护日本天皇政体，并在日本宣告投降时呼吁全国军民「不念旧恶」、「以德报怨」，除责成日本忠诚履行投降条款外，绝不冤冤相报。因此，蒋委员长于战后，不主张我国派兵占领日本，保持日本领土主权完整，主动放弃要求日本赔偿，并迅即于受降后遣送日侨、日俘回国，使其重整战后家园，迅速得以复兴。”
785001b27ddec935838c88c6c67fe16ff8081b9a.translatedText: Out of respect for history, here I also copy a narrative about the "Victory of the Anti-Japanese War" from the "National Army Historical Museum" on the other side: "Japan bullies the weak and deliberately invades our country. The First Sino-Japanese War forced the Qing government to cede Taiwan and the Penghu Islands. In the 20th year of the Republic of China, the "September 18th Incident" occupied Northeast my country. After the "July 7th Incident", the "Nanjing Massacre" was first followed by the "Chongqing Bombing". The crimes are countless. When Japan was defeated and surrendered, our leader, Chairman Chiang Kai-shek, upheld the supreme virtue of the Chinese nation. Not only did he advocate for the maintenance of Japan's emperor's political system at the Cairo Conference, but when Japan announced its surrender, he called on the military and civilians across the country to "not remember old evils" and "repay grievances with kindness." In addition to instructing Japan to faithfully fulfill the terms of surrender, it will never retaliate against grievances. Therefore, after the war, Chairman Chiang did not advocate that my country send troops to occupy Japan, maintain the integrity of Japan's territorial sovereignty, voluntarily gave up asking Japan for compensation, and promptly sent Japanese overseas Chinese and Japanese prisoners back to the country after the surrender, so that they could reorganize their post-war homes and quickly recover. "

5b81b6606547452abc99612b52ece3c3b99370e9.sourceText: 让我们再看看日本政府目前的态度： 日本内阁官房长官菅义伟在2014年2月26日上午举行的记者会上，就中国审议将南京大屠杀发生的每年12月13日设立为”国家公祭日”草桉一事表示：质疑中方的用意何在，对为何在战后69年才设立国家公祭日抱有疑问。 称”南京大屠杀”为”南京事件”，质疑死亡人数30万的说法，狡辩称死亡人数是无法查证的，变相否认”南京大屠杀”。
5b81b6606547452abc99612b52ece3c3b99370e9.translatedText: Let's take a look at the current attitude of the Japanese government: At a press conference held on the morning of February 26, 2014, Japan's Chief Cabinet Secretary Yoshihide Suga expressed doubts about China's draft decision to establish December 13th of each year as the "National Memorial Day" when the Nanjing Massacre occurred: He questioned China's intentions and had questions about why the National Memorial Day was only established 69 years after the war. Calling the "Nanjing Massacre" the "Nanjing Incident", questioning the statement that the death toll was 300,000, arguing that the death toll could not be verified, and denying the "Nanjing Massacre" in disguise.

fc04aec281b341c26bc77b6f1b377221c0b25367.sourceText: 德国人在二次大战战败后，所挣到的每一个马克都要按百分比去作战争赔偿，所以才有切肤之痛，德国总理在二战英灵纪念碑前下跪，才得到世人的原谅。反观日本悍然发动了侵华战争，给中国人民带来了前所未有的巨大灾难，中国付出了伤亡3500万人的沉重代价，中国城乡战火连绵、硝烟四起，人民生灵涂炭、苦难深重，中国大地赤地千里、饿殍遍野！但战后不要日本进行战争赔偿，造成了今天日本人不知悔改，狼子野心不死，日本首相带头参拜供奉二战甲级战犯亡灵的靖国神社，日本人不但在东海钓鱼岛滋事，还把飞机潜艇卖给东南亚国家在南海抵制中国。＂凤凰网＂报导：日本提供情报给美国人，一但冲突就先炸毁长江全线从上游至下游的十五座大桥，割断中国南北大动脉；日本不断军扩，＂出云号＂原是侵华时的一艘旗舰，在抗战中已被击沉，但现在日本又把一艘新的直昇机航空母舰冠名为＂出云号＂，并且已下水服役，由此可见日本军国主义还魂！另外，日本人也在年年大搞＂原爆纪念＂，美国总有一天也会让这条毒蛇再反咬一口！
fc04aec281b341c26bc77b6f1b377221c0b25367.translatedText: After the Germans were defeated in World War II, every mark they earned had to be paid as war compensation as a percentage, so it was very painful. The German Chancellor was a hero in World War II. Only by kneeling in front of the monument can I be forgiven by the world. On the other hand, Japan brazenly launched a war of aggression against China, which brought unprecedented disasters to the Chinese people. China paid a heavy price of 35 million casualties. The war in China's urban and rural areas continued, and the people were devastated and suffered a lot. However, after the war, Japan did not want to pay war compensation! Today, the Japanese are unrepentant and ambitious. The Japanese Prime Minister takes the lead in visiting the Yasukuni Shrine, which honors the souls of Class-A war criminals in World War II. The Japanese not only cause trouble on the Diaoyu Islands in the East China Sea, but also sell aircraft and submarines to Southeast Asian countries to resist China in the South China Sea. "Phoenix.com" reported: Japan provides intelligence to the Americans. In the event of a conflict, it will first blow up fifteen bridges along the Yangtze River from the upstream to the downstream, cutting off China. The north-south artery; Japan continues to expand its military. The "Izumo" was originally a flagship during the invasion of China and was sunk during the Anti-Japanese War. But now Japan has named a new helicopter carrier "Izumo" and has been put into service. This shows that Japanese militarism is back! In addition, the Japanese are also carrying out "atomic bomb commemorations" every year. The United States will one day let this poisonous snake bite again!

32a6796eb0d349cf8a6f28e4a50e9eb0ac235982.sourceText: 疑今者察之古；不知来者视之往！有人提出可以放下仇恨，有人提出可以宽恕。 但这里没说前提，没有申张正议，让国人放松警惕！中国人要保持压力，要追讨战争赔偿， 要日本人对侵略战争作彻底的忏悔！没有这个前提，任何放下和宽恕都将助长日本军国主义的嚣张气焰！
32a6796eb0d349cf8a6f28e4a50e9eb0ac235982.translatedText: Those who doubt the present look at the past; those who do not know what is coming look at the past! Some people suggested letting go of hatred, while others suggested forgiveness. But there is no premise mentioned here, no serious argument made, so the Chinese people can relax their vigilance! The Chinese must keep up the pressure, demand war compensation, and demand the Japanese to fully repent for their war of aggression! Without this premise, any letting go and forgiveness will only encourage the arrogance of Japanese militarism!

bc99e21137396e200c9e65f6b4d8ab9128dc9ab2.sourceText: 当我们从纪念馆出来，外面下着倾盆大雨。苍天在为九一八哭泣，在为南京惨死在日冦屠刀下的卅万冤魂悲恸！
bc99e21137396e200c9e65f6b4d8ab9128dc9ab2.translatedText: When we came out of the memorial hall, it was pouring rain outside. The sky is weeping for September 18th, mourning for the 300,000 innocent souls who died tragically at the hands of Japanese butchers in Nanjing!

6ad48ceb536950515b3a38aecf187a9dd651a7ee.sourceText: 为欢庆2015年美国独立日，大凤凰城侨联将继续举办青少年绘画比赛活动。今年正值反法西斯战争胜利暨中国抗日战争胜利七十週年，为了铭记历史、缅怀先烈、维护世界和平，今年绘画比赛将围绕这一主题自选题目。
6ad48ceb536950515b3a38aecf187a9dd651a7ee.translatedText: To celebrate the 2015 American Independence Day, the Overseas Chinese Federation of the Greater Phoenix City will continue to hold youth painting competitions. This year marks the 70th anniversary of the victory of the Anti-Fascist War and the Chinese Anti-Japanese War. In order to remember history, honor the martyrs, and maintain world peace, this year’s painting competition will have a self-selected topic based on this theme.

6014dffa28afcf5824b5ae167bcf2b0b218aceed.sourceText: 报名时间：即日起到五月十日 报名方法：参赛者请网上报名，Email发送到qiaolianarts@gmail.com信箱。请注明姓名、年龄、选择参赛日期和地点及老师姓名。也可以通过学校、画室集体报名。
6014dffa28afcf5824b5ae167bcf2b0b218aceed.translatedText: Registration time: from now to May 10th Registration method: Participants please register online and send email to qiaolianarts@gmail.com. Please indicate your name, age, date and place you choose to participate, and teacher’s name. You can also register collectively through schools and studios.

68554f57531838da4585eba21249ce18460162e6.sourceText: 绘画分四个年龄组： 幼儿组6岁以下 少年组 7-9岁 青少年组 10-13岁 青年组 14-17岁
68554f57531838da4585eba21249ce18460162e6.translatedText: Painting is divided into four age groups: Toddler group under 6 years old Youth group 7-9 years old Youth group 10-13 years old Youth group 14-17 years old

c2f35e415f27804610aee0e9356cc82fe0d24f04.sourceText: 比赛方法：绘画比赛採用统一时间、地点现场作画的方式. 参赛者可在赛前根据自选题目完成构思和草样。绘画採用11＂X14＂的统一画纸，由侨联统一提供。绘画工具由参赛者自备。可选择铅笔画、水彩画和油画等多种形式。
c2f35e415f27804610aee0e9356cc82fe0d24f04.translatedText: Competition method: The painting competition adopts the method of on-site painting at the same time and place. Contestants can complete ideas and drafts based on self-selected topics before the competition. The drawings are made on 11"X14" unified drawing paper, which is provided by the Federation of Overseas Chinese. Drawing tools must be prepared by the contestants themselves. Choose from pencil drawings, watercolors and oil paintings.

4281a3ace2593354b6ea786b5195e5421a1242ac.sourceText: 比赛日期和时间：五月十二日（星期日）下午一时至四时。地点：新东方艺术学校 五月十九日（星期日）下午一时至四时。 地点：亚省艺术学校 参赛者可根据自己的时间选择比赛日期和地点，欢迎家长和老师陪同和指导。
4281a3ace2593354b6ea786b5195e5421a1242ac.translatedText: Contest date and time: May 12 (Sunday) from 1:00 pm to 4:00 pm. Venue: New Oriental Art School, May 19 (Sunday), 1:00 pm to 4:00 pm. Venue: Alberta Art School. Participants can choose the date and location of the competition according to their own time. Parents and teachers are welcome to accompany and provide guidance.

680c0f4f4b4ef741ba003fa2c6331dbe91b4502b.sourceText: 评比与奖励：由侨联聘请专业人士五人组成评审小组，每组评出三名优胜奨和若干名杰出奨。在七月四庆祝美国国庆盛典上授予奨品和証书。得奖作品在侨联国庆专刋上刊登。
680c0f4f4b4ef741ba003fa2c6331dbe91b4502b.translatedText: Evaluation and awards: The Overseas Chinese Federation hires a five-person review panel composed of professionals, and each group selects three winners and several outstanding students. Medals and certificates awarded during the Fourth of July celebration of the Fourth of July. The winning works were published in the National Day Special Issue of the Federation of Overseas Chinese.

f0c2ed109796adf0a4e6bf5150171a462e5e5436.sourceText: 2015年1月17日，凤凰城龙冈亲义公所召开年度选举会议。上任主席刘全知总结了过去的一年的成绩，龙冈公所在全体职员努力下，取得了有目共睹的成绩，大家对刘主席刘的领导工作，一致鼓掌赞扬。这次会议选出了以关宗任主席为首的2015年度新班子。关宗任世长服务龙冈公所四十年，从来都是出钱出力，任劳任怨。他作风低调但坚持原则，他关心侨社和龙冈族务而不遗馀力，经常慷慨解囊给龙冈宗亲活动和侨社各类善事，积极支持凤凰城举办美洲龙冈2016 年恳亲大会，并带头捐赠一万元。关宗任世长自凤凰城龙冈公所创会以来不争名利，今次答应出任主席，实在是老骥伏枥可喜可嘉！凤凰城龙冈成员一致赞成并集名登报志贺。相信在关主席的领导下，全体龙冈职员团结一致，齐心协力，共同做好2015年度工作和2016年美洲龙冈第21届恳亲大会筹备会的工作。(张肇鸿报导) 2015年度凤凰城龙冈亲义公所职员表： 主席：关宗任 副主席：刘沃彪 张华芳 财政: 刘邓婉仪 英文书记: 刘汝璋 中文书记: 张万波 核数: 关兆锋 会务、网站：张肇鸿 公关: 刘邓情芬 顾问: 刘全知 关鍚樵 关嬿仪 关昆容 职员：刘丽华 赵新卓
f0c2ed109796adf0a4e6bf5150171a462e5e5436.translatedText: On January 17, 2015, Phoenix Longgang Qinyi Office held its annual election meeting. The incoming chairman Liu Quanzhi summarized the achievements of the past year. With the efforts of all staff, Longgang Office has achieved results that are obvious to all. Everyone unanimously applauded and praised Chairman Liu's leadership work. At this meeting, a new team for 2015 headed by Guan Zongren was elected. Guan Zong served in the Longgang Office for forty years, always contributing money and effort, working hard and never complaining. He has a low-key style but adheres to principles. He cares about the affairs of the overseas Chinese community and the Longgang clan and spares no effort. He often donates generously to Longgang clan activities and various charity activities of the overseas Chinese community. He actively supports Phoenix City in hosting the 2016 American Longgang Friendship Conference and takes the lead in donating 10,000 yuan. Mr. Guan Zongren has not striven for fame and wealth since the establishment of Longgang Office in Phoenix City. It is really gratifying for him to agree to serve as chairman this time! The members of Phoenix City Long Gang unanimously approved and registered their names in the newspaper Shiga. I believe that under the leadership of Chairman Guan, all Longgang employees will unite and work together to do a good job in 2015 and the preparatory meeting for the 21st Longgang Americas Conference in 2016. (Reported by Zhang Zhaohong) Staff list of Phoenix Longgang Qinyi Office in 2015: Chairman: Guan Zongren Vice Chairman: Liu Wobiao Zhang Huafang Finance: Liu Dengwanyi English secretary: Liu Ruzhang Chinese secretary: Zhang Wanbo Auditor: Guan Zhaofeng Conference and website: Zhang Zhaohong Public relations: Liu Dengqingfen Consultants: Liu Quanzhi Guan Xiqiao Guan Yanyi Guan Kunrong Staff: Liu Lihua Zhao Xinzhuo

ef8dc94c32a2a3e2d31adb902a5a4e005991ad6c.translatedText: Although a food festival that provides a variety of food tastings is still a new activity for many friends, the Scottsdale Culinary Festival already has a long history of 37 years.

f2b158d954d05e42ba1b58a949b78bd2629e627e.sourceText: 作为全美举历史最悠久的美食节，从1978年创办以来，Scottsdale Culinary Festival就坚持为来宾提供最精致最新鲜美食试吃，最赞的现场音乐和活动。至今，它已经跃居全美顶级的美食节榜单，成为不容置疑的吃货最青睐的盛会之一。
f2b158d954d05e42ba1b58a949b78bd2629e627e.translatedText: As the oldest food festival in the United States, since its inception in 1978, the Scottsdale Culinary Festival has insisted on providing guests with the most exquisite and fresh food tastings, the best live music and activities. So far, it has ranked among the top food festivals in the United States and has become one of the most popular events for foodies.

b0c2110211d08b3487665d2fe472693bdc74273d.sourceText: 从4月7日至12日，美食节共有20多场试吃活动，届时，会有亚利桑那当地乃至全国的顶级大厨到场献技，为你带来非同反响的美食体验。满足口福之余，超赞的颁奖晚宴、鸡尾酒会、烹饪展示等等精彩活动也同样值得期待。
b0c2110211d08b3487665d2fe472693bdc74273d.translatedText: From April 7th to 12th, the food festival has more than 20 tasting activities. At that time, top chefs from Arizona and even the country will be present to perform their skills, bringing you an extraordinary food experience. In addition to satisfying your taste buds, exciting events such as awards dinners, cocktail parties, cooking demonstrations, etc. are also worth looking forward to.

2b1943221e9f4dc9a1e3fdb59c1606eda61c11b7.sourceText: 面对眼花缭乱的活动安排，选哪一家出席不禁成为难题。是选择225美金／人高价的Friends of James Beard Dinner gala，与精致餐点尽情缠绵？还是现身40美金／人的Southwest Festival of Beers，抓住这同时畅饮200种特酿啤酒的好机会？
2b1943221e9f4dc9a1e3fdb59c1606eda61c11b7.translatedText: Faced with a dazzling array of activities, choosing which one to attend can’t help but be a difficult problem. Should you choose the Friends of James Beard Dinner gala at a high price of US$225 per person and indulge in exquisite meals? Or show up to the $40/person Southwest Festival of Beers and seize the opportunity to drink 200 kinds of specialty beers at the same time?

612d2502f85d35d2711a9ae5af9de5e637633950.sourceText: 相信这里没有什么不佳的选择，但有?#26368;适合你的选择?#12290;今天就为朋友们送来贴心推荐和细致介绍，助你找到?#30495;爱?#21734;。
612d2502f85d35d2711a9ae5af9de5e637633950.translatedText: I believe there are no bad choices here, but there are options that are suitable for you. Today I will send you thoughtful recommendations and detailed introductions to my friends to help you find love.

fb27289b229acb1c295f093e3ffb96a16f72e834.sourceText: 丰富内容: 优惠多多的全票中包括Great Arizona Picnic的入场券，以及给酒迷们倾情呈现的Southwest Festival of Beers, the SKYY Vodka Tent, the North American Spirit Tour和大师级别的鸡尾酒调酒展示等等。
fb27289b229acb1c295f093e3ffb96a16f72e834.translatedText: Rich content: The full ticket with great discounts includes admission to the Great Arizona Picnic, as well as the Southwest Festival of Beers, the SKYY Vodka Tent, the North American Spirit Tour and a master-level cocktail mixology demonstration presented to wine fans.

a8985b5580b20e97f55b717ff4060058c25a425b.translatedText: He Fengchen: 9-day tour of the North and South Islands of New Zealand in 2014 (1) Phoenix He Fengchen had heard about New Zealand more than once before we started this trip...

2de673ba80094dd113fe04c6a2444d98805bba9d.sourceText: 在我们开 始这次旅游前已不止一次的听说新西兰的美丽，当我们踏上这片土地后才真正的信服新西兰真是上帝在这个世界上留下的最后一块净土。这里没有污染，空气是那么的清新，蓝色的湖泊，白色的雪山，绿色的草地，满山遍野在那安安静静吃草没有天敌的牛羊，真可谓是人间天堂啊。 11月8日 悉尼-奥克兰 (Sydney-Auckland) 11月8日我们从悉尼飞到新西兰的首都Auckland。在飞机落地之前从飞机的舷窗往外眺望可看到整个城市是处在蜿蜒曲折的海岸线上。同学赵敬平来机场接我们，在去他家的路上他把我们带到他家以前所住的Half Moon Bay，在海边欣赏了海景和对面的火山岛。整个海湾星星点点布满了帆船，真不亏”千帆之都”的美称。据说在Auckland凡是有点钱的人都拥有船，玩船是大部分Auckland人的爱好。赵敬平把我们带到离家不远的一家中国餐馆晚餐，点了当地有名的龙虾和海鲜。菜做得很地道，想不到这里竟有这么好的中国餐馆。 奥克兰海湾的帆船 奥克兰的Half Moon Bay 11月9日 奥克兰市内游 (Auckland) 早晨
2de673ba80094dd113fe04c6a2444d98805bba9d.translatedText: Before we started Before starting this trip, we had heard about the beauty of New Zealand more than once. It was only when we set foot on this land that we were truly convinced that New Zealand was really the last piece of pure land left by God in the world. There is no pollution here, the air is so fresh, the blue lakes, white snow-capped mountains, green grasslands, and the cows and sheep grazing peacefully without natural predators all over the mountains and fields are really a paradise on earth. November 8th Sydney-Auckland (Sydney-Auckland) On November 8th we flew from Sydney to Auckland, the capital of New Zealand. Before the plane landed, looking out the window of the plane, you could see that the entire city was on the winding coastline. Our classmate Zhao Jingping came to pick us up at the airport. On the way to his home, he took us to Half Moon Bay, where his family used to live, where we enjoyed the sea view and the volcanic island opposite. The entire bay is dotted with sailboats, which really deserves the reputation of the "City of Thousand Sails". It is said that everyone in Auckland who has some money owns a boat, and boating is a hobby of most Auckland people. Zhao Jingping took us to a Chinese restaurant not far from home for dinner, and ordered the famous local lobster and seafood. The food is very authentic. I never expected there to be such a good Chinese restaurant here. Sailing boat in Auckland Bay Half Moon Bay in Auckland November 9th Auckland City Tour (Auckland) Morning

3fc4178528bdd55350713ea950f4cff53a5bcd2c.translatedText: [Alberta Special Issue on the 70th Anniversary of the Anti-Fascist Victory]: National Spirit

c83ffdcf2be8cfab545d8846c6626f23f1498d5c.sourceText: 【反法西斯胜利70周年亚省特刊】：民族精神 凤凰笔会 崔增祁 抗日战争时期，我还是个孩子，但是那团结抗日的…
c83ffdcf2be8cfab545d8846c6626f23f1498d5c.translatedText: [Alberta Special Issue on the 70th Anniversary of the Anti-Fascist Victory]: National Spirit Phoenix PEN Club Cui Zengqi During the Anti-Japanese War, I was still a child, but those who united against Japan...

6364b9cd48415bc7d0c076fed06b2053d869cb84.sourceText: 抗日战争时期，我还是个孩子，但是那团结抗日的民族精神深深地影响到我和我们这一代人，以至影响着我整个人生。 在日寇侵略，中国人民横遭生灵涂炭的苦难曰子里，我们历尽艰辛，从上海逃难来到昆明。我父亲通过资源委员会的朋友，在明良煤矿找到一份工作，我们就在离昆明几十里路的山区小村住了下来。那是一个只有二十户人家左右的小村名字叫宰格。为了开发煤矿，一下子新搬来了二十多户人家，有来自江苏、浙江、山东、安徽、上海的，还有来自陝西、河北的。这些来自各地、语言生活都不相同的陌生人聚在一起，大家就像好朋友一样，马上在村子附近动手搭起了棚子,用山上砍下的树枝和泥土搭建了一个像古代城堡似的一片住房。这片住房背面靠山,东边有一座高大的门，是唯一出口，四面都用树枝编成的篱笆围护着。居民们在围栏内办了一个合作社，成立了一个缝纫组，还建了一个老虎灶，每天给各家供应开水和热水。生活中难免有摩擦，但在共同抗日这个大气氛下，人们生活得很和谐，到处呈现出一种相互帮助相互关怀的景象。一次，一架美国飞机跌落在附近的农田里，全村男女老少都奔去救助，把伤员抬到家里养伤，各家都送来了营养食品,像对待家人一样。大家都知道这是同盟军，是美国朋友。我长大以后才知道那就是陈纳德将军领导的帮助中国人抗战的美国飞虎队队员。 生活安定以后，在村旁还办起了一所小学校，名为明良煤矿职工子弟小学，我的启䝉教育就是得益于此地。学校许多老师都是员工兼职，我记忆最深是外地请来的一位音乐老师，他姓刘，他教我们唱的都是抗日歌曲。所以从小我就会唱义勇军进行曲、黄水謡、流亡三部曲和毕业歌等许多抗日歌曲。”起来，不愿做奴隶的人们”唤起了我对祖国肩负的觉醒。”我们今天桃李芬芳，明天是社会的栋梁”我们今天欢聚在一堂，明天要掀起民族解放的巨浪，担负起天下的兴亡。’使我己经把自己的命运和祖国的未来紧紧地联繫在一起。在那段日子里，职工们还组织了京剧社，搭起了一个大篷作剧场，搭起舞台演京剧四郎探母、正气歌、苏武牧羊等历史上抵御外侵的剧目。还曾举行过支援前方将士的捐献活动。在这样一个小社会里，生活条件十分艰苦，人们却生活得十分和谐，抗击日寇的气氛却十分浓厚。在那颠沛流离的年代，大人们也无心生育，我们几个孩子就成了公共的儿子和女儿，走到那里都招人喜爱，给人们带来欢笑。有人说我是吃百家饭长大的，这对我一生性格的形成有着重要的影响。 我十分怀念那个年代，在我离开这个埧子四十週年和六十五年以后，我曾两次返回那的村庒。第一次回去我还见到我们原来的住房。一位小时的同学、现在是煤矿工人，他住在当时矿长住的房子里，我低下头来才能走进了那间低矮潮湿的小屋。我真难以想像当时人们在这样的环境下怎麽还能乐观地生活了将近八年。我想那是一种民族精神，伟大的中华民族精神。那时外国人説我们是’东亚病夫”一盘散砂’， 当敌寇强佔我国土、杀戳我同胞，国家民族存亡的关头，中国人站起来了，团结一心，以各自的行动抗御外敌的入侵，靠的就是这股民族精神。我们虽然没有见过一个日本鬼子，也没有发过一枪一弹，但那个小村里的人们，生活中充满了这股民族精神，全民抵御日寇入侵的精神。我认为这正是取得二战胜利的重要保障。在纪念二战胜利七十週年的今天，缅怀往事，展望中国强国之梦，我们决不可忘却那被人鄙视和凌辱的历史，决不可失却我们的民族精神—我们民族生存之魂。民族精神万岁！
6364b9cd48415bc7d0c076fed06b2053d869cb84.translatedText: During the Anti-Japanese War, I was still a child, but the national spirit of unity and resistance against Japan deeply affected me and our generation, and even affected my entire life. During the days when the Japanese invaded and the Chinese people suffered a great loss of life, we went through many hardships and fled from Shanghai to Kunming. My father found a job in Mingliang Coal Mine through friends in the Resource Committee, and we settled in a small mountain village dozens of miles away from Kunming. It was a small village named Zaige with only about twenty households. In order to develop the coal mine, more than 20 new families moved in, including from Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Shandong, Anhui, Shanghai, as well as from Shaanxi and Hebei. These strangers who came from different places and spoke different languages ​​and lives came together. They were like good friends. They immediately set up a shed near the village, using branches and soil cut from the mountain to build a house like an ancient castle. This house is backed by a mountain. There is a tall gate on the east side, which is the only exit. It is surrounded by fences made of branches. The residents set up a cooperative within the fence, established a sewing group, and built a tiger stove to supply boiling and hot water to each household every day. Friction is inevitable in life, but in the general atmosphere of joint resistance against Japan, people live in harmony, showing a scene of mutual help and care everywhere. Once, an American plane crashed into a nearby farmland. The whole village, men, women and children, rushed to the rescue and carried the injured home to recover. Every family sent nutritious food and treated the injured like family members. Everyone knows that this is the Allied Forces and a friend of the United States. It was only after I grew up that I learned that they were members of the American Flying Tigers led by General Chennault who helped the Chinese in the war. After my life became stable, a primary school was opened next to the village, named Mingliang Coal Mine Workers' Children Primary School. My early education benefited from this place. Many teachers in the school are part-time employees. What I remember most is a music teacher invited from other places. His surname was Liu. He taught us anti-Japanese songs. So since I was a child, I would sing many anti-Japanese songs such as March of the Volunteers, Huang Shuijian, Trilogy in Exile, and Graduation Song. "Rise up, people who do not want to be slaves" aroused my awareness of the responsibility of the motherland. "Today we are fragrant with peaches and plums, and tomorrow we will be the pillars of society." We gather together today, and tomorrow we will set off a huge wave of national liberation and bear the responsibility for the rise and fall of the world. ’ I have closely linked my destiny with the future of my motherland. During those days, the employees also organized a Peking Opera club, set up a large tent as a theater, and set up a stage to perform Peking opera plays such as Shi Lang Visiting His Mother, Zhengqi Song, and Su Wu Shepherding the Sheep, which were historically used to resist foreign invasion. Donation activities have also been held to support soldiers on the front lines. In such a small society, living conditions are very difficult, but people live in harmony, and the atmosphere of fighting against the Japanese invaders is very strong. In that era of upheaval and displacement, adults had no intention of having children, so we children became the sons and daughters of the public, attracting people's love and bringing laughter to everyone wherever we went. Some people say that I grew up eating hundreds of meals, which had an important impact on the formation of my life-long personality. I miss that era very much. I returned to the village twice on the 40th and 65th anniversary of my leaving this village. The first time I went back, I saw our original house. A classmate who was a child when I was a child is now a coal miner. He lived in the house where the mine director lived at that time. I lowered my head to enter the low and damp hut. I really can't imagine how people could live optimistically for nearly eight years in such an environment. I think that is a kind of national spirit, the great Chinese national spirit. At that time, foreigners said that we were the ‘sick men of East Asia’ and a plate of loose sand. When the enemy invaded our land and killed our compatriots, at the critical moment of the survival of the country and the nation, the Chinese people stood up, united as one, and resisted the invasion of foreign enemies with their own actions. It was this national spirit that relied on us. Although we have never seen a Japanese devil or fired a single shot, the lives of the people in that small village are full of this national spirit. God, the spirit of the whole people to resist the Japanese invasion. I think this is an important guarantee for the victory of World War II. Today, as we commemorate the 70th anniversary of the victory of World War II, we must not forget the history of being despised and humiliated, and we must not lose our national spirit-the soul of our national survival!
