c1f3505c6db006c593d18a437d88e6e7f328fcb3.sourceText: 亚省鸭邮绘画比赛华裔学生成绩斐然，一举斩获前三名95% 2015年亚省Junior duck 中小学生鸭油…
c1f3505c6db006c593d18a437d88e6e7f328fcb3.translatedText: Chinese students in the Alberta Duck Painting Competition achieved outstanding results, winning 95% of the top three places in the 2015 Alberta Junior Duck Duck Oil for Primary and Secondary School Students...

d4d990f7a20f7a52839065d3e640fbebb76d55c9.sourceText: 2015年亚省Junior duck 中小学生鸭油绘画颁奖典礼于4月4日(周六)在凤凰城举行。华裔学生在比赛中成绩斐然，一举斩获所有奖项前三名的95%。其中中小学组的前三名更是被华裔学生所统揽，这充分说明了华裔家庭在对鸭邮比赛的高度重视与不懈努力下，已掌握了鸭邮比赛的制胜法宝。如今，亚省的鸭邮比赛已经完全被华裔学生征服和垄断。
d4d990f7a20f7a52839065d3e640fbebb76d55c9.translatedText: 2015 Alberta Junior Duck The duck oil painting award ceremony for primary and secondary school students was held on April 4 (Saturday) in Phoenix. Chinese students performed very well in the competition, winning 95% of the top three places in all awards. Among them, the top three places in the primary and secondary school groups are dominated by Chinese students. This fully demonstrates that Chinese families have mastered the magic weapon of winning the duck mail competition through their great attention to the duck mail competition and their unremitting efforts. Today, the duck mail competition in Alberta has been completely conquered and monopolized by Chinese students.

d6b4c7bfd989866db03465d1c2d1acfc24dff7da.sourceText: 亚省华裔孩子积极投入鸭邮比赛的热情，感染了正在林峰艺术工作室学习绘画的几位孩子和家长。今年初，有几位孩子要求参加比赛。
d6b4c7bfd989866db03465d1c2d1acfc24dff7da.translatedText: The enthusiasm of Chinese children in Alberta to actively participate in the duck mail competition has infected several children and parents who are learning painting in Lin Feng Art Studio. Earlier this year, several kids asked to compete.

41984ce505eb41f6f8cf466ab84b1b7c1a0e6385.sourceText: 从该项比赛的历年全美获奖作品来看，鸭邮比赛是一种极为精美的现实主义写真绘画竞赛，以北美各种罕见、甚至濒临绝境的鸭子为主题，让观赏者切身感受稀有鸭子的千姿百态，丰富的色彩以及复杂精细的羽毛造型。由于小学孩子的绘画水平还处于儿童画阶段，那么这样的绘画要求已然超出了他们应有的绘画观察和表现能力，极巨写实的鸭子绘画，对他们来说有很大的难度。细想之下，林峰画家只能为两位已经学习了几年绘画的小学生选择了色彩单一、造型简单的鸭子，通过简单的用色和简洁的线条勾画来指导教学，使她们在一到两次课程内轻松有趣地完成参赛作品，并进一步提升绘画技巧。
41984ce505eb41f6f8cf466ab84b1b7c1a0e6385.translatedText: Judging from the competition’s award-winning works across the United States over the years, the Duck Mail Competition is an extremely exquisite realism painting competition, with various rare and even endangered ducks in North America as the theme, allowing viewers to personally experience the various poses, rich colors and complex and delicate feather shapes of rare ducks. Since the painting level of primary school children is still in the stage of children's painting, such painting requirements have exceeded their painting observation and expression abilities. The extremely realistic duck painting is very difficult for them. After careful consideration, Painter Lin Feng could only choose ducks with single colors and simple shapes for the two primary school students who had been studying painting for several years. He guided the teaching through simple use of colors and concise line drawings, so that they could easily and interestingly complete the entries in one or two classes, and further improve their painting skills.

8f705a26b11db599b167697b968312c051fe0d9a.sourceText: Group 1, 第一名， Alisa Bai, 8岁
8f705a26b11db599b167697b968312c051fe0d9a.translatedText: Group 1, first place, Alisa Bai, 8 years old

29d4c313935389bea6fc8ac4251de66891c88fa4.sourceText: Group 1. 第二名， Charisse Qin, 8岁
29d4c313935389bea6fc8ac4251de66891c88fa4.translatedText: Group 1. Second place, Charisse Qin, 8 years old

121bb36e5a713f2f9ef4c598eb2ad395ef171fde.sourceText: Group 2 第二名 Alyssa Wong, 10岁
121bb36e5a713f2f9ef4c598eb2ad395ef171fde.translatedText: Group 2 second place, Alyssa Wong, 10 years old

c24a5ec95c26361861421ec576d9ffab7c33d288.sourceText: 对于初中生安雅、高中生艾咪以及仍在小学就读的美达三位同学，林峰画家则要求孩子们自己去做Research, 让他们自选喜爱、了解的鸭子进行创作，林峰着重在绘画的方法和技巧上给予指导。面对离截稿日只有一个多月的时间，林峰画家结合三位同学所选的鸭子主题，在作品形象勾勒、细节描绘和色彩应用上针对性教学，使三位孩子仅在四五节课程内尽其所能，完成参赛创作。 Group 3 佳作奖， 安雅, 13 岁
c24a5ec95c26361861421ec576d9ffab7c33d288.translatedText: For the three classmates An Ya, a junior high school student, Amy, a high school student, and Meida, who is still in elementary school, painter Lin Feng asked the children to do research on their own and let them choose the ducks they like and know about to create. Lin Feng focused on providing guidance on painting methods and techniques. Faced with only more than a month before the deadline, Painter Lin Feng combined the duck theme chosen by the three students and provided targeted teaching on the image outline, detail description and color application of the work, so that the three children could do their best to complete the competition creation in only four or five classes. Group 3 Excellence Award, Anya, 13 years old

b06b44b9d1102403277c55f2935ac5dfd497e528.sourceText: 曾在全美2014年度纪念宪法绘画比赛（Constitution)和全美野生动物绘画比赛(Wildlife ）两个大赛中，获得高中组第一名的艾咪同学，此次参赛选择了Canvasback作为创作主题。林峰画家以全美Junior Duck比赛获奖的最高水准要求对其指导。最后，在艾咪同学作品中，Canvasback在湖水中悠闲自得，湖面层层碧波荡漾，动静相宜，回头嘬着翅膀的Canvasback神态怡然，洁白的羽毛沐浴在夕阳余辉下丝丝缕缕。细节雕琢精美，色彩丰富，是一幅极为精致优美的鸭邮作品。虽然这幅作品在此次鸭邮比赛中仅获得州的佳作奖，但依旧足见艾咪同学扎实的绘画实力。
b06b44b9d1102403277c55f2935ac5dfd497e528.translatedText: Amy, who won first place in the high school group in the 2014 National Constitution Painting Competition (Constitution) and the National Wildlife Painting Competition (Wildlife), chose Canvasback as her creative theme for this competition. Painter Lin Feng requested his guidance at the highest level of winning the National Junior Duck Competition. Finally, in Amy's work, Canvasback is leisurely and contented in the lake. The surface of the lake is rippling with blue waves, and the movement and stillness are harmonious. The Canvasback looks back and licks its wings with a happy expression, and its white feathers are bathed in the afterglow of the sunset. The details are exquisitely carved and the colors are rich. It is an extremely delicate and beautiful duck stamp work. Although this work only won the state's best work award in this duck mail competition, it still shows Amy's solid painting ability.

593b3115ade6aa3c6f76155ce353b2607df343c3.sourceText: Group 4, 佳作奖， 艾咪， 16 岁
593b3115ade6aa3c6f76155ce353b2607df343c3.translatedText: Group 4, Excellence Award, Amy, 16 years old

dbe67bf2f0978b9d44ca516d83cb1b4a348cf3eb.sourceText: 与此同时，屡在全美和亚省众多绘画比赛中获奖的12岁美达同学，首次参加鸭邮绘画比赛。虽然在此次比赛中她没能获得奖项，但其作品画面构思灵巧，色彩优美，羽毛线条勾勒精美，富有童趣，也展现了美达同学的想象力和绘画能力。
dbe67bf2f0978b9d44ca516d83cb1b4a348cf3eb.translatedText: At the same time, 12-year-old Meda, who has repeatedly won prizes in many painting competitions across the United States and Alberta, participated in the Duck Post Painting Competition for the first time. Although she failed to win an award in this competition, her work was deftly conceived, with beautiful colors, exquisite feather lines and childlike interest. It also demonstrated Meda's imagination and painting ability.

e396ad85625c1a8afa6de6b32b20a124c5a103a8.sourceText: Group 2, 美达， 12岁， 参赛作品

a07b7c76faa4ebaea4674622a1d624e6d1fc55d3.sourceText: 亚省鸭邮绘画所设置的奖数是所有绘画赛事中最多的比赛，今年获奖人数高达87名，其中前三名共计36名，佳作奖为51名。如今，该比赛俨然成为以华裔学生为主流的画鸭竞赛。虽然画鸭是一种培养学生耐心、提高绘画技能的一种途径和方法，但是许多家长和教师则对此另有看法。
a07b7c76faa4ebaea4674622a1d624e6d1fc55d3.translatedText: The number of prizes set up by the Alberta Duck Painting Competition is the largest among all painting competitions. This year, the number of winners is as high as 87, including a total of 36 top three winners and 51 outstanding works awards. Today, the competition has become a duck drawing competition dominated by Chinese students. Although drawing ducks is a way and method to cultivate students' patience and improve drawing skills, many parents and teachers have other opinions.

6aee5a206f8cfaca41656efa5057082f12c79678.sourceText: 带着鸭邮的梦想，华裔孩子们在这幅长卷中年年孜孜不倦地追求。在此，我们衷心祝愿，热爱鸭邮绘画的华裔孩子们，明年再创辉煌。
6aee5a206f8cfaca41656efa5057082f12c79678.translatedText: With the dream of duck mail, Chinese children pursue it tirelessly year after year in this long scroll. Here, we sincerely wish that the Chinese children who love duck stamp paintings will achieve greater success next year.

107c10f17c3384f2491f7c4d2d2526225aac6384.sourceText: 中国驻洛杉矶总领事馆证件组将于今年４月4日、5日来凤凰城换发护照 （亚省华联UCAA供稿） 快讯：为方便广大侨胞，中国驻洛杉矶总领事馆证件组将于今年４月4日 、5日来凤凰城为侨胞现场受理中国护照换发和补发的申请（不办理前往中国的签证）。亚省华联 受中国驻洛杉矶总领事馆的委托，将和大凤凰城侨团联合总会共同协助办理中国护照换发和补发 及委托公证、健在公证等申请。 具体安排如下： 时间：4月4日（周六）上午9:00-下午15:00，4月5日（周日）上午9:00-中午12:00 地点：中国文化中心Chinese Cultural Center（欣欣超市旁） 668 N 44th St, Suite M08, Phoenix, AZ 85008 联系人：亚省华联 王惟咨 weiziw@gmail.com 。 请申请人务必提前认真阅读洛杉矶总领事馆网站有关介绍（ http://losangeles.china- consulate.org/chn/visa/news/) ，按要求准备好申请表、照片、证件原件及复印件、回邮信 封及邮费等材料。
107c10f17c3384f2491f7c4d2d2526225aac6384.translatedText: The Documentation Team of the Chinese Consulate General in Los Angeles will come to Phoenix to renew passports on April 4th and 5th this year (Contributed by UCAA) Newsletter: For the convenience of the overseas Chinese, the Documentation Team of the Chinese Consulate General in Los Angeles will come to Phoenix on April 4th and 5th this year to accept applications for Chinese passport renewal and reissue on-site for overseas Chinese (no visas to China will be processed). Entrusted by the Chinese Consulate General in Los Angeles, the Hualian of Alberta will work with the Greater Phoenix Overseas Chinese Association to assist in processing applications for Chinese passport renewal and reissue, as well as entrusted notarization and aliveness notarization. The specific arrangements are as follows: Time: April 4 (Saturday) 9:00 am - 15:00 pm, April 5 (Sunday) 9:00 am - 12:00 noon Venue: Chinese Cultural Center (next to Xinxin Supermarket) 668 N 44th St, Suite M08, Phoenix, AZ 85008 Contact: Alberta Hualian Wang Weizi weiziw@gmail.com. Applicants must carefully read the introduction on the Los Angeles Consulate General website (http://losangeles.china-consulate.org/chn/visa/news/) in advance, and prepare application forms, photos, original and photocopies of certificates, return envelopes, postage and other materials as required.

1f70773b078684b4b9017985604edcd33f8bdc9f.sourceText: Salt River龙舟赛实况回顾(图) (张肇鸿报道/摄影)位于天庇市(Tempe)的Salt Rive…
1f70773b078684b4b9017985604edcd33f8bdc9f.translatedText: Salt River Dragon Boat Race Live Review (Photos) (Reported by Zhang Zhaohong/Photography) Salt Rive located in Tempe City (Tempe)...

059f71e606b394ff0a178925d23c6d0090c484f8.sourceText: (张肇鸿报道/摄影) 位于天庇市(Tempe)的Salt River，有着流经亚省最美丽的一段河面，凤凰城人暱称它为＂天庇湖＂(Tempe Lake)。暮春三月，天庇湖迎来了最美好的一天，因为富有中国传统特色的龙舟赛，已在大湖区擂响了赛鼓！今年共有70多支来自全美各地的龙舟队伍参加，他们在大湖边安营扎寨，近二千名选手磨拳擦掌，准备在龙舟赛中大显身手。
059f71e606b394ff0a178925d23c6d0090c484f8.translatedText: (Reported by Zhang Zhaohong/Photographed) Salt River located in Tempe City (Tempe) River has the most beautiful section of river flowing through Alberta. People in Phoenix nickname it "Tempe Lake". In late spring in March, Tianbi Lake ushered in the most beautiful day, because the dragon boat race with Chinese traditional characteristics has already started beating the drums in the Great Lakes area! This year, more than 70 dragon boat teams from all over the United States participated. They set up camp on the edge of the Great Lakes, and nearly 2,000 players were gearing up to show off their skills in the dragon boat race.

a7b0785400671440d800541fd85e81e052a0b941.sourceText: 在爱好户外运动的美国，龙舟赛活动从三月起就接连不断地举行。一些训练有素的龙舟队伍在此期间南征北战，互相较量，从西海岸的加州和东海岸的纽约州，向着内陆州蔓延开去，在洛杉矶、旧金山，纽约，华盛顿特区，丹佛、凤凰城等地定期举行。比赛分男女溷合组、公司组、学生组、残障组、乳癌康复病人组等等。龙舟赛活动在全美各地大有风起云涌之势，虽然由华人挑头带动，但白人龙舟爱好者已经后来居上，龙舟赛已经成为当地主流社会的重要文化活动，促进了各族裔的文化交流和发展。
a7b0785400671440d800541fd85e81e052a0b941.translatedText: In the United States, which loves outdoor sports, dragon boat racing events have been held continuously since March. During this period, some well-trained dragon boat teams traveled north and south to compete with each other. From California on the west coast and New York state on the east coast, they spread to inland states. They were held regularly in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington, D.C., Denver, Phoenix and other places. The competition is divided into mixed group, corporate group, student group, disabled group, breast cancer rehabilitation patient group, etc. Dragon boat racing activities are surging across the United States. Although it is spearheaded by the Chinese, white dragon boat enthusiasts have caught up from behind. Dragon boat racing has become an important cultural activity in the local mainstream society, promoting cultural exchanges and development of various ethnic groups.

78382f7e063cb8222c88eeb20884932cde594281.sourceText: 多年来，亚省中餐协会和百事可乐公司携手并肩，一起撑起如潮涌至的文化龙舟。3月28日，由主席张华芳及元老人物邓朝驹坐镇，由巫宜钊、任达宏带领的龙威水师已是即日成军，今年的龙舟队穿着清一色的青衣，看上去是一群＂青兵＂，＂勇＂字不在胸前，而是写在脸上。龙舟赛场250呎开阔，一次赛程共有五条龙舟竞技，一天需赶四埸。龙舟选手加前后鼓手掌舵共计廿二人，要彰显团队精神同舟共济才能取胜。在碧波荡漾的湖水龙舟竞渡时，岸上千百人呐喊加油，人声鼎沸高潮迭起，波澜壮阔蔚为奇观。
78382f7e063cb8222c88eeb20884932cde594281.translatedText: Over the years, the Alberta Chinese Restaurant Association and Pepsi-Cola have worked hand in hand to support the influx of cultural dragon boats. On March 28, the Longwei Navy, chaired by Chairman Zhang Huafang and veteran figure Deng Chaoju, and led by Wu Yizhao and Yam Dahong, was formed immediately. This year's dragon boat team wore uniform Tsing Yi and looked like a group of "green soldiers". The word "brave" is not on the chest, but written on the face. The dragon boat racing venue is 250 feet wide, with a total of five dragon boats competing in one race, requiring four races a day. There are a total of 22 dragon boat racers plus front and rear applauders and helmsmen. Only by demonstrating team spirit can we win by working together in the same boat. During the dragon boat race on the rippling blue water of the lake, thousands of people on the shore shouted for cheers.

56099ae7002819c203c9f6f8d54f20fcffc25c4a.sourceText: 今次的龙舟大赛，华文媒体随行，有亚省中餐网、火凤凰网、亚省时报等主编记者作专程报导。中餐会和亚省亚裔摄影协会还联手举办龙舟摄影大赛，以鼓励青少年学习和参与更多的中华文化。会长郑弘，还有黄双双，赛前已筹备多时，影协副会长林源还亲临其境，拍下许多大赛精采镜头。餐馆会的后援队当然也不会少，财神爷頼甲乙专程送来了美味可口的午餐，高志中和王瑞瑾大姐也到现在加油。龙舟到终奌后一个大迴转凯旋归来，得了个第三名，拿了季军也算不错，需知拿锅铲的技能转去拿木桨总会有小小的差别。
56099ae7002819c203c9f6f8d54f20fcffc25c4a.translatedText: This dragon boat race was accompanied by Chinese media, including editors and reporters from the Alberta Chinese Food Network, Huifeng.com, and the Alberta Times, who made special reports. The Chinese Dining Club and the Asian Photography Association of Asia also jointly held a dragon boat photography competition to encourage young people to learn and participate in more Chinese culture. President Zheng Hong and Huang Shuangshuang have been preparing for the competition for a long time. Lin Yuan, vice president of the Film Association, also visited the event in person and took many wonderful shots of the competition. Of course, the restaurant club also has a large support team. The God of Wealth, Li Jiayi, made a special trip to deliver a delicious lunch. Sister Gao Zhizhong and Wang Ruijin are also here to cheer up. The dragon boat made a giant slalom at the end and returned triumphantly. It came in third place. Winning the third place is not bad. It should be noted that there will always be a small difference in the skills of holding a spatula and holding a wooden oar.

5497c621854e0e61b5acc8a9d3c180edfdab7a84.sourceText: 除了赛场上生动活泼的龙舟竞技，假日的湖边也是一片欢乐，各族裔传统民俗技艺在此汇演，武术、舞蹈、音乐等千姿百态内容丰富，烘托出各族裔浓厚的文化气息。你看这边厢黑人大妈的街舞跳得可好？那边厢的中华摊档就与众不同！上头挂着彩龙、勐狮和大熊猫呢。今天的中国龙在美国人心中不再是张牙舞爪的恶兽，而是祥龙和嬉水之龙；今天的中国狮是会随鼓声起舞的瑞狮；今天中国大熊猫不但温顺，还变成＂功夫熊猫＂！当中华文化融合到世界文明，就会升华得更加精采和绚丽。
5497c621854e0e61b5acc8a9d3c180edfdab7a84.translatedText: In addition to the lively dragon boat racing on the field, the lakeside during the holidays is also full of joy, where traditional folk skills of various ethnic groups are put on display, with martial arts, dance, music and other forms of rich content, highlighting the strong cultural atmosphere of various ethnic groups. Do you think the black aunt over here is doing a good hip-hop dance? The Chinese stalls over there are different! There are colorful dragons, lions and giant pandas hanging on them. Today's Chinese dragon is no longer an evil beast with teeth and claws in the hearts of Americans, but an auspicious dragon and a dragon that plays in the water; today's Chinese lion is an auspicious lion that can dance with the sound of drums; today's Chinese giant panda is not only docile, but has also become a "Kung Fu Panda"! When Chinese culture is integrated into world civilization, it will become more splendid and splendid.

caaf419f884daf43d0f31f61de8f90df36e2f243.sourceText: 划龙舟之所以很快就受到各族裔人们的一致喜爱，主要因为这是一种表现团结合作的群体活动。不论是竞技比赛还是休閒娱乐，划龙舟都不受年龄和性别的限制，增加人与人之间的感情互动，促进族裔之间的和谐相处，具有不寻常的社会意义。
caaf419f884daf43d0f31f61de8f90df36e2f243.translatedText: The reason why dragon boat racing has quickly become popular among people of all ethnic groups is mainly because it is a group activity that shows unity and cooperation. Whether it is competitive competition or leisure entertainment, dragon boat rowing is not restricted by age or gender. It increases the emotional interaction between people and promotes harmonious coexistence between ethnic groups, which has unusual social significance.

9c11186c8ad7101478017042f7508008dd6eff18.sourceText: 随着对＂亚省华人第一墓碑＂资料深入的发掘，发现邓湘远家族在亚省华人历史上，无论是经济、政治、法律和文化方面，都有过十分积极的贡献。 查邓湘远的家族史，其祖父邓鼎元有四个儿子，其第三子邓恬芳(邓湘远的父亲) 是个纨绔弟子，资料显示＂恬芳壮年时，还是不务正业，终日流涟于赌场＂，而＂其父鼎元公严格教训，亲临赌埸执其以杖笞之＂，而按当时的大清律例，在光天化日和公众场作如此家教而无人追究，可知邓鼎元是个有权势之人。但是，邓恬芳最终还是竖子可教，能够＂当即表示痛改前非，并声言将建生祠＂，并＂从此洗心革面，立志创业，开设蒸酒磨米及养猪之店铺＂。＂经多年刻苦经营，勤节约俭，终于有此成就。晚年逐建生祠，终尝当年之愿＂。＂正是浪子回头金不换，该祠堂足见证矣，对吾軰子孙实有深刻教育意义＂。(注1) 其时已到十九世纪中叶，正是中国广东沿海居民移民潮的开始，初时是到美国加州去＂掘金＂，其后是去修铁路。铁路完工后，部分中国劳工归国，剩馀的散落去开矿山、垦农地，也有部分落脚于凤凰城开设洗衣店、餐馆和经商。 邓恬芳有四个儿子，分别是：汎远、藻远、贤远和湘远。邓湘远在四兄弟中排名最小，其大哥汎远，在开平打理父亲邓恬芳留下的産业，未来过美国。二哥藻远，当年娶妻余氏，其儿子邓盛于1889年出生。 1910年，21岁的邓盛从广州经旧金山来到美国凤凰城，所用的英文姓名是Shing Tang，他从叔叔手接过在 529 South和 7th Avenue开的一间杂货店生意，而叔叔不久就返回中国。1912年，他在凤凰城622 South 7 Avenue开了新的杂货店。1914年，他与在美国出生的Lucy Sing结婚，并在贤妻的帮助下，继续经营的杂货店近二十年，邓盛成为了一个成功的商人。他建立了＂太阳商业公司＂(Sun Mercantile Company)，为周边城镇提供许多的食品杂货供应(注2) 。1929年4月，太阳商业公司搬进了位于凤凰城杰克逊街和第三街的新仓库，整幢大仓库价值$80000，配备了连接城市报警系统的水喷洒系统和火灾报警器。该建筑位于20世纪早期开发仓库区的中心地带，这幢建筑物意义重大，因为它是凤凰城已知中国出生的商人建造并拥有的第一个和唯一的仓库。太阳商业公司是当时亚利桑那州德尔蒙特产品的第一大销售商，并供应Safeway和Basha抯等公司食品货物，使许多其他企业得以建立。他不仅是一个领先的中国公民，也受到其它族裔所推崇(注3) 。 太阳商业公司成为在凤凰城最大的批发杂货的企业，不仅供应本地，而且扩充到亚利桑那州。《亚利桑那州共和报》有报导：＂本报注意到，太阳商业公司是本州货物分门别类最多的普通商品批发货仓'(注4)。公司显着的成长史被称为?#20964;凰城和盐河河谷的业务及发展杰出的一章?(注5) 。 在上世纪二、三十年代，排华法桉严重影响着在美华人，所查到相关华人的资料绝大数都是负面的，而邓盛作为成功的一个华人企业家，并得到了主流社会的推崇，这是邓氏家族在亚省经济领域上所作出的积极的贡献。 邓盛于1954年去世, 享年65岁。他太太Lucy Sing 1980去世，享年84岁，因邓盛夫妇是罗马天主教徒，他们被埋葬在圣弗朗西斯公墓(St. Francis Cemetery)。我通过不断的寻找，搜集到以上的资料。在链接的资讯中，还可看到邓盛父母简单的英文讯息：父亲名Chou Yeun Tan(邓藻远)，母亲名 Shee Yee。邓藻远 Abt. 1850年在中国广东出生， Abt. 1910年在广东去世(注6)。另外，邓盛婚后的字排是＂业＂字辈，在邓氏族谱上的名字为＂邓安业＂，但邓盛来美后不再使用。 邓盛夫妇育有10个儿女，其中排行第六的是儿子邓心平，他在本省历史上的政治、军政方面，亦都有过十分积极的贡献。
9c11186c8ad7101478017042f7508008dd6eff18.translatedText: With the in-depth excavation of the information on "The First Chinese Tombstone in Alberta", it was discovered that the Deng Xiangyuan family has made very positive contributions in the history of Chinese people in Alberta, whether in economics, politics, law, and culture. Looking into Deng Xiangyuan’s family history, his grandfather Deng Dingyuan had four sons, and his third son Deng Tianfang (Deng Xiangyuan’s father) He was a playboy disciple. According to the data, "When Tianfang was in his prime, he still did not do his job and lived in casinos all day long." And "his father, Ding Yuan Gong, taught him strict lessons and personally went to the casino to flog him with a stick." According to the laws of the Qing Dynasty at that time, no one was held accountable for such tutoring in broad daylight and in public. This shows that Deng Dingyuan was a powerful man. However, in the end, Deng Tianfang still had a good temper and was able to "immediately change his ways and declare that he would build a shrine" and "changed his mind from then on, determined to start a business, and open a shop that steams wine, grinds rice and raises pigs." "After years of hard work, diligence and frugality, I finally achieved this achievement. In my later years, I built a shrine one after another, and finally realized what I had hoped for back then." "It is true that a prodigal son never changes his fortune. This ancestral hall is a testimony to this and has profound educational significance for our descendants." (Note 1) It was already the middle of the 19th century, which was the beginning of the wave of immigrants from coastal areas of Guangdong, China. First, they went to California to "dig gold" and later to build railroads. After the completion of the railway, some Chinese workers returned to the country, and the rest scattered to open mines and cultivate farmland. Some also settled in Phoenix to open laundries, restaurants, and do business. Deng Tianfang has four sons, namely: Fanyuan, Zaoyuan, Xianyuan and Xiangyuan. Deng Xiangyuan is the youngest among the four brothers. His eldest brother Fanyuan is taking care of the property left by his father Deng Tianfang in Kaiping and will not come to the United States in the future. The second brother Zaoyuan married his wife Yu, and his son Deng Sheng was born in 1889. In 1910, 21-year-old Deng Sheng came to Phoenix from Guangzhou via San Francisco. His English name was Shing Tang. He took over the grocery store business opened at 529 South and 7th Avenue from his uncle, who returned to China soon after. In 1912, he opened a new grocery store at 622 South 7 Avenue in Phoenix. In 1914, he married Lucy Sing, who was born in the United States. With the help of his good wife, he continued to run the grocery store for nearly twenty years, and Deng Sheng became a successful businessman. He established the "Sun Mercantile Company" (Sun Mercantile Company), which provided many groceries to surrounding towns (Note 2). In April 1929, Sun Commercial Company moved into a new warehouse at Jackson Street and Third Street in Phoenix. The entire large warehouse was worth $80,000 and was equipped with a sprinkler system and fire alarm connected to the city's alarm system. Located in the heart of a developing warehouse district in the early 20th century, this building is significant as it is the first and only warehouse known to have been built and owned by a Chinese-born businessman in Phoenix. Sun Commercial was the number one seller of Del Monte, Arizona products at the time and supplied food goods to companies such as Safeway and Basha's, allowing many other businesses to be established. He is not only a leading Chinese citizen, but also respected by other ethnic groups (Note 3). Sun Commercial became the largest wholesale grocery business in Phoenix, not only supplying locally but also expanding into Arizona. The "Arizona Republic" reported: "This newspaper notes that Sun Commercial Company is the general merchandise wholesale warehouse with the largest variety of goods in the state" (Note 4). The company's remarkable growth history has been called an outstanding chapter in the business and development of Phoenix and the Salt River Valley (Note 5). In the 1920s and 1930s, the Chinese Exclusion Act seriously affected Chinese people in the United States. Most of the information found about Chinese people was negative. However, Deng Sheng was a successful Chinese entrepreneur and was respected by mainstream society. This was the positive contribution made by the Deng family to the economic field of Alberta. Deng Sheng died in 1954 at the age of 65. His wife Lucy Sing. He died in 1980 at the age of 84. Because Deng Sheng and his wife were Roman Catholics, they were buried in St. Francis Cemetery. Through constant searching, I collected the above information. In the linked information, you can also see simple English information about Deng Sheng’s parents: his father’s name is Chou Yeun Tan (Deng Zaoyuan), and his mother’s name is Shee Yee. Abt. Deng Sheng was born in Guangdong, China in 1850. He died in Guangdong in 1910 (Note 6). In addition, Deng Sheng's name after his marriage was "Ye", and his name in the Deng family tree was "Deng Anye", but it was no longer used after Deng Sheng came to the United States. The Deng Sheng couple had 10 children, the sixth of whom was son Deng Xinping, who also made very active contributions to the politics and military affairs of the province.

950ead5fb6811bab406a06e78471143232cb8f4e.sourceText: 邓心平是邓盛的第六个儿子，也是邓湘远的亲侄孙。 邓心平于1922年1月11日出生于凤凰城，青少年时就读于公立学校。二次大战爆发后他应征入伍，参加后备军官训练团，1942年，年仅20岁的邓心平成为了美国陆军的一名中尉。时值中国抗战，他被派往中国，在中缅边界、云南、广西等地帮助中国完善军事设备，并从日军收回相关设施(注1)。他是亚利桑那州两位直接回中国抗日前线抗击日本侵略者的华裔军人之一。(另一位是邓桐臻。)
950ead5fb6811bab406a06e78471143232cb8f4e.translatedText: >Deng Xinping was Deng Sheng’s sixth son and Deng Xiangyuan’s nephew. Deng Xinping was born in Phoenix on January 11, 1922, and attended public schools as a teenager. After the outbreak of World War II, he enlisted in the Army and participated in the Reserve Officer Training Corps. In 1942, at the age of 20, Deng Xinping became a lieutenant in the U.S. Army. During the Anti-Japanese War in China, he was sent to China to help China improve its military equipment on the Sino-Burmese border, Yunnan, Guangxi and other places, and recover related facilities from the Japanese army (Note 1). He was one of two Chinese soldiers in Arizona who went directly back to the anti-Japanese front line in China to fight against the Japanese invaders. (The other one is Deng Tongzhen.)

94a4f7e9bc88bf281d88821d86b4606b786557ce.sourceText: 二次大战胜利后，他回美国上大学，并于1947年毕业于圣克拉拉的加州大学，以后参加韩战，升为上尉。之后回美国，并从亚利桑那大学获得了法律学位。成为当时亚利桑那州仅有的三个华裔律师之一。 1952年，邓心平担任亚利桑那州马利可巴郡副检察官，1956年年，担任亚利桑那州副检察长1960年至1962年年被选为凤凰城市议员，1962年任凤凰城市副市长。1962年的8年，担任亚利桑那州上等法院法官。1977年被选为亚利桑那州律师协会主席。1977年8月26日被总统卡特委任为美国上诉法院第九巡迴法院法官(Circuit法官），获联邦参议院通过。巡迴法官为终身职务，地位仅次于最高法院法官，绾美西华盛顿、加利福利亚、亚利桑那、内华达等十州法务。他当了16年巡迴大法官，人们对他的评价是：冷静，绅士风度，他倡导个人权利和少数民族在法律界的发展。他为美国印第安人法律、劳工权利、和其他问题提过400条的意见。邓心平是此职位的第一位华裔，他在美国法律界中的地位至今未有其它华人超越（注3）（注4）。
94a4f7e9bc88bf281d88821d86b4606b786557ce.translatedText: After the victory of World War II, he returned to the United States to attend college and graduated from the University of California at Santa Clara in 1947. He later participated in the Korean War and was promoted to captain. He then returned to the United States and received a law degree from the University of Arizona. Became one of only three Chinese-American lawyers in Arizona at the time. In 1952, Deng Xinping served as the deputy prosecutor of Maricopa County, Arizona. In 1956, he served as the deputy attorney general of Arizona. From 1960 to 1962, he was elected as a Phoenix City Councilman. In 1962, he served as the deputy mayor of Phoenix City. From 1962 to 1968, he served as a judge of the Superior Court of Arizona. In 1977, he was elected president of the Arizona State Bar Association. On August 26, 1977, he was appointed by President Carter as a judge of the Ninth Circuit Court of Appeals of the United States (Circuit Judge), and was confirmed by the Federal Senate. Circuit judges are lifelong positions, second only to Supreme Court judges, and are responsible for the legal affairs of ten states including Western Washington, California, Arizona, and Nevada. He served as a circuit judge for 16 years. People commented on him as: calm and gentlemanly. He advocated individual rights and the development of ethnic minorities in the legal profession. He wrote 400 opinions on American Indian law, labor rights, and other issues. Deng Xinping is the first Chinese-American to hold this position. His status in the American legal profession has not been surpassed by other Chinese (Note 3) (Note 4).

a81e7cc6114b07300de461f4481f7940f339ffaa.sourceText: 邓心平除在美国政界和法律界享有盛誉外，还有是以他的名字所命名的＂亚省邓心平退伍军人会＂（The American Legion of Arizona Thomas Tang Post 50）。
a81e7cc6114b07300de461f4481f7940f339ffaa.translatedText: In addition to Deng Xinping's high reputation in the American political and legal circles, there is also "The American Legion of Arizona Thomas Tang Post 50" named after him.

17956c45b6685a78df9a99120fc32444671f5a83.sourceText: 1950年，由44位亚省退伍华人组成了”亚省华裔军人会”，其中有三名西裔人士，邓心平是创会人之一。邓心平于1995年年去世，享年73岁。为纪念他的政绩，”亚省华裔军人会?#22240;而改名为”邓心平退伍军人会?#65288;注5）。
17956c45b6685a78df9a99120fc32444671f5a83.translatedText: In 1950, the "Alberta Chinese Soldiers' Association" was formed by 44 retired Chinese from Alberta, including three Hispanics, and Deng Xinping was one of the founders. Deng Xinping died in 1995 at the age of 73. In order to commemorate his political achievements, the "Alberta Chinese Veterans Association?#22240; was renamed the "Deng Xinping Veterans Association?#65288; Note 5).

453f2d31e57159718c61a4ee6ad6f0eee8d3babe.sourceText: 在＂邓心平退伍军人会＂一书中，记载着亚省参加一次世界大战中的两位华人军人；二次大战中的七十九位华裔军人，及其它战争中参战的华裔军人。我查过在亚省华人当兵历史中，有四十多位官兵姓邓，在所有的六位烈士之中，也有三位是邓家子弟（注6)。《邓心平退伍军人会》一书有二百馀页，书中记载着许多可歌可泣的感人故事。 邓氏家族在亚省华人历史上，无论从军、从政和法律界，都有十分积极的贡献。
453f2d31e57159718c61a4ee6ad6f0eee8d3babe.translatedText: In the book "Deng Xinping Veterans Association", it is recorded that two Chinese soldiers in Alberta participated in World War I; 79 Chinese soldiers in World War II, and Chinese soldiers who participated in other wars. I checked the history of Chinese military service in Alberta and found that there were more than 40 officers and soldiers named Deng. Among the six martyrs, three were descendants of the Deng family (Note 6). The book "Deng Xinping Veterans Association" has more than 200 pages and contains many touching and touching stories. The Deng family has made very positive contributions in the history of Chinese people in Alberta, whether in the military, politics or legal circles.

38d2b9f3bed5357dd2b2d8e76e4f13a1c9e3daf5.sourceText: 邓湘远的三哥是邓贤远，邓贤远的孙儿是邓锡邦。据邓锡邦提供的族谱，祖父邓贤远有三个儿子，分别是棠业、朗业和富业。目前邓棠业的后裔在中国开平；邓富业的后裔在香港。邓贤远是1885年来美国凤凰城的，邓贤远之子即邓锡邦之父邓朗业是在美国出生。朗业青年时回大陆娶妻，于1926年在开平生下邓锡邦，以后朗业回到美国，开过餐馆，也去过侄儿邓盛的＂太阳商业公司＂打工。而邓锡邦是到1947年申请来美国，目前生活在凤凰城。 邓锡邦有民间艺人之称，早年活跃于凤凰城侨社。他爱好画画和摄影，常在报刊上发表佳作，他还打得一手好听的舞狮锣鼓，他的打鼓技巧获得过三藩市民间鼓法比赛的奖项。在对亚省华人历史的贡献方面，邓锡邦多年来一直保存的＂告恬芳祖宗亲书＂(2001年)，无疑提供了不少关于邓湘远家族具体的资料，其祖宗亲书上记录有邓湘远上下七代人的族谱，为我们解开邓湘远的＂墓碑之谜＂提供了宝贵的线索。 最后是邓湘远本人。关于他的资料不多，否则就无须破解＂墓碑谜团＂了。根据资料，邓湘远有两个儿子，分别是邓杖业、邓本业。邓杖业在开平，生儿子邓有森，邓有森因被劫贼打死，从邓本业过继一儿子，名邓世钊，邓世钊之子名邓润养，润养有两个儿子，分别是邓宗明和邓宗业，邓宗明在香港，邓宗业生活在开平。邓宗业是＂告恬芳祖宗亲书＂发起人之一。 邓湘远的另一个儿子邓本业，早年由开平来到美国，有独生女邓瑞霞(在凤凰城去世)，邓本业妻子1940年代领养6岁的邓瑞海为养子。邓瑞海1965年用＂难民＂身份来美国，今年76岁。邓瑞海有三个儿子和三个孙子，他们现生活在凤凰城。儿孙不懂中文，邓瑞海本人并不知道有关邓湘远的情况。 邓湘远之子邓本业回过香港，在日本入侵香港时期曾和侄儿邓锡邦同居一室，让邓锡邦对邓湘远家庭有所了解。据邓锡邦回忆，邓本业初回港时是西装革履，爱饮名酒，可知邓本业家庭是有一定经济基础的，但战乱时邓本业经济无继，又不能回美国，只好改饮水酒了。邓本业最后回到祖家大楼村并直至去世。 根据资料，在1886年和1914年之间，有50个有中国血统的人被埋葬在纪念墓园，有部分人的骇骨被起出运回中国。在后来的考古资料上，証实尚有廿三位凤凰城华人先辈葬在纪念墓园墓地中。 由于契而不舍努力引起纪念墓园的重视，Pioneer & Military Memorial Park送来尘封档的桉资料，让人看到了50个中国人的全部名单。令人相当兴奋是， 其中有个名字＂Ong Xian Yuan＂，其发音和开平乡音＂邓湘远＂完全吻合，是个商人，1913年去世，享年51岁，往前推算应在1862出生。 唐孝先先生也找到了一份有关邓湘远具体的死亡証明，文件来自「亚利桑那领地健康委员会人口动态统计局209号死亡证明书原件」(Arizona Territorial Board of Health Bureau of Vital Statistics Original Death Certificate 209)，亡者姓名 Ong Sing Yuen。去世地点在529 S.7th Ave. (Phoenix, Arizona) ，职业是商人 ，来美国卅年，死亡时年龄51岁 ，死因为食道癌。1913年6月8日凌晨去世，6月9日安葬于Loosley公墓。邓湘远父亲名字是Heaw Tong，母亲婚前名字是Ham She，均在中国出生。查询到此，综合各种资料，这长达廿年的邓湘远之＂墓碑之谜＂ ，终于可以完全破解： 邓湘远，1862在中国出生，1883年21岁时来美国凤凰城，1913年因病去世，是个商人，享年51岁，葬于先民和军人纪念墓园，已没有至亲在美国。但其家族对亚省华人历史在政治、经济和文化等方面都有积极的贡献和影响。 但因邓湘远墓碑上的中文名字在翻译时是用汉语拼音＂Deng, Xian Yuan＂，并用于英文考古杂志和其它资料中，有其权威性，如要作更改须要一定程序，须专家学者去鉴别和 更正。另外，考古小组曾在墓园里进行过发掘，邓湘远的墓葬是否有陪葬品呢？还有，那些出土了的中国钱币、骨器、玉器和小菩萨像等物件，现在又放置在何方？ 邓湘远墓碑到今已有超过一百年的历史，往事如烟，逝者已矣。为解开这个＂墓碑谜团＂亦有多年，资料查証来之不易。在如此多的例証中，邓湘远虽然不是最早来到亚利桑那州的华人，但他的中文墓碑已有其清楚的历史定位，在没有其它的发现之前，邓湘远的墓碑是亚省华人遗留下来最早的墓碑，其碑文是最早的中国文字，他的墓碑和这片墓地已成为了解亚省华人先民历史的宝贵资源，这也是邓湘远在亚省华人历史文化方面留给后人最大的遗产和贡献。 到此有关解开＂墓碑谜团＂的文章系列已全部完成。凤凰城华人福利会决定为华人先民墓地树立纪念墓碑，并将择日进行公祭，邓湘远及其家族从今后将不会再被人们所遗忘。邓湘远及其家族的贡献资料将呈送＂中国华侨历史博物馆＂存桉。 ＂墓碑谜团＂全文可上 http://www.paaca.us/new_page_144.htm 浏览。
38d2b9f3bed5357dd2b2d8e76e4f13a1c9e3daf5.translatedText: Deng Xiangyuan's third brother is Deng Xianyuan, and Deng Xianyuan's grandson is Deng Xibang. According to the genealogy provided by Deng Xibang, his grandfather Deng Xianyuan had three sons, namely Tangye, Langye and Fuye. Currently, Deng Tangye’s descendants are in Kaiping, China; Deng Fuye’s descendants are in Hong Kong. Deng Xianyuan came to Phoenix, United States in 1885. Deng Xianyuan's son, Deng Langye, the father of Deng Xibang, was born in the United States. Langye returned to mainland China to marry a wife when he was young, and gave birth to Deng Xibang in Kaiping in 1926. Later, Langye returned to the United States, opened a restaurant, and also worked at his nephew Deng Sheng's "Sun Commercial Company." Deng Xibang applied to come to the United States in 1947 and currently lives in Phoenix. Deng Xibang is known as a folk artist and was active in the Phoenix Overseas Chinese Community in his early years. He loves painting and photography, and often publishes excellent works in newspapers and periodicals. He is also good at playing lion dance gongs and drums. His drumming skills have won awards in the San Francisco Folk Drumming Competition. In terms of contribution to the history of Chinese people in Alberta, the "Gao Tianfang Ancestral Letter" (2001) that Deng Xibang has preserved for many years undoubtedly provides a lot of specific information about the Deng Xiangyuan family. The ancestral letter records the genealogy of seven generations of Deng Xiangyuan, which provides us with valuable clues to solve the "mystery of the tombstone" of Deng Xiangyuan. Finally, there is Deng Xiangyuan himself. There is not much information about him, otherwise there would be no need to solve the "tombstone mystery". According to the information, Deng Xiangyuan has two sons, Deng Zhangye and Deng Benye. Deng Zhangye gave birth to his son Deng Yousen in Kaiping. Deng Yousen was beaten to death by a robber and adopted a son from Deng Benye, named Deng Shizhao. Deng Shizhao's son was named Deng Runyang. Runyang had two sons, Deng Zongming and Deng Zongye. Deng Zongming lived in Hong Kong and Deng Zongye lived in Kaiping. Deng Zongye is one of the initiators of the "Letter to Tianfang's Ancestors". Deng Xiangyuan's other son, Deng Benye, came to the United States from Kaiping in his early years. He had an only daughter, Deng Ruixia (died in Phoenix). Deng Benye's wife adopted 6-year-old Deng Ruihai as their adopted son in the 1940s. Deng Ruihai came to the United States as a "refugee" in 1965 and is 76 years old this year. Deng Ruihai has three sons and three grandchildren, who now live in Phoenix. His children and grandchildren do not understand Chinese, and Deng Ruihai himself does not know the situation about Deng Xiangyuan. Deng Xiangyuan's son Deng Benye returned to Hong Kong and lived in the same room with his nephew Deng Xibang during the Japanese invasion of Hong Kong, which gave Deng Xiangyuan some knowledge of Deng Xiangyuan's family. According to Deng Xibang's recollection, when Deng Benye first returned to Hong Kong, he was wearing a suit and leather shoes and liked to drink famous wines. This shows that Deng Benye's family had a certain financial foundation. However, during the war, Deng Benye's finances were unsustainable and he could not return to the United States, so he had to drink water and wine instead. Deng Benye finally returned to his ancestral home village where he lived until his death. According to information, between 1886 and 1914, 50 people of Chinese descent were buried in the memorial cemetery, and some of their bones were removed and transported back to China. Later archaeological data confirmed that there are still 23 Phoenix Chinese ancestors buried in the memorial cemetery. Due to their unremitting efforts to attract the attention of the memorial cemetery, Pioneer & Military Memorial Park sent the dust-laden eucalyptus information, allowing people to see the complete list of 50 Chinese people. What is quite exciting is that one of the names is "Ong Xian Yuan", whose pronunciation exactly matches the Kaiping dialect "Deng Xiangyuan". He was a businessman who died in 1913 at the age of 51. It is estimated that he was born in 1862. Mr. Tang Xiaoxian also found a specific death certificate about Ong Sing Yuen. The document came from the "Arizona Territorial Board of Health Bureau of Vital Statistics Original Death Certificate 209" (Arizona Territorial Board of Health Bureau of Vital Statistics Original Death Certificate 209). The name of the deceased was Ong Sing Yuen. The place of death was 529 S. 7th Ave. (Phoenix, Arizona). He was a businessman by profession. He came to the United States thirty years ago. He was 51 years old when he died. The cause of death was esophageal cancer. He died in the early morning of June 8, 1913 and was buried in Loosley Cemetery on June 9. Deng Xiangyuan's father's name is Heaw Tong, and his mother's maiden name is Ham She. They were both born in China. After searching this point and combining various information, the 20-year-old "mystery of the tombstone" of Deng Xiangyuan can finally be completely solved: Deng Xiangyuan was born in China in 1862. He came to Phoenix in the United States in 1883 when he was 21 years old. He died of illness in 1913. He was a businessman at the age of 51. He was buried in the Ancestors and Soldiers Memorial Cemetery. He has no close relatives in the United States. However, his family has made positive contributions and influences on the political, economic and cultural aspects of Chinese history in Alberta. However, because the Chinese name on Deng Xiangyuan's tombstone was translated using the Chinese pinyin "Deng, Xian Yuan" and was used in English archaeological magazines and other materials, it has its authority. If it is to be changed, certain procedures are required, and experts and scholars must identify and correct it. In addition, the archaeological team has conducted excavations in the cemetery. Are there any burial objects in Deng Xiangyuan's tomb? Also, where are the unearthed Chinese coins, bone vessels, jades, small Bodhisattva statues and other objects placed now? Deng Xiangyuan's tombstone has a history of more than a hundred years. The past is like smoke and the deceased is gone. It took many years to solve this "tombstone mystery", and the verification of information was not easy. Among so many examples, although Deng Xiangyuan was not the first Chinese to come to Arizona, his Chinese tombstone has its own clear historical position. Before other discoveries, Deng Xiangyuan’s tombstone is the oldest Chinese tombstone left in Arizona. The earliest tombstone and the inscription on it are the earliest Chinese characters. His tombstone and this cemetery have become valuable resources for understanding the history of Chinese ancestors in Alberta. This is also Deng Xiangyuan’s greatest legacy and contribution to future generations in the history and culture of Chinese people in Alberta. This article series on solving the "tombstone mystery" has been completed. The Phoenix Chinese Welfare Association has decided to erect a commemorative tombstone for the Chinese ancestors' cemetery and will hold a public memorial on a date. Deng Xiangyuan and his family will no longer be forgotten by people from now on. The contribution information of Deng Xiangyuan and his family will be submitted to the "China Overseas Chinese History Museum" for storage. The full text of "Tombstone Mystery" can be viewed at http://www.paaca.us/new_page_144.htm.

09db336c211ae0f907bed7ccc9f7716fea1c7a94.translatedText: If you were this man named Isaac Martinez, would you calmly take out your phone, take a selfie and post it on social software? !

dee512da31f19e275c6739e766e9d822408dd9a4.sourceText: Martinez，今年20岁，在Bistro 13工作，这是一家位于菲尼克斯东边的餐厅，由当地一家科技公司经营。在本周三Mesa骇人听闻的连环枪击案发生的时候，Martinez发现自己正处于嫌疑人Ryan E. Giroux的视线当中。
dee512da31f19e275c6739e766e9d822408dd9a4.translatedText: >Martinez, 20, works at Bistro 13, a restaurant in east Phoenix run by a local technology company. During Wednesday's horrific shooting spree in Mesa, Martinez found himself in the sights of suspect Ryan E. Giroux.

967bfe1116c5c7a6da88f3aaf56db40118bead9f.sourceText: Martinez介绍说，当时嫌疑人逼近他并要求他用钥匙打开车门。此举遭到Martinez拒绝后，Giroux随即拿枪对他射击。中枪后，Martinez立刻拍下自己的伤势，图中鲜血从他肩部渗出，染红他当时身着的白色工作制服，他把此图po上了Snapchat上。
967bfe1116c5c7a6da88f3aaf56db40118bead9f.translatedText: Martinez said that the suspect approached him and asked him to use the key to open the car door. When Martinez refused, Giroux shot him. After being shot, Martinez immediately took a picture of his injuries. In the picture, blood seeped from his shoulder, staining the white work uniform he was wearing at the time. He posted the picture on Snapchat.

449d57d98e1f1d73e59f8067c23c175d159c996d.translatedText: On March 5, 2015, the groundbreaking ceremony for the Arizona SeaWorld, with a total investment of 64 million, was held in the Maricoopa Indian Reservation. Greg Crane, president of the Arizona Art Institute's group, attended the groundbreaking ceremony as the only investor representative and shoveled the first shovelful of soil. Industry insiders say this project will become the most attractive entertainment project in Arizona.

3407e62b707824198156a05e678f9eb5170d06f9.sourceText: 亚利桑那海洋世界占地两百万英尺，集寓教于乐为一体，是孩子了解海洋生物的重要教育基地。执行公司负责人说与全美的其他海洋世界相比，亚利桑那海洋世界一定是独一无二的。举个例子，当你走进海洋公园的厕所，你都会被现场的设计所震惊！你眼睛的所到之处都是活灵活现的海洋生物，洗手台，墙壁都是玻璃制作成的鱼缸，各种海洋生物就在你的身边游荡。当你上完洗手间，你一定会跟你太太说：”亲爱的，你该去上个洗手间”太太会很不耐烦的回答”亲爱的，我现在不想上洗手间。。。。”你还是会两眼发直的重复”亲爱的，你该去上个洗手间”。项目负责人的表述非常幽默，但是海洋世界将会给你带来层层惊喜！
3407e62b707824198156a05e678f9eb5170d06f9.translatedText: Arizona SeaWorld covers an area of ​​two million feet and integrates education and entertainment. It is an important educational base for children to understand marine life. The head of the executive company said that SeaWorld Arizona must be unique compared to other sea worlds in the United States. For example, when you walk into the toilets in Ocean Park, you will be shocked by the design of the place! Everywhere your eyes go there are vivid marine life. The sinks and walls are all made of glass fish tanks, and all kinds of marine life are wandering around you. When you go to the bathroom, you will definitely say to your wife: "Honey, you should go to the bathroom." Your wife will answer impatiently, "Honey, I don't want to go to the bathroom now..." You will still repeat with straight eyes, "Honey, you should go to the bathroom." The statement of the project leader is very humorous, but Ocean World will bring you layers of surprises!

421fc2ee067d35352eb8b8db7eabf356c95d552b.translatedText: The ocean park is expected to be completed in July 2016. During the construction period, SeaWorld Arizona will sell limited lifetime memberships, priced at $399 for a single membership and $1095 for a family lifetime membership. This will be an unexpected gift for your family and children. This is the company’s latest investment project in 2016, following Butterfly Wonderland, Thrill Seeker Stunt Run (5-kilometer obstacle course), and the Arizona Institute of Art. Phoenix Economic Magazine, Channel 12, Fox10 and many other media reported on this entertainment event.

fc57c22f6407c0ffaec15bec149e804f4d18f25b.sourceText: 中国国民党亚利桑那直属分部于三月十四日，如期在凤凰城召开本年度首次党员大会，按照原订三大议程进行，出席党员达开会法定人数。约中午十一时，由党友曾丽卿女士领唱中美国歌，揭开序幕。常委王玮𤧟首先致词，感谢三年多来长官及各界先进的指导，凤凰城媒体及党友的支持，本部党员同志之努力奉献，始有亚利桑那直属分部之成立与成长，由衷之辞，溢于言表。 一、亚利桑那直属分部常委曁委员任期届满改选 此次常委曁委员改选，纯係任期届满，遵照党章规定办理，三年一任，两任为限。亚利桑那直属分部直接报告于中央党部海外部，并不隷属于任何北美分支党部，所选之常委，亦是分部负责人，主持一切党务工作，自筹所有经费，党中央从未给予直属分部任何补助，特此澄清。 三年多来，分部所有党员竭尽思虑，任劳任怨，亚利桑那直属分部才有今日之规模。王常委经党员推选，因应情势，续担传承重任，依票选连任本直属分部第二任常委，随即遴选委员，宣誓就职。 二、 2016年中华民国总统及立法委员选举后援会 2016年中华民国总统及立法委员选举，为期不远，与会党员咸盼中央慎重其事，详加策划，能推选出最适当的侯选人，全力以赴。亚利桑那直属分部将如往年一样，依中央决策，适时筹组后援会，凝聚力量，展开助选工作。 三、 凤凰城侨情与党务工作 侨委顾问李麟玲以本直属分部与凤城台北姊妹市，庆祝去年双十国庆，在州政府博物馆与凤城市政大厅，合办台湾图片展览为例，说明各社团当能彼此合作，推展侨务工作。李顾问并指出，侨务工作除了服务侨社之外，应宣扬中华民国，兼顾文化交流，从事国民外交，缔结国际友谊。 侨领吴亮祖受邀发言，在美华侨来自不同地区，有着不同的文化背景，侨社多元化，是自然而正常的，也是好事，我们要面对现实，适应状况。另提及团体法规和体制的重要，欣见直属分部具有健全之体制，党务必将持续成长。来自科罗拉多州曲奋勇先生建言，招募年轻党员，扎根发展，并祝愿党部蒙神的祝福，党员更加努力，党务更加蓬勃。 王常委及多位委员均表示，直属分部将努力于失联党员的归队，新生党员的招募，以及服务党员同志。今后党务工作的推动，将考量整体侨情，配合与其它社团交流合作，举办各种活动，服务侨社。
fc57c22f6407c0ffaec15bec149e804f4d18f25b.translatedText: The Arizona branch of the Chinese Kuomintang held its first party member meeting of the year in Phoenix on March 14 as scheduled. It was carried out in accordance with the original three major agendas, and the quorum of party members present reached the meeting. At about 11 noon, party member Ms. Zeng Liqing led the singing of Chinese and American songs to kick off the event. Standing Committee Member Wang Wei first delivered a speech, thanking the superiors and advanced guidance from all walks of life for more than three years, the support of Phoenix media and party members, and the hard work and dedication of the party members and comrades of this department, which led to the establishment and growth of the Arizona branch. His heartfelt words were beyond words. 1. Re-election of Standing Committee members and members directly under the Arizona branch upon expiration of their terms. This re-election of Standing Committee members and members is purely based on the expiration of the term and is handled in accordance with the provisions of the Party Constitution. One term is three years, with a limit of two terms. The Arizona branch directly reports to the Overseas Department of the Central Party Headquarters and is not affiliated with any North American branch. The selected standing committee member is also the head of the branch, presides over all party affairs and raises all funds by itself. The Party Central Committee has never given any subsidy to the directly affiliated branch. This is hereby clarified. For more than three years, all the party members of the branch have worked hard and worked hard to achieve the scale of the Arizona branch. Standing Committee Member Wang was elected by party members. In response to the situation, he continued to assume the important responsibility of inheritance. He was re-elected as the second standing member of the directly affiliated branch by vote. The members were then selected and sworn in. 2. Support Association for the 2016 Presidential and Legislative Elections of the Republic of China. The 2016 Presidential and Legislative Elections of the Republic of China are not far away. Party members attending the meeting hope that the central government will take the matter seriously, make detailed planning, and select the most suitable candidates and go all out. The Arizona branch will, as in previous years, organize support groups in a timely manner in accordance with central decisions, gather strength, and start election support work. 3. Overseas Chinese Affairs and Party Work in Phoenix City Li Linling, consultant of the Overseas Chinese Affairs Committee, took the example of the jointly organized Taiwan photo exhibition in the State Government Museum and the Fengcheng City Hall to celebrate the National Day last year with the sister city of Taipei, Fengcheng, as an example of how various associations can cooperate with each other to promote overseas Chinese affairs. Consultant Li also pointed out that in addition to serving overseas Chinese communities, overseas Chinese affairs should promote the Republic of China, take into account cultural exchanges, engage in national diplomacy, and establish international friendship. Overseas Chinese leader Wu Liangzu was invited to speak. Chinese overseas Chinese in the United States come from different regions and have different cultural backgrounds. It is natural and normal for overseas Chinese communities to be diverse, and it is also a good thing. We must face reality and adapt to the situation. He also mentioned the importance of collective regulations and systems, and was pleased that the directly affiliated branches have a sound system and that the party will continue to grow. Mr. Qu Fenyong from Colorado suggested recruiting young party members to take root and develop. He also wished that the party headquarters would be blessed by God, that party members would work harder, and that party affairs would become more prosperous. Standing Committee Member Wang and many members said that the directly affiliated branch will work hard to return lost party members, recruit new party members, and serve party members and comrades. In the future, the promotion of party affairs will take into account the overall overseas Chinese sentiment, cooperate with exchanges and cooperation with other associations, organize various activities, and serve the overseas Chinese community.

0aecca40684e5c40b3e704800a0e6c07f56eb5b3.sourceText: 2015年亚利桑那春晚在美莎艺术中心隆重举办，盛况空前！参与春晚的中美朋友都说真没想到在短短3个月的时间里，能如此大范围的团结社区精英，征召中美商家，共同给美国华人社区呈上了如此盛大的文化大餐。 2月21日上午10时晚会总导演刘洛宏，剧务总监冯晓欣等就来到了剧场，开始调整预先安排好的灯光音响。舞台下的测光是本次晚会的亮点，它将舞台延伸到观众区。因为装灯工作人员迟迟没有到位，几经周折，重新组装灯架，才达到导演预想的效果，装灯就耽误很长彩排的时间。
0aecca40684e5c40b3e704800a0e6c07f56eb5b3.translatedText: >The 2015 Arizona Spring Festival Gala was grandly held at the Mesa Art Center with unprecedented grandeur! Chinese and American friends who participated in the Spring Festival Gala said that they really did not expect that in just three months, community elites could be united on such a large scale, Chinese and American businessmen were recruited, and jointly presented such a grand cultural feast to the Chinese American community. At 10 a.m. on February 21, the party's chief director Liu Luohong, stage director Feng Xiaoxin and others came to the theater and began to adjust the pre-arranged lighting and sound. The highlight of this evening was the metering under the stage, which extended the stage into the audience area. Because the lighting staff was not in place for a long time, and it took several twists and turns to reassemble the light stand before achieving the effect expected by the director, the lighting installation delayed the rehearsal for a long time.

86355378d98dd78f3d23d14557f2831045d02833.sourceText: 灯光控制室（左至右）剧场工作人员 志愿者林欣 总导演刘洛宏
86355378d98dd78f3d23d14557f2831045d02833.translatedText: Lighting control room (left to right) theater staff, volunteer Lin Xin, chief director Liu Luohong

c3272d9c1a8cab8becbdd84a50bcaaa95ef68b88.sourceText: 近3点节目才正式开始彩排。开场舞是晚会的重头戏，人员多，台位变化也复杂，负责开场舞蹈的亚利桑那艺术学校的汤可老师，一边调整演员位置，一边和其他节目的人员要在很短的时间内协调。虽然这个舞蹈演员们已经练得滚瓜烂熟了，可是汤可老师还是希望做到尽善尽美。时间紧张，大部分节目只能把主要队形变换一下，就必须下台，所有演员只能匆匆走台。
c3272d9c1a8cab8becbdd84a50bcaaa95ef68b88.translatedText: The show officially started rehearsals at nearly 3 o'clock. The opening dance is the highlight of the party. There are many people and the stage changes are complicated. Teacher Tang Ke from the Arizona School of the Arts, who is in charge of the opening dance, has to adjust the positions of the actors while coordinating with other program personnel in a very short time. Although the dancers have already practiced very well, Teacher Tang Ke still hopes to achieve perfection. Time is tight, and most shows can only change the main formation before they have to step off the stage, and all the actors can only walk off the stage in a hurry.

14d8cc877e21720e473189e51853bb96d0311a06.sourceText: 演出结束后汤可老师（左六）和演员们合影留念
14d8cc877e21720e473189e51853bb96d0311a06.translatedText: After the performance, Teacher Tang Ke (sixth from left) took a group photo with the actors

99545f03b02c34bae339605b86a7497a04a3b12c.sourceText: 在节目轮换中间，总看到两个身影趴在舞台地板上，仔细一看，才发现是平时教舞蹈的亚利桑那艺术学校的邱晓榕，陈蔚萍老师，她们怕小演员们看不清位置，一人拿了一个颜色的胶条在舞台上贴位置，还一个劲儿的叮嘱小演员，记得你是粉色的条，你是绿色的条，你是。。。。。。
99545f03b02c34bae339605b86a7497a04a3b12c.translatedText: During the program rotation, I always saw two figures lying on the stage floor. After a closer look, I realized that they were Teachers Qiu Xiaorong and Chen Weiping from the Arizona School of the Arts, who usually teach dance, were afraid that the young actors could not see clearly their positions, so each of them took a colored strip of tape and pasted it on the stage. They also kept telling the young actors, remember, you are a pink strip, you are a green strip, you are. . . . . .

fbf0ddd2ba46165706930ff400997fce5f60e4ef.sourceText: 舞台上忙着贴标志的陈蔚萍和邱晓榕老师 5,4,3,2,1开始！总导演一声令下，7点17分开场音乐响起。观众看到了一个台上台下互动性极强的开场。绚丽的灯光，优美的舞蹈，熟悉的歌曲，全场上下都被热情点燃。而后台演员们非常有秩序的，穿梭候场。第二个节目《小鸿雁》是十几个小朋友组成的节目。节目负责老师刘鸥在这次演出中身兼数职，她不仅是《水姑娘》的领舞，而且还参加其他几个节目的表演，同时还负责编排舞蹈。与她一样，身兼数职的还有从一大早忙到最后的剧务总监冯晓欣。她穿着演出服，戴着耳机对全场各个演出部门发出指令。节目已经开始了，她还没化妆，头饰也还没戴好。可是舞台上上下下的协调，一分钟也离不开她。没办法，独舞演员陈思，搬来了她的所有化妆品就在舞台边上化妆。冯晓欣一边涂着脸，一边听着耳机，发出各个指令，坐怀不乱。台下传来的观众们热烈的掌声，是工作人员们心中最有效的指挥棒，虽然不能直接看到节目，可是大家一定能感觉的各个节目的演出效果。就当节目一个接一个的将晚会推向高潮的时候，忽然看到后台总监王玉兰，腰部裹着绷带，着急得楼上楼下的转.’怎么啦？’有人问. ‘下一个节目马上就要到弦乐四重奏了，可是我上上下下就是找不着这四个孩子！’王玉兰急得满头大汗，”我上楼下都找好几遍了” 一边说，一边继续走，一个一个的敲开后台化妆间的门。两分钟又过去了，还没有任何消息，这下后台的上上下下都急红眼了！眼看再过一分钟台上节目就要结束，主持人要出去报幕了。后台的老师班妈都动起来了。就在这时候，听见王玉兰的声音从二楼楼梯传来：’你们四个。。。。。’ 大家全送了口气，终于在最后一分钟，她找到了这四个小演员，一切都化险为夷。
fbf0ddd2ba46165706930ff400997fce5f60e4ef.translatedText: Teachers Chen Weiping and Qiu Xiaorong were busy putting up signs on the stage. 5,4,3,2,1 starts! The chief director gave an order and the opening music started at 7:17. The audience saw a highly interactive opening on and off stage. Gorgeous lights, beautiful dances, familiar songs, the whole audience was ignited with enthusiasm. The actors backstage were very orderly, shuttling and waiting. The second program "Little Hongyan" is a program composed of more than a dozen children. Liu Ou, the teacher in charge of the show, wears many hats in this performance. She is not only the lead dancer of "Water Girl", but also participates in performances of several other shows and is also responsible for choreographing the dance. Like her, Feng Xiaoxin, the drama director who works from early morning to last, also wears multiple hats. Wearing costumes and headphones, she gave instructions to various performance departments throughout the venue. The show had already started, but she hadn't put on makeup or put on her headdress yet. But the coordination up and down the stage cannot be separated from her for even a minute. There was no choice but Chen Si, the solo dancer, moved all her cosmetics and put on her makeup at the edge of the stage. Feng Xiaoxin painted her face, listened to her headphones, and issued various instructions while sitting still. The warm applause from the audience is the most effective baton in the minds of the staff. Although they cannot directly see the program, everyone can definitely feel the performance of each program. Just as the show was pushing the party to a climax one after another, I suddenly saw Wang Yulan, the backstage director, with a bandage on her waist, anxiously running upstairs and downstairs. 'What's wrong? ’ someone asked. ‘The next program is going to be a string quartet, but I’ve looked all over and can’t find these four kids! ’ Wang Yulan was so anxious that she was sweating profusely, “I’ve been looking for it several times downstairs and downstairs.” As she spoke, she continued walking and knocked on the doors of the dressing room backstage one by one. Two minutes passed, and there was still no news. Now everyone backstage was furious! Seeing that the program on stage will end in one minute, the host will go out to announce the curtain. The teachers and class mothers in the background started to move. At this moment, Wang Yulan's voice was heard coming from the stairs on the second floor: 'You four. . . . . ’ Everyone breathed a sigh of relief. Finally, at the last minute, she found these four young actors, and everything was saved.

a3388bb3d8ca968c031f71f15db2197a0055fbdd.sourceText: 终于把演员送上台的两位后台总监王玉兰（左）吕丽华（右） 台下的观众依然陶醉在四个美少女悠扬的音乐声中，后台的工作人员才从恐慌中，再次恢复到正常的秩序。《花开时节》的十几个演员正准备去候场，其中一个就被班妈张娆英抓出来，”她的头花歪了，我要帮她重新弄一下”不由分说，她马上在走道口，把演员的头饰重新弄好。
a3388bb3d8ca968c031f71f15db2197a0055fbdd.translatedText: The two backstage directors Wang Yulan (left) and Lu Lihua (right) finally sent the actors to the stage. The audience was still intoxicated by the melodious music of the four beautiful girls, and the backstage staff returned to normal order from the panic. A dozen actors of "When Flowers Bloom" were preparing to wait for the show. One of them was caught by the class mother Zhang Raoying, "Her hair is crooked, I want to help her fix it." Without any explanation, she immediately went to the aisle to fix the actor's headdress.

d38f68e487d5ad0436d80e1b42308ba1ae8f17cb.sourceText: 在这场演出中，不知道有多少叫不出名字的班妈，演员，演员家属，志愿者，正是他们台后无私的付出，数千观众才能在台前，获得这样一份如此精彩绝伦的新年礼物，而且是份让我们华人自豪，让美国朋友刮目相看的礼物！ ”我们是相亲相爱的一家人。。。。 ”《相亲相爱》的歌声中，2015春晚圆满落下帷幕。2015亚利桑那春晚总策划吕丽华，在此向所有参加2015亚利桑那春晚的朋友表示感谢，哪怕您奉献的只是掌声！没有您的参与我们的春晚不会如此精彩！
d38f68e487d5ad0436d80e1b42308ba1ae8f17cb.translatedText: In this performance, I don’t know how many class mothers, actors, actors’ families, and volunteers who cannot be named. It is their selfless dedication behind the stage that allowed thousands of viewers to receive such a wonderful New Year gift in front of the stage. It is a gift that makes us Chinese proud and makes our American friends look up to us! "We are a family that loves each other..." With the song "Love each other", the 2015 Spring Festival Gala came to a successful conclusion. Lu Lihua, the chief planner of the 2015 Arizona Spring Festival Gala, would like to express her gratitude to all friends who participated in the 2015 Arizona Spring Festival Gala, even if all you gave was applause! Without your participation our Spring Festival Gala would not be so exciting!

d7e2ae2bd2d7749ed41523339602ae2443e4da2b.sourceText: 随着亚利桑那州议会的进行，一些法案通过审批，进入下一步考虑程序。其中高中学生公民考试（civics test）尤其引人关注，此外该考试也展现了新州长Doug Ducey对州民民族意识和爱国意识的强调。
d7e2ae2bd2d7749ed41523339602ae2443e4da2b.translatedText: As the Arizona State Assembly proceeds, some bills have been approved and entered the next step of consideration. Among them, the citizenship test for high school students is particularly interesting. In addition, the test also shows the new governor Doug Ducey's emphasis on the national consciousness and patriotism of the state's people.

db3b6eef0ce0a2e7a91ce648defe94c3ef8f5e4a.sourceText: 参议院和众议院教育委员会在周四早进行了听证会，全众议院在当天下午对该法案进行了辩论和投票，而参议员据悉也将对此作出反应。
db3b6eef0ce0a2e7a91ce648defe94c3ef8f5e4a.translatedText: The Senate and House of Representatives Education Committees held hearings on Thursday morning, and the entire House of Representatives debated and voted on the bill that afternoon, and senators are expected to react to it.

fdbe2523f54edb07c9bcae52a16d1e7b82248bf0.sourceText: 众议院的Bill 2064 以及 参议员的 Bill 1029已经通过审批确立下来，并将很快递送至Ducey由其表态。
fdbe2523f54edb07c9bcae52a16d1e7b82248bf0.translatedText: The House of Representatives' Bill 2064 and the Senator's Bill 1029 have been approved and will be sent to Ducey soon for his stance.

088679560cc868c60ec41e5b3a7cd2f3a4813108.sourceText: 这两条法案要求学生在国民考试100道题目中答对至少60题才能算一个合格的美国公民。而从2016-2017年的学生开始，通过此考试才能成功获得高中或GED文凭。
088679560cc868c60ec41e5b3a7cd2f3a4813108.translatedText: These two bills require students to answer at least 60 questions correctly out of 100 questions on the national exam to be considered a qualified American citizen. Starting in 2016-2017, students will need to pass this exam to successfully obtain a high school or GED diploma.

a7f4224ccb77953d99c3e3d59ba1dc8b5585732b.sourceText: Ducey对此表示，学生不仅要了解基本的国民知识，他们还需要称为优秀的美国公民。
a7f4224ccb77953d99c3e3d59ba1dc8b5585732b.translatedText: Ducey said that students not only need to understand basic national knowledge, they also need to be good American citizens.

86b387487bf3736c424a9f114ada5910925719c9.sourceText: ２０１５图桑春晚节目可以说是五彩缤纷，龙凤呈祥： 舞蹈，从TSD的《百花争妍》到youth的《蝶恋花》， 从Kelly 的《吉祥得勒》到陈凤的《中国味道》，从舞蹈动作到服装道具，无一不是美轮美奂，精心打造；武术， 今年由2位少林大师和4位UA舞蹈演员共同演绎西藏的《生命之源》；钱德勒交响乐团将按照”维也纳金色大厅新年音乐会”的风格演奏斯特劳斯的《蓝色多瑙河圆舞曲》， 并和年轻民乐演奏家们合作演出中国经典器乐作品《彝族舞曲》《秦王破阵乐》和《除夕》；最不可错过的，将是由中国戏曲学院教授涂玲慧领衔演唱的交响合唱版《梨花颂》厖保证你在美国其他地方看不到这样的春晚盛宴！
86b387487bf3736c424a9f114ada5910925719c9.translatedText: The 2015 Tucson Spring Festival Gala program can be said to be colorful, with dragons and phoenixes presenting auspiciousness: Dance, from TSD's "Hundred Flowers Bloom" to youth's "Butterfly Love Flower", from Kelly's "Auspicious Dele" to Chen Feng's "Taste of China", from dance moves to costumes and props, all are beautiful and carefully crafted; martial arts, This year, two Shaolin masters and four UA dancers will perform Tibet's "The Source of Life"; the Chandler Symphony Orchestra will perform Strauss's "Blue Danube Waltz" in the style of the "Vienna Musikverein New Year's Concert". We will also collaborate with young folk musicians to perform Chinese classic instrumental works "Dance of the Yi Nationality", "King of Qin's Breaking Formation Music" and "New Year's Eve"; the most unmissable one will be the symphonic choral version of "Ode to the Pear Blossom" sung by Tu Linghui, a professor at the China Academy of Opera. I guarantee you will not see such a Spring Festival Gala feast anywhere else in the United States!

f3337714b5c66149aedfabf57fe4b426247c46c8.sourceText: 2015年1月23日晚6时，亚利桑那共和党主席颁奖晚宴在喜来登酒店隆重举行。在过去六年，与记者参加过的所有主流政治活动相比，这次有一个让人欣喜而激动的景象。在共和党颁奖晚宴上，有近四分之一是亚裔面孔。而让这一切慢慢发生变化的是亚裔社区共同努的成果。当晚，亚利桑那共和党主席罗伯特 格雷厄姆（Robert S.Graham）将卓越奉献奖颁给前亚利桑那华裔众议员黄仕钧（Barry Wong）。
f3337714b5c66149aedfabf57fe4b426247c46c8.translatedText: At 6:00 pm on January 23, 2015, the Arizona Republican Party Chairman Award Dinner was held at the Sheraton Hotel. Compared with all the mainstream political events that journalists have attended in the past six years, this one offers a welcome and exciting sight. At the Republican awards dinner, nearly a quarter of the faces were Asian. What slowly changed all this was the joint efforts of the Asian community. That night, Arizona Republican Party Chairman Robert S. Graham awarded the Outstanding Contribution Award to former Arizona Chinese Representative Barry Wong.

c64a7d07ea1de35a595073b4e808ecd293427a2d.translatedText: Chairman Robert Graham and his wife presented the Outstanding Contribution Award to Huang Shijun (middle)

07d2c73a6ad892bcd2d18590c747c4cf843f0a79.sourceText: 在颁奖晚宴上出席了如此之多的亚裔面孔，当然直接与黄仕钧有关。黄仕钧告诉记者，最近几年来，他一直致力于在亚裔社区发展共和党党员，在社区建立基本的党组织，让更多人了解共和党。他总是鼓励关心政治的朋友加入到党派活动中来，我们看到了亚裔中非常活跃的侨领们的身影。例如华裔张圣儀（Michelle Chang）， 华裔黄馨民（Sam Huang），越南裔Kevin Dang，韩国裔Jae Chin, 菲律宾裔Marie Cuning,越南裔 MaiLe, 印度裔Venkat Kommineni,亚裔Einesh’Dan ‘Rama, 亚裔Astria Wong等等。
07d2c73a6ad892bcd2d18590c747c4cf843f0a79.translatedText: There were so many Asian faces present at the awards dinner, which were of course directly related to Huang Shijun. Huang Shijun told reporters that in recent years, he has been committed to developing Republican Party members in the Asian community, establishing basic party organizations in the community, and letting more people understand the Republican Party. He always encourages friends who care about politics to join party activities. We have seen very active overseas Chinese leaders among Asians. For example, Chinese-American Michelle Chang, Chinese-American Sam Huang, Vietnamese-American Kevin Dang, Korean-American Jae Chin, Filipino-American Marie Cuning, Vietnamese-American MaiLe, Indian-American Venkat Kommineni, Asian-American Einesh’Dan ‘Rama, Asian-American Astria Wong, etc.

08bb9f03dc4eec0d2948a1b2365d596658641a33.sourceText: 向黄仕钧表示祝贺的部分亚裔支持者 中华总会邱顺雄夫妇，中餐馆协会会长张华芳，侨联主席David Yee, 亚利桑那艺术学校校长吕丽华夫妇，侨联副主席崔增祺华裔社区的很多侨领都参加了此次活动。 在表彰餐会中，也出现了一个小插曲。某与会人员突然身体不适，昏厥，主席罗伯特 格雷厄姆停下手中一切事务，亲自守护在患者身边，呼打911等待救援。现场也相当有秩序，400多人迅速留出紧急通道，协助警察进行救护。
08bb9f03dc4eec0d2948a1b2365d596658641a33.translatedText: Some of the Asian supporters who congratulated Huang Shijun were Qiu Shunxiong and his wife of the Chinese Federation, Zhang Huafang, president of the Chinese Restaurant Association, David Yee, chairman of the Overseas Chinese Federation, Lu Lihua and his wife, principal of the Arizona Art School, Cui Zengqi, vice chairman of the Overseas Chinese Federation, and many overseas Chinese leaders from the Chinese community attended the event. There was also an episode during the commendation dinner. A participant suddenly felt unwell and fainted. Chairman Robert Graham stopped everything he was doing, stayed by the patient's side personally, and called 911 to await rescue. The scene was also quite orderly, with more than 400 people quickly setting aside emergency lanes to assist the police with rescue operations.

0d6bfaa5bb8cfdd82d58ef82d47ab208bc99e0f9.sourceText: 现场救护场景（左三身着蓝色西服的为主席罗伯特 格雷厄姆） 表彰大会热闹有序，让现场无党派人士看到共和党更加真实的一面。 2014年11月4日亚利桑那共和党囊括了８个州政府的管理席位，在参众议会也获得非常好的成绩，为了表彰在选举过程中表现突出的共和党内人士，亚利桑那共和党主席罗伯特 格雷厄姆特别隆重举办此次活动。
0d6bfaa5bb8cfdd82d58ef82d47ab208bc99e0f9.translatedText: On-site rescue scene (the third person from the left in a blue suit is Chairman Robert Graham) The commendation meeting was lively and orderly, allowing non-partisan people at the scene to see a more real side of the Republican Party. On November 4, 2014, the Arizona Republican Party captured 8 state government seats and also achieved very good results in the House of Representatives and the Senate. In order to commend the Republican Party members who performed outstandingly during the election process, Arizona Republican Party Chairman Robert Graham held this event with great solemnity.

Hance Park (East), 1202 N. 3rd Street, Phoenix, 85004 (位于凤凰城市中心图书馆东边) 免费入场/ 免费停车 详情请查看 http://www.phoenixchineseweek.org/2015-festival/ 上週末，中国週支持在凤凰城的乐器博物馆 (Musical Instrument Museum)筹办”体验中国”的大型活动：中国週安排传统和民族舞蹈表演，中国乐器合奏表演和武术演示。中国本週还设计让参与者自己製作中国灯笼及拨浪鼓。中国週还提供了一个教授中国书画的工作坊。这两天的活动有超过1600人参加, 为博物馆创新入场纪录,取得了巨大的成功。 希望中文学校表演 中华乐团表演 中国文化中的手工制作
1737b3ccc2ec72118082a61b0c35e1a3bb94a773.translatedText: >China Week 2015 New Year Celebration Activities Happy Year of the Sheep! Phoenix China Week celebrates its 25th anniversary this year. Over the years, China Monday has held a series of traditional cultural and social education activities to highlight the diverse culture of Chinese history and tradition. The annual 3-day festival attracts tens of thousands of visitors who love Chinese culture. Everyone can enjoy wonderful dragon and lion dance performances; martial arts demonstrations; singing and dancing musical instrument performances; traditional Chinese costume shows; art and culture, handicrafts, calligraphy and painting exhibitions; Tai Chi and Go competitions; mahjong demonstrations; purchase a variety of souvenirs and handicrafts and taste delicious authentic Chinese food; Date: February 13 to 15, 2015 Time: Friday 9:00am – 3:00pm Saturday: 10:00am – 5:00pm Sunday: 10:00am – 4:00pm Location: Margaret T. Hance Park (East), 1202 N. 3rd Street, Phoenix, 85004 (located east of Phoenix Downtown Library) Free admission/free parking See details http://www.phoenixchineseweek.org/2015-festival/ Last weekend, China Week supported the preparation of a large-scale "Experience China" event at the Musical Instrument Museum in Phoenix: China Week arranged traditional and ethnic dance performances, Chinese instrument ensemble performances and martial arts demonstrations. This week in China also designed for participants to make their own Chinese lanterns and rattles. China Week also offers a workshop teaching Chinese calligraphy and painting. The two-day event was attended by more than 1,600 people, setting a new admission record for the museum and achieving great success. 973578a392362f5ccee14829de1930470d405df1.sourceText: 凤凰城侨联举办的2015年华裔小姐选美取得了成功，有了许多新的突破。第一次由美国国庆日改在年初举办，方便了参选佳丽的参与和训练，为新的一年到来和迎接中国新年增添了欢乐气氛。大胆移师Casino 剧场，音响和灯光效果有很大改善，剧场使每个座位的观众都有良好的视角，不需要任何费用解决了近二百名老人的交通困难。聘请了ASU大学学生会主席朱博威同学和老一代的主持人Annie 共同主持节目，取得了极大成功，年轻主持人的风度、机智、幽默及国语、粤语、三种语言的交替，使每位观众的思维都和选美活动紧紧联繫在一起, 他的参与也增进了侨社和青年学子的联繫，不少ASU 的学生也来参加选美活动和做义工服务。总导演闻玲琳和艺术总监胡秋子的年轻组合展示出青春的活力，証明了青年将成功创造未来的真理，支持和发展青年人参加侨联的活动将给侨社带来新的活力。节目的安排也十分精彩和紧凑，古筝伴奏的古典舞蹈、小提琴合奏、优美的芭蕾和印第安传统园圈舞，个个有特色而且有髙水准，博得了观众热情的掌声。当然，作为主要内容的佳丽们的表演，人人都努力展示自己的美丽，才兿和聪明睿智，真是精彩纷呈。
973578a392362f5ccee14829de1930470d405df1.translatedText: The 2015 Miss Chinese beauty pageant organized by the Phoenix Overseas Chinese Federation was a success, with many new breakthroughs. For the first time, it was held from the Fourth of July to the beginning of the year, which facilitated the participation and training of contestants and added a joyful atmosphere to the arrival of the new year and the welcoming of the Chinese New Year. It was boldly moved to the Casino Theater, where the sound and lighting effects were greatly improved. The theater gave every seat of the audience a good viewing angle, and solved the transportation difficulties of nearly 200 elderly people at no cost. We hired ASU University Student Union Chairman Zhu Bowei and older generation host Annie to co-host the program, which was a great success. The young host's demeanor, wit, humor, and alternation of Mandarin, Cantonese, and three languages ​​made every audience member's thinking closely connected with the beauty pageant. His participation also enhanced the relationship between the overseas Chinese community and young students. Many ASU students also came to participate in the beauty pageant and provide volunteer services. The young combination of chief director Wen Linglin and artistic director Hu Qiuzi showed the vitality of youth and proved the truth that young people will successfully create the future. Supporting and developing young people to participate in the activities of the Overseas Chinese Federation will bring new vitality to the overseas Chinese community. The arrangement of the program was also very exciting and compact. Classical dance accompanied by guzheng, violin ensemble, beautiful ballet and traditional Indian circle dance were all unique and of high standard, winning enthusiastic applause from the audience. Of course, as the main content, the performances of the beauties, everyone strives to show their beauty, talent, intelligence and wisdom, are really exciting.

31f0856c3928cb8a5cfa62e1e0285fd6a0d12df5.sourceText: 选美活动司仪 方慧贤（左） 朱博威（右）
31f0856c3928cb8a5cfa62e1e0285fd6a0d12df5.translatedText: Beauty pageant emcee Fang Huixian (left) Zhu Bowei (right)

31fae426e15fe203b8e061baac29aa3517487bcb.sourceText: 当裁判评出2015年皇后是7号李博娅的时候，我想起了一件美丽动人的故事，也赞赏评委们的眼力。那是 2014年的九月，侨联在康乐大厦召开第一次佳丽见面会，当大家散会离去时，一位佳丽倒车时不小心碰倒了住在老人公寓的86岁的耿志萍老人。她扶着Walker正在院子里等女儿，不料被车碰倒在地。这时李博娅和她的父母亲见状立即跑过去，她的父亲用手托起老人的头部，慢慢地帮她坐起来，一直安抚她，问她有什麽不舒服？这时碰车的女孩子已不知所措，耿大姐是个心地善良的老妈妈，见孩子那惊慌的状态，顾不着自己的疼痛，却对那孩子说没什麽，快回家吧！这时李博娅和她的父母一直没有离开耿大姐，一边扶她慢慢地走回公寓门口坐在椅子上，一边又打电话联系耿的女儿，久久不愿离去，耿大姐十分感动，这件事引起我无限思绪，耿大姐和李博娅一家人的一举一动表现出人们内在的美德。近年看到中国有一些老人有意碰瓷讹诈和路人见老人跌倒不敢相扶的报导，李先生一家和耿大姐的形为与此形成显明的对照。耿大姐的腰本来不好，踫倒这一跤足足痛了好几天，也有皮肤受伤流血，但老大姐不讲这些，想的只是𣎴要让孩子为难。李博娅跟随好品德的父母，忙前忙后，传承了优良的品德。她在舞台上走出那坚毅稳健的步伐正是她内心善良和充满自信的表现。愿我们的皇后在新的一年里在为侨社的服务中更好地成长。
31fae426e15fe203b8e061baac29aa3517487bcb.translatedText: When the judges selected the 2015 queen as No. 7 Li Boya, I remembered a beautiful and touching story and admired the judges' vision. It was September 2014. The Overseas Chinese Federation held its first beauties meeting at the Kangle Building. When everyone was leaving the meeting, a beauty accidentally knocked down the 86-year-old Geng Zhiping who lived in an apartment for the elderly while reversing. She was supporting Walker and waiting for her daughter in the yard when she was hit by a car and fell to the ground. At this time, Li Boya and her parents ran over immediately when they saw this. Her father held up the old man's head with his hands, slowly helped her sit up, kept comforting her, and asked her what was wrong with her. At this time, the girl who hit the car was at a loss. Sister Geng was a kind-hearted old mother. Seeing the child's panic state, she ignored her own pain, but said to the child that it was nothing, go home quickly! At this time, Li Boya and her parents never left Sister Geng. While helping her slowly walk back to the door of the apartment and sit on a chair, they also called Geng's daughter. In recent years, we have seen reports that some elderly people in China intend to engage in blackmail and passers-by are afraid to help the elderly when they see them fall. The behavior of Mr. Li's family and Sister Geng is in stark contrast to this. Sister Geng's waist was not good at all. She fell down and her feet were in pain for several days. She also had skin injuries and bleeding. But the elder sister did not talk about these things. She only wanted to embarrass her child. Li Boya followed her parents with good moral character, worked hard and passed on her good moral character. The firm and steady steps she takes on the stage are a reflection of her inner kindness and confidence. May our queen grow better in her service to the overseas Chinese community in the new year.

4a56f25508a0c8d01273f69b7804dd113e5c2052.sourceText: 当我把李博娅当选皇后的消息告知耿大姐的时候，她十分高兴，并嘱咐我一定要转达她对李先生、屈宁（妈妈）和李博娅的衷心祝贺。
4a56f25508a0c8d01273f69b7804dd113e5c2052.translatedText: When I told Sister Geng that Li Boya was elected queen, she was very happy and asked me to convey her heartfelt congratulations to Mr. Li, Qu Ning (mother) and Li Boya.

be684ada5b31834208afc6ff2f4faccc97f145f4.translatedText: Earlier in the day, after preparing to predict a rise in temperature in Phoenix, the National Weather Service also reminded citizens that this would be the best day of the week: on the following Thursday, the temperature dropped to 65-70 degrees Fahrenheit with hazy and cloudy weather, while the night temperature dropped to 41-49 degrees Fahrenheit.

3873598c62681c72fb5b63c9e784e3bd9fa06229.sourceText: 10月大凤凰城房屋的价格和销售量持平，但是出售房屋的数量上升。”我们已经看到大凤凰城房屋市场去年的一点变化，价格越来越稳定。”亚利桑那州立大学凯利商学院房地产中心的主任表示。 从2012年到2013年凤凰城75%的房屋价格都上升。十月房屋的中值为二十万八千，比九月下降了1%。九月的中值为二十万九千九百。2006年房地产最高峰时期的均价为二十六万七千。到2011跌到最低点，中值为十一万七千。 十月份有6749套房子被销售，比九月份多卖了1%。11月房地产市场上有25953套房子在销售。价格上涨了6%。
3873598c62681c72fb5b63c9e784e3bd9fa06229.translatedText: Phoenix home prices and sales were flat in October, but the number of homes sold rose. "We've seen a little bit of change in the greater Phoenix housing market over the last year, with prices becoming more stable," said the director of the Real Estate Center at Arizona State University's Kelley School of Business. From 2012 to 2013, 75% of Phoenix home prices increased. The median home value in October was $28,000, down 1% from September. The median value for September was two hundred ninety-nine thousand. In 2006, the average real estate price at its peak was 267,000. By 2011 it had reached its lowest point, with a median value of 117,000. There were 6,749 homes sold in October, 1% more than in September. There were 25,953 homes for sale on the real estate market in November. Prices increased by 6%.

0e344bdc9d835605b1fce4e91196da2788ff2fcd.sourceText: 全美上下寒风袭人，唯有亚利桑那春光一片，昨天中午（２０１５年１月５日）共和党州长候选人在州府举办了就职宣誓典礼，成为了亚利桑那州第23任州长，新的州政府领导团队也宣誓就职，首次与市民见面。 Doug Ducey是前一任州政府的财务厅长，也是甜品Cold Stone前执行董事长。据Doug Ducey介绍Cold Stone在中国的北京和上海都有分店。Doug Ducey从筹备竞选州长开始，都一直受到华人社区的关注和支持。2014年10月4日华裔社区专门为Doug Ducey组织了募款早餐会。Doug Ducey在就职演讲上表示，将会为亚利桑那市民提供更多的机会，包括工作和生活；进行教育改革，让更多的家庭过上有质量的生活。昨天华人社区的政界人士和社区侨领都到现场为新的州政府团队支持喝彩。州参议员余艳芬以及她的父亲，前众议院黄仕均，钱德勒公共关系委员张圣仪，亚省中华总会会长邱顺雄夫妇，前白宫亚太裔委员会委员邓朝驹，台湾侨委会侨务咨询委员高志中，亚太委员会Albert Lin，侨联副主席崔增祁等亚裔朋友都一一到场表示祝贺。黄仕均和张圣仪与州长以及夫人合影留念。
0e344bdc9d835605b1fce4e91196da2788ff2fcd.translatedText: Across the country, the cold wind was blowing, but only Arizona was a scene of spring. Yesterday at noon (January 5, 2015), the Republican gubernatorial candidate held an oath of office ceremony at the state capital, becoming the 23rd governor of Arizona. The new state government leadership team was also sworn in and met with the citizens for the first time. Doug Ducey is the former state government's finance minister and the former executive chairman of dessert Cold Stone. According to Doug Ducey, Cold Stone has branches in Beijing and Shanghai in China. Doug Ducey has been receiving attention and support from the Chinese community since he was preparing to run for governor. On October 4, 2014, the Chinese community organized a fundraising breakfast specifically for Doug Ducey. In his inaugural speech, Doug Ducey said that he will provide Arizona citizens with more opportunities, including work and life, and carry out educational reforms so that more families can live a quality life. Yesterday, politicians and overseas Chinese leaders from the Chinese community came to the scene to applaud the new state government team for their support. State Senator Yu Yanfen and her father, former House of Representatives Huang Shijun, Chandler Public Relations Committee member Zhang Shengyi, President of the Chinese Association of Alberta Qiu Shunxiong and his wife, former White House Asian and Pacific Islander Council member Deng Chaoju, Taiwan Overseas Chinese Affairs Advisory Committee Gao Zhizhong, Asia Pacific Committee Albert Lin, Vice Chairman of the Overseas Chinese Federation Cui Zengqi and other Asian friends came to express their congratulations. Huang Shijun and Zhang Shengyi took photos with the governor and his wife.

c46a200752262d4ae7cddf3ce37ca2a82ab51c23.sourceText: 图片新闻： 他乡也有团圆宴–亚省华联(UCAA)”中秋团圆晚宴” 火热度：1278 9月21日星期日晚上，亚省华联在第8届庆中秋迎国庆”凤凰之夜”顺利落下帷幕后首次推出”中秋团圆晚宴”。第一次举办的”中秋团圆晚宴”就得到亚利桑那州华人华侨各社团机构和美国其他族裔社区的热烈响应。在晚宴大厅席内，新老朋好友把盏祝福，叙旧言欢，笑语欢声，和美温馨。亚利桑那州财务长、今年亚利桑那州州长竞选夺标呼声极高的共和党提名候选人Doug Ducey先生出席晚宴并致词向华人社区表达衷心的节日祝愿；Scottsdale 市长Jim Lane先生祝福这个华人家庭团聚的节日，他谈到，Scottsdale与海口市建立了姐妹城市关系，两市密切互动交流，把世界的不同视角带到一起。亚省中餐馆协会会长张华芳女士盛赞亚省各华人华侨团体彼此支持鼓励，共同服务亚省华人社区的优良传统。年近80的老侨、《亚省时报》社长甄硕钦老先生动情地回忆了华人侨社越做越好。
c46a200752262d4ae7cddf3ce37ca2a82ab51c23.translatedText: Photo News: There is also a reunion banquet in a foreign land – Hualian of Alberta (UCAA) "Mid-Autumn Festival Reunion Dinner" Popularity: 1278 On the evening of Sunday, September 21st, the Alberta Hualian launched the "Mid-Autumn Reunion Dinner" for the first time after the 8th "Phoenix Night" to celebrate the Mid-Autumn Festival and the National Day came to a successful conclusion. The first "Mid-Autumn Festival Reunion Dinner" was held and received enthusiastic response from various Chinese organizations in Arizona and other ethnic communities in the United States. In the banquet hall, old and new friends held candles and gave blessings, reminiscing about old times, laughing and cheering, creating harmony and warmth. Mr. Doug Ducey, Arizona State Treasurer and the Republican nominee with a strong claim to win this year's Arizona gubernatorial election, attended the dinner and delivered a speech to express his heartfelt holiday wishes to the Chinese community; Mr. Jim Lane, Mayor of Scottsdale, blessed this holiday for Chinese family reunions. He said that Scottsdale has established a sister city relationship with Haikou City, and the two cities interact closely and bring different perspectives of the world together. Ms. Zhang Huafang, President of the Chinese Restaurant Association of Alberta, praised the fine traditions of various Chinese and overseas Chinese groups in the province to support and encourage each other and jointly serve the Chinese community in the province. Mr. Zhen Shuoqin, an overseas Chinese who is nearly 80 years old and the president of "Alberta Times", recalled with emotion that the Chinese overseas Chinese community is doing better and better.
