3d4e951e2e15ef15c6d064e60d4e0dfeb1919fa9.sourceText: 为了落实国民党中央关于海外党部积极参与侨务工作，并配合台湾七合一选举，及推动党员和侨胞回台投票，谨定于3月22日上午11点，在Mandarin Super Buffet召开直属分部2014年第二次工作会议，征求党员对侨务工作的看法和意见，听取党员在侨社工作中遇到的困难和问题，并将所有讨论结果和提出建议用署名的方式汇报国民党海外部。
3d4e951e2e15ef15c6d064e60d4e0dfeb1919fa9.translatedText: In order to implement the Kuomintang Central Committee’s policy on overseas party offices to actively participate in overseas Chinese affairs, to cooperate with Taiwan’s seven-in-one election, and to promote party members and overseas Chinese to return to Taiwan to vote, we are hereby scheduled to hold a meeting at Mandarin Super at 11 a.m. on March 22 Buffet convened the second working meeting of the directly affiliated branch in 2014 to solicit party members’ views and opinions on overseas Chinese affairs, listen to the difficulties and problems encountered by party members in the work of overseas Chinese communities, and report all discussion results and suggestions to the Kuomintang Overseas Department in the form of signatures.

9000a7c11f1af501a0e19163228369f7e33d01ea.sourceText: 亚利桑那州华裔少年曲嘉禾全国鸭邮总决赛获奖（图）火热度：1243 在全国鸭邮绘画总决赛中，来自Chandler15岁的华裔少年曲嘉禾（Jiahe Qu）以精湛的画技绘制的连帽秋沙鸭荣获全国第三名。这是自美国国会1994年创办青少年鸭邮比赛以来亚省选手第一次荣获全国前三名。作为全国的获胜者，除了将获得政府颁发的奖金外，其作品将在全国巡回展出一年，曲嘉禾及其家长也将获邀请免费前往华盛顿参加全国的庆典活动。曲嘉禾自幼酷爱绘画，曾多次在各种绘画比赛中获奖。
9000a7c11f1af501a0e19163228369f7e33d01ea.translatedText: Qu Jiahe, a Chinese-American boy from Arizona won the National Duck Stamp Finals (picture) Popularity: 1243 In the National Duck Stamp Painting Finals, Qu Jiahe, a 15-year-old Chinese boy from Chandler The hooded merganser painted by Qu) won third place in the country with his superb painting skills. This is the first time since the U.S. Congress established the youth duck mail competition in 1994 that an Alberta athlete has won the top three in the country. As a national winner, in addition to receiving a prize from the government, his or her work will be exhibited nationwide for one year. Qu Jiahe and his parents will also be invited to Washington for free to participate in national celebrations. Qu Jiahe has loved painting since he was a child and has won many awards in various painting competitions.

2b59422370b80c90d1e6e7314aa34282771228ed.sourceText: 张肇鸿：虎狼抢钱，华人小心破财！火热度：987 1月25日，约了几位老友到”新世界酒楼”饮茶。茶市兴旺，席无虚座。饮完茶后，正准备达上归程之际，忽然闻得友人的LUX轿车在停车场内不翼而飞，众人惊讶，连忙四方寻找，但遍查不获。光天化日竟有偷车贼如此猖獗乎？此时亦惊动了新世界酒楼经理前来帮忙，她发现在失车区域中有一灯柱上，贴有一块小到不能再小的广告(图1蓝线区)，前去细看，方知道是警告非专属用户不得在此泊车，否则会被强行拖走。
2b59422370b80c90d1e6e7314aa34282771228ed.translatedText: Zhang Zhaohong: Tigers and wolves grab money, Chinese people be careful about losing money! Popularity: 987 On January 25, I made an appointment with some old friends to have tea at the "New World Restaurant". The tea market is booming and every seat is packed. After drinking tea, as they were preparing to return home, they suddenly heard that their friend's LUX car was missing from the parking lot. Everyone was surprised and searched everywhere, but could not find it. Are car thieves so rampant in broad daylight? At this time, the manager of New World Restaurant was alerted and came to help. She found an extremely small advertisement posted on a lamppost in the area where the car was lost (blue line area in Figure 1). When she went to take a closer look, she realized that it was warning non-exclusive users not to park here, otherwise they would be forcibly towed away.

de71a83069b2b55b18ca73cc9d80465ac000203e.sourceText: 希望中文学校：硕果满枝辞旧岁 意气风发迎新年 火热度：976 凤凰城里春来早，欢歌笑语在希望！在辞旧迎新之际，亚省希望中文学校于一月二十五日晚在凤城酒家举行2014马年春节晚宴。倏然间，岁月的年轮在不经意中又多划了一圈。我们满怀着喜悦挥手告别硕果累累的2013年，带着执着与追求迎來新的一年。2013年是希望中文学校办学十九年来特别的一年，学校荣获国务院侨务办公室颁发的”海外华文教育示范学校”的光荣称号, 建立了学校图书馆华星书屋并开始启动, 严婕娅同学赢得2014亚省最杰出女青少年比赛冠军, 学生在各种大赛中获得好成绩。 谢小红校长回顾和总结了即将过去的一年,感谢师生, 家长和义工们的努力,支持和无私奉献。
de71a83069b2b55b18ca73cc9d80465ac000203e.translatedText: Hope Chinese School: Bid farewell to the old year with fruitful fruits and welcome the new year with high spirits Popularity: 976 Spring has come early in Phoenix, and joy and laughter are in hope! On the occasion of bidding farewell to the old year and welcoming the new, Alberta Hope Chinese School held the 2014 Year of the Horse Spring Festival Dinner at Fengcheng Restaurant on the evening of January 25th. Suddenly, the annual rings of the years made another circle inadvertently. We wave goodbye to the fruitful 2013 with joy and welcome the new year with persistence and pursuit. 2013 is a special year for Hope Chinese School in its 19th year of operation. The school won the honorary title of "Overseas Chinese Education Demonstration School" issued by the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the State Council. The school library Huaxing Bookstore was established and started. Yan Jieya won the 2014 Alberta Most Outstanding Female Youth Competition. Students have achieved good results in various competitions. Principal Xie Xiaohong reviewed and summarized the past year and thanked teachers, students, parents and volunteers for their efforts, support and selfless dedication.

95e3fea8cc47cb296fa99ed3a3b31d0a810258f9.sourceText: 希望中文学校2014年毕业典礼（组图）火热度：970 （希望中文学校5/11/2014供稿）2014年5月4日，希望中文学校一年一度的毕业颁奖典礼又如期举行。为了有更大更好的舞台，学校今年特地移师Rhodes Junior High School的礼堂来举办, 无论从舞台到灯光，再到音响设备，都能与专业水平相媲美。即使礼堂比原来大了很多，但是现场依旧座无虚席，学生和家长盛装出席，欢声笑语充满整场盛会。

In order to have a bigger and better stage, the school specially moved to the auditorium of Rhodes Junior High School this year. From the stage to the lighting to the sound equipment, it can be compared with professional standards. Even though the auditorium was much larger than before, the venue was still full. Students and parents attended in costumes and filled the entire event with laughter and laughter.

0b2f86c8072f6a1d4bb9260c0d47e50a85401822.sourceText: 400多嘉宾出席”亚太之美”晚宴 为亚太居民健康募款 火热度：721 2014年5月10日，由亚太社区促进会（Asian Pacific Community in Action）主办的第九届”亚太之美”募款晚宴，在Scottsdale doubletree酒店隆重落下帷幕。来自亚利桑那亚太社区的成员，政府官员，医疗保健企业400多嘉宾共襄盛举。为长期致力于亚太社区健康事业的St.Luke健康基金会，华裔知名脊椎微创医生杨桐，菲律宾裔注册护师Josefina ”Jo”Barone颁奖，感谢他们卓越的专业技术给病患带来的福音，更感谢他们为亚裔社区健康事业贡献的时间和资金。
0b2f86c8072f6a1d4bb9260c0d47e50a85401822.translatedText: More than 400 guests attended the "Beauty of Asia and the Pacific" dinner to raise funds for the health of Asia and Pacific residents Popularity: 721 On May 10, 2014, the ninth "Beauty of Asia Pacific" fundraising dinner hosted by the Asian Pacific Community in Action came to a grand conclusion at the Scottsdale DoubleTree Hotel. More than 400 guests from Arizona’s Asian Pacific community, government officials, and healthcare companies attended the event. The St. Luke Health Foundation, which has long been committed to the health of the Asian-Pacific community, presented the award to the well-known Chinese minimally invasive spine doctor Yang Tong and the Filipino registered nurse Josefina “Jo” Barone. They thanked them for the benefits their excellent professional skills have brought to patients, and thanked them for their contribution of time and funds to the health of the Asian community.

eb2346b95da0d9aafe0361291b25bf49bcd9a142.sourceText: 喷泉山的灯彩盛会（图）火热度：675 从1月31日至2月9日，中国扬州市在美国亚利桑那州的喷泉山公园(Fountain Park, Fountain Hills, AZ)举办灯彩盛会，共摆设了20组传统花灯。花灯多以民俗题材为主，如福禄寿、八仙、孙悟空、运财童子，也有白雪公主和７个小矮人等。各种人物、花卉和建筑造形的花灯的高度在2米至12米，夜间现场灯火辉煌，并有水中莲花灯与数十米高的喷泉相互辉映。扬州花灯代表中国花灯至高製作水平，有最强大的製作阵容。也是赴美的花灯近年来规模最大的一次。
eb2346b95da0d9aafe0361291b25bf49bcd9a142.translatedText: The lantern festival at Fountain Hill (picture) Popularity: 675 From January 31st to February 9th, Yangzhou City, China, in Fountain Park (Fountain Park, Arizona, USA) Fountain Hills, AZ) held a lantern festival, with a total of 20 groups of traditional lanterns displayed. Most of the lanterns are based on folk themes, such as fortune, longevity, the Eight Immortals, Sun Wukong, the Lucky Boy, Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs, etc. The height of the lanterns with various figures, flowers and architectural shapes ranges from 2 to 12 meters. The scene is brilliantly lit at night, with lotus lanterns in the water and fountains tens of meters high reflecting each other. Yangzhou lanterns represent the highest production level of Chinese lanterns and have the most powerful production lineup. It is also the largest lantern trip to the United States in recent years.

8036862ba819f0cdd30c44a59e349c7388786841.translatedText: The weather around you: A sea of clouds appears in the Grand Canyon, and AZ will receive rainfall on Friday Recently, in Arizona's Grand Canyon National Park, thick cumulus clouds filled the canyon, and the deep...

20b12c21b3c7f52dfc7f089951458a3c380463fe.sourceText: 近日，在亚利桑那州的大峡谷国家公园，厚重的积云填满了峡谷，和深红色的广袤山脉相映成趣，俊美壮阔。这样奇特的天气现象吸引了大批游客驻足欣赏。 据相关天气部门估测，积云可能一直停留保持到本周四才会逐渐消散。 国家天气服务中心的 Cory Mottice介绍说，这样的气象奇观一般几年才会出现一次，然后这是大峡谷紧随去年第二次出现这样的现象。
20b12c21b3c7f52dfc7f089951458a3c380463fe.translatedText: Recently, in Arizona's Grand Canyon National Park, thick cumulus clouds filled the canyon, contrasting with the vast crimson mountains, creating a beautiful and majestic scene. Such a strange weather phenomenon attracted a large number of tourists to stop and admire. According to estimates from relevant weather departments, the cumulus clouds may stay until Thursday and then gradually dissipate. Cory Mottice of the National Weather Service said that such a weather spectacle usually only occurs once every few years, and this is the second time such a phenomenon has occurred in the Grand Canyon following last year.

3d5b4bdbcd0bd631ff5df54f3087e31837175aa1.sourceText: 此外，大量的水汽从加州席卷入境，将在本周五晚给亚省带来阵雨甚至一些降雪，气温将有大幅度的下降。请朋友们注意添加衣物，防止受凉。
3d5b4bdbcd0bd631ff5df54f3087e31837175aa1.translatedText: In addition, a large amount of water vapor swept in from California, which will bring showers and even some snowfall to Alberta on Friday night, and the temperature will drop significantly. Friends, please pay attention to add clothing to prevent catching cold.

289dd810f7dc0bf48db1ba4fc37e14027493632c.sourceText: 【协会秘书处供稿】全美中文学校协会定于2014年12月12日至14日在美国亚利桑那州凤凰城举行第10次年会年会暨华文教育研讨会。届时散布在四十多个州的会员学校代表将共聚一堂，同庆二十年来协会在中文教育、弘扬中华文化及社区服务等方面的成果，共襄发展北美华文教育盛举。
289dd810f7dc0bf48db1ba4fc37e14027493632c.translatedText: [Contributed by the Association Secretariat] At that time, representatives of member schools scattered in more than 40 states will gather together to celebrate the association's achievements in Chinese education, promotion of Chinese culture and community services over the past 20 years, and to jointly develop Chinese education in North America.

625e55d6f6ebdd6a6ced1282aaefeab163fa102e.sourceText: 全美中文学校协会成立二十年来，秉承服务于美国各地的中文学校和华人社区、弘扬中华文化、促进美中文化交流和民间友好往来的宗旨，为协会的五百多所会员学校、十余万名各族裔青少年学生和八千多名教师员工竭诚服务，在祖籍国和北美社会各界鼎力支持下，成为统领千军万马推进北美华文业余教育事业蓬勃发展的主要力量，成为北美主流社会不可忽略的重要组成部分。据了解，近年来全世界到处都出现中文热，华文教育和在世界各地蓬勃发展。即使如此，也只有全美中文学校协会这样致力于华文教育的大陆新移民草根组织能够在二十年中，定期举办全国性华文教育年会，使得北美华文业余教育事业日新月异，蒸蒸日上，延绵不绝。在即将召开的第十次全国代表大会暨华文教育研讨会将对协会二十年的工作进行深入研讨和总结，集思广益、凝聚力量、制定战略，推进北美华文教育事业更好地发展。
625e55d6f6ebdd6a6ced1282aaefeab163fa102e.translatedText: Since its establishment 20 years ago, the National Association of Chinese Schools has been adhering to the purpose of serving Chinese schools and Chinese communities across the United States, promoting Chinese culture, and promoting cultural exchanges and friendly people-to-people exchanges between the United States and China. It has provided services to more than 500 member schools and ten schools of the association. More than 10,000 young students of all ethnic groups and more than 8,000 teachers and staff serve wholeheartedly. With the full support of their home countries and all walks of life in North America, they have become the main force leading thousands of troops to promote the vigorous development of Chinese amateur education in North America, and have become an important part of mainstream North American society that cannot be ignored. It is understood that in recent years, there has been a craze for Chinese language all over the world, and Chinese education is booming all over the world. Even so, only the National Association of Chinese Schools, a grassroots organization of new immigrants from mainland China dedicated to Chinese education, has been able to hold regular national annual Chinese education conferences over the past two decades, making the Chinese amateur education industry in North America ever-changing, prosperous and continuous. At the upcoming 10th National Congress and Chinese Education Seminar, the association will have an in-depth discussion and summary of the twenty years of work, brainstorm, gather strength, formulate strategies, and promote the better development of Chinese education in North America.

1fbd9f800ecdba8dc1022cf4c59cbc52b75abae6.sourceText: 本次大会适逢协会20周年华诞。不但是协会有了成熟的发展经验，众多会员学校也有了教学和管理方面的丰富经验。因此，本次华文教育研讨会将更注重当前华文教育普遍关注的共同课题，注重总结和分享华文教育的实际经验，力求选题实际有效，安排紧凑合理，让到会人员收获丰盛，满载而归；通过本次大会，切实推进全美国的华文教育进一步向纵深发展！
1fbd9f800ecdba8dc1022cf4c59cbc52b75abae6.translatedText: This conference coincides with the 20th anniversary of the association. Not only does the association have mature development experience, but many member schools also have rich experience in teaching and management. Therefore, this Chinese education seminar will pay more attention to the common issues that are generally concerned about Chinese education, focus on summarizing and sharing the practical experience of Chinese education, and strive to select practical and effective topics, and the arrangement is compact and reasonable, so that the participants will gain a rich harvest and leave with a full load; through this conference, we will effectively promote the further development of Chinese education in the United States!

e9396dfc8c9d0ae6add8a3547c382fa48ba94cc0.sourceText: 大会将邀请中美两国政界和华文教育界的名人大师到大会演讲，以开拓思路，发掘和利用多方面的资源；大会将安排华文教育相关的多个领域和课题的著名专家学者讲座，包括AP中文考试，教材教法等方面；大会将请现有的全美各地的近20所”华文教育示范学校”现身说法，分享办学发展历程和成功的经验；大会也将更注重广大会员在教学和管理第一线累积的各种经验，根据多次问卷调查和分析，深入了解了大家普遍关注的课题，划分为以下六个专题， 广泛交流和深入探讨。 1、 中文学校管理 2、 中文教育和中文学校发展 3、 中文课程和教材研究 4、 中文教学方法经验交流 5、 教学评估 6、 中文教育的社会环境 除了以上多个专题探讨以外，协会也将表彰过去两年来协会工作参与奖， 和全美华文教育优秀工作奖， 优秀教师奖等。协会还将举行会务工作总结，回顾会务发展经验，制定进一步发展的愿景规划， 并且将选举产生第11届理事会。
e9396dfc8c9d0ae6add8a3547c382fa48ba94cc0.translatedText: The conference will invite famous masters from the political circles and Chinese education circles of China and the United States to give speeches at the conference to expand ideas, explore and utilize various resources; the conference will arrange lectures by famous experts and scholars in multiple fields and topics related to Chinese education, including AP Chinese exams, textbooks and teaching methods, etc.; Nearly 20 existing "Chinese Education Demonstration Schools" across the United States will be invited to speak out and share their school development history and successful experiences. The conference will also pay more attention to the various experiences accumulated by members on the front line of teaching and management. Based on multiple questionnaire surveys and analysis, it will gain an in-depth understanding of topics of common concern, which are divided into the following six topics. Communicate extensively and discuss in depth. 1. Chinese school management 2. Chinese education and Chinese school development 3. Research on Chinese curriculum and teaching materials 4. Exchange of experience in Chinese teaching methods 5. Teaching evaluation 6. Social environment of Chinese education In addition to the above topics, the association will also honor the association’s work participation award in the past two years, and the National Chinese Education Outstanding Work Award, Outstanding Teacher Award, etc. The association will also hold a summary of conference work, review conference development experience, formulate a vision plan for further development, and elect the 11th Board of Directors.

9ea8fa8a7684045f0352a73466a23a736bfaaf3b.sourceText: 据悉，今年的年会由现任理事会主导筹备工作，当地八所中文學组成的执行委员会承担了许多后勤服务，各僑團組織給予大会積極的支持。 整个筹备工作从2014年初就开始，有条不紊，步步推进，目前已经有300多名各界代表报名参加，达到一个新的高峰。参加大会的会员学校总数也将达到新高。 在上世纪八十年代末兴起的华文业余教育的大潮以来，各成员学校不懈地开拓进取，广大教师、家长、教育工作者为建设具有北美特色的华文业余教育事业前赴后继、兢兢业业，曾经做出巨大的贡献，甚至也曾付出过生命的代价。让我们的子孙和各族裔的孩子们学会华文，传承、弘扬博大精深的中华文化，是功在千秋的宏伟事业，也是建设伟大中华民族软实力的大业，但是要建成科学的、成熟的华文业余教育体系则道路艰辛、曲折，任重道远。让我们共同关注、关心、投入这项伟大事业，开创出更加璀璨的北美业余华文教育新天地！
9ea8fa8a7684045f0352a73466a23a736bfaaf3b.translatedText: It is reported that the current council is leading the preparations for this year's annual conference. The executive committee composed of eight local Chinese schools has undertaken many logistical services. Various overseas Chinese organizations have given active support to the conference. The entire preparatory work began in early 2014 and has been progressing step by step in an orderly manner. Currently, more than 300 representatives from all walks of life have signed up to participate, reaching a new peak. The total number of member schools participating in the conference will also reach a new high. Since the rise of Chinese amateur education in the late 1980s, all member schools have been forging ahead unremittingly. Teachers, parents, and educators have worked hard to build a Chinese amateur education with North American characteristics. They have made great contributions and even paid the price with their lives. Letting our children and grandchildren and children of all ethnic groups learn Chinese, inherit and carry forward the extensive and profound Chinese culture, is a grand cause that will last forever, and is also a great cause of building the soft power of the great Chinese nation. However, the road to building a scientific and mature Chinese amateur education system is arduous, tortuous, and has a long way to go. Let us pay attention, care and invest in this great cause together, and create a more brilliant new world of amateur Chinese education in North America!

43aed29fbaf66f5c274a827df289345289986064.sourceText: 12月6日下午，菲匿中文学校的学生在完成了期末攷试后，学生们欢喜雀跃地和家长、老师们一起举行了年终结业派对。各班级的同学以表演的形式展示了他们的学习成果。孩子们表演了朗诵唐诗、玩游戏、唱中文歌曲、自报姓名和说出学好中文愿望等，武术班的孩子在老师带领下忽而趴下，忽而跃起，如生龙活虎，博得全塲喝彩。绘画班的学生也将这学期的好作品展示在牆上，驻足覌看栩栩如生的秃鹰和美丽的沙漠风光，人们赞许孩子们的想象力和绘画技兿的进步。学校董事长Eva 李主持了结业典礼，典礼开始，全体师生为不幸因病逝世的余咏谕老师黙哀，对她长期为学校作出的贡献永志怀念，她的音容笑貌永留我们心间。 大鳯凰城侨联一贯重视和支持菲匿中文学校的成长和发展。今天，侨领余文劲先生、侨联前主席张华芳、副主席张肇鸿、邓洪钺和热心教育事业的余妈妈等侨领都出席了结业典礼并观看了孩子们的表演。中餐馆协㑹送来了匹萨，余氏宗亲会送来了饮料，欣欣超市赖经理赠送200元礼券给孩子们买了又香又脆的食品，六福酒家的陆老板给学校义工和老师赠送了就歺礼券，感谢大家为教育事业作出的奉献。 典礼结束前，校长助理谢大卫展示了他从中国专门买来并赠送给学校的练习写毛笔字的乾布，并表演了书法技兿。’字如其人’ 。写好中国字是学习中文的重要部分，下学期学校将增设毛笔字班，帮助学生提高写字的功力。 典礼在欢笑声中结束。人们互祝圣诞快乐，新年快乐，假日玩得开心，并相互提醒，别忘了过了元旦，一月三号新学期就要开学。（菲匿中文学校供稿）
43aed29fbaf66f5c274a827df289345289986064.translatedText: On the afternoon of December 6th, after the students of the Finnish Chinese School completed their final exams, the students happily held a year-end graduation party with their parents and teachers. Students from each class showed their learning achievements in the form of performances. The children performed reciting Tang poems, played games, sang Chinese songs, reported their names and expressed their desire to learn Chinese well. Under the leadership of the teacher, the children in the martial arts class suddenly lay down and suddenly jumped up, like a lively dragon, which won the applause of the whole crowd. Students in the painting class also displayed their best works from this semester on the wall. They stopped to look at the lifelike bald eagles and the beautiful desert scenery. People praised the children's imagination and progress in painting skills. Eva Li, the school's chairman, presided over the graduation ceremony. At the beginning of the ceremony, all the teachers and students mourned for the teacher Yu Yongyu who unfortunately passed away due to illness. She will always remember her long-term contribution to the school. Her voice and smile will always be in our hearts. The Overseas Chinese Federation of Daluohuangcheng has always attached great importance to and supported the growth and development of Feini Chinese School. Today, overseas Chinese leaders Mr. Yu Wenjin, former Chairman of the Overseas Chinese Federation Zhang Huafang, Vice Chairman Zhang Zhaohong, Deng Hongyue and Yu’s mother who is enthusiastic about education all attended the graduation ceremony and watched the children’s performances. The Chinese Restaurant Association sent pizza, the Yu Clan Association sent drinks, Xinxin Supermarket manager Lai gave 200 yuan gift certificates to buy fragrant and crispy food for the children, and Luk Fook Restaurant boss Lu gave breakfast gift certificates to school volunteers and teachers, thanking everyone for their contribution to education. Before the ceremony ended, Assistant Principal David Xie showed off the dry cloth he bought from China and presented to the school for practicing calligraphy, and performed calligraphy skills. 'Words are like people'. Writing Chinese characters well is an important part of learning Chinese. Next semester, the school will add calligraphy classes to help students improve their writing skills. The ceremony ended with laughter. People wish each other a Merry Christmas, a Happy New Year, and have fun during the holidays, and remind each other that after New Year's Day, the new semester will start on January 3rd. (Contributed by Feinian Chinese School)

9e352208247fa4f33bd8584081d8b9ddb374e3fb.sourceText: 我们停靠在库拉索（CURACAO) ，据资料介绍，是一座位于加勒比海南部，靠近委内瑞拉海岸的岛屿，该岛原为荷属安的列斯群岛的一部分。2010年10月10日后改制为荷兰王国的自治国。库拉索首府是港口城市威廉市（Willemstad），过去也是荷属安的列斯的首府。库拉索与邻近的阿鲁巴（Aruba）(我们下次停靠的岛屿)与波内赫（Bonaire）经常被合称为”ABC群岛”。 这里经济不算发达，主要以旅游业和与其相关的产业，以及炼油及海外银行业。是一个彩色的小国，美丽缤纷的荷兰殖民时期的建筑倒映在湛蓝的海水上。可以在当地尝尝委内瑞拉的啤酒。库拉索旗帜底色为蓝色，在下部有一条黄色条纹，左上方有两颗白色五角星。邮轮停靠时间，从下午1：00pm至夜晚11:00pm 。我们吃过午饭就三家一起下船，由于我的脚不易长途行走，更不能下海水游泳，怕不小心再感染，所以决定让二哥和关先生、张先生两家共9人乘一辆中巴士去一个海水浴埸，我与先生在临近码头的市区商业街转转，拍一下当地的风俗优美风景。 我们邮轮在向库拉索停靠时，看到一座高大无比、雄伟壮观的高架桥，下了邮轮向高架桥走去，谁知高架桥横垮南北，跟本无法攀升上去，只好从高架桥下通过，去商业街的专卖店熘达一下，没有我们需要的东西。转而去了露天商业街，是以卖当地原住民物品为主的自由市场，很有特色，但仍没出手购买，就当看一次少数民族的服饰及物品展览，以饱眼福了。两人还怕走丢了，凭借记忆，沿原路返回到邮轮上，回到我们的房间休息。虽然没走太远，这膝关节还是有酸痛，趟在床上把腿垫高，好好休息一会，才感觉轻松舒服了许多。
9e352208247fa4f33bd8584081d8b9ddb374e3fb.translatedText: We docked in Curacao) , according to the information, is an island located in the southern Caribbean Sea, close to the coast of Venezuela. The island was originally part of the Netherlands Antilles and was transformed into an autonomous country of the Kingdom of the Netherlands on October 10, 2010. The capital of Curacao is the port city of Wei. Willemstad was also the capital of the Netherlands Antilles in the past. Curacao and the neighboring islands of Aruba (our next stop) and Bonaire are often collectively referred to as the "ABC Islands". The economy here is not very developed, mainly based on tourism and related industries, as well as oil refining and overseas banking. It is a small and colorful country with beautiful and colorful Dutch colonial buildings reflected on the blue water. You can try Venezuelan beer locally. The flag of Curacao has a blue background with a yellow stripe in the lower part and two white five-pointed stars in the upper left. The cruise docking time is from 1:00pm to 11:00pm. After lunch, the three of us disembarked together. Since my feet are not easy to walk for long distances, and I cannot swim in the sea water, for fear of accidentally getting infected again, we decided to let the second brother, Mr. Guan and Mr. Zhang, a total of 9 people, take a medium-sized bus to a bathing place. My husband and I walked around the urban commercial street near the pier and took pictures of the local customs and beautiful scenery. When our cruise ship docked in Curacao, we saw an extremely tall and majestic viaduct. We got off the cruise ship and walked towards the viaduct. Unexpectedly, the viaduct collapsed across the north and south, and it was impossible to climb up. We had to pass under the viaduct and go to the specialty stores in the commercial street. There was nothing we needed. Instead, we went to the open-air commercial street, which is a free market that mainly sells local aboriginal products. It is very unique, but still not enough. The purchase was a feast for the eyes. We were afraid of getting lost, so we returned to the cruise ship along the same route and went back to our room to rest. Although we hadn’t walked too far, our knee joints still felt sore. We sat on the bed and raised our legs for a while, and then we felt much more relaxed and comfortable.

5034958d1fe80ed2d8227ed018d9c40e7056e260.sourceText: 邮轮航行了一夜又一上午，我们的邮轮第四次靠岸，从早晨8：00am至下午4:00pm共8个小时，这是最后一次靠岸。它的名字叫阿鲁巴(ARUBA)，是位于加勒比海地区的一个岛屿，在委内瑞拉湾外海，目前是荷兰王国的一个构成国，有一半的国民经济来自旅游和相关的产业。多数观光客来自美州各国，就像我们这邮轮一样，一次就载3000多人，而且每次都是2～3艘邮轮在海上结伴同行。 在阿鲁巴上了码头，穿过一个商业商品区，并不急于观看商品，走到头有一介绍旅游景点的台子，摆有地图和景点介绍的小册子。走出大厅，我们选择了一辆大巴士，上面已经坐满了大人和小孩，我们三家共11人，总算各人找一座位坐下，司机是一位当地中年人，说着一口带有当地口音的英语，他向客人们介绍了自己，将带领我们去多处景点观光。沿途有许多新建的各式各样的别墅，有的还在建筑中。近几年阿鲁巴经济飞速发展，人民的收入增加，生活水平提高，买房买车的人也逐年增加，所以房地产业也随其发展，到处大兴土木，一派欣欣向荣的景向，就是司机兼导游的中年人，说起来都有几分骄傲。大巴士开过了一条条新盖的小别墅的街道，来到一个景点，游人们纷纷下车，看到的是名副其实的一堆石头，高出地面堆成一座小山，游客们不约而同顺山势爬上山，山虽然不高，为保护我的脚不至再受伤，我还是乖乖地在山下观看，看着游客们很快又陆续下山，他们讲，在这不高的山上，依然可以观看远处的大海。下一个景点是一座弃而不用的导航灯塔，它服务已超过百年，周围环境光秃秃的，有一户卖椰子的商家到是生意很好，大家都渴得不行，都抢着买椰子喝椰子水解渴，我们也凑热闹用＄5美元买了两个，只见生意人拿起一个，用大刀三下两下就砍开了，插入一个吸管递给我，用嘴一吸还真是又甜又凉又解渴。大巴士再往前开，停在一个教堂前，园内空无一人，导游说：今天他们没有聚会不开门。我们转而向下一个景点，在经过几个海水浴场时，下起毛毛细雨，有人想下车去浴场游泳，可是不巧的是，这时雨越来越大，客人们不由得纷纷回到车上，司机先生一踏油门，冒雨开回码头，把游客们送入商品大厅。我们在商品大厅转了一下，物品大同小意，再出门上邮轮时，已经雨过天晴。 晚饭前，张先生来电话，要去甲板上拍日落，这下提醒了我们三人，很快拿着相机来到甲板上，还好不晚，虽然已有许多人等在甲板上，还是有我们可以挑选的位置。看看太阳正在云层中穿越，今天白天就下了雨，晚霞中太阳也是时隐时现，就在太阳接触到海平面时，太阳刚好穿过一大朵黑云，露出了笑脸。我迅速按下快门，拍下这难得一见的瞬间美景。 接下来的两天，邮轮开始返航，日夜在海上巡航。白天没事就去船上的免税商店看看，还真有便宜的东西，可又用不着，就买了三条围巾和手链，给家人和朋友做礼品。最后一晚的晚餐，在宴会厅度过。在就餐中，所有的服务人员，站在两边的楼梯上，为客人们表演节目，欢快又有韵律的音乐和歌声，加上优美的舞姿，表达的是衷心的福，真的谢谢他（她）们这十天的优质服务和辛劳，为我们的邮轮度假增添了光彩，我们也真城的感谢祝福他（她）们每一位。
5034958d1fe80ed2d8227ed018d9c40e7056e260.translatedText: The cruise sailed all night and morning, and our cruise ship docked for the fourth time. It took a total of 8 hours from 8:00am to 4:00pm. This was the last time we docked. Its name is ARUBA, an island located in the Caribbean, off the Gulf of Venezuela. It is currently a constituent country of the Kingdom of the Netherlands, and half of its national economy comes from tourism and related industries. Most of the tourists come from various countries in the United States. Just like our cruise ship, it carries more than 3,000 people at a time, and each time there are 2 to 3 cruise ships traveling together on the sea. We got on the pier in Aruba and passed through a commercial area. I was not in a hurry to see the products. At the end, there was a table introducing tourist attractions, with maps and brochures introducing the attractions. Walking out of the lobby, we chose a large bus, which was already full of adults and children. There were 11 people in our three families, and we finally found a seat for each of us. The driver was a local middle-aged man who spoke English with a local accent. He introduced himself to the guests and would take us to many sightseeing spots. There are many newly built villas of various types along the way, and some are still under construction. In recent years, Aruba's economy has developed rapidly, people's incomes have increased, living standards have improved, and the number of people buying houses and cars has also increased year by year. Therefore, the real estate industry has also developed with it, with large-scale construction projects everywhere, and there is a prosperous scene. Even the middle-aged driver and tour guide sounds a bit proud. The big bus drove through the streets of newly built villas and came to a scenic spot. Tourists got off the bus one after another and saw a veritable pile of stones, piled high above the ground to form a hill. The tourists climbed up the mountain in unison. Although the mountain was not high, to protect my feet from getting hurt again, I still watched obediently at the bottom of the mountain. Watching the tourists quickly went down the mountain one after another. They said that on this low mountain, you can still watch the sea in the distance. The next attraction is an abandoned navigation lighthouse. It has been in service for more than a hundred years. The surrounding environment is bare. There is a business selling coconuts that is doing very well. Everyone is very thirsty and rush to buy coconuts and drink coconut water to quench their thirst. We also joined in the fun and bought two for $5. The businessman picked up one and cut it open with a big knife three or two times. He inserted a straw and handed it to me. I sucked it with my mouth and it was really sweet, cool and thirst-quenching. The bus drove further and stopped in front of a church. There was no one in the park. The tour guide said: There is no party today and they will not open the door. We turned to the next attraction. As we passed several bathing beaches, it started to drizzle. Some people wanted to get out of the car and go swimming at the bathing beach. But unfortunately, the rain became heavier and heavier, and the guests couldn't help but return to the car. The driver stepped on the accelerator and drove back to the pier in the rain, taking the tourists into the merchandise hall. We walked around the merchandise hall and found that the items were all the same. When we went out to board the cruise ship, the rain had passed and the weather had cleared. Before dinner, Mr. Zhang called and wanted to go to the deck to take pictures of the sunset. This reminded the three of us, and we quickly came to the deck with our cameras. Fortunately, it was not too late. Although there were many people waiting on the deck, we still had a seat to choose from. Look at the sun passing through the clouds. It rained during the day today, and the sun also disappeared and appeared in the sunset. Just when the sun touched the sea level, the sun just passed through a large black cloud, showing a smiling face. I quickly pressed the shutter button to capture this rare moment of beauty. In the next two days, the cruise ship began to return, cruising on the sea day and night. During the day, when I had nothing to do, I went to the duty-free shop on the ship. There were really cheap things, but I didn’t need them, so I bought three scarves and bracelets as gifts for my family and friends. Dinner on the last night was spent in the banquet hall. During the meal, all the service staff stood on the stairs on both sides to perform for the guests. The cheerful and rhythmic music and singing, coupled with the graceful dancing, expressed heartfelt blessings. I really thank them (her) for their excellent service and hard work over the past ten days, which added luster to our cruise vacation. We also sincerely thank and wish each of them (her).

d787b09886336c17ecf3479ab4ede9c2e238b57c.sourceText: 尾声 从10月4日乘飞机飞往佛罗里达机埸，经过邮轮上游玩九天，又平安飞回咱们凤凰城前后十天，我们三人被关先生和张先生两家人的爱心包围着，一路关心照顾我们。上飞机，照顾我腿脚不方便，关太太给服务员一说，就让我们优先登机，免除等待之苦。去旅馆，去邮轮都是他（她）们租车送我们，就是吃大餐也要他们帮忙点菜，靠岸登陆后，也要他们照顾、带领和讲解。他们的照顾就像看顾自己家人一样。有一首歌是这样唱的：”我们成为一家人，因着耶稣，成为 神儿女，成为 神国的子民，同享复活的生命，同享生命的喜悦，同在主爱中连结，因着耶稣同度人生的风浪。”我们在主里大家都是弟兄姊妹，我们还是要感谢张先生和关先生两家人，对我们无微不至的关心和照顾，愿 神赐福他（她）们！
d787b09886336c17ecf3479ab4ede9c2e238b57c.translatedText: Epilogue: From October 4th, we flew to the Florida airport, spent nine days on a cruise, and flew back to Phoenix safely for ten days. The three of us were surrounded by the love of Mr. Guan and Mr. Zhang, who cared for us all the way. On the plane, it was inconvenient to take care of my legs and feet. Mrs. Guan told the waiter and let us board the plane first to avoid the pain of waiting. When we went to hotels or cruises, they rented cars to take us there. Even when we had a big meal, they helped us order food. After we landed at the beach, they took care of us, led us, and explained everything. Their care is like taking care of their own family. There is a song that goes like this: "We have become a family, because of Jesus, we have become children of God, people of the kingdom of God, sharing resurrection life, sharing the joy of life, being connected in the love of the Lord, and going through the storms of life together because of Jesus." We are all brothers and sisters in the Lord. We still want to thank Mr. Zhang and Mr. Guan's family for their meticulous care and concern for us. May God bless them (her)!

774ab128788aee6a9825bc3074a711d5e15e641b.sourceText: (四）第二次靠岸 10月8日是我们邮轮第二次靠岸，从早上9：00am到下午4:00pm，共停靠7个小时，这里是LA ROMANA REPUBLIC”拉 罗马纳 多米尼加共和国”。早饭后，和张先生、关先生我们三家人在各种旅行社的包围下，最终选中坐大巴士去有名的古堡看一看。大约半小时左右来到一个古城堡。一路上司机兼导游是一个胖胖的中年，随开车随介绍当地的风土人情。我们要去的是一个十六世纪的地中海古堡复制品，大巴士停在入口处，下车后发现，在我们前面已经有些游客先到了。 这里的建筑的确有欧洲的建筑风格，尖尖的房顶，细细的长方形的窗户和房子的格局，就是外面刷油漆的颜色，都向游客们展示它们是一系列古建筑，也透着那么些灵气儿，忧如回到十六世纪建筑群里，感觉像穿越回十六世纪，游客们好像当年古老城堡中生活的古人，只是游客们的穿衣打伴是现代人而已。游客们都慢慢的走仔细的观看，不时按下手机和相机的按钮，拍下美丽瞬间。在这些古建筑中，最让人感动的是，有一古代的露天剧埸，气势磅礴的剧埸，整个剧埸在地平线下建成一个园形，最南边是一个半园形舞台，看台共有35层介梯，组成一个五分之四园的大看台，每位观众都可以非常清楚的看到舞台上演员的表演，不会阻挡任何人的视线，这种剧埸比室内剧院效果更好，只是不够舒适、时尚和潮流而已。 我们在回邮轮的路上，导游又一路讲解沿途的风景名胜，有许多富人在此建有别墅，只在休假时过来度假，有漂亮的高尔夫球埸，供有钱人休闲娱乐。回到邮轮上，正是吃午饭的时间，今天想换换口味，来到盖伊的汉堡包联合的柜台前，有十几个人排队，我们三人也排在后面，这里的汉堡包是现做，先有人在库房把面包烤好，有两位厨师分别做不同口味的汉堡包，然后外加好多炸土豆条，这炸土豆条是我的最爱，平时是不准吃的，上了邮轮出海这是特殊情况，一切禁忌的食物都解禁了，好好地美餐了一顿，想想人也是很可怜的，要求也不高，一盘炸土豆条就心满意足了。 午饭以后，回到房间，二哥要随张先生一家去海边游泳，我们就留在房内休息，打打游戏聊聊天，平时难得有这么清闲的时间，不用操心买什么菜、做什么饭，到点就能上餐厅挑选喜欢又合口味的饭菜，而且，晚餐还有宴会厅的美式大餐可以享用，一年能有这么几天空闲，也十分满足了。 晚餐后，出了宴会厅到对面的小剧埸看节目，今天的节目是度假岛的故事。有4对青年男女结伴到度假岛旅游度假，在经历幸福快乐的美好时光的同时，也经历了惊心动魄的火山爆发，在灾难来临的考验面前，他们都在灾难面前临危不惧，不顾危险、忘我的互相邦助，共度难关，最后平安返回，在这度假岛上写下光辉灿烂的一页。让我们看到世界万物都事事存在不安全因素，在大难临头时，能够不顾个人安危、互助友爱，见证 神的爱充满间！
774ab128788aee6a9825bc3074a711d5e15e641b.translatedText: (4) Second docking October 8th was the second docking of our cruise ship, from 9:00am to 4:00pm, a total of 7 hours of docking. This is LA ROMANA REPUBLIC "La Romana Dominican Republic". After breakfast, together with Mr. Zhang and Mr. Guan, the three of us were surrounded by various travel agencies and finally chose to take a bus to visit the famous castle. We arrived at an ancient castle in about half an hour. Along the way, the driver and tour guide was a fat middle-aged man who introduced the local customs and customs as he drove. We were going to a replica of a sixteenth-century Mediterranean castle. The big bus stopped at the entrance. After getting off the bus, we found that some tourists had already arrived before us. The buildings here do have a European architectural style. The pointed roofs, thin rectangular windows and the layout of the houses, even the colors of the paint on the outside, all show tourists that they are a series of ancient buildings, and they also have so much aura. It feels like going back to the sixteenth century building complex, and it feels like traveling back to the sixteenth century. The tourists are like the ancients who lived in the ancient castle back then, except that the tourists are dressed and played with modern people. Tourists walked slowly and watched carefully, pressing the buttons on their mobile phones and cameras from time to time to take pictures of the beautiful moments. Among these ancient buildings, the most touching thing is that there is an ancient open-air theater, a majestic theater. The entire theater is built into a garden shape under the horizon, with a semi-circular stage at the far south. The stands have 35 floors of stairs, forming a four-fifths garden grandstand. Every audience can clearly see the performances of the actors on the stage without blocking anyone's view. This kind of theater is better than an indoor theater, but it is not comfortable, fashionable and trendy enough. On our way back to the cruise ship, the tour guide explained the scenic spots along the way. Many rich people have built villas here and only come here for vacation. There are beautiful golf courses for the rich people to relax and entertain. Back on the cruise, it was time for lunch. I wanted to change my taste today, so I came to the counter of Guy's Hamburger Joint. There were more than a dozen people queuing up, and the three of us were also in line behind. The hamburgers here are freshly made, and someone bakes the bread in the warehouse first. There are two chefs who make different flavors of hamburgers. , and then add a lot of fried potato chips. These fried potato chips are my favorite. They are not allowed to be eaten normally. It is a special situation on a cruise ship to go to sea. All taboo foods are lifted. It is a good meal. Think about people, they are very pitiful and their requirements are not high. I am satisfied with a plate of fried potato chips. After lunch, we returned to the room. My second brother wanted to go swimming with Mr. Zhang and his family at the beach, so we stayed in the room to rest, play games and chat. It is rare to have such free time. We don’t have to worry about what to buy or cook. We can go to the restaurant to choose the food that suits our taste. Moreover, there is also an American dinner in the banquet hall for dinner. It is very satisfying to have so many free days a year. After dinner, we left the banquet hall and went to the small theater opposite to watch a show. Today’s show was The Story of a Resort Island. Four pairs of young men and women traveled to a holiday island together. While experiencing happy and wonderful times, they also experienced a thrilling volcanic eruption. In the face of the test of disaster, they all stood up to the disaster and helped each other selflessly to overcome the difficulties regardless of danger. Finally, they returned safely and wrote a glorious page on this holiday island. Let us see that there are insecurities in everything in the world. When disaster strikes, we can help each other regardless of personal safety and witness that God's love fills the world!

47070672fd66ce13cebd459feaafdf9db4f55fb1.translatedText: Taiwan Golden Horse Awards: "Massage" won 6 awards including Best Picture Chen Jianbin won 3 awards. All awards were announced at the 51st Taiwan Film Golden Horse Awards in Taipei on the evening of November 22. Chen Jianbin won two awards for Best Actor and Best New Director for his directorial debut "A Spoon". In addition, he also won the Best Supporting Actor Award for "Army Paradise" and became the big winner. The most competitive Best Actress award was won by Taiwanese actor Chen Xiangqi, who starred in "Sonata of Light". In addition, Xu Anhua's "Golden Age", which failed at the box office in the mainland market, won the Best Director Award. "Massage" directed by Lou Ye won 6 awards including Best Feature Film, Best New Actor, Best Adapted Screenplay, Best Cinematography, Best Editing, and Best Sound Effects, becoming the film with the most awards. The following is the complete list of winners of this year's Golden Horse Awards: Best Feature Film: Lou Ye "Massage" Best Director: Xu Anhua "The Golden Age" Best New Director: Chen Jianbin "A Spoon" Best Actor: Chen Jianbin "A Spoon" Best Actress: Chen Xiangqi "Echo Sonata" Best Supporting Actor: Chen Jianbin "Army Paradise" Best Supporting Actress: Wan Qian "Army Paradise" Best New Actor: Zhang Lei "Massage" Best Cinematography: "Massage" Best Original Script: Yi Zhiyan "Operation Codename: Sun Yat-sen" Best Adapted Screenplay: Ma Yingli "Massage" Best Visual Effects: "In the early hours of that night, I got on the red van from Mong Kok to Tai Po" Best Action Design: Huang Weiliang "Firefighting Heroes" Best Art Design: "Daytime Fireworks" Best Style Design: "Embroidered Spring Knife" Best Original Film Music: Chen Qigang's "Return" Best Original Film Song: Pu Shu's "The Ordinary Road" Best Editing: "Massage" Best Sound Effects: "Massage" Best Documentary: "Cotton" Best Creative Short Film: "The Hammer and Sickle Rest" Lifetime Achievement Award: Tian Feng

fec0a889a1c63d70e380e66021e979caf52fca6e.sourceText: 美军遇“征兵难”窘境：1/4年轻民众过于肥胖不符参军要求 糟糕的饮食习惯也能上升成为国家安全问题？1/4的美国民众过于肥胖，不符合参军要求，竟然给全球战力首屈一指的美国军方造成了”征兵难”的窘境。 美国 ”准备使命”组织发布报告称，肥胖是美军征兵难题的头号罪魁。”准备使命”成员包括500多名退伍的美国军官，意在保障美国未来的国家安全。 ”准备使命”成员、退伍的美国海军少将史蒂芬 托马谢斯基说：”能够符合军队的全部要求，并在军中服役的男男女女的数量正在减少，我对此非常担心。17至24岁的全部美国人之中，将近1/4，也就是25%的人都因为过于肥胖而不能入伍服役。肥胖不仅妨碍我们招募新兵，还给正在服役的老兵们带来一定挑战。” ”准备使命”决定从学生着手，解决肥胖问题。该组织代表兼美国农业部长汤姆维尔塞克呼吁，学校食堂应该减少垃圾食品的供应，有关方面也应该抬高对学校午餐的要求标准。 美国国防部发现，自1995年以来，美国现役军人的肥胖率一直在50%到60%之间浮动，虽然肥胖程度略有减少，但是肥胖人数逐年增加。这一趋势和美国百姓的肥胖现状相吻合。另外，美国国防部调查显示，若以BMI指数为标准，51.2%的美军士兵偏胖。 各兵种中最为肥胖的要数海岸护卫队（肥胖率57%）；男兵肥胖率过半，远超女兵（34%）；另外，美国陆军和海军分别有15.8%和14.9%的士兵受到肥胖的影响。 不少美国民众参军之前都要减肥，其中36.1%的新人要甩掉9到17斤肉，要减肥18斤以上的人的比例竟然高达40%。
fec0a889a1c63d70e380e66021e979caf52fca6e.translatedText: The U.S. military is faced with the dilemma of "recruitment difficulties": 1/4 of young people are too obese and do not meet the requirements for joining the military. Can poor eating habits also become a national security issue? One-quarter of the American people are too obese and do not meet the requirements for joining the military, which has actually caused a "difficulty in recruiting" dilemma for the US military, which is the world's leading combat power. The US "Ready Mission" organization released a report stating that obesity is the number one culprit in the recruitment problem of the US military. "Mission Ready" members include more than 500 retired U.S. military officers and are intended to ensure the future national security of the United States. "The number of men and women who can meet all the requirements and serve in the military is declining, and I'm very concerned about that. Nearly a quarter of all Americans between the ages of 17 and 24, or 25%, are too obese to serve in the military," said retired U.S. Navy Rear Adm. Stephen Tomaszewski, a member of Mission Ready and a member of Mission Ready. Representative of the organization and U.S. Agriculture Secretary Tom Vilsek called on school cafeterias to reduce the supply of junk food, and relevant parties should also raise the standards for school lunches. The U.S. Department of Defense found that since 1995, the obesity rate among U.S. active duty military personnel has been fluctuating between 50% and 60%. Although the degree of obesity has decreased slightly, the number of obese people has increased year by year. This trend is consistent with the obesity status of American people. In addition, a survey by the U.S. Department of Defense shows that if the BMI index is used as the standard, 51.2% of U.S. soldiers are obese. The most obese among all branches of the military is the Coast Guard (obese rate 57%); more than half of male soldiers are obese, far exceeding female soldiers (34%); in addition, 15.8% and 14.9% of soldiers in the U.S. Army and Navy are affected by obesity respectively. Many Americans need to lose weight before joining the military. Among them, 36.1% of new recruits need to lose 9 to 17 pounds, and the proportion of people who want to lose more than 18 pounds is as high as 40%.

The two investment companies are China International Development Investment Corporation Limited (CIDIC), headquartered in Hong Kong, and Trendex Holdings, headquartered in the United States. They jointly established the Pier 202 Development Company LLC (IFC@202).

f266385562c72c5efc82f5a1351153a2fee4736b.sourceText: 这个项目将吸引和服务于股票和商品交易所，贵宾理财，金融和投资机构，金融律师事务所，贸易行业领袖，和其他人。通过连接超过25家财富500强的国际企业，包括中国新兴（集团）总公司，北京首钢建设有限公司（首钢建设集团），Norendar国际有限公司，河北雷根工程与项目管理有限公司等等。已建立的协议标志着一个新时代：IFC与美国的全球领导者之间的关系。IFC@202标志着美国和中国进行共同开发，拥有和管理的世界级设计中心的水平，这个项目是国际金融服务行业之间迈出的显著一步。 这个金融中心的位置也是大家关注的焦点，在Rio Salado 路上，Rural路以东.12月正式开始动工，部分灯光，街景图已提前曝光。
f266385562c72c5efc82f5a1351153a2fee4736b.translatedText: This project will attract and serve stock and commodity exchanges, VIP financial management, financial and investment institutions, financial law firms, trading industry leaders, and others. By connecting more than 25 Fortune 500 international companies, including China Xinxing (Group) Corporation, Beijing Shougang Construction Co., Ltd. (Shougang Construction Group), Norendar International Co., Ltd., Hebei Legian Engineering and Project Management Co., Ltd. and many more. The established agreement marks a new era in IFC’s relationship with America’s global leader. IFC@202 marks a world-class design center jointly developed, owned and managed by the United States and China, and this project is a significant step forward for the international financial services industry. The location of this financial center is also the focus of everyone's attention. It is on Rio Salado Road, east of Rural Road. Construction officially started in December, and some lights and street views have been exposed in advance.

1627e9035730f6b1a9fc7edf467cad5f7bd291d4.sourceText: 每年一度的纪念美国宪法全美中小学生绘画设计比赛近日揭晓（constitution day poster design contest）。 亚利桑那州的Hamilton high school 罗霖和 Desert vista high school 的林枚分别夺得9年级组和11年级组的冠军。
1627e9035730f6b1a9fc7edf467cad5f7bd291d4.translatedText: The annual National Primary and Secondary School Painting Design Competition to commemorate the US Constitution was recently announced (constitution day poster design contest). Luo Lin from Hamilton High School in Arizona and Lin Mei from Desert Vista High School won the championships in the 9th grade and 11th grade categories respectively.

d96aa03b6fa3cb6c43a97c5125cc0f084de27594.sourceText: 纪念美国宪法绘画比赛是一个面向全美以及全世界的中小学生的绘画比赛，旨在促进中小学生了解和认识美国宪法的诞辰和发展的历史，加深对国家的民主与法制建设的重要意义，展示自己在民主法治国家受享受到的的利益和幸福。今年的绘画比赛是在数千幅的参赛者中产生出39名侯选人（ 每个年级各3名）。 在此基础上，评委在各年级组中评选出一名冠军获奖者（共13名），最后再由这13名冠军中评选出全国总冠军一人。
d96aa03b6fa3cb6c43a97c5125cc0f084de27594.translatedText: Commemorating the U.S. Constitution Painting Competition is a painting competition open to primary and secondary school students across the United States and around the world. It aims to promote primary and secondary school students to understand and understand the history of the birth and development of the U.S. Constitution, deepen its significance to the country's democracy and legal system construction, and demonstrate the benefits and happiness they enjoy in a democratic and rule of law country. This year's painting competition resulted in 39 candidates (3 from each grade) from thousands of entries. On this basis, the judges selected a champion winner in each grade group (a total of 13 winners), and finally selected the national champion from these 13 champions.

ee65881036e842276adb1e23ca1ff40532c4ca77.sourceText: 罗霖的创作的是以美国在硫磺岛战役作为背景， 战士们浴血奋战，为了美国的独立，民主和自由， 高高耸立的宪法大厦体现了美国强大和力量。
ee65881036e842276adb1e23ca1ff40532c4ca77.translatedText: Luo Lin's creation is based on the United States' Battle of Iwo Jima. The soldiers fought bloody battles for the independence, democracy and freedom of the United States. The towering Constitution Building reflects the strength and power of the United States.

6fe7f0303728d9316e950a77ee008c7bdf6a0606.sourceText: 罗霖的获奖作品 林枚的创作是美国首任总统乔治 华盛顿和其他在美国历史上有着重大贡献的三为总统所组成的巨石群雕图，四位伟大总统和自由女神面容上充满了严肃和坚定的表情，仿佛对胜利充满了信心，我们是(美利坚)人民为捍卫和维护宪法不屈不劳地奋斗。
6fe7f0303728d9316e950a77ee008c7bdf6a0606.translatedText: > Luo Lin's award-winning work Lin Mei's creation is a monolithic group sculpture composed of the first President of the United States, George Washington, and three other presidents who have made significant contributions to the history of the United States. The faces of the four great presidents and the Statue of Liberty are full of serious and determined expressions, as if they are full of confidence in victory. We are the (American) people working tirelessly to defend and maintain the Constitution.

f29a100ea218da09d232f8e619107176f7520ed9.sourceText: 罗霖和林枚同学都是初次参加 全美宪法绘画比赛。她们在林峰画家的指导下学习绘画并进行艺术创作的尝试，都夺得了佳绩。期望了解观赏更多获奖者的绘画请访问 http://www.constitutionfacts.com/constitution-poster-design-contest/
f29a100ea218da09d232f8e619107176f7520ed9.translatedText: Luo Lin and Lin Mei participated in the National Constitution Painting Competition for the first time. They learned painting and attempted artistic creation under the guidance of painter Lin Feng, and all achieved great results. To learn more about the winners’ paintings, please visit http://www.constitutionfacts.com/constitution-poster-design-contest/

As the holidays in the United States approach, you will immediately see the whole family sitting around the crackling stove, grandma baking...

060a4911893eb257f29707f44e1473cd5aafbbdf.sourceText: 第三，对于购买房屋者来说，竞争小 大部分美国人不愿意在节日期间忙房子买卖，他们愿意花更多的时间和家人团聚。对于买方来说这个季节是竞争最少的。从每年的1月到4月是亚利桑那房屋交易的最旺盛的时期，等到那个时候，基本是卖方市场，好房子通常要加价才能购买到。 第四，根据多年的统计，这个季节的房子的价钱更接近每年的最低价。1月到3月是房子涨价最快的时候，三年前1月到3月房屋价格上涨了28%， 两年前上涨25%， 去年有一些通货膨胀，也上涨了5%到6%。 第五，卖家也最好在房屋的装饰中，分享您的节日理念，把你的房子装扮得更有一些节日气氛，或者分享一些节日的小食品和饮料，这样买家会在屋里多逗留15到20分钟，这也许增加买家的兴趣。 更多节日假期买房，卖房的小技巧，请咨询Tinna Xie(480)287-0180 Tinna@platinumaz.com
060a4911893eb257f29707f44e1473cd5aafbbdf.translatedText: Thirdly, there is little competition for home buyers. Most Americans are not willing to be busy buying and selling houses during the holidays, and they are willing to spend more time with their families. This season is the least competitive for buyers. The busiest period for housing transactions in Arizona is from January to April every year. By that time, it is basically a seller's market, and good houses usually require a price increase to purchase. Fourth, according to statistics over the years, the price of houses in this season is closer to the lowest price every year. January to March is the time when house prices rise the fastest. House prices rose by 28% from January to March three years ago, and by 25% two years ago. There was some inflation last year, and they also rose by 5% to 6%. Fifth, it is also best for sellers to share your holiday ideas in the decoration of the house, make your house more festive, or share some festive snacks and drinks, so that buyers will stay in the house for 15 to 20 minutes longer, which may increase buyers' interest. For more tips on buying and selling a house during the holidays, please contact Tinna Xie (480) 287-0180 Tinna@platinumaz.com

7cd07beb54f060847c83774606d797ad395fe8e7.sourceText: 我们第一次停靠的岛是比较大的〝大特克岛，是英国的殖民地，想不到竞还有殖民地国家。早上7:00am船在港口稳稳地停下，很多人早早吃过早餐排队下船，我们吃过早餐等人少了再下船，这时人已经稀稀拉拉的了。下了船走过码头，看到远处己有不少人在海里游泳，我们再往前走，有一排房子挡住了去路，门口站着几个像是保安，从他前面通过，每个人要把乘船上的房卡拿给他看。进到里面一看，原来是一免税店，设有高挡烟酒柜台、高挡化妆品柜台、各式服装、鞋帽、小到各种当地特色的挂饰，样样齐全应有尽有，看了半天也没有自己想要的东西。串过这个免税店，进入一个大院，原来这里还有许多小店铺，里面的东西大同小意，最后转到一个大门前，里面非常热闹，这才是我们要去的地方。这是一个游客们娱乐、休娴的埸所，迎面有一游泳池，有人正在里面游泳，埸子里的高音喇叭播放着欢快的音乐，同时也穿插一位男士声嘶力竭的吆喝声，旁边摆放几张园桌和椅子，和许多供游泳者休息用的太阳趟椅。我们三人找了座位坐下，欣赏着音乐，看着泳池里游玩的年青人。忽然发现一对年轻夫妇，用一个有花装饰的很漂亮的船形花兰，里面放着很俊美的小女儿，小儿子则和父母一起，在水中推着小花船游玩，嘻嘻哈哈其乐融融，多么温馨、幸福的一家。感谢 神的恩典，我们可以享受这人间乐园！ 我们坐在竹制的椅子里，园桌上面有一园形遮阳伞，虽然在烈日下，并不感到太热，何况是在海边，我们悠闲地观看这海边的漂亮景色：这里就像建在海滩边的水上花园，游泳池由一条小河通向大海，还有一座中国式的小桥横跨其上，大海里有许多人在游泳嘻闹，湛蓝的海水风平浪静，只有投入它怀抱的人儿的喜闹喧哗声，激起层层细小浪花。人们脱离了城市的喧嚣、烦恼与压力，在无边的大海中，忘情的、自由自在的遨游放松。远远地看到我们乘的邮轮，稳稳地停靠在码头边，是它这个庞然大物，把我们尽3000人从北美洲带到南美洲，这快美丽而舒适的加勒比海边，享受这人间天堂的幸福快乐的生活。快中午了，我们三人回船上吃午饭，二哥喜欢游泳，午饭后他同张先生一家去游泳了，我们坐在船的甲板边，一边吃冰淇淋、一边看着人们来往于船和码头之间，终于人渐渐都回到船上，下午2：00pm 邮轮准时离开码头启航。 晚上依然去宴会厅吃大餐，看到的依然是兴奋快乐的幸福笑脸，一家人或亲朋好友围坐一起，听着扩音器传来的欢快歌曲，吃得依然是自已点的山珍海味，美味佳肴，这就是人们讲究的一种气氛，这种氛围使人陷入陶醉幸福中。忘记一切世俗的烦恼，工作压力，在快乐中与主联合，感谢主！这一切都是主所赐，我们要珍惜这来之不易的幸福和平安！ 晚餐后，去了邮轮小剧埸，今晚的节目是〝杂耍〞，只有一个胖胖高大的先生，先表演五色小球，请三位观众上台与其互动，我发现美国人很热情，喜欢表现自己，只要一邀请就有好多位上台互动。之后，他又表演抖空竹，最后是踏高跷，高跷由三大段连接起来，人站在上面快摸到房顶了，让人感到惊奇的是，这位看起来有点胖又不是很灵活的先生，居然稳稳地站住脚并一步一步走下台，又稳稳当当的回到台上。他的表演，获得全埸观众经久不息的掌声！人的技艺不在高底，只要心中有观众，认真尽心尽力表演，就会得到观众的认可和欢迎！
7cd07beb54f060847c83774606d797ad395fe8e7.translatedText: The island we docked for the first time was the relatively large Grand Turk Island, which is a British colony. I didn’t expect that there were even colonial countries. The ship stopped steadily at the port at 7:00 am. Many people had had breakfast early and lined up to disembark. We had breakfast and waited until there were fewer people before disembarking. By this time, the people were sparse. After getting off the ship and walking through the pier, we saw many people in the distance. Swimming in the sea, we walked forward, and there was a row of houses blocking the way. There were a few security guards standing at the door. Everyone wanted to show him the room card of the boat. When we went inside, we saw that it was a duty-free shop with high-end tobacco and alcohol counters, high-end cosmetics counters, all kinds of clothing, shoes and hats, and various local ornaments. Everything was available. After looking at it for a long time, there was nothing I wanted. This duty-free shop enters a large courtyard. It turns out that there are many small shops here, and the things inside are similar. Finally, we turn to a gate, which is very lively. This is the place where we are going. There are several garden tables and chairs, and many sun loungers for swimmers to rest. The three of us found a seat, listened to the music, and looked at the young people playing in the swimming pool. Suddenly we found a young couple with a beautiful boat-shaped orchid decorated with flowers. The younger son was pushing a small flower boat in the water with his parents, and they were having fun. What a warm and happy family. By God’s grace, we can enjoy this paradise on earth! We sat in bamboo chairs, and there was a garden-shaped parasol on the garden table. Although it was under the scorching sun, we didn't feel too hot, let alone at the seaside. We leisurely watched the beautiful scenery of the seaside: it was like a water garden built on the beach, with a swimming pool leading to the sea from a small river, and A Chinese-style small bridge spans it, and there are many people swimming and laughing in the sea. The blue water is calm, and only the joyful noises of the people who fall into its arms stir up layers of tiny waves. People are separated from the hustle and bustle, worries and pressure of the city, and forget their feelings in the boundless sea. , travel freely and relax. From a distance, I saw the cruise ship we were on, docked steadily at the pier. It was this giant ship that brought all 3,000 of us from North America to South America, to the beautiful and comfortable Caribbean Sea, to enjoy the happy and happy life of this paradise on earth. It was almost noon, and the three of us went back to the boat for lunch. My second brother liked to swim. After lunch, he went swimming with Mr. Zhang’s family. We sat on the deck of the boat, eating ice cream while watching people coming and going between the boat and the pier. Finally, people gradually returned to the boat at 2:00pm. The cruise ship left the dock on time and set sail. In the evening, I still go to the banquet hall to have a big meal, and I still see happy and happy faces. The family or friends sit together, listening to the cheerful songs from the loudspeaker, and eating the delicacies and delicacies they ordered. This is an atmosphere that people pay attention to. This atmosphere makes people fall into intoxication and happiness. Forget all worldly worries and work pressure, unite with the Lord in happiness, thank the Lord! All this is given by the Lord, and we must cherish this hard-won happiness and peace! After dinner, we went to the cruise theater. Tonight's show was "Various". There was only one fat and tall man who performed a five-color ball first and invited three audience members to come on stage to interact with him. I found that Americans are very enthusiastic and like to express themselves. As soon as they are invited, many people come to the stage to interact. After that, he performed diabolo and finally walked on stilts. The stilts are connected by three sections. People can almost touch the roof when standing on it. What surprised everyone was that this gentleman who looked a little fat and not very flexible actually stood firm and walked off the stage step by step, and then returned to the stage steadily. His performance won endless applause from the audience! As long as you have the audience in mind and perform with all your heart, you will be recognized and welcomed by the audience!

7dfc81157ca5498fb11f2f2965659ee39dc0e540.translatedText: Chinese investors invest US$2 billion to build a world financial investment center in Tempe (Exclusive Beijing report by this website) Eight skyscrapers, 6.1 million square feet...

cd4b1ff34f626a9fe4dcb6f5a1ce85860dd3d892.sourceText: (本网独家 北京报道)八栋摩天大楼，610万平方呎的建筑群，将于12月在 Tempe Lake 旁破土推出。 以香港，北京，亚利桑那(city of tempe) 为中轴线，在美国西海岸形成新的世界级财务金融及投资中心，这是强强联手，但若用 〃亚亚合作〃称谓它，就更清楚的看见这将是一颗光亮耀眼的新星。 这是跳过集三千宠爱于一身的洛杉矶，把亚洲经济实体直接落在亚利桑那的土地上，这是目前世界上最具养份的补料，滋润这块土地，将把亚利桑那推上了世界金融投资的舞台。 这个近廿亿美金的投资计划，是由中国(香港)国际开发投资公司与本地 Tempe 投资公司(TRS Companies)共同合资设立，经过二年的协调商谈，北京新兴集团与首钢建设于10月28日正式签约成为合作伙伴并负责执行工程建造。
cd4b1ff34f626a9fe4dcb6f5a1ce85860dd3d892.translatedText: (Exclusive Beijing report by this website) Eight skyscrapers, 6.1 million square feet building complex will be built in December Groundbreaking launch next to Tempe Lake. With Hong Kong, Beijing, and Arizona (city of tempe) as the central axis, a new world-class financial and investment center will be formed on the west coast of the United States. This is a strong alliance, but if we call it "Asia-Asia Cooperation", we can see more clearly that this will be a bright and dazzling new star. This is to skip Los Angeles, which is loved by three thousand people, and directly land Asian economic entities on the land of Arizona. This is currently the most nutritious supplement in the world. Nourishing this land will put Arizona on the stage of world financial investment. This investment plan of nearly US$200 million is a joint venture between China (Hong Kong) International Development and Investment Corporation and local Tempe Investment Company (TRS Companies). After two years of coordination and negotiation, Beijing Xinxing Group and Shougang Construction officially signed on October 28 to become partners and be responsible for executing the project construction.

ec2c8d5b9a621e0ac1a60bb23dcb8a06077d7b04.sourceText: 以金融办公大楼为主体的610万平方呎建筑面积，包括百货公司，超商，大卖场，餐饮一条街及高级住宅公寓在内，建成后的影响犹如一颗核弹爆炸一样，不仅改变了东区的地貌，更把 Tempe 市从大学城变装为世界级金融中心，很有可能因亚洲联锁餐饮店的进驻，特别是在带有中国文化的中餐品牌的影响下，不用怀疑，活力精彩的新世代”中国城市”将在 Tempe 市出现。
ec2c8d5b9a621e0ac1a60bb23dcb8a06077d7b04.translatedText: The 6.1 million square feet construction area is mainly composed of financial office buildings, including department stores, supermarkets, hypermarkets, a restaurant street and high-end residential apartments. The impact after completion is like the explosion of a nuclear bomb. It not only changed the landscape of the Eastern District, but also transformed Tempe The city's transformation from a university town to a world-class financial center is likely due to the presence of Asian chain restaurants, especially under the influence of Chinese food brands with Chinese culture. There is no doubt that a new generation of vibrant and exciting "Chinese cities" will emerge in Tempe.

a505acff4d6d3f511eb4705fc7b746fcab750228.translatedText: Chandler Asians are kindly requested to vote against Chandler’s Proposition 479. In the general election on November 4th this year, Chandler...

72cce46baaae499e3e583bb7432f74e384b6a006.sourceText: 今年十一月四日的大选裡，Chandler City Council在部份市议员的提议下，送出了第479号延长任期的提桉，将原本可只能连任二届的限制，改成可以连任三届。我们在这裡呼吁所有认同民主价值的亚裔朋友们，一起投票反对这个提桉。
72cce46baaae499e3e583bb7432f74e384b6a006.translatedText: In the general election on November 4th this year, Chandler City At the suggestion of some city councilors, the Council submitted Proposal No. 479 to extend the term of office, changing the original limit of two terms to three terms. We are here to call on all Asian friends who agree with democratic values ​​to vote against this proposal.

1ce634c274d279c31144807b69d8a75cdb794154.sourceText: Chandler City Council members 的任期是一任四年，连选可以连任一次，总共八年，八年后如果还想再选，必须再等两年后的下一次选举。我们知道美国总统也有连任限制，目的就是在防范政治人物在同一职位佔据太久，形成过大的私人势力，造成贪腐的温床；另一方面在维持政府的适当更新速度，让政府的施政能够更有能力适应新的需要和变化。
1ce634c274d279c31144807b69d8a75cdb794154.translatedText: Chandler City Council members are elected for a four-year term and can be re-elected once for a total of eight years. If they want to be re-elected after eight years, they must wait for the next election two years later. We know that the US president also has re-election restrictions. The purpose is to prevent politicians from occupying the same position for too long, forming excessive private power and creating a breeding ground for corruption. On the other hand, it is to maintain the appropriate renewal speed of the government so that the government's governance can be more capable of adapting to new needs and changes.

d8e30f319d8216cc40a2390cf07da69d04e1c80c.sourceText: 和邻近城市相比，Chandler市的施政是一个相对较有进步更新能力的城市，Chandler市议员有连任八年的限制，是其中一个重要的原因。
d8e30f319d8216cc40a2390cf07da69d04e1c80c.translatedText: Compared with neighboring cities, the governance of Chandler City is a relatively progressive and innovative city. One of the important reasons is that Chandler City Council members are limited to eight consecutive terms.

abf1402a839b0d6e53ff204b2263d925067ae79f.sourceText: 这个４７９提桉，最主要是因为部份市议员即将连续任满八年，他们想要继续当下去，于是联合部份议员来支持放寛连任的限制，这是非常明白的自肥提桉。这个提桉，固然有少部份人因为利益关係加以支持，但是绝大部份Chandler的公民的立场是反对的。事实上，Chandler市议会在1986, 1996, 和2000 年就已经分别提出三次要取消连任限制，或是延长任期的公民投票提桉，但是三次都被Chandler 的公民否决掉。经过了十四年，又有人再次尝试，想要利用选民们不注意而蒙溷过关，让新人没有机会出头。为了让市政不会长期掌握在职业政客的手上，为了维持市政权力的适当更新速度，让Chandler的施政，能够与时俱进。再次呼吁，希望我们全体亚裔共同反对479提桉，在十一月四日，投下反对票。
abf1402a839b0d6e53ff204b2263d925067ae79f.translatedText: This 479 proposal is mainly because some city councilors are about to serve for eight consecutive years. They want to continue to serve, so they unite with some council members to support relaxing the limit on re-election. This is a very clear self-help proposal. Although a small number of people support this proposal because of their interests, the vast majority of Chandler citizens are opposed to it. In fact, the Chandler City Council has proposed three referenda proposals to remove re-election limits or extend terms in 1986, 1996, and 2000, but all three times were rejected by the citizens of Chandler. Fourteen years later, someone is trying again, hoping to take advantage of voters' inattention and pass the election in a blur, so that newcomers have no chance to stand out. In order to prevent the municipal government from being in the hands of professional politicians for a long time, in order to maintain the appropriate renewal speed of municipal power, Chandler's governance can keep pace with the times. We appeal again, hoping that all Asians will jointly oppose Proposal 479 and vote against it on November 4th.

77511c51fccb64e61aedbde73204035e7f62dcc1.sourceText: 美国一年一度的万圣节狂欢开始了。无论你是刚到美国还是已经在这里很久了，都应该穿上”恐怖”服装，参与这个节日，体会不一样的文化。
77511c51fccb64e61aedbde73204035e7f62dcc1.translatedText: The annual Halloween carnival in the United States has begun. Whether you are new to the United States or have been here for a long time, you should wear your spooky costumes, participate in this festival, and experience a different culture.

980fe1a01a2f652d6a9e635a9bbbf721ee5e3949.sourceText: 每年Tempe Mill Ave 就将举办创意服装或者创意角色扮演的游行活动。街上的行人都会穿着非常夸张的服饰，就等待其他路过的朋友，拦下来要求合影留念。每个人在展示自己的同时，也会锁定自己的目标客户，看到自己喜欢的服饰和角色，也会冲上前去，要求合影留念。通常由多个人组成的有设计的组合，特别容易被关注。去年就有七八个无脸彩色人，受到大家欢迎，他们用彩色丝袜累的东西，把自己严严实实地包裹住，突显自己健硕的身材，所到之处都被人团团围住，抢尽风头。
980fe1a01a2f652d6a9e635a9bbbf721ee5e3949.translatedText: Every year Tempe Mill Ave will hold a parade with creative costumes or creative role-playing. Pedestrians on the street would wear very exaggerated costumes, waiting for other friends passing by to stop and ask for photos. While showing off themselves, everyone will also lock in their target customers. When they see the costumes and characters they like, they will rush forward and ask for a photo. Designed combinations, usually composed of multiple individuals, are particularly likely to attract attention. Last year, there were seven or eight faceless colorful people who were welcomed by everyone. They wrapped themselves tightly in colorful stockings to highlight their muscular bodies. They were surrounded by people wherever they went and stole the limelight.

1f1422eeb2ab76bf4b437e19f46b8a3487b34e62.sourceText: 万圣节体现了美国人的创意精神，不在乎衣服是不是好看，但是一定要吸引眼球，如果能通过服饰迅速传达一个信息那就更精彩了。曾经看到一个人穿着克林顿的衣服，并把莱温斯基的头挂在裤腰带上。加上了标语’FXXX Politics’,非常尖锐的直接的表达自己对政治的厌恶，让人记忆深刻。
1f1422eeb2ab76bf4b437e19f46b8a3487b34e62.translatedText: Halloween embodies the creative spirit of Americans. It doesn’t matter whether the clothes are good-looking, but it must attract attention. It would be even more exciting if a message can be quickly conveyed through costumes. A man was once seen wearing Clinton clothes and hanging Lewinsky's head from his waistband. With the addition of the slogan 'FXXX Politics', he expresses his dislike of politics very sharply and directly, which is deeply memorable.

30d396d73833bf2c3882ace99bb7ee2c9329c9a8.sourceText: 万圣节活动开始的比较晚，而且越晚越热闹，好像真是天黑，魔鬼才活跃的意思。服饰和化妆都是重点。今晚，你准备好了吗，一起狂欢吧。
30d396d73833bf2c3882ace99bb7ee2c9329c9a8.translatedText: Halloween activities started relatively late, and the later they got, the more lively they became. It seemed that it was really dark when the devil was active. Costumes and makeup are the focus. Tonight, are you ready, let’s party together.

fe416941a2b3330ba5680390f78c81d597718bb9.sourceText: 美国凤凰城的余风采堂，历年来族人团结，族务兴隆，在全美余氏宗亲中一直是个模范的团体。余风采堂每年举办适合家庭老幼的秋游活动，用于团结亲朋，和睦侨社。他们每次都办得认认真真，红红火火，一直持续举办了廿多年，在凤凰城是唯一连年举办秋游活动的宗亲团体。
fe416941a2b3330ba5680390f78c81d597718bb9.translatedText: The Yu Fengcaitang in Phoenix, USA, has been united and prosperous over the years. It has always been a model group among the Yu clan in the United States. Yufengcaitang holds autumn outings suitable for families of all ages every year to unite relatives and friends and harmonize the overseas Chinese community. Every time they organize it seriously and prosperously, they have been holding it for more than 20 years. They are the only clan group in Phoenix that holds autumn outings in consecutive years.

90e36e0f9a23cf17afbf9c59708ea41893196672.sourceText: 10月26日，凤凰城天高云澹，阳光明媚，余风采堂在风景秀丽的Margaret Hance公园举办郊游活动。堂口上下分工合作，齐心合力，提早数天就购买好各式各样的食材和用品。不少宗亲一早就去布置场地，摆设檯椅，叠起瓶水、汽水等，有人燃起袅袅炊烟，烧烤出一盘盘的热狗、汉堡牛肉和火鸡肉，食物中还有炸鸡、炒麵、各种沙律以及婶母姑嫂们自制的美味甜品糕点。餐后备有上百份礼物供抽奖，有日常用品、食品、饮料等，令大家物有所用。
90e36e0f9a23cf17afbf9c59708ea41893196672.translatedText: On October 26, the sky was high and the sun was shining brightly in Phoenix. Yu Fengcaitang held an outing in the beautiful Margaret Hance Park. The top and bottom staff in the hall worked together and purchased all kinds of ingredients and supplies several days in advance. Many clan members went to set up the venue early in the morning, setting up tables and chairs, stacking bottles of water, soda, etc. Someone lit up the smoke and grilled plates of hot dogs, hamburgers, beef and turkey. The food also included fried chicken, fried noodles, various salads and delicious desserts and pastries made by aunts and sisters. After the meal, there are hundreds of gifts for drawing, including daily necessities, food, drinks, etc., so that everyone can use them.

66855b49616acef071edf959603cccefb8cec8ff.sourceText: 余风采堂有开阔胸襟，无论是宗亲族人，或是侨民好友，一律欢迎参加，不取分文。所以整个郊游温馨处处，笑语阵阵，无论男女老少，近三百位亲朋好友享受到一个愉快的假日。
66855b49616acef071edf959603cccefb8cec8ff.translatedText: Yu Fengcaitang has a broad mind. Whether you are a clan member or an expatriate friend, you are welcome to participate without any charge. Therefore, the entire outing was warm and full of laughter. Nearly 300 relatives and friends, regardless of gender, old or young, enjoyed a happy holiday.

a0a5802f8f5d89825dc6ef762e7984f225b59a92.sourceText: 联谊能维係族人的团结，侨社团结才有和谐社会。余风采堂的联谊郊游活动持续举办，平凡而有意义。更多的郊游相片请上《凤凰艺文网》浏览： http://www.paaca.us/yee%20picnic.htm
a0a5802f8f5d89825dc6ef762e7984f225b59a92.translatedText: Friendship can maintain the unity of ethnic groups, and only the unity of overseas Chinese communities can create a harmonious society. Yu Feng Caitang’s social outing activities continue to be held, ordinary but meaningful. For more outing photos, please visit "Phoenix Arts Network": http://www.paaca.us/yee%20picnic.htm

cc352853ae2f36b8ec2fcd215350b0df55716afd.sourceText: (二) 航海第一天 凤凰城 凤鸣 吃完晚餐后大略观看了一下这个庞大的邮轮，据资料介绍：它是一个长952米，110000吨位（毛重），可承载近3000位游客（2980 人）、船员1150人的大型邮轮。在前甲板上有一个不算大的游泳池，四周排满了供游泳者歇息和日光浴的大趟椅。在前甲板西侧是丽都餐管，有令人垂涎的盖伊财物汉堡Guy 的汉堡联合，在泳池的正前上方，有一宽大的银幕，不间断地播放新闻，晚间则播放最新电影供旅客欣赏。在十层建有乒乓球台、按摩室、健身俱乐部等，更有一个可供客人健身的200多米的椭园形跑道，还有孩子们喜欢的〝扭腰滑水〞，爱玩又勇敢的孩子们跳入滑水道，只听到欢笑、尖叫声，随着弯弯曲曲的滑水槽，冲入大水池，孩子们高兴的手舞足蹈，大喊大叫，接着又爬上阶梯排队，进行第二次冲锋。在船尾甲板上，有与船头甲板上同样大的游泳池，布局与前甲板相同，在泳池前有一〝海盗比萨〞窗口，备有多种口味供客人挑选，现做现取，经常排不少人等。在我们留意观察时，不觉天已黑下来，船已驶入深海，我们真正进人有趣的〝东加勒比海Carival Freedom 邮轮〞游。回到我们的客房，三人都很激动，感叹 神创造世界万物，又按他的形像创造人，〝使他们管理海里的鱼，空中的鸟，地上的牲畜，和全地，并地上所爬的一切昆虫。〞(创世纪1:26) 我们人类世世代代都按 神的旨意行，今天我们能乘邮轮在大海中航行，也是 神赐福我们。这一天折腾的也都累了，各人盥洗完毕后关灯休息。 第二天，天还蒙蒙亮，三人就都醒了，看着窗外刚刚退去了点点繁星，太阳刚刚露出笑脸，大海中没有高山密云遮蔽，初升的太阳在薄薄云雾中，时隐时现。7:00am三人一起去九层吃早餐，从各种西方食品中，挑着自己能喜欢的食品，还有一种很好喝的汤，把面包撕碎放里面，还是满合我的口味。饭后先生邦我做了一个火炬形冰淇淋，看上去就很诱人，吃着这甜美的冰淇淋，心中升起无限感慨：过去先生绝不允许我吃这样的甜品(因我过去血糖有点偏高)，今天打破禁戒让我解了嘴谗。今天在大海中航行一天，没有靠岸的项目，我们转上十层，有一付乒乓球台，没有人打，和先生两人想打一下，过过球瘾，结果由于有风，球发飘根本打不了，只得暂时回房间休息。站在窗前透过玻璃窗向外看，一望无际的兰色海洋，和朗朗浅兰色天空，在望不到边的地方，相汇成一条线，分不清哪儿是海那儿是天，朵朵漂亮的白云飘在海上天上，甚是令人 神往。在静静的大海中，不时传来邮轮发动机的轰鸣，探头向外看在船侧有轮船驶过击起的白色浪花，串串水珠争先恐后的浮上水面，又干净又抚媚，像是向人诉说大海的衷情。 中午去餐厅，依然是西式餐点随便挑了几样，吃个八成饱即可，饭后三人都回房间小息了一会，二哥喜欢游泳，他就一人去游泳池泡了。晚餐前，张弟兄来电话说，今晚我们要去三层宴会厅吃大餐，最好是正装出席，我要求二哥和我先生都穿衬衣打领带，我自己也换上准备好的dress(连衣裙) ，好久没穿这么正式，突然穿起来有些溷身不自在，走起路来也不自然，不过还好反正没有认识的人，进入宴会厅一看，大家都穿得很正式很喜庆，我也就平静下来，准备就餐。说起吃大餐，在去年六月份也在去阿拉斯加的〝黄金邮轮〞上吃过，是和孩子们一起点菜，有些太麻烦，先点头台(开胃菜) ，再点主菜，最后点甜点。这次是由张弟兄陪我们一起点。我们俩家的餐桌相邻，在有装饰的有情调的地方，灯光闪烁，适合情人或一家人团园用餐，今晚的主餐是大龙虾，等我们吃完了开胃菜后，不一会就有热情的侍者送上三份龙虾，刚放到餐桌上就闻到一股冲鼻的腥味，白花花的龙虾肉都被放在虾壳外，这么好的龙虾做成这样太可惜了，我只好撒上一些细盐和花椒粉，沾上一些酱，硬着头皮吃下去，真是自己找苦吃，也是自己的中国胃没有这口福。 饭后去了宴会厅对面的剧场，人还不太多，找了一个较好位子坐下，不一会演出开始，是88`skys (80年代流行歌曲集) ，整个舞台鲜艳夺目，激光四射，布景千变万化，有升有降，左右、前后移动。演员的服装也是千奇百怪，五彩缤纷，每出场一次就换一套衣服，灯光设计全是由激光完成，让人眼花缭乱，目不暇接，耳中传来强烈的摇滚乐，激烈的打击乐，高昂的另、女声嘶力竭的歌声。那些美国观众还会有时跟着一起手舞足蹈地唱，看来都是八十年代年青人耳熟能祥的流行歌曲，引起在坐人的共鸣，他（她）们是否觉得又回到他（她）们当年的青年时代，沉醉于往夕的回忆中不能自拔，谁说老人不疯狂！今晚的精彩演出，为我们这次游轮游的生活增光加彩！
cc352853ae2f36b8ec2fcd215350b0df55716afd.translatedText: (2) The first day of sailing Phoenix City Feng Ming took a brief look at this huge cruise ship after dinner. According to the information: it is a large cruise ship with a length of 952 meters, a tonnage of 110,000 (gross weight), and can carry nearly 3,000 tourists (2,980 people) and a crew of 1,150 people. There is a small swimming pool on the front deck, surrounded by large chairs for swimmers to rest and sunbathe. On the west side of the foredeck is the Lido Restaurant, which houses the mouth-watering Guy's Burger joint. Directly above the swimming pool, there is a large screen that continuously plays news and the latest movies in the evening for guests to enjoy. There are table tennis tables, massage rooms, fitness clubs, etc. on the tenth floor. There is also an oval-shaped track of more than 200 meters for guests to exercise. There is also a "twisting water slide" that children love. The fun-loving and brave children jumped into the water slide. Only laughter and screams were heard. Following the twists and turns of the water slide, they rushed into the large pool. The children danced and shouted happily, and then climbed up the stairs to line up for the second charge. On the stern deck, there is a swimming pool that is as big as the bow deck. The layout is the same as the front deck. There is a "Pirate Pizza" window in front of the swimming pool. There are a variety of flavors for guests to choose from. They are made fresh and taken away. There is often a long queue. While we were observing carefully, we didn't realize that it was getting dark and the ship had sailed into the deep sea. We really entered the interesting "Eastern Caribbean Carival Freedom Cruise" tour. Back in our guest room, the three of us were very excited and exclaimed that God created all things in the world and created man in His image, "and gave them dominion over the fish in the sea, and over the birds in the sky, and over the livestock on the earth, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creeps upon the earth." (Genesis 1:26) We humans have been doing God's will for generations. Today we can sail in the sea on a cruise ship, and God has blessed us. Everyone was tired from the day's work, so everyone turned off the lights and rested after washing. The next day, when the sky was still bright, the three of them woke up and looked out the window. The stars had just receded and the sun had just shown its smiling face. There were no mountains and dense clouds in the sea. The rising sun appeared and disappeared in the thin clouds. At 7:00am, the three of us went to have breakfast together on the ninth floor. We chose the foods we liked from various Western foods, as well as a delicious soup. We tore up the bread and put it in it, which still satisfied my taste. After the meal, my husband made me a torch-shaped ice cream, which looked very tempting. As I ate this sweet ice cream, I felt infinite emotion in my heart: My husband would never allow me to eat such desserts in the past (because my blood sugar was a bit high in the past). Breaking the prohibition today freed me up. Today we spent a day sailing in the sea. There was no docking project. We went up to the tenth floor and there was a table tennis table. No one was playing with it. My husband and I wanted to play some to get some enjoyment out of the game. However, due to the wind, the ball was so fluttered that we could not play at all, so we had to go back to the room to rest temporarily. Standing in front of the window and looking out through the glass window, the endless blue ocean and the bright light blue sky merge into a line in an endless place. It is difficult to tell where is the sea and where is the sky. Beautiful white clouds are floating on the sea and sky, which is very fascinating. In the quiet sea, the roar of the cruise engine can be heard from time to time. Looking out, there is a ship passing by the white waves on the side of the ship. Strings of water droplets are rushing to the surface of the water, clean and charming, as if telling people the true feelings of the sea. We went to the restaurant at noon, and still picked a few Western-style meals. We ate until we were about 80% full. After the meal, the three of us went back to the room to rest for a while. The second brother liked swimming, so he went to the swimming pool alone. Before dinner, Brother Zhang called and said that tonight we were going to have a big dinner in the banquet hall on the third floor. It was best to attend in formal attire. I asked my second brother and my husband to wear shirts and ties. I also put on the dress I had prepared. I had not worn such a formal dress for a long time, and suddenly I felt a little uneasy and uncomfortable when I walked. Fortunately, I didn’t know anyone. When I entered the banquet hall, I saw that everyone was dressed very formally and festively, so I calmed down and prepared to eat. Speaking of eating a big meal, I also had it on the "Golden Cruise" to Alaska in June last year. We ordered the dishes together with the children. It was a bit too troublesome. I ordered the appetizers first, then the main courses, and finally the desserts. This time, Brother Zhang accompanied us to order together. The dining tables of our two families are next to each other. It is a decorated and atmospheric place with twinkling lights. It is suitable for lovers or a family to dine together. The main meal tonight is lobster. After we finished the appetizers, the enthusiastic waiter soon served three lobsters. We could smell it as soon as it was placed on the table. There was a strong fishy smell, and the white lobster meat was placed outside the shrimp shell. It was a pity that such a good lobster was made like this. I had no choice but to sprinkle some fine salt and pepper powder, dip it in some sauce, and eat it bravely. I was really asking for trouble, and my Chinese stomach was not such a blessing. After dinner, I went to the theater opposite the banquet hall. There were not too many people, so I found a better seat and sat down. After a while, the performance started. It was 88`skys (a collection of pop songs from the 1980s). The entire stage was bright and dazzling, with lasers everywhere. The scenery was ever-changing, rising and falling, moving left and right, forward and backward. The costumes of the actors are also all kinds of strange and colorful. They change clothes every time they appear. The lighting design is all done by lasers, which makes people dazzled and dizzy. In the ears, there are strong rock music, fierce percussion, and high-pitched female voices singing at the top of their lungs. Those American audiences would sometimes dance and sing along. It seemed that they were all popular songs familiar to young people in the 1980s, which resonated with those present. Do they feel like they have returned to their youth, indulging in the memories of the past? Who says that old people are not crazy! Tonight's wonderful performance adds splendor to our cruise life!
