5d0138f1a6517993ca197238702185b0763805d3.sourceText: 感恩节 是美国和加拿大的节日，原意是为了感谢上天赐予的好收成。在美国，自1941年起，感恩节是在每年11月的第四个星期四，并从这一天起休假两天。加拿大的感恩节则起始于1879年，是在每年10月第二个星期一，与美国的哥伦布日相同。
5d0138f1a6517993ca197238702185b0763805d3.translatedText: Thanksgiving is a holiday in the United States and Canada. Its original intention is to thank God for the good harvest. In the United States, since 1941, Thanksgiving Day has been on the fourth Thursday of November every year, and there are two days off from this day. Canada's Thanksgiving Day began in 1879 and is celebrated on the second Monday of October each year, the same as Columbus Day in the United States.

f2f33bb356f63c517d2df8ea570ff7c4fa5e76b3.sourceText: 感恩节的由来要一直追溯到美国历史的发端。1620年，着名的”五月花号”船满载不堪忍受英国国内宗教迫害的清教徒102人到达美洲。1620年和1621年之交的冬天，他们遇到了难以想像的困难，处在饥寒交迫之中，冬天过后，活下来的移民只剩下50来人。基于「来者是客」的信念与习俗，印第安人给这些移民送来了生活必需品，并且教导他们狩猎、捕鱼和种植玉米、南瓜等等生存方法。在印第安人的帮助下，来自欧陆的新移民逐渐习惯了在当地的生存方式。在欢庆丰收的日子，欧陆新移民邀请印第安人一同感谢上天的赐予。在当前广为人知的感恩节版本裡，往往只强调双方的友好关係以及欢乐庆贺的气氛；但也有许多人指出，只一味强调感恩节的快乐以及友好对印第安人并不公平。因为这样容易让人们倾向忘记后续对印第安人的剥削与屠杀的历史。
f2f33bb356f63c517d2df8ea570ff7c4fa5e76b3.translatedText: The origin of Thanksgiving can be traced back to the beginning of American history. In 1620, the famous "Mayflower" ship arrived in America, carrying 102 Puritans who could not endure the religious persecution in Britain. In the winter between 1620 and 1621, they encountered unimaginable difficulties and were suffering from hunger and cold. After the winter, only about 50 immigrants survived. Based on the belief and custom that "all comers are guests", the Indians brought daily necessities to these immigrants and taught them survival methods such as hunting, fishing, and planting corn and pumpkins. With the help of the Indians, the new immigrants from Europe gradually became accustomed to the local way of living. On the day of celebrating the harvest, the new European immigrants invited the Indians to thank God for their blessings. In the currently well-known version of Thanksgiving, it often only emphasizes the friendly relations between the two sides and the atmosphere of joyful celebration; however, many people point out that it is unfair to the Indians to only emphasize the happiness and friendship of Thanksgiving. Because it is easy for people to forget the subsequent history of exploitation and massacre of Indians.

2184a2b59e919e680cf45d2cf11aac4c8c8dc4c2.sourceText: 许多人认为，美国第一个感恩节就是印第安人与新移民第一次齐聚感谢上天赐予的那一天。但是，对许多印第安人来说，这并不是第一次人们齐聚一堂感谢上天的经验。对于一些新英格兰的印第安人来说，感恩节在他们那里早已存在。这些印第安人一年举行六次感恩节庆，他们依照不同时节举行感恩的仪式。在秋季收成时节举行的感恩仪式，对于这些印第安人来说，是他们一年中的第五次感恩节庆。一般人所知的「感恩节的由来」，事实上是第一次欧洲的新移民与印第安人一同感谢上天赐与的那一天，而非所谓「美国的第一个感恩节」。
2184a2b59e919e680cf45d2cf11aac4c8c8dc4c2.translatedText: Many people believe that the first Thanksgiving in the United States was the day when Indians and new immigrants gathered together to thank God for the first time. But, for many Indians, this is not the first time people have come together to give thanks to God. For some New England Indians, Thanksgiving has long existed there. These Indians hold Thanksgiving celebrations six times a year, and they hold thanksgiving ceremonies according to different seasons. The thanksgiving ceremony held during the autumn harvest season is, for these Indians, their fifth thanksgiving celebration of the year. The "origin of Thanksgiving" that most people know is actually the day when new European immigrants and Indians thanked God together for the first time, not the so-called "America's first Thanksgiving".

2f86790fe5789665ca66bc5fa8e404e04e74bbe6.sourceText: 第一次欧洲新移民与印第安人一同庆贺的感恩节延续了三天，双方也同意了一个和平、友好的协议：印第安人欢迎他们在其中一块原属印第安人的土地上建造属于新移民自己的村庄。这个时刻原本是双方友谊逐渐巩固的开始，但不幸的是，友好的关係并没有持续太久。由于不再像以前一样需要印第安人的援助，一些新移民慢慢澹忘了他们一开始遭受的困难以及受到的帮助；再加上更多新移民不断的涌入，双方的不信任感逐渐升高，而产生了越来越多的摩擦；一些新移民甚至不容忍印第安人的宗教信仰，试图教导、说服印第安人他们的信仰是不正确的。许多的摩擦与冲突导致了后来的「菲力浦国王战争」。
2f86790fe5789665ca66bc5fa8e404e04e74bbe6.translatedText: The first Thanksgiving celebrated by the new European immigrants and the Indians lasted for three days. The two sides also agreed to a peaceful and friendly agreement: the Indians were welcome to build their own village for the new immigrants on a piece of land that originally belonged to the Indians. This moment was originally the beginning of the gradual consolidation of friendship between the two parties, but unfortunately, the friendly relationship did not last long. Since they no longer needed the assistance of the Indians as before, some new immigrants slowly forgot about the difficulties they suffered at the beginning and the help they received; coupled with the continuous influx of more new immigrants, the distrust between the two sides gradually increased, resulting in more and more friction; some new immigrants even did not tolerate the religious beliefs of the Indians and tried to teach and convince the Indians that their beliefs were incorrect. Many frictions and conflicts led to what became known as King Philip's War.

eead5c2ca6bb87d76ae15a539e8f94717e2fc200.sourceText: 以上历史告诉我们，人总是时时刻刻地用自己的价值观来衡量我们身边的一切，当别人思想文化跟我们不一样的时候，人下意识便会觉得自己永远是对的，别人是错的，或是为甚麽他跟我不一样？他是不是有毛病了？从而主张要改变别人或是以敌对批评的态度来判断跟我们不一样的人或事，结果是产生冲突到战争残杀。其实世界上种种的事物往往都没有对错，不同的角度时间立场看来，对中会有错，错中也会有对，那又何苦相争，另自己活得难过呢？往往最难接受的人与事物，都是我们不熟悉的，但经过谦卑开怀有爱心的态度，我们都可以尝试打开自己的心胸，学习思想接受哪以为不能接受的，放下你批评的眼光，勇敢地让自己去感受那不熟悉的，也许情况没有你想像那麽难过，结果也可能不是你想像的那回事，往往事情竟然是别有洞天，日久了也许你还会逐渐欣赏，自己心胸容量广阔，就不会为一些不必要的事情去计较，看见什麽事情，什麽人都不顺眼,。因为你已经能看到你以前不能看到的角度，你心胸思想的世界变宽，心境也自然会晴朗，愉快。才擦觉回头看到熟悉的也不一定是对你最适合的，那可能只是一份安全感的错觉，哪以为不适合的也许是更好的，但往往人们都缺乏勇气，毅力去发掘哪未知的将来，跨越尝试新的事物环境与关係，一些心理医书说：想要做个快乐的人，不能尽相信自己的思想，要安静和平的去听我们的心，因我们一路走过来背着过去的包袱实在太多，好与不好的都放不下，也看不清楚，容易自己的思想迷误。
eead5c2ca6bb87d76ae15a539e8f94717e2fc200.translatedText: The above history tells us that people always use their own values ​​​​to measure everything around us. When other people's thoughts and cultures are different from ours, people will subconsciously feel that they are always right and others are wrong, or why they are different from me? Is there something wrong with him? Therefore, we advocate changing others or judging people or things that are different from us with a hostile and critical attitude. The result is conflicts and even wars and killings. In fact, there is often no right or wrong in all kinds of things in the world. From different angles, time and standpoints, there will be mistakes among the right, and there will also be the right among the wrongs. So why bother to fight and make your life difficult? Often the most difficult people and things to accept are those we are unfamiliar with, but with a humble, open-minded and loving attitude, we can all try to open our minds and learn to accept what we think is unacceptable, put down your critical eye, and bravely allow yourself to feel the unfamiliar and perhaps emotional aspects. The situation is not as sad as you think, and the result may not be what you imagined. Often things turn out to be different. As time goes by, you may gradually appreciate that you have a broad mind and will not worry about unnecessary things. No matter what you see, no one will like it. Because you can already see angles that you couldn't see before, the world of your mind and thoughts has broadened, and your mood will naturally become clear and happy. Only then do you realize that what you are familiar with may not be the most suitable for you when you look back. It may be just an illusion of security. What you think is not suitable may be better. But often people lack the courage and perseverance to explore the unknown future and try new things, environments and relationships. Some psychological medicine books say: If we want to be a happy person, we must not believe in our own thoughts, but must listen to our hearts quietly and peacefully, because we have carried too much baggage from the past along the way, and we cannot let go of the good and the bad. We cannot see clearly, and it is easy for our thoughts to go astray.

1fd3c852248387219d65088b85af3f021946d951.sourceText: 这是你的生命。 生命本是上天恩赐的礼物，珍惜它，不要迷误地活着，爱护你的身体，放弃哪些恶习，不要让身心太多负担，睡的好一点，吃健康的食物，适量的运动。爱你所爱做的，常常做你所爱做的。 对不满意的尽量改变，改变不了的，随缘，放下。不喜欢你的工作吗？也许辞职吧。不够时间用吗？不要看电视，手机咯！让自己眼睛，生活歇歇吧，拒绝身边的诱惑，安静跟自己说说，我爱我！ 寻找一生最爱的人吗？ 不用了，如果你做你所喜爱的，你就会发现她其实就在那默默地等候着你，你本来就是充满了爱，尽量去发掘那潜伏在你裡面哪爱的泉源，不用到处再去找。对于那些儘管你多努力讨好他，他总是看不见，不能欣赏你好处与美丽，只是处处挑剔你种种不是的人，算了吧！离开这些给你负能量的人吧！不要过份分析你的情绪与情感，其实所有的情感，喜怒哀乐都是美丽的。当你吃东西的时候，感恩着每一口，慢慢品尝。欣赏你吃的每一口。打开你的思想，手臂，心胸，接受新的人与事物，让我们从我们的不一样裡，互相学习，互相弥补，从而团结起来，建立美好的事物。尝试问一问下一位你遇到的人他们热爱什麽，跟他分享你的梦想。尽量让自己多游历，旅行，不要害怕，迷了路会帮助你找到自己。很多机会也许只有一次，不要错过，好好把握！生命是在乎你遇到的人，还有你跟他们一起创造的许许多多的事物与经历，所以不要犹豫，现在就开始创作感受吧！ 人生太短了，实现你的梦想，分享你的爱好与热情。
1fd3c852248387219d65088b85af3f021946d951.translatedText: >This is your life. Life is a gift from God, cherish it, don’t live in a misguided way, take good care of your body, give up any bad habits, don’t overburden your body and mind, sleep better, eat healthy food, and exercise moderately. Love what you love and do what you love often. Try to change what you're not satisfied with, and if you can't change it, let it go and let it go. Don't like your job? Maybe quit your job. Not enough time? Stop watching TV and use your cell phone! Let your eyes and life rest, reject the temptations around you, and quietly tell yourself, I love me! Looking for the love of your life? No need, if you do what you like, you will find that she is actually there waiting for you silently. You are full of love to begin with, try your best to discover the source of love lurking in you, there is no need to look for it everywhere. For those people who, no matter how hard you try to please them, they can't see you, can't appreciate your benefits and beauty, and just find fault with you for all your faults, forget it! Leave these people who give you negative energy! Don't over-analyze your moods and emotions. In fact, all emotions, joys, anger, sorrows and joys are beautiful. When you eat, be grateful for every bite and savor it slowly. Appreciate every bite you take. Open your mind, arms, and heart to accept new people and things. Let us learn from each other and make up for each other from our differences, so as to unite and build beautiful things. Try asking the next person you meet what they are passionate about and share your dreams with them. Try to let yourself travel as much as possible, travel, don't be afraid, getting lost will help you find yourself. Many opportunities may only come once, don't miss it, seize it! Life is about the people you meet and the many things and experiences you create with them, so don’t hesitate and start creating and feeling now! Life is too short, live your dreams and share your hobbies and passions.

f70d95592a8ade5112b6096d06cfacc267e6da35.sourceText: 生命是礼物，奉献是恩典，当年来到美国新大陆追求宗教自由的清教徒，流传下来盛名的民歌有一首名为「简单的礼物」的歌，歌词唱道：人能活得简单，自由就是一个礼物，我们能在哪就在哪裡，真是最好的礼物，当我们找到最简单的自己，就会一切顺利，无忧无虑。不要为勤劳而自卑，弯身的谦卑，一转又一转，付出的爱心，无私的奉献，就是最好的礼物。
f70d95592a8ade5112b6096d06cfacc267e6da35.translatedText: Life is a gift, and dedication is grace. The Puritans who came to the New World in the United States to pursue religious freedom have a famous folk song called "Simple Gift" that has been handed down. The lyrics sing: People can live simply, freedom is a gift, we can be wherever we can, it is really the best gift. When we find the simplest version of ourselves, everything will go smoothly and be carefree. Don't feel inferior because of hard work. The humility of bending down, the love and selfless dedication you give are the best gifts.

3b8f74a2db3215f85c6d661a4dbd66a092fcd9ee.sourceText: 凤凰城房地产市场9月​变缓，但出现积极的信​号 大凤凰城房地产市场9月变缓。销售量和价格都略微下降。根据最新的统计数据。9月6252套房子被销售。比八月下降了3%， 比2013年9月下降了2.7%。 9月房屋的均价从195000美元下降到194000美元。但是均价比2013年9月上涨5%。预计10月低，房屋的均价会到191000美元. 尽管如此，房地产市场还出现了一些积极的信号。房屋在市场滞留的时间8月是88天，9月下降到84天。9月市场上房屋的供应量继续减少。从8月24220栋减为23555栋。 房屋标价的均价9月为224800美元，8月为215000美元。房屋标价的提高是否预示着会带动11月的销售价格？ 业内人士表示目前房屋价格相当稳定，10月份的适度下调可能是销售季节造成的。更多房地产信息请联系Tinna Xie (480)287-0180 Tinna@platinumaz.com
3b8f74a2db3215f85c6d661a4dbd66a092fcd9ee.translatedText: Phoenix real estate market slowed in September, but there are positive signals The Greater Phoenix real estate market slowed in September. Sales volumes and prices were down slightly. According to the latest statistics. 6,252 homes were sold in September. This was a 3% decrease from August and a 2.7% decrease from September 2013. The average price of a home fell from $195,000 to $194,000 in September. However, the average price increased by 5% compared with September 2013. It is expected that the average price of a house will reach $191,000 in October. Nonetheless, there are some positive signals in the real estate market. Houses stayed on the market for 88 days in August and dropped to 84 days in September. The supply of homes on the market continued to decrease in September. It was reduced from 24,220 buildings in August to 23,555 buildings. The average list price of a home was $224,800 in September and $215,000 in August. Does the increase in home list prices indicate that it will boost sales prices in November? Industry insiders said that housing prices are currently quite stable, and the moderate decrease in October may be caused by the sales season. For more real estate information, please contact Tinna Xie (480)287-0180 Tinna@platinumaz.com

e04b7833fe1fc9c06253cbdd2ed4a2ae7ff1688a.sourceText: City of Chandler 商会会长及多位亚裔社区领袖们呼吁Chandler 市民，在即将到来的11月大选，投下您神圣的一票，赞成Prop 479提案,用行动来支持市政府为贯彻执行各项促进経贸发展政策的决心。 Prop 479 提案主要是Chandler 市民以公投的方式，同意市政府的市议员不受其二次任期的限制，在第二任期届满后，可再参选第三任服务市民，减少市议㑹议员汰换率，以便顺利贯彻执行各项市政建设与法案，加速促进政经发展。为了所有City of Chandler 居民与世代子孙有更美好的未来，请投Yes 赞成Prop 479!!!
e04b7833fe1fc9c06253cbdd2ed4a2ae7ff1688a.translatedText: City of Chandler Chamber of Commerce President and many Asian community leaders call on Chandler Citizens, in the upcoming November general election, cast your sacred vote in favor of Prop 479 and use actions to support the city government’s determination to implement various policies to promote economic and trade development. The main proposal of Prop 479 is that Chandler citizens agree through a referendum that city council members are not subject to the limit of their second term. After the expiration of the second term, they can run for a third term to serve the citizens, reduce the replacement rate of city council members, so as to smoothly implement various municipal construction and bills, and accelerate political and economic development. For a better future for all City of Chandler residents and future generations, please vote Yes in favor of Prop 479!!!

In December of this year, the warm spring city of Phoenix will welcome Chinese education representatives from all over the United States, and...

2dfd4dc94e23bea3d19bb949c098d22ecd7af896.sourceText: 今年 12 月，温暖如春的凤凰城将迎来全美国的华文教育代表，以及中国、加拿大等地的嘉宾，与本地华文教育工作者、议员政要、侨领先进、各界人士，为培育华裔后代、传扬中华文化，共聚一堂、共商大计。
2dfd4dc94e23bea3d19bb949c098d22ecd7af896.translatedText: This year 12 In March, the warm spring city of Phoenix will welcome Chinese education representatives from all over the United States, as well as guests from China, Canada and other places. They will gather with local Chinese education workers, parliamentarians and dignitaries, overseas Chinese leaders, and people from all walks of life to cultivate future generations of Chinese Americans and spread Chinese culture.

b2feda09bfa6e68b908d873e8a9f2ba96a35e245.sourceText: 全美中文学校协会第十次全国代表大会暨全美华文教育研讨会并协会成立二十周年庆典，定于2014年12月12日至14日在美国亚利桑那州凤凰城机场万豪大酒店（ Phoenix Airport Marriott ） 举行， 这是全国性的华文教育大会首次在凤凰城举行。
b2feda09bfa6e68b908d873e8a9f2ba96a35e245.translatedText: The 10th National Congress of the National Association of Chinese Schools and the 20th Anniversary Celebration of the National Chinese Education Seminar will be held from December 12 to 14, 2014 at the Phoenix Airport Marriott in Arizona, USA. This is the first time that a national Chinese education conference will be held in Phoenix.

5c9d29dad5dd976439c20151c611f27210798152.sourceText: 全美中文学校协会 (CSAUS) 创立于 1994 年，是一个全国性的非盈利教育组织。协会由分布在美国近五十个州，几乎涵盖所有大中城市、远至太平洋关岛的 500 余所中文学校组成。会员学校在校学生达十万以上，教师 8000 余人。协会服务面向美国各地的中文学校和华人社区。协会在全美促进各地开设 AP 中文课程，组织中文 SAT 模拟考试，组织全国性绘画、舞蹈、武术、歌咏、作文比赛和中华文化知识竞赛等大赛，承办中国文艺团体来美巡回演出，举办国际文化艺术交流活动。
5c9d29dad5dd976439c20151c611f27210798152.translatedText: Founded in 1994, the Chinese Language Schools Association of America (CSAUS) is a national non-profit educational organization. The association consists of more than 500 Chinese schools located in nearly fifty states in the United States, covering almost all large and medium-sized cities, and as far away as Guam in the Pacific. Member schools have more than 100,000 students and more than 8,000 teachers. The association's services are provided to Chinese schools and Chinese communities across the United States. The association promotes the opening of AP Chinese courses across the United States, organizes Chinese SAT mock tests, organizes national painting, dance, martial arts, singing, composition competitions and Chinese cultural knowledge competitions, organizes Chinese literary and artistic groups to tour the United States, and organizes international cultural and art exchange activities.

14e38280b1aa798535ca6a4903477c19bf5e4416.sourceText: 二十年来，协会的服务和影响遍及在美的千千万万华裔家庭。作为在美华文教育最大的组织、也是美国华人社会最大的草根组织，全美中文学校协会在美国多元文化的环境中，起到了凝聚华人力量、传播中华文化、促进美中友好的重要作用。
14e38280b1aa798535ca6a4903477c19bf5e4416.translatedText: Over the past twenty years, the association’s services and influence have reached thousands of Chinese families in the United States. As the largest Chinese education organization in the United States and the largest grassroots organization in the Chinese community in the United States, the National Association of Chinese Schools plays an important role in uniting the strength of Chinese people, spreading Chinese culture, and promoting U.S.-China friendship in the multicultural environment of the United States.

f2672c59bb08fb674d36f84a4e76378d1111b8be.sourceText: 全美中文学校协会及其会员学校以其广泛坚实的基础、多功能的社会效应和巨大的发展潜力，得到了中美两国多方面的关注和支持。全美中文学校协会的代表多次应邀出席美国主流教育部门召开的全美外文大会、全美中文大会并做专题报告，为推动美国大学委员会增设中文 AP 考试作出了重要的贡献。历年来，全美中文学校协会的代表多次应邀回中国访问交流，出席中国海外交流协会、中国侨联、各省市海外交流协会举办的各类大会，列席全国政协大会；包括协会现任会长出席了今年 6 月的第七届世界华侨华人社团联谊大会，国家主席习近平 6 月 6 日在北京人民大会堂会见了第七届世界华侨华人社团联谊大会代表并与全体代表合影。
f2672c59bb08fb674d36f84a4e76378d1111b8be.translatedText: The National Association of Chinese Schools and its member schools have received attention and support from China and the United States with their broad and solid foundation, multi-functional social effects and huge development potential. Representatives of the National Association of Chinese Schools have been invited to attend the National Foreign Language Conference and the National Chinese Language Conference held by mainstream education departments in the United States for many times and make special reports. They have made important contributions to promoting the establishment of the Chinese AP examination by the College Board. Over the years, representatives of the National Association of Chinese Schools have been invited back to China for visits and exchanges many times, attending various conferences organized by the China Overseas Exchange Association, the China Overseas Chinese Federation, and provincial and municipal overseas exchange associations, and attending the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference; including the current president of the association, he attended the Seventh World Congress of Overseas Chinese Societies in June this year. President Xi Jinping met with representatives of the Seventh World Congress of Overseas Chinese Societies at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing on June 6 and took a group photo with all delegates.

7695940cf84a430bc78242e18ded4cf0531b0afd.sourceText: 近年来，全美最具规模的四大中文教育组织 – 全美中文学校协会、全美中小学中文教师协会、全美大学中文教师学会和全美中文学校联合总会（教授正体字）已多次开会，四大组织决定加强合作，共同推动中文教育在美国更普遍更高层次的发展。
7695940cf84a430bc78242e18ded4cf0531b0afd.translatedText: In recent years, the four largest Chinese education organizations in the United States - the National Association of Chinese Schools, the National Association of Elementary and Secondary School Chinese Teachers, the National Association of College Chinese Teachers, and the National Association of Chinese Schools (Teaching Traditional Chinese Characters) have held many meetings. The four major organizations have decided to strengthen cooperation and jointly promote the more common and higher-level development of Chinese education in the United States.

6abd819ac51d17e809af7c78d8128bd21e54eeac.sourceText: 全美中文学校协会每两年召开一次全国代表大会暨华文教育研讨会。自 1994 年以来，协会已成功地在美国各地举办过九次双年会，历届大会均得到中美相关部门的大力支持，中国国侨办及华教单位、大会所在地的中国使领馆均有负责人出席，美国相关州市的政要议员也都光临大会。
6abd819ac51d17e809af7c78d8128bd21e54eeac.translatedText: The National Association of Chinese Schools holds a national congress and Chinese education seminar every two years. Since 1994, the association has successfully held nine biennial conferences across the United States. All conferences have received strong support from relevant departments in China and the United States. Responsible persons from the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of China, Chinese education units, and Chinese embassies and consulates where the conference is located were all present. Dignitaries from relevant states and cities in the United States also attended the conference.

03961a40223f9146a7f4e9c98e44fc6fa8396f70.sourceText: 今年的大会除了各地中文学校代表、协会理事会执委会成员、各地联络中心负责人、协会历届会长出席，还有中国国侨办相关负责人，中国侨联负责人，华教部门负责人，中国华文教育专家，各地使领馆代表，美国几大华文教育友会组织代表，美国议员，亚利桑那州市政要，教育专家，以及亚利桑那侨界人士等出席。
03961a40223f9146a7f4e9c98e44fc6fa8396f70.translatedText: In addition to representatives of Chinese schools from all over the country, members of the executive committee of the association, heads of local liaison centers, and past presidents of the association, this year’s conference was also attended by relevant heads of the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of China, heads of the All-China Federation of Returned Overseas Chinese, heads of Chinese education departments, Chinese education experts, representatives of local embassies and consulates, representatives of several major Chinese education friendship organizations in the United States, U.S. congressmen, Arizona state municipal officials, education experts, and Arizona overseas Chinese people.

1604b893d1a223b923db6c967a8ca658fbb11018.sourceText: 大会的重头议程是 12 月 13 日上午 8:30 的开幕式和晚上 6:00 的晚宴。晚宴上将由中美特邀嘉宾、议员政要、著名华文教育专家、亚利桑那州侨领代表共同为各地中文学校提名、协会理事会核准的优秀教师、优秀学校工作者、积极组织协会活动的学校负责人颁发奖状；以及凤凰城地区五所中文学校的联合演出。晚宴后各地代表和本地参会人员共同联欢，举行卡拉歌会和舞会。
1604b893d1a223b923db6c967a8ca658fbb11018.translatedText: The main agenda of the conference is the opening ceremony at 8:30 am on December 13 and the dinner at 6:00 pm. At the dinner, special guests from China and the United States, dignitaries, famous Chinese education experts, and representatives of Arizona overseas Chinese leaders will jointly award certificates to outstanding teachers nominated by Chinese schools in various places and approved by the association board of directors, outstanding school workers, and school leaders who actively organize association activities; there will also be a joint performance by five Chinese schools in the Phoenix area. After the dinner, representatives from all over the country and local participants got together and held a karaoke session and dance.

9b4d5eca7e721fc14ff5874c9ed1cb402fb5360f.sourceText: 12 月 14 日中午将举行协会理事会换届选举，欢迎各界人士出席旁听，各地中文学校推荐的竞选代表，经过书面递交竞选材料并经审核后，在会场发表竞选演说，并由各校代表一校一票，当场选出新一届理事会成员、协会正副会长。
9b4d5eca7e721fc14ff5874c9ed1cb402fb5360f.translatedText: The general election of the association's board of directors will be held at noon on December 14. People from all walks of life are welcome to attend. Representatives recommended by Chinese schools from various places will deliver campaign speeches at the venue after submitting written campaign materials and reviewing them. Representatives from each school will elect the new council members and the president and vice president of the association on the spot with one vote per school.

9e3b7c8a06f749a15f65b5461c21c872c02a2068.translatedText: In order to welcome this conference, the heads of seven Chinese schools in the state held a meeting in May this year. 21c4545964f868497c852125ae02410b96b0b5bf.translatedText: The list of working group members of the state organizing committee is recommended by each Chinese school. The list of all organizing committees will be compiled and released soon.

f383b860edc9ad0a4ed85e2a86faa0fe8a8072a9.sourceText: 现在，大会组委会开始向亚利桑那本地侨领、各界人士发出邀请函，诚邀侨领先进、各界人士出席大会，共襄发展北美华文教育盛举。本州热心华文教育的人士正在为推动本次大会的成功举办出策出力，并借此扩大亚利桑那州在全美的影响，展现沙漠绿洲中一座欣欣向荣的城市面貌，展示热情淳朴的本地民众的精神风范。大会组委会诚挚地感谢各位侨界先进的大力支持，并将在大会专门鸣谢。
f383b860edc9ad0a4ed85e2a86faa0fe8a8072a9.translatedText: Now, the organizing committee of the conference has begun to send invitation letters to local Arizona overseas Chinese leaders and people from all walks of life, and sincerely invites overseas Chinese leaders and people from all walks of life to attend the conference and jointly develop Chinese education in North America. People who are enthusiastic about Chinese education in this state are making suggestions and efforts to promote the success of this conference, and use this to expand the influence of Arizona in the United States, show the face of a prosperous city in a desert oasis, and showcase the spirit of the warm and simple local people. The organizing committee of the conference sincerely thanks all the advanced overseas Chinese for their strong support and will express special thanks at the conference.

4063518faf0e8b41d4af02ecc3728ff5903fc094.sourceText: 大会组委会期盼各界人士光临大会，为着华裔后代以及其他族裔学习中华语言文字，为着在海外继承传扬中华文化的千秋大业，为着推动美中友好交往的光明目标，不分族裔、不分国籍、不分地域、不分派别、不分宗教，登高望远，为着美好的愿景而共同努力。
4063518faf0e8b41d4af02ecc3728ff5903fc094.translatedText: The organizing committee of the conference hopes that people from all walks of life will come to the conference to learn the Chinese language for future generations of Chinese and other ethnic groups, to inherit and promote the great cause of Chinese culture overseas, and to promote the bright goal of friendly exchanges between the United States and China.

d66b9183c07558a513342254c82b2e523c6c6aa1.sourceText: 大会组委会已经为本州中文学校人员，其他中文教师，以及本地侨界人士开辟了专门的注册网站，以统计出席大会午餐、晚宴人数，大会为参会者提供了优惠，并为每位出席者制作有大会会标的正式名牌，详情请见网站。今后大会将发布进一步消息。
d66b9183c07558a513342254c82b2e523c6c6aa1.translatedText: The organizing committee of the conference has opened a special registration website for Chinese school personnel, other Chinese teachers, and local overseas Chinese to count the number of people attending the conference lunch and dinner. The conference provides discounts for participants and produces an official nameplate with the conference logo for each attendee. Please see the website for details. Further information will be released at the conference in the future.

This community was completed in 2013. It is a student dormitory. The minimum rent for each room is US$700 and the highest is US$1,200. It has a total of 900 rooms. As Arizona State University continues to expand enrollment, more and more students need to live in Tempe. Coupled with the relocation of the US professional basketball headquarters, Tempe is regarded as one of the best investment cities in Arizona. 226c652e9e1a7687b5a8c9475b7685653aba7cbd.translatedText: Contributed by the UCAA Photography: Linda Wei, Ye Meng, Li Jian

8344c5565c4a68b935394366d35def427d83a7bc.sourceText: 9月21日星期日晚上，亚省华联在第8届庆中秋迎国庆”凤凰之夜”顺利落下帷幕后首次推出”中秋团圆晚宴”。第一次举办的”中秋团圆晚宴”就得到亚利桑那州华人华侨各社团机构和美国其他族裔社区的热烈响应。在晚宴大厅席内，新老朋好友把盏祝福，叙旧言欢，笑语欢声，和美温馨。亚利桑那州财务长、今年亚利桑那州州长竞选夺标呼声极高的共和党提名候选人Doug Ducey先生出席晚宴并致词向华人社区表达衷心的节日祝愿；Scottsdale 市长Jim Lane先生祝福这个华人家庭团聚的节日，他谈到，Scottsdale与海口市建立了姐妹城市关系，两市密切互动交流，把世界的不同视角带到一起。亚省中餐馆协会会长张华芳女士盛赞亚省各华人华侨团体彼此支持鼓励，共同服务亚省华人社区的优良传统。年近80的老侨、《亚省时报》社长甄硕钦老先生动情地回忆了华人侨社越做越好。
8344c5565c4a68b935394366d35def427d83a7bc.translatedText: On the evening of Sunday, September 21st, Hualian of Alberta launched the "Mid-Autumn Reunion Dinner" for the first time after the 8th "Phoenix Night" to celebrate the Mid-Autumn Festival and the National Day came to a successful conclusion. The first "Mid-Autumn Festival Reunion Dinner" was held and received enthusiastic response from various Chinese organizations in Arizona and other ethnic communities in the United States. In the banquet hall, old and new friends held candles and gave blessings, reminiscing about old times, laughing and cheering, creating harmony and warmth. Mr. Doug Ducey, Arizona State Treasurer and the Republican nominee with a strong claim to win this year's Arizona gubernatorial election, attended the dinner and delivered a speech to express his heartfelt holiday wishes to the Chinese community; Mr. Jim Lane, Mayor of Scottsdale, blessed this holiday for Chinese family reunions. He said that Scottsdale has established a sister city relationship with Haikou City, and the two cities interact closely and bring different perspectives of the world together. Ms. Zhang Huafang, President of the Chinese Restaurant Association of Alberta, praised the fine traditions of various Chinese and overseas Chinese groups in the province to support and encourage each other and jointly serve the Chinese community in the province. Mr. Zhen Shuoqin, an overseas Chinese who is nearly 80 years old and the president of "Alberta Times", recalled with emotion that the Chinese overseas Chinese community is doing better and better.

5fa2be4f91e961910744d4a0151b4e1cdf9287fa.translatedText: The 2015 Miss Chinese Phoenix Pageant will be held on January 25, 2015. Following the 2014 Miss Chinese Universe Pageant and the Federation of Overseas Chinese Community Variety Show in August...

0133788174fc93d19711b52340aaf477ffb688ca.sourceText: 继八月的2014年中华小姐环球大赛和侨联社区综艺表演晚会后, 大凤凰城华人侨团联合总会(侨联)主席余文泽公佈2015年凤凰城华裔小姐选美将于2015年1月25日假钱德勒市的野马酒店赌场举行。 2015年凤凰城华裔小姐选美的参赛报名表格可在网上： www.PhoenixChineseUnited.org 下载。参赛者必须是17和28岁之间的佳丽。 2015年凤凰城华裔小姐选美大赛的冠, 亚, 季军获奖者将获得1,500美元，1,000美元，及八百元的奖学金。 所有符合资格入围2015年凤凰城华裔小姐选美的的佳丽将获得500美元的奖学金。 2015年凤凰城华裔小姐选美大赛的参赛者必须提交于2014年10月24日递交报名表格。查询或了解更多信息，请联繫2015年凤凰城华裔小姐选美大赛主席闻玲琳女士: 电话(480) 516-8868或电邮 lindancegreat@gmail.com。
0133788174fc93d19711b52340aaf477ffb688ca.translatedText: Following the 2014 Miss Chinese Universe Pageant and the Federation of Overseas Chinese Community Variety Show in August, Yu Wenze, chairman of the Greater Phoenix Federation of Overseas Chinese Associations (Overseas Chinese Federation), announced that the 2015 Miss Chinese Phoenix Pageant will be held on January 25, 2015 at the Wild Horse Hotel and Casino in Chandler. The registration form for the 2015 Miss Chinese Phoenix Pageant can be downloaded online: www.PhoenixChineseUnited.org. Contestants must be between the ages of 17 and 28. The first, first and second runner-up winners of the 2015 Miss Chinese Phoenix Pageant will receive scholarships of US$1,500, US$1,000 and US$800. All qualified finalists for the 2015 Miss Chinese Phoenix Pageant will receive a $500 scholarship. Contestants for the 2015 Miss Chinese Phoenix Pageant must submit their registration form by October 24, 2014. For inquiries or more information, please contact Ms. Wen Linglin, Chairperson of the 2015 Miss Chinese Phoenix Pageant: phone (480) 516-8868 or email lindancegreat@gmail.com.

b27a3398f404a14184091698ccdedf9afa17db03.translatedText: ASU celebrates the "Confucius Institute Day" series of activities - Chinese Art Interactive Exhibition

62a53ea600efc6c2d6b81aebb8247c54fd0561c7.sourceText: ASU庆祝“孔子学院日”系列活动之——中国艺术互动展览 伴随着一场中秋金雨，亚利桑那州的夏天迈着轻盈的步伐…
62a53ea600efc6c2d6b81aebb8247c54fd0561c7.translatedText: ASU celebrates the "Confucius Institute Day" series of activities - the Chinese Art Interactive Exhibition With a Mid-Autumn Golden Rain, Arizona's summer is taking a light step...

11aca4443e23156813c533ef16a65696a99a1b0d.sourceText: 伴随着一场中秋金雨，亚利桑那州的夏天迈着轻盈的步伐渐渐远离。清爽的凉风、渐红的树叶、飘香的蔬果，我们迎来了丰收的秋天，也迎来了”孔子学院十周年诞辰”。为了让广大的亚利桑那州人民能够亲身体验中国舞蹈和艺术的魅力，亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院于2014年9月14日在钱德勒市艺术中心成功开展了大型文化盛宴，内容包括中国艺术互动展会会以及携手新东方艺术学校共同举办的首届”金秋”中国舞蹈节。
11aca4443e23156813c533ef16a65696a99a1b0d.translatedText: With a Mid-Autumn Golden Rain, Arizona's summer is moving away with a light step. With the refreshing cool breeze, the gradually red leaves, and the fragrant fruits and vegetables, we ushered in the harvest of autumn and also ushered in the "10th Anniversary of the Confucius Institute". In order to allow Arizona people to experience the charm of Chinese dance and art first-hand, the Confucius Institute at Arizona State University successfully held a large-scale cultural feast at the Chandler Art Center on September 14, 2014, including an interactive Chinese art exhibition and the first "Golden Autumn" Chinese Dance Festival jointly organized with New Oriental Art School.

10def36899528994318ea2539eec4bc8c909fc8b.sourceText: 亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院于2014年9月14日在钱德勒市艺术中心开展了中国艺术互动展览会
10def36899528994318ea2539eec4bc8c909fc8b.translatedText: The Confucius Institute at Arizona State University launched an interactive exhibition of Chinese art at the Chandler Art Center on September 14, 2014

7bd69154b87868cb3fd7dd3f8f4d5715a9e23f10.sourceText: 艺术中心大厅音乐渐起，悠扬流畅的曲调呈现出一幅辽阔壮丽、运程万里，一下子把大家带进了中国水墨画的世界。放眼望去，只见展示着不同中国艺术形式的展台错落有致地布置的大厅里面：有书签展台、十二生肖展台、中秋灯笼展台、手工大鼓展台、中国画演示台、中国民乐展台、摄影大赛获奖作品展示区以及趣味盎然的中国传统服饰和技艺展台，多角度全方面地展示中国艺术的独特魅力。观众们不仅可以欣赏中国画和民乐，了解中国艺术、民俗等知识，更能够亲手感受和实践中国手工艺品。
7bd69154b87868cb3fd7dd3f8f4d5715a9e23f10.translatedText: The music started to play in the art center hall, and the melodious and smooth tunes presented a vast and magnificent picture with thousands of miles of destiny, which suddenly brought everyone into the world of Chinese ink painting. Looking around, we can see booths displaying different Chinese art forms in an orderly manner in the hall: there is a bookmark booth, a zodiac booth, a Mid-Autumn lantern booth, a handmade drum booth, a Chinese painting demonstration booth, a Chinese folk music booth, a photography competition award-winning work display area, and an interesting traditional Chinese costumes and skills booth, displaying the unique charm of Chinese art from multiple angles. The audience can not only appreciate Chinese paintings and folk music, learn about Chinese art, folk customs and other knowledge, but also experience and practice Chinese handicrafts with their own hands.

8d2c51d247f89d7e67f1e79ffd296bbf862f24ba.sourceText: 为了让观众们能够生动有趣地感受到”中国印象”和”中国元素”，孔子学院特地为此次活动制作了一批设计精美的书签。有的书签上有一个汉字，还有相对应的拼音和英文解释，比如儒家五常里面的”信”学生可以用马克笔描摹书签上的汉字，并且向孔子学院的工作人员学习汉字的读法；有的学过中文的小朋友更是当场运用课堂所学知识，现场教了他们父母中文；有的书签则是一只只象征着中美友谊的憨态可掬的大熊猫；有的书签上则是各类瑰丽的中国水墨画，许多观众都表达了自己对画独特的见解。在制作好属于自己的独一无二的书签之后，工作人员还会协助大家制作小小的中国结，为书签锦上添花。虽然是小小的几枚书签，但是每一枚书签都包含着孔子学院的殷切期待，希望每一位观众都可以通过书签上的”中国元素”熟悉中国，激发对中国的更多的兴趣。
8d2c51d247f89d7e67f1e79ffd296bbf862f24ba.translatedText: In order to allow the audience to feel the "Chinese impression" and "Chinese elements" vividly and interestingly, the Confucius Institute specially produced a batch of beautifully designed bookmarks for this event. Some bookmarks have a Chinese character on it, along with the corresponding pinyin and English explanation, such as "letter" in Confucianism. Students can use a marker pen to trace the Chinese character on the bookmark, and learn how to read Chinese characters from the staff of the Confucius Institute; some children who have studied Chinese even more They used the knowledge learned in class to teach their parents Chinese on the spot; some bookmarks were a naive giant panda that only symbolized the friendship between China and the United States; some bookmarks were various types of magnificent Chinese ink paintings, and many viewers expressed their unique views on the paintings. After making your own unique bookmarks, the staff will also help you make small Chinese knots to make the bookmarks even better. Although there are only a few small bookmarks, each bookmark contains the Confucius Institute’s ardent expectations. It is hoped that every audience can become familiar with China through the “Chinese elements” on the bookmarks and stimulate more interest in China.

36464a1cfc87e9a5de04d45f0980f299677fd2a0.sourceText: 参与者设计制作属于自己独一无二的书签和中国结
36464a1cfc87e9a5de04d45f0980f299677fd2a0.translatedText: Participants designed and made their own unique bookmarks and Chinese knots

31e62efb4fd86fcf621f625dfa09eafac574b8cd.sourceText: 十二生肖展台无疑是最吸引小朋友的展台之一，里面包含了多个和十二生肖有关的活动：填色游戏、折纸、手工生肖帽子以及手工扇子。小朋友在家长和工作人员的帮助下，查找出自己的生肖并在生肖卡上涂上自己喜欢的颜色，于此同时，他们还能知道许多关于自己生肖的特质。折纸活动也是小朋友的心头好之一，只见他们围着负责折纸的老师手边，通力合作，折出一只只色彩斑斓的小动物。而手工帽子则是男孩子们的挚爱，他们认真地挑选着自己喜欢的生肖图案，当他们带上自己设计的生肖帽子时，那些天真无邪的笑容闪耀在每个在场的人的心中。小女孩则是偏好有着各类扇面的手工扇子，她们同样自己挑选着喜欢的扇面，有素雅幽静的荷花、夸张的京剧脸谱、活泼可爱的小动物等等，然后制成一把中国扇，别有一番娟秀典雅之韵。
31e62efb4fd86fcf621f625dfa09eafac574b8cd.translatedText: The twelve zodiac booth was undoubtedly one of the most attractive booths for children. It included a number of activities related to the twelve zodiac signs: coloring games, origami, handmade zodiac hats and handmade fans. With the help of parents and staff, children can find out their zodiac sign and paint their favorite color on the zodiac card. At the same time, they can also learn a lot about the characteristics of their zodiac sign. Origami is also one of the children's favorite activities. They gathered around the teacher in charge of origami and worked together to fold out colorful animals. Handmade hats are the boys’ favorite. They carefully selected their favorite zodiac patterns. When they put on the zodiac hats they designed, those innocent smiles shined in the hearts of everyone present. Little girls prefer handmade fans with various fan surfaces. They also choose their favorite fan surfaces, including elegant and quiet lotuses, exaggerated Peking Opera masks, lively and cute animals, etc., and then make them into a Chinese fan, which has a unique and elegant charm.

f7ada9f38d13f81ef3561e1b66b6b0bc36bf48b2.sourceText: 工作人员正在帮助小朋友制作手工扇子
f7ada9f38d13f81ef3561e1b66b6b0bc36bf48b2.translatedText: Staff are helping children make handmade fans

07ff9f7035aa982146ce0ddb0f4fd06f905f1add.sourceText: 中秋灯笼展台和手工大鼓展台比肩而立，被热情的观众们围了个水泄不通。通过展示板和工作人员的介绍，观众们可以了解灯笼的历史、作用、种类等等各类知识，也知道了因为灯笼是中国人喜庆的象征，在中秋节，中国江南地带有燃灯以助月色的风俗。孔子学院也为此特地制作了一批灯笼，让观众们也能一起动手感受中国人合家团圆之心。这批灯笼除了传统的朱红色，更大胆地运用了粉紫、粉红、嫩黄等可爱迷人的冰淇淋系色调，温润而恬静的色彩受到大家的一致好评。此外，在完成了灯笼的雏形后，还会再配上一个精致的穗子和一个小巧提绳，更添风雅之趣。虽然孔子学院没有办法将一面真正的大鼓搬到艺术中心的大厅，但是其小巧玲珑的手工大鼓依旧向观众们展示了其作为中国各族人民喜爱的民族乐器的风采，大家纷纷震惊于其四千多年的历史。工作人员们在这里还小小的”剧透”了一下，他们告知观众们今晚的舞蹈节上就会有由大鼓伴奏的乐曲，引得观众不由心驰神往，愈加期待起晚上的群英会舞。
07ff9f7035aa982146ce0ddb0f4fd06f905f1add.translatedText: The Mid-Autumn Festival lantern booth and the handmade drum booth stood side by side and were surrounded by enthusiastic audiences. Through the display board and introduction by the staff, the audience can learn about the history, functions, types and other knowledge of lanterns. They also learned that because lanterns are a symbol of Chinese people’s happiness, during the Mid-Autumn Festival, there is a custom in China’s Jiangnan region of lighting lanterns to help with the moonlight. The Confucius Institute also specially produced a batch of lanterns for this purpose, so that the audience can feel the Chinese people’s spirit of family reunion. In addition to the traditional vermilion, these lanterns boldly use cute and charming ice cream tones such as pink, purple, pink, and bright yellow. The warm and tranquil colors have been well received by everyone. In addition, after the prototype of the lantern is completed, a delicate tassel and a small handle will be added to add to the elegance. Although the Confucius Institute was unable to move a real drum to the lobby of the art center, its small and exquisite handmade drum still showed the audience its elegance as a national musical instrument loved by people of all ethnic groups in China. Everyone was shocked by its more than 4,000 years of history. The staff also gave a little "spoiler" here. They told the audience that tonight's dance festival will have music accompanied by drums, which attracted the audience's attention and looked forward to the evening's dance party.

e48462c4a92e0cf100c54208f7cb0ff40818b2f3.sourceText: 中国画展示台和民乐展示台前也是人头攒动。在国画老师的指导下，只见观众们纷纷拿起毛笔，虽然时不时微微颤颤，却都非常努力地画下他们人生的第一幅中国水墨画棗熊猫戏竹。在民乐老师的鼓励下，只见观众们小心翼翼地捧起琵琶，正襟危坐，按照老师的指示，轻轻地弹拨起来。许多人都是第一次接触中国乐器，他们欣喜地触摸着古琴、好奇地聆听着丝竹音色。此外，民乐老师还开展了迷你课堂的环节：教授中西方乐器的不同之处。
e48462c4a92e0cf100c54208f7cb0ff40818b2f3.translatedText: There were also crowds of people in front of the Chinese painting display stand and the folk music display stand. Under the guidance of the traditional Chinese painting teacher, the audience picked up their brushes one after another. Although they trembled slightly from time to time, they worked very hard to draw the first Chinese ink painting of jujube, panda and bamboo. With the encouragement of the folk music teacher, the audience carefully picked up the pipa, sat upright, and started playing it gently according to the teacher's instructions. Many people came into contact with Chinese musical instruments for the first time. They touched the guqin with joy and listened curiously to the timbre of silk and bamboo. In addition, the folk music teacher also conducted a mini class session: teaching the differences between Chinese and Western musical instruments.

8536ce3aee593660e2e5c099af452751bed3f663.sourceText: 本次活动最热闹的展台莫过于中国传统服饰和技艺展台，只见观众们兴趣盎然地拿起京剧脸谱往脸上比划，询问着工作人员这是哪个角色的脸谱，脸谱的颜色有什么特殊意义吗？更多的观众则是完全着迷手绢舞中，只见他们拿起一块块镶嵌着银色亮片的红色手绢，试图用手指大力地旋转开来，可是要不就是一会儿就手绢就飞了出去，要不就是手绢始终”耷拉着”。展台的工作人员个个绝技，他们耐心地教导着观众们，传授着他们的独门秘技，或者和已经掌握的观众练习起手绢接力，展台时不时传来一阵阵的欢声笑语。有些观众则展示的中国传统的唐装和旗袍所吸引，他们在工作人员的帮助下，换上一身华袍，高高兴兴地抱着熊猫玩偶，撑着丝绢伞，合影留念。
8536ce3aee593660e2e5c099af452751bed3f663.translatedText: The most lively booth at this event was the Chinese traditional costumes and skills booth. The audience was interested in picking up the Peking Opera masks and gesturing on their faces, asking the staff which character's mask it was. Does the color of the mask have any special meaning? More spectators were completely fascinated by the handkerchief dance. They picked up pieces of red handkerchiefs inlaid with silver sequins and tried to spin them vigorously with their fingers. However, either the handkerchiefs flew out after a while, or the handkerchiefs kept "hanging". The staff at the booth all had their own unique skills. They patiently taught the audience their unique secret skills, or practiced the handkerchief relay with the audience who had already mastered it. From time to time, bursts of laughter came from the booth. Some viewers were attracted by the traditional Chinese Tang suits and cheongsam on display. With the help of the staff, they changed into Chinese robes and happily took photos while holding panda dolls and silk umbrellas.

174de563058bfd1da55b126d8e7eb5856700c3f1.sourceText: 本次大型中国艺术互动展览会给了亚利桑那地区的人民一个近距离了解中国文化的机会。观众们怀着好奇乘兴而来，带着愉悦满载而归。 他们表示很高兴参加本次中国艺术互动展览会，从中他们学到了许多和中国有关的知识，并对中文产生了更加浓厚的兴趣。他们也希望今后能多参加此类活动，从而进一步了解中国。
174de563058bfd1da55b126d8e7eb5856700c3f1.translatedText: This large-scale Chinese art interactive exhibition will give people in Arizona an opportunity to understand Chinese culture up close. The audience came with curiosity and returned with joy. They expressed that they were very happy to participate in this Chinese art interactive exhibition, from which they learned a lot about China and became more interested in Chinese. They also hope to participate in more such activities in the future to learn more about China.

a35d80c2e6eec2a2a3896c7c587462e5366fbc8f.sourceText: 本次活动的成功举办还离不开凤凰城地区学界和社区的大力支持，他们纷纷派出志愿者参与协助。其中包括4位Hamilton高中的学生、13位Chandler Basis的学生，3位索诺兰小径初中的学生、7位ASU的学生（4位来自中文领航项目），以及ASU孔子学院的10位工作人员。另外还要特别感谢负责中国画演示的Su Zhiying女士和她的四位学生，以及中国乐器展示的Cai Shangao先生。
a35d80c2e6eec2a2a3896c7c587462e5366fbc8f.translatedText: The success of this event is also inseparable from the strong support of the academic circles and communities in the Phoenix area, who sent volunteers to assist. These include 4 Hamilton High School students, 13 Chandler Basis students, 3 Sonoran Trail Junior High School students, 7 ASU students (4 from the Chinese Navigator Program), and 10 staff members from the ASU Confucius Institute. Special thanks also go to Ms. Su Zhiying and her four students who were in charge of the Chinese painting demonstration, and Mr. Cai Shangao who was in charge of the Chinese musical instrument demonstration.

c802750e19d52b36ae35a72c9149449bab4d135c.sourceText: 大凤凰城地区房屋销售数量和价格7月小幅回调。2014年7月房屋销售下降了4.5%，房屋销售的均价为21万。亚利桑那州立大学房地产理论部主任表示房地产市场的适度放缓证明了房地产泡沫不会很快再开始。 他表示2005年下半年和2006年，2007年房地产供应开始增长，预示着房地产泡沫的崩溃，今年夏天房地产供应正在慢慢减弱。 不少卖家依然有耐心等待更好的时间，他们不愿意降价处置房子。今年7月，7279个房子销售，与六月的7624进行比较，六月的均价为211000美元。2011年凤凰城房价迅速上升，知道去年夏天，销售价格开始放缓。专家预计，在未来数月，供需需要重新回到平衡。 更多房 地产资讯请咨询 Ti nna 480-287-0180 E-mail: goldtrustrealty2010@gmail.com
c802750e19d52b36ae35a72c9149449bab4d135c.translatedText: The number and prices of houses sold in the greater Phoenix area fell back slightly in July. Home sales fell 4.5% in July 2014, with the average home sales price being $210,000. The director of Arizona State University's Department of Real Estate Theory says the modest slowdown in the housing market is proof that a housing bubble won't start again anytime soon. He said that in the second half of 2005 and 2006, real estate supply began to grow in 2007, which heralded the collapse of the real estate bubble, and that real estate supply is slowly weakening this summer. Many sellers are still patiently waiting for a better time, and they are unwilling to lower the price to dispose of their houses. In July, 7,279 homes sold, compared to 7,624 in June, when the average price was $211,000. Phoenix home prices rose rapidly in 2011 until last summer, sales prices began to slow. Experts predict that supply and demand will need to return to balance in the coming months. For more real estate information, please contact Ti nna 480-287-0180 E-mail: goldtrustrealty2010@gmail.com

9ded6e02e1bcffda18a62ef40ed2260ac262b252.sourceText: 美国篮球总部新家将要落户Tempe城，这是作为4.36亿美元Mill街改造的一个组成部分。 这个项目预计今年12月开始施工。开发商已经与亚利桑州立大学签署了一个99年的租赁协议，使用Mill街东边，大学路和第10街的10.7英亩的土地。 除了体育场馆落户此地，这个项目还包括了全方位的酒店和会议中心，豪华公寓，零售店，办公室以及地下停车场。整个项目就建在亚利桑那州立大学的隔壁，属于适宜步行的，可持续性发展的商业区。 美国篮球总部执掌10支参加国际比赛的篮球队，包括奥运会和世锦赛，以后NBA和WNBA就就在这里集训。因为这个场地预计在2016年末才完工，所以2016年的奥运会没无法在这里举行。这个中心建好后，预计每年能吸引35万的游客，带来1.15亿的收入。Tempe市长表示，这个USA Place将会成为新的城市中心。
9ded6e02e1bcffda18a62ef40ed2260ac262b252.translatedText: The new home of the US Basketball Headquarters will be located in Tempe City, as part of the $436 million Mill Street transformation. Construction of this project is expected to begin in December this year. The developer has signed a 99-year lease agreement with Arizona State University for use of 10.7 acres east of Mill Street, University Avenue and 10th Street. In addition to housing the sports venues, the project also includes a full-service hotel and conference center, luxury apartments, retail stores, offices and underground parking. The entire project is built next door to Arizona State University in a walkable, sustainable business district. The US Basketball Headquarters manages 10 basketball teams participating in international competitions, including the Olympic Games and World Championships. The NBA and WNBA will train here in the future. Because the venue is not expected to be completed until the end of 2016, the 2016 Olympic Games will not be held here. After the center is completed, it is expected to attract 350,000 tourists every year and bring in revenue of 115 million. The Mayor of Tempe said that this USA Place will become a new city center.

e132e4693a2416fe0ccd28292cdc2b3186db715f.translatedText: Dance - Expression Beyond Language 2014 "Golden Autumn" Chinese Dance Art Festival (Contributed by New Oriental Art School) Yali...

f3732d8fd559a505320a19d6ea532bb0aa380582.sourceText: （新东方艺术学校来稿）亚利桑那的华人活动一向丰富多彩，具有东方特色的舞蹈是各种中西方文化活动中重要组成部分，每年的中国周，中国春晚，各华人社团的春宴，各大筹款晚宴，都可以看到”新东方艺术学校”舞蹈小演员的身影。她们的每次演出不仅延续着极高的艺术水准，不断推新作，推新人，坚持带领中国舞蹈走出华人社区，全方位打造东方文化品牌。 为了将”中国舞蹈”更加系统化地展示出来，新东方艺术学校诚邀亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院，亚利桑那华人华侨联合会，这些致力于推广东西方文化交流的社团，于9月14日下午在钱德勒艺术中心，精心主办了首届”金秋”中国舞蹈艺术节。主办方代表新东方艺术学校校长吕丽华，孔子学院副院长徐智萍，华联会长王惟咨以及社区侨领都隆重出席了本次活动。 伴随着充满异域风情的鼓点，欢快的节奏，肚皮舞《欢乐的赛琳娜》拉开本次舞蹈节的序幕，红色的纱巾，黄色的服饰，十几位婀娜多姿的舞蹈演员瞬间点燃了舞台。作为一种优美地身体艺术，肚皮舞通过骨盆，臂部，胸部，手臂的动作营造了热情，欢快的舞台气氛。舞蹈作为跨越语言的艺术表达形式，展现了不懂地域的，不同文化特色。
f3732d8fd559a505320a19d6ea532bb0aa380582.translatedText: (Contributed by New Oriental Art School) Chinese activities in Arizona have always been rich and colorful. Dance with oriental characteristics is an important part of various Chinese and Western cultural activities. Every year, during China Week, Chinese Spring Festival Gala, the spring banquets of various Chinese associations, and major fundraising dinners, young dancers from the "New Oriental Art School" can be seen. Each of their performances not only maintains extremely high artistic standards, but also constantly promotes new works and talents, persists in leading Chinese dance out of the Chinese community, and builds an all-round oriental cultural brand. In order to present "Chinese Dance" in a more systematic manner, New Oriental Art School sincerely invites the Confucius Institute at Arizona State University and the Arizona Chinese Overseas Chinese Association, which are dedicated to promoting cultural exchanges between the East and the West, to carefully host the first "Golden Autumn" Chinese Dance Art Festival at the Chandler Art Center on the afternoon of September 14. On behalf of the organizers, Lv Lihua, principal of New Oriental Art School, Xu Zhiping, deputy director of the Confucius Institute, Wang Weizi, president of Hualian, and overseas Chinese leaders in the community all attended the event. Accompanied by exotic drumbeats and cheerful rhythms, the belly dance "Happy Selena" kicked off the dance festival. A dozen graceful dancers in red scarves and yellow costumes instantly lit up the stage. As a beautiful body art, belly dancing creates a warm and cheerful stage atmosphere through the movements of the pelvis, arms, chest and arms. As a form of artistic expression that transcends languages, dance shows different cultural characteristics that do not understand the region.

84877b4a72d2d8d986a2691404c1fa490e65a335.sourceText: 汉族舞蹈《六月清荷》把观众们带到了六月的中国江南。舞者手中的绿色中国扇就如那飘荡在水面上的荷叶在微风中轻轻摇弋，身着粉色服饰的舞蹈者时而是穿梭在荷塘中的曼妙的采莲姑娘，时而是端庄大气的朵朵荷花。中国扇在姑娘们的手中千变万化，似轻轻泛起的水波，似姑娘欲笑还羞遮面手绢。”轻风摇荷影 青荷凝碧珠”的画面，跃然纸上。安静，娟秀的田园风光，美不胜收。
84877b4a72d2d8d986a2691404c1fa490e65a335.translatedText: Han dance "Qinghe in June" brought the audience to Jiangnan, China in June. The green Chinese fans in the hands of the dancers are like the lotus leaves floating on the water, swaying gently in the breeze. The dancers in pink costumes are sometimes graceful lotus-picking girls shuttled in the lotus pond, and sometimes they are dignified lotus flowers. The Chinese fans are ever-changing in the hands of the girls, like gentle ripples in the water, or like a handkerchief used by a girl to hide her face in shame even though she is about to laugh. The picture of "The light breeze shakes the shadow of the lotus, and the blue lotus condenses with blue beads" is vividly displayed on the paper. Quiet, beautiful pastoral scenery, beautiful.

2b3353950e26dab244c862c41b0e82c35c79a686.sourceText: 这里刚让观众体会了舒缓，闲适，那里又开始让人屏住呼吸。新东方艺术学校８班的《蒙古舞舞蹈组合》。一下子，把观众们拉到了广袤的草原。雄雄万马奔腾，苍鹰翱翔在广阔的晴空。在中国，蒙古族是能歌善舞的民族。蒙古族舞蹈也是中国舞蹈重要组成部分，特点是节奏明快，热情奔放，语汇新颖，风格独特。动作多以抖肩、翻腕来表现蒙古族姑娘欢快优美，热情。这个班的姑娘大都有多年学习中国舞蹈的经验，腿功，腰功，以及手臂的力量，寸寸到位，表情，神态更是感染了台下的每一位观众，即使是美国观众都纷纷伸出大母子赞叹：完美至极！
2b3353950e26dab244c862c41b0e82c35c79a686.translatedText: The audience has just experienced soothing and leisure here, and it starts to take people's breath away again there. "Mongolian Dance Group" from Class 8 of New Oriental Art School. All of a sudden, the audience was transported to the vast grassland. Thousands of majestic horses galloped, and goshawks soared in the vast clear sky. In China, the Mongolian people are good at singing and dancing. Mongolian dance is also an important part of Chinese dance. It is characterized by bright rhythm, enthusiasm, novel vocabulary and unique style. The movements mostly involve shaking shoulders and turning wrists to express the cheerfulness, gracefulness and enthusiasm of Mongolian girls. Most of the girls in this class have many years of experience in learning Chinese dance. Their leg skills, waist skills, and arm strength are perfect every inch. Their expressions and demeanor have infected every audience in the audience. Even the American audience stretched out their arms and praised: Perfect!

7c37f7c4a6c3f7492b3b88c4c1a4ddde8c5c7986.sourceText: 《红旗颂》 本次艺术节的舞蹈总监邱晓榕老师介绍舞蹈是一种国际语言，即使完全没有东方背景的人，一眼都能看懂。汉族舞蹈《小嫚》讲述的就是一群爱跳舞的中国女孩。它以胶州秧歌为基础，用传统的团扇，来表现东方女孩含蓄，优雅的气质。举办这次舞蹈节，就是要让大家看到中国不同地区，不同民族的人和他们的生活形态。这只是舞蹈节首次尝试，未来她希望和其他美国学校进行更多的舞蹈形式的交流，大家不仅能看到中国舞蹈，还能看到更多的美国当地舞蹈，让舞蹈节成为一个热爱舞蹈朋友的大联欢。
7c37f7c4a6c3f7492b3b88c4c1a4ddde8c5c7986.translatedText: "Ode to the Red Flag" The dance director of this art festival, Qiu Xiaorong, introduced that dance is an international language that even people with no Eastern background can understand at a glance. The Han dance "Xiaoman" is about a group of Chinese girls who love to dance. It is based on Jiaozhou Yangko and uses traditional round fans to express the subtle and elegant temperament of oriental girls. The purpose of holding this dance festival is to let everyone see people from different regions and ethnic groups in China and their lifestyles. This is only the dance festival’s first attempt. In the future, she hopes to have more exchanges with other American schools in dance forms. Not only can everyone see Chinese dance, but also more local American dances, making the dance festival a grand gathering for friends who love dance.

a11429263df3dcb363256f7ba08a7750de3b9903.sourceText: 汉族舞蹈《小嫚》 短短两个小时，台上台下都依依不舍，小演员们多年的努力，家长们的支持，老师们的辛勤培育，给观众带来了一份丰盛的艺术盛宴。当主持人告诉大家”2015年春晚”再见的时候，很多美国朋友都纷纷记下了这个日子。2015年2月我们再次相约，不见不散！
a11429263df3dcb363256f7ba08a7750de3b9903.translatedText: The Han Chinese Dance "Xiao Man" lasted just two hours, and everyone on and off the stage was reluctant to leave. The young actors' years of hard work, the support of parents, and the diligent cultivation of teachers brought a rich artistic feast to the audience. When the host told everyone to see you again at the "2015 Spring Festival Gala", many American friends took note of this date. We will meet again in February 2015, see you there!

c29be425a84cafd105735e05089ebee3d5bc6344.sourceText: 2014秋季亚利桑那州立大学迎来600多位中国新留学生
c29be425a84cafd105735e05089ebee3d5bc6344.translatedText: In the fall of 2014, Arizona State University welcomed more than 600 new international students from China

d83eb539e135e259b0cad700f4cebcf671272c7f.sourceText: 2014秋季亚利桑那州立大学迎来600多位中国新留学生 8月29日晚5时在亚利桑那州立大学学生学者联谊会（…
d83eb539e135e259b0cad700f4cebcf671272c7f.translatedText: In the fall of 2014, Arizona State University welcomed more than 600 new international students from China. August 29, 5 pm, at the Arizona State University Students and Scholars Association (…

7407cf09d378bf05f57ce41170b69a4192716e65.sourceText: 8月29日晚5时在亚利桑那州立大学学生学者联谊会（ASUCSSA）在Mormon Church举办了2014年秋季迎新活动。洛杉矶领事馆赵守圣副领事亲自到现场欢迎新同学。500多新生参加了本次活动，2014秋季学期共有600多位来自中国的新留学生在ASU求学。
7407cf09d378bf05f57ce41170b69a4192716e65.translatedText: August 29, 5 pm, at the Arizona State University Students and Scholars Association (ASUCSSA) in Mormon Church held the 2014 fall orientation event. Deputy Consul Zhao Shousheng of the Los Angeles Consulate was on hand to welcome new students. More than 500 freshmen attended the event. In the 2014 fall semester, there were more than 600 new international students from China. Studying at SU.

64a78c3810592e2625f437d35410a2f4f6a45a31.sourceText: ASU中国学生学者联谊会主席朱博威主持了本次活动。洛杉矶领事馆赵守圣领事就留学安全问题，强调留学过程中的人生安全问题。驾驶安全，身体，精神健康，家庭暴力，遵守美国法律法规，紧急事件的处理等等问题是侨务工作的重中之重。2014年在美留学生中失去了11位年轻的生命，赵领事亲身参与了很多的善后工作，反复强调了一些容易被忽视的安全问题。例如家庭暴力，很多同学认为离自己很遥远，可是这样的事件就常常发生，学生自己还不知道。男女朋友发生小的纠纷，其中一位同学推搡了另一位，这种情况被周围的人看见，并报警。那位有推搡动作的同学，就会因为这一行为惹上诉讼。各种昂贵的律师费用就不用说了，还有可能摊上家庭暴力的犯罪记录，失去学生身份，或者终身无法再进入美国等等（即使后来推搡双方都原谅彼此，但都无济于事）。赵领事说新生给他带来最深刻的映象就是朝气，生机勃勃，这些新同学也正是海外留学生中高危人群。赵领事表示这次参加ASU迎新生活动也开启2014秋季学期，中国领事馆”侨务进校园”首站活动。
64a78c3810592e2625f437d35410a2f4f6a45a31.translatedText: Chairman of the ASU Chinese Students and Scholars Association Xi Zhubowei hosted this event. Consul Zhao Shousheng of the Los Angeles Consulate discussed the safety issues of studying abroad, emphasizing issues such as driving safety, physical and mental health, domestic violence, compliance with U.S. laws and regulations, and handling of emergencies. Overseas Chinese affairs are the top priority. In 2014, 11 young students in the United States lost their lives. Consul Zhao personally participated in a lot of aftermath work and repeatedly emphasized some safety issues that are easily ignored, such as domestic violence, which many students think are far away from them. However, such incidents often happen, and the students themselves don’t know it. There is a small dispute between a boyfriend and a girlfriend, and one of the classmates pushes the other. If this happens, the student who did the pushing will call the police. Not to mention various expensive legal fees, there is also the possibility of having a criminal record of domestic violence, losing student status, or being unable to reenter the United States for life, etc. (Even if both parties forgive each other later, it will not help). The most profound impression he brought was that they were full of vigor and vitality. These new students are also among the high-risk groups of overseas students. Consul Zhao said that this participation in the ASU freshman orientation event was the first stop of the Chinese Consulate's "Overseas Chinese Affairs on Campus" event

64a98ce6a000e323af100b505e530d479899d171.sourceText: 华人移民律师戴学正也在活动中给大家做了一些法律方面的提醒，并能为未来同学们移民身份转换提供更加专业的服务。Tempe警察局Sergeant Chris警长也给新同学们带来些一些安全介绍。提醒大家出门要关注自己身边的人群，不要只关注手机或者平板电脑。注意遵守美国法律，度过一个愉快的求学旅程。 迎新活动中还包括凤凰城各商家赞助的奖品，同学们通过抽奖，投篮等游戏赢得奖品。
64a98ce6a000e323af100b505e530d479899d171.translatedText: Chinese immigration lawyer Dai Xuezheng also gave everyone some legal reminders at the event and provided more professional services for future students' immigration status. Sergeant, Tempe Police Department Sheriff Chris also gave some safety introductions to the new students. He reminded everyone to pay attention to the people around them when going out, and to abide by the laws of the United States and have a pleasant academic journey. The orientation activities also included prizes sponsored by various businesses in Phoenix, and students won prizes through lottery, shooting and other games.

b29359dd4f417fc2db990e7ef78d7087aa4ff681.sourceText: 幕后故事：COSMO 选美大赛面面观（图）
b29359dd4f417fc2db990e7ef78d7087aa4ff681.translatedText: Behind-the-scenes story: A look at the COSMO beauty pageant (pictures)

4a6eb6658abb504255a262e362a5d88ec7e49155.sourceText: 幕后故事：COSMO 选美大赛面面观（图） 2014度年中华小姐环球大赛北美赛区总决赛，已于８月１０日下午…
4a6eb6658abb504255a262e362a5d88ec7e49155.translatedText: Behind-the-scenes story: A look at the COSMO beauty pageant (pictures) The North American Division Finals of the 2014 Miss China Universe Contest concluded on the afternoon of August 10th...

c8e6a9a277f47e1817c616e70f8cfe3ff96e4a7a.sourceText: 2014度年中华小姐环球大赛北美赛区总决赛，已于８月１０日下午在美国凤凰城野马大剧场落下帷幕。 15位佳丽经过角逐，来自温哥华的１号佳丽钟祺摘得桂冠。 10号林雨田获得亚军，13号金小媞获得季军。上图是她们素颜面众。
c8e6a9a277f47e1817c616e70f8cfe3ff96e4a7a.translatedText: The North American Division Finals of the 2014 Miss China Universe Contest concluded on the afternoon of August 10th at the Mustang Arena in Phoenix, USA. After 15 beauties competed, the No. 1 beauty Zhong Qi from Vancouver won the crown. No. 10 Lin Yutian won the runner-up, and No. 13 Jin Xiaoti won the third runner-up. The picture above shows them without makeup.

7f9a90cc4fb76a5649eee1bad200467d30a93877.sourceText: 这次能邀请到洲际性的选美大赛来沙漠之城举办，是大凤凰城侨联总会出钱出力，穿针引线和经年努力准备的结果，能让凤凰城人看上一场规模空前的大骚，亦是相当的值得。今次侨联举办的赛前晚会和选美大赛的观赏人数，由剧院统计分别有八百和九百人之众，也算是个不错的成织。凤凰城自从1980年出了个关碧云到过三藩市参加华埠小姐选美以来，三十多年来都是关起门来自己玩，如今看看人家如何玩法，自身倒也可以反思和领教一番。
7f9a90cc4fb76a5649eee1bad200467d30a93877.translatedText: This time, the intercontinental beauty pageant can be invited to the desert city. It is the result of the money and efforts of the Overseas Chinese Federation of Greater Phoenix, as well as years of hard work and preparation. It is quite worthwhile to allow people in Phoenix to watch a show of unprecedented scale. According to statistics from the theater, the number of people watching the pre-game party and the beauty pageant organized by the Overseas Chinese Federation this time was 800 and 900 people respectively, which can be considered a good number. Ever since Phoenix City produced Guan Biyun in 1980 and went to San Francisco to participate in the Miss Chinatown beauty pageant, it has been playing behind closed doors for more than 30 years. Now, looking at how others play, it can help us reflect on and learn from it.

dd31640edacff2917f33911066372305d907f6e3.sourceText: 首先，选美大赛的大製作是张天爱，她早年学习芭蕾舞，9岁考入皇家芭蕾舞学院，在校园内已拥有个人凋像。她也是香港的时装设计师、演员。1981年创立了个人的时装品牌Pavlova而蜚声中外。编舞的Johan Stjernholm出生于瑞典，毕业于芭蕾舞名校, ，2003年获得欧洲舞蹈戏剧实践文学硕士学位，2010年获得哲学博士学位，现担任伦敦皇家舞蹈学院舞蹈编排和表演讲师。凤凰卫视有此两位巨星坐阵，乌鸦也能变凤凰。
dd31640edacff2917f33911066372305d907f6e3.translatedText: First of all, the beauty pageant's big production is Zhang Tianai. She studied ballet in her early years and was admitted to the Royal Ballet Academy at the age of 9. She already has a personal statue on campus. She is also a Hong Kong fashion designer and actress. In 1981, he founded his own fashion brand Pavlova and became famous at home and abroad. Choreographer Johan Stjernholm was born in Sweden and graduated from a prestigious ballet school. He received a Master of Arts in European Dance Theater Practice in 2003 and a PhD in Philosophy in 2010. He is currently a choreography and performance lecturer at the Royal Academy of Dance in London. Phoenix TV has these two superstars in the lineup, and a crow can become a phoenix.

1a6c36d1e588f7695cbe211ff6576f72cb14c8b2.sourceText: 其次，看了自家人几十年来千篇一律选美的凤凰城华人，对其选美流程可谓倒背如流。但人家製作单位就有本事打破固有模式，把部分表演和佳丽才艺穿插于各环节中，不但节省时间，也增加观赏性。本届佳丽素质相对来说一般，十八廿二的姑娘只有5位，其余10位的年龄偏大但学历高，书读得够多的，但才艺就未必够班，故主办单位不专门设才艺考核(其实历届如是) ，不象我们凤凰城，有些佳丽才学了三几个星期才艺，就要上场献丑，令到观众也为之捏把汗。也让众多的有书卷气而无杰出才艺的佳丽连报名都望而怯步！
1a6c36d1e588f7695cbe211ff6576f72cb14c8b2.translatedText: Secondly, Chinese people from Phoenix who have watched their family members perform the same beauty pageants for decades know the beauty pageant process by heart. However, other production units have the ability to break the stereotype and intersperse some performances and beauties' talents into various links, which not only saves time, but also increases the enjoyment. The quality of this year's contestants is relatively average. There are only 5 girls who are 18 or 22 years old. The remaining 10 contestants are older but have high academic qualifications. They have read enough books, but their talents may not be up to par. Therefore, the organizer does not set up a special talent assessment (in fact, it has been the case in previous years). Unlike our Phoenix City, some contestants have only learned their talents for three or more weeks and have to go on stage to show off their talents, which makes the audience sweat. It also makes many bookish beauties without outstanding talents shy away from even signing up!

59ac80092e035b6789596a463713dbae69da6087.sourceText: 第三，既然是选美，有修长美腿和面目姣好者才称得上＂中华小姐＂。大赛亦以＂美＂为优先选择，道得品行符合参赛标准即可，至予其它环节如服装、才艺、智答等环节只属参考，这会影响对佳丽评分吗？当然会，但大局抵定。当你看到老绰大牌司仪尉迟琳嘉最后一句：既然大部分观众都叫嚷一号当选，那冠军就是她了，随即把裁判信封看也不看就撕掉，直接宣佈冠军得主。明眼人就知道是内定的呢，但也让你不得不服大媒体的底气和霸气。日后的凤凰城华裔小姐选美，是否也应让了解佳丽状况的主办单位多一份发言权呢？
59ac80092e035b6789596a463713dbae69da6087.translatedText: Third, since it is a beauty pageant, only those with long, beautiful legs and good looks can be called "Miss China." The competition also prioritizes "beauty". It only needs to be that the moral character meets the competition standards. Other aspects such as clothing, talent, intellectual answers, etc. are only for reference. Will this affect the score of the beauties? Of course it will, but the overall situation is determined. When you see the last sentence of Yuchi Linjia, the emcee of Lao Chuo: since most of the audience is shouting that No. 1 is elected, then she is the champion, then he tore up the referee envelope without looking at it and directly announced the winner. Anyone with a discerning eye will know that it is an unofficial decision, but it also forces you to accept the confidence and domineering power of the big media. In future Miss Chinese Phoenix pageants, should the organizers who understand the situation of the beauties have an additional say?

8ba64ab1690cf1383876adaf0b1a5b8abd26a5f9.sourceText: 还有一点，选后要问冠军是谁？大多数人未必叫得出钟祺的名字，倒是当晚司仪令人印象深刻。凤凰城华人多有不知这位人被称为＂凤凰卫视当家男神尉迟琳嘉主持＂来头。他的《笑逐言开》栏目可谓天下大小事无所不包，或谈笑风生，或嬉笑怒骂，或能唱能演，或敢言敢玩.呈现出极具个人的特色。当晚他上台的那一句：为何这里称＂亚利桑那州＂呢？不用＂亚利＂就叫＂桑拿州＂不是更好？真是妙不可言！随即在每个环节中，尉迟都会口没遮拦的修理佳丽，尽挖苦之能事但也让你捧腹大笑。夸张一点说，全场选美都是他个人的脱口秀，大会宠着他，观众赞着他，一人搅动全场气氛，功力和魅力绝对一流，难怪他能成为当今凤凰卫视中的活宝。总台能派这麽一员大将来作北美赛区的金牌司仪，是否因2013年北美冠军牟冠红勇夺＂中华小姐环球总决赛＂亚军之故？今后我们还会有专文再八卦一下这位比＂北美崔哥＂更神的主持＂尉迟琳嘉＂。
8ba64ab1690cf1383876adaf0b1a5b8abd26a5f9.translatedText: One more thing, after the election, I have to ask who is the champion? Most people may not be able to recognize Zhong Qi's name, but the emcee that night was impressive. Many Chinese people in Phoenix City don't know the background of this man known as "Phoenix TV's leading male idol Yuchi Linjia." His "Laughing with Words" column can be said to cover everything in the world, whether he talks and laughs, or laughs and curses, or can sing or act, or speaks out and dares to play. It shows a very personal characteristic. What he said when he took the stage that night: Why is this place called "Arizona"? Wouldn't it be better to call it "Sauna State" instead of "Yali"? How wonderful! Then in every link, Yuchi will criticize the beauties without hesitation, trying his best to be sarcastic but also making you laugh. To exaggerate, the entire beauty pageant is his personal talk show. The conference dotes on him, the audience praises him, and he stirs up the atmosphere of the entire audience. His skills and charm are absolutely top-notch. No wonder he has become a living treasure on Phoenix TV today. Is it because the 2013 North American champion Mou Guanhong won the runner-up spot in the "Miss China Universe Finals" that the Taiwanese broadcaster can send such a senior to serve as the gold medal emcee in the North American division? In the future, we will have a special article to gossip about this host "Yuchi Linjia" who is more awesome than "North America Cui Ge".

b3401500e0228cb78475fc249ea864f4d3ff2001.sourceText: 再说些选美事儿。由于学期末考试与选美夏令营撞期，来自加拿大赛区的选手陶璐苗自愿放弃16强佳丽资格，由来自北卡的选手陆菲补位。另外，不是说有16位佳丽参赛吗？何故只有15位呢？原来有位参赛选手名叫宁乐，因违反规定，被取消其比赛资格。所以陶璐苗和宁乐就无缘参加决赛，而补位的陆菲就多晒了几天亚利桑那州的太阳。
b3401500e0228cb78475fc249ea864f4d3ff2001.translatedText: Let’s talk about beauty pageants. Due to the conflict between the end-of-semester exam and the beauty pageant summer camp, contestant Tao Lumiao from Canada voluntarily gave up her qualifications for the top 16 contestants, and contestant Lu Fei from North Carolina took the place. Also, didn’t it say that there were 16 beauties competing? Why are there only 15? It turns out that a contestant named Ning Le was disqualified from the competition for violating the regulations. Therefore, Tao Lumiao and Ning Le missed the chance to participate in the finals, while Lu Fei, who took the place, got to bask in the Arizona sun for a few more days.

ed29c104e7bb221654c90d69e9464a12e9a3b009.sourceText: 说起亚利桑那州的太阳也真是够毒的，居然让北美各地的佳丽人人中招，事关她们在参加夏令营中，因汽车在旅途中死火两个多小时，佳丽被白花花的太阳光所沐浴，在炙风热土等候救助时，还唱唱跳跳的。更夸张的是，回到凤凰城有佳丽因中暑不适，而星期六西医又不开诊，唯有看中医见郎中，中药慢慢的熬，等得花儿也谢了。北美的佳丽们，向你们致敬！太辛苦你们了！
ed29c104e7bb221654c90d69e9464a12e9a3b009.translatedText: Speaking of the Arizona sun, it is really poisonous. It actually affected beauties from all over North America. It happened when their car stalled for more than two hours during the summer camp when they were traveling. The beauties were bathed in the white sun and sang and danced while waiting for rescue in the scorching wind. What's even more exaggerated is that a beauty returned to Phoenix City and felt unwell due to heat stroke. Western medicine was not open on Saturdays, so she had to see a Chinese medicine doctor. The Chinese medicine was slowly applied until the flowers withered. Beauties of North America, salute to you! Thank you so much!

a59d18548691e40fd6d4ae04045e5c8a1dbd539b.sourceText: 我们亚利桑那州的州长珍‧布鲁尔接见了众位佳丽，她送给每人一枚印有州旗的心形像章留念。不知是否有说些鼓励的活儿？
a59d18548691e40fd6d4ae04045e5c8a1dbd539b.translatedText: Our Arizona Governor, Jane Brewer, met the contestants and gave each of them a heart-shaped badge with the state flag printed on it as a souvenir. I wonder if there is anything encouraging?

0acbc6bc8e86ae88a42ce7901f55c60726708ee8.sourceText: 佳丽们对这次在美国的亚利桑那州举办的选美，又不知会留下些什麽样的深刻印象呢？
0acbc6bc8e86ae88a42ce7901f55c60726708ee8.translatedText: > What kind of deep impression will the beauties have on this beauty pageant held in Arizona, USA?

51c3e506e241f7885be75cb9d7d9f7c987a77d1c.translatedText: The election for Chandler Councilor is coming soon. Volunteers are solicited to put in small signs. The election of Chandler City Council has been...

eab6c6d0e8148370b4619534aede72f9d43ca364.sourceText: 此次Chandler City Council 的选举已近尾声，八月二十六日是投票日，全Chandler 共有四十三个投票所（其中有重迭者，故实际为四十一个投票所）。
eab6c6d0e8148370b4619534aede72f9d43ca364.translatedText: The election of Chandler City Council is coming to an end. August 26 is the voting day. There are 43 polling stations in Chandler (there are overlaps, so there are actually 41 polling stations).

e092538b796c41b60a36d50295908fa536c8fd8b.sourceText: 我们需要在投票日前，在投票所的入口处，插上竞选的小牌子，因为仍然有很多选民，即使到了投票日当天，尚未做最后决定，有部份人甚至根本不知道候选人的名字。我们需要再一次增加他们的印象。因为如果别的候选人有牌子，而我没有，很可能就会失去那一张票。
e092538b796c41b60a36d50295908fa536c8fd8b.translatedText: We need to put up a small campaign sign at the entrance of the polling station before the voting day, because there are still many voters who have not yet made a final decision even on the voting day, and some people do not even know the names of the candidates. Once again we need to increase their impressions. Because if other candidates have signs but I don’t, I will probably lose that vote.

e0ae7f9da8b94897b125575a7870f21b716de1a6.sourceText: 非常感谢您几个月来的热心帮忙，馨民此次当选的希望相当浓厚，在此最后的关头，希望能够得到你的帮助。如果我们能够得到十五位义工的帮忙，那么每一个人只需要到二到三个投票所，连车程半小时到一个小时就可以完成。
e0ae7f9da8b94897b125575a7870f21b716de1a6.translatedText: Thank you very much for your enthusiastic help over the past few months. Xinmin has a strong hope of being elected this time. At this last moment, I hope to get your help. If we can get the help of fifteen volunteers, then each person only needs to go to two to three polling stations, and the drive can take half an hour to an hour.

731e2dee4ca0a568b1c7e3150745033e7a158c90.sourceText: 谨此附上投票所的地址以及地图（每一个都已经标示），如果你的住所，或是活动范围在Chandler 附近，能够帮忙的话，敬请回覆此一邮件，或是给我电话（480-689-2305)。我们预定在八月二十五日（星期一），下午前来小弟办公室领取地图和牌子。非常感谢。
731e2dee4ca0a568b1c7e3150745033e7a158c90.translatedText: Attached are the addresses and maps of the polling places (each one is marked). If you live or are active near Chandler and can help, please reply to this email or call me (480-689-2305). We are scheduled to come to my office in the afternoon on August 25th (Monday) to pick up the map and sign. Thank you so much.

When buying a house, the three most critical factors are Location, Location, and Location. 284b4e4968b5b10a071f7d4b51867b24bc520288.translatedText: The 2014 Miss China Beauty Pageant hosted by Phoenix Satellite TV, the North American Division Finals entered the most intense stage. At 2:00 this afternoon, the Mustang Arena in Phoenix, USA will welcome fifteen contestants to the North American finals.

705c336f65af7b3ff0eab6e8e480ed51a3fe3a93.sourceText: 为了为本次活动热身，一展华谊小姐的风采，8月9日由凤凰卫视知名主持陆锦仪，莫少康，中华小姐亚军张梦，凤凰卫视嘉宾饶湘以，以及凤凰城当地的艺人共同献上了一场精彩的文艺晚会。凤凰卫视美国有限公司，财务经理林英明先生接受了本网记者采访：”他表示，中华小姐选美是凤凰卫视的传统，广泛受到全球关注，每年来自全球6个赛区的前三名，都将到香港参加最后的总决赛。” 林先生介绍，今年他们陆续派出了三十几位工作人员到凤凰城进行节目的制作。协办单位侨联给与了很大帮助，一切就绪，就等10日下午佳丽们的精彩展示。
705c336f65af7b3ff0eab6e8e480ed51a3fe3a93.translatedText: In order to warm up for this event and show off the style of Miss Huayi, on August 9th, well-known Phoenix TV hosts Lu Jinyi, Mo Shaokang, Miss China runner-up Zhang Meng, Phoenix TV guest Rao Xiangyi, and local artists in Phoenix City jointly presented a wonderful cultural evening. Mr. Lin Yingming, financial manager of Phoenix TV America Co., Ltd., accepted an interview with this reporter: "He said that the Miss China beauty pageant is a tradition of Phoenix TV and has attracted widespread global attention. Every year, the top three from six competition regions around the world will go to Hong Kong to participate in the finals." Mr. Lin introduced that this year they have sent more than 30 staff to Phoenix to produce the program. The co-organizer, the Overseas Chinese Federation, has been very helpful. Everything is ready, waiting for the wonderful display of the beauties on the afternoon of the 10th.

bd4de59a86855bc5d61fbb6fa63b3eea7f2162f0.sourceText: （综合资讯）截止到7月27日，2014 中华小姐环球大赛美洲赛区16强佳丽已产生，她们将进入在亚利桑那举办的选美夏令营，并于8月10日在凤凰城角逐总决赛桂冠。 来自美西赛区的近三十位参赛选手有五名佳丽脱颖而出:在好莱坞闯荡多年的华裔演员刘百惠是毕业于纽约大学影视表演专业的硕士，拥有丰富表演经验。金晓媞是出生在洛杉矶的北京人，现在是加州大学尔湾分校艺术系大一学生。来自广州的刁华现在是加州大学尔湾分校经济系大四学生。青岛姑娘刘欣如是毕业于旧金山艺术学院的硕士生，擅长街舞。来自辽宁的宁乐是毕业于南加州大学工业工程专业的硕士，练习武术多年。 7月26日，加西分赛区甄选在阿尔伯塔省卡尔加里圆满落幕。二十位来自温哥华，多伦多和卡尔加里的参赛选手，经过’大唐飞舞’，小礼服，泳装，才艺表演，晚礼服及机智问答等五个环节进行激烈角逐。最终代表加西赛区进入总决赛的佳丽有：谢文聪、林雨田、钟祺以及陶潞苗。 7月22日，美东有4名选手入围美洲赛区总决选。她们分别是来自纽约的王杨和杨倩、来自圣路易斯的董玥、来自智利的王静叶。 7月21日，加拿大东部入选的三强佳丽依次是来自约克大学的刘元喆以及来自多伦多大学的韩馨予和杜雨格。生于山东长于上海的刘元喆现在就读于约克大学人力资源管理专业，从小学习钢琴，10岁已拿到中央音乐学院10级证书。就读于多伦多大学的韩馨予是一个综合素质很高的才女，她认为，美丽是一份能经由时间考验的精神。来自北京的杜雨格今年9月将进入多伦多大学Rotman商学院开始本科学习，从小练习小提琴、舞蹈、花样滑冰等才艺，是琴棋书画样样通的标准美女。
bd4de59a86855bc5d61fbb6fa63b3eea7f2162f0.translatedText: (Comprehensive information) As of July 27, 2014 The top 16 beauties of the Americas division of the Miss China Universe competition have been selected. They will enter the beauty pageant summer camp in Arizona and compete for the finals crown in Phoenix on August 10. Among the nearly thirty contestants from the Western United States, five beauties stood out: Liu Baihui, a Chinese actor who has been in Hollywood for many years, graduated from New York University with a master's degree in film and television performance and has rich acting experience. Jin Xiaoti is a Beijinger who was born in Los Angeles. She is now a first-year art student at the University of California, Irvine. Diao Hua from Guangzhou is now a senior student in the Department of Economics at the University of California, Irvine. Qingdao girl Liu Xinru graduated from the San Francisco Art Institute with a master's degree and is good at street dancing. Ningle, who is from Liaoning, graduated from the University of Southern California with a master's degree in industrial engineering and has practiced martial arts for many years. On July 26, the Western Canada division selection concluded successfully in Calgary, Alberta. Twenty contestants from Vancouver, Toronto and Calgary competed fiercely in five sessions including 'Flying in the Tang Dynasty', mini dress, swimsuit, talent show, evening dress and quiz. The contestants who represented the Western Canada region in the finals were: Xie Wencong, Lin Yutian, Zhong Qi and Tao Lumiao. On July 22, 4 players from the US East were shortlisted for the Americas Division Finals. They are Wang Yang and Yang Qian from New York, Dong Yue from St. Louis, and Wang Jingye from Chile. On July 21, the top three contestants from Eastern Canada were Liu Yuanzhe from York University and Han Xinyu and Du Yuge from the University of Toronto. Liu Yuanzhe, who was born in Shandong and grew up in Shanghai, is currently studying human resources management at York University. He has studied piano since he was a child and has obtained the Level 10 certificate from the Central Conservatory of Music at the age of 10. Han Xinyu, who is studying at the University of Toronto, is a talented woman with high overall quality. She believes that beauty is a spirit that can stand the test of time. Du Yuge from Beijing will enter the Rotman School of Business at the University of Toronto to begin undergraduate studies in September this year. She has practiced violin, dance, figure skating and other talents since she was a child. She is a standard beauty who is good at playing music, chess, calligraphy and painting.

86d2fd1686ac5882dfedcab95fefe27faf3bd642.sourceText: （美西时间）7月21日，2014中华小姐环球大赛美洲赛区加拿大东部甄选在多伦多圆满落幕。在众多美貌与智慧并重的佳丽中，经过自我介绍、才艺展示、即兴问答等环节的展示，决出了加东赛区前三甲，进入美洲赛区总决赛。
86d2fd1686ac5882dfedcab95fefe27faf3bd642.translatedText: (Western United States Time) July 21st, the 2014 Miss Chinese Universe Pageant Americas Division Canada Eastern Selection concluded successfully in Toronto. Among the many beauties with equal emphasis on beauty and intelligence, after self-introduction, talent display, impromptu Q&A and other sessions, the top three in the Eastern Division were determined and entered the American Division finals.

b9f181c54b37df22859e9d95a268b1c3fdb1a9bd.sourceText: 入选的三强佳丽依次是来自约克大学的刘元喆以及来自多伦多大学的韩馨予和杜雨格。生于山东长于上海的刘元喆现在就读于约克大学人力资源管理专业，从小学习钢琴，10岁已拿到中央音乐学院10级证书，更在中学期间就参加了数学和物理竞赛，并获得名次。就读于多伦多大学的韩馨予是一个综合素质很高的才女，她认为，美丽是一份能经由时间考验的精神。来自北京的杜雨格今年9月将进入多伦多大学Rotman商学院开始本科学习，从小练习小提琴、舞蹈、花样滑冰等才艺，是琴棋书画样样通的标准美女。
b9f181c54b37df22859e9d95a268b1c3fdb1a9bd.translatedText: The top three selected contestants are Liu Yuanzhe from York University and Han Xinyu and Du Yuge from the University of Toronto. Liu Yuanzhe, who was born in Shandong and grew up in Shanghai, is currently studying human resources management at York University. He has studied piano since he was a child. At the age of 10, he has received a Grade 10 certificate from the Central Conservatory of Music. He also participated in mathematics and physics competitions and won rankings while in middle school. Han Xinyu, who is studying at the University of Toronto, is a talented woman with high overall quality. She believes that beauty is a spirit that can stand the test of time. Du Yuge from Beijing will enter the Rotman School of Business at the University of Toronto to begin undergraduate studies in September this year. She has practiced violin, dance, figure skating and other talents since she was a child. She is a standard beauty who is good at playing music, chess, calligraphy and painting.
