ef2bd7844a0f040982eac4d4311cd0af4fea9d26.translatedText: A prisoner in Arizona was given a lethal injection and died after a 2-hour struggle, sparking controversy. According to the "Daily Mail" report on July 24, the person executed in Arizona on 23 local time...

c2eddb0d5f5d444828a9889d4b7c20c2db29f9a5.sourceText: 被执行死刑的是55岁的约瑟夫 鲁道夫伍德(JosephRudolphWood)，其因于1989年在图森的家庭汽车商店中杀害黛布拉迪茨(DebraDietz)和她的父亲尤金迪茨(EugeneDietz)而被判处死刑。亚利桑纳州最高法院曾于23日上午暂停对其执行死刑，接受最后的上诉。州法院考虑到不必要的骚扰而拒绝提供行刑细节，如药物名称及行刑人员。伍德的律师戴尔 百奇(DaleBaich)则采取一种新的法律策略，提出法院拒绝提供注射药物细节的行为侵害了其委托人的第一修正案权利。但最终，死刑仍继续执行，时间被调整为下午1点。据司法部长汤姆恩的办公室称，伍德在行刑后挣扎了1小时57分钟，于下午3点49分被宣告死亡。
c2eddb0d5f5d444828a9889d4b7c20c2db29f9a5.translatedText: was 55-year-old Joseph. Joseph Rudolph Wood, who was sentenced to death for the 1989 slayings of Debra Dietz and her father, Eugene Dietz, at their family's auto shop in Tucson. The Arizona Supreme Court suspended his execution on the morning of the 23rd to accept the final appeal. State courts, citing unnecessary harassment, declined to provide details of the execution, such as the names of the drugs and the executioners. Wood's attorney, Dale Baich, took a new legal tack by arguing that the court's refusal to provide details about the injection violated his client's First Amendment rights. But in the end, the execution continued and the time was adjusted to 1 p.m. According to Attorney General Thomson's office, Wood struggled for an hour and 57 minutes after the execution and was pronounced dead at 3:49 p.m.

8b10ee72eb8d8900d24a559a767a277e00f35ca1.sourceText: 一位同样对死刑持反对意见的法官表示，行刑队应该寻求一种更人性的执行方法。百奇也表示，”亚利桑那州竭尽全力所保护的秘密损害了我们的民主，因为这阻止了公众、法院及囚犯去知晓行刑是否符合联邦及各州法律。”他还说道，”使用药物意味着个人具有使用药物行刑的需求，被执行死刑的人员看起来平静和安详，这是企图掩盖死刑的残忍真相的面具。”
8b10ee72eb8d8900d24a559a767a277e00f35ca1.translatedText: A judge who also opposes the death penalty said firing squads should seek a more humane method of execution. Pocky also said, "The secrecy that Arizona goes to great lengths to protect undermines our democracy because it prevents the public, courts and prisoners from knowing whether executions comply with federal and state laws." He also said, "The use of drugs implies a personal need to use drugs for execution, and the person being executed looks calm and serene. This is a mask that attempts to hide the cruel truth of the death penalty."

c04b73431a1b0972fb198d5a2f13a9e7bdc8d0ca.sourceText: 值得注意的是，周永康和令计划政治图谋的败露，完全是上文提到的一名周永康身边的”深喉”向三名常委报告的结果。那麽，这个”深喉”是谁呢？
c04b73431a1b0972fb198d5a2f13a9e7bdc8d0ca.translatedText: It is worth noting that the exposure of the political plots of Zhou Yongkang and Ling Jihua was entirely the result of a report by the "Deep Throat" around Zhou Yongkang to the three Standing Committee members. So, who is this "Deep Throat"?

8b9eeff00b1d3c2c5217ccbd89337cdc630af68b.sourceText: 此人正是现任公安部副部长、北京公安局长傅政华。
8b9eeff00b1d3c2c5217ccbd89337cdc630af68b.translatedText: This person is Fu Zhenghua, the current deputy minister of the Ministry of Public Security and the director of Beijing Public Security Bureau.

6a8500b5d7c31c20d47cd9bc425c7ffc43c60000.sourceText: 傅政华负责处理令儿子车祸一案。车祸发生的第一时间，傅政华就接到周永康的一个手令。周永康在手令上明确告诉傅政华，不许将令计划儿子车祸事件的调查过程和结果上报给江泽民、胡锦涛、习近平和孟建柱。
6a8500b5d7c31c20d47cd9bc425c7ffc43c60000.translatedText: Fu Zhenghua is responsible for handling the case of his son's car accident. Immediately after the car accident, Fu Zhenghua received a warrant from Zhou Yongkang. Zhou Yongkang clearly told Fu Zhenghua in the warrant that he was not allowed to report the investigation process and results of Ling Jihua's son's car accident to Jiang Zemin, Hu Jintao, Xi Jinping and Meng Jianzhu.

29d77d6ebbca064e84c3f10d03140666752bcaf8.sourceText: 不过，傅政华后来还是把这份手令交给了胡锦涛和习近平，最后激怒了江、胡、习、孟。傅政华的这一举动最后赢得习近平的信任。在对周永康案展开调查前，习近平就亲自下令，让刚刚升任公安部副部长的傅政华担任公安系统周案调查组组长。
29d77d6ebbca064e84c3f10d03140666752bcaf8.translatedText: However, Fu Zhenghua later handed over the warrant to Hu Jintao and Xi Jinping, which ultimately angered Jiang, Hu, Xi, and Meng. Fu Zhenghua's move finally won Xi Jinping's trust. Before the investigation into the Zhou Yongkang case was launched, Xi Jinping personally ordered Fu Zhenghua, who had just been promoted to deputy minister of the Ministry of Public Security, to serve as the leader of the Zhou Yongkang case investigation team in the public security system.

8830667b83ab9b08b272db3f56778fc89b109542.sourceText: 傅政华不但不是周的人马，而且还是周在公安系统的”死敌”。早在傅振华在公安部担任刑侦局副局长时，与公安部部长助理郑少东关系非常紧张，据说后来担任公安部经侦局副局长的项怀珠，曾用枪打碎了傅政华家的玻璃，威胁到傅的生命安全。
8830667b83ab9b08b272db3f56778fc89b109542.translatedText: Fu Zhenghua is not only not Zhou's man, but also Zhou's "dead enemy" in the public security system. As early as when Fu Zhenhua was the deputy director of the Criminal Investigation Bureau of the Ministry of Public Security, he had a very tense relationship with Zheng Shaodong, the assistant minister of the Ministry of Public Security. It is said that Xiang Huaizhu, who later served as the deputy director of the Economic Investigation Bureau of the Ministry of Public Security, broke the glass of Fu Zhenghua's house with a gun, threatening Fu's life.

6c1f6fdbb7a4d579ccf6480eaa5c30e4a9be6c88.sourceText: 北京知情人士向媒体透露的信息显示，除了习近平之外，傅政华兼任公安部副部长的另一推手正是中纪委书记王岐山。”当初王岐山因非典而调任北京市长，变成救火队长后，得到当时在北京市公安局任职的傅政华的支持和配合，王很欣赏傅。”
6c1f6fdbb7a4d579ccf6480eaa5c30e4a9be6c88.translatedText: Information disclosed to the media by insiders in Beijing shows that in addition to Xi Jinping, another promoter of Fu Zhenghua's appointment as deputy minister of the Ministry of Public Security was Wang Qishan, secretary of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection. "When Wang Qishan was transferred to the mayor of Beijing due to SARS, and became the firefighting captain, he received the support and cooperation of Fu Zhenghua, who was working in the Beijing Public Security Bureau at the time. Wang admired Fu very much."

d01166aba9e30c8b3fb2902445fca6198d129c00.sourceText: 知情人士接著指出，”因此，当王岐山开始著手对周永康案展开调查时，就对傅政华赋予重任，让傅从公安系统内部先对周案展开暗中调查。”在知情人士看来，王岐 山重用傅政华并不是因为傅是周的死敌，而是王出任中纪委书记后，还兼管一些中央政法委事务，傅是王在公安系统最信任的人，对其委以重任也很自然。
d01166aba9e30c8b3fb2902445fca6198d129c00.translatedText: People familiar with the matter went on to point out, "Therefore, when Wang Qishan began to investigate the Zhou Yongkang case, he gave Fu Zhenghua the important task of secretly investigating the Zhou case from within the public security system." According to people familiar with the matter, Wang Qishan Shan re-appointed Fu Zhenghua not because Fu was Zhou's mortal enemy, but because after Wang became secretary of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection, he also took charge of some affairs of the Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission. Fu was Wang's most trusted person in the public security system, so it was natural for him to be entrusted with important responsibilities.

613075f877eba55333f2211dab0c384b559c8a0e.sourceText: 在谈到现任公安部几名副部长时，无论是知情人士还是北京消息来源都数次强调称，除了现任公安部长郭声琨是习近平可以相信的人之外，几位副部长不是周永康的亲信（如常务副部长李东生等），就是江胡曾遗留下来的旧将。
613075f877eba55333f2211dab0c384b559c8a0e.translatedText: When talking about the current deputy ministers of the Ministry of Public Security, both insiders and sources in Beijing have emphasized several times that, except for the current Minister of Public Security Guo Shengkun, who is someone Xi Jinping can trust, several deputy ministers are either Zhou Yongkang’s cronies (such as Executive Vice Minister Li Dongsheng, etc.) or old generals left over by Jiang Huzeng.

5b1c4522b015714b997265780246ad0e73999e84.sourceText: 「2014年侨商青年台湾自行车旅游邀访团」受理报名至7月31日
5b1c4522b015714b997265780246ad0e73999e84.translatedText: "2014 Overseas Chinese Business Youth Taiwan Cycling Tour Invitation Group" accepts registration until July 31

e34dbe1251a5b17fe980c09709bcf07e05d62774.sourceText: 「2014年侨商青年台湾自行车旅游邀访团」受理报名至7月31日 侨务委员会为响应政府推动环保节能减碳政策，…
e34dbe1251a5b17fe980c09709bcf07e05d62774.translatedText: "2014 Overseas Chinese Business Youth Taiwan Cycling Tour Invitation Group" accepts registration until July 31 In response to the government's promotion of environmental protection, energy conservation and carbon reduction policies, the Overseas Chinese Affairs Council...

fbcc291965871650b7426350c52e626192d509d3.sourceText: 侨务委员会为响应政府推动环保节能减碳政策，并厚植台湾自行车观光旅游产业实力，订于2014年8月31日至9月5日办理「2014年侨商青年台湾自行车旅游邀访团」。本活动鼓励侨商青年返国藉骑乘自行车体验台湾城乡风貌、地方文化，并增益国内外自行车产业商机交流合作。参加团员须自行负担侨居地回国往返机票及报到时缴交五晚住宿费(双人房新台币6,900元、单人房新台币13,800元)，其馀团体交通、膳食、参访及保险等相关费用，及自行车、安全装备由侨委会负担提供。报名参加资格为25至45岁具备每日骑乘50公里（含）以上之体能、技术及经验，且谙中文之侨商青年。有意参加者请于2014年7月31日前，橙县、圣地牙哥、亚历桑纳州地区请洽橙县华侨文教服务中心，电话714-754-9999；洛杉矶地区请洽洛杉矶华侨文教服务中心，电话626-443-9999。招生简章及相关讯息请自「全球侨商服务网」( www.ocbn.org.tw /首页/最新消息) 下载。
fbcc291965871650b7426350c52e626192d509d3.translatedText: In response to the government's promotion of environmental protection, energy conservation and carbon reduction policies, and to strengthen the strength of Taiwan's bicycle tourism industry, the Overseas Chinese Affairs Council has scheduled the "2014 Overseas Chinese Business Youth Taiwan Bicycle Tour Invitation Group" from August 31 to September 5, 2014. This event encourages young overseas Chinese businessmen to return to their country to experience Taiwan’s urban and rural landscape and local culture by riding bicycles, and to increase business opportunities for exchanges and cooperation in the bicycle industry at home and abroad. Participating group members must pay for their own round-trip air tickets to their place of residence and five-night accommodation fees (NT$6,900 for a double room and NT$13,800 for a single room) upon check-in. The remaining group transportation, meals, visits, insurance and other related expenses, as well as bicycles and safety equipment, will be provided by the Overseas Chinese Affairs Council. Eligibility for registration is young overseas Chinese businessmen aged 25 to 45 who have the physical fitness, skills and experience to ride more than 50 kilometers (inclusive) every day and are proficient in Chinese. Those interested in participating should contact the Orange County Overseas Chinese Cultural and Educational Service Center at 714-754-9999 in Orange County, San Diego, and Arizona; in the Los Angeles area, please contact the Los Angeles Overseas Chinese Cultural and Educational Service Center at 626-443-9999. Please download the admission brochure and related information from the "Global Overseas Chinese Business Service Network" (www.ocbn.org.tw/Homepage/Latest News).

9a25d78b143012b5452dc7936a2176871d6bf98b.sourceText: 美发起严打偷渡行动 已抓获蛇头近200人非法资金62.5万美元 国土安全部星期二宣布，执法人员将近一个月来…
9a25d78b143012b5452dc7936a2176871d6bf98b.translatedText: The United States has launched a crackdown on people smuggling, and nearly 200 people have been caught with illegal funds of US$625,000. The Department of Homeland Security announced on Tuesday that law enforcement officers have been cracking down on smuggling activities in the Texas border area for nearly a month...

377ffdc95afccebc2fe808c6483109027b7f5505.sourceText: 国土安全部星期二宣布，执法人员将近一个月来严打德克萨斯州边境地区的偷渡活动，已经抓获蛇头近200人，没收非法所得62.5万美元。
377ffdc95afccebc2fe808c6483109027b7f5505.translatedText: > The Department of Homeland Security announced on Tuesday that law enforcement officers have been cracking down on smuggling activities in the Texas border area for nearly a month, and have arrested nearly 200 smugglers and confiscated US$625,000 in illegal gains.

316a0b5914904774f46c8cca1dc4b2d722594dc3.translatedText: Beijing and Shanghai flights were extensively delayed and canceled on the 14th, suspected to be due to air traffic control (picture)

eb0618ed691cd82a046fc1e6e7e2a0fa022ecc3c.sourceText: 北京上海航班14日大面积延误取消 疑因空中管制(图) 14日中午至傍晚，超过100趟往返于上海和北京的航班…
eb0618ed691cd82a046fc1e6e7e2a0fa022ecc3c.translatedText: Beijing and Shanghai flights were extensively delayed and canceled on the 14th, suspected to be due to air traffic control (picture) From noon to evening on the 14th, more than 100 flights to and from Shanghai and Beijing...

3ea1f674580f4240db909f8d44c377a8cf42bf65.sourceText: 14日中午至傍晚，超过100趟往返于上海和北京的航班因空中管制原因大量延误或取消。
3ea1f674580f4240db909f8d44c377a8cf42bf65.translatedText: From noon to evening on the 14th, more than 100 flights to and from Shanghai and Beijing were delayed or canceled due to air control reasons.

5c1ab9c2bb3f7af075ec88a3b3c637ab355a89f1.sourceText: 今天中午至傍晚，超过100趟往返于上海和北京的航班因空中管制原因大量延误或取消。有航空公司工作人员称，空中管制是由于军事演习所致。
5c1ab9c2bb3f7af075ec88a3b3c637ab355a89f1.translatedText: From noon to evening today, more than 100 flights between Shanghai and Beijing were delayed or canceled due to air control reasons. Some airline staff said the air traffic control was due to military exercises.

53df23b27419c96105b11df8fd14cb0073d27e48.sourceText: 经查询，今天11点之后起飞、由上海虹桥机场飞往北京的航班，大多已经取消。
53df23b27419c96105b11df8fd14cb0073d27e48.translatedText: According to inquiries, most flights from Shanghai Hongqiao Airport to Beijing that took off after 11 o'clock today have been cancelled.

5bac282b54dd85301c2fafd77adeb891b39c2de6.sourceText: 《南华早报》记者向浦东机场求证后获知，航班取消是因为空中管制的原因，但拒绝对此事作具体解释或评论。
5bac282b54dd85301c2fafd77adeb891b39c2de6.translatedText: After seeking confirmation from Pudong Airport, a reporter from the South China Morning Post learned that the flight cancellation was due to air traffic control, but refused to provide a specific explanation or comment on the matter.

d9de3c2cb2a7e3d08375fbf6e0856f394dc52a20.sourceText: 民航局空管局旗下的空中交通网也证实了这一地区空域繁忙的消息，但并未解释原因。
d9de3c2cb2a7e3d08375fbf6e0856f394dc52a20.translatedText: The Air Traffic Network under the Civil Aviation Administration of China's Air Traffic Control Bureau also confirmed the news that the airspace in this area is busy, but did not explain the reason.

423bf13a883aac19330815b244562e73c113afd0.sourceText: 有航空公司的咨询热线工作人员提及，军事演习所采取的空中管制，或是航班取消的原因。该区是南京军区的管辖范围。
423bf13a883aac19330815b244562e73c113afd0.translatedText: Some airline consultation hotline staff mentioned that the air control adopted by military exercises may be the reason for flight cancellations. This area is under the jurisdiction of the Nanjing Military Region.

84c084bcc718bc4b19e05a3feb43d9b61c2d3d8a.sourceText: 今天上午，一份疑为来自民航局的飞行通知在网络上曝光。通知称，华东(上海)地区10:00至16:00有重大军事活动。民航局已发出通告，预计活动期间通行能力下降75%，为红色预警。这一消息随后为部分行业媒体转载。民航局一名发言人表示，会跟进有关事件。
84c084bcc718bc4b19e05a3feb43d9b61c2d3d8a.translatedText: This morning, a flight notice suspected to be from the Civil Aviation Administration was exposed on the Internet. The notice states that there are major military activities in East China (Shanghai) from 10:00 to 16:00. The Civil Aviation Administration of China has issued a notice that traffic capacity is expected to drop by 75% during the event, which is a red alert. This news was subsequently reproduced by some industry media. A spokesman for the Civil Aviation Administration said it would follow up on the incident.

8ee21a7b7a32f80116411c1ec20e8ea057cbc6d2.sourceText: 空中交通网的通告显示：7月14日，预计上海虹桥、浦东机场10时至16时将会出现空域繁忙情况，期间进出港航班可能会受到较严重影响，预期将于次日02时恢复正常运行。
8ee21a7b7a32f80116411c1ec20e8ea057cbc6d2.translatedText: A notice from the air traffic network shows: On July 14, the airspace at Shanghai Hongqiao and Pudong airports is expected to be busy from 10:00 to 16:00. During this period, inbound and outbound flights may be seriously affected. Normal operations are expected to resume at 02:00 the next day.

bd35c6ec85552a8d46f100d0dded8ffb7d33411f.sourceText: 据新浪财经报道，未被取消的航班则也出现了大面积延误，延误时间长达三四个小时。例如，由上海虹桥飞往北京的MU5147/CZ9922原定于14点30分起飞，但截至发稿尚未起飞，预计起飞时间被安排到17点30分左右。由上海浦东起飞的航班情况略好，但也出现航班延误，例如原定于12点20分起飞的MU564航班，直到15点23分才起飞。
bd35c6ec85552a8d46f100d0dded8ffb7d33411f.translatedText: According to Sina Finance, flights that have not been canceled have also experienced extensive delays, with delays lasting as long as three to four hours. For example, MU5147/CZ9922 flying from Shanghai Hongqiao to Beijing was originally scheduled to take off at 14:30, but it had not taken off as of press time, and the expected departure time was scheduled to around 17:30. The situation of flights departing from Shanghai Pudong was slightly better, but there were also flight delays. For example, flight MU564, which was originally scheduled to take off at 12:20, did not take off until 15:23.

15ef479841bba782bdaf5444d57252a04e3d2b79.sourceText: 航班取消导致晚间客票紧张，国航、东航和南航的工作人员均表示，晚间客票已经基本售罄。
15ef479841bba782bdaf5444d57252a04e3d2b79.translatedText: Flight cancellations have led to a shortage of evening tickets. Staff from Air China, China Eastern Airlines and China Southern Airlines all said that evening tickets have been basically sold out.

26d4b4d3efd44612a507f1427dfcade00efc4c14.sourceText: 5月底，中国民航局公布《民航局航班正常管理规定(征求意见稿)》，计划于今年10月30日起施行，其中规定，由于天气、突发事件、空中交通管制、安检以及旅客等原因，造成航班在始发地延误或取消，作为航空公司的承运人应协助旅客安排餐食和住宿，但费用由旅客自理。这一规定随即引发争议，有观点认为，因为客观原因导致航班延误或取消，不应由乘客承担后果。
26d4b4d3efd44612a507f1427dfcade00efc4c14.translatedText: At the end of May, the Civil Aviation Administration of China announced the Civil Aviation Administration of China Flight Normal Management Regulations (Draft for Comments), which is scheduled to be implemented on October 30 this year. It stipulates that if flights are delayed or canceled at the place of origin due to weather, emergencies, air traffic control, security inspections, and passengers, etc., the carrier, as an airline, should assist passengers in arranging meals and accommodation, but the expenses shall be borne by the passengers themselves. This provision immediately sparked controversy. Some people believed that passengers should not bear the consequences if flights are delayed or canceled due to objective reasons.

fcf467df4b4fa1ac3163501d8035a2adb511a217.translatedText: It is rumored that the 27-year-old beautiful anchor Ouyang Zhiwei of CCTV Financial Channel was taken away for investigation (picture) …

f4d842d2f84aa72e7dee6e73c60af1ce347d5fd3.sourceText: 7月14日，继央视财经频道总监郭振玺被吉林检察院以涉嫌受贿犯罪被检方立案侦查并采取强制措施后，经媒体又曝光了央视财经频道原副总监李勇、知名主持人芮成钢和一名制片人也被检方带走的消息。15日上午，微博上多名认证用户爆料称财经频道《第一时间》的女主播欧阳智薇也被带走调查，而欧阳智薇的微博最新一条的更新是在6月6日。
f4d842d2f84aa72e7dee6e73c60af1ce347d5fd3.translatedText: On July 14, after CCTV Financial Channel Director Guo Zhenxi was investigated by the Jilin Procuratorate on suspicion of bribery and compulsory measures were taken, the media also revealed that the former deputy director of CCTV Financial Channel Li Yong, well-known host Rui Chenggang and a producer were also taken away by the prosecutors. On the morning of the 15th, multiple authenticated users on Weibo broke the news that Ouyang Zhiwei, the female anchor of the financial channel "First Time", was also taken away for investigation. The latest update on Ouyang Zhiwei's Weibo was on June 6.

7c3595825151a59387cf4ef175bbfcc919354811.sourceText: 2014年美国最佳公立高中排行榜

4ff6f95a17b2867192c43a1d9961839314285448.sourceText: 2014年美国最佳公立高中排行榜 近日，《美国新闻与世界报道周刊》公布了2014年美国最佳公立高中排行榜。…
4ff6f95a17b2867192c43a1d9961839314285448.translatedText: Ranking of the best public high schools in the United States in 2014 Recently, "U.S. News & World Report" announced the ranking of the best public high schools in the United States in 2014. …

bdfac4da130ae5d0bbcc5c9d5ad9c64a59ddd765.sourceText: 近日，《美国新闻与世界报道周刊》公布了2014年美国最佳公立高中排行榜。美国公立学校一般不对非美国籍学生开放。但通过这个榜单，中国读者可以了解到美国教育资源显著集中的一些区域，比如美国东部的缅因州、西部的加州，新晋的达拉斯独立学区，以研究能力著称的亚利桑那州的图森市以及康涅狄格州。无论您是来洛杉矶投资或定居，”买卖房屋找成薇一定成!”
bdfac4da130ae5d0bbcc5c9d5ad9c64a59ddd765.translatedText: Recently, "U.S. News & World Report" announced the 2014 ranking of the best public high schools in the United States. U.S. public schools are generally not open to non-U.S. students. However, through this list, Chinese readers can learn about some areas in the United States where educational resources are significantly concentrated, such as Maine in the eastern United States, California in the west, the newly promoted Dallas Independent School District, Tucson, Arizona, and Connecticut, which are known for their research capabilities. Whether you come to Los Angeles to invest or settle, "Buying or selling a house will definitely be successful with Chengwei!"

70346da4ba50fd91435e245df4f8e34e3d1d5fd2.sourceText: US News（《美国新闻与世界报道周刊》）近日发布了2014全美最佳公立高中排行榜，帮助家长评选出各州甚至是全国范围内最优秀的公立高中。 周刊分析了美国全部50个州及哥伦比亚特区的3万1200所公立高中，并公布了其中1万9400所高中的信息，包括生源的构成，学生参加州统考、美国大学先修课程（AP课程）和国际预科证书课程（IB课程）考试的成绩等。 自1983年以来，US News每年为全美的大学及其院系进行排名，对公立高中的排名也已经进行了好几年，具有很高的知名度和认可度。 位于德克萨斯州的达拉斯资优人才高中（TAG：School for the Talented and Gifted）已连续三年在US News的榜单上拔得头筹。在榜单公布后，TAG就在学校的主页的醒目位置贴出了榜单的巨大Logo，其下的”学校新闻”一栏中，几乎全是TAG夺得冠军的消息。无论您是来洛杉矶投资或定居，?#20080;卖房屋找成薇一定成!?nbsp; TAG的学生必须至少修读11门AP课程，并且可以和地区大学合作进行极富挑战性的调查研究。根据美国教育部2011-2012学年的数据，TAG的少数族裔学生比例很高，近60%的学生是非裔、西裔和亚裔，并且，30%的学生参加了美国的午餐计划，享受免费或者减免部分费用的午餐。 位于亚利桑那的BASIS Scottsdale高中（斯科茨代尔基础中学）夺得亚军。无论您是来洛杉矶投资或定居，”买卖房屋找成薇一定成!”该校高中部2007学年开始招生，在2013年首次获得评选资格时就拿到了第五名的好成绩。同样在亚利桑那的BASISTucson North高中（图森基础中学）则从去年的第二降至第五。 其他进入前10名的”熟面孔”还包括乔治亚州的格威内特数学和科技高中，弗吉尼亚州的托马斯 杰弗逊科学与技术高中，两所高中分别蝉联两届榜单的第三及第四名。位于佛罗里达州的的松视中学，获得第六名。 今年打入10强的”新人”包括亚利桑那的大学高中（第七名）、密歇根的国际学院（第九名）和加州的牛津学院（第十名）。和TAG同样位于达拉斯学区的科学和工程磁石学校在2012年曾获得季军，但去年却掉出十名之外，今年终于重回十强名单，获得第八名。 在US News的官网上还可按州搜索最佳高中的排行榜。位于美国东部的缅因州和美国西部的加州在排行榜中的表现最佳。在所有有资格评比的学校中，两州各有超过22%的公立高中获得金牌或银牌。其中，加州有105所高中获得金牌，比其他任何一个州都要多，在全国排名中位列第10的牛津学院是加州排名最高的公立高中。
70346da4ba50fd91435e245df4f8e34e3d1d5fd2.translatedText: US News ("U.S. News & World Report Weekly") recently released the 2014 ranking of the best public high schools in the United States to help parents select the best public high schools in each state and even the country. The Weekly analyzed 31,200 public high schools in all 50 states and the District of Columbia, and published information on 19,400 of them, including the composition of the student population and the results of students taking state unified examinations, American Advanced Placement (AP courses) and International Preparatory Certificate (IB courses) exams. Since 1983, US News has ranked universities and their departments in the United States every year. It has also ranked public high schools for several years and has a high degree of visibility and recognition. Dallas High School for the Talented and Gifted (TAG: School for the Talented and Gifted) located in Texas has topped the US News list for three consecutive years. After the list was announced, TAG posted a huge logo of the list in a prominent position on the school's homepage. The "School News" column under it was almost all news about TAG winning the championship. Whether you come to Los Angeles to invest or settle, you will definitely succeed in selling your house with Chengwei! TAG students must take at least 11 AP courses and can cooperate with area universities to conduct extremely challenging research. According to data from the U.S. Department of Education for the 2011-2012 school year, TAG has a high proportion of minority students. Nearly 60% of students are African Americans, Hispanics, and Asians. Moreover, 30% of students participate in the U.S. lunch program and enjoy free or partially reduced lunches. BASIS Scottsdale High School in Arizona won the runner-up spot. Whether you are coming to Los Angeles to invest or settle down, "Buying and selling houses with Chengwei will definitely make it happen!" The high school department of the school started enrolling students in the 2007 school year, and it ranked fifth when it first qualified for the selection in 2013. BASISTucson North High School (Tucson Basic High School), also in Arizona, dropped from second place to fifth place last year. Other "familiar faces" in the top 10 include Gwinnett High School for Mathematics and Technology in Georgia and Thomas Jefferson High School for Science and Technology in Virginia. The two high schools have ranked third and fourth on the list respectively for two consecutive years. Pineview Middle School in Florida won sixth place. This year's "newcomers" to the top 10 include Arizona's University High School (seventh), Michigan's International Academy (ninth) and California's Oxford Academy (tenth). The Science and Engineering Magnet School, located in the same Dallas school district as TAG, finished third in 2012, but fell out of the top ten last year. This year it finally returned to the top ten list, finishing eighth. You can also search for rankings of the best high schools by state on the US News official website. Maine in the eastern United States and California in the western United States perform best in the rankings. Among all schools eligible for the evaluation, more than 22% of public high schools in each state received gold or silver medals. Among them, 105 high schools in California won gold medals, more than any other state. Oxford Academy, ranked 10th in the national rankings, is the highest-ranked public high school in California.

be77d15066026ace8838ec26fd734a481284b531.sourceText: US News根据学校的性质，把公立高中分成特许学校、磁石学校、STEM（科学、技术、工程、数学）三类。US News对这三类学校也进行了单独的排名。 政府特许类学校（经由州政府立法通过，特别允许教师、家长、教育专业团体或其它非营利机构等私人经营公家负担经费的学校）和磁石学校（设置一定特色课程的学校）在500强中占据了155席。 这两类高中通过摇号或者申请的方式录取学生，特别是磁石学校通过竞争激烈的申请过程来录取更资优的学生。而STEM学校在500强中拿到了超过半数的金牌。 2014全美排名前十公立高中 1、达拉斯资优人才高中 (School for the Talented andGifted) 得克萨斯州达拉斯市 2. 斯科茨代尔基础中学 (BASIS Scottsdale) 亚利桑那州斯科茨代尔 3.格威内特数学科学技术高中 (Gwinnett School ofMathematics, Scienceand Technology) 佐治亚州劳伦斯维尔市 4. 托马斯杰弗逊科技高中 (Thomas Jefferson High Schoolfor Scienceand Technology) 弗吉尼亚州亚历山德里亚市 5. 图森基础中学 (BASIS Tucson North) 亚利桑那州图森市 6. 松视中学 (PineView School) 佛罗里达州奥斯普瑞市 7. 美国高校附中 (University High School) 亚利桑那州图森市 8. 科学和工程学校 （School ofScience and Engineering Magnet） 得克萨斯州达拉斯市 9. 国际专科学校 （InternationalAcademy） 密歇根州布卢姆菲尔德希尔斯市 10. 牛津高中 （OxfordAcademy） 加利福利亚州赛普拉斯市

0a523148e3bf93e93bdbc0d0386b15aa2550b617.sourceText: 第八届“凤凰之夜”迎国庆贺中秋系列庆祝活动将于9月21日举办 (亚省华联供稿 依一 撰稿) 第八届2014”凤凰之夜”国庆贺中秋系列庆祝活动将由亚省华联（UCAA）、ASU孔子学院、ASU中国学生学者联谊会联合主办，大凤凰城华人华侨联合总会、新东方艺术学校、现代中文学校、希望中文学校等团体协办，拟定于9月21日星期日于ASU Memorial Union拉开帷幕。 6月22日，亚省华联会集各主办、协办团体召开了第一次筹备会议。会长王惟咨回顾了7年来一年一度的”凤凰之夜” 迎国庆贺中秋庆祝活动。历年的庆祝活动得到了中国驻洛杉矶总领事馆大力支持，领馆负责人专程从洛杉矶赴会，与亚省华人华侨共度”凤凰之夜”；美国各级政界人士也热情参与；大批公司、商业机构、学术机构及其他团体的学者教授、高级管理人员等在”凤凰之夜”中美论坛上发表演说；各界各族裔民众热情响应。”凤凰之夜”成为亚利桑那州深受广泛盛赞的一年一度的传统，成为汇聚中美各族裔各阶层高层次交流平台，成为亚利桑那州政界、商界、学术界及其民众对中华文化加强了解理解、增进感情的一个热烈活泼的亮丽舞台。 今年的第八届”凤凰之夜”亚省华联及各主协办团体将精心筹备，更上一层楼，继续推出深具影响的中美合作交流论坛、国庆招待会、竞赛颁奖、艺术表演、国庆中秋舞会。此外，还将特别推出”凤凰之夜”中庆中秋团圆晚宴，届时大家共享团圆佳肴，在如家的温馨友爱中交流分享，增进感情。欢迎各界团体机构及热心民众尽早报名参与，预订有限席位。报名请联系亚省华联副会长李健 (jian_l1@yahoo.com)、秘书长董斌 (bindong@cox.net)。 为感谢亚省各商家多年来的参与支持，今年的”凤凰之夜”特别邀请各商家继续襄助这项社区公益，为酬谢商家支持，赞助商家将鸣谢列名于本次”凤凰之夜”广泛发行的精美宣传画页上。 9月21日，让我们一起期待第八届迎国庆贺中秋”凤凰之夜”！
0a523148e3bf93e93bdbc0d0386b15aa2550b617.translatedText: The 8th "Phoenix Night" series of celebratory events to welcome the National Celebration and Mid-Autumn Festival will be held on September 21st (Contributed by Alberta Hualian, written by Yiyi) The 8th 2014 "Phoenix Night" National Day Mid-Autumn Festival celebration series will be co-sponsored by the Chinese Federation of Alberta (UCAA), the ASU Confucius Institute, and the ASU Chinese Students and Scholars Association, and co-organized by the Chinese Overseas Chinese Association of Greater Phoenix, New Oriental Art School, Modern Chinese School, Hope Chinese School and other groups. It is planned to kick off on Sunday, September 21 at the ASU Memorial Union. On June 22, the Hualian Association of Alberta gathered various sponsoring and co-organizing groups to hold the first preparatory meeting. President Wang Weizi reviewed the annual "Phoenix Night" celebrations to welcome the National Day and celebrate the Mid-Autumn Festival in the past seven years. The celebrations over the years have received strong support from the Chinese Consulate General in Los Angeles. The head of the consulate made a special trip from Los Angeles to spend the "Phoenix Night" with the Chinese in Alberta. Politicians at all levels in the United States also enthusiastically participated; a large number of scholars, professors, and senior managers from companies, commercial institutions, academic institutions, and other groups gave speeches at the "Phoenix Night" China-US Forum; people from all walks of life and ethnic groups responded enthusiastically. "Phoenix Night" has become a widely praised annual tradition in Arizona. It has become a high-level exchange platform for all ethnic groups and all walks of life in China and the United States. It has become a lively and bright stage for Arizona's political circles, business circles, academia and its people to enhance their understanding of Chinese culture and enhance their feelings. This year's 8th "Phoenix Night", the Hualian Association of Alberta and the host and co-organizer groups will carefully prepare to take it to the next level and continue to launch the influential Sino-US cooperation and exchange forum, National Day reception, competition awards, art performances, and National Day and Mid-Autumn Festival dances. In addition, a special "Phoenix Night" Mid-Autumn Festival reunion dinner will be launched, where everyone will share reunion delicacies, communicate and share in the warmth and friendship of Home Inn, and enhance their relationship. Organizations and enthusiastic people from all walks of life are welcome to sign up as early as possible and reserve limited seats. To register, please contact Li Jian (jian_l1@yahoo.com), Vice President of the Alberta Hualian Association, and Dong Bin (bindong@cox.net), Secretary General. In order to thank all merchants in Alberta for their participation and support over the years, this year’s “Phoenix Night” specially invites all merchants to continue to support this community charity. In order to reward the merchants for their support, the sponsoring merchants will list their acknowledgments on the exquisite promotional pages of this “Phoenix Night” that are widely distributed. On September 21st, let us look forward to the 8th National Celebration and Mid-Autumn Festival "Phoenix Night"!

d953eb1a9df22341ff3c916f663a9debb185bb5f.sourceText: 1日，韩国大韩商工会议所与大韩贸易投资振兴公司(KOTRA：Korean Trade and Investment Promotion Corporation)表示将于4日在首尔共同举办”中韩商务论坛”。届时将有420余名中韩企业家参加这一论坛。大韩商工会议所相关人士表示，此次访韩的中国经济使团中，除了制造业，还包括金融、IT、服务业等未来有希望合作领域的代表企业。无论是在规模上，还是在质量上都是史上最高水平。
d953eb1a9df22341ff3c916f663a9debb185bb5f.translatedText: On the 1st, the Korea Chamber of Commerce and Industry and the Korean Trade and Investment Promotion Corporation (KOTRA: Korean Trade and Investment Promotion Corporation) announced that they would co-host the "China-Korea Business Forum" in Seoul on the 4th. More than 420 Chinese and Korean entrepreneurs will participate in this forum. Relevant sources from the Korea Chamber of Commerce and Industry said that in addition to the manufacturing industry, the Chinese economic delegation visiting South Korea also includes representative companies in areas with promising future cooperation such as finance, IT, and services. Both in terms of scale and quality, it is the highest level in history.

8f11a206fddf759295ee778013807c256f2216da.sourceText: 韩方将有大韩商工会议所会长朴容晚、韩国经济人联合会长许昌秀、韩国贸易协会会长韩德洙等179名企业家参加?#20013;韩商务论坛?#12290;中方将有百度董事长李彦宏、阿里巴巴董事局主席马云、华为董事长任正非、中国银行董事长田国立等企业家参加此次论坛。
8f11a206fddf759295ee778013807c256f2216da.translatedText: From South Korea, 179 entrepreneurs including Park Yong-wan, President of the Korea Chamber of Commerce and Industry, Heo Chang-soo, President of the Federation of Korean Businessmen, and Han Deok-soo, President of the Korea Trade Association, will participate in the Korean Business Forum. From China, Robin Li, Chairman of Baidu, Jack Ma, Chairman of Alibaba Board of Directors, Ren Zhengfei, Chairman of Huawei, and Tian Guoli, Chairman of Bank of China, will participate in the forum.

378e214a2ffaa82e4dea63b7116ec03ac9afed10.sourceText: 报道称，继2013年6月在北京召开的论坛之后，在此次论坛上，各个领域的投资合作话题可能会成为热点。中韩两国企业有望在此次论坛上签署能源、钢铁等各种领域的投资合作书。中韩企业将对各自企业现状进行介绍，并将向对象国企业提出扩大企业投资等相关协助申请。
378e214a2ffaa82e4dea63b7116ec03ac9afed10.translatedText: reported that following the forum held in Beijing in June 2013, at this forum, the topic of investment cooperation in various fields may become a hot topic. Enterprises from China and South Korea are expected to sign investment cooperation letters in various fields such as energy and steel at this forum. Chinese and Korean companies will introduce the current status of their respective companies and submit applications for related assistance such as expanding corporate investment to companies in the target country.

33a6de125a63fdacd19c2fcdf10ee7352b3a1eb3.sourceText: 国旗国歌‏美国梦 Happy 4th of July
33a6de125a63fdacd19c2fcdf10ee7352b3a1eb3.translatedText: Flag and national anthem‏American dream Happy 4th of July

f43e951b5db1b992b8cdda99d589d423a61488ca.sourceText: 国旗国歌‏美国梦 Happy 4th of July 张肇鸿 在一年一度的7月4日美国国庆节来到之际，…
f43e951b5db1b992b8cdda99d589d423a61488ca.translatedText: Flag and national anthem‏American dream Happy 4th of July Zhang Zhaohong On the occasion of the annual United States National Day on July 4th,...

7288b6b0fa4e25501638f3f46bb15c997345097a.sourceText: 在一年一度的7月4日美国国庆节来到之际，让我想起了美国的国旗和国歌。以前我对国旗与国歌的来历所知不多，但在这个我们繁衍生息的之地，对它们应有多一份的了解。
7288b6b0fa4e25501638f3f46bb15c997345097a.translatedText: On the occasion of the annual United States National Day on July 4th, it reminds me of the American flag and national anthem. I didn’t know much about the origins of the national flag and the national anthem before, but in this place where we thrive, we should have a better understanding of them.

51cb810141cba40666471a5332eb7c33e8812df9.sourceText: 关于星条旗的起源至今没有一个统一的说法。 一个在美国流传很广的故事认为，第一面星条旗是由一位名为贝特西 罗斯（Betsy Ross）女士缝製的。
51cb810141cba40666471a5332eb7c33e8812df9.translatedText: There is still no unified statement about the origin of the Stars and Stripes. A widely circulated story in the United States holds that the first Stars and Stripes was sewn by a woman named Betsy Ross.

9e8061b6a775247cc0f6473c75885264c6fea89e.sourceText: 在宾夕法尼亚州首府的宾州博物馆，有一幅着名的油画，那就是”我们的国旗的诞生”(Birth of Our Nation’s Flag)。这幅油画创作于1892年，由画家Charles Weisgerber 所画。​​在画上那位女性是贝特西 罗斯，她正将缝製好的国旗展开。美国首任总统华盛顿坐在左边，站立者为乔治 罗斯（George Ross）美军上校，他是当时宾州国会议员。另一位坐着的男士为罗伯特 毛里斯（Robert Morris），他也是国会议员。在此时此刻，他们正在编织着＂美国梦＂。
9e8061b6a775247cc0f6473c75885264c6fea89e.translatedText: In the Pennsylvania Museum in the capital of Pennsylvania, there is a famous oil painting, that is “Birth of Our Nation’s Flag”. This oil painting was created in 1892 by the painter Charles Weisgerber. The woman in the painting is Betsy Ross, unrolling the sewn flag. Washington, the first president of the United States, is seated on the left. Standing is U.S. Army Colonel George Ross, who was a Pennsylvania congressman at the time. The other seated man is Robert Morris, also a member of Congress. At this moment, they are weaving the "American Dream."

23ffdc545377115339dcd820e6c32c72fc718cc0.sourceText: 这幅油画以艺术的形式表现了1776年国旗的诞生一刻。在贝西的身边，是缝纫工具和布料的碎片，而缕缕阳光，正透过窗櫺射入屋内，这不但给画面增添了色彩，也向人们昭示，共和国的旗帜和新生的共和国在阳光的沐浴下，为历史翻开了新的篇章。而高举起这面共和国的旗帜，正是那年代多数美国人的＂美国梦＂。
23ffdc545377115339dcd820e6c32c72fc718cc0.translatedText: This oil painting expresses the birth of the national flag in 1776 in an artistic form. Beside Bessie are sewing tools and fragments of fabric, while rays of sunlight are shining into the house through the window lattice. This not only adds color to the picture, but also shows people that the flag of the Republic and the new Republic are bathed in the sun, opening a new chapter in history. And holding high the flag of the Republic was the "American Dream" for most Americans at that time.

2c9e5fd7280e315b0b1f4007581c16d4fb79a552.sourceText: 油画展出后，取得了极大的成功。短短几年内，这幅画印了两百万张，而画家本人，则组织了美国国旗房屋与贝特西 罗斯纪念协会，其成员需交10美分的会费。画家以会费及油画印刷品出售得来的钱，买下了贝西小屋的旧址重建，日后成为永久的历史性建筑。1953年，贝西诞生两百週年之际，它还印上了邮票。美国大众为贝西完成她的＂美国梦＂。
2c9e5fd7280e315b0b1f4007581c16d4fb79a552.translatedText: After the oil painting was exhibited, it achieved great success. Within a few years, two million copies of the painting were printed, and the artist himself organized the American Flag House and Betsy Ross Memorial Association, whose members paid a 10-cent dues. With the money from membership fees and the sale of oil painting prints, the painter bought the old site of Bessie's cabin and rebuilt it, which later became a permanent historical building. In 1953, on the occasion of the bicentenary of Bessie's birth, it was also featured on a postage stamp. The American public helped Bessie fulfill her "American Dream".

8d6f1ddde9457da9b3ba2d2097d92dd8aa4f6291.sourceText: 从史实来看，国旗是否在贝西的小屋中诞生虽然有诸多疑点。但是，在两百多年以后，对一般民众而言，这故事是否符合历史的真实性已不是那麽的重要。一位女性，在小屋裡缝出了第一面国旗，并向共和国的第一任总统展示了这面国旗。而这面旗帜最后飘扬在美利坚的土地上空，激励着人们去为实现民主自由而奋战。后来，高高飘扬的美国国旗，激励千百万新移民来到这个生气勃勃的国度，去实现他们心目中的＂美国梦＂。
8d6f1ddde9457da9b3ba2d2097d92dd8aa4f6291.translatedText: From a historical perspective, there are many doubts as to whether the national flag was born in Bessie's cabin. However, more than two hundred years later, to the general public, whether this story is historically accurate is no longer so important. A woman who sewed the first flag in her hut and presented it to the first president of the republic. And this flag finally flew over the land of the United States, inspiring people to fight for the realization of democracy and freedom. Later, the American flag flying high inspired millions of new immigrants to come to this vibrant country to realize the "American Dream" in their minds.

47897075b1f526a1440836168fbef4678550acb5.sourceText: 现在的美国国旗旗面由13道红白相间的宽条构成，代表最早建国时的13个殖民地，红色象徵勇气，白色象徵真理，蓝色则像徵正义。左上角有一个包含了50颗白色小五角星的蓝色长方形，代表了美国的50个州。这面旗帜俗称”星条旗”（Stars and Stripes），正式名称「合众国旗」（The Flag of the United States）。它曾经过28次修改。对美国人而言，国旗不但是美国宪法以及权利法桉所保障的所有自由的象徵。大多数时候它还是个人自由的象徵，＂美国梦＂的精华。
47897075b1f526a1440836168fbef4678550acb5.translatedText: The current American flag consists of 13 wide strips of red and white, representing the 13 colonies when the country was first founded. Red symbolizes courage, white symbolizes truth, and blue symbolizes justice. There is a blue rectangle containing 50 white five-pointed stars in the upper left corner, representing the 50 states of the United States. This flag is commonly known as the "Stars and Stripes" and its official name is "The Flag of the United States". It has been revised 28 times. For Americans, the flag is not only a symbol of all the freedoms guaranteed by the U.S. Constitution and the Bill of Rights. Most of the time it is a symbol of personal freedom and the essence of the "American Dream".

de20c88b4ca177e0335e99a868748577763e5eb5.sourceText: 美国国歌诞生于1814年，诞生地是在麦克亨利堡（Fort McHenry）。
de20c88b4ca177e0335e99a868748577763e5eb5.translatedText: The American national anthem was born in 1814 at Fort McHenry.

33a9b2533ff08f2a6e38f963da03dedf9dc083af.sourceText: 1814年9月13日凌晨，英军海军开始进攻麦克亨利堡，此举是为进占巴尔的摩开闢通路。当时的一位律师Francis Scott Key, 因留英军军舰，他目睹了整个海战的进程。翌日凌晨，在一天一夜的砲火激战后，他看到星条旗依然在麦克亨利堡上空飘扬，他激动万分，写下了一首诗”防守麦克亨利堡”。这首诗后来配上已有的英国曲子，成了一首新的歌曲，取名”星条旗”（The Star 朣pangled Banner）。 1889年，这首歌已被海军所用。 1931年，由国会通过，胡佛总统签署，它正式成为了美国的国歌。这歌的产生于民族危亡之际，战火纷飞之时。歌词不但壮怀激越，也充满诗情画意。歌词共有四段，这裡附上的是第一段：
33a9b2533ff08f2a6e38f963da03dedf9dc083af.translatedText: In the early morning of September 13, 1814, the British navy began to attack Fort McHenry. This move was to open a way to occupy Baltimore. Francis Scott Key, a lawyer at the time, stayed on a British warship and witnessed the entire naval battle. In the early morning of the next day, after a day and night of fierce artillery fire, he saw the Stars and Stripes still flying over Fort McHenry. He was so excited that he wrote a poem "Defending Fort McHenry." This poem was later set to an existing British tune and became a new song named "The Star-Spangled Banner". By 1889, the song was already in use by the Navy. In 1931, passed by Congress and signed by President Hoover, it officially became the national anthem of the United States. This song was born when the nation was in danger and war was raging. The lyrics are not only passionate and exciting, but also full of poetic and picturesque meaning. There are four paragraphs in the lyrics, and here is the first paragraph:

6824f3b4c9f2c0f4065b4c82c912ea026df0c599.sourceText: 你可看见，黎明已至，晨曦初现， 那是日出前的最后一道光柱， 我们自豪地欢呼， 那带着宽阔的条条与闪亮的星星的旗帜， 经历激战后，仍在那堡垒上空高高飘扬。 火箭发出红色光柱，炸弹在空中隆隆作响， 它证明在漫长的黑夜后，我们的旗帜仍在飘扬。 你看，那星条旗，会永远在 这自由的土地和这勇士的家园上空飘扬！
6824f3b4c9f2c0f4065b4c82c912ea026df0c599.translatedText: You can see that dawn has arrived, and the morning light has emerged. It is the last beam of light before sunrise. We cheer proudly, and the flag with its wide stripes and shining stars is still flying high over the fortress after the fierce battle. The red beams of rockets and the rumble of bombs in the sky are proof that after a long night, our flag still flies. You see, the Stars and Stripes will always fly over this land of freedom and the home of this brave man!

d7356abee9a8a71f778f718ed9289ab2258466fc.sourceText: 美国国歌同样号召着人们为实现＂美国梦＂而奋斗。每当国歌响起，就是庄严刻的到来。
d7356abee9a8a71f778f718ed9289ab2258466fc.translatedText: The American national anthem also calls on people to strive for the realization of the "American Dream". Whenever the national anthem sounds, it is the arrival of a solemn moment.

2cffd80ea402635fb6911bff8299d437c962009a.sourceText: 来美多年，虽然不止一次地听到美国国歌，但对我来说，最切身的感受，是当年入藉的那一刻。未来美国之前，＂美藉华人＂对我来说还是报章杂志上的一个陌生的名词。而那天当美国国歌响起，随着誓词的宣读，＂美国梦＂已是梦境成真。肩负着家族的重担，我入藉后第一件事，就是去移民局递交申请纸，让父母姐妹未来的＂美国梦＂，也能得到早一点的实现。
2cffd80ea402635fb6911bff8299d437c962009a.translatedText: I have been in the United States for many years, and although I have heard the American national anthem more than once, the most personal feeling for me was the moment I moved in. Before the future of the United States, "America borrowed from Chinese" was still an unfamiliar term to me in newspapers and magazines. On that day, when the American national anthem sounded and the oath was read, the "American Dream" became a dream come true. Carrying the burden of my family, the first thing I did after I moved in was to submit an application to the Immigration Bureau, so that my parents and sisters’ future “American Dream” could be realized earlier.

6dcb88bc401df15c49357af68ffc9831f4c3bc46.sourceText: 多年后，自己在自由竞争的国度中也算事业有成，生活充实而满足，其实我们的＂美国梦＂并不奢华。儿女在和平环境中成长，学业优秀，女儿用爱心服务社会，为聋哑儿童作手语翻译工作，儿子毕业后被美国太空总署录取，实现了孩提时代的梦想。对他们而言，或不明白＂美国梦＂是何种含意，甚至还会生在福中不知福，而作为第一代移民的父母，早已感概＂美国梦＂来之不易。我们在这个社会中得益良多，也在不断地学会回馈社会。多年来，每逢美国国庆日的到来，我们都参加庆祝活动，做义工、作奉献，怀着的是一颗感恩的心。
6dcb88bc401df15c49357af68ffc9831f4c3bc46.translatedText: Many years later, I can be considered successful in my career in a country of free competition, living a fulfilling and satisfying life. In fact, our "American Dream" is not luxurious. The children grew up in a peaceful environment and excelled in academic studies. The daughter served the society with love and worked as a sign language interpreter for deaf-mute children. The son was admitted to NASA after graduation, realizing his childhood dream. For them, they may not understand what the "American Dream" means, and may even be born in a state of ignorance. As parents of first-generation immigrants, they have long understood that the "American Dream" is hard-won. We have benefited a lot from this society and are constantly learning to give back to the society. Over the years, every time the Fourth of July comes, we have participated in celebrations, volunteered, and made contributions, with a grateful heart.

d8574760471ab18a86539dbd5a6d8db157e17342.sourceText: 在国旗和国歌之下，人们希望完成＂美国梦＂，而对普罗大众而言，也就是为了建立更美好的生活和幸福的家庭。
d8574760471ab18a86539dbd5a6d8db157e17342.translatedText: Under the flag and national anthem, people hope to realize the "American Dream", and for the general public, it is to build a better life and a happy family.

555c60dfa4688b0bf7d60f2775847624d09c204e.sourceText: 每年的美国国庆，凤凰城最受欢迎的活动就是选美。经过激烈地角逐，评选出一年一度的凤凰城华裔小姐。今年当然也不例外。由于今年北美华裔小姐的总决赛安排在凤凰城，并由侨联协办，今年的凤凰城华裔小姐的评选活动简化了，由2013年的亚军李乐筠升任为2014凤凰城华裔小姐， 叶安萍为大公主，并在活动中受冠。
555c60dfa4688b0bf7d60f2775847624d09c204e.translatedText: Every year on the Fourth of July, the most popular event in Phoenix is ​​the beauty pageant. After fierce competition, the annual Miss Chinese Phoenix was selected. This year is certainly no exception. Since this year's Miss Chinese North America finals were arranged in Phoenix and co-organized by the Federation of Overseas Chinese, the selection event for this year's Miss Chinese Phoenix was simplified. Li Lejun, the runner-up in 2013, was promoted to Miss Chinese Phoenix 2014. Ye Anping was the eldest princess and was crowned during the event.

e1565b9ab848f8762a1c71f7d6706f2e67b6802c.sourceText: City of Chandler 当年用精准眼光配备相当勇气与魄力在发展经济计划中走出一条与衆不同的路线，让它成为东区最亮眼的城市。 密集的高科技公司吸引大量优秀亚裔工程师迁入， City of Chandler 的亚裔人口比例是全州最高。 市政府公共关係委员会(Human Relations Commission ) 是一个桥樑把市政府与社区紧密联结起来，它也代表市政府在各社区推动多元文化的发展。 City of Chandler 在6月份市政会议中全票通过提名华裔社区知名侨领张圣仪出任该市公共关係委员会委员，任期6年。
e1565b9ab848f8762a1c71f7d6706f2e67b6802c.translatedText: The City of Chandler used a precise vision and considerable courage and courage to carve out a unique route in the economic development plan, making it the most dazzling city in the East District. The dense high-tech companies have attracted a large number of outstanding Asian engineers to move in, and the City of Chandler has the highest proportion of Asians in the state. The Municipal Government Public Relations Commission (Human Relations Commission) is a bridge that closely connects the municipal government and the community. It also promotes the development of multiculturalism in various communities on behalf of the municipal government. The City of Chandler voted unanimously at the June city council meeting to nominate Zhang Shengyi, a well-known overseas Chinese leader in the Chinese community, to serve as a member of the city’s Public Relations Committee for a six-year term.

1eb1070f6c6321ecc15aad8cd0eac7659d2458bc.sourceText: 劳工部：5月全美非农就业新增21.7万 失业率6.3% 美国劳工部今天公布的数据显示，5月新增就业21.7万个，失业率仍停留在6.3%的水平。但这是一个里程碑时刻，迄今美国新增工作终于首次超过此前在5年衰退期中失去的工作。今天的就业报告显示，5月新增就业21.7万个，这也是连续四个月，新增就业超20万，是自1999年以来的首次。劳工部长佩雷斯称此份报告证实经济正朝着正确方向发展。 这也是新增就业总数5年来首次超过经济衰退期间时消失的工作。但失业率仍保持在6.3%，劳动参与率仍保留62.8%的水平。但分析人士认为，因美国人口增多，仍需要更多就业岗位，分行业看，制造业和建筑业就业复苏缓慢，仅恢复了金融危机失去就业岗位的一半左右。同时，工资增长也维持在较低水平，在过去一年里，美国平均工资仅上涨了2.1%。全美失业已经超过六个月的人数仍旧很高，还有众多兼职工作的人希望找到全职工作。两周后，联储会将重新评估其刺激政策，就业数据是其中重要参考指标之一。
1eb1070f6c6321ecc15aad8cd0eac7659d2458bc.translatedText: Department of Labor: 217,000 new non-farm jobs were added in the United States in May, and the unemployment rate was 6.3%. Data released today by the U.S. Department of Labor showed that 217,000 new jobs were created in May, and the unemployment rate remained at 6.3%. But this is a landmark moment, as for the first time so far, the number of new jobs in the United States has exceeded the number of jobs lost during the previous five years of recession. Today's employment report shows that 217,000 new jobs were created in May. This is the fourth consecutive month that more than 200,000 new jobs have been created, and the first time since 1999. Labor Secretary Shimon Perez said the report confirmed the economy was moving in the right direction. This is the first time in five years that the total number of new jobs has exceeded the number of jobs lost during the recession. However, the unemployment rate remains at 6.3% and the labor force participation rate remains at 62.8%. However, analysts believe that as the U.S. population increases, more jobs are still needed. Looking at different industries, employment in the manufacturing and construction industries has recovered slowly, recovering only about half of the jobs lost during the financial crisis. At the same time, wage growth has remained low, with average wages in the United States rising by only 2.1% over the past year. The number of people in the United States who have been unemployed for more than six months remains high, and there are still many people working part-time hoping to find full-time employment. In two weeks, the Federal Reserve will reassess its stimulus policy, and employment data will be one of the important reference indicators.

9a0288822220aac4406c7180b90a28b477328c4f.translatedText: Zhang Zhaohong: The tombstone mystery in the "Alberta Chinese History and Culture Grand View Garden" (10) Phoenix Zhang Zhaohong Tombstones have become the historical testimony of the early Chinese exploration of Arizona...

b4d6a1dd414363a788c668d741318c4591dadc13.sourceText: 墓碑已成为华人早期开拓亚利桑那州的历史见证。邓湘远的名字不会再被人们遗忘。 为何要解开墓碑谜团？有几个原因：一是去了解墓碑的历史和碑文的含意；二是去寻找墓碑主人邓湘远的后裔；三是通过寻找，籍此介绍侨乡人文历史及今昔的变化；四是通过＂墓碑谜团＂背后的故事，掀出了海外华人历史的进程，彰显侨社精英的故事。 在寻觅过程中，从美国墓园到中国侨乡，从查询姓名到翻阅族谱，从跟进历史到拜访前侨，方向改而目标未变，线索常断又努力再续，终于有了水落石出。邓家谱的发现或是必然中的偶然，有如雪中送炭，让谜团有了答桉；而邓心平名字的出现更是锦上添花，让墓碑谜团的故事，到最后带出了一个光环。 有一个很深的感触，在早期华人墓地里埋葬有五十华人，当年无论生前死后都是地位低微，是受岐视的一族，在那个排华时代，他们有着许多心酸的故事。当完成编写＂墓碑谜团＂的那天，我专门去墓园和邓湘远的墓碑照了张相作留念。同时，也去了另一个＂绿木墓园＂一趟，和其中的＂华人纪念墓园＂碑照了一张相，以此用作对照。
b4d6a1dd414363a788c668d741318c4591dadc13.translatedText: The tombstones have become the historical testimony of the early Chinese exploration of Arizona. Deng Xiangyuan's name will no longer be forgotten. Why solve the tombstone mystery? There are several reasons: first, to understand the history of the tombstone and the meaning of the inscription; second, to find the descendants of the owner of the tombstone, Deng Xiangyuan; third, through searching, to introduce the humanistic history of the overseas Chinese hometown and the changes in the past and present; fourth, through the story behind the "tombstone mystery", it reveals the process of overseas Chinese history and highlights the stories of the elites of the overseas Chinese community. In the process of searching, from the American cemetery to the hometown of overseas Chinese, from looking up names to reading genealogy, from following up on history to visiting former overseas Chinese, the direction changed but the goal remained the same. The clues were often broken but efforts were continued again and again, and finally the truth came to light. The discovery of Deng's family tree may be an inevitable accident, which is like providing help in times of need, providing an answer to the mystery; and the appearance of Deng Xinping's name is the icing on the cake, giving the story of the tombstone mystery a halo in the end. I have a deep impression that there were fifty Chinese buried in early Chinese cemeteries. They were of low status and discriminated against, both before and after life. In that era of Chinese exclusion, they had many sad stories. On the day I finished writing "Tombstone Mystery", I went to the cemetery to take a photo with Deng Xiangyuan's tombstone as a souvenir. At the same time, I also went to another "Greenwood Cemetery" and took a photo with the "Chinese Memorial Cemetery" monument there for comparison.

2e61a20a3436799cc77d05b3f699b863bbd86b9e.sourceText: 美国的＂绿木墓园＂(Greenwood/Memory Lawn Mortuary & Cemetery)创建于1906年。1947年，萨姆威家族在凤凰城墓园的西侧成立了绿林纪念公园。1963年，建立内存陵和教堂，这两个墓地在1989年合併，从而创造了在亚利桑那州最大的墓园 。 一九九二年，亚省的着名侨领余文劲先生，有感于华人墓地不集中，而且太靠近高速公路日夜嘈杂，有违华人入土为安的传统观念。于是，他联同华人福利会和绿木墓园管理层商议，新开辟出亚省首个也是至目前惟一的一个＂华人墓地公园＂(Chinese memorial garden)，不但树立有纪念墓园石碑，还专门内建象征着尊贵地位的＂王室墓地＂，上方建有凋龙刻凤中国亭，充分反应出绿木墓园高层对华人地位的尊重。这是在一百多年前，华人做梦都想不到的变化。由于墓园为华人着想，尊重华人的文化风俗，目前已有大批华人置地安葬。 我曾拍摄了一辑绿木墓园中华人墓地的相片去参加摄影比赛，不管别人用何种眼光来看待，我只想用墓地历史进程去宣示华人地位所发生的转变；我亦把绿木墓园的中国亭用作《亚省华人历史文化大观园》书籍的封面设计，也是用以表达我们华人从筚路蓝缕到大路开阔，从受其岐视到受其尊重的一种的纪念。
2e61a20a3436799cc77d05b3f699b863bbd86b9e.translatedText: America's "Greenwood/Memory Lawn Mortuary & Cemetery" was founded in 1906. In 1947, the Samway family established Greenwood Memorial Park on the west side of Phoenix Cemetery. In 1963, a memorial mausoleum and chapel were built, and the two cemeteries merged in 1989, thus creating the largest cemetery in Arizona. In 1992, Mr. Yu Wenjin, a well-known overseas Chinese leader in Alberta, felt that the Chinese cemeteries were not concentrated and were too close to the highway and were noisy day and night, which violated the traditional concept of Chinese people being buried in peace. Therefore, he worked with the Chinese Welfare Association and the management of Greenwood Cemetery to open up the first and so far only "Chinese Memorial Garden" in Alberta. Not only was there a commemorative cemetery stone, but a "royal cemetery" was built to symbolize the noble status. A Chinese pavilion with carved dragons and phoenixes was built above it, which fully reflected the respect of the senior management of Greenwood Cemetery for the status of the Chinese. This is a change that the Chinese could not have dreamed of more than a hundred years ago. Since the cemetery considers the Chinese people and respects their cultural customs, a large number of Chinese people have been buried there. I once took a series of photos of the Chinese cemetery in Greenwood Cemetery to participate in a photography competition. No matter how others view it, I just want to use the historical process of the cemetery to declare the changes in the status of the Chinese. I also used the Chinese pavilion in Greenwood Cemetery as the cover design of the book "Alberta Chinese History and Culture Grand View Garden". It is also used to express a kind of commemoration for us Chinese from the blue road to the open road, from being discriminated against to being respected.

8d9857afd623c31323ae63895db94d5b17cfc8a2.sourceText: 当年的美国学者朋友，在纪念墓园裡发现邓湘远的墓碑后，便试图＂研究其生平、思想、家族等，藉此宏扬华人开拓亚省的光荣历史＂。后来，光荣的人物果真出现了，大法官邓心平不但是邓氏也是全美国华人的优秀代表，比起祖辈，他有着更大的抱负和期望，因为他已站在时代的制高点上。我找到他在1978年写的一篇文章，是为凤凰城华人庆祝美国国庆所写的： ＂两年前，在庆祝美国国庆二百周年之际，鳯凰城的庆典中出现了中国的舞狮表演，这是我们的先辈们在制定宪法时不可能想到的，一个非常有意义的想法是，自由的精神和民主的理念，不仅存在于跳广塲舞的美国白人中，也存在于喜爱墨西哥音乐和中国舞狮的不同族群中。实现美国梦的程式是200年前制订的，它还不是完美无缺的，需要不断的寻求探索，我们每个人都要为使他日臻完善作出贡献。同时，发扬和喜爱你们的传统和习俗，华人在亚利桑那的历史已包容在我们美国的传统中，并已成为其组成部份。＂ 今天，华人的地位有了显着的提升，在不断地溶入主流社会中，观念和胸怀也在不断扩充，华人不再沉鬱在过去的历史和社会所给予的不公，而是更积极去面对，为日臻完善制度作出贡献，并勇于参与未来的开拓和创新。 2014年5月26日，凤凰城侨界到《先民和军人纪念墓园》展开对华侨先民的追悼和拜祭活动。包括资深侨领余文劲、凤凰城侨联总会、斐匿华人福利会、邓高密公所、余风采堂、开平同乡会、中国餐馆协会、荣光会、台联会、龙冈公所、学术界、亚省太阳鸟华人网等团体的廿余位成员参加，大家向华人墓地献上花圈花蓝，向凤凰城先民们进行鞠躬致敬，在慎终追远中，寄托对华人先辈的悼念。
8d9857afd623c31323ae63895db94d5b17cfc8a2.translatedText: After discovering Deng Xiangyuan's tombstone in the memorial cemetery, American scholar friends at that time tried to "research his life, thoughts, family, etc., so as to promote the glorious history of the Chinese pioneering the province." Later, a glorious figure really appeared. Justice Deng Xinping was not only the Deng family but also an outstanding representative of the Chinese people in the United States. Compared with his ancestors, he had greater ambitions and expectations because he was already standing at the commanding heights of the times. I found an article he wrote in 1978, which was written for the Chinese in Phoenix to celebrate the National Day of the United States: "Two years ago, when celebrating the Bicentennial of the United States, a Chinese lion dance performance appeared in the Phoenix celebration. This is something our forefathers could not have thought of when they formulated the Constitution. A very meaningful idea is that the spirit of freedom and the concept of democracy exist not only among white Americans who dance Cantonese dance, but also among those who love Mexican music and Chinese lion dance. Among the different ethnic groups. The program to realize the American dream was formulated 200 years ago. It is not perfect and needs continuous exploration. At the same time, we must carry forward and love your traditions and customs. The history of the Chinese in Arizona has been included in our American tradition and has become an integral part of it.” Today, the status of the Chinese has been significantly improved. As they continue to integrate into mainstream society, their concepts and minds are also constantly expanding. The Chinese no longer dwell on the injustices inflicted by history and society in the past, but face them more actively, contribute to the improvement of the system, and have the courage to participate in future development and innovation. On May 26, 2014, the overseas Chinese community in Phoenix went to the "Ancestors and Soldiers Memorial Cemetery" to commemorate and pay homage to the overseas Chinese ancestors. More than 20 members, including senior overseas Chinese leader Yu Wenjin, the Phoenix Overseas Chinese Federation, Fei Ni Chinese Welfare Association, Deng Gaomi Office, Yu Fengcaitang, Kaiping Association, Chinese Restaurant Association, Rongguang Association, Taiwan Federation, Longgang Office, academic circles, Sunbird Chinese Network of Alberta and other groups participated. Everyone presented wreaths and blue flowers to the Chinese cemetery, bowed to pay tribute to the ancestors of Phoenix City, and expressed their condolences to the Chinese ancestors in the final memory.

71e11f056d207e723fc9420dda2e8e1213a785f5.sourceText: 凤凰城侨界到《先民和军人纪念墓园》对华侨先民追悼和拜祭 百年前邓湘远先辈的墓碑显得矮小单薄，有如是那个时代华人的历史地位低微的写照。由于年代久远，加上邓湘远的孙辈也分别是过继的和领养的，所以，他连魂归故里、寻觅至亲之路也困难重重。他剩下这惟一的墓碑，在旷野荒塚中自怜，在历史寂寥岁月中等待……。今天，这一页终于翻过。先民为亚省华人留下了一份珍贵的历史文化遗产。今后，＂华人墓园第一碑＂和邓湘远名字将不会再被人们遗忘。 ＂墓碑谜团＂的故事虽然写完，但墓地仍埋葬着廿余位华人先民，我们是否要为他们立个纪念碑呢？我已申请加入纪念墓园的义工队伍，以方便进行此项工作，让这些在最早期开拓亚利桑那州华人的先民们，也能得到他们应有的地位和尊重。（全文完。文章连载《凤凰艺文网》 http://www.paaca.us ）
71e11f056d207e723fc9420dda2e8e1213a785f5.translatedText: The overseas Chinese community in Phoenix went to the "Ancestors and Soldiers Memorial Cemetery" to commemorate and pay homage to the overseas Chinese ancestors. A hundred years ago, the tombstone of Deng Xiangyuan's ancestors looked short and thin, which seemed to be a portrayal of the low historical status of the Chinese in that era. Due to the age and the fact that Deng Xiangyuan's grandchildren were adopted and adopted respectively, it was difficult for him to return to his hometown and find his relatives. He has this only tombstone left, pitying himself in the wilderness and tombs, waiting in the lonely years of history... Today, the page is finally turned. The ancestors left a precious historical and cultural heritage for the Chinese in Alberta. In the future, "the first monument in the Chinese cemetery" and Deng Xiangyuan's name will no longer be forgotten. Although the story of "Tombstone Mystery" has been written, more than 20 Chinese ancestors are still buried in the cemetery. Should we build a monument for them? I have applied to join the volunteer team at the Memorial Cemetery to facilitate this work, so that these pioneers who pioneered the earliest Chinese immigrants in Arizona can get the status and respect they deserve. (Full text completed. The article is serialized in "Phoenix Art and Literature Network" http://www.paaca.us)

789ae0a6920573b2c687065adf6b17036f7ab6db.translatedText: 2 million illegal immigrants were deported. Has Obama broken his promise? The number of illegal immigrants deported by the Obama administration has reached a historical record. Although Obama...

ef6e9a02176479dda2700a333c9ec8bbf15f2e03.sourceText: 虽然奥巴马强调被驱逐出境的移民大多数是罪犯，黑帮份子，并不是学生或努力养家糊口的家庭。
ef6e9a02176479dda2700a333c9ec8bbf15f2e03.translatedText: Although Obama emphasized that most of the immigrants being deported are criminals and gang members, not students or families trying to support their families.

0144bebab9e324664d36d5f993a95cdfc56f4383.sourceText: 但是，根据《纽约时报》分析政府内部的记录显示，自奥巴马总统上台之后，接近200万名被递解出境的非法移民，有三分之二只犯了轻微的违法行为，包括交通违法，或是没有犯罪记录。
0144bebab9e324664d36d5f993a95cdfc56f4383.translatedText: However, according to an analysis of internal government records by The New York Times, since President Obama took office, two-thirds of the nearly 2 million illegal immigrants who have been deported only committed minor violations, including traffic violations, or have no criminal record.

8cde2bd8ae66b7d618820ad971aa1d4dc9aa5636.sourceText: 另外20%，大约394,000个被驱逐出境的个案犯有严重罪行，包括与毒品有关的罪案。
8cde2bd8ae66b7d618820ad971aa1d4dc9aa5636.translatedText: The other 20%, approximately 394,000 deportees, were convicted of serious crimes, including drug-related crimes.

a29a8ba00c8e1e95a2edb1154ae02a60c070ec7a.sourceText: 2014加州初选华裔成绩亮眼 余胤良“名列第三” 2014加州初选于4日结束，包括州长、州务卿等八个州级职位以及多个联邦众议院，加州参、众议员及地方公职等职位推举出进军11月决选的名单。其中华裔候选人成绩亮眼。 根据最新的统计数据，在当日进行的加州2014初选中，赵美心、江俊辉、周本立等多为华裔候选人在中半数排名中顺利出线，获得年底决战的入场券。 截至5日凌晨3点的统计数据显示，华裔政坛常青树、27选区联邦众议员候选人赵美心以61.2%的得票率稳居第一。候选人多达18位额联邦33选区，刘云平以19.0%的得票率暂居第二，领先第三名2.2个百分点。 此外前获得洛杉矶时报特别背书的加州财务长候选人江俊辉，以55.1%的得票率占据绝对优势。在加州众议员选战中，49选区周本立和55选区张玲龄分别以60.7%和27.9%的得票率稳居第一，奠定冲刺11月决选的大局。 北加方面，旧金山市议长邱信福、民主党人朱感生、共和党人郭宗政等，也都如愿闯入各自选区州众议员或参议员职位的11月大选。 竞选副州长的共和党人杨承志，得票率为8%，位居8位参选人中的第四而惜败。 原本计划竞选加州州务卿的华裔候选人余胤良，此前由于涉嫌受贿而宣布退出竞选，但是在当日的选举中，他的名字仍然印在选票上，并且获得了将近29万张选票，一直名列第三。此次选举胜出的候选人将参加11月的决选。
a29a8ba00c8e1e95a2edb1154ae02a60c070ec7a.translatedText: Chinese Americans performed well in the 2014 California primary election, Yu Yinliang "ranked third" The 2014 California primaries ended on the 4th, including eight state-level positions such as governor and secretary of state, as well as several federal houses of representatives, California senators, representatives and local public offices, and the candidates for the November runoff elections were selected. Among them, Chinese candidates have outstanding results. According to the latest statistics, in the California 2014 primary election held on that day, mostly Chinese-American candidates such as Zhao Meixin, Jiang Junhui, and Zhou Benli successfully qualified in the middle half of the rankings and obtained tickets for the final battle at the end of the year. Statistics as of 3 a.m. on the 5th showed that Zhao Meixin, an evergreen figure in Chinese-American politics and candidate for the 27th district federal representative, ranked first with 61.2% of the vote. There are 18 candidates in the federal constituency 33. Liu Yunping temporarily ranked second with 19.0% of the vote, 2.2 percentage points ahead of the third place. In addition, California Treasurer candidate Jiang Junhui, who was specially endorsed by the Los Angeles Times, had an absolute advantage with 55.1% of the vote. In the California House of Representatives election, Zhou Benli in the 49th district and Zhang Lingling in the 55th district firmly ranked first with 60.7% and 27.9% of the vote respectively, setting the stage for the November runoff election. In Northern California, San Francisco City Mayor Chiu Xinfu, Democrat Zhu Kansheng, Republican Guo Zongzheng, etc. also entered the November general election for the position of state representative or senator in their respective districts. Yang Chengzhi, a Republican who ran for lieutenant governor, received 8% of the vote, ranking fourth among the eight candidates and narrowly losing. Yu Yinliang, a Chinese-American candidate who originally planned to run for California Secretary of State, had previously announced his withdrawal from the race due to suspicion of bribery. However, in the election that day, his name was still printed on the ballot and received nearly 290,000 votes, ranking third. The winning candidate in this election will participate in the November runoff.

97d0d594b079c7a8d676c0860bffdad6078131aa.sourceText: 85%美国移民在家不说英语 6成双语中国移民英语不好 根据美国人口调查局周二发布的数据，只有一小部分的美国移民的英语不错，13%的移民从来不说英语。 而来到美国超过30年的移民的英语程度则好很多棗63%的人能够较流利地说英语，只有6%的人完全不说英语。 人口统计学家Christine Gambino称:”一般来说，已移民到美国很长时间的人的英语口语会比移民来美国时间较短的人要好，而受教育程度较高的人会比受教育程度较低的人的英语口语要好。” 报告还发现，相较1980年代，现在的移民家庭在家中较少说英语。1980年，70%的移民家庭在家中说英语之外的语言，而现在这个数字上升到了85%。 调查显示，4060万移民的年龄在5岁以上。 墨西哥裔是美国移民人口数量最多的族裔，占移民人口总数超过四分之一。调查显示29%的墨西哥裔的英语说得不好，18%称他们完全不会说英语。 而中国移民中，只有9%的人在家说英语，30%的英语很好，21%的英语不好，还有11%的人不会说英语。而在家兼说英语和母语的中国移民只有30.4%的英语不错，另有61%的英语不好，或者根本不会说英语。
97d0d594b079c7a8d676c0860bffdad6078131aa.translatedText: 85% of American immigrants do not speak English at home, 60% of bilingual Chinese immigrants do not speak English well Only a small percentage of immigrants to the United States speak English well, and 13 percent never speak English, according to data released Tuesday by the U.S. Census Bureau. The English proficiency of immigrants who have been in the United States for more than 30 years is much better: 63% can speak English relatively fluently, and only 6% do not speak English at all. Demographer Christine Gambino said: "In general, people who have immigrated to the United States for a long time will speak English better than those who have immigrated to the United States for a shorter time, and people who are more educated will speak English better than those who are less educated." The report also found that compared with the 1980s, immigrant families today speak less English at home. In 1980, 70% of immigrant families spoke a language other than English at home; now that number has risen to 85%. The survey shows that 40.6 million immigrants are over the age of 5. Mexicans are the ethnic group with the largest immigrant population in the United States, accounting for more than a quarter of the total immigrant population. The survey showed that 29% of Mexican Americans did not speak English well, and 18% said they did not speak English at all. Among Chinese immigrants, only 9% speak English at home, 30% speak English very well, 21% speak poor English, and 11% do not speak English. However, only 30.4% of Chinese immigrants who speak both English and their mother tongue at home speak good English, and another 61% speak poor English or cannot speak English at all.

Tickets for the festival will go on sale on June 1, and audiences can buy tickets at the theater or online.

815e8edf69a87768284ec596b601e76dc07834d2.sourceText: 本次艺术节由新东方艺术学校、亚利桑那州立大学（ASU）孔子学院、亚省华联联合举办。它将是亚利桑那州第一届以中国舞蹈为主题的艺术节，会在每年金秋举办一次，主要以中国舞蹈演出为主，配以音乐、美术等多类艺术形式，集中展示中国舞蹈的魅力。中国舞蹈节将让我们的孩子能够通过中国舞蹈直接地接触和学习中国文化；也让美国人有了更多的机会了解博大精深的华夏文明。
815e8edf69a87768284ec596b601e76dc07834d2.translatedText: This art festival is jointly organized by New Oriental Art School, Confucius Institute at Arizona State University (ASU), and Hualien of Alberta. It will be the first art festival with the theme of Chinese dance in Arizona. It will be held in the golden autumn every year. It will mainly focus on Chinese dance performances, accompanied by music, art and other art forms, focusing on displaying the charm of Chinese dance. The Chinese Dance Festival will allow our children to directly contact and learn Chinese culture through Chinese dance; it will also give Americans more opportunities to understand the profound Chinese civilization.

a25fbe3332957f7ae07de6fbf8aa9ece40c4daed.sourceText: 参加悼念活动的华人代表 在1880年代初，铁路开通到凤凰城，城市原来的旧墓地须搬迁，当年有部分无人认领的华人墓葬者由市政府集中安葬于新墓园，即现的华人墓地。根据墓园资料，从1886年到1914年间，共有50位有中国血统的华人被埋葬在此。在岐视和排华的年代，华人有心酸的历史，部分人嘱託后裔把他们骇骨运回中国。由于墓地不断荒芜，许多年来已没有华人前来此地拜祭。1990年初，有ASU考古学者在此墓地进行了发掘，列出尚存的廿三位华人墓葬者的名单，其中包括有邓氏、余氏、黄氏、关氏等早期的华人先民，墓地还有惟一的一块墓碑，上面刻有＂开平大楼村人邓湘远坟墓＂的碑文。考古小组不得其解，曾委托华人学者唐孝先登报寻找＂邓湘远＂后裔的讯息，但由于年代久远，多年来仍是杳无音讯。 近年来，斐匿华人福利会主席张肇鸿为解开这个＂墓碑谜团＂，进行了多年的调查研究，从姓名查到族谱，从美国查回中国，从历史查到现在，终于有了水落石出。因纪念墓园的建立有年份的佐証，邓湘远的辈份有邓氏族谱资料的佐証，所以，在未有其它新发现之前，推论邓湘远的墓碑有可能是亚省华人遗留下来的最早的墓碑，碑文是亚省华人遗留下来的最早的中国文字。这块墓碑对今后研究亚省华人的历史文化有很大的参考价值。另一个收获是，在发现邓湘远的家谱中，查到有一位后人是华人的精英，他就是曾任九巡大法官的邓心平。 在进行华人墓地及碑文的研究中，得到了资深侨领余文劲先生的关心和支持，以及广大侨民不断的协助，他们提供许多缐索和文字及照片资料，让调查得到顺利完成。今天，凤凰城侨社各界人士冒着骄阳前来凭吊先民，慎终追远，让百年前的先辈从今以后不再令人遗忘。华人今天的地位已有了显着的提升，观念和胸怀也在不断扩充，不再沉鬱在过去的历史和社会所给予的不公，而是更积极去面对未来，勇于参与开拓与创新。 参加次这追悼活动的有资深侨领余文劲，学术界代表唐孝先，凤凰城侨联总会主席余文泽，侨联前主席邓朝驹，邓高密公所主席邓丰占、成员邓家彦、邓家健，开平同乡会主席关兆峰、副主席邓汝杨，余风采堂代表余富强，斐匿华人福利会主席张肇鸿，荣光会理事高志中、中国餐馆协会董事巫宜钊、成员朱其华，台联会名誉主席陈彩屏、其女儿朱莞菁，现役美国陆军宪兵士官朱莞菱，龙冈公所书记张万波、代表刘陈爱卿。亚省太阳鸟华人网主编谢成彦。活动结束后，资深侨领余文劲，在六福酒家宴请来宾。《美西侨报》、太阳鸟华人网、凤凰华人资讯网、凤凰艺文网、全程关注和报导＂墓碑谜团＂组文。娟娟花店精心制作了追悼活动的花圈和花篮。
a25fbe3332957f7ae07de6fbf8aa9ece40c4daed.translatedText: 参加悼念活动的华人代表 在1880年代初，铁路开通到凤凰城，城市原来的旧墓地须搬迁，当年有部分无人认领的华人墓葬者由市政府集中安葬于新墓园，即现的华人墓地。 According to cemetery information, a total of 50 Chinese of Chinese descent were buried here from 1886 to 1914. In the era of discrimination and anti-Chinese, the Chinese had a sad history, and some people asked their descendants to transport their bones back to China. Due to the continuous desertion of the cemetery, no Chinese have come to pay their respects here for many years. 1990年初，有ASU考古学者在此墓地进行了发掘，列出尚存的廿三位华人墓葬者的名单，其中包括有邓氏、余氏、黄氏、关氏等早期的华人先民，墓地还有惟一的一块墓碑，上面刻有＂开平大楼村人邓湘远坟墓＂的碑文。考古小组不得其解，曾委托华人学者唐孝先登报寻找＂邓湘远＂后裔的讯息，但由于年代久远，多年来仍是杳无音讯。 近年来，斐匿华人福利会主席张肇鸿为解开这个＂墓碑谜团＂，进行了多年的调查研究，从姓名查到族谱，从美国查回中国，从历史查到现在，终于有了水落石出。因纪念墓园的建立有年份的佐証，邓湘远的辈份有邓氏族谱资料的佐証，所以，在未有其它新发现之前，推论邓湘远的墓碑有可能是亚省华人遗留下来的最早的墓碑，碑文是亚省华人遗留下来的最早的中国文字。 This tombstone has great reference value for future research on the history and culture of Chinese people in Alberta. Another gain is that in the genealogy of Deng Xiangyuan, it was found that one of his descendants is an elite Chinese. He is Deng Xinping, who once served as the chief judge of the Ninth Circuit. 在进行华人墓地及碑文的研究中，得到了资深侨领余文劲先生的关心和支持，以及广大侨民不断的协助，他们提供许多缐索和文字及照片资料，让调查得到顺利完成。 Today, people from all walks of life in the overseas Chinese community in Phoenix City braved the scorching sun to come to pay homage to their ancestors, and to pay close attention to our ancestors, so that our ancestors from a hundred years ago will no longer be forgotten from now on.华人今天的地位已有了显着的提升，观念和胸怀也在不断扩充，不再沉鬱在过去的历史和社会所给予的不公，而是更积极去面对未来，勇于参与开拓与创新。 参加次这追悼活动的有资深侨领余文劲，学术界代表唐孝先，凤凰城侨联总会主席余文泽，侨联前主席邓朝驹，邓高密公所主席邓丰占、成员邓家彦、邓家健，开平同乡会主席关兆峰、副主席邓汝杨，余风采堂代表余富强，斐匿华人福利会主席张肇鸿，荣光会理事高志中、中国餐馆协会董事巫宜钊、成员朱其华，台联会名誉主席陈彩屏、其女儿朱莞菁，现役美国陆军宪兵士官朱莞菱，龙冈公所书记张万波、代表刘陈爱卿。 Xie Chengyan, editor-in-chief of the Alberta Sunbird Chinese Network. After the event, senior overseas Chinese leader Yu Wenjin entertained the guests at Luk Fook Restaurant. "American Overseas Chinese News", Sunbird Chinese Network, Phoenix Chinese Information Network, Phoenix Art Network, all paid attention to and reported on the "Tombstone Mystery" article. Juanjuan Flower Shop carefully crafted wreaths and flower baskets for the memorial service.

ef8c107b545eb429f3b7a3cbdcc5bf90163a19e5.sourceText: 在竞选演说正式开始前，府邸主人Nick Goodman带领来宾参观了这栋极富欧式古典风格的住宅，并且耐心地讲解了各个房间的设计及用途。之后，所有人都集中到了后院的露天泳池边，等候竞选晚会开场。
ef8c107b545eb429f3b7a3cbdcc5bf90163a19e5.translatedText: 在竞选演说正式开始前，府邸主人Nick Goodman led the guests to visit this European classical-style house, and patiently explained the design and use of each room. Afterwards, everyone gathered at the outdoor swimming pool in the backyard, waiting for the campaign party to start.

f6d1999af61b912aa882d8ae6aebbbb94efe3e19.sourceText: 晚会由前州议员Barry Wong主持，竞选嘉宾有：亚利桑那州共和党主席Robert Graham、前亚利桑那州共和党主席Tom Morrissey、Arizona Asian American Association 主席Maribel Dillard、中华商会会长伍兆文等。每位嘉宾都进行了简短的演说，讲述了华人在本州的作用以及竞选人黄馨民的参选优势。最后的压轴是竞选人黄馨民的演讲。他以一个匹萨为噱头，不仅迅速吸引了人们的注意力，而且生动地阐述了华人在美国的地位、作用以及参与政治的重要意义。
f6d1999af61b912aa882d8ae6aebbbb94efe3e19.translatedText: 晚会由前州议员Barry Wong主持，竞选嘉宾有：亚利桑那州共和党主席Robert Graham、前亚利桑那州共和党主席Tom Morrissey、Arizona Asian American Association 主席Maribel Dillard、中华商会会长伍兆文等。 Each guest gave a brief speech, describing the role of Chinese in the state and the advantages of candidate Huang Xinmin's candidacy. The finale was the speech of candidate Huang Xinmin.他以一个匹萨为噱头，不仅迅速吸引了人们的注意力，而且生动地阐述了华人在美国的地位、作用以及参与政治的重要意义。

1e1df18c821f85bac60a0a9d10f8b03e3647b0c7.sourceText: 黄馨民来美二十一年，取得了教育博士学位，曾担任记者、党部执行长、教师、教育研究者、中学校长等。今次是他第二次参加该职位的竞选。他认为这一次的政见比第一次要更为成熟棗”财政责任、经济机会、生活质量”。此外，他还有一个政见，虽然未正式公开，但在当晚的演讲中，他做出了一个承诺，那就是每年争取专款一百万美元，做为亚裔小区文化活动以及各种事项之用。 作为一名参加市参议院竞选的华人，黄馨民认为自己的优势在于：”华人在美国的形象比较正面，因此在主流社会里，有一部分人对华人特别有好感，对竞选来说，这一点是加分的。”然而，已经落选过一次的他也有很多顾虑，”选举是数人头的游戏，钱德勒市所有的华裔加起来也不过四千多，实际去做投票登记的可能不到五百人，而这五百人又很可能不会都去投票。如果要在八月二十六日的第一轮选举就直接当选，大约需要一万四千票。”所以，在竞选这条路上，黄馨民的压力可想而知。不过，他自己倒是相当有信心，他说即使这次竞选失败，他依然不会放弃，因为他希望自己的参选和当选能够提升华人的地位和影响力。
1e1df18c821f85bac60a0a9d10f8b03e3647b0c7.translatedText: Huang Xinmin came to the United States 21 years ago and obtained a doctorate in education. He has served as a journalist, party executive, teacher, education researcher, and middle school principal. This is his second run for the position. He believes that this time's political views are more mature than the first time - "fiscal responsibility, economic opportunities, quality of life."此外，他还有一个政见，虽然未正式公开，但在当晚的演讲中，他做出了一个承诺，那就是每年争取专款一百万美元，做为亚裔小区文化活动以及各种事项之用。 作为一名参加市参议院竞选的华人，黄馨民认为自己的优势在于：”华人在美国的形象比较正面，因此在主流社会里，有一部分人对华人特别有好感，对竞选来说，这一点是加分的。”然而，已经落选过一次的他也有很多顾虑，”选举是数人头的游戏，钱德勒市所有的华裔加起来也不过四千多，实际去做投票登记的可能不到五百人，而这五百人又很可能不会都去投票。如果要在八月二十六日的第一轮选举就直接当选，大约需要一万四千票。”所以，在竞选这条路上，黄馨民的压力可想而知。不过，他自己倒是相当有信心，他说即使这次竞选失败，他依然不会放弃，因为他希望自己的参选和当选能够提升华人的地位和影响力。

7eae289c4eb8a9ef7a66bc9afbb8fa8472ad1fb0.sourceText: 竞选晚会以音乐表演和自助餐的形式画上了完满的句号。然而，华人在美国政坛的路还只是一个逗号，很长且艰难。希望华人朋友除了在人力和财力上对竞选人黄馨民博士多加支持外，还能多多在其他族群和主流社会多加宣传，化成能掌握在手中的选票。

6e881a5b913011b54620eb075f64fe5c1685bab4.sourceText: (亚省华联供稿) 2014年5月18日，凤凰城当地华人网球爱好者和韩国网球爱好者之间进行了一场网球友谊赛。友谊赛在Corona del Sol High School网球中心举行。本次赛事由李教练、Howard Shim和亚省华联王惟咨会长共同协调组织。活动期间，分别进行了单打和双打的比赛。 对于此次赛事，王惟咨会长表示，这是第一次亚省华联和其它族裔一起共同举办活动；活动能够圆满顺利地完成，要感谢李教练和当地韩国网球对领队Howard Shim的安排和协调，也要感谢大家的积极响应和参与。赛事的举办不仅提高了大家对网球的热情，也拉近了各族裔网球爱好者之间的关系。值得欣喜的是，本次网球赛事自始至终在融洽和愉快的氛围中进行，赛手们不仅锻炼了球技，也充分享受了网球的乐趣。正如一位赛手所言，只要玩得开心，谁输谁赢并不重要。赛事结束后，韩国网球队领队Howard Shim表示，我们一起迈出了可喜的第一步，希望和亚省华联一道为日后举办更多的体育赛事加强合作。
6e881a5b913011b54620eb075f64fe5c1685bab4.translatedText: (亚省华联供稿) On May 18, 2014, a friendly tennis match was held between local Chinese tennis enthusiasts and Korean tennis enthusiasts in Phoenix. The friendly match was held at the Corona del Sol High School Tennis Center. This event was coordinated and organized by Coach Li, Howard Shim and President Wang Weizi of the Alberta Hualian Federation. During the event, singles and doubles matches were held. 对于此次赛事，王惟咨会长表示，这是第一次亚省华联和其它族裔一起共同举办活动；活动能够圆满顺利地完成，要感谢李教练和当地韩国网球对领队Howard Shim的安排和协调，也要感谢大家的积极响应和参与。 The hosting of the event not only increased everyone's enthusiasm for tennis, but also brought closer the relationship between tennis enthusiasts of all ethnic groups.值得欣喜的是，本次网球赛事自始至终在融洽和愉快的氛围中进行，赛手们不仅锻炼了球技，也充分享受了网球的乐趣。 As one racer said, it doesn't matter who wins or loses as long as you're having fun.赛事结束后，韩国网球队领队Howard Shim表示，我们一起迈出了可喜的第一步，希望和亚省华联一道为日后举办更多的体育赛事加强合作。

c3dcc267ab47ed10c100fb3d143918181d605a97.sourceText: 2014年全球各个经济体的竞争力如何？美国领跑、欧洲恢复、大型新兴经济体挣扎。这是全球顶级商学院瑞士洛桑国际管理发展学院（IMD）在2014年全球竞争力年鉴中给出的答案。
c3dcc267ab47ed10c100fb3d143918181d605a97.translatedText: >How competitive are the various economies around the world in 2014? The United States leads, Europe recovers, and large emerging economies struggle. This is the answer given by the International Institute for Management Development (IMD) in Lausanne, Switzerland, the world's top business school, in the 2014 Global Competitiveness Yearbook.

157e96791185c2f0863f7f17392cb09458bd3301.sourceText: 在今年的排行榜中，美国仍居首位，瑞士和新加坡分列二、三位，中国内地则位列23，日本反超中国列21位。
157e96791185c2f0863f7f17392cb09458bd3301.translatedText: 在今年的排行榜中，美国仍居首位，瑞士和新加坡分列二、三位，中国内地则位列23，日本反超中国列21位。

b1c83c0c8edfb09524e8339971c1a070a9f0ca66.sourceText: 根据该年鉴，美国排在首位是因为其经济的快速恢复能力、转好的就业数据，以及在科技和基础设施上的优势。
b1c83c0c8edfb09524e8339971c1a070a9f0ca66.translatedText: 根据该年鉴，美国排在首位是因为其经济的快速恢复能力、转好的就业数据，以及在科技和基础设施上的优势。

22e64e0365c5018f716830d91a6d02d0570fa8b0.sourceText: 和去年相比，今年排行榜前十位的经济体并没有太大变化。得益于出口、商业效率和创新，瑞士、新加坡和中国香港这三个小经济体依次占据二、三、四位。
22e64e0365c5018f716830d91a6d02d0570fa8b0.translatedText: Compared with last year, the top ten economies in this year’s ranking have not changed much. Thanks to exports, business efficiency and innovation, the three small economies of Switzerland, Singapore and Hong Kong occupy the second, third and fourth positions respectively.

6addd6878d77f62976ee59c6fca3b23809d51c8a.sourceText: 经 济的逐渐恢复令欧洲的竞争力表现优于去年。除了排在第2的瑞士、第5的瑞典、第6的德国和第10的挪威外，丹麦也挤进前十，名列第9。而在欧洲的外围经济 体中，爱尔兰、西班牙和葡萄牙竞争力均有所上升，分列15、39和43位，意大利和希腊则分别下滑2和3个位次，列46和57位。
6addd6878d77f62976ee59c6fca3b23809d51c8a.translatedText: The gradual recovery of the economy has made Europe's competitiveness better than last year. In addition to Switzerland in 2nd, Sweden in 5th, Germany in 6th and Norway in 10th, Denmark also made it into the top ten, ranking 9th.而在欧洲的外围经济 体中，爱尔兰、西班牙和葡萄牙竞争力均有所上升，分列15、39和43位，意大利和希腊则分别下滑2和3个位次，列46和57位。

109d2227e4193ee065a5bfe6dd0db8a340a5ef76.sourceText: 在亚洲国家中，日本从去年的24位上升到21位，报告称 日元 弱势有助于增强其海外竞争力。马来西亚和印度尼西亚竞争力同样也有所上升，分列12位和37位。而政治的不稳定性导致泰国竞争力比去年下滑2个位次，到29位。
109d2227e4193ee065a5bfe6dd0db8a340a5ef76.translatedText: Among Asian countries, Japan rose to 21st from 24th last year. The report said that the weak yen helped enhance its overseas competitiveness. The competitiveness of Malaysia and Indonesia has also improved, ranking 12th and 37th respectively. Political instability has caused Thailand's competitiveness to fall 2 places from last year to 29th.

80eaf4da3828c3ba5eeb75466e52fd8bd675042b.sourceText: 由 于经济增长和外国投资放缓，以及基础设施仍有所不足，大多数大型新兴经济体今年的竞争力下滑。报告称，中国内地从去年的21位下滑到23位，在一定程度上 是由于对其商业环境的担忧；而效率低下的劳动力市场和经营管理则使得印度和巴西分别从去年的40位和51位，下滑到44位和54位。此外，土耳其、墨西 哥、菲律宾和秘鲁排名也纷纷下滑。
80eaf4da3828c3ba5eeb75466e52fd8bd675042b.translatedText: 由 于经济增长和外国投资放缓，以及基础设施仍有所不足，大多数大型新兴经济体今年的竞争力下滑。报告称，中国内地从去年的21位下滑到23位，在一定程度上 是由于对其商业环境的担忧；而效率低下的劳动力市场和经营管理则使得印度和巴西分别从去年的40位和51位，下滑到44位和54位。 In addition, Türkiye, Mexico, the Philippines and Peru also fell in the rankings.

8e83555b08350946b5b10fdd82bb5e2bf30d8691.sourceText: ”2014年总的竞争力情况是，美国继续取得成功，欧洲得到部分恢复，而一些大型新兴市场则在挣扎。”IMD世界竞争力中心负责人阿尔图罗 布里斯称，”一个国家要想在竞争力排行上攀升，没有唯一针对性的秘方，大部分取决于当地的环境。”
8e83555b08350946b5b10fdd82bb5e2bf30d8691.translatedText: ”2014年总的竞争力情况是，美国继续取得成功，欧洲得到部分恢复，而一些大型新兴市场则在挣扎。”IMD世界竞争力中心负责人阿尔图罗 布里斯称，”一个国家要想在竞争力排行上攀升，没有唯一针对性的秘方，大部分取决于当地的环境。”

6ae2c2ff51dd42a7f6df17cb8ac3d32e547e05c2.sourceText: 作为世界竞争力排名的一部分，IMD世界竞争力中心也对各个经济体商业环境和海外形象进行了调查。
6ae2c2ff51dd42a7f6df17cb8ac3d32e547e05c2.translatedText: 作为世界竞争力排名的一部分，IMD世界竞争力中心也对各个经济体商业环境和海外形象进行了调查。

79397fd4f896402460e1da86098b225532780db3.sourceText: 根据IMD对各国企业高管的调查，在竞争力排名前十的国家中，有七个在海外形象的排行榜中也位列前十位。总的来说，一个国家的整体竞争力排名和是否有友好商业的国际形象具有很强的关联性。
79397fd4f896402460e1da86098b225532780db3.translatedText: 根据IMD对各国企业高管的调查，在竞争力排名前十的国家中，有七个在海外形象的排行榜中也位列前十位。 Overall, there is a strong correlation between a country's overall competitiveness ranking and its international image as a business-friendly country.

78eab8eb02948896c17ada7c5d009396e2c03a76.sourceText: 新加坡的企业高管大部分对国家海外形象很乐观。相比较而言，美国、法国、中国台湾和波兰的企业高管们则更悲观。调查报告称，美国的结果可能反映了国际冲突和国内政治僵局等问题，而法国的形象则仍然被缓慢的改革和对全球化的消极态度拖累。
78eab8eb02948896c17ada7c5d009396e2c03a76.translatedText: Singapore's business executives are mostly optimistic about the country's overseas image. In comparison, business executives in the United States, France, Taiwan, and Poland are more pessimistic.调查报告称，美国的结果可能反映了国际冲突和国内政治僵局等问题，而法国的形象则仍然被缓慢的改革和对全球化的消极态度拖累。

69c7310e9f5eec54f60381d6aa6d4e0fe62f5d57.sourceText: ”经济表现逐年变化，观念是长期、逐渐转变的。它们也能够进入一个更好的形象和更佳的经济表现的良性循环中。”布里斯说，所以，高管们如何认知他们的国家，对未来的竞争力发展来说是一个潜在的有用的指导。
69c7310e9f5eec54f60381d6aa6d4e0fe62f5d57.translatedText: ”经济表现逐年变化，观念是长期、逐渐转变的。它们也能够进入一个更好的形象和更佳的经济表现的良性循环中。”布里斯说，所以，高管们如何认知他们的国家，对未来的竞争力发展来说是一个潜在的有用的指导。
