b46bb469ae1ba135d9b2f5c55dc21561b8bace8e.sourceText: 每个中国人都有自己的姓氏，同一个祖先繁衍的后代称为宗族，姓氏与人名一起构成了一个人的姓名，姓氏是表示一个人的家族血缘关系的标志和符号。邓姓是中国大陆第34大姓（2006年数据），邓姓发源于今河南省境，大举南迁于东晋之时，而播迁入闽、粤则早于汉代。主要分佈于四川、湖南、广东、香港等地。
b46bb469ae1ba135d9b2f5c55dc21561b8bace8e.translatedText: 每个中国人都有自己的姓氏，同一个祖先繁衍的后代称为宗族，姓氏与人名一起构成了一个人的姓名，姓氏是表示一个人的家族血缘关系的标志和符号。邓姓是中国大陆第34大姓（2006年数据），邓姓发源于今河南省境，大举南迁于东晋之时，而播迁入闽、粤则早于汉代。 Mainly distributed in Sichuan, Hunan, Guangdong, Hong Kong and other places.

06a594711346cbdc0e281ab0f09cadd2a318189f.sourceText: 邓氏支族甚多，派辈各异，很多支族用字辈来排别辈份。字不是原先的姓名，婚后的男性才能取字棑辈，以邓小平家族为例，在《广安县邓氏家谱》中是用”以仁存心，克绍先型，培成国用，燕尔昌荣。”来立字辈的，邓小平的曾祖父邓心早，祖父邓克达，父亲邓绍昌，他原名是邓先贤，参加革命后才改为邓小平， 这全是按字辈中的＂心、克、绍、先＂来排列，字辈可以让人一眼便知辈份的高低。
06a594711346cbdc0e281ab0f09cadd2a318189f.translatedText: There are many branches of the Deng family, with different generations. Many branches use the word generation to distinguish their seniority.字不是原先的姓名，婚后的男性才能取字棑辈，以邓小平家族为例，在《广安县邓氏家谱》中是用”以仁存心，克绍先型，培成国用，燕尔昌荣。”来立字辈的，邓小平的曾祖父邓心早，祖父邓克达，父亲邓绍昌，他原名是邓先贤，参加革命后才改为邓小平， These are all arranged according to the characters "xin, ke, shao, and xian" in generation. The character generation can make people know the level of seniority at a glance.

e78dcd37cccdc71fb0e9a7df8e8e1fce25032923.sourceText: 邓粤钿先生编辑的邓家谱可追溯至公元1200年，邓粤钿先生说，自从邓氏99代传人晚景公自台山迳头村迁至开平护龙村以来，就开始了命字棑辈，晚景公共有三个儿子，称为＂三房＂，他们属邓家二房，其字辈排列为：＂嘉厚源芳远，业隆世运昌。＂他的曾祖父属＂远＂字辈，名邓伟远，祖父属＂业＂字辈，名邓增业，父亲属＂隆＂字辈，名邓楷隆，到自己这一代属＂世＂字辈，婚后的姓名本应是邓诚世，但这时候在美国已没改名的必要，故仍用出生时的姓名邓粤钿。
e78dcd37cccdc71fb0e9a7df8e8e1fce25032923.translatedText: 邓粤钿先生编辑的邓家谱可追溯至公元1200年，邓粤钿先生说，自从邓氏99代传人晚景公自台山迳头村迁至开平护龙村以来，就开始了命字棑辈，晚景公共有三个儿子，称为＂三房＂，他们属邓家二房，其字辈排列为：＂嘉厚源芳远，业隆世运昌。＂他的曾祖父属＂远＂字辈，名邓伟远，祖父属＂业＂字辈，名邓增业，父亲属＂隆＂字辈，名邓楷隆，到自己这一代属＂世＂字辈，婚后的姓名本应是邓诚世，但这时候在美国已没改名的必要，故仍用出生时的姓名邓粤钿。

49394e0e8212e69363f898f4486e2bf71c952466.sourceText: 邓粤钿的曾祖父邓子辕，按辈排字为邓伟远，有两位夫人。
49394e0e8212e69363f898f4486e2bf71c952466.translatedText: >Deng Yuedian's great-grandfather Deng Ziyuan, named Deng Weiyuan by generation, had two wives.

a97664710075bb1634deb103489b06f522b2db32.sourceText: 邓粤钿的曾祖父邓子辕，婚后命字排辈为邓伟远，是清朝的一名官员，与邓湘远同辈份。邓粤钿的祖父邓增业，是第一代到美国的移民，但留下的资料不多，只知道后来去了檀香山经营果业生意至去世。父亲邓楷隆， 1888年出生于广东开平赤坎护龙永安里，1907年，19岁的邓楷隆赴三藩市，后来到凤凰城经营生意。1916年，邓楷隆回大陆结婚并携妻返回凤凰城。1928年，重视中国传统文化教育的邓楷隆带领全家回中国，并把两个儿子邓粤寅和邓粤钿留在广州学中文，后来其兄邓粤寅和母亲先返美，邓粤钿就读于广州国立中山大学附中，初三时由于中国抗日战争爆发回到美国，所以两兄弟的中英文水平俱佳。其父邓楷隆是本埠华人早期着名的侨领，也是亚省第一个华人组织＂华商总会＂的创会人之一，＂华商总会＂1939年向亚利桑那州府注册成立，现称＂亚省中华商会＂，华商总会对本地华人有很大的贡献。
a97664710075bb1634deb103489b06f522b2db32.translatedText: Deng Yuedian's great-grandfather Deng Ziyuan, whose surname after marriage was Deng Weiyuan, was an official in the Qing Dynasty and the same generation as Deng Xiangyuan.邓粤钿的祖父邓增业，是第一代到美国的移民，但留下的资料不多，只知道后来去了檀香山经营果业生意至去世。父亲邓楷隆， 1888年出生于广东开平赤坎护龙永安里，1907年，19岁的邓楷隆赴三藩市，后来到凤凰城经营生意。 In 1916, Deng Kailong returned to the mainland to get married and returned to Phoenix with his wife. 1928年，重视中国传统文化教育的邓楷隆带领全家回中国，并把两个儿子邓粤寅和邓粤钿留在广州学中文，后来其兄邓粤寅和母亲先返美，邓粤钿就读于广州国立中山大学附中，初三时由于中国抗日战争爆发回到美国，所以两兄弟的中英文水平俱佳。其父邓楷隆是本埠华人早期着名的侨领，也是亚省第一个华人组织＂华商总会＂的创会人之一，＂华商总会＂1939年向亚利桑那州府注册成立，现称＂亚省中华商会＂，华商总会对本地华人有很大的贡献。

424833e146bd19f6cb38d6f7d2f3da20720ef18c.sourceText: 邓粤钿四兄弟曾先后服过兵役，他本人在二次世界大战当兵，参加过诺曼底战役。 1944年8月6日，邓粤钿执行第30次任务，轰炸德国柏林的发动机工厂，但投弹后飞机被砲火击中，跳伞后被德军俘虏。 1945年2月，为逃避苏军的攻势，德国人决定步行迁移整个战俘营，邓粤钿与超过一万人的战俘开始了 ”死亡之旅”步行了一千英里，从东海岸走到西海岸，到西海岸后再折回东海岸，足足步行了一百多天，受尽磨难。 1945年5月4日，邓粤钿被英军解救。他是亚利桑那州唯一在二战期间被俘的华裔美国人，被美国政府授予战争先锋勳章。2007年1月16日，凤凰城市长菲尔戈登(Phil Gordon) 把这天特定为＂邓粤钿日＂。邓粤钿和大哥邓粤寅都是凤凰城华人社团的资深侨领，担任过许多职务，对宗族和老一辈华侨情况也十分熟悉。邓家公所的族人早年曾到过纪念墓园过向先人扫过墓，这对我们了解邓湘远背景有莫大的帮助。
424833e146bd19f6cb38d6f7d2f3da20720ef18c.translatedText: >Deng Yuedian's four brothers have served in the military one after another. He himself served as a soldier in World War II and participated in the Battle of Normandy. 1944年8月6日，邓粤钿执行第30次任务，轰炸德国柏林的发动机工厂，但投弹后飞机被炮火击中，跳伞后被德军俘虏。 1945年2月，为逃避苏军的攻势，德国人决定步行迁移整个战俘营，邓粤钿与超过一万人的战俘开始了 ”死亡之旅”步行了一千英里，从东海岸走到西海岸，到西海岸后再折回东海岸，足足步行了一百多天，受尽磨难。 On May 4, 1945, Deng Yuedian was rescued by the British army. He was the only Chinese American in Arizona captured during World War II and was awarded the War Vanguard Medal by the U.S. government. On January 16, 2007, Phoenix Mayor Phil Gordon designated this day as "Deng Yuedian Day."邓粤钿和大哥邓粤寅都是凤凰城华人社团的资深侨领，担任过许多职务，对宗族和老一辈华侨情况也十分熟悉。 The clan members of Deng's family office visited the memorial cemetery in the early years and visited the tombs of their ancestors. This is of great help to us in understanding Deng Xiangyuan's background.

2d1d3039b83354d251dbeb33eb0a16fee2a3b62f.sourceText: 邓粤钿先生查过族谱后对我说，大楼村的邓湘远属三房族人，在这方面他本人缺少资料，在他保存其父邓楷隆的＂邓高密总公所楼业新旧百子会部＂中，我看到有纪录大楼村邓氏三房中远、业、隆各辈分的人名，如：霖远，安业、钜业、仕业，心隆、都隆、侨隆等相关名字。不过，在他编辑的邓氏族谱里，却找不到有关邓湘远的名字。
2d1d3039b83354d251dbeb33eb0a16fee2a3b62f.translatedText: 邓粤钿先生查过族谱后对我说，大楼村的邓湘远属三房族人，在这方面他本人缺少资料，在他保存其父邓楷隆的＂邓高密总公所楼业新旧百子会部＂中，我看到有纪录大楼村邓氏三房中远、业、隆各辈分的人名，如：霖远，安业、钜业、仕业，心隆、都隆、侨隆等相关名字。 However, in the Deng family tree he compiled, the name Deng Xiangyuan could not be found.

1400d6a08d61958e07ddbb8b4136b06aecf4d95d.sourceText: 大凤凰​城房地产三月均价比二​月上涨了近1万美元 大凤凰城房地产价格经历了一个疯狂的三月。平均房屋售价比二月份增加了近万元。 根据亚利桑那凯瑞商学院的最新报告，三月份房屋价格的中值为二十万四千五百美金，二月为十九万五千，上涨了近4.9%。 房地产理论与实践研究中心的迈克说每年三月，春忙季节都会是销售旺季，一直会继续超过5月。 近七月来，二月通常是最低的中值价格。尽管三月价格猛增，但是销售数量还是远远低于去年，比去年大约低了20%。 迈克表示城区的房地产价格大幅反弹可能性不大，但是最近贷款利率的降低，银行为更多贷款者放款，将会在接下去的几个月内帮助市场继续恢复。30年的固定利率已经降到4.18%。业内人士调查表明四月中旬是在过去三年中，最容易拿到贷款的时间。与去年同期相比，三月房地产中值上涨了17%。更多房地產資訊請諮詢 金 信 地產Tinna 480-287-0180 E-mail: goldtrustrealty2010@gmail.com
1400d6a08d61958e07ddbb8b4136b06aecf4d95d.translatedText: 大凤凰​城房地产三月均价比二​月上涨了近1万美元 大凤凰城房地产价格经历了一个疯狂的三月。 The average home selling price increased by nearly 10,000 yuan compared with February. 根据亚利桑那凯瑞商学院的最新报告，三月份房屋价格的中值为二十万四千五百美金，二月为十九万五千，上涨了近4.9%。 Mike from the Real Estate Theory and Practice Research Center said that every March, the spring busy season will be the peak sales season, which will continue beyond May. February has typically had the lowest median price for the past seven months. Despite the surge in prices in March, sales numbers are still far lower than last year, about 20% lower than last year. 迈克表示城区的房地产价格大幅反弹可能性不大，但是最近贷款利率的降低，银行为更多贷款者放款，将会在接下去的几个月内帮助市场继续恢复。 The 30-year fixed rate has dropped to 4.18%. Industry surveys show that mid-April has been the easiest time to get a loan in the past three years. The median real estate value rose 17% in March compared to the same time last year. ae72a20163c5587e773c59be541667e85c9bd972.sourceText: Phoenix, Arizona：亚太医护行动协会（Asian Pacific Community in Action）第九届年度”太之美”宴会订于2014年5月10日，星期六晚上5:30举行，特颁奖于St. Luke健康倡议、Dr. Anthony Yeung和Josefina’Jo’Barone、MBA，RN，对他们为无数亚利桑那居民在改善健康和生活品位上的贡献以示敬意。地点：Doubletree Paradise Valley Resort, 5401 North Scottsdale Road in Scottsdale。一如往届，这将是一个充满乐趣的晚宴，包括有才艺展示、无声拍卖和亚太开胃菜。预计将有超过350本地亚太社区成员、政府官员和医护保健企业出席。

a910846077e7dc99b4f00d8444cf36061bd698f8.sourceText: St. Luke健康倡议（St. Luke Health Initiative，SLHI）是Phoenix本地的一个公共基金会，其使命–通过卫生政策、社区发展和功能建设等进行宣示、连繫和提供支援，努力改善Arizona社区居民健康。1907年，St. Luke初创为非营利医院，然于1995年，SLHI出售其所有设施，使用其金融资产提供基金从事慈善以及公众教育活动。

9e58510fb2f75e69e4511f7a7773eaca44211b43.sourceText: 美投资签证八成给中国人 房地产成最重要投资项目之一?#36234;来越多富有的中国人选择生活在美国?#65292;据美国福布斯网站13日报道，美国国务院发布的最新数据显示，2013年，美国发给中国人的EB-5投资签证达6895人，占该项目总数的80%。 2011年，获得美国EB-5投资签证的中国人不足2500人。该项目给予在美国投资100万美元或在高失业率的农村地区投资50万美元的外国人移民身份。 投资项目品目繁多，但是房地产一直是华人最热衷的。纽约，洛杉矶，旧金山，甚至凤凰城有很多地产都更换到华人或者华人企业名下。 报道称，美国并不是富有中国人唯一的选择。在澳大利亚，针对富裕投资者的投资项目中，九成的申请人来自中国，2013年一实施即获得近3亿美元的进账。在加拿大，因为对投资移民带来经济效果的争议，加政府今年初宣布暂停投资移民计划。据称有4.5万名中国大陆投资者在申请该项目。更多房地产资讯请咨询金信地产Tinna 480-287-0180 E-mail: goldtrustrealty2010@gmail.com
9e58510fb2f75e69e4511f7a7773eaca44211b43.translatedText: 美投资签证八成给中国人 房地产成最重要投资项目之一?#36234;来越多富有的中国人选择生活在美国?#65292;据美国福布斯网站13日报道，美国国务院发布的最新数据显示，2013年，美国发给中国人的EB-5投资签证达6895人，占该项目总数的80%。 In 2011, fewer than 2,500 Chinese obtained U.S. EB-5 investment visas. The program grants immigration status to foreigners who invest $1 million in the United States or $500,000 in rural areas with high unemployment. There are many types of investment projects, but real estate has always been the most popular among Chinese people. Many real estate properties in New York, Los Angeles, San Francisco, and even Phoenix have been transferred to the names of Chinese or Chinese companies. According to reports, the United States is not the only option for wealthy Chinese. In Australia, 90% of the applicants for investment projects targeting wealthy investors are from China, and nearly US$300 million was received as soon as they were implemented in 2013. In Canada, due to controversy over the economic effects of investment immigration, the Canadian government announced the suspension of the investment immigration program earlier this year. It is said that 45,000 mainland Chinese investors are applying for the project. For more real estate information, please contact Goldtrust Realty Tinna 480-287-0180 E-mail: goldtrustrealty2010@gmail.com

2aee21cf635b7eee6cd2fcc911244756df860b42.sourceText: (亚省华联供稿) 第九届”Taste of Asia”年度筹款晚会于2014年5月10日晚在Doubletree Paradise Valley Resort in Scottsdale举行。 筹款晚会上，APCA向Dr. Anthony Yeung和Josefina Barron颁奖，以表彰他们在医疗卫生方面为社区所做出的杰出贡献。另外，APCA还向St. Luke’s Health Initiatives对在APCA的初创阶段和多年以来的连续支持表示最诚挚的敬意。亚省华联王惟咨会长和陶世诚董事代表亚省华联出席了本届年度筹款晚会。 APCA的宗旨是通过授权、健康推广和预防疾病来改善在马里科帕郡的亚太裔社区的健康和福利。自2002年成立以来， APCA一直协助本州与当地组织，举办乙型肝炎测试、妇女健康检测、慢性疾病检查、烟草使用预防和戒烟教育，等健康活动，并全年进行健康推广和认知宣传活动及教育讲座。 凤凰城资深侨领余文劲，为APCA和社区服务多年的王馨馨医生、廖丰医生，及其它社团组织负责人也出席了年度筹款晚会。

4da25a62fc38cf68d1e0c4d46382b5c0bd842f52.sourceText: 4月全美零售业激增6%创两年来最大增幅 母亲节或再创新高 美国4月零售业同店销售额激增6%，随着天气好转、复活节延后到来加上积极促销吸引血拼客，业绩出现2011年9月以来最大成长。开张至少1年的门市营收成长幅度，轻易击败研究机构Retail Metrics Inc.今天公布的分析师预估均值3.9%。 3月和4月合计营收年增4.8%。Retail Metrics指出，零售业状态可能还没完全明朗。正面业绩将必须延续到5月才能确认这股趋势，而且深达50%的折扣可能有损零售业第1季的盈余。 Retail Metrics总裁柏金斯（Ken Perkins）今天在新闻稿中表示：?#25105;们必须再接再厉，以扎实的母亲节和阵亡将士纪念日周末业绩造就优异的5月表现，才会更有自信地认为消费者已回笼。?/DIV> Cato Corp.以成长18%领先群雄。这家女装零售商上修第1季获利预测，从原估每股至多95美分拉高到1.05美元。Cato股价劲扬4.2%，报28.87美元。拥有维多利亚的秘密（Victoria’s Secret）的有限品牌公司（L Brands Inc.）与青少年服饰连锁店Zumiez Inc.，营收分别成长8%与8.2%。好市多公司（Costco Wholesale Corp.）营收增长5%。有限品牌股价弹涨4.9%，报56.01美元。Zumiez则大涨13%，报28美元。

The combined revenue in March and April increased by 4.8% year-on-year. Retail Metrics pointed out that the state of the retail industry may not be completely clear yet. Positive results will have to extend into May to confirm the trend, and discounts as deep as 50% could hurt retail earnings in the first quarter. Retail Metrics总裁柏金斯（Ken Perkins）今天在新闻稿中表示：?#25105;们必须再接再厉，以扎实的母亲节和阵亡将士纪念日周末业绩造就优异的5月表现，才会更有自信地认为消费者已回笼。 ?/DIV> Cato Corp. led the pack with growth of 18%. The women's clothing retailer raised its first-quarter profit forecast to $1.05 a share from its original estimate of as much as 95 cents. Cato shares surged 4.2% to $28.87.拥有维多利亚的秘密（Victoria’s Secret）的有限品牌公司（L Brands Inc.）与青少年服饰连锁店Zumiez Inc.，营收分别成长8%与8.2%。 Costco Wholesale Corp.'s revenue rose 5%. Limited Brands shares rose 4.9% to $56.01. Zumiez rose 13% to $28.

fab23326796a331f4d871a4c970e927e4b52aba6.sourceText: 祝贺韩安娜荣获2014年美国青年艺术总统奖! 她将于6月中去白宫领奖并在肯尼迪艺术中心表演。全美共有二十名青年艺术家获得总统奖,音乐家在其中只有三名。当安娜在五月五日得知这个喜讯时， 马上打电话告诉他的钢琴老师许飞。她从五岁开始跟许飞老师学习钢琴, 在许老师13年的辛勤 培养下，她对音乐的追求越来越成熟和执着。一直不断的努力使她获得了许多国际比𡧳大奖。近年来她在纽约和华盛顿等地举行了数次独奏音乐会，获得了包括华盛顿邮报在内多家报纸很好的评论。今年安娜以优秀的成绩考上了朱莉亚音乐学院。秋季将入学。她感谢她的父母这么多年来为她的学习所付出的精力和支持。她的父亲韩文海是一位电脑工程师，母亲万红是一位护士。在此时韩安娜特别感谢她的钢琴老师许飞并恭贺他获得了2014年美国杰出教师奖! 当问起许老师对韩安娜和他取得这样杰出的成绩怎样看待时他谦虚的说：在教学中一起成长，凡事谢恩！
fab23326796a331f4d871a4c970e927e4b52aba6.translatedText: 祝贺韩安娜荣获2014年美国青年艺术总统奖! 她将于6月中去白宫领奖并在肯尼迪艺术中心表演。 A total of 20 young artists in the United States have received the Presidential Award, and only three musicians are among them. When Anna learned the good news on May 5, she immediately called his piano teacher Xu Fei to tell him. She started learning piano from Teacher Xu Fei at the age of five. Under Teacher Xu’s 13 years of hard training, her pursuit of music has become more and more mature and persistent. Her continuous efforts have enabled her to win many international competition awards. In recent years, she has given several solo concerts in New York and Washington, D.C., and received favorable reviews from newspapers including the Washington Post. This year Anna was admitted to the Juilliard School of Music with excellent results. Enrollment will begin in the fall. She thanked her parents for their energy and support in her studies over the years. Her father Han Wenhai is a computer engineer and her mother Wan Hong is a nurse.在此时韩安娜特别感谢她的钢琴老师许飞并恭贺他获得了2014年美国杰出教师奖! 当问起许老师对韩安娜和他取得这样杰出的成绩怎样看待时他谦虚的说：在教学中一起成长，凡事谢恩！

30f82cc2fcbfb21a21a41d197fa7a76c6c0a469e.sourceText: 海外华裔青少年”寻根之旅”营是国际青少年儿童基金会（IEYC）和中国海外交流协会为帮助广大海外华裔青少年学习中文、了解中国国情和中华文化、促进海内外华裔青少年的交流而在寒暑假期间举办的大型综合性活动，主要内容有学习中国民族舞蹈和中华武术、学习汉语和中华文化常识、与中国青少年学生交流、参观历史文化名胜等。让学生们在乐中学，在乐中感受中国的传统文化。

65537282625fabf7eb7e8f5397cf74f3da9cc129.sourceText: 南京是中国著名的四大古都及历史文化名城。千百年来，奔腾不息的长江不仅孕育了长江的文明，也催生了南京这座江南城市。南京襟江带河，依山傍水，钟山龙蟠，石头虎踞，山川秀美，古迹众多。
65537282625fabf7eb7e8f5397cf74f3da9cc129.translatedText: Nanjing is one of the four famous ancient capitals and historical and cultural cities in China. For thousands of years, the surging Yangtze River not only gave birth to the civilization of the Yangtze River, but also gave birth to the city of Nanjing in the south of the Yangtze River. Nanjing is surrounded by rivers, mountains and rivers, Zhongshan with dragons and tigers standing on it, beautiful mountains and rivers, and numerous historical sites.

a89bb9c82de77a61d18ef13923dd9858c88f4fd0.sourceText: 而泰州境内名胜古迹也非常多，现存古遗址、古建筑、古石刻数百处，其中列为省市级文物保护的有134处，全市建有5座博物馆，珍藏文物万余件，不少为稀世珍品。光孝寺、城隍庙、望海楼以及梅兰芳纪念馆等传承历史，文脉灵动；古银杏森林、溱湖湿地、水上森林等生态自然，风光绮丽。
a89bb9c82de77a61d18ef13923dd9858c88f4fd0.translatedText: 而泰州境内名胜古迹也非常多，现存古遗址、古建筑、古石刻数百处，其中列为省市级文物保护的有134处，全市建有5座博物馆，珍藏文物万余件，不少为稀世珍品。光孝寺、城隍庙、望海楼以及梅兰芳纪念馆等传承历史，文脉灵动；古银杏森林、溱湖湿地、水上森林等生态自然，风光绮丽。

16807ae935d5ba21f5a5cd745293aa3a2bf52582.sourceText: 说到宿迁，不得不提的就是宿迁是著名的”杨树之乡”、”水产之乡”、”名酒之乡”和”蚕茧之乡”。自古便有”北望齐鲁、南接江淮，居两水（即黄河、长江）中道、扼二京（即北京、南京）咽喉”之称。宿迁是世界生物进化中心之一，也是人类起源中心之一，被誉为地球上的”生命圣地”。
16807ae935d5ba21f5a5cd745293aa3a2bf52582.translatedText: 说到宿迁，不得不提的就是宿迁是著名的”杨树之乡”、”水产之乡”、”名酒之乡”和”蚕茧之乡”。 Since ancient times, it has been known as "looking at Qilu in the north, Jianghuai in the south, sitting in the middle of the two rivers (i.e., the Yellow River and the Yangtze River), and straddling the throat of the two capitals (i.e., Beijing and Nanjing)". Suqian is one of the world's centers of biological evolution and one of the centers of human origin. It is known as the "Holy Land of Life" on Earth.

c9817b5e209d9f55d6a14ca5c9b40ce1360fb74d.sourceText: （希望中文学校5/11/2014供稿）2014年5月4日，希望中文学校一年一度的毕业颁奖典礼又如期举行。为了有更大更好的舞台，学校今年特地移师Rhodes Junior High School的礼堂来举办, 无论从舞台到灯光，再到音响设备，都能与专业水平相媲美。即使礼堂比原来大了很多，但是现场依旧座无虚席，学生和家长盛装出席，欢声笑语充满整场盛会。
c9817b5e209d9f55d6a14ca5c9b40ce1360fb74d.translatedText: （希望中文学校5/11/2014供稿）2014年5月4日，希望中文学校一年一度的毕业颁奖典礼又如期举行。 In order to have a bigger and better stage, the school specially moved to the auditorium of Rhodes Junior High School this year. From the stage to the lighting to the sound equipment, it can be compared with professional standards. Even though the auditorium was much larger than before, the venue was still full. Students and parents attended in costumes and filled the entire event with laughter and laughter.

62fb83fef3f77b079df39918c1325112f4b43162.sourceText: 典礼开始，首先由谢小红校长致辞。谢校长总结了一年来学校的教学活动，以及学生们取得的骄人成绩，无论是中文还是才艺都全面开花。今年是希望中文学校建校19周年，除了在各种比赛中获得骄人成绩，学校还被评为”海外华文教育示范学校”并创建了学校图书馆”华星书屋”。饮水不忘挖井人，谢校长对历届的校长、学校团队以及热心办学的人士都表示了感谢。我校第一届校长唐孝先校长也来到了现场，望着新一代的希望师生感慨万千。
62fb83fef3f77b079df39918c1325112f4b43162.translatedText: The ceremony began with a speech by Principal Xie Xiaohong. Principal Xie summarized the school’s teaching activities over the past year and the students’ impressive achievements, both in Chinese and in their talents.今年是希望中文学校建校19周年，除了在各种比赛中获得骄人成绩，学校还被评为”海外华文教育示范学校”并创建了学校图书馆”华星书屋”。饮水不忘挖井人，谢校长对历届的校长、学校团队以及热心办学的人士都表示了感谢。 Principal Tang Xiaoxian, the first president of our school, also came to the scene and was filled with emotion as he looked at the new generation of hopeful teachers and students.

07fcd67ac3bf822428785301a5298d3677933666.sourceText: 谢校长对学校董事会和校委会以及所有老师表示了最崇高的谢意，感谢他们为学校的各项事务以及教学工作一年来兢兢业业呕心沥血。并和何世江董事长向董事会和校委会成员，年度优秀教师颁发了奖。这次还特别向教龄五年以上及十年以上的老师颁发了奖，感谢他们对学校多年的辛勤耕耘。随后她向大家隆重介绍了学校新校长田琳女士以及新董事长周青女士，相信她们会继续带领这支希望的团队把学校办得更好。学生会也给义工们和老师们献了鲜花，代表学生们对义工和老师的感谢。
07fcd67ac3bf822428785301a5298d3677933666.translatedText: 谢校长对学校董事会和校委会以及所有老师表示了最崇高的谢意，感谢他们为学校的各项事务以及教学工作一年来兢兢业业呕心沥血。 Chairman He Shijiang and Chairman He Shijiang presented awards to the members of the board of directors and school committee and the annual outstanding teachers. This time, special awards were given to teachers with more than five years of teaching experience and more than ten years of teaching experience to thank them for their hard work in the school for many years.随后她向大家隆重介绍了学校新校长田琳女士以及新董事长周青女士，相信她们会继续带领这支希望的团队把学校办得更好。 The student union also presented flowers to the volunteers and teachers to represent the students' gratitude to the volunteers and teachers.

5b99bbad4f771ee8f84faa2eda36c0678c21a56c.sourceText: 舞台上一排排金光闪闪的奖杯奖牌都是为孩子们准备的。他们有的在识字比赛中名列前茅，有的在写作比赛中脱颖而出，有的在文化知识竞赛中过关斩将, 还有杰出社区服务奖。学校今年还特地设立了希望奖学金，奖励优秀的毕业生。一张张童真的笑脸，映衬着一块块闪光的奖牌，这是对他们努力付出的最好回报。
5b99bbad4f771ee8f84faa2eda36c0678c21a56c.translatedText: The rows of glittering trophies and medals on the stage are all prepared for the children.他们有的在识字比赛中名列前茅，有的在写作比赛中脱颖而出，有的在文化知识竞赛中过关斩将, 还有杰出社区服务奖。 The school also specially established the Hope Scholarship this year to reward outstanding graduates. The innocent smiling faces, set against the shining medals, are the best reward for their hard work.

98609d012f2a9d7eea027e258a4a1d49c0a51168.sourceText: 颁奖仪式后，丰富多彩的中文和文艺汇演开始。中文班的学生们通过形式多样的表演来汇报他们一年里学到的知识，除了传统的儿歌诗词朗诵《上下左右》、《小鸭子》、《长歌行》、《星星》、《中国功夫》《满江红》和《山居秋暝》；还有合唱《幸福的脸》、《找朋友》、《萤火虫》和《让我们荡起双桨》，更有巧心思编排的舞台剧《小猴子下山》、《蜗牛月光的故事》。才艺班的更是精彩紛呈, 让人印象深刻。孩子们带来了热热闹闹的舞蹈《我给你拜年》、充满青春活力的《花季》、场面宏大的《木兰出征》；还有经典的历史表演剧《说唱脸谱》、《英雄》及吉它和武术表演。除了孩子们的表演，成人也不甘示弱，成人舞蹈班带来了优美的舞蹈《牧民新歌》、《玫瑰》和太极班的太极剑表演。在希望的校园里不只是孩子们在学习和成长，我们的家长也在一起学习成长，完美人生。在欢声笑语相互祝贺勉励中，毕业典礼完美结束。

With laughter and mutual congratulations and encouragement, the graduation ceremony ended perfectly.

cd3edccbfbd4e444fc597cf8a7f1f0e22013ee8e.translatedText: 【凤凰城 凤鸣报道】5月11日星期天，这一天也是母亲节，主日崇拜后，在凤凰城华人基督教会大堂，中文学校的师生和学生家长们，欢聚一堂，为庆祝学生们一年的勤奋学习所取得的丰硕成果，举行了庄严，欢乐的结业典礼。 While preparing for the final exam, the students also carefully prepared exciting programs under the leadership of their homeroom teachers.

0c33c8d6af89faaa97573f34c5ffe16b8a098efc.sourceText: 结业典礼，在张婉飞老师主持下1：30 Pm准时开始，教会刘书华牧师为大会祝祷，并向学生颂发成绩特优奖 Outstanding Award ，共有30名学生得到这特殊荣誉奖。下面从学前注音班的儿歌 Children Songs 开始，接下来是正体一班的说说唱唱，唱游班的颜色歌，儿童舞蹈班的舞蹈〝故乡是北京〞，中文学前班的儿歌〝小动物怎样叫？〞，双语班的歌曲〝我的好妈妈〞，彭子安同学的讲故事〝你很特别, 简体四班的歌词朗诵〝最美的祝福〞，青少年舞蹈班的舞蹈〝凤阳花鼓〞等等，共有十六个之多。这其中包括儿歌、舞蹈、歌曲、古诗朗诵、讲故事、和自编自演的话剧，样样具全，孩子们纯真的笑脸，稚嫩甜美的童声，朗诵起来真的比歌声还动听，青少年舞蹈班表演的舞蹈：鳯阳花鼓 Chinese Folk Dance 是得奖节目，其中以讲故事和歌曲〝我的好妈妈 〞尤其受欢迎。彭子安同学的讲故事：〝你很特别 You are special〞，用标准的国语，向大家生动的讲述了每一个很特别的你，对小朋友们有极大的鼓励，双语班的同学们演唱的歌曲：〝我的好妈妈〞非常感人，尤其这一天正好是母亲节，孩子们的歌声，深深打动了在座的每一位母亲，虽然养育儿女是那样的辛苦，孩子们能有这极大的爱心，一切都值得，孩子是上帝给每个家庭的最好礼物，我们是在为上帝管教和培养孩子。孩子们有这样的成绩，老师和学生都下了很大功夫。节目中间串插中文学校校长李珍致词，向全体老师和同工们致谢，感谢他（她）们在这一年中的辛勤工作和奉献付出，祝学生们取得优秀的学习成绩，勉力学生们在假期，不要忘记学中文。在典礼文娱节目中还设有Trivia问题抢荅和由李鸿志董事给识字/朗诵比赛优秀得奖的19名学生颁奖。文娱节目在全场欢声笑语中结束，学生们高高兴兴、三五成群地飞快涌向奖品区领奖，对自己一年的辛勤学习，有个美好的奖赏。

Student Peng Zian's storytelling: "You are special." special〞，用标准的国语，向大家生动的讲述了每一个很特别的你，对小朋友们有极大的鼓励，双语班的同学们演唱的歌曲：〝我的好妈妈〞非常感人，尤其这一天正好是母亲节，孩子们的歌声，深深打动了在座的每一位母亲，虽然养育儿女是那样的辛苦，孩子们能有这极大的爱心，一切都值得，孩子是上帝给每个家庭的最好礼物，我们是在为上帝管教和培养孩子。孩子们有这样的成绩，老师和学生都下了很大功夫。节目中间串插中文学校校长李珍致词，向全体老师和同工们致谢，感谢他（她）们在这一年中的辛勤工作和奉献付出，祝学生们取得优秀的学习成绩，勉力学生们在假期，不要忘记学中文。在典礼文娱节目中还设有Trivia问题抢荅和由李鸿志董事给识字/朗诵比赛优秀得奖的19名学生颁奖。文娱节目在全场欢声笑语中结束，学生们高高兴兴、三五成群地飞快涌向奖品区领奖，对自己一年的辛勤学习，有个美好的奖赏。

60a36f87e918037153cd5cdaf07b058ef2309665.sourceText: 凤凰城华人基督教会中文学校成立于1983年，至今已有30年的历史，是一个非营利组织学校。目前学校设有唱游班, 中文学前班, 简体幼儿班, 注音班, 正体班4个、简体班8个、双语班4个、会话班1个、中文AP班1个、课后活动班中有2个舞蹈班，2个绘画班， 3个数学班和1个武术班共30个班级250多位学生。办校宗旨是教导学生学习中文及中国传统文化以外，并融和基督博爱真理来培养学生健全品格。该校老师、同工皆本着荣神益人、传扬中华文化为心志。聘任的老师和助教均是具有爱心、服务热忱、肯牺牲奉献，志同道合的伙伴。办学的目标是：老师队伍专业化、教学系统化、环境社区化、教材趣味化、家长参与化。本年度校长李珍校长，在中文学校执教9年，2011年度任中文学校校长，在李珍校长的领导下，大力开展各项工作，取得不寻常的业绩。盼望凤凰城基督教会中文学校越办越好，欢迎对传扬中华文化有责任感的有志之士，到中文学校与全体同工同心协力办好学校！下学年的开学日是8/17/2014 下午1:30，注册日是8/10/2014下午1:30pm～3:30. 欢迎登陆学校网站：gpccs.org 浏览学校更多资讯。

061a965abb833e491a134ed14a3e72f3b9d2396f.sourceText: 凤凰城 张肇鸿 一块华侨先辈的墓碑，一个未解开的谜团，掀开了中国开平赤坎古镇的风貌。
061a965abb833e491a134ed14a3e72f3b9d2396f.translatedText: Phoenix City Zhang Zhaohong A tombstone of an overseas Chinese ancestor, an unsolved mystery, reveals the style of Chikan Ancient Town in Kaiping, China.

6b196bbdbc633d2f354f5cde254d2133e83ffb03.sourceText: ”先民和军人纪念墓园”中惟一的一块华人墓碑，上刻有：”开平大楼村人邓湘远坟墓”。为了解开其中所包涵的讯息，我们把碑文分开为：开平、大楼村人、邓湘远、坟墓，再一一来作分析。
6b196bbdbc633d2f354f5cde254d2133e83ffb03.translatedText: The only Chinese tombstone in the "Ancestors and Soldiers Memorial Cemetery" is engraved with: "Grave of Deng Xiangyuan, a resident of Kaiping Tower Village". In order to understand the message contained in it, we divided the inscriptions into: Kaiping, Dalou Villager, Deng Xiangyuan, and Tomb, and then analyzed them one by one.

62d49164881d6eb2085399c488a7856d1bca16dc.sourceText: 邓湘远先辈来自开平。开平是中国一个着名的侨乡，位于广东珠江三角州，城市被潭江分为长沙、新昌和荻海三个区域，所以又称”三埠”。开平旅居海外及港澳台者近百万人，分佈在68个国家和地区，因此在世界上有两个开平的说法。开平名人辈出，如香港恆生银行总经理利国伟；着名粤剧艺术家红线女；香港艺人关德兴、周润发、戚美珍等等。在美国，有电视大厨甄文达；在亚省，有全美第一位参政华人，亚利桑那州众议员邓悦宁；大法官邓心平，还有美莎前市长邓伟利等。
62d49164881d6eb2085399c488a7856d1bca16dc.translatedText: >Deng Xiangyuan’s ancestor came from Kaiping. Kaiping is a famous hometown of overseas Chinese in China, located in the Pearl River Delta of Guangdong. The city is divided into three areas: Changsha, Xinchang and Dihai by the Tanjiang River, so it is also called the "Three Ports". There are nearly one million people living in Kaiping overseas, in Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan, distributed in 68 countries and regions, so there are two versions of Kaiping in the world. There are many celebrities in Kaiping, such as Lee Guowei, general manager of Hong Kong Hang Seng Bank; famous Cantonese opera artist Hongxian Nu; Hong Kong artists Guan Dexing, Chow Yun-fat, Qi Meizhen and so on. In the United States, there is TV chef Zhen Wenda; in Alberta, there is the first Chinese in the United States to participate in politics, Arizona State Representative Deng Yuening; Justice Deng Xinping, and former Mesa Mayor Deng Weili, etc.

0168e9c4bb02c5d6985e926967b270c54d43d695.sourceText: 在一百多年前邓湘远的那个年代，开平还是一个小县城，中心地区在现在的赤坎镇。赤坎镇历史大约有350年。距现在的开平市中心12公里，历史上赤坎镇是开平县城所在地，后来才挪到三埠镇，即现在的开平市区。
0168e9c4bb02c5d6985e926967b270c54d43d695.translatedText: In the era of Deng Xiangyuan more than a hundred years ago, Kaiping was still a small county, with the center in what is now Chikan Town. Chikan Town has a history of about 350 years. It is 12 kilometers away from the current city center of Kaiping. Historically, Chikan Town was the seat of Kaiping County. It was later moved to Sanbu Town, which is now the urban area of ​​Kaiping.

ae4516fd8a1d833dc5d744e80c66c57cb30529f9.sourceText: 赤坎镇原来是由新会县分割出来的，由于潭江水围着赤坎镇，所以水路交通相当发达。据镇志记载，1676年赤坎已有水渡码头。虽然历史不如中国其他名古镇如周庄、乌镇、朱仙、黄姚等悠久，但赤坎镇另有一番中西合璧的风貌，因此有”中国第五名古镇”之称。开平有碉楼1833幢，赤坎镇三门里的”迎龙楼”碉楼于明朝嘉靖年间建造，历史悠久。碉楼与村落被联合国教科文组织评定为世界文化遗产之一。
ae4516fd8a1d833dc5d744e80c66c57cb30529f9.translatedText: Chikan Town was originally divided from Xinhui County. Since the Tanjiang River surrounds Chikan Town, waterway transportation is quite developed. According to town records, there was a water crossing dock in Chikan in 1676. Although its history is not as long as other famous ancient towns in China such as Zhouzhuang, Wuzhen, Zhuxian, Huangyao, etc., Chikan Town has a unique combination of Chinese and Western features, so it is known as "China's fifth ancient town". There are 1,833 watchtowers in Kaiping. The "Yinglong Tower" watchtower in Sanmenli, Chikan Town, was built during the Jiajing period of the Ming Dynasty and has a long history. The watchtowers and villages have been rated as one of the world cultural heritage sites by UNESCO.

1ef25ddc1f37f6d71fb9432763c12ec883da7a03.sourceText: 在晚清时代，赤坎古镇内的面积有三平方公里，约四万多居民，民国时期，长期在这裡定居生活的大致有五六千人。光绪三年(1877)，美国长老会牧信文已来到赤坎，在归国华侨的协助下，创办了长老会礼拜堂。光绪二十三年(1897)，归国华侨关真人、关茂隆亦在赤坎创办了基督教循道会礼拜堂。
1ef25ddc1f37f6d71fb9432763c12ec883da7a03.translatedText: In the late Qing Dynasty, Chikan Ancient Town covered an area of ​​three square kilometers and had more than 40,000 residents. During the Republic of China, about 5,000 to 6,000 people settled here for a long time. In the third year of Guangxu's reign (1877), Pastor Xinwen of the American Presbyterian Church came to Chikan, and with the help of returned overseas Chinese, he founded a Presbyterian chapel. In the 23rd year of Guangxu (1897), returned overseas Chinese Guan Zhenren and Guan Maolong also founded the Christian Methodist Church in Chikan.

3ea638412d212e66f5b31dccc6d883ee6fbc6459.sourceText: 赤坎镇有着名的”欧陆风情街”，岭南地区的骑楼在镇上非常普遍，六里长的骑楼街有600座房子，是上世纪20年代，由归侨们沿江修筑的。据说，当年的老华侨在衣锦回乡后，拄着拐杖手比手划脚，把他们带回来关于西方的某些印象，或建筑图纸，再融合本地传统建筑风格，建造出一批中西合璧的楼房。这些精緻的楼宇保留了花窗凋刻和牌坊传统的风格，又夹杂着罗马柱、拱形窗、浮凋等西式建筑的痕迹，成为赤坎古镇的一道亮丽的风景线。
3ea638412d212e66f5b31dccc6d883ee6fbc6459.translatedText: Chikan Town has the famous "European Style Street". The arcades in the Lingnan area are very common in the town. The six-mile-long arcade street has 600 houses and was built along the river by returned overseas Chinese in the 1920s. It is said that after the old overseas Chinese returned to their hometowns in fine clothes, they used crutches to gesticulate and brought back certain impressions or architectural drawings about the West, and then integrated them with local traditional architectural styles to build a number of buildings that combined Chinese and Western styles. These exquisite buildings retain the traditional style of carved flower windows and archways, and are mixed with traces of Western architecture such as Roman columns, arched windows, and reliefs. They have become a beautiful scenery in the ancient town of Chikan.

9f3b8142c9ecf640bfab28e7d17ecc00782235b2.sourceText: 在繁华的黄金时代, 赤坎老街的许多楼房只有底层有住家，楼上则是紧闭的窗户，原来楼主都在海外，底楼是看房的远亲或租赁的房客。这些楼主大多是”金山伯”，十九世纪中叶，美国加州发现金矿，以后修铁路、挖河道，开平当地不少农民应招而去。
9f3b8142c9ecf640bfab28e7d17ecc00782235b2.translatedText: In the prosperous golden age, many buildings on Chikan Old Street only had residents on the ground floor, while the upper floors had closed windows. It turned out that the owners were overseas, and the ground floor was occupied by distant relatives who were looking at the property or tenants who rented the property. Most of these posters are "Jin Shan Bo". In the mid-19th century, gold mines were discovered in California, USA. Later, railways were built and rivers were dug. Many local farmers in Kaiping responded to the recruitment.

ef20ba1b22cfe8debd1e51bda179ec9ac512247b.sourceText: 当年把去美国淘金称作”去金山”或者”去花旗”。这些出过洋的人被赤坎人称为”金山伯”。在上世纪二十年代，”金山伯”们历经千辛万苦，省下几个钱，回家乡完成”田、园、庐、墓”的梦想。赤坎的乡村侨眷多，侨汇畅通，因而商业开始繁荣。那时西方文明也迅速传入，1914年小火轮航行于赤坎。 10年后，也有了第一辆美国福特公司製造的敞篷汽车。 20世纪40年代，这裡拥有电话、电报和汽车公司。
ef20ba1b22cfe8debd1e51bda179ec9ac512247b.translatedText: Back then, going to the United States to go gold hunting was called “going to Jinshan” or “going to Citigroup”. These people who went abroad were called "Jin Shanbo" by the Chikan people. In the 1920s, the "Jin Shanbo" people went through untold hardships, saved a few money, and returned to their hometown to fulfill their dreams of "fields, gardens, huts, and tombs." There were many overseas Chinese relatives in Chikan's countryside, and overseas remittances flowed smoothly, so business began to prosper. At that time, Western civilization was also introduced rapidly, and in 1914, a small steamer sailed to Chikan. Ten years later, there was also the first convertible car made by the American Ford Company. In the 1940s, it was home to telephone, telegraph and automobile companies.

0492fc95fe91d96f5dc2d6673c708f1f044478a3.sourceText: 繁华时代的赤坎，金铺、布行、当舖林立。沿岸开了17间大规模的茶楼酒馆。其中金融业、银号、金银铺兴旺。外地商人来来往往，烟馆、赌馆相继兴起，不长的街道就有天香楼等6间妓院，繁华而奢靡。因为华侨多，先进的西医学早在民国初年就在赤坎落户，赤坎繁荣时曾有”医生街”，很多医生都是名牌医大出身。繁华路上最多的是诊所与各种药舖。
0492fc95fe91d96f5dc2d6673c708f1f044478a3.translatedText: In the prosperous era of Chikan, there were many gold shops, cloth shops and pawnshops. There are 17 large-scale teahouses and taverns opened along the coast. Among them, the financial industry, banks, and gold and silver shops are prosperous. Businessmen from other places come and go, opium dens and gambling houses have sprung up one after another. There are six brothels including Tianxiang Tower in a short street, which is prosperous and luxurious. Because there are many overseas Chinese, advanced Western medicine has been established in Chikan as early as the early years of the Republic of China. When Chikan was prosperous, there was a "Doctor Street", and many doctors were from famous medical universities. Most of the busy roads are clinics and various pharmacies.

f9fb61cec0cd5ea670e35041ebb21dd027653bd1.sourceText: 赤坎镇文风鼎盛。当年最奇特的景观，莫过于小小的地方竟然有两座公共图书馆。缘起因镇上有两大家族，河东区是司徒氏族人，来自河北邯郸。河西则是关氏族人，来自福建。两族人则经过多年发展都成为望族，而随着发展两家也开始明争暗斗。1920年司徒族人开设閲览室，1925年图书馆大楼在潭江东堤落成，旅居海外的和当地司徒氏共筹得4万多银圆，聘请了着名建筑公司修建成三层钢筋水泥楼，馆内藏书逾万册，其中有《四库全书》、《万有文库》等鸿幅巨着。第二年，旅加的司徒昆仲又捐资在楼顶增建一座钟楼，购回美国波士顿名牌钟，上鍊一次大钟可以运转一周。洪亮悠远的钟声震惊了关姓族人，关氏也不甘居后，在第二年就成立了图书馆筹建会，并选用港资建筑公司和上乘材料修建，不到5年关氏图书馆也矗​​立在赤坎上埠堤西河畔，对照司徒氏图书馆有镇馆的巨着，关氏图书馆也重金购买了《四库全书》、《万有文库》、《廿四史》三部巨着，又特别选购了德国大钟，与司徒氏的美国钟抗衡。在那时人们习惯看日出日落的年代，两具大钟同时响起，极大地方便了当地居民，也成为南国水乡的一个传奇故事。
f9fb61cec0cd5ea670e35041ebb21dd027653bd1.translatedText: > Chikan Town has a prosperous literary style. The most peculiar sight at that time was that there were two public libraries in a small place. The origin is that there are two big families in the town. The Hedong District is from the Situ clan and comes from Handan, Hebei. Hexi is a member of the Guan clan, from Fujian. After years of development, the two tribes have become prominent families, and as they develop, the two families also begin to fight openly and secretly. In 1920, the Situ people opened a reading room, and in 1925, the library building was completed on the east embankment of the Tanjiang River. The overseas and local Situ families raised more than 40,000 silver yuan and hired a famous construction company to build a three-story reinforced concrete building. The next year, Situ Kunzhong, who was living in Canada, donated money to build a bell tower on the top of the building and bought back the famous Boston clock in the United States. The big clock can run for a week once it is wound. The loud and distant sound of the bell shocked the people of the Guan family. Not to be outdone, the Guan family established a library preparatory committee the next year and selected Hong Kong-funded construction companies and high-quality materials to build it. In less than five years, the Guan family library also stood on the Chikan Shangbu Embankment. On the bank of the West River, while the Situ Library has a collection of masterpieces, the Guan Library also spent a lot of money to purchase three masterpieces: "Sikuquanshu", "Wanyou Library", and "Twenty-Four Histories". It also specially purchased a large German clock to compete with Situ's American clock. At that time, when people were accustomed to watching the sunrise and sunset, the two big bells rang at the same time, which greatly facilitated the local residents and became a legend in the southern water town.

cb3333868d3260403aab28ffc59539dd104b7ac0.sourceText: 用了不少资料介绍开平赤坎古镇，是因为赤坎古镇百年来繁荣的离不开早期出国掏金、修铁路、辟农场、掘水利、做洗衣、开餐馆的华侨先辈，他们在异国它乡含辛茹苦，饱经风霜，流汗流血，甚至付出性命；他们拚命工作，逆来顺受，节衣宿食，而把挣来的血汗钱捎回家乡养妻小，搞建设，做公益。可以说，没有华侨，就不可能有开平今天如此繁荣的局面。另外，开平华侨也把故乡的勤劳美德，聪明才智，风俗民情带到了海外，没有老家开平，华侨也就失去了根，失去了重心和牵挂，连家乡桑梓的美梦也会破灭。开平故乡和华侨息息相关，荣辱与共，有了祖家平安繁荣，海外华人才能感到真正的安稳和自豪。
cb3333868d3260403aab28ffc59539dd104b7ac0.translatedText: uses a lot of information to introduce Chikan Ancient Town in Kaiping, because the prosperity of Chikan Ancient Town over the past century is inseparable from the early people who went abroad to make money, build railways, build farms, dig for water conservancy, do laundry, and open restaurants. The ancestors of the overseas Chinese endured hardships in foreign lands, suffered hardships, sweated blood, and even sacrificed their lives. They worked hard, accepted the odds, lived frugally, and took the hard-earned money back to their hometowns to support their wives and children, engage in construction, and do charity. It can be said that without overseas Chinese, Kaiping would not be as prosperous as it is today. In addition, the overseas Chinese in Kaiping have also brought the virtues of hard work, intelligence, customs and people of their hometown overseas. Without their hometown of Kaiping, the overseas Chinese will lose their roots, focus and care, and even the dreams of their hometown will be shattered. The hometown of Kaiping and overseas Chinese are closely related, sharing weal and woe. Only with the peace and prosperity of our ancestral home can overseas Chinese feel truly stable and proud.

90ed9e08f6cf237a7a11c1a9dce6733b39cf14ff.sourceText: 在开平赤坎古镇，司徒和关姓是望族，但在周边的乡村中，还有其他如邓氏、甄氏、张氏等大姓人家。当年从开平来美国多数是开平各乡村的农民，移民来到亚省凤凰城的亦有为数不少，并且以邓姓的居多。不过，碑文中提到的”大楼村”到如今已是资料缺乏，但在寻找过程中，却意外得到今日不少侨乡从繁华走向衰落的因由和景况，我们将继续寻找解开”墓碑谜团”的方法。（未完待续，文章连载《凤凰艺文网》 http://www.paaca.us ）
90ed9e08f6cf237a7a11c1a9dce6733b39cf14ff.translatedText: In Chikan Ancient Town, Kaiping, the Situ and Guan surnames are prominent families, but in the surrounding villages, there are other famous families such as the Deng family, the Zhen family, and the Zhang family. At that time, most of the people who came to the United States from Kaiping were farmers from various villages in Kaiping. There were also a large number of immigrants who immigrated to Phoenix, Alberta, and most of them had the surname Deng. However, there is currently a lack of information about the "Tombstone Village" mentioned in the inscription. However, in the process of searching, we unexpectedly found the reasons and circumstances of why many overseas Chinese hometowns today have gone from prosperity to decline. We will continue to look for ways to solve the "tombstone mystery". (To be continued, the article is serialized in "Phoenix Art and Literature Network" http://www.paaca.us)

f93ee5c1415a5e548aca65608fdee62689e57d4a.translatedText: Manor Night – Sam Huang Chandler City Councilor Campaign Party…

366d6fd28e2a1b3ac4d3f3ebbd328ac7466c900e.sourceText: 五月十六日星期五晚，在佔地十点五英亩的欧式古堡，钱德勒市议员华裔参选人黄馨民，将举办一塲别开生面的竞选晚会。本州多位著名华裔人士、社区领袖、政党主席、参众议员，也将现身为黄馨民加油造势。
366d6fd28e2a1b3ac4d3f3ebbd328ac7466c900e.translatedText: On the evening of Friday, May 16, at the European-style castle covering an area of ​​11.5 acres, Sam Huang, the Chinese candidate for Chandler City Councilor, will hold a unique campaign party. Many well-known Chinese Americans, community leaders, political party chairs, senators and representatives in the state will also appear to support Huang Xinmin.

b8730be9c39f3805d74058e03b1f5e4fdd4c28c5.sourceText: 黄馨民来美二十一年，取得教育博士学位，曾担任记者、党部执行长、教师、教育研究者、中学校长。主要政见在于低税而有责任的政府，增进经济的机会，和提昇生活的品质。希望能藉由他的参选和当选，提升华人的地位和影响力。钱德勒市议会于今年八月将改选三席，目前共有六人参选，黄馨民声势排在第三，非常有希望，但也很危险，稍有不慎就可能被赶上。做为一个少数族裔，在政治上能走到这步，非常不易。因此希望华人朋友除了在人力和财力上加以支持以外，还能多多在其它族群和主流社会加以宣传，化成选票。
b8730be9c39f3805d74058e03b1f5e4fdd4c28c5.translatedText: Huang Xinmin came to the United States 21 years ago and obtained a doctorate in education. He has served as a journalist, party executive, teacher, education researcher, and middle school principal. The main political views are low taxes and responsible government, increasing economic opportunities, and improving the quality of life. It is hoped that through his candidacy and election, the status and influence of the Chinese will be enhanced. Three seats on the Chandler City Council will be re-elected in August this year. There are currently six candidates running for election. Huang Xinmin is ranked third. He is very promising, but also very dangerous. If he is not careful, he may be overtaken. As an ethnic minority, it is not easy to reach this point in politics. Therefore, I hope that in addition to providing human and financial support, Chinese friends can also promote it to other ethnic groups and mainstream society to turn it into votes.

2e62f929e64200db52474384b20f7c48c8883ce2.sourceText: 晚会地点Chateau de Vie, 是钱德勒稀有的一座私人物业，建于一九八四年，佔地十点五英亩，有千株树木、十二间衞浴、图书室、家庭电影院，英式酒吧台，地下酒窖及可停泊二十五辆车的室内车库。户外还有网球塲，游泳池，管家房及面积达一点五英亩的人工湖。
2e62f929e64200db52474384b20f7c48c8883ce2.translatedText: The party venue is Chateau de Vie, a rare private property in Chandler. It was built in 1984 and covers an area of ​​11.5 acres. It has thousands of trees, 12 bathrooms, a library, a home cinema, an English-style bar, an underground wine cellar and an indoor garage that can park 25 cars. Outdoors there is a tennis court, swimming pool, butler's room and an artificial lake with an area of ​​1.5 acres.

af88431096440401c73b466684f1fecf048b8e5a.sourceText: 晚会于五点半免费入场，自由乐捐。六点半节目正式开始前半小时，屋主 Nick Goodman 将会亲自导览来宾参观堡内各项精緻装璜设计。会中有美食晚点招待及音乐欣赏，与候选人直接互动。试想置身夕阳裡品嚐美食，月光下聆听，在此诚挚地邀请各位贵宾前来叙旧联谊，悠哉自在的度过一个与以往不同的週五晚上。
af88431096440401c73b466684f1fecf048b8e5a.translatedText: Admission to the party is free at 5:30, donations are free. Half an hour before the official start of the show at 6:30, owner Nick Goodman will personally guide guests to visit the various exquisite decoration designs in the castle. During the meeting, there will be delicious food and music appreciation, and direct interaction with the candidates. Imagine tasting delicious food in the sunset and listening to music under the moonlight. We sincerely invite all distinguished guests to come and reminisce about old times and spend a leisurely and leisurely Friday night that is different from the past.

983da71b389bcb5f6e49814d93d4ee7bfe91c53e.translatedText: The Chinese Consulate General in Los Angeles will issue electronic Chinese passports from April 28th The Chinese Consulate General in Los Angeles will issue electronic passports from April 28th. In order to make the vast sea...

752e05f39e92fc914556337786c85b79f32c6fa1.sourceText: 中国驻洛杉矶总领馆于4月28日起签发电子护照。为使广大海外中国公民和侨胞了解有关情况，4月17日，总领馆举办情况说明会，邀请当地主要华文媒体及侨胞、留学生代表出席。美国华裔教授专家网陈钧铭教授与美西南学联主席陈钦应邀出席了会议。说明会由孙伟德副总领事主持，证件组组长叶秀薇领事等参加。
752e05f39e92fc914556337786c85b79f32c6fa1.translatedText: The Chinese Consulate General in Los Angeles will issue electronic passports starting from April 28. In order to make overseas Chinese citizens and overseas Chinese understand the relevant situation, the Consulate General held a briefing on April 17, inviting major local Chinese media and representatives of overseas Chinese and international students to attend. Professor Chen Junming of the Chinese American Professors and Experts Network and Chen Qin, chairman of the Southwest American Federation of Students, were invited to attend the meeting. The briefing was hosted by Deputy Consul General Sun Weide, and attended by Consul Ye Xiuwei, leader of the document team, and others.

0685efa7d3e4ac597c250929cbea3028ce85be3e.sourceText: 叶秀薇领事介绍了电子护照的主要特征并表示，电子护照可有效提高防伪和安全性能，使中国护照更加符合国际先进标准，对方便中国公民国际旅行具有积极意义。总领馆开通”护照预约系统”，目的是为了提升服务水平，使申请人更加顺畅的申请护照。总领馆将一如既往地为广大中国公民及侨胞提供优质、便捷服务。随后，有关工作人员在现场演示了”海外申请护照在线填表预约系统”。
0685efa7d3e4ac597c250929cbea3028ce85be3e.translatedText: Consul Ye Xiuwei introduced the main features of electronic passports and said that electronic passports can effectively improve anti-counterfeiting and security performance, make Chinese passports more in line with international advanced standards, and have positive significance in facilitating international travel for Chinese citizens. The Consulate General has launched the "Passport Reservation System" in order to improve service levels and make it smoother for applicants to apply for passports. The Consulate General will continue to provide high-quality and convenient services to Chinese citizens and overseas Chinese. Subsequently, relevant staff demonstrated the "Online Form Filling and Appointment System for Overseas Passport Application" on site.

966e8c813f3965d4ba1dcb64e95499526f2b1c03.translatedText: > Call for Papers for the 2014 Chinese and Foreign Poetry and Prose Invitational Competition In order to showcase the new achievements of Chinese and foreign contemporary poetry and prose, promote the great development and prosperity of socialist culture, and unite China...

018f55790f9a568f1c371f2fe85be73cb3b88175.sourceText: 为展示中外当代诗歌、散文新成就，促进社会主义文化大发展大繁荣，团结中外诗歌、散文作家，发现和培养诗歌、散文作者及爱好者，2014年中外诗歌散文邀请赛即日起向海内外隆重征稿。2014年的盛夏我们将相聚在首都，播种希望，放飞梦想，用我们的心，感知生命与岁月，用我们的笔，讴歌生活与爱情。
018f55790f9a568f1c371f2fe85be73cb3b88175.translatedText: In order to showcase the new achievements of Chinese and foreign contemporary poetry and prose, promote the great development and prosperity of socialist culture, unite Chinese and foreign poetry and prose writers, discover and cultivate poetry, prose authors and enthusiasts, the 2014 Chinese and Foreign Poetry and Prose Invitational Competition is now soliciting submissions from home and abroad. In the midsummer of 2014, we will gather in the capital to sow hope, let go of dreams, use our hearts to feel life and time, and use our pens to sing life and love.

bf94ec358f54504f6c62b9b8569870242a923b35.sourceText: 征稿内容：创作格调高雅、立意新颖，能够体现时代精神和反映现实生活的诗歌、散文、散文诗。要言之有物，情真意切，且富有文采。作品题材不限，发表与否不限，可寄复印件并注明出处，文责自负。
bf94ec358f54504f6c62b9b8569870242a923b35.translatedText: Call for submissions: Poems, prose, and prose poems that are elegant in style, novel in concept, and can embody the spirit of the times and reflect real life. What you say should be meaningful, sincere and full of literary talent. There is no limit to the subject matter of the work, and there is no limit to whether it will be published or not. You can send a copy and indicate the source. You are responsible for the article.

7f7457aff52520e0f41c168c9fe49b49114d9e82.sourceText: 征文要求：1.新诗限2首共50行以内。传统诗词限3首。散文限1篇、限2000字内；散文诗限3章，每章限800字内，提倡精短，以小见大。谢绝组诗、应酬诗和自传式文章。2. 稿件注明详细地址和真实姓名、电话及创作简历，来稿不退，请自留底稿。欢迎电子邮件投稿，勿用附件，投稿邮箱：zwsw8868@sina.com。3.每人限参加其中一类评比，重复无效。电子投稿后请勿再寄纸稿。
7f7457aff52520e0f41c168c9fe49b49114d9e82.translatedText: Essay requirements: 1. New poems are limited to 2, with a total of 50 lines or less. Limit of 3 traditional poems. The prose is limited to 1 article and 2,000 words; the prose poem is limited to 3 chapters, each chapter is limited to 800 words. We advocate keeping things short and using the small to see the big. Group poems, social poems and autobiographical articles are not allowed. 2. Please indicate your detailed address, real name, phone number and resume on the manuscript. Submissions will not be returned. Please keep the manuscript for yourself. Submissions are welcome via email, please do not use attachments. Submission email is: zwsw8868@sina.com. 3. Each person can only participate in one category of the competition, duplicates will be invalid. Please do not send paper manuscripts again after electronic submission.

f194eb5d60fd3f436fed5dd634e59f13008f3081.sourceText: 评选与奖励：1.邀请赛不收参赛费、评审费。由主办单位领导和在京作家、诗人组成评委会。入围即为初评，再经复评、终评程序。2.邀请赛设一、二、三等奖及优秀奖等，同时评出十篇”中外最佳诗歌奖”，十篇”中外最佳散文奖”等，均颁发证书。无奖金和奖品，请周知。3.凡获奖作家给予书面通知，邀请到北京参加颁奖盛典和创作论坛，其作品将在中华散文网发表，并将由国家级出版社出版专集。推荐优异获奖者出国参加世界诗人大会。
f194eb5d60fd3f436fed5dd634e59f13008f3081.translatedText: > Selection and rewards: 1. There is no entry fee or judging fee for the invitational competition. The judging panel is composed of leaders of the organizer and writers and poets in Beijing. Shortlisting is the preliminary evaluation, and then goes through the re-evaluation and final evaluation procedures. 2. The invitational competition has first, second, third prizes and excellence awards. At the same time, ten "Best Chinese and Foreign Poetry Awards" and ten "Best Chinese and Foreign Prose Awards" will be selected, and certificates will be awarded. Please be aware that there are no bonuses or prizes. 3. All award-winning writers will be notified in writing and invited to Beijing to participate in the awards ceremony and creative forum. Their works will be published on China Prose Network and will be published by national publishing houses. Recommend outstanding winners to go abroad to participate in the World Poets Conference.

0c4ab687aafd8a785d551afcea5d33d00b8f33b6.sourceText: ”凤凰小姐在凤凰”是凤凰卫视美洲区选美大会第十届(2014年)的主题。 2014年凤凰小姐美洲区决赛大会各大城市竞争激烈，在侨联总会强力邀请下，确定于八月十日落户在大凤凰城地区隆重举行。 大会电视转播工作小组遣送技术工作人员于五月一日抵凤凰城展开先期作业。 今年美洲区凤凰小姐选美大会预期将有十六位佳丽竞争后冠，大会将邀请港台知名歌星助阵演出，十年一盛会精彩可期。
0c4ab687aafd8a785d551afcea5d33d00b8f33b6.translatedText: "Miss Phoenix in Phoenix" is the theme of the tenth (2014) Phoenix TV Americas Beauty Pageant. The competition in major cities for the 2014 Miss Phoenix Americas Finals was fierce. Under the strong invitation of the Overseas Chinese Federation, it was decided to be held grandly in the greater Phoenix area on August 10th. The conference television broadcast working group sent technical staff to Phoenix on May 1 to start preliminary operations. This year's Miss Phoenix Beauty Pageant in the Americas is expected to have 16 beauties vying for the crown. The pageant will invite well-known singers from Hong Kong and Taiwan to perform. It is expected that this event will be exciting every ten years.

The main purpose of this cultural activity is to form a Chinese Overseas Chinese Celebration through mass writing...

0ff2cd729a993df27ece182b75c93264aaf7753a.sourceText: 大凤凰城侨联关于2014国庆徴文活动的若干説明 1，本次徴文活动主要目的是通过群众性的撰文，形成一个华人华侨庆祝美国国庆的氛围。青少年可以尽情抒发美丽的梦想，成年人写下实现美国梦的经历和体㑹。 2，青少年作品以中文作文的形式评选。按年龄分两个组：13岁以下为少年组，14岁-20岁为青年组。每组选优胜奨三名，鼓励奨七名。 3，成年人徴文不评选名次，重在参与。我们各个时代来到美国的华人，从”金山伯”到近代来美国留学和创业的人，都曾有各自实现美国梦的不同的奋斗经历，在这块陌生的土地上，我们洒下了辛勤的汗水，学习了新的知识，在东西方文化的融合中创建我们的事业，有过许多精彩的篇章，非常值得记录下来。我们希望通过这次国庆徴文活动，写出我们的心声，相互交流经验，使其成为社会的共同财富。文章可用中文和英文写作，字数也不作限制。欢迎大家踊跃投稿。我们将把大家的文章在庆国庆专栏发表或汇集成册。参加徴文的作者本会将赠送纪念品。 （侨联供稿）
0ff2cd729a993df27ece182b75c93264aaf7753a.translatedText: Several explanations from the Overseas Chinese Federation of Greater Phoenix City on the 2014 National Day cultural activities 1. The main purpose of this writing activity is to create an atmosphere for Chinese and overseas Chinese to celebrate the National Day of the United States through mass writing. Teenagers can express their beautiful dreams to their heart's content, and adults can write about their experiences and experiences of realizing the American dream. 2. Young people’s works will be selected in the form of Chinese compositions. There are two groups according to age: the youth group for those under 13 years old, and the youth group for those between 14 and 20 years old. Three winners from each group will be selected and seven will be encouraged. 3. Adults do not judge the rankings, but participate in them. The Chinese who came to the United States in various eras, from "Jin Shanbo" to those who came to the United States to study and start businesses in modern times, have had different struggles to realize the American dream. In this strange land, we shed hard sweat, learned new knowledge, and built our careers in the integration of Eastern and Western cultures. There have been many wonderful chapters, which are worth recording. We hope that through this National Day writing activity, we can write our voices, exchange experiences with each other, and make it a common wealth of society. Articles can be written in Chinese and English, and there is no limit on the number of words. Everyone is welcome to contribute. We will publish your articles in the National Day column or compile them into a volume. Souvenirs will be given to the participating authors. (Contributed by the Overseas Chinese Federation)

ac1709a9cd9ddbfc59a5f4b403d4c84ba6285264.translatedText: The 2014 “Arizona Bike Week” in the United States concluded successfully Arizona Bike Week is “Arizona…

ea1ed0e3745ea20ce54d67afe221a02aa0b084b8.sourceText: Arizona Bike Week 即”亚利桑那州摩托周”是目前仅次于”Daytona-戴托纳”和”Sturgis-斯特格斯”摩托周的美国第三大摩托车庆典活动。
ea1ed0e3745ea20ce54d67afe221a02aa0b084b8.translatedText: Arizona Bike Week That is, "Arizona Motorcycle Week" is currently the third largest motorcycle celebration in the United States after "Daytona-Daytona" and "Sturgis-Sturgis" Motorcycle Week.

40e9769957919d05003da5c42ad758a59b56f1e8.sourceText: 第18届”亚利桑那州摩托周”于4月2日至6日在 Scottsdale 市的一块占地约360英亩的地方举行。在官方的庆祝活动之前，大批摩托迷已于3月29日-4月1日提前集聚此地进行预热活动。当美国其它州或加拿大的四月气候依然处于较寒冷、洪水、乃至暴风雪的恶劣气候时，此时位于亚利桑那州的索诺拉沙漠却呈现一番蓝天白云、骄阳似火的不同景象。十天的会期吸引了大批摩迷前来观赏、参加，而本届无论参加车辆及人员均比去年增加了25%。
40e9769957919d05003da5c42ad758a59b56f1e8.translatedText: The 18th "Arizona Motorcycle Week" will be held in Scottsdale from April 2 to 6. It is held on an area of about 360 acres in the city. Before the official celebration, a large number of motorcycle fans have gathered here for warm-up activities from March 29th to April 1st. While the weather in other states or Canada in April is still relatively cold, floods, and even snowstorms, the Sonora Desert in Arizona presents a different scene of blue sky, white clouds, and scorching sun during the ten-day event. A large number of motorcycle fans come to watch and participate, and the number of participating vehicles and people this year has increased by 25% compared to last year.

9d030e1b806af22e15e6b5119109cb03b1f91c84.sourceText: 美食享受、狂欢畅饮、音乐会、真人秀、厂家直展、特技表演、慈善街游、改装车秀、依然是摩托周不变的主题！
9d030e1b806af22e15e6b5119109cb03b1f91c84.translatedText: Food enjoyment, carnival drinking, concerts, reality shows, direct manufacturer exhibitions, stunt performances, charity street parades, and modified car shows are still the unchanged themes of Motorcycle Week!

0b152413e88740f47e339f823d879bbb6f6727e0.sourceText: 2014 夏季色彩绘画提高班开始报名 Feng Fine Art Design 将举办夏季短期色彩培训班。 报名对象 ： 12 岁以上的学生以及成年人，具有一定的绘画基础，希望在短期时间内强化色彩学习，以及想为自家量身制作装饰画的朋友们 学习内容 ： 油画 （风景，静物，人物与动物的油画临摹与写生） 丙烯画 （ 风景，人物画及动物，名画临摹） 水彩及水墨画 （ 风景画，人物及动物） 各种混合材料的现代主义装饰画 * 本画室为学员免费提供油画布和丙烯画布 学习时间 ： 6 月 4—7/18. 为期 6 周（其中 6 月中的一周休课） 每周三， 周五 开课， 每次课 2 小时， 每小时收费 15 元， 6 人以下（含 6 人）为一个班级 说明： 1. 学员可根据自己的时间选择参加一周的学习（ 2 次课共 4 小时），或多周的学习（学习丙烯和油画）。 2. 学员可自带任何自己喜欢的作品或名画，在课堂学习复制。（根据自己家将悬挂的位置的尺寸大小来完成） 3. 为了解学员的绘画基础和提供相适合的学习素材，同时准备好学习材料， 5 月 18 日周日下午日 4 ： 30PM–7:PM 以及 5 月 23 日周五全日 10AM–3:PM 提供免费咨询。 学习班地址： 11620 E.Starflower Dr. Chandler, AZ 85248 。 联系电话 Tel: 480-332-1014 绘画学习班由 LIN 先生指导。他熟悉于各种绘画技术和材料的综合应用，是美西地区美术作品最畅销的画家之一。了解和观赏他的作品请到画廊 15330 N. Hayden Road #101,Scottsdale, AZ 85260 Tel:480-735-7282 ，以及 1746 W. Ruby Drive #106, Tempe, AZ 85284,tel: 480.598.6786 ， http://user.qzone.qq.com/1847751091/main
0b152413e88740f47e339f823d879bbb6f6727e0.translatedText: >2014 Summer Color Painting Improvement Class Registration Opens Feng Fine Art Design will hold a summer short-term color training class. Applicants for registration: Students and adults over 12 years old who have a certain foundation in painting, who want to strengthen color learning in a short period of time, and friends who want to make customized decorative paintings for their own homes. Learning content: oil painting (copying and sketching of oil paintings of landscapes, still lifes, figures and animals), acrylic painting (copying of landscapes, figure paintings and animals, famous paintings), watercolor and ink painting (landscape paintings, figures and animals), modernist decorative paintings of various mixed materials * This studio provides students with free oil and acrylic canvas. Learning time: June 4-7/18. It lasts for 6 weeks (one week in June is closed). Classes start every Wednesday and Friday. Each class lasts 2 hours. The fee is 15 yuan per hour. A class of less than 6 people (including 6 people) is a class. Note: 1. Students can choose to participate in a week of study according to their own time (2 classes total 4 hours), or multiple weeks of study (learning acrylics and oils). 2. Students can bring any works or famous paintings they like and learn to copy them in class. (Complete according to the size of the place where it will be hung in your home) 3. In order to understand the students' painting foundation and provide suitable learning materials, and prepare learning materials, free consultation will be provided on Sunday, May 18th at 4:30PM-7:PM and Friday, May 23rd at 10AM-3:PM. Class address: 11620 E. Starflower Dr. Chandler, AZ 85248. Contact number Tel: 480-332-1014 Painting class is guided by Mr. LIN. He is familiar with the comprehensive application of various painting techniques and materials, and is one of the best-selling painters in the Western United States. To learn about and view his work, visit the gallery at 15330 N. Hayden Road #101, Scottsdale, AZ 85260 Tel: 480-735-7282, and 1746 W. Ruby Drive #106, Tempe, AZ 85284, tel: 480.598.6786. http://user.qzone.qq.com/1847751091/main

654c907c4faf6a40c9204f0067f14a1eaa57d949.sourceText: 为迎接20l4年美国国庆，鳯凰城华人侨团联合总会将再次举办迎国庆John Yuan杯青少年儿童绘画比赛。本会热诚邀请各位家长和老师鼓励和指导学生积极参加这一活动。 夲次绘画比赛作品的主题是：我爱美国。作者可以围绕主题进行创作
654c907c4faf6a40c9204f0067f14a1eaa57d949.translatedText: To welcome the National Day of the United States in 2014, the Federation of Chinese Overseas Chinese League in Huangcheng will once again hold the John Yuan Cup Youth and Children's Painting Competition to celebrate the National Day. Our association sincerely invites parents and teachers to encourage and guide students to actively participate in this activity. The theme of the painting competition is: I love America. Authors can create around the theme

f31183ac65a5b18e3a4884de61431c42a973bbc0.sourceText: 参赛条件：凡居住在大鳯凰城地区，年龄在十七岁以下（含十七岁）的在校学生、独立绘画室的学员或个人均可参加。
f31183ac65a5b18e3a4884de61431c42a973bbc0.translatedText: Conditions of entry: School students, students in independent painting studios or individuals under the age of seventeen (inclusive) who live in the Daluohuang City area can participate.

f0ac242de1f6a85aa3f1f4dba6b0536c1e86d35c.sourceText: 参赛作品：绘画形式和风格不限。水墨、油彩、铅笔画均可。作品尺寸以40X60公分为宜。
f0ac242de1f6a85aa3f1f4dba6b0536c1e86d35c.translatedText: Entries: There is no limit on the form and style of painting. Ink, oil, and pencil drawings are acceptable. The appropriate size of the work is 40X60 cm.

71f7ead0840bdf167a344031e9f90c8457f98bb7.sourceText: 作品送审：绘画作品请于20l4年6月l日前送交我会（详细地址另行公告）。送审作品时请填写作品送审表，包括作者姓名、年龄，所在学校或画室名称和联系电话。
71f7ead0840bdf167a344031e9f90c8457f98bb7.translatedText: Submission of works for review: Paintings should be submitted to our association before June 1, 2014 (the detailed address will be announced separately). When submitting your work for review, please fill in the work submission form, including the author’s name, age, name of school or studio, and contact number.

54d3e4207a04ce84b5ca4ae9186dc9b5160e8dfd.sourceText: 评审与奨励：作品评选分为三个年龄组，六岁以下为儿童组；七至十一岁为少年组；十二至十七岁为青少年组。本㑹将聘请相关人士组成评审组评选出优胜作品三十份。每组三名优胜奨和七名荣誉奨。在今年庆祝国庆July4th的大会上展示和颁奨。优胜者由侨联颁发奨品和证书，并推荐给相关报刊杂志刊出或展出。
54d3e4207a04ce84b5ca4ae9186dc9b5160e8dfd.translatedText: >Judgement and Encouragement: The selection of works is divided into three age groups, the children group under six years old; the juvenile group between seven and eleven years old; and the youth group between twelve and seventeen years old. This company will hire relevant people to form a review team to select thirty winning works. There are three winners and seven honorees in each group. It will be displayed and awarded at this year's National Day July 4th conference. The winners will be awarded prizes and certificates by the Overseas Chinese Federation, and recommended to relevant newspapers and magazines for publication or exhibition.

f4560ebbf76dc18056f2e3f91c1129a3d33c281c.sourceText: 比赛结束后参赛作品退还作者，夲会保留一年的使用权。 如有问题，请Emal给凤凰城侨联副主席崔增祁 cuizq@hotmail.com 联系。
f4560ebbf76dc18056f2e3f91c1129a3d33c281c.translatedText: After the competition, the entries will be returned to the author, and the Association will retain the right to use them for one year. If you have any questions, please contact Emal Cuizqi, Vice Chairman of the Phoenix Overseas Chinese Federation at cuizq@hotmail.com.

111223ab5df1ff78d2d20e0e695532b37d1c7cba.sourceText: 鳯凰城侨联举办2014年迎国庆徴文活动
111223ab5df1ff78d2d20e0e695532b37d1c7cba.translatedText: >The Overseas Chinese Federation of Phoenix City holds a 2014 National Day celebration event

5fcde01132491584a39213f813a562c29af7e5bf.sourceText: 为迎接2014年美国国庆，鳯凰城华人侨团联合总会将举办2014年迎国庆徴文活动，欢迎社会各界人士和儿童、青少年积极参与投稿，共襄盛举。每个移居美国的华人，无论卓有成就或是平凡的生活，都有一个梦，有一个适应新环境创造新生活的历程。我们希望通过这次活动，记彔下更多华人华侨的奋斗亊蹟，也展现出新一代华人华侨在美国的梦想 。
5fcde01132491584a39213f813a562c29af7e5bf.translatedText: To welcome the 2014 National Day, the Phoenix Overseas Chinese Federation will hold a 2014 National Day celebration event. People from all walks of life, children and teenagers are welcome to actively participate in submissions and participate in the grand event. Every Chinese who immigrated to the United States, no matter whether they have great achievements or live an ordinary life, has a dream and a journey of adapting to a new environment and creating a new life. We hope that through this event, we will record the struggles of more overseas Chinese and also show the dreams of the new generation of overseas Chinese in the United States.

2678c933b433ae8524c014e02970c15645c25cbd.sourceText: 本次徴文的题目是：我的美国梦
2678c933b433ae8524c014e02970c15645c25cbd.translatedText: The title of this article is: My American Dream

de9b8aca3674d2ba9371b6725c00c6c37fb1264c.sourceText: 参加徴文活动的条件：凡居住在大鳯凰城地区的华裔居民均可参加，无年龄限制。
de9b8aca3674d2ba9371b6725c00c6c37fb1264c.translatedText: Conditions for participating in the article: All Chinese residents living in the Greater Phoenix area can participate, with no age limit.

263995712e6bb55249f2526fdfadb31b162d8b9e.sourceText: 徴文要求：徴文可用中文或英文撰写。青少年可以写自己对未来的梦想，成年人可以写出自己实现美国梦的奋斗历程和展望。要求文字生动、朴实。字数在一千字以内。
263995712e6bb55249f2526fdfadb31b162d8b9e.translatedText: >English writing requirements: The writing can be written in Chinese or English. Teenagers can write about their dreams for the future, and adults can write about their struggles and prospects for realizing the American dream. The text is required to be vivid and simple. The word count should be less than 1,000 words.

b36f05df78ce70773ad1f0dba06436960acf2562.sourceText: 徴文送交：即日起收集文章至2014年6月10日截稿。稿件 请用电子邮件发送到侨联网站迎国庆徴文小组 chineseunitedguoqing@gmail.com。并请填写作品送交表，内容包括作者姓名，住址，联系电话，Email和所在学校等。作者可以用笔名投稿。
b36f05df78ce70773ad1f0dba06436960acf2562.translatedText: Article submission: Articles will be collected from now on until June 10, 2014. Please send your manuscripts by email to the National Day celebration team of the Overseas Chinese Federation website chineseunitedguoqing@gmail.com. And please fill in the work submission form, including the author's name, address, contact number, email and school, etc. Authors may submit under pseudonyms.

f786bfeda8210a00efda8f9faefa9ffc0619dbb2.sourceText: 作品评审与奨励：收到作品将陆续在本地报刋或网站”迎国庆徴文”专栏刋登。本㑹将聘请相关人士组成评审组，分年龄段分类评选出优秀作品予以奖励，具体办法将根据来稿情况在评审前确定和公佈。
f786bfeda8210a00efda8f9faefa9ffc0619dbb2.translatedText: Work review and encouragement: The received works will be published in the local newspaper or website in the "National Day Articles" column. This 㑹 will hire relevant people to form a review team, and select outstanding works according to age groups and reward them. The specific method will be determined and announced before the review based on the submissions.

13c88288ad5ce024980ceb6b314cf398ed9fdb74.translatedText: Record of the Spring Picnic Activities of the Modern Chinese School of Alberta in 2014 Reported by Wu Jin of the Modern Chinese School of Alberta On April 19th, a teacher of the Modern Chinese School of Alberta, …

6d14095d3acd81b07c34a12142eba593eb395e04.sourceText: 亚省现代中文学校吴觐报道 四月十九日，亚省现代中文学校老师, 家长和同学们期待已久的一年一度野餐聚会活动在Desert Breeze 公园举行。这天天气非常完美，温度适中，蓝天飘着白云，阳光十分温和，微风习习轻吹。Desert Breeze是野餐活动非常理想的地点，公园占地宽大，树木草地郁郁葱葱，园内有个大湖，波光潋滟的湖面上，鸭子快乐地游来游去，中文学校为野餐包了公园临湖的四个大亭子。
6d14095d3acd81b07c34a12142eba593eb395e04.translatedText: Reported by Wu Jin of the Modern Chinese School of Alberta On April 19th, a teacher of the Modern Chinese School of Alberta, The long-awaited annual picnic party held by parents and classmates was held at Desert Breeze Park. The weather was perfect today, with moderate temperatures, blue skies with white clouds, mild sunshine, and a gentle breeze. Desert Breeze is an ideal place for picnics. The park occupies a large area with lush trees and grass. There is a large lake in the park. Ducks swim happily on the sparkling lake. The Chinese school has rented out four large pavilions in the park facing the lake for picnics.

dafc5d323a769f7559647cc62c28f2bd66bc9f8f.sourceText: 十二点一刻，American Express 的义工队伍来到公园，开始为小朋友们准备水球。水球的做法是把水压到气球里，看似很简单，但是水量的多少和压水的方式很有技巧，一开始，很多气球都爆了，每个义工都被水溅了一身。义工们继续尝试，终于掌握了技巧，做好了几百个五颜六色的水球。
dafc5d323a769f7559647cc62c28f2bd66bc9f8f.translatedText: At a quarter past twelve, the American Express volunteer team came to the park and started preparing water polo balls for the children. The method of water polo is to press water into balloons. It seems very simple, but the amount of water and the method of pressing water are very skillful. At the beginning, many balloons burst and every volunteer was splashed with water. The volunteers continued to try, and finally mastered the skills and made hundreds of colorful water balloons.

63af088c15298f1da5d76c637fab144b068e4adb.sourceText: 亭子旁边的草地上，学校为孩子们搭好了蹦蹦床和滑梯。小朋友们玩得很开心，在蹦床里面蹦上蹦下，或在滑梯上滑下来爬上去。感谢在旁边看管和维持次序的义工和家长们，整个活动中，虽然小朋友一直不停地玩乐，但没有任何事故发生。
63af088c15298f1da5d76c637fab144b068e4adb.translatedText: On the grass next to the pavilion, the school has set up a trampoline and slide for the children. The children had a lot of fun jumping up and down on the trampoline or sliding down and up the slide. Thanks to the volunteers and parents who watched and maintained order, no accidents occurred during the entire event, although the children kept having fun.

59f8cf72ca67f0bb5f63b8995a5dfac76878417c.sourceText: 十二点半左右，家长们带着学生陆路续续到达野餐地点。同时，校委会，董事会和义工们也在忙碌着搬运和摆置午餐。学校为聚会者准备了五百个三明治，一千瓶水和很多零食。学生会的义工还设好了爆米花的机器。十二点五十分，朱岩校长宣布野餐开始，大家马上井然有序地排队领餐，校委会，董事会成员和义工们则一一发放三明治，水和土豆片。学生会义工们也开动机器炸爆米花，每一杯只收取五十美分，获得的利润成为学生会的活动资金。家长和学生领好食品后， 就在亭子里面坐下来边吃边与周围的朋友们热烈，开心地聊天。学校提前卖出了四百张野餐券，当天来参加野餐聚会的人数将近五百人。
59f8cf72ca67f0bb5f63b8995a5dfac76878417c.translatedText: At around 12:30, parents and students arrived at the picnic spot one after another. At the same time, the school committee, board of directors and volunteers are also busy moving and setting up lunches. The school prepared 500 sandwiches, 1,000 bottles of water and lots of snacks for the partygoers. Volunteers from the Student Union also set up a popcorn machine. At 12:50, Principal Zhu Yan announced the start of the picnic, and everyone immediately lined up to receive the meal in an orderly manner. The school committee, board members and volunteers distributed sandwiches, water and potato chips one by one. The student union volunteers also operated the machine to pop popcorn, charging only fifty cents per cup, and the profits became funds for the student union's activities. After receiving the food, parents and students sat down in the pavilion to eat and chat happily with friends around them. The school sold 400 picnic tickets in advance, and nearly 500 people came to the picnic party that day.

f956bf88883243a31a1182f5652b796d7eae19f7.sourceText: 享用过午餐以后，董事会的Larry Song 和Jianjun Sun 带领大家进行拔河比赛。参加比赛的有兴致勃勃的孩子们， 也有童心未泯的大人。比赛中，参赛者都卯足了劲，全力以赴为自己的队伍得分，观看的人也都成为啦啦队员，为自己喜欢的队伍呐喊助阵。最后，Intel队以2比1胜American Express队, 校委会队以2比1胜董事会队，最有意思的是妈妈们组成的教师队以2比0战胜了爸爸们组成的家长队，学生队之间也进行了亲切友好的较量，各有胜负。第二个娱乐活动是玩水球，每个小朋友们都领到水球，有些小朋友互相扔水球嘻戏，有些则小心翼翼地捧着，象对待一件艺术品，不舍得弄破。另一个颇受大家喜爱的活动是画脸，Christine Chen 是大家公认的画画高手，她和李雪为爱美的孩子和大人画上各种各样图案，比如蝴蝶，蜜蜂，乌龟，小虫，小花， 小草， 等等，最受欢迎的是蝴蝶，很多人脸上和手上戴着蝴蝶，喜气洋洋地展示给大家看。这天下午，整个公园都回荡着中文学校野餐聚会大人和孩子们的欢声笑语。
f956bf88883243a31a1182f5652b796d7eae19f7.translatedText: After lunch, Larry Song and Jianjun Sun from the board of directors led everyone in a tug-of-war game. The competition was attended by enthusiastic children as well as adults who were still childlike at heart. During the game, the contestants worked hard and went all out to score points for their team, and the spectators also became cheerleaders, cheering for their favorite team. In the end, the Intel team defeated the American Express team 2-1, and the school committee team defeated the board team 2-1. The most interesting thing was that the teachers team composed of mothers defeated the parent team composed of fathers 2-0. The student teams also had a cordial and friendly competition, each with its own victory or defeat. The second entertainment activity was to play water polo. Every child received a water polo. Some children threw water polo to each other and had fun, while others held it carefully, like a piece of art, not willing to break it. Another popular activity is face painting. Christine Chen is recognized as a master of painting. She and Li Xue paint various patterns for children and adults who love beauty, such as butterflies, bees, turtles, bugs, flowers, grass, etc. The most popular one is the butterfly. Many people wear butterflies on their faces and hands and show them to everyone happily. This afternoon, the whole park echoed with the laughter of adults and children at the Chinese school picnic party.

31c79be7542ecb798044f6ca730426f197e104e2.sourceText: 下午三，四点左右，大家在依依不舍中告别，准备回家，并且对明年的野餐活动充满期待。感谢来参加聚会的所有人！
31c79be7542ecb798044f6ca730426f197e104e2.translatedText: At around three or four o'clock in the afternoon, everyone said goodbye reluctantly, preparing to go home, and looking forward to next year's picnic. Thanks to everyone who came to the party!

eb0bcf4fd4873bace02a846ae543cbaf28fca157.sourceText: 这次野餐活动的圆满举行离不开中文学校校委会和董事会成员的精心筹划和众多义工的积极参与。特别感谢他们的辛勤工作和奉献。
eb0bcf4fd4873bace02a846ae543cbaf28fca157.translatedText: The successful holding of this picnic would not have been possible without the careful planning of the Chinese school committee and board members and the active participation of many volunteers. Special thanks to them for their hard work and dedication.

cbd215b72ba75036601aa9e987d9336160c4b9e8.translatedText: The Filipino kidnappers who kidnapped a Chinese female tourist demanded a ransom of nearly 70 million

b4f34a580d6cd94e8bfeadec42f56bc166991264.translatedText: The Filipino kidnappers who kidnapped a Chinese female tourist demanded a ransom of nearly 70 million [Filipino kidnappers who kidnapped Chinese female tourists demanded a ransom of nearly 70 million] Malaysian Chinese media...

a59fb5729abf6970e5ad3c61c38ddf8cdd225c64.sourceText: 【马内政部长：已遣人与中间人谈判】马来邮报报道，大马内政部长阿末扎希今天透露，掳走中国女游客的菲武装分子已提出高达5亿比索（约合6961万人民币）的赎金要求。马方已派遣警方和谈判专家与绑匪的中间人谈判，以期减少赎金金额。绑匪未对同时被掳的菲律宾籍酒店工作人员提出赎金要求。
a59fb5729abf6970e5ad3c61c38ddf8cdd225c64.translatedText: [Malaysian Interior Minister: People have been sent to negotiate with intermediaries] The Malay Mail reported that Malaysian Interior Minister Ahmad Zahid Hamidi revealed today that the Filipino militants who kidnapped the Chinese female tourists have asked for a ransom of up to 500 million pesos (approximately 69.61 million yuan). The Malaysian side has sent police and negotiators to negotiate with the kidnappers' middlemen in order to reduce the ransom amount. The kidnappers did not demand ransom for the Filipino hotel staff who was also kidnapped.

cf776546fb6ad0aac7c802a146651bee54dd038c.sourceText: 当地时间4月2日晚十点半左右，马来西亚沙巴州仙本那一酒店发生人质劫持事件，1名上海女游客和1名菲律宾籍酒店女员工被一伙持枪武装人员带走。外交部要求当地警方在确保中国公民安全的前提下全力开展营救，采取有效措施保障中国在当地游客的安全，外交部将继续密切跟踪事件进展，指导驻古晋总领馆做好相关工作。
cf776546fb6ad0aac7c802a146651bee54dd038c.translatedText: At about 10:30 pm local time on April 2, a hostage-taking incident occurred at a hotel in Semporna, Sabah, Malaysia. A Shanghai female tourist and a Filipino female hotel employee were taken away by a group of armed men. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs requires the local police to carry out rescue operations with all their strength while ensuring the safety of Chinese citizens, and take effective measures to ensure the safety of Chinese tourists in the area. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs will continue to closely follow the progress of the incident and guide the Consulate General in Kuching to do relevant work.

9f8c0b5702db17d33c56bc3eb3cd2240f67d62a1.sourceText: By Barry Wong, Esq. Over 300 guests feasted on a traditional multi-course Chinese dinner celebrating the Chinese Chamber of Commerce of Arizona’s 75th anniversary at its annual Spring Banquet. This special evening at the Great Wall Restaurant in Phoenix on April 5, 2014 commemorated the Chinese Chamber’s founding by an enterprising group of Chinese immigrants and at the same time acknowledged the successes of their descendants. Marty Manning, the evening’s master of ceremony and 99.9 KEZ radio personality, led the program like a symphonic conductor. Preceding the formal program, guests enjoyed each other’s company and bidding on silent auction items which included a group dinner at The Capital Grille, jewelry from Burland Jewelry Center, a group wine tasting at Total Wine, stays at Arizona Biltmore Resort & Spa and Tempe Mission Palms and a Mane Attraction Salon package. Another 75 Years. ”Our founders had the foresight to start an organization to address issues critical to the business of its grocery store and restaurant owner members,” said Bernard Wu, president of the Chinese Chamber. ”We celebrate their legacy and the leadership of the many past officers and board members who built and sustained the Chinese Chamber; today and for another 75 years the mission continues-advancing Chinese-American businesses.” Dignitaries at this yearly see-and-be-seen event included State Senator Kimberly Yee, Arizona Republican Party Chairman Robert Graham, Phoenix Mayor Greg Stanton and Phoenix First Lady Nicole, Maricopa County Sheriff Joe Arpaio and his wife Ava, Scottsdale Mayor Jim Lane and his wife Joanne, Maricopa County Attorney Bill Montgomery and his wife Becky and candidates for governor: Secretary of State Ken Bennett and Mesa Mayor Scott Smith; also, from the bench Phoenix Chief Presiding Judge Roxanne Song Ong and Paradise Valley Judge Larry King. Chamber History. Rosalind Ong Onodera, daughter of the late Wing F. Ong-a founding member of the Chinese Chamber and former Arizona state senator, talked about the history of the Chinese Chamber. It was founded in 1939 by Ernest Yee Wing Dong, Henry Gong, Ong Hung Yen, Harry Yen, Henry Ong, Sr., George J. Q. Ong and Wing F. Ong. Among the anecdotes she shared was the chamber’s successful opposition to legislation proposed at the request of incumbent and dominant Caucasian-owned grocery stores that would have forced all stores to close on July 4th Independence Day; she said Chinese-American grocers’decision to open every day of the week including during holidays, when Caucasian-owned grocers would close, had enough of a financial impact on its dominant competitors to compel them to attempt to change the laws on when retailer stores may open for business. A video history of the Chinese Chamber, produced by Youmiao Schilt, was played showing a collage of photographs from the early grocers and restaurants including Sing Yee’s American Kitchen?the first Chinese restaurant in Arizona, Chinese Chamber board member Eddie Yue’s father, Frank Yue, on horseback in front of his grocery-gas station, Frank抯 Cut Rate Store, and former legislator Barry Wong’s grandfather, N.K. Wong, in front of his W and W Market to Dr. Pearl Tang and the late federal Judge Thomas Tang, 9th Circuit Court of Appeals, at a Chinese Chamber dinner honoring then-Arizona Governor Raul Castro to modern-day Chinese Chamber ”Doing Business in China” forum at Thunderbird School of Global Management with Ambassador Barbara Barrett. The video provided a tasteful and respectful historical overview of the Chinese as entrepreneurs and leaders in our community. Leaders Celebrating. Community and business leaders helping to celebrate the anniversary were numerous and included community elder John M. Yee; Desert Jade Women抯 Club President Brenda Fung; Asian American Association of Arizona President Maribel Dillard; Phoenix Suns legendary player Alvin Adams; Chinese United Association of Greater Phoenix President David Yee; Arizona Asian American Bar Association Board Member Amanda Chua; United Chinese Association of Arizona President Kevin Wang; Chinese Week President Eva Li; Chinese Restaurant Association of Arizona Vice President Donald Mui and Phoenix Chinese American Citizens Alliance President Elaine Wong. Also, Jesus Borboa, APS Supplier Diversity Program Manager; Southwest Gas’Garry Walters; Ramon Martinez, Casino Arizona Director of Public Relations; and representatives from Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Arizona, Phoenix Aviation and A. L. Moore-Dignity. Scholarships. In addition to the anniversary celebration the Chinese Chamber presented its annual scholarships to deserving high achieving high school students embarking on university studies. Chamber officers Beverly Ong and Wesley Ong led the presentation of Certificates of Scholarship Award and funds to the following recipients: Philip Haslim, Northwest Christian School, parents: Andreas and Hue Haslim; Dustin Ma, Corona del Sol High School, parents: Lam and Evelyn Ma; Lindsay Wong, Desert Mountain High School, parents: Howard and Charlene Wong. With these students, the future is bright. The evening would not be complete without a Chinese cultural performance. Guests were entertained by the internationally acclaimed ”Changing Faces”with origins in Chengdu, China performed by Phoenix-based Zhigang Chen. His instantaneous change of face masks enthralled the audience; each mask depicted a noted figure in Chinese history. The evening was full of energy and a success by all measures!

0bf1a90d6f5e69f012884861937a6617e3381f9a.sourceText: ASU 举办“科技在中国国际关系中的角色演变”为期两天的学术盛会
0bf1a90d6f5e69f012884861937a6617e3381f9a.translatedText: ASU holds a two-day academic event on "The Evolving Role of Science and Technology in China's International Relations"

098d57449779aeb33b17155c71c54e170b74d53d.sourceText: ASU 举办“科技在中国国际关系中的角色演变”为期两天的学术盛会 首届名为”科技在中国国际关系…
098d57449779aeb33b17155c71c54e170b74d53d.translatedText: ASU holds a two-day academic event on "The Evolving Role of Science and Technology in China's International Relations" The first conference titled "The Evolution of the Role of Science and Technology in China's International Relations...

42aa728c79826a27a2fbe50bbd4f476dda2a89c9.sourceText: 首届名为”科技在中国国际关系中的角色演变”大会将于4月3日和4月4日在亚利桑那州立大学坦佩校区隆重举行。希望能从多角度对中国对外科技合作深度了解，在发展全球合作的过程中，了解重点科技领域在内部发挥的积极作用。
42aa728c79826a27a2fbe50bbd4f476dda2a89c9.translatedText: " The first conference titled "The Evolution of the Role of Science and Technology in China's International Relations" will be held grandly on April 3 and April 4 at the Tempe campus of Arizona State University. We hope to gain an in-depth understanding of China's foreign science and technology cooperation from multiple perspectives. , in the process of developing global cooperation, understand the active role that key science and technology fields play internally.

aead65b266ba87bd80e9916b59c595d592f1b58b.sourceText: 亚利桑那州立大学国际战略办公室副教务长说：”除了参与美国的科技领域的双边关系，中国还分享与其他国家类似的合作。” ”这次会议，我们希望得到一个全面的看法和解释，这些关系是如何影响中国科技发展；在未来几年内，中国是如何塑造国际化的研发体系。”
aead65b266ba87bd80e9916b59c595d592f1b58b.translatedText: Vice Provost of the Office of International Strategy at Arizona State University said: "In addition to participating in bilateral relations in the field of science and technology with the United States, China also shares similar cooperation with other countries. "In this meeting, we hope to get a comprehensive view and explanation of how these relationships affect China's scientific and technological development; how China will shape its international R&D system in the next few years." "

c0bb508b091b6b4af0e03981000bb4a8398367c5.sourceText: 与中国的合作将成为ASU一个典范，形成更有意义的合作关系，专注于研发，例如学生培训。目前ASU有2500个中国本科和研究生。除了推出加速国际学位课程，ASU与四川大学还有一个合作中心，传播美国文化。ASU的孔子学院同时也积极发展中国语言教育和文化传播。中国的焦点不再是廉价的劳动力，而是日益上升的中国脑力劳动者的力量。一些人提到中国”威胁论”，而国际地位不断上升的中国，反而美国提供了更多战略机遇，形成了重要的合作伙伴关系。
c0bb508b091b6b4af0e03981000bb4a8398367c5.translatedText: Cooperation with China will serve as a model for ASU to form more meaningful partnerships focused on research and development, such as student training. Currently, ASU has 2,500 Chinese undergraduate and graduate students. In addition to launching accelerated international degree programs, ASU has partnered with Sichuan The university also has a cooperation center to spread American culture. The Confucius Institute at ASU is also actively developing Chinese language education and cultural dissemination. The focus of China is no longer on cheap labor, but on the rising power of Chinese intellectual workers, and its international status. As China continues to rise, the United States has provided more strategic opportunities and formed important partnerships.

5823d0ae5ba9b7e2bf25eaf9cc2fce24b0adfd55.sourceText: 为期两天的会议将邀请到来自中国科技部，中国科学院院，清华大学，加州大学，俄勒冈大学，密西根大学等知名大学的专家学者。关注中国科技发展的，来自日本，俄罗斯，澳大利亚的研究者，也将共襄盛举。
5823d0ae5ba9b7e2bf25eaf9cc2fce24b0adfd55.translatedText: The two-day conference will invite well-known experts from the Chinese Ministry of Science and Technology, the Chinese Academy of Sciences, Tsinghua University, the University of California, the University of Oregon, and the University of Michigan. Experts and scholars from universities and researchers from Japan, Russia, and Australia who are concerned about China's science and technology development will also participate in the event.

0c960a46db9dc20de79a67567ef5140581764f15.sourceText: 本次活动不对外开放，欢迎媒体报名参与。这是首个在海外举行的中国科技关系的盛会。
0c960a46db9dc20de79a67567ef5140581764f15.translatedText: This event is not open to the public. This is the first event on China's science and technology relations held overseas.

eca6f51d782934b704807b24ad240e8fb43ba082.sourceText: ASU隆重举办关注中国的学术会议：科技在中国国际关系中扮演的角色
eca6f51d782934b704807b24ad240e8fb43ba082.translatedText: ASU grandly holds an academic conference focusing on China: The role of science and technology in China’s international relations
