4ec5d9c2a500250402a13746b89808c3e63ba1f3.translatedText: ASU grandly holds an academic conference focusing on China: The role of science and technology in China’s international relations – China Overseas…

edf0f41f9cb06a93dc4414586c3a096117b83c62.sourceText: –中国海外新形象的转变 劳动密集型-科技密集型 2014年4月3日-4日”科技在中国国际关系中扮演的角色”大会在亚利桑那州立大学（Arizona State Uinversity）隆重举行。为期两天的会议，由来自中国，美国，俄罗斯，澳大利亚，日本等国家的40来位学者，政府工作人员组成。中国的科技发展，改变了世界对中国的看法：中国不再是廉价劳动力输出的大国，在短短十年的发展，它已经成为了高科技劳动密集型国家，科技合作为中国国际关系的建立起到了相当重要的作用。
edf0f41f9cb06a93dc4414586c3a096117b83c62.translatedText: – The transformation of China Overseas’ new image Labor-intensive-technology-intensive From April 3 to 4, 2014, the conference "The Role of Science and Technology in China's International Relations" was held grandly at Arizona State University. The two-day conference consisted of more than 40 scholars and government staff from China, the United States, Russia, Australia, Japan and other countries. China's scientific and technological development has changed the world's view of China: China is no longer a big country exporting cheap labor. In just ten years of development, it has become a high-tech, labor-intensive country. Scientific and technological cooperation has played a very important role in the establishment of China's international relations.

fff3e0a1adf68d84dabed533a1ecf95899db7aac.sourceText: ASU副校长丹尼斯 西蒙博士

be6bf55f3ebc05b716deca2e9941b43940214190.sourceText: 会议现场 本次会议的主要负责人ASU副校长丹尼斯 西蒙博士说，三十年前他开始研究中国，当时他的老师，朋友，家人都觉得他是个不务正业，无所事事的人。三十年后他成为了美国炙手可热的人物。微软，英特尔各大知名国际企业都聘用他为中国问题顾问。中国政府也聘用他，为大学评估的评审专家，大量的中美合作都经他手促成。然而这一切在他眼里，都才只是刚刚开始。他用一系列的数据阐述了变化：2006到2010年中国在运用科技研究方面的突飞猛进进展；2006-2010高校合作成为科技合作中发展最快的合作形式之一；1996世界高科技领域中国所占的份额大大低于美国，欧盟，日本，到2006年中国追平美国并列第一。丹尼斯教授说中国科学和技术的发展将给世界带来新的机遇，没有抓住和中国的发展，就没有抓住世界的脉搏。 参加会议的来自中国科学院的Sun Fuquan教授介绍了中国国际科技关系的概况，中国科技交换中心的Wang Zhongcheng把中国国际合作系统从中央到地方的组织架构也做了详细介绍。让人们兴奋的点总是和人才有关系，中国与全球化智库主任王辉耀教授介绍了最近几年的”海归潮”，展示了中国政府以及地方为海外归国人员提供的优越待遇和创业机会。这些人员的回归为国际合作提供更多高品质的人力资源。这也是中国从廉价劳动密集型人力资源向科技密集型人力资源转化的重要标志。 精彩总是在碰撞中产生的,到提问环节，密西根大学范蓓蕾教授提出，讲座内容大多是政策性的从上至下分析角度，然而科技合作更多是从下至上的。很多一线企业希望了解在科技合作中具体遇到的问题。她举例华为在硅谷建立了科研机构，他们利用硅谷的人力资源，吸引到了世界顶尖的科技人员，为他们提供了相对稳定的工作和生活环境，他们不用到中国，就能为中国企业工作。这就是一种典型的企业的科技合作，利用海外资源为中国企业服务。那么美国企业也很渴望走进中国，获得更多的市场。当提到海归，对于高质量的人力资源，那些不是海归的海外华人是不是也可以为中国的国际合作做出贡献？那些以海外专家身份参加国际合作的人员怎样得到合理的报酬等，很多新锐而且实际的问题，让大家看到了本次会议的重要意义。 这次会议的首次在亚利桑那州立大学举办体现了海外对中国科技，中国国际关系的关注。副校长丹尼斯表示在未来几年内，中国留学生会占ASU留学生总数的1/3。ASU已经与国内二十多所211工程的大学已经建立合作关系。他们有的提供”3+2”国际学历（在中国大学学习三年，在ASU学习两年，获得两个大学的文聘），有的学校除了传统的互派学生到学校进行学习外，还鼓励教授带课题组到中国和美国做研究。ASU已经在四川大学建立了美国文化中心，致力于将美国文化系统地在中国推广。ASU孔子学院已经在亚利桑那州建立了一个系统的中文学习体系，并大力推动中国文化在美国的传播。 企业，学校的在科技方面的合作就是国际关系建立的重要组成部分。抓住科技合作的良机，达到双赢，是共建良好国际关系的大势所趋。
be6bf55f3ebc05b716deca2e9941b43940214190.translatedText: Meeting site ASU Vice President Dr. Dennis Simon, the main person in charge of this meeting, said that when he started studying China thirty years ago, his teachers, friends, and family members all thought that he was a person who was not doing his job properly and had nothing to do. Thirty years later he was a popular figure in America. Microsoft, Intel, and other well-known international companies have hired him as a consultant on China issues. The Chinese government also hired him as an expert in university evaluation, and he has facilitated a large number of Sino-US cooperation. However, in his eyes, all this was just the beginning. He used a series of data to illustrate the changes: from 2006 to 2010, China made rapid progress in applied science and technology research; from 2006 to 2010, university cooperation became one of the fastest growing forms of cooperation in science and technology; in 1996, China's share of the world's high-tech fields was much lower than that of the United States, the European Union, and Japan. By 2006, China tied the United States and tied for first place. Professor Dennis said that the development of China's science and technology will bring new opportunities to the world. If we fail to seize China's development, we will fail to grasp the pulse of the world. Professor Sun Fuquan from the Chinese Academy of Sciences who participated in the meeting introduced the overview of China's international science and technology relations. Wang Zhongcheng from the China Science and Technology Exchange Center also gave a detailed introduction to the organizational structure of China's international cooperation system from the central to the local levels. What excites people is always related to talent. Professor Wang Huiyao, director of the China and Globalization Think Tank, introduced the "wave of overseas returnees" in recent years, demonstrating the superior treatment and entrepreneurial opportunities provided by the Chinese government and local governments to overseas returnees. The return of these personnel will provide more high-quality human resources for international cooperation. This is also an important symbol of China's transformation from cheap labor-intensive human resources to technology-intensive human resources. Wonderful things are always produced in collisions. During the question-and-answer session, Professor Beilei Fan of the University of Michigan pointed out that most of the lecture contents were from a policy-related top-down analysis perspective, but scientific and technological cooperation was more from a bottom-up perspective. Many front-line companies want to know the specific problems encountered in scientific and technological cooperation. She gave the example of Huawei establishing a scientific research institution in Silicon Valley. They use the human resources of Silicon Valley to attract the world's top scientific and technological personnel and provide them with a relatively stable working and living environment. They can work for Chinese companies without going to China. This is a typical technological cooperation between enterprises, using overseas resources to serve Chinese enterprises. Then American companies are also eager to enter China and gain more markets. When it comes to returnees, in terms of high-quality human resources, can overseas Chinese who are not returnees also contribute to China's international cooperation? How can those who participate in international cooperation as overseas experts receive reasonable remuneration? Many cutting-edge and practical issues have made everyone see the importance of this meeting. The fact that this conference was held at Arizona State University for the first time reflects overseas attention to Chinese science and technology and China's international relations. Vice President Dennis said that in the next few years, Chinese students will account for 1/3 of the total number of international students at ASU. ASU has established cooperative relationships with more than 20 universities in the 211 Project in China. Some of them offer "3+2" international academic qualifications (three years of study at a Chinese university, two years of study at ASU, and employment from both universities). Some schools, in addition to the traditional exchange of students to study at the school, also encourage professors to lead research groups to China and the United States for research. ASU has established an American Cultural Center at Sichuan University and is committed to systematically promoting American culture in China. The ASU Confucius Institute has established a systematic Chinese learning system in Arizona and vigorously promotes the spread of Chinese culture in the United States. Cooperation between enterprises and schools in science and technology is an important part of the establishment of international relations. Seizing the good opportunity of scientific and technological cooperation and achieving win-win situation is the general trend of jointly building good international relations.

cdbf0a1d5cd013e715685b7ece412a2fd1e80962.translatedText: The 75th anniversary of the establishment of the Arizona Chinese Chamber of Commerce in 2014 and the 2014 Spring Banquet were grandly held on April 5th at Luk Fook Restaurant. Nearly 400 guests from Arizona's political and business circles attended the event. Secretary of State Ken Bennett, Chinese-American State Senator Kimberly Yee, Scottsdale Mayor Jim Lane, former Chinese-American Representative Huang Shijun, senior overseas Chinese leader Yu Wenjin, Chinese-American Justice Zhou Yading, etc. all attended the banquet.

e91d52e4165d674b8b6b686760988c792ce04a94.translatedText: Chairman of the Chinese Chamber of Commerce Wu Zhaowen

dedf0e5459a0974a7623170ee85b4a596a679a8d.sourceText: 中华商会主席伍兆文为晚宴致欢迎辞，并回顾了2013商会举办的活动，例如受大家欢迎的移民讲座，网络市场，社交媒 体带来的新市场。 今年是中华商会成立第75周年。一个介绍华人小企业主在亚利桑那成长的影片成为了活动的亮点。这个影片是由商会自己制作的。 在华人小经济发展繁荣1930左右，大约有60家零售店是属于华人。零售店，餐馆，洗衣店是华裔家庭的主业。华人因聪明，勤奋，努力在个商业圈内占有一席之地。中华商会也是在那个时候创办的。由Henry Ong,Sr., Wing F. Ong, Ong Huang Yen, Ernest Yee, Wing Dong, Harry Yen, Henry Gong and George J.Q.Ong组成，并发展至今。当年一些法令要关闭所有的中国零售店。商会四处游说立法院，最终赢得胜利，让华人小企业保留下来。因此中华商会在亚利桑那成为非常重要的组织。同时，这个片子也是代代华人移民在亚利桑那奋斗的缩影。
dedf0e5459a0974a7623170ee85b4a596a679a8d.translatedText: Chairman of the Chinese Chamber of Commerce Wu Zhaowen delivered a welcome speech for the dinner and reviewed the activities organized by the Chamber of Commerce in 2013, such as the popular immigration lectures, online markets, and new markets brought about by social media. This year is the 75th anniversary of the establishment of the Chinese Chamber of Commerce. A video introducing Chinese small business owners growing up in Arizona became the highlight of the event. This video was produced by the Chamber of Commerce itself. Around 1930, when the Chinese small economy developed and prospered, there were about 60 retail stores owned by Chinese. Retail stores, restaurants, and laundries are the main businesses of Chinese families. Chinese people have a place in the business circle because of their intelligence, hard work and hard work. The Chinese Chamber of Commerce was also founded at that time. It is composed of Henry Ong, Sr., Wing F. Ong, Ong Huang Yen, Ernest Yee, Wing Dong, Harry Yen, Henry Gong and George J.Q.Ong, and has developed to this day. At that time, some laws were required to close all Chinese retail stores. The Chamber of Commerce lobbied the Legislative Yuan and eventually won, allowing Chinese small businesses to remain. Therefore, the Chinese Chamber of Commerce has become a very important organization in Arizona. At the same time, this film is also a microcosm of the struggle of generations of Chinese immigrants in Arizona.

80cb817ffa040de434b10dd95b91e181dd4f00f6.sourceText: 如今亚利桑那中华商会仍然秉承着为华人小企业提供资源，知识，服务的宗旨。在春宴上商会为三位小企业主的孩子准备了奖学金，他们分别是Philip Haslim. Dustin Ma. Lindsay Wong.各个赞助商也为活动提供了大大的支持。电视机，IPAD以及礼品券给来宾带来的新年的问候。希望在新的一年里，企业主们互相支持，开拓商机，共同成长。
80cb817ffa040de434b10dd95b91e181dd4f00f6.translatedText: Today, the Arizona Chinese Chamber of Commerce still adheres to the purpose of providing resources, knowledge, and services to Chinese small businesses. At the spring banquet, the Chamber of Commerce prepared scholarships for the children of three small business owners, namely Philip Haslim, Dustin Ma, and Lindsay Wong. Various sponsors also provided great support for the event. TV sets, IPADs and gift certificates brought New Year greetings to the guests. I hope that in the new year, business owners will support each other, explore business opportunities, and grow together.

f91019bb3abf3f5aa21f79466eac8097c9d0f339.translatedText: The first Arizona 2014 Golden Autumn "Chinese Dance Art Festival" hosted by New Oriental Art School will be held on September 14 this year, on the eve of the Mid-Autumn Festival, the traditional Chinese festival, at the CHANDLER Art Center Theater. This art festival will be the first art festival with the theme of Chinese dance in Arizona. It is held every year in the golden autumn and mainly focuses on Chinese dance performances, accompanied by music, art and other art forms to showcase the charm of Chinese dance. The Chinese Dance Festival will allow our children to directly contact and learn Chinese culture through Chinese dance; it will also give Americans more opportunities to understand the profound Chinese civilization. The chairman of the Overseas Chinese Federation is Yu Wenze.

ea2000e127b103aad0248c1702d2de464afd4e69.sourceText: 侨联总会目前由有十八个侨团组成，分别是邓心平退伍军人会、科工专协会、凤凰城同源会、华美专业协会、中华商会、亚省中餐馆会、沙漠玉妇女会、鳯凰城龙冈公所、邓高密公所、海外华人妇女会、华人耆英会、华人福利会、荣光会、台湾同乡联谊会、黄氏宗亲会、余风采堂、英端工商会，中国週委员会。侨联总会每年年初举行侨团大会，以每个团体委派两位代表参加投票，共同推选出新一年度的主席和其它董事局的成员。上届主席张华芳工作成效卓越，她在发言中对过去两年的工作进行了总结，感谢大家所作出的努力。大家以热烈掌声对她的工作表示肯定和赞许。
ea2000e127b103aad0248c1702d2de464afd4e69.translatedText: >The Overseas Chinese Federation currently consists of eighteen overseas Chinese groups, including the Deng Xinping Veterans Association, the Association of Science and Engineering Professionals, the Phoenix Homology Association, the Chinese American Professional Association, the Chinese Chamber of Commerce, and the Alberta Chinese Restaurant Association. Desert Jade Women's Association, Huangcheng Longgang Office, Deng Gaomi Office, Overseas Chinese Women's Association, Chinese Elders Association, Chinese Welfare Association, Rongguang Association, Taiwan Fellowship Association, Huang Clan Association, Yu Fengcaitang, Yingduan Chamber of Commerce and Industry, and China Weekly Committee. The Overseas Chinese Federation holds a general meeting of overseas Chinese groups at the beginning of each year. Each group appoints two representatives to participate in the voting and jointly elect the chairman and other board members for the new year. The previous president, Zhang Huafang, had outstanding work results. In her speech, she summarized the work of the past two years and thanked everyone for their efforts. Everyone expressed their affirmation and praise for her work with warm applause.

This year, a total of 75 dragon boat teams from all over the United States participated, and nearly 2,000 players showed off their skills in the two-day race. The rippling blue water of the lake rose one after another at the climax of the competition, and thousands of people shouted for cheers.

The 2014 Overseas Chinese Entrepreneurship and Development Conference (referred to as the 14th China Entrepreneurship Conference), co-sponsored by the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the State Council and the Hubei Provincial People's Government and Wuhan Municipal People's Government, is scheduled to be held in Wuhan, Hubei from June 23 to 25, 2014. The Xiangyang branch event will be held from June 26th to 27th. The China Entrepreneurship Association has been held in Wuhan, Hubei for 13 consecutive times on a regular basis and has achieved good results and is welcomed by overseas Chinese. For meeting details and a list of cooperation projects, please visit the website of China Entrepreneurship Association: www.hch.org.cn.

2af6ffbf1a9ea5e924cc277c21e4f9039e7ebefa.sourceText: 全美新屋销售1月份大增至46.88万栋 创五年半新高 商务部 周三 公布报告称，1月全美新屋销售量为46.8万栋，出人意料地大幅增长，创下五年多以来的最高水平。 根据商务部的数据，1月新屋销售总数年化46.8万户，创2008年7月以来的新高，远超市场预期的40.1万户，与预期之差创13个月来最大。其中，遭受暴风雪袭击的东北部地区新屋销售年化3.3万户，环比暴增73%，创去年6月来最大。遭遇雨雪的南部地区新屋销售量也增加10.4%，也是近5年来的新高。另外，西部销量新增11%，但中西部下降17.2%。新屋销售中位价格为26.01万元,环比下跌2.2%，跌至去年8月来最低.但同比上涨3.4%，房价上涨动能明显减弱。与此同时，1月全美新屋供应量则下降至4.7个月，低于去年12月的5.2个月。报告公布后，10年期国债收益率下降1个基点至2.69%，三大股指小幅上涨。 另外，周二公布的史坦普／凯斯-席勒房价指数显示，全美20大城市去年12月房价较一年前上涨13.4%，但增幅不如11月的13.7%，是去年6月来首次减速，并有继续减缓的趋势，显示房贷利率上扬与酷寒的冬季压低了过去几个月来的房市买气。其中以迈阿密上涨1.2%最多，其次为底特律与旧金山的1.1%；克利夫兰是唯一房价下跌的城市，纽约上涨0.6%。 更多地产新闻请咨询金信地产 Tinna 电话 480-287-0180 E-mail： goldtrustrealty2010@ gmail.com
2af6ffbf1a9ea5e924cc277c21e4f9039e7ebefa.translatedText: New home sales across the United States surged to 468,800 in January, a five-and-a-half-year high. The Department of Commerce reported on Wednesday that new home sales across the United States in January were 468,000, an unexpected surge and the highest level in more than five years. According to data from the Ministry of Commerce, the total number of new home sales in January reached an annualized rate of 468,000 units, a new high since July 2008, far exceeding market expectations of 401,000 units, and the difference from expectations was the largest in 13 months. Among them, the annual sales of new homes in the Northeast, which was hit by the blizzard, was 33,000, a 73% month-on-month increase, the largest since June last year. New home sales in the southern region, which suffered from rain and snow, also increased by 10.4%, which was also a new high in the past five years. In addition, sales in the western region increased by 11%, but sales in the central and western regions decreased by 17.2%. The median sales price of new homes was 260,100 yuan, down 2.2% month-on-month to the lowest since August last year. However, it rose 3.4% year-on-year, and the momentum for rising house prices has significantly weakened. At the same time, the supply of new homes nationwide fell to 4.7 months in January, down from 5.2 months in December. After the report was released, the 10-year government bond yield fell 1 basis point to 2.69%, and the three major stock indexes rose slightly. In addition, the S&P/Case-Shiller House Price Index released on Tuesday showed that house prices in the 20 largest cities in the United States rose by 13.4% in December last year compared with a year ago, but the growth rate was not as good as the 13.7% increase in November. It was the first deceleration since June last year, and has continued to slow down, indicating that rising mortgage interest rates and the harsh winter have depressed housing market buying sentiment in the past few months. Among them, Miami had the largest increase of 1.2%, followed by Detroit and San Francisco with 1.1%; Cleveland was the only city where house prices fell, and New York increased by 0.6%. 3e3f3d2943282096325417f7c8bfc0d52e5bbc6f.sourceText: 伊斯梅尔同时表示：”虽然我们有专业的警察和军队正在进行搜救，但这些渔民海上经验丰富，十分了解海情。每艘渔船平均载员10人，所以共计1.7万到2万名渔民将会加入到搜救行动之中。”
3e3f3d2943282096325417f7c8bfc0d52e5bbc6f.translatedText: Ismail also said: "Although we have professional police and military personnel conducting search and rescue operations, these fishermen have rich experience at sea and know the sea conditions very well. Each fishing boat carries an average of 10 people, so a total of 17,000 to 20,000 fishermen will join the search and rescue operation."

As of 1:00 on March 2, the violence had killed 28 people and injured 113 people. Public security officers killed 5 thugs on the spot, and the remaining thugs are still being rounded up

193f48d609ac1f420df19dcc404c06b2333522cc.sourceText: 案件发生后，中共中央总书记、国家主席、中央军委主席习近平高度重视，立即作出重要指示，要求政法机关迅速组织力量全力侦破案件，依法从严惩处暴恐分子，坚决将其嚣张气焰打下去。要精心做好受伤和遇难群众的救治、善后工作。要深刻认识反恐形势的严峻性复杂性，强化底线思维，以坚决态度、有力措施，严厉打击各种暴力恐怖犯罪活动，全力维护社会稳定，保障人民群众生命财产安全。并指派中共中央政治局委员、中央政法委书记孟建柱，国务委员、公安部部长郭声琨和有关部门同志连夜赶赴云南指导处置工作，看望受伤群众和遇难人员亲属。
193f48d609ac1f420df19dcc404c06b2333522cc.translatedText: After the incident, Xi Jinping, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, President of the State, and Chairman of the Central Military Commission, attached great importance to it and immediately issued important instructions, requiring the political and legal authorities to quickly organize forces to fully investigate the case, severely punish violent terrorists in accordance with the law, and resolutely put down their arrogance. It is necessary to carefully carry out the treatment and aftermath of the injured and victims. We must deeply understand the seriousness and complexity of the anti-terrorism situation, strengthen bottom-line thinking, use a firm attitude and effective measures to severely crack down on various violent terrorist criminal activities, and make every effort to maintain social stability and ensure the safety of people's lives and property. Meng Jianzhu, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and secretary of the Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission, Guo Shengkun, State Councilor and Minister of Public Security, and comrades from relevant departments were assigned to rush to Yunnan overnight to guide the disposal work and visit the injured people and relatives of the victims.

24e88307f9141644c68fbdcbc0d9573506d1485a.sourceText: 中共中央政治局常委、国务院总理李克强对处置工作作出批示，要求抓紧追捕和坚决严惩暴徒，各地公安机关要加强治安防控措施，做好人群密集的公共场所防范工作。
24e88307f9141644c68fbdcbc0d9573506d1485a.translatedText: > Li Keqiang, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Premier of the State Council, issued instructions on the handling of the incident, calling for the rioters to be hunted down and punished resolutely. Public security agencies in various places must strengthen public security prevention and control measures and do a good job in preventing crowds in public places.

3043225c63a7c0ae84f560713d139835788d4a0e.sourceText: 云南省委、省政府有关负责同志迅速赶赴现场组织指挥处置工作。目前，受伤群众救治、案件侦破等工作正抓紧进行中。
3043225c63a7c0ae84f560713d139835788d4a0e.translatedText: Relevant responsible comrades from the Yunnan Provincial Party Committee and Provincial Government rushed to the scene to organize, direct and handle the work. At present, the treatment of injured people and the investigation of cases are in progress.

bc42441130adf4e8b8c8e6aaf57d7dae9d3f9a82.sourceText: 裘援平访波士顿：建和谐侨社 “绿卡”政策利侨胞 据 美国中文电视驻波士顿记者严涵报道，当地时间2月17日，中国国务院侨务办公室主任裘援平一行在中国驻纽约总领馆总领事孙国祥大使的陪同下,继续走访波士顿侨社。裘援平参观了在麻州的剑桥文化中心，并与各界代表进行座谈会。座谈会中，裘援平表示，国侨办将会继续努力为侨民服务，并强调团结侨民以及华文教育的重要性。 裘援平在座谈会中，首先介绍了近些年来中国的发展状况，她说，今年是中国全面深化改革之年，目的是为了解决35年来中国的快速发展所带来的问题，比如环境污染、雾霾等；同时要加快城镇化建设。在国际关系方面，裘援平表示近期个别挑起争议的国家并不会对中国造成影响。 随后，裘援平聆听了各界代表的发言，对大家所提出的的签证问题，裘援平表示，中国也在努力为侨民提供便利。 裘援平说：”现在的’绿卡’制度，开口相对较小，一个是给孩子，还有是给60岁以上老人，再有是专业人才。这三块现在在逐步拓宽，可能发放速度会增快。同时，我们也在研究如何推进’绿卡’的发放问题，解决长期居留的问题。中国政府的心中始终惦记着海外侨民。” 裘援平表示，中国侨网将于今年5月1日开通，希望能够联通全球的华人华侨，包括侨团。她也希望能有更多的华裔参政。 裘援平说：”我们（国务院侨办）把今年确定为’和谐侨社’建设年，重点是面向侨团，面向基层，面向华人华侨社会，首先是整合侨团，其次是服务侨胞。” 17日，裘援平还参观了剑桥文化中心，并特别提到华文教育的重要性。她还提到去年与她在北京相见的熊昊，这名在剑桥文化中心学习汉语的美国出生的华裔学生，在去年的寻根之旅中，在6000多名学生中表现出众。熊昊对中国文化的热爱和对祖籍国的感情让裘援平非常感动。 中国国侨办主任裘援平一行于14号抵达旧金山，随即展开了密集的访问行程，慰问侨胞，听取侨声。裘援平于16日抵达波士顿，在圆满结束了波士顿的访问之后，裘援平一行将于17日前往加拿大多伦多继续进行访问。
bc42441130adf4e8b8c8e6aaf57d7dae9d3f9a82.translatedText: Qiu Yuanping visits Boston: Building a harmonious overseas Chinese community and the "green card" policy benefits overseas Chinese. According to Yan Han, a reporter from American Chinese Television in Boston, reported that on February 17, local time, Qiu Yuanping, Director of the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the State Council of China, and his delegation, accompanied by Ambassador Sun Guoxiang, Consul General of the Chinese Consulate General in New York, continued to visit overseas Chinese communities in Boston. Qiu Yuanping visited the Cambridge Cultural Center in Massachusetts and held symposiums with representatives from all walks of life. During the symposium, Qiu Yuanping said that the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the State Council will continue to work hard to serve overseas Chinese and emphasized the importance of uniting overseas Chinese and Chinese education. During the symposium, Qiu Yuanping first introduced China's development in recent years. She said that this year is the year for China to comprehensively deepen reforms, with the purpose of solving the problems caused by China's rapid development over the past 35 years, such as environmental pollution, haze, etc.; at the same time, it is necessary to accelerate urbanization. In terms of international relations, Qiu Yuanping said that individual countries that have provoked recent disputes will not have an impact on China. Subsequently, Qiu Yuanping listened to the speeches of representatives from all walks of life. Regarding the visa issues raised by everyone, Qiu Yuanping said that China is also working hard to provide convenience for overseas Chinese. Qiu Yuanping said: "The current 'green card' system has relatively small openings. One is for children, the elderly over 60 years old, and the third is professionals. These three categories are now being gradually broadened, and the issuance speed may be accelerated. At the same time, we are also studying how to promote the issuance of 'green cards' and solve the problem of long-term residence. The Chinese government has always been thinking about overseas expatriates." Qiu Yuanping said that the China Overseas Chinese Network will be launched on May 1 this year, hoping to connect overseas Chinese around the world, including overseas Chinese groups. She also hopes that more Chinese Americans can participate in politics. Qiu Yuanping said: "We (the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the State Council) have designated this year as the year of building a 'harmonious overseas Chinese community'. The focus is on facing the overseas Chinese community, facing the grassroots, and facing the Chinese overseas Chinese society. The first is to integrate the overseas Chinese community, and the second is to serve the overseas Chinese." On the 17th, Qiu Yuanping also visited the Cambridge Cultural Center and specifically mentioned the importance of Chinese education. She also mentioned Xiong Hao, whom she met in Beijing last year. This American-born Chinese student studied Chinese at the Cambridge Cultural Center. During last year's root-seeking trip, he performed outstandingly among more than 6,000 students. Qiu Yuanping was very moved by Xiong Hao's love for Chinese culture and his feelings for his ancestral country. Qiu Yuanping, director of the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of China, and his delegation arrived in San Francisco on the 14th and immediately began an intensive visit to visit overseas Chinese and listen to their voices. Qiu Yuanping arrived in Boston on the 16th. After successfully concluding his visit to Boston, Qiu Yuanping and his party will continue their visit to Toronto, Canada on the 17th.

e7ce069be27c60ecea781a5bba9dab9580efc49a.sourceText: CNN总结中国春节11大现象:买火车票就像中彩票 CNN网站30日在首页刊发报道介绍中国春节。为了向美国受众介绍春节，该媒体记者特别总结了”11大现象。” ”春节非中国独有” 第一，中国人不叫它中国新年。报道用繁体汉字介绍称，在中国，它叫”春节”或”农历新年”。春节不只是中国人的节日。朝鲜半岛、越南、日本和其他一些国家也庆祝农历新年。 第二，交通大拥堵。”农历新年基本上就是让整个国家的人实现一次家庭团聚，且在同一时间。”因此，交通不可避免地要迎来大决战。 ”无论是挤上拥挤的长途汽车，买黄牛票，还是为买上一张火车票站上几个小时，旅行者们无论如何也要与他们所爱的人团聚。”报道称。 第三，春节不只是一天。”这是一个有着各种庆祝活动的节日。” 第四，这是一个?#36855;信?#30340;节日。?#22312;春节第一天，你得像一个大学生那样生活，不洗澡也不洗衣。也不要扔垃圾，因为据说这样会扔掉你的财富和运气。?/FONT> ” 租个男友规避唠叨” 第五，租个男友回家。报道称，对于单身者、尤其是单身女性而言，春节是一个不好过的日子，”于是有了解决办法，中国最大的电商已经出现租用男友回家的服务，以此让父母亲朋停止唠叨。” 第六，有许多传统习惯需要遵守。整个春节期间，”你不能购买鞋类，但你可以把福字倒着贴在门上。” 第七，放鞭炮是为了驱逐怪兽。 第八，红内衣是一些人的关键装备。”红色与幸运和财富有关，但红内裤主要用于保护的目的。” 报道称，对那些出生在马年的人，红内裤是春节的必备品，”因为春节的怪兽不仅害怕响亮的声音，也能被红色吓退棗这令人厌的怪兽还有透视眼吗？” 第九，甜食时间。”食物是所有中国节日的主角，但在春节，甜食尤为重要，因为它意味着来年的甜蜜生活。” 第十，它有自己的电影类型棗贺岁片。”中国内地和香港都有一种叫’贺岁片’的电影类型，专供春节放映。” 第十一，春节习俗并非铁板一块。 春节不一定不能买鞋，就看你如何去解读它，”鞋这个词听起来像叹气，但另一方面，鞋也与’谐’同音。” ” 买火车票就像中彩票” 除了介绍中国春节，CNN记者David McKenzie还随一名返乡农民工，挤上从北京至合肥的T83次列车，讲述这名农民工的返乡故事，以及中国春节的”移民潮”。 ”在春节期间，中国人的旅行次数超过30亿次，其中超过2亿次经由铁道，因此，得到一张火车票几乎像中彩票。”这篇报道称。
e7ce069be27c60ecea781a5bba9dab9580efc49a.translatedText: CNN summarizes the 11 major phenomena of the Chinese Spring Festival: buying a train ticket is like winning the lottery. The CNN website published a report on the homepage on the 30th to introduce the Chinese Spring Festival. In order to introduce the Spring Festival to American audiences, reporters from this media specially summarized the "11 major phenomena." "The Spring Festival is not unique to China." First, the Chinese do not call it Chinese New Year. The report introduced it in traditional Chinese characters and said that in China, it is called "Spring Festival" or "Lunar New Year". The Spring Festival is not just a Chinese festival. The Korean Peninsula, Vietnam, Japan and some other countries also celebrate the Lunar New Year. Second, there is huge traffic congestion. "The Lunar New Year is basically a family reunion for the entire country, and at the same time." Therefore, transportation will inevitably face a decisive battle. "Whether they are squeezing into crowded long-distance buses, buying tickets from scalpers, or standing in the station for hours just to buy a train ticket, travelers have to reunite with their loved ones no matter what," the report said. Third, the Spring Festival is not just one day. "It's a festival with all kinds of celebrations." Fourth, it's a festival of faith. ?#22312;On the first day of the Spring Festival, you have to live like a college student, without taking a shower or doing laundry. Don't throw away trash either, as this is said to throw away your wealth and luck. ?/FONT> "Rent a boyfriend to avoid nagging" Fifth, rent a boyfriend to take home. The report said that for singles, especially single women, the Spring Festival is a difficult time. "So there is a solution. China's largest e-commerce company has launched a service of renting boyfriends home to make parents, relatives and friends stop nagging." Sixth, there are many traditional habits that need to be observed. Throughout the Spring Festival, "You can't buy shoes, but you can put the word "Fu" upside down on the door." Seventh, setting off firecrackers is to drive away monsters. Eighth, red underwear is an important piece of equipment for some people. "Red is associated with luck and wealth, but red underwear is mainly used for protection." The report said that for those born in the Year of the Horse, red underwear is a must-have for the Spring Festival, "because the monsters during the Spring Festival are not only afraid of loud sounds, but also can be scared off by the color red. Does this disgusting monster still have clairvoyance?" Ninth, dessert time. "Food is the protagonist of all Chinese festivals, but during the Spring Festival, sweets are especially important because it means a sweet life in the coming year." Tenth, it has its own movie genre, the New Year film. "Mainland China and Hong Kong both have a type of movie called 'Lunar New Year films', which are specially screened during the Spring Festival." Eleventh, Spring Festival customs are not monolithic. You don’t necessarily have to not buy shoes during the Spring Festival, it just depends on how you interpret it. “The word shoe sounds like a sigh, but on the other hand, shoes also have the same pronunciation as ‘harmony’.” “Buying a train ticket is like winning the lottery.” In addition to introducing the Chinese Spring Festival, CNN reporter David McKenzie also followed a returning migrant worker on the T83 train from Beijing to Hefei to tell the story of the migrant worker’s return and the “immigration wave” during the Chinese Spring Festival. "During the Spring Festival, Chinese people traveled more than 3 billion times, of which more than 200 million were via railways, so getting a train ticket is almost like winning the lottery," the report said.

96b3f6748386c6e1697a24d984667e81616c5a4e.sourceText: 2014年中国周活动于2月9日晚在六福酒家举办了超过四百多人的庆典晚宴，并庆祝凤凰城成都姐妹城市28周年。凤凰城市长格雷格 斯坦顿（ Greg Stanton ）， 成都市政府外事办公室秘书处副处长李旭东、《中国周》委员会主席朱倚华、 凤凰城姐妹城市委员会主席 刘汝章出席本次活动。
96b3f6748386c6e1697a24d984667e81616c5a4e.translatedText: The 2014 China Week event was held at Lukfook Restaurant on the evening of February 9th for more than 400 people at the gala dinner to celebrate the 28th anniversary of Phoenix Chengdu Sister City. Phoenix Mayor Greg Stanton, Deputy Director of the Secretariat of the Foreign Affairs Office of the Chengdu Municipal Government Li Xudong, "China Week" Committee Chairman Zhu Yihua, and Phoenix Sister City Committee Chairman Liu Ruzhang attended this event.

ac36f305978249e6889211f176e65d32657944c9.sourceText: 今年举办的是第24届中国周活动。本次中国周活动从２月７日到９日在凤凰城市中心 ”Margaret T. Hance 公园”全面展开，内容包括：由中西人士呈现的各类文艺表演、邀请美国少年儿童参加的中华才艺及书法训练、中国文化介绍（四大发明、古代服饰、中国乐器、木偶、地图、少数民族等）、传统木偶戏演出、儿童游乐场。成都友城文艺演出代表团也给凤凰城的华人朋友带来了家乡的气息。数千中美朋友参加到了有中国文化特色的活动中，体验东方文化古国的魅力。
ac36f305978249e6889211f176e65d32657944c9.translatedText: This year is the 24th China Week event. This China Week event was held in full swing at "Margaret T. Hance Park" in downtown Phoenix from February 7th to 9th. The content included: various cultural performances presented by Chinese and Western people, Chinese talent and calligraphy training that invited American children to participate, introduction to Chinese culture (the four great inventions, ancient costumes, Chinese musical instruments, puppets, maps, ethnic minorities, etc.), traditional puppet shows, and children's playgrounds. The Chengdu sister city artistic performance delegation also brought the atmosphere of hometown to Chinese friends in Phoenix. Thousands of Chinese and American friends participated in activities with Chinese cultural characteristics and experienced the charm of this ancient country with oriental culture.

1b25c0d50698f2f7cc5d904277222a1e2957d471.translatedText: Coronado Elementary School in the Higley School District of Alberta has fully launched English/Chinese bilingual immersion teaching &#8212…

5f1e69fb6eaadc711c2b16bbd34a0a4a9cf369e6.sourceText: (2014-2-4, Gilbert, AZ）Higley学区（Higley United School District: www.husd.org）的Coronado 小学（Coronado Elementary）今秋全力启动英文/中文沉浸式双语教学–今年8月从学前班（Kindergarten）和一年级 (Frist Grade) 两个年级同时展开。目前报名正在热烈进行中。双语报名咨询电话：480-279-6900. 沉浸式双语教学(Dual Language Immersion Program)这个词对很多朋友来说还不是那么熟悉。它是指学生用英文和一门世界语，比如西班牙语、中文、法文等某一语言来同时进行每天的学习。 对于Coronado 小学选择英文/中文沉浸式教育的这个方向来说具体就是：学前班和一年级的学生用英文学习语言文学（Language Art）和 社会学（Social Study）；而数学（Math）和科学（Science）两门课则用中文进行学习。进入这个项目的学生，也就是将入学的学前班和一年级的小朋友，每天在学校里半天用英文学习语言文学和社会学，半天中文学习数学和科学。
5f1e69fb6eaadc711c2b16bbd34a0a4a9cf369e6.translatedText: (2014-2-4, Gilbert, AZ) Higley United School District (Higley United School District: Coronado Elementary (www.husd.org) will fully launch English/Chinese immersion bilingual teaching this fall – starting from Kindergarten and First Grade at the same time in August this year. Registration is currently in progress. Bilingual registration consultation hotline: 480-279-6900. The term Dual Language Immersion Program is not so familiar to many friends. It means that students use English and an Esperanto language, such as Spanish, Chinese, French, etc., to study at the same time every day. The specific direction of Coronado Elementary School’s choice of English/Chinese immersion education is this: Pre-kindergarten and first-grade students learn Language Art and Social Study in English; while Math and Science are taught in Chinese. Students who enter this program, that is, children who will enter kindergarten and first grade, spend half a day at school studying language, literature and social studies in English, and half a day studying mathematics and science in Chinese.

83164ec7a482b151acc30128ff09e1503bac5fd9.sourceText: 英文/中文沉浸式教学是近六、七年来北美教育界特别热门的一个教育方向。它在犹他州、南卡萝兰纳州、德拉威尔州、科罗拉多州等地已是一种成熟的教育实践，形成了独特、丰满的教育模式。Coronado 小学在未来学年展开这个教学项目是建立在全美沉浸式教学的成熟教学体系和丰富的教学资源上的。并且还得到ASU孔子学院、汉办、美国CollegeBoard和其他国际教育组织的鼎力支持。不光教育资源得到很好的整合和开发，更重重要的是他们把中美两边的最优秀的教育人才直接引用到英文/中文沉浸式双语教学的日常教学当中。
83164ec7a482b151acc30128ff09e1503bac5fd9.translatedText: English/Chinese immersion teaching has been a particularly popular educational direction in the North American education industry in the past six or seven years. It is already a mature educational practice in Utah, South Carolina, Delaware, Colorado and other places, forming a unique and rich educational model. Coronado Elementary School will launch this teaching project in the coming school year based on the mature teaching system and rich teaching resources of immersion teaching in the United States. It also receives strong support from the ASU Confucius Institute, Hanban, American CollegeBoard and other international education organizations. Not only have the educational resources been well integrated and developed, but more importantly, they have directly introduced the best educational talents from China and the United States into the daily teaching of English/Chinese immersion bilingual teaching.

5522151ce6b082f1bd0fba1f65b37168bf8f1e84.sourceText: Coronado 小学的英文/中文沉浸式双语教学从今年8月开课，而后随着学生升入高一年级，学校每年添加新一级的双语班，在6年内实现从学前班到小学六年级（K-6）的各年级沉浸式教学。中文作为每天学生应用的学习工具将直接教授学生学习数学和科学两门日常课程。英语语言文学和社会学两门课程继续保持英文授课。
5522151ce6b082f1bd0fba1f65b37168bf8f1e84.translatedText: >Coronado Elementary School's English/Chinese immersion bilingual teaching started in August this year, and then as students entered the first grade of high school, the school added a new level of bilingual classes every year, achieving immersive teaching for all grades from preschool to sixth grade (K-6) within 6 years. Chinese, as a learning tool used by students every day, will directly teach students the two daily courses of mathematics and science. Two courses, English Language and Literature and Sociology, continue to be taught in English.

c41bf588a64a7e54529a22bb2cadb7588b01b4c0.sourceText: 采用双语教学方向，但教学目标和单语教学是一样的—都是以教育部的Common Core Standards为准。英文老师和中文老师通过紧密的合作，保证数学和科学中的英文表述和中文表述是同时推进的。学生的标准考试，升学，评估，搬家转学到任何单语教育的机构都不会受任何影响。唯一不同的是他们从比较小的年龄开始较熟练地掌握了中文。Coronado 小学所在的Higley学区课程设置主任, Dr. Dawn Foley指出：不但学习第二外语可以提高学生未来的就业机会，更有研究表明较早开始双语学习的孩子在未来的数学学习中往往表现出色。 ”用中文，你几乎可以和50%的世界人口直接交流”，Coronado 小学校长Dr. Mai-Lon Wong女士说，”我们的学区住户的问卷调查结果是67%的住户有兴趣让孩子到英文/中文沉浸式双语教学的班级里学习。”去年九月Coronado 小学所在的Gilbert的市长John Lewis更表达对双语沉浸教学的关注，强调要通过未来对中文等其他第世界语的学习加强地方经济和培养国际化人才至关重要。 Coronado 小学面向学前班和一年级的招生目前正在进行中。如果您有兴趣了解更多详情请参加以下任意一个时段的家长校长见面会：
c41bf588a64a7e54529a22bb2cadb7588b01b4c0.translatedText: Bilingual teaching is adopted, but the teaching objectives are the same as monolingual teaching - both are based on the Common Core Standards of the Ministry of Education. English teachers and Chinese teachers work closely together to ensure that English and Chinese expressions in mathematics and science are promoted simultaneously. Students' standardized testing, progression, assessment, and relocation to any monolingual education institution will not be affected in any way. The only difference is that they mastered Chinese more proficiently from a younger age. Dr. Dawn Foley, curriculum director of the Higley School District where Coronado Elementary School is located, pointed out: Not only can learning a second foreign language improve students’ future employment opportunities, but research has shown that children who start bilingual learning early tend to perform well in future mathematics studies. "Using Chinese, you can communicate directly with almost 50% of the world's population," said Dr. Mai-Lon Wong, principal of Coronado Elementary School. "The result of the questionnaire survey of residents in our school district is that 67% of residents are interested in sending their children to English/Chinese immersion bilingual teaching classes." Last September, Mayor John of Gilbert, where Coronado Elementary School is located Lewis also expressed his concern for bilingual immersion teaching, emphasizing that it is crucial to strengthen the local economy and cultivate international talents through the future learning of Chinese and other Esperanto languages. Enrollment at Coronado Elementary School for pre-kindergarten and first grade is currently underway. 92dce821cb5b9980795b8c3f090b88171f9da954.translatedText: The 2013 Arizona Primary and Secondary School Student Art Competition has come to an end, with a total of 132 primary and secondary school students from all districts in the province participating in this competition. After strict review by seven professional artists in the state, 13 students won awards in this competition. Among them, the creations of two Asian girls, 11-year-old Huang Meida and 8-year-old Yao Jing, were particularly outstanding. They won first place in the 4-6 grade group and second place in the K-3 grade group, and received prizes of 300 yuan and 200 yuan respectively.

a9a823cf900aa54a85c49a75f78d0256ad3d6e16.sourceText: 州官员与 全体获奖同学合影
a9a823cf900aa54a85c49a75f78d0256ad3d6e16.translatedText: State officials took a group photo with all the award-winning students

677a6ab8ae5bb2292087fd40e652e58f648ca7da.sourceText: 黄美达创作的作品《印第安女孩》，充分展现印第安女孩正直、朴实、刚毅和勇敢的精神。画中的印第安女孩头饰鹰羽冠，身着极具印第安民族特色的服装，与西部灿烂绚丽的色彩和谐融合，带给观者强烈的艺术震撼力，在所有的绘画作品中脱颖而出，受得评委们一致好评，夺得本次大赛6?年级组的第一名。
677a6ab8ae5bb2292087fd40e652e58f648ca7da.translatedText: The work "Indian Girl" created by Huang Meida fully demonstrates the integrity, simplicity, perseverance and bravery of Indian girls. The Indian girl in the painting wears an eagle feather crown on her head and a costume with Indian ethnic characteristics. It harmoniously blends with the brilliant and gorgeous colors of the West, bringing a strong artistic shock to the viewer. She stands out among all the paintings and won unanimous praise from the judges. She won the first place in the 6th grade group of this competition.

2d4c2c3b9b24228035c54603986c8cbb03248df2.sourceText: 年仅8岁的要静同学，以儿童画天真、可爱的线条勾勒出西部牛仔的生活景象，构图优美，色彩浓烈而粗犷，夺得K-3年级组的第二名。作品取名《西部晚风》，画中身姿矫健的牛仔牵着一匹棕褐马，在瑰丽的晚霞中回到家，坚固厚实的土楼房，错落有致，毗邻而座，石阶长梯紧靠着房屋外沿、门前随意摆放若干瓷器，以及前景神气快活的公鸡，无不展现了西部牛仔的智慧、古朴而健康的生活状态，令人虽不能至，然心向往之。
2d4c2c3b9b24228035c54603986c8cbb03248df2.translatedText: Yao Jing, who is only 8 years old, used innocent and cute lines drawn by children to outline the life scenes of western cowboys. The composition is beautiful, the colors are strong and rough, and he won the second place in the K-3 grade group. The work is titled "Western Evening Breeze". In the painting, a vigorous cowboy leads a brown horse and returns home in the magnificent sunset. The solid and thick earthen buildings are well-proportioned and sit next to each other. The long stone steps are close to the outer edge of the house, some porcelain is randomly placed in front of the door, and the cheerful rooster in the foreground all shows the wisdom, simple and healthy living conditions of the western cowboys. Although it is impossible to visit, people yearn for it.

97a5c0ccacad2d741c2828fdbef62ef46d763aa5.sourceText: 画家林峰为本次大赛共选送的这两名同学都表现不俗，双双获奖。 两位小朋友利用周末时间，跟随林峰学习绘画，接受基础培训，使她们在构图、造型、透视比例以及色彩上的应用得到较大的提高。黄美达同学成绩优异，她的作品曾获得2013亚省华人美术作品展少儿组(6-12Year old)杰出作品奖，美国独立日Joan Yen (Grades 8-12)第二名， Arizona Asia Festival Poster Design Contest（Grades 3-5)第一名等。
97a5c0ccacad2d741c2828fdbef62ef46d763aa5.translatedText: The two students selected by painter Lin Feng for this competition performed well and both won awards. The two children used their weekends to learn painting from Lin Feng and received basic training, which greatly improved their application of composition, shape, perspective proportion and color. Huang Meida has excellent academic performance. Her works won the Outstanding Work Award in the Children's Group (6-12 Year old) of the 2013 Alberta Chinese Art Exhibition, the second place in the American Independence Day Joan Yen (Grades 8-12), and the first place in the Arizona Asia Festival Poster Design Contest (Grades 3-5).

92a498adafb59223b6bb7c753f956877e13b20cf.translatedText: 1.3 million people lost federal unemployment benefits, a loss of $1,166 a month Christmas has just passed, but at the end of the year, for more than 1 million Americans...

6eee1a5c8dae09625e406d513f40c4a4d37d8e48.sourceText: 对于依赖现金援助的家庭来说，停止失业联邦救济金，将意味着失去平均每月1166美元的津贴，他们将不得不在紧缩生活中的花费。尽管失业率可能有所下降，但分析师指出，这一行为可能会对经济产生不良影响，将导致消费者从衣服到汽车上花更少的钱。
6eee1a5c8dae09625e406d513f40c4a4d37d8e48.translatedText: For families who rely on cash assistance, ending federal unemployment benefits will mean losing an average monthly allowance of $1,166, which they will have to spend in austerity life. While unemployment may be down, analysts say the move could have adverse economic consequences, causing consumers to spend less on everything from clothes to cars.

9f5d0f5c4d591809f1107b98d9dc87a6b531dafc.sourceText: 在约130万的领取失业救济金的美国人中，加州比例最大，有21万4千人。而预计到明年6月多数州该项目到期截止，这个数字还会继续飙升到近200万人受到波及。而纽约和新泽西州也是救济金大户，纽约州有多于12万7千人正在面临窘况，而新泽西州则有9万人。
9f5d0f5c4d591809f1107b98d9dc87a6b531dafc.translatedText: Of the approximately 1.3 million Americans receiving unemployment benefits, California has the largest proportion, with 214,000 people. It is expected that by June next year when the project expires in most states, this number will continue to soar to nearly 2 million people affected. New York and New Jersey are also big recipients of relief funds. More than 127,000 people in New York state are facing hardship, while 90,000 people in New Jersey are facing hardship.

ba624e173c32afbac98e2d7bd41ed0da55320335.sourceText: 失业联邦救济金是提供给那些领完州政府事业保险后仍然找不到工作的民众。正在夏威夷度假的总统奥巴马曾表示，美国政府努力要求国会支持并通过一项预算议案，以向失业民众持续支付失业保险金。国会在新年的第一项工作就是修复这一福利，但他对于修复时间他并没有给予确切时间。白宫经济顾问委员会主席杰森?#31119;尔曼在谈到美国政府采取此举时称，不通过这项预算议案将使失业人群的状况雪上加霜。福尔曼在谈到这项议案对美国130万名失业者的生活产生直接影响时说，失业保险金仅能帮助这些失业者支付账单。如果通过这项议案通过并继续支付保险金，这些人仍然必须加大继续寻找工作的力度。
ba624e173c32afbac98e2d7bd41ed0da55320335.translatedText: Unemployment federal benefits are provided to people who still cannot find a job after receiving state government insurance. President Obama, who is on vacation in Hawaii, has said that the U.S. government is working hard to ask Congress to support and pass a budget bill to continue paying unemployment insurance benefits to unemployed people. Congress' first order of business in the new year will be to repair this benefit, but he has not given an exact time for repairs. When talking about the U.S. government’s move, Jason Mann, chairman of the White House Council of Economic Advisers, said that failure to pass this budget bill will make the situation of the unemployed even worse. When talking about the direct impact this bill will have on the lives of the 1.3 million unemployed people in the United States, Foreman said that unemployment insurance benefits can only help these unemployed people pay their bills. If this bill passes and premiums continue to be paid, these people will still have to increase their efforts to continue looking for work.

b7ccbab4a15d990ebaec73fef9250bc77897197b.translatedText: Chinese books worth paying attention to in 2013 are jointly recommended by many writers, scholars, literary translators and company people. Recommended books are Chinese readings published this year, regardless of translated works or original Chinese works, not limited to simplified or traditional Chinese, and not limited to the region in which they were published. Among the recommended books this year, fiction is mostly translated works; non-fiction responds to or reflects slavery, violence and revolution in the totalitarian era from various angles.

832a7cc5eb36dfa35e5b230a427c94715b754957.sourceText: 2013洛杉矶游客破纪录 中国游客增21%日消费惊人！ 洛杉矶旅游及会展委员会（ Los Angeles Tourism & Convention Board）周一宣布：2013年到洛杉矶的游客数量为4220万人，打破历史纪录；这个数字比2012年增长了2%，其中来自中国的游客比2012年增长了21%。 在2013年来洛杉矶的游客中，有3600万人为美国境内游客，有620万人为境外游客，其中中国游客所占比重最大。 洛杉矶市长Eric Garcetti称，游客数量的稳步增长是一个”经济的闪光点，为洛杉矶的家庭创造更多就业机会，为当地商业和政府税收带来可观收入，从而更有益于城市建设。” 2012年，来到洛杉矶的游客总共花费了165亿美元，创造了305亿美元的经济效益，并带来了34万个就业岗位。平均每位中国游客每天花费1000美元，仅次于日本游客的1731美元。中国游客对洛杉矶的经济发展起到了强大的促进作用。 洛杉矶旅游局官员表示，他们在2014年的目标是促进城市会展与博览业的发展，扩大他们在美国、英国、澳大利亚、加拿大和中国的市场。
832a7cc5eb36dfa35e5b230a427c94715b754957.translatedText: 2013 Los Angeles tourists broke record. Chinese tourists increased by 21% and their daily consumption was amazing! The Los Angeles Tourism & Convention Board announced on Monday that the number of tourists to Los Angeles in 2013 was 42.2 million, breaking the historical record; this number increased by 2% compared with 2012, of which tourists from China increased by 21% compared with 2012. Among the tourists who came to Los Angeles in 2013, 36 million were domestic tourists in the United States and 6.2 million were overseas tourists, of which Chinese tourists accounted for the largest proportion. Los Angeles Mayor Eric Garcetti said that the steady growth in the number of tourists is an "economic shining point, creating more job opportunities for Los Angeles families and bringing considerable revenue to local businesses and government taxes, which is more beneficial to urban construction." In 2012, tourists who came to Los Angeles spent a total of US$16.5 billion, created US$30.5 billion in economic benefits, and brought 340,000 jobs. On average, each Chinese tourist spent US$1,000 per day, second only to Japanese tourists who spent US$1,731. Chinese tourists have played a strong role in promoting the economic development of Los Angeles. Los Angeles Tourism Bureau officials said their goal in 2014 is to promote the development of the city's convention and exhibition industry and expand their markets in the United States, United Kingdom, Australia, Canada and China.

b4c7dc21c0b6efec2aca4cd8a2c3ecb5d6670444.sourceText: （编者按）2013年12月16日至18日，凤凰卫视美洲台工作小组在曾台长的带领下，到凤凰城进行『中华小姐』十週年选美场地的视察，并到亚利桑那州北部景点作资料调查。观察景点包括：圣都娜、历史66号公路、亚省野生动物园、双箭赌场、PAGE镇马蹄湾、羚羊谷、Lake Power湖等，凤凰城侨联总会主席张华芳及邓朝驹、高志中、张肇鸿等热情招待来宾，部分成员随团同行观察景点。
b4c7dc21c0b6efec2aca4cd8a2c3ecb5d6670444.translatedText: (Editor's note) From December 16 to 18, 2013, the Phoenix TV Americas Working Group, led by Director Zeng, went to Phoenix to inspect the venue for the 10th anniversary of the "Miss China" pageant, and to conduct information research at scenic spots in northern Arizona. Observation attractions include: Santa Clara, Historic Route 66, Alberta Wildlife Park, Double Arrow Casino, Horseshoe Bend in PAGE Town, Antelope Valley, Lake Power, etc. Phoenix Overseas Chinese Federation Chairman Zhang Huafang and Deng Chaoju, Gao Zhizhong, Zhang Zhaohong and others warmly entertained the guests, and some members accompanied the group to observe the attractions.

94e56861080ab15b19dfcfae0cd2b6efef275230.sourceText: 人们传说：『上帝创造了大峡谷，但是却住在圣多娜(Sedona)。』圣多娜海拔 1200 公尺，四季的风景截然不同且风情万种，有多变的风貌，怡人的天气和绝美的景色。
94e56861080ab15b19dfcfae0cd2b6efef275230.translatedText: People say: "God created the Grand Canyon, but he lived in Sedona." 』Sedona is 1,200 meters above sea level. The scenery in the four seasons is completely different and varied, with varied features, pleasant weather and stunning scenery.

e7d1fba605d09bb829fad5ef56293de5a0a5ae5a.sourceText: Sedona山峦密集，土石红褐，秀丽壮观，很多杂志、报章都把它誉为美国风景最美的地方。因其外形非常奇特，且颜色鲜豔亮丽，聚集了许多艺术家在这里创作及蒐集艺术品，特别是欣赏本州原住民的艺术。圣多娜红色山岩也是美国被摄影最多的景緻。
e7d1fba605d09bb829fad5ef56293de5a0a5ae5a.translatedText: >Sedona has dense mountains, reddish-brown soil and rocks, and is spectacularly beautiful. Many magazines and newspapers have hailed it as the most beautiful place in the United States. Because of its unique appearance and bright colors, many artists gather here to create and collect art, especially to appreciate the art of the state's indigenous people. The red rock formations of Sedona are also the most photographed landscape in the United States.

928f4f33d1fc2696659b3be9cb948b789684838e.sourceText: Sedona早年为北美印第安人的圣地，是各部落讲和及祭典之处。从一九四零到一九八零年代，好莱坞到此拍了四、五十片西部电影，有好山好水好空气的盛名，北美的艺术家、诗人开始搬入。这裡也是相信有神奇力量存在的人们嚮往的一个圣殿。
928f4f33d1fc2696659b3be9cb948b789684838e.translatedText: Sedona was a sacred place for North American Indians in the early years, where various tribes made peace and held ceremonies. From the 1940s to the 1980s, Hollywood filmed forty or fifty Western movies here. It was famous for its beautiful mountains, water, and air. North American artists and poets began to move in. This is also a temple that people who believe in the existence of magical powers long for.

8f136121e9da75349654435c4fe9e0eef4aa77b3.sourceText: 此地的牛仔艺术，尤其是老鹰、野马、动物或人物的凋塑非常出名。有的人能感受到气或能量场的存在，某种感应导致双手会微微颤动；有的人或许会感到身心特别的舒坦，当地人也说这可能是山岩红土裡铁质的作用。这一切来自于对大自然之美的震撼与赏识，据说会对游客产生各种影响，能永远地改变他们的人生。
8f136121e9da75349654435c4fe9e0eef4aa77b3.translatedText: The cowboy art here is very famous, especially the sculptures of eagles, wild horses, animals or figures. Some people can feel the presence of Qi or energy field, and some kind of induction causes their hands to tremble slightly; some people may feel particularly comfortable physically and mentally. Locals also say that this may be the effect of the iron in the red soil of the rocks. All this comes from the shock and appreciation of the beauty of nature, which is said to have various impacts on tourists and can change their lives forever.

On the 27th, the verdict was passed on the case in which Wu Zongxian emptied Lianming Technology Company of more than NT$30 million...

fd0abcf39759625b0b221326743dcf45efa49dec.sourceText: 27日，吴宗宪掏空联明科技公司3千多万元新台币案判决，吴宗宪被判刑1年零10个月，缓刑3年，须缴纳300万元新台币（约60万元人民币）。
fd0abcf39759625b0b221326743dcf45efa49dec.translatedText: On the 27th, the verdict was passed on the case in which Wu Zongxian emptied Lianming Technology Company of more than NT$30 million. Wu Zongxian was sentenced to 1 year and 10 months in prison, suspended for 3 years, and had to pay NT$3 million (approximately 600,000 yuan).

092f8bfbe6ef065773b1fc982b81aa5eb43c7b22.sourceText: 据台湾媒体消息，吴宗宪投资LED节能产业阿尔发光子科技公司，不但亏损连连，还被检方调查出涉嫌和上市公司联明行动科技许丰扬勾结，利用假交易共同掏空联明3250万元新台币资产，去年被以业务侵占等罪起诉。
092f8bfbe6ef065773b1fc982b81aa5eb43c7b22.translatedText: According to Taiwanese media, Wu Zongxian invested in the LED energy-saving industry Al Luminous Technology Co., Ltd. Not only did he suffer losses, but he was also investigated by prosecutors and suspected of colluding with Xu Fengyang, a listed company, Lianming Action Technology, to use fake transactions to jointly drain Lianming's NT$32.5 million in assets. Last year, he was prosecuted for business misappropriation and other crimes.

21d15a9fdedbec8d6373cf4070211e8978ddf4f3.sourceText: 吴宗宪在27日新浪微博发表声明，表示受到无端牵连，感到万分无奈。其经纪人表示：”吴先生是个好人，没有做过任何犯法行为。”吴宗宪经纪人程小姐还表示：”对于这场无妄之灾，我们将上诉到底。”
21d15a9fdedbec8d6373cf4070211e8978ddf4f3.translatedText: > Wu Zongxian issued a statement on Sina Weibo on the 27th, saying that he was unreasonably implicated and felt extremely helpless. His agent said: "Mr. Wu is a good person and has not done any illegal behavior." Wu Zongxian's agent, Ms. Cheng, also said: "We will appeal to the end for this unjust disaster."

ef702598e1d7f3597698587f21565f8ba96de987.sourceText: 为何被判？涉嫌”假交易、真借贷”被查
ef702598e1d7f3597698587f21565f8ba96de987.translatedText: Why was he sentenced? Investigation for suspected "fake transactions and real loans"

c9c01b75cdcea53219ea0032dba9e23098e09a96.sourceText: 2011年7月13日，吴宗宪突然遭台北检署约谈，因其涉嫌”假交易、真借贷”，违反商业会计法。当时台湾上柜公司联明行动科技爆发”掏空案”，该公司前董事长许丰扬涉嫌以挪用、借贷、投资、操纵股价、虚增营收或虚伪增资美化财报等手法，挪用公司资金近亿元新台币，其中有6000万新台币被查出于2009年1月流向吴宗宪的阿尔发公司账户。
c9c01b75cdcea53219ea0032dba9e23098e09a96.translatedText: On July 13, 2011, Wu Zongxian was suddenly interviewed by the Taipei Prosecutor's Office because he was suspected of "fake transactions and real loans" and violated the Commercial Accounting Law. At that time, a "hollow-out case" broke out in Taiwan's over-the-counter company Lianming Action Technology. The company's former chairman, Xu Fengyang, was suspected of misappropriating nearly NT$100 million in company funds through misappropriation, borrowing, investing, manipulating stock prices, falsely increasing revenue or falsely increasing capital to beautify financial reports. Among them, NT$60 million was found to have flowed to Wu Zongxian's Alpha Company account in January 2009.

0325aad42ef6e4ab8a4af31ebacc8de16d371e10.sourceText: 虽然表面看上去是科技公司向阿尔发公司购买LED产品，但同年3月，阿尔发公司以产能不够、无法出货为由”解约”。不过检调方认为这笔账很可疑，怀疑吴宗宪联合许丰扬掏空联明行动，之后台北地检署指挥台北市调查处全面搜查证据，其中包括吴宗宪的阿尔发公司。
0325aad42ef6e4ab8a4af31ebacc8de16d371e10.translatedText: Although on the surface it seemed that the technology company was purchasing LED products from Alfa Company, in March of the same year, Alfa Company "terminated the contract" on the grounds that it had insufficient production capacity and was unable to ship. However, the prosecutors believed that this account was very suspicious and suspected that Wu Zongxian collaborated with Xu Fengyang to hollow out Lianming. Afterwards, the Taipei District Prosecutor's Office directed the Taipei City Investigation Division to conduct a comprehensive search for evidence, including Wu Zongxian's Alfa Company.

5917efd5a378c35447dc020bac157699ce799a34.sourceText: 在前往检调方说明案情时，吴宗宪坦承2009年1月联明行动科技的确用6000万本票购买LED灯，但后来因产能不足，3月就取消合作。事后吴宗宪退还了3600万新台币现金，剩余的2400万新台币也在随后归还。不过即使这样，2012年台北地检署侦办完后，仍然以背信、违反商业会计法规等罪将吴宗宪列为被告，并提起公诉。
5917efd5a378c35447dc020bac157699ce799a34.translatedText: When going to the prosecutor to explain the case, Wu Zongxian admitted that Lianming Action Technology did use 60 million promissory notes to purchase LED lights in January 2009, but later canceled the cooperation in March due to insufficient production capacity. Afterwards, Wu Zongxian returned NT$36 million in cash, and the remaining NT$24 million was subsequently returned. However, even so, after the Taipei District Prosecutor's Office completed its investigation in 2012, Wu Zongxian was still listed as a defendant for breach of trust, violation of commercial accounting regulations and other crimes, and public prosecution was launched.

2b7fe1dccf0bb516e52ef94dbfc105ea578ace28.sourceText: 吴宗宪获刑22个月 经纪人称将上诉到底
2b7fe1dccf0bb516e52ef94dbfc105ea578ace28.translatedText: Wu Zongxian was sentenced to 22 months in prison. His agent said he would appeal to the end

92c92216e60a109053b4870a4ac9bae2e935b00b.sourceText: 在经过一年多的审理之后，昨天该案判决。台北地院当初以吴宗宪掏空联明科技公司3250万元新台币资产，并依最重可处10年徒刑的《证券交易法》业务侵占等罪起诉。因吴宗宪认罪并与投资人保护中心达成和解，台北地院依违反《证交法》等罪判吴1年10个月徒刑，缓刑3年，罚款300万元新台币。
92c92216e60a109053b4870a4ac9bae2e935b00b.translatedText: After more than a year of trial, the case was decided yesterday. The Taipei District Court originally charged Wu Zongxian with emptying NT$32.5 million in assets of Lian Ming Technology Company, and charged him with business embezzlement and other crimes under the Securities and Exchange Act, which carries a maximum penalty of 10 years in prison. Because Wu Zongxian pleaded guilty and reached a settlement with the Investor Protection Center, the Taipei District Court sentenced Wu to 1 year and 10 months in prison for violating the Securities and Exchange Act, suspended for 3 years, and fined NT$3 million.

56449c6007bc414b62b6fbe80c6ec7ea58c383fd.sourceText: 判决结果遭曝光之后，昨晚吴宗宪罕见高调在微博发出澄清，称自己在演艺圈30多年，只懂为观众表演，没有做过违背良心的事，也从未经手过财务。对于卷入掏空案，吴宗宪称是遭受童年朋友的牵连，感到非常无奈。他并以父母的名义发誓，自己绝对没有参与掏空联明行动。同时吴宗宪称已经全权交由律师处理，相信法律会还自己一个清白。昨晚记者也立刻致电经纪人程小姐，她称吴宗宪从头到尾都是清白的，何来认罪之说，批台湾媒体颠倒是非。她表示目前还未收到判决书，但态度坚决：”对于这场无妄之灾，我们上诉到底。”
56449c6007bc414b62b6fbe80c6ec7ea58c383fd.translatedText: After the verdict was exposed, Wu Zongxian issued a rare high-profile clarification on Weibo last night, saying that he has been in the entertainment industry for more than 30 years and only knows how to perform for the audience. He has never done anything against his conscience and has never dealt with finances. Regarding being involved in the hollowing out case, Wu Zongxian said that he was implicated by his childhood friends and felt very helpless. He also swore in the name of his parents that he would never participate in the operation to hollow out Lian Ming. At the same time, Wu Zongxian said that he has left full power to the lawyers and believes that the law will clear his name. Last night, the reporter also immediately called his agent, Ms. Cheng. She said that Wu Zongxian was innocent from beginning to end, how could he plead guilty, and criticized the Taiwan media for confusing right and wrong. She said that she has not received the verdict yet, but her attitude is firm: "We will appeal to the end for this unjust disaster."

55bde68bf5c48195ee05b94f8d76cf73ea8e8212.sourceText: 宗宪一生在艺能界30余年只懂得为大家表演，奉献青春岁月只为博君一灿！没有做过任何违背良心的事！这次的官司；遭受童年朋友无端的牵连，感到万分的无奈，我一辈子从未经手财务，又怎么会去做出有损名节的勾当！？我相信法律会还我一个清白！我也交由律师全力捍卫个人的名节！ 宗宪可以选择谨言慎行，但是却无法选择我的童年….有些无奈但是只能自己吞下，天知、地知、你知、我知！”斗室之内，但见高洁人品”，是我从小的庭训！以父母为名，立下重誓！
55bde68bf5c48195ee05b94f8d76cf73ea8e8212.translatedText: Zongxian has been in the entertainment industry for more than 30 years, only knowing how to perform for everyone, and dedicating his youthful years just to shine! I haven't done anything against my conscience! This lawsuit: I was unreasonably implicated by a childhood friend, and I felt extremely helpless. I had never dealt with finances in my life, so how could I do something that would harm my reputation? ? I believe the law will return my innocence! I also leave it to my lawyer to fully defend my personal reputation! Zongxian can choose to be cautious in his words and deeds, but he cannot choose my childhood... I am a little helpless but I can only swallow it by myself. God knows, earth knows, you know, I know! "A noble character can only be found in a small room", this has been my court motto since childhood! In the name of my parents, I make a solemn oath!

16454338d89ed8e3c90223c3795028185e1898c3.sourceText: Chinese Lantern & Folk Festival Coming to Fountain Hills A colorful and unique Chinese tradition is coming to Arizona for the first time. The inaugural Chinese Lantern & Folk Festival will be held Jan. 24?Feb. 2 along the lake in Fountain Hills. Coinciding with the Chinese New Year celebration of the Year of the Horse, the festival will feature dozens of large, richly-colored lit displays made from special silk material depicting animals, characters, gods, angels, flora and structures. The displays, which will be created by two dozen Chinese artisans, become a stunning kaleidoscope of colorful lights and visuals. A number of displays measure up to 60 feet long and 40 feet wide. The festival will also feature cultural dancing, puppets, food, Tai Chi and Kung Fu demonstrations, handmade crafts and music. Festival times will be Monday through Friday from 3 to 10 p.m., and Saturday and Sunday noon to 10 p.m. Tickets for adults will be $12, and $8 for children 5-12. Both adults and children will receive a free gift. Children under 5 are free. Business sponsorships are available for displays from $1,000 to $10,000. Modern lantern festivals have been held around the world in places like Vancouver, Canada, Auckland, New Zealand and Singapore. Lantern festivals are held in a few locations throughout the U.S. The first lantern festival began during China抯 Han dynasty (A.D. 25 – A.D. 220.) 揟he Chinese Lantern and Folk Festival will bring the colorful and historic Eastern culture to America,?said Festival Director Cathy Hum. 揟his event will showcase the creative art of lantern making, along with featuring the Chinese arts and way of life.?BR>揟he Town of Fountain Hills it thrilled to host the very first Chinese Lantern & Folk Festival,?said Fountain Hills Mayor Linda Kavanagh. 揙ur town will be the meeting place for the colorful Eastern traditions and our American traditions. It is also another opportunity to show the world what Fountain Hills has to offer in both its residents, its way of life and our area抯 beautiful scenery.?BR> For more information, call Festival Director Cathy Hum at (623)521-8188 or visit ucorganization@gmail.com.

b44a75bb44b92e8ab20a89676e43f0d532bb7526.sourceText: 斯普林菲尔德是美国伊利诺伊州的首府，国家前总统亚伯拉罕?#26519;肯曾经在这里住过。1908年由于一场种族引起的骚乱这里创建了一个名为全国有色人种协进会（英文缩写：NAACP）的组织，该组织现在已经演变成一个促进黑人民权的全国性组织。但即便今天它还是一个小城镇，用它自己惯有的小镇思维思考着世间百态。
b44a75bb44b92e8ab20a89676e43f0d532bb7526.translatedText: Springfield is the capital of the state of Illinois in the United States. Former President Abraham Ken once lived here. In 1908, due to a racial riot, an organization called the National Association for the Advancement of Colored People (English abbreviation: NAACP) was created here, which has now evolved into a national organization promoting black civil rights. But even today it is still a small town, thinking about the world with its own small-town thinking.

ae99ca5075585685b8c13933464af02977982af3.sourceText: ”每个人相互之间分享的几乎都是彼此的工作，”伊戈达拉说，”大家都害怕走出去，他们觉得那里的生活很舒服。没有人喜欢体验新的事物或者做一些不同的事情。有很多优秀的球员都是从这里走出去的，在我之前有很多人都有实力打进NBA ( 微博 ) 成了业篮球运动员，其中杰夫-沃克就是伴随着我成长的一位。他拥有极高的篮球天赋，他是一名伟大的球员，他本应该进入NBA的，但是他没有这么做。这个小城镇固有的思维束缚了很多优秀运动员。我上大学后就想离这里越远越好，所以最终我没有被困在这里。”
ae99ca5075585685b8c13933464af02977982af3.translatedText: "Everyone shares almost everything with each other's work," Iguodala said. "Everyone is afraid to go out. They feel that life there is very comfortable. No one likes to experience new things or do something different. There are many excellent players who came out from here, and many people before me had the ability to enter the NBA (Weibo) He became a professional basketball player, and one of them was Jeff Walker. He had great basketball talent, and he should have entered the NBA, but he didn't. The inherent mentality of this small town restrained many outstanding athletes. After I went to college, I wanted to stay as far away as possible, so in the end I was not trapped here."

d8442f40d941c71ca515c6a317f254192303ac71.sourceText: 伊戈达拉的母亲琳达-尚克林女士此前就一直鼓励自己的两个儿子将来能够离开斯普林菲尔德。但是伊戈达拉其实更清楚，他特想离开的是伊利诺伊州。但是很多专业的运专家在看到伊戈达拉的表现后，都一致认同他将会成为一个田径明星。但是他的好朋友们却不这么认为，其中就有他高中篮球队的队友麦克布赖德。而恰在此时，伊戈达拉在AAU打球是的主教练拉力-巴特勒吩咐自己的助教将其招致麾下。此后伊戈达拉还被邀请参加了乔丹赞助的篮球精英赛，这也让巴特勒大为欣慰。巴特勒还游说著名分析师克拉克-弗兰克给伊戈达拉更高顺位的预测。不过在升大学的时，虽然没有一线的篮球名校录取，但总算还是收到了几所大学发出的邀请。
d8442f40d941c71ca515c6a317f254192303ac71.translatedText: Ms. Linda Shanklin, Iguodala's mother, had always encouraged her two sons to leave Springfield in the future. But Iguodala actually knows better. It is Illinois that he specifically wants to leave. But after seeing Iguodala's performance, many professional sports experts agreed that he will become a track and field star. But his close friends, including his high school basketball teammate McBride, didn't think so. At this time, Iguodala's head coach in AAU, Larry Butler, ordered his assistant to recruit him. After that, Iguodala was also invited to participate in the Jordan-sponsored Basketball Classic, which also greatly pleased Butler. Butler also lobbied prominent analyst Clark Frank to give Iguodala a higher pick. However, when I entered college, although I was not admitted to the top basketball schools, I finally received invitations from several universities.

1de0f02625425405e1701a10ea4626382f921e75.sourceText: 伊戈达拉一开始就很想去的球队的是阿肯色大学野猪队，但是很不幸是该球队的主教练突然辞职后球队招收球员的名额也变少了。然而好歹天无绝人之路，伊戈达拉的一个好友曾参加过全美麦当劳大赛，认识亚利桑那州大学的主教练鲁特-奥尔森，这给了伊戈达拉去大学打球一线生机，最终他也正是被亚利桑那大学录取。
1de0f02625425405e1701a10ea4626382f921e75.translatedText: The team that Iguodala wanted to go to from the beginning was the University of Arkansas Razorbacks, but unfortunately, after the team's head coach suddenly resigned, the number of players recruited by the team became smaller. However, there is always a road ahead. One of Iguodala's friends had participated in the National McDonald's Game and met the head coach of Arizona State University, Rut Olson. This gave Iguodala a chance to play in college. In the end, he was admitted to the University of Arizona.

231e78e206e0f62ddc8ec2e782dbc3c3113a47df.sourceText: ”当他因裁员被阿肯色大学裁掉后，他和我们通了电话，咨询我们是否对他感兴趣。”奥尔森老爷子说，”我就回答’是的，我们对他很感兴趣。但是我们已经录取过你一次，不想再录取你第二次。我们对你感兴趣，现在你只需要来到这里和我们在一起就行了。”’
231e78e206e0f62ddc8ec2e782dbc3c3113a47df.translatedText: "When he was cut by the University of Arkansas due to layoffs, he got on the phone with us and asked if we were interested in him," Olson said. "I said, 'Yes, we are interested in him. But we have admitted you once and we don't want to admit you a second time. We are interested in you, and now you just need to come here and be with us."'

e379f5a8149647d16061d873cd25b160798c008e.sourceText: 冬季暴风雪横扫美国东海岸！7人死亡2000余航班取消 周日，袭击达拉斯的冷空气系统抵达东海岸。 从中西部地区一路裹挟着暴雪、冻雨等恶劣气象而来的冬季风暴，8日抵达美国东海岸地区，让全美从德州直到新英格兰地区的广大面积都遭受困扰。纽约市从8日下午开始也下起了大雪。气象预报显示，这股冬季风暴的威力将一直持续至周二。 9日降雪将主要集中在纽约州及新英格兰地区中部，而宾州中部则将迎来冻雨。这股冬季风暴周日给西维吉尼亚州带来3到6英寸厚的积雪。德州北部达拉斯附近地区已有三人因灾死亡，3万5千户家庭和工作单位直到周日下午仍然停电。 截至8日晚6点左右，全美已有2238架次的航班取消，5300多趟延误。其中达拉斯-沃思堡国际机场受影响最为严重，共有1500趟左右的航班取消或延误，此外费城、华盛顿的机场也都有数百趟航班受到影响。而降雪、冻雨加上低温的多重作用，让路面变得十分湿滑，给驾车者带来很大隐患。俄亥俄、维吉尼亚等州的道路工人不得不一刻不停地展开清理工作。 而中西部的冷空气恐怕不会那么快结束，周六，达拉斯沃思堡国际机场的气温仅26华摄氏度，达23年以来历史同期最低气温。 在这场暴风雪中，已经至少有7人丧生。全国范围内的交通也因为糟糕的天气形成了大瘫痪，为人们的节日出行造成极大不便。
e379f5a8149647d16061d873cd25b160798c008e.translatedText: Winter blizzard sweeps across the East Coast of the United States! 7 people died and more than 2,000 flights were canceled. On Sunday, the cold air system that hit Dallas reached the East Coast. The winter storm that brought blizzards, freezing rain and other severe weather all the way from the Midwest reached the East Coast of the United States on the 8th, causing trouble across a wide area of ​​the United States from Texas to New England. New York City also began to snow heavily on the afternoon of the 8th. Forecasts show the force of this winter storm will continue into Tuesday. Snowfall on the 9th will be mainly concentrated in central New York State and New England, while freezing rain will hit central Pennsylvania. The winter storm brought 3 to 6 inches of snow to West Virginia on Sunday. Three people have died in the area near Dallas in northern Texas, and 35,000 homes and workplaces were still without power until Sunday afternoon. As of around 6 p.m. on the 8th, 2,238 flights across the United States had been canceled and more than 5,300 were delayed. Among them, Dallas-Fort Worth International Airport was the most severely affected, with a total of about 1,500 flights canceled or delayed. In addition, hundreds of flights were also affected at the airports in Philadelphia and Washington. The multiple effects of snowfall, freezing rain and low temperatures have made the road surface very slippery, posing great risks to motorists. Road crews in Ohio, Virginia and other states had to work non-stop to clean up. The cold air in the Midwest may not end so soon. On Saturday, the temperature at Dallas-Fort Worth International Airport was only 26 degrees Celsius, the lowest temperature for the same period in 23 years of history. At least 7 people have died in this snowstorm. Traffic across the country has also been paralyzed due to the bad weather, causing great inconvenience for people's holiday travel.

911c6fd83487fe6f1eb5d3b7557129c213eeef26.sourceText: 您有没有想要做一天牛仔? 亚利桑那州 基本 牛仔培训 ，西部牛仔风情服饰和度假牧场一应俱全，让您的牛仔体验之旅并非那么遥不可及。从牛仔学院，西部牛仔风情服饰到度假牧场， 亚利桑那州 绝对是牛仔迷的旅游胜地。
911c6fd83487fe6f1eb5d3b7557129c213eeef26.translatedText: Have you ever wanted to be a cowboy for a day? Arizona provides basic cowboy training, western cowboy-style clothing and holiday ranches, making your cowboy experience not so far away. From cowboy academies, western cowboy-style clothing to vacation ranches, Arizona is definitely a tourist destination for cowboy fans.

7d42932d1ab53e4ed262899f24e7e4de19fc85ae.sourceText: 首先，您要在亚利桑那牛仔学院（Arizona Cowboy College）学习成为专业牛仔的入门级知识。这所学院拥有40年建校历史，并不是一般典型性大学。在这里，学员们通过在斯科茨代尔牧场的亲自实践学习如何成为一个”真正的”牛仔。私人及团体课程涵盖从基本骑术，骑马安全知识到如何栓绳，烙印留记，入栏圈和牧场经营等。您将学习所有的马术技能和养马技巧。您可以自由选择一天或三天课程，还有带有工棚住宿为期一周的课程。除7月和8月以外，该课程全年开设。
7d42932d1ab53e4ed262899f24e7e4de19fc85ae.translatedText: First, you will learn the entry-level knowledge of becoming a professional cowboy at Arizona Cowboy College. This college has a history of 40 years and is not a typical university. Here, students learn how to become a "real" cowboy through hands-on experience at the Scottsdale Ranch. Private and group lessons cover everything from basic riding skills and riding safety knowledge to how to tie a rope, branding, pen entry and ranch management. You will learn all the equestrian skills and horse care techniques. You can choose from one- or three-day courses, as well as one-week courses with shed accommodation. The course is offered year-round except July and August.

73bdb5c441d03054ce2313ec3300410e83b513da.sourceText: 由于您已学会怎样骑马及拴马，现在可以加快进行下一步了。一般而言，典型的专业牛仔会买一双牛仔靴。考虑到合脚性和舒适度，纯手工制作的靴子是不错的选择。大多数鞋店提供令人眼花缭乱的皮革选择，细密的针脚和不同鞋跟设计。亚利桑那州的工匠一直在不断完善自己的手艺，包括位于诺加莱斯的保罗邦德皮靴公司（Paul Bond Boot Company），约翰 韦恩（John Wayne）和约翰尼 卡什（Johnny Cash）都曾是这个品牌的忠实客户。在普雷斯科特，当地的皮革工艺家保罗 克劳斯（Paul Krause），可以为您量脚定做一双牛仔靴。您可以造访他的工作室PK Bootmaker，挑选自己喜欢的风格和配饰。如果您身在凤凰城，可以选择大卫?#22467;斯皮诺萨（David Espinoza），这家老店销售手工制作的传统牛仔靴已余40年，您可以在他的实体内选择各式各样的高品质皮革。
73bdb5c441d03054ce2313ec3300410e83b513da.translatedText: Now that you have learned how to ride and tie a horse, you can now speed up to the next step. Generally speaking, the typical professional cowboy will buy a pair of cowboy boots. Handmade boots are a good choice when it comes to fit and comfort. Most shoe stores offer a dizzying selection of leathers, intricate stitching and different heel designs. Arizona artisans have been perfecting their craft, including the Paul Bond Boot Company in Nogales, which counted John Wayne and Johnny Cash among its loyal customers. In Prescott, local leather craftsman Paul Krause can custom-make a pair of cowboy boots for you. You can visit his studio PK Bootmaker and pick out your favorite styles and accessories. If you're in Phoenix, check out David Espinoza, which has been selling handmade traditional cowboy boots for more than 40 years, and you can choose from a wide variety of high-quality leathers at his location.

13b2295c0c6da0699678d370421605970d7b294c.sourceText: 牛仔帽当然也必不可少。若论舒服和合适度，手工制作的牛仔帽的质量绝对无与伦比。位于洞溪的埃里克沃森帽店（Eric Watson’s Hat Shop）继承了采用老式设备和优质材料纯手工制作帽子的优良传统。订制的牛仔帽需30天到45天方可完成。但若您随便去问在他家买牛仔帽的顾客，他们绝对会告诉您：一切漫长的等待都是值得的。这家店甚至可以为你私人定制，添加牧场的标志或特殊的牛仔设计。位于斯科茨代尔的哈利定制帽品（Hally’s Custom Hats）可以定做独一无二的牛仔帽，甚至帮您清理陈旧磨损的帽子让它看起来焕然一新。哈利专注于制帽已有25年，精通于使用诀窍和历久弥新的工艺制作符合现代潮流的牛仔帽。
13b2295c0c6da0699678d370421605970d7b294c.translatedText: A cowboy hat is of course a must. When it comes to comfort and fit, the quality of a handmade cowboy hat is unparalleled. Eric Watson’s Hat Shop in Cave Creek continues the fine tradition of handcrafting hats using vintage equipment and quality materials. Customized cowboy hats take 30 to 45 days to complete. But if you ask any customer who buys a cowboy hat at his store, they will definitely tell you: all the long wait is worth it. The store can even customize it for you, adding a ranch logo or a special cowboy design. Hally’s Custom Hats in Scottsdale can custom-make a one-of-a-kind cowboy hat and even clean up an old, worn hat to make it look brand new. Harry has been specializing in hat making for 25 years and is proficient in using know-how and timeless craftsmanship to make cowboy hats that meet modern trends.

92036c444e5d560debfa2c15c0025e1907214043.sourceText: 牛仔漫游在何方？ 目前，这些牛仔和那些即将成为牛仔的人，可以在通常被称为休闲或度假牧场里找到：养牛场被改造成度假胜地。这些牧场的历史可以追溯到20世纪伊始，当时，随着铁路的扩建，通往美国西部更加方便快捷。随着牧场不断衰落，资金短缺的牧场主将度假牧场作为增收的一种方式。
92036c444e5d560debfa2c15c0025e1907214043.translatedText: Where do the cowboys roam? Currently, these cowboys, and those who would become cowboys, can be found on what are often called recreational or resort ranches: cattle ranches converted into resorts. The ranches date back to the turn of the 20th century, when expansion of railroads made access to the American West easier and faster. As ranches continued to decline, cash-strapped ranchers turned to resort ranching as a way to supplement their income.

84d613d1bfe84a1a3463a977dbae9b11ac4f4f00.sourceText: 如今的度假牧场通常收取全包式票价，其中包括住宿、三餐和一些娱乐项目。许多豪华牧场设有游泳池，水疗中心或其他休闲选择，更不用说一些有氧运动项目，如骑马，入栏圈和拴马等。家庭友好型度假牧场根据客人的不同喜好，既可以为喜欢热闹的您提供一系列娱乐活动，也能为青睐于清净冥想的您提供足够的独处空间。图森市附近的维德牧场酒店（The Tanque Verde Ranch）设有水疗中心，在马不停蹄的一天辛苦奔波之后，在这里您可以享受按摩服务，让酸疼的肌肉彻底放松。这家牧场在2012年被《亚利桑那共和报》评为”最佳度假牧场”。入住的宾客可以早起挤牛奶，白天骑马纵横，晚上欣赏西部舞蹈和牛仔诗歌。
84d613d1bfe84a1a3463a977dbae9b11ac4f4f00.translatedText: Today's resort ranches often charge all-inclusive fares, which include accommodation, meals and some entertainment. Many luxury ranches feature swimming pools, spas, or other recreational options, not to mention a number of aerobic activities such as horseback riding, penning, and tethering. Based on the different preferences of guests, the family-friendly resort ranch can provide a series of entertainment activities for those who like liveliness, and enough space for solitude for those who prefer pure meditation. The Tanque Verde Ranch near Tucson has a spa where you can enjoy a massage to relax your sore muscles after a hard day of running. This ranch was named "Best Resort Ranch" by the Arizona Republic in 2012. Guests staying there can get up early to milk cows, ride horses during the day, and enjoy western dancing and cowboy poetry at night.

12d82e01737ba0339d7d8b21e8443ca3a41ee746.sourceText: 牛仔女郎主题的特色度假选择

d1beb23fd36afb0eb144b4b027e90f1897e892df.sourceText: 以牛仔女郎为主题的度假牧场日益受到青睐。带上您的母亲，姐妹和女友，出发去寻找旧时牛仔女郎独有的乐趣。位于威肯堡的Rancho de los Caballeros牧场推出的”姐妹团”旅游套餐可以让你们一起骑马，篝火旁闲聊及温泉放松。萨萨比德拉奥萨家庭牧场（Rancho de la Osa） 推出的”女牛仔大本营”（Cactus Cowgirls）活动包括鸡尾酒欢迎会，每日骑术课程，西部乡村课程及骑马品酒会。在位于威肯堡的Flying E Ranch，女牛仔可以享受诸如”年度女牛仔周末派对”等特殊的优惠旅游套餐。
d1beb23fd36afb0eb144b4b027e90f1897e892df.translatedText: > Cowgirl-themed holiday ranches are increasingly popular. Grab your moms, sisters, and girlfriends and head out for some old-time cowgirl fun. Rancho de los Caballeros in Wickenburg offers a "sister group" tour package that allows you to ride horses, chat around the campfire, and relax in the hot springs. Cactus Cowgirls at Rancho de la Osa includes a welcome cocktail party, daily riding lessons, country western lessons and horseback riding tastings. At Flying E Ranch in Wickenburg, cowgirls can enjoy special packages such as the Annual Cowgirl Weekend Party.

3949207d5abe6e287e2b74ecba3993d69e9bb5d5.sourceText: 颱风海燕8日侵袭菲律宾，国际媒体喻为30年来最强颱风，所过之处满目疮痍，有22万人口的莱特省独鲁万市受灾最为惨重。目前全省预估死亡人数高达一万人，由于灾情规模太大，搜救缓慢，估计死伤人数还会继续攀升，更有许多人无家可归，急需食物和乾淨饮水。 慈济基金会启动紧急援助行动，已备妥20万人份香积饭、3万条毛毯。第一批3万条毛毯、6万人份香积饭，十二日透过空军C-130赈灾专机分批运往灾区。 十三日起，由40位菲律宾慈济志工组成勘灾小组及医疗小组，将由马尼拉飞往宿雾，再转往灾区关怀，展开第一阶段的勘灾及关怀。勘灾小组已在菲律宾准备 1500 份生活包及日常用品，提供灾民应急之用。医疗小组则由慈济人医会10位医护人员组成，协助灾民紧急医疗服务。后续关怀将俟勘灾后，再针对灾民实际的需求，提供协助与肤慰。 慈济宗教处副主任王运敬说：「宿务跟马尼拉，都成立了指挥中心，特别是宿务距离灾区最近，慈济也跟分支机构联络处点就仓库和慈济人过去的交通安全等问题连繫妥当。」 慈济美国总会召开全美紧急赈灾会议，展开全美募心募款行动。慈济委员将邀约同事、会员、亲友，以及社会善心大德，共同发挥爱心，汇聚善款援助灾民。捐款支票请开【Tzu Chi】，左下角可注明Disaster Fund。若有任何相关问题，欢迎询问各地慈济联络处，电邮：info@us.tzuchi.org或捐款专线：888.989.8244（9 am-6 pm PST）。 新闻窗口：慈济基金会副执行长及慈善志业发展室主任曹惟宗（909-447-7799，分机695） 佛教慈济基金会美国总会 Buddhist Tzu Chi Foundation 1100 S. Valley Center Ave., San Dimas, CA 91773 Web: www.us.tzuchi.org
3949207d5abe6e287e2b74ecba3993d69e9bb5d5.translatedText: Typhoon Haiyan hit the Philippines on the 8th. The international media hailed it as the strongest typhoon in 30 years. The place it passed was devastated. Tacloban City in Leyte Province, with a population of 220,000, was the hardest hit. The current estimated death toll in the province is as high as 10,000. Due to the scale of the disaster and the slow search and rescue efforts, the number of casualties is expected to continue to rise. Many people are homeless and in urgent need of food and clean drinking water. Tzu Chi Foundation has launched an emergency assistance operation and has prepared 200,000 portions of Xiangji rice and 30,000 blankets. The first batch of 30,000 blankets and 60,000 rice dishes were transported to the disaster area in batches on the 12th via the Air Force C-130 disaster relief plane. Starting from the 13th, a disaster investigation team and medical team composed of 40 Filipino Tzu Chi volunteers will fly from Manila to Cebu, and then transfer to the disaster area to provide care and begin the first phase of disaster investigation and care. The disaster investigation team has prepared 1,500 living kits and daily necessities in the Philippines to provide emergency needs for disaster victims. The medical team is composed of 10 medical staff from the Tzu Chi Medical Association to provide emergency medical services to the victims. Follow-up care will be provided after the disaster has been assessed, and then assistance and comfort will be provided based on the actual needs of the victims. Wang Yunjing, deputy director of Tzu Chi’s Religious Affairs Department, said: “Command centers have been set up in Cebu and Manila, especially since Cebu is the closest to the disaster area. Tzu Chi has also properly contacted branch liaison offices on issues such as warehouses and traffic safety for Tzu Chi residents.” Tzu Chi USA held a national emergency disaster relief meeting to launch a nationwide fundraising campaign. Tzu Chi committee members will invite colleagues, members, relatives and friends, as well as well-wishers from society to show their love and pool donations to assist the victims. Please make donation checks to [Tzu Chi] and mark Disaster Fund in the lower left corner. If you have any relevant questions, please feel free to contact Tzu Chi liaison offices in various locations, email: info@us.tzuchi.org or donation hotline: 888.989.8244 (9 am-6 pm PST). News Window: Tzu Chi Foundation Deputy CEO and Director of Charity Development Office Cao Weizong (909-447-7799, extension 695) Buddhist Tzu Chi Foundation USA Buddhist Tzu Chi Foundation 1100 S. Valley Center Ave., San Dimas, CA 91773 Web: www.us.tzuchi.org
