88badffe69a9e94787f5d9f4770488fe2db0ffc2.sourceText: 2013年11月30日，12月1日，香港著名歌手陈奕迅在San Jose State Event Center举办了名为”Life”的演唱会，11月30日的演唱会门票在当天就售空。主办方在歌迷们的一再邀请下加入了12月1日的一场。来自凤凰城的歌迷们，飞往San Jose一睹天王级歌手的现场表演。
88badffe69a9e94787f5d9f4770488fe2db0ffc2.translatedText: On November 30, 2013, and December 1, 2013, the famous Hong Kong singer Eason Chan held a concert called "Life" at the San Jose State Event Center. The tickets for the November 30 concert were sold out on the same day. The organizer joined the show on December 1st after repeated invitations from fans. Fans from Phoenix flew to San Jose to see the king-level singer's live performance.

f3d741ba5ca8e65f66f8810c4d820768442e6cd1.sourceText: 12月1日的San Jose气温比凤凰城低很多，穿着大棉袄来到了演唱会现场，又一次看到座无虚席的场面。8时演唱正式开始，身着绿色甩袖服装的陈奕迅出现在了舞台中央，全场歌迷欢呼雀跃。
f3d741ba5ca8e65f66f8810c4d820768442e6cd1.translatedText: The temperature in San Jose on December 1st was much lower than that in Phoenix. Wearing a large cotton-padded jacket, I came to the concert and once again saw a packed house. The concert officially started at 8 o'clock. Eason Chan, wearing a green sleeveless costume, appeared in the center of the stage, and the fans cheered.

6965bde4f360dfd1811cee1b8c5da46262fea940.sourceText: 人来人往，岁月如歌，太空漫游，大人，幸福摩天轮，十年等等脍炙人口的歌曲，把听众带入了成长的历史。这些不同年代的歌曲总会带来不同的回忆，歌迷们与陈奕迅台上呼应，共同歌唱。这个以”Life”为主题的演唱会，每首歌曲的歌词，都传达了生命和生活的主题，甚至舞台的伴舞，都是木偶，机器人，小丑等角色…..让听众感觉时间的匆匆流过，人们追着很自认为是”重要”的东西，忽略了很多”不重要”的东西。而那些生活中的小人物，面对柴米油盐的挣扎，还依然每天笑着，有自嘲，更有超凡魅力的阿Q精神。在歌曲的叙述中，似乎那些小人物先领悟到了生活的真谛，那些被忽略的生活的细节，才是’Life’。陈奕迅也如那些有些怪异的小玩偶一样，在音乐的世界，嬉戏人生。
6965bde4f360dfd1811cee1b8c5da46262fea940.translatedText: People come and go, Time is like a song, A Space Odyssey, Adults, Happy Wheel, Ten Years and other popular songs bring the audience into the history of growth. These songs from different eras will always bring different memories. Fans echoed Eason Chan on stage and sang together. In this concert with the theme of "Life", the lyrics of each song convey the theme of life and life. Even the backup dancers on the stage are all puppets, robots, clowns and other characters... It makes the audience feel that time is passing by in a hurry. People are chasing things that they think are "important" and ignoring many "unimportant" things. And those little people in life, faced with the struggle of daily necessities, still laugh every day, have self-deprecation, and have the charismatic Ah Q spirit. In the narrative of the song, it seems that the little people first realize the true meaning of life, and those ignored details of life are ‘Life’. Eason Chan is just like those weird little dolls, playing around in the world of music.

85bf97a03ee35e45140d02c1e30b4d2d9ea5d6aa.sourceText: 陈奕迅(Eason)近年的歌，如果你用心去听，从歌词乃至其演绎中，不难发现所呈现的氛围、形态，充满更深刻的「人味」，是我们经历过、感动过、纳闷过、忐忑过，勾起灵魂深处的共鸣。像一位朋友在身旁细细和你诉说自己的心事，然而他的故事，又像面镜子给你认清自己。从06年推出生命蜕变后产生疑惑的「Life Continues’」，一路走来，到去年玩复古却内省人生的「3mm」，陈奕迅为乐迷精心送上的一场人生告白，坦承面对自我，没有太多策划性的举动，却触动你的心弦。
85bf97a03ee35e45140d02c1e30b4d2d9ea5d6aa.translatedText: Eason Chan (Eason) in recent years If you listen to the song attentively, from the lyrics and even its interpretation, it is not difficult to find that the atmosphere and form presented are full of a deeper "human flavor". It is what we have experienced, been moved, wondered, and worried, and evokes resonance deep in the soul. It's like a friend who tells you his or her thoughts carefully by your side, but his story is like a mirror that helps you recognize yourself. From the release of "Life Continues'" in 2006, which caused doubts after the transformation of life, to last year's "3mm" that played retro but introspected life, Eason Chan carefully sent a life confession to music fans, admitting to facing oneself, there are not many planned actions, but it touches your heartstrings.

143363f0861c5bdd6732ed5e11d948f56cd3b820.sourceText: 现场歌迷的热情让陈奕迅返场感谢歌迷厚爱
143363f0861c5bdd6732ed5e11d948f56cd3b820.translatedText: The enthusiasm of the fans at the scene made Eason Chan return to the stage to thank the fans for their love.

832e061b565aa6e8810dc780cd2a3c2bdc43f71e.sourceText: 随着全美大降温，12月9日凤凰城的最低温度也接近了0摄氏度。周三，Casa Grande, Gila Bend and Wickenburg这些地区还将有接近0摄氏度的气温。专家提出预警，请大家注意保暖，同时为一些无法移到室内的植物做好防冻措施。Flagstaff出现了强降雪天气，高速I17南部已经被大雪封住，有两辆四轮驱动的SUV都陷入大雪中，该地区的驾驶员应当特别留意开车安全。
832e061b565aa6e8810dc780cd2a3c2bdc43f71e.translatedText: As temperatures dropped across the United States, the lowest temperature in Phoenix on December 9 was close to 0 degrees Celsius. On Wednesday, areas such as Casa Grande, Gila Bend and Wickenburg will also see temperatures close to 0 degrees Celsius. Experts have issued an early warning, asking everyone to keep warm and take antifreeze measures for some plants that cannot be moved indoors. Heavy snowfall has occurred in Flagstaff. The southern part of Highway I17 has been blocked by heavy snow. Two four-wheel drive SUVs were stuck in the heavy snow. Drivers in the area should pay special attention to driving safety.

e4d9a378157232027d6d1910f4a07cf3f85cbb83.sourceText: 亚裔家庭年消费6.1万全美第一 五年内购买力飚1万亿 市场研究公司尼尔森近期专门针对亚裔消费者进行了一项调查，调查数据显示，美国亚裔人群的购买力自1990年以来上涨了5.23倍，在今年达到了7184亿美元。如果美国亚裔消费者组成一个国家，将成为世界第18大经济体。 根据尼尔森调查公司的报告，在未来五年内，亚裔美国人的购买力将飙升至1万亿美元。目前，28%的亚裔家庭年收入超过10万美元，而仅有18%的美国家庭年收入超过10万美元。
e4d9a378157232027d6d1910f4a07cf3f85cbb83.translatedText: Asian households rank first in the United States with an annual consumption of RMB 61,000, and their purchasing power will soar by RMB 1 trillion in five years. Market research company Nielsen recently conducted a survey specifically on Asian consumers. The survey data shows that the purchasing power of Asian Americans has increased 5.23 times since 1990, reaching US$718.4 billion this year. If Asian American consumers formed a country, it would be the 18th largest economy in the world. According to a report by the Nielsen research company, the purchasing power of Asian Americans will soar to $1 trillion in the next five years. Currently, 28% of Asian families have an annual income of more than $100,000, while only 18% of American families have an annual income of more than $100,000.

969408033fe8c66169ef84861c022abad1f2a796.translatedText: A series of tornadoes in the U.S. Midwest has claimed 8 lives and affected 53 million people in 12 states. Dozens of tornadoes swept across the Midwestern United States on the 17th local time. Currently, the tornado...

205e38a86eed98df9c7370c1286fc8e177ad18e6.sourceText: 风暴减弱之后，星期一凌晨向东北方向移动。尽管风速已经下降到每小时50英里，仍然可能导致停电和干扰航班起降。
205e38a86eed98df9c7370c1286fc8e177ad18e6.translatedText: After the storm weakened, it moved northeastward early Monday morning. Although wind speeds have dropped to 50 miles per hour, they can still cause power outages and disrupt flight takeoffs and landings.

01049fd9d0123674ea3ebbd84dbbbdbc9ceaa3c2.sourceText: 据福克斯新闻（Fox News）报道，伊利诺伊州中部、芝加哥西南大约140英里的华盛顿镇（Washington）受灾尤其严重。州警皮尔斯（Dustin Pierce）说，龙卷风在该镇切出一条八分之一英里（200米）宽的路径。
01049fd9d0123674ea3ebbd84dbbbdbc9ceaa3c2.translatedText: According to Fox News, the town of Washington (Washington) in central Illinois, about 140 miles southwest of Chicago, was particularly severely affected. State Trooper Dustin Pierce said the tornado cut a path about an eighth of a mile (200 meters) wide through the town.

8882de276ca03bad5d04413be991a881b56bea17.sourceText: 伊利诺伊州共和党众议员肖克（Aaron Schock）说，”整个社区都被抹去。…….我去看一些20-30户人家的小区，没有一所房子留下。”他补充一句，”华盛顿整个镇都被摧毁。”
8882de276ca03bad5d04413be991a881b56bea17.translatedText: Illinois Republican Rep. Aaron Schock said, "Whole communities were wiped out. ... I went to see some 20-30-family neighborhoods, and there wasn't a house left." He added, "The entire town of Washington was destroyed."

8178037987132821aa196718307512d32fc162e3.sourceText: 国家海洋和大气局说，他们收到81个龙卷风的报告。恶劣天气在伊利诺伊、印第安纳、肯塔基、密苏里和俄亥俄造成严重灾害。
8178037987132821aa196718307512d32fc162e3.translatedText: The National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration said they received reports of 81 tornadoes. Severe weather caused severe damage in Illinois, Indiana, Kentucky, Missouri and Ohio.

4207c8d7bcf618c56801f86ceaea475a505480f3.translatedText: Taiwan Foreign Trade Association signs MOU with Arizona The Taiwan Foreign Trade Association and the Arizona Department of Commerce (ACA) in the United States signed a cooperation memorandum yesterday (13th)...

169e76cada5b5c762c300ad4d3dd8754e6c80431.sourceText: 台湾外贸协会昨（13）日与美国亚利桑那州商务厅（ACA）共同签署合作备忘录（MOU），贸协表示，此备忘录是台美在今年3月恢复双边「贸易暨投资架构协定」（TIFA）会谈后，贸协与美国商务机构签订的第三个合作备忘录，为推进两国合作再进一步。 贸协与亚利桑纳州昨日签署经贸合作备忘录，在外贸协会董事长王志刚及亚利桑那州州长布鲁尔(Janice Brewer)共同见证下，由贸协秘书长黄文荣及ACA厅长Sandra Watson共同签署。贸协表示，不仅为台美贸易拓展再添新猷，且有助于我国厂商建立与相关产业美商合作。
169e76cada5b5c762c300ad4d3dd8754e6c80431.translatedText: The Taiwan Foreign Trade Association and the Arizona Department of Commerce (ACA) in the United States yesterday (13th) jointly signed a memorandum of cooperation (MOU). The Taiwan Foreign Trade Association stated that this memorandum is the third cooperation memorandum signed between Taiwan and the United States after the resumption of bilateral "Trade and Investment Architecture Agreement" (TIFA) talks in March this year. It will further promote cooperation between the two countries. The Trade Association and Arizona signed a memorandum of economic and trade cooperation yesterday. It was witnessed by Wang Zhigang, Chairman of the Foreign Trade Association, and Janice Brewer, the Governor of Arizona. It was signed by Huang Wenrong, Secretary-General of the Trade Association, and Sandra Watson, Director of the ACA. The Trade Association stated that it will not only add new opportunities to the expansion of trade between Taiwan and the United States, but also help Chinese manufacturers establish cooperation with American businessmen in related industries.

4406d140d9780b3ec79eafcb694e98207232f058.sourceText: 贸协于去年10月间，就与美国商务部国际贸易署签订合作意向书，今年又陆续与美国密苏里州、加州及亚利桑那州的商务机构签署合作备忘录。
4406d140d9780b3ec79eafcb694e98207232f058.translatedText: The Trade Association signed a letter of intent for cooperation with the International Trade Administration of the U.S. Department of Commerce in October last year, and this year it successively signed cooperation memoranda with business agencies in Missouri, California and Arizona.

92c54ceb284cce4dbda1f8b1d445e047e712e7b4.sourceText: 银行开闸 5%首付又回来 对于手头现款不足的房屋买主，这也许是个好消息：多家银行放宽信贷，要求客户只要拿出…
92c54ceb284cce4dbda1f8b1d445e047e712e7b4.translatedText: Banks are opening, and 5% down payment is back. This may be good news for house buyers who are short of cash on hand: many banks are relaxing credit, requiring customers to just come up with...

cbbaa855a3d7615f8026305aef4ef1b72fb28d8a.sourceText: 对于手头现款不足的房屋买主，这也许是个好消息：多家银行放宽信贷，要求客户只要拿出5%的首期付款，就能得到抵押贷款买房。
cbbaa855a3d7615f8026305aef4ef1b72fb28d8a.translatedText: This may be good news for house buyers who are short of cash on hand: many banks are relaxing credit, requiring customers to just come up with 5% down payment to get a mortgage loan to buy a house.

27857183ff3cad53c173234c81e3567dcd6a0723.sourceText: 自从房地产市场泡沫破灭以后，买主都要拿出相当于房价20%的首期付款才能找商业银行谈判房贷，否则只有转向联邦住房局（FHA）寻找低首付贷款。
27857183ff3cad53c173234c81e3567dcd6a0723.translatedText: Since the real estate market bubble burst, buyers have to come up with a down payment equivalent to 20% of the house price before they can negotiate a mortgage with a commercial bank. Otherwise, they have to turn to the Federal Housing Administration (FHA) for low down payment loans.

693f0f659ad3bee8bc044e3c65da6dc2a8b595d7.sourceText: 现在，TD银行（TD Bank）、美国银行（Bank of America）和富国银行（Well Fargo）都为最低只有5%首付的客户提供抵押贷款。
693f0f659ad3bee8bc044e3c65da6dc2a8b595d7.translatedText: Now, TD Bank, Bank of America and Wells Fargo all offer mortgages to customers with as little as 5% down payment.

7725bae4417240d412cabaef68ce559c7f3090fd.sourceText: TD银行的”正确步骤”抵押贷款不仅允许借款人以5%的首付得到贷款，而且允许他们将从亲友那里得到相当于房价2%的馈赠纳入首付，因此他们实际上真正需要的首付只有房价的3%。
7725bae4417240d412cabaef68ce559c7f3090fd.translatedText: >TD Bank's "Right Step" mortgage not only allows borrowers to get a loan with a 5% down payment, but also allows them to incorporate gifts equivalent to 2% of the house price from relatives and friends into the down payment, so the down payment they actually really need is only 3% of the house price.

db695fe451c7d8dbc8e1437928670700a8417e17.sourceText: 报道说，出现这种改变的原因之一是市场机会。联邦住房局在房地产市场崩溃时期全面接管低首付市场。接手那些风险贷款之后，一度造成联邦住房局储备枯竭，迫使它增加开支。
db695fe451c7d8dbc8e1437928670700a8417e17.translatedText: reports that one of the reasons for this change is market opportunity. The Federal Housing Administration took over the low-down-payment market in full during the housing market collapse. Taking over those risky loans depleted FHA reserves and forced it to increase spending.

51b9f1c2932b090b851a9a7875fba7eda85916ac.sourceText: 过去两年来，联邦住房局提高收费。今年它要求借款人为整个贷款周期购买私人抵押贷款保险，那种昂贵的要求迫使许多潜在的借款人转向其它机构。
51b9f1c2932b090b851a9a7875fba7eda85916ac.translatedText: Over the past two years, FHA has increased fees. This year it required borrowers to purchase private mortgage insurance for the entire life of the loan, an expensive requirement that forced many would-be borrowers to look elsewhere.

d06caa5f9c34912c277231f858edd9c2321098e7.sourceText: 尽管低首付抵押贷款对于私人银行是个高风险业务，导致很多银行此前不敢接手，但房价上涨降低了它的赌博性。同时，银行认为它们能比联邦住房局提供更好的条件。
d06caa5f9c34912c277231f858edd9c2321098e7.translatedText: Although low down payment mortgage loans are a high-risk business for private banks, which has caused many banks to be afraid to take over them before, rising housing prices have reduced its gambling nature. At the same time, banks believe they can offer better terms than FHA.

953d070e1af8929409c339ea19c7d2103fcc70d6.sourceText: TD银行零售借贷部主任霍伦斯坦纳（Malcom Hollensteiner）说，联邦住房局提高收费，降低市场份额，我们推出联邦住房局房贷的替代品。
953d070e1af8929409c339ea19c7d2103fcc70d6.translatedText: Malcom Hollensteiner, director of the retail lending department of TD Bank, said that the FHA has increased its fees and reduced market share, so we are launching alternatives to FHA mortgages.

471b99c9c71b2d6fbf3566c9fb44a29ee9531eef.sourceText: 尽管私人银行也要求5%首付用户购买私人抵押贷款保险，但他们要求的购买期限仅仅是到屋主住宅净值达到房价20%的时候，而不是整个贷款周期。
471b99c9c71b2d6fbf3566c9fb44a29ee9531eef.translatedText: Although private banks also require users with a 5% down payment to purchase private mortgage insurance, the purchase period they require is only when the homeowner's home equity reaches 20% of the house price, not the entire loan cycle.

29219bdc2074693b56219f51324c49518faabd0c.sourceText: 那种差别累积起来数字可观：要为20万美元固定利率抵押贷款的房贷购买30年的保险费，总额为6万美元。
29219bdc2074693b56219f51324c49518faabd0c.translatedText: That difference adds up to a sizable sum: 30 years of insurance premiums on a $200,000 fixed-rate mortgage would total $60,000.

dc4a061cbddff6540bab3440591f0cd00e87c8ab.sourceText: 亲爱的亚省中国同胞们：

fa45be3d0aa92aabb620eee61146d7bf1da53dd1.sourceText: 距离 ABC 10 月 16 日播放有”杀光所有中国人”言论的 Jimmy Kimmel” 儿童圆桌”节目已经有三周了，虽然 ABC 娱乐节目组在华人团体的强烈抗议下发了道歉信， Jimmy Kimmel 本人也在洛杉矶的华人示威集会上作了非正式的道歉，但是”我们只是娱乐”的道歉缺乏诚意， ABC 娱乐节目组和 Kimmel 本人也没有受到任何实质性的处罚。全国华人将在 11/9 在各个城市举行示威游行活动，谴责 ABC 放任种族仇恨和屠杀言论的传播，发表对族裔平等和尊重的诉求。我们亚省的华人团体也将于 11 月 9 日在凤凰城 ABC15 门口举行集会。关于此事件的更多背景内容，请参考后附链接。
fa45be3d0aa92aabb620eee61146d7bf1da53dd1.translatedText: It will be 16th from ABC on October 16th. It has been three weeks since Jimmy Kimmel's "Children's Roundtable" program aired in Japan with the "Kill all Chinese" remarks. Although ABC Entertainment issued a letter of apology amid strong protests from Chinese groups, and Jimmy Kimmel himself also made an informal apology at a Chinese demonstration in Los Angeles, the "we are just entertainment" apology lacked sincerity, and neither ABC Entertainment nor Kimmel himself received any substantive punishment. Chinese people across the country will hold demonstrations in various cities on November 9 to condemn ABC for allowing the spread of racial hatred and massacre remarks, and to express their demands for ethnic equality and respect. Our Chinese community in Alberta will also hold a rally in front of ABC15 in Phoenix on November 9th. For more background on this incident, please refer to the attached link.

d0f8efca8dd44ed720a0cccc27f3a944935a8451.sourceText: [ 集会时间 ] 11/9/2013 周六上午 10 点到下午 1 点

744b27553bc7a571d1bac60dbd39305a20a374e9.sourceText: [ 集会地点 ] ABC15 门口。地址： 515 North 44th Street, Phoenix, AZ 。在中国城的对面，大家可以把车停在中国城欣欣超市的停车场，走到 44 街马路对面去集合。找到其他带着标语牌的同胞就可以了。我们正在跟市政府和警察局申请许可，如果地点有变动会在周五前通知大家。
744b27553bc7a571d1bac60dbd39305a20a374e9.translatedText: [Meeting Location] ABC15 door. Address: 515 North 44th Street, Phoenix, AZ. Opposite Chinatown, you can park your car in the parking lot of Xinxin Supermarket in Chinatown and walk across the street to 44th Street to gather. Just find other compatriots with placards. We are applying for permission from the city government and the police department, and will notify everyone before Friday if the location changes.

8b1201019a5d04e448fdf45a279c7ad45fd1ac44.sourceText: [ 标语牌 ] 请不要用人身攻击和种族歧视的言论来应对种族歧视， 要写能让其他种族、其他人群共鸣的普世价值的标语。标语可以手写或在FEDEX/UBS 打印。 个人携带的标语牌和宣传片应和集会主题相关，不涉及其它政治诉求。

cfc5759d37cf526617b8805c759d8b5d4878a30b.sourceText: [ 其它形式 ] 如果您周六上午不能参加集会，您可以在白宫调查请愿投票 https://petitions.whitehouse.gov/petition/investigate-jimmy-kimmel-kids-table-government-shutdown-show-abc-network/tLxzbBjg 。 截止 11 月 6 日，请愿签名已有 9 8843 ，还差 1157 ，请呼吁更多人参与请愿！你也可以给你的 Congressman 和 Senator 或者给 Kimmel show 的广告商写信抗议。

0d6001366543101acfb9de1ed320474aaecc9093.sourceText: 我们希望通过这些努力让华人在美国不再是被忽视和轻易调侃的对象，为我们争取一个更加平等和开放的社会环境，让我们的孩子能够在更多的尊重和友爱中成长。这是一个让当地媒体和社区听到我们声音的好机会，请带上你的孩子，动员你的朋友家人一起来参加这个集会吧！

52412a9f18f05a00c5ecbf4fad1753ea5a12609b.translatedText: Dust storm in Arizona, USA, caused 19 vehicles to hit 3 people in a row and killed 3 According to the National Broadcasting Corporation, a thick sandstorm passed through Arizona on the 29th.

5ae8dc6ed3379a77b377fbf8f99bcf3a8f7e347d.sourceText: 据美国国家广播公司报道，一股浓厚的沙尘暴29日穿越亚利桑那州10号州际公路，狂风尘土顿时将那一路段能见度降为零，引起19辆汽车连环撞，3人死亡，12人受伤。
5ae8dc6ed3379a77b377fbf8f99bcf3a8f7e347d.translatedText: According to the National Broadcasting Corporation, a thick sandstorm passed through Interstate 10 in Arizona on the 29th. The strong wind and dust suddenly reduced the visibility on that section to zero, causing a pile-up of 19 cars, killing 3 people and injuring 12 others.

645d41c8916ec93c0f3d0cce277826550f5734f1.sourceText: NBC News报道说，在亚利桑那州首府凤凰城到图森的那段公路发生车祸后，急救人员晚上要打着手电营救被困人员。亚利桑那公共安全局官员说，他们要用机械打开卷入车祸的10辆商业卡车、7辆轿车、一辆油罐车和一辆活动房屋车救人。
645d41c8916ec93c0f3d0cce277826550f5734f1.translatedText: NBC News reported that after a car accident occurred on the stretch of road from Phoenix, the capital of Arizona, to Tucson, first responders had to use flashlights at night to rescue trapped people. Arizona Department of Public Safety officials said they would use machinery to open 10 commercial trucks, seven cars, a tanker truck and a mobile home involved in the crash to rescue people.

f79cb38a891c0f1315511e707ff93f7acb82d380.sourceText: 电视画面显示，至少一辆轿车被两辆18轮大卡车挤压，有的汽车则在亚利桑那中南部皮卡措山峰附近被卡在大钻机下。医疗直升机将几名伤者送往图森和凤凰城医院，公共安全局官员说，至少一人伤势危急。来自华盛顿州密德镇的76岁老人史密斯是死者之一。他妻子受伤，但官方没有透露她的伤势。另外两名遇难者的姓名还没有公布。
f79cb38a891c0f1315511e707ff93f7acb82d380.translatedText: TV footage showed that at least one car was squeezed by two 18-wheel trucks, and some cars were stuck under a large drilling rig near the Picacuo Peak in central and southern Arizona. Medical helicopters flew several injured to Tucson and Phoenix hospitals, and Department of Public Safety officials said at least one person was in critical condition. Smith, a 76-year-old man from Meade, Washington, was one of the deceased. His wife was injured, but officials did not disclose the extent of her injuries. The names of the other two victims have not been released.

9feee48bd852af1b5a861c67afd38c57ba99d308.sourceText: 美国公共安全局调查人员正在访问连环撞车祸幸存者，以确定其原因。该局官员库克说，连环撞可能包括三次到五次车祸。那些信息来自开车人和目击者。库克说，10号公路那个路段历史上就以沙尘暴出名。这次连环撞时，有人报告路上能见度为零，由于车辆行驶速度很快，人们当时都惊呆了。
9feee48bd852af1b5a861c67afd38c57ba99d308.translatedText: U.S. Department of Public Safety investigators are interviewing survivors of the pileup to determine the cause. Bureau official Cook said the pileup could include three to five crashes. That information comes from motorists and witnesses. Cook said that section of Highway 10 is historically known for sandstorms. At the time of the pileup, some people reported zero visibility on the road, and people were stunned because of the speed of the vehicles.

83f62a0ef0ba2e6d7387064fa69b0d94efc2972e.sourceText: 美国国家气象局在沙尘暴之前不久发出警告称，当地风速为每小时30英里。10号公路部分路段关闭超过5个小时。(老任)
83f62a0ef0ba2e6d7387064fa69b0d94efc2972e.translatedText: The National Weather Service issued a warning shortly before the dust storm, saying local winds were gusting to 30 miles per hour. Parts of Highway 10 were closed for more than five hours. (Lao Ren)

ce5e5b27a7208fb5cd480eacfa9054f1143631ed.translatedText: More than 200 Chinese people in Phoenix gathered at ABC15 on November 9 to protest against racial discrimination More than 200 Phoenix Chinese people gathered in front of the ABC15 building on the morning of November 9th...

bcbfe4b16f4dc7e8074961cd145a97d9cb426d7d.sourceText: 200多凤凰城华人11月9日上午在ABC15大楼前集会，抗议ABC10月16日录播的Jimmy Kimmel Show在”儿童圆桌”部分鼓励6岁幼童说出”杀光中国人”的骇人言论，要求ABC 正式道歉，撤销Kimmel 节目，并公布在台内加强种族平等和文化包容教育的方案。这是11月9日在全美各地25个城市华人自发组织的抗议示威的一部分。CBS5, Fox10, 和ABC15 均到场采访。
bcbfe4b16f4dc7e8074961cd145a97d9cb426d7d.translatedText: More than 200 Phoenix Chinese people gathered in front of the ABC15 building on the morning of November 9th to protest against the Jimmy Kimmel Show taped by ABC on October 16th in the "Children's Roundtable" segment where a 6-year-old child was encouraged to make shocking remarks such as "kill all the Chinese", and demanded that ABC formally apologize and withdraw Kimmel. program, and announced plans to strengthen racial equality and cultural inclusion education in Taiwan. This was part of a spontaneous protest demonstration organized by Chinese in 25 cities across the United States on November 9. CBS5, Fox10, and ABC15 were on hand to interview.

817758aa170d09e8f3e760279a841819ca01f791.sourceText: 两百多华人参加集会抗议美国ＡＢＣ的种族言论
817758aa170d09e8f3e760279a841819ca01f791.translatedText: More than two hundred Chinese people participated in a rally to protest against the racial remarks of ABC in the United States

1f5ff48af7f45fdde17d9edebb0e5db484efb344.sourceText: 2013年10月16日，美国ABC电视台播出了事先录制的Jimmy Kimmel Live Show，当主持人Jimmy Kimmel先生与几个5、6岁的孩子谈到”如何偿还美国所欠中国的巨额国债”时，一个6岁男孩回答说：”杀掉所有的中国人”。Jimmy Kimmel先生随后又向孩子们提问：”我们应该允许中国人活着吗？”这段带有明显种族歧视意味和暴力杀戮色彩的节目片段，非但没有被编辑删除，反而在ABC电视台及互联网上进行了播放。因而引起了美国华裔及亚裔社区的极大愤慨与不满，并引发了近日席卷美国各地的抗议示威游行。
1f5ff48af7f45fdde17d9edebb0e5db484efb344.translatedText: On October 16, 2013, the American ABC TV station broadcast a pre-recorded Jimmy Kimmel Live Show. When the host Jimmy When Mr. Kimmel talked to several 5 and 6-year-old children about "how to repay the huge national debt that the United States owes to China," a 6-year-old boy replied: "Kill all the Chinese." Mr. Jimmy Kimmel then asked the children: "Should we allow the Chinese to live?" This segment of the program, which had obvious racial undertones and violent killings, was not edited and deleted, but was instead broadcast on ABC TV and the Internet. This has caused great indignation and dissatisfaction among the Chinese and Asian American communities, and triggered protests and demonstrations that have swept across the United States in recent days.

051d236c44ed19ecb982a25eef2a0e5a94ad25a8.sourceText: 凤凰城的抗议活动从上午10点开始，在井然有序中持续了3个小时。到场的有四个月大的婴儿也有花甲老人。很多华人家庭带着孩子全家出动，并称来示威的主要目的是为了孩子能够得到更公平安全的学校和社会环境。大家打着”Teach Kids to Love, not to Kill（教育孩子爱而不是杀戮）”,”Hate Speech Today, Hate Crime tomorrow（今天的仇恨言论，明天的恶性犯罪）”等标语条幅，喊着”Shame on ABC, Shame on Kimmel（ABC 丢人，Kimmel 丢人）”等口号，在44街、Van Buren路口和ABC15大厦门口抗议示威。不少路过的车辆鸣喇叭表示对示威活动的支持。
051d236c44ed19ecb982a25eef2a0e5a94ad25a8.translatedText: The protest in Phoenix started at 10 a.m. and lasted for three hours in an orderly manner. There were four-month-old babies and elderly people in their sixties present. Many Chinese families came out with their children, saying that the main purpose of the demonstration was to provide their children with a fairer and safer school and social environment. Everyone held banners with slogans such as "Teach Kids to Love, not to Kill" and "Hate Speech Today, Hate Crime tomorrow" and shouted slogans such as "Shame on ABC, Shame on Kimmel" and protested at the intersection of 44th Street, Van Buren intersection and the ABC15 building. Many passing vehicles honked their horns to show their support for the demonstrations.

be186f42c6c6b1783c68c9baa771d56943aa6688.sourceText: 占美国人口1.2%的华裔族群向来以勤恳工作、遵纪守法著称，并很少卷入政治活动，也因此往往成为美国反种族歧视和文化多元化教育中被忽视的一部分。此次华人再次成为ABC恶意调侃的对象，一方面折射出美国民众对本国国债危机的忧心正转化成对大债主中国的恶意，另一方面也正体现了华人群体在美国群众政治舞台上的缺失。到场维持秩序的警员表示他负责少数族裔事务多年，这是三年来第一次有亚裔走上街头为自己维权，至少这是一个令人欣慰的转变。此次凤凰城的活动主要由当地华人高科技协会和各校友会、中文学校牵头组织，组织者称要求ABC道歉和撤除Kimmel节目只是短期目标，他们希望通过这次抗议和后续的活动能够提高当地社区对华裔的尊重，消除暴力和族裔隔阂，敦促主流媒体在教育中起到正面引导的作用。
be186f42c6c6b1783c68c9baa771d56943aa6688.translatedText: The Chinese ethnic group, which accounts for 1.2% of the U.S. population, has always been known for their hard work and law-abiding, and are rarely involved in political activities. Therefore, they often become a neglected part of anti-racial discrimination and cultural diversity education in the United States. This time, the Chinese have once again become the target of ABC's malicious ridicule. On the one hand, it reflects that the American people's worries about their country's national debt crisis are turning into ill will towards China, the big creditor. On the other hand, it also reflects the lack of the Chinese community in the American mass political stage. The police officer who attended the scene to maintain order said that he has been responsible for ethnic minority affairs for many years. This is the first time in three years that Asians have taken to the streets to defend their rights. At least this is a gratifying change. The Phoenix event was mainly organized by the local Chinese High-tech Association, alumni associations, and Chinese schools. The organizers said that asking ABC to apologize and remove Kimmel's program was only a short-term goal. They hope that through this protest and subsequent activities, they can increase the local community's respect for Chinese Americans, eliminate violence and ethnic barriers, and urge mainstream media to play a positive guiding role in education.

6fffa64487e180012c9cd52bbd34b68972187c88.sourceText: 全美二十几个城市一致行动，华人社区不再是一盘散沙，不再是各自为战。美国社会将会意识到华人的声音不可忽视，华人的尊严不可轻辱。为了族群的尊严和权益，为了华人的下一代，今天这只是开始。

American society will realize that the voices of the Chinese cannot be ignored and the dignity of the Chinese cannot be lightly insulted. For the dignity and rights of the ethnic group, and for the next generation of Chinese people, today is just the beginning.

b14d602496f032a253a2d6297bf2841ee973cfd0.sourceText: 实际行动展现了在美华人的另一面，华人不再甘于做一个只会勤恳工作却默默无闻的族群，我们开始行动起来为了应得的尊重和权益而呐喊。这不仅仅是为了反对哪个电视节目或哪句话，而是为了创造更公平安全的生活和工作环境，为了我们子孙后代创造有尊严的未来。今天北美华人正在创造历史，这两百多人是这段激动人心的历史的一部分。
b14d602496f032a253a2d6297bf2841ee973cfd0.translatedText: Practical actions show another side of the Chinese in the United States. The Chinese are no longer willing to be a group that only works hard but is unknown. We have begun to take action and cry out for the respect and rights we deserve. This is not just about opposing a TV show or a sentence, but about creating a fairer and safer living and working environment and a dignified future for our children and grandchildren. Today, the Chinese in North America are making history, and these two hundred people are part of this exciting history.

67bd3fa536df1bfbe9c36b8892380d408e62c9ea.sourceText: (10/20/2013 希望中文学校供稿) 秋雨过后的降温，衣橱里的或艳丽、或素雅的丝巾也到了出场之时。一方优质丝巾是初秋外套的最佳配饰，杂志街拍中的秋日丽人总令人心驰神往。
67bd3fa536df1bfbe9c36b8892380d408e62c9ea.translatedText: (10/20/2013 Contributed by Hope Chinese School) As the temperature cools down after the autumn rain, it’s time for the gorgeous or elegant silk scarves in the wardrobe to appear. A high-quality silk scarf is the best accessory for an early autumn coat. The autumn beauties in magazine street photos are always fascinating.

e3a784955aa91ee05dbcd68553a948a8349ead2c.sourceText: 记得我们曾一齐灿烂过春季，可不知大家是否还记得三种丝巾的系法。是否在某些场合也曾拿起丝巾装扮过而让众人们眼前一亮；是否丝巾上手，即便照葫芦画瓢，却这边高高突起，那边又耷拉下去，手中这方丝物像顽童一般不听使唤，几个回合后，只得灰心丧气地胡乱一裹便了；是否觉得什么仪表形象，什么独特魅力都与自己无关，还是做回原来的我最真。
e3a784955aa91ee05dbcd68553a948a8349ead2c.translatedText: I remember that we had a glorious spring together, but I wonder if you still remember the three ways to tie silk scarves. Have you ever picked up a silk scarf to dress up on some occasions and made everyone shine? Have you ever used a silk scarf, even if you draw a gourd, but it sticks out high here and droops there. The square silk object in your hand is like a naughty child. After a few rounds, you can only wrap it up in frustration; whether you feel that any appearance or unique charm has nothing to do with you, or is it truest to be the original me?

8578b3cbf7e7ea9bc83e41eec7c2dd9712084905.sourceText: 不过如此，未免也太辜负这个季节的一番盛情，也暴殄了那些美丽又高价的丝巾。是呵，有哪个女人会出说美丽与我无关这样违心的话呢。相约在秋季，让我们重现美丽的丝巾！
8578b3cbf7e7ea9bc83e41eec7c2dd9712084905.translatedText: However, it would be too much to live up to the hospitality of this season, and it would also be a waste of those beautiful and expensive silk scarves. Yes, which woman would say something against her will that beauty has nothing to do with me. Meet in autumn and let’s recreate beautiful silk scarves!

29e139a680a1fefa7cff180183ac011157019531.sourceText: 这次丝巾课程以实用为主题，主要教大家怎样将丝巾变成一件优雅时装；又怎样在办公室里感觉阵阵凉意时有一件趁心的披肩衣；怎样在沙滩身穿比基尼时却能用丝巾装纳重要的手机和房卡等小物件；又怎样在逛店没带购物袋时丝巾瞬间变成时尚大跨包。总之，相约在秋季，让我们再次感受丝巾带给我们的魅力！
29e139a680a1fefa7cff180183ac011157019531.translatedText: This silk scarf course has a practical theme and mainly teaches you how to turn a silk scarf into an elegant fashion; how to have a comfortable shawl when you feel the chill in the office; how to use a silk scarf to hold important small items such as mobile phones and room keys when wearing a bikini on the beach; and how to instantly turn a silk scarf into a fashionable cross-body bag when you go to the store without a shopping bag. In short, let’s meet in autumn and let us feel the charm brought by silk scarves again!

39971dc64f76cd54e9a560656f5db9d1797dd77d.sourceText: 政府重开雇员们仍忧心忡忡 明年1月政府会再次关门？ 周四，因政府关门而休假的联邦政府雇员们已被要求复工。停业的国家公园、政府机构也都恢复了正常运作。然而许多雇员们仍然为政府资金感到紧张。 不少政府雇员担心政府的开门只是暂时的，毕竟联邦政府获得的新的预算资金只到2014年1月15日，他们担心政府在此之前无法找到更好的解决办法以致再次关门。 格兰戴尔市国税局员工阿维提亚（Manuel Avitia）说，”我们有贷款、房屋租金、学费贷款以及孩子的日托费用要支付，这些并不会因为政府关门而中止。” 他表示对于能重返工作岗位和看到地方债务协议表示很高兴，即使这只是一个临时的解决方法。 阿维提亚还表示自己已经开始”经济危机”：”现在的问题是’何时’，我们什么时候才能拿到薪水，我们都要债务要偿还。我最近收到了一个仅10刀的网络支票，所以我有点担心。” 许多联邦雇员们都像阿维提亚一样勒紧裤腰带生活，并为华盛顿官员们可能带来的最坏情况做起了准备。直到通过了一个更长远和稳定的预算协议，这些雇员们才可能放心。 而一些政府承包商工人无法得到政府关门的16日的薪水。泰勒（ Taylor）是一名美国航天局（NASA）承包商公司的员工，她说：”我认为如果政府雇员们可以拿到这16日的薪水，政府承包商的雇员也一样可以。?她十分担心政府可能在明年1月中旬再次关闭：”那些法规制定者并没有损失，真正受到损失的人是美国努力工作的人们。” 美国中文网据美联社报道：政府关门无赢家，在两党为各自的利益扯皮争执时，逾两周的政府关门让人不禁要问，谁是这场斗争最大的输家？ 周四，白宫发言人卡尼表示，”这场战争没有赢家。” 美国的国际声望和政治信誉已然随着这场政府关门闹剧一步步受损。根据皮尤中心最新的民调结果显示，81%的美国民众都对这个国家的走向感到不满。 共和党人内部的不团结被外界嘲笑，奥巴马面对信用评级被降的难堪局面，而美国作为世界金融安全避难所的美名也一手被自己捣毁。 共和党人希望借此机会向奥巴马医改发难，但最终奥巴马决不让步的坚定让共和党黯然失色，反而进一步加剧了共和党内部的分化。众议院内立场坚定的保守派议员们和一些务实的共和党人几乎出现了公开的分裂，迫使党团领导层两次撤销了原本计划提出的方案，第二次时甚至要求议员们回家等待来自党团领导层关于周三到底应该如何行事的决定。众议院议长，来自俄亥俄州的共和党人约翰-博纳（John A. Boehner）由于未能有效控制局面，在这场两党之战后恐怕只能徒留虚名。 根据新的协议，联邦政府将会获得直到2014年1月15日的预算资金，债务上限将会被提升到2014年2月7日。但是，这一短期的解决方案可能会为政府未来的战争埋下伏笔，奥巴马誓言消除两党分歧的承诺似乎已遥不可及，而其第二任期曾雄心壮志要完成的核心任务也因政府关门而在此被耽搁。 参议院在这场战争中的表现为不少人所称道，虽然内部两党分歧存在，在多数党领袖哈利-里德（Harry Reid）和共和党领导人米切-麦康纳（Mitch McConnell）的有效领导下仍及时妥协达成一致。 评级机构标普于周三宣布，美国政府部门关闭导致美国四季度GDP至少下滑0.6个百分点，或240亿美元。标普表示，华盛顿的政客们达成短暂一致，进而为长期协议进行谈判，可能会增强消费者信心，尤其是那些在政府关门期间被临时”放假”的公务员们。
39971dc64f76cd54e9a560656f5db9d1797dd77d.translatedText: The government reopens and employees are still worried. Will the government shut down again in January next year? Federal employees furloughed due to the government shutdown were asked to return to work Thursday. National parks and government agencies that were closed have also resumed normal operations. Yet many employees are still nervous about government funding. Many government employees are worried that the government's opening is only temporary. After all, the federal government will only receive new budget funds until January 15, 2014. They are worried that the government will not be able to find a better solution before then and will shut down again. Manuel Avitia, an Internal Revenue Service employee in Glendale, said, "We have loans, house rent, tuition loans, and children's day care expenses to pay, and these will not stop because of the government shutdown." He said he was happy to return to work and see the local debt agreement, even if it is only a temporary solution. Avitiya also said that he has begun an "economic crisis": "The question now is 'when', when will we get paid, we all have debts to pay off. I recently received an online check for only $10, so I am a little worried." Like Avitiya, many federal employees are tightening their belts and preparing for the worst-case scenario that officials in Washington may bring. Until a longer-term and stable budget deal is passed, those employees won't be able to rest assured. And some government contractor workers were unable to get their paychecks during the government shutdown on the 16th. Taylor, an employee of a NASA contractor company, said: "I think if government employees can get paid on the 16th, so can government contractor employees." She is very worried that the government may shut down again in mid-January next year: "Those regulators have not lost. The people who really suffer are the hard-working people in the United States." " According to the Associated Press report on the Chinese website of the United States: There are no winners in the government shutdown. As the two parties argue for their own interests, the more than two weeks of government shutdown makes people wonder, who is the biggest loser in this fight? On Thursday, White House spokesman Carney said, "There are no winners in this war. "The international prestige and political credibility of the United States have been damaged step by step with this government shutdown farce. According to the latest poll results from the Pew Center, 81% of the American people are dissatisfied with the direction of this country. The disunity within the Republicans was ridiculed by the outside world, Obama faced the embarrassing situation of having his credit rating downgraded, and the United States' reputation as a safe haven for the world's financial security was destroyed by himself. Republicans hoped to take this opportunity to attack Obamacare, but in the end, Obama's determination to never give in overshadowed the Republican Party, which further intensified the divisions within the Republican Party. Firm conservative members and some pragmatic Republicans in the House of Representatives almost had an open split, forcing the caucus leadership to twice withdraw the plan it originally planned to propose. The second time, they even asked the members to go home and wait for a decision from the caucus leadership on how to proceed on Wednesday. John A. Boehner, a Republican from Ohio. Boehner, because he failed to effectively control the situation, may only have a name in vain after this two-party war. Under the new agreement, the federal government will receive budget funds until January 15, 2014, and the debt ceiling will be raised to February 7, 2014. However, this short-term solution may pave the way for the government's future wars. Obama's pledge to eliminate differences between the two parties seems to be out of reach, and the core tasks that he once ambitiously accomplished in his second term have also been delayed by the government shutdown. The Senate's performance in this war has been praised by many people. Despite the internal differences between the two parties, under the effective leadership of Majority Leader Harry Reid and Republican Leader Mitch McConnell, a timely compromise was reached. Ratings agency S&P announced on Wednesday that the U.S. government shutdown caused U.S. GDP to fall by at least 0.6 percentage points, or $24 billion, in the fourth quarter. S&P said that politicians in Washington reached a short-term agreement and then negotiate for a long-term agreement, which may increase consumer confidence, especially those civil servants who were temporarily "furloughed" during the government shutdown.

a92c51e065ee94616eaa442d28e8182868bd7725.sourceText: 下午两点半左右几个水平较高的参赛选手，为预赛掀起小高潮。杨承宇演唱张学友的《眼泪》。
a92c51e065ee94616eaa442d28e8182868bd7725.translatedText: Around 2:30 in the afternoon, several high-level contestants set off a small climax for the preliminaries. Yang Chengyu sang "Tears" by Jacky Cheung.

3840e55d3c46a8f21168933b6b693be879982e8c.sourceText: （左至右）评委 黄晨雪 高薇佳 阿呆 参赛选手 杨承宇
3840e55d3c46a8f21168933b6b693be879982e8c.translatedText: (left to right) Judges Huang Chenxue Gao Weijia Dui Contestant Yang Chengyu

7d554f738b69c8a0b8a72784072eeab807af0ad3.sourceText: 杨承宇演唱时非常的投入，现场观众和评委都听得如痴如醉，歌声结束时，掌声雷鸣，相当感人。另一位参赛选手凌志演唱的《空白格》，他的声音一出，就让现场陷入宁静，所有听者都沉静在清澈，舒缓的音乐当中。听了几位歌手的演唱，本次比赛的水平可见一斑。
7d554f738b69c8a0b8a72784072eeab807af0ad3.translatedText: Yang Chengyu was very involved in singing. The audience and judges were mesmerized. When the song ended, there was thunderous applause, which was quite touching. Another contestant, Ling Zhi, sang "Blank Space". As soon as his voice came out, the scene fell into silence, and all the listeners were immersed in the clear and soothing music. After listening to the performances of several singers, the level of this competition is evident.

354ced9361600faea3f20cdf3b560bd25c2b554d.sourceText: 高薇佳，黄晨雪，阿呆三位评委也忙得不亦乐乎，要从这么多优秀选手中选出进入决赛少于１０人的名额，也是很大的考验。
354ced9361600faea3f20cdf3b560bd25c2b554d.translatedText: The three judges Gao Weijia, Huang Chenxue and Ah Dai were also very busy. It was also a big test to select less than 10 people from so many outstanding contestants to enter the finals.

17ffb88574a564a99632689f897948cfdc0ae9d7.sourceText: 更吸引听众的是，２０１３年亚利桑那州立大学中国学生卡拉ＯＫ比赛称为全明星赛，也就是说在最近几年ＡＳＵ卡拉ＯＫ比赛中获得佳绩的参赛选手都可能在这次的比赛中再度与听众见面。
17ffb88574a564a99632689f897948cfdc0ae9d7.translatedText: What is even more attractive to the audience is that the 2013 Arizona State University Chinese Student Karaoke Competition is called the All-Star Game, which means that contestants who have achieved good results in the ASU Karaoke Competition in recent years may meet the audience again in this competition.

6957df5c35686d2416a89a1c65eddce6a05c63f2.sourceText: 最后赢家会是谁？参赛选手们给大家带来怎样的音乐盛宴？《太阳鸟》亚利桑那华人网将持续为您带来报道。
6957df5c35686d2416a89a1c65eddce6a05c63f2.translatedText: Who will be the final winner? What kind of music feast will the contestants bring to everyone? "Sunbird" Arizona Chinese Network will continue to bring you reports.

584507e581f1ac83df5476100fb8ffa0359e4167.sourceText: 中国近5年留学归国人员近80万 为有史以来最大回国潮 今年正值欧美同学会百年华诞，中国也迎来有史以来最大的留学人员回国潮，近5年归国留学人员近80万人。10月13日，中国人力资源和社会保障部副部长、欧美同学会副会长王晓初在欧美同学会北京论坛暨第八届中国留学人员创新创业论坛大会上表示，截至去年年底，留学回国人数已达到109万人，去年一年回国27.29万人，同比增长46.57%。目前，中国已建成各级各类留学人员创业园260多家。 在全国工商联副主席林毅夫看来，中国是海外留学生创业最好的地方，因为中国的经济”风景这边独好”。2008年国际金融危机后，国际经济还没有复苏，对中国经济增长有影响。中国政府采取了一些必要的反国际经济周期的措施，条件非常优惠。他相信，今年的第三季度、第四季度中国经济会回升，今年经济完全有可能保持7.5%～8%的增长。展望未来，中国经济保持8%增长的潜力依然存在。 ”未来，中国要完成自己经济的升级版，要有根本的创造和发明。”中国宽带资本基金董事长田溯宁认为，这种创造和发明就像爱迪生发明了电灯、福特建立了现代工业生产线一样，在技术和商业模式、组织方法上有创新。随着信息革命的发展，由于云计算、大数据和中国庞大的人口，孕育着未来重大的技术变革和创新的机会。根本的发明和商业模式的创新，既是海归人才的使命，也是非常激动人心的机会。 创造和创新不仅体现在经济进步方面，还体现在社会发展上。清华大学公共管理学院院长薛澜指出，中国目前进行的历史性变革，是人类历史上公共管理一个最好的案例，在吸取各国治理模式的经验和教训基础上，能否创立更好的中国治理模式，也需要海归在观念、理论、思想等方面作出努力。
584507e581f1ac83df5476100fb8ffa0359e4167.translatedText: Nearly 800,000 people from China have returned from studying abroad in the past five years, the largest wave of returnees in history. This year marks the 100th anniversary of the European and American Alumni Association, and China has also welcomed the largest wave of returnees from overseas students in history. In the past five years, nearly 800,000 people have returned from studying abroad. On October 13, Wang Xiaochu, Vice Minister of the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security of China and Vice President of the European and American Alumni Association, stated at the European and American Alumni Association Beijing Forum and the 8th China Overseas Students Innovation and Entrepreneurship Forum that as of the end of last year, the number of students who had returned to China had reached 1.09 million, and 272,900 had returned last year, a year-on-year increase of 46.57%. At present, China has built more than 260 entrepreneurial parks for overseas students at all levels and types. According to Lin Yifu, vice chairman of the All-China Federation of Industry and Commerce, China is the best place for overseas students to start their own businesses because China’s economy is “uniquely beautiful here.” After the international financial crisis in 2008, the international economy has not yet recovered, which has had an impact on China's economic growth. The Chinese government has taken some necessary measures to counter the international economic cycle, and the conditions are very favorable. He believes that China's economy will rebound in the third and fourth quarters of this year, and it is entirely possible for the economy to maintain a growth rate of 7.5% to 8% this year. Looking to the future, China's economy still has the potential to maintain 8% growth. "In the future, if China wants to complete an upgraded version of its own economy, it must have fundamental creation and invention." Tian Suning, chairman of China Broadband Capital Fund, believes that this kind of creation and invention is just like Edison invented the electric light and Ford established a modern industrial production line, with innovations in technology, business models, and organizational methods. With the development of the information revolution, due to cloud computing, big data and China's huge population, there are opportunities for major technological changes and innovation in the future. Fundamental inventions and business model innovations are not only the mission of returned talents, but also very exciting opportunities. Creation and innovation are not only reflected in economic progress, but also in social development. Xue Lan, dean of the School of Public Policy and Management at Tsinghua University, pointed out that China's current historic changes are the best case of public management in human history. Whether a better Chinese governance model can be created based on the experience and lessons of other countries' governance models also requires the efforts of overseas returnees in terms of concepts, theories, and ideas.

45f3268bdb7990674ef689c5135f2045d73f22cb.sourceText: １０月５日郑文良牙医诊所Open House. 经过全新装修的诊所，让人觉得温馨舒适，更多先进的设备让患者体会到安静优雅的就诊经历。
45f3268bdb7990674ef689c5135f2045d73f22cb.translatedText: On October 5th, Zheng Wenliang Dental Clinic opened House. The newly renovated clinic makes people feel warm and comfortable, and more advanced equipment allows patients to experience a quiet and elegant medical experience.

80077b930761c7eee67fae9f9ec3213c6ef8327a.sourceText: 诊所负责人郑文良牙医向记者介绍了自己诊所在设备方面的优势。首先是最直接通畅的病患互动交流设备。郑文良牙医精通熟练的英文，闽南语，以及中文普通话，他可以通过一个影像仪，直接将口腔的情况展示给病人，同时向他们介绍处理方案。这个影像设备他买得辐射小，图像清晰，操作直接，非常方便病人了解自己牙齿的状况。第二个是模牙机，这个小小的磨牙设备，是郑医生精挑细选的产品。磨牙的噪音非常小，可以降低病人对牙处理的恐惧。磨牙上有专业的照明设施，不用医生或护士再耽误一只手，来处理照明问题。第三消毒设备也是当前市场上最先进的设备之一。
80077b930761c7eee67fae9f9ec3213c6ef8327a.translatedText: Dentist Zheng Wenliang, the person in charge of the clinic, introduced the advantages of his clinic in terms of equipment to reporters. The first is the most direct and smooth patient interaction communication device. Dentist Zheng Wenliang is fluent in English, Hokkien, and Mandarin Chinese. He can directly show the oral conditions to patients through an imaging device and introduce treatment plans to them. The imaging equipment he bought has low radiation, clear images, and direct operation, making it very convenient for patients to understand the condition of their teeth. The second one is the dental mold machine. This small teeth grinding equipment is a product carefully selected by Dr. Zheng. The noise of grinding teeth is very small, which can reduce the patient's fear of dental treatment. There are professional lighting facilities on the molars, so doctors or nurses don’t have to waste one hand to deal with lighting problems. The third disinfection equipment is also one of the most advanced equipment on the market.

07838d2aded1068223312c67acc0037da909471c.sourceText: 郑文良牙医用影像仪展示病人的牙齿情况
07838d2aded1068223312c67acc0037da909471c.translatedText: Dentist Zheng Wenliang uses an imaging device to display the patient's dental condition

b989729ca18d81dd02fb06b5e0fb46056f5d4b65.sourceText: 郑文良牙医说：” 工欲善其事，必先 利其器” 。他除了不断提高自己的技术水平，还一直关注最先进的牙处理设备，将技术和先进设别良好结合，给病人带来一个轻松愉快的看牙体验。
b989729ca18d81dd02fb06b5e0fb46056f5d4b65.translatedText: Dentist Zheng Wenliang said: "If a worker wants to do his job well, he must first sharpen his tools." In addition to constantly improving his technical level, he has also been paying attention to the most advanced dental treatment equipment, combining technology and advanced equipment to bring patients a relaxing and enjoyable dental experience.

94cbd773c3e5b4f95149dc28103d8ae1d0587f98.sourceText: 凤凰城 张肇鸿 前凤凰城中国週主席扬美女士原籍英国，但却有一颗火热的中国心… 。 收到凤凰城中国週副主席Diana Ho女士的电邮，惊悉中国週前主席扬美(Mai Young)女士去世的消息，深感婉惜，在此谨表达最沉痛的悼念。 我是通过中国週活动而认识扬美和扬震威伉俪的。扬美在早期的中国週中已担任主席，在中西社会中享有不少的知名度。中国週多年来办得有声有色，扬美及其丈夫和家人贡献良多。 我和扬美的先生扬震威(英文全名Jung”Johnny”Wai Young)较为熟络，通常大家称呼扬震威先生为”Johnny”，他曾在美国空军服役，当过核武器方面的主管(Nuclear Weapons Supervisor) ，去过英国工作，并曾派往台湾服务过三年，经过廿年的军旅生活后，他于1972年退役。之后，他在Luke AFB 空军基地又服务了廿年。1994年退休后，Johnny成为本地侨社的积极人士，他当过军人会和耆英会的领导人，并且多年来一直参与和协助妻子在中国週中的工作。 从上世纪九十年代起，我曾多次去过Johnny 的家。他们家门前很特别，邮箱由Johnny 自己设计和亲手製作，和小庙宇一般，漆成红牆黑瓦，一看就知道主人家的中国情怀。其家中也有很多中国文化方面的资料和艺术品。他们知道我在搜集侨社资料，曾很热心地回答我提到有关侨社和中国週方面的事情。 扬美和Johnny对中华文化有十分浓烈的兴趣和感情，有时”中国”得比我们还中国。他们谈到早期的中国週，每年都有二三十万中西人士参与，声势浩大，对主流社会有着广泛且深入的影响。作为凤凰城的姐妹市，大陆成都市和台湾台北市隔年会来参加中国週的活动，本地的中餐馆、各商号、中文学校和文化艺术单位也在中国週这个平台上宣扬中华文化，使到中国週活动多姿多彩。 扬美夫妇把这些活动内容分档记录下来，Johnny曾打开电脑给我介绍，其内存中有很多是中国週年复一年的资料，Johnny说因贮存量大，已经换了更大容量的电脑，以方便资料的查阅。在当年中国週的录像带中，可看到繁华热闹的景象。在阅读中国週年刊时，觉得年刊设计得十分精緻，内容都也相当精彩，其中还有扬美和Johnny亲自撰写的文章，他们用自己的亲身感悟去介绍中华文化，让西裔人士感受更深。 廿年前中文翡翠台在美国开播时，Johnny约我去安装卫星电视，以便通过更多元渠道去了解中港台资讯，并和我探讨有关中国文化艺术中方方面面的讯息。他曾带我到他们家的后院，看到了很多各式各样的工具，长期的军旅生活，让Johnny练就了灵活的头脑和一双巧手，家中很多设备都是他自己维修更换，包括研修古董车等。他们懂得生活，家中厨房有清一色的不鏽钢设备，厅中有各式音响和影视器材。有时他们还开车去参加古董车展览和朋友聚会。 扬美除担任过中国週主席外，还长期主管财政，为中国週活动倾注很多心力和时间。Johnny和家人很有心思，有不少用于中国週用的道具和民间艺术品，都是肖自己亲手製作，而且很有创意。前后去过几次他们的家，最后一次见到Johnny是好几年前，当时他的身体已欠佳，那次他正在茶楼饮完茶，由于开过刀，身子虚弱，随身还带有一个氧气筒，话虽不多，但他的眼中仍有一股热情，流露出对生活的热爱。Johnny在不久之后便过世了，侨社和亲朋好友都十分伤感和惋惜。 Johnny是在年青时在英国邂逅Mai Young的，不久之后Mai 就成为Johnny太太，从此之后更迷上了博大精深的中华文化，一位原籍英国人，却有着一颗火热的中国心。他们婚后育有一男二女，儿女也成为了中国週的忠实支持者。大约两年前，接到扬美女士的电话，约我前去安装凤凰卫视。见面时，扬美因腰椎受伤已坐轮椅。由于凤凰卫视组合有CCTV-4的中英频道，扬美能更容易地了解和欣赏中华文化，对于中国的情有独锺，她始终未变。考虑到她的行动不便，我特地在大厅装上主机，在厨房装上分机，以避免她因为行动不便而做成的收视间断。 一对中外结合的伉俪，是如此地热衷爱好中华文化，二十年来，为中国週的成功举办贡献了不少心力，他们亦在其中不断学习进步，可以说，他们的晚年是充实和有意义的，夕阳晚照，也让人们见到那绚丽的霞彩。
94cbd773c3e5b4f95149dc28103d8ae1d0587f98.translatedText: Phoenix Zhang Zhaohong Former Phoenix China Week Chairman Ms. Yang Mei is originally from the UK, but she has a fiery Chinese heart... I received an email from Phoenix China Week Vice Chairman Ms. Diana Ho. I was surprised to learn of the death of former China Week Chairman Ms. Mai Young. I am deeply saddened and would like to express my deepest condolences. I got to know Mr. and Mrs. Yang Mei and Yang Zhenwei through China Week activities. Yang Mei served as the chairman of the early China Week and enjoyed a lot of popularity in Chinese and Western societies. China Week has been a success over the years, and Yang Mei, her husband and her family have made a lot of contributions. I am relatively familiar with Yang Mei’s husband Jung “Johnny” Wai Young (full English name is Jung “Johnny” Wai Young), who is usually called “Johnny”. He served in the U.S. Air Force as a Nuclear Weapons Supervisor, worked in the United Kingdom, and was sent to Taiwan to serve for three years. After twenty years of military life, he retired in 1972. He then served at Luke AFB for another twenty years. After retiring in 1994, Johnny became an active member of the local overseas Chinese community. He served as a leader of the Military Association and the Senior Citizens Association, and has been participating in and assisting his wife's work in China Weekly for many years. I've been to Johnny's house many times since the 1990s. The front of their house is very special. The mailbox was designed and made by Johnny himself. It looks like a small temple, painted with red walls and black tiles. You can tell the Chinese sentiment of the owner at a glance. There are also many Chinese cultural materials and artworks in his home. They knew that I was collecting information on overseas Chinese communities, and they enthusiastically answered my questions about overseas Chinese communities and China Week. Yangmei and Johnny have very strong interest and affection for Chinese culture. Sometimes, "China" is even more Chinese than us. They talked about the early China Week, which was attended by 200,000 to 300,000 Chinese and Western people every year. It was a huge event and had a broad and profound impact on mainstream society. As sister cities of Phoenix, Chengdu in mainland China and Taipei in Taiwan will participate in China Week activities every other year. Local Chinese restaurants, businesses, Chinese schools and cultural and art units also promote Chinese culture on the China Week platform, making China Week activities colorful. The Yangmei couple recorded these activities in files. Johnny once turned on the computer and introduced to me that there was a lot of data on China year after year in its memory. Johnny said that due to the large storage capacity, he had replaced the computer with a larger capacity to facilitate the review of the data. In the video of China Week that year, you can see the bustling and lively scene. When reading the China Annual Magazine, I felt that the design of the annual magazine was very exquisite and the content was quite exciting. There were also articles personally written by Yang Mei and Johnny. They used their own personal insights to introduce Chinese culture and let Hispanics have a deeper experience. When the Chinese Jade Channel was launched in the United States twenty years ago, Johnny asked me to install satellite TV so that he could learn more about China, Hong Kong and Taiwan through more channels, and he discussed with me information about all aspects of Chinese culture and art. He once took me to the backyard of their home and saw many various tools. Johnny’s long-term military life has allowed Johnny to develop a flexible mind and a pair of skillful hands. He repairs and replaces many equipment in the house himself, including working on antique cars. They know how to live well. The kitchen at home is equipped with all stainless steel equipment, and the living room is equipped with various audio and video equipment. Sometimes they also drive to antique car shows and gatherings with friends. In addition to serving as the chairman of China Week, Yang Mei has also been in charge of finance for a long time and devoted a lot of effort and time to China Week activities. Johnny and his family are very considerate. There are many props and folk art used in Chinese Weekends. They are all made by Xiao himself and are very creative. I have been to their home several times. The last time I saw Johnny was several years ago, when he was in poor health. At that time, he was drinking tea in a teahouse. He was weak due to surgery and carried an oxygen tank with him. Although he did not speak much, there was still a passion in his eyes, showing his love for life. Johnny passed away not long after, and the overseas Chinese community, relatives and friends were very sad and sorry. Johnny met Mai Young in England when he was young. Soon after, Mai became Johnny's wife. From then on, she became obsessed with the profound Chinese culture. She was originally from England, but had a passionate Chinese heart. After their marriage, they had a son and two daughters, and their children also became loyal supporters of China Zhou. About two years ago, I received a call from Ms. Yang Mei, asking me to install Phoenix TV. When we met, Yang Mei was in a wheelchair due to a lumbar injury. Since Phoenix Satellite TV has CCTV-4's Chinese and English channels, Yang Mei can understand and appreciate Chinese culture more easily, and her love for China has never changed. Considering her mobility issues, I specially installed a main unit in the hall and an extension in the kitchen to avoid viewing interruptions caused by her mobility issues. A Chinese and foreign couple are so passionate about Chinese culture that they have contributed a lot to the success of China Week over the past twenty years. They have also continued to learn and make progress in it. It can be said that their later years are fulfilling and meaningful. The sunset also allows people to see the gorgeous glow.

e0fbdf9a4baa0f967f783ecef22526349d0fa7ef.translatedText: U.S. contracted sales fell 1.6% in August and the real estate market recovery seems to be blocked

ecf2a178b3cf516dcbe5f41a3a051eca3d0f3c47.sourceText: 美8月签约销售下降1.6% 房地产市场复苏似受阻 由于利率上升和价格提高开始压制需求，全美房屋买主8月对现…
ecf2a178b3cf516dcbe5f41a3a051eca3d0f3c47.translatedText: U.S. signed sales dropped 1.6% in August and the real estate market recovery seems to be blocked. As rising interest rates and higher prices began to suppress demand, U.S. home buyers signed contracts for existing homes in August...

4be04aa7e130fe36283df4dfe66fddaf63fdee2a.sourceText: 由于利率上升和价格提高开始压制需求，全美房屋买主8月对现有房屋的签约数量比7月下降1.6%。根据全国地产商协会的报告，8月房屋销售签约数量仍比去年同月上升5.8%。
4be04aa7e130fe36283df4dfe66fddaf63fdee2a.translatedText: As rising interest rates and rising prices began to suppress demand, U.S. home buyers signed contracts for existing homes in August, down 1.6% from July. According to a report from the National Association of Realtors, the number of housing sales contracts in August was still up 5.8% compared with the same month last year.

ab6cee8c8732a1b7d9c8d13048939ef1f92fa1dc.sourceText: 地产商本月初已经提出警告说，8月房屋成交数量上升–大都是6月和7月签约–可能是最后一波，因为经纪人纷纷报告8月买主流量急剧下降。销售签约通常需要一到二个月成交，因此它预示着今年秋季房地产成交放缓。
ab6cee8c8732a1b7d9c8d13048939ef1f92fa1dc.translatedText: Real estate developers warned earlier this month that a rise in August home sales - mostly signed in June and July - could be the last, as agents reported a sharp drop in buyer traffic in August. Sales signings typically take one to two months to close, so it signals a slowdown in real estate transactions this fall.

067a52088416bee79a6fe71e881dd7857348b5da.sourceText: 全国地产商协会经济学家劳伦斯云（Lawrence Yun）说，今年春季抵押贷款利率急剧上升促使买主匆忙做出决定，6年半来的销售高峰终于在上月出现。我们预计今后几个月现有房屋销量降低，但由于很多市场待售房屋数量较少，将在今后几个月继续推动房价上涨。
067a52088416bee79a6fe71e881dd7857348b5da.translatedText: National Association of Realtors economist Lawrence Yun said the sharp rise in mortgage rates this spring prompted buyers to make hasty decisions, and the sales peak in six and a half years finally occurred last month. We expect lower existing home sales in the coming months, but a lower number of homes for sale in many markets will continue to drive home price growth in the coming months.

65282523a2f16945863dbcc538f50d58ada082b7.sourceText: 根据标普/凯斯-席勒（S&P/Case-Shiller）本周发表的房价指数，全美20个大城市7月房价上涨12%。尽管房价上涨趋势放缓，但那种上涨幅度已经造成首次买房人更难以进入市场。
65282523a2f16945863dbcc538f50d58ada082b7.translatedText: According to the house price index released by S&P/Case-Shiller this week, house prices in 20 major cities in the United States rose by 12% in July. While house price growth has slowed, that level of growth has made it more difficult for first-time buyers to enter the market.

1674588ce4fb1ac004fb31a1d0461188a4421d94.sourceText: 另一报告说8月新房销售比7月上升，但升幅是一年来的第二低。新房和现房市场都因为待售数量较少和信贷较紧而受限制。
1674588ce4fb1ac004fb31a1d0461188a4421d94.translatedText: Another report said new home sales rose in August from July, but the increase was the second-lowest in a year. Both the new and existing home markets are constrained by fewer listings and tighter credit.

ce2b2acc2924561b2c8379066be8e9e78e40fafd.sourceText: 东北地区8月房屋销售签约比7月增长4%，也是全美唯一签约上涨的地区。中西部下降1.4%，南部下降3.5%，西部下降1.6%。地产商预计2013年现房销售数量将达到520万套，比去年上升11%；但他们预计明年可能没有变化。
ce2b2acc2924561b2c8379066be8e9e78e40fafd.translatedText: Home sales contracts in the Northeast region increased by 4% in August compared with July, making it the only region in the United States where contract sales increased. The Midwest fell 1.4%, the South fell 3.5%, and the West fell 1.6%. Real estate developers predict that the number of existing home sales will reach 5.2 million units in 2013, an increase of 11% from last year; but they expect there may be no change next year.

2b4d74a5e591944ba7ab048cd5f70de05911c72e.translatedText: The real income of U.S. households has declined for the fifth consecutive year. The income of a typical American family is lower than the level in 1989 in real terms, and household income has declined for the fifth consecutive year. …

a91eacef2716bfe5e9bf9384b33b2bbeba00b4d5.sourceText: 经济复苏未能给美国中产阶级带来任何利益，突出表明美联储仍然面临持续挑战。美联储已经决定继续维持每月850亿美元的资产购买规模。
a91eacef2716bfe5e9bf9384b33b2bbeba00b4d5.translatedText: The failure of the economic recovery to bring any benefits to the American middle class underscores the ongoing challenges the Federal Reserve still faces. The Fed has decided to continue maintaining its monthly asset purchases of $85 billion.

17b91ac9730a19c8be251865844b4c56260a8285.sourceText: 这些数据还增加了左翼人士要求巴拉克?#22885;巴马任命珍妮特?#32822;伦(Janet Yellen)为下任美联储主席的压力。耶伦被普遍视为最关心高失业率的政策制定者之一。
17b91ac9730a19c8be251865844b4c56260a8285.translatedText: The data also increased pressure on the left for Barack Obama to name Janet Yellen as the next Fed chair. Yellen is widely seen as one of the policymakers most concerned about high unemployment.

8958a3ce111f5b969ceedb242999af0b922ef36c.sourceText: 奥巴马将收入中值视为其总统任期内的标志性议题之一。
8958a3ce111f5b969ceedb242999af0b922ef36c.translatedText: Obama has made median income one of the signature issues of his presidency.

376fb5648dd12dd4d015f7b34d2de9b674235e7a.sourceText: 美国人口普查局(US Census Bureau)数据显示，2012年家庭收入中值从51100美元下降至51017美元，比去年收入中值下滑了0.2%，比2007年的衰退前峰值低了8.3%。去年西部地区收入水平最高（55157美元），南方地区收入最低（48033美元）。此外，人口普查局还公布了全美贫困人口调查。2012年，全美贫困人口4649.6万人，贫困率15.0%。亚裔贫困人口192.1万，贫困率11.7%，较去年的贫困人口减少了5.2万人。非拉丁裔白人贫困率最低，为9.7%，拉丁裔和黑人贫困率最高，分别为25.6%和27.2%。
376fb5648dd12dd4d015f7b34d2de9b674235e7a.translatedText: U.S. Census Bureau data show that median household income fell from $51,100 to $51,017 in 2012, a 0.2% decline from last year’s median income and 8.3% below the pre-recession peak in 2007. Last year, the western region had the highest income level ($55,157), while the southern region had the lowest income ($48,033). Additionally, the Census Bureau publishes the National Poverty Survey. In 2012, there were 46.496 million poor people in the United States, with a poverty rate of 15.0%. There are 1.921 million Asians living in poverty, with a poverty rate of 11.7%, a decrease of 52,000 from last year. Non-Latino whites have the lowest poverty rate, at 9.7%, while Latinos and blacks have the highest poverty rates, at 25.6% and 27.2%, respectively.

06293db0349dbdd9dbcd2ecb2d00ee91189fb3bf.sourceText: 美国人口普查局的这些年度数据表明，美国中产阶级正渐渐成为”失落的一代”。社会科学研究资助机构–罗素 塞奇基金会(Russell Sage Foundation)的主席谢尔顿?#20025;齐格(Sheldon Danziger)表示：”比起2000年，今天贫困更严重，家庭收入更低。”
06293db0349dbdd9dbcd2ecb2d00ee91189fb3bf.translatedText: These annual data from the U.S. Census Bureau indicate that the American middle class is gradually becoming a "lost generation." "Poverty is worse today than in 2000 and household incomes are lower," said Sheldon Danziger, president of the Russell Sage Foundation, a social science research funder.

07dea124990c4a34bddb7a776ccc7c58d1047c71.translatedText: >Cui Yongyuan's fourth resignation to CCTV was finally approved. A few days ago, Cui Yongyuan started a "war of words" with Fang Zhouzi over genetically modified foods...

c501a419d674dc4c604058de98a76a95024b6284.sourceText: 崔永元第4次向央视辞职终获批 前些天，崔永元因为转基因食品与方舟子掀起了一场”口水战”，在网络上好不热闹。前日，有人在微博上出面”劝架”，提及崔永元时这样写道：”央视名嘴此次可谓大家风范，但也请结束这场混战，公道自在人心，无谓在此耗心费神。我相信还有更多需要关注的事情值得您去’实话实说’。您让我们尊敬。”崔永元在自己的微博上特意转发了这一条，并写道：”谢谢总结！麻烦以后不要叫我’央视名嘴’，叫小崔或老崔吧，我不喜欢那几个字。 ”表面上看，崔永元此话并无不妥，但记者从知情人处获悉，这并不是小崔的矫情，而是因为他确确实实不再是央视主持人了。上周三，崔永元的辞职信已经被领导批准，目前小崔正在办理相关手续。 去意已决：4次递交辞职信 上周三已经被领导批准 记者从央视内部人员处得知，崔永元此番辞职，并不是冲动之举，因为近两年他已经先后4次递交辞职信，而之前每一次都被强力挽留。直到这一次，领导看他去意已决，终于点头应允，于上周三（11日）晚，在他的第4封辞职信上签字同意。 自打离开了让他一举成名的《实话实说》节目，崔永元虽贵为”央视名嘴”，但近些年并无王牌节目，2012年开播的两档新节目《谢天谢地，你来啦》《小崔说立波秀》，都是雷声大，雨点小，并未让小崔延续当年《实话实说》的辉煌。相反，近几年崔永元最常进入公众视线的，往往是他对社会热点事件的表态，包括这一次他与网络红人方舟子因为转基因食品的”对掐”。 很多观众是通过赵本山与宋丹丹的小品《说事儿》知道崔永元曾经得过抑郁症的，失眠也是他生活中面临的最大困扰。据透露，此次崔永元从央视辞职，理由之一也有身体原因，但其实最重要的深层次原因，是他不适应央视的体制，不喜欢拿着话筒在镜头前的这份工作。眼下这份顶着”央视名嘴”头衔的工作，外人看着光鲜，但却让个性鲜明的崔永元时常有一种压抑的感觉，一直想要极力摆脱。 完成梦想：全心投身电影圈 崔永元辞职，很容易让人联想到之前李咏的跳槽事件，但记者了解到，小崔和小李完全不同，李咏从央视离开到母校中国传媒任教，表面上是从主持人岗位换到了教师岗位，殊不知这只是李咏的一个”障眼法”，实际上李咏是脱离了央视的束缚，以高身价频繁接下各大卫视的节目邀约，另外商演和广告也是应接不暇。但崔永元则不然，据悉小崔决意离开，最主要是为了完成他的电影梦想。 熟悉崔永元的观众都知道，离开了《实话实说》之后，崔永元曾创办过一档名为《电影传奇》的节目，虽然该节目的影响力远远不及《实话实说》，但小崔对这档节目投入的精力和心血却是不同寻常的，而这档节目在某种程度上也确实是”中国电影的档案馆”。 据崔永元身边人表示，离开央视之后，崔永元再主持节目将可能是业余或玩票形式，遇到适合的节目形态和节目风格，他也许不会排斥拿起话筒，但他将最大限度地完成自己的电影梦，”他应该会正式投入到电影圈，或者制作，或者当导演也不一定。”由此可见，也许未来再看崔永元频繁在电视上露脸不太容易，但说不定在哪部电影的字幕上，能看到”崔永元作品”五个大字。 记者一直试图采访崔永元本人，但一直未得到他的回应。 崔永元，《小崔说事》《小崔说立波秀》《实话实说》《谢天谢地，你来啦》等节目主持人、纪录片《我的抗战》总策划。1981年考入中国传媒大学新闻系。1985年毕业后进入中央人民广播电台任记者，客串中国中央电视台策划《东方时空》等节目，1996年以《实话实说》主持人崭露头角，大受欢迎。2009年，崔永元倾力打造《电影传奇》。2011年9月，’崔永元 新锐导演计划’在北京启动。
c501a419d674dc4c604058de98a76a95024b6284.translatedText: Cui Yongyuan's fourth resignation to CCTV was finally approved. A few days ago, Cui Yongyuan started a "war of words" with Fang Zhouzi over genetically modified foods, which caused a lot of excitement on the Internet. The day before yesterday, someone came forward to "stop the fight" on Weibo. When referring to Cui Yongyuan, he wrote: "The famous CCTV reporter is doing well this time, but please put an end to this melee. Justice is in the hearts of the people, and there is no need to worry about it." I believe there are more things that need attention that deserve your 'telling the truth'. You make us respect you. Cui Yongyuan specially forwarded this article on his Weibo and wrote: "Thank you for the summary!" Please don't call me 'CCTV celebrity' in the future. Call me Xiao Cui or Lao Cui. I don't like those words. "On the surface, Cui Yongyuan's words are not inappropriate, but the reporter learned from insiders that this is not Xiao Cui's pretentiousness, but because he is indeed no longer the CCTV host. Last Wednesday, Cui Yongyuan's resignation letter was approved by the leadership, and Xiao Cui is currently going through the relevant procedures. He has decided to leave: 4 resignation letters were submitted and were approved by the leadership last Wednesday. Reporters learned from CCTV insiders that Cui Yongyuan's resignation was not an impulsive move, because he had submitted letters of resignation four times in the past two years, and had been forcefully retained each time. Until this time, the leader finally nodded in agreement and signed his fourth resignation letter on the evening of last Wednesday (11th). Since he left the "Tell the Truth" program that made him famous, although Cui Yongyuan is a "famous CCTV speaker", he has not had a major program in recent years. The two new programs launched in 2012, "Thank God You're Here" and "Xiao Cui Talks about Libo Show", were both very popular. The lack of rain did not allow Xiao Cui to continue the glory of "Tell the Truth". On the contrary, in recent years, Cui Yongyuan has often come into the public eye for his statements on hot social issues, including this time his "confrontation" with Internet celebrity Fang Zhouzi over genetically modified food. Many viewers know that Cui Yongyuan once suffered from depression through Zhao Benshan and Song Dandan's sketch "Speaking of Things". Insomnia is also the biggest problem he faces in life. According to reports, one of the reasons for Cui Yongyuan's resignation from CCTV is physical reasons, but in fact the most important reason is deep. The second reason is that he doesn't adapt to the CCTV system and doesn't like the job of holding a microphone in front of the camera. The current job with the title of "CCTV famous speaker" may look glamorous to outsiders, but it often makes Cui Yongyuan, who has a distinctive personality, feel depressed and has been trying his best to get rid of it. Fulfill your dream: devote yourself to the film industry Cui Yongyuan's resignation is easily reminiscent of Li Yong's previous job-hopping incident. However, the reporter learned that Xiao Cui and Xiao Li are completely different. Li Yong left CCTV to teach at his alma mater China Media. On the surface, he changed from the host position to the teaching position. Little did he know that this was just a part of Li Yong's career. This is a "hidden trick". In fact, Li Yong broke away from the shackles of CCTV and frequently accepted program invitations from various major TV stations. In addition, he was overwhelmed with commercial performances and advertisements. But Cui Yongyuan was not the same. It is reported that Xiao Cui decided to leave mainly to fulfill his movie dream. Audiences who are familiar with Cui Yongyuan know that after leaving "To Tell the Truth", Cui Yongyuan once founded a program called "Film Legend". Although the influence of this program is far less than that of "To Tell the Truth", the energy and effort Xiao Cui put into this program is unusual, and this program is indeed the "Archives of Chinese Films" to a certain extent. According to people close to Cui Yongyuan, after leaving CCTV, Cui Yongyuan will probably host a program in an amateur or casual format. If he encounters a suitable program format and style, he may not refuse to pick up the microphone, but he will maximize his movie dream. "He should officially join the film industry, or produce, or become a director." "It can be seen that it may not be easy to see Cui Yongyuan frequently appearing on TV in the future, but maybe in the subtitles of any movie, you can see the five characters "Cui Yongyuan's work". The reporter has been trying to interview Cui Yongyuan himself, but has never received a response from him. Cui Yongyuan, host of programs such as "Little Cui Talks", "Xiao Cui Talks Libo Show", "To Tell the Truth", "Thank God You're Here" and the chief planner of the documentary "My War of Resistance", was admitted to the Journalism Department of Communication University of China in 1985 and entered the Central People's Government after graduation. He worked as a reporter at a radio station and guest-produced programs such as "Oriental Time and Space" on China Central Television. In 1996, he emerged as the host of "To Tell the Truth" and became very popular. In 2009, Cui Yongyuan devoted himself to creating "Movie Legend". The Emerging Directors Program’ was launched in Beijing.

0cd210a2516d08a37cbea1dc13205d3b28569fbd.sourceText: 中国海外交流协会主办、全美中文学校协会承办的《全美海外华文教育名师巡讲团》2013暑期教师培训活动日前顺利落下帷幕。这次为了更有力地推动北美华文教育的强势发展，中国海外交流协会特派出了北京师范大学张和生教授、北京语言大学程龙副教授、中国北京翠微小学周金萍副校长、领队王匡廷先生，青岛大学副校长徐宏力教授、山东大学文学院盛玉麒教授、山东大学第二附属中学小学部汪静副校长、领队房振三博士，四川大学汉语言文字学专业的俞理明教授、四川大学王晓路教授、小学语文特级教师李海容老师以及领队李虹女士等强大阵容，分成东、中、西三条线路，停留纽约、波士顿、费城、亚特兰大、华盛顿特区、休斯敦、圣路易斯、辛辛那提、哥伦布、克利夫兰、底特律、印第安纳波利斯、芝加哥、图桑地区、凤凰城、圣地亚哥、旧金山、西雅图等十八个地区为华文教师培训。
0cd210a2516d08a37cbea1dc13205d3b28569fbd.translatedText: > The 2013 summer teacher training event of the "National Overseas Chinese Education Famous Teacher Tour" sponsored by the China Overseas Exchange Association and hosted by the National Association of Chinese Schools has successfully concluded recently. In order to more effectively promote the strong development of Chinese education in North America, China Overseas Exchange Association specially sent Professor Zhang Hesheng from Beijing Normal University, Associate Professor Cheng Long from Beijing Language and Culture University, Vice President Zhou Jinping of Cuiwei Primary School in Beijing, China, and Mr. Wang Kuangting, the team leader, Professor Xu Hongli, Vice President of Qingdao University, Professor Sheng Yuqi from the School of Liberal Arts of Shandong University, Vice Principal Wang Jing of the Primary School of the Second Affiliated Middle School of Shandong University, and Dr. Fang Zhensan, the team leader, and Yu Li from Sichuan University majoring in Chinese language and philology. Professor Ming, Professor Wang Xiaolu of Sichuan University, primary school Chinese teacher Li Hairong and team leader Ms. Li Hong and other strong lineups were divided into three routes: east, middle and west, stopping in 18 areas including New York, Boston, Philadelphia, Atlanta, Washington, DC, Houston, St. Louis, Cincinnati, Columbus, Cleveland, Detroit, Indianapolis, Chicago, Tucson, Phoenix, San Diego, San Francisco, and Seattle to train Chinese teachers.

7ffec08282a7d20020fdcdb082e41f7069282aed.sourceText: 各区这次培训项目的主要负责人为：大纽约华夏中文学校校长林骏，伟博教育中心校长韦剑波，协会联络中心主任、剑桥中国文化中心副董事长陶凯，协会理事、费城的任钢及项目负责人穆建西先生，协会常务副总干事、长城中文学校理事长依慧，协会联络中心主任、亚特兰大现代中文学校总校长龚晓红负责人惠秦，DC希望中文学校董事长梁康之，协会联络中心主任、华夏中文学校校长黄玲，协会理事、圣路易斯现代中文学校校长刘申，大辛辛那提中文学校校长胡华，协会理事、俄亥俄现代中文学校邵爱萍，协会名誉会长、克利夫兰当代中文学校理事长汤年发、校长王黎明，协会副会长、密西根中文学校协会董事长郑良根，希林协会执行主席杨八林及副校长李伟，协会秘书长何振宇，协会通讯季刊编委、图桑祖荀中文学校校长陈荣基，协会副总干事、亚省现代中文学校校长朱岩，协会副总干事、亚利桑那希望中文学校校长谢小红，协会联络中心主任、圣地亚哥华夏中文学校校长邢彬，长江/黄河中文学校校长顾丽青，协会联络中心主任、西北中文学校马冬校长、冷静副校长，以及协会会长帅致若；还有更多校董、校长、校委及志愿者们分别负责接待、组织、举办各地区的教师培训。在所在区域的各校积极配合、热情协助下，众志成城，齐心协力圆满地完成了此次培训任务。总计全美国共有128多各类中文学校，1173名从事华文教育的老师、校长、校委们参加了培训讲座，且有1061名参训者领取了培训证书。这是目前为止全美中文学校协会最大规模的，涉及学校、教师最广泛、人数最多的一次大范围教师培训。
7ffec08282a7d20020fdcdb082e41f7069282aed.translatedText: >The main persons in charge of this training project in each district are: Lin Jun, principal of Huaxia Chinese School in Greater New York; Wei Jianbo, principal of Weibo Education Center; Tao Kai, director of the association's liaison center and vice chairman of the Cambridge Chinese Cultural Center; Mr. Ren Gang, director of the association and project leader from Philadelphia; Yi Hui, executive deputy director-general of the association and chairman of the Great Wall Chinese School , Hui Qin, director of the association contact center and chief principal of Atlanta Modern Chinese School Gong Xiaohong, chairman of DC Hope Chinese School Liang Kangzhi, director of the association contact center and principal of Huaxia Chinese School Huang Ling, association director and principal of St. Louis Modern Chinese School Liu Shen, principal of Greater Cincinnati Chinese School Hu Hua, association director and Ohio Modern Chinese School Shao Aiping, honorary president of the association, Tang Nianfa, Chairman of Cleveland Contemporary Chinese School, and Wang Liming, Principal of Cleveland Contemporary Chinese School; Zheng Lianggen, Vice President of the Association and Chairman of the Michigan Chinese School Association; Yang Balin, Executive Chairman of the Xilin Association and Vice Principal Li Wei; He Zhenyu, Secretary General of the Association; Chen Rongji, Editorial Board Member of the Association’s Quarterly Journal and Principal of Zuxun Chinese School in Tucson; Zhu Yan, Deputy Director-General of the Association and Principal of Modern Chinese School of Alberta; Deputy Director-General of the Association, Arizona Xie Xiaohong, principal of Na Hope Chinese School, Xing Bin, director of the association liaison center and principal of San Diego Huaxia Chinese School, Gu Liqing, principal of Yangtze River/Yellow River Chinese School, Ma Dong, principal of the association liaison center, principal of Northwest Chinese School, Ling Ling, vice principal, and Shuai Zhiruo, president of the association; there are more school directors, principals, school committees and volunteers who are responsible for receiving, organizing and holding teacher training in various regions. With the active cooperation and enthusiastic assistance of the schools in the region, we united as one and worked together to successfully complete this training mission. In total, there are more than 128 Chinese schools of various types in the United States. 1,173 teachers, principals, and school committee members engaged in Chinese education participated in the training lectures, and 1,061 participants received training certificates. This is by far the largest large-scale teacher training by the National Chinese Schools Association, involving the most extensive schools and teachers and the largest number of people.

83275e9dd40b18713461ba23b517afcf652e6560.sourceText: 由于巡讲团成员学识广博、学术造诣深厚、教学实践经验丰富、解决问题针对性强，使广大教师学到现代华文教学各种富有创意的教学理念、技巧，也学到文字作为文化载体所具有的深厚底蕴和深入简出的理论；高师们妙语连珠的演讲带出了博大精深中华文字、中华文化的精华，使得听者们无不感到受益匪浅，各地好评如潮，纷纷希望此类培训在条件允许的情况下，尽可能多、尽可能广泛地举行。巡讲团成员们不辞远途跋涉的辛劳，兢兢业业的敬业精神也使各地接待组织者、受训者们深受教育。特别提出的是，中线巡讲团为满足各校的强力需求，克服万难，20来天内风尘仆仆地比原计划多跑出三个区域，各地学校均为之所感动和深受教育。中线巡讲团的山东大学文学院盛玉麒教授在这马不停蹄繁忙的奔波中，诗兴大发，为八个点的培训各题诗一首（另文发表），抒发为华文教育添砖加瓦的壮志豪情，令人感慨，可钦可佩。
83275e9dd40b18713461ba23b517afcf652e6560.translatedText: Due to the extensive knowledge, profound academic attainments, rich practical teaching experience and strong problem-solving skills of the members of the tour group, teachers have learned a variety of creative teaching concepts and techniques in modern Chinese teaching, as well as the uniqueness of words as a cultural carrier. The profound heritage and in-depth and simple theories; the witty speeches of the teachers brought out the essence of the extensive and profound Chinese characters and Chinese culture, which made the listeners feel that they benefited a lot. There were rave reviews from all over the country, and they all hope that such training can be held as much and as widely as possible when conditions permit. The members of the tour team spared no effort to travel long distances, and their dedicated professionalism also deeply educated the reception organizers and trainees in various places. In particular, in order to meet the strong needs of each school, the Central Line Tour Group overcame all difficulties and traveled to three more areas than originally planned in the past 20 days. Schools everywhere were moved and deeply educated. Professor Sheng Yuqi from the School of Liberal Arts of Shandong University, who is part of the Central Lecture Tour Group, became very popular in poetry during this non-stop busy schedule. He wrote a poem for each of the eight training points (published separately), expressing his ambition and passion to contribute to Chinese education. It is touching and admirable.

dd5f52dd40c44a39d569efe4903be3c49358735c.sourceText: 这次协会能成功举办如此规模的大型教师培训，是全体参训地区的学校领导、老师、志愿者们的实干和热情奉献所致。感谢祖籍国的大力支持，感谢更多的默默无闻的实干家们，我们北美华文业余教育就是在这样众多人的栽培下茁壮成长的。（2013.9.15）
dd5f52dd40c44a39d569efe4903be3c49358735c.translatedText: The association was able to successfully hold such a large-scale teacher training this time because of the hard work and enthusiastic dedication of all school leaders, teachers, and volunteers in the participating areas. Thanks to the strong support of our country of origin, and to more unknown doers, our Chinese amateur education in North America has thrived under the cultivation of so many people. (2013.9.15)

a6489501c3ec224979127c3d79bfade5d0433e0d.sourceText: 2013中国企业500强发布 中石化蝉联第一 中国企业联合会、中国企业家协会8月31日在昆明发布2013中国企业500强榜单，中石化以2012年营业收入28306亿元连续9年领跑榜单，中石油、国家电网、工商银行、建设银行、农业银行、中国银行、中国移动、中国建筑、中海油分列第二至第十位。 与上一年度相比，榜单前十位企业名单未出现变化，中石化、中石油、国家电网、工商银行、建设银行仍依次雄踞前五位，农业银行、中银行排名均上升了一位，中国移动由第六位退居第八位。在这500家企业中，有42家企业换榜，比上一年度增加了4家，表明中国大企业格局继续呈现较强的稳定性。 在入围门槛方面，2013中国企业500强的入围门槛达到了198．67亿元，较上年增长了13．48％。营业收入超过1000亿元的企业达到123家，比上年增加了16家；其中有16家民营企业，比上年增加了1家。这123家企业营业收入总额为34．97万亿元，占全部500强营业收入的69．9％。 虽然中国企业500强的整体规模持续壮大，去年的营业收入总额首次突破50万亿元，达到50．02万亿元，但增速已经显著放缓，仅为11．41％，比上年大幅回落了12．22个百分点。从经营效益来看，这500家企业的归属母公司利润总额为2．17万亿，仅比上年增长了3．58％；平均收入利润率为4．34％，比上年降低了0．33个百分点；平均资产利润率为1．44％，比上年降低了0．14个百分点，平均收入利润率和平均资产利润率已经连续两年出现下滑。 在税收方面，2013中国企业500强纳税总额达到3．65万亿元，较上年度增长了10．92％，占2012年中国税收总额的36．28％，但比上年的37．24％有所下降；从单个企业看，有69家企业的纳税额超过100亿元，比上年增加了9家。 值得关注的是，这500家企业中，有216家企业的净利润出现负增长；43家企业出现亏损，比上年度增加了30家，7家企业亏损进一步扩大。这500家企业中有430家企业填报了研发数据，共投入研发资金5424．95亿元，较上年增长了11．37％，但增幅较上年有明显回落，增速也略低于营业收入增速；这430家企业的平均研发强度为1．27％，已经连续两年下滑。 以下为2013年中国企业500强部分榜单 名次 a6489501c3ec224979127c3d79bfade5d0433e0d.translatedText: China Enterprises Confederation and China Entrepreneurs Association released the 2013 China Top 500 Enterprises list in Kunming on August 31. Sinopec has led the list for nine consecutive years with an operating income of 2,830.6 billion yuan in 2012. PetroChina, State Grid, Industrial and Commercial Bank of China, China Construction Bank, Agricultural Bank of China, Bank of China, China Mobile, China Construction, and CNOOC ranked second to tenth respectively. Compared with the previous year, the list of the top ten companies on the list has not changed. Sinopec, PetroChina, State Grid, Industrial and Commercial Bank of China, and China Construction Bank still rank in the top five. Agricultural Bank of China and Bank of China have both moved up one place in the rankings. China Mobile has dropped from sixth to eighth. Among these 500 companies, 42 companies changed the list, an increase of 4 companies from the previous year, indicating that the pattern of China's large companies continues to show strong stability. In terms of entry threshold, the entry threshold for the top 500 Chinese enterprises in 2013 reached 19.867 billion yuan, an increase of 13.48% over the previous year. The number of companies with operating income exceeding 100 billion yuan reached 123, an increase of 16 over the previous year; among them, 16 were private enterprises, an increase of one over the previous year. The total operating income of these 123 companies is 34.97 trillion yuan, accounting for 69.9% of the operating income of all the top 500 companies. Although the overall scale of China's top 500 enterprises continues to grow, with total operating income exceeding 50 trillion yuan for the first time last year, reaching 50.02 trillion yuan, the growth rate has slowed down significantly, only 11.41%, a sharp drop of 12.22 percentage points from the previous year. From the perspective of operating efficiency, the total profit attributable to the parent company of these 500 companies was 2.17 trillion, an increase of only 3.58% over the previous year; the average revenue profit rate was 4.34%, a decrease of 0.33 percentage points from the previous year; the average asset profit rate was 1.44%, a decrease of 0.14 percentage points from the previous year. The average revenue profit rate and average asset profit rate have declined for two consecutive years. In terms of taxation, the total tax paid by China's top 500 enterprises in 2013 reached 3.65 trillion yuan, an increase of 10.92% from the previous year, accounting for 36.28% of China's total tax revenue in 2012, but a decrease from 37.24% of the previous year. Looking at individual companies, there are 69 companies with tax payments exceeding 10 billion yuan, 9 more than the previous year. It is worth noting that among these 500 companies, 216 companies experienced negative growth in net profits; 43 companies suffered losses, an increase of 30 companies from the previous year, and 7 companies suffered further losses. 430 of these 500 companies have reported R&D data, investing a total of 542.495 billion yuan in R&D funds, an increase of 11.37% from the previous year. However, the growth rate has dropped significantly from the previous year, and the growth rate is slightly lower than the growth rate of operating income; the average R&D intensity of these 430 companies is 1.27%, which has been declining for two consecutive years.
