1d175e9642fbd4eea9c39bdd7291909a26d6d3fc.sourceText: 亲爱的朋友们， 金秋时节，秋高气爽，中国最重要的传统佳节中秋将至。恭祝大家瞌家团圆，中秋愉快！ 如果你曾阅读过中国历史上最具影响的文学经典名著之一的《红楼梦》； 如果你曾看过在国内无数次重播的87版电视连续剧《红楼梦》并至今记忆犹新； 如果你曾被《红楼梦》音乐中那风格独特，惆怅凄婉又极其优美动听的旋律深深感动:”此曲只应天上有， 人间哪得几回闻？” http://www.360doc.com/content/13/0224/10/2788370_267567111.shtml 如果你更曾记住了那位用如泣如诉般的情感诠释演绎了《红楼梦》音乐的著名歌唱家陈力的歌声； 如果你从未曾淡忘那无数首脍炙人口，广为传唱，曾伴随一代人成长并见证了我们青春岁月的歌曲《太阳岛上》、《浪花里飞出欢乐的歌》、《驼铃》、《少林，少林》、《牧羊曲》、《大海啊，故乡》。。。 如果你知道以上所有感人肺腑、根植于心的隽永的优美旋律都出自中国当代最著名的作曲家王立平先生之手； 那么，当你耳闻9月20-21日晚，将在亚利桑那大学音乐厅举办北美首演的《红楼梦交响音乐会》(中秋音乐会)； 当你了解到这将是亚利桑那大学建校一百二十年的建校史上，第一次举办中国音乐作品音乐会； 当你知悉受邀于亚大孔院专程赴美参加Tucson第二届中国文化节的王立平老先生，将亲临出席观看这场音乐会，并举办《红楼梦》专题访谈节目； 当你知晓歌唱家陈力将受中秋音乐会之邀，担纲《红楼梦交响音乐会》的全部独唱和领唱； 当你获知这场精心策划筹备、历时半年有余的中秋音乐会，将汇聚中美两国的艺术家、音乐家。亚利桑那大学音乐学院、美国亚利桑那交响乐团、中国陕西师范大学民乐团、图森华声合唱团 (Tucson Sino Choir)、亚利桑那合唱团、亚利桑那男童合唱团等，将联袂合作， 并由亚利桑那交响乐团的Mr. Thomas Cockrell执棒指挥；除《红楼梦》外，还将为现场观众带来传统、现代，包括国粹京剧以及旅美著名音乐家谭盾的中国音乐作品。。。您一定可以想象中秋音乐会将带给现场观众怎样唯美享受的一场视听盛宴。 有兴趣的朋友，大家还可以在9月20日的音乐会后的reception中，和家人朋友一起驻足赏月、品尝中秋月饼（九月二十日恰是中国农历八月十六，又曰八月十五的月亮十六圆）。。。 亲爱的朋友，在这花好月圆的美好中秋之夜，你是否渴望邀亲唤友，结伴走进大学音乐厅，去共同欣赏这场有着非同寻常意义的”Once of life experience”的《红楼梦交响音乐会》？音乐会演出票有限，预购请从速： UA音乐学院售票处票价：$15 UA音乐学院售票处优惠票价： UA教职员工及Senior ( $10 ); UA Student ( $5 )； 同时，可在Tucson华声合唱团购买统一优惠票价 (仅代售9月20日，星期五音乐会)： $12 有意在Tucson华声合唱团处购票的朋友，请Email： ningq66@gmail.com
1d175e9642fbd4eea9c39bdd7291909a26d6d3fc.translatedText: Dear friends, In the golden autumn season, the air is crisp and clear, and China's most important traditional festival, the Mid-Autumn Festival, is approaching. I wish you all a happy family reunion and a happy Mid-Autumn Festival! If you have ever read "A Dream of Red Mansions", one of the most influential literary classics in Chinese history; if you have watched the 1987 version of the TV series "A Dream of Red Mansions" that has been rebroadcast countless times in China and still remember it; if you have been deeply moved by the unique style, melancholy and extremely beautiful melody in the music of "A Dream of Red Mansions": "This music should only exist in heaven, how many times can it be heard in the world?" http://www.360doc.com/content/13/0224/10/2788370_267567111.shtml If you have ever remembered the singing voice of the famous singer Chen Li who performed the music of "A Dream of Red Mansions" with a tearful and emotional interpretation; If you have never forgotten the countless popular and widely sung songs, "Island of the Sun", "Songs of Joy Flying from the Waves", "Shaolin, Shaolin", "Shepherd's Song", and "Ocean, My Hometown" that have accompanied a generation's growth and witnessed our youth. . . If you know that all the above touching and timeless beautiful melodies rooted in the heart were written by Mr. Wang Liping, the most famous contemporary Chinese composer; then, when you heard that on the evening of September 20-21, the North American premiere of the "Dream of Red Mansions Symphony Concert" (Mid-Autumn Festival Concert) will be held at the University of Arizona Concert Hall; when you learned that this will be the first time in the 120-year history of the University of Arizona to hold a concert of Chinese music works; When you know that Mr. Wang Liping, who was invited by the Confucius Institute at Asia University to the United States to participate in the second Chinese Culture Festival in Tucson, will attend the concert in person and hold a special interview program on "Dream of Red Mansions"; when you know that singer Chen Li will be invited by the Mid-Autumn Festival Concert to perform all solo and lead vocals in "Dream of Red Mansions Symphony Concert"; when you learn that this Mid-Autumn Festival concert, which has been carefully planned and prepared for more than half a year, will bring together artists and musicians from China and the United States. The School of Music at the University of Arizona, the Arizona Symphony Orchestra, Shaanxi Normal University Chinese Orchestra, Tucson Sino Choir, Arizona Choir, Arizona Boys Choir, etc. will work together, and will be conducted by Mr. Thomas Cockrell of the Arizona Symphony Orchestra. In addition to "Dream of Red Mansions", traditional and modern Chinese music works will also be brought to the audience, including the quintessence of Chinese Peking Opera and the famous musician Tan Dun in the United States. . . You can definitely imagine what an audio-visual feast the Mid-Autumn Festival Concert will bring to the audience. Interested friends can also stop to admire the moon and taste Mid-Autumn moon cakes with family and friends in the reception after the concert on September 20 (September 20 happens to be the sixteenth day of the eighth month of the Chinese lunar calendar, and the moon is sixteenth round on the fifteenth day of August). . . Dear friends, on this beautiful Mid-Autumn Festival night when the flowers are blooming and the moon is full, are you eager to invite relatives and friends to walk into the university concert hall to enjoy the "Dream of Red Mansions Symphony Concert" with its extraordinary "Once of life experience"? Concert performance tickets are limited, please pre-order as soon as possible: UA Conservatory of Music Box Office Ticket Price: $15 UA Conservatory of Music Box Office Discounted Ticket Prices: UA Faculty and Senior ($10); UA Student ($5); At the same time, a unified discounted ticket price can be purchased at the Tucson Huasheng Chorus (only for the concert on September 20, Friday): $12. Friends who are interested in purchasing tickets at the Tucson Huasheng Choir, please email: ningq66@gmail.com

9c1e4368099f85f1e9e8d1c572c9e5984b3f3725.sourceText: 凤凰城中文学校秋季班开学了! 凤凰城中文学校 来稿 在炎炎的暑假结束后，本校新的学期秋季班将于八月十八日注册开学。上课地点依然是在美莎社区大学 (Mesa Community College)，上课时间为每周日下午1:30 -3:30。 凤凰城中文学校不仅为学生开设由幼儿学前班一直晋阶到十一年级，并开办成人初级/高级会话班，提供社会大众，有兴趣学中文的人士一个学习的机会。本学年所有双语班将以Better Chinese为主要教学教材，并以网上教材为辅助教材，以方便家长和小孩在家一起学习中文。 本校除了中文教学之外，课后从3:30 – 4:30并安排有中国结、篮球、儿童劳作、排舞、话剧和书法等课外活动。在学生上课时，还有开办成人中国结、成人篮球，让等待的家长也可以参与活动，一边学习，另一方面增加与其他家长互动的机会。 如果您想多认识凤凰城中文学校，或是想加入这个大家庭，请与校长程秀玲联络(480-620-1982) 或参观学校网页( http://www.clsphoenix.org/ )。凤凰城中文学校邀请你加入我们的团队。
9c1e4368099f85f1e9e8d1c572c9e5984b3f3725.translatedText: The fall classes of Phoenix Chinese School have started! Submissions from Phoenix Chinese School After the hot summer vacation, registration for the new fall semester of our school will begin on August 18th. The class location is still at Mesa Community College, and the class time is every Sunday afternoon from 1:30-3:30. Phoenix Chinese School not only offers students from kindergarten to eleventh grade, but also offers beginner/advanced conversation classes for adults, providing a learning opportunity for the general public and those who are interested in learning Chinese. All bilingual classes this school year will use Better Chinese as the main teaching material, and online teaching materials as supplementary teaching materials to facilitate parents and children to learn Chinese together at home. In addition to Chinese teaching, our school also arranges extracurricular activities such as Chinese knot, basketball, children's work, line dancing, drama and calligraphy after class from 3:30 to 4:30. When students are in class, adult Chinese knots and adult basketball are also held, so that waiting parents can also participate in the activities, while learning, and on the other hand, increasing the opportunity to interact with other parents. If you want to know more about Phoenix Chinese School or want to join this big family, please contact the principal Cheng Xiuling (480-620-1982) or visit the school website (http://www.clsphoenix.org/). Phoenix Chinese School invites you to join our team.

397bb5073b1edcc65d7e2552c220c177a006648f.sourceText: 亚裔儿童家境最好 中位收入近8万 最新研究显示，移民的第二代子女，其中9成都是合法公民，往往比本土美国人子女生活的更好，父母工作更稳定，出生时身体更健康死亡率更低，青少年时期受教育程度更高。 纽约?#20799;童发展基金会?#30740;究表示，这个国家每四个儿童中就有一个有移民家长，因此有越来越多的研究着重于这些孩子和他们来自非移民家庭同辈人的对比。报告的作者表示，这些移民家庭来到美国时没有受到社会足够的教育以及医保上的支持，但是他们仍然坚强地为子女闯出一条路。 根据《督教科学箴言报》报导，报告指出，父母出生于美国的移民第三代亚裔儿童，所处家庭的中位收入将近8万元，是所有移民家庭中最高的，其中非裔家庭最低，仅有2万9977元。 报告中指出，四年级小学生的英文阅读能力，亚裔学生也比其他非裔和西裔的同学好。家里主要语言非英语的非裔儿童，多达84%阅读能力不足，但家里说英语的非裔儿童，也有83%阅读不佳。这个比率最低的是亚裔，不论家里是否说英语，只有51%的亚裔儿童阅读能力不足。 不过在学前教育和享有医保方面，非裔、白人、西语裔和亚裔的移民子女都比较差。 报告指出，到了2018年美国白人小孩将不到半数，而且移民家庭中，九成儿童是美国公民，所以这些少数族裔儿童将成为美国未来的重大组成部分。
397bb5073b1edcc65d7e2552c220c177a006648f.translatedText: >Asian children have the best family circumstances, with a median income of nearly 80,000. The latest research shows that second-generation children of immigrants, 90% of whom are legal citizens, tend to live better than native-American children. Their parents have more stable jobs, are healthier at birth, have lower mortality rates, and are better educated as teenagers. One in four children in this country has an immigrant parent, according to a study by the New York-based Child Development Foundation, so there is a growing body of research focusing on how these children compare to their peers from non-immigrant families. The authors of the report said that these immigrant families did not receive adequate education and medical support from society when they came to the United States, but they still worked hard to carve a way for their children. According to the Christian Science Monitor, the report pointed out that the median income of third-generation Asian children whose parents were born in the United States is nearly 80,000 yuan, the highest among all immigrant families. Among them, African-American families have the lowest income, only 29,977 yuan. The report pointed out that the English reading ability of fourth-grade elementary school students is also better than that of other African-American and Hispanic students. As many as 84% ​​of African-American children whose primary language at home is not English have poor reading skills, but 83% of African-American children whose families speak English are also poor in reading. The lowest rate is among Asians, where only 51% of Asian children have insufficient reading skills, regardless of whether English is spoken at home. However, in terms of pre-school education and access to health insurance, African-American, white, Hispanic and Asian immigrant children are worse off. The report points out that by 2018, less than half of the children in the United States will be white, and 90% of the children in immigrant families will be U.S. citizens, so these minority children will become an important part of the future of the United States.

The new appointees either have exchanges in other places or have experience in multiple places. According to Zhengzhou Evening News, it was learned from public information that Zeng Qinghong, member of the Standing Committee of the Chongqing Municipal Party Committee and Minister of the Organization Department of the Municipal Party Committee, Zhao Aiming, member of the Standing Committee of the Jiangxi Provincial Committee and Minister of the Organization Department of the Provincial Committee, and Ma Xuejun, Minister of the Organization Department of the Party Committee of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region, who were recently appointed, are respectively the Vice Governor of Jiangxi Province, the Deputy Director of the Standing Committee of the Sichuan Provincial People's Congress, and the Inspector and Deputy Director of the Second Bureau of Cadres of the Central Organization Department. Before taking office recently, Xu Songnan, member of the Standing Committee of the Chongqing Municipal Committee and Secretary of the Municipal Commission for Discipline Inspection, had long worked in Sichuan, Hubei, and Ningxia. Since March 2012, he has been a member of the Standing Committee of the Chongqing Municipal Committee and director of the Organization Department of the Municipal Committee; Ni Yuefeng, member of the Standing Committee of the Chongqing Provincial Committee and Secretary of the Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection, has long worked in Qingdao, the State Oceanic Administration, and the National People's Congress Environment He worked with the Resource Protection Committee and was appointed as the vice governor of Fujian Province in February 2011; Wang Lingjun, member of the Standing Committee of the Qinghai Provincial Committee and director of the Organization Department of the Provincial Committee, has long worked in Shenzhen and the State Administration for Industry and Commerce. Since December 2007, he has been successively appointed as the deputy governor of Qinghai Province, a member of the Standing Committee of the Provincial Committee, and the Secretary of the Political and Legal Affairs Committee of the Provincial Committee. 29f65a0aa2cd2660678122d9648186f97a072875.sourceText: （本网讯） 7 月 3 日亚太社区促进会（亚促会）在 Excelencia School 举行新闻发布会， 为广大低收入家庭带来了价格非常低廉的儿童医疗保险。现场来了很多咨询保险内容的家长和小朋友。
29f65a0aa2cd2660678122d9648186f97a072875.translatedText: (news from this website) On July 3, the Asia Pacific Community Promotion Association (Asia Development and Reform Commission) held a press conference at Excelencia School. It has brought very low-priced children’s medical insurance to the majority of low-income families. Many parents and children came to the scene to inquire about the insurance content.

991566d8d4466598c85a8401f24739328b7c1c04.sourceText: Graciela Montenegro 是一个刚刚失业的孩子的妈妈。她的女儿今年 13 岁了，因为有慢性疾病，每个月需要 $300 左右药费进行治疗。自从 Graciela 失业后，孩子的药费就让这个小家庭没法负担。朋友把这个医疗保险的信息告诉了 Graciela 。在工作人员的帮助下，他们注册了这个儿童医疗保险。 Graciela 的孩子现在获得了她需要的药物，顺利进行治疗。他们每月只需支付 $15 的保险费, 。 Graciela 非常感谢社区提供的如此优惠的项目，希望有更多孩子能获得健康的保障。
991566d8d4466598c85a8401f24739328b7c1c04.translatedText: Graciela Montenegro is a mother of a child who has just lost her job. Her daughter is 13 years old this year. She has a chronic disease and needs about $300 in medication every month for treatment. Since Graciela lost her job, the child's medication has become unaffordable for the small family. A friend told Graciela about the health insurance. With the help of the staff, they signed up for the children's medical insurance. Graciela's baby now has the medication she needs and is well on her way to treatment. They only pay a monthly premium of $15, . Graciela is very grateful to the community for providing such a favorable project and hopes that more children can receive health protection.

0e9184a6d574e2e7e1855cf40d875a69dd47e411.sourceText: 这个儿童医疗保险（ Kidscare ）是针对年收入在 $46,000 以下的家庭。此类家庭 18 岁以下的孩子都可以获得这个保险。一个孩子的保险费价格在 15-50 每月不等，两个或者两个以上孩子的家庭在 $20-$70 不等。这些孩子必须是之前没有保险的。儿童意外伤害，慢性疾病等问题将获得保障。
0e9184a6d574e2e7e1855cf40d875a69dd47e411.translatedText: This children's medical insurance (Kidscare) is aimed at families with an annual income of less than $46,000. This insurance is available to children under the age of 18 in such families. Insurance premiums range from $15-$50 per month for one child and $20-$70 for a family of two or more children. These children must have been previously uninsured. Children's accidental injuries, chronic diseases and other issues will be covered.

a32c62c8fafa82503d2aa834ae38a1979a24f4a2.sourceText: 这个保险项目最多能够支持 $60,000 个儿童，目前已经有 36,000 多孩子参加。希望符合条件的家长们赶紧报名，有更多问题请咨询： 1 （ 800 ） -235-9678 。
a32c62c8fafa82503d2aa834ae38a1979a24f4a2.translatedText: This insurance program can support up to $60,000 of children, and currently more than 36,000 children have participated. Parents who meet the requirements are encouraged to sign up quickly. If you have more questions, please contact: 1 (800) -235-9678.

f0b5273d7a3e4baeeee47f6077c28b1abf1cdcd8.translatedText: The U.S. Boeing 787 Dreamliner has another problem. After the Boeing 787 Dreamliner resumed flying, more problems continued to occur. A Japan Airlines Dreamliner flying to Tokyo 1...

7ed3b60637a6bacd1b71ef2c35d0d842e4c5d2b0.sourceText: 这是继埃塞俄比亚航空公司一架飞机上周因电池问题起火，导致英国希斯罗机场一度关闭后，梦幻客机再次出状况。
7ed3b60637a6bacd1b71ef2c35d0d842e4c5d2b0.translatedText: This is after an Ethiopian Airlines plane caught fire due to a battery problem last week, causing the British Heathrow Airport to be temporarily closed. The Dreamliner has another problem.

b3319ad237bbc134ab294b86b3aabbc08896f63c.sourceText: 日航梦幻机是18日下午1时许离开波士顿罗根机场飞往日本，飞行时间预计14个小时，但下午6时30分前重返波士顿。在航班宣布取消后，所有乘客均被安排转搭其他航班继续旅程。
b3319ad237bbc134ab294b86b3aabbc08896f63c.translatedText: The Japan Airlines Dreamliner left Boston Logan Airport for Japan at around 1 pm on the 18th. The flight time was expected to be 14 hours, but it returned to Boston before 6:30 pm. After the flight was announced to be cancelled, all passengers were arranged to transfer to other flights to continue their journey.

06bec4006af001a2e4a297b94a76829b43d173c7.sourceText: 日航发言人说，从波士顿飞往日本东京的梦幻机，返航是为防意外而采取的预防措施。机师在看到仪表发出警告，指油泵有问题时，采取了标准的防范措施。机师的返航降落安全，没有宣布飞机进入紧急状态。
06bec4006af001a2e4a297b94a76829b43d173c7.translatedText: A spokesman for Japan Airlines said that the return of the Dreamliner from Boston to Tokyo, Japan, was a precautionary measure to prevent accidents. The pilot took standard precautions when he saw the instrument warning that there was a problem with the fuel pump. The pilot returned and landed safely, and no emergency was declared.

d7b918004f1266ffcfabc7d5de59ca969a7d5c3e.sourceText: 日航787梦幻机在罗根机场至少出现两次故障，今年1月曾发生电池失火，第二天，另一架梦幻机在跑道上漏出50加仑燃油。
d7b918004f1266ffcfabc7d5de59ca969a7d5c3e.translatedText: Japan Airlines' 787 Dreamliner experienced at least two malfunctions at Logan Airport. A battery fire occurred in January this year, and the next day, another Dreamliner leaked 50 gallons of fuel on the runway.

4e7021a95bff5dc60c945de55fd04f709e6e1ff8.sourceText: 一架梦幻机本月12日在英国希斯罗机场起火，导致机场在消防员救火期间，被关闭一个半小时。 18日公布的埃塞俄比亚航空公司梦幻机的调查显示，失火是锂电池发生故障。
4e7021a95bff5dc60c945de55fd04f709e6e1ff8.translatedText: A Dreamliner caught fire at Heathrow Airport in the United Kingdom on the 12th of this month, causing the airport to be closed for an hour and a half while firefighters put out the fire. An investigation into the Ethiopian Airlines Dreamliner released on the 18th showed that the fire was caused by a malfunction of the lithium battery.

fe2dd773bea169de4ec71e388e5d5e3a3f180683.sourceText: 同日在德州休士顿也传出飞机被迫返航的事件。联合航空公司一架飞往阿姆斯特丹的波音777航班18日傍晚因一具引擎停机，被迫在休士顿机场紧急降落，降落时没有发生意外，事件中也没有人员受伤。
fe2dd773bea169de4ec71e388e5d5e3a3f180683.translatedText: On the same day, there were also reports of a plane being forced to return in Houston, Texas. A United Airlines Boeing 777 flight bound for Amsterdam was forced to make an emergency landing at the Houston Airport due to an engine shutdown on the evening of the 18th. There was no accident during the landing and no one was injured in the incident.

eda2732831fae3391b7190d28a0bb1c3b3a02de3.sourceText: 联航人员说：”从休士顿飞往阿姆斯特丹的58号航班，在工作人员发现一台引擎的问题后，开始返航回到休士顿机场。”
eda2732831fae3391b7190d28a0bb1c3b3a02de3.translatedText: United Airlines personnel said: "Flight 58 from Houston to Amsterdam began returning to the Houston Airport after the staff discovered an engine problem."

1d25fd25ac5d0721ba7eeb222246fd7d2d021867.sourceText: (亚省华联供稿) 第七届《凤凰之夜》庆祝中华人民共和国成立64周年国庆招待会暨中秋佳节将于2013年9月22日在亚利桑那州立大学隆重举行。为了筹办这次活动，亚省华联会长王惟咨于6月23日召集了第一次筹备会议。王惟咨会长首先向大家介绍了新一届华联组织结构，并就第七届《凤凰之夜》的初步构想和活动安排与大家交换了意见。会议开得热烈有序，大家畅所欲言，集思广益，初步勾画出了一幅弘扬中国文化、促进中美友谊的活动蓝图。届时亚利桑那州侨学界将举办一系列相关庆祝活动，其中包括：中美文化论坛、国庆招待会、才艺表演、中秋联谊舞会、青少年作文比赛和摄影比赛(有待最后决定)。
1d25fd25ac5d0721ba7eeb222246fd7d2d021867.translatedText: (Contributed by Alberta Hualian) The seventh "Phoenix Night" celebration of the 64th anniversary of the founding of the People's Republic of China and the Mid-Autumn Festival will be held grandly at Arizona State University on September 22, 2013. In order to prepare for this event, Wang Weizi, president of the Chinese Federation of Alberta, convened the first preparatory meeting on June 23. President Wang Weizi first introduced the new organizational structure of Hualian to everyone, and exchanged opinions with everyone on the preliminary concept and activity arrangements of the seventh "Phoenix Night". The meeting was held in a lively and orderly manner. Everyone spoke freely, brainstormed, and initially sketched out a blueprint for activities to promote Chinese culture and promote Sino-US friendship. At that time, the overseas Chinese community in Arizona will hold a series of related celebration activities, including: Sino-US Cultural Forum, National Day Reception, Talent Show, Mid-Autumn Festival Dance, Youth Essay Competition and Photography Competition (to be finalized).

ce305e6d7d232177352619a1eeb57612609570bd.translatedText: See you at the National Day Beauty Pageant on July 4th! Written by Zhang Zhaohong As the date of the National Day beauty pageant approaches, the beauties of the Miss Chinese Phoenix Pageant are about to embark on...

95cb0a07544a33ede6cd02316c675bdb7744024e.sourceText: 随着国庆选美日期的临近，凤凰城华裔小姐选美的佳丽们，即将踏上她们人生旅途中的一个重要舞台，去展示她们的美丽和才华，几个月的精心准备和无数遍的演练，终于到了要尽情发挥的这一刻。紧张吗？难免！期盼吗？一定！”最佳上镜小姐”虽有赛果但尚未公佈，网上投票的”人气小姐”即将出炉但仍需等待，佳丽们忐忑的心情，你们知道吗？即将来临的选美大赛，面临夏日风情的泳装骚，临场发挥的才艺秀，斗智逗趣的问答题，佳丽们虽有胜算却无把握。谁可艳压群芳，脱颖而出？最终是那隻凤凰迎风展翅，飞上枝头？让我们和佳丽一起翘首以待！7月4日国庆及选美晚会不见不散！ 还是先看一组佳丽们的生活照片，从每个人甜美的笑意，自信心的倍添，就知道参加选美是不虚此行，不是人人可以梦境成真，却是每位佳丽都能得到人生中难得的历炼。
95cb0a07544a33ede6cd02316c675bdb7744024e.translatedText: As the National Day beauty pageant approaches, the beauties of the Miss Chinese Phoenix Pageant are about to embark on an important stage in their life journeys to showcase their beauty and talent. After months of careful preparation and countless rehearsals, they have finally reached the moment when they can give full play to their talents. Nervous? It’s inevitable! Looking forward to it? must! Although the results of "Miss Photogenic" have been announced, they have not yet been announced. The "Miss Popularity" voted on online will be announced soon, but they still have to wait. Do you know the uneasy mood of the beauties? The upcoming beauty pageant will feature summer-style swimsuits, on-the-spot talent shows, and witty quizzes. Although the beauties have a chance of winning, they are not sure. Who can stand out from the crowd? In the end, it was the phoenix that spread its wings in the wind and flew up the branch? Let us look forward to it with the beauties! See you at the National Day and Beauty Pageant Party on July 4th! Let’s first take a look at a group of photos of the beauties’ daily lives. From the sweet smiles and increased self-confidence of each one, you can tell that participating in the beauty pageant is a worthwhile trip. Not everyone can make their dreams come true, but every beautician can get a rare experience in life.

3a1b518f847dada99e251baaa006a105bae76011.sourceText: 厦门纵火案8名失踪考生全部遇难 央视新闻【厦门公交车起火案：8名下落不明考生全部遇难】记者获悉，目前8名下落不明的学生全部遇难。其中医高专3人，同安职校4人，工商旅游学校1人，皆为赴高职单招考试的考生。 早前报道： 记者从厦门市教育局获悉，厦门公交车起火案件中8名下落不明考生已有7名确认遇难，还有1名还在DNA比对确认中。 7日傍晚发生的厦门公交车纵火案共造成47人死亡、34人因伤住院。厦门市教育局副局长郭献文说，在车上共有15名中等职业学校参加今年高等教育职业学校招生统一考试的考生，考点在集美的厦门工商旅游学院，这些学生是参加完考试后从集美赶回来，其中，受伤7人，有8名学生下落不明。 郭献文说，8名下落不明考生已有7名确认遇难，还有1名还在DNA比对确认中，厦门正在做学生家长的关心疏导工作，关心照顾好住院学生。
3a1b518f847dada99e251baaa006a105bae76011.translatedText: 8 missing examinees were killed in Xiamen arson case CCTV News [Xiamen Bus Fire Case: All 8 Unaccounted Examination Students Died] Reporters learned that all 8 students whose whereabouts were unknown were killed. Among them, 3 are from medical college, 4 are from Tongan Vocational School, and 1 is from Industrial and Commercial Tourism School, all of whom are candidates for the single-entry examination for higher vocational colleges. Earlier report: Reporters learned from the Xiamen Municipal Education Bureau that 7 of the 8 students whose whereabouts were unknown in the Xiamen bus fire case have been confirmed to have been killed, and one is still being confirmed by DNA comparison. A total of 47 people were killed and 34 were hospitalized due to injuries in the Xiamen bus arson incident that occurred on the evening of the 7th. Guo Xianwen, deputy director of the Xiamen Municipal Education Bureau, said that there were 15 secondary vocational school candidates taking this year's unified examination for higher education vocational school admissions in the car. The examination center was Xiamen Industry and Commerce Tourism College in Jimei. These students rushed back from Jimei after taking the examination. Among them, 7 were injured and 8 students were missing. Guo Xianwen said that 7 of the 8 unaccounted candidates have been confirmed to have died, and 1 is still being confirmed through DNA comparison. Xiamen is doing care and guidance for the parents of the students and taking good care of the hospitalized students.

9c35e503d453bccbb04d084578b356e957f4122b.translatedText: IBM plans to lay off 8,000 people worldwide. It has already started.

958b13aabcfa0518f9bfc5150e1e68aea6c43497.translatedText: IBM plans to lay off 8,000 people worldwide. It has started. According to Bloomberg, people familiar with the matter revealed that IBM has started laying off employees across the United States from this Wednesday. This is...

606bbadca87981852753e0c3aa65959c6f488d06.sourceText: 据彭博社报道，知情人士透露，IBM已经从本周三开始在全美裁员，这是该公司在全球范围内削减10亿美元支出计划的一部分。
606bbadca87981852753e0c3aa65959c6f488d06.translatedText: According to Bloomberg, people familiar with the matter revealed that IBM has started laying off employees across the United States starting this Wednesday. This is part of the company’s plan to cut $1 billion in expenditures globally.

332ee1fc7ec8e1141b0817af079c79097e1456d4.sourceText: 该知情人士称，IBM此次裁员的目标涉及各级别员工。劳工组织 Alliance@IBM 协调员李 康拉德(Lee Conrad)也证实了这一消息。康拉德透露，从周二开始，IBM位于美国的部分员工就已经接到了裁员通知。
332ee1fc7ec8e1141b0817af079c79097e1456d4.translatedText: The person familiar with the matter said that IBM’s targets for layoffs involve employees at all levels. Lee Conrad, coordinator of the labor organization Alliance@IBM, also confirmed the news. Conrad revealed that starting on Tuesday, some IBM employees in the United States have received layoff notices.

15bb234c05c4ad306defefc4b11b8a9952a88984.sourceText: IBM今年4月份公布的2013年第一季度业绩令人失望，随后该公司宣布了一项裁员计划。IBM当时表示裁员主要集中在海外而非美国国内。
15bb234c05c4ad306defefc4b11b8a9952a88984.translatedText: IBM announced a layoff plan in April after disappointing first-quarter 2013 results. IBM said at the time that layoffs were mainly concentrated overseas rather than in the United States.

76fb47a37ee5a8fd1a3fcccfd6f6be2fb7915eba.sourceText: 华盛顿州投资研究机构Oracle Investment Research分析师劳伦斯 巴尔特(Laurence Balter)指出，IBM计划通过裁员削减10亿美元成本，如果以业界的补偿标准来看，IBM最终有可能在全球范围内裁员6000至8000名员工。
76fb47a37ee5a8fd1a3fcccfd6f6be2fb7915eba.translatedText: Laurence Balter, an analyst at Oracle Investment Research, a Washington state investment research institution, pointed out that IBM plans to cut costs by US$1 billion through layoffs. Based on the industry's compensation standards, IBM may eventually lay off 6,000 to 8,000 employees worldwide.

399a27da2a1ad07713456827c08aef88b0c13f8f.sourceText: 截至2012年12月31日，IBM员工总数为434246人，这意味着本次裁员人员数将接近IBM员工总数的2%。
399a27da2a1ad07713456827c08aef88b0c13f8f.translatedText: As of December 31, 2012, the total number of IBM employees was 434,246, which means that the number of layoffs will be close to 2% of the total number of IBM employees.

6ef540d6e227ab66feed2520e9e942ed7a3a8026.sourceText: IBM发言人表示：”在科技行业，人员变动是很常见的事，而转型也是公司商业模式的一部分。因此，将员工进行重新组合是公司根据业务需求所做的决定。鉴于IBM在行业内的领导地位，我们不会公布此次人事调整的具体细节。”
6ef540d6e227ab66feed2520e9e942ed7a3a8026.translatedText: An IBM spokesperson said: "In the technology industry, personnel changes are common, and transformation is also part of the company's business model. Therefore, reorganizing employees is a decision made by the company based on business needs. In view of IBM's leading position in the industry, we will not announce the specific details of this personnel adjustment."

fed81ecfc32265099c3b4363d143056fec381441.sourceText: 青少年们围绕＂我爱亚利桑那＂这一主题，认真创作，用他们敏锐的洞察力和特异的手法，精心描绘出一幅幅美丽的圗昼，展示了亚利桑那的热带风情和人文景观，作品质量有很大提高。五位评委都是长期从事艺术事业并具有一定造诣的专业人士，他们经过认真讨论，经民主投票，分年龄组各选出十名优胜者，并评选出第一、二、三名（见附件）。三十名优胜者将在七月四日的庆祝国庆大会上授奬。每位参与比赛的青少年都会得到一份John yen’family 设计的一份精美的证书作为纪念。 所有绘画作品将在七月四日庆国庆大会会塲展出，并以参会者每人一票的方式投票选出我最喜爱的一幅画。欢迎大家积极参与。 需要有关作品的图片请与林萱联系：lxfineart@hotmail.com 电话：602 -626-8237 绘画作品将退还夲人。具体退还事宜请与万培杰先生联系: wpj834866@hotmail.com 电话：626-466-8539

All the paintings will be displayed at the Fourth of July National Day Convention, and attendees will be able to vote for my favorite painting. Everyone is welcome to actively participate. ed892a3144a12d5462edae183f29241cbe577203.sourceText: 您想戒烟吗？联邦政府建立了一个亚裔烟友戒烟热线，此专线提供华语(普通话与广东话)免费电话辅导，并有两个星期的免费尼古丁贴片。研究显示个别辅导与尼古丁贴片是成功戒烟的有效组合，请打热线电话: 1-800-838-8917
ed892a3144a12d5462edae183f29241cbe577203.translatedText: Do you want to quit smoking? The federal government has established a smoking cessation hotline for Asian smokers, which provides free telephone counseling in Chinese (Mandarin and Cantonese) and free nicotine patches for two weeks. Research shows that individual counseling and nicotine patches are an effective combination for successful smoking cessation. Please call the hotline: 1-800-838-8917

2874f17b634706633457e2d4cd58c451c3caf85a.sourceText: 会说华语的辅导员週一至週五，太平洋时间上午八时至晚间九时为您提供电话辅导，录音戒烟信息或语音留言二十四小时开放。说英语的人士可透过亚利桑那州烟友辅助专线(ASHLine): 1-800-556-6222 取得免费戒烟辅导。
2874f17b634706633457e2d4cd58c451c3caf85a.translatedText: Mandarin-speaking counselors are available Monday to Friday, 8 a.m. to 9 p.m. Pacific Time, to provide you with telephone counseling. Recorded smoking cessation information or voice messages are available 24 hours a day. English speakers can get free smoking cessation counseling through the Arizona Smokers Help Line (ASHLine): 1-800-556-6222.

218a7fd906177f5a23ed6c746727307b745a5677.sourceText: 欲知更多戒烟相关信息，请致电亚太社区促进会480-452-5771黄智樱女士 或浏览亚裔烟友戒烟热线网站: www.asiansmokersquitline.org 。
218a7fd906177f5a23ed6c746727307b745a5677.translatedText: For more information on quitting smoking, please call Ms. Huang Zhiying of the Asia Pacific Community Promotion Association at 480-452-5771 or visit the Asian Smokers Quitline website: www.asiansmokersquitline.org.

686105a848c3cb953034e0abe6e036c9295f7dd0.sourceText: 全美房市复苏:房价大涨10.9%
686105a848c3cb953034e0abe6e036c9295f7dd0.translatedText: National housing market recovery: housing prices soared 10.9%

3783e48fc5918949df302fda7b57cb7084888e4d.sourceText: 全美房市复苏:房价大涨10.9% 纽约时报报道，美国20城市房价综合指数较去年上涨10.9%，继续了年初的…
3783e48fc5918949df302fda7b57cb7084888e4d.translatedText: National housing market recovery: housing prices rose 10.9% The New York Times reported that the comprehensive housing price index in 20 U.S. cities rose 10.9% from last year, continuing the trend at the beginning of the year...

b4567a0d8dbe52b257d50be6319901ae526956f4.sourceText: 纽约时报报道，美国20城市房价综合指数较去年上涨10.9%，继续了年初的回暖势头。房地产复苏、油价下降、股市上扬，这些都增强了消费者的信心。
b4567a0d8dbe52b257d50be6319901ae526956f4.translatedText: The New York Times reported that the comprehensive housing price index in 20 U.S. cities rose 10.9% from last year, continuing the recovery momentum at the beginning of the year. A recovery in real estate, falling oil prices, and a rising stock market have all boosted consumer confidence.

aef892c9812aaf4a6994f62b0a07a3e41bac50fb.sourceText: 房市回暖，消费者信心增高 周二，标准普尔(Standard & Poor抯)凯斯-希勒(Case-Shiller)房屋价格指数涨幅创下了七年来的新高，这是美国房地产市场复苏的最新迹象。被追踪的20座城市的房价全部出现上涨，延续了始于三个月前的增长趋势。房屋价格的上涨，促使建筑公司加速建设和雇佣新工人，现有房产及新房的交易，以及建筑许可证的发放，也随之出现类似强势劲头。
aef892c9812aaf4a6994f62b0a07a3e41bac50fb.translatedText: Housing market picks up, consumer confidence rises Standard & Poor's Case-Shiller home price index hit a seven-year high on Tuesday, the latest sign of a recovery in the U.S. housing market. House prices rose in all 20 cities tracked, continuing a growth trend that began three months ago. Rising home prices prompted construction companies to speed up construction and hire new workers, and there was a similar surge in transactions for existing properties and new homes, as well as the issuance of building permits.

5e58049d681fa6c660a9da2e74a0d054c8595433.sourceText: 房地产市场的大范围回暖似乎增强了消费者信心，鼓励他们增加开支，冲抵了今年早些时候的担忧，即政府的紧缩政策可能会抑制消费者购买行为。
5e58049d681fa6c660a9da2e74a0d054c8595433.translatedText: A broad recovery in the housing market appears to be boosting consumer confidence, encouraging them to spend more, offsetting concerns earlier this year that government austerity could curb consumer buying behavior.

57e2afc7b070e45c53a173095669031ac092bfe5.sourceText: 最近关于制造业和出口等经济其他方面的数据，也令人失望。但同样于周二发布的世界大型企业联合会(Conference Board)的一份报告显示，消费者信心创下了五年来的新高，美国人对当前经济，以及未来经济形势的看法出现大幅好转。考虑到税收增加的因素，今年到目前为止，消费性支出一直表现出了惊人的韧性。
57e2afc7b070e45c53a173095669031ac092bfe5.translatedText: Recent data on other aspects of the economy, such as manufacturing and exports, have also been disappointing. But a Conference Board report also released on Tuesday showed that consumer confidence hit a five-year high, and Americans' views on the current economy and future economic conditions have improved significantly. Taking into account higher taxes, consumer spending has been surprisingly resilient so far this year.

14c6874478e1459d3af45a2c34df31a0e9a75800.sourceText: ”金融危机开始大规模爆发五年后，经济复苏开始四年又一个星期之后，我们的经济终于开始出现更大的回暖迹象了，”RDQ经济研究公司(RDQ Economics)的首席经济学家约翰?#21525;丁(John Ryding)说。”这是个漫长的过程，但你别忘了，我们是从什么样的情势下，努力挣扎着走出来的。”
14c6874478e1459d3af45a2c34df31a0e9a75800.translatedText: "Five years after the financial crisis began to erupt on a massive scale, and four years and a week after the recovery began, our economy is finally starting to show signs of greater recovery," said John Ryding, chief economist at RDQ Economics. "This is a long process, but don't forget what kind of situation we came from and struggled to get out of it."

c765a488533ef3df2dbfcdc102a57200e3d5ed3c.sourceText: 最近汽油价格下降可能起到了帮助，股市上扬可能也起到了积极作用，虽然只有约半数美国人持有股票。经济学家表示，也许最重要的是，现有房产的升值意味着美国各地的房屋拥有者终于感觉自己更有钱了，而很可能是这种所谓的财富效应，让消费者稍微放松了自己的荷包。
c765a488533ef3df2dbfcdc102a57200e3d5ed3c.translatedText: The recent drop in gasoline prices may have helped, and the rise in the stock market may also have had a positive effect, although only about half of Americans own stocks. Perhaps most importantly, economists say, the rising value of existing properties means homeowners across the U.S. are finally feeling richer, and it's likely this so-called wealth effect that's allowing consumers to loosen their purse strings a bit.

39414f2c13c1d4e40edbaf5fb46019462976e46d.sourceText: 房屋增值，股市上扬，大幅抵消财政开支紧缩
39414f2c13c1d4e40edbaf5fb46019462976e46d.translatedText: Home value appreciation, rising stock market, significantly offset fiscal spending tightening

48d54d5b50517be201e8232f607a47ca65b94222.sourceText: 潘西恩宏观经济咨询公司(Pantheon Macroeconomic Advisors)首席经济师伊恩 谢泼德森(Ian Shepherdson)预计，房屋增值带来的积极影响，以及股市的上扬，会抵消财政开支紧缩至少三分之一的影响。
48d54d5b50517be201e8232f607a47ca65b94222.translatedText: Ian Shepherdson, chief economist at Pantheon Macroeconomic Advisors, expects the positive impact of home appreciation and rising stock markets to offset at least one-third of the impact of fiscal spending tightening.

d9ba550501eda51624d54e61445f10904e4a63c3.sourceText: 凯斯-希勒美国20大城市房价综合指数较去年上涨10.9%，为自2006年4月以来的最大涨幅。数座城市（北卡罗来纳州夏洛特、洛杉矶、俄勒冈州波特兰、西雅图，以及佛罗里达州坦帕）的房价指数环比涨幅创下7年多以来的新高。
d9ba550501eda51624d54e61445f10904e4a63c3.translatedText: The Case-Shiller composite index of house prices in the 20 largest cities in the United States rose 10.9% from last year, the largest increase since April 2006. The month-on-month housing price index growth in several cities (Charlotte, North Carolina, Los Angeles, Portland, Oregon, Seattle, and Tampa, Florida) hit a new high in more than seven years.

4f1063562daa93c8676f51cc948717792acb58d8.sourceText: 很多因素集合在一切，推动了房价的两位数增长。
4f1063562daa93c8676f51cc948717792acb58d8.translatedText: Many factors converged to promote double-digit growth in housing prices.

b9517f1a41153ccc7d06a94a622fa3ec4df10955.sourceText: 其中一个原因是，连续31个月以来，雇主一直在增加就业岗位，因此家庭愿意再度开始消费。同时，由于过去几年几乎没有新建的楼房，而且大量房屋所有者要还的房贷比他们房屋的价值还高，从而使他们不愿在赔钱的情况下卖房，因此，市场上的房屋存量持续处于一个罕见的低水平。
b9517f1a41153ccc7d06a94a622fa3ec4df10955.translatedText: One reason is that for 31 consecutive months, employers have been adding jobs, so households are willing to start spending again. At the same time, the inventory of homes on the market continues to remain at an unusually low level, as there has been almost no new construction in the past few years and a large number of homeowners have to pay more on their mortgages than their homes are worth, making them reluctant to sell at a loss.

bf11f34da34c873a29695873846908e74d3f2270.sourceText: 目前有迹象表明，更高的价格开始促使一些潜在卖家站出来，把自己的房产拿到市场上销售。这有利于市场健康，也有助于消除人们对于房价再次出现过高的担忧。
bf11f34da34c873a29695873846908e74d3f2270.translatedText: There are now signs that higher prices are starting to prompt some would-be sellers to come forward and put their properties on the market. This is good for the health of the market and helps eliminate concerns about housing prices becoming too high again.

492757630a025e33e7048dfc7fdfe1365551d1ba.sourceText: ”目前的形势有利于价格上涨，但它同时也有利于房屋供应重回市场，所以也就意味着可以平抑价格增长的速度，”摩根大通(JPMorgan Chase)经济师丹尼尔 西尔弗(Daniel Silver)说。他说他预期房价会继续增长，但增长率不一定达到5月份两位数增长的水平。
492757630a025e33e7048dfc7fdfe1365551d1ba.translatedText: "The current situation is conducive to price growth, but it is also conducive to the return of housing supply to the market, so it means that the pace of price growth can be moderated," said Daniel Silver, an economist at JPMorgan Chase. He said he expected home prices to continue growing, but not necessarily at the double-digit pace seen in May.

5e0331daf23e38b500ba3e1070617846067e068e.sourceText: 由于房价上涨，建筑业也出现了增长，但是建筑企业将房屋投放市场的速度还是跟不上购房者的需求。
5e0331daf23e38b500ba3e1070617846067e068e.translatedText: The construction industry has also grown due to rising housing prices, but construction companies are still not able to put homes on the market at a pace that keeps pace with homebuyer demand.

3b198e7e2bb701d7365c6987d9cb0ec58352145e.sourceText: 廉价急售现象的减少，也推高了房价的上涨。这种现象包括止赎房屋的销售和亏本销售的做法。止赎的房屋一般会以极低的价格出售，从而压低报告的总体房价水平。
3b198e7e2bb701d7365c6987d9cb0ec58352145e.translatedText: The reduction of cheap and urgent sales has also pushed up the rise in housing prices. This phenomenon includes foreclosure sales and the practice of selling at a loss. Foreclosed homes typically sell for significantly lower prices, depressing overall reported home price levels.

052aee47bfc4c0fd5b1011d4130268fe1a3be23b.sourceText: 最后，在经济衰退期间，很多地区的房价都经历了严重且持续的下跌。房价最近的上涨是建立在一个极低的基础之上的，所以其增长势头还是显得很强劲，尽管房价水平仍远低于2005年前后房地产市场繁荣时期的高点。
052aee47bfc4c0fd5b1011d4130268fe1a3be23b.translatedText: Finally, during the recession, many areas experienced severe and sustained declines in home prices. The recent rise in housing prices is based on an extremely low base, so its growth momentum still appears to be very strong, although housing prices are still well below the highs of the housing market boom around 2005.

ee8b2beeebad559adf4bc90f3419e5e5991860aa.sourceText: 西尔弗说，”金融危机时期房价下跌最严重的地区，最近表现出了最强劲的增长势头。”例如，菲尼克斯的房价与一年前相比上涨了22.5%，而拉斯维加斯则上涨了20.6%。
ee8b2beeebad559adf4bc90f3419e5e5991860aa.translatedText: Silver said, “The areas that experienced the most severe home price declines during the financial crisis have shown the strongest growth recently.” For example, Phoenix home prices are up 22.5% compared with a year ago, while Las Vegas is up 20.6%.

e93a1966b9764fce659c22f16585f3c6f5e855ac.translatedText: It's too early for a house price bubble

a6105f3f1bbc12866f88ad95e604aac86aff00a6.sourceText: 经济学家一般都预期房价会继续上涨，尤其是随着经济状况改善，会有越来越多的年轻人搬出父母家，住进自己的房子。而且很多人都认为没必要担心会出现泡沫，不仅是因为住户数量正在增加，也因为房价与高点相比仍然很低。
a6105f3f1bbc12866f88ad95e604aac86aff00a6.translatedText: Economists generally expect house prices to continue to rise, especially as economic conditions improve and more and more young people move out of their parents' homes and into their own homes. And many people believe there is no need to worry about a bubble, not only because the number of households is increasing but also because home prices remain low compared with their highs.

7cefb72c989f044bc478c2d5d511206d774201cc.sourceText: ”现在讨论房价泡沫似乎还为时过早，”凯投宏观(Capital Economics)经济师埃德?#26031;坦斯菲尔德(Ed Stansfield)说。”与人们的收入、租金或过去的房价相比，美国的房价看起来仍然很低。”
7cefb72c989f044bc478c2d5d511206d774201cc.translatedText: "It seems premature to talk about a house price bubble," said Ed Stansfield, an economist at Capital Economics. "House prices in the U.S. still look low compared to people's incomes, rents, or past home prices."

3b20fec81a22db442edd3fa3e4eeec58b75e76e1.sourceText: 此外，获得贷款仍然很难。尽管美联储(Federal Reserve)已经把利率降到了最低程度，但还是有很多想买房的人发觉很难得到住房贷款。
3b20fec81a22db442edd3fa3e4eeec58b75e76e1.translatedText: Additionally, getting a loan remains difficult. Even though the Federal Reserve has cut interest rates to rock-bottom levels, many people who want to buy a home are still finding it difficult to get a home loan.

4e1c6f34f6dc381af74d7babf30abb9d590a2bfa.sourceText: ”说起泡沫，我们通常会联想到它是由非常宽松的信贷推动的，人们借的钱比尚未还清的房贷还多，而且只付很少的首付甚至根本不付首付，”巴克莱资本(Barclays Capital)美国高级经济师迈克尔 加彭(Michael Gapen)说。”如今的信贷标准可不是这样的。”
4e1c6f34f6dc381af74d7babf30abb9d590a2bfa.translatedText: "When we think of a bubble, we usually think of it being fueled by very easy credit, with people borrowing more than they have to pay off their mortgages and making little or no down payment," said Michael Gapen, senior U.S. economist at Barclays Capital. "That's not what credit standards are today."

19c2875898e6af376ce2bc3688c88d04a10cae1a.sourceText: 2013年“汉语桥”汉语技能大赛西南赛区冠军邓哲菲专访
19c2875898e6af376ce2bc3688c88d04a10cae1a.translatedText: An exclusive interview with Deng Zhefei, the winner of the Southwest Division of the 2013 "Chinese Bridge" Chinese Skills Competition

5a2a54826f63556de70a32e1ad9b546e4124d6e8.sourceText: 2013年“汉语桥”汉语技能大赛西南赛区冠军邓哲菲专访 当地时间2013年5月4日，一年一度的&#8221…
5a2a54826f63556de70a32e1ad9b546e4124d6e8.translatedText: Exclusive interview with Deng Zhefei, the champion of the Southwest Division of the 2013 "Chinese Bridge" Chinese Skills Competition On May 4, 2013, local time, the annual &#8221…

eb7a5f0b6d43278510d6b999a6d5153a16a7cf3a.sourceText: 当地时间2013年5月4日，一年一度的”汉语桥”汉语技能大赛在洛杉矶拉开帷幕。随着”汉语热”的持续升温，汉语大赛也越来越备受人们的关注。来自亚利桑那州立大学的邓哲菲（Jonny Dangerfield）同学，凭借着其出色并稳定的发挥和明显的优势，成功摘得比赛的桂冠。赛后，邓哲菲同学接受了我们的采访：（记：记者；邓：邓哲菲）
eb7a5f0b6d43278510d6b999a6d5153a16a7cf3a.translatedText: On May 4, 2013, local time, the annual “Chinese Bridge” Chinese Skills Competition kicked off in Los Angeles. As the “Chinese craze” continues to heat up, Chinese proficiency competitions are attracting more and more attention. Jonny Dangerfield, a student from Arizona State University, successfully won the competition with his outstanding and stable performance and obvious advantages. After the game, classmate Deng Zhefei accepted our interview: (Note: reporter; Deng: Deng Zhefei)

9b1bb7488f55ead74619aec04726eb1660ca759a.sourceText: 记：给我们简单介绍一下你自己吧。 邓：大家好，我是邓哲菲，我现在大四，是亚利桑那州立大学（简称ASU，下同）中文专业/ASU Chinese Flagship的学生，今年24岁。
9b1bb7488f55ead74619aec04726eb1660ca759a.translatedText: Note: Please briefly introduce yourself to us. Deng: Hello everyone, my name is Deng Zhefei. I am currently a senior and a Chinese major/ASU Chinese Flagship student at Arizona State University (ASU for short, the same below). I am 24 years old this year.

136f064001a8f18f85f5fc15c6167543f1aff8e4.sourceText: 记：给我们说说你的专业和你在中国大陆以及台湾留学的经历吧。
136f064001a8f18f85f5fc15c6167543f1aff8e4.translatedText: Note: Tell us about your major and your experience studying abroad in mainland China and Taiwan.

796c87f7f389ec6fac2e785fa43dea434ba63bcf.sourceText: 邓：我刚到ASU的时候，我的专业是政治学，后来我把专业改成英语语言学，但是，在我改了专业以后，我发现ASU还有汉语专业。我很好奇，于是尝试着选了汉语课，虽然只上了一个学期，但是这一个学期足以让我认识到我的兴趣究竟在哪儿了，我果断地又把我的专业换成的汉语。从那以后，我就在汉语学习的路上”痛并快乐着”了，可以说，这种经历真的很享受！我曾经去过四川和台湾留学，在那里，我遇到了很多从未见过的”贵人”，尝到了从未尝过的”山珍”，也学到了前所未有的本领。
796c87f7f389ec6fac2e785fa43dea434ba63bcf.translatedText: Deng: When I first arrived at ASU, my major was political science. Later I changed my major to English Linguistics. However, after I changed my major, I discovered that ASU also majored in Chinese. I was very curious, so I tried to take a Chinese class. Although I only took a semester, this semester was enough for me to realize what my interests were. I decisively changed my major to Chinese. Since then, I have been "painful and happy" on the road of learning Chinese. It can be said that this experience is really enjoyable! I once went to Sichuan and Taiwan to study abroad. There, I met many "noble people" I had never seen before, tasted "mountain delicacies" I had never tasted, and learned unprecedented skills.

88e6c38f92a30827aba6f196f1b204003e655677.sourceText: 记：你对将来的事业有什么样的目标呢？
88e6c38f92a30827aba6f196f1b204003e655677.translatedText: > Note: What goals do you have for your future career?

fb373b933cc6178e962208d01acc93d1c9adb864.sourceText: 邓：对于将来的打算，我想从事和汉语有关的工作，至于到底做什么，我还没有决定，不过最近，我决定，我会到中国继续上学并学习表演。我希望以后可以在中国从事电视、电影或者舞台表演方面的工作。
fb373b933cc6178e962208d01acc93d1c9adb864.translatedText: Deng: As for my future plans, I want to engage in work related to the Chinese language. As for what I will do, I haven’t decided yet. However, recently, I decided that I will continue to go to school and study acting in China. I hope to work in TV, movies or stage performances in China in the future.

ad8f265d078fd469bddb69796a6acdc76f86c5cb.sourceText: 记：是什么让你对汉语学习有这么大的动力？
ad8f265d078fd469bddb69796a6acdc76f86c5cb.translatedText: Note: What makes you so motivated to learn Chinese?

a082812918e3ccbbb9582e95b96c6f4dc7efae6e.sourceText: 邓：这个说来话长了，给我动力的因素有很多。但是刚开始学汉语时的动力因素现在已经显得不那么重要了。我还记得，几年前我刚开始学习汉语的时候，汉语对我来说，充满着挑战和魅力，就好像我们孩提时代，总想着挖一个洞，越挖越深，直到我们想挖到洞的尽头，看到洞那边的另一个世界一样，小孩子总是对这些未知事物充满着好奇感和神秘感。而汉语就是那个对孩子们来说很神秘的洞，每个人都想继续挖下去，看看到底谁能看到世界的另一端。这些只是我刚开始学习汉语时的感觉，后来我发现，这些动力因素会随着时间的流逝渐渐褪去，现在，我学习汉语最大的动机，就是能够真正感受中国和中国的人们。在中国和在亚利桑那和中国人的亲身接触让我迫不及待地想要提高自己的汉语能力。而且更重要的因素是，这个月18号，我就要和一个湖北的姑娘结婚了！以后见了岳父岳母，我得跟他们交流并了解他们，这也是我学习汉语的一个很重要的，不可或缺的原因。
a082812918e3ccbbb9582e95b96c6f4dc7efae6e.translatedText: Deng: It’s a long story. There are many factors that motivate me. But the motivation factor that I had when I first started learning Chinese no longer seems so important. I still remember that when I first started learning Chinese a few years ago, Chinese was full of challenges and charm for me, just like when we were children, we always wanted to dig a hole, digging deeper and deeper until we wanted to dig to the end of the hole and see another world on the other side. Children are always full of curiosity and mystery about these unknown things. And Chinese is that mysterious hole for children. Everyone wants to keep digging to see who can see the other side of the world. These were just my feelings when I first started learning Chinese. Later I found that these motivational factors would gradually fade away as time goes by. Now, my biggest motivation for learning Chinese is to truly experience China and its people. My personal contact with Chinese people in China and Arizona made me eager to improve my Chinese language skills. And the more important factor is that on the 18th of this month, I will get married to a girl from Hubei! When I meet my father-in-law and mother-in-law in the future, I have to communicate with them and understand them. This is also a very important and indispensable reason for me to learn Chinese.

75ad1caa86ae1f1c9d925293692e730b4cec6190.sourceText: 记：比赛的时候，你的中华才艺表演是什么？你为什么选择这个来表演？
75ad1caa86ae1f1c9d925293692e730b4cec6190.translatedText: Note: What was your Chinese talent show during the competition? Why did you choose this to perform?

b0b9865ff3d3db7cc02b17b51185db7df469a3f6.sourceText: 邓：我表演的是我自己创作的一段单口相声，中间重点展示的是一个传统的相声段子《报菜名》。我对相声感兴趣已经很长时间了，我一直想把这段灌口儿练好，表演给大家看。把幽默诙谐的表演和语言技能串联起来让我有了表演相声，特别是《报菜名》的想法。我还记得，背诵《报菜名》的时候，对我真的是很大的挑战，但是我整个过程也特别开心，表演的时候更是非常兴奋！
b0b9865ff3d3db7cc02b17b51185db7df469a3f6.translatedText: Deng: What I performed was a stand-up comedy piece that I created myself. The highlight in the middle was a traditional cross-talk joke called "Reporting the Name of the Dish." I have been interested in cross talk for a long time, and I have always wanted to practice this cross talk well and perform it for everyone. Combining humorous performances and language skills gave me the idea of ​​performing cross talk, especially "Report the Name of the Dish". I still remember that it was really a big challenge for me to recite "Report the Name of the Dish", but I was very happy during the whole process, and I was even more excited during the performance!

8e5823ced14878da496afd645568a16c889a6081.sourceText: 记： 你参加汉语大赛最难忘的经历是什么？
8e5823ced14878da496afd645568a16c889a6081.translatedText: > Note: What is your most unforgettable experience in participating in the Chinese language competition?

37514f058468f743adb68e26c396df4d9648d125.sourceText: 邓： 对我来说，参加汉语桥比赛印象最深的事是赛前，我的老师和朋友们帮我一起准备的那段日子。那段时间，我也更深地了解了我的老师和朋友们。5月4号的比赛当然给我的印象也特别深刻，因为我有幸在比赛的时候接触到一些重要的人物，包括加州大学洛杉矶分校孔子学院的工作人员和中国驻洛杉矶领事馆的官员们。赛后，我们一起聊天，分享有趣的事情，也是一段特别幸福特别甜蜜的经历。
37514f058468f743adb68e26c396df4d9648d125.translatedText: Deng: For me, the most impressive thing about participating in the Chinese Bridge Competition was the days before the competition when my teachers and friends helped me prepare. During that time, I also got to know my teachers and friends better. Of course, the competition on May 4th left a particularly deep impression on me because I was fortunate enough to meet some important people during the competition, including staff from the Confucius Institute at UCLA and officials from the Chinese Consulate in Los Angeles. After the game, we chatted together and shared interesting things. It was also a very happy and sweet experience.

b6267e2a990ba2c9361d4c76239b5a65f156e966.sourceText: (左三)邓哲菲（ Jonny ）和中国驻洛杉矶领事馆的陈准民领事（左二） 加州大学洛杉矶分校孔子学院的美方院长 Susan Pertel Jian, 和中国驻洛杉矶领事馆的官员们合影
b6267e2a990ba2c9361d4c76239b5a65f156e966.translatedText: (Third from left) Deng Zhefei (Jonny) and Consul Chen Zhunmin of the Chinese Consulate in Los Angeles (second from left) Susan Pertel Jian, the American director of the Confucius Institute at UCLA, took a group photo with officials from the Chinese Consulate in Los Angeles

afbb976022483338debdd93b3433213911594971.sourceText: 结语：邓哲菲（Jonny）是一个在汉语学习方面不可多得的学生。一分耕耘，一分收获，他通过自己的努力和对汉语的热情，短短几年时间，能将汉语演绎得如此地道，令人瞠目。他在相声表演方面的才艺更是让大家对他未来在中国的发展充满的期待。
afbb976022483338debdd93b3433213911594971.translatedText: Conclusion: Deng Zhefei (Jonny) is a rare student in Chinese learning. No matter how hard you work, you will gain. Through his own efforts and passion for Chinese, in just a few years, he was able to interpret Chinese so authentically that it is astonishing. His talents in cross talk performances have made everyone full of expectations for his future development in China.

586d308b732c6ca7780e8dcd3b742a15ebd77d03.sourceText: 全美首季9成市区家庭房价大涨
586d308b732c6ca7780e8dcd3b742a15ebd77d03.translatedText: House prices in 90% of U.S. urban areas soared in the first quarter

f4cd1c93275397ee69acb1894f336a4ec4d2e2a6.sourceText: 全美首季9成市区家庭房价大涨 彭博社电，最新公布的报告显示，今年1月到3月的第一季，全美近九成市区为一家庭…
f4cd1c93275397ee69acb1894f336a4ec4d2e2a6.translatedText: > House prices in 90% of U.S. urban areas soared in the first quarter. Bloomberg News, the latest report shows that in the first quarter from January to March this year, nearly 90% of U.S. urban areas had one household...

f900c65a643197f70d5a31a8d08670c0089a5328.sourceText: 全美首季9成市区家庭房价大涨 彭博社电，最新公布的报告显示，今年1月到3月的第一季，全美近九成市区为一家庭设计的独栋屋房价上涨，而且涨幅达到七年多以来的最大。 不过，多数地区的房价仍在可负担范围，这代表就业改善与工资水平保持稳定，持续推动房市复苏。 全国房地产商协会(NAR)9日公布，今年第一季全美150个市区中有133个中位数房价上涨，远多于一年前的74个，且家庭住的中位数房价为17万6600元，较去年同期上涨11.3%，涨幅为2005年第四季来最大。所谓中位数房价指一半的房屋售价高于此价，一半低于此价。 这份报告显示，房价涨幅最大的是俄亥俄州阿克隆（Akron）与加州旧金山，各较一年前上升33%。然后依次是加州硅谷与内华达州雷诺（Reno）上涨32%、亚特兰大上涨31%，凤凰城上涨30%。 跌幅最大的则是伊利诺伊州坎卡基（Kankakee），较一年前下降19%。然后依次是新泽西州爱迪生（Edison）下跌8.6%，与宾州艾伦镇（Allentown）下跌8.3%。 NAR首席经济学家劳伦斯 尹（Lawrence Yun）在报告中说，”部分在金融危机中遭重创的地区，如凤凰城、加州沙加缅度与迈阿密等，持续出现了戏剧性的反弹；另一方面，包括亚特兰大、明尼亚波利斯市与西雅图等地，也开始显现房价上升动力的迹象”。 房市持续复苏主要归功于就业市场逐渐改善，以及联准会将房贷利率维持在低点。据劳工部数据，4月失业率已降至7.5%，为四年以来的低点，上周初次申领失业保险金的人数也降至五年来最少。 另外，各地上市屋存量仍低，加上买家竞价买房，则是导致房价节节上升的主因。据NAR统计，截至第一季止，全美仅有193万户待售成屋，数量较一年前同期减少16.8%。百仕通（Blackstone）等机构的投资人大手笔搜购一家庭式住房，也使部分地区房价加速上扬。 不过，NAR也指出，房贷利率处于低点及薪资水平保持稳定，能让潜在买家有”充裕的购买能力”。假设房贷利率为3.5%，并用25%收入偿还贷款，买家若有能力自付5%头期款，年收入达3万6500元就能购买中位数房价的房子。
f900c65a643197f70d5a31a8d08670c0089a5328.translatedText: 90% of U.S. urban areas saw house price increases in the first quarter. Bloomberg News: The latest report shows that in the first quarter from January to March this year, the price of single-family houses designed for one family rose in nearly 90% of urban areas across the United States, and the increase reached the largest increase in more than seven years. However, housing prices in most areas are still within the affordable range, which means that employment improvements and wage levels have remained stable, continuing to promote the recovery of the housing market. The National Association of Realtors (NAR) announced on the 9th that in the first quarter of this year, 133 of 150 urban areas in the United States saw median house prices increase, far more than 74 a year ago. The median house price for a family was $176,600, an increase of 11.3% from the same period last year, the largest increase since the fourth quarter of 2005. The so-called median house price means that half of the houses are sold for more than this price and half are less than this price. The report shows that the largest price increases were in Akron, Ohio, and San Francisco, California, with each rising 33% from a year ago. This was followed by California's Silicon Valley and Nevada's Reno (Reno), which rose 32%, Atlanta rose 31%, and Phoenix rose 30%. The largest decline was in Kankakee, Illinois, down 19% from a year ago. This was followed by Edison, New Jersey, which fell 8.6%, and Allentown, Pennsylvania, which fell 8.3%. NAR chief economist Lawrence Yun said in the report, "Some areas that were hit hard by the financial crisis, such as Phoenix, Sacramento, California, and Miami, have continued to rebound dramatically; on the other hand, places including Atlanta, Minneapolis, and Seattle are also beginning to show signs of upward momentum in housing prices." The continued recovery of the housing market is mainly attributed to the gradual improvement of the job market and the Federal Reserve's decision to keep mortgage interest rates at low levels. According to the Labor Department, the unemployment rate fell to 7.5% in April, a four-year low, and the number of people filing initial claims for unemployment insurance last week also fell to the lowest in five years. In addition, the inventory of listed houses in various places is still low, and buyers are bidding to buy houses, which is the main reason for the rising housing prices. According to NAR statistics, as of the first quarter, there were only 1.93 million existing homes for sale in the United States, a 16.8% decrease from the same period a year ago. Investors from institutions such as Blackstone have been aggressively purchasing single-family homes, which has also accelerated the rise in housing prices in some areas. However, NAR also pointed out that low mortgage interest rates and stable salary levels will allow potential buyers to have "ample purchasing power." Assuming that the mortgage interest rate is 3.5% and 25% of the income is used to repay the loan, a buyer who can afford to pay a 5% down payment can purchase a house with a median house price with an annual income of NT$36,500.

6a0ffaf8460f8173c6207bc1cd9dea54139a9823.sourceText: 茅台价暴跌6成 经销商哀求厂家：少给点酒吧
6a0ffaf8460f8173c6207bc1cd9dea54139a9823.translatedText: The price of Moutai plummeted by 60%, and the dealers begged the manufacturers: give them less bars

2fc6a1a54a70785034755410a6384ec6490f522b.sourceText: 茅台价暴跌6成 经销商哀求厂家：少给点酒吧 在业内人士看来，茅台酒价格走到今天主要是当初量价双双走高，忽视…
2fc6a1a54a70785034755410a6384ec6490f522b.translatedText: The prices of Moutai plummeted by 60%, and the dealers begged the manufacturers: give them less bars. In the opinion of industry insiders, the price of Moutai has reached today mainly due to the increase in both volume and price, ignoring...

ff564f35e6f7bafb9944677a7afd6b12c50b9e2b.sourceText: 在业内人士看来，茅台酒价格走到今天主要是当初量价双双走高，忽视了普通消费者的感受，在”限制三公消费”政策下，茅台酒不得不面临”今天谁在喝茅台”的窘境。 ”高端白酒最艰难的时期来了”深圳市世界观品牌营销顾问有限公司总经理谢一颖对记者如此描述当前 相关公司股票走势五粮液、贵州茅台高端白酒的现状。而以贵州茅台为代表的高端白酒在市场销售遇阻的大环境下，其经销商也面临”进退两难”的抉择。
ff564f35e6f7bafb9944677a7afd6b12c50b9e2b.translatedText: In the view of industry insiders, the price of Moutai has reached today mainly due to the increase in both volume and price, ignoring the feelings of ordinary consumers. Under the policy of "restricting the consumption of three public goods", Moutai has to face the dilemma of "who is drinking Moutai today?" "The most difficult period for high-end liquor is coming," Xie Yiying, general manager of Shenzhen Worldview Brand Marketing Consulting Co., Ltd., told reporters, describing the current stock trends of relevant companies Wuliangye and Kweichow Moutai high-end liquor. In an environment where high-end liquor represented by Kweichow Moutai is facing difficulties in market sales, its dealers are also faced with a "dilemma".

5840ebc2e72c5fb41ec258a0f1e19d4ec20766d5.translatedText: The price of Moutai is chaotic

7134029c020e736c7f9b94ae531fc0e7fb4a3094.sourceText: 在2011年卖出”天价”的53度飞天茅台如今价格跌破千元，有的地方还出现价格倒挂的现象。在京东商城和一淘网上，53度飞天茅台的价格更是”参差不齐”，即便如此，在业内人士看来，其价格还会因市场需求不足而下滑。
7134029c020e736c7f9b94ae531fc0e7fb4a3094.translatedText: The 53-degree Feitian Moutai, which was sold at a "sky-high" price in 2011, is now priced below 1,000 yuan, and in some places there is even a phenomenon of price inversion. On JD.com and Yitao.com, the price of 53-degree Feitian Moutai is even more "varying." Even so, in the opinion of industry insiders, its price will decline due to insufficient market demand.

6f7b5e109de75f409e93e3cf0f67e53b38f52dcb.sourceText: 记者在京东商城上查阅茅台的价格，53度飞天茅台的价格在950元/瓶-1300元/瓶之间。而在一淘网上，虽然价格也是各不相同，但有的已经卖到800元以下。更有媒体报道，部分地区的茅台酒价格已经到了780元/瓶，但据记者了解，53度飞天茅台的出厂价在819元/瓶，也就是说，有公司或个人正在以低于出厂价的价格出售茅台。
6f7b5e109de75f409e93e3cf0f67e53b38f52dcb.translatedText: The reporter checked the price of Moutai on JD.com. The price of 53-degree Feitian Moutai is between 950 yuan/bottle and 1,300 yuan/bottle. On Yitao.com, although the prices vary, some have been sold for less than 800 yuan. There are even media reports that the price of Moutai in some areas has reached 780 yuan/bottle, but according to reporters, the ex-factory price of 53-degree Feitian Moutai is 819 yuan/bottle, which means that some companies or individuals are selling Moutai at a price lower than the ex-factory price.

f0b94627aa0e7b849a0a0273a020436088728b85.sourceText: 据一淘网的肖女士表示，她经营的酒水批发公司即便53度飞天茅台卖798元/瓶也不亏本，因为他们靠的是走量返点。据肖女士介绍，他们的产品是从北京一茅台批发商手里拿货，而这一批发商拿到的茅台价格是619元/瓶，”我们每个月卖50箱，完成任务就可以返点，因此谁都不亏本，来买的有个人的也有单位采购的”。在肖女士看来，茅台价格走低与市场环境有很大关系，因为很多茅台经销商手里有存货。
f0b94627aa0e7b849a0a0273a020436088728b85.translatedText: According to Ms. Xiao from Yitao.com, the liquor wholesale company she runs does not lose money even if the 53-degree Feitian Moutai sells for 798 yuan/bottle because they rely on volume rebates. According to Ms. Xiao, their products are purchased from a Moutai wholesaler in Beijing, and the price of Moutai obtained by this wholesaler is 619 yuan/bottle. "We sell 50 boxes every month, and you can get points back when you complete the task, so no one loses money. There are individuals and units purchasing." In Ms. Xiao's view, the lower price of Moutai has a lot to do with the market environment, because many Moutai dealers have inventory in hand.

53260389f1f8d9cb7811f0560a468198f5116c1a.sourceText: 不过，本报记者走访了北京部分专卖店和酒水批发部了解到，市场上的53度飞天茅台酒的价格多数在千元以上，最低的是900元/瓶。
53260389f1f8d9cb7811f0560a468198f5116c1a.translatedText: However, our reporter visited some specialty stores and liquor wholesale departments in Beijing and learned that most of the prices of 53-degree Feitian Moutai on the market are more than 1,000 yuan, with the lowest price being 900 yuan per bottle.

763b8c91fc24970fcc2ee34051ddb94af7cc607c.sourceText: 其中，北京马甸附近一酒水城的销售人员告诉记者，虽然高端酒遇到销售困难，但是，那些喝惯了茅台的人很难改变习惯，因此，他们还会购买茅台，为了不让人抓住把柄，购买后往往会换掉包装。
763b8c91fc24970fcc2ee34051ddb94af7cc607c.translatedText: Among them, a salesperson at a liquor store near Madian, Beijing, told reporters that although high-end liquor has encountered sales difficulties, it is difficult for those who are used to drinking Moutai to change their habits. Therefore, they will still buy Moutai. In order to prevent others from being caught, they often change the packaging after purchasing.

8e99cf080267da5bb715aa05a141402969de01b1.sourceText: 从2011年的2300元到如今的780元，茅台酒的价格跌幅超过六成。虽然造成这种局面的原因很多，如白酒添加”塑化剂”导致白酒销量下降，再加上”禁酒令”对”三公消费”的影响，让身为白酒”一哥”的茅台销量很受伤。
8e99cf080267da5bb715aa05a141402969de01b1.translatedText: From 2,300 yuan in 2011 to 780 yuan today, the price of Moutai has dropped by more than 60%. Although there are many reasons for this situation, such as the addition of "plasticizer" in liquor, which led to a decline in liquor sales, coupled with the impact of the "Prohibition" on "three public consumption", the sales of Moutai, the "biggest brother" of liquor, were very hurt.

9663ba51319b75e1870d76f50f2d0e4bedc2e182.sourceText: 但在业内人士看来，茅台之所以走到今天的地步，最主要的原因在于茅台酒近年来销量、价格的双双走高，让茅台人在顺境中丧失了忧患意识，躺在白酒”一哥”的王座上睡大觉，忽视了普通消费者特别是国内新兴中产阶级的体验感受。尤其是一度传出的茅台要成为国内第一”奢侈品”的消息，让消费者不得不向茅台说”再见”。而当”限制三公消费”为常态后，茅台酒不得不面临”今天谁在喝茅台”的窘境。
9663ba51319b75e1870d76f50f2d0e4bedc2e182.translatedText: However, in the eyes of industry insiders, the main reason why Moutai is where it is today is that the sales volume and price of Moutai liquor have increased in recent years. Moutai people have lost their sense of worry in good times and slept on the throne of the "big brother" of liquor, ignoring the experience of ordinary consumers, especially the emerging middle class in the country. In particular, the news that Moutai was going to become the number one "luxury product" in China forced consumers to say "goodbye" to Moutai. And when "restricting the consumption of three public goods" became the norm, Moutai had to face the dilemma of "who is drinking Moutai today?"

38e4507ab756b96b02670b8aed696349b78412b6.sourceText: 茅台经销商忙”送礼”减压
38e4507ab756b96b02670b8aed696349b78412b6.translatedText: Moutai dealers are busy "giving gifts" to relieve pressure

f7f0a3ece7d13d005685d0fbbe513f13e0552dad.sourceText: 数据显示，目前，市场上库存的茅台酒有1万多吨。而记者通过采访也了解到部分茅台经销商的存货情况。即便当前白酒行业遭遇困境之际，这些经销商肯定不会轻易退出，而是采用其他一些手段来帮自己减压。
f7f0a3ece7d13d005685d0fbbe513f13e0552dad.translatedText: Data show that currently, there are more than 10,000 tons of Moutai liquor in stock on the market. The reporter also learned about the inventory status of some Moutai dealers through interviews. Even if the liquor industry is currently experiencing difficulties, these dealers will certainly not quit easily, but will use other means to relieve themselves.

786fbc47030c92de9be6e8bc3741f5a2ae13baa1.sourceText: 据一位不愿具名的白酒业资深人士对记者透露，4月份时，贵州省一位经销商手里还有100多件53度飞天茅台，不过，5月份他就去厂家提货，而看到的场景是提货的人都在排队。对于此经销商的情况，上述人士分析有两种可能，一是，经过20多天的消化，他手中的存货或许已经消化掉了，二是，他按照茅台之前的政策不得不提配额中的货。
786fbc47030c92de9be6e8bc3741f5a2ae13baa1.translatedText: According to a senior person in the liquor industry who did not want to be named, he told reporters that in April, a dealer in Guizhou Province still had more than 100 pieces of 53-degree Feitian Moutai. However, in May, he went to the manufacturer to pick up the goods, and what he saw was that people were queuing up to pick up the goods. Regarding the situation of this dealer, the above-mentioned person analyzed that there are two possibilities. First, after more than 20 days of digestion, the inventory in his hand may have been digested. Second, he had to withdraw the goods in the quota according to Maotai's previous policy.

7309f3f3073435fe12a6e6303f7bdedff7588e30.sourceText: 虽然根据上述经销商的情况不能下明确的结论，但一位从事茅台、五粮液销售的经销商在接受记者采访时表示，目前，很多茅台的经销商在观望，他们给茅台打款也不积极，因为，在高库存压力下，他们已经出现了资金周转困难。不过，也有一些白酒经销商为取得茅台的销售资格而努力。
7309f3f3073435fe12a6e6303f7bdedff7588e30.translatedText: Although no clear conclusion can be drawn based on the situation of the above dealers, a dealer engaged in the sales of Moutai and Wuliangye said in an interview with reporters that at present, many Moutai dealers are waiting and watching, and they are not active in making payments to Moutai because, under the pressure of high inventory, they have already experienced difficulties in capital turnover. However, there are also some liquor dealers who are working hard to obtain the sales qualification of Moutai.

a37bf79e105d1607d87b5d59c20b0236b24e5ed5.sourceText: 在上述经销商看来，以前，只要拥有茅台的销售资格，经销商们就可以高枕无忧，闭着眼睛数钱。而如今，那些一直想进入茅台经销商大军中的经销商们觉得现在是极好的时机，因此，他们想抓住这个时机，成为茅台”家庭”中的一员。
a37bf79e105d1607d87b5d59c20b0236b24e5ed5.translatedText: According to the above-mentioned dealers, in the past, as long as they had Moutai sales qualifications, dealers could sit back and relax and count money with their eyes closed. Now, those dealers who have always wanted to join the army of Moutai dealers feel that now is an excellent time, so they want to seize this opportunity and become a member of the Moutai "family".

b002ca5a3a5070d2c5f8b411f5c1f4b7a47db0c7.sourceText: ”如果库存压力不大，周转资金没有出现问题，那么，很少有经销商放弃茅台经销权的。”上述行业资深人士如此描述，但是，他也透露了一些茅台经销商的心态。”现在很多一批经销商也在忙着’送礼’。在茅台酒不愁卖的情况下，他们送礼是为了获得更多的配额。而如今，他们给茅台高管送礼则是为了减少配额”。
b002ca5a3a5070d2c5f8b411f5c1f4b7a47db0c7.translatedText: "If the inventory pressure is not great and there is no problem with working capital, then few dealers will give up the Moutai distribution rights." The above-mentioned industry veteran described it this way, but he also revealed the mentality of some Moutai dealers. "Many dealers are now busy giving gifts. When Moutai had no worries about selling, they gave gifts in order to obtain more quotas. Now, they give gifts to Moutai executives in order to reduce quotas."

4d9e64ca23a3b7833a49c20478a0639d23646867.sourceText: 事实上，在此轮调整中，那些没有实力的中间销售商们正逐渐退出市场，无疑扩大了一些经销商的利润空间，因此，他们抱着能赚点就赚点的心态，只要有利就卖。不过，市场销售疲软也让很多经销商感到无奈，为了能挺过难关，选择降价和要求厂家降低配额也是无奈之举。
4d9e64ca23a3b7833a49c20478a0639d23646867.translatedText: In fact, in this round of adjustment, those middle sellers who have no strength are gradually withdrawing from the market, which has undoubtedly expanded the profit margins of some dealers. Therefore, they have the mentality of making as much as they can and selling as long as it is beneficial. However, weak market sales have also made many dealers feel helpless. In order to survive the difficulties, they have no choice but to cut prices and ask manufacturers to reduce quotas.

9940a97ac7e3bca39c79ebc315a32ce13fe12a5c.translatedText: At 10 a.m. on April 27, ASU NEEB The auditorium was packed with seats, and the 2013 graduation ceremony of the Alberta Modern Chinese School was grandly held here.

f032f9b86abb018135ec9b1e3d664b464b5a82de.sourceText: AP中文班 于欣睿，郭斯原，谭晓枫，孙颖钰 小提琴合奏 大会在AP中文班 于欣睿，郭斯原，谭晓枫，孙颖钰 4 名同学优美的小提琴声中拉开序幕，一首耳熟能详的中国民乐《康定情歌》让全校师生不由自主地陶醉其中。 紧接着作为主持人的副校长孙吉军郑重宣布结业典礼正式开始。首先是校长Larry Song做了热情洋溢的讲话。宋校长在讲话中总结了本学年学校的工作，感谢所有的老师，家长和义工们对学校的大力支持。宋校长以自己在中文学校服务的十几年历程，深有体会的的呼吁大家更多的参与中文学校，为孩子学好中文，传播中华文化贡献每个人的一份力量。宋校长还特别向于志副校长颁发了奖杯，奖杯上刻着”大爱无边， 善行无限， 热心公益， 造福后代” 以感谢他为中文学校多年的辛苦付出和所做出的巨大贡献，同时希望有更多的家长像于志付校长一样加入到我们的义工队伍。宋校长的讲话最后被一阵热烈的掌声所淹没，原来是在介绍明年的新校长朱岩，家长和学生太熟悉她了，朱岩老师在现代中文学校任副校长和AP中文教师多年。事无巨细，方方面面，到处可以看到她的身影。大到从策划、组织、部署、宣传及每年的中国年的庆祝活动，在师资和教材都缺乏的条件下开设AP中文班，主编每学期的校刊，张罗每年的年末教师及校委会，董事会，学校的义工等的感谢大会， 小到每年一家一家的中国餐馆去签折扣卡的合同，代表学校参与社区的各种活动等等。难怪有这么热烈的掌声，众望所归呀。
f032f9b86abb018135ec9b1e3d664b464b5a82de.translatedText: >AP Chinese Class Yu Xinrui, Guo Siyuan, Tan Xiaofeng, Sun Yingyu Violin Ensemble The conference kicked off with the beautiful violin sounds of four students from the AP Chinese class Yu Xinrui, Guo Siyuan, Tan Xiaofeng, and Sun Yingyu. A familiar Chinese folk music "Kangding Love Song" made all the teachers and students in the school intoxicated. Immediately afterwards, Vice President Sun Jijun, as the host, solemnly announced that the graduation ceremony had officially begun. First, Principal Larry Song gave a passionate speech. In his speech, Principal Song summarized the work of the school this school year and thanked all teachers, parents and volunteers for their strong support to the school. Based on his more than ten years of service in Chinese schools, Principal Song has a deep understanding of calling on everyone to get more involved in Chinese schools, and contribute everyone's efforts to help children learn Chinese well and spread Chinese culture. Principal Song also specially presented a trophy to Vice Principal Yu Zhi. The trophy was engraved with the words "Boundless love, unlimited good deeds, enthusiastic about public welfare, and benefiting future generations" to thank him for his many years of hard work and great contributions to the Chinese school. At the same time, he hopes that more parents will join our volunteer team like Principal Yu Zhifu. Principal Song's speech was drowned out by a burst of warm applause at the end. It turned out that he was introducing next year's new principal, Zhu Yan. Parents and students are very familiar with her. Teacher Zhu Yan has been the vice principal and AP Chinese teacher at Modern Chinese School for many years. No matter how small or small, she can be seen everywhere. It ranges from planning, organizing, deploying, publicizing and celebrating the annual China Year, opening AP Chinese classes despite the lack of teachers and teaching materials, editing the school magazine for each semester, organizing the annual end-of-year thank-you meeting for teachers and school committees, board of directors, school volunteers, etc., to signing discount card contracts at Chinese restaurants one by one every year, participating in various community activities on behalf of the school, etc. No wonder there was such warm applause and everyone expected it.

63fc0d453fadc19484f254c20a464345fba943b7.translatedText: School leaders Tao Shicheng and Gary Li

32ff36bb5aa87ad939e652a7cdaf9ddfc13fea58.sourceText: 光荣退役的副校长于志 接下来由董事长Connie He讲话，她在讲话中感谢学校管理团队的通力合作，并介绍了新董事长和新董事的成员。根据学校的管理章程规定今年又三位老董事会成员任期已满，由家长投票，高票选出三位新董事会成员：Larry Song ， Jim Xi ， Xiaohong Wang. 当Connie宣布了新董事长为 Larry Song时, 全场再次响起了热烈的掌声，掌声中充满了对这些义工的带头人的敬仰，凝聚着家长们对为了学校，为了孩子们默默奉献者的感谢。 同学们期待已久的时刻到了，为了准备《中文知识竞赛》，整个春假都没离开老师布置的竞赛题目，教学副校长沈颢瑾总结并表彰了所有在中文知识竞赛中获奖的同学，全校共有 114 同学获奖。其中一等奖：25 名，二等奖38 名，三等奖 51 名。当沈颢瑾老师讲到请一，二，三等奖及鼓励奖的学生原地起立接受表彰时，只见高举奖杯的同学们一起站起来，个个神采奕奕，得意洋洋，从他们的脸上我们看到了收获的喜悦，这是牺牲多少休息和玩的时间换来的。勤奋和坚持，才能收获成功。在下面的获奖同学身上，哪个不闪耀着勤奋，坚持这四个字。正常学校的功课，各种各样的课外活动，五花八门的才艺课，在这重重压力之下，我们有郭斯原，阮天乐，姜睿，杨汉文，张楚仪等5名同学获得了《2012年海外华裔青少年中文知识竞赛》优秀奖。董事长给他们颁发了奖状。接着中文教学组长田韶薇老师总结和表彰了YCT中文考试中取得优异成绩的同学， 8位同学取得了总分280分以上的好成绩。他们是：Lucia Wang，Shirley Ruan，Lingfeng Guo，Iris Cheng，Kevin Zou，Jane Wang，Victoria Lim，Eric Ye
32ff36bb5aa87ad939e652a7cdaf9ddfc13fea58.translatedText: Honorably retired vice-principal Yu Zhi Next was the speech by chairman Connie He. In her speech, she thanked the school management team for their full cooperation and introduced the new chairman and new directors. According to the school's management charter, the term of three old board members has expired this year. Parents voted and elected three new board members with high votes: Larry Song, Jim Xi, and Xiaohong Wang. When Connie announced that the new chairman was Larry Song, the audience once again burst into warm applause. The applause was full of admiration for these volunteer leaders, embodying the parents' gratitude to the silent devotees for the school and the children. The long-awaited moment for the students has arrived. In order to prepare for the "Chinese Knowledge Contest", they did not leave the competition topics assigned by the teacher throughout the spring break. Vice Principal Shen Haojin summarized and commended all the students who won awards in the Chinese Knowledge Contest. A total of 114 students in the school won awards. Among them: 25 first prize winners, 38 second prize winners, and 51 third prize winners. When Teacher Shen Haojin asked the first, second, third prize and encouragement award students to stand up and accept the commendation, all the students holding the trophies stood up together, all of them were in high spirits and triumphant. From their faces, we could see the joy of harvest, which was obtained by sacrificing a lot of rest and play time. Diligence and persistence will lead to success. Among the award-winning students below, who doesn’t shine with the words “diligence and perseverance”? Normal school homework, various extracurricular activities, and various talent classes. Under this heavy pressure, five of our students, including Guo Siyuan, Ruan Tianle, Jiang Rui, Yang Hanwen, and Zhang Chuyi, won the Excellence Award in the "2012 Overseas Chinese Youth Chinese Knowledge Competition". The chairman awarded them certificates. Then Teacher Tian Shaowei, the head of the Chinese teaching team, summarized and commended the students who achieved excellent results in the YCT Chinese exam. 8 students achieved a total score of 280 or more. They are: Lucia Wang, Shirley Ruan, Lingfeng Guo, Iris Cheng, Kevin Zou, Jane Wang, Victoria Lim, Eric Ye

4781ca1154a555909af36d562a7b0a5b966190cc.sourceText: 中文对话毕业班 历年的毕业班，是让学弟学妹们羡慕的榜样。今年又有5年级19位同学，5年级马立平班17位同学，8年级9位同学和12年级的 8 位同学Beginner抯 Chinese 班 6 位同学，Conversational Chinese班16位同学毕业。毕业班的同学手持毕业证书上台和他们的老师合影留念。接下来 校长 颁发了12年级优秀毕业生的奖学金，陶悦榕，叶瑞和，杨星宇3位同学获得了12年级毕业生奖学金。参考综合各方面因素朱文倩同学获得了优秀毕业生奖学金。Sophia Lee老师介绍了毕业班及奖学金得主的杰出表现。毕业班的同学代表也讲了话，他在讲话中感谢老师辛辛苦苦的教导，感谢家长每周不辞辛苦的接送。他们鼓励低年级的学弟学妹们，坚持下去学好中文并决心继续学习中文。
4781ca1154a555909af36d562a7b0a5b966190cc.translatedText: Chinese dialogue graduating class The graduating classes of the past years are role models that are envied by the younger students. This year, 19 students from grade 5, 17 students from grade 5 Ma Liping, 9 students from grade 8, 8 students from grade 12, 6 students from Beginner’s Chinese class, and 16 students from Conversational Chinese class graduated. The graduating class took the stage with their diplomas in hand and took photos with their teachers. Next, the principal awarded scholarships to outstanding 12th grade graduates. Tao Yuerong, Ye Ruihe, and Yang Xingyu won the 12th grade graduate scholarships. Taking into consideration various factors, Zhu Wenqian won the Outstanding Graduate Scholarship. Teacher Sophia Lee introduced the outstanding performance of the graduating class and scholarship winners. The representative of the graduating class also spoke. In his speech, he thanked the teachers for their hard work and the parents for their hard work every week. They encouraged the younger students to persevere and learn Chinese well and to be determined to continue learning Chinese.

997fd1240c6f0d55baff6eb694ff50e56562ce1b.sourceText: 于华小小班精彩表演 在马立平学前班于华老师一群可爱的小朋友朗诵儿歌之后，AP中文班的朱岩老师表彰了在SAT中考满分800分的郭斯原，徐立程两位同学。同时宣布了AP考试得5分的8名同学，他们是： 鲁叶蓁，江昊明，汤立弘，费凯琳，张雨佳，魏倚萱，赖子杨，宋霏霏。七年级邵英老师班同学们一组激情的诗朗诵《青春万岁》将很多家长们带回了自己青葱少年的时代， 顿生一番感慨。 在AP班四位女生《渔舟唱晚》悠扬的小提琴声中，结业典礼结束了。此时此刻， 同学老师和家长们有欢聚一堂的喜悦，有溢于言表的留恋，有放假可以小歇的轻松，也有准备来年更上一层楼的决心。 中文学校将于八月初开学， 请大家关注学校网站www.ccsarizona.org 及时注册， 我们下学期再见！
997fd1240c6f0d55baff6eb694ff50e56562ce1b.translatedText: >Wonderful performance by Yu Hua's small class After a group of lovely children from Ma Liping's preschool teacher Yu Hua recited children's songs, teacher Zhu Yan from the AP Chinese class commended two classmates, Guo Siyuan and Xu Licheng, who scored 800 points on the SAT. At the same time, the eight students who scored 5 points in the AP exam were announced. They are: Lu Yezhen, Jiang Haoming, Tang Lihong, Fei Kailin, Zhang Yujia, Wei Yixuan, Lai Ziyang, and Song Feifei. A group of students from seventh grade teacher Shao Ying's class recited a passionate poem "Long Live Youth", which brought many parents back to their youthful days and made them feel emotional. The graduation ceremony ended amid the melodious violin sounds of "Fishing Boat Sings Evening" by the four girls in the AP class. At this moment, classmates, teachers and parents have the joy of gathering together, the nostalgia that is beyond words, the relaxation of taking a break during the holidays, and the determination to prepare for greater success in the coming year. The Chinese school will start in early August. Please pay attention to the school website www.ccsarizona.org and register in time. See you next semester!

b3bff33fcc7a0edb119ac944a058a72a4e09c717.sourceText: 4月就业增16.5万失业率7.5% 受4月美国非农业就业人数增加影响，美国股市周五早盘继续上扬，道指逼近15000点，标普指数突破1600点，两者均创历史新高。美国4月非农就业人数增加16.5万、失业率降至7.5%，达自2008年12月以来最低点，令市场情绪振奋。 美国劳工部宣布，4月非农就业人数环比增16.5万。据彭博社此前对90名经济学家的调查中值显示，平均预期为环增14.5万。失业率稳定维持在7.6%。 数据显示，4月就业机会增加主要集中于饭店、酒吧和零售行业。 此外，美国2、3月非农业就业人数增幅经修正后再增11.4万。 野村证券首席经济学家Steven Ricchiuto表示，就业量大幅增加出乎人们意料。 尽管就业势头显示良好，但专家认为并不能过于乐观。目前来看，政府目前似乎成为市场的最大拖累，4月联邦、市级和地方政府工削减就业岗位1.1万个。州和地方政府开支水平已经跌回10年前同期水平，并且持续走低。
b3bff33fcc7a0edb119ac944a058a72a4e09c717.translatedText: Employment increased by 165,000 in April, and the unemployment rate was 7.5%. Affected by the increase in U.S. non-agricultural employment in April, the U.S. stock market continued to rise in early trading on Friday, with the Dow approaching 15,000 points and the S&P index exceeding 1,600 points, both hitting record highs. The number of non-farm payrolls in the United States increased by 165,000 in April, and the unemployment rate fell to 7.5%, reaching the lowest level since December 2008, which cheered up market sentiment. The U.S. Department of Labor announced that non-farm employment increased by 165,000 in April from the previous month. According to the median of a previous Bloomberg survey of 90 economists, the average expectation was for an increase of 145,000. The unemployment rate remained stable at 7.6%. Data show that job gains in April were mainly concentrated in restaurants, bars and retail industries. In addition, the increase in non-agricultural employment in the United States in February and March was revised to increase by 114,000. Steven Ricchiuto, chief economist at Nomura Securities, said the sharp increase in employment was unexpected. Although the employment momentum shows good results, experts believe that we cannot be too optimistic. At present, the government seems to be the biggest drag on the market, with federal, municipal and local government workers cutting 11,000 jobs in April. The level of state and local government spending has fallen back to the same period 10 years ago and continues to decline.
