e49ade06fe203227780caf35b2a6ff7433682493.sourceText: 美严查学生签证恐嫌​​名单增至90万 国家反恐中心说，该中心管理的恐嫌观察名单过去五年大幅膨胀，从54万人增至2012年底的87万5000人。其中美国人近9000人，既包括美国公民，也有绿卡持有者。反恐中心说，观察名单为机密资料，真实姓名不会公布。 恐怖观察名单的正式名称为”恐怖身分资料库环境”(TIDE)，一名情报官员不认为名单扩大后，将使查找真正的恐怖分子更难。 全国情报和执法部门装备的软体，可通过筛选资料，找到需要的情报。情报官员说，”我们每天都利用观察名单，寻找想要找的结果”。 观察名单中的87万5000人都是恐怖分子或恐怖嫌疑，他们姓名的不同拼写方式和别名都有注明。 情报官员说，恐怖观察名单近年来大幅膨胀，部分原因是2009年内裤炸弹客试图炸毁飞机但未遂的事件引起的，恐怖观察名单的管理受到国会批评，促使反恐中心修改了名单录入规则。 情报官员说，在谁应被列入名单的问题上，现在的标准降低，不需要很多的恶劣纪录。 海关下令严查国际学生签证 据美联社，周五国土安全部在内部会议中下令，所有海关工作人员必须立刻行动起来，严格确保每位入境美国的国际学生都持有有效学生签证。这是波士顿爆炸案后，政府发布的首项与之相关的安全政策变革。 这项命令由美国海关与边境保护局的一位高层官员David J. Murphy在周五下达。仅仅一天前，政府证实日前新逮捕的波士顿案三位嫌犯中，其中一人在学生签证已经失效的情况下，今年一月顺利入境美国，引起不小的非议。 据早前报道，4月27日，马萨诸塞州警方抓捕了两名乘黑色宝马车的年轻男子，该宝马车牌上写有”头号恐怖分子”字样。经过证实，他们是波士顿恐怖袭击事件嫌疑犯焦哈尔?#33832;纳耶夫的朋友，曾在时代广场和焦哈尔合影。 这两人因妨碍司法公正被起诉，他们被控帮助波士顿案二号嫌犯处理掉了装有火药的背包。 据报道，这两名年轻男子来自于哈萨克斯坦，名叫Azamat Tazhayakov和Dias Kadyrbayev。他们于本月19日曾被警方扣留问话，后又被释放。20日他们又因违反移民法再次被捕。据《纽约时报》消息，他们面临着被驱逐出境。 嫌犯被开除仍能入境留学生登记存严重漏洞 目前很多人质疑：两位新嫌犯入境后遭学校除名仍能返美，这曝出美国留学生登记存在严重系统漏洞。 被美国当局拘捕的两名哈萨克斯坦籍嫌犯所持学生签证均已失效，其中塔兹哈雅科夫在签证过期后曾离境并又成功进入美国。 主修工程学的卡迪尔巴耶夫因成绩低劣自去年秋季学期被学校开除，但此后一直滞留境内。 经济学专业的塔兹哈雅科夫也因被学校除名而其签证已于1月4日到期，但令人不解的是他在去年12月离境后，在今年1月20日返回美国时在纽约成功入境。 联邦当局表示，塔兹哈雅科夫重新入境时，国安部的留学生及交流学者信息系统中仍有他的记录。但同时也承认，海关及边境保护局当时未及时接到他已被学校除名的通知。
e49ade06fe203227780caf35b2a6ff7433682493.translatedText: The list of possible suspects in the United States to strictly check student visas has increased to 900,000. The National Counterterrorism Center said the terrorist watch list it manages has expanded significantly over the past five years, from 540,000 to 875,000 at the end of 2012. There are nearly 9,000 Americans among them, including both U.S. citizens and green card holders. The Counterterrorism Center said the watch list is confidential and real names will not be released. An intelligence official doesn't believe the expansion of the terror watch list, officially known as the Terrorist Identity Database Environment (TIDE), will make it harder to find actual terrorists. Intelligence and law enforcement agencies across the country are equipped with software that can sift through data to find the intelligence they need. "We use watch lists every day to look for the results we're looking for," the intelligence official said. The 875,000 people on the watch list are terrorists or suspected terrorists, and their names are spelled in different spellings and aliases. Intelligence officials say terror watch lists have ballooned in recent years, in part because of the 2009 underpants bomber's failed attempt to blow up a plane. The management of the watch lists has been criticized by Congress, prompting the Counterterrorism Center to revise its rules. Intelligence officials say the bar is now lowered on who should be included on the list and does not require a bad record. Customs orders strict inspection of international student visas According to the Associated Press, the Department of Homeland Security ordered in an internal meeting on Friday that all customs staff must take immediate action to strictly ensure that every international student entering the United States holds a valid student visa. This is the first security policy change the government has issued since the Boston bombing. The order was issued on Friday by David J. Murphy, a top official with U.S. Customs and Border Protection. Just one day ago, the government confirmed that one of the three newly arrested suspects in the Boston case successfully entered the United States in January this year even though his student visa had expired, causing considerable criticism. According to earlier reports, on April 27, the Massachusetts police arrested two young men in a black BMW with the words "Terrorist Number One" written on the license plate. It was confirmed that they were friends of Dzhokhar Nayev, the suspect in the Boston terrorist attack, and had taken photos with Dzhokhar in Times Square. The pair were indicted on obstruction of justice charges after helping the second suspect in the Boston case get rid of a backpack containing gunpowder. According to reports, the two young men are from Kazakhstan and are named Azamat Tazhayakov and Dias Kadyrbayev. They were detained by the police for questioning on the 19th of this month and were later released. On the 20th, they were arrested again for violating immigration laws. According to the New York Times, they face deportation. Suspects are still able to enter the United States even after being expelled. There are serious loopholes in the registration system for international students. Many people are currently questioning whether two new suspects can still return to the United States after being expelled from their schools after entering the country. This exposes serious loopholes in the registration system for international students in the United States. The student visas held by the two Kazakhstani suspects arrested by the US authorities have expired. Among them, Tazkhayakov left the country and successfully entered the United States after his visa expired. Kadyrbayev, who majored in engineering, was expelled from school last fall due to poor grades, but has been stranded in the country since then. Economics major Tazkhayakov was also expelled from school and his visa expired on January 4. However, what is puzzling is that after leaving the country in December last year, he successfully entered the United States in New York on January 20 this year when he returned to the United States. Federal authorities said that when Tazkhayakov re-entered the country, his record was still in the Department of Homeland Security's International Students and Exchange Scholars Information System. But he also admitted that Customs and Border Protection did not receive timely notification that he had been expelled from the school.

d9aaf1e01a979ff7eca8668aa159557130176f49.sourceText: 2013年ASU中国学生学者联谊会主席竞选终于落下帷幕。 本次中国学生会对选举制度做了修改以保证更加公正公平的选举结果。与往年不同，本次选举虽然仅限ASU在校中国学生投票，总票数却达到历史最高：共计1041张，其中有效选票787张。竞选人刘维哲同学总共获得544张选票。竞选人应才翔同学总共获得243张选票。刘维哲同学以69.12%的支持率当选2013-2014学年ASU中国学生学者联谊会主席。
d9aaf1e01a979ff7eca8668aa159557130176f49.translatedText: The 2013 ASU Chinese Students and Scholars Association presidential election has finally come to an end. This time, the Chinese Student Union has made changes to the election system to ensure a more fair and equitable election result. Different from previous years, although voting in this election was limited to Chinese students at ASU, the total number of votes reached a record high: a total of 1,041 votes, of which 787 were valid votes. Candidate Liu Weizhe received a total of 544 votes. Candidate Ying Caixiang received a total of 243 votes. Liu Weizhe was elected president of the ASU Chinese Students and Scholars Association in the 2013-2014 academic year with a support rate of 69.12%.

9c7e857d51b0ec964e57ce254160ddb19bc93950.sourceText: 毕业于中央民族大学法学学士，就读于ASU公共管理硕士专业，刘维哲同学有着丰富的编导，主持，策划经验。作为ASU中国学生会资质较老的成员之一，刘维哲在过去几年里为ASU中国学生会做出了卓越的贡献，向大家证明了优秀的领导才能，并在中国学生群体里树立起了良好的个人形象。作为本次竞选呼声最高的主席人选，刘维哲同学旨在全力提升ASU中国学生会在社区及学生心目中的形象，真正发挥中国学生会的能力和职责造福ASU中国学生及凤城的华人社区。
9c7e857d51b0ec964e57ce254160ddb19bc93950.translatedText: Graduated from Minzu University of China with a Bachelor of Laws and studied Master of Public Administration at ASU. Liu Weizhe has rich experience in directing, hosting, and planning. As one of the older members of the ASU Chinese Student Union, Liu Weizhe has made outstanding contributions to the ASU Chinese Student Union in the past few years, proving his excellent leadership skills and establishing a good personal image among the Chinese student community. As the most popular candidate for chairman in this election, Liu Weizhe aims to fully enhance the image of the ASU Chinese Student Union in the community and students, and truly leverage the capabilities and responsibilities of the Chinese Student Union to benefit ASU Chinese students and the Chinese community in Fengcheng.

4fb30d83cc2d0470f03df4b79676defd68c1b3f6.sourceText: 在此对刘维哲同学的当选表示祝贺，也感谢所有积极参选的候选人和参与投票的同学们。

58c2b2dc0783490ac24efb2568ec9148c4951342.sourceText: (2013-4-29 Chandler, AZ）Sonoran Desert 的气温开始频频凸显3位数字的时候，孩子们开始了他们的悠长暑假。这个5月到8月，有上学孩子的父母们除了操持既定的家庭出行之外，心里还至少盘算着一件事儿–这个暑假孩子学点儿啥呢？
58c2b2dc0783490ac24efb2568ec9148c4951342.translatedText: (2013-4-29 Chandler, AZ) When the temperature in the Sonoran Desert began to hit three digits frequently, the children began their long summer vacation. From May to August, parents with school-going children, in addition to planning scheduled family trips, are also thinking about at least one thing - what will their children learn this summer vacation?

6363653e3a9bf0ae26f5df18480b417f3c674977.sourceText: ”让学生和家长有选择有侧重”–这是今夏位于Chandler市的新东方艺术学校（EAA）夏令营 Camp套餐的关键词。从2013年5月27日到8月2日，EAA为孩子们精心准备了快乐、有益的夏令营Camp教育项目，旨在继续坚持和突出EAA艺术特长和中文教育的特色，更为学员和家长提供的可选择、有侧重的教育套餐。
6363653e3a9bf0ae26f5df18480b417f3c674977.translatedText: “Allow students and parents to choose and focus” – this is the keyword of this summer’s New Oriental Art School (EAA) summer camp package in Chandler. From May 27 to August 2, 2013, EAA carefully prepared a happy and beneficial summer camp education program for children. It aims to continue to uphold and highlight EAA's artistic expertise and the characteristics of Chinese education, and to provide students and parents with optional and focused education packages.

8d9a45b85d283603a4841c0793d3d9dd6ba9cd4f.sourceText: 新东方传统的艺术夏令营Summer Camp是多年来深受广大家长和学员喜欢的教育项目。暑期周一到周五，早7：30到下午6：00pm，学员们在韵律健身、美术、武术、音乐和中文课程中度过充实快乐的时光。
8d9a45b85d283603a4841c0793d3d9dd6ba9cd4f.translatedText: New Oriental's traditional art summer camp Summer Camp is an educational project that has been loved by parents and students for many years. From Monday to Friday in the summer, from 7:30 am to 6:00 pm, students spend a fulfilling and happy time in rhythmic fitness, art, martial arts, music and Chinese courses.

8b555253281c84ba56b14b7dee2fdb0c6ced31f5.sourceText: 炫舞夏令营Dance Intensive是为了满足对舞蹈特别爱好的学员想利用暑期集中学习舞蹈的要求。暑期周一到周五，早8：30到下午12：30pm，学员们接受每天4小时专门的舞蹈教育：基本功，技巧和艺术性训练在集中的阶段学习中可以有个更好的积累和推进。每个月学员将学到一个完整的舞蹈作品。
8b555253281c84ba56b14b7dee2fdb0c6ced31f5.translatedText: Dance Intensive summer camp is designed to meet the requirements of students who are particularly interested in dance and want to use the summer to learn dance intensively. From Monday to Friday in the summer, from 8:30 am to 12:30 pm, students receive 4 hours of specialized dance education every day: basic skills, techniques and artistic training can be better accumulated and advanced in concentrated stages of learning. Each month students will learn a complete dance piece.

4130ff04329546d16c96bedab9780f201455e803.sourceText: 为了方便炫舞夏令营的家长朋友，学员到校时间可以提早为早7：30am.
4130ff04329546d16c96bedab9780f201455e803.translatedText: For the convenience of parents and friends of Dance Dance Summer Camp, students can arrive at school as early as 7:30am.

d78182cb4b0528417a83889b82f7122642af1d5a.sourceText: 对于全日事物繁忙的家长，您可以选择炫舞夏令营+艺术夏令营Summ Camp+Dance Intensive的套餐设计。也即是说在炫舞夏令营中午的学习结束后，学员参加艺术夏令营下午的活动安排，直到下午6：00pm放学。
d78182cb4b0528417a83889b82f7122642af1d5a.translatedText: For parents who are busy all day long, you can choose the package design of Dance Dance Summer Camp + Art Summer Camp Summ Camp + Dance Intensive. That is to say, after the noon study at the Dance Dance Summer Camp, students will participate in the afternoon activities of the Art Summer Camp until school ends at 6:00 pm.

1a26d74b7db645ff01a3d93e337b141a1c0a4e5a.sourceText: 想帮助孩子们强化中文学习是家长朋友们的另一个比较响亮的呼声。炫舞夏令营+中文提高夏令营Dance Intensive + Chinese Conversation & Writing是专门为兼顾舞蹈和中文的学员设置的。学员完成上午的舞蹈专门课程后，周一至周五每日下午有2小时的中文会话和写作课程。此课程采用专用教材，有专职教师负责，小班授课，报满为止。课堂侧重教授后的课堂实践，对话，朗读，讲述，书写和创作。
1a26d74b7db645ff01a3d93e337b141a1c0a4e5a.translatedText: Wanting to help children strengthen their Chinese learning is another loud voice from parents and friends. Dance Intensive + Chinese Conversation & Writing Summer Camp is specially designed for students who want to balance dance and Chinese. After students complete the specialized dance courses in the morning, they will have a 2-hour Chinese conversation and writing course every afternoon from Monday to Friday. This course uses special teaching materials and is in charge of full-time teachers. It is taught in small classes and is subject to full registration. The class focuses on classroom practice, dialogue, reading, telling, writing and creation after teaching.

b9ffe8f18cd757237760a44f5a494b6fb33d6f89.sourceText: 为方便繁忙的家长接送，此Camp课后学生可以在下午6：00pm前离开学校。
b9ffe8f18cd757237760a44f5a494b6fb33d6f89.translatedText: To facilitate pick-up and drop-off for busy parents, students at this Camp can leave the school before 6:00pm.

7d1d9bbb8d1aaacfaea12fafec37e1594ee7ed68.sourceText: ”动起来，学进去”是新东方一直以来的教育主旨。孩子们在充实和欢乐中不但学到新东西，更提高自信心。更难能可贵的是往往一个夏天过去同学们还收获新的友谊和一夏天的美好回忆。
7d1d9bbb8d1aaacfaea12fafec37e1594ee7ed68.translatedText: "Move and learn" has always been the educational theme of New Oriental. Children not only learn new things in enrichment and joy, but also improve their self-confidence. What is even more valuable is that often after a summer passes, students still gain new friendships and a summer of good memories.

1a4e43e716f72ef2ada8475ba91d4fbc7e9bcb55.sourceText: 中国地震台网正式测定：04月20日08时02分在四川省雅安市芦山县(北纬30.3度，东经103.0度)发生7.0级地震，震源深度13千米。四川、重庆、湖南、陕西多地震感强烈！
1a4e43e716f72ef2ada8475ba91d4fbc7e9bcb55.translatedText: China Seismological Network officially determined that a 7.0-magnitude earthquake occurred in Lushan County, Ya'an City, Sichuan Province (30.3 degrees north latitude, 103.0 degrees east longitude) at 08:02 on April 20, with a focal depth of 13 kilometers. Earthquakes were felt strongly in Sichuan, Chongqing, Hunan, and Shaanxi!

b8c45ed7dbe933223d843c36b00c12c5e45623cb.sourceText: 中共中央总书记、国家主席、中央军委主席习近平，今天就解放军和武警部队做好四川雅安芦山地震救灾工作做出了一个重要批示。这个批示里指出，在当前，灾情就是命令，他要求部队要部署好迅速奔赴灾区投入抗震救灾第一线，已经到达灾区的各部队要发扬能打仗，打胜仗的精神，全力抢救受灾群众，全力救治伤员，努力防止次生灾害发生。同时要积极配合地方做好受灾群众的安置，灾区社会稳定等工作。他还特别指出，各救灾部队一定要注意自身的安全防护。
b8c45ed7dbe933223d843c36b00c12c5e45623cb.translatedText: Xi Jinping, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, President of the State, and Chairman of the Central Military Commission, today gave an important instruction on the People's Liberation Army and the Armed Police Force to carry out earthquake relief work in Lushan, Ya'an, Sichuan. This instruction pointed out that at present, the disaster situation is an order. He required the troops to deploy quickly and rush to the disaster area to join the front line of earthquake relief. The troops that have arrived in the disaster area should carry forward the spirit of being able to fight and win, make every effort to rescue the affected people, treat the wounded, and strive to prevent secondary disasters. At the same time, we must actively cooperate with local governments in the resettlement of disaster-stricken people and social stability in disaster areas. He also specifically pointed out that all disaster relief forces must pay attention to their own safety protection.

198a42f33ecd82e0c4b17f0b7b9672ab4ffa210e.sourceText: 中共中央政治局常委、国务院总理李克强赶往四川雅安地震灾区，指导抗震救灾工作。
198a42f33ecd82e0c4b17f0b7b9672ab4ffa210e.translatedText: Li Keqiang, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Premier of the State Council, rushed to the earthquake-stricken area in Ya'an, Sichuan to guide the earthquake relief work.

a492cfe1c3bbd3af00b5a006ea146f680b445ded.sourceText: 今年，全球最大的2000家企业的营收总计为38万亿美元（上涨6%）、利润总计为2.43万亿美元（下滑7%）、资产总计为159万亿美元（增长7%）、市值总计为39万亿美元（增长7%），雇佣员工共计为8,700万人。除利润外，其他几项指标均较去年有所上升。
a492cfe1c3bbd3af00b5a006ea146f680b445ded.translatedText: This year, the world's largest 2,000 companies have total revenue of US$38 trillion (up 6%), total profits of US$2.43 trillion (down 7%), total assets of US$159 trillion (up 7%), total market value of US$39 trillion (up 7%), and a total of 87 million employees. Except for profits, several other indicators have increased compared with last year.

48c66acb60c4ef47022484ec287aff2438723339.sourceText: 今年的2000强榜单再次折射出全球商业的动态变化。榜单覆盖63个国家，较去年减少了3个。美国（543家企业上榜）新增加了19家上榜企业，挽回了其自2004年以来上榜企业一路减少的势头，也是其自2009年以来上榜企业数量最多的一年。日本（251家企业上榜）再次居于次席，不过其上榜企业数量较去年减少了7家。中国大陆（136家企业上榜）位列第三，上榜企业数量与去年持平。这也是自2004年我们发布首届全球企业2000强榜单以来，中国上榜企业数量首次未有出现增长。有11个国家仅有一家企业上榜，其中包括新西兰、捷克共和国和越南。
48c66acb60c4ef47022484ec287aff2438723339.translatedText: This year’s top 2000 list once again reflects the dynamic changes in global business. The list covers 63 countries, 3 fewer than last year. The United States (543 companies on the list) added 19 new companies to the list, reversing the trend of decreasing companies on the list since 2004. It was also the year when the number of companies on the list was the largest since 2009. Japan (251 companies on the list) once again ranks second, but the number of companies on the list has decreased by 7 compared with last year. Mainland China (136 companies on the list) ranked third, and the number of companies on the list was the same as last year. This is also the first time since we released the first Global 2000 list in 2004 that the number of Chinese companies on the list has not increased. Eleven countries have just one company on the list, including New Zealand, the Czech Republic and Vietnam.

2e59a5065a06e3006dc1918b2057f8380a2cbd51.sourceText: 四项指标均出现增长而有亮眼表现的国家是：新加坡、泰国和马来西亚。比利时、土耳其和阿联酋则拥有企业市值增幅最大的荣誉棗这三国均较去年出现了两位数的增幅。西班牙和希腊最近深陷经济危机，两国的企业利润也由此遭受打击，分别都出现整体滑坡。你也可以将意大利归入此列，该国企业今年所有四项指标均出现了下滑。
2e59a5065a06e3006dc1918b2057f8380a2cbd51.translatedText: The countries with outstanding performance in all four indicators are: Singapore, Thailand and Malaysia. Belgium, Türkiye and the United Arab Emirates have the honor of having the largest increase in corporate market value. These three countries all experienced double-digit increases compared with last year. Spain and Greece have recently been plunged into economic crisis, which has also hit corporate profits in both countries, with both countries experiencing overall declines. You could also include Italy in this category, where companies have declined in all four indicators this year.

6d0071dd1aeb53ed8815f49b005a5b9bd3a29bde.sourceText: 这是我们第十年发布全球企业2000强榜单。今年，中国工商银行超越埃克森美孚，成为全球最大企业，首次登上了全球老大哥的宝座。另一家来自中国的银行棗中国建设银行棗排名上升了11位，一跃升至榜眼位置。这两家企业在我们榜单上排名的迅速蹿升得益于它们2012年的销售额和利润均出现了两位数增长。尽管两家银行的利润仍在增长，2012年却是它们自上市以来年增长率最慢的一年。大多数分析师都不认为中国会爆发银行业危机，但逐渐增多的违约事件和缩水的贷款创收能力对中国银行系统来说是一个严重的威胁。摩根大通在2011年曾摘得全球最大企业称号，今年因其销售额出现小幅下滑，排名下降至第三位。通用电气的排名也下降了一位，去年该公司排在第三位，今年位列第四。今年排名第五的公司是去年的榜首棗埃克森美孚。尽管其连续第二年成为全球最能挣钱的企业，但该石油及天然气巨头在第一名的宝座上仅仅呆了一年就被被迫让位。
6d0071dd1aeb53ed8815f49b005a5b9bd3a29bde.translatedText: This is the tenth year that we have released the list of the top 2000 global companies. This year, the Industrial and Commercial Bank of China surpassed Exxon Mobil to become the world's largest company, ascending to the throne of global Big Brother for the first time. Another bank from China, China Construction Bank, rose 11 places in the ranking and jumped to the second position. Both companies' rapid rise on our list was driven by double-digit sales and profit growth in 2012. Although both banks' profits are still growing, 2012 was their slowest annual growth rate since going public. Most analysts do not expect a banking crisis in China, but increasing defaults and shrinking loan-generating capacity are a serious threat to the Chinese banking system. JPMorgan Chase, which won the title of the world's largest company in 2011, dropped to third place this year due to a slight decline in sales. General Electric also fell one spot, from third last year to fourth this year. The fifth-ranked company this year is Exxon Mobil, last year's number one. Despite being the world's most profitable company for the second year in a row, the oil and gas giant was forced to relinquish the No. 1 spot after just a year.

1158d81a51e2d9c4cff6a6ea997cd461630c2b2f.sourceText: 苹果公司（排名并列第15）依然是世界上市值最高的公司，即便其市值自去年3月份以来已缩水24%。沃尔玛（排名并列第15）则凭借5%的销售额增幅，从荷兰皇家壳牌石油手中夺回了全球销售额最高企业的头衔。德国的安联（Allianz）、韩国的三星电子以及美国的AT&T今年闯入前25，其中安联排名蹿升最快，从去年的第50名升至今年的第25名。
1158d81a51e2d9c4cff6a6ea997cd461630c2b2f.translatedText: Apple (tied for 15th) remains the world's most valuable company, even though its market value has shrunk by 24% since March last year. Walmart (ranked tied for 15th) regained the title of the world's largest company by sales from Royal Dutch Shell with a 5% sales increase. Germany's Allianz, South Korea's Samsung Electronics and the United States' AT&T broke into the top 25 this year. Among them, Allianz's ranking jumped the fastest, rising from 50th last year to 25th this year.

8f4b55542bf0aacfe4be7602840556f745dac31e.sourceText: 如果你想知道今年榜单上有哪些公司排名上升最快，那么首当其冲的当属德国的意昂集团（E.ON，今年排名99，去年排名409）；该公司在2012年重新盈利，这要归功于多个因素，其中包括其与俄罗斯和挪威政府就天然气供应合约进行了成功的再谈判、没有出现先前那种造成负面影响的一次性事件，以及德国政府逐渐停止使用核能的决定。美国的ES药品福利管理（Express Scripts，排名第170，去年排名第381）排名蹿升211位，主要得益于其以291亿美元收购了竞争对手美可保健公司（Medco Health Solutions）。而日本饮料公司麒麟控股（Kirin Holdings，排名第467，去年排名第733）利润大幅增加，市值更是增长了31%。
8f4b55542bf0aacfe4be7602840556f745dac31e.translatedText: If you're wondering which companies on this year's list have risen the fastest, top of the list is Germany's E.ON (ranked 99 this year, 409 last year); the company returned to profitability in 2012 thanks to a number of factors, including successful renegotiations of gas supply contracts with the governments of Russia and Norway, the absence of previous negative one-time events, and the German government's decision to phase out the use of nuclear energy. The US's ES Pharmacy Benefit Management (Express Scripts, ranked 170th, ranked 381st last year) jumped 211 places, mainly due to its US$29.1 billion acquisition of competitor Medco Health Solutions. The Japanese beverage company Kirin Holdings (ranked 467th, ranked 733rd last year) has seen a significant increase in profits, and its market value has increased by 31%.

3a67bd349cf182a071f8c216558e89ddbb73831f.sourceText: 至于排名降幅最大的那些公司，它们在四项指标上都出现了下滑。美国PC巨头惠普（排名第438，去年排名第67）在以111亿美元收购了英国软件公司Autonomy之后的一年，对该笔灾难性的交易进行了88亿美元的减记。采矿业巨头力拓（Rio Tinto，排名第435，去年排名第69）因为高达140亿美元的交易损失，去年出现净亏损，这些损失主要与该公司铝业务及莫桑比克的煤炭资产有关。另一家排名大幅下滑的企业是巴西能源巨头巴西中央电力（Eletrobr醩，排名第935，去年排名第320），由于政府下令降低电费，该公司在2012年出现了净亏损。
3a67bd349cf182a071f8c216558e89ddbb73831f.translatedText: As for the companies with the biggest declines in rankings, they fell in all four indicators. A year after buying British software company Autonomy for $11.1 billion, US PC giant HP (ranked 438th, down from 67th last year) took an $8.8 billion write-down on the disastrous deal. Mining giant Rio Tinto (ranked 435th, down from 69th last year) posted a net loss last year due to trading losses of up to US$14 billion, mainly related to the company's aluminum business and coal assets in Mozambique. Another company that has fallen sharply in the rankings is Brazilian energy giant Eletrobra (ranked 935th, compared with 320th last year), which posted a net loss in 2012 due to government orders to reduce electricity rates.

982bf341b8d87104b6cb4f2abc3510a5e5e4c26f.sourceText: 今年新上榜企业共有162家。其中最大的那些，要么是公开上市不久，要么是从母公司拆分出来的大块业务形成的新公司，然后与母公司一道上榜。菲利普斯66（Phillips 66，排名130）去年5月从康菲石油公司（ConocoPhillips，排名第73）分拆出来。雅培生命（AbbVie，排名第257）原是雅培实验室（Abbott Labs，排名第123）旗下专注于研发的医药分支，今年1月，两家公司正式分拆，前者作为独立企业公开上市。截至发稿时，雅培实验室尚未发布其2012年作为独立公司的各项数据，故而其销售额、利润及资产数据和排名均事基于分拆前的合并数据。北美杂货企业卡夫食品集团（Kraft Foods Group，排名第360）去年10月从Mondelez国际公司（Mondelez International，排名第182）分拆出来。中国人民保险集团（排名第226）在2012年11月上市，筹得31亿美元。德国保险公司塔兰克斯（Talanx）是汉诺威再保险（Hannover Re）的主要所有人，前者先是在2012年9月中旬宣布搁置IPO计划，但接着在10月进行了规模为6.02亿美元的首次公开募股。
982bf341b8d87104b6cb4f2abc3510a5e5e4c26f.translatedText: There are 162 new companies on the list this year. The largest ones are either publicly listed shortly, or are new companies formed by spinning off large pieces of business from the parent company, and then listed together with the parent company. Phillips 66 (No. 130) was spun off from ConocoPhillips (No. 73) last May. Abbott Life (AbbVie, ranked 257th) was originally the pharmaceutical branch of Abbott Labs (ranked 123rd) focusing on research and development. In January this year, the two companies officially separated, and the former went public as an independent company. As of press time, Abbott Laboratories has not released its data as an independent company in 2012, so its sales, profit and asset data and rankings are based on consolidated data before the spin-off. North American grocery company Kraft Foods Group (No. 360) was spun off from Mondelez International (No. 182) last October. The People's Insurance Company of China (ranked 226th) went public in November 2012, raising US$3.1 billion. German insurance company Talanx, the main owner of Hannover Re, first announced in mid-September 2012 that it was shelving its IPO plans, but then launched a $602 million initial public offering in October.

002e263075a3e61f74dda1a31f465aa08a7cd6c5.sourceText: 银行及多元化金融企业依然主导这份榜单，共有469家（较去年减少9家）此类公司上榜，很大程度上要归功于它们的销售额和资产总额。接下去的三大行业是石油及天然气（124家企业）、原材料（122家企业）和保险（109家企业）。去年一年，各项指标的增幅领先行业分别为：医疗保健类企业，主要是服务类企业，在销售额上领跑（增长15%）；家用产品和服务类企业在利润上占据领先地位（增长22%）；半导体企业在资产增幅上占据优势（增长24%）；媒体类企业则受益于广播和有线电视公司的推动，在市值增长上领先（增长20%）。原材料行业，包括冶金和采矿类企业，则落后于所有其他行业：利润大降55%，市值下滑19%。
002e263075a3e61f74dda1a31f465aa08a7cd6c5.translatedText: Banks and diversified financial companies still dominate this list, with a total of 469 (a decrease of 9 from last year) such companies on the list, largely due to their sales and total assets. The next three largest industries are oil and gas (124 companies), raw materials (122 companies) and insurance (109 companies). Last year, the leading industries in terms of growth in various indicators were: healthcare companies, mainly service companies, led in sales (up 15%); household products and service companies took the lead in profits (up 22%); semiconductor companies had the advantage in asset growth (up 24%); media companies benefited from the promotion of broadcasting and cable TV companies and led in market value growth (up 20%). The raw materials industry, including metallurgical and mining companies, lagged behind all other industries: profits fell by 55% and market value fell by 19%.

3aeb5701e3406d4b48a9e610c763bb32a91e6c07.sourceText: 榜单的区域划分上，我们将其分为四块：首先是亚太地区（715家上榜企业），紧随其后的是欧洲、中东及非洲地区（606家企业），之后是美国（543家企业）及除美国之外的美洲地区（143家企业）。仅美国在所有四项指标均出现了同比增长。领衔的亚太地区已经连续第六年拥有上榜企业最多的称号，其还在销售额增幅（8%）和资产增幅（15%）上排名第一。美国则在利润增幅（4%）和市值增幅（11%）上领先，美国上榜企业的利润总额为8,760亿美元，市值总额为14.8万亿美元。美国企业是四大地区中盈利能力最强也是市值最高的。欧洲、中东及非洲地区则交出了最高销售额（总计13.3万亿美元）和最高资产额（64万亿美元）的成绩单。
3aeb5701e3406d4b48a9e610c763bb32a91e6c07.translatedText: In terms of regional division of the list, we divide it into four regions: first is the Asia-Pacific region (715 companies on the list), followed by Europe, the Middle East and Africa (606 companies), followed by the United States (543 companies) and the Americas (143 companies) except the United States. Only the United States posted year-over-year increases in all four indicators. The leading Asia-Pacific region has the title of having the most companies on the list for the sixth consecutive year, and it also ranks first in sales growth (8%) and asset growth (15%). The United States leads in terms of profit growth (4%) and market value growth (11%). The total profits of the companies on the list in the United States are US$876 billion, and the total market value is US$14.8 trillion. American companies are the most profitable and have the highest market capitalization among the four major regions. The Europe, Middle East and Africa region delivered the highest sales (a total of US$13.3 trillion) and the highest assets (US$64 trillion).

1f54869e4d5b7f17169fd94b478a338ea542d5c1.sourceText: ASU和UA秋季学费上涨3%已经通过 （本网编译）周四（2013年4月4日）大学教务委员会批准亚利桑按州立大学（ASU）与亚利桑那大学（UA）从本年秋季学期开始增收3%的学费。这样亚利桑那州立大学的新生将让学校增收1万美元。 这样ASU州内新生学费将涨到$282到$10002一年 UA学生将涨到$356到$10391一年 北亚利桑那大学将上涨5%。但是大部分学生都在学费承诺计划中，他们的学费将不变。新生将付$467到$9738一年。 三个学生要求教务委员会改变这个政策，其中一位说本来她就要毕业了，但是因为是没有合法身份的学生，她要付更高的学费。她只能上一个学期，休学一个学期，这样花更多的时间去挣学费。一个24岁的学生告诉教务委员会，没有理由让他们花10年的时间去完成5年的大学学历。如果不改变这个涨价的政策，这种情况马上就会发生。
1f54869e4d5b7f17169fd94b478a338ea542d5c1.translatedText: >ASU and UA have passed a 3% fall tuition increase. (Compiled by this website) On Thursday (April 4, 2013), the University Senate approved Arizona State University (ASU) and the University of Arizona (UA) to increase tuition by 3% starting from this fall semester. This new student at Arizona State University will increase the school's revenue by $10,000. In this way, tuition for ASU in-state freshmen will rise to $282 to $10,002 per year, UA students will rise to $356 to $10,391 per year, and Northern Arizona University will rise by 5%. But most students are on the Tuition Commitment Plan and their tuition will remain the same. Freshmen will pay $467 to $9738 per year. Three students asked the academic board to change the policy. One said she was about to graduate, but because she was an undocumented student, she had to pay higher tuition. She could only attend one semester and take one semester off, so she could spend more time earning tuition. One 24-year-old student told the Senate there was no reason why it would take them 10 years to complete a five-year university degree. If the price increase policy is not changed, this situation will happen soon.

8509499a736544149d5dd58d77314809477e940a.sourceText: 亚利桑那州立大学学生学者联谊会选举 4月21将公布结果 以下是学生会的有关通知： 选举投票人资格： 1）所有ASU在读中国学生和中国学者 2）ASU现任中国教职人员 3）ASU中国校友 本次选举活动的程序 1）请有意参选学生会主席者在本公告发布之日起至2013年4月7日星期日晚上11:59前，将履历表，竞选大纲（1-2页），以及近照一张邮寄到 cssaelection2013@gmail.com 2）选举投票开始时间：2013年4月13日星期六晚上11:59； 选举投票截止时间：2013年4月20日星期六晚上11:59； 3) 选举结果公布时间：2013年4月21日星期天； 投票具体办法: 确定你心目中的理想人选后，请用你的 asu.edu 邮箱发送邮件到 cssaelection2013@gmail.com ，邮件主题写上: CSSA Election 邮件内容必须包括: a) 所投候选人的中文姓名 b) 投票人ASU 学生卡号码 (10位数字)?注意: 此号码我们只交予ASU核实投票人并予以保密，绝不对外公开！绝无其他用途！公布投票结果时，我们保密所有投票人的名字，只显示学生卡后4位数字 c) 投票人姓名（必须是完整中文名或者中文名字拼音，英文名、缩写视为无效票） 有效票: 不符合以下条件中任意一条的邮件，视为无效票 (1 )必须以 asu.edu 邮件信箱发送 (2 )必须提供投票人ASU学生证10位数字号码(例如：1000xxxxxx) (3 )必须提供投票人姓名（必须是完整中文名或者拼音，英文名、缩写视为无效票） (4 )必须在投票时间内发送邮件 (5 )所投候选人的姓名要正确，不能出现错别字或者拼写错误 每封邮件，计算为一张选票；每位投票人只能投票给一位候选人（若同时投票给多名候选人，该投票人的所有投票都将视为无效票）。 为了实现竞选的公平公正公开，学生会将于每两天于凌晨一点之前公布实时票数。 时间如有变动，我们会及时更新，敬请关注！再次感谢大家一直以来对CSSA的大力支持和帮助！ 亚利桑那州立大学中国学生学者联谊会 2013年4月2日
8509499a736544149d5dd58d77314809477e940a.translatedText: The results of the Arizona State University Student and Scholar Association election will be announced on April 21. The following is the relevant notice from the student union: Election voter qualifications: 1) All current Chinese students and scholars at ASU 2) Current Chinese faculty at ASU 3) ASU Chinese alumni Procedures for this election 1) Those who are interested in running for student union president should mail their resume, campaign outline (1-2 pages), and a recent photo to cssaelection2013@gmail.com from the date of this announcement to 11:59 pm on Sunday, April 7, 2013. 2) Election voting start time: 11:59 pm on Saturday, April 13, 2013; Election voting deadline: 11:59 pm on Saturday, April 20, 2013; 3) Election results announcement time: Sunday, April 21, 2013; Specific voting methods: After determining your ideal candidate, please use your asu.edu email address to send an email to cssaelection2013@gmail.com, and write the email subject: The content of the CSSA Election email must include: a) The Chinese name of the candidate to vote for b) The voter’s ASU student card number (10 digits)? Note: We only give this number to ASU to verify the voter and keep it confidential, and will never make it public! No other uses! When announcing the voting results, we keep the names of all voters confidential and only show the last 4 digits of the student ID card c) Voter's name (must be the complete Chinese name or Chinese pinyin, English names and abbreviations are considered invalid votes) Valid votes: Emails that do not meet any of the following conditions are considered invalid votes (1) Must be sent to the asu.edu email address (2) The 10-digit ASU student ID number of the voter must be provided (for example: 1000xxxxxx) (3 ) The voter’s name must be provided (must be the complete Chinese name or pinyin, English names and abbreviations are considered invalid votes) (4) The email must be sent within the voting time (5) The name of the candidate voted for must be correct, and there must be no typos or spelling errors. Each email is counted as one vote; each voter can only vote for one candidate (if he votes for multiple candidates at the same time, all votes cast by the voter will be considered invalid votes). In order to achieve a fair, just and open election, the Student Union will announce real-time vote counts before 1 a.m. every two days. If the time changes, we will update it in time, so stay tuned! Thank you again for your continued support and help to CSSA! Arizona State University Chinese Students and Scholars Association April 2, 2013

The U.S. Customs and Border Protection will implement the exemption for foreign passengers entering the United States from April 21st...

dd1a7576fd711ffdc93d9c730f06f13f5448a9ef.sourceText: 驻美官员表示，这项规定是美国海关与边境保护局于22日在联邦政府网站宣布，并将在公布后30天自动生效。换句话说，自4月21日起，所有外国旅客入境美国将不再需要填写入出境登记卡I-94。
dd1a7576fd711ffdc93d9c730f06f13f5448a9ef.translatedText: Officials in the United States said that this regulation was announced by the U.S. Customs and Border Protection on the federal government website on the 22nd and will automatically take effect 30 days after the announcement. In other words, starting from April 21, all foreign travelers entering the United States will no longer need to fill in the entry and exit registration card I-94.

ebc2852293ecf9de7630b04a1b4e7bae8f55c7d1.sourceText: I-94是美国移民官员记录并查询外籍旅客进出美国国境与在美国停留期间的表格。入境美国的外籍旅客在入境美国前，必须先填写I-94，详附航班资料、护照号码、预计停留时间与地点、签证种类等资料。
ebc2852293ecf9de7630b04a1b4e7bae8f55c7d1.translatedText: I-94 is a form used by U.S. immigration officials to record and inquire about foreign travelers entering and leaving the United States and during their stay in the United States. Foreign passengers entering the United States must fill out the I-94 before entering the United States, including flight information, passport number, expected stay time and location, visa type and other information.

fe0da97451bf45ce7e63d821c972eb6f778db903.sourceText: 这张俗称「小白卡」的美国入出境登记卡将全面电子化，未来外国旅客在登机前往美国前，资料将同步透过旅客资料预报（Advanced Passenger Information）系统送到美国海关与边境保护局，旅客在美国海关入境时，经查资料无误后，即可入境。
fe0da97451bf45ce7e63d821c972eb6f778db903.translatedText: This U.S. entry and exit registration card, commonly known as the "little white card", will be fully electronic. In the future, before foreign passengers board a plane to the United States, their information will be simultaneously sent to the U.S. Customs and Border Protection through the Advanced Passenger Information (Advanced Passenger Information) system. When passengers enter the United States, they can enter the country after checking that the information is correct.

c53edc3bea4778e22709e636dbbeed7a6260d78c.sourceText: 这项入出境电子化措施，预估每年将可为美国政府节省约1550万美元政府预算。
c53edc3bea4778e22709e636dbbeed7a6260d78c.translatedText: This electronic entry and exit measure is estimated to save the US government's budget by approximately US$15.5 million per year.

But a judge delayed official filings to consider outgoing CEO Tom Horton's severance package. At a court hearing on Wednesday, the judge said it was a good outcome and there was no objection. The United States has been protecting companies from bankruptcy since 2011. The company proposed to pay CEO Horton a severance package of 20 million, and he will complete the handover within a year. American Trust Company believes that this severance package exceeds the limits of bankruptcy law. Holden has been serving American Airlines his entire career. After he became CEO, American Airlines filed for bankruptcy on November 29, 2011. UA CEO Doug Parker will run the combined company, and Horton will leave after receiving a severance package. UA is not opposed to special compensation arrangements for grassroots employees after the merger.

1210e9eeb2448b819323e1f7c4271f48ce316750.sourceText: 美失业率降至7.7% 2008年来最低 美国劳工部8日公布的数据显示，今年2月份美国非农业部门失业率较前月下降0.2个百分点，降至7.7%。 美国2月增加就业岗位23.6万个，较1月份的11.9万个新增工作岗位有大幅增长。 就业岗位增加和失业率减少都好过此前预期。周五早间开盘时，股市也微幅上涨，道琼斯指数再攀历史高点。 尽管各个领域就业岗位都有所增加，但建筑领域显然堪当翘楚，2月净增就业岗位4万8千个。建筑领域就业市场转好表明整体经济正在回暖。
1210e9eeb2448b819323e1f7c4271f48ce316750.translatedText: The U.S. unemployment rate dropped to 7.7%, the lowest since 2008. Data released by the U.S. Department of Labor on the 8th showed that the U.S. non-agricultural sector unemployment rate fell by 0.2 percentage points from the previous month to 7.7% in February this year. The United States added 236,000 jobs in February, a significant increase from the 119,000 new jobs in January. Both job creation and the unemployment rate decrease were better than previously expected. Stocks were also slightly higher at the open early Friday morning, with the Dow Jones climbing to another all-time high. Although jobs increased in all fields, construction was clearly the leader, with a net increase of 48,000 jobs in February. An improving job market in the construction sector is a sign that the overall economy is picking up.

e09257351621222864a45c044c9ed0da3338c629.sourceText: 报告称15%美国企业将撤离中国
e09257351621222864a45c044c9ed0da3338c629.translatedText: The report said that 15% of American companies will leave China

ac12eb9fa3e8e8a6fd5c179966f6af0875e90025.sourceText: 报告称15%美国企业将撤离中国 据经济之声《央广财经评论》报道，中国拥有广大的市场和低廉的生产成本，这些因…
ac12eb9fa3e8e8a6fd5c179966f6af0875e90025.translatedText: The report said that 15% of American companies will leave China. According to the Economic Voice's "Central Broadcasting and Economics Review" report, China has a vast market and low production costs. These factors...

cb57697156225ac801052fae72ca43e2e409e63f.sourceText: 据经济之声《央广财经评论》报道，中国拥有广大的市场和低廉的生产成本，这些因素吸引着无数外商来中国投资设厂。但是随着人力成本上升和经济转型带来的经济增速放缓，有些企业正在选择离开中国。
cb57697156225ac801052fae72ca43e2e409e63f.translatedText: According to the Economic Voice of China's "Central Broadcasting and Economics Review", China has a vast market and low production costs. These factors have attracted countless foreign businessmen to invest and set up factories in China. However, as labor costs rise and economic growth slows down due to economic transformation, some companies are choosing to leave China.

e20dcc4794ea09963bdbba5914934226a6cb18e9.sourceText: 上海美国商会最新发布的《2012到2013中国商业报告》就反映出这样的问题。这份报告显示，美国企业在中国的盈利水平、营业额和营运利润率等主营业绩指标出现连续两年的下滑。所以有15%的美国企业现在准备离开中国。
e20dcc4794ea09963bdbba5914934226a6cb18e9.translatedText: The latest "China Business Report 2012 to 2013" released by the American Chamber of Commerce in Shanghai reflects this problem. This report shows that the main performance indicators of American companies in China, such as profitability, turnover and operating profit margin, have declined for two consecutive years. So 15% of American companies are now preparing to leave China.

09fd94c1bffb3cd80cbc27fb3e5fa926f5210be9.sourceText: 有离开中国的冲动的并非只有美国企业，也并非今年才开始出现。2011年底，跨国企业就出现了从中国战略性撤退的趋势，国家外汇管理局则在最新的报告中罕见地警告，目前存在资本流出风险。
09fd94c1bffb3cd80cbc27fb3e5fa926f5210be9.translatedText: American companies are not the only ones who have the urge to leave China, nor did they start to appear only this year. At the end of 2011, multinational companies began to strategically withdraw from China, and the State Administration of Foreign Exchange issued a rare warning in its latest report that there is currently a risk of capital outflows.

55b5f6f9b5fecfff06c118a245b66a8f88eb3156.sourceText: 稍加研究可以发现，离去的大多是制造业企业，另外一些外国企业则逐渐地把设计部门转移到中国来。
55b5f6f9b5fecfff06c118a245b66a8f88eb3156.translatedText: After a little research, we can find that most of the companies leaving are manufacturing companies, and some other foreign companies are gradually transferring their design departments to China.

cc0c3413d520a76599636f7555bbddec7645dc34.sourceText: 当然，由此带来的不仅是危机，也有机遇。这些制造业企业退出所留下的空档，国内的制造业和创意产业如何来填补；外资流出，我们如何进一步激活内需，这些问题考验着企业和管理部门的智慧。但是阵痛过后，中国经济必然会走上依靠内需、重视创新的良性发展之路。经济之声特约评论员、商务部研究院副院长邢厚媛就此事发表评论。
cc0c3413d520a76599636f7555bbddec7645dc34.translatedText: Of course, this brings not only crises, but also opportunities. How can domestic manufacturing and creative industries fill the gap left by the exit of these manufacturing companies? With the outflow of foreign capital, how can we further activate domestic demand? These issues test the wisdom of enterprises and management departments. But after the pain is over, China's economy will inevitably embark on a healthy development path that relies on domestic demand and emphasizes innovation. Xing Houyuan, a special commentator for Economic Voices and deputy director of the Research Institute of the Ministry of Commerce, commented on this matter.

842882db98e24e8bb9c10b01af8f9957c435191b.sourceText: 邢厚媛：上海美国商会的这份报告提醒我们，不少美国企业准备离开中国，但是并不是所有的美国企业都想离开，现在还有一些美国企业准备把设计部门建到中国来。邢厚媛指出，有打算离开中国或者已经离开中国的美国企业，主要还是集中在高端制造业领域。
842882db98e24e8bb9c10b01af8f9957c435191b.translatedText: Xing Houyuan: This report from the American Chamber of Commerce in Shanghai reminds us that many American companies are preparing to leave China, but not all American companies want to leave. There are still some American companies that are preparing to build design departments in China. Xing Houyuan pointed out that American companies that plan to leave China or have already left China are mainly concentrated in the high-end manufacturing field.

afef73fdc62fe0b2288136668500f2b2e6926df8.sourceText: 根据研究调查发现，目前有打算离开中国或者在过去一年多的时间里面已经离开中国的美国企业，主要还是集中在和美国现有的制造业的核心产业相配套的一些比较高端的制造业。
afef73fdc62fe0b2288136668500f2b2e6926df8.translatedText: According to research and surveys, American companies that currently plan to leave China or have left China in the past year or so are mainly concentrated in some relatively high-end manufacturing industries that match the core industries of the existing manufacturing industry in the United States.

d492fdf39cf39293f97d266d1038008393973400.sourceText: 它们离开中国一方面是由于中国在这些领域的制造成本比以往增加了。另一方面，美国目前也在实行再工业化的战略，还有和它相配套的是美国的出口倍增战略以及扩大就业的战略，这三个战略组合一起后，政府有一些优化政策，就使得美国本土的制造业成本在下降。在美国相对成本下降，中国的本土制造业成本有所上升的背景下，二者的差额就变得比较小了。
d492fdf39cf39293f97d266d1038008393973400.translatedText: Their departure from China is partly due to the fact that China's manufacturing costs in these fields have increased compared with the past. On the other hand, the United States is currently implementing a reindustrialization strategy, which is matched by the U.S. export doubling strategy and the employment expansion strategy. When these three strategies are combined, the government has some optimization policies, which has led to a decline in manufacturing costs in the United States. In the context of the relative cost reduction in the United States and the increase in China's local manufacturing costs, the difference between the two has become relatively small.

094265deb79649dc78efe3e5db8a536b84af8274.sourceText: 除了中国制造业特别是劳动力成本的因素之外，我们还要考虑到目前全球制造业的物流成本在这种产业链很长的制造业领域里面所占的比重很高，所以如果能减少一次物流的成本、国际运输的成本，就会使得总体的成本有较大的降低空间。
094265deb79649dc78efe3e5db8a536b84af8274.translatedText: In addition to the factors of China's manufacturing industry, especially labor costs, we must also consider that the current global manufacturing logistics costs account for a high proportion in this manufacturing field with a long industrial chain. Therefore, if we can reduce the cost of primary logistics and international transportation, there will be greater room for reduction in the overall cost.

53298506050d8d558ab6be55daa665db860f4a50.sourceText: 金融危机发生以后，随着世界经济在疲软的状态下缓慢复苏，其实我们也正在经历一次全球制造业产业布局的重新整合。劳动密集型产业这一块越来越多的转向了比我们发展水平更低端的新兴制造业国家，国际上高端的制造业还在发达国家的本土继续在生存，而中等水平的终端制造业这一块在流向中国。
53298506050d8d558ab6be55daa665db860f4a50.translatedText: After the financial crisis, as the world economy slowly recovers from a weak state, we are actually experiencing a reintegration of the global manufacturing industry layout. Labor-intensive industries are increasingly turning to emerging manufacturing countries with lower development levels than ours. Internationally high-end manufacturing continues to exist in developed countries, while mid-level terminal manufacturing is flowing to China.

deb1f7aa2d99a15286a45912a2036dcbd06b88ca.sourceText: 全球制造业产业布局重新整合对我们来讲是机遇和挑战并存的。中国制造业在过去三十年通过改革开放，通过自主创新两个手段的发展，已经在国际制造业体系当中占据了非常重要的位置。同时，我想在其他国家没有我们这么大规模的制造业基地，我们不光是市场规模大，而且我们的门类特别齐全，另外熟练的产业的工人量也非常大。
deb1f7aa2d99a15286a45912a2036dcbd06b88ca.translatedText: The reintegration of the global manufacturing industry layout brings both opportunities and challenges to us. Over the past thirty years, China's manufacturing industry has developed through reform and opening up and independent innovation, and has occupied a very important position in the international manufacturing system. At the same time, I think that other countries do not have such a large-scale manufacturing base as ours. Not only does our market have a large scale, but our categories are particularly complete. In addition, the number of skilled workers in the industry is also very large.

fb038a99dd68ae1ce122cbd04d07795dc6b08571.sourceText: 我觉得我们有充分的自信，我们政局稳定，这是一点。第二点，我们的产业配套能力特别强，因为门类齐全，所以配套能力非常强。第三，我们工人的工资虽然相对于其他比我们低端的发展中国家，的确贵了一点，但对于发达国家而言，同岗位的劳动工资成本我们还是比较低廉的。而且我们中国人劳动效率高，吃苦耐劳、心灵手巧，更应该自信。
fb038a99dd68ae1ce122cbd04d07795dc6b08571.translatedText: I think we have full confidence and our political situation is stable. This is one point. The second point is that our industrial supporting capabilities are particularly strong. Because of the complete range of categories, our supporting capabilities are very strong. Third, although the wages of our workers are indeed a bit higher than those of other low-end developing countries, compared to developed countries, the cost of labor wages for the same position is still relatively low. Moreover, we Chinese are highly efficient, hard-working and ingenious, so we should be more confident.

10e79f5d39886675fa9acefc0c3a50eb0766becc.sourceText: 丰田、福特、本田 130万辆车大清查
10e79f5d39886675fa9acefc0c3a50eb0766becc.translatedText: Toyota, Ford, Honda 1.3 million vehicles under inspection

75b4f723997fa16df587b42d066adf6c704eef0b.sourceText: 丰田、福特、本田 130万辆车大清查 全國公路交通安全管理署(NHTSA)已對豐田(Toyota)、福特…
75b4f723997fa16df587b42d066adf6c704eef0b.translatedText: Toyota, Ford, Honda 1.3 million vehicles under inspection The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) has launched a 1.3 million vehicle inspection on Toyota, Ford...

a2420c26a3348ea6e2d7b3a6598410705b841294.sourceText: 丰田、福特、本田 130万辆车大清查 全國公路交通安全管理署(NHTSA)已對豐田(Toyota)、福特(Ford)和本田(Honda)三家公司約130萬輛不同車型的安全問題，展開一系列調查。 遭到調查的車型包括56萬1000輛2004年至2009年份豐田Prius油電混合車、72萬4000輛2009年至2011年份福特Escape、 Fusion、Mercury Mariner和Milan車型，以及8萬7000輛2005年份本田Pilot多功能車。NHTSA尚未決定是否對這些車型宣布召回。 NHTSA表示，Prius油電混合車可能有轉向軸組裝不當的問題。不過，這次遭調查的車型，許多已被列入豐田先前與轉向軸缺陷有關的召回行動。 福特四個車型接受調查是在接獲123起通報，顯示與車子突然喪失動力或完全熄火有關。該問題可能涉及多個原因，其中包括化油器總成缺陷和電路板遭污染。 本田Pilot多功能車的調查重點則在於當局接獲205起通報，指出該車型會突然猛煞車，問題可能是「汽車穩定輔助系統」的感測器故障。 另一方面，消費者報導雜誌26日公布「年度十大最佳汽車」名單中，本田汽車公司和豐田汽車公司各有三個車款上榜。 本田重新設計的2013年度雅哥(Accord)被消費者報導評為最佳中型轎車，奧德賽(Odyssey)被評為最佳迷你廂形車，CR-V被評為最佳小型多功能車(SUV)。 豐田的油電車普銳斯(Prius)連續十年被評為最佳綠色汽車，而Highlander被評為最佳中型SUV，豐田著眼於年輕世代的Scion廠牌的FR-S，以及日本速霸陸(Subaru)的BRZ，則被選為最佳跑車(sports car)。 速霸陸的Impreza被評為最佳小型轎車，韓國現代(Hyundai)的伊蘭特(Elantra)則被評為最划算的轎車。德國的奧迪A6和寶馬328i分別被評為最佳豪華車和最佳運動型轎車，成為十大最佳汽車中的唯一兩款非亞洲車款。
a2420c26a3348ea6e2d7b3a6598410705b841294.translatedText: Toyota, Ford, Honda 1.3 million vehicles under inspection The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) has launched a series of investigations into safety issues in about 1.3 million different models of Toyota, Ford and Honda. The vehicles under investigation include 561,000 Toyota Prius hybrids from 2004 to 2009, 724,000 Ford Escape, Fusion, Mercury Mariner and Milan models from 2009 to 2011, and 87,000 2005 Honda Pilot utility vehicles. NHTSA has not yet decided whether to issue a recall for these models. NHTSA said the Prius hybrid may have an improperly assembled steering shaft. However, many of the models under investigation this time have been included in Toyota's previous recalls related to steering shaft defects. Ford's four models are under investigation after receiving 123 reports related to the sudden loss of power or complete stalling of the vehicle. The problem may have several causes, including a defective carburetor assembly and a contaminated circuit board. The focus of the Honda Pilot multi-purpose vehicle investigation is that the authorities received 205 reports indicating that the model would suddenly brake violently. The problem may be a sensor failure of the "vehicle stability assist system". On the other hand, Consumer Reports magazine announced on the 26th its "Top Ten Best Cars of the Year" list. Honda Motor Company and Toyota Motor Company each had three models on the list. Honda's redesigned 2013 Accord was named Best Midsize Car by Consumer Reports, the Odyssey was named Best Minivan, and the CR-V was named Best Small SUV. Toyota's gas-electric Prius has been named the best green car for ten consecutive years, while the Highlander was named the best mid-size SUV. Toyota's Scion brand's FR-S, which focuses on the younger generation, and Japan's Subaru BRZ were selected as the best sports car. Subaru's Impreza was named the best small car, while South Korea's Hyundai's Elantra was named the best deal. Germany's Audi A6 and BMW 328i were named Best Luxury Car and Best Sports Car respectively, becoming the only two non-Asian models among the top ten best cars.

375390f53787c2d140ab8825a1a706dc4dbc2e9f.sourceText: 中国富豪为2岁女儿买纽约公寓
375390f53787c2d140ab8825a1a706dc4dbc2e9f.translatedText: Chinese rich man buys New York apartment for 2-year-old daughter

e0767deb1b809ee8081946e610799e1c5f88fa4e.sourceText: 中国富豪为2岁女儿买纽约公寓 《华尔街日报》2月25日刊登文章，凯文?#24067;朗是纽约苏富比地产的房…
e0767deb1b809ee8081946e610799e1c5f88fa4e.translatedText: > Chinese rich man buys New York apartment for 2-year-old daughter The Wall Street Journal published an article on February 25, Kevin Lang is the real estate agent of Sotheby's Realty in New York...

fc88e19caec30cb11c2af271bc0a42d429a499fc.sourceText: 据美国房地产数据分析公司Core Logic的数据，纽约住房价格指数去年12月同比上涨7%。中国人往往买涨不买跌，所以价格上升反而会刺激更多需求。在中国，净资产在100万美元以上的有270万人，其中30%都在海外进行地产投资。第一批走出去的超级富豪专注于高档物业，主要以现金买房。现在更多普通买家也开始走出去，他们一般采用和在中国买房一样的按揭做法。
fc88e19caec30cb11c2af271bc0a42d429a499fc.translatedText: According to data from Core Logic, a US real estate data analysis company, the New York housing price index rose 7% year-on-year in December last year. Chinese people tend to buy up prices rather than down prices, so rising prices will stimulate more demand. In China, there are 2.7 million people with net assets of more than US$1 million, 30% of whom invest in real estate overseas. The first batch of super-rich people to go abroad focus on high-end properties and mainly buy houses with cash. Now more ordinary buyers are starting to go out, and they generally adopt the same mortgage practices as when buying a house in China.

3d8add56ed3603e22108beb89e2334faaa86f83b.sourceText: 美国仍是最受中国购房者青睐的国家。在1200万参与调查的潜在购房者中，43%称移民是海外置业的主要目的。洛杉矶、纽约、三藩市、华盛顿特区和波士顿在首选城市中排名前5。
3d8add56ed3603e22108beb89e2334faaa86f83b.translatedText: The United States is still the most popular country for Chinese home buyers. Among the 12 million potential home buyers who participated in the survey, 43% said that immigration was the main purpose of buying overseas property. Los Angeles, New York, San Francisco, Washington, D.C., and Boston rounded out the top 5 preferred cities.

740c74bd4578e2a7785bfd1ae2614d5792cc1256.sourceText: 另外，50万美元及以上预算的购房者佔比超过60%。布朗的客户构成已经随之改变，「三年前我的客户当中约12%是中国人，去年则增长到20%，现在约三分之一都来自中国」。
740c74bd4578e2a7785bfd1ae2614d5792cc1256.translatedText: In addition, the proportion of home buyers with a budget of US$500,000 and above accounts for more than 60%. The composition of Brown's customers has changed accordingly. "Three years ago, about 12% of my customers were Chinese. Last year, it increased to 20%. Now about one-third are from China."

418b25c8a3ac1f8e0c6b9129f421fa52b2548780.sourceText: 中国留学生蜂拥而至，父母想在这里给他们提供一个和国内同样安逸的环境。来自成都的高亦丘今年21岁，虽然只是纽约佩斯大学的大三学生，但她已在着名的99John住了两年多。这栋楼过去80年中一直是曼哈顿的地标住宅之一。
418b25c8a3ac1f8e0c6b9129f421fa52b2548780.translatedText: Chinese students studying abroad flock here, and their parents want to provide them with the same comfortable environment here as at home. Gao Yiqiu from Chengdu is 21 years old. Although she is only a junior at Pace University in New York, she has lived in the famous 99John for more than two years. The building has been one of Manhattan's landmark residences for the past 80 years.

3d6747423e381ce77ccd45e0036aa4e68391da60.sourceText: 2010年9月入学后，高租下这栋楼的一间小套房。一个月后她父母决定在这买套一室一厅的公寓，当时全加起来价格差不多是80万美元，他们选择在美国向汇丰银行贷款。
3d6747423e381ce77ccd45e0036aa4e68391da60.translatedText: After enrolling in school in September 2010, Gao rented a small suite in this building. A month later, her parents decided to buy a one-bedroom apartment here. The total price at that time was almost US$800,000. They chose to get a loan from HSBC Bank in the United States.

5219cc1c834d8798555386afef23ef5771cfbd6e.sourceText: 高当年的房产经纪人莱恩?#29791;汉表示，虽然美国的按揭付款方式已完全对中国买家开放，但是对个人信用等资质的审核门槛非常高，「绝大多数中国买家还是选择一次性付清房款。伴随房价上升，那些非一次性付清全款的买家基本都选50%的按揭，但这些人其实也是非常富有、有充足银行存款证明的客户。」
5219cc1c834d8798555386afef23ef5771cfbd6e.translatedText: Ryan Han, a real estate agent from Gao's time, said that although the mortgage payment method in the United States has been completely opened to Chinese buyers, the review threshold for personal credit and other qualifications is very high. "The vast majority of Chinese buyers still choose one-time Pay off the house. "

This year’s tax filing season has kicked off. The Internal Revenue Service announced on the 7th that in order to combat identity theft in tax filing fraud nationwide...

c52cc152147343113d6003bb8d541de6e43f8022.sourceText: 国税局大执法 逮109人控189人 今年报税季已揭开序幕，国税局7日宣布，为了在全国打击报税诈欺的身分盗窃犯罪，联邦执法部门今年1月採取700多次执法行动，查获389人涉嫌身分盗窃和报税诈欺，共109人被捕、189人被控罪。 国税局的审计和犯罪调查部门，1月底开始对金融服务机构进行严格检查，甚至包括支票兑现商店，以确保没有资助身分盗窃和退税诈欺。 国税局重点查缉了凤凰城、图桑、纽约、费城、亚特兰大、天帕、迈阿密、芝加哥、休士顿、洛杉矶、圣地牙哥、艾尔巴索、伯明罕、底特律、旧金山、屋崙和圣荷西17个城市，部分调查持续了一年，一些窃贼利用其他人的社会安全号和身分资讯向国税局报税，以便获得退税。 国税局代理局长米勒说：「今年的报税季节已开始，我们要清楚地申明，预谋退税诈欺和身分盗窃的人，将付出沉重的代价。我们已採取并将继续採取严厉措施，追查和预防退税诈欺与身分盗窃。」 为制止犯罪，国税局加强了对诈欺与盗窃的电脑筛选。米勒局长承认，国税局因为筛选检查而减缓了日常的报税和退税，但国税局将把延缓降到最低。 米勒说，国税局2012年派出3000多税务人员查处身分盗窃，比2011多出一倍多。国税局去年避免使200亿元成为诈欺退税被人冒领，其中大部分与身分盗窃有关，2011年有140亿元没有成为诈欺退税。 国税局在打击身分盗窃的退税诈欺上虽然取得进展，但米勒认为仍有改进空间。对于遭受身分盗窃的诚实纳税人，国税局将加快处理他们的退税。
c52cc152147343113d6003bb8d541de6e43f8022.translatedText: Large-scale enforcement by the Internal Revenue Service, arresting 109 people and charging 189 people. This year’s tax filing season has kicked off. The Internal Revenue Service announced on the 7th that in order to combat the identity theft crime of tax filing fraud across the country, federal law enforcement agencies conducted more than 700 law enforcement actions in January this year and arrested 389 people suspected of identity theft and tax filing fraud. A total of 109 people were arrested and 189 people were charged. The Internal Revenue Service's Audit and Criminal Investigation Division began conducting rigorous inspections of financial services institutions in late January, including check cashing stores, to ensure they are not funding identity theft and tax refund fraud. The IRS targeted 17 cities including Phoenix, Tucson, New York, Philadelphia, Atlanta, Tempa, Miami, Chicago, Houston, Los Angeles, San Diego, El Paso, Birmingham, Detroit, San Francisco, Oakland and San Jose. Part of the investigation lasted for a year. Some thieves used other people's Social Security numbers and identity information to file tax returns with the IRS in order to obtain tax refunds. "This year's tax filing season has begun, and we want to make it clear that those who plan to commit tax refund fraud and identity theft will pay a heavy price," said IRS Acting Commissioner Miller. Commissioner Miller acknowledged that the IRS has slowed down routine tax filings and refunds due to screening checks, but the IRS will keep delays to a minimum. Miller said the IRS sent more than 3,000 tax agents to investigate identity theft in 2012, more than double the number in 2011. The IRS avoided $20 billion in fraudulent refunds last year, much of it related to identity theft, and $14 billion in 2011. While the IRS has made progress in combating identity theft tax refund fraud, Miller believes there is still room for improvement. The IRS will expedite the processing of refunds for honest taxpayers who have suffered identity theft.

445fa8fd07097e308e2de974d8afb512524d9837.translatedText: was suspected of being shot from outside the car

3269dade39cdf5733b313dbfaafdb7b7ea6ad1e3.sourceText: 现年28岁的华裔女教练 莫妮卡 关 系洛杉矶市首位华裔警察局长的女儿，目前是加州大学富勒顿分校的篮球教练。3日晚，有人在加州尔湾市一个停车场，发现了她与其27岁未婚夫凯什 劳伦斯双双倒在一辆汽车的座位上，中弹身亡。当地警方经调查认为，两名死者均为被凶手从车外开枪杀害。可以确定，这不是一宗抢劫行凶案，因为死者的财物并没有被抢劫。目前此案仍在调查之中。
3269dade39cdf5733b313dbfaafdb7b7ea6ad1e3.translatedText: The 28-year-old Chinese female coach Monica is the daughter of the first Chinese police chief in Los Angeles and is currently the basketball coach at the University of California, Fullerton. On the evening of the 3rd, someone found her and her 27-year-old fiancé Cash Lawrence slumped on the seats of a car in a parking lot in Irvine, California, and were shot to death. After investigation, the local police believed that the two deceased were shot and killed by the murderer from outside the car. It is certain that this was not a robbery as the property of the deceased was not robbed. The case is still under investigation.

8c34cde7cc17461e53328ab53ccc48bdb9c17024.sourceText: 另据最新消息称，警方目前正在追捕嫌疑犯棗前洛杉矶警官克里斯托弗 乔丹 多尔纳。
8c34cde7cc17461e53328ab53ccc48bdb9c17024.translatedText: According to the latest news, the police are currently hunting for the suspect, former Los Angeles police officer Christopher Jordan Dorner.

79244255914df896083326928b274a4cafc94536.sourceText: 华裔女孩 及未婚夫惨遭枪杀
79244255914df896083326928b274a4cafc94536.translatedText: A Chinese girl and her fiancé were shot and killed

7941c7e11b49635895ccd70ab11bdbd8dc2bb4a9.sourceText: 据报道，当地时间2月3日晚，加州 尔湾 市警方接到一名女路人的报警电话称，当晚9点左右，她在某高级公寓停车场顶楼向自己的汽车走去时，发现旁边一辆汽车里竟然倒着一对青年男女。警方随后发现，现年28岁的莫妮卡 关陈尸倒在这辆白色起亚轿车的前座，而其27岁的未婚夫凯什 劳伦斯则趴在驾驶座的方向盘上。
7941c7e11b49635895ccd70ab11bdbd8dc2bb4a9.translatedText: According to reports, on the evening of February 3, local time, the police in Irvine, California received a call from a female passerby saying that at about 9 o'clock that night, when she was walking to her car on the top floor of a high-end apartment parking lot, she found a young man and woman lying in a car next to her. Police later found the body of 28-year-old Monica Kwan slumped in the front seat of the white Kia sedan, while her 27-year-old fiancé Cash Lawrence was slumped on the steering wheel of the driver's seat.

7ca3e8784293d88a5d6cd13ea8ef5891c2681585.sourceText: 经对现场初步勘查，警方初步认定两名死者均属枪击致命，系被人从车外射杀，目前杀手的动机尚不清楚。蹊跷的是，案发时附近居民竟然没有听到枪声。负责调查此案的尔湾市警官恩金表示：”现场证据使我们相信，这不是一起抢劫枪杀案，（因为）他们的财物并没有被抢劫。”
7ca3e8784293d88a5d6cd13ea8ef5891c2681585.translatedText: After preliminary investigation of the scene, the police initially determined that the two deceased persons were fatally shot from outside the car. The motive of the killer is currently unclear. The strange thing is that the nearby residents did not hear the gunfire when the incident occurred. Enjin, the Irvine police officer in charge of investigating the case, said: "The evidence at the scene leads us to believe that this was not a robbery and shooting case (because) their belongings were not robbed."

d56c8f0a2ebd3e6d381adff823757b25781fde15.sourceText: 据悉，这对遇害情侣均居住在案发停车场附近的高级公寓里。警方推测，这辆白色起亚远舰轿车就是两名死者遇害的第一现场。住在该公寓的居民表示，3日晚突然来了十多辆警车，最后看到救护车没有载人就离开现场。尔湾警方4日上午已将死者劳伦斯的轿车拖吊到警局进行取证。案发地点的五层楼高级公寓门禁森严，停车场的出入口均设有安全门，车辆必须有安全密码才能进入，外表上看起来安全无虑。5日，莫妮卡 关和劳伦斯尸检开始进行。
d56c8f0a2ebd3e6d381adff823757b25781fde15.translatedText: It is reported that the murdered couple lived in a high-end apartment near the parking lot where the crime occurred. Police speculated that the white Kia Optima sedan was the first scene where the two victims were killed. Residents living in the apartment said that more than a dozen police cars suddenly arrived on the evening of the 3rd, and they finally saw the ambulance leaving the scene without anyone on board. Irvine police towed the deceased Lawrence's car to the police station on the morning of the 4th for evidence collection. The five-story high-end apartment where the crime took place is tightly guarded. Security gates are installed at the entrances and exits of the parking lot. Vehicles must have a security code to enter. It looks safe on the outside. On the 5th, the autopsies of Monica Guan and Lawrence began.

6ff54f392144f7eaf985b994e7297ed7756f3058.sourceText: 尔湾市警局发言人安简表示，警方目前仍在调查确切的死亡时间，警方初步排除了死者开枪自杀的可能，而朝他杀进行调查，目前尚不清楚凶手及其作案动机，但警方拒绝透露进一步细节。
6ff54f392144f7eaf985b994e7297ed7756f3058.translatedText: Irvine Police Department spokesperson An Jian said that the police are still investigating the exact time of death. The police have initially ruled out the possibility that the deceased shot himself and are investigating the murder. The murderer and his motive for the crime are currently unclear, but the police refused to disclose further details.

cca689ba337b8ce457e70fcef5ea9be2545f946e.sourceText: 遇难情侣均曾为 篮球高手
cca689ba337b8ce457e70fcef5ea9be2545f946e.translatedText: The couple who died were both former basketball players

48d42de2520599512f6a5a0a28f18d85c30453a9.sourceText: 现年28岁的莫妮卡 关及其未婚夫凯什 劳伦斯均毕业于康考迪亚大学，都曾效力于该校篮球队。莫妮卡关高中毕业时，曾创下一个赛季三分球最高得分的纪录，2003-2005年，她在加州州立大学长滩分校打球，2005-2007年转入康考迪亚大学球队，并获得运动体育科学的学士学位，2007-2009年攻读硕士学位。毕业后，她曾在加州千橡树市的路德大学担任篮球 助理教练 ，2年前她担任加州大学富勒顿分校的篮球助理教练。
48d42de2520599512f6a5a0a28f18d85c30453a9.translatedText: Monica Guan, 28, and her fiancé Cash Lawrence both graduated from Concordia University and played for the school's basketball team. When Monica Guan graduated from high school, she set a record for the most three-pointers scored in a season. From 2003 to 2005, she played at California State University, Long Beach. From 2005 to 2007, she transferred to the Concordia University team and received a bachelor's degree in exercise science. From 2007 to 2009, she studied for a master's degree. After graduation, she served as an assistant basketball coach at Lutheran University in Thousand Oaks, California, and 2 years ago she served as an assistant basketball coach at the University of California, Fullerton.

da719959065e807554b14ce1e7972fc466f07b4f.sourceText: 莫妮卡关的未婚夫凯什 劳伦斯现年27岁，两人是在上大学时相识的，当时两人都是康考迪亚大学校篮球队队员。劳伦斯主修商业，遇害前刚刚结束警察局的培训，开始在南加大做保安。保安主管约翰 托马斯说，”由于他的工作，南加大社区变得更安全，我们的部门更出色。”莫妮卡 关的父亲关兰德一直服务于洛杉矶市警察局，曾经是洛杉矶警察局里第一位华裔警长，2002年被任命为加州州立理工大学波莫纳分校警察局局长。
da719959065e807554b14ce1e7972fc466f07b4f.translatedText: Monica Guan's fiancé, Cash Lawrence, is now 27 years old. The two met when they were in college. At that time, they were both members of the Concordia University basketball team. Lawrence, who majored in business, had just completed police training before he was killed and started working as a security guard at the University of Southern California. Security Director John Thomas said, "Because of his work, the USC community has become safer and our department is better." Monica Kwan's father, Kwan Land, has been serving in the Los Angeles Police Department. He was once the first Chinese-American sergeant in the Los Angeles Police Department. In 2002, he was appointed as the chief of police of California State Polytechnic University, Pomona.

e6f92cc9a333d820c433ac318b2a889173f14c7f.sourceText: 莫妮卡关不幸遇害的噩耗4日传到富勒顿州大校园后，球员及教练震惊不已，许多人对一向治安良好的尔湾竟会发生双尸命案感到难以置信。富勒顿州大校长贾西亚4日上午发表声明表示，莫妮卡关意外遇害，令全校师生悲痛和揪心，该校将在这个困难时期全力支援她的家人，并为体育部球员及教练提供心理咨询。
e6f92cc9a333d820c433ac318b2a889173f14c7f.translatedText: After the sad news of Monica Guan's tragic murder reached the campus of Fullerton State University on the 4th, players and coaches were shocked. Many people found it unbelievable that a double murder would occur in Irvine, which has always had good security. Fullerton State University President Garcia issued a statement on the morning of the 4th, saying that the accidental murder of Monica Guan made all the teachers and students of the school sad and worried. The school will fully support her family during this difficult period and provide psychological counseling to the players and coaches of the athletic department.

dc268cfb7ce7437131fb0de54d7218f3ac16cc6d.sourceText: 富勒顿州大体育部主管唐纳文及女篮队总练教马希娅 福斯特在校内召开记者会，福斯特强忍悲痛地说：”我们的悲伤是难以用语言形容的，球队的姑娘们能与这位阳光和热情的女士一起共事，是一种荣幸。不久前大家才为莫妮卡 关订婚的喜事而欢聚，没想到年纪轻轻的她竟发生意外。女子篮球圈从此失去一盏明灯，而我也失去了最好的工作伙伴。”
dc268cfb7ce7437131fb0de54d7218f3ac16cc6d.translatedText: Fullerton State University Athletic Department Director Donald Donavan and women's basketball team head coach Marcia Foster held a press conference on campus. Foster held back his grief and said: "Our sadness is indescribable in words. It is an honor for the girls on the team to work with this sunny and enthusiastic woman. Not long ago, everyone paid tribute to Monica. We gathered together to celebrate the engagement, but we didn’t expect that something happened to her at such a young age. The women’s basketball circle lost a bright light, and I also lost my best working partner.”

b4066864f3c5982e60dc731f6295265ef24842ca.translatedText: Fujian plans to develop 532 uninhabited islands: individuals can apply

b44f66d422f64fd740c5982c28e85af356ef8283.translatedText: Fujian plans to develop 532 uninhabited islands: individuals can apply According to the "Fujian Island Protection Plan" recently released by the Fujian Provincial Department of Oceans and Fisheries, the province will moderately...

b9f7a79817734b794b1b4ec891ee0af9eaaeb031.sourceText: 根据规划，福建省将确定重点开发东山岛、大嶝岛、小嶝岛等22个有居民海岛，优化开发厦门岛、鼓浪屿、湄洲岛等3个有居民海岛，适度开发532个无居民海岛。
b9f7a79817734b794b1b4ec891ee0af9eaaeb031.translatedText: According to the plan, Fujian Province will determine the key development of 22 inhabited islands such as Dongshan Island, Dadeng Island, and Xiaodeng Island, optimize the development of 3 inhabited islands, including Xiamen Island, Gulang Island, and Meizhou Island, and moderately develop 532 uninhabited islands.

7641cae371b1c6aa226433fc4d96271a2c48f727.sourceText: 这些无人岛将根据不同功能进行开发：厦门宝珠屿等132个为旅游娱乐用岛，福鼎牛栏屿等83个为交通运输用岛，霞浦小目岛等97个为工业与城乡建设用岛，连江燕屿等102个为渔业用岛，福清过屿等6个为农林牧业用岛，平潭峻山岛等46个为可再生能源用岛，罗源上担屿等66个为公共服务用岛。
7641cae371b1c6aa226433fc4d96271a2c48f727.translatedText: These uninhabited islands will be developed according to different functions: 132 islands such as Xiamen Baozhu Island are used for tourism and entertainment, 83 islands including Fuding Niulan Island are used for transportation, and 97 islands including Xiapu Xiaomu Island are used for tourism and entertainment. Three are islands for industry and urban and rural construction, 102 islands such as Lianjiang Yanyu are used for fishery, 6 islands including Fuqing Guoyu are used for agriculture, forestry and animal husbandry, 46 islands including Pingtan Junshan Island are used for renewable energy, and 66 islands including Luoyuan Shangdan Island are used for public services.

c1e3b39ce4ad50c877589c360f21743b500fd6f2.sourceText: 申请开发利用无人岛须严守程序：申请人应提交海岛使用申请书、坐标图、使用项目论证报告、开发利用具体方案、相关资信证明材料等申请文件。开发利用必须符合海岛保护规划的要求，开发利用方向须与海岛保护规划中的海岛功能定位一致，并制定海岛开发利用生态环境保护措施。申请在得到海洋行政主管部门受理后，须获得国务院或省政府审批。单位和个人还须按照规定缴纳海岛使用金。
c1e3b39ce4ad50c877589c360f21743b500fd6f2.translatedText: Applications for the development and utilization of uninhabited islands must strictly abide by the procedures: Applicants should submit application documents such as island use applications, coordinate maps, use project demonstration reports, specific plans for development and utilization, and relevant credit certification materials. Development and utilization must comply with the requirements of the island protection plan. The direction of development and utilization must be consistent with the functional positioning of the island in the island protection plan. Ecological and environmental protection measures for island development and utilization must be formulated. After the application is accepted by the marine administrative department, it must be approved by the State Council or the provincial government. Units and individuals must also pay island usage fees in accordance with regulations.

2f18f607c3a387159b418f70461737e25edfac23.translatedText: Securities and Exchange Commission freezes fraudsters and their company assets

4ba1bd75b95deff9eb64757a148508d6c8e766a9.sourceText: 约200中国人被骗上亿美元
4ba1bd75b95deff9eb64757a148508d6c8e766a9.translatedText: About 200 Chinese people were defrauded of hundreds of millions of dollars

3e2e85a5adef128a88ccd8cd9dba11b2a10db44e.sourceText: 当地时间8日，美国证券交易委员会(SEC)在其网站上宣布，美国商人 塞思 谎称投资者购买其公司股份便可快速获得移民美国的机会，诈骗250余名投资者1.45亿美元投资和1100万美元管理费用，这些投资者大多来自中国。SEC已对塞思及其两家公司的资产进行了冻结，保留了上亿美元的投资款项，但投资者被骗的1100万美元管理费用已有九成被花掉。
3e2e85a5adef128a88ccd8cd9dba11b2a10db44e.translatedText: On the 8th local time, the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) announced on its website that American businessman Seth He falsely claimed that investors could quickly obtain the opportunity to immigrate to the United States by purchasing shares in his company, and defrauded more than 250 investors, most of whom were from China, of US$145 million in investments and US$11 million in management fees. The SEC has frozen the assets of Seth and his two companies, retaining hundreds of millions of dollars in investment funds, but 90% of the $11 million in management fees that investors were defrauded has been spent.

5c8b703f23ba19361628b1f40e9dc5813ddae1a0.sourceText: 塞思创建的两家公司分别为芝加哥会议中心（ACCC）及芝加哥洲际区域中心信托（IRCTC），塞思此前谎称他的公司将在芝加哥奥黑尔机场附近融资建设”世界上第一个零碳排放铂金LEED认证”的酒店和会议中心，投资者只要购买ACCC的股份，就可以通过EB-5移民投资者试点计划快速获得移民美国的机会。
5c8b703f23ba19361628b1f40e9dc5813ddae1a0.translatedText: The two companies Seth founded are the Chicago Convention Center (ACCC) and the Chicago Intercontinental Regional Center Trust (IRCTC). Seth had previously falsely claimed that his company would finance the construction of "the world's first zero-carbon emission platinum LEED certified" hotel and conference center near Chicago's O'Hare Airport. Investors can quickly obtain the opportunity to immigrate to the United States through the EB-5 immigrant investor pilot program as long as they purchase shares in ACCC.

c8276c2d56057ceaee7af42f192f9e2625f8f197.sourceText: EB-5计划的主要内容是，如果海外投资者投资100万美元（或50万美元在失业率较高的”特定就业领域”）于创造或维持10个美国工人岗位的项目，他们就有可能获得美国绿卡。
c8276c2d56057ceaee7af42f192f9e2625f8f197.translatedText: The main content of the EB-5 program is that if overseas investors invest US$1 million (or US$500,000 in "specific employment areas" with high unemployment) in projects that create or maintain 10 American worker jobs, they may obtain a US green card.

64ca24d12aaa2bfce5fa713fbe192b7405e5a9ad.sourceText: SEC表示，塞思与他的公司欺骗中国投资者称他们已经得到所有必要的建设许可，几家酒店连锁企业也加入了这一项目。他们还向美国公司身份和移民服务局提交了伪造的文件，试图取得项目许可以及投资者的临时签证。
64ca24d12aaa2bfce5fa713fbe192b7405e5a9ad.translatedText: >The SEC said Seth and his company deceived Chinese investors into saying they had obtained all necessary construction permits and that several hotel chains had joined the project. They also submitted forged documents to the U.S. Corporate Identity and Immigration Services in an attempt to obtain project permits and temporary visas for investors.

2de70d0aec55f27b3f8c73dd40e5d6d2bf3947c7.sourceText: SEC指控称，塞思向超过250名投资者欺诈销售超过1.45亿美元证券，并收取了1100万美元管理费用，而这些投资者主要来自于中国。塞思曾承诺，如果签证不成功将退回收取的管理费，但塞思及其公司已经花掉了管理费的90%。其中，超过250万美元已经进入塞思在香港的个人账户。
2de70d0aec55f27b3f8c73dd40e5d6d2bf3947c7.translatedText: > The SEC alleged that Seth fraudulently sold more than $145 million in securities to more than 250 investors, mainly from China, and collected $11 million in management fees. Seth had promised to refund the management fee collected if the visa was unsuccessful, but Seth and his company had already spent 90% of the management fee. Among them, more than US$2.5 million has entered Seth's personal account in Hong Kong.

243bba3e7c5baff713859b23ce54f6609d960b24.sourceText: ”好消息是，我们干预得比较早，资产冻结保留了几乎所有投资款项。”SEC执法部门的副主任斯蒂芬 L 科恩说。根据美国证券与交易委员会起诉书中的指控，塞思及其两家公司违反了1933年证券法第17（a）条及10（b）条。除了法院授予的临时限制令及资产冻结外，SEC的申诉寻求永久禁止令以及其他的金钱禁令。（记者刘佳 消息来自新华网）
243bba3e7c5baff713859b23ce54f6609d960b24.translatedText: "The good news is that we intervened early and the asset freeze preserved almost all of the investment funds." said Stephen L. Cohen, deputy director of the SEC's Enforcement Division. According to the charges in the SEC complaint, Seth and his two companies violated Sections 17(a) and 10(b) of the Securities Act of 1933. In addition to the temporary restraining order and asset freeze granted by the court, the SEC's complaint seeks a permanent injunction and other monetary injunctions. (Reporter Liu Jia, news from Xinhuanet)

89123ff2d8f494dfba25d012aa241bea707d83cf.sourceText: 周日凌晨， 因用 ” 其他方式取暖” 引起的一场火灾使 14 街和 Pima 街交界一所房子烧为灰烬，事件中有 3 人丧生 。
89123ff2d8f494dfba25d012aa241bea707d83cf.translatedText: In the early hours of Sunday, a fire caused by the use of "other means of heating" burned a house at the intersection of 14th Street and Pima Street to ashes, and three people died in the incident.

bea382b94affc2625bf2f551bcd8d84f32baeaa3.sourceText: 消防员于周日凌晨 3 点 20 分赶到火灾现场时，房子已被熊熊大火彻底包围。凤凰城消防局发言人上尉麦克唐纳说，这间空置的房子已经连续数月断水断电，他推测有人蜷居在那所房子里。
bea382b94affc2625bf2f551bcd8d84f32baeaa3.translatedText: When firefighters arrived at the scene of the fire at 3:20 a.m. Sunday, the house was completely engulfed in flames. Capt. McDonald, a spokesman for the Phoenix Fire Department, said the vacant house had been without water and power for months and he speculated that someone was huddled in the house.

af1a8ca5515b304abaf6ea8ef84b3e1acb5cf0d2.sourceText: 一名女子成功从火灾中逃生，只轻微烧伤并吸入烟尘。
af1a8ca5515b304abaf6ea8ef84b3e1acb5cf0d2.translatedText: A woman managed to escape the fire with only minor burns and smoke inhalation.

2cd340d122b6fd6821a67bf781033330efd2ec7d.sourceText: 麦克唐纳说他们一直在注视着山谷附近地区，居住在这些房子里的人基本上是在没有水电的情况下生活的。他不知道这些人的房子是否已经抵押了，他们采取其他方式来取暖，结果导致火灾频发。
2cd340d122b6fd6821a67bf781033330efd2ec7d.translatedText: McDonald said they have been looking at areas near the valley where people living in homes are essentially living without water or electricity. He didn't know if these people's houses had been mortgaged and they resorted to other means to keep warm, resulting in frequent fires.

ed79d7912f379b70acb50d481628a0dc3285ecaa.translatedText: It's 14th Street again, just a coincidence, right?

777478a704c389d945de0256ab61f1706948d79c.sourceText: 去年，美国总统奥巴马取得大多数西语裔选民的投票支持，获近71%的西班牙裔投票率，共和党惨败之后，或对移民改革有所改变。早些时候，两党委员会的双方宣布了一项改革计划草案，可以为超过1,100万名非法移民走出无证阴影。纽约州参议员舒默(Chuck Schumer)表示，八人小组提出了全面的移民改革立法，希望可于参议院以压倒性通过。
777478a704c389d945de0256ab61f1706948d79c.translatedText: Last year, U.S. President Obama won the support of the majority of Hispanic voters, with nearly 71% of Hispanic turnout. After the Republican Party's disastrous defeat, there may be changes to immigration reform. Earlier, both sides of the bipartisan committee announced a draft reform plan that could bring more than 11 million illegal immigrants out of the shadow of undocumentation. New York Senator Chuck Schumer said the eight-member group has proposed comprehensive immigration reform legislation that it hopes will pass the Senate overwhelmingly.

ca262bb1587580380d075675504e2eaa086c77c1.sourceText: 亚利桑那州参议员约翰麦凯恩(John McCain)说：”我希望众议院同意通过，非法居留在美国的人将要支付税款，支付转换公民身份的费用，这将不会花费纳税人的金钱。”但是，今年移民改革仍然有很大的争议，得克萨斯州参议员特德克鲁茲(Ted Cruz)说，他深切关注立法建议成为公民的途径。他指出，为了让那些非法来美国的无证居民得到合法身份，并不符合法治和法律，对数以百万计的合法移民等候多年转换身份是极不公平的。
ca262bb1587580380d075675504e2eaa086c77c1.translatedText: Arizona Senator John McCain said: "I hope the House agrees to pass that people who are in the United States illegally will have to pay taxes and pay to convert citizenship, which will not cost taxpayers money." However, immigration reform remains very controversial this year, and Texas Senator Ted Cruz said he is deeply concerned about the path to citizenship proposed by the legislation. He pointed out that in order to allow those undocumented residents who came to the United States illegally to obtain legal status, it is not consistent with the rule of law and the law, and it is extremely unfair for millions of legal immigrants to wait for many years to change status.

24a8048f04e216da6f607b979e5ee68c20a736b6.sourceText: 陕西房姐同事被指在京拥12套房 据南方都市报报道，近日网上传出消息称，陕西神木县农商行副行长杨利平也在北京三里屯SO H O有12套房屋。杨利平以他妻子高引娥的名义，在三里屯SO H O购置了12套房屋。该消息还称，杨利平的妻子有3个身份证和户口，他儿子的一场婚礼耗资千万。 一名知情者告诉记者，杨利平的父亲杨买昌是知名的神木大砭窑煤矿的大股东。2004年，大砭窑煤矿改制后，杨买昌成为公司股东，出资1900万，占股比例19.79%。杨买昌在公司的职务为公司监事。 值得注意的是，就在杨买昌控股大砭窑煤矿之后不久的2005年，中国银行业监督管理委员会银监复[2005]144号文件显示，杨利平的陕西神木农村合作银行董事任职资格获得通过，这是该银行的要职，杨利平在八大董事中排名第三。 昨晚，记者登录神木农商行官网，发现有关杨利平的三条新闻已被删除。

Yang Liping purchased 12 houses in Sanlitun SO H O in the name of his wife Gao Yin'e. The news also said that Yang Liping's wife has three ID cards and household registrations, and his son's wedding cost tens of millions. An insider told reporters that Yang Liping’s father, Yang Maichang, is the major shareholder of the well-known Shenmu Dayianyao Coal Mine. In 2004, after the restructuring of Dayunyao Coal Mine, Yang Maichang became a shareholder of the company, investing 19 million yuan, accounting for 19.79% of the shares. Yang Maichang's position in the company is company supervisor. It is worth noting that in 2005, shortly after Yang Maichang took control of Dayunyao Coal Mine, the China Banking Regulatory Commission Yinjianfu [2005] No. 144 document showed that Yang Liping was qualified to be a director of Shaanxi Shenmu Rural Cooperative Bank.
