8495ebb8dcc5712fd15027ec81c3ba515dc992e9.sourceText: 严打报税欺诈 退税延后1周 国税局(IRS)定30日开始接受2012年所得税申报，为加强查核身分窃贼申报不实税表，今年许多人可能会延后约一星期，才能拿到退税支票。 国税局正致力于让其自动系统对可能的欺诈迹象更敏锐，这代表对一些税表将会被更仔细的检查。去年国税局阻止发出200亿元的不实退税，比前一年的140亿元大幅增加。 国税局发言人米雪儿 艾德瑞其说，国税局预期能达成其在21天内发出90%退税的目标。 国税局一直试图缩减处理税表程序，以加速退税，旨在鼓励电子报税和减少纳税人依赖短期贷款，但这也增加了诈欺的机会。 近年来纳税人身份被窃非常普遍，在2012会计年度，国税局收到45万件身分盗窃的案件，比前一年增加78%。罪犯从医生办公室、公司发薪部门等来源非法获得纳税人的社安号码后，能够伪造出工资报告和不实税表，他们集中在报税开始之时作案，寻求把退税存入一个一次性的销账卡内，或在真正的纳税人申报之前，提走退税款。 有组织的身份窃贼集团会先送一个人去报税公司去报税，试探其不实的文件是否能蒙混成功，如果成功，就立即分散到不同的报税公司申报几十份类似的税表，有时每份税表有高达8000元的退税。 身分被盗窃的纳税人有时要等待数月才能获得退税，并要经过国税局查核的程序和步骤，经常历时数年才能完成。 今年国税局引进了更多的”过滤器”来防止发出退税欺诈，这些”过滤器”用来分析税表，和判定该税表是否需要更多的检查。国税局不愿透露细节，以避免给罪犯信息。
8495ebb8dcc5712fd15027ec81c3ba515dc992e9.translatedText: Crack down on tax filing fraud and tax refunds are delayed by one week. The Internal Revenue Service (IRS) is scheduled to begin accepting 2012 income tax returns on the 30th. In order to strengthen checks on identity thieves filing false tax returns, many people may be delayed by about a week this year before they can get their tax refund checks. The IRS is working to make its automated systems more sensitive to possible signs of fraud, which means some tax forms will be scrutinized more closely. Last year the IRS blocked $20 billion in false tax refunds, a significant increase from $14 billion the year before. IRS spokesperson Michelle Eldridge said the IRS expects to meet its goal of issuing 90% of refunds within 21 days. The IRS has been trying to streamline tax return processing in an effort to speed up refunds in an effort to encourage electronic filing and reduce taxpayers' reliance on short-term loans, but it also increases the opportunity for fraud. Taxpayer identity theft has become very common in recent years. In fiscal year 2012, the IRS received 450,000 identity theft cases, a 78% increase from the previous year. After criminals illegally obtain a taxpayer's Social Security number from sources such as a doctor's office or a company's payroll department, they are able to forge wage reports and false tax returns. They focus their crimes at the beginning of tax filing, seeking to deposit tax refunds into a one-time charge-off card or withdraw the tax refund before the real taxpayer files. An organized identity thief group will first send a person to a tax filing company to file a tax return to test whether the false documents can be successfully deceived. If successful, they will immediately send dozens of similar tax returns to different tax filing companies, sometimes with tax refunds of up to 8,000 yuan per tax return. Taxpayers whose identities have been stolen sometimes have to wait months to receive their tax refunds and go through IRS verification procedures and steps that often take years to complete. This year the IRS is introducing more "filters" to prevent tax refund fraud. These "filters" are used to analyze the tax return and determine whether the return needs more inspections. The IRS won't release details to avoid giving information to criminals.

7405509f808596e03ae9c4ceafb57d813221e4be.sourceText: 民主党方面包括德宾（有大批西裔人口的伊利诺伊州代表），梅南德斯（古巴裔的新泽西州代表），舒默（纽约州代表），班乃特（科罗拉多州代表）
7405509f808596e03ae9c4ceafb57d813221e4be.translatedText: The Democratic Party includes Durbin (Representative of Illinois, which has a large Hispanic population), Menendez (Representative of New Jersey, a Cuban-American representative), Schumer (Representative of New York State), Bennett (Representative of Colorado)

9d744431944aa596a37c4225093e0ed488a66d90.sourceText: 共和党方面有前总统候选人麦肯，傅雷克（亚利桑纳州代表），2016年的总统候选人鲁比欧（佛罗里达），葛理汉（南卡罗来纳）。
9d744431944aa596a37c4225093e0ed488a66d90.translatedText: The Republican Party includes former presidential candidates McCann, Fleck (Representative of Arizona), 2016 presidential candidates Rubio (Florida), and Graham (South Carolina).

f044da100da16514c5201ca947f362dfe41e0478.sourceText: 参院的计划将规定非法移民必须向联邦登记，并通过背景调查，缴付罚款和欠税，才能获得?#20020;时合法地位?#12290;一旦通过这些障碍，非法移民将能首次获得合法居留身分。
f044da100da16514c5201ca947f362dfe41e0478.translatedText: The Senate plan would require illegal immigrants to register with the federal government, pass background checks, and pay fines and back taxes in order to obtain temporary legal status. Once these obstacles are passed, illegal immigrants will be able to obtain legal residency status for the first time.

98e753e12c79badcceb8eb352dbaf43a7e8ef936.sourceText: 获得合法身分的非法移民，必须排在依法申请绿卡的外国人后面等待排期。他们也必须学英语，继续交税，上报在美国的工作历史，以申请合法永久居留。
98e753e12c79badcceb8eb352dbaf43a7e8ef936.translatedText: Illegal immigrants who have obtained legal status must wait in line behind foreigners who apply for green cards in accordance with the law. They must also learn English, continue to pay taxes, and report their U.S. work history to apply for legal permanent residence.

32f9020e5aa1f4e079ad2a56ebe27b74b5d46cc9.sourceText: 成功的通过这些关卡的移民将能拿到绿卡，使他们能在美国永久居留和工作，然后就像其他拥有绿卡的移民一样，依法申请入籍。
32f9020e5aa1f4e079ad2a56ebe27b74b5d46cc9.translatedText: Immigrants who successfully pass these checkpoints will be able to obtain a green card, allowing them to reside and work permanently in the United States, and then apply for naturalization according to law just like other immigrants with green cards.

fc8aa0c8bd4ea789309ccb114c6585176c4fca5b.sourceText: 加强确保美国边防，尤其是与墨西哥接壤的西南部边界。措施包括增加无人飞机，侦测设备，以及边界执法人员。
fc8aa0c8bd4ea789309ccb114c6585176c4fca5b.translatedText: Strengthen security of U.S. borders, especially the southwestern border with Mexico. Measures include increasing drones, surveillance equipment, and border enforcement personnel.

4d830eb142090273fd981908a8d1973a636ae4c2.sourceText: 设立出入境系统，追踪持临时签证从机场和港口进入美国的每一个人，以确定他们是否都依法离境。
4d830eb142090273fd981908a8d1973a636ae4c2.translatedText: Set up an immigration system to track everyone entering the United States from airports and ports on temporary visas to determine whether they have all left the country in accordance with the law.

5b409400681149dd66a434f93691b658db8edc5d.sourceText: 成立由西南部边界州的州长，其他官员和平民组成的委员会，负责监督确保边界安全的进展，并提出有关建议。
5b409400681149dd66a434f93691b658db8edc5d.translatedText: Establish a committee composed of governors, other officials and civilians from the southwestern border states to oversee progress in ensuring border security and make relevant recommendations.

870a6f20dd0b40972710156619efda37b9387d04.sourceText: 年轻非法移民 ：奥巴马去年夏天下令暂缓驱逐童年随同父母来到美国，并合乎一些规定条件的年轻人。
870a6f20dd0b40972710156619efda37b9387d04.translatedText: Young illegal immigrants: Obama last summer ordered a moratorium on deportations for young people who came to the United States with their parents as children and meet certain requirements.

f842ae664a537e518f23e750aa8f0e6f3fabe43e.sourceText: 根据参院的计划，这些年轻非法移民不必遵守前面描述的入籍途径，不过参院公布的大纲，并未说明他们将获得何种待遇。
f842ae664a537e518f23e750aa8f0e6f3fabe43e.translatedText: According to the Senate's plan, these young illegal immigrants do not have to follow the naturalization path described above, but the outline announced by the Senate does not specify what kind of treatment they will receive.

3013a27df48d272384a1da7cf33f01d89d00c505.sourceText: 农场工人也将根据新的农工计划，获得不同的待遇。
3013a27df48d272384a1da7cf33f01d89d00c505.translatedText: Farm workers will also receive different treatment under the new agricultural and industrial plan.

35c72542b6bf71647019251da9c4c2b5f23c4d85.sourceText: 促使明知故犯雇用非法移民的雇主负起责任，并使非法移民更难伪造身分证件以获得工作。
35c72542b6bf71647019251da9c4c2b5f23c4d85.translatedText: Hold employers who knowingly hire illegal immigrants accountable and make it harder for illegal immigrants to forge identity documents to get jobs.

7ffbd67e61f1dc384970aab62386f13a65e1c65b.sourceText: 同时，联邦政府将提供更快速有效的方法，让雇主查证新雇用的人手是否在美国合法居留。
7ffbd67e61f1dc384970aab62386f13a65e1c65b.translatedText: At the same time, the federal government will provide a faster and more effective way for employers to verify whether newly hired workers are legally residing in the United States.

e1b1c331e46c9f88a60cee75bda6e173e781e35a.sourceText: 疑气囊瑕疵 本田召修2款汽车 本田汽车公司（Honda）日前宣布召修美国74万8000辆Pilot和Odyssey，因为驾驶座安全气囊可能有瑕疵。 本田表示，这个安全气囊可能在制作时缺少某些将气囊塑胶盖板上紧的铆钉。本田说：”如果没有铆钉，安全气囊可能无法适当展开，增加驾驶在车祸中受伤的风险。”目前没有消息说，有车祸或受伤事件与这个问题有关。 这个问题影响到2009至2013年款的Pilot运动型多功能休旅车，以及2011至2013年的Odyssey厢型车。本田将检查这些车辆，必要时将更换驾驶座安全气囊。
e1b1c331e46c9f88a60cee75bda6e173e781e35a.translatedText: Honda recalls 2 cars due to suspected airbag defects Honda Motor Co. (Honda) recently announced a recall of 748,000 Pilot and Odyssey vehicles in the United States because the driver's seat airbag may be defective. Honda said the airbag may have been manufactured without some of the rivets that hold the plastic cover tightly together. Honda said: "Without the rivets, the airbag may not deploy properly, increasing the risk of injury to the driver in a crash." There is currently no news that any crashes or injuries are related to this issue. The issue affects the 2009 to 2013 Pilot SUV and the 2011 to 2013 Odyssey van. Honda will inspect these vehicles and replace the driver's airbag if necessary.

c190e24e96625d0b45235522ea578a9f63c0d627.sourceText: 2013年最精彩的大型新春歌舞表演将于2月10日隆重上演 (ASU孔子学院供稿)2013年2月10日下午4点, 本年度大型新春歌舞表演将于钱德勒艺术中心隆重举行, 逾200名优秀艺术家将登台演出。 数载春华秋实，数载薪火相传。新东方艺术学校经过了不平凡的发展历程，有着雄厚的艺术实力，鲜明的艺术风格，独特的艺术魅力。开场舞将由80多名来自东方艺术学校的舞者给观众带来激情澎湃的演出，为庆祝中国传统新年拉开序幕。本次舞台设计由新东方艺术学校独家设计，精美而豪华。整台演出融入多样化风格，既有精彩绝伦的民族歌舞，又有耳熟能详的大合唱，及气势宏大的功夫表演。 2012年的经典演出仍在1500多名观众的脑海里回荡。2013年新的精彩节目即将重磅登场。此次大型新春歌舞表演由亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院和新东方艺术学校主办。购票活动已经在如火如荼地进行着，座位有限。如果不想错过这场气势宏大的视听盛宴，请立即拨打钱德勒艺术中心购票热线480-782-2680，或拨打新东方艺术学校购票专线602-490-8613。观众还可登录TicketMaster.com进行购票。演出票价为15美元/张。
c190e24e96625d0b45235522ea578a9f63c0d627.translatedText: The most exciting large-scale New Year's song and dance performance in 2013 will be held grandly on February 10 (Contributed by ASU Confucius Institute) At 4 pm on February 10, 2013, this year's large-scale New Year's song and dance performance will be held grandly at the Chandler Art Center, with more than 200 outstanding artists performing on the stage. Several years of spring blossoms and autumn fruits, several years of firewood are passed down from generation to generation. New Oriental Art School has gone through an extraordinary development process and has strong artistic strength, distinctive artistic style and unique artistic charm. The opening dance will bring a passionate performance to the audience with more than 80 dancers from the Oriental Art School, kicking off the celebration of the traditional Chinese New Year. The stage design is exclusively designed by New Oriental Art School and is exquisite and luxurious. The entire performance incorporates diverse styles, including wonderful folk songs and dances, familiar choruses, and magnificent Kung Fu performances. The classic performance in 2012 is still echoing in the minds of more than 1,500 spectators. New exciting programs in 2013 are about to debut. This large-scale New Year song and dance performance was hosted by the Confucius Institute at Arizona State University and the New Oriental Art School. Ticket sales are already in full swing and seats are limited. If you don’t want to miss this magnificent audio-visual feast, please call the Chandler Art Center ticket hotline at 480-782-2680 or the New Oriental Art School ticket hotline at 602-490-8613. Audiences can also log on to TicketMaster.com to purchase tickets. Tickets for the performance are US$15 per ticket.

4cfebffda9f6a96203e84e42f40ba61c1714557f.sourceText: 当地时间29日，在少数族裔遍地的”罪恶之城”拉斯维加斯，美国总统奥巴马誓言加速1100万非法移民”美国梦”的实现速度。
4cfebffda9f6a96203e84e42f40ba61c1714557f.translatedText: On the 29th local time, in Las Vegas, the “Sin City” where ethnic minorities abound, U.S. President Obama vowed to speed up the realization of the “American Dream” for 11 million illegal immigrants.

2a36f3bfa682d8e787e6520301e49f555e82cbac.sourceText: 事实上，移民改革与医保改革、金融改革一道，号称奥巴马执政生涯的三大历史任务。奥巴马不出所料地将其第二任期首次国内出行”奉献”给了移民改革问题，他说，在首个任期内没能实现移民法改革是其最大的失败。
2a36f3bfa682d8e787e6520301e49f555e82cbac.translatedText: In fact, immigration reform, along with health care reform and financial reform, are known as the three major historical tasks of Obama's administration. As expected, Obama dedicated his first domestic trip of his second term to the issue of immigration reform. He said that the failure to achieve immigration law reform in his first term was his biggest failure.

8f16806a241be38445ae40d72a19ce287d42e508.sourceText: 而就在前一天的28日，美国参议院两党重要议员已经公布了一份有关移民改革的框架方案。目前看来，世界头号移民国家的移民改革已经箭在弦上。
8f16806a241be38445ae40d72a19ce287d42e508.translatedText: Just the day before, the 28th, important members of both parties in the U.S. Senate announced a framework plan for immigration reform. At present, it seems that immigration reform in the world's number one immigrant country is on the verge of completion.

2ddf543062411cfc0e27733fa0d1f93c15a50504.translatedText: How do illegal immigrants become naturalized?

faf20a6c955a378c8598f3e4c41701f7b6f8baaa.sourceText: ”是时候了。”奥巴马说，”我们不能允许移民改革在无休止的辩论中停顿。”他表示，自己对于国会耐心有限，如果国会不通过此前提出的移民改革方案，他会要求立法者就白宫更宽容的移民计划投票。
faf20a6c955a378c8598f3e4c41701f7b6f8baaa.translatedText: "It's time." Obama said, "We cannot allow immigration reform to stall in endless debates." He said that his patience with Congress is limited, and if Congress does not pass the previously proposed immigration reform package, he will ask lawmakers to vote on the White House's more permissive immigration plan.

b99b2a8919f75a04804887093dec194ffa93cfe9.sourceText: 奥巴马移民改革的目标，是在防止新的非法移民涌入的同时，为已在美国的非法移民提供入籍途径。他还提议移民政策向理工科人才和在美投资创业者倾斜。
b99b2a8919f75a04804887093dec194ffa93cfe9.translatedText: The goal of Obama's immigration reform is to prevent the influx of new illegal immigrants while providing a path to naturalization for illegal immigrants already in the United States. He also proposed that immigration policies favor science and engineering talents and entrepreneurs investing in the United States.

2d5d4bb0d48c07a79cc756d6ae9456fe5c9db7d1.sourceText: 为此奥巴马提出了四项原则：加强边境安全、严打雇用非法移民行为、为非法移民提供入籍途径和提高移民体系效率。
2d5d4bb0d48c07a79cc756d6ae9456fe5c9db7d1.translatedText: To this end, Obama proposed four principles: strengthening border security, cracking down on the employment of illegal immigrants, providing naturalization pathways for illegal immigrants, and improving the efficiency of the immigration system.

d4725cb62da5e449719fc33a31707985d4e0c2d9.sourceText: 根据他提出的改革建议，非法移民必须向政府登记、通过相关审查并缴纳罚款以取得过渡身份。取得过渡身份的非法移民必须等到现有合法移民申请全部处理完后才能开始申请永久居留权（绿卡），并最终入籍。在幼年时非法来到美国的非法移民可以通过上学或从军的办法加速这一过程。
d4725cb62da5e449719fc33a31707985d4e0c2d9.translatedText: According to his reform proposals, illegal immigrants must register with the government, pass relevant examinations and pay fines to obtain transitional status. Illegal immigrants who have obtained transitional status must wait until all existing legal immigration applications have been processed before they can begin applying for permanent residency (green cards) and, ultimately, naturalization. Illegal immigrants who came to the United States illegally as children can speed up the process by attending school or joining the military.

0f21341cf64334306e8bf1278df316ccc3d1782a.sourceText: ”我们将自己定义为移民国家。”奥巴马说，”这让我们拥有年轻的劳动力、尖端的技术，以及创造有史以来最伟大的经济引擎。”
0f21341cf64334306e8bf1278df316ccc3d1782a.translatedText: "We define ourselves as a country of immigrants." Obama said, "This allows us to have a young workforce, cutting-edge technology, and create the greatest economic engine in history."

bbdb696d4dc15b67c8386cb111b3c817affa3e7a.sourceText: 同时，在政治上，在经历了最近几次大选后，民主共和两党都充分认识到了移民力量的崛起棗拉丁裔目前已成为增长最快的选民人群。各类民调显示，在包括拉丁裔、非洲裔甚至亚裔在内的少数族群中，民主党拥有远高于共和党的支持率，这在身为少数族裔总统的奥巴马身上，体现得尤为明显。
bbdb696d4dc15b67c8386cb111b3c817affa3e7a.translatedText: At the same time, politically, after experiencing the last few elections, both the Democratic and Republican parties have fully recognized the rise of the power of immigrants - Latinos have now become the fastest-growing group of voters. Various polls show that among minority groups, including Latinos, African Americans and even Asians, the Democratic Party has a much higher support rate than the Republican Party. This is particularly obvious for Obama, who is a minority president.

f0b87b89a4de6bac91300e448f663a74f622f6a4.sourceText: 奥巴马的计划，大致与此前由民主党参议员舒默和共和党参议员麦凯恩领导的两党参议院小组推出的移民改革框架方案一致。该方案提出将允许大部分非法移民在政府部门登记、通过背景审查，并缴清罚款以及任何拖欠的税款后，有资格进入合法身份考察期。而有犯罪记录或对美国构成威胁的人将被驱逐。 共和党人挣扎前行
f0b87b89a4de6bac91300e448f663a74f622f6a4.translatedText: Obama's plan is roughly consistent with the immigration reform framework previously introduced by a bipartisan Senate group led by Democratic Senator Schumer and Republican Senator John McCain. The plan proposes that most illegal immigrants will be eligible to enter the legal status review period after registering with government departments, passing background checks, and paying fines and any outstanding taxes. Those with criminal records or who pose a threat to the United States will be deported. Republicans struggle to move forward

01932ebce902da27cdccff9d78a0885db965367d.sourceText: 跟以往一样，奥巴马政治抱负的实现，障碍仍在国会之中，直到他发表讲话时，也仍是如此。
01932ebce902da27cdccff9d78a0885db965367d.translatedText: As always, obstacles to the realization of Obama's political ambitions remained in Congress, and they remained so until he delivered his speech.

501ed6feeba99941fe546a0a783343b9bb08aa57.sourceText: 事实上，在保守派共和党人中，一直充斥着对于过分放松移民限制的担忧。其中最具争议的问题之一，是非法移民是否必须等待，直到美国和墨西哥边境安全以及其他强制措施都到位后，才能获得绿卡。
501ed6feeba99941fe546a0a783343b9bb08aa57.translatedText: In fact, among conservative Republicans, there have been concerns about excessive relaxation of immigration restrictions. One of the most contentious issues is whether illegal immigrants must wait until U.S.-Mexico border security and other enforcement measures are in place to obtain green cards.

99f6f7211e4733e80151191b3233a12acbc3cfb4.sourceText: ”从一开始就必须明确有通往公民身份的正确道路。”奥巴马29日说，政府已经大幅推动具体措施的实施。而一些关键的共和党议员则认为，任何没有和边境安全挂钩的移民提案，都会滋生更为严重的非法移民问题。
99f6f7211e4733e80151191b3233a12acbc3cfb4.translatedText: "It must be clear from the beginning that there is a correct path to citizenship." Obama said on the 29th that the government has significantly promoted the implementation of specific measures. Some key Republican lawmakers believe that any immigration proposal that is not linked to border security will breed a more serious illegal immigration problem.

51ce5e95aea486624a1c963cbfeca97cb1af2907.sourceText: 被视为可能是2016年总统大选候选人的共和党参议员马科?#21346;比奥说：”没有这些，我们将回到几年前处理数百万没有出生证明的新生儿时的境况。”
51ce5e95aea486624a1c963cbfeca97cb1af2907.translatedText: Republican Senator Marco Bio, considered a possible candidate in the 2016 presidential election, said: "Without these, we will be back to the situation we were in a few years ago when dealing with millions of newborns without birth certificates."

12906be9e362afd55b4a25af28774417cf7ee6ed.sourceText: 另外，在众议院，很多共和党人对任何可能对非法移民过于慷慨的立法都持强烈的怀疑态度。”对于如何最好地稳固我们破碎的移民体系有很多想法。”众议院议长博纳的发言人布兰丹巴克说，”我们希望总统小心不要拖动辩论向左，最终瓦解参众两院艰难的工作。”
12906be9e362afd55b4a25af28774417cf7ee6ed.translatedText: In addition, many Republicans in the House of Representatives are strongly skeptical of any legislation that may be too generous to illegal immigrants. "There are many ideas about how best to stabilize our broken immigration system," said Brendan Barker, spokesman for House Speaker John Boehner. "We hope the president will be careful not to drag the debate to the left and ultimately unravel the difficult work of the House and Senate."

25b6c386730d3f51485c8bd4d7373b84a8d29aeb.sourceText: 就在一年前的共和党总统候选人党内初选中，移民话题其实就占据了很大篇幅，而自去年11月奥巴马赢得大选后，很多共和党人已经认识到移民问题的严重性。
25b6c386730d3f51485c8bd4d7373b84a8d29aeb.translatedText: Just a year ago, during the Republican presidential primaries, the topic of immigration occupied a large space. Since Obama won the election in November last year, many Republicans have realized the seriousness of the immigration issue.

0f0758583e2ff87d9ca0943d98b8f73ab526ac18.sourceText: 在去年的竞选活动中，奥巴马曾在全美拉丁裔官员集会上说，若自己赢得大选，将会推动综合性的移民改革。他当时就强调只要达到特定条件，将允许大概80万幼年赴美的非法移民留在美国。最终，奥巴马赢得了超过70%的拉丁裔和亚裔美国人的支持。
0f0758583e2ff87d9ca0943d98b8f73ab526ac18.translatedText: During last year's election campaign, Obama said at a rally of Latino officials across the country that if he won the election, he would promote comprehensive immigration reform. He emphasized at that time that as long as certain conditions were met, about 800,000 illegal immigrants who came to the United States as children would be allowed to stay in the United States. In the end, Obama won the support of more than 70% of Latinos and Asian Americans.

28cbafd06c7b34ae9ee0e5269ee434eb4411c73a.sourceText: “北京情思 相约凤凰城”门票正在热销中–2月15日隆重登场 〔亚省华联供稿〕”北京情思~相约凤凰城”2013迎新春综艺联欢会将于2013年2月15日晚7点整在 Mesa Arts Center 举行。联欢会由北京市侨联和 亚省华联 共同主办，并由ASU孔子学院，大凤凰城华人侨团联合总会，希望中文学校，现代中文学校，新东方艺术学校，”太阳鸟”亚省华人网，以及美中文化艺术交流协会联合赞助和协办。 本次赴美国、加拿大慰问演出的艺术团成员由来自中国广播艺术团、中国东方歌舞团、中国铁路文工团和北京风雷京剧团的艺术家们组成。艺术团成员有国家一级演员，多次在国家级比赛中获第一名，代表中国艺术团多次出国访问演出，深受海内外观众的欢迎。有从中央电视台星光大道走出来的蒙古族呼麦表演艺术家。有国家一级魔术师，曾先后出访美国、加拿大、日本、坦桑尼亚、赞比亚、南非、刚果、苏丹、斯里兰卡等20多个国家和地区。有获得第三届全国舞蹈大赛最佳表演奖的中国东方歌舞团青年舞蹈艺术家。有获得国际舞蹈大赛金奖的中国铁路文工团舞蹈演员。有著名口技表演艺术家和著名京剧表演艺术家。演出节目包括歌曲演唱、舞蹈、口技、呼麦、书法绘画、魔术、京剧等丰富多彩的艺术形式。艺术团阵容强，规格高，无疑将为当地华侨华人带来精彩纷呈的文化艺术盛宴，增添节日的欢乐与喜庆。 设备一流的 Mesa Arts Center 座落于 Mesa 市中心，地址是：1 East Main Street，Mesa，AZ 85201。目前，门票正在热销中。普通赞助: $10，VIP赞助: $20。购票地点: 希望中文学校, 现代中文学校, 新东方艺术学校 602-490-8613, 台湾美食 480-668-9888。查询更多售票途径 www.chineseaz.org 或电邮: jian6351@yahoo.com, shichengt@hotmail.com ， sunbirdarizona@gmail.com 。 附：演员阵容及演出曲目 中国北京市归国华侨联合会 北京情思 迎 新 春 综 艺 联 欢 会 节目目主持： 中国铁路文工团国家一级演员 纪 丽 一、男声独唱：《举杯吧 朋友》《母亲》《缆车》 中国东方歌舞团青年歌唱家 徐 杰 二、双人舞蹈：《荷塘月色》 中国东方歌舞团青年舞蹈家 曾 明 中国铁路文工团青年舞蹈家 张 乐 三、呼麦表演：《满都拉克汗赞》《天堂》 中国铁路文工团民族乐器演奏家 包连锁 四、京韵魔术：《五彩缤纷》 中国铁路文工团一级魔术师 刘玉华 五、女声独唱：《前门情思大碗茶》《打虎上山》《互动歌曲》 中国铁路文工团国家一级演员 纪 丽 六、中国元素：《舞墨情浓》书法+绘画+民族舞蹈 北京奥运会”北京欢迎你”书法作者 郭宝庆 北京青年画家 田 添 中国铁路文工团 张 乐 七、京剧表演：《猴王借扇》 北京风雷京剧团团长 松 岩 郝 莹 八、口 技：《盛世欢声》 中国铁路文工团口技表演家 付学铭 翟 军 九、女声独唱：《我爱你 中国》《西班牙女郎》《长江之歌》 中国广播艺术团国家一级演员 牛秀兰 十、男女声二重唱：《祖国，我为您干杯》 中国东方歌舞团、中国广播艺术团 徐 杰 牛秀兰 十一、谢 幕 曲：《北京欢迎你》 全体演员 （注：准备男子独舞《风吟》）

a4db645704b98ea44dc4fde979936006c67dc7df.translatedText: Jinxin Real Estate News: U.S. Builder Confidence Index reaches 7-year high. U.S. Home Builder Confidence Index reached 7-year high from December last year, and now...

813bf620c1a65320ad8bfb5048f0a64051319282.sourceText: 美国住宅建筑商信心指数从去年12月达到7年来的最高点，现在依然保持不变，但是在未来半年，他们对销售业绩仍然持谨慎态度。 全国房屋协会建筑商富国银行表示建筑商景气指数为47，保持稳定，这是2006年4月以来的最高水平。该指数等于50表明市场持中立态度，小于50为负面，高于50为正面，该指数上一次在这个级别是2006年4月，当时为51. 2011年10月到达最低位17，后来一路走高。 通过十二月份对潜在客户测量，数量应该会上升。 更多有关房地产的信息请咨询金信地产的Tinna(480)287-0180 E-mail:Goldtrustrealty2010@gmail.com
813bf620c1a65320ad8bfb5048f0a64051319282.translatedText: U.S. Home Builder Confidence Index reached 7-year high from December last year and remains unchanged, but in the next six months, they are still cautious about sales performance. National Housing Association builder Wells Fargo said its builder sentiment index remained stable at 47, the highest level since April 2006. An index equal to 50 indicates a neutral stance on the market, less than 50 is negative, and above 50 is positive. The last time the index was at this level was in April 2006, when it was 51. It reached a low of 17 in October 2011 and has since moved higher. By measuring leads in December, numbers should be up. For more information about real estate, please contact Tinna of Goldtrust Realty (480) 287-0180 E-mail: Goldtrustrealty2010@gmail.com

6173af3b09ac25b195b6241bebf3979d61868de0.sourceText: 旗杆埠2012年房屋销售量上升15% 据《亚利桑那每天太阳报》消息，旗杆埠地区2012年单幢住宅销售量，比2011年上升了15%。 旗杆埠在2012年出售886幢单户住宅，这个数字是过去6年最多的一年。 同时，2012年的房屋平均价格下跌了4%，但每平方尺的价格与去年基本持平。 房地产经纪人斯蒂芬布莱顿说，2012年下半年，市场呈现出稳健的增长。布莱顿说，四季度，尤其是十二月，房屋销售的数量，平均价格和每平方英尺价格都在上升。
6173af3b09ac25b195b6241bebf3979d61868de0.translatedText: Home sales in Flagstaff Port increased by 15% in 2012. According to the Arizona Daily Sun, single-family home sales in the Flagstaff area in 2012 increased by 15% compared with 2011. Flagstaff sold 886 single-family homes in 2012, the highest number in the past six years. Meanwhile, the average price of a home fell 4% in 2012, but the price per square foot remained essentially the same as last year. Estate agent Stephen Brydon said the market showed solid growth in the second half of 2012. Brighton said the number of home sales, average price and price per square foot were all up in the fourth quarter, especially in December.

682ea0115e4996410753bcabc0b58f6a1c2bd94a.sourceText: 在买卖房屋的过程中，我们会听到或看到一些和房地产相关的用语，您对这些词汇、用语了解多少呢? 请参考以下问与答，或许能对您的房产交易有所帮助。
682ea0115e4996410753bcabc0b58f6a1c2bd94a.translatedText: In the process of buying and selling houses, we will hear or see some terms related to real estate. How much do you know about these words and terms? Please refer to the following questions and answers, which may be helpful to your real estate transactions.

3bdfb89110245e7f7bec790a27e7f24d6a01f40b.sourceText: 问: 什么是SPDS? 答: SPDS是Seller’s Property Disclosure Statement的简称，在亚利桑那的制式化购屋合约中，预先记载了此文件必需在购屋合约成立后的5天内由卖方提供，其中记载了像是: 正确地址、目前的屋主、HOA名称、费用以及房屋状况、已知问题等等的资料。
3bdfb89110245e7f7bec790a27e7f24d6a01f40b.translatedText: Question: What is SPDS? Answer: SPDS is the abbreviation of Seller’s Property Disclosure Statement. In Arizona’s standardized house purchase contract, it is pre-recorded that this document must be provided by the seller within 5 days after the house purchase contract is established. It records information such as: correct address, current owner, HOA name, fees, house condition, known problems, etc.

3008af1b63d60fd69e204cd0dd1d58ee8970dcc4.sourceText: 问: 什么是COE (交屋日)? 答: COE是Close of Escrow的简称，是房产交易的最后一个步骤，依照买卖双方同意的条件，在交屋日由Escrow Company处理交、付款，登记产权的程序。 问: 什么是Appraisal (估价)? 答: Appraisal是由领有执照的专业估价师，在某一特定日期、对某一指定的房地产标的所做出的评估市价报告。
3008af1b63d60fd69e204cd0dd1d58ee8970dcc4.translatedText: Question: What is COE (Closed of Escrow)? Answer: COE is the abbreviation of Close of Escrow, which is the last step in the real estate transaction. According to the conditions agreed by the buyer and the seller, the Escrow Company handles the handover, payment, and registration of property rights on the handover date. Q: What is an Appraisal? A: An Appraisal is a market value report on a specified real estate subject made by a licensed professional appraiser on a specific date.

f6441679f4046959fe7bcaf1b4b8ddc68d488a70.sourceText: 问: 什么是Home Inspection? 答: Home Inspection(房屋检查)可以让购屋者对屋况有一个详细和整体性的了解，一位合格的专业房屋检查员可以为您提供深入、公正的房屋检查报告，报告上应该要记载关于房屋结构的状况，列出什么东西需要修理或更换，并对一些主要设备，诸如冷气机、暖炉、热水炉等设备的状况做出一个评估。在亚利桑那的制式化购屋合约中，已预先列出买屋者在购屋合约成立后的10天内有权利做专业房屋检查，并依据检查结果要求售屋者改善，或做出是否购买的决定，所以Home Inspection是对购屋者的一个保障。
f6441679f4046959fe7bcaf1b4b8ddc68d488a70.translatedText: Question: What is Home Inspection? Answer: Home Inspection allows home buyers to have a detailed and comprehensive understanding of the condition of the house. A qualified professional home inspector can provide you with an in-depth and impartial home inspection report. The report should record the condition of the house structure, list what needs to be repaired or replaced, and make an assessment of the condition of some major equipment, such as air conditioners, heaters, water heaters, etc. In Arizona's standardized home purchase contract, it is stated in advance that the home buyer has the right to have a professional home inspection within 10 days after the home purchase contract is established, and based on the inspection results, the home seller will be required to make improvements or make a decision on whether to purchase. Therefore, Home Inspection is a guarantee for home buyers.

7de2f5db46cf3e272aa500ac6a892616f57a4954.sourceText: 沃尔玛11日起即在零售店和网站同时推出iPhone 4或iPhone 5预付手机服务Straight Talk，提供用户无需合同的无限数据流量、无限简讯和无限通话包月服务。但如大多数预付业务，购买手机没有任何补贴，必须付全价。苹果公司的 iPhone4/8GB零售价为449美元， iPhone5/16GB售价649美元。Straight Talk是由TracFone无线公司运营。
7de2f5db46cf3e272aa500ac6a892616f57a4954.translatedText: Walmart will launch Straight Talk, a prepaid mobile phone service for iPhone 4 or iPhone 5, in both retail stores and on its website starting from the 11th, providing users with unlimited data traffic, unlimited text messages and unlimited calls monthly services without a contract. But like most prepaid services, there is no subsidy for purchasing a mobile phone, and you must pay the full price. Apple's iPhone 4/8GB retails for $449, and iPhone 5/16GB retails for $649. Straight Talk is operated by TracFone Wireless.

8a3dec057172afd6d876384d735d2b9fe99b38ba.sourceText: 不过，引人注目的是每月费率：只需花45美元，即可有无限数据、无限简讯、无限通话服务。若要加上国际长途无限通话，则每月费率60每元，可打往墨西哥、加拿大、印度等国家，超过1000个地区。而AT＆T的服务，仅是无线通话，即需每月索费69.99美元。
8a3dec057172afd6d876384d735d2b9fe99b38ba.translatedText: However, what is eye-catching is the monthly rate: for only $45, you can have unlimited data, unlimited text messages, and unlimited calling services. If you add unlimited international long-distance calls, the monthly rate is 60 yuan per month, and you can make calls to more than 1,000 countries such as Mexico, Canada, and India. AT&T's service costs $69.99 per month for wireless calling only.

a2faf8800470457fd1fb3f8798cb3cdbb619018f.sourceText: 这计划还有一项吸引人之处。一般情况下，预付计划大多提供库存的旧手机。例如，Virgin Mobile刚刚采用三星的Galaxy S II。而此计划，沃尔玛将提供仅上市4个月的iPhone5，不须签任何合同。这可能会使Verizon和AT＆T等运营商大受伤害。
a2faf8800470457fd1fb3f8798cb3cdbb619018f.translatedText: There is another attraction to this plan. Generally, prepaid plans mostly offer old phones in stock. For example, Virgin Mobile just adopted Samsung's Galaxy S II. Under this plan, Wal-Mart will provide the iPhone 5, which will only be on the market for 4 months, without signing any contract. That could hurt carriers like Verizon and AT&T big time.

f3c666289f757876aeefcdc67c4c0b484cb7f19f.sourceText: 以AT＆T为例，拥有一支iPhone5手机，并签2年合同，无限通话、无限简讯、5GB的数据计划，将耗资用户大约 3550美元。Straight Talk的计划，拥有2年的成本只需1729美元，这包括全价的iPhone 5。
f3c666289f757876aeefcdc67c4c0b484cb7f19f.translatedText: Taking AT&T as an example, owning an iPhone 5 and signing a 2-year contract with unlimited calls, unlimited text messages, and a 5GB data plan will cost the user approximately US$3,550. Straight Talk's plan costs just $1,729 to own for two years, and that includes the full price of the iPhone 5.

e077067d4737888db6ebad291aeb49680d973f61.sourceText: Facebook网站立新规交100美元给名人发信息 自2012年12月，美国最大社交网站Facebook（脸书）进行了一项新的收费实验，给”脸书”创始人马克 扎克伯格或和他同一等级的名人发一条站内信息将需缴纳100美元的费用。 有分析认为”脸书”这一做法是向10亿名用户发起的又一次”要钱”攻势。 ”脸书”负责人则回应称这个方法是想试试”以经济信号来定义信息的重要性”。 负责人还表示，对于那些收取付费信息的VIP用户来说，这项功能自动为他们过滤了垃圾信息。如果他们收到陌生信息的话，说明有个陌生人真的有很重要的事要找他们。
e077067d4737888db6ebad291aeb49680d973f61.translatedText: >The Facebook website has set a new rule for paying US$100 to send messages to celebrities. Since December 2012, Facebook, the largest social networking site in the United States, has conducted a new charging experiment. Send an on-site message to Facebook founder Mark Zuckerberg or a celebrity of his level will be charged $100. Some analysts believe that Facebook’s approach is another “money” attack from its 1 billion users. The person in charge of Facebook responded that this method is to try to “define the importance of information based on economic signals.” The person in charge also said that for VIP users who receive paid information, this function automatically filters spam messages for them. If they receive unfamiliar messages, it means that a stranger really wants to find something important for them.

2a07d5bcd43c46b7f71d9bcd25bed7a8e5cf215e.sourceText: 美国10个经济复苏最快的地方 《亚省时报》 自美国经历大簫条以来，已经步入第五年，虽然经济衰退在2009年6月正式结束，但是，美国的经济复甦仍然有很长的路要走，至少失业率仍远高于经济衰退前的水平。 2007年11月，在经济衰退前的一个月，全美估计有730万人失业，当时全美的失业率为4.7%2009年10月，全美的失业率为10%，大约有1,500万名失业大军。截至2012年11月，全国失业率为7.7%，仍然有1,130万人失业。 《24/7华尔街》回顾近几年美国50个州的失业率，考虑到经济衰退之前，高峰期或目前的失业状况。虽然失业人数的变化可以反映经济增长或停滞的情况，但是，失业率也可以是误导性。考虑到这一点，过去五年来，分析各州经济复甦的情况时，也要考虑其他因素。 有些州已经慢慢恢复回来，增加数百个新的就业机会，减少失业人数。有几个州却还没有恢复，经济状况相比其他地区更为恶劣。有些州几乎没有任何进展，失业率接近经济衰退的高峰期。 部分州在经济衰退期间，当地失去大量的就业机会，住房市场严重下降。目前失业率已显著改善，但仍远高于全国的比例。 亚利桑那州以2011年国民生产总值增长1.5%排名第十。据劳工统计局每月的失业率数据，本州目前失业率为8.1%，高峰期失业率为10.8%，相比高峰期失业率下降了2.7%。 榜上有名的其他9个州分别为：密歇根州，俄亥俄州，南卡州，犹他州，俄勒冈州，佛罗里达州，印第安纳州，田纳西州，和密苏里州。
2a07d5bcd43c46b7f71d9bcd25bed7a8e5cf215e.translatedText: The 10 places with the fastest economic recovery in the United States "Alberta Times" It has entered the fifth year since the Great Depression in the United States. Although the economic recession officially ended in June 2009, the United States' economic recovery still has a long way to go. At least the unemployment rate is still much higher than the pre-recession level. In November 2007, a month before the recession, an estimated 7.3 million people were unemployed in the United States, when the national unemployment rate was 4.7%. In October 2009, the national unemployment rate was 10%, with about 15 million unemployed people. As of November 2012, the national unemployment rate was 7.7%, with 11.3 million people still unemployed. "24/7 Wall Street" looks back at the unemployment rate in the 50 U.S. states in recent years, taking into account unemployment conditions before the recession, at its peak, or now. While changes in the number of unemployed people can reflect economic growth or stagnation, the unemployment rate can also be misleading. With that in mind, there are other factors to consider when analyzing state economic recoveries over the past five years. Some states have slowly bounced back, adding hundreds of new jobs and reducing unemployment. Several states have not yet recovered, and their economic conditions are worse than in other regions. There has been little progress in some states, with unemployment rates approaching the peak of the recession. During the economic recession in some states, a large number of local jobs were lost and the housing market declined severely. The unemployment rate has improved significantly but is still much higher than the national rate. Arizona ranked tenth with a 2011 GDP growth of 1.5%. According to the monthly unemployment rate data from the Bureau of Labor Statistics, the state's current unemployment rate is 8.1%. The peak unemployment rate was 10.8%, which is a 2.7% decrease from the peak unemployment rate. The other nine states on the list are: Michigan, Ohio, South Carolina, Utah, Oregon, Florida, Indiana, Tennessee, and Missouri.

5d78a0949f5fc45cd0e200abe72bf63b328d3ba7.translatedText: >What is MLS? What happened to the loan amount? "Alberta Times" Real Estate Mailbox: Q: I often see a set of seven-digit MLS numbers in many house sales advertisements...

05446d26205b2d3b236fb9b09865a401d3865b0a.sourceText: 房地产信箱： 问: 我常常看到很多售屋广告中都有一组七位数的MLS编号，请问它是做什么用的? 答: MLS代表了Multiple Listing Service，凡是由房地产经纪人代为销售并放上此MLS系统的待售屋，都会有这样的一组编号以方便管理，若您看上喜欢的房子并知道它的MLS 编号，只要将这一组号码告知您的房产经纪人，他们就能把该房屋的详细资讯提供给您。
05446d26205b2d3b236fb9b09865a401d3865b0a.translatedText: Real Estate Mailbox: Q: I often see a set of seven-digit MLS numbers in many house sales advertisements. What is it used for? Answer: MLS stands for Multiple Listing Service, any house for sale sold by a real estate agent and put on this MLS system will have such a set of numbers for easy management. If you like a house and know its MLS number, you only need to inform your real estate agent of this set of numbers, and they will be able to provide you with detailed information about the house.

f86262a8994a18561c47fba991ac5f64180e3ad8.sourceText: 问: 我去年向银行贷款买了一户房子，当初申请的贷款方案是30年固定利率的贷款方案，照理说每个月该付的贷款金额应该是一样的，为什么今年开始我的应缴金额 变不一样了? 答: 大部分人每个月缴交的房屋贷款都包含了: 本金、利息、代收房地产税和代收保险费，银行把代收房地产税和代收保险费放到Escrow帐户中(Impound Account)，银行会用这个帐户里的钱来帮您缴交房地产税和保险费。 您的贷款是30年固定利率方案，摊还本金和利息当然不会变动，至于税金和保险费就不是每年固定的了，尤其房地产税几乎是年年变动，银行都会先计算好每个月 要代收多少钱到这个Escrow帐户，计算方法是将每年一次的保费加上一年的预估房地产税，再把它除以十二，预计每个月代收到这个Escrow里的金额， 如果这个Escrow帐户里的钱不够，银行下个年度就会提高每个月的预收金额，这样才会有足够的钱帮您缴税和付保费，而当年度结束时，该帐户有多余、 超过规定的金额，银行也会寄一张支票退款给您。 若是对此代收帐户有任何问题，可以主动向贷款银行查询。
f86262a8994a18561c47fba991ac5f64180e3ad8.translatedText: Question: I bought a house with a bank loan last year. The loan plan I applied for was a 30-year fixed-rate loan plan. Logically speaking, the loan amount I should pay every month should be the same. Why is my payable amount different starting this year? Answer: Most people’s monthly home loan payments include: Principal, interest, real estate tax collection and insurance premium collection. The bank puts the real estate tax collection and insurance premium collection into the Escrow account (Impound Account), and the bank will use the money in this account to help you pay the real estate tax and insurance premiums. Your loan is a 30-year fixed interest rate plan. Of course, the amortized principal and interest will not change. As for taxes and insurance premiums, they are not fixed every year. In particular, real estate taxes change almost every year. The bank will first calculate how much money it will collect every month into the Escrow account. The calculation method is to add the annual premium plus the estimated real estate tax for one year, and then divide it by twelve. The amount in the Escrow is expected to be received every month. If there is not enough money in this Escrow account, the bank will increase the monthly advance payment amount next year, so that there will be enough money to help you pay taxes and premiums. At the end of the year, if the account has excess and exceeds the specified amount, the bank will also send you a check to refund you. If you have any questions about this collection account, you can take the initiative to inquire with the lending bank.

7dfd65ee8117b30b6b762f35c682ea9fe4cd1175.sourceText: 现金为王 100美元纸钞成投资新宠 《亚省时报》 去年美国 100 美元纸钞印量突然大幅度上扬，让 ConvergEx Group 的首席设略师 Nick Colas 嗅出了些许不对劲，决定一探究竟。 100 美元人气强强滚，相对的，面额较小的1、5、10、20 美元，在过去 10 年用量逐渐下滑，与此同时，与纸钞无关的消费行为(比方说信用卡)，数量也逐渐攀升。 事实上，截至 10 月为止的财年中，美国铸币印钞局共发出 30 亿张的 100美 元纸钞。 ”这是破纪录的印量，且超出 1 美元纸钞的 20 亿张达 50%。”他说。 虽然这可能与贿络、贩毒、走私活动的猖獗有关，但这可能代表了另一件事，那就是人们对政府及经济都不再信任，使得 100 美元纸钞受宠，与黄金一样备受宠爱。尤有甚之，许多美元是在海外被持有－毕竟它使用容易，又易于保存。 ”在税率越来越高的环境下，现金是最好的储存财富方式。”他说。买黄金是储蓄的好方法，”但如果要买吃的 100美元真的无可匹敌。” 有趣的是，100 美元纸钞的需求暴增，与防伪钞功能翻新有着密不可分的关系。虽然这种新钞尚未发行，但人们依旧趋之若鹜，需求提前引爆。 同时间，美国国债的获利少的可怜，也让人们觉得直接拥有现金比较实在。这当中仍有一些亮点；美元受人喜爱，代表全球仍对它充满信心。
7dfd65ee8117b30b6b762f35c682ea9fe4cd1175.translatedText: Cash is king, and $100 bills have become the new investment favorite. "Alberta Times" Last year, the printing of $100 bills in the United States suddenly increased significantly. Nick Colas, chief strategist of ConvergEx Group, smelled something wrong and decided to find out. The popularity of 100 US dollars is strong. In contrast, the use of smaller denominations of 1, 5, 10, and 20 US dollars has gradually declined in the past 10 years. At the same time, the number of consumption behaviors that have nothing to do with banknotes (such as credit cards) has also gradually increased. In fact, the U.S. Mint and Printing Office issued a total of 3 billion $100 bills in the fiscal year that ended in October. "This is a record-breaking print run and exceeds the 2 billion dollar bills by 50%," he said. While this may be related to rampant bribery, drug trafficking, and smuggling, it may represent another thing, which is that people no longer trust the government and the economy, making the $100 bill as favored as gold. What's more, many dollars are held overseas - after all, they are easy to use and easy to keep. "In an environment where tax rates are getting higher and higher, cash is the best way to store wealth." He said. "Buying gold is a good way to save," but if you want to buy food, $100 is really unbeatable. "Interestingly, the surge in demand for $100 banknotes is inseparable from the renovation of anti-counterfeiting features. Although this new banknote has not yet been issued, people are still flocking to it, and the demand is detonated in advance. At the same time, the profits from U.S. Treasury bonds are pitiful, which also makes people feel that it is more practical to own cash directly. There are still some bright spots; the dollar's popularity means the world still has confidence in it.

dd130bf98313c322f871783665e8d12c97462897.sourceText: 亚太社区促进会执行会长Doug Hirano 先生最近获得Virginia G. Piper Charitable Trust奖学金。Hirano 先生是玛瑞科帕郡内获得此项殊荣的五位非营利性机构领导人士之一。此奖学金让得奖的非营利性机构领导人得以暂时离开工作冈位，参与自订专业发展计划来加强技能并探索新的知识领域，以便将来可用於他们服务的机构。
dd130bf98313c322f871783665e8d12c97462897.translatedText: Mr. Doug Hirano, the Executive President of the Asia-Pacific Association for Community Promotion, recently received the Virginia G. Piper Charitable Trust Scholarship. Mr. Hirano is one of five nonprofit leaders in Maricopa County to receive this honor. This scholarship allows winning nonprofit leaders to take a break from their jobs and participate in a customized professional development program to strengthen skills and explore new areas of knowledge that can be applied to the organizations they serve.

eaf9fe0914aa4e8d8065cc429c0a9e4d9614c622.sourceText: ”我狠荣幸获选得此奖学金，”亚太社区促进会会长Hirano 先生说：”在小型的非营利性机构工作有时相当具有挑战性，此奖学金提供一极佳机会来探索亚太社区促进会未来的新方向。”Hirano 先生用此奖学金将前往柬埔寨三週当一名健康教育志工，另参加史坦福大学的领导学院短期课程并拜访美国其他地方表现突出的亚裔美籍人士健康机构。
eaf9fe0914aa4e8d8065cc429c0a9e4d9614c622.translatedText: "I am honored to be selected for this scholarship," said Mr. Hirano, President of the Asia Pacific Community Initiative. "Working in a small non-profit organization can sometimes be quite challenging, and this scholarship provides an excellent opportunity to explore new directions for the future of the Asia Pacific Community Initiative." Mr. Hirano will use the scholarship to travel to Cambodia for three weeks as a health education volunteer, participate in Stanford University's Leadership Academy short course, and visit outstanding Asian American health organizations elsewhere in the United States.

368c18d461f1fbe7b41c6ad3fefab0de723755d9.sourceText: Virginia G. Piper Charitable Trust 的执行总裁Judy Jolley Mohraz 女士指出：”Piper 奖学金提供的时间与资源可能带给捉襟见肘但经验丰富、充满活力的领导人士多层面的转变。Piper Trust看到了此项在人力潜能上的投资是重新注入领导人士活力并激发新思想理念的一种宝贵方式。”
368c18d461f1fbe7b41c6ad3fefab0de723755d9.translatedText: > Judy Jolley Mohraz, executive director of the Virginia G. Piper Charitable Trust, said: "The time and resources provided by the Piper Scholarship can bring about multi-faceted transformation for experienced and dynamic leaders who are stretched thin. The Piper Trust sees this investment in human potential as a valuable way to re-energize leaders and inspire new ideas."

9048b5f5d72fa837f1aa51c33581c9e5da97ddc7.sourceText: 医院挂条幅贺住院病人破4万暴露医德缺失 广州 杨绮薇 广东省吴川市人民医院住院病人总数突破4万，医院在住院部大楼挂出大红条幅庆贺，此举引发患者和家属的极大不满，继而，网上热议铺天盖地，一致鞭挞医院方的冷漠、无医德和管理智慧缺失。 众所周知，住院病人超过4万人次与银行存款超过4万亿有着本质上的不同，后者是储户与银行的双赢，而前者只是医院的”独胜”。医院内部悄悄开”庆功会”也就算了，但竟然公开挂条幅庆贺，这就极大地刺激了患者和家属，试想，我生病住院了，这本身就是一件不好、不幸甚至是倒霉的事情，有什么值得你庆贺的？ 依我看，”贺病条幅”暴露出来的严重问题是，医改的失败和公立医院先进商业化的歧途。长期以来，我国医疗机构公益性与营利性不分，这也暴露了医改不力。公立医院的公益性缺位，导致弊病丛生，像无钱不手术，没钱刚做完缝合手术又拆钱一样，这是医院不顾病人感受，”掉进钱眼里”的表现，是医院人性化服务与管理智慧缺憾的表现。目前，在医疗卫生领域占据主导地位的医疗机构绝大多数都是公立医院，但由于财政投入补偿机制不到位等原因，在经营上，公立医院见利忘义、一味追逐利润，趋利性十分突出。统计显示，95%以上的公立医院正按照营利性的商业模式在运营。我国医药卫生体制改革方案强调要坚持公立医院的公益性质，然而，现状却呈现相反趋势。 医院挂出”贺病条幅”，其喜悦之情溢于言表，其追求利益最大化的嘴脸暴露无遗，不难想象，因为住院看病的人多了，医院的收入也多了，赚得盆满钵满的，当然高兴啦，当然要庆贺啦。但是，你有没有顾及到病人及其家属的感受呢？对病人及其家属有没有同情心？你是不是盼着人们生病住院，越多越好，能把医院的门槛踩破了才好呢？须知医院是救死扶伤的地方，可以在收治病人的时候收取费用，取得利润，但不能以利为唯一的目标，而忘了医者本应有的”父母心”和”悬壶济世”的仁者态度。如此得意忘形地为住院病人总数突破4万拉上大红条幅庆贺，让患者和家属情何以堪？让公众情何以堪？这是对”白衣天使”的一种亵渎，太缺德，没人味。 在当下的医疗体制下，一些公立医院为私利而颠倒了医患关系，他们更关心的是营利数字，赚钱成了医院上下论英雄的硬指标，治病当成赚钱的营生来做，医患关系成了冷冰冰的金钱关系。虽然，医院也要讲成本核算，要营利，要避免亏损，这都无可厚非。然而，医院更是救死扶伤、履行人道主义义务的地方，具有较强的公益性，相比于赚钱，体现公益性是更重要的。医院须摆正营利与公益、医德之间的关系，考虑到自己在公众心目中的形象，不能唯利是图而沦落，不能忘记了自己的神圣使命，背离了医疗公益的本质及其要求。按道理来说，医疗机构的功能并非只是诊治病人，它还负有一定地域内人民群众的疾病预防与控制的责任。也就是说，从宏观与长远的角度来看，住院病人增多，只能从侧面证明了区域内人民群众健康状况的不堪与忧患，这显然不是值得庆贺的事情。 因此，医院挂条幅庆贺住院病人突破4万，就与”祝贺你病了”、”祝贺你住院了”、”祝贺你花钱治病”等没有什么本质区别，所透出的是寒彻人心的冷漠甚至是冷血，所暴露出的是中国公立医院的逐利冲动和公益性缺位。突然想起清代名医程道州的一副很经典的对联：但愿人皆健；何妨我独贫。对现在的公立医院来说，即使没有如此悲天悯人、妙手仁心的普世情怀和医德，也不应该因住院病人创新高而”热烈祝贺”，但凡宅心仁厚的医者，怎能这样在医患伤口上撒盐、插刀呢？ 即使房产开发商非常期盼房价上涨，也不敢公开叫嚣”涨吧涨吧”；即使棺材商恨希望发财，也不敢公开表白”多死几个吧”；即使军火商巴不得战火连天，也不敢公开宣称”好盼望打仗”…..如果这样，即便法律奈何不了这种行为，公众的口水也会把他们淹没的。因此，吴川市人民医院高挂条幅庆贺住院病人创新高，就犯了大忌。因为在那兴高采烈的声音背后，是刺耳的潜台词：多生病多生病！此举当然会让患者、家属和公众深恶痛绝，这也是当下中国民众对医疗公益性回归的强烈诉求，佷值得医院好好反思。 如今，吴川市人民医院已经将”贺病条幅”撤下，并承认了错误。但蕴含其中的逐利思维会不会真正有所松动，仍不容乐观。
9048b5f5d72fa837f1aa51c33581c9e5da97ddc7.translatedText: The hospital hung up banners to celebrate the number of inpatients exceeding 40,000, revealing a lack of medical ethics. Guangzhou Yang Qiwei The total number of inpatients in Wuchuan People's Hospital in Guangdong Province exceeded 40,000. The hospital hung up red banners in the inpatient building to celebrate. This move caused great dissatisfaction among patients and their families. Subsequently, online discussions were overwhelming, unanimously lashing out at the hospital for its indifference, lack of medical ethics and lack of management wisdom. As we all know, there is an essential difference between having more than 40,000 hospitalized patients and having more than 4 trillion bank deposits. The latter is a win-win situation for depositors and banks, while the former is only a "win-win" for the hospital. It's okay to hold a "celebration party" quietly inside the hospital, but to hang up banners publicly to celebrate, which greatly irritates the patients and their families. Just imagine, I am sick and hospitalized. This in itself is a bad, unfortunate or even unlucky thing. What is there for you to celebrate? In my opinion, the serious problem exposed by the "Congratulations on Disease Banner" is the failure of medical reform and the misguided path of advanced commercialization of public hospitals. For a long time, my country's medical institutions have not distinguished between public welfare and for-profit purposes, which has also exposed the ineffectiveness of medical reform. The lack of public welfare in public hospitals has led to numerous ills, such as not having surgery if there is no money, or withdrawing money after a suturing operation without money. This is a manifestation of the hospital's disregard for the patient's feelings and "falling into the eyes of money". It is also a manifestation of the hospital's lack of humanized service and management wisdom. At present, the vast majority of medical institutions that dominate the medical and health field are public hospitals. However, due to reasons such as insufficient financial investment compensation mechanisms, in terms of operations, public hospitals are blindly pursuing profits and are very profit-oriented. Statistics show that more than 95% of public hospitals are operating according to a for-profit business model. my country's medical and health care system reform plan emphasizes the need to uphold the public welfare nature of public hospitals. However, the current situation shows the opposite trend. The hospital hangs up a "banner congratulating patients", and its joy is beyond words, and its pursuit of profit maximization is fully exposed. It is not difficult to imagine that because more people are hospitalized and treated, the hospital's income will also increase, and it will make a lot of money. Of course it is happy and of course it is celebrated. But have you considered the feelings of patients and their families? Do you have compassion for patients and their families? Are you looking forward to people getting sick and being hospitalized? The more the better, so that the threshold of the hospital can be broken down? It should be noted that hospitals are places that save lives and heal the wounded. They can charge fees and make profits when treating patients, but they cannot take profit as the only goal and forget the "parental heart" and benevolent attitude of "hanging the pot to help the world" that doctors should have. Why are patients and their families so embarrassed when they proudly put up red banners to celebrate when the total number of hospitalized patients exceeded 40,000? How can the public be embarrassed? This is a kind of blasphemy against the "angel in white". It is too immoral and inhumane. In the current medical system, some public hospitals have reversed the doctor-patient relationship for personal gain. They are more concerned about profit figures. Making money has become a hard indicator for hospitals to judge heroes. Treating diseases is regarded as a profitable business, and the doctor-patient relationship has become a cold money relationship. Although, it is understandable that hospitals also need to pay attention to cost accounting, make profits, and avoid losses. However, hospitals are places that save lives and heal the wounded and fulfill humanitarian obligations. They have a strong public welfare nature. Compared with making money, it is more important to reflect public welfare. Hospitals must correct the relationship between profit-making, public welfare, and medical ethics. Taking into account their image in the public mind, hospitals must not be reduced to profit-seeking, and must not forget their sacred mission and deviate from the essence and requirements of medical public welfare. Logically speaking, the function of medical institutions is not only to diagnose and treat patients, but also has the responsibility of disease prevention and control for the people in a certain region. In other words, from a macro and long-term perspective, the increase in hospitalized patients can only prove from the side that the health status of the people in the region is unbearable and worrying. This is obviously not something worth celebrating. Therefore, when a hospital hangs a banner to celebrate the number of hospitalized patients exceeding 40,000, it is no different in essence from "Congratulations on your illness," "Congratulations on your hospitalization," or "Congratulations on your spending money on medical treatment." What it reveals is a chilling indifference and even cold-bloodedness. What it exposes is the profit-seeking impulse and lack of public welfare in China's public hospitals. Suddenly I remembered a classic couplet written by Cheng Daozhou, a famous doctor in the Qing Dynasty: I hope everyone is healthy; why not be poor alone. For today's public hospitals, even if they do not have such universal sentiments and medical ethics of compassion and kindness, they should not be "warmly congratulated" for the record high number of inpatients. How can a kind-hearted doctor rub salt and insert a knife into the wounds of doctors and patients like this? Even if real estate developers are eager to see housing prices rise, they don’t dare to openly shout “Let’s go up.” Even if coffin dealers hate to get rich, they don’t dare to openly say “Let’s kill a few more people.” Therefore, it is a taboo for Wuchuan People's Hospital to hang up banners to celebrate the record number of inpatients. Because behind that cheerful voice is a harsh subtext: Get sick more often! Of course, this move will be deeply disgusted by patients, family members and the public. This is also the current strong demand of the Chinese people for the return of medical public welfare, and it deserves careful reflection by the hospital. Now, Wuchuan People's Hospital has taken down the "congratulations on the disease banner" and admitted its mistake. But it is still not optimistic whether the profit-seeking thinking contained in it will really loosen up.

f4a08361a50bf03206d192a19f8f541cb1d38e7d.sourceText: 亚利桑那边境查获108磅大麻 （亚省时报） 美国海关和边境防卫官员周一发布消息，一名墨西哥籍男子携带108磅大麻试图进入本州南部时被捕。 18岁的罗伯特?#38463;科斯塔阿尔瓦拉多周六驾驶一辆多驱动车在道格拉斯海关等待入境时，被缉毒犬发现问题，探员随后在他的车上搜出超过100包大麻。有关负责人表示，这批毒品价值约合91000美元。 据交代，嫌犯是墨西哥索诺拉州人，边境方面已经将其移交给美国移民和海关执法局的国土安全调查部处理。

Roberto Costa Alvarado, 18, was driving a multi-drive at customs in Douglas on Saturday when a drug-sniffing dog spotted him, and agents later found more than 100 packages of marijuana in his vehicle. The relevant person in charge stated that the value of this batch of drugs is approximately US$91,000. According to reports, the suspect is a native of Sonora, Mexico, and the border authorities have handed him over to the Homeland Security Investigations Division of the U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement Agency for processing.

6526868f30843a95f44054e6d09e6080bd9740fc.sourceText: 斯坦福大学MBA花费超18万美元 全球最高 据Poets&Quants最新数据，斯坦福大学（Stanford University）MBA项目已经一举超越宾西法尼亚大学沃顿商学院（Pennsylvania’s Wharton School）、哥伦比亚大学商学院（Columbia Business School）以及哈佛商学院（Harvard Business School）成为全球最昂贵的MBA项目。 今年，斯坦福大学告诉申请者MBA项目花费超过18.5万美元，比两年前高出1.8万美元。当时哥伦比亚大学商学院以16.8万美元成为最贵的MBA项目。但是在短短两年内，斯坦福大学MBA项目的花费攀升了10.9%。 斯坦福大学MBA项目花费包括学费、杂费、书籍及学习成本、强制性医疗保险、在硅谷吃住的成本以及耗费4000美元的全球性研究之旅。斯坦福大学表示书籍购 买花费2184美元，教材花费1710美元，交通花费963美元，强制性医疗保险花费3600美元，卫生费537美元。此外，包括房租、食物及个人消费的?#27491;常生活方式?#23558;花费2.4万美元。 但是实际上MBA实际花费往往比学校预估高，因为第二年通常都有3%至5%的学费上涨，而且精英的MBA课程都包括与朋友享用昂贵晚餐、在长周末去滑雪胜地旅游等。如果已婚学生住在校外，总成本更将超过22万。 目前美国MBA项目的成本远远高于其它国际学校。伦敦商学院MBA项目总费用大约为9万美元至11万美元，而位于法国的欧洲工商管理学院MBA项目总费用大约为11万美元。
6526868f30843a95f44054e6d09e6080bd9740fc.translatedText: The cost of an MBA from Stanford University exceeds US$180,000, the highest in the world. According to the latest data from Poets&Quants, Stanford University (Stanford) costs more than US$180,000, the highest in the world. University’s MBA program has surpassed Pennsylvania’s Wharton School, Columbia Business School and Harvard Business School to become the most expensive MBA program in the world. This year, Stanford told applicants that its MBA program will cost more than $185,000, which is $18,000 more than two years ago, when Columbia Business School was the most expensive program. But in just two years, the cost of the Stanford MBA program has increased by 10.9%. The cost of the Stanford MBA program includes tuition, fees, books and study costs, mandatory health insurance, room and board in Silicon Valley, and a global research trip that costs $4,000. Purchases cost $2,184, textbooks cost $1,710, transportation cost $963, mandatory medical insurance cost $3,600, and health expenses $537. In addition, daily lifestyle expenses including rent, food and personal expenses cost $24,000. But in fact, the actual cost of an MBA is often higher than the school estimates, because there is usually a 3% to 5% tuition increase in the second year, and elite MBA programs include expensive dinners with friends, long weekend trips to ski resorts, etc. If married students live off campus, the total cost will exceed 220,000. The current cost of American MBA programs is much higher than that of other international schools. The total cost of the London Business School MBA program is approximately US$90,000 to US$110,000, while the total cost of the INSEAD MBA program in France is approximately US$110,000.

There will be one-day training lectures in Tucson and Phoenix on August 10th and 11th.

All teachers who attend the full one-day training course will receive a certificate. The relevant departments of Chinese education are increasing the training of Chinese teachers year by year in order to improve the level of Chinese teaching and gradually establish a three-in-one Chinese teacher training mechanism of "training, assessment, and certification".

The principals above have issued a notice requiring all Chinese teachers in the school to participate in this training; the heads of other schools in the region have also forwarded the training news to the teachers.

7891fa1e9c9501f3e561b07d8dacb2222bc14491.translatedText: Editor's note of "A Dream of Red Mansions":

ff0285221e763604bb44c634637561cca83641e3.sourceText: 红楼梦87版的电视剧歌曲音乐是著名作曲家王立平根据曹雪芹的《金陵十二钗》词，花了四年多时间写成的，其中《葬花吟》几乎花费了这位音乐家近两年的时间。其歌曲经过陈力这位音乐奇才的演绎，几乎成了歌迷心中的千古绝唱。
ff0285221e763604bb44c634637561cca83641e3.translatedText: The songs and music of the 87 version of the TV series Dream of Red Mansions were written by the famous composer Wang Liping based on the lyrics of Cao Xueqin's "The Twelve Hairpins of Jinling" and took more than four years to write. Among them, "The Song of the Burial Flowers" took the musician almost two years. Its songs, performed by Chen Li, a music wizard, have almost become eternal songs in the hearts of fans.

42ce91542afe4a5f9e95b2c820d615cd8fbbe670.sourceText: 为了重现红楼歌曲的美妙，美国亚里桑那（Arizona）州的图桑(Tucson)华声合唱团和亚里桑那大学孔子学院共同筹办了2013 红楼梦乐曲中秋音乐会(9月20日 \9月21日举行)，届时，王立平和陈力都会出席音乐会，陈力还会担当合唱的主唱。这是红楼梦电视剧自87年播出后陈力第一次出山重演红楼歌曲。
42ce91542afe4a5f9e95b2c820d615cd8fbbe670.translatedText: In order to recreate the beauty of the Red Mansions songs, the Tucson Huasheng Chorus in Arizona and the Confucius Institute at the University of Arizona jointly organized the 2013 Mid-Autumn Festival Concert of Dreams of Red Mansions (held on September 20 and September 21). Wang Liping and Chen Li will attend the concert, and Chen Li will also serve as the lead singer of the chorus. This is the first time Chen Li has performed the song of Red Mansions since the TV series "Dream of Red Mansions" was aired in 1987.

4ae16540cdc80cf94965fe19a1fe64f582f6871d.sourceText: 鉴于海外的观众对红楼梦故事了解的不足，本栏特地邀请专家介绍和点评红楼故事和人物，也希望因此抛砖引玉，引起更多华人朋友的兴趣。
4ae16540cdc80cf94965fe19a1fe64f582f6871d.translatedText: In view of the lack of understanding of the story of Dream of Red Mansions by overseas audiences, this column specially invites experts to introduce and comment on the story and characters of Red Mansions, hoping that this will attract more Chinese friends.

b90edcab5c315181b634327404b0846db0d82deb.sourceText: 一提起黛玉，人们眼前便浮现出一个柔弱的少女，荷锄而来，挖出一个坑来，趴进几瓣花叶，累了伸一下腰还不忘洒几滴泪。
b90edcab5c315181b634327404b0846db0d82deb.translatedText: Whenever Daiyu is mentioned, a frail girl appears in front of people's eyes. She comes with a hoe, digs a hole, lays down on a few petals of flowers and leaves, stretches her waist when tired, and sheds a few tears.

6c3497e8aa23a96443a86d3563e938b3bab673e5.sourceText: 这世间能给人伤感的事多的去了，何以这美丽女子偏为此等花落之事动情呢？人们各述己见，常以为独到。
6c3497e8aa23a96443a86d3563e938b3bab673e5.translatedText: There are so many sad things in this world, why is this beautiful woman so moved by such things as falling flowers? People all express their own opinions and often think they are unique.

5e3bd6e06eea26e2c7d20b1f0dbe834eb7726d34.sourceText: 大家看到的只是她母亲的离去，新到一地的孤独以及多愁善感的脾性导致黛玉因花思人念己的情节。其实情节是服从于内容的。文学作品能否吸引人，不但取决于具体的描写，而在于作者对作品框架内容的整体把握。往往框架一旦确立，里面的人物便活鲜起来了。
5e3bd6e06eea26e2c7d20b1f0dbe834eb7726d34.translatedText: What everyone saw was the death of her mother, the loneliness in a new place, and the sentimental temperament that caused Daiyu to miss others because of flowers. In fact, the plot is subordinate to the content. Whether a literary work is attractive or not depends not only on the specific description, but also on the author's overall grasp of the frame content of the work. Often once the framework is established, the characters inside come alive.

a5350feebcadb44f0956f6c32b4819c08de2d47b.sourceText: 在写红楼之前，曹雪芹心中的故事框架是什么呢？猜想他企图通过对眼前几个家族兴衰的剖析，还原当时的一段历史原貌吧。红楼产生的背景，我们似乎不陌生：清朝政府统治华夏大地，已经由盛至衰，下层农民贫民以及本来家景尚好的小地主们被大权贵们层层兼并，土地和家产都被掠夺去，林黛玉的一家包括以后宁荣大家用现在的语言形容，就是被权势者”土地储备”，弄得家破人亡了。
a5350feebcadb44f0956f6c32b4819c08de2d47b.translatedText: Before writing Red Mansions, what was the story framework in Cao Xueqin’s mind? I guess he was trying to restore the original history of that time by analyzing the rise and fall of several families in front of him. The background of the Red Mansion seems familiar to us: the Qing Dynasty ruled the land of China and has gone from prosperity to decline. The lower-class peasants and poor people as well as the small landowners with good family backgrounds were annexed by the powerful and powerful, and their land and family property were plundered. Lin Daiyu's family, including Ning Rong in the future, described in current language, was "land reserve" by the powerful, causing their family to be ruined.

56b87e6c4c19dfcdf3e6a150f1351a253fb2a7a2.sourceText: 黛玉一个小女子，只读过《四书》，是不便从她嘴里出现埋怨社会制度的宏篇大论的，但发发幽怨还是很符合她的身份的。所以在外人看来，她只是个” 无事闷坐，不是愁眉，便是 长叹，且好端端的不知为着什么，常常的便自泪不干 的”的林妹妹。
56b87e6c4c19dfcdf3e6a150f1351a253fb2a7a2.translatedText: Daiyu is a young woman who has only read the "Four Books". It is not convenient for her to come out with grand speeches complaining about the social system, but it is still in line with her status to express grievances. Therefore, in the eyes of outsiders, she is just a sister Lin who "sits in silence with nothing to do, either frowning or sighing, and she doesn't know why, and often bursts into tears."

b6ffecbb5553e91985886ec2cccb967273807bdc.sourceText: 但其实，你听听看看她葬花时的流泪竟是这样的怨：” 三月香巢初垒成，梁间燕子太无情!明年花发虽可啄，却不道人去梁空巢已倾。 一年三百六十日，风刀霜剑严相逼。明媚鲜妍能几时，一朝飘泊难寻觅” ，这哪是林妹妹在埋怨世态炎凉呢？整个是曹雪芹对 一个家族或社会政权兴衰盛亡的感怀。或者说悲悲切切的是林姑娘，但那背后却是那些坚守中国传统的文人们的感伤和咏叹。
b6ffecbb5553e91985886ec2cccb967273807bdc.translatedText: But in fact, listen to her tears when burying the flowers, and she actually complained like this: "In March, the fragrant nest has just been built, and the swallows in the beams are so ruthless! Although the flowers can be pecked next year, they will not let people go. The empty nest has fallen. Three hundred and sixty days a year, the wind, the sword, the frost, the sword. How long can the bright and beautiful flowers last? It is hard to find them once they wander." Is this Sister Lin complaining about the cold world? The whole story is Cao Xueqin's feelings about the rise and fall of a family or a social regime. In other words, it is Miss Lin who is deeply saddened, but behind it are the sentiments and chants of those literati who adhere to Chinese tradition.

3159d1404006410ce8f720ac739c8a0ea1d66ada.sourceText: 中国文人虽百无技能，但什么时候都愿清高一把，”不吃嗟来之食”，所以曹雪芹又借黛玉葬花之叹，唱出了自己” 质本洁来还洁去，不教污淖陷渠沟” 的清高。但这种品位只欢喜林妹妹 颦颦 美色的读者是难以体会的。
3159d1404006410ce8f720ac739c8a0ea1d66ada.translatedText: Although Chinese literati have no skills, they are willing to be noble at all times and "don't eat the food that comes after sighing." Therefore, Cao Xueqin used Daiyu's sigh of burying flowers to sing about her own noble nature of "coming and going clean again, not letting dirt fall into ditches." But this kind of taste is difficult for readers who only like Sister Lin's beauty and beauty to understand.

76848205444eca4af07559f4ec6c35507d90ce20.sourceText: 从红楼葬花情节来看，原本是黛玉宝玉两小无猜，收拾落花的青涩风情事，到后来演变成” 花魂鸟魂总难留，鸟自无言花自羞。 愿侬此日生双翼，随花飞到天尽头” 一腔情愫 ， 到末了连只会幽怨的林妹妹葬花时都发出了” 出的多，进的少，如今若不省俭， 必致后手不接” 的感叹，无不透露出小民百姓对传统对美好的一种希冀。这已不是情爱说可以包钠的了。
76848205444eca4af07559f4ec6c35507d90ce20.translatedText: Judging from the plot of burying flowers in the Red Mansion, it was originally a youthful love affair between Daiyu and Baoyu's childhood sweethearts, picking up fallen flowers, but later evolved into "The souls of flowers and birds are always hard to keep, and the birds are speechless and the flowers are ashamed. May I have wings today and fly to the end of the sky with the flowers." In the end, even the resentful sister Lin expressed it when she buried the flowers. "A lot goes out, but little comes in. If we are not thrifty now, we will not be able to catch up with anything else." The sighs all reveal the common people's hope for tradition and beauty. This is no longer the case that love can contain sodium.

f6f097aabc5f31372c4167c5ee8b747bf51a0340.sourceText: 林黛玉用葬花悲切地感怀美丽，感怀爱情，那么地情深谊长，那么地痛不欲生，未必和读者所处的时代相符，但后来的人们总能记住林妹妹的一笑一颦，因为她对爱情的独特见解与关云长的忠义和孔夫子仁爱已经构成了中国传统文化独特的一页。
f6f097aabc5f31372c4167c5ee8b747bf51a0340.translatedText: Lin Daiyu mournfully expressed her beauty and love with the funeral flowers. Such deep friendship and deep sorrow may not be in line with the era in which readers lived. However, people in the future can always remember Sister Lin’s smile and frown, because her unique views on love, Guan Yunchang’s loyalty and Confucius’ benevolence have formed a unique page of Chinese traditional culture.

976d89ce9019dfe524626eb3b298eb78a886256f.sourceText: （关于葬花的情节参见《红楼梦》第 23\27\62 回）
976d89ce9019dfe524626eb3b298eb78a886256f.translatedText: (For the plot of burying flowers, please refer to Chapter 23\27\62 of "A Dream of Red Mansions")

d705c0d0b26131c6d3a2a065093b81b68d7cc9d5.sourceText: 流感季高峰期今年提前到来 逾1亿人接种疫苗 美国疾病控制和预防中心主任托马斯?#24343;里登3日表示，美国今年的流感季比往年提前至少一个月进入高峰期，不过目前已有1亿多人接种了疫苗。 疾控中心汇总的数据显示，11月18日至24日期间，全国约2.2%的就诊者因出现流感样症状而就医，在部分南部州，这一比例高达4%。弗里登表示，这比一般年份出现流感病例大幅上升的情况早了至少一个月。 据弗里登介绍，今年传播的主要流感病毒为H3N2型，而这种病毒通常都会导致比较严重的流感流行，幸运的是，今年的流感疫苗与H3N2型流感病毒相匹配。 疾控中心数据显示，政府已向医疗机构发放了1.23亿剂流感疫苗，约1.12亿人已接种疫苗；在医生、护士和药剂师群体中，疫苗接种率超过80%，孕妇约半数也已接种。 美国的流感季一般从10月份开始，至第二年4月份结束。在普通流感季中，全美平均死亡约3.6万人，20万人住院。
d705c0d0b26131c6d3a2a065093b81b68d7cc9d5.translatedText: The peak of the flu season has arrived early this year, and more than 100 million people have been vaccinated. Thomas Reeden, director of the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, said on the 3rd that this year's flu season in the United States has reached its peak at least a month earlier than in previous years, but more than 100 million people have been vaccinated so far. Data compiled by the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention show that between November 18 and 24, about 2.2% of patients nationwide sought medical treatment due to flu-like symptoms. In some southern states, this rate was as high as 4%. Frieden said this was at least a month earlier than a typical year when flu cases would rise significantly. According to Frieden, the main influenza virus circulating this year is H3N2, and this virus usually causes more serious influenza epidemics. Fortunately, this year's influenza vaccine matches the H3N2 influenza virus. Data from the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention show that the government has distributed 123 million doses of influenza vaccine to medical institutions, and about 112 million people have been vaccinated; among doctors, nurses and pharmacists, the vaccination rate exceeds 80%, and about half of pregnant women have also been vaccinated. The flu season in the United States generally starts in October and ends in April of the following year. During a typical flu season, an average of about 36,000 people die and 200,000 people are hospitalized in the United States.

ae96aa0c665dfaf57cb6041e4653656ee014576a.translatedText: Mass incident in Dongxing, Guangxi, 5 police officers were injured Pictures from Weibo Reporter...

951e367cc24b31f4f6d834caf5e6149f6dbb78a1.sourceText: 记者从广西防城港市公安局了解到，今天（7日）上午，防城港下辖的东兴市发生一起群体性事件，导致5名民警受伤，9辆缉私警车受损。
951e367cc24b31f4f6d834caf5e6149f6dbb78a1.translatedText: The reporter learned from the Public Security Bureau of Fangchenggang City, Guangxi, that this morning (7th), a mass incident occurred in Dongxing City under the jurisdiction of Fangchenggang, resulting in 5 police officers being injured and 9 anti-smuggling police vehicles being damaged.

e30301c1a3a59bd602efd1aea7ac3365f61e18f6.sourceText: 据防城港市公安局初步了解， 当地时间12月7日上午8时许，东兴海关缉私警察在执勤过程中，发现一辆摩托车涉嫌装载走私物品，在围堵抓捕过程中致摩托车司机受轻伤，引起伤者家属及在市场买菜的约1000名群众围观，进而阻挠执法人员处理现场。其间，部分群众对执法车辆及人员投掷石块，致5名民警轻伤和9辆缉私警车不同程度受损。防城港市公安局称，在事件发生过程中，执法人员未采取过激行为。
e30301c1a3a59bd602efd1aea7ac3365f61e18f6.translatedText: According to preliminary information from the Fangchenggang City Public Security Bureau, at about 8 a.m. on December 7, local time, the Dongxing Customs anti-smuggling police discovered a motorcycle suspected of loading smuggled goods while on duty. During the arrest, the motorcycle driver was slightly injured. The family members of the injured and about 1,000 people shopping for food in the market gathered to watch, thereby obstructing law enforcement officers from handling the scene. During this period, some people threw stones at law enforcement vehicles and personnel, causing minor injuries to 5 police officers and damage to 9 anti-smuggling police vehicles to varying degrees. The Fangchenggang City Public Security Bureau stated that law enforcement officers did not take any drastic action during the incident.

1f3a1560e495c88bd02addfed395ef3c21a1164c.sourceText: 接报后，防城港市委、市政府组织东兴市及政法、公安、边防、海关等相关部门成立专案组，出动200多名警力赶赴现场维护秩序，并劝告群众不参与走私活动。
1f3a1560e495c88bd02addfed395ef3c21a1164c.translatedText: After receiving the report, the Fangchenggang Municipal Party Committee and Municipal Government organized Dongxing City and relevant departments of politics and law, public security, border defense, customs and other departments to set up a task force and dispatched more than 200 police officers to the scene to maintain order and advise the masses not to participate in smuggling activities.

f33ee48cb8941e0f072cfd01c353e357bc49b30f.sourceText: 目前，伤者已送到东兴市人民医院救治，事态已得到控制。
f33ee48cb8941e0f072cfd01c353e357bc49b30f.translatedText: At present, the injured have been sent to Dongxing People's Hospital for treatment, and the situation is under control.

e1c474a69e183b5b5a1846584471ea9eab8bc534.sourceText: 美国亚利桑那州两学生因打架被罚手拉手坐操场。事件发生后，一些目睹者将两人手拉手的照片传至网络，引发热议。
e1c474a69e183b5b5a1846584471ea9eab8bc534.translatedText: Two students in Arizona, USA, were punished for fighting and were punished by sitting hand in hand on the playground. After the incident, some witnesses posted photos of the two holding hands to the Internet, sparking heated discussions.

e1ab49f803161ec40624899a5595e48e042c9047.sourceText: 美国亚利桑那州梅萨市韦斯特伍德高中，两名学生因为在体育课上打架而受到处罚。校长理查德(Tim Richard)给出两种选择：停课9天或是当着大伙的面手拉手在操场上坐上一小时。两人选择了后者，因为停课不仅会惊动家长，还会在期末成绩单上留下记录。
e1ab49f803161ec40624899a5595e48e042c9047.translatedText: Two students at Westwood High School in Mesa, Arizona, USA, were punished for fighting in physical education class. Principal Tim Richard gave the students two options: suspend classes for nine days or sit hand in hand on the playground for an hour in front of everyone. The two chose the latter because the suspension of classes would not only alarm parents, but would also leave a record on the final report card.

8d4aeba6efd730ea8935cd93bb61e04a6dcb6516.sourceText: 高中生布莱特妮(Bretny Samir)目击了整个惩罚过程，她说：”周围的同学都在嘲笑他们，叫着他们的名字问’你们是同性恋吗’。”另一名学生则说：”我曾在美国后备军官训练队呆过，这和他们的处理方法类似，而且确实奏效了。”
8d4aeba6efd730ea8935cd93bb61e04a6dcb6516.translatedText: >High school student Bretny Samir, who witnessed the entire punishment process, said: "The classmates around them were laughing at them, calling their names and asking, 'Are you gay?'" Another student said: "I have been in the U.S. ROTC. This is similar to their handling method, and it really worked."

8c19ba5813abfeb2b124bdb1697c35fc81b5a751.sourceText: 令两人没有想到的是，当时尴尬牵手、掩面而坐的照片被周围的同学拍下，并在社交网络引发轰动。14岁的查尔斯?#20811;罗克特是受罚人之一，他后来在接受采访时说，由于过于尴尬，第二天他没去上学。当记者询问他从这次事件中学到什么的时候，他回答说：”千万不要在学校里打架。”
8c19ba5813abfeb2b124bdb1697c35fc81b5a751.translatedText: What the two did not expect was that a photo of them awkwardly holding hands and sitting with their faces covered was taken by the surrounding classmates and caused a sensation on social networks. One of those punished, 14-year-old Charles Rocket, later said in an interview that he was too embarrassed to go to school the next day. When a reporter asked him what he learned from this incident, he replied: "Never fight in school."

2ff64527c72d8d8f6048f05ad594e519f9ed6811.sourceText: 不过，并不是所有人都认同这样的做法。许多网友在看到照片之后，评论说这样的做法”不合适”。还有评论说，如此指名道姓的惩罚会被认为是在”鼓励大家欺负人”。
2ff64527c72d8d8f6048f05ad594e519f9ed6811.translatedText: However, not everyone agrees with this approach. After seeing the photo, many netizens commented that this approach was "inappropriate". Others commented that such naming and punishment would be considered to "encourage everyone to bully others."

eda608fd0385182eed8b2b96fa7a6aff2b887357.sourceText: 梅萨市公立学校地方委员会，也在事后发表声明说”不会容忍”校方的类似做法，会进一步了解情况，并将和学校管理者一起重新审视校纪校规方面的不足。
eda608fd0385182eed8b2b96fa7a6aff2b887357.translatedText: The Mesa City Public Schools Local Board also issued a statement afterwards, saying that it "will not tolerate" similar practices by the school and will learn more about the situation and will re-examine the deficiencies in school discipline and rules with the school administrators.

220756dd9c078fb3918e14e0675081cda659b7f1.translatedText: The purchasing power of Asians in the United States has soared five times in 22 years. Asians in the United States are not only a group with a rapidly growing population, but their purchasing power has also increased rapidly. Nigeria...

aa1209a1a5c82529d4f3c89ddc17a5a1dad9e67a.sourceText: 美国的亚裔不但是人口增加迅速的族群，而且购买力也迅猛增加。尼尔森(Nielsen)市场行销公司4日公布的亚裔消费习惯显示，由于购买力迅速提高，亚裔今后将成为企业和商家推销产品与服务的主要目标。
aa1209a1a5c82529d4f3c89ddc17a5a1dad9e67a.translatedText: Asians in the United States are not only a rapidly growing population, but their purchasing power is also increasing rapidly. According to the consumption habits of Asians released by the Nielsen marketing company on the 4th, due to the rapid increase in purchasing power, Asians will become the main target of companies and merchants to promote products and services in the future.

f949ec6369653fa656f75f8d410ea0e5cc36959d.sourceText: examiner.com网站报导，亚裔今年的购买力是7184亿元，比1990年猛增5.23倍。如果美国的亚裔人口单独组成一个国家，将成为世界的第18大经济体。到五年后的2017年，亚裔的购买力将高达1万亿元。
f949ec6369653fa656f75f8d410ea0e5cc36959d.translatedText: examiner.com website reported that the purchasing power of Asians this year was 718.4 billion yuan, a surge of 5.23 times compared with 1990. If the Asian population in the United States formed a country alone, it would be the 18th largest economy in the world. By 2017, five years later, the purchasing power of Asians will reach 1 trillion yuan.

b1cfcfd20ebee898bca1d2c467dd63633f769041.sourceText: 尼尔森公司副总裁朴特罗斯基认为，亚裔的购买力强大，以至于任何商家都不能忽视，「受移民增多因素的影响，亚裔的购买力将持续提高，企业应更重视他们」。
b1cfcfd20ebee898bca1d2c467dd63633f769041.translatedText: Nielsen Vice President Petrowski believes that the purchasing power of Asians is so strong that no business can ignore it. "Affected by the increase in immigration, the purchasing power of Asians will continue to increase, and companies should pay more attention to them."

21f27522b8644db109cb42a9237dfcfdaf6a2250.sourceText: 全美约有1850万亚裔，仅占美国人口的5%，但亚裔的影响力却很重要。丕优研究中心今年初公布的「亚裔美国人的崛起」报告，就突显出亚裔的积极作用。
21f27522b8644db109cb42a9237dfcfdaf6a2250.translatedText: There are approximately 18.5 million Asians in the United States, accounting for only 5% of the U.S. population, but the influence of Asians is very important. The "Rise of Asian Americans" report released by the Pioneer Research Center earlier this year highlighted the positive role of Asians.

7be362947cd6a3d0e0cdabcd4280b0ba6c9d57a2.sourceText: 报告说：「亚裔是美国增加最快的移民群体，他们的收入水平和受教育程度最高。亚裔对生活、家庭财务和国家未来的走向，比其他族群更感到满意。他们比其他族群更重视婚姻、教育子女、勤奋工作和在职场取得成功。」
7be362947cd6a3d0e0cdabcd4280b0ba6c9d57a2.translatedText: The report said: "Asians are the fastest-growing immigrant group in the United States, and they have the highest income levels and education levels. Asians are more satisfied with life, family finances, and the country's future direction than other groups. They value marriage and educating their children more than other groups. , work hard and succeed in the workplace. "

ed208f98a8d6e3c628085586f94542cb1157feeb.sourceText: 2010年，美国和外国出生的亚裔包揽了全国45%的博士学位，在25岁以上的亚裔中，25%拥有学士学位，全国平均有学士学位的人才占28%。
ed208f98a8d6e3c628085586f94542cb1157feeb.translatedText: In 2010, American and foreign-born Asians accounted for 45% of the country's doctoral degrees. Among Asians over 25 years old, 25% had a bachelor's degree, and the national average was 28%.

f9f57f7ec7e424e8d3d40bda065eaab17ba276ea.sourceText: 亚裔的人口增长迅猛，增速仅次于西语裔人口，在全国49个州是以两位数增长。28%的亚裔家庭的年收入超过10万元，而全国平均年收入逾10万元的家庭才是18%。亚裔的家庭中位收入是6万5000元，全国平均是5万元。
f9f57f7ec7e424e8d3d40bda065eaab17ba276ea.translatedText: The Asian population is growing rapidly, second only to the Hispanic population, with double-digit growth in 49 states across the country. 28% of Asian families have an annual income of more than 100,000 yuan, while the national average annual income of more than 100,000 yuan is only 18%. The median household income of Asians is 65,000 yuan, and the national average is 50,000 yuan.

aef690ba29b656400df17dc699bf31df4f85512c.sourceText: 尼尔森公司副董事长苏珊 威庭说﹕「更深入地了解亚裔，企业和商家将为他们提供更好的产品与服务。」
aef690ba29b656400df17dc699bf31df4f85512c.translatedText: > Susan Whiting, Vice Chairman of Nielsen Company, said: "With a deeper understanding of Asians, companies and merchants will provide them with better products and services."

86581e4956afeca1c61fcf9bcb92d7b3c9e1fdfa.sourceText: 萨比利铜矿整改 裁减400多职位 一个本地矿业上周五宣布，将暂停其萨比利(Superior)铜矿的操作轴和钻探工作，并裁减400多个职位，原因是周围土地交换持续性不稳定。 这家名为Resolution Copper Mining的发言人说，他们将尝试将受影响的员工安排在公司内部其它工作岗位，其中有些将安置至公司总部伦敦。此次裁员将裁减矿务公司75%的劳动力，从12月起，至明年三月完成。 造成这次裁员的原因，主要是该公司自2005年以来一直悬而未决的一扩展项目。公司提议将5300亩土地作保育用途，用以交换2400亩国家森林土地作扩展计划。此项交易在国会受阻多年，受到一些保护主义者和印第安原住民的反对。公司坚称此片森林下面蕴藏着世界上最大的未开发铜矿资源。 本州刚当选的国会众议员，民主党安科克柏特里克说，这项裁员将摧毁铜矿周边地区，如萨比利、格鲁(Globe)和迈阿米及其它小社区的经济。 本州资深参议员约翰麦凯恩敦促国会通过立法，促使土地交换交易进行，这样会使矿山扩张，导致新增就业岗位4000个。
86581e4956afeca1c61fcf9bcb92d7b3c9e1fdfa.translatedText: Sapele Copper Mine rectifies and cuts more than 400 positions A local miner announced on Friday that it would suspend operations and drilling at its Sapele (Superior) copper mine and cut more than 400 jobs due to ongoing instability around land exchanges. A spokesperson for Resolution Copper Mining said they would try to place affected employees in other jobs within the company, some of which would be relocated to the company's headquarters in London. The layoffs will cut 75% of the mining company's workforce, starting in December and ending in March next year. The layoffs were caused by an expansion project that had been pending at the company since 2005. The company proposed to use 5,300 acres of land for conservation purposes in exchange for 2,400 acres of national forest land for expansion plans. The deal has been blocked in Congress for years and is opposed by some preservationists and Native Americans. The company insists that the forest contains the world's largest untapped copper resource. The state's newly elected Congressman, Democratic Ankirk Betrick, said the layoffs will devastate the economies of areas surrounding the copper mines, such as Sapele, Globe, Maiami and other small communities. John McCain, the state's senior senator, urged Congress to pass legislation to facilitate the land swap deal, which would allow the mine to expand and create 4,000 new jobs.
