04ee2ce62d42e065e56c84f52880d2ffd44faa07.sourceText: 图森生物圈2号 模拟地球新体验 科学家以地球为「生物圈1号」（Biosphere #1），建构密封状态模拟地球真实的生态环境的实验室称为「生物圈2号」（Biosphere #2），也称为「微型地球」，地点就在亚利桑纳州土桑市（Tucson）以南的沙漠中。 德 州石油巨子巴斯（Edward Bass）于1986年出资2亿元建立此实验室，为寻找第二个人类可能生活的星球兴建大型温室做试验。1991年9月26日八名科学家首次进驻，21个月 后离开；1994年3月6日另外七名科学家再度进驻，10个月后以失败告终，如今成为观光景点。 汽车在荒野沙丘中行驶，沿途不是稀零的仙人 掌和枯草丛无力地趴在沙丘上，就是荒茫黄沙、突兀山丘和远处的崎嶙群山。「目的地快到了!」在导游提醒下，游客向远处望去，一根飘着三面旗帜的旗杆插在被 仙人掌及沙丘植物包围下的大石块，石上刻着Biosphere #2，并刻着地球的图案。 「生物圈2号」占地1.28公顷，其主体和附属部 分均为涂有特殊成分的粉剂白色涂料，主体为立体钢架构型，以双层玻璃密封，外形像埃及金字塔。其它附属部分的外形像长圆白桶的是能源中心，像半圆球的是空 气和温度调节器、在圆桶上加建的碉堡楼可能是当年的「住宅区」，这些建筑群在沙丘上充满科幻意境。 沿着白色的走廊进入金字塔形的玻璃钢架的 密封体生态室，据介绍，密封体生态室里包括五个野生生物群落，分别为热带雨林、草原、海洋、沼泽和沙漠，圈内有4000个物种，包括来自澳洲、非洲、美洲 的动物、植物和微生物。两个人工生物群落农业区和居民区，居民区配置厨房、餐厅、寝室、健身房、浴室、图书馆、实验室，科学家们曾住在这里，他们饮用的是 生态系统自然生成的纯水，呼吸的是圈内植物释放出的氧气，吃的是自己栽种的粮食。 进入「热带雨林」区，浓烈的青草味扑鼻而来，葱郁的树木、 灌丛错落有致，高大迭错的树叶摇曳，倒映在清澈的河流中，雾气常化为水珠滴落游客头上，这是生物圈中最有生气的野生生物群。其它的几个物群则荒凉无比，但 有棵长在沙漠上的仙人掌树，十分丰满、茁壮，开出许多美丽的花球，为沙漠增添色彩。 步入微型城市的「住宅区」，区内展出当年科学家在简单窄小的居室兼办公室里生活，专心做试验的雕像及照片。这些科学精英在密封圈中与世隔绝21个月，据统计，平均每人体重两年内下降24磅，为的就是要探索给人类寻找第二空间，他们的敬业精神令人敬佩。 实 验室展示图中有科学家用手托起大玻璃球，里面装有地球上的各种生态物质，这是地球生态圈的「缩影」，科学家以它来演示和测试生态的平衡状况。然而，大自然 的生态系统相当复杂，难以复制，任何一种生物不能维持平衡，都会产生意外后果。据记载，由于生物圈中氧气和二氧化碳比例失衡，而导致居住其内的科学家失 眠、疲劳，蟑螂也从黑暗的角落爬出乱蹿，原本是荒凉的沙漠却绿草满地，鲜花怒放；海水酸臭噗鼻，生物圈2号试验不得不结束。 小贴士： 路线：从凤凰城往东南方向到土桑市，车程约2小时，途经I-17S/US-60E、I-10E、Congress St.、Broadway Blvd左转进入 S scott Ave便可到达。 开放时间：除感恩节和圣诞节外全年开放，开放时间为早上9时至下午4时。 门票：成人20元，62岁以上18元，AAA会员和军眷18元，六至12岁的青少年儿童13元，亚利桑那大学职员和学生凭证购票10元。 建议：景点属沙漠地带，11月至2月游览气候较佳。 电话：520-838-6200。 网址：http://www.b2science.org/。 生物圈2号的主体建筑。
04ee2ce62d42e065e56c84f52880d2ffd44faa07.translatedText: Tucson Biosphere 2 is a new experience of simulating the Earth. Scientists use the Earth as "Biosphere #1" and build a sealed laboratory that simulates the Earth's real ecological environment. It is called "Biosphere #2", also known as "Mini Earth". It is located in the desert south of Tucson, Arizona. Texas oil tycoon Edward Bass invested 200 million yuan to establish this laboratory in 1986 to build a large greenhouse for experiments in finding a second planet where humans might live. Eight scientists first moved in on September 26, 1991, and left 21 months later; another seven scientists moved in again on March 6, 1994, but ended in failure 10 months later, and now it has become a tourist attraction. The car was driving in the wilderness of sand dunes. Along the way, there were either sparse cacti and dead grass lying helplessly on the sand dunes, or the desolate yellow sand, abrupt hills and rugged mountains in the distance. "The destination is almost here!" At the reminder of the tour guide, the tourists looked into the distance. A flagpole with three flags flying was inserted into a large stone surrounded by cacti and dune plants. Biosphere #2 was engraved on the stone, and the pattern of the earth was engraved on it. "Biosphere 2" covers an area of ​​1.28 hectares. Its main body and ancillary parts are coated with powder white paint with special ingredients. The main body is a three-dimensional steel structure, sealed with double-layer glass, and looks like an Egyptian pyramid. The other ancillary parts are shaped like a long round white barrel and are the energy center, and those shaped like a hemisphere are air and temperature regulators. The bunker building added to the barrel may be the "residential area" of the year. These buildings on the sand dunes are full of science fiction. Follow the white corridor into the pyramid-shaped glass-reinforced plastic sealed ecological chamber. According to reports, the sealed ecological chamber includes five wildlife communities, namely tropical rainforest, grassland, ocean, swamp and desert. There are 4,000 species in the circle, including animals, plants and microorganisms from Australia, Africa and America. There are two artificial biomes, an agricultural area and a residential area. The residential area is equipped with kitchens, restaurants, dormitories, gyms, bathrooms, libraries, and laboratories. Scientists once lived here. They drank pure water naturally generated by the ecosystem, breathed oxygen released by the plants in the circle, and ate food grown by themselves. Entering the "Tropical Rainforest" area, the strong smell of grass hits your nostrils. The lush trees and shrubs are scattered in an orderly manner. The tall and stacked leaves are swaying, which are reflected in the clear river. The mist often turns into water droplets and drips on the heads of tourists. This is the most vibrant group of wild life in the biosphere. The other groups of objects are extremely desolate, but there is a cactus tree growing in the desert. It is very plump and strong, and it blooms many beautiful flower bulbs, adding color to the desert. Stepping into the "residential area" of the miniature city, the area displays statues and photos of scientists who lived in simple and narrow rooms and offices and concentrated on conducting experiments. These scientific elites were isolated from the outside world in a sealed ring for 21 months. According to statistics, each person lost an average of 24 pounds in two years in order to explore and find a second space for mankind. Their professionalism is admirable. In the laboratory display picture, scientists hold up a large glass ball with their hands, which contains various ecological substances on the earth. This is a "microcosm" of the earth's ecosystem. Scientists use it to demonstrate and test the ecological balance. However, nature's ecosystem is quite complex and difficult to replicate. If any organism cannot maintain balance, it will have unexpected consequences. According to records, due to the imbalance in the ratio of oxygen and carbon dioxide in the biosphere, scientists living in it suffered from insomnia and fatigue, and cockroaches crawled out of dark corners. The originally desolate desert was full of green grass and flowers bloomed; the seawater was sour and smelly, and the Biosphere 2 experiment had to end. Tips: Route: Go southeast from Phoenix to Tucson. It takes about 2 hours to drive. Pass I-17S/US-60E, I-10E, Congress St., Broadway Blvd and turn left into S Scott Ave. You can get there. Opening hours: Open all year round except Thanksgiving and Christmas, from 9 am to 4 pm. Tickets: $20 for adults, $18 for those 62 and older, $18 for AAA members and military dependents, $13 for children six to 12 years old, $10 for University of Arizona employees and students with a voucher. Recommendation: The scenic spot is in a desert area, and the weather is better when visiting from November to February. Phone: 520-838-6200. Website: http://www.b2science.org/. The main building of Biosphere 2.

de2ba662ec62ae7243b721e7af96d3031825cd65.sourceText: 《消费者报告》一篇分析文章揭示，该组织监测的全美猪肉样品当中69%都含小肠结肠炎耶尔森菌（Yersinia enterocolitica）。联邦疾病防治中心（CDC）认为那种细菌可能导致发烧、腹痛和腹泻。
de2ba662ec62ae7243b721e7af96d3031825cd65.translatedText: An analysis article by Consumer Reports revealed that 69% of U.S. pork samples monitored by the organization contained Yersinia enterocolitica. The federal Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) believes that bacteria may cause fever, abdominal pain and diarrhea.

0b0fbef2015b6a0e5180448e4a0fb04423f674e4.sourceText: 《消费者报告》称，大约7成猪肉含有病菌。（CNN图）
0b0fbef2015b6a0e5180448e4a0fb04423f674e4.translatedText: "Consumer Reports" stated that about 70% of pork contains pathogens. (CNN Photo)

17d5ba4aa4cfbccbfd8045cf3c74ae11ffbda5a7.sourceText: 将于2013年1月号发表的那篇文章说，《消费者报告》发现3-7%的样品含有沙门氏菌、金色葡萄球菌、单核细胞增多性李斯特氏菌和其它常见病菌。大约23%的样品没有含任何病菌。
17d5ba4aa4cfbccbfd8045cf3c74ae11ffbda5a7.translatedText: The article to be published in the January 2013 issue said that Consumer Reports found that 3-7% of samples contained Salmonella, Staphylococcus aureus, Listeria monocytogenes and other common germs. About 23% of the samples did not contain any germs.

f808eb4e09f0ed1492cf8cebc571565e1f3b8876.sourceText: 在198份样品中，该组织发现它们同其它”白肉”产生的并发症。样品还显示部分病菌对阿莫西林、青霉素、四环素和链霉素等典型的抗生素具有抗药性。含小肠结肠炎耶尔森菌的132份样品中，121份都对某种抗生素具有抗药性。
f808eb4e09f0ed1492cf8cebc571565e1f3b8876.translatedText: In 198 samples, the organization found complications with other "white meat". The samples also showed that some bacteria were resistant to typical antibiotics such as amoxicillin, penicillin, tetracycline and streptomycin. Of the 132 samples containing Yersinia enterocolitica, 121 were resistant to some type of antibiotic.

35596c443fd16b423afb462bff2a225ca0e0d5d4.sourceText: 《消费者报告》说，养猪场经常使用低剂量的抗生素可能加快抗药性”超级病毒”的繁殖，威胁人类健康。
35596c443fd16b423afb462bff2a225ca0e0d5d4.translatedText: "Consumer Reports" said that the frequent use of low-dose antibiotics in pig farms may accelerate the reproduction of drug-resistant "super viruses" and threaten human health.

bb2f3e7828f780858e0368e75d0dc54594a0d2f2.sourceText: 全国猪肉协会（National Pork Board）执行长诺瓦克（Chris Novak）立即通过《全国养猪农》（National Hog Farmer ）杂志发表文章反驳说，”我们相信《消费者报告》没有准确的说明猪肉产品的安全性及其质量。”
bb2f3e7828f780858e0368e75d0dc54594a0d2f2.translatedText: National Pork Board CEO Chris Novak immediately retorted through an article in National Hog Farmer magazine, saying, "We believe Consumer Reports does not accurately describe the safety and quality of pork products."

a838c3f3d3053e69a12e1f84f6d0ab65576f3c67.sourceText: 猪肉安全主任拉尔森（Steve Larsen）说，农场是细菌存在的自然环境，农民投入数百万美元研究并了解抗菌素和其它工具用于帮助他们为消费者生产健康和安全的产品。
a838c3f3d3053e69a12e1f84f6d0ab65576f3c67.translatedText: Pork Safety Director Steve Larson Larsen said farms are natural environments for bacteria, and farmers invest millions of dollars in research and understanding of antimicrobials and other tools to help them produce healthy and safe products for consumers.

8c5048187b7c66a39fd0c4a1b8c32b051ecaf8f1.sourceText: 《消费者报告》另一文章显示，240份猪肉样品当中，五分之一含有微量莱克多巴胺（ractopamine，瘦肉精）–那种有争议的兽医用药促进生长并提高瘦肉率。莱克多巴胺在1999年得到联邦食品医药局批准使用，但在包括中国和欧盟的160个国家受到禁止。
8c5048187b7c66a39fd0c4a1b8c32b051ecaf8f1.translatedText: Another article in Consumer Reports showed that one-fifth of 240 pork samples contained trace amounts of ractopamine (clenbuterol) – the controversial veterinary drug that promotes growth and increases lean meat content. Ractopamine was approved for use by the Federal Food and Drug Administration in 1999, but is banned in 160 countries, including China and the European Union.

bd4127e70fd1d1c6fd7614eaa5f0b31eccf34a52.sourceText: 老报骨：亚省短评之一-猜猜谁“No Money” 一位医师来电称：有人劝他，停下在本报的广告，因为报社经济危机，要使用不合格的纸张，要减少了印报数量。 据了解，本地几家中文报纸分别由两间工厂印刷。本报一向用名副其实的新闻纸，大报小报通行。从阅览、传放、邮寄和发行等方面考虑，无须用画纸，本报每期寄往州内州外、国内国外，订户数以千百计，用新闻纸轻便易折。承印本报是一家在几个大城市设厂的大企业，印刷版面颜色鲜明，送达各售报点，畅销一空。目前，本报每周的印量，分别为几家报纸的：近一倍、一倍半、七八倍。虽然，报社依赖的广告费收入，正处于最​​不理想的时期，但是．每周两期印费，从末欠账。工厂方面说，有家报纸则不然，己多次没有按时送版式来付印了，恐怕”No money”吧。 那位医师透露，劝他的人说，快找某报吧，广告费会比本报减半或大半！新上报的尤其优惠，头两个月或三个月不收钱，待生意好起来，才讨论价钱呀。能搞如此阔绰的游戏，怎会”No money”呢？ 君不见？某报开张时，后台老板有好几位，每人一千元、三千元、几千元，奉送基金。有家专刋说：某报是属于一位”富甲凤城”的华人，在亚省投资经营的企业。有位无名氏透露，该报主管几次满有信心表示：”本人不会去找广告的?”旁人猜想，一定有人”包起”。人们感到奇怪，这家报纸怎会落到”No money”的地步呢？消息灵通人说，这家报纸才出到第96期，提前四周通知做派对”一百期庆”，应邀者每人带一两百或几十元去，食布斐。看来”No money”就是某报吧？ 某报若然不是”No money”，为何要打破报业游戏规则，用卑劣的手段来去拉拢广告户呢？为何把经济危机的”药膏”贴到本报脸上呢？无非是贬低别人，以抬高自己！四邑人话:”此乃茶柜卖大包，一盅送两件，先顶冧对面，以后用劏牛刀来割也！”司马昭之心，路人皆知。奉劝读者，勿为节约几块钱，广告不登在当地发行最多、效力最大好的媒体上，而到缺乏公信力的地方去。钱花了收不到效效益，”赔了夫人又折兵”，到头来像近期关闭那几家餐馆，登广告Not money，后悔莫及！ 敢问那位高明的医师，怎样处方？ １ 18年前出版的亚省时报在市中心中国周活动中出現，照片登载于1994年2月5日的Arizona Republic亚利桑那共和報
bd4127e70fd1d1c6fd7614eaa5f0b31eccf34a52.translatedText: Old newspaper bones: One of the short comments on the province of Alberta - Guess who is "No Money" A doctor called and said: Someone advised him to stop advertising in this newspaper. Because of the economic crisis of the newspaper, he had to use substandard paper and reduce the number of printed newspapers. It is understood that several local Chinese newspapers are printed by two factories. This newspaper has always used newsprint worthy of the name, which is popular among broadsheets and tabloids. From the aspects of reading, broadcasting, mailing and distribution, there is no need to use drawing paper. Each issue of this newspaper is sent to thousands of subscribers within and outside the state, at home and abroad. Newsprint is light and easy to fold. This newspaper is printed by a large enterprise with factories in several big cities. The printed pages are brightly colored and delivered to various newspaper sales outlets, where they are sold out. At present, the weekly print volume of this newspaper is nearly double, one and a half times, and seven to eight times that of several newspapers. Although the advertising revenue that newspapers rely on is in the most unsatisfactory period, however. The printing fee is paid twice a week, and the debt will be owed from the end. The factory said that this is not the case for one newspaper. It has failed to deliver the layout for printing on time many times. I am afraid it "no money". The doctor revealed that the person who advised him said, hurry up and find a certain newspaper. The advertising fee will be half or more than half of this newspaper! There is a special discount for new applicants. There is no charge for the first two or three months. We will discuss the price after business picks up. How can you have "no money" when you can play such a lavish game? Don't you see me? When a certain newspaper opened, there were several bosses behind the scenes, each giving away funds of one thousand, three thousand, or several thousand yuan. One expert said: A certain newspaper is owned by a "rich Fengcheng" Chinese and is an enterprise invested and operated in Alberta. An anonymous person revealed that the newspaper's manager said with confidence several times: "I won't look for advertisements?" Others speculated that someone must be "covering up". People are wondering, how could this newspaper fall into the position of "no money"? A well-informed person said that this newspaper had only published its 96th issue and had given four weeks’ notice to hold a party to celebrate its 100th issue. Each invitee would bring one or two hundred or dozens of yuan to eat and drink. It seems that "No money" is from a certain newspaper, right? If a certain newspaper is not "no money", why should it break the rules of the newspaper industry and use despicable means to win over advertisers? Why put the "ointment" of the economic crisis on this newspaper's face? It’s nothing more than putting others down in order to elevate yourself! People in Siyi said: "This is a tea cabinet that sells big bags. One cup comes with two pieces. First, hold it against the opposite side, and then use an ox knife to cut it!" Sima Zhao's heart was known to everyone on the road. Readers are advised not to go to places that lack credibility in order to save a few dollars by not placing your advertisements in the local media with the largest circulation and the greatest effectiveness. The money is spent but the results are not achieved, "losing the wife and losing the army", in the end, like those restaurants that were closed recently, advertising was not money, and there is no regret! May I ask that wise doctor how to prescribe it? 1 The Alberta Times, published 18 years ago, appears at the China Week event in the city center. The photo appears in the Arizona Republic on February 5, 1994.

0beb6837b39e5adefcc70d2043888bde64f6f770.sourceText: 9月25日，”辽宁舰”正式交付海军。全舰官兵牢记嘱托，不辱使命，深入开展了”以优异成绩向党的十八大献礼”训练竞赛活动，围绕舰载机上舰，全舰各部门、各战位结合科研试验，凝聚力量、攻坚克难主动把试验与训练有机融合，以试验带动训练，以训练保障试验，大大提高了试训效率。入列以来，全舰完成了上百个训练科目和试验项目。
0beb6837b39e5adefcc70d2043888bde64f6f770.translatedText: On September 25, the "Liaoning Ship" was officially delivered to the Navy. The officers and soldiers of the ship kept in mind the instructions and fulfilled their mission, and carried out in-depth training and competition activities of "presenting outstanding achievements to the 18th National Congress of the Communist Party of China". Focusing on the boarding of carrier-based aircraft, all departments and combat positions of the whole ship combined scientific research and testing, gathered strength, and took the initiative to integrate testing and training to overcome difficulties. Combining experiments with training and training to support experiments has greatly improved the efficiency of trial training.

70997f0eee84e1a61433d85ca057e3a66fe5bd53.sourceText: 我国自己培养的首批舰载战斗机飞行员和舰上飞行指挥员，面对新机种、新科目、新环境、新要求，勇于探索，刻苦训练，把握规律，精益求精，按照?#22823;胆地飞，科学地飞，精准地飞?#30340;要求，进行了高强度飞行训练，探索并固化了着舰的飞行方法，突破了滑跃起飞、阻拦着舰等飞行关键技术，掌握了大侧风、低能见度、不稳定气流等条件下的偏差修正动作要领。在实际研练中，所有舰载机飞行员的训练成绩都达到了训练大纲规定标准和上舰试验要求，首次上舰飞行均一次成功。
70997f0eee84e1a61433d85ca057e3a66fe5bd53.translatedText: The first batch of carrier-based fighter pilots and shipboard flight commanders trained by my country have the courage to explore, train hard, grasp the rules, and strive for excellence in the face of new aircraft types, new subjects, new environments, and new requirements. In accordance with the requirements of "Fly courageously, fly scientifically, and fly accurately", we conducted high-intensity flight training, explored and solidified the flight method of landing on the ship, made breakthroughs in key flight technologies such as ski jump take-off and blocked landing, and mastered the essentials of deviation correction actions under conditions such as strong crosswinds, low visibility, and unstable airflow. In the actual training, the training results of all carrier-based aircraft pilots reached . According to the standards stipulated in the training syllabus and the shipboard test requirements, the first shipboard flight was a success.

5daf8f87d0d682f6bf616b2f19d24ea4ce372aaa.sourceText: 歼?5飞机是我国自行设计研制的首型舰载多用途战斗机，具有完全的自主知识产权，可遂行制空、制海等作战任务，飞行性能良好，配挂多型精确制导武器，具备远程打击和昼夜间作战能力。
5daf8f87d0d682f6bf616b2f19d24ea4ce372aaa.translatedText: The J-5 aircraft is my country's first self-designed and developed carrier-based multi-purpose fighter aircraft. It has completely independent intellectual property rights and can perform air and sea control missions. It has good flight performance, is equipped with multiple types of precision guidance weapons, and has long-range strike and day and night combat capabilities.

91603033d194916af29e7aaa748dec0d409af9c8.sourceText: 尹曦荣任亚省华人高科技协会２０１２－１３年度主席 亚省华人高科技协会本周任命尹曦为2012-13年度主席。该协会成立于2002年，现有会员100余人，主要分布于英特尔、美满等各大公司，亚省州立大学也有部分会员。 尹曦，男，汉族，1982年生，云南昆明人，清华大学机械工程系学士，加州大学伯克利分校工学博士，现任英特尔公司高级封装工程师。目前从事的研发工作主要为智能手机和平板电脑微处理器的封装结构设计和工艺优化。著有顶级期刊一作文章六篇，曾四次在国际会议上做学术报告，并于2010年荣获中国政府颁发的国家优秀自费留学生奖学金。
91603033d194916af29e7aaa748dec0d409af9c8.translatedText: Yin Xirong was appointed as the 2012-13 Chairman of the Chinese High-tech Association of Alberta. The Chinese High-tech Association of Alberta appointed Yin Xi as the 2012-13 Chairman this week. The association was established in 2002 and currently has more than 100 members, mainly distributed in major companies such as Intel and Marvell, and there are also some members from Alberta State University. Yin Xi, male, Han nationality, born in 1982 in Kunming, Yunnan, holds a bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering from Tsinghua University and a doctorate in engineering from the University of California, Berkeley. He is currently a senior packaging engineer at Intel Corporation. The research and development work he is currently engaged in is mainly the packaging structure design and process optimization of microprocessors for smartphones and tablet computers. He has authored six articles in top journals, given academic reports at international conferences four times, and won the National Scholarship for Outstanding Self-financed Students Abroad awarded by the Chinese government in 2010.

96c82e51112acdac00aa74533ab0f6dbce673a49.sourceText: Fry’s超级市场支持亚裔妇女健康计划 Fry’s超级市场最近捐赠五千美元给亚太社区促进会，供做乳癌教育与认知计划，此项命名为”亚裔妇女初歩行动”的计划为亚裔以及太平洋岛裔妇女提供乳癌教育与筛查服务。 研究显示此二族群在所有族群当中最不可能接受早期乳腺癌检测。 亚太社区促进会执行会长Doug Hirano先生说:我们很髙兴Fry’s超级巿场支持我们在乳癌认知方面所做的努力，有了这些资金我们可以教育上百位髙风险的妇女并继续破解”亚裔妇不会罹患乳癌”的迷思。 亚太社区促进会是以鳯凰城为基地旳非营利基机构，其任务是改善居住在鳯凰城大都会亚太裔人士的健康，更多訉息请致电亚太社区促进会，电话：(602) 265-4598或是浏览促进会网站: www.apcaaz.org。 Fry’s超级市场的​​总部在Tolleson市，此公司雇用一万七千多位亚利桑纳卅人士，旗下一百一十九家商店每星期为上百万家庭服务，自一九六零年起为亚利桑纳卅提供新鲜食品，并以低价位闻名，Fry’s是以俄亥俄州辛辛那提市为基地的Kroger公司会员公司之一，更多訉息，请浏览Fry’s网站: www.frysfood.com 。
96c82e51112acdac00aa74533ab0f6dbce673a49.translatedText: Fry’s Supermarket supports Asian Women’s Health Initiative Fry’s Supermarkets recently donated $5,000 to the Asian Pacific Community Advancement Association for a breast cancer education and awareness program. This program, called the Asian Women’s First Steps Initiative, provides breast cancer education and screening services to Asian and Pacific Islander women. Research shows that these two groups are the least likely of all groups to receive early breast cancer testing. Doug Hirano, Executive Director of the Asia Pacific Community Initiative, said: “We are very pleased that Fry’s Super Market supports our breast cancer awareness efforts. With these funds, we can educate hundreds of at-risk women and continue to dispel the myth that Asian women do not get breast cancer.” APCA is a non-profit foundation based in Phoenix. Its mission is to improve the health of Asian and Pacific Islanders living in the Phoenix metropolitan area. For more information, please call APCA at (602) 265-4598 or visit the APCA website: www.apcaaz.org. Fry’s Supermarkets is headquartered in Tolleson. The company employs more than 17,000 Arizonans. Its 119 stores serve millions of households every week. It has provided fresh food to Arizona since 1960 and is famous for its low prices. Fry’s is a member company of Kroger Company based in Cincinnati, Ohio. For more information, please visit Fry’s website: www.frysfood.com .

0e56e0c3d3ff9e89f297ded5d56f40e39764fb1f.sourceText: 马利科巴郡10个危险路口 5个在凤凰城 （亚省时报） 日前，亚利桑那州交通部发布马利科巴郡十个危险交叉路口，令人惊讶的是，其中有一半在凤凰城。 州交通部是根据2010年各市警察局资料，将人身伤害或车辆损伤超过1000美元的车祸列成数据表得出结论。 凤凰城最危险路口在Dunlap和35th avenues，也是马利科巴郡第二危险路口。其他包括Peoria和43rd avenues，59th Avenue和Indian School Road，35th和Peoria avenues，43rd Avenue 和Thomas Road。以上路段多在凤凰城西北部，其中35th avenue两个路口事故发生率高。 据美国汽车协会亚利桑那发言人蜜雪儿多纳蒂说，从2010年至2011年，本州车祸总体上下降了3%，但同期致命事故增加了8.7%。多纳蒂说，尽管交通部门为减少车祸事故做了很大努力，但各驾车人也应该承担安全责任。
0e56e0c3d3ff9e89f297ded5d56f40e39764fb1f.translatedText: 10 dangerous intersections in Maricopa County, 5 in Phoenix (Alberta Times) The Arizona Department of Transportation recently released ten dangerous intersections in Maricopa County, and surprisingly, half of them are in Phoenix. The state Department of Transportation came to its conclusion based on 2010 data from city police departments, tabulating data on crashes in which personal injury or vehicle damage exceeded $1,000. The most dangerous intersection in Phoenix is ​​at Dunlap and 35th avenues, and the second most dangerous intersection in Maricopa County. Others include Peoria and 43rd avenues, 59th Avenue and Indian School Road, 35th and Peoria avenues, 43rd Avenue and Thomas Road. Most of the above road sections are in northwest Phoenix, and the two intersections of 35th avenue have a high accident rate. According to AAA Arizona spokesperson Michelle Donati, crashes in the state overall dropped 3 percent from 2010 to 2011, but fatal crashes increased 8.7 percent during the same period. Donati said that while transportation agencies have made great efforts to reduce crashes, individual motorists should also bear safety responsibilities.

9e6d96c4c5cf4b9c33dbb478ac12754f534a00fc.sourceText: 日光节约时间(daylight saving time)已结束 （亚省时报） 加拿大和美国的日光节约时间(daylight saving time)于11月4日凌晨结束，恢复使用标准时间(standard time)，美国大部分地区将时钟拨慢一个小时。 为了节约用电，美加两地每年3月的第二个周日起使用日光节约时间，将时钟拨快一小时；每年11月的第一个周日起恢复标准时间，将时钟拨慢一小时。 消防及紧急救援机构建议，每年这个时候除将时钟拨慢一小时外，还应顺便检查一下家中的火警及一氧化碳警报器，及时更换失效的电池，以免火灾或一氧化碳中毒等意外事件发生。 亚利桑那州只有东北部那瓦霍印第安保留地使用日光节约时间，时间改变对本州居民日常生活影响不大，只是出门往外州时注意飞行时刻表变化。
9e6d96c4c5cf4b9c33dbb478ac12754f534a00fc.translatedText: Daylight saving time (daylight saving time) has ended (Alberta Times) Canada and the United States daylight saving time (daylight saving time) ended in the early morning of November 4th, and the use of standard time (standard time) resumed time), most parts of the United States set their clocks back one hour. In order to save electricity, the United States and Canada use daylight saving time every year to set clocks forward one hour; starting on the first Sunday in November every year, they return to standard time and set clocks back one hour. Fire and emergency rescue agencies recommend that at this time of year, in addition to setting clocks back one hour, you should also check your home's fire alarms and carbon monoxide alarms, and replace failed batteries in time to avoid accidents such as fires or carbon monoxide poisoning. Only the Navajo Indian Reservation in northeastern Arizona uses daylight saving time. The time change has little impact on the daily life of residents in the state. Just pay attention to changes in flight schedules when going out of state.

0814426525d27439ef11cd5d73f5ab1771400be6.sourceText: 如果国会不采取行动，任由政府明年1月坠入「财政悬崖」，自动开始的全面削减政府与军事支出，国家公园管理局也将自动减少2亿1800万元预算，全国最多200个国家公园将可能关闭。 对于明年出现的「财政悬崖」问题，更多人是关注国防预算的削减，实际上国家公园局的预算被砍，显示「财政悬崖」将影响到美国人的日常生活。 支持公园的人士认为，削减8.2%的预算将对全美398个国家公园造成沉重打击。削减还将导致宿营地和游客中心被关闭，和旅游旺季的公园管理人员减少。 卡托研究所分析人员德海文说，国家公园局的资金已经减少，他建议，决策者可允许州府和私人部门管理部分公园，「国会面临的问题较严重，他们没有能力顾及到每一方面」。 国家公园局将削减的2亿1800万元预算，是奥巴马政府以2012年的预算为基础，在今年9月提出的，2013年将开始执行。 本州共有30个州立公园，根据北亚利桑那大学2007年研究，州立公园游客一年产生超过2.66亿美元经济效益，并支持3347个就业机会。今年有两个州立公园（Oracle和Picacho Peak）因财政困难关闭，五个每周关闭一到两天，只有14个保持全日开放。州府已经成立特别小组，成员包括银行代表、公共服务公司及州立大学学者、大自然保护协会代表等，专门研究维护州立公园财政问题。
0814426525d27439ef11cd5d73f5ab1771400be6.translatedText: If Congress does not take action and the government is allowed to fall into the "fiscal cliff" in January next year, comprehensive cuts in government and military expenditures will automatically begin. The National Park Service will also automatically reduce its budget by 218 million yuan, and up to 200 national parks across the country may be closed. Regarding the "fiscal cliff" issue that will arise next year, more people are paying attention to the cuts in the defense budget. In fact, the budget of the National Park Service has been cut, which shows that the "fiscal cliff" will affect the daily lives of Americans. Park supporters believe that the 8.2% budget cut will be a heavy blow to the 398 national parks in the United States. The cuts will also result in the closure of campgrounds and visitor centers and a reduction in park management staff during the peak tourist season. DeHaven, an analyst at the Cato Institute, said that funding for the National Park Service has been reduced. He suggested that policymakers allow state governments and the private sector to manage some parks. "The problem facing Congress is more serious. They do not have the ability to take into account every aspect." The $218 million budget cut by the National Park Service was proposed by the Obama administration in September this year based on the 2012 budget, and will be implemented in 2013. There are 30 state parks in the state, and according to a 2007 study by Northern Arizona University, state park visitors generate more than $266 million in economic benefits a year and support 3,347 jobs. Two state parks (Oracle and Picacho Peak) have closed this year due to financial difficulties, five have closed one or two days a week, and only 14 remain open full time. The state government has established a special group, whose members include bank representatives, public service companies and state university scholars, and representatives from the Nature Conservancy, to study the financial issues of maintaining state parks.

87c326997cffa4b87f431a1a952800af0dfb28de.sourceText: 清爽秋日 Lake Pleasant之旅 （亚省时报福娃报导） 10月的亚利桑那凉爽宜人。沿着17号高速公路往北，路旁山峦起伏，绿树成荫，将骄阳全然遮去。及至湖边，Lake Pleasant的一片湖光山色让终日与南山公园仙人掌，骆驼山红色巨石为伴的Phoenix来客眼前为之一亮。 10月月28日，由中国科学家工程师协会亚利桑那分会（科工专）精心组织的活动就在Lake Pleasant湖畔拉开了帷幕。随着活动组织者AMOY Yang一声召唤，老老少少三十多人沿着山路进发。山势并不险峻，路上大家纷纷说起去年四月在此登山的情景，四月水量丰富，山涧中到处是溪流，如今不见了溪水，甚至连浮桥都干干地躺在了山崖上，似乎少了很多乐趣。那您就大大的想错了，路上的美景和惊奇连连出现，一只有一尺多长的大乌龟，非常悠闲的看着我，俨然成了大牌明星，大家纷纷”荣幸”地与这位”老寿星”合影。到了湖边，孩子们争相地看湖上的游艇和摩托，还有些朋友沿着湖边行走，还顺路把苍耳用鞋”顺走”，成为了本次爬山最有”野趣”的佐证。 欢乐大合影 美食的诱惑 童趣 最具特色的登山鞋 还有我！
87c326997cffa4b87f431a1a952800af0dfb28de.translatedText: Refreshing Autumn Trip to Lake Pleasant (Reported by Fuwa, the Alberta Times) Arizona is cool and pleasant in October. Going north along Highway 17, the roadside is surrounded by rolling hills and green trees, completely blocking the scorching sun. Arriving at the lakeside, the beautiful scenery of Lake Pleasant dazzles Phoenix visitors who spend all day with the cactus in Nanshan Park and the red boulders of Camel Mountain. On October 28, the event carefully organized by the Arizona Branch of the Chinese Association of Scientists and Engineers (Science and Engineering College) kicked off at the shore of Lake Pleasant. Following the call from event organizer AMOY Yang, more than 30 people, old and young, set off along the mountain road. The mountain is not steep. Everyone on the way talked about the scene of climbing here last April. There was abundant water in April and there were streams everywhere in the mountain streams. Now there are no streams. Even the pontoons are lying dry on the cliffs. It seems that there is a lot less fun. Then you are greatly mistaken. The beautiful scenery and surprises appeared one after another on the road. A big turtle over a foot long looked at me very leisurely, as if he had become a big-name star. Everyone was "honored" to take photos with this "old birthday star". When we arrived at the lake, the children rushed to see the yachts and motorcycles on the lake. Some friends walked along the lake and "walked" the cockleburs with their shoes along the way, which became the most "wild fun" of this mountain climbing. Happy group photo, the temptation of delicious food, childlike fun, the most unique hiking shoes, and me!

167e9a5d910f770bd149bb92ae107ecc66285675.sourceText: 社区学院毕业生 就业率大增 两年制社区学院的毕业生找工作可能比四年制大学毕业生更容易，联邦劳工部18日说，过去六个月，拥有副学士学位(associate degree)的就业增多57万8000个，达 3520万个，而学士以上学位的就业只增加31万4000个，为4650万人。 两年制学院毕业生的就业增多趋势，说明了经济衰退时期消失的中等技能职位正重新回来，也可能标志着中等技能的工作今后将继续增多，如工厂机械工人、冷暖维修工、X光透视 技师、医务服务人员和中低层的管理人员等。 乔治城大学的教育与劳动力研究中心主任卡内维尔说﹕「与要求学士学位的职位相比，副学士学位的就业近年来没有增加，但现在可能开始增加。」 不过，高中以下教育水平的就业，自经济衰退出现剧降之后，2010年以来一直停滞不前。 工厂、建筑业和其他中等技能的许多工作在经济衰退后消失，但学士以上学位的就业却只有微幅下降。 在2010和2011年的复苏期，四年制大学毕业生的就业，比两年制的社区学院增多两倍以上。 在经济周期中，雇主在衰退阶段裁减低技能的工作，复苏时期是先招高技能的员工，最终通过高层管理人员安排中低层的管理人员。 目前就处于这一阶段，社区学院的毕业生开始承担衰退时期消失的工作，意味着经济复苏的势头强劲。 卡内维尔认为，目前的趋势还说明，经快速培训即可就业的技术工人，市场需求也在增多。 许多被裁人员为适应新职业的要求，近年来到社区学院和技术学校进修。 全国教育统计中心说，经培训后重新就业的人从2007年以来增多14.6%，但2007年前的五年只增加1.3%。
167e9a5d910f770bd149bb92ae107ecc66285675.translatedText: The employment rate of community college graduates has increased significantly. It may be easier for graduates of two-year community colleges to find jobs than graduates of four-year universities. The federal Labor Department said on the 18th that in the past six months, employment for those with associate degrees increased by 578,000 to 35.2 million, while employment for those with bachelor's degrees or above increased by only 314,000 to 46.5 million. The growing employment trend for graduates from two-year colleges illustrates the return of middle-skill jobs that disappeared during the recession, and may also be a sign that middle-skill jobs will continue to increase in the future, such as factory mechanics, heating and cooling maintenance workers, X-ray technicians, medical service personnel, and middle- and lower-level managers. "Compared with jobs requiring a bachelor's degree, employment with associate's degrees has not increased in recent years, but it may be starting to increase now," said Carneville, director of Georgetown University's Center for Education and Workforce Studies. However, employment with education below high school has stagnated since 2010, following a sharp decline in the recession. Many jobs in factories, construction and other middle-skill jobs disappeared after the recession, but employment with bachelor's degrees and above declined only slightly. During the recovery period of 2010 and 2011, employment for four-year college graduates more than tripled that of two-year community college graduates. In an economic cycle, employers shed low-skilled jobs during the recession phase, hire high-skilled workers first during the recovery phase, and eventually move middle and lower-level managers through top management. We are currently in this phase, where community college graduates are beginning to take on jobs that disappeared during the recession, which means that the economic recovery is gaining momentum. Carnevale believes that current trends also indicate that there is an increasing market demand for skilled workers who can be quickly trained and ready for employment. In order to adapt to the requirements of new occupations, many laid-off workers have gone to community colleges and technical schools for further education in recent years. The National Center for Education Statistics said that the number of people re-employed after training has increased by 14.6% since 2007, but only increased by 1.3% in the five years before 2007.

28fce930ff60043d0c3ebff1446c5e134c808933.sourceText: CMJ纽约最大音乐节 唱响华语摇滚 CMJ音乐节纽约历史最久，规模最大的音乐节，18号晚音乐节在联合广场开幕，来自全球各地的音乐人参加了这场狂欢派对。 在纽约联合广场公园，CMJ音乐节今晚在这里火热开场。 离表演开始还有半个小时，演出大厅外的歌迷就已经排起了长队，期待一睹偶像的风采。 当晚的表演也是火爆异常，只限300人的演出场地被挤得水泄不通，纽约CMJ音乐节自创办以来，今年是第二次有华语音乐的声音，享有”五月天”接班人的摇滚乐团”831”，五个年轻的小伙子激情四射的演出，让现场的气氛嗨到爆棚。 乐手们表示，他们走上音乐的道路大多是受来自欧美流行音乐的影响，不过近年来华语音乐的迅猛发展，让音乐人对华语音乐走向国际舞台都充满着信心。此次受邀参加音乐节的华语乐团还有嘻哈团体”大嘴巴”，和以电子音乐结合摇滚的乐团”化学猴子”。 CMJ自1980年开始举办音乐活动，数百场”音乐马拉松”演出，每年都会吸引超过12万年轻音乐迷前来观看，也是业界发掘新星以及歌手乐队崭露头角的平台。（美国中文网 赵沐沕）
28fce930ff60043d0c3ebff1446c5e134c808933.translatedText: CMJ New York's largest music festival, singing Chinese rock music CMJ Music Festival is the oldest and largest music festival in New York. The music festival opened in Union Square on the evening of the 18th. Musicians from all over the world participated in this carnival party. In New York's Union Square Park, the CMJ Music Festival kicks off tonight. Half an hour before the performance started, fans were already queuing up outside the performance hall, looking forward to catching a glimpse of their idol. The performance that night was also extremely popular, and the performance venue, which was limited to 300 people, was packed to the brim. This was the second time since the establishment of the New York CMJ Music Festival that there was the sound of Chinese music. The rock band "831", the successor of "Mayday", and the passionate performance of five young guys made the atmosphere full of excitement. The musicians said that their path to music was mostly influenced by pop music from Europe and the United States. However, the rapid development of Chinese music in recent years has given musicians full confidence in Chinese music entering the international stage. The Chinese bands invited to participate in the music festival this time include the hip-hop group "Big Mouth" and the band "Chemical Monkey" that combines electronic music with rock. CMJ has been organizing music events since 1980. Hundreds of "Music Marathon" performances attract more than 120,000 young music fans every year. It is also a platform for the industry to discover new stars and emerging singers and bands. (USChinese.com Zhao Muchu)

According to recent data, Phoenix has one of the highest moving rates in the country. New data shows that 78.9% of citizens did not move in 2011. At least 1 million city residents moved across the U.S. last year, with Austin and Las Vegas having the lowest resident stability. Across the United States, Phoenix's citizen stability rate ranks 457th out of 520 cities. There are many reasons for relocation, including buying a larger new house due to low housing prices, or choosing to go bankrupt and become a renter. There's also the resurgence of Phoenix's industry and the immigration that comes with new job opportunities. Tucson's stability rate is better, ranking 451st. In the Phoenix area, 16.9% of people moved within the state in 2011. 3.5% moved to Phoenix from out of state, and 0.75% immigrated overseas. 53765b6abf5b7d29f22d20a2c0ab05d4b86d73c6.sourceText: 美国知名谷类早餐制造商「家乐」公司(Kellogg)，11日主动召回280万盒有糖霜和无糖霜的「Mini-Wheats」谷麦片(cereal)，因为产品中可能有金属小碎片。 这类产品包装大小不一，行销全美。 召回产品的名称为「Frosted Mini-Wheats Bite Size Original」及「Mini-Wheats Unfrosted Bite Size」，在「保鲜期限」前面或后面印有KB、AP或FK字样，包装包括一次食用碗装，也有 70盎司大纸盒包装。 保鲜期限自2013年4月1日至2013年9月21日。 家乐公司透过联邦食品暨药物管理局(FDA)发表声明表示，由于制造零件有缺陷，前述产品中可能出现零件掉下的有弹性金属网线(flexible metal mesh)。 声明并说：「我们了解消费者的关切，深表歉意。」 消费者可在食药局(FDA)网站找到家乐公司召回产品的完整清单和产品条码(UPC code)。 如有问题要与该公司连络，可打免费电话：800-962-1413(美东时间周一至周五上午8时至下午6时)。
53765b6abf5b7d29f22d20a2c0ab05d4b86d73c6.translatedText: Kellogg, a well-known American breakfast cereal manufacturer, voluntarily recalled 2.8 million boxes of "Mini-Wheats" cereal (cereal) with and without frosting on the 11th because there may be small metal fragments in the product. These products come in various sizes and are sold throughout the United States. The names of the recalled products are "Frosted Mini-Wheats Bite Size Original" and "Mini-Wheats Unfrosted Bite Size", with the words KB, AP or FK printed before or after the "shelf life". The packaging includes single-serve bowls and 70-ounce large cartons. The shelf life is from April 1, 2013 to September 21, 2013. Knorr issued a statement through the Federal Food and Drug Administration (FDA) saying that due to defective manufacturing parts, flexible metal mesh may appear in the above-mentioned products and the parts may fall off. The statement also said: "We understand consumers' concerns and deeply apologize." Consumers can find a complete list of Knorr's recalled products and product barcodes (UPC codes) on the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) website. If you have any questions and want to contact the company, you can call the toll-free number: 800-962-1413 (Monday to Friday, 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. ET).

5609a7f11fbd3dea37f61bfe93e52132aefb5e8f.translatedText: College tuition fees exceed 60,000 (Alberta Times) A ​​college degree in the United States may be becoming less and less valuable, but the cost of a four-year college education continues to rise. College News…

b6bdfb5dabb890f8ad325ad84c64a783f8c38579.sourceText: 美国大学学位或许越来越不值钱，但是大学四年教育费用却持续上涨。 大学新闻刊物Campus Grotto说，读大学一年的学费，今年首度超过6万元。 Campus Grotto每年都编纂名单，列出全美最昂贵的大学。 Campus Grotto今年的名单显示，超过70所大学学费都在5万5000元以上。 位于纽约州的莎拉劳伦斯学院(Sarah Lawrence College)拔得今年名单的头筹，一年费用要6万1236元，其次为纽约大学(5万9837元)，位于加州的哈维穆德学院(Harvey Mudd College)则名列第三，一年学费5万8913元，紧接其后的则是纽约哥伦比亚大学(5万8742元)，以及位于康州的卫斯理阳大学(5万8202 元) 。 这种价位得学费使得学生必须透过学生贷款和其他途径，寻求财务奥援。 这也促使学贷总额水涨船高。 丕优研究中心(Pew Research Center)最新报告指出，全美有五分之一的家庭须求助于学生贷款。 去年全美就学贷款超越1兆元。 户主35岁以下的家庭，有40%背负着学生贷款。 所有背负学贷的家庭，平均未偿还贷款额度从2007年的2万3349元，增加到2010年的2万6682元。 在各州缩减高等教育预算，加上诸如乔治亚、亚利桑那和加州等州大幅调涨学费的煽风点火下，四年学制公立大学学费在2008年至2010年平均上扬了15%。 根据Campus Grotto的这份排行榜，美国今年最贵大学的6至10名分别是：加州的克莱蒙迈金纳学院(claremont mckenna college，5万8065元)、位于新罕布夏州的长春藤 盟校达特茅斯学院( Dartmouth College，5万7996元)、宾州的爵克索大学(Drexel University，5万7975元)、芝加哥大学(U. of Chicago，5万7711元)，以及位于 纽约州的巴德学院(Bard College，5万7580元)。
b6bdfb5dabb890f8ad325ad84c64a783f8c38579.translatedText: A college degree in the United States may be becoming less valuable, but the cost of a four-year college education continues to rise. Campus Grotto, a university news publication, said the tuition for a year of college exceeded $60,000 for the first time this year. Campus Grotto compiles a list of the most expensive colleges in the United States each year. This year's Campus Grotto list shows that more than 70 universities have tuition fees above $55,000. Sarah Lawrence College in New York State topped this year's list, with a yearly tuition of $61,236, followed by New York University ($59,837). Harvey Mudd College in California ranked third, with a yearly tuition of $58,913, followed by Columbia University in New York ($58,742) and Wesleyan University in Connecticut ($58,202). Tuition at this price level requires students to seek financial assistance through student loans and other means. This has also caused the total amount of student loans to rise. A new report from the Pew Research Center states that one in five families in the United States has to resort to student loans. Last year, U.S. student debt exceeded $1 trillion. 40% of households with heads under the age of 35 have student loans. The average outstanding amount of student loan debt for all households increased from $23,349 in 2007 to $26,682 in 2010. Tuition at four-year public colleges rose an average of 15 percent from 2008 to 2010, fueled by state cuts to higher education budgets and steep tuition hikes in states such as Georgia, Arizona and California. According to the Campus Grotto ranking, the 6 to 10 most expensive universities in the United States this year are: Claremont McKenna College in California ($58,065), Dartmouth College (Dartmouth College), an Ivy League school in New Hampshire ($57,996), Drexel University in Pennsylvania ($57,975), and the University of Chicago (U. of Chicago ($57,711), and Bard College in New York State ($57,580).

fa6cb26832c26c1f34e1382e817734f99e7b7d56.sourceText: 皮尤民调:4成中国人不信任奥巴马 CNN称，民调机构皮尤研究中心公布调查显示，认为中美是合作伙伴关系的受访中国人比例，由2年前的68%大幅滑落至39%。 中国对美国的正面看法和观点近两年出现快速降低的趋势。43%成年受访者对美国抱持好感，2010年为58%，减少15个百分点，但不抱好感者由37%升高至48%，增加11个百分点。 39%的受访者认为美中两国是合作伙伴关系，上次民调结果为68%，大幅减少29个百分点。认为两国关系具有敌意者，由8%提高至26%，增加18个百分点。 对总统奥巴马有信心的中国人，由两年前的52%降低至38%，减少14个百分点，没有信心者由30%增加至41%。2009年，57%中国人赞成奥巴马的外交政策，如今，仅27%表示赞同。在如何应对全球经济问题和”亚洲轴心”政策上，中国人给奥巴马打分也很低。多数中国人对美国的意图表示忧虑，52%的中国人认为美国试图阻止中国成为一个大国。 除了美中关系下滑，中国人也不看好中国和日本、印度的关系。超过4成受访者认为中日具有敌意，只有3成认为中国和日本是合作关系，39%认为中国与印度可以合作，结果和两年前相较，都出现大幅滑落的现象。 尽管如此，需要指出的是，中国社会各阶层对美国的态度差别很大。年轻，学历高，收入高，生活在城市的中国人更乐意接受美国的流行文化和做事方式，30岁以下，略微上过大学的城市居民和高收入者表示，他们喜欢美国的民主观。多数中国人喜欢更加开放的社会。 调查显示，中国人对中国经济发展仍持保留态度，48%受访者认为，美国才是全球经济的龙头，只有29%说中国已经领先。 皮尤研究中心在今年3月18日至4月15日间，对3177名中国成年人进行面对面访谈。
fa6cb26832c26c1f34e1382e817734f99e7b7d56.translatedText: Pew poll: 40% of Chinese people do not trust Obama CNN said that a survey released by the polling agency Pew Research Center showed that the proportion of Chinese respondents who believed that China and the United States were a cooperative partnership fell sharply from 68% two years ago to 39%. China's positive views and opinions on the United States have shown a rapid downward trend in the past two years. 43% of adult respondents have a favorable opinion of the United States, compared with 58% in 2010, a decrease of 15 percentage points, but those who have a disfavorable opinion increased from 37% to 48%, an increase of 11 percentage points. 39% of the respondents believe that the United States and China are a cooperative partnership, compared with 68% in the last poll, a significant decrease of 29 percentage points. Those who believe that the relationship between the two countries is hostile increased from 8% to 26%, an increase of 18 percentage points. The number of Chinese who have confidence in President Obama dropped to 38% from 52% two years ago, a decrease of 14 percentage points, while those who have no confidence increased from 30% to 41%. In 2009, 57% of Chinese people approved of Obama's foreign policy; today, only 27% agree. The Chinese also gave Obama low marks on how to deal with global economic problems and the "Asia Axis" policy. Most Chinese people are worried about the intentions of the United States, with 52% of Chinese people believing that the United States is trying to prevent China from becoming a great power. In addition to the decline in U.S.-China relations, the Chinese are also not optimistic about China's relations with Japan and India. More than 40% of the respondents believe that China and Japan are hostile, only 30% believe that China and Japan have a cooperative relationship, and 39% believe that China and India can cooperate. Compared with two years ago, there has been a significant decline. Nonetheless, it needs to be pointed out that attitudes towards the United States vary widely among different classes of Chinese society. Young, well-educated, high-income Chinese who live in cities are more willing to accept American pop culture and ways of doing things. Urban residents and high-income earners who are under 30 years old, slightly college-educated, say they like the American view of democracy. Most Chinese prefer a more open society. The survey shows that Chinese people still have reservations about China's economic development. 48% of respondents believe that the United States is the leader of the global economy, while only 29% say that China is already leading. The Pew Research Center conducted face-to-face interviews with 3,177 Chinese adults from March 18 to April 15 this year.

30c0856cfd4a3c4e2de362534e4e0e7c250dec82.translatedText: Passport can be used as an ID card

096da26073d0d44ee384b7af045f733d5476223b.sourceText: 国侨办政策法规司司长王晓萍介绍说，这些法规 根据”以人为本”的原则保护华侨在国内的权益，包括：华侨凭中国护照，而不需中国身份证，便可以办理驾照、开户、保险等事务；在国内就业的华侨可参加社区 保险；华侨与港澳台学生一样参加联合招生，而不需参加国内高考，华侨享受小学到初中的免交学费义务教育；享受国家吸引人才的优惠政策；侨胞回国捐款支持公 益事业，实行”自觉自愿”原则；华侨与中国国内居民结婚，如果子女在境外，可在国内生一个子女，国外子女可到国内落户，但要交社会抚养费。
096da26073d0d44ee384b7af045f733d5476223b.translatedText: Wang Xiaoping, director of the Policy and Regulations Department of the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the State Council, said that these regulations protect the rights and interests of overseas Chinese in the country based on the principle of "people-oriented", including: overseas Chinese can apply for driver's licenses, account openings, insurance and other matters with a Chinese passport without a Chinese ID card; overseas Chinese employed in the country can participate in community Insurance; overseas Chinese participate in joint enrollment like students from Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan, and do not need to take the domestic college entrance examination. Overseas Chinese enjoy tuition-free compulsory education from primary school to junior high school; enjoy the country's preferential policies to attract talents; overseas Chinese return to China to donate to support public welfare undertakings, implementing the principle of "volunteer"; overseas Chinese marry a Chinese resident, and if their children are abroad, they can have a child in China, and foreign children can settle in China, but they must pay social support fees.

e0e325abc13dac99cb44a2cbda83ea143f0d4fb1.translatedText: Overseas Chinese returning to the country to settle down

111859523fc53d931eb1b45f7fc8a28a3793192d.sourceText: 华侨回国定居近年来受到关注，王晓萍解释说，华侨回国定居与华侨在国内居住不同。华侨持中国护照可以自由出境入境，在中国境内居住不受时间限制。华侨回国定居实际上是恢复常住户口或设立常住户口，如果华侨并不是想回国落户，不需要申请回国定居。
111859523fc53d931eb1b45f7fc8a28a3793192d.translatedText: Overseas Chinese returning to the country to settle down have received attention in recent years. Wang Xiaoping explained that the return of overseas Chinese to settle in the country is different from the overseas Chinese living in the country. Overseas Chinese can freely enter and leave the country with Chinese passports, and there are no time restrictions on living in China. For overseas Chinese to return to the country to settle down is actually to restore their permanent residence or establish a permanent residence. If the overseas Chinese do not want to return to the country to settle down, they do not need to apply to return to the country to settle down.

0135f13e4b11bc5da8d203978b636222a99a3723.sourceText: 公安部出入境管理局副局长曲云海说，华侨回国定居有逐步增加的趋势，2011年该部门受理了近一万人回国定居。
0135f13e4b11bc5da8d203978b636222a99a3723.translatedText: Qu Yunhai, deputy director of the Exit-Entry Administration Bureau of the Ministry of Public Security, said that there is a gradual increase in the number of overseas Chinese returning to settle in China. In 2011, the department accepted nearly 10,000 people returning to settle in China.

b1b51dda49aa302678af7085adfd48f4b440b51c.sourceText: 曲云海介绍说，在中国居留6个月以上的，才需 申请居留证。居留证通常发给留学生和到国内就业的人士，华人到国内探亲、投靠、赡养老人、买房、寄养小孩，也发给居留证。更长期的居留，开申请中国”绿 卡”，新政策降低了外籍华人办理”绿卡”的审批门槛，”绿卡”不仅发给优秀人才，外籍华人除了到国内投资、任职外，还可因家庭团聚事由申请绿卡。
b1b51dda49aa302678af7085adfd48f4b440b51c.translatedText: Qu Yunhai said that only those who have stayed in China for more than 6 months need to apply for a residence permit. Residence permits are usually issued to international students and people working in China. Residence permits are also issued to Chinese people who come to visit relatives, seek refuge in the country, support the elderly, buy houses, and foster children. For longer-term residence, apply for China's "green card". The new policy has lowered the approval threshold for foreign Chinese to apply for a "green card." "Green cards" are not only issued to outstanding talents. In addition to investing and working in China, foreign Chinese can also apply for a green card for family reunion purposes.

20b67e042571a7b252ac891c9c8cc15569237b5a.sourceText: 车窗起火 丰田召回247万辆 丰田汽车(Toyota)10日宣布全球召回12款逾743万辆车，以检修驾驶座旁电动车窗开关的瑕疵。 联邦全国公路交通安全管理署(NHTSA)表示，其中美国将召回近250万辆，该问题已在美国传出逾200件冒烟和起火事件，至少造成九起受伤案例。 丰田这次召回车型销售地区遍及亚洲、欧洲、中东和北美市场，出厂年份涵盖2005年至2010年。 而美国将召回247万辆，车型包括2007年至2009年Camry和Camry Hybrid油电车、2009年Corolla、2007年至2008年Yaris、20090年Matrix。 多功能车方面则包括2007年至2009年份的RAV4、2008年Highlander和Highlander Hybrid、2007年至2009年Tundra、2008年至2009年Sequoia。 另外也包括2008年至2009年Scion xB和xD。 丰田表示，这批电动车窗开关在制造时，因润滑油脂未均匀涂抹，使得开关内产生摩擦，车主使用时会有卡住的感觉，有时并会出现开关熔毁、冒烟和起火， 但该瑕疵尚未导致车祸事件。 丰田将从10月底开始邮寄召修通知书给车主，回厂检修时约需一个小时，丰田计画拆解驾驶座旁的电动车窗开关，检查内部情形，并涂抹一层特制润滑油脂。
20b67e042571a7b252ac891c9c8cc15569237b5a.translatedText: > Fire in car windows Toyota recalls 2.47 million vehicles Toyota announced on the 10th that it would recall more than 7.43 million vehicles in 12 models worldwide to repair defects in the power window switch next to the driver's seat. The federal National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) said that nearly 2.5 million vehicles will be recalled in the United States. The problem has reported more than 200 incidents of smoke and fire in the United States, resulting in at least nine injuries. Toyota's recalled models are sold in Asia, Europe, the Middle East and North America, and their production years cover 2005 to 2010. The U.S. will recall 2.47 million vehicles, including the 2007 to 2009 Camry and Camry Hybrid gasoline-electric vehicles, the 2009 Corolla, the 2007 to 2008 Yaris, and the 20090 Matrix. Utility vehicles include the 2007 to 2009 RAV4, 2008 Highlander and Highlander Hybrid, 2007 to 2009 Tundra, and 2008 to 2009 Sequoia. Also included are the 2008-2009 Scion xB and xD. Toyota stated that when these power window switches were manufactured, the lubricating grease was not evenly applied, causing friction within the switch. Owners would feel stuck when using the switch, and sometimes the switch would melt, smoke, and catch fire. However, this defect has not yet caused a car accident. Toyota will start mailing recall notices to car owners at the end of October. It will take about an hour to return to the factory for maintenance. Toyota plans to disassemble the electric window switch next to the driver's seat, check the internal condition, and apply a layer of special lubricating grease.

The Cochise County Sheriff's Office said a Tombstone Police Department deputy commander was under internal investigation after he fatally shot a 15-year-old boy in the line of duty. At 3:45 a.m. on Saturday, a resident of Tangshidong called the police, saying that someone was trying to break in. The deputy commander led his men to the scene and found that the boy was already in the house and holding a pistol. The deputy commander then shot and killed him. Police later informed the boy's family that the homeowner was not injured. A spokesperson for the Sheriff's Office said the incident is being investigated by county deputies and the Sara Vista Police Department.

800911be727c894a476bf3867fd285d6d0b4ce27.sourceText: Arizona State Fair老地方见 一年一度的Arizona State Fair（亚利桑那州博览会）又来了，10月12日至11月4日，在凤凰城的1826 West McDowell Road盛大开幕。 州博览会历史跨越三个世纪。早在128年前，在亚利桑那还未成为联邦一州时，亚利桑那的先民就在这个季节聚集一起，展示自己最好的牲畜，分享他们的农业成就。 1884年11月，部分亚利桑那的先民在凤凰城盐河以西的中央大街附近组织第一次博览会，以后每年都在此举行集会。1891年，盐河泛滥，淹没了此地。1905年，由酒店经营者JC亚当斯领头，成了专门委员会，部分商人集资9200美元购买了现址，建造两个赛道，看台和一个木制栅栏，后经多次扩建至如今的规模。 博览会定期举行，只有1921年因棉花欠收，1934至1939年大萧条时期，1943至1945年大战等年停办，基本每年一次如期举行。 时至今日，博览会不只是展示农畜牧的展览会，更多的是提供本州居民一个娱乐休闲的好去处，棉花糖、爆米花、热狗、旋转木马、过山车、乐队现场演唱……是一家大小尽情享受美丽秋日的好去处。
800911be727c894a476bf3867fd285d6d0b4ce27.translatedText: Arizona State Fair See you at the same place The annual Arizona State Fair (Arizona State Fair) is here again, from October 12th to November 4th, with a grand opening at 1826 West McDowell Road in Phoenix. The history of the State Fair spans three centuries. As early as 128 years ago, before Arizona became a federal state, Arizona's ancestors gathered during this season to showcase their best livestock and share their agricultural achievements. In November 1884, some Arizona ancestors organized the first fair near Central Street west of the Salt River in Phoenix, and held meetings here every year. In 1891, the Salt River overflowed and flooded the place. In 1905, a special committee was formed, led by hotelier J.C. Adams, and some businessmen raised $9,200 to purchase the current site, build two tracks, grandstands and a wooden fence, and later expanded it to its current size several times. The fair is held regularly, except in 1921 due to the cotton harvest, the Great Depression from 1934 to 1939, and the war from 1943 to 1945. It is basically held as scheduled every year. Today, the fair is not only an exhibition showing agriculture and livestock, but also a good place for entertainment and leisure for the residents of the state. Marshmallows, popcorn, hot dogs, carousels, roller coasters, live bands... It is a good place for the whole family to enjoy the beautiful autumn.

ac0e795907fb02d1d8695493fbd7a4be7ff75194.sourceText: 激情，温馨，动情—台湾101年双十庆祝活动（组图） （亚省时报讯 清宝报导 邓凌捷 郑弘摄影） 10月10日由知名艺人陆一婵、方芳、陈凯伦、郎祖筠、苏霈，以及今年获得金曲奖最佳台语男歌手奖的荒山亮等人组成的台湾「本安文化 剧团」，以「群星舞动庆双十」为节目主题，在凤凰城美莎艺术中心给当地的侨胞带来充满激情和温情的精彩演出。 不仅台上大腕云集，台下的观众也群星璀璨。 亚利桑那州长简布鲁尔（Jan Brewer），美莎市市长斯科特史密斯（Scott Smith） 吉尔伯特市长约翰刘易斯（John Lewis） ，华裔女众议院余艳芬，驻洛杉矶台北经文处副处长 周庆龙橙县文教中心主任高家富侨务咨询委员余文劲，尹衍桓，前白宫亚太裔事务委员会委员邓朝驹，多位当地议员，华人政客都到现场共襄盛举，欢庆台湾101年双十。 州长布鲁尔亲自上台致贺词，她回顾了台湾和亚利桑那州稳定长久的友情，也回忆起了访问台湾的旅程，她提及很多台湾的知名景点，当地朋友和生活中的小故事。 她希望两地继续加强合作，共创辉煌。 当地资深侨领侨务咨询委员余文劲尹衍桓作为东道主发言，他们感谢当地政界对华人社区的支持，欢迎演出团的到访，同时也邀请大家常回台湾看看。 主持人陈凯伦以一曲《两只蝴蝶》打开了晚会的序幕。 经典歌曲「热情的沙漠」、「站在高冈上」，清新悦耳的小调「西湖盼」、「满场飞」，脍炙人口的台语歌曲「内山姑娘要出嫁」、「干一杯」，耳熟能详的 粤语歌曲「上海滩」，以及饶富趣味的One-Man Talk Show等，以老干新枝之表演团队，具体展现台湾多元文化，让心系故乡的海外侨胞们，感受中华民国国庆普天同庆的欢乐气氛 。 侨务委员会为庆祝中华民国101年双十国庆，特于9月中旬遴派「本安文化剧团」及「玩声乐团」筹组国庆文化访问团，分赴美国及加拿大26个城市巡回访演， 以具传统文化及台湾新创音乐特色之文化飨宴，与海外侨胞及主流人士欢度中华民国国庆，进而让世界看到台湾生命力与文化活力。 「本安文化剧团」巡回城市包括波士顿、纽约、纽泽西、华府、达拉斯、波特兰、西雅图、圣地牙哥、洛杉矶及凤凰城等地，演出10场次。 凤凰城是本次巡演的最后一站，精彩也在压轴戏。 领队方芳在节目的最后隆重的介绍了他们的团队，一路演出，团员们共同协作，共同生活的点点滴滴，让所有团员不仅是合作者，更成为了家人，方芳就像个大家长，给 每个团员于褒奖。 这为激情的演出加上了最动情的部分，她们热泪盈眶，温情相拥。 全场观众被演出团精彩的表演，以及温馨的真情所感染，挥旗与台上呼应，共唱《中华民国颂》，告别这令人难忘的双十之夜。 贵宾席 侨务咨询委员 尹衍桓（左）亚利桑那州长 简 布鲁尔（右） 前白宫亚太事务委员委员 邓朝驹（左）侨务咨询委员 余文劲（右） 晚会歌舞《西湖盼》苏霈（左二） 方芳 脱口秀 陆一婵 歌曲《可爱的玫瑰花》 部分嘉宾与演员谢幕
ac0e795907fb02d1d8695493fbd7a4be7ff75194.translatedText: Passionate, warm, and emotional—Taiwan’s 101st Double Ten celebration (photo) (Alberta Times News, Qingbao Report, Deng Lingjie, Zheng Hong Photography) On October 10, Taiwan’s “Ben’an Culture” was formed by well-known artists Lu Yichan, Fang Fang, Chen Karen, Lang Zujun, Su Pei, and this year’s Golden Melody Award for Best Taiwanese Male Singer Arayama Ryo. Theater Troupe", with the theme of "Dancing Stars to Celebrate Double Ten", brought a wonderful performance full of passion and warmth to the local overseas Chinese at the Meisha Art Center in Phoenix. Not only were big names gathered on stage, but the audience was also star-studded. Arizona Governor Jan Brewer, Mesa Mayor Scott Smith, Gilbert Mayor John Lewis, Chinese-American female member of the House of Representatives Yu Yanfen, deputy director of the Taipei Cultural Office in Los Angeles Zhouqing Longcheng County Cultural and Educational Center Director Gao Jiafu, Overseas Chinese Affairs Advisory Committee member Yu Wenjin, Yin Yanhuan, former White House Asian and Pacific Islander Affairs Committee member Deng Chaoju, many local congressmen, and Chinese politicians attended the event to celebrate Taiwan's 101st National Day. Governor Brewer personally came to the stage to deliver a congratulatory speech. She reviewed the stable and long-lasting friendship between Taiwan and Arizona, and also recalled her trip to Taiwan. She mentioned many well-known attractions in Taiwan, local friends and small stories in life. She hopes that the two places will continue to strengthen cooperation and create brilliance together. Yu Wenjin and Yin Yanhuan, local senior overseas Chinese and overseas Chinese affairs advisory committee member, spoke as the host. They thanked the local political circles for their support to the Chinese community, welcomed the performance group's visit, and also invited everyone to return to Taiwan often. The host Karen Chen opened the party with a song "Two Butterflies". The classic songs "Passionate Desert" and "Standing on the High Hill", the fresh and melodious ditty "West Lake Hope" and "Flying Around the Field", the popular Taiwanese songs "The Girl from Uchiyama is Getting Married" and "Cheers", the familiar Cantonese song "Shanghai Beach", and the interesting One-Man Talk Show, etc., with the performance team of Laogan and Xinzhi, concretely demonstrate Taiwan's diverse culture, allowing overseas Chinese who care about their hometown to feel the joyful atmosphere of the National Day celebrations of the Republic of China. In order to celebrate the 101st National Day of the Republic of China, the Overseas Chinese Affairs Council specially selected the "Ben'an Cultural Troupe" and the "Wansheng Ensemble" in mid-September to form a National Day cultural tour group, which toured 26 cities in the United States and Canada. They celebrated the National Day of the Republic of China with overseas Chinese and mainstream people with a cultural feast featuring traditional culture and Taiwanese new music, and then let the world see the vitality and cultural vitality of Taiwan. "Ben On Cultural Theater" toured cities including Boston, New York, New Jersey, Washington, Dallas, Portland, Seattle, San Diego, Los Angeles and Phoenix, with 10 performances. Phoenix is ​​the last stop of this tour, and the highlight is also the finale. The team leader Fang Fang grandly introduced their team at the end of the program. They performed together and the team members worked together and lived together, making all the team members not only collaborators, but also family members. Fang Fang was like a big parent, giving praise to each team member. This added the most emotional part to the passionate performance. They burst into tears and embraced each other tenderly. The entire audience was infected by the troupe's wonderful performance and warm sincerity. They waved flags and echoed on the stage, singing "Ode to the Republic of China" to bid farewell to this unforgettable Double Ten night. VIP seats Overseas Chinese Affairs Advisory Committee Yin Yanhuan (left) Arizona Governor Jane Brewer (right) Former White House Asian and Pacific Affairs Committee member Deng Chaoju (left) Overseas Chinese Affairs Advisory Committee Yu Wenjin (right) Party song and dance "West Lake Hope" Su Pei (second from left) Fang Fang Talk show Lu Yichan song "Lovely Rose" Some guests and actors took their final bows

9f28a5fb630b4d777abced4a77d468fe09af9b7a.translatedText: Phoenix Airport Terminal 3 had an unexpected power outage. Phoenix Airport Terminal 3 had an unexpected power outage on Sunday afternoon, causing panic among passengers. Airport spokesperson Li Sina said the power outage occurred around 3:30 pm on Sunday, and preliminary information indicated that an old transformer failed. The power outage caused the escalators and baggage carousels to stop operating. The entire terminal was dark and passengers were in chaos. The management immediately activated emergency lights, causing three flights to be delayed for about 20 to 25 minutes. It is not clear that other arriving flights were delayed and landed. There is no statistics on how many passengers were affected. The power was restored at 5:30 p.m. During this period, ground staff of various airlines continued to reassure passengers that order was still good. Airlines operating in Terminal 3 of the Airport include: American, Delta, Frontier, JetBlue, Hawaiian, and Sun Country.

3de34df30efa0bdea4a57f53b963b2f0f0745f19.sourceText: 收获的不仅仅是荣誉－Tucson中国文化节汉语日巡礼 《亚省时报》图桑特约记者 慧明 九月二十九日不是图桑中文学校的上课日，但图桑祖荀华人中心却人山人海，来自Tucson地区的所有中文学校、有中文教育课程的公立学校以及Orovalley地区学校的学生老师和家长都早早地来到了中心，参加这里举行的中国汉语日的比赛。整个活动是亚大孔子学院举办的中国文化节的一部分。 比赛分三部分依次举行，首先举行的是初级汉语比赛。首先上场的6个美国学校代表队的18名同学，他们的紧张有序完成了答题。比赛紧随其后的是图森两所基本在本地区两个中文学校之间的比赛初年级班的学生中进行的。题目诸如”2008年北京奥运会开幕式在哪个中国国家体育场举行？”答案从”五棵松、鸟巢、水立方、奥林匹克公园”中选出。这类题对于在美国长大，才十岁的华裔孩子也许不是太容易。但这丝毫没有影响孩子的好胜和积极性，往往是下一个题目刚刚在大屏幕显示，没等主持人解说完毕，孩子们就迫不及待地举手举牌，争先恐后地回答。题目出得好，而且也允许孩子们在兴趣中讨论答案，孩子们在几个会合的失败后，终于知道，中秋节中国人吃的传统食品是月饼，而不是粽子了。 孩子的家长也不闲着，手中的各种摄影摄像器材对准这些孩子狂闪乱拍，那些齐刷刷举起的小手像春笋一样不但为汉语日留下了别样的情趣，而且也让孩子有了当明星的感觉，凭增了一份学习中国文字和文化的自豪感。 初级汉语比赛后，孩子们用汉语表演的诗歌朗诵《无题》、《寻隐者不露》和歌舞《找朋友》、《小星星》庆贺他们的胜利，也欢迎了中级汉语水平的哥哥姐姐们继续比赛。 中级汉语水平比赛的参赛者基本都也是来自４所美国公立学校中学的学生和两所中文学校的学生。这些学生大多数是美国孩子和生长在美国的华裔孩子。中级比赛相对初级要有一定的难度，但对于热爱中国文化的孩子，再难的问题也能在讨论中迎刃而解。即便回答错了，比如”什么是中国最主要的粮食作物，它是全国60％以上人口的主食”。只知道小麦和土豆的美国孩子自然选择了小麦。但最后学生们幸福地享受了刚才的遗憾，因为他们现在知道了水稻产出的大米才是中国人的主食。 若是某队答题正确，代表们便立刻可以享受台下队友们带口哨的山呼海啸。因为选手们捧回的荣誉是关于中国的：能知道大洋那边的中国原来是火药、印刷术、造纸术还有指南针的发源地，本身就是一件很酷的事。 中级汉语比赛组的表演也很有意思，演员除了用〈写字歌〉〈超级明星〉和〈依然爱你〉的歌声表示对中国文化的痴迷和眷恋外，还用小品〈相亲〉的形式展示了他们的中文水平。一位女孩讲述了自己对爱情的看法，立刻引起四个男孩不同的表白。尽管人的发音各有不同，但他们的认真和幽默的真诚都打动了姑娘和台下的观众。 随后举行的是高级汉语水平比赛，先由2个美国学校代表队6名同学答题，然后是中文学校的6名同学。 比赛还引起了观众的互动。当评委将回答的权利给台下观众的时候，台下孩子和大人的举手如林般地举起，渴望自己的参与。而这些热望的参与者大都是美国的孩子和他们的家长。中国文化节弘扬华夏文化的初衷，在欢乐的知识互动中得到鲜活的体现和回报。 汉语日的活动最后在参赛学校的演员《七彩孔雀》《两只老虎》《歌声与微笑》《木槿花》《生别离》《北京欢迎你》的歌舞中卸下了帷幕。主办者亚大孔子学院的院长向参赛的优胜者和参与的学生和工作人员发了奖杯及纪念品，感谢大家的努力和参与。 比赛的帷幕虽然降下了，但图桑人热爱汉语的感情却在升温，因为在这短短的一天里，人们收获的不但是喜欢和荣誉，而且收获了对中国文化，中国文字的痴迷和深爱。 非常感谢参加活动的学校和团体，仅以此文一表感激： BASIS Tucson North School 3队 2个节目 Accelerated Learning Laboratory 3队 2个节目 Basis Oro vally Charter School 2队 East Asian Studies Dept. at U of A 2队 1个节目 Catalina foothills High School 1队 2个节目 Tucson High Magnet School 1队 1个节目？两只老虎？ Tucson Chinese School 5队 3个节目 TCMC Chinese School 3队 Tucson International School 2个节目 当天表演了一个 International School of Tucson 2个节目（名单）
3de34df30efa0bdea4a57f53b963b2f0f0745f19.translatedText: Gain more than just honors - Chinese Language Day Tour of Tucson Chinese Culture Festival Huiming, Tucson Special Correspondent of the Alberta Times September 29th is not a class day for Tucson Chinese School, but the Tucson Chinese Center was packed with people. Students, teachers and parents from all Chinese schools in the Tucson area, public schools with Chinese education courses, and schools in the Orovalley area came to the center early to participate in the Chinese Language Day competition held here. The entire event was part of the Chinese Culture Festival organized by the Confucius Institute at Asia University. The competition is divided into three parts. The first one is the junior Chinese competition. The 18 students from the 6 American school teams were the first to take the stage. They answered the questions nervously and orderly. The competition followed among students in the junior classes of two Tucson schools, essentially a competition between two Chinese schools in the area. Questions such as "Which Chinese national stadium will the opening ceremony of the 2008 Beijing Olympic Games be held in?" The answers are selected from "Five Pines, Bird's Nest, Water Cube, and Olympic Park." This type of question may not be too easy for a ten-year-old Chinese child who grew up in the United States. But this does not affect the children's competitiveness and enthusiasm at all. Often the next question is just displayed on the big screen. Before the host has finished explaining, the children can't wait to raise their hands and placards, rushing to answer. The questions were well asked, and the children were allowed to discuss the answers in their interest. After several failed meetings, the children finally learned that the traditional food eaten by Chinese people during the Mid-Autumn Festival is moon cakes, not rice dumplings. The parents of the children were not idle either. They pointed all kinds of photography equipment in their hands at these children and took pictures wildly. The little hands raised in unison like spring bamboo shoots not only left a special interest in the Chinese Language Day, but also made the children feel like being stars, adding a sense of pride in learning Chinese characters and culture. After the elementary Chinese competition, the children celebrated their victory with Chinese performance poems reciting "Untitled", "The Hidden One Does Not Reveal" and singing and dancing "Looking for Friends" and "Little Star", and also welcomed the brothers and sisters with intermediate Chinese proficiency to continue the competition. Participants in the Intermediate Chinese Proficiency Competition are basically students from four American public schools and two Chinese schools. Most of these students are American children and Chinese children who grew up in the United States. Intermediate competitions are more difficult than beginners, but for children who love Chinese culture, no matter how difficult the problem is, they can be easily solved through discussion. Even if the answer is wrong, such as "What is China's most important food crop, it is the staple food of more than 60% of the country's population." American children who only know wheat and potatoes naturally choose wheat. But in the end, the students happily enjoyed their regrets because they now know that rice produced by rice is the staple food of the Chinese people. If a team answers the question correctly, the representatives can immediately enjoy the whistles of their teammates in the audience. Because the honors that the players took home were about China: it is cool to know that China on the other side of the ocean was the birthplace of gunpowder, printing, papermaking and the compass. The performance of the intermediate Chinese competition group was also very interesting. In addition to expressing their obsession and attachment to Chinese culture with the songs "Chinese Song", "Superstar" and "Still Love You", the actors also used the skit "Blind Date" to show off their Chinese proficiency. A girl talked about her views on love, which immediately triggered different confessions from four boys. Although people have different pronunciations, their seriousness and humorous sincerity impressed the girl and the audience. Then there was the Advanced Chinese Proficiency Competition, with 6 students from 2 American school teams answering questions first, and then 6 students from the Chinese school. The competition also resulted in audience interaction. When the judges gave the audience the right to answer, the children and adults in the audience raised their hands like a forest, eager to participate. Most of these eager participants are American children and their parents. The original intention of the Chinese Culture Festival to promote Chinese culture is vividly reflected and rewarded in the joyful knowledge interaction. The activities of the Chinese Language Day ended with the singing and dancing of "Colorful Peacock", "Two Tigers", "Song and Smile", "Hibiscus Flower", "Farewell" and "Beijing Welcomes You" by actors from participating schools. The organizer, the director of the Confucius Institute at Asia University, distributed trophies and souvenirs to the winners and participating students and staff, thanking everyone for their efforts and participation. Although the curtain of the competition has come down, Tucson people's love for Chinese is heating up, because in this short day, people gained not only love and honor, but also their obsession and deep love for Chinese culture and Chinese characters. I am very grateful to the schools and groups that participated in the event. 04048830b7cdcec82132f0f6e41ef4033e01d2df.sourceText: 联邦卫生官员说，全美大约1.3万可能接受过受污染的类固醇注射，那种类固醇最近引起真菌性脑膜炎爆发，到星期一为止已造成8人死亡，另外还有97人生病。
04048830b7cdcec82132f0f6e41ef4033e01d2df.translatedText: Federal health officials say about 13,000 people across the United States may have been injected with tainted steroids that caused a recent outbreak of fungal meningitis that killed eight people and sickened 97 others as of Monday.

194165d9806f3fd7566a29d6bcfccd41f8e901a4.sourceText: 联邦疾病防治中心（CDC）官员是根据各州卫生局和使用那种药物的诊所报告首次提出上述估计数据。那种正式名称为”甲基强的龙醋酸盐”（methylprednisolone acetate）的药物在靠近脊椎附近注射，用于治疗颈背疼痛，全美每年大约500万人接受那种治疗。
194165d9806f3fd7566a29d6bcfccd41f8e901a4.translatedText: Officials from the federal Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) first presented the estimate based on reports from state health departments and clinics that use the drug. The drug, formally known as methylprednisolone acetate, is injected near the spine to treat neck and back pain, and about 5 million people in the United States receive that treatment each year.

fe6d59194526841a5e8c3535e591ba1cf93835bd.sourceText: 其中受污染的那种类固醇注射剂已经向23州诊所发送出17,676支。CDC星期一预计，更多病例可能还会出现。
fe6d59194526841a5e8c3535e591ba1cf93835bd.translatedText: 17,676 of the contaminated steroid injections have been sent to clinics in 23 states. The CDC predicted Monday that more cases may emerge.

99eaa4fd6399a60db730b362a2cffe6d7a470fbe.sourceText: 制造那种药物的厂家是位于马萨诸塞州弗拉明翰（Framingham）的新英格兰复合药物中心。该公司已经关闭、上交执照并召回所有产品。
99eaa4fd6399a60db730b362a2cffe6d7a470fbe.translatedText: The manufacturer of that drug is the New England Compounding Center in Framingham, Massachusetts. The company has shut down, surrendered its license and recalled all products.

551c8c84b72762c7b035afd6d1d492d2e907bfae.sourceText: CDC说，由于该公司自5月21日开始发送受污染的注射剂，在那个日期之后接受那种药物注射的病人，如果出现严重的头痛、发烧、脖颈僵硬、头晕、四肢无力、畏光和失去平衡感，应尽快就医。
551c8c84b72762c7b035afd6d1d492d2e907bfae.translatedText: Because the company began shipping contaminated injections on May 21, patients who received injections of that drug after that date should seek medical attention as soon as possible if they develop severe headache, fever, neck stiffness, dizziness, weakness, photophobia, and loss of balance, the CDC said.

ea6ffc95f5b2def0fe591da6152464ab42ecd6ab.sourceText: 但是，是否所有同一批量的注射剂都受到那种致病的真菌污染或者是否所有接触那种真菌的人都患病，这些仍是未知数。CDC发言人艾伦（Curtis Allen）估计多数接触那种真菌的人不会生病。
ea6ffc95f5b2def0fe591da6152464ab42ecd6ab.translatedText: However, it remains unknown whether all injections from the same batch were contaminated with that disease-causing fungus or whether all people exposed to that fungus became sick. CDC spokesman Curtis Allen estimates that most people exposed to the fungus will not get sick.

19c78f124e01603f12dc2d0f845e9764787a2e6b.sourceText: 真菌性脑膜炎可能非常严重，会引起中风，早治疗可以挽救患者生命。卫生官员敦促尽快查明可能接触那种真菌的人，并在发现有关症状时尽早治疗。
19c78f124e01603f12dc2d0f845e9764787a2e6b.translatedText: Fungal meningitis can be very serious and can cause stroke, and early treatment can save the patient's life. Health officials urge people who may have been exposed to the fungus to be identified as soon as possible and treated as soon as possible if symptoms are detected.

2011b2f7c89362e0a597b3a3bf9089d281973c29.translatedText: The September employment report surprised Obama

08fec4a2704310130bb07140e59b184e15f50b3e.sourceText: 9月就业报告让奥巴马意外惊喜 据《今日美国》报道：周五，劳工部的报告显示9月美国失业率下降至2009年1月…
08fec4a2704310130bb07140e59b184e15f50b3e.translatedText: The September employment report surprised Obama According to "USA Today": On Friday, the Labor Department's report showed that the U.S. unemployment rate dropped in September to January 2009...

da31dfb38041996e63cfc566aecb636b1aacaa11.sourceText: 劳工部的报告说：9月新增了114,000就业岗位，失业率从8月的8.1％下降至7.8％，这对因为第一场全国性的总统电视辩论失利而挣扎的奥巴马意义重大。
da31dfb38041996e63cfc566aecb636b1aacaa11.translatedText: The Labor Department's report said: 114,000 new jobs were added in September, and the unemployment rate fell to 7.8% from 8.1% in August. This is of great significance to Obama, who is struggling because of his defeat in the first national presidential televised debate.

653f960b1aa9ed81983996ce39ec3dfb806784ac.sourceText: 更多的好消息是，此前宣布的7月和8月就业数据经过调整，有了新的增加。上个月宣布的8月创造了96,000个就业岗位，已经修改为创造了142,000个就业岗位，奥巴马甚至更可以以此自夸。
653f960b1aa9ed81983996ce39ec3dfb806784ac.translatedText: More good news is that the previously announced employment data for July and August have been adjusted and have new increases. The 96,000 jobs announced last month in August have been revised to 142,000 jobs, and Obama can even boast of this.

be2f154e81a770f9a3e3e65fdb858d60793011db.sourceText: 就业分析机构AFL-CIO 的副总裁西娅 李说：”这个月的就业报告显示美国经济终于迎来好的势头，这个消息的出现的时间对总统是再好不过了，人们正在回到劳动力市场，雇主显现出了一定的信心。”
be2f154e81a770f9a3e3e65fdb858d60793011db.translatedText: Thea Lee, vice president of employment analysis agency AFL-CIO, said: "This month's employment report shows that the U.S. economy is finally seeing good momentum. The timing of this news couldn't be better for the president. People are returning to the labor market and employers have shown a certain degree of confidence."

a520c93721397136ff6799f81ae9da65f1e2e075.sourceText: 白宫则对新的就业数据持谨慎态度。
a520c93721397136ff6799f81ae9da65f1e2e075.translatedText: The White House is cautious about new employment data.

a5d0703831a90f8d76d2a4eb02ebde2754fe5439.sourceText: 经济顾问委员会主席艾伦克鲁格说：”今天的就业报告提供了进一步的证据：美国自大萧条以来最严重的经济创伤正在持续愈合，虽然我们依然还有更多的工作需要做，我们将继续推动适宜中产阶级的经济政策，这是非常重要的。”
a5d0703831a90f8d76d2a4eb02ebde2754fe5439.translatedText: Chairman of the Council of Economic Advisers Alan Krueger said: "Today's employment report provides further evidence: The United States' worst economic trauma since the Great Depression is continuing to heal. Although we still have more work to do, we will continue to promote economic policies that are suitable for the middle class. This is very important."

385bac8aa7532be575b8218062d4d17eeb06f351.sourceText: 保守人士则立即对乐观的报告泼冷水。在首场辩论中表现抢眼的共和党总统候选人罗姆尼在一份声明中说：”9月比8月就业机会更少、8月比7月的就业机会更少，奥巴马总统就职以来我们已经失去了超过60万个制造业的就业机会，如果将所有退出劳动力市场的人计算在内，实际失业率将接近11％。”
385bac8aa7532be575b8218062d4d17eeb06f351.translatedText: Conservatives immediately poured cold water on the optimistic report. Republican presidential candidate Mitt Romney, who performed well in the first debate, said in a statement: "There are fewer jobs in September than in August, and there are fewer jobs in August than in July. We have lost more than 600,000 manufacturing jobs since President Obama took office. If all people who have withdrawn from the labor market are included, the actual unemployment rate will be close to 11%."

bd8e9ebe42234b626c5cfd262d5252e793c6ccb6.sourceText: 最新的数字将接二连三地出现在电视广告上。奥巴马可以说私营部门连续31个月实现就业增长、失业率已降至2009年1月他走进白宫办公室以来的最低水平。罗姆尼可以说至今还有1210万美国人仍然没有工作棗加上那些处于半失业状态、或已停止找工作的人，这个数字可能会增加两倍。
bd8e9ebe42234b626c5cfd262d5252e793c6ccb6.translatedText: The latest numbers will appear on TV ads one after another. Obama can say that the private sector has posted 31 consecutive months of job growth and that the unemployment rate has dropped to its lowest level since he entered the White House office in January 2009. Romney can say that there are still 12.1 million Americans who are still unemployed. Add in those who are partially unemployed or have stopped looking for work, and this number may triple.

60704b16735cbae47120041fd0863d816904eb8b.sourceText: 就业数据可以在某个时刻主宰总统选举。1976年7.5％的失业率使杰拉尔德福特受挫、1980年吉米卡特、1992年乔治H布什竞选都受到失业率数字的影响。
60704b16735cbae47120041fd0863d816904eb8b.translatedText: Jobs data could dominate the presidential election at some point. The 7.5% unemployment rate frustrated Gerald Ford in 1976, Jimmy Carter in 1980, and George H. Bush's campaign in 1992 were all affected by unemployment numbers.

0ca6d92d653cebd6564529b0424b07555c6ed2c9.sourceText: 奥巴马自进入白宫办公室的第一个月，他的就业数字就已经很糟糕了棗一直徘徊在8.1％到10％不等。他可以说，他制定的就业措施一直在发挥效益棗私营部门已创造了超过500万的就业机会。
0ca6d92d653cebd6564529b0424b07555c6ed2c9.translatedText: Since Obama entered the White House office in his first month, his employment numbers have been terrible, hovering between 8.1% and 10%. He can say that the employment measures he instituted have been paying dividends - more than 5 million jobs have been created in the private sector.

21cb9dfc5d4c1e6ebb0da5db9f31a605827d858b.sourceText: 在大选投票前的4天，奥巴马将还有最后一次机会看到失业率低于8％棗11月2日将公布10月就业率及过去数月修订的就业数字。然而，到那时大多数选民的心中已经根据他们对就业或经济状况分析做出了选择。
21cb9dfc5d4c1e6ebb0da5db9f31a605827d858b.translatedText: Four days before the general election vote, Obama will have one last chance to see the unemployment rate below 8%. On November 2, the October employment rate and revised employment figures for the past few months will be announced. However, by then most voters have already made their choice in their minds based on their analysis of employment or economic conditions.

05b9532e1e359524965b4d337f353b23d0a9441f.sourceText: 事实上，一些经济学家和政治分析家说，选民的心目中一般都不会因为就业报告或统计数据动摇，一般以经济如何影响到他们的家庭作为判断标准。副总统拜登的前经济学家顾问贾里德伯恩斯坦说，其实选民在初夏就已经坚定了自己的看法。
05b9532e1e359524965b4d337f353b23d0a9441f.translatedText: In fact, some economists and political analysts say voters are generally not swayed by jobs reports or statistics, but rather by how the economy affects their families. Jared Bernstein, a former economist adviser to Vice President Biden, said voters had already solidified their views in early summer.

8d9138c8399d722bf61fd071c2a6b7f98e1ce4a7.sourceText: 伯恩斯坦说，最新的报告提供了通过修订的夏季就业数据：美国经济在第二季度平均每月增加67,000个就业机会，但在第三季度却达到每月增加146,000个就业机会。这对现任的总统十分有利：说明我们正朝着正确的方向前进。
8d9138c8399d722bf61fd071c2a6b7f98e1ce4a7.translatedText: Bernstein said the latest report provided revised summer employment data: the U.S. economy added an average of 67,000 jobs per month in the second quarter, but reached 146,000 jobs per month in the third quarter. This is very good for the current president: it shows that we are moving in the right direction.

f24c005dc20bed7992d2827e4da87b81b218c487.sourceText: 这份报告公布的时间离第一次总统候选人辩论罗姆尼表现抢眼和奥巴马表现低迷不到36小时。
f24c005dc20bed7992d2827e4da87b81b218c487.translatedText: This report was released less than 36 hours after Romney’s outstanding performance and Obama’s sluggish performance in the first presidential debate.

431feafd8ad516deb420c75c33e053a4c0b58670.sourceText: 在那场辩论中，罗姆尼再次承诺在未来四年将创造1200万个新的就业机会。他说：”我的首要任务是让美国人有工作。”随后他在星期四一个新的电视广告中声称，他的新能源计划将创造超过300万个就业机会，他的减税计划、贸易政策和在职培训将另外再创造700万个就业机会。
431feafd8ad516deb420c75c33e053a4c0b58670.translatedText: During that debate, Romney again pledged to create 12 million new jobs over the next four years. "My top priority is putting Americans to work," he said, later claiming in a new television ad Thursday that his new energy plan would create more than 3 million jobs and that his tax cuts, trade policies and on-the-job training would create an additional 7 million jobs.

4c80bcd9a84f595b6af7678d35c96f8988e4156e.sourceText: 奥巴马在辩论中承认，美国人处在一个痛苦的时期，”但是我们已经开始为争取回到正确的道路上而战斗。”在周四的竞选活动中，他发誓要创造100万个新的制造业就业机会和几十万个的绿色能源岗位的就业机会。
4c80bcd9a84f595b6af7678d35c96f8988e4156e.translatedText: Obama acknowledged during the debate that Americans are in a painful period, "but we have begun fighting to get back on the right path." During Thursday's campaign event, he vowed to create 1 million new manufacturing jobs and hundreds of thousands of green energy jobs.
