7e1266d588b0cfda33f006170e38f116e0fe618c.translatedText: The peanut butter infection problem has expanded, and about 100 products have been recalled The FDA said that Val...

aecd047f98bbeae70e8930f5a622f4280f4ac136.sourceText: 花生酱感染问题扩大 约召回100个产品 FDA表示，零售商Trader Joe’s出售的Valencia花生酱产品召回行动已经扩大成召回桑兰德（Sunland）公司约100种含有花生、坚果和种子的产品。 美国食品药品管理局（FDA）官员说，启动相关召回行动的是Chattanooga烘烤公司、Falcon贸易公司/SunRidge农场、Gretchen Shoebox Express和Whole Foods Market。 FDA和CDC、州和地方政府的公共卫生官员在联合调查多个州爆发的沙门氏菌感染，它可能跟零售店Trader Joe’s出售的Valencia咸花生酱有关。疾病防控中心说，CDC说，19个州的30人被感染沙门氏菌株Bredeney。 桑兰德公司也扩大了召回，从开始的数种到上周的76种，再扩大至100种产品，包括花生酱和其他用坚果和种子制作的产品，出产日期在5月1日到9月24日之间自同一生产线生产的。 召回产品的清单请参阅 http://www.fda.gov/Food/FoodSafety/CORENetwork/ucm320413.htm
aecd047f98bbeae70e8930f5a622f4280f4ac136.translatedText: The peanut butter infection problem has expanded, and about 100 products have been recalled. The FDA said that the retailer Trader A recall of Valencia peanut butter products sold at Joe's has expanded to recall about 100 Sunland products that contain peanuts, tree nuts and seeds. U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) officials said the recalls were initiated by Chattanooga Baking Company, Falcon Trading Company/SunRidge Farms, Gretchen Shoebox Express and Whole Foods Market. The FDA and CDC, along with state and local public health officials, are investigating a multi-state outbreak of salmonella infections that may be linked to Valencia salted peanut butter sold at Trader Joe’s. The CDC says 30 people in 19 states have been infected with the Salmonella strain Bredeney, the CDC said. Sunland also expanded the recall, from just a few to 76 last week, to 100 products, including peanut butter and other products made with nuts and seeds, produced on the same production line between May 1 and September 24. As long as citizens are over 18 years old, they can register as voters and choose democratic, republican or independent parties according to their own beliefs. Details are available at www.servicearizona.com. Maricopa County Elections Director Karen Osborne expects 65% of eligible voters in metro Phoenix to vote this year, mostly by mail. 72d90f15c6130b91f45eff21226a0538165f5eee.sourceText: 美国国务院领务局签证办公室公共及外交联络主任凯伦金 (Karin King) ， 1 日在国务院外籍记者中心的记者会中强调，申请须以私人的电子邮箱地址登记，每人只能申请一次。但是不同的人可使用同一电邮地址。而一个家庭中的每一个成年人，都可分别申请。
72d90f15c6130b91f45eff21226a0538165f5eee.translatedText: Karin King, Director of Public and Diplomatic Liaison, Visa Office, Bureau of Consular Affairs, U.S. State Department, 1 At a press conference held by the Foreign Correspondents Center of the State Council on September 1, it was emphasized that applications must be registered with a private email address, and each person can only apply once. But different people can use the same email address. Each adult in a family can apply separately.

d4e2a06e2c1e9964d80ea62b68be7ccb7d5e5676.sourceText: 金指出，登记抽签移民不需费用。幸运中签者在办签证面谈时才须缴费。
d4e2a06e2c1e9964d80ea62b68be7ccb7d5e5676.translatedText: Jin pointed out that there is no fee to register for lottery immigration. Lucky winners only have to pay the fee when they go to the visa interview.

a8dcc9eba4c139945129979dd253accb126875ff.sourceText: 金说，国务院不会通知申请人是否中签，只会以电子邮件提醒申请人上网查询。申请人可从明年 5 月起上网查看结果。申请人登录提供姓氏、出生年及电邮地址后，将被告知是否已经中签。
a8dcc9eba4c139945129979dd253accb126875ff.translatedText: Jin said that the State Council will not notify applicants whether they are successful, but will only send emails to remind applicants to check online. Applicants can check their results online from May next year. After applicants log in and provide their last name, year of birth and email address, they will be notified whether they have been selected.

e19cff01493d46f3cd99070ca3501b0b797c3b9e.sourceText: 美国政府对绿卡抽签没有外包作业，民众如收到任何关于中签的通知，均为不实。美国政府发出的通知一定是.gov 的电邮。
e19cff01493d46f3cd99070ca3501b0b797c3b9e.translatedText: The U.S. government does not outsource the green card lottery. If the public receives any notification about winning the lottery, it is false. Notices sent by the U.S. government must be .gov emails.

dac636a7cff26ce38f0ce98f01ab4116a2a5e0d7.sourceText: 申请人必须高中毕业或具同等学历；或是于过去五年中，至少有两年的工作资历。申请者本人、配偶及 21 岁以下未婚子女，都可同时移民。
dac636a7cff26ce38f0ce98f01ab4116a2a5e0d7.translatedText: Applicants must graduate from high school or have equivalent academic qualifications; or have at least two years of work experience in the past five years. The applicant, his/her spouse and unmarried children under the age of 21 can all immigrate at the same time.

9fd9430a9659d40689ac284616a2990015fea210.sourceText: 中签者须通过体检及背景调查，并须证明在美国将不会成为公众负担。
9fd9430a9659d40689ac284616a2990015fea210.translatedText: The successful candidate must pass a physical examination and background check, and must prove that he will not become a public charge in the United States.

34ff7e35769e226af7a2759fc29090d05a7b1fcd.sourceText: 绿卡抽签始于 1995 年。美国每年以抽签方式发出 5 万 5000 个多样性签证，给移民美国人数较少的国家及地区，以维持美国移民的多样性。
34ff7e35769e226af7a2759fc29090d05a7b1fcd.translatedText: The green card lottery began in 1995. The United States issues 55,000 diversity visas by lottery every year to countries and regions with fewer immigrants to the United States to maintain the diversity of immigrants in the United States.

2ee04b5c8155055d4b2ef64d5b2d4b38c9856e71.sourceText: 官员指出，每年都有数百万孟加拉国出生者申请。但下一年度孟加拉国出生者已失去资格，因此估计申请总数将减少数百万件。
2ee04b5c8155055d4b2ef64d5b2d4b38c9856e71.translatedText: Officials pointed out that millions of people born in Bangladesh apply every year. But those born in Bangladesh have become ineligible the following year, so the total number of applications is estimated to be millions less.

18ca7cd2485a39ba724545e89d51166e95a60195.translatedText: 500 universities have joined forces to make America the world's leading university Affiliated to the Association of Public and Public Universities (APLU) and the American Association of State Colleges and Universities...

c2fe95bdf608849c3f1e8b8c6360b049bdd157fb.sourceText: 500大学联手 美再成世界大学龙头 隶属于美国「公立与公地大学协会」(APLU)和「美国州立学院与大学协会」(AASCU)的约500所公立大学，2日联合发表声明，承诺从现在起到 2025年，在保持高质量教育的同时，增加授予380万个大学学士学位，并遏制大学生上大学的费用。此一雄心勃勃的行动旨在帮助美国重获世界大学教育的龙头地位。 2日声明的焦点是提高毕业率，这是美国高等教育存在的老问题。美国是全世界大学入学率最高的国家之一，但超过三分之一的大学生没有取得学位。在成人中有学位者所占比例上，美国从世界第一位下跌到第14位。 声明中说，各大学将联系曾就读该校但未获任何学位的学生；在提高学位授予率的同时，绝不降低教育质量；坚持学生组成多样化的原则；缩短学生取得学位的平均时间；遏制大学费用；与中小学和小区学院合作，尤其是在科学、技术、工程、数学和其他急需的课程教育方面的合作。 声明还说，为了帮助当地、各州和全美的经济发展，许多公立大学将增加科学、技术、工程和数学专业的毕业生。 这些大学目前每年毕业的大学生人数仅稍稍超过100万。按照这个速率，它们到2025年将一共授予约1460万人的大学学位。
c2fe95bdf608849c3f1e8b8c6360b049bdd157fb.translatedText: 500 universities have joined forces to make America the world's leading university About 500 public universities affiliated with the Association of Public and Public Universities (APLU) and the American Association of State Colleges and Universities (AASCU) jointly issued a statement on the 2nd, promising that from now to 2025, while maintaining high-quality education, they will award an additional 3.8 million bachelor's degrees and curb the cost of college for college students. This ambitious move is designed to help the United States regain its position as the world's leader in university education. The focus of the statement on the 2nd was to increase graduation rates, which is an old problem in American higher education. The United States has one of the highest college enrollment rates in the world, but more than one-third of college students do not earn a degree. In terms of the proportion of adults with a degree, the United States fell from first to 14th in the world. The statement said that each university will contact students who have attended the school but did not receive any degree; while increasing the degree-granting rate, never reduce the quality of education; adhere to the principle of diversifying the student composition; shorten the average time for students to obtain a degree; curb college expenses; cooperate with primary and secondary schools and community colleges, especially in science, technology, engineering, mathematics and other urgently needed curriculum education. The statement also said that to help local, state and national economic development, many public universities will increase the number of graduates majoring in science, technology, engineering and mathematics. These universities currently graduate just over 1 million college students each year. At this rate, they will award a total of about 14.6 million college degrees by 2025.

0163fe3af21614b0c21d8e795441cb6c2c9c9aa3.sourceText: 联邦卫生官员警告消费者不要食用Trader Joe’s商店贩卖的Valencia Creamy Salted花生酱，因为这种产品可能受到沙门氏菌污染，在美国18个州已有29人因此生病。 Trader Joe’s已从全国各地商店撤下这种产品，并在公司网页发布通知。消费者应把这些货号为97111的花生酱送回Trader Joe’s商店，店方将全额退款。 联邦食品药物管理局(FDA)说，五岁以下的儿童、老年人和免疫机能有问题的人，更应该避免这些可能与爆发布雷登尼沙门氏菌(salmonella Bredeney)传染有关的产品
0163fe3af21614b0c21d8e795441cb6c2c9c9aa3.translatedText: Federal health officials warn consumers not to eat Valencia Creamy Salted peanut butter sold in Trader Joe’s stores because the product may be contaminated with salmonella, which has sickened 29 people in 18 states. Trader Joe’s has pulled the product from stores across the country and posted a notice on the company’s website. Consumers should return the peanut butter, item number 97111, to Trader Joe’s stores for a full refund. The federal Food and Drug Administration (FDA) says children under five, the elderly and people with compromised immune systems should avoid products that may be linked to the salmonella Bredeney outbreak.

08e9558c7c6ce101b9ff14785c8a4022257bd94e.sourceText: 比阳光更热的是…..-记Tucson首届中国文化节开幕式暨健康日 《亚省时报》图桑特约记者 慧明 亚利桑那周（Arizona）是以自己的阳光而著称世界的，９月２２日图桑华人又用自己热情为本州多元化文化涂上了一缕炙热的中国色彩。图桑的中国文化节由亚利桑那大学孔子学院（亚大孔院）策划和主办，在图桑中心的Reid Park拉开了序幕。 文化节的开幕与第一天的活动是以健康为主题的，来自图桑各界的华人团体以及与中华文化有关的美国协会以及当地民众，都兴致勃勃地参加了中国文化节开幕式的各项活动，并以自己特有的中国元素符号诠释了中华文化的内敛、柔媚和渊源流长的秘诀。 在文化节的开幕式上，图森市长乔纳森*罗斯柴尔德 （Jonathan Rothschild）首先代表图森市府讲话。他高度肯定并赞扬了图森华人对当地的历史及发展所做出的贡献。’图森是一个多元文化的城市。一直以来，这都是我们城市的特点和优势。’罗斯柴尔德并特别指出：’近年来，华人社区在图森蓬勃发展，中国文化已在图森这座城市中，在社会生活的每个角落生根、开花、结果。我们对此深感自豪，这是一个真正的成功故事。’ 亚利桑那大学副教务长Gail Burd教授在发言中强调，亚大非常重视与中国的关系，希望与中国相关院校保持紧密联系以及在教育领域的交流和合作。’ 亚大公共卫生学院院长Iman Hakim 教授 也在开幕式上发表了热情洋溢的讲话，表示十分高兴能参与本次中国文化节的主办，希望借文化节的成功举办，能向美国当地民众更多地传播有关中国文化中的健康理念。中国河南汉办和河南武术学院也派人员专程赶来参加文化节的开幕式活动，并赠送了精美的清明上河图画轴。在亚大孔子学院的院长和图桑市长的祝辞后，各路豪杰美女们或摩拳擦掌，或亭亭玉立，迫不及待地向观众展示了华人生活的美好状况和中华文化的精深。 由图桑华夏太极队为首的演出吸引了所有的在场观众。这不但是由于他们柔中有刚、舒展大方的技艺恰如其分地展示了中华文化的内涵和华人的风貌，而且因为太极队无论老幼，不分男女，让洁白的功夫服在演出中心掀起了一阵阵银色的波浪。连美国功夫爱好者也按耐不住激动的心情，参加了演出，用他们的肌肉和力量演绎着不一样的中华太极。 本地一位资深的太极拳师很激动地说，自己每个动作都在脑中过目，一晚上都睡不着觉，因为参加这样的演出是图桑华人在展示母国的文化。确实，此刻用任何文字都无法记叙他们的激动。 华姿舞蹈团和她们的年轻梯队给观众展示的是生命的另一种美丽。她们用自己柔美的舞姿告诉和提醒着人们，在那遥远的故乡，在每个华人最近的心里，永远都有一个美好的童年、美妙的憧憬。用欢欣的心情去迎接新的每一天，才会发现春天的雨水是那么的可亲，无私地滋润着郁郁葱葱的小苗；才会发现美丽的孔雀原来就在身边，翩翩起舞；才会发现真挚的爱情是那么的可贵，就在你和我之间；才会发现炙热的太阳原来也是那么的和蔼，还有那么多慈爱和温暖！ 观众们用热烈的掌声感谢了演员，因为他们看懂了为什么中国的姑娘会永远靓丽娇美，青春永驻？为什么中华文化会那么的源远流长，百折不挠？因为有健康的心态才会有健康的体态，才会有生活的美态，也才有中华文化息息永存的常态。 当天的阳光是炙热的，但比阳光更热的是图桑华人的热情。为了给美国当地人传达更多中华文化的信息，各种华人团体和组织用各种大棚展台浓缩了许多华人健康生活的密码。亚大孔子学院展示的是中国的各种健康的蔬菜，蔬菜们稀罕的造型和品种引得不少美国人驻足询问。祖荀中文学校摊位前则挤满了前来咨询的家长和孩子，北京清华大学和上海华东师大的美术大师以及从本州州府凤凰城特地赶来的画家们为孩子们当场挥毫，用不同的情趣和表达方式吸引了孩子们的赞叹和惊呼。 收获观众最多的也许是图桑Seven cup tea的展台。当人们为精彩的演出喊哑了喉咙，当阳光如此亲密地接触了热情的观众时，一杯清凉的中国茶水便是健康生活的最佳礼品。业主配制了各种口味的凉茶，为演员和观众提供了便利，也顺机传达了健康饮料的中国好味道。 原来中国文化有这么多好滋味！参加图桑中国文化节开幕式的观众都由衷地发出感慨。期待着，大家都期待在一周的中国文化展示中有更多的好声音，好形象，给美国多元的文化增添东方的美妙色彩。
08e9558c7c6ce101b9ff14785c8a4022257bd94e.translatedText: What's hotter than the sun is... - Notes on the opening ceremony and health day of Tucson's first Chinese Culture Festival Huiming, Tucson special correspondent of the "Alberta Times" Arizona is famous for its sunshine. On September 22, the Chinese in Tucson used their enthusiasm to paint the state's diverse culture with a hot Chinese color. Tucson’s Chinese Culture Festival, planned and hosted by the Confucius Institute at the University of Arizona (Confucius Institute at the University of Arizona), kicked off at Reid Park in central Tucson. The opening and first day of the cultural festival were themed on health. Chinese groups from all walks of life in Tucson, as well as American associations related to Chinese culture, as well as local people, enthusiastically participated in various activities at the opening ceremony of the Chinese Cultural Festival. They used their own unique Chinese elements and symbols to interpret the secrets of Chinese culture's restraint, femininity and long history. At the opening ceremony of the cultural festival, Tucson Mayor Jonathan Rothschild first spoke on behalf of the Tucson City Government. He highly affirmed and praised the contributions made by the Chinese in Tucson to local history and development. ’ Tucson is a multicultural city. This has always been the characteristic and advantage of our city. ’ Rothschild specifically pointed out: ‘In recent years, the Chinese community has flourished in Tucson, and Chinese culture has taken root, blossomed, and bore fruit in every corner of social life in the city of Tucson. We are very proud of this and it is a real success story. Professor Gail Burd, Vice Provost of the University of Arizona, emphasized in her speech that the University of Arizona attaches great importance to its relationship with China and hopes to maintain close ties with relevant Chinese institutions and exchanges and cooperation in the field of education. ’ Professor Iman Hakim, Dean of the School of Public Health at the University of Asia, also delivered a passionate speech at the opening ceremony, saying that he was very happy to participate in the hosting of this Chinese Culture Festival and hoped that through the success of the cultural festival, he could spread more health concepts in Chinese culture to the local people in the United States. China's Henan Hanban and Henan Martial Arts Academy also sent personnel to attend the opening ceremony of the cultural festival and presented them with exquisite scrolls of "Along the River During the Qingming Festival". After the congratulations from the Director of the Confucius Institute at Asia University and the Mayor of Tucson, the heroes and beauties from all walks of life were either gearing up or standing gracefully, eager to show the audience the beautiful situation of Chinese life and the profoundness of Chinese culture. The performance led by the Tucson Chinese Tai Chi Team attracted all the audiences present. This is not only because their soft yet firm and generous skills appropriately demonstrate the connotation of Chinese culture and the Chinese style, but also because the Tai Chi team, regardless of age or gender, made the white kung fu uniforms set off waves of silver in the performance center. Even American kung fu enthusiasts couldn't hold back their excitement and participated in the performance, using their muscles and strength to perform different Chinese Tai Chi. A senior local Tai Chi master said excitedly that he could not sleep at night because he had seen every move in his mind, because participating in such a performance was a way for the Chinese in Tucson to showcase the culture of their home country. Indeed, no words can describe their excitement at this moment. Huazi Dance Troupe and their young echelon showed the audience another kind of beauty of life. They use their graceful dancing to tell and remind people that in that distant hometown, in the hearts of every Chinese, there will always be a beautiful childhood and wonderful longing. When you greet each new day with joy, you will find that the spring rain is so kind, selflessly nourishing the lush seedlings; you will find that the beautiful peacock is right beside you, dancing gracefully; you will find that true love is so precious, just between you and me; and you will find that the hot sun is also so kind, with so much kindness and warmth! The audience thanked the actors with warm applause because they understood why Chinese girls will always be beautiful and youthful? Why is Chinese culture so long-standing and enduring? Because only with a healthy mentality can we have a healthy body, a beautiful life, and the normalcy of Chinese culture that will last forever. The sun was hot that day, but what was hotter than the sun was the enthusiasm of the Chinese people in Tucson. In order to convey more information about Chinese culture to local Americans, various Chinese groups and organizations used various greenhouse booths to condense many codes of healthy Chinese living. The Confucius Institute at Asia University displays various healthy vegetables from China. The rare shapes and varieties of vegetables have attracted many Americans to stop and ask. The booth of Zu Xun Chinese School was crowded with parents and children who came to consult. Art masters from Tsinghua University in Beijing and East China Normal University in Shanghai, as well as painters who came specially from Phoenix, the capital of the state, painted for the children on the spot, using different tastes and expressions to attract the children's admiration and exclamation. Perhaps the booth that attracted the most visitors was the Seven Cup Tea booth in Tucson. When people shout hoarse for the wonderful performance, and when the sun touches the enthusiastic audience so intimately, a cup of refreshing Chinese tea is the best gift for a healthy life. The owner prepared various flavors of herbal tea to provide convenience for the actors and the audience, and also conveyed the good Chinese taste of healthy drinks. It turns out that Chinese culture has so many wonderful flavors! The audience who attended the opening ceremony of the Tucson Chinese Culture Festival expressed their sincere emotions. Looking forward to it, everyone is looking forward to more good voices and good images in the week-long Chinese cultural display, which will add the wonderful color of the East to the diverse American culture.

e4ea9f735367e77b4bac9b1352cc5e7fb5c7ae06.sourceText: １０月４日上午一私人飞机坠毁 遗孀为华裔 （亚省时报 谢成彦报道）10月4日上午9時30分左右，在图桑一架私人小飞机不幸坠毁。驾驶飞机的一美国男性不幸遇难。遇难者遗体将被送往图桑医疗检查办公室，并在接下去的两三天里送到家属指定的殡仪馆。遇难者留下了一华裔遗孀，和一个女儿。华裔遗孀来美仅两年。遇难者女儿正从其他州赶往图桑。 该小飞机是由驾驶者设计的单引擎Mustang II FB，有顺利行驶的记录，并获得过政府的驾驶认证。事故发生地点仅距起飞场两英里，美国联邦航空管理局和国家交通安全局（ FAA and the National Transportation Safety Board）正在对飞机坠毁的原因进行调查。目前，《亚省时报》以及华人华侨联合总会副会长屈宁正在与家属联系，帮助他们安排善后事宜。
e4ea9f735367e77b4bac9b1352cc5e7fb5c7ae06.translatedText: On the morning of October 4th, a private plane crashed and the widow was of Chinese descent (Reported by Chengyan Xie of the Alberta Times) At around 9:30 a.m. on October 4, a small private plane crashed in Tucson. An American man piloting the plane died. The remains of the victims will be sent to the Tucson Medical Examiner's Office and then to the funeral home designated by the family in the next two or three days. The victims left behind a Chinese widow and a daughter. The Chinese widow has only been in the United States for two years. The victim's daughter was traveling to Tucson from out of state. The small aircraft is a single-engine Mustang II FB designed by the pilot, has a smooth driving record, and has received government driving certification. The cause of the crash, which occurred just two miles from the departure airport, is under investigation by the FAA and the National Transportation Safety Board. Currently, the "Alberta Times" and Qu Ning, vice president of the Overseas Chinese Federation, are contacting the family to help them arrange the aftermath.

e2209f266eafbfdfb1dfd459bc6d448468eb471b.sourceText: 美航裁员引大量飞行员请病假300多航班被取消 陷入困境中的美国航空公司(American Airlines)上周又遭受新的打击：由于大量飞行员”因病”请假，300多个航班被迫临时取消。据悉，这次飞行员罢非与公司下发了多达11000多份裁员通知，造成人心涣散有关。 美国航空公司上周表示，预计9月底至10月初该公司1%-2%的航班会被取消。一家航空服务公司报告说，从上周一至周三，美国航空公司已经有249个航班被临时取消。未来还可能有更多航班被临时取消，实际被取消的航班数量可能会大大超出公司的预期。 美国航空公司从九月初开始出现航班延误或被临时取消现象，本周情况进一步加剧。 19日多达73个航班被临时取消。 这次航班出现大面积取消和延误之前，美国航空公司刚刚推出了一项主要针对飞行员的经费压缩计划，其中包括增加飞行任务，并计划从11月份起停止执行原来的员工退休计划。此举招致飞行员强烈不满。 今年2月份美国航空公司曾经宣布一项可能裁减14000名员工的裁员计划，以避免陷入破产。美国航空公司是美国第三大航空公司，该公司去年11月根据美国《破产法》第11章申请了破产保护，根据该法，申请破产保护的公司可以大规模裁员。 美国航空总部设在德州沃斯堡，去年年底起，一直与总部设在坦佩的全美航空(US AIRWAYS)商洽合并。如若合并成功，全美航空将迁往沃斯堡，随之而来是坦佩附近航空有关行业数万人失业。
e2209f266eafbfdfb1dfd459bc6d448468eb471b.translatedText: American Airlines layoffs caused a large number of pilots to take sick leave, and more than 300 flights were canceled. The troubled American Airlines Airlines suffered a new blow last week: due to a large number of pilots taking leave "due to illness", more than 300 flights were temporarily canceled. It is reported that the pilot dismissal was not related to the company's issuing of more than 11,000 layoff notices, which caused dissatisfaction. American Airlines said last week that it expects 1%-2% of its flights to be canceled from the end of September to early October. An aviation service company reported that 249 flights on American Airlines have been temporarily canceled in the future. More flights may be temporarily canceled in the future, and the actual number of canceled flights may greatly exceed the company's expectations. American Airlines has experienced flight delays or temporary cancellations since early September, and the situation has further intensified this week. Before the widespread cancellations and delays, American Airlines had just launched a funding reduction plan mainly for pilots, which included increasing flying tasks and planning to stop implementing the original employee retirement plan starting in November. This move caused strong dissatisfaction among pilots. In February this year, American Airlines announced a layoff plan that may lay off 14,000 employees to avoid bankruptcy. American Airlines, the third largest airline in the United States, filed for bankruptcy protection under Chapter 11 of the U.S. Bankruptcy Code last November. According to this law, companies that file for bankruptcy protection can lay off large-scale layoffs. Since the end of last year, American Airlines has been working with US Airways, which is headquartered in Tempe. AIRWAYS) is negotiating a merger. If the merger is successful, US Airways will move to Fort Worth, resulting in the loss of tens of thousands of jobs in the aviation-related industries near Tempe.

a536c9c9f68e29db8be0cdbc2a2a9eb2ed8fe006.sourceText: 从小家到大家—记亚省第20区州参议员候选人余艳芬助选筹款晚宴 （亚省时报报道） 9月15日晚6时在凤凰城六福酒家，迎来了150多位的友人共同支持亚利桑那首位华裔女众议员余艳芬参选亚省第20区参议员。余艳芬和先生，兄弟姐妹，余氏宗亲，华裔新老移民，ABC，还有很多西裔朋友，像吃团圆饭似的度过了一个难忘的夜晚。没有歌舞，却有献花和掌声，以及动人的真实的故事。这个筹款晚宴最吸引人的元素都弥漫在空气里，会让你为余艳芬为荣，为华人为荣，为移民而荣，为一个普通市民而荣。 余艳芬，华裔，2010年顶替退休第十区众议员职位，成为了亚利桑那首位华裔众议员，是州”最有魅力48位女性”之一。她走上演讲台介绍了自己的从政经历：曾经为加州州长斯瓦辛格，亚利桑那州州长简 布鲁尔服务，曾任州财政部长政府公关事务部门负责人，也为社区教育等方方面面工作了16年。然而，与这些政绩相比，华裔女众议员余艳芬身上很多更特别的东西。余艳芬有一个很简单的小家庭，在晚宴上，余艳芬感谢他的先生为她而改变。先生喜欢自由散漫的生活，选择了当牙医，终于可以不用西装革履，朝九晚五。可是没想到，现在不是为了工作，而是为了太太，不得不几乎天天西装革履，朝九晚九，时而是余艳芬专业的摄影师，时而是通讯师，时而是后勤服务人员。他们夫妇为社区忙碌而快乐着。 亚省第20区参议员候选人 余艳芬 余艳芬的父亲走上演讲台，他为自己的女儿而骄傲。他讲述了自己的父母（余艳芬的爷爷奶奶）从中国移民到美国，从开办小小的洗衣店开始。他们努力工作，用辛勤的劳动，坚持为孩子创造好的教育条件。让他们努力学习照顾好自己，再帮助别人。他们知道在经济困难的时候，钱应该用在哪里，哪里该说Yes， 哪里该说No。父母把这些勤俭，朴实，善良，睿智代代相传。到了余艳芬这一代，他们的小家富裕，幸福。可是国家遇到了危机，政府资金不是那么富裕了，很多市民因经济萧条，没有了房子，没有了工作。在这样的情况，来为政府服务，似乎不是那么明智的选择。可是作为移民家庭，都经过了这些，这时候是让衣食无忧的孩子们，去为遇到困难的政府，家庭，市民服务的时候。余艳芬的父亲把全家人的支持，都带到了现场。 世界余氏宗親總會名譽會長余文勁走上演讲台，他说在多元化的美国社会中，华裔是少数民族当中的少数，华人社区需要有那么一个人，了解社区，把华人的声音传达出去，并将政府的信息及时传达回来。他表示余艳芬的家庭是典型的华裔移民的故事，从小生意开始，一点一点的在美国立足，这样了解移民，了解小生意主成长过程的人，才能切实的为市民服务 。余氏家族为拥有余艳芬这样的后裔而自豪，作为老华侨也为华裔有这样的青年才俊而自豪。 凤凰城的普通市民，知名华裔医生杨桐，表示因为她有多民族的视角，了解小生意主的境遇，总是给很多政府决策带来新鲜的想法。工作上的老师和朋友，州参议员琳达（Linda Gray）更是强调余艳芬有现代女性特色，她关注女性权益，关注孩子教育，关注每一个生活在社区里的居民，能有一个幸福的家。”家”是我们这个社会的一个基本单位，无论你是一个人还是十个人，从家这个单位，着手解决问题，用”家”的标准来衡量问题解决的成果（家包含物质层面和精神层面的标准），相信新的州参议员候选人余艳芬，能”从小家到大家”为每一个市民创造一个幸福的家。 希望了解更多有关余艳芬的情况请点击:www. Kimberlyyee.com 支持余艳芬的朋友可以将支票寄往P.O. BOX 83561 Phoenix, AZ 支票抬頭請填寫：”Kimberly Yee for Arizona”。 现场支持者为余艳芬摇旗助选 余艳芬（左四）以及家人与侨领们合影 余艳芬（右）与侨联主席张华芳（左）
a536c9c9f68e29db8be0cdbc2a2a9eb2ed8fe006.translatedText: From a small home to everyone - A fundraising dinner for Yu Yanfen, a state senator candidate in the 20th District of Alberta (Alberta Times report) At 6 pm on September 15, at Luk Fook Restaurant in Phoenix, more than 150 friends were welcomed to support Arizona’s first Chinese-American female congresswoman Yu Yanfen’s candidacy for the Senate in the 20th District of Alberta. Yu Yanfen and her husband, brothers and sisters, Yu family members, old and new Chinese immigrants, ABC, and many Hispanic friends spent an unforgettable night like having a reunion dinner. There was no singing and dancing, but there were flowers, applause, and touching true stories. The most attractive elements of this fundraising dinner are all in the air, making you proud of Yu Yanfen, proud of the Chinese, proud of the immigrants, and proud of an ordinary citizen. Yu Yanfen, a Chinese American, replaced the retired 10th District Representative in 2010 and became Arizona's first Chinese American Representative. She is one of the state's "48 Most Attractive Women." She took to the podium to introduce her political experience: she once served California Governor Schwarzenegger and Arizona Governor Jane Brewer, was the head of the government public relations department of the state treasurer, and also worked in various aspects such as community education for 16 years. However, compared with these political achievements, there are many things more special about Chinese-American congresswoman Yu Yanfen. Yu Yanfen has a very simple small family. At the dinner, Yu Yanfen thanked her husband for changing for her. My husband likes a free and undisciplined life, so he chose to be a dentist. Finally, he can no longer work in suits and ties from nine to five. But I didn't expect that now it was not for work, but for my wife, that I had to wear suits and leather shoes almost every day from nine to nine, sometimes working as Yu Yanfen's professional photographer, sometimes as a communications engineer, and sometimes as a logistics service worker. The couple is busy and happy serving the community. Senatorial candidate for District 20 of Alberta, Yu Yanfen. Yu Yanfen’s father took to the podium. He was proud of his daughter. He told how his parents (Yu Yanfen’s grandparents) immigrated to the United States from China and started by opening a small laundry. They work hard and insist on creating good educational conditions for their children. Let them work hard to learn to take care of themselves and then help others. They know where money should be spent in times of financial difficulty, where they should say yes and where they should say no. Parents pass on thrift, simplicity, kindness and wisdom from generation to generation. By Yu Yanfen's generation, their family was wealthy and happy. However, the country has encountered a crisis, and the government funds are not so rich. Many citizens have lost their houses and jobs due to the economic depression. Under such circumstances, serving the government does not seem to be a wise choice. But as an immigrant family, we have gone through this. Now is the time for the children, who have no worries about food and clothing, to serve the government, families, and citizens who are encountering difficulties. Yu Yanfen’s father brought the whole family’s support to the scene. Yu Wenjin, the honorary president of the World Yu Clan Association, came to the podium. He said that in the diversified American society, Chinese Americans are a minority among the ethnic minorities. The Chinese community needs someone who understands the community, conveys the voice of the Chinese, and conveys the government's information back in a timely manner. He said that Yu Yanfen’s family is a typical story of Chinese immigrants. They started with a small business and gradually established themselves in the United States. Only those who understand immigrants and the growth process of small business owners can effectively serve the citizens. The Yu family is proud to have a descendant like Yu Yanfen, and as an old overseas Chinese, we are also proud to have such young talents of Chinese descent. Yang Tong, an ordinary citizen of Phoenix City and a well-known Chinese doctor, said that because she has a multi-ethnic perspective and understands the plight of small business owners, she always brings fresh ideas to many government decisions. State Senator Linda Gray, a teacher and friend at work, emphasized that Yu Yanfen has the characteristics of a modern woman. She cares about women's rights, children's education, and every resident living in the community to have a happy home. "Home" is a basic unit of our society. Whether you are one person or ten people, start solving problems from the unit of home, and use the standard of "home" to measure the results of problem solving (home includes both material and spiritual standards). I believe that the new state senator candidate Yu Yanfen can create a happy home for every citizen "from small homes to everyone". If you want to know more about Yu Yanfen, please click: www. Kimberly Yee.com Friends who support Yu Yanfen can send checks to P.O. BOX 83561 Phoenix, AZ. Please make the check payable to: "Kimberly Yee for Arizona". Supporters on site wave flags for Yu Yanfen to support the election. Yu Yanfen (fourth from left) and her family take photos with overseas Chinese leaders. 1dbd1beb8f63e53d6ee7fa758b44718e1d553953.sourceText: 美国食品药物管理局(FDA) 日前发出警告，一些非处方外用止痛药，包括奔肌(Bengay)、辣椒膏(Capzasin)、Flexall，冰热(Icy Hot)和曼秀雷敦(Mentholatum)等，有造成严重化学烧伤的危险，FDA迄今接获43起药膏导致灼伤案例，从一度轻微灼伤至三度灼伤住院治疗 的案例都有。 外用肌肉及关节止痛剂，通常制成乳剂、药水、软膏和贴布等使用方式，含有薄荷醇(menthol)，水杨酸甲酯(methyl salicylate)等成分，或者以辣椒素(capsaicin)作为单一成分或和其他成分组合而成。 FDA表示，从第二和三度灼伤申诉案得知，多数是产品有效成分含薄荷醇，或者主要成分为薄荷醇和水杨酸甲酯。这些产品中，薄荷醇浓度超过3％，水杨酸甲酯则超过10％。他们建议，为了减少伤害事件的风险，患者应尽量避免在皮肤敷上止痛剂后，使用绷带，或者以加热垫、灯进行局部加热。 此外，FDA还提醒，这些产品不应该涂抹于开放性伤口、皮肤破损处、黏膜、或眼睛上。FDA最后补充说明，尽管产生严重的伤害申诉，因病例不多，产品标签上暂时还不会强制加注可能造成皮肤伤害的警语。
1dbd1beb8f63e53d6ee7fa758b44718e1d553953.translatedText: U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) A few days ago, a warning was issued that some over-the-counter topical analgesics, including Bengay, Capzasin, Flexall, Icy Hot, and Mentholatum, have the risk of causing severe chemical burns. The FDA has received 43 cases of burns caused by the ointments so far, ranging from first-degree minor burns to third-degree burns that resulted in hospitalization. External muscle and joint analgesics are usually made into emulsions, potions, ointments, patches, etc., and contain ingredients such as menthol and methyl salicylate, or capsaicin as a single ingredient or in combination with other ingredients. The FDA stated that it has learned from second- and third-degree burn complaints that most of the products contain menthol as the active ingredient, or the main ingredients are menthol and methyl salicylate. In these products, menthol concentrations exceed 3% and methyl salicylate exceeds 10%. They recommend that in order to reduce the risk of injury, patients should try to avoid applying analgesics to the skin, using bandages, or using heating pads or lamps for local heating. In addition, the FDA reminds that these products should not be applied to open wounds, broken skin, mucous membranes, or eyes. The FDA finally added that despite serious injury complaints, due to the small number of cases, product labels will not be required to add warnings about possible skin damage for the time being.

74c74504f994b039821a1b64c7a29b1a3a1f25fc.sourceText: 法官星期二裁决，亚利桑那州警方可立即执行SB1070中最有争议的条款，即警方在其它执法活动中可以盘问被怀疑是非法在美居留者的移民身份。 美国地区法官博尔顿的裁决是针对亚利桑那州移民法长达两年法律战中的一个里程碑。美国最高法院今年6月维持这一条款不变，认为它同联邦法律没有冲突。 反对者将这一条款称为”出示你的文件”。在最高法院做出裁决之后，他们要求博尔顿法官阻止该条款的实施，声称它将导致系统性地种族分类和对拉美裔的长期无理监禁。 SB1070中其它争议较小的条款，包括对于2005年移民偷渡法的小幅变更和禁止州和地方政府机构限制实施联邦移民法，已经在2010年7月生效。但那些条款几乎没有什么作用。 尽管亚利桑那警方获准盘查移民身份，但这一法律的支持者仍然质疑联邦移民特工的合作程度，因为警方需要后者核查移民身份并带走非法移民。 联邦移民官员说，他们将提供帮助，但条件是必须符合他们的优先安排，包括抓获累犯和发现并遣返威胁公共安全和国家安全的人。 如果联邦特工不去带走非法移民，地方警察只好放走那些人，除非怀疑他们犯罪。 SB1070的反对者包括奥巴马政府，后者对该法最有争议的部分发起挑战，迫使它被暂停实施。在2010年7月该法生效之前不久，博尔顿阻止警察实施盘问移民身份条款，裁决认为奥巴马政府能胜诉。 州长布鲁尔对那一裁决提出上诉，在第九巡回上诉法庭失败，又把案子送到最高法院。奥巴马政府未能说服最高法院大法官打消要求警察盘查移民身份的条款。 民权、宗教和商界联合会今年7月要求博尔顿阻止警方实施盘查移民身份条款，认为该条款会导致拉美裔受到种族区分和长期无理拘留。州长的律师则要求法官允许那一条款立即生效。博尔顿9月5日否决了联合会的要求。
74c74504f994b039821a1b64c7a29b1a3a1f25fc.translatedText: A judge ruled on Tuesday that the Arizona police can immediately enforce the most controversial provision of SB1070, that is, police can question the immigration status of people suspected of being in the United States illegally during other law enforcement activities. U.S. District Judge Bolton's ruling is a milestone in a two-year legal battle over Arizona's immigration laws. The U.S. Supreme Court upheld this provision in June this year, holding that it did not conflict with federal law. Opponents refer to this provision as "show your documents." Following the Supreme Court's ruling, they asked Judge Bolton to block the provision, claiming it would lead to systematic racial profiling and the long and unjustified incarceration of Latinos. Other less controversial provisions of SB 1070, which included minor changes to the 2005 Immigrant Smuggling Act and prohibited state and local government agencies from restricting enforcement of federal immigration laws, took effect in July 2010. But those provisions had little effect. Although Arizona police are allowed to check immigration status, supporters of the law still question the level of cooperation from federal immigration agents who are needed to verify immigration status and remove illegal immigrants. Federal immigration officials say they will provide help but only if it meets their priorities, which include catching repeat offenders and identifying and deporting people who threaten public safety and national security. If federal agents don't remove illegal immigrants, local police have no choice but to let them go unless they are suspected of committing a crime. Opponents of SB 1070 include the Obama administration, which challenged the most controversial parts of the law, forcing its suspension. Shortly before the law took effect in July 2010, Bolton blocked police from enforcing immigration status questioning provisions, ruling that the Obama administration would win. Governor Brewer appealed that ruling, lost in the Ninth Circuit Court of Appeals, and took the case to the Supreme Court. The Obama administration has failed to convince a Supreme Court justice to strike down a provision requiring police to check immigration status. Civil rights, religious and business unions asked Bolton in July to prevent police from enforcing immigration status checks, arguing that the provision would lead to racial distinctions and long-term unreasonable detention of Latinos. The governor's lawyers asked the judge to allow that provision to take effect immediately. Bolton rejected the federation's request on September 5.

291576bca61b8df327a4ef519107658c755cff77.sourceText: 17日是美国宪法签署第225年纪念日，美国人口普查局报告称，截至17日中午，美国总人口达到3.14395013亿人。 世界调整时间2012年9月18日06:39时，美国总人口3.14399374亿人，世界总人口70.40068533亿人。 人口普查局官网称，美国经济状况还是没有明显的好转，2011年家庭中位收入比上一年下降1.5%。以四口之家年收入23021美元为贫困线的标准，2011年美国有4260万人处于贫困线下，贫困率为15%，没有变化，有4860万人没有医疗保险。 美国生活的外国出生者也就是主要是移民2011年家庭平均收入为44431美元，比上年减少2%，从中可以看出亚裔移民家庭收入减少的程度比美国家庭总体水平更严重。再看看贫困率，去年亚裔有197万人生活在贫困线下，贫困率为12.3%。
291576bca61b8df327a4ef519107658c755cff77.translatedText: The 17th is the 225th anniversary of the signing of the U.S. Constitution. The U.S. Census Bureau reported that as of noon on the 17th, the total population of the United States reached 314,395,013 million people. At 06:39 UTC on September 18, 2012, the total population of the United States was 314399374 million, and the total world population was 7040068533 million. According to the official website of the Census Bureau, the U.S. economic situation has not improved significantly. In 2011, the median household income fell by 1.5% compared with the previous year. Using the annual income of US$23,021 for a family of four as the poverty line, 42.6 million people in the United States were below the poverty line in 2011, with a poverty rate of 15%, unchanged, and 48.6 million people without medical insurance. The average family income of foreign-born people living in the United States, who are mainly immigrants, was $44,431 in 2011, a decrease of 2% from the previous year. It can be seen that the income of Asian immigrant families has decreased more seriously than that of American families as a whole. Looking at the poverty rate, 1.97 million Asians lived below the poverty line last year, with a poverty rate of 12.3%.

The use of smart phones is becoming more and more common, but as consumers pay more and more attention to personal privacy, the usage habits of mobile phone users have gradually...

9ac4e931e25e4a68dbe20c422cf3384d4408c87d.sourceText: 54%手机族 防泄密拒app 智慧手机的使用愈来愈普遍，但由于消费者对个人隐私愈加重视，手机族的使用习惯渐趋保守，根据5日公布的一项调查，超过一半使用智慧手机者不再下载手机应用软体( app)，也有人将现有软体移除，以避免网路上有其他人查看或分享其个人资讯。 调查指出，88%受调者表示使用手机，但民调也发现，美国人手机遗失率惊人，多达三分之一称曾遗失过手机。 这项由丕优网路与美国生活计画(Pew Internet & American Life)进行的民调发现，有54%手机使用人在了解安装应用软体，将造成个人资讯被其他人分享后，决定不安装 这些软体。 30%手机使用者为隐私的原因，移除手机上的应用软体。 半数手机使用者清除浏览器贮存内容或搜寻历史，来去除个人资讯；三分之一使用者关闭个人所在地显示功能，以免透露行踪。 四分之一的18到24岁年轻智慧型手机使用者表示，未被授权的使用者曾企图查看他们手机中的个人资讯；25到34岁的使用者中，18%表示，未被授权的 使用者曾企图查看其手机中的个人资讯；65岁以上的使用者中，只有2%个人资讯曾遭外人查看。 41%使用者表示，他们会把手机中的资讯，如照片和朋友的电话号码，复制到储存设备中，以避免遗失手机造成失去重要个人资讯。 曾经遗失手机者，大多会复制手机中的重要资讯。 为保护个人隐私，男性使用者比女性更倾向移除应用软体。 为保护个人隐私而决定不安装应用软体者，没有性别差异。 遗失手机或手机被偷的比率：黑莓机使用者高达45%；使用iPhone者为36%；Android系统手机为6%。 以年龄层统计手机遗失率：18到24岁手机遗失率为45%；35到54岁为45%；65岁以上为20%。 丕优民调机构于3月15日到4月3日间，在全国访问2254位手机使用者而得到上述数字，其误差率为正负2.4%。
9ac4e931e25e4a68dbe20c422cf3384d4408c87d.translatedText: 54% of mobile phone users refuse apps to prevent secret leakage. The use of smartphones is becoming more and more common, but as consumers pay more attention to personal privacy, the usage habits of mobile phone owners are becoming more conservative. According to a survey released on the 5th, more than half of people who use smartphones no longer download mobile application software (app), and some people remove existing software to prevent others from viewing or sharing their personal information on the Internet. The survey pointed out that 88% of those surveyed said they use mobile phones, but the poll also found that Americans have an alarming rate of losing their mobile phones, with as many as one-third saying they have lost their mobile phones. The poll, conducted by Pew Internet & American Life, found that 54% of mobile phone users decided not to install application software after understanding that installing it would cause personal information to be shared with others. 30% of mobile phone users remove applications from their phones for privacy reasons. Half of mobile phone users clear their browser cache or search history to remove personal information; one-third turn off the display of their personal location to avoid revealing their whereabouts. A quarter of young smartphone users aged 18 to 24 said that unauthorized users have tried to view personal information on their phones; 18% of users aged 25 to 34 said that unauthorized users have tried to view personal information on their phones; only 2% of users over 65 years old have had their personal information viewed by outsiders. 41% of users said they would copy information on their phones, such as photos and friends’ phone numbers, to storage devices to avoid losing important personal information if their phones were lost. Most people who have lost their mobile phones will copy the important information in their mobile phones. To protect personal privacy, male users are more likely than female users to remove applications. There is no gender difference in those who decide not to install applications to protect personal privacy. The rate of lost or stolen mobile phones is as high as 45% for BlackBerry users; 36% for iPhone users; and 6% for Android phones. The mobile phone loss rate is calculated by age group: 45% of mobile phones are lost among those aged 18 to 24; 45% among those aged between 35 and 54; and 20% among those aged over 65. The Piyou polling agency obtained the above figures by interviewing 2,254 mobile phone users across the country from March 15 to April 3, with an error rate of plus or minus 2.4%.

93f7087444b9c2f5baa65c6d916442e25f96ae89.sourceText: 旅游网站均推介9月是最佳月份，前往世界各地不同的景点，包括弗吉尼亚海滩，迪斯尼世界，迪士尼乐园，玛莎葡萄园岛，泰山北斗，多伦多，巴黎和北京。
93f7087444b9c2f5baa65c6d916442e25f96ae89.translatedText: Travel websites recommend September as the best month to travel to different attractions around the world, including Virginia Beach, Disney World, Disneyland, Martha's Vineyard, Taishan Beidou, Toronto, Paris and Beijing.

6cc23bc16f825c75d5e9b7c0ff6c784b176297e0.sourceText: 9月是颶风季节的高峰期，但是，不代表你有机会体验到，尤其是位于弗吉尼亚州的东南部。北卡罗莱纳州，往往是东岸首当其冲的颶风吹袭的地区。
6cc23bc16f825c75d5e9b7c0ff6c784b176297e0.translatedText: September is the peak of hurricane season, but that doesn’t mean you have a chance to experience it, especially in southeastern Virginia. North Carolina is often the area that bears the brunt of hurricanes on the East Coast.

4e92585c3f9d6ec172cad52ee2c48018e0375dce.sourceText: 9月份，前往弗吉尼亚海滩，享受到怡人的天气，气温保持于80度华氏，加上夏季的人潮都走了，酒店的价格下跌。每天的海滨酒店房间，包括免费的早餐，预计只需支付大约100美元。
4e92585c3f9d6ec172cad52ee2c48018e0375dce.translatedText: In September, go to Virginia Beach and enjoy the pleasant weather. The temperature remains at 80 degrees Fahrenheit. Plus, the summer crowds have left, and hotel prices have dropped. Expect to pay only about $100 per day for an oceanfront hotel room, including free breakfast.

6cb5e149c7a2cd70caa07941c541c9287a6f460d.sourceText: 迪斯尼世界： 如果愿意让孩子请假几天，9月份前往迪斯尼世界，就不用跟夏季的游客挤迫，天气凉爽，也不太潮湿。各地飞往奥兰多的航班和酒店也更为便宜。
6cb5e149c7a2cd70caa07941c541c9287a6f460d.translatedText: Disney World: If you are willing to let your children take a few days off, go to Disney World in September so you don’t have to crowd with summer tourists, and the weather is cooler and not too humid. Flights and hotels to Orlando are also cheaper from various locations.

1cfc5d5cae1bcad5d2ce3707fc21dccff1aa98e5.sourceText: 迪士尼乐园： 前往迪斯尼世界，还有一个额外的好处，就是不用担心颶风。 玛莎葡萄园岛： 比弗吉尼亚海滩更受欢迎，在劳工节之后，熙熙攘攘的人群随即减少，但是，气候仍然是温和，岛上的企业持续经营，直至10月迎接秋季的游客。如果这还不够吸引力，劳工节之后，当地的酒店或渡假屋，价格至少下降25%。
1cfc5d5cae1bcad5d2ce3707fc21dccff1aa98e5.translatedText: Disneyland: An added benefit of traveling to Disney World is that you don’t have to worry about hurricanes. Martha's Vineyard: More popular than Virginia Beach, the bustling crowds die down after Labor Day, but the climate remains mild and the island's businesses continue to operate well into October to welcome fall visitors. If that’s not tempting enough, after Labor Day, prices at local hotels or vacation rentals drop by at least 25%.

139567bc77367f995f2a90362c081f7698ccc62b.sourceText: 夏季的天气一直延伸到9月，却不会有太多的游客。据统计，每年6月至8月份，超过150万名游客前往拉什莫尔山。像其他附近的夏季旅游目的地，在劳工节之后，酒店价格下降20%以上。
139567bc77367f995f2a90362c081f7698ccc62b.translatedText: The summer weather extends into September, but there aren’t many tourists. According to statistics, more than 1.5 million tourists visit Mount Rushmore from June to August every year. Like other nearby summer destinations, hotel prices drop more than 20% after Labor Day.

58ee6d880a23e85e5a8f4ed12a3b695c104cbe37.translatedText: The 10 highest-paying jobs in the United States that do not require a degree. Recently, a report from Georgetown University pointed out that during the economic recession, Americans with only a high school diploma...

9b00dbfcdabcae010d0789b35700387eb7ca1463.sourceText: 事实上，对于那些以任何理由不能考上大学的美国人，还有数以百计，甚至数以千计的高薪职位，其入职条件只需要高中毕业文凭。
9b00dbfcdabcae010d0789b35700387eb7ca1463.translatedText: In fact, for those Americans who cannot go to college for any reason, there are hundreds or even thousands of high-paying positions, and the entry requirements only require a high school diploma.

54d92fa6e94fdd227884615a070cadc606da85a8.sourceText: 《24/7华尔街》评论2011年劳工统计局的职业概况资料，找出最高薪的工作，却又不要求任何超过高中文凭的学历。
54d92fa6e94fdd227884615a070cadc606da85a8.translatedText: "24/7 Wall Street" reviewed the 2011 Bureau of Labor Statistics occupational profile data to find the highest-paying jobs that don't require anything more than a high school diploma.

696e55f9c9df53365dd2c6878856a727746d86ef.sourceText: 绝大多数的高薪工作，具有大专以上学历，是一个先决条件。
696e55f9c9df53365dd2c6878856a727746d86ef.translatedText: For the vast majority of high-paying jobs, a college degree or above is a prerequisite.

86d49834607b70f85a4783d61dabbfddcc3f8667.sourceText: 2011年，在185个职位类别中，薪金中位数为至少60,000美元的工作，只有16个职位的入职条件，不需要大专以上学历的。
86d49834607b70f85a4783d61dabbfddcc3f8667.translatedText: In 2011, of 185 job categories, only 16 jobs with a median salary of at least $60,000 had entry requirements that did not require a college degree or above.

24ae32174e71944b841f5cf9bcb928bd699d16a9.sourceText: 其中24个最高薪的就业机会，必须具备一个学士学位，在许多情况下，甚至是一个硕士或博士学位。
24ae32174e71944b841f5cf9bcb928bd699d16a9.translatedText: For 24 of the highest paying job opportunities, one must have a bachelor's degree and, in many cases, even a master's or doctoral degree.

3590c4c310c0675e7fad1c97ad4b59d3ae38f1db.sourceText: 只有极少数的高薪职位，只需要一个高中文凭入职，大多数是由较低的职位做起，随著时间而得到晋升的机会。
3590c4c310c0675e7fad1c97ad4b59d3ae38f1db.translatedText: There are only a handful of high-paying positions that only require a high school diploma to join. Most start from lower positions and gain opportunities for promotion over time.

1aa13bc9418c7e3c360b29ccfbade0dd7aa0162b.sourceText: 其中10个职位中，有5个是主管或经理的职位。
1aa13bc9418c7e3c360b29ccfbade0dd7aa0162b.translatedText: Among the 10 positions, 5 are supervisor or manager positions.

03bbf20c36c2ad7d7df19e16614792d13b6e2d4c.sourceText: 此外，许多这些高薪的工作，得到较多的补偿金，主要是因为工作环境的危险，或是极为不利的工作条件。
03bbf20c36c2ad7d7df19e16614792d13b6e2d4c.translatedText: In addition, many of these high-paying jobs receive larger compensation mainly because of the dangerous working environment or extremely unfavorable working conditions.

3f92fe6a4249f65e17b3d6d15060e1094d751596.sourceText: 例如，地铁运营商，获支付的年薪中位数为63,000美元，工作时间长，轮班的地下工作。电梯维修工和核电厂操纵员，其工作也可能危及生命，因此相对得到更高的薪金。 为了找出各类不需要大学学位的高薪职位，《24/7华尔街》研究劳工局的职业就业统计的数据，具有最高的平均年薪的工作，也找出预计未来10年的职位增长。
3f92fe6a4249f65e17b3d6d15060e1094d751596.translatedText: Subway operators, for example, are paid a median annual salary of $63,000 and work long hours and shifts underground. Elevator maintenance workers and nuclear power plant operators, whose jobs can also be life-threatening, receive relatively higher salaries. To identify the types of high-paying jobs that don't require a college degree, 24/7 Wall Street looked at data from the Bureau of Labor Statistics' Occupational Employment Statistics to identify the jobs with the highest average annual salaries and to find out where job growth is expected to be over the next 10 years.

df1ae3a9e541791a2d42ea7889d06291d7e502db.sourceText: 首届亚利桑那大学孔子学院中国文化节9月22日图桑举办(图) 首届亚利桑那大学孔子学院中国文化节 9月22-30 日 美国亚利桑那大学孔子学院 美国亚利桑那州图桑市 为向当地美国民众介绍中国文化，促进汉语教学， 和提高亚大孔院的知名度， 亚利桑那大学孔子学院（亚大孔院）正在同大学和社区一起积极筹备图桑首届中国文化节。这次文化节的活动内容丰富，形式多样，力求满足美国民众 对多方位了解中国文化的需要。首届亚大孔院中国文化节将在九月二十二日以在图桑市公园的中华健康日隆重拉开帷幕。接下一周活动包括系列中国文化讲座，涉及中国少林功夫和太极，孔府祭乐和民乐，中国电影和导演，及中国考古。我们还将举办中国诗歌讲座和中秋 诗歌 音乐会及汉语日全市大，中，小学生汉语大赛。九月三十日中秋之 夜，亚大孔院将同美国当地的音乐家和学生们一起献上一场 浓郁中国风情的仲秋晚会来为这次文化节 画上一个圆满的句号。 此次中国文化节得到了各界广泛的支持和校方的极其重视。直接 协助亚大孔院 举办文化节的亚利桑那大学的学院和系就有人文学院， 东亚系，诗词中心，音乐学院， 公共卫生学院， 疾病预防和健康保健中心，社会和行为科学院，及人类学系等单位。图桑中国文化中心，图桑 华声合唱团, 图桑华人舞蹈队，图桑华人太极队，图桑华人武术队，和中医和针灸学校等十几个社会团体也纷纷加盟和参与文化节的准备活动；市政 有关管理部门专门为我们中国文化节 的开幕式开放公园 场地并提供减价动物园门票以吸引 家庭和各年龄组的市民大众参加。当地参演的专业和业余演员们正在积极紧张地排练。各个学区和学校正在踊跃报名参加汉语日的竞赛活动。 中国领馆将派人从洛杉矶前来参加文化节。图桑市市长和亚利桑那大学的校领导将出席中华健康日（9 月22 日）并在当日中国文化节开幕式上做讲演。 社会各界将出席一周多的文化节的活动。文化节期间亚大孔院还将邀请大学和图桑市领导及 社会名流参观亚大孔院和探讨孔院近期和长期的发展计划。当地电台和报纸就首届中国文化节采访了 孔院院长和孔院学生并将陆续向 市民报道。汉办北京总部的网络孔子学院 已和亚大孔院协商，计划通过首届中国文化节宣传网络孔子学院和鼓励学生注册网络孔子学院。网络孔子学院还将开设专栏介绍和报道亚大孔院 组织的首届图桑中国文化节。 预计直接参加这次中国文化节的人数将达到四千。通过报纸，电视和多媒体了解图桑中国文化节的美国大众将不计其数。亚大孔院期待在中国文化节之际同更多的大学院系，政府机构，和社会团体建立共识和合作，为当地中国语言和文化教学工作的进一步发展创下良好的群众基础和社会环境。 有关于图桑中国文化节和亚大孔子学院的详细介绍请登陆亚大孔院的网站 http://confucius.arizona.edu 有关文化节的具体活动和时间： Chinese Health Day Saturday, September 22 | 8 a.m. -12 p.m. Explore Chinese Martial Arts and Tai Chi with Masters Junmin Zhao and Junjie Feng from Shaolin, China. They were the leading performers at the opening ceremony of the 2008 Beijing Olympic Games. Discover traditional Chinese medicine, learn how to cook healthy Chinese cuisine, and receive complimentary admission to the Reid Park Zoo. Co-hosted by the UA Mel and Enid Zuckerman College of Public Health and the Canyon Ranch Center for Prevention & Health Promotion. Co-hosted by the UA School of Anthropology. Location: UA Student Union, Kiva Room, 2nd floor Chinese Language Day Saturday, September 29 | 9 a.m. -2 p.m. Co-hosted by Tucson Chinese Association Tucson elementary, middle, high school, and college students test their knowledge of Chinese language. Other activities include making traditional moon cakes, Chinese games, cultural activities and prizes! Location: Tucson Chinese Cultural Center, 1288 West River Road, Tucson, AZ 85704 Moon Festival Concert Sunday, September 30 | 7 p.m. -9 p.m. Attendees can experience Chinese traditional music, folk songs, and choral masterworks at the Moon Festival Concert. Co-hosted by the UA School of Music and the Tucson Sino Choir, this celebration of Chinese composition is an encounter not to be missed. Location: UA Crowder Hall, 1017 E Olive Rd., Tucson, AZ 85719
df1ae3a9e541791a2d42ea7889d06291d7e502db.translatedText: The First Confucius Institute at the University of Arizona Chinese Culture Festival was held in Tucson on September 22 (picture) The First Confucius Institute at the University of Arizona Chinese Culture Festival was held from September 22 to 30, Confucius Institute at the University of Arizona, Tucson, Arizona, United States. In order to introduce Chinese culture to the local American people, promote Chinese language teaching, and increase the visibility of the Confucius Institute at the University of Arizona (Confucius Institute at the University of Arizona), the Confucius Institute at the University of Arizona (Confucius Institute at the University of Arizona) is actively preparing for the first Chinese Culture Festival in Tucson together with the university and the community. The activities of this cultural festival are rich in content and diverse in form, striving to meet the needs of the American people for a multi-faceted understanding of Chinese culture. The first Asian University Confucius Institute Chinese Culture Festival will grandly kick off with the Chinese Health Day at Tucson City Park on September 22. Activities in the coming week include a series of lectures on Chinese culture, covering Chinese Shaolin Kung Fu and Tai Chi, Confucian ritual music and folk music, Chinese films and directors, and Chinese archeology. We will also hold Chinese poetry lectures and Mid-Autumn Festival poetry concerts, as well as a city-wide Chinese language competition for college, middle school and primary school students on Chinese Language Day. On the night of the Mid-Autumn Festival on September 30, the Confucius Institute at Asia University will present a Mid-Autumn Party with a rich Chinese style together with local musicians and students in the United States to bring this cultural festival to a successful conclusion. This Chinese Culture Festival has received widespread support from all walks of life and the school attaches great importance to it. Colleges and departments at the University of Arizona that directly assist the Confucius Institute at Asia University in organizing cultural festivals include the School of Humanities, the Department of East Asia, the Poetry Center, the School of Music, the School of Public Health, the Center for Disease Prevention and Health Care, the School of Social and Behavioral Sciences, and the Department of Anthropology. More than a dozen social groups, including the Tucson Chinese Cultural Center, the Tucson Huasheng Chorus, the Tucson Chinese Dance Team, the Tucson Chinese Tai Chi Team, the Tucson Chinese Martial Arts Team, and schools of traditional Chinese medicine and acupuncture, have also joined and participated in the preparations for the cultural festival; the relevant municipal management departments have specially opened park venues for the opening ceremony of our Chinese Cultural Festival and provided reduced-price zoo tickets to attract families and citizens of all age groups to participate. Local professional and amateur actors are rehearsing intensively. Various school districts and schools are actively signing up to participate in the Chinese Language Day competition. The Chinese Consulate will send people from Los Angeles to attend the cultural festival. The mayor of Tucson and the leaders of the University of Arizona will attend China Health Day (September 22) and give speeches at the opening ceremony of the Chinese Culture Festival on that day. All walks of life will attend the cultural festival's activities over a week. During the cultural festival, the Confucius Institute at Asia University will also invite university and Tucson city leaders and celebrities to visit the Confucius Institute at Asia University and discuss the Confucius Institute’s recent and long-term development plans. Local radio stations and newspapers interviewed the director of the Confucius Institute and students of the Confucius Institute about the first Chinese Culture Festival and will continue to report to the public. The Online Confucius Institute at the Beijing headquarters of Hanban has negotiated with the Confucius Institute at Asia University to promote the Online Confucius Institute through the first Chinese Culture Festival and encourage students to register for the Online Confucius Institute. The Online Confucius Institute will also open a column to introduce and report on the first Tucson Chinese Culture Festival organized by the Confucius Institute at Asia University. It is expected that the number of people directly participating in this Chinese Culture Festival will reach 4,000. Countless Americans will learn about the Tucson Chinese Cultural Festival through newspapers, television and multimedia. The Confucius Institute at Asia University looks forward to establishing consensus and cooperation with more university departments, government agencies, and social groups on the occasion of the Chinese Culture Festival, so as to create a good mass foundation and social environment for the further development of local Chinese language and culture teaching. For detailed information about the Tucson Chinese Cultural Festival and the Confucius Institute at UA, please visit the website of the Confucius Institute at UA at http://confucius.arizona.edu. Other activities include making traditional moon cakes, Chinese games, cultural activities and prizes! ab1d50bc679bae7ae54c7fdc966c66fa14691444.sourceText: 联邦政府30日颁布执行健保法的新规定显示，参加雇主健保计画的低收入员工，他们购买保险的保费可获联邦抵税，但不适用于他们的子女。维权组织估计，约50万员工子女将受到影响，可能没有保险。 健保法规定，大企业必须为员工提供保险和补贴，以使保费不会超过员工薪资的9.5%，否则企业将面临罚款。联邦政府去年规定，雇主必须为员工的未成年子女提供保险，但不必提供补贴。雇主则不一定须为员工配偶提供保险。 从2014年开始，许多买不起保险的低收入者购买保险的保费，可获联邦抵税。但根据新规定，即使保费超过员工的负担，抵税政策也不适用于参加雇主健保计画的员工的子女。政府说，这些低收入者将无需为没有健保而支付罚款。 财政部人员说，规定是根据健保法条文制定的，但维权组织感到失望。消费者联盟说，家庭保险计画的保费如果占低收入员工的收入过高，政府应允许他们的子女申请联邦退税，联盟律师萝莉索贝尔说：「联邦政府的这一规定，可能阻碍更多没有保险的人取得健保。」这一规定实际上是促使想买保险的家庭做出比较，在没有抵税的保险计画与雇主健保计画的保费之间选择。
ab1d50bc679bae7ae54c7fdc966c66fa14691444.translatedText: New regulations issued by the federal government on the 30th to implement the health insurance law show that low-income employees who participate in employer health insurance plans can receive federal tax credits for their insurance premiums, but this does not apply to their children. Rights groups estimate that about 500,000 employees' children will be affected and may be uninsured. The health insurance law stipulates that large companies must provide insurance and subsidies for employees so that premiums do not exceed 9.5% of employees' salaries, otherwise the company will face fines. The federal government last year mandated that employers provide coverage for employees' minor children but do not have to subsidize it. Employers are not required to provide insurance for employee spouses. Starting in 2014, many low-income people who cannot afford insurance can receive federal tax credits for purchasing insurance premiums. But under the new rules, even if the premium exceeds the employee's burden, the tax credit policy does not apply to the children of employees who participate in employer health insurance plans. The government says these low-income earners will not have to pay penalties for not having health insurance. Treasury officials said the regulations were based on the provisions of the health care law, but activist groups were disappointed. The Consumers Union said that if the premiums for family insurance plans account for too much of low-income workers' income, the government should allow their children to apply for federal tax refunds. "This federal rule may prevent more uninsured people from obtaining health insurance," said Alliance lawyer Lori Sobel. This rule actually prompts families who want to buy insurance to compare and choose between insurance plans without tax credits and the premiums of employer health insurance plans.

a0e4af18b9c3882a653c9b8becaeb57c3442153c.sourceText: 当谈论到旅游消费时，总有一些明智的建议和选择，这些指引是真的吗？
a0e4af18b9c3882a653c9b8becaeb57c3442153c.translatedText: When it comes to travel spending, there are always some wise suggestions and choices. Are these guidelines true?

28adf6592bda1b61d456c53f04c238c165d7a1fd.translatedText: (1) The earlier you book your flight, the better?

2be1b93f0deff1b7c6f4d6680ababd6b8cee6714.sourceText: 去年，航空公司报告的研究指出总共820亿美元的预订机票金额，发现最佳价格的机票于旅行出发之前的6个星期。2011年的研究发现，在这段时间内订购的机票大约便宜6%，甚至高于前年的折扣。最近CheapAir.com的研究发现，提早7个星期预订机票，将会得到最优惠的机票。调查机票的博客加里莱夫(Gary Leff)说，航空公司不会提早推出优惠机票，或以飞行里数来兑现便宜的机票，也以旅行日期和时间来决定。如果想以飞行里数来买机票，可能要再提前6至9个月。
2be1b93f0deff1b7c6f4d6680ababd6b8cee6714.translatedText: Last year, airlines reported a total of $82 billion in air bookings, finding that the best prices occurred six weeks before travel. Research from 2011 found that flights booked during this period were about 6% cheaper, even higher than the discounts the year before. A recent CheapAir.com study found that booking flights seven weeks in advance will result in the best deals. Gary Leff, a blogger who investigates air tickets, said airlines do not offer discounted tickets early or use miles to redeem cheaper tickets, but also decide based on the date and time of travel. If you want to use flight miles to buy air tickets, you may have to wait 6 to 9 months in advance.

8bdcc101c7daef21cfca1b6457a569ca52e744ee.sourceText: （二）旅行租用汽车时，需要额外支付保险？
8bdcc101c7daef21cfca1b6457a569ca52e744ee.translatedText: (2) Do I need to pay extra for insurance when renting a car for travel?

508032942d0e44de1f66a3a17153a03d84c158b5.sourceText: 租车公司可能会建议加设购买额外的保险，如果发生意外，损坏或被盗等，可以得到全面的补偿。专家建议不要被骗，因为你可能已经有汽车保险的全面覆盖，许多汽车保险政策也包括租车在内，但是其细节可能有所不同。因此，在旅行之前，可以先联繫保险公司，以确保已有保险服务。即使你的车保没有覆盖，但是，现时各款各样的信用卡也扩大租车保险的服务。租车时，通常必须使用信用卡支付，大多数情况下，信用卡的保险覆盖不是全面的，可能仍要提交一份汽车保险索赔资料。
508032942d0e44de1f66a3a17153a03d84c158b5.translatedText: The car rental company may recommend purchasing additional insurance to provide comprehensive compensation in the event of an accident, damage or theft. Experts advise not to be scammed, as you may already have comprehensive car insurance coverage. Many car insurance policies also cover rental cars, but the details may vary. Therefore, before traveling, you can contact your insurance company to make sure you have coverage. Even if your car insurance doesn't cover it, various credit cards now offer car rental insurance services. When renting a car, you usually have to pay with a credit card. In most cases, credit card insurance coverage is not comprehensive, and you may still have to file a car insurance claim.

d82ba77f4d4650652185bb0dbdaf572935daee3b.sourceText: 因此，出门前，可以先检查信用卡的覆盖面。
d82ba77f4d4650652185bb0dbdaf572935daee3b.translatedText: Therefore, before you go out, you can check the coverage of your credit card.

1e7a7659c0ad520b370b80ad00f2686b592abf37.sourceText: （三）在海外以现金付款，可以得到更好的汇率？
1e7a7659c0ad520b370b80ad00f2686b592abf37.translatedText: (3) Can I get a better exchange rate by paying in cash overseas?

f36b7844eb040979f61770adfb889b6f282035aa.sourceText: 在海外其他国家，以美元换成当地货币来购物，并不代表你可以避免钱币交易的手续费。最重要的是每天的货币转换的汇率不一样，在一般情况下，最聪明的做法是海外旅行时，尽量使用信用卡。美国有些信用卡提供购物保障，万一发现货品破碎了，或是交易金额出现问题，你可以提出除消信用卡的交易项目。根据调查发现，信用卡公司提供的货币汇率，比较美国各大银行的兑换货币率便宜大约8%，比较各大机场的货币汇率便宜大约16%。但是，你要确保信用卡不额外收取国外交易手续费3%。
f36b7844eb040979f61770adfb889b6f282035aa.translatedText: In other overseas countries, converting US dollars into local currencies for shopping does not mean that you can avoid currency transaction fees. On top of that, currency conversion rates vary from day to day, and in general, the smartest thing to do is to try to use a credit card when traveling overseas. Some credit cards in the United States provide purchase protection. If you find that the goods are broken or there is a problem with the transaction amount, you can cancel the credit card transaction. According to the survey, the currency exchange rates provided by credit card companies are about 8% cheaper than the currency exchange rates of major U.S. banks, and about 16% cheaper than the currency exchange rates of major airports. However, you want to make sure that the credit card does not charge an additional 3% foreign transaction fee.

9bfac31082b2c0d5b7aa546050199aca8ce2d9d8.sourceText: （四）週二晚上购买最便宜机票？
9bfac31082b2c0d5b7aa546050199aca8ce2d9d8.translatedText: (Thursday) Buying the cheapest air tickets on Tuesday night?

2f74f12fead901b72b3948d97e2c2919d61450df.sourceText: 消费倡导者克里斯托弗埃利奥特(Christopher Elliott)指出，这是一个持续的传说，指出每逢星期二午夜可以在网上找到最优惠的机票。最新两项的研究发现情况并不如此。得克萨斯州A&M大学的研究人员在一个星期内，不同的日子购买同一航班的机票，结果发现週末购买机票更便宜大约5%。然而，CheapAir.com的研究却有不同的结论，调查发现没有特定一天的机票价格显著降低。
2f74f12fead901b72b3948d97e2c2919d61450df.translatedText: It's an ongoing legend, says consumer advocate Christopher Elliott, noting that the best airfare deals can be found online every Tuesday at midnight. Two recent studies find that's not the case. Researchers at Texas A&M University bought tickets for the same flight on different days of the week and found that it was about 5% cheaper to buy tickets on the weekends. However, CheapAir.com's research came to a different conclusion, finding that there was no particular day when airfares were significantly lower.

6b96e24ebafd8a74982351c10bfaeb68069d2102.sourceText: 现实是许多旅客在机场閒逛或消磨时间时，总会发现免税店的香水，太阳眼镜，巧克力等的价格更为便宜。事实上，许多的产品并不是如此优惠。当然，你不用支付正规商店的税款，但是，很多时候，免税店的商品价格高于正规商店的售价。Esquire杂志做了一个免税店的价格比较调查，发现酒和香烟确实是有不错的优惠。但是，香水，珠宝等，零售店的售价更加便宜。
6b96e24ebafd8a74982351c10bfaeb68069d2102.translatedText: The reality is that when many travelers hang out or kill time at the airport, they will always find that the prices of perfume, sunglasses, chocolates, etc. in duty-free shops are cheaper. In fact, many products are not so affordable. Of course, you don’t have to pay taxes in regular stores, but many times, the prices of goods in duty-free stores are higher than those in regular stores. Esquire magazine conducted a price comparison survey on duty-free shops and found that there are indeed good discounts on wine and cigarettes. However, perfumes, jewelry, etc., are sold more cheaply in retail stores.

91f5279d04a49bbdea650cc5930f11558123f033.sourceText: 为庆祝中华人民共和国成立六十三周年，祝愿祖国日益繁荣昌盛，凤凰城侨界决定於2012年9月15日在上午九点在American Legion Arizona Department of Arizona(地址4701 N 19th Ave Phoenix AZ 85015 ) 举行扬升中国和美国两国国旗典礼仪式。 凤凰城侨界在2009年中华人民共和国成立六十周年之际，曾联合举辨了升旗典礼，表达华人华侨对祖国的热爱。祖国在不断发展中走向强大，让我们海外华侨感到扬眉吐气。 在上世纪九十年代初，当时中美关系仍在发展之中。美国在中国只有将近一千家公司，投资额亦只有四十亿美元，而到了2012年，单是亚省就有5400间企业对中国有业务上的联系，州长Jan Brewer亦一而再地访问中华人民共和国。 本地侨社热爱祖国，歷年来举办”中国周”活动弘扬中华文化；每逢祖国遇到大灾情、侨胞必定展开賑灾活动和支持重建工作。四川汶川大地震，亚省广大华侨慷慨解囊，并联系美国主流社会展开捐款活动，总计筹得超过廿五万的善款捐给四川灾后重建。2008年中国首次举办奥运，海外侨胞欢欣鼓舞，亚省华人华侨踊跃捐款共建”水立方”场馆，并為中国选手在奥运取得的成绩而欢呼喝釆。 今年凤凰城侨界举办联合升旗庆典，表达侨胞对祖国热爱，并希望中美两国在全球各个领域中有著更全面的合作，而两国和谐的相处对世界和平有十分重要的意义。海外侨胞心向祖国，情系故乡，将欢庆新中国六十三周年华诞。 為表达对亚省侨胞升旗仪式的重视，中国驻美国洛杉磯领事馆已发来了贺函，并派出卞立新副总领事，许翠英领事和白东石领事前来参加仪式。希望凤凰城的老侨、新侨、港澳同胞踊跃准时出席，共同参与升旗典礼，见証歷史上的庄严一刻。
91f5279d04a49bbdea650cc5930f11558123f033.translatedText: In order to celebrate the 63rd anniversary of the founding of the People's Republic of China and wish the motherland increasing prosperity, the overseas Chinese community in Phoenix decided to hold a flag-raising ceremony for the Chinese and American flags at 9 a.m. on September 15, 2012 at the American Legion Arizona Department of Arizona (address: 4701 N 19th Ave Phoenix AZ 85015). On the occasion of the 60th anniversary of the founding of the People's Republic of China in 2009, the overseas Chinese community in Phoenix jointly held a flag-raising ceremony to express the overseas Chinese's love for the motherland. The motherland is becoming stronger through continuous development, which makes us overseas Chinese feel proud and proud. In the early 1990s, Sino-US relations were still developing. The United States has only nearly a thousand companies in China, with an investment of only US$4 billion. By 2012, there were 5,400 companies in Alberta alone with business ties to China, and Governor Jan Brewer has visited the People's Republic of China again and again. The local overseas Chinese community loves the motherland and has held "China Week" activities over the years to promote Chinese culture. Whenever the motherland encounters a major disaster, the overseas Chinese will definitely carry out disaster relief activities and support reconstruction efforts. After the Wenchuan earthquake in Sichuan, overseas Chinese in Alberta generously donated money and contacted mainstream society in the United States to launch a donation campaign. A total of more than 250,000 yuan was raised and donated to Sichuan's post-disaster reconstruction. In 2008, China hosted the Olympic Games for the first time. Overseas Chinese were delighted. Overseas Chinese in Alberta actively donated money to build the "Water Cube" venue and cheered for the achievements of Chinese athletes in the Olympics. This year, the overseas Chinese community in Phoenix held a joint flag-raising ceremony to express their love for the motherland and hope that China and the United States will have more comprehensive cooperation in various fields around the world. The harmonious coexistence of the two countries is of great significance to world peace. Overseas Chinese are devoted to their motherland and love their hometown, and will celebrate the 63rd anniversary of the founding of the People's Republic of China. In order to express its importance to the flag-raising ceremony of the overseas Chinese in Alberta, the Chinese Consulate in Los Angeles has sent a congratulatory letter and sent Deputy Consul General Bian Lixin, Consul Xu Cuiying and Consul Bai Dongshi to attend the ceremony. I hope that the old overseas Chinese, new overseas Chinese, and compatriots from Hong Kong and Macao in Phoenix will attend on time, participate in the flag-raising ceremony, and witness this solemn moment in history.

1bd31bed03f3c60eb0fc7db16c2ff57d685d2026.sourceText: 纽约市出租车4号起涨价17% 据纽约时报报导，黄色出租车将从4日起调涨对乘客的收费。 纽约市出租车暨礼车管理局2日晚宣布，在黄色出租车经营者重新调整收费表、更新汽车外表标志之后，准许黄色出租车调涨收费约17%的决定将从3日晚12时生效。 该管理局并不要求经营者等到预定的9月30日之后首次汽车检查后才实施新收费政策，这意味着纽约市的黄色出租车在未来数周内很可能实施一种新旧收费制度混合的政策。 出租车管理局发表声明说：”我们预计许多出租车经营者将在9月4日实行新收费政策，所以，让乘坐者知道和理解此事是极为重要的。” 该局在7月批准这项收费调涨。起价保持不变，但每行驶五分之一里的收费，或遭遇交通不畅时出租车每停顿60秒钟的收费，将从40分提高到50分。 从今天起，往返于肯尼迪国际机场和曼哈顿间的出租车费用将上涨7美元，总费用达52美元。往返于纽瓦克国际机场的附加费用也将上涨，总费用从15美元上升至17.5美元。 纽约市出租车上次调整费用是6年前的价格。 约市出租车和轿车管理委员会主席David S. Yassky认为，”出租车司机工资本就不高，且近六年来都没有增长，如今应该确保他们可以靠一分体面的工资维生。”
1bd31bed03f3c60eb0fc7db16c2ff57d685d2026.translatedText: New York City taxi prices will increase by 17% starting from the 4th. According to the New York Times, yellow taxis will increase their fares for passengers starting from the 4th. The New York City Taxi and Limousine Authority announced on the evening of the 2nd that the decision to allow yellow taxis to increase their fares by about 17% will take effect at 12:00 pm on the 3rd after yellow taxi operators readjust their fare schedules and update their car exterior signs. The authority does not require operators to wait until the first scheduled vehicle inspection after September 30 before implementing the new fare policy, which means that New York City's yellow taxis are likely to implement a hybrid policy of the old and new fare systems in the coming weeks. "We anticipate that many taxi operators will implement the new fare policy on September 4, so it is extremely important that riders know and understand this," the Taxi Authority said in a statement, which approved the toll increase in July. The starting fare will remain unchanged, but the charge for every fifth of a mile traveled, or for every 60 seconds the taxi stops in heavy traffic, will increase from 40 cents to 50 cents. Starting today, taxi fares between JFK International Airport and Manhattan will increase by $7, bringing the total cost to $52. Additional fees for traveling to and from Newark International Airport will also increase, with the total cost rising from $15 to $17.50. New York City taxi fares were last adjusted six years ago. David S. Yassky, chairman of the New York City Taxi and Limousine Management Committee, believes that "taxi driver wages are not high and have not increased in the past six years. Now we should ensure that they can live on a decent wage."

3a5054b27fcdc50b5d03cef5aa7edcbaccaf95ec.sourceText: 劳工节周末 400人涉及酒驾被捕 （亚省时报） 州长的高速公路安全办公室周三发布消息，劳工节长周末假期中，单是周六和周日，全州近400人因涉嫌酒后驾驶被捕。这数字不包含周一劳工节正日。 假期内共逮捕了382人，近三分之一的被捕者涉及酒后驾驶，血液中酒精含量为0.15%或更高。四十多人为重度酒后驾驶。 这个数字比去年同期下降，去年劳工节警方逮捕了617人。
3a5054b27fcdc50b5d03cef5aa7edcbaccaf95ec.translatedText: 400 people were arrested for drunk driving over the Labor Day weekend (Alberta Times) The governor's Office of Highway Safety announced Wednesday that nearly 400 people were arrested across the state on suspicion of drunk driving on Saturday and Sunday alone during the Labor Day weekend. This number does not include Labor Day on Monday. A total of 382 arrests were made during the holidays, with nearly a third of those arrested involving drunk driving with a blood alcohol content of 0.15% or higher. More than 40 people were convicted of serious drunk driving. That number is down from the same time last year, when police arrested 617 people on Labor Day.

2b28157c60e3101e8ead1cb4f29412c13b675075.sourceText: 美国逾4成食物 进了垃圾桶 非营利环保组织「自然资源保护协会」日前公布的一份研究报告指出，美国人每年丢弃超过40%的食物，这些浪费掉的食物价值约1650亿元。 「自然资源保护协会」的报告指出，美国人每年有逾40%的食物不是吃到肚子裡，而是进了垃圾桶。报告指出，一个美国的四口之家平均每年扔掉价值 2275元的食物。只要扔掉食物的百分比下降15%，节省下来的钱就足以购买2500万美国人需要的食物，而且还能减轻填埋垃圾的负担，因為固体垃圾的很 大一部分是扔掉的食物。 NRDC还指出，特别严重的是，证据显示，自1970年代以来，美国人扔掉的食物增长了50%，其中相当大一部分是食品杂货店没有卖掉的水果和蔬菜。但消费者和餐馆也应承担责任，他们烹飪的食物过多，导致许多食物未被吃掉而被扔进垃圾桶。 该协会食物与农业计画的科学家丹娜冈德斯表示：「就整个国家而言，我们基本上把所得食物的一半扔掉了，这是把金钱和珍贵的资源扔进了下水道。」 NRDC说，该组织正在要求美国政府研究食品制度中的浪费问题，并制定减少浪费的目标。冈德斯说：「无论我们的食物生產具有多大的可持续性，如果食物未被吃掉，这就不是妥善地利用资源。」
2b28157c60e3101e8ead1cb4f29412c13b675075.translatedText: More than 40% of the food in the United States goes into the trash can. A research report recently released by the non-profit environmental organization "Natural Resources Defense Council" pointed out that Americans throw away more than 40% of their food every year, and this wasted food is worth about 165 billion yuan. A report from the Natural Resources Defense Council states that more than 40% of the food Americans eat each year ends up in the trash instead of in their stomachs. The report points out that the average American family of four throws away $2,275 worth of food every year. If the percentage of food thrown away dropped by just 15 percent, the savings would be enough to buy the food needed by 25 million Americans and reduce the burden on landfills, since a large portion of solid waste is thrown away food. The NRDC also points out that evidence shows that the amount of food Americans throw away has increased by 50 percent since the 1970s, and a significant portion of this is fruits and vegetables that are not sold in grocery stores. But consumers and restaurants are also responsible for cooking too much food, leaving much of it uneaten and thrown into the trash. "As a country, we're basically throwing away half of the food we get, which is throwing money and precious resources down the drain," said Dana Gundes, a scientist with the association's food and agriculture program. The NRDC said the group is asking the U.S. government to study waste in the food system and set goals to reduce it. "No matter how sustainable our food production is, if the food isn't eaten, it's not a good use of resources," Gunders said.

53c71d917c7dcf8d191bb75097998a0928c31e9b.sourceText: 过去一个月内，本州的油价逐步攀升，升幅大概是每天一美分。在即将到来的劳动节周末，上升幅度可能加大。 美国汽车协会将油价上升的原因归咎于台风和中东不稳。 AAA 发言人米歇尔多纳蒂说，台风令海上油田的平台不稳，增加了采油风险。墨西哥湾沿岸地区因台风艾萨克逼近，多个主要炼油厂停止了作业，因为它们需要做好应对强风和暴雨的准备。汽油价格应声上涨。加州一家炼油厂火灾和麻烦的中东又令油价雪上加霜。 凤凰城一居民说，风暴还未打到岸边，本谷的油价已经升了，这又怎么解释？ 过去一个月内，本州的油价已涨了 35 美分。目前全国只有三个州的油价高于亚利桑那。
53c71d917c7dcf8d191bb75097998a0928c31e9b.translatedText: Gas prices in the state have gradually climbed over the past month, by about a cent a day. The increase could increase during the upcoming Labor Day weekend. American Automobile Association blamed typhoons and instability in the Middle East for rising oil prices. AAA spokesperson Michelle Donati said the typhoon destabilized platforms at offshore oil fields, increasing production risks. As Typhoon Isaac approaches the Gulf Coast, several major refineries have halted operations as they prepare for strong winds and heavy rains. Gasoline prices rose in response. A fire at a refinery in California and trouble in the Middle East have added to the pain for oil prices. A Phoenix resident said that before the storm hit the shore, the price of oil in the valley had already risen. How to explain this? Gas prices in the state have increased 35 cents in the past month. There are currently only three states in the country with higher gas prices than Arizona.

bc1a5fd154dcd7647d442bba37b17c0c281b48a8.sourceText: 中领馆：明年7月实施新“出入境法”，尚未掌握具体细节 从明年7月1日开始实施的中华人民共和国出入境管理法，管理对象不仅是外国公民，也包括在外国取得永久居留权（绿卡）的中国公民。 法案要求，海外华侨欲回国定居，需预先向政府相关机构提出申请。 该法案13条规定，定居国外的中国公民要求回国定居，应当在入境前向中国驻外领馆或者外交部委托的其他驻外机构提出申请，也可由本人或国内亲属向拟定居住地的县 级以上地方人民政府侨务部门提出申请。 但现在还没有具体细节详细说明。
bc1a5fd154dcd7647d442bba37b17c0c281b48a8.translatedText: The Chinese Consulate: The new "Exit and Entry Law" will be implemented in July next year, but the specific details are not available yet The Exit-Entry Administration Law of the People's Republic of China, which will be implemented from July 1 next year, will not only cover foreign citizens, but also Chinese citizens who have obtained permanent residency (green cards) in foreign countries. The bill requires overseas Chinese who want to return to the country to settle down to apply to relevant government agencies in advance. Article 13 of the bill stipulates that Chinese citizens who have settled abroad and wish to return to the country to settle down should apply to the Chinese consulate abroad or other overseas agencies entrusted by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs before entering the country. They or their relatives in China can also apply to the Overseas Chinese Affairs Department of the local people's government at or above the county level in the proposed place of residence. But no specific details have been spelled out yet.

dfee37dd8b3e24339da7d1cedb454bb0eb7e06ff.sourceText: 中新网8月29日电今日，中国国际航空公司由北京飞往纽约的CA981航班因受到威胁，在起飞后7小时返航降落，于当时20时26分安全返抵北京首都国际机场。据悉，补发的航班将于今晚23时55分起飞，预计8月30日零时48分(纽约时间)到达纽约。
dfee37dd8b3e24339da7d1cedb454bb0eb7e06ff.translatedText: China News Service, August 29. Today, Air China flight CA981 from Beijing to New York was threatened and returned to land 7 hours after takeoff. It returned safely to Beijing Capital International Airport at 20:26 at that time. It is reported that the replacement flight will take off at 23:55 tonight and is expected to arrive in New York at 0:48 on August 30 (New York time).

f7acaa1a963dc719cd18a980c927edfdbdf29a8a.sourceText: 8月29日20时18分，中国国际航空公司在其官方微博发布特别公告。公告称，由于收到了CA981航班受到威胁的信息，为了确保旅客的安全，该航班已返航北京首都国际机场。该微博引发广泛转载和评论。
f7acaa1a963dc719cd18a980c927edfdbdf29a8a.translatedText: At 20:18 on August 29, Air China issued a special announcement on its official Weibo. The announcement stated that due to receiving information about the threat to flight CA981, in order to ensure the safety of passengers, the flight has returned to Beijing Capital International Airport. The Weibo post sparked widespread reposts and comments.

c5248c00fdddd0301f4f3d926542aaf2c5be39ca.sourceText: 随后21时13分左右，北京首都国际机场官方微博转发国航这条微博时指出，”大家关注的CA981航班，已经平安降落首都机场。”
c5248c00fdddd0301f4f3d926542aaf2c5be39ca.translatedText: At around 21:13, the official Weibo of Beijing Capital International Airport forwarded Air China's Weibo and pointed out, "The flight CA981 that everyone is paying attention to has landed safely at the Capital Airport."
