e0d7292561f06a606e40cd456f2f943dcfa92a7e.sourceText: 在这场暴雨中，岳琉路及附近多条道路上，车子都遭遇急流吞噬 Mitbbs.com 亲属苦寻一天一夜 最后电话竟成诀别：”老伴,我过不去你那了” Mitbbs.com 在康凤英的葬礼上，因为泡得太久，身体肿胀，家人几乎无法为她穿上衣服。 Mitbbs.com 7?1那个雨夜，这位62岁的老人想去看看在山上养蜂的老伴。两天后，家人在距马路数百米远的麦秸地里找到了她的尸体。 Mitbbs.com 遇难者档案 Mitbbs.com 姓名：康凤英 Mitbbs.com 女 62岁 Mitbbs.com 住址：房山区韩村河镇西东村 Mitbbs.com 去世原因：在返家的岳琉路上，被冲出河道的急流吞噬，溺水罹难 Mitbbs.com 永别”老伴，我过不去你那了” Mitbbs.com 在房山区韩村河镇西东村，据称，康凤英是暴雨中这座村庄唯一的遇难者。 Mitbbs.com 她家院落的门框上贴着象征刚刚有人故去的白纸，墙上则刷着”出售蜂蜜”的字样。 Mitbbs.com 几年前开始养蜂，每年此时，老伴胡茂常都会待在山上。7月21日傍晚，雨水开始灌进西东村时，康凤英决定去山上看看老伴。 Mitbbs.com 叫上一位自家亲戚，二人驶上了临村的岳琉路。没人会想到，在这个夜晚，这条宽敞、平坦的四车道马路，会将一些过客永远留下。 Mitbbs.com 当晚9点，胡茂常接到了康凤英的电话，”老伴，我过不去你那了。” Mitbbs.com 踏上返程的康凤英并不知道，雨水已将岳琉路旁一条干涸多年的河道灌满，即将漫上路面。 Mitbbs.com 突然，急流裹着一根旧货市场的圆木冲了过来。圆木撞上风挡玻璃，雨水灌了进来。 Mitbbs.com 开车的亲戚将康凤英拽下车，俩人抱住路旁的电线杆。雨越下越大、水位越来越高，他们不知道还能坚持多久。 Mitbbs.com 就在这时，一辆水泥车开了过来，那庞大的体形暂时挡住了一些水流。这是次绝佳的逃生机会，亲戚率先跳了过去，扒住了车身。本能的，他也抓紧了老人的手，康凤英跟随着跃了过去。 Mitbbs.com 一切都在一瞬间发生，失手、下落、消失在水中。亲戚再去寻找，只能看见黑夜中的急流。 Mitbbs.com 寻找”把她捞上来这事，晚一天都等不了” Mitbbs.com 胡家在西东村是个大姓，聚集些人手不是问题。雨还在下，几名族人已奔到了出事地点。 Mitbbs.com 没有装备、没有经验，靠着从修理厂拖来的一条游船，搜寻开始了。船是坏的，不多会儿便进水了，众人只得下水寻找。大雨中，他们要对抗的是”一片汪洋”。 Mitbbs.com 22日早上，当两个在城里居住的儿子赶到时，岳琉路上已有几十人在搜寻各自失踪的亲人。 itbbs.com 儿子胡海刚和众人共找到了三具尸体，但没有一个是康凤英。”当时已经知道，人肯定是没了。”对于胡家来说，尽早将人找到，是为了让尸体更有”尊严”。 Mitbbs.com 他们也曾试着联系一家专业的打捞队，但得到答复是，第二天上午才能赶到。”不行，把她捞上来这事，晚一天都等不了。”胡海刚说。 Mitbbs.com 在岳琉路旁的积水下，遍是倒塌的麦秸。翻开每一寸麦秸，胡家二子盼望那个熟悉的身影能尽早出现。
e0d7292561f06a606e40cd456f2f943dcfa92a7e.translatedText: In this heavy rain, cars on Yueliu Road and many nearby roads were swallowed up by rapids. Mitbbs.com Relatives searched for her for a day and night. The last phone call turned out to be a farewell: "Honey, I can't go to your place." Mitbbs.com At Kang Fengying's funeral, her body was swollen because she had been soaked for too long, and her family could hardly put her clothes on. Mitbbs.com On the rainy night of July 1, this 62-year-old man wanted to see his wife who was keeping bees in the mountains. Two days later, her family found her body in a wheat straw field hundreds of meters away from the road. Mitbbs.com Victim file Mitbbs.com Name: Kang Fengying Mitbbs.com Female, 62 years old Mitbbs.com Address: Xidong Village, Hancunhe Town, Fangshan District Mitbbs.com Cause of death: On the way home to Yueliu, she was swallowed by the rapids rushing out of the river and drowned Mitbbs.com Farewell to "Honey, I can't live with you anymore" Mitbbs.com In Xidong Village, Hancunhe Town, Fangshan District, Kang Fengying is said to be the only victim in the village during the heavy rain. Mitbbs.com The door frame of her courtyard is pasted with a white paper symbolizing the recent death of someone, and the words "honey for sale" are painted on the wall. Mitbbs.com I started beekeeping a few years ago. At this time of year, my wife Hu Mao often stays in the mountains. On the evening of July 21, when the rain began to pour into Xidong Village, Kang Fengying decided to go to the mountains to see her wife. Mitbbs.com called a relative, and the two drove onto Yueliu Road near the village. No one would have thought that on this night, this spacious, flat four-lane road would leave some passersby behind forever. Mitbbs.com At 9 o'clock that night, Hu Maochang received a call from Kang Fengying, "Honey, I can't go to your place." Mitbbs.com Kang Fengying was on her way back but she didn't know that the rain had filled a river that had been dry for many years next to Yueliu Road and was about to overflow the road. Mitbbs.com Suddenly, a flea market log was carried by the rapids. The log hit the windshield and rain poured in. Mitbbs.com The relative who was driving the car pulled Kang Fengying out of the car, and the two of them hugged a telephone pole by the roadside. The rain is getting heavier and the water level is getting higher. They don't know how long they can hold on. Mitbbs.com At this moment, a cement truck drove over, and its huge body temporarily blocked some of the water flow. This was an excellent opportunity to escape. The relative jumped over first and grabbed the car body. Instinctively, he also grabbed the old man's hand, and Kang Fengying followed and jumped over. Mitbbs.com Everything happened in an instant, missed, dropped, disappeared into the water. When relatives went to look for it, they could only see the rapids in the dark night. Mitbbs.com Looking for "Finding her out can't wait even a day later" Mitbbs.com The Hu family is a big name in Xidong Village, so gathering some people is not a problem. The rain was still falling, and several tribesmen had already rushed to the scene of the accident. Mitbbs.com With no equipment, no experience, and a boat towed from a repair shop, the search began. The boat was broken down and flooded soon after, so everyone had to go into the water to look for it. In the heavy rain, what they have to fight is "a vast ocean". Mitbbs.com On the morning of the 22nd, when the two sons who lived in the city arrived, dozens of people were already searching for their missing relatives on Yueliu Road. itbbs.com His son Hu Haigang and others found three corpses in total, but none of them was Kang Fengying. "I already knew at that time that the person must be dead." For the Hu family, finding the person as soon as possible is to give the body more "dignity." Mitbbs.com They also tried to contact a professional salvage team, but the reply was that they could only arrive the next morning. "No, we can't wait even a day to fish her out," Hu Haigang said. Mitbbs.com Under the water beside Yueliu Road, there are fallen wheat straw everywhere. Opening every inch of wheat straw, the two sons of the Hu family hoped that the familiar figure would appear as soon as possible.

81a8443fc8ccd10d3885ec3ca8cb498bba0feac8.sourceText: 当被麦秆划开的伤口遍布胡海刚整个小腿时，23日上午，康凤英的尸体在离岳琉路数百米远的地方被发现，身上没有明显的伤痕，只是布满了泥水。 Mitbbs.com 回忆”我妈跟我好，就得让我找到她” Mitbbs.com 昨日上午，哭声在西东村内响起，康凤英下葬了。因为被泡得太久，尸体肿胀，家人几乎无法帮她穿上衣服。 Mitbbs.com 对于这个终年62岁的老人，村中人的评价是”和善、有求必应”，望着出殡队伍，观者落泪的不在少数。 Mitbbs.com 5岁的小孙子来到家中，不见那个身材微胖、永远面露笑容的奶奶，他急得四处寻找。稍已懂事的哥哥告诉他：”别找了。”小孙子似乎明白了，但找得却更急，跺着脚嚷道：”我奶奶在哪？” Mitbbs.com 开车的那位亲戚至今不愿面对胡家人，据旁人讲，几天了他总在梦中突然惊醒，大喊着：”水，水来了” 老人下葬的当晚，酒精味在胡宅内弥散，对于他们来说，”几天来太累了，要好好歇歇了。” Mitbbs.com 胡海刚是最终发现母亲尸体的人，闷下一口白酒，他憋红着脸望着康凤英的彩色遗像，”我妈跟我好，就得让我找到她。” Mitbbs.com
81a8443fc8ccd10d3885ec3ca8cb498bba0feac8.translatedText: When the wounds cut by wheat straw were all over Hu Haigang's entire calf, Kang Fengying's body was found hundreds of meters away from Yueliu Road on the morning of the 23rd. There were no obvious wounds on her body, but it was just covered with mud and water. Mitbbs.com recalls "My mother is good to me, so I have to find her." Mitbbs.com Yesterday morning, cries rang out in Xidong Village, and Kang Fengying was buried. Her body was so swollen from being soaked for so long that her family could hardly help her put on clothes. Mitbbs.com For this 62-year-old man, people in the village described him as "kind and responsive to requests". Looking at the funeral procession, many viewers shed tears. Mitbbs.com When his 5-year-old grandson came home, he couldn't see the fat grandma who was always smiling. He looked around anxiously. The elder brother, who had become more sensible, told him: "Stop looking." The grandson seemed to understand, but he searched even more urgently, stamping his feet and shouting: "Where is my grandma?" Mitbbs.com The relative who drove the car still does not want to face the Hu family. According to others, for several days, he always wakes up suddenly from his sleep and shouts: "Water, water is coming." On the night of the old man's burial, the smell of alcohol permeated Hu's house. For them, "I have been too tired for the past few days and need to take a good rest." Mitbbs.com Hu Haigang was the one who finally discovered his mother's body. He took a sip of white wine and looked at Kang Fengying's colorful portrait with a red face. "My mother is good to me, so I have to let me find her." Mitbbs.com

452cf541d591ad384eaf5a31f3b5ec30452a1cf9.sourceText: 徐凯莱/徐彭树霞：针灸浅谈 时常有许多不同年纪与族裔的朋友，在茶余饭后和我们谈论到针灸治病及复健的事情。 有些年轻人和非华裔朋友说：『我不敢打针灸，看起来很可怕。 』有些老人家说：『我以前在老家时，曾看过家中的长辈或佣工们，他们一群群坐在院子里的台阶上针灸、刮痧、放血等。 』而妇女朋友则表示，他们针灸的经验是治疗头痛、经痛、腰膝和关节痛等，甚至做减肥或脸部美容。 现在我们就约略地介绍一些有关针灸的来龙去脉给大家。 首先介绍针灸医术的发展，针灸疗法乃是中国古代的医疗学术，源起于新石器时代，黄帝时代即有遗作〝黄帝针灸经〞传世。 唐朝将针灸列为专科考试项目并传至日本。 明朝是针灸学术发展的鼎盛时期，且由传教士将针灸带入欧洲，开始为国际重视。 到了清朝，西方文明成为潮流，西医也进入中国，针灸缺乏现代基础加上医者重药轻针，逐渐走向衰退。 然而在中国人口剧增之下，西药常常供不应求，针灸再度获得医界的重视，并不断改进研究，又在各种动物身上试验等等，于是针灸又广泛倡行于民间，有些手术使用针灸来麻醉 ，均收到非常好的效果。 如何定义针灸呢？ 针即针刺，也称针治法，是运用一定的操作手法，把金属制成的细针按一定穴位刺入患者体内，运用捻转与提插等针刺手法来治病。 古人制针有九种：如圆柱体，分粗细长短不同，也有两面或三面刃的，有尖头也有圆头，它们的用途区别也不同，有刺入皮肤肌肉、刺破血管泄血、刺激 皮下神经等方法，针刺法不仅治疗内科疾病，也医治一些外科方面的疖肿、开割等症。 近代大部份医生仅用毫针治疗，非常安全，偶而会用三菱针来点刺放血。 灸乃灸灼，一般是用艾绒搓成长条形，点燃后放在一定穴位的皮肤上热薰叫灸疗，我国曾经有艾灸、针上灸、隔姜灸、隔蒜灸等，灸 疗具有散寒、消肿疖、解毒、调和气血等功用。 针灸治病的原理是调整人体内的神经和气血，使五脏六腑之间有阻碍的得以恢复到正常生理机能。 人体分布有十二条经道，加上任脉及督脉，共有十四条经脉；其中分阴经与阳经各占一半，且十二条经络中内属脏腑外络属肢节，如手 太阴经是与肺脏相连外通于肌肤，它在人体里是通达内外的一条要道，其他经络亦复如此。 又包括三百六十五个穴位，其经脉之间，相互皆有通达和关连作用，刺激一个穴位可调整另一个有关部份的神经机能，例如针足部会影响头部，针手阳明大肠 能之合谷穴治下颚齿痛，针手阳明胃经之内庭穴治上颚齿痛等，据此证明确有经络存在。 针灸也就是利用经脉相连相通达到治病的效果。 许多人疑虑针灸治疗是否安全，病人一定须有合格针灸执照的医生从事治疗才具保障。 首先医生要对病人进行必要的初步检查，如望、闻、问、切后，再决定对病人施针的部位、数目、深浅度以及留针的时间等。 施针前，医生、病人、相关器材等均须消毒处理，施针期间要注意病人的反应，除针时一般均无出血现象，偶而会有一点出血是属正常。 因此，针灸治疗大体而言，是非常安全的。 针灸在美国何时成为合法医疗？ 远在1972年尼克森总统访问中国的前一年七月，他曾派秘书长季辛吉先生和多名随行记者先行前往北京，当时纽约时报记者詹姆士雷斯顿先生(Mr. James Reston)到达后突患急性兰尾炎，需立即手术；术后第二晚，雷斯顿先生的腹部有种似痛非痛的难受感觉，经以针灸治疗不到一小时，他的腹胀感觉 明显减轻，而且以后也没有复发。 对自己这么快速的恢复感到非常惊讶，返美后，他撰写一篇专文刊登在纽约时报，报导针灸在他身上的奇事，题目是『现在让我告诉你我在北京的兰尾炎』。 于是，针灸医疗之事便像一阵风一样，盛行在美国东岸一带。 可惜好景不常，不到三年时光，便遭到西医界的反对，理由是任何医疗行为都需经过长期之研究及实验并验证其结果，方能实行于人体。 为何针灸未经这些过程就可以从事医疗行为，自此针灸治疗在美国被迫停止。 虽然对针灸的质疑是因为中西医在理论基础的思维模式上相距甚大，然而世界卫生组织(WHO)在1979 年出版的刊物中认可针灸对某些症状有治疗作用，又于2003年发表专文认为 有对照试验证实针灸可有效治疗若干疾病或改善状态，此后西医界不再坚决排拒针灸疗法。 经过多年的努力研究，美国逐渐承认针灸为有效的医疗方式之一，但无论由何处来到美国的针灸医生要执业，必须经过严格的合法考试制度，取得执照者方能行医。 2010年联合国教科文组织保护非物质文化遗产委员会通过《中医针灸》列入人类非物质文化遗产代表作名录。 本州现设有针灸学校培育造就更多人才，继续发扬及发展针灸医学技术。
452cf541d591ad384eaf5a31f3b5ec30452a1cf9.translatedText: Xu Kailai/Xu Pengshuxia: A brief talk on acupuncture. Many friends of different ages and ethnicities often talk to us about acupuncture treatment and rehabilitation after dinner. Some young people and non-Chinese friends say, "I don't dare get acupuncture, it looks scary." "Some elderly people said: "When I was in my hometown, I saw the elders or servants sitting in groups on the steps in the yard doing acupuncture, scraping, bloodletting, etc. "Female friends said that their experience with acupuncture is to treat headaches, menstrual pain, waist, knee and joint pain, etc., and even for weight loss or facial beauty. Now we will briefly introduce to you some of the ins and outs of acupuncture. First, we will introduce the development of acupuncture. Acupuncture is an ancient Chinese medical science, which originated in the Neolithic Age. During the Huangdi era, the Huangdi Acupuncture Sutra was handed down as a posthumous work. In the Tang Dynasty, acupuncture was listed as a specialist examination item and spread to Japan. The Ming Dynasty was the heyday of the academic development of acupuncture, and missionaries introduced acupuncture to Europe, where it began to attract international attention. By the Qing Dynasty, Western civilization became the trend and Western medicine also entered China. Acupuncture lacked a modern foundation and doctors focused on medicine but not on needles, so it gradually declined. However, with the rapid increase in China's population, demand for Western medicine often exceeds supply. Acupuncture has once again gained attention from the medical community, and research has been continuously improved and tested on various animals. As a result, acupuncture is widely advocated among the people. Acupuncture is used for anesthesia in some surgeries, and has achieved very good results. How to define acupuncture? Acupuncture refers to acupuncture, also known as acupuncture. It uses certain operating techniques to insert thin metal needles into the patient's body at certain acupoints, and uses acupuncture techniques such as twisting and lifting to treat diseases. There are nine types of needles made by the ancients: cylindrical, with different thicknesses and lengths, or with two or three blades, with sharp or round heads. Their uses are also different, including piercing skin and muscles, puncturing blood vessels to release blood, stimulating subcutaneous nerves, etc. Acupuncture not only treats internal diseases, but also treats some surgical boils and cuts. In modern times, most doctors only use filiform acupuncture for treatment, which is very safe. Occasionally, Mitsubishi needles are used for pricking and bleeding. Moxibustion is moxibustion. It is usually made by rolling moxa into a long strip, lighting it and placing it on the skin at certain acupoints. It is called moxibustion therapy. my country has had moxa-moxibustion, acupuncture moxibustion, ginger-partition moxibustion, garlic-partition moxibustion, etc. Moxibustion has the functions of dispersing cold, reducing swelling and boils, detoxifying, and reconciling qi and blood. The principle of acupuncture treatment is to adjust the nerves and qi and blood in the human body, so that the internal organs that have obstacles can return to normal physiological functions. There are twelve meridians distributed in the human body. Together with the Ren and Du meridians, there are a total of fourteen meridians; half of them are Yin meridians and Yang meridians, and the twelve meridians belong to the internal organs and external meridians and belong to the limbs. For example, the Taiyin meridian of the hands is connected with the lungs and externally leads to the skin. It is an important channel in the human body that connects the inside and outside, and the same is true for other meridians. It also includes 365 acupoints. The meridians are all connected and related to each other. Stimulating one acupoint can adjust the nerve function of another related part. For example, acupuncture at the foot will affect the head. Acupuncture at the Hegu point of Yangming's large intestine in the hand can treat toothache in the lower jaw. Acupuncture at the Neiting point in the stomach meridian of Yangming in the hand can treat toothache in the upper jaw. This proves the existence of meridians. Acupuncture uses the connection of meridians to achieve the effect of treating diseases. Many people doubt whether acupuncture treatment is safe. Patients must be treated by a doctor with a qualified acupuncture license to be protected. First, the doctor must conduct necessary preliminary examinations on the patient, such as looking, smelling, questioning, and incision, and then decide on the location, number, depth, and time of needle retention for the patient. Before acupuncture, the doctor, patient, and related equipment must be disinfected. During the acupuncture, attention should be paid to the patient's reaction. There is generally no bleeding when removing the acupuncture. Occasionally there will be a little bleeding, which is normal. Therefore, acupuncture treatment is generally very safe. When did acupuncture become a legal medical treatment in the United States? As far back as July 1972, the year before President Nixon visited China, he sent Secretary-General Kissinger and a number of accompanying reporters to Beijing first. At that time, New York Times reporter Mr. James Reston suddenly suffered from acute orchiditis upon arrival and required immediate surgery. On the second night after the operation, Mr. Reston had an uncomfortable feeling in his abdomen that was not painful. Within an hour of acupuncture treatment, his abdominal distension was significantly relieved, and there has been no recurrence since. He was very surprised by his rapid recovery. After returning to the United States, he wrote an article and published it in the New York Times, reporting on the strange things acupuncture had done on him. The title was "Now let me tell you about my orchiditis in Beijing." As a result, acupuncture became popular in the East Coast of the United States like a gust of wind. Unfortunately, the good times did not last long. In less than three years, it was opposed by the Western medicine community. The reason was that any medical treatment must undergo long-term research and experiments and verify the results before it can be implemented on the human body. Why can acupuncture be used as a medical treatment without these procedures? Since then, acupuncture treatment has been forced to stop in the United States. Although doubts about acupuncture are due to the vast difference in theoretical thinking between Chinese and Western medicine, the World Health Organization (WHO) recognized the therapeutic effect of acupuncture on certain symptoms in a publication published in 1979, and published a special article in 2003 stating that controlled trials have confirmed that acupuncture can effectively treat certain diseases or improve conditions. Since then, the Western medical community no longer firmly rejects acupuncture. After years of hard research, the United States has gradually recognized acupuncture as one of the effective medical methods. However, no matter where they come from, acupuncturists who come to the United States must pass a strict legal examination system and obtain a license before they can practice medicine. In 2010, the UNESCO Committee for the Protection of Intangible Cultural Heritage approved the inclusion of "Acupuncture and Moxibustion in Traditional Chinese Medicine" on the Representative List of Humanity's Intangible Cultural Heritage. The state now has acupuncture schools to cultivate more talents and continue to promote and develop acupuncture medical technology.

ad677c951ee12b2e0fe3ec1030a3e24016353319.sourceText: 凤凰城凤鸣：轻松快乐的公务员生活 离开了学校踏入社会，到省级机关当一个早八晚六的公务员，一切都是很新鲜的，科室里的同事以及其他各处室的同事，对我这新分配来的学生，我感觉 他们的热情里充满了好奇心。 偏偏那时的我因初到一个新环境，表现的是性格内向，每每总是以微笑示人，几乎是寡言少语，虽不懂社会深浅、人情世故，但总知人心险恶、人言可畏， 总自我保护的把自己包裹在安全地带，让那些爱打听消息、好奇心重的人，有些急不可耐的向我问长短、话东西，深知祸从口出的我，对那些巧立名目包打听的好心 人，一切据实相告，一个刚毕业的学生，​​能有多少不为人知的密秘呢？ 我只是个刚走出校门的学生，一切透明，渐渐地我被接纳、很快融入其中，尤其是比我稍大点的年青人，很快成为无话不说的好朋友。 我的轻松快乐的公务员生活打开序幕！ 每天早晨7:30骑车从家出发，经过青年路、到西门桥、省府前街、后宰门，串过一条小巷，看到大明湖南岸的开濶湖面，我工作的机关右拐 就到。 每天不是很忙，空闲时学习〝毛泽东选集〞，为每旬一次的旬报收集材料做好准备工作，最忙时每旬有三、四天，往各市、地、县打长途电话，那时打 长途电话，要通过114长途台挂长途，有几位长途台的女服务员成了从未谋面的朋友，长途电话收集完情报，再用一天的时间，写完旬报，由处长签发后交打字 室打印，打完的旬报经过校对后再去打字室油印，赶上打字员繁忙时，还要自己去油印，虽然油印又脏又累，但能早日把旬报发出去，我也乐在其中 。 这种平淡枯燥乏味的工作，实在让我难以安心工作，整天想入非非地想方设法去工厂，从事我所学的机械制造设计师的工作。 每旬一次的旬报工作量，对我来说应付自如，业余时间更是自由支配，玩心未眠的我，敞开性子玩。 下班后，经过百货大楼，从一楼到四楼看个遍，买些雪花膏、电池、漂亮的毛线和女孩子喜欢的小玩意儿，日子过得悠哉悠哉。 很快搬进机关大院里的单身宿舍，上下班，吃饭、休息都在一个大院里。 我住的集体宿舍，在一个二层小楼上，与一名女打字员同一房间，成为好朋友，也就是现在俗称闺密。 那时她有一个男朋友，她那点甜情蜜意的事情，都会悄悄地告诉我，我也会把我和先生的秘密告诉她。 每天晨练回来，她都为我打好早餐放在桌上，我也非常感谢她。 从学生时期，我一直有早起锻练的习惯，当我早晨走出机关大院，发现在机关大院的围墙外、大明湖畔，有许多晨练的人们。 在如此风景如画的优雅环境中锻练，优如天仙般的感觉。 在众多晨练的人当中，我被一位髭须皆白的老先生所吸引，当时他正在教徒弟舞剑，那飘洒自如、刚柔并济的剑术，深深地吸引我，使我有 种立刻学习的冲动，一直在旁默默欣赏。 当老先生锻练完毕、收拾行头准备离去时，我毫不迟疑走上前去，礼貌地向老先生提出请求：老师，能否收我当徒弟，我非常希望跟您学习武术。 老师很爽快地荅应下来，每月交很少钱的学费。 从此，每天早早来到湖边的空地上，呼吸着带有湿润的新鲜空气，开始了一召一式认真的武术学习，有剑、枪、刀和拳。 学习武术还是有些灵气，几个月下来，各样武艺学得有模有样，得到师付和同学们的称赞。
ad677c951ee12b2e0fe3ec1030a3e24016353319.translatedText: Phoenix City Fengming: Relaxing and happy civil servant life After leaving school and entering the society, I worked as a civil servant in a provincial government agency from 8 a.m. to 6 a.m. Everything was very new. My colleagues in the department and other departments were full of curiosity about me as a newly assigned student. At that time, because I had just arrived in a new environment, I was introverted. I always smiled at others and was almost taciturn. Although I did not understand the depth of society and the ways of the world, I always knew that people's hearts are sinister and their words are scary. I always protected myself in a safe zone, so that those who loved to inquire about information and were curious could impatiently ask me questions and talk. I knew that trouble would come from my mouth, and I would not care about those kind-hearted people who cleverly made excuses to inquire. People, tell the truth. How many unknown secrets can a newly graduated student have? I was just a student who had just stepped out of school. Everything was transparent. Gradually, I was accepted and quickly integrated into the community. Especially the young people who were slightly older than me, we soon became good friends who talked about everything. My relaxed and happy civil servant life has begun! I ride my bicycle from home at 7:30 every morning, pass through Qingnian Road, go to Ximen Bridge, Shengfuqian Street, Houzaimen, pass through an alley, and see the Kaichu Lake on the south bank of Daming Lake. I turn right to the office where I work. I am not very busy every day. I study "Selected Works of Mao Zedong" in my free time and prepare for collecting materials for the ten-day report. During the busiest period, I spend three or four days every ten-day period making long-distance calls to cities, prefectures and counties. At that time, long-distance calls had to go through the 114 long-distance station. Several of the waitresses on the long-distance station became friends I had never met. After collecting the information through long-distance calls, I spent another day writing the ten-day report, which was signed by the director and then handed over for typing. I print it in the office, and then go to the typing room to mimeograph the finished ten-day newspaper after proofreading. When the typist is busy, I have to mimeograph it myself. Although the mimeographing is dirty and tiring, I am happy to be able to send out the ten-day newspaper as soon as possible. This kind of dull and boring work really made it difficult for me to work with peace of mind. All day long, I was thinking of ways to go to the factory and work as a mechanical manufacturing designer. The workload of reporting once every ten days is easy for me to cope with, and I have free time to spend my spare time. I am still in the mood for fun, so I can play with all my heart. After get off work, I passed by the department store, looked around from the first floor to the fourth floor, bought some cream, batteries, beautiful wool and gadgets that girls like, and lived a leisurely life. Soon I moved into a single dormitory in the compound of the government agency, commuting, eating, and resting in the same compound. The dormitory I lived in was on a two-story building. I shared a room with a female typist, and we became good friends, who are now commonly known as besties. She had a boyfriend at that time, and she would quietly tell me all her sweet things, and I would also tell her the secrets about my husband and me. Every day after morning exercise, she would prepare breakfast for me and put it on the table. I was very grateful to her. Since I was a student, I have always had the habit of getting up early to exercise. When I walked out of the government compound in the morning, I found many people doing morning exercises outside the wall of the government compound and by the Daming Lake. It feels like a fairy to exercise in such a picturesque and elegant environment. Among the many people practicing in the morning, I was attracted by an old man with a white moustache. At that time, he was teaching his disciples how to dance swords. His free and smooth swordsmanship, which combines strength and softness, deeply attracted me. I had the urge to learn immediately, and I kept admiring it silently. When the old man finished training, packed up and was about to leave, I walked up to him without hesitation and politely made a request to him: Teacher, can you accept me as your apprentice? I really hope to learn martial arts from you. The teacher readily agreed and paid a small amount of tuition every month. From then on, I came to the open space by the lake early every day, breathed in the fresh and moist air, and began to seriously learn martial arts, including swords, guns, knives and boxing. There is still some aura in learning martial arts. After a few months, I have learned various martial arts in a decent manner, and I have been praised by my master and classmates.

4421330dfe0a706b56ca50e7ae720cbc4cd7f697.sourceText: 美国华人参政的歷史可追溯到19世纪末。 1895年，旧金山以陈德為首的一批华人组建了”同源总局”这是美国华人第一个全国性的政治组织。目前的＂凤凰城同源分会＂(简称CACA) 仍是”同源总局”的一个分会。但是，在那个年代裡，华人要参与美国政治实际上是非常困难的事。因為美国不允许华人加入美国国籍，他们不是公民，因而不能享有公民的参政权。二战后，美国废除了排华法案，华人可以入籍，為参政创造了条件。 邓悦寧，别名荣勋，1904年2月4日出生於开平赤坎护龙乡永安里一个华侨家庭。 14岁那年，他在广州登上了一艘开往旧金山的船来到美国。1946年，邓悦寧以民主党候选人的资格，再度参加亚利桑那州眾议员的竞选，结果胜利当选，成為美国有史以来第一个不是在美国出生而当选為美国州议员的华人。邓悦寧当选议员后，联络美国各方面的律师，根据自由、平等、法治等原则，积极提议敦促修改移民法例，并於1952年取得了胜利，美国移民局取消了华人入境时必须接受禁闭审查的不人道的移民手续，并准许华人申请携同配偶入境，使以后到美国去的亚裔新移民均受其惠。1977年12月19日，邓悦寧在美国亚利桑那州凤凰城去世，终年73岁。 1978年，在美国行医多年的黄锦波当选為加利福尼亚州喜瑞都市的副市长，成為美国第一位华人市长，并连续担任了3届副市长，两届市长。 1983年，陈李婉若女士当选為蒙特利公园市市长，成為全美歷史上第一位华人女市长。 在此之后，华人参政的逐渐多起来，从国会议员、地方州议会的议员，到州长、市长，到处都有华人的身影。美国劳工部长赵小兰、华盛顿州州长骆家辉更是成為华人参政的代表。据不完全统计，美国的华人在职民选官员，到目前為止已经达到50位左右。 按照美国的行政划分，有大型城市和小型城市之分。大城市实行的是首席执行官（即市长）负责制，小城市实行的则是议会议员轮值制，即市长由议会的议员们轮流担任，每个议员在4年的任期内，可以担任9个月的市长。 在华人较多的中小城市竞选市长或市议员是华人参政的主要途径。另外，从目前当选的眾多华人市长的个人情况来看，他们大都是在青年时期移民美国的，在美国有较长的生活经歷，了解选民的要求，关心少数族裔的生活，敢於為华人说话。能够被选為一个城市的市议员和市长，他必须是一个被市民所接受的人，能积极参与各类社区的活动，对社区的生态环境和政治环境相当了解；同时也是一个热心大眾事务，真诚服务社区的人。除此以外，还应当具有一定的领导才能和演讲能力。资料显示，华人能够进入政坛，主要靠华人的支持，但在亚省参选市长成功的叁位华裔市长则是个例外。
4421330dfe0a706b56ca50e7ae720cbc4cd7f697.translatedText: The history of Chinese participation in politics in the United States can be traced back to the end of the 19th century. In 1895, a group of Chinese in San Francisco headed by Chen De established the "General Administration of the Same Origin", which was the first national political organization for Chinese in the United States. The current "CACA Chapter of Phoenix City" (referred to as CACA) is still a branch of the "CACA General Administration". However, in that era, it was actually very difficult for Chinese people to participate in American politics. Because the United States does not allow Chinese to become American citizens, they are not citizens and therefore cannot enjoy the rights of citizens to participate. After World War II, the United States repealed the Chinese Exclusion Act, allowing Chinese to become naturalized citizens, creating conditions for participating in politics. Deng Yuening, also known as Rongxun, was born on February 4, 1904, in an overseas Chinese family in Yong'an, Hulong Township, Chikan, Kaiping. When he was 14 years old, he boarded a ship in Guangzhou bound for San Francisco and came to the United States. In 1946, Deng Yuening once again ran for the Arizona House of Representatives as a Democratic candidate, and was successfully elected. He became the first Chinese in the history of the United States who was not born in the United States and was elected as a U.S. state representative. After being elected as a congressman, Deng Yuening contacted lawyers from all walks of life in the United States and actively proposed and urged the revision of immigration laws based on the principles of freedom, equality, and the rule of law. In 1952, she won victory. The U.S. Immigration Service canceled the inhumane immigration procedures that required Chinese people to undergo confinement inspection when entering the country, and allowed Chinese people to apply to bring their spouses to enter the country, so that all new Asian immigrants to the United States in the future would benefit from this. On December 19, 1977, Deng Yuening passed away in Phoenix, Arizona, USA, at the age of 73. In 1978, Huang Jinbo, who had practiced medicine in the United States for many years, was elected as the deputy mayor of Cerritos, California, becoming the first Chinese mayor in the United States. He served as deputy mayor for three consecutive terms and mayor for two terms. In 1983, Ms. Chen Liwanruo was elected mayor of Monterey Park, becoming the first Chinese female mayor in the history of the United States. After that, more and more Chinese participated in politics. From members of Congress and local state assemblies to governors and mayors, Chinese people were everywhere. U.S. Secretary of Labor Elaine Chao and Washington State Governor Gary Locke have become representatives of Chinese people participating in politics. According to incomplete statistics, there are about 50 Chinese elected officials in office in the United States so far. According to the administrative divisions of the United States, there are large cities and small cities. Large cities implement a chief executive (i.e. mayor) responsibility system, while small cities implement a rotation system for members of the parliament, that is, the mayor is served by members of the assembly in turns. Each member can serve as mayor for 9 months during a four-year term. Running for mayor or city councilor in small and medium-sized cities with a large number of Chinese people is the main way for Chinese people to participate in politics. In addition, judging from the personal circumstances of the many Chinese mayors currently elected, most of them immigrated to the United States in their youth, have a long life experience in the United States, understand the requirements of voters, care about the lives of ethnic minorities, and dare to speak for the Chinese. To be elected as a city councilor or mayor, he must be a person accepted by the citizens, able to actively participate in various community activities, and have a good understanding of the ecological and political environment of the community; he must also be enthusiastic about public affairs and sincerely serve the community. In addition, you should also have certain leadership and public speaking skills. Data show that the Chinese can enter the political arena mainly relying on the support of the Chinese, but the three Chinese mayors who successfully ran for mayor in Alberta are exceptions.

60bd0683137fb738d97ae9b298e36498ab76a73c.sourceText: 亚利桑那州的叁位华裔市长

7b26daf578f6231b7df1e94a55a0a3ba6d4291d2.sourceText: 在美国的中小城市中，有叁位华裔市长是出自亚利桑那州。 第一位是邓达明(Egmund Tang) ，亚省皮澳利亚(Peoria) 市的市长。邓达明当过兵，上过大学，做过货仓生意，并於1955年开始从政，当选為皮澳利亚的市议员，以后更连任了18年之久。 1973年至1979年，邓达明成功当上副市长。 1979年，他竞选市长又获成功，并连任至1985年。在他开始从政的年份，当地几乎没有华人，查得最早的《华人通讯录》(1971)，当年皮澳利亚市的华人只有两户人家，一户是邓达明家庭，另一户是邓家鸞夫人。要在那年代几乎全是西人、墨裔的环境中参选从政，一定是要加倍努力才能获得成功。邓达明在前后30年时间担任过市议员、副市长和市长，是华人在美国从政歷史止一项不可多得的记录。 第二位是邓伟利(Willie Wong)，亚省梅萨(Mesa) 市的市长。他毕业於本州州立大学，曾任梅萨市的青年会主席、警政参议会主席、玛利科巴郡政治研究会主席，於1988年至1989年出任梅萨市副市长。 1993年，他参加市长竞选并获当选，成為全美管理人口最多的华裔市长。当年梅萨市的亚裔人口只佔全市人口总数的百分之一，他能得到成功殊属不易。邓伟利上任后，和中国广东开平缔结成姐妹市。 1993年，他要率团回开平签约，但因操劳市政而累坏了身子，随时都有开刀住院的可能，连上飞机也得徵得医生同意。是出於对故乡的思念，还是邓家祖宗有灵，邓市长终於平安地回到了开平，而且精神爽利，行程顺畅。开平市长亲自将一把城市?#37329;锁匙?#36192;予邓伟利市长，祝贺他成為开平市的荣誉市民。当年要获此殊荣者，需投资一千万或纯捐献一百万港币的商贾才可获得认证。那本名册上有着数十位遍布港澳和海外的知名华侨，但没有一位象邓伟利那样，在美国从政并荣膺市长的开平弟子，是他填补了这个?#31354;白?#12290;邓伟利回开平时，乡亲為他欢呼，祖坟得到重修。在香火縈绕中，邓氏祖宗看到了有一个远在美国的孝子贤孙，在西方修成了正果，并越洋返回到开平赤坎，為僻壤的祖宗山坟添上了一道光环。 第叁位是邓鼎奇(Michael Hing)，他於2009年当上亚省优越(Superior)市的市长。邓鼎奇祖籍开平赤坎，曾祖父邓业双於清光绪年间以华工身份赴美，修筑铁路和水库，后回国定居。祖父邓春庆青年时代来美，在此地经营杂货店，由於热心服务，得到当地政府和大家敬重，曾以其名為一条街道命名，华人能有此殊荣者，实属凤毛麟角。邓鼎奇的父亲邓新华在美出生，接受西方教育，学业有成。上世纪30年代，美国经济不景气，邓新华与其它四姐弟随同母亲一同回国居住，至1938年才返回美国。父亲邓新华不忘桑梓，於1993年和1999年两次返乡，捐款给家乡的学校办学。而邓鼎奇已是第四代开平人的后裔，他在美出生读书，在大学主修农科，后转為经商，开设超市，事业有成，从政以后，竞选成為当地首位华人后裔的市长。邓鼎奇深受家庭影响，热心服务社区，2009年，邓鼎奇市长出席斐匿邓高密公所春宴，获得主席邓丰沾颁发奖牌，以表彰他為服务社团所作出的贡献。远在祖国的开平市侨办，也為他的当选市长发来了贺函。 邓达明、邓伟利、邓鼎奇叁位市长能够在美国主流社会出人头地，实属本地华人之光，并成為今后华人奋门之楷模。
7b26daf578f6231b7df1e94a55a0a3ba6d4291d2.translatedText: Among small and medium-sized cities in the United States, three Chinese mayors are from Arizona. The first is Egmund Tang, the mayor of Peoria, Alberta. Deng Daming served in the military, went to college, and did a warehouse business. He began to enter politics in 1955 and was elected as a city councilor in Piola, and was re-elected for 18 years. From 1973 to 1979, Deng Daming successfully became deputy mayor. In 1979, he successfully ran for mayor and was re-elected until 1985. In the year when he began to enter politics, there were almost no Chinese in the local area. The earliest "Chinese Address Book" (1971) found shows that there were only two Chinese families in Piaolia City at that time, one was the Deng Daming family, and the other was Mrs. Deng Jialuan. If you were to run for office in an environment where almost all Westerners and Mexicans were in those days, you would have to work extra hard to succeed. Deng Daming served as a city councilor, deputy mayor and mayor for 30 years, which is a rare record in the history of Chinese politics in the United States. The second one is Willie Wong, the mayor of Mesa, Alberta. He graduated from the state university of the state. He served as the chairman of the Mesa Youth Association, the chairman of the Police Council, and the chairman of the Maricopa County Political Research Association. He served as the deputy mayor of Mesa from 1988 to 1989. In 1993, he ran for mayor and was elected, becoming the Chinese-American mayor with the largest population in the United States. At that time, the Asian population in Mesa only accounted for one percent of the city's total population. It was not easy for him to succeed. After Deng Weili took office, he established a sister city relationship with Kaiping, Guangdong, China. In 1993, he wanted to lead a delegation back to Kaiping to sign a contract, but he was exhausted from working in the municipal government. There was a possibility of being hospitalized at any time, and he had to seek permission from a doctor even to board a plane. Whether it was out of longing for his hometown or the spirit of the Deng family ancestors, Mayor Deng finally returned to Kaiping safely, in high spirits and with a smooth schedule. The mayor of Kaiping personally handed a city key to Mayor Deng Weili and congratulated him on becoming an honorary citizen of Kaiping City. Those who wanted to win this honor back then needed to invest 10 million Hong Kong dollars or make a pure donation of 1 million Hong Kong dollars to obtain certification. There are dozens of well-known overseas Chinese in Hong Kong, Macao and overseas on that list, but none of them is like Deng Weili, a disciple of Kaiping who entered politics in the United States and was honored as mayor. It was he who filled this gap. When Deng Weili returned to Kaiping, the villagers cheered for him and his ancestral graves were rebuilt. Surrounded by the incense, the Deng family's ancestors saw a filial son and grandson far away in the United States, who had cultivated righteousness in the West, and returned across the ocean to Chikan, Kaiping, adding a halo to the remote mountain tomb of his ancestors. The third one is Michael Hing, who became the mayor of Superior City in Alberta in 2009. Deng Dingqi's ancestral home is Chikan, Kaiping. His great-grandfather Deng Yeshuang went to the United States as a Chinese laborer during the Guangxu period of the Qing Dynasty to build railways and reservoirs, and later returned to China to settle down. My grandfather, Deng Chunqing, came to the United States in his youth and ran a grocery store here. Due to his enthusiastic service, he was respected by the local government and everyone. A street was named after him. It is really rare for Chinese to have this honor. Deng Dingqi's father, Deng Xinhua, was born in the United States, received Western education, and was academically successful. In the 1930s, when the U.S. economy was in recession, Deng Xinhua and his four other siblings returned to China to live with their mother. They did not return to the United States until 1938. His father, Deng Xinhua, did not forget his family roots and returned to his hometown twice in 1993 and 1999 to donate money to schools in his hometown. Deng Dingqi is a descendant of the fourth generation of Kaiping people. He was born in the United States and studied agriculture at university. He later turned to business, opened a supermarket, and had a successful career. After entering politics, he ran for office and became the first local mayor of Chinese descent. Influenced by his family, Mayor Deng Dingqi is enthusiastic about serving the community. In 2009, Mayor Deng Dingqi attended the spring banquet of the Fei Deng Gaomi Office and received a medal from Chairman Deng Fengzhan in recognition of his contribution to serving the community. The Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of Kaiping City, far away in the motherland, also sent a congratulatory letter for his election as mayor. The three mayors, Deng Daming, Deng Weili and Deng Dingqi, are able to stand out in mainstream American society. They are indeed the light of the local Chinese and will become a model for future Chinese to strive for success.

06df18dde79fa58e4c5e7c9c0addf0ca7ef437b5.sourceText: 今天，亚省又有华人出来勇敢地站出来参政了！他就是要竞选今年钱德勒市政府的市政委员（City Council Members）职位的黄馨民（Sam Huang），虽然这只是一个地区性的选举，但是选举结果对我们华人以及亚裔的影响力却有相当重要的意义。我们华人应大力支持和鼓励，以改变政治版图，提升我们华人的地位。选举造势已经展开，我们希望有更多约华人参与!
06df18dde79fa58e4c5e7c9c0addf0ca7ef437b5.translatedText: Today, another Chinese person in Alberta bravely stood up to participate in politics! He is Sam Huang who is running for the position of City Council Members of the Chandler City Government this year. Although this is only a regional election, the results of the election are of great significance to the influence of us Chinese and Asians. We Chinese should give strong support and encouragement to change the political landscape and enhance the status of us Chinese. The election campaign has begun, and we hope more Chinese people will participate!

6c1b3928d790120ede63fe8c369c9b4b8bac9a59.sourceText: 图桑：养大孩子靠什么 （特約撰述：慧明） 这个命题一出来，大多数家长的答案已经胸有成竹了。靠袋里的钱？钱有…
6c1b3928d790120ede63fe8c369c9b4b8bac9a59.translatedText: Tucson: What do you rely on to raise children (Special writer: Huiming) As soon as this proposition came out, most parents already had a well-prepared answer. With money in your pocket? Money has...

85db5b7695fd5d0f9e7188260c801d23f2a6526a.sourceText: 这个命题一出来，大多数家长的答案已经胸有成竹了。靠袋里的钱？钱有时也不是万能的。靠手中的权，权终归也是暂时的。所以，靠知识和技术不要输在起跑线上是这些家长共同的答案。中国的家长把五六岁的孩子送进英语培训班，美国的华裔家长同样把五六岁的孩子送到当地的中文学校，就是希望以后用两种语言听生活的发令枪比一种更有优势。 当今的美国国务卿希拉里算是个女强人，思维缜密，口齿清楚，但比起很多关于世界的见解来，她关于”养大一个孩子需要一个村子的关怀”的答案却更能吸引人。 村子是什么？首先是乡下，是她老公出生的小镇小石头城，是大家闺秀的她没和克林顿结婚前不可能接触到的社会环境。但她能决定同来自美国中部乡下的一个聪明才俊结婚，并原谅他以后的错误，就是因为她明白克林顿的成功更加不易，一个有酗酒的继父，只记得爷爷和妈妈教育的乡下小子，能成为耶鲁的博士，一定有他特别的家教。这是她的见解。 对我们在美国的华人来说，村子应该是家庭环境。孩子的成长过程中家长应该是他的最贴近的老师。但遗憾的是由于父母知识结构组成的偏差，或者环境的缺陷，孩子不可能获得全面的知识和道德观的教育，以至孩子的性格出现某种偏差。 所以，村子的第二个含义便应该是社区环境。我想，当希拉里看到克林顿获得那么多黑人选票的时候，或者以后读到《克林顿传》时，她开始明白了村子对一个人的教育起了怎样的作用。这对我们也是有启迪意义的。 华裔的孩子大部分是在缺乏中国那种社区亲情教育环境中长大的。比如在中国，一个孩子长大有七大姑八大姨的督促鼓励和劝解，孩子可以在这种父母以外的教育中寻找到自己的方向。但在美国不同，孩子整天和家长在一起，本来就有一种审美疲劳的感觉，加上强大美式教育力量强化了孩子的自我意识，往往会抵触家长的一面教育。换句话说，没有一种外界的亲情教育可以辅助父母的教育。一旦孩子和父母之间发生问题，家长意识到凭一己之力不能完全胜任教育孩子的力量，几乎是无能为力面对这种现实。 所以鉴于希拉里村子的见解，笔者以为在美国的华裔家长应该主动建立这种村子氛围，加强对孩子的教育。这种社区之力可以是孩子所处的各种社团，如艺术团体、义工团体、教会等，但更重要的应该是华人自己的团体，用各人所具备的中华传统文化和思想细流，汇成教育孩子的主流。 与家长和学校的教育相比，村子教育似乎更应该偏重于道德、思想、抱负方面。技艺学业教育是必要的，但事实是凡是在村子教育里得益的孩子，他（她）在学业和技艺上也一定是拔尖的。 克林顿的女儿切尔西当了《让世界不同》系列节目。这档节目聚焦那些为帮助他人和社会作出重大贡献的组织或个人。为什么她会有这样的选择？切尔西回答，在母亲希拉里２００８年参加美国总统选举期间，她为那些无私奉献者的故事所感动，希望讲述那些故事，”帮助我践行外祖母的格言，’生活并不在于你身上发生了什么事，而在于你如何处理那些发生在自己身上的事”’。她还计划将把全国广播公司支付给大部分薪水捐给克林顿基金会和乔治 华盛顿大学医院。 村子教育的结果让切尔西真正成为了完美的女孩。在美国我们也是华裔村子里的村民，我们也能够让自己的孩子和朋友的孩子得到村子的关怀。
85db5b7695fd5d0f9e7188260c801d23f2a6526a.translatedText: As soon as this proposition comes out, most parents already have a well-prepared answer. With money in your pocket? Money is not everything sometimes. Relying on the power in one's hands, power is only temporary after all. Therefore, relying on knowledge and technology not to lose at the starting line is the common answer of these parents. Chinese parents send their five- and six-year-old children to English training classes, and Chinese parents in the United States also send their five- and six-year-old children to local Chinese schools, hoping that hearing the starting guns of life in two languages ​​will be more advantageous than one. Today's U.S. Secretary of State Hillary is a strong woman, thoughtful and articulate, but compared to many insights about the world, her answer to "It takes a village to raise a child" is more attractive. What is a village? First of all, it was the countryside, Little Rock City, the town where her husband was born. It was a social environment that she would not have been exposed to before marrying Clinton. But she was able to decide to marry a smart man from the countryside in the middle of the United States and forgive him for his future mistakes because she understood that Clinton's success was even more difficult. A country boy with an alcoholic stepfather and who only remembered the education of his grandfather and mother could become a doctor at Yale because of his special tutor. This is her opinion. For us Chinese in the United States, the village should be a family environment. Parents should be the closest teachers to their children as they grow up. But unfortunately, due to deviations in the composition of the parents' knowledge structure or defects in the environment, it is impossible for children to obtain comprehensive knowledge and moral education, and as a result, the child's character may have certain deviations. Therefore, the second meaning of village should be community environment. I think that when Hillary saw that Clinton received so many black votes, or later read "Clinton's Biography", she began to understand the role that the village played in a person's education. This is also instructive to us. Most Chinese children grow up in an environment that lacks the kind of community-based family education in China. For example, in China, when a child grows up, he has the supervision, encouragement and persuasion of seven aunts and eight aunts. The child can find his own direction in this kind of education other than that of his parents. But it is different in the United States. Children spend all day with their parents, and they already feel a sense of aesthetic fatigue. Coupled with the strong power of American education that strengthens children's self-awareness, they often resist the parents' one-sided education. In other words, there is no external family education that can assist parents’ education. Once problems arise between children and parents, parents realize that they are not fully capable of educating their children on their own, and are almost powerless to face this reality. Therefore, in view of the insights of Hillary Village, the author believes that Chinese parents in the United States should take the initiative to establish this kind of village atmosphere and strengthen the education of their children. This kind of community power can be the various associations that children belong to, such as art groups, volunteer groups, churches, etc., but more importantly, it should be the Chinese groups themselves, using the trickles of traditional Chinese culture and ideas that each person possesses to form the mainstream of educating children. Compared with education by parents and schools, village education seems to focus more on morality, ideology, and aspirations. Technical and academic education is necessary, but the fact is that any child who benefits from village education must also be top-notch in academics and skills. Clinton's daughter Chelsea stars on the series "Making a Difference." This program focuses on organizations or individuals who have made significant contributions to helping others and society. Why would she make such a choice? Chelsea replied that when her mother Hillary was running for the US presidential election in 2008, she was moved by the stories of those selfless devotees and hoped to tell those stories to "help me live up to my grandmother's motto, 'Life is not about what happens to you, but how you deal with what happens to you.'" She also plans to donate the majority of her NBC salary to the Clinton Foundation and George Washington University Hospital. As a result of village education, Chelsea truly became the perfect girl. In the United States, we are also villagers in a Chinese village, and we can also let our children and the children of our friends receive care from the village.

1279e4dcfa2023610449b8d51cea98e495f9594e.translatedText: Officials of the Department of Justice said on the 9th that they are offering a reward of US$1 million for the arrest of the person who killed Border Patrol Agent Boon Terry in the mountains of southern Tucson. 5 Mexican border suspects.

41cbabf2e51e5e7186108681857852fede3643bb.sourceText: 巡警泰瑞的死亡已经成为国会调查 ATF 枪支走私调查” 迅速和愤怒” 的核心事件。国会调查者与司法部就此事调查文件的分歧使得上个月司法部长艾里克霍德遭蔑视国会的表决。尽管有如此的争论，直到今天关于泰瑞遇害的细节才被披露。
41cbabf2e51e5e7186108681857852fede3643bb.translatedText: Patrolman Terry's death has become the centerpiece of a "fast and furious" congressional inquiry into the ATF's gun-trafficking investigation. Disagreement between congressional investigators and the Justice Department over the documents prompted Attorney General Eric Holder to be held in contempt of Congress last month. Despite the controversy, details about Terry's murder were not revealed until today.

ec3ced47dbf6b704a762f22b5e8b9756e89e907d.sourceText: 据图森新闻发布会有关信息，司法部的官员表示， 2010 年 12 月 4 日，泰瑞与其他的巡警企图阻止数名从墨西哥进入美国的人，他们被植入南亚利桑那州沙漠的电子传感器所绊倒。联邦巡警面对这几个人开枪时，用的是豆子袋子弹，不是真正的子弹。这几个人被证实为” 边界歹徒” 。他们随后开火，巡警泰瑞在交火中不幸遇难。其中一名歹徒脚部被击中，因而被拘留。在其他巡警照顾泰瑞的时候，其他四名嫌疑人逃逸。
ec3ced47dbf6b704a762f22b5e8b9756e89e907d.translatedText: On December 4, 2010, Terry and other patrol officers were trying to stop several people entering the United States from Mexico when they tripped over an electronic sensor implanted in the southern Arizona desert, Justice Department officials said, according to information from a news conference in Tucson. When federal patrol officers fired at these men, they used beanbag bullets, not real bullets. These people were confirmed to be "border gangsters." They then opened fire, and Patrolman Terry was killed in the crossfire. One of the criminals was shot in the foot and was detained. While other patrol officers tended to Terry, the other four suspects fled.

782a84dcf1fc749feb676c99a01a9de03ad92ecb.sourceText: 关于对杀害泰瑞的 5 人，以一级杀人罪、二级杀人罪、阴谋抢劫干涉商业罪、企图抢劫干涉商业罪、暴力犯罪中使用并携带武器罪、袭击联邦官员罪、被禁止拥有武器罪等罪名指控，并且司法部宣布为逮捕 4 名逃犯， FBI 悬赏高达 100 万美元。
782a84dcf1fc749feb676c99a01a9de03ad92ecb.translatedText: Regarding the five people who killed Terry, they were charged with first-degree homicide, second-degree homicide, conspiracy to commit robbery to interfere with commerce, attempted robbery to interfere with commerce, using and carrying a weapon in a violent crime, assault on a federal officer, and prohibited possession of weapons. The Department of Justice announced that the FBI was offering a reward of up to $1 million for the arrest of the four fugitives.

ce9cdd9f37b71ca85c06f7e0fada8dbf664b79c8.sourceText: 泰瑞被认为是非常敬业的巡警，并且泰瑞的家人也表示，只有凶手受到正义的审判，才能告慰亡者之灵，抚慰生者之心。
ce9cdd9f37b71ca85c06f7e0fada8dbf664b79c8.translatedText: Terry is considered a very dedicated patrol officer, and Terry's family also said that only when the murderer is brought to justice can the spirits of the dead and the hearts of the living be comforted.

b102577655774b059f7e419841acdd7f2b4232c6.sourceText: 全国公路交通安全管理署(NHTSA)29日说，它已要求丰田汽车公司(Toyota)召回在美销售的约15万4000辆凌志(Lexus)多功能车(SUV)，车型为2010年份 的RX 350及RX 450车款，因为这些车辆的脚垫可能卡住油门踏板，导致车子无预警加速(暴冲)。 NHTSA还可能调查丰田公司是否迅速、及时向该署通报问题。 这项召回行动显示，2009年开始造成丰田品牌形象严重受损、销量大幅下滑的「脚垫卡死油门」安全问题，挥之不去。 这个问题导致丰田迄今在全球共召回1400余万辆车。 NHTSA表示，它审查了消费者的投诉及丰田提供的相关资讯，做出要求丰田召回前述车子的决定。 它说，前述SUV的车主应移除驾驶座的脚垫，迅速到经销商处修理。 丰田在声明中说：「车主将在今年8月初接到第一类邮件寄达的召回通知书，凌志经销商将免费为车主修理这个问题。」 专家建议车主，如果车子暴冲，应踩煞车，并打入「空档」(neutral，N档)，或将引擎熄火。 NHTSA并表示，可能就丰田是否及时向该署通报展开调查。 在早先一系列召回行动中，丰田因未及时通报被罚款总计4880万元。
b102577655774b059f7e419841acdd7f2b4232c6.translatedText: The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) said on the 29th that it has asked Toyota to recall about 154,000 Lexus utility vehicles (SUVs) sold in the United States, including the 2010 RX 350 and RX 450 models, because the floor mats of these vehicles may jam the accelerator pedal, causing the vehicle to accelerate without warning (surge). NHTSA may also investigate whether Toyota reported problems to the agency promptly and promptly. This recall action shows that the safety issue of "foot pads blocking the accelerator", which has seriously damaged Toyota's brand image and caused a sharp decline in sales since 2009, is still lingering. This problem has led Toyota to recall more than 14 million vehicles worldwide so far. NHTSA said it reviewed consumer complaints and relevant information provided by Toyota and made the decision to require Toyota to recall the aforementioned vehicles. It said owners of the aforementioned SUVs should remove the driver's seat floor mats and go to dealers for repairs quickly. Toyota said in a statement: "Car owners will receive a recall notice sent by first-class mail in early August this year. Lexus dealers will repair the problem for free for car owners." Experts recommend that car owners should apply the brakes and shift into "neutral" (N) or shut down the engine if their car suddenly swerves. NHTSA also said it may launch an investigation into whether Toyota notified the agency in a timely manner. In a series of earlier recalls, Toyota was fined a total of 48.8 million yuan for failing to notify them in a timely manner.

ca595e8923f5b765fb0632900f8167587cb7a9bc.translatedText: CDC launches trial of free HIV screening at pharmacies CDC pilots free HIV screening in pharmacies The federal Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) announced a pilot plan on the 26th...

20ff464e526bcace706774848f472874b8958cb9.sourceText: CDC试行药房免费HIV筛检联邦疾病防治中心(CDC)26日宣布一项试行计画，将投入120万元在24个城市和乡村社区的药房和商店诊所，为民众提供「人体免疫缺乏病毒」(HIV)免费筛检。
20ff464e526bcace706774848f472874b8958cb9.translatedText: CDC pilots free HIV screening in pharmacies The federal Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) announced a pilot plan on the 26th to invest $1.2 million in pharmacies and store clinics in 24 urban and rural communities to provide free human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) screening to the public.

cbece3bc1c2151ce89434bfa8848a19082642523.sourceText: 卫生官员希望这项针对「后天性免疫缺乏症候群」(AIDS)病毒的检验，未来可与测量血压和注射疫苗一样，成为全美各地药房的例行服务项目之一。
cbece3bc1c2151ce89434bfa8848a19082642523.translatedText: Health officials hope that the test for the Acquired Immunodeficiency Syndrome (AIDS) virus will one day become as routine a service at pharmacies across the country as blood pressure measurements and vaccinations.

9bf90749ff84cabca224583a82f51c932c5d9cc3.sourceText: 筛检方式是使用准确度高达99%的口腔检验棒，而且只需20分钟即可获知初步结果；若检验棒呈现阳性反应，顾客将被转介至卫生单位或医疗机构进一步验血确认，以及接受咨询和治疗。
9bf90749ff84cabca224583a82f51c932c5d9cc3.translatedText: The screening method uses an oral test stick with an accuracy of 99%, and the preliminary results can be obtained in just 20 minutes; if the test stick shows a positive reaction, the customer will be referred to a health unit or medical institution for further blood test confirmation, as well as consultation and treatment.

1cd2e1d1f4157cd11ffb655fb529e8fb9c01b487.sourceText: CDC目前已在七处地点展开试行，很快会再挑选其他17处地点。该试行计划在明年夏季结束后，CDC官员将再评估执行成效。CDC指出，估计目前全美有110万人感染HIV，但约有20%的人根本不知道已有病毒在身，因为感染后可能需要十年或更长的时间，才会出现症状和致病。自2006年以来，CDC已多次呼吁13岁至64岁的美国人应至少接受一次HIV筛检，而非仅限于高危险群。
1cd2e1d1f4157cd11ffb655fb529e8fb9c01b487.translatedText: >CDC has currently launched trials in seven locations and will soon select 17 other locations. After the pilot program ends next summer, CDC officials will re-evaluate the effectiveness of the implementation. The CDC points out that an estimated 1.1 million people in the United States are currently infected with HIV, but about 20% of people are not even aware that they have the virus because it can take ten years or more after infection for symptoms and illness to appear. Since 2006, the CDC has repeatedly called on Americans ages 13 to 64 to receive at least one HIV screening, not just those in high-risk groups.

436552fe7037fff51a2474e5f81e5bde08267218.sourceText: 不过，由当局最新的统计数据显示，65岁以下的成年人至今接受筛检的比率仍低于五成。专家指出，过去被诊断出感染HIV的病患，如同被宣判死刑，但现今的治疗药物已可让病患活得更长久和更健康。与此同时，全美最大的连锁药房华格林药店(Walgreens)本周也与当局合作，由卫生机构派员至20个城市的分店提供HIV免费筛检。不过，华格林这项活动与CDC试行计画不同之处，在于CDC是训练各地药房的员工具备自行检验的能力，并可能成为永久性的服务项目。
436552fe7037fff51a2474e5f81e5bde08267218.translatedText: However, the latest statistics from the authorities show that the screening rate for adults under the age of 65 is still less than 50%. Experts point out that in the past, being diagnosed with HIV was like a death sentence, but today's treatment drugs can help patients live longer and healthier lives. At the same time, Walgreens, the largest pharmacy chain in the United States, also cooperated with the authorities this week, and health agencies sent personnel to branches in 20 cities to provide free HIV screening. However, the difference between Hua Gelin's activity and the CDC's pilot plan is that the CDC is training employees in pharmacies in various places to have the ability to perform self-tests, and it may become a permanent service project.

8ddcf144fd1b908ffbd87836da813d0a79f7f47d.sourceText: 报告显示：这不是你的想象力，AZ是越来越热 （亚省时报） 凤凰城 – 如果你感觉夏天更长更热，你可能离得不太远。一份新的报告显示，亚利桑那州的温度上升的速度比任何其他州都快。”你以为你习惯它，当你上了年纪你就明白，你的身体不习惯?#26757;萨某店老板，艾伦弗里曼说。弗里曼花了很多时间在户外。””你清晨开始，你一直在外面”他说。他在这里住了一辈子，他注意到，在多过去几十年里越来越热。”过去，我们每年将花费约15晚与霜冻战斗，现在可能每5年我才会担心一下霜冻，”弗里曼说。这不是他的想象。从气候中心的一个新的报告说，自1970年以来，亚利桑那州成为每一个十年的变暖速度最快的州，每十年气温增加约0.6度。自1912年以来，我们一直排在变暖速度最快的州的第四。我们越来越热的原因之一是因为我们已经采取了农业用地和把它变成了城市和郊区的土地使用材料，如混凝土和沥青，这些材料通常都吸收热量。我们也有峡谷效应，如果你有建筑物和建筑物之间的狭窄地区，晚上就会有热反弹，州气候学家，南希博士这样说。她说，亚利桑那州，重新思考我们使用的建造材料，因为如果继续这样，就会耗费能源。我们问她为什么晚上也如此热，她说，像沥青和混凝土吸收热量，夜间的时间不够长，足以让他们冷却下来。
8ddcf144fd1b908ffbd87836da813d0a79f7f47d.translatedText: Report: It’s not your imagination, AZ is getting hotter (Alberta Times) PHOENIX – If summer feels like it’s getting longer and hotter, you’re probably not too far away. A new report shows temperatures are rising faster in Arizona than in any other state. "You think you get used to it, and then as you get older you realize that your body isn't used to it?" says Sam shop owner, Alan Freeman. Freeman spends a lot of time outdoors. "You start early in the morning and you're outside all the time," he said. He's lived here his whole life, and he's noticed that it's getting hotter and hotter over the past few decades. "Where we used to spend about 15 nights a year fighting frost, now I only worry about frost maybe every five years," Freeman said. This is not his imagination. A new report from Climate Central says Arizona has become the fastest-warming state every decade since 1970, with temperatures increasing by about 0.6 degrees per decade. We've been ranked fourth among the fastest-warming states since 1912. One of the reasons we're getting hotter is because we've taken agricultural land and turned it into urban and suburban land using materials like concrete and asphalt, which generally absorb heat. We also have a canyon effect, where if you have buildings and narrow areas between buildings, you have heat rebound at night, state climatologist Dr. Nancy said. Arizona, she said, rethink the materials we use to build because if we continue like this, we're going to waste energy. We asked her why it was so hot at night, and she said that like asphalt and concrete absorb heat, the nighttime hours aren't long enough for them to cool down.

e69a59f716bdc36b94ab740c1541acfcbc48bee3.sourceText: 钱德勒统一学区，将给教师2％加薪 教师的薪水将提高2％，总额在213亿美元预算一下，周三晚上钱德勒统一学区拟定了议案。如果下月这个议案获得批准，这个城市第二大的学区将从7月1日起，为35名教师和8个公交车司机，增加预算。该地区预计下一学年会有500到700多名学生，入学人数将达到39,500。增加的人数可能带来高达420万的州资金。财务官乔尔?#27779;思说，立法院已提高了2012-13 CUSD资金近2.9亿元，。但沃思说，额外的资金是不够偿还过去四年在国家教育预算削减36亿美元的”结构性赤字”。因此，该学区计划要求选民在11月投票追加15％的预算。如果获得批准，将每年集资$ 28万持续四年，从2013年7月1日开始。增加的预算将给教师额外1％的加薪，提高过去几年的工资停滞。区的初步预算包括150万美元，进入三年级学生开始，有新的”移动阅读”的任务，2013-14年度生效。”好消息是它有150万美元预算”沃斯说。
e69a59f716bdc36b94ab740c1541acfcbc48bee3.translatedText: Chandler Unified School District to give teachers 2% pay raise Teachers' salaries will be increased by 2%, totaling $21.3 billion under a budget, the Chandler Unified School District proposed a bill Wednesday night. If approved next month, the city's second-largest school district will have a budget increase for 35 teachers and eight bus drivers starting July 1. The district expects to have between 500 and 700 more students next school year, bringing enrollment to 39,500. The increased numbers could bring up to $4.2 million in state funding. Treasurer Joel #27779;s said the Legislature has increased 2012-13 CUSD funding by nearly $290 million. But Wirth said the additional funding won't be enough to repay the "structural deficit" of $3.6 billion in cuts to the state education budget over the past four years. As a result, the district plans to ask voters in November to add a 15% budget increase. If approved, it will raise $280,000 per year for four years, starting on July 1, 2013. The increased budget would give teachers an additional 1% raise, boosting wages that have stagnated over the past few years. The district's preliminary budget includes $1.5 million, starting with entering third grade, with new "mobile reading" mandates effective in 2013-14. "The good news is it has a $1.5 million budget," Voss said.

98cbd6b1f0d2056489a7362bacb61bd997d825ce.sourceText: (侨联通讯张肇鸿)2012年七月四日，凤凰城华人庆祝美国国庆和华裔小姐选美活动将拉开帷幕。
98cbd6b1f0d2056489a7362bacb61bd997d825ce.translatedText: (Reporter Zhang Zhaohong of the Overseas Chinese Federation) On July 4th, 2012, Chinese people in Phoenix will celebrate the National Day of the United States and the Miss Chinese Beauty Pageant will kick off.

49b788b83f069fb88519dd8a89afbb46e5d8488c.sourceText: 与前两年的节目流程一样，今年也是以一个主题和四个环节来展开。配合龙年的到来， July 4th, 2012 Celebration & Miss Phoenix Chinese Pageant的大主题是: 《龙飞凤舞》，而四个环节分别是: 1.翩扇舞青花；2. 清荷步影盈；3.才华蕴智艺；4. 翔凤凯歌声。
49b788b83f069fb88519dd8a89afbb46e5d8488c.translatedText: Similar to the program flow of the previous two years, this year it is also launched with a theme and four links. In conjunction with the arrival of the Year of the Dragon, the main theme of the July 4th, 2012 Celebration & Miss Phoenix Chinese Pageant is: "Dragon Flying and Phoenix Dance", and the four links are: 1. Fan dancing with blue and white flowers; 2. Clear lotus steps with shadows; 3. Talent with wisdom and art; 4. Soaring phoenix singing triumphantly.

f838f98937f913e7fe3d01178069539944f1e5b9.sourceText: ”翩扇舞青​​花”环节，包括了欢庆国庆和龙年的文艺节目及佳丽们的集体舞和旗袍秀。今年为了给佳丽能穿上一件优美和有中国特色的旗袍，侨联主席张华芳以及形象和化妆总监黄欣明，庆祝国庆青少作文绘画比赛主办人之一的万培杰，后勤主管庄淑华等，不辞劳累地专门开车到洛衫矶，到中国城有关部门去精挑细选和购置，发现有一款接近明青花瓷般蓝色的旗袍十分雅美和亮丽，所以便亳不犹疑地买了回来。本想连泳装也一连购置，可惜价钱偏高，宁可回来上网去选购。
f838f98937f913e7fe3d01178069539944f1e5b9.translatedText: The "Fan Dance with Blue and Flowers" section includes cultural and artistic programs to celebrate National Day and the Year of the Dragon, as well as group dances and cheongsam shows by the beauties. This year, in order to give the contestants a beautiful cheongsam with Chinese characteristics, Chairman Zhang Huafang of the Overseas Chinese Federation, image and makeup director Huang Xinming, Wan Peijie, one of the organizers of the National Day Youth Essay and Painting Competition, and logistics manager Zhuang Shuhua, worked tirelessly to Los Angeles and went to the relevant departments in Chinatown to carefully select and purchase. They found a cheongsam that was as blue as Ming blue and white porcelain that was very elegant and bright, so they bought it without hesitation. I wanted to buy swimsuits as well, but unfortunately the price was too high, so I would rather go back and shop online.

a1d34e2341d491948365e6f7304ee549406788d0.sourceText: 举办​​一个大活动花费不菲，就算有大量的义工帮忙，精打细算后各种开销也将近要三万元，节流固然重要，开源更加紧逼，这就是为什么一班老侨一开始就带头捐助经费的缘由，也是《 龙飞凤舞点将台》要多次表彰和感谢各位赞助佳丽的善者仁翁和广告客户的原因。那么，举办这么一个活动有什么义意呢？在今年侨联出版的国庆特刊中，我们将刊登《华人庆祝美国国庆的历史意义和现实意义》的文章，阐述侨联四十年来举办这个活动的意义所在。
a1d34e2341d491948365e6f7304ee549406788d0.translatedText: It costs a lot to hold a large event. Even with a large number of volunteers to help, the various expenses will be nearly 30,000 yuan after careful calculation. Saving money is important, and open source is even more urgent. This is why a group of old overseas Chinese took the lead in donating funds from the beginning, and it is also the reason why " This is why "Dragon Fei Feng Dancing on the Stage" has repeatedly commended and thanked all the benefactors and advertisers who sponsored the beauties. So, what’s the point of holding such an event? In this year's National Day special issue published by the Overseas Chinese Federation, we will publish an article on "The Historical and Practical Significance of Chinese Celebration of the National Day in the United States" to explain the significance of the event held by the Overseas Chinese Federation for 40 years.

c5351f7f65300d7951936f5a685f80d12de20a6e.sourceText: 活动从筹划到举办，时间紧，任务重，领导者肩上的重任可想而知，这就难怪新上任的侨联主席张华芳为此事日夜操劳，见人开口侨社，闭口广告的，用尽人情牌，还得遮挡一些对侨社不实的攻击，团结内部力量，寻求外界的支援等，为的就是要办好这次活动，我们应该对这样的侨领大力支持鼓励和鼓掌。我们始终相信，一个有传统和有意义的活动，一个能得到主流社会和华人社区支持的活动，一个有侨联领导班子主导和广大义工帮忙的活动，一定可以举办成功的。
c5351f7f65300d7951936f5a685f80d12de20a6e.translatedText: From the planning to the holding of the event, time is tight and the tasks are heavy. The heavy responsibilities on the leaders' shoulders can be imagined. It is no wonder that the newly appointed Chairman of the Overseas Chinese Federation Zhang Huafang works day and night on this matter and speaks to everyone in the Overseas Chinese Community. , those who keep silent about advertising, use up their favor cards, and block out some false attacks on the overseas Chinese community, unite internal forces, seek external support, etc., in order to successfully host this event. We should strongly support, encourage and applaud such overseas Chinese leaders. We always believe that an event with tradition and meaning, an event that can get support from mainstream society and the Chinese community, an event that is led by the leadership team of the Overseas Chinese Federation and helped by volunteers, can be successfully held.

0c846181ccabead161e7ee593528451096499755.sourceText: 在如下的三个环节中，”清荷步影盈”是泳装秀，”才华蕴智艺”是才艺欣赏；”翔凤凯歌声”不单是皇后加冕，更是对众佳丽的勉励。而在选美其间中还有文艺节目表演和抽奖，奖品也十分丰富。
0c846181ccabead161e7ee593528451096499755.translatedText: In the following three links, "Qing He Ying Ying" is a swimsuit show, "Talent contains wisdom and art" is talent appreciation; "Feng Feng Kai Sing" is not only the coronation of the queen, but also an encouragement to all the beauties. During the beauty pageant, there are also cultural performances and lucky draws, and the prizes are also very rich.

fc2ceefdbf1078cd18425d9505f303df5cde671b.sourceText: 四十多年来，凤凰城华裔小姐选美不同于其它商业选美，侨联在传承我们先辈的优良传统，宏扬中华文化，鼓励下一代的参与和对佳丽培养和学习奉献精神，始终是举办选美的重要因素。欢迎参加观赏今年的国庆和选美，在其中我们还可看到有青少年国庆绘画比赛的优秀作品展出。大家可到下面地点购买入场券，或现场购票，普通票10元，VIP票25元，其票价都已包括了晚餐费。
fc2ceefdbf1078cd18425d9505f303df5cde671b.translatedText: For more than 40 years, the Miss Chinese Phoenix Pageant is different from other commercial beauty pageants. The Overseas Chinese Federation has always been an important factor in holding the pageant in inheriting the fine traditions of our ancestors, promoting Chinese culture, encouraging the participation of the next generation and dedication to the cultivation and learning of beauties. Welcome to attend this year's National Day and beauty pageant, where we can also see the outstanding works of the Youth National Day Painting Competition on display. You can purchase admission tickets at the following location or on-site. Regular tickets are 10 yuan and VIP tickets are 25 yuan. The ticket price includes dinner.

7d2dc0659efdaaeecd143f2fc536abc9d9d9b0ed.sourceText: 在亚利桑那州的沙漠中发现3个疑似非法移民的遗体 边境巡逻人员说，三名涉嫌非法入境者的尸体已在亚利桑那州南部被发现。 有关当局说，这个三个人的死亡可能是因为三位数的沙漠温度。 边境巡逻员说，三个受害者在星期六被发现在不同的事故地点。 位于卡萨格兰德附近的巡逻员说看到一个怀孕的女性坐在她已故的丈夫身边。 已经越过边境两天的危地马拉夫妇，已经被他们的?#34503;头?#25918;弃，当时她的丈夫已经倒下了。 在当天晚些时候，巡逻人员在图森发现他先生一个70多岁的老人遗骸。 上周六晚上巡逻人员在Lukeville西北部，发现一个30多岁赤身裸体男子的一体，从姿势上看是希望脱掉衣物降温。

2bd43c263d7fb8be117adfb9fe0bfa60565b2d7b.sourceText: 高法的裁决是围绕亚利桑那州移民法4条主要规定作出的，其中允许警察盘查怀疑为非法移民者移民地位的条款获得保留。主笔本案判决书的高法法官安东尼-肯尼迪说，因为亚利桑那州尚未将这一条款付诸实践，因此高法无法判定其是否与联邦法律抵触。
2bd43c263d7fb8be117adfb9fe0bfa60565b2d7b.translatedText: 高法的裁决是围绕亚利桑那州移民法4条主要规定作出的，其中允许警察盘查怀疑为非法移民者移民地位的条款获得保留。主笔本案判决书的高法法官安东尼-肯尼迪说，因为亚利桑那州尚未将这一条款付诸实践，因此高法无法判定其是否与联邦法律抵触。

68a0614a6258f554ba414c20fd0f27267c3fdc7d.sourceText: 除此之外，亚利桑那州移民法中遭联邦政府反对的另外3条规定全被高法推翻，它们包括规定在亚利桑那州非法居留触犯州法律；规定非法移民在亚利桑那州工作或找工作触犯州法律；规定警察可以在没有逮捕证的情况下逮捕被怀疑为非法移民者。高法认为，这3条规定都与联邦法律相抵触。理由是，联邦法律已将非法居留定为非法，不用各州再多此一举；国会选择不将非法移民在美工作入罪，各州不能自行其是；是否及何时逮捕非法移民是联邦政府的职权范围，州一级机构不能随意行事。
68a0614a6258f554ba414c20fd0f27267c3fdc7d.translatedText: 除此之外，亚利桑那州移民法中遭联邦政府反对的另外3条规定全被高法推翻，它们包括规定在亚利桑那州非法居留触犯州法律；规定非法移民在亚利桑那州工作或找工作触犯州法律；规定警察可以在没有逮捕证的情况下逮捕被怀疑为非法移民者。 The Supreme Court believes that these three provisions conflict with federal law.理由是，联邦法律已将非法居留定为非法，不用各州再多此一举；国会选择不将非法移民在美工作入罪，各州不能自行其是；是否及何时逮捕非法移民是联邦政府的职权范围，州一级机构不能随意行事。

f81b8e802bd5ab85db285d5b105f42ff2aa3524e.sourceText: 高法在判决书中写道，亚利桑那州对非法移民问题处理感到失望可以理解，但这不代表该州可以施行与联邦法律抵触的地方政策。

097c58da6ac62e9e89f003b9e1bf3e903097c7da.sourceText: 这一判决围绕亚利桑那州2010年4月由州长简-布鲁尔签署的一项打击非法移民法案展开。这一法律获得签署后，联邦政府立刻提出上诉，要求法庭禁止亚利桑那州施行其中许多规定。联邦第九巡回上诉法庭裁决，亚利桑那州不能施行其中4项主要规定，该州就此向最高法院起诉。由于多个州近年出台类似移民法，高法对此案的判决结果可能成为重要判例。此外，由于移民问题备受拉美裔选民关注，此案判决对总统选举选情也具有一定影响。
097c58da6ac62e9e89f003b9e1bf3e903097c7da.translatedText: This ruling revolves around a bill to combat illegal immigration signed by Arizona Governor Jane Brewer in April 2010. Immediately after the law was signed, the federal government filed an appeal asking a court to prohibit Arizona from enforcing many of its provisions. The Ninth Circuit Court of Appeals ruled that Arizona could not enforce four of the main provisions, and the state sued the Supreme Court. Since many states have enacted similar immigration laws in recent years, the Supreme Court’s ruling on this case may become an important precedent. In addition, since the immigration issue has attracted much attention from Hispanic voters, the judgment in this case will also have a certain impact on the presidential election.

f8d4162e98ca5fdec8fb2a1d849ede3bcab086e2.sourceText: 一个裸体女人在亚利桑那沙漠中行走求救死亡 （亚省时报） 马里科帕县警长的官员说，一加州女子被发现在亚利桑那沙漠里死亡。她在车祸后，留下受伤的父母，独立步行几个小时寻求帮助最后死亡。 受害人被确定为清迈博尔​​，37岁，警长的调查人员说。她与她的家人从加州来度假。周五 在10号公路以南半英里和411路处发生碰撞。 ”车内是一对老的越南夫妇和他们30多岁的女儿”玛里科帕县警长办公室发言人杰夫说。 上午6点左右车坠毁后，他们的女儿到沙漠去寻求帮助，两小时后，这对夫妇发现了一名路人于是向他呼救。 ”我们向家长提供了援助。不幸的是，由于语言障碍，当时我们并不了解他们的女儿走出去求救了”杰夫说。直到夫妇俩被带到离事故发生地40公里之外的固特异市西谷医院，通过口译，我们从父母那得到了事情的经过。MCSO才知道他们失踪的女儿，在酷暑里徘徊。”我们猜测她是在阳光下暴晒了8至10小时。”该名女子被发现时已经死了，在距离车祸发生地一英里左右，没有任何衣服。”最好的猜测，因为身体缺少某些元素或者可能在事故发生的伤害，”他说。媒体问，CBS5询问 MCSO当时能否为这对父母找一个翻译，这也许能够挽救女儿的生命，但是发言人 不知道是否有这样的翻译。 MCSO说，这是个没有任何可疑这个死亡。家长预计会没事的。 杰夫说，被滞留在一个地方这样的事情不时发生。他建议说，留些水在车里，带着手机呆在车里是等待营救最好的办法。
f8d4162e98ca5fdec8fb2a1d849ede3bcab086e2.translatedText: 一个裸体女人在亚利桑那沙漠中行走求救死亡 （亚省时报） 马里科帕县警长的官员说，一加州女子被发现在亚利桑那沙漠里死亡。 After a car accident, she left her injured parents behind and walked for several hours to seek help before dying. The victim was identified as Chiang Mai Bol, 37, sheriff's investigators said. She was on vacation from California with her family. Friday about a half mile south of Highway 10 and 411. "Inside the car was an elderly Vietnamese couple and their daughter in their 30s," said Jeff, a spokesman for the Maricopa County Sheriff's Office. After the car crashed around 6 a.m., their daughter went into the desert to seek help. Two hours later, the couple spotted a passerby and called him for help. "We offered assistance to the parents. Unfortunately, due to the language barrier, we didn't understand at the time that their daughter went out and asked for help," Jeff said.直到夫妇俩被带到离事故发生地40公里之外的固特异市西谷医院，通过口译，我们从父母那得到了事情的经过。 MCSO just learned that their missing daughter was wandering in the sweltering heat. ”我们猜测她是在阳光下暴晒了8至10小时。”该名女子被发现时已经死了，在距离车祸发生地一英里左右，没有任何衣服。 "The best guess is that the body is missing some element or the injury may have occurred in the accident," he said.媒体问，CBS5询问 MCSO当时能否为这对父母找一个翻译，这也许能够挽救女儿的生命，但是发言人 不知道是否有这样的翻译。 MCSO says there is nothing suspicious about this death. Parents are expected to be fine. Jeff said being stranded in one place happens from time to time. He suggested that leaving some water in the car and staying in the car with a mobile phone is the best way to wait for rescue.

fa6047e050e9e2a6506d635269a4a8f7aa14cc97.sourceText: 近25年间，美国政府不断出台苛刻移民法，使非法移民在美国生活处境极其危险，最新数据显示，拉美裔移民迅速减少。虽然，美国总统奥巴马15日放松对非法移民的驱逐，向符合条件的非法移民提供工作许可，但这一法案不会根本改变移民在美国的处境，也无法使移民忘却美国政府违背移民精神，对他们造成心里上的疼痛。美国经济复苏缓慢，多数移民选择放弃美国，投奔中国，中国成为移民香饽饽。
fa6047e050e9e2a6506d635269a4a8f7aa14cc97.translatedText: 近25年间，美国政府不断出台苛刻移民法，使非法移民在美国生活处境极其危险，最新数据显示，拉美裔移民迅速减少。虽然，美国总统奥巴马15日放松对非法移民的驱逐，向符合条件的非法移民提供工作许可，但这一法案不会根本改变移民在美国的处境，也无法使移民忘却美国政府违背移民精神，对他们造成心里上的疼痛。 The U.S. economy is recovering slowly, and most immigrants choose to abandon the United States and go to China, making China a popular destination for immigrants.

e2c964d128a8c568fe78b9d51a204b33f38587bf.sourceText: 美国总统奥巴马(Barack Obama)奥巴马15日将放松对非法移民的驱逐，向符合条件的非法移民提供工作许可。根据新方案，16岁以前赴美且未满30岁，并且在美国连续居住5年、正在上学或高中毕业并且没有犯过重罪的非法移民可以申请有效期为两年的工作许可，并可以无限制续期。这一举措更多侧重政治上的考量，能够赢得部分拉美裔选票，但是，并不能够从根本上消除，长期以来历史遗留的移民问题。
e2c964d128a8c568fe78b9d51a204b33f38587bf.translatedText: 美国总统奥巴马(Barack Obama)奥巴马15日将放松对非法移民的驱逐，向符合条件的非法移民提供工作许可。根据新方案，16岁以前赴美且未满30岁，并且在美国连续居住5年、正在上学或高中毕业并且没有犯过重罪的非法移民可以申请有效期为两年的工作许可，并可以无限制续期。这一举措更多侧重政治上的考量，能够赢得部分拉美裔选票，但是，并不能够从根本上消除，长期以来历史遗留的移民问题。

e4bb8d80ec9fad8ff8d2d1fe94978117a504b47d.sourceText: 19世纪末，美国于出现过历史上最大规模的移民浪潮。然而，近25年间，由于美国经济不景气，美政府不断出台苛刻移民法，收紧移民政策，使非法移民在美国生活处境极其危险，限制移民进入美国，对非法移民实施逮捕，扣押，驱逐移民处境。索性留在美国的非法移民生活状况也处于底层，他们凭借微薄的收入，时常面临经营餐馆被关闭、种族歧视等现象。文化上的代沟与认同感不会因为一向移民政策的修改而瞬间消失。
e4bb8d80ec9fad8ff8d2d1fe94978117a504b47d.translatedText: At the end of the 19th century, the United States experienced the largest wave of immigration in history.然而，近25年间，由于美国经济不景气，美政府不断出台苛刻移民法，收紧移民政策，使非法移民在美国生活处境极其危险，限制移民进入美国，对非法移民实施逮捕，扣押，驱逐移民处境。索性留在美国的非法移民生活状况也处于底层，他们凭借微薄的收入，时常面临经营餐馆被关闭、种族歧视等现象。 The cultural generation gap and sense of identity will not disappear instantly just because of changes in immigration policies.

a3a24bd6679060a210d8d627263cb56b7da287ea.sourceText: 奥巴马此前在处理移民政策上，也屡出”杀手锏”。在两年多任期内，奥巴马递解非法移民人数已超过百万，这个数字直逼其前任小布什（George W.Bush）和克林顿（Bill Clinton）两人各自8年创造的”业绩”。基于此，外界曾抨击奥巴马政府是有史以来对非法移民最严苛的一届。
a3a24bd6679060a210d8d627263cb56b7da287ea.translatedText: Obama has repeatedly come up with "trump cards" in dealing with immigration policy.在两年多任期内，奥巴马递解非法移民人数已超过百万，这个数字直逼其前任小布什（George W.Bush）和克林顿（Bill Clinton）两人各自8年创造的”业绩”。 Based on this, the outside world has criticized the Obama administration as the most stringent administration on illegal immigrants in history.

637de997bd49165c884ad4fdec094fede16eeaf9.sourceText: 2011年，联邦政府在递解非法移民问题上的推波助澜，使得各个州”反移民潮”四起。自2010年亚利桑那州通过SB1070移民法后，各州群起而效仿。2011年9月，亚拉巴马州开始执行全美最严苛移民法，其中包括警方可以盘问并逮捕疑似非法移民者，以及学校可要求学生出示出生证明以确定合法身份。面对国内”一刀切”地反非法移民，纽约市10月3日举行公听会，拟立法限制市惩教局与联邦移民及海关执法局（ICE）合作，过分递解移民。
637de997bd49165c884ad4fdec094fede16eeaf9.translatedText: In 2011, the federal government's push to deport illegal immigrants caused an "anti-immigration wave" to spread in various states. Since Arizona passed the SB1070 immigration law in 2010, states have followed suit. 2011年9月，亚拉巴马州开始执行全美最严苛移民法，其中包括警方可以盘问并逮捕疑似非法移民者，以及学校可要求学生出示出生证明以确定合法身份。面对国内”一刀切”地反非法移民，纽约市10月3日举行公听会，拟立法限制市惩教局与联邦移民及海关执法局（ICE）合作，过分递解移民。

af3981328834323c15f95e72cf9e2da424b2e18f.sourceText: 非法移民在美生活状况令人担忧。华人在美财务被抢、被骗、华人餐馆遭遇强制拆的案件仍难以避免。美国有1,200万非法移民，目前，亚裔已经成为了美移民第一种族。这些非法移民在美国从事清洁工、家务、房屋维修、建筑等美国公民不愿意从事的工作。非法移民对美国经济注入新鲜活力，推动了美国经济发展。移民成为支撑美国经济不可替代的力量。
af3981328834323c15f95e72cf9e2da424b2e18f.translatedText: The living conditions of illegal immigrants in the United States are worrying. Cases of Chinese people in the United States having their finances robbed and deceived, and Chinese restaurants being forced to demolish are still unavoidable. There are 12 million illegal immigrants in the United States, and currently, Asians have become the first ethnic group to immigrate to the United States. These illegal immigrants work in the United States as cleaners, housework, home maintenance, construction and other jobs that American citizens are unwilling to do. Illegal immigration has injected fresh vitality into the U.S. economy and promoted its economic development. Immigration has become an irreplaceable force supporting the U.S. economy.

c0d78fa7b3d92458d9f921bcc08102594b11e5e9.sourceText: 美国此前一项调查报告指出，与美国本土劳工相较，有更多的移民处于工作年龄，而且在同一行业中，移民可以从事更多的职位。此外，研究预测未来10年内，在15项有更多就业机会的行业中，估计移民会在其中的8项扮演重要角色。加州移民政策中心20日公布了一些研究数据显示，移民对加州的经济贡献大，更容易成为创业者并为社会创造工作机会，其中洛杉矶县就有50%的创业者是移民，其中有1/3是韩国裔移民，1/4是华裔移民。
c0d78fa7b3d92458d9f921bcc08102594b11e5e9.translatedText: 美国此前一项调查报告指出，与美国本土劳工相较，有更多的移民处于工作年龄，而且在同一行业中，移民可以从事更多的职位。 In addition, the study predicts that immigrants will play an important role in 8 of the 15 industries with more job opportunities in the next 10 years.加州移民政策中心20日公布了一些研究数据显示，移民对加州的经济贡献大，更容易成为创业者并为社会创造工作机会，其中洛杉矶县就有50%的创业者是移民，其中有1/3是韩国裔移民，1/4是华裔移民。

2c722b47f5cc9e5810a0d725dd7e2a4ceae41086.sourceText: 移民是美国经济发展的永动机，是使美国变成最具创新性和最繁荣国家的原因。一方面使技术要求不高的工种的工资保持在低水平，另一方面，也使很多美国公司可以扩大生产规模，使美国企业更具竞争力和影响性。
2c722b47f5cc9e5810a0d725dd7e2a4ceae41086.translatedText: Immigration is the perpetual motion machine of the U.S. economy and is what makes the United States the most innovative and prosperous country.一方面使技术要求不高的工种的工资保持在低水平，另一方面，也使很多美国公司可以扩大生产规模，使美国企业更具竞争力和影响性。

57b99221da6ee4d0253ce2d0507bd7a69d7e7c3c.sourceText: 圣地亚哥加州大学(UCSD)亚太经济中心主任韩森(Gordon Hanson)指出，非法移民满足了美国经济的某些需求。从理论上说，这些工作机会本应留给从外国引进的合法劳工，但合法劳工来美的签证手续繁复缓慢，事实上很难满足需求。如果没有非法移民，某些行业将人手匮缺。至于非法移民加重了美国财政负担的说法，他也表示否定。因为非法移民也缴税，例如，他们所缴的房租包含物业税，他们购物时要缴销售税，有的人更以假身份缴社会安全税。
57b99221da6ee4d0253ce2d0507bd7a69d7e7c3c.translatedText: Gordon Hanson, director of the Asia-Pacific Economic Center at the University of California, San Diego (UCSD), pointed out that illegal immigration meets certain needs of the U.S. economy.从理论上说，这些工作机会本应留给从外国引进的合法劳工，但合法劳工来美的签证手续繁复缓慢，事实上很难满足需求。 Without illegal immigration, certain industries would be short-staffed. As for the argument that illegal immigration has increased the financial burden on the United States, he also denied it.因为非法移民也缴税，例如，他们所缴的房租包含物业税，他们购物时要缴销售税，有的人更以假身份缴社会安全税。

6778873d37f13db70743cefabf5a7bc909664d27.sourceText: 但是，由于美国政府在对待移民问题上，长期采取强势姿态，驱逐非法移民，扭曲美国移民精神，使移民精神变质。非法移民不会威胁美国人的工作，这些非法移民在美国租房、消费，又刺激了美国经济的发展。现在因为美国经济的不景气，美国政客们开始收紧移民政策，完全不顾美国移民精神的本质，完全一刀切反对外来移民。现在，美国经济复苏缓慢，原本打算在美国维持生计并愿意留下的高科技人才，又因为美国政府苛刻的移民政策却从美国熘走。在美生活的华人受到排挤，纷纷开始寻求回中国发展，这一趋势使中国成为了华人的”香饽饽”。

This trend has made China a "hot potato" for the Chinese.

c3eec84f8d144c4a180ecf4ef68a36ccd542740e.sourceText: 一些美国公司担忧，外来移民正在放弃美国。《纽约时报》18日题为”很多美国移民的子女到国外寻找美国梦”的文章称，数代人以前，欠发达国家中很多最优秀的人才流向美国，但现在人才开始回流，特别是越来越多华人等受过高等教育的移民子女离开美国回到故乡。
c3eec84f8d144c4a180ecf4ef68a36ccd542740e.translatedText: Some American companies are worried that immigrants are abandoning the United States. 《纽约时报》18日题为”很多美国移民的子女到国外寻找美国梦”的文章称，数代人以前，欠发达国家中很多最优秀的人才流向美国，但现在人才开始回流，特别是越来越多华人等受过高等教育的移民子女离开美国回到故乡。

53f9f18643e56600946c082b969165b1a82ca099.sourceText: 目前，亚洲裔已经超过拉美裔成为美国第一大移民族群。皮尤研究中心(Pew Center) 新近报告指出，目前亚洲裔在美国的人口数量已经超过1,820万，这使得亚洲裔移民成为了美国境内人口数量最大的群体。很多开始在发展蒸蒸日上的中国寻找机会，人才回流至中国，将使得美国在这一轮人才争夺战中惨败。

4c12b1c2e6f20f2bd6991e16b048dd4561066df1.sourceText: 1986年，美国政府颁布《移民改革与控制法》（Immigration Reform and Control Act ）法律规定禁止雇佣非法移民。此后25年间，除了小布什（George W. Bush）任期内支持”客工计划”，改革移民政策外，美国国会多次加大对非法移民的处罚，阻止非法移民的涌入。美国政客抛弃美国移民精神的本质，完全一刀切反对外来移民。

ffafabc3361f9027487df60c3ddfccb683f47f6e.sourceText: 塞米诺尔县法院已经发布了由乔治 齐默尔曼和他的妻子雪莉在监狱里的 6 个电话录音为证据，雪莉被控伪证罪。雪莉齐默尔曼被指控说谎，谎报夫妇的财政状况，导致较低的保释金为乔治 齐默尔曼保释。 在雪莉齐默尔曼 6 月 12 日听证会上，一些电话录音被释放，她向法院撒谎。 乔治 齐默尔曼是社区看护，二月，他射杀手无寸铁的的少年马丁，声称自卫。他的保释金被被撤销，因为他声称没钱。可是他通过网站 TheRealGeorgeZimmerman.com PayPal 帐户拥有超过 20 万美元。该网站已被撤下。 雪莉齐默尔曼说，她知道这个网站，但不知道有多少钱。检方指控，夫妇彼此谈话中用暗语交流，表明雪莉知道多少钱，在帐户中。 ” 我们的立场是防止被告误导法院” ，根据贝尔纳多， 州检察官办公室人员介绍。 乔治 齐默尔曼， 28 岁， 4 月 11 日被捕，并被控二级谋杀罪。因为 2 月 26 日，他枪杀 17 岁的马丁。乔治 齐默尔曼面临终身监禁和高达 10,000 美 元的罚款。
ffafabc3361f9027487df60c3ddfccb683f47f6e.translatedText: 塞米诺尔县法院已经发布了由乔治 齐默尔曼和他的妻子雪莉在监狱里的 6 个电话录音为证据，雪莉被控伪证罪。 Shirley Zimmerman is accused of lying about the couple's financial situation, resulting in a lower bail for George Zimmerman. During Shirley Zimmerman's June 12 hearing, some phone recordings were released and she lied to the court. George Zimmerman was the community caretaker who claimed self-defense when he shot and killed unarmed teenager Martin in February. His bail was revoked because he claimed he had no money. But he has more than $200,000 through his website TheRealGeorgeZimmerman.com PayPal account. The website has been taken down. Shirley Zimmerman said she knew about the site but didn't know how much money it cost. Prosecutors allege the couple used code words in their conversations to show Shirley knew how much money was in the account. "Our position is to prevent defendants from misleading the court," according to Bernardo, a member of the State Attorney's Office. George Zimmerman, 28, was arrested April 11 and charged with second-degree murder. For the Feb. 26 shooting death of 17-year-old Martin. George Zimmerman faces life in prison and a fine of up to $10,000.

a0c386936dfc9f439b456207ac47ba2897f6e025.sourceText: 911调度员將关注心脏猝停救护 希望抢救心脏猝停的患者，亚利桑那州健康官员已经调整了病人拨打911的救护方案。去年，亚利桑那州卫生服务部推出了新的紧急呼叫调度培训，以帮助​​识别心脏猝停的迹象和旁观人员做心肺复苏的新方法。 医疗部门的紧急医疗服务局和创伤系统主任，本博布罗，表示，该计划的最新举措是努力提高那些患有心脏猝停患者的存活率。 每年全国有38万例心脏猝停患者发病，在亚利桑那州每天大约15例，在全国范围内，成活率为5％到8％。在2004年各州已经实施抢救计划，存活率已提高 ，亚利桑那州的成活率为32％。经过现在的努力，存活率有望更高。 新的调度员培训，包括在现场培训教程和在线教程，强调设施更少，针对更具体的问题，以迅速诊断心跳猝停和激励来电者帮助患者开始心肺复苏。博布罗说，我们的目标是在不到一分钟的时间内开始复苏，在电话打进来后。如果患者没有收到及时的救助，每分钟生存下来的机会就会下降10％。由于心跳猝停多数发生在家庭，朋友和家人是保持病人存活的关键。 ”危险的不是做心肺复苏术是否正确或病人不需要心肺复苏。而是什么也不做”博布罗说。 旁观者被要求开始帮助患者胸部按压心肺复苏术，代替了传统的形式：混合按压，以及人工呼吸。 博布罗说，新的方案，消除不必要的问题，并鼓励人们突破传统人工呼吸带来的不适。 ”这些很微妙的小改变就意味着生存或死亡.”博布罗说。 资料仍在收集，但博布罗估计已有很多患者的生命被这个新计划保存下来。一些调度中心从通话到开始复苏的时间减少50％，以前平均是两分钟。 琳威斯克 ，梅萨区域调度中心的调度说，自11月实施的新系统，中心从接听电话到开始复苏的平均时间下降到一分钟。 注重胸外按压是很及时的的照顾。与旧的心肺复苏相比，由医护人员赶到时，胸外按压往往还没有开始。 ”这个新项目好就好在，我们可以做一些帮助，在救护人员到达之前，该计划实行的第一个月，梅萨挽救了八条性命。”琳威斯克说。她的中心的目标是挽救75％的心脏猝停患者。克里斯，是农村/地铁消防处，其中包括在马里科帕，皮马，皮纳尔和尤马县社区的紧急调度，克里斯说，在过去的三个星期，他看到该计划有助于急救成功率提高了三倍， 杰夫宁斯，在的塞多纳火区的交通中心的主管，说他的部门已经做了20年了类似的电话辅助心肺复苏项目。 他说，由于农村部门的设置 – 它涵盖了在翠峰山谷11个社区 – 这样一个方案是非常有必要的，他能挽救人的生命。这项新的救助措施，不仅仅是卫生部门的持续努力的一部分，去减少心脏猝停死亡人数，更是亚利桑那州注册和教育，以及百姓共同分享的急救方案。因为2004年亚利桑那州的心脏猝停的存活率仅为3%。 该计划旨在鼓励旁观者的反应，并通过宣传和培训规范应急响应和住院治疗系统治疗。 通过共享计划自2004年以来，已有超过900个生命被挽救。

In 2004, states have implemented rescue programs and survival rates have improved, with Arizona's survival rate being 32%. With current efforts, the survival rate is expected to be even higher. 新的调度员培训，包括在现场培训教程和在线教程，强调设施更少，针对更具体的问题，以迅速诊断心跳猝停和激励来电者帮助患者开始心肺复苏。 The goal is to start resuscitation in less than a minute after the call comes in, Bobrow said. If a patient does not receive timely assistance, the chance of survival drops by 10% every minute. Since sudden cardiac arrest occurs most often in families, friends and family are key to keeping the patient alive. "The danger is not whether CPR is done correctly or that the patient doesn't need CPR. It's not doing anything," Bobrow said. Bystanders are asked to begin CPR to help the patient with chest compressions, replacing the traditional form: a mix of compressions, and rescue breathing. Bobro said the new program eliminates unnecessary problems and encourages people to break through the discomfort caused by traditional artificial respiration. "These are subtle little changes that can mean life or death," Bobrow said. Data is still being collected, but Bobrow estimates that many patients' lives have been saved by the new program. Some dispatch centers have reduced the time from call to resuscitation by 50%, which previously averaged two minutes. 琳威斯克 ，梅萨区域调度中心的调度说，自11月实施的新系统，中心从接听电话到开始复苏的平均时间下降到一分钟。 Paying attention to chest compression is very timely care. The program is designed to encourage bystander response and standardize emergency response and residential treatment systems through advocacy and training. More than 900 lives have been saved through the Share program since 2004.

64c8662b1a68d29f61b79c05ab68337efcc07b0a.sourceText: 新兴经济体一直以来要求在包括国际货币基金组织在内的国际机构中获得更多话语权，以体现它们与日俱增的影响力。由巴西、俄罗斯、印度、中国和南非组成的”金砖五国”(BRICs) 代表全球43%的人口和大约18%的经济产量；这些国家的外汇储备总量为4万亿美元，其中中国掌握最大的份额。
