252f163ca69b275b04dd84f0520d8b896b6196e9.sourceText: 面积达100万平方英尺的数据中心落户钱德勒 为了满足西岸大公司对信息技术的要求，美国休斯顿的 CyrusOne 公司周三表示要在亚利桑那钱德勒兴建面积达100万平方英尺的数据中心。这将是大凤凰城最大的数据中心,也是全美第二大信息中心，仅次于芝加哥湖区面积110万平方英尺的数据中心。近10万平方英尺的多样化办公空间的投资，这是经济危机之后，凤凰城地区写字楼投资的重大突破。 这个项目分为三期建设，第一阶段将于2013年完成，公司没有公布该项目的成本，首席技术主管凯文-蒂蒙斯说，这会是一个”大规模，模块化”的全新设计。同时他还强调CyrusOne 公司有大量的忠实客户，无论CyrusOne 公司走到哪里，他们都会跟到哪里。这个中心将会雇用50位技术管理人员。然而这个信息中心为当地带来的影响远远不仅如此，他将会带入大量的网络管理和托管用户进入该地区。数据中心还将配备一个110兆瓦的变电站，这也是凤凰城最大的变电站之一，也是美国现有的专用变电站。 去年十月份数据中心市场分析报告显示，信息系统的需求者都会涌向凤凰城，因为这里的预期很好，其中最重要的原因有三点，稳定的电力和电网，低的实际经营费用，低的房地产成本。最大的缺点也许是空调成本，开发商已经开始制定非常经济的解决方式和并购买设施，来处理这个问题。更多有关亚利桑那房地产投资开发的信息，请谘询金信地产的Tinna(480)287-0180 E-mail: Goldtrustrealty2010@gmail.com
252f163ca69b275b04dd84f0520d8b896b6196e9.translatedText: A data center with an area of 1 million square feet is located in Chandler. In order to meet the requirements of large companies on the West Coast for information technology, CyrusOne in Houston, USA... The company said Wednesday it will build a 1 million-square-foot data center in Chandler, Arizona. It will be the largest data center in the greater Phoenix area and the second-largest information center in the United States, second only to the 1.1 million-square-foot data center in Chicago's Lake District. The investment of nearly 100,000 square feet of diverse office space is a major breakthrough for office investment in the Phoenix area following the economic crisis. The project is divided into three phases. The first phase will be completed in 2013. The company has not disclosed the cost of the project. Chief technical director Kevin Timmons said it will be a "large-scale, modular" new design. At the same time, he also emphasized that CyrusOne has a large number of loyal customers, and they will follow wherever CyrusOne goes. The center will employ 50 technical and managerial staff. However, the impact of this information center on the local area goes far beyond that. It will bring a large number of network management and hosting users into the area. The data center will also be equipped with a 110-megawatt substation, one of the largest in Phoenix and an existing dedicated substation in the United States. The data center market analysis report last October showed that demanders of information systems will flock to Phoenix because the expectations here are very good. The most important reasons are three points: stable power and power grid, low actual operating expenses, and low real estate costs. Perhaps the biggest drawback is the cost of air conditioning, and developers have begun to develop very economical solutions and purchase facilities to deal with this problem. 963ae5fcc1700a296a345453387a1309ce41bb1c.sourceText: 桑福劳尔（Sunflower)的山火已经殃及12000亩 桑福劳尔（Sunflower），亚利桑那州 – 上周六，火勢开始缓慢蔓延，目前已經殃及12000亩。 超过30英里的阵风還在加大桑福咯爾市的火勢，當地消防隊員都與高溫乾燥以及几乎是不可能的控制的地形進行鬥爭。官員表示, 火繼續吞噬未燃烧的燃料，无论是已經燃燒的區域，還是它以外的北部和西部。着火面积占7％，保持在遏制线内。 Beeline高速公路和附近的电线仍然受保护，佩森一直到北也安全，虽然燃烧的灰下降到镇上，根据当天早些时候的报道。 400余人已到事故现场，通过Tonto国家森林组织帮助灭火。这些人员是来自亚利桑那州和新墨西哥州，以及加利福尼亚州，犹他州，爱达荷州，蒙大拿州，得克萨斯州和俄勒冈州。资源被均匀的分配于空中和地面。 ”我们肯定有很多在地面上的人员”公共信息官黛比水芹说。”有几个引擎，沿着这些土路驻扎在不同点，在那里他们可以获取资源”。 火已经达到2004年的Willow消防北线。当它完全达到这个老火线的时候，大火就会延缓进展。这是一个很难看懂的东西，甚至对这一流域的老居民。”我已经做了很多后援准备在Mazatzals市”梅萨居民史蒂夫Sowards说。他看着火从山顶上烧过来。”山路没有得到很好的修剪，所以我一点不羡慕的消防队员，他们呆在非常脏乱的环境里，这个环境将需要很长的时间恢复。” 风预计下周三稍微平静。桑福咯爾的山火正在凤凰城东北80英里燃烧。
963ae5fcc1700a296a345453387a1309ce41bb1c.translatedText: The wildfire in Sunflower has affected 12,000 acres SUNFLOWER, Ariz. – The fire started spreading slowly on Saturday and has now affected 12,000 acres. Wind gusts of more than 30 miles per hour continued to fuel the fires in the city of Sanfurore, where firefighters battled hot, dry conditions and terrain that was nearly impossible to control. Officials said the fire continues to devour unburned fuel, both in areas already burning and beyond it to the north and west. The fire area accounted for 7% and remained within the containment line. The Beeline Highway and nearby power lines remained protected, and Payson was safe all the way north, although burning ash fell into the town, according to reports earlier in the day. More than 400 people have arrived at the scene of the accident to help put out the fire through the Tonto National Forest Organization. The personnel are from Arizona and New Mexico, as well as California, Utah, Idaho, Montana, Texas and Oregon. Resources are evenly distributed in the air and on the ground. "We definitely have a lot of personnel on the ground," said Public Information Officer Debbie Cress. "There are several engines stationed at various points along these dirt roads where they can access resources." The fire had reached the Willow Fire Protection North Line in 2004. When it fully reaches this old fire line, the fire slows progress. This is something difficult to understand, even for older residents of the basin. "I've been doing a lot of backup preparation in the city of Mazatzals," said Mesa resident Steve Sowards. He watched the fire coming from the top of the mountain. "The mountain roads are not well mowed, so I don't envy the firefighters at all, they stay in a very dirty environment and this environment will take a long time to recover." Winds are expected to calm down slightly next Wednesday. The Sanford Fire is burning 80 miles northeast of Phoenix.

06e2cc0d2bb973f4d46556bc50922c8ab99c5d54.sourceText: 一名25岁的北凤凰城居民上週五凌晨被捕，原因是他勐烈摇晃他3个月大的儿子，至婴儿脑部受严重伤害。 警方说，凤凰消防处在周四晚11点接到报桉，说有婴儿受伤。医护人员到场将伤者送医。医院官员在周五凌晨通知警方，婴儿有受虐迹象。医院发言人说，至週五下午，男婴病情仍然危殆。 凤凰警方发言人说，男婴的父亲尚恩在追问下承认，因男婴在商店哭闹而生气，他当着孩子的母亲和祖母的面，将婴儿用力摇晃数下。 尚恩被带到马利科巴郡监狱，将以虐待儿童罪名起诉。 医生提醒父母，新生儿一般轻轻摇晃不会造成生命危险，用力过勐可能产生颈椎脱位，导致呼吸暂停，引起死亡。另外，婴儿的大脑组织尚未发育完全，容易受到外力而晃动，严重者可使脑内组织受到伤害。
06e2cc0d2bb973f4d46556bc50922c8ab99c5d54.translatedText: A 25-year-old North Phoenix resident was arrested early Friday morning after he violently shook his 3-month-old son, causing the baby to suffer severe brain damage. Police said the Phoenix Fire Department received a report of an injured infant at 11 p.m. Thursday. Paramedics arrived at the scene and took the injured to hospital. Hospital officials notified police early Friday morning that the baby showed signs of abuse. A hospital spokesman said the baby boy remained in critical condition as of Friday afternoon. A spokesman for the Phoenix police said that the baby boy's father, Sean, admitted under questioning that he was angry because the baby boy was crying in the store. He shook the baby vigorously several times in front of the child's mother and grandmother. Shane was taken to the Maricopa County Jail to be charged with child abuse. Doctors remind parents that shaking a newborn baby generally will not cause life-threatening injuries. Excessive force may cause cervical dislocation, leading to apnea and death. In addition, the baby's brain tissue is not fully developed and is easily shaken by external forces. In severe cases, the brain tissue may be damaged.

290e89627372c8034d1485d8ab79e61e827980b9.sourceText: 本州三家州立大学决定在秋季上涨学费，将于本週三分别在凤凰城、图森、旗杆、尤马和谢拉维斯塔举办听证会，听取学生意见。 据悉，UA将针对州内本科新生和研究生学费上涨2.7%，州外本科生和研究生上涨2.9%。 NAU的学费分类有点细緻，州内本科新生上涨5%，州外本科新生涨2%，本地研究生涨5%，非本地研究生涨3%。 ASU则对州内学生和州外学生一视同仁，不论本科生、研究生，一律上涨3%。 亚利桑那州大学委员会将于4月5日表决通过上述涨费方案。
290e89627372c8034d1485d8ab79e61e827980b9.translatedText: Three state universities in the state have decided to raise tuition in the fall and will hold hearings on Wednesday in Phoenix, Tucson, Flagstaff, Yuma and Sierra Vista to hear student feedback. It is reported that UA will increase tuition for in-state undergraduate freshmen and graduate students by 2.7% and out-of-state undergraduate and graduate students by 2.9%. NAU's tuition fees are somewhat detailed. In-state undergraduate students will increase by 5%, out-of-state undergraduate students will increase by 2%, local graduate students will increase by 5%, and non-local graduate students will increase by 3%. ASU treats in-state and out-of-state students equally, with a 3% increase for both undergraduate and graduate students. The Arizona College Board will vote to approve the above fee increase plan on April 5.

2b2373fb235fbca6dfa8bcb7dd8150809dd2ac1a.sourceText: 1. 参加对象及组队方式 （一）年满18-35岁之国内及海外华裔青年，皆可报名参加。 （二）3至7人自行组成一队（成员以跨领域者为佳），以团队方式向本会报名；为增进提案品质，应自行洽妥学者专家担任业师（此为必要条件，业师不 受年龄限制），提供团队咨询指导。 2.竞赛主题：以「活力经济」、「公义社会」、「优质文教」、「永续环境」及「全面建设」等五项国家建设愿景为范围；团队应对提案主题搜集议题背景、相关 主管部会现行政策等资讯，并充分分析讨论，提出解决对策，俾使提案深入务实 3. 受理提案时间：自101年2月1日起至5月31日止。 4.本活动相关讯息可参阅行政院青年辅导委员会青年政策大联盟网站(http://youthhub.tw/ypu)。
2b2373fb235fbca6dfa8bcb7dd8150809dd2ac1a.translatedText: 1. Participants and team formation methods (1) Domestic and overseas Chinese youth aged 18-35 can sign up to participate. (2) Form a team of 3 to 7 people (the members are preferably those from across fields) and register with the Association as a team; in order to improve the quality of the proposal, you should arrange for scholars and experts to serve as practitioners (this is a necessary condition, and practitioners are not subject to age restrictions) to provide team consultation and guidance. 2. Competition theme: Based on the five national construction visions of "dynamic economy", "just society", "quality culture and education", "sustainable environment" and "comprehensive construction"; the team should collect information on the background of the issue, current policies of relevant competent ministries and other information on the proposal theme, and fully analyze and discuss, propose solutions, so that the proposal can be in-depth and practical. 3. Time for accepting proposals: from February 1 to May 31, 2019. 4. Information related to this event can be found on the Youth Policy Alliance website of the Youth Advisory Council of the Executive Yuan (http://youthhub.tw/ypu).

25f4e84e5bf2f4d72086153b5ed3dfe4b99dfdb9.sourceText: 去年，我回中国参加了低价的江南游，今年回国又恰逢美西侨报登出洛杉磯旅行社推出99美元云南七日游的项目， 引起了我极大的兴趣。云南，是我八岁前生活过的地方。我在那个偏僻的山区渡过了童年，留下了许多难以忘怀的记忆。不知為什麼，我对这片土地一直有着那样一种割舍不开的感情。 我的这次旅行上午十点从苏州出发，乘城际高铁约30分鐘抵达上海虹桥机场。高铁站和机场入口是连在一起的。十二点起飞，下午三点半就到了昆明春水机场。整个旅程只用了五个小时。舒适又快捷的行程使我联想起幼年时代的昆明之行。 1938年，那是日本侵略者在中国土地上横行霸道的时代，中国政府已经迁都重庆。许多爱国青年不愿过亡国奴的日子，跟随政府撤退到后方坚持抗战。我的父亲就是跟随当时国民党资源委员会的一批爱国人士到云南去开发了明良煤矿，支援抗战。在我父亲到达了目的地后，日本鬼子已经阻断了陆路，我母亲只得带着刚学会走路的我经海路乘船到香港，再从越南海防经滇越铁路，辗转周折到了昆明，实现了家庭团聚。这决不是一般意义上的旅行，是逃难。在国破家亡的年代，人们為了求得生存的希望，背着大包小包，挤坐在充满着臭味的船舱裡，还要时刻提防着鬼子飞机的轰炸，用了近一个月的时间才走完了这段旅途。也有一些同胞没有到达目的地就失去了生命。我那时还不记事，只是依偎在妈妈的怀抱裡，睁大着眼睛看著这发生的一切。这都是妈妈告诉我的故事，还留下这张护照用过的照片见证这苦难的旅程。
25f4e84e5bf2f4d72086153b5ed3dfe4b99dfdb9.translatedText: Last year, I went back to China to take part in a low-priced tour to the south of the Yangtze River. When I returned to China this year, the American Overseas Chinese Newspaper published an article in the Los Angeles Travel Agency launching a seven-day tour of Yunnan for US$99, which aroused my great interest. Yunnan is the place where I lived before I was eight years old. I spent my childhood in that remote mountainous area and have many unforgettable memories. I don't know why, I have always had such an inseparable feeling for this land. My trip departed from Suzhou at 10 a.m. and took the intercity high-speed rail to Shanghai Hongqiao Airport in about 30 minutes. The high-speed rail station and the airport entrance are connected together. It took off at 12 o'clock and arrived at Kunming Chunshui Airport at 3:30 in the afternoon. The whole journey took only five hours. The comfortable and fast trip reminded me of my childhood trip to Kunming. In 1938, it was an era when Japanese invaders were tyrannical on Chinese soil. The Chinese government had moved its capital to Chongqing. Many patriotic young people did not want to live the life of subjugated slaves and followed the government to retreat to the rear to persist in the war of resistance. My father followed a group of patriots from the Kuomintang Resources Committee to Yunnan to develop the Mingliang Coal Mine and support the Anti-Japanese War. After my father arrived at his destination, the Japanese had blocked the land route, so my mother had to take me, who had just learned to walk, by sea to Hong Kong, and then from Vietnam's Haiphong via the Yunnan-Vietnam Railway to Kunming, where our family was reunited. This is by no means a journey in the ordinary sense, but an escape. In an era when the country was ruined and the family was destroyed, in order to survive, people carried large and small bags on their backs, crowded into smelly cabins, and were always on guard against bombings from Japanese planes. It took nearly a month to complete the journey. Some compatriots also lost their lives before reaching their destination. I didn’t remember anything at the time, I just snuggled in my mother’s arms and watched everything that happened with my eyes wide open. These are the stories my mother told me, and she also left this used passport photo to bear witness to this painful journey.

df62b9aecf72b65e20c75a18cd9b49c66fcf401c.sourceText: 1945年，抗日战争胜利，小日本鬼子投降了。人们欢欣鼓舞，离别了家乡八年的人们都想着早日回乡与家人团聚。那时坐飞机的人还很少，极少数有钱的，当大官的坐上飞机回了南京，上海；大部分人只能筹划盘缠，从陆路回家。那时云南还没有铁路通往国内，通过公路返乡是唯一的选择。于是父母带着我走上了回家的旅途。那时的我已经八岁，读完了四年级，有了完整的记忆。我们从昆明出发，先坐汽车经贵州到湖南长沙，这是一条险途。三十多人坐在一个带篷的大卡车裡，卡车是靠烧木炭驱动的，每天早上副司机要提前起来点火，九点才能发车，下午四点左右一定要住下来，因為当时贵州土匪十分猖獗，黑天行车十分危险。后来我曾有一次去贵州招工，和当地的青年谈起他们的家史，才知道他们几乎每家都与土匪有关系，由此可见一斑。加上贵州尽是山路，老爷车时速十多公里，不时大家还要一起下来推车。就这样平均一天一个山头，大约走了20天，终於到了长沙。从长沙转乘拖轮，也就是用机器船拖着几个木船穿越洞庭湖走了五天，再由武汉坐大一点的江轮到南京，从南京乘火车回到上海。我们原本过了元旦从昆明出发，计划赶回上海过个团圆年，结果船过安庆已是大年初一了，整个旅程用了一个多月。这是一段艰幸的旅程，但心情一直是阳光的，因為打走了日本鬼子，我们是战胜国的公民。 日本佔领时期苦难的旅程，抗战胜利时那艰辛的旅程和这次轻鬆愉快的旅程形成了鲜明的对比。不论国共内战和不断的政治运动给人们带来了多少伤害，科学技术的进步和社会的发展是不可阻挡的，七十年来我们的国家确实有了翻天覆地的变化。飞机降落在刚建成不久的春水国际机场，机场规模在中国名列第四，我下飞机到出口走了半个小时。我不喜欢这个机场，因為它太大，太新，感觉空盪盪的，离市区也太远，更重要的是我爱巫家坝。昆明机场一直以巫家坝机场而闻名，那是在法国人帮助下1922年建成的，在抗日战争时期，陈纳德将军领导的飞虎队的司令部和主要基地就设在这裡。多少抗日英雄在这裡生活和工作过，多少英雄故事在这裡传颂。巫家坝机场和当时开闢的驼峰航线在抗日战争后期曾作出了重要贡献。巫家坝，多麼动听的名字，在我再度来看望您的时候，您居然以九十岁的高龄退休了。
df62b9aecf72b65e20c75a18cd9b49c66fcf401c.translatedText: In 1945, the Anti-Japanese War was victorious and the little Japanese surrendered. People were happy and excited. People who had been away from their hometown for eight years wanted to return home and reunite with their families as soon as possible. At that time, there were very few people flying, and a very small number of wealthy people who were high-ranking officials got on the plane and returned to Nanjing and Shanghai; most people could only plan to travel home by land. At that time, there was no railway from Yunnan to the country, so returning home by road was the only option. So my parents took me on the journey home. I was eight years old at that time, had finished fourth grade, and had a complete memory. We started from Kunming and first took a bus through Guizhou to Changsha, Hunan. This was a dangerous journey. More than thirty people sat in a large covered truck. The truck was driven by burning charcoal. Every morning, the co-driver had to get up early to light the ignition. The truck could not start until nine o'clock. He had to stay at about four o'clock in the afternoon because bandits were very rampant in Guizhou at that time and driving in the dark was very dangerous. Later, I once went to Guizhou to recruit workers and talked with local young people about their family history, and I learned that almost every family was related to bandits, which is evident from this. In addition, Guizhou is full of mountain roads, and the speed of classic cars is more than ten kilometers per hour. From time to time, everyone has to get out together to push the cars. In this way, we averaged one hilltop a day, and after walking for about 20 days, we finally arrived in Changsha. From Changsha, I transferred to a tugboat, which meant using a robotic boat to drag several wooden boats across Dongting Lake for five days. Then I took a larger riverboat from Wuhan to Nanjing, and from Nanjing I took a train back to Shanghai. We originally set off from Kunming after New Year's Day and planned to rush back to Shanghai to celebrate the New Year. However, it turned out that it was already the first day of the Lunar New Year when the ship passed Anqing, and the whole journey took more than a month. This is a difficult journey, but the mood is always sunny, because the Japanese devils have been defeated, and we are citizens of the victorious country. The painful journey during the Japanese occupation, the arduous journey during the victory of the Anti-Japanese War, and this relaxed and happy journey formed a sharp contrast. No matter how much harm the civil war between the Kuomintang and the Communist Party of China and the constant political movements have caused to people, the progress of science and technology and the development of society are unstoppable. Our country has indeed undergone earth-shaking changes in the past seventy years. The plane landed at the newly built Chunshui International Airport, the fourth largest airport in China. I got off the plane and walked to the exit for half an hour. I don't like this airport because it's too big, too new, feels empty, and too far from the city. More importantly, I love Wujiaba. Kunming Airport has always been known as Wujiaba Airport, which was built in 1922 with the help of the French. During the Anti-Japanese War, the headquarters and main base of the Flying Tigers led by General Chennault were located here. How many anti-Japanese heroes have lived and worked here, and how many heroic stories have been told here. Wujiaba Airport and the hump route opened at that time made important contributions in the late Anti-Japanese War. Wujiaba, what a beautiful name, when I came to visit you again, you actually retired at the age of ninety.

5d6d237a88a8ec3b8f7a4c38dda40ab825a26098.sourceText: 中华函授学校2012学年招生开始 中华函授学校2012学年招生开始 将推动多项变革并鼓励网路修课 为扩大中华函授学校提供终身学习服务之深度及广度，侨务委员会自2012学年起与以远距教学著称之国立中正大学合作推展函校校务工作，藉由中正大学优质多元的师资阵容及专业行政团队 ，开发新课程与办理校务，让中华函授学校学员享受到更即时的学习、更多元的资讯与更便捷的服务。 配合2012学年到来，中华函授学校自即日起接受报名，截止日期为2012年3月15日。 为使校务运作更具效能，中华函授学校于新学年将推动多项变革，其中学生修业时间将调整为4月至10月，12月底前完成结业工作，使招生、修课及结业可于一 年内完成。 另鉴于近年数位学习已逐渐成为趋势，为鼓励函校学员利用网路修课，美国、加拿大、欧洲、澳洲及纽西兰等地区将试办仅能选择网路修课，不再提供函授讲义 ；其余地区则维持目前函授及网路双轨选读服务。 同时，在新的学年也将强化「中华函授学校远距教学网站」功能，增加线上同步及非同步之学习社群经营，使学员得以透过网路连结与知识分享。 在学员管理方面，针对函授修课者，将增加近3年每年皆逾二分之一(含)以上课程未结业者，不予录取之规定；有关修课课程数，原受学员诟病限选读2 门学科4种课程的规定，将改为不限学科、最多4种课程，让选课更为弹性。 函校于2012学年将赓续提供「华文教师科」、「华语文应用科」、「文史艺术科」、「农工科、「商业及管理科」、「家庭与儿童科」、「餐饮科」 、「电脑资讯科」、「中小学进修科」等9门学科、79种课程供学员选读，欢迎大家把握良机，将此讯息周知亲朋好友，共同加入函校终身学习的行列。 有意选读课程的侨胞可径至本校网站（从侨务委员会网站（www.ocac.gov.tw）或全球华文网（www.huayuworld.org）进入）详阅招生简章及课程一览表，直接办理线上报名或 下载报名表件，或向橙县华侨文教服务中心714-754-9999洽取报名表件。 本校新地址：台湾嘉义县民雄乡三兴村大学路168号(教育学院2馆338室) ；服务专线：886-5-2720411，分机17105 或17107；电子信箱：chcs@ccu.edu.tw。
5d6d237a88a8ec3b8f7a4c38dda40ab825a26098.translatedText: Chung Hwa Correspondence School has begun enrollment for the 2012 academic year. Chung Hwa Correspondence School has begun enrollment for the 2012 academic year. It will promote many changes and encourage online courses. In order to expand the depth and breadth of lifelong learning services provided by Chung Hwa Correspondence School, the Overseas Chinese Affairs Council has cooperated with National Chung Cheng University, which is famous for distance teaching, to promote correspondence school affairs since the 2012 academic year. With Chung Cheng University’s high-quality and diverse faculty and professional administrative team , develop new courses and handle school affairs, so that students of Chung Hwa Correspondence School can enjoy more real-time learning, more diverse information and more convenient services. In conjunction with the arrival of the 2012 school year, Chung Hwa Correspondence School is accepting registration from now on, and the deadline is March 15, 2012. In order to make school operations more efficient, Chung Hwa Correspondence School will promote a number of changes in the new school year. Among them, the study period for students will be adjusted from April to October, and the completion work will be completed by the end of December, so that enrollment, course taking, and graduation can be completed within one year. In addition, in view of the fact that digital learning has gradually become a trend in recent years, in order to encourage correspondence school students to take courses online, the United States, Canada, Europe, Australia, New Zealand and other regions will pilot only online courses and will no longer provide correspondence lectures; other regions will maintain the current dual-track correspondence and online courses. At the same time, in the new school year, the functions of the "Chinese Correspondence School Distance Learning Website" will also be strengthened, and online synchronous and asynchronous learning community management will be added, so that students can share knowledge through Internet links. In terms of student management, for those who take correspondence courses, there will be an increase in the requirement that those who have not completed more than half (inclusive) of the courses in each of the past three years will not be admitted; regarding the number of courses, the original limit of 2 subjects and 4 types of courses, which was criticized by students, will be changed to no limit on subjects and a maximum of 4 types of courses, making course selection more flexible. In the 2012 school year, the correspondence school will continue to offer 9 subjects and 79 courses for students to choose from, including "Chinese Teachers' Course", "Chinese Applied Course", "Literature, History and Art", "Agricultural and Engineering Course", "Business and Management Course", "Family and Children's Course", "Catering Course", "Computer Information Course", and "Primary and Secondary School Continuing Education Course". You are welcome to seize this opportunity, inform your relatives and friends, and join the ranks of lifelong learning in the correspondence school. Overseas Chinese who are interested in choosing courses can go to the school's website (accessed from the Overseas Chinese Affairs Commission website (www.ocac.gov.tw) or the Global Chinese Language Network (www.huayuworld.org)) to read the admission brochure and course list, apply online directly or download the application form, or contact the Orange County Overseas Chinese Cultural and Educational Service Center at 714-754-9999 to obtain the application form. The new address of our school: No. 168, Daxue Road, Sanxing Village, Minxiong Township, Chiayi County, Taiwan (Room 338, Building 2, College of Education); service hotline: 886-5-2720411, extension 17105 or 17107; email: chcs@ccu.edu.tw.

3a9674094b21b062b4d5c41522afe618c2020f00.sourceText: 根据高力国际在凤凰城的最新数字，今年上半年的住房价格反弹和房屋的低库存推动了凤凰城地区的土地收购，比去年同期价格高了59％。 今年中期报告表明，大凤凰城市区土地收购，在今年上半年出现了多个高得很多的投标价格，其中一些与去年同期相比平均价格飙升了80％。 根据该报告，今年打算销售的土地中约70％已经销售- 约150宗交易，土地面积约3.2万英亩?都将作住宅发展。 三年前，所有凤凰城地区的土地交易作住宅用途的面积都低于55%。 今年施工许可证的数量一直在增加。 例如，市区的近3,800独立屋在第二季度授予了许可证，比上一季度激增51%，比去年同期激增83％。 高力国际预计，到今年年底，总数超过15,000独立屋已发出施工许可证，这将是自2007年以来最大的数字。 多户项目的施工许可证（公寓连体屋），预计也类似的速度增长。 预计将在今年年底，有2000和2500个多户项目的施工许可证发行。 与去年相比，有40％左右回升，是2010年数字的两倍。 更多有关房地产的信息请咨询金信地产的Tinna(480)287-0180 E-mail:Goldtrustrealty2010@gmail.com。
3a9674094b21b062b4d5c41522afe618c2020f00.translatedText: A rebound in home prices and low inventory of homes in the first half of the year drove Phoenix-area land acquisitions, with prices 59% higher than the same period last year, according to Colliers International's latest numbers in Phoenix. This year’s interim report shows that land acquisitions in the greater Phoenix area saw multiple much higher bid prices in the first half of this year, with some averaging prices soaring by 80% compared to the same period last year. According to the report, about 70% of the land intended for sale this year has already been sold - about 150 transactions and about 32,000 acres - all destined for residential development. Three years ago, less than 55 percent of all Phoenix-area land transactions were for residential use. The number of construction permits has been increasing this year. For example, nearly 3,800 single-family homes in the urban area were granted permits in the second quarter, a 51% surge from the previous quarter and an 83% surge from the same period last year. Colliers International expects a total of more than 15,000 detached homes to have been issued construction permits by the end of the year, which would be the largest number since 2007. Construction permits for multifamily projects (apartment duplexes) are expected to grow at a similar rate. Construction permits are expected to be issued for 2,000 and 2,500 multifamily projects by the end of the year. Compared with last year, there is a rebound of about 40%, which is double the figure in 2010. 02f1283bc8116d79686452ea84828b98ad2d8c6c.sourceText: 本报前总编辑余蔼蓉，广东省开平县人氏，一九三六年二月十六日生于台山县里边，在中国从事人民教师工作三十三年，一九八八年移民来美，一九九零年参与在当地创建中文报业直至积劳成疾，久治不愈，至九月十三日晨在医院抢救无效，不幸辞世，享积闰寿七十八岁。谨定于九月十八日星期日上午九时至十时在绿木殡仪馆（Greenwood Memory Lawn，2300 W Van Buren Ave, Phoenix）举行瞻仰仪容，上午十时半举行追悼会，随即安葬华人绿木墓园，礼成在六福大酒家设备素餐招待亲戚朋友。忝属戚友世谊哀此讣闻。
02f1283bc8116d79686452ea84828b98ad2d8c6c.translatedText: Yu Airong, the former editor-in-chief of this newspaper, is from Kaiping County, Guangdong Province. He was born in Taishan County on February 16, 1936. He is engaged in human affairs in China. He worked as a teacher for thirty-three years and immigrated to the United States in 1988. In 1990, he participated in the establishment of a local Chinese newspaper industry until he became ill due to overwork and could not be cured. On the morning of September 13th, he was unable to save his life in the hospital. Unfortunately, he passed away at the age of 78. A viewing ceremony will be held at Greenwood Memory Lawn (2300 W Van Buren Ave, Phoenix) on Sunday, September 18, from 9 to 10 a.m. A memorial service will be held at 10:30 a.m., followed by burial at Greenwood Chinese Cemetery, and a vegetarian meal will be served at Luk Fook Restaurant to entertain relatives and friends. My relatives and friends mourn this obituary.

9fb2c022014c8910ac8715b084a8d05a34fc136c.sourceText: 中新社华盛顿1月24日电 (记者 吴庆才 德永健)美国总统奥巴马在24日晚发表的任内第三份国情咨文中五次提到中国，与前两份国情咨文相比，奥巴马提及中国的次数逐年上升，口气也发生明显变化，其中对华贸易态度明显趋于强硬，但有关措辞却第一时间遭到在华有生意的美国商界领袖的反驳。
9fb2c022014c8910ac8715b084a8d05a34fc136c.translatedText: China News Service, Washington, January 24 (Reporters Wu Qingcai and Tok Yongjian) U.S. President Obama mentioned China five times in his third State of the Union Address delivered on the evening of the 24th. Compared with the previous two State of the Union Addresses, the number of times Obama mentioned China has increased year by year, and his tone has also changed significantly. His attitude towards China's trade has obviously become tougher. However, the relevant words were immediately refuted by American business leaders who have business in China.

2d96eb0d8a03b95a8e6da7fce96f0f6092ee2d6f.sourceText: 奥巴马当晚黄金时间遵循传统向国会发表国情咨文，这是他本届任期内第三份也是最后一份国情咨文。在连续三份国情咨文中，”中国”无一例外成了奥巴马演讲中出现频率最高的国家之一，而且出现次数也从2010年的2次递增到2011年的4次以及今年的5次。
2d96eb0d8a03b95a8e6da7fce96f0f6092ee2d6f.translatedText: Obama followed tradition and delivered the State of the Union address to Congress during prime time that night. This was his third and last State of the Union address during his current term. In the three consecutive State of the Union addresses, "China" has without exception become one of the countries that appears most frequently in Obama's speeches, and the number of occurrences has also increased from 2 times in 2010 to 4 times in 2011 and 5 times this year.

325a8dfb37106ffa5edd1481b636ce13c2ac264f.sourceText: 奥巴马当晚五次提及中国均与经济有关，开篇几分钟之内就第一次提到中国，他在鼓动美国企业将就业机会从国外带回美国时说：”我们不可能收回所有转移到国外去的的工作，但现在在像中国这样的国家做生意代价越来越高，同时美国的生产能力则越来越强。”
325a8dfb37106ffa5edd1481b636ce13c2ac264f.translatedText: Obama mentioned China five times that night, all of which were related to the economy. He mentioned China for the first time within a few minutes of the opening paragraph. When he encouraged American companies to bring jobs back to the United States from abroad, he said: "We can't take back all the jobs that have been transferred abroad, but now they are in The cost of doing business in countries like China is getting higher and higher, and at the same time, the production capacity of the United States is getting stronger and stronger."

d897655e2bf375effacdc70f75433cf34f88d3c7.sourceText: 第二次提到中国时奥巴马态度开始趋于强硬，他说：”为了给美国产品打开新市场，我愿意到世界任何地方去。 当我们的竞争对手不按规则行事时，我不会袖手旁观，我们提出的针对中国的贸易案几乎是上届政府的两倍，这样做收到了效果。”
d897655e2bf375effacdc70f75433cf34f88d3c7.translatedText: When Obama mentioned China for the second time, his attitude became tougher. He said: "In order to open up new markets for American products, I am willing to go anywhere in the world. I will not stand idly by when our competitors do not play by the rules. We have filed almost twice as many trade cases against China as the previous administration, and this has paid off."

8d49092b0c4fdfe6a65bd07478dac8def82a59b7.sourceText: 为了证明所谓对华贸易救济案的效果，奥巴马第三次提到中国，他举例说：”我们阻止了蜂拥而来的中国轮胎，使一千多名美国人今天得以有工作。但我们还需再接再厉。”
8d49092b0c4fdfe6a65bd07478dac8def82a59b7.translatedText: To prove the effectiveness of the so-called trade remedy cases against China, Obama mentioned China for the third time. He gave an example: "We blocked it. Thanks to the influx of Chinese tires, more than a thousand Americans have jobs today. "

435f3a8fd32c1966a2ad3c52af609c1690ef8a8a.sourceText: 第四次提到中国时，奥巴马措辞更强硬，他宣布建立一个贸易执法部门，专门负责调查所谓像中国这样的国家的”不公平贸易行为”。
435f3a8fd32c1966a2ad3c52af609c1690ef8a8a.translatedText: When referring to China for the fourth time, Obama's words were stronger. He announced the establishment of a trade enforcement department specifically responsible for investigating so-called "unfair trade practices" in countries like China.

4a2fcd7bbce9790fc69126aae3f0d165e286cb55.sourceText: 最后，奥巴马在鼓吹自己上任以来力推的清洁能源政策时表示，不会因为遇到阻力而撤回有关清洁能源的承诺，他强调自己”不会将风能、太阳能或者(高科技)电池行业拱手让给中国或德国。”
4a2fcd7bbce9790fc69126aae3f0d165e286cb55.translatedText: Finally, when advocating the clean energy policy he has promoted since taking office, Obama said that he would not withdraw his commitment to clean energy because of resistance. He emphasized that he "will not hand over the wind energy, solar energy or (high-tech) battery industry to China or Germany."

b4f57a198f6d683c150ef52b3b16f5adabe524cc.sourceText: 纵观三次国情咨文，奥巴马涉华言辞明显改变。2010年第一次国情咨文中他强调，中国拥有最快铁路列车和生产清洁能源产品的新工厂，并大声疾呼”不接受美国沦为第二名”，与中国竞争意味浓厚；到了2011年，奥巴马的心态转为承认中国在某些领域的领先地位，颇有以”中国为榜”，向中国学习的意味；而今次其标榜对华贸易救济案的数量以及宣布成立针对中国的新机构，显现其对华贸易态度趋于强硬，并付诸实际行动。
b4f57a198f6d683c150ef52b3b16f5adabe524cc.translatedText: Throughout the three State of the Union addresses, Obama's China-related rhetoric has changed significantly. In his first State of the Union address in 2010, he emphasized that China has the fastest railway trains and new factories that produce clean energy products, and loudly declared that he "will not accept the United States being reduced to second place", which means that competition with China has a strong meaning; by 2011, Obama's mentality changed to inheritance. Recognizing China's leading position in certain fields means using "China as an example" and learning from China; and this time it flaunted the number of trade remedy cases against China and announced the establishment of a new agency targeting China, showing that its attitude towards trade with China has become tougher and it has taken practical actions.

24744c6eb4253c3c6f1f45ab4be2117d758c6222.sourceText: 而与前几任总统相比，也能看出明显不同。过去，中国出现在美国总统国情咨文中经常是被”教训”、”教育”甚至”帮扶”对象，如1999年克林顿在国情咨文中就曾居高临下地说：”要帮助中国融入世界”，2008年小布什也声称要”帮助”中国更好地利用清洁能源，但到了奥巴马时已无这样的高姿态，他甚至还担心美国落后于中国”沦为老二”，就连布什声称要帮助中国的清洁能源领域，奥巴马也一直担心落后于中国。
24744c6eb4253c3c6f1f45ab4be2117d758c6222.translatedText: Compared with previous presidents, obvious differences can also be seen. In the past, China often appeared in the US President's State of the Union address as the target of "teaching," "education," and even "help." For example, in 1999, Clinton said condescendingly in the State of the Union address: "We must help China integrate into the world." In 2008, George W. Bush also claimed It is necessary to "help" China make better use of clean energy, but by the time of Obama, it no longer had such a high profile. He was even worried that the United States would fall behind China and "become the second best". Even though Bush claimed to help China in the clean energy field, Obama had always been worried about falling behind China.

042fc205c2c645a9264564cb9aa6ff944cacffb6.sourceText: 奥巴马的这次演讲是在2012年美国总统大选即将展开的背景下进行的，有分析认为，这或许是他对华措辞趋于强硬的原因。由于今年是选举年，共和党的候选人已开始炒作中国议题，奥巴马在对华贸易问题上采取强硬态度意在拉拢部分选民，并避免给共和党以口实。
042fc205c2c645a9264564cb9aa6ff944cacffb6.translatedText: Obama's speech was delivered against the backdrop of the upcoming 2012 US presidential election. Some analysts believe that this may be the reason why he has become tougher on China. Since this year is an election year, Republican candidates have begun to hype China issues. Obama's tough stance on trade issues with China is intended to win over some voters and avoid giving the Republican Party any excuse.

a687d4d1ccd7f774ef84e6111ad33cf7d2d8ad86.sourceText: 然而，在奥巴马演讲尚未结束之际，代表近240家在华做生意的公司的美中贸易全国委员会就唱起”反调”，尤其反对奥巴马提及的轮胎案。该委员会主席傅强恩声明说：”我们不同意对中国低端轮胎征收关税的举措会对美国就业和经济有任何积极影响。所有证据都表明，受益的是亚洲和墨西哥的其他低端轮胎生产商，而美国公司已从低端轮胎转向价值更高、反映我们生产和技术优势的产品上。”
a687d4d1ccd7f774ef84e6111ad33cf7d2d8ad86.translatedText: However, before Obama's speech was over, the U.S.-China Business Council, which represents nearly 240 companies doing business in China, sang a "counter-argument", especially against the tire case mentioned by Obama. "We do not agree that the imposition of tariffs on China's low-end tires will have any positive impact on U.S. jobs and the economy. All evidence shows that the beneficiaries are other low-end tire manufacturers in Asia and Mexico, while U.S. companies have switched from low-end tires to higher-value products that reflect our production and technological advantages."

343d20d9bec2c1fc19655dbbbb1030c3053d1b64.sourceText: 傅强恩指，中国已成为美国增长最快的主要出口市场，自2000年以来美国对华出口年均增长15%，在世界上独一无二。他强调，在与中国发生贸易摩擦时，”美国公司有多个选项，直接与中国谈判是处理美中商业问题的最好的第一方式。”完
343d20d9bec2c1fc19655dbbbb1030c3053d1b64.translatedText: Fu Qiangen pointed out that China has become the fastest-growing major export market of the United States. Since 2000, U.S. exports to China have grown at an average annual rate of 15%, which is unique in the world. He emphasized that when trade frictions occur with China, "U.S. companies have multiple options, and direct negotiation with China is the best first way to deal with U.S.-China commercial issues." End

1ef70c1241d3c47d5cf2397d4a46bcda965d65ae.sourceText: 据悉，该团由中国国务院侨办副主任任启亮率领，将到访美国洛杉矶、西雅图、芝加哥、纽约以及加拿大的蒙特利尔、温哥华等城市。吕继宏、吕薇、王宏伟、于魁智、李胜素、杨赤等著名艺术家，将共同为美、加两国侨胞献上优美的乡音和富含传统韵味的节目。
1ef70c1241d3c47d5cf2397d4a46bcda965d65ae.translatedText: It is reported that the delegation is led by Ren Qiliang, deputy director of the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the State Council of China, and will visit Los Angeles, Seattle, Chicago, New York in the United States, and Montreal and Vancouver in Canada. Famous artists such as Lu Jihong, Lu Wei, Wang Hongwei, Yu Kuizhi, Li Shengsu, and Yang Chi will jointly present beautiful local accents and programs rich in traditional charm to overseas Chinese in the United States and Canada.

5dbc502f73b0ee5711e46ec528975eeda67a2c72.sourceText: ”’文化中国 四海同春’品牌的影响力不再局限于华侨华人中间，也深受当地民众和政要欢迎。”任启亮在行前接受中新社记者专访时表示，”四海同春”彰显了文化交流的魅力，展示了中国传统文化在海外的影响力。
5dbc502f73b0ee5711e46ec528975eeda67a2c72.translatedText: "The influence of the brand 'Cultural China, Spring in Four Seas' is no longer limited to overseas Chinese, but is also very popular among local people and political figures." Ren Qiliang said in an exclusive interview with a reporter from China News Service before the trip that "Spring in Four Seas" highlights the charm of cultural exchanges and demonstrates the influence of traditional Chinese culture overseas.

0a18acce03da94c2999d2d479b170591b6fce7f2.sourceText: 任启亮表示，该团阵容强大，演员层次和艺术水准高，节目具有中华民族传统文化特色。节目类型主要是歌舞，除了民歌、通俗、美声外，还有两个代表性的戏曲 京剧和黄梅戏。”这个艺术团是我历次率团赴海外演出以来，带过的规模最大的艺术团”。
0a18acce03da94c2999d2d479b170591b6fce7f2.translatedText: Ren Qiliang said that the troupe has a strong lineup, high-level actors and artistic standards, and the program has the traditional cultural characteristics of the Chinese nation. The program types are mainly singing and dancing. In addition to folk songs, popular songs, and bel canto, there are also two representative operas: Peking Opera and Huangmei Opera. "This art troupe is the largest art troupe I have ever led since I led the troupe to perform overseas."

08f5333e893b0721036aef33c000486b0d3efff1.sourceText: 谈及中国农历龙年春节，任启亮表示，希望海外侨胞日子过得越来越好。他说，龙是中国传统的符号，希望农历龙年能为海外华侨华人带来好运，更好地融入当地社会，更多地参与当地事务，在住在国与中国交流合作方面发挥更大的作用。
08f5333e893b0721036aef33c000486b0d3efff1.translatedText: Talking about the Spring Festival of the Year of the Dragon in the Chinese Lunar Calendar, Ren Qiliang expressed his hope that overseas Chinese will live better and better lives. He said that the dragon is a traditional Chinese symbol and he hopes that the Lunar Year of the Dragon can bring good luck to overseas Chinese, better integrate into local society, participate more in local affairs, and play a greater role in exchanges and cooperation between the country of residence and China.

08e69bfbcd151a6c4690cc1edbcb08b2f12b4744.sourceText: 吕继宏十几年来曾多次跟随国务院侨办赴海外参加慰侨演出，本次访演将为侨胞带去《咱老百姓》等经典老歌。在他看来，虽然国外的文化事业相对繁荣，平时的文艺演出也很多，但侨胞仍然很期待”文化中国 四海同春”因为来自中国的声音更能吸引他们。
08e69bfbcd151a6c4690cc1edbcb08b2f12b4744.translatedText: Lu Jihong has followed the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the State Council to participate in performances overseas for overseas Chinese many times over the past decade. This visit will bring classic old songs such as "We Ordinary People" to the overseas Chinese. In his opinion, although foreign cultural undertakings are relatively prosperous and there are many theatrical performances, overseas Chinese still look forward to "Cultural China, Spring Together" because the voices from China attract them more.

c4dec8695ce229b402088653ec5b2028591349fd.sourceText: 青年歌唱演员吕薇透露，为把有代表性的中国元素展现给海外侨胞，她特意为此次演出准备了七八首歌曲，除新歌《蝴蝶》、《大地之约》外，还包括《我和我的祖国》以及成名作《中国红》；此外，准备了一些江浙一带的民歌，想让海外乡亲听一下乡音。
c4dec8695ce229b402088653ec5b2028591349fd.translatedText: Young singer Lu Wei revealed that in order to present representative Chinese elements to overseas Chinese, she specially prepared seven or eight songs for this performance. In addition to the new songs "Butterfly" and "Promise of the Earth", it also includes "My Motherland and Me" and the famous song "China Red"; in addition, she has prepared some folk songs from Jiangsu and Zhejiang, hoping that overseas folks can hear the local accent.

3f244271ba2e274ee4d26cb4c2fdc3ea082e673e.sourceText: ”侨胞们远离祖(籍)国，很少有机会听到这样的西北民歌，一定会倍感亲切。”被誉为”西部歌王”的王宏伟介绍，此次为北美洲的华侨华人准备了《一杯美酒》、《儿行千里》、《可爱的一朵玫瑰花》等多首力作，希望把悠扬辽阔的西北风情带给侨胞们。
3f244271ba2e274ee4d26cb4c2fdc3ea082e673e.translatedText: "Overseas Chinese are far away from their ancestral country and rarely have the opportunity to hear such northwest folk songs. They will definitely feel more intimate." Wang Hongwei, known as the "King of Western Songs," introduced that this time he has prepared many masterpieces such as "A Glass of Fine Wine", "Son Travels Thousands of Miles", and "Lovely Rose" for the overseas Chinese in North America, hoping to bring the melodious and vast Northwest style to the overseas Chinese.

4d690cae760b54887bc9dd5a0778433f93fbe731.sourceText: 此次访演期间，于魁智会和老搭档李胜素、大连京剧院院长花脸名家杨志一起奉上精彩的京剧表演。于魁智说，我们会分别演唱自己的代表作品，同时也会两两组合表演一些合唱的段子，此外还特意为年轻观众准备了融入现代元素的京歌。（完）
4d690cae760b54887bc9dd5a0778433f93fbe731.translatedText: During this visit, Yu Kuizhi will present a wonderful Peking Opera performance with his old partner Li Shengsu and Yang Zhi, director of the Dalian Peking Opera Theater and a famous painter with colorful faces. Yu Kuizhi said that we will sing our own representative works separately, and we will also perform some chorus jokes in pairs. In addition, we have specially prepared Beijing songs with modern elements for young audiences. (over)

597fe96089d67380664640d8aa5355655e9c6dcb.sourceText: 昨日，著名的PFC能源公司公布了2011年上市能源公司50强排名，美国石油天然气生产商埃克森美孚以4063亿美元的市值蝉联冠军，中国石油和荷兰皇家壳牌紧随之后。
597fe96089d67380664640d8aa5355655e9c6dcb.translatedText: Yesterday, the famous PFC Energy Company announced the ranking of the top 50 listed energy companies in 2011. ExxonMobil, an American oil and gas producer, retained the title with a market value of US$406.3 billion, followed closely by PetroChina and Royal Dutch Shell.

501f3791527ec15b94112f5e637fcc3e05c255de.sourceText: 在PFC的这份榜单中，中石油曾于2007年和2009年两度问鼎，其他年份榜首位置全部由埃克森美孚占据。
501f3791527ec15b94112f5e637fcc3e05c255de.translatedText: In PFC's list, PetroChina claimed the top spot twice, in 2007 and 2009. In other years, the top spot was all occupied by Exxon Mobil.

fd3b77a2f6649cab6d7f5a27df7e45cde29aeeab.sourceText: 在2011年的50强榜单中，共有3家来自中国内地的公司入围，除了排名第2的中石油，还有第9位的中国石化和第15位的中国海洋石油。
fd3b77a2f6649cab6d7f5a27df7e45cde29aeeab.translatedText: In the 2011 top 50 list, a total of three companies from mainland China were shortlisted. In addition to the second-ranked PetroChina, there are also the ninth-ranked Sinopec and the 15th-ranked China National Offshore Oil Corporation.

6d02eb76288fd679d1c3df9219f7981d33d7f70e.sourceText: 根据PFC的统计，2011年全球50大能源公司的总市值高达3.6万亿美元，堪比整个纳斯达克股票市场。
6d02eb76288fd679d1c3df9219f7981d33d7f70e.translatedText: According to PFC statistics, the total market value of the world's 50 largest energy companies in 2011 was as high as US$3.6 trillion, comparable to the entire Nasdaq stock market.

572089baebff06dd347883aa0c1c82c3c37971bd.sourceText: 不过，尽管目前的油价远比4年前要高，但50大能源公司的总市值尚未突破2007年达到的5.2万亿美元的最高值。
572089baebff06dd347883aa0c1c82c3c37971bd.translatedText: However, although the current oil price is much higher than four years ago, the total market value of the 50 largest energy companies has not yet exceeded the peak value of US$5.2 trillion reached in 2007.

c69e33bf578bd60ca83edb24421f8fdb4daea25b.sourceText: 对此，PFC能源公司CEO指出，导致总市值低的原因有很多，主要包括北美天然气价格的下降，以及全球股票市场的活跃度低。
c69e33bf578bd60ca83edb24421f8fdb4daea25b.translatedText: In this regard, the CEO of PFC Energy pointed out that there are many reasons for the low total market value, including the decline in natural gas prices in North America and the low activity of the global stock market.

a6d6662926838d4d0afe9ef2fd3f287e643926b5.sourceText: PFC能源公司总部位于美国华盛顿，是一家世界领先的 能源领域 战略咨询公司。（记者 王进雨）
a6d6662926838d4d0afe9ef2fd3f287e643926b5.translatedText: PFC Energy Company, headquartered in Washington, USA, is a world-leading strategic consulting company in the energy field. (Reporter Wang Jinyu)

e972f57114acd65f2d91c1cf30325a4a3b3c283d.sourceText: 《雨果 布里特》是继《阿凡达》《飞屋环游记》和《玩具总动员３》之后，第四部获得奥斯卡最佳影片奖 提名 的３Ｄ片。近年来，好莱坞一窝蜂地推出连篇累牍的大片续集，３Ｄ趋势方兴未艾。尽管没有获得表演类奖项提名，但《雨果 布里特》以最佳影片、最佳导演、最佳改编剧本、最佳艺术指导、最佳摄影、最佳服装设计、最佳电影剪辑、最佳电影配乐、最佳音效剪辑、最佳音响效果、最佳视觉效果１１项提名成为第８４届奥斯卡奖提名最大赢家。斯科塞斯本人第七次获最佳导演奖提名。
e972f57114acd65f2d91c1cf30325a4a3b3c283d.translatedText: "Hugo Britt" is the fourth 3D film to be nominated for the Academy Award for Best Picture, following "Avatar", "Up" and "Toy Story 3". In recent years, Hollywood has launched a swarm of blockbuster sequels, and the 3D trend is in the ascendant. Although it was not nominated for acting awards, "Hugo Britt" became the biggest winner of the 84th Academy Awards nominations with 11 nominations for Best Picture, Best Director, Best Adapted Screenplay, Best Art Direction, Best Cinematography, Best Costume Design, Best Film Editing, Best Film Score, Best Sound Editing, Best Sound Effects, and Best Visual Effects. Scorsese himself was nominated for the Best Director award for the seventh time.

03205428e2a872875cb37f5b5bee28c57dae8718.sourceText: 以一项提名之差屈居第二的《艺术家》则被业内人士一致看好为最佳影片奖的最有力争夺者。这部影片是奥斯卡奖设立８３年以来第五部 入围 的默片，同时也是自１９７０年以来第七部入围的黑白片。在其他６部入围的黑白片中，《辛德勒的名单》在第６６届奥斯卡奖上摘取了包括最佳影片在内的７项大奖。《艺术家》导演阿扎纳维修是好莱坞史上第八位入围最佳导演的法国人。该片还获得最佳男主角、最佳女配角、最佳艺术指导、最佳摄影、最佳服装设计、最佳电影剪辑、最佳电影配乐和最佳原创剧本奖项提名。
03205428e2a872875cb37f5b5bee28c57dae8718.translatedText: "The Artist", which came in second place with one nomination difference, is unanimously regarded by industry insiders as the strongest contender for the Best Picture Award. This film is the fifth silent film to be nominated in the 83-year history of the Academy Awards, and the seventh black-and-white film to be nominated since 1970. Among the other six shortlisted black-and-white films, "Schindler's List" won seven awards at the 66th Academy Awards, including Best Picture. "The Artist" director Azanavivi is the eighth Frenchman in Hollywood history to be nominated for Best Director. The film was also nominated for Best Actor, Best Supporting Actress, Best Art Direction, Best Cinematography, Best Costume Design, Best Film Editing, Best Film Score and Best Original Screenplay.

f69c349a5745715f134af83fb525be5f8aac184e.sourceText: 采用２０世纪早期好莱坞制作风格、旨在向好莱坞黄金时代致敬的《艺术家》的出现，在国际影坛刮起了一股清新的空气，它既给观众提供了纯粹的享受，也使影评家眼前一亮，引来如潮好评。从戛纳金棕榈到好莱坞颁奖季，各路评委均对这部影片给予极大关注和肯定。《艺术家》也成为各地影评人协会奖项最大的赢家，并一举斩获金球奖最佳喜剧片、最佳喜剧类男主角（让 迪雅尔丹）和最佳原创音乐大奖。一位英国著名影评家改变了多年的习惯，慷慨地用”完美”词来形容这部影片。
f69c349a5745715f134af83fb525be5f8aac184e.translatedText: The emergence of "The Artist", which adopts the Hollywood production style of the early 20th century and aims to pay tribute to the golden age of Hollywood, has blown a breath of fresh air in the international film world. It not only provides pure enjoyment to the audience, but also makes the eyes of film critics shine, attracting rave reviews. From the Cannes Palme d'Or to the Hollywood awards season, judges from all walks of life have paid great attention and recognition to this film. "The Artist" has also become the biggest winner of awards from various film critics associations, and won the Golden Globe Award for Best Comedy, Best Actor in a Comedy (Jean Dujardin) and Best Original Score. A famous British film critic changed his habit for many years and generously used the word "perfect" to describe this film.

cb936fcd81e8304a4a5da6f6c13c5cb03250463e.sourceText: 从电影发展的历史来看，黑白片和默片是观众集体观影的最传统也是最常见的方式。观众在欣赏 影片 时获得的体验会通过互相传播起到放大作用。曾几何时，观众习惯于三五成群、或全家老少前往电影院欣赏电影，大小影院爆满、一票难求的情景历历在目。但随着互联网的发展和手机等通信技术的日新月异，这种现象已渐式微，代之以在手机上点播或在家里一个人观看影碟。这种科技发展带来的新现象使影评家和影艺学院评委不免产生了浓郁的怀旧情结，而《艺术家》的出现与这种情结不谋而合。
cb936fcd81e8304a4a5da6f6c13c5cb03250463e.translatedText: Judging from the history of film development, black-and-white films and silent films are the most traditional and common ways for audiences to watch movies collectively. The experience the audience has while watching the film will be amplified through mutual communication. Once upon a time, audiences were accustomed to going to movie theaters in small groups or with whole families to watch movies. The scene of theaters of all sizes being full and it was hard to get a ticket is vividly visible. However, with the development of the Internet and the rapid advancement of communication technologies such as mobile phones, this phenomenon has gradually declined, and has been replaced by on-demand videos on mobile phones or watching DVDs alone at home. This new phenomenon brought about by the development of science and technology has caused film critics and Academy of Film and Television judges to have a strong nostalgia complex, and the appearance of "The Artist" coincides with this complex.

dfacc3f7ccd884f1aee95d3801b8886005ffa2c5.sourceText: 此外，世界 电影 诞生已经百年，但描写电影人自身经历的影片十分鲜见。《艺术家》讲述默片时期著名男演员乔治 瓦伦丁因拒绝有声电影将取代无声片的事实，事业发展遭遇挫折，但在女友帮助下最终收获圆满人生的故事。美国影艺学院近５８００位评委，尤其是人数最多的演员出身的评委对于这部描写演员经历的影片自然格外垂青。《艺术家》同时也是近年来首部由非英语国家推出的奥斯卡最佳影片候选者。
dfacc3f7ccd884f1aee95d3801b8886005ffa2c5.translatedText: In addition, it has been a hundred years since the birth of world cinema, but films describing the filmmakers' own experiences are very rare. "The Artist" tells the story of George Valentine, a famous actor in the silent film period who encountered setbacks in his career because he refused the fact that talkies would replace silent films, but with the help of his girlfriend, he finally gained a happy life. The nearly 5,800 judges of the American Film Academy, especially the largest number of judges who are actors, are naturally particularly fond of this film that describes the experience of actors. "The Artist" is also the first Oscar candidate for Best Picture from a non-English-speaking country in recent years.

8eeeaf2c9f69ff3e2a26846120daac68bf3e0ef6.sourceText: 另一部最佳影片奖 入围 影片《战马》导演斯皮尔伯格此次未能入围最佳导演奖。
8eeeaf2c9f69ff3e2a26846120daac68bf3e0ef6.translatedText: Another Best Picture Award nominee Spielberg, the director of the film "War Horse", failed to be nominated for the Best Director Award this time.

81bc72ca9bce042cee71598817aa043dffb9c8f0.sourceText: 对于自编自导浪漫喜剧片《午夜巴黎》的伍迪 艾伦来说，这是他获得的第七个最佳导演奖 提名 。艾伦此次还获得最佳原创剧本奖提名，这是他第１５次入围。
81bc72ca9bce042cee71598817aa043dffb9c8f0.translatedText: For Woody Allen, who wrote and directed the romantic comedy "Midnight in Paris," this is his seventh Best Director Award nomination. Allen was also nominated for the Best Original Screenplay Award this time, marking his 15th time being nominated.

f7600ad348db2b27c16d48273c315d183c9c07b4.sourceText: 在 奥斯卡奖 入围名单中，在前期的颁奖活动中得到影评人赞誉的《生命之树》和影评人评价不高的美国”９1１” 题材影片《特别响，非常近》也都入围最佳影片行列。
f7600ad348db2b27c16d48273c315d183c9c07b4.translatedText: Among the Oscar nominees, "The Tree of Life", which was praised by film critics in the early awards activities, and the American "9/11" themed film "Very Loud and Very Close", which was not highly praised by film critics, are also shortlisted for the best picture.

898327a052ba4de18c7822c7b902b5321bbfda22.sourceText: 同样演绎真人真事的演员受到的待遇则大相径庭。扮演英国前首相撒切尔夫人的好莱坞常青树梅里尔 特里普、饰演已故影星玛丽 梦露的米歇尔 威廉斯，以及扮演带领队员打翻身仗的球队经理的布拉德 皮特均榜上有名，而刻画美国联邦调查局创始人胡佛的影星莱昂纳多 迪卡普里奥却名落孙山。
898327a052ba4de18c7822c7b902b5321bbfda22.translatedText: Actors who also perform real-life stories are treated very differently. Hollywood evergreen Meryl Tripp, who plays former British Prime Minister Margaret Thatcher, Michelle Williams, who plays the late movie star Mary Monroe, and Brad Pitt, who plays the team manager who leads the team to turn around, are all on the list, while Leonardo DiCaprio, the movie star who portrays Hoover, the founder of the FBI, is not on the list.

1ea0d7bfdbb2dfb539b2dadfe87da16533cead75.sourceText: 此外，同一部影片也呈现”冰火两重天”的状态。戴维 芬彻新作《龙文身的女孩》颇受评委关爱，一举收获５项提名，其主演鲁尼 玛拉还出人意料地入围最佳女主角奖，与斯特里普等老演员同场竞技，但这部影片却与最佳影片奖无缘。
1ea0d7bfdbb2dfb539b2dadfe87da16533cead75.translatedText: In addition, the same film also presents a state of "ice and fire". David Fincher's new film "The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo" was well received by the judges and received 5 nominations in one fell swoop. Its star Rooney Mara was also unexpectedly nominated for the Best Actress Award, competing with veteran actors such as Streep. However, this film missed the Best Picture Award.

2aafdd5d4304878fde31e0f8553c0fe00ff00176.sourceText: 入围最佳外语片奖的《内达和西敏：一次别离》是自１９９８年以来第二部入围的伊朗影片。如果最终夺冠，将实现伊朗影片在奥斯卡奖上零的突破。
2aafdd5d4304878fde31e0f8553c0fe00ff00176.translatedText: "Neda and Simin: A Separation" was shortlisted for the Best Foreign Language Film Award, becoming the second Iranian film to be shortlisted since 1998. If it finally wins, it will be a breakthrough for an Iranian film at the Oscars.

2270f08e8ec4732264a2179dfa3e9896240ce965.sourceText: 科技发达为人类带来许多方便，现代人已不知不觉被计算机、网络世界所俘虏；几乎不可一日不呆在计算机前。那些至今不用计算机者，早被等同盲人，属于时代落伍者，对本文内容可说无关痛痒。
2270f08e8ec4732264a2179dfa3e9896240ce965.translatedText: The development of science and technology has brought many conveniences to mankind. Modern people have been unconsciously captured by computers and the Internet world; it is almost impossible for them to stay in front of computers for a day. Those who do not use computers have long been regarded as blind people and are laggards. The content of this article can be said to be irrelevant.

76f1f5e5e6d21fa3d0e7ed0fc46c4976379baff2.sourceText: 大千世界、凡事皆有正负两面，利与弊同时并存；在一个虚拟网络中，竟也处处有陷阱。经常听闻的无非是计算机被黑客入侵，失去了所有存盘数据。要重新输入，费时失事在所难免；但不幸的是有些资料一旦失落，再无从寻觅。
76f1f5e5e6d21fa3d0e7ed0fc46c4976379baff2.translatedText: In this world, everything has both positive and negative sides, pros and cons coexist at the same time; in a virtual network, there are traps everywhere. What we often hear is that computers have been hacked and all saved data has been lost. It is inevitable to re-enter, which is time-consuming and error-prone; but unfortunately, once some data is lost, it can no longer be found.

3250ac9149d8a1fc92515e07bf0aabbaa61d4aed.sourceText: 应用计算机创作经已十年有多，为了提防被病毒破坏或受到不明黑客入侵；我的电子邮址是封锁式运作，让陌生人无法传来邮件。同时、亲友转发分享的种种图文，若非特别吸引或有用信息，一般我是不会打开附件。不少病毒往往暗藏附件中，一打开就上当了。
3250ac9149d8a1fc92515e07bf0aabbaa61d4aed.translatedText: I have been using computers to create for more than ten years. In order to prevent viruses or unknown hackers from intruding, my email address is blocked so that strangers cannot send emails. At the same time, I generally won’t open the attachments if they are forwarded and shared by relatives and friends, unless they are particularly attractive or useful information. Many viruses are often hidden in attachments and you will be fooled as soon as you open them.

54472c47b7663d9312a21479b255d8ab09d81d74.sourceText: 由于小心及对来函 「附件」特别警惕，因此、从用计算机至今，就没有被任何病毒破坏过，算是很幸运呢。去年创办了「世界华文作家交流协会」，为了运作，唯有在谷歌网开设一个新邮址。尤于要征收会员及与各地文友通讯，自然不能像我个人电邮般采用封锁式。
54472c47b7663d9312a21479b255d8ab09d81d74.translatedText: Because I am careful and particularly vigilant about the "attachments" of incoming letters, I am very lucky that I have not been damaged by any viruses since I started using the computer. The "World Chinese Writers Exchange Association" was founded last year. In order to operate, the only way is to open a new email address on Google. Especially when it comes to recruiting members and communicating with literary friends from all over the world, naturally we can't use a blocked method like my personal email.

d9d6e757293b5e7ddd6cd7528f773a48af8803f8.sourceText: 没有封锁的电子邮址，等同开放门户，任何人都可传寄任何电子图文、广告信息；每天打开电邮、单单清理这堆不必要的来函，已花去不少时间。「世华交流会」的电子邮箱:wongxinshui@gmail.com,开设了七个月，没想到上周外游回家后就出事了。
d9d6e757293b5e7ddd6cd7528f773a48af8803f8.translatedText: There is no blocked email address, which is equivalent to an open door. Anyone can send any electronic graphics, text, and advertising information. It takes a lot of time to open the email every day and just clean up this pile of unnecessary emails. The email address of "Shihua Exchange Meeting" is wongxinshui@gmail.com. It has been open for seven months. Unexpectedly, something happened after returning home from a trip last week.

dfec99be894931ebe1304320053a16e7fd93e861.sourceText: 各地作家文友来邮关心询问我是否已回家？诗人方浪舟先告知收到我用英文姓名的求援信？纽西兰知名作家林爽来电话、印度尼西亚晓星主编将原信转来给我参考；丘桥兄传来示警信，洪门民治党的伍颂达主委打电话问候，知我并非如求援信所讲沦落在希腊，总算明白那封英文信是讹骗函。
dfec99be894931ebe1304320053a16e7fd93e861.translatedText: Writers and literary friends from all over the world have sent me emails asking me if I have returned home? The poet Fang Langzhou first informed me that he received my letter asking for help with an English name? Well-known New Zealand writer Lin Shuang called me, and the editor-in-chief of Hyosung Indonesia forwarded the original letter to me for reference; Brother Qiu Qiao sent me a warning letter, and Chairman Wu Songda of the Hongmen Democratic Party called to say hello, knowing that I was not trapped in Greece as stated in the letter asking for help. I finally understood that the English letter was a letter of blackmail.

e2dfb105ff2f5d45542bf844d24608f16c8a23b2.sourceText: 原来我那个用作「世华作家交流会」通讯的电子邮址、密码被远在希腊的犯罪份子偷盗；用我名誉向邮址存档内近百位作家、文友及亲友发出一封英文求救信，说我人在希腊丢了钱包证件，要求按提供的设在希腊银行户口、紧急汇款一千五百欧元。银行户口居然是我的英文姓名呢？
e2dfb105ff2f5d45542bf844d24608f16c8a23b2.translatedText: It turns out that my email address and password used for communication of the "Shihua Writers Exchange Conference" were stolen by criminals in Greece. I used my reputation to send a distress letter in English to nearly a hundred writers, literary friends, relatives and friends in the email address archive, saying that I had lost my wallet ID in Greece and requested an emergency remittance of 1,500 euros from the Greek bank account provided. The bank account actually has my English name?

f62aa814c5ab12da401599a43ea2137291301b8c.sourceText: 关心则乱，那是人的常情；假如有任何一位至亲友好不经查询而误信，将钱汇去希腊以济我「燃眉之急」，那无良贼子岂非正中下怀？由于这类网上讹骗事经常会发生，为了警惕大家，除了小心外，无论何时何人，收到何种求援电子信，一定要先查问当事人，或打电话，或传易妙，千万不要误信而被骗。
f62aa814c5ab12da401599a43ea2137291301b8c.translatedText: >Concern leads to chaos, that is human nature; if any close relatives and friends misunderstood without checking and sent money to Greece to help me in "urgent needs", wouldn't that be what the unscrupulous thieves wanted? Since this type of online fraud often occurs, in order to alert everyone, in addition to being careful, no matter when or who receives an electronic letter asking for help, you must first check with the person involved, or call or send a message to Yi Miao. Do not mislead and be deceived.

a356f7c7dd07376162e04c702037b9550a0cc9f8.sourceText: 虽然无人被骗而汇钱到希腊「救我于水火」，但那个邮址也就此报废，赶快重开新邮址。要重新输入那大堆作家们的数据，让我整整两天面对荧光幕，实在辛苦。
a356f7c7dd07376162e04c702037b9550a0cc9f8.translatedText: Although no one was deceived and sent money to Greece to "save me from the fire", the email address was scrapped and a new one was opened as soon as possible. It was really hard to re-enter the data of so many writers, which kept me in front of the screen for two whole days.

5732e318e16e471a8007788e5db8347462eada22.sourceText: 万幸之事是，我从来不将个人证件、银行数据、密码等存放在网中，不然、一旦被盗取电子邮件密码，所有涉及个人私瘾都将被窃取，麻烦与损失就大了。读者们，千万不要为了方便，将个人所有数据都输入能上网的计算机座机或手提计算器。可以储存在家中没有接驳网站的座机或「铁指」。当然、若存在「铁指」中，自然不能弄丢了小小的「铁指」啊。
5732e318e16e471a8007788e5db8347462eada22.translatedText: Fortunately, I never store personal documents, bank data, passwords, etc. online. Otherwise, once the email password is stolen, all personal information will be stolen, causing great trouble and losses. Readers, please do not enter all your personal data into a landline computer or portable calculator with Internet access just for the sake of convenience. Can be stored on a landline or "iron finger" at home that does not have access to the website. Of course, if there is an "Iron Finger", you can't lose the little "Iron Finger".

00e68fc07948a09c08ff73d0ffca1e97f55184ef.sourceText: 为保障及安全起见、开设电子邮址所用密码，至少每三月更换一次；密码输入、用键越多，越难破解。当然、对于黑客，可说没有破解不了的密码(如维基译码、连中国中南海、美国中情局、瑞士银行等国家极机密的计算机也都一一破解。)；增加难度，只可令盗贼知难而退而已。
00e68fc07948a09c08ff73d0ffca1e97f55184ef.translatedText: For the sake of protection and security, the password used to open an email address must be changed at least every three months; the more keys you enter and use in the password, the harder it is to crack. Of course, for hackers, there is no password that cannot be cracked (such as Wikipedia, even the most secret computers of China's Zhongnanhai, the United States CIA, Swiss Bank and other countries have been cracked one by one.); increasing the difficulty will only make the thieves retreat.

8567987483d2963f0aa00c52d37e8257ce9b72cc.sourceText: 科技改进了人类社会生活，同时也存在了不少负面影响；任何事总是利弊参半，除了小心外，我们总不能因噎废食啊。在此次我的电子邮址被盗后，特别感恩各地文友、友好来函、来电关心。给大家造成困扰及不便，在此郑重致歉。
8567987483d2963f0aa00c52d37e8257ce9b72cc.translatedText: >Technology has improved human social life, but it also has many negative effects; everything always has pros and cons. In addition to being careful, we can't stop eating because of choking. After my email address was stolen this time, I would like to express my special gratitude to literary friends from all over the world for their friendly letters and calls of concern. We sincerely apologize for the trouble and inconvenience caused to everyone.

44138dc2259c397e6c6b13525afb2df5016e2a55.sourceText: 供电频率试行一年不调整 美国时钟恐大乱 美国当局准备自7月中起进行为期一年的实验，不调整交流电供电的频率误差，这或将使全美各地依靠此频率计时的交通号志、安全系统、电钟和咖啡壶等电器的时间失准，一年最多会快20分钟。 自1930年起，美国开始利用交流电频率作为电钟计时的依据，每当频率出现误差时，电力公司都会采取调整措施，以确保计时准确，但此调整措施成本高昂，而且相当费力。 联邦能源管理委员会负责可靠性的主管麦克利兰指出，未来电网使用更多太阳能和风能等再生能源，其发电量随时受天气干扰，若要校正供电频率会耗用庞大成本，而且后备电源必须随时待命。 负责监管全美供电网的北美电力可靠性公司为了使供电更稳定、节省成本并减少可能是不需要的工作，拟自7月中起试行不调整此频率误差，看看会造成什么影响，但实际试行的时间可能会稍微 延后。 针对此实验可能造成的影响，美国海军天文台时间服务部主任马察基思说：”很多人将来出了事都不知道为什么。”他认为这是一项有趣的实验，可以看看人们的计时依赖电网的程度。 报导说，这项实验不会影响手机、GPS或电脑上的时钟，也不会影响美国官方或网路的时间，但会影响停电时会闪烁”12:00”的时钟，例如：墙上的电钟和烤箱与咖啡壶上的计时器等。 据北美电力可靠性公司的报告指出，东海岸的时钟一年可能快20分钟，但西海岸的时钟可能只有8分钟的误差，而德州的时钟可能只会快2分钟。
44138dc2259c397e6c6b13525afb2df5016e2a55.translatedText: A one-year trial of not adjusting the power supply frequency could cause chaos in U.S. clocks. The U.S. authorities are preparing to conduct a one-year experiment starting from mid-July without adjusting the frequency error of AC power supply. This may cause the time of traffic signs, security systems, electric clocks, coffee pots and other appliances across the United States that rely on this frequency to be timed, and the time will be up to 20 minutes faster a year. Since 1930, the United States has begun to use alternating current frequency as the basis for electric clock timing. Whenever there is an error in the frequency, the power company will take adjustment measures to ensure accurate timing. However, this adjustment measure is costly and laborious. McClelland, director of reliability at the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission, pointed out that in the future, the power grid will use more renewable energy sources such as solar and wind energy, and its power generation will be disrupted by weather at any time. It will cost a lot to correct the power supply frequency, and backup power must be on standby at all times. In order to make the power supply more stable, save costs and reduce unnecessary work, the North American Electric Reliability Corporation, which is responsible for supervising the power supply network across the United States, plans to start a trial of not adjusting this frequency error from mid-July to see what the impact will be, but the actual trial time may be slightly delayed. In response to the possible impact of this experiment, Matsakis, director of the Time Service Department of the U.S. Naval Observatory, said: "Many people will not know why something will happen in the future." He thinks this is an interesting experiment to see how much people's timing depends on the power grid. The report said that this experiment will not affect the clocks on mobile phones, GPS or computers, nor will it affect the official US or online time, but it will affect clocks that flash "12:00" during a power outage, such as wall clocks and timers on ovens and coffee pots. According to a report from the North American Electric Reliability Corporation, clocks on the East Coast may be ahead by 20 minutes a year, but clocks on the West Coast may be off by only 8 minutes, and clocks in Texas may be off by only 2 minutes.

4462673e8d6653e4624553835c0dbd36ec13b9a1.sourceText: 北京时间6月28日消息，据香港媒体报道，昨天(27日)是梁朝伟49岁生日，一向低调的他，前晚(6月26日)与太太刘嘉玲吃饭庆祝，经理人公司泽东将他庆祝生日的照片上载微博与大家分享。过往一年，梁朝伟在内地连拍两部片，包括王家卫的《一代宗师》及尔冬升执导的《大魔术师》，他早前出席《大》片记者会，仍有一丝倦意，回香港休息好一段时间之后，明显精神了，加上有太太嘉玲陪伴度生日，难怪他笑容满脸，看着蛋糕也一脸满足。过往，韩国与日本粉丝都会来香港与梁朝伟庆祝生日，较早前，粉丝已组团来香港与他吃饭庆祝，并送上礼物。
4462673e8d6653e4624553835c0dbd36ec13b9a1.translatedText: Beijing time, June 28 News, according to Hong Kong media reports, yesterday (27th) was Tony Leung’s 49th birthday. He, who has always been low-key, had a meal with his wife Carina Lau the night before (June 26th) to celebrate. Manager Zedong uploaded photos of him celebrating his birthday on Weibo to share with everyone. In the past year, Tony Leung has been filming two films in the Mainland, including Wong Kar-wai's "The Grandmaster" and "The Magician" directed by Er Dongsheng. He attended the press conference for "The Grandmaster" earlier, but he was still a little tired. After returning to Hong Kong to rest for a while, he was obviously energetic. In addition, his wife Carina was with him to celebrate his birthday. No wonder he was smiling all over his face, and he looked satisfied when looking at the cake. In the past, Korean and Japanese fans would come to Hong Kong to celebrate Tony Leung's birthday. Earlier, fans had organized a group to come to Hong Kong to celebrate with him by having dinner and giving him gifts.

6de11c31937fcbf4906dd7e767c260fcfbc6d3b9.sourceText: 据悉，《一代宗师》仍没拍竣，问还要拍什么？何时复工？梁朝伟表示没收到王家卫的指示。没有工作的梁朝伟乐得清闲，继续休息及陪伴刘嘉玲。刘嘉玲昨天(6月27日)透过微博，称呼梁朝伟做Master，她说：揗aster，happy birthday to you！?#22909;友钟镇涛则祝梁朝伟影帝生日快乐，永远靓仔，他说：?#20170;天(6月27日)客来茶当酒，身体健康快乐透。?#20237;咏薇亦透过微博祝贺：?#22025;玲姐，是你丈夫今天生日吗？祝梁先生，生日快乐，身体健康，夫妻恩爱，享受二人世界吧！?/P>

f4ba795bed6b85553dcd50da1483b10b8f46cd70.sourceText: 扩财源 各州纷征网络销售税 在全美许多州对教师进行裁员、关闭图书馆和公园，并削减医疗照顾服务之际，有些州为扩大财源，纷纷立法要求类似亚马逊网站(Amazon)的网络零售商缴付销售税。 估计全美每年网络销售税约达230亿元。这笔收入足以支付4万6000名教师薪水。加州仅由亚马逊网站未征收的网络销售税，即相当于该州儿童福利服务遭削减的预算，但由主要网络零售商收税，十分困难。 网络零售商仅在设有店面或公司实体存在的州，必须收取销售税；消费者若由外州交易，依法也必须缴税，但一直难以执行。依现行规定，卖方不用负担未收税责任，买方则可省下3%至9%的销售税，因为甚少有消费者愿意缴付销售税。 由于许多州在2007年至2010年的销售税收入大幅减少逾30%，促使各州议员研究解决之道，以征收未缴付的销售税。 德州州众议员奈许塔(Elliot Naishtat)已提案要求更多网络零售商收取德州销售税。她说：「问题在于一些外州网络零售商声称，他们不适用征收销售税，这是攸关可能为德州创造数亿元税收的问题。」 德州因税收下滑已削减240亿元服务计划，包括针对儿童、医疗补助计划(Medicaid)，以及低收入和残障人士的服务。 不过，网络零售业已引用1992年最高法院在奎尔公司(Quill)与北达科他州的判例，指出州政府仅可要求在州内实体存在的公司收税。 有些州为突破该判例限制，扩大解释实体存在的定义，例如只要某家网络零售商雇用的营销公司，或旗下拥有的企业设在该州，即符合收税条件。 德州主计长2月份就要求亚马逊网站缴付2亿6900万元销售税，理由是该网站旗下分公司在达拉斯附近有一间仓库。 纽约州去年也通过一项立法，规定网络零售商若支付州内营销经纪人佣金，便构成在州内实体存在。之后有多个州迅速通过类似法案；亚利桑那州、加州、佛罗里达州、麻州、明尼苏达州和宾州，亦有类似法案尚待通过。 加州当局估计，每年由未收取的网络销售税，至少损失2亿元，其中亚马逊网站即占8300万元。不过亚马逊网站为避免负责收税，已威胁要关闭德州仓库、伊利诺伊州和北卡罗来纳州的营销分公司，并控告纽约州的立法违宪。
f4ba795bed6b85553dcd50da1483b10b8f46cd70.translatedText: To expand financial resources, states are levying online sales taxes. As many states across the United States are laying off teachers, closing libraries and parks, and cutting medical care services, some states have enacted legislation requiring online retailers like Amazon to pay sales tax in order to expand financial resources. It is estimated that online sales taxes in the United States amount to approximately $23 billion each year. This revenue is enough to pay the salaries of 46,000 teachers. California's online sales tax, which is not collected by Amazon alone, is equivalent to budget cuts for child welfare services in the state, but it is very difficult for major online retailers to collect the tax. Online retailers must collect sales tax only in the states where they have stores or corporate entities; consumers must also pay tax according to law if they trade from out of state, but it has been difficult to enforce. According to current regulations, sellers do not have to bear the responsibility for uncollected taxes, and buyers can save 3% to 9% sales tax, because few consumers are willing to pay sales tax. Sales tax revenue in many states dropped by more than 30% from 2007 to 2010, prompting state lawmakers to explore ways to collect unpaid sales taxes. Texas Rep. Elliot Naishtat has proposed requiring more online retailers to collect Texas sales tax. She said: "The problem is that some out-of-state online retailers claim that they are not eligible for sales tax, which is an issue that could generate hundreds of millions of dollars in tax revenue for Texas." Texas has cut $24 billion in service programs due to declining tax revenue, including services for children, Medicaid, and low-income and disabled people. However, the online retail industry has cited the 1992 Supreme Court case in Quill and North Dakota, stating that state governments can only require companies with a physical presence in the state to collect taxes. In order to break through the limitations of this jurisprudence, some states have expanded the definition of physical presence. For example, as long as a marketing company hired by an online retailer or a company owned by it is located in that state, it is eligible for taxation. In February, the Texas comptroller ordered Amazon.com to pay $269 million in sales tax because its subsidiary had a warehouse near Dallas. New York State also passed legislation last year that requires online retailers to have a physical presence in the state if they pay an in-state marketing broker commission. Since then, several states have quickly passed similar bills; Arizona, California, Florida, Massachusetts, Minnesota and Pennsylvania also have similar bills pending. California authorities estimate that at least $200 million is lost each year from uncollected online sales taxes, of which Amazon.com accounts for $83 million. However, in order to avoid being responsible for collecting taxes, Amazon.com has threatened to close its Texas warehouse, marketing branches in Illinois and North Carolina, and sued New York State’s legislation as unconstitutional.

b0778b34087f0ff4ecd3dd8b702b95df433ca5a3.sourceText: 加州众议院通过法案 禁鱼翅交易 加州众议院5月23日以63票赞成、8票反对通过法案，禁止在加州出售、交易或持有鱼翅。该法案将交参议院审议，如果通过，将于2013年1月1日起生效。 加州议会华裔众议员方文忠和众议员霍夫曼提交的法案，要求加州禁止鱼翅交易。方文忠说：”加州是全美国鲨鱼翅需要量最大的地方，大量的需求促使渔民大量捕猎鲨鱼，加剧鲨鱼数量减少。因此我们必须在加州堵塞鱼翅交易渠道。” 圣马刁县民主党众议员马世云反对这个法案，她说：”25年前我开始选择不吃肉。我不会将我个人的选择强加给加州人。事实上在加州没有一项禁止食品的法律。” 马世云表示，加州有联邦和州一级的机构，通过许可证、法规、配额和执行等手段，在监视并努力保护频危物种。如果鲨鱼属于频危物种，就应当禁止对所有的鲨鱼的捕杀。马世云表示，她用Google搜索加州鲨鱼肉餐厅，发现很多餐馆都有鲨鱼排。 在旧金山中餐馆，一客鱼翅羹卖15到75美元不等，是餐馆的高利润菜式。餐馆老板欧先生也说：”如果禁止鱼翅，对中华饮食文化，和中餐馆的生存，都会有影响。” 不过，也有华人支持方文忠的提案，中餐馆老板范先生说：”虽然这是华人精致文化的一部份，但是地球至上，因此我支持禁止鱼翅交易法案。” 马世云认为，鱼翅在很多华人社区成了一个敏感的文化问题，鱼翅汤被认为是一种历史悠久的传统美味，在盛大、重要的场合都会有鱼翅汤，如在婚典或庆生的正式场合。对她社区的很多人来说，这一法案代表了对中国文化和传统的直接攻击。 她在解释投下反对票的原因时重申，这一法案可能是加州第一个禁止食品的法案。并且，这个法案将带我们走到一个危险的方向上去：由我们来决定某一族群什么可以吃，什么不可以吃。
b0778b34087f0ff4ecd3dd8b702b95df433ca5a3.translatedText: California House of Representatives passes bill to ban shark fin trade The California House of Representatives passed a bill on May 23 with 63 votes in favor and 8 votes against, banning the sale, trade or possession of shark fins in California. The bill will be submitted to the Senate for consideration and, if passed, will take effect on January 1, 2013. The bill submitted by Chinese-American Representatives Fang Wenzhong and Representative Huffman of the California Assembly requires California to ban the shark fin trade. Fang Wenzhong said: "California has the largest demand for shark fins in the United States. The large demand has prompted fishermen to hunt sharks in large quantities, exacerbating the decline in shark numbers. Therefore, we must block shark fin trading channels in California." San Mateo County Democratic Rep. Ma Shiyun opposed this bill. She said: "I chose not to eat meat 25 years ago. I will not impose my personal choice on Californians. In fact, there is no law prohibiting food in California." Ma Shiyun said that California has federal and state-level agencies that monitor and work hard to protect endangered species through licenses, regulations, quotas and enforcement. If sharks are an endangered species, all shark hunting should be banned. Ma Shiyun said that she searched California shark meat restaurants on Google and found that many restaurants have shark steaks. In San Francisco Chinese restaurants, a dish of shark fin soup costs between 15 and 75 US dollars, making it a high-profit dish for restaurants. Restaurant owner Mr. Ou also said: "If shark fin is banned, it will have an impact on Chinese food culture and the survival of Chinese restaurants." However, there are also Chinese people who support Fang Wenzhong's proposal. Mr. Fan, a Chinese restaurant owner, said: "Although this is part of the exquisite Chinese culture, the earth comes first, so I support the bill to ban the shark fin trade." Ma Shiyun believes that shark fin has become a sensitive cultural issue in many Chinese communities. Shark fin soup is considered a traditional delicacy with a long history. Shark fin soup is served on grand and important occasions, such as weddings or birthday celebrations. To many in her community, this bill represents a direct attack on Chinese culture and tradition. Explaining the reason for her vote, she reiterated that the bill would be California's first to ban food. Moreover, this bill will take us in a dangerous direction: Let us decide what a certain group of people can and cannot eat.
