eb8a2a59672f86f2e65d2d177fd8f76096b96e0b.sourceText: 广东北江上游的韶关、清远等市遭遇暴雨到大暴雨天气袭击，局部地区暴雨超过百年一遇。暴雨使局部地区出现洪涝灾害，造成２人失踪，８万多人受灾。目前清远地区洪峰未过，水位仍在上涨。
eb8a2a59672f86f2e65d2d177fd8f76096b96e0b.translatedText: Shaoguan, Qingyuan and other cities in the upper reaches of the Beijiang River in Guangdong have been hit by heavy rains to heavy rainstorms. In some areas, heavy rains have exceeded the once-in-a-century event. Heavy rains caused flooding in some areas, leaving two people missing and more than 80,000 people affected. At present, the flood peak in Qingyuan has not passed and the water level is still rising.

99f15592b2299eb9c547b3c9f135960c475e555b.sourceText: 广东省气象台首席预报员梁健告诉记者，８日，广东韶关市和清远市北部出现了暴雨到大暴雨，局部特大暴雨。
99f15592b2299eb9c547b3c9f135960c475e555b.translatedText: Liang Jian, chief forecaster of the Guangdong Provincial Meteorological Observatory, told reporters that on the 8th, there were heavy to heavy rains and local heavy rains in Shaoguan City and the northern part of Qingyuan City, Guangdong.

edd5721a613ec0fd77ba83b1097f65bf6ee9c017.sourceText: 据广东省防总介绍，本次降雨主要集中在广东北江上游的韶关乳源、仁化和清远连州、阳山、连南一带，强降雨使局部地区出现洪涝灾害。
edd5721a613ec0fd77ba83b1097f65bf6ee9c017.translatedText: According to the Guangdong Provincial Prevention and Control Bureau, this rainfall is mainly concentrated in the Ruyuan and Renhua areas of Shaoguan and Lianzhou, Yangshan and Liannan in Qingyuan in the upper reaches of the Beijiang River in Guangdong. The heavy rainfall has caused flooding in some areas.

e313999f6a13f7272a67046dd0b744494d944477.sourceText: 清远市三防办副主任赵谊钰在接受记者采访时说，截至９日１６时，清远市的连州、连南、阳山、连山４个县市２０个乡镇出现灾情，其中连南涡水等镇灾情较为严重。全市１人失踪，４２０００人受灾，３８６００亩农作物受灾面积，７９间房屋倒塌。”连南县县城至涡水镇公路出现两处滑坡，致使交通、通讯中断。目前正在抢修中，预计今晚可以修通。”赵谊钰说。
e313999f6a13f7272a67046dd0b744494d944477.translatedText: Zhao Yiyu, deputy director of Qingyuan City's Three Prevention and Control Office, said in an interview with reporters that as of 16:00 on the 9th, 20 towns and villages in four counties and cities in Qingyuan City, Lianzhou, Liannan, Yangshan, and Lianshan, were affected by disasters. Among them, Liannan Woushui and other towns were more seriously affected. One person was missing in the city, 42,000 people were affected, 38,600 acres of crops were affected, and 79 houses collapsed. "Two landslides occurred on the road from Liannan County to Woshui Town, causing traffic and communications to be interrupted. Repairs are currently under way and are expected to be repaired tonight," Zhao Yiyu said.

9ae1c64781223026011cc33261f1f6caa1ef81e6.sourceText: 目前部分水文站水位已超过警戒线，水位仍在上涨。赵谊钰说：”目前北江水位还在上涨中，预计洪峰将在今晚２３时到清远附近上游的飞来峡水库。”据水文部门监测，北江清远站９日８时水位１１．５７米，连州站９１．０６米（超警戒水位０．０６米），阳山站６３．０６米（超警戒水位１．０６米），英德站２８．６５米（警戒水位２．６５米）。预计９日２０时，北江清远水文站水位将达到１２．３０米（超过警戒水位０．３米）。
9ae1c64781223026011cc33261f1f6caa1ef81e6.translatedText: At present, the water level at some hydrological stations has exceeded the warning line and the water level is still rising. Zhao Yiyu said: "The water level of the Beijiang River is still rising, and the flood peak is expected to reach the Feilaixia Reservoir in the upper reaches near Qingyuan at 23:00 tonight." According to monitoring by the hydrology department, the water level of the Qingyuan Station in the Beijiang River was 11.5 at 8:00 on the 9th. 7 meters, Lianzhou Station is 91.06 meters (0.06 meters above the warning level), Yangshan Station is 63.06 meters (1.06 meters above the warning level), and Yingde Station is 28.65 meters (the warning water level is 2.65 meters). It is expected that at 20:00 on the 9th, the water level at Qingyuan Hydrological Station in Beijiang will reach 12.30 meters (0.3 meters above the warning level).

9e4b21b51c4fb7ae19f045a7540b1aab8378c7ab.sourceText: 据统计，截至９日１３时，暴雨造成韶关市１人失踪，４８４００人受灾，９３０７３亩农作物受灾，２９９间房屋倒塌，６座桥梁被冲毁，３５００米河堤受损坏。韶关市三防办副主任黄剑新说，目前韶关受灾地区洪水已经消退，应该不会出现新的灾情。
9e4b21b51c4fb7ae19f045a7540b1aab8378c7ab.translatedText: According to statistics, as of 13:00 on the 9th, heavy rains caused one person to go missing in Shaoguan City, 48,400 people were affected, 93,073 acres of crops were damaged, 299 houses collapsed, 6 bridges were washed away, and 3,500 meters of river embankments were damaged. Huang Jianxin, deputy director of the Shaoguan Municipal Three-Way Prevention Office, said that the floods in the affected areas of Shaoguan have subsided and there should be no new disasters.

8997ef45fa33b421e3be915b5214c237a483e0e7.sourceText: 两岸三地游客首次“60天环游世界”圆满收官
8997ef45fa33b421e3be915b5214c237a483e0e7.translatedText: The first "Around the World in 60 Days" for tourists from the two sides and three places came to a successful conclusion

3dd7c472a310d0a37720d8e42c72a1de9bd6220c.sourceText: 两岸三地游客首次“60天环游世界”圆满收官 新华网 来自内地、香港及台湾的31位游客参加，游历大洋洲、南美…
3dd7c472a310d0a37720d8e42c72a1de9bd6220c.translatedText: The first "Around the World in 60 Days" for tourists from the two sides and the three places came to a successful conclusion Xinhuanet Thirty-one tourists from the Mainland, Hong Kong and Taiwan participated in the trip to Oceania and South America...

5cc050be7f7088b7f4aeba743090f93983a47b32.sourceText: 来自内地、香港及台湾的31位游客参加，游历大洋洲、南美洲、欧洲、亚洲等13个国家和地区的两岸三地游客首次”60天环游世界”，近日圆满收官。人均50万元人民币的这一顶极豪华旅游，开创了旅游市场的新纪录。
5cc050be7f7088b7f4aeba743090f93983a47b32.translatedText: Thirty-one tourists from the Mainland, Hong Kong and Taiwan participated and traveled to 13 countries and regions including Oceania, South America, Europe and Asia. The first "60 days around the world" for tourists from both sides of the Taiwan Straits and three regions came to a successful conclusion recently. This top luxury tour with an average per capita price of RMB 500,000 has set a new record in the tourism market.

8e884fa74d161ab166dd485752519609d333b368.sourceText: 这次环球旅行包括地球两极之旅，游客先后进入南极洲和北极圈，对他们而言考验的不仅仅是财富，更是时间与体能；而对旅游服务商来说，60天出入境13个国家和地区，体验各大洲最有代表性的景点、豪华酒店，以及新兴旅游大国的旅游服务，都是全新的尝试。
8e884fa74d161ab166dd485752519609d333b368.translatedText: This round-the-world trip includes a trip to the two poles of the earth. Tourists have entered Antarctica and the Arctic Circle. For them, it is not only a test of wealth, but also time and physical fitness. For tourism service providers, it is a brand-new attempt to enter and exit 13 countries and regions in 60 days and experience the most representative attractions and luxury hotels on each continent, as well as the tourism services of emerging tourist countries.

c484a6f975e771d9fe4fbb4a5f7ac28668522b64.sourceText: 此次环游世界产品由携程旅游、香港永安旅游、台湾易游网合作推出，体现了国家旅游局局长邵琪伟所说的两岸三地旅游业”从互相输送游客到全方位产业合作”的尝试。
c484a6f975e771d9fe4fbb4a5f7ac28668522b64.translatedText: This round-the-world product is jointly launched by Ctrip Travel, Hong Kong Wing On Travel, and Taiwan Easy Travel. It reflects what Shao Qiwei, director of the National Tourism Administration, said of the cross-strait and three-region tourism industry's attempt to "transport tourists to all-round industrial cooperation."

32d62c8ff6cadb91ec1790ca39b37e303c6f2f1d.sourceText: 顺利完成各大洲游历，刚刚回到居住地的团员，在对行程表示肯定的同时，对旅行有待调整处也直言不讳。
32d62c8ff6cadb91ec1790ca39b37e303c6f2f1d.translatedText: The group members who successfully completed their trip to various continents and have just returned to their place of residence expressed their affirmation of the itinerary and also spoke frankly about the adjustments that need to be made during the trip.

369c1e2b3bede34d4419aed957023017d5e64572.sourceText: 内地客人马先生的观点很有代表性，他认为两岸三地环游世界是一个非常好的创意，顶级豪华和浪漫概念很吸引人，”物有所值”甚至”物超所值”。但部分行程安排可参照客人喜好适当修改；可适当增加服务人员比例；在保证各地风味餐饮的情况下，根据中国人饮食习惯增加中餐；行程不能太紧凑，少数几程航班在午夜转机，到达目的地后需要休息较长时间。
369c1e2b3bede34d4419aed957023017d5e64572.translatedText: The views of Mr. Ma, a mainland guest, are very representative. He believes that traveling around the world in three places across the Taiwan Strait is a very good idea. The concept of top luxury and romance is very attractive, and it is "good value for money" or even "great value for money." However, part of the itinerary can be modified appropriately based on guests' preferences; the proportion of service personnel can be appropriately increased; while ensuring local food and beverages, Chinese food can be added according to Chinese eating habits; the itinerary should not be too compact. A few flights transfer at midnight and need to rest for a long time after arriving at the destination.

ea57aeb54e1b9724d969556a8ac0c25a8965d8b0.sourceText: 不过，马先生也认为”如此高难度的旅游团，有一些瑕疵和调整是正常的”，两岸三地游客在一个团里，也有利于他们之间加强情感沟通。
ea57aeb54e1b9724d969556a8ac0c25a8965d8b0.translatedText: However, Mr. Ma also believes that "it is normal for such a difficult tour group to have some flaws and adjustments." Being in a group with tourists from the three places across the Taiwan Strait is also conducive to strengthening emotional communication between them.

21b045abc2bddc381c46ade8540a4ca5c69aea50.sourceText: 携程旅行网副总裁郭东杰表示，此次”环游世界60天”不仅为高端旅游消费者提供了环游世界服务，而且在行程范围、顶级程度以及三地组团的形式等方面，都开创了旅游市场的新纪录。
21b045abc2bddc381c46ade8540a4ca5c69aea50.translatedText: Guo Dongjie, Vice President of Ctrip.com, said that this "Around the World in 60 Days" not only provides high-end travel consumers with around-the-world services, but also sets a new record in the tourism market in terms of the scope of the itinerary, the top level, and the format of the three-place group.

16b311e8ca0ed62212b4bc75e621e9d6b74639a0.sourceText: 网上调查显示，九成以上旅游者都有环游世界的梦想，但是否有足够的钱和空闲时间成为主要的阻碍。一位网民说：”环游世界是我的梦想，可惜现在因工作关系，很难成行，等我退休了吧。”另有一位网民说：”60天50万对我来说有点奢侈！有分段的吗？比如20天，30天，不同的团我可以尝试。”
16b311e8ca0ed62212b4bc75e621e9d6b74639a0.translatedText: Online surveys show that more than 90% of tourists have the dream of traveling around the world, but whether they have enough money and free time has become the main obstacle. One netizen said: "It is my dream to travel around the world, but unfortunately it is difficult to do it now due to work. I will wait until I retire." Another netizen said: "500,000 yuan in 60 days is a bit luxurious for me! Is there a segmented tour? For example, 20 days, 30 days, I can try different tours."

cd058e978d35cf8bbf43d49f87509e6adc9b69de.sourceText: 也有网友感叹，环游世界60天需要的不仅仅是财力支持，还需要充足的时间、充沛的体力、旺盛的精力、坚强的意志、乐观的精神，这种超常规旅游大概只适合少数人。
cd058e978d35cf8bbf43d49f87509e6adc9b69de.translatedText: Some netizens lamented that traveling around the world for 60 days requires not only financial support, but also sufficient time, abundant physical strength, strong energy, strong will, and optimistic spirit. This kind of unconventional travel is probably only suitable for a few people.

ae4fd4b8d8205bcb6f6476bd99e0ae39f287307e.sourceText: [人間社 善全 美國亞利桑那州鳳凰城報導] 適逢佛誕節與母親節，美國亞利桑那州佛光山鳳凰城禪淨中心與國際佛光會鳳凰城協會從5月12日至5月13日共同舉辦了2024年浴佛祈福法會，素食園遊會與雲水浴佛活動。雖然炎熱的夏日溫度已超過100°F(38°C)，但是近一百多位信眾和佛光之友仍然無畏高溫，踴躍參加活動，共霑法喜。 祈福法會中，鳳凰城禪淨中心的永善法師帶領大眾誦持《心經》後開示提到浴佛的真正意義，希望大眾在淨水沐浴佛像之外，也清洗各自的內在污垢，淨化身心，心懷慈悲地一起祈願世界和平，同體共生與共榮。為慶祝母親節，法師也親自送上康乃馨給現場的每位母親，祝愿天下母親「身體健康，平安吉祥」。 在園遊會中，鳳凰城協會會長畢秋鳳與幹部，會員一起推出了多元化的美味素食，推廣「蔬食A計劃」，提倡素食不但可以活出健康的身體，也可以同時環保救地球。另外，協會也提供了多項義賣，將所得的募款捐贈到安寧中心，兒童癌症醫院，和無家可歸者收容所。 為方便行動不便的長者或工作不便的大眾，協會特別在商店和老人公寓里設置了雲水浴佛，讓不能前往祈福法會的大眾能與佛結緣，共沐佛恩。 西人Katherina也滿臉歡喜地分享了她的感受，“我剛好做完了運動，無意經過。一位可愛的小女孩竟然帶著甜美的微笑送了我一碗紅豆刨冰，讓我及時解渴。她真是人間的小天使。從她身上我可以感受到佛光人的三好, 說好話、做好事、存好心, 和四給精神，給人信心、給人歡喜、給人希望、給人方便。小妹妹是一位好榜樣！她的父母應該為她而自豪!” 其中參加了雲水浴佛的李翠棠菩薩說，“我今年90歲了，非常感動與感恩，大家還記得我，讓我可以在家浴佛。好開心看到Q萌的悉達多太子，他好像對我在笑呢!” 活動後其中一位會員李慧玲師姐表示，非常感謝佛光山開山祖師星雲大師。因為大師才有佛光會。感恩同修和兩位兒子再次參加素食義賣行列，把握當下，播下人間佛教的種子，與大眾結善緣！ 圖片一 慶祝佛誕浴佛活動 圖片二 雲水浴佛方便年長老弱 圖片三 慶祝母親節 圖片四 素食義賣推廣素食
ae4fd4b8d8205bcb6f6476bd99e0ae39f287307e.translatedText: [Human Society Shanquan Report from Phoenix, Arizona, USA] On the occasion of Buddha’s Birthday and Mother’s Day, the Fo Guang Shan Phoenix Zen Purification Center in Arizona, USA, and the Phoenix Association of the International Buddha’s Light Society jointly organized the 2024 Buddha Bathing Prayer Ceremony, Vegetarian Garden Party and Cloud Water Bathing Buddha Activities from May 12 to May 13. Although the hot summer temperature has exceeded 100°F (38°C), nearly a hundred believers and friends of Buddha's Light are still fearless of the heat and actively participate in the activities to enjoy the Dharma. During the blessing ceremony, Master Yongshan of the Phoenix Zen Purification Center led the public to recite the Heart Sutra and then gave a lecture on the true meaning of bathing the Buddha. He hoped that in addition to bathing the Buddha statue in pure water, the public would also wash away their own inner dirt, purify the body and mind, and pray together with compassion for world peace, coexistence and common prosperity. To celebrate Mother's Day, the Master personally sent carnations to every mother present, wishing all mothers in the world "good health, peace and prosperity." At the garden party, Phoenix Association President Bi Qiufeng, together with officials and members, launched a variety of delicious vegetarian dishes to promote the "Vegetarian Plan A", advocating that vegetarianism can not only lead a healthy body, but also protect the environment and save the earth. In addition, the association also held a number of charity sales and donated the proceeds to hospice centers, children's cancer hospitals, and homeless shelters. For the convenience of the elderly with limited mobility or people with working difficulties, the association has specially set up cloud-water bathing Buddhas in shops and apartments for the elderly, so that people who cannot go to the blessing ceremony can get connected with the Buddha and bask in the blessings of the Buddha together. Katherina, a Westerner, also shared her feelings with joy on her face, "I just finished my exercise and happened to pass by by accident. A cute little girl gave me a bowl of red bean shaved ice with a sweet smile, which helped me quench my thirst in time. She is really a little angel in the world. From her, I can feel the three virtues of the Buddha's Light people, which is to say good things, do good deeds, and have good intentions. The spirit of harmony gives people confidence, joy, hope and convenience. My little sister is a good role model! Her parents should be proud of her!" Bodhisattva Li Cuitang, who participated in the Yunshui Buddha Bathing, said, "I am 90 years old and I am very touched and grateful that everyone still remembers me and allows me to bathe in the Buddha at home. I am so happy to see the cute Prince Siddhartha. He seems to be smiling at me!" After the event, one of the members, Sister Li Huiling, said she was very grateful to Master Hsing Yun, the founder of Fo Guang Shan. It’s because of the Master that the Buddha’s Light Society exists. I am grateful to fellow practitioners and my two sons for participating in the vegetarian charity sale again, seizing the moment, sowing the seeds of humanistic Buddhism, and forming good relationships with the public! Picture 1: Buddha bathing activity to celebrate the birthday of Buddha; Picture 2: Bathing Buddha in cloud water to benefit the elderly and infirm; Picture 3: Celebrating Mother’s Day; Picture 4: Vegetarian charity sale to promote vegetarianism.

7cf6793a609efb33c53e68a70273e4e5ae0a7e78.sourceText: 离开北溪庙，我们去到奥列维尔（Oroville)，参观被列入“美国国家史迹名录”中的《列圣宫》。
7cf6793a609efb33c53e68a70273e4e5ae0a7e78.translatedText: After leaving Bei Xi Temple, we went to Oroville to visit the Holy Palace, which is listed on the National Register of Historic Places.

5b0bcd705886a8d1fec51c0aa1743666c5245e82.sourceText: 与庙宇工作人员合照 摄影 李苏
5b0bcd705886a8d1fec51c0aa1743666c5245e82.translatedText: Taking photos with temple staff Photography Li Su

d145e0e7ee26282b14cf64d7a29c38c25e7d5442.sourceText: 如果问我对这次旅游最大的收获是什么，我会回答：亲历当年中国人淘金和筑路的原址，实地感受到华人先辈创业的艰辛和取得的成就，步行唐人街，亲临黄安杂货店，脚踏中国营地，观察淘金小溪，手撫百年残墙等等，这都是可触碰到的实物，比我在虚拟电脑前所看到的资料，是截然不同的真实感受。今天我来到列圣宫，则有另类的探究：百年前的华人先辈，除了留下物质上的遗产，在精神文化方面也给我们留下了些什么？
d145e0e7ee26282b14cf64d7a29c38c25e7d5442.translatedText: If you ask me what is the biggest gain from this trip, I will answer: personally experiencing the original site where the Chinese gold mined and built roads, feeling the hardships and achievements of the Chinese ancestors in entrepreneurship, walking in Chinatown, visiting Huang'an Grocery Store, stepping into the Chinese camp, observing the gold rush creek, touching the century-old ruins of the wall, etc. These are all tangible objects. Compared with the information I saw in front of the virtual computer, it is a completely different real experience.今天我来到列圣宫，则有另类的探究：百年前的华人先辈，除了留下物质上的遗产，在精神文化方面也给我们留下了些什么？

9bfc47566e7558a1881eef12b3c90bf4dbe2a3dc.sourceText: 北溪庙是道观，而列圣宫是佛寺。这寺庙曾得到过清朝政府的资助，注意这个关健词，表示此庙有了与众不同的“皇气加持”！一些物件从中国运抵此地，有很多物件也有较早年份的准确标记。
9bfc47566e7558a1881eef12b3c90bf4dbe2a3dc.translatedText: Beixi Temple is a Taoist temple, while Liesheng Palace is a Buddhist temple. This temple was funded by the Qing Dynasty government. Pay attention to this key word, which means that this temple has a unique "imperial blessing"! Some objects arrived here from China, and many also have accurate markings from an earlier date.

6ca28fe9d042bd5557a1624862cb8b3abb12582b.sourceText: 1850年前后，离乡背井而远度重洋的华人，为了寻求精神上的支撑，在此地集资建造了第一座的佛教寺庙，但因採用木质架构来建造，寺庙曾被火烧毁过两次。
6ca28fe9d042bd5557a1624862cb8b3abb12582b.translatedText: Around 1850, the Chinese who left their hometown and traveled across the ocean raised funds to build the first Buddhist temple here in order to seek spiritual support. However, because it was built with a wooden structure, the temple was destroyed by fire twice.

40bc6639f60214ddce2b538a5f384137cb416707.sourceText: 清皇朝也十分明白，当年输出了劳工，亦需要让中华文化在异域落地生根，方能让移民怀恩念祖，有利于教化。于是，列圣宫的第三次重建，得到了同治皇帝的资助，寺庙改由红砖所建，于1863年9月完工，並一直保存至今。
40bc6639f60214ddce2b538a5f384137cb416707.translatedText: The Qing Dynasty also understood very well that after they exported workers, they also needed to allow Chinese culture to take root in foreign lands so that immigrants could remember their ancestors and be civilized. Therefore, the third reconstruction of Lisheng Palace was funded by Emperor Tongzhi. The temple was built with red bricks. It was completed in September 1863 and has been preserved to this day.

123c494aba6360021e944928beb5d90a32d93007.sourceText: 淘金时代的中国劳工，最终将列圣宫建成有儒、道、佛三教的礼拜场所，供奉着关公、华佗和天后的主神位，还有门神、土地公和八仙等等，之后还加上一位“驱除瘟神”的陈氏先祖绥靖伯。
123c494aba6360021e944928beb5d90a32d93007.translatedText: Chinese laborers during the gold rush era eventually built Lieshenggong into a place of worship for Confucianism, Taoism and Buddhism, enshrining the main gods of Guan Gong, Hua Tuo and Tian Hou, as well as the door god, Tu Tu Gong and the Eight Immortals, etc. Later, a Chen family ancestor, Emperor Bo of Appeasement, who "expelled the god of plague" was added.

c8c6ff2213efdb58c313ba4a6cb3eff0b43903a1.sourceText: 笔者认为，关帝代表着忠义仁勇，这是维系封建文化的精神支柱。华陀祛病去瘟，华工劳动强度大而体质较弱，在缺医少药的情况下，参拜华陀是一种心灵安慰和精神治疗的方法。天后是一位释道兼修的仙姑，为人占卜祸福为事，羽化之后，保祐海洋平安航行，並视为慈航观音的化身。天后原称妈祖，是福建蒲田人氏，终身未婚，受历代皇帝褒封多次直至“天后”。对于当年的华工，探亲、娶妻和携带家人来美，诚心祈求天后的保祐而平安到达，此乃是至关重要的事情。
c8c6ff2213efdb58c313ba4a6cb3eff0b43903a1.translatedText: The author believes that Emperor Guan represents loyalty, justice, benevolence and courage, which is the spiritual pillar that maintains feudal culture. Hua Tuo can cure diseases and plagues. Chinese workers have high labor intensity and weak constitutions. In the absence of medical treatment and medicine, visiting Hua Tuo is a method of spiritual comfort and spiritual healing. The Queen of Heaven is a Buddhist fairy who also practices Taoism. She divines fortunes and fortunes for people. After becoming an immortal, she protects the safe navigation of the ocean and is regarded as the incarnation of Guanyin. The Queen of Heaven was originally called Mazu. She was a native of Putian, Fujian Province. She was never married and was praised many times by emperors of all dynasties until she was named "Queen of Heaven". For the Chinese workers back then, when visiting relatives, getting married, and bringing their families to the United States, it was very important to sincerely pray for God’s blessing and arrive safely.

673bf78a29b83399e523c1add30f89538a27de75.sourceText: 寺庙前的铁鼎 攝影 李苏
673bf78a29b83399e523c1add30f89538a27de75.translatedText: The iron tripod in front of the temple Photography by Li Su

a26e004516d664d17a0b38de38eb9092cc4d82b3.sourceText: 列圣宫前的生铁鼎是由中国运抵。华人先侨孝心念祖，敬畏天神，尊崇帝皇，寺庙中可看到由绒布刺绣制成的大帅旗，皇家巡遊的罗伞，各种牌匾不可胜数！这些以前只能从相片上看到的平面图，现在都历历在目展现在眼前，令人恍如隔世，又似时空穿越，如不是身在其中，则无法见其真章，领略其精神。
a26e004516d664d17a0b38de38eb9092cc4d82b3.translatedText: The cast iron tripod in front of the Liesheng Palace was shipped from China. The Chinese ancestors were filial to their ancestors, feared the gods, and respected the emperor. In the temples, you can see the flags made of velvet embroidery, the umbrellas used for royal parades, and countless plaques! These floor plans that could only be seen from photos in the past are now vividly displayed before our eyes, making us feel like we are in another world, and like traveling through time and space. If we are not in it, we cannot see its true meaning and appreciate its spirit.

5efe2f17ccdebb96917effca342451af29e34a92.sourceText: 门神秦琼、尉迟恭 攝影 李苏
5efe2f17ccdebb96917effca342451af29e34a92.translatedText: 门神秦琼、尉迟恭 摄影Li Su

53a689719f491d3cf5e026894bee3ed532391184.translatedText: From left: Hualun, Guandi, and Tianhou

c0f8fa9647e43ef7bfda2bb85109a356d133efe5.translatedText: The commander-in-chief's banner used during the parade in Liesheng Palace

c0952823f9cc6f94a3a3601e80ac65f427815a99.sourceText: 织锦遮阳罗伞，光绪十六年（1890年）
c0952823f9cc6f94a3a3601e80ac65f427815a99.translatedText: Brocade sunshade umbrella, the 16th year of Guangxu (1890)

2c0a722c4bb067fa8e0dd482d3534ba9d3721aa2.translatedText: >Plaque of the Thirteenth Year of Guangxu (1887)

2b3c5d5eea0c2fbd4673a6ff8b84670fc3504d79.sourceText: 1907年，大洪水破坏了寺庙，加上当时美国出现的大萧条导致大量华人迁出或返回中国，留下的华人继续维持该庙宇，尤其是陈氏族人。1937年，陈氏家族把列圣宫交付给奥罗维尔市政府保存，之后建为博物馆至今。
2b3c5d5eea0c2fbd4673a6ff8b84670fc3504d79.translatedText: In 1907, the flood destroyed the temple, and the Great Depression in the United States at that time caused a large number of Chinese to move out or return to China. The remaining Chinese continued to maintain the temple, especially the Chen clan. In 1937, the Chen family handed over the Holy Palace to the Oroville city government for preservation, and then built it as a museum to this day.

966fd42b5213ff1d0d7f69c10e608f0b8deaa52b.sourceText: 北溪庙和列圣宫，保留着中国移民早期来美国的历史物件和精神财富，值得花更多的时间来领会和欣赏，希望日后能旧地重游。
966fd42b5213ff1d0d7f69c10e608f0b8deaa52b.translatedText: Bei Khe Temple and the Temple of Saints retain the historical objects and spiritual wealth of the early Chinese immigrants who came to the United States. It is worth spending more time to understand and appreciate, and I hope to visit the old places again in the future.

9dfef026c68f7945a34653b67e35a10bd611137e.sourceText: 由亚省艺术学院、钱德勒市政府和美国华人联合会（亚省分会）共同举办的2023年亚省春晚于1月15日晚在钱德勒艺术中心圆满落幕，也打响了本地华人庆祝农历新年的第一炮。钱德勒市长Kevin Hartke和 Councilmember Christine Ellis莅临了本场晚会，并予以了高度评价。 当天下午四点半，华人社区各社团负责人以及长期支持亚裔社区活动的各族裔朋友，早早就来应邀来到了春晚前的新年招待会，觥筹交错，举杯同庆。7点整，台下高朋满座，在一阵爆竹声中，大幕拉开，彩绸飘，锣鼓响，热闹的氛围感染了所有观众。当天的节目精彩纷呈，古典舞、民族舞、现代舞、K-pop、京剧、合唱、器乐演奏、名家独唱、少林功夫等轮番登场。亚省艺术学院的舞蹈《月光》，独舞演员的曼妙身姿以剪影的形式在一轮明月前翩然起舞，让台下观众拍案叫绝。成人舞蹈班的学员们真正体现了什么是能歌善舞，他们多年都是以舞蹈形式登台，今年献上的是表演唱《回娘家》，多声部完美配合，表情生动，丰富了歌曲的艺术表现力。器乐合奏《太阳出来喜洋洋》的表演者是本地在读学生，精熟西洋乐器的他们第一次尝试中国四川的原生态民歌音乐风格，也是当天晚会的一大亮点。整台晚会东西方艺术合璧、演出水准很高，观众掌声不断，好评如潮。自媒体时代，一场盛会的成功，马上就在社交平台上掀起刷屏之势。发布在微信朋友圈的照片、视频获得的点赞、转发都可谓空前。观众纷纷发来赞誉“亚省春晚名不虚传！节目质量杠杠滴！”“看完晚会俩娃一路都很兴奋，讨论自己最喜欢哪个节目，讨论中国少数民族的服饰。还主动要求去学习中国舞，这着实让我喜出望外！” “看到中文节目单，隽隽居然说想要学习汉字。果然，孩子的兴趣就是最好的内驱力。”…… 新春伊始， 辞旧迎新，对于每个华人来说都特别有意义。晚会在解本地华人的思乡之情、凝聚华人社区的同时，也向美国朋友推介了中国传统文化艺术。“亚省春晚”已经举办了十几年，早已成为大凤凰城地区欢庆中国新年活动的一道亮丽风景，也起到了传播中华文化、搭建中美文化桥梁重要作用。远在海外的我们守望相助，拼搏进取，将继续秉持团结协作精神，促进多元文化的共同发展与繁荣。本次演出的一大亮点就是由不同族裔艺术团体担纲，体现了我们共建多元化、公平性和包容性（Diversity，Equity, Inclusion，简称DEI）未来的美好愿景。 感谢组委会成员辛勤的组织工作和所有演职人员的刻苦排练，感谢协办单位和晚会的赞助商，同样感谢义工朋友的辛勤付出。祝愿大家新的一年前“兔”无量，“兔“飞猛进，！（亚省艺术学院供稿）
9dfef026c68f7945a34653b67e35a10bd611137e.translatedText: The 2023 Alberta Spring Festival Gala, co-organized by the Alberta College of the Arts, the Chandler City Government and the Federation of Chinese Americans (Alberta Chapter), concluded successfully on the evening of January 15th at the Chandler Arts Center, marking the first time for local Chinese to celebrate the Lunar New Year. Chandler Mayor Kevin Hartke and Councilmember Christine Ellis attended the party and spoke highly of it. At 4:30 that afternoon, the heads of various associations in the Chinese community and friends of various ethnic groups who have long supported Asian community activities came early to be invited to the New Year reception before the Spring Festival Gala, where they drank and toasted together. At 7 o'clock sharp, the audience was full of guests. Amidst the sound of firecrackers, the curtain opened, colorful silks floated, gongs and drums sounded, and the lively atmosphere infected all the audience. The program of the day was exciting, with classical dance, folk dance, modern dance, K-pop, Peking opera, chorus, instrumental performance, celebrity solos, Shaolin Kung Fu, etc. taking turns to appear. In the dance "Moonlight" performed by the Art Institute of Alberta, the solo dancer's graceful figure danced gracefully in the form of a silhouette in front of a bright moon, which wowed the audience. The students in the adult dance class truly embody what it means to be good at singing and dancing. They have been on stage in the form of dance for many years. This year, they performed "Go Back to My Mother's Home". The multi-voice parts cooperated perfectly and the expressions were vivid, which enriched the artistic expression of the song. The performers of the instrumental ensemble "The Sun Comes Out" were local students. They were proficient in Western instruments and tried the original folk music style of Sichuan, China for the first time. It was also a highlight of the evening party. The entire evening show was a combination of Eastern and Western art, and the performance was of a very high standard. The audience applauded continuously and received rave reviews. In the era of self-media, the success of a grand event will immediately set off a trend of overwhelming the social media platforms. Photos and videos posted in WeChat Moments have received unprecedented likes and reposts. The audience sent in praises, "The Alberta Spring Festival Gala is well-deserved! The quality of the program is outstanding!" "After watching the party, the two children were very excited all the way, discussing which program they liked best and the costumes of Chinese ethnic minorities. They also actively asked to learn Chinese dance, which really surprised me!" "Seeing the Chinese program, Juan Jun actually said that he wanted to learn Chinese characters. Sure enough, children's interest is the best internal driving force."... At the beginning of the new year, Saying farewell to the old and welcoming the new is particularly meaningful to every Chinese. The party not only relieved the homesickness of local Chinese and united the Chinese community, but also introduced traditional Chinese culture and art to American friends. The "Alberta Spring Festival Gala" has been held for more than ten years and has long become a beautiful scenery in the greater Phoenix area to celebrate the Chinese New Year. It has also played an important role in spreading Chinese culture and building a cultural bridge between China and the United States. We, overseas, are helping each other, working hard and forging ahead, and will continue to uphold the spirit of unity and collaboration to promote the common development and prosperity of multiculturalism. One of the highlights of this performance is that it is performed by art groups of different ethnic groups, which reflects our beautiful vision of building a future of diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI). Thanks to the organizing committee members for their hard organizational work and all the cast and crew for their hard rehearsals, to the co-organizers and sponsors of the party, and to the volunteers for their hard work. I wish you all that the "rabbits" will be boundless and the "rabbits" will make rapid progress in the new year! (Contributed by the Alberta College of Art)

029919f463a73b855f22f966eb961b690cfabc95.sourceText: 弗拉格斯塔夫（Flagstaff）最早的华人家庭，共有十二个兄弟姊妹。我们在此叙述其中的几位。
029919f463a73b855f22f966eb961b690cfabc95.translatedText: The earliest Chinese family in Flagstaff, with a total of twelve brothers and sisters. We describe some of them here.

603bc81499032b9decd6f8f3a7e05862f49aa5fb.sourceText: 黄炳芬（George June wong），他在洗衣店中的工作是维护大型洗衣机。他是亚利桑那州国民警卫队第158步兵团Bushmasters部队中的一员。第二次世界大战爆发后，他应征入伍，被送到德克萨斯的一个基地接受培训，之后被派到欧洲战场。由于他的身材矮小，也许还有他的种族的原因，他主要是作为乔治·卢卡斯将军的助手，乔治·卢卡斯将军指挥了意大利安齐奥海滩的战役。在战场中，他是乘吉普车而不像其他步兵那样步行，这是对他的奖励。 黄炳芬是战后能回到家中的幸运者之一，他为母亲带回了意大利纪念品。退役后，他经营地毯和家具清洁业务，并开启了地毯和地板安装大师的职业生涯。 他去世时年仅58岁。
603bc81499032b9decd6f8f3a7e05862f49aa5fb.translatedText: George June wong, his job in the laundry is to maintain large washing machines. He is a member of the Bushmasters, 158th Infantry Regiment, Arizona National Guard. After the outbreak of World War II, he was drafted into the Army and sent to a base in Texas for training before being sent to the European battlefield. Due to his small stature and perhaps his race, he served primarily as an aide to General George Lucas, who commanded the Battle of Anzio Beach in Italy. In the battlefield, he was rewarded by traveling in a jeep instead of walking like other infantrymen. Huang Bingfen was one of the lucky ones to return home after the war and brought back Italian souvenirs for his mother. After retirement, he ran a carpet and furniture cleaning business and began a career as a master carpet and floor installer. He was only 58 years old when he died.

8e90fc0e74cfc7318a5ef697451c4da3f2feeae9.sourceText: 黄炳辉（Robert Lincoln June），在第二次世界大战期间，他加入美国海军，并在长滩造船厂担任船舶设计的大部分职务。退役后后，他和兄弟Lema创立了家具和地板的企业。
8e90fc0e74cfc7318a5ef697451c4da3f2feeae9.translatedText: Robert Lincoln June, during World War II, he joined the U.S. Navy and held most of the ship design positions at Long Beach Shipyard. After retiring, he and his brother Lema founded a furniture and flooring business.

e5e61655813223f1c165ec974f2144c13a4b6cce.sourceText: William JuneWong，（书中没有留下中文名字），家人亲切称他为“Lema”。他在1943年被征召入伍，被派往美国陆军航空队。 满足了他成为一名飞行员的梦想。他以最令人满意的方式通过了入学考试，被任命为投弹手。他在加利福尼亚州维克多维尔（Victorville）进行轰炸机训练后，成为马里亚纳群岛的第七军航空兵中的一员。他是B-24轰炸机的投弹手，执行了50多次任务，定期去击中目标。 轰炸机要扔下100磅和500磅炸弹，并要查看下方的敌方设施和飞机遭到破坏情况。
e5e61655813223f1c165ec974f2144c13a4b6cce.translatedText: >William JuneWong, (no Chinese name left in the book), his family affectionately calls him "Lema". He was drafted into the Army in 1943 and assigned to the United States Army Air Forces. Fulfilling his dream of becoming a pilot. He passed the entrance examination most satisfactorily and was appointed bombardier. After training as a bomber in Victorville, California, he became a member of the Seventh Army Aviation Corps in the Mariana Islands. He was a bombardier on a B-24 bomber and flew more than 50 missions, regularly hitting targets. The bombers would drop 100-pound and 500-pound bombs and view damage to enemy facilities and aircraft below.

066400bd63af4fd38be36bb0da8bfc8f801ec23b.sourceText: Lema执行的战斗飞行任务总计超过600个小时，飞行了75,000英里。在太平洋上飞越了环礁岛的夸瓦林，沃特耶，马绍拉群岛的马洛拉普，以及波那普，雅浦，威克，关岛，奇奇马岛和硫磺岛。他讲述过真实战争的故事：“有一些艰难的时刻。 我们的轰炸机被击中两次，一次是在特鲁克号上，当时一块大块的防空弹片在左侧机翼上打了一个洞。“另一次是在硫磺岛上，有一枚7.5毫米的子弹从飞机机头右侧的打了进来。在关岛执行任务时，一架日本零式战斗机袭击了飞机前部，Lema开了约100发子弹。 他被称为“装备王”，被授予五枚勋章，并获得了杰出飞行十字勋章和航空勋章。
066400bd63af4fd38be36bb0da8bfc8f801ec23b.translatedText: Lema has flown more than 600 hours of combat missions and flown 75,000 miles. In the Pacific, it flew over the atolls of Kwavarin, Waterje, and Malolapu in the Masora Islands, as well as Pohnpei, Yap, Wake, Guam, Chichima, and Iwo Jima. He told real-life war stories: "There were some tough moments. Our bomber was hit twice, once on the Truk when a large piece of anti-aircraft shrapnel punched a hole in the left wing. "The other time was on Iwo Jima when a 7.5mm bullet came through the right side of the nose of the aircraft. While on a mission in Guam, a Japanese Zero fighter struck the front of the aircraft and Lema fired about 100 rounds. Known as the "King of Equipment", he was decorated with five decorations and received the Distinguished Flying Cross and the Air Medal.

cdd02320f769aed9ed936eb9e22818c989ae9428.sourceText: 1945年二战结束后，Lema留在陆军航空兵部队接受飞行员训练，直到1945年12月4日退役。是母亲最喜欢的儿子，也是她的英雄儿子！
cdd02320f769aed9ed936eb9e22818c989ae9428.translatedText: After the end of World War II in 1945, Lema stayed in the Army Air Corps to receive pilot training until his retirement on December 4, 1945. He is his mother's favorite son and her hero son!

b61a2c23c1b9e4c04276b8d65acf0ca08b7e5c77.sourceText: Lema一直是家庭中每个人最喜欢的兄弟，不仅因为他是一名真正的战斗英雄，而且随着父母的离去，他对家庭的热爱将我们凝聚在一起。他的许多勇气和战时经历使事情变得简单。
b61a2c23c1b9e4c04276b8d65acf0ca08b7e5c77.translatedText: Lema has always been everyone's favorite brother in the family, not only because he was a true fighting hero, but also because his love for family held us together as his parents passed away. His many courage and wartime experiences made things easy.

ef62ae5f38d8aecdea12ddae16e6503b6837c17c.sourceText: 大家都知道必须在没有母亲的情况下尽力生存下去。作者当时年纪尚小，姐姐玛格丽特（Margaret）和哥哥Lema成为家中的领导，共同守护着这个黄氏家族。他们是使家庭团结在一起，直到每个人都走上自己的生活道路。
ef62ae5f38d8aecdea12ddae16e6503b6837c17c.translatedText: Everyone knows that they must try their best to survive without their mother. The author was still young at the time, and his sister Margaret and brother Lema became the leaders of the family, guarding the Huang family together. They are the ones that keep the family together until everyone takes their own path in life.

0b49f67bfc4d89ef47f621bd4e38faa3da9833e9.sourceText: 作者黄炳海（Jimmy June Wong），在众多的兄弟姐妹之中，是唯一在图森（Tucson）上过大学的一位，并成为了牙科医生。在撰写这本书中时，他姐姐玛格丽特Margaret已经 96 岁， 她有着与生俱来的家庭感， 提供了许多有关她父亲与所有兄弟姐妹一起洗衣店中成长的记忆信息。 保存了许多关于这个家庭历史的论文，图片，文件和纪念品。
0b49f67bfc4d89ef47f621bd4e38faa3da9833e9.translatedText: The author Jimmy June Wong, among many brothers and sisters, is the only one who went to college in Tucson and became a dentist. His sister Margaret, who was 96 when the book was written, had an innate sense of family and provided many memories of her father growing up in a laundromat with all his siblings. Many papers, pictures, documents and memorabilia about the family's history have been preserved.

5797fc92779e9048ced1c465cc74195a983da526.sourceText: 在80岁时出版这本 《永不孤单》（Never Alone ）的书，是他对这个家庭和家族的热爱，以及有担当的一份责任, 觉得有必要讲述一个历史时期内在一个小镇上的大家庭中的故事。此本英文版的书籍连相片、文件等共有228页。目前也尚未有翻译的中文版本，网上也没有可以原文可阅读。编者是通过购买书籍，从而了解到这个在弗拉格斯塔夫，甚至是亚利桑那州华人家庭历史最早的一个纪录，毕竟无论在时间和地域，其跨度都是如此的大，内容是如此的丰富。
5797fc92779e9048ced1c465cc74195a983da526.translatedText: Publishing the book "Never Alone" at the age of 80 was a result of his love for this family and his responsibility. He felt that it was necessary to tell the story of a big family in a small town during a historical period. This English version of the book has a total of 228 pages including photos, documents, etc. There is currently no translated Chinese version, and the original text is not available online. The editor learned about this record by purchasing books, which is the earliest record of Chinese family history in Flagstaff and even Arizona. After all, its span is so large and its content is so rich, both in time and region.

89027be502dec7503c96b4c92bf39ba84b891276.sourceText: 同时要指出的是，因限于篇幅，本文是摘译和编辑了其中的主要内容向大家介绍，本文中的图片也来自《永不孤单》一书。编者在编译中难免会有错漏，其内容请以原英文版本为准。
89027be502dec7503c96b4c92bf39ba84b891276.translatedText: At the same time, it should be pointed out that due to space limitations, this article has excerpted and edited the main contents to introduce to you. The pictures in this article are also from the book "Never Alone". The editor will inevitably make errors and omissions during compilation. Please refer to the original English version for its content.

2f913fbb8c0422af587c891d8263a79ecaeb1a0f.sourceText: 我们在此仅向作者黄炳海和Margaret至以祟高的敬意！
2f913fbb8c0422af587c891d8263a79ecaeb1a0f.translatedText: We would like to express our highest respect to the authors Huang Binghai and Margaret!

af6d3c09e02243feaeefb49b8527f03b4fdf8b0a.sourceText: 在刚刚结束的2021-2022国际“桃李杯”舞蹈大赛春季群舞决赛中，亚省艺术学院选送的两支舞蹈取得了骄人成绩，《且吟春雨》获得十佳铂金奖，《溯跃》获得铂金奖及最佳魅力奖。
af6d3c09e02243feaeefb49b8527f03b4fdf8b0a.translatedText: In the spring group dance finals of the just-concluded 2021-2022 International "Taoli Cup" Dance Competition, the two dances selected by the Art Institute of Alberta achieved remarkable results. "Singing the Spring Rain" won the Top Ten Platinum Award, and "Tracing the Jump" won the Platinum Award and the Best Charm Award.

71f82b34ffe365f6d4fb76aecca9507c7dad027d.sourceText: 平均年龄不到10岁的小舞者们以中国古典舞《且吟春雨》不仅获得她们年龄组的第一名，更是斩获整个群舞比赛的最高奖——十佳铂金奖。这是从85支由世界各国推选的竞技舞蹈中脱颖而出，获得了仅有的6个十佳铂金奖之一。
71f82b34ffe365f6d4fb76aecca9507c7dad027d.translatedText: The young dancers with an average age of less than 10 years old not only won the first place in their age group with the Chinese classical dance "Singing the Spring Rain", but also won the highest award in the entire group dance competition - the Top Ten Platinum Award. This dance stood out from 85 competitive dances selected by countries around the world and won one of only 6 top ten platinum awards.

6cd0cadf114c9ce051e4ba549be549a386957a86.sourceText: 《溯跃》是一支题材新颖的中国民间舞，舞蹈的基本元素取自海阳秧歌，并加以高阶的艺术形式进行表达。舞者们演绎的鱼儿在溪水中畅游，在激流中勇进，挥洒自如的绸扇也如同鱼尾摆动，浪花翻滚。亚省艺术学院成人班的舞蹈生们来自不同的工作岗位，她们用自己的业余时间来学习舞蹈。这次比赛她们用自己的方式诠释了这支舞蹈，征服了在场的所有评委和观众，获得本次比赛唯一的“最具魅力奖”和铂金奖。
6cd0cadf114c9ce051e4ba549be549a386957a86.translatedText: "Suiyue" is a Chinese folk dance with a novel theme. The basic elements of the dance are taken from Haiyang Yangge and expressed in high-level art forms. The dancers performed fish swimming in the stream and advancing bravely in the rapids. The silk fans swayed freely like fish tails and the waves rolled. Dance students in the adult class at the Alberta College of the Arts come from different jobs and use their spare time to learn dance. In this competition, they interpreted this dance in their own way, conquered all the judges and audiences present, and won the only "Most Charming Award" and Platinum Award in this competition.

9a724660f5f76bd0aa8c5d00c84fdbf4757816db.sourceText: 再次恭喜所有获奖的舞者，她们精彩的演绎也展现了北美华人艺术生活的一部分。台上一分钟，台下十年功，那么平时这些舞者都要经历怎样的训练，才能有如此曼妙的身材和灵活的肢体表现能力呢？让我们走进亚省艺术学院的幕后，看看她们平时基本功的训练。
9a724660f5f76bd0aa8c5d00c84fdbf4757816db.translatedText: Congratulations again to all the award-winning dancers. Their wonderful performances also show a part of the artistic life of Chinese in North America. One minute on stage, ten years of hard work off stage, so what kind of training do these dancers have to go through in order to have such graceful figures and flexible body expressions? Let’s go behind the scenes at the Art Institute of Alberta and see their daily basic skills training.

239781a1beef647f441e1266bfa24e05d20fdf6b.translatedText: If you also want to join them

6613e1a9d220472c9f1fc31a827f0bd9de96ab85.translatedText: please contact the Alberta College of Art:

fd0dffc1259c2ef4973bb51b77071f8277b0a7d8.sourceText: 由亚省艺术学院和钱德勒市政府联合主办的2022年亚省春晚—Chinese New Year Show for Our Heroes 于2月5日晚在钱德勒市汉密尔顿高中礼堂举行。这不仅是一次传统的庆祝农历新年的文化艺术盛会，也是为警察、消防员、医护等一线抗疫人员奉上的感恩回馈活动。
fd0dffc1259c2ef4973bb51b77071f8277b0a7d8.translatedText: The 2022 Alberta Spring Festival Gala—Chinese New Year Show for Our Heroes, co-sponsored by the Alberta College of the Arts and the City of Chandler, was held on the evening of February 5th at the auditorium of Hamilton High School in Chandler. This is not only a traditional cultural and artistic event to celebrate the Lunar New Year, but also a gratitude and feedback event for frontline anti-epidemic personnel such as police, firefighters, and medical staff.

a13100ff56bebe428a6da71acd6722a22aedab25.sourceText: 当夜，剧场座无虚席，其中不乏从凤凰城驱车一小时来领略东方艺术的观众。整台晚会东西方艺术合璧、演出水准很高，观众掌声不断，好评如潮。晚会节目包括古典舞、民族舞、现代舞、Kpop、歌剧、京剧、独唱、童声合唱、少林功夫等。其中，塔尔沃特小学中文沉浸式项目的学生奉上的中文歌曲《听我说谢谢你》，点明了本次晚会的主题，令场下的观众无比感动，也令一线抗疫人员倍感光荣。
a13100ff56bebe428a6da71acd6722a22aedab25.translatedText: That night, the theater was packed with seats, including many people who drove an hour from Phoenix to experience oriental art. The entire evening show was a combination of Eastern and Western art, and the performance was of a very high standard. The audience applauded continuously and received rave reviews. The program of the party includes classical dance, folk dance, modern dance, Kpop, opera, Peking opera, solo singing, children's chorus, Shaolin Kung Fu, etc. Among them, the Chinese song "Hear Me Say Thank You" performed by students from the Chinese immersion program at Talwater Elementary School illuminated the theme of the party, which moved the audience extremely and made the front-line anti-epidemic personnel feel proud.

a9f1736525a6e5a9bd365b28f90ef5bdfcd987e8.sourceText: 本次晚会由亚省艺术学院全体员工和义工同心合力，秉持着连接与服务社区，为抗疫事业尽微薄之力的初衷，精心打造。知名导演刘洛宏老师在节目精选、流程衔接、会场布置等方面精益求精，追求卓越，最终为大家奉上了一场喜庆热烈、精彩绝伦的文化盛宴。晚会在解本地华人的思乡之情的同时，也向美国朋友推介了中国传统文化，促进各族裔交流与合作。
a9f1736525a6e5a9bd365b28f90ef5bdfcd987e8.translatedText: This party was carefully created by all the staff and volunteers of the Art Institute of Alberta, adhering to the original intention of connecting and serving the community and making a modest contribution to the anti-epidemic cause. The well-known director Liu Luohong kept improving and pursuing excellence in program selection, process connection, venue layout, etc., and finally presented everyone with a festive, warm and wonderful cultural feast. The party not only relieved the homesickness of local Chinese, but also introduced traditional Chinese culture to American friends and promoted exchanges and cooperation among various ethnic groups.

163deca5c0d1612a78bbf5787be5d24ffd908188.sourceText: 华人春晚早已成为全球华侨华人互致亲情、遥寄相思的独特文化载体与情感寄托。“亚省春晚”也已经举办了十届以上，早已成为大凤凰城地区欢庆中国新年活动的一道亮丽风景。对于举办这台晚会，晚会总策划吕丽华女士表示，“亚省春晚”这个品牌已经有一定历史了，但今年举办这场晚会我们还是面临着前所未有的困难。因为疫情的顾虑，演员名单几经修改，观众上座率也难以保证。但怀着“对一线抗疫人员的尊重与感恩”，我们认为应该迎难而上，在虎年新春之际，展示出我们不怕困难的决心和对新的一年的美好期盼。
163deca5c0d1612a78bbf5787be5d24ffd908188.translatedText: The Chinese Spring Festival Gala has long become a unique cultural carrier and emotional sustenance for overseas Chinese around the world to express their love for each other and miss each other from afar. The "Alberta Spring Festival Gala" has been held for more than ten times and has long become a beautiful scenery in the greater Phoenix area to celebrate the Chinese New Year. Regarding hosting this gala, Ms. Lu Lihua, the general planner of the gala, said that the brand "Alberta Spring Festival Gala" has a certain history, but we are still facing unprecedented difficulties in hosting this gala this year. Due to concerns about the epidemic, the cast list has been revised several times, and it is difficult to guarantee audience attendance. However, with "respect and gratitude for the front-line anti-epidemic personnel", we believe that we should face the difficulties and show our determination not to be afraid of difficulties and our good expectations for the new year in the Year of the Tiger.

9a77eb8bc1e0fc174bc5d9f3a9179e4d86e8145f.sourceText: 所幸本次晚会得到了钱德勒市政府和凤凰城各媒体的大力支持。ABC15 News多次播报预告了本次活动，介绍了晚会内容以及主创人员两个多月的筹备进程。钱德勒市长Kevin Hartke先生在晚会致辞和会后的采访中都表示，这是一次极其精彩的演出，也是一次非常成功的合作，本场晚会的高水准使钱德勒市政府更坚定了以后长期与亚省艺术学院合作的信心。
9a77eb8bc1e0fc174bc5d9f3a9179e4d86e8145f.translatedText: Fortunately, this party received strong support from the Chandler City Government and Phoenix media. ABC15 News has previewed this event multiple times, introducing the content of the party and the preparation process of the main creative staff for more than two months. Chandler Mayor Kevin Hartke said in his speech at the party and in the interview after the meeting that this was an extremely wonderful performance and a very successful cooperation. The high level of this party has strengthened the Chandler City Government’s confidence in long-term cooperation with the Art School of Alberta.

369738c1e186e730eed454573d65d27bd2351f88.sourceText: 办好春晚，对于传播中华文化、凝聚华人社区、为中美搭建文化桥梁非常重要。感谢组委会成员辛勤的组织工作和所有演职人员的刻苦排练，感谢协办单位和晚会的赞助商，同样感谢义工朋友的辛勤付出。祝愿大家虎年大吉！虎虎生威！（亚省艺术学院供稿）
369738c1e186e730eed454573d65d27bd2351f88.translatedText: Hosting the Spring Festival Gala successfully is very important for spreading Chinese culture, uniting the Chinese community, and building a cultural bridge between China and the United States. Thanks to the organizing committee members for their hard organizational work and all the cast and crew for their hard rehearsals, to the co-organizers and sponsors of the party, and to the volunteers for their hard work. I wish everyone good luck in the Year of the Tiger! Tigers and tigers are powerful! (Contributed by the Alberta College of Art)

8912824bd9c98842d119bd7398f6b59cf10b65e7.sourceText: Gilbert 历史博物馆免费线上英文讲座
8912824bd9c98842d119bd7398f6b59cf10b65e7.translatedText: Gilbert Free online English lecture at the History Museum

e99ebb5761132b763abf64f4694afce2f2534500.translatedText: Time: 6:30 to 8:00 pm on May 4th, AZ time

89344de6ca98ab20a49667395f06902972251cd3.sourceText: 在这个由“公民之声”支持的讲座中，参与者将更多地了解到凤凰城地区的水、电以及Salt River Project的（SRP） 历史。本次讲座将介绍凤凰城地区早期的运河系统、SRP填海工程的形成、盐田（Salt）和佛得河大坝（Verde Dams）的建设以及凤凰城地区电力系统的发展。欢迎大家参加！
89344de6ca98ab20a49667395f06902972251cd3.translatedText: In this presentation supported by Citizen Voice, participants will learn more about water, power and Salt in the Phoenix area River Project's (SRP) History. This lecture will introduce the early canal system in the Phoenix area, the formation of the SRP reclamation project, the construction of Salt and Verde Dams, and the development of the power system in the Phoenix area. Everyone is welcome to attend!

41b68d50757f1f087272f6246bade3dea9e669eb.sourceText: 亚利桑那州周一宣布，马里科帕县（Maricopa County）的两个疫苗接种点，位于格兰代尔（Glendale）的State Farm Stadium和位于凤凰城的Phoenix Municipal Stadium现已向55岁及以上的人开放，将在今天中午（3月2日）开放约50,000个疫苗接种预约，以便3月4日正式实地开始接种疫苗。
41b68d50757f1f087272f6246bade3dea9e669eb.translatedText: Arizona announced Monday that two vaccination sites in Maricopa County, State Farm Stadium in Glendale and Phoenix Municipal Stadium in Phoenix, are now open to people 55 and older and will open approximately 50,000 vaccination appointments at noon today (March 2) in preparation for the official on-site start of vaccinations on March 4.

cc7529ba7dec1f8128edb6bc827a303bf9d371e4.sourceText: 州数据显示，亚利桑那州因COVID-19死亡的人中有90％在55岁及以上的人群中，而因COVID-19而住院的患者中约有65％在该年龄段。
cc7529ba7dec1f8128edb6bc827a303bf9d371e4.translatedText: State data shows that 90% of people who have died from COVID-19 in Arizona have been among people 55 and older, while about 65% of patients hospitalized with COVID-19 have been in that age group.

6dbad2588c62bd7733e63e2f9ff50b9ba6db28c8.sourceText: 亚利桑那州卫生服务局局长Cara Christ博士表示，一旦每个司法管辖区的目标人群的55％接种了疫苗，或者官员们认为不再需要疫苗，疫苗将向下一个年龄段的人群开放。所以在55％的55至64岁年龄段的人群接种疫苗后，下一个接种人群将会是45至54岁。
6dbad2588c62bd7733e63e2f9ff50b9ba6db28c8.translatedText: Dr. Cara Christ, director of the Arizona Department of Health Services, said the vaccine will be opened to the next age group once 55% of each jurisdiction's target population has been vaccinated or officials determine that the vaccine is no longer needed. So after 55% of people in the 55 to 64 age group have been vaccinated, the next group to be vaccinated will be the 45 to 54 year olds.

3edd9b4bc2739a3af76fafb97f37c1df41ca3bf8.sourceText: 这项变更是在亚利桑那州疫苗（Arizona Vaccine）和抗病毒优先咨询委员会（Antiviral Prioritization Advisory Committee）一致建议之后提出的，该委员会包括州，当地城市和部落专家以及医疗保健合作伙伴。
3edd9b4bc2739a3af76fafb97f37c1df41ca3bf8.translatedText: This change follows the unanimous recommendation of the Arizona Vaccine and Antiviral Prioritization Advisory Committee, which includes state, local city and tribal experts, and health care partners.

eac0791c110293c43b6e04c59914d42d179e39ee.sourceText: Cara Christ博士表示，亚利桑那州从现在开始选择采用基于年龄的方法进行疫苗接种，同时还致力于为诸如食品服务业（包括餐馆和杂货店）工作的一线基本工人进行疫苗接种。她还表示，新的混合模式意味着扩大了前线基本工人的疫苗接种范围。一些变化将取决于各个县，因为一些县已经开始扩大他们的疫苗接种范围，超出了优先1B组。各县以及位于图森的亚利桑那大学的疫苗站点也有望采用基于年龄的混合模型。
eac0791c110293c43b6e04c59914d42d179e39ee.translatedText: Dr. Cara Christ said Arizona is opting for an age-based approach to vaccinations from now on while also working to vaccinate frontline essential workers such as those working in the food service industry, including restaurants and grocery stores. She also said the new hybrid model means expanded vaccinations for frontline essential workers. Some changes will depend on individual counties, as some have begun expanding their vaccinations beyond the priority 1B group. Vaccine sites in counties as well as the University of Arizona in Tucson are also expected to use age-based hybrid models.

9de22e6ddd87ac13262b44bb8240facffbcc7a6f.sourceText: 疫苗接种预约注册网址：ADHS – Highlighted Infectious Diseases for Arizona – Coronavirus Disease 2019 – Vaccine Registration (azdhs.gov)
9de22e6ddd87ac13262b44bb8240facffbcc7a6f.translatedText: Vaccine appointment registration website: ADHS – Highlighted Infectious Diseases for Arizona – Coronavirus Disease 2019 – Vaccine Registration (azdhs.gov)

85ecedf7e2efd9eabb8164adf20ceb55bfca7c1b.sourceText: 作为亚省拥有最丰富的大规模网课经验，最全面的初级到高级课程，最多公立私立学校专业教师，最完善的师生激励机制，最具有创业精神的义工团队，亚省现代中文学校春季开学全面招生开始了！
85ecedf7e2efd9eabb8164adf20ceb55bfca7c1b.translatedText: As the province has the richest experience in large-scale online courses, the most comprehensive elementary to advanced courses, the most professional teachers from public and private schools, the most complete incentive mechanism for teachers and students, and the most entrepreneurial volunteer team, the modern Chinese school in Alberta has begun full enrollment for the spring semester!

161fe5d0d3d5ac1179cd6a3469fd6de860953fc9.sourceText: 课程从传统经典中文教学到各年级数学、特色才艺，乃至College Prep高阶课程，亚省现代中文学校在疫情之下，创造出更多样、更为便利的网络授课模式，全方位地为华文爱好者和整个亚利桑那多族裔社区提供更为优质的教学服务。
161fe5d0d3d5ac1179cd6a3469fd6de860953fc9.translatedText: Courses range from traditional classic Chinese teaching to mathematics for all grades, special talents, and even College Prep advanced courses. Under the epidemic, the Alberta Modern Chinese School has created more diverse and more convenient online teaching models to provide better teaching services for Chinese language lovers and the entire Arizona multi-ethnic community in an all-round way.

082be1534d0148543cca0336f24c9620791f5f27.sourceText: 亚省现代中文学校将于本周末（1/9/2021）正式开始春季课程，部分课程将设立课程试听，详情请扫描二维码进入网站垂询。
082be1534d0148543cca0336f24c9620791f5f27.translatedText: >Alberta Modern Chinese School will officially start spring courses this weekend (1/9/2021). Some courses will have course trials. For details, please scan the QR code to enter the website for more information.

a5cc6aa44d4937515ba2f09b48f74be762541e98.sourceText: 这几天看到中国高中教科书关于文革的定义又改了，从“艰难探索”改为“灾难”和“错误”的了。知错就改是个好姿态，但改了未必就能够消除掉文革对中国和世界，特别是对人性改变的影响。
a5cc6aa44d4937515ba2f09b48f74be762541e98.translatedText: In the past few days, I have seen that the definition of the Cultural Revolution in Chinese high school textbooks has changed again, from “difficult exploration” to “disaster” and “mistake”. It is a good gesture to correct mistakes when you recognize them, but correcting may not eliminate the impact of the Cultural Revolution on China and the world, especially on the changes in human nature.

d2bfd2d8f812cc624ca2a172c588383ccca6aa65.sourceText: 大概现在的手指族经历文革的人很少了，那些被文革摧残的人们大都驾鹤仙去，再也不要看着地面上的芸芸众生——文革剩余者和得益者瞎折腾了。他们已经解脱了。
d2bfd2d8f812cc624ca2a172c588383ccca6aa65.translatedText: There are probably very few people in the Finger Tribe who have experienced the Cultural Revolution. Most of those who were devastated by the Cultural Revolution have gone away and no longer have to watch all the living beings on the ground - the survivors and beneficiaries of the Cultural Revolution mess around. They have been liberated.

2434132785c692ee122e28295e54715e614ec14e.sourceText: 但被文革摧残的精神——中国人曾经引以为豪的士大夫精神也几乎被消灭殆净，而且在天网恢恢的今天很难听到他们的声音。
2434132785c692ee122e28295e54715e614ec14e.translatedText: But the spirit that was destroyed by the Cultural Revolution - the spirit of the scholar-bureaucrats that the Chinese people were once proud of has been almost wiped out, and it is difficult to hear their voices in today's prosperous Skynet.

40db77c90333f95216fff5f08a408c19ee04c303.sourceText: 焚书坑儒过了后可以重开出版业，可以再来尊师风，但士大夫之风却不是一句错误就可以轻易乘春风而回归的。
40db77c90333f95216fff5f08a408c19ee04c303.translatedText: After burning books and humiliating scholars, the publishing industry can be reopened, and the style of respecting teachers can be restored, but the style of scholar-bureaucrats cannot be easily returned by making a mistake.

06e066c9b770e87fdba0d67ca89017aa583d2a9d.sourceText: 其实说士大夫精神是可以写一部书的，但通俗点说就是有点独立思考精神的人。举个例子就是李白杜甫之类的人。
06e066c9b770e87fdba0d67ca89017aa583d2a9d.translatedText: In fact, a book can be written about the spirit of scholar-bureaucrats, but in layman's terms, they are people with a bit of independent thinking spirit. For example, people like Li Bai and Du Fu.

d8b08b876f441723c9f72e805ea8615753c71bc6.sourceText: 李白杜甫也是普通人，也想过金榜题名，功成名就，好好生活的。但被世俗社会的贪官污吏阿谀奉承所累，他们都舍弃了这一切，或歌颂江山大川，或嫉恶如仇去了。
d8b08b876f441723c9f72e805ea8615753c71bc6.translatedText: Li Bai and Du Fu were also ordinary people. They also wanted to be named on the gold medal list, achieve fame and live a good life. But tired of the flattery of corrupt officials in the secular society, they all gave up all this, either singing praises of the great mountains and rivers, or hating evil as much as hatred.

ac6f4689054205050700994a41b8e5342656ceb6.sourceText: 他们喜欢吟诵风花雪月，却也留心大众生活的里井琐事，但让后人崇拜他们的却是他们都有一颗敬畏自然，体恤百姓的善心，有不媚上的独立人格。
ac6f4689054205050700994a41b8e5342656ceb6.translatedText: They like to sing about romance, but they also pay attention to the trivial matters of public life. But what makes future generations admire them is that they all have a kind heart that respects nature, is considerate of the people, and has an independent personality that is not flattering.

32d8156bfd78138cb58eaf425e418cbd230baac0.sourceText: 不过今天您做个李白杜甫却不易，不行做个鲁迅也罢，即便没被那些平安和平诗淹了，断了你的口粮，您也无以为生呀。
32d8156bfd78138cb58eaf425e418cbd230baac0.translatedText: But today it is not easy for you to be Li Bai and Du Fu. Even if you cannot be Lu Xun, even if you are not overwhelmed by those peace poems and your food rations are cut off, you will not be able to make a living.

b873653a402be412df0dc83caed2ec34be3e5135.sourceText: 还是你没有李白杜甫那两把刷子，写不出独立的精神！只会堆出一脸媚笑的战狼来！跌宕起伏，波澜壮阔的时代大背景在此，有人搞出个新时代的“兵车行”和“卖炭翁”没有？说到底，精神的丧失是文革对中国文化的最残忍的一刀。
b873653a402be412df0dc83caed2ec34be3e5135.translatedText: You still don’t have the two brushes of Li Bai and Du Fu, and you can’t write with an independent spirit! There will only be a bunch of war wolves with charming smiles on their faces! Against the background of ups and downs and magnificent times, has anyone come up with a new era of "military chariot dealers" and "charcoal sellers"? In the final analysis, the loss of spirit was the most cruel blow the Cultural Revolution dealt to Chinese culture.

d135df399f9d4995b7ab96d0253aa7c708c74255.sourceText: 之所以中国教科书一个改动会引起兄弟如此关注，是因为身边正在发生的一些事。文革最可笑和可悲的是，当年全国几亿人竟然相信一个有权势的人瞎鼓噪，还摇着红书，像当年德国崇拜一个人一样！今天在美国又见到了当年中国的情景。一个人很难一生经历两个同样的时代大事，但俺感到自己有点幸运也有点背时。那边决心改正的东西，这边在选举中正在进行！
d135df399f9d4995b7ab96d0253aa7c708c74255.translatedText: The reason why a change in Chinese textbooks arouses such concern among brothers is because of some things happening around us. The most ridiculous and sad thing about the Cultural Revolution is that hundreds of millions of people across the country actually believed the nonsense of a powerful person and waved the red book, just like Germany worshiped a person back then! Today in the United States, we see the scene in China again. It is difficult for a person to experience two major events of the same era in his life, but I feel that I am a little lucky and a little behind the times. What is determined to be corrected over there is being implemented here in the election!

d459c09b5fba532dd1e01007fbddc79c968b3ce3.sourceText: 老美红脖子多，容易信掌权人的瞎掰，纳闷的是来到美国的华人也会死做川粉白粉！也许俺已经到了不会崇拜偶像的年代了，不能与狼共舞了。
d459c09b5fba532dd1e01007fbddc79c968b3ce3.translatedText: There are many red necks in the United States, and it is easy to believe the nonsense of those in power. What is puzzling is that the Chinese who come to the United States will die as Sichuan fans and white fans! Maybe I have reached an age where I no longer worship idols and cannot dance with wolves.

065ec150fa95fb92ea7c1ff7fa0f3d0865ec14d8.sourceText: 都说，一个人不能在不能在同一条泥沟里摔倒两次，这次俺决心在岸上观虎斗，独吟“逝者如斯夫”……
065ec150fa95fb92ea7c1ff7fa0f3d0865ec14d8.translatedText: It is said that a person cannot fall down twice in the same mud ditch. This time I am determined to watch the tiger fight on the shore and chant "The dead are like a husband"...

f6d526c2cbd7c162af416450ea430f80077178bc.sourceText: 从 gofundme正式公开募捐至今整整四个半月，我们这个心系疫情中心亚省一线医护急救 人员防护安危， 凝聚力强，执行给力的团体看着面前的疫捐任务表里的任务落在最后一 项时，知道这次的亚省疫捐活动已进入收尾阶段。从 3/18日义捐正式成立，3/20日向公 众公布以来，我们经历了无数次一波三折的因为担心货源及物流而到处电话微信邮件联系 /恨不得一天当两天用的无数个漫长的夜晚/白天，也收获无数来自并肩作战的小伙伴们/捐 赠群里/受捐医护/媒体/让人觉得温暖/备受鼓舞/获得直戳人心的力量/让人感动到热泪盈眶 的数不尽的瞬间。看着医护人员及警员心怀感激地收下满是关切及爱心的医用防护口罩， 我们知道我们又在疫情防感染防护上为亚省的一线英雄们筑了一道防护墙。此时在亚省疫 捐活动进入最后帷幕之际，我们为大家所作的一切感到骄傲和自豪的同时，也小结一下这 次的捐赠活动。
f6d526c2cbd7c162af416450ea430f80077178bc.translatedText: It has been four and a half months since gofundme officially raised funds. As a group that cares about the safety of frontline medical and emergency personnel in the epicenter of the epidemic in Alberta, has strong cohesion and performs well, when we saw that the last task on the epidemic donation task list in front of us fell to the end, we knew that this provincial epidemic donation event had entered the final stage. Since the charity donation was officially established on March 18th and announced to the public on March 20th, we have gone through countless twists and turns. We have called, WeChat and email everywhere because we were worried about the source of goods and logistics. Countless long nights and days when we wished we could use two days a day. We have also gained countless moments from our friends who work side by side/donation groups/recipient medical care/media/that make people feel warm/inspired/gain the power to touch people's hearts/that move people to tears. Seeing the medical staff and police officers gratefully accepting the medical protective masks filled with care and love, we know that we have once again built a protective wall for the frontline heroes of Alberta in terms of epidemic prevention and infection protection. At this time, as the provincial epidemic donation activity enters its final curtain, while we are proud of everything you have done, we would also like to summarize this donation activity.

ac835860f21a99afdc494f27db041aa4db59507d.sourceText: 1）时间就是生命 我们的这个华裔团体在 3/20 gofundme推出后的 4天内捐赠了超过 50,000美元！疫情当前，时间就是生命，抓紧一切时间尽我们最大的努力，这 4天 5万美元是我们小小 华裔社区在疫情中对守护家园的大爱和奉献的最好诠释！我们经常谈论如何希望世界变得 更好，我们这个 300多人组成的亚省抗疫团队以无私地给予和全心地投入确切地在疫情肆 虐的今天展示了世界由于我们的努力而变得美好。你们是最棒的！2）十分爱心，十分风雨，十分颠簸,十分坚定，十分收获。最复杂最艰难的任务需要持之以恒的无私付出。我们有 40多名在大役面前勇于担当日夜 不懈地工作的自愿者，由于他们的努力使我们在捐赠开始后的 5天内就完成订购了第一批 100,000个医用口罩的任务。目前为止。我们已经购买了 15.8万个医用口罩，用以捐赠给 18所亚省的医院，警署急救中心和 Navajo Nation,完美地超额完成了我们预定目标。3）利泽施予万世的境界和胸怀 AZ中国餐馆，在生意受疫情如此严重影响的情况下，但仍然设法给亚省守护医护义捐了 $ 19,200。其实每次社区要需要，都能够看到中餐馆协会和中餐馆的爱心奉献。他们利泽 施予万世的境界和胸怀是我们学习的榜样 [Heart][Heart][Heart][ThumbsUp][ThumbsUp][ThumbsUp] 4）身后坚强的后盾 这里要提一下我们所做的这一切，都离不开一个非营利组织：亚省希望中文学校。我们 70%的志愿组织者都来自于希望中文学校的义工团队。她们多年热心公益，组织能力强， 行动力也是杠杠的。她们中很多人还在从前半场 1/25开始组织的湖北捐赠活动收尾工作 中，看到亚省疫情日渐严重，早在 3/15就发起亚省捐赠事宜。后经商议觉得各团体一起 合作更适合亚省守护家园的抗疫活动，于是于 3/18日集体带着丰富的义捐经验和满腔的 热情立刻和 我们医护团体的义工们一起组建了新团体，全心投入了下半场亚省医护捐赠 活动中来。此外希望中文学校还提供了法律、文档、捐助资金管理的全面支持。由于 gofundme网站有 90天延期取款的要求，希望中文学校甚至直接为我们提供了 5万美元现 金借款以便我们能及时完成防疫用品的捐赠。没有希望中文学校，我们的捐助绝不可能如 此顺利。让我们大家一起感谢这个低调而极富爱心和凝聚力的希望中文学校。我们爱你， 希望！5.并肩作战 还要感谢以方方为首的图森华人社区与我们一起并肩作战，共同在疫情中为守护亚省医护 捐赠。6.默默鼓励我们的雇主们 同时我们还要感谢所有为员工捐赠提供匹配资金的雇主们，谢谢他们鼓励其雇员为社区疫 捐做出贡献并提供匹配资金。7. 我们的媒体组 最后再一次表扬一下我们这次亚省华人捐赠中非常棒的媒体组。在这次亚省 Chinese American Covid19 Relief AZ疫情捐赠宣传组挑起了中文英文媒体报道大梁，这是个任务 艰巨冲锋陷阵的大梁，尤其是英文媒体，在我们整个捐赠过程中起着传播我们美裔华人生 命力,以及美裔华人在家园危机中如何凝集大爱托起守护医护的正能量活动的作用，是我 们这次捐赠中至关重要的一个大任。我们的募捐从 gofundme 公布日 3/20起，短短几周时 间我们的捐赠活动受到当地主流电视台及中英文媒体的报道：超过 20次英文电台采访和 其它媒体报道，还有数不清的各大中文报纸社交媒体报道。这既要有极强的公关能力，也 要有中英文撰稿功底以及细致到落实各种媒体稿件的细节处理能力。其中的能力，工作量 和辛苦我们大家有目共睹。谢谢我们棒棒的媒体组的全体小伙伴们的辛勤付出
ac835860f21a99afdc494f27db041aa4db59507d.translatedText: 1) Time is of the essence Our Chinese group donated more than $50,000 within 4 days after the gofundme was launched on 3/20! During the current epidemic, time is of the essence, so we should seize every moment and do our best. These 4 days of US$50,000 are the best interpretation of our small Chinese community's great love and dedication to protecting their homeland during the epidemic! We often talk about how we want the world to become a better place. With our selfless giving and wholehearted devotion, our Alberta anti-epidemic team of more than 300 people has truly shown that the world has become a better place due to our efforts today when the epidemic is raging. You are the best! 2) Very loving, very windy, very bumpy, very determined, very rewarding. The most complex and difficult tasks require sustained and selfless effort. We have more than 40 volunteers who have the courage to take on the challenge and work tirelessly day and night. Thanks to their efforts, we were able to complete the task of ordering the first batch of 100,000 medical masks within 5 days of the start of donations. So far. We have purchased 158,000 medical masks to donate to 18 Alberta hospitals, police emergency centers and the Navajo Nation, exceeding our target perfectly. 3) Lizer’s realm and heart of giving to the world. AZ Chinese restaurant, even though its business was so severely affected by the epidemic, still managed to donate $19,200 to the Alberta Guardian Medical Care Foundation. In fact, every time the community is in need, we can see the love and dedication of the Chinese Restaurant Association and Chinese restaurants. Their state of mind and mind to give to all generations are examples for us to learn from [Heart][Heart][Heart][ThumbsUp][ThumbsUp][ThumbsUp] 4) Strong backing behind us. Here I would like to mention that everything we do is inseparable from a non-profit organization: Alberta Hope Chinese School. 70% of our volunteer organizers are from the volunteer team of Hope Chinese School. They have been enthusiastic about public welfare for many years, have strong organizational skills, and are very capable in taking action. Many of them were still finishing the Hubei donation event organized on 1/25 in the first half. Seeing that the epidemic in Alberta was getting worse, they initiated donations to the province as early as 3/15. After discussion, it was felt that cooperation among various groups would be more suitable for the province’s anti-epidemic activities to protect our homeland. So on March 18, the collective, with rich experience in charity donation and full of enthusiasm, immediately formed a new group together with the volunteers of our medical care group, and devoted themselves wholeheartedly to the second half of the province’s medical donation activities. In addition, Hope Chinese School also provides comprehensive support in legal, documentation, and donation fund management. Since the gofundme website has a 90-day deferred withdrawal requirement, Hope Chinese School even directly provided us with a cash loan of US$50,000 so that we could complete the donation of anti-epidemic supplies in time. Without Hope Chinese School, our donation would never have gone so smoothly. Let us all express our gratitude to this low-key but extremely caring and cohesive Hope Chinese School. We love you, hope! 5. Fighting side by side We would also like to thank the Chinese community in Tucson, headed by Fang Fang, for working side by side with us and donating to protect medical care in Alberta during the epidemic. 6. Silently encourage our employers We would also like to thank all employers who have provided matching funds for employee donations. Thank you for encouraging their employees to contribute to community epidemic donations and providing matching funds. 7. Our media team. Finally, we would like to commend our excellent media team for this donation by the Chinese in Alberta. During this time, the Chinese American Covid19 Relief AZ epidemic donation promotion team in Alberta took on the responsibility of reporting on the Chinese and English media. This was an arduous task, especially the English media, which played a role in spreading the vitality of our Chinese Americans throughout our donation process, and how the Chinese Americans gathered great love and supported the positive energy of protecting medical care in the crisis at home. This is a crucial task for us in this donation. Our fundraising started on 3/20, the day we announced it on gofundme. In just a few weeks, our donation activities were reported by local mainstream TV stations and Chinese and English media: more than 20 English radio interviews and other media reports, as well as countless social media reports from major Chinese newspapers. This requires not only strong public relations skills, but also writing skills in Chinese and English, as well as the ability to handle details in implementing various media manuscripts. The ability, workload and hard work are obvious to all of us. Thank you to all the members of our awesome media team for their hard work

f361016300769c4e24158be08b94aae4874a5d05.sourceText: 谢谢所有捐赠者和义工们的爱心和努力。这确实是使不可能变为可能的绝佳例子之一！华 裔美国人 Covid 19 Relief AZ团队是最棒的！4个多月很长也很短，愿我们的不曾停歇的 脚步击穿冷漠，击穿偏见，保护我们所需要保护的一切，在我们生活的土地上，印上了一 个大写的温软而有力的爱字！We are making a difference!
f361016300769c4e24158be08b94aae4874a5d05.translatedText: Thank you to all the donors and volunteers for your love and efforts. This is truly one of those great examples of making the impossible possible! The Chinese American Covid 19 Relief AZ team is the best! More than 4 months is both long and short. May our never-ending footsteps break through indifference and prejudice, protect everything we need to protect, and stamp a soft and powerful word of love in capital letters on the land where we live! We are making a difference!

5a5431a9acf76146c958f08428c28f1c574fee25.sourceText: 我们的捐款都是通过希望中文学校进行的。中文学校的老师、董事、和校长不但在捐赠活动上尽心尽力， 还做了大量的幕后工作。以 Emily为组长的财会组在保障捐款顺利到位、及时处理报账项目、保障账目进 出清晰上，做了大量而细致的工作。

The teachers, directors, and principals of Chinese schools not only work hard on donation activities, but also do a lot of behind-the-scenes work. The accounting team headed by Emily has done a lot of detailed work to ensure that donations are received smoothly, reimbursement items are processed in a timely manner, and the incoming and outgoing accounts are clear.

5e45142aa2517546c4f63ee5202d121c6b03a922.sourceText: 国家气象局发布了针对La Paz, Maricopa, Pinal, Yuma ，Counties高温警告，高温时间为4/26/20上午10点至晚上7点。莫哈维郡（Mohave County）也发布了过热监测报告。预计最高温度为109°F，时间从4/26/20到4/30/20（上午10点至晚上10点）。详细了解如何在极端高温下保持安全并随时了解未来的高温警报。下面看看亚利桑那州当日疫情，也可关注高温天气下的疫情数据，
5e45142aa2517546c4f63ee5202d121c6b03a922.translatedText: The National Weather Service has issued a heat warning for La Paz, Maricopa, Pinal, Yuma, and Counties from 10 a.m. to 7 p.m. on April 26, 2020. Mohave County also issued an excessive heat watch. A high temperature of 109°F is expected from 4/26/20 to 4/30/20 (10 a.m. to 10 p.m.). You can also pay attention to the epidemic data in hot weather.

8f7c51ca48893deb9af412ed02e96ded19461556.sourceText: 周六到周日新型冠状病毒感染新增246例，总人数超过6000！全亚利桑那的人口为738万，目前，I10高速路上开始堵车了，洗车场，costco的加油站排起了长队，在家蹲了很久的人还是开始出动了。。。。每日增量比例有降低，死亡人数也有减少。（是否跟上升的温度有关，还需进一步观察和统计数字）
8f7c51ca48893deb9af412ed02e96ded19461556.translatedText: There were 246 new cases of new coronavirus infection from Saturday to Sunday, and the total number of people exceeded 6,000! The population of Arizona is 7.38 million. Currently, there are traffic jams on the I10 highway. There are long lines at car washes and Costco gas stations. People who have been squatting at home for a long time are starting to go out. . . . The daily increase rate has decreased, and the number of deaths has also decreased. (Whether it is related to the rising temperature requires further observation and statistics)

ca17540b37abfdd7b8b4770d3f5d508dc2ef7c74.sourceText: 亚利桑那州居家禁令未解除！坚持，巩固多个月的努力！据亚利桑那州卫生服务部周六发布的数字，由新的冠状病毒引起的亚利桑那州COVID-19病例6280人，已知死亡273人，新增246例.
ca17540b37abfdd7b8b4770d3f5d508dc2ef7c74.translatedText: The stay-at-home ban in Arizona has not been lifted! Persevere and consolidate many months of hard work! There are 6,280 cases of COVID-19 in Arizona caused by the new coronavirus, with 273 known deaths and 246 new cases, according to numbers released Saturday by the Arizona Department of Health Services.

50f9f095800ef6ececf4264373c19ec993fb6c1b.sourceText: 截止3/26/20 12：00pm,全州一共508例确诊，8名死亡病例。
50f9f095800ef6ececf4264373c19ec993fb6c1b.translatedText: As of 12:00pm on 3/26/20, there were a total of 508 confirmed cases and 8 deaths across the state.

101187ad105d2b3b3bd6d2f91f470105ab5cd1b7.sourceText: 州卫生总监卡拉·克里斯特尔（Cara Christ）博士说，本州已经有超过6,600名亚利桑那人接受了测试，其中大部分是由私人实验室完成的。该州的实验室已经进行了403次测试。报告显示检测结果呈阳性508例，347人排除感染，33等待结果。各个郡确诊人数如下
