The state's labs have conducted 403 tests. The report shows that 508 people have tested positive, 347 have been ruled out for infection, and 33 are awaiting results. The number of confirmed cases by county is as follows

8fde9b28ee9c0b071b675457abe99ec7ec9fd6af.sourceText: 州数字显示，确诊的由新冠状病毒引起的COVID-19病例在周四突破500例，有8例已知死亡。
8fde9b28ee9c0b071b675457abe99ec7ec9fd6af.translatedText: Confirmed cases of COVID-19, the disease caused by the new coronavirus, topped 500 on Thursday, with eight known deaths, state numbers show.

c453bf1156419537c336f3d6edde75369dff7dbe.sourceText: 现在，全州确诊总数为508。Maricopa县300例病例。
c453bf1156419537c336f3d6edde75369dff7dbe.translatedText: Now, the total number of confirmed cases in the state is 508. 300 cases in Maricopa County.

20cf01c7850d7127a7023ee9fe3280902247ada4.sourceText: 州卫生部门网站上列出的社区传播程度已从中等扩散到“广泛传播”。社区传播意味着患者没有前往新的冠状病毒感染地区的历史，也没有与感染该病毒的任何人的接触依然被感染！
20cf01c7850d7127a7023ee9fe3280902247ada4.translatedText: The level of community spread listed on the state health department's website has ranged from moderate to "widespread." Community transmission means that the patient has no history of traveling to an area affected by the new coronavirus, and has not been in contact with anyone infected with the virus and still became infected!

d69ffe6065f7e188cb46759fb62bd66f7b0bc36d.sourceText: 从星期三到星期四，已识别出的病例数量增加了107例，或将近27％。
d69ffe6065f7e188cb46759fb62bd66f7b0bc36d.translatedText: From Wednesday to Thursday, the number of identified cases increased by 107, or nearly 27%.

3b951de4f5863d0d8bb984fb511a8933a3ba3872.sourceText: 根据该县的数据，在Maricopa郡发生了4例已知死亡，在科科尼诺郡发生了2例死亡，在皮马郡发生了1例。目前尚不清楚在有另一人死亡。
3b951de4f5863d0d8bb984fb511a8933a3ba3872.translatedText: There have been four known deaths in Maricopa County, two in Coconino County and one in Pima County, according to county data. It's unclear if another person died.

a32bb1947fbbdfbc35fe790ec5b6b5d42c16a0d0.sourceText: 在周三的新闻发布会上，州卫生总监卡拉·克里斯特尔（Cara Christ）博士说， 如果感染以目前的速度继续下去，疾病将在4月达到高峰，住院治疗将在5月达到高峰。
a32bb1947fbbdfbc35fe790ec5b6b5d42c16a0d0.translatedText: At a press conference on Wednesday, state Health Director Dr. Cara Christ said that if infections continue at the current pace, illness will peak in April and hospitalizations will peak in May.

f6f1a4e46e5d03f0833902b86d93edd1e80e1a53.sourceText: 克里斯说：“亚利桑那州仍处于COVID-19爆发的开始阶段，该州的病例数将大大增加。”
f6f1a4e46e5d03f0833902b86d93edd1e80e1a53.translatedText: "Arizona is still in the beginning stages of the COVID-19 outbreak and the number of cases in the state will increase significantly," Chris said.

8006c76a093d4169fbb3e5e157f3a515f36407d2.sourceText: 根据州卫生部门网站上的数据，亚利桑那州已确认的大多数病例都在马里科帕郡，星期四共有299例。
8006c76a093d4169fbb3e5e157f3a515f36407d2.translatedText: Most of Arizona's confirmed cases are in Maricopa County, with a total of 299 on Thursday, according to data on the state health department website.

350dfde99aeb586812f6f354838431e3aa18efe4.sourceText: 一些大学报告说，他们的学生或社区成员现在的测试呈阳性。亚利桑那州立大学说，有15名学生的测试呈阳性，而亚利桑那大学社区的4名确诊。The Maricopa County Community College District 说三名确诊为阳性，两名学生，一名助教。他们分别于 Estrella Mountain Community College, Phoenix College and Mesa Community College三个学校相关
350dfde99aeb586812f6f354838431e3aa18efe4.translatedText: Some universities are reporting that their students or community members are now testing positive. Arizona State University said 15 students have tested positive, while four in the University of Arizona community have tested positive. The Maricopa County Community College District says three people have tested positive, two students and one teaching assistant. They are related to three schools: Estrella Mountain Community College, Phoenix College and Mesa Community College

42ad92648a8acc8f12a0350bae9a619d32d10d97.sourceText: 截至周三，纳瓦霍郡的人均病例数高于任何其他县。
42ad92648a8acc8f12a0350bae9a619d32d10d97.translatedText: As of Wednesday, Navajo County had more cases per capita than any other county.

428da969d5649c300066289ca4aa2189fc3096ee.sourceText: 纳瓦霍族在星期三晚上宣布，COVID-19病例数已达到69例，比周二增加了20例。在纳瓦霍保留区没有确认死于COVID-19的死亡。
428da969d5649c300066289ca4aa2189fc3096ee.translatedText: The Navajo Nation announced Wednesday evening that the number of COVID-19 cases has reached 69, an increase of 20 from Tuesday. There have been no confirmed deaths from COVID-19 on the Navajo Reservation.

e7c88933cdf3dd135fb87ab567b1c92a88bc7621.sourceText: 案件包括纳瓦霍县的43个，阿帕奇县的8个，亚利桑那州的科科尼诺县的6个，麦金莱县的4个，圣胡安县的7个，新墨西哥州的西博拉县的1个。
e7c88933cdf3dd135fb87ab567b1c92a88bc7621.translatedText: Cases include 43 in Navajo County, eight in Apache County, six in Coconino County, Arizona, four in McKinley County, seven in San Juan County, and one in Cibola County, New Mexico.

2f7f3cb8da3ab32ed2fde76d791a5bd72df5de3c.sourceText: 纳瓦霍族负责人乔纳森·内兹（Jonathan Nez）在一份新闻稿中说：“不幸的是，在每个人都开始遵守“居家命令”之前，这一数字将继续上升。我们必须隔离自我以隔离病毒。让我们为我们的长者，我们的孩子和我们的高危人群做这件事。”
2f7f3cb8da3ab32ed2fde76d791a5bd72df5de3c.translatedText: Navajo Nation Chief Jonathan Nez said in a press release: "Unfortunately, until everyone begins to comply with the stay at home order, the numbers will continue to rise. We must isolate ourselves to isolate the virus. Let us do this for our elders, our children and our at-risk populations."

6e95644a3a67a85d58aaaeef814b9e1f239156e3.sourceText: 内兹发布的“待在家里”命令仍然有效。这就要求那瓦伙族人保留区的居民呆在家里，并消除不必要的旅行。
6e95644a3a67a85d58aaaeef814b9e1f239156e3.translatedText: The "stay at home" order issued by Nez remains in effect. This requires residents on the Navajo reservation to stay home and eliminate unnecessary travel.

1865525d98678bb9dc20213b44a3933f8fb03d64.sourceText: 凤凰城-亚利桑那州州长道格·杜西（Doug Ducey）周一表示：“现在是采取进一步行动的时候了，因为我已经下达了全天候的命令，直到4月30日为止。
1865525d98678bb9dc20213b44a3933f8fb03d64.translatedText: PHOENIX - Arizona Governor Doug Ducey said Monday: "Now is the time to take further action as I have issued a stay-at-home order through April 30."

04c4337ee3b94f3b64d4d61787e1d9fbd5516f06.sourceText: 据美联社报道，杂货店和药房将继续营业。
04c4337ee3b94f3b64d4d61787e1d9fbd5516f06.translatedText: Grocery stores and pharmacies will remain open, according to the Associated Press.

c2aa6fb82b410ba1586e639d8f07e87594b5c4d8.sourceText: 他补充说：“待在家里，保持健康，保持联系。”
c2aa6fb82b410ba1586e639d8f07e87594b5c4d8.translatedText: He added: "Stay home, stay healthy, stay connected. "

640a4806179915fcaa0209251158d4f8353ba61e.sourceText: 在政府的另一项新行政命令中。他说，杜西（Ducey）将不再允许在疗养院探望，除非另行通知。（今天图桑一养老院爆发，确诊27例阳性病例）
640a4806179915fcaa0209251158d4f8353ba61e.translatedText: In another new executive order from the administration. He said Ducey will no longer allow visits in nursing homes until further notice. (Today an outbreak at a Tucson nursing home confirmed 27 positive cases)

b55c233fbec3f97456c65bc04350099801ece58c.sourceText: 他还宣布了超过600万美元的新资金，用于支持失学儿童，家庭和老年人的食品计划。
b55c233fbec3f97456c65bc04350099801ece58c.translatedText: He also announced more than $6 million in new funding to support food programs for out-of-school children, families and seniors.

c145850d4b12479978f306ad1f75fdce26d1ab48.sourceText: Ducey概述了纽约州应对流感大流行的其他几种方式，例如：在全州范围内关闭学校，获得个人保护设备（PPE），获得数百万美元来支持家庭，小型企业和失业者。
c145850d4b12479978f306ad1f75fdce26d1ab48.translatedText: Ducey outlined several other ways the state is responding to the pandemic, such as: closing schools across the state, getting personal protective equipment (PPE), getting millions of dollars to support families, small businesses and the unemployed.

1462737b793544003ffc1c52f737534b37097cc6.sourceText: 杜西说：“在全州范围内，亚利桑那人正在尽自己的一份力量。” “亚利桑那人待在家里是因为这样做是对的。”
1462737b793544003ffc1c52f737534b37097cc6.translatedText: “Across the state, Arizonans are doing their part,” Ducey said. “Arizonans are staying home because it’s the right thing to do. "

a8a52b669214612c20170583cb654a31005e2793.sourceText: 政府杜西（Ducey）周一宣布这一消息是在亚利桑那州几位市长共同签署的一封信中敦促政府督促。 Ducey发出命令。
a8a52b669214612c20170583cb654a31005e2793.translatedText: Government Ducey announced the news on Monday in a letter co-signed by several Arizona mayors urging the administration. Ducey issued the order.

ea2b62a97a6d0ad83928f7ac54a6db03f77d4e82.sourceText: 凤凰城（phoenix）市长Kate Gallego，弗拉格斯塔夫（Flagstaff）市长Coral Evans，喷泉山（Fountain Hill）市长Ginny Dickey，瓜达卢佩（Guadalupe）市长Valerie Molina，高级（Superior）市长Mila Besich，埃尔米拉奇（El Mirage）市长Alexis Hermosillo，图森（Tucson）市长Regina Romero和温斯洛（Winslow）市长Thomas L签署了这封信。
ea2b62a97a6d0ad83928f7ac54a6db03f77d4e82.translatedText: Phoenix Mayor Kate Gallego, Flagstaff Mayor Coral Evans, Fountain Hill Mayor Ginny Dickey, Guadalupe Mayor Valerie Molina, Superior Mayor Mila Besich, El Mirage Mayor Alexis Hermosillo, Tucson Mayor Regina Romero and Winslow Mayor Thomas L signed the letter.

658d1b93fdd0b70d2d9ee24d56080780e6fa5671.sourceText: 信中的一部分读到：“亚利桑那州绝不能浪费机会，应该从我们姊妹州疫情发展中学到东西，并立即在全州范围内颁布“居家令”，以确保我们采取一切途径来平息这场毁灭性大流行的曲线。”
658d1b93fdd0b70d2d9ee24d56080780e6fa5671.translatedText: Part of the letter reads: “Arizona must not waste the opportunity to learn from the outbreak in our sister states and immediately enact a statewide stay-at-home order to ensure we take every avenue to flatten the curve of this devastating pandemic. "

fb5efb7b569e2e8779824c654bbebd3fa5aa1270.sourceText: 今天，美国小企业管理局（SBA）批准了针对亚利桑那州的《经济伤害灾难贷款声明》，该声明将有助于受COVID-19影响的该州的小企业。通过该计划，个体企业可以获得最高200万美元贷款。
fb5efb7b569e2e8779824c654bbebd3fa5aa1270.translatedText: Today, the U.S. Small Business Administration (SBA) approved the Economic Injury Disaster Loan Declaration for Arizona, which will assist the state’s small businesses affected by COVID-19. Through this program, individual businesses can receive loans of up to $2 million.

7d4704fd374a6c4344298d1a46059fa13745e6ba.sourceText: 2020年3月16日星期一，州长杜西（Ducey）向联邦政府提交了一项经济援助请求， submitted a request 该请求可通过特朗普总统于2020年3月6日签署的《冠状病毒防范和应对补充拨款法》获得。
7d4704fd374a6c4344298d1a46059fa13745e6ba.translatedText: On Monday, March 16, 2020, Governor Ducey submitted a request to the federal government for financial assistance, which is available through the Coronavirus Preparedness and Response Supplemental Appropriations Act, signed by President Trump on March 6, 2020.

12aa4093df8d502d83bd5f4db5afa1410d606906.sourceText: 在此处阅读州长的来信 HERE 。

abfe59b7e978981378bec93a7ecfc8eac3edcbd0.sourceText: “我们将继续致力于解决COVID-19并把公共卫生置于优先地位，我们正在与我们的联邦伙伴合作，以减轻对亚利桑那州的小企业和员工的经济影响，”州长杜西说。 “由于COVID-19而遭受严重经济损失的企业可以通过小型企业管理局的网站访问SBA.gov/disaster申请此项贷款。我们的政府随时准备提供帮助。”
abfe59b7e978981378bec93a7ecfc8eac3edcbd0.translatedText: "We remain committed to addressing COVID-19 and prioritizing public health, and we are working with our federal partners to mitigate the economic impact on Arizona's small businesses and workers," said Governor Ducey. "Businesses that have experienced significant economic harm due to COVID-19 can apply for this loan through the Small Business Administration's website at SBA.gov/disaster. Our government stands ready to help."

5174b7b5afde4600e660504fdd805272d499ccc1.sourceText: 全国独立企业联合会亚利桑那州州长查德·海因里希说：“亚利桑那州的小型企业社区感谢州长杜西（Ducey）在支持受COVID-19影响的企业的同时，将亚利桑那州人民的健康与安全放在首位。”毫无疑问，这些艰难时期将严重损害我们的经济以及全州在职男女的生计。这种救济将大大弥补所造成的损失并保护亚利桑那州的家庭。”
5174b7b5afde4600e660504fdd805272d499ccc1.translatedText: National Federation of Independent Business Arizona State "Arizona's small business community is grateful to Governor Ducey for prioritizing the health and safety of Arizonans while supporting businesses impacted by COVID-19," said Commissioner Chad Heinrich. "There is no question that these trying times will severely harm our economy and the livelihoods of working men and women across the state." This relief will go a long way toward making up for the damage caused and protecting Arizona families. "

a81996452694d072e272f900500e7b7b43a76798.sourceText: 这些贷款可能用于支付固定债务，工资单，应付帐款和由于COVID-19的影响而无法支付的其他账单。没有其他地方可得的信贷的小型企业的利率为3.75％。非营利组织的利率为2.75％。 SBA提供长期还款的贷款，以使付款负担得起，最长30年。根据每个借款人的还款能力，根据具体情况确定条款。符合此条件的整个州的小型企业都有资格。
a81996452694d072e272f900500e7b7b43a76798.translatedText: These loans may be used to pay fixed debts, payroll, accounts payable and other bills that cannot be paid due to the impact of COVID-19. The interest rate for small businesses with no credit available elsewhere is 3.75%. The interest rate for non-profit organizations is 2.75%. The SBA offers loans with long-term repayments to make payments affordable, up to 30 years. Terms are determined on a case-by-case basis based on each borrower's ability to repay.

4d670207ec9a7532efdfc2c4a01f4f5ea2d38106.sourceText: 受COVID-19影响的亚利桑那州企业可以在此处申请贷款 HERE 。
4d670207ec9a7532efdfc2c4a01f4f5ea2d38106.translatedText: Arizona businesses impacted by COVID-19 are eligible here.

8e3cda8a5c64ce59dce4634c318c5ceacdc1a0c4.sourceText: 今天(3/3/20)上午玛丽库帕郡公共卫生部宣布亚利桑那州昨日疑似病例推定测试结果为阳性，该男子二十多岁，曾经接触过新冠病毒感染区域的旅行者，目前的症状轻微，在家隔离康复。截止到3月3日上午，亚利桑那州参加新型冠状病毒测试COVID-19的人员一共有32人，其中一人于1月26日确诊阳性，来自中国武汉，目前已经康复。另一位是今天上午刚刚推定检测结果为阳性的男子，到今天为止，还有6人的检查结果待定，24人测试结果为阴性。
8e3cda8a5c64ce59dce4634c318c5ceacdc1a0c4.translatedText: This morning (3/3/20) the Maricoopa County Public Health Department announced that yesterday’s suspected case in Arizona had a presumptive positive test result. The man was in his twenties and had been exposed to travelers from areas infected with the new coronavirus. He currently has mild symptoms and is recovering in isolation at home. As of the morning of March 3, a total of 32 people in Arizona had participated in the COVID-19 test for the new coronavirus. 27760292ec30a606b2bb817d35e5a82b72af1cd9.sourceText: 学校义工们和老师们早早地就来到了学校，注册，教科书的发售，每一项工作都进行得有条不紊。中文班的老师们带着学生们们回顾了一下上学期的学期内容，马立平一年级的小朋友们在蔡敏老师的带领下把上学期学习的的儿歌全部都背诵了一遍。孩子们的朗诵声袅袅悦耳，像动人的童声大合唱，音符漫天。马立平二年级的学生们走进教室看到了曹老师都跑过去给了曹老师一个个大大的拥抱，一个寒假不见曹老师说她很想念班里的每一个孩子，孩子们也都大声的说他们也很想曹老师，温馨的师生之情弥漫在教室的每一个角落。这学期学校的重要活动之一就是即将到来的2019年春节庙会。去年的庙会家长大厨们把各地美食带给了大家，今年原班人马又再次出山再把精彩带给所有家庭，?#32047;并快乐着?#23601;是希望的精神。
27760292ec30a606b2bb817d35e5a82b72af1cd9.translatedText: The school volunteers and teachers came to the school early to register and sell textbooks. Every work was carried out in an orderly manner. The first-grade children of Ma Liping recited all the children's songs they learned last semester under the leadership of Teacher Cai Min. The children's recitation sounds sweet and sweet, like a moving chorus of children's voices, with notes filling the sky. When Ma Liping's second-grade students walked into the classroom and saw Teacher Cao, they ran over and gave Teacher Cao a big hug. After missing Teacher Cao during the winter vacation, she said that she missed every child in the class. The children also said loudly that they also missed Teacher Cao. Last year's temple fair parent chefs brought delicious food from all over the world to everyone. This year, the original team is back to bring excitement to all families. ?#32047;And being happy?#23601;is the spirit of hope.

af4b977dd6c963a51375ffd99ba1fe34db9e0f6b.sourceText: 2020年1月18日，农历腊月二十四，临近春节，当日晚6时，由中国华文教育基金会、全美中文学校协会主办，亚省现代中文学校承办的华文教师系统培训互动课堂隆重举行。本次培训的题目是“华语课堂中的汉字教学”，由北京外国语大学对外汉语系主任孟德宏教授主讲。全美中文学校协会董事兼秘书长、我校杨轶伦校长和陶世诚董事长全程参加了培训。现代中文学校教学副校长安然、学生工作副校长曾颖华及全体中文老师和社区其他中文老师及中文教学爱好者齐聚一堂，现场聆听了孟教授的精彩解析。本次培训还由中国华文教育基金会进行了网络直播，全美中文学校协会遍布全美的上百所会员中文学校均组织老师一同观看了现场实况。
af4b977dd6c963a51375ffd99ba1fe34db9e0f6b.translatedText: On January 18, 2020, the 24th day of the twelfth lunar month, approaching the Spring Festival, at 6 p.m. that day, an interactive classroom for systematic training of Chinese teachers, sponsored by the China Chinese Education Foundation and the National Association of Chinese Schools, and hosted by the Alberta Modern Chinese School, was grandly held. The title of this training is "Teaching Chinese Characters in Chinese Classrooms" and was delivered by Professor Meng Dehong, Director of the Department of Chinese as a Foreign Language at Beijing Foreign Studies University. Director and Secretary General of the National Association of Chinese Schools, Principal Yang Yilun and Chairman Tao Shicheng of our school participated in the entire training. An Ran, the vice-principal of teaching at Modern Chinese School, Zeng Yinghua, the vice-principal of student affairs, all Chinese teachers, other Chinese teachers and Chinese teaching enthusiasts in the community gathered together to listen to Professor Meng's wonderful analysis. This training was also broadcast live online by the China Chinese Education Foundation. Hundreds of member Chinese schools across the United States of the National Chinese Schools Association organized teachers to watch the live broadcast.

109a5a148dea9d776a43fecadd7462baba2ea47c.sourceText: 孟教授开宗明义，指出汉语文字、文化、文明的渊源联系。正值新春来临之际，孟教授便首先以金文的 “春”为例，讲解了春字的三个组成部分、各部分的意思、组成“春”字的含义等，通俗易懂地解说了“会意”造字法，而后又以“白”字、“刃”字等为例，分别讲解了“形声字”、“象形字”、“指事字”等造字方法。至此，孟教授形象、直观地讲解了四种造字方法。
109a5a148dea9d776a43fecadd7462baba2ea47c.translatedText: >Professor Meng made a clear statement, pointing out the origins and connections of Chinese characters, culture, and civilization. On the occasion of the New Year, Professor Meng first used the word "spring" in bronze inscriptions as an example to explain the three components of the character spring, the meaning of each part, and the meaning of the character "spring". He also explained the "knowing" character creation method in an easy-to-understand manner. Then he took the character "白" and "edge" as examples to explain the character creation methods of "phonetic characters", "pictographic characters", and "zhishi characters" respectively. At this point, Professor Meng has vividly and intuitively explained the four methods of character creation.

00634733517f39fb357cd33d54394207ae1fcbe9.sourceText: 汉字的一大特点是，也是汉字与字母文字最大的区别，就在于每个字都是形、音、义的复合体。泊、柏、伯、百等字的主体是“白”；诸、著、猪、煮等字的主体是“者”。“白”有“大”的意思，“者”有“附着、依附”的含义。所以，以它们为主体的汉字字意，就必然带有主体字的原义。此外，汉字还有“音近意通”的特点。比如：相、像、香、响、想、享等，分别表达了视觉、味觉、嗅觉、听觉、心理等方面相近的体验。 人类社会的历史，也必然会在文字上留下痕迹。孟教授以“纸”字、“著”字为例，解读出我们的先民有过把字写在“草”上的历史；以“妻”为例，表明我们祖先的婚姻是以抢亲为主要手段，而西方文化也有类似的造字记录和历史起源；他还以“阅”字为例，说明古时我们检查武装力量的方法等等。 现场所有老师被孟教授旁征博引的讲解牢牢吸引，深深沉浸在汉语言博大精深的知识海洋时，60分钟很快就过去了，大家都有意犹未尽的感觉，希望有机会再次聆听孟教授的讲课。 孟教授从我们日常生活中经常用到的汉字入手，分析其造字方法，探寻其原旨原意，深刻揭示了汉字的词语示意、文化传承等功能。为我们学习、理解、讲授汉语汉字，提高学生的学习兴趣，提供了很好的方法。 感谢中国华文教育基金会和全美中文学校协会为在美国的中文教育者提供了一个难得的和汉语言文学大师互动学习的机会，感谢全美中文学校协会邢彬会长、许兰薇部长对本次活动的关怀和指导，感谢亚省现代中文学校的义工们一个月前即开始为本次讲座筹划安排，并确保互动课堂的成功举办。 让我们翘首企盼下一个精彩培训！
00634733517f39fb357cd33d54394207ae1fcbe9.translatedText: > One of the characteristics of Chinese characters, and the biggest difference between Chinese characters and alphabetic characters, is that each character is a complex of form, sound and meaning. The main body of the characters such as Bo, Bai, Bo, and Bai is "bai"; the main body of the characters such as Zhu, Zhu, Zhu, and Zhu is "zhe". "Bai" means "big", and "Zhe" means "attachment, attachment". Therefore, the meaning of Chinese characters with them as the main body must have the original meaning of the main character. In addition, Chinese characters also have the characteristic of "similar sounds and similar meanings". For example: appearance, image, fragrance, sound, thought, enjoyment, etc., respectively express similar experiences in vision, taste, smell, hearing, psychology and other aspects. The history of human society will inevitably leave traces in words. Professor Meng used the characters "paper" and "zhu" as examples to interpret that our ancestors had a history of writing words on "grass"; taking "wife" as an example, it showed that our ancestors' marriages were based on robbing brides as the main method, and Western culture also has similar records of word creation and historical origins; he also used the word "read" as an example to explain how we inspected armed forces in ancient times, etc. All the teachers at the scene were firmly attracted by Professor Meng's erudite explanations and were deeply immersed in the vast and profound ocean of knowledge about the Chinese language. The 60 minutes passed quickly. Everyone felt that there was still something to learn and hoped to have the opportunity to listen to Professor Meng's lectures again. Professor Meng started with the Chinese characters we often use in our daily lives, analyzed their creation methods, explored their original meanings, and profoundly revealed the functions of Chinese characters in terms of word expression and cultural inheritance. It provides a good way for us to learn, understand and teach Chinese characters and improve students' interest in learning. Thanks to the China Chinese Language Education Foundation and the National Association of Chinese Schools for providing Chinese educators in the United States with a rare opportunity to interact with masters of Chinese language and literature. Thanks to President Xing Bin and Minister Xu Lanwei of the National Association of Chinese Schools for their care and guidance for this event. Thanks to the volunteers of the Modern Chinese School in Alberta for planning and arranging this lecture a month ago and ensuring the success of the interactive class. Let us look forward to the next exciting training!

3d30f0b3bf6b7c281850fc98f8bc2db53dd8ed86.sourceText: 亚省春晚是由亚省艺术学院和美中文化教育基金会共同主办，亚省华人华侨联合会，现代中文学校，希望中文学校，中华乐团，Tarwater Elementary School，Coronado Elementary School，凤凰导报，亚省时报，亚美报，太阳鸟亚利桑那华人网共同协办。 富国银行 Arizona抯 Vision ，王楠医生，利利超级市场，徐国富保险服务依然是资深的赞助商。他们共同为华人文化在海外的传播起到了重要作用。
3d30f0b3bf6b7c281850fc98f8bc2db53dd8ed86.translatedText: The Alberta Spring Festival Gala is co-sponsored by the Art Institute of Alberta and the US-China Cultural Education Foundation, and co-organized by the Chinese Overseas Chinese Association of Alberta, Modern Chinese School, Hope Chinese School, Chinese Orchestra, Tarwater Elementary School, Coronado Elementary School, Phoenix Herald, Alberta Times, Asian American News, and Sunbird Arizona Chinese Network. Wells Fargo, Arizona's Vision, Dr. Wang Nan, Lili Supermarket, and Xu Guofu Insurance Services remain senior sponsors. Together, they played an important role in the spread of Chinese culture overseas.

f868952b23aa31f68bbfd51eecec9e6c5667098c.sourceText: 本次春晚由近两百个华人家庭参与表演，上千观众观看。就开场舞一个舞蹈近上百的中美小朋友共同表演，瞬间点燃现场的热情。表演者是来自亚省艺术学院，Tarwater Elementary School，Coronado Elementary School两所公立小学，一个艺术学校。要想让这些孩子，整齐划一的听话，编排老师以及近二十个班妈们功劳大大的。为了配合演出，有的家庭全家出动，妈妈和孩子们紧张排练，爸爸妈妈爷爷姥姥天天接送，陪练，还要额外加上和其他班级合排，爸爸开始在家做饭，同时苦练摄影基本功，准备在正式演出时留下精彩的瞬间。2019年的春晚节目也将会让更多的观众参与其中，体会全家团圆，舞台上下齐欢乐的节日气氛。筹备工作紧锣密鼓，道具服装刚刚从中国采购回来，精彩的节目也在紧张有序的进行中，华人华侨联合会邀请嘉宾，现代中文学校和希望中学学校的小朋友正在准备朗诵以及传统戏曲两个特色节目。
f868952b23aa31f68bbfd51eecec9e6c5667098c.translatedText: This Spring Festival Gala was performed by nearly two hundred Chinese families and watched by thousands of viewers. In the opening dance, nearly a hundred Chinese and American children performed together, instantly igniting the enthusiasm of the venue. The performers are from two public elementary schools, the Alberta College of the Arts, Tarwater Elementary School and Coronado Elementary School, and an arts school. To make these children obedient in a uniform manner, the arrangement teacher and the nearly twenty class mothers have to do a lot of work. In order to cooperate with the performance, some families go out with the whole family. The mother and children rehearse intensively. The parents pick up and drop off the performers every day, and practice with them. In addition, they also arrange with other classes. The father starts cooking at home and practices basic photography skills at the same time, preparing to capture wonderful moments during the official performance. The 2019 Spring Festival Gala program will also allow more audiences to participate and experience the festive atmosphere of family reunion and joy on and off the stage. Preparations are in full swing, props and costumes have just been purchased from China, and exciting programs are also in progress. The Overseas Chinese Federation has invited guests, and children from Modern Chinese School and Hope Middle School are preparing two special programs: recitation and traditional opera.

34fe0bc72e7b1ff6d0347cace37dd5b85572a1ab.translatedText: >The United States and China join hands to welcome the Spring Festival

f535cdaf6d6a1e0671f6838f50a0fdae84c45a99.sourceText: 美中文化教育基金会将中国自贡的灯展带到了凤凰城，于此同时，他们也邀请到国内的精英艺人一起到亚省春晚同台献艺。挑战人类力量与柔韧性的极限，知名的中国杂技高手在高空用双臂将力量的美展现得淋漓尽致。他们时而如空中雄鹰般，翱翔展翅，时而变轻巧的飞雁，穿梭于云际。
f535cdaf6d6a1e0671f6838f50a0fdae84c45a99.translatedText: The U.S.-China Cultural and Educational Foundation brought China’s Zigong lantern show to Phoenix. At the same time, they also invited domestic elite artists to perform on the same stage at the Alberta Spring Festival Gala. Challenging the limits of human strength and flexibility, the well-known Chinese acrobatic master used his arms at high altitude to vividly demonstrate the beauty of strength. Sometimes they soar like eagles in the sky, sometimes they become light geese, flying through the clouds.

a854bf72da872b0eacd6dd27e990b4cf35348463.sourceText: 来自四川的传统技艺变脸是很多美国朋友的最爱，四川的变脸大师将中西文化相结合，让传统技艺焕发现代风采。这是来自中国家乡的节日问候，也是传统艺术的交流和传承。既然请到了这么多优秀的表演嘉宾，作为东道主，在Young Women in Harmony国际比赛中连续四次第一，天籁之音，亚利桑那无伴奏青少年合唱团，也将和我们一起同庆新春，庆祝华人节日。最为亚省最有人气的华裔合唱团棗中华乐团与现代中文学校学生乐队和Trinity church 管弦乐队联合演绎。中华乐团合唱队和乐队正在蔡老师的带领下加紧排练，届时一个场面宏大，气势磅礴的经典音乐曲目《今夜无眠》将会呈现给观众。
a854bf72da872b0eacd6dd27e990b4cf35348463.translatedText: The traditional face-changing technique from Sichuan is the favorite of many American friends. Sichuan's face-changing masters combine Chinese and Western cultures to give the traditional technique a modern look. This is a holiday greeting from my hometown in China, and it is also the exchange and inheritance of traditional art. Since we have invited so many outstanding performers, as the host, the Arizona A Cappella Youth Choir, which has won the first place four times in a row in the Young Women in Harmony international competition, will also join us to celebrate the New Year and Chinese festivals. The Zao Chinese Orchestra, the most popular Chinese choir in Alberta, jointly performed with the modern Chinese school student band and the Trinity church orchestra. The chorus and band of the Chinese Orchestra are rehearsing intensively under the leadership of Teacher Cai, and a grand and majestic classic music piece "Sleepless Tonight" will be presented to the audience.

de3fab55f293b41008629ede260c91a0fdd2f418.sourceText: 大凤凰城台美商会于十月十曰晚上六点在Octillo Country Club高尔夫度假村主办庆祝中华民国107年双十国庆暨中秋联欢酒会。主席大凤凰城台美商会会长张圣仪首先代表商会致欢迎词，感谢所有与会佳宾，并简介商会促成钱德勒市府与台南市前市长頼清德缔结姊妹市，致力推广棒球外交并见证台湾驻美代表高硕泰大使在Diamondbacks 对Dodgers 棒球赛䦕球仪式和举办经贸论坛，结合主流政要媒体社团及台商侨青共同参与，以落实国民外交宣扬中华民国台湾，让亜利桑那卅主流社会及侨民支持台湾参与各项国际组织并增加台湾在主流社会的能见度，増进台商会员交流联谊促进商机，凝聚侨心支持政府。
de3fab55f293b41008629ede260c91a0fdd2f418.translatedText: The Taiwan-American Chamber of Commerce in Greater Phoenix hosted a reception to celebrate the 107th National Day and Mid-Autumn Festival of the Republic of China at the Octillo Country Club golf resort at 6pm on October 10th. Chairman Zhang Shengyi, President of the Greater Phoenix Taiwan American Chamber of Commerce, first delivered a welcome speech on behalf of the Chamber of Commerce, thanked all the guests attending the meeting, and introduced that the Chamber of Commerce has promoted the establishment of a sister city between the Chandler City Hall and former Tainan City Mayor Li Qingde, and is committed to promoting baseball diplomacy. He also witnessed Taiwan's representative in the United States, Ambassador Ko Shuotai, at the Diamondbacks against the Dodgers. The baseball game ball ceremony and the economic and trade forum were held with the participation of mainstream politicians, media organizations and Taiwanese businessmen and overseas Chinese youth to implement national diplomacy and promote the Republic of China, Taiwan, so that the mainstream society and overseas Chinese in Arizona can support Taiwan's participation in various international organizations and increase Taiwan's visibility in mainstream society, increase exchanges and friendships among Taiwanese business members, promote business opportunities, and rally overseas Chinese to support the government.

08dab9eec726ce02b90a1928fee836da864ee081.sourceText: 今年八月大凤城台美商会受邀出席蔡英文总统过境洛杉矶侨宴及举办总统府祕书长陈菊欢迎晚宴，以实际行动表达支持政府的决心。钱德勒市长Jay Tibshraeny 于2014年十月十曰明令颁Proclaimed 十月十曰是中华民国台湾曰。洛杉矶经文处副处长王秉槙在致词中也特别提到亜利桑那卅和中华民国台湾自高华德联邦参议员至Senator John McCain 长久以来维持友好关係，非常支持台湾，亜利桑那卅也是台湾的重要经贸伙伴。
08dab9eec726ce02b90a1928fee836da864ee081.translatedText: In August this year, the Taiwan American Chamber of Commerce in Dafeng City was invited to attend President Tsai Ing-wen’s overseas Chinese banquet when she passed through Los Angeles and hosted a welcome dinner for Presidential Secretary-General Chen Ju to express her determination to support the government with practical actions. Chandler Mayor Jay Tibshraeny proclaimed Proclaimed on October 10, 2014. October 10 is Taiwan Day in the Republic of China. In his speech, Wang Bingshu, deputy director of the Los Angeles Cultural Affairs Office, also specifically mentioned that the District of Columbia and Taiwan of the Republic of China have maintained friendly relations for a long time from Senator John Goward to Senator John McCain and are very supportive of Taiwan. The District of Columbia is also an important economic and trade partner of Taiwan.

236f4adf3aeb63f65ce2ff32b148ee9338294232.sourceText: 本次国庆酒会以「明月心 台湾情 庆双十」为主题播放外交部双十国庆影片介绍台湾。酒会活动包括切双十国庆国旗大蛋糕仪式，主流政要致贺辞，表演节目，并备有十道美味前菜，二种义大利麵点和主厨烤牛肉美食餐点，台式月饼绿豆椪蛋黄酥，饮料和近百样高级摸彩奖品，供所有出席主流贵宾媒体，商会理监事会员暨台侨朋友享用。
236f4adf3aeb63f65ce2ff32b148ee9338294232.translatedText: This National Day cocktail reception is themed "Mighty Moon Heart, Taiwan Love Celebrates Double Ten" and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs' Double Ten National Day video will be played to introduce Taiwan. The cocktail reception included a National Day National Flag cake-cutting ceremony, congratulatory speeches from mainstream dignitaries, performances, and ten delicious appetizers, two types of pasta and chef's roast beef delicacies, Taiwanese mooncakes, mung bean and egg yolk cakes, drinks and nearly a hundred high-end lottery prizes for all attending mainstream VIP media, chamber of commerce supervisors and Taiwanese overseas friends to enjoy.

46b7313333c623f3c90e12f1ab5bb0e703bea1d9.sourceText: 【 侨报网 3月28日综合报道】”美国典型家庭年平均收入5.65万美元，中美经贸关系可帮这些家庭一年节省850美元。出口到美国的中国商品使美国物价水平降低1%-1.5%”这是美中贸易全国委员会联合英国牛津经济研究院提供的2015年相关数据。
46b7313333c623f3c90e12f1ab5bb0e703bea1d9.translatedText: [Comprehensive report by Qiaobao.com on March 28] "The average annual income of a typical American family is US$56,500. Sino-US economic and trade relations can help these families save US$850 a year. Chinese goods exported to the United States reduce the US price level by 1%-1.5%." This is relevant data for 2015 provided by the US-China Business Council and Oxford Economics in the UK.

9897faf4ad06e1910a7a7d876986c48061ebe4c3.sourceText: 中美经贸关系本是两国关系的压舱石，但美国特朗普政府对中美经贸的双赢视而不见。美国一些人对中国投资不放心、对美中贸易中美国逆差耿耿于怀甚至要打贸易战，美国很多普通家庭却要接受惩罚。
9897faf4ad06e1910a7a7d876986c48061ebe4c3.translatedText: Sino-US economic and trade relations are originally the ballast stone of the relationship between the two countries, but the Trump administration in the United States has turned a blind eye to the win-win situation of Sino-US economic and trade. Some people in the United States are worried about Chinese investment, are worried about the U.S. deficit in U.S.-China trade, and even want to start a trade war, but many ordinary families in the United States have to accept the punishment.

0a36eb75d0c8531f6b864326cb700466ee66981f.sourceText: 据环球时报报道，旅居美国华盛顿的资深媒体人隗静近日对自家和一些美国家庭的调查显示，中美经贸丰富了美国家庭的生活，从生日会上的礼物到餐桌上的香肠，从彩色印刷的书籍到”铁锈地带”创造的就业，美国都无法对中国说”不”。
0a36eb75d0c8531f6b864326cb700466ee66981f.translatedText: According to the Global Times, Wei Jing, a senior media person living in Washington, USA, recently conducted a survey of her own family and some American families. It showed that Sino-US trade has enriched the lives of American families. From gifts at birthday parties to sausages on the table, from color-printed books to jobs created in the "Rust Belt", the United States cannot say "no" to China.

66d36257db53219924bb5048bc09f14f5b2cdef4.sourceText: 光买玩具每年可省100美元
66d36257db53219924bb5048bc09f14f5b2cdef4.translatedText: You can save $100 a year just by buying toys

75a48b74e215203624fd3fbd28529108a701dddd.sourceText: 如果美国和中国开打贸易战，这样一个国家层面的”大政策”势必直接影响到成千上万个美国家庭的生活。我的家庭同样如此。对我7岁的女儿来说，玩具的地位至高无上。女儿上个月生日会上收到的20多份礼物基本上全是玩具，而且都是”中国制造”，多数玩具单价在30美元左右。女儿上学头10 个月里，几乎每个月都有小朋友开生日会要送礼。加上圣诞节和平时给孩子买玩具，保守估计，如果买中国制造的玩具我家每年就能节省100美元。美国的家庭主妇也要算账。一位有龙凤胎的美国妈妈告诉我，如果某个玩具单价超过30美元，她肯定不可能给儿子和女儿都买，他们只能一起玩同一个。
75a48b74e215203624fd3fbd28529108a701dddd.translatedText: If the United States and China start a trade war, such a "big policy" at the national level will inevitably directly affect the lives of thousands of American families. The same goes for my family. For my 7-year-old daughter, toys are king. Most of the more than 20 gifts my daughter received at her birthday party last month were toys, and they were all "Made in China." Most of the toys cost around US$30 each. During the first 10 months of my daughter's schooling, almost every month there was a birthday party for children asking for gifts. In addition to buying toys for my children at Christmas and normal times, I conservatively estimate that if I buy toys made in China, my family can save US$100 every year. American housewives also have scores to settle. An American mother with twins told me that if a toy costs more than $30, she will definitely not be able to buy it for both her son and daughter. They can only play with the same one together.

c0bff595452d28b1273ba61422db87ae071cfe75.sourceText: 原标题：对中国免签、落地签国家已达68个，最高效的国家一分钟出签
c0bff595452d28b1273ba61422db87ae071cfe75.translatedText: Original title: There are 68 visa-free and visa-on-arrival countries for China, and the most efficient country can issue visas in one minute

5a5f1f8445f0e53534278942f48b5b0e5f1a9734.sourceText: 4月2日,携程旅游在上海发布了我国首个”全球签证服务中心”，并发布《2017-2018年度国民出境游签证报告》和各国签证办理度排行榜，从签证角度对国人出境旅行的最新特征进行了解读。
5a5f1f8445f0e53534278942f48b5b0e5f1a9734.translatedText: On April 2, Ctrip Travel launched my country's first "Global Visa Service Center" in Shanghai, and released the "2017-2018 National Outbound Travel Visa Report" and the visa processing rankings of various countries, interpreting the latest characteristics of Chinese outbound travel from a visa perspective.

b5a611b09439016beb04f2a9cdfe5eb944dd6a78.sourceText: 报告显示，国人出境游和签证办理便利度大幅提升。目前对我国持普通护照中国公民提供免签、落地签的国家数量已达68个。各国签证条件简化、电子签实行，极大便利了中国公民出境旅游。
b5a611b09439016beb04f2a9cdfe5eb944dd6a78.translatedText: The report shows that the convenience of Chinese people traveling abroad and applying for visas has been greatly improved. Currently, the number of countries that provide visa-free and visa-on-arrival services to Chinese citizens holding ordinary passports has reached 68. The simplified visa conditions and implementation of electronic visas in various countries have greatly facilitated Chinese citizens’ outbound travel.

8ef078f03af7faf2b1213dc5bce0e5967551d603.sourceText: ”签证便利度排行榜”前三甲分别是马来西亚、土耳其和柬埔寨，在线办理签证最快只需要1分钟出签。亚洲等短线国家平均办签时长缩短到平均6.8个工作日。
8ef078f03af7faf2b1213dc5bce0e5967551d603.translatedText: The top three in the "Visa Convenience Ranking" are Malaysia, Türkiye and Cambodia. The fastest time to apply for a visa online is 1 minute. The average visa processing time in short-term countries such as Asia has been shortened to an average of 6.8 working days.

ebb7d003324458d085c310e02ee05082110738be.sourceText: 免签证、落地签国家已增至68个
ebb7d003324458d085c310e02ee05082110738be.translatedText: The number of visa-free and visa-on-arrival countries has increased to 68

aed2cac11a80477d124cc8d9ce0031fd73f26a89.sourceText: 为了招揽中国游客，各国签证政策的变化频次明显提高，特别是多个热门目的地对中国开放免签或落地签。报告显示，截至今年3月15日，持普通护照中国公民可以免签证或落地签前往的国家数量增至68个。相比去年3月份的61个增加了7个，增幅喜人。这七个国家分别是阿联酋、巴巴多斯、加蓬、玻利维亚、卡塔尔、卢旺达、圣多美和普林西比。
aed2cac11a80477d124cc8d9ce0031fd73f26a89.translatedText: In order to attract Chinese tourists, the frequency of changes in visa policies in various countries has increased significantly, especially many popular destinations that offer visa-free or visa-on-arrival to China. The report shows that as of March 15 this year, the number of countries that Chinese citizens holding ordinary passports can visit without visa or visa on arrival has increased to 68. This is an increase of 7 compared to 61 in March last year, which is a gratifying increase. The seven countries are the United Arab Emirates, Barbados, Gabon, Bolivia, Qatar, Rwanda, Sao Tome and Principe.

fe0d81c55dd49d048fe641089d54dd43d4e5a307.sourceText: 这些国家和地区包括11个互免普通护照签证的，例如毛里求斯、塞舌尔、塞尔维亚等；15个单方面允许中国公民免签入境，比如阿联酋、印度尼西亚、韩国济州岛、摩洛哥等；42个单方面允许中国公民办理落地签证，例如泰国、越南、柬埔寨、马尔代夫等。
fe0d81c55dd49d048fe641089d54dd43d4e5a307.translatedText: These countries and regions include 11 countries that mutually exempt ordinary passports from visas, such as Mauritius, Seychelles, Serbia, etc.; 15 countries that unilaterally allow Chinese citizens to enter visa-free, such as the United Arab Emirates, Indonesia, South Korea's Jeju Island, Morocco, etc.; 42 countries that unilaterally allow Chinese citizens to apply for visas on arrival, such as Thailand, Vietnam, Cambodia, Maldives, etc.

558af1914248a6da85eb2a6a37b36c44e1239edf.sourceText: 2018年，韩国冬奥会对观赛的中国团队游客免签；俄罗斯世界杯对中国游客免签；欧洲阿尔巴尼亚在4到10月对中国实行旺季免签。
558af1914248a6da85eb2a6a37b36c44e1239edf.translatedText: In 2018, the Korean Winter Olympics will be visa-free for Chinese team tourists attending the games; the Russian World Cup will be visa-free for Chinese tourists; European Albania will be visa-free for China during the peak season from April to October.

366f258e88aa02db71a59f285f9738327c9ffcf3.sourceText: 俄罗斯成为办签证增幅最高的国家
366f258e88aa02db71a59f285f9738327c9ffcf3.translatedText: >Russia has become the country with the highest increase in visa applications

b8672a399caa8bb2863de57c3c9926ca2054a5eb.sourceText: 从办签证数量看，携程签证平台共可以办理的122个国家和地区中，前十大热门国家分别为：泰国、日本、新加坡、马来西亚、美国、越南、澳大利亚、菲律宾、加拿大和柬埔寨。这些国家也基本上都在签证便利度上排名领先，也说明签证便利性是推动出境游的重要引擎。
b8672a399caa8bb2863de57c3c9926ca2054a5eb.translatedText: In terms of the number of visa applications, among the 122 countries and regions that the Ctrip visa platform can handle, the top ten most popular countries are: Thailand, Japan, Singapore, Malaysia, the United States, Vietnam, Australia, the Philippines, Canada and Cambodia. These countries are also basically ranked first in terms of visa convenience, which also shows that visa convenience is an important engine for promoting outbound tourism.

369ae70fc8dcd593f67e798a75eaf16937c1ea14.sourceText: 不少国家成为最近一年中国人出国旅游的”黑马”，2017-2018年办签数量上涨最快的前十大热门目的地：俄罗斯、日本、越南、菲律宾、奥地利、印度、西班牙、荷兰、新西兰、意大利。俄罗斯、日本、越南分获前三，通过携程办理签证人数增长依次为127%、90%、74%。凭借2018年世界杯的举办对中国游客的招揽，俄罗斯办签涨幅强势登顶第一位。日本也因为在2017年5月份简化了签证政策，赴日人数激增。
369ae70fc8dcd593f67e798a75eaf16937c1ea14.translatedText: Many countries have become "dark horses" for Chinese people traveling abroad in the past year. The top ten popular destinations with the fastest growing number of visa applications from 2017 to 2018 are: Russia, Japan, Vietnam, Philippines, Austria, India, Spain, Netherlands, New Zealand, and Italy. Russia, Japan, and Vietnam ranked in the top three, with the number of people applying for visas through Ctrip increasing by 127%, 90%, and 74% respectively. With the hosting of the 2018 World Cup attracting Chinese tourists, Russia ranked first in terms of increase in visa processing. Japan also simplified its visa policy in May 2017, resulting in a surge in the number of people visiting Japan.

cebec416fb7f63949336d42bf7d504985a160f3c.sourceText: 而办签便利度最高的前十名依次是：马来西亚、土耳其、越南、柬埔寨、泰国、俄罗斯、新加坡、美国、印度和菲律宾。相比2017年，绝大部分目的地的签证便利度都有提升。主要体现在电子签证的实施、材料的简化、办签时间缩短、价格下调等。马来西亚、柬埔寨、土耳其等因快速的网上电子签制度排名领先。
cebec416fb7f63949336d42bf7d504985a160f3c.translatedText: The top ten countries with the highest convenience in visa application are: Malaysia, Turkey, Vietnam, Cambodia, Thailand, Russia, Singapore, the United States, India and the Philippines. Compared with 2017, visa convenience has improved in most destinations. Mainly reflected in the implementation of electronic visas, simplification of materials, shortened visa application time, price reduction, etc. Malaysia, Cambodia, Türkiye, etc. rank first due to their fast online electronic visa systems.

b9479ffb4e9621556d15eb5f51319022d7d70196.sourceText: 女性办签证比例明显高于男性
b9479ffb4e9621556d15eb5f51319022d7d70196.translatedText: The proportion of women applying for visas is significantly higher than that of men

286316a930c4bac8549d47368f6c72f80fdc6d7d.sourceText: 从办理签证人群的构成中也可以看出中国出境游游客人群的主要特征。
286316a930c4bac8549d47368f6c72f80fdc6d7d.translatedText: The main characteristics of China's outbound tourists can also be seen from the composition of the people who apply for visas.

3dc7a3876d0845cad1ef042445de8222020c731b.sourceText: 携程签证对用户的抽样调查发现，办签人群00后占11%，90后占18%，80后占31% ，70后占19%，中老年人占21%。显然，80后仍是办签群体的中坚力量，但90后00后的势头也正在猛增。
3dc7a3876d0845cad1ef042445de8222020c731b.translatedText: Ctrip Visa’s sample survey of users found that 11% of the people applying for visas were born in the 2000s, 18% were born in the 90s, 31% were born in the 80s, 19% were born in the 70s, and 21% were middle-aged and elderly people. Obviously, those born in the 1980s are still the backbone of the visa processing group, but the momentum of those born in the 90s and 00s is also growing rapidly.

f12a12687a143132ddebe70d9f256e19e324da2b.sourceText: 女性占比达到55%，这也从侧面说明女性在旅游行为中占据主导地位。
f12a12687a143132ddebe70d9f256e19e324da2b.translatedText: Women account for 55%, which also shows that women occupy a dominant position in tourism behavior.

9cbd556ad8de49c312ba60612a54774e25656002.sourceText: 在收入方面，办签人群中家庭年收入10万以下占9%，10-20万占28% ，20-30万占21%。30万以上占26%。
9cbd556ad8de49c312ba60612a54774e25656002.translatedText: In terms of income, 9% of those applying for visas have annual family incomes of less than RMB 100,000, 28% have annual incomes between RMB 100,000 and RMB 200,000, and 21% have annual household incomes between RMB 200,000 and RMB 300,000. More than 300,000 accounted for 26%.

e562545fab734bb1f18589a5c3453c58db93f9a1.sourceText: 从办理城市来看，在最近一年通过携程办理签证的百万级旅游者中，办理签证最多的前十五大城市为：上海、北京、广州、成都、深圳、南京、杭州、苏州、天津、佛山、武汉、无锡、重庆、宁波、东莞。
e562545fab734bb1f18589a5c3453c58db93f9a1.translatedText: From the perspective of application cities, among the millions of tourists who applied for visas through Ctrip in the past year, the top fifteen cities with the most visa applications are: Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Chengdu, Shenzhen, Nanjing, Hangzhou, Suzhou, Tianjin, Foshan, Wuhan, Wuxi, Chongqing, Ningbo, and Dongguan.

d4a0b2c07ab3b64280346266b044e41bd447d012.sourceText: 可见，除了上、北、广、深的一线城市以外，二线城市出境游继续一路高跟猛进，尤其是长江三角洲和珠三角城市成为中国公民出境游的两大重点区域。成都、重庆等城市也后力强劲。
d4a0b2c07ab3b64280346266b044e41bd447d012.translatedText: It can be seen that in addition to the first-tier cities in Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou and Shenzhen, outbound tourism in second-tier cities continues to advance rapidly. In particular, the Yangtze River Delta and Pearl River Delta cities have become the two key areas for Chinese citizens to travel abroad. Cities such as Chengdu and Chongqing also have strong prospects.

710a59876fa26facf3ed2ba37208ae6414e56b3b.sourceText: 办签证最关心材料、出签率、时长
710a59876fa26facf3ed2ba37208ae6414e56b3b.translatedText: Materials, visa issuance rate, and duration of visa application are most concerned about

a0212821638c3383abd018e05bab72e150e2ba4a.sourceText: 携程签证报告还通过对实际办签证用户的问卷调查，发布了”国民办签最关心因素排行榜”，其中出签率和材料繁简程度占前两位，关注程度都到达69%、66%；对办签时长、办签资质和专业度也较为看重，关注程度都在50%以上，价格、服务水平、拒签退款关注度也都在40%以上。
a0212821638c3383abd018e05bab72e150e2ba4a.translatedText: The Ctrip Visa Report also released the "Ranking of Factors Most Concerned about Visa Application by Nationals" through a questionnaire survey of actual visa application users. , among which the visa issuance rate and the complexity of the materials accounted for the top two, with the attention levels reaching 69% and 66%; the visa application time, visa application qualifications and professionalism were also valued, with the attention level being more than 50%, and the price, service level, and refund for refusal were also more than 40%.

ef08696efb774ba985c4b9fea550d3ca30ce45fc.sourceText: 用户的调查还发现，在携程签证平台的服务保障中，旅游者认为最有价值的是：”价格透明”、”进度实时”、”退款保证”、”信息安全”、”拒签全退”。
ef08696efb774ba985c4b9fea550d3ca30ce45fc.translatedText: The user survey also found that among the service guarantees of the Ctrip visa platform, tourists think the most valuable ones are: "price transparency", "real-time progress", "refund guarantee", "information security", and "full refund for refusal of visa".

35a329aa85cf8b99068d9b8c299b137be2f7803d.sourceText: 携程签证专家分析，从用户调查看，办签出签难易程度、服务商专业度是我国出境游客最为关心的两大因素，办好签证是出境游的前提，能否顺利出签、旅行社机构是否靠谱最为重要，价格反而排名其次。这说明消费者心理越来越成熟。
35a329aa85cf8b99068d9b8c299b137be2f7803d.translatedText: Ctrip visa expert analysis shows that according to user surveys, the difficulty of obtaining a visa and the professionalism of service providers are the two factors that Chinese outbound tourists are most concerned about. Obtaining a visa is a prerequisite for outbound travel. Whether the visa can be issued smoothly and whether the travel agency is reliable are the most important, and price ranks second. This shows that consumer psychology is becoming more and more mature.

8feb73701628e0dab10763abfbc4ea88c346ce9c.sourceText: 新華社華盛頓3月14日電 新聞分析：特朗普頻繁換人為哪般
8feb73701628e0dab10763abfbc4ea88c346ce9c.translatedText: Xinhua News Agency, Washington, March 14th News analysis: Why does Trump frequently change people?

8969d467ff6bf2f80923af66994feae3ab9c8dd9.sourceText: 新華社記者徐劍梅 劉陽
8969d467ff6bf2f80923af66994feae3ab9c8dd9.translatedText: Xinhua News Agency reporters Xu Jianmei and Liu Yang

7aa7405f0654808da58e681bdc860b77e37cae7b.sourceText: 這些人的離職原因各異。有因與特朗普政見不合，如蒂勒森、科恩；有因”通俄”調查，如弗林、科米；有因白宮內鬥，如普裏伯斯、斯派塞、班農；有因個人醜聞，如因包機事件下台的衛生部長普賴斯和因家暴指控辭職的白宮秘書羅布.波特等。
7aa7405f0654808da58e681bdc860b77e37cae7b.translatedText: The reasons for these people leaving are different. Some are due to political disagreements with Trump, such as Tillerson and Cohen; some are due to the "Russian collusion" investigation, such as Flynn and Comey; some are due to infighting in the White House, such as Priebus, Spicer, and Bannon; and some are due to personal scandals, such as Health Secretary Price who resigned due to the charter flight incident, and White House Secretary Rob Porter who resigned due to domestic violence accusations.

020def52eb1ef880929512306881a17ab335d6c5.sourceText: 對此，白宮和多數美國主流媒體呈現兩極化说法。后者一直批評特朗普上任以來，政府內部運作混亂成為一種常態；特朗普則堅稱自己執政穩定、有效。
020def52eb1ef880929512306881a17ab335d6c5.translatedText: In this regard, the White House and most mainstream American media have polarized opinions. The latter has been criticizing that since Trump took office, chaos in the government's internal operations has become the norm; Trump insists that his governance is stable and effective.

4e93ace9af90355b02aaaecce32030b6669ddbc1.sourceText: 從大選時起，特朗普就和美國主流媒體激烈互懟，這已成美國政治生活一道日常景觀。此次更值得注意的，是面對白宮的人事喧嘩、特朗普處理人事變動的非常規方式(通過推特宣佈蒂勒森離職，而蒂勒森本人尚在從非洲返美途中且不知情)，共和黨表現出越來越高的容忍度和接受度。有共和黨國會議員感慨：”我們對此已經麻木了。”前白宮新聞秘書斯派塞則為特朗普辯護说，美國經濟、股市都景氣、稅改等取得成功，既然一切順利，政府內部混亂一點又算什麼呢？
4e93ace9af90355b02aaaecce32030b6669ddbc1.translatedText: Since the election, Trump has been fiercely exchanging blows with the mainstream American media, which has become a daily spectacle in American political life. What is more noteworthy this time is that in the face of the personnel uproar in the White House and Trump's unconventional way of handling personnel changes (announced Tillerson's resignation through Twitter, while Tillerson himself was still on his way back to the United States from Africa and was unaware of it), the Republican Party has shown increasing tolerance and acceptance. Some Republican congressmen lamented: "We have become numb to this." Former White House press secretary Spicer defended Trump, saying that the U.S. economy, stock market, and tax reform have been successful. Since everything is going well, what's the point of a little chaos within the government?

0465c2c8116a0b791ac6debb44ff2542817f1c80.sourceText: 一年多來，特朗普通過社交媒體，成功地把美國主流媒體的批評隔斷於其基本盤之外，明顯不再像上台初期那麼願意拉攏共和黨建制派，聽取其建議並示好和妥協。而國會共和黨人中，目前公開和特朗普嗆聲者寥寥，即便與特朗普”撕破臉”的參議院外交委員會主席科克等人，在稅改等關鍵時刻也支持了特朗普。相形之下，共和黨建制派處處着眼於今年11月國會中期選舉，顧忌特朗普對共和黨選民基本盤的掌控。
0465c2c8116a0b791ac6debb44ff2542817f1c80.translatedText: For more than a year, Trump has used social media to successfully isolate criticism from the mainstream American media from his base. He is obviously no longer as willing as he was when he took office to win over the Republican establishment, listen to its suggestions, and show goodwill and compromise. Among congressional Republicans, very few have publicly spoken out against Trump. Even Senate Foreign Affairs Committee Chairman Corker and others, who have "fallen apart" from Trump, have supported Trump at critical moments such as tax reform. In contrast, the Republican establishment is focused on the congressional midterm elections in November this year and is wary of Trump's control of the Republican base of voters.

9abdda5e61415e23b4737a589ba721497189c89d.sourceText: 這就使得一段時間以來，特朗普對共和黨越來越顯得強勢。早有美媒評論，特朗普相信自己的直覺遠勝自己的顧問。而事實上，從大選到現在，他的直覺在許多事件中的判斷更接共和黨基礎選民的”地氣”，這方面遠勝國會共和黨人一籌。在憑直覺判斷和運用推特維持基本盤方面，特朗普迄今比較順利，而這種順利也助長了他的自信，未來可能産生雙刃劍效應。
9abdda5e61415e23b4737a589ba721497189c89d.translatedText: This has made Trump increasingly aggressive towards the Republican Party for some time. US media have long commented that Trump trusts his own instincts far more than his own advisers. In fact, from the election to the present, his intuitive judgments on many events are more in line with the "local temperament" of the Republican base voters, and he is far better than the Republicans in Congress in this regard. Trump has so far been relatively successful in making intuitive judgments and using Twitter to maintain his base, and this success has also boosted his self-confidence, which may have a double-edged sword effect in the future.

c5bf3ab31983712f2399326ebf4c4025b0b1de23.sourceText: 許多跡象表明，不論內政、外交和經濟貿易領域，特朗普希望自己扮演決策者、宣示者甚至新聞發言人的角色。他不斷通過推特投下政策巨石，激起輿論壯觀的水花。但宣佈政策意向是一回事，具體誰來執行、如何執行？分析人士認為，這表明，特朗普可能存在”真人秀”心理，或者本來就有轉移輿論焦點和公衆注意力的考量，總之，他常將重大政策宣示作為一種策略手段。
c5bf3ab31983712f2399326ebf4c4025b0b1de23.translatedText: Many signs indicate that Trump hopes to play the role of decision-maker, announcer and even spokesperson regardless of domestic affairs, foreign affairs, economic and trade fields. He continues to throw policy boulders through Twitter, arousing spectacular public opinion splashes. But announcing policy intentions is one thing, but who will implement it and how? Analysts believe that this shows that Trump may have a "reality show" mentality, or that he has an original intention to shift the focus of public opinion and public attention. In short, he often uses major policy announcements as a strategic means.

670963ffef0ecdb37ee6478a2c9c120f87e557cc.sourceText: ”猜一猜誰不來吃晚餐”，一直是美國媒體津津樂道的話題。分析人士認為，特朗普政府的人事變動或仍將繼續上演。
670963ffef0ecdb37ee6478a2c9c120f87e557cc.translatedText: "Guess who won't come to dinner" has always been a hot topic in the American media. Analysts believe that personnel changes in the Trump administration may continue to occur.

5603e92488cf421ba37cf8ebbbd8c6112f6368c6.sourceText: 中新网3月19日电 据美国中文网综合报道，纽约华裔青年董金(Jin Dong，音译)此前向未婚妻翁玉清(Yu Qing Weng，音译)和其家庭支付了29万美元的彩金，但还没等到举行婚礼，翁玉清便成了”落跑新娘”。董金感到自己受骗，于是将未婚妻和其家人告上法庭，要求赔偿损失。
5603e92488cf421ba37cf8ebbbd8c6112f6368c6.translatedText: China News Service, March 19. According to a comprehensive report by the Chinese website of the United States, Jin Dong (transliteration), a Chinese young man in New York, had previously paid a bonus of US$290,000 to his fiancée Yu Qing Weng (transliteration) and her family. However, before the wedding could be held, Yu Qing Weng became a "runaway bride." Dong Jin felt that he had been cheated, so he took his fiancée and her family to court, demanding compensation for losses.

fa8ccfc73292e04b6aa49042a4491e00ca316539.sourceText: 据《每日邮报》报道，董金一周前向曼哈顿最高法院提交起诉书。起诉书写到，”作为合法结婚的承诺以及家乡习俗”，董姓男子付给了翁女士六位数的礼金。为了凑足这笔礼金，他向不少家里的亲戚、朋友借了钱。
fa8ccfc73292e04b6aa49042a4491e00ca316539.translatedText: According to the "Daily Mail" report, Dong Jin submitted an indictment to Manhattan Supreme Court a week ago. The indictment states that "as a commitment to legal marriage and as a custom in his hometown," the man surnamed Dong paid Ms. Weng a six-figure gift. In order to collect the gift money, he borrowed money from many relatives and friends at home.

5e47a7835ea45b6f2ebdcb5a1cda1d0b7963763c.sourceText: 根据《纽约邮报》，董金和未婚妻在2017年早些时候已摆了酒席，两人决定在晚些时候再去正式领证。
5e47a7835ea45b6f2ebdcb5a1cda1d0b7963763c.translatedText: According to the New York Post, Dong Jin and his fiancée had a banquet earlier in 2017, and the two decided to formally obtain the certificate later.

e4fbf5a6e93ce15790dfdde9685416553ca5442f.sourceText: 但2017年8月，翁玉清却从两人的住所”消失了”。 根据起诉书，翁玉清离开时拿走了所有的结婚彩礼和珠宝。
e4fbf5a6e93ce15790dfdde9685416553ca5442f.translatedText: But in August 2017, Weng Yuqing "disappeared" from their residence. According to the indictment, Weng Yuqing took all the wedding gifts and jewelry when he left.

cbe3a89725b12b27bb948078e78ffbd78b2d43ec.sourceText: 据悉，董金此前还给了翁玉清母亲5300美元的礼物，并给了她父母6300美元的聘礼。准新娘的哥哥和祖母也分别从董先生的手中拿到2000美元。
cbe3a89725b12b27bb948078e78ffbd78b2d43ec.translatedText: It is reported that Dong Jin also gave Weng Yuqing’s mother a gift of US$5,300 and a betrothal gift of US$6,300 to her parents. The bride-to-be's brother and grandmother also received US$2,000 each from Mr. Dong.

c72aa7faf5d1c77bb41051f627235b2c08e4f175.sourceText: 董金之后从翁玉清母亲那里拿回了1500美元。当他要求女方家退还从自己这里拿到的所有聘礼时，则遭到拒绝。董金随即将翁一家人告上法院，并要求退还28.7万美元。
c72aa7faf5d1c77bb41051f627235b2c08e4f175.translatedText: Dong Jin later took back $1,500 from Weng Yuqing’s mother. When he asked the woman's family to return all the bride price they received from him, he was refused. Dong Jin then took the Weng family to court and demanded the return of US$287,000.

4d587f4c684cad042d05e8d864679f4314566f36.sourceText: 为便利当地中国公民申办证件，驻洛杉矶总领馆将于 4 月 7 日（星期六）派员在亚利桑那州立大学现场受理中国公民护照、旅行证申请。现就具体事项通知如下：
4d587f4c684cad042d05e8d864679f4314566f36.translatedText: In order to facilitate local Chinese citizens to apply for documents, the Consulate General in Los Angeles will send personnel to Arizona State University on April 7 (Saturday) to accept applications for passports and travel documents from Chinese citizens. The specific matters are now notified as follows:

a1548177945cd68b6d5ad53fced4490c0bc73d54.sourceText: 地址： Neeb Hall, L.S. Neeb Hall, 920 S Forest Mall, Tempe, AZ 85281 （请点击浏览地图）。
a1548177945cd68b6d5ad53fced4490c0bc73d54.translatedText: Address: Neeb Hall, L.S. Neeb Hall, 920 S Forest Mall, Tempe, AZ 85281 (please click to view the map).

dae298b1c5da4dbe91d5cca7057e368bfe7636d9.sourceText: 受场地、人手等条件的制约，此次现场办证仅受理以下申请：
dae298b1c5da4dbe91d5cca7057e368bfe7636d9.translatedText: > Subject to the constraints of venue, manpower and other conditions, this on-site visa application only accepts the following applications:

ad705267a3f3c8b8831e559486ea07568a35e9e8.sourceText: （一）有效期不足一年的 因私护照换发 申请；
ad705267a3f3c8b8831e559486ea07568a35e9e8.translatedText: (1) Application for renewal of private passport with validity less than one year;

dd782ca96618289e3211f8c704a8a4c5199ec3e1.sourceText: （二）空白签证页用完的 因私护照换发 申请；
dd782ca96618289e3211f8c704a8a4c5199ec3e1.translatedText: (2) Renewal of private passport with all blank visa pages Application;

1cf0840fdd65515f518912e2b3703234e6c0d5a1.sourceText: （三）遗失 护照补发 申请；

65cc4e55613da555b9e7add59605e06dba00f678.sourceText: （四）在美出生 中国籍儿童的旅行证 申请。
65cc4e55613da555b9e7add59605e06dba00f678.translatedText: (4) Application for travel permit for Chinese children born in the United States.

21c80adab9812d490852eb52490c55d7510fdaa0.sourceText: （一） 所有申请人（含儿童）均须 认真阅读并浏览我馆网站发布的 《外地办证须知》 ，并须按要求、逐项、提前准备好所有申请材料。
21c80adab9812d490852eb52490c55d7510fdaa0.translatedText: (1) All applicants (including children) must carefully read and browse the "Instructions for Applying for Certificates from Other Places" published on our website, and must prepare all application materials item by item in advance as required.

fc96a7bd4642ca8bc291c0e2d848195b4c479361.sourceText: （二） 所有申请人均须 事先在线预约、填表（请 点击这里 ）。此次办证预约与到总领馆预约不同， 请勿必选择办证地点为” 凤凰城” 。现场办证的预约系统将于 3 月 20 日下午 5 ： 00 开通，并在 4 月 5 日下午 5 ： 00（洛杉矶时间） 关闭，请及时预约。
fc96a7bd4642ca8bc291c0e2d848195b4c479361.translatedText: (2) All applicants must make an appointment online and fill out the form in advance (please click here). This appointment for applying for the certificate is different from making an appointment at the Consulate General. Please do not select the place of application as "Phoenix City". The appointment system for on-site certification will open at 5:00 pm on March 20 and close at 5:00 pm on April 5 (Los Angeles time). Please make an appointment in time.

71e415be2009d5e87aa6d23cd4fa9db91e9088cf.sourceText: （一） 总领馆按预约时段，而非现场排队先后受理申请。 为避免长时间等候且为维护良好的办证秩序，请按预约时段准时（不建议提前）前来递交申请。
71e415be2009d5e87aa6d23cd4fa9db91e9088cf.translatedText: (1) The Consulate General accepts applications by appointment rather than on-site queuing. In order to avoid long waiting times and to maintain good order, please submit your application on time (it is not recommended to arrive in advance) according to the appointment time slot.

849e5a1b63afb4c66c8feaef4fab7a37015eff12.translatedText: (2) The following situations will not be accepted:

8e3ef03751592545712cf097314f419ebfda4b51.sourceText: 1、 未提前在线预约、填表并打印申请表格等材料的；
8e3ef03751592545712cf097314f419ebfda4b51.translatedText: 1. Failure to make an online appointment, fill in and print the application form and other materials in advance;

3a41cf00556359672157820f227f415e5678482c.sourceText: 2、 预约时未按要求选定办证地点为”凤凰城”的 ；

a6074713f9151dc0add78f946dc562b6e2b40d4c.translatedText: 3. Failure to prepare all the application materials as required;

0d27a2709a35b4d02a04657808af5bcddabc3128.translatedText: 4. Failure to truthfully declare the situation.

c2fff62436aface0b67e9f3bd055c667876c755f.sourceText: 我馆今年 10 月将再次派员赴凤凰城办证，请注意根据个人情况安排好办证时间。
c2fff62436aface0b67e9f3bd055c667876c755f.translatedText: Our consulate will send personnel to Phoenix to apply for the certificate again in October this year. Please pay attention to arrange the time for applying for the certificate according to your personal situation.

20ed268204856e69f4a9eacd65cc26fedbad6f6e.sourceText: 更多当地华人活动等着你
20ed268204856e69f4a9eacd65cc26fedbad6f6e.translatedText: More local Chinese activities are waiting for you

32b12761249aa428f2452a0aa5a35f31da578e49.sourceText: # 李敖 病逝#【作家李敖去世：生前曾表示愿意将遗体捐给医院”千刀万剐”】今天上午10点59分，作家李敖去世，享年83岁。李敖说他不忌讳生死，死后愿意把遗体捐给医院，但是要把骨头立在医院病房，让欣赏他的人看看他的”骨气”，让对他恨之入骨的人也来看看”我的骨头就在这里”。
32b12761249aa428f2452a0aa5a35f31da578e49.translatedText: #李斖 died of illness# [Writer Li Ao passed away: Before his death, he expressed his willingness to donate his body to the hospital for "death by a thousand cuts"] At 10:59 this morning, the writer Li Ao passed away at the age of 83. Li Ao said that he was not taboo about life and death, and was willing to donate his body to the hospital after his death, but he would keep his bones in the hospital ward so that those who admired him could see his "bone" and those who hated him could also see "my bones are here."

b019f5a47fee1dbbf086129ee4ca880870872876.sourceText: 原标题：台湾作家李敖病逝 享年83岁
b019f5a47fee1dbbf086129ee4ca880870872876.translatedText: Original title: Taiwanese writer Li Ao died of illness at the age of 83

3847fc125750bef865dea425ea4ee0d336a1af37.sourceText: 海外网3月18日电 据台媒消息，台湾作家李敖因罹患脑瘤于今日（18日）病逝。据悉，李敖于18日上午10点59分离世，享年83 岁。将于下午2点在台北荣总中正楼一楼大厅召开记者会说明。
3847fc125750bef865dea425ea4ee0d336a1af37.translatedText: Overseas Network, March 18 According to Taiwanese media, Taiwanese writer Li Ao died today (18th) of a brain tumor. It is reported that Li Ao passed away at 10:59 am on the 18th at the age of 83. A press conference will be held at 2 p.m. in the lobby on the first floor of the Zhongzheng Building, Taipei Wing.

a4b7aa670604d9e66853deffa9a5c2e55d19f18d.sourceText: 据海外网早前报道，83岁高龄的台湾知名作家李敖，这两年健康频亮红灯，更惊爆罹患脑瘤，只剩3年可活。先前李敖告诉曾透露自己去年因左脚行动不便而就医，竟发现罹患脑瘤，所幸最终证实是良性，但他的经纪人表示，有两家医院皆表示没看过这样的病例，认为病例很罕见。
a4b7aa670604d9e66853deffa9a5c2e55d19f18d.translatedText: According to overseas reports earlier, the 83-year-old well-known Taiwanese writer Li Ao has been suffering from frequent health problems in the past two years. He even suffered from a brain tumor and only had 3 years left to live. Li Ao previously told reporters that he sought medical treatment last year due to difficulty in moving his left foot and was found to have a brain tumor. Fortunately, it turned out to be benign. However, his agent said that two hospitals said they had never seen such a case and believed that the case was rare.

ce5c58eb743f7e95246409507948bec843a4ac04.sourceText: 李敖（1935年4月25日?018年3月18日），男，字敖之，思想家，自由主义大师，国学大师，中国近代史学者，时事批评家，台湾作家，历史学家，诗人；台湾省无党派人士，曾任台湾”立法委员”，2008年任满，宣布退出台湾省政坛。因其文笔犀利、批判色彩浓厚，嬉笑怒骂皆成文章，所以自诩为”中国白话文第一人”。
ce5c58eb743f7e95246409507948bec843a4ac04.translatedText: Li Ao (April 25, 1935 - March 18, 2018), male, courtesy name Aozhi, thinker, liberal master, Chinese studies master, scholar of modern Chinese history, current affairs critic, Taiwanese writer, historian, poet; non-party person in Taiwan Province, once served as Taiwan's "legislator". When his term expired in 2008, he announced his withdrawal from the political arena of Taiwan Province. Because of his sharp writing style and strong critical tone, he can express both laughter and anger, so he calls himself "the first person in Chinese vernacular writing".

9350053f03d79a59298355c01c1749415a334d33.sourceText: ”以玩世来醒世，用骂世而救世”，有《北京法源寺》、《阳痿美国》、《李敖有话说》、《红色11》等100多本著作，前后共有九十六本被禁，创下历史记录，被西方传媒追捧为”中国近代最杰出的批评家”。《李敖大全集》是他大部分著作的合集，共80册，凡3000万字。2005年9月访问大陆，在北大、清华、复旦三所顶尖高校发表了名为”金刚怒目、菩萨低眉、尼姑思凡”的系列演讲。
9350053f03d79a59298355c01c1749415a334d33.translatedText: "To wake up the world with cynicism, and to save the world with scolding", there are more than 100 books such as "Beijing Fayuan Temple", "Impotence America", "Li Ao has something to say", "Red 11", etc. A total of 96 books have been banned, setting a historical record. He is sought after by the Western media as "the most outstanding critic in modern China". "The Complete Works of Li Ao" is a collection of most of his works, with a total of 80 volumes and 30 million words. In September 2005, he visited mainland China and delivered a series of lectures titled "Vajra's Angry Eyes, Bodhisattvas' Low Brows, and Nuns' Thoughts on Extraordinary Things" at three top universities: Peking University, Tsinghua University, and Fudan University.

b87a4e302418da860bbe7f607d6026513893c4ae.translatedText: Letter written by Li Ao before his death

4770639c4699ff955ff88a49e48c1aa36e952ce2.sourceText: 你们好，我是李敖，今年83岁。
4770639c4699ff955ff88a49e48c1aa36e952ce2.translatedText: Hello, I am Li Ao, I am 83 years old.

b0f97c3db882f0f904a8ac8f17d762b95f63fd11.sourceText: 年初，我被查出来罹患脑瘤，现在刚做完放射性治疗。现在每天要吃6粒类固醇，所以身体里面变得像一个战场，最近又感染二次急性肺炎住院，我很痛苦，好像地狱离我并不远了。
b0f97c3db882f0f904a8ac8f17d762b95f63fd11.translatedText: At the beginning of the year, I was diagnosed with a brain tumor and have just completed radioactive treatment. Now I have to take 6 steroids a day, so my body has become like a battlefield. Recently, I was hospitalized for a second acute pneumonia infection. I am in pain, as if hell is not far away from me.

032f1bbd1497c84f112d2801d1abf98365242b7d.sourceText: 我这一生当中，骂过很多人，伤过很多人;仇敌无数，朋友不多。医生告诉我：”你最多还能活三年，有什么想做、想干的，抓紧!”
032f1bbd1497c84f112d2801d1abf98365242b7d.translatedText: In my life, I have scolded many people and hurt many people; I have countless enemies and few friends. The doctor told me: "You can live for up to three years. If you want to do anything, hurry up!"

9663838135c9e6f667b86ac9ea4827606a777b44.sourceText: 我就想，在这最后的时间里，除了把《李敖大全集》加编41-85本的目标之外，就想和我的家人，友人，仇人再见一面做个告别，你们可以理解成这是我们人生中最后一次会面，”再见李敖”及此之后，再无相见。
9663838135c9e6f667b86ac9ea4827606a777b44.translatedText: I just thought that in this last time, in addition to the goal of adding 41-85 volumes to "The Complete Works of Li Ao", I just want to see my family, friends, and enemies again to say goodbye. You can understand that this is the last meeting in our lives, "Goodbye Li Ao" and we will never see each other again after that.

72d2d9d87bd2c84878d05ee5ff6e8841d5e37e62.sourceText: 因为是最后一面，所以我希望这次会面是真诚，坦白的。不仅有我们如何相识，如何相知，更要有我们如何相爱又相杀。
72d2d9d87bd2c84878d05ee5ff6e8841d5e37e62.translatedText: Because this is the last time, I hope this meeting is sincere and frank. Not only how we met and understood each other, but also how we loved and killed each other.

13021f0350faa2da812f1cf5a343004204f5e60b.sourceText: 对于来宾，我会对你说实话;我也想你能对我讲真话，言者无罪，闻者足戒。
13021f0350faa2da812f1cf5a343004204f5e60b.translatedText: For the guests, I will tell you the truth; I also want you to tell the truth to me. The speaker is not guilty and the listener is warned.

fbd7c02142677e76898ac65e20dfcd8dc58984a9.sourceText: 或许我们之前有很多残酷的斗争，但或许我们之前也有很多美好的回忆;我希望通过这次会面，能让我们都不留遗憾。不留遗憾，这是我对你的承诺，也是我对你的期盼。
fbd7c02142677e76898ac65e20dfcd8dc58984a9.translatedText: Maybe we had many cruel struggles before, but maybe we also had many good memories before; I hope that through this meeting, we will have no regrets. No regrets, this is my promise to you and my expectation for you.

5caed75c22e919abf9157199f26e207eed827ceb.sourceText: 对于来宾，不管你们身在哪里，我都会给你们手写一封邀请信。邀请你来台北，来我书房，我们可以一起吃一顿饭，合一张影，我会带你去看可爱的猫，我会全程记录我们最后一面的相会，一方面是留作你我纪念，另一方面也满足我的一点私心：告别大陆媒体近10年了，我想通过这些影片，让大家再一次见到我，再一次认识不一样的我，见证我人生的谢幕。 谢谢各位!
5caed75c22e919abf9157199f26e207eed827ceb.translatedText: For guests, no matter where you are, I will write a handwritten invitation letter to you. I invite you to come to Taipei, come to my study, we can have a meal together, take a photo together, I will take you to see the cute cats, and I will record our last meeting throughout the whole process. On the one hand, it will be kept as a souvenir for you and me, and on the other hand, it will also satisfy my selfishness: I have bid farewell to the mainland media for nearly 10 years. I want to use these videos to let everyone see me again, get to know a different me again, and witness the end of my life. Thank you!

2eab54a0783f1e279efde0d013989604b7eb4e24.sourceText: 移民美国才两年遭遇国税局彻查 险失绿卡
2eab54a0783f1e279efde0d013989604b7eb4e24.translatedText: Just two years after immigrating to the United States, he encountered a thorough investigation by the IRS and nearly lost his green card

a577643ef8777617783e2beb325cc362edf33e5e.sourceText: 中国侨网3月22日电 据美国《世界日报》报道，不同于几十年前的老移民拿着200美元就敢追逐”美国梦”，如今的新移民经济实力越来越强，多以高学历人才或经营企业为主。众所周知，美国课税严重，为了避免辛苦赚的钱被白白缴税，所以他们在移民前早做了税务规划。可是殊不知所谓经过”高人”指点的策略，却让他们遭遇美国国税局彻查，若查出违法时，有时连绿卡都保不住。
a577643ef8777617783e2beb325cc362edf33e5e.translatedText: China Overseas Chinese Network, March 22 According to the US "World Journal" report, unlike the old immigrants decades ago who dared to pursue the "American Dream" with $200, today's new immigrants are becoming more and more economically powerful, and most of them are highly educated talents or business owners. As we all know, the United States imposes serious taxes. In order to avoid paying taxes in vain on their hard-earned money, they made tax planning before immigrating. However, little did they know that the so-called strategies guided by "experts" have caused them to encounter thorough investigations by the US Internal Revenue Service. If they are found to have violated the law, sometimes they cannot even keep their green cards.

2eb4e9105fa2f3060aa08ccaa65c282bba4b71d0.sourceText: 会计师和税务律师童志敏(Derek Tung)分享一个具代表性的案例，刘先生和刘太太2015年4月从中国移民美国，移民前将持有一家公司100%的权益转让到父母和兄弟名下。这家公司收入超过5000万元人民币，注册资金为2000万元人民币。刘先生为这家公司工作，每年有4万美元收入，他的工资是公司所有管理人员中最高的，并拥有公司签字权。他们的父母和兄弟每年都会”赠予”刘氏夫妇50万美元，刘氏夫妇也将这笔支出申报为赠予。
2eb4e9105fa2f3060aa08ccaa65c282bba4b71d0.translatedText: Accountant and tax lawyer Derek Tung shared a representative case. Mr. Liu and Mrs. Liu immigrated to the United States from China in April 2015. Before immigrating, they transferred 100% of the interests in a company to their parents and brothers. The company's revenue exceeds 50 million yuan and its registered capital is 20 million yuan. Mr. Liu works for this company and earns US$40,000 per year. His salary is the highest among all managers in the company and he has the company's signature authority. Their parents and brothers would "gift" the Lius $500,000 every year, and the Lius also declared this expenditure as a gift.

05e0c358072294ea84ca69e991293a18a023eab3.sourceText: 刘氏夫妇有一个小孩，虽然不在美国工作，但经常来往于中美之间，他们在中国的银行帐户存款都不超过1万美元，有几张借记卡(Debit Card)，每张都有超过1万美元的存款，有100美元的利息收入，没有任何股息分红。他们有一栋房子以187万美元购得，并有50万美元贷款，2017年他们被国税局审查。
05e0c358072294ea84ca69e991293a18a023eab3.translatedText: The Lius have a child. Although they do not work in the United States, they often travel between China and the United States. Their bank account deposits in China do not exceed US$10,000. They have several debit cards, each with a deposit of more than US$10,000, with interest income of US$100, and no dividends. They had a house they bought for $1.87 million and had a $500,000 loan, and they were audited by the IRS in 2017.

eb701a0f60dd77e1b30c8d8563e54380ad7b7000.sourceText: 童志敏表示，国税局控诉他们没有申报公司名下的银行账户，50万美元赠予是否需要缴税的问题，以及隐瞒交易来源、交易权属、资金控制等。刘氏夫妇的经历也是许多新移民面临的问题，虽然只报了两年的税，2017年就被查税，”只要认罪，输了官司，绝对取消绿卡资格”。
eb701a0f60dd77e1b30c8d8563e54380ad7b7000.translatedText: Tong Zhimin said that the IRS accused them of not declaring the bank account in the company's name, whether tax was required for the $500,000 gift, and of concealing the source of the transaction, transaction ownership, and fund control. The Lius' experience is also a problem faced by many new immigrants. Although they only filed taxes for two years, they were inspected in 2017. "As long as they plead guilty and lose the lawsuit, their green card qualifications will definitely be cancelled."

b2a25cbd78c6adf28f843d02222c2d9f6d4e25b1.sourceText: 他说，类似该案由第三方持有财产(Property Held By Third Party)，很多时候是为了避免财产被放置联邦欠税留置权，因此纳税人将其资产转移给亲友避税，但此举一般不会成功，因为联邦欠税留置权会延伸至由第三方持有的财产。
b2a25cbd78c6adf28f843d02222c2d9f6d4e25b1.translatedText: He said that in cases like this one, where property was held by a third party (Property Held By Third Party), taxpayers often transfer their assets to relatives and friends to avoid having federal tax liens placed on the property, but this generally does not succeed because the federal tax lien will extend to the property held by a third party.

6c0bac83e1d52a0b8b020f26de0ec102b3e2a111.sourceText: 该案国税局最后的结论是：50万元不是赠予，而是纳税人没有申报他们控制的公司在2015至2016年的额外收入(additional income)，并判罚1万美元。照说依法若没有申报海外资产，罚款可以高达其存款余额的50%，但在他的争取下锐减。
6c0bac83e1d52a0b8b020f26de0ec102b3e2a111.translatedText: The final conclusion of the IRS in this case was that the 500,000 yuan was not a gift, but the taxpayer's failure to declare the additional income (additional income) of the company they controlled from 2015 to 2016, and a fine of US$10,000 was imposed. According to the law, if you fail to declare overseas assets, the fine can be as high as 50% of your deposit balance, but this was reduced sharply after his fight.

8497b3f953568d4a71830c0461f719d91d4820d2.sourceText: 总之由于刘氏夫妇听取别人的税务规划建议，很难判定最初就有意欺诈国税局，所以该案最后从刑事案变为民事官司，当事人才得以保住绿卡。
8497b3f953568d4a71830c0461f719d91d4820d2.translatedText: In short, because the Liu couple listened to other people's tax planning advice, it was difficult to determine that they had intended to defraud the IRS in the first place. Therefore, the case was eventually changed from a criminal case to a civil lawsuit, and the parties were able to keep their green cards.

ab56849e011f856af5370563d7922af16f07f514.sourceText: 童志敏说，刘氏夫妇移民美国才短短两年，就遭遇国税局审查。不过有关方面会根据当事人移民时间长短，处事手法，也就是每个事实都可能影响审判结果。(王全秀子)
ab56849e011f856af5370563d7922af16f07f514.translatedText: Tong Zhimin said that the Liu couple had been audited by the IRS just two years after they immigrated to the United States. However, the relevant parties will depend on the length of time the parties have immigrated and their handling of affairs, that is, each fact may affect the outcome of the trial. (Wang Quanxiuzi)

f5600fd1946408230ea2ef7289793d65303638f5.sourceText: Global Ties Arizona舉辦農曆新年慶典 展現多元文化魅力
f5600fd1946408230ea2ef7289793d65303638f5.translatedText: Global Ties Arizona held a Lunar New Year celebration to show the charm of multiculturalism

79dba332d411a366614c86baa5992722868810f3.sourceText: 【亞利桑那州斯科茨代爾訊】3月6日晚，由國際交流組織 Global Ties Arizona 舉辦的第三屆農曆…
79dba332d411a366614c86baa5992722868810f3.translatedText: [Scottsdale, Arizona] On the evening of March 6, the third Lunar New Year celebration organized by the international exchange organization Global Ties Arizona…

a79f7545b69a18acae3cffe28688c5e015c2eecb.sourceText: 【亞利桑那州斯科茨代爾訊】3月6日晚，由國際交流組織 Global Ties Arizona 舉辦的第三屆農曆新年慶典在 Western Spirit: Scottsdale’s Museum of the West 隆重舉行。來自不同國家和文化背景的嘉賓齊聚一堂，共同慶祝這一具有東方傳統特色的節日。
a79f7545b69a18acae3cffe28688c5e015c2eecb.translatedText: [Scottsdale, Arizona] On the evening of March 6, the third Lunar New Year celebration organized by the international exchange organization Global Ties Arizona was held at Western Spirit: Scottsdale’s Museum of the West Held solemnly. Guests from different countries and cultural backgrounds gathered together to celebrate this festival with oriental traditional characteristics.

62f6eb75ec00026738561c71708e0d6cca7b6628.sourceText: 活動現場洋溢著濃厚的中國農曆新年氛圍。晚會以中國舞蹈《好日子》熱鬧開場，隨後精彩節目輪番上演。舞獅表演氣勢熱烈，贏得觀眾陣陣掌聲；華人畫家 范融先生 現場揮毫作畫，以馬為主題展示中國水墨藝術；具有兩千多年曆史的中國傳統樂器 古箏獨奏 悠揚動聽。此外，越南舞蹈與歌曲表演也為晚會增添了多元文化色彩。華裔僑領 Barry 擔任整場活動主持人，使晚會氣氛熱烈而融洽。
62f6eb75ec00026738561c71708e0d6cca7b6628.translatedText: The event site was filled with a strong Chinese New Year atmosphere. The party started lively with the Chinese dance "Good Day", followed by exciting performances. The lion dance performance was enthusiastic and won rounds of applause from the audience; the Chinese painter Mr. Fan Rong painted on the spot, using horses as the theme to show Chinese ink art; the guzheng, a traditional Chinese musical instrument with a history of more than 2,000 years, played a melodious solo. In addition, Vietnamese dance and song performances also added a multicultural touch to the party. Barry, a Chinese-American leader, served as the host of the entire event, making the party atmosphere warm and harmonious.

b887909f055ec2a6315ee8925ff4e63d50e9f151.sourceText: 華人畫家 范融先生 現場揮毫作畫
b887909f055ec2a6315ee8925ff4e63d50e9f151.translatedText: Chinese painter Mr. Fan Rong painted on the spot

6b6cfbd254d9a5c9619f9420fae646374530f9fd.sourceText: 在節目之外，來賓還可以體驗中國書法，將自己的名字寫成中文作為紀念。主辦方還準備了家庭式晚宴和甜點，讓嘉賓在輕鬆愉快的氛圍中交流互動。
6b6cfbd254d9a5c9619f9420fae646374530f9fd.translatedText: In addition to the program, guests can also experience Chinese calligraphy and write their names in Chinese as a souvenir. The organizers also prepared a family-style dinner and desserts to allow guests to interact in a relaxed and pleasant atmosphere.

22e3eba7ed3f44cb931d74ee342f75a361dd7262.sourceText: Global Ties Arizona 是亞利桑那州致力於推動國際交流與民間外交的非營利組織，通過國際訪問項目、文化交流和社區活動促進亞利桑那與世界各國之間的理解與合作。該機構擁有近60年的歷史，長期接待來自世界各地的國際代表團，並組織各類跨文化活動，幫助當地社區更好地瞭解全球文化與事務。
22e3eba7ed3f44cb931d74ee342f75a361dd7262.translatedText: >Global Ties Arizona is a non-profit organization in Arizona dedicated to promoting international exchanges and people-to-people diplomacy, promoting understanding and cooperation between Arizona and other countries around the world through international visit projects, cultural exchanges and community activities. The institution has a history of nearly 60 years. It has long received international delegations from all over the world and organized various cross-cultural activities to help local communities better understand global culture and affairs.

8453a6c70bc0705acf0837a40a9f302f0a7acc3e.sourceText: 此次農曆新年慶典不僅展示了中國傳統文化，也體現了鳳凰城地區多元文化交融的活力，成為促進不同文化交流與友誼的一場精彩盛會。
8453a6c70bc0705acf0837a40a9f302f0a7acc3e.translatedText: This Lunar New Year celebration not only showcases Chinese traditional culture, but also embodies the vitality of multicultural integration in the Phoenix area, becoming a wonderful event that promotes exchanges and friendship between different cultures.
